text: athAto mahAcatuShpAdamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
sheShatvAdAyuSho yApyamasAdhyaM pathyasevayA| labdhAlpasukhamalpena hetunA~a~ashupravartakam||17||
gambhIraM bahudhAtusthaM marmasandhisamAshritam| nityAnushAyinaM rogaM dIrghakAlamavasthitam||18||
...tadvat pratyAkhyeyaM tridoShajam| kriyApathamatikrAntaM sarvamArgAnusAriNam||19||
autsukyAratisammohakaramindriyanAshanam| durbalasya susaMvRuddhaM vyAdhiM sAriShTameva ca||20||
bhiShajA prAk parIkShyaivaM vikArANAM svalakShaNam| pashcAtkarmasamArambhaH kAryaH sAdhyeShu dhImatA||21||
sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgaj~jo yaH samyakpratipattimAn| na sa maitreyatulyAnAM mithyAbuddhiM prakalpayet||22||
tatra shlokau- ihauShadhaM pAdaguNAH prabhavo bheShajAshrayaH| AtreyamaitreyamatI matidvaividhyanishcayaH||23||
caturvidhavikalpAshca vyAdhayaH svasvalakShaNAH| uktA mahAcatuShpAde yeShvAyattaM bhiShagjitam||24||

catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante, yaduktaM pUrvAdhyAye ShoDashaguNamiti, tadbheShajaM yuktiyuktamalamArogyAyeti bhagavAn punarvasurAtreyaH||3||

Commentary: ShoDashakalaM ShoDashaguNaM, kalAshabdo guNavacanaH| bhiShajo bhAShanta iti bruvate| prakRute~arthe shAstrAntarasammatiM darshayati- yuktiyuktamiti| yunaktIti yuktiH pravRuttirucyate; yuktiyuktaM pravRuttimadityarthaH; pravRuttishca vaidyAdInAM cikitsArUpA pUrvAdhyAye vyAkRutA| alaM samartham| iti bhagavAnAtreyo ‘brUte’ iti sheShaH||3||

neti maitreyaH, kiM kAraNaM? dRushyante hyAturAH kecidupakaraNavantashca paricArakasampannAshcAtmavantashca kushalaishca bhiShagbhiranuShThitAH samuttiShThamAnAH, tathAyuktAshcApare mriyamANAH; tasmAdbheShajamaki~jcitkaraM bhavati, tadyathA- shvabhre sarasi ca prasiktamalpamudakaM, nadyAM vA syandamAnAyAM pAMsudhAne vA pAMsumuShTiH prakIrNa iti; tathA~apare dRushyante~anupakaraNAshcAparicArakAshcAnAtmavantashcAkushalaishca bhiShagbhiranuShThitAH samuttiShThamAnAH, tathAyuktA mriyamANAshcApare| yatashca pratikurvan sidhyati, pratikurvan mriyate; apratikurvan sidhyati, apratikurvan mriyate; tatashcintyate bheShajamabheShajenAvishiShTamiti ||4||

Commentary: uktamAkShipati- netItyAdi| upakaraNaM bheShajam| anuShThitAH cikitsitumupakrAntAH| tathAyuktAH pUrvavaccikitsitumupakrAntA ityarthaH| aki~jcitkaramiti bheShaje satyapi yadA~a~arogyaM na bhavati; tena, yatrApi sati bheShaje ArogyaM bhavati, tatrApi bheShajavyatiriktaM karmaiva daivasa~jj~jakaM kAraNaM, bheShajaM tu tatra daivAgatasannidhAnamakAraNamevetyarthaH| atraivArthe dRuShTAntadvayaM darshayati- tadyathetyAdi| shvabhre garte yathA~alpaM jalamaki~jcitkaramevaM mriyamANe~api bheShajaM, yathA ca sarasi anyata eva pUrNe~alpamudakamaki~jcitkaraM bhavatyevamanyata evArogyahetoH karmaNo rogaprashamane jAyamAne bheShajamaki~jcitkaraM bhavatIti sarodRuShTAntena darshayati; evaM nadyAM syandamAnAyAM vahamAnAyAM pAMsumuShTiriti nidarshanaM shvabhravat, pAMsudhAne pAMshurAshau pAMshumuShTiriti sarodRuShTAntavadvyAkhyeyam| atra ca toyadRuShTAntaH saMshodhanabheShajAbhiprAyeNa, pAMshudRuShTAntastu saMshamanabheShajAbhiprAyeNa; yadi vA jalaM santarpaNabheShajAbhiprAyeNa, pAMshumuShTistvapatarpaNAbhiprAyeNa boddhavyA| bheShajAnvayavyabhicAraM darshayitvA tadvyatirekavyabhicAraM darshayati- tathA~apare ityAdi| pratikurvannityantarbhAvitaNyarthatvAt pratikArayannityarthaH; yadi vA~a~atura eva vaidyAdInutpAdyAtmAnaM pratikurvanniti mantavyam; etena daivAkhyakarmavashAdevAyaM jIvati mriyate vA, rogI bhavatyarogo vA, na dRuShTabheShajamatra ki~jcitkaramiti pUrvapakShArthaH||4||

maitreya ! mithyA cintyata ityAtreyaH; kiM kAraNaM, ye hyAturAH ShoDashaguNasamuditenAnena bheShajenopapadyamAnA mriyanta ityuktaM tadanupapannaM, na hi bheShajasAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAM bheShajamakAraNaM bhavati; ye punarAturAH kevalAdbheShajAdRute samuttiShThante, na teShAM sampUrNabheShajopapAdanAya samutthAnavisheSho nAsti; yathA hi patitaM puruShaM samarthamutthAnAyotthApayan puruSho balamasyopAdadhyAt, sa kShiprataramaparikliShTa evottiShThet, tadvat sampUrNabheShajopalambhAdAturAH; ye cAturAH kevalAdbheShajAdapi mriyante, na ca sarva eva te bheShajopapannAH samuttiShTheran, nahi sarve vyAdhayo bhavantyupAyasAdhyAH, na copAyasAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAmanupAyena siddhirasti, na cAsAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAM bheShajasamudAyo~ayamasti , na hyalaM j~jAnavAn bhiSha~gmumUrShumAturamutthApayituM; parIkShyakAriNo hi kushalA bhavanti, yathA hi yogaj~jo~abhyAsanitya iShvAso dhanurAdAyeShumasyannAtiviprakRuShTe mahati kAye nAparAdhavAn bhavati, sampAdayati ceShTakAryaM, tathA bhiShak svaguNasampanna upakaraNavAn vIkShya karmArabhamANaH sAdhyarogamanaparAdhaH sampAdayatyevAturamArogyeNa; tasmAnna bheShajamabheShajenAvishiShTaM bhavati||5||

Commentary: siddhAntayati- mithyetyAdi| kevalAt sampUrNAt| na nAstItyubhayanakArakaraNAdasti samutthAnavisheSha ityarthaH| tadvaditi kShiprataramakliShTA evottiShThanta ityarthaH| evaM manyate- yadyapyadRuShTamevotthAne kAraNaM, tathA~api yadi dRuShTamapi tatrAnubalaM bhavati, tadA dRuShTAdRuShTobhayabalAcchIghramevArogyaM bhavati| sarva eveti sAdhyavyAdhayo~asAdhyavyAdhayashca; sampUrNabheShajopapattAvapi satyAmasAdhyavyAdhayo nottiShThante, sAdhyavyAdhaya uttiShThanta iti bhAvaH| yadyapyasAdhyavyAdhiM prati sampUrNabheShajopapattireva nAsti, yaduktaM- “na cAsAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAM bheShajasamudAyo~ayamasti, nahyalaM j~jAnavAn bhiSha~gmumUrShumAturamutthApayitum” iti, tathA~apIha ki~jcidasampUrNabheShajatve~api sampUrNabheShajopapanna ityuktam| ye tu sAdhyavyAdhayaste satyAmeva bheShajasampattau jIvanti, asatyAM tu bheShajasampattau balavajjIvanakarmAbhAve mriyanta eveti darshayannAha- na copAyetyAdi| upAyenaiva dRuShTArthena sAdhyA upAyasAdhyAH| idamatrAkUtaM- yat- dvividhaM karma balavadabalavacca; tatra balavanniyatavipAkakAlaM, yathedaM karmAsminneva kAle mArayati; abalavacca mArakaM karma mArayatveva paraM kAlAniyamena, tadyadA dRuShTasAmagrImanuguNAmapathyasevArUpAmauShadhAbhAvarUpAM ca prApnoti tadA mArayati, yadA tu na prApnoti tadA na mArayati| yaduktaM janapadoddhvaMsanIye- “karma ki~jcit kvacit kAle vipAke niyataM mahat| ki~jcinna kAlaniyataM pratyayaiH pratibodhyate” (vi.a.3) iti| asya tvarthaM prapa~jcena tatraiva darshayiShyAmaH| na ca vAcyam- adRuShTameva sarvatra kAraNaM, tacca niyatakAlavipAkameva, yaducyate- “nAkAle jAyate kashcinnAkAle mriyate tathA| jagat kAlavashaM sarvaM kAlaH sarvatra kAraNam”  iti; yataH, yadevAdRuShTaM tadeva dRuShTayAgAdibrahmavadhAdijanyaM ki~jcit| yaddRuShTenAnupapannaM, tatrAdRuShTakalpanA prAmANikI, yattu dAhAdi dRuShTenaivAgnisambandhenopapadyate tatra kA kathA~adRuShTasya dRuShTakAryAnyathAnupapattiparikalpanIyasya; tena ya ime durbalena karmaNA dRuShTabalavadapathyasevAjanitadoShabalAdArabdhA vyAdhayaste balavatA catuShpAdasampannena bheShajena doShakShayakenopAyena paraM sAdhyAH, tadabhAve tu durbalenApi karmaNA dRuShTadoShabalAdArabdhA vyAdhayo na nivartanta iti| yaduktaM- “daivaM puruShakAreNa durbalaM hyupahanyate| daivena cetarat karma vishiShTenopahanyate” (vi.a.3) iti| anupAyena abheShajena| ayaM bheShajasamudAyaH sarvaguNasampanna ityarthaH; asAdhye vyAdhau cikitsAM kurvan vaidya eva yathoktaguNo na bhavatItyarthaH| nahyalaM na samarthaH; yadyasAdhyatAM jAnAti tadA na pravartata eva, atha na jAnAti tadA j~jAnavAneva na bhavatIti bhAvaH| catuShpAdasampadA~avashyaM vyAdhiprashamo bhavatIti dRuShTAntenAha- yathA hItyAdi| iShvAso dhAnuShkaH| asyan kShipan| nAtiviprakRuShTe sannihite| anaparAdha iti lakShyabhraMsharahitaH| iShTaM kAryaM lakShyavedhalakShaNam||5||

idaM ca naH pratyakShaM- yadanAtureNa bheShajenAturaM cikitsAmaH , kShAmamakShAmeNa, kRushaM ca durbalamApyAyayAmaH, sthUlaM medasvinamapatarpayAmaH, shItenoShNAbhibhUtamupacarAmaH, shItAbhibhUtamuShNena, nyUnAn dhAtUn pUrayAmaH, vyatiriktAn hrAsayAmaH, vyAdhIn mUlaviparyayeNopacarantaH samyak prakRutau sthApayAmaH; teShAM nastathA kurvatAmayaM bheShajasamudAyaH kAntatamo bhavati||6||

Commentary: bheShajasya rogaprashamakartRutve upapattyantaramAha- idaM cetyAdi| anAtureNeti AturaguNaviparItena| AturamanAtureNa cikitsAma iti yaduktaM, tasyaiva vivaraNaM- kShAmamakShAmeNetyAdi| kShAmo nirdravaH| kRushaM ca durbalamApyAyayAma iti santarpayAmaH| vyatiriktAniti atiriktAnityarthaH | mUlaviparyayeNeti kAraNaviparyayeNa, tacca prabhAvAditi boddhavyaM; tena viShavikArasya viSheNopacaraNametat pratyakShaM cAnyadupagRuhItaM bhavati| kAntatamo vikAraprashamakatvenAbhIShTatamaH; anye~arthadharmopAyAH kAntAH kAntatarAshca, ayaM tu bheShajasamudAyaH sarvocchedakarogaharatvena kAntatamaH||6||
bhavanti cAtra- sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgaj~jo j~jAnapUrvaM cikitsakaH| kAle cArabhate karma yattat sAdhayati dhruvam||7||
arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham | prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret||8||
sukhasAdhyaM mataM sAdhyaM kRucchrasAdhyamathApi ca| dvividhaM cApyasAdhyaM syAdyApyaM yaccAnupakramam ||9||
sAdhyAnAM trividhashcAlpamadhyamotkRuShTatAM prati| vikalpo, na tvasAdhyAnAM niyatAnAM vikalpanA||10||
hetavaH pUrvarUpANi rUpANyalpAni yasya ca| na ca tulyaguNo dUShyo na doShaH prakRutirbhavet||11||
na ca kAlaguNastulyo na desho durupakramaH| gatirekA navatvaM ca rogasyopadravo na ca||12||
doShashcaikaH samutpattau dehaH sarvauShadhakShamaH| catuShpAdopapattishca sukhasAdhyasya lakShaNam||13||
nimittapUrvarUpANAM rUpANAM madhyame bale| kAlaprakRutidUShyANAM sAmAnye~anyatamasya ca||14||
garbhiNIvRuddhabAlAnAM nAtyupadravapIDitam| shastrakShArAgnikRutyAnAmanavaM kRucchradeshajam||15||
vidyAdekapathaM rogaM nAtipUrNacatuShpadam| dvipathaM nAtikAlaM vA kRucchrasAdhyaM dvidoShajam||16||

pUrvAdhyAye vaidyAdayo vyAdhiprashamakAraNamityuktaM, tadihAkShipya vyavasthApyata ityanantaraM mahAcatuShpAdo~abhidhIyate| mahattvaM cAsya pUrvAdhyAyApekShayA, bahugranthatvena pUrvapakShasiddhAntarUpabahuprameyAbhidhAyakatvena ca||1-2||

yApyatvenaivAsAdhyatve labdhe yadasAdhyamiti padaM tadyApyayApanArthaM kriyamANabheShajatayA sAdhyatvasha~gkAnirAsArtham| sheShatvAdAyuSha iti vacanamAyuHsheShe vidyamAna eva yApyavyAdhiprAdurbhAvo bhavatIti darshanArtham| pathyasevayA bheShajasevayA, labdhamalpaM sukhaM yasmin tallabdhAlpasukham| pravartanaM pravartaH, alpena hetunA~a~ashu shIghraM pravartanaM yasya tadAshupravartakaM; svArthe aN| gambhIraM medaHprabhRutidhAtugatam| nityAnushAyI nityAnubandhaH| vidyAddvidoShajamityantena yApyalakShaNam||17-18||-

tadvadityAdi tu pratyAkhyeyalakShaNam| tadvadityanena gambhIrAdiyApyalakShaNayuktaM sattridoShajaM pratyAkhyeyamityarthaH| autsukyaM harShodrekaH, aratiranavasthAnalakShaNA, sammoho manaso mohaH||19-20||

na sa maitreyatulyAnAM mithyAbuddhiM prakalpayediti eva~gguNo vaidyaH pratiniyamena yaM vyAdhimupakramettaM sAdhayatyeva paraM, tato bheShajasya vyAdhiprashamanaM prati karaNatvAvadhAraNe sati bheShajamabheShajena samAnamiti maitreyasadRushAnAM karmavAdinAM mithyAbuddheranutpAda iti bhAvaH||21-22||
sa~ggrahe iheti ihAdhyAye| auShadhamiti catuShpAdam| pAdaguNA iti yaduktaM pUrvAdhyAye ShoDashaguNamiti| prabhAvo bheShajAshraya iti tadbheShajaM yuktiyuktamalamArogyAyeti||23-24||

j~jAnapUrvamiti bheShajAdij~jAnapUrvaM, yat karmArabhate tat karma cikitsitarUpaM, sAdhayati ‘sAdhyaM’ iti sheShaH| asAdhyavyAdhau na pravartitavyamiti shikShayati- arthetyAdi| arthaH arthalAbhaH, hAniH kShatiH| upakrosho janApavAdaH| asa~ggrahaH cikitsArthamanupAdAnaM; yadi ‘vA asadgraha’ iti pAThaH, tadA cAsadgraho rAjadaNDenAsatpuruShaishcANDAlAdibhirgrahaNam||7-8||

sAdhye pravRuttiruktA, asAdhye nivRuttishca, tena sAdhyAsAdhyayorbhedakathanapUrvakaM lakShaNaM vaktumAha- sukhasAdhyamityAdi| aki~jcitkaratvenAvidyamAna upakramo yasya tadanupakramaM; yApyaM tvanupakramaM na bhavati, yApanAkartRutvena ki~jcitkaratvAt| tatropakramasyAlpamadhyamotkRuShTatAM pratIti alpamadhyamotkRuShTayogAdityarthaH; tenAlpasAdhyamalpopAyasAdhyaM, madhyasAdhyaM madhyopAyasAdhyam, utkRuShTasAdhyamutkRuShTopAyasAdhyamiti bhedatrayaM sAdhyAnAM bhavati| asAdhyAnAM tu niyatAnAmiti yApyavyatiriktAnAmanupakramANAM, vikalpanA vikalpaH, nAstIti evambhUtA~alpAsAdhyAdirUpA nAsti; prANahara-vaikalyakara-sadyaHprANahara-kAlAntaraprANaharatvAdikalpanA tvasAdhyAnAmastyeva; yadasAdhyaM tadalpena madhyena cotkRuShTena copAyenAsAdhyameva; yApyarUpAsAdhyAnAM tvalpopAyayApyatvAdibhedo~astyeva||9-10||

na doShaH prakRutirbhavediti vyAdhyArambhako yo doShaH sa tatprakRutAvutkaTo na bhavedityarthaH| desho bhUmirAturashca| desho durupakramo yathA- vAtavyAdhau tulyaguNo maruH, tathA shleShmavyAdhAvanUpaH| dehashca durupakramo yathA- sarvavyAdhInAmeva marmalakShaNo deshaH, tathA vAtavyAdheH pakvAshaya ityAdi| gatirekA eko mArga ityarthaH, mArgAstrayastisraiShaNIye vaktavyAH- “shAkhA marmAsthisandhayaH koShThashca” (sU.a.11) iti| etaccotsarganyAyenoktaM, tena kvacidvyAdhiprabhAvAdanyathA~api sukhasAdhyatvAdilakShaNAbhidhAnena virodho na vaktavyaH| yaduktaM- “jvare tulyartudoShatvaM pramehe tulyadUShyatA| raktagulme purANatvaM sukhasAdhyasya lakShaNam” iti||11-13||

kAlaprakRutidUShyANAmiti nirdhAraNe ShaShThI| sAmAnya iti doSheNa samam| garbhiNIvRuddhabAlAnAM sarva eva vyAdhiH kRucchrasAdhyo boddhavyaH| nAtyupadravapIDitamiti pUrveNa na yojanIyaM, kintu svatantrameva| shastrakShArAgnikRutyAH shastrakShArAgnisAdhyAH; eShAM yo vyAdhistaM kRucchrasAdhyaM vidyAditi sambandhaH| kRucchradeshajaM marmasandhyAdijam| ekapathasya visheShaNaM- nAtipUrNacatuShpadamiti| dvipathamityasya visheShaNaM- nAtikAlamiti||14-16||
athAtastisraiShaNIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
pratyakShapUrvaM trividhaM trikAlaM cAnumIyate| vahnirnigUDho dhUmena maithunaM garbhadarshanAt||21||
evaM vyavasyantyatItaM bIjAt phalamanAgatam| dRuShTvA bIjAt phalaM jAtamihaiva sadRushaM budhAH||22||
jalakarShaNabIjartusaMyogAt sasyasambhavaH| yuktiH ShaDdhAtusaMyogAdgarbhANAM sambhavastathA||23||
mathyamanthana(ka)manthAnasaMyogAdagnisambhavaH| yuktiyuktA catuShpAdasampadvyAdhinibarhaNI||24||

buddhiH pashyati yA bhAvAn bahukAraNayogajAn| yuktistrikAlA sA j~jeyA trivargaH sAdhyate yayA||25||

Commentary: samprati yukterlakShaNamAha- buddhirityAdi| yA buddhirbhAvAn pashyati viShayIkaroti, bahukAraNayogo bahUpapattiyogaH, janishcAyaM j~jAnArthe, tena bahUpapattiyogaj~jAyamAnAnarthAn yA buddhiH pashyati UhalakShaNA sA yuktiriti pramANasahAyIbhUtA| evamanena bhavitavyamityevaMrUpa Uho~atra yuktishabdenAbhidhIyate; sA ca paramArthato~apramANabhUtA~api vastuparicchede pramANasahAyatvena vyApriyamANatvAt, tathA tayaiva UharUpayA prAyo lokAnAM vyavahArAdiha pramANatvenoktA| ata eva pradeshAntare yuktiM vinA yathoktaM pramANatrayaM darshayiShyati- “trividhA vA (parIkShA) sahopadeshena” (vi. a.4) iti vacanAt| tathA, upamAnaM gRuhItvA rogabhiShagjitIye shabdAdIni catvAri pramANAnyabhidhAsyati| trikAlA vartamAnAtItAnAgataviShayA; trikAlaviShayatvaM cAsyAstrikAlAnumAnaviShayopadeshakatvenaiva| trivargasAdhakatvaM ca trivargasAdhanAdeva, Uhenaiva hi prAyastrivargAnuShThAne pravRuttirbhavati; (pramANaparicchedena tu pracAro virala eva|) yattu bahukAraNajalakarShaNabIjartusaMyogAdbhAvisasyaj~jAnaM yuktirucyate, taccAnumAnAnnArthAntarabhUtaM; tatrAnumAnAdbhedo duShkara iti nAdriyAmahe; ki~jca kAraNebhyaH kAryaM pratIyamAnaM na kadA~api vartamAnaM pratIyate, tatashca trikAleti parAhataM syAt| atra shAntarakShitakamalashIlAbhyAM yuktipramANAntarasvIkAre pUrvapakShasiddhAntAvuktau- “yasmin sati bhavatyeva na bhavatyasatIti ca| tasmAdato bhavatyetadyuktireShA~abhidhIyate|| pramANAntaramevedamityAha carakA muniH| nAnumAnamiyaM yasmAddRuShTAnto~atra na vidyate” (ta.saM.kA.1692-93) iti| etacchAntarakShitavacanaM kamalashIlena vyAkhyAtaM- “tadbhAvabhAvitvena yA tatkAryatApratItiriyaM yuktiH; iyaM ca savikalpatvAnna pratyakShaM; nApyanumAnaM dRuShTAntAbhAvAt, tathAhi- dRuShTAnto~api- ata eva tadbhAvabhAvitvAttatkAryatApratipattiH, tatrApi dRuShTAnto~anyo~anveShaNIyaH , tatrApyapara ityanavasthA syAt; tasmAt pramANAntaraM yuktirityAha carako vaidyaH; evaM pUrvapakShamutthApya dUShitaM yat- “kAryakAraNabhAvasya pratipattirna sa~ggatA| tasmAdasyAM na bhedo~asti sAdhyasAdhanayoryataH|| tadbhAvavyavahAre tu yogyatAyAH prasAdhane| sa~gketakAlavij~jAto vidyate~artho nidarshanam” (ta.saM.kA.1696-48)| etadvyAkhyAtaM kamalashIlena- “yuktau na sAdhyasAdhanayorbhedaH; tathAhi- atra tadbhAvabhAvitA hetuH, kAryakAraNatA ca sAdhyA, na cAnayorbheda upalabhyate paryAyatvAttarupAdapavat; atha mataM- na kAryakAraNatA sAdhyate kintarhi tadbhAvavyavahAra iti, tatrAha- tadbhAvavyavahAre ityAdi; tasyA hetuphalatAyA bhAvastadbhAvaH, tatra vyavahAro yaH sa tadbhAvavyavahAraH j~jAnAbhidhAnapravRuttilakShaNamanuShThAnaM, tasmin yogyatA mUDhaM prati sAdhyate; ye yadvyApArAnantaraniyatopalambhasvabhAvAste tatkAryavyavahArayogyAH, tadyathA- sa~gketakAlAnubhUtAH kulAlAdivyApArAnantaropalambhasvabhAvA ghaTAdayaH; tathA ca tAlvAdivyApArAnantaraniyatopalambhasvabhAvAH shabdA iti svabhAvo hetuH; tatashca sa dRuShTAntatvAdanumAnAdabhedo yukteH”| etau ca pUrvapakShasiddhAntau evambhUtayuktyasvIkArAdevApratividheyau ||25||

eShA parIkShA nAstyanyA yayA sarvaM parIkShyate| parIkShyaM sadasaccaivaM tayA cAsti punarbhavaH||26||

Commentary: upasaMharati- eShetyAdi| nAstyanyetivacanenArthApattyasambhavAdInAmanyatantramatAnAM pramANAnAM niShedhaM karoti| prastute parIkShAM prayojayati- tayA cAsti upalabhyate ca punarbhava iti||26||

tatrAptAgamastAvadvedaH , yashcAnyo~api kashcidvedArthAdaviparItaH parIkShakaiH praNItaH shiShTAnumato lokAnugrahapravRuttaH shAstravAdaH, sa cA~a~aptAgamaH; AptAgamAdupalabhyatedAnatapoyaj~jasatyAhiMsAbrahmacaryANyabhyudayaniHshreyasakarANIti||27||

Commentary: tatra shabdasya punarbhavapratipAdakatvaM darshayati- tatrA~a~aptAgama ityAdi| prathamaM vedaM pradarshayan vedasya nirastavibhramAsha~gkaM prAmANyaM darshayati, yashcAnyo~apItyanena granthena vedArthAviparItatvAdibhirhetubhiH paricchedanIyaprAmANyAyurvedasmRutishAstrAdIni darshayati| shAstrarUpo vAdaH shAstravAdaH| AptAgamAditi vedAt| yaj~jaH agniShTomAdiH; brahmAcaryam upasthasaMyamAdi| abhyudayaH svargaH, niHshreyasaM mokShaH; atra yathAyogyatayA svargasya mokShasya ca kAraNamiti boddhavyam| etena janmAntarabhogyasvargAnekajanmalabhyamokShopadeshenAtmanaH paralokaH kathito bhavatIti bhAvaH||27||

na cAnativRuttasattvadoShANAmadoShairapunarbhavo dharmadvAreShUpadishyate||28||

Commentary: AgamAntaramAha- na cetyAdi| anativRuttau avanupashAntau sattvadoShau manodoShau rajastamorUpau yeShAM te tathA, teShAm; punarbhavo mokShaH, dharmadvAreShu dharmashAstreShu, adoShaiH nirmanodoShairmaharShibhiH, upadishyate na, iti sambandhaH; tena punarbhava upadishyate ityarthaH||28||

dharmadvArAvahitaishca vyapagatabhayarAgadveShalobhamohamAnairbrahmaparairAptaiH karmavidbhiranupahatasattvabuddhipracAraiH pUrvaiH pUrvatarairmaharShibhirdivyacakShubhirdRuShTvopadiShTaH punarbhava iti vyavasyedevam ||29||

Commentary: AgamAntaramRuShivacanamAha- dharmadvAretyAdi| brahmA adhyAtmaj~jAnaM, tatparaiH| karmavidbhiH anuShThAtavyayAgAdikarmavidbhiH| anupahatasattvaguNo buddheH pracAro bodhalakShaNo yeShAM te tathA, etena vishuddhabuddhitvaM darshayati| divyamatIndriyArthadarshi cakShuH samAdhirUpaM j~jAnaM yeShAM te divyacakShuShaH, taiH| dRuShTvopadiShTaH svayamanubhUya kathita ityarthaH| itishabdo hetau| evamiti Agamena||29||

pratyakShamapi copalabhyate- mAtApitrorvisadRushAnyapatyAni, tulyasambhavAnAM varNasvarAkRutisattvabuddhibhAgyavisheShAH, pravarAvarakulajanma, dAsyaishvaryaM, sukhAsukhamAyuH, AyuSho vaiShamyam, iha kRutasyAvAptiH, ashikShitAnAM ca ruditastanapAnahAsatrAsAdInAM pravRuttiH, lakShaNotpattiH, karmasAdRushye phalavisheShaH, medhA kvacit kvacit karmaNyamedhA, jAtismaraNam- ihAgamanamitashcyutAnAmiti , samadarshane priyApriyatvam||30||

Commentary: pratyakShaM ca yadyapi punarbhavaM na gRuhNAti, tathA~api tat punarbhavagrAhakAnumAnasya li~ggagrahaNe yathA vyApriyate tathA darshayati- pratyakShamapItyAdi| visadRushAnIti kashcit kurUpaH, kashcit surUpaH| tulyasambhavAnAM tulyotpAdakAraNAnAM kashcidgauraH kashcit kRuShNaH, evaM svarAdAvapi visheSho boddhavyaH| dAsyaishvaryamiti kasyaciddAsyaM kasyacidaishvaryam| evamaparatrApi viparyayaH puruShabhedena boddhavyaH| sukhAsukhamiti AyuSho visheShaNam| ruditAdayo~amI avyutpannabAlagocaratayA boddhavyAH; ete ca ruditAdayo yathAyogamiShTAniShTasmaraNamantarA na bhavanti, smaraNaM ca pUrvaj~jAnaM vinA na bhavatIti pUrvajanmaj~jAnAnumAnAt paralokAnumAyakA bhavanti| pUrvapratipAditaM ca visadRushatvAdivaicitryamuttaratra pratipAdanIyaM ca lakShaNotpattyAdikAraNAntarAdarshane sati pUrvajanmakRutakAraNAnumAyakamiti paralokAnumAyakaM mantavyam| lakShaNotpattiriti sAmudrakalakShaNapratipAditalakShaNotpattiH| karmasAdRushye sevAdisAdRushye| medhA kvacit karmaNi citralekhanAstravidyAdau| jAteratItAyAH smaraNaM jAtismaraNaM; tadeva smaraNaM darshayati- ihAgamanamitashcyutAnAmiti; iha kule jAto~asmi, itashca kulAdAgato~asmItyevamAkAraM jAtismaraNamityarthaH yadi vA, iha janmani cyutAnAmiha janmani punarAgamanam, anena ca nAmabhrAntyA yamapuruShairnItasya punarAgamanaM dRushyate| samadarshane tulyAkAre kvacit puruShe priyatvaM kvacit punarapriyatvamiti samadarshane priyApriyatvam| atra cAvAntarAnumAnabhedo vistarabhayAnna darshitaH||30||

ata evAnumIyate- yat- svakRutamaparihAryamavinAshi paurvadehikaM daivasa~jj~jakamAnubandhikaM karma, tasyaitat phalam; itashcAnyadbhaviShyatIti; phaladbIjamanumIyate, phalaM ca bIjAt||31||

Commentary: evaM pratyakSheNa li~ggagrahaNaM darshayitvA~anumAnamAha- ata evetyAdi| svakRutam AtmanA kRutam| avinAshIti upabhogaM vinA~avinAshi| paurvadehikaM pUrvadehakRutam| janmAntarANyanugacchatItyAnubandhikam| etatphalamiti visadRushApatyotpAdAdi phalam; etacca sa~gkShepAdvyutpAditameva| itashceti iha janmani kRutAt karmaNaH, anyaditi bhAvijanmAntaraM, bhaviShyatItyanumIyata iti sambandhaH| kathamanumIyate ityAha- phalAdityAdi| phalAt phalasadRushApatyadarshanAt , bIjaM pUrvajanmakRutaM karmAdikAraNamanumIyate; tathA phalaM ca bhAvijanmAntare sukhaduHkhAdi, bIjAdihajanmakRutAt karmaNo~anumIyata iti yojanA||31||

yuktishcaiShA- ShaDdhAtusamudayAdgarbhajanma, kartRukaraNasaMyogAt kriyA; kRutasya karmaNaH phalaM nAkRutasya, nA~gkurotpattirabIjAt; karmasadRushaM phalaM, nAnyasmAdbIjAdanyasyotpattiH; iti yuktiH||32||

Commentary: tarkarUpayuktiviShayatAM paralokasya darshayati- yuktishcaiShetyAdi| ShaDdhAtusamudAyAdgarbhajanmeti vadatA AtmasambandhamantarA cetanA garbhasya notpadyate, AtmA ca paralokasambandha eveti paralokasadbhAve yuktirupadarshyate| kartRukaraNasaMyogAt kriyeti AtmAnaM kartAraM vinA kriyA paridRushyamAnA yAgAdilakShaNA na bhavatIti| Atmana UhaM darshayati- kRutasyetyAdinA~abIjAdityantena| paridRushyamAnadAsyaishvaryAdiphalena janmAntarakRutasya karmaNaH kAraNabhAvaM darshayati| karmasadRushaM phalamiti pUrvakRutashubhakarmaNaH shubhaM putradhanAdi phalam| atra dRuShTAntamAha- nAnyasmAdityAdi| nAnyabIjAt shAlibIjAdanyasya yavA~gkurasyotpattirityarthaH| yuktimupasaMharati- iti yuktiriti| atra bahuvaktavye prameye tathAvidhopayogAbhAvAdvistarabhayAcca vistaro na kRutaH||32||

evaM pramANaishcaturbhirupadiShTe punarbhave dharmadvAreShvavadhIyeta; tadyathA- gurushushrUShAyAmadhyayane vratacaryAyAM dArakriyAyAmapatyotpAdane bhRutyabharaNe~atithipUjAyAM dAne~anabhidhyAyAM tapasyanasUyAyAM dehavA~gmAnase karmaNyakliShTe dehendriyamanorthabuddhyAtmaparIkShAyAM manaHsamAdhAviti; yAni cAnyAnyapyevaMvidhAni karmANi satAmavigarhitAni svargyANi vRuttipuShTikarANi vidyAttAnyArabheta kartuM; tathA kurvanniha caiva yasho labhate pretya ca svargam| iti tRutIyA paralokaiShaNA vyAkhyAtA bhavati||33||

Commentary: samprati paralokaM vyutpAdya tadupayuktadharmasAdhanAnyAha- evamityAdi| dharmadvAreShu dharmasAdhanadvAreShu| iha cAtithipUjAdIni sadvRuttoktAnyapi prakaraNaprAptatvenodAharaNArthaM punarabhidhIyante| dehAdiparIkShAyAmavadhIyeteti vacanAdavadhAnopadarshanena dehAdInAM kShayitvAdi dharmanirUpaNenopajAyamAnAM matiM viShayAnabhiSha~ggaM ca jAyamAnamicchanti| viShayeShu prasaktiM manaso vArayitvA~a~atmani samAdhAnaM manaHsamAdhiH| atra ca sarvatra ‘avadhIyeta’ iti sambandhaH| svargyANi svargahitAni svargakarANIti yAvat| vRutterdhanasya puShTiH vRuttipuShTiH, dharmaiShaNAyAM ca vRuttipuShTikarAbhidhAnaM dharmahetUnAM vRuttihetvavirodhenAcaraNopadeshArtham| yasho labhate dhArmiko~ayamityevamAdikhyAtirUpam| paralaukaiShaNA tRutIyaiva, tatashca punastRutIyeti padaM dharmasya prANadhanakAraNatvena dharmaiShaNAyAH prANadhanaiShaNAtvaprasaktipratiShedhArtham||33||

atha khalu traya upastambhAH, trividhaM balaM, trINyAyatanAni, trayo rogAH, trayo rogamArgAH, trividhA bhiShajaH, trividhamauShadhamiti||34||

Commentary: samprati trisa~gkhyAvacchinnopoddhAtenAnyAnyapi trisa~gkhyAvacchinnAni svasthAturahitatveneha vaktavyAnyAha- atha khalvityAdi| prathamamupastambhA abhidhIyante mUlabhUtasharIradhArakatvena, tadanu balamupastambhAhArAdijanyatvAt, tadanu rogAyatanAni balavirodhakartRutvena, tadanu rogAstajjanyatvena, tadanu tanmArgaj~jAnaM suvinyastameva, tadanu rogapratiShedhArthaM pradhAnakAraNavaidyAbhidhAnaM, tadanu tadupakaraNatvena bhaiShajyam||34||

traya upastambhA iti- AhAraH, svapno, brahmacaryamiti; ebhistribhiryuktiyuktairupastabdhamupastambhaiH sharIraM balavarNopacayopacitamanuvartate yAvadAyuHsaMskArAt saMskAramahitamanupasevamAnasya , ya ihaivopadekShyate||35||

Commentary: anyena stabhyamAnaM dhAryamANamupa samIpaM pradhAnakAraNasya gatvA stambhayati dhArayatItyupastambhaH; yathA gRuhadhAraNaniyuktapradhAnastambhasamIpavartI tadbalAdhAyaka upastambhaH, tathehApi sharIrasyAyuHsampravartakena karmaNA dhriyamANasyAhArAdayo dhArakatvenopastambhA ityucyante| AyatanAni kAraNAni ‘rogasya’ iti sheShaH| brahmacaryashabdena indriyasaMyamasaumanasyaprabhRutayo brahmaj~jAnAnuguNA gRuhyante| AhArAdayashceha pradhAnakalpanayA prashastA eva gRuhyante, tena virUDhakAhArAdInAM sharIrAnustambhakatvaM nodbhAvanIyam; ata eva yuktiyuktairiti visheShaNaM kariShyati, yuktyA prashastena yogena yuktA yuktiyuktAH|  brahmacaryasyAyuktiranabhyAsAdatimAtrendriyasaMyamanAdirUpA, sA hi manaHkShobhAdiheturbhavati| upacitaM yuktam| AyuHsaMskArAt AyuHkAraNaM dharmAdharmAvasAnaM yAvadityarthaH; saMskArashabdaH kAraNavacanaH| AhArAdayashca prAdhAnyenoktAH; tenAbhya~ggAdInAM sharIradhArakatvamaviruddhameva| nanvAhArAdIni samyagAcarato~api visheShairasAtmendriyArthasaMyogAdijanyairvyAdhibhirantarApi maraNaM dRuShTamityAha- saMskAramityAdi| saMskAraM kAraNam| ahitaM ‘sharIrasya’ iti sheShaH| ya ihaivopadekShyata iti ‘trINyAyatanAni’ ityAdinA granthena||35||

iha khalu puruSheNAnupahatasattvabuddhipauruShaparAkrameNa hitamiha cAmuShmiMshca loke samanupashyatA tisra eShaNAH paryeShTavyA bhavanti| tadyathA- prANaiShaNA, dhanaiShaNA, paralokaiShaNeti||3||

Commentary: iheti bhogArthipuruShAdhikAre, yato mokShArthipuruShaM prati dhanaiShaNA sarvathaivAnupayuktA| puruSheNeti padaM kurvan ya eva puruSha eShaNAtrayamanviShyati sa eva puruSho bhaNyate nAnyaH, pashutulyatvAditi darshayati| pauruShaM shArIraM balaM, parAkramastu shauryAkhyaM mAnasaM balam| iheti iha janmani, amuShminniti janmAntare| iShyate~anviShyate sAdhyate~anayetyeShaNA| prANo jIvitaM, tat sAdhyate dIrghatvena rogAnupahatatvena cAnayeti prANaiShaNA| evaM dhanaiShaNA| paralokopakArakasya dharmasyaiShaNA paralokaiShaNA| kAmaiShaNA tu prANaiShaNAdhanaiShaNayorantarbhAvanIyA, sharIrasampattidhanasampattisAdhyatvAt kAmasya; yadi vA kAmaiShaNAyAM svata eva puruShaH pravRutto bhavati nopadeshamapekShata iti tadeShaNopadesho na kRutaH||3||

trividhaM balamiti- sahajaM, kAlajaM, yuktikRutaM ca| sahajaM yaccharIrasattvayoH prAkRutaM, kAlakRutamRutuvibhAgajaM vayaHkRutaM ca, yuktikRutaM punastadyadAhAraceShTAyogajam||36||

Commentary: yuktiH AhAraceShTayoH samyak sharIreNa yojanA| sattvaM manaH, manaso balaM vA yat ‘utsAha ’ ucyate| prAkRutamiti janmAdipravRuttaM prAkRutadhAtuvRuddhyA hetvantaranirapekShaM vRuddhaM, dRushyante hi kecit svabhAvAdeva balino durbalAshca kecit| RutuvibhAgajam “AdAvante ca daurbalyaM” (sU.a.6) ityAdyuktam| AhArasya mAMsasarpirAdeH, ceShTAyA ucitavishrAmavyAyAmAderyoga AhAraceShTAyogaH; anye tu yogashabdena rasAyanaprayogaM grAhayanti||36||

trINyAyatanAnIti- arthAnAM karmaNaH kAlasya cAtiyogAyogamithyAyogAH| tatrAtiprabhAvatAM dRushyAnAmatimAtraM darshanamatiyogaH, sarvasho~adarshanamayogaH, atishliShTAtiviprakRuShTaraudrabhairavAdbhutadviShTabIbhatsanavikRutavitrAsanAdirUpadarshanaM mithyAyogaH; tathA~atimAtrastanitapaTahotkruShTAdInAM shabdAnAmatimAtraM shravaNamatiyogaH, sarvasho~ashravaNamayogaH, paruSheShTavinAshopaghAtapradharShaNabhIShaNAdishabdashravaNaM mithyAyogaH; tathA~atitIkShNogrAbhiShyandinAM gandhAnAmatimAtraM ghrANamatiyogaH, sarvasho~aghrANamayogaH, pUtidviShTAmedhyaklinnaviShapavanakuNapagandhAdighrANaM mithyAyogaH; tathA rasAnAmatyAdAnamatiyogaH, sarvasho~anAdAnamayogaH, mithyAyogo rAshivarjyeShvAhAravidhivisheShAyataneShUpadekShyate; tathA~atishItoShNAnAM spRushyAnAM snAnAbhya~ggotsAdanAdInAM cAtyupasevanamatiyogaH, sarvasho~anupasevanamayogaH, snAnAdInAM shItoShNAdInAM ca spRushyAnAmanAnupUrvyopasevanaM viShamasthAnAbhighAtAshucibhUtasaMsparshAdayashceti mithyAyogaH||37||

Commentary: arthAnAm indriyArthAnAm| karmaNaH kAyavA~gmanaHpravRutteH| kAlasya shItoShNavarShalakShaNasya| atiprabhAvatAm AtapAgniprabhRutInAm| atra hInamAtradarshanaM vikAraM na karoti, tena ‘sarvasha’ ityuktam| adarshanaM cAtiprabhAvatAmeva boddhavyam, aprabhAvatAM ca ghaTAdInAM darshanamatiyogAdapi na doShakaram; evamanyatrApi sarvasha iti vyAkhyeyam| atishliShTaM nayanapratyAsannam, ativiprakRuShTam atidUravarti, raudram adbhutakAraNAtmakaM bhayajanakaM, bhairavam anadbhutamapi vyAghrAdi, diShTaM yadyasya dveShyaM, bIbhatsanaM manasa udvegakArakaM, vikRutaM hInA~ggAdi, vitrAsanaM jhaTiti bhayajanakam; AdigrahaNAdamedhyAdInAM grahaNam| raudrAdayo yadyapi na rUpaM kintvAkRutivisheShAH, tathA~api rUpaikArthasamavAyena cakShurarthA eva; na cehendriyArthagrahaNena rUpAdInAmeva paraM grahaNamiti pUrvameva vyAkhyAtaM, yataH sparshanarasanayoH samyagyoge~asamyagyoge ca bahavaH sparsharasavyatiriktAH snAnAbhya~ggAdayaH prakRutisaMyogasaMskArAdayashca kAraNatvena vaktavyAH| atimAtrastanitaM pravRuddho meghadhvaniH, paTahaH paTahashabdaH, utkruShTaM darpAdatimAtraM shabditaM, pradharShaNaM tiraskAraH| tIkShNo gandhashcakShurvirecanakArakaH, yathA- kRuShNajIrakAdInAm; ugro vamanakArako vacAdInAm; abhiShyandI staimityakArako mastusurAsavAdInAM ; pUti atyarthaklinnaM; viShayuktaH pavano viShapavanaH; kuNapaH shavaH| rasAnAmiti rasasahitAnAM dravyANAm| ihAnAdAnamiti kurvan hInayogo~api rasAnAM vikArakara iti darshayati| AhAravidhivisheShAyatanAni rasavimAne vakShyamANAni “prakRutikaraNasaMyogarAshideshakAlopayogasaMsthopayotkraShTamAni” (vi.a.1); tatra rAshivarjyeShvitivacanena rAshiM pRuthakkaroti, rAsherAhArasya parimANarUpasya yo doShaH- hInamAtratvamatimAtratvaM vA, tasyAtiyogAyogAbhyAmeva gRuhItatvAt; na mithyAyogo rAsheH sambhavati; uktaM hi- “rAshiH punarmAtrAmAtrAphalavinishcayArthaH” (vi.a.1.) iti| prakRutyAdInAM tu doShAdAhArasya mithyAyoga eva paraM sambhavati, yataH prakRutiviruddhAnAM mAShAdInAM bhojanaM mithyAyoga evAhArasya bhavati; evaM saMskAraviruddhashaktupiNDike~api mithyAyoga eva, tathA saMyogaviruddhasamadhRutamadhusarpirupayoge~api; evaM kAlAdiviruddhodAharaNamapi rasavimAne pratipAditaM sarvaM mithyAyogarUpameva, teShAmayogAtiyoganirapekShANAmeva doShakartRutvAt| shItoShNAdInAmityAdi| yadyapi shItoShNAdInAmabhya~ggAdInAM ca hInayogo~api rogakarastathA~api sarvasho~anupasevanamiti vacanaM sarvasho~anupasevanasya bhUripravyaktavikArakartRutvAbhiprAyeNa| anAnupUrvyA yathoktakramala~gghanena, yathA- snAtvA utsAdanaM, tathoShNapIDitasya sahasA shItalapAnIyAvagAhanam, evamAdi| abhighAtaH kha~ggahananAdi, bhUtAH prANinaH pishAcaprabhRutayaH| AdigrahaNAdyatki~jcit sparshanasambaddhaM sharIropaghAtakamayogAtiyogavyatiriktaM tadgRuhyate||37||

tatraikaM sparshanamindriyANAmindriyavyApakaM , cetaH- samavAyi, sparshanavyAptervyApakamapi ca cetaH; tasmAt sarvendriyANAM vyApakasparshakRuto yo bhAvavisheShaH, so~ayamanupashayAt pa~jcavidhastrividhavikalpo bhavatyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH; sAtmyArtho hyupashayArthaH||38||

Commentary: nanu cakShurAdIni pa~jcendriyANi, atasteShAM pratiniyatAH pa~jcAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAH, tat kathameko~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga ityAkhyAyata ityAsha~gkya sparshanendriyasya sarvendriyavyApakatvaM darshayitvA sarvendriyAnugataM sparshamarthagrahaNakAraNamekarUpaM darshayati, tatashca tasyaikasyAsAtmyendriyArthena saMyogAdupapanna ekarUpo~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga iti darshayati- tatraikamityAdinA sAtmyArtho hyupashayArtha ityantena| ekaM sparshanamiti sparshanendriyameva, nAnyaccakShurAdi| indriyANAmiti nirdhAraNe ShaShThI| indriyANi cakShurAdIni vyApnotItIndriyavyApakaM; sparshanaM hi sarveShvindriyeShvasti, ata eva spRuShTvaivArthamindriyANi gRuhNanti| tarhi kathaM na sarvadA~arthagrahaNaM bhavatItyata Aha- ceta ityAdinA| shrotraM cAsmaddarshane pA~jcabhautikaM karNashaShkulIgatanabhorUpaM, tena tasyApi sparsho~asti; cetaHsamavAyi manaHsambandhi; manaHsambandhakathanena cArthagrahaNaM prati samarthatvaM sparshasya darshayati, mano~adhiShThitAnAmindriyANAmarthagrAhakatvAt| tat kimaNuparimANena manasaikatrasthitenaiva sparshanasya sarvendriyavyApakasya sambandhAt sarvendriyANi pravartante, tathA sati yugapatpa~jcaj~jAnotpattiprasa~gga ityAha- sparshanendriyavyAptervyApakamapi ceta iti| sparshanenendriyANAM vyAptiH sparshanendriyavyAptiH, tasyAshceto~api vyApakam; etaduktaM bhavati- yAvati pradeshe sparshanaM tiShThati tAvantaM deshaM mano~api bhramati pratyakSheNArthagrahaNArthaM, tena yasmin pradeshe yadA mano vartate tadA tena pradeshena cakShurAdirUpeNArthaM gRuhNAtIti na yugapajj~jAnotpattiH| prakRute yojayati- tasmAdityAdi| vyApakashcAsau sparshashceti vyApakasparshaH, tena kRutastannibandhanaH; sarvendriyANAM bhAvavisheShaH svabhAvavisheSho~arthagrahaNakAraNIbhUtaH sparsha ityarthaH; yamadhikRutyoktam- “sparshanendriyasaMsparshaH sparsho mAnasa eva ca| dvividhaH sukhaduHkhAnAM vedanAnAM pravartakaH” (shA. a.1) iti; atra shloke sparshanasambandhakRutaH sarvendriyasparshaH sparshanendriyasaMsparshashabdenoktaH, mAnasastu sparshashcintyena viShayeNa satA~api sambhavatIti tatraiva vyAkhyeyam| visheSha ityatra ‘asti’ iti sheShaH| so~ayamekasyendriyavyApakasya sparshasyaikarUpo~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH, anupashayAditi duHkhakartRutvAt, pa~jcavidhaH cakShurasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogo ghrANAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga ityAdirUpaH san, punastrividhavikalpo bhavati- ayogAtiyogamithyAyogeneti bhAvaH| evaM caikaprakArastriprakArastathA pa~jcadashaprakAro~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga ukto bhavati| anupashayashabdena cakShurAdyanupashayavisheSho~atrAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogasya pa~jcavidhahetutvopadeshAdboddhavyaH, na hyekarUpo~anupashayaH pa~jcavidhatvamasAtmyendriyArthasya kartuM samarthaH, yatashcakShurAdInAM pratiniyatAnyevopaghAtakAnyatibhAsvararUpAdIni, tatashca sparshendriyavyAptyA~api naikasparshanendriyatvaM cakShurAdInAm, ekatve hyekendriyopaghAtakamanyeShAmapyupaghAtakaM syAditi mantavyam| sAtmyopashayayorekArthatAM darshayati- sAtmyArtho hyupashayArtha iti| etenAnupashayenendriyArthasaMyogaM darshayitvA~asAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga iti sa~jj~jAkaraNamaviruddhamiti darshitaM bhavati||38||

karma vA~gmanaHsharIrapravRuttiH| tatra vA~gmanaHsharIrAtipravRuttiratiyogaH; sarvasho~apravRuttirayogaH; vegadhAraNodIraNaviShamaskhalanapatanA~ggapraNidhAnA~ggapradUShaNaprahAramardanaprANoparodhasa~gkleshanAdiH shArIro mithyAyogaH, sUcakAnRutAkAlakalahApriyAbaddhAnupacAraparuShavacanAdirvA~gmithyAyogaH, bhayashokakrodhalobhamohamAnerShyAmithyAdarshanAdirmAnaso mithyAyogaH||39||

Commentary: arthAnAmayogAtiyogamithyAyogAnabhidhAya karmaNastAnAha- karmetyAdi| atra yadyapi bhUripradhAnasharIrarogakartRutvena pUrvaM shArIrameva karmAsAtmyamabhidhAtuM yujyate, tathA~apyalpatvena vA~gmanase karmaNI pUrvamukte, pratyekamithyAyogakathane tu prAdhAnyAcchArIra eva mithyAyogaH prathamaM darshitaH| atrAtiyogarUpA~atipravRuttistathA~ayogarUpA~apravRuttirvihitAnAM kAyavA~gmanaH karmaNAM boddhavyA, ahitAcaraNasya tu sarvasya mithyAyogatvena vaktavyatvAt| vegodIraNam aprAptavegodIraNam| viShamashabdo~a~ggapraNidhAnAntaiH sabadhyate| a~ggadUShaNam atikaNDUyanAdibhiH| sa~gkleshanaM madyAtapajalasecanAdibhiH| abaddhavacanam asambaddhM yAvattAvatkIrtanam| anupacAravacanam| iha cAnRutavacanAdayo~adharmadvAreNa rogakarAH||39||

sa~ggraheNa cAtiyogAyogavarjaM karma vA~gmanaHsharIrajamahitamanupadiShTaM yattacca mithyAyogaM vidyAt||40||

Commentary: anuktamithyAyogasa~ggrahArthamAha- sa~ggraheNetyAdi| ahitamiha janmani, anupadiShTamityanena paraloke~adharmahetutayA pApakArakaM paradArasevAdi grAhayati; etena yaducyate- adharmasyAgrahaNAnnyUnametadAyatanakathanamiti, tanna bhavati| shArIramAnasikavAcanikakarmamithyAyogenaivAdharmotpAdAvAntaravyApAreNAdharmajanyAnAM vikArANAM kriyamANatvAt, yathA- agniShTomena svargaH kriyate dharmotpAdAvAntaravyApAreNaiva; anye tu kAlamithyAyoge~adharmaM kShipanti, adharmo hi kAlavashAdeva phalati na tatkAlamiti kRutvA; etacca prathamAdhyAya eva prapa~jcitam||40||

iti trividhavikalpaM trividhameva karma praj~jAparAdha iti vyavasyet||41||

Commentary: samprati karmAsamyagyogaH praj~jAparAdhamUlatvAt praj~jAparAdha evocyata iti trividhamityAdinA darshayan, yaduktaM pUrvaM hetutrayakathane “asAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH praj~jAparAdhaH pariNAmashca” ityasyAvirodhaM darshayati; evaM yadagre vakShyati ‘kAlaH punaH pariNAma ucyate’ tatrApi pUrvoktAvirodhopadarshanaM vyAkhyeyamiti| trividhavikalpamihAtiyogAdirUpam||41||

shItoShNavarShalakShaNAH punarhemantagrIShmavarShAH saMvatsaraH, sa kAlaH| tatrAtimAtrasvalakShaNaH kAlaH kAlAtiyogaH, hInasvalakShaNaH (kAlaH) kAlAyogaH, yathAsvalakShaNaviparItalakShaNastu (kAlaH) kAlamithyAyogaH| kAlaH punaH pariNAma ucyate||42||

Commentary: kAlAtishayayogAdIn darshayati- shItoShNetyAdi| atimAtrasvalakShaNaH atimAtrashItAdiH| yathAsvalakShaNAcchItAderviparItalakShaNo yathA- hemante varShaNaM, varShAsu shItamityAdi||42||

ityasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH, praj~jAparAdhaH, pariNAmashceti trayastrividhavikalpA hetavo vikArANAM; samayogayuktAstu prakRutihetavo bhavanti||43||

Commentary: AyatanAnyupasaMharati- itItyAdi| vikArANAM hetavo bhavantIti sambandhaH; tathA samayogayuktAH samyagyogayuktAH prakRutihetavo bhavantIti yojyaM; prakRutiH Arogyam||43||

sarveShAmeva bhAvAnAM bhAvAbhAvau nAntareNa yogAyogAtiyogamithyAyogAn samupalabhyete; yathAsvayuktyapekShiNau hi bhAvAbhAvau||44||

Commentary: idAnIM dhAtusAmyavaiShamyahetutvena samyagyogAyogau ca pratipAdya bAhyAnAmapi vRukShaghaTAdInAM samyaksthitivinAshayoH samyagyogAyogAveva kAraNamiti dRuShTAntArthaM bhAvasvarUpaj~jAnArthaM cAha- sarveShAmityAdi| bhAvaH samyagavasthAnam, abhAvaH, asamyagavasthAnaM vinAsho vA; yogAt samyagyogAdbhAvaH, ayogAdibhyo~abhAvaH; yathAsvaM yuktiryA yasya bhAvasyAbhAvasya vA yuktiH svakAraNayuktiH, tadapekShiNau bhavata iti sambandhaH| yathA- vRukShasya bhAve avasthAne~anatyalpapAnIyayogAdiryuktiH, abhAve tu vRukShasya pAnIyAtapAtiyogAyogau tathA vajrapAtAdiryuktiH; tatastadapekShau vRukShasya bhAvAbhAvau bhavata ityAdi kalpanIyam||44||

trayo rogA iti- nijAgantumAnasAH| tatra nijaH shArIradoShasamutthaH, AganturbhUtaviShavAyvagnisamprahArAdisamutthaH, mAnasaH punariShTasya lAbhAllAbhAccAniShTasyopajAyate||45||

Commentary: rogAnAha- trayo rogA ityAdi| iShTalAbhAjjAyate kAmaharShAdiH, aniShTapriyaviyogAdilAbhAcca shokAdayaH; yadi vA ‘iShTasyAlAbhAllAbhAccAniShTasya’ iti pAThaH; atra tu pAThe cakArAdiShTalAbho~api heturboddhavyaH||45||

tatra buddhimatA mAnasavyAdhiparItenApi satA buddhyA hitAhitamavekShyAvekShya dharmArthakAmAnAmahitAnAmanupasevane hitAnAM copasevane prayatitavyaM, na hyantareNa loke trayametanmAnasaM ki~jcinniShpadyate sukhaM vA duHkhaM vA; tasmAdetaccAnuShTheyaM- tadvidyAnAM copasevane prayatitavyam, AtmadeshakulakAlabalashaktij~jAne yathAvacceti||46||

Commentary: samprati mAnasavyAdhicikitsAyA alpavaktavyatvenehaiva taccikitsAmAha- tatretyAdi| mAnasavyAdhiparItenApIti apishabdena shArIravyAdhiyuktenApi vakShyamANamanuShTheyamiti sUcayati| trayametaddharmArthakAmarUpaM mAnasaM sukhaM vA mAnasaM duHkhaM vA niShpadyata iti yojyam| tadvidya iha mAnasavyAdhibheShajavedI| AtmadeshetyAdi|- ko~ahaM, kiM me hitamityAtmaj~jAnaM; ko deshaH, asmin kimucitamiti deshaj~jAnam; evaM kAlAdAvapi j~jAnaM boddhavyam||46||

bhavati cAtra- mAnasaM prati bhaiShajyaM trivargasyAnvavekShaNam| tadvidyasevA vij~jAnamAtmAdInAM ca sarvashaH||47||

Commentary: sampratyamumevArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM shlokenAha- mAnasaM pratItyAdi|- mAnasaM vikAramiti bhAvaH| trivargasya dharmAdeH||47||

trayo rogamArgA iti- shAkhA, marmAsthisandhayaH, koShThashca| tatra shAkhA raktAdayo dhAtavastvak ca, sa bAhyo rogamArgaH; marmANi punarbastihRudayamUrdhAdIni, asthisandhayo~asthisaMyogAstatropanibaddhAshca snAyukaNDarAH , sa madhyamo rogamArgaH; koShThaH punarucyate mahAsrotaH sharIramadhyaM mahAnimnamAmapakvAshayashceti paryAyashabdaistantre, sa rogamArga AbhyantaraH||48||

Commentary: atra rogamArgAnAha - traya ityAdi| marmAsthisandhibhyAmeko mArgaH| atra shAkhetisa~jj~jAkaraNaM vyavahArArthaM, tathA raktAdInAM dhAtUnAM shAkhAbhidheyAnAM vRukShashAkhAtulyatvena bAhyatvaj~jApanArtham| tvakceti tvakshabdena tadAshrayo raso~api gRuhyate; sAkShAttu rasAnabhidhAnaM hRudayasthAyino rasasya shAkhAsa~jj~jAvyavacchedArthaM , tasya hi koShThagrahaNenaiva grahaNam; anena nyAyena yakRutplIhAshritaM ca shoNitaM koShThatvenaivAbhipretamiti boddhavyaM, samAnanyAyatvAt | uktaM ca koShThavivaraNe- “sthAnAnyAmAgnipakvAnAM mUtrasya rudhirasya ca| hRuduNDukaH phuphphusashca koShTha ityabhidhIyate” (su.ci. a.2) iti| asthisandhivivaraNam- asthisaMyogA ityAdi| tatreti asthisandhau| kaNDarA iha tantre sthUlasnAyuH| Amasya pakvasya cAshaya AmapakvAshayaH| etacca mArgabhedakathanaM tadAshritavyAdhInAM sukhasAdhyatvAdij~jAnArtham||48||

tatra, gaNDapiDakAlajyapacIcarmakIlAdhimAMsamaShakakuShThavya~ggAdayo vikArA bahirmArgajAshca visarpashvayathugulmArshovidradhyAdayaH shAkhAnusAriNo bhavanti rogAH; pakShavadhagrahApatAnakArditashoSharAjayakShmAsthisandhishUlagudabhraMshAdayaH shirohRudbastirogAdayashca madhyamamArgAnusAriNo bhavanti rogAH; jvarAtIsAracchardyalasakavisUcikAkAsashvAsahikkAnAhodaraplIhAdayo~antarmArgajAshca visarpashvayathugulmArshovidradhyAdayaH koShThAnusAriNo bhavanti rogAH||49||

Commentary: samprati yanmArgAshrito yo rogo bhavati taM darshayati- tatra gaNDetyAdi| bahirmArgajAshceti visarpAdInAM visheShaNaM visarpAdayo hyantarmArgabhAjo~api sambhavantyatastadvyudAsArtham| pakShashabdo vadhagrahAbhyAM sambadhyate, shoSho dhAtushoShaH| jvaro yadyapi sarvasharIraga eva, tathA~api visheSheNAmAshayasamutthatvAdihocyate| antarmArgajAshceti visarpAdivisheShaNam| arsho bahirvalyAshritaM shAkhAgatam, anyacca koShThagatam| bahirmArgajo gulmo yo bahiruttuNDita upalabhyate bahishca pacyate sa j~jeyaH, anyastu sarvaH koShThagata eva||49||

AsAM tu khalveShaNAnAM prANaiShaNAM tAvat pUrvataramApadyeta| kasmAt? prANaparityAge hi sarvatyAgaH| tasyAnupAlanaM- svasthasya svasthavRuttAnuvRuttiH, Aturasya vikAraprashamane~apramAdaH, tadubhayametaduktaM vakShyate ca; tadyathoktamanuvartamAnaH prANAnupAlanAddIrghamAyuravApnotIti prathamaiShaNA vyAkhyAtA bhavati||4||

Commentary: prANaiShaNAyAH prathamAnuShThAne upapattimAha- AsAM tvityAdi| trayANAM madhye dve pUrve bhavataH, tRutIyAyAH sarvottaratvenApUrvatvAt; tena dvayostara iti nyAyAt pUrvataraM prANaiShaNeti sAdhustaraprayogaH| prANashabdo jIvitavacana ekavacanAnto~apyasti; yaduktaM- “dashaivAyatanAnyAhuH prANo yeShu pratiShThitaH” (sU.a.30) iti, tena prANapratyavamarshakaM ‘tasya’ iti padamekavacanena yuktameva| vikArAn prashamayatIti vikAraprashamanaM cikitsA, tasmin| apramAdaH avadhAnenAnuShThAnam| vakShyate ceti nikhilena shAstreNa| prANAnupAlanAditi prANAnupAlanasAdhanAt; tena prANAnupAlanadIrghAyuShTvayorarthAbhedAt sAdhyasAdhanabhAvo nAstIti yaccocyate tannirastaM bhavati| prathameti prAdhAnyAt prANaiShaNA||4||
trividhA bhiShaja iti- bhiShakchadmacarAH santi santyeke siddhasAdhitAH| santi vaidyaguNairyuktAstrividhA bhiShajo bhuvi||50||
vaidyabhANDauShadhaiH pustaiH pallavairavalokanaiH| labhante ye bhiShakshabdamaj~jAste pratirUpakAH||51||
shrIyashoj~jAnasiddhAnAM vyapadeshAdatadvidhAH| vaidyashabdaM labhante ye j~jeyAste siddhasAdhitAH||52||
prayogaj~jAnavij~jAnasiddhisiddhAH sukhapradAH| jIvitAbhisarAste syurvaidyatvaM teShvavasthitamiti||53||

trividhamauShadhamiti- daivavyapAshrayaM, yuktivyapAshrayaM, sattvAvajayashca| tatra daivavyapAshrayaM-  mantrauShadhimaNima~ggalabalyupahArahomaniyamaprAyashcittopavAsasvastyayanapraNipAtagamanAdi, yuktivyapAshrayaM-  punarAhArauShadhadravyANAM yojanA, sattvAvajayaH- punarahitebhyo~arthebhyo manonigrahaH||54||

Commentary: daivamadRuShTaM tadvyapAshrayaM, tacca yadadRuShTajananena vyAdhipratyanIkaM mantrAdi; yadi vA daivashabdena devA ucyante, tAnAshritya yadupakaroti tattathA; mantrAdayo hi devaprabhAvAdeva vyAdhiharAH, balyupahArAdiprItAshca devA eva prabhAvAdvyAdhIn ghnanti| atra daivavyapAshrayamAdAvuktamAshuvyAdhiharatvena| praNipAto devAdInAM shArIro namaskAraH, gamanaM vidUradevAdigamanam||54||

sharIradoShaprakope khalu sharIramevAshritya prAyashastrividhamauShadhamicchanti- antaHparimArjanaM, bahiHparimArjanaM, shastrapraNidhAnaM ceti| tatrAntaHparimArjanaM yadantaHsharIramanupravishyauShadhamAhArajAtavyAdhIn pramArShTi, yatpunarbahiHsparshamAshrityAbhya~ggasvedapradehapariShekonmardanAdyairAmayAn pramArShTi tadbahiHparimArjanaM, shastrapraNidhAnaM punashchedanabhedanavyadhanadAraNalekhanotpATanapracchanasIvanaiShaNakShArajalaukasashceti||55||

Commentary: samprati prakArAntareNopayuktaM bheShajatraividhyamAha- sharIretyAdi| prAyaHshabdaH sharIradoShakopa ityanena sambadhyate; tena, mAnasadoShaje~apyunmAdApasmArAdAva~jjanAdi bhavatIti darshayati; yadi vA prAyastrividhamityanena shArIre~api daivavyapAshrayaM svastyayanAdi darshayati||55||
bhavanti cAtra- prAj~jo roge samutpanne bAhyenAbhyantareNa vA| karmaNA labhate sharma shastropakramaNena vA||56||
bAlastu khalu mohAdvA pramAdAdvA na budhyate| utpadyamAnaM prathamaM rogaM shatrumivAbudhaH||57||
aNurhi prathamaM bhUtvA rogaH pashcAdvivardhate| sa jAtamUlo muShNAti balamAyushca durmateH||58||
na mUDho labhate sa~jj~jAM tAvadyAvanna pIDyate| pIDitastu matiM pashcAt kurute vyAdhinigrahe||59||
atha putrAMshca dArAMshca j~jAtIMshcAhUya bhAShate| sarvasvenApi me kashcidbhiShagAnIyatAmiti||60||
tathAvidhaM ca kaH shakto durbalaM vyAdhipIDitam| kRushaM kShINendriyaM dInaM paritrAtuM gatAyuSham||61||
sa trAtAramanAsAdya bAlastyajati jIvitam| godhA lA~ggUlabaddhevAkRuShyamANA balIyasA||62||
tasmAt prAgeva rogebhyo rogeShu taruNeShu vA| bheShajaiH pratikurvIta ya icchet sukhamAtmanaH||63||
tatra shlokau- eShaNAH samupastambhA balaM kAraNamAmayAH| tisraiShaNIye mArgAshca bhiShajo bheShajAni ca||64||
tritvenAShTau samuddiShTAH kRuShNAtreyeNa dhImatA| bhAvA, bhAveShvasaktena yeShu sarvaM pratiShThitam||65||

atha dvitIyAM dhanaiShaNamApadyeta, prANebhyo hyanantaraM dhanameva paryeShTavyaM bhavati ; na hyataH pApAt pApIyo~asti yadanupakaraNasya dIrghamAyuH, tasmAdupakaraNAni paryeShTuM yateta| tatropakaraNopAyAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- kRuShipAshupAlyavANijyarAjopasevAdIni, yAni cAnyAnyapi satAmavigarhitAni karmANi vRuttipuShTikarANi vidyAttAnyArabheta kartuM; tathA kurvan dIrghajIvitaM jIvatyanavamataH puruSho bhavati | iti dvitIyA dhanaiShaNA vyAkhyAtA bhavati||5||

Commentary: atheti prANaiShaNAnantaram| dvitIyAmiti hetugarbhaM visheShaNaM, yasmAdiyameva dvitIyA prANaiShaNAnantaramavashyopAdeyatvena, tata iyamevocyata ityarthaH| prANaiShaNAmanu cAsyAH prAdhAnyaM darshayati- prANebhyo hItyAdi| pApashabdena pApakAryaM duHkhamucyate| upakaraNam ArogyabhogadharmasAdhanIbhUto dhanaprapa~jcaH, sa yasya nAstyasAvanupakaraNaH| dhanopAyAniti vaktavye upakaraNopAyAniti yataH karoti, tena dhanasya bhogadharmasAdhanArthamevotpAdamicchanti, na punaH kRupaNasyeva viniyogashUnyasya susaMvardhitamAtrakaraNArtham | anyAnyapIti pratigrahAdhyApanAdIni| vRuttiH vartanaM, puShTiH dhanasampattiH| anavamataH anavaj~jAto bahumAnagRuhIta iti yAvat| dIrghaM jIvitaM jIvati dhArayatItyarthaH, anekArthatvAddhAtUnAM; yadi vA dIrghajIvitaM yathA syAttathA jIvatIti kriyAvisheShaNatvena vyAkhyeyam||5||

atha tRutIyAM paralokaiShaNAmApadyeta| saMshayashcAtra, kathaM? bhaviShyAma itashcyutA naveti; kutaH punaH saMshaya iti, ucyate- santi hyeke pratyakShaparAH parokShatvAt punarbhavasya nAstikyamAshritAH, santi cAgamapratyayAdeva punarbhavamicchanti; shrutibhedAcca- ‘mAtaraM pitaraM caike manyante janmakAraNam | svabhAvaM paranirmANaM yadRucchAM cApare janAH’ || iti | ataH saMshayaH- kiM nu khalvasti punarbhavo na veti||6||

Commentary: paralokaiShaNAM vyAkaroti- athetyAdi| atra ca paralokasya durj~jeyatvena cArvAkAdinAstikAsammatatvena ca paralokaM pramANena vyavasthApayituM nirNayArthaM pramANapravRuttiviShayaM saMshayameva tAvat paraloke darshayati- saMshayashcAtretyAdi| itashcyutA iha janmani mRutAH, bhaviShyAmo janmAntara ityarthaH| saMshayahetuM pRucchati- kutaH saMshayaH punariti| vAdivipratipattiM saMshayahetumAha- ucyata ityAdi| pratyakShaparA anumatapratyakShaikapramANAH| parokShatvAta pratyakShAviShayatvAt| punarbhavasya janmAntarasya| nAsti punarbhavo nAsti karmaphalaM nAstyAtmetyAdinAstinA pracaratIti nAstikaH, tasya bhAvo nAstikyam| yata pratyakShapramANenopalabhyate ghaTapaTAdi, tadeva paramasti; nopalabhyate ca pratyakSheNa paralokaH, tasmAnnAsti paraloka iti nAstikAbhiprAyaH| asti punarbhava iti yeShAM mataM tAn darshayati- santItyAdi| santi cetyatra ‘apare’ iti vAkyasheShaH| AgamapratyayAt AgamaprAmANyAt| AgamaM ca punarbhavapratipAdakaM dAnatapoyaj~jetyAdi darshayiShyatyagre| icchantItyatra ‘ye’ iti vAkyasheShaH| evaM tAvadvAdivipratipattirekA saMshayakAraNaM darshitA; saMshayahetvantaramAha- shrutibhedAccetyAdi| shrUyata iti shrutiH; prativAdivacanameva~ggranthanibaddham| etAni ca mAtApitarAveva janmakAraNamityAdIni punarbhavapratikShepakANi vacanAni| AgamapratyayAdasti punarbhava iti yo brUte, tadvacanena samaM vAdivipratipattirUpatayaiva saMshayakAraNaM bhavatItyata uktamupasaMhAre ‘ataH saMshayaH’ iti| eke manyante janmakAraNamiti janmakAraNamiti padaM mAtaraM pitaraM tathA svabhAvaM tathA paranirmANamiti padatrayeNa sambadhyate; yadRucchAM cA~apare janA ityatra manyante janmakAraNamiti padaM sambadhyate| mAtApitarAvevAtmAntaranirapekShAvapatyotpAdane kAraNaM, tena pUrvasharIraM parityajya sharIrAntaraparigraharUpa AtmanaH paraloko nAstIti prathamavAdinaH pakShaH| paridRushyamAnapRuthivyAdibhAvAnAmevAyaM svabhAvo- yat- saMyogavisheShAnmilitAH santashcetanaM puruShAdilakShaNaM kAryavisheShamArabhante, yathA surAbIjAdIni pratyekamamadakarANyapi madakaraM madyamArabhante, nAtra kashcidAtmA vidyate yasya paralokaH syAditi svabhAvavAdino bhAvaH| para aishvaryAdiguNayukta AtmavisheShaH, tena saMsAryAtmanirapekShiNA nirmANaM paranirmANaM, tatrApi parasyaivaishvaryAdiguNayuktasyAtmavisheShasya prabhAvAdbhUtAni cetayante nAtmAntaramastIti paralokAbhAvaH| yadRucchA kAraNApratiniyamenotpAdaH; na kAraNapratiniyamena kAryotpAdo~avadhArayituM shakyate, avadhArakapramANAnAM prAmANyAnavadhAraNAt; tasmAdAtmaiva punarbhavamanubhavatIti na vAcyamiti yAdRucchikasyAbhiprAyaH||6||

tatra buddhimAnnAstikyabuddhiM jahyAdvicikitsAM ca| kasmAt? pratyakShaM hyalpam; analpamapratyakShamasti, yadAgamAnumAnayuktibhirupalabhyate; yaireva tAvadindriyaiH pratyakShamupalabhyate, tAnyeva santi cApratyakShANi||7||

Commentary: punarbhavAstitvapakShaM gRuhItvA prAha- tatretyAdi| buddhimAniti prashastabuddhiyuktaH| nAstyeva paraloka iti viparyayaj~jAnaM nAstikyabuddhiH, tAM jahyAt| paralokaviShayo viparyayo yathA dharmAnuShThAnaM prati virodhakaH, tathA stokakrameNAsti paraloko na veti saMshayo~api dharmAnuShThAnaM prati virodhaka ityAha- vicikitsAM ceti; vicikitsAM jahyAditi sambandhaH, vicikitsA sandehaH, sA ceha prakRutatvAt paralokaviShayaiva| atraiva hetuprashnapUrvakaM hetumAha- kasmAdityAdi| apratyakShatvAt paraloko nAstIti prathamavAdimataM dUShayati- pratyakShamityAdi| yathA, pratyakShaM pramANamavyabhicAripramAjanakatvena; tathA~a~agamAdInyapi tathAbhUtapramAjanakatvAt pramANAnyeva; tatashca pratyakShAviShayatvenaiva yat punarbhavasya nAstitvaM vyavasthApyate tanna yuktamiti prakaraNArthaH| punarbhavasAdhakAni cAgamAdInyagre vakShyamANAni santyeveti bhAvaH| AgamAdIni lakShaNato~agre~abhidhAsyante| pratyakShAviShayatve satyapi yAnyanyapramANasiddhAni santi tAnyAha- yairevetyAdi| pratyakShamiti pratyakShaviShayaM ghaTAdi| santIti indriyopakramaNIyoktAnumAnagamyatvAditi boddhavyam||7||

satAM ca rUpANAmatisannikarShAdativiprakarShAdAvaraNAt karaNadaurbalyAnmanonavasthAnAt samAnAbhihArAdabhibhavAdatisaukShmyAcca pratyakShAnupalabdhiH; tasmAdaparIkShitametaducyate- pratyakShamevAsti, nAnyadastIti||8||

Commentary: itashca pratyakShAnupalabdhirna vastvabhAvanishcayakAriketyAha- satAmityAdi| satAmityagre vakShyamANAtisannikarShAdyabhAve pratyakSheNaiva gRuhyamANatvena satAmityarthaH| pratyakShAnupalabdhirityatisannikarShAdibhiH saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate| atisannikarShAdanupalabdhiryathA- nayanagatakajjalAdeH, ativiprakarShAdyathA- dUrAkAshagatasya  pakShiNaH, AvaraNAdyathA- kuDyAdipihitasya ghaTAdeH, karaNadaurbalyAdyathA- kAmalAdyupahatasya cakShuShaH paTashauklyAdyapratibhAnaM, manonavasthAnAdyathA- kAntAmukhanirIkShaNaprahitamanasaH pArshvAgatavacanAnavabodhaH, samAnAbhihArAdyathA- bilvarAshipraviShTasya bilvasyendriyasambaddhasyApi bhedenAgrahaNam, abhibhavAdyathA- madhyandine ulkApAtasya, saukShmyAdyathA- tricaturhastapramANadeshavartinaH krimivisheShalikhyAderagrahaNam||8||
shrutayashcaitA na kAraNaM, yuktivirodhAt| AtmA mAtuH piturvA yaH so~apatyaM yadi sa~jcaret| dvividhaM sa~jcaredAtmA sarvovA~avayavena vA||9||
sarvashcet sa~jcarenmAtuH piturvA maraNaM bhavet| nirantaraM, nAvayavaH kashcitsUkShmasya cAtmanaH||10||

buddhirmanashca nirNIte yathaivAtmA tathaiva te| yeShAM caiShA matisteShAM yonirnAsti caturvidhA||11||

Commentary: atha sha~gkyate- mA~a~atmA mAtApitroH sa~jcaratu, buddhistu tayormano vA~apatyaM sa~jcaratu, ata evApatyasya caitanyaM bhaviShyatItyAha- buddhirmanashcetyAdi| nirNIte vyavasthApite pramANena, kimbhUtenetyAha- yathaivAtmA niravayavatvenAvayavasa~jcaraNAkShamastathA tatkAlameva mAtApitRuparityAgaprasa~ggena kArtsnyenApi sa~jcaritumakShamaH, tathA te api buddhimanasI niravayavatvAnnaikadeshena sa~jcareyAtAM, mAtApitrostatkAlamevAbuddhimattvAmanaskatvaprasa~ggAcca na kArtsnyena sa~jcareyAtAmiti bhAvaH| dUShaNAntaramAha- yeShAmityAdi| yeShAM matiriti mAtApitarAvevApatye caitanyakAraNamityevaMrUpA| caturvidhA yoniriti jarAyujANDajasaMsvedajodbhijjalakShaNA| evaM manyate- saMsvedajAnAM mashakAdInAM tathodbhijjAnAM gaNDUpadAdInAM cetanAnAM mAtApitarau na vidyete; tatasteShAmacaitanyaM syAt, mAtApitroshcetanakAraNayorabhAvAditi||11||

vidyAt svAbhAvikaM ShaNNAM dhAtUnAM yat svalakShaNam| saMyoge ca viyoge ca teShAM karmaiva kAraNam||12||

Commentary: svAbhAvikavAdino bhUtacaitanyapakShaM dUShayati- vidyAdityAdi| svabhAvakRutaM svAbhAvikam| ShaNNAM dhAtUnAmiti pRuthivyaptejovAyvAkAshAtmanAm, eShAM ca dhAtutvaM sharIradhAraNAjjagaddhAraNAcca| svalakShaNam AtmIyamavyabhicAri lakShaNaM; tacca pRuthivyAH kAThinyAdi, apAM dravatvAdi, tejasa uShNatvAdi, vAyostiryaggamanAdi, AkAshasyApratighAtAdi Atmano j~jAnAdi; etena, etadeva parameShAM lakShaNaM svAbhAvikaM, na tAvadAtmarahitAnAmeShAM caitanyamapi svAbhAvikamastIti darshayati| tatashca yat pratyekaM bhUtAnAM na sambhavati tanmilitAnAmapi na sambhavati caitanyaM; yato bhUtAnAmapi saMyogAccaitanyasambhave bahUni cetanAni syurbAlyAdyavasthAbhedAt, tatashca j~jAtRubhedAt pratisandhAnAnupapattiriti bhAvaH; Atmasambandhena tu caitanyaM sammatameva, paraM tatrApi garbhotpattau bhUtAnAmAtmasambandhe tathA maraNe bhUtAnAmAtmano viyoge karmaiva janmAntarakRutaM kAraNaM, nAnyat| tat bhUtasaMyogavibhAgakAraNajanmAntarakRutakarmasvIkArAt pretyabhAvaH svIkRuto bhavatIti bhAvaH||12||

anAdeshcetanAdhAtorneShyate paranirmitiH| para AtmA sa ceddheturiShTo~astu paranirmitiH||13||

Commentary: paranirmANapakShaM dUShayati- anAderityAdi| atra paranirmANapakShe sharIrasyAtmarahitasya pareNa nirmANaM vA~abhipretaM syAt, Atmano vA~api pareNa nirmANamabhipretaM syAt; AtmanaH paranirmANaM dUShayati- anAderityAdi| nityasya cetanAdhAtoriti AtmanaH; neShyate nityasyotpAdakakAraNAbhAvAditi bhAvaH; nityatvaM cAtmanaH shArIre pratipAdayiShyati| atha sharIramAtrasya paranirmANamabhipretaM, tadanumatameva; pareNA~a~atmanA dharmAdharmasahAyena tasya kriyamANatvAdityAha- para ityAdi| heturiShTa iti sharIrotpAde heturiShTa ityarthaH; astu paranirmitirIdRushI pretyabhAvAvirodhinIti bhAvaH| evaM manyate- pareNaishvaryAdiguNayuktenAtmavisheSheNaitaccetanaM sharIraM kriyamANaM cetanAhetubhUtAtiriktAtmasambandhamantarA (cetanAyuktaM ) kartuM na pAryeta, ghaTAdivadacetanatvaprasa~ggAt; cetanAhetushcAtmA nityatvena na kriyate, tasmAccetanAhetunityatvena janmAntarasambandhinamAtmAnaM gRuhItvA sharIraM cetanaM paraH karotIti svIkaraNIyam; evamapi ceshvaradaridrAdijagadvaicitryadarshanAdAtmano dharmAdharmayogavaicitryaM kalpanIyaM; tathAca satyAtmana eva dharmAdharmasahAyatA~avashyaM svIkaraNIyA, tasmAt sa eva sharIrAdyutpattau kAraNamastu kimapareNehAtmavisheShakalpanena; yadi vA, evamAtmanyanekajanmasambandhini saMsArahetudharmAdharmaguNashAlini siddhe astu so~apyAtmavisheShaH kAraNam, ato na kAcit kShatiriti||13||
na parIkShA na parIkShyaM na kartA kAraNaM na ca| na devA narShayaH siddhAH karma karmaphalaM na ca||14||
nAstikasyAsti naivAtmA yadRucchopahatAtmanaH| pAtakebhyaH paraM caitat pAtakaM nAstikagrahaH||15||

tasmAnmatiM vimucyaitAmamArgaprasRutAM budhaH| satAM buddhipradIpena pashyetsarvaM yathAtatham||16||

Commentary: nAstikatAparityAgena yathAkartavyatAmAha- tasmAdityAdi| etAmiti nAstikabuddhim| amArge adharme prasRutA amArgaprasRutA| buddhireva pradIpo buddhipradIpaH, tena pratyakShAdipramANena pashyedityarthaH| yathAtathamiti yathAsvarUpam||16||

dvividhameva khalu sarvaM saccAsacca; tasya caturvidhA parIkShA- AptopadeshaH, pratyakSham, anumAnaM, yuktishceti||17||

Commentary: samprati parapakShaM dUShayitvA svapakShaparalokasAdhanAni pramANAnyavatArayati- dvividhamityAdi| sarvamiti yatki~jcit pramANapratIyamAnaM, taddvividhaM; taddvaividhyamAha- saccAsacca; saditi vidhiviShayapramANagamyaM bhAvarUpam, asaditi niShedhaviShayapramANagamyamabhAvarUpam| parIkShyate vyavasthApyate vastusvarUpamanayeti parIkShA pramANAni, AptopadeshAdaya uttaragranthe sphuTA bhaviShyanti||17||
AptAstAvat- rajastamobhyAM nirmuktAstapoj~jAnabalena ye| yeShAM trikAlamamalaM j~jAnamavyAhataM sadA||18||
AptAH shiShTA vibuddhAste teShAM vAkyamasaMshayam| satyaM, vakShyanti te kasmAdasatyaM nIrajastamAH ||19||

AtmendriyamanorthAnAM sannikarShAt pravartate| vyaktA tadAtve yA buddhiH pratyakShaM sa nirucyate||20||

Commentary: pratyakShalakShaNamAha- AtmendriyetyAdi| sannikarShAditi sambandhAt; sa ca sambandhaH- saMyogaH, samavAyaH, saMyuktasamavAyaH, saMyuktasamavetasamavAyaH, samavetasamavAyaH, visheShaNavisheShyabhAvalakShaNo boddhavyaH| vyaktA ityanena vyabhicAriNImayathArthabuddhiM saMshayaM ca nirAkaroti| tadAtve tatkShaNam; anena ca pratyakShaj~jAnAnantarotpannAnumAnaj~jAnaM smaraNaM ca paramparayA~a~atmendriyamanorthasannikarShajaM vyavacchinatti; AtmAdicatuShTayasannikarShAbhidhAnaM ca pratyakShakAraNAbhidhAnaparaM; tena, ‘indriyArthasannikarShAt pravartate yA’ ityetAvadeva lakShaNaM boddhavyam; etena sukhAdiviShayamapi pratyakShaM gRuhItaM bhavati; tatra hi catuShTayasannikarSho nAsti, AtmasannikarShastu pramANaj~jAnasAdhAraNatvenaiva lakShaNAnupayuktaH | iha ca pratyakShaphalarUpA~api buddhiH pratyakShashabdenAbhidhIyate, tathaiva lokavyavahArAt; paramArthatastu yato bhavatIndriyAderIdRushI buddhistat pratyakSham||20||

pUrvAdhyAye catuShpAdamArogyakAraNaM vyavasthApitaM, tatashcatuShpAdasampattyA prAptArogyeNa satA yadanuShTheyaM prANaparipAlanasAdhanaM, tathA dhanArjanasAdhanaM, tathA dharmArjanasAdhanaM, tadihaiShaNAtrayarUpamabhidhIyata ityanantaraM tisraiShaNIyo~abhidhIyate| tisraiShaNAshabdo~asminnastIti matvarthIyashchaH, atrAnukAryAnukaraNayorbhedAvivakShayA yalopAsiddherabhAvAt saMhitayA ‘tisraiShaNIyaH’ iti sa~jj~jAyate, adhyAyAnte “tisraiShaNIye mArgAshca” iti shlokapAdaM kariShyati; yadyapyanye~apyatra shabdAH santi, tathA~api pradhAnatvenAyaM gRuhyate||1-2||

anumAnasvarUpamAha- pratyakShetyAdi| pratyakShagrahaNaM vyAptigrAhakapramANopalakShaNArthaM, tena pratyakShapUrvamiti vyAptigrAhakapramANapUrvakam| trividhamityanenAnumAnatraividdhyaM darshayati; tena, kAryAt kAraNAnumAnaM, yathA- garbhadarshanAnmaithunAnumAnaM; tathA kAraNAt kAryAnumAnaM, yathA- bIjAt sahakArikAraNAntarayuktAt phalAnumAnaM; tathA~akAryakAraNabhUtAnAM ca sAmAnyato darshanAdanumAnaM, yathA- dhUmAdvartamAnakShaNasambandhAdagnyanumAnam; etattrividhamanumAnaM gRuhItaM bhavati| trikAlamityanena trikAlaviShayatvamanumAnasya darshayati| anumIyate ityatra ‘yena tadanumAnam’ iti vAkyasheShaH| tena, vyAptigrahaNAdanu anantaraM mIyate samya~gnishcIyate parokShArtho yena tadanumAnaM, vyAptismaraNasahAyali~ggadarshanamityarthaH| trividhamiti yaduktaM tasyodAharaNaM darshayati- vahnirityAdi| etacca vyAkRutameva | nigUDhaH adRushyamAnaH| evaM vyavasyantyatItamiti vyavacchedaH| bIjAditi sahakArikAraNAntarajalakarShaNAdiyuktAditi boddhavyam| anAgataM phalaM sadRushaM vyavasyantIti sambandhaH| dRuShTvA bIjAt phalaM jAtamityanena bIjaphalayoH kAraNakAryalakShaNAM vyAptiM darshayati; yadyapi ca kAraNaM kAryaM vyabhicarati, yato nAvashyaM bIjasadbhAve phalaM bhavati, tathA~api sahakArikAraNAntarayuktaM bIjaM phalaM na vyabhicaratItyabhiprAyo boddhavyaH; kAraNasAmagrI ca kAryaM na vyabhicaratyeva||21-22||

yukteH pramANasyAnyashAstraprasiddhatvenodAharaNAnyeva tAvaddarshayati, udAharaNe j~jAte yukterlakShaNaM sukhena j~jAyate ityabhiprAyeNa- jalakarShaNetyAdi| karShaNashabdena karShaNasaMskRutA bhUmirgRuhyate, jalakarShaNabIjartusaMyogAt sasyasya sambhavo bhavatIti yajj~jAnaM tadyuktiriti yojanIyam| ShaDdhAtusaMyogAt pa~jcamahAbhUtAtmasaMyogAt| tathAshabdo yuktirityAkarShati| mathyaM manthanakAShThayantrakaM, kAShThaM manthanaM, manthAnaM kAShThabhrAmaNaM; kiMvA ‘manthaka’ iti pAThaH, tatra manthAnaM bhrAmyamANakAShThaM; saMyogAnmelakAditi boddhavyaM, yato manthanasya kriyArUpasya saMyogo na sa~ggacchate; kiMvA manthanashabdena manthanarajjurucyate| yujyate sambadhyate~anayeti yuktiH, tayA yuktA yuktiyuktA| catuShpAda iti vaktavye sampadgrahaNaM guNavaccatuShpAdagrahaNArtham||23-24||

bhiShakchadmacarA bhiShagveshacarAH| siddhena prasiddhena sAdhitAH siddhasAdhitAH| vaidyabhANDaM bastinetrAdi| pratirUpakA vaidyasadRushAH| vyapadeshaH anyasambandhena kIrtanam| atadvidhA j~jAnahInAH||50-53||

vaidyabhedAbhidhAnaprasa~ggenAturabhedamAha- prAj~ja ityAdi| sharma sukhamArogyamiti yAvat| pramAdaH buddhvA~api rogamapratIkAraH| sa~jj~jA samyagj~jAnaM vyAdhirayaM tvarayA pratikartavya evamAkAram| trAtAraM vaidyamanAsAdya; tathAvidhaM hi rogiNaM vaidyo nopasarpatIti bhAvaH| bAlaH aj~jaH| godhAdRuShTAntena jIvanArthaM yatnaM kurvannapi vipadyata iti darshayati| pratikurvIta ‘yatnam’ iti sheShaH||56-63||
sa~ggrahe dhImatA bhAvA iti chedaH; aShTau bhAvA iti sambandhaH| bhAveShu viShayeShu| asaktena aprasaktena| yeShu eShaNAdiShvaShTasu| sarvamiti dharmArthakAmAH||64-65||

samprati shrutibhedavAdimataM dUShayati- shrutayashcetyAdi| na kAraNamiti na punarbhavapratiShedhe kAraNamityarthaH| yuktivirodhAt upapattivirodhAt| apatyasharIre mAtApitroH kAraNatvamanumatameva, yatastathAvidhe mAtApitroH kAraNatve satyapi caitanyahetorAtmanaH paralokAdAgamane pretyabhAvo~akhaNDita eveti| caitanyamapatyasya mAtApitrorapi caitanyaheturya AtmA tata eva bhavatIti yo manyate taM pratyAha- AtmA mAturityAdi| dvividhaM dviprakAram| sarva iti mAtaraM pitaraM parityajyApatyaM gacchet; avayaveneti eko~avayavo vA~a~atmano mAtari pitari vA tiShThet, anyashcaikadesha Atmano~apatyaM gacchet| prathamapakShe dUShaNamAha- sarvashcetyAdi| nirantaramiti cchedaH, nirantaraM tatkAlameva, yadi mAturAtmA~apatyaM sa~jcarettadA tatkAlameva mAturmaraNaM, yadi tu piturAtmA~apatyaM sa~jcarettadA tatkAlameva piturmaraNaM, syAditi| dvitIyaM pakShaM dUShayati- nAvayava ityAdi| sUkShmasyeti asthUlasya; sthUlAnAM pRuthivyAdInAmavayavA bhavanti, na tu sUkShmANAmAkAshakAlamanobuddhiprabhRutInAM; tatashcAvayavAbhAvAdAtmano~avayavena sa~jcaraNaM dUramapAstamityarthaH||9-10||

yadRucchAvAdimataM dUShayati- na parIkShetyAdi| yadRucchAvAdI khalvekamapi pramANaM nAnumanyate, tatashca tasyAprAmANikatvAt pramANaM vinaiva yatki~jcidbruvato na shraddheyaM vacanaM bhavati, tasmAdupekShaNIya evAyamiti prakaraNAbhiprAyaH| yadRucchayA aparisthitapakShatayA, upahata ihalokaparalokAnupayukta AtmA yasya sa yadRucchopahatAtmA; tasya parIkShA nAstIti parIkShAhetUnAM pramANAnAmabhAvAdityarthaH; parIkShyamapi nAsti, parIkShakapramANAbhAvAdeva; evaM kartA~api nAsti tatkAraNamapi nAsti, pramANAsvIkArAditi bhAvaH; tathA sarvajanasiddhA devAdayo~api na santItyabhidhAnena nAstikasya varjanIyatvaM darshayati| pAtakebhyo brahmAvadhAdibhyaH; paraM shreShThaM; nAsti paraloka ityAdiko graho nAstikagrahaH; nAstikabuddhyA hyucchRu~gkhalaH puruShaH sarvamapi pAtakaM karotIti bhAvaH||14-15||

AptopadeshaM darshayitumAptameva tAvadAha- AptA ityAdi| niHsheSheNa muktA nirmuktAH| tapoj~jAnabaleneti rajastamonirmuktau kAraNatvena yojanIyam| trikAlamiti atItAnAgatavartamAnaviShayam| amalamiti yathArthagrAhitvena| avyAhatamiti kvacidapi viShaye~akuNThitashaktitvena| AptI rajastamorUpadoShakShayaH, tadyuktA AptAH ; shAsati jagatkRutsnaM kAryAkAryapravRuttinivRuttyupadesheneti shiShTAH; boddhavyaM visheSheNa buddhametairiti vibuddhAH; AptAH, shiShTAH, vibuddhA iti sa~jj~jAtrayeNAptAnAM loke prasiddhiM darshayati; teShAmAptAnAM vAkyamasaMshayaM nishcitaM satyaM yathArthamityarthaH| tadvAkyasatyatve hetumAha- vakShanti te kasmAdasatyaM nIrajastamA iti| nIrajastamA iti tamappratyayAntaH shabdaH, tena nIrajastvaprakarSheNa tamo~api vyudastaM bhavati; na hi sarvathA nIrajaske puruShe tamo bhavati; yaduktaM- “nArajaskaM tamaH” (vi.a.6) iti| vakShanti te kasmAdasatyaM na kasmAdapItyarthaH; asatyaM mithyAj~jAnAdvA~abhidhIyate, samyagj~jAne satyapi rAgadveShAbhyAM vA~abhidhIyate, tacca tritayamapi mithyAj~jAnarAgadveSharUpaM rajastamonirmukte sattvaguNodrekAdamalavij~jAne na sambhavatItyarthaH; yadi vA ‘nIrajastamaso mRuShA’ iti pAThaH sugamaH| etaccAptalakShaNaM sahajAptabrahmAdyabhiprAyeNa, laukikAnAM tu puruShANAmAptatvaM prativiShayasamyagj~jAnasambhavane tadviShayarAgadveShAsambhavena ca boddhavyam; etena, Aptopadesha iti shabdarUpapramANalakShaNamuktaM bhavati; buddhipramANapakShe tu, AptopadeshajanitA buddhiH pramANamiti boddhavyam||18-19||
athAto vAtakalAkalIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tacchrutvA baDishavacanamavitathamRuShigaNairanumatamuvAca vAryovido rAjarShiH- evametat sarvamanapavAdaM yathA bhagavAnAha| yAni tu khalu vAyoH kupitAkupitasya sharIrAsharIracarasya sharIreShu carataH karmANi bahiHsharIrebhyo vA bhavanti, teShAmavayavAn pratyakShAnumAnopadeshaiH sAdhayitvA namaskRutya vAyave yathAshakti pravakShyAmaH- vAyustantrayantradharaH, prANodAnasamAnavyAnApAnAtmA, pravartakashceShTAnAmuccAvacAnAM, niyantA praNetA ca manasaH, sarvendriyANAmudyojakaH, sarvendriyArthAnAmabhivoDhA, sarvasharIradhAtuvyUhakaraH, sandhAnakaraH sharIrasya, pravartako vAcaH, prakRutiH sparshashabdayoH, shrotrasparshanayormUlaM, harShotsAhayoryoniH, samIraNo~agneH, doShasaMshoShaNaH , kSheptA bahirmalAnAM, sthUlANusrotasAM bhettA, kartAgarbhAkRutInAm, AyuSho~anuvRuttipratyayabhUto bhavatyakupitaH| kupitastu khalu sharIre sharIraM nAnAvidhairvikArairupatapati balavarNasukhAyuShAmupaghAtAya , mano vyAharShayati , sarvendriyANyupahanti, vinihanti garbhAn vikRutimApAdayatyatikAlaM vA dhArayati, bhayashokamohadainyAtipralApA~jjanayati, prANAMshcoparuNaddhi| prakRutibhUtasya khalvasya loke carataH karmANImAni bhavanti; tadyathA- dharaNIdhAraNaM, jvalanojjvAlanam, AdityacandranakShatragrahagaNAnAM santAnagatividhAnaM, sRuShTishca meghAnAm, apAM visargaH, pravartanaM srotasAM, puShpaphalAnAM cAbhinirvartanam, udbhedanaM caudbhidAnAm, RutUnAM pravibhAgaH, vibhAgo dhAtUnAM, dhAtumAnasaMsthAnavyaktiH, bIjAbhisaMskAraH, shasyAbhivardhanamavikledopashoShaNe , avaikArikavikArashceti| prakupitasya khalvasya lokeShu carataH karmANImAni bhavanti; tadyathA- shikharishikharAvamathanam, unmathanamanokahAnAm, utpIDanaM sAgarANAm, udvartanaM sarasAM, pratisaraNamApagAnAm, AkampanaM ca bhUmeH, AdhamanamambudAnAM , nIhAranirhrAdapAMshusikatAmatsyabhekoragakShArarudhirAshmAshanivisargaH, vyApAdanaM ca ShaNNAmRutUnAM, shasyAnAmasa~gghAtaH, bhUtAnAM copasargaH, bhAvAnAM cAbhAvakaraNaM, caturyugAntakarANAM meghasUryAnalAnilAnAM visargaH; sa hi bhagavAn prabhavashcAvyayashca, bhUtAnAM bhAvAbhAvakaraH, sukhAsukhayorvidhAtA, mRutyuH, yamaH, niyantA, prajApatiH, aditiH, vishvakarmA, vishvarUpaH, sarvagaH, sarvatantrANAM vidhAtA, bhAvAnAmaNuH, vibhuH, viShNuH, krAntA lokAnAM, vAyureva bhagavAniti||8||

Commentary: sharIrAsharIracarasyeti vAtasvarUpakathanaM, tena sharIreShu carata iti bahiH sharIrebhyo veti ca punaruktaM na bhavati| atrAvayavAniti vadan kArtsnyAbhidhAnamashakyaM bahuprapa~jcatvAditi darshayati| sAdhayitvA pratipAdya| vAtakarmasu pratyakShANi vacanAdIni, manaHpreraNAdyanumeyaM, garbhAkRutikaraNAdyAgamagamyam| tantraM sharIraM, yaduktaM- “tantrayantreShu bhinneShu tamo~antyaM pravivikShatAm” (iM. a.12) iti, tadeva yantraM; yadi vA, tantrasya yantraM sandhayaH| prANAdyAtmA prANAdisvarUpaH| ceShTAvisheShaNam- uccAvacAnAM, vividhAnAmityarthaH, kiMvA shubhAshubhAnAmityarthaH| niyantA anIpsite viShaye pravartamAnasya manasaH, praNetA ca manasa evepsite~arthe| udyojakaH prerakaH; kiMvA ‘udyogakAraka’ iti pAThaH, so~apyabhinnArthaH| abhivoDhevAbhivoDhA sarvendriyArthagrAhakatvena; taccAsya vAyumayena sparshanendriyeNa sarvendriyANAM vyApakatvAt pUrvAdhyAyapratipAditena nyAyena boddhavyam| vyUhakaraH sa~gghAtakaro racanAkara iti yAvat | prakRutiH kAraNaM, shabdakAraNatvaM ca vAyornityamAkAshAnupraveshAt; uktaM hi khAdInyabhidhAya- “teShAmekaguNaH pUrvo guNavRuddhiH pare pare” (shA. a.1) iti| tathA punaruktaM khAdInyabhidhAya “viShTaM hyaparaM pareNa” (nyA.da. a.2. A.1.sU.66) iti| shravaNamUlatvaM vAyoH karNashaShkulIracanAvisheShe vyApriyamANatvAt; mUlaM pradhAnakAraNam| utsAhaH kAryeShUdyogo manasaH| yoniH abhivyaktikAraNam| doShasaMshoShaNaH sharIrakledasaMshoShaNaH| bhettA kartA; etacca sharIrotpattikAle| bhUta shabdaH svarUpavacanaH| upaghAtAyeti chedaH| garbhAniti vikRutimApAdayatyatikAlaM dhArayatItyanena ca sambadhyate| AdityAdInAM santAnenAvicchedena gatividhAnaM santAnagatividhAnam| srotasAmiti nadInAm| pravibhAgo vibhaktalakShaNam | dhAtUnAmiti pRuthivyAdInAM, dhAtavaH kAryadravyANi prastarAdIni; mAnaM parimANaM, saMsthAnamAkRutiH, tayorvyaktirabhivyaktiH, tatra kAraNamiti yAvat| bIjasya shAlyAdeH, abhisaMskAro~a~gkurajananashaktiH| avikledaH pAkakAlAdarvAgaviklinnatvam, upashoShaNaM ca pAkena yavAdInAmArdrANAmeva, avikledopashoShaNe shasyAnAmeva| avaikArikavikAreNa sarvasminneva jagati prakRutirUpe kAraNatvaM brUte| shikharI parvataH| anokaho vRukShaH| UrdhvaM vartanamudvartanam| pratisaraNaM pratIpagamanam| visarjanaM visargaH, sa ca pRutha~gnIhArAdibhiH sambadhyate; nIhAraH shishirasamUhaH, nirhrAdo meghaM vinA garjitam, ashaniH vajrabhedo~agniH| asa~gghAtaH anutpAdo~anupacayo vA| upasargaH marakAdiprAdurbhAvaH| meghasUryetyAdau visargaH sRuShTiH| vAyuriha devatArUpo~abhipretaH, tena tasya bhUtarUpacaturyugAntakarAnilakaraNamaviruddham; evaM yadanyadapyanupapadyamAnaM vAyostadapi devatArUpatvenaiva samAdheyam| samprati sAmAnyena punaH kupitAkupitasya vAyoH svarUpamucyate- sa hi bhagavAnityAdi| prabhavaH kAraNam| avyayaH akShayaH| bhUtAnAmityuttareNa sambadhyate| mRutyuyamAdibhedAshcAgame j~jeyAH| sarvatantrANAM sarvakarmaNAM; tantrashabdaH karmavacano~apyasti, yaduktaM- “bastistantrANAM” (sU. a.25); karmaNAmityarthaH||8||
tacchrutvA vAryovidavaco marIciruvAca- yadyapyevametat, kimarthasyAsya vacane vij~jAne vA sAmarthyamasti bhiShagvidyAyAM; bhiShagvidyAmadhikRutyeyaM kathA pravRutteti ||9||

vAryovida uvAca- bhiShak pavanamatibalamatiparuShamatishIghrakAriNamAtyayikaM cennAnunishamyet, sahasA prakupitamatiprayataH kathamagre~abhirakShitumabhidhAsyati prAgevainamatyayabhayAt; vAyoryathArthA stutirapi bhavatyArogyAya balavarNavivRuddhaye varcasvitvAyopacayAya j~jAnopapattaye paramAyuHprakarShAya ceti||10||

marIciruvAca- agnireva sharIre pittAntargataH kupitAkupitaH shubhAshubhAni karoti; tadyathA- paktimapaktiM darshanamadarshanaM mAtrAmAtratvamUShmaNaH prakRutivikRutivarNau shauryaM bhayaM krodhaM harShaM mohaM prasAdamityevamAdIni cAparANi dvandvAnIti||11||

Commentary: pittAntargata iti vacanena sharIre jvAlAdiyuktavahniniShedhena pittoShmarUpasya vahneH sadbhAvaM darshayati; na tu pittAdabhedaM, pittenAgnimAndyasya grahaNyadhyAye vakShyamANatvAt, tathA pittaharasya sarpiSho~agnivardhanatvenoktatvAt| paktimapaktimiti avikRutivikRutibhedena pAcakasyAgneH karma, darshanAdarshane netragatasyAlocakasya, UShmaNo mAtrAmAtratvaM varNabhedau ca tvaggatasya bhrAjakasya, bhayashauryAdayo hRudayasthasya sAdhakasya, ra~jjakasya tu bahiHsphuTakAryAdarshanAdudAharaNaM na kRutam||11||

tacchrutvA marIcivacaH kApya uvAca- soma eva sharIre shleShmAntargataH kupitAkupitaH shubhAshubhAni karoti; tadyathA- dArDhyaM shaithilyamupacayaM kArshyamutsAhamAlasyaM vRuShatAM klIbatAM j~jAnamaj~jAnaM buddhiM mohamevamAdIni cAparANi dvandvAnIti||12||

Commentary: somo jaladevatA, yadi vA candraH||12||

tacchrutvA kApyavaco bhagavAn punarvasurAtreya uvAca- sarva eva bhavantaH samyagAhuranyatraikAntikavacanAt; sarva eva khalu vAtapittashleShmANaH prakRutibhUtAH puruShamavyApannendriyaM balavarNasukhopapannamAyuShA mahatopapAdayanti samyagevAcaritA dharmArthakAmA iva niHshreyasena mahatA puruShamiha cAmuShmiMshca loke; vikRutAstvenaM mahatA viparyayeNopapAdayanti Rutavastraya iva vikRutimApannA lokamashubhenopaghAtakAla iti||13||
tadRuShayaH sarva evAnumenire vacanamAtreyasya bhagavato~abhinanandushceti||14||
bhavati cAtra- tadAtreyavacaH shrutvA sarva evAnumenire| RuShayo~abhinanandushca yathendravacanaM surAH||15||
tatra shlokau- guNAH ShaD dvividho heturvividhaM karma yat punaH| vAyoshcaturvidhaM karma pRuthak ca kaphapittayoH||16||
maharShINAM matiryA yA punarvasumatishca yA| kalAkalIye vAtasya tat sarvaM samprakAshitam||17||

vAtakalAkalAj~jAnamadhikRutya parasparamatAni jij~jAsamAnAH samupavishya maharShayaH papracchuranyo~anyaM- ki~gguNo vAyuH, kimasya prakopaNam, upashamanAni vA~asya kAni, kathaM cainamasa~gghAtavantamanavasthitamanAsAdya prakopaNaprashamanAni prakopayanti prashamayanti vA, kAni cAsya kupitAkupitasya sharIrAsharIracarasya sharIreShu carataH karmANi bahiHsharIrebhyoveti||3||

Commentary: atrAnekarShivacanarUpatayA vAtAdiguNavacanaM bahvRuShisammatidarshanArthaM tantradharmaitihyayuktatvakaraNArthaM ca| asa~gghAtamiti pittashleShmavadavayavasa~gghAtarahitam| anavasthitamiti calasvabhAvam| anAsAdyeti calatvenAnibiDAvayatvena ceti mantavyam||3||

atrovAca kushaH sA~gkRutyAyanaH- rUkShalaghushItadAruNakharavishadAH ShaDime vAtaguNA bhavanti||4||

Commentary: rUkShAdayo bhAvapradhAnAH, tena rUkShatvAdayo guNA mantavyAH| dAruNatvaM calatvaM calatvAt, evaM dIrgha~jjIvitIyoktaM calatvamuktaM bhavati; yadi vA, dAruNatvaM shoShaNatvAt kAThinyaM karotIti||4||

tacchrutvA vAkyaM kumArashirA bharadvAja uvAca- evametadyathA bhagavAnAha, eta eva vAtaguNA bhavanti, sa tveva~gguNairevandravyairevamprabhAvaishca karmabhirabhyasyamAnairvAyuH prakopamApadyate, samAnaguNAbhyAso hi dhAtUnAM vRuddhikAraNamiti||5||

Commentary: kumArashirA iti bharadvAjavisheShaNamAtreyagurubharadvAjaniShedhArtham| evamprabhAvairiti prabhAvAdraukShyAdikArakairdhAvanajAgaraNAdibhiH, prabhAvAbhidhAnaM ca karmaNAM nirguNatvAt| abhyasyamAnairiti asakRutprayuktaiH||5||

tacchrutvA vAkyaM kA~gkAyano bAhlIkabhiShaguvAca- evametadyathA bhagavAnAha, etAnyeva vAtaprakopaNAni bhavanti; ato viparItAni vAtasya prashamanAni bhavanti, prakopaNaviparyayo hi dhAtUnAM prashamakAraNamiti||6||

tacchrutvA vAkyaM baDisho dhAmArgava uvAca- evametadyathA bhagavAnAha, etAnyeva vAtaprakopaprashamanAni bhavanti| yathA hyenamasa~gghAtamanavasthitamanAsAdya prakopaNaprashamanAni prakopayanti prashamayanti vA, tathA~anuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- vAtaprakopaNAni khalu rUkShalaghushItadAruNakharavishadashuShirakarANi sharIrANAM, tathAvidheShu sharIreShu vAyurAshrayaM gatvA~a~apyAyamAnaH prakopamApadyate; vAtaprashamanAni punaHsnigdhagurUShNashlakShNamRudupicchilaghanakarANi sharIrANAM, tathAvidheShu sharIreShu vAyurasajyamAnashcaran prashAntimApadyate||7||

pUrvAdhyAye rogAH svarUpamArgabAhyakAraNabheShajairabhihitAH, upayuktaj~jAnAstatkAraNavAtAdayo bahuvAcyatvAnnoktAH, ataH samprati pRuthakprakaraNe te~abhidhIyante vAtakalAkalIye; tatrApi prAdhAnyAdvAyureva prathamamucyate| kalA guNaH, yaduktaM- “ShoDashakalam” (sU.a.10) iti; akalA guNaviruddho doShaH; tena vAtakalAkalIyo vAtaguNadoShIya ityarthaH; yadi vA kalA sUkShmo bhAgaH, tasyApi kalA kalAkalA; tasyApi sUkShmo bhAga ityarthaH||1-2||
tacchrutvetyAdi sugamam| varcasvitvaM tejasvitvam||9-10||
aikAntikavacanAditi avadhAraNAdityarthaH| niHshreyasena sukhena| Rutavastraya iti shItoShNavarShalakShaNAshcaturmAsena RutunA| upaghAtakAla iti deshocchedakAle||13-15||

sa~ggrahe guNAH ShaDiti rUkShAdayaH| dvividho heturiti vAtaprakopaheturvAtaprashamahetushca| vividhaM nAnAprakAraM sannikhilameva vAyoH karma, yat punashcaturvidhaM kupitAkupitasharIrAsharIracarabhedena bhavati, taduktamiti yojanIyaM; na hi caturvidhavyatirekeNa vAyoH pRuthagvidhaM karmoktam||16-17||

sharIrANAmiti sharIrAvayavAnAm| shuShirakarANi randhrakarANi| Ashrayamiti samAnaguNasthAnam| ApyAyamAnaH cIyamAnaH| dAruNaviparIto mRuduH, shuShiraviparIto ghanaH| asajyamAnaH anavatiShThamAnaH, kShIyamANAvayava iti yAvat| etenaitaduktaM bhavati- yadyapi vAyunA vAtakAraNAnAM vAtashamanAnAM vA tathA sambandho nAsti, tathA~api sharIrasambaddhaistairvAtasya sharIracAriNaH sambandho bhavati, tatashca vAtasya samAnaguNayogAdvRuddhirviparItaguNayogAcca hrAsa upapanna eveti||6-7||
(kaTUShNaM tailamairaNDaM vAtashleShmaharaM guru | kaShAyasvAdutiktaishca yojitaM pittahantrapi ||1||)
ghRutaM pittAnilaharaM rasashukraujasAM hitam| nirvApaNaM mRudukaraM svaravarNaprasAdanam||14||
mArutaghnaM na ca shleShmavardhanaM balavardhanam| tvacyamuShNaM sthirakaraM tailaM yonivishodhanam||15||
viddhabhagnAhatabhraShTayonikarNashiroruji| pauruShopacaye snehe vyAyAme ceShyate vasA||16||
balashukrarasashleShmamedomajjavivardhanaH| majjA visheShato~asthnAM ca balakRut snehane hitaH||17||

sarpiH sharadi pAtavyaM vasA majjA ca mAdhave| tailaM prAvRuShi nAtyuShNashIte snehaM pibennaraH||18||

Commentary: sarpirAdipAnakAlamAha- sarpiH sharadItyAdi| mAdhave vaishAkhe| prAvRuDAShADhashrAvaNau, yaduktaM- “prAvRuT shukranabhau j~jeyau” (si.a.6) iti| sharadi bahupittatvena pittaviruddhaM ghRutameva yaugikaM, nAnyastailAdiH| vasAmajj~jostu nAtishItoShNatvAt sAdhAraNe; yatastayoranupAne shItatvena voShNatvena vA nirdesho na kRutaH; “yathAsattvaM tu shaityauShNye vasAmajj~jorvinirdishet” (sU.a.27) iti tu vacanena shaityauShNyAbhidhAnaM sAmAnyena, tailasarpirvadauShNyashaityAnabhidhAnAnna prakarShaprAptashaityoShNatvaprApakam| ata evoktaM- “tailavasAmajjasarpiShAM tu yathApUrvaM shreShThatvaM vAtashleShmavikAreShu bhavati, yathottaraM pittavikAreShu” (vi.a.8) iti| atrottarasya sarpiShaH shaityAt pittaharatvaM, tailasya tUShNatvAdvAtashleShmaharatvaM, vasAmajj~jostu sAdhAraNatvena madhyagatatvamiti sthitam| evaM vasAmajj~joH sAdhAraNatvena tathA balyatvadhAtuvRuddhikaratvAbhyAmanatishItoShNe tathA balakShayadhAtukShayayukte mAdhave prayogo yuktaH| caitrastu mukhyasAdhAraNaguNo~api prabhUtashleShmatayA na snehaviShaya ityanuktaH| sAmAnyena snehopayoge shastaM kAlamAha- nAtyuShNetyAdi| nAtyuShNe grIShme, nAtishIte hemante shishire ca tathA varShajanitashaitye varShAkAle| ayaM cAnAtyayikavikAre sati kAlaniyamo j~jeyaH, agre uShNe shIte ca kAle snehopadeshAt||18||

vAtapittAdhiko rAtrAvuShNe cApi pibennaraH| shleShmAdhiko divA shIte pibeccAmalabhAskare||19||

Commentary: kAlavisheShe doShavisheShe ca pAnakramaM darshayati- vAtetyAdinA| vAtashca pittaM ca vAtapittaM, tadadhiko vAtapittAdhikaH| rAtrAviti sAyam| uShNe grIShme| shleShmAdhikagrahaNamatyantashItavikAragRuhItapuruShopalakShaNArthaM, tena vAtashleShmAdhikaH shleShmAdhikashca gRuhyate; ata eva sushrute~apyuktaM- “vAtapittAdhiko rAtrau vAtashleShmAdhiko divA” (su.ci.31) iti| kevalavAtAdhikasya tathA pittAdhikasya shleShmAdhikasya ca sAdhAraNe sharadAdau kAle utsargasiddha eva pAnakAlo vakShyamANo bhavati| vakShyati hi- “pibet saMshamanaM snehamannakAle” ityAdi| anye tu bruvate- vAtAdhikagrahaNena kevalavAtasyApi grahaNaM, shleShmAdhikavyapadeshAcca vAtashleShma-pittashleShmaNorapi grahaNamiti| shIte hemantAdau| amalaH prabalarashmiryasmin dinasya bhAge bhAskaraH so~amalabhAskaro madhyAhna iti yAvat||19||
atyuShNe vA divA pIto vAtapittAdhikena vA| mUrcchAM pipAsAmunmAdaM kAmalAM vA samIrayet||20||
shIte rAtrau piban snehaM naraH shleShmAdhiko~api vA| AnAhamaruciM shUlaM pANDutAM vA samRucchati||21||

jalamuShNaM ghRute peyaM yUShastaile~anu shasyate| vasAmajj~jostu maNDaH syAt sarveShUShNamathAmbu vA||22||

Commentary: anupAnamAha- jalamityAdi| taile~anviti anupAne| anupAnaparimANaM tu samyagbheShajapAkArthaM kriyamANaM bheShajAvaikArikapAkenaivonneyaM, vRuddhavaidyavyavahArAcca||22||
