odanashca vilepI ca raso mAMsaM payo dadhi| yavAgUH sUpashAkau ca yUShaH kAmbalikaH khaDaH||23||
saktavastilapiShTaM ca madyaM lehAstathaiva ca| bhakShyamabhya~jjanaM bastistathA cottarabastayaH||24||
gaNDUShaH karNatailaM ca nastaHkarNAkShitarpaNam| caturviMshatirityetAH snehasya pravicAraNAH ||25||

acchapeyastu yaH sneho na tAmAhurvicAraNAm| snehasya sa bhiShagdRuShTaH kalpaH prAthamakalpikaH||26||

Commentary: kevalasnehapAnaM tu snehane shaktyatishayavattvena na vicAraNAsa~jj~jayocyate, etadevAha- acchapeya ityAdi| acchashca peyashca acchapeyaH, odanAdyasambandhe sati peya ityarthaH| na tAmAhurvicAraNAmiti vacanena vaidyaparamparAsiddho~ayaM vyavahAra iti darshayati| bhiShagbhirdRuShTo bhiShagdRuShTaH| prathame shreShThe kalpe pakShe bhavatIti prAthamakalpikaH, shreShTha ityarthaH||26||
rasaishcopahitaH snehaH samAsavyAsayogibhiH| ShaDbhistriShaShTidhA sa~gkhyAM prApnotyekashca kevalaH||27||
evametAshcatuHShaShTiH snehAnAM pravicAraNA | okartuvyAdhipuruShAn prayojyA jAnatA bhavet||28||
ahorAtramahaH kRutsnamardhAhaM ca pratIkShate| pradhAnA madhyamA hrasvA snehamAtrA jarAM prati||29||
iti tisraH samuddiShTA mAtrAH snehasya mAnataH| tAsAM prayogAn vakShyAmi puruShaM puruShaM prati||30||
prabhUtasnehanityA ye kShutpipAsAsahA narAH| pAvakashcottamabalo yeShAM ye cottamA bale||31||
gulminaH sarpadaShTAshca visarpopahatAshca ye| unmattAH kRucchramUtrAshca gADhavarcasa eva ca||32||
pibeyuruttamAM mAtrAM tasyAH pAne guNA~jchRuNu| vikArA~jchamayatyeShAM shIghraM samyakprayojitA||33||
doShAnukarShiNI mAtrA sarvamArgAnusAriNI| balyA punarnavakarI sharIrendriyacetasAm||34||
aruShkasphoTapiDakAkaNDUpAmAbhirarditAH| kuShThinashca pramIDhAshca vAtashoNitikAshca ye||35||
nAtibahvAshinashcaiva mRudukoShThAstathaiva ca| pibeyurmadhyamAM mAtrAM madhyamAshcApi ye bale||36||
mAtraiShA mandavibhraMshA na cAtibalahAriNI| sukhena ca snehayati shodhanArthe ca yujyate||37||
ye tu vRuddhAshca bAlAshca sukumArAH sukhocitAH| riktakoShThatvamahitaM yeShAM mandAgnayashca ye||38||
jvarAtIsArakAsAshca yeShAM cirasamutthitAH| snehamAtrAM pibeyuste hrasvAM ye cAvarA bale||39||
parihAre sukhA caiShA mAtrA snehanabRuMhaNI| vRuShyA balyA nirAbAdhA ciraM cApyanuvartate||40||

sA~gkhyaiH sa~gkhyAtasa~gkhyeyaiH sahAsInaM punarvasum| jagaddhitArthaM papraccha vahniveshaH svasaMshayam||3||

Commentary: sa~gkhyA samyagj~jAnaM, tena vyavaharantIti sA~gkhyAH| sa~gkhyAtaM j~jAtaM sa~gkhyeyaM j~jeyaM yaiste tathA; yadi vA ‘sa~gkhyAtasa~gkhyeyam’ iti pAThaH, tadA punarvasuvisheShaNametat; arthastu samAnaH| sA~gkhyaiH sahAvasthAnopadarshanamAtreyasya kartavyaprashnAnuguNamanaHsamAdhAnopadarshanArtham| saMshayamiti saMshayena viShayiNA viShayaM lakShayati, tena saMshayamiti saMshayaviShayamityarthaH||3||
kiMyonayaH kati snehAH ke ca snehaguNAH pRuthak| kAlAnupAne ke kasya kati kAshca vicAraNAH||4||
kati mAtrAH kathammAnAH kA ca keShUpadishyate| kashca kebhyo hitaH snehaH prakarShaH snehane ca kaH||5||
snehyAH ke ke na ca snigdhAsnigdhAtisnigdhalakShaNam| kiM pAnAt prathamaM pIte jIrNe ki~jca hitAhitam||6||
ke mRudukrUrakoShThAH kA vyApadaH siddhayashca kAH| acche saMshodhane caiva snehe kA vRuttiriShyate||7||
vicAraNAH keShu yojyA vidhinA kena tat prabho!| snehasyAmitavij~jAna j~jAnamicchAmi veditum||8||
vAtapittaprakRutayo vAtapittavikAriNaH| cakShuHkAmAH kShatAH kShINA vRuddhA bAlAstathA~abalAH||41||
AyuHprakarShakAmAshca balavarNasvarArthinaH| puShTikAmAH prajAkAmAH saukumAryArthinashca ye||42||
dIptyojaHsmRutimedhAgnibuddhIndriyabalArthinaH| pibeyuH sarpirArtAshca dAhashastraviShAgnibhiH||43||
pravRuddhashleShmamedaskAshcalasthUlagalodarAH| vAtavyAdhibhirAviShTA vAtaprakRutayashca ye||44||
balaM tanutvaM laghutAM dRuDhatAM sthiragAtratAm | snigdhashlakShNatanutvaktAM ye ca kA~gkShanti dehinaH||45||
kRumikoShThAH krUrakoShThAstathA nADIbhirarditAH| pibeyuH shItale kAle tailaM tailocitAshca ye||46||
vAtAtapasahA ye ca rUkShA bhArAdhvakarshitAH| saMshuShkaretorudhirA niShpItakaphamedasaH||47||
asthisandhisirAsnAyumarmakoShThamahArujaH| balavAnmAruto yeShAM khAni cAvRutya tiShThati||48||
mahaccAgnibalaM yeShAM vasAsAtmyAshca ye narAH| teShAM snehayitavyAnAM vasApAnaM vidhIyate||49||

dIptAgnayaH kleshasahA ghasmarAH snehasevinaH| vAtArtAH krUrakoShThAshca snehyA majjAnamApnuyuH||50||

Commentary: dIptAgnaya ityAdi majjapAnaviShayaH| ghasmarA bahubhakShakAH| ApnuyuH upayu~jjIran||50||-

snehanasya prakarShau tu saptarAtratrirAtrakau||51||

Commentary: prakarShAviti alpaprakarShabhUyaHprakarShau ; tena, alpatvena trairAtrikaH prakarShaH, bhUyastvena sAptarAtrika iti ca bhavati| etacca vakShyamANasadyaHsnehaprayogAtiriktaprayoge boddhavyaM; yadi vA, sadyaHsnehaprayogA api tryaheNaiva snehayanti, stutyarthaM tu teShu sadya ityuktam| yaduktaM- “tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya iShTaH| nAtaH paraM snehanamAdishanti sAtmyIbhavet saptadinAt paraM tu” (si.a.1.) iti||51||

svedyAH shodhayitavyAshca rUkShA vAtavikAriNaH| vyAyAmamadyastrInityAH snehyAH syurye ca cintakAH||52||

Commentary: sAmAnyena snehyAnAha- svedyA ityAdi| svedyAH svatantrasvedasAdhyA vAtarugArtAdayaH, shodhanA~ggasvedasAdhyAnAM tu shodhayitavyA ityanenaiva gRuhItatvAt| cintakA iti cintAbahulAH||52||
atha tatsaMshayacchettA pratyuvAca punarvasuH| snehAnAM dvividhA saumya yoniH sthAvaraja~ggamA||9||
tilaH priyAlAbhiShukau bibhItakashcitrAbhayairaNDamadhUkasarShapAH| kusumbhabilvArukamUlakAtasInikocakAkShoDakara~jjashigrukAH||10||
snehAshayAH sthAvarasa~jj~jitAstathA syurja~ggamA matsyamRugAH sapakShiNaH| teShAM dadhikShIraghRutAmiShaM vasA sneheShu majjA ca tathopadishyate||11||
saMshodhanAdRute yeShAM rUkShaNaM sampravakShyate| na teShAM snehanaM shastamutsannakaphamedasAm||53||
abhiShyaNNAnanagudA nityamandAgnayashca ye| tRuShNAmUrcchAparItAshca garbhiNyastAlushoShiNaH||54||
annadviShashchardayanto jaTharAmagarArditAH| durbalAshca pratAntAshca snehaglAnA madAturAH||55||
na snehyA vartamAneShu na nasto bastikarmasu| snehapAnAt prajAyante teShAM rogAH sudAruNAH||56||
purIShaM grathitaM rUkShaM vAyurapraguNo mRuduH| paktA kharatvaM raukShyaM ca gAtrasyAsnigdhalakShaNam||57||
vAtAnulomyaM dIpto~agnirvarcaH snigdhamasaMhatam| mArdavaM snigdhatA cA~gge snigdhAnAmupajAyate||58||
pANDutA gauravaM jADyaM purIShasyAvipakvatA| tandrIrarucirutkeshaH syAdatisnigdhalakShaNam||59||
dravoShNamanabhiShyandi bhojyamannaM pramANataH| nAtisnigdhamasa~gkIrNaM shvaH snehaM pAtumicchatA||60||
pibet saMshamanaM snehamannakAle prakA~gkShitaH| shuddhyarthaM punarAhAre naishe jIrNe pibennaraH||61||
uShNodakopacArI syAdbrahmacArI kShapAshayaH | shakRunmUtrAnilodgArAnudIrNAMshca na dhArayet||62||
vyAyAmamuccairvacanaM krodhashokau himAtapau| varjayedapravAtaM ca seveta shayanAsanam||63||
snehaM pItvA naraH snehaM pratibhu~jjAna eva ca| snehamithyopacArAddhi jAyante dAruNA gadAH||64||
mRudukoShThastrirAtreNa snihyatyacchopasevayA| snihyati krUrakroShThastu saptarAtreNa mAnavaH||65||
guDamikShurasaM mastu kShIramulloDitaM dadhi| pAyasaM kRusharAM sarpiH kAshmaryatriphalArasam||66||
drAkShArasaM pIlurasaM jalamuShNamathApi vA| madyaM vA taruNaM pItvA mRudukoShTho viricyate||67||
virecayanti naitAni krUrakoShThaM kadAcana| bhavati krUrakoShThasya grahaNyatyulbaNAnilA||68||
udIrNapittA~alpakaphA grahaNI mandamArutA| mRudukoShThasya tasmAt sa suvirecyo naraH smRutaH||69||
udIrNapittA grahaNI yasya cAgnibalaM mahat| bhasmIbhavati tasyAshu snehaH pIto~agnitejasA||70||
sa jagdhvA snehamAtrAM tAmojaH prakShArayan balI| snehAgniruttamAM tRuShNAM sopasargAmudIrayet||71||
nAlaM snehasamRuddhasya shamAyAnnaM sugurvapi| sa cet sushItaM salilaM nAsAdayati dahyate| yathaivAshIviShaH kakShamadhyagaH svaviShAgninA||72||
ajIrNe yadi tu snehe tRuShNA syAcchardayedbhiShak| shItodakaM punaH pItvA bhuktvA rUkShAnnamullikhet||73||
na sarpiH kevalaM pitte peyaM sAme visheShataH| sarvaM hyanurajeddehaM hatvA sa~jj~jAM ca mArayet||74||
tandrA sotklesha AnAho jvaraH stambho visa~jj~jatA| kuShThAni kaNDUH pANDutvaM shophArshAMsyarucistRuShA||75||
jaTharaM grahaNIdoShAH staimityaM vAkyanigrahaH| shUlamAmapradoShAshca jAyante snehavibhramAt||76||
tatrApyullekhanaM shastaM svedaH kAlapratIkShaNam| prati prati vyAdhibalaM buddhvA sraMsanameva ca||77||
takrAriShTaprayogashca rUkShapAnAnnasevanam| mUtrANAM triphalAyAshca snehavyApattibheShajam||78||

akAle cAhitashcaiva mAtrayA na ca yojitaH| sneho mithyopacArAcca vyApadyetAtisevitaH||79||

Commentary: mithyopacArAt yathoktavidhyananuShThAnAt| atisevitaH kAlaprakarSheNa sevitaH||79||

snehAt praskandanaM jantustrirAtroparataH pibet| snehavaddravamuShNaM ca tryahaM bhuktvA rasaudanam||80||

Commentary: saMshodhanasnehapAne vRuttipracAramAha- snehAdityAdi| snehAt snehaprayogAt| trirAtroparataH trirAtraM parityaktasnehapAna ityarthaH| praskandanaM virecanam| snehoparamatrirAtra eva bhojanaM darshayati- snehavadityAdi| rasapradhAnamodanaM rasaudanam||80||

syAttvasaMshodhanArthIye vRuttiH snehe viriktavat||81||

Commentary: saMshamanavidhimAha- syAttvityAdi| asaMshodhanArthIye saMshamane| vRuttiH upacAraH| viriktavadityanenAgatAvekShaNenopakalpanIyavakShyamANaM “samyagviriktaM cainaM” (sU. a.15) ityAdigranthapratipAdanIyamupacAramAha, natu peyAdikramamAtram | yadyapi vamanoktA eva tatroccairbhAShyAdayo virecanavRuttAvapyatidiShTAstathA~apIha vamanavidhi parityajya virecanavidhyatidesho dhUmapAnapratiShedhArthaH, virecane hi tatra “dhUmapAnavarjaM” (sU. a.15) iti kRutaM, snehapAne ca dhUmapAnaM niShiddhaM mAtrAshitIye- “na madyadugdhe pItvA ca na snehaM” (sU. a.5) ityAdinA||81||
snehadviShaH snehanityA mRudukoShThAshca ye narAH| kleshAsahA madyanityAsteShAmiShTA vicAraNA||82||
lAvataittiramAyUrahAMsavArAhakaukkuTAH| gavyAjaurabhramAtsyAshca rasAH syuH snehane hitAH||83||
yavakolakulatthAshca snehAH saguDasharkarAH| dADimaM dadhi savyoShaM rasasaMyogasa~ggrahaH||84||
snehayanti tilAH pUrvaM jagdhAH sasnehaphANitAH| kRusharAshca bahusnehAstilakAmbalikAstathA||85||
phANitaM shRu~ggaveraM ca tailaM ca surayA saha| pibedrUkSho bhRutairmAMsairjIrNe~ashnIyAcca bhojanam||86||
tailaM surAyA maNDena vasAM majjAnameva vA| piban saphANitaM kShIraM naraH snihyati vAtikaH||87||
dhAroShNaM snehasaMyuktaM pItvA sasharkaraM payaH| naraH snihyati pItvA vA saraM dadhnaH saphANitam||88||
pA~jcaprasRutikI peyA pAyaso mAShamishrakaH| kShIrasiddho bahusnehaH snehayedacirAnnaram||89||
sarpistailavasAmajjAtaNDulaprasRutaiH shRu(kRu)tA| pA~jcaprasRutikI peyA peyA snehanamicchatA||90||
grAmyAnUpaudakaM mAMsaM guDaM dadhi payastilAn| kuShThI shothI pramehI ca snehane na prayojayet||91||
snehairyathArhaM tAn siddhaiH snehayedavikAribhiH| pippalIbhirharItakyA siddhaistriphalayA~api vA||92||
drAkShAmalakayUShAbhyAM dadhnA cAmlena sAdhayet| vyoShagarbhaM bhiShak snehaM pItvA snihyati taM naraH||93||
yavakolakulatthAnAM rasAH kShAraH surA dadhi| kShIrasarpishca tat siddhaM snehanIyaM ghRutottamam||94||

tailamajjavasAsarpirbadaratriphalArasaiH| yonishukrapradoSheShu sAdhayitvA prayojayet||95||

Commentary: tailamajjetyAdi|- catuHsneho~akalka eva, tailamajjavasAsarpirityekavadbhAvAddvitIyAntaH prayogaH||95||
gRuhNAtyambu yathA vastraM prasravatyadhikaM yathA| yathAgni jIryati snehastathA sravati cAdhikaH||96||
yathA vA~a~akledya mRutpiNDamAsiktaM tvarayA jalam| sravati sraMsate snehastathA tvaritasevitaH||97||

lavaNopahitAH snehAH snehayantyacirAnnaram| taddhyabhiShyandyarUkShaM ca sUkShmamuShNaM vyavAyi ca||98||

Commentary: snehane sarvasneheShu lavaNaprayogamAha- lavaNopahitA ityAdi| taditi lavaNam| abhiShyandi doShasa~gghAtavicchedakam| vyavAyi akhiladehavyAptipUrvakapAkagAmi||98||

snehamagre prayu~jjIta tataH svedamanantaram| snehasvedopapannasya saMshodhanamathetarat ||99||

Commentary: ato vakShyamANasvedopakalpanAdhyAyayoH sambandhasUcakaM svedAdiShu snehasya prAgbhAvamAha- snehamityAdi||99||

tatra shlokaH- snehAH snehavidhiH kRutsnavyApatsiddhiH sabheShajA| yathAprashnaM bhagavatA vyAhRutaM cAndrabhAginA||100||

Commentary: cAndrabhAgI punarvasuH||100||

sarveShAM tailajAtAnAM tilatailaM vishiShyate| balArthe snehane cAgryamairaNDaM tu virecane||12||

Commentary: tailajAtAnAmiti jAtashabdaH prakAravacanaH; yathA- “yadAhArajAtamagnivesha” (sU.a.25) ityAdi| atra yadyapi yogAttilabhavameva tailaM, tathA~api rUDhyeha sarva eva sthAvarasnehAstailamityucyante| yaduktaM sushrute- “niShpattestadguNatvAcca tailatvamitareShvapi” (su.sU.a.45) iti| vishiShyate atiricyate| agryamityairaNDena sambadhyate||12||

sarpistailaM vasA majjA sarvasnehottamA matAH| eShu caivottamaM sarpiH saMskArasyAnuvartanAt||13||

Commentary: sarvasnehottamA ityatra sarvashabdena dadhikShIrAdayo gRuhyante; sarvasnehottamatvaM ca sarpirAdInAM snehaguNaprakarShavattvena| saMskAro guNAntarAropaNaM, tasyAnuvartanamanuvidhAnaM svIkaraNamiti yAvat| etaduktaM bhavati- yat- na tathA tailAdayo dravyAntarasaMskRutAH saMskAraguNAn vahanti yathA sarpiriti| ata evoktaM- “nAnyaH snehastathA kashcit saMskAramanuvartate| yathA sarpirataH sarpiH sarvasnehottamaM matam” (ni. a.1)| ata eva saMskArakadravyacitrakAdiguNAnuvidhAne~api sarpirna svaguNAn snehashaityAdIn jahAti, ki~jca svaguNAn tadguNAMshca vahati, yato~anushabdena pashcAdvAcinA svaguNavartanasya pashcAt saMskArakaguNavartanamucyate| ata evoktaM- “snehAdvAtaM shamayati pittaM mAdhuryashaityataH| ghRutaM tulyaguNaM doShaM saMskArAttu jayet kapham” (ni. a.1) iti| na ca vAcyaM rUkShoShNacitrakAdisaMskArAdrUkShoShNaM sarpirbhUtaM, tatashca sarpiShaH snehashaitye tadviruddhe kathaM tiShThataH? iti; yataH sarpiHsambaddhacitrakAvayavAnugataM hi rUkShoShNatvaM, sarpirgate ca snehashaitye iti bhinnAshrayatvAnna virodhaH; idameva ca sarpiShaH saMskArAnuvartanaM yat- svaguNaviruddhasyApi tasyAnupaghAtena dhAraNaM; saMskArakacitrakAdiguNavahane~api sarpiShaH shaityAdayaH kadAcidabhibhUyante saMskArakaguNairuShNAdibhirna punaH snehaguNaH, tasya sneheShu sarvAtmanA vyavasthitasya prabalatvAt; ata eva sarpirAdayaH snehapradhAnatvAt ‘snehA’ ityucyante| anye tu saMskArAnuvartanaM svaguNopaghAtena saMskArakaguNavahanaM bruvate, etacca taile tiShThati na sarpiShIti vadanti; sarpiShi tu saMskArAnuvartanamuktaM yat tat sarpiShi sarvathA kasyacidguNasya saMskAraguNenAnupaghAtAdbhavati ; tathAhi- dAhaprashamanArthaM jvare candanAdishItadravyasAdhitatailamuktaM, yataH shItena sAdhitaM tailamuShNamapi svabhAvAcchItameva bhavatIti||13||

snehaguNAnabhidhatte- ghRutamityAdi| nirvApaNaM dAhaprashamanam| mArutaghnamityAdi tailaguNAH| sthirakaram a~ggasthairyakaram| viddhetyAdi vasAguNAH| pauruShopacayaH shukropacayaH| snehe sharIrasnehane kartavye| balashukretyAdi majjaguNAH||14-17||

uktakAlaniyamaviparyaye doShamAha- atyuShNe vetyAdi| atyuShNe kAle divA pItaH snehaH shlaiShmikasyApi yathoktavikArakaraH, tathA vAtapittAdhikena pItaH shItakAle~api yathoktavikArakaraH; evaM nishApAne~api vAkyArthaH; paraM niShiddhasya kAlasya doShasya ca melake~atyaye coktavikAraprakarShAprakarShau tarkaNIyau||20-21||

vicAraNAH sa~gkhyayA svarUpeNa caikagranthenAha- odanashcetyAdi| vilepI viraladravA yavAgUrbahusikthasamanvitA j~jeyA| sashAkapallavena kRuto yUShaH khaDaH| kAmbaliko dadhilavaNasnehatilAdikRuta IShadamlaH| etayorudAharaNaM yathA- “takre kapitthacA~ggerImaricAjAjicitrakaiH | supakvaH khaDayUSho~ayamayaM kAmbaliko mataH|| dadhyamlo lavaNasnehatilamAShAnvitaH shRutaH” iti| lehaH sharkarAdInAM pAkAt kRutaH; lihyata iti lehaH| pravicAryate avacAryate~anukalpenopayujyate~anayeti pravicAraNA odanAdayaH; odanAdayashca snehapravicAraNAyAM snehayuktA eva boddhavyAH; abhya~jjanAdayastu yadyapi shuddhasnehasampAdyAstathA~api jaTharAgnisambandhe na vyApriyanta iti tantre vicAraNAshabdenocyante||23-25||

prakArAntareNa vicAraNAbhedamAha- rasaishcetyAdi| samAso rasAnAmanyonyamelakaH, vyAso~amelakaH; samAsavyAsavadbhiH ShaDbhI rasairodanAdigatairupahito yuktaH san snehastriShaShTisa~gkhyAM prApnoti| ekashca kevala ityacchapeyaM varjayitvA~abhya~jjanAdiprayojyaH| triShaShThI rasabhedA AtreyabhadrakApyIye “svAduramlAdibhiryogaM” (sU.a.26) ityAdivAkye vakShyamANA boddhavyAH| evaM snehAnAM rasayuktAnAM catuHShaShTiH pravicAraNA bhavanti| catuHShaShTiriti snehAnAmityanena sambadhyate, tena pravicAraNetyekavacanamupapannaM bhavati| na sarvavicAraNA sarvatra kartavyA, kintu sAtmyartuvyAdhidoShapuruShAn parIkShya yA yatra yujyate sA tatra kartavyetyAha- okartvityAdi| okaH abhyAsaH| puruShagrahaNena kasmin deshe~ayaM puruSho vartata iti parIkShayA desho~apyavaruddho boddhavyaH, vayobalaprabhRutayashca boddhavyAH||27-28||

mAtrAyAH sa~gkhyAM pramANaM cAha- ahorAtramityAdi| ahorAtrashabdo~aShTapraharopalakShaNaH, evamahaHshabdArdhAhashabdau catuHpraharadvipraharopalakShaNau, tena praharAdyatIte~apyahani pItA mAtrA yathoktapraharakAlaprAptyA dinAntare rAtrau vA jIryamANA mantavyA; anye tvahorAtrashabdena nyUnenApyahnA yuktA rAtrirahorAtrashabdenocyate , kRutsnArdhAhau tu praharopalakShaNAviti vadanti| atra yadA ahorAtrapariNAminI mAtrA kriyate, tadA tadaharAhAro na kartavyaH; ata evaitatpAnaM puruShavisheShaviShayakathane uktaM- “kShutpipAsAsahAnarAH” iti| prabhUtasnehanityAH prabhUtasnehasAtmyAH| samyagyo jitetivacanena mahAvyApattitvamasyAH sUcayati| sarvamArgAH koShThasandhimarmashAkhAH| punarnavakarI niHsheShadoShaharatvena| aruShketyAdi madhyamamAtrAguNaH; aruShkA arUMShikA| shodhanArtha iti shodhanArtha(~gga)snehakaraNe; etena uttamamAtrA saMshamane eva paraM, na tu shodhanA~ggasnehe kartavyeti darshayati| ye tvityAdi hrasvamAtrAguNaH| parihAre sukheti alpaparihAratvena||29-40||

ko~asau saMshaya ityAha- kiMyonaya ityAdi| kiMyonayaH kimAdhArakAraNAH| kAlashcAnupAnaM ca kAlAnupAne| vicAraNA dravyAntarAsaMyuktasnehapAnaM varjayitvA snehopayogaH| kathammAnA kIdRu~gmAnA| kA ceti mAtrA| prakarShaH kAlaprakarShaH| snehane snehayuktikriyAyAm| ke naceti ke na ca snehyAH| kiM pAnAt snehapAnAt prathamaM pUrvaM hitAhitaM; ki~jca pIte snehe tathA jIrNe ca snehe hitAhitamiti yojyam| siddhayo vyApatsAdhanAni bheShajAni| acche iti saMshodhanapRutha~gnirdeshAdgobalIvardanyAyena saMshamana iti bhavati| vRuttiriti vRuttiH upacAravidhAnam| j~jAnaM shAstram||4-8||

yaH sneho yatra kAryastamAha- vAtapittetyAdi| vAtapittavikAragrahaNenaiva vAtapittaprakRutiShu labdheShu punastadabhidhAnaM vAtapittaprakRutInAM stokashleShmavikAre~api ghRutapAnopadeshArtham; evaM vAtavyAdhibhirAviShTA vAtaprakRutayashca ya ityatra vyAkhyeyam| balArthina ityatra balashabdaH smRutyAdibhiH sambadhyate| ArtAH pIDitAH, dAhAdibhiriti sambandhaH||41-43||

tailaviShayamAha- pravRuddhetyAdi| shItale kAla iti tailasyoShNatvena shItale~api kAla ityarthaH; tena sAmAnyapratiShedhaH ‘nAtyuShNashIte snehaM pibennaraH’ iti na virudhyate; yadi vA sarpiHpAnakAlApekShayA shItatvaM boddhavyam||44-46||
vasAviShayamAha- vAtAtapetyAdi| saMshuShkaniShpItashabdau kShINArthAveva| mahAruja ityasthyAdibhiH sambadhyate| khAni srotAMsi||47-49||

abhiShuka auttarApathikaH| citrA gorakShakarkaTI, tadbIjamiha; yadi vA citrA lohitairaNDaH| atasI ‘umA’ iti khyAtA | ArukanikocakAkShoDA auttarApathikAH| snehAshayAH snehasthAnAni| ete cAviShkRutatamatvenoktAH, tena nimbatailAdayo boddhavyAH| AmiShaM mAMsam||9-11||

asnehyAnAha- saMshodhanAdRuta ityAdi| yeShAM rUkShaNaM vakShyate la~gghanabRuMhaNIye- “abhiShyandA mahAdoShA marmasthA vyAdhayashca ye| UrustambhaprabhRutayo rUkShaNIyA nidarshitAH” (sU. a.22) ityanena, teShAM shodhanAdRute snehanaM na shastaM, yadA tu shodhanena virUkShyante tadA paraM shodhanA~gga(rtha)statra snehaH kartavya iti bhAvaH| utsanno vRuddhaH kapho medashca yeShAM te tathA; etacca visheShaNaM virUkShaNIyA evambhUtA eva bhavantIti darshayati | abhiShyaNNaH dravapradhAnashleShmavikArI| garaH kRutrimaM viSham| atipratAntaH atikShINadravadhAtuH| vartamAneShu kriyamANeShvityarthaH||53-56||
asnigdhalakShaNamAha- purIShamityAdi| mRuduriti pakturvisheShaNam| vAtAnulomyamityAdi snigdhalakShaNam| pANDutetyAdi atisnigdhalakShaNam| jADyam indriyajaDatvam||57-59||

snehAt pUrvaM yat pathyaM tadAha- dravoShNamityAdi| asa~gkIrNam aviruddhavIryam| shva ityAgAmidine| annakAle dvipraharAdilakShaNe bubhukShA kadAcinna syAdapi tadarthaM visheShaNaM- prakA~gkShita iti| shuddhyarthaM tu snehaM naishe dinAntarakRute AhAre jIrNa eva prAtareva pibedityarthaH| saMshamanArthasneho yadi jaraNAnte prAtareva kriyate tadA koShThopalepakadoShasyAkShayAttena doSheNa sambaddho doShotkleshaM kuryAnna saMshamanaM, saMshodhanArthastu doShotkleshaM karotItyapekShaNIya eveti bhAvaH| etacca kAlakathanamutsargeNa, tena “vAtapittAdhiko rAtrau” ityuktakAlavirodho na bhavati||60-61||

kShapAyAmeva svapitIti kShapAshayaH| apravAtaM ceti shayanAsanavisheShaNam| snehaM pratibhu~jjAna iti snehe jIrNe~api snehaprayogAnuguNamanyasnehamaviruddhavIryAdiguNayuktaM bhu~jjAnaH| etena snehe pIte jIrNe ki~jca hitAhitamiti prashnadvayasyottaramidam- uShNodakopacArI syAdityAdi bhavati||62-64||

mRudukoShThAdilakShaNamAha- mRudvityAdi| abhyarhitatvAt koShThaj~jAnasyAnyathA~api tallakShaNamAha- guDamityAdi| ulloDitaM dadhisaraH| kRusharA tilataNDulamAShakRutA yavAgUH; vacanaM hi- “tilataNDulamAShaistu kRusharA trisareti ca”| krUrakoShThAvirecanahetumAha- bhavatItyAdi| grahaNI koShThasthAgnyadhiShThAnabhUtA nADI; yaduktam- “agnyadhiShThAnamannasya grahaNAdgrahaNI matA” (ci.a.15) iti| udIrNapittetyAdi mRudukoShThasvarUpakathanam| krUrakoShThasya grahaNIgato vAyurguDAdInAM saratvaM pratibadhnAti, mRudukoShThasya hi grahaNyAM virodhako vAyurnAsti, stambhako~api shleShmA~alpaH, udbhUtasaratvaguNaM ca pittaM prabalaM; tena guDAdibhiH sukhaM virecanaM bhavatIti bhAvaH||65-69||

samprati snehavyApado darshayati- udIrNetyAdi| ojaH sarvadhAtusArabhUtaM hRudi sthitaM, prakShArayan sthAnAdbhraMshayan kShapayaMshca| balItyanena snehendhano vahnirnitarAM balavAn bhavatIti darshayati| vacanaM hi- “nAlaM snehasamRuddhasya shamAyAnnaM sugurvapi” iti| uttamAM mahatIM mAtrAm| sopasargAM sopadravAm| kakShaH kAShThasamUhaH| chardayediti prathamaM snehameva tRuShNAkArakaM chardayitvA punaH shItodakaM pItvA rUkShAnnaM ca bhuktvA ullikhediti yojanIyam| na sarpirityAdi|- na sarpiH sAme pitte peyaM, kevalaM tvasaMskRutaM visheShato na peyaM sAmapitta eveti yojanA; evaM manyate- saMskRutaM tiktakAdibhiryutaM sAme pitte tiktakAdipAcanaguNAnuyogAdyogyaM kadAcidbhavatyapi , asaMskRutaM tu sarvathA viruddhameva; yadivA, kevalamasaMskRutaM sarpiH pitte sAmAnyena sAme nirAme vA na peyaM, sAme pitte visheShata iti yojanA| etena, yatrApi sAmAnyena ghRutaM vihitaM, yathA- “ata UrdhvaM kaphe mande vAtapittottare jvare| paripakveShu doSheShu sarpiHpAnaM yathA~amRutam” (ci.a.3) ityAdau, tatrApyucitabheShajasaMskRutameva boddhavyam| yadivA, na kevalaM pitte sAme sarpirvisheShato na peyaM, kintarhi tailAdInyapi vAtashleShmavihitAni tayoH sAmayorna peyAnItyarthaH| asmin vyAkhyAne~apeyamityakAraprashleSho draShTavyaH| anurajet pittavarNaM kuryAt| sa~jj~jA smRutiH, taddhananaM ceha vyAdhiprabhAvAt| staimityam ArdravastrAguNThitatvamiva| AmapradoShA alasakavisUcikAdayaH| kAlapratIkShaNaM snehajanitadoShakShayaM yAvadabhojanam| takrasyAriShTAnAM ca cikitsAvakShyamANAnAM prayogaH| mUtrANAM triphalAyAshca sevanamiti sambandhaH||70-78||

vicAraNAviShayamAha- snehadviSha ityAdinA| lAvAdirasAnAmuktAnAM saMskAramAha- yavetyAdi| rase snehArthoktarasa ucitaH saMyogo yeShAM te rasasaMyogAH, teShAM sa~ggrahaNaM sa~ggrahaH| pUrvamiti bhojanAt pUrvam| tilapradhAnaH kAmbalikastilakAmbalikaH| phANitamityAdau shRu~ggaveramiti shRu~ggaverarasam| bhRutaiH bhaTitrIkRutaiH| pA~jcaprasRutikI agre vakShyamANA| mAShamishrako mAShataNDulakRutamannam| peyA pAtavyA||82-90||

yathArhamiti yo yatra sneho yujyate sarpirAdiH| siddhairiti pippalIbhistathA harItakyA tathA triphalayA ceti pRuthagyojanIyaM; pippalyAdisiddhasnehashca kuShThAdiShu yathAsa~gkhyamiti kecit| yUShashabdaH kvAthavacanaH| vyoShagarbhaM vyoShakalkam| atra tribhirdravyairmilitvA cAturguNyam| yavakolAdau ShaDdravyANi snehasamAni| kShAro yavakShAraH kalkaH||91-94||

samprati sneha upayukto yathA sharIraM sasnehyAdhiko dRushyate, tadAha- gRuhNAtItyAdi| tacca shiShyeNAdhyAyAdAvapRuShTamapi shiShyahitatayA~abhidhIyate| yathAgnIti agnyanadhika ityarthaH| nanvagnyadhikashcet sravati, tadavadhi ca snehalakShaNamuktaM, yaducyate- “adhastAt snehadarshanam” iti, tenaikadina evAdhikasnehapAnaM kriyatAmityAha- yathA cetyAdi| Akledya IShatkledayitvA| tvaritasevitaH sneho dhAtUnasnehayitvaiva sraMsate~adho yAti yAvAn, na tAvatA snehanaM bhavatIti bhAvaH||96-97||
athAtaH svedAdhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
pittaprakopo mUrcchA ca sharIrasadanaM tRuShA| dAhaH svarA~ggadaurbalyamatisvinnasya lakShaNam||14||
uktastasyAshitIye yo graiShmikaH sarvasho vidhiH| so~atisvinnasya kartavyo madhuraH snigdhashItalaH||15||
kaShAyamadyanityAnAM garbhiNyA raktapittinAm| pittinAM sAtisArANAM rUkShANAM madhumehinAm||16||
vidagdhabhraShTabradhnAnAM viShamadyavikAriNAm| shrAntAnAM naShTasa~jj~jAnAM sthUlAnAM pittamehinAm||17||
tRuShyatAM kShudhitAnAM ca kruddhAnAM shocatAmapi| kAmalyudariNAM caiva kShatAnAmADhyarogiNAm||18||
durbalAtivishuShkANAmupakShINaujasAM tathA| bhiShak taimirikANAM ca na svedamavatArayet||19||
pratishyAye ca kAse ca hikkAshvAseShvalAghave| karNamanyAshiraHshUle svarabhede galagrahe||20||
arditaikA~ggasarvA~ggapakShAghAte vinAmake| koShThAnAhavibandheShu mUtrAghAte vijRumbhake||21||
pArshvapRuShThakaTIkukShisa~ggrahe gRudhrasIShu ca| mUtrakRucchre mahattve ca muShkayora~ggamardake||22||
pAdajAnUruja~gghArtisa~ggrahe shvayathAvapi| khallIShvAmeShu shIte ca vepathau vAtakaNTake||23||
sa~gkocAyAmashUleShu stambhagauravasuptiShu | sarvA~ggeShu vikAreShu svedanaM hitamucyate||24||
tilamAShakulatthAmlaghRutatailAmiShaudanaiH| pAyasaiH kRusharairmAMsaiH piNDasvedaM prayojayet||25||
gokharoShTravarAhAshvashakRudbhiH satuShairyavaiH| sikatApAMshupAShANakarIShAyasapUTakaiH||26||
shlaiShmikAn svedayet pUrvairvAtikAn samupAcaret| dravyANyetAni shasyante yathAsvaM prastareShvapi||27||

bhUgRuheShu ca jentAkeShUShNagarbhagRuheShu ca| vidhUmA~ggAratapteShu svabhyaktaH svidyate sukham||28||

Commentary: bhUgRuheShviti bhUsvedArtheShu gRuheShu| uShNagarbhagRuheShviti kuTIsvedaM darshayati| svabhyakta iti samyagabhyaktaH||28||
grAmyAnUpaudakaM mAMsaM payo bastashirastathA| varAhamadhyapittAsRuk snehavattilataNDulAH||29||
ityetAni samutkvAthya nADIsvedaM prayojayet| deshakAlavibhAgaj~jo yuktyapekSho bhiShaktamaH||30||
vAruNAmRutakairaNDashigrumUlakasarShapaiH| vAsAvaMshakara~jjArkapatrairashmantakasya ca||31||
shobhA~jjanakasaireyamAlatIsurasArjakaiH | patrairutkvAthya salilaM nADIsvedaM prayojayet||32||
bhUtIkapa~jcamUlAbhyAM surayA dadhimastunA| mUtrairamlaishca sasnehairnADIsvedaM prayojayet||33||

eta eva ca niryUhAH prayojyA jalakoShThake| svedanArthaM ghRutakShIratailakoShThAMshca kArayet||34||

Commentary: eta eveti nADIsvedoktAstrayo~api| jalakoShThaH avagAhArthaM kRutaM mahajjalapAtram; evaM ghRutakShIratailakoShThAshca vyAkhyAtAH||34||
godhUmashakalaishcUrNairyavAnAmamlasaMyutaiH| sasnehakiNvalavaNairupanAhaH prashasyate||35||
gandhaiH surAyAH kiNvena jIvantyA shatapuShpayA| umayA kuShThatailAbhyAM yuktayA copanAhayet||36||
carmabhishcopanaddhavyaH salomabhirapUtibhiH| uShNavIryairalAbhe tu kausheyAvikashATakaiH||37||

rAtrau baddhaM divA mu~jcenmu~jcedrAtrau divA kRutam| vidAhaparihArArthaM, syAt prakarShastu shItale||38||

Commentary: upanAhasvede bandhamokShAvadhiM darshayati- rAtrau baddhamityAdi| divAkRutamityatra ‘bandhaM’ iti sheShaH| vidAhaH raktAdividAhaH| shItale ityatra “kAle” iti sheShaH| prakarSha uktAdbandhanakAlAdadhikakAlatvaM bandhanasya||38||
ataH svedAH pravakShyante yairyathAvatprayojitaiH| svedasAdhyAH prashAmyanti gadA vAtakaphAtmakAH||3||
snehapUrvaM prayuktena svedenAvajite~anile| purIShamUtraretAMsi na sajjanti katha~jcana||4||
shuShkANyapi hi kAShThAni snehasvedopapAdanaiH| namayanti yathAnyAyaM kiM punarjIvato narAn||5||
sa~gkaraH prastaro nADI pariSheko~avagAhanam| jentAko~ashmaghanaH karShUH kuTI bhUH kumbhikaiva ca||39||
kUpo holAka ityete svedayanti trayodasha| tAn yathAvat pravakShyAmi sarvAnevAnupUrvashaH||40||

tatra vastrAntaritairavastrAntaritairvA piNDairyathoktairupasvedanaM sa~gkarasveda iti vidyAt||41||

Commentary: piNDairyathoktairiti tilamAShAdipiNDaistathA gokharAdigranthoktapuTakarUpaishca piNDaiH; svedanamevopasvedanam||41||

shUkashamIdhAnyapulAkAnAM veshavArapAyasakRusharotkArikAdInAM vA prastare kausheyAvikottarapracchadepa~jcA~ggulorubUkArkapatrapracchade vA svabhyaktasarvagAtrasya shayAnasyopasvedanaM prastarasveda iti vidyAt||42||

Commentary: pulAkaH tucchadhAnyam| utkArikA mAShAdikRutotkArAkRutivya~jjanavisheShaH | prastIryata iti prastaraH shayanapramANena svedavastUnAM vistaraNaM, tasmin prastare| kausheyAvikottarapracchade kausheyAvikapihita ityarthaH| pa~jcA~ggula eraNDabhedaH||42||

svedanadravyANAM punarmUlaphalapatrashu~ggAdInAM mRugashakunapishitashiraspadAdInAmuShNasvabhAvAnAM vA yathArhamamlalavaNasnehopasaMhitAnAM mUtrakShIrAdInAM vA kumbhyAM bAShpamanudvamantyAmutkvathitAnAM nADyA shareShIkAvaMshadalakara~jjArkapatrAnyatamakRutayA gajAgrahastasaMsthAnayA vyAmadIrghayA vyAmArdhadIrghayA vA vyAmacaturbhAgAShTabhAgamUlAgrapariNAhasrotasA sarvato vAtaharapatrasaMvRutacchidrayA dvistrirvA vinAmitayA vAtaharasiddhasnehAbhyaktagAtro bAShpamupaharet; bAShpo hyanRujugAmI vihatacaNDavegastvacamavidahan sukhaM svedayatIti nADIsvedaH||43||

Commentary: svedanetyAdinA nADIsvedamAha| svedanadravyANi svedopagagaNoktAni iha ca nADIsvedakvAthArthamuktAni| shiraHpadaM mastakam| bAShpamanudvamantyAmityanena kvathanakAle bAShpo yathA na niryAti tathA kartavyamiti darshayati| utkvathitAnAM bAShpaM snehAktagAtraH san nADyA upaharediti sambandhaH| nADIkaraNavidhimAha- shareShIketyAdi| vaMshadalo vaMshavidalaH | gajAgrahastasaMsthAnatvaM nADyA agra eva boddhavyam| vyAmaH tiryagvistRutabAhudvayapramANaM; vyAmadIrghatvaM nADyA bahalasvede kartavyam| vyAmacaturthabhAgena vyAmAShTabhAgena ca mUle agre ca yathAsa~gkhyaM mAnaM nADyA veditavyaM; pariNAhena veShTanena sroto randhraM yasyAH sA tathA| yathoktanADIkaraNe guNamAha- bAShpo hItyAdi| vihatacaNDavegatvaM nADIkAyA dIrghatvena vakratvena ca boddhavyam||43||

vAtikottaravAtikAnAM punarmUlAdInAmutkvAthaiH sukhoShNaiH kumbhIrvarShaNikAH pranADIrvA pUrayitvA yathArhasiddhasnehAbhyaktagAtraM vastrAvacchannaM pariShecayediti pariShekaH||44||

Commentary: pariShekavidhimAha- vAtiketyAdi| vAtikAni vAtaharANi, uttaravAtikAni uttaravAte pradhAnavAte vAtashleShmaNi hitAnIha grAhyANi| varShaNikA alpaghaTI, ‘sahasradhArA’ ityanye; praNADI veNunalanADyAdyAH||44||

vAtaharotkvAthakShIratailaghRutapishitarasoShNasalilakoShThakAvagAhastu yathokta evAvagAhaH||45||

Commentary: yathokta eveti lokaprasiddha eva| avagAhaH avagAhasvedaH||45||

atha jentAkaM cikIrShurbhUmiM parIkSheta- tatra pUrvasyAM dishyuttarasyAM vA guNavati prashaste bhUmibhAge kRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNamRuttike vA parIvApapuShkariNyAdInAM jalAshayAnAmanyatamasya kUle dakShiNe pashcime vA sUpatIrthe samasuvibhaktabhUmibhAge saptAShTau vA~aratnIrupakramyodakAt prA~gmukhamuda~gmukhaM vA~abhimukhatIrthaM kUTAgAraM kArayet, utsedhavistArataH paramaratnIH ShoDasha, samantAt suvRuttaM mRutkarmasampannamanekavAtAyanam; asya kUTAgArasyAntaH samantato bhittimaratnivistArotsedhAM piNDikAM kArayedAkapATAt, madhye cAsya kUTAgArasya catuShkiShkumAtraM puruShapramANaM mRunmayaM kandusaMsthAnaM bahusUkShmacchidrama~ggArakoShThakastambhaM sapidhAnaM kArayet; taM ca khAdirANAmAshvakarNAdInAM vA kAShThAnAM pUrayitvA pradIpayet; sa yadA jAnIyAt sAdhu dagdhAni kAShThAni gatadhUmAnyavataptaM ca kevalamagninA tadagnigRuhaM svedayogyena coShmaNA yuktamiti, tatrainaM puruShaM vAtaharAbhyaktagAtraM vastrAvacchannaM praveshayet, praveshayaMshcainamanushiShyAt- saumya! pravisha kalyANAyArogyAya ceti, pravishya cainAM piNDikAmadhiruhya pArshvAparapArshvAbhyAM yathAsukhaM shayIthAH, na ca tvayA svedamUrcchAparItenApi satA piNDikaiShA vimoktavyA~a~aprANocchvAsAt, bhrashyamAno hyataH piNDivakAvakAshAddvAramanadhigacchan svedamUrcchAparItatayA sadyaH prANA~jjahyAH, tasmAt piNDikAmenAM na katha~jcana mu~jcethAH; tvaM yadA jAnIyAH- vigatAbhiShyandamAtmAnaM samyakprasrutasvedapicchaM sarvasrotovimuktaM laghUbhUtamapagatavibandhastambhasuptivedanAgauravamiti, tatastAM piNDikAmanusaran dvAraM prapadyethAH, niShkramya ca na sahasA cakShuShoH paripAlanArthaM shItodakamupaspRushethAH, apagatasantApaklamastu muhUrtAt sukhoShNena vAriNA yathAnyAyaM pariShikto~ashnIyAH; iti jentAkasvedaH||46||

Commentary: jentAkavidhimAha- athetyAdi| athashabdo ma~ggale Anantarye vA| pUrvasyAmuttarasyAM veti grAmAdbAddhavyam| guNavatIti sasyaprarohAdiyuktatvena; prashastabhUmibhAgatvaM tuShA~ggArAdirahitatvena| parIvApaH dIrghikA| suShThu upa samIpe tIrthaM yasya tasmin sUpatIrthe| aratniH hastaH| prA~gmukhamiti pashcime, uda~gmukhamiti dakShiNe; evaM hyabhimukhaM tIrthaM bhavati| kUTAgAramiti vartulAgAram| AkapATAdityanena dvAraparyantaM lakShayati| kiShkuH hastaH| puruShapramANamiti UrdhvataH| kanduH kandvAkArAgnisthAnam| a~ggArArthaM koShTho~avakAsho vidyate yasmin so~a~ggArakoShThakaH, sa eva stambha itya~ggArakoShThakastambhaH| khAdirANAmiti pUraNe ShaShThI| sa ityatra ‘tvaM’ ityadhyAhAryaM, jAnIyA ityarthaH; kiMvA, ‘jAnIyAt’ iti pAThaH, uttaratrApi ‘praveshayet’ iti pAThaH; evaM ca sugamam| picchA svedasyaiva picchilo bhAgaH| sarveShu srotaHsu vimuktaM sarvasrotovimuktam apagatavibandhastu apagatamalavibandho boddhavyaH| cakShuShoH paripAlanArthamiti atropataptasya sahasA shItajalapraveshe shItajalaparAhata UShmA nayanopaghAtaM karotItyabhiprAyaH| atra ca jentAke bhUmivisheShaparigrahajalasAnnidhyAdayo ma~ggalArthAH; jalasAnnidhyaM tu svidyamAnasya darshanena dRuShTeH paripAlanArthaM ca, tathA svedAtiyogapratikriyArthaM kUTAgArasya jalasAnnidhye sukhena karaNArthaM ca||46||
shayAnasya pramANena ghanAmashmamayIM shilAm| tApayitvA mArutaghnairdArubhiH sampradIpitaiH||47||
vyapojjhya sarvAna~ggArAn prokShya caivoShNavAriNA| tAM shilAmatha kurvIta kauSheyAvikasaMstarAm||48||
tasyAM svabhyaktasarvA~ggaH svapan svidyati nA sukham| kauravAjinakauSheyaprAvArAdyaiH susaMvRutaH ||49||
...karShUsvedaH pravakShyate| khAnayecchayanasyAdhaH karShUM sthAnavibhAgavit||50||
dIptairadhUmaira~ggAraistAM karShUM pUrayettataH| tasyAmupari shayyAyAM svapan svidyati nA sukham||51||
anatyutsedhavistArAM vRuttAkArAmalocanAm| ghanabhittiM kuTIM kRutvA kuShThAdyaiH sampralepayet||52||
kuTImadhye bhiShak shayyAM svAstIrNAmupakalpayet| prAvArAjinakausheyakuthakambalagolakaiH||53||
hasantikAbhira~ggArapUrNAbhistAM ca sarvashaH| parivAryAntarArohedabhyaktaH svidyate sukham||54||
ya evAshmaghanasvedavidhirbhUmau sa eva tu| prashastAyAM nivAtAyAM samAyAmupadishyate||55||

rogartuvyAdhitApekSho nAtyuShNo~atimRudurna ca| dravyavAn kalpito deshe svedaH kAryakaro mataH||6||

Commentary: rogamRutuM vyAdhitaM ca balavattvAdinA~apekShata iti rogartuvyAdhitApekShaH| nAtyuShNo nAticaNDatApaH| dravyavAniti snigdharUkShAdidravyavAn| kalpita iti rogAdInapekShya yathocitena dravyeNa deshe cAmAshayAdau yathAyogyatayA sampAdita iti mantavyam||6||
kumbhIM vAtaharakvAthapUrNAM bhUmau nikhAnayet| ardhabhAgaM tribhAgaM vA shayanaM tatra copari||56||
sthApayedAsanaM vA~api nAtisAndraparicchadam| atha kumbhyAM susantaptAn prakShipedayaso guDAn||57||
pAShANAn voShmaNA tena tatsthaH svidyati nA sukham| susaMvRutA~ggaH svabhyaktaH snehairanilanAshanaiH||58||
kUpaM shayanavistAraM dviguNaM cApi vedhataH| deshe nivAte shaste ca kuryAdantaHsumArjitam||59||
hastyashvagokharoShTrANAM karIShairdagdhapUrite| svavacchannaH susaMstIrNe~abhyaktaH svidyati nA sukham||60||
dhItIkAM tu karIShANAM yathoktAnAM pradIpayet| shayanAntaHpramANena shayyAmupari tatra ca||61||
sudagdhAyAM vidhUmAyAM yathoktAmupakalpayet| svavacchannaH svapaMstatrAbhyaktaH svidyati nA sukham||62||
holAkasveda ityeSha sukhaH prokto maharShiNA| iti trayodashavidhaH svedo~agniguNasaMshrayaH||63||

vyAyAma uShNasadanaM guruprAvaraNaM kShudhA| bahupAnaM bhayakrodhAvupanAhAhavAtapAH||64||

Commentary: sampratyanagnisvedAnAha- vyAyAma ityAdi| uShNasadanamiti agnisantApavyatirekeNa nirjAlakatayA ghanabhittitayA ca yadgRuhaM svedayati tadboddhavyam| bahupAnamiti bahumadyapAnam| upanAho dvividhaH- sAgniranagnishca; tatra yaH sAgnirupanAhaH sa sa~gkara eva boddhavyaH, yaduktaM- “kolaM kulatthAH suradArurAsnAH” (sU.a.3) ityAdinA~a~aragvadhIye; yastvanagnirbahalatvena sharIroShmarodhaM kRutvA svedayati sa iha boddhavyaH| Atapashca yadyapyuShNaH, tathA~apyagnikRutaM tasyoShNatvaM na bhavatItyanagnisveda uktaH| agniguNAdRute iti sAkShAdagnisambandhena kRutAduShNatvAdvinA||64||-
ityukto dvividhaH svedaH saMyukto~agniguNairna ca||65||
ekA~ggasarvA~ggagataH snigdho rUkShastathaiva ca| ityetattrividhaM dvandvaM svedamuddishya kIrtitam||66||

snigdhaH svedairupakramyaH svinnaH pathyAshano bhavet| tadahaH svinnagAtrastu vyAyAmaM varjayennaraH||67||

Commentary: svinnena yathA kartavyaM tadAha- snigdha ityAdi| pathyAshano bhavedityatra yadyapi shRu~ggagrAhikayA pathyaM noktaM, tathA~api svedapravRuttiviShayadoShasya yat pathyaM tadeva boddhavyam||67||
tatra shlokAH- svedo yathA kAryakaro hito yebhyashca yadvidhaH| yatra deshe yathA yogyo desho rakShyashca yo yathA||68||
svinnAtisvinnarUpANi tathA~atisvinnabheShajam| asvedyAH svedayogyAshca svedadravyANi kalpanA||69||
trayodashavidhaH svedo vinA dashavidho~agninA| sa~ggraheNa ca ShaT svedAH svedAdhyAye nidarshitAH||70||
svedAdhikAre yadvAcyamuktametanmaharShiNA | shiShyaistu pratipattavyamupadeShTA punarvasuH||71||
vyAdhau shIte sharIre ca mahAn svedo mahAbale| durbale durbalaH svedo madhyame madhyamo hitaH||7||
vAtashleShmaNi vAte vA kaphe vA sveda iShyate| snigdharUkShastathA snigdho rUkShashcApyupakalpitaH||8||

AmAshayagate vAte kaphe pakvAshayAshrite| rUkShapUrvo hitaH svedaH snehapUrvastathaiva ca||9||

Commentary: taM deshavisheShasambandhena vyabhicArayan deshApekShAM kalpanAmAha- AmAshayetyAdi| AmAshayagate vAte rUkShapUrvaH sthAnApekShayA pUrvaM rUkShaM kRutvA pashcAdvAtApekShaH snigdhaH kAryaH, evaM pakvAshayagate kaphe snehapUrvo vyAkhyeyaH; AmAshayashabdena kaphasthAnaM j~jeyaM, kaphasthAnApekShayA hi prathamaM rUkShaH kriyate, yaduktaM- “sthAnaM jayeddhi pUrvaM tu sthAnasthasyAviruddhataH” iti||9||

vRuShaNau hRudayaM dRuShTI svedayenmRudu naiva vA| madhyamaM va~gkShaNau sheShama~ggAvayavamiShTataH||10||

Commentary: mRudu naiva veti svedaikasAdhye vRuShaNAdigate vyAdhau mRudusvedaH, svedavyatiriktopAyAntarasambhave tu na veti boddhavyam| iShTata ityAturecchAto vaidyecchAtashca| iShTata iti bhAvAdicchAvacanaH||10||

sushuddhairnaktakaiH piNDyA godhUmAnAmathApi vA| padmotpalapalAshairvA svedyaH saMvRutya cakShuShI||11||

Commentary: svede kriyamANe cakShuShaH svedaparihAropAyamAha- sushuddhairityAdi| naktakaH karpaTAvayavaH ||11||

muktAvalIbhiH shItAbhiH shItalairbhAjanairapi| jalArdrairjalajairhastaiH svidyato hRudayaM spRushet||12||

Commentary: svede kriyamANe hRudayarakShaNArthamAha- muktAvalIbhirityAdi| jalajAni pa~gkajAdIni| evamasvedyatvasAmAnyatvAdvRuShaNarakShA~apyunnetavyA, prAdhAnyAddhRudayacakShuHpAlanamuktam||12||

shItashUlavyuparame stambhagauravanigrahe| sa~jjAte mArdave svede svedanAdviratirmatA||13||

Commentary: shItashUletyAdi| sveda iti svedabhave gharme| svedanAdviratirmatetyupadishan shItAdivyuparame sati svedo nivartanIyaH, shItAdyanuparame ca svedaH kartavya iti dvayamupadishati; tatashca ita eva svedanivRuttiviShayashItAdivyuparamotpAdaH svedasya samyagyogalakShaNaM tathA shItAdivyuparamAnutpAdashca svedAnivRuttiviShayo~ayogalakShaNamuktaM bhavatIti nAyogalakShaNAnabhidhAnamudbhAvanIyam||13||

atisvinnacikitsitamAha- ukta ityAdi| graiShmiko vidhirityanena labdhe punarmadhuraH snigdhashItala ityAdivacanaM “madyamalpaM na vA peyaM” (sU.a.6) ityatropadiShTamadyapAnasya pratiShedhArthaM, madhurashItAdiyogavisheShavidhAnArthaM ca||14-15||

asvedyAnAha- kaShAyetyAdi| kaShAyadravyakRutaM madyaM kaShAyamadyaM; kiMvA kaShAyashabdo~amadhuravacanaH, na tena yaducyate- kaShAyanityasya vAtapradhAnatA syAt kaShAyasya vAtakAritvAt, vAte ca svedo vihita eva, tat kathaM kaShAyanityaM prati svedaniShedha iti, tannirastaM bhavati| kiMvA, kaShAyanityA rUkShAtistabdhagAtrA bhavanti, kaShAyasya virUkShakastambhakatvena; tatashca teShAM svedaH parvabhedamAvahatItyataH kaShAyanityaniShedhaH| raktapittinAmavidhAnAdeva svede niShiddhe, punaH svedaniShedho raktapittinAM yadyanyo~api svedasAdhyo vAtashleShmajo vikAro bhavati tatrApi svedaniShedhArthaM, tathA raktapittinAM vamanavirecanA~ggatayA prAptasvedapratiprasavaniShedhArthaM ca; evaM pittamehikAmalyAdiShvapi vyAkhyeyam| pittinAmiti pittaprakRutInAm| madhumehashabdena sarva evaM mehA gRuhyante, madhumehashabdo hi sarveShveva meheShu vartata iti kiyantaHshirasIye darshanIyaM, meheShu ca sarveShveva sharIrashaithilyapravRutteShu visheShataH sharIrashaithilyahetutvena svedo na yujyate; pittamehinAmiti tu punarabhidhAnaM pittasambandhena visheShapratiShedhatAdarshanArtham| bradhnaH gudaH| madyavikAriNAmiti madyanityasya vAtakaphajamadAtyaye svedaniShedhArtham| ADhyarogIha vAtaraktI| eShu cAsvedaviShayeShu yadi svedaikasAdhyaH sannyAsAdirbhavati tadA mahApratyavAyabhayAdalpapratyavAyamupekShyApi svedo vidheya iti nyAyasiddhameva; yadAhurnyAyavidaH- “bhUyovirodhe svalpamanyAyyam” iti||16-19||

pratishyAye cetyAdinA svedyAn darshayati| vinAmakaH sharIravinamanakArI vAtaH| vijRumbhako bahirAyAmaH, jRumbhAbahutvaM vA| pAdajAnUruja~gghAbhirartiH sa~ggrahashca pRuthak sambadhyate| khallI hastapadAvamoTanam| vAtakaNTako gulphAshrito vAtaH| alAghava iti pUrvamukte~api punargauravavacanama~ggAnAM gurutaratvapratipAdanArtham, alAghavavacanaM tu lAghavapratiShedhamAtraprayojanaM nAtigurutvaM brUte, yataH sarvatra na~j viruddhe na vartate, yathA “arUkShamanabhiShyandi tvAsInapracalAyitam” (sU.a.21) ityatra na hyarUkShashabdena snigdhatvamabhipretaM, kiM tarhi rUkShatApratiShedhamAtrameva||20-24||

vakShyamANAnAM sa~gkarAdisvedAnAM dravyANyAha- tilamAShetyAdi| piNDarUpaH svedaH piNDasvedaH| karIShaH shuShkagomayaH; AyasaH ayovikAraH, sa ceha puTakaraNayogyo boddhavyaH| pUrvairiti tilamAShAdibhiH| yathAsvamityanena tilamAShAdayo vAte, gokharAdigranthoktAshca shleShmaNi, prastarasvede kartavyA iti darshayati||25-27||

bastashiraH chAgamastakam| snehavantashcairaNDabIjAdayaH tilAshca taNDulAshca snehavattilataNDulAH| grAmyetyAdinA vAtApaho nADIsveda uktaH, vAruNetyAdinA kaphApahaH, bhUtIketyAdinA vAtashleShmApahaH| vAruNo varuNaH amRutakA guDUcI, sarShapairityatra patrairiti sambadhyate| vaMsho veNuH| punaH shobhA~jjanagrahaNAddvitIyo viTapashobhA~jjano gRuhyate, saireyaH jhiNTI||29-33||

godhUmashakalaiH godhUmacUrNaiH| kiNvaH surAbIjam| upanAhaH bahalaM lepaM dattvA carmAdibhirAvRutya vyAdhiyuktasyA~ggasya bandhanam; carmabhishcopanaddhavya ityatra upanAho~anagnisvedo grAhyaH| gandhaiH sugandhidravyairupanAho bandhanIyaH| uShNavIryairiti uShNavIryamRugAdiprANiprabhavaiH | AvikashATakaH kambalaH||35-37||

vAtakaphAtmakA asaMsRuShTavAtakaphajAH, vAtakaphajatve~apyudarAdayaH svedena na shAmyanti, ata Aha- svedasAdhyAH; etenodarAdayo~asvedyA vyAvartyante| snehapUrvamiti kriyAvisheShaNam| na sajjanti apravRuttAni na bhavanti| yathAnyAyaM yathAgamam, etacca snehasvedopapAdanairityanena sambadhyate; yadi vA yathAnyAyaM yathAsahajaM namayantIti sambandhaH||3-5||

samprati sAgnisvedAnAM sa~gkarAdInAM lakShaNamabhidhAtuM sa~gkarAdIn svedAn nAmatastAvaduddishati- sa~gkara ityAdi| sa~gkarAdishabdAshcAyurvedaparamparAsiddhAH; tatra kvacinnADIsvedAdau nADyA praNIyata ityanvayo~apyanusaraNIyaH, jentAkAdayashcAnvayanirapekShA eva||39-40||
kauravaM kArpAsam||47-49||-
karShUH abhyantaravistIrNaH svalpamukho gartaH||50-51||

anatyutsedhavistArAmiti svalpapramANocchrAyavistArAm| alocanAM nirjAlakAm| kuShThAdyairiti atrAdishabdaH prakAravacanaH, tenoShNasugandhidravyairiti bhavati| hasantikA a~ggAradhAni(ri)kA, parivAryeti hasantikAbhirityanena sambadhyate| tAmiti upakalpitashayyAM kuTIm, Arohediti sambandhaH||52-55||
shayanaM tatra coparIti atra kumbhIkopari shayanaM khaTTAdi tathA kartavyaM yathA kumbhIkA na bhajyate| tatstha iti yathoktashayanAsanasthaH||56-58||

kUpamiti kUpamiva kUpaM gabhIratvena| dviguNamiti vistArAdboddhavyam| vedhata ityadhaHkhananapramANena| susaMstIrNa iti suShThu saMstIrNe AcchAdite, shayyayA khaTvoparisthitayA AcchAdite kUpe iti boddhavyam||59-60||

dhItIkAmityAdinA holAkasvedaH| dhItIkA shuShkagomayAdikRuto~agnyAshrayavisheShaH| yathoktAnAmiti pUrvoktahastyashvAdibhavAnAm| shayanAntaHpramANena dhItIkAM ‘kRutvA’ ityadhyAhArya yojyam| yathoktAmiti nAtisAndraparicchadAm| upasaMharati- itItyAdi| sAkShAdagnerguNamuShNatvamAshritya svedayatItyagniguNasaMshrayaH||61-63||

sarvasvedamupasaMharati- ityukta ityAdi| ekA~ggagatAH sa~gkaranADyAdayaH, sarvA~ggagatAH prastarajentAkAdayaH| snigdho vAtavihitaH svedaH| rUkShaH kaphavihitaH| snigdharUkShastu vAtashleShmavihito~anayorna bhidyata iti pRutha~ggoktaH| dvandvaM parasparaM viruddhaM yugmam||65-66||

sa~ggrahe svedo yathA kAryakara iti snehapUrvaM prayuktenetyAdi| yebhyashca yadvidha iti vAte snigdha ityAdi sa~ggRuhNAti| yatra deshe yathA yogya iti AmAshayagate vAte rUkShapUrva ityAdi| sheShaM sugamam||68-71||

rogAdyapekShayoktakalpanAM darshayati- vyAdhAvityAdi| vyAdhau mahAbale tathA shIte kAlakRute mahAbale| mahAniti caNDatApa eva punaH punaH kriyamANatvena mRudusvedApekShayA~adhikatApatvena j~jeyaH| durbala iti tathA madhyama iti ca vyAdhyAdiShu pUrvavadyojanIyam| snigdharUkShadravyakRutaH snigdharUkShaH, snigdharUkShadravyAdayo vAtashleShmAdiShu yathAsa~gkhyaM mantavyAH; etacca snigdharUkShAdikathanaM dravyApekShakalpanodAharaNaM; vAte snigdhaH, kaphe rUkShaH||7-8||
athAta upakalpanIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tatrAmUnyayogayogAtiyogavisheShaj~jAnAni bhavanti; tadyathA- apravRuttiH kutashcit kevalasya vA~apyauShadhasya vibhraMsho vibandho vegAnAmayogalakShaNAni bhavanti; kAle pravRuttiranatimahatI vyathA yathAkramaM doShaharaNaM svayaM cAvasthAnamiti yogalakShaNAni bhavanti, yogena tu doShapramANavisheSheNa tIkShNamRudumadhyavibhAgo j~jeyaH; yogAdhikyena tu phenilaraktacandrikopagamanamityatiyogalakShaNAni bhavanti| tatrAtiyogAyoganimittAnimAnupadravAn vidyAt- AdhmAnaM parikartikA parisrAvo hRudayopasaraNama~ggagraho jIvAdAnaM vibhraMshaH stambhaH klamashcetyupadravAH||13||

Commentary: apravRuttiH kutashciditi sarvasyaivApravRuttiH; tathA kevalasya kRutsnasya shodhanIyadoShasyApravRuttiH; tathauShadhasya vibhraMshaH prAtilomyena gamanaM; yathA- vamanasyAdha UrdhvaM ca virecanasya, etadeva siddhAvuktaM- “ayogaH prAtilomyena nacA~alpaM vA pravartanam” (si. a.6) iti| kiMvA, kutashciddhA~apravRuttiH stokadoShapravRuttirityarthaH, tathA kevalasya cApyauShadhasya pravRuttiriti yojanA| yathAkramamiti vamane prathamaM shleShmA, tadanu pittaM, tadanu vAyuH; yaduktaM- “kramAt kaphaH pittamathAnilashca yasyaiti samyagvamitaH sa iShTaH” (si. a.1) iti| samyagyogo~api hartavyadoShasyAlpatvamadhyatvotkRuShTatvena trividho bhavatIti darshayannAha- yogena tvityAdi| tushabdo~avadhAraNe, tena yogenaiva yaH pramANavisheSho~alpAdistena, na tvayogAtiyogAbhyAmityarthaH; ayaM ca tIkShNAdiyogavibhAgaH peyAkramotkarShArthaH, tathAhi vakShyati siddhau- “peyAM vilepIM” (si. a.1.) ityAdi| tatrAtiyogetyAdau AdhmAnAdayaH shodhanasiddhau “bahudoShasya rUkShasya” (si. a.6) ityAdinA granthena prapa~jcena vaktavyAH, atastatraiShAM yogAtiyogajanyo yashcAyogajanyaH sa sphuTo j~jeyaH||13||

yogena tu khalvenaM charditavantamabhisamIkShya suprakShAlitapANipAdAsyaM muhUrtamAshvAsya, snaihikavairecanikopashamanIyAnAM dhUmAnAmanyatamaM sAmarthyataH pAyayitvA, punarevodakamupasparshayet||14||

upaspRuShTodakaM cainaM nivAtamAgAramanupraveshya saMveshya cAnushiShyAt- uccairbhAShyamatyAshanamatisthAnamatica~gkramaNaM krodhashokahimAtapAvashyAyAtipravAtAn yAnayAnaM grAmyadharmamasvapanaM nishi divA svapnaM viruddhAjIrNAsAtmyAkAlapramitAtihInaguruviShamabhojanavegasandhAraNodIraNamiti bhAvAnetAnmanasA~apyasevamAnaH sarvamaho gamayasveti | sa tathA kuryAt||15||

athainaM sAyAhne pare vA~ahni sukhodakapariShiktaM purANAnAM lohitashAlitaNDulAnAM svavaklinnAM maNDapUrvAM sukhoShNAM yavAgUM pAyayedagnibalamabhisamIkShya, evaM dvitIye tRutIye cAnnakAle, caturthe tvannakAle tathAvidhAnAmeva shAlitaNDulAnAmutsvinnAM vilepImuShNodakadvitIyAmasnehalavaNAmalpasnehalavaNAM vA bhojayet, evaM pa~jcame ShaShThe cAnnakAle, saptame tvannakAle tathAvidhAnAmeva shAlInAM dviprasRutaM susvinnamodanamuShNodakAnupAnaM tanunA tanusnehalavaNopapannena mudgayUSheNa bhojayet, evamaShTame navame cAnnakAle, dashame tvannakale lAvakapi~jjalAdInAmanyatamasya mAMsarasenaudakalAvaNikena nAtisAravatA bhojayeduShNodakAnupAnam; evamekAdashe dvAdashe cAnnakAle; ata UrdhvamannaguNAn krameNopabhu~jjAnaH saptarAtreNa prakRutibhojanamAgacchet||16||

Commentary: sAyAhna ityAdau samyagagnishuddhilakShaNabhUte sAyAhne, ki~jcittvavishuddhAvapare~ahni| yaduktaM siddhau- “vamitaM la~gghayet samyagjIrNali~ggAnyavekShayan| tAni dRuShTvA tu peyAdikramaM kuryAnna la~gghanam” (si. a.6) iti| maNDapUrvAM maNDapradhAnAm| ayaM ca dvAdashakAlanivartanIyaH kramaH pradhAnashuddhishuddhe j~jeyaH, madhye tvaShTAnukAlikaH, tathA~alpe caturanukAlikaH; uktaM hi- “peyAM vilepIM” (si. a.1) ityAdi| annaguNAn madhurAdIn gurukaThinAdIMshca| etacca saMsarjanakramAdUrdhvaM saptarAtreNa prakRutibhojanagamanaM tadA kartavyaM yadi vamanAnantaraM virecanaM na kartavyaM bhavati, tatkaraNe tu saMsarjanakramAdUrdhvameva snehapAnaM; yaduktaM- “saMsRuShTabhaktaM navame~ahni sarpistaM pAyayedvA~apyanuvAsayedvA” (si. a.1) iti| tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “pakShAdvireko vAntasya” (su.ci. a.36) iti| yadi saMsarjanakramaM tathA~anuguNAbhyAsaM ca kRutvA snehaH kriyate, tadA pakShAdvireko vAntasya na syAt||16||

athainaM punareva snehasvedAbhyAmupapAdyAnupahatamanasamabhisamIkShya sukhoShitaM suprajIrNabhaktaM kRutahomabalima~ggalajapaprAyashcittamiShTe tithinakShatrakaraNamuhUrte brAhmaNAn svasti vAcayitvA trivRutkalkamakShamAtraM yathArhAloDanaprativinItaM pAyayet prasamIkShya doShabheShajadeshakAlabalasharIrAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutivayasAmavasthAntarANi vikArAMshca, samyak viriktaM cainaM vamanoktena dhUmavarjena vidhinopapAdayedAbalavarNaprakRutilAbhAt, balavarNopapannaM cainamanupahatamanasamabhisamIkShya sukhoShitaM suprajIrNabhaktaM shiraHsnAtamanuliptagAtraM sragviNamanupahatavastrasaMvItamanurUpAla~gkArAla~gkRutaM suhRudAM darshayitvA j~jAtInAM darshayet, athainaM kAmeShvavasRujet||17||
bhavanti cAtra- anena vidhinA rAjA rAjamAtro~athavA punaH| yasya vA vipulaM dravyaM sa saMshodhanamarhati||18||
daridrastvApadaM prApya prAptakAlaM vishodhanam| pibet kAmamasambhRutya sambhArAnapi durlabhAn||19||
na hi sarvamanuShyANAM santi sarve paricchadAH| na ca rogA na bAdhante daridrAnapi dAruNAH||20||
yadyacchakyaM manuShyeNa kartumauShadhamApadi| tattat sevyaM yathAshakti vasanAnyashanAni ca||21||

malApahaM rogaharaM balavarNaprasAdanam| pItvA saMshodhana samyagAyuShA yujyate ciram||22||

Commentary: saMshodhanakaraNaguNamAha- malApahamityAdi||22||
tatra shlokAH- IshvarANAM vasumatAM vamanaM savirecanam| sambhArA ye yadarthaM ca samAnIya prayojayet||23||
yathA prayojyA mAtrA yA yadayogasya lakShaNam| yogAtiyogayoryacca doShA ye cApyupadravAH||24||
yadasevyaM vishuddhena yashca saMsarjanakramaH| tat sarvaM kalpanAdhyAye vyAjahAra punarvasuH||25||

iha khalu rAjAnaM rAjamAtramanyaM vA vipuladravyaM vamanaM virecanaM vA pAyayitukAmena bhiShajA prAgevauShadhapAnAt sambhArA upakalpanIyA bhavanti samyakcaiva hi gacchatyauShadhe pratibhogArthAH, vyApanne cauShadhe vyApadaH parisa~gkhyAya pratIkArArthAH; na hi sannikRuShTe kAle prAdurbhUtAyAmApadi satyapi krayAkraye sukaramAshu sambharaNamauShadhAnAM yathAvaditi||3||

evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- nanu bhagavan! AdAveva j~jAnavatA tathA pratividhAtavyaM yathA prativihite sidhyedevauShadhamekAntena, samyakprayoganimittA hi sarvakarmaNAM siddhiriShTA, vyApaccAsamyakprayoganimittA; atha samyagasamyak ca samArabdhaM karma siddhyati vyApadyate vA~aniyamena, tulyaM bhavati j~jAnamaj~jAneneti||4||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- shakyaM tathA pratividhAtumasmAbhirasmadvidhairvA~apyagnivesha! yathA prativihite sidhyedevauShadhamekAntena, tacca prayogasauShThavamupadeShTuM yathAvat; nahi kashcidasti ya etadevamupadiShTamupadhArayitumutsaheta, upadhArya vA tathA pratipattuM prayoktuM vA; sUkShmANi hi doShabheShajadeshakAlabalasharIrAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutivayasAmavasthAntarANi, yAnyanucintyamAnAni vimalavipulabuddherapi buddhimAkulIkuryuH kiM punaralpabuddheH; tasmAdubhayametadyathAvadupadekShyAmaH- samyakprayogaM cauShadhAnAM, vyApannAnAM ca vyApatsAdhanAni siddhiShUttarakAlam||5||

Commentary: prayogasauShThavaM prayogasuShThutvaM, yathAvadupadeShTuM shakyamasmAbhirasmadvidhairveti yojanA| etaditi prayogasauShThavam| evamiti yathAvad| upadhArayitumiti granthena dhArayitum| pratipattumiti arthato grahItum| sUkShmANItyAdi sUkShmANIva sUkShmANi durbodhatvena; tatra doShasyAvasthAntarANi- kShayastathA vRuddhistathA samatvaM, evamUrdhvadehagamanaM tathA~adhodehagamanaM tiryaggamanaM vA, tathA shAkhAshrayitvaM koShThAshrayitvaM madhyamArgAshrayitvaM, tathA svadeshagamanaM paradeshagamanaM, tathA svatantratvaM paratantratvaM, tathAM~ashAMshavikalpaH, tathA dhAtuvisheShAshrayitvaM, tathA kAlaprakRutidUShyAnuguNatvAdikRutsnatantrapratipAditAni j~jeyAni; evaM bheShajasyAvasthAntarANi- taruNatvaM, vRuddhatvam, ArdratvaM, shuShkatvaM, dravyAntarasaMyuktatvaM, svarasAdikalpanAyogitvaM, rasavIryavipAkaiH prabhAvaishca tasmin dehe doShAdau tattatkAryakartRutvamevamAdIni; deshastvAnUpajA~ggalasAdhAraNaprashastAdibhedabhinnaH; kAlAvasthAntarANi tu RutubhedAH, pUrvAhNAdishca tathA vyAdhyavasthA jvarAShTAhAdaya ityevamAdIni; balaM tu sahajaM yuktikRutaM tathA kAlakRutamutkRuShTApakRuShTamadhyAdibhedabhinnaM; sharIraM tu sthUlatvakRushatvasAravattvaniHsAravattvAdi, tathA paripAlanIyadRuShTimarmAdyavayavavisheShAdibhishca bhinnam; AhArastu prakRutikaraNasaMyogarAshibhedAdibhirbhinnaH; sAtmyaM tu deshataH kAlato vyAdhitaH prakRutitaH svabhAvato~abhyAsatashca bhinnaM bhavati; sattvaM tu bhayashauryaviShAdaharShAdiyogabhinnaM bhavati; prakRutibhedAstvanekaprakArabhinnavAtAdyArabdhatvena boddhavyAH; vayobhedAstu bAlyayauvanavArdhakyatadavAntarabhedAH ; etAni doShAdyavasthAntarANi cikitsAprayoge yathAyathA~apekShyante, tadudAharaNaM shAstre~anusaraNIyam, iha likhyamAnaM tu vistaratvaM granthasyAvahatIti noktam| ubhayametaduttarakAlaM siddhiShUpadekShyAma iti yojanA||5||

idAnIM tAvat sambhArAn vividhAnapi samAsenopadekShyAmaH; tadyathA- dRuDhaM nivAtaM pravAtaikadeshaM sukhapravicAramanupatyakaM dhUmAtapajalarajasAmanabhigamanIyamaniShThAnAM ca shabdasparsharasarUpagandhAnAM sodapAnodUkhalamusalavarcaHsthAnasnAnabhUmimahAnasaM vAstuvidyAkushalaH prashastaM gRuhameva tAvat pUrvamupakalpayet||6||

Commentary: vividhAnapIti apishabdaH samAsenApItyevaMrUpo j~jeyaH; tena gRuhAdayo~api vistareNocyante, sa~ggrahaNIyAdayashca samAseneti dvayamapi susthaM syAt; yadi vA ‘dvividhAnapi’ iti pAThaH, tena bhogArthAni tathA vyApatsAdhanAni gRuhyante| anupatyakaM yad vidUramanyasya mahato gRuhasya| udakaM pIyate yena tadudapAnam||6||

tataH shIlashaucAcArAnurAgadAkShyaprAdakShiNyopapannAnupacArakushalAn sarvakarmasu paryavadAtAn sUpaudanapAcakasnApakasaMvAhakotthApakasaMveshakauShadhapeShakAMshca paricArakAn sarvakarmasvapratikUlAn, tathA gItavAditrollApakashlokagAthAkhyAyiketihAsapurANakushalAnabhiprAyaj~jAnanumatAMshca deshakAlavidaH pAriShadyAMshca, tathA lAvakapi~jjilashashahariNaiNakAlapucchakamRugamAtRukorabhrAn, gAM dogdhrIM shIlavatImanAturAM jIvadvatsAM suprativihitatRuNasharaNapAnIyAM, pAtryAcamanIyodakoShThamaNikaghaTapiTharaparyogakumbhIkumbhakuNDasharAva- darvIkaToda~jcanaparipacanamanthAnacarmacelasUtrakArpAsorNAdIni ca, shayanAsanAdIni copanyastabhRu~ggArapratigrahANi suprayuktAstaraNottarapracchadopadhAnAni sopAshrayANi saMveshanopaveshanasnehasvedAbhya~ggapradehapariShekAnulepanavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsana- shirovirecanamUtroccArakarmaNAmupacArasukhAni, suprakShAlitopadhAnAshca sushlakShNakharamadhyamA dRuShadaH, shastrANi copakaraNArthAni, dhUmanetraM ca, bastinetraM cottarabastikaM ca, kushahastakaM ca, tulAM ca, mAnabhANDaM ca, ghRutatailavasAmajjakShaudraphANitalavaNendhanodakamadhusIdhusurAsauvIrakatuShodaka- maireyamedakadadhidadhimaNDodasviddhAnyAmlamUtrANi ca, tathA shAliShaShTikamudgamAShayavatilakulatthabadaramRudvIkAkAshmaryaparUShakAbhayAmalakabibhItakAni, nAnAvidhAni ca snehasvedopakaraNAni dravyANi, tathaivordhvaharAnulomikobhayabhA~jji, sa~ggrahaNIyadIpanIyapAcanIyopashamanIyavAtaharAdisamAkhyAtAni cauShadhAni; yaccAnyadapi ki~jcihyApadaH parisa~gkhyAya pratIkArArthamupakaraNaM vidyAt, yacca pratibhogArthaM, tattadupakalpayet||7||

Commentary: prAdakShiNyam AnukUlyam| ullApakaM stotram, itihAsaH aj~jAyamAnakartRukAptopadeshaH| mRugamAtRukA pRuthUdaro hariNaH| sharaNaM gRuham| AcamanIyodakoShTham AcamAnArthamudakakoShThaM; kiMvA Acamyate yena pAtreNa tadAcamanaM; maNiko golakaH , piTharaH sthAlI, paryogaH kaTAhaH, kumbho dRuDhAvayavo~alpamukho ghaTaH, kaTaH tRuNAdiracitamAsanam, uda~jcanaM pidhAnasharAvaH, paripacanaM tailapAcanikA| UrNA gaDDararomANi| suprakShAlitetyAdau upadhAnaH shilAputra iti prasiddhaH, dRuShadaH pAShANapaTTakAH| shastrANi copakaraNArthAnIti kuddAlakartarIprabhRutIni| kushahastakaM sammArjanI; anye tu Ardradravyaparipacanamabhidadhati| mAnabhANDaM pratimAnam||7||

tatastaM puruShaM yathoktAbhyAM snehasvedAbhyAM yathArhamupapAdayet, taM cedasminnantare mAnasaH shArIro vA vyAdhiH kashcittIvrataraH sahasA~abhyAgacchettameva tAvadasyopAvartayituM yateta, tatastamupAvartya tAvantamevainaM kAlaM tathAvidhenaiva karmaNopAcaret||8||

tatastaM puruShaM snehasvedopapannamanupahatamanasamabhisamIkShya sukhoShitaM suprajIrNabhaktaM shiraHsnAtamanuliptagAtraM sragviNamanupahatavastrasaMvItaM devatAgnidvijaguruvRuddhavaidyAnarcitavantamiShTe nakShatratithikaraNamuhUrte kArayitvA brAhmaNAn svastivAcanaM prayuktAbhirAshIrbhirabhimantritAM madhumadhukasaindhavaphANitopahitAM madanaphalakaShAyamAtrAM pAyayet||9||

madanaphalakaShAyamAtrApramANaM tu khalu sarvasaMshodhanamAtrApramANAni ca pratipuruShamapekShitavyAni bhavanti; yAvaddhi yasya saMshodhanaM pItaM vaikArikadoShaharaNAyopapadyate na cAtiyogAyogAya, tAvadasya mAtrApramANaM veditavyaM bhavati||10||

pItavantaM tu khalvenaM muhUrtamanukA~gkSheta, tasya yadA jAnIyAt svedaprAdurbhAveNa doShaM pravilayanamApadyamAnaM, lomaharSheNa ca sthAnebhyaH pracalitaM, kukShisamAdhmApanena ca kukShimanugataM, hRullAsAsyasravaNAbhyAmapi cordhvamukhIbhUtam, athAsmai jAnusamamasambAdhaM suprayuktAstaraNottarapracchadopadhAnaM sopAshrayamAsanamupaveShTuM prayacchet, pratigrahAMshcopacArayet, lAlATapratigrahe pArshvopagrahaNe nAbhiprapIDane pRuShThonmardane cAnapatrapaNIyAH suhRudo~anumatAH prayateran||11||

athainamanushiShyAt- vivRutoShThatAlukaNTho nAtimahatA vyAyAmena vegAnudIrNAnudIrayan ki~jcidavanamya grIvAmUrdhvasharIramupavegamapravRuttAn pravartayan suparilikhitanakhAbhyAma~ggulibhyAmutpalakumudasaugandhikanAlairvA kaNThamabhispRushan sukhaM pravartayasveti, sa tathAvidhaM kuryAt; tato~asya vegAn pratigrahagatAnavekShetAvahitaH, vegavisheShadarshanAddhi kushalo yogAyogAtiyogavisheShAnupalabheta, vegavisheShadarshI punaH kRutyaM yathArhamavabudhyeta lakShaNena; tasmAdvegAnavekShetAvahitaH||12||

Commentary: upavegaM vegasamIpam; etena sarvathA~apravRutte vege pravartanaM niShedhayati| vegavisheShadarshanAddhItyAdigranthasya bhAvino yogAyogAdIn vegaviShayAnupalabhya tarkayatItyarthaH; kiMvA, siddhau vaigikI shuddhirabhidhAtavyA “jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegAshcatvAra iShTA vamane ShaDaShTau” (si.a.1) ityAdinA, tAmanena darshayati||12||

snehasvedopapannasya saMshodhanamanantaramityanenaivoktAt sambandhAt svedAdhyAyAnantaraM shodhanavidherabhidhAyakamupakalpanIyamAha| upakalpanIyamiti shodhanopakalpanAmadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAya upakalpanIyaH||1-2||

snaihikAdidhUmapAnavikalpaH puruShaprakRutyapekShaH; ata eva sAmarthyata ityuktaM, yadyasya yujyata ityarthaH| atisthAnamiti atyarthaM daNDAyamAnatvenAvasthitiH| pramitabhojanam ekarasAbhyAsaH| atihInaM naShTashaktikaM dhAnyAdi| gurushabdena svabhAvagurulaTTukacipiTakAderyathoktamAtrayA~api bhojananiShedhaH||14-15||

athainamiti kRutasaMsarjanakramam| prativinItam AloDitam| doShAdayaH pUrvavadvyAkhyeyAH| vikArAMshceti kuShThajvarAdIn virecanasAdhyAn; pUrvaM tu “sUkShmANi hi” ityAdau vikAro noktaH, tasya parIkShyatvenaiva grahaNAt; kiMvA doShagrahaNenaiva tatra vikAragrahaNam| kAmeShu IpsiteShu, avasRujet niryantraNaM kuryAt||17-18||
samprati daridrasya yathoktaM sambhAramakRutvA~api saMshodhanakaraNamAha- daridra ityAdi| durlabhAniti vacanena sulabhAni daridreNA~apyutpAdanIyAni||19-21||
sa~ggrahe- IshvarAH savilAsAH; tena rAj~jo rAjamAtrasya ca grahaNam| prayojayediti ‘sambhArAn’ iti sheShaH||23-25||
rAj~ja iva mAtrA paricchado yasya sa rAjamAtraH| vipuladravyastu vaNigAdiH| parisa~gkhyAyeti j~jAtvA| krayaH paNyam, Akrayo mUlyam| aniyameneti samyagArabdhaM sidhyati vyApadyate ca||3-4||

taM cetyAdau asminnantara iti snehasvedakaraNasamaye| tAvantameva kAlamiti yAvatA kAlenAgatavyAdhiprashamaH kRutastAvantam| iShTa iti shodhanakartRupuruShanakShatrAdyanuguNe auShadhaprayogArthaM vihita ityarthaH; yaduktaM jyotiSha- “puShyo hastastathA jyeShThA rohiNI shravaNAshvinau| svAti saumyaM ca bhaiShajye kuryAdanyatra varjayet” ityAdi| kArayitveti svastivAcanaM kArayitvA||8-9||

pratipuruShamapekShitavyAnItyanena pratipuruShaM shodhanamAtrAbhedaM darshayati| yAvaddhItyAdi mAtrAshitIyoktaH ‘yAvaddhyasyAshanaM’ (sU.a.5) ityAdigranthavyAkhyAnAnusAreNa vyAkhyeyam| anukA~gkSheteti parIkShayan dhArayet| asambAdhamiti asa~gkIrNam| pratigRuhNantIti pratigrahaH patadgrahAH| lalATapratigrahAdaya anapatrapaNIyA alajjAviShayAH||10-11||
athAtashcikitsAprAbhRutIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
atiyogAnubaddhAnAM sarpiHpAnaM prashasyate| tailaM madhurakaiH siddhamathavA~apyanuvAsanam||24||
yasya tvayogastaM snigdhaM punaH saMshodhayennaram| mAtrAkAlabalApekShI smaran pUrvamanukramam||25||
snehane svedane shuddhau rogAH saMsarjane ca ye| jAyante~amArgavihite teShAM siddhiShu sAdhanam||26||

jAyante hetuvaiShamyAdviShamA dehadhAtavaH| hetusAmyAt samAsteShAM svabhAvoparamaH sadA||27||

Commentary: samprati yadetat siddhau vakShyamANaM rogANaM sAdhanaM tadanuSha~ggeNa ca sarvabheShajAnAmeva kShaNabha~ggibhAve pakShe~api rogashamakatvaM pratipAdayituM prakaraNamArabhate- jAyanta ityAdi| teShAmiti viShamANAM dhAtUnAM samAnAM ca| svabhAvAt vinAshakAraNanirapekShAduparamo vinAshaH svabhAvoparamaH| sadeti avilambena; tenotpannamAtrA eva vinashyantItyarthaH||27||

pravRuttiheturbhAvAnAM na nirodhe~asti kAraNam| kecittatrApi manyante hetuM hetoravartanam||28||

Commentary: atraivArthe upapattimAha- pravRuttItyAdi| pravRuttihetuH utpattiheturbhAvAnAmasti, nirodhe vinAshe heturbhAvAnAM kAraNaM nAsti; yasmAt sarva eva bhAvAH pradIpArcirvadutpattau kAraNApekShiNaH, vinAshe tu dvitIyakShaNAvidyamAnatvalakShaNe sahajasiddhe na hetvantaramapekShante; yato na svAbhAvikarUpe hetvantarApekShA bhavati, nahyutpannaH kha~ggaH svAbhAvike lauhamayatve kAraNAntaramapekShate; tadevaM sarveShAmeva bhAvAnAM svAbhAvike nAshe viShamadhAtUnAmapi nAshaH svAbhAvika eveti bhAvaH| vyAdhiprashame ca cikitsApekShakaM pakShAntaramAha- kecidityAdi| tatrApi vinAshe~api, hetuM kAraNaM, hetoravartanamiti utpAdakahetorabhAvaM, manyanta iti yojanA| evamapi hetuparamparAyAH kShaNikatvena tatkAryANAmapi svabhAvAdeva nityaM sannihitasvahetuvinAsharUpavinAshahetUnAM na vinAshahetucikitsApekSheti bhAvaH||28||
evamuktArthamAcAryamagnivesho~abhyabhAShata| svabhAvoparame karma cikitsAprAbhRutasya kim||29||
bheShajairviShamAn dhAtUn kAn samIkurute bhiShak| kA vA cikitsA bhagavan! kimarthaM vA prayujyate||30||
tacchiShyavacanaM shrutvA vyAjahAra punarvasuH| shrUyatAmatra yA somya! yuktirdRuShTA maharShibhiH||31||
na nAshakAraNAbhAvAdbhAvAnAM nAshakAraNam| j~jAyate nityagasyeva kAlasyAtyayakAraNam||32||

nirodhe kAraNaM tasya nAsti naivAnyathAkriyA||33||

Commentary: pUrvasAdhitamahetuvinAshitvaM tathA shIghragatvahetusAdhitaM cAsaMskAryatvamupasaMharati- nirodha ityAdi| tasyeti bhAvasya| anyathAkriyA anyathAkaraNaM, saMskArAdhAnamiti yAvat; etena viShame dhAtau sAmyaM saMskAra AdhIyatAmityevaMrUpA~api cikitsA nirastA mantavyA||33||
yAbhiH kriyAbhirjAyante sharIre dhAtavaH samAH| sA cikitsA vikArANAM karma tadbhiShajAM smRutam||34||
kathaM sharIre dhAtUnAM vaiShamyaM na bhavediti| samAnAM cAnubandhaH syAdityarthaM kriyate kriyA||35||
tyAgAdviShamahetUnAM samAnAM copasevanAt| viShamA nAnubadhnanti jAyante dhAtavaH samAH||36||
samaistu hetubhiryasmAddhAtUn sa~jjanayet samAn| cikitsAprAbhRutastasmAddAtA dehasukhAyuShAm||37||
dharmasyArthasya kAmasya nRulokasyobhayasya ca| dAtA sampadyate vaidyo dAnAddehasukhAyuShAm||38||
tatra shlokAH- cikitsAprAbhRutaguNo doSho yashcetarAshrayaH| yogAyogAtiyogAnAM lakShaNaM shuddhisaMshrayam||39||
bahudoShasya li~ggAni saMshodhanaguNAshca ye| cikitsAsUtramAtraM ca siddhivyApattisaMshrayam||40||
yA ca yuktishcikitsAyAM yaM cArthaM kurute bhiShak| cikitsAprAbhRute~adhyAye tat sarvamavadanmuniH||41||
cikitsAprAbhRuto dhImAn shAstravAn karmatatparaH| naraM virecayati yaM sa yogAt sukhamashnute||3||
yaM vaidyamAnI tvabudho virecayati mAnavam| so~atiyogAdayogAcca mAnavo duHkhamashnute||4||
daurbalyaM lAghavaM glAnirvyAdhInAmaNutA ruciH| hRudvarNashuddhiH kShuttRuShNA kAle vegapravartanam||5||
buddhIndriyamanaHshuddhirmArutasyAnulomatA| samyagviriktali~ggAni kAyAgneshcAnuvartanam ||6||
ShThIvanaM hRudayAshuddhirutkleshaH shleShmapittayoH| AdhmAnamarucishchardiradaurbalyamalAghavam||7||
ja~gghorusadanaM tandrA staimityaM pInasAgamaH| lakShaNAnyaviriktAnAM mArutasya ca nigrahaH||8||
viTpittakaphavAtAnAmAgatAnAM yathAkramam| paraM sravati yadraktaM medomAMsodakopamam||9||
niHshleShmapittamudakaM shoNitaM kRuShNameva vA| tRuShyato mArutArtasya so~atiyogaH pramuhyataH||10||
vamane~atikRute li~ggAnyetAnyeva bhavanti hi| UrdhvagA vAtarogAshca vAggrahashcAdhiko bhavet||11||
cikitsAprAbhRutaM tasmAdupeyAccharaNaM naraH| yu~jjyAd ya enamatyantamAyuShA ca sukhena ca||12||
avipAko~aruciH sthaulyaM pANDutA gauravaM klamaH| piDakAkoThakaNDUnAM sambhavo~aratireva ca||13||
AlasyashramadaurbalyaM daurgandhyamavasAdakaH| shleShmapittasamutklesho nidrAnAsho~atinidratA||14||
tandrA klaibyamabuddhitvamashastasvapnadarshanam| balavarNapraNAshashca tRupyato bRuMhaNairapi||15||
bahudoShasya li~ggAni tasmai saMshodhanaM hitam| UrdhvaM caivAnulomaM ca yathAdoShaM yathAbalam||16||
evaM vishuddhakoShThasya kAyAgnirabhivardhate| vyAdhayashcopashAmyanti prakRutishcAnuvartate||17||
indriyANi manobuddhirvarNashcAsya prasIdati| balaM puShTirapatyaM ca vRuShatA cAsya jAyate||18||
jarAM kRucchreNa labhate ciraM jIvatyanAmayaH| tasmAt saMshodhanaM kAle yuktiyuktaM pibennaraH||19||
doShAH kadAcit kupyanti jitA la~gghanapAcanaiH| jitAH saMshodhanairye tu na teShAM punarudbhavaH||20||
doShANAM ca drumANAM ca mUle~anupahate sati| rogANAM prasavAnAM ca gatAnAmAgatirdhruvA||21||
bheShajakShapite pathyamAhAraireva bRuMhaNam| ghRutamAMsarasakShIrahRudyayUShopasaMhitaiH||22||
abhya~ggotsAdanaiH snAnairnirUhaiH sAnuvAsanaiH| tathA sa labhate sharma yujyate cAyuShA ciram||23||

pUrvAdhyAyoktavamanavirecanayorvistareNa samyagyogAdilakShaNaM, tathA tatpravRuttiviShayabahudoShapuruShAdyabhidhAtuM cikitsAprAbhRutIyo~abhidhIyate| cikitsA prabhRutarUpA sadA yatnena AturopaDhaukanIyatvena ca yasya vidyate sa cikitsAprAbhRutIyaH||1-2||
atiyogAdicikitsAmAha- atiyogetyAdi| smaran pUrvamanukramamityanena yaH pUrvamayoge hetubhUtastaM pariharanniti shikShayati| amArgavihite avidhivihite| sAdhanamityatra ‘vakShyate’ iti sheShaH||24-26||

evamutthitAyAM sha~gkAyAM guruM pRucchati- evamityAdi| kimiti AkShepe| karma sAdhyaM; svabhAvoparame sati na kimapi sAdhyaM pashyAmIti bhAvaH| kAn samIkurute iti viShamANAmasthiratvena sAmyaM tatra kartuM na pAryata ityAshayaH| kA vA cikitseti rogaprashamaM pratyakAraNatvena cikitsA nAstItyarthaH| kimarthaM vA prayujyata iti yannivRuttyarthaM cikitsA prayujyate taddhAtuvaiShamyaM svata eva nivRuttamiti cikitsAprayojanaM nAsti||29-30||

pUrvoktahetuvinAshaM dRuShTAntena hetumantamAha- na nAshetyAdi| bhAvAnAM nAshakAraNaM na j~jAyate, tat kimabhAvAdeva, yathA- shashaviShANam, uta vA j~jAnAyogyatvAt pRuthivyAM nikhAtamUlakIlakAdivat sadapi na j~jAyate, ityAha- nAshakAraNAbhAvAditi; na j~jAnAyogyatvena, kintarhyabhAvAdevetyarthaH| atra dRuShTAntamAha- nityagasyetyAdi| nimeShAdirUpatvena nityagasya| evaM manyate- nityagaH kAlo yathA vinashvaratvena na hetvantaraM vinAshe~apekShate, tathA sarva eva bhAvAH; yaddhi yasya hetvantarApekShaM na tasya tadavashyambhAvi, yathA- paTasya rAgaH; hetvantarApekShI cedvinAshaH syAt, nAvashyambhAvI syAt; etadviparyayAccAnapekShatvaM vinAshasya siddham| sampratyahetuko vinAsha utpattyanantarameva bhavati, pashcAdasthiratvena saMskArAdhAnamapi bhAveShu na pAryate kartumityAha- shIghragatvAdityAdi| yathA bhUta iti yAdRusha utpannaH, tatheti tAdRusha eva vipadyate; kutaH? shIghragatvAt asthiratvAt||31-32||

evaM vyavasthite pUrvAkShiptaM cikitsitaM samAdadhati- yAbhirityAdi| ‘sA cikitsA’ ityanena ‘kA vA cikitsA’ ityAkShepaH parihRutaH| ‘karma tad’ ityanena prathamoddiShTa AkShepaH parihRutaH| ‘ityarthaM kriyate kriyA’ ityanena ‘kimarthaM vA’ ityAkShepaH parihRutaH| ‘kAn samIkurute’ ityAkShepastu ‘samaistu hetubhiryasmAd’ ityAdinA parihRutaH| viShameShu dhAtuShu yAbhiH kriyAbhiH sAmA dhAtavo janyante sA cikitsA| evaM manyate- yadyapi dhAtuvaiShamyaM kShaNikatvena vinashvaraM, tathA~api vinashyadapi taddhAtuvaiShamyaM svakAryaM viShamameva dhAtumArabhate, evaM so~apyaparaM viShamamiti na dhAtuvaiShamyasantAnanivRuttirdhAtusAmyajanakahetuM vinA; yadA tu dhAtusAmyaheturupayukto bhavati, tadA tena sahitaM vaiShamyasantatipatitamapi kAraNaM samameva dhAtusantAnamArabhate, yathA- mudgaraprahArasahito ghaTaparamANusantAno visadRushaM kapAlasantAnamArabhate; evaM vyavasthite ‘kathaM sharIre’ ityAdigrantho vyAkhyeyaH| vaiShamyaM na bhavet notpadyata ityarthaH| samAnAM cAnubandha iti santatyotpAdaH| viShamA nAnubadhnantIti hetvabhAvAdviShamasantAnasyotpAdo na bhavati| samAnAM copasevanAditi samahetUnAM sevanAt||34-36||
dehasukhAyuShAM dAnAt dharmAdInAM dAtA bhavati, dehasampattisAdhyatvAddharmAdInAmiti bhAvaH||37-38||
sa~ggrahe siddhisaMshrayaM ca vyApattisaMshrayaM ca siddhivyApattisaMshrayaM; tatra siddhisaMshrayaM siddhisthAnasaMshrayeNa , vyApattisaMshrayaM ‘atiyogAnubaddhAnAM’ ityAdinoktam||39-41||

yogAt samyagyogAt| sukham Arogyam| virecayatItyatra vAmayatItyapi boddhavyaM, virecanashabdasya vamane~api pravRutteH| so~atiyogAdityAdi| duHkhaM vikAraM; yaduktaM- “vikAro duHkhameva tu” (sU. 9)| nanu vamanAdau kasmAnmithyAyogo nocyate, yAvatA yasya vastuna ucito yogaH sa yogaH, tasya svalpo vA yogaH sarvathA vA ayogo ayoga ucyate, tasyaivAtimAtrayogo vikArakaro~atiyogaH, anucitasambandhena tu vastuno mithyAyogaH; tenehApyutkliShTashleShmAdidharmaprayukte puruShe virecanaM sarvathA~ayaugikameva, tacca prayuktaM pratIpagamanenaiva yAti, virecane mithyAyogo~ayamucitaH, evaM vamanAdiShvapi j~jeyam| naivam, evambhUtamithyAyogasyAyogenaiva grahaNAt, uktaM hi- “prAtilomyena doShANAM haraNAtte hyakRutsnashaH| ayogasa~jj~je kRucchreNa yadA gacchati cAlpashaH” (si. 6) iti| duShTavirecanauShadhasya rasanayopayujyamAnasya hInamAtratvAtimAtratvAbhyAM vinA yadvyAdhikaraNatvaM tanmithyAyogAdeva paraM bhavati; yaduktaM tisraiShaNIye- “mithyAyogo rAshivarjeShvAhAravidhivisheShAyataneShUpadekShyate” (sU. 11) iti| satyaM bheShajasya mithyAyogo~ayaM, vamanasya tu doShaharaNarUpasyAyoga iti; evaM ca virecanAdAvapi j~jeyam| yadyapyatrApi mithyAyogaH katha~jcit pAryate kalpayituM, tathA~api prayojanashUnyatvAdAcAryeNa pRutha~gna kRutaH, shabdAdiShu tu mithyAyoginAM sambandhamAtrasyApi parihArArthaM pRuthakkRuta iti||3-4||

daurbalyamityAdIni virecanasya samyagyuktAyuktAtiyuktasya lakShaNAni| adaurbalyaM sthaulyAnapagamaH | yathAkramamiti paThan krameNaiveti darshayati; yaduktaM- “prAptishca viTpittakaphAnilAnAM samyagviriktasya bhavet krameNa” (si. 1) iti| AgatAnAM paramUrdhvamiti yojanA||5-10||

atiyogalakShaNaM vamane~atidishati- vamana ityAdi| vamanAtiyoge viTpittakaphavAtAnAmiti na yojanIyaM, yena vamanaprayoge kaphapittAnilAgamarUpaH kramo bhavet| yaduktaM- “kramAt kaphaH pittamathAnilashca yasyaiti samyagvamitiH sa iShTaH” (si. a. 1) iti||11-12||

saMshodhanaviShayabahudoShalakShaNamAha- avipAka ityAdi| anAyAsakRutaH shramaH klamaH; shramastviha svalpenAyAsena j~jeyaH| avasAdako mano~avasAdaH| nidrAnAsho vAtapradhAnena doSheNa; atinidratA shleShmapradhAnena||13-19||

samUladoShApahArakatvaM saMshodhanasya, la~gghanapAcanayostu doShApaharatve satyapi na saMshodhanavaddoShahantRutvamityAha- doShA ityAdi| kadAciditi anyahetuprAptyA| na teShAM punarudbhava iti balavaddoShakAraNatvaM vineti mantavyam| ukte~arthe dRuShTAntamAha- doShANAmityAdi| la~gghanapAcanAbhyAM rogakAraNIbhUtadoShaprakopaharaNamAtre kRute rogo yo nivRuttaH sa mUlabhUtAshayavyavasthitadoShAnucchedAdyatki~jcidanuguNakAlAdiprAptyA punaH kupitadoSheNa bhavatIti bhAvaH||20-21||

samprati shodhanena yathA doShakShayastathA dhAtukShayo~api bhavati, tena tatra pratIkAramAha- bheShajetyAdi| AhAraireveti evAvadhAraNe; tena bheShajena bRuMhaNaM niShedhati, bheShajasya vIryapradhAnasya tadA duHsahatvAt| sAnuvAsanairityatra cakAro boddhavyaH, tenAbhya~ggAdibhishca bRuMhaNaM pathyam||22-23||
(bhramaraiH phalapuShpebhyo yathA sambhriyate madhu| tadvadojaH svakarmabhyo guNaiH sambhriyate nRuNAm||1||)
tilakShIraguDAjIrNapUtisa~gkIrNabhojanAt| kledo~asRukkaphamAMsAnAM doShalasyopajAyate||27||
tataH shirasi sa~gkledAt krimayaH pApakarmaNaH| janayanti shirorogaM jAtA bIbhatsalakShaNam||28||
vyadhacchedarujAkaNDUshophadaurgatyaduHkhitam | krimirogAturaM vidyAt krimINAM darshanena ca||29||
shokopavAsavyAyAmarUkShashuShkAlpabhojanaiH | vAyurAvishya hRudayaM janayatyuttamAM rujam||30||
vepathurveShTanaM stambhaH pramohaH shUnyatA daraH | hRudi vAtAture rUpaM jIrNe cAtyarthavedanA||31||
uShNAmlalavaNakShArakaTukAjIrNabhojanaiH| madyakrodhAtapaishcAshu hRudi pittM prakupyati||32||
hRuddAhastiktatA vakre tiktAmlodgiraNaM klamaH| tRuShNA mUrcchA bhramaH svedaH pittahRudrogalakShaNam||33||
atyAdAnaM gurusnigdhamacintanamaceShTanam| nidrAsukhaM cAbhyadhikaM kaphahRudrogakAraNam||34||
hRudayaM kaphahRudroge suptaM stimitabhArikam| tandrAruciparItasya bhavatyashmAvRutaM yathA||35||
hetulakShaNasaMsargAducyate sAnnipAtikaH| (hRudrogaH kaShTadaH kaShTasAdhya ukto maharShibhiH) tridoShaje tu hRudroge yo durAtmA niShevate||36||
tilakShIraguDAdIni granthistasyopajAyate| marmaikadeshe sa~gkledaM rasashcAsyopagacchati||37||
sa~gkledAt krimayashcAsya bhavantyupahatAtmanaH| marmaikadeshe te jAtAH sarpanto bhakShayanti ca||38||
tudyamAnaM sa hRudayaM sUcIbhiriva manyate| chidyamAnaM yathA shastrairjAtakaNDUM mahArujam||39||
hRudrogaM krimijaM tvetairli~ggairbuddhvA sudAruNam| tvareta jetuM taM vidvAn vikAraM shIghrakAriNam||40||
dvyulbaNaikolbaNaiH ShaT syurhInamadhyAdhikaishca ShaT| samaishcaiko vikArAste sannipAtAstrayodasha||41||
saMsarge nava ShaT tebhya ekavRuddhyA samaistrayaH| pRuthak trayashca tairvRuddhairvyAdhayaH pa~jcaviMshatiH||42||
yathA vRuddhaistathA kShINairdoSheH syuH pa~jcaviMshatiH| vRuddhikShayakRutashcAnyo vikalpa upadekShyate||43||
vRuddhirekasya samatA caikasyaikasya sa~gkShayaH| dvandvavRuddhiH kShayashcaikasyaikavRuddhirdvayoH kShayaH ||44||
prakRutisthaM yadA pittaM mArutaH shleShmaNaH kShaye| sthAnAdAdAya gAtreShu yatra yatra visarpati||45||
tadA bhedashca dAhashca tatra tatrAnavasthitaH| gAtradeshe bhavatyasya shramo daurbalyameva ca||46||
prakRutisthaM kaphaM vAyuH kShINe pitte yadA balI| karShet kuryAttadA shUlaM sashaityastambhagauravam||47||
yadA~anilaM prakRutigaM pittaM kaphaparikShaye| saMruNaddhi tadA dAhaH shUlaM cAsyopajAyate||48||
shleShmANaM hi samaM pittaM yadA vAtaparikShaye| sannirundhyAttadA kuryAt satandrAgauravaM jvaram||49||
pravRuddho hi yadA shleShmA pitte kShINe samIraNam| rundhyAttadA prakurvIta shItakaM gauravaM rujam ||50||
samIraNe parikShINe kaphaH pittaM samatvagam| kurvIta sannirundhAno mRudvagnitvaM shirograham ||51||
nidrAM tandrAM pralApaM ca hRudrogaM gAtragauravam| nakhAdInAM ca pItatvaM ShThIvanaM kaphapittayoH||52||
hInavAtasya tu shleShmA pittena sahitashcaran| karotyarocakApAkau sadanaM gauravaM tathA||53||
hRullAsamAsyasravaNaM pANDutAM dUyanaM madam| virekasya ca vaiShamyaM vaiShamyamanalasya ca||54||
hInapittasya tu shleShmA mArutenopasaMhitaH| stambhaM shaityaM ca todaM ca janayatyanavasthitam||55||
gauravaM mRudutAmagnerbhaktAshraddhAM pravepanam| nakhAdInAM ca shuklatvaM gAtrapAruShyameva ca||56||
mArutastu kaphe hIne pittaM ca kupitaM dvayam| karoti yAni li~ggAni shRuNu tAni samAsataH||57||
bhramamudveShTanaM todaM dAhaM sphuTanavepane| a~ggamardaM parIshoShM dUyanaM dhUpanaM tathA||58||
vAtapittakShaye shleShmA srotAMsyapidadhadbhRusham| ceShTApraNAshaM mUrcchAM ca vAksa~ggaM ca karoti hi||59||
vAtashleShmakShaye pittaM dehaujaH sraMsayaccaret| glAnimindriyadaurbalyaM tRuShNAM mUrcchAM kriyAkShayam||60||
pittashleShmakShaye vAyurmarmANyatinipIDayan| praNAshayati sa~jj~jAM ca vepayatyathavA naram||61||

doShAH pravRuddhAH svaM li~ggaM darshayanti yathAbalam| kShINA jahati li~ggaM svaM, samAH svaM karma kuvete||62||

Commentary: doShANAM vRuddhisAmyakShayalakShaNAni pRuthagAha- doShA ityAdi| svaM li~ggamiti vaikArikam| yathAbalamiti ativRuddhairativRuddhaM, madhyavRuddhairmadhyavRuddhamityAdi| li~ggaM svaM jahatItyanena kShINAnAM prakRutili~ggakShayavyatiriktaM vikArakartRutvaM nAstIti darshayati; yato vRuddhA unmArgagAmino doShA dUShyaM dUShayanto jvarAdIn kurvanti na kShINAH, svayameva duHsthitatvAt| svaM karmeti prAkRutaM karma| ete ca dviShaShTirbhedA AviShkRutatamatvenoktAH; tenaikadoShakShaye dvidoShavRuddhau ca vRuddhavRuddhatarabhedAdibhyo~adhikatvamudbhAvanIyam | nanu bhavatvevaM sa~gkhyA yadi sannipAto doShANAM syAt, sa tu na bhavitumarhati, yato vAtAdInAM parasparaM viruddhAH santi guNAH, viruddhaguNAnAM tu parasparopaghAto bhavati, yathA- vahnitoyayoH| naivaM, virodho hi bhAvAnAM kAryonneyaH, nAnyato dRuShTamAtreNa kalpayituM pAryate; yato~anyatra toyadahanayorbheda upalabdhaH, tat kiM pA~jcabhautikadravyArambhe~api tayorvirodhAt pA~jcabhautikaM dravyaM na syAt, toyAgniguNAtirekAdvA~amlaraso na syAt , tasmAdanupalabdhatvAddoShasaMsarge virodhasya svabhAvaparyanuyogo na yujyate| atha manyase- evaM viruddhaguNAnAmapi doShANAmavirodhe “viruddhaguNasannipAte bhUyasA~alpamavajIyate” (vi. 1) iti, tathA “hrAsaheturvisheShastu” (sU. 1) iti vacane tarhi nirarthake| na, anayoH prabhAvAt pratipAditaviShayavyatireke caritArthatvAt| prabhAvastu tayorvirodhako bhavatyeva; yathA- tridoShakaranikucagatA guNAH samAn doShAn kurvanti paraM, na tu viruddhatvena doShaharaNaM kurvate tridoShakartRutvaprabhAvAt; tathA Amalake~amlatvaM vAtaM hanti, mAdhuryashaitye tu pittaM, shleShmANaM ca kaTutvatiktatve; nikuce tvamlatvaM kaShAyashaityAbhibhUtaM vAtaM na nihanti, mAdhuryashaitye cAmlatvAbhibhUte pittaM na jayata evamAdi| tasmAddoShANAM prabhAvo~ayaM dRuShTatvAdavadhAryate- yat- na te parasparamupaghnanti| evambhUtaprabhAvatve tu teShAmadRuShTameva kAraNaM, prANinAM duHkhajanakena hyadRuShTena te~avirodhena niveshyante, ata eva vakShyati- “viruddhairapi na tvete guNairghnanti parasparam| doShAH sahajasAtmyatvAddhoraM viShamahIniva” (ci. 26) iti| sahajaM daivavashAt svAbhAvikaM sAtmyatvaM sahajasAtmyatvam| anena ca vyAkhyAnena ‘yathA doShA anyonyaM nopaghnanti, tathA rasaraktAdInapi nopahanyuH’ ityAdi yaducyate kaishcit, tat sarvaM nirastam| nanu, “kAladUShyaprakRutibhirdoShastulyo hi santatam| niShpratyanIkaH kurute” (ci. 3) iti cikitsite vakShyati, tena prakRutirdoShasya pratipakShA bhavatItyuktaM, prakRutishca janmaprabhRutivRuddho vAtAdirucyate, “doShAnushayitA hyeShAM dehaprakRutirucyate” (sU. 7) ityAdivacanAt; tadayaM prAkRutena doSheNa doShasya virodhaH kathaM tarhyupapannaH? ucyate- tatra prakRuteH pratyanIkatA ananuguNatvena mantavyA, samAnAM hi prakRutiM prApya doShaH pravRuddhabalo bhavati, asamAnAM tu prApya tathA balavAnna bhavati, nAsamAnayA prakRutyA hanyate; evamanyatrApyunneyam| ativRuddhena vAyunAshleShmaNo durbalasya duShTatvAdvirodho bhavatyeva kvacit, naitAvatA saMsargasannipAtAsambhavaH||62||
vAtAdInAM rasAdInAM malAnAmojasastathA| kShayAstatrAnilAdInAmuktaM sa~gkShINalakShaNam ||63||
ghaTTate sahate shabdaM noccairdravati shUlyate| hRudayaM tAmyati svalpaceShTasyApi rasakShaye||64||
paruShA sphuTitA mlAnA tvagrUkShA raktasa~gkShaye| mAMsakShaye visheSheNa sphiggrIvodarashuShkatA||65||
sandhInAM sphuTanaM glAnirakShNorAyAsa eva ca| lakShaNaM medasi kShINe tanutvaM codarasya ca||66||
keshalomanakhashmashrudvijaprapatanaM shramaH| j~jeyamasthikShaye li~ggaM sandhishaithilyameva ca||67||
shIryanta iva cAsthIni durbalAni laghUni ca| pratataM vAtarogINi kShINe majjani dehinAm||68||
daurbalyaM mukhashoShashca pANDutvaM sadanaM shramaH| klaibyaM shukrAvisargashca kShINashukrasya lakShaNam||69||
kShINe shakRuti cAntrANi pIDayanniva mArutaH| rUkShasyonnamayan kukShiM tiryagUrdhvaM ca gacchati||70||
mUtrakShaye mUtrakRucchraM mUtravaivarNyameva ca| pipAsA bAdhate cAsya mukhaM ca parishuShyati||71||
malAyanAni cAnyAni shUnyAni ca laghUni ca| vishuShkANi ca lakShyante yathAsvaM malasa~gkShaye||72||
