kiyantaH shirasi proktA rogA hRudi ca dehinAm| kati cApyanilAdInAM rogA mAnavikalpajAH||3||
kShayAH kati samAkhyAtAH piDakAH kati cAnagha!| gatiH katividhA coktA doShANAM doShasUdana!||4||
hutAshaveshasya vacastacchrutvA gururabravIt| pRuShTavAnasi yat saumya! tanme shRuNu savistaram||5||
dRuShTAH pa~jca shirorogAH pa~jcaiva hRudayAmayAH| vyAdhInAM hyadhikA ShaShTirdoShamAnavikalpajA||6||
dashAShTau ca kShayAH sapta piDakA mAdhumehikAH| doShANAM trividhA coktA gatirvistarataH shRuNu||7||
bibheti durbalo~abhIkShNaM dhyAyati vyathitendriyaH| dushchAyo durmanA rUkShaH kShAmashcaivaujasaH kShaye||73||
hRudi tiShThati yacchuddhaM raktamIShatsapItakam| ojaH sharIre sa~gkhyAtaM tannAshAnnA vinashyati||74||
prathamaM jAyate hyojaH sharIre~asmi~jcharIriNAm| sarpirvarNaM madhurasaM lAjagandhi prajAyate||75||
vyAyAmo~anashanaM cintA rUkShAlpapramitAshanam| vAtAtapau bhayaM shoko rUkShapAnaM prajAgaraH||76||
kaphashoNitashukrANAM malAnAM cAtivartanam| kAlo bhUtopaghAtashca j~jAtavyAH kShayahetavaH||77||
gurusnigdhAmlalavaNAnyatimAtraM samashnatAm| navamannaM ca pAnaM ca nidrAmAsyAsukhAni ca||78||
tyaktavyAyAmacintAnAM saMshodhanamakurvatAm| shleShmA pittaM ca medashca mAMsaM cAtipravardhate||79||
tairAvRutagatirvAyuroja AdAya gacchati| yadA bastiM tadA kRucchro madhumehaH pravartate||80||
sa mArutasya pittasya kaphasya ca muhurmuhuH| darshayatyAkRutiM gatvA kShayamApyAyate punaH||81||
upekShayA~asya jAyante piDakAH sapta dAruNAH| mAMsaleShvavakAsheShu marmasvapi ca sandhiShu||82||
sharAvikA kacchapikA jAlinI sarShapI tathA| alajI vinatAkhyA ca vidradhI ceti saptamI||83||
antonnatA madhyanimnA shyAvA kledaruganvitA| sharAvikA syAt piDakA sharAvAkRutisaMsthitA||84||
avagADhArtinistodA mahAvAstuparigrahA| shlakShNA kacchapapRuShThAbhA piDakA kacchapI matA||85||
stabdhA sirAjAlavatI snigdhAsrAvA mahAshayA| rujAnistodabahulA sUkShmacchidrA ca jAlinI||86||
piDakA nAtimahatI kShiprapAkA mahArujA| sarShapI sarShapAbhAbhiH piDakAbhishcitA bhavet||87||
dahati tvacamutthAne tRuShNAmohajvarapradA| visarpatyanishaM duHkhAddahatyagnirivAlajI||88||
avagADharujAkledA pRuShThe vA~apyudare~api vA| mahatI vinatA nIlA piDakA vinatA matA||89||
sandhAraNAddivAsvapnAdrAtrau jAgaraNAnmadAt| uccairbhAShyAdavashyAyAt prAgvAtAdatimaithunAt||8||
gandhAdasAtmyAdAghrAtAdrajodhUmahimAtapAt| gurvamlaharitAdAnAdati shItAmbusevanAt||9||
shiro~abhighAtAdduShTAmAdrodanAdbAShpanigrahAt | meghAgamAnmanastApAddeshakAlaviparyayAt||10||
vAtAdayaH prakupyanti shirasyasraM ca duShyati| tataH shirasi jAyante rogA vividhalakShaNAH||11||
vidradhiM dvividhAmAhurbAhyAmAbhyantarIM tathA| bAhyA tvaksnAyumAMsotthA kaNDarAbhA mahArujA||90||
shItakAnnavidAhyuShNarUkShashuShkAtibhojanAt| viruddhAjIrNasa~gkliShTaviShamAsAtmyabhojanAt||91||
vyApannabahumadyatvAdvegasandhAraNAcchramAt| jihmavyAyAmashayanAdatibhArAdhvamaithunAt||92||
antaHsharIre mAMsAsRugAvishanti yadA malAH| tadA sa~jjAyate granthirgambhIrasthaH sudAruNaH||93||
hRudaye klomni yakRuti plIhni kukShau ca vRukkayoH| nAbhyAM va~gkShaNayorvA~api bastau vA tIvravedanaH||94||
duShTaraktAtimAtratvAt sa vai shIghraM vidahyate| tataH shIghravidAhitvAdvidradhItyabhidhIyate||95||
vyadhacchedabhramAnAhashabdasphuraNasarpaNaiH| vAtikIM, paittikIM tRuShNAdAhamohamadajvaraiH||96||
jRumbhotkleshArucistambhashItakaiH shlaiShmikIM viduH| sarvAsu ca mahacchUlaM vidradhIShUpajAyate||97||
shastrAstrairbhidyata iva colmukairiva dahyate| vidradhI vyamlatA yAtA vRushcikairiva dashyate||98||
tanu rUkShAruNaM shyAvaM phenilaM vAtavidradhI| tilamAShakulatthodasannibhaM pittavidradhI||99||
shlaiShmikI sravati shvetaM picchilaM bahalaM bahu| lakShaNaM sarvamevaitadbhajate sAnnipAtikI||100||

prANAH prANabhRutAM yatra shritAH sarvendriyANi ca| yaduttamA~ggamA~ggAnAM shirastadabhidhIyate||12||

Commentary: prANA ityAdinA~a~ggeShu shiraHprAdhAnyaM darshayan prakRutashirorogANAmevAtyahitatvaM darshayati; tena notsUtraM shiraHprAdhAnyAbhidhAnam| shritA iva shritAH, shira-upaghAte upaghAtAt| upariShTAda~ggamuttamA~ggam||12||

athAsAM vidradhInAM sAdhyAsAdhyatvavisheShaj~jAnArthaM sthAnakRutaM li~ggavisheShamupadekShyAmaH- tatra pradhAnamarmajAyAM vidradhyAM hRuddhaTTanatamakapramohakAsashvAsAH, klomajAyAM pipAsAmukhashoShagalagrahAH, yakRujjAyAM shvAsaH, plIhajAyAmucchvAsoparodhaH, kukShijAyAM kukShipArshvAntarAMsashUlaM, vRukkajAyAM pRuShThakaTigrahaH, nAbhijAyAM hikkA, va~gkShaNajAyAM sakthisAdaH, bastijAyAM kRucchrapUtimUtravarcasatvaM ceti||101||
pakvaprabhinnAsUrdhvajAsu mukhAt srAvaH sravati, adhojAsu gudAt, ubhayatastu nAbhijAsu||102||

AsAM hRunnAbhibastijAH paripakvAH sAnnipAtikI ca maraNAya; sheShAH punaH kushalamAshupratikAriNaM cikitsakamAsAdyopashAmyanti| tasmAdacirotthitAM vidradhIM shastrasarpavidyudagnitulyAM snehavirecanairAshvevopakramet sarvasho gulmavacceti||103||
bhavanti cAtra- vinA pramehamapyetA jAyante duShTamedasaH| tAvaccaitA na lakShyante yAvadvAstuparigrahaH||104||
sharAvikA kacchapikA jAlinI ceti duHsahAH| jAyante tA hyatibalAH prabhUtashleShmamedasaH||105||
sarShapI cAlajI caiva vinatA vidradhI ca yAH| sAdhyaH pittolbaNAstAstu sambhavantyalpamedasaH||106||
marmasvaMse gude pANyoH stane sandhiShu pAdayoH| jAyante yasya piDikAH sa pramehI na jIvati||107||
tathA~anyAH piDakAH santi raktapItAsitAruNAH| pANDurAH pANDuvarNAshca bhasmAbhA mecakaprabhAH||108||
mRudvyashca kaThinAshcAnyAH sthUlAH sUkShmAstathA~aparAH| mandavegA mahAvegAH svalpashUlA mahArujaH||109||
tA buddhvA mArutAdInAM yathAsvairhetulakShaNaiH| brUyAdupacareccAshu prAgupadravadarshanAt||110||
tRuTshvAsamAMsasa~gkothamohahikkAmadajvarAH| vIsarpamarmasaMrodhAH piDakAnAmupadravAH||111||
kShayaH sthAnaM ca vRuddhishca doShANAM trividhA gatiH| UrdhvaM cAdhashca tiryakca vij~jeyA trividhA~aparA||112||
trividhA cAparA koShThashAkhAmarmAsthisandhiShu| ityuktA vidhibhedena doShANAM trividhA gatiH||113||

cayaprakopaprashamAH pittAdInAM yathAkramam| bhavantyekaikashaH ShaTsu kAleShvabhrAgamAdiShu||114||

Commentary: yathAkramamiti varShAsharaddhemantavasantagrIShmaprAvRuTkrameNa; kiMvA yathAkramamiti yathAyogyatayA| pittAdInAmiti pittashleShmavAtAnAm| ekaikasha iti ayaugapadyena| etacca prAdhAnyenaiva j~jeyaM, tena prAvRuShi shleShmapittakopenApradhAnena na vyabhicAraH| yaduktaM- “varShAsvagnibale hIne kupyanti pavanAdayaH” (sU.a.6) iti| atra hi pavanAdaya iti pavanapradhAnAH; evaM vasante vAtapittaprakope vyAkhyeyam| atra ca ShaTsu RutuShu pittashleShmavAtAnAM prabalacayAdayo vibhajyamAnatvena; tena pittacayakAle vAtasya kopaH, sharadi pittasya prakopakAle vAtaprashamaH, hemante pittaprashamaH kaphasya cayaH, vasante tu kaphaprakopa eva paraM, tathA kaphaprashamake grIShme vAtacaya iti ca syAt| vAtaM parityajya pittAdInAmityabhidhAnAM visargasyAbhipretatvenAgre vaktavyatvAt kRutaM, visarge ca pittacaya eva bhavatIti kRutvA||114||-
gatishca dvividhA dRuShTA prAkRutI vaikRutI ca yA||115||
pittAdevoShmaNaH paktirnarANAmupajAyate| tacca pittaM prakupitaM vikArAn kurute bahUn||116||
prAkRutastu balaM shleShmA vikRuto mala ucyate| sa caivaujaH smRutaH kAye sa ca pApmopadishyate||117||
sarvA hi ceShTA vAtena sa prANaH prANInAM smRutaH| tenaiva rogA jAyante tena caivoparudhyate||118||
ardhAvabhedako vA syAt sarvaM vA rujyate shiraH| pratishyAmukhanAsAkShikarNarogashirobhramAH||13||
arditaM shirasaH kampo galamanyAhanugrahaH| vividhAshcApare rogA vAtAdikrimisambhavAH||14||

nityaM sannihitAmitraM samIkShyAtmAnamAtmavAn| nityaM yuktaH paricaredicchannAyuranitvaram||119||

Commentary: AtmavAniti prashaMsAyAM matuppratyayaH| yukta ityudyuktaH| anitvaram agatvaram||119||
tatra shlokau- shirorogAH sahRudrogA rogA mAnavikalpajAH| kShayAH sapiDakAshcoktA doShANAM gatireva ca||120||
kiyantaHshirasIye~asminnadhyAye tattvadarshinA| j~jAnArthaM bhiShajAM caiva prajAnAM ca hitaiShiNA||121||
pRuthagdiShTAstu ye pa~jca sa~ggrahe paramarShibhiH| shirogadAMstA~jchRuNu me yathAsvairhetulakShaNaiH||15||
uccairbhAShyAtibhAShyAbhyAM tIkShNapAnAt prajAgarAt| shItamArutasaMsparshAdvyavAyAdveganigrahAt||16||
upavAsAdabhIghAtAdvirekAdvamanAdati| bAShpashokabhayatrAsAdbhAramArgAtikarshanAt||17||
shirogatAH sirA vRuddho vAyurAvishya kupyati| tataH shUlaM mahattasya vAtAt samupajAyate||18||
nistudyete bhRushaM sha~gkau ghATA sambhidyate tathA| sabhrUmadhyaM lalATaM ca tapatIvAtivedanam||19||
vadhyete svanataH shrotre niShkRuShyete ivAkShiNI| ghUrNatIva shiraH sarvaM sandhibhya iva mucyate||20||
sphuratyati sirAjAlaM stabhyate ca shirodharA| snigdhoShNamupashete ca shiroroge~anilAtmake||21||
kaTvamlalavaNakShAramadyakrodhAtapAnalaiH| pittaM shirasi sanduShTaM shirorogAya kalpate||22||
dahyate rujyate tena shiraH shItaM suShUyate | dahyete cakShuShI tRuShNA bhramaH svedashca jAyate||23||
AsyAsukhaiH svapnasukhairgurusnigdhAtibhojanaiH| shleShmA shirasi sanduShTaH shirorogAya kalpate||24||
shiro mandarujaM tena suptaM stimitabhArikam| bhavatyutpadyate tandrA tathA~a~alasyamarocakaH||25||
vAtAcchUlaM bhramaH kampaH pitAddAho madastRuShA| kaphAdgurutvaM tandrA ca shiroroge tridoShaje||26||

pUrvacatuShkacatuShTayena bheShajamabhihitaM, samprati tadviShayarogAbhidhAnArthaM rogacatuShko~abhidhAtavyaH, cikitsA ca vidheyatvenaiva pradhAnamataH prathamamuktA, ki~jca darshitashcAyaM prathamAdhyAya eva sambandhaH, evaM cA~ggeShu marmasu ca pradhAnabhUtashirohRudayarogAbhidhAyakatvena kiyantaH shirasIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||
sa~gkIrNabhojanaM viruddhAharaH| doShalasya bahudoShasya| pApakarmaNa ityanenAdharmavata evAyamatiduHkhakrimirogo bhavatIti darshayati| bIbhatsalakShaNamiti ghrANAdibhyaH pUyAdipravRutteH||27-29||

shokopavAsetyAdi hRudrogalakShaNam| veShTanam udveShTanamiva| daraH daradarikA| acintanam alpacintanam| ashmAvRutam ashmAkrAntam| granthiriva granthiH, sa ca rasadoShakRutaH| marmaikadeshe hRudayaikadeshe| dvitIyaM marmetipadaM karmatApannam||30-40||

‘kati cApyanilAdInAm’ ityAdyuktasyottaraM- dvyulbaNairityAdi| hInamadhyAdhikairiti vRuddhavRuddhataravRuddhatamaiH| saMsarge naveti cchedaH| asyaiva vivaraNaM- ShaT tebhya ityAdi| samaisraya iti vRuddhaiH samaiH| vRuddhikShayakRuta ityasya vivaraNaM- vRuddhirekasyetyAdi| atra ca yadyapi samatA~api vRuddhikShayavikalpe paThyate, tathA~api samatAyAH svAtantryeNa vikArAkartRutvAt ‘vRuddhikShayakRuta’ ityuktam| vRuddhirekasya samatA caikasyaikasya sa~gkShaya ityanena ShaDvikArAH| dvandvavRuddhiH kShayashcaikasyetyanena trayaH| ekavRuddhirdvayoH kShayaH , tena trayaH| evaM dviShaShTiprakArA bhavanti||41-44||

vRuddhirekasyetyAderudAharaNam- prakRutisthaM yadA pittamityAdi| atra kecidetadeva paramudAharaNaM dRuShTAntArthaM paThanti, sheShodAharaNaM tu kRutsne tantre boddhavyaM; kecittu vRuddhikShayavikalpasya durbodhatvena sarveShAmeva dvAdashAnAmapi vikalpAnAmAcAryeNa lakShaNaM kRutamiti kRutvA sarvameva paThanti| nanu prakRutisthe pitte kathaM tadA dAhashceti sa~ggataM bhavati, na hi prakRutistho doSho vikArakArI, na ca vAyordAhaH sambhavati| ucyate- yatra yatreti vacanAd yatra kupitena vAyunA pittaM nItaM, tatra sharIrAvayave prakRutimAnasthitamapi pittaM vRuddhameva, yatastasmin pradeshe tAvAn pittasambandha ucito na bhavatyevetyadhikena tatra pittena dAha upapanna eva, evamanyatrApi prakRutisthasyApi doShasya vikAre vyAkhyeyam| anye tu bruvate- prakRutisthAnAmapi doShANAM duShTadoShasambandhAdvikArakAritvaM bhavati; yathA- raktAdInAm| hInavAtasyetyAdi ‘dvandvavRuddhiH kShayashcaikasya’ ityasyodAharaNam| dehaujo dehasAraH; kiMvA dehashca ojashca dehaujaH||45-61||

sampratyaShTAdashakShayAnAha- vAtAdInAmityAdi| atra malAnAmityanena mUtrapurIShayoH pa~jcendriyamalAnAM ca grahaNam| visheSheNetivacanAdanyagAtrANAmapi shuShkatA labhyate| sandhInAmityAdi bhedaH- kShayalakShaNam, keshetyAdi asthikShayasya| bAdhate cAsyeti karmaNi sheShalakShaNA ShaShThI| malAyanAnItyanena pa~jcendriyAdhiShThAnAnAM mukhanAsikAcakShuHkarNAnAM tvagindriyAdhiShThAnabhUtAnAM ca lomakUpaprajananAnAM yathAsvaM malAyanAni gRuhyante| yaduktaM jatUkarNe- “doShANAM dhAtUnAmojomUtrashakRudindriyamalAnAm| aShTAdashakShayAste lakShyAH svaguNakriyAnAshAt” iti||63-72||

kShayasthAnavRuddhayo doShamAnaM, tasya vikalpo doShAntarasambandhAsambandhakRuto bhedaH| mAdhumehikA ityatra madhumehashabdaH sAmAnyena pramehavacanaH| yato~atraiva sAmAnyena brUte- “vinA pramehamapyetA jAyante duShTamedasaH” iti; anyathA hi ‘vinA madhumehaM’ iti kRutaM syAt; tathA cikitsite vakShyati sAmAnyenaiva yat- “pramehiNAM yAH piDakA mayoktA rogAdhikAre pRuthageva sapta” (ci. 6) ityAdi| tathA madhumehapiDakAnAM cikitsitopadeshAcca sarvamehabhavatvaM piDakAnAM, madhumehabhavatve hi madhumehasyaivAsAdhyatvAnna tadbhavapiDakAnAmupakramaNIyatvamasti; ki~jca pradeshAntare~api madhumehashabdenAyaM sarvapramehAnuktavAn, yathA- “gulmI ca madhumehI ca rAjayakShmI ca yo naraH| acikitsyA bhavantyete balamAMsaparikShaye” (iM. 9) iti| atra hi yadi vAtiko madhumeho~abhipretaH syAttadA tasya svarUpata evAsAdhyatvena ‘balamAMsaparikShaye sati’ iti visheShaNamanarthakaM syAt| sushrutenApi ca sAmAnyena pramehe evaitAH piDakA darshitAH, yaduktaM- “tatra vasAmedobhyAmabhipannasharIrasya tribhirdoShaishcAnugatadhAtoH pramehiNo dasha piDakA jAyante” (su. ni. 6) ityAdi| sarva eva pramehA yasmAddehaM madhurIkRutya jAyante tasmAnmadhumehA ityucyante, vacanaM hi- “ShaTpadapippIlikAbhishca sharIramUtrAbhisaraNam” (ni. 4) iti, tathA ca vAgbhaTaH- “madhuraM yacca sarveShu prAyo madhviva mehati| sarve hi madhumehAkhyA mAdhuryAcca tanorataH” (vA. ni. 10) iti| vistarata iti shRuNvityanena sambadhyate||3-7||

ojaHkShayalakShaNamAha- bibhetItyAdi| durmanA manobalavihInaH| ojaso durj~jeyatvena lakShaNamAha- hRudItyAdi| shuddhamiti shuklaM, raktamIShaditi ki~jcidraktaM, sapItakamiti IShatpItakaM; tena shuklavarNamojaH, raktapItau tu varNAvatrAnugatau; kiMvA, IShadityalpapramANaM, tenAShTabindukamoja iti darshayati| yaduktaM tantrAntare- “prANAshrayasyaujaso~aShTau bindavo hRudayAshrayAH” iti| etaccAShTabindukaM paramojo j~jeyam, ardhA~jjaliparimANaM tu yadojastadapradhAnaM; yacchArIre vakShyati- “tAvaccaiva shlaiShmikasyaujasaH pramANam” (shA. 7) ityanena; tasmAddvividhamihaujaH| ata evArthe dashamahAmUlIye vakShyati- “tat parasyaujasaH sthAnaM” (sU. 30) iti; parasya shreShThasyAShTabindukasyetyarthaH| iha ca kShayalakShaNamardhA~jjalimAnasyaiva j~jaiyam, aShTabindukasya tvavayavanAshe~api mRutyurbhavatIti hRudItyAdinA granthena darshayati| etaccaujaH sarvadhAtusamudAyarUpaM, tena saptadhAtuShvevAvaruddhamiti nAShTamadhAtutvAtiprasaktiH ; ata eva sushrute~apyuktaM- “rasAdInAM shukrAntAnAM dhAtUnAM yat paraM tejastat khalvojaH” (su. sU. 15) iti| anyatrApyuktaM- “bhramaraiH phalapuShpebhyo yathA saMhriyate madhu| tadvadojaH sharIrebhyo guNaiH saMhriyate nRuNAm” iti| ‘prathamaM jAyate’ ityAdipAThastu nAtiprasiddhaH| ete cAShTAdasha kShayA AviShkRutatamatvenoktAH; tena udakakShayasvarakShayAdyanabhidhAnaM nodbhAvanIyam; uktaM hi- “svarakShayamurorogaM” iti; tathodakakShayalakShaNaM yathA- “jihvAtAlvoShThakaNThaklomasaMshoShaM pipAsAM cAtivRuddhAM dRuShTvA udakavahAnyasya srotAMsi praduShTAnIti jAnIyAt” (vi. 5) iti||73-75||

sAmAnyena kShayANAM hetumAha- vyAyAma ityAdi| pramitAshanam ekarasAbhyAsaH| ativartanam atipravRuttiH, bahirgamanamiti yAvat| kAlo vArdhakyamAdAnaM ca| bhUtopaghAtaH pishAcAdyupaghAtaH| atra vAtakShayaheturnokto vilakShaNatvAt, sa cAcintanadivAsvapanAdirj~jeyaH; kiMvA, anashanAt kiTTAbhAvaH, tatashca kiTTarUpasya vAtasyApyanutpAdAt kShayo j~jeyaH||76-77||

samprati saptapiDakA vaktavyAH, atastAsAM pradhAnahetutvena pramehAneva tAvannidAnAdikrameNAha- gurvityAdi| navaM pAnamiti navaM madyam| nidrAmAsyAsukhAni cetyatrAnte ‘bhajatAM’ iti sheShaH| ojaH prasAdo dhAtUnAmiti yAvat| kRucchr iti kRucchrasAdhyaH| upekShayA acikitsayA| sharAvikAdisa~jj~jAnvayo vivaraNe sphuTaH| alajIsa~jj~jA rUDhA| etAshca prAdhAnyAduktAH| tena sushrute~api piDakAdhikyamuktaM yat, tanna virodhi| sirAjAlaM sirAsamUhaH| citA adhiShThitA||78-89||

sandhAraNAditi vegasandhAraNAt| haritam ArdrakAdi| atIti pUrveNa pareNa ca shItAmbusevanAdityanena sambadhyate| duShTAdAmAt duShTAmAt; kiMvA ‘uShNAmAt’ iti pAThaH, tatroShNAccAmAccetyarthaH| deshakAlaviparyayAdityatra deshaviparyaya upasargagRuhItatvaM deshasya| asraM ca praduShyatItyabhidadhAnaH sarvashirorogeShu raktaduShTiM darshayati||8-11||

vidradhiM dvividhAmityanenAbhyantaravidradherapi vidradhitvena piDakAnAM saptatve~avirodha iti darshayati| kaNDarAbhA sthUlasnAyvAkArA| antarvidradhergarIyastvena nidAnAnyAha- shItaketyAdi| sa~gkliShTaM doShalam| vyApannaM ca bahu ca madyamupayu~gkte yaH sa vyApannabahumadyaH| antaHsharIra iti koShThe| malA doShAH| granthiriva granthiH| sa iti granthiH| vyadhAdayo vyathAprakArAH | shItameva shItakam| vyamlatAM yAtA vidAhaM prAptA| tamakaH shvAsabhedaH||90-100||

kukShipArshvAntarAMsashUlamiti kukShipArshvAntarAMseShu shUlam | hRunnAbhibastijAsu sAnnipAtikIM pRuthak paThan sAnnipAtikIM pakvAmapakvAM cAsAdhyAM darshayati| shastrAdidRuShTAntatrayAcchastravanmarmacchedakatvaM, sarpavadAshusa~jj~jAhAritvaM, vidyudagnivadAshumArakatvaM j~jeyam||101-103||
pramehaM vinA~apyuktapiDakAsambhavaM darshayati- vinetyAdi| etena ca piDakAnAM mAdhumehikatvaM yat pUrvamuktaM tat prAyikatvena j~jeyam| vAstu sthAnam| vidradhI ceti bAhyavidradhI||104-107||

pramehapiDakAprasa~ggenAnyAsAmapi piDakAnAmAviShkRutAnAM lakShaNaM brUte- tathA~anyA ityAdi| pANDurA dhUsarAH, pANDuvarNAstu rUkShapANDuvarNA j~jeyAH| mecakaprabhAH snigdhakRuShNavarNAH| upacarecceti mArutAdInAM bheShajairityarthAdbhavati| prAgupadravadarshanAdityanena upadravayuktA piDakA asAdhyeti darshayati| sa~gkothaH pUtibhAvaH||108-111||

samprati doShANAM gatiM vivRuNoti- kShaya ityAdi| sthAnaM svamAnavasthAnam| gatiH prakAro~avasthA vA| caya ityatra prashabdo luptanirdiShTaH, tena prakRuShTacayaH; evaM prakRuShTaH kopaH prakopaH; evaM prashamo~api| etena varShAdiShu pittAdInAM prakRuShTashcayo bhavatIti darshyate, itaradoShasyApi ca stokamAtreNa cayo yathAsambhavaM sUcyate; tena sharadyanubalatvena kaphaprakopo bhavatItyAdi gRuhItaM bhavati||112-113||

gatibhedAntaramAha- gatishcetyAdi| atra pittamAdau kRutaM sharIrasthitihetvagnikartRutvena| paktiH pAkaH| balamiti balahetutvena| mala iti sharIramalinIkaraNAt| oja iti sArabhUtaM; yadi vA dvitIyashlaiShmikaujohetutvenaujaH| vakShyati hi shArIre- “tAvaccaiva shlaiShmikasyaujasashca pramANam” (shA.a.7) iti| duHkhahetutvAt pApmA| sarvA hi ceShTA iti avikRutagamanAdyAH| uparudhyate mriyate||115-118||
prakRutA~jchirorogAnAha- ardhetyAdinA krimisambhavA ityantena| etacca ‘jAyante rogA vividhalakShaNAH’ ityasya vivaraNam||13-14||
tatra shlokAvityAdi||120-121||

shirogatatvena nAsAdirogeShvapi prApteShu tAn vihAyaivAShTodarIye proktAMstAneva shiraHshUlalakShaNAn rogAn prapa~jcena vaktumAha- pRuthagityAdi| sa~ggrahe aShTodarIye; tena nArUMShikAdayo~atraprakaraNe shirorogashabdenocyante; shirorogashabdasya shUla eva rujAkare vRuttatvAt | tIkShNapAnaM tIkShNamadyapAnaM; kiMvA, tIkShNaM maricAdi| vadhyete iva vadhyete, atyarthapIDAyuktatvena||15-21||
shItaM suShUyate shItamicchati||22-23||
svapnasukhamanucitadivAsvapnena j~jeyam| suptamiva suptaM, prabodharahitatvena| bhArAkrAntamiva bhArikam||24-26||
athAtastrishothIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

ayaM tvatra visheShaH- shItarUkShalaghuvishadashramopavAsAtikarshanakShapaNAdibhirvAyuH prakupitastva~gmAMsashoNitAdInyabhibhUya shophaM janayati; sa kShiprotthAnaprashamo bhavati, tathA shyAmAruNavarNaH prakRutivarNo vA, calaH spandanaH kharaparuShabhinnatvagromA chidyata iva bhidyata iva pIDyata iva sUcIbhiriva tudyate pipIlikAbhiriva saMsRupyate sarShapakalkAvalipta iva cimicimAyate sa~gkucyata Ayamyata iveti vAtashothaH (1); uShNatIkShNakaTukakShAralavaNAmlAjIrNabhojanairagnyAtapapratApaishca pittaM prakupitaM tva~gmAMsashoNitAnyabhibhUya shothaM janayati; sa kShiprotthAnaprashamo bhavati, kRuShNapItanIlatAmrAvabhAsa uShNo mRuduH kapilatAmraromA uShyate dUyate dhUpyate UShmAyate svidyate klidyate na ca sparshamuShNaM ca suShUyata iti pittashothaH (2); gurumadhurashItasnigdhairatisvapnAvyAyAmAdibhishca shleShmA prakupitastva~gmAMsashoNitAdInyabhibhUya shothaM janayati; sa kRucchrotthAnaprashamo bhavati, pANDushvetAvabhAso guruH snigdhaH shlakShNaH sthiraH styAnaH shuklAgraromA sparshoShNasahashceti shleShmashothaH (3); yathAsvakAraNAkRutisaMsargAddvidoShajAstrayaH shothA bhavanti; yathAsvakAraNAkRutisannipAtAt sAnnipAtika ekaH; evaM saptavidho bhedaH||7||
prakRutibhistAbhistAbhirbhidyamAno dvividhastrividhashcaturvidhaH saptavidho~aShTavidhashca shotha upalabhyate, punashcaika evotsedhasAmAnyAt||8||
bhavanti cAtra- shUyante yasya gAtrANi svapantIva rujanti ca| pIDitAnyunnamantyAshu vAtashothaM tamAdishet||9||
yashcApyaruNavarNAbhaH shotho naktaM praNashyati| snehoShNamardanAbhyAM ca praNashyet sa ca vAtikaH||10||
yaH pipAsAjvarArtasya dUyate~atha vidahyate| svidyati klidyate gandhI sa paittaH svayathuH smRutaH||11||
yaH pItanetravaktratvak pUrvaM madhyAt prashUyate| tanutvak cAtisArI ca pittashothaH sa ucyate||12||
shItaH saktagatiryastu kaNDUmAn pANDureva ca| nipIDito nonnamati shvayathuH sa kaphAtmakaH||13||
yasya shastrakushacchinnAcchoNitaM na pravartate| kRucchreNa picchA sravati sa cApi kaphasambhavaH||14||
nidAnAkRutisaMsargAcchvayathuH syAddvidoShajaH| sarvAkRutiH sannipAtAcchotho vyAmishrahetujaH||15||
yastu pAdAbhinirvRuttaH shothaH sarvA~ggago bhavet| jantoH sa ca sukaShTaH syAt prasRutaH strImukhAcca yaH||16||
yashcApi guhyaprabhavaH striyA vA puruShasya vA| sa ca kaShTatamo j~jeyo yasya ca syurupadravAH||17||

chardiH shvAso~arucistRuShNA jvaro~atIsAra eva ca| saptako~ayaM sadaurbalyaH shophopadravasa~ggrahaH||18||

Commentary: uktAnupadravAnAha- chardirityAdi||18||
yasya shleShmA prakupito jihvAmUle~avatiShThate| Ashu sa~jjanayecchothaM jAyate~asyopajihvikA||19||
yasya shleShmA prakupitaH kAkale vyavatiShThate| Ashu sa~jjanayecchophaM karoti galashuNDikAm||20||
yasya shleShmA prakupito galabAhye~avatiShThate| shanaiH sa~jjanayecchophaM galagaNDo~asya jAyate||21||
yasya shleShmA prakupitastiShThatyantargale sthiraH| Ashu sa~jjanayecchophaM jAyate~asya galagrahaH||22||
yasya pittaM prakupitaM saraktaM tvaci sarpati| shophaM sarAgaM janayedvisarpastasya jAyate||23||
yasya pittaM prakupitaM tvaci rakte~avatiShThate| shothaM sarAgaM janayet piDakA tasya jAyate||24||
yasya prakupitaM pittaM shoNitaM prApya shuShyati| tilakA piplavo vya~ggA nIlikA tasya jAyate||25||
yasya pittaM prakupitaM sha~gkhayoravatiShThate| shvayathuH sha~gkhako nAma dAruNastasya jAyate||26||
yasya pittaM prakupitaM karNamUle~avatiShThate| jvarAnte durjayo~antAya shothastasyopajAyate||27||
vAtaH plIhAnamuddhUya kupito yasya tiShThati| shanaiH paritudan pArshvaM plIhA tasyAbhivardhate||28||
yasya vAyuH prakupito gulmasthAne~avatiShThate| shophaM sashUlaM janayan gulmastasyopajAyate||29||
yasya vAyuH prakupitaH shophashUlakarashcaran| va~gkShaNAdvRuShaNau yAti vRuddhistasyopajAyate||30||
yasya vAtaH prakupitastva~gmAMsAntaramAshritaH| shothaM sa~jjanayet kukShAvudaraM tasya jAyate||31||
yasya vAtaH prakupitaH kukShimAshritya tiShThati| nAdho vrajati nApyUrdhvamAnAhastasya jAyate||32||
rogAshcotsedhasAmAnyadadhimAMsArbudAdayaH| vishiShTA nAmarUpAbhyAM nirdeshyAH shothasa~ggrahe||33||
vAtapittakaphA yasya yugapat kupitAstrayaH| jihvAmUle~avatiShThante vidahantaH samucchritAH||34||
janayanti bhRushaM shothaM vedanAshca pRuthagvidhAH| taM shIghrakAriNaM rogaM rohiNIti vinirdishet||35||
trirAtraM paramaM tasya jantorbhavati jIvitam| kushalena tvanukrAntaH kShipraM sampadyate sukhI||36||
santi hyevaMvidhA rogAH sAdhyA dAruNasammatAH| ye hanyuranupakrAntA mithyAcAreNa vA punaH||37||
sAdhyAshcApyapare santi vyAdhayo mRudusammatAH| yatnAyatnakRutaM yeShu karma sidhyatyasaMshayam||38||
asAdhyAshcApare santi vyAdhayo yApyasa~jj~jitAH| susAdhvapi kRutaM yeShu karma yAtrAkaraM bhavet||39||
santi cApyapare rogA yeShu karma na sidhyati| api yatnakRutaM bAlairna tAn vidvAnupAcaret||40||
sAdhyAshcaivApyasAdhyAshca vyAdhayo dvividhAH smRutAH| mRududAruNabhedena te bhavanti caturvidhAH||41||
ta evAparisa~gkhyeyA bhidyamAnA bhavanti hi| rujAvarNasamutthAnasthAnasaMsthAnanAmabhiH ||42||
vyavasthAkaraNaM teShAM yathAsthUleShu sa~ggrahaH| tathA prakRutisAmAnyaM vikAreShUpadishyate||43||
vikAranAmAkushalo na jihrIyAt kadAcana| na hi sarvavikArANAM nAmato~asti dhruvA sthitiH||44||
sa eva kupito doShaH samutthAnavisheShataH| sthAnAntaragatashcaiva janayatyAmayAn bahUn ||45||
tasmAdvikAraprakRutIradhiShThAnAntarANi ca| samutthAnavisheShAMshca buddhvA karma samAcaret||46||
yo hyetattritayaM j~jAtvA karmANyArabhate bhiShak| j~jAnapUrvaM yathAnyAyaM sa karmasu na muhyati||47||

nityAH prANabhRutAM dehe vAtapittakaphAstrayaH| vikRutAH prakRutisthA vA tAn bubhutseta paNDitaH||48||

Commentary: samprati vAtAdij~jAnena rogaj~jAnamuddiShTaM tenopoddhAtena vAtAdInAM prakRutisthAnAmaprakRutisthAnAM ca lakShaNaM vaktumAha- nityA ityAdi| bubhutseta j~jAtumicchet||48||
utsAhocchvAsaniH shvAsaceShTA dhAtugatiH samA| samo mokSho gatimatAM vAyoH karmAvikArajam||49||
darshanaM paktirUShmA ca kShuttRuShNA dehamArdavam| prabhA prasAdo medhA ca pittakarmAvikArajam||50||
sneho bandhaH sthiratvaM ca gauravaM vRuShatA balam| kShamA dhRutiralobhashca kaphakarmAvikArajam||51||

vAte pitte kaphe caiva kShINe lakShaNamucyate| karmaNaH prAkRutAddhAnirvRuddhirvA~api virodhinAm||52||

Commentary: kShayalakShaNamAha- vAte ityAdi| karmaNaH prAkRutAditi vAtAdiprakRutikarmatvenoktAdutsAhAdeH| hAniH apacayaH| vRuddhirvA~api virodhinAmiti uktaprAkRutalakShaNavirodhinAM karmaNAM vRuddhiH; yathA vAtakShaye utsAhavirodhino viShAdasya vRuddhiH, pittakShaye~adarshanApaktyAdInAM, shleShmakShaye raukShyAdInAM vRuddhiH| iha prAkRutakarmahAnau satyAM nAvashyaM virodhikarmavRuddhirata uktaM- vRuddhirvetyAdi; na hyavashyamutsAhahAnAvalpamAtrAyAM satyAM viShAdo vardhate, alobhanyUnatve vA manAglobho vardhate; kiMvA, utsAhAdyabhAvenAbhAvamukhena j~jAnArthaM ‘karmaNaH prAkRutAddhAniH’ ityuktaM, viShAdAdivRuddhyA tu vidhimukhena j~jAnArthaM ‘vRuddhirvA~api virodhinAm’ ityuktam| yaducyate- vRuddhirvA~api virodhinAmiti virodhidoShANAM, yathA- pittavRuddhau shleShmakShayo jAyate, ityevamAdi; tanna, yato~anyadoShavRuddhAvanyasyAvashyaM na hyapAyo bhavati, tathAhi sati pittavRuddhau satyAM sarvadA shleShmakShyaH syAt; na ca doShAH parasparaghAtakA iti prAgeva pratipAditaM; pradeshAntare~api doShANAM svalakShaNahAnireva paraM kShayalakShaNaM- “kShINA jahati li~ggaM svaM” (sU.a.17) ityanenoktam||52||

doShaprakRutivaisheShyaM niyataM vRuddhilakShaNam| doShANAM prakRutirhAnirvRuddhishcaivaM parIkShyate||53||

Commentary: vRuddhilakShaNamAha- doShetyAdi| prakRutiH svabhAvaH, tasya vaisheShyamAdhikyaM; shleShmaNaH snehashaityamAdhuryAdiryA prakRutistasyA atisnigdhAtishaityAtimAdhuryAdivaisheShyaM vRuddhilakShaNam| niyatamiti pratiniyataM, yadyasya prakRutilakShaNaM tadvRuddhaM saptasyaiva vRuddhilakShaNamityarthaH; anye tu nishcitamityAhuH||53||
tatra shlokAH- sa~gkhyAM nimittaM rUpANi shothAnAM sAdhyatAM na ca| teShAM teShAM vikArANAM shothAMstAMstAMshca pUrvajAn||54||
vidhibhedaM vikArANAM trividhaM bodhyasa~ggraham| prAkRutaM karma doShANAM lakShaNaM hAnivRuddhiShu||55||
vItamoharajodoShalobhamAnamadaspRuhaH| vyAkhyAtavAMstrishothIye rogAdhyAye punarvasuH||56||

trayaH shothA bhavanti vAtapittashleShmanimittAH, te punardvividhA nijAgantubhedena||3||

Commentary: vakShyamANadvividhAdibhede vidyamAne~api vAtAdikRutatritvAbhidhAnamagre vAtAdikRutasyaiva prAdhAnyakhyApanArtham||3||

tatrAgantavashchedanabhedanakShaNanabha~jjanapicchanotpeShaNaprahAravadhabandhanaveShTanavyadhanapIDanAdibhirvA bhallAtakapuShpaphalarasAtmaguptAshUkakrimishUkAhitapatralatAgulmasaMsparshanairvA svedanaparisarpaNAvamUtraNairvA viShiNAM saviShaprANidaMShTrAdantaviShANanakhanipAtairvA sAgaraviShavAtahimadahanasaMsparshanairvA shothAH samupajAyante||4||

Commentary: bhedanam AshayavidAraNaM, kShaNanam asthicUrNanaM, bha~jjanaM jarjarIkaraNaM, picchnam atyarthapIDanam, utpeShaNaM shilotpeShaNamiva, veShTanam agranthibandhanaM sarpAdibhiH| shUkavatAM krimINAM shUkaH shUkakrimishUkaH| svedanAdibhirviShiNAmiti yojyam||4||

te punaryathAsvaM hetuvya~jjanairAdAvupalabhyante nijavya~jjanaikadeshaviparItaiH; bandhamantrAgadapralepapratApanirvApaNAdibhishcopakramairupakramyamANAH prashAntimApadyante||5||

Commentary: AdAvupalabhyanta iti vacanAduttarakAlamAgantorapi nijatulyatAM brUte| yaduktam- “Aganturanveti nijaM vikAraM” (sU.a.19) iti| nijavya~jjanaikadeshaviparItairiti nijalakShaNebhya AgantUnAmekadesho viparIto bhavati, sa ca vAtAdijanyashyAvAdivarNavikAratvAjj~jeyaH; kiMvA AganturvyathApUrvo bhavati pashcAdvAtAdibhiranubadhyate, nijastu pUrvaM vAtAdilakShaNairyujyate pashcAdvedanAvAn bhavatItyekadeshavaiparItyam| bandhaH ariShTAbandho vraNabandhashca| bandhAdayashca yathAyogyatayA boddhavyAH||5||

nijAH punaH snehasvedavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanashirovirecanAnAmayathAvatprayogAnmithyAsaMsarjanAdvA chardyalasakavisUcikAshvAsakAsAtisArashoShapANDurogodarajvarapradarabhagandarArshovikArAtikarshanairvA kuShThakaNDUpiDakAdibhirvA chardikShavathUdgArashukravAtamUtrapurIShavegadhAraNairvA karmarogopavAsAdhvakarshitasya vA sahasA~atigurvamlalavaNapiShTAnnaphalashAkarAgadadhiharitakamadyamandakavirUDhanavashUkashamIdhAnyAnUpaudaka- pishitopayogAnmRutpa~gkaloShTabhakShaNAllavaNAtibhakShaNAdgarbhasampIDanAdAmagarbhaprapatanAt prajAtAnAM ca mithyopacArAdudIrNadoShatvAcca shophAH prAdurbhavanti; ityuktaH sAmAnyo hetuH||6||

Commentary: chardyAdayaH svarUpata eva shothahetavaH| karmAdyatikarshitasya tu sahasA~atigurvAdisevanaM shothahetuH; karmeti pa~jcakarma| virUDhanavashabdau shUkashamIdhAnyavisheShaNau| prajAtAnAmiti aciraprasUtAnAm||6||
pUrvAdhyAye piDakA uktAH, tAshca shotharUpAH, ataH shothAdhikArAt trishothIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

kShapaNaM vamanAdibhiH| prakRutivarNaH dehasamAnavarNaH| calaH sa~gkramaNavAn| spandanaH kampanaH| uShyate pArshvastheneva vahninA dahyate| dhUpyate dhUmamivodvamati| UShmAyate bahiH parairapyuShNatvenopalabhyate| svidyate svedavAn bhavati| na suShUyate na sahate; sparshanaM ca na sahate, uShNaM ca na sahate| sa kRucchrotthAnaprashama iti cirotthAnaprashamaH| prakRutibhiriti kAraNaiH| utsedha unnatatvam||7-8||

shUyanta ityAdi| punaH shlokena lakShaNAbhidhAnaM prAyobhAvilakShaNadarshanArtham| svapantIveti nirvedanaH| etena vAyoshcalatvena kShaNAcca ruk, kShaNAcca tadabhAva iti j~jeyam| madhyAditi sharIramadhyAt| saktagatiH avisArI| shastrakushacchinnAditi shastrakushakRutAcchedAt||9-15||

pAdAbhinirvRuttaH shothaH puruShANAM laghAvadhodeshe jAtaH san yadA na jIyate tadA gurumUrdhvadeshaM gataH sa na pAryate jetuM, yo hi laghau pradeshe jetuM na pAryate sa gurupradeshagato nitarAmeva na pAryate; evaM prasRutaH strImukhAcca ya ityapi j~jeyam| vacanaM hi- “adhobhAgo guruH strINAmUrdhvaH puMsAM gurustathA” (su.sU.a.46) iti||16-17||

sampratyutsedhasAmAnyAt prAdeshikA~jchothAnAha- yasyetyAdi| kAkalaM tAlumUlam| shanairitivacanena galagaNDakAriNo doShAshcirakriyA bhavantIti darshayati; galagrahAdau cAshukAriNo doShA bhavanti| visarpasya piDakAyAshca tulyakAraNatve~api visarpe sarpaNashIlo doShaH, piDakAyAM ca sthiro j~jeyaH; ata eva piDakAsamprAptau ‘avatiShThate’ ityuktam| yasya pittamityAdau pittaM prApya shoNitaM kartRu shuShyatIti yojanIyam| piplavaH ‘jaTulA’ iti prasiddhaH| dAruNaH anupakramAdAshumArakaH| durjayo~antAyeti durjayo vA yathAkramamupakramyamANaH , antAya vA mithyopakramAdveti mantavyam| ayameva shotho~anyatrApyuktaH- “sannipAtajvarasyAnte karNamUle sudAruNAH| shothaH sa~jjAyate tena kashcideva pramucyate” iti| gulmAdayo vistaravaktavyA api ihotsedhasAmAnyAlleshata ucyante| shothasa~ggraha iti shothatvenotsedharUpeNa sa~ggrahaH shothasa~ggrahaH|| samucchritA atiriktapramANAH| bhRusham atyarthaduHkhakAriNam| kShipramityanukrAnta ityanena sambadhyate, tena trirAtraghAtitvaM yasya tasya kathaM shIghraprashama iti codyaM nottiShThate; kiMvA kShipraM sampadyate sukhIti vyAdhimahimnA bhavati| vyAdherevaitat svarUpaM yacchIghraM hanti, shIghraM prashAmyatIti| yaduktaM- “sa shIghraM shIghrakAritvAt prashamaM yAti hanti vA” (ci. 3) iti||19-36||

etadeva shIghrakAritvamanyeShvapi jvarAntakarNashothavalayAdiShvastItyAha- santItyAdi| dAruNA iti sammatA dAruNasammatAH| dAruNatvaprasa~ggena mRudvAdibhedAnapyAha- sAdhyAshcetyAdi| yAtrAkaraM yApanAkaram| bAlaiH aj~jaiH, asAdhye aj~jA evotsAhAt pravartanta ityarthaH| asAdhyasya mRududAruNatvaM yApyapratyAkhyeyabhedena, tathA sadyaHprANaharakAlAntaraprANaharatvAdinA ca||37-41||

ta evetyAdi| samutthAnabhedA hetubhedAH; rUkShabhojanarAtrijAgaraNAdibhinnahetujanyo hi vAto bhinnopakramasAdhyashca bhavatIti bhAvaH| sthAnabhedA AmAshayAdayo rasAdayashca| saMsthAnam AkRutiH, yathA- gulmArbudAdiH| nAmabhedo yathA- ekasminneva rAjayakShmaNi rAjayakShmashoShAdisa~jj~jA| nanvevamaparisa~gkhyeyatve kathaM vyavahAra ityAha- vyavasthetyAdi| vyavasthAkaraNaM cikitsAvyavahArArthaM sa~gkhyAkathanam| yathAsthUleShviti ye ye sthUlA udaramUtrakRucchrAdayasteShu; sa~ggrahaH aShTodarIyarogasa~ggrahe (udishyate) ityarthaH| asthUleShu vikAreShu aShTodarIye sa~jj~jayA~anukteShu kathaM vyavasthAkaraNamityAha- tathetyAdi| prakRutisAmAnyaM samAnakAraNatA; tenAnukteShu sAkShAddhyAdhiShu vAtajo~ayaM shleShmajo~ayamiti, tathA rasajo~ayaM raktajo~ayamityAdikA cikitsAvyavahArArthaM vyavasthA kartavyeti bhAvaH| ata evAShTodarIye vakShyati- “sarve vikArA vAtapittakaphAnnAtivartante” (sU. 19) iti||42-43||

jvararaktapittAdivannAmAj~jAne~api vAtAdijanyatvaj~jAnenaiva pracaritavyamityAha- vikAretyAdi| sthAnAntaragatashcetyatra cakAra ekasthAnagato~api bahuvikAraM karotIti samuccinoti| yato vakShyati- “karoti galamAshritaH| kaNThoddhvaMsaM ca kAsaM ca svarabhedamarocakam” (ci. 8) iti| adhiShThAnAntarANi AshayAntarANi| j~jAnapUrvamiti cikitsAj~jAnapUrvakam| yathAnyAyaM yathAgamam| evaM manyate- yadvAtArabdhatvAdij~jAnameva kAraNaM rogANAM cikitsAyAmupakAri, nAmaj~jAnaM tu vyavahAramAtraprayojanArthaM na svarUpeNa cikitsAyAmupakArIti||44-47||

ceShTeti avikRutA ceShTA| dhAtugatiriti rasAdInAM poShyaM dhAtuM prati gamanam| gatimatAmiti purIShAdInAM bahirniHsaratAm| prasAdaH manaHprasAdaH| bandhaH sandhibandhaH| sthiratvam ashaithilyam| gauravaM prAkRutaM sharIragauravam| kShamA sahiShNutA| dhRutiH manaso~acA~jcalyam| kShamAdayashca shleShmaNaH prabhAvAt kriyante; evamanyatrApi j~jeyam||49-51||

sa~ggrahe shothAnAM sAdhyatAmiti bheShajavisheShasAdhyatvam, upashaya ityarthaH; tacca ‘snehauShNyamardanAbhyAM ca praNashyet sa ca vAtika’ ityuktaM j~jeyam| na ceti na ca sAdhyatAM, yathA- ‘yashca pAdAbhinirvRuttaH’ ityAdi| teShAM teShAmiti upajihvAdInAm| shothAn pUrvajAnityabhidadhAna upajihvAdiShu pUrvaM shotho bhavati, pashcAdupajihvAdirogavyaktiriti darshayati| ata eva ‘Ashu sa~jjanayecchothaM’ ityuktvA ‘jAyate~asyopajihvikA’ ityuktam| bodhyaH boddhavyo vikAraprakRutyAdiH| tasya trividhaM sa~ggrahamiti ‘tasmAdvikAraprakRutIH’ ityAdyuktaM trayam||54-56||
athAto~aShTodarIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

etAni yathoddeshamabhinirdekShyAmaH- aShTAvudarANIti vAtapittakaphasannipAtaplIhabaddhacchidradakodarANi, aShTau mUtrAghAtA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtAshmarIsharkarAshukrashoNitajAH, aShTau kShIradoShA iti vaivarNyaM vaigandhyaM vairasyaM paicchilyaM phenasa~gghAto raukShyaM gauravamatisnehashca, aShTau retodoShA iti tanu shuShkaM phenilamashvetaM pUtyatipicchalamanyadhAtUpahitamavasAdi ca (1); sapta kuShThAnIti kapAlodumbaramaNDalarShyajihvapuNDarIkasidhmakAkaNAni, sapta piDakA iti sharAvikA kacchapikA jAlinI sarShapyalajI vinatA vidradhI ca, sapta visarpA iti vAtapittakaphAgnikardamakagranthisannipAtAkhyAH (2); ShaDatIsArA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtabhayashokajAH, ShaDudAvartA iti vAtamUtrapurIShashukracchardikShavathujAH (3); pa~jca gulmA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtashoNitajAH, pa~jca plIhadoShA iti gulmairvyAkhyAtAH, pa~jca kAsA iti vAtapittakaphakShatakShayajAH, pa~jca shvAsA iti mahordhvacchinnatamakakShudrAH, pa~jca hikkA iti mahatI gambhIrA vyapetA kShudrA~annajA ca, pa~jca tRuShNA iti vAtapittAmakShayopasargAtmikAH, pa~jca chardaya iti dviShTArthasaMyogajA vAtapittakaphasannipAtodrekotthAshca , pa~jca bhaktasyAnashanasthAnAnIti vAtapittakaphasannipAtadveShAH, pa~jca shirorogA iti pUrvoddeshamabhisamasya vAtapittakaphasannipAtakrimijAH, pa~jca hRudrogA iti shirorogairvyAkhyAtAH, pa~jca pANDurogA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtamRudbhakShaNajAH, pa~jconmAdA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtAgantunimittAH (4); catvAro~apasmArA iti vAtapittakaphasannipAtanimittAH, catvAro~akShirogAshcatvAraH karNarogAshcatvAraH pratishyAyAshcatvAro mukharogAshcatvAro grahaNIdoShAshcatvAro madAshcatvAro mUrcchAyA ityapasmArairvyAkhyAtAH, catvAraH shoShA iti sAhasasandhAraNakShayaviShamAshanajAH, catvAri klaibyAnIti bIjopaghAtAddhvajabha~ggAjjarAyAH shukrakShayAcca (5); trayaH shothA iti vAtapittashleShmanimittAH, trINi kilAsAnIti raktatAmrashuklAni, trividhaM lohitapittamiti UrdhvabhAgamadhobhAgamubhayabhAgaM ca (6); dvau jvarAviti uShNAbhiprAyaH shItasamutthashca shItAbhiprAyashcoShNasamutthaH, dvau vraNAviti nijashcAgantujashca, dvAvAyAmAviti bAhyashcAbhyantarashca, dve gRudhrasyAviti vAtAdvAtakaphAcca, dve kAmale iti koShThAshrayA shAkhAshrayA ca, dvividhamAmamiti alasako visUcikA ca, dvividhaM vAtaraktamiti gambhIramuttAnaM ca, dvividhAnyarshAMsIti shuShkANyArdrANi ca (7); eka Urustambha ityAmatridoShasamutthaH, ekaH sannyAsa iti tridoShAtmako manaHsharIrAdhiShThAnaH, eko mahAgada iti atattvAbhiniveshaH (8); viMshatiH krimijAtaya iti yUkA pipIlikAshceti dvividhA bahirmalajAH, keshAdA lomAdA lomadvIpAH saurasA audumbarA jantumAtarashceti ShaT shoNitajAH, antrAdA udarAveShTA hRudayAdAshcuravo darbhapuShpAH saugandhikA mahAgudAshceti sapta kaphajAH, kakerukA makerukA lelihAH sashUlakAH sausurAdAshceti pa~jca purIShajAH; viMshatiH pramehA ityudakamehashcekShubAlikArasamehashca sAndramehashca sAndraprasAdamehashca shuklamehashca shukramehashca shItamehashca shanairmehashca sikatAmehashca lAlAmehashceti dasha shleShmanimittAH, kShAramehashca kAlamehashca nIlamehashca lohitamehashca ma~jjiShThAmehashca haridrAmehashceti ShaT pittanimittAH, vasAmehashca majjAmehashca hastimehashca madhumehashceti catvAro vAtanimittAH, iti viMshatiH pramehAH; viMshatiryonivyApada iti vAtikI paittikI shleShmikI sAnnipAtikI ceti catasro doShajAH, doShadUShyasaMsargaprakRutinirdeshairavashiShTAH ShoDasha nirdishyante, tadyathA- raktayonishcArajaskA cAcaraNA cAticaraNA ca prAkcaraNA copaplutA ca pariplutA codAvartinI ca karNinI ca putraghnI cAntarmukhI ca sUcImukhI ca shuShkA ca vAminI ca ShaNDhayonishca mahAyonishceti viMshatiryonivyApado bhavanti (9); kevalashcAyamuddesho yathoddeshamabhinirdiShTo bhavati||4||

Commentary: ihaikAdi sa~gkhyAparityAgAdaShTasa~gkhyAgrahaNamAdau kRutam, aShTasa~gkhyAyA bahutvena prAdhAnyAt; viMshatisa~gkhyamehAdInAmUnaviMshatyAdyadhaHsa~gkhyAnupUrvIprAptyabhAvAnna kRutaH prathamaM niveshaH| yadyapi cikitsite~aShTAdasha kuShThAni, tathA~apIha mahAkuShThAbhiprAyeNa saptocyante| ShaDudAvartA ityatra navegAndhAraNIyoktanyAyenoccArAdinirodhajAdaya udAvartA ihocyante| gulmairvyAkhyAtA iti yathA gulmabhedAstathA plIhadoShAH| pa~jca tRuShNeti sambhojanasnehAdijanitAnAmapi vAtAdijAsvevAvarodhAt| sthAnamiva sthAnaM kAraNaM; tena, anashanasthAnAnyarocakAni; anena kAraNena kAryANyarocakAni lakShyante ; tena rogasa~ggrahe kAraNAbhidhAnamanyAyyamiti na bhavati| pUrvoddeshamabhisamasyeti kiyantaHshirasIye vistaroktAn sa~gkShipya; kiMvA kiyantaHshirasIya eva “ardhAvabhedako vA syAt” (sU. 17) ityAdyuddiShTAnabhisamasya parityajya shirasyeva rujArUpA ye pa~jca ta ucyante| ‘sAhasaM sandhAraNaM kShayo viShamAshanam’ iti pAThe kAraNena kAryaM caturvidhaH shoSha ucyate| dvau jvarAvityAdau shItasamutthatvenaivoShNAbhiprAyatA labdhA, yato nidAnaviparItamicchati jvarI; tadihoShNAbhiprAyatAvisheShaNaM shItartusamutthatvena paittikasyApi jvarasya shItasamutthatvanirAsArtham; evaM shItAbhiprAye~api vAcyam| dvividhamAmamiti AmaviShasya trividhakukShIye vakShyamANasyAlasaka evAntarbhAvAt; anye tvAmaviShasya viShatvenAnyaviShatantraviShayatvAdihAgrahaNamiti bruvate| atattvAbhinivesho mAnaso vikAraH, sa ca sarvasaMsAriduHkhahetutayA gada ityucyate| krimINAM sa~jj~jA prAyo rUDhA j~jAtavyA| pipIlikA likhyAH| doShasya dUShyeNa raktAdinA saMsargo doShadUShyasaMsargaH, prakRutiH kAraNam; tatra doShadUShyasaMsarganirdeshena raktayonyAdayaH, prakRutinirdeshena prAkcaraNAdayo yonivyApatticikitsitaM vIkShya vyAkartavyAH| atra madA eva madAtyayarUpatAM yAntIti kRutvA madAtyayAH pRutha~gnoktAH| iha coktAnAM rogANAM yadyapi prakArAntareNAnyathA~api sa~gkhyA bhavati; tathA hi- aShTau jvarAH, dvAvunmAdau nijAgantukabhedenetyAdi, tathA~api pradhAnavivakShayA eta eva bhedA gRuhItAH; prAdhAnyaM ca svAdhikAre rogANAmanusaraNIyam||4||

sarva eva nijA vikArA nAnyatra vAtapittakaphebhyo nirvartante, yathAhi- shakuniH sarvaM divasamapi paripatan svAM chAyAM nAtivartate, tathA svadhAtuvaiShamyanimittAH sarve vikArA vAtapittakaphAnnAtivartante| vAtapittashleShmaNAM punaH sthAnasaMsthAnaprakRutivisheShAnabhisamIkShya tadAtmakAnapi ca sarvavikArAM stAnevopadishanti buddhimantaH||5||

Commentary: sampratyaShTodarAdInAM tathA vakShyamANAnAM mahAroge tathA~anuktAnAmiha tantre rogANAM nijAnAM vAtapittashleShmANa eva vyastAH samastA vA kAraNaM bhavantItyetadrUpaM rogANAM cikitsopayogi sUtraM darshayitumAha- sarva ityAdi| sarva ityuktA anuktAshca| yadyapyAgantuShvapi doShasambandho na vyabhicarati, tathA~apyAgantau roge doShApekShayA na cikitsetyAgantuvyudAsArthaM nijA ityuktam| svashabdenAgantukRutaM dhAtuvaiShamyaM nirAkaroti| nanu, yadi vAtAdijanyA eva sarvavikArAstat kimarthamanyathA~apyudarAdayaH plIhajatvAdibhirnirdishyanta ityAha- vAtapittetyAdi| sthAnaM rasAdayo bastyAdayashca, saMsthAnam AkRutirlakShaNamiti yAvat, prakRutiH kAraNam, eShAM visheShAnabhisamIkShya tAMstAnupadishantIti ‘aShTAvudarANi’ ityevammAdyupadishanti| tadAtmakAnapIti vAtAdijanitAnapi| tatra, sthAnavisheShAdupadesho yathA- UrustambharaktayonikAmalAprabhRutayaH; saMsthAnavisheShAt piDakAgulmaprabhRutayaH; prakRutivisheShAcchleShmaplIhodaraprabhRutayaH| anye tu vyAkhyAnayanti- yatastAneveti vAtAdijAneveti vyapadishanti; tadAtmakAnapIti yathoktAShTAdisa~gkhyAyuktAnapi| yadyapi plIhAdikAraNAntareNa bhinnA api rogAstathA~api vAtAdisthAnajanyatvena tathA vAtAdilakShaNayuktatvena tathA vAtAdikAraNajAtatvena vAtAdijA eva sarvavikArA iti vAkyArthaH||5||

bhavatashcAtra- svadhAtuvaiShamyanimittajA ye vikArasa~gghA bahavaH sharIre| na te pRuthak pittakaphAnilebhya Agantavastveva tato vishiShTAH||6||

Commentary: amumevArthaM shlokenAha- svadhAtvityAdi| svashabdo~agre vakShyamANasharIrApekShaH; tena sharIradhAtuvaiShamyaM gRuhyate, mAnasaM tu pratikShipyate| dhAtavashca na svarUpeNa rogakAraNamiti vaiShamyapadaM kRutam| Agantavo hi rogA abhighAtajvarAdayo dhAtuvaiShamyajA bhavanti, atastahyudAsArthaM nimittapadam; AgantuShu vaiShamyaM vidyamAnamapi kAraNatvena na vyapadishyate, apradhAnatvAt; kintvAgantureva laguDAdiprahArastatra cikitsAvisheShaprayojakaH kAraNaM, nije tu vaiShamyameva cikitsAprayojakam| nimittajA iti ca svadhAtuvaiShamyapadasya karmadhArayatvena, bahuvrIhipakShe tvanarthakameva syAt| vikArasa~gghA iti ‘aShTAvudarANi’ ityAdayaH| bahuvacanenaiva bahutve labdhe punaH ‘bahavaH’ iti vacanaM bahuvacanasya tritvamAtreNaiva caritArthatvaniShedhArtham| na te pittakaphAnilebhyaH pRuthagiti pittakaphAnilA eva te dUShyAdivisheShabhAja ityarthaH| iha pittamAdau kRutaM chando~anurodhAt; kiMvA prAdhAnyAniyamaj~jApanArthaM kRutam| atra ca dhAtuvaiShamyamAtraM vikAro noktaH, tasya vAtAdivaiShamyarUpatvena siddhatvAdeva; yastu dhAtuvaiShamyavisheSho dhAtuvaiShamyajAto jvarAdirUpaH, sa iha shiShyaM prati vikRutavAtAdyabhedena pratipAdyate| tata iti pUrvoktavikArasa~gghAt| vishiShTA iti pittakaphAnilavyatiriktAH||6||

Aganturanveti nijaM vikAraM nijastathA~a~agantumapi pravRuddhaH| tatrAnubandhaM prakRutiM ca samyag j~jAtvA tataH karma samArabheta||7||

Commentary: samprati bhinnayornijAgantvoH sambandhamAha- AganturityAdi| nijaM prathamasamutpannaM vikAramAganturbhUtAdijanyo vikAraH anveti anugato bhavati, yathA- doShaja eva jvare unmAde vA pashcAdbhUtanivesho~api bhavati; tathA~a~agantumutpannamabhighAtajaM jvaraM bhUtajaM conmAdaM pashcAddhetumAsAdya nijo~api tatra doShalakShaNalakShito gado bhavati| ‘api pravRuddhaH’ iti vacanena AgantvavasthAyAmapi nijadoSho vRuddho~astyeva, paraM pravRuddho~asau na bhavati svalakShaNAkartRutveneti darshayati| apishabdena nijasya nijena tathA~agantorapyAgantunA~anubandhaH sUcyate| atra nijAgantvoranubandhe kAryamAhatatretyAdi| anubandhaH pashcAtkAlajAtaH| prakRutiH mUlabhUtaH| samyagj~jAtveti balavattvAbalavattvAdinA; kiMvA, anubandhaH apradhAnaH; prakRutiH anubandhyaH pradhAnamityarthaH| yaduktaM- “svatantro vyaktali~ggo yathoktasamutthAnaprashamo bhavatyanubandhyaH, ato viparItastvanubandhaH” (vi. 6) iti||7||
tatra shlokau- viMshakAshcaikakAshcaiva trikAshcoktAstrayastrayaH| dvikAshcAShTau, catuShkAshca dasha, dvAdasha pa~jcakAH||8||
catvArashcAShTakA vargAH, ShaTkau dvau, saptakAstrayaH| aShTodarIye rogANAM rogAdhyAye prakAshitAH||9||

pUrvAdhyAye proktaM “vyavasthAkaraNaM teShAM yathAsthUleShu sa~ggrahaH” (sU. 18) iti, tadanu jij~jAsAyAmaShTAvudarANItyAdiM yathAsthUlaM sa~ggraho~abhidhIyate| aShTodarIya iti cArthaparA sa~jj~jA||1-2||

(kaTvamlalavaNAH pittaM, svAdvamlalavaNAH kapham| kaTutiktakaShAyAshca kopayanti samIraNam ||1||)

Commentary: iha hi dharmArthakAmamokShaparipanthirogopashamAya brahmaprabhRutibhiH praNItAyurvedatantreShvativistaratvena samprati vartamAnAlpAyurmedhasAM puruShANAM na samyagarthAdhigamaH, tadanadhigamAcca tadvihitArthAnAmananuShThAne tathaivopaplavo rujAmiti manvAnaH paramakAruNiko~atrabhavAnagnivesho~alpAyurmedhasAmapi sukhopalambhArthaM nAtisa~gkShepavistaraM kAyacikitsApradhAnamAyurvedatantraM praNetumArabdhavAn| tasmiMshca shlokanidAnavimAnashArIrendriyacikitsitakalpasiddhisthAnAtmake~abhidhAtavye nikhilatantrapradhAnArthAbhidhAyakatayA shlokasthAnamevAgre vaktavyamamanyata| vakShyati hi- “shlokasthAnaM samuddiShTaM tantrasyAsya shiraH shubham| catuShkANAM mahArthAnAM sthAne~asmin sa~ggrahaH kRutaH” (sU. a.30) iti| tatra ca sUtrasthAne~apyutpannarogagrahaNe tvarayA rogopaghAtibheShajAbhidhAyicatuShke~abhidhAtavye nikhilatantrabIjabhUtahetuli~ggauShadhAdyarthasya tathA tantrapravRuttya~ggaprayojanavadAyurvedAgamAderabhidhAyakaM dIrgha~jjIvitIyamadhyAyamabhidhAtumArabdhavAn| shrotRujanapravRuttihetvabhidheyaprayojanasambandhopadarshakaM shrotRubuddhisamAdhAnAya vyAkhyAnapratij~jAparamaShTapadamaShTasa~gkhyAyA ma~ggalatvenAdau sUtraM niveshitavAn- athAto dIrgha~jjIvitIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAma iti| yato nirabhidheye kacaTatapAdau sAbhidheye vA niShprayojane kAkadantaparIkShAdau prekShAvatAM pravRuttirnopalabhyate, tenAdAvabhidheyaprayojane abhidhAtavye| yaduktaM- “abhidheyaphalaj~jAnavirahastimitodyamAH| shrotumalpamapi granthaM nAdriyante hi sAdhavaH” iti| abhidheyavattvaprayojanavattvanirvAhArthaM cAbhidheyashAstrayorabhidhAnAbhidheyalakShaNaH sambandhaH, prayojanashAstrayoshca sAdhyasAdhanabhAvalakShaNo~abhidhAtavyaH| tatrehAbhidheyaM hitAhitAdirUpeNAyuH| vakShyati hi- “hitAhitaM sukhaM duHkhamAyustasya hitAhitam| mAnaM ca tacca yatroktamAyurvedaH sa ucyate” (sU. a.30) iti| atra ca sarvAbhidheyAvarodho yathAsthAnameva vyAkaraNIyaH| prayojanaM ca dhAtusAmyam| yathoktaM- “dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam” (sU. a.1) iti| sambandho~apyAyuHshAstrayorabhidhAnAbhidheyalakShaNaH, prayojanena ca dhAtusAmyena samamasya shAstrasya heyopAdeyaj~jAnAvAntaravyApArasya sAdhyasAdhanabhAvalakShaNaH| tadetatsarvaM dIrgha~jjIvitIyamityanena padena dIrgha~jjIvitashabdamadhikRutya kRutaprayojanAbhidhAyaka ‘dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA’ ityAdivAkyAbhidhAyakena darshitaM mantavyam| nanu, prayojanAbhidhAnaM shAstrapravRuttyarthamiti yaduktaM tanna yuktaM, yato na prayojanAbhidhAnamAtreNa prayojanavattAvadhAraNaM, vipralambhakasaMsAramocanapratipAdakAdishAstreShu prayojanAbhidhAne~api niShprayojanatvadarshanAt| atha manyase, AptaprayojanAbhidhAnametadato~atra yathArthatvaM; nanu bho kathamayaM prayojanAbhidhAyI AptaH? tadabhihitashAstrasya yathArthatvAditi cet, hanta na yAvacchAstrasya prayojanavattvAvadhAraNaM na tAvacchAstrapravRuttiH, na yAvacchAstrapravRuttirna tAvacchAstrasya yathArthatvAvadhAraNaM, na yAvacchAstrasya yathArthatvAvadhAraNaM na tAvacchAstrasya karturAptatvamavadhAryate, AptatvAnavadhRutau ca kutastadabhihitaprayojanavattAvadhAraNamiti cakrakamApadyate ; atha manyase, mA bhavatu prayojanavattAvadhAraNam, artharUpaprayojanavattAsandeha eva pravartako bhaviShyati, kRuShyAdAvapi hi pravRuttirarthasandehAdeva; nahi tatra kRuShIvalAnAM phalalAbhAvadhAraNaM vidyate, antarA~avagrahAderapi sambhAvyamAnatvAt; nanvevamasatyapi prayojanAbhidhAne saprayojananiShprayojanashAstradarshanAcchAstratvameva prayojanavattAsandehopadarshakamastu, tathA~apyalaM prayojanAbhidhAnena| naivaM, nahi sAmAnyena prayojanasandehaH prayojanavisheShArthinaM tathA pravartayati yathA~abhipretaprayojanavisheShaviShayaH sandehaH; abhipretavisheShaviShayashca sandeho na visheShaviShayasmaraNamantarA bhavati, ato ye tAvadanavadhRutAgniveshaprAmANyAsteShAM dhAtusAmyasAdhanamidaM shAstraM na vetyevamAkAravisheShasandehotpAdanArthaM prayojanavisheShAbhidhAnaM; ye punaH paramarSheragniveshasyAdyata evAvadhRutaprAmANyAsteShAM tadabhihitaprayojanavattAvadhAraNenaiva pravRuttiriti yuktaM prayojanAbhidhAnam| prayojanAbhidhAyivAkye tu svalpaprayatnabodhye prayojanasAmAnyasandehAdeva pravRuttirupapannA, na punaranekasaMvatsarakleshabodhye shAstre| tadevaM yaducyate- ‘prayojanAbhidhAyivAkyapravRuttAvapi prayojanamabhidhAtavyaM, tathA cAnavasthA’ iti, tannirastaM bhavati| athetyAdisUtre~athashabdo brahmAdipraNItatantreShvalpAyurmedhasAmarthAnavadhAraNasya, tathA~abhIShTadevatAnamaskArashAstrakaraNArthagurvAj~jAlAbhayorAnantarye prayukto~api shAstrAdau svarUpeNa ma~ggalaM bhavatyudakAharaNapravRuttodakumbhadarshanamiva prasthitAnAm| granthAdau ma~ggalasevAnirastAntarAyANAM granthakartRushrotRUNAmavighneneShTalAbho bhavatIti yuktaM ma~ggalopAdAnam| athashabdasya ma~ggalatve smRutiH- “o~gkArashcAthashabdashca dvAvetau brahmaNaH purA| kaNThaM bhittvA viniryAtau tena mA~ggalikAvubhau” iti| shAstrAntare cAdau ma~ggalatvena dRuShTo~ayamathashabdaH| yathA- “atha shabdAnushAsanam” (vyA. ma. bhA. a.  1 pA. 1 A. 1), “athAto dharmaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH” (vai . a.1A.1sU.1) ityAdau| abhIShTadevatAnamaskArastu granthAdau shiShTAcAraprAptaH paramashiShTenAgniveshena kRuta eva, anyathA shiShTAcArala~gghanena shiShTatvameva na syAd vyAkhyAnAntarAyabhayashca ; tathA granthAviniveshitasyApi namaskArasya pratyavAyApahatvAcca na granthaniveshanam| yathA ca gurvAj~jAlAbhAnantarametattantrakaraNaM tathA “atha maitrIparaH puNyam” (sU. a. 1) ityAdau sphuTameva| granthakaraNe ca gurvanumatipratipAdanena granthasyopAdeyatA pradarshitA bhavati| yat punaH shiShyaprashnAnantaryArthatvamathashabdasya varNyate tanna mAM dhinoti, nahi shiShyAn puro vyavasthApya shAstraM kriyate; shrotRubuddhisthIkAre tu shAstrakaraNaM yuktaM, na ca buddhisthIkRutAH praShTAro bhavanti| ataH shabdo~adhikAraprAgavadhyupadarshakaH, ata UrdhvaM yadupadekShyAmo dIrgha~jjIvitIyaM taditi; yadi vA hetau, yena brahmAdipraNItAyurvedatantrANAmuktena nyAyenotsambandhatvamiva , ato hetordIrgha~jjIvitIyaM vyAkhyAsyAma iti yojanIyam| dIrgha~jjIvitIyamityatra dIrgha~jjIvitashabdo~asminnastIti matvarthe “adhyAyAnuvAkayorluk ca” (pA. a. 5/2/60) iti chapratyayaH| yadi vA dIrgha~jjIvitashabdamadhikRutya kRuto grantho~adhyAyarUpastantrarUpo vA, ityasyAM vivakShAyAm “adhikRutya kRute granthe” (pA. a. 4/3/87) ityadhikArAt “shishukrandayamasabha” (pA. a. 4/3/88) ityAdinA chaH| evamanyatrApyeva~jjAtIye mantavyam| atra ca satyapi shabdAntare dIrgha~jjIvitashabdenaiva sa~jj~jA kRutA, dIrgha~jjIvitashabdasyaiva pravacanAdau niveshAt prashastatvAcca| ‘dIrgha~jjIvitashabdo~asminnasti’ iti, dIrgha~jjIvitashabdamadhikRutya kRuto vA, ityanayA vyutpattyA dIrgha~jjIvitIyashabdastantre~adhyAye ca pravartanIyaH| tena dIrgha~jjIvitIyaM vyAkhyAsyAma ityanena tantraM prati vyAkhyAnapratij~jA labdhA bhavati, punardIrgha~jjIvitIyamiti padamAvartyAdhyAyapadasamabhivyAhRutamadhyAyavyAkhyAnapratij~jAM lambhayati| dRuShTaM cAvRutya padasya yojanaM, yathA- apAmArgataNDulIye “gaurave shirasaH shUle pInase” (sU. a. 2) ityAdau ‘shirasa’ iti padaM ‘gaurave’ ityanena yujyate, AvRutya ‘shUle’ ityanena ca| atashca yaducyate- akRutatantrapratij~jasyAdhyAyapratij~jA UnakAyamAneti, tannirastaM bhavati| yadi vA, adhyAyapratij~jaivAstu, tayaiva tantrapratij~jA~apyarthalabdhaiva, na hyadhyAyastantravyatiriktaH, tenAvayavavyAkhyAne tantrasyApyavayavino vyAkhyA bhavatyeva; yathA- a~ggulIgrahaNena devadatto~api gRuhIto bhavati| avayavAntaravyAkhyAnapratij~jA tu na labhyate, tAM tu pratyadhyAyameva kariShyati| adhyAyamiti adhipUrvAdi~gaH “i~gashca” (pA. a. 2/4/47) iti karmaNi gha~jA sAdhyam| tena adhIyate ityadhyAyaH| na cAnayA vyutpattyA prakaraNacatuShkasthAnAdiShvatiprasa~ggaH, yato yogarUDheyamadhyAyasa~jj~jA~adhyAyasya prakaraNasamUhavisheSha eva dIrgha~jjIvitIyAdilakShaNe pa~gkajashabdavadvartate na yogamAtreNa vartate| vakShyati hi- “adhikRutyeyamadhyAyanAmasa~jj~jA pratiShThitA” (sU. a. 30) iti; nAmasa~jj~jA yogarUDhasa~jj~jetyarthaH| yadi vA karaNAdhikaraNayorarthayoH “adhyAyanyAyodyAvasaMhArAshca” (pA. a. 3/3/112) itisUtreNa nipAtanAdadhyAyapadasiddhiH| adhIyate~asminnanena vA~arthavisheSha ityadhyAyaH| atiprasaktiniShedhastUktanyAyaH| vyAkhyAsyAma iti vyA~gpUrvAt khyAterlRuTA sAdhyam| cakShi~go hi prayoge~anicchato~api vyAkhyAtuH kriyAphalasambandhasya durnivAratvena “svarita~jita” (pA. a. 1/3/72) ityAdinA~a~atmanepadaM syAditi| ‘vi’ iti visheShe, visheShAshca vyAsasamAsAdayaH| A~gayaM kriyAyoge, ye tu maryAdAyAmabhividhau vA A~gprayogaM manyante teShAmabhiprAyaM na vidmaH| yato maryAdAyAmabhividhau cA~gaH prAtipadikena yogaH syAt; yathA- “AsamudrakShitIshAnAM” (ra. vaM. a. 1) “ApATalIputrAdvRuShTo deva” ityAdau, ihApi ca tathA| kriyAyogavirahe “upasargAH kriyAyoge” (pA. a. 1/4/59) iti niyamAdA~ga upasargatvaM na syAt; tatashcAnupasargeNA~gA vyavadhAnAd verupasargasya prayogo na syAt| yenAvyavahitaH sajAtIyavyavahito vA dhAtorupasargo bhavati| vyA~gorubhayorapyanupasargatve tatsambandhocitabhUriprAtipadikakalpanAgauravaprasa~ggaH syAt; tasmAt kriyAyogitvamevA~go nyAyyam| atha, ataH, dIrghaM, jIvitIyam, adhyAyaM, vi, A, khyAsyAma ityaShTapadatvam||1||
RuShayashca bharadvAjAjjagRuhustaM prajAhitam| dIrghamAyushcikIrShanto vedaM vardhanamAyuShaH||27||
maharShayaste dadRushuryathAvajj~jAnacakShuShA| sAmAnyaM ca visheShaM ca guNAn dravyANi karma ca||28||
samavAyaM ca tajj~jAtvA tantroktaM vidhimAsthitAH| lebhire paramaM sharma jIvitaM cApyanitvaram ||29||
atha maitrIparaH puNyamAyurvedaM punarvasuH| shiShyebhyo dattavAn ShaDbhyaH sarvabhUtAnukampayA||30||
agniveshashca bhela(Da)shca jatUkarNaH parAsharaH| hArItaH kShArapANishca jagRuhustanmunervacaH||31||
buddhervisheShastatrAsInnopadeshAntaraM muneH| tantrasya kartA prathamamagnivesho yato~abhavat||32||
atha bhelAdayashcakruH svaM svaM tantraM kRutAni ca| shrAvayAmAsurAtreyaM sarShisa~gghaM sumedhasaH||33||
shrutvA sUtraNamarthAnAmRuShayaH puNyakarmaNAm| yathAvatsUtritamiti prahRuShTAste~anumenire||34||
sarva evAstuvaMstAMshca sarvabhUtahitaiShiNaH| sAdhu bhUteShvanukrosha ityuccairabruvan samam||35||
taM puNyaM shushruvuH shabdaM divi devarShayaH sthitAH| sAmarAH paramarShINAM shrutvA mumudire param||36||
aho sAdhviti nirghoSho lokAMstrInanvavA(nA)dayat| nabhasi snigdhagambhIro harShAdbhUtairudIritaH||37||
shivo vAyurvavau sarvA bhAbhirunmIlitA dishaH| nipetuH sajalAshcaiva divyAH kusumavRuShTayaH||38||
athAgniveshapramukhAn vivishurj~jAnadevatAH| buddhiH siddhiH smRutirmedhA dhRutiH kIrtiH kShamA dayA||39||
tAni cAnumatAnyeShAM tantrANi paramarShibhiH| bha(bhA)vAya bhUtasa~gghAnAM pratiShThAM bhuvi lebhire||40||

hitAhitaM sukhaM duHkhamAyustasya hitAhitam| mAnaM ca tacca yatroktamAyurvedaH sa ucyate||41||

Commentary: sampratyAyurvedavyutpattiM kurvannAyurvedAbhidheyaM darshayati- hitAhitamityAdi| hitaM cAhitaM ca hitAhitaM, tathA sukhayuktatvAt sukhaM, duHkhayuktatvAdduHkhaM; etacca catuShprakAramapyAyurarthedashamahAmUlIye “tatra shArIramAnasAbhyAm” ityAdinA granthena “ahitamato viparyayeNa” (sU.a.30) ityantena vakShyati| tasya hitAhitamiti AyuShaH pathyApathyam| mAnaM cetyAyuSha eva, tacca pramANaM mAsikadvimAsikatvAdibhirvikRutilakShaNairindriyasthAne tathA prakRutilakShaNaiH “idamAyuShmatAM kumArANAM lakShaNaM bhavati” (shA.a.8) ityAdinA shArIre vaktavyam| tacceti AyuH svarUpeNa “sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyoga” ityAdinA vakShyamANam| tena hitAhitamityAdinA ‘AyurvedayatItyAyurveda’ ityuktaM bhavati| vidadhAtushceha j~jAnArtha evAbhipretaH| yadvakShyatyarthe dashamahAmUlIye- “tadAyurvedayatItyAyurvedaH” (sU.a.30) iti| lAbhAdayastvarthA videriha noktAH, teShAM sAkShAdAyurvedAjanyatvAditi bhAvaH||41||

sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogo dhAri jIvitam| nityagashcAnubandhashca paryAyairAyurucyate||42||

Commentary: Ayurvedapade pUrvapadavAcyamAyurAha- sharIretyAdi| sharIraM pa~jcamahAbhUtavikArAtmakamAtmano bhogAyatanam, indriyANi cakShurAdIni, sattvaM manaH, AtmA j~jAnapratisandhAtA, eShAM samyagadRuShTayantrito yogaH saMyogaH| yadyapi sharIragrahaNenaiva indriyANyapi labhyante, tathA~api prAdhAnyAttAni punaH pRuthaguktAni| ayaM ca saMyogaH saMyoginaH sharIrasya kShaNikatvena yadyapi kShaNikastathA~api santAnavyavasthito~ayamekatayocyate| tasyAyuShaH paryAyAnAha- dhArItyAdi| dhArayati sharIraM pUtitAM gantuM na dadAtIti dhAri| jIvayati prANAn dhArayatIti jIvitam| nityaM sharIrasya kShaNikatvena gacchatIti nityagaH| anubadhnAtyAyuraparAparasharIrAdisaMyogarUpatayetyanubandhaH| paryAyairAyurucyata iti ekArthAbhidhAyibhiH shabdairucyate| yadyapi ca nityagAnubandhashabdAbhyAM na kvacidapyAyurabhidhIyate, tathA~api nityagatvAnubandhatvadharmakhyApanArthamevaitatsa~jj~jAdvayaM boddhavyaM, dhArisa~jj~jA tvarthedashamahAmUlIye bhaviShyati| nanu, uttaratra “caitanyAnuvRuttirAyuH” (sU.a.30) ityAyurlakShaNaM kariShyati, iha tu sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyoga iti kimarthamuktam? brUmaH- sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogajanyA caitanyAnuvRuttiryathoktasaMyogAvyabhicAritvena vyaktatvena cArthedashamahAmUlIye lakShaNatvenoktA; sharIrAdisaMyogarUpameva tvAyuH paramArthataH; evambhUtasaMyogAbhAve maraNamAyuruparamarUpaM bhavati, mRutasharIre tu cetaso~abhAvAdAyUrUpasaMyogAbhAvaH||42||

tasyAyuShaH puNyatamo vedo vedavidAM mataH| vakShyate yanmanuShyANAM lokayorubhayorhitam ||43||

Commentary: tasyetyAdi| vedayatIti vedaH| vedavidAM mata iti vedavidbhiH pUjitaH| atha kasmAdAyurvedalakShaNo vedaH puNyatamo vedavidAM ca pUjita ityAha- vakShyata ityAdi| yaditi yasmAt; evamuktaM bhavati- yadanye RugvedAdayaH prAyaH paralokahitamevArthaM vadanti tena puNyAH, puNyatamashcAyamAyurvedo yad yasmAnmanuShyANAmubhayorapi lokayoryaddhitamAyurArogyasAdhanaM dharmasAdhanaM ca tadvakShyate, tenAtishayena puNyatamastathA vedavidAM ca pUjita iti| kecit ‘vakShyate yaH’ iti paThanti, tatrApi hetugarbhamiti vyAkhyeyam| jIvitapradAtRutvAdAyurvedasya puNyatamatvaM boddhavyaM, yatashcaturvargasAdhanIbhUtajIvitapradameva sarvottamaM bhavati| ucyate ca- “na hi jIvitadAnAddhi dAnamanyadvishiShyate” (ci.a.1) iti||43||

sarvadA sarvabhAvAnAM sAmAnyaM vRuddhikAraNam| hrAsaheturvisheShashca, pravRuttirubhayasya tu||44||

Commentary: sampratyAyurvedAbhidheyatayA sUtrite sAmAnyAdau sAmAnyasya prathamasUtritatvAttathA sAmAnyaj~jAnamUlatvAccAyurvedapratipAdyasya hetvAdeH sAmAnyamevAgre nirdishati- sarvadetyAdi| sarvadA sarvasmin kAle nityage cAvasthike ca| sarvabhAvAnAmityatra sarvashabdaH kRutsnavAcI; bhavanti sattAmanubhavantIti bhAvA dravyaguNakarmANItyarthaH, natu bhavantyutpadyanta iti bhAvAH; tathA sati pRuthivyAdiparamANUnAM nityAnAM sAmAnyasya pArthivadvyaNukAdivRuddhaM kAryamasa~ggRuhItaM syAt| sAmAnyaM ca “sAmAnyamekatvakaraM” ityAdinA vakShyamANalakShaNam| vRuddhiH AdhikyaM, tatkAraNaM vRuddhikAraNam| etacca sAmAnyaM sAmAnyavato mAMsadravyAdervRuddhikAraNasya lakShaNatvena vRuddhikAraNamityuktam| yato na sAmAnyaM mAMsatvAdijAtirUpaM vRuddhau kAraNaM bhavati, tathAhi sati sAmAnyaM mAMsatvarUpaM yathA vardhake bhojyarUpe mAMse~asti tathA sharIradhAturUpe vardhanIye~apyasti, tatashca nityaM mAMsatvasambandhAdamAMsAdAnAmapi mAMsena vardhitavyaM; tasmAdvRuddhikAraNalakShaNatvena sAmAnyaM vRuddhikAraNamityuktam| ata eva vaisheShike~apyuktaM- “trayANAmakAryatvamakAraNatvaM ca” iti| atra trayANAmiti sAmAnyavisheShasamavAyAnAm| ye tu samAnameva sAmAnyamiti kRutvA dravyAdyeva sAmAnyashabdenAbhidadhati, teShAM mate “sAmAnyaM ca visheShaM ca” (sU.a.1) ityAdigranthoktasya sAmAnyasya na ki~jcidanenoktaM syAdityasambandhArthatvaM prakaraNasya syAt| etacca vRuddhikAraNatvaM sAmAnyasya na lakShaNaM, kiM tarhyAyurvedopayoginA dharmeNa nirdeshaH; lakShaNaM tu “sAmAnyamekatvakaram” iti kariShyati| evaM dravyAdAvapi coddeshAnantaraM nirdeshaM kariShyati “khAdInyAtmA” ityAdinA, tato lakShaNaM “yatrAshritAH karmaguNA” ityAdinA kariShyati| sAmAnyasya ca vRuddhikAraNatvaM hyasati virodhikAraNe boddhavyaM, tenAmalakAdigatAnAmamlatvAdInAM pittagatAmlatvAdyavardhakatvamAmalakagatashishiratvaprabhAvavirodhitvAdupapannam| evamanyatrApi tridoShaharadravye boddhavyam| iha ca sAmAnyasya vRuddhikAraNatvamityucyate, natu sAmAnyameva vRuddhikAraNamityucyate, tenAsamAnAdapi ghRutAnmedhAyA vahneshca vRuddhiH prabhAvAdevopapannA, yaduktaM- “ghRutamagnimedhe karoti” iti; tathA cintayA vAtavRuddhiH, tathA sa~gkalpAdvRuShyapAdayugalepAcca shukravRuddhirityAdi prabhAvAdupapannam| sAmAnyaM ceha vRuddhikAraNamityucyamAne samAnasyeti gamyate, na hi shoNitaM prati mAMsatvaM sAmAnyaM, kintu vyAvRuttabuddhijanakatvAdvisheSha eva| atha vaisheShikoktAnAmantyavisheShANAmiha shAstre cikitsAyAmanupayuktatvAttadvisheShadharmavyAvartakatvayogAt sAmAnyavisheShAneva hrAsakAraNatvenAha- hrAsaheturityAdi| atrApi sarvadA sarvabhAvAnAmiti yojanIyam| hrAsaH apacayaH| vishiShyate vyAvartata iti visheShaH| sAmAnyameva gavedhukatvaM mAMsAdIn prati visheShaH; gavedhuko hi gavedhukatvena gavedhukavyaktyantarApekShayA samAnaH, mAMsApekShayA vyAvRuttatvAdvisheShaH; na hi mAMse gavedhukatvamasti| evaM mAMsatvaM mAMsAntarApekShayA~anugatatvAt sAmAnyaM, shoNitAdyapekShayA tu mAMsAnAM vyAvRuttatvAdvisheSha eva| atrApi hrAsahetutvaM hrAsahetudravyAdilakShaNatvena sAmAnyavajj~jeyaM; tathA hrAsahetutvamapyasati virodhake sAmAnyoktanyAyena j~jeyaM; tena mandakanikucAdInAM vAtAdiviruddhAnAmapi snigdhatvAdInAM vAtAdyashamakatvaM dravyasyApathyatvaprabhAvAdeva j~jeyam| visheShashceha viruddhavisheSho~abhipretaH; te(ye)nottaratra viruddhavisheShameva hrAsahetutayA tatra tatropadekShyati; yathA- “vRuddhiH samAnaiH sarveShAM viparItairviparyayaH” (vA.sU.a.1) iti, tathA “viparItaguNairdeshamAtrAkAlopapAditaiH” (sU.a.1) ityAdi, tathA viparItaguNairdravyairmArutaH samprashAmyati (sU.a.1) ityAdi, tathA jatUkarNe~apyuktaM- “samAnaiH sarvabhAvAnAM vRuddhirhAnirviparyayAt” iti| aviruddhavisheShastu yadyapi hrAse vRuddhau vA~apyakAraNaM, yathA- pRuthivyA anuShNAshItasparsho vAtasya shaityaM na vardhayati nApi hrAsayati, tathA~apyagnikShIyamANAnAM dhAtUnAmasamAnatvenAjanakatvAddhrAsakAraNami(me)va bhavati; yato~asamAnadravyopayoge sati hrAso vinashvarANAM bhAvAnAmApUrakahetvabhAvAdupalabhyata eva; yathA- vahato jalasya pUrvadeshasetunottaradeshajalasya hrAsaH| evambhUtaM cAviruddhavisheShopayoge~api hrAsaM pashyatA~a~acAryeNa sAmAnyenaivehoktaM hrAsaheturvisheSha iti| cashabdaH sarvabhAvAnAmiti samuccinoti| atha kimasambaddhAvapi sAmAnyavisheShau vRuddhihrAsakAraNaM netyAha - pravRuttirubhayasya tviti| ‘kAraNaM’ iti sheShaH| ubhayasya sAmAnyasya visheShasya ca, pravRuttiH pravartanaM sharIreNAbhisambandha iti yAvat; evambhUtA pravRuttiH dhAtusAmAnyavisheShayorvRuddhihrAse kAraNamityarthaH| tushabdo~avadhAraNe; tena nAsambaddhau sAmAnyavisheShau svakAryaM kuruta iti darshayati| kiMvA pravRuttiH ucitA dhAtupravRuttirdhAtusAmyamiti yAvat, sA ubhayasya sAmAnyasya visheShasya ca ‘kAryA’ iti sheShaH| tena kevalasamAnopayogAddhAtuvRuddhyA dhAtuvaiShamyaM , kevalavisheShopayogAcca dhAtukShayAddhAtuvaiShamyaM, yugapatsamAnavishiShTadravyopayogAt pravRuttirdhAtusAmyarUpA bhavatItyuktaM bhavati| tushabdaH pUrvapakShAdekadravyopayogalakShaNAdvyAvartayati||44||

sAmAnyamekatvakaraM, visheShastu pRuthaktvakRut| tulyArthatA hi sAmAnyaM, visheShastu viparyayaH||45||

Commentary: atha kiMlakShaNaM tat sAmAnyaM kiMlakShaNo vA sa visheSha ityAha- sAmAnyamityAdi| ekatvakaramiti ekatvabuddhikaraM, sAmAnyaM yadanekAsu bhinnadeshakAlAsu gavAdivyaktiShu ‘ayaM gaurayaM gauH’ ityAdiprakArA ekAkArA buddhistat sAmAnyam| na hi bhinnAsu vyaktiShvabhinnaM sAmAnyamekarUpaM vinA~abhrAntA ekAkArA buddhirbhavatIti bhAvaH| yatrApi ca ‘ayaM pAcako~ayaM pAcakaH’ iti, tathA ayaM ‘shuklo~ayaM shuklaH’ ityAdau kriyAguNAdisAmAnyAdekarUpA buddhistatrApi sAmAnyamekakriyAguNAdigatamekarUpAdhyavasAye hetuH| na hyekasmin pAcake yA kriyA sA pAcakAntare~api, kintarhi tajjAtIyA| ataH kriyAsAmAnyaM tatrApyekatvAdhyavasAye kAraNam| visheShalakShaNaM- pRuthaktvakRuditi|- vyAvRuttabuddhikRut; tena yadgovyaktyantarApekShayaikabuddhikartRutayA gotvaM sAmAnyaM, tadeva gotvamashvAdyapekShayA vyAvRuttabuddhikartRutvAdashvAdIn prati visheSha ityuktaM bhavati| tena mAMsatvaM mAMsaM prati mAMsAntarApekShayA samAnatvAdvRuddhikAraNaM bhavati, tadeva tu mAMsatvaM vAtaM prati visheSharUpatayA hrAsaheturbhavati; shoNitAdIn prati tvavirodhivisheShatvena na tathA hrAsakAraNaM, guNasAmAnyAttu vardhakamapi mAMsaM shoNitAdInAM bhavati| kathamanekAsu vyaktiShu sAmAnyamekabuddhimavyabhicAriNIM karotItyAha- tulyArthatA hItyAdi| tulyArthatA ekasAmAnyarUpArthAnuyogitA| etena yasmAdbhinnAsu vyaktiShu sAmAnyamekarUpasambandhamasti , tatastadanekArthAvalambA satyapi vyaktibhede ekabuddhiryukteti bhAvaH| visheShastu viparyaya iti atulyArthatA hi visheShatvaM , tena gogajayoratulyagotvagajatvarUpArthayoH pRuthagbuddhiryuktaiveti darshitaM bhavati| anye tu vyAkhyAnayanti yat- trividhaM sAmAnyaM, visheShashca trividhaH; yathA- dravyagocaraH, guNagocaraH, karmagocarashca; tatra sarvadetyAdinA dravyasAmAnyamucyate; sAmAnyamekatvakaramityanena guNasAmAnyaM; yathA- payaHshukrayorbhinnajAtIyayorapi madhuratvAdiguNasAmAnyaM tatraikatAM karoti, evaM visheShe~apyudAhAryaM; tulyArthatetyAdinA tu karmasAmAnyaM nigadyate, AsyArUpaM hi karma na shleShmaNA samAnamapi tu pAnIyAdikaphasamAnadravyArthakriyAkAritvAt kaphavardhakarUpatayA AsyA~api kaphasamAnetyucyate; evaM svapnAdAvapi karmaNi boddhavyam| tadetadbhaTTAraharicandreNaiva dUShitaM; yataH sarvadetyAdinaiva lakShaNena trividhimapi sAmAnyaM labhyate, tenAsmin pakShe sAmAnyamekatvakaramityAdyavAcyaM syAditi kRutvA| anye tu pashyanti- yattrividhaM sAmAnyam- atyantasAmAnyaM, madhyasAmAnyam, ekadeshasAmAnyaM ca; tatra sarvadetyAdinA~atyantasAmAnyamucyate, sAmAnyamekatvakaramityanena madhyasAmAnyaM, tulyArthatA hItyAdinaikadeshasAmAnyaM etadapi traividhyakathanaM nAtiprayojanamasa~ggatalakShaNaM ceti nAtishraddhAkaram| kecit sAmAnyaM dvividhamicchanti- ubhayavRutti, tathaikavRutti ca; tatra mAMsaM mAMsavardhakam, ubhayavRuttisAmAnyAt; mAMsatvaM hi poShye poShake ca gatatvAdubhayavRutti; ekavRutti tu yathA- ghRutamagnikaraM, tathA dhAvanAdikarma vAtakaraM, tathA~a~asyAdi kaphakaram; etaddhi sarvaM na vardhanIyena samAnaM, kintu prabhAvAdvardhakaM; prabhAvashca ghRutatvadhAvanatvAdireva; sa caikavRuttisAmAnyarUpaH, tenAtrApi sAmAnyameva vRuddhikAraNamiti bruvate| asmiMstu pakShe~anubhayavRuttisAmAnyaM visheSha eva bhavati, tathA samAnamasamAnaM ca vRuddhikAraNaM bhavatIti na ki~jcit sAmAnyasyoktaM syAt| asmanmate tu sAmAnyaM vRuddhau kAraNameva bhavatIti sAmAnyaM vRuddhikAraNatvena niyamyate; na tu vRuddhiH sAmAnyakAraNikaiveti niyamyate, tenAsamAnAdapi vRuddhirbhavati nirdoShA| yattUcyate- karmasAmAnyaM neha tantre vRuddhikAraNamasti, yato na dhAvanena vAyuH samAna iti; ata evAcAryeNa dravyasAmAnyamuktaM “mAMsamApyAyate mAMsena” (shA.a.6) ityAdinA, tathA “samAnaguNAnAmAhAravikArANAmupayogaH” (shA.a.6) ityAdinA guNasAmAnyamuktaM; naivaM karmasAmAnyamuktaM, vacanaM hi “karmApi ca yadyasya dhAtorvRuddhikaraM tattadAsevyam” (shA.a.6) iti; na tatra sAmAnyopagrahaH kRutaH| atra brUmaH- karmaNAM prAyaH prabhAveNaiva vRuddhihetutvAt sAmAnyAnupagrahaH kRutaH, na tu karmasAmAnyAbhAvAt; yataH kriyAvato vAtasya kriyAvatA vyAyAmAdiyuktena sharIreNa vRuddhiH kriyate, niShkriyatayA cAsya vAtasya hrAsaH| svapnAdayastu “saMyoge ca vibhAge ca” ityanena vakShyamANalakShaNenAnuktA api shAstravyavahArAt karmashabdenocyate| tatra svapnaH svakAraNAdeva cIyamAnasya kaphasya kShayakAraNasharIraparispandAdinirodhakatvena vRuddhikara ucyate, na tu svapnaH sAkShAcchleShmavRuddhiM karoti| evamAsyAdAvapi cintanIyam| yatra tvevaM kAraNaM cintayituM na pAryate tatra prabhAva eva varNanIyaH| nanu mAMsaM mAMsaM vardhayati sAmAnyAt, visheShAcca vAtaM kShapayati, tat kathaM yugapadviruddhArthadvayakartRutvaM mAMsasya; na hi devadatto yadaiva kumbhaM karoti tadaiva kANDamapi| naivaM, kriyAvatAmayaM dharmo nAkriyAvatAmiti ; tathAhi- shabdo yugapadanekAneva shabdAnekakAlamArabhate, tathA~agniH prakAshadAhau yugapat karoti; ata evoktamAcAryeNa- “tasmAdbheShajaM samyagavacAryamANaM yugapadUnAtiriktAnAM dhAtUnAM sAmyakaraM bhavati; adhikamapakarShati, nyUnamApyAyayati” (shA.a.6) iti| yaducyate- kShIyamANadhAtorvRuddhasya tathA bahudoShasya samAnaguNo~apyAhAro na vRuddhihetuH, tathA grIShme ca madhurAdinA samAnenApi na kaphAbhivRuddhirityAdi; tatra pratibandhakAnAM jarA-bahudoShatva-grIShmoShNatvAdInAM vidyamAnatvAnna sAmAnyaM vardhakam; asati ca virodhake sAmAnyaM vRuddhikAraNamiti siddhAntaH; tena na kAcit kShatiH| kiMvA vRuddhAdInAM samAnenAhAreNa kriyata eva vRuddhiH; paramatibalavatA kShayahetunA~a~adhIyamAnakShaye puruShe sA vRuddhirnopalabhyate| atra ca dravyasAmAnyameva dhAtUnAM dravyarUpANAM vardhakaM na guNasAmAnyaM, guNAnAM dravyAnArambhakatvAt| guNasAmAnyAttu tadguNAshrayaM dravyamanumIyate; tacca dravyaM dhAtuvardhakaM bhavati, yathA- rUkShAdIn guNAn dRuShTvA citrako vAyvadhiko yo~anumitaH, sa ca citraka upayukto vAtaM vardhayati, guNAstu guNAneva janayanto~abhivardhayanti| sAmAnyaM ca vRuddhikAraNalakShaNaM na sAkShAdvRuddhikAraNamiti prAgevoktam; evaM visheShe~api| ayaM ca sAmAnyavisheShavAdo granthavistarabhayAdAyurvedopayuktadharmamAtreNoktaH; vistarastvasya vaisheShike boddhavyaH||45||
sattvamAtmA sharIraM ca trayametattridaNDavat| lokastiShThati saMyogAttatra sarvaM pratiShThitam||46||
sa pumAMshcetanaM tacca taccAdhikaraNaM smRutam| vedasyAsya, tadarthaM hi vedo~ayaM samprakAshitaH||47||

khAdInyAtmA manaH kAlo dishashca dravyasa~ggrahaH| sendriyaM cetanaM dravyaM, nirindriyamacetanam||48||

Commentary: samprati guNAbhidhAnaM kramaprAptamulla~gghya dravyANi nirdishatA guNAdhAratayA dravyasya prAdhAnyamucyate; sUtre ca “sAmAnyaM ca visheShaM ca” ityAdau guNAnAdau nirdishatA guNAnAmeva rasAdInAM prAyaH shAstre kArmukatvamupadarshyate; ata evAtreyabhadrakApyIye (sU.a.26) madhurAdirasadvArA sarvaguNAn karmANi ca dravyasya vakShyati; ki~jca sarvapradhAnaM yajjIvitaM tadeva saMyogaguNarUpamityagre tatra guNagrahaNaM, sa ca saMyogaguNaH sattvamAtmetyAdinA prathamamukta eva; visheShaguNeShu tu dravyaM pradhAnamiti dravyamucyate- khAdInItyAdi| khAdInItyAdAvAtmA kasmAt pradhAnabhUto~api prathamaM noktaH? ucyate- sharIrasyeha vyAdhyArogyAdhikaraNatayA pradhAnatvAttadArambhakAni khAdInyevocyante nAtmA, tasya nirvikAratvAt; vacanaM hi “nirvikAraH parastvAtmA” (sU.a.1) ityAdi; khAdIni ca “mahAbhUtAni khaM vAyuragnirApaH kShitistathA” (shA.a.1) ityanena krameNoktAni bhUtAnyanAgatAvekShaNenocyante | AtmAdInAM ca yathAbhyarhitasya pUrvanirdeshaH| dravyasa~ggraha iti karacaraNaharItakItrivRutAdyasa~gkhyeyabhedabhinnasya kAryadravyasya kAraNadvArA sa~gkShepa ityarthaH| sarvakAryadravyANAmapi vyavasthAmAha- sendriyamityAdi| nirindriyamityatra niHshabdo~abhAve, nirmakShikamitivat| atra sendriyaM cetanamityevAvataivArthApattyA nirindriyamacetanamiti labdhe~api punastadvacanamevambhUtArthApatteranaikAntikatvAdboddhavyam| yathA navajvare divAsvapnAdi niShiddhaM, arthAjjIrNe jvare tadApadyeta , na caivaM; tatra teShAM divAsvapnAdInAM niShiddhatvAt; tasmAttrividhashiShyabuddhihitatayohyamapi sAkShAdevocyate; vadanti hi nyAyavido- “vyAkhyAnAdvaraM karaNam” iti| yadyapi cAtmaiva cetano na sharIraM, nApi manaH, yaduktaM- “cetanAvAn yatashcAtmA tataH kartA nirucyate” (shA.a.1) iti, tathA~api salilauShNyavat saMyuktasamavAyena sharIrAdyapi cetanam| idameva cAtmanashcetanatvaM yadindriyayoge sati j~jAnashAlitvaM, na kevalasyAtmanashcetanatvaM ; yaduktaM- “AtmA j~jaH, karaNairyogAjj~jAnaM tvasya pravartate” (shA.a.1) iti| atra sendriyatvena vRukShAdInAmapi cetanatvaM boddhavyaM; tathAhi- sUryabhaktAyA yathA yathA sUryo bhramati tathA tathA bhramaNAddRuganumIyate, tathA lavalI meghastanitashravaNAt phalavatI bhavati, bIjapUrakamapi shRugAlAdivasAgandhenAtIva phalavadbhavati, cUtAnAM ca matsyavasAsekAt phalADhyatayA rasanamanumIyate, ashokasya ca kAminIpAdatalAhatisukhinaH stabakitasya sparshanAnumAnaM; smRutishcAnumAnaM draDhayati, yathA- “yo~abhivAditaviprastu nAshiShaM samprayacchati| shmashAne jAyate vRukSho gRudhraka~gkopasevitaH” iti; tathA “vRukShagulmaM bahuvidhaM tatraiva tRuNajAtayaH| tamasA~adharmarUpeNa cchAditAH karmahetunA|| antaHsa~jj~jA bhavantyete sukhaduHkhasamanvitAH| etadantAshca gatayo brahmAdyAH samudAhRutAH” (manusmRuti a.1) iti| tathA tantrakArashca vAnaspatyAnUkAn prANino vakShyati; tenAgamasaMvalitayA yuktyA cetanA vRukShAH||48||

dIrghaM jIvitamanvicchanbharadvAja upAgamat| indramugratapA buddhvA sharaNyamamareshvaram||3||

Commentary: nanu yathA~agniveshasyAyurvedasya duradhigamatvena pratyakShato vA~anvayavyatirekAdvA j~jAnaM na sambhAvyate, evamAtreyasyApi kathamAyurvedaj~jAnaM syAt, yanmUlamagniveshasyAyurvedaj~jAnaM samIcInamucyate, ityAsha~gkyAyurvedasyAviplutAgamatvaM darshayannAha- dIrghaM jIvitamityAdi| jIvitaM sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogaH| tacca dIrghamiti dIrghakAlasambandhi, kAlashabdo~apyatra luptanirdiShTo draShTavyaH| yattantrashailI ceyamAcAryasya yata AdimadhyAntalopAn karoti, ye luptA api gamyanta eva| yathA “grAmyAnUpaudakarasA” (sU.a.21) ityatra mAMsashabdo luptaH, tathA ‘dagdhaviddha’ ityatra viShashabdo lupta ityAdi| anvicchanniti anurUpaM dIrghamicchan| bharadvAja iti gotranAma| ‘ugratapA’ iti visheShaNena bharadvAjasya mAnuShasyApIndrAbhigamanashaktiH, tathA sharaNyatvapratItishaktishcopadarshyate; acintyo hi tapasAM prabhAvo yenAgastyo mahodadhimapi culukanipeyamakarot| naca vAcyamugratapastvenaiva kimityayamAyurvedamapi na budhyate, yatastapaHprabhAvo~api pratiniyataviShayatvAnna sarvatra shaktimAn, shaktishcAsya kAryonneyA; tena gurunirapekShAyurvedaj~jAnalakShaNakAryAdarshanAnna tattapastatra samarthamityavadhArayAmaH; kiMvA gurupUrvakrameNaivAyurvedaj~jAnaM phalatItIndramupAgamadbharadvAjaH| atha kathaM brahmAdiShvAyurvedapUrvaguruShu vidyamAneShvindramevAyamupAgamat? yuktaM ca pradhAnaguroreva shravaNaM, yataH shiShyaparamparAsa~jcAriNI vidyA~asamyaggrahaNAdidoShAt pAtraparamparAsa~jcAryamANamadhuvat kShINA~api sambhAvyeta; ata Aha- buddhvA sharaNyamamareshvaramiti| yasmAdayamevendro~alpAyuH, sa eva bhayatrastAnAM yathA sharaNyo rakShaNahito na tathA brahmAdayaH, tena tamevopAgamat| amareshvara ityanena cendrasya rakShaNopayuktatAM darshayati; rAjA hi prajArakShaNe prayatnAtishayavAn bhavati| nanu dIrghaM jIvitamanvicchannityatra dIrghasyAvyavasthitatvena kiyatkAlaM taddIrghamabhipretaM? tatra yugAnurUpaM varShashataM, yaduktaM- “varShashataM khalvAyuShaH pramANamasmin kAle” (vi.a.3) iti| etacca kalikAlAdau paramAyuHkAlasya yathA yathA kShayastathA~a~ayuShaH kShayaH| yadAha- “saMvatsarashate pUrNe yAti saMvatsaraH kShayam| dehinAmAyuShaH kAle yatra yanmAnamiShyate” (vi.a.3) iti| etadanusAreNa pUrvayugeShvAyuHprakarShaH| yadAha bhagavAn vyAsaH- “puruShAH sarvasiddhAshca caturvarShashatAyuShaH| kRute tretAdike~apyevaM pAdasho hrasati kramAt” iti| karmAnurUpaM cAyurniyataM vA, aniyataM vA bhavati| tatra balavatkarmArabdhaM niyataM, yathA~ayamasmin kAle mriyata eva param; abalavatkarmArabdhaM tvaniyataM, tadyadA dRuShTaM viShAdi mArakaM pratyayamAsAdayati tadA sa~jjAtabalaM mArayati, yadA na prApnoti dRuShTaM mArakaM kAraNaM tadA yugAnurUpAyuHprAptau yugaprabhAvajarjarIkRutasharIraM mArayati| atra dRuShTAntashcAcAryeNa darshitaH “yathA hyakShaH svaguNopapanno vAhyamAno yathAkAlaM svapramANakShayAdevAvasAnaM gacchati, sa evAkSho~atibhArAdhiShThita” ityArabhya yAvat “antarA vyasanamApadyate; tathA~aniyatAyuSho~antarA prANA aparAdhAnnirudhyante” (vi.a.3) ityantena| yadA tvaniyatAyuSho rasAyanamAcaranti tadA tatprabhAvAdyugaprabhAvaniyatAyurla~gghanaM bhavati| yadAha- “tAni yAvanti bhakShayet| jIvedvarShasahasrANi tAvantyAgatayauvanaH” (ci.a.1) ityAdi| na tu balavatkarmaniyatasyAyuSho la~gghanamasti, yadAha- “karma ki~jcit kvacitkAle vipAke niyataM mahat| ki~jcittvakAlaniyataM pratyayaiH pratibodhyate” (vi.a.3) iti| hanta yadyevaM tadA sarvatra karmaiva kAraNaM maraNe jIvite vA tathA vyAdhau vyAdhyapagame vA, tat kimanenAyurvedena karmajanitaphalAnuvidhAyinA; tathAhi- yattAvaducyate- niyataM karma, tatra tAvadAyurvedavyApAro nAsti, yena niyatenaiva karmaNA militamapi dRuShTaM tatra viphalIkriyate; yaccAbalavatkarmArabdhatvenAniyatamAyurucyate tadapi na shraddhAdhInaM, yenAdRuShTashaktiparAbhavena dRuShTasya kAryakAritAM dRuShTvA~api vivAdAdhyAsite viShaye~adRuShTameva kAraNamavadhArayAmaH, dRuShTaM tvadRuShTAkRuShTameva tatra bhavati| naivam, evaM sati sarvAnuShThAnasyoparamaprasa~ggaH; ki~jca kevalakarmavAdino dRuShTamapavadato~adRuShTotpattireva na prApnoti, adRuShTaM hi dRuShTAgniShTomAdijanyaM, dRuShTaM ca kAraNaM karmavAdino~abhimatam; athAdRuShTakAraNaM dRuShTamicchanti hanta tarhi tenaiva nyAyena dahanAdInAmapi kimiti shItApahatvasphoTAdijanakatvAdi na svIkriyate; ki~jca kevalakarmavAdino dRuShTe kAraNe vyAptigrahaNAbhAvAdadRuShTAnumAnameva na syAt, tasmAddRuShTamadRuShTaM ca kAraNam| tatra kvacidadRuShTaM dRuShTena bAdhyate, kvacicca dRuShTamadRuShTeneti; tena yatra puruShe balavanniyatamaraNakAraNamadRuShTaM , tatra jIvitamaraNayoraki~jcitkaro~ayamAyurvedaH, kintu tatrApi niyatamaraNakAlAdarvAgduHkhajanakavyAdhiprashamane vyApriyata eva yadi vyAdhirapi tasya niyatakarmajanyo na syAt; yattu karmAniyatavipAkaM bhavati tatprati sarvathA prayojanavadAyurvedopAdAnam| yattu yuganiyatamAyuH, tannAtibalavatA karmaNA niyamitaM; yena rasAyanaprayogAttadbAdhanaM dRuShTatvAdanumanyante, na tu svasthahitAturahitacikitsAbhyAm| ayaM ca vAdaH shAstrakAreNa svayameva prapa~jcena nirlocanIya iti neha pratanyate||3||

...prayatnAdi karma ceShTitamucyate||49||

Commentary: kramAgataM karma nirdishati- prayatnAdItyAdi| prayatanaM prayatnaH karmaivAdyamAtmanaH; yathA- “tulyAsyaprayatnaM savarNam” (pA.a.1pA.1sU.9) ityatra vyAkhyAtam| AdishabdaH prakAravAcI| tena saMskAragurutvAdijanyakRutsnakriyAvarodhaH| yadyapi ceShTitaM prANivyApAra ucyate, tathA~apIha sAmAnyena kriyA vivakShitA| ceShTitapadenaiva sarvakarmalAbhe siddhe vamanAdikarmaniShedhe ca siddhe prayatnAdIti padaM susUkShmaprayatnarUpakarmavyApitvadyotanArtham | anye tu prayatnAdIti prayatnakAraNamiti bruvate, prayatnagrahaNaM ca kAraNopalakShaNaM vadanti; tena gurutvAdikAryasyApi karmaNo grahaNamiti| prayatnashabdashcAyurvede~api karmavacano dRushyate; “pravRuttistu ceShTA kAryArthA, saiva kriyA prayatnaH kAryasamArambhashca” (vi.a.8) iti vacanAt||49||

samavAyo~apRuthagbhAvo bhUmyAdInAM guNairmataH| sa nityo yatra hi dravyaM na tatrAniyato guNaH||50||

Commentary: samavAyamAha- samavAya ityAdi| samavAyasya cAyaM nirdesha eva lakShaNam| tenottaratra dravyAdilakShaNe punarasya lakShaNaM na kartavyam| samavAya iti lakShyanirdeshaH, apRuthagbhAva iti lakShaNam; apRuthagbhAvaH ayutasiddhiH, sahaivAvasthAnamiti yAvat| yathA- avayavAvayavinoH, guNaguNinoH, karmakarmavatoH, sAmAnyasAmAnyavatoH; nahyavayavAdIn virahayyAvayavyAdaya upalabhyante| apRuthagbhAvameva visheShayannAha- bhUmyAdInAM guNairmata iti| bhUmyAdInAM bhUmiprakArANAM; bhUmishca bhUyasAmAdheyAnAmAdhArA, tenAdhAratvodAharaNArthamuktA; yato bhUmerarthAH sarve gurvAdiparAdyAshca guNAstathA cAvayavisAmAnyaka(dha)rmANyapyAdheyAni, netaradravye yathoktasarvAdheyasampattiH| etena bhUmyAdInAmityAdhArANAM, guNairiti apradhAnairAdheyaiH;
