Adheyo hyAdhArApekShayA~apradhAnam, apradhAne ca guNashabdo yathA- guNIbhUto~ayamiti, apradhAnamityarthaH; tenAdhArANAmAdheyairyo~apRuthagbhAvaH sa samavAyaH iti| tena pRuthivItvagandhavattvayorapRuthaksiddhayorapyAdhArAdheyabhAvAbhAvAnna samavAya ityuktaM bhavati| ata evoktaM vaisheShike yat- “ayutasiddhAnAmAdhAryAdhArabhUtAnAM yaH sambandha ihetipratyayahetuH sa samavAyaH” (pa.dha.saM.dravyapadArthanirUpaNa) iti| sa nitya iti samavAyo~avinAshI| satyapi samavAyinAM dravyANAM nAshe samavAyo na vinashyati| atra hetumAha- yatra hItyAdi| yatra dravyaM niyataM nityaM, yathA- AkAshaM, na tatra nitya AkAshe~aniyato vinAshI guNaH, ‘kashcit’ iti sheShaH| evaM manyate- nitye vyomni parimANamapi tAvannityaM, tathA dravyatvamapyAkAshagataM nityaM, tathA nityayorAkAshatadguNayoH samavAyalakShaNaH sambandho~api nitya eva| evaM tatra samavAyasya nityatve siddhe ekarUpatvAt samavAyasyAnyatrApi nityatvameva| na cAshrayadravyanAshe samavAyavinAshaH| yathA- govyaktivinAshe~api gotvasya sAmAnyasya na vinAshaH| nityasyaiva samavAyasya te te pArthivadravyAdayastatra tatra vya~jjakA bhavanti sAmAnyasyeva vyaktayaH| anyaistu nityAnityabhedena dvividhaH samavAyo vyAkhyAtaH; ayaM ca grantho bhUmyAdInAM guNaireva yaH sambandhastasyaiva yathAshrutasya pratipAdaka iti vyAkhyAtaM; tattu na vyApakaM nApi vaisheShikamatAnuyAyIti neha prapa~jcitam||50||

...samavAyI tu nishceShTaH kAraNaM guNaH||51||

Commentary: dravyalakShaNamAha- yatretyAdi| yatrAshritA yatra samavetAH, karma ca guNAshca karmaguNAH| kAraNaM samavAyi yaditi samavAyi kAraNaM yat, dravyameva hi dravyaguNakarmaNAM samavAyikAraNam| samavAyikAraNaM ca tad yat svasamavetaM kAryaM janayati; guNakarmaNI tu na svasamavetaM kAryaM janayataH, ato na te samavAyikAraNe| etatkarmavattvaM hi dravyasya guNAdipa~jcapadArthavyAvRuttimAtralakShaNakathanaM, na tu sajAtIyavyApakavijAtIyavyAvartakalakShaNakathanaM; yena karmasamavAyo nAkAshAdInAM vartate , tena lakShaNAnugataM vijAtIyavyAvRuttaM dravyasya lakShaNaM guNavattvaM samavAyikAraNatvaM ca boddhavyam| yadu(ttU)tpannamAtraM dravyaM prathamakShaNe nirguNaM, tadapi dvitIyakShaNAvashyambhAviguNavattayA tadyogyatvAdguNavadeveti mantavyam| vaisheShike~apyucyate- kriyAvadguNavat samavAyikAraNaM dravyam (vai.da.a.1sU.15) iti| tatrApi ca yatheha vyAkhyAtaM tathaiva vyAkhyAtam| 51|- guNalakShaNamAha- samavAyItyAdi| samavAyIti samavAyAdheyaH; tena vyApakadravyebhyo niShkriyebhya AkAshAdibhyo guNasya vyAvRuttiH; nahyAkAshAdayaH samavAyAdheyAH| nirgatashceShTAyAH nishceShTaH; ceShTAnirgatyA ceha ceShTAshUnyatvaM tathA ceShTAvyatiriktatvaM cocyate; tena ceShTArUpAt karmaNo vyAvRuttiH, tathA kriyAdhAratvayogebhyo mUrtadravyebhyo vyAvRuttiH siddhA; guNasya kAraNamityanena cAkAraNebhyaH sAmAnyavisheShasamavAyebhyo vyAvRuttiH siddhA| kAraNatvaM tu vibhudravyaparimANAntyAvayavirUpAdiShu lakShaNIyeShu guNeShu nAsti, tena bhAgAsiddhaM lakShaNaM syAt, ataH kAraNatveneha bhAvarUpakAraNAvyabhicAri sAmAnyavattvaM lakShaNatayA boddhavyam| tacca sAmAnyavattvaM sarvaguNavyApakaM sAmAnyAdivyAvartakaM ca, sAmAnyAdInAM sAmAnyavattvAbhAvAt| athavA vibhudravyaparimANAntyAvayavirUpAdyantarANAM kAraNatvadarshanAdvibhudravyaparimANAntyAvayavirUpAdAvapi kAraNatvayogyatvamastyeveti na bhAgAsiddhatA kAraNatvasya; kiMvA yogipratyakShaj~jAnahetutayA vibhudravyaparimANAdInAmapi kAraNatvaM boddhavyam| evambhUtaM ca kAraNatvaM yadyapi sAmAnyAdiShvapi kvacidanugamyate, tathA~api ‘samavAyI tu’ iti padena samavAyAdhAratA tathA samavAyAdheyatA ca yugapadvipakShitA; tena samavAyakevalAdhArasya vibhudravyasya tathA samavAyakevalAdheyasya sAmAnyAdeshca vyudAsaH siddho bhavati||51||

saMyoge ca vibhAge ca kAraNaM dravyamAshritam| kartavyasya kriyA karma karma nAnyadapekShate||52||

Commentary: karmalakShaNamAha- saMyoga ityAdi| saMyoge ca vibhAge ca yugapat kAraNam| tena saMyoge uttaradeshasaMyogakArake vibhAgAkAraNe, tathA vibhAge ca vibhAgajavibhAgamAtrakAraNe saMyogAkAraNe vyAvRuttiH siddhA| dravyamAshritamiti svarUpamAtrakathanaM vyAkhyeyaM, dravyavyAvRuttistu ‘karma nAnyadapekShate’ ityanenaiva siddhA | asyAyamartho yat- karma utpannaM svAshrayasya dravyasya pUrvadeshavibhAge uttaradeshasaMyoge ca kartavye nAnyatkAraNaM pashcAtkAlabhAvyapekShate; dravyaM tu yadyapi saMyogavibhAgakAraNaM yugapadbhavati, tathA~api tadutpannaM sadyadA karmayuktaM bhavati tadaiva saMyogavibhAgakAraNaM syAt ; karma tUtpannaM karotyeva paraM saMyogavibhAgau na tu kAraNAntaraM pashcAdbhAvyapekShate, saMyogavibhAgAshrayapratyAsattiM tvapekShate, sA ca pUrvasiddhaiveti na caramabhAvikAraNAntarApekShatA karmaNaH| atha karmashabdena vamanAdInAM tathA~adRuShTasya tathA kriyAyAshcAbhidhIyamAnatvAt kasya karmaNa idaM lakShaNamityata Aha- kartavyasya kriyA karmeti| etena kriyArUpasya karmaNa idaM lakShaNaM nAdRuShTAderiti||52||

... kAryaM dhAtusAmyamihocyate| dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam||53||

Commentary: kAraNaM sAmAnyenAbhidhAyAyurvedopayuktaM kAryamAha- kAryamityAdi| dhAtusAmyam ArogyaM; vakShyati hi- “vikAro dhAtuvaiShamyaM sAmyaM prakRutirucyate| sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyam” (sU.a.9) ityAdi| ihetyAyurvede; tenAnyatrAnyadapi ghaTAdi kAryamucyate| iha tu kimiti tat kAryaM nocyata ityAha- dhAtusAmyetyAdi| cakAro hetau| dhAtusAmyakriyaiva yasmAdAyurvedaprayojanaM, tasmAdAyurvede dhAtusAmyameva kAryamucyate prayojanaM kathyate; anyattvavivakShitatvAttathA~apradhAnatvAcca neha kAryatvenocyate||53||

kAlabuddhIndriyArthAnAM yogo mithyA na cAti ca| dvayAshrayANAM vyAdhInAM trividho hetusa~ggrahaH||54||

Commentary: samprati sAmAnyena kAraNamuktaM tadAyurvedopayuktadvAreNa vaktavyaM; tatra vyAdhikAraNameva tAvadagre~abhidhIyate- kAletyAdinA sUtrakramAnurodhAt| sUtraNaM hi “hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnam” (sU.a.1) iti| kAlaH shItoShNavarShalakShaNaH, buddhiH praj~jA, indriyArthAH shabdasparsharUparasagandhAstatsahacaritAni dravyaguNakarmANIndriyadvAropayujyamAnAni ca; teShAM kAlAdInAM yogaH sambandhaH| tasya visheShaNatrayaM-  mithyA na cAti ceti| tena kAlAdInAM mithyAyogaH, naca yogaH ayoga ityarthaH, ati ca yogaH atiyoga ityarthaH| dvayAshrayANAmiti manaHsharIrAshrayANAm| etacca manaHsharIrAdhiShThAnatvaM pRutha~gmilitaM ca boddhavyam| trividha ityayogAtiyogamithyAyogarUpaH| hetusa~ggrahaH hetusa~gkShepaH| ete ca kAlAdInAmatiyogAyogamithyAyogAstisraiShaNIye “tatrAtiprabhAvatAM” (sU.a.11) ityAdinA granthena suvyaktaM vAcyA iti neha vivriyante| kAlagrahaNaM tvihAdau kRutaM, kAlasya duShparihAratvAt| tadanu buddhirucyate, buddhyaparAdhasyaivendriyArthAtiyogAdihetutvAt; vakShyati hi- “praj~jAparAdhAddhyahitAnarthAn pa~jca niShevate” (sU.a.28) iti; evaM ca yadyapyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH praj~jAparAdhe pravishati, tathA~api pratyAsannakAraNatvAdasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogenaivAyaM pRuthak tantre sUcyate, praj~jAparAdhastvasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogavyatiriktakAyavA~gmanaHkriyAparAdhe vartate| atra cAdharmo~api vyAdhiheturasti, yaduktaM- “kriyAghnAH karmajA rogAH” (shA.a.1) ityAdi; tasya cAdharmasya kAlagrahaNenaiva grahaNaM kecinmanyante; tanna, tisraiShaNIye praj~jAparAdhenaivAdharmagrahaNAt| tatra hi, anRutavacanAbhidhyAdivA~gmanomithyAyogarUpaH praj~jAparAdhavisheSha uktaH; natvanRutavacanAdInAM svarUpeNa vyAdhikartRutvaM, kintvadharmotpAdAvAntaravyApArANAmeva; tena praj~jAparAdha evAdharmotpAdAvAntaravyApAraH karmajarogeShu kAraNaM, yAga iva dharmotpAdAvAntaravyApAraH svarge| yattUcyate- kAlapariNAmajAyamAnatvAt karmajavikArANAM kAlajatvaM, yaduktaM- “kAlasya pariNAmena jarAmRutyunimittajAH| rogAH svAbhAvikA dRuShTAH svabhAvo niShpratikriyaH” (shA.a.1) iti; tanna, tathA satyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogajasyApi ki~jcitkAlapariNAmajAyamAnasya kAlajatvaM syAt| naca kAlAtiyogAdyabhidhAyigranthe tisraiShaNIye karmAvarodhaH kathamapi pratibhAti| katidhApuruShIye tu “dhIdhRutismRutivibhraMshaH samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAm| asAtmyendriyasaMyogA vij~jeyA rogahetavaH” (shA.a.1) ityabhidhAya svAbhAvikAnAM rogANAM tathA karmajAnAM ca kAlaja evAvarodhaH kRutaH| uktaM hi tatra- “kAlasya pariNAmena jarAmRutyunimittajAH| rogAH svAbhAvikA dRuShTAH svabhAvo niShpratikriyaH” (shA.a.1) iti, tathA “nirdiShTaM daivasa~jj~jaM tu karma yat paurvadaihikam| hetustadapi kAlena rogANAmupalabhyate” (shA.a.1) iti| atrApi buddhimithyAyogarUpaH praj~jAparAdha eva rogajanakakarmakAraNam| kAlavisheShaprAptyA tu yeShAM vyAdhInAmAgamo bhavati, te kAlamithyAdiyogajanyA vA bhavantu, asAtmyendriyArthapraj~jAparAdhajanyA vA; sarva evAvisheSheNa kAlakRutAbhivyaktimAtraparigrahaNAttatra kAlasamprAptijanyA ityuktA gadAH| tathAhi- tatra santatAdijvarA api kAlajanyA evoktAH| vacanaM hi- “santataH satato~anyedyustRutIyakacaturthakau| sve sve kAle pravartante kAle hyeShAM balAgamaH” (shA.a.1) iti| naca santatAdau kAlasya mithyAyogAdayaH kAraNatvenopalabhyante, kintarhyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogapraj~jAparAdhAveva; tathA svAbhAvikeShu ca rogeShu na kAlamithyAyogAdayaH kAraNatvenopalabhyante; tasmAnna tatra kAlamithyAyogAdijanyAH kAlajatvenAcAryasyAbhipretAH, kintu kAlAbhivya~jjanIyAH kAlajAH; ata eva ca tatra “samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAm” (shA.a.1) iti paThitaM natu “kAlo mithyA na cAti ca” iti paThitam | ki~jca tatrApi kAlamabhidhAyApi karmaNAmiti padaM pRuthak paThitvA kAle jAtaH karmajaH pRuthageva sUcitaH| ki~jca, unmAdanidAne sAkShAdevAcAryeNa karmajasya praj~jAparAdhajatvamuktam| vacanaM hi- “praj~jAparAdhAt sambhUte vyAdhau karmaja AtmanaH| nAbhishaMsedbudho devAnna pitRUnna ca rAkShasAn” (ni.a.7) iti| janapadoddhvaMsanIye~apyuktaM- “tasyamUlamadharmaH, tanmUlaM cAsatkarma pUrvakRutaM, tayoryoniH praj~jAparAdha eva” (vi.a.3)| (tadevaM karmApekShadvayamupadarshitaM,) balAbalaM tu vidvAMsaH svayameva nirlocayiShyanti| idaM tvatra cintyatAM- svAbhAvikAnAM kShutpipAsAdInAM tathA kAlasamyagyoge~api jAyamAnAnAM doShacayaprakopANAM kva pravesho bhavatu; na tAvat kAlaje, yataH kAlo hi tatra samyagyukta eva, kAlasamyagyogashca na vyAdhikAraNamiti siddhAntaH; atha kAlapratiniyatastatrAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga eva kAraNamiShyate, tathA~apyevaM sati kAlamithyAyogAdAvapyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyoga eva kAraNamiti vaktuM pAryate; tasmAdasminmArge evaM buddhirvalate - yat- sahajAnAM vikArANAM niShpratikriyatvenehAyogAdijanyatvenAvarodho na kRuta eva, kAlasvabhAvajA api sahajA eva; yA tvatra pratikriyA kAlasvabhAvajAnAmanAgatAnAM bhAvAnAM sattvaguNadravyasevAdirUpA tathA svAbhAvikAnAM ca kShutpipAsAjarAdInAM kAlabhojanarasAyanAdirUpA, tasyA akaraNe sati kAlasvabhAvajasya rogasya prAdurbhAvaH praj~jAparAdhajanya eva, ucite hi kAle kartavyAkaraNaM praj~jAparAdha eva; uktaM hi katidhApuruShIye~api praj~jAparAdhasa~ggrahe- “karmakAlAtipAtashca mithyArambhashca karmaNAm” (shA.a.1) iti| anye tu mithyAyogAdishUnyakAlavidyamAnatvena kAla evAvarodha eShAM vikArANAmiti katidhApuruShIye vakShyamANagranthasya yathAshrutArthaparigrahAdvarNayanti| naceti cakArAddhInayogaM gRuhNAti| vakShyati hi- “mithyAtihInali~ggebhyo yo vyAdhirupajAyate” (shA.a.1) iti| hInayogasya tu sAkShAdapaThanamayogaprabhedatvAt; svalpayoge(go)~apyayogo bhavati, yathaikataNDulAbhyavahAre~anashanamucyate||54||

sharIraM sattvasa~jj~jaM ca vyAdhInAmAshrayo mataH| tathA sukhAnAM, yogastu sukhAnAM kAraNaM samaH||55||

Commentary: dvayAshrayANAmityanenoktamAshrayaM darshayati- sharIramityAdi| atra sharIramAdau kRutaM, sharIrarogAdhikAreNaivAsya tantrasya pravRuttatvAt| sattvasa~jj~jashabdena mana ucyate; kiMvA sattvashabdenaiva manasi labdhe sa~jj~jAshabdenAtmasharIrasambaddhaM mana ucyate, sharIrAdyasambandhasya manaso vyAdhyanAshrayatvAt| asamAsena ca pRuthagapi sharIramanasorvyAdhyAshrayatvaM darshayati| yataH kuShThAdayaH shArIrA eva, kAmAdayastu mAnasAH, unmAdAdayashca dvayAshrayAH| ArogyasyAshrayaM hetuM cAha- tathA sukhAnAmityAdi| sukhAnAmiti ArogyANAm| vacanaM hi- “sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyaM vikAro duHkhameva tu” (sU.a.9) iti| tatheti sharIraM manashca, tatra sharIrarogAbhAvarUpasyArogyasya sharIramAshrayaH, mAnasarogAbhAvasya tu manaH| yogastu samaH kAlabuddhIndriyArthAnAM samyagyogarUpastathA sukhAnAmArogyANAM kAraNam| sukhAnAmiti sukhapadAbhidheyAnAM ca rogAbhAvAnAM bahutvaM niShedhyarogabahutvAdeva boddhavyam| idameva hyabhAvAnAM bahutvaM yanniShedhyabhAvabahutvam| nanu “AyurvedAgamo hetuH” (sU.a.1) ityAdAvadhyAyArthasa~ggrahe vyAdhyAshrayo na sa~ggRuhItaH, tat kimidamanArShaM? na, hetavashcetyanena vyAdhyAshrayarUpasyApi hetostatra sa~ggrahaNam||55||

brahmaNA hi yathAproktamAyurvedaM prajApatiH| jagrAha nikhilenAdAvashvinau tu punastataH||4||

Commentary: pAta~jjalamahAbhAShyacarakapratisaMskRutaiH| manovAkkAyadoShANAM hartre~ahipataye namaH||4||

ashvibhyAM bhagavA~jchakraH pratipede ha kevalam| RuShiprokto bharadvAjastasmAcchakramupAgamat||5||

Commentary: naradattagurUddiShTacarakArthAnugAminI| kriyate cakradattena TIkA~a~ayurvedadIpikA||5||

nirvikAraH parastvAtmA sattvabhUtaguNendriyaiH| caitanye kAraNaM nityo draShTA pashyati hi kriyAH||56||

Commentary: sattvamAtmA sharIraM ceti vacanena trayamupAttam, atra sharIramanasI vyAdhyAshrayatayokte , Atmanastu kA vyavasthetyAha- nirvikAra ityAdi| nirvikAro nirvikRutiH, tena nIrogatvamAtmanaH| para iti sUkShmaH shreShTho vA, tena sattvasharIrAtmamelakarUpo ya Atmashabdenocyate taM vyAvartayati; yaduktaM- “saMyogapuruShasyeShTo visheSho vedanAkRutaH” (shA.a.1) iti| saMyoge~api cAtmAdInAM manasyeva vedanA bhavati, sA tu manaHsaMyukte Atmanyapi sambaddhetyucyate, tena “nirvyathe cAntarAtmani” (sU.a.22) iti vacanaM nirvyathe manasIti syAt ; tathA sharIrAdAvapyAtmashabdo vartate, tadvyavacchedArthaM para iti padam| uktaM hyanyatra- “brahmendravAyvagnimanodhRutInAM dharmasya kIrteryashasaH shriyashca| tathA sharIrasya sharIriNashca syAddvAdashasvi~ggita AtmashabdaH” iti| nanu, yadyAtmA nirvikArastat kiM j~jAnarUpo~apyasya vikAro~asti vA nAstItyAha- sattvetyAdi| sattvaM manaH, bhUtaguNAH shabdAdayaH, indriyANi cakShurAdIni, etaiH karaNabhUtaishcaitanye kAraNaM bhavatyAtmA| caitanyaM cAtmani jAyate vyajyate vA| ata eva ca sattvAdInAM j~jAnakAraNAnAM sarvatrAsambhavAt sarvagate~apyAtmani na sarvatra pradeshe j~jAnaM bhavati| nanu yadi caitanyavAnAtmA, tadA kadAcijj~jAnavAn kadAcidaj~ja ityanityaH syAdityAha- nitya iti| nityasyApyAtmano j~jAnamanityaM; naca dharmAnityatve dharmiNo~apyanityatvaM, nahyAkAshaguNashabdAnityatve~apyAkAshasyApyanityatvamiti bhAvaH| nityatvaM cAtmanaH pUrvAparAvasthAnubhUtArthapratisandhAnAt; nahyanitye j~jAtari pUrvAnubhUtamarthamuttaro j~jAtA pratisandhatte ; nahi devadattabuddhamarthaM yaj~jadatto~avagatatvena pratisandadhAti| nanu, dRushyate j~jAnavataH sukhopalabdhAvanurAgalakShaNo vikArastathA duHkhopalabdhau ca dveShalakShaNaH, tat kathaM sukhaduHkhopalabdhAvayamAtmA nirvikAra ityAha- draShTA pashyati hi kriyA iti| draShTA sAkShI; tena yatiryathA paramashAntaH sAkShI sa~jjagataH kriyAH sarvAH pashyanna rAgadveShAdinA yujyate, tathA~a~atmA~api sukhaduHkhAdyupalabhamAno~api na rAgAdinA yujyate; dRushyamAnarAgAdivikArastu manasi, prAkRutabuddhau vA sA~gkhyadarshanaparigrahAdbhavatIti bhAvaH| sA~gkhyamate ca manaHshabdena buddhirantaHkaraNaM ca gRuhyate||56||

vAyuH pittaM kaphashcoktaH shArIro doShasa~ggrahaH| mAnasaH punaruddiShTo rajashca tama eva ca||57||

Commentary: samprati vikArAshrayaM tathA vikArasya vyavahitaM ca hetumabhidhAya pratyAsannaM doSharUpahetumAha- vAyurityAdi| atra pradhAnatvAdagre vAyuruktaH, prAdhAnyaM cAshubhUridAruNavikArakartRutvAt; vacanaM hi- ‘AshukArI muhushcArI’ (su. ni. a. 1) iti; tathA ashItiM vAtajAn vikArAn, catvAriMshat pittavikArAn, viMshatiM ca kaphajAn vakShyati hi mahArogAdhyAye (sU. a. 2)| vAtamanu pittaM pradhAnaM, sharIramUlabhUtAgnihetutvAttathA kaphAdhikavikArakartRutvAttathA kaphApekShayA cAshukAritvAt| asamAsakaraNaM tu pRuthagapi vAyvAdInAM rogakartRutvopadarshanArtham| shArIra iti mAnasadoShavyavacchedArtham| sa~ggraha iti “dvyulbaNaikolbaNaiH ShaT syurhInamadhyAdhikaishca ShaT” (sU.a.17) ityAdivakShyamANaprapa~jcasya sa~gkShepaH| nanu, shoNitasyApi doShatvAnnAyaM sa~ggrahaH sAdhuH, yato raktasyApi vAtAdivadvishiShTahetulakShaNavikAracikitsitanirdeshaH kRutaH; tatra hetunirdesho yathA- “kAle cAnavasecanAt” (sU.a.24/9) ityAdi, lakShaNaM ca yathA- “tapanIyendragopAbhaM padmAlaktakasannibham” (sU.a.24/22) ityAdi, raktavikArAshca raktArshaHpradararaktapittAdaya uktAH, upakramashca “srAvaNaM shoNitasya tu” (sU.a.24/18) ityAdinoktaH, tathA doShasa~jj~jA ca carake kRutA, yaduktaM- “kaphe vAte jitaprAye pittaM shoNitameva vA| yadi kupyati vAtasya kriyamANe cikitsite|| yatholbaNasya doShasya tatra kAryaM bhiShagjitam” (ci.a.5/27) iti; tathA ca tantrAntare~api shalye shoNitaM doShatvenoktaM- “tairetaiH shoNitacaturthaiH” (su.sU.a.21) iti vacanAt| naivaM, doSho hi svatantradUShaNAtmaka ucyate; yato na vAtAdayo vRuddhAH ki~jcidapekShya dUShayanti kintu svata eva, shoNitaM tu duShTavAtAdisaMsargamapekShyaiva dUShakaM bhavati, na hi shoNitaM vikRutavAtAdisambandhamantareNa vikRutaM bhavati; sarvadA vAtAdijanakaireva shoNitaduShTeH; tathA sarvadA vAtAdilakShaNayuktasyaiva shoNitasya duShTatvAt; yashca hetvAdivisheSha uktaH sa vAtAdiyuktasyaiva shoNitasya bhavati; tena vAtAdaya eva tatrApi dUShaNAtmakAH, shoNitaM tu svapramANAtiriktamapi dUShyameva; na ca dUShyasya hetvAdayo vishiShTA na bhavanti, yato mAMsAdInAmapi hetvAdivisheSho~asti; yathA mAMsaduShTau- “mAMsavAhIni duShyanti bhuktvA ca svapatAM divA” (vi.a.5) ityAdi vakShyati; mAMsaduShTilakShaNaM “shRuNu mAMsapradoShajAn” (sU.a.28) ityAdinA vividhAshitapItIye vakShyati yAn vikArAste j~jeyAH, yata etAneva mAMsadoShavikArAn srotovimAne mAMsaduShTilakShaNatvenAtideshAdabhidhAsyati, duShTamAMsavikArAshcAdhimAMsArbudAdaya uktAH; upakramashca “mAMsajAnAM tu saMshuddhiH shastrakShArAgnikarma ca” (sU.a.28) ityuktaH| tasmAddUShyAdhikAre doShakRute kArye dUShyeNa vyapadeshaH- raktajo~ayaM, mAMsajo~ayamityAdi; yathA- snehAdhAreNa vahninA dagdhe snehadagdha iti vyapadeshaH| doShasa~jj~jA tu pIDAkartRutvasAmAnyAdadoShe~api syAt ; yathA- “svayaM pravRuttaM taM doShamupekSheta hitAshanaiH” (ci.a.5/46) ityatra purIShameva doShatvenoktam| sushrute tu shoNitasya doShatvaM vraNeShu prAyaH shoNitaduShTidarshanAdupacaritamevoktam| yataH pradeshAntare vraNaprashne vAtAdayastraya eva tatrApyuktAH- “vAtapittashleShmANa eva devasambhavahetavo bhavanti” (su.sU.a.21) ityAdinA| ki~jca yadi shoNitaM doShaH syAttadA vAtAdivatprakRutyArambhakaM syAt, nacArabhate; tasmAttraya eva doShA iti siddham| mAnasadoShamAha- mAnasaH punarityAdi| punaHshabdo~avadhAraNe, tena mAnasa uddiShTa eva paraM na shArIradoShavat prapa~jcitaH, mAnasadoShANAmasmiMstantre kAyacikitsArUpe~aprAstAvikatvAditi bhAvaH| Adau raja uktaM prAdhAnyAt; vacanaM hi- “nArajaskaM tamaH pravartate” (vi.a.6) iti| evashabdena sattvAkhyaguNasyAdoShatvamavadhArayati, sattvaM hyavikAri||57||

prashAmyatyauShadhaiH pUrvo daivayuktivyapAshrayaiH| mAnaso j~jAnavij~jAnadhairyasmRutisamAdhibhiH||58||

Commentary: samprati doShaprashamakAraNamAha- prashAmyatItyAdi| pUrva iti shArIraH| doShagrahaNena tajjanyA vyAdhayo~api gRuhyante, vikRutadoShAdananyatvAdvyAdhInAm| daivamadRuShTaM, tadAshritya yadvyAdhipratIkAraM karoti taddaivavyapAshrayaM balima~ggalAdi; etacca prathamamuktaM sadyo~akleshena ca vyAdhiprashamakatvAt| yuktiH yojanA; sharIrabheShajayorhito yo yogastadapekShaM saMshodhanasaMshamanAdi yuktivyapAshrayamucyate| j~jAnam adhyAtmaj~jAnaM, vij~jAnaM shAstraj~jAnaM , dhairyam anunnatishcetasaH, smRutiH anubhUtArthasmaraNaM, samAdhiH viShayebhyo nivartyAtmani manaso niyamanam||58||
rUkShaH shIto laghuH sUkShmashcalo~atha vishadaH kharaH| viparItaguNairdravyairmArutaH samprashAmyati||59||
sasnehamuShNaM tIkShNaM ca dravamamlaM saraM kaTu| viparItaguNaiH pittaM dravyairAshu prashAmyati||60||
gurushItamRudusnigdhamadhurasthirapicchilAH| shleShmaNaH prashamaM yAnti viparItaguNairguNAH||61||

viparItaguNairdeshamAtrAkAlopapAditaiH| bheShajairvinivartante vikArAH sAdhyasammatAH||62||

Commentary: viparItaguNairapyalpamAtraistathA~aviparItadeshakAlAdipratibaddhaishca na prashamo bhavatItyAha- viparItetyAdi| desho bhUmirAturashca, mAtrA anapAyiparimANaM, kAlo nityagaH RutvAdirAvasthiko bAlyAdishca; deshAdyapekShayA yathocitatvena kalpito deshamAtrAkAlopapAditaH| upapAditairiti caurAdiko Nic; kiMvA vaidyenopapAditaiH| atra deshagrahaNAdbalasharIrAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutInAM grahaNaM, kAlagrahaNAdvayaso~api grahaNaM, doShastu prashamanIyatayaiva gRuhItaH, bheShajaM tu sAkShAdevoktam; evaM doShabheShajadeshakAlabalasharIrAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutivayasAM parIkShyANAM dashavidhAnAM sarveShAmeva grahaNaM bhavati| sAdhyatvena prAmANikAnAM sammatAH sAdhyasammatAH; etenAj~jenAj~jAnAdye sAdhyatvena gRuhItAste nirAkriyante| yattu samyaggrahaNena yApyayApanamucyate tannAtisundaraM, vinivartanta iti vacanAt; na ca yApyayApanaM vinivRuttiH| asAdhye bheShajanivRuttimAha- sAdhanamityAdi| nanvasAdhyAnAmapi sAdhanaM dRuShTaM, yato~ariShTavAMstAvadavashyaM mRutyugRuhItatvenAsAdhyaH; yaduktaM- “ariShTaM cApi tannAsti yadvinA maraNaM bhavet| maraNaM cApi tannAsti yannAriShTapuraHsaram” (iM.a.2); utpannAriShTasAdhanaM ca sushrute proktaM- “dhruvaM tvariShTe maraNaM brAhmaNaistat kilAmalaiH| rasAyanatapojapyatatparairvA nivAryate” (su.sU.a.28) iti; tathA cAha bhagavAnagastyaH- “rasAyanatapojapyayogasiddhairmahAtmabhiH| kAlamRutyurapi prAj~jairjIyate nAlasairnaraiH” iti; tathA~anyatrApyuktaM- “jAtA~ariShTo~api jIvati” iti| atrAhureke- dvividhamariShTaM niyatamaniyataM ca; tatra yanniyataM tadasAdhyameva, ata evoktaM “na tvariShTasya jAtasya nAsho~asti maraNAdRute” (iM.a.2); atra jAtasyeti vacanAnniyatasyeti gamyate; yattvaniyatamariShTaM tatprati sushrutAgastyavacanayorarthavattA| carake~apyaniyatamariShTamuktaM; yathA- saMshayaprAptamAtreyo jIvitaM tasya manyate (iM.a.9) iti| anye tu bruvate- saMshayaprAptamiti uktibhedamAtramatra; tena sarvAriShTaM mArakamevAsati rasAyanAdau, rasAyanatapaHprabhRutayastu prabhAvAtishayayogAditarakriyayA~asAdhyamapi sAdhayanti; taccAriShTanivAraNaM viraleShveva puruShAtishayeShu nandikeshvarAdiShu dRuShTaM, na sarvapuruShaistacchakyamato jAtAriShTAnAmasAdhyataiva tantre procyate| yattu kaishciducyate- niyatAyuSho mRutyurariShTapUrvo bhavati, aniyatAyuShastvariShTaM vinaiva mRutyurbhavati| tanna, “maraNaM cApi tannAsti yannAriShTapuraHsaram” (iM.a.2) iti vacanAt| yaducyate- aniyatAyuShaH satyapi riShTaprAdurbhAve samyakkriyopapAdanAjjIvitena bhavitavyaM, yato~aniyatAyuShaH puruShakArAparAdhAdeva paraM mRutyurbhavati, samyakkriyAyAM ca puruShakArAparAdho nAsti| tanna, nahyaniyatAyuShaH sarvadaiva puruShakArasAdhyAH, kintu yathocitakAlakriyamANasvasthAturahitasevArUpapuruShakArasAdhyAH; tena yathocitakAle hitAsevanAdasAdhyatvayukte vyAdhau riShTe jAte kiM bheShajamatItakAlakriyamANamapakrAnte salila iva setubandhaH kariShyatIti| tasmAdasAdhyAnAM sAdhanaM nopadishyata iti sAdhu||62||-

bhUyashcAto yathAdravyaM guNakarmANi vakShyate||63||

Commentary: kimetAnyeva guNakarmANi, utAparANyapItyAha- bhUyashcetyAdi| guNAnAM karmANi guNakarmANi| yathAdravyamiti yasmin yasmin dravye yadyadguNakarma tattattasmiMstasmin dravye~annapAnAdau kRutsne vA tantre vakShyate ‘AcArya’ iti sheShaH; vakShyate iti brU~jo vacirAdeshAt prayogaH| kiMvA yathAdravyamiti yathAhetuM; tadyathA- gurukharakaThinAdiguNabahulaM pArthivadravyaM, teShAM ca pArthivAnAM guNAnAM karma upacayasa~gghAtagauravAdIti||63||

rasanArtho rasastasya dravyamApaH kShitistathA| nirvRuttau ca visheShe ca pratyayAH khAdayastrayaH||64||

Commentary: samprati doShAnabhidhAya tatprashamanapradhAnAn rasAn vaktumudyato rasalakShaNapUrvakaM rasotpattikramamAha- rasanArtha ityAdi| rasyata AsvAdyata iti rasaH| rasanArtha iti jihvAgrAhyaH| etacca ShaNNAmapi rasAnAmanugataM rUpAdiShu ca vyAvRuttatvAt sAdhulakShaNam| tasyeti rasasya| dravyamiti AdhArakAraNam| dravyashabdo hyAdhArakAraNavAcI; yathA- “pa~jcendriyadravyANi” (sU.a.8) iti| kShitistatheti yathA Apa AdhArakAraNaM tathA kShitirapi| ‘apkShitI’ iti vaktavye kShitistathetivacanAt kShiterAdhArakAraNatvamamukhyamiti darshayati| yenApo hi nisargeNa rasavatyaH| tathA hyAtreyabhadrakApyIye “saumyAH khalvApaH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA jala eva rasasya vyaktiriti darshayati| sushrute~apyuktaM- “tasmAdApyo rasaH” (su.sU.a.42) iti| kShitistvapAmeva rasena nityAnuShaktena rasavatItyucyate| yato nityaH kShitijalasambandhaH; vacanaM hi- “viShTaM hyaparaM pareNa” (nyA.da.3/1/60) iti| asyArthaH- khavAyvagnijalakShitInAmuttarottare bhUte pUrvapUrvabhUtasya nityamanupraveshaH, tatkRutashca khAdiShu guNotkarShaH| rasasya kiM vyaktAvapkShitI kAraNaM kiMvA visheShe ityAha- nirvRuttAvityAdi| nirvRuttau ceti abhivyaktau| etena raso~abhivyajyamAno jalakShityAdhAra eva vyajyata iti darshayati| cakArAdvisheShe~api madhurAdilakShaNe apkShitI pratyayau| tena “somaguNAtirekAnmadhuraH, pRuthivyagniguNAtirekAdamlaH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA jalapRuthivyorapi visheShakAraNatvaM vakShyamANamupapannam| visheShe ca pratyayAH khAdaya iti madhurAdivisheShanirvRuttau nimittakAraNaM khavAyvanalAH, na tvAdhArakAraNabhUtAH| khAdaya ityanenaiva tritve labdhe punastraya iti vacanaM teShAmeva vyastasamastAnAmapi pratyayatvadarshanArtham; ata eva vyastasamastAkAshAdisaMsargabhedAdrasAnAM madhurataramadhuratamAdyavAntarabheda upapannaH| visheShe ceti cakArAdabhivyaktAvapyAkAshAdInAM nimittakAraNatvaM darshayati| vakShyati hi- tAstvantarIkShAdbhrashyamAnA bhraShTAshca pa~jcamahAbhUtavikAraguNasamanvitA ja~ggamasthAvarANAM bhUtAnAM mUrtIrabhiprINayanti; tAsu ShaDabhimUrcchanti rasAH (sU.a.26) iti| anye tu visheShe ceti cakAraM khAdayashcetyatra yojayanti; tena cakArAt kAlo~api visheShe~abhivyaktau ca kAraNaM labhyate| sAkShAttu kAlasyAvacanena khAdibhyo~apyapakRuShTaM kAlasya kAraNatvaM darshyate| kiMvA rasasyApo dravyaM kShitistatheti pUrvavadeva; nirvRuttau ceti kShitireva nirvRuttAvabhivyaktau pratyayo nApaH; yata Apo hyavyaktarasA eva, kShitisambandhAdeva ca raso~abhivyakta upalabhyate| uktaM ca- “ja~ggamasthAvarANAM bhUtAnAM mUrtIrabhiprINayanti, tAsu ShaDabhimUrcchanti rasAH” (sU.a.26) iti| tena pArthivadravyasambandhAdevApAM raso vyajyate, nAnyathA| visheShe ceti cakArAdapkShitI visheShe kAraNe| yadyapi cApkShitI visheShe kAraNe, tathA~api “somaguNAtirekAnmadhuraH”- (sU.a.26) ityAdau tu khAdaya eva tathA sannivishanti yathA somo~atirikto bhavati, tena tatrApyUnatvena sanniviShTAH khAdaya eva visheShahetava iti| yadyapicAbhivyaktirmadhurAdivisheSharahitA kvacidbhavati, tathA~api sAmAnyena sarvatra yadabhivyaktaye~anugataM kAraNamupalabhyate kShitirUpaM jalakShitirUpaM vA tadabhivyaktikAraNaM; yadanugamAttu madhurAdivisheShopalabdhistadvisheShakAraNamucyate||64||

svAduramlo~atha lavaNaH kaTukastikta eva ca| kaShAyashceti ShaTko~ayaM rasAnAM sa~ggrahaH smRutaH||65||

Commentary: rasavisheShAnAha- svAdurityAdi| atra sarvaprANinAmiShTatvAdAdau madhura uktaH; tadanu ca prANyabhIShTotkarShakrameNaivAmlAdinirdeshakramo boddhavyaH| ShaTka iti punaH sa~gkhyAkaraNaM paravAdimatasaptasa~gkhyatvAdiniShedhArtham| ayaM sa~ggraha ityanenAvAntarabhedabahutvaM tathA vakShyamANarasasaMsargabahutvaM ca darshayati||65||

svAdvamlalavaNA vAyuM, kaShAyasvAdutiktakAH| jayanti pittaM, shleShmANaM kaShAyakaTutiktakAH||66||

Commentary: rasAnAmupayuktataraM kAryamAha- svAdvamletyAdi| atra ca vAyornIrasasyApi rasasahacaritasnigdhatvAdiguNairviparItaiH prashamo j~jeyaH| evaM madhurarasasyApi shleShmaNo~amlalavaNAbhyAM snigdhatvAbhiShyanditvAdisahacaritaguNayogAdeva vRuddhiH| atra ca ye prashamakatvena rasA vAtAdInAM noktAste vardhakA boddhavyAH| yadAha vAgbhaTaH- “tatrAdyA mArutaM ghnanti trayastiktAdayaH kapham| kaShAyatiktamadhurAH pittamanye tu kurvate” (vA.sU.a.1) iti| rasakarmAtideshenaiva guNavIryavipAkAnAmapi karmanirdeshaH kRuta eva| yato madhurAdirasenaiva sarvaguNAn vIryavipAkAMshca nirdekShyatyAtreyabhadrakApyIye- “tatra svAduH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA; tathA “kaTutiktakaShAyANAM vipAkaH prAyashaH kaTuH” (sU.a.26); tathA “amlo~amlaM pacyate svAdurmadhuraM lavaNastathA” (sU.a.26) tathA “shItaM vIryeNa yaddravyaM madhuraM rasapAkayoH| tayoramlaM yaduShNaM ca yaccoShNaM kaTukaM tayoH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA||66||

ki~jciddoShaprashamanaM ki~jciddhAtupradUShaNam| svasthavRuttau mataM ki~jcittrividhaM dravyamucyate||67||

Commentary: ato~avashiShTaM dravyakAryaM prabhAvakRutaM vaktuM prabhAvabhedena dravyabhedamAha- ki~jcidityAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| doShasya doShayordoShANAM vA prashamanaM doShaprashamanam| doShagrahaNena duShTA rasAdayo~api gRuhyante| tena dravyamahimnA yaddoShANAM duShTAnAM rasAdInAM dhAtUnAM vA shamakamAmalakadurAlabhAdi tadgRuhyate| AmalakaM hi shivatvAttridoShaharaM; durAlabhA cApi vAtapittashleShmaharI| yadyapi cAmalakasya “hanti vAtaM tadamlatvAt” (su.sU.a.46) ityAdinA guNadvArA tridoShaharatvamucyate, tathA~api tatprabhAvabRuMhitameva boddhavyam| yatastatrAmlatvAdinA pittAdiko~api yujyate, sa tvAmalakaprabhAvAnna bhavati| dhAtupradUShaNamiti vAtAdInAM samatvena sharIradhAraNAtmakAnAM tathA rasAdInAM ca dUShaNaM ki~jcit, yathA- yavakamandakaviShAdi| suShThu avatiShThate nIrogatveneti svasthaH, tasya vRuttiH svastharUpatayA~anuvartanaM, tatra svasthavRuttau matamabhimataM pUjitamiti yAvat| sa~gkhyeyanirdeshAdeva tritve labdhe trividhagrahaNaM niyamArtham| tena saMshodhanasaMshamanAdInAmanekavidhAnAmapyatraivAvarodhaH| rasAyanavAjIkaraNe tu svasthavRuttimAtra eva| yaduktaM- “svasthasyojaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam” (ci.a.1pA.1) iti| pratipAde ki~jcidgrahaNaM doShaharatvAdikarmaNAM vibhinnadravyAshrayitvopadarshanArtham; ekaki~jcidgrahaNe tvekameva dravyaM doShaharaM dhAtupradUShakaM svasthavRuttimataM ca syAt, na ca tadabhimatam| nanu, svasthavRuttimatAnAM raktashAliShaShTikayavAdInAM doShaprashamanatvamapi dRushyate, yato vakShyati tatra tatra raktashAlyAdInAM jvarAdau prayogaM; tathA prakRutisharIradeshakAlamAtrAbhi(di)yuktaM doShaprashamanamapi doShakaraM bhavati, yathA- AmalakamatimAtramagnimAndyAyetyAdi j~jeyaM; tathA dhAtupradUShaNamapi doShashamanaM dRushyate, yathA- viShamudaraharaM, tathA yadeva mandakAdi doShakaraM tadeva kShINadoShaM prati doShavRuddhyA sAmyApAdanena doShaprashamanaM bhavati; tadevamavyavasthitatvAt ki~jciddoShaprashamanamityAdi viruddham| atrocyate- svasthavRuttimataM raktashAlyAdi doShaprashamanamapi bhavati, paraM tat prAyaH svasthavRuttihitatvAt svasthavRuttimatatvena gRuhyate| vacanaM hi- “svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam| prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM shamane hitam|| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtha ubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut” (ci.a.1) iti| doShaprashamanAni dravyANi viguNaprakRutyAdipratibandhakAbhAve doShaprashamanamAcarantyeva, pratibandhakasadbhAve tu na kurvanti, na caitAvatA teShAM sa svabhAvo na bhavati; nahyagnirmantrAdipratibandhAt kadAcinna dahatIti dAhakatvena nopadishyate; evaM dhAtupradUShakasyApi kadAciddhAtuprashamakatvaM nimittAntarayogAdbhavanna dhAtupradUShakasvarUpatAM hanti, yathA salilasyAgnisambandhAduShNatvam| tasmAdyadyasya prAyikamananyopAdhikRutaM ca rUpaM, tenaiva vyapadesho yuktaH| yacca mandakAdInAM kShINadoShavardhakatvena doShaprashamakatvaM tadvidyamAnamapi kAdAcitkatvAttathA hyuttarakAlaM doShAvahatvAcca na vyapadishyate doShaprashamakatvena| nanu, yadyapyevaM tathA~api yadekadoShaharamaparadoShakaraM yathA maricaM shleShmaharaM pittakaraM cetyAdi bahudravyajAtaM tat kutra pravishatu? atraike vadanti- yadubhayAtmakaM taddoShaharaM doShakaraM ca, nacaitAvatA dravyatritvakShatiH; yato na vAtAdisaMsargajavyAdhisadbhAve vAtAdijanyatvena yattraividhyaM rogANAmucyate tat khaNDitaM bhavati; kiMvA maricAdInAM yadubhayakartRutvaM na taddravyaprabhAvakRutaM, kiM tarhi rasAdikRutaM, tena na dravyaprabhAvaprastAve tadudAharaNIyaM; naca ki~jciddravyaM tAdRushamasti yat prabhAvAdeva ki~jciddoShaM karoti ki~jcicchamayatIti na doShaprashamanatvAdiprabhAvaM prati niyamaH; ayameva ca pakShaH sAdhuH| nanu ‘ki~jciddoShaprashamanaM ki~jciddoShapradUShaNam’ iti vA kriyatAM, ‘ki~jciddhAtuprashamanaM ki~jciddhAtupradUShaNam’ iti vA| naivaM, tathA sati doShashabdasya mukhyavRuttyA vAtAdiShveva vRuttitvAttathA dhAtushabdasya ca rasAdivRuttitvAdubhayagrahaNaM na prApyate; ubhayapadopAdAnena dvayaM nipuNakArI tantrakAro dUShaNatvadhAraNatvayogaparigrahAddoShaprashamanena duShTarasAdiprashamanamapi bheShajaM vividhAshitapItIyAdivakShyamANaM, tathA dhAtupradUShaNena vAtAdipradUShakamapi nidAnAdivakShyamANaM grAhayati| prashabdo~atra prakAre; tena prakAreNa mRudumadhyAdinA prakopaNaM, tathA prakAreNa saMshodhanasaMshamanAdinA shamanamucyate; kiMvA dhAtvarthAnuvRuttAveva imau prashabdau, yathA- ‘cyutAMshaH paridhAvati’ ityatra dhAvatItyarthaH| Adau doShaprashamanagrahaNaM tasyaivehAbhipretatvAt| nanu svasthavRuttimataM dravyaM bhAvidoShaharatvena doShaprashamanameva| naivaM, nahi svAsthyAnuvRuttijanakatvAddoShanivRuttikaraM doShaharaNamucyate, kiM tarhi samadhAtUnAmavardhakatvenAkShayakaratvena ca rasAdisrotasAM cAnuguNatvena dhAtusAmyAnuvRuttikaramucyate| vacanaM hi- “pathyaM patho~anapetaM yat” (sU.a.25) iti||67||

vighnabhUtA yadA rogAH prAdurbhUtAH sharIriNAm| tapopavAsAdhyayanabrahmacaryavratAyuShAm ||6||

Commentary: sabhyAH sadguruvAksudhAsrutiparisphItashrutInasmi vo nAlaM toShayituM payodapayasA nAmbhonidhistRupyati| vyAkhyAbhAsarasaprakAshanamidaM tvasmin yadi prApyate kvApi kvApi kaNo guNasya tadasau karNe kShaNaM dhIyatAm ||6||
tadA bhUteShvanukroshaM puraskRutya maharShayaH| sametAH puNyakarmANaH pArshve himavataH shubhe||7||
tat punastrividhaM proktaM ja~ggamaudbhidapArthivam | madhUni gorasAH pittaM vasA majjA~asRugAmiSham||68||
viNmUtracarmareto~asthisnAyushRu~gganakhAH khurAH| ja~ggamebhyaH prayujyante keshA lomAni rocanAH||69||
suvarNaM samalAH pa~jca lohAH sasikatAH sudhA| manaHshilAle maNayo lavaNaM gairikA~jjane||70||
bhaumamauShadhamuddiShTamaudbhidaM tu caturvidham| vanaspatistathA vIrudvAnaspatyastathauShadhiH||71||
phalairvanaspatiH puShpairvAnaspatyaH phalairapi| oShadhyaH phalapAkAntAH pratAnairvIrudhaH smRutAH||72||
mUlatvaksAraniryAsanAla(Da)svarasapallavAH| kShArAH kShIraM phalaM puShpaM bhasma tailAni kaNTakAH||73||
mUlinyaH ShoDashaikonA phalinyo viMshatiH smRutAH||74||
mahAsnehAshca catvAraH pa~jcaiva lavaNAni ca| aShTau mUtrANi sa~gkhyAtAnyaShTAveva payAMsi ca||75||
shodhanArthAshca ShaD vRukShAH punarvasunidarshitAH| ya etAn vetti saMyoktuM vikAreShu sa vedavit||76||
hastidantI haimavatI shyAmA trivRudadhoguDA| saptalA shvetanAmA ca pratyakshreNI gavAkShyapi||77||
jyotiShmatI ca bimbI ca shaNapuShpI viShANikA| ajagandhA dravantI ca kShIriNI cAtra ShoDashI||78||
shaNapuShpI ca bimbI ca cchardane haimavatyapi| shvetA jyotiShmatI caiva yojyA shIrShavirecane||79||
...phalinIH shRuNu||80||
sha~gkhinyatha viDa~ggAni trapuShaM madanAni ca| dhAmArgavamathekShvAku jImUtaM kRutavedhanam| AnUpaM sthalajaM caiva klItakaM dvividhaM smRutam||81||
prakIryA codakIryA ca pratyakpuShpA tathA~abhayA| antaHkoTarapuShpI ca hastiparNyAshca shAradam||82||
kampillakAragvadhayoH phalaM yat kuTajasya ca| dhAmArgavamathekShvAku jImUtaM kRutavedhanam||83||
madanaM kuTajaM caiva trapuShaM hastiparNinI| etAni vamane caiva yojyAnyAsthApaneShu ca||84||
nastaH pracchardane caiva pratyakpuShpA vidhIyate| dasha yAnyavashiShTAni tAnyuktAni virecane||85||
sarpistailaM vasA majjA sneho diShTashcaturvidhaH ||86||
pAnAbhya~jjanabastyarthaM nasyArthaM caiva yogataH| snehanA jIvanA varNyA balopacayavardhanAH||87||
sauvarcalaM saindhavaM ca viDamaudbhidameva ca||88||
sAmudreNa sahaitAni pa~jca syurlavaNAni ca| snigdhAnyuShNAni tIkShNAni dIpanIyatamAni ca||89||
AlepanArthe yujyante snehasvedavidhau tathA| adhobhAgordhvabhAgeShu nirUheShvanuvAsane||90||
abhya~jjane bhojanArthe shirasashca virecane| shastrakarmaNi vartyarthama~jjanotsAdaneShu ca||91||
... nyU(U)rdhvaM mUtrANyaShTau nibodha me||92||
mukhyAni yAni diShTAni sarvANyAtreyashAsane| avimUtramajAmUtraM gomUtraM mAhiShaM ca yat ||93||
hastimUtramathoShTrasya hayasya ca kharasya ca| uShNaM tIkShNamatho~arUkShaM kaTukaM lavaNAnvitam||94||
mUtramutsAdane yuktaM yuktamAlepaneShu ca| yuktamAsthApane mUtraM yuktaM cApi virecane||95||
svedeShvapi ca tadyuktamAnAheShvagadeShu ca| udareShvatha cArshaHsu gulmikuShThikilAsiShu ||96||
tadyuktamupanAheShu pariSheke tathaiva ca| dIpanIyaM viShaghnaM ca krimighnaM copadishyate||97||
pANDurogopasRuShTAnAmuttamaM sharma cocyate| shleShmANaM shamayet pItaM mArutaM cAnulomayet||98||
karShet pittamadhobhAgamityasmin guNasa~ggrahaH| sAmAnyena mayoktastu pRuthaktvena pravakShyate||99||
avimUtraM satiktaM syAt snigdhaM pittAvirodhi ca| AjaM kaShAyamadhuraM pathyaM doShAnnihanti ca||100||
gavyaM samadhuraM ki~jciddoShaghnaM krimikuShThanut| kaNDUM ca shamayet pItaM samyagdoShodare hitam||101||
arshaHshophodaraghnaM tu sakShAraM mAhiShaM saram| hAstikaM lavaNaM mUtraM hitaM tu krimikuShThinAm||102||
prashastaM baddhaviNmUtraviShashleShmAmayArshasAm| satiktaM shvAsakAsaghnamarshoghnaM cauShTramucyate||103||
vAjinAM tiktakaTukaM kuShThavraNaviShApaham| kharamUtramapasmAronmAdagrahavinAshanam||104||
ataH kShIrANi vakShyante karma caiShAM guNAshca ye||105||
avikShIramajAkShIraM gokShIraM mAhiShaM ca yat| uShTrINAmatha nAgInAM vaDavAyAH striyAstathA||106||
prAyasho madhuraM snigdhaM shItaM stanyaM payo matam| prINanaM bRuMhaNaM vRuShyaM medhyaM balyaM manaskaram||107||
jIvanIyaM shramaharaM shvAsakAsanibarhaNam| hanti shoNitapittaM ca sandhAnaM vihatasya ca||108||
sarvaprANabhRutAM sAtmyaM shamanaM shodhanaM tathA| tRuShNAghnaM dIpanIyaM ca shreShThaM kShINakShateShu ca||109||
pANDuroge~amlapitte ca shoShe gulme tathodare| atIsAre jvare dAhe shvayathau ca visheShataH ||110||
yonishukrapradoSheShu mUtreShvapracureShu ca| purIShe grathite pathyaM vAtapittavikAriNAm||111||
nasyAlepAvagAheShu vamanAsthApaneShu ca| virecane snehane ca payaH sarvatra yujyate||112||
yathAkramaM kShIraguNAnekaikasya pRuthak pRuthak| annapAnAdike~adhyAye bhUyo vakShyAmyasheShataH||113||
athApare trayo vRukShAH pRuthagye phalamUlibhiH| snuhyarkAshmantakAsteShAmidaM karma pRuthak pRuthak||114||
vamane~ashmantakaM vidyAt snuhIkShIraM virecane| kShIramarkasya vij~jeyaM vamane savirecane||115||
imAMstrInaparAn vRukShAnAhuryeShAM hitAstvacaH| pUtIkaH kRuShNagandhA ca tilvakashca tathA taruH||116||
virecane prayoktavyaH pUtIkastilvakastathA| kRuShNagandhA parIsarpe shotheShvarshaHsu cocyate||117||
dadruvidradhigaNDeShu kuShTheShvapyalajIShu ca| ShaDvRukShA~jchodhanAnetAnapi vidyAdvicakShaNaH||118||
ityuktAH phalamUlinyaH snehAshca lavaNAni ca| mUtraM kShIrANi vRukShAshca ShaD ye diShTapayastvacaH||119||
a~ggirA jamadagnishca vasiShThaH kashyapo bhRuguH| Atreyo gautamaH sA~gkhyaH pulastyo nArado~asitaH||8||
agastyo vAmadevashca mArkaNDeyAshvalAyanau| pArikShirbhikShurAtreyo bharadvAjaH kapi~jja(ShTha)laH||9||
vishvAmitrAshmarathyau ca bhArgavashcyavano~abhijit| gArgyaH shANDilyakauNDilyau(nyau)vArkShirdevalagAlavau||10||
sA~gkRutyo baijavApishca kushiko bAdarAyaNaH| baDishaH sharalomA ca kApyakAtyAyanAvubhau||11||
kA~gkAyanaH kaikasheyo dhaumyo mArIcakAshyapau| sharkarAkSho hiraNyAkSho lokAkShaH pai~ggireva ca||12||
shaunakaH shAkuneyashca maitreyo maimatAyaniH| vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye maharShayaH||13||
brahmaj~jAnasya nidhayo da(ya)masya niyamasya ca| tapasastejasA dIptA hUyamAnA ivAgnayaH||14||
dharmArthakAmamokShANAmArogyaM mUlamuttamam||15||
oShadhIrnAmarUpAbhyAM jAnate hyajapA vane| avipAshcaiva gopAshca ye cAnye vanavAsinaH||120||
na nAmaj~jAnamAtreNa rUpaj~jAnena vA punaH| oShadhInAM parAM prAptiM kashcidveditumarhati||121||
yogavittvapyarUpaj~jastAsAM tattvaviducyate| kiM punaryo vijAnIyAdoShadhIH sarvathA bhiShak||122||
yogamAsAM tu yo vidyAddeshakAlopapAditam| puruShaM puruShaM vIkShya sa j~jeyo bhiShaguttamaH||123||
yathA viShaM yathA shastraM yathA~agnirashaniryathA| tathauShadhamavij~jAtaM vij~jAtamamRutaM yathA||124||
auShadhaM hyanabhij~jAtaM nAmarUpaguNaistribhiH| vij~jAtaM cApi duryuktamanarthAyopapadyate||125||
yogAdapi viShaM tIkShNamuttamaM bheShajaM bhavet| bheShajaM cApi duryuktaM tIkShNaM sampadyate viSham||126||
tasmAnna bhiShajA yuktaM yuktibAhyena bheShajam| dhImatA ki~jcidAdeyaM jIvitArogyakA~gkShiNA||127||
kuryAnnipatito mUrdhni sasheShaM vAsavAshaniH| sasheShamAturaM kuryAnnatvaj~jamatamauShadham||128||
duHkhitAya shayAnAya shraddadhAnAya rogiNe| yo bheShajamavij~jAya prAj~jamAnI prayacchati||129||
tyaktadharmasya pApasya mRutyubhUtasya durmateH| naro narakapAtI syAttasya sambhAShaNAdapi||130||
varamAshIviShaviShaM kvathitaM tAmrameva vA| pItamatyagnisantaptA bhakShitA vA~apyayoguDAH||131||
natu shrutavatAM veshaM bibhratA sharaNAgatAt| gRuhItamannaM pAnaM vA vittaM vA rogapIDitAt||132||
bhiShagbubhUShurmatimAnataH svaguNasampadi| paraM prayatnamAtiShThet prANadaH syAdyathA nRuNAm||133||

tadeva yuktaM bhaiShajyaM yadArogyAya kalpate| sa caiva bhiShajAM shreShTho rogebhyo yaH pramocayet||134||

Commentary: atha samyagyuktasya bheShajasya kiM lakShaNaM kiMvA upAdeyasya shreShThavaidyasya lakShaNamityAha- tadevetyAdi| rogebhyo yaH pramocayedityanena ca j~jAnapUrvaM bheShajaprayogeNa rogahArakatvamucyate; tena yAdRucchikasiddhyA kuvaidyavyavahAro na vAcyaH; yAdRucchikasiddhau hi vaidyo na rogapramokShe kAraNaM, kintu ghuNAkSharanyAyena daivAgato bheShajasya samyagyoga iti||134||

samyakprayogaM sarveShAM siddhirAkhyAti karmaNAm| siddhirAkhyAti sarvaishca guNairyuktaM bhiShaktamam||135||

Commentary: kathamArogyAt samyagyogo bheShajasya j~jAyate ityAha- samyakprayogamityAdi| sarveShAmityanenAnyeShAmapi karmaNAM pratimAkaraNAdInAM siddhiH samyagyogaM tatkAraNatAM khyApayati; na hyasamyakprayukte kAraNe samyak kAryaM bhavati| siddhirAkhyAtIti uktA prAtiniyamikI siddhiH, na yAdRucchikI| sarvairguNairiti shrute paryavadAtatvAdibhiH khuDDAkacatuShpAda (sU.a.10) vakShyamANaiH||135||
tatra shlokAH- AyurvedAgamo heturAgamasya pravartanam| sUtraNasyAbhyanuj~jAnamAyurvedasya nirNayaH||136||
sampUrNaM kAraNaM kAryamAyurvedaprayojanam| hetavashcaiva doShAshca bheShajaM sa~ggraheNa ca||137||
rasAH sapratyayadravyAstrividho dravyasa~ggrahaH| mUlinyashca phalinyashca snehAshca lavaNAni ca||138||
mUtraM kShIrANi vRukShAshca ShaD ye kShIratvagAshrayAH| karmANi caiShAM sarveShAM yogAyogaguNAguNAH||139||
vaidyApavAdo yatrasthAH sarve ca bhiShajAM guNAH| sarvametat samAkhyAtaM pUrvAdhyAye maharShiNA||140||
rogAstasyApahartAraH shreyaso jIvitasya ca| prAdurbhUto manuShyANAmantarAyo mahAnayam||16||
kaH syAtteShAM shamopAya ityuktvA dhyAnamAsthitAH| atha te sharaNaM shakraM dadRushurdhyAnacakShuShA||17||
kaH sahasrAkShabhavanaM gacchet praShTuM shacIpatim||18||
ahamarthe niyujyeyamatreti prathamaM vacaH| bharadvAjo~abravIttasmAdRuShibhiH sa niyojitaH||19||
sa shakrabhavanaM gatvA surarShigaNamadhyagam | dadarsha balahantAraM dIpyamAnamivAnalam||20||
so~abhigamya jayAshIrbhirabhinandya sureshvaram| provAca vinayAddhImAnRuShINAM vAkyamuttamam||21||
vyAdhayo hi samutpannAH sarvaprANibhaya~gkarAH| tadbrUhi me shamopAyaM yathAvadamaraprabho||22||
tasmai provAca bhagavAnAyurvedaM shatakratuH| padairalpairmatiM buddhvA vipulAM paramarShaye||23||

hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnaM svasthAturaparAyaNam| trisUtraM shAshvataM puNyaM bubudhe yaM pitAmahaH||24||

Commentary: yAdRusho~asAvalpapadairupadiShTa AyurvedastamAha- hetvityAdi| hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnamiti hetvAdIni j~jAyante~aneneti hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnaM, yAvaccAyurvedavAcyaM tAvaddhetvAdyantarbhUtamityarthaH| hetugrahaNena sannikRuShTaviprakRuShTavyAdhihetugrahaNaM; li~ggagrahaNena ca vyAdherArogyasya ca kRutsnaM li~ggamucyate, tena vyAdhyArogye api li~ggashabdavAcye, yatastAbhyAmapi hi talli~ggaM li~ggyata eva; vakShyati hi viShamArambhamUlAnAM jvara eko hi lakShaNam| viShamArambhamUlAdyairjvara eko nigadyate (ni.a.8) ityAdi; auShadhagrahaNena ca sarvapathyAvarodhaH| sharIraM cAtra hetau li~gge cAntarbhavati| svasthAturayoH paramutkRuShTamayanaM mArga iti svasthAturaparAyaNam| kimanyo~ayaM hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnarUpa Ayurvedo brahmabuddhAdAyurvedAdutAnanya ityAha- trisUtramityAdi| pitAmaho~api yaM trisUtraM bubudhe tamindraH provAca| trINi hetvAdIni sUtryante yasmin yena vA tattrisUtram| tatra sUcanAt sUtraNAccArthasantateH sUtram| etena taM yathA brahmA trisUtraM bubudhe tathaiva hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnamindraH provAcetyaviplutamAgamaM darshayati| bubudha iti na kRutavAn| ata evoktaM- shAshvataM; nityamityarthaH| tacca nityatvaM sUtrasthAnAnte vyutpAdanIyam||24||
so~anantapAraM triskandhamAyurvedaM mahAmatiH| yathAvadacirAt sarvaM bubudhe tanmanA muniH||25||
tenAyuramitaM lebhe bharadvAjaH sukhAnvitam| RuShibhyo~anadhikaM tacca shashaMsAnavasheShayan||26||
sarasvatyai namo yasyAH prasAdAt puNyakarmabhiH| buddhidarpaNasa~gkrAntaM jagadadhyakShamIkShyate||2||

dIrghamAyushcikIrShanta iti prANinAmAtmanashca| j~jAnArthaM j~jAnarUpaM vA cakShurj~jAnacakShuH, tena j~jAnacakShuShA| gRuhItena tenAyurvedena kiM dadRushurityAha- sAmAnyaM cetyAdi| eShAM cottaratra lakShaNaM ShaNNAM padArthAnAM vishvarUpANAM bhaviShyati; tenaitattatraiva vyAkaraNIyam| taditi sAmAnyAdi| tantroktaM vidhimiti apathyaparihArapathyopAdAnarUpam| sharma sukham| paramiti duHkhAnAkrAntam| anitvaramiti agatvaram||27-29||

athetyAdinA bharadvAjashiShyasyAtreyasya punarvasvaparanAmno~agniveshAdigurutAM darshayati| atra kecidbharadvAjAtreyayoraikyaM manyante, tanna; bharadvAjasa~jj~jayA Atreyasya kvacidapi tantrapradeshe~akIrtanAt; hArIte cAtreyAdigurutayA bharadvAja uktaH- “shakrAdahamadhItavAn” ityAdinA “mattaH punarasa~gkhyeyAstrisUtraM triprayojanam| atrAtreyAdiparyantA viduH sapta maharShayaH|| AtreyAddhArIta-RuShiH”- ityantena| vAgbhaTena tu yaduktaM “brahmA smRutvA~a~ayuSho vedaM prajApatimajigrahat| so~ashvinau tau sahasrAkShaM so~atriputrAdikAn munIn” (vA.sU.a.1) ityanenAtreyasyendrashiShyatvaM, tadAyurvedasamutthAnIyarasAyanapAde Adishabdena vakShyamANendrashiShyatAyogAt samarthanIyam| tatra hIndreNa punarmaharShINAmAyurveda upadiShTa iti vaktavyam| maitrIparo maitrIpradhAnaH; maitrI ca sarvaprANiShvAtmanIva buddhiH||30-31||

samprati sAmAnyavisheShAvabhidhAya, uddeshakramAnurodhAdguNe~abhidhAtavye, guNeShu pradhAnabhUtamAyurvedopakAryaM sattvAtmasharIrasaMyogaM vaktumAha- sattvamityAdi; kiMvA sAmAnyavisheShAbhyAmeva hetuli~ggauShadhAni darshitAni, sAmAnyavisheShavata eva sarvatra kAraNatvAlli~ggatvAccaitAvadeva vicAryamANaM tantraM bhavati, adhikaraNaM ca noktam, ataH sattvAdimelakaM hetvAdyadhikaraNamAha- sattvamityAdi| sattvaM manaH| cashabdaH samuccaye| sa~gkhyeyanirdeshAdeva sa~gkhyAyAM labdhAyAM trayamiti padaM militAnAmeva grahaNArtham| etadityanantaroktanirdeshaH| tridaNDaH parasparasaMyogavidhRutaH kumbhAdidhArakastadvat| etena yathA tridaNDe~anyatamApAye nAvasthAnaM, tathA sattvAdInAmanyatamApAye~api na lokasthitirityuktaM bhavati| lokata Alokata iti lokaH, teneha ja~ggamo bhUtagrAma ucyate| saMyogAttiShThatIti parasparopagrAhakAt saMyogAt svArthakriyAM kurvanna vishakalitaM bhavati| atra tu pRuthagindriyagrahaNaM na kRutaM, sharIragrahaNenaiva gRuhItatvAt| tatra sarvaM pratiShThitamiti tasmiMlloke karmaphalAdi vyavasthitaM; yadvakShyati- “atra karmaphalaM cAtra j~jAnaM cAtra pratiShThitam| atra mohaH sukhaM duHkhaM jIvitaM maraNaM svatA” (shA.a.1) iti| sa pumAniti tat sattvAditrayaM pumAniti bhaNyate| tatra yadyapi sattvAditrayaM napuMsakali~ggaM, tathA~api pumAniti vakShyamANali~ggagrahaNAt ‘sa’ iti puMli~gganirdeshaH; yathA- “NeraNau yatkarma Nau cet sa kartAnAdhyAne” (pA.a.1pA.3sU.67) ityAdau| ki~jcaitaditi yadyapi vartamAnanirdeshaH kRutastathA~api tasyaiva ‘sa’ ityatItanirdisho~api sarvanAmnAM sarvakAlanirdeshAdevAviruddho mantavyaH| vadanti hi lAkShaNikAH- “pratyakShe ca parokShe ca sAmIpye dUra eva ca| eteShvartheShu vidvadbhiH sarvanAma prayujyate” iti| cetanamiti j~jAnavat| taccAdhikaraNaM smRutaM tantrasyetyatra hetumAha- tadarthaM hItyAdi| tadarthamiti tadupakArArtham; etena taduddishya pravRuttiradhikaraNArthA nAdhArArtheti darshayati| atra sattvamAdau kRutaM, tadadhInatvAdAtmasharIrakriyAyAH; yaduktaM- “acetanaM kriyAvacca manashcetayitA paraH| yuktasya manasA tasya nirdishantyAtmanaH kriyAm” (shA.a.1) iti| pUrvaM sharIretyAdinA~a~ayuruktaM, sattvamAtmetyAdinA tu tantrAdhikaraNabhUtapuruSha ucyata iti na paunaruktyam| atra cAtmagrahaNena buddhyaha~gkArAdInAM grahaNaM, sharIragrahaNenendriyANAmarthAnAM ca sharIrasambaddhAnAM grahaNaM vyAkhyeyam||46-47||

kathamindra eva sharaNyo na brahmAdaya ityAha- brahmaNA hItyAdi| hi yasmAdarthe| prajApatirdakShanAmA| proktamiti prakarSheNoktaM, prakarShashcAnavasheSheNAbhidhAnam| yathetyanena tathAshabdasya nityasambandhasyAkarShaNAdyAdRushaM proktaM tAdRushameva jagrAha| nikhileneti anavasheSheNa| ashvinau tu tataH prajApaterjagRuhatuH| atrApi yathAproktaM nikhilena cetipadaM tathaiva yojanIyam| evamashvibhyAM bhagavA~jchakraH pratipede hetyatrApi yathAproktamityAdi yojanIyam| hashabdastvavadhAraNe, tena pratipede eva paraM shakro natu kasmaicidAyurvedaM dattavAnityarthaH| anena ca granthenAnyUnAdhikAyurvedAgamopadarshakena yathA brahmaNa Ayurvedaj~jAnaM tathendrasyApIti darshitam| tena brahmaNo vA~a~ayurvedaH shrUyate indrAdveti na ki~jcidarthato visheShaH| indre tvidamadhikaM- yadayamasa~gkrAmitavidyatvena shiShyArthI| yaduktaM- “yo hi gurubhyaH samyagAdAya vidyAM na prayacchatyantevAsibhyaH sa khalvRuNI gurujanasya mahadeno vindati” iti, ato~akRutashiShyatvena shiShyArthitvavisheShayogAdbrahmAdibhyo visheSheNendra eva sharaNya iti| brahmaNastu paramagurorviditasakalavedasya sarvatrAtirohitamaterAyurvedaj~jAnaM svataHsiddhameveti na gurvantarApekShA| etacca brahmAdiguruparamparopadarshanamAyurvedasyAviplutAgamopadarshanArthaM tathA mahApuruShasevitatvenopAdeyatvopadarshanArthaM ca| vacanaM hi- “tatra yanmanyeta mahadyashasvisudhIrapuruShAsevitam” ityAdi yAvat “tadabhiprapadyeta shAstram” (vi.a.8) iti| RuShiprokta iti vakShyamANavRuttAntena RuShiproktaH| tasmAditi yasmAdindra eva visheSheNa sharaNyaH||4-5||

samprati sharIrarogAdhikArapravRuttatvAdasya tantrasya shArIrarogajanakavAtAdilakShaNaM bheShajaM cAha- rUkSha ityAdi| pradhAnatvAdagre vAyorabhidhAnam| rUkShAdInAM jyAyastvAdabhidhAnaM, tena dAruNAdayo~api guNA boddhavyAH; rUkShatvaM ca vAyAvadhikaM, snehasAdhyatvAdvAyoH; ato rUkShatvamagre~abhihitam| yadyapi vaisheShike~anuShNAshIto vAyuH, tathA~apIha shItena vRuddhidarshanAduShNena ca prashamadarshanAttathA kevalavAtArabdhe roge shItadarshanAcca shIta eva vAyuH; yacca pittayuktasyoShNatvaM, tadyogavAhitvAt; yathA pAShANasya yena dravyeNa shItenoShNena vA yogo bhavati tadguNAnuvidhAnaM, tathA vAyorapi| viparItA vAtaguNapratipakShA guNA yasya tadviparItaguNaM; guNashabdena ceha dharmavAcinA rasavIryavipAkaprabhAvAH sarva eva gRuhyante, tena prabhAvAdapi yadvAtaviparItaM tadapi gRuhyate| anye tvekaviparItashabdalopAdviparItaM viparItaguNaM ca grAhayanti; tena viparItagrahaNAt prabhAvaviparItaM gRuhyate, guNavaiparItyAdvipAkAdayo gRuhyante| nanu viparItaguNabhUyiShThairapi vAtAdInAM prashamo bhavati, yato na hi sarvaM bheShajaM vAtAdInAM sarvAtmanA viruddhaM bhavati; uktaM hi- “viruddhaguNasannipAte hi bhUyasA~alpamavajIyate” (vi.a.1) iti; tat kimiti viruddhaguNabhUyiShThasyAgrahaNam? ucyate- viruddhaguNabhUyiShThasyApi viparItaguNashabdenaiva grahaNAt| viparItaguNabhUyiShThe~api ye viparItA alpA abalA vA guNAste svakAryAkartRutvAdavyapadeshyA eva; kiMvA sarvathA viparItaguNairadhikA prashastA ca shAntirbhavati, ata eva samprashabdau shIghrasamyakprashamArthAbhidhAyakau kRutau; viparItaguNabhUyiShThairna tathA shAntirbhavati, ata eva samprashabdAbhyAM na tat sAkShAduktam| evaM ca vyAkhyAnaM pittashleShmaNorapi kartavyam| sasnehamiti IShatsnehaM, tena pitte sarpiShaH snigdhasya bheShajatvamupapannam| amlarasatA ceha pittasyocyate, aptejaHsamArabdhatvAt pittasya; sushrute tu kaTutvameva pittasyoktam, amlatA ca vidagdhasya pittasyoktA| yaduktaM- “vidagdhaM cAmlameva ca” (su.sU.a.21) iti| evaM sasnehatAyAmapi pittasya sushrutasvaraso nAsti| etacca snigdhatvamamlatvaM ca jalAnalArabdhatvAt pittasyopapannameva, sushrute tu tejorUpapittAbhiprAyeNaiva tannirastaM bhavati| shleShmaNo viparItaguNairguNAnAM prashama ucyate, na punaH shleShmaNaH prashamo~abhidhIyate; kasmAdevamucyate? guNaprashamanena ca guNiprashamo guNavRuddhyA ca guNivRuddhirbhavatIti sUcanArtham| yata uShNena shItaprashame kriyamANe shItAdhArasyodakabhAgasyAvashyameva prashamaH kriyate||59-61||

atha kathamayamRuShiprokta ityAyurvedasya martyalokAgame hetumAha- vighnabhUtA ityAdi| vighnabhUtA ityantarAyasvarUpAH| rujantIti rogAH| prAdurbhUtA ityAvirbhUtAH| ayaM ca rogaprAdurbhAvaH kRutayugAnte boddhavyaH| vakShyati hi- “bhrashyati tu kRutayuge” (vi.a.3) ityAdinA rogaprAdurbhAvaM janapadoddhvaMsanIye| prAdurbhAvashca pUrvasiddhasyaivAvirbhAvaH| tena rogasantAnanityatA~apyaviruddhA bhavatyarthedashamahAmUlIye (sU.a.30) vaktavyA| shIryata iti sharIraM, tadasyAstIti sharIrI| etena sharIraM svata eva shIryamANaM rogasambandhAttu nitarAM shIryata iti sUcayati| keShAM vighnabhUtA ityAha- tapopavAsAdhyayanetyAdi| rogagrastA hi sharIriNastapaHprabhRutIni kartuM na pArayanti vikRutatvAt; tathA, AyuShashca mArakatvena kecidgadA virodhakA bhavanti| atra tapashcAndrAyaNAdi, upavAsaH krodhAdiparityAgaH satyAdyupAdAnaM ca, vacanaM hi- “upAvRuttasya pApebhyaH sahavAso guNe hi yaH| upavAsaH sa vij~jeyo na sharIrasya shoShaNam” iti; adhyayanaM vedAdhyayanaM, brahmaNe mokShAya caryaM brahmacaryamupasthanigrahAdi, vratamIpsitakAmo niyamaH, Ayuruktam| tapopavAseti prayogaH pUrvatrAsiddhavidheranityatvena tapaHsakArasthAnibhUtayalopasya siddhatvAjj~jeyaH, yathA “nopadhAyAH” (pA.a.6pA.4sU.7) iti| bhUteShu prANiShu| anukroshamiti anukampAM, kasmAt? anekArthatvAddhAtUnAm| puraskRutya AdRutya| etena prANirogaharaNameva pradhAnamAyurvedopagamane maharShINAM phalam; AyuHprakarShastvanuSha~ggasiddhasteShAM mahAtmanAmiti bhAvaH| nareShviti vaktavye yadayaM bhUteShviti sAmAnyashabdaM karoti, tena na samAnajIvaprayukteyamanukampA , kintu prANimAtraprayukteti samadarshitAmRuShINAM darshayati| mahAntashca te RuShayashceti maharShayaH; anena caturvidhA api RuShayaH- RuShikA, RuShiputrA, devarShayo, maharShayashca gRuhyante; maharShyanugAmitvAdRuShikAdInAmapi grahaNam| puNyaM pAvanaM karma yeShAM te puNyakarmANaH| parshukAbhistRutaM pArshvaM, tena pArshvamiva (tataM) pArshvam| shubhe iti padaM kartavyasamAdhyanuguNopadarshanArthaM, yataH shubhe hi deshe samAdhayaH prasIdanti||6-7||

sampratyanyathA dravyabhedamAha- tat punarityAdi| taditi dravyam| gacchatIti ja~ggamam, udbhidya pRuthivIM jAyata iti audbhidaM vRukShAdi, uktaprakAradvayAtiriktaH pRuthivIvikAraH pArthivam| saMsvedajasyeha krimyAderja~ggame~avarodhaH, kukuNDakAdeshca audbhide| iha ca dravyashabdena pArthivadravyamevocyate; tena jalAnilAgnyAdInAmagrahaNAdavyAptirna vAcyA| ja~ggamashabdena ja~ggamaprabhavaM gorasamadhvAdyapi grAhyam| evamaudbhidapArthivayorapi grahaNaM vAcyam| rocanA gorocanA| etacca madhvAdi prAya upayogitvAt prAdhAnyAduktaM; tenANDabastyAdInAM ca grahaNaM boddhavyam| yadyapi ja~ggamAnantaraM bahuprapa~jcatvena pradhAnatvAdaudbhidamupadiShTaM, tathA~apyabahuvaktavyatvAt pArthivameva ja~ggamAnantaraM vivriyate; tadanu bahuvaktavyamaudbhidam| suvarNamityAdi| pa~jca lohA iti tAmrarajatatrapushIsakRuShNalohAnAM grahaNam| samalA iti malashabdena shilAjatUni lohamalarUpANi gRuhyante, tacca sushrutadarshanAt suvarNarajatAdibhavaM ShaDvidhameva gRuhyate; sushrute hi ShaDvidhameva shilAjatUktam, iha tu rasAyane caturvidhamuktaM- “caturbhyo dhAtubhyastasya sambhavaH| hemno~atha rajatAttAmrAdvaraM kRuShNAyasAdapi” (ci.a.1) iti vacanAt| etacca vacanaM rasAyanAdhikAritAM caturvidhasya shilAjatuno darshayati, natu ShaDvidhashilAjatupratiShedhaparamiti na sushrutena samaM virodhaH| kiMvA suvarNaM nirmalaM, samalAstu rajatatAmratrapushIsalohAH (iti militvA pa~jca lohAH|) shilAjatupAShANapa~gkaprabhRutInAM tu grahaNamuddiShTashabdena sUcitam; uddesho hyalpakathanam| sudhA gA~ggeyikA| AlaM haritAlam| a~jjanaM sauvIrA~jjanam| phalairvanaspatiriti vinApuShpaiH phalairyuktA vaTodumbarAdayaH| yaduktaM hArIte- “teShAmapuShpAH phalino vanaspataya iti smRutAH” iti| puShpairvAnaspatyaH phalairapIti puShpAnantaraM phalabhAja ityarthaH| phalasya pAkAdanto vinAsho yeShAM tilamudgAdInAM te phalapAkAntAH; atra kecit phalapAkAntAH pAkAntAshcauShadhya iti vadanti; tena vinA~api phalaM pAkenaivAnto yeShAM dUrvAdInAM te~api gRuhyante| pratAnashabdena latA gulmAshca gRuhyante| yaduktaM hArItena- “latA gulmAshca vIrudhaH” iti| mUlatvagityAdau niryAso lAkShAsarjarasAdiH| audbhido gaNa ityaudbhidasamudbhUto gaNaH||68-73||-

sampratyatraiva ja~ggamaudbhidapArthivadravye yat prashastaM tadAha- mUlinya ityAdi| mUlaM prashastatamaM yAsAM tA mUlinyaH; evaM phalinyo~api| ShoDasheti cchedaH| mahAsnehA iti kShIramAMsAdInAmapi snehatayA snehAdhyAye vakShyamANatvena teShu sarpirAdInAM bhUrisnehavattvena mahattvam| pa~jcaiva lavaNAnIti vimAne (vi.a.8) vakShyamANalavaNabahutve pa~jcAnAmeva prashastatvena darshanArtham| evaM mUtrAdiShvapi prAdhAnyamunneyaM sajAtIyeShu| vedaviditi Ayurvedavit||74-76||

hastidantItyAdi| hastidantI bRuhatphalA goDumbA, ‘iyameva nAgadantI bhaNyate’ ityeke| haimavatI vacA| shyAmA shyAmamUlA trivRut| adhoguDA praddhadArakaH| saptalA carmakaShA| shvetanAmA shvetA~aparAjitA| pratyakshreNI dantI| bimbI oShThopamaphalA| shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA| viShANikA AvartanI| ajagandhA ‘phokAndI’ iti khyAtA| dravantI dantyeva cIritapatrA| kShIriNI dugdhikA| mUlinInAM vamanAdiviniyogamAha- shaNapuShpItyAdi||77-79||-

sha~gkhinI shvetabuhnA(dhna)| klItakaM yaShTImadhu; asya tu yadyapi sushrute mUlaM prashastaM, mUlenaiva vyavahAraH, tathA~api virecanaM prati yaShTImadhudvayasyApi phalameva prashastaM j~jeyam| dhAmArgavaH pItaghoShakaH| ikShvAkuH tiktAlAbuH| jImUto ghoShakabhedaH| kRutavedhanaM jyotsnikA| prakIryodakIrye kara~jjadvayam| pratyakpuShpA apAmArgaH| antaHkoTarapuShpI nIlabudhnA| hastiparNI moraTaH, asyAshca sharatkAlabhavameva phalaM grAhyaM; ata uktaM- hastiparNyAshca shAradamiti| kampillakaM guNDArocanikA| Aragvadhasya yadyapi sushrute patraM pradhAnamuktaM, tathA~apIha phalaM gRuhyate pradhAnatamatvAt| dhAmArgavamityAdinA pa~jcakarmaviniyoga ucyate| nastaH pracchardana iti shirovirecane||80-85||-
mahAsneheShu sarpirAdau paThitaM, prAdhAnyAt; vacanaM hi- “nAnyaH snehastathA kashcit saMskAramanuvartate| yathA sarpirataH sarpiH sarvasnehottamaM matam” (ni.a.1) iti||86-87||-

lavaNeShu yadyapi saindhavaM pradhAnaM, yato vakShyati- “saindhavaM lavaNAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityagryAdhikAre, tathA~api sauvarcalasya rocanatvaprakarShAttathA saindhavamanu prAdhAnyakhyApanArthamagre pAThaH| audbhidam autkArikAlavaNaM, kecicchAmbharilavaNamAhuH| sAmudraM dakShiNasamudrabhavaM ‘karakaca’ iti khyAtam| abhya~jjana iti snehAbhya~gge| vartyarthamiti phalavartyartham||88-91||-

avimUtramityAdau strImUtrameva prashastamiti li~ggaparigrahAddarshayati; yataH strINAM laghva~ggatvAnmUtramapi laghu; vacanaM hi- “lAghavaM jAtisAmAnye strINAM puMsAM ca gauravam” (sU.a.27) iti| yattUcyate- puMsAM mUtraM shukrasambandhAdguru; tanna, shukrasambandhasya strINAmapi shukravattvena tulyatvAt; vacanaM hi- “yadA nArI hi nAryA tu maithunAyopapadyate| mu~jcataH shukramanyo~anyamanasthistatra jAyate ” ityAdi; napuMsakamUtraM tvama~ggalatvAnna gRuhyate| agadeShvityanenAgadaprayogayaugikatvaM, viShaghnamityanena ca kevalasyaiva viShahantRutvamiti na paunaruktyam| sharma cocyata iti ArogyarUpasukhakartRutvAt| adhobhAgamiti adhomArgeNa pittaM karShet; kiMvA yadevAdhogataM pittaM tadeva virecayati nordhvagam| yathAsAmarthyayogata iti yAdRushaH shaktiyogo mUtrANAM tathA||92-104||-

prAyasho madhuramiti prAdhAnyena madhuram| tena kShIramuShTrINAmIShallavaNaM tathA chAgaM kaShAyamityAdau rasAntarasyAprAdhAnyenAnubandho~api kShIre bhavatIti darshayati| prAyasha iti bRuMhaNaM snigdhamityetAbhyAM tathA shItamityanena ca sambadhyate; tenauShTrasya rUkShoShNatvAbhidhAnaM na virodhi| stanyamiti stanyavRuddhikaram| manaskaramiti prabhAvAdojaskaratvAcca; ojovRuddhyA hi tadanuvidhAyino manaso~api svakarmasAmarthyaM bhavati| etadeva ca nityasyeha manasaH karaNaM yanmanasaH prakarShabuddhyutkarShAdiguNakaraNam| hanti shoNitapittamiti avasthAvisheShApannameva shoNitapittaM hanti| vacanaM hi- “kaShAyayogairvividhairyathoktairdIpte~anale shleShmaNi nirjite ca| yadraktapittaM prashamaM na yAti tatrAnilaH syAdanu, tatra kAryam|| chAgaM payaH syAt paramaM prayoge gavyaM shRutaM pa~jcaguNe jale vA” (ci.a.4) iti| evaM ca yaducyate- adhobhAge raktapitte saratvAt kShIramayaugikam, Urdhvage ca kaphakartRutayA~ayaugikamiti, tannirastam| sarvaprANabhRutAM sAtmyamityatra sarvashabdashcikitsyatayA prakRutasarvamanuShyeShveva vartate, tena kShIrasya saMsvedajAdiprANyasAtmyatvaM nodbhAvanIyaM; kiMvA sarvashabdo~ayaM bhUrivacanaH||105-113||
phalamUlibhiriti pRuthakshabdayogAdapAdAne tRutIyA| ashmantako mAluyAsadRushapatro vRukShaH||114-115||

pUtIkaH kaNTakIkara~jjaH| tilvako lodhraH; tasya taruriti visheShaNena paTTikAlodhraM vyudasyati, shAbaralodhraM ca mahApramANaM tarushabdayogyaM grAhayati; kiMvA taruvisheShaNena bAlaM lodhraM vyudasyati| ShaDvRukShA~j shodhanAnityatra yadyapi kRuShNagandhAyAH pa~jcakarmaNyanabhidhAnAnna shodhanatvaM, tathA~api bAhyAlepanena bahiHsthitadoShasaMshodhanatvaM boddhavyaM; kiMvA apishabdAt kRuShNagandhAyA ashodhanatvamapi sUcyate||116-119||

ke te maharShaya ityAha- a~ggirA ityAdi| bahvRuShINAmatra kIrtanaM granthAdau pApakShayahetutvena, tathA~a~ayurvedasyaivaMvidhamahApuruShasevitatvena sevyatvopadarshanArthaM ceti| eShu ca madhye kecidyAyAvarAH, kecicchAlInAH, kecidayonijAH, evamprakArAshca sarve militA boddhavyAH| bhikShurityAtreyavisheShaNaM, vakShyati hi- “tanneti bhikShurAtreyaH” (sU.a.25) iti| vaikhAnasA iti karmavisheShaprayuktA sa~jj~jA| vAlakhilyAstu svalpapramANAH kecidRuShayaH| nidhaya iva nidhayo~akShayasthAnatvena| damo dAntatvam| imAmiti agre vakShyamANAm||8-14||-

uktAnAmoShadhInAM yogaj~jAnasya prAdhAnyaM darshayannAha- oShadhIrityAdi| parAM prAptimiti utkRuShTaM vyAdhisharIrAdyapekShaM samyagyogam| yogo vyAdhisharIrAdyapekShA samyagyojanA bheShajasya| sarvatheti nAmarUpayogaiH| yogameva vishiShTaM darshayannAha- yogamityAdi| deshakAlopapAditamiti deshakAlakRutam| puruShaM puruShaM vIkShyeti vIpsAyAM, pratipuruShaM prakRutyAdibhedena yogasya prAyo bhedo bhavatIti darshayati| puruShashabdena ceha saMyogapuruSho~abhipretaH||120-123||

yogasyauShadhaj~jAnAdhInatvAdauShadhAj~jAnasya mahAnarthakAritAM bahubhirdRuShTAntairdarshayati- yathA viShamityAdi| viShAdibahudRuShTAntenAj~jAtaM bheShajaM ki~jcidviShavat sa~jj~jAnAshaM kRutvA mArayati, ki~jcicca shastravanmarmacchedaM kRutvA mArayati, ki~jciccAgnivat sphoTAdikaM kRutvA mArayati, ki~jciccAshanivat sadyo mArayatIti darshayati| nAmarUpaguNairityanena tritve labdhe punastribhiriti vacanamekaikaj~jAnapratiShedhArthaM; tena tribhireva militairj~jAtaM bheShajaM prashastamiti darshayati||124-125||

yogaM stauti- yogAdapItyAdi| viShaM ca samyagyogAdbheShajaM bhavatIti “tilaM dadyAdviShasya tu” (ci.a.1) ityAdiprayoge boddhavyam| na kevalamAtureNaivAbhiShajo bheShajaM nAdeyaM, kintu bhiShajA~api yuktibAhyena bheShajamAturAya na deyamityAha- duHkhitAyetyAdi||126-133||

tatra shlokA iti tantrakArasya rItiriyaM yat- yatroktamarthaM sa~ggraheNAbhidhatte tatra ‘tatra shlokA’ iti karoti; yatra tUktAdanadhikamucyate tatra ‘bhavati cAtra’ iti karoti; na cAsya niShprayojanatvaM, tantradharmatvAt| adhyAyoktamarthamadhyAyAnte sa~ggraheNAbhidhatte- AyurvedAgama ityAdinA| sa~ggrahakathanaM ca pUrvoktArthasya sa~gkShepeNa grahaNArthaM tathA durj~jAnapratiShedhArthaM ca| yato yatki~jcidatra durj~jAnaM syAttadiha pratipAditArthasaMvAdenAvadhAryate| vacanaM hi- “gadyokto yaH punaH shlokairarthaH samanugIyate| tadvyaktivyavasAyArthaM dviruktiH sA na garhyate” (ni.a.1) iti| atra ca gadyokta iti vistaroktopalakShaNam| tena shlokoktasyApyAragvadhIyAdyarthasya punaH shlokena sa~ggrahaNamaviruddham| vyaktiH spaShTatA, vyavasAyaH avadhAraNam| Agama iti “dIrgha~jjIvitamanvicchan” ityAdinA, heturiti AyurvedAgamahetuH, sa ca “vighnabhUtA yadA rogA” ityAdinA rogaprAdurbhAva uktaH; kiMvA “dIrgha~jjIvitamanvicchan” ityAdishloko visheSheNAyurvedAgamasya tathA~a~ayurvedAgamahetoshca piNDasUtrarUpaH, “brahmaNA hi” ityAdigranthastvAyurvedAgamapratipAdakaH, hetupratipAdakastu “vighnabhUtA” ityAdigrantho yathokta eva| Agamasya pravartanamiti indrAdAnIya bharadvAjena martyaloke pravartanamAyurvedagrahaNaparyantam| sUtraNamityAyurvedatantrakaraNamagniveshAdInAm| abhyanuj~jAnamiti “tAni cAnumatAni” ityAdi| sheShaM sugamam||136-140||

dhAraNAddharmaH sa cAtmasamavetaH kAryadarshanAnumeyaH, arthaH suvarNAdiH, kAmyata iti kAmo vanitApariShva~ggAdiH, mokShaH saMsAravimokShaH| ArogyaM rogAbhAvAddhAtusAmyam| mUlaM kAraNam| uttamamiti pradhAnaM; tenArogyaM caturvarge pradhAnaM kAraNaM, rogagRuhItasya kvacidapi puruShArthe~asamarthatvAdityuktam| tasyApahartAra iti ArogyasyApahartAraH; idameva ca rogANAmArogyApaharaNaM yadanarthalAbhaH; na punarutpanno rogaH pashcAdArogyamapaharati, bhAvAbhAvayoH parasparAbhAvAtmakatvAt| shreyaso jIvitasya ceti shreyovajjIvitaM hitatvena sukhatvena cArthedashamahAmUlIye (sU.a.30) vakShyamANaM, tasya jIvitasyApahartAra iti yojanIyam; ashreyojIvitamahitatvena duHkhahetutayA cAnupAdeyamiti kRutvA tadapaharaNamiha noktam| atra sukhahitajIvitopaghAto dharmAdyupaghAtenaiva labdhaH; tena vayaM pashyAmaH- shreyaHshabdena sAmAnyenAbhyudayavAcinA dharmAdayo~abhidhIyante, jIvitashabdena ca jIvitamAtraM, yato jIvitaM svarUpeNaiva sarvaprANinAM nirupAdhyupAdeyaM; vacanaM hi- “Acakame ca brahmaNa iyamAtmA AshIH- AyuShmAn bhUyAsam” iti| yattvatyantaduHkhagRuhItasya jIvitaM jihAsitaM, tatra duHkhasyAtyantajihAsitasyAnyathAhAtumashakyatvAt priyamapi jIvitaM tyaktumicchati na svarUpeNa| antarAya iti dharmAdisAdhane boddhavyaH| ayamiti rogaprAdurbhAvarUpaH| teShAmiti rogANAm| sharaNamiti rakShitAram| shaktatvAcchakra ucyate| dhyAnaM samAdhivisheShaH, tadupalabdhisAdhanatvAccakShuriva dhyAnacakShuH, ‘tena sa vakShyati shamopAyaM yathAvadamaraprabhuH’ iti dhyAnacakShuShA dadRushuriti yojanA||15-17||-

athaiteShu madhye bharadvAjaH kathamindramupAgamadityAha- ka ityAdi| shacIpatimityanena shacIsambhogavyAsaktamapyahamupAsituM kShama iti bharadvAjo darshayati| arthe prayojane| niyujyeyaM vyApArayeyam| atreti prakRutaprayojana eva, atretishabdo yasmAdarthe| yathA- subhikShamityAgataH; yasmAt subhikShaM tasmAdAgata ityarthaH| niyojita iti caurAdiko Nic, na hetau| anena prakaraNena bharadvAjasyAyurvedAgame visheSheNArthitvAnna preraNamiti darshitaM bhavati| provAceti samyaguvAca; na tu prashabdaH prapa~jcArthaH, padairalpairityuktatvAt| kasmAt padairalpairuvAcetyAha- matiM buddhvA vipulAmiti; yasmAdvipulamatiM bharadvAjaM pratipannavAn tasmAt padairalpairuvAceti bhAvaH; matishca bahuviShayatvenopacArAdvipuletyucyate, sA ca matiH shushrUShAshravaNagrahaNadhAraNohApohatattvAbhiniveshavatIha vipulA boddhavyA| atra cendreNa divyadRushA bharadvAjAbhiprAyamagrata eva buddhvA~a~ayurveda upadiShTaH; tena bharadvAjasyendrapRucchAdIha na darshitaM, kiMvA bhUtamapIndrapRucchAdi granthavistarabhayAdiha na likhitam||18-23||

athoddiShTamAyurvedaM kathaM gRuhItavAn bharadvAja ityAha- so~anantetyAdi| avidyamAnAvantapArau yasyAsAvanantapAraH, atra pArashabdena gobalIvardanyAyenAdirucyate; pArashabdo hyubhayorapi nadIkUlayorvivakShAvashAdvartate; kiMvA ananto mokShaH, pAramutkRuShTaM phalaM yasyAyurvedasyAsAvanantapAraH| vakShyati hi- cikitsA tu naiShThikI yA vinopadhAm (shA.a.1) iti| atra naiShThikI mokShasAdhanahetuH | trayo hetvAdayaH skandharUpA yasya sa triskandhaH; skandhashca sthUlAvayavaH pravibhAgo vA| tatraivAyurvedagrahaNe mano yasya sa tanmanAH| mananAt j~jAnaprakarShashAlitvAnmuniH | etena yasmAdayaM mahAmatistanmanAH munishca tenAnantapAramapyAyurvedaM hetvAdiskandhatrayamAlambanaM kRutvA yathAvadacirAdeva pratipannavAnityAshayaH| acirAditi acireNa| atra ca yathA brahmA trisUtraM bubudhe yathA cendro hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnaM provAca tathaiva bharadvAjo~api triskandhaM taM bubudhe ityanenAyurvedasyAviplutAgamatvamupadarshyate; tena trisUtratriskandhayorna punaruktiH| teneti indrAdgRuhItenAyurvedena| amitamiti amitamivAmitam, atidIrghatvAt| AyuHshabdashcAyuHkAraNe rasAyanaj~jAne boddhavyaH; yenottarakAlaM hi rasAyanopayogAdayaM bharadvAjo~amitamAyuravApsyati (na RuShibhya AyurvedakathanAt pUrvaM rasAyanamAcarati sma); kiMvA sarvaprANyupakArArthAdhItAyurvedajanitadharmavashAttatkAlamevAmitamAyurlebhe bharadvAja iti boddhavyam| tacceti shrutaM; yadA tamiti pAThaH, tadA tamAyurvedam| anavasheShayanniti kArtsnyenetyarthaH| AyurvedamadhItyAnantaramevAyaM tamRuShibhyo dattavAn||25-26||
athAto mahArogAdhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

sarvasharIracarAstu vAtapittashleShmANaH sarvasmi~jcharIre kupitAkupitAH shubhAshubhAni kurvanti- prakRutibhUtAH shubhAnyupacayabalavarNaprasAdAdIni, ashubhAni punarvikRutimApannA vikArasa~jj~jakAni||9||

tatra vikArAH sAmAnyajA, nAnAtmajAshca| tatra sAmAnyajAH pUrvamaShTodarIye vyAkhyAtAH, nAnAtmajAMstvihAdhyAye~anuvyAkhyAsyAmaH| tadyathA- ashItirvAtavikArAH, catvAriMshat pittavikArAH, viMshatiH shleShmavikArAH||10||

tatrAdau vAtavikArAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH| tadyathA- nakhabhedashca, vipAdikA ca, pAdashUlaM ca, pAdabhraMshashca, pAdasuptatA ca, vAtakhuDDatA ca, gulphagrahashca, piNDikodveShTanaM ca, gRudhrasI ca, jAnubhedashca, jAnuvishleShashca, Urustambhashca, UrusAdashca, pA~ggulyaM ca, gudabhraMshashca, gudArtishca, vRuShaNAkShepashca , shephastambhashca, va~gkShaNAnAhashca, shroNibhedashca, viDbhedashca, udAvartashca, kha~jjatvaM ca, kubjatvaM ca, vAmanatvaM ca, trikagrahashca, pRuShThagrahashca, pArshvAvamardashca, udarAveShTashca, hRunmohashca , hRuddravashca, vakShaudgharShashca , vakShauparodhashca, vakShastodashca, bAhushoShashca, grIvAstambhashca, manyAstambhashca, kaNThoddhvaMsashca, hanubhedashca , oShThabhedashca, akShibhedashca , dantabhedashca, dantashaithilyaM ca, mUkatvaM ca , vAksa~ggashca, kaShAyAsyatA ca, mukhashoShashca, arasaj~jatA ca, ghrANanAshashca, karNashUlaM ca, ashabdashravaNaM ca, uccaiHshrutishca , bAdhiryaM ca, vartmastambhashca, vartmasa~gkocashca, timiraM ca, akShishUlaM ca, akShivyudAsashca, bhrUvyudAsashca, sha~gkhabhedashca, lalATabhedashca, shiroruk ca, keshabhUmisphuTanaM ca, arditaM ca, ekA~ggarogashca, sarvA~ggarogashca, pakShavadhashca , AkShepakashca, daNDakashca, tamashca , bhramashca, vepathushca, jRumbhA ca, hikkA ca, viShAdashca, atipralApashca, raukShyaM ca, pAruShyaM ca, shyAvAruNAvabhAsatA ca, asvapnashca, anavasthitacittatvaM ca; ityashItirvAtavikArA vAtavikArANAmaparisa~gkhyeyAnAmAviShkRutatamA vyAkhyAtAH||11||

sarveShvapi khalveteShu vAtavikAreShUkteShvanyeShu cAnukteShu vAyoridamAtmarUpamapariNAmi karmaNashca svalakShaNaM, yadupalabhya tadavayavaM vA vimuktasandehA vAtavikAramevAdhyavasyanti kushalAH; tadyathA- raukShyaM shaityaM lAghavaM vaishadyaM gatiramUrtatvamanavasthitatvaM ceti vAyorAtmarUpANi; evaMvidhatvAcca vAyoH karmaNaH svalakShaNamidamasya bhavati taM taM sharIrAvayavamAvishataH ; tadyathA- sraMsabhraMsavyAsasa~ggabhedasAdaharShatarShakampavartacAlatodavyathAceShTAdIni , tathA kharaparuShavishadasuShirAruNavarNakaShAyavirasamukhatvashoShashUlasuptisa~gkocanastambhanakha~jjatAdIni ca vAyoH karmANi; tairanvitaM vAtavikAramevAdhyavasyet||12||

Commentary: vAyoridamityAdau vAyoridamAtmarUpaM svarUpam| apariNAmIti sahajasiddhaM nAnyopAdhikRutamityarthaH| karmaNashceti vikRutasya vAyoH karmaNaH| svalakShaNamiti AtmIyaM lakShaNam| atrApyapariNAmIti sambadhyate; apariNAmIti pittashleShmasambandhanirapekShaM, na tu sharIrAvayavAnapekShamiti; yataH brUte- taM taM sharIrAvayavamAvishataH iti; ata eva ca sraMsAdInAM sharIrAvayavApekShatvena na sarvadA bhAvaH| evaM ca pittashleShmaNorapi cAtmarUpAdi vyAkhyeyam| amUrtatvamiti adRushyatvam| evaMvidhatvAditi raukShyAdiyuktatvAdvAyoriti sambandhaH| sraMsaH ki~jcitsvasthAnacalanam, bhraMshastu dUragatiH| vyAsaH vistaraNam| harShaH vAyoranavasthitatvena prabhAvAdvA kriyate| vartulIkaraNaM vartaH| cAlaH spandaH| rasavarNau vAyunA rasavarNarahitenApi prabhAvAt kriyete||12||

taM madhurAmlalavaNasnigdhoShNairupakramairupakrameta, snehasvedAsthApanAnuvAsananastaHkarmabhojanAbhya~ggotsAdanapariShekAdibhirvAtaharairmAtrAM kAlaM ca pramANIkRutya; tatrAsthApanAnuvAsanaM tu khalu sarvatropakramebhyo vAte pradhAnatamaM manyante bhiShajaH, taddhyAdita eva pakvAshayamanupravishya kevalaM vaikArikaM vAtamUlaM chinatti; tatrAvajite~api vAte sharIrAntargatA vAtavikArAH prashAntimApadyante, yathA vanaspatermUle chinne skandhashAkhAprarohakusumaphalapalAshAdInAM niyato vinAshastadvat||13||

Commentary: prastAvAgatatvena cikitsAsUtramAha- taM madhuretyAdi| Adita eveti shIghrameva| kevalaM vaikArikamiti sakalavikArakArakam ||13||

pittavikArAMshcatvAriMshatamata UrdhvamanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- oShashca, ploShashca, dAhashca, davathushca, dhUmakashca, amlakashca, vidAhashca, antardAhashca, aMsadAhashca , UShmAdhikyaM ca, atisvedashca (a~ggasvedashca), a~ggagandhashca, a~ggAvadaraNaM ca, shoNitakledashca, mAMsakledashca, tvagdAhashca, (mAMsadAhashca ), tvagavadaraNaM ca, carmadalanaM ca, raktakoThashca, raktavisphoTashca, raktapittaM ca, raktamaNDalAni ca, haritatvaM ca, hAridratvaM ca, nIlikA ca, kakShA(kShyA)ca, kAmalA ca, tiktAsyatA ca, lohitagandhAsyatA ca, pUtimukhatA ca, tRuShNAdhikyaM ca, atRuptishca, AsyavipAkashca, galapAkashca, akShipAkashca, gudapAkashca, meDhrapAkashca, jIvAdAnaM ca , tamaHpraveshashca, haritahAridranetramUtravarcastvaM ca; iti catvAriMshatpittavikArAH pittavikArANAmaparisa~gkhyeyAnAmAviShkRutatamA vyAkhyAtAH||14||

sarveShvapi khalveteShu pittavikAreShUkteShvanyeShu cAnukteShu pittasyedamAtmarUpamapariNAmi karmaNashca svalakShaNaM, yadupalabhya tadavayavaM vA vimuktasandehAH pittavikAramevAdhyavasyanti kushalAH; tadyathA- auShNyaM taikShNyaM dravatvamanatisneho varNashca shuklAruNavarjo gandhashca visro rasau ca kaTukAmlau saratvaM ca pittasyAtmarUpANi; evaMvidhatvAcca pittasya karmaNaH svalakShaNamidamasya bhavati taM taM sharIrAvayavamAvishataH; tadyathA- dAhauShNyapAkasvedakledakothakaNDUsrAvarAgA yathAsvaM ca gandhavarNarasAbhinirvartanaM pittasya karmANi; tairanvitaM pittavikAramevAdhyavasyet||15||

taM madhuratiktakaShAyashItairupakramairupakrameta snehavirekapradehapariShekAbhya~ggAdibhiH pittaharairmAtrAM kAlaM ca pramANIkRutya; virecanaM tu sarvopakramebhyaH pitte pradhAnatamaM manyante bhiShajaH; taddhyAdita evAmAshayamanupravishya kevalaM vaikArikaM pittamUlamapakarShati, tatrAvajite pitte~api sharIrAntargatAH pittavikArAH prashAntimApadyante, yathA~agnau vyapoDhe kevalamagnigRuhaM shItIbhavati tadvat||16||

shleShmavikArAMshca viMshatimata UrdhvaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- tRuptishca, tandrA ca, nidrAdhikyaM ca, staimityaM ca, gurugAtratA ca, AlasyaM ca, mukhamAdhuryaM ca, mukhasrAvashca, shleShmodgiraNaM ca, malasyAdhikyaM ca, balAsakashca , apaktishca, hRudayopalepashca, kaNThopalepashca, dhamanIprati(vi)cayashca, galagaNDashca, atisthaulyaM ca, shItAgnitA ca, udardashca, shvetAvabhAsatA ca, shvetamUtranetravarcastvaM ca; iti viMshatiH shleShmavikArAH shleShmavikArANAmaparisa~gkhyeyAnAmAviShkRutatamA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||17||

sarveShvapi khalveteShu shleShmavikAreShUkteShvanyeShu cAnukteShu shleShmaNa idamAtmarUpamapariNAmi karmaNashca svalakShaNaM yadupalabhya tadavayavaM vA vimuktasandehAH shleShmavikAramevAdhyavasyanti kushalAH; tadyathA- snehashaityashauklyagauravamAdhuryasthairyapaicchilyamArtsnyAni shleShmaNa AtmarUpANi; evaMvidhatvAcca shleShmaNaH karmaNaH svalakShaNamidamasya bhavati taM taM sharIrAvayavamAvishataH; tadyathA- shvaityashaityakaNDUsthairyagauravasnehasuptikledopadehabandhamAdhuryacirakAritvAni shleShmaNaH karmANi; tairanvitaM shleShmavikAramevAdhyavasyet||18||

taM kaTukatiktakaShAyatIkShNoShNarUkShairupakramairupakrameta svedavamanashirovirecanavyAyAmAdibhiH shleShmaharairmAtrAM kAlaM ca pramANIkRutya; vamanaM tu sarvopakramebhyaH shleShmaNi pradhAnatamaM manyante bhiShajaH, taddhyAdita evAmAshayamanupravishyorogataM kevalaM vaikArikaM shleShmamUlamUrdhvamutkShipati, tatrAvajite shleShmaNyapi sharIrAntargatAH shleShmavikArAH prashAntimApadyante, yathA bhinne kedArasetau shAliyavaShaShTikAdInyanabhiShyandyamAnAnyambhasA prashoShamApadyante tadvaditi||19||
bhavanti cAtra- rogamAdau parIkSheta tato~anantaramauShadham| tataH karma bhiShak pashcAjj~jAnapUrvaM samAcaret||20||
yastu rogamavij~jAya karmANyArabhate bhiShak| apyauShadhavidhAnaj~jastasya siddhiryadRucchayA||21||
yastu rogavisheShaj~jaH sarvabhaiShajyakovidaH| deshakAlapramANaj~jastasya siddhirasaMshayam||22||

catvAro rogA bhavanti- AgantuvAtapittashleShmanimittAH; teShAM caturNAmapi rogANAM rogatvamekavidhaM bhavati, ruksAmAnyAt; dvividhA punaH prakRutireShAm, AgantunijavibhAgAt; dvividhaM caiShAmadhiShThAnaM, manaHsharIravisheShAt ; vikArAH punaraparisa~gkhyeyAH, prakRutyadhiShThAnali~ggAyatanavikalpavisheShAparisa~gkhyeyatvAt ||3||

Commentary: AgantoruktasyApi trishothIye punariha visheSheNa lakShaNAdyabhidhAnArthamabhidhAnam| prakRutiriha svabhAvaH| manaHsharIravisheShAditi Agantorapi manaH sharIraM cAdhiShThAnam, evaM nijasyApi; AgantugrahaNena ca mAnaso~api kAmAdirgRuhyate| evaM caturvidhatvAdi pratipAdya punaH prakArAntareNAparisa~gkhyeyatAM rogANAmAha- vikArA ityAdi| punariti vakShyamANaprakArAntareNa| prakRutiH pratyAsannaM kAraNaM vAtAdi, adhiShThAnaM dUShyaM, li~ggAni lakShaNAni, AyatanAni bAhyahetavo duShTAhArAcArAH; eShAM vikalparUpo visheSho vikalpavisheShaH, teShAmaparisa~gkhyeyatvAditi| atra doShAH saMsargAMshAMshavikalpAdibhirasa~gkhyeyAH, dUShyAstu sharIrAvayavA aNushaH parasparamelakena vibhajyamAnA asa~gkhyeyAH, li~ggAni kRutsnavikAragatAnyasa~gkhyeyAnyeva, AviShkRutAni tu tantre kathitAni, hetavashcAvAntaravisheShAdasa~gkhyeyAH pravyaktA eva| kecit punaH ‘eShAM vikArAH’ iti paThanti, sa tu pATho nAnumatastAvat; yadi ca syAttadA dehamanaHpratyavamarshakam eShAm iti padaM, bahuvacanaM tu manaHsharIrayorbahutvavivakShayA||3||
tatra shlokAH- sa~ggrahaH prakRutirdesho vikAramukhamIraNam | asandeho~anubandhashca rogANAM samprakAshitaH||23||
doShasthAnAni rogANAM gaNA nAnAtmajAshca ye| rUpaM pRuthak ca doShANAM karma cApariNAmi yat||24||
pRuthaktvena ca doShANAM nirdiShTAH samupakramAH| samya~gmahati rogANAmadhyAye tattvadarshinA||25||

mukhAni tu khalvAgantornakhadashanapatanAbhicArAbhishApAbhiSha~ggAbhighAtavyadha- bandhanaveShTanapIDanarajjudahanashastrAshanibhUtopasargAdIni, nijasya tu mukhaM vAtapittashleShmaNAM vaiShamyam||4||

Commentary: mukhAni kAraNAni; yathA “rajasvalAgamanamalakShmImukhAnAm” (sU. 25) iti||4||

dvayostu khalvAgantunijayoH preraNamasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH, praj~jAparAdhaH, pariNAmashceti||5||

Commentary: preraNamiti kAraNam, anekArthatvAddhAtUnAm||5||

sarve~api tu khalvete~abhipravRuddhAshcatvAro rogAH parasparamanubadhnanti, na cAnyonyena saha sandehamApadyante ||6||

Commentary: anubadhnanti anugacchanti| na sandehamApadyanta iti na sandehaviShayatAmApadyante; mishrIbhUtA api pratisvaM bhinnairlakShaNairbhedena j~jAyanta ityarthaH||6||

Aganturhi vyathApUrvaM samutpanno jaghanyaM vAtapittashleShmaNAM vaiShamyamApAdayati; nije tu vAtapittashleShmANaH pUrvaM vaiShamyamApadyante jaghanyaM vyathAmabhinirvartayanti||7||

Commentary: AgantunijayorbhedakaM lakShaNamAha- AganturhItyAdi| AganturutpannaH san, vyathApUrvamiti pIDAM prathamaM kRutvA, pashcAddoShANAM vaiShamyamiti doShavaiShamyalakShaNamuktaM; svalakShaNakArakaM tu vaiShamyamAgantorAditaHprabhRuti vidyamAnamapyaki~jcitkaramiti bhAvaH||7||

teShAM trayANAmapi doShANAM sharIre sthAnavibhAga upadekShyate; tadyathA- bastiH purIShAdhAnaM kaTiH sakthinI pAdAvasthIni pakvAshayashca vAtasthAnAni, tatrApi pakvAshayo visheSheNa vAtasthAnaM; svedo raso lasIkA rudhiramAmAshayashca pittasthAnAni, tatrApyAmAshayo visheSheNa pittasthAnam; uraH shiro grIvA parvANyAmAshayo medashca shleShmasthAnAni, tatrApyuro visheSheNa shleShmasthAnam||8||

Commentary: AgantunijayorbhedakaM lakShaNamabhidhAya nijavikArakarANAM vAtAdInAM bhedaj~jAnArthamAha- teShAmityAdi| purIShAdhAnaM pakvAshayaH| yadyapi prANAdibhedabhinnasya vAyoH pRuthageva sthAnAni vakShyati; yathA- “sthAnaM prANasya shIrShoraHkaNThajihvAsyanAsikAH ” (ci. 28) ityAdi; tathA~apIdaM vaisheShikaM sthAnaM j~jeyaM, yato~atra prAyo vAtavikArA bhavanti, bhUtAshca durjayAH; atra ca vijite vAte sarvavAtavikArAvajaya iti| lasIkA udakasya picchAbhAgaH| pittasthAneShu AmAshaya iti AmAshayAdhobhAgAH, shleShmasthAneShvAmAshaya AmAshayordhvabhAgaH||8||
pUrvaM sAmAnyena vAtAdijanyA gadA uktAH, sampratyavashiShTAn kevalavAtAdijanyAnabhidhAtuM mahArogAdhyAdhyo~abhidhIyate ||1-2||
