sAmAnyajA iti vAtAdibhiH pratyekaM militaishca ye janyante| nAnAtmajA iti ye vAtAdibhirdoShAntarAsampRuktairjanyante| vipAdikA pANipAdasphuTanam| pAdabhraMshaH pAdasyAropaviShayadeshAdanyatra patanam| suptiH pAdayorniShkriyatvaM sparshAj~jatA vA| vAtakhuDDatA ‘cAluka’ iti prasiddhaH| gRudhrasIshabdena gRudhrasIshUlaM gRuhyate| Urustambhena ca UrustambhanamAtraM vAtajanyatvena gRuhyate| evaM karNAkShishUlayoH shUlamAtram| vAtajAtIsAre~api viDbhedo vAtajaH| evaM ca na gRudhrasyAdInAM sAmAnyajatvaM, yathoktAMshasya kevalavAtajanyatvAt| udarasyAveShTanamivodarAveShTaH| ashabdashravaNaM shabdAbhAve~api shabdashravaNam| uccaiHshrutiH tArasvaramAtrashravaNam, alpashabdasya tu sarvathaivAshravaNam| bAdhiryaM shabdamAtrasyaivAshravaNam| timiraM tu vAtajameva, doShAntarasambandhastatrAnubandharUpaH| ekA~ggarogaH sarvA~ggarogashceti jvarAdiShu uShNatvashItatvAdInAM kadAcidekA~ggavyApakatvenaikA~ggarogaH, teShAmeva kadAcit sarvA~ggavyApakatvena sarvA~ggarogaH; doShAntarasambandhe~api vyAptyavyAptI vAtakRute eva, “vAyunA yatra nIyante tatra varShanti meghavat” iti vacanAt| tathA bhramashca vAtikaH smRutimoharUpaH| atra kasyacida~ggasya pAdAdeH shUlAdayo~abhihitA na hastAdInAM; tatra ye~abhihitAste pradhAnabhUtAH prAyobhAvitvena, anuktAstu vAtavikArANAmaparisa~gkhyeyatvena grAhyAH||9-11||

oShaH pArshvasthiteneva vahninA pIDA| ploShaH ki~jciddahanamiva| dAhaH sarvA~ggadahanamiva| davathuH ‘dhakadhakikA’ iti loke khyAtA| dhUmakaH dhUmodvamanamiva| tvagavadaraNaM bAhyatva~gmAtrAvadaraNaM; carmAvadaraNaM tu ShaNNAmapi tvacAM daraNam| raktapittaM doShAntarAsampRuktaM raktapittaM paittikaM j~jeyam| evaM tRuShNAyAM ca tRuShNAmAtram| kakShA kakShadeshagatamAMsadAraNAH sphoTAH sushrutakShudrarogoktAH| gandho visra AmagandhaH| yathAsvamiti AtmagandhavarNarasasadRusham| agnimadgRuhamagnigRuham||14-16||

tRuptiryena tRuptamivAtmAnaM sarvadA manyate| balAsakaH balakShayaH; kiMvA shleShmodrekAnmandajvaritvaM, sthUlA~ggatA vA balAsakaH| dhamanIpraticayo dhamanyupalepaH | shItAgnitA mandAgnitA| mArtsnyaM masRuNatA| shleShmakarmasu suptirniShkriyatvena, vAte tu sparshAj~jAnena| atrAmAshayamanupravishyeti vacanena shleShmasthAneShvAmAshayasya prAdhAnyaM, pUrvaM tu ‘tatrApi uro visheSheNa’ iti vacanenoraH pradhAnam; evamubhayamapi tulyaM j~jeyam||17-19||

samprati rogaj~jAnasya cikitsAyAmupayogamAha- rogamityAdi| auShadhaM parIkSheteti sambandhaH| auShadhaparIkShA rogApekShiNI, tena tadanantarameva sA bhavatIti bhAvaH| tataH karmeti cikitsAm| j~jAnapUrvamiti karmadarshanajanitaj~jAnapUrvam||20-22||

sa~ggrahe sa~ggraha iti ‘catvAro rogA’ ityAdisa~gkShepoktiH| prakRutiriti ‘dvividhA punaH’ ityAdinA| desha iti ‘dvividhaM caiShAmadhiShThAnam’ ityAdinA| vikArAshca mukhaM ca vikAramukhaM, tatra ‘vikArAH punaH’ ityAdinA vikArAH, ‘mukhAni’ ityAdinA mukham| ‘dvayostu’ ityAdinA IraNam| asandehaH ‘na cAnyonya’ ityAdinA| ‘sarveShu’ ityAdinA anubandhaH| nAnAtmajAH sarve iti doShAntarAsampRuktadoShajanyA uktAH||23-25||
athAto~aShTauninditIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
satataM vyAdhitAvetAvatisthUlakRushau narau| satataM copacaryau hi karshanairbRuMhaNairapi||16||
sthaulyakArshye varaM kArshyaM samopakaraNau hi tau| yadyubhau vyAdhirAgacchet sthUlamevAtipIDayet||17||
samamAMsapramANastu samasaMhanano naraH| dRuDhendriyo vikArANAM na balenAbhibhUyate||18||
kShutpipAsAtapasahaH shItavyAyAmasaMsahaH| samapaktA samajaraH samamAMsacayo mataH||19||

guru cAtarpaNaM ceShTaM sthUlAnAM karshanaM prati| kRushAnAM bRuMhaNArthaM ca laghu santarpaNaM ca yat||20||

Commentary: evaM sthUlakRushau pratipAdya tayoryojanIyaM bheShajamAha- gurvityAdi| guru cAtarpaNaM ca yathA- madhu; etaddhi gurutvAdvRuddhamagniM yApayati, atarpaNAtvAcca medo hanti| evaM prashAtikAprabhRutInAmatarpaNAnAM saMskArAdinA gurutvaM kRutvA bhojanaM deyam| kRushAnAM tu laghu tarpaNaM ca deyaM; taddhi lAghavAdagnivRuddhikaraM santarpaNatvAcca puShTikRut| etacca dvitayamapyabhIShTatamatvenoktaM; tena, medasvino yallaghu cAtarpaNaM prashAtikApriya~ggvAdi tacca kartavyaM; tathA kRushasyApi navAnnAdi gurvapi santarpaNaM kartavyaM; paraM lAghavaM gauravaM ca tatra saMskArAdinA pratikartavyam||20||
vAtaghnAnyannapAnAni shleShmamedoharANi ca| rUkShoShNA bastayastIkShNA rUkShANyudvartanAni ca||21||
guDUcIbhadramustAnAM prayogastraiphalastathA| takrAriShTaprayogashca prayogo mAkShikasya ca||22||
viDa~ggaM nAgaraM kShAraH kAlaloharajo madhu| yavAmalakacUrNaM ca prayogaH shreShTha ucyate||23||
bilvAdipa~jcamUlasya prayogaH kShaudrasaMyutaH| shilAjatuprayogashca sAgnimantharasaH paraH||24||
prashAtikA priya~ggushca shyAmAkA yavakA yavAH| jUrNAhvAH kodravA mudgAH kulatthAshcakramudgakAH ||25||
ADhakInAM ca bIjAni paTolAmalakaiH saha| bhojanArthaM prayojyAni pAnaM cAnu madhUdakam||26||
ariShTAMshcAnupAnArthe medomAMsakaphApahAn| atisthaulyavinAshAya saMvibhajya prayojayet||27||
prajAgaraM vyavAyaM ca vyAyAmaM cintanAni ca| sthaulyamicchan parityaktuM krameNAbhipravardhayet||28||
svapno harShaH sukhA shayyA manaso nirvRutiH shamaH| cintAvyavAyavyAyAmavirAmaH priyadarshanam||29||
navAnnAni navaM madyaM grAmyAnUpaudakA rasAH| saMskRutAni ca mAMsAni dadhi sarpiH payAMsi ca||30||
ikShavaH shAlayo mAShA godhUmA guDavaikRutam| bastayaH snigdhamadhurAstailAbhya~ggashca sarvadA||31||
snigdhamudvartanaM snAnaM gandhamAlyaniShevaNam| shuklaM vAso yathAkAlaM doShANAmavasecanam||32||
rasAyanAnAM vRuShyANAM yogAnAmupasevanam| hatvA~atikArshyamAdhatte nRuNAmupacayaM param||33||
acintanAcca kAryANAM dhruvaM santarpaNena ca| svapnaprasa~ggAcca naro varAha iva puShyati||34||

yadA tu manasi klAnte karmAtmAnaH klamAnvitAH | viShayebhyo nivartante tadA svapiti mAnavaH||35||

Commentary: samprati prastAvAgataM sthaulyakArshyacikitsApradhAnabhUtaM svapnaM nidrArUpaM sarvato nirUpayati- yadA tvityAdi| manasIti antaHkaraNe; kiMvA manoyukta AtmA mana ityucyate, tasmin klAnta iti niShkriye| karmAtmAna iti indriyANi| klamAnvitAH kriyArahitAH| viShayebhyaH rUpAdibhyaH| manaso~apravRuttyendriyANyapi na pravartanta iti bhAvaH| tadA svapitIti svapnaguNayukto bhavati; svapnashca nirindriyapradeshe manovasthAnam| kiMvA karmAtmAna iti saMsAryAtmAnaH| manasi klAnte AtmAnaH klAntA bhavanti, manodhInapravRuttitvAdAtmanAM; tatashca manonivRuttyA AtmAno~api na viShayAn gRuhNanti, indriyANi cAtmano~apravRuttyaiva na pravartante||35||
nidrAyattaM sukhaM duHkhaM puShTiH kArshyaM balAbalam| vRuShatA klIbatA j~jAnamaj~jAnaM jIvitaM na ca||36||
akAle~atiprasa~ggAcca na ca nidrA niShevitA| sukhAyuShI parAkuryAt kAlarAtririvAparA||37||
saiva yuktA punaryu~gkte nidrA dehaM sukhAyuShA| puruShaM yoginaM siddhyA satyA buddhirivAgatA||38||

iha khalu sharIramadhikRutyAShTau puruShA ninditA bhavanti; tadyathA- atidIrghashca, atihrasvashca, atilomA ca, alomA ca , atikRuShNashca, atigaurashca, atisthUlashca, atikRushashceti||3||

Commentary: sharIramadhikRutyetivacanena mano~adhikRutya ye ninditA adhArmikakadaryAdayaH, tAnihAnupayuktAnnirAkaroti; atidIrghAdayashca ShaDiha ninditaprastAvAducyante; ninditatvaM ca teShAM lokavigAnAdeva | atidIrghashcetyAdicakAraH kubjAdininditagrahaNArtham||3||
gItAdhyayanamadyastrIkarmabhArAdhvakarshitAH| ajIrNinaH kShatAH kShINA vRuddhA bAlAstathA~abalAH||39||
tRuShNAtIsArashUlArtAH shvAsino hikkinaH kRushAH| patitAbhihatonmattAH klAntA yAnaprajAgaraiH||40||
krodhashokabhayaklAntA divAsvapnocitAshca ye| sarva ete divAsvapnaM severan sArvakAlikam||41||
dhAtusAmyaM tathA hyeShAM balaM cApyupajAyate| shleShmA puShNAti cA~ggAni sthairyaM bhavati cAyuShaH||42||
grIShme tvAdAnarUkShANAM vardhamAne ca mArute| rAtrINAM cAtisa~gkShepAddivAsvapnaH prashasyate||43||
grIShmavarjyeShu kAleShu divAsvapnAt prakupyataH| shleShmapitte divAsvapnastasmAtteShu na shasyate||44||
medasvinaH snehanityAH shleShmalAH shleShmarogiNaH| dUShIviShArtAshca divA na shayIran kadAcana||45||
halImakaH shiraHshUlaM staimityaM gurugAtratA| a~ggamardo~agninAshashca pralepo hRudayasya ca||46||
shophArocakahRullAsapInasArdhAvabhedakAH| koThAruHpiDakAH kaNDUstandrA kAso galAmayAH||47||
smRutibuddhipramohashca saMrodhaH srotasAM jvaraH| indriyANAmasAmarthyaM viShavegapravarta(rdha)nam||48||
bhavennRuNAM divAsvapnasyAhitasya niShevaNAt| tasmAddhitAhitaM svapnaM buddhvA svapyAt sukhaM budhaH||49||

rAtrau jAgaraNaM rUkShaM snigdhaM prasvapanaM divA| arUkShamanabhiShyandi tvAsInapracalAyitam||50||

Commentary: rAtrAvityAdinA jAgaraNasya svapnasya ca rUkShatvaM snigdhatvaM ca tatkAryakartRutvAdupacaryate| ki~jca jAgaraNaM rAtrau dine vA rUkShameva; paraM divA jAgaraNaM na virUkShaNaM sharIre karoti rAtrisvapnaprasnigdhatvAt; rAtrau jAgaraNaM tu raukShyaM karoti, tena tadrUkShamucyate; evaM divAsvapne~api vAcyam| svapnaprasa~ggena svapnabhedaguNamAha- arUkShamityAdi| anabhiShyandi asnigdhamityarthaH| AsInapracalAyitam upaviShTasya ki~jcinnidrAsevanaM; yadAhurjanAH pradhAnaM vihAreShu||50||

dehavRuttau yathA~a~ahArastathA svapnaH sukho mataH| svapnAhArasamutthe ca sthaulyakArshye visheShataH||51||

Commentary: svapnaprAdhAnye hetumAha- dehavRuttAvityAdi| sukha iti sukhahetuH||51||
abhya~ggotsAdanaM snAnaM grAmyAnUpaudakA rasAH| shAlyannaM sadadhi kShIraM sneho madyaM manaHsukham||52||
manaso~anuguNA gandhAH shabdAH saMvAhanAni ca| cakShuShostarpaNaM lepaH shiraso vadanasya ca||53||
svAstIrNaM shayanaM veshma sukhaM kAlastathocitaH| AnayantyacirAnnidrAM pranaShTA yA nimittataH||54||
kAyasya shirasashcaiva virekashchardanaM bhayam| cintA krodhastathA dhUmo vyAyAmo raktamokShaNam||55||
upavAso~asukhA shayyA sattvaudAryaM tamojayaH| nidrAprasa~ggamahitaM vArayanti samutthitam||56||
eta eva ca vij~jeyA nidrAnAshasya hetavaH| kAryaM kAlo vikArashca prakRutirvAyureva ca||57||

tatrAtisthUlakRushayorbhUya evApare ninditavisheShA bhavanti| atisthUlasya tAvadAyuSho hrAso javoparodhaH kRucchravyavAyatA daurbalyaM daurgandhyaM svedAbAdhaH kShudatimAtraM pipAsAtiyogashceti bhavantyaShTau doShAH| tadatisthaulyamatisampUraNAdgurumadhurashItasnigdhopayogAdavyAyAmAdavyavAyAddivAsvapnAddharShanityatvAda- cintanAdbIjasvabhAvAccopajAyate| tasya hyatimAtramedasvino meda evopacIyate na tathetare dhAtavaH, tasmAdasyAyuSho hrAsaH; shaithilyAt saukumAryAdgurutvAcca medaso javoparodhaH , shukrAbahutvAnmedasA~a~avRutamArgatvAcca kRucchravyavAyatA, daurbalyamasamatvAddhAtUnAM, daurgandhyaM medodoShAnmedasaH svabhAvAt svedanatvAcca, medasaH shleShmasaMsargAdviShyanditvAdbahutvAdgurutvAdvyAyAmAsahatvAcca svedAbAdhaH, tIkShNAgnitvAt prabhUtakoShThavAyutvAcca kShudatimAtraM pipAsAtiyogashceti||4||

Commentary: tatrAtisthUlakRushayoshcikitsopayuktaM visheShaM vaktumAha- tatretyAdi| bhUya eveti atidIrghAditulyalokavigAnAdadhikAH| ninditAshca te visheShAshceti ninditavisheShAH| atisthaulyasya hetumAha- tadityAdi| atisampUraNam atibhojanam| bIjasvabhAvAditi sthUlamAtApitRujanyatvAt| samprati sthUlasya sAdhAraNAdapyAhArAdbhUrimedojanmAha- tasya hItyAdi| medasvina iti hetugarbhavisheShaNaM; tena yasmAdatisthUle sharIre medo dehavyApakatvena labdhavRutti, atastadeva prAyo vardhate nAnye rasAdayaH, tadabhibhUtatvAdityarthaH| tasmAditi viShamadhAtutvAt| medodoShAditi duShTaM medo durgandhaM bhavati| svabhAvAditi svabhAvAdapi meda Amagandhitvena durgandham| svedanatvAcceti sati ca svede durgandhatA~anubhavasiddhaivetyarthaH | shleShmasaMsargAdibhyo hetubhyaH svedAbAdho j~jeyaH||4||

tamobhavA shleShmasamudbhavA ca manaHsharIrashramasambhavA ca| AgantukI vyAdhyanuvartinI ca rAtrisvabhAvaprabhavA ca nidrA||58||

Commentary: nidrAvisheShAnAha- tamobhavetyAdi| tamobhavA iti tamoguNodrekabhavA| manaHsharIrashramasambhavA tu nidrA manaHsharIrayoH shrameNa kriyoparame sati nendriyANi na ca mano viShayeShu pravartante, tatashca nidrA bhavati; shramashcAyamanativRuddho bhUrivAtAprakopako~abhipretaH, tena shramasya vAtajanakatvena nidrAnAshaH kimiti na bhavatIti na vAcyaM, dRuShTaM caitadyacchrAntAnAM nidrA bhavatIti| AgantukI riShTabhUtA| vyAdhyanuvartinI sannipAtajvarAdikAryA| rAtrisvabhAvAt prabhavatIti rAtrisvabhAvaprabhavA| divA prabhavantI tu nidrA tamaHprabhRutibhya eva bhavati||58||

rAtrisvabhAvaprabhavA matA yA tAM bhUtadhAtrIM pravadanti tajj~jAH| tamobhavAmAhuraghasya mUlaM sheShAH punarvyAdhiShu nirdishanti||59||

Commentary: Asu nidrAsu prashastAM ninditAM cAha- rAtrItyAdi| bhUtAni prANino dadhAti puShNAtIti bhUtadhAtrI, dhAtrIva dhAtrI| aghasya pApasya mUlamiti kAraNaM; tamogRuhIto hi sadA nidrAtmakatvenAnuShTheyaM sadvRuttaM na karoti, tatashcAdharmotpAdaH| vyAdhiShviti shArIravyAdhiShu; shleShmAdayo vyAdhaya eva, teShu ca bhUtA nidrA vyAdhirUpaiva| AgantukI cAsAdhyavyAdhibhavA ca svayamapyasAdhyabhUtA vyAdhirUpA, tena tAM ca vyAdhiShu madhye nirdishanti; kiMvA vyAdhiShvAdhAreShu nirdishantItyartho j~jeyaH||59||
tatra shlokAH- ninditAH puruShAsteShAM yau visheSheNa ninditau| nindite kAraNaM doShAstayorninditabheShajam||60||
yebhyo yadA hitA nidrA yebhyashcApyahitA yadA| atinidrAyAnidrAya bheShajaM yadbhavA ca sA||61||
yA yA yathAprabhAvA ca nidrA tat sarvamatrijaH| aShTauninditasa~gkhyAte vyAjahAra punarvasuH||62||
bhavanti cAtra- medasA~a~avRutamArgatvAdvAyuH koShThe visheShataH| caran sandhukShayatyagnimAhAraM shoShayatyapi||5||
tasmAt sa shIghraM jarayatyAhAraM cAtikA~gkShati| vikArAMshcAshnute ghorAn kAMshcitkAlavyatikramAt||6||
etAvupadravakarau visheShAdagnimArutau| etau hi dahataH sthUlaM vanadAvo vanaM yathA||7||
medasyatIva saMvRuddhe sahasaivAnilAdayaH| vikArAn dAruNAn kRutvA nAshayantyAshu jIvitam||8||
medomAMsAtivRuddhatvAccalasphigudarastanaH| ayathopacayotsAho naro~atisthUla ucyate||9||
... vakShyate vAcyamatikArshye tvataH param||10||
sevA rUkShAnnapAnAnAM la~gghanaM pramitAshanam| kriyAtiyogaH shokashca veganidrAvinigrahaH||11||
rUkShasyodvartanaM snAnasyAbhyAsaH prakRutirjarA| vikArAnushayaH krodhaH kurvantyatikRushaM naram||12||
vyAyAmamatisauhityaM kShutpipAsAmayauShadham | kRusho na sahate tadvadatishItoShNamaithunam||13||
plIhA kAsaH kShayaH shvAso gulmo~arshAMsyudarANi ca| kRushaM prAyo~abhidhAvanti rogAshca grahaNIgatAH||14||
shuShkasphigudaragrIvo dhamanIjAlasantataH| tvagasthisheSho~atikRushaH sthUlaparvA naro mataH||15||

rogacatuShke rogA uktAH, bheShajaM ca bheShajacatuShke, rogabheShajayostu yojanA yathA kartavyA tadvaktuM yojanAcatuShko~abhidhIyate| sA ca yojanA rogeNa samaM bheShajAnAM prAyaH sharIramevApekShata iti sharIrabhedapratipAdako~aShTauninditIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

karshanairbRuMhaNairiti yathAsa~gkhyam| varamiti manAgiShTam| sthUlamevAtipIDayediti sthUlasya durupakramatvAt| yataH sthUlasya santarpaNamatisthaulyakaram, apatarpaNaM cAyaM pravRuddhAgnitvAnna soDhuM kShamaH; durbale tu santarpaNaM yogyameveti bhAvaH||16-17||
samprati prashastapuruShamAha- sametyAdi| mAMsashabdenehopacayo vivakShitaH, tena samamupacayasya pramANaM yasya sa tathA| saMhananaM melakaH| aparAnapi samamAMsapramANaguNAnAha- kShudityAdi||18-19||

mAkShikasyeti madhunaH; na ca madhuno vRuShyaprayogeShu dRuShTatvAd bRuhaNatvaM vAcyaM, yato yogavAhi madhu yadA vRuShyeNa yujyate tadA vRuShyatvaM karoti, lekhanayuktaM tu lekhanakaraM, tathA svarUpeNApi rUkShAdiguNayogAt karshanaM; vacanaM hi- “nAnAdravyAtmakatvAcca yogavAhi paraM madhu (su. sU. 45) iti”| viDa~ggAdiprayogo gauravanirapekSha evAtisthaulyaharaH, prabhAvAt| prashAtikA ‘uDikA’ iti prasiddhA| yavakAH svalpayavAH| cakramudgakaH ‘RuShimudgaka’ iti prasiddhaH| ADhakI tuvarI||21-28||

kArshyacikitsAmAha- svapna ityAdi| shamaH shAntiH| nanu navAnnAdInAM gurUNAM saMskArAdinA gauravaM pratikartavyamagnimAndyabhayAt, tat kimiti laghUnyeva raktashAlyAdIni tatra na dIyante, tAni hi prakRutyA laghUni tarpaNAni ca madhurayogAt| na, ubhayasyApyabhipretatvAt; prakRutilaghu ca tarpaNaM raktashAlyAdi, saMskArAdilaghu ca navAnnAdi santarpaNakaramiti| evaM pUrvoktaprashAtikAdAvapyanusartavyam| acintanAccetyAdinA prakRuShTaM bRuMhaNakAraNamucyate| svapnaprasa~ggo nityaM svapnamatimAtraM ca||29-34||

samprati vidhinA sevitAyA nidrAyA guNamavidhinA ca doShamAha- nidrAyattamityAdinA na cetyantena| atra ca sukhAdi vidhisevitanidrAphalaM, duHkhAdi tvavidhinidrAphalam| etadeva vibhajate- akAla ityAdi| akAla iti dinAdau nidrAM prati niShiddhe kAle; anena ca mithyAyogo nidrAyA uktaH| kAlarAtriH kAloShA| satyA buddhiH tattvaj~jAnam||36-38||

samprati dine~api yairnidrA sevyA tAnAha- gItetyAdi| iha gItakarshitAnAM divAsvapnAddhAtupuShTau satyAmArogyam| atIsArAdiShu ca prabhAvAddivA~api nidrA hitA| ajIrNinastvajIrNapAkArthaM divAnidrA; nidrA hi sroto~avarodhenAgnibalaM kRutvA shIghramAhAraM pacati| divAsvapnasAtmyAnAM sahasA tatparityAge doSha eva syAt| rAtrau jAgaritAnAM ca tajjanitavAtakShobhashamArthaM divAsvapnaH, sa ca kShArapANivacanena kartavyaH; yaduktaM- “yAvatkAlaM na suptaH syAdrAtrau svapnAdyathocitAt| tato~ardhamAtraM tatkAlaM divAsvapno vidhIyate” iti; ayaM ca divAsvapno~abhuktavatAmeva; yaduktaM hArIte- “bhuktvA svapnaM na seveta sustho~apyasukhito bhavet” iti; anyatrApyuktaM vyAyAmAdiShu divAsvapnavidhAne- “narAnnirashanAn kAmaM divA svApayet” iti| sArvakAlikamiti grIShmaM parityajyApi| ‘rAtrINAM cAtisa~gkShepAditi’ anenAlpanidratvaM ca sUcayati||39-43||

na shayIran kadAcanetivacanAdgrIShme~api divAsvapnaM medasviprabhRutInAM niShedhati| gItakarShaNAdau tu balAbalaM nirUpya divAsvapnapravRuttirvA nivRuttirvA vidheyA| viShavegapravartanamiti dUShIviShArtAnAM boddhavyam| svapyAt sukhamiti sukhaM yathA bhavati tathA svapyAt; taccAhitasvapnaparityAgena hitasvapnasevayA ca||44-49||

svapnajanakaM hetumAha- abhya~ggetyAdi| kAlastathocita iti yasmin kAle nidrA puruSheNAbhyastA sa kAlastasyocitaH| nimittataH pranaShTetivacanamariShTajanitanidrApratiShedhArtham; ariShTaM hyanimittamucyate shAstre||52-54|

atra nidrApratiShedhahetumAha- kAyasyetyAdi| sattvaudAryaM sattvaguNabhUritvam| tamojayaH tamoguNajayaH, sa ca yogAbhyAsAdinA bhavati| eta eva ceti svasthe kriyamANA iti boddhavyaM; nidrAtiprasa~gge tu sati kriyamANA atiprasa~gganiShedhakA bhavanti| aparAnapi nidrAnAshahetUnAha- kAryamityAdi| kAryamiti kAryAsakto na nidrAM yAti| kAla iti vArdhakyaM, vRuddhA hi svabhAvata eva jAgarUkA bhavanti| vikAraH vyAdhiH shUlAdiH| prakRutiH svabhAvaH, svabhAvAdeva kecidanidrA bhavanti | vikAragrahaNainaiva vAte labdhe punarvAtagrahaNaM visheSheNa vAyornidrApahArakatvapratipAdanArtham||55-57||
sa~ggrahe anidrAyeti avidyamAnanidrAya puruShAya| yathAprabhAvA ceti bhUtadhAtrItyAdivarNitaprabhAvA||60-62||

medasetyAdau vAyoranativRuddhatvenAgnisandhukShakatvaM na vaiShamyApAdakatvaM, yato~ativRuddho hi vaiShamyaM vahneH karoti vAyuH| sa iti medasvI| kAlavyatikramAditi bhojanakAlAtikramAt| atisthUlalakShaNamAha- medomAMsetyAdi||5-9||-

vAcyam abhidheyaM; kiMvA vAcyamiti ninditamavadyamiti yAvat| pramitasya stokasyAshanaM pramitAshanam| kriyAtiyogaH vamanAdyatiyogaH| prakRutiH dehajanakaM bIjam| anushayaH anubandhaH| kRushasya lakShaNaM- shuShketyAdi| tvagasthisheSha iti ‘dRushyata’ iti sheShaH| sthUlaparvA sthUlagranthiH||10-15||
athAto la~gghanabRuMhaNIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH ||1||
tadagniveshasya vaco nishamya gururabravIt| yat ki~jcillAghavakaraM dehe talla~gghanaM smRutam||9||
bRuhattvaM yaccharIrasya janayettacca bRuMhaNam| raukShyaM kharatvaM vaishadyaM yat kuryAttaddhi rUkShaNam||10||
snehanaM snehaviShyandamArdavakledakArakam | stambhagauravashItaghnaM svedanaM svedakArakam||11||
stambhanaM stambhayati yadgatimantaM calaM dhruvam| laghUShNatIkShNavishadaM rUkShaM sUkShmaM kharaM saram||12||
kaThinaM caiva yaddravyaM prAyastalla~gghanaM smRutam| guru shItaM mRudu snigdhaM bahalaM sthUlapicchilam||13||
prAyo mandaM sthiraM shlakShNaM dravyaM bRuMhaNamucyate| rUkShaM laghu kharaM tIkShNamuShNaM sthiramapicchilam||14||
prAyashaH kaThinaM caiva yaddravyaM taddhi rUkShaNam| dravaM sUkShmaM saraM snigdhaM picchilaM guru shItalam| prAyo mandaM mRudu ca yaddravyaM tatsnehanaM matam||15||
uShNaM tIkShNaM saraM snigdhaM rUkShaM sUkShmaM dravaM sthiram| dravyaM guru ca yat prAyastaddhi svedanamucyate||16||
shItaM mandaM mRudu shlakShNaM rUkShaM sUkShmaM dravaM sthiram| yaddravyaM laghu coddiShTaM prAyastat stambhanaM smRutam||17||

catuShprakArA saMshuddhiH pipAsA mArutAtapau| pAcanAnyupavAsashca vyAyAmashceti la~gghanam||18||

Commentary: catuShprakArA saMshuddhiriti anuvAsanaM varjayitvA, tasya bRuMhaNatvAt||18||
prabhUtashleShmapittAsramalAH saMsRuShTamArutAH| bRuhaccharIrA balino la~gghanIyA vishuddhibhiH||19||
yeShAM madhyabalA rogAH kaphapittasamutthitAH| vamyatIsArahRudrogavisUcyalasakajvarAH||20||
vibandhagauravodgArahRullAsArocakAdayaH| pAcanaistAn bhiShak prAj~jaH prAyeNAdAvupAcaret||21||
eta eva yathoddiShTA yeShAmalpabalA gadAH| pipAsAnigrahaisteShAmupavAsaishca tA~jjayet||22||
rogA~jjayenmadhyabalAn vyAyAmAtapamArutaiH| balinAM kiM punaryeShAM rogANAmavaraM balam||23||
tvagdoShiNAM pramIDhAnAM snigdhAbhiShyandibRuMhiNAm| shishire la~gghanaM shastamapi vAtavikAriNAm||24||
adigdhaviddhamakliShTaM vayasthaM sAtmyacAriNAm| mRugamatsyaviha~ggAnAM mAMsaM bRuMhaNamucyate||25||
kShINAH kShatAH kRushA vRuddhA durbalA nityamadhvagAH| strImadyanityA grIShme ca bRuMhaNIyA narAH smRutAH||26||
shoShArshograhaNIdoShairvyAdhibhiH karshitAshca ye| teShAM kravyAdamAMsAnAM bRuMhaNA laghavo rasAH||27||
snAnamutsAdanaM svapno madhurAH snehabastayaH| sharkarAkShIrasarpIMShi sarveShAM viddhi bRuMhaNam||28||
kaTutiktakaShAyANAM sevanaM strIShvasaMyamaH| khalipiNyAkatakrANAM madhvAdInAM ca rUkShaNam||29||
abhiShyaNNA mahAdoShA marmasthA vyAdhayashca ye| UrustambhaprabhRutayo rUkShaNIyA nidarshitAH||30||
snehAH snehayitavyAshca svedAH svedyAshca ye narAH| snehAdhyAye mayoktAste svedAkhye ca savistaram||31||
tapaHsvAdhyAyaniratAnAtreyaH shiShyasattamAn| ShaDagniveshapramukhAnuktavAn paricodayan||3||
la~gghanaM bRuMhaNaM kAle rUkShaNaM snehanaM tathA| svedanaM stambhanaM caiva jAnIte yaH sa vai bhiShak||4||
tamuktavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca ha||5||
bhagava@mlla~gghanaM kiMsvilla~gghanIyAshca kIdRushAH| bRuMhaNaM bRuMhaNIyAshca rUkShaNIyAshca rUkShaNam||6||
ke snehAH snehanIyAshca svedAH svedyAshca ke matAH| stambhanaM stambhanIyAshca vaktumarhasi tadguro!||7||
la~gghanaprabhRutInAM ca ShaNNAmeShAM samAsataH| kRutAkRutAtivRuttAnAM lakShaNaM vaktumarhasi||8||
dravaM tanvasaraM yAvacchItIkaraNamauShadham| svAdu tiktaM kaShAyaM ca stambhanaM sarvameva tat||32||
pittakShArAgnidagdhA ye vamyatIsArapIDitAH| viShasvedAtiyogArtAH stambhanIyA nidarshitAH||33||
vAtamUtrapurIShANAM visarge gAtralAghave| hRudayodgArakaNThAsyashuddhau tandrAklame gate||34||
svede jAte rucau caiva kShutpipAsAsahodaye| kRutaM la~gghanamAdeshyaM nirvyathe cAntarAtmani||35||
parvabhedo~a~ggamardashca kAsaH shoSho mukhasya ca| kShutpraNAsho~arucistRuShNA daurbalyaM shrotranetrayoH||36||
manasaH sambhramo~abhIkShNamUrdhvavAtastamo hRudi| dehAgnibalanAshashca la~gghane~atikRute bhavet||37||

balaM puShTyupalambhashca kArshyadoShavivarjanam| lakShaNaM bRuMhite sthaulyamati cAtyarthabRuMhite||38||

Commentary: kArshyadoShavivarjanamiti kArshye ye doShAH shItoShNAsahatvAdayaH, teShAM varjanam||38||-
stambhitaH syAdbale labdhe yathoktaishcAmayairjitaiH||39||
shyAvatA stabdhagAtratvamudvego hanusa~ggrahaH| hRudvarconigrahashca syAdatistambhitalakShaNam||40||
lakShaNaM cAkRutAnAM syAt ShaNNAmeShAM samAsataH| tadauShadhAnAM dhAtUnAmashamo vRuddhireva ca||41||
iti ShaT sarvarogANAM proktAH samyagupakramAH| sAdhyAnAM sAdhane siddhA mAtrAkAlAnurodhinaH||42||

bhavati cAtra- doShANAM bahusaMsargAt sa~gkIryante hyupakramAH| ShaTtvaM tu nAtivartante tritvaM vAtAdayo yathA||43||

Commentary: sampratyuktala~gghanAdyupakramANAM vikArApekShayA saMsargamAha- doShANAmityAdi| doShANAM yasmAt saMsargA bahavaH, tasmAttatsAdhanArthamupakramA api sa~gkIryante mishratAM yAnti| yathA- kvacilla~gghanasvedane, kvacidbRuMhaNasnehane , evamAdi| ShaTtvaM tu nAtivartanta iti saMsRuShTA api la~gghanAdisvarUpaM na jahati; na la~gghanAdayaH parasparayuktA madhusarpiHsaMyogavat prakRutiguNAnapekShikAryAntaramArabhanta iti bhAvaH| atraiva dRuShTAntamAha- tritvamityAdi| ayaM ca dRuShTAntaH saMsargisa~gkhyA~aparityAgamAtrakaH||43||
tatra shlokAH- ityasmi@mla~gghanAdhyAye vyAkhyAtAH ShaDupakramAH| yathAprashnaM bhagavatA cikitsA yaiH pravartate||44||
yojanApekShiNIyaM sharIramabhidhAya la~gghanAdiviShayatvAdyojanAyA la~gghanAdInyeva viShayataH svarUpatashca vaktuM la~gghanabRuMhaNIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

raukShyamityAdau raukShyameva pradhAnaM boddhavyaM, kharatvavaishadye tu tadanugate| viShyandaH vilayanam| svedakArakaM gharmakArakam| stambhayatIti niruNaddhi| calamiti ki~jcidgatimat| gatimantamiti pravyaktagatimantam| etaccAtisArashoNitasrutiviShadAhavedanAdiShu boddhavyaM na kevalavAte, gatimantaM prati stambhakasya vardhakatvAt| gurvityAdau bahalaM ghanam| mandamiti cirakAri| sthUlaM saMhatAvayavaM laDDukapiShTakAdi| virUkShaNadravyakathane yadguNameva la~gghanadravyamuktaM tadguNameva virUkShaNaM yadyapyuktaM, tathA~api rUkShaguNasyAtra prAdhAnyaM, la~gghane tu laghuguNaprAdhAnyaM j~jeyaM; tathA la~gghanamadravyeNopavAsenApi kriyate, virUkShaNaM tu dravyakAryatayaiva prAdhAnyAduktaM; tena la~gghanavirUkShaNayornaikatA| yattu vakShyati- “kRutAtikRutali~ggaM yalla~gghite tadvirUkShite” iti, tat prAyovAdAt| virUkShaNasya hi mukhyaH snehAbhAvaH sAdhyaH, la~gghanasya tu gauravAbhAva iti sphuTa eva bhedaH pratibhAti| svedanaguNakathane snigdhaM rUkShamiti snigdhaM vA rUkShaM vetyarthaH| evaM sarasthirAvapi vikalpena j~jeyau| pipAseti pipAsAnigrahaH| mAruto yadyapi somasambandhAttathAla~gghanaM na bhavati, tathA~api svarUpeNa la~gghanameva| pacantamagniM pratipakShakShapaNena baladAnena ca yat pAcayati tat pAcanaM; tacca vAyvagniguNabhUyiShTham||9-17||

uktasya dashaprakArala~gghanasya bhinnaM viShayamAha- prabhUtetyAdi| AdAviti vacanamante cchardyAdInAM nirAmANAM saMshamanIyatvAt| rogAniti la~gghanIyarogAn| balinAmiti padaM balavatAmeva vyAyAmAdisevAbhidhAnArtham| madhyabalAniti madhyabalAnapi; etenA~jjasA alpabalA eva gadA vyAyAmAdiviShayA iti bhAvaH| bRuMhiNAM bRuMhaNayuktAnAm| la~gghanaM shastamiti dashavidhamapi| shishira iti shishiraguNayukte hemante shishire ca; atra ca la~gghanaM balavattvAt prANinAM kAryam||19-24||
adigdhaviddhamiti viShAktashastrAviddham| sAtmye deshe carantIti sAtmyacAriNaH| laghava iti saMskAreNa laghavaH; kiMvA kravyAdAnAM ye laghavaH shyenAdayaH, tanmAMsarasA ityarthaH||25-28||
madhvAdInAM ca sevanamiti sambandhaH| khaliH sarShapakhaliH; piNyAkaM tilakhaliH, kiMvA piNyAkashAkam| prabhRutigrahaNAdADhyavAtapramehAdayo grAhyaH||29-31||
paricodayanniti j~jAnArthaM prerayan| kRutetyAdau kRutaM samyakkRutam||3-8||
tanu abahalam| sarati gacchatIti saraM, na saramasaraM, sthiramityarthaH||32-33||

kShutpipAsayorasahaH pIDAkaratvenodayaH kShutpipAsAsahodayaH, na tu kShutpipAsayoryugapadudayaH | ata evoktaM sushrute- “sRuShTamArutaviNmUtraM kShutpipAsAsahaM laghum” (su. u. taM. 39) ityAdi| antarAtmanIti manasi| manasaH sambhramo bhrAntireva| Urdhve kAye vAta UrdhvavAtaH ||34-37||
bale labdhe iti balavAn yadA puruSho bhavati| yathoktairiti “pittakShArAgnidagdhA ye” ityAdyabhidheyaiH| udvega UrdhvavAtavegaH; kiMvA bhaiShajyAnabhilAShaH||39-40||
tadauShadhAnAmiti la~gghanAdisAdhyAnAm| vRuddhireva ceti stokamAtrakRutala~gghanAdikriyayA doShakShobhamAtrasya kRutatvAt| dhAtUnAmiti doShANAM, “doShA api dhAtushabdaM labhante” iti vacanAt||41-42||
athAtaH santarpaNIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
tatra shlokaH- santarpaNotthA ye rogA rogA ye cApatarpaNAt| santarpaNIye te~adhyAye sauShadhAH parikIrtitAH||40||
santarpayati yaH snigdhairmadhurairgurupicchilaiH| navAnnairnavamadyaishca mAMsaishcAnUpavArijaiH||3||
gorasairgauDikaishcAnnaiH paiShTikaishcAtimAtrashaH| ceShTAdveShI divAsvapnashayyAsanasukhe rataH||4||
rogAstasyopajAyante santarpaNanimittajAH| pramehapiDakAkoThakaNDUpANDvAmayajvarAH||5||
kuShThAnyAmapradoShAshca mUtrakRucchramarocakaH| tandrA klaibyamatisthaulyamAlasyaM gurugAtratA||6||
indriyasrotasAM lepo buddhermohaH pramIlakaH| shophAshcaivaMvidhAshcAnye shIghramapratikurvataH||7||
shastamullekhanaM tatra vireko raktamokShaNam| vyAyAmashcopavAsashca dhUmAshca svedanAni ca||8||
sakShaudrashcAbhayAprAshaH prAyo rUkShAnnasevanam| cUrNapradehA ye coktAH kaNDUkoThavinAshanAH||9||
triphalAragvadhaM pAThAM saptaparNaM savatsakam| mustaM samadanaM nimbaM jalenotkvathitaM pibet||10||
tena mehAdayo yAnti nAshamabhyasyato dhruvam| mAtrAkAlaprayuktena santarpaNasamutthitAH||11||
mustamAragvadhaH pAThA triphalA devadAru ca| shvadaMShTrA khadiro nimbo haridre tvakca vatsakAt||12||
rasameShAM yathAdoShaM prAtaH prAtaH pibannaraH| santarpaNakRutaiH sarvairvyAdhibhiH sampramucyate||13||
ebhishcodvartanoddharShasnAnayogopayojitaiH| tvagdoShAH prashamaM yAnti tathA snehopasaMhitaiH||14||
kuShThaM gomedako hi~ggu krau~jcAsthi tryUShaNaM vacA| vRuShakaile shvadaMShTrA ca kharAhvA cAshmabhedakaH||15||
takreNa dadhimaNDena badarAmlarasena vA| mUtrakRucchraM pramehaM ca pItametadvyapohati||16||
takrAbhayAprayogaishca triphalAyAstathaiva ca| ariShTAnAM prayogaishca yAnti mehAdayaH shamam||17||
tryUShaNaM triphalA kShaudraM krimighnamajamodakaH| mantho~ayaM saktavastailaM hito lohodakAplutaH||18||
vyoShaM viDa~ggaM shigrUNi triphalAM kaTurohiNIm| bRuhatyau dve haridre dve pAThAmativiShAM sthirAm||19||
hi~ggu kebukamUlAni yavAnIdhAnyacitrakAn| sauvarcalamajAjIM ca hapuShAM ceti cUrNayet||20||
cUrNatailaghRutakShaudrabhAgAH syurmAnataH samAH| saktUnAM ShoDashaguNo bhAgaH santarpaNaM pibet||21||
prayogAdasya shAmyanti rogAH santarpaNotthitAH| pramehA mUDhavAtAshca kuShThAnyarshAMsi kAmalAH||22||
plIhA pANDvAmayaH shopho mUtrakRucchramarocakaH| hRudrogo rAjayakShmA ca kAsaH shvAso galagrahaH||23||
krimayo grahaNIdoShAH shvaitryaM sthaulyamatIva ca| narANAM dIpyate cAgniH smRutirbuddhishca vardhate||24||
vyAyAmanityo jIrNAshI yavagodhUmabhojanaH| santarpaNakRutairdoShaiH sthaulyaM muktvA vimucyate||25||
vakShyante sauShadhAshcordhvamapatarpaNajA gadAH||26||
dehAgnibalavarNaujaHshukramAMsaparikShayaH| jvaraH kAsAnubandhashca pArshvashUlamarocakaH||27||
shrotradaurbalyamunmAdaH pralApo hRudayavyathA| viNmUtrasa~ggrahaH shUlaM ja~gghorutrikasaMshrayam||28||
parvAsthisandhibhedashca ye cAnye vAtajA gadAH| UrdhvavAtAdayaH sarve jAyante te~apatarpaNAt||29||
teShAM santarpaNaM tajj~jaiH punarAkhyAtamauShadham| yattadAtve samarthaM syAdabhyAse vA tadiShyate ||30||
sadyaHkShINo hi sadyo vai tarpaNenopacIyate| narte santarpaNAbhyAsAccirakShINastu puShyati||31||
dehAgnidoShabhaiShajyamAtrAkAlAnuvartinA| kAryamatvaramANena bheShajaM ciradurbale||32||
hitA mAMsarasAstasmai payAMsi ca ghRutAni ca| snAnAni bastayo~abhya~ggAstarpaNAstarpaNAshca ye||33||
jvarakAsaprasaktAnAM kRushAnAM mUtrakRucchriNAm| tRuShyatAmUrdhvavAtAnAM vakShyante tarpaNA hitAH||34||
sharkarApippalItailaghRutakShaudraiH samAMshakaiH| saktudviguNito vRuShyasteShAM manthaH prashasyate||35||
saktavo madirA kShaudraM sharkarA ceti tarpaNam| pibenmArutaviNmUtrakaphapittAnulomanam||36||
phANitaM saktavaH sarpirdadhimaNDo~amlakA~jjikam| tarpaNaM mUtrakRucchraghnamudAvartaharaM pibet||37||
manthaH kharjUramRudvIkAvRukShAmlAmlIkadADimaiH| parUShakaiH sAmalakairyukto madyavikAranut||38||

svAduramlo jalakRutaH sasneho rUkSha eva vA| sadyaH santarpaNo manthaH sthairyavarNabalapradaH||39||

Commentary: svAduramla ityAdinA sadyastarpaNamAha| amla iti amladADimAdiyogAt| atra rUkShasaktukRutasyApi manthasya dravatvashaityadehAnusAritvaiH sadyaHsantarpakatvaM bhavatyeva, ata eva ‘sadya’ ityuktaM, snehAdibRuMhaNadravyayogAttu kAlAntaratarpakatvamapi bhavati||39||
vyAkhyAtaShaDupakramANAmeva santarpaNApatarpaNabhedena dvividhAnAM dvividhaviShaye pravRuttiM darshayituM santarpaNIyo~abhidhIyate ||1-2||

santarpayati santarpaNamAcarati| snigdhairityAdivacanamasnigdhAdibhirapi shaktuprabhRutibhistRuptimAtrakArakatvena santarpaNaniShedhArthaM; bhavati hi tRuptikArake santarpaNashabdaprayogaH, yathA~atraiva santarpaNaprayoge- “shaktUnAM ShoDashaguNo bhAgaH santarpaNaM pibet” iti| shayyAsanasukhe ratatvenaiva ceShTAdveShitve labdhe punastadvacanaM shayyAsanasthitasyApi gItA~ggacAlanAdiceShTAniShedhArtham| AmapradoShA visUcikAdayaH| pramIlakaH satataM pradhyAnam||3-7||

sakShaudrashcAbhayAprAsha iti kShaudreNa saha harItakIprAshaH; kiMvA agastyaharItakyAdiprAshaH| ye coktA iti AragvadhIye (sU. 3)| teneti kvAthena karaNabhUtena, abhyasyato~abhyAsaM kurvANasya; kiMvA tena kvAthena triphalAdInyabhyasyata iti yojanA| yathAdoShamiti doShapramANApekShayA gRuhItamAtram| udvartanamabhya~ggapUrvakam, uddharShastvanabhya~ggapUrvakaH| snehopasaMhitairiti snehasAdhanopayuktaiH| gomedakaH maNivisheShaH| krau~jcaH pakShI, ‘ko~jca’ iti khyAtaH| kharAhvA ajamodA| lohodakApluta iti agurUdakAplutaH| udakakaraNaM ca ShaDa~ggajalavidhAnena| iha prayoge vakShyamANavyoShAdyuktapramANena sAhacaryAccUrNAdimAnaM j~jeyam| santarpaNamiti jalAloDitashakturUpatayA, tena santarpaNasa~jj~jasyApyapatarpaNatA j~jeyA| shvaitryaM shvitritvaM; ‘shvaityaM’ iti pAThe shvetAvabhAsatA||8-25||-

UrdhvavAtAdaya iti pUrvAdhyAyoktAH “UrdhvavAtastamo hRudi” (sU. 22) ityAdayaH| UrdhvavAtaH shvAsAdiryatrordhvaM vAyuryAti; kiMvA tantrAntarokto rogavisheSha eva, yathA- “adhaH pratihato vAyuH shleShmaNA kupitena ca| karotyanishamudgAramUrdhvavAtaH sa ucyate” iti||26-30||

sadyastarpaNatarpaNAbhyAsayoruktayorviShayabhedamAha- sadya ityAdi| atvaramANeneti vacanena ciradurbale tvarayA kriyamANaM tarpaNamagnivadhAdidoShaM karotIti sUcayati| tarpaNAstarpaNAshceti santarpaNakArakA manthAdayaH; tena, iha sa~jj~jAmAtreNa ye tarpaNA apatarpaNakArakA vyoShAdayaste na grAhyAH; kintu ‘sharkarApippalI’ ityAdigranthavAcyAH| sharkarAdimanthoktamAnenApare~apIha manthA grAhyAH||31-38||
athAto vidhishoNitIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH ||1||

tapanIyendragopAbhaM padmAlaktakasannibham| gu~jjAphalasavarNaM ca vishuddhaM viddhi shoNitam||22||

Commentary: tapanIyaM lohitasuvarNam, indragopaH svanAmaprasiddhaH kITavisheShaH| vishuddharaktali~gge nAnAvarNatA vAtAdiprakRutitvAnmanuShyANAm||22|

nAtyuShNashItaM laghu dIpanIyaM rakte~apanIte hitamannapAnam| tadA sharIraM hyanavasthitAsRugagnirvisheSheNa ca rakShitavyaH||23||

Commentary: nAtyuShNAdibhojane hetumAha- tadetyAdi| atishItamagnimAndyaM karoti, atyuShNaM ca pracalasyAsRujo nitarAM pracalatAM karoti, tasmAnnAtyuShNashItam| laghu dIpanIyaM cAgnidIptyarthameva||23||

prasannavarNendriyamindriyArthAnicchantamavyAhatapaktRuvegam| sukhAnvitaM tu(pu)ShTibalopapannaM vishuddharaktaM puruShaM vadanti||24||

Commentary: samprati shoNitAdarshanenApi vishuddharaktaj~jAnArthaM lakShaNamAha- prasannetyAdi| avyAhatA paktishca vegashca purIShAdInAM yasya sa tathA||24||
yadA tu raktavAhIni rasasa~jj~jAvahAni ca| pRuthak pRuthak samastA vA srotAMsi kupitA malAH||25||
malinAhArashIlasya rajomohAvRutAtmanaH| pratihatyAvatiShThante jAyante vyAdhayastadA||26||
madamUrcchAyasannyAsAsteShAM vidyAdvicakShaNaH| yathottaraM balAdhikyaM hetuli~ggopashAntiShu||27||
durbalaM cetasaH sthAnaM yadA vAyuH prapadyate| mano vikShobhaya~jjantoH sa~jj~jAM sammohayettadA||28||
pittamevaM kaphashcaivaM mano vikShobhayannRuNAm| sa~jj~jAM nayatyAkulatAM visheShashcAtra vakShyate||29||
saktAnalpadrutAbhAShaM calaskhalitaceShTitam | vidyAdvAtamadAviShTaM rUkShashyAvAruNAkRutim||30||
sakrodhaparuShAbhAShaM samprahArakalipriyam| vidyAt pittamadAviShTaM raktapItAsitAkRutim||31||
svalpAsambaddhavacanaM tandrAlasyasamanvitam| vidyAt kaphamadAviShTaM pANDuM pradhyAnatatparam||32||

jAyate shAmyati kShipraM mado madyamadAkRutiH||33||

Commentary: madasvarUpamAha- jAyata ityAdi||33||

yashca madyakRutaH prokto viShajo raudhirashca yaH| sarva ete madA narte vAtapittakaphatrayAt||34||

Commentary: madaprasa~ggena madyaviShajayorapi madayoshcAturvidhyamAha- yashcetyAdi| vAtapittakaphatrayAditi vAtAt pittAt kaphAdvAtapittakaphAcca; etena teShAmapyetadeva lakShaNaM vAtAdikRutaM bhavatIti bhAvaH||34||
nIlaM vA yadi vA kRuShNamAkAshamathavA~aruNam| pashyaMstamaH pravishati shIghraM ca pratibudhyate ||35||
vepathushcA~ggamardashca prapIDA hRudayasya ca| kArshyaM shyAvAruNA cchAyAmUrcchAye vAtasambhave||36||
raktaM haritavarNaM vA viyat pItamathApi vA| pashyaMstamaH pravishati sasvedaH pratibudhyate||37||
sapipAsaH sasantApo raktapItAkulekShaNaH| sambhinnavarcAH pItAbho mUrcchAye pittasambhave||38||
meghasa~gkAshamAkAshamAvRutaM vA tamoghanaiH| pashyaMstamaH pravishati cirAcca pratibudhyate||39||
gurubhiH prAvRutaira~ggairyathaivArdreNa carmaNA| saprasekaH sahRullAso mUrcchAye kaphasambhave||40||
sarvAkRutiH sannipAtAdapasmAra ivAgataH| sa jantuM pAtayatyAshu vinA bIbhatsaceShTitaiH||41||
doSheShu madamUrcchAyAH kRutavegeShu dehinAm| svayamevopashAmyanti sannyAso nauShadhairvinA||42||
vAgdehamanasAM ceShTAmAkShipyAtibalA malAH| sannyasyantyabalaM jantuM prANAyatanasaMshritAH||43||
sa nA sannyAsasannyastaH kAShThIbhUto mRutopamaH| prANairviyujyate shIghraM muktvA sadyaHphalAH kriyAH||44||
durge~ambhasi yathA majjadbhAjanaM tvarayA budhaH| gRuhNIyAttalamaprAptaM tathA sannyAsapIDitam||45||
a~jjanAnyavapIDAshca dhUmAH pradhamanAni ca| sUcIbhistodanaM shastaM dAhaH pIDA nakhAntare||46||
lu~jcanaM keshalomnAM ca dantairdashanameva ca| AtmaguptAvagharShashca hitaM tasyAvabodhane||47||
sammUrcchitAni tIkShNAni madyAni vividhAni ca| prabhUtakaTuyuktAni tasyAsye gAlayenmuhuH||48||
mAtulu~ggarasaM tadvanmahauShadhasamAyutam| tadvatsauvarcalaM dadyAdyuktaM madyAmlakA~jjikaiH||49||
hi~ggUShaNasamAyuktaM yAvat sa~jj~jAprabodhanam| prabuddhasa~jj~jamannaishca laghubhistamupAcaret||50||
vismApanaiH smAraNaishca priyashrutibhireva ca| paTubhirgItavAditrashabdaishcitraishca darshanaiH||51||
sraMsanollekhanairdhUmaira~jjanaiH kavalagrahaiH| shoNitasyAvasekaishca vyAyAmodgharShaNaistathA||52||
prabuddhasa~jj~jaM matimAnanubandhamupakramet| tasya saMrakShitavyaM hi manaH pralayahetutaH||53||
snehasvedopapannAnAM yathAdoShaM yathAbalam| pa~jca karmANi kurvIta mUrcchAyeShu madeShu ca||54||
aShTAviMshatyauShadhasya tathA tiktasya sarpiShaH| prayogaH shasyate tadvanmahataH ShaTpalasya vA||55||
triphalAyAH prayogo vA saghRutakShaudrasharkaraH| shilAjatuprayogo vA prayogaH payaso~api vA||56||
pippalInAM prayogo vA payasA citrakasya vA| rasAyanAnAM kaumbhasya sarpiSho vA prashasyate||57||
raktAvasekAcchAstrANAM satAM sattvavatAmapi| sevanAnmadamUrcchAyAH prashAmyanti sharIriNAm||58||
tatra shlokau- vishuddhaM cAvishuddhaM ca shoNitaM tasya hetavaH| raktapradoShajA rogAsteShu rogeShu cauShadham||59||
madamUrcchAyasannyAsahetulakShaNabheShajam| vidhishoNitake~adhyAye sarvametat prakAshitam||60||
kulatthamAShaniShpAvatilatailaniShevaNaiH| piNDAlumUlakAdInAM haritAnAM ca sarvashaH||6||

vidhinA shoNitaM jAtaM shuddhaM bhavati dehinAm| deshakAlaukasAtmyAnAM vidhiryaH samprakAshitaH||3||

Commentary: vidhineti samyagAhArAcAravidhinA| shuddhaM bhavatItyatra bhavati vidyata ityarthaH, utpAdasya jAtashabdenaivoktatvAt| kena vidhinetyAha- deshetyAdi| sAtmyashabdasya deshAdibhiH pratyekamanvayaH| okasAtmyam abhyAsasAtmyam| samprakAshita iti tasyAshitIye (sU.a.6), samprakAshita ityatra ‘tena’ iti sheShaH; ato yaH samprakAshito vidhistena vidhineti sambandhaH| anye vyAkhyAnayanti- shoNitaM jAtaM tAvadbhavati, tacca kAraNAntaraduShTaM sadvidhinA yathoktena punaH shuddhaM bhavatIti yojanIyam||3||

tadvishuddhaM hi rudhiraM balavarNasukhAyuShA| yunakti prANinaM prANaH shoNitaM hyanuvartate||4||

Commentary: vishuddhaM shoNitaM kiM karotItyAha- tadvishuddhamityAdi| tena vidhinA vishuddhaM tadvishuddhaM; kiMvA taditi shoNitam| prANaH shoNitaM hyanuvartata iti shoNitAnvayavyatirekamanuvidhIyate| yaduktaM- “dashaivAyatanAnyAhuH prANA yeShu pratiShThitAH| sha~gkhau marmatrayaM kaNTho raktaM shukraujasI gudam”- (sU.a.29) iti||4||
praduShTabahutIkShNoShNairmadyairanyaishca tadvidhaiH| tathA~atilavaNakShArairamlaiH kaTubhireva ca||5||
jalajAnUpabailAnAM prasahAnAM ca sevanAt| dadhyamlamastusuktAnAM surAsauvIrakasya ca||7||
viruddhAnAmupaklinnapUtInAM bhakShaNena ca| bhuktvA divA prasvapatAM dravasnigdhagurUNi ca||8||
atyAdAnaM tathA krodhaM bhajatAM cAtapAnalau| chardivegapratIghAtAt kAle cAnavasecanAt||9||
shramAbhighAtasantApairajIrNAdhyashanaistathA| sharatkAlasvabhAvAcca shoNitaM sampraduShyati||10||
tataH shoNitajA rogAH prajAyante pRuthagvidhAH| mukhapAko~akShirAgashca pUtighrANAsyagandhitA||11||
gulmopakushavIsarparaktapittapramIlakAH| vidradhI raktamehashca pradaro vAtashoNitam||12||
vaivarNyamagnisAdashca pipAsA gurugAtratA| santApashcAtidaurbalyamaruciH shirasashca ruk||13||
vidAhashcAnnapAnasya tiktAmlodgiraNaM klamaH| krodhapracuratA buddheH sammoho lavaNAsyatA||14||
svedaH sharIradaurgandhyaM madaH kampaH svarakShayaH| tandrAnidrAtiyogashca tamasashcAtidarshanam||15||
kaNDvaruHkoThapiDakAkuShThacarmadalAdayaH| vikArAH sarva evaite vij~jeyAH shoNitAshrayAH||16||
shItoShNasnigdharUkShAdyairupakrAntAshca ye gadAH| samyak sAdhyA na sidhyanti raktajAMstAn vibhAvayet||17||

kuryAcchoNitarogeShu raktapittaharIM kriyAm| virekamupavAsaM ca srAvaNaM shoNitasya ca||18||

Commentary: shoNitarogacikitsAmAha- kuryAdityAdi| raktapittaharakriyAdayo yathAyogyatayA boddhavyAH||18||

baladoShapramANAdvA vishuddhyA rudhirasya vA| rudhiraM srAvayejjantorAshayaM prasamIkShya vA||19||

Commentary: uktashoNitasrAvaNapramANamAha- baletyAdi| baladoShapramANAditi balasya tathA doShasya shoNitavyAdhirUpasya pramANaM vIkShya; doShashabdo hyayaM roge vartate| vishuddhyA rudhirasya ceti yAvatA srAvaNena shoNitaM vishuddhaM bhavati| AshayaM sthAnaM duShTashoNitAsha(shra)yamiti yAvat| yathA- svalpe kuShThe stokameva vishuddhyarthamupAdeyaM, mahati kuShThe bahu srAvaNIyam| yaduktaM- “pracchanamalpe kuShThe mahati ca shastaM sirAvyadhanam” (ci. 7) iti| eShu ca pakSheShu yadyatrAnatyayaM bhavati tattatra grAhyam||19||
aruNAbhaM bhavedvAtAdvishadaM phenilaM tanu| pittAt pItAsitaM raktaM styAyatyauShNyAccireNa ca||20||
IShatpANDu kaphAdduShTaM picchilaM tantumadghanam| saMsRuShTali~ggaM saMsargAttrili~ggaM sAnnipAtikam||21||
samprati vAtAdivadbahuvikArakartRutvena shoNitasya shoNitavikArANAM pUrvoktAnevopakramAn la~gghanabRuMhaNAdIn visheSheNa darshayituM vidhishoNitIyo~abhidhIyate| iyamapyarthaparA sa~jj~jA ||1-2||

samprati raktavAhidhamanIduShTyA ye vyAdhayo bhavanti tAnAha- yadA tvityAdi| sa~jj~jAvahAnIti sa~jj~jAhetumanovahAni, manasastu kevalameva sharIramayanIbhUtaM; yaduktaM- “sattvAdInAM punaH kevalaM sharIramayanIbhUtam” (vi. 5) ityAdi; kiMvA rasasa~jj~jaM dhAtumAvahantIti rasasa~jj~javahAni | rasavahadhamanInAM tu hRudayaM sthAnaM, tadupaghAtAcca moha upapanna eva| malA iti duShTadoShasa~jj~jAH; yaduktaM- “malinIkaraNAnmalAH” iti| yathottaraM li~ggAdhikyaM madamUrcchAyasannyAseShu moharUpaM j~jeyaM; made~api hi stoko moho~asti, uttarayostu vyakta eva mohaH||25-29||
paruShaM brUta iti paruShAbhAShaH||30-32||-

mUrcchAyalakShaNamAha- nIlaM vetyAdi| tatra vAtamUrcchAye shyAvAruNA chAyA riShTarUpatvAnmaraNAya syAd vAyavyatvAditi codyaM kurvanti; uktaM hi- “vAyavyA sA vinAshAya kleshAya mahate~api vA” (iM. 7) iti| tanna, animittA hi chAyA riShTaM na tu dRushyamAnanimittA, iha ca vAtasambandho dRushyata eva nimittaM; kiMvA “kleshAya mahate~api vA” iti vacanAdeva vAyavyacchAyAyA mArakatvaM vyabhicaritam| tamobhirghanaishceti tamoghanaiH; kiMvA tamobhireva ghanaiH| vinA bIbhatsaceShTitairiti dantakhAdanA~ggavikShepaNAdikaM vinA||35-41||

sannyAsasya mUrcchAdibhyo bhedakaM lakShaNamAha- doSheShvityAdi| kRutavegeShviti vegaM kRutvA kShINabaleShu, vego hi doShANAM balakShayakAraNaM bhavati; yaduktaM viShamajvare- “kRutvA vegaM gatabalA” (ci. 3) ityAdi| sannyasyanti aceShTaM kurvanti | prANAyatanamiti hRudayam| muktveti aprApya| sadyaHphalA iti sadyaH prabodhanakArikAstIkShNA~jjanAdikAH| sUcIbhiriti ca todanena sambadhyate| sammUrcchitAnIti militAni| gAlayediti yatnena mukhe prakShipet| sauvarcalasthAne kecit sauvIrakamAhuH| anubandhaM satatam| pralayahetuta iti mohahetutaH||42-53||

aShTAviMshatyauShadhasyeti pAnIyakalyANasya| tiktasya mahatastathA tiktasya ShaTpalasya tathA mahatastiktasyeti sambandhaH; ete ca tiktaShaTpalamahAtiktakaghRute kuShThacikitsite vaktavye| kaumbhaM sarpirdashAbdikam||54-58||

shuddhihetumabhidhAya duShTihetumAha- praduShTetyAdi| praduShTaM svaprakRutiviparItam| anyaishca tadvidhairiti praduShTapAnakAdibhiH; kiMvA ‘annaiH’ iti pAThaH| tathA~atilavaNakShArairityAdi kecidbheShajaviShayaM varNayanti, tadvidhairiti vacanenAnnapAnasyAtilavaNAdergRuhItatvAt| niShpAvaH shvetashimbiH| atyAdAnaM tRuptimatikramya bhojanam| kAle ceti shoNitaduShTiyukte sharatkAle| ajIrNe~adhyashanamajIrNAdhyashanaM; kiMvA ajIrNasyApakvasyAshanamajIrNAshanam, adhyashanaM tu pUrvAnnasheShe yadbhujyate, yadAha- “bhuktasyopari yadbhuktaM tadadhyashanamucyate” (ci.a.15)||5-10||

upakushaH mukharogavisheShaH; yaduktaM sushrute- “veShTeShu dAhaH pAkashca tebhyo dantAshcalanti ca| yasminnupakusho nAma pittaraktakRuto gadaH” (su. ni. 16) iti| kuShTha ityukte~api carmadalAbhidhAnaM visheShArtham| shoNitAshrayA iti bhAShayA shoNitasya vAtAdivat svAtantryeNa rogakartRutvaM nirAkaroti| anuktabhUrishoNitarogagrahaNArthamAha- shItoShNetyAdi| AdyagrahaNAttIkShNamRudvAdInAM grahaNam| samyagiti pUrveNa yojanIyam | tatra shItoShNasnigdharUkShAdyairiti shoNitavRuddhimanapekShya vAtAdijayArthamAtraprayuktairiti mantavyam| yena shoNitavyAdherapi shAntirvakShyamANaraktapittaharakriyAdibhiH shItoShNasnigdhAdikriyApraviShTaiva, tatashca shoNitarogasyApi shItAdikriyAbhireva shoNitapratikUlAbhiH prashamo bhavati; pravRuddhashoNitAshrayAstu vAtAdaya AshrayaprabhAvAnna svacikitsAmAtreNa prashAmyanti||11-17||
duShTaraktalakShaNamAha- aruNAbhamityAdi| styAyati ghanaM bhavati||20-21||
athAto yajjaHpuruShIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
bhadrakApyastu netyAha nahyandho~andhAt prajAyate| mAtApitrorapi ca te prAgutpattirna yujyate||18||
karmajastu mato jantuH karmajAstasya cAmayAH| nahyRute karmaNo janma rogANAM puruShasya vA||19||
bharadvAjastu netyAha kartA pUrvaM hi karmaNaH| dRuShTaM na cAkRutaM karma yasya syAt puruShaH phalam||20||
bhAvahetuH svabhAvastu vyAdhInAM puruShasya ca| kharadravacaloShNatvaM tejontAnAM yathaiva hi||21||
kA~gkAyanastu netyAha na hyArambhaphalaM bhavet| bhavet svabhAvAdbhAvAnAmasiddhiH siddhireva vA||22||
sraShTA tvamitasa~gkalpo brahmApatyaM prajApatiH| cetanAcetanasyAsya jagataH sukhaduHkhayoH||23||
tanneti bhikShurAtreyo na hyapatyaM prajApatiH| prajAhitaiShI satataM duHkhairyu~jjyAdasAdhuvat||24||
kAlajastveva puruShaH kAlajAstasya cAmayAH| jagat kAlavashaM sarvaM kAlaH sarvatra kAraNam||25||
tatharShINAM vivadatAmuvAcedaM punarvasuH| maivaM vocata tattvaM hi duShprApaM pakShasaMshrayAt||26||
vAdAn saprativAdAn hi vadanto nishcitAniva| pakShAntaM naiva gacchanti tilapIDakavadgatau||27||
muktvaivaM vAdasa~gghaTTamadhyAtmamanucintyatAm| nAvidhUte tamaHskandhe j~jeye j~jAnaM pravartate||28||
yeShAmeva hi bhAvAnAM sampat sa~jjanayennaram| teShAmeva vipadvyAdhInvividhAnsamudIrayet||29||
athAtreyasya bhagavato vacanamanunishamya punareva vAmakaH kAshipatiruvAca bhagavantamAtreyaM- bhagavan! sampannimittajasya puruShasya vipannimittajAnAM ca rogANAM kimabhivRuddhikAraNamiti||30||
tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- hitAhAropayoga eka eva puruShavRuddhikaro bhavati, ahitAhAropayogaH punarvyAdhinimittamiti ||31||

evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- kathamiha bhagavan! hitAhitAnAmAhArajAtAnAM lakShaNamanapavAdamabhijAnImahe; hitasamAkhyAtAnAmAhArajAtAnAmahitasamAkhyAtAnAM ca mAtrAkAlakriyAbhUmidehadoShapuruShAvasthAntareShu viparItakAritvamupalabhAmaha iti||32||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- yadAhArajAtamagnivesha! samAMshcaiva sharIradhAtUn prakRutau sthApayati viShamAMshca samIkarotItyetaddhitaM viddhi, viparItaM tvahitamiti; ityetaddhitAhitalakShaNamanapavAdaM bhavati||33||
evaMvAdinaM ca bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- bhagavan! na tvetadevamupadiShTaM bhUyiShThakalpAH sarvabhiShajo vij~jAsyanti||34||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- yeShAM hi viditamAhAratattvamagnivesha! guNato dravyataH karmataH sarvAvayavashashca mAtrAdayo bhAvAH, ta etadevamupadiShTaM vij~jAtumutsahante| yathA tu khalvetadupadiShTaM bhUyiShThakalpAH sarvabhiShajo vij~jAsyanti, tathaitadupadekShyAmo mAtrAdIn bhAvAnanudAharantaH; teShAM hi bahuvidhavikalpA bhavanti| AhAravidhivisheShAMstu khalu lakShaNatashcAvayavatashcAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||35||

Commentary: etadevAsarvabhiShagj~jeyatvaM lakShaNasyAha- yeShAM hItyAdi| guNata iti iha prakaraNe gurulaghutvAdiguNataH| dravyata iti kAraNataH, yathA- idamApyamidamAgneyamityAdi; kiMvA dravyata ityAhAradravyAdraktashAlyAdeH| karmataH kAryataH; yathA- idaM jIvanamidaM bRuMhaNamityAdi| sarvAvayavashashceti rasavIryavipAkaprabhAvebhyaH| mAtrAdayashcAnantaroktAH puruShAntA j~jeyAH| AhAratattvaM ca guNAdibhyo viditaM mAtrAdayashca viditA iti yojanA| kiMvA guNashabdena rasavIryAdInAmapi grahaNaM, sarvAvayavashashceti mAtrAdij~jAnena sambadhyate| yathetyAdau etaditi hitAhitam| bhUyiShThakalpA nAnAprakArA uttamAdhamamadhyamA ityarthaH, bhUyiShThakalpA iti kRutvA sarvagrahaNamuttamAdInAmeva shreShThashreShThatarashreShThatamAdibhedagrahaNArthaM; kiMvA shalyAdyaShTA~ggAdhyAyivaidyagrahaNArthaM ; kiMvA bhUyiShThakalpA iti vij~jAtabhUrihitAhitodAharaNAH; agryAdhikAre hi bahu hitAhitaM vaktavyaM, taccAlpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya bhavati, prakRuShTabuddhInAM cAnuktaj~jAnAyeti bhAvaH| lakShaNata iti lakShaNamAhAratvaM sthAvaraja~ggamAtmakatvAdi, etacca ‘tadyathA- AhAratvaM’ ityAdinA ‘karaNabAhulyAt’ ityantena vakShyati| avayavata iti ekadeshataH, ekadeshAshca lohitashAlyAdayaH; te tu ‘tadyathA lohitashAlayaH’ ityAdinA vakShyante||35||

tadyathA- AhAratvamAhArasyaikavidhamarthAbhedAt; sa punardviyoniH, sthAvaraja~ggamAtmakatvAt; dvividhaprabhAvaH, hitAhitodarkavisheShAt; caturvidhopayogaH, pAnAshanabhakShyalehyopayogAt; ShaDAsvAdaH, rasabhedataH ShaDvidhatvAt; viMshatiguNaH, gurulaghushItoShNasnigdharUkShamandatIkShNasthirasaramRudukaThina- vishadapicchilashlakShNakharasUkShmasthUlasAndradravAnugamAt; aparisa~gkhyeyavikalpaH, dravyasaMyogakaraNabAhulyAt||36||

Commentary: arthAbhedAditi abhyavahriyamANatvArthAbhedAt| dviyoniriti dviprabhavaH| hitarUpo~ahitarUpo vodarko hitAhitodarkaH, sa eva visheShaH; udarka uttarakAlInaM phalam| gurulAghavAdayo yugmAH parasparavirodhino j~jeyAH; anugamAditi anugatatvAt| AtreyabhadrakApyIye (sU. 26) vakShyamANAH paratvAdayo guNA na tathA~atropakArakA iti nehocyante| ye tu tatra saMyogakaraNe AhAravidhau bhUryupayoginI, te bahuvidhatvena tvaparisa~gkhyeyavikalpahetutvenaiva niveshite| parimANaM tu mAtrA, sA cehAnudAharaNIyatvena pratij~jAtA ‘mAtrAdIn bhAvAnanudAharantaH’ iti vacanena| dravyasaMyogakaraNabAhulyAditi dravyaM shUkadhAnyAdikaM, saMyoga AhAradravyANAM melakaH, karaNaM saMskAraH||36||

tasya khalu ye ye vikArAvayavA bhUyiShThamupayujyante, bhUyiShThakalpAnAM ca manuShyANAM prakRutyaiva hitatamAshcAhitatamAshca, tAMstAn yathAvadupadekShyAmaH||37||

Commentary: vikArAvayavA iti vikAraikadeshAH| bhUyiShThakalpAnAmiti ki~jcinnyUnabahUnAM , kalpashabdo hyayamIShadasamAptyarthaH , yathArAjakalpa iti| etena prAyasho bahUnAM ye hitA ahitAshca ta ucyanta ityarthaH| anye tu bhUyiShThakalpAnAmiti samAnadhAtuprakRutInAmiti bruvate| prakRutyeti na saMyogakaraNAdinA, kintu svabhAvena||37||

tadyathA- lohitashAlayaH shUkadhAnyAnAM pathyatamatve shreShThatamA bhavanti, mudgAH shamIdhAnyAnAm, AntarikShamudakAnAM, saindhavaM lavaNAnAM, jIvantIshAkaM shAkAnAm, aiNeyaM mRugamAMsAnAM, lAvaH pakShiNAM, godhA bileshayAnAM, rohito matsyAnAM, gavyaM sarpiH sarpiShAM, gokShIraM kShIrANAM, tilatailaM sthAvarajAtAnAM snehAnAM, varAhavasA AnUpamRugavasAnAM, culukIvasA matsyavasAnAM, pAkahaMsavasA jalacaraviha~ggavasAnAM, kukkuTavasA viShkirashakunivasAnAM, ajamedaH shAkhAdamedasAM, shRu~ggaveraM kandAnAM, mRudvIkA phalAnAM, sharkarekShuvikArANAm, iti prakRutyaiva hitatamAnAmAhAravikArANAM prAdhAnyato dravyANi vyAkhyAtAni bhavanti||38||

Commentary: lohitashAlI raktashAliH| shUkadhAnyAnAmityAdau nirdhAraNe ShaShThI| pathyatamatva iti tamapprayogaH sajAtIyebhyaH prakRuShTatvena shreShThatamA iti, yathA- shreShThatama iti prashasyaH; kiMvA tamapgrahaNaM svArthikaM, yathA- “yudhiShThiraH shreShThatamaH kurUNAm” iti, tathA ‘anyatamaM jihvAvaiShayikam’ (sU. 26) iti| yadyapi kAkamAcI tridoShaghnI rasAyanI ca, tathA~apIha jIvantI svasthahitatvaprakarShAducyate, svasthahitatvaprakarShashceha vacanAdeva labhyate| evamanyatrApi vyAkhyeyam| kAkamAcyAM tvayaM visheShaH- yat- kAkamAcI paryuShitA maraNAya| yadyapi godhArohitau kaphapittavardhanau, vacanaM hi- “bhUshayA vArijAtAshca kaphapittavivardhanAH” iti, tathA~apIha sajAtIyeShu pathyatvaprakarSheNehocyete; tathA ki~jciddoShakarasyApi Rutubhedena pathyatvaM bhavatyeva; ki~jcit svasthahitatvaM dravyasya pRuthageva guNaH na doShakartRutvaM doShaharatvaM vA~apekShate; yaduktaM- “ki~jciddoShaprashamanaM ki~jciddhAtupradUShaNam| svasthavRuttau mataM ki~jciddravyaM trividhamucyate” (sU. 1) iti| cullukI ‘sugRuha’ iti khyAtaH| pAkahaMsaH shvetahaMsaH||38||

ahitatamAnapyupadekShyAmaH- yavakAH shUkadhAnyAnAmapathyatamatvena prakRuShTatamA bhavanti, mAShAH shamIdhAnyAnAM, varShAnAdeyamudakAnAm, USharaM lavaNAnAM, sarShapashAkaM shAkAnAM, gomAMsaM mRugamAMsAnAM, kANakapotaH pakShiNAM, bheko bileshayAnAM, cilicimo matsyAnAm, AvikaM sarpiH sarpiShAm, avikShIraM kShIrANAM, kusumbhasnehaH sthAvarasnehAnAM, mahiShavasA AnUpamRugavasAnAM, kumbhIravasA matsyavasAnAM, kAkamadguvasA jalacaraviha~ggavasAnAM, caTakavasA viShkirashukanivasAnAM, hastimedaH shAkhAdamedasAM, nikucaM phalAnAm, AlukaM kandAnAM, phANitamikShuvikArANAm, iti prakRutyaivAhitatamAnAmAhAravikArANAM prakRuShTatamAni dravyANi vyAkhyAtAni bhavanti; (iti) hitAhitAvayavo vyAkhyAta AhAravikArANAm||39||

Commentary: prakRuShTatamA iti tamapprayogaH pUrvavat svArthikaH| yadyapyapathyatama iti tamapprayogeNaiva prakRuShTatvaM pratipAditaM, tathA~apyapathyatamAnAM bahUnAM madhye prakarShakhyApanArthaM prakRuShTatama iti padam| varShAsu nAdeyaM varShAnAdeyam| USharadeshabhavamUSharam| kANakapota ityatra kANashabdo~alpavacanaH; yathA- kANo megha iti| cilicimo mahAshakalI matsyo rohitabhedaH, atraiva hyagre rohitabhedameva cilicimaM vakShyati| kAkamadguH pAnIyakAkikA| caTakaH prasiddhaH| hitAhitAvayava ityAdi| atrAdau ‘iti’ shabdo~adhyAhAryaH, tena iti hitAhitAvayava AhAravikArANAM vyAkhyAto bhavatIti pUrveNaiva yojanIyam||39||

ato bhUyaH karmauShadhAnAM ca prAdhAnyataH sAnubandhAni dravyANyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH| tadyathA- annaM vRuttikarANAM shreShTham, udakamAshvAsakarANAM (surA shramaharANAM ), kShIraM jIvanIyAnAM, mAMsaM bRuMhaNIyAnAM, rasastarpaNIyAnAM, lavaNamannadravyarucikarANAm, amlaM hRudyAnAM, kukkuTo balyAnAM, nakrareto vRuShyANAM, madhu shleShmapittaprashamanAnAM, sarpirvAtapittaprashamanAnAM, tailaM vAtashleShmaprashamanAnAM, vamanaM shleShmaharANAM, virecanaM pittaharANAM, bastirvAtaharANAM, svedo mArdavakarANAM, vyAyAmaH sthairyakarANAM, kShAraH puMstvopaghAtinAM, (tindukamanannadravyarucikarANAm ,) AmaM kapitthamakaNThyAnAm, AvikaM sarpirahRudyAnAm, ajAkShIraM shoShaghnastanyasAtmyaraktasA~ggrAhikaraktapittaprashamanAnAm, avikShIraM shleShmapittajananAnAM, mahiShIkShIraM svapnajananAnAM, mandakaM dadhyabhiShyandakarANAM, gavedhukAnnaM karshanIyAnAm, uddAlakAnnaM virUkShaNIyAnAm, ikShurmUtrajananAnAM, yavAH purIShajananAnAM, jAmbavaM vAtajananAnAM, shaShkulyaH shleShmapittajananAnAM, kulatthA amlapittajananAnAM, mAShAH shleShmapittajananAnAM, madanaphalaM vamanAsthApanAnuvAsanopayoginAM, trivRut sukhavirecanAnAM, catura~ggulo mRuduvirecanAnAM, snukpayastIkShNavirecananAM, pratyakpuShpA shirovirecanAnAM, viDa~ggaM krimighnAnAM, shirISho viShaghnAnAM, khadiraH kuShThaghnAnAM, rAsnA vAtaharANAm, AmalakaM vayaHsthApanAnAM, harItakI pathyAnAm, eraNDamUlaM vRuShyavAtaharANAM, pippalImUlaM dIpanIyapAcanIyAnAhaprashamanAnAM, citrakamUlaM dIpanIyapAcanIyagudashothArshaHshUlaharANAM, puShkaramUlaM hikkAshvAsakAsapArshvashUlaharANAM, mustaM sA~ggrAhikadIpanIyapAcanIyAnAm, udIcyaM nirvApaNadIpanIyapAcanIyacchardyatIsAraharANAM, kaTva~ggaM sA~ggrAhikapAcanIyadIpanIyAnAm, anantA sA~ggrAhikaraktapittaprashamanAnAm, amRutA sA~ggrAhikavAtaharadIpanIyashleShmashoNitavibandhaprashamanAnAM, bilvaM sA~ggrAhikadIpanIyavAtakaphaprashamanAnAm, ativiShA dIpanIyapAcanIyasA~ggrAhikasarvadoShaharANAm, utpalakumudapadmaki~jjalkaH sA~ggrAhikaraktapittaprashamanAnAM, durAlabhA pittashleShmaprashamanAnAM, gandhapriya~gguH shoNitapittAtiyogaprashamanAnAM, kuTajatvak shleShmapittaraktasA~ggrAhikopashoShaNAnAM, kAshmaryaphalaM raktasA~ggrAhikaraktapittaprashamanAnAM, pRushniparNI sA~ggrAhikavAtaharadIpanIyavRuShyANAM, vidArigandhA vRuShyasarvadoShaharANAM, balA sA~ggrAhikabalyavAtaharANAM, gokShurako mUtrakRucchrAnilaharANAM, hi~gguniryAsashchedanIyadIpanIyAnulomikavAtakaphaprashamanAnAm, amlavetaso bhedanIyadIpanIyAnulomikavAtashleShmaharANAM, yAvashUkaH sraMsanIyapAcanIyArshoghnAnAM, takrAbhyAso grahaNIdoShashophArshoghRutavyApatprashamanAnAM, kravyAnmAMsarasAbhyAso grahaNIdoShashoShArshoghnAnAM, kShIraghRutAbhyAso rasAyanAnAM, samaghRutasaktuprAshAbhyAso vRuShyodAvartaharANAM, tailagaNDUShAbhyAso dantabalarucikarANAM, candanaM durgandhaharadAhanirvApaNalepanAnAM, rAsnAguruNI shItApanayanapralepanAnAM, lAmajjakoshIraM dAhatvagdoShasvedApanayanapralepanAnAM, kuShThaM vAtaharAbhya~ggopanAhopayoginAM, madhukaM cakShuShyavRuShyakeshyakaNThyavarNyavirajanIyaropaNIyAnAM, vAyuH prANasa~jj~jApradAnahetUnAm, agnirAmastambhashItashUlodvepanaprashamanAnAM, jalaM stambhanIyAnAM, mRudbhRuShTaloShTranirvApitamudakaM tRuShNAcchardyatiyogaprashamanAnAm, atimAtrAshanamAmapradoShahetUnAM, yathAgnyabhyavahAro~agnisandhukShaNAnAM, yathAsAtmyaM ceShTAbhyavahArau sevyAnAM, kAlabhojanamArogyakarANAM, tRuptirAhAraguNAnAM, vegasandhAraNamanArogyakarANAM, madyaM saumanasyajananAnAM, madyAkShepo dhIdhRutismRutiharANAM, gurubhojanaM durvipAkakarANAm, ekAshanabhojanaM sukhapariNAmakarANAM, strIShvatiprasa~ggaH shoShakarANAM, shukraveganigrahaH ShANDyakarANAM, parAghAtanamannAshraddhAjananAnAm, anashanamAyuSho hrAsakarANAM, pramitAshanaM karshanIyAnAm, ajIrNAdhyashanaM grahaNIdUShaNAnAM, viShamAshanamagnivaiShamyakarANAM, viruddhavIryAshanaM ninditavyAdhikarANAM, prashamaH pathyAnAM, AyAsaH sarvApathyAnAM, mithyAyogo vyAdhikarANAM, rajasvalAbhigamanamalakShmImukhAnAM, brahmacaryamAyuShyANAM, paradArAbhigamanamanAyuShyANAM, sa~gkalpo vRuShyANAM, daurmanasyamavRuShyANAm, ayathAbalamArambhaH prANoparodhinAM, viShAdo rogavardhanAnAM, snAnaM shramaharANAM, harShaH prINanAnAM, shokaH shoShaNAnAM, nivRuttiH puShTikarANAM, puShTiHsvapnakarANAm, atisvapnastandrAkarANAM, sarvarasAbhyAso balakarANAm, ekarasAbhyAso daurbalyakarANAM, garbhashalyamAhAryANAm, ajIrNamuddhAryANAM, bAlo mRudubheShajIyAnAM, vRuddho yApyAnAM, garbhiNI tIkShNauShadhavyavAyavyAyAmavarjanIyAnAM, saumanasyaM garbhadhAraNAnAM, sannipAto dushcikitsyAnAm, Amo viShamacikitsyAnAM , jvaro rogANAM, kuShThaM dIrgharogANAM, rAjayakShmA rogasamUhAnAM, prameho~anuSha~ggiNAM, jalaukaso~anushastrANAM, bastistantrANAM, himavAnauShadhibhUmInAM, soma oShadhInAM, marubhUmirArogyadeshAnAm, anUpo~ahitadeshAnAm, nirdeshakAritvamAturaguNAnAM, bhiShak cikitsA~ggAnAM, nAstikovarjyAnAM, laulyaM kleshakarANAm, anirdeshakAritvamariShTAnAM, anirvedo vArtalakShaNAnAM, vaidyasamUho niHsaMshayakarANaM, yogo vaidyaguNAnAM, vij~jAnamauShadhInAM, shAstrasahitastarkaH sAdhanAnAM, sampratipattiH kAlaj~jAnaprayojanAnAm, avyavasAyaH kAlAtipattihetUnAM, dRuShTakarmatA niHsaMshayakarANAm, asamarthatA bhayakarANAM, tadvidyasambhAShA buddhivardhanAnAm, AcAryaH shAstrAdhigamahetUnAm, Ayurvedo~amRutAnAM, sadvacanamanuShTheyAnAm, asadgrahaNaM sarvAhitAnAM, sarvasannyAsaH sukhAnAmiti||40||

Commentary: ato bhUya iti ata iti hetau, yasmAddhitAhitAdyuktaM na tu teShAM karmetyarthaH| bhUyaH shabdaH punararthe, karmeti kAryam; tena, ato bhUya AhAravikArANAM karma| yathA- ‘annaM vRuttikarANAm’, ‘udakamAshvAsakarANAm’ ityAdi; tathauShadhAnAM ca karma, yathA- ‘trivRut sukhavirecanAnAm’ ityAdi vakShyAmaH| prAdhAnyata ityanena na sarveShAmAhAravikArANAmauShadhAnAM ca karmAbhidhAnaM , kintu yathApradhAnamiti darshayati| sAnubandhAnIti saprayojanAni, yathA- ajIrNamuddhAryANAmityAdi; ajIrNajvarAdikarmakathanaM hi cikitsopayogi vyaktameva| dravyANIti mahAbhUtAni, yathA- jalaM stambhanAnAM, vAyuH prANasa~jj~jApradAnahetUnAm, ityAdi| dravyANItyupalakShaNaM; tacca sAnubandhAnItyasya visheShaNaM, tenAdravyamapi sAnubandhamucyate; yathA- ‘shAstrasahitastarkaH sAdhanAnAm’ ityAdi| kiMvA, hitAhitAvayavamiti karmavisheShaNaM; tena, hitAhitaikadesharUpaM karmAhAravikAraNAmiti bhavati; tatra hitaM karma ‘annaM vRuttikarANAm’ ityAdi, ahitaM karma ‘AvikaM sarpirahRudyAnAm’ ityAdi| auShadhAnAM karma ‘trivRut sukhavirecanAnAm’ ityAdi vyAkhyAnaM pUrvavadeva| vRuttikarANAmiti sharIrasthitikarANAm | annadravyarucikarANAmiti lavaNamannena saMyuktaM sadanne ruciM karotItyarthaH| amlaM hRudyAnAmiti rucyAnAm, amlaM tu svayameva rocate| madhu shleShmapittaprashamanAnAmiti dravadravyeShu, durAlabhA tvauShadhadravyeShu; tena durAlabhAyA madhunashca shleShmapittaprashamanashreShThatvAvadhAraNaM na virodhi| bastiriti avisheShAdAsthApanAnuvAsane| avikShIraM pittashleShmajananAnAmiti peyeShu madhye, mAShAH pittashleShmajananAnAmiti bhojyeShu, shaShkulyaH pittashleShmajananAnAmiti bhakShyeShu madhye; kiMvA, trayamapyetat pittashleShmajananaM prati samAnamiti tritayamapyucyate; evamanyatrApi tulyashreShThatAbhidhAnaM tajjAtIyashreShThatAbhiprAyeNa tathA tulyatvena ca j~jeyam| mandakamiti mandajAtam| uddAlako vanakodravaH| gudashothaH arshaH| gandhapriya~gguH priya~ggureva| kravyaM mAMsamattIti kravyAd vyAghrAdiH| samaghRuta ityatra samashabdaH sahArthaH| udvepanamiti vepanam| udakamAshvAsanastambhanAnAmiti vaktavye, yat pRuthak ‘udakamAshvAsakarANAM’, tathA ‘jalaM stambhanAnAM’ iti karoti, tena karmadvaye~api jalasyAnanyasAdhAraNatAM darshayati; militvA guNapAThe hyubhayakarmakartRuShveva prAdhAnyaM syAt; evamanyatrApyanekakarmakartRutve yasya prAdhAnyamuktaM pippalImUlAdau, tatra tathAbhUtAnekakarmakartRutveShveva prAdhAnyaM j~jeyaM, na pRuthakkarmaNi| lAmajjakoshIramushIradvayaM sagandhamagandhaM ca gRuhyate| ekAshanabhojanamiti ekakAlabhojanam; anenaikAshanasya sukhapariNAmatAmAtramucyate, na dvitIyAnnapratiShedhaH kriyate; etena dvirbhojane~apyavyAhatAgnitAnidrAdayaH sukhapariNAmakAraNatvena j~jeyAH| shoShadvArANAmiti shoShakAraNAnAm| parAghAtanaM vadhasthAnaM, vadhyamAnaprANidarshanAddhi ghRuNayA nAnne shraddhA syAt| ‘yathA~ashitaM’ iti kecit paThanti, tannAtisAdhu| pramitAshanam atItakAlabhojanaM, stokabhojanaM vA| viShamAshanaM prakRutikaraNAdiviShamAshanam| ninditavyAdhiH shvitrakuShThAdiH| alakShmImukhAnAm alakShmIkAraNAnAm| mithyAyogaH samyagyogAdanyastrividho yogaH| sa~gkalpaH strIsa~ggasa~gkalpaH| jvaro rogANAmiti rujAkartRUNAm| anuSha~ggI punarbhAvI| tantrANAmiti karmaNAm| soma oShadhirAjaH pa~jcadashaparvA| vArtalakShaNAnAmiti ArogyalakShaNAnAm| j~jAnamiti auShadhAdivij~jAnam| sAdhanAnAmiti j~jAnasAdhanAnAm| sampratipattiH yathAkartavyatAnuShThAnam | tRuptirAhAraguNAnAmityatra guNashabdaH prashastadharmavacanaH| ekarasAbhyAsaH karshanAnAmiti apavAdaM varjayitvA, tena ghRutAbhyAso rasAyanAnAmiti na virudhyate| amRutAnAmiti jIvitapradhA(dA)nahetUnAm| sarvasannyAsaH sarvakriyAtyAgaH , sa hi paramasukhamokShahetuH shArIre vaktavyaH||40||

bhavanti cAtra- agryANAM shatamuddiShTaM yaddvipa~jcAshaduttaram| alametadvikArANAM vighAtAyopadishyate||41||

Commentary: agryANAmityAdau agryashabdaH shreShThavacanaH| alamiti samartham| atra jvarapramehAdayo~api svarUpeNAtipIDAkaratvAnuSha~ggikatvAdinA j~jAtAH santashcikitsAyAmupayuktA bhavanti, ato jvarAdij~jAnamapi vikArANAM vighAtAya samarthaM bhavati | agryANAM ca vikArashamakatvAbhidhAnaM prAdhAnyAducyate, stutyarthaM vA; tena yaducyate- eta eva cedagryAdhikAre vihitA vikArA~jchamayanti, tat kimaparacikitsAbhidhAneneti; tannirastaM bhavati| vikAravighAtashcehotpannAnAmauShadhopayogena, tathA~anutpannAnAM svAsthyaparipAlanena j~jeyaH||41||
samAnakAriNo ye~arthAsteShAM shreShThasya lakShaNam| jyAyastvaM kAryakartRutve varatvaM cApyudAhRutam||42||
vAtapittakaphAnAM ca yadyat prashamane hitam| prAdhAnyatashca nirdiShTaM yadvyAdhiharamuttamam||43||
etannishamya nipuNaM cikitsAM samprayojayet| evaM kurvan sadA vaidyo dharmakAmau samashnute||44||
pathyaM patho~anapetaM yadyaccoktaM manasaH priyam| yaccApriyamapathyaM ca niyataM tanna lakShayet||45||
mAtrAkAlakriyAbhUmidehadoShaguNAntaram | prApya tattaddhi dRushyante te te bhAvAstathA tathA||46||
tasmAt svabhAvo nirdiShTastathA mAtrAdirAshrayaH| tadapekShyobhayaM karma prayojyaM siddhimicchatA||47||

tadAtreyasya bhagavato vacanamanunishamya punarapi bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- yathoddeshamabhinirdiShTaH kevalo~ayamartho bhagavatA shrutashcAsmAbhiH| AsavadravyANAmidAnImanapavAdaM lakShaNamanatisa~gkShepeNopadishyamAnaM shushrUShAmaha iti||48||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- dhAnyaphalamUlasArapuShpakANDapatratvaco bhavantyAsavayonayo~agnivesha! sa~ggraheNAShTau sharkarAnavamIkAH| tAsveva dravyasaMyogakaraNato~aparisa~gkhyeyAsu yathApathyatamAnAmAsavAnAM caturashItiM nibodha| tadyathA- surAsauvIratuShodakamaireyamedakadhAnyAmlAH ShaD dhAnyAsavA bhavanti, mRudvIkAkharjUrakAshmaryadhanvanarAjAdanatRuNashUnyaparUShakAbhayAmalakamRugaliNDikAjAmbavakapittha- kuvalabadarakarkandhupIlupriyAlapanasanyagrodhAshvatthaplakShakapItanodumbarAjamodashRu~ggATakashA~gkhinIphalAsavAH ShaDviMshatirbhavanti, vidArigandhAshvagandhAkRuShNagandhAshatAvarIshyAmAtrivRuddantIdravantIbilvorubUkacitrakamUlairekAdasha mUlAsavA bhavanti, shAlapriyakAshvakarNacandanasyandanakhadirakadarasaptaparNArjunAsanArimedatindukakiNihIshamI- shuktishiMshapAshirIShava~jjaladhanvanamadhUkaiH sArAsavA viMshatirbhavanti, padmotpalanalikumudasaugandhikapuNDarIkashatapatramadhUkapriya~ggudhAtakIpuShpairdasha puShpAsavA bhavanti, ikShukANDekShvikShuvAlikApuNDrakacaturthAH kANDAsavA bhavanti, paTolatADakapatrAsavau dvau bhavataH, tilvakalodhrailavAlukakramukacaturthAstvagAsavA bhavanti, sharkarAsava eka eveti| evameShAmAsavAnAM caturashItiH paraspareNAsaMsRuShTAnAmAsavadravyANAmupanirdiShTA bhavati| eShAmAsavAnAmAsutatvAdAsavasa~jj~jA| dravyasaMyogavibhAgavistArastveShAM bahuvidhakalpaH saMskArashca| yathAsvaM saMyogasaMskArasaMskRutA hyAsavAH svaM karma kurvanti| saMyogasaMskAradeshakAlamAtrAdayashca bhAvAsteShAM teShAmAsavAnAM te te samupadishyante tattatkAryamabhisamIkShyeti||49||

Commentary: idAnImagryAdhikArAdAsaveShvananteShu ya AsavA agryAsta ucyante| dhAnyAdInyekatvena paThitvA pRuthak sharkarAM paThati, dhAnyAdInAmavAntarajAtimatvAt; sharkarAyAstvavAntarajAtirnAsti, yA tu yAsasharkarA sA nAsavakAraNatayA shrUyate, madhusharkarA tu madhvantarniviShTaiva| madhu tu nAsavayonitayA pRuthakpaThitaM, yena tatkRutasyAsavasya dhAnyasambandhAddhAnyAsavenaiva grahaNam | evaM gauDAsavAdiShvapi boddhavyam| dravyaM ca saMyogashca karaNaM ca dravyasaMyogakaraNaM, tato~aparisa~gkhyeyAH syuH| sauvIraM nistuShayavakRutaM, maireyaM surAkRutA surA, medakaH shvetasurA jagalAkhyA, dhAnyAmbu kA~jjikam| tRuNashUnyaM ketakI, mRugaliNDikA vibhItakaM, kuvalamiti sthUlabadarI, karkandhuH shRugAlabadarI| kadaraH shvetakhadiraH, ashvakarNaH shAlabhedaH, arimedo viTkhadiraH, kiNihI apAmArgaH, shuktiH badarI| padmaM saraktamaShTadalapadmaM, nalinaM shvetamaShTadalapadmaM, puNDarIkaM shvetashatapatrapadmaM, shatapatraM tvaruNam| ikShushabdaprAptasyApi puNDrakasya punarabhidhAnamAsavaM prati tasya prAdhAnyakhyApanArtham| kramukaM guvAkam| tilvakaH shAbaralodhraH| AsutatvAditi sandhAnarUpatvAt| dravyasaMyogavibhAga ityAdau ‘eShAm’ iti padena pratyekaM dhAnyAdidravyakRutA AsavA uktAH| teShAM ca vibhAgo~anupapanna ekarUpatvAditi cet? tanna, teShAmapi sajAtIyadravyavibhAgasya vidyamAnatvAt| ki~jca saMskArakadravyavibhAgasyApi tatra shakyatvAt; nahyekenaiva dravyeNa surAdayaH kriyante, prAdhAnyAttu dhAnyAdayo~abhidhIyante| saMskArashca bahuvidhavikalpa iti yojanA| saMyogasaMskArakaraNaprayojanamAha- yathAsvamityAdi| yathAsvamiti yadyujyate; desho bhasmarAshidhAnyarAshyAdiH sandhAneShu vakShyamANaH, kAlastu pakShamAsAdisthApanaM, mAtrA sandhAnadravyamAtrA| AdigrahaNAddravyasvabhAvetikartavyatAsa~ggrahaNam| tattatkAryamiti deshakAlasharIradoShAdibhinnaM hitatvam||49||

bhavati cAtra- manaHsharIrAgnibalapradAnAmasvapnashokArucinAshanAnAm| saMharShaNAnAM pravarAsavAnAmashItiruktA caturuttaraiShA||50||

Commentary: manaHsharIretyAdinA guNakathanaM yuktyA pItasyAsavasya j~jeyam||50||
tatra shlokaH- sharIrarogaprakRutau matAni tattvena cAhAravinishcayaM ca| uvAca yajjaHpuruShAdike~asmin munistathA~agryANi varAsavAMshca||51||
purA pratyakShadharmANaM bhagavantaM punarvasum| sametAnAM maharShINAM prAdurAsIdiyaM kathA ||3||
AtmendriyamanorthAnAM yo~ayaM puruShasa~jj~jakaH| rAshirasyAmayAnAM ca prAgutpattivinishcaye||4||
tadantaraM kAshipatirvAmako vAkyamarthavit | vyAjahArarShisamitimupasRutyAbhivAdya ca||5||
kinnu bhoH puruSho yajjastajjAstasyAmayAH smRutAH| na vetyukte narendreNa provAcarShIn punarvasuH||6||

sarva evAmitaj~jAnavij~jAnacchinnasaMshayAH| bhavantashchettumarhanti kAshirAjasya saMshayam||7||

Commentary: amitAbhyAM j~jAnavij~jAnAbhyAM chinnaH saMshayo yeShAM te tathA| “bhavantashchettumarhanti kAshirAjasya saMshayam” iti pAThaH sugamaH| “bhavanto~arhanti nashchettuM kAshirAje ca saMshayam” iti tu pAThe, no~asmAkaM kAshirAje~asmanmadhyagata ityarthaH| etena svapakShe kAshirAje na vyAmohavacanaM vaktavyamiti shikShayati| cakAreNAnyeShAM ca RuShINAM saMshayaM samuccinoti| anye tu, no~asmAkaM saMshayaM kAshirAje ca saMshayamiti vyAkhyAnayanti| saMshayadvaye caiko~atra RuShINAmAtmendriyetyAdinA shlokena darshitaH saMshayaH, sa ca puruShasyAmayAnAM ca prAgutpattiM prathamotpattiM pratIti vyAkhyAnayanti; dvitIyastu kAshipateryathokta eva||7||
pArIkShistatparIkShyAgre maudgalyo vAkyamabravIt| AtmajaH puruSho rogAshcAtmajAH kAraNaM hi saH||8||
sa cinotyupabhu~gkte ca karma karmaphalAni ca| nahyRute cetanAdhAtoH pravRuttiH sukhaduHkhayoH||9||
sharalomA tu netyAha na hyAtmA~a~atmAnamAtmanA| yojayedvyAdhibhirduHkhairduHkhadveShI kadAcana||10||
rajastamobhyAM tu manaH parItaM sattvasa~jj~jakam| sharIrasya samutpattau vikArANAM ca kAraNam||11||
vAryovidastu netyAha na hyekaM kAraNaM manaH | narte sharIrAcchArIrarogA na manasaH sthitiH||12||
rasajAni tu bhUtAni vyAdhayashca pRuthagvidhAH| Apo hi rasavatyastAH smRutA nirvRuttihetavaH||13||
hiraNyAkShastu netyAha na hyAtmA rasajaH smRutaH| nAtIndriyaM manaH santi rogAH shabdAdijAstathA||14||
ShaDdhAtujastu puruSho rogAH ShaDdhAtujAstathA| rAshiH ShaDdhAtujo hyeSha sA~gkhyairAdyaiH prakIrtitaH ||15||
tathA bruvANaM kushikamAha tanneti kaushikaH| kasmAnmAtApitRubhyAM hi vinA ShaDdhAtujo bhavet||16||
puruShaH puruShAdgaurgorashvAdashvaH prajAyate| pitryA mehAdayashcoktA rogAstAvatra kAraNam||17||

ya ime yojanAcatuShke ShaDupakramA abhihitAste~annapAnApekShayaiva vyAdhiharaNe samarthAH, ato~annapAnacatuShko~abhidhIyate| tatrApi sa~gkShepeNAnnapAnaguNAbhidhAyako yajjaHpuruShIyo~abhidhIyate| tatrAdau puruShavyAdhikAraNanishcAyakaprakaraNaM tvAhAraguNaprashnAvatArArthaM tathA pUrvoktaShaDupakramaNIyarogakAraNaj~jAnArthaM ca ‘yajjaHpuruSha’ iti prashnaM prAdhAnyenAdhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyo yajjaHpuruShIyo j~jeyaH| yadyapi ‘puruSho yajjaH’ iti prashnakramaH, tathA~api prashnArtho~atra gRuhItaH||1-2||

na hyandha ityAdi| mAtApitRukAraNatve~andhena jAto~andhaH syAdityarthaH| hetvantaramAha- mAtApitrorapItyAdi| te tava mAtApitRukAraNavAdinaH, prAgiti sargAdau mAtApitrorutpattirna syAt; sargAdau niHsharIriNi AdibhUtayormAtApitrorabhAvAdutpAdo nopapanna iti bhAvaH||18-19||

kartA pUrvaM hItyAdi| karmaNaH pUrvaM kartA ‘bhavati’ iti sheShaH| yena karmaNA sa puruShaH kartavyaH, tasya karmaNaH puruShapUrvabhAvitvAt kAraNatvaM svIkartavyaM; tatashca sa cedvinA karma puruSho~abhUt , tat kathaM puruShasya karma kAraNamiti bhAvaH| atha sha~gkyate akRutamevAdau puruShajanakaM karma bhaviShyatItyAha- dRuShTaM na cetyAdi| akRutaM karma na dRuShTaM, pramANena nopalabdhamityarthaH| yasmAcchubhAshubhakarma kriyAjanyameva dharmAdharmarUpaM sarvaM bhavatIti bhAvaH| bhAvahetuH utpattihetuH| svAbhAvikatve dRuShTAntamAha- kharetyAdi| tejo~antAnAmiti “kharadravacaloShNatvaM bhUjalAnilatejasAm” (shA. 1) ityAdivakShyamANakrameNa bhavet||20-21||

svabhAvAdityatra Adau ‘yadi’ ityadhyAhartavyaM; tena yadi svabhAvAdeva bhAvAnAM vikArasharIrAdInAM siddhyasiddhI bhavataH, tadA ArambhaphalaM na bhavet, svAbhAvikatvAdbhAvAnAM; ya ime lokashAstrasiddhA yAgakRuShyadhyayanAdyArambhAste niShprayojanA bhaveyuH, akAraNatvAdityarthaH | sraShTetyAdau jagataH sukhaduHkhayoshca sraShTA prajApatiriti yojanA| sa ca brahmaNo~apatyam| amitasa~gkalpa iti yugapadaparimitasthAvaraja~ggamarUpakAryakartRutvenAparimitatajjananasa~gkalpa ityarthaH| asAdhuvaditi asAdhuH apatyadrohakArI||22-25||

pakShasaMshrayAditi rAgataH pakShasa~ggrahAt| nishcitAniveti paramArthato~anishcitA eva, paraM pakSharAgAdbuddhiprakarShAnnishcitA ivAbhidhIyante pakShA ityarthaH| pakShAntamiti samyagarthAvadhAraNarUpaM pakShAntam| tilapIDakastailArthaM yantropari sthito manuShyaH; tilapIDako yathA gatau gamane sati, gamyadeshAprAptyA cAntaM nAsAdayati, punastatraiva bhramaNAt; tathA pakShasaMshrayAdvAdino~apItyarthaH| sa~gghaTTaH anyonyapIDako melakaH| adhyAtmaM tattvam| skandhaH samUhaH| pakSharAgashceha tattvaj~jAnapratibandhakatvena tamaskandha ucyate| siddhAntamAha- yeShAmityAdi| yeShAmiti yajjAtIyAnAM, te ca mahAbhUtAdayaH| tena mahAbhUtatvenaiva vAtAdInAM grahaNam| sampaditi prashastaguNatA| naramiti saMyogipuruSham| vipaditi vaiguNyam| samudIrayediti janayet| eteShAM ca RuShivAdAnAM kathanaM pUrvapakShasiddhAntashravaNena shiShyasandehanivRuttyartham ||26-29||

hitAhAropayoga eka evetyavadhAraNenAsya prAdhAnyaM darshayati nAnyapratiShedham, AcArasya svapnAdestathA shabdAdInAmapi kAraNatvenoktatvAt| vyAdhinimittamiti vyAdhyabhivRuddhinimittaM madhyapadalopAjj~jeyam, abhivRuddhikAraNasyaiva pRuShTatvAt; tathA~ahitAhArasya yadvyAdhinimittatvaM, tasya ‘teShAmeva vipadvyAdhIn vividhAn samudIrayet’ ityanenaivoktatvAt| kiMvA vyAdhinimittashabdena sAmAnyena janako vardhakashca heturucyate| anapavAdamiti avyabhicAri| hitAhitAhAradurj~jAnatAhetumAha- hitasamAkhyAtAnAmityAdi| viparItakAritvamiti pathyasyApathyatvaM tathA apathyasya pathyatvaM mAtrAdivashAdbhavati| tatra pathyA raktashAlyAdayo~atimAtrA hInamAtrA vA mAtrAdoShAdapathyA bhavanti| tathA kAlavashAtta eva raktashAlyAdayo laghutvAdbalavadagnInAM hemante na hitAH; kAlashabdena ceha nityaga eva kAlo gRuhyate, Avasthikasya puraShAvasthAshabdena gRuhItatvAt| kriyA tu saMskaraNaM, tena ca raktashAlirasamyaksvinnAprasrutatvAdinA odanadoSheNAhito bhavati, tathA sa eva bhUmisambandhAdAnUpadeshajaH sannapathyo bhavati| tathA dehApekShayA medasvino raktashAlirlaghutayA na hito bhavati, taduktaM- “guru cAtarpaNaM ceShTaM sthUlAnAM karshanaM prati” (sU. 21) iti| tathA sa eva doShe vAyAvahitaH, doShashabdena vyAdhirapi grahItavyaH| tathA- puruShasya bAlyAvasthAyAM shleShmapradhAnAyAM tiktAdi pathyaM, tattu vArdhakye vRuddhavAte na pathyam| avasthAntarashabdashca mAtrAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate| evamahitasyApi mAtrAdiparigraheNa hitatvamunnetavyam||30-32||

siddhAntayati- yadAhArajAtamityAdi| anena ca granthena hitAhitatvaM na svarUpeNa bhAvAnAM, kintu mAtrAdisavyapekShamiti darshitaM bhavati| na tvetadityAdi| etaditi hitAhitam| evamupadiShTamiti yadAhArajAtamityAdilakShaNoddiShTam| vij~jAsyanti na tviti sambandhaH| etasmin hitAhitalakShaNe mAtrAdyavasthAntaraj~jAnaM vinA na hitatvamahitatvaM vA hitAnAM raktashAlyAdInAmahitAnAM yavakAdInAM ca j~jAtuM pAryate, mAtrAdyavasthAyAshca durj~jAnatvena sarvavaidyA j~jAtumakShamA iti bhAvaH||33-34||

agryAdhikAroktaM sa~ggraheNa kathayati- samAnetyAdi| samAnakAriNaH tulyakarmANaH| shreShThasya lakShaNamiti prashastasya lakShaNaM; lakShaNaM tviha pATha eva, pAThena hi shraiShThyaM lakShyate j~jAyata ityarthaH| jyAyastvaM bRuhattvaM , tadaprashastaguNabRuhattvaM j~jeyam; ata evAhitAdhikArakathane shreShThatamashabdaM tyaktvA ‘apathyatamatve prakRuShTatamA bhavanti’ ityuktaM, tena shreShThasya lakShaNamiti raktashAlyAdInAM hitAhArANAM j~jeyaM, jyAyastvaM cAhitAhArANAM yavakAdInAmapathyatamatve prakarShashAlitvam| kAryakartRutve varatvaM ceti karmaNi cotkRuShTatvaM, tacca ‘annaM vRuttikarANAm’ ityAdinoktaM j~jeyam| vAtapittakaphAnAM cetyAdau ‘bastirvAtaharANAM’, ‘virecanaM pittaharANAM’, ‘vamanaM shleShmaharANAm’, ‘AsthApanaM vAtaharaNAm’ ityAdi j~jeyam| yadvyAdhiharamiti ‘khadiraH kuShThaharANAM’, ‘puShkaramUlaM hikkAshvAsakAsapArshvashUlAnAhaharANAm’ ityAdi j~jeyam| kiMvA ‘avaratvam’ iti pAThaH; tadA avaratvam anyathA anabhipretakartRutvaM, tacca ‘rajasvalAgamanamalakShmImukhAnAm’ ityAdi j~jeyam| shreShThatvajyAyastvAbhyAM prashastAprashastakarmaNAmapi grahaNaM vyAkhyeyam||42-44||

sampratyuktasya pathyasya hitAparanAmno lakShaNamAha- pathyamityAdi| pathaH sharIramArgAt srotorUpAdanapetam; apetam apakArakam, anapetam anapakArakamityarthaH| pathograhaNena pathovAhyA doShA dhAtavashca, tathA pathonirvartakA dhAtavo gRuhyante; tena kRutsnameva sharIraM gRuhItaM bhavati, tatashca sharIrAnupaghAti pathyamiti bhavati| kiMvA, svasthasvAsthyarakShaNamAturavyAdhiparimokShashceti panthAH, tasmAdanapetaM pathyam| evamapi mano~anupaghAtitvaM na labhyata ityAha- yaccoktaM manasaH priyamiti| manaso~atiprItyA~abhilaShitaM, tena manaso hitamiti priyArthaH; tena prashamaj~jAnAtIkShNatvAdayo gRuhyante| etena, ‘manaHsharIrAnupaghAti pathyaM’ iti pathyalakShaNamanapavAdamuktaM bhavati| anye tu pathyalakShaNadvayametat paThanti, vadanti ca- “yadyekaM lakShaNaM syAttadA jvarAdiShu tiktaM bheShajaM manaso~apriyatvena na pathyaM syAt; etaccAnumatameva , yad jvare tiktaprayogasya tadAtve na manaso~anukUlatvaM, na caitAvatA sharIraM pratyapathyatvaM bhavati”, ato yanmAtraM mano~anukUlatvaM mAnasavikArAkartRutvAt tadvyapadeshyameva; kiMvA tAvanmAtramano~ananukUlatvaM mAnasavikArAkartRutvAdavyapadeshyameva| tadetadapathyatvaM kimAhArAcArANAM niyatamasti netyAha- yaccetyAdi| niyataM nishcitamidamapriyameva sarvadedamapathyameva sarvadetyevaMrUpaM ki~jcinnAstItyarthaH| kuto nAstItyAha- mAtretyAdi| guNAntarashabdo mAtrAdibhiH sambadhyate| tattaditi mAtrAdiguNAntaram| te te iti hitAhitAhArAcArAH| tathA tatheti hitoktA api hitAshcAhitAshca, tathA ahitoktAshcAhitA hitAshca| evaM priyamapi madhurAdyapriyaM, tiktAdyapriyamapi priyam| atrodAharaNaM yathA- pathyaM tAvadghRutaM; tadatimAtramapathyaM bhavati, kAle ca vasante~apathyaM, saMskAreNa ca viruddhadravyasaMskRutamapathyaM, bhUmau cAnUpAyAmapathyam, evaM dehe~atisthUle doShe ca kaphe~apathyam| apathyamapi viShaM mAtrAdinA hitaM bhavati, yathA rasAyane- “viShasya tilaM dadyAt” (ci.a.1) ityAdi| evamanyadapyUhyam| yasmAdevamekAntamapathyatvamanishcitaM, prAyovAdapathyatA tu nishcitA; tasmAt svabhAvo nirdiShTa iti pathyAnAM raktashAlyAdInAmapathyAnAM ca yavakAdInAmityarthaH; svabhAvaH prakRutyA pathyatA apathyatA ca| tathA mAtrAdirAshraya iti nirdiShTa iti sambandhaH| mAtrAdiH mAtrAkAlakriyAdiH| Ashraya iti pathyatvApathyatvayoH| mAtrAdInyAshritya bhAvAnAM pathyatvApathyatvaM ca pAramArthikaM bhavatItyarthaH| ubhayamiti svabhAvaM mAtrAdiM ca||45-47||

pratyakShadharmatvaM tapaHprabhAvAt| iyamiti agre vakShyamANA| kathA tattvajij~jAsArthamanyonyapRucchA| rAshiH melakaH, Atmendriyamano~arthasamudAya ityarthaH| asya rAsherAmayAnAM cotpattivinishcaye utpattivinishcayaviShayiNI kathA prAdurAsIditi sambandhaH||3-4||

tAmeva parasparaprashnarUpAM kathAM darshayati- tadantaramityAdi| antarashabdaH kAlavacanaH; yathA- “apasmArAya kurvanti vegaM ki~jcidathAntaram” (ci. 10) iti; ki~jcitkAlamityarthaH; tena tadantaramiti kathArambhakAla ityarthaH| kAshI vArANasI tasyAH patiH, teShAM bahutvAdvisheShaNaM- vAmaka iti| yasmAjjAto yajjaH; tata eva puruShajanakAt kAraNAjjAtAstajjAH| na veti anyataH puruSho jAyate~anyatashca tasya rogA ityarthaH| narendreNeti kAshipatinAmnA rAjarShiNA||5-6||

AtmajaH puruSha ityAdiprashnadvayasyottaraM; tatra pUrvaprashnasya puruShasyAmayAnAM ca kuta utpattirityevaMrUpasya prashnasyottaraM AtmajaH puruSho rogAshceti, kAshipatiprashnamAtre~apyuttarametat yata evAtmataH puruSho jAyate tata eva rogA ityartharUpameva | prashnottaratA tvasya granthasya sugamaiva| kAraNatve hetumAha- sa cinotItyAdi| cinoti karma, karmaphalAni ca sharIrArogyavikArAdIni bhu~gkta iti yojanA| karmasahAyasyAtmanaH sharIravikArAdikartRutvAt kAraNatvamiti bhAvaH| etadeva vyatirekeNAha- nahyRuta ityAdi| cetanAdhAtuH AtmA| sukhaduHkhayoriti sukhaduHkhasAdhanayoH nIruksharIravikArayorityarthaH||8-9||

mana ityukte manyate~aneneti vyutpattyA~a~atmA~api sha~gkyeta, taduktaM- sattvasa~jj~jakamiti| narte sharIrAcchArIrA vAtAdijanyAH shoShAdayastiShThanti; tathA na manasaH sthitiH, Rute sharIrAditi yojyam| rajastamaHparItasya hi manaso nityaM sharIra eva sthitiH; yattu nirdoShaM manastattu na puruShasya nApi ca vyAdheH kAraNamiti bhAvaH| rasajAnItyAdau smRutA nirvRuttihetava iti vyAdhipuruShayoH| etena vyAdhipuruShajanakarasakAraNatvenApaH kAraNakAraNatayA puruShavikArayoH kAraNaM bhavanti| kiMvA Apo nirvRuttihetava iti rasAnAM; kiMvA yasmAdrasavatya ApastasmAttA nirvRuttihetava iti yojanA||10-13||

nahyAtmetyAdau nAtIndriyaM mano rasajaM smRutamiti yojanA; yasmAdatIndriyaM mana AtmA cAtIndriyaH, tasmAnna rasajau; rasAddhi jAyamAnaM kAraNaguNAnuvidhAnAdaindriyakaM syAdityarthaH| hetvantaramAha- santItyAdi| ahitashabdarUpAdijanye vikAre na rasaH kAraNamityarthaH| AtmA pRuthivyAdIni ca pa~jca ShaD dhAtavaH| yaduktaM- “khAdayashcetanAShaShThA dhAtavaH puruShaH smRutaH” (shA. 1) iti||14-15||
