kushika iti hiraNyAkShasya nAma| kasmAditi AkShepe| mAtApitranapekShitve sarvaprANiShu ShaDdhAtusamudAyasya vidyamAnatvena narago~ashvAdibhedo na syAditi bhAvaH| hetvantaramAha- pitryA mehAdayashcoktA iti| pitRuto~apatyaM gacchantIti pitryAH; Adishabdena kuShThArshaHprabhRutayo grAhyAH| svapakShaM darshayati- tAvatra kAraNamiti; tau mAtApitarau||16-17||
athAta AtreyabhadrakApyIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

svAduramlAdibhiryogaM sheShairamlAdayaH pRuthak| yAnti pa~jcadashaitAni dravyANi dvirasAni tu||15||

Commentary: bhedamAha- svAdurityAdi| tatra svAdoramlAdiyogAt pa~jca, sheShairiti AditvenopayuktAdanyaiH; tenAmlasya lavaNAdiyogAccatvAri, evaM lavaNasya kaTvAdiyogAttrINi, kaTukasya tiktakaShAyayogAddve, tiktasya kaShAyayogAdekam, evaM pa~jcadasha dvirasAni ||15||

pRuthagamlAdiyuktasya yogaH sheShaiH pRuthagbhavet| madhurasya tathA~amlasya lavaNasya kaTostathA||16||

Commentary: trirasamAha- pRuthagityAdi| madhurasyAmlAdirasacatuShTayena pRuthagityekaikasho yuktasya sheShairlavaNAdibhiryogo bhavati; tatra madhurasyAmlayuktasya sheShalavaNAdiyogAccatvAri, tathA madhurasya lavaNayuktasya kaTvAdiyogAttrINi, tathA kaTuyuktasya tiktAdiyogAddve, tathA tiktayuktasya kaShAyayogAdekam, evaM madhureNAdisthitena dasha| evamamlasyAdisthitasya lavaNayuktasya kaTvAdiyogAttrINi, tathA kaTukayuktasya sheShAbhyAM yogAddve, evaM tiktayuktasya kaShAyayogAdekam, evamamlasya ShaT| anenaiva nyAyena lavaNasya trINi, kaToshcaikameva; evaM militvA trirasAni viMshatiH ||16||-
vakShyante tu catuShkeNa dravyANi dasha pa~jca ca||17||
svAdvamlau sahitau yogaM lavaNAdyaiH pRuthaggatau| yogaM sheShaiH pRuthagyAtashcatuShkarasasa~gkhyayA||18||
sahitau svAdulavaNau tadvat kaTvAdibhiH pRuthak| yuktau sheShaiH pRuthagyogaM yAtaH svAdUShaNau tathA||19||
kaTvAdyairamlalavaNau saMyuktau sahitau pRuthak| yAtaH sheShaiH pRuthagyogaM sheShairamlakaTU tathA||20||

ShaT tu pa~jcarasAnyAhurekaikasyApavarjanAt||21||

Commentary: apavarjanAditi tyAgAt| atra ca rasAnAM guNatvenaikasmin dravye samavAyo yogashabdenocyate||21||-
iti triShaShTirdravyANAM nirdiShTA rasasa~gkhyayA||22||
triShaShTiH syAttvasa~gkhyeyA rasAnurasakalpanAt | rasAstaratamAbhyAM tAM sa~gkhyAmatipatanti hi||23||

saMyogAH saptapa~jcAshat kalpanA tu triShaShTidhA| rasAnAM tatra yogyatvAt kalpitA rasacintakaiH||24||

Commentary: evamasa~gkhyeyatve~api triShaShTividhaiva kalpanA cikitsAvyavahArArthamihAcAryaiH kalpitetyAha- saMyogA ityAdi| tatra yogyatvAditi tatra svasthAturahitacikitsAprayoge~anatisa~gkShepavistararUpatayA hitatvAdityarthaH||24||
kvacideko rasaH kalpyaH saMyuktAshca rasAH kvacit| doShauShadhAdIn sa~jcintya bhiShajA siddhimicchatA||25||
dravyANi dvirasAdIni saMyuktAMshca rasAn budhAH| rasAnekaikasho vA~api kalpayanti gadAn prati||26||

yaH syAdrasavikalpaj~jaH syAcca doShavikalpavit| na sa muhyedvikArANAM hetuli~ggopashAntiShu ||27||

Commentary: rasaj~jAnaphalamAha- yaH syAdityAdi| atra rasavikalpaj~jAnAdeva vyAdhihetudravyaj~jAnaM kRutsnamavaruddhaM, rasaj~jAnenaiva prAyaH sakaladravyaguNasya vakShyamANatvAt| doShavikalpaj~jAnAcca li~ggaj~jAnaM, yAvaddhi li~ggaM tat sarvaM doShavikalpasambaddham| rasadoShavikalpaj~jAnAttu bheShajaj~jAnaM, yato rasataH svarUpaj~jAnaM bheShajadravyasya, doShatashca bheShajaprayogaviShayavij~jAnam| kiMvA, rasavikalpAcca tathA doShavikalpAcca hetvAdij~jAnaM pRuthageva vaktavyaM; rasabhedAddhi tatkAryaM li~ggamapi j~jAyate, hetubheShajavij~jAnaM tu rasabhedavij~jAnAdeva vaktavyaM, yato rasabhedavaddravyameva vikArANAM heturbheShajaM ca bhavatIti; evaM doShabhedaM j~jAtvA ca tasya samAnaM hetuM pratyeti, doShavirodhi ca dravyaM bheShajamiti| tadyuktamuktaM- na sa muhyedvikArANAM hetuli~ggopashAntiShviti||27||

vyaktaH shuShkasya cAdau ca raso dravyasya lakShyate| viparyayeNAnuraso raso nAsti hi saptamaH||28||

Commentary: pUrvoktarasAnurasalakShaNamAha- vyakta ityAdi| shuShkasya ceti cakArAdArdrasya ca, Adau ceti cakArAdante ca; tena shuShkasya vA~a~ardrasya vA prathamajihvAsambandhe vA~a~asvAdAnte vA yo vyaktatvena madhuro~ayamamlo~ayamityAdinA vikalpena gRuhyate, sa vyaktaH; yastUktAvasthAcatuShTaye~api vyakto nopalabhyate, kintarhyavyapadeshyatayA chAyAmAtreNa kAryadarshanena vA mIyate, so~anurasa iti vAkyArthaH| yatashca madhurAdaya eva vyaktatvAvyaktatvAbhyAM rasAnurasarUpAH, ato~avyakto nAma saptamo raso nAsti| ayaM cArthaH pUrvaM pratiShiddho~apyanuguNaspaShTahetuprAptyA punarniShidhyate| anye tvAhuH- shuShkasya cetyanena yasya dravyasya shuShkasya cArdrasya copayogaH, tatra shuShkAvasthAyAM yo~avyaktaH sa rasa ucyate; yastvArdrAvasthAyAM vyaktaH san shuShkAvasthAyAM nAnuyAti , nAsau rasaH, kintvanurasaH| yathA- pippalyA ArdrAyA madhuro raso vyaktaH, shuShkAyAstu pippalyAH kaTukaH; tena kaTuka eva rasaH pippalyAH, madhurastvanurasaH; yastu drAkShAdInAmArdrAvasthAyAM shuShkAvasthAyAM ca madhura eva, tatra vipratipattirapi nAsti, tena tatra madhura eva rasaH; nityArdraprayojyAnAM tu kA~jjikatakrAdInAmAdau vyakto ya upalabhyate rasaH, anu copalabhyate yaH so~anuraso yuktastiktatvAdiH; tathA, ArdrAvasthAyAM shuShkAvasthAviparIto yaH pippalyA iva madhuraH, so~anurasa iti| kintvArdrA~api pippalI madhurarasaiveti pashyAmaH, yato vakShyati- “shleShmalA madhurA cArdrA gurvI snigdhA ca pippalI” (sU. 27) iti; madhurasya tatrAnurasatve gurutvashleShmakartRutvAnyanupapannAni; tena, ArdrA pippalI vyaktamadhurarasaiva, shuShkA tu madhurAnuraseti yuktam||28||
parAparatve yuktishca sa~gkhyA saMyoga eva ca| vibhAgashca pRuthaktvaM ca parimANamathApi ca||29||
saMskAro~abhyAsa ityete guNA j~jeyAH parAdayaH| siddhyupAyAshcikitsAyA lakShaNaistAn pracakShmahe||30||
deshakAlavayomAnapAkavIryarasAdiShu| parAparatve, yuktishca yojanA yA tu yujyate||31||
sa~gkhyA syAdgaNitaM, yogaH saha saMyoga ucyate| dravyANAM dvandvasarvaikakarmajo~anitya eva ca||32||
vibhAgastu vibhaktiH syAdviyogo bhAgasho grahaH| pRuthaktvaM syAdasaMyogo vailakShaNyamanekatA||33||
parimANaM punarmAnaM, saMskAraH karaNaM matam| bhAvAbhyasanamabhyAsaH shIlanaM satatakriyA||34||
iti svalakShaNairuktA guNAH sarve parAdayaH| cikitsA yairaviditairna yathAvat pravartate||35||

guNA guNAshrayA noktAstasmAdrasaguNAn bhiShak| vidyAddravyaguNAn karturabhiprAyAH pRuthagvidhAH||36||

Commentary: samprati rasAnAM parasparasaMyogo guNa uktaH, tathA~agre ca snigdhatvAdirguNo vAcyaH, sa ca guNarUparase na sambhavatIti yathA rasAnAM guNanirdesho boddhavyastadAha- guNA ityAdi| guNA guNAshrayA noktA iti dIrgha~jjIvitIye “samavAyI tu nishceShTaH kAraNaM guNaH” (sU. 1) ityanena| rasaguNAniti rase snigdhAdIn guNAnnirdiShTAn tadrasAdhAradravyaguNAneva vidyAt| nanu, yadi dravyaguNA eva te, tat kimiti rasaguNatvenocyanta ityAha- karturityAdi; karturiti tantrakartuH| abhiprAyA iti tatra tatropacAreNa tathA sAmAnyashabdAdiprayogeNa tantrakaraNabuddhayaH; sAmAnyashabdopacArAdiprayogashca prakaraNAdivashAdeva sphuTatvAt tathA prayojanavashAcca kriyate| tacca prakaraNAdi ‘atashca prakRutaM buddhvA’ ityAdau darshayiShyAmaH| iha ca dravyaguNAnAM raseShu yadupacaraNaM tasyAyamabhiprAyo- yat- madhurAdinirdeshenaiva snigdhashItAdiguNA api prAyo madhurAdyavyabhicAriNo dravye nirdiShTA bhavantIti na madhuratvaM nirdishya snigdhatvAdipratipAdanaM punaH pRuthak kriyata iti||36||

atashca prakRutaM buddhvA deshakAlAntarANi ca| tantrakarturabhiprAyAnupAyAMshcArthamAdishet||37||

Commentary: abhiprAyapRuthaktve sati yathA grantho boddhavyastadAha- atashcetyAdi| tatra prakRutaM buddhvA, yathA- “kShArAH kShIraM phalaM puShpam” ityatrodbhidagaNasya prakRutatvAt kShIramiti snuhyAdikShIrameva kShIrashabdena vadet| deshAntaraM buddhveti yathA- shirasi shodhane~abhidhIyamAne “krimivyAdhau” (sU. 2) iti, tacchirogatakrimivyAdhAveva bhavati| kAlAntare yathA- vamanakAle~abhihitaM “pratigrahAMshcopahArayet” (sU. 15) iti, tatra pratigrahashabdena pAtramucyate, na tu grahaNaM pratigrahaH| tantrakarturabhiprAyAniti yathoktaM raseShu guNAropaNe tadboddhavyam| upAyAniti shAstropAyAn tantrayuktirUpAn| artham abhidheyam| yadyapi prakRutAdayo~api tantrakarturabhiprAyA eva, tathA~api yatra prakRutatvAdi na sphuTaM pratIyate tatra tantrakarturabhiprAyatvena boddhavyam||37||

ShaDvibhaktIH pravakShyAmi rasAnAmata uttaram| ShaT pa~jcabhUtaprabhavAH sa~gkhyAtAshca yathA rasAH||38||

Commentary: ShaDvibhaktIriti madhurAdiShaDvibhAgAnityarthaH| ShaT pa~jcabhUtaprabhavA iti pa~jcabhUtaprabhavAH santo yathoktena prakAreNa ‘somaguNAtirekAt’ ityAdinA yathA ShaT sa~gkhyAtAH ShaTsa~gkhyAparicchinnA bhavanti, tathA vakShyAmIti yojanA||38||

saumyAH khalvApo~antarikShaprabhavAH prakRutishItA laghvyashcAvyaktarasAshca, tAstvantarikShAdbhrashyamAnA bhraShTAshca pa~jcamahAbhUtaguNasamanvitA ja~ggamasthAvarANAM bhUtAnAM mUrtIrabhiprINayanti, tAsu mUrtiShu ShaDabhimUrcchanti rasAH||39||

Commentary: samprati rasAnAmAdikAraNameva tAvadAha- saumyA ityAdi| saumyAH somadevatAkAH| bhrashyamAnA iti vadatA bhUmisambandhavyatirekeNAntarIkSheritaiH pRuthivyAdiparamANvAdibhiH sambandho rasArambhako bhavatIti darshyate| mUrtIriti vyaktIH| abhiprINayantIti tarpayanti, kiMvA janayanti| abhimUrcchanti rasA iti vyaktiM yAnti| atra cAntarIkShamudakaM rasakAraNatve pradhAnatvAduktaM, tena kShitisthamapi sthAvaraja~ggamotpattau rasakAraNaM bhavatyeva||39||

teShAM ShaNNAM rasAnAM somaguNAtirekAnmadhuro rasaH, pRuthivyagnibhUyiShThatvAdamlaH, salilAgnibhUyiShThatvAllavaNaH, vAyvagnibhUyiShThatvAt kaTukaH, vAyvAkAshAtiriktatvAttiktaH, pavanapRuthivIvyatirekAt kaShAya iti| evameShAM rasAnAM ShaTtvamupapannaM nyUnAtirekavisheShAnmahAbhUtAnAM bhUtAnAmiva sthAvaraja~ggamAnAM nAnAvarNAkRutivisheShAH; ShaDRutukatvAcca kAlasyopapanno mahAbhUtAnAM nyUnAtirekavisheShaH||40||

Commentary: somaguNAtirekAditi atirekashabdena sarveShveva raseShu sarvabhUtasAnnidhyamasti, kvacittu kasyacidbhUtaguNasyAtirekAdrasavisheSho bhavatIti darshayati; etacca madhuraM prati abguNAtiriktatvaM visheShotpattau kAraNatvena j~jeyaM; yaccAdhArakAraNatvamapAM, tat sarvasAdhAraNam| evaM lavaNe~apyapAM kAraNatvaM j~jeyam| lavaNastu sushrute pRuthivyagnyatirekAt paThitaH, asmiMshca virodhe kAryavirodho nAstyeva| nanu, uShNashItAbhyAmagnisalilAbhyAM kRutasya lavaNasyApyuShNashItatvena bhavitavyaM, tallavaNaM kathamuShNaM bhavati? naivaM, yato bhUtAnAmayaM svabhAvaH- yat- kenacit prakAreNa sanniviShTAH ka~jcidguNamArabhante, na sarvam| yathA- makuShThake~adbhirmadhuro rasaH kriyate, na snehaH; tathA saindhave vahninA~api noShNatvamArabhyate| ayaM ca bhUtAnAM sannivesho~adRuShTaprabhAvakRuta eva, sa ca sanniveshaH kAryadarshanenonneyaH| tena yatra kAryaM dRushyate tatra kalpyate, yathA- lavaNe uShNatvAdagnirviShyanditvAcca jalamanumIyate| AgamavedanIyashcAyamartho nAtrAsmadvidhAnAM kalpanAH prasaranti| etena yaducyate- toyavat pRuthivyAdayo~api kimiti pRuthagrasAntaraM na kurvanti, tathA toyavAtAdisaMyogAdibhyaH kimiti rasAntarANi notpadyanta iti, tadapi bhUtasvabhAvAparyanuyogAdeva pratyuktam| iha ca kAraNatvaM bhUtAnAM rasasya madhuratvAdivisheSha eva nimittakAraNarUpamucyate, tena nIrasAnAmapi hi dahanAdInAM kAraNatvamupapannameva vyutpAditam| rasabhedaM dRuShTAntena sAdhayannAha- evamityAdi| rasAnAM ShaTtvaM mahAbhUtAnAM nyUnAtirekavisheShAt somaguNAtirekapRuthivyagnyatirekAdeH ShaDutpAdakAraNAdupapannaM, ShaDbhyaH kAraNebhyaH ShaT kAryANi bhavantIti yuktameveti bhAvaH| bhUtAnAM yathA nAnAvarNAkRutivisheShA mahAbhUtAnAM nyUnAtirekavisheShAt, tathA rasAnAmapIti| bhUtAnAM yathoktAnAmatirekavisheShahetumAha- ShaDRutukatvAdityAdi| ShaDRutukatvena kAlo nAnAhemantAdirUpatayA ka~jcidbhUtavisheShaM kvacidvardhayati, sa cAtmakAryaM rasaM puShTaM karoti, yathA- hemantakAle somaguNAtireko bhavati, shishire vAyvAkAshAtirekaH, evaM tasyAshitIyoktarasotpAdakrameNa vasantAdAvapi bhUtotkarSho j~jeyaH; ShaDRutukAcceti cakAreNAhorAtrakRuto~api bhUtotkarSho j~jeyaH, tathA~adRuShTakRutashca; tena hemantAdAvapi rasAntarotpAdaH kvacidvastunyupapanno bhavati| yadyapi ca, Rutubhede~api bhUtotkarShavisheSha eva kAraNaM, yaduktaM- “tAvetAvarkavAyU” (sU. 6) ityAdi, tathA~api bIjA~gkurakAryakAraNabhAvavat saMsArAnAditayaiva bhUtavisheShartvoH kAryakAraNabhAvo vAcyaH||40||

tatrAgnimArutAtmakA rasAH prAyeNordhvabhAjaH, lAghavAdutplavanatvAcca vAyorUrdhvajvalanatvAcca vahneH; salilapRuthivyAtmakAstu prAyeNAdhobhAjaH, pRuthivyA gurutvAnnimnagatvAccodakasya; vyAmishrAtmakAH punarubhayatobhAjaH||41||

Commentary: bhUtavisheShakRutaM rasAnAM dharmAntaramAha- tatretyAdi| prAyeNeti na sarve| rasA iti rasayuktAni dravyANi| plavanatvAditi gatimattvAt; yadyapi gatiradho~api syAt, tathA~api laghutvaparigatagatiriha vAyorUrdhvameva gamanaM karoti, yathA- shAlmalItulAnAm| hetvantaramAha- UrdhvajvalanatvAccAgneriti; agnerapyUrdhvagatitvAdityarthaH| nimnagatvamadhogatvameva||41||

teShAM ShaNNAM rasAnAmekaikasya yathAdravyaM guNakarmANyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||42||

Commentary: yathAdravyamiti yadyasya rasasya dravyamAdhArastadanatikrameNa| etena rasAnAM guNakarmaNI rasAdhAre dravye boddhavye iti darshayati||42||

kaTuko raso vaktraM shodhayati, agniM dIpayati, bhuktaM shoShayati, ghrANamAsrAvayati, cakShurvirecayati, sphuTIkarotIndriyANi, alasakashvayathUpacayodardAbhiShyandasnehasvedakledamalAnupahanti, rocayatyashanaM, kaNDUrvinAshayati , vraNAnavasAdayati, krimIn hinasti, mAMsaM vilikhati, shoNitasa~gghAtaM bhinatti, bandhAMshchinatti, mArgAn vivRuNoti, shleShmANaM shamayati, laghuruShNo rUkShashca| sa eva~gguNo~apyeka evAtyarthamupayujyamAno vipAkaprabhAvAt puMstvamupahanti, rasavIryaprabhAvAnmohayanti, glApayati, sAdayati, karshayati, mUrcchayati, namayati, tamayati, bhramayati, kaNThaM paridahati, sharIratApamupajanayati, balaM kShiNoti, tRuShNAM janayati; api ca vAyvagniguNabAhulyAdbhramadavathukampatodabhedaishcaraNabhujapArshvapRuShThaprabhRutiShu mArutajAn vikArAnupajanayati (4); tikto rasaH svayamarociShNurapyarocakaghno viShaghnaH krimighno mUrcchAdAhakaNDUkuShThatRuShNAprashamanastva~gmAMsayoH sthirIkaraNo jvaraghno dIpanaH pAcanaH stanyashodhano lekhanaH kledamedovasAmajjalasIkApUyasvedamUtrapurIShapittashleShmopashoShaNo rUkShaH shIto laghushca| sa eva~gguNo~apyeka evAtyarthamupayujyamAno raukShyAtkharaviShadasvabhAvAcca rasarudhiramAMsamedosthimajjashukrANyucchoShayati, srotasAM kharatvamupapAdayati, balamAdatte, karshayati, glapayati, mohayati, bhramayati, vadanamupashoShayati, aparAMshca vAtavikArAnupajanayati (5); kaShAyo rasaH saMshamanaH sa~ggrAhI sandhAnakaraH pIDano ropaNaH shoShaNaH stambhanaH shleShmaraktapittaprashamanaH sharIrakledasyopayoktA rUkShaH shIto~alaghushca| sa eva~gguNo~apyeka evAtyarthamupayujyamAna AsyaM shoShayati, hRudayaM pIDayati, udaramAdhmApayati, vAcaM nigRuhNAti, srotAMsyavabadhnAti, shyAvatvamApAdayati, puMstvamupahanti, viShTabhya jarAM gacchati, vAtamUtrapurISharetAMsyavagRuhNAti, karshayati, glapayati, tarShayati, stambhayati, kharavishadarUkShatvAt pakShavadhagrahApatAnakArditaprabhRutIMshca vAtavikArAnupajanayati||43||

Commentary: vipAkasya prabhAvo vipAkaprabhAvaH, vipAkashca kaTUnAM kaTureva; rasasya vIryasya ca prabhAvo rasavIryaprabhAvaH; ayaM ca vakShyamANe sarvatra hetuH| caraNAdInAM sAkShAdgrahaNaM tatraiva prAyo vAtavikArabhAvAt| atra ca vipAkaprabhAvAdikathanamudAharaNArthaM, tena madhurAdiShu vipAkAdikAryamunneyam| glapayati harShakShayaM karoti| pIDano vraNapIDanaH| sharIrakledasyopayokteti AcUShakaH| ‘shIto~alaghushca’ ityakAraprashleShAdalaghuH | avagRuhNAtIti baddhAni karoti ||43||

ityevamete ShaDrasAH pRuthaktvenaikatvena vA mAtrashaH samyagupayujyamAnA upakArAya bhavantyadhyAtmalokasya, apakArakarAH punarato~anyathA bhavantyupayujyamAnAH; tAn vidvAnupakArArthameva mAtrashaH samyagupayojayediti||44||

Commentary: pRuthaktveneti ekaikasho mAtrashaH| ekatveneti ekIkRutya samudAyamAtrasha ityarthaH| mAtrasha iti mAtrayA| taccaikIkaraNaM dvitryAdibhiH sarvairj~jeyam| adhyAtmalokasyeti sarvaprANijanasya| anyatheti amAtrayA||44||

bhavanti cAtra- shItaM vIryeNa yaddravyaM madhuraM rasapAkayoH| tayoramlaM yaduShNaM ca yaddravyaM kaTukaM tayoH||45||

Commentary: samprati rasadvAreNaiva dravyANAM vIryamAha- shItamityAdi | yaddravyaM rase pAke ca madhuraM tacchItaM vIryeNa j~jeyaM; tathA tayoriti rasapAkayoryadamlaM dravyaM taduShNaM vIryeNa; tathA yacca dravyaM tayoriti rasapAkayoH kaTukamuktaM taccoShNaM vIryeNa, ‘bhavati’ iti sheShaH| kiMvA ‘yaccoShNaM kaTukaM tayoH’ iti pAThaH| tatra yadrasato madhuraM tadvIryataH shItamiti vaktavye yadrasapAkayoriti karoti, tanmadhurarasocitapAkasyaiva madhuradravyasya shItavIryatAprAptyartham; evamamlakaTukayorapi vAcyam||45||
teShAM rasopadeshena nirdeshyo guNasa~ggrahaH| vIryato~aviparItAnAM pAkatashcopadekShyate||46||
yathA payo yathA sarpiryathA vA cavyacitrakau| evamAdIni cAnyAni nirdishedrasato bhiShak||47||
madhuraM ki~jciduShNaM syAt kaShAyaM tiktameva ca| yathA mahatpa~jcamUlaM yathA~abjAnUpamAmiSham||48||
lavaNaM saindhavaM noShNamamlamAmalakaM tathA| arkAguruguDUcInAM tiktAnAmuShNamucyate||49||
ki~jcidamlaM hi sa~ggrAhi ki~jcidamlaM bhinatti ca| yathA kapitthaM sa~ggrAhi bhedi cAmalakaM tathA||50||
pippalI nAgaraM vRuShyaM kaTu cAvRuShyamucyate| kaShAyaH stambhanaH shItaH so~abhayAyAmato~anyathA||51||
tasmAdrasopadeshena na sarvaM dravyAmAdishet| dRuShTaM tulyarase~apyevaM dravye dravye guNAntaram||52||
raukShyAt kaShAyo rUkShANAmuttamo madhyamaH kaTuH| tikto~avarastathoShNAnAmuShNatvAllavaNaH paraH||53||
madhyo~amlaH kaTukashcAntyaH snigdhAnAM madhuraH paraH| madhyo~amlo lavaNashcAntyo rasaH snehAnnirucyate||54||
madhyotkRuShTAvarAH shaityAt kaShAyasvAdutiktakAH | svAdurgurutvAdadhikaH kaShAyAllavaNo~avaraH||55||
amlAt kaTustatastikto laghutvAduttamottamaH| kecillaghUnAmavaramicchanti lavaNaM rasam||56||
paraM cAto vipAkAnAM lakShaNaM sampravakShyate||57||
kaTutiktakaShAyANAM vipAkaH prAyashaH kaTuH| amlo~amlaM pacyate svAdurmadhuraM lavaNastathA||58||
madhuro lavaNAmlau ca snigdhabhAvAttrayo rasAH| vAtamUtrapurIShANAM prAyo mokShe sukhA matAH||59||
kaTutiktakaShAyAstu rUkShabhAvAttrayo rasAH| duHkhAya mokShe dRushyante vAtaviNmUtraretasAm||60||
shukrahA baddhaviNmUtro vipAko vAtalaH kaTuH| madhuraH sRuShTaviNmUtro vipAkaH kaphashukralaH||61||
pittakRut sRuShTaviNmUtraH pAko~amlaH shukranAshanaH| teShAM guruH syAnmadhuraH kaTukAmlAvato~anyathA||62||

vipAkalakShaNasyAlpamadhyabhUyiShThatAM prati| dravyANAM guNavaisheShyAttatra tatropalakShayet||63||

Commentary: samprati yathoktavipAkalakShaNAnAM dravyabhede kvacidalpatvaM kvacinmadhyatvaM kvaciccotkRuShTatvaM yathA bhavati tadAha- vipAketyAdi| vipAkalakShaNasyAlpamadhyabhUyiShThatAmupalakShayet, prati prati dravyANAM guNavaisheShyAddhetorityarthaH| etena, dravyeShu yadguNavaisheShyaM madhuratvamadhurataratvamadhuratamatvAdi, tato hetorvipAkAnAmalpatvAdayo visheShA bhavantItyuktaM bhavati| atra kecidbruvate- pratirasaM pAko bhavati, yathA madhurAdInAM ShaNNAM ShaNmadhurAdayaH pAkA iti; kecidbruvate- balavatAM rasAnAmabalavanto rasA vashatAM yAnti, tatashcAnavasthitaH pAkaH| tatraitaddvitayamapi pAke vyavasthA~akaraNamanAdRutya sushrutena dvividhaH pAko madhuraH kaTushcA~ggIkRutaH| dvaividhyaM ca pa~jcabhUtAtmake dravye gurubhUtapRuthivItoyAtirekAnmadhuraH pAko bhavati, sheShalaghubhUtAtirekAttu kaTukaH pAko bhavati; yaduktaM- “dravyeShu pacyamAneShu yeShvambupRuthivIguNAH| nirvartante~adhikAstatra pAko madhura ucyate|| tejo~anilAkAshaguNAH pacyamAneShu yeShu tu| nirvartante~adhikAstatra pAkaH kaTuka ucyate ” (su. sU. 40) iti| pratirasapAke tathA~anavasthitapAke ca dravyaM rasaguNenaiva tulyaM pAkAvasthAyAmapi bhavati, tena na kashcidvisheSho vipAkena tatra bodhyata iti sushrutena tatpakShadvayamupekShitamiti sAdhukRutam| tRutIyAmlapAkanirAsastu doShamAvahati, yato vrIhikulatthAdInAmamlapAkatayA pittakartRutvamupalabhyate; atha manyase- vrIhyAderuShNavIryatvena tatra pittakartRutvaM; tanna, madhurasya vrIhestanmate madhuravipAkasyoShNavIryatAyAmapi satyAM na pittakartRutvamupapadyate, rasavipAkAbhyAmekasya vIryasya bAdhanIyatvAt| ki~jca, amlapAkatvAdvrIhyAdeH pittamamlaguNamutpadyate, yadi tu taduShNavIryatAkRutaM syAttadA kaTuguNabhUyiShThaM pittaM syAt; dRushyate ca vrIhibhakShaNAdamlodgArAdinA~amlaguNabhUyiShThataiveti| ki~jca, pRuthivIsomaguNAtirekAnmadhuraH pAko bhavati, vAyvagnyAkAshAtirekAcca kaTurbhavatIti pakShe yadA vyAmishraguNAtirekatA bhavati tadA somAgnyAtmakasyAmlasyotpAdaH kathaM pratikShepaNIyaH| athavA, tantrakArayoH kimanayoranena vacanamAtravirodhena kartavyaM; yato yadamlapAkaM carako brUte, tat sushrutena vIryoShNamiti kRutvA samAdhIyate; tena na kashciddravyaguNe virodhaH| yattu sushrute~amlapAkanirAsArthaM dUShaNamucyate “pittaM hi vidagdhamamlatAmupaiti” (su. sU. 40) ityAdinA, tadanabhyupagamAdeva nirastam| nanu, lavaNasya madhurapAkitve pittaraktAdikartRutvamanupapannaM, tathA tiktakaShAyayoH kaTupAkitve pittahantRutvamanupapannaM? naivaM, satyapi lavaNasya madhurapAkitve tatra lavaNarasa uShNaM ca vIryaM yadasti tena tat pittaraktAdikArakaM, vipAkastu tatra pittaraktaharaNalakShaNe kArye bAdhitaH san ‘sRuShTaviNmUtraM’ ityAdinA lakShaNena lakShyata eva| etena yaducyate- lavaNe madhuro vipAkashcedrasavIryAbhyAM bAdhitaH san svakAryakaro na bhavati tat kiM tenopadiShTeneti, tannirastaM bhavati| yato~astyeva sRuShTaviNmUtratAdinA tatra lavaNe madhuravipAkitvaM lakShaNIyam| anayA dishA tiktakaShAyayorapi pUrvapakShaparihAraH| anye tvetaddoShabhayAllavaNo~apyamlaM pacyata iti vyAkhyAnayanti, lavaNastathetyatra tathAshabdena viprakRuShTasyAmlamityasya karShaNAditi| tanna, “kaTvAdInAM kaTurvipAko~amlo~amlasya sheShayormadhuraH” iti jatUkarNavacanAt| naca vAcyaM, kasmAttraya eva vipAkA bhavanti na punastiktAdayo~apIti; yato bhUtasvabhAva evaiShaH, yena madhurAdayastraya eva bhavanti, bhUtasvabhAvAshcAparyanuyojyAH| nanu, yashca rasaviparItaH pAko yathA- lavaNasya madhuraH, tiktakaShAyayoshca kaTuH, sa ucyatAM; yastu samAnaguNo madhurasya madhuro~amlasyAmlaH kaTukasya vA kaTukaH, tatkathane kiM prayojanaM? yato rasaguNaireva tatra vipAkaguNo~api j~jAsyate| naivaM, yena lavaNAdivadvisadRusharasAntarotpAdasha~gkAnirAsArthamapi tatrAnuguNo~api vipAko vaktavya eva; vipAkajashca rasa AhArapariNAmAnte bhavati, prAkRutastu raso vipAkaviruddhaH pariNAmakAlaM varjayitvA j~jeyaH; tena pippalyAH kaTukarasatvamAdau kaNThasthashleShmakShapaNamukhashodhanAdikartRutvena saprayojanaM, madhuravipAkatvaM tu pariNAmena vRuShyatvAdij~jApanena saprayojanam| tathA, yatra vipAkasya rasAH samAnaguNatayA~anuguNA bhavanti tatra balavat kAryaM bhavati, viparyaye tu durbalamiti j~jeyam| etacca pAkatrayaM dravyaniyataM, tena grahaNyadhyAye vakShyamANAhArAvasthApAkAdbhinnameva; tatra hyavisheSheNa sarveShAmeva rasAnAmavasthAvashAt trayaH pAkA vAcyAH “annasya bhuktamAtrasya ShaDrasasya prapAkataH” (ci. 15) ityAdinA granthena||63||
mRudutIkShNagurulaghusnigdharUkShoShNashItalam| vIryamaShTavidhaM kecit, keciddvividhamAsthitAH||64||
shItoShNamiti, vIryaM tu kriyate yena yA kriyA| nAvIryaM kurute ki~jcit sarvA vIryakRutA kriyA||65||

raso nipAte dravyANAM, vipAkaH karmaniShThayA| vIryaM yAvadadhIvAsAnnipAtAccopalabhyate||66||

Commentary: rasAdInAmekadravyaniviShTAnAM bhedena j~jAnArthaM lakShaNamAha- raso nipAta ityAdi| nipAta iti rasanAyoge| karmaniShThayeti karmaNo niShThA niShpattiH karmaniShThA kriyAparisamAptiH, rasopayoge sati yo~antyAhArapariNAmakRutaH karmavisheShaH kaphashukrAbhivRuddhyAdilakShaNaH, tena vipAko nishcIyate| adhIvAsaH sahAvasthAnaM, yAvadadhIvAsAditi yAvaccharIranivAsAt; etacca vipAkAt pUrvaM nipAtAccordhvaM j~jeyam| nipAtAcceti sharIrasaMyogamAtrAt; tena ki~jcidvIryamadhIvAsAdupalabhyate, yathA- AnUpamAMsAderuShNatvaM; ki~jcicca nipAtAdeva labhyate, yathA- marIcAdInAM tIkShNatvAdi; ki~jcicca nipAtAdhIvAsAbhyAM, yathA- marIcAdInAmeva| etena rasaH pratyakSheNaiva; vipAkastu nityaparokShaH, tatkAryeNAnumIyate; vIryaM tu ki~jcidanumAnena, yathA- saindhavagataM shaityamAnUpamAMsagataM vA auShNyaM, ki~jcicca vIryaM pratyakSheNaiva, yathA- rAjikAgataM taikShNyaM ghrANena, picchilavishadasnigdharUkShAdayaH cakShuHsparshanAbhyAM nishcIyanta iti vAkyArthaH| etacca vIryaM sahajaM kRutrimaM ca j~jeyam | etacca yathAsambhavaM gurulaghvAdiShu vIryeShu lakShaNaM j~jeyam| dravyANAmiti upayujyamAnadravyANAm| etacca vIryalakShaNaM pAribhAShikavIryaviShayameva||66||

rasavIryavipAkAnAM sAmAnyaM yatra lakShyate| visheShaH karmaNAM caiva prabhAvastasya sa smRutaH||67||

Commentary: prabhAvalakShaNamAha- rasavIryetyAdi| sAmAnyamiti tulyatA| visheShaH karmaNAmiti dantyAdyAshrayANAM virecanatvAdInAm| sAmAnyaM lakShyata ityanena rasAdikAryatvena yannAvadhArayituM shakyate kAryaM tat prabhAvakRutamiti sUcayati, ata evoktam- prabhAvo~acintya ucyate; rasavIryavipAkakAryatayA~acintya ityarthaH||67||
kaTukaH kaTukaH pAke vIryoShNashcitrako mataH| tadvaddantI prabhAvAttu virecayati mAnavam ||68||
viShaM viShaghnamuktaM yat prabhAvastatra kAraNam| UrdhvAnulomikaM yacca tat prabhAvaprabhAvitam||69||
maNInAM dhAraNIyAnAM karma yadvividhAtmakam| tat prabhAvakRutaM teShAM prabhAvo~acintya ucyate ||70||
samyagvipAkavIryANi prabhAvashcApyudAhRutaH| ki~jcidrasena kurute karma vIryeNa cAparam||71||
dravyaM guNena pAkena prabhAveNa ca ki~jcana| rasaM vipAkastau vIryaM prabhAvastAnapohati||72||
ShaNNAM rasAnAM vij~jAnamupadekShyAmyataH param||73||
snehanaprINanAhlAdamArdavairupalabhyate| mukhastho madhurashcAsyaM vyApnuva@mllimpatIva ca||74||
dantaharShAnmukhAsrAvAt svedanAnmukhabodhanAt| vidAhAccAsyakaNThasya prAshyaivAmlaM rasaM vadet||75||
pralIyan kledaviShyandamArdavaM kurute mukhe| yaH shIghraM lavaNo j~jeyaH sa vidAhAnmukhasya ca||76||
saMvejayedyo rasAnAM nipAte tudatIva ca| vidahanmukhanAsAkShi saMsrAvI sa kaTuH smRutaH||77||
pratihanti nipAte yo rasanaM svadate na ca| sa tikto mukhavaishadyashoShaprahlAdakArakaH ||78||
vaishadyastambhajADyairyo rasanaM yojayedrasaH| badhnAtIva ca yaH kaNThaM kaShAyaH sa vikAsyapi||79||

evamuktavantaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- bhagavan! shrutametadavitathamarthasampadyuktaM bhagavato yathAvaddravyaguNakarmAdhikAre vacaH, paraM tvAhAravikArANAM vairodhikAnAM lakShaNamanatisa~gkShepeNopadishyamAnaM shushrUShAmaha iti||80||

Commentary: samprati viruddhAhAraM vaktumAha- evamityAdi| sharIradhAtuvirodhaM kurvantIti vairodhikAH, lakShyate vairodhikamaneneti lakShaNaM vairodhikAbhidhAyako grantha eva| ‘yat ki~jciddoShamAsrAvya’ ityAdi vairodhikalakShaNaM j~jeyam||80||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- dehadhAtupratyanIkabhUtAni dravyANi dehadhAtubhirvirodhamApadyante; parasparaguNaviruddhAni kAnicit, kAnicit saMyogAt, saMskArAdaparANi, deshakAlamAtrAdibhishcAparANi, tathA svabhAvAdaparANi||81||

Commentary: dehadhAtupratyanIkabhUtAnIti dehadhAtUnAM rasAdInAM vAtAdInAM ca prakRutisthAnAM pratyanIkasvarUpANi| virodhamApadyanta iti dehadhAtUnAM virodhamAcaranti, dUShayantIti yAvat| yathAbhUtAni dravyANi dehadhAtubhirvirodhamApadyante tadAha- parasparaviruddhAni kAnicidityAdi| tatra parasparaguNaviruddhAni yathA- “na matsyAn payasA~abhyavaharet, ubhayaM hyetat” ityAdinoktAni| saMyogaviruddhaM yathA- “tadeva nikucaM pakvaM na mASha” ityAdi noktaM; yat saMskArAdiviruddhaguNakathanaM vinA sAhityamAtreNa viruddhamucyate, tat saMyogaviruddham| matsyapayasostu yadyapi sahopayogo viruddhatvenoktaH, tathA~apyasau guNaviruddhatvena kathita iti guNavirodhakasyaivodAharaNam| virodhashca viruddhaguNatve satyapi kvacideva dravyaprabhAvAdbhavati; tena ShaDrasAhAropayoge madhurAmlayorviruddhashItoShNavIryayorvirodho nodbhAvanIyaH| saMskArato viruddhaM yathA- “na kapotAn sarShapatailabhRuShTAn” ityAdi| desho dvividhaH- bhUmiH, sharIraM ca| tatra bhUmiviruddhaM yathA- “tadeva bhasmapAMshuparidhvastam”, kiMvA yat ki~jcidagocarabhRutaM taddeshaviruddhaM; sharIraviruddhaM yathA- uShNArtasya madhu maraNAya| kAlaviruddhaM yathA- paryuShitA kAkamAcI maraNAya| mAtrAviruddhaM yathA- samaghRute madhusarpiShI maraNAya| AdigrahaNAddoShaprakRutyAdiviruddhAnAM grahaNam| svabhAvaviruddhaM yathA- viSham||81||

tatra yAnyAhAramadhikRutya bhUyiShThamupayujyante teShAmekadeshaM vairodhikamadhikRutyopadekShyAmaH- na matsyAn payasA sahAbhyavaharet, ubhayaM hyetanmadhuraM madhuravipAkaM mahAbhiShyandi shItoShNatvAdviruddhavIryaM viruddhavIryatvAcchoNitapradUShaNAya mahAbhiShyanditvAnmArgoparodhAya ca||82||

tannishamyAtreyavacanamanu bhadrakApyo~agniveshamuvAca- sarvAneva matsyAn payasA sahAbhyavaharedanyatraikasmAccilicimAt, sa punaH shakalI lohitanayanaH sarvato lohitarAjI rohitAkAraH prAyo bhUmau carati, taM cet payasA sahAbhyavaharenniHsaMshayaM shoNitajAnAM vibandhajAnAM ca vyAdhInAmanyatamamathavA maraNaM prApnuyAditi||83||

neti bhagavAnAtreyaH- sarvAneva matsyAnna payasA sahAbhyavaharedvisheShatastu cilicimaM, sa hi mahAbhiShyanditvAt sthUlalakShaNatarAnetAn vyAdhInupajanayatyAmaviShamudIrayati ca| grAmyAnUpaudakapishitAni ca madhutilaguDapayomAShamUlakabisairvirUDhadhAnyairvA naikadhyamadyAt, tanmUlaM hi bAdhiryAndhyavepathujADyakalamUkatAmaiNmiNyamathavA maraNamApnoti| na pauShkaraM rohiNIkaM shAkaM kapotAn vA sarShapatailabhraShTAnmadhupayobhyAM sahAbhyavaharet, tanmUlaM hi shoNitAbhiShyandadhamanIpravi(ti)cayApasmArasha~gkhakagalagaNDarohiNInAmanyatamaM prApnotyathavA maraNamiti| na mUlakalashunakRuShNagandhArjakasumukhasurasAdIni bhakShayitvA payaH sevyaM, kuShThAbAdhabhayAt| na jAtukashAkaM na nikucaM pakvaM madhupayobhyAM sahopayojyam, etaddhi maraNAyAthavA balavarNatejovIryoparodhAyAlaghuvyAdhaye ShANDhyAya ceti| tadeva nikucaM pakvaM na mAShasUpaguDasarpirbhiH sahopayojyaM vairodhikatvAt| tathA~a~amrAmrAtakamAtulu~gganikucakaramardamocadantashaThabadarakoshAmrabhavyajAmbavakapitthatintiDIka- pArAvatAkShoDapanasanAlikeradADimAmalakAnyevamprakArANi cAnyAni dravyANi sarvaM cAmlaM dravamadravaM ca payasA saha viruddham| tathA ka~gguvanakamakuShThakakulatthamAShaniShpAvAH payasA saha viruddhAH| padmottarikAshAkaM shArkaro maireyo madhu ca sahopayuktaM viruddhaM vAtaM cAtikopayati| hAridrakaH sarShapatailabhRuShTo viruddhaH pittaM cAtikopayati| pAyaso manthAnupAno viruddhaH shleShmANaM cAtikopayati| upodikA tilakalkasiddhA heturatIsArasya| balAkA vAruNyA saha kulmAShairapi viruddhA, saiva shUkaravasAparibhRuShTA sadyo vyApAdayati| mayUramAMsameraNDasIsakAvasaktameraNDAgnipluShTameraNDatailayuktaM sadyo vyApAdayati| hAridrakamAMsaM hAridrasIsakAvasaktaM hAridrAgnipluShTaM sadyo vyApAdayati; tadeva bhasmapAMshuparidhvastaM sakShaudraM sadyo maraNAya| matsyanistAlanasiddhAH pippalyastathA kAkamAcI madhu ca maraNAya| madhu coShNamuShNArtasya ca madhu maraNAya| madhusarpiShI samaghRute, madhu vAri cAntarikShaM samaghRutaM, madhu puShkarabIjaM, madhu pItvoShNodakaM, bhallAtakoShNodakaM, takrasiddhaH kampillakaH, paryuShitA kAkamAcI, a~ggArashUlyo bhAsashceti viruddhAni| ityetadyathAprashnamabhinirdiShTaM bhavatIti||84||

Commentary: grAmyapishitAdIni madhvAdInAmanyatareNApi viruddhAni| kalamUkateti kalamUkatA avyaktavacanatA| pauShkarAdInAM madhupayobhyAM sahAbhyavahAro viruddhaH, pauShkaraM puShkaratratrarUpaM shAkaM, rohiNI kaTurohiNI| (dhamanIpraticayaH sirAjagranthiH |) jAtushAkaM vaMshapatrikA| vairodhikatvAdityanena prakaraNalabdhasyApi vairodhikatvasya punarabhidhAnaM sAmAnyoktaShANDhyAdivyAdhikartRutopadarshanArtham, evamanyatrApi sAmAnye~api vairodhikatvamAtrAbhidhAne vaktavyam| tathA~amletyAdau amlagrahaNena labdhAnApyamlAmrAtakAdInAmabhidhAnaM visheShavirodhasUcanArtham| sarvagrahaNenaiva dravAdravAmle prApte punardravAdravavacanaM ‘sarva’ shabdasya dravAdravAmlakArtsnyArthatApratiShedhArthaM, bhavati hi prakaraNAdekadeshe~api sarvavyapadeshaH, yathA sarvAn bhojayeditiH, kiMvA sarvagrahaNamamlavipAkAnAM vrIhyAdInAM grahaNArtham| payaseti tRutIyayaiva sahArthe labdhe punaH sahetyabhidhAnaM kevalAmlAdiyuktasyaiva virodhitopadarshanArthaM; tena, amlapayaHsaMyoge guDAdisaMyoge sati viruddhatvaM na dugdhAmrAdInAm| vanako vanakodravaH| padmottarikA kusumbhaH| shArkara iti maireyavisheShaNam| vAtaM cAtikopayatIti vacanena pittakaphAvalpaM kopayatIti bodhayati; evaM pittaM cAtikopayati kaphaM cAtikopayatItyetayorapi vAcyam| hAridrako ‘haritAla’ iti khyAtaH pakShI| balAkA vAruNyA saha viruddhA, tathA kulmAShaishca balAkA viruddhA| eraNDasIsakAvasaktamiti eraNDakAShThAvasaktaM, sIsako hi bhaTitrakaraNakAShThamucyate| tadeveti hAridrakamAMsam| matsyA nistAlyante pacyante yasmin tanmatsyanistAlanaM; kiMvA nistAlanaM vasA, jatUkarNe~apyuktaM- “matsyavasAsiddhAH pippalyaH” iti| kAkamAcI madhu ceti saMyogaviruddham| bhAso goShThakukkuTaH||84||

bhavanti cAtra shlokAH- yat ki~jciddoShamAsrAvya na nirharati kAyataH| AhArajAtaM tat sarvamahitAyopapadyate||85||

Commentary: anuktavairodhikasa~ggrahArthamAha- yat ki~jcidityAdi| Ahriyata ityAhAro bheShajamapi| doShamAsrAvyeti doShAnutkliShTarUpAn janayitvA na nirharatIti| anena vamanavirecanadravyANi nirAkaroti, tAni hi doShAnAsrAvya nirharanti||85||
yaccApi deshakAlAgnimAtrAsAtmyAnilAdibhiH| saMskArato vIryatashca koShThAvasthAkramairapi||86||
parihAropacArAbhyAM pAkAt saMyogato~api ca| viruddhaM tacca na hitaM hRutsampadvidhibhishca yat||87||
viruddhaM deshatastAvadrUkShatIkShNAdi dhanvani| AnUpe snigdhashItAdi bheShajaM yanniShevyate||88||
kAlato~api viruddhaM yacchItarUkShAdisevanam| shIte kAle, tathoShNe ca kaTukoShNAdisevanam||89||
viruddhamanale tadvadannapAnaM caturvidhe| madhusarpiH samadhRutaM mAtrayA tadvirudhyate||90||
kaTukoShNAdisAtmyasya svAdushItAdisevanam| yattat sAtmyaviruddhaM tu viruddhaM tvanilAdibhiH||91||
yA samAnaguNAbhyAsaviruddhAnnauShadhakriyA| saMskArato viruddhaM tadyadbhojyaM viShavadbhavet||92||
eraNDasIsakAsaktaM shikhimAMsaM yathaiva hi| viruddhaM vIryato j~jeyaM vIryataH shItalAtmakam||93||
tat saMyojyoShNavIryeNa dravyeNa saha sevyate| krUrakoShThasya cAtyalpaM mandavIryamabhedanam||94||
mRudakoShThasya guru ca bhedanIyaM tathA bahu| etat koShThaviruddhaM tu, viruddhaM syAdavasthayA||95||
shramavyavAyavyAyAmasaktasyAnilakopanam| nidrAlasasyAlasasya bhojanaM shleShmakopanam||96||
yaccAnutsRujya viNmUtraM bhu~gkte yashcAbubhukShitaH| tacca kramaviruddhaM syAdyaccAtikShudvashAnugaH||97||
parihAraviruddhaM tu varAhAdInniShevya yat| sevetoShNaM ghRutAdIMshca pItvA shItaM niShevate||98||
viruddhaM pAkatashcApi duShTadurdArusAdhitam| apakvataNDulAtyarthapakvadagdhaM ca yadbhavet| saMyogato viruddhaM tadyathA~amlaM payasA saha||99||
amanorucitaM yacca hRudviruddhaM taducyate| sampadviruddhaM tadvidyAdasa~jjAtarasaM tu yat||100||
atikrAntarasaM vA~api vipannarasameva vA| j~jeyaM vidhiviruddhaM tu bhujyate nibhRute na yat| tadevaMvidhamannaM syAdviruddhamupayojitam||101||
ShANDhyAndhyavIsarpadakodarANAM visphoTakonmAdabhagandarANAm| mUrcchAmadAdhmAnagalagrahANAM pANDvAmayasyAmaviShasya caiva||102||
kilAsakuShThagrahaNIgadAnAM shothAmlapittajvarapInasAnAm | santAnadoShasya tathaiva mRutyorviruddhamannaM pravadanti hetum||103||

eShAM khalvapareShAM ca vairodhikanimittAnAM vyAdhInAmime bhAvAH pratikArA bhavanti| tadyathA- vamanaM virecanaM ca, tadvirodhinAM ca dravyANAM saMshamanArthamupayogaH, tathAvidhaishca dravyaiH pUrvamabhisaMskAraH sharIrasyeti||104||
bhavatashcAtra- viruddhAshanajAn rogAn pratihanti vivecanam| vamanaM shamanaM caiva pUrvaM vA hitasevanam||105||
sAtmyato~alpatayA vA~api dIptAgnestaruNasya ca| snigdhavyAyAmabalinAM viruddhaM vitathaM bhavet||106||
tatra shlokAH- matirAsInmaharShINAM yA yA rasavinishcaye| dravyANi guNakarmabhyAM dravyasa~gkhyA rasAshrayA||107||
kAraNaM rasasa~gkhyAyA rasAnurasalakShaNam| parAdInAM guNAnAM ca lakShaNAni pRuthakpRuthak||108||
pa~jcAtmakAnAM ShaTtvaM ca rasAnAM yena hetunA| UrdhvAnulomabhAjashca yadguNAtishayAdrasAH||109||
ShaNNAM rasAnAM ShaTtve ca savibhaktA vibhaktayaH| uddeshashcApavAdashca dravyANAM guNakarmaNi||110||
pravarAvaramadhyatvaM rasAnAM gauravAdiShu| pAkaprabhAvayorli~ggaM vIryasa~gkhyAvinishcayaH||111||
ShaNNAmAsvAdyamAnAnAM rasAnAM yat svalakShaNam| yadyadvirudhyate yasmAdyena yatkAri caiva yat||112||
vairodhikanimittAnAM vyAdhInAmauShadhaM ca yat| AtreyabhadrakApyIye tat sarvamavadanmuniH||113||
Atreyo bhadrakApyashca shAkunteyastathaiva ca| pUrNAkShashcaiva maudgalyo hiraNyAkShashca kaushikaH||3||
yaH kumArashirA nAma bharadvAjaH sa cAnaghaH| shrImAn vAryovidashcaiva rAjA matimatAM varaH||4||
nimishca rAjA vaideho baDishashca mahAmatiH| kA~gkAyanashca bAhlIko bAhlIkabhiShajAM varaH||5||
ete shrutavayovRuddhA jitAtmAno maharShayaH| vane caitrarathe ramye samIyurvijihIrShavaH||6||
teShAM tatropaviShTAnAmiyamarthavatI kathA| babhUvArthavidAM samyagrasAhAravinishcaye||7||

eka eva rasa ityuvAca bhadrakApyaH, yaM pa~jcAnAmindriyArthAnAmanyatamaM jihvAvaiShayikaM bhAvamAcakShate kushalAH, sa punarudakAdananya iti| dvau rasAviti shAkunteyo brAhmaNaH, chedanIya upashamanIyashceti| trayo rasA iti pUrNAkSho maudgalyaH, chedanIyopashamanIyasAdhAraNA iti| catvAro rasA iti hiraNyAkShaH kaushikaH, svAdurhitashca svAdurahitashcAsvAdurhitashcAsvAdurahitashceti| pa~jca rasA iti kumArashirA bharadvAjaH, bhaumaudakAgneyavAyavyAntarikShAH| ShaDrasA iti vAryovido rAjarShiH, gurulaghushItoShNasnigdharUkShAH| sapta rasA iti nimirvaidehaH, madhurAmlalavaNakaTutiktakaShAyakShArAH| aShTau rasA iti baDisho dhAmArgavaH, madhurAmlalavaNakaTutiktakaShAyakShArAvyaktAH| aparisa~gkhyeyA rasA iti kA~gkAyano bAhlIkabhiShak, AshrayaguNakarmasaMsvAdavisheShANAmaparisa~gkhyeyatvAt||8||

Commentary: eka evetyAdi | indriyArthAnAmiti nirdhAraNe ShaShThI| anyatamamiti ekam; anyashabdo hyayamekavacanaH, yathA- anyo dakShiNena gato~anya uttareNa; eka ityarthaH; tamappratyayashca svArthikaH| jihvAvaiShayikamiti jihvAgrAhyam| rasAbhAvo~api jihvayA gRuhyate~ata Aha- bhAvamiti| udakAdananya iti rasodakayorekatvakhyApanArthaM, pUrvapakShatvAdaduShTam| pUrvapakShashca kapilamatena, te hi rasatanmAtraM gandhatanmAtramityAdivacanena guNAvyatiriktaM dravyamiti bruvate| chedanIya iti apatarpaNakArakaH| upashamanIya iti bRuMhaNaH| sAdhAraNa ityAgneyasaumyasAmAnyAdubhayorapi la~gghanabRuMhaNayoH kartA , parasparavirodhAdakartA vA| svAduriti abhIShTaH, hita iti AyatAvanapakArI| AshrIyata ityAshrayo dravyaM, guNAH snigdhagurvAdayaH; karma dhAtuvardhanakShapaNAdi, saMsvAdaH rasAnAmavAntarabhedaH; eShAM visheShANAM bhedAnAmityarthaH| tatra dravyabhedAdAdhArabhedenAshritasyApi rasasya bhedo bhavati, Ashrayo hi kAraNaM, kAraNabhedAcca kAryabhedo~avashyaM bhavatItyarthaH| gurvAdiguNabhedAstathA karmabhedAshca rasakRutA eva| tatashca kAryabhedAdavashyaM kAraNabheda iti pUrvapakShAbhiprAyaH| saMsvAdabhedastu ekasyAmapi madhurajAtAvikShukShIraguDAdigataH pratyakShameva bhedo dRushyate, sa tu saMsvAdabhedaH svasaMvedya eva; yaduktaM- “ikShukShIraguDAdInAM mAdhuryasyAntaraM mahat| bhedastathA~api nAkhyAtuM sarasvatyA~api shakyate” iti||8||

ShaDeva rasA ityuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH punarvasuH, madhurAmlalavaNakaTutiktakaShAyAH| teShAM ShaNNAM rasAnAM yonirudakaM, chedanopashamane dve karmaNI, tayormishrIbhAvAt sAdhAraNatvaM, svAdvasvAdutA bhaktiH , hitAhitau prabhAvau, pa~jcamahAbhUtavikArAstvAshrayAH prakRutivikRutivicAradeshakAlavashAH, teShvAshrayeShu dravyasa~jj~jakeShu guNA gurulaghushItoShNasnigdharUkShAdyAH; kSharaNAt kShAraH, nAsau rasaH dravyaM tadanekarasasamutpannamanekarasaM kaTukalavaNabhUyiShThamanekendriyArthasamanvitaM karaNAbhinirvRuttam; avyaktIbhAvastu khalu rasAnAM prakRutau bhavatyanurase~anurasasamanvite vA dravye; aparisa~gkhyeyatvaM punasteShAmAshrayAdInAM bhAvAnAM visheShAparisa~gkhyeyatvAnna yuktam, ekaiko~api hyeShAmAshrayAdInAM bhAvAnAM visheShAnAshrayate visheShAparisa~gkhyeyatvAt, na ca tasmAdanyatvamupapadyate; parasparasaMsRuShTabhUyiShThatvAnna caiShAmabhinirvRutterguNaprakRutInAmaparisa~gkhyeyatvaM bhavati; tasmAnna saMsRuShTAnAM rasAnAM karmopadishanti buddhimantaH| taccaiva kAraNamapekShamANAH ShaNNAM rasAnAM paraspareNAsaMsRuShTAnAM lakShaNapRuthaktvamupadekShyAmaH||9||

Commentary: siddhAntaM punarvasuvacanenAha- ShaDevetyAdi| pUrvapakShoktarasaikatvAdivyavasthAmAha- teShAM ShaNNAmityAdi| yoniH AdhArakAraNaM, kAryakAraNayoshca bhedAt siddha udakAdrasabhedaH pratyakSha eveti bhAvaH| kShitivyatiriktamudakameva yathA rasayonistathA “rasanArtho rasastasya” (sU. 1) ityAdau vivRutameva dIrgha~jjIvitIye| tayormishrIbhAvAditi karmaNoramUrtayormishrIbhAvAnupapattau tadAdhArayordravyayormishrIbhAvAditi boddhavyam| sAdhAraNamiti sAdhAraNakAryayogitvam | bhaktiH icchetyarthaH| tena, yoyamicchati sa tasya svAdurasvAduritara iti puruShApekShau dharmau, na rasabhedakAryAvityarthaH| pa~jcamahAbhUtetyAdau ‘tu’ shabdo~avadhAraNe; tena AshrayA eva, na rasA ityarthaH| kimbhUtA bhaumAdayo bhUtavikArA AshrayA ityAha- prakRutivikRutivicAradeshakAlavashA iti; vashashabdo~adhInArthaH, sa ca prakRutyAdibhiH pratyekaM yojyaH| tatra prakRutivashA yathA- mudgAH kaShAyA madhurAshca santaH prakRutyA laghavaH; etaddhi lAghavaM na rasavashaM, tathAhi sati kaShAyamadhuratvAdgurutvaM syAt ; vikRutivashaM ca vrIherlAjAnAM laghutvaM, tathA saktusiddhapiNDakAnAM ca gurutvam; vicAraNA vicAro dravyAntarasaMyoga ityarthaH, tena vicAraNAvashaM yathA- madhusarpiShI saMyukte viShaM, tathA viShaM cAgadasaMyuktaM svakAryavyatiriktakAryakAri ; desho dvividho bhUmirAturashca, tatra bhUmau ‘shvetakApotI valmIkAdhirUDhA viShaharI’, tathA “himavati bheShajAni mahAguNAni bhavanti”, sharIradeshe yathA- “sakthimAMsAdgurutaraM skandhakroDashiraspadAm” (sU. 27) ityAdi; kAlavashaM tu yathA mUlakamadhikRutyoktaM- “tadbAlaM doShaharaM vRuddhaM tridoSham” (sU. 27), tathA “yathartupuShpaphalamAdadIta” (ka. 1) ityAdi| atra caikaprakaraNoktA ye~anuktAste cakArAt svabhAvAdiShvevAntarbhAvanIyAH| yaduktaM- “caraH sharIrAvayavAH svabhAvo dhAtavaH kriyAH| li~ggaM pramANaM saMskAro mAtrA cAsmin parIkShyate” (sU. 27) iti| tatra, carasharIrAvayavadhAtUnAM deshena grahaNaM, mAtrA vicAre pravishati, sheShaM svabhAve; tathA rasavimAne vakShyamANaM cAtrApraviShTamAhAravisheShAyatanamantarbhAvanIyaM yathAsambhavam| snigdharUkShAdyA ityatrAdigrahaNenAnuktA api tIkShNamRudvAdayo na rasAH, kintu dravyaguNAH pRuthageveti darshayati| kSharaNAt adhogamanakriyAyogAt kShAro dravyaM nAsau rasaH, rasasya hi niShkriyasya kriyA~anupapannetyarthaH| kSharaNaM ca kShArasya pAnIyayuktasyAdhogamanena, vadanti hi laukikAH- ‘kShAraM srAvayAmaH’ iti; shAstraM ca- “chittvA chittvA~a~ashayAt kShAraH kSharatvAt kShArayatyadhaH” (ci. 5) iti| hetvantaramAha- dravyaM tadanekarasotpannamiti; anekarasebhyo muShkakApAmArgAdibhya utpannamanekarasotpannaM; yatashcAnekarasotpannamata evAnekarasaM, kAraNaguNAnuvidhAyitvAt kAryaguNasyeti bhAvaH| anekarasatvamevAha- kaTukalavaNabhUyiShThamiti|- bhUyiShThashabdenApradhAnarasAntarasambandho~astIti darshayati| hetvantaramAha- anekendriyArthasamanvitamiti| kShAro hi sparshena gandhena cAnvitaH, tena dravyaM, rase hi guNe na sparsho nApi gandha iti bhAvaH| hetvantaramAha- karaNAbhinirvRuttamiti; karaNena bhasmaparisrAvaNAdinA~abhinirvRuttaM kRutamityarthaH, na raso~anena prakAreNa kriyata iti bhAvaH| avyaktarasapakShaM niShedhayati- avyaktIbhAva ityAdi| avyaktIbhAva ityabhUtatadbhAve cvipratyayena rasAnAM madhurAdInAM vyaktAnAmeva kvacidAdhAre~avyaktatvaM, nAnyo madhurAdibhyo~avyaktarasa ityarthaH| rasAnAmiti madhurAdInAM ShaNNAm| prakRutAvityAdi| prakRutau kAraNe jala ityarthaH| avyaktatvaM ca rasasAmAnyamAtropalabdhirmadhurAdivisheShashUnyA, sA ca jale bhavati; yata uktaM jalaguNakathane sushrute- “vyaktarasatA rasadoShaH” (su. sU. 45) iti, ihApi ca ‘avyaktarasaM ca’ iti vakShyati, loke~api cAvyaktarasaM dravyamAsvAdya vaktAro vadanti- jalasyevAsya raso na kashcinmadhurAdirvyakta iti| visheShamadhurAdyanupalabdhishcAnudbhUtatvena| yathA- dUrAdavij~jAyamAnavisheShavarNe vastuni rUpasAmAnyapratItirbhavati, na shuklatvAdivisheShabuddhiH, tathA~anurase~avyaktIbhAvo bhavati; pradhAnaM vyaktaM rasamanugato~avyaktatvenetyanurasaH, yathA veNuyave madhure kaShAyo~anurasaH| yaduktaM- “rUkShaH kaShAyAnuraso madhuraH kaphapittahA” (sU. 27) iti| anurasasamanvita iti sarvAnurasayukte, yathA- viShe; vacanaM hi- “uShNamanirdeshyarasaM” (ci. 23) ityAdi| kiMvA, ‘aNurasasamanvite’ iti pAThaH; tena, aNurasenaikena maricena sharkarApAnake kaTutvamavyaktaM syAt| aparisa~gkhyeyapakShaM dUShayati- aparItyAdi| teShAmiti rasAnAm, aparisa~gkhyeyatvaM na yuktam; AshrayAdInAM bhAvAnAmiti AshrayaguNakarmasaMsvAdAnAm; visheShAparisa~gkhyeyatvAditi AshrayAdi bhedasyAparisa~gkhyeyatvAt| atra hetumAha- ekaiko~api hItyAdi| eShAmAshrayaguNakarmasaMsvAdAnAM visheShAnekaiko~api madhurAdirAshrayate, na ca tasmAdAshrayAdibhedAdanyatvamAshritasya madhurAderbhavati| evaM manyate- yadyapi shAlimudgaghRutakShIrAdayo madhurasyAshrayA bhinnAH, tathA~api tatra madhuratvajAtyAkrAnta eka eva raso bhavati balAkAkShIrakArpAsAdiShu shuklavarNa iva| tathA guNAnAM gurupicchilasnigdhAdInAmanyatve~api karmaNAM vA rasAdivardhanAyurjananavarNakaratvAdInAM bhinnatve satyapi na madhurarasasyAnyatvaM, yata eka eva madhurastattadguNayukto bhavati tatkarmakArI ceti ko virodhaH| tathA madhurasyAvAntarAsvAdabhede~api madhuratvajAtyanatikramaH, kRuShNavarNAvAntarabhede yathA kRuShNatvAnatikramaH| nanu, maivaM bhavatvaparisa~gkhyeyatvaM rasAnAM, parasparasaMyogAttu ya AsvAdavisheShaH sa kAryavisheShakaro~api; nahi yanmadhurAmlena kriyate, tanmadhureNa vA~amlena vA shakyam; atastena parasparasaMyogenAparisa~gkhyeyatvaM bhaviShyatItyAha- parasparetyAdi| saMsRuShTamiti bhAvektaH, tena parasparasaMsargabhUyiShThatvAdeShAM madhurAdInAmabhinirvRutterna guNaprakRutInAmasa~gkhyeyatvamiti yojanA; ayamarthaH- yadyapi rasAH parasparasaMsargeNAtibhUyasA yuktAH santo~abhinirvRuttA dvirasAdau dravye bhavanti, tathA~api na teShAM guNA gurulaghvAdayaH, prakRutayo vA madhurAdInAM yA yA AyuShyatvarasAbhivardhakatvAdyAstA asa~gkhyeyA bhavanti, kintu ya eva madhurAdInAM pratyekaM guNAH prakRutayashca uddiShTAsta eva mishrA bhavanti| kiMvA guNaprakRutInAmiti madhurAdiShaDguNasvarUpANAmityarthaH; tena, rasasya rasAntarasaMsarge doShANAmiva doShAntarasaMsarge rasAnAM nAparisa~gkhyeyatvamityarthaH| prakRutishabdena karma vocyate, tena guNakarmaNAmityarthaH| madhurAdInAmavAntarAsvAdavisheSho~api parasparasaMsargakRute j~jeyaH| yata eva heto rasAnAM saMsRuShTAnAM nAnye guNakarmaNI bhavataH, ata eva saMsRuShTAnAM rasAnAM pRuthakkarma shAstrAntare~api noktamityAha- tasmAdityAdi| karmashabdeneha gauravalAghavAdikArakA gurutvAdayo rasaraktAdijananAdayashcApi boddhavyAH| na kevalamanyashAstrakArai rasAnAM saMsRuShTAnAM karma nopadiShTaM, kintu vayamapi nopadekShyAma ityAha- taccaivetyAdi| taccaiva kAraNamiti parasparasaMsarge~api rasAnAmanadhikaguNakarmatvam| lakShaNena pRuthaktvaM lakShaNapRuthaktvam| tatra lakShyate yena tallakShaNam; atastu ‘madhuro rasaH’ ityAdinA granthena, tathA ‘snehanaprINanahlAdana’ ityAdinA ca yadvAcyaM, tat sarvaM gRuhyate;| kiMvA, lakShaNashabdena ‘madhuro rasa’ ityAdigranthavAcyaM lakShaNamucyate, pRuthaktvaM ca rasabhedaj~jAnArthaM yadvakShyati ‘snehanaprINana’ ityAdi tadgRuhyate||9||

agre tu tAvaddravyabhedamabhipretya ki~jcidabhidhAsyAmaH| sarvaM dravyaM pA~jcabhautikamasminnarthe ; taccetanAvadacetanaM ca, tasya guNAH shabdAdayo gurvAdayashca dravAntAH, karma pa~jcavidhamuktaM vamanAdi||10||

Commentary: agre tvityAdi| raseShu vAcyeShu dravyabhedamabhipretya pratipAdanIyatayA parigRuhya rasAnAM dravyaj~jAnAdhInaj~jAnatvAddravyAbhidhAnamagre kRutamityarthaH| ki~jciditi AyurvedopayogidravyasvarUpaM na sarvam, aprasa~ggadoShAditi bhAvaH| sarvadravyamiti kAryadravyam| asminnarthe asmin prakaraNe| dravAntA iti vacanena pUrvoktAn viMshatiguNAnAha| atra ca paratvAparatvAdInAmihAnabhidhAnena cikitsAyAM paratvAdInAmaprAdhAnyaM darshayati; ye~api tatrApi yuktisaMyogaparimANasaMskArAbhyAsA atyarthacikitsopayogino~api na te parthivAdidravyANAM shabdAdivat sAMsiddhikAH kintarhyAdheyAH, ata iha naisargikaguNakathane noktAH| uktamiti apAmArgataNDulIye| etacca prAdhAnyAducyate, tena bRuMhaNAdyapi boddhavyam||10||

tatra dravyANi gurukharakaThinamandasthiravishadasAndrasthUlagandhaguNabahulAni pArthivAni , tAnyupacayasa~gghAtagauravasthairyakarANi; dravasnigdhashItamandamRudupicchilarasaguNabahulAnyApyAni, tAnyupakledasnehabandhaviShyandamArdavaprahlAdakarANi; uShNatIkShNasUkShmalaghurUkShavishadarUpaguNabahulAnyAgneyAni, tAni dAhapAkaprabhAprakAshavarNakarANi; laghushItarUkShakharavishadasUkShmasparshaguNabahulAni vAyavyAni, tAni raukShyaglAnivicAravaishadyalAghavakarANi; mRudulaghusUkShmashlakShNashabdaguNabahulAnyAkAshAtmakAni, tAni mArdavasauShiryalAghavakarANi||11||

Commentary: bahulashabdo gurvAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate; kiMvA gandhenaiva, yato gandhaguNabahulA pRuthivyeva bhavati; ata eva dravyAntaralakShaNe~api vaisheShikaguNo~anta eva paThyate ‘rasaguNabahulAni’ ityAdi; tena tatrApi rasAdibhireva bahulashabdo yojyaH| sarvakAryadravyANAM pA~jcabhautikatve~api pRuthivyAdyutkarSheNa pArthivatvAdi j~jeyam| sa~gghAtaH kAThinyaM, sthairyam avicAlyam| bandhanaM parasparayojanaM, prahlAdaH sharIrendriyatarpaNam| sUkShmaM sUkShmasroto~anusAri| prabhA varNaprakAshinI dIptiH; yaduktaM- “varNamAkrAmati cchAyA prabhA varNaprakAshikA” (iM.a.7) ityAdi| vicaraNaM vicAro gatirityarthaH| sauShiryaM randhrabahulatA| atrAkAshabAhulyaM dravyasya pRuthivyAdibhUtAntarAlpatvena bhUrivyaktAkAshatvena ca j~jeyaM, yadeva bhUrishuShiraM tannAbhasaM; kiMvA AkAshaguNabahulatvena nAbhasaM dravyamityucyate||11||

anenopadeshena nAnauShadhibhUtaM jagati ki~jciddravyamupalabhyate tAM tAM yuktimarthaM ca taM tamabhipretya||12||

Commentary: aneneti pratiniyatadravyaguNopadeshena; yat pArthivAdi dravyaM yadguNaM tadguNe dehe sampAdye tad bheShajaM bhavatItyarthaH| tacca pArthivAdi dravyaM na sarvathA na ca sarvasmin vyAdhau bheShajamityAha- tAM tAM yuktimityAdi|- yuktimiti upAyam, arthamiti prayojanam, abhipretyeti adhikRutya; tena kenacidupAyena kvacit prayojane ki~jciddravyamauShadhaM bhavati na sarvatra| tena yaducyate- vairodhikAnAM sarvadA~apathyatvena ‘nAnauShadhaM dravyam’ iti vaco virodhi; tanna bhavati, vairodhikAni hi saMyogasaMskAradeshakAlAdyapekShANi bhavanti, vairodhikasaMyogAdyabhAve tu pathyAnyapi kvacit syuH| yAnyapi (sarvadA~api ) svabhAvAdeva viShamandakAdInyapathyAni, tAnyapyupAyayuktAni kvacit pathyAni bhavanti; yathA udare- “viShasya tilaM dadyAt” (ci. 13) ityAdi| yattu tRuNapAMshuprabhRutIni nopayujyante, ato na tAni bheShajAnItyucyate; tanna, teShAmapi bheShajasvedAdyupAyatvena bheShajatvAt||12||

na tu kevalaM guNaprabhAvAdeva dravyANi kArmukANi bhavanti; dravyANi hi dravyaprabhAvAdguNaprabhAvAddravyaguNaprabhAvAcca tasmiMstasmin kAle tattadadhikaraNamAsAdya tAM tAM ca yuktimarthaM ca taM tamabhipretya yat kurvanti, tat karma; yena kurvinti, tadvIryaM; yatra kurvanti, tadadhikaraNaM; yadA kurvanti, sa kAlaH; yathA kurvanti, sa upAyaH; yat sAdhayanti, tat phalam||13||

Commentary: pArthivAdidravyANAM gurukharAdiguNayogAdbheShajatvamuktaM, tena guNaprabhAvAdeva bheShajaM syAditi sha~gkAM nirasyannAha- na tu kevalamityAdi| dravyaprabhAvAdyathA- dantyA virecakatvaM, tathA maNInAM viShAdihantRutvamityAdi| guNaprabhAvAdyathA- jvare tiktako rasaH, shIte~agnirityAdi| dravyaguNaprabhAvAdyathA- kRuShNAjinasyoparIti, atrApi kRuShNatvaM guNo~ajinaM ca dravyamabhipretaM; yathA vA- “maNDalairjAtarUpasya tasyA eva payaH shRutam” (ci. a. 2. pA. 3); tatra maNDalaguNayuktasyaiva jAtarUpasya kArmukatvam | kathaM kurvantItyAha- tasmiMstasminnityAdi| tAM tAM yuktimAsAdyeti tAM tAM yojanAM prApya| yat kurvantItyAdAvudAharaNaM yathA- shirovirecanadravyANi yacchirovirecanaM kurvanti, tacchirovirecanaM karma; yenoShNatvAdikAraNena shirovirecanaM kurvanti, tadvIryaM, vIryaM shaktiH, sA ca dravyasya guNasya vA; yatra shirovirecanaM kurvanti tadadhikaraNaM shiraH, nAnyatrAdhikaraNe shirovirecanadravyaM prabhavatItyarthaH; yadeti vasantAdau shirogauravAdiyukte ca kAle, etenAkAle shIte shirovirecanaM stabdhatvAnna kArmukaM, kintu svakAla eva; yathA yena prakAreNa pradhamanAvapIDanAdinA tathA “prasAritA~ggamuttAnaM shayane saMstarAstRute| IShatpralambashirasaM saMveshya cAvRutekShaNam” ityAdinA vidhinA kurvanti, sa upAyaH; yat sAdhayanti shirogauravashUlAdyuparamaM , tat phalaM; phalam uddeshyam| karma kAryaM sAdhanam, uddeshyaM phalaM sAdhyaM; yathA- yAganiShpAdyo dharmaH kAryatayA karma, tajjanyastu svargAdiruddeshyaH phalam; evaM vamanAdiShvapi karmAdhikaraNAdyunneyam||13||

bhedashcaiShAM triShaShTividhavikalpo dravyadeshakAlaprabhAvAdbhavati, tamupadekShyAmaH||14||

Commentary: samprati dravyamabhidhAya vikRutAnAM rasAnAmeva bhedamAha - bhedashcaiShAmityAdi| prabhAvashabdo dravyadeshakAlaiH pratyekaM yujyate; tatra dravyaprabhAvAdyathA- ’somaguNAtirekAnmadhuraH’ ityAdi; deshaprabhAvAdyathA- himavati drAkShAdADimAdIni madhurANi bhavantyanyatrAmlAnItyAdi; kAlaprabhAvAdyathA- bAlAmraM sakaShAyaM taruNamamlaM pakvaM madhuraM, tathA hemante oShadhyo madhurA varShAsvamlA ityAdi| agnisaMyogAdayo ye~anye rasahetavaste~api kAle dravye vA~antarbhAvanIyAH||14||

hitAhitaikadeshamabhidhAya kRutsnadravyahitAhitatvaj~jAnArthaM rasavIryavipAkAbhidhAyaka AtreyabhadrakApyIyo~abhidhIyate| tatrApi vipAkAdInAmapi rasenaiva prAyo lakShaNIyatvAdrasaprakaraNamAdau kRutam||1-2||

catUrase svAdvamlAvAdisthitau lavaNAdibhirekaikashyena yuktau sheShaiH kaTvAdibhiryogAt ShaD bhavanti| svAdulavaNau sahitau Adisthitau, kaTvAdibhiriti kaTutiktAbhyAM pRuthagyuktau, sheShairiti tiktakaShAyAbhyAM, teneha bahuvacanaM jAtau boddhavyam; evaM trINi| svAdUShaNau tathetyanena svAdukaTukatiktakaShAyarUpamekam| kaTvAdyairityAdAvapi bahuvacanaM jAtau| amlalavaNau saMyuktau kaTunA sahitau sheShAbhyAM yogAddve, tathA~amlalavaNau tiktayuktau sheShayogAdekam| amlakaTU tathetyanenAmlakaTutiktakaShAyarUpamekam| yujyete tvityAdinA caikam| evaM pa~jcadasha catUrasAni||17-20||-

rasasaMsargasya prakArAntareNAsa~gkhyeyatAmAha- triShaShTiH syAdityAdi| anuraso~agre vakShyamANaH| atra ca triShaShTyAtmakarase rasAnurasakalpanA nAsti, kevale madhurAdau tadabhAvAt; tena yathAsambhavaM saptapa~jcAshatsaMyogaviShayaM rasAnurasakalpanaM j~jeyam| kiMvA, ekarase~apyanuraso~astyevAvyapadeshyaH| prakArAntareNApyasa~gkhyeyatAmAha- rasAstaratamAbhyAmityAdi| madhuramadhurataramadhuratamAdibhedAdasa~gkhyeyatA rasAnAM bhavatIti bhAvaH| kiMvA, rasAnurasatvenaiva yA~asa~gkhyeyatA tatraivAyaM hetuH- rasAstaratamAbhyAmityAdiH||22-23||

tameva cikitsAprayogamAha- kvacidityAdi| atrAdigrahaNAddeshakAlabalAdInAmanuktAnAM grahaNam| etadeva saMyuktAsaMyuktarasakalpanaM bhinnarasadravyamelakAdvA~anekarasaikadravyaprayogAdekarasadravyaprayogAdvA bhavatIti darshayannAha- dravyANItyAdi| dvirasAdIni utpattisiddhadvirasatrirasAdIni; dvirasaM yathA- kaShAyamadhuro mudgaH; trirasaM yathA- “madhurAmlakaShAyaM ca viShTambhi guru shItalam| pittashleShmaharaM bhavyaM” (sU. 27) ityAdi; catUrasastilaH, yaduktaM- “snigdhoShNamadhurastiktaH kaShAyaH kaTukastilaH” (sU. 27); pa~jcarasaM tvAmalakaM harItakI ca, “shivA pa~jcarasA” ityAdivacanAt; vyaktaShaDrasaM tu dravyamihAnuktaM, viShaM tvavyaktaShaDrasasaMyuktaM; hArIte tveNamAMsaM vyaktaShaDrasasaMyuktamuktam| evaM dvirasAdidravyayogAddvirasAdyupayogaH| tathA saMyuktAMshca rasAniti ekaikarasAdidravyamelakAt saMyuktAn rasAnekaikashaH kalpayanti prayojayanti| gadAn pratIti prAdhAnyena, tena svasthavRutte~api boddhavyaM; kiMvA, dvirasAdibhedo gada eva, svasthe tu sarvarasaprayoga eva; yaduktaM- “samasarvarasaM sAtmyaM samadhAtoH prashasyate” (sU. 7) iti| evaM ca vyAkhyAne sati ‘kvacideko rasa’ ityAdinA samamasya na paunaruktyam| kiMvA, ‘kvacideko rasa’ ityAdinA svamatamuktam, atraivArthe ‘dravyANi dvirasAdIni’ ityAdinA~a~acAryAntarasammatiM darshayati; ata evAnyAcAryAntarAbhiprAyeNa kalpayantItyuktaM, tena na paunaruktyam||25-26||

samprati pUrvoktagurvAdiguNAtiriktAn paratvAparatvAdIn dashaguNAn rasadharmatvenopadeShTavyAnAha- paretyAdi| tacca paratvaM pradhAnatvam, aparatvam apradhAnatvam| tadvivaraNaM- deshakAletyAdi| tatra desho maruH paraH, anUpo~aparaH; kAlo visargaH paraH, AdAnamaparaH; vayastaruNaM param, aparamitarat; mAnaM ca sharIrasya yathA vakShyamANaM shArIre paraM, tato~anyadaparaM; pAkavIryarasAstu ye yasya yoginaste taM prati parAH, ayaugikAstvaparAH| AdigrahaNAt prakRutibalAdInAM grahaNam| kiMvA, paratvAparatve vaisheShikokte j~jeye; tatra deshApekShayA sannikRuShTadeshasambandhinamapekShya vidUradeshasambandhini paratvaM, sannikRuShTadeshasambandhini cAparatvaM bhavati; evaM sannikRuShTaviprakRuShTakAlApekShayA ca sthavire paratvaM, yUni cAparatvaM bhavati| vayaHprabhRutiShu paratvAparatvaM yathAsambhavaM kAladeshakRutamevehopayogAdupacaritamapyabhihitaM, yato na guNe mAnAdau guNAntarasambhavaH| yuktishcetyAdau yojanA doShAdyapekShayA bheShajasya samIcInakalpanA, ata evoktaM- yA tu yujyate; yA kalpanA yaugikI bhavati sA tu yuktirucyate, ayaugikI tu kalpanA~api satI yuktirnocyate putro~apyaputravat| yuktishceyaM saMyogaparimANasaMskArAdyantargatA~apyatyupayuktatvAt pRuthagucyate| sa~gkhyAM lakShayati- sa~gkhyetyAdi| gaNitamihaikadvitryAdi| saMyogamAha- yoga ityAdi | saheti militAnAM dravyANAM yogaH prAptirityarthaH, sahetyanenehAki~jcitkaraM parasparasaMyogaM nirAkaroti| tadbhedamAha- dvandvetyAdi| tatra dvandvakarmajo yathA- yudhyamAnayormeShayoH, sarvakarmajo yathA- bhANDe prakShipyamANAnAM mAShANAM bahulamAShakriyAyogajaH, ekakarmajo yathA- vRukShavAyasayoH| anitya iti saMyogasya karmajatvenAnityatvaM darshayati| vibhAgamAha- vibhAgastvityAdi| vibhaktiH vibhajanam| vibhaktimeva vivRuNoti- viyoga iti; saMyogasya vigamo viyogaH| tat kiM saMyogAbhAva eva viyoga ityAha- bhAgasho graha iti|- vibhAgasho vibhaktatvena grahaNaM yato bhavatIti bhAvaH; tena vibhaktirityeShA bhAvarUpA pratItiH, na saMyogAbhAvamAtraM bhavati, kintarhi bhAvarUpavibhAgaguNayuktA ityarthaH | pRuthaktvaM tu ‘idaM dravyaM paTalakShaNaM, ghaTAt pRuthag’ ityAdikA buddhiryato bhavati, tat pRuthaktvaM bhavati| taccAcAryastraividhyenAha- pRuthaktvamityAdi| tatra yat sarvathA~asaMyujyamAnayoriva meruhimAcalayoH pRuthaktvam, etadasaMyoga ityanenoktam| tathA saMyujyamAnAnAmapi pRuthaktvaM vijAtIyAnAM mahiShavarAhAdInAM, tadAha- vailakShaNyamityAdi|- vishiShTalakShaNayuktatvalakShitaM vijAtIyAnAM pRuthaktvamityarthaH| tathaikajAtIyAnAmapyavilakShaNAnAM mAShANAM pRuthaktvaM bhavatItyAha- anekateti| ekajAtIyeShu hi saMyukteShu na vailakShaNyaM nApyasaMyogaH, atha cAnekatA pRuthaktvarUpA bhavatIti bhAvaH| kiMvA, pRuthaktvaM guNAntaramicchan lokavyavahArArthamasaMyogavailakShaNyAnekatArUpameva yathodAhRutaM pRuthaktvaM darshayati | mAnaM prasthADhakAditulAdimeyam| karaNaM guNAntarAdhAyakatvaM saMskaraNamityarthaH; yadvakShyati- “saMskAro hi guNAntarAdhAnamucyate” (vi. 1) iti| bhAvasya ShaShTikAdervyAyAmAdeshcAbhyasanamabhyAsaH| abhyasanameva lokaprasiddhAbhyAM paryAyAbhyAM vivRuNoti- shIlanaM satatakriyeti; yaM lokAH shIlanasatatakriyAbhyAmabhidadhati so~abhyAsa iti bhAvaH| ayaM ca saMyogasaMskAravisheSharUpo~api visheSheNa cikitsopayuktatvAt pRuthagucyate| na yathAvat pravartata iti vacanena shabdAdiShu ca gurvAdiShu ca parAdInAmaprAdhAnyaM sUcayati||29-35||

teShAmiti madhurapAkAdInAM, rasopadesheneti rasamAtrakathanenaiva, yato vipAko~api rasata eva prAyo j~jAyate; yadvakShyati- ‘kaTutiktakaShAyANAM vipAkaH prAyashaH kaTuH’ ityAdi| etacca na sarvatretyAha- vIryata ityAdi| vIryato~aviparItAnAM rasadvArA vIryaj~jAnaM, na tu rasaviruddhavIryANAM mahApa~jcamUlAdInAM; na kevalaM rasena kintarhi pAkatashca ya upadekShyate guNasa~ggrahaH ‘shukrahA baddhaviNmUtro vipAko vAtalaH kaTuH’ ityAdinA, sa ca vIryato~aviruddhAnAM vij~jeyaH; yadi tatra vIryaM virodhi bhavati tadA vipAko~api yathoktaguNakArI na syAt| kiMvA, pAkatashcAviparItAnAM rasopadeshena guNasa~ggrahaH shItoShNalakShaNo nirdeshyaH, yasyAstu pippalyAH kaTukAyA api viparItamadhurapAkitvaM, na tatra kaTurasatvenoShNatvamityarthaH| asmiMshca pakShe ‘upadekShyate’ iti ‘yathA payaH’ ityAdinA sambadhyate| tAnyevAviparItavIryavipAkAnyAha- yathA paya ityAdi| payaHprabhRutIni hi dravyaguNakathane~aviruddhavIryavipAkAnyupadeShTavyAni||46-47||

samprati yatra viruddhavIryatvena rasenoShNatvAdi na nirdeshyaM tadAha- madhuramityAdi| ki~jcit kaShAyaM coShNaM tiktaM coShNamiti yojanA, kaShAyatiktalavaNAnAmudAharaNamasUtritAnAmapi prakaraNAt kRutam| mahatpa~jcamUlaM bilvAdipa~jcamUlamiha| etacca tiktasya kaShAyasya coShNatAyAmudAharaNam, abjAnUpAmiShaM tu madhurasyoShNavIryatve||48-49||
vIryaprasa~ggAdanyamapyamlAdInAM viruddhaguNamAha- ki~jcidityAdi| abhayAyAmato~anyatheti abhayAyAM kaShAyo raso bhedanashcoShNashcetyarthaH||50-52||

raukShyAdityAdi| raukShyeNa kaShAya uttama iti rUkShatamaH, tikto rUkShaH, kaTustu madhyo rUkShataraH; evamanyatrApi| kaTukashcAntya iti avara ityarthaH| evaM lavaNashcAntya iti avara ityarthaH| lavaNo~avara iti gurutvenetyarthaH| amlAt kaTurityAdau amlAt kaTurlaghuH, tataH kaTukAduttamAttikto laghutvenottamottamaH; uttamAt kaTukAduttama uttamottamaH| ekIyamatamAha- kecidityAdi| ekIyamataM vacanabha~ggyA svIkurvannAha- gaurava ityAdi| etena, gaurave lAghave cAvaratvaM lavaNasya svIkurvan gaurave~avara ityanenAmlakaTutiktebhyo gurutvaM svIkaroti lavaNasya, lAghave cAvara ityanenAmlAdapi laghuno~alpaM lAghavaM lavaNasya svIkaroti| na ca vAcyam- amle pRuthivI kAraNaM lavaNe tu toyaM, tataH pRuthivyapekShayA toyajanyasya lavaNasyaiva lAghavamucitamiti; yato na bhUtaniveshena gauravalAghave shakyete~avadhArayituM, tathAhi toyAtirekakRuto madhuraH pRuthivyatirekakRutAt kaShAyAdgururbhavati||53-56||-

samprati vipAkasyApi rasarUpatvAllakShaNamAha- paramityAdi| prAyograhaNAt pippalIkulatthAdInAM rasAnanuguNapAkitAM darshayati| kaTukAdishabdena ca tadAdhAraM dravyamucyate, yato na rasAH pacyante kintu dravyameva| lavaNastatheti lavaNo~api madhuravipAkaH prAya ityarthaH| vipAkalakShaNaM tu- jaTharAgniyogAdAhArasya niShThAkAle yo guNa utpadyate sa vipAkaH; vacanaM hi- “jAThareNAgninA yogAdyadudeti rasAntaram| AhArapariNAmAnte sa vipAkaH prakIrtitaH” (vA. sU. 9)||57-58||

samprati vakShyamANavipAkalakShaNe madhurAmlapAkayorvAtamUtrapurIShAnavarodhakatve tathA kaTorvipAkasya vAtamUtrapurIShavibandhakatve hetumAha- madhura ityAdi| atra madhurAmlalavaNA niShThApAkaM gatA api santaH snehaguNayogAdvAtamUtrapurIShANAM visargaM sukhena kurvantIti vAkyArthaH| tena madhurAmlapAkayoretat samAnaM lakShaNam| evaM kaTutiktakaShAyeShvapi viparyaye~api vAkyArthaH||59-60||
samprati vipAkalakShaNaM hetuvyutpAditaM shukrahatvAdivisheShayuktaM vaktumAha- shukrahetyAdi| ato~anyatheti laghuH||61-62||

ekIyamatena vIryalakShaNamAha- mRudvityAdi| etaccaikIyamatadvayaM pAribhAShikIM vIryasa~jj~jAM puraskRutya pravRuttam| vaidyake hi rasavipAkaprabhAvavyatirikte prabhUtakAryakAriNI guNe vIryamati sa~jj~jA, tenAShTavidhavIryavAdimate picchilavishadAdayo guNA na rasAdiviparItaM kAryaM prAyaH kurvanti, tena teShAM rasAdyupadeshenaiva grahaNaM; mRudvAdInAM tu rasAdyabhibhAvakatvamasti, yathA- pippalyAM kaTurasakAryaM pittakopanamabhibhUya tadgate mRudushItavIrye pittameva shamayata iti, tathA kaShAye tiktAnurase mahati pa~jcamUle tatkAryaM vAtakopanamabhibhUyoShNena vIryeNa tadviruddhaM vAtashamanameva kriyate, tathA madhure~apIkShau shItavIryatvena vAtavRuddhirityAdi| yaduktaM sushrute- “etAni khalu vIryANi svabalaguNotkarShAdrasamabhibhUyAtmakarma darshayanti ” (su. sU. 40) ityAdi| shItoShNavIryavAdimataM tvagnIShomIyatvAjjagataH shItoShNayoreva prAdhAnyAjj~jeyam| uktaM ca “nAnA~a~atmakamapi dravyamagnIShomau mahAbalau| vyaktAvyaktaM jagadiva nAtikrAmati jAtucit” (vA. sU. 9) iti| etacca matadvayamapyAcAryasya paribhAShAsiddhamanumatameva, yenottaratra “rasavIryavipAkAnAM sAmAnyaM yatra lakShyate” ityAdau pAribhAShikameva vIryaM nirdekShyati| pAribhAShikavIryasa~jj~jAparityAgena tu shaktiparyAyasya vIryasya lakShaNamAha- vIryaM tvityAdi | vIryamiti shaktiH| yeneti rasena vA vipAkena vA prabhAveNa vA gurvAdiparAdibhirvA guNairyA kriyA tarpaNahlAdanashamanAdirUpA kriyate , tasyAM kriyAyAM tad rasAdi vIryam| ata evoktaM sushrute- “yena kurvanti tadvIryam” (su. sU. 40) iti| atraiva lokaprasiddhAmupapattimAha- nAvIryamityAdi | avIryam ashaktamityarthaH| vIryakRuteti vIryavatA kRutA vIryakRutA||64-65||

asyaiva durabhigamatvAdudAharaNAni bahUnyAha- kaTuka ityAdinA| tadvaditi citrakasamAnaguNA | viShaghnamuktamiti “tasmAddaMShTrAviShaM maulaM” (ci. 23) ityAdinA| UrdhvAnulomikamiti yugapadubhayabhAgaharaM, kiMvA UrdhvaharaM tathA~anulomaharaM ca| karma yadvividhAtmakamiti viShaharaNashUlaharaNAdi| etaccodAharaNamAtraM, tena jIvanamedhyAdidravyasya rasAdyacintyaM sarvaM ‘prabhAva’ iti j~jeyam| prabhAvashceha dravyashaktirabhipretA, sA ca dravyANAM sAmAnyavisheShaH dantItvAdiyuktA vyaktireva, yataH shaktirhi svarUpameva bhAvAnAM, nAtiriktaM ki~jciddharmAntaram; evaM pradeshAntaroktaguNaprabhAvAdiShvapi vAcyam; yathoktaM- ‘dravyANi hi dravyaprabhAvAdguNaprabhAvAt’ ityAdi| na ca vAcyaM dantyAdiH svarUpata eva virecayati, tena kimiti jalAdyupahatA dantI na virecayatIti; pratibandhakAbhAvavishiShTasyaiva prabhAvasya kAraNatvAt, jalopahatAyAM dantyAM jalopaghAtaH pratibandhaka ityAdyanusaraNIyam| naiyAyikashaktivAde yA ca viShasya viShaghnatve upapattiruktA UrdhvAdhogAmitvavirodhalakShaNA sA~antarbhAgatvAt prabhAvAdeva bhavati| evamUrdhvAnulomikatvAdau pArthivatvAdikathane~api vAcyam||68-72||-
vij~jAyate~aneneti vij~jAnaM lakShaNamityarthaH| pralIyanniti vilIno bhavan | saMsrAvayatIti saMsrAvI| vikAsIti hRudayavikasanashIlaH; uktaM hi sushrute- “hRudayaM pIDayati” (su. sU. 42) iti||74-79||

vairodhikamadhikRutyeti vairodhikamuddishya| shItoShNatvAditi payaH shItamuShNavIryAshca matsyAH, sheShaM madhuratvAdi samAnam| etacca dravyaprabhAvAdeva virodhi| ‘sa punaH shakalI’ ityAdinA ‘nAndiniH’ iti khyAto matsya ucyate||82-83||
yaccApi deshakAlAgnItyAdigranthaM kecit paThanti, sa ca vyakta eva||86-101||

ShANDhyaM napuMsakatA| santAnadoSho mRutavatsatvAdiH| etacca vairodhikakathanaM visheShavacanena bAdhyate; tena lashunasya kShIreNa pAnaM kvacinna virodhi; yaduktaM- “sAdhayecchuddhashuShkasya lashunasya catuShpalam| kShIrodake~aShTaguNite kShIrasheShaM ca pAyayet” (ci.a.5), tathA “mUlakasvarasaM kShIraM” ityAdiprayogeShUnneyam| kiMvA, anekadravyasaMyogAdatra virodhinAmavirodhaH; virodhimAtrasaMyoga eva virodhI bhavati| yatu madhuna uShNena vamanena saMyuktasya satyapi madanaphalAdidravyasaMyoge~avirodhArthamuktamapakvagamanAdi, tanmadhuno dravyAntarasaMyoge~apyuShNasambandhatve virodhitvopadarshanArthaM; yato viShAnvayaM madhu, viShasya coShNavirodhi| lashunAdInAM tu dravyAntarAsaMyoge satyeva melako viruddha iti shAstravacanAdunnIyate||102-103||

tadvirodhinAmiti ShADhyAdiharANAm| tathAvidhairiti viruddhAhArajavyAdhiviruddhaiH| abhisaMskAra iti satatopayogena sharIrabhAvanam| kiMvA tathAvidhairiti rasAyanaprayogaiH| etaccAnAgatAbAdhacikitsitaM j~jeyam||104-106||

sa~ggrahe dravyasa~gkhyA rasAshrayA iti ‘bhedashcaiShAM’ ityAdinA; rasasa~gkhyA hi paramArthato dravyasa~gkhyaiva, nirguNatvAdrasAnAmiti bhAvaH| kAraNaM rasasa~gkhyAyA iti ‘rasAnAM tatra yogyatvAt’ ityAdinA| vibhaktayo bhedaH ‘tatra madhura’ ityAdinA| uddesho dravyANAM ‘shItaM vIryeNa’ ityAdinA, apavAdo dravyANAM ‘madhuraM ki~jcit’ ityAdinA||107-113||

munimataiH pUrvapakShaM kRutvA siddhAntavyavasthApanaM shiShyavyutpattyartham| rasenAhAravinishcayo rasAhAravinishcayaH; kiMvA ayaM rasavinishcayaH, tathA ‘paraM cAto vipAkAnAM’ ityAdirAhAravinishcayaH ||3-7||
athAto~annapAnavidhimadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
kelUTaM ca kadambaM ca nadImAShakamaindukam| vishadaM guru shItaM ca samabhiShyandi cocyate||114||
utpalAni kaShAyANi raktapittaharANi ca| tathA tAlapralambaM syAduraHkShatarujApaham||115||
kharjUraM tAlashasyaM ca raktapittakShayApaham| tarUTabisashAlUkakrau~jcAdanakasherukam||116||
shRu~ggATakA~gkaloDyaM ca guru viShTambhi shItalam| kumudotpalanAlAstu sapuShpAH saphalAH smRutAH||117||
shItAH svAdukaShAyAstu kaphamArutakopanAH| kaShAyamIShadviShTambhi raktapittaharaM smRutam||118||
pauShkaraM tu bhavedbIjaM madhuraM rasapAkayoH| balyaH shIto guruH snigdhastarpaNo bRuMhaNAtmakaH||119||
vAtapittaharaH svAdurvRuShyo mu~jjAtakaH param| jIvano bRuMhaNo vRuShyaH kaNThyaH shasto rasAyane||120||
vidArikando balyashca mUtralaH svAdushItalaH| amlikAyAH smRutaH kando grahaNyarshohito laghuH||121||
nAtyuShNaH kaphavAtaghno grAhI shasto madAtyaye| tridoShaM baddhaviNmUtraM sArShapaM shAkamucyate||122||
(tadvat syAdraktanAlasya rUkShamamlaM visheShataH|) tadvat piNDAlukaM vidyAt kandatvAcca mukhapriyam| sarpacchatrakavarjyAstu bahvyo~anyAshchatrajAtayaH||123||
shItAH pInasakartryashca madhurA gurvya eva ca| caturthaH shAkavargo~ayaM patrakandaphalAshrayaH||124||
iti shAkavargashcaturthaH
iti shAkavargashcaturthaH atha phalavargaH- tRuShNAdAhajvarashvAsaraktapittakShatakShayAn| vAtapittamudAvartaM svarabhedaM madAtyayam||125||
tiktAsyatAmAsyashoShaM kAsaM cAshu vyapohati| mRudvIkA bRuMhaNI vRuShyA madhurA snigdhashItalA||126||
madhuraM bRuMhaNaM vRuShyaM kharjUraM guru shItalam| kShaye~abhighAte dAhe ca vAtapitte ca taddhitam||127||
tarpaNaM bRuMhaNaM phalgu guru viShTambhi shItalam| parUShakaM madhUkaM ca vAtapitte ca shasyate||128||
madhuraM bRuMhaNaM balyamAmrAtaM tarpaNaM guru| sasnehaM shleShmalaM shItaM vRuShyaM viShTabhya jIryati||129||
tAlashasyAni siddhAni nArikelaphalAni ca| bRuMhaNasnigdhashItAni balyAni madhurANi ca||130||
madhurAmlakaShAyaM ca viShTambhi guru shItalam| pittashleShmakaraM bhavyaM grAhi vakravishodhanam||131||
amlaM parUShakaM drAkShA badarANyArukANi ca| pittashleShmaprakopINi karkandhunikucAnyapi||132||
nAtyuShNaM guru sampakvaM svAduprAyaM mukhapriyam| bRuMhaNaM jIryati kShipraM nAtidoShalamArukam||133||
dvividhaM shItamuShNaM ca madhuraM cAmlameva ca| guru pArAvataM j~jeyamarucyatyagninAshanam||134||
bhavyAdalpAntaraguNaM kAshmaryaphalamucyate| tathaivAlpAntaraguNaM tUdamamlaM parUShakAt||135||
kaShAyamadhuraM Ta~gkaM vAtalaM guru shItalam| kapitthamAmaM kaNThaghnaM viShaghnaM grAhi vAtalam ||136||
madhurAmlakaShAyatvAt saugandhyAcca rucipradam| paripakvaM ca doShaghnaM viShaghnaM grAhi gurvapi||137||
bilvaM tu durjaraM pakvaM doShalaM pUtimArutam| snigdhoShNatIkShNaM tadbAlaM dIpanaM kaphavAtajit||138||
raktapittakaraM bAlamApUrNaM pittavardhanam| pakvamAmraM jayedvAyuM mAMsashukrabalapradam||139||
kaShAyamadhuraprAyaM guru viShTambhi shItalam| jAmbavaM kaphapittaghnaM grAhi vAtakaraM param||140||
badaraM madhuraM snigdhaM bhedanaM vAtapittajit| tacchuShkaM kaphavAtaghnaM pitte na ca virudhyate||141||
kaShAyamadhuraM shItaM grAhi simbi(~jci)tikAphalam| gA~ggerukI karIraM ca bimbI todanadhanvanam||142||
madhuraM sakaShAyaM ca shItaM pittakaphApaham| sampakvaM panasaM mocaM rAjAdanaphalAni ca||143||
svAdUni sakaShAyANi snigdhashItagurUNi ca| kaShAyavishadatvAcca saugandhyAcca rucipradam||144||
avadaMshakShamaM hRudyaM vAtalaM lavalIphalam| nIpaM shatAhvakaM pIlu tRuNashUnyaM vika~gkatam||145||
prAcInAmalakaM caiva doShaghnaM garahAri ca| ai~ggudaM tiktamadhuraM snigdhoShNaM kaphavAtajit||146||
tindukaM kaphapittaghnaM kaShAyaM madhuraM laghu| vidyAdAmalake sarvAn rasAMllavaNavarjitAn||147||
rUkShaM svAdu kaShAyAmlaM kaphapittaharaM param| rasAsRu~gmAMsamedojAndoShAn hanti bibhItakam||148||
svarabhedakaphotkledapittarogavinAshanam| amlaM kaShAyamadhuraM vAtaghnaM grAhi dIpanam||149||
snigdhoShNaM dADimaM hRudyaM kaphapittAvirodhi ca| rUkShAmlaM dADimaM yattu tat pittAnilakopanam||150||
madhuraM pittanutteShAM pUrvaM dADimamuttamam| vRukShAmlaM grAhi rUkShoShNaM vAtashleShmaNi shasyate||151||
amlikAyAH phalaM pakvaM tasmAdalpAntaraM guNaiH| guNaistaireva saMyuktaM bhedanaM tvamlavetasam||152||
shUle~arucau vibandhe ca mande~agnau madyaviplave | hikkAshvAse ca kAse ca vamyAM varcogadeShu ca||153||
vAtashleShmasamuttheShu sarveShvevopadishyate| kesaraM mAtulu~ggasya laghu sheShamato~anyathA||154||
rocano dIpano hRudyaH sugandhistvagvivarjitaH| karcUraH kaphavAtaghnaH shvAsahikkArshasAM hitaH||155||
madhuraM ki~jcidamlaM ca hRudyaM bhaktaprarocanam| durjaraM vAtashamanaM nAgara~ggaphalaM guru ||156||
vAtAmAbhiShukAkShoTamukUlakanikocakAH| gurUShNasnigdhamadhurAH sorumANA balapradAH||157||
vAtaghnA bRuMhaNA vRuShyAH kaphapittAbhivardhanAH| priyAlameShAM sadRushaM vidyAdauShNyaM vinA guNaiH||158||
shleShmalaM madhuraM shItaM shleShmAtakaphalaM guru| shleShmalaM guru viShTambhi cA~gkoTaphalamagnijit||159||
gurUShNaM madhuraM rUkShaM keshaghnaM ca shamIphalam| viShTambhayati kAra~jjaM vAtashleShmAvirodhi ca||160||
AmrAtakaM dantashaThamamlaM sakaramardakam| raktapittakaraM vidyAdairAvatakameva ca||161||
vAtaghnaM dIpanaM caiva vArtAkaM kaTu tiktakam| vAtalaM kaphapittaghnaM vidyAt parpaTakIphalam||162||
pittashleShmaghnamamlaM ca vAtalaM cAkShikIphalam| madhurANyamlapAkIni pittashleShmaharANi ca||163||
ashvatthodumbaraplakShanyagrodhAnAM phalAni ca| kaShAyamadhurAmlAni vAtalAni gurUNi ca||164||
bhallAtakAsthyagnisamaM tanmAMsaM svAdu shItalam| pa~jcamaH phalavargo~ayamuktaH prAyopayogikaH||165||
iti phalavargaH
shItaH snigdho~aguruH svAdustridoShaghnaH sthirAtmakaH| ShaShTikaH pravaro gauraH kRuShNagaurastato~anu ca||13||
varakoddAlakau cInashAradojjvaladardurAH| gandhanAH kuruvindAshca ShaShTikAlpAntarA guNaiH||14||
madhurashcAmlapAkashca vrIhiH pittakaro guruH| bahumUtrapurIShoShmA tridoShastveva pATalaH||15||
sakoradUShaH shyAmAkaH kaShAyamadhuro laghuH| vAtalaH kaphapittaghnaH shItaH sa~ggrAhishoShaNaH||16||
hastishyAmAkanIvAratoyaparNIgavedhukAH| prashAntikAmbhaHshyAmAkalauhityANupriya~ggavaH ||17||
mukundo jhiNTigarmUTI varukA varakAstathA| shibirotkaTajUrNAhvAH shyAmAkasadRushA guNaiH||18||
rUkShaH shIto~aguruH svAdurbahuvAtashakRudyavaH| sthairyakRut sakaShAyashca balyaH shleShmavikAranut||19||
rUkShaH kaShAyAnuraso madhuraH kaphapittahA| medaHkrimiviShaghnashca balyo veNuyavo mataH||20||
iti phalavargaH atha haritavargaH- rocanaM dIpanaM vRuShyamArdrakaM vishvabheShajam| vAtashleShmavibandheShu rasastasyopadishyate||166||
rocano dIpanastIkShNaH sugandhirmukhashodhanaH| jambIraH kaphavAtaghnaH krimighno bhaktapAcanaH||167||
bAlaM doShaharaM, vRuddhaM tridoShaM, mArutApaham| snigdhasiddhaM, vishuShkaM tu mUlakaM kaphavAtajit||168||
hikkAkAsaviShashvAsapArshvashUlavinAshanaH| pittakRut kaphavAtaghnaH surasaH pUtigandhahA||169||
yavAnI cArjakashcaiva shigrushAleyamRuShTakam| hRudyAnyAsvAdanIyAni pittamutkleshayanti ca||170||
puMstvaghnaH kaTurUkShoShNo bhUstRuNo vakrashodhanaH| kharAhvA kaphavAtaghnI bastirogarujApahA||171||
dhAnyakaM cAjagandhA ca sumukhashceti rocanAH| sugandhA nAtikaTukA doShAnutkleshayanti ca||173||
grAhI gRu~jjanakastIkShNo vAtashleShmArshasAM hitaH| svedane~abhyavahAre ca yojayettamapittinAm||174||
shleShmalo mArutaghnashca palANDurna ca pittanut | AhArayogI balyashca gururvRuShyo~atha rocanaH||175||
krimikuShThakilAsaghno vAtaghno gulmanAshanaH| snigdhashcoShNashca vRuShyashca lashunaH kaTuko guruH||176||
shuShkANi kaphavAtaghnAnyetAnyeShAM phalAni ca| haritAnAmayaM caiSha ShaShTho vargaH samApyate||177||
iti shamIdhAnyavargo dvitIyaH
sandhAnakRudvAtaharo godhUmaH svAdushItalaH| jIvano bRuMhaNo vRuShyaH snigdhaH sthairyakaro guruH||21||
nAndImukhI madhUlI ca madhurasnigdhashItale| ityayaM shUkadhAnyAnAM pUrvo vargaH samApyate||22||
ityAhArayogivargo dvAdashaH

iti haritavargaH atha madyavargaH- prakRutyA madyamamloShNamamlaM coktaM vipAkataH| sarvaM sAmAnyatastasya visheSha upadekShyate||178||

Commentary: annamabhidhAya pAnaM vaktavyaM, tatrApi pAnapradhAnamapi pAnIyamulla~gghya harShAdikartRutvAjjanAnAM mukhyapeyatvAcca madyamAha| prakRutyeti svabhAvAt| yadyapi ca madye pIyamAne nAmlarasatA pratIyate vyaktA, tathA~api dantaharShamukhasrAvAdyamlakAryakartRutvAdamlameva| vacanaM hi- “madhurANi madhuraprabhAvANi madhurANyeva kRutvopadekShyAmaH, tathetarANyapi” (vi. 8) iti| tena, amlaprabhAvasya madyasyAmlarasatvameva; ata evoktaM- “sarveShAM madyamamlAnAmuparyupari vartate” (ci. 24) iti| vipAkata iti tRutIyAyAM tasiH||178||
kRushAnAM saktamUtrANAM grahaNyarshovikAriNAm| surA prashastA vAtaghnI stanyaraktakShayeShu ca||179||
hikkAshvAsapratishyAyakAsavarcograhArucau| vamyAnAhavibandheShu vAtaghnI madirA hitA||180||
shUlapravAhikATopakaphavAtArshasAM hitaH| jagalo grAhirUkShoShNaH shophaghno bhaktapAcanaH||181||
shoShArshograhaNIdoShapANDurogArucijvarAn| hantyariShTaH kaphakRutAn rogAnrocanadIpanaH ||182||
mukhapriyaH sukhamadaH sugandhirbastiroganut | jaraNIyaH pariNato hRudyo varNyashca shArkaraH||183||
rocano dIpano hRudyaH shoShashophArshasAM hitaH| snehashleShmavikAraghno varNyaH pakvaraso mataH||184||
jaraNIyo vibandhaghnaH svaravarNavishodhanaH| lekhanaH shItarasiko hitaH shophodarArshasAm||185||
sRuShTabhinnashakRudvAto gauDastarpaNadIpanaH| pANDurogavraNahitA dIpanI cAkShikI matA ||186||
surAsavastIvramado vAtaghno vadanapriyaH| chedI madhvAsavastIkShNo maireyo madhuro guruH||187||
dhAtakyA~abhiShuto hRudyo rUkSho rocanadIpanaH| mAdhvIkavanna cAtyuShNo mRudvIkekShurasAsavaH||188||
rocanaM dIpanaM hRudyaM balyaM pittAvirodhi ca| vibandhaghnaM kaphaghnaM ca madhu laghvalpamArutam||189||
surA samaNDA rUkShoShNA yavAnAM vAtapittalA| gurvI jIryati viShTabhya shleShmalA tu madhUlikA||190||
dIpanaM jaraNIyaM ca hRutpANDukrimiroganut| grahaNyarshohita bhedi sauvIrakatuShodakam||191||
dAhajvarApahaM sparshAt pAnAdvAtakaphApaham| vibandhaghnamavasraMsi dIpanaM cAmlakA~jjikam||192||
prAyasho~abhinavaM madyaM gurudoShasamIraNam| srotasAM shodhanaM jIrNaM dIpanaM laghu rocanam||193||
harShaNaM prINanaM madyaM bhayashokashramApaham| prAgalbhyavIryapratibhAtuShTipuShTibalapradam||194||
sAttvikairvidhivadyuktyA pItaM syAdamRutaM yathA| vargo~ayaM saptamo madyamadhikRutya prakIrtitaH||195||
iti madyavargaH saptamaH
atha shamIdhAnyavargaH- kaShAyamadhuro rUkShaH shItaH pAke kaTurlaghuH| vishadaH shleShmapittaghno mudgaH sUpyottamo mataH||23||
vRuShyaH paraM vAtaharaH snigdhoShNo madhuro guruH| balyo bahumalaH puMstvaM mAShaH shIghraM dadAti ca||24||
rAjamAShaH saro rucyaH kaphashukrAmlapittanut| tatsvAdurvAtalo rUkShaH kaShAyo vishado guruH||25||
uShNAH kaShAyAH pAke~amlAH kaphashukrAnilApahAH| kulatthA grAhiNaH kAsahikkAshvAsArshasAM hitAH||26||
madhurA madhurAH pAke grAhiNo rUkShashItalAH| makuShThakAH prashasyante raktapittajvarAdiShu||27||
caNakAshca masUrAshca khaNDikAH sahareNavaH| laghavaH shItamadhurAH sakaShAyA virUkShaNAH||28||
pittashleShmaNi shasyante sUpeShvAlepaneShu ca| teShAM masUraH sa~ggrAhI kalAyo vAtalaH param||29||
snigdhoShNo madhurastiktaH kaShAyaH kaTukastilaH| tvacyaH keshyashca balyashca vAtaghnaH kaphapittakRut||30||
madhurAH shItalA gurvyo balaghnyo rUkShaNAtmikAH| sasnehA balibhirbhojyA vividhAH shimbijAtayaH||31||
shimbI rUkShA kaShAyA ca koShThe vAtaprakopinI| na ca vRuShyA na cakShuShyA viShTabhya ca vipacyate||32||
ADhakI kaphapittaghnI vAtalA, kaphavAtanut| avalgujaH saiDagajo, niShpAvA vAtapittalAH||33||
kAkANDomA(lA)tmaguptAnAM mAShavat phalamAdishet| dvitIyo~ayaM shamIdhAnyavargaH prokto maharShiNA||34||

iti madyavargaH saptamaH atha jalavargaH- jalamekavidhaM sarvaM patatyaindraM nabhastalAt|196|

Commentary: ekavidhatve~api tasya bhedahetumAha- tat patadityAdi| patad deshamAkAshagatabhUtarUpaM, kAlaM ca shItoShNAdirUpaM; tathapatitaM ca bhUmivisheSharUpaM deshaM, kAlaM ca tathaivApekShate; ‘guNadoShA sambandhe ’ iti sheShaH||196||

khAt patat somavAyvarkaiH spRuShTaM kAlAnuvartibhiH| shItoShNasnigdharUkShAdyairyathAsannaM mahIguNaiH||197||

Commentary: enameva deshakAlasambandhamAha- khAdityAdi| somagrahaNena saumyatvAt pRuthivyA api gaganagatadhUlIrUpAyAstathA meghasahacaritalUtAdiviShAdirUpAyAshca grahaNaM vaktavyaM; kiMvA vAyugrahaNAdeva vAyunA nIyamAnAyAH pRuthivyA grahaNam| spRuShTaM ‘bhavati’ itisheShaH| kAlAnuvartibhiriti kAlaparAdhInaiH; etena kAlakRuta eva somAdisambandhavisheSho jale visheShaM karoti, tena na kAlasyAki~jcitkaratA| patitajalasya deshakAlasambandhamAha- shItoShNetyAdi| yathAsannamiti yasmin kAle yasyAM mahyAM ye guNAH shItAdaya udriktA bhavanti, taiH spRuShTaM jalaM bhavati| etena sushrute pratipAditagA~ggasAmudrabhedo guNadoShasambandhamAtrakRuta eva divyajalasyeti darshayati| tena, yadviShAdijuShTaM tat sAmudrasamAnaguNatvAt sAmudraM, yaddhUlyAdinA viShAdinA ca rahitaM tattadguNatvAdgA~ggamityuktaM sushrute| Ashvine tu mAsi divyajalasya dhUlIviShAdisambandho na bhavatyeva, kAlamahimnA bhavannapi vA na jalaM tathA dUShayati; ata uktaM sUshrute- “sAmudraM tanna pAtavyaM mAsAdAshvayujAdvinA” (su. sU. 45) iti| atra hArItavacanAt kArtikAgrahAyaNayorapyAntarIkShaM jalaM grAhyameva bhavati; yadAha- “pravRuttAyAM sharadyasmAt pashcAdvAte pravAti ca| hemante cApi gRuhnIyAttajjalaM mRunmayairghaTaiH” iti| tena ‘AshvayujAdvinA’ iti vacanaM AshvayujAt prabhRuti jalopAdeyatopadarshanArthaM, na tvAshvina evopAdeyatopadarshanaparam| anye tvAhuH- Ashvina eva paramAntarIkShaM grAhyamiti| jatUkarNavacanaM hi- “varShAsu caranti ghanaiH sahoragA viyati kITalUtAshca| tadviShajuShTamapeyaM khajalamagastyodayAt pUrvam” iti||197||

...bhraShTaM pAtramapekShate||198||

Commentary: divyajalasya prAkRutaguNamAha- shItamityAdi| shivamiti kalyANakaratvena| mRuShTamiti vadanapriyatvena|198|-
shvete kaShAyaM bhavati pANDare syAttu tiktakam| kapile kShArasaMsRuShTamUShare lavaNAnvitam||199||
kaTu parvatavistAre madhuraM kRuShNamRuttike| etat ShADguNyamAkhyAtaM mahIsthasya jalasya hi| tathA~avyaktarasaM vidyAdaindraM kAraM himaM ca yat||200||
yadantarIkShAt patatIndrasRuShTaM coktaishca pAtraiH parigRuhyate~ambhaH| tadaindramityeva vadanti dhIrA narendrapeyaM salilaM pradhAnam ||201||
IShatkaShAyamadhuraM susUkShmaM vishadaM laghu| arUkShamanabhiShyandi sarvaM pAnIyamuttamam||202||
gurvabhiShyandi pAnIyaM vArShikaM madhuraM navam| tanu laghvanabhiShyandi prAyaH sharadi varShati||203||
tattu ye sukumArAH syuH snigdhabhUyiShThabhojanAH| teShAM bhojye ca bhakShye ca lehye peye ca shasyate||204||
