hemante salilaM snigdhaM vRuShyaM balahitaM guru| ki~jcittato laghutaraM shishire kaphavAtajit||205||
kaShAyamadhuraM rUkShaM vidyAdvAsantikaM jalam| graiShmikaM tvanabhiShyandi jalamityeva nishcayaH| RutAvRutAvihAkhyAtAH sarva evAmbhaso guNAH||206||
vibhrAnteShu tu kAleShu yat prayacchanti toyadAH| salilaM tattu doShAya yujyate nAtra saMshayaH||207||
rAjabhI rAjamAtraishca sukumAraishca mAnavaiH| sugRuhItAH sharadyApaH prayoktavyA visheShataH||208||
nadyaH pAShANavicchinnavikShubdhAbhihatodakAH | himavatprabhavAH pathyAH puNyA devarShisevitAH||209||
nadyaH pAShANasikatAvAhinyo vimalodakAH| malayaprabhavA yAshca jalaM tAsvamRutopamam||210||
pashcimAbhimukhA yAshca pathyAstA nirmalodakAH| prAyo mRuduvahA gurvyo yAshca pUrvasamudragAH||211||
pAriyAtrabhavA yAshca vindhyasahyabhavAshca yAH| shirohRudrogakuShThAnAM tA hetuH shlIpadasya ca||212||
vasudhAkITasarpAkhumalasandUShitodakAH| varShAjalavahA nadyaH sarvadoShasamIraNAH||213||
vApIkUpataDAgotsasaraHprasravaNAdiShu| AnUpashailadhanvAnAM guNadoShairvibhAvayet||214||
picchilaM krimilaM klinnaM parNashaivAlakardamaiH| vivarNaM virasaM sAndraM durgandhaM na hitaM jalam||215||
visraM tridoShaM lavaNamambu yadvaruNAlayam| ityambuvargaH prokto~ayamaShTamaH suvinishcitaH||216||
iti jalavargo~aShTamaH
iti jalavargo~aShTamaH atha gorasavargaH- svAdu shItaM mRudu snigdhaM bahalaM shlakShNapicchilam| guru mandaM prasannaM ca gavyaM dashaguNaM payaH||217||
tadeva~gguNamevaujaH sAmAnyAdabhivardhayet| pravaraM jIvanIyAnAM kShIramuktaM rasAyanam||218||
mahiShINAM gurutaraM gavyAcchItataraM payaH| snehAnyUnamanidrAya hitamatyagnaye ca tat||219||
rUkShoShNaM kShIramuShTrINAmIShatsalavaNaM laghu| shastaM vAtakaphAnAhakrimishophodarArshasAm||220||
balyaM sthairyakaraM sarvamuShNaM caikashaphaM payaH| sAmlaM salavaNaM rUkShaM shAkhAvAtaharaM laghu||221||
chAgaM kaShAyamadhuraM shItaM grAhi payo laghu| raktapittAtisAraghnaM kShayakAsajvarApaham||222||
hikkAshvAsakaraM tUShNaM pittashleShmalamAvikam| hastinInAM payo balyaM guru sthairyakaraM param||223||
jIvanaM bRuMhaNaM sAtmyaM snehanaM mAnuShaM payaH| nAvanaM raktapitte ca tarpaNaM cAkShishUlinAm||224||

iShTavarNagandharasasparshaM vidhivihitamannapAnaM prANinAM prANisa~jj~jakAnAM prANamAcakShate kushalAH, pratyakShaphaladarshanAt; tadindhanA hyantaragneH sthitiH; tat sattvamUrjayati, taccharIradhAtuvyUhabalavarNendriyaprasAdakaraM yathoktamupasevyamAnaM, viparItamahitAya sampadyate||3||

Commentary: kiM tadannapAnaM karotItyAha- iShTetyAdi| iShTamiti abhimataM hitaM ca; kiMvA iShTaM priyaM, hitaM tu vidhivihitashabdenaiva prApyate| vidhirvakShyamANarasavimAne “tadetadAhAravidhAnama” (vi. 1) ityAdigranthavAcyaH, tathendriyopakramaNIye ca “nAratnapANiH” (sU. 8) ityAdinoktaM vidhAnaM; tena vidhinA vihitaM vidhivihitam| atra varNAdiShu shabdAgrahaNamannapAne prAyaH shabdasyAvidyamAnatvAt| varNAdiShu yadyat prathamamannapAne guhyate, tattat pUrvamuktam| rasastu sparshasya pashcAdgRuhyamANo~api prAdhAnyakhyApanArthaM sparshasyAgre kRutaH| prANinAmityanenaiva labdhe~api “prANisa~jj~jakAnAm” iti vacanaM sthAvaraprANipratiShedhArthaM; vRukShAdayo hi vanaspatisattvAnukAropadeshAcchAstre prANina uktAH; natu loke prANisa~jj~jakAH, kintarhi ja~ggamA eva| iha ca manuShyasyaivAdhikRutatve~api sAmAnyena sakalaprANiprANahetutayA~a~ahArakathanaM manuShyavyatirikte~api prANinyAhArasya prANajanakatvopadarshanArtham| prANamiti prANahetutvAt; yathA- AyurghRutam| atha kathaM tat prANamAcakShata ityAha- pratyakShaphaladarshanAditi |- pratyakSheNaiva hyAhAraM vidhinA kurvatAM prANA anuvartanta iti, tathA nirAhArANAM prANA nahyavatiShThanta iti dRushyata ityarthaH| pratyakShashabdashceha sphuTapramANe vartate, yataH prANAnAmannakAryatvamanumAnagamyameva| annakAryatva eva prANAnAM hetumAha- tadindhanA hItyAdinA| yasmAdantaragnisthitishcAnnapAnahetunA, agnisthitishca prANahetuH, tato~annaM prANA iti bhAvaH; uktaM hi- “balamArogyamAyushca prANAshcAgnau pratiShThitAH”| kiMvA, pUrvamannapAnasya prANahetutvamuktaM, tadindhanA hItyAdinA~agnihetutvaM varNyate| sattvamUrjayatIti manobalaM karoti| dhAtuvyUho dhAtusa~gghAtaH| viparItam avidhisevitam||3||
rocanaM dIpanaM vRuShyaM snehanaM balavardhanam| pAke~amlamuShNaM vAtaghnaM ma~ggalyaM bRuMhaNaM dadhi||225||
pInase cAtisAre ca shItake viShamajvare| arucau mUtrakRucchre ca kArshye ca dadhi shasyate||226||
sharadgrIShmavasanteShu prAyasho dadhi garhitam| raktapittakaphottheShu vikAreShvahitaM ca tat||227||

tridoShaM mandakaM, jAtaM vAtaghnaM dadhi, shukralaH| saraH, shleShmAnilaghnastu maNDaH srotovishodhanaH||228||

Commentary: mandakaM yadA kShIraM vikriyAmApannaM ghanatvaM na yAti tadA tanmandakam| jAtaM vAtaghnamiti yadA tu mandakAvasthAmutsRujya ghanatayA jAtaM sanmadhuramIShadamlaM ca bhavati, tadA vAtaghnaM visheSheNa bhavatItyarthaH| pUrve tu dadhiguNAH sujAtasya vyaktAmlasya boddhavyAH| shukralaH sara iti cchedaH| saro dadhyuparisnehaH, shukralaH shukrasrutivRuddhikaraH; ata eva sushrute saraguNe “vRuShyaH shukravivardhanaH” (su. sU. 45) iti padadvayopAdAnaM kRutam| maNDa iti prakaraNAddadhimaNDo mastvityarthaH||228||

shophArshograhaNIdoShamUtragrahodarArucau| snehavyApadi pANDutve takraM dadyAdgareShu ca||229||

Commentary: shophetyAdinA takraguNaH| mUtragraho mUtrakRucchrAdi| garo~atra kRutrimaviSham||229||

sa~ggrAhi dIpanaM hRudyaM navanItaM navoddhRutam| grahaNyarshovikAraghnamarditArucinAshanam||230||

Commentary: sa~ggrAhItyAdi navanItaguNaH| navoddhRutaM sadyaskaM; navoddhRutamiti vacanAdabhinavasyaiva navanItasya yathoktaguNAH prakarShavanto bhavanti, purANasya tu naite balavanto guNA bhavantIti||230||
smRutibuddhyagnishukraujaHkaphamedovivardhanam| vAtapittaviShonmAdashoShAlakShmIjvarApaham ||231||
sarvasnehottamaM shItaM madhuraM rasapAkayoH| sahasravIryaM vidhibhirghRutaM karmasahasrakRut||232||
madApasmAramUrcchAyashoShonmAdagarajvarAn| yonikarNashiraHshUlaM ghRutaM jIrNamapohati||233||
pIyUSho moraTaM caiva kilATA vividhAshca ye||234||
dIptAgnInAmanidrANAM sarva eva sukhapradAH| guravastarpaNA vRuShyA bRuMhaNAH pavanApahAH||235||
vishadA guravo rUkShA grAhiNastakrapiNDakAH| gorasAnAmayaM vargo navamaH parikIrtitaH||236||
iti gorasavargo navamaH

iti gorasavargo navamaH athekShuvargaH- vRuShyaH shItaH saraH snigdho bRuMhaNo madhuro rasaH| shleShmalo bhakShitasyekShoryAntrikastu vidahyate||237||

Commentary: mAdhuryasAmAnyAdikShuvikRutiprAyo varga ucyate| bhakShitasyeti dantapIDitasya| yAntrika iti yantrapIDitaH| vidAhashcAsya prAyashastvaggranthiyuktasya yantreNa pIDanAt, tathA kAlAntarAvasthAnAcca| vacanaM hi- “mUlatvaggranthisaMyogAdyAntrikastu vidahyate”; uktaM ca hArIte- “vyApitvAt sukumAro hi raso yantranipIDitaH| saukShmyAt spRuShTo~anilArkAbhyAM bhRushaM kAye vidahyate” iti| atra vyApitvAditi tvagAdiyuktekShukANDabhavatvAt| yaducyate- vidAhitve yAntrikasya raktapittahantRutvamuktaM virudhyate, yathA “madhUdakasyekShurasasya caiva pAnAcchamaM gacchati raktapittam” (ci.a.4) iti; tanna, yato dantaniShpIDitasyaivAvidAhino raktapitte grahaNaM bhaviShyati, kiMvA yAntrike~api vidAhakArakatvagAdisaMyogasya tathA kAlAntarAvasthAnasya ca tyAgaM kRutvopayogaH kartavyaH; ‘yAntrikastu vidahyate’ iti vacanaM prAyovAdamAshritya bodhyam| anye tvetaddoShabhayAdvidahyata iti shIghraM pacyata iti vyAkhyAnayanti||237||-
prabhUtakrimimajjAsRu~gmedomAMsakaro guDaH||238||
kShudro guDashcaturbhAgatribhAgArdhAvasheShitaH| raso gururyathApUrvaM dhautaH svalpamalo guDaH||239||
tato matsyaNDikAkhaNDasharkarA vimalAH param| yathA yathaiShAM vaimalyaM bhavecchaityaM tathA tathA||240||
vRuShyA kShINakShatahitA sasnehA guDasharkarA| kaShAyamadhurA shItA satiktA yAsasharkarA||241||
rUkShA vamyatisAraghnI cchedanI madhusharkarA| tRuShNAsRukpittadAheShu prashastAH sarvasharkarAH||242||
atha mAMsavargaH- gokharAshvataroShTrAshvadvIpisiMharkShavAnarAH| vRuko vyAghrastarakShushca babhrumArjAramUShikAH||35||
lopAko jambukaH shyeno vAntAdashcAShavAyasau| shashaghnI madhuhA bhAso gRudhrolUkakuli~ggakAH||36||
shvetaH shyAmashcitrapRuShThaH kAlakaH kAkulImRugaH||37||
kUrcikA cillaTo bheko godhA shallakagaNDakau| kadalI nakulaH shvAviditi bhUmishayAH smRutAH||38||

sRumarashcamaraH kha~ggo mahiSho gavayo gajaH| nya~gkurvarAhashcAnUpA mRugAH sarve rurustathA||39||

Commentary: sRumaraH mahAshUkaraH| camaraH keshamRutyuH| kha~ggaH gaNDakaH| gavayaH gavAkAraH| nya~gkuH nya~gkusho hariNaH| ruruH bahushRu~ggo hariNaH||39||

kUrmaH karkaTako matsyaH shishumArastimi~ggilaH| shuktisha~gkhodrakummIraculukImakarAdayaH||40||

Commentary: shishumAraH gotuNDanakraH| timi~ggilaH sAmudro mahAmatsyaH| shuktiH muktAprabhavo jantuH, UdraH jalabiDAlaH, kumbhIraH ghaTikAvAn, culukI ‘shushu’ iti khyAtaH| shishumArAdInAM matsyagrahaNena grahaNe prApte visheShavyavahArArthaM punarabhidhAnam||40||-
...vakShyante vAricAriNaH| haMsaH krau~jco balAkA ca bakaH kAraNDavaH plavaH||41||
sharAriH puShkarAhvashca kesharI maNituNDakaH | mRuNAlakaNTho madgushca kAdambaH kAkatuNDakaH||42||
utkroshaH puNDarIkAkSho megharAvo~ambakukkuTI| ArA nandImukhI vATI sumukhAH sahacAriNaH||43||
rohiNI kAmakAlI ca sAraso raktashIrShakaH| cakravAkastathA~anye ca khagAH santyambucAriNaH||44||
pRuShataH sharabho rAmaH shvadaMShTro mRugamAtRukA| shashoraNau kura~ggashca gokarNaH koTTakArakaH||45||
cAruShko hariNaiNau ca shambaraH kAlapucchakaH| RuShyashca varapotashca vij~jeyA jA~ggalA mRugAH||46||
lAvo vartIrakashcaiva vArtIkaH sakapi~jjalaH| cakorashcopacakrashca kukkubho raktavartmakaH||47||
lAvAdyA viShkirAstvete vakShyante vartakAdayaH| vartako vartikA caiva barhI tittirikukkuTau||48||
ka~gkashArapadendrAbhagonardagirivartakAH| krakaro~avakarashcaiva vAraDashceti viShkirAH||49||
shatapatro bhRu~ggarAjaH koyaShTirjIvajIvakaH| kairAtaH kokilo~atyUho gopAputraH priyAtmajaH||50||
laTTA laTTa(TU)Shako babhrurvaTahA DiNDimAnakaH| jaTI dundubhipAkkAralohapRuShThakuli~ggakAH ||51||
kapotashukashAra~ggAshciraTIka~gkuyaShTikAH| sArikA kalavi~gkashca caTako~a~ggAracUDakaH||52||
prasahya bhakShayantIti prasahAstena sa~jj~jitAH||53||
bhUshayA bilavAsitvAdAnUpAnUpasaMshrayAt | jale nivAsAjjalajA jalecaryAjjalecarAH||54||
sthalajA jA~ggalAH proktA mRugA jA~ggalacAriNaH| vikIrya viShkirAshceti pratudya pratudAH smRutAH||55||
prasahA bhUshayAnUpavArijA vAricAriNaH||56||
gurUShNasnigdhamadhurA balopacayavardhanAH| vRuShyAH paraM vAtaharAH kaphapittavivardhanAH||57||
hitA vyAyAmanityebhyo narA dIptAgnayashca ye| prasahAnAM visheSheNa mAMsaM mAMsAshinAM bhiShak||58||
jIrNArshograhaNIdoShashoShArtAnAM prayojayet| lAvAdyo vaiShkiro vargaH pratudA jA~ggalA mRugAH||59||
laghavaH shItamadhurAH sakaShAyA hitA nRuNAm| pittottare vAtamadhye sannipAte kaphAnuge||60||
nAtishItagurusnigdhaM mAMsamAjamadoShalam||61||
sharIradhAtusAmAnyAdanabhiShyandi bRuMhaNam| mAMsaM madhurashItatvAdguru bRuMhaNamAvikam||62||
sAmAnyenopadiShTAnAM mAMsAnAM svaguNaiH pRuthak||63||
keShA~jcidguNavaisheShyAdvisheSha upadekShyate| darshanashrotramedhAgnivayovarNasvarAyuShAm||64||
barhI hitatamo balyo vAtaghno mAMsashukralaH| gurUShNasnigdhamadhurAH svaravarNabalapradAH||65||
bRuMhaNAH shukralAshcoktA haMsA mArutanAshanAH| snigdhAshcoShNAshca vRuShyAshca bRuMhaNAH svarabodhanAH||66||
balyAH paraM vAtaharAH svedanAshcaraNAyudhAH| gurUShNo madhuro nAtidhanvAnUpaniShevaNAt||67||
tittiriH sa~jjayecchIghraM trIn doShAnanilolbaNAn| pittashleShmavikAreShu sarakteShu kapi~jjalAH||68||
mandavAteShu shasyante shaityamAdhuryalAghavAt| lAvAH kaShAyamadhurA laghavo~agnivivardhanAH||69||
sannipAtaprashamanAH kaTukAshca vipAkataH| godhA vipAke madhurA kaShAyakaTukA rase||70||
vAtapittaprashamanI bRuMhaNI balavardhanI| shallako madhurAmlashca vipAke kaTukaH smRutaH||71||
vAtapittakaphaghnashca kAsashvAsaharastathA| kaShAyavishadAH shItA raktapittanibarhaNAH||72||
vipAke madhurAshcaiva kapotA gRuhavAsinaH| tebhyo laghutarAH ki~jcit kapotA vanavAsinaH ||73||
shItAH sa~ggrAhiNashcaiva svalpamUtrakarAshca te| shukamAMsaM kaShAyAmlaM vipAke rUkShashItalam||74||
shoShakAsakShayahitaM sa~ggrAhi laghu dIpanam| caTakA madhurAH snigdhA balashukravivardhanAH||75||
sannipAtaprashamanAH shamanA mArutasya ca| kaShAyo vishado rUkShaH shItaH pAke kaTurlaghuH||76||
shashaH svAduH prashastashca sannipAte~anilAvare| madhurA madhurAH pAke tridoShashamanAH shivAH||77||
laghavo baddhaviNmUtrAH shItAshcaiNAH prakIrtitAH| snehanaM bRuMhaNaM vRuShyaM shramaghnamanilApaham||78||
varAhapishitaM balyaM rocanaM svedanaM guru| gavyaM kevalavAteShu pInase viShamajvare||79||
shuShkakAsashramAtyagnimAMsakShayahitaM ca tat| snigdhoShNaM madhuraM vRuShyaM mAhiShaM guru tarpaNam||80||
dArDhyaM bRuhattvamutsAhaM svapnaM ca janayatyapi| gurUShNA madhurA balyA bRuMhaNAH pavanApahAH||81||
matsyAH snigdhAshca vRuShyAshca bahudoShAH prakIrtitAH| shaivAlashaShpabhojitvAtsvapnasya ca vivarjanAt||82||
rohito dIpanIyashca laghupAko mahAbalaH| varNyo vAtaharo vRuShyashcakShuShyo balavardhanaH||83||
medhAsmRutikaraH pathyaH shoShaghnaH kUrma ucyate| kha~ggamAMsamabhiShyandi balakRunmadhuraM smRutam||84||
snehanaM bRuMhaNaM varNyaM shramaghnamanilApaham| dhArtarAShTracakorANAM dakShANAM shikhinAmapi||85||
caTakAnAM ca yAni syuraNDAni ca hitAni ca| kShINaretaHsu kAseShu hRudrogeShu kShateShu ca||86||
madhurANyavidAhIni sadyobalakarANi ca| sharIrabRuMhaNe nAnyat khAdyaM mAMsAdvishiShyate||87||
atha shAkavargaH- pAThAshuShAshaTIshAkaM vAstukaM suniShaNNAkam||88||
vidyAdgrAhi tridoShaghnaM bhinnavarcastu vAstukam| tridoShashamanI vRuShyA kAkamAcI rasAyanI||89||
nAtyuShNashItavIryA ca bhedinI kuShThanAshinI| rAjakShavakashAkaM tu tridoShashamanaM laghu||90||
grAhi shastaM visheSheNa grahaNyarshovikAriNAm| kAlashAkaM tu kaTukaM dIpanaM garashophajit||91||
laghUShNaM vAtalaM rUkShaM kAlAyaM shAkamucyate| dIpanI coShNavIryA ca grAhiNI kaphamArute||92||
prashasyate~amlacA~ggerI grahaNyarshohitA ca sA| madhurA madhurA pAke bhedinI shleShmavardhanI||93||
vRuShyA snigdhA ca shItA ca madaghnI cApyupodikA| rUkSho madaviShaghnashca prashasto raktapittinAm||94||
madhuro madhuraH pAke shItalastaNDulIyakaH| maNDUkaparNI vetrAgraM kucelA vanatiktakam||95||
karkoTakAvalgujakau paTolaM shakulAdanI| vRuShapuShpANi shAr~ggeShTA kembUkaM sakaThillakam||96||
nADI kalAyaM gojihvA vArtAkaM tilaparNikA| kaulakaM kArkashaM naimbaM shAkaM pArpaTakaM ca yat||97||
sarvANi sUpyashAkAni pha~jjI cillI kutumbakaH||98||
AlukAni ca sarvANi sapatrANi kuTi~jjaram | shaNashAlmalipuShpANi karbudAraH suvarcalA||99||
niShpAvaH kovidArashca patturashcuccuparNikA| kumArajIvo loTTAkaH pAla~gkyA mAriShastathA||100||
kalambanAlikAsUryaH kusumbhavRukadhUmakau| lakShmaNA ca prapunnADo nalinIkA kuTherakaH||101||
loNikA yavashAkaM ca kUShmANDakamavalgujam| yAtukaH shAlakalyANI triparNI pIluparNikA||102||
shAkaM guru ca rUkShaM ca prAyo viShTabhya jIryati| madhuraM shItavIryaM ca purIShasya ca bhedanam||103||
svinnaM niShpIDitarasaM snehADhyaM tat prashasyate| shaNasya kovidArasya karbudArasya shAlmaleH||104||
puShpaM grAhi prashastaM ca raktapitte visheShataH| nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthaplakShapadmAdipallavAH||105||
kaShAyAH stambhanAH shItA hitAH pittAtisAriNAm| vAyuM vatsAdanI hanyAt kaphaM gaNDIracitrakau||106||
shreyasI bilvaparNI ca bilvapatraM tu vAtanut| bhaNDI shatAvarIshAkaM balA jIvantikaM ca yat||107||
parvaNyAH parvapuShpyAshca vAtapittaharaM smRutam| laghu bhinnashakRuttiktaM lA~ggalakyurubUkayoH||108||
tilavetasashAkaM ca shAkaM pa~jcA~ggulasya ca| vAtalaM kaTutiktAmlamadhomArgapravartanam||109||
rUkShAmlamuShNaM kausumbhaM kaphaghnaM pittavardhanam| trapusairvArukaM svAdu guru viShTambhi shItalam||110||
mukhapriyaM ca rUkShaM ca mUtralaM trapusaM tvati| ervArukaM ca sampakvaM dAhatRuShNAklamArtinut||111||
varcobhedInyalAbUni rUkShashItagurUNi ca| cirbhaTairvAruke tadvadvarcobhedahite tu te||112||
sakShAraM pakvakUShmANDaM madhurAmlaM tathA laghu| sRuShTamUtrapurIShaM ca sarvadoShanibarhaNam||113||
mAkShikaM bhrAmaraM kShaudraM pauttikaM madhujAtayaH| mAkShikaM pravaraM teShAM visheShAdbhrAmaraM guru||243||
mAkShikaM tailavarNaM syAdghRutavarNaM tu pauttikam| kShaudraM kapilavarNaM syAcchvetaM bhrAmaramucyate||244||
vAtalaM guru shItaM ca raktapittakaphApaham| sandhAtRu cchedanaM rUkShaM kaShAyaM madhuraM madhu ||245||
hanyAnmadhUShNamuShNArtamathavA saviShAnvayAt| gururUkShakaShAyatvAcchaityAccAlpaM hitaM madhu||246||
nAtaH kaShTatamaM ki~jcinmadhvAmAttaddhi mAnavam| upakramavirodhitvAt sadyo hanyAdyathA viSham||247||
Ame soShNA kriyA kAryA sA madhvAme virudhyate| madhvAmaM dAruNaM tasmAt sadyo hanyAdyathA viSham||248||

nAnAdravyAtmakatvAcca yogavAhi paraM madhu| itIkShuvikRutiprAyo vargo~ayaM dashamo mataH||249||

Commentary: madhuno yogavAhitvamAha- nAnetyAdi| yasmAnnAnArasavIryAdibhyaH puShpebhya utpannaM tanmadhu, tenAnabhivyaktanAnAshaktikameva| tatashca yena dravyeNa vAmanIyena vA~a~asthApanIyena vA vRuShyeNa kAryAntarakArakeNa vA yujyate tasyaiva karma karoti, samAnAnukAridravyaprabodhitashaktitvAditi bhAvaH| cakAro~atra hetvantarasamuccaye, tena prabhAvAcceti boddhavyam| tena satyapi nAnauShadhisambhavatve prabhAvAnna kShIramadyAdayo yogavAhinaH; tathA, anAnAtmakA api shilAjatutailAdayo yogavAhino bhavanti| yogavAhitve~api madhu snehane na prayujyate vAte, rUkShAdiguNayuktatvAt| nAnAdravyAtmakatve~api madhu rUkShakaShAyatvAbhyAmevAvirbhUtaM bhavati, prAyeNa rUkShakaShAyaguNAdhike eva puShpe madhumakShikANAM caraNAditi boddhavyam| anena ca nyAyena nAnAdravyAtmakatvena sarvaguNatAprasa~ggo madhuno nirasto bhavati| sushrute~apyevameva yogavAhitvaM “tacca nAnA” (su.sU.a.45) ityAdinA granthena madhuna uktam| ikShuvikRutiprAya iti ikShuvikRutipradhAnaH, tena yAsasharkarAdikathanamapyatrAviruddhamiti bhAvaH||249||
atha kRutAnnavargaH- kShuttRuShNAglAnidaurbalyakukShirogajvarApahA| svedAgnijananI peyA vAtavarconulomanI||250||
tarpaNI grAhiNI laghvI hRudyA cApi vilepikA| maNDastu dIpayatyagniM vAtaM cApyanulomayet||251||
mRudUkaroti srotAMsi svedaM sa~jjanayatyapi| la~gghitAnAM viriktAnAM jIrNe snehe ca tRuShyatAm||252||
dIpanatvAllaghutvAcca maNDaH syAt prANadhAraNaH| lAjapeyA shramaghnI tu kShAmakaNThasya dehinaH||253||
tRuShNAtIsArashamano dhAtusAmyakaraH shivaH| lAjamaNDo~agnijanano dAhamUrcchAnivAraNaH ||254||
mandAgniviShamAgnInAM bAlasthavirayoShitAm| deyashca sukumArANAM lAjamaNDaH susaMskRutaH||255||
kShutpipAsApahaH pathyaH shuddhAnAM ca malApahaH| shRutaH pippalishuNThIbhyAM yukto lAjAmladADimaiH||256||
sudhautaH prasrutaH svinnaH santaptashcaudano laghuH||257||
bhRuShTataNDulamicchanti garashleShmAmayeShvapi| adhauto~aprasruto~asvinnaH shItashcApyodano guruH||258||
mAMsashAkavasAtailaghRutamajjaphalaudanAH| balyAH santarpaNA hRudyA guravo bRuMhayanti ca||259||
kulmAShA guravo rUkShA vAtalA bhinnavarcasaH||260||
svinnabhakShyAstu ye kicit saupyagaudhUmayAvikAH| bhiShak teShAM yathAdravyamAdishedgurulAghavam||261||

akRutaM kRutayUShaM ca tanuM sAMskArikaM rasam| sUpamamlamanamlaM ca guruM vidyAdyathottaram||262||

Commentary: akRutakRutayUShalakShaNam- “asnehalavaNaM sarvamakRutaM kaTukairvinA| vij~jeyaM lavaNasnehakaTukaiH saMskRutaM kRutam” (su. sU. 46) iti| tanumiti svalpamAMsatvenAghanaM, sAMskArikamiti bahumAMsasnehAdisaMskRutatvAdghanam||262||
saktavo vAtalA rUkShA bahuvarconulominaH| tarpayanti naraM sadyaH pItAH sadyobalAshca te||263||
madhurA laghavaH shItAH saktavaH shAlisambhavAH| grAhiNo raktapittaghnAstRuShNAcchardijvarApahAH||264||
hanyAdvyAdhIn yavApUpo yAvako vATya eva ca| udAvartapratishyAyakAsamehagalagrahAn||265||
dhAnAsa~jj~jAstu ye bhakShyAH prAyaste lekhanAtmakAH| shuShkatvAttarpaNAshcaiva viShTambhitvAcca durjarAH||266||
virUDhadhAnA shaShkulyo madhukroDAH sapiNDakAH| pUpAH pUpalikAdyAshca guravaH paiShTikAH param||267||
phalamAMsavasAshAkapalalakShaudrasaMskRutAH| bhakShyA vRuShyAshca balyAshca guravo bRuMhaNAtmakAH||268||
veshavAro guruH snigdho balopacayavardhanaH| guravastarpaNA vRuShyAH kShIrekShurasapUpakAH ||269||
saguDAH satilAshcaiva sakShIrakShaudrasharkarAH| bhakShyA vRuShyAshca balyAshca paraM tu guravaH smRutAH||270||
sasnehAH snehasiddhAshca bhakShyA vividhalakShaNAH| guravastarpaNA vRuShyA hRudyA gaudhUmikA matAH||271||
saMskArAllaghavaH santi bhakShyA gaudhUmapaiShTikAH| dhAnAparpaTapUpAdyAstAn buddhvA nirdishettathA||272||

pRuthukA guravo bhRuShTAn bhakShayedalpashastu tAn| yAvA viShTabhya jIryanti sarasA bhinnavarcasaH||273||

Commentary: pRuthukAH cipiTAH| yAvA iti yavacipiTAH, anye tu gAndhAradeshaprasiddhAn sampiShTasa~jj~jAnAhuH | sarasA abhRuShTAH||273||

sUpyAnnavikRutA bhakShyA vAtalA rUkShashItalAH| sakaTusnehalavaNAnalpasho bhakShayettu tAn||274||

Commentary: sUpyavikRutA iti mudramAShAdivikArAH||274||

mRudupAkAshca ye bhakShyAH sthUlAshca kaThinAshca ye| guravaste vyatikrAntapAkAH puShTibalapradAH||275||

Commentary: mRudupAkAH stokAgnisaMyogasAdhyAH| vyatikrAntapAkA iti cireNa jarAM gacchanti||275||

dravyasaMyogasaMskAraM dravyamAnaM pRuthak tathA| bhakShyANAmAdishedbuddhvA yathAsvaM gurulAghavam||276||

Commentary: anuktabhakShyaguNAtideshArthamAha- dravyasaMyogetyAdi | dravyamAnaM pRuthagiti bhakShyakaraNe saMyuktAnAM dravyANAM madhye kasya kiyanmAnamiti buddhvA| yathAsvamiti yasya dravyasya gauravaM lAghavaM vA balavadbhavati taM nirdishet||276||
(nAnAdravyaiH samAyuktaH pakvAmaklinnabharjitaiH| vimardako gururhRudyo vRuShyo balavatAM hitaH)||277||
rasAlA bRuMhaNI vRuShyA snigdhA balyA rucipradA| snehanaM tarpaNaM hRudyaM vAtaghnaM saguDaM dadhi||278||
drAkShAkharjUrakolAnAM guru viShTambhi pAnakam| parUShakANAM kShaudrasya yaccekShuvikRutiM prati||279||
teShAM kaTvamlasaMyogAn pAnakAnAM pRuthak pRuthak| dravyaM mAnaM ca vij~jAya guNakarmANi cAdishet||280||
kaTvamlasvAdulavaNA laghavo rAgaShADavAH| mukhapriyAshca hRudyAshca dIpanA bhaktarocanAH||281||
AmrAmalakalehAshca bRuMhaNA balavardhanAH| rocanAstarpaNAshcoktAH snehamAdhuryagauravAt||282||
buddhvA saMyogasaMskAraM dravyamAnaM ca tacchritam| guNakarmANi lehAnAM teShAM teShAM tathA vadet||283||
raktapittakaphotkledi shuktaM vAtAnulomanam| kandamUlaphalAdyaM ca tadvadvidyAttadAsutam||284||
shiNDAkI cAsutaM cAnyat kAlAmlaM rocanaM laghu| vidyAdvargaM kRutAnnAnAmekAdashatamaM bhiShak||285||
kaShAyAnurasaM svAdu sUkShmamuShNaM vyavAyi ca| pittalaM baddhaviNmUtraM na ca shleShmAbhivardhanam||286||
vAtaghneShUttamaM balyaM tvacyaM medhAgnivardhanam| tailaM saMyogasaMskArAt sarvarogApahaM matam||287||
tailaprayogAdajarA nirvikArA jitashramAH| AsannatibalAH sa~gkhye daityAdhipatayaH purA||288||
airaNDatailaM madhuraM guru shleShmAbhivardhanam| vAtAsRuggulmahRudrogajIrNajvaraharaM param||289||
kaTUShNaM sArShapaM tailaM raktapittapradUShaNam| kaphashukrAnilaharaM kaNDUkoThavinAshanam ||290||
priyAlatailaM madhuraM guru shleShmAbhivardhanam| hitamicchanti nAtyauShNyAtsaMyoge vAtapittayoH||291||
AtasyaM madhurAmlaM tu vipAke kaTukaM tathA| uShNavIryaM hitaM vAte raktapittaprakopaNam||292||
kusumbhatailamuShNaM ca vipAke kaTukaM guru| vidAhi ca visheSheNa sarvadoShaprakopaNam||293||
phalAnAM yAni cAnyAni tailAnyAhArasaMvidhau | yujyante guNakarmabhyAM tAni brUyAdyathAphalam||294||

madhuro bRuMhaNo vRuShyo balyo majjA tathA vasA| yathAsattvaM tu shaityoShNe vasAmajj~jorvinirdishet||295||

Commentary: yathAsattvamiti yaH prANI AnUpAdiruShNastasyoShNaH, yastu prANI jA~ggalAdiH shItastasya shIta ityarthaH| sAmAnyatastu vasAmajj~joranuShNAshItatvaM yathA bhavati tathA snehAdhyAye eva proktam||295||
sasnehaM dIpanaM vRuShyamuShNaM vAtakaphApaham| vipAke madhuraM hRudyaM rocanaM vishvabheShajam||296||
shleShmalA madhurA cArdrA gurvI snigdhA ca pippalI| sA shuShkA kaphavAtaghnI kaTUShNA vRuShyasammatA ||297||
nAtyarthamuShNaM maricamavRuShyaM laghu rocanam| cheditvAcchoShaNatvAcca dIpanaM kaphavAtajit ||298||
vAtashleShmavibandhaghnaM kaTUShNaM dIpanaM laghu| hi~ggu shUlaprashamanaM vidyAt pAcanarocanam||299||
rocanaM dIpanaM vRuShyaM cakShuShyamavidAhi ca| tridoShaghnaM samadhuraM saindhavaM lavaNottamam||300||
saukShmyAdauShNyAllaghutvAcca saugandhyAcca rucipradam| sauvarcalaM vibandhaghnaM hRudyamudgArashodhi ca||301||
taikShNyAdauShNyAdvyavAyitvAddIpanaM shUlanAshanam| UrdhvaM cAdhashca vAtAnAmAnulomyakaraM biDam||302||
satiktakaTu sakShAraM tIkShNamutkledi caudbhidam| na kAlalavaNe gandhaH sauvarcalaguNAshca te||303||
sAmudrakaM samadhuraM, satiktaM kaTu pAMshujam| rocanaM lavaNaM sarvaM pAki sraMsyanilApaham||304||
hRutpANDugrahaNIrogaplIhAnAhagalagrahAn| kAsaM kaphajamarshAMsi yAvashUko vyapohati||305||
tIkShNoShNo laghurUkShashca kledI paktA vidAraNaH| dAhano dIpanashchettA sarvaH kShAro~agnisannibhaH ||306||

kAravI ku~jcikA~ajAjI yavAnI dhAnyatumburu| rocanaM dIpanaM vAtakaphadaurgandhyanAshanam||307||

Commentary: kAravI kRuShNajIrakam| ku~jcikA sthUlajIrakam| ajAjI jIrakam||307||

AhArayoginAM bhaktinishcayo na tu vidyate| samApto dvAdashashcAyaM varga AhArayoginAm||308||

Commentary: uktAttailAderanyadapyAhArasaMskArakatvenAhArayogi bhavatItyAha- AhAretyAdi| bhaktiH vibhAga iyatteti yAvat; kiMvA bhaktiH icchA; tena puruShecchAnAmaniyamAduktamapi ki~jcit prAya AhArayogi na bhavati, tathA anuktamapi rasonAmrapeShikAdyAhArasaMyogi bhavatItyuktaM bhavati||308||
shUkadhAnyaM shamIdhAnyaM samAtItaM prashasyate| purANaM prAyasho rUkShaM prAyeNAbhinavaM guru ||309||
yadyadAgacchati kShipraM tattallaghutaraM smRutam| nistuShaM yuktibhRuShTaM ca sUpyaM laghu vipacyate||310||

mRutaM kRushaM cAtimedyaM vRuddhaM bAlaM viShairhatam| agocarabhRutaM vyAlasUditaM mAMsamutsRujet||311||

Commentary: mRutamiti svayaM mRutam| medyaM meduram| kRushagrahaNena shuShkamapi grAhyam| agocarabhRutaM yathA- AnUpaM dhanvadeshe puShTam| vyAlA vyAghrAdayaH; kiMvA vyAlaH sarpaH| viShahataM tu viShadigdhashastraviddham||311||-
prINanaH sarvabhUtAnAM hRudyo mAMsarasaH param||312||
shuShyatAM vyAdhimuktAnAM kRushAnAM kShINaretasAm| balavarNArthinAM caiva rasaM vidyAdyathAmRutam||313||
sarvarogaprashamanaM yathAsvaM vihitaM rasam| vidyAt svaryaM balakaraM vayobuddhIndriyAyuShAm||314||
vyAyAmanityAH strInityA madyanityAshca ye narAH| nityaM mAMsarasAhArA nAturAH syurna durbalAH||315||
krimivAtAtapahataM shuShkaM jIrNamanArtavam| shAkaM niHsnehasiddhaM ca varjyaM yaccAparisrutam||316||
purANamAmaM sa~gkliShTaM krimivyAlahimAtapaiH| adeshakAlajaM klinnaM yatsyAtphalamasAdhu tat||317||
haritAnAM yathAshAkaM nirdeshaH sAdhanAdRute| madyAmbugorasAdInAM sve sve varge vinishcayaH||318||
yadAhAraguNaiH pAnaM viparItaM tadiShyate| annAnupAnaM dhAtUnAM dRuShTaM yanna virodhi ca||319||
AsavAnAM samuddiShTAmashItiM caturuttarAm| jalaM peyamapeyaM ca parIkShyAnupibeddhitam||320||
snigdhoShNaM mArute shastaM pitte madhurashItalam| kaphe~anupAnaM rUkShoShNaM kShaye mAMsarasaH param||321||
upavAsAdhvabhAShyastrImArutAtapakarmabhiH| klAntAnAmanupAnArthaM payaH pathyaM yathA~amRutam||322||
surA kRushAnAM puShTyarthamanupAnaM vidhIyate| kArshyArthaM sthUladehAnAmanu shastaM madhUdakam||323||
alpAgnInAmanidrANAM tandrAshokabhayaklamaiH| madyamAMsocitAnAM ca madyamevAnushasyate||324||

athAnupAnakarmaguNAn pravakShyAmaH- anupAnaM tarpayati, prINayati, Urjayati, bRuMhayati, paryAptimabhinirvartayati, bhuktamavasAdayati, annasa~gghAtaM bhinatti, mArdavamApAdayati, kledayati, jarayati, sukhapariNAmitAmAshuvyavAyitAM cAhArasyopajanayatIti||325||
bhavati cAtra- anupAnaM hitaM yuktaM tarpayatyAshu mAnavam| sukhaM pacati cAhAramAyuShe ca balAya ca||326||
nordhvA~ggamArutAviShTA na hikkAshvAsakAsinaH| na gItabhAShyAdhyayanaprasaktA norasi kShatAH||327||
pibeyurudakaM bhuktvA taddhi kaNThorasi sthitam| snehamAhArajaM hatvA bhUyo doShAya kalpate||328||
annapAnaikadesho~ayamuktaH prAyopayogikaH| dravyANi na hi nirdeShTuM shakyaM kArtsnyena nAmabhiH||329||
yathA nAnauShadhaM ki~jciddeshajAnAM vaco yathA| dravyaM tattattathA vAcyamanuktamiha yadbhavet||330||

caraH sharIrAvayavAH svabhAvo dhAtavaH kriyA| li~ggaM pramANaM saMskAro mAtrA cAsmin parIkShyate||331||

Commentary: aparamapyanuktAnnapAnaguNaj~jAnakAraNamAha- cara ityAdi| caryata iti caro deshaH bhakShyashca sAmAnyena gRuhyate| kriyA vyApAraH| pramANaM mAnam| atreti annapAnaguNAdhikaraNe||331||
caro~anUpajalAkAshadhanvAdyo bhakShyasaMvidhiH| jalajAnUpajAshcaiva jalAnUpacarAshca ye||332||
gurubhakShyAshca ye sattvAH sarve te guravaH smRutAH| laghubhakShyAstu laghavo dhanvajA dhanvacAriNaH||333||
sharIrAvayavAH sakthishiraHskandhAdayastathA| sakthimAMsAdguruH skandhastataH kroDastataH shiraH||334||
vRuShaNau carma meDhraM ca shroNI vRukkau yakRudgudam| mAMsAdgurutaraM vidyAdyathAsvaM madhyamasthi ca||335||
svabhAvAllaghavo mudgAstathA lAvakapi~jjalAH| svabhAvAdguravo mAShA varAhamahiShAstathA||336||
dhAtUnAM shoNitAdInAM guruM vidyAdyathottaram| alasebhyo vishiShyante prANino ye bahukriyAH||337||

gauravaM li~ggasAmAnye puMsAM strINAM tu lAghavam| mahApramANA guravaH svajAtau laghavo~anyathA||338||

Commentary: li~ggyante j~jAyante gavAdayo~aneneti li~ggaM jAtiH, tena li~ggasAmAnye jAtisAmAnye; etacca catuShpAdAbhiprAyeNa boddhavyaM, pakShiShu viparyayaH; yadAha hArItaH- “catuShpAdeShu laghvI strI vihageShu laghuH pumAn” iti, atrApyuktaM- “striyashcatuShpAtsu pumAn vihageShu laghuH” iti| puMsAM ca gaurave atyarthaguroH shukrasyArambhakasya bhUyastvaM hetuM bruvate; kintu svabhAvastatra heturapavAda iti pashyAmaH, viha~ggeShu viparyayadarshanAditi||338||

gurUNAM lAghavaM vidyAt saMskArAt saviparyayam| vrIherlAjA yathA ca syuH saktUnAM siddhapiNDikAH||339||

Commentary: saviparyayamiti saMskArAllaghUnAmapi gauravaM vidyAdityarthaH| tadeva saMskArajanyaM lAghavaM gauravaM cAha- vrIherityAdi| gurorapi vrIheH saMskArAllAjA laghava ityarthaH| saktUnAM ca laghUnAM siddhapiNDikA gurvyaH, siddhapiNDikA agnipAcitAH piNDAH||339||
alpAdAne gurUNAM ca laghUnAM cAtisevane| mAtrA kAraNamuddiShTaM dravyANAM gurulAghave||340||
gurUNAmalpamAdeyaM laghUnAM tRuptiriShyate| mAtrAM dravyANyapekShante mAtrA cAgnimapekShate||341||

balamArogyamAyushca prANAshcAgnau pratiShThitAH| annapAnendhanaishcAgnirjvalati vyeti cAnyathA ||342||

Commentary: kutaH punaragnyapekShA mAtrA kriyata ityAha- balamityAdi| agnimapekShya mAtrayA prayuktayA~agnyanAshAdvalAdayo bhavantIti bhAvaH| agnau pratiShThitA iti agnyadhInAH; yathA- rAjAshritAH prajA iti| prANA iti vAyavaH; kiMvA, prANAshrayAH sha~gkhAdayo dasha prANAH| indhanaM kAShTham, indhanamivendhanaM, taiH; kiMvA agnidAhyamindhanamucyate| anyatheti anindhanam||342||

gurulAghavacinteyaM prAyeNAlpabalAn prati| mandakriyAnanArogyAn sukumArAnsukhocitAn||343||

Commentary: iyaM carAdikRutA gurulAghavacintA~alpAgniM prati prAya iti darshayannAha- gurvityAdi| atrApyabalatvena mandakAdyairapi vahnimAndyameva lakShaNIyam||343||

dIptAgnayaH kharAhArAH karmanityA mahodarAH| ye narAH prati tAMshcintyaM nAvashyaM gurulAghavam||344||

Commentary: kharAhArA iti kaThinAhArasAtmyAH| mahodaratvenApi medovarodhAnmahAgnitvaM darshayati| nAvashyaM cintyamiti anena dIptAgnInAmapi prati stokaprayojanA gurulAghavacintA vidyata eveti darshayati| yato dIptAgnyAdInAmapi gurudravyamagneH pratipakShamAvahatyeva, svabhAvato~agniviruddhatvAt||344||
hitAbhirjuhuyAnnityamantaragniM samAhitaH| annapAnasamidbhirnA mAtrAkAlau vicArayan||345||
AhitAgniH sadA pathyAnyantaragnau juhoti yaH| divase divase brahma japatyatha dadAti ca||346||
naraM niHshreyase yuktaM sAtmyaj~jaM pAnabhojane| bhajante nAmayAH kecidbhAvino~apyantarAdRute||347||

ShaDtriMshataM sahasrANi rAtrINAM hitabhojanaH| jIvatyanAturo janturjitAtmA sammataH satAm||348||

Commentary: varShashatAyuShTvamapi hitAdbhojanAdbhavatItyAha- ShaTtriMshatamityAdi| etAvatIbhI rAtribhirvarShashatameva bhavati| jitAtmA jitendriyaH| sammataH pUjitaH||348||
prANAH prANabhRutAmannamannaM loko~abhidhAvati| varNaH prasAdaH sausvaryaM jIvitaM pratibhA sukham||349||
tuShTiH puShTirbalaM medhA sarvamanne pratiShThitam| laukikaM karma yadvRuttau svargatau yacca vaidikam||350||
tatra shlokaH- annapAnaguNAH sAgryA vargA dvAdasha nishcitAH||351||
saguNAnyanupAnAni gurulAghavasa~ggrahaH| annapAnavidhAvuktaM tat parIkShyaM visheShataH||352||
itIkShuvargo dashamaH

tasmAddhitAhitAvabodhanArthamannapAnavidhimakhilenopadekShyAmo~agnivesha! tat svabhAvAdudaktaM kledayati, lavaNaM viShyandayati, kShAraH pAcayati, madhu sandadhAti, sarpiH snehayati, kShIraM jIvayati, mAMsaM bRuMhayati, rasaH prINayati, surA jarjarIkaroti, shIdhuravadhamati, drAkShAsavo dIpayati, phANitamAcinoti, dadhi shophaM janayati, piNyAkashAkaM glapayati, prabhUtAntarmalo mAShasUpaH, dRuShTishukraghnaH kShAraH, prAyaH pittalamamlamanyatra dADimAmalakAt, prAyaH shleShmalaM madhuramanyatra madhunaH purANAcca shAliShaShTikayavagodhUmAt, prAyastikaM vAtalamavRuShyaM cAnyatra vegAgrAmRutApaTolapatrAt, prAyaH kaTukaM vAtalamavRuShyaM cAnyatra pippalIvishvabheShajAt||4||

Commentary: annapAnaM vidhIyate yena taM vidhiM dravyaguNakarmarUpaM, tathA carasharIrAvayavAdirUpaM cAkhilena kArtsnyenopadekShyAmaH| yadyapi ceha dravyaM prati prati guNakarmabhyAM na nirdekShyati, vakShyati hi- “annapAnaikadesho~ayamuktaH prAyopayogikaH” iti, tathA~apyanuktAnAmapi dravyANAM carasharIrAvayavAdyupadeshena, tathA pUrvAdhyAyoktapArthivAdidravyaguNakarmakathanena ca tadvidhAnamapyuktaM bhavatItyata uktam- akhilenaneti; vakShyati hi- “yathA nAnauShadhaM kiM ciddeshajAnAM vaco yathA| dravyaM tu tattathA vAcyamanuktamiha yadbhavet”, tathA “caraH sharIravayavAH” ityAdi; kiMvA, vidhishabdo~ashitapItalIDhakhAditaprakAravAcI, tena cAshitAdayaH sarva evAkhilena vAcyaH, tatkAraNabhUtAni tu dravyANi raktashAlyAdInyekadeshenoktAni, ato vakShyati- ‘annapAnaikadesho~ayamuktaH’ iti| annapAne ca vaktavye yaddravyaM prAya upayujyate, tasya sAmAnyaguNamabhidhAya vargasa~ggraheNa guNamupadekShyati| udakAbhidhAnaM cAgre kRutam, udakasyAnne pAne ca vyApriyamANatvAt| tadityudAharaNaM; kiMvA sa svabhAvo yasya sa tatsvabhAvaH, tasmAt kledanasvabhAvAdityarthaH| yadyapi ‘udakamAshvAsakarANAM, jalaM stambhanAnAm’ (sU. 26) ityuktaM, tathA~apIhAnuktakledanakarmAbhidhAnArthaM punarucyate| iha jalalavaNAdInAM yat karmocyate tatteShAmitarakarmabhyaH pradhAnaM j~jeyam, agryAdhikAre tu tatkarmakartRudravyAntaraprashastatA j~jeyA| kShAraH pacantamagniM pAcayati, tena pAcayatIti hetau Nic| snehayatItyAdau tu “tatkaroti tadAcaShTe” iti Nic| sandadhAtIti vishliShTAni tva~gmAMsAdIni saMshleShayati| rasaH mAMsarasaH| prINayatIti kShINAn puShNAti, natvatibRuhattvaM karoti; tena mAMsakarmaNA bRuMhaNena samaM naikyam| jarjarIkarotIti shlathamAMsAdyupacayaM karoti; yaduktaM hArIte- “surA jarjarIkarotyasRu~gmedobAhulyAt” iti, tathA hyatraivoktaM- “surA kRushAnAM puShTyartham” iti| avadhamayatIti vilikhatItyarthaH, anekArthatvAddhAtUnAM; vacanaM hi- ‘lekhanaH shItarasikaH’ iti, tathA hArIte~apyuktaM- “shIdhuravadhamayati vAyvagniprabodhanAt” iti| Acinoti ‘doShAn’ iti sheShaH, tantrAntaravacanaM hi- “vAtapittakaphAMstasmAdAcinoti ca phANitam” iti| piNyAkaH tilakalkaH; nighaNTukArastvAha- piNyAko haritashigruH| glapayati harShakShayaM karoti| prabhUtAntarmalasya purIShasya kartA prabhUtAntarmalaH; yadyapi ‘mASho bahumalaH’ iti vakShyati, tathA~api mAShavikRuteH sUpasyeha guNakathanaM, tena na punaruktaM; na cAvashyaM prakRutidharmo vikRutimanugacchati, yataH saktUnAM siddhapiNDikA gurvI eva bhavati, tasmAnmAShavikRutAvapi malavRuddhidarshanArthametadabhidhAnam| kShArasya pAcanatvaM guNo~abhihitaH, iha tu dRuShTishukraghnatvaM doSha iti pRuthagucyate| prAyaH pittalamiti visheSheNAnyebhyo lavaNakaTukebhyo~amlaM pittalam| evamanyatrApi prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho vAcyaH; kiMvA prAyaHshabdo~amlena sambadhyate| atra pittamAdAvamlajanyatayoktaM, doShaprAdhAnyasyAniyatatvAt; uktaM hi- “na te pRuthak pittakaphAnilebhya” (sU. 19) iti, tathA “samapittAnilakaphA” (sU. 7) iti; kiMvA pittoShmA vahniH, sa cehAnnapAnapacane pradhAnaM; yaduktaM- “yadannaM dehadhAtvojobalavarNAdipoShakam| tatrAgnirheturAhArAnnahyapakvAdrasAdayaH” (ci. 15) iti; teneha vahnikAraNapittajanakamevAdAvucyate; yatashca pittajanakamagre vaktavyam, ato rasapradhAnamapi madhuro nAdAvuktaH| madhuna iti vicchedapAThena navAnavasya madhunaH kaphAkartRutvaM darshayati| iha ca ShaDrasasyaiva kathanametattrayeNaiva, anuktAnAM lavaNatiktaShAyANAmapi pAkadvArA grahaNAt; yato lavaNaH pAkAt prAyo madhuraH, tiktakaShAyau kaTukau pAkato bhavataH| ‘prAyaH sarvaM tiktaM’ ityAdistu grantho hArItIyaH, iha kenApi pramAdAllikhitaH||4||
iti vargastRutIyo~ayaM mAMsAnAM parikIrtitaHiti mAMsavargastRutIyaH
paramato vargasa~ggraheNAhAradravyANyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH ||5||
shUkadhAnyashamIdhAnyamAMsashAkaphalAshrayAn| vargAn haritamadyAmbugorasekShuvikArikAn||6||
dasha dvau cAparau vargau kRutAnnAhArayoginAm| rasavIryavipAkaishca prabhAvaishca pracakShmahe||7||
atha shUkadhAnyavargaH- raktashAlirmahAshAliH kalamaH shakunAhRutaH | tUrNako dIrghashUkashca gauraH pANDukalA~ggulau||8||
sugandhako lohavAlaH sArivAkhyaH pramodakaH| pata~ggastapanIyashca ye cAnye shAlayaH shubhAH||9||
shItA rase vipAke ca madhurAshcAlpamArutAH| baddhAlpavarcasaH snigdhA bRuMhaNAH shukramUtralAH||10||
raktashAlirvarasteShAM tRuShNAghnastrimalApahaH | mahAMstasyAnu kalamastasyApyanu tataH pare||11||
yavakA hAyanAH pAMsuvApyanaiShadhakAdayaH | shAlInAM shAlayaH kurvantyanukAraM guNAguNaiH||12||

samprati sAmAnyenoktAnAM guNakarmabhyAM prativyaktyanuktAnAM prativyaktiprAya upayogidravyasya vishiShTaguNakarmakathanArthamannapAnavidhiradhyAyo~abhidhIyate| atrotpannasya chapratyayasya luk| atrAnne kAThinyasAmAnyAt khAdyaM, pAne ca dravatvasAmAnyAllehyamavaruddhaM j~jeyam| annapAnaM vidhIyate vishiShTaguNakarmayogitayA pratipAdyate~anenetyannapAnavidhiH; dravyANAM guNakarmakathanameva cAnnapAnavidhiH, yatastaddhi j~jAtvA~annapAnaM vidhIyate||1-2||

keluTe hArItavacanaM- “keluTaM svAdu viTapaM tatkandaH svAdushItalaH” iti| kadambaM kadambikAM vadanti, kecittu svalpakadambakamAhuH| nadImAShakaH ‘udImAnaka’ iti khyAtaH| aindukaM nikShAraH| tAlapralambaH tAlA~gkuraH| shasyashabdeneha mastakamajjA gRuhyate| taruTaH kahlArakandaH| krau~jcAdanaM dhi~jculikA| kasherukashabdena ci~jcoDakA rAjakasherukashca gRuhyate| a~gkAloDyaM hrasvotpalakandaH| mu~jjAtaka auttarApathikakandaH| amlikA svalpaviTapA prAyaH kAmarUpAdau bhavati| sarpacchatraM sarpaphaNAkAraM chatrakam| anyAshchatrajAtayaH karIShapalAlAdijA bahulA j~jeyAH| patrakandaphalAshraya iti prAdhAnyena, tena puShpAdyAshrayatvamapi shAkavargasya j~jeyam||114-124||

phalAnAmapi keShA~jcicchAkavadupayogAt phalavargamAha| mRudvIkA~agre~abhidhIyate shreShThaguNatvAt| phalgu audumbaram| madhUkashabdena samAnaguNatvAt phalaM kusumaM ca j~jeyam| parUShakaM ceha madhuraparUShakaM j~jeyam| AmrAtam ‘AmaDA’ iti khyAtamAmraphalasadRushamiti candrikA; etacca dvividhaM madhuramamlaM ca; atra madhurasyaiva guNaH, amlasya vakShyamANatvAt| tAlashasyAnIti tAlaphalAni, yathA “harItakInAM shasyAni” (ci. 1) ityatra phalameva shasyamucyate| siddhAni pakvAni; tena pakvatAlasya grahaNam| bhavyaM karmara~ggaphalaM; kecittvaksaMhatimAtraphalaM vadanti| ArukaM kArtikeyapure prasiddham| karkandhUH shRugAlabadarI, karkandhUnikucayorvicchidya pAThena nityaM pittashleShmakartRutvaM tayordarshayati| parUShakAdInAM tu madhurAmlabhedena dvirUpANAM ya eva parUShakAdayo~amlAsta eva pittashleShmakarA iti| pArAvataH kAmarUpaprasiddhaH| atra yo madhuraH sa shItaH, yashcAmlaH sa uShNa iti j~jeyam| evaM rasanirdeshenaiva vIrye labdhe~api punarvIryAkhyAnamamlasyAmalakasya shItatAdarshanAdboddhavyam| Ta~gkaM kAshmIraprasiddham| siddhamiti kAlavashAt pakvam| kapitthabilvAmrANAmavasthAbhedena guNakathanaM sarvAvasthAsu teShAmupayojyatvAt| badaraM madhyapramANaM; taddhi madhurameva bhavati| gA~ggerukaM nAgabalAphalam| karIro marujo drumaH| todanaM dhanvanabhedaH| rAjAdanaM kShIrI| avadaMshakShamamiti lavalIphalaM prAshya dravyAntare rucirbhavati| nIpaM kadambakam| shatAhvakaphalaM ‘seha’ iti khyAtam| pIlu auttarApathikam| tRuNashUnyaM ketakIphalam| prAcInAmalakaM pAnIyAmalakam| tindukaM kenduH| dADimaguNe kaphapittAvirodhIti amladADimaM pittAvirodhi, madhuraM tu kaphAvirodhi, evaM ca tridoShaharatvamasyopapannaM; yaduktaM sushrute- “dvividhaM tattu vij~jeyaM madhuraM cAmlameva ca| tridoShaghnaM tu madhuramamlaM vAtakaphApaham” (su. sU. 46) iti| vRukShAmlaM mahArdrakam| amlikA tintiDI| sheShamiti tva~gmAMsam, ato~anyatheti guru; kiMvA, shUle~arucAvityAdyuktakesharaguNaviparItam| vAtAmAdaya auttarApathikAH| priyAlo~ayaM magadhaprasiddhaH| dantashaThaH jambIraH; kecidamloTaM vadanti| ihAmrAtakamamlaM grAhyaM, pUrvaM tu madhuramAmrAtakamuktam| karamardaM dvividhaM grAmajaM vanajaM ca| airAvatam amlAtakaM; kiMvA nAgara~ggam| vArtAkaM dakShiNApathe phalavat khAdyate yadgoShThavArtAkasa~jj~jakaM, tasyeha guNaH; kiMvA phalavadasiddhasyaiva vArtAkasyopayojyasyAyaM guNaH| AkShikI latA tasyAH phalamAkShikam| anupAki ‘anuyA’ iti khyAtA| agnisamamiti sphoTAdijanakatvAt||125-165||

ShaShTikaguNe~akAraprashleShAdagururiti boddhavyaM, mAtrAshitIye (sU. 5) ShaShTiko laghuH paThitaH| tato~anu ceti gauraShaShTikAdalpAntaraguNaH| varakoddAlakAdayaH ShaShTikavisheShAH; kecit kudhAnyAni varakAdIni vadanti| vrIhiriti shAradAshudhAnyasya sa~jj~jA| pATalo vrIhivisheShaH| tantrAntare~api paThyate- “tridoShastveva pATalaH” iti, sushrute pATalashabdenaitadvyatirikto dhAnyavisheSho j~jeyaH, tena tadguNakathanena neha virodhaH||13-15||

koradUShAdayaH kudhAnyavisheShAH| koradUShaH kodravaH, koradUShasya kevalasya shleShmapittaghnatvaM, tena yaduktaM raktapittanidAne- “yadA janturyavakoddAlakakoradUShaprAyANyannAni bhu~gkte” (ni. 2) ityAdinA pittakartRutvaM koradUShasya, tattatraivoktaniShpAvakA~jjikAdiyuktasya saMyogamahimnA boddhavyam| shyAmAkAdayo~api tRuNadhAnyavisheShAH| hastishyAmAkaH shyAmAkabheda eva; nIvAra uDikA; gavedhuko ghulu~jcaH, sa grAmyAraNyabhedena dvividhaH| prashAtikA uDikaiva sthalajA raktashUkA; ambhaHshyAmAkA jalajA oDikA loke ‘De’ ityucyate; priya~gguH ‘kA~gganI’ iti prasiddhA| mukundo ‘vAkasatRuNa’ iti; varukaH shaNabIjaM; varakaH shyAmabIjaM; shivirastIrabhuktau ‘siddha(ktA)ka’ ityucyate; jUrNAhvo ‘jonAra’ iti khyAtaH||16-18||

yavasya gurorapi bahuvAtatvaM rUkShatvAt; kiMvA sushrute yavo laghuH paThitaH, tenAtrApyagururiti mantavyaM; balyashca srotaH- shuddhikaratvAt prabhAvAdvA| asya ca shItamadhurakaShAyatvenAnuktamapi pittahantRutvaM labhyata eva, tena sushrute “kaphapittahantA” (su. sU. 46) ityuktamupapannam||19-20||

haritAnAmapyArdrakAdInAM phalavadagnipAkamantareNa bhojanasya prAk pashcAccopayogAt phalamanu haritakathanaM, phalebhyastu pashcAdabhidhAnaM haritasya tRuptyanAdhAyakatvAt| Ardrakamiti visheShaNaM shuNThIvyavRuttyarthaM, shuNThIguNashcAhArasaMyogivarge bhaviShyati| jambIraH parNAsabhedaH, jambIraphalaM sugandhi| bAlaM doShaharamiti taruNAvasthAyAmavyaktarasAyAM tridoShaharam| tantrAntaravacanaM hi- “yAvaddhi cAvyaktarasAnvitAni navaprarUDhAni ca mUlakAni| bhavanti tAvallaghudIpanAni pittAnilashleShmaharANi caiva”| vRuddhaM tridoShamiti tadeva pravRuddham, enAmeva mUlakAvasthAmabhipretya coktaM- “mUlakaM kandAnAmapathyatve prakRuShTatamam” (sU. 25) iti| mArutApahaM snigdhasiddhamiti sAmAnyena bAlaM vRuddhaM ca| ‘shuShkANi kaphavAtaghnAnyetAni’ iti vakShyamANagranthenaiva shuShkamUlakasya kaphavAtahantRutve labdhe punarvacanaM prakarShaprAptyartham| pUtigandhaheti sharIrasya tathA vya~jjanArthaM mAMsasya ca pUtigandhatAM hanti| arjakaH shvetaparNAsaH| shigruH viTapashobhA~jjanaH; shAleyashcANakyamUlaM marau prasiddhaM, kiMvA shAleyamiti misteyaM pATakaprasiddhaM, vacanaM hi- “cANakyamUlamisteye shAleyAbhikhyayA jaguH” iti; mRuShTakaM rAjikA| gaNDIro dvividho raktaH shuklashca; tatra yo raktaH sa hi kaTutvena haritavarge paThyate, yastu shuklo jalajaH sa shAkavarge paThita iti naikasya vargadvaye pAThaH| jalapippalI jale pippalyAkArA bhavati| shRu~ggaverI gojihvikA, kiMvA ArdrakAkRutiH shRu~ggaverI; yaduktaM- “shRu~ggaveravadAkRutyA shRu~ggaverIti bhAShitA| kustumburusamAkRutyA tumburUNi vadanti ca” iti| bhUstRuNo gandhatRuNaH| kharAhvA kRuShNajIrakam| ajagandhA vanayavAnI| sumukhaH parNAsabhedaH| ayaM ca dhAnyakAdInAmArdrANAM guNaH, shuShkANAM tvAhArayogigaNe “kAravI ku~jcikA” ityAdinA guNaM nirdekShyati| gRu~jjanakaH svalpanAlapatraH palANDureva| etAnIti haritavargoktAni| shuShkANItyAdinA yadyapi shuShkANAmapi shuNThIprabhRutInAM guNa ukto bhavati, tathA~api visheShaguNAntarakathanArthaM punastadabhidhAnamAhArasaMyogivarge bhaviShyatIti na paunaruktyam||166-177||

godhUmasya svAdushItasnigdhAdiguNopayogAcchleShmakartRutvaM bhavatyeva, ata eva sushrute “shleShmakara” (su. sU. 46) ityuktam| yattu vasante kaphapradhAne “yavagodhUmabhojanaH” (sU. 6) ityuktaM tat purANagodhUmAbhiprAyeNa; purANashca godhUmaH kaphaM na karotItyuktameva ‘prAyaH shleShmalaM madhuram’ ityAdinA granthenAtraivAdhyAye| nandImukhI yavikA, madhUlI godhUmabhedaH| ityayamatra ‘iti’ prakArArthaH| samApta iti vaktavye samApyata iti yat karoti, tena j~jApayati- yat- bahudravyatvAnnAyaM samApto gaNaH, kintu yathAkatha~jcit prasiddhaguNakathanena samApyate| evamanyatrApi ShaShTho vargaH samApyata ityAdau vyAkhyeyam||21-22||

surA anuddhRutamaNDA| madirA tu surAmaNDaH| jagalaH bhaktakiNvakRutA surA| ariShTa auShadhakvAthamadhvAdisampAdito vakShyamANo dantyabhayAriShTAdiH| shArkaraH sharkarAprakRutika AsavaH| pakvarasaH yaH kvathitenekShurasena kriyate| shItarasikastu shItekShurasakRutaH| gauDaH guDaprakRutikaH| surAsavaH yatra surayaiva toyakAryaM kriyate| madhUkapuShpakRuto madhvAsavaH| maireyalakShaNaM yathA- “Asavasya surAyAshca dvayorekatra bhAjane| sandhAnaM tadvijAnIyAnmaireyamubhayAshrayam” iti| dhAtakyA~abhiShuto dhAtakIphalAsavaH| mAdhvIkaM madhupradhAnaM ‘rocanaM dIpanaM’ ityAdinA vakShyamANaM; tadvanmRudvIkekShurasAbhyAM militAbhyAM kRuta Asavo j~jeyaH| madhviti madhupradhAna AsavaH| surA samaNDeti yavataNDulakRutA boddhavyA| viShTabhyeti vicchedaH| madhUlakaH godhUmabhedaH, tatkRutaM madyaM madhUlakam; anye tu medakamAhuH| dIpanamityAdi sauvIratuShodakaguNaH| amlakA~jjikamiti kA~jjikamevAmlaguNam||179-195||

dhAnyatvena shamIdhAnyavarge~abhidhAtavye pradhAnatvAnmudgo nirucyate| sUpyaM sUpayogyaM shamIdhAnyaM, tatrottamaH sUpyottamaH | vRuShya ityAdimAShaguNe srigdhoShNamadhuratvAdiguNayogAdeva vAtaharatve labdhe punastadabhidhAnaM visheShavAtahantRutvapratipAdanArtham, evamanyatrApyeva~jjAtIye vyAkhyeyam| puMstvaM shukram| shIghramitivacanena shukrasrutikaratvalakShaNamapi vRuShyatvaM mAShasya darshayati, shukrasrutikaraM ca vRuShyashabdenocyata eva, vacanaM hi- “shukrasrutikaraM ki~jcit ki~jcit shukravivardhanam| srutivRuddhikaraM ki~jcittrividhaM vRuShyamucyate” iti; tadevaM sampUrNavRuShyatvaM mAShe boddhavyam| rAjamAShaguNakathane tatsvAduriti mAShavatsvAduH; kiMvA rUkShashcetyAdi pAThAntaram| uShNa ityAdinA kulatthaguNaH, kulatthashca shuklakRuShNacitralohitabhedena caturvidho bhavati, tathA grAmyavanyabhedena ca dvividho~api; ata eva tantrAntare “vanyaH kulatthastadvacca visheShAnnetraroganut” ityuktam| makuShTako ‘moTha’ iti khyAtaH| caNakaH prasiddhaH| khaNDikA tripuTakalAyaH, hareNuH vartulakalAyaH| kalAyo vAtala iti tripuTakalAyaH| tilaguNo yadyapi visheSheNa noktaH, tathA~api pradhAne kRuShNatile j~jeyaH; uktaM hi sushrute- “tileShu sarveShvasitaH pradhAno, madhyaH sito, hInatarAstato~anye” (su. 46) iti | vividhAH shimbIjAtaya iti kRuShNapItaraktashvetakushimbIbhedA ityarthaH| ‘shimbI rUkShA’ ityAdi kecit paThanti| ADhakI tuvarI vAtaleti cchedaH| kaphavAtanudityavalgujaiDagajayorbIjasya guNaH| niShpAvo vallaH| kAkANDaH shUkarashimbiH , umA atasI, UrNApAThapakShe tasyaivorNA| shamIdhAnyavarga ityatra shamI shimbiH, tadantargataM dhAnyam||23-34||

vakShyamANaguNavisheShahetumAha- bhraShTamityAdi| pAtramapekShata iti nadyAdipAtravisheShasambandhamapekShya guNavisheShavadbhavati| etacca yadyApi ‘deshakAlAvapekShata’ ityanena pUrvamevoktaM, tathA~api kAlApekShayA deshavisheShasya prakarSheNa guNavisheShe hetutApradarshanArthaM punaruktam| kecittu “shvete kaShAyaM bhavati” ityAdigranthaM paThanti, sa tu nAtiprasiddhaH||198-208||

AdhAravisheShe guNavisheShamAha- nadya ityAdi| pAShANairvicchinnaM vikShubdhamabhihataM codakaM yAsAM tAstathA; etena, adhityakAprabhavA eva himAlaye nadyaH pathyA uktA bhavanti nopatyakAprabhavAH, yato~adhityakAprabhavAsveva pAShANavicchinnatvAdi; atashca sushrute yaduktaM- “himavatprabhavA hRudrogAdIn janayanti” (su. sU. 45) iti, tadupatyakAprabhavAbhiprAyeNeti na virodhaH| yattu tatroktaM “malayaprabhavAH krimI~jjanayanti” (su. sU. 45) tadapAShANasikatAvAhinadyabhiprAyeNa, iha pAShANasikatAvAhinadIShvamRutopamiti na virodhaH| yattu, pAriyAtrabhavAnAM shirorogAdikartRutvaM, tat pAriyAtradarIbhavanadIjalAbhiprAyeNa, sushrute tu pAriyAtrataDAgabhavanadIjalAbhiprAyeNoktaM- “pAriyAtrabhavAH pathyAH” (su. sU. 45) iti| taduktaM vishvAmitreNa- “taDAgajaM darIjaM ca taDAgAdyat sarijjalam| balArogyakaraM tat syAddarIjaM doShalaM matam” iti| prAyograhaNAt pUrvasamudragamane~api gA~ggaM pathyaM bhavati; kiMvA yathoktalakShaNahimAlayabhavatvAdeva gA~ggaM jalaM pathyam| pAriyAtrAdayaH parvatAH svanAmaprasiddhAH||209-212||

varShAsu jalaM vahantIti varShAjalavahAH; yaduktamagryAdhikAre “varShAnAdeyamudakAnAm” (sU. 25) iti, tasyehApathyatve upapattivarNanamiti na paunaruktyam| prasravaNAdiShvityatra ‘jalaM’ iti sheShaH| vApyAdayo~anUpadeshe dhanvani himAliyAdiparvateShu ca bhaveyuH, tatashcAnUpAdijalaguNaireva tadguNanirdeshaH kartavyaH; pashcimAbhimukhanadIjalapUrvAbhimukhanadIjalAnUpajalakhadhanvajalaparvatajalaguNAshcoktA eva, tena tadguNAtidesho vApyAdiShu boddhavyaH| uktaM ca hArItena- “anUpadeshe yadvAri guru tacchleShmavardhanam| viparItamato mukhyaM jA~ggalaM laghu cocyate” iti| sushrute~api vApyAdInAM pRuthageva guNa uktaH; sa ceha kUpAdInAM sakShAratvAdiH pratyakShadRuShTo granthavistarabhayAnnokta iti mantavyam| vApI iShTakAdibaddhatIrthA dIrghikA; kUpaH prasiddhaH; taTAdAgo gatiryasya sa taDAgaH, sa punaruccadeshAdAgacchajjalabandhanAdbhavati, anye tu puShkarINIM taDAgamAhuH; utsA nimnAduttiShThajjalasthAnaM; saro divyakhAtaM puruShavyApAraM vinA, tatpunaH pampAdi; prasravaNaH nirjharaH| anye tu ‘hradadhArAjalAdiShu’ iti paThanti; tatra hradaH nadIsthajalapradesho gambhIro jalAshayaH, dhArA tu parvatAdeva jaladhArArUpA patantI; AdigrahaNAt kedAracuNDAdInAM grahaNam| klinnaM parNAdibhiryutaM sadityarthaH| varuNAlaye samudre| visram Amagandhi| suvinishcita iti sarvajalaguNakathanAt||213-216||

jIvanIyasAmAnyAjjalamanu kShIramucyate , kShIrajatvAddadhyAdayashcocyante| prasannamiti nirdoShaM, nirdoShatA tu prashastatvena guNa ityucyate; kiMvA guNAnAmasa~gkhyeyatvena prasannatvaM gurvAdyapaThitamapi guNa eveti j~jeyam| eva~gguNameveti svAdvAdidashaguNam| sAmAnyAditi samAnatvAt| mahiShIkShIraguNe snehAdUnamiti mahiShIkShIraM gavyakShIrAt snehonaM, gauravashaityAbhyAM tu tadadhikamiti kecidbruvate; tanna, pratyakShameva hi mahiShIkShIrAdadhikameva ghRutaM dRushyate; tathA jatUkarNe~apyuktaM- “guru shItaM snigdhataraM mAhiShamatibalyaM bRuMhaNaM cAgryam” iti, sushrute~apyuktaM- “gavyAt snigdhataraM” (sU. 45) iti; tasmAt ‘snehAnyUnaM’ iti pAThaH; tena snehAdadhikamityarthaH; kiMvA snehAnyUnamiti snehapUrNamityarthaH| uShTrIkShIrAdInAM salavaNatvAdi madhurAnurasatvena boddhavyaM; madhurastu rasaH pradhAna eva, dIrgha~jjIvitIye ‘prAyasho madhuraM’ (sU. 1) ityuktaM, na tu sarvathA madhurameva| aikashaphamiti vaDavAyAH | kecittu sarvashabdena kharavegasarayorapi kShIrasyAyaM guNa iti vadanti| uShNamiti kShIrAntarApekShayA, tena sAmAnyaguNe shItatvamuktamaviruddhaM bhavati, yato laghUttamAttiktarasAdgururapi kaTu laghurevocyate madhurAdyapekShayA, evaM shItatamAditarakShIrAduShNamapi vaDavAyAH kShIraM shItameva mUtramadhvAdyapekShayA bhavati; evaM rUkShamityetadapi vyAkhyeyam| yadyapi ca hastinIkShIrAdIni shAstre prayogeShu noktAni, tathA~api kathitaguNaM buddhvA tatra tatra prayojyAni||217-224||

dadhiguNamAha- rocanamityAdi| atra rocanamityuktvA~api arucAviti vacanamarucirogaharatvena, rocanatA tUpayogakAla eva dravyAntararucikaratvenoktA| bRuMhaNamiti rogAdikRushasya bRuMhaNaM, kArshye ceti sahaje kArshye shasyata iti boddhavyaM; tena na paunaruktyam| pInase caturvidhe~api prabhAvAddhitaM; kiMvA pInasapAcakatvAt sarvatra hitam| yacca vRuShyashItakahitatvAdi dadhiguNaparyAlocanayA~anupapadyamAnamiha dRushyate, tat prabhAvAdboddhavyam| yacca guNAntarAdevAmlatvoShNatvasnigdhatvAllabhyamAnamapi vAtaghnatvaM punarucyate tat prakarShArthaM, tathA amlatvAdiyuktasyApi vAtahantRutAdivyabhicAradarshanAditi boddhavyam| vyabhicArodAharaNAni ca mandakamandajAtamadyAdInyanusartavyAni| nyAyashcAyaM sarvAnnapAnaguNakathane yathAsambhavaM varNanIyaH, granthapracurataratAbhItyA sarvaM vastu vayamatra nodbhAvayAmaH| prAyasha iti vacanAt kAlAntare~api garhitatvaM sharadAdAvapi ca prakRutyAdivashAddhitatvaM darshayati||225-227||

utpAdakramAgatasya ghRutasya guNamAha- smRutItyAdi| sahasravIryamiti bhUrishaktikam| kathaM sahasravIryamityAha- vidhivaditi| vidhivad vidhiyuktaM sadityarthaH, vidhishca nAnAkarmakAribhirdravyaiH saMskAraH saMyogashca, ata evoktaM- “nAnyaH snehastathA kashcit saMskAramanuvartate” (ni. 1) iti, tathA tantrAntare “ghRutaM yogavAhi” iti; tasmAt sahasravIryataH karmasahasrakRuditi yojyam| yattu sushrutaTIkAkRutaH sushrutoktaghRutaguNeShu “tridoShApakarShaNaM” iti paThanti, tat saMskAreNa kaphaharaNAditi j~jeyam| madetyAdi| jIrNaM tu dashavarShAtItaM; vacanaM hi- “purANaM dashavarShaM syAt prapurANamataH param” iti| yathA yathA ca jIrNatvaprakarShastathA tathA guNotkarSho j~jeyaH| uktaM hi hArIte- “yathA yathA jarAM yAti guNavat syAttathA tathA” iti| anuktasarpirguNAnatidishati- sarpIMShItyAdi| sarpIMShi svAnIti sambandhaH; tena, ajAkShIravadajAsarpirnirdishediti| evaM sheShayorapi vAcyam| anena ca nyAyena hastinyAdisarpirapi boddhavyaM, hastinyAdisarpirvyavahArAbhAvAt sAkShAnnoktam||231-233||-

pIyUShaH sadyaHprasUtAyAH kShIram| tadeva yAvanna parataH prasannatAM yAti tAvat ‘moraTa’ ityucyate| kilATo naShTakShIrabhAgaH, yaM lokAH kShIrasAmityAhuH| vishada ityAdistakrapiNDakaguNaH, takrapiNDaH takrakUrcikAyA eva srutadravo ghano bhAgaH| gorasAnAmityatra Adishabdo luptanirdiShTo draShTavyaH, tena mahiShIkShIrAdInAmapi grahaNaM; kiMvA prAdhAnyAdgorasanirdeshaH; gorasabhAShayA gorasaniShpannAH sarva eva kShIradadhitakrAdayo gRuhyante; loke hi sarveShvevaiShu gorasasa~jj~jA||234-236||

prabhUtakrimyAdikAraNatvAt prabhUtakrimyAdikaro guDa ucyate| kShudraguDastathA caturbhAgatribhAgArdhAvasheShito rasa ityatra cakAralopo draShTavyaH; tena kShudraguDashcaturbhAgAvasheShitAdrasAdguruH, tathA tribhAgAccaturbhAgAvasheShito gururityAdi j~jeyam| kShudraguDo~asitaguDa ityucyate| phANitaM ca tantulIbhAvAdbhavati| dhautaH svalpamala iti malAvasekena dhauto~alpamalo bhavati, tenAlpakrimyAdirbhavatIti bhAvaH| tata iti dhautaguDAt| matsyaNDikA khaNDamadhye pAkAdghanIbhUtA matsyANDanibhA bhavati| vimalAH paramityuttarottaraM vimalAH| bhavecchaityaM tathA tatheti matsyaNDikAyAshca khaNDaH shItataraH, tatashca sharkarA shItatametyarthaH| guDasharkareti yAsamadhusharkarayorvyavacchedArtham| yAsasharkarA durAlabhAkvAthakRutA sharkarA| madhusharkarA tu madhubhANDeShu sharkarAkArA bhavati||238-242||

sUpyAnantaraM mAMsasya vya~jjanatvena prAdhAnyAnmAMsavargAbhidhAnam| kharaH gardabhaH; ashvataraH vegasaraH, sa cAshvAyAM kharAjjAtaH; dvIpiH citravyAghraH; RukShaH bhallUkaH| vRukaH kukkurAnukArI pashushatruH; tarakShuH vyAghrabhedaH ‘taraccha’ iti khyAtaH; babhruH atilomashaH kukkuraH parvatopakaNThe bhavati, kecidbRuhannakulamAhuH| lopAkaH svalpashRugAlo mahAlA~ggUlaH| shyenaH pakShI prasiddhaH| vAntAdaH kukkuraH| cAsaH(ShaH) ‘kanakavAyasa ’ iti khyAtaH| shashaghnI ‘pA~jjiH’ iti khyAtA| bhAsaH bhasmavarNaH pakShI shikhAvAn prasahavarge| kuli~ggaH kAlacaTakaH||35-36||-

kAkulImRugaH ‘mAluyAsarpa’ iti khyAtaH, tasya shveta ityAdayashcatvAro bhedAH| kUrcikA sa~gkucaH| cillaTaH ciyAraH| shallakaH mahAshakalI, ‘shalaka’ iti khyAtaH; gaNDakaH godhAbhedaH| kadalI ‘kadalIhaTTa’ iti khyAtaH| shvAvit ‘sejjaka’ iti khyAtaH| bhUmishayA bileshayAH||37-38||

haMsashcaturvidho~api rAjahaMsAdirgrAhyaH| krau~jcaH ‘ko~jca’ iti khyAtaH| bakaH pANDurapakShaH| balAkA shuklA| kAraNDavaH kAkavaktraH| plavaH svanAmaprasiddhaH prasevagalaH| sharAriH ‘sharAlI’ iti loke| madguH pAnIyakAkaH| kAdambaH kalahaMsaH| kAkatuNDakaH shvetakAraNDavaH| utkroshaH ‘kurala’ iti khyAtaH| puNDarIkAkShaH puNDaraH| megharAvaH meghanAdaH; megharAvashcAtaka ityanye, tanna tasya vAricaratvAbhAvAt| ambukukkuTI jalakukkuTI| ArA svanAmakhyAtA| nandImukhI patrATI| sArasaH prasiddhaH| raktashIrShakaH sArasabhedo lohitashirAH| ambucAriNa iti jale plavanta ityarthaH||41-44||

pRuShataH citrahariNaH| sharabhaH aShTApada uShTrapramANo mahAshRu~ggaH pRuShThagatacatuShpAdaH kAshmIre prasiddhaH| rAmaH himAlaye mahAmRugaH| shvadaMShTraH caturdaMShTraH kArtikapure prasiddhaH| mRugamAtRukA svalpA pRuthUdarA hariNajAtiH| kura~ggaH hariNabhedaH| gokarNaH gomukhahariNavisheShaH | hariNaH tAmravarNaH, eNaH kRuShNasAraH| RuShyaH nIlANDo hariNaH| cAruShkAdayo~api hariNabhedA eva| shashastu sushrute bileshayeShu paThitaH, tadadUrAntarArtham||45-46||

lAvaH prasiddhaH| vartIraH kapi~jjalabhedaH| kapi~jjalaH gauratittiriH| vArtIkaH caTakabhedaH sa~gghAtacArI| upacakraH cakorabhedaH| kukkubhaH prasiddhaH; raktavartmaka iti kukkubhavisheShaNaM, tena sthUlakukkubho gRuhyate| vartakaH ‘vaTTahI’ iti khyAtaH| vArtikA svalpapramANA jAtyantarameva, kecittu vartakastriyaM vartikAM vadanti; asyAshca grahaNaM strIli~ggabhede~api visheShalAghavapratiShedhArtham, anyathA strItvena vartikAdvartikAyA lAghavaM syAt| barhI mayUraH| shArapadendrAbhaH mallaka~gkaH| gonardo ‘ghoDAka~gka’ iti khyAtaH| krakaraH prasiddhaH| lAvAdivartikAdiviShkiragaNadvayakaraNaM guNabhedakathanArtham||47-49||

shatapatraH kAShThakukkuTakaH| bhRu~ggarAjaH prasiddho bhramaravarNaH| koyaShTiH ‘koDA’ iti khyAtaH| jIva~jjIvakaH viShadarshanamRutyuH| atyUhaH DAhukaH, ‘dAtyUha’ iti vA pAThaH, sa ca prasiddhaH| laTTA phe~jcAko raktapucchAdhobhAgaH, laTUShako~api tadbhedaH| DiNDimAnakaH DiNDimavadutkaTadhvaniH| kuli~gga iti vanacaTakAkAraH pItamastakaH ‘vAai’ iti loke| kalavi~gkaH grAmyacaTakaH| caTakastu devakulacaTakaH svalpapramANaH| yAnyatrAnuktAnyaprasiddhAni tAni tadvidbhyo deshAntaribhyashca j~jeyAni||50-52||-

prasahAdisa~jj~jAniruktyA lakShaNamAha| prasahyeti haThAt| AnUpAnUpasaMshrayAditi pUrvatrAsiddhavidheranityatvenAnUpA ityatra yalopasya siddhatvenaiva saMhitA j~jeyA| jalecaryAditi jalavAsinAmeva haMsAdInAM jale caraNamAtratvaM boddhavyam| ‘sthalajA’ ityukte gajAdiShvapi sthalajAteShu prasaktiH syAdityAha- jA~ggalacAriNa iti| vikIryetyatra ‘bhakShayanti’ iti sheShaH; evaM pratudyetyatrApi, pratudyeti bahudhA~abhihatya||53-55||-

prasahA dvividhA mAMsAdA vyAghrashyenAdayaH, tathA amAMsAdAshca gavAdayaH; tena mAMsAdAnAM visheShamAha- prasahAnAmityAdi| jIrNatvenArshaHprabhRutInAM cirAnubandhaM darshayati| pratudA ityatra tathA jA~ggalA ityatra cakAro luptanirdiShTaH| kaphAnuge iti cchedaH||56-60||-

sharIradhAtusAmAnyAditi manuShyamAMsasamAnatvAt| etena shItagurusnigdhatvena yuktamapyAjamAMsaM sharIradhAtusAmyAt kaphaM na karotItyuktaM bhavati| AvikaM mAMsaM madhurashItatvena pittaharamapi boddhavyam, ata eva sharadvidhAvapyuktam- “urabhrasharabhAn” (sU. 6) iti| raktapittanidAne (ni. 2) tu varAhamahiShetyAdinA dravyAntarasaMyuktasyaivAvikamAMsasya raktapittakartRutvaM j~jeyam| yonAviti prasahAdyaShTavidhajAtau| mishragocaratvAditi kadAcidanUpasevanAt, kadAciddhanvasevanAt, kadAcidubhayasevanAdajAvyoranishcitayonitvamityarthaH| atra, ‘anishcite’ iti yonivisheShaNaM, kiMvA ajA ca avI ca ete anishcite| nanu yadyevaM tadA tittirirapi dhanvAnUpasevanAnna viShkiragaNe paThanIyaH| naivaM, tittirijAtivisheShasya dhanvAnUpayorniyamena niShevaNAdguNaniyamaH pAryate kartum; avyajayostu niyamo~ayaM nAsti, yataH kecidajAvI dhanvamAtracare, keciccAnUpamAtracare, keciccobhayAmAtracare; tena tayorniyamacarakRuto yonibhedaH kartuM na pAryate||61-62||-

keShA~jciditi vakShyamANamayUrAdInAm| guNavaisheShyAditi vishiShTaguNashAlitvAt| mayUrasya gurutvasnigdhatvaM vartakAdigaNapaThitatvenaiva labdhaM sat punarucyate visheShArtham| evamanyatrApi gaNoktaguNakathanena labdhasya punaH kathane vyAkhyeyam| caraNAyudhaH kukkuTaH| dhanvAnUpaniShevaNAditi hetukathanena ya eva dhanvAnUpaniShevI tittiriH sa eva yathoktaguNa iti j~jeyam| evamanye~api ye gavAdayo dhanvAnUpaniSheviNaste~api tittirisamAnaguNA bhavanti, tittiristu visheSheNeti tittiriH sAkShAduktaH| kiMvA, tittirereva eva~gguNatve dhanvAnUpaniShevaNaM hetuH, nAnyatra gavAderanUpadeshAderiti j~jeyam| kapotA gRuhavAsina iti pArAvatAH| caTakA madhurA ityAdi kecit paThantyeva, ye tu na paThanti teShAM mate caTakasya pratudasAmAnyaguNalabdhaM vRuShyatvaM “tRuptiM caTakamAMsAnAM gatvA yo~anupibet payaH” (ci. 2) ityAdivRuShyaprayogAdeva labhyate| mayUrAdInAM tu bahavo guNA gaNoktaguNAdhikA iti pRuthak pAThaH kRutaH| “mAMsaM bRuMhaNAnAm” (sU. 25) ityanenaivAgryAdhikAravacanena mAMsasya bRuMhaNatve labdhe ‘sharIrabRuMhaNe nAnyat’ ityAdivacanaM prakaraNaprAptatvena tathA tasyaivArthasya dArDhyArthaM ca j~jeyam||63-87||-

shAkAnAmapi vya~jjanatvenAnantaramupadeshaH| shuShA kAsamardaH| shaTI svanAmaprasiddhA| vAstukaM Ta~gkavAstukam| nAtyuShNashItavIryeti noShNatvaM prakarShaprAptamasyA nApi shItatvamityarthaH| yattu sushrute “tiktA kAkamAcI vAtaM shamayati, uShNavIryatvAt” (su. sU. 40) ityuktaM tadvIryavAdimatena, ata eva dravyaguNe sushrute~api “nAtyuShNashItA” (su. sU. 46) ityevameva paThitam| rAjakShavakaH dugdhikA| kAlashAkaM ‘kAliyA’ iti khyAtaM, kAlAkhyamiti kAlashAkamevocyate punaH; anye tu ‘kAlAyaM’ iti paThanti| maNDUkaparNI maNimaNIti khyAtA| kucelA akarNaviddhakAbhedaH| vanatiktakaM pathyasundaram| avalgujo vAlgujI| shakulAdanI kaTurohiNI| shAr~ggeShTA kAkatiktA| kaThillakaH punarnavA| nADI nADIcaH| kalAyo vartulakalAyaH| tilaparNikA hulahulikA| gojihvA dArvipatrikA| kulakaH kAravellakaH, kecittu kulakaM paTolabhedamAhuH| karkashaH svalpakarkoTakaH||88-97||-

sUpyashAkAni mAShaparNyAdIni| pha~jjI brAhmaNayaShTikA| cillI gauDavAstukaH| kutumbakaH droNapuShpikA| AlukAni piNDAlukAdIni| karbudAraH kA~jcanaH| suvarcalA sUryabhaktikA, kecit phappukamAhuH| pattUraH shAli~jcaH| cuccuparNikA nADIcabhedaH| kumArajIvaH jIvashAkam| loTTAkaH loTTAmAriShaH| nAlikA gonADIcaH| AsurI rAjikA maNDako vA| vRukadhUmakaH bhUmishirIShaH| lakShmaNA svanAmakhyAtA| nalinI padmamRuNAlaM, nIlinItipAThapakShe buhnA| yavashAkaM kShetravAstukam| kUShmANDaH sarpacchatram| avalgujamiti avalgujabhedaH| yAtukaH shuklA shAlaparNI| shAlakalyANI shAli~jcabhedaH| triparNI haMsapAdikA| pIluparNI moraTakaH| gaNDIraH shamaThaH| bilvaparNI bilvArjakam| bhaNDI svanAmakhyAtA| parvaNI parvashAkam| parvapuShpI kukkuTI| pa~jcA~ggulaH citrairaNDaH| ervArukaM rAjakarkaTI| kUShmANDakaM sushrute bAlyAdyavasthAbhedena paThitaM tadapyaviruddhabheva, yato bAlamadhyayostatra pittaharatvaM kaphakaratvaM coktaM, tadapIha pittottare kaphottare sannipAte boddhavyam||98-113||

madhusharkarAprasa~ggena madhvabhidhAnam| makShikAH pi~ggalAH, tadbhavaM mAkShikam| bhramaraH prasiddhaH| kShudramakShikAbhavaM kShaudram| pi~ggalA makShikA mahatyaH puttikAH, tadbhavaM pauttikam| chatrAdayashcApare catvAro madhubhedAH sushrutoktAH sAmAnyamadhuguNA eva j~jeyAH; kiMvA aprashastatvAdiha noktAH| kecit ‘mAkShikaM tailavarNaM syAt’ ityAdishlokaM paThanti| uShNArtamathaveti bhAShayA, yathA uShNaM madhu hanyAnna tathA uShNArtamiti sUcayati| tatraiva hetumAha- saviShAnvayAditi|- saviShANi nAnApuShpANi, kiMvA saviShA eva makShikAdayaH, anvayA utpattisthAnAni yasya tat saviShAnvayaM madhu; tena viShAnugatasyoShNavirodhitvasyaiva madhuno~anugamo bhavati, na tu saviShatvasya; tathA satyuShNamapi mArakaM syAt; kiMvA athaveti saviShAnvayAdityanena sambadhyate, tena saviShAnvayAdanyatashca shaityAt saukumAryAccoShNena madhu virudhyata ityartho bhavati| uktaM hi hArIte- “nAnApuShpaprakArANAM rasasArAtmakaM madhu| tacchaityAt saukumAryAcca sarvairuShNairvirudhyate” iti; sushrute~apyuktaM- “tat saukumAryAcca tathaiva shaityAt” (su. sU. 45) ityAdi| alpasya madhuno hitatve hetumAha- gurvityAdi| gurutvAnmadhvAmakArakaM bhavati, rUkShaM kaShAyashItaM tu mahAtyayavAtakaramiti bhAvaH||243-246||
madhvAmasya mahAtyayatAmAha- nAta ityAdi| upakramavirodhitvaM madhvAme yathA- Ame tUShNaM pathyaM, tanmadhuni viruddhaM; yattu madhuhitaM shItaM, tadAme viruddham||247-248||

samprati shUkadhAnyAdivargauryathAsambhavaM sampAditasya kRutAnnasya peyAderguNAn vaktuM kRutAnnavarga ucyate | te ca peyAdInAM guNAH kecit saMskArasaMyogAdijAH, kecit prAkRutA api j~jeyAH| na ca vAcyaM- peyAdInAmeva guNena bAdhitatvAcchUkadhAnyAdInAM pRuthagguNo na vAcya iti; yataH peyAdayo hi prakRutiguNAnuvidhAyinaH santaH svaguNamAvahanti, tena kRutAnnasya yo guNa ucyate sa yadi raktashAlyAdiprakRutAvapi bhavati tadA balavAn bhavati, atha prakRutau viparIto guNo bhavati tadA kRutAnnaguNasyAlpatvaM bhavatIti mantavyam| atra svasthAturahitatvenAdau peyocyate; peyA bahudravA yavAgUH, vilepI viraladravA yavAgUH| peyAdikrameNAnne vaktavye annAt prathamotpadyamAnatvena maNDaguNakathanam| dIpanalaghutvAbhyAmagniM yasmAt karoti, tasmAlla~gghitAdInAM prANadhAraNa iti j~jeyam| susaMskRuta iti dhAnyakapippalyAdisusaMskRutaH| shuddhAnAM malApaha iti samyakshuddhAnAmapi koShThopalepakadoShApaharatvena; yaducyate- shuddhAnAmiti IShacchuddhAnAM; tena, IShacchuddhyA sheShadoShasambandhAnmalApaha ityupapannaM, sushrute~api (su.sU.a.46) “lAjamaNDo~avishuddhAnAM” ityakAraprashleShAdIShadvishuddhAnAmiti bodhyam| tanna sat, IShadvishuddhe peyA niShiddhaiva, vacanaM hi- “kaphapitte vishuddhe~alpe madyape vAtapaittike| tarpaNAdikramaH kAryaH peyA~abhiShyandayeddhi tAn” (si.a.6) iti||250-256||-

svinna ityutsvinnadhAnyataNDulakRutaH, kiMvA samyaksvinnatvena mRudubhUtaH| santapta iti sahajenoShmaNA, na tu punastApanena; vacanaM hi- “vivarjayet sthiraM shItamannamuShNIkRutaM punaH” iti| bhRuShTataNDulakRuta odano bhRuShTataNDulaH| adhAtaH adhautataNDulakRutaH| atra sudhautatvAdiguNavishiShTasyAdanasya laghutvaMvacanena tadviparItAnAmadhautAdInAM gurutvamarthataH siddhamapi yat punarucyate tat spaShTArtham| santarpaNA iti tadAtve~api balakarAH| mAMsAdisaMyogasAdhitAshcaudanA eva boddhavyAH| atra rUkShAbhyAM shAkamudgAbhyAmapi saMyuktasyaudanasya balyatvAdi saMyogamahimnA tathA ghRutAdisaMskArAcca lokavyavahArakriyamANatvAdboddhavyam ||257-259||-

yavapiShTamuShNodakasiktamIShatsvinnamapUpIkRutaM kulmAShamAhuH| svinnabhakShyA ityutsvedanamAtrakRutA haNDarikAdayaH| yathAdravyamiti vadatA nAtra prakRutiguNopamardena lAjAdAviva guNAntarodaya iti darshayati||260-261||

saktUnAM rUkShatve~api vAtalatvAbhidhAnaM takrasya rUkShasyApi vAtahAritvadarshanAt| pItA ityanena saktUnAM piNDopayoge niShedhaM darshayati| tarpayanti tRuptiM janayanti| sadyobalAH tadAtvenaiva vAjIkaraNavadbalakarAH; etena pariNAme balApahatvamapyuktaM bhavati||263-264||

yavakRuto vATyo yAvako vATyaH, vATyashca bhRuShTayavaudanaH| dhAnA bhRuShTayavAH| a~gkuritasya yavasya dhAnA virUDhadhAnAH| shaShkulyaH shAlipiShTaiH satilaistailapakvAH kriyante| madhukroDAH pAkaghanIbhUtamadhugarbhAH| sapiNDakA iti madhukroDA eva sapiShTakapiNDAH; nalastvAha- “vimardya samitAcUrNaM mRudupAkaM guDAnvitam| ghRutAvagAhe guDikAM vRuttAM pakvAM sakesharAm|| saugandhikAdhivAsAM ca kuryAt pUpalikAM budhaH| sa eva khaNDasaMyAvaH sitAmrAtakapUritaH|| mAtulu~ggatvacA caiva veShTito madhushIrShakaH” iti| madhushIrShaka eva madhukroDaH| pUpAH piShTikAH| pUpalikA cApaDiketi khyAtA||265-267||

palalaM tilacUrNam| veshavAraH sUdashAstre- “mAMsaM nirasthi susvinnaM punardRuShadi peShitam| pippalIshuNThimaricaguDasarpiHsamanvitam|| aikadhyaM vipacet samyagveshavAra iti smRutaH”| kShIrapradhAnAH pUpAH kShIrapUpAH| saguDA ityAdau ‘sakShIrAH’ iti kShIrayogamAtraM, na kShIrapradhAnateti na paunaruktyam||268-270||

sasnehA iti piShTAvasthAyAmeva snehayogAt| gurutvenoktAnAmapi bhUryagnisaMyogAdinA saMskArAllAghavaM bhavatItyAha- saMskArAllaghava ityAdi| buddhvA nirdishediti saMskAraguNaM tathA prakRutiguNaM ca buddhvA yathocitaM guNaM nirdishet||271-272||
rasAlAlakShaNaM- “sacaturjAtakAjAji sasitArdrakanAgaram| rasAlA syAcchikhariNI sa~gghRuShTaM sasaraM dadhi” iti| rasAlAprasa~ggena saguDadadhiguNamAha- snehanamityAdi||277-278||

pAnakAnAmapi kRutAnnabhedatvAttadguNamAha- drAkShetyAdi| yaccekShuvikRutiM prati pAnakamiti sambandhaH| rAgaShADavaM kecidevaM vadanti- “kvathitaM tu guDopetaM sahakAraphalaM navam| tailanAgarasaMyuktaM vij~jeyo rAgaShADavaH” iti; kiMvA , “sitArucakasindhUtthaiH savRukShAmlaparUShakaiH| jambUphalarasairyukto rAgo rAjikayA~anvitaH” iti| ShADavastu madhurAmladravyakRutaH| AmrAmalakalehAstu tayoH pRuthakkvAthena sasharkareNa ghanAH kriyante| anuktapAnakaguNAtideshArthamAha- buddhvetyAdi| asya dravyasaMyogetyAdivadvyAkhyAnam||279-283||

shuktalakShaNaM- “yanmastvAdi shucau bhANDe saguDakShaudrakA~jjikam| dhAnyarAshau trirAtrasthaM shukraM cukraM taducyate” iti| tadAsutamiti shuktamadhyasthitaM mUlakakUShmANDAdi| shiNDAkI svanAmaprasiddhA tIrabhuktau| AsutaM cAnyaditi sandhAnAntaram| kAlAmlamiti cirakAlAvasthAnAdamlaM, natvamladravyasaMyogAt| kRutAnnAnAmiti karaNaniShpAditamaNDapeyAdInAm||284-285||

AhAramabhidhAya tadyogidravyaM brUte| tatra sarpiSha uktatvAttailamevAnnasaMskArakapradhAnatvAdAha- kaShAyetyAdi| saMyogAcca saMskArAcceti saMyogasaMskArAt; saMskArastailasya bheShajaiH pAkaH, saMyogastvavacAraNAyAM j~jeyaH| sa~gkhye yuddhe| Atasyam umAtailam| anuktatailaguNanirdeshArthamAha- phalAnAmityAdi| phalAnAmityupalakShaNaM; tena sArasnehA api sushrutoktA boddhavyAH| yathAphalamiti yAdRushaguNaM phalaM tAdRusha eva tatsneho~apItyarthaH||286-294||

saukShmyAdityAdinA sauvarcalaguNaH| taikShNyAdityAdinA biDaguNaH| audbhidam utkArikAlavaNam | kAlalavaNaM sauvarcalamevAgandham| dakShiNasamudrasamIpe bhavatIti sAmudraM karakacam| pAMshujaM pUrvasamudrajam||296-304||
kShArANAmapi lavaNasattvAt kShAraguNamAha- hRudityAdi| yavakShAraguNaH| sarvaH kShAra iti svarjikAkShAraTa~gkanakShArAdiH||305-306||

sampratyuktAnAM shUkadhAnyAdInAM yadanuktaguNaM tadvaktumAha- shUkadhAnyamityAdi| samAtItamiti ekavarShAtItam| prashasyata iti lAghavAt; hemante navadhAnyavidhAnaM tvapavAdaH| Agacchati kShipramiti uptaM sacchIghraM bhavati; tena ShaShTikAH sarvadhAnyeShu laghavaH, te hi ShaShTirAtreNa bhavanti| asmiMshca vyAkhyAne, vrIheH shAradasya ca haimantaM shAliM pratyalpakAlatvena laghutvaM prApnoti, tasmAt sajAtIya eva shIghragamanaM lAghavaheturiti vAcyam| kiMvA, Agacchati kShipramiti bhuktaM sat kShipraM pacyate| yuktibhRuShTam IShadbhRuShTamiti yAvat| sUpyaM sUpAya yogyaM mudgamAShAdi||309-310||

mAMsarasaguNAH- prINana ityAdi| sarvarogaprashamanamiti sarvashabdo bhUrivacanaH; etena unmAdAdau mAMsaniShedho na virodhavAn bhavati; uktaM hi unmAde- “nivRuttAmiShamadyo yaH” (ci. 9) ityAdi| yathAsvamiti yasya vyAdheryo vihitaH, tAdRushaM rasam||312-315||

snehena vinA siddhaM niHsnehasiddham| Amamiti apakvam; etacca bilvAdIn vihAya boddhavyam| adeshajamiti anucitadeshabhavam| akAlajam anArtavam| sAdhanAdRuta iti haritAnAmArdrakapalANDuprabhRutInAM niHsnehasiddhAnAmapi tathA aparisrutAnAmapi nirdoShatvamityarthaH| vinishcayaH ‘kRuta’ iti sheShaH; tathAca madyAnAM ‘prAyasho~abhinavam’ ityAdinA guNadoShakathanaM kRutameva, evaM jale~api ‘picchilaM krimilam’ ityAdinA, gorasakRutAnnAhArayogivargeShu tu yathoktakartRuguNavadviparIte viparItaguNamanumeyamiti bhAvaH||316-318||

samprati yeShAM yadanupAnaM kartavyaM tadevAha- yadityAdi| AhAraguNairiti shItasnehamadhurAdibhiH; viparItamiti viparItaguNamanupeyam| evaM ca dadhno~amlasya madhuraM kShIraM tathA pAyasasya kA~jjikAnupAnaM syAdityAha- dhAtUnAM yanna virodhi ceti| evaM cAmle payo~anupIyamAnaM viruddhatvAddhAtuvirodhena pratyuktaM bhavati, evamanyadapi viruddhaM boddhavyam| samuddiShTamiti yajjaHpuruShIye (sU. 25)| peyamapeyaM ceti sahajaguNadoShavattvAt tathopayuktabhojanApekShayA| snigdhoShNamityAdinA doShabhedenApyanupAnamAha| anushastamiti anupAnaM shastam||319-324||
anupAnaguNAnAha- athetyAdi| paryAptiH tRuptiH| ||325-326||

yairanupAnaM na kartavyaM tAnAha- nordhvA~ggetyAdi| kaNThorasi sthitamiti anenordhvA~ggamArutAdInAmanupAnaM kaNThorasi sthitameva bhavati, nAdho yAtIti darshayati| snehamAhArajaM hatveti AhArajAtaM snehamabhibhUya bhUyo doShAya kalpate, vAtalakShaNaM doShaM karotItyarthaH| AhArasnehena yo vAtaprashamaH kartavyastaM shaityaprakarShAt pAnIyamabhibhavatItyarthaH| etena yaducyate- apAM snigdhatvena snehanamupapannamiti, tanna bhavati| ye tu bruvate- ‘hana’ hiMsAgatyoriti vacanAt snehaM hatveti snehaM gatvetyarthaH; tadapi na bhavati, yataH snehayuktatvenordhvA~ggamArutAdihananameva yuktaM, na tu karaNam| kiMvA snehamiti sAraM, yathA- “dehaH snehaparikShayAt” (ci. 8) iti dehasAraparikShayAdityarthaH, sArahananaM ca jalenAhArasnehaM gRuhItvA kaNThorasyavasthAnAdapAkAt kriyate ||327-328||

annapAnadravyaikadeshakathanaM sahetukamAha- annetyAdi| annapAnaikadeshaH prAyopayogika iti bAhulyena yadupayujyate; etena yadbAhulyenopayujyate tasya shRu~ggagrAhikayA kathanaM, prAyo~anupayujyamAnAnAM shRu~ggagrAhikayA~akathanamalpadoShamiti darshayati; tathA alpadoShasyApi parihArArthaM tadapi kimiti nocyata ityAha- dravyANItyAdi| dravyANi kArtsnyeneti sAkalyena nirdeShTuM; nAmabhiriti nAmabhirapi na shakyaM, ‘kenacit’ iti sheShaH; hishabdo yasmAdarthe, etena yasmAt sarvANi dravyANi nAmamAtreNApi vaktuM kashcinna pArayatyatibahutvAt, tat kA kathA asheShAnnapAnadravyasya shRu~ggagrAhikayA guNakathanaM pratIti bhAvaH| kiMvA, nAmabhirnirdiShTAni kArtsnyena nirdeShTumiti guNataH kathayituM na shakyaM kenaciditi yojanA| atha kathaM hyatrAkIrtitAnnapAnasya tarhi guNA nirdeShTavyA ityAha- yathetyAdi| yathA yena prakAreNa “nAnauShadhaM ki~jcit” (sU. 26) iti pUrvAdhyAye proktaM tathA tena prakAreNAnuktaM dravyaM vAcyaM; ‘guNataH’ iti sheShaH| pUrvAdhyAye hi “tatra dravyANi gurukhara” (sU. 26) ityAdinA granthena pArthivAdibhedena vishiShTena ca karmaNA proktAni dravyANi, tatashcAnuktaM dravyaM tenaiva gurukharAdinA guNena pArthivatvAdi pratipAdya yathoktopacayAdikarmakartRukatayA vyapadeShTavyamityarthaH| tadevAnirdiShTadravyasya gurukharatvAdi kathaM j~jeyamityAha- deshajAnAM vaco yatheti; deshajA deshAntarIyAH, taddeshIyavacanAtte te gurukharatvAdayo j~jeyA ityarthaH; kiMvA, deshajA yathA tattaddravyaM vyavaharanti ‘idaM madhuram, idamamlam’ ityAdi, tat pratipAdya madhuratvAmlatvAdipratipannapRuthivyAdyasya kAraNamiti pRuthivyAdInAM gurvAdiguNagaNena karmaNA ca rasoktena tadvaktavyamityarthaH||329-330||

caraM vivRuNoti- caro~anUpetyAdi| bhakShyasya saMvidhiH bhakShyabhakShaNam| tatrAnUpajalAkAshadhanvAdya ityanena gatirUpashcara ucyate, bhakShyasaMvidhivacanena ca bhakShyarUpashcara ucyate| atraivodAharaNamAha- jalajetyAdi| atra jalajatvenAnUpajatvena ca jale vA~anUpe vA gatireva dRushyate, na hi jalAdau ye jAtAste prAyo~anyatrAvatiShThante; ye tvanyatra jAtA apyanyatra tiShThante prAyaH kAkamadguprabhRutayastadgrahaNArthamAha- jalAnUpacarAshca ye iti| etena sAmAnyena jale prAyo~avasthAnAdiha jalacaratvam; evamanUpacaratvAdyapi j~jeyam| bhakShyarUpacarakRutaM guNamAha- gurubhakShyA ityAdi| dhanvajA dhanvacAriNa ityatra cakAro luptanirdiShTo draShTavyaH; tena, AkAshacAriNAmapi shyenAdInAmanuktamapi lAghavaM svajAtiprasahAntarApekShayA boddhavyam, AkAshasya laghutvAt| ye tu bruvate- AkAshacAriNAM gauravalAghavAniyamAdakathanamiti; tanna, tathA satyAkAshasyAprayojakatvena ‘caro~anUpajalAkAshadhanvAdyaH’ ityatrAkAshakathanaM niShprayojanaM syAt||332-333||

mAMsAdgurutaraM vidyAditi gurutvena pratipAditasakthyAdimAMsAdvRuShaNAdi gurutaraM vidyAditi| yathAsvamiti ekasharIrasakthyAdInAmevaitadgauravAdi, natvanyasharIrApekShayA| madhyamiti antarAdhiH| asthi iti asthisthitaM mAMsam| anye tu madhyamiti asthimadhyagataM majjAnaM bruvate; tannAtisundaraM, tasyottarottaradhAtugauravakathanenaiva labdhatvAt||334-335||
svabhAvAditi prakRutyA| kriyodAharaNam- alasebhya ityAdi; alasebhya iti alpakriyebhyaH| vishiShyanta iti vishiShTA bhavanti, laghavo bhavantItyarthaH||336-337||

alpAdAna ityAdi| gurUNAM dravyANAmalpasya stokamAtrasyAdAne yallAghavaM, tasmin lAghave mAtrA kAraNaM; na dravyaM, tasya gurutvAt| evaM laghUnAmatisevane gauravaM mAtrAkRutam| uddiShTamiti mAtrAshitIye (sU. 5), asmAbhirapi ca tatraivaitat saprapa~jcaM vyAkhyAtam; prakaraNAgatatvena abhyarhitatvAcca punaruktam | dravyANi mAtrAmapekShante iti yathocitamAtrAvanti sukhaM pacyanta ityarthaH| mAtrA cAgnimapekShata iti pratipuruShaM pratidinaM cAgnibhedamapekShya mAtrA mahatI svalpA vA bhavati, na pratiniyatA mAtrA vidyata iti bhAvaH||340-341||

annaM samidha iva samidhaH| AhitAgniriti sAtmyena vyavasthApitAgniH; kiMvA AhitAgnirivAhitAgniH; tena AhitAgniryathA prAtaH sAyaM juhoti, tathA~ayamapi prAtaH sAyaM ca pathyAnyantaragnau juhoti| brahma japatIti praNavAdimantramAvartayati| dadAti ceti yathAshakti dAnamAcarati| taM naraM niHshreyase kalyANe yuktamAmayA na bhajante| bhAvino~apIti janmAntare~api; iha janmani pathyAshitvAnna bhavanti gadAH, janmAntare~api brahmajapadAnAbhyAmarjitadharmaprabhAvAdeva na bhavanti| ata evAha- antarAdRuta iti; antarAditi kAraNAt, Rute vinA; apathyasya tathA adharmasya rogakaraNasyAbhAvAdgadA na bhavantIti bhAvaH||345-347||

kimarthamannapAnavidhAvetat parIkShyamityAha- prANA ityAdi| abhidhAvatIti prArthayati| pratibhA praj~jA| medhA dhAraNAvatI dhIH| laukikamiti aparIkShakaloke bhavam; aparIkShakA eva hi vartamAnamAtre pravartante, parIkShakAstu janmAntaropakAriNyeva| karma yadvRuttAviti vartamAne sAdhye yat karma kRuShyAdi| svargatAviti svargagamane| vaidikamiti yaj~jAdi| apavarga iti mokShe| etAshca nimittasaptamyaH| yaccoktamiti mokShashAstre satyabrahmacaryAdi| anne pratiShThitamiti nirannasya dehasthityabhAvena sarvArambhAbhAvAt| yasmAdannaM sarvatra kAraNaM, tatastatrAvadhAtavyamiti||349-350||-
sa~ggrahe~annapAnaguNA iti ‘iShTavarNa’ ityAdinoktAH| sAgryA iti udakaM kledayati ityAdinA; udakAdayo hi kledanAdiShu agryAH shreShThA ityarthaH||351-352||

vargeNa shUkadhAnyAdInAM AhAradravyANAM sa~ggraho vargasa~ggrahaH| rasavIryetyAdau prabhAvo~alpaviShayatayA pRuthakpaThitaH| rasAdinirdeshashca yathAyogyatayA j~jeyaH, tena na sarvadravye sarvarasAdyabhidhAnaM bhaviShyati| atra shUkadhAnyamAdAvAhArapradhAnatvAt; shUkavanti dhAnyAni shUkadhAnyAni||5-7||

iha ca dravyanAmAni nAnAdeshaprasiddhAni, tena nAmaj~jAne sAmarthyaM tathAbhUtaM nAstyevAnyeShAmapi TIkAkRutAM, tena deshAntaribhyo nAma prAyasho j~jeyaM, yattu pracarati gauDe tallekhiShyAmo~anyadeshaprasiddhaM ca ki~jcit| kalamo vedAgrahAreShu svanAmaprasiddhaH| shakunAhRutaH shrAvastyAM vakranAmnA prasiddhaH| raktashAliH prasiddha eva| mahAshAlirmagadhe prasiddhaH| atra ca shAlirhaimantikaM dhAnyaM, ShaShTikAdayashca graiShmikAH, vrIhayaH shAradA iti vyavasthA| raktashAlyAdInAM madhurapAkitve~api baddhavarcastvaM prabhAvAdeva| mahAMstasyAnviti raktashAleranu, tena raktashAliguNA mahAshAlermanAgalpAH; evaM tasyAnu kalama ityatrApi vAcyam| tasyeti mahAshAleH| tataH pare iti shakunAhRutAdayaH, uttarottaramalpaguNA ityarthaH| guNAguNairiti shAlInAM raktashAlyAdInAM ye guNAstRuShNAghnatvatrimalApahatvAdayaH, teShAmaguNaistadguNaviparItairdoShairyavakAdayo~anukAraM kurvanti, tatashca yavakAstRuShNAtrimalAdikarA iti| guNashabdashceha prashaMsAyAm ||8-12||
athAto vividhAshitapItIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- na hitAhAropayoginAmagnivesha! tannimittA vyAdhayo jAyante, na ca kevalaM hitAhAropayogAdeva sarvavyAdhibhayamatikrAntaM bhavati, santi hyRute~apyahitAhAropayogAdanyA rogaprakRutayaH, tadyathA- kAlaviparyayaH, praj~jAparAdhaH, shabdasparsharUparasagandhAshcAsAtmyA iti| tAshca rogaprakRutayo rasAn samyagupayu~jjAnamapi puruShamashubhenopapAdayanti; tasmAddhitAhAropayogino~api dRushyante vyAdhimantaH| ahitAhAropayoginAM punaH kAraNato na sadyo doShavAn bhavatyapacAraH| na hi sarvANyapathyAni tulyadoShANi, na ca sarve doShAstulyabalAH, na ca sarvANi sharIrANi vyAdhikShamatve samarthAni bhavanti| tadeva hyapathyaM deshakAlasaMyogavIryapramANAtiyogAdbhUyastaramapathyaM sampadyate| sa eva doShaH saMsRuShTayonirviruddhopakramo gambhIrAnugatashcirasthitaH prANAyatanasamuttho marmopaghAtI kaShTatamaH kShiprakAritamashca sampadyate| sharIrANi cAtisthUlAnyatikRushAnyaniviShTamAMsashoNitAsthIni durbalAnyasAtmyAhAropacitAnyalpAhArANyalpasattvAni ca bhavantyavyAdhisahAni, viparItAni punarvyAdhisahAni| ebhyashcaivApathyAhAradoShasharIravisheShebhyo vyAdhayo mRudavo dAruNAH kShiprasamutthAshcirakAriNashca bhavanti| ta eva vAtapittashleShmANaH sthAnavisheShe prakupitA vyAdhivisheShAnabhinirvartayantyagnivesha!||7||

Commentary: tannimittA iti hitAhAranimittAH| na kevalamiti na param| rogaprakRutaya iti rogakAraNAni| ahitAhAropayoginAmityAdi| kAraNata iti nimittAntarAt pratibandhakAt; tacca kAraNaM ‘tadeva hyapathyaM’ ityAdivakShyamANagranthaviparItaM boddhavyam| sadya iti tatkAlam| anenApathyasya rogajananaM prati kAlAntaravikArakartRutvaM prAyo bhavatIti darshayati; anyathA sadya ityanarthakaM syAt, kAlAntare~api doShAkartRutvAt| doShavAniti vyAdhijanakaH| apacAra iti ahitAhAropayogaH| ukte kAraNamAha- nahItyAdi| tulyadoShANIti tulyadoShakarANi| vyAdhikShamatvaM vyAdhibalavirodhitvaM vyAdhyutpAdapratibandhakatvamiti yAvat| tadevApathyatulyadoShatAdi vivRuNoti- tadevetyAdi| atra yadyapi prastutatvAdapathyapratibandhakAni kAraNAni vaktavyAni, tathA~api samAnanyAyatayA~apathyashaktivardhakAnyucyante| tatra deshAdInAM yogAditi anuguNadeshAdiyogAt;
