yathA- vrIhiH pittakartRutvenApathyaH, sa cAnUpadeshayogAdbhUyastaramapathyo bhavati, dhanvadeshe tu hInabalo bhavati; tathA sharatkAlasyAnuguNasya yogAdbalavAn bhavati, hemante durbalaH; saMyogAdyathA- sa vrIhirdadhiphANitAdiyukto balavAn , madhvAdiyuktashca durbalaH; vIryAdyathA- sa evoShNIkRuto balavAn, shItastu durbalaH; sa eva ca prAmANAtiyogAdbalI, hInamAtrastvabalaH; ityAdyanusartavyam| doShatulyabalatAmAha- sa eva doSha ityAdi| saMsRuShTA militA bahavo yonayaH kAraNAni yasya sa tathA, kiMvA saMsRuShTayoniriti anuguNadUShyaH; yathA- pittasya raktaM dUShyamAsAdya kaShTatvaM kShiprakAritvaM ca bhavati| viruddhopakramo yathA- pittaM mehArambhakaM, vacanaM hi- “pittamehAH sarva eva yApyAH, viruddhopakramatvAt” (ni.a.4) iti; viruddhatA copakramasyAtra yat pittaharaM madhurAdi tanmehapradhAnadUShyamedaso viruddhaM, medonuguNaM tu kaTvAdi pitte viruddhamiti| gambhIrAnugata iti gambhIramajjAdidhAtugataH; vacanaM hi- “tva~gmAMsAshrayamuttAnaM gambhIraM tvantarAshrayam” (ci.a.39) iti| cirasthita iti dehe cirakAlAvasthAnena kRutamUlatvAt kaShTasAdhyaH| prANAyatanasamuttha iti agre~adhyAye (sU.a.29) vakShyamANasha~gkhAdidashaprANAyatanAshrayI| marmopaghAtIti prANAyatanavyatiriktakShipratalahRudayAdimarmopaghAtakArI| marmaghAtitvenaiva marmavisheShaprANAyatanasamutthatve labdhe punastadvacanaM prANAyatanamarmAshrayiNo visheSheNa kaShTatvapratipAdanArtham| kaShTatama iti bahuduHkhakartRutvenAsAdhyatvena ca| kShiprakAritama iti AshuvikArakAritamaH| cakArAt saMsRuShTayonitvAdihetUnAmalpatvena kaShTa-kaShTatara-kShiprakAri-kShiprakAritarAdivisheShAshca bhavantIti darshayati; yathoktasarvahetumelake kaShTatamaH kShiprakAritamashca bhavatIti j~jeyaM, kaShTatamatvAdi ca yathAyogyatayA j~jeyaM; viruddhopakramo doShaH kaShTa eva bhavati na kShiprakArI| vyAdhyakShamasharIrANyAha- sharIrANi cetyAdi| aniviShTAni shlathAni mAMsAdIni yeShAM sharIrANAM tAni tathA; kiMvA, aniviShTAnIti viShamANi| upacitAnIti saMvardhitAni; asAtmyapuShTaM hi sharIraM bhUridoShabhAvitameva bhavatIti bhAvaH| viparItAnIti anatisthUlatvAdiyuktAni| vyAdhisahAnIti vyAdhyutpAdakapratibandhakAni| etacca sharIramadhikRutya vaiparItyaM vyAdhisahatve udAharaNArthamupanyastaM, tena yathoktApathyabalavaiparItyaM doShabalavaiparItyaM ca na sadyo vyAdhikArakaM bhavatItyetadapyuktaM boddhavyam| etadevApathyAhAradoShasharIrANAmevAbalavattvabalavattvAbhyAM lakShaNavisheShaM yathAyogyatayA mRudvAdivyAdhikAraNatvenopasaMharannAha- ebhyashcaivetyAdi| visheShA yathoktA uktaviparItAshca; tatroktaviparItavisheShAnmRudavastathA cirakAriNashca bhavanti, yathoktApathyAdivisheShAttu dAruNAH kShiprakAriNashca bhavantIti mantavyam| anena prasa~ggena vAtAdInAM rasAdisthAnavisheSheShu kupitAnAM ye vyAdhayo bhavanti tAn darshayitumAha- ta evetyAdi||7||

tatra rasAdiShu sthAneShu prakupitAnAM doShANAM yasmin sthAne ye ye vyAdhayaH sambhavanti tAMstAn yathAvadanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||8||

Commentary: tatra rasetyAdau prakupitAnAM doShANAmiti aniyamena rase kupito vAyurvA pittaM vA shleShmA vA saMsRuShTA vA ashraddhAdIni kurvanti| satyapi doShabhede~atrAshrayasyAbhedAdAshrayaprabhAveNaivAshraddhAdayo bhavanti, paraM doShabhede ashraddhAdAveva vAtAdili~ggaM vishiShTaM bhavati| kiMvA yathAyogyatayA rasAshrayiNA vAtAdinA ashraddhAdikaraNaM boddhavyaM, yato na gauravaM vAtaduShTarase bhavitumarhati; etacca nAtisundaraM, tena pUrva eva pakSho jyAyAn||8||
ashraddhA cArucishcAsyavairasyamarasaj~jatA| hRullAso gauravaM tandrA sA~ggamardo jvarastamaH ||9||
pANDutvaM srotasAM rodhaH klaibyaM sAdaH kRushA~ggatA| nAsho~agnerayathAkAlaM valayaH palitAni ca||10||
...vakShyante raktadoShajAH| kuShThavIsarpapiDakA raktapittamasRugdaraH||11||
gudameDhrAsyapAkashca plIhA gulmo~atha vidradhiH| nIlikA kAmalA vya~ggaH pipplavastilakAlakAH||12||
adhimAMsArbudaM kIlaM galashAlUkashuNDike| pUtimAMsAlajIgaNDagaNDamAlopajihvikAH||14||
...shRuNu mAMsapradoShajAn||13||

... medaHsaMshrayAMstu pracakShmahe| ninditAni pramehANAM pUrvarUpANi yAni ca||15||

Commentary: ninditAni pramehapUrvarUpANIti keshajaTilatvAdIni, teShAmeva ninditatvAt; natvAsyavairasyamadhuratvAdIni| kiMvA, ninditAnIti atisthUlagatAnyAyurhrAsAdInyaShTauninditIyoktAni, teShAM ca ninditatvaM ninditAtisthUlasambaddhatvena| evaM pUrvasmin vyAkhyAne ‘yAni ca’ iti cakAro niyame, uttaravyAkhyAne tu samuccaye||15||

adhyasthidantau dantAsthibhedashUlaM vivarNatA| keshalomanakhashmashrudoShAshcAsthipradoShajAH||16||

Commentary: adhyasthidantashabdena adhyasthyadhidantayorgrahaNam| shUlamiti asthishUlameva boddhavyam||16||

ruk parvaNAM bhramo mUrcchA darshanaM tamasastathA| aruShAM sthUlamUlAnAM parvajAnAM ca darshanam||17||

Commentary: rugityAdi majjadoShAjj~jeyam| aruMShIti vraNAni||17||-
...shukrasya doShAt klaibyamaharShaNam| rogi vA klIbamalpAyurvirUpaM vA prajAyate||18||
na cAsya jAyate garbhaH patati prasravatyapi| shukraM hi duShTaM sApatyaM sadAraM bAdhate naram||19||

vividhamashitaM pItaM lIDhaM khAditaM jantorhitamantaragnisandhukShitabalena yathAsvenoShmaNA samyagvipacyamAnaM kAlavadanavasthitasarvadhAtupAkamanupahatasarvadhAtUShmamArutasrotaH kevalaM sharIramupacayabalavarNasukhAyuShA yojayati sharIradhAtUnUrjayati ca| dhAtavo hi dhAtvAhArAH prakRutimanuvartante||3||

Commentary: vividhamityAdi| vividhamiti anenAshitAdInAmavAntarabhedaM darshayati; ashitAdiShu yo yaH prAya upayujyate sa pUrvamuktaH| jantorhitamiti vacanamahitasyAshitAderbalavarNAdikartRutvAbhAvAt| antaragninA jAThareNa vahninA sandhukShitaM balaM yasya tenAntaragnisandhukShitabalena| yathAsvenoShmaNeti pRuthivyAdirUpAshitAderyasya ya UShmA pArthivAgnyAdirUpastena; vacanaM hi- “bhaumApyAgneyavAyavyAH pa~jcoShmANaH sanAbhasAH| pa~jcAhAraguNAn svAn svAn pArthivAdIn pacanti hi” (ci. 15) iti| samyagvipacyamAnamiti ashitAdi| kiMvA yathAsvenoShmaNeti yasya rudhirAderya UShmA dhAtvagnirUpastena samyagvipacyamAnamashitAdi rasatAmApannaM yadA raktAdidhAtUn pratipadyate tadA raktAdyUShmaNaiva pacyate; evaM vipacyamAnamashitAdi sharIramupacayAdinA yojayatyUrjayati vardhayatIti yojanA| kiMvishiShTaM sharIramityAha- kAlavadityAdi|- yathA kAlo nityagatvenAnavasthitaH, tathA~anavasthitaH avishrAntaH sarvadhAtUnAM pAko yasmin sharIre tattathA; etena sarvadA svAgnipAkakShIyamANadhAtoH sharIrasyAshitAdinopacayAdiyojanamupapannamiti darshayati, yadi hi pAkakShIyamANaM sharIraM na syAttadA svataH siddhe upacayAdau kimashitAdi kuryAditi bhAvaH| kiMvA kAlavadityashitAdivisheShaNaM; tena yathoktakAlakRutamashitAdItyarthaH , akAlabhojanasyopacayAdyakArakatvAt| tathA, anavasthitasarvadhAtupAkamityetadapi ashitAdivisheShaNaM, tena anavasthitaH sarvadhAtuShu pAko yasyAshitAdestattathA; etena kvacidapi dhAtau sthagitasyAshitAde rasarUpasya pAkavigamanAnnopacayAdirbhavatIti darshayati| etacca vyAkhyAnaM nAtisundaram, asyArthasya anupahatetyAdisharIravisheShaNenaiva labdhatvAt punaH sharIravisheShaNamanupapannam| anupahatetyAdi anupahatAni sarvadhAtUnAmUShmamArutasrotAMsi yasya tattathA;, yadA hi eko~api dhAtupAcako~agnirupahataH mAruto vA dhAtupoShakarasavAhI vyAnarUpaH kvacidupahato bhavati, tathA sroto vA dhAtupoShakarasavahamupahataM syAt, tadA ashitAdikaM dhAtUnAmavardhakatvAnnopacayAdikArakamiti bhAvaH| kevalamiti kRutsnaM sharIraM; kiMvA kevalamiti adharmarahitam, adharmayukte hi sharIre viphalamashitAdi bhavatIti| nanu sharIradhAtUnAM prakRutisthitAnAM svata evopacayAdyasti, tat kimashitAdinA kriyata ityAha- dhAtavo hItyAdi| dhAturAhAro yeShAM te dhAtvAhArAH; dhAtavo rasAdayo nityaM kShIyamANA ashitAdijanitadhAtvAhArA eva santaH paraM svAsthyamanuvartante, nAnyathetyarthaH||3||

indriyANi samAshritya prakupyanti yadA malAH| upaghAtopatApAbhyAM yojayantIndriyANi te||20||

Commentary: upaghAtetyAdau upaghAto vinAshaH, upatApastu ki~jcidvaikalyam||20||

snAyau sirAkaNDarAbhyo duShTAH klishnanti mAnavam| stambhasa~gkocakhallIbhirgranthisphuraNasuptibhiH||21||

Commentary: kaNDArAbhya iti saptamyarthe pa~jcamI| khallI karapadAvamoTanam| granthiH snAyvAdigranthireva||21||

malAnAshritya kupitA bhedashoShapradUShaNam| doShA malAnAM kurvanti sa~ggotsargAvatIva ca||22||

Commentary: malAnityAdau bhedashoShapradUShaNamiti yathAsambhavaM j~jeyaM; tatra bhedaH purIShasya, shoShastu visheSheNa sarvamaleShu sambhavati, pradUShaNaM tu praduShTavarNAdiyuktatvena prAkRutavarNAdyupaghAtaH| sa~ggotsargAvatIva ceti atIva sa~ggaH apravRuttiH, atyutsargastu atipravRuttiH||22||
vividhAdashitAt pItAdahitAllIDhakhAditAt| bhavantyete manuShyANAM vikArA ya udAhRutAH||23||
teShAmicchannanutpattiM seveta matimAn sadA| hitAnyevAshitAdIni na syustajjAstathA~a~amayAH||24||
rasajAnAM vikArANAM sarvaM la~gghanamauShadham| vidhishoNitike~adhyAye raktajAnAM bhiShagjitam||25||
mAMsajAnAM tu saMshuddhiH shastrakShArAgnikarma ca| aShTauninditike~adhyAye medojAnAM cikitsitam||26||
asthyAshrayANAM vyAdhInAM pa~jcakarmANi bheShajam| bastyaH kShIrasarpIMShi tiktakopahitAni ca||27||
majjashukrasamutthAnAmauShadhaM svAdutiktakam| annaM vyavAyavyAyAmau shuddhiH kAle ca mAtrayA||28||
shAntirindriyajAnAM tu trimarmIye pravakShyate| snAyvAdijAnAM prashamo vakShyate vAtarogike||29||
navegAndhAraNe~adhyAye cikitsAsa~ggrahaH kRutaH| malajAnAM vikArANAM siddhishcoktA kvacitkvacit||30||
vyAyAmAdUShmaNastaikShNyAddhitasyAnavacAraNAt| koShThAcchAkhA malA yAnti drutatvAnmArutasya ca||31||
tatrasthAshca vilambante kadAcinna samIritAH| nAdeshakAle kupyanti bhUyo hetupratIkShiNaH||32||

vRuddhyA viShyandanAt pAkAt srotomukhavishodhanAt| shAkhA muktvA malAH koShThaM yAnti vAyoshca nigrahAt||33||

Commentary: samprati shAkhAbhyaH koShThAgamanahetuM doShANAmAha- vRuddhyetyAdi| viShyandanAditi vilayanAt, vilInashca dravatvAdeva koShThe nimnaM yAti| pAkAditi pakvo doSho~abaddhatvenaiva nimnaM koShThaM yAti | srotomukhavishodhanAditi avarodhakApagamAt| vAyornigrahAditi kShepturvAyornigrahAt prAkRutaM sthAnaM koShThaM yAti||33||
ajAtAnAmanutpattau jAtAnAM vinivRuttaye| rogANAM yo vidhirdRuShTaH sukhArthI taM samAcaret||34||
sukhArthAH sarvabhUtAnAM matAH sarvAH pravRuttayaH| j~jAnAj~jAnavisheShAttu mArgAmArgapravRuttayaH||35||
hitamevAnurudhyante praparIkShya parIkShakAH| rajomohAvRutAtmAnaH priyameva tu laukikAH||36||
shrutaM buddhiH smRutirdAkShyaM dhRutirhitaniShevaNam| vAgvishuddhiH shamo dhairyamAshrayanti parIkShakam||37||
laukikaM nAshrayantyete guNA moharajaHshritam | tanmUlA bahavo yanti rogAH shArIramAnasAH||38||

tatrAhAraprasAdAkhyo rasaH kiTTaM ca malAkhyamabhinirvartate| kiTTAt svedamUtrapurIShavAtapittashleShmANaH karNAkShinAsikAsyalomakUpaprajananamalAH keshashmashrulomanakhAdayashcAvayavAH puShyanti| puShyanti tvAhArarasAdrasarudhiramAMsamedosthimajjashukraujAMsi pa~jcendriyadravyANi dhAtuprasAdasa~jj~jakAni sharIrasandhibandhapicchAdayashcAvayavAH| te sarva eva dhAtavo malAkhyAH prasAdAkhyAshca rasamalAbhyAM puShyantaH svaM mAnamanuvartante yathAvayaHsharIram| evaM rasamalau svapramANAvasthitAvAshrayasya samadhAtordhAtusAmyamanuvartayataH| nimittatastu kShINavRuddhAnAM prasAdAkhyAnAM dhAtUnAM vRuddhikShayAbhyAmAhAramUlAbhyAM rasaH sAmyamutpAdayatyArogyAya, kiTTaM ca malAnAmevameva| svamAnAtiriktAH punarutsargiNaH shItoShNaparyAyaguNaishcopacaryamANA malAH sharIra dhAtusAmyakarAH samupalabhyante||4||

Commentary: yo~asau dhAtUnAmAhArastamAha- tatretyAdi| tatreti ashitAdau| rasaH kiTTaM cAbhinivartata ityanvayaH| AhAraprasAda ityAkhyA yasya sa tathA; prasAdaH sAraH| kiTTam asArabhAgaH| kiTTAditi kiTTAMshAt ; tena annAdyaH kiTTAMshastato mUtrapurIShe bhavato vAyushca, rasAt pacyamAnAnmalaH kaphaH, evamAdi grahaNyadhyAye vakShyamANamanusartavyaM; vakShyati hi- “kiTTamannasya viNmUtraM rasasya tu kapho~asRujaH| pittaM mAMsasya khamalo malaH svedastu medasaH|| syAt kiTTaM keshalomAsthno majj~jaH sneho~akShiviT tvacAm” (ci. 15) iti| AdigrahaNAdakShisnehAdi grAhyam| yadyapi ca vAto~anashanAdapyupalabhyate, tathA~api rUkShakiTTAdibhojanamalAMshAdapyutpadyata eveti kiTTAdvAtotpattiryuktaiva; na cAyaM niyamo yanmalAdevotpadyata iti, vyAyAmAdavagAhAderapi ca vAtAdisadbhAvAt| prajananaM li~ggam| rasapoShyamAha- puShyanti tvityAdi| pa~jcendriyadravyANIti pRuthivyAdIni ghrANAdIndriyakAraNAni| dhAtuprasAdasa~jj~jakAnIti atyarthashuddhenaiva dhAtuprasAdenendriyANyArabhyanta iti darshayati| sharIraM badhnAtIti sharIrabandhaH snAyusirAdiH| AdigrahaNAdArtavastanyAdigrahaNam| atrAhArarasAd raktAdipoShaNe kecidbruvate- yat- raso raktarUpatayA pariNamati, raktaM ca mAMsarUpatayA, evaM mAMsAdayo~apyuttarottaradhAturUpatayA pariNamanti| atrApi ca pakShe kecidbruvate- kShIrAdyathA sarvAtmanA dadhi bhavati, tathA kRutsno raso raktaM bhavati; evaM raktAdayo~api mAMsAdirUpA bhavanti| anye tvAhuH- kedArIkulyAnyAyena rasasya dhAtupoShaNaM; tatrAnnAdutpanno raso dhAturUpaM rasamadhigamya kiyatA~apyaMshena taM rasaM vardhayati; aparashca rasarAshistatra gataH san shoNitagandhavarNayuktatvAcchoNitamiva bhUtvA kiyatA~api shoNitasamAnenAMshena dhAturUpaM shoNitaM puShNAti, sheShashca bhAgo mAMsaM yAti, tatrApi shoNitavadvyavasthA; tathA medaHprabhRutiShvapIti| ata eva ca mukhyArtho~ayaM grantho bhavati; yathA- “rasAdraktaM tato mAMsaM mAMsAnmedastato~asthi ca| asthno majjA tataH shukraM shukrAdgarbhaH prasAdajaH ” (ci. 15) iti; tathA hArIte~apyuktaM- “rasaH saptAhAdarvAk parivartamAnaH shvetakapotaharitahAridrapadmakiMshukAlaktakarasaprakhyashcAyaM yathAkramaM divasaparivartAdvarNaparivartamApadyamAnaH pittoShmoparAgAcchoNitatvamApadyate” iti; tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “sa khalvApyo rasa ekaikasmin dhAtau trINi trINi kalAsahasrANi pa~jcadasha ca kalA avatiShThate, evaM mAsena rasaH shukrIbhavati” (su. sU. 14) iti| anye tvAhuH- khalekapotanyAyenAyamannarasaH pRuthakpRuthagdhAtumArge gataH san rasAdIn poShayati, na tvasya dhAtupoShako rasabhAgo dhAtvantareNa samaM sambandhamapyanubhavati, rasAdipoShakANi srotAMsyuttarottaraM sUkShmamukhAni dIrghANi ca, tenaiva rasapoShakarasabhAgo rasamArgacAritvAdrasaM poShayati, evaM rasapoShaNakAlAduttarakAlaM (raktapoShakamArgacAritvAt ) raktapoShako rasabhAgo raktaM poShayati, tathA shoNitapoShaNakAlAduttarakAlaM mAMsapoShako rasabhAgo mAMsaM poShayati, vidUrasUkShmamArgacAritvAt; evaM medaHprabhRutipoShaNe~api j~jeyam| tena, “rasAdraktaM tato mAMsaM” ityAderayamarthaH- yat- rasapuShTikAlAduttarakAlaM raktaM jAyate, tathA raktapuShTikAlAduttarakAlaM mAMsaM prajAyate ityAdi| evaM sushrutahArItavacane api vyAkhyeye| yacca “raktaM vibaddhamArgatvAnmAMsAdInna prapadyate” (ci.a.8) iti rAjayakShmaNi vakShyati, taddhRudayacArishoNitAbhiprAyeNa, na tu poShakashoNitAbhiprAyeNa | ki~jca, pariNAmapakShe vRuShyaprayogasya raktAdirUpatApattikrameNAticireNa shukraM bhavatIti, kShIrAdayashca sadya eva vRuShyA dRushyante; khalekapotapakShe tu vRuShyotpanno rasaH prabhAvAcchIghrameva shukreNa sambaddhaH san tatpuShTiM karotIti yuktaM; tathA rasaduShTau satyAM pariNAmapakShe tajjanmanAM shoNitAdInAM sarveShAmeva duShTiH syAt, duShTakAraNajAtatvAt| khalekapotapakShe tu yaddhAtupoShako rasabhAgo duShTaH sa eva duShyati na sarve, taditareShAmaduShTakAraNatvAt; tathA medovRuddhau satyAM bhUrikAraNatvenAsthnA~api bhUyasA bhavitavyaM, dRushyate ca bhUrimedasa itaradhAtuparikShayaH; vacanaM ca- “medasvino meda evopacIyate, na tathetare dhAtavaH” (sU.a.21) iti; evamAdi pariNAmavAde dUShaNam| eShu ca pakSheShu sarvAtmapariNAmavAdo viruddha eva, yena sarvAtmapariNAme tricaturopavAsenaiva nIrasatvAccharIrasya maraNaM syAt, mAsopavAse ca kevalaM shukramayaM sharIraM syAt| kedArIkulyAnyAyastu tulyabala eva khalekapotanyAyena; yato yaduktaM vRuShyaprabhAvaM prati tat kedArIkulyApakShe~api prabhAvAdeva shIghraM raktAdidhAtUnabhigamya shukraM janayiShyati vRuShyaM, yathA khalekapotapakShe~api prabhavAditi| yattu rasaduShTau shoNitadUShaNaM; tanna bhavati, dhAtubhUtashoNitAMshapoShakasya rasabhAgasyAduShTatvAt; iti samAnaM pUrveNa| atrApi hi pakShe na sarvo raso dhAturUpashoNitatAmApadyate, kiM tarhi kashcideva shoNitasamAno bhAgaH; sheShastu shoNitasthAnagatatvena ki~jcicchoNitasamAnavarNAditvAcca shoNitamucyate; anena nyAyena medovRuddhau satyAmasthivRuddhirapi nirastA, yato na medasA asthi poShyate, api tarhi medaHsthAnagatenaiva rasena medonukAriNA| evamanayoH pakShayormahAjanAdRutatvena tulyanyAyatvena ca naikamapi nishcitaM brUmaH, buddhivibhavAnna pakShabalAbalam, atra na kashcit kAryavirodha ityuparamyate| nanvAhArarasAdrasAdayaH puShyantIti vadatA dhAturasAdAhArarasotpAdaH pRuthak svIkriyate, tatashca tasya kiM sthAnaM kiMvA pramANamiti kimiti noktam? ucyate- na tasyAhArotkarShApakarShAvevaMvidhau, utkarShApakarShasya nishcitapramANatvAbhAvAt; sthAnaM tu dhamanya eva| poShakAhArarasasya tasya ca pRuthagrasAdidhAtubhyaH pradeshAntaragrahaNaM na kriyate, rasAdikAraNarUpatayA rasAdigrahaNenaiva grahaNAt| atra yadyapyojaH saptadhAtusArarUpaM, tena dhAtugrahaNenaiva labhyate, tathA~api prANadhAraNakartRutvena pRuthak paThitaM; ye tu shukrajanyamoja icchanti, teShAmaShTamo dhAturojaH syAditi pakShe cAtideshaM kRutvA vakShyati- “rasAdInAM shukrAntAnAM yat paraM tejaH, tat khalvojaH” (su.sU.a.15) iti| upapAditapoShaNAnAM dhAtumalAnAM prakRutyanuvidhAnamupasaMharati- te sarva ityAdi| malAkhyA api svedamUtrAdayaH svamAnAvasthitA dehadhAraNAddhAtavo bhavantItyuktaM- dhAtavo malAkhyA iti| yathAvayaHsharIramiti yasmin vayasi bAlyAdau yAdRushaM mAnaM dhAtUnAM tAdRushaM puShyantaH, tathA yasmi~j sharIre prakRutyA dIrghe hrasve kRushe vA sthUle vA yAdRushaM mAnaM dhAtUnAM tAdRushaM puShyanta iti yojanA| evamityAdau svapramANAvasthitAviti anatiriktAvanyUnau ca| Ashrayasyeti sharIrasya; yathAvatpakvau sarvAshrayaM pashcAddhamanIbhiH prapadyete, sarvasharIramityarthaH| samadhAtoriti samarasAdeH samasvedamUtrAdeshca| nimittata ityAdi| nimittata ityanenAnimitte ariShTarUpe kShayavRuddhI nirAkaroti| vRuddhikShayAbhyAmAhAramUlAbhyAmiti yathAsa~gkhyaM vRuddhakShINAhArakRutAbhyAm, etenAhAravisheShakRutavRuddhikShayo rasaH sAmyaM karotItyarthaH | dhAtusAmyasyArogyatve siddhe~api yadArogyAyeti brUte tena prAkRutadhAtUnAM kShayeNa vA~ativRuddhyA vA sAmyaM nirAkaroti, asya sAmyasya rogakartRutvAdeva| kiTTaM ca malAnAmevameveti yathA rasastathA kiTTamapyArogyAya malAnAM sAmyaM pratipAditarasakrameNa karoti| vRuddhamalAnAM cikitsAntaramAha- svamAnetyAdi| utsargo bahirniHsaraNaM saMshodhanarUpameShAM shAstroktamasti, utsargaM vA vahantItyutsargiNaH | vRuddhAnAM malAnAM cikitsAntaramAha- shItoShNetyAdi| paryayaH viparyayaH; tena shItoShNaviparItaguNairityarthaH; tena, shItasamutthe male uShNaM tathoShNasamutthe shItamupacAro bhavati| AdishabdashcAtra luptanirdiShTaH; tena snigdharUkShAdInAmapi viparItaguNAnAM grahaNam| kiMvA paryayaguNA dvandvaguNAH snigdharUkShamRudutIkShNAdayaH, taishca yathAyogyatayopacaryamANA iti j~jeyam| etena, vRuddhamalAnAM trividho~apyupakramo nidAnavarjanashodhanashamanarUpa ukto bhavati; tatra nidAnavarjanaM vRuddhamale malavRuddhihetvAhAraparityAgAdalpamalAhAropayogAdvA boddhavyaM, saMshodhanaM ca utsargiNa ityanenoktaM, shamanaM ca shItoShNetyAdigranthenoktam||4||
praj~jAparAdhAddhyahitAnarthAn pa~jca niShevate| sandhArayati vegAMshca sevate sAhasAni ca||39||
tadAtvasukhasa~jj~jeShu bhAveShvaj~jo~anurajyate| rajyate na tu vij~jAtA vij~jAne hyamalIkRute||40||

na rAgAnnApyavij~jAnAdAhArAnupayojayet| parIkShya hitamashnIyAddeho hyAhArasambhavaH||41||

Commentary: na rAgAdityAdi| ahitatvena jAnannapi rAgAdeva kashcidduShTaH pravartate, aj~jAnAccAhitatvAj~jAnAdeva kashciddhitAdhyavasAyena pravartate; etaddvayamapi niShidhyate||41||

AhArasya vidhAvaShTau visheShA hetusa~jj~jakAH| shubhAshubhasamutpattau tAn parIkShya prayojayet||42||

Commentary: kathamAhAraH parIkShya ityAha- AhArasyetyAdi| AhArasya vidhau vidhAne~aShTau visheShAH prakRutikaraNasaMyogAdayo rasavimAne (vi.a.1) vaktavyA hetusa~jj~jakAH; kva hetusa~jj~jakA ityAha- shubhetyAdi| shubhAshubhasamutpattau iti te ca prakRutyAdayaH shubhAH shubhakarAH, ashubhA ashubhakarAH, iti j~jeyam||42||
parihAryANyapathyAni sadA pariharannaraH| bhavatyanRuNatAM prAptaH sAdhUnAmiha paNDitaH||43||
yattu rogasamutthAnamashakyamiha kenacit| parihartuM na tat prApya shocitavyaM manIShibhiH||44||
tatra shlokAH- AhArasambhavaM vastu rogAshcAhArasambhavAH| hitAhitavisheShAcca visheShaH sukhaduHkhayoH||45||
sahatve cAsahatve ca duHkhAnAM dehasattvayoH | visheSho rogasa~gghAshca dhAtujA ye pRuthakpRuthak||46||
teShAM caiva prashamanaM koShThAcchAkhA upetya ca| doShA yathA prakupyanti shAkhAbhyaH koShThametya ca||47||
prAj~jAj~jayorvisheShashca svasthAturahitaM ca yat| vividhAshitapItIye tat sarvaM samprakAshitam||48||

teShAM tu malaprasAdAkhyAnAM dhAtUnAM srotAMsyayanamukhAni| tAni yathAvibhAgena yathAsvaM dhAtUnApUrayanti| evamidaM sharIramashitapItalIDhakhAditaprabhavam| ashitapItalIDhakhAditaprabhavAshcAsmi~j sharIre vyAdhayo bhavanti| hitAhitopayogavisheShAstvatra shubhAshubhavisheShakarA bhavantIti||5||

Commentary: ayanAni ca tAni mukhAni cetyayanamukhAni, atra AyAntyanenetyayanAni mArgANi, mukhAni tu yaiH pravishanti; etena malAnAM dhAtUnAM ca yadevAyanaM tadeva praveshamukhamiti nAnyena pravesho nAnyena ca gamanamityuktaM bhavati| rasAdInAM yathAsvanAma srotomukhaM cAyanaM ca| kiMvA, ayanasya gamanasya mukhAni mArgANi; tena, ayanamukhAni gatimArgANItyarthaH| tAni ca srotAMsi malaprasAdapUritAni dhAtUn yathAsvamiti yadyasya poShyaM tacca tat pUrayati| yathAvibhAgeneti yasya dhAtoryo vibhAgaH pramANaM tenaiva pramANena pUrayati, tAdRukpramANAnyeva puShyanti, nAdhikanyUnAnItyarthaH| etacca prakRutisthAnAM karma, vikRutAnAM tu nyUnAtiriktadhAtukaraNamastyeveti boddhavyam| uktaM cAnyatra- “srotasA ca yathAsvena dhAtuH puShyati dhAtunA” (ci. 8) iti| upasaMharati- evamityAdi| kathamashitAderviruddhayoH sharIratadupaghAtakarogayorutpAda ityAha- hitAhitetyAdi| hitarUpo~ashitAdivisheShaH shubharUpavisheShakArakaH, ahitarUpastvashitAdivisheSho~ashubharUpavisheShakaro bhavati; tena naikarUpAt kAraNAdviruddhakAryodaya iti bhAvaH||5||

evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- dRushyante hi bhagavan! hitasamAkhyAtamapyAhAramupayu~jjAnA vyAdhimantashcAgadAshca, tathaivAhitasamAkhyAtam; evaM duShTe kathaM hitAhitopayogavisheShAtmakaM shubhAshubhavisheShamupalabhAmaha iti||6||

Commentary: dRushyante hi bhagavannityAdau tathaivAhitasamAkhyAtamupayu~jjAnA vyAdhimantashcAgadAshceti sambandhaH| visheShAtmakamiti visheShodbhavam||6||
pUrvAdhyAye ‘annaM prANAH’ (sU. 27) ityuktaM, tadyena prakAreNAnnaM prANaheturbhavati tadabhidhAnArthaM vividhAshitapItIyo~abhidhIyate| iyamapyarthaparA sa~jj~jA||1-2||

ashraddhAyAM mukhapraviShTasyAhArasyAbhyavaharaNaM bhavatyeva paraM tvanicchA , arucau tu mukhapraviShTaM nAbhyavaharatIti bhedaH| Asyavairasyam ucitAdAsyarasAdanyathAtvam | arasaj~jatA rasApratipattiH| sAdaH a~ggAvasAdaH||9-10||-
raktapradoShajeShu kuShThagrahaNAdeva dadrvAdilAbhe siddhe punastadvacanaM visheShaprAdurbhAvapradarshanArtham| tilakAlakAH tilAkRutayaH| asramaNDalaM lohitamaNDalam||11-12||-
kIlashabdenAtrArsha ucyate||13-14||-

klaibyamiti dhvajAnucchrAyaH| aharShaNaM ca satyapi dhvajotthAne maithunAshaktiH | shukraM hi duShTaM sApatyaM sadAraM bAdhate naramiti atrApatyabAdhA rogiklIbAdyapatyajanakatvena, dArabAdhA tu srAvigarbhAdijanakatvena||18-19||

sampratyahitAhArajanitAn doShAn darshayan yathAkartavyamupadishati- vividhAdityAdi| bhiShagjitam ‘uktam’ iti sheShaH| pa~jcakarmANItyabhidhAyApi bastaya iti vacanaM tiktopahitabastervisheSheNa hitatvopadarshanArtham| shuddhiriti vamanAdinA| siddhiH proktA kvaciditi atIsAragrahaNyAdau||23-30||

samprati rasAdInAM shAkhArUpatvAt koShThAshrayiNo doShA yathA shAkhAM yAnti tadAha- vyAyAmetyAdi| tatra vyAyAmakShobhAt koShThaM parityajya shAkhAM malA yAnti, UShmaNo vahnestIkShNatvAdvilAyitA doShAH shAkhAM yAnti, hitasyAnavacAraNayA~ahitasevayA~atisevayA~atimAtravRuddho doSho jalApUravadvRuddhaH svasthAnamAplAvya sthAnAntaraM yAtIti yuktam| drutatvAnmArutasyeti calatvAdvAyorvAyunA kShipto yAtItyarthaH; vAyvantareNa ca vAyorAkShepaNamupapannameveti, anyathA malA iti bahuvacanamasAdhu| atha shAkhAgatAH kiM kurvantItyAha- tatrasthAshcetyAdi| vilambante kadAciditi kadAcidvyAdhikaraNe vilambaM kurvanti| kuto vilambanta ityAha- na samIritAH| ye doShA alpatvenAbalavantaste hetvantareNa samIritAH santaH kupyanti; tathA ta eva nAdesha ityananuguNadeshe, tathA nAkAla ityananuguNakAle kupyantIti yojanA| atraiva hetumAha- bhUya ityAdi| yasmAdbhUyo hetupratIkShiNaste~alpabalA doShAstasmAdIraNAdyapekShante; etena bhUyo ye~ahetupratIkShiNo bhavanti balavattvAnna te IraNAdyapekShante, ata evoktaM kadAciditi||31-32||

idAnIM sa~gkShepeNAkhilavyAdhipratIkAraM sUtrayati- ajAtAnAmityAdi | yo vidhirdRuShTa iti kRutsne tantre| nanu, yadi sukhArthA sarvaprANinAM pravRuttistatkathaM ko~api amArge pravartata ityAha- j~jAnetyAdi| aj~jAnAdeva sukhasAdhanamidamiti kRutvA aparIkShakAH pravartante, na tu duHkhakartRutAsandhAnAditi bhAvaH||34-35||

hitameveti Ayativishuddhameva tadAtve duHkhakaramapi| priyameveti tadAtve sukhakaramAyativiruddham| laukikA aparIkShakAH| parIkShakaM stauti- shrutamityAdi| parIkShakamAshrayantIti parIkShake bhavanti; kiMvA, buddhyAdidevatAH parIkShakamAshrayante, yaduktaM- “vivishurj~jAnadevatAH” (sU. 1) iti| tanmUlA iti rajastamomUlAH||36-38||

yathA aparIkShake rajastamomUlA rogA bhavanti tadAha- praj~jAparAdhAdityAdi| ahitArthasevAdi ca rogaM karotIti bhAvaH| tadAtvasukheShviti vaktavye, yat ‘sukhasa~jj~jeShu’ iti karoti, tattadAtvasukhasyApathyasya duHkhAnubandhasukhakartRutayA paramArthatastadAtve~apyasukhatvaM darshayati; yathA ‘sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyaM’ (sU.a.9) ityatroktam| vij~jAteti parIkShakaH||39-40||

nanu pathyasevAyAM kriyamANAyAmapi balavatprAktanAdharmavashAdapi vyAdhayo bhavanti, tat kimanena pathyasevanenetyAha- parihAryANItyAdi| anRuNatAmiva prApto~anRuNatAM prAptaH; etena parihAryaparihAreNa puruShakAre~anaparAdhaH puruSho bhavatIti darshayati| yastu daivAgatastasya vyAdhistatra sAdhavo naivaM pathyasevinaM garhayanti, etadevAha- yattvityAdi| ashakyaM parihartumiti balavatkarmajanyatvAdityarthaH| na shocitavyamiti puruShakArasya daivajanye~avashyambhAvini vyAdhAvaki~jcitkaratvAdityarthaH||43-44||
sa~ggrahe vastviti sharIram| sahatve cAsahatve cetyAdinA sharIrANi cAtisthUlAni ityAdi ‘viparItAni punarvyAdhisahAni’ ityantaM granthaM j~jApayati||45-48||
athAto dashaprANAyatanIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
dashaivAyatanAnyAhuH prANA yeShu pratiShThitAH | sha~gkhau marmatrayaM kaNTho raktaM shukraujasI gudam||3||
tAnIndriyANi vij~jAnaM cetanAhetumAmayAn| jAnIte yaH sa vai vidvAn prANAbhisara ucyate||4||

dvividhAstu khalu bhiShajo bhavantyagnivesha! prANAnAmeke~abhisarA hantAro rogANAM, rogANAmeke~abhisarA hantAraH prANAnAmiti||5||

Commentary: sarvacikitsAyA vaidyAdhInatvena yAdRusho vaidya upAdeyo yAdRushashcAnupAdeyastaddarshanakaushalAt sUtrasthAnArthasa~ggrahaM darshayati- dvividhA ityAdi| rogANAmabhisarA iti rogANAmAnetAraH||5||
evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- bhagavaMste kathamasmAbhirveditavyA bhaveyuriti||6||

bhagavAnuvAca- ya ime kulInAH paryavadAtashrutAH paridRuShTakarmANo dakShAH shucayo jitahastA jitAtmAnaH sarvopakaraNavantaH sarvendriyopapannAH prakRutij~jAH pratipattij~jAshca te j~jeyAH prANAnAmabhisarA hantAro rogANAM; tathAvidhA hi kevale sharIraj~jAne sharIrAbhinirvRuttij~jAne prakRutivikAraj~jAne ca niHsaMshayAH, sukhasAdhyakRucchrasAdhyayApyapratyAkhyeyAnAM ca rogANAM samutthAnapUrvarUpali~ggavedanopashayavisheShaj~jAne vyapagatasandehAH, trividhasyAyurvedasUtrasya sasa~ggrahavyAkaraNasya satrividhauShadhagrAmasya pravaktAraH , pa~jcatriMshato mUlaphalAnAM caturNAM ca snehAnAM pa~jcAnAM ca lavaNAnAmaShTAnAM ca mUtrANAmaShTAnAM ca kShIrANAM kShIratvagvRukShANAM ca ShaNNAM shirovirecanAdeshca pa~jcakarmAshrayasyauShadhagaNasyAShTAviMshateshca yavAgUnAM dvAtriMshatashcUrNapradehAnAM ShaNNaM ca virecanashatAnAM pa~jcAnAM ca kaShAyashatAnAM prayoktAraH, svasthavRuttavihitabhojanapAnaniyamasthAnaca~gkramaNashayanAsanamAtrAdravyA~jjanadhUmanAvanAbhya~jjana- parimArjanavegAvidhAraNavidhAraNavyAyAmasAtmyendriyaparIkShopakramaNasadvRuttakushalAH , catuShpAdopagRuhIte ca bheShaje ShoDashakale savinishcaye satriparyeShaNe savAtakalAkalaj~jAne vyapagatasandehAH, caturvidhasya ca snehasya caturviMshatyupanayasyopakalpanIyasya catuHShaShTiparyantasya ca vyavasthApayitAraH, bahuvidhavidhAnayuktAnAM ca snehyasvedyavamyavirecyavividhauShadhopacArANAM ca kushalAH, shirorogAderdoShAMshavikalpajasya ca vyAdhisa~ggrahasya sakShayapiDakAvidradhestrayANAM ca shophAnAM bahuvidhashophAnubandhAnAmaShTacatvAriMshatashca rogAdhikaraNAnAM catvAriMshaduttarasya ca nAnAtmajasya vyAdhishatasya tathA vigarhitAtisthUlAtikRushAnAM sahetulakShaNopakramANAM svapnasya ca hitAhitasyAsvapnAtisvapnasya ca sahetUpakramasya ShaNNAM ca la~gghanAdInAmupakramANAM santarpaNApatarpaNajAnAM ca rogANAM sarUpaprashamanAnAM shoNitajAnAM ca vyAdhInAM madamUrcchAyasannyAsAnAM ca sakAraNarUpauShadhopacArANAM kushalAH, kushalAshcAhAravidhivinishcayasya prakRutyA hitAhitAnAmAhAravikArANAmagryasa~ggrahasyAsavAnAM ca caturashIterdravyaguNakarmavinishcayasya rasAnurasasaMshrayasya savikalpavairodhikasya dvAdashavargAshrayasya cAnnapAnasya saguNaprabhAvasya sAnupAnaguNasya navavidhasyArthasa~ggrahasyAhAragateshca hitAhitopayogavisheShAtmakasya ca shubhAshubhavisheShasya dhAtvAshrayANAM ca rogANAM sauShadhasa~ggrahANAM dashAnAM ca prANAyatanAnAM yaM ca vakShyAmyarthedashamahAmUlIye triMshattamAdhyAye tatra ca kRutsnasya tantroddeshalakShaNasya tantrasya ca grahaNadhAraNavij~jAnaprayogakarmakAryakAlakartRukaraNakushalAH , kushalAshca smRutimatishAstrayuktij~jAnasyAtmanaH shIlaguNairavisaMvAdanena ca sampAdanena sarvaprANiShu cetaso maitrasya mAtApitRubhrAtRubandhuvat, evaMyuktA bhavantyagnivesha! prANAnAmabhisarA hantAro rogANAmiti||7||
ato viparItA rogANAmabhisarA hantAraH prANAnAM, bhiShakchadmapraticchannAH kaNTakabhUtA lokasya pratirUpakasadharmANo rAj~jAM pramAdAccaranti rAShTrANi||8||

teShAmidaM visheShavij~jAnaM bhavati- atyarthaM vaidyaveshena shlAghamAnA vishikhAntaramanucaranti karmalobhAt, shrutvA ca kasyacidAturyamabhitaH paripatanti, saMshravaNe cAsyAtmano vaidyaguNAnuccairvadanti, yashcAsya vaidyaH pratikarma karoti tasya ca doShAnmuhurmuhurudAharanti, AturamitrANi ca praharShaNopajApopasevAdibhiricchantyAtmIkartuM, svalpecchutAM cAtmanaH khyApayanti, karma cAsAdya muhurmuhuravalokayanti dAkShyeNAj~jAnamAtmanaH pracchAdayitukAmAH, vyAdhiM cApAvartayitumashaknuvato vyAdhitamevAnupakaraNamaparicArakamanAtmavantamupadishanti , antagataM cainamabhisamIkShyAnyamAshrayanti deshamapadeshamAtmanaH kRutvA, prAkRutajanasannipAte cAtmanaH kaushalamakushalavadvarNayanti, adhIravacca dhairyamapavadanti dhIrANAM, vidvajjanasannipAtaM (cAbhisamIkShya) pratibhayamiva kAntAramadhvagAH pariharanti dUrAt, yashcaiShAM kashcit sUtrAvayavo bhavatyupayuktastamaprakRute prakRutAntare vA satatamudAharanti, na cAnuyogamicchantyanuyoktuM vA, mRutyoriva cAnuyogAdudvijante, na caiShAmAcAryaH shiShyaH sabrahmacArI vaivAdiko vA kashcit praj~jAyata iti||9||
bhavanti cAtra- bhiShakchadma pravishyaivaM vyAdhitAMstarkayanti ye| vItaMsamiva saMshritya vane shAkuntikA dvijAn||10||
shrutadRuShTakriyAkAlamAtrAj~jAnabahiShkRutAH| varjanIyA hi te mRutyoshcarantyanucarA bhuvi||11||
vRuttihetorbhiSha~gmAnapUrNAn mUrkhavishAradAn| varjayedAturo vidvAn sarpAste pItamArutAH||12||
ye tu shAstravido dakShAH shucayaH karmakovidAH| jitahastA jitAtmAnastebhyo nityaM kRutaM namaH||13||
tatra shlokaH- dashaprANAyatanike shlokasthAnArthasa~ggrahaH| dvividhA bhiShajashcoktAH prANasyAyatanAni ca||14||

sampratyadhyAyadvaye~avashiShTe vaktavye pUrvAdhyAye ‘prANAyatanasamutthaH’ iti prANAyatanashabdakIrtanAddashaprANAyatanIya ucyate; kiMvA, ayaM dashaprANAyatanIyaH sUtrasthAnopasa~ggrahaH, sheShAdhyAyastu sarvatantrasa~ggraha iti pashcAducyate| iyamapyarthaparA sa~jj~jA, na shabdAnukAriNI| AyatanAnIva AyatanAni, tadupaghAte prANopaghAtAt, tannAshe ca prANanAshAdityarthaH| na prANasya jIvitAkhyasya sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogarUpasya sha~gkhAdaya eva paramAshayAH, tasya kRutsnasharIrAdyAshrayatvAt||1-2||

marmatrayamiti hRudayabastishirAMsi| tAnIti sha~gkhAdIni| vij~jAnaM buddhiH | cetanAhetuH AtmA, cetanAsamavAyikAraNatvAt; kiMvA cetanAshabdenAtmA, hetushabdena tu vyAdhInAM janako heturnidAnarUpastathA shamako heturbheShajarUpa ucyate; Amayashabdena ca li~ggamucyate| tena, AdhyAtmikAnIndriyAdIni bAhyAni ca hetuli~ggauShadhAni yo jAnIta ityuktaM bhavati; etAvaccaitacchAstraM yat- AdhyAtmikAnIndriyANi tathA hetuli~ggauShadhAni ca| prANAbhisarA mahAcatuShpAde uktAH||3-4||

pratipattij~jA iti tadAtve kartavyaj~jAH| sharIrAbhinirvRuttij~jAnaM yathA sharIraM shukrashoNitasaMyogAdibhya upajAyate, tathA j~jAnam| prakRutivikAraj~jAnaM sA~gkhyanayena shArIre vakShyamANam| trividhasyAyurvedasUtrasyeti “hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnaM” (sU. 1) ityasya| itaH prabhRuti ca tantroddeshalakShaNasyetyantena sUtrasthAnArthasa~ggraho yathAkramamanusAraNIyaH| sasa~ggrahavyAkaraNasyeti “sAmAnyaM ca visheShaM ca” (sU. 1) ityAdinA dIrgha~jjIvitIye sa~ggrahaH, vyAkaraNaM ca “sAmAnyamekatvakaraM” (sU. 1) ityAdi| satriparyeShaNa iti eShaNAtrayayukte| navavidhasyeti “caraH sharIrAvayavAH” (sU. 27) ityAdeH| AhAragateriti “vividhamashitaM pItaM” (sU. 28) ityAdinA| tantroddeshalakShaNasyeti tatra tantroddeshaH “aShTau sthAnAni” (sU. 30) ityAdinA, tantralakShaNaM tu AyuSho vedasya ca yanniruktau lakShaNaM vakShyati| atra sthAnArthaj~jAnekaushalamabhidhAyAnyathApyAha- tantrasyetyAdi| gRuhItasyottarakAlasmaraNaM dhAraNaM, vij~jAnam arthato j~jAnaM, prayogaH cikitsAprayogaH, karma anekadhA cikitsAkaraNaM, kAryaM dhAtusAmyaM, kAlaH kriyAkAlaH, karteha bhiShak, karaNaM bheShajam| shAstrayuktiH shAstrayojanA| yuktij~jAnasyeti kushalayogAt karaNe ShaShThI| Atmana ityAdi|- AtmanaH shIlaguNaiH karaNabhUtaiH mAtRupitRubandhuvat sarvaprANiShu cetaso maitrasya sampAdanena tathA avisaMvAdanena ca kushalA iti granthasambandho boddhavyaH||6-7||

bhiShakchadmacaro va~jcanArthakRutabhiShagveshaH| pratirUpakaH anyathArUpakArI drohakAraka (?) ityucyate loke | rAj~jAM pramAdAditi rAj~jA hi te kuvaidyAH shAsanIyAH| vishikhA rathyA, kiMvA karmamArgaH| saMshravaNe cAsyeti Aturasya shravaNayogye pradeshe| antagatamiti mumUrShum| apadeshaM vyAjam| akushalavaditi yathA akushalAH parasparaviruddhamAtmakaushalaM varNayanti tathetyarthaH| adhIravaditi uccATaravAH santaH| upayukta iti j~jAtaH| anuyogaM pRucchAm||8-9||

vItaMsaH pakShibandhanam| shrutaM shAstre shravaNam| dRuShTaM karmadarshanam| kriyA cikitsAj~jAnaM, j~jAnaM shAstrajanyaM, shrutaM tu shravaNamAtram| tebhyo nityaM kRutaM nama ityanena prANAbhisaraM stauti||10-14||
athAto~apAmArgataNDulIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
apAmArgasya bIjAni pippalIrmaricAni ca| viDa~ggAnyatha shigrUNi sarShapAMstumburUNi ca||3||
ajAjIM cAjagandhAM ca pIlUnyelAM hareNukAm| pRuthvIkAM surasAM shvetAM kuTherakaphaNijjhakau||4||
shirIShabIjaM lashunaM haridre lavaNadvayam| jyotiShmatIM nAgaraM ca dadyAcchIrShavirecane||5||
gaurave shirasaH shUle pInase~ardhAvabhedake| krimivyAdhAvapasmAre ghrANanAshe pramohake||6||
madanaM madhukaM nimbaM jImUtaM kRutavedhanam| pippalIkuTajekShvAkUNyelAM dhAmArgavANi ca||7||
upasthite shleShmapitte vyAdhAvAmAshayAshraye| vamanArthaM prayu~jjIta bhiShagdehamadUShayan||8||
trivRutAM triphalAM dantIM nIlinIM saptalAM vacAm| kampillakaM gavAkShIM ca kShIriNImudakIryakAm||9||
pIlUnyAragvadhaM drAkShAM dravantIM niculAni ca| pakvAshayagate doShe virekArthaM prayojayet||10||
pATalAM cAgnimanthaM ca bilvaM shyonAkameva ca| kAshmaryaM shAlaparNIM ca pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm||11||
balAM shvadaMShTrAM bRuhatImeraNDaM sapunarnavam| yavAn kulatthAn kolAni guDUcIM madanAni ca||12||
palAshaM kattRuNaM caiva snehAMshca lavaNAni ca| udAvarte vibandheShu yu~jjyAdAsthApaneShu ca||13||
ata evauShadhagaNAt sa~gkalpyamanuvAsanam| mArutaghnamiti proktaH sa~ggrahaH pA~jcakarmikaH||14||

tAnyupasthitadoShANAM snehasvedopapAdanaiH| pa~jcakarmANi kurvIta mAtrAkAlau vicArayan||15||

Commentary: pa~jcakarma yathA kartavyaM tathA tAnItyAdinA darshayati| tAnIti pUrvoktAni| snehasvedopapAdanairiti bahuvacanaM nAnAvidhasnehasvedopadarshanArtham| upasthitadoShANAmiti shAkhAM tyaktvA koShThagamanena tathA lInatvaparityAgena pradhAnAvasthAprAptadoShANAm | tatra pa~jcakarmapravRuttAvupasthitadoShatvameva hetuH, tadyadi snehasvedopapAdanamantarA~api syAt, yathA jvare “kaphapradhAnAnutkliShTAn doShAnAmAshayasthitAn| buddhvA jvarakarAn kAle vamyAnAM vamanairharet” (ci.a.3) iti; tatra snehasvedAvantareNApi vamanapravRuttirbhavatyeva| snehasvedopapAdanaM tu prAyikatvena tathA~anyathopasthitadoShe~api stokamAtrayA pa~jcakarmapravRuttikShobhajanyavAtajayArthaM kriyamANatvenoktam| mAtrAkAlayorvicAryatvena grahaNaM prAdhAnyAt, tena doShabheShajAdayo~api vicAryatveneha boddhavyAH; yadi vA pUrvavat kAlagrahaNAdeva sheShANAM doShAdInAmavarodho vyAkhyeyaH| tAnItyukte~api punaH pa~jcagrahaNaM pa~jcAnAmapyupasthitadoShatve sati pravRuttyupadeshArtham| iha vamanAdiShu karmalakShaNaM bahvitikartavyatAyogidoShanirharaNashaktijyAyastvam| tena tantrAntare snehasvedau prakShipya saptakarmANIti yaducyate tanna bhavati, nahi snehasvedau doShabahirniHsaraNaM kurutaH, doShasaMshamanaM tu tau kurutaH; pa~jcakarmA~ggatvena vyApriyamANau tu snehasvedau doShopasthAna eva paraM vyApriyete, na doShanirharaNe vamanAdisampAdye| anuvAsanaM tu yadyapi vamanAdivanna bahudoShanirharaNakAraNaM bhavati, tathA~api purIShasya pakvAshayagatavAtasya ca bahirnirhArakatvAt karmalakShaNaprAptameva| niShThIvananetrA~jjanAdau tu na snehasvedAdivadbahvitikartavyatAyogo naca bahudoShanirhArakatvaM, tena na tat karmashabdavAcyam| uttarabastistu sneharUpo nirUhaH snehabastAvevAntarbhavati| yadi veha vamanAdiShu pa~jcakarmasu pa~gkajashabdavadyogarUDheyaM sa~jj~jA; tena snehasvedaniShThIvanAdiShu na pravartate||15||

mAtrAkAlAshrayA yuktiH, siddhiryuktau pratiShThitA| tiShThatyupari yuktij~jo dravyaj~jAnavatAM sadA||16||

Commentary: mAtrAkAlavicAraphalamAha- mAtrAkAletyAdi| yuktiH yojanA bheShajasya dehadoShAdyapekShayA| yuktiM stauti- siddhirityAdinA| siddhiriha vikAropashamasya sAdhyasya niShpattiH||16||

ata UrdhvaM pravakShyAmi yavAgUrvividhauShadhAH| vividhAnAM vikArANAM tatsAdhyAnAM nivRuttaye||17||

Commentary: idAnIM vamanAdInAmayogAnmandIbhUtasya vahneH sandhukShaNArthaM tathA vamanAdiShvaprayogajanitasya shUlAdeH prashamArthaM pratij~jApUrvakaM yavAgUrabhidhatte- ata UrdhvamityAdi| uktaM hi “yathA~aNuragnistRuNagomayAdyaiH sandhukShyamANo bhavati krameNa| mahAn sthiraH sarvapacastathaiva shuddhasya peyAdibhirantaragniH” (si.a.1) iti| pippalyAdiyavAgUnirdeshe upasAdhiteti vacanaM bheShajapAnIyataNDulAdiprakRutidravyANAmucitaparimANagrahaNArtham | sAkShAdbheShajAdInAM pramANamiha noktaM, mAtrAyA agnyAdibhedenAnavasthitatvAt | yaduktaM- “mAtrAyA nAstyavasthAnaM doShamagniM balaM vayaH| vyAdhiM dravyaM ca koShThaM ca vIkShya mAtrAM prayojayet” iti| yadyapyevaM tathA~api paribhAShAdarshanAdvRuddhavaidyavyavahAradarshanAcca yathA kartavyaM taducyate- yavAgUsAdhanadravyaM tAvaddvividhaM- vIryapradhAnamauShadhadravyaM, tathA rasapradhAnamAhAradravyaM ca| tatrApyauShadhadravyaM trividhaM, vIryabhedAt; tIkShNavIryaM yathA shuNThyAdi, madhyavIryaM bilvAgnimanthAdi, mRuduvIryaM cAmalakAdi; tatra tIkShNAnAM karShaH, madhyAnAmardhapalaM, mRudUnAM palamityutsargaH| yaduktamagniveshena- “karShArdhaM vA kaNAshuNThyoH kalkadravyasya vA palam| vinIya pAcayedyuktyA vAriprasthena cAparAm” iti| atra madhyavIryANAmardhapalamAtrA noktA sA madhyapramANagrahaNAdboddhavyA| tathA “jIvantyajAjIshaTIpuShkarAhvaiH” (ci.a.12) ityAdikAyAM peyAyAM navabhirdravyaiH kolapramANairmilitvA palamadUrAntaraM bhavati, tacca mRuduvIryAbhiprAyeNaiva; “kvAthyadravyA~jjaliM kShuNNaM shrapayitvA jalADhake| ardhashRutena tenAtha yavAgvAdyupakalpayet” ityatra catuShpaladravyAbhidhAnaM rasapradhAnadravyAbhiprAyeNaiva; tena “siddhA varAhaniryUhe yavAgUrbRuMhaNI matA” ityAdAviyaM paribhAShA boddhavyA| ShaDa~ggasAdhanaparibhAShAyAM “yadapsu shRutashItAsu ShaDa~ggAdi prayujyate| karShamAtraM tato dravyaM sAdhayet prAsthike~ambhasi|| ardhashRutaM prayoktavyaM pAne peyAdisaMvidhau” ityatra peyAM prati karShadravyAbhidhAnaM madhyavIryasyApi ShaDa~ggasya mandAnalapuruShAbhiprAyeNa boddhavyam| vArimAnaM tu ShaDa~ggArthaparibhAShAyAM karShadravye vAriprastho~abhihitaH, tadanusAreNAnyatrApi jalotkarSho boddhavyaH| kalkasAdhyA tu yavAgUryatra bhavati, tatra sUdashAstroktaparimANAjjalaM grAhyam| yaduktaM- “annaM pa~jcaguNe sAdhyaM vilepI ca caturguNe| maNDashcaturdashaguNe yavAgUH ShaDguNe~ambhasi” iti| etacca pa~jcaguNe ityAdi taNDulabheShajasamudAyAdboddhavyam| yavAgUprakRutibhUtataNDulamAnaM tu sushrutavacanAdboddhavyam| yaduktaM- “vilepImucitAdbhaktAccaturbhAgakRutAM bhiShag” (su.ci.a.39) ityAdi| tathA “yavAgUH svalpataNDulA” iti||17||
pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakanAgaraiH| yavAgUrdIpanIyA syAcchUlaghnI copasAdhitA||18||
dadhitthabilvacA~ggerItakradADimasAdhitA| pAcanI grAhiNI, peyA savAte pA~jcamUlikI||19||
shAlaparNIbalAbilvaiH pRushniparNyA ca sAdhitA| dADimAmlA hitA peyA pittashleShmAtisAriNAm||20||
payasyardhodake cchAge hrIverotpalanAgaraiH| peyA raktAtisAraghnI pRushniparNyA ca sAdhitA||21||
dadyAt sAtiviShAM peyAM sAme sAmlAM sanAgarAm| shvadaMShTrAkaNTakArIbhyAM mUtrakRucchre saphANitAm||22||
viDa~ggapippalImUlashigrubhirmaricena ca| takrasiddhA yavAgUH syAt krimighnI sasuvarcikA||23||
mRudvIkAsArivAlAjapippalImadhunAgaraiH| pipAsAghnI, viShaghnI ca somarAjIvipAcitA||24||
siddhA varAhaniryUhe yavAgUrbRuMhaNI matA| gavedhukAnAM bhRuShTAnAM karshanIyA samAkShikA||25||
sarpiShmatI bahutilA snehanI lavaNAnvitA| kushAmalakaniryUhe shyAmAkAnAM virUkShaNI||26||
dashamUlIshRutA kAsahikkAshvAsakaphApahA| yamake madirAsiddhA pakvAshayarujApahA||27||
shAkairmAMsaistilairmAShaiH siddhA varco nirasyati| jambvAmrAsthidadhitthAmlabilvaiH sA~ggrAhikI matA||28||
kShAracitrakahi~ggvamlavetasairbhedinI matA| abhayApippalImUlavishvairvAtAnulomanI ||29||
takrasiddhA yavAgUH syAddhRutavyApattinAshinI| tailavyApadi shastA syAttakrapiNyAkasAdhitA||30||
gavyamAMsarasaiH sAmlA viShamajvaranAshinI| kaNThyA yavAnAM yamake pippalyAmalakaiH shRutA||31||
tAmracUDarase siddhA retomArgarujApahA| samAShavidalA vRuShyA ghRutakShIropasAdhitA||32||
upodikAdadhibhyAM tu siddhA madavinAshinI| kShudhaM hanyAdapAmArgakShIragodhArasaiH shRutA||33||

tatra shlokaH- aShTAviMshatirityetA yavAgvaH parikIrtitAH| pa~jcakarmANi cAshritya prokto bhaiShajyasa~ggrahaH||34||

Commentary: pratilomatantrayuktyA~adhyAyasa~ggrahaM karoti- aShTAviMshatirityAdi||34||

pUrvaM mUlaphalaj~jAnahetoruktaM yadauShadham| pa~jcakarmAshrayaj~jAnahetostat kIrtitaM punaH||35||

Commentary: dIrgha~jjIvitIye mUlinIphalinIgaNapaThitAnAmapAmArgajImUtAdInAM punarvacane upapattimAha- pUrvamityAdi| mUlaphalaj~jAnahetoriti asya mUlena vyavahAraH, asya phalena vyavahAraH, iti j~jAtumityarthaH| pa~jcakarmaNAmAshrayaH, Ashrayashabdashca bhAvapradhAnaH; tena pa~jcakarmAshrayatve j~jAnArthamiti phalati| yadyapi mUlinyashca phalinyashca dIrgha~jjIvitIye~api “shaNapuShpI ca bimbI ca” (sU.a.1) ityAdinA granthena pa~jcakarmAshrayatvenApyuktAH, tathA~apIha mukhyaprapa~jcenAbhidhIyamAnapa~jcakarmAshrayadravyagaNe~anabhidhAnAt pa~jcakarmAshrayatvenAprAdhAnyaM vA~apAmArgAdInAM sha~gketa, ata uktaM- pa~jcakarmAshrayaj~jAnahetostat kIrtitaM punariti||35||

smRutimAn hetuyuktij~jo jitAtmA pratipattimAn| bhiShagauShadhasaMyogaishcikitsAM kartumarhati||36||

Commentary: etadadhyAyapratipAditAyAH pa~jcakarmapravRutterdurj~jeyatvena yathAbhUtena vaidyena cikitsA kartavyAM tAdRushaM vaidyamAha- smRutimAnityAdi| pratipattirutpannAyAmApadi jhaTiti yathAkartavyatAj~jAnaM, tadvAn pratipattimAn||36||

dIrgha~jjIvitIye mUlinyashca phalinyashca pa~jcakarmA~ggabhUtA uktAH, aparANyapi ca pippalImaricaprabhRutIni pa~jcakarmasAdhanAni santi, tathA pa~jcakarmaprabhRutiviShayo~api tatra noktaH, tenAnantaraM sheShapa~jcakarmopayogidravyapa~jcakarmapravRuttiviShayAbhidhAyako~apAmArgataNDulIyo~abhidhIyate| pUrvoktAnyapi cApAmArgAdIni yat punarihAbhidhIyante tadAcArya evAdhyAyAnte ‘pUrvaM mUlaphala’ ityAdinA shlokadvayena samAdhAsyati| apAmArgabIjIya iti sa~jj~jAyAM prAptAyAmapAmArgataNDulIya iti sa~jj~jAkaraNamapAmArgAdibIjAnAM nistuShANAmeva grahaNArtham| adhyAyasa~jj~jAM taNDulena kRutvA~apAmArgasya bIjAnIti yadbIjashabdaM karoti tada~gkurajananasamarthabIjabhavAnAmeva taNDulAnAM grahaNArtham| yadyapi cehotsargataH pa~jcakarmapravRuttirvamanapUrvikaiva bhavati, yaduktaM- “sAdhAraNeShvRutuShu vamanAdInAM pravRuttirbhavati” (vi.a.8) ityAdi, tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “avAntasya hi samyagviriktasyApyadhaHsrastaH shleShmA grahaNImAcchAdayati” (su.ci.a.33) ityAdi; tathA~api kvacit prabaladoShApekShayA~anyathA~api kramo bhavati, yathA sharadyudrikte pitte virecanAdi, tathA prAvRuShi prabalavAte bastyAdirityaniyamArthamiha shirovirecanamAdAvabhihitaM; yadi vA, pradhAnA~ggashiraHshodhanatvAcchirovirecanamAdau kRutam| yaduktaM- “yaduttamA~ggama~ggAnAM shirastadabhidhIyate” (sU.a.17) iti| shAlAkye~apyuktaM- “anAmaye yathA mUle vRukShaH samyak pravardhate | anAmaye shirasyevaM dehaH samyak pravardhate” iti| apAmArgAbhidhAnamAdau shirovirecanaprAdhAnyAt| yaduktaM- “pratyakpuShpA shirovirecanAnAm” iti (sU.a.25)| ajagandhA ajamodA, “phophAndhI” iti kecit| pIlu auttarApathikaM phalam| lavaNadvayaM lavaNavargAdipaThitaM sauvarcalaM saindhavaM ca| ayaM vargo vyastaH samastashca shirovirecane prayojyo gaNatvAt| yaduktaM- “parisa~gkhyAtamapi hi yaddravyamayaugikaM manyeta tadapaharet” (vi.a.8) iti| anyatrApyuktaM- “samastaM vargamardhaM vA yathAlAbhamathApi vA” (su.sU.a.37) iti| shirasa iti gaurava ityanena shUla ityanena ca sambadhyate| krimivyAdhiriha shirogata eva boddhavyaH, tatraiva shirovirecanasya samarthatvAt| pramohako mUrcchA, indriyApaTutvaM vA||1-6||

vamanadravye Adau madanamuktaM prAdhAnyAt; uktaM hi- “vamanadravyeShu madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate~anapAyitvAt” iti (ka.a.1)| upasthita iti AmAshayordhvabhAge shleShmaNaH sthAnaM gatvotkleshaM gata iti vyAkhyeyam| shleShmapitta iti shleShmapitte shleShmaNi pitte ca| pittaM ca yadyapi sAkShAnna vamanaviShayaM tathA~api shleShmasthAnagatatvena shleShmasambandhAdvamanaviShayam| yaduktaM- “doShasthAnagataM doShaM sthAnivat samupAcaret” iti| dehamadUShayanniti yadyapi vamane proktaM tathA~api virecanAdiShvapi boddhavyaM, tatrApyatiyogAyogamithyAyogairdehaduShTisha~gkAyAH samAnatvAt| ucyate ca nyAyavidbhiryat- “samAneShvartheShvekatrAbhihito vidhiranyatrApyanuSha~jjanIyaH” iti||7-8||

vamanamanu virecanAbhidhAnaM shiraHpUrvakadehashodhanAbhidhAnAnukrameNAmAshayordhvabhAgashodhanAnantaramAmAshayAdhobhAgasthitapittaharatvena| evaM virecanAnantaraM bastyabhidhAne~api vAcyam| trivRudAdAvucyate, virecanadravyeShu shreShThatvAt| uktaM hi- “trivRut sukhavirecanAnAm” (sU.a.25) iti| nIlikA nIlabuhnA | kShIriNI dugdhikA| dravantI dantIbhedaH| niculaM hijjalamiti prasiddham| pakvashcAsAvAshayagatashceti pakvAshayagataH| tena pittAshaye evAmAshayAdhobhAgalakShaNe doSho virecanaviShayo bhavati, na pakvAshayagataH| doShashabdena ceha virecananirharaNayogyatvAt pittaM kaphapittaM vA gRuhyate| yaduktaM- “pittaM vA kaphapittaM vA pittAshayagataM haret| sraMsanaM, trIn malAn bastirharet pakvAshayasthitAn” (ci.a.3) iti| yadi vA pakvAshayasamIpagatatvenAdhaHpravRuttyunmukho doShaH pakvAshayagata ityucyate; yathA- ga~ggAyAM ghoSha iti||9-10||

pATalAmityAdinA~anuvAsanAt prA~gnirUhAbhidhAnaM, nirUhasya doShaharaNapradhAnatvAt| kattRuNaM gandhatRuNam| snehAH sarpistailavasAmajjAnaH| lavaNAni saindhavAdIni rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) bastyarthaM mukhyAnyuktAni gaNena| ata eveti nirUhoktapATalAdigaNAt| sa~gkalpyamanuvAsanamityanena snehasAdhanaM brUte; anuvAsanaM hi sneha eva bhavati| anuvAsanArthaM snehasAdhanadravyaM pRutha~gnoktaM, nirUhArthoktabheShajagaNenaiva tatsiddheH| mArutaghnamityanenAnuvAsanapravRuttiviShayaM darshayati; mArute hantavye~anuvAsanaM prakalpyamityarthaH| yadi vA pATalAdermArutaharAdgaNAnmArutaghnamanuvAsanaM prakalpyam; anyatra tu pittaharAdgaNAt pittaghnaM, tathA shleShmaharAdgaNAcchleShmaghnamiti sUcayati| sa~ggraha ityanena rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) kalpe siddhau ca vakShyamANapa~jcakarmaprapa~jcaM sUcayati||11-14||

pa~jcakolasAdhitA yavAgUrAdAvucyate, pa~jcakarmakShINAgnivRuddhihetutvena| dadhitthaH kapitthaH| takramiha jalArthakArakam| grAhiNIti chedaH| savAte iti savAte~atIsAre| pa~jcamUlamatra sthirAdipa~jcamUlaM; yaduktaM jatUkarNe- “dhruvAdyairvAyvatIsAre” iti; dhruvAdiH vidArigandhAdiH| pRushniparNI vartulapatrA siMhapucchI| dADimAmleti vacanena yAvatA dADimenAmlatvaM syAttAvanmAnaM dADimaM darshayati| payasyardhodake ityAdau nAgaraM mustaM; yaduktaM jatUkarNe- “raktAtIsAre~ajAkShIrajale ghanajalotpalaiH” iti| pRushniparNyA ceti raktAtIsAraghnayavAgvAmeva| sAmlAmiti dADimAmlAmiti boddhavyam| shvadaMShTretyAdau jatUkarNaH- “pRushnigokaNTakaguDairmUtrArtibastishUlanut” iti| suvarcikA sarjikAkShAraH| pipAsAghnIti chedaH| somarAjI avalgujaH | gavedhuko ghulu~jcaH; gavedhukAshca taNDulasthAne| shyAmAkaH tRuNavisheShaH; tasya ca bIjataNDulA grAhyAH| yamake ghRutataile| madirA dravasthAne| shAkAdibhiH samAnairyavAgUrmantavyA| dadhitthAmlashabdena kapitthasyAmlAvasthAyAmeva grahaNaM darshayati| kShAro yavakShAraH| takrasiddheti takrakRutodakakAryA| piNyAkaH tilakalkaH| yamaka ityanena yamakena paribharjanaM darshayati| samAShavidaletyAdau taNDulena mAShavidalasya tulyamAnatA, kShIraM ca jalasthAne, ghRutaM ca paribharjane; kiMvA mAShaprakRutikaiveyam| madashabdena viShaja-raudhira-madyamadAnAM trayANAmapi grahaNam, avisheShAbhidhAnAt| kShudhaM hanyAdityAdAvapAmArgataNDulAstaNDulasthAne; kShIragodhAmAMsarasau tu jalasthAne||18-33||

athAto~arthedashamahAmUlIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

Commentary: iti carakacaturAnanashrImaccakrapANidattakRutAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM prathamaM sUtrasthAnam||1||

tatrAyurvedavidastantrasthAnAdhyAyaprashnAnAM pRuthaktvena vAkyasho vAkyArthasho~arthAvayavashashca pravaktAro mantavyAH| tatrAha- kathaM tantrAdIni vAkyasho vAkyArthasho~arthAvayavashashcoktAni bhavantIti||16||
atrocyate- tantramArShaM kArtsnyena yathAmnAyamucyamAnaM vAkyasho bhavatyuktam||17||
buddhyA samyaganupravishyArthatattvaM vAgbhirvyAsasamAsapratij~jAhetUdAharaNopanayanigamanayuktAbhistrividhashiShyabuddhigamyAbhirucyamAnaM vAkyArthasho bhavatyuktam||18||
tantraniyatAnAmarthadurgANAM punarvibhAvanairuktamarthAvayavasho bhavatyuktam||19||

tatra cet praShTAraH syuH- caturNAmRuksAmayajuratharvavedAnAM kaM vedamupadishantyAyurvedavidaH?, kimAyuH?, kasmAdAyurvedaH?, kimarthamAyurvedaH?, shAshvato~ashAshvato vA?, kati kAni cAsyA~ggAni?, kaishcAyamadhyetavyaH?, kimarthaM ca? iti||20||

Commentary: idAnImAyurvedavidaH prashnenaiva nirNetavyA ityataH prashnAnAha- tatra cedityAdi| kaM vedamupadishanti ‘Ayurvedam’ iti sheShaH||20||

tatra bhiShajA pRuShTenaivaM caturNAmRuksAmayajuratharvavedAnAmAtmano~atharvavede bhaktirAdeshyA, vedo hyAtharvaNo dAnasvastyayanabalima~ggalahomaniyamaprAyashcittopavAsamantrAdiparigrahAccikitsAM prAha; cikitsA cAyuSho hitAyopadishyate||21||

Commentary: atharvavede bhaktiH sevetyarthaH; etena bhiShaksevyatvenAtharvavedasyAyurvedatvamuktaM bhavati| AyurvedasyAtharvavedAbhedahetumAhavedo hItyAdi| etenaikaprayojanatvAdatharvavedaikadesha evAyurveda ityuktaM bhavati||21||

vedaM copadishyAyurvAcyaM ; tatrAyushcetanAnuvRuttirjIvitamanubandho dhAri cetyeko~arthaH||22||

Commentary: prashnakrameNa vedaM pratipAdyAyureva pratipAdanIyaM bhavatItyAha- vedaM copadishyetyAdi| cetanAnuvRuttiriti caitanyasantAnaH; etacca garbhAvadhimaraNaparyantaM boddhavyaM, tadUrdhvaM cetanAnanuvRutteH; sAkShAdanupalabdhatvenaivAnanuvRuttiriti bhAvaH| na ca vAcyaM prasuptasya caitanyavicchedo bhavatIti, yatastatrApi ‘sukhamahamasvApsam’ ityuttarakAlInapratisandhAnadarshanAt sUkShmaj~jAnamastyeva| yadyapi dIrgha~jjIvitIye sharIrAdisaMyoga AyurityuktaM, tathA~api tatkAryatvAdiha caitanyAnuvRuttiH kAryakAraNayorabhedavivakShayA Ayurucyate| anubandhadhArishabdau prathamAdhyAye vyAkRutau||22||

tadAyurvedayatItyAyurvedaH ; kathamiti cet? ucyate- svalakShaNataH sukhAsukhato hitAhitataH pramANApramANatashca; yatashcAyuShyANyanAyuShyANi ca dravyaguNakarmANi vedayatyato~apyAyurvedaH| tatrAyuShyANyanAyuShyANi ca dravyaguNakarmANi kevalenopadekShyante tantreNa||23||

Commentary: kasmAdAyurvedaH? ityasyottaraM- tadAyurityAdi| vedayati bodhayati| ye tvatra tantrAntare viderlAbhAdayo~arthA vyAkhyAtAH, te na sAkShAttadarthajanyA itIha noktAH| svalakShaNata ityAdi svamayevodAhariShyati| AyuShyAnAyuShye AyuHkAraNatvena AyuHshabdena vaktavye, tenAyuShyAnAyuShyavedapakShe gauNI niruktiH ‘AyurvedaH’ iti; ata evAtra apishabdaH kRutaH- ato~apyAyurveda iti| anAyuShyamapi ca j~jAtamasevyatvenAvyavahriyamANamAyuH kAraNaM bhavatyeva, tenAnAyuShyamapyAyuHkAraNatayA AyuHshabdavAcyaM, nAtrAparAdhaH||23||

tatrAyuruktaM svalakShaNato yathAvadihaiva pUrvAdhyAye ca| tatra shArIramAnasAbhyAM rogAbhyAmanabhidrutasya visheSheNa yauvanavataH samarthAnugatabalavIryayashaHpauruShaparAkramasya j~jAnavij~jAnendriyendriyArthabalasamudaye vartamAnasya paramarddhiruciravividhopabhogasya samRuddhasarvArambhasya yatheShTavicAriNaH sukhamAyurucyate; asukhamato viparyayeNa; hitaiShiNaH punarbhUtAnAM parasvAduparatasya satyavAdinaH shamaparasya parIkShyakAriNo~apramattasya trivargaM paraspareNAnupahatamupasevamAnasya pUjArhasampUjakasya j~jAnavij~jAnopashamashIlasya vRuddhopasevinaH suniyatarAgaroSherShyAmadamAnavegasya satataM vividhapradAnaparasya tapoj~jAnaprashamanityasyAdhyAtmavidastatparasya lokamimaM cAmuM cAvekShamANasya smRutimatimato hitamAyurucyate; ahitamato viparyayeNa||24||

Commentary: ihaiveti ‘tatrAyushcetanAnuvRuttiH’ ityAdinA| tatra shArIretyAdinA sukhamAyurabhidhatte| pauruSham utkRuShTaM karma| j~jAnavij~jAnendriyairbalashabdaH, indriyArthena ca samudayashabdaH sambadhyate; kiMvA j~jAnAdibhiH sarvaireva samudayashabdaH sambadhyate; kiMvA j~jAnAdibhiH sarvaireva ‘balasamudaye’ iti yojyaM; balasya samudayo balasamudayaH| paramA atyarthA Ruddhiryasya sa paramarddhiH| samRuddhA niShpAditasAdhyAH sarvArambhA yasya sa tathA| hitaiShiNo bhUtAnAmiti sambandhaH| tatparasyeti adhyAtmaparasya, adhyAtmam AtmAdisvarUpam| amuM ceti paralokam||24||

pramANamAyuShastvarthendriyamanobuddhiceShTAdInAM vikRutilakShaNairupalabhyate~animittaiH, ayamasmAt kShaNAnmuhUrtAddivasAt tripa~jcasaptadashadvAdashAhAt pakShAnmAsAt ShaNmAsAt saMvatsarAdvA svabhAvamApatsyata iti; tatra svabhAvaH pravRutteruparamo maraNamanityatA nirodha ityeko~arthaH; ityAyuShaH pramANam; ato viparItamapramANamariShTAdhikAre; dehaprakRutilakShaNamadhikRutya copadiShTamAyuShaH pramANamAyurvede ||25||
prayojanaM cAsya svasthasya svAsthyarakShaNamAturasya vikAraprashamanaM ca||26||
arthe dasha mahAmUlAH samAsaktA mahAphalAH| mahaccArthashca hRudayaM paryAyairucyate budhaiH||3||
ShaDa~ggama~ggaM vij~jAnamindriyANyarthapa~jcakam| AtmA ca saguNashcetashcintyaM ca hRudi saMshritam||4||

so~ayamAyurvedaH shAshvato nirdishyate, anAditvAt, svabhAvasaMsiddhalakShaNatvAt, bhAvasvabhAvanityatvAcca| na hi nAbhUt kadAcidAyuShaH santAno buddhisantAno vA, shAshvatashcAyuSho veditA, anAdi ca sukhaduHkhaM sadravyahetulakShaNamaparAparayogAt| eSha cArthasa~ggraho vibhAvyate AyurvedalakShaNamiti| gurulaghushItoShNasnigdharUkShAdInAM dravyANAM sAmAnyavisheShAbhyAM vRuddhihrAsau, yathoktaM- gurubhirabhyasyamAnairgurUNAmupacayo bhavatyapacayo laghUnAM, evamevetareShAmiti, eSha bhAvasvabhAvo nityaH, svalakShaNaM ca dravyANAM pRuthivyAdInAM; santi tu dravyANi guNAshca nityAnityAH| na hyAyurvedasyAbhUtvotpattirupalabhyate, anyatrAvabodhopadeshAbhyAm; etadvai dvayamadhikRutyotpattimupadishantyeke| svAbhAvikaM cAsya lakShaNamakRutakaM, yaduktamihAdye~adhyAye ca; yathA- agnerauShNyam, apAM dravatvam| bhAvasvabhAvanityatvamapi cAsya, yathoktaM- gurubhirabhyasyamAnairgurUNAmupacayo bhavatyapacayo laghUnAmiti||27||

Commentary: anAditvAditi hetutrayamatra| prathamasya vivaraNaM- na hItyAdi| iha vyavahAranityatvamAyurvede sAdhyaM, taccArtharUpasyAyurvedasya na shabdarUpasya; kiMvA, vyavahAranityAyurvedArthAbhidhAyakasyAyurvedasya pAramparyayogAnnityatvaM sAdhyate| tatrAyuShastAvadAyurvedapratipAdyasya nityatvam| na hi nAbhUt kadAcidAyuHsantAna iti sarvadaivAyuraparAparasantAnanyAyena vidyate, AyuryuktAnAM prANinAmanucchedAdityarthaH| evaM buddhisantAno~api nahi kadAcinnAbhUditi yojanA| etena tasyApi santAnena nityasyAyuSho vedanamapi nityam| shAshvatashcAyuSho vediteti anenAyurvedaveditRunityatvamuktam| etena vedyavedanaveditRUNAmanAditvAdAyurvedasya nityatvam| na cAyuHsvarUpeNaivAyurvedaviShayaH, kiM tarhi rogAdigRuhItamityAha- anAdi cetyAdi| sukhaduHkhamiti ArogyaM sukhaM, vyAdhirduHkham| sadravyahetulakShaNamiti sahetucikitsitali~ggama| hetushabdo hi dravyashabdenaiva vyAdhikAraNasyoktatvAt prashamahetumAha; kecittu ‘sahetulakShaNam’ iti paThanti, tatrApi hetushabdena janakaH shamakashca rogaheturvAcyaH; yadi vA sukhaheturbheShajaM duHkhahetushca nidAnamiti j~jeyaM, lakShaNaM ca vyAdhyArogyayorubhayorapi; etena duHkhaM tAvat kadAcidapyajihAsitaM na bhavati, jihAsitamanupAyaM na bhavati, upAyashcAyurveda eva, sa ca sarvaduHkhaparihArArthamupAdeyaH; tasmAdduHkhaprashamanopAyopadesharUpAyurvedasyAnAditeti bhAvaH| evaM sukhasya nityopAdeyasyAnAditvaM j~jeyaM, tadupAyasyAyurvedasya ca| kathamanAdi sukhaduHkhamityAha- aparAparayogAditi; santAnAdityarthaH| svabhAvasaMsiddhalakShaNatvaM dvitIyaM hetumAha- eva cetyAdi| eSha iti AyurbuddhiveditRusukhaduHkhAni| arthasa~ggrahaH abhidheyasa~ggrahaH; etena AyurAdirAyurvedapratipAdya iti darshayati| ayaM cAyurAdiratrAyurvedalakShaNamiti vibhAvyate j~jAyata ityarthaH| AyurAdinA~abhidheyenAyurvedo lakShyate, vacanaM hi- “hitAhitaM sukhaM duHkhaM” (su. 1) ityAdyAyurvedalakShaNam| etena, AyurAderarthasyAyurvedalakShaNasyAnAditayA yathoktayA svabhAvasaMsiddhalakShaNatvaM vyAkRutaM bhavati| svabhAvasaMsiddhamiti sarvadA santAnanyAyena siddhatvamabhipretam| bhAvasvabhAvanityatvAditi tRutIyaM hetuM vyAkaroti- gurvityAdi| gurulaghusnigdharUkShashItoShNAdInAM dravyANAM sAmAnyavisheShAbhyAM yathAkramaM vRuddhihrAsau bhavataH| tadeva pUrvoktaM ghaTayati- gurubhirityAdinA evamevetareShAmityantena| evamevetareShAmiti laghubhirabhyasyamAnairlaghUnAmupacayo bhavati, apacayo gurUNAmityAdi draShTavyam| eSha ityevamprakAraH; bhAvasvabhAvo nitya iti naiSha sAmAnyavisheShAbhyAM vRuddhihrAsarUpo bhAvasvabhAvaH kadAcidanyathA bhavatItyarthaH| na kevalamayaM bhAvasvabhAvo nityaH, kintarhyanyo~apItyAha- svalakShaNaM cetyAdi| svalakShaNaM pRuthivyAdInAM kharadravatvAdi| kathaM pRuthivyAdisvalakShaNaM nityamityAha- santi tvityAdi| dravyANi yasmAt sarvadA santi, guNAshca nityAH santi sarvadA, cakArAddravyANi cAnityAni santi| tatrAkAshAdi dravyaM nityaM, pRuthivyAdi kAryaM cAnityam| eva~gguNA AkAshaparimANAdayo nityAH, anityAshra kAryaguNA rasAdayaH, anityA api ca sajAtIyAparAparasantAnanyAyena sarvadA tiShThantIti yuktamanityAnAmapi santAnanityatvamiti bhAvaH| atra bhAvasvabhAvanityatvena hetunA bhAvasvabhAvasya vyAdhijanakasya tathA vyAdhiprashamakasya nityatvena tatpratipAdakasyAyurvedasyApi nityatvamuktaM bhavatIti mantavyam| athAyurvedasya yatra tatrotpattishravaNAt kathaM nityatvamityAha- na hyAyurvedasyetyAdi| abhUtvotpattiH pUrvamasata utpattiH| anyatrAvabodhopadeshAbhyAmiti yatra yatrAyurvedasyotpattiruktA, tatra tatrAvabodhAdupadeshAdvA; avabodhAdutpattiryathA- brahmaNa AyurvedotpattiH, upadeshAccotpattiryathA- indropadeshAdbharadvAjena martyaloke Ayurveda utpAdita ityAdi| etaddvayamiti avabodhopadeshau | nanu, svabhAvasaMsiddhalakShaNatvAditi yo heturuktaH, tatra svAbhAvikaM ca lakShaNaM bhaviShyatyanityaM ca, yathA- ghaTe kambugrIvAkAratAdi, na hi tat svAbhAvikamapi ghaTasya nityatAM sAdhayatItyAha- svAbhAvikaM cetyAdi| akRutakamiti nAsmadAdinA kRutam| yaduktamiha- ‘svalakShaNataH sukhAsukhataH’ ityAdinA, Adye cAdhyAye dIrgha~jjIvitIye “hitAhitaM sukhaM duHkhaM” (sU. 1) ityAdinA| atraivAkRutakatve dRuShTAntamAha- yathA~agnerauShNyamityAdi| etena svalakShaNasyAkRutakatvena vyavahAranityatvAttatpratipAdakasyAyurvedasyApi vyavahAranityatvamiti bhAvaH| na kevalaM svAbhAvikaM lakShaNamakRutakaM, kiM tarhi bhAvasvabhAvanityatvamapi na kenacidIshvarAdinA kRutamityAha- bhAvasvabhAvanityatvamapi ceti; akRutakamiti cakAreNAnukarShati| tadeva bhAvasvabhAvanityatvaM darshayati- yathoktamityAdi| sAmAnyavisheShakRutavRuddhihrAsakArako(No)~api bhAvasvabhAvo na kenacit kRuta ityarthaH, tatashcAyurvedo~api nityaH||27||

tasyAyurvedasyA~ggAnyaShTau; tadyathA- kAyacikitsA , shAlAkyaM, shalyApahartRukaM, viShagaravairodhikaprashamanaM, bhUtavidyA, kaumArabhRutyakaM, rasAyanaM, vAjIkaraNamiti||28||

Commentary: samprati kAni cetyAdiprashnasyottaraM- tasyetyAdi| kAyasyAntaragneshcikitsA kAyacikitsA| paTalavedhashalAkApradhAnama~ggaM shAlAkyam| garaH kAlAntaraprakopi viShaM, vairodhikaM saMyogaviruddham | bhUtAnAM rAkShasAdInAM j~jAnArthA prashamArthA ca vidyA bhUtavidyA| kumArasya bharaNamadhikRutya kRutaM kaumArabhRutyam||28||

sa cAdhyetavyo brAhmaNarAjanyavaishyaiH| tatrAnugrahArthaM prANinAM brAhmaNaiH, ArakShArthaM rAjanyaiH, vRuttyarthaM vaishyaiH; sAmAnyato vA dharmArthakAmaparigrahArthaM sarvaiH| tatra yadadhyAtmavidAM dharmapathasthAnAM dharmaprakAshakAnAM vA mAtRupitRubhrAtRubandhugurujanasya vA vikAraprashamane prayatnavAn bhavati, yaccAyurvedoktamadhyAtmamanudhyAyati vedayatyanuvidhIyate vA, so~asya paro dharmaH; yA punarIshvarANAM vasumatAM vA sakAshAt sukhopahAranimittA bhavatyarthAvAptirArakShaNaM ca, yA ca svaparigRuhItAnAM prANinAmAturyAdArakShA, so~asyArthaH; yat punarasya vidvadgrahaNayashaH sharaNyatvaM ca, yA ca sammAnashushrUShA, yacceShTAnAM viShayANAmArogyamAdhatte so~asya kAmaH| iti yathAprashnamuktamasheSheNa||29||

Commentary: ArakShArthaM rAjanyairiti kShatriyasya paripAlanadharmatvAt| anudhyAyati manasA cintayati| vedayatIti anyasya pratipAdayati| anuvidhIyata iti tadanuguNaM dehenAnutiShThati| ArakShaNam AtmAdirakShaNam| svaparigRuhItAnAmiti bhRutyAdInAm| vidvadgrahaNameva yashaH vidvadupAdeyatAjanyaM yasha ityarthaH| iShTAnAmiti vanitAdInAm||29||

atha bhiShagAdita eva bhiShajA praShTavyo~aShTavidhaM bhavati- tantraM, tantrArthAn, sthAnaM, sthAnArthAn, adhyAyam, adhyAyArthAn, prashnaM, prashnArthAMshceti; pRuShTena caitadvaktavyamasheSheNa vAkyasho vAkyArthasho~arthAvayavashashceti ||30||

Commentary: bhiShakparIkShArthaM pRucchAvidhimAha- athetyAdi||30||
tatrAyurvedaH shAkhA vidyA sUtraM j~jAnaM shAstraM lakShaNaM tantramityanarthAntaram ||31||

tantrArthaH punaH svalakShaNairupadiShTaH| sa cArthaH prakaraNairvibhAvyamAno bhUya eva sharIravRuttihetuvyAdhikarmakAryakAlakartRukaraNavidhivinishcayAddashaprakaraNaH, tAni ca prakaraNAni kevalenopadekShyante tantreNa||32||

tantrasyAsyAShTau sthAnAni ; tadyathA- shlokanidAnavimAnashArIrendriyacikitsitakalpasiddhisthAnAni| tatra triMshadadhyAyakaM shlokasthAnam, aShTAShTAdhyAyakAni nidAnavimAnashArIrasthAnAni, dvAdashakamindriyANAM, triMshakaM cikitsitAnAM, dvAdashake kalpasiddhisthAne bhavataH||33||

Commentary: tantrasyAsyetyAdi| indriyANAM cikitsitAnAM cetyubhayatrApi sthAnamiti sheShaH||33||

bhavati cAtra- dve triMshake dvAdashakaM trayaM ca trINyaShTakAnyeShu samAptiruktA| shlokauShadhAriShTavikalpasiddhinidAnamAnAshrayasa~jj~jakeShu||34||

Commentary: triMshake iti sUtrasthAnaM cikitsitaM ca| Ashrayasa~jj~jakaM shArIrasthAnam, Ashrayo hi sharIramucyate||34||

sve sve sthAne yathAsvaM ca sthAnArtha upadekShyate| saviMshamadhyAyashataM shRuNu nAmakramAgatam||35||

Commentary: saviMshamiti viMshatishabdAt svArthe ‘DaH’, svArthikashca ‘DaH’ pratyayo bhavati; tena laliteshvare ca- “caturviMshAdhikaM” iti prayogaH siddho bhavati; vacanaM hi “caturviMshAdhikaM j~jeyaM bhuvanAnAM shatatrayam” iti| evaM sushrute~api ‘saviMshaM’ (su.sU.a.1) iti vyAkhyeyam||35||
dIrgha~jjIvo~apyapAmArgataNDulAragvadhAdikau| ShaDvirekAshrayashceti catuShko bheShajAshrayaH||36||
mAtrAtasyAshitIyau ca navegAndhAraNaM tathA| indriyopakramashceti catvAraH svAsthyavRuttikAH ||37||
khuDDAkashca catuShpAdo mahAMstisraiShaNastathA| saha vAtakalAkhyena vidyAnnairdeshikAn budhaH||38||
snehanasvedanAdhyAyAvubhau yashcopakalpanaH| cikitsAprAbhRutashcaiva sarva eva prakalpanAH||39||
kiyantaHshirasIyashca trishophAShTodarAdikau| rogAdhyAyo mahAMshcaiva rogAdhyAyacatuShTayam||40||
aShTauninditasa~gkhyAtastathA la~gghanatarpaNe| vidhishoNitikashcaiva vyAkhyAtAstatra yojanAH||41||
yajjaHpuruShasa~gkhyAto bhadrakApyAnnapAnikau| vividhAshitapItIyashcatvAro~annavinishcayAH||42||
dashaprANAyatanikastathA~arthedashamUlikaH| dvAvetau prANadehArthau proktau vaidyaguNAshrayau||43||
auShadhasvasthanirdeshakalpanArogayojanAH| catuShkAH ShaT krameNoktAH saptamashcAnnapAnikaH||44||
dvau cAntyau sa~ggrahAdhyAyAviti triMshakamarthavat| shlokasthAnaM samuddiShTaM tantrasyAsya shiraH shubham ||45||
catuShkANAM mahArthAnAM sthAne~asmin sa~ggrahaH kRutaH| shlokArthaH sa~ggrahArthashca shlokasthAnamataH smRutam||46||
jvarANAM raktapittasya gulmAnAM mehakuShThayoH| shoShonmAdanidAne ca syAdapasmAriNAM ca yat||47||
ityadhyAyAShTakamidaM nidAnasthAnamucyate| raseShu trividhe kukShau dhvaMse janapadasya ca||48||
trividhe rogavij~jAne srotaHsvapi ca vartane| rogAnIke vyAdhirUpe rogANAM ca bhiShagjite||49||
aShTau vimAnAnyuktAni mAnArthAni maharShiNA| katidhApuruShIyaM ca gotreNAtulyameva ca||50||
khuDDikA mahatI caiva garbhAvakrAntirucyate| puruShasya sharIrasya vicayau dvau vinishcitau||51||
sharIrasa~gkhyA sUtraM ca jAteraShTamamucyate | ityuddiShTAni muninA shArIrANyatrisUnunA||52||
varNasvarIyaH puShpAkhyastRutIyaH parimarshanaH| caturtha indriyAnIkaH pa~jcamaH pUrvarUpikaH||53||
katamAnisharIrIyaH pannarUpo~apyavAkshirAH| yasyashyAvanimittashca sadyomaraNa eva ca||54||
aNujyotiriti khyAtastathA gomayacUrNavAn| dvAdashAdhyAyakaM sthAnamindriyANAmiti smRutam ||55||
abhayAmalakIyaM ca prANakAmIyameva ca| karapracitakaM vedasamutthAnaM rasAyanam||56||
saMyogasharamUlIyamAsiktakShIrakaM tathA| mAShaparNabhRutIyaM ca pumA~jjAtabalAdikam||57||
catuShkadvayamapyetadadhyAyadvayamucyate| rasAyanamiti j~jeyaM vAjIkaraNameva ca||58||
jvarANAM raktapittasya gulmAnAM mehakuShThayoH| shoShonmAde~apyapasmAre kShatashothodarArshasAm||59||
grahaNIpANDurogANAM shvAsakAsAtisAriNAm| chardivIsarpatRuShNAnAM viShamadyavikArayoH||60||
dvivraNIyaM trimarmIyamUrustambhikameva ca| vAtaroge vAtarakte yonivyApatsu caiva yat||61||
triMshaccikitsitAnyuktAnyataH kalpAn pracakShmahe| phalajImUtakekShvAkukalpo dhAmArgavasya ca||62||
pa~jcamo vatsakasyoktaH ShaShThashca kRutavedhane| shyAmAtrivRutayoH kalpastathaiva catura~ggule||63||
tilvakasya sudhAyAshca saptalAsha~gkhinIShu ca| dantIdravantyoH kalpashca dvAdasho~ayaM samApyate||64||
kalpanA pa~jcakarmAkhyA bastisUtrI tathaiva ca| snehavyApadikI siddhirnetravyApadikI tathA||65||
siddhiH shodhanayoshcaiva bastisiddhistathaiva ca| prAsRutI marmasa~gkhyAtA siddhirbastyAshrayA ca yA||66||
phalamAtrA tathA siddhiH siddhishcottarasa~jj~jitA| siddhayo dvAdashaivaitAstantraM cAsu samApyate||67||
sve sve sthAne tathA~adhyAye cAdhyAyArthaH pravakShyate| taM brUyAt sarvataH sarvaM yathAsvaM hyarthasa~ggrahAt||68||
pRucchA tantrAdyathAmnAyaM vidhinA prashna ucyate| prashnArtho yuktimAMstasya tantreNaivArthanishcayaH ||69||
niruktaM tantraNAttantraM, sthAnamarthapratiShThayA| adhikRutyArthamadhyAyanAmasa~jj~jA pratiShThitA ||70||
iti sarvaM yathAprashnamaShTakaM samprakAshitam| kArtsnyena coktastantrasya sa~ggrahaH suvinishcitaH||71||
santi pAllavikotpAtAH sa~gkShobhaM janayanti ye| vartakAnAmivotpAtAH sahasaivAvibhAvitAH||72||
tasmAttAn pUrvasa~jjalpe sarvatrAShTakamAdishet| parAvaraparIkShArthaM tatra shAstravidAM balam||73||
shabdamAtreNa tantrasya kevalasyaikadeshikAH| bhramantyalpabalAstantre jyAshabdeneva vartakAH||74||
pashuH pashUnAM daurbalyAt kashcinmadhye vRukAyate| sa satyaM vRukamAsAdya prakRutiM bhajate pashuH||75||
tadvadaj~jo~aj~jamadhyasthaH kashcinmaukharyasAdhanaH| sthApayatyAptamAtmAnamAptaM tvAsAdya bhidyate||76||
babhrurgUDha ivorNAbhirabuddhirabahushrutaH| kiM vai vakShyati sa~jjalpe kuNDabhedI jaDo yathA||77||
sadvRuttairna vigRuhNIyAdbhiShagalpashrutairapi| hanyAt prashnAShTakenAdAvitarAMstvAptamAninaH ||78||
dambhino mukharA hyaj~jAH prabhUtAbaddhabhAShiNaH| prAyaH, prAyeNa sumukhAH santo yuktAlpabhAShiNaH||79||
tattvaj~jAnaprakAshArthamaha~gkAramanAshritaH| svalpAdhArAj~jamukharAnmarShayenna vivAdinaH||80||
paro bhUteShvanukroshastattvaj~jAna(ne)parA dayA| yeShAM teShAmasadvAdanigrahe niratA matiH||81||
asatpakShAkShaNitvArtidambhapAruShyasAdhanAH| bhavantyanAptAH sve tantre prAyaH paravikatthakAH||82||
tAn kAlapAshasadRushAn varjayecchAstradUShakAn| prashamaj~jAnavij~jAnapUrNAH sevyA bhiShaktamAH||83||
samagraM duHkhamAyattamavij~jAne dvayAshrayam| sukhaM samagraM vij~jAne vimale ca pratiShThitam||84||
idamevamudArArthamaj~jAnAM na prakAshakam| shAstraM dRuShTipraNaShTAnAM yathaivAdityamaNDalam||85||
tatra shlokAH- arthe dashamahAmUlAH sa~jj~jA cAsAM yathA kRutA| ayanAntAH ShaDagryAshca rUpaM vedavidAM ca yat||86||
saptakashcAShTakashcaiva pariprashnAH sanirNayAH| yathA vAcyaM yadarthaM ca ShaDvidhAshcaikadeshikAH||87||
arthedashamahAmUle sarvametat prakAshitam| sa~ggrahashcAyamadhyAyastantrasyAsyaiva kevalaH||88||
yathA sumanasAM sUtraM sa~ggrahArthaM vidhIyate| sa~ggrahArthaM tathA~arthAnAmRuShiNA sa~ggrahaH kRutaH||89||
agniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRuteiyatA~avadhinA sarvaM sUtrasthAnaM samApyate

pratiShThArthaM hi bhAvAnAmeShAM hRudayamiShyate| gopAnasInAmAgArakarNikevArthacintakaiH||5||

Commentary: atha kathamamI ShaDa~ggAdayo hRudayAshrayAH, yAvatA “hRudayaM dvya~ggulaM” (vi. 8) iti vakShyati, a~ggaM ca ShaDa~ggAshrayaM mahat, indriyANyapi ca svAshraya cakShurAdisthitAni, arthAshca bAhyadravyAshrayiNaH, AtmA cAnAshrita eva vyApakaH, tadguNashca vij~jAnamAtmanyevAshritaM, mano~apyanAshritamAtmagataM, cintyaM ca dhyeyAdi na hRudi, ityAsha~gkyAha- pratiShThetyAdi|- pratiShThA kAryakaraNAvirodhenAvasthAnam | bhAvAnAmeShAmiti ShaDa~ggAdInAm| hRudayamiShyate ‘kAraNam’ iti sheShaH| atraiva dRuShTAntamAha gopAnasInAmityAdi| gopAnasyaH gRuhAcchAdanAdhArakAShThAni | AgArakarNikA gRuhAcchAdanamadhye gRuhAcchAdanakAShThanibandhanI loke ‘ADakam’ ityucyate| arthacintakairiti hRudayacintakaiH| tena, ShaDa~ggAdInAM hRudayAshritatvaM nAdhArAdheyabhAvena, kiM tarhi tadanvayavyatirekAnuvidhAyitveneti darshitaM bhavati| hRudayAshritatvaM hRudaye prakRutisthe ShaDa~ggAdibhAvAnAM prakRutisthatvaM, hRudayopaghAte tadupaghAta ityarthaH| yadyapi ca, Atmavij~jAnamanasAM hRudayAshritatvamAdhArAdheyabhAvAdapi kaShTasRuShTyA pAryate vaktuM, tathA~api sarvavyApakatvAnnopAdeyamAdhAradheyatvam| naivam, AtmA hyatra saMsArI bhogAyatanatvenAbhipretaH, sa ca hRudayapradesha eva sukhaduHkhAdyupalabhata ityanubhavasiddhaM, tena hRudayAshrita ivAtmA| tathA mano~api prAyeNa hRudyeva tiShThati, yata uparatakriyaM mano hRudyeva tiShThati, tathA dhyAne yoge ca hRudisthameva mano bhavati| yadapyuktam- “Atmasthe manasi sthire” (shA. 1) iti, tadapyAtmasthatvaM manaso hRudayasthatvameva| evaM j~jAnasukhaduHkhAni ca hRudayasthAnyeva lakShyante, tathA hyaticintanAttathA duHkhAveshAdvA hRudayameva pIDyate, nAnyada~ggam| bhavatvanenAvyApakenAshrayAshrayibhAvena vyutpAditena | tameva hRudayopaghAte ShaDa~ggAdibhAvopaghAtamAha- tasyopaghAtAdityAdi| tasyeti hRudayasya| upaghAtaH ki~jcidupahananam| bhedAditi mahopaghAtAt| maraNaM ca ShaDa~ggAdInAM sarveShAmeva yathoktapratiShThAnAsha iti bhAvaH||5||-
yaddhi tat sparshavij~jAnaM dhAri tattatra saMshritam||6||
tat parasyaujasaH sthAnaM tatra caitanyasa~ggrahaH| hRudayaM mahadarthashca tasmAduktaM cikitsakaiH ||7||

tena mUlena mahatA mahAmUlA matA dasha| ojovahAH sharIre~asmin vidhamyante samantataH||8||

Commentary: samprati dhamanInAM mahAmUlatvaM pratipAdayati- tenetyAdi| teneti hRudayena mahatA, ‘yuktAH’ iti sheShaH| vidhamyante visarpante ||8||
yenaujasA vartayanti prINitAH sarvadehinaH | yadRute sarvabhUtAnAM jIvitaM nAvatiShThate||9||
yat sAramAdau garbhasya yattadgarbharasAdrasaH | saMvartamAnaM hRudayaM samAvishati yat purA ||10||
yasya nAshAttu nAsho~asti dhAri yaddhRudayAshritam | yaccharIrarasasnehaH prANA yatra pratiShThitAH||11||

dhmAnAddhamanyaH sravaNAt srotAMsi saraNAtsirAH||12||

Commentary: dhamanIshabdAdiniruktimAha- dhmAnAdityAdi| dhmAnAt pUraNAd vAhyena rasAdinetyarthaH| sravaNAditi rasAdereva poShyasya sravaNAt| saraNAd deshAntaragamanAt||12||
tanmahat tA mahAmUlAstaccojaH parirakShatA| parihAryA visheSheNa manaso duHkhahetavaH||13||
hRudyaM yat syAdyadaujasyaM srotasAM yat prasAdanam| tattat sevyaM prayatnena prashamo j~jAnameva ca||14||

atha khalvekaM prANavardhanAnAmutkRuShTatamamekaM balavardhanAnAmekaM bRuMhaNAnAmekaM nandanAnAmekaM harShaNAnAmekamayanAnAmiti | tatrAhiMsA prANinAM prANavardhanAnAmutkRuShTatamaM, vIryaM balavardhanAnAM, vidyA bRuMhaNAnAm, indriyajayo nandanAnAM, tattvAvabodho harShaNAnAM, brahmacaryamayanAnAmiti ; evamAyurvedavido manyante||15||

Commentary: sevyaprastAvena prANavardhanAdyutkRuShTAnyahiMsAdInyapyAha- atha khalvityAdi| ekamiti ekameva, na dvitIyamutkRuShTatamamastItyarthaH| ayanAnAmiti mArgANAm| yadyapyannaM prANavardhanaM tathA~apyahiMsaivotkRuShTA, ahiMsayA hi dharmajananAttatkRutamavicAlyaM bhavati| yadyapi mAMsaM bRuMhaNapradhAnaM, tathA~api taccharIramAtrabRuMhaNaM, vidyA tu sharIramanobRuMhaNIyA~atiricyate||15||

pArisheShyAt kiMvA sUtrasthAnamabhidhAya tantrasa~ggrahaM vaktumarthedashamahAmUlIya ucyate| atra ‘adhikRutya kRute granthe’ (pA. a. 4/3/87) ityanuvartamAne “adhyAyAnuvAkayorluk ca” (pA. a. 5/2/60) iti cchaH||1-2||

AyurvedashravaNaprasa~ggenAyurvedaniruktyA~a~ayuShastathA~a~ayurvedasya ca nirUpakaM prakaraNaM brUte- tatretyAdi| vAkyasha ityAdi svayameva vyAkariShyati| ArSham RuShikRutam| tantraM shAstram| yathAmnAyamucyamAnamiti yathApAThakrameNocyamAnam| udAharaNaM dRuShTAntaH; upanayaH siddhAntopapAditasya sAdhanadharmasya sAdhye punaH kathanaM, yathA- tathA cAyaM dhUmavAniti; nigamanaM hetusAdhitasAdhyadharmakathanaM, yathA- tasmAdagnimAniti| tantraniyatAnAmiti tantragatAnAm| vibhAvanairuktamiti vyAkhyAnaiH kathanam; uktamiti bhAve ‘ktaH’| asyodAharaNaM yathA- “sharIraceShTA yA ceShTA sthairyArthA balavardhinI” (sU. 7) ityatra ‘iShTA yA ceShTA’ ityetAvanmAtramucyate, tena dvitIyaceShTApadasya durgasya vyAkaraNaM paraM bhavati||16-19||

vikRutirUpairlakShaNaiH vikRutilakShaNaiH; teShAmeva visheShaNam- animittaiH; AkasmikaiH ariShTairityarthaH; animittA hi vikRutirarthendriyANAmariShTam| tatrArthavikRutiryathA- “nAnApuShpopamagandho yasya vAti divAnisham” (iM. 2) ityAdi, indriyavikRutiryathA- “yashca pashyatyadRushyAn” (iM. 4) ityAdi, manovikRutiryathA- “yaiH purA vindate bhAvaiH sametaiH paramAM ratim| tairevAramamANasya glAsnormaraNamAdishet” (iM.a.8) iti, buddhivikRutiryathA- “buddhirbalamahetukam” ityAdi, ceShTAvikRutiryathA- “vikarShanniva yaH pAdau cyutAMsaH paridhAvati” (iM. 12) ityAdi| AdigrahaNAt parijanavikRutyAdayo j~jeyAH| atra ca riShTaprastAve kShaNAdivarShAntakAlakathanaM varShAdUrdhvaM riShTajanyamaraNAbhAvAt| ato viparItamapramANamiti riShTahInaM na nishcitapramANamAyurariShTAdhikAra ityarthaH| anyadapi cAyuHpramANaj~jAnamAhadehaprakRutItyAdi | dehashca prakRutishca lakShaNaM ca dehaprakRutilakShaNam| tatra dehamadhikRutyAyuHpramANaM yathA- “sarvaiH sArairupetAH” ityArabhya yAvat “cirajIvinashca bhavanti” (vi. 8) iti; prakRutito yathA- “shlaiShmikA balavanto vasumanto vidyAvanta ojasvinaH shAntA AyuShmantashca bhavanti” (vi. 8) iti; lakShaNato yathA- “tatremAnyAyuShmatAM kumArANAM lakShaNAni bhavanti” (shA. 8) ityAdi| kiMvA, dehasya sahajalakShaNaM dehaprakRutilakShaNaM, tacca sarvaM sAraprakRutyAdilakShaNaM boddhavyam||25-26||

arthe iti hRudaye, mahAmUlA iti mahaddhRudayaM mUlaM yAsAM dhamanInAM tAstathA, samAsaktA ityAshritAH| tasya hRudayasya paryAyAnAha- mahaccetyAdi| mahatsa~jj~jA tathA arthasa~jj~jA ca hRudayasya vaidyavyavahArasiddhA na sarvatra shAstrAntareShu| hRudayasya yathA yanmahattvaM yathA vA arthyamAnatvenArthatvaM taddhRudayasyAbhyarhitatvAt| abhyarhitatvamAha- ShaDa~ggamityAdi| ShaDa~ggAni bAhudvayaja~gghAdvayashirontarAdhirUpANi yasya tat ShaDa~ggama~ggam| a~ggaM ca ShaDa~ggAdatiriktaM samudAyarUpamavayavirUpaM vA| a~ggamiti vaktavye ShaDa~ggavisheShaNaM ShaNNAma~ggAnAmapi hRudayAshritatvapratipAdanArthaM; kiMvA, a~ggashabdasyAvayavavAcino niShedhArtham| vij~jAnaM ca yadyapi ‘AtmA ca saguNaH’ iti vacanAdeva AtmaguNatvena labdhaM, tathA~apyAtmaguNeShu prAdhAnyAt punaH pRuthagucyate; vacanaM hi “sukhaM samagraM vij~jAnaM visarge ca pratiShThitam” iti| indriyANi cakShurAdIni pa~jca| arthapa~jcakaM shabdAdi| saguNa ityanena sukhAdigrahaNam| cetaH manaH| cintyaM manoviShayaH| ete ca ShaDa~ggavij~jAnAdayaH prati prati paThitAH pratyekamevopAdeyatvena; tenAtra kasyacidarthalabdhatvenopAdAnaM kartavyamiti nodbhAvanIyam, arthalabdho hyarthaH sAkShAdanabhidhIyamAnatvAdapradhAnaM bhavati||3-4||

tatretyAdi| svalakShaNairiti tadAyurvedayatItyAyurvedaH, ityAdinA hitAhitAyUrUpairityarthaH| prakaraNairiti AyurvedapradeshaiH| dashaprakaraNAni dashabhedAH, te ca sharIrAdayo dasha| tatra sharIraM pa~jcamahAbhUtavikArasamudayAtmakamavayavAdibhedAdbahuprakAraM; vRuttishcAhAro~ashitapItAdibhedabhinnA(nnaH); hetustu vyAdhiheturasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogapraj~jAparAdhapariNAmalakShaNaH; vyAdhishca dhAtuvaiShamyarUpaH; karma cikitsA; kAryam ArogyaM; kAlaH RutvAdiH, kriyAkAlashca; kartA bhiShak; karaNaM bheShajaM; vidhiH vidhAnam upakalpanA, sA ca kAlavyAdhidravyApekShA boddhavyA, yathA- “hemante~abhyasatastoyamuShNamAyurna hIyate” (sU. 6) ityAdi; deshastvatrAhito hetugrahaNena, hitastu deshaH karaNagrahaNena gRuhIto mantavyaH | sharIravRuttyAdibhedAshca bahavaH kRutsne tantre buddhimatA boddhavyAH| kevaleneti samagreNa||31-32||

dIrgha~jjIvetyAdisa~jj~jAH shlokAnurodhAdekadeshalakShaNA boddhavyAH| prANadehArthAvityAdau dehashabdenaujo~abhidhIyate | shiraH shubhamityatra shira iva shiraH| shlokArtha ityAdau sa~ggrahArthashceti cakArAt sushrutoktasUtraNAdikaM, tena “sUtraNAt sUcanAccaiva dhAraNAdarthasantataiH| sUtrasthAnaM samuddiShTam” (su. sU. 3) ityetadapi gRuhItaM bhavati| mAnArthAnIti j~jAnArthAni| indriyANAmiti riShTAnAm| catuShkadvayamiti rasAyanapAdacatuShka ekaH, vAjIkaraNapAdacatuShkashcaikaH; catuShpAdashcAdhyAyo bhavatIti yuktamevAdhyAyatvam| tantraM cAsu samApyata iti Asu samAptAsu tantraM samApyata ityarthaH| cAdhyAyArtha iti cakAro bhinnakrame; tena adhyAyArthashcAdhyAyAnte tathA sthAnArthashca sthAnAnte kRutasa~ggrahaH| yadyapi shArIre sthAnArtho na vyaktaH, tathA~api shArIrashabdavyupattyA boddhavyastantrAntarAdvA; yathA- “sharIraM cintyate sarvaM daivamAnuShasampadA| sarvabhAvairyatastasmAcchArIraM sthAnamucyate” (shA. 8) iti||36-68||

prashnAShTakasyoktasya nirAkaraNIyasa~jj~jAmAha - santItyAdi| pAllavikAH prAdeshikAH| vartakA akasmAdutpatantaH kShobhaM manaso janayantIti lokaprasiddham| aShTakamiti yathoktaM prashnAShTakam| parAvarau shreShThAshreShThau| tatra shAstravidAM balamiti shAstravida eva prashnAShTakaM jAnanti na pAllavikAH||72-74||

prakRutiH svabhAvaH| babhrurUrNAvAn kashcit pashuH, sa yathA meShaM yuddhAyAtmIyAmivorNAM dRuShTvA upasarpanna~ggabha~ggamApnoti, tadvadaj~jo~apyAptaM prApya bhidyata ityarthaH; kiMvA, babhrurvRuddhanakula UrNArAshimadhyago yathA ki~jcinna pratipadyate, tathA~abuddhirapi sa~jjalpe vAdiprativAdikathAyAm| kuNDabhedI bhraShTayoniH; tena pRucchAditAtmIyanirNitajAtiryathA~avadAtajAtiH san kashcidbrUte, tathA~abuddhirapi sa~jjalpe| vigRuhNIyAd vigRuhya sambhAShAM kuryAt| itarAn asadvRuttAn| svalpAdhArAHsvalpashrutAH| na marShayediti nopekSheta| aj~javaidyasaMvAdapratiShedhaphalamAha- paro bhUteShvityAdi| niratA iti tatparA||75-81||

aj~javaidyaphalamAha- asatpakShetyAdi| asatpakShAdi sAdhanaM yeShAM te tathA; asatpakShaH anAgamapakShasiddhaH pakShaH| akShaNitvaM pRucchArthamanuyuktasya ‘samprati vaktuM kShaNo nAsi’ iti bhAShaNam, artiH pRucchArthamanuyuktasya shirovyathAdikamudbhAvya bhAShaNaM, dambhaH pustakavaidyabhANDAdibhiH svArthotkarShapratipAdanaM, pAruShyaM kRucchrato~api navAcyatvAdiparuShabhAShaNam | anAptAH sve tantra iti svatantrAnabhij~jAnAt| paravikatthakAH paradUShakAH||82-83||

dvayAshrayamiti manaHsharIrAshrayam| samagramiti shArIraM mAnasaM ca sukhamArogyAdirUpam| vij~jAne vimala iti vishuddhaj~jAne, kiMvA vij~jAne vimala iti mokShe, mokShe hi sukhaM svacchaM samagraM ca duHkhAsambhinnatvAt; kiMvA, bhaTTadarshanAt susambhavam| idamiti shAstram| evamudArArthamiti lokadvayahitArthAbhidhAyakam| dRuShTipraNaShTAnAmiti praNaShTadRushAm||84-85||

sa~ggrahe sa~jj~jA cAsAM yathA kRuteti ‘tena mUlena mahatA mahAmUlA’ ityAdinA| ayanAntAH ShaDagryAshceti ‘ekaM prANavardhanAnAm’ ityAdinoktAH| ete cAhiMsAdayo~agryAdhikAre yajjaHpuruShIye uktA ulla~gghyehoktA adhyAtmaviShayatvena, pUrvoktAstvagryarogAdhikArikAH; uktaM hi tatra- “alametadvikArANAm” (sU.a.25) ityAdi| saptakaH prashnaH ‘kimAyuH? kasmAdAyurvedaH?’ ityAdi; aShTakaH prashnaH ‘tantraM tantrArthaM’ ityAdi||86-89||

kathametadbhavatItyAha- yaddhItyAdi| sparsho vij~jAyate~aneneti sparshaM vA vijAnAtIti sparshavij~jAnaM; tasyaiva visheShaNaM- dhArIti, dhAri tu sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogaH; yaduktaM- “sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogo dhAri jIvitam” (sU. 1) iti; etena yaH sharIrAdisaMyogaH sparshanena vijAnAti sarvaM j~jeyaM, yashcAyaM sharIradhAraNAddhArItyucyate, sa hRudi sthitaH| tena, tadupaghAtAnmUrcchA tathA tadbhedAnmaraNaM caitanyAnanuvRuttilakShaNamupapannam| sparsho hi dvividha aindriyako mAnasashca, etatsparshadvayaM vinA na ki~jcijj~jAnaM bhavati;
