yaduktaM- “yashcaivaindriyakaH sparshaH sparsho mAnasa eva ca| dvividhaH sukhaduHkhAnAM vedanAnAM pravartakaH” (shA. 1) iti| mAnasaM ca sparshanaM shArIre yathAsthAnameva darshayiShyAmaH| sparsho vij~jAyata iti niruktipakShe tu sparshashabdena lakShaNayA spRushyamAno~artho~abhipretaH, tena sarvaj~jeyAvarodhaH; yaM prApyaivArthamindriyANi sparshenArthaM prakAshayanti, yaduktaM- “spRushyate nAnupAdAno nA~aspRuShTo vetti vedanAH” (shA. 1) iti| yadyapi sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogaH sharIrapradeshAntare~apyasti, tathA~api nAsau sharIradhAraNe tathA j~jAnotpattau vA pradhAnaM, tadupaghAte~api sharIradhAraNaj~jAnayordRuShTatvAt; hRudgatastu saMyogaH pradhAnaM, tadanvayavyatirekAnuvidhAyitvAt sparshaj~jAnasharIradhAraNayoH; tena sUktaM- tattatra saMshritamiti| hRudayAbhyarhitatve dharmAntaramAha- tat parasyetyAdi| parasya shreShThasya| etena dvividhamojo darshayati- paramaparaM ca; tatrA~jjaliparimANamaparaM, yaduktaM- “tAvadeva parimANaM shlaiShmikasyaujasaH” (shA. 7) iti; alpapramANaM tu paraM, yadabhipretyoktaM- “hRudi tiShThati yacchuddhaM raktamIShatsapItakam” (sU. 17) iti, tantrAntare~apyuktaM- “prANAshrayasyaujaso~aShTau bindavo hRudayAshritAH” iti; ki~jca, sati hi pare cApare caujasi ‘parasya’ iti visheShaNaM sArthakaM bhavati, natvekarUpe| ardhA~jjaliparimitasyaujaso dhamanya eva hRudayAshritAH sthAnam| tathA pramehe~ardhA~jjaliparimitamevaujaH kShIyate nAShTabindukam, asya hi ki~jcitkShaye~api maraNaM bhavati; pramehe tu ojaHkShaye jIvatyeva tAvat; ojaHkShayalakShaNamapyardhA~jjalyojaHkShaya eva boddhavyam| ojaHshabdashca yadyapi rase~api vartate, yaduktaM- “rasashcaujasa~gkhyAtaH” (ni. 4) iti, tathA “malIbhavati tat prAyaH kalpate ki~jcidojase” (ci. 8) iti; tathA~apIha sarvadhAtusAramojo~abhidhIyate| etaccauja upadhAturUpaM kecidAhuH; dhAturhi dhAraNapoShaNayogAdbhavati, ojastu dehadhArakaM sadapi na dehapoShakaM, tena nAShTamo dhAturojaH| kecittu shukravisheShamojaH prAhuH, tacca na manaH prINAti| ye tu bruvate- sarvadhAtUnAM sArasamudayabhUtamojaH, te rasAdisArarUpatayA rasAdibhyo~abhinnamoja iti pRuthagdhAtutvenopadhAtutvena vA na nirdeshyamiti pashyanti; vacanaM ca- “bhramaraiH phalapuShpebhyo yathA sa~jcIyate madhu| tadvadojaH sharIrebhyo guNaiH sambhriyate nRuNAm” (sU. 17) iti; atra sharIrebhya iti dhAtubhyaH, guNairiti sArabhAgaiH| tatra caitanyasa~ggraha iti tatra hRudi AtmA caitanyasya svaviShaye prasRutasya sa~ggrahaNaM karoti, tena prasRutaM mano hRudaye nigRuhya yogaj~jo bhavatyAtmetyuktaM bhavati; tatashca yogasya mokShasAdhanatvenopAdeyasyApi hRudayameva sthAnamiti hRudayamabhyarhitaM bhavati| yasmAdeva~gguNaM hRudayam, ato hRudayaM ‘mahad’ iti ca, tathA ‘artha’ iti cocyate cikitsakaiH||6-7||

samprati dhamanInAmuktaM mahAphalatvaM vyutpAdayannAha- yenaujasetyAdi| yenaujaseti sAmAnyena dvividhamapyojo grAhyam| vartayanti jIvanti, vartayantIti caurAdiko Nic| prINitA iti tarpitAH| yat sAramAdau garbhasyeti shukrashoNitasaMyoge jIvAdhiShThitamAtre yat sArabhUtaM, tatrApi tiShThati| yattadgarbharasAdrasa iti garbharasAcchukrashoNitasaMyogapariNAmena kalalarUpAt, rasa iti sArabhUtam| saMvartamAnaM hRudayaM samAvishati yat pureti yadA hRudayaM niShpadyamAnaM, tadaiva vyaktalakShaNaM saddhRudayamadhitiShThati yadityarthaH| etena, garbhAvasthAtraye~api tadojastiShThatItyucyate; paraM garbhAdau shukrashoNitasArarUpatayA, kalalAvasthAyAM tu rasasArarUpatayA, avayavaniShpattau tu svalakShaNayuktameva bhavatyoja ityojasaH sarvAvasthAvyApakatvena mahattvamucyate| yasya nAshAttu nAsho~astIti dhAtvantarAkShaye~api satyojaHkShaye maraNamityarthaH| dhArIti jIvadhArakasaMyogibhyaH pradhAnatvAt| sharIrarasasneha iti sharIrasArasAraM; rasashabdaH snehashabdashca sAravacanaH, tena sharIrarasAnAM dhAtUnAmapi sAra ityarthaH| etacca prakArAntareNAbhyarhitAnekakarmakathanamojaso~abhyarhitatvakhyAtyartham| tatphalA ojaHphalA ojovahA iti yAvat| etena, yathoktaguNashAlitvenaujo mahat; etadvahanena phalantIveti mahAphalA dhamanya uktAH| dvitIyAM niruktimAha- bahudhA vA tAH phalantIti, ‘tA hRudayAshritA dasha dhamanyo bahudhA anekaprakAraM phalantIti’ niShpadyante; etena, mUle hRudaye dasharUpAH satyo mahAsa~gkhyAH sharIre pratAnabhedAdbhavantItyuktam||9-11||-

samprati hRudisthasya manasaH paripAlanahetumAha- tanmahadityAdi| tanmahaditi ShaDa~ggAdisthAnaM hRudayam| tA mahAmUlA iti ojovahA dhamanyaH| taccauja iti yenaujasetyAdinoktaguNamojaH| prashamaH shAntiH| j~jAnaM tattvaj~jAnam||13-14||
athAta AragvadhIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
AragvadhaH saiDagajaH kara~jjo vAsA guDUcI madanaM haridre| shryAhvaH surAhvaH khadiro dhavashca nimbo viDa~ggaM karavIrakatvak||3||
granthishca bhaurjo lashunaH shirIShaH salomasho guggulukRuShNagandhe| phaNijjhako vatsakasaptaparNau pIlUni kuShThaM sumanaHpravAlAH||4||
vacA hareNustrivRutA nikumbho bhallAtakaM gairikama~jjanaM ca| manaHshilAle gRuhadhUma elA kAshIsalodhrArjunamustasarjAH||5||
ityardharUpairvihitAH ShaDete gopittapItAH punareva piShTAH| siddhAH paraM sarShapatailayuktAshcUrNapradehA bhiShajA prayojyAH||6||
kuShThAni kRucchrANi navaM kilAsaM sureshaluptaM kiTibhaM sadadru| bhagandarArshAMsyapacIM sapAmAM hanyuH prayuktAstvacirAnnarANAm||7||
kuShThaM haridre surasaM paTolaM nimbAshvagandhe suradArushigrU| sasarShapaM tumburudhAnyavanyaM caNDAM ca cUrNAni samAni kuryAt||8||
taistakrapiShTaiH prathamaM sharIraM tailAktamudvartayituM yateta| tenAsyakaNDUH piDakAH sakoThAH kuShThAni shophAshca shamaM vrajanti||9||
kuShThAmRutAsa~ggakaTa~gkaTerIkAsIsakampillakamustalodhrAH| saugandhikaM sarjaraso viDa~ggaM manaHshilAle karavIrakatvak||10||
tailAktagAtrasya kRutAni cUrNAnyetAni dadyAdavacUrNanArtham| dadrUH sakaNDUH kiTibhAni pAmA vicarcikA caiva tathaiti shAntim||11||
manaHshilAle maricAni tailamArkaM payaH kuShThaharaH pradehaH| tutthaM viDa~ggaM maricAni kuShThaM lodhraM ca tadvat samanaHshilaM syAt||12||
rasA~jjanaM saprapunnADabIjaM yuktaM kapitthasya rasena lepaH| kara~jjabIjaiDagajaM sakuShThaM gomUtrapiShTaM ca paraH pradehaH||13||
ubhe haridre kuTajasya bIjaM kara~jjabIjaM sumanaHpravAlAn| tvacaM samadhyAM hayamArakasya lepaM tilakShArayutaM vidadhyAt||14||
manaHshilA tvak kuTajAt sakuShThAt salomashaH saiDagajaH kara~jjaH| granthishca bhaurjaH karavIramUlaM cUrNAni sAdhyAni tuShodakena||15||
palAshanirdAharasena cApi karShoddhRutAnyADhakasammitena| darvIpralepaM pravadanti lepametaM paraM kuShThanisUdanAya||16||
parNAni piShTvA catura~ggulasya takreNa parNAnyatha kAkamAcyAH| tailAktagAtrasya narasya kuShThAnyudvartayedashvahanacchadaishca||17||
kolaM kulatthAH suradArurAsnAmAShAtasItailaphalAni kuShTham| vacA shatAhvA yavacUrNamamlamuShNAni vAtAmayinAM pradehaH||18||
AnUpamatsyAmiShavesavArairuShNaiH pradehaH pavanApahaH syAt| snehaishcaturbhirdashamUlamishrairgandhauShadhaishcAnilahaH pradehaH||19||
takreNa yuktaM yavacUrNamuShNaM sakShAramartiM jaThare nihanyAt| kuShThaM shatAhvAM savacAM yavAnAM cUrNaM satailAmlamushanti vAte||20||
ubhe shatAhve madhukaM madhUkaM balAM priyAlaM ca kasherukaM ca| ghRutaM vidArIM ca sitopalAM ca kuryAt pradehaM pavane sarakte||21||
rAsnA guDUcI madhukaM bale dve sajIvakaM sarShabhakaM payashca| ghRutaM ca siddhaM madhusheShayuktaM raktAnilArtiM praNudet pradehaH||22||
natotpalaM candanakuShThayuktaM shirorujAyAM saghRutaM pradehaH||23||
prapauNDarIkaM suradAru kuShThaM yaShTyAhvamelA kamalotpale ca| shirorujAyAM saghRutaH pradeho lohairakApadmakacorakaishca||24||
rAsnA haridre naladaM shatAhve dve devadArUNi sitopalA ca| jIvantimUlaM saghRutaM satailamAlepanaM pArshvarujAsu koShNam||25||
shaivAlapadmotpalavetratu~ggaprapauNDarIkANyamRuNAlalodhram| priya~ggukAleyakacandanAni nirvApaNaH syAt saghRutaH pradehaH||26||
sitAlatAvetasapadmakAni yaShTyAhvamaindrI nalinAni dUrvA| yavAsamUlaM kushakAshayoshca nirvApaNaH syAjjalamerakA ca||27||
shaileyamelAguruNI sakuShThe caNDA nataM tvak suradAru rAsnA| shItaM nihanyAdacirAt pradeho viShaM shirIShastu sasindhuvAraH||28||
shirIShalAmajjakahemalodhraistvagdoShasaMsvedaharaH pragharShaH| patrAmbulodhrAbhayacandanAni sharIradaurgandhyaharaH pradehaH||29||

tatra shlokaH- ihAtrijaH siddhatamAnuvAca dvAtriMshataM siddhamaharShipUjyaH| cUrNapradehAn vividhAmayaghnAnAragvadhIye jagato hitArtham||30||

Commentary: adhyAyArthasa~ggrahaH- ihAtrija ityAdi| cUrNapradehAniti pUrvavadvyAkhyeyam| dvAtriMshatamiti sa~gkhyAkaraNaM nyUnAdhikasa~gkhyA durbodhanirAkaraNArtham||30||

dvividhaM hi bheShajamantaHparimArjanaM bahiHparimArjanaM ca; tatrApAmArgataNDulIyena pa~jcakarmayavAgUrUpamantaHparimArjanamabhidhAyAvashiShTaM bahiHparimArjanaM pralepAdyAragvadhIyenAha- athAta AragvadhIyamityAdi| yadyapi kuShThacikitsitaM pRuthageva cikitsAsthAne bhaviShyati, tatraiva cAvasaraprAptA ete AragvadhAdayo vaktumucitAH; tathA~apIha pRuthak kuShThayogAnAmabhidhAnena kuShThasyAnubandhitvena ca mahArogatvaM khyApayati; abhyarhito hyarthaH punaH punarabhidhIyate| iyaM ca kuShThacikitsA~a~anAgatAvekShaNatantrayuktyA nidAnasthAne hetulakShaNAdibhirlakShitaM kuShThamuddishyoktA; tenAlakShitasya cikitsA~abhidhIyamAnA~aj~jAtaviShayatvena na yujyata iti yaducyate tannirastaM bhavati| yadyapi rAjayakShmaprabhRutayo~api mahArogAH santi, tathA~api na te bhUribahiHparimArjanaviShayA yathA kuShThamiti kuShThaviShayA eva bahiHparimArjanayogA abhidhIyante| kuShThaharabahiHparimArjanopodghAtena ca vAtApahAH “kolaM kulatthA” ityAdayo~abhidhAsyante| ki~jca kuShThaharabahiHparimArjanaprayogANAmidaM svarUpaM yacchodhanAnantaraM prayujyamAnAH siddhibhAjo bhavanti; yaduktaM- “ye lepAH kuShThAnAM prayujyante nirhRutAsradoShANAm| saMshodhitAshayAnAM sadyaH siddhirbhavetteShAm” (ci.a.7) iti; tat pUrvAdhyAye saMshodhanamabhidhAyeha kuShThaprayogAnavasaraprAptAnabhidadhatA~a~acAryeNa sAdhu granthaniveshaH kRutaH| yadyapi ca “khadiraH kuShThaharANAm” (sU.a.25) iti vacanena khadiraH kuShThaharabheShajeShu pradhAnaM, tathA~api khadiraM parityajyAragvadhamAdAvupadishati, kuShThaharabahiHparimArjanabheShajeShvAragvadhasyaiva pradhAnatvakhyApanArtham||1-2||

tAneva kuShThaharayogAnAha- Aragvadha ityAdi| shryAhvo ‘navanItakhoTiH’ iti prasiddhaH| granthishca bhaurja iti bhUrjapatragranthiH| salomasho dhAtukAsIsam| phaNijjhakaH parNAsabhedaH| sumanaHpravAlA jAtIpallavAH| nikumbho dantI| AlaM haritAlam| ardharUpairiti ardhashlokaiH| gopittapItA iti pItagopittAH, mayUravyaMsakAditvena pUrvanipAtaniyamAt; yadi vA gopittabhAvanayA pItavarNA gopittapItAH| paramatyarthaM siddhAH; yadyapi sarvaprayogA maharShipraNItAH svaviShaye siddhAstathA~apIha bahUnAM dushcikitsyAnAM rogANAmAshuharaNAt paraM siddhA ityucyante| cUrNAni ca pradehAshca cUrNapradehAH; yadi vA cUrNIkRutAnAM pradehAshcUrNapradehA; pradeho lepaH, pradehatAkaraNaM caiShAM yogAnAM kuShThaharagomUtragopittAdinA boddhavyam| sureshaluptam indraluptam| kuShThagrahaNena labdhAnAmapi kiTibhadadrupAmAdInAM punarabhidhAnaM prayogANAM visheSheNa taddharaNashaktikhyApanArtham| tumburu svanAmaprasiddham| vanyaM kaivartamustakam| caNDA corapuShpI| prathamamiti tailAktamityanena sambadhyate| tailaM ceha kuShThaharaprakaraNe sArShapaM boddhavyam| amRutAsa~ggaH tutthakam| kaTa~gkaTerI dAruharidrA| saugandhikaM gandhatRuNaM gandhako vA| ArkaM payaH arkakShIram| tadvaditi pradehaH kuShThaharaH | prapunnADa eDagajaH| hayamArakaH karavIraH; tasya tvag grAhyA, madhyaM ca pRuthagbhAvena grAhyam| tuShodakaM satuShairyavaiH sandhAnavisheShAt kRutaM kA~jjikam| palAshasya nirdAhena gRuhIto rasaH palAshanirdAharasaH; sa ca palAshasya pradhAnamUle cchinne~adhaH kumbhaM dattvopari vRukShadAhAdyo galati svarasaH sa gRuhyate| catura~ggulaH svarNahAliH| ashvahanaH karavIraH| catura~ggulakAkamAcyashvahanacchadairekaH prayogaH, dvitve hyasya dvAtriMshatsa~gkhyA vakShyamANA virudhyate||3-17||

tailayoniphalAnyeraNDaphalatilAdIni| amlamiti kA~jjikAdiyogAt| AnUpAnAM khaDgAdInAM matsyAnAM cAmiShaM mAMsamAnUpamatsyAmiSham| vesavAraH- “nirasthi pishitaM piShTaM svinnaM guDaghRutAnvitam| kRuShNAmaricasaMyuktaM vesavAra iti smRutaH”| gandhapradhAnAnyauShadhAni gandhauShadhAni, tAni cAgurvAdIni jvarAdhyAye pratipAdyAni; gandhauShadhaishca siddhairiti yojanIyaM; tena dashamUlagandhauShadhAbhyAM snehAH sAdhanIyAH (kiMvA gandhauShadhairdashamUlasiddhaiH snehapRuktairayaM pradehaH )| ushanti kathayanti| vidArI vidArIkandaH| sitopalA sitasharkarA| madhusheShaH sikthakam| siddhamiti ghRutadugdhayuktaM sat ki~jcidevAgnau sAdhitam||18-22||-

nataM tagarapAdikA, tadabhAve shIulIcoppaDako gRuhyate| prapauNDarIkaH puNDarIkam| loham aguru| erakA hoggalaH| ayaM prapauNDarIkAdibhishcorakaishcetyanta ekaH prayogaH| corakaH corapuShpikA svanAmaprasiddhaH| naladaM mAMsI| shatAhve iti shatapuShpAmadhurike| tu~ggaH punnAgaH| amRuNAlam ushIram| kAleyakaM kAliyAkAShTham| latA ma~jjiShThA| aindrI gorakShakarkaTI| nalinaM kamalam| yavAsamUlaM durAlabhAmUlam| kushakAshayoshca mUlam| ayaM sitAdirerakA cetyanta eko yogaH| jalaM vAlakam| sindhuvAraH nirguNDI| viShamityAdiraparaH prayogaH| lAmajjakam ushIram| hema nAgakesharam| abhayam ushIram||23-29||
iti bheShajacatuShkaH||1||
iha khalu ShaD virecanashatAni bhavanti, ShaD virecanAshrayAH, pa~jca kaShAyayonayaH, pa~jcavidhaM kaShAyakalpanaM, pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyAH, pa~jca kaShAyashatAni, iti sa~ggrahaH||3||

vIraNashAliShaShTikekShuvAlikAdarbhakushakAshagundretkaTakattRuNamUlAnIti dashemAni stanyajananAni bhavanti (17), pAThAmahauShadhasuradArumustamUrvAguDUcIvatsakaphalakirAtatiktakakaTurohiNIsArivA iti dashemAni stanyashodhanAni bhavanti (18), jIvakarShabhakakAkolIkShIrakAkolImudgaparNImAShaparNImedAvRuddharuhAjaTilAkuli~ggA iti dashemAni shukrajananAni bhavanti (19), kuShThailavAlukakaTphalasamudraphenakadambaniryAsekShukANDekShvikShurakavasukoshIrANIti dashemAni shukrashodhanAni bhavanti (20), iti catuShkaH kaShAyavargaH||12||

Commentary: ikShuvAlikA khAgAlikA, darbha uluyAtRuNaM, gundrA gulu~jca (17)| stanyashodhano vyaktaH (18)| vRuddharuhA shatAvarI, vRukSharuhApAThapakShe bandAkaH, jaTilA uccaTA, kuli~gga uccaTAbhedaH (19)| kadambo bahuphalastasya niryAsaH, ikShurakaH kokilAkShaH, vasuko vasuhaTTakaH, atra jatUkarNaH paThatyelavAlukaM kaTphalasthAne (20)||12||

mRudvIkAmadhukamadhuparNImedAvidArIkAkolIkShIrakAlolIjIvakajIvantIshAlaparNya iti dashemAni snehopagAni bhavanti (21), shobhA~jjanakairaNDArkavRushcIrapunarnavAyavatilakulatthamAShabadarANIti dashemAni svedopagAni bhavanti (22), madhumadhukakovidArakarbudAranIpavidulabimbIshaNapuShpIsadApuShpApratyakpuShpA iti dashemAni vamanopagAni bhavanti (23), drAkShAkAshmaryaparUShakAbhayAmalakabibhItakakuvalabadarakarkandhupIlUnIti dashemAni virecanopagAni bhavanti (24), trivRudbilvapippalIkuShThasarShapavacAvatsakaphalashatapuShpAmadhukamadanaphalAnIti dashemAnyAsthApanopagAni bhavanti (25), rAsnAsuradArubilvamadanashatapuShpAvRushcIrapunarnavAshvadaMShTrAgnimanthashyonAkA iti dashemAnyanuvAsanopagAni bhavanti (26), jyotiShmatIkShavakamaricapippalIviDa~ggashigrusarShapApAmArgataNDulashvetAmahAshvetA iti dashemAni shirovirecanopagAni bhavanti (27), iti saptakaH kaShAyavargaH||13||

Commentary: snehopago vyaktaH (21)| vRushcIraH shvetapunarnavA (22)| kovidAraH svanAmaprasiddhaH, karbudAraH shvetakA~jcanaH, vidulo hijjalaH, shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpA arkaH, pratyakpuShpA apAmArgaH (23)| badarItrayam (24)| vyaktaH (25)| vyaktaH (26)| kShavakaH chikkAkArakaH, shvetA aparAjitA, mahAshvetA tadbhedaH kaTabhI vA (27)||13||

jambvAmrapallavamAtulu~ggAmlabadaradADimayavayaShTikoshIramRullAjA iti dashemAni chardinigrahaNAni bhavanti (28), nAgaradhanvayavAsakamustaparpaTakacandanakirAtatiktakaguDUcIhrIveradhAnyakapaTolAnIti dashemAni tRuShNAnigrahaNAni bhavanti (29), shaTIpuShkaramUlabadarabIjakaNTakArikAbRuhatIvRukSharuhAbhayApippalIdurAlabhAkulIrashRu~ggya iti dashemAni hikkAnigrahaNAni bhavanti (30), iti trikaH kaShAyavargaH||14||

Commentary: vyaktaH (28)| vyaktaH (29)| vyaktaH (30)||14||

priya~ggvanantAmrAsthikaTva~ggalodhramocarasasama~ggAdhAtakIpuShpapadmApadmakesharANIti dashemAni purIShasa~ggrahaNIyAni bhavanti (31), jambushallakItvakkacchurAmadhUkashAlmalIshrIveShTakabhRuShTamRutpayasyotpalatilakaNA iti dashemAni purIShavirajanIyAni bhavanti (32), jambvAmraplakShavaTakapItanoDumbarAshvatthabhallAtakAshmantakasomavalkA iti dashemAni mUtrasa~ggrahaNIyAni bhavanti (33), padmotpalanalinakumudasaugandhikapuNDarIkashatapatramadhukapriya~ggudhAtakIpuShpANIti dashemAni mUtravirajanIyAni bhavanti (34), vRukShAdanIshvadaMShTrAvasukavashirapAShANabhedadarbhakushakAshagundretkaTamUlAnIti dashemAni mUtravirecanIyAni bhavanti (35), iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH||15||

Commentary: anantA anantamUlaM, kaTva~ggaH shyonAkaH, mocarasaH shAlmalIveShTakaH, padmA brAhmaNayaShTikA (31)| shallakI svanAmaprasiddhA, kacchurA shUkashimbA, shAlmalIveShTakaH shimalIAThA, shrIveShTako navanItakhoTI (32)| kapItano gandhamuNDaH, ashmantakaH amlaloTaH, somavalkaH khadiraH (33)| padmabhedAshcatvAraH, saugandhikaH shundhI (34)| vRukShAdanI bandAko vidArikando vA, vashiraH sUryAvartaH (35) ||15||

drAkShAbhayAmalakapippalIdurAlabhAshRu~ggIkaNTakArikAvRushcIrapunarnavAtAmalakya iti dashemAni kAsaharANi bhavanti (36), shaTIpuShkaramUlAmlavetasailAhi~ggvagurusurasAtAmalakIjIvantIcaNDA iti dashemAni shvAsaharANi bhavanti (37), pATalAgnimanthashyonAkabilvakAshmaryakaNTakArikAbRuhatIshAlaparNIpRushniparNIgokShurakA iti dashemAni shvayathuharANi bhavanti (38), sArivAsharkarApAThAma~jjiShThAdrAkShApIluparUShakAbhayAmalakabibhItakAnIti dashemAni jvaraharANi bhavanti (39), drAkShAkharjUrapriyAlabadaradADimaphalguparUShakekShuyavaShaShTikA iti dashemAni shramaharANi bhavanti (40), iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH||16||

Commentary: tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI (36)| caNDA corahulI (37)| vyaktaH (38)| vyaktaH (39)| phalguH kAShThodumbarakaH (40)||16||

lAjAcandanakAshmaryaphalamadhUkasharkarAnIlotpaloshIrasArivAguDUcIhrIberANIti dashemAni dAhaprashamanAni bhavanti (41), tagarAgurudhAnyakashRu~ggaverabhUtIkavacAkaNTakAryagnimanthashyonAkapippalya iti dashemAni shItaprashamanAni bhavanti (42), tindukapriyAlabadarakhadirakadarasaptaparNAshvakarNArjunAsanArimedA iti dashemAnyudardaprashamanAni bhavanti (43), vidArIgandhApRushniparNIbRuhatIkaNTakArikairaNDakAkolIcandanoshIrailAmadhukAnIti dashemAnya~ggamardaprashamanAni bhavanti (44), pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakashRu~ggaveramaricAjamodAjagandhAjAjIgaNDIrANIti dashemAni shUlaprashamanAni bhavanti (45), iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH||17||

Commentary: lAjAdau jatUkarNapAThAt guDUcIsthAne padmakaH, yadi vA “arkAguruguDUcInAM tiktAnAM cauShNyamiShyate” (sU.a.26), iti vacanAdyadyapyuShNA guDUcI, tathA~api tasyA dAhaprashamakatvaM prabhAvAdboddhavyam (41)| bhUtIko yavAnikA (42)| tindukaH ‘kenduH’ iti prasiddhaH, kadaro viTkhadiraH, arimedaH khadirabhedaH (43)| vyaktaH (44)| ajagandhA phokAndI (45)||17||

madhumadhukarudhiramocarasamRutkapAlalodhragairikapriya~ggusharkarAlAjA iti dashemAni shoNitasthApanAni bhavanti (46), shAlakaTphalakadambapadmakatumbamocarasashirIShava~jjulailavAlukAshokA iti dashemAni vedanAsthApanAni bhavanti (47), hi~ggukaiTaryArimedAvacAcorakavayasthAgolomIjaTilApala~gkaShAshokarohiNya iti dashemAni sa~jj~jAsthApanAni bhavanti (48), aindrIbrAhmIshatavIryAsahasravIryA~amoghA~avyathAshivA~ariShTAvATyapuShpIviShvaksenakAntA iti dashemAni prajAsthApanAni bhavanti (49), amRutA~abhayAdhAtrImuktAshvetAjIvantyatirasAmaNDUkaparNIsthirApunarnavA iti dashemAni vayaHsthApanAni bhavanti (50), iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH||18||

Commentary: rudhiraM ku~gkumam (46)| va~jjulo vetasaH (47)| kaiTaryaH parvatanimbaH, vayaHsthA brAhmI, golomI bhUtakeshI, pala~gkaShA gugguluH jaTAmAMsI vA (48)| shatavIryAsahasravIrye dUrve; amoghA pATalA, AmalakI vA, lakShmaNA vA; avyathA kadalI, guDUcI vA, harItakI vA; ariShTA kaTurohiNI; viShvaksenakAntA priya~gguH (49)| muktA rAsnA; shvetAsthAne ‘shreyasI’ iti kecit, sA rAsnAbhedaH (50)||18||

iti pa~jcakaShAyashatAnyabhisamasya pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyA mahatAM ca kaShAyANAM lakShaNodAharaNArthaM vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||19||

Commentary: sampratyetAnyeva jIvakAdInyuktAni pratyekasho dravyagaNanayA pa~jcakaShAyashatAni syuH, dashakagaNanayA ca pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyAH shRu~ggagrAhikayoktA bhavantIti darshayannupasaMharati- itItyAdi| abhisamasyeti dashakasa~gkhyayaikavargIkRutya| lakShaNasyodAharaNaM (lakShaNodAharaNaM ), pUrvaM jIvanIyAdisa~jj~jA lakShaNamabhipretyoktA; lakShaNodAharaNArthamiti samprati jIvakarShabhakAdInyudAharaNArthaM vyAkhyAtAni; jIvakAdibhirdashabhirlakShyate j~jAyate jIvanIyo mahAkaShAyaH| mahatAM ceti cakAraH pa~jcakaShAyashatAnAM ca lakShaNasyodAharaNArthamiti samuccinoti| tatra jIvakAdayaH pratyekaM pa~jcakaShAyashatAnAmekaikadravyarUpANAM lakShaNasvarUpA bhavanti| yadi vA lakShaNArthamudAharaNArthaM ceti; tatra mandabuddhInAM lakShaNArthaM pa~jcakaShAyashatapa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyaj~jAnArthamityarthaH, buddhimatAM tUdAharaNArthaM dRuShTAntArtham||19||

nahi vistarasya pramANamasti, na cApyatisa~gkShepo~alpabuddhInAM sAmarthyAyopakalpate, tasmAdanatisa~gkShepeNAnativistareNa copadiShTAH| etAvanto hyalamalpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya, buddhimatAM ca svAlakShaNyAnumAnayuktikushalAnAmanuktArthaj~jAnAyeti||20||

Commentary: nanu kaShAyadravyANi yAvanti santi tAvanti vA~abhidhIyantAM, dRuShTAntArthaM dvitrANi vA; tat kimarthamayaM nAtivistaro nAtisa~gkShepa ityatrAha- nahItyAdi| na hi vistarasya pramANamiyattAparicchedo~asti, tena vistaro nAbhidhIyata ityarthaH| atisa~gkShepo~api dvitralakShaNAbhidhAnarUpo nAlpabuddhInAmanumAnAkushalAnAM sAmarthyAya cikitsAvyavahArAyopakalpate| etAvanto yathoktAH| alaM samarthAH| vyavahArAyeti cikitsAvyavahArAya| svalakShaNasya bhAvaH svAlakShaNyaM, tenAnumAnaM, tatra kushalA abhij~jA ityarthaH| buddhimanto hi, jIvakAdayo hi snigdhashItamadhuravRuShyAdiguNayuktAH santo jIvanaM kurvantIti bhUyodarshanAdavadhArya tadguNayukte~anyatrApi drAkShApayovidAryAdau tajjAtIyatvena jIvanAnItyanumimate, yathA jIvakAdInAmekajIvanakAryakartRutvena mahAkaShAyatvaM, tadvat pAThAsama~ggAprabhRutInAmapyatIsAraharANAmatIsAraharamahAkaShAyatvamityanumAnena kRutsnameva kaShAyaM pratipadyanta iti bhAvaH||20||
evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- naitAni bhagavan! pa~jca kaShAyashatAni pUryante, tAni tAni hyevA~ggAnyupaplavante teShu teShu mahAkaShAyeShviti||21||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- naitadevaM buddhimatA draShTavyamagnivesha| eko~api hyanekAM sa~jj~jAM labhate kAryAntarANi kurvan, tadyathA- puruSho bahUnAM karmaNAM karaNe samartho bhavati, sa yadyat karma karoti tasya tasya karmaNaH kartRu-karaNa-kAryasamprayuktaM tattadgauNaM nAmavisheShaM prApnoti, tadvadauShadhadravyamapi draShTavyam| yadi caikameva ki~jciddravyamAsAdayAmastathAguNayuktaM yat sarvakarmaNAM karaNe samarthaM syAt, kastato~anyadicchedupadhArayitumupadeShTuM vA shiShyebhya iti||22||

ShaD virecanashatAni, iti yaduktaM tadiha sa~ggraheNodAhRutya vistareNa kalpopaniShadi vyAkhyAsyAmaH; (tatra ) trayastriMshadyogashataM praNItaM phaleShu, ekonacatvAriMshajjImUtakeShu yogAH, pa~jcacatvAriMshadikShvAkuShu, dhAmArgavaH ShaShTidhA bhavati yogayuktaH, kuTajastvaShTAdashadhA yogameti, kRutavedhanaM ShaShTidhA bhavati yogayuktaM, shyAmAtrivRudyogashataM praNItaM dashApare cAtra bhavanti yogAH, catura~ggulo dvAdashadhA yogameti, lodhraM vidhau ShoDashayogayuktaM, mahAvRukSho bhavati viMshatiyogayuktaH, ekonacatvAriMshat saptalAsha~gkhinyoryogAH, aShTacatvAriMshaddantIdravantyoH, iti ShaDvirecanashatAni||4||

Commentary: sa~ggraheNa uddeshamAtreNa| kalpa evopaniShat kalpopaniShat; upaniShadityatyupayuktarahasyavidyopadeshasthAnamucyate vede; tadvadihApi kalpasyAtyupayuktatvena rahasyavamanavirecanaprayogopadeshakatvAt kalpa evopaniShadityucyate| na ca vAcyaM kalpa eva vistareNa ShaDvirecanashatAnyabhidhAsyante, tena tadevAstu, alamanena sa~gkShepAbhidhAnena samyagavabodhAnupAyatvAt; yatastantradharmo~ayaM- yat prathamaM sUtraNaM bhavati, tadanu tadvivaraNaM prapa~jcena; ucyate ca nyAyavidbhiH- “te vai viShayAshca susa~ggRuhItA bhavanti yeShAM samAso vyAsashca” iti| trayastriMshatA~adhikaM yogashataM trayastriMshadyogashatam| kRutavedhanayogAntA yogA vamanasya, sheShA virecanasya| atreti shyAmAtrivRutoreva| shyAmeti shyAmamUlA trivRut, trivRuditi aruNamUlA trivRut||4||

ShaD virecanAshrayA iti kShIramUlatvakpatrapuShpaphalAnIti||5||

Commentary: ShaDityAdi| ShaDeva virecanAshrayA virecanAdhikaraNAni| atra hi kShIramAdau kRutaM tIkShNavirecanatvAt; uktaM hi- “snukpayastIkShNavirecanAnAm” (sU.a.25) iti| tvagityanena lodhratvaggRuhyate| patramityanena ikShvAkvAdipatram| yadvakShyati kalpe- “apuShpasya pravAlAnAM muShTiM prAdeshasammitAm| kShIraprasthe shRutaM dadyAt pittodrikte kaphajvare” (ka.a.3) iti| yadyapi cairaNDatailatAmrapAradAdInAM kShIrAdyadhikAnAmapi virecanAshrayatvaM sambhavati, tathA~api teShAmiha tantre kalpasthAne virecanAshrayatvenAnabhidhAnAdadhyAyAdipratipAditenehashabdena yogAdiha ShaDAshrayA ityaviruddhameva||5||

pa~jca kaShAyayonaya iti madhurakaShAyo~amlakaShAyaH kaTukaShAyastiktakaShAyaH kaShAyakaShAyashceti tantre sa~jj~jA||6||

Commentary: pa~jca kaShAyashatAni mahAkaShAyavyAkhyayA vyAkhyAtavyAni, atastadulla~gghya pa~jca kaShAyayonayo~abhidhIyante| madhurashcAsau kaShAyashceti madhurakaShAyaH, evaM sheSheShvapi| tantre sa~jj~jetyanena lavaNarasaM varjayitvA madhurAdayo rasAH kaShAyasa~jj~jayA vyavahriyante ityayaM svatantrasamaya iti sUcayati, nAtra paratantravyavahAra iti| atha kimarthaM punarAcAryeNa kaShAyasa~jj~jApraNayane lavaNasya madhurAderiva guNAdibhiruddiShTasya tathA prayogeShu citrakaguDikAdau “dvau kShArau lavaNAni ca” (ci.a.15) ityAdinoddiShTasya rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) ca skandhenopadiShTasya rasAdhikAreShu ca teShu teShu madhurAdivadupadiShTasya parityAgaH kriyate? ucyate- kaShAyasa~jj~jeyaM bheShajatvena vyApriyamANeShu raseShvAcAryeNa niveshitA| atra ca kevalasya lavaNasya prayogo nAsti, madhurAdInAM tu kevalAnAmapi prayogo~asti, lavaNaM tu dravyAntarasaMyuktamevopayujyate| madhurAdiShu svarasakalkAdilakShaNA kalpanA sambhavati, na lavaNe| yato na tAvallavaNasya svaraso~asti; kalko~api dravyasya draveNa peShaNAt kriyate, tacca na sambhavati lavaNe, lavaNaM hi pAnIyayogAt pAnIyameva bhavati; yadyapi kalkasyaiva bhedashcUrNaM, cUrNatA ca lavaNasya sambhavati, tathA~api lavaNasya cUrNarUpatA na pUrvasmAdacUrNarUpAt ki~jcicchaktivisheShamApAdayati, shaktivisheShakalpanArthaM ca kalpanA kriyata ityuttaratra pratipAdayiShyAmaH, tasmAccUrNatvamapi lavaNasya kalpanakalpanamiva; shRutashItaphANTakaShAyAstu dravyasya kArtsnyenAnupayojyasya tattatsaMskAravashAddraveShu dravyasya stokAvayavAnupraveshArthamupadishyante; lavaNe caitanna sambhavati, lavaNaM hi dravasambandhe sarvAtmanaiva dravamanugataM bhavati; tasmAllavaNaM pRuthakprayogAbhAvAt kalpanA~asambhavAccAcAryeNa kaShAyasa~jj~jApraNayane nirastamiti na niShprayojaneyamAcAryapravRuttiH||6||

pa~jcavidhaM kaShAyakalpanamiti tadyathA- svarasaH, kalkaH, shRutaH, shItaH, phANTaH, kaShAya iti| (yantraniShpIDitAddravyAdrasaH svarasa ucyate | yaH piNDo rasapiShTAnAM sa kalkaH parikIrtitaH || vahnau tu kvathitaM dravyaM shRutamAhushcikitsakAH | dravyAdApotthitAttoye pratapte nishi saMsthitAt || kaShAyo yo~abhiniryAti sa shItaH samudAhRutaH | kShiptvoShNatoye mRuditaM tat phANTaM parikIrtitam ||) teShAM yathApUrvaM balAdhikyam; ataH kaShAyakalpanA vyAdhyAturabalApekShiNI; na tvevaM khalu sarvANi sarvatropayogIni bhavanti||7||

Commentary: kalpanamupayogArthaM prakalpanaM saMskaraNamiti yAvat svarasAdibahulakShaNaM; yathA- “svo rasaH svarasaH proktaH, kalko dRuShadi peShitaH| kvathitastu shRutaH, shItaH sharvarImuShito mataH|| kShiptoShNatoye mRuditaH phANTa ityabhidhIyate” iti| atra shaunakavacanaM tu “dravyAdApothitAttoye pratapte nishi saMsthitAt| kaShAyo yo~abhiniryAti sa shItaH samudAhRutaH” iti| phANTaH kaShAya iti kaShAyashabdo~ayaM svarasAdibhirapi sambadhyate, tena svarasaH kaShAyaH, kalkaH kaShAyaH, ityAdyapi boddhavyam| teShAM svarasAdInAM yathApUrvaM balAdhikyamiti phANTAcchIto guruH, shItAcchRuto gururityAdi| yato yathApUrvaM gurvI kaShAyakalpanA, ata eva vyAdhyAturabalApekShiNI; vyAdherAturasya ca balamapekShata ityarthaH| atropapattimAha- na tvevamityAdi| balavati puruShe vyAdhau ca dravyasArabhAgamayatvenAtyarthaM gururbahukAryakaraH svaraso yujyate, nAyamalpabale puruShe roge vA yogavAn bhavati, balabhraMshabheShajAtiyogadoShakartRutvAditi bhAvaH; evamanyatrApi vyAkhyeyam| tathA na sarvANi svarasAdIni sarvatra puruShe yogyAni bhavanti; yataH kecit svarasadviShaH, kecit svarasapriyA itarakalpanAdviSha evamAdi| na cAtyarthaM dviShTabheShajasya prayoga iShyate, tatkShaNavamanArucyAdidoShakartRutvAt | tathA kaShAyakalpanA vyAdhyAturabalApekShiNItyetadudAharaNArthaM, tena dravyApekShiNItyetadapi boddhavyam| yato dravyaniyamena kalpanAniyamaM vakShyati rasAyane; yathA- “maNDUkaparNyAH svarasaH prayojyaH, kShIreNa yaShTImadhukasya cUrNam| raso guDUcyAstu samUlapuShpyAH, kalkaH prayojyaH khalu sha~gkhapuShpyAH” (ci.a.1) iti| cUrNaM kalka evAntarbhAvanIyaM, dvividho hi kalkaH sadravo~adravashceti kRutvA; tena “nishi sthitA vA svarasIkRutA vA kalkIkRutA cUrNamatho shRutA vA” (ci.a.4) ityAdau pRuthak cUrNapAThenAdhikakalpanAprasa~ggo nodbhAvanIyaH||7||

‘pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyA’ iti yaduktaM tadanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- jIvanIyo bRuMhaNIyo lekhanIyo bhedanIyaH sandhAnIyo dIpanIya iti ShaTkaH kaShAyavargaH; balyo varNyaH kaNThyo hRudya iti catuShkaH kaShAyavargaH; tRuptighno~arshoghnaH kuShThaghnaH kaNDUghnaH krimighno viShaghna iti ShaTkaH kaShAyavargaH; stanyajananaH stanyashodhanaH shukrajananaH shukrashodhana iti catuShkaH kaShAyavargaH; snehopagaH svedopago vamanopago virecanopaga AsthApanopago~anuvAsanopagaH shirovirecanopaga iti saptakaH kaShAyavargaH; chardinigrahaNastRuShNAnigrahaNo hikkAnigrahaNa iti trikaH kaShAyavargaH; purIShasa~ggrahaNIyaH purIShavirajanIyo mUtrasa~ggrahaNIyo mUtravirajanIyo mUtravirecanIya iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH; kAsaharaH shvAsaharaH shothaharo jvaraharaH shramahara iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH; dAhaprashamanaH shItaprashamana udardaprashamano~a~ggamardaprashamanaH shUlaprashamana iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH; shoNitasthApano vedanAsthApanaH sa~jj~jAsthApanaH prajAsthApano vayaHsthApana iti pa~jcakaH kaShAyavargaH; iti pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyA mahatAM ca kaShAyANAM lakShaNodAharaNArthaM vyAkhyAtA bhavanti| teShAmekaikasmin mahAkaShAye dasha dashAvayavikAn kaShAyAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tAnyeva pa~jca kaShAyashatAni bhavanti||8||

Commentary: mahAkaShAyAnudAharati- pa~jcAshadityAdi| jIvane hito jIvanIyaH; evamanyatrApi| ShaDbhirniShpAditaH ShaTkaH, evaM catuShkAdiShvapi bodhyam| atra ca ShaTkAdirmahAkaShAyANAM paricchedaH kasyacidarthasyAnugamena boddhavyaH; yathA- jIvanIyAdau ShaTke IyAntatvaM, balyAdau yapratyayAntatvaM, tRuptighnAdau ghnAntatvaM, stanyajananAdau stanyashukraviShayatvam, evamAdyUhyam | etacca IyapratyayAntatvAdinA bahubhedakathanaM vaicitryeNa granthasya puShkalAbhidhAnatAkaraNArtham| etacca shAstre~avashyaM kartavyam| yaduktamihaiva shAstraguNakathane yathA- “anavapatitashabdamakaShTashabdaM puShkalAbhidhAnam” (vi.a.8) ityAdi| jIvanIyashabdenehAyuShyatvamabhipretam| yatra ca madhurarasaguNe “AyuShyo jIvanIyaH” (sU.a.26) iti ca kariShyati tatra mUrcchitasya sa~jj~jAjanakatvena jIvanIyatvaM vyAkhyeyam| tRuptiH shleShmavikAro yena tRuptamivAtmAnaM manyate, tadghnaM tRuptighnam| snehopagAnIti snehasya sarpirAdeH snehanakriyAyAM sahAyatvenopagacchantIti snehopagAni, mRudvIkAdisnehopagayuktasya sarpirAdeH snehane prakarShavatI shaktirbhavatItyarthaH; tathA vamanopagAnItyatra madanaphalAdInAM vamanadravyANAM madhumadhukAdIni sahAyAni bhavantIti; evaM svedopagAdau vyAkhyeyam| shirovirecanopage tu shirovirecanapradhAnAnyeva dravyANi boddhavyAni| purIShasya virajanaM doShasambandhanirAsaM karotIti purIShavirajanIyaH| evaM mUtravirajanIye vyAkhyeyam| mUtrasya virecanaM karotIti mUtravirecanIyaH| udardo varaTIdaShTAkAraH shothaH, tatprashamana udardaprashamanaH; na punariha mahArogAdhyAye paThito vAtavikAro gRuhyate, tindukAdInAmudardaprashamanAnAM vAtaM pratyananukUlatvAt| shoNitasya duShTasya duShTimapahRutya prakRutau shoNitaM sthApayatIti shoNitasthApanam| vedanAyAM sambhUtAyAM tAM nihatya sharIraM prakRutau sthApayatIti vedanAsthApanam| sa~jj~jAM j~jAnaM ca sthApayatIti sa~jj~jAsthApanam| prajopaghAtakaM doShaM hRutvA prajAM sthApayatIti prajAsthApanam| vayastaruNaM sthApayatIti vayaHsthApanam| upasaMharati- itItyAdi| mahatAM kaShAyANAM pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyA bhavantItyanenoddiShTAnAM, lakShaNaM svarUpaM jIvanIyAdi, tasyodAharaNaM prapa~jcena kathanaM, tadarthaM vyAkhyAtA nirdeshena kathitA ityarthaH; yadi vA mahatAM kaShAyANAM yallakShaNamanekaiH kaShAyairmilitvaikArthajIvanIyAdisampAdanaM, tasyodAharaNArthaM dRuShTAntArtham| etenAnyAnyapi mahAkaShAyANi vAtaprashamanapittaprashamanAdInyekakAryasampAdakAnekadravyamayAni bhavantIti sUcayati| mahatAM ceti cakAra udAharaNArthaM cetyatra boddhavyaH, tenAlpabuddhInAM vyavahArArthaM ceti samuccinoti; etaccottaratra sphuTaM bhaviShyati| uttaratra yadvakShyati- “mahatAM ca kaShAyANAM lakShaNodAharaNArthaM vyAkhyAtA bhavanti” iti, tat tadyathetyAdigranthasyArthaM vyAkartuM; kiMvA~atra vyAkhyAtA iti padaM sa~jj~jAmAtreNa mahAkaShAyakathane vartate, tatra tu vyAkhyAtA iti padaM prati prati jIvakAdidravyakathane vartate, tena na paunaruktyam| avayavA evAvayavikAH, tAnyeva pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyANi dashAvayavaguNitAnyekaikadravyarUpANi pa~jca kaShAyashatAni bhavantItyarthaH||8||

tadyathA- jIvakarShabhakau medA mahAmedA kAkolI kShIrakAkolI mudgaparNImAShaparNyau jIvantI madhukamiti dashemAni jIvanIyAni bhavanti (1), kShIriNI rAjakShavakAshvagandhAkAkolIkShIrakAkolIvATyAyanIbhadraudanIbhAradvAjIpayasyarShyagandhA iti dashemAni bRuMhaNIyAni bhavanti (2), mustakuShThaharidrAdAruharidrAvacAtiviShAkaTurohiNIcitrakacirabilvahaimavatya iti dashemAni lekhanIyAni bhavanti (3), suvahArkorubukAgnimukhIcitrAcitrakacirabilvasha~gkhinIshakulAdanIsvarNakShIriNya iti dashemAni bhedanIyAni bhavanti (4), madhukamadhuparNIpRushniparNyambaShThakIsama~ggAmocarasadhAtakIlodhrapriya~ggukaTphalAnIti dashemAni sandhAnIyAni bhavanti (5), pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakashRu~ggaverAmlavetasamaricAjamodAbhallAtakAsthihi~gguniryAsA iti dashemAni dIpanIyAni bhavanti (6), iti ShaTkaH kaShAyavargaH||9||

Commentary: jIvanIyamAdAvucyate sarveShAM jIvanahitasyaivAtyarthamabhipretatvAt| mudgamAShaparNyantaM sugamam| jIvantI svanAmakhyAtA suvarNavarNAbhA, madhukaM yaShTImadhukam (1)| kShIriNI kShIralatA, rAjakShavako dugdhikA, vATyAyanI shvetabalA, bhadraudanI pItabalA, bhAradvAjI vanakArpAsI, payasyA vidArIkandaH, RuShyagandhA RuShyajA~ggalakaH (2)| kaTukA kaTurohiNI, cirabilvaH kara~jjaH, haimavatI shvetavacA (3)| suvahA trivRut, agnimukhI ‘lA~ggaliyA’ iti khyAtA, citrA dantI, sha~gkhinI shvetabuhnA, shakulAdanI kaTurohiNI, svarNakShIriNI a~gguShThaprabhA (4)| ambaShThakI akarNaviddhA, sama~ggA varAhakrAntA, kaTphalaM svanAmaprasiddhaM, sandhAnIyaH sa~ggrahaNaH sAmAnyena; purIShasya sa~ggrahaNastu bhinnamalamAtrasa~ggrahaNaH (5)| shRu~ggaveraH shuNThI, hi~gguniryAso hi~ggu||9||

aindryRuShabhyatirasarShyaproktApayasyAshvagandhAsthirArohiNIbalAtibalA iti dashemAni balyAni bhavanti (7), candanatu~ggapadmakoshIramadhukama~jjiShThAsArivApayasyAsitAlatA iti dashemAni varNyAni bhavanti (8), sArivekShumUlamadhukapippalIdrAkShAvidArIkaiTaryahaMsapAdIbRuhatIkaNTakArikA iti dashemAni kaNThyAni bhavanti (9), AmrAmrAtakalikucakaramardavRukShAmlAmlavetasakuvalabadaradADimamAtulu~ggAnIti dashemAni hRudyAni bhavanti (10), iti catuShkaH kaShAyavargaH||10||

Commentary: aindrI gorakShakarkaTI, RuShabhI shUkashimbA, atirasA shatAvarI RuddhirvA, RuShyaproktA mAShaparNI, atibalA pItabalA, payasyeha kShIravidArI kAkolI vA (7)| tu~ggaH punnAgaH, sitA shvetadUrvA, latA shyAmadUrvA (8)| sArivA anantamUlam, ikShumUlamatrekShormUlaM moraTo vA, vidArI vidArIkandaH, kaiTaryaM kaTphalaM, haMsapAdI svanAmaprasiddhA (9)| AmrAtaka AmrADakaH, vRukShAmlaM bRuhadamlam (10)||10||

nAgaracavyacitrakaviDa~ggamUrvAguDUcIvacAmustapippalIpaTolAnIti dashemAni tRuptighnAni bhavanti (11), kuTajabilvacitrakanAgarAtiviShAbhayAdhanvayAsakadAruharidrAvacAcavyAnIti dashemAnyarshoghnAni bhavanti (12), khadirAbhayAmalakaharidrAruShkarasaptaparNAragvadhakaravIraviDa~ggajAtIpravAlA iti dashemAni kuShThaghnAni bhavanti (13), candananaladakRutamAlanaktamAlanimbakuTajasarShapamadhukadAruharidrAmustAnIti dashemAni kaNDUghnAni bhavanti (14), akShIvamaricagaNDIrakebukaviDa~gganirguNDIkiNihIshvadaMShTrAvRuShaparNikAkhuparNikA iti dashemAni krimighnAni bhavanti (15), haridrAma~jjiShThAsuvahAsUkShmailApAlindIcandanakatakashirIShasindhuvArashleShmAtakA iti dashemAni viShaghnAni bhavanti (16), iti ShaTkaH kaShAyavargaH||11||

Commentary: tRuptighno vyaktaH (11)| dhanvayAso durAlabhA (12)| aruShkaro bhallAtakaH (13)| naladaM mAMsI, kRutamAlaH suvarNahaliH, naktamAlaH kara~jjaH (14)| akShIvo~abdakaH shobhA~jjano vA, gaNDIraH shamaThashAkaM, nirguNDI sindhuvAraH, kiNihI kaTabhI, AkhuparNI mUShikaparNI, vRuShaparNI ca tadbhedaH ‘pha~jjipatrikA’ iti khyAtA (15)| suvahA rAsnA hApharamAlI vA, pAlindI shyAmalatA, shleShmAtako bahuvAraH (16)||11||
tatra shlokAH- yato yAvanti yairdravyairvirecanashatAni ShaT| uktAni sa~ggraheNeha tathaivaiShAM ShaDAshrayAH||23||
rasA lavaNavarjyAshca kaShAya iti sa~jj~jitAH| tasmAt pa~jcavidhA yoniH kaShAyANAmudAhRutA||24||
tathA kalpanamapyeShAmuktaM pa~jcavidhaM punaH| mahatAM ca kaShAyANAM pa~jcAshat parikIrtitA||25||
pa~jca cApi kaShAyANAM shatAnyuktAni bhAgashaH| lakShaNArthaM, pramANaM hi vistarasya na vidyate||26||
na cAlamatisa~gkShepaH sAmarthyAyopakalpate| alpabuddherayaM tasmAnnAtisa~gkShepavistaraH||27||
mandAnAM vyavahArAya, budhAnAM buddhivRuddhaye| pa~jcAshatko hyayaM vargaH kaShAyANAmudAhRutaH||28||
teShAM karmasu bAhyeShu yogamAbhyantareShu ca| saMyogaM ca prayogaM ca yo veda sa bhiShagvaraH||29||

apAmArgataNDulIye~antaHparimArjanamuktam, AragvadhIye ca bahiHparimArjanamuktaM; samprati pUrvAdhyAyadvayApratipAditabheShajacatuShkAvashyavaktavyamavashiShTamubhayaparimArjanabheShajamabhidhAtuM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyo~abhidhIyate| AshrIyata ityAshritamAshraya ityarthaH| ShaTsa~gkhyAvacchinnAni virecanashatAnyAshritAni cAdhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyaH ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyaH, etenaitaduktaM- ShaDvirecanashatAni, ShaDvirecanAshrayAH, etaddvayamadhikRutya sa~jj~jeyaM praNIteti mantavyam| yadyapi cAdhyAyAdAviha khalviti padaM shrUyate, tathA~api tadapradhAnatvAnnAdhyAyasa~jj~jApraNayane niveshitam| iheti agniveshatantre~anatisa~gkShepavistare| etena vakShyamANavirecanaShaTshatAnAM tathA pa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyANAM tathA pa~jcakaShAyashatAnAM vistarakalpanAyAmadhikatvamapi bhavatIti sUcyate| ata eva vakShyati kalpe- “uddeshamAtrametAvaddraShTavyamiha ShaTshatam| svabuddhyaivaM sahasrANi koTirvA samprakalpayet” (ka.a.12) iti| tathA~atraiva vakShyati- “na hi vistarasya pramANamasti” ityAdi| khalushabdaH prakAshane| virecanashabdeneha vamanaM virecanaM ca gRuhyate| yato vakShyati kalpe- “ubhayaM vA doShamalavirecanAdvirecanashabdaM labhate” (ka.a.1) iti| na ca vAcyaM doShamalavirecanAccedvirecanasa~jj~jA, tena bastishirovirecanayorapi virecanasa~jj~jApravRuttiH; yatastantrakArasiddheyaM sa~jj~jA na pAcakavadyogamAtrapravRuttA; tantrakArashca vamanavirecanayoreva yogarUDhAM sa~jj~jAM vidadhAti nAnyatra, tat kuto~anyatra prasaktiH| ShaDvirecanashatAnItyAdi svayamevAcAryo vyAkhyAsyati| pa~jca kaShAyashatAnItyatra kaShAyashabdena madhurAdInAM lavaNavarjAnAM rasAnAM kaShAyatvena paribhAShitAnAmAshrayatvenauShadhadravyamucyate| kaShAyayonayaH kaShAyajAtayaH| kaShAyANAM yathoktadravyANAM kalpanamupayogArthaM saMskaraNaM kaShAyakalpanam| mahAkaShAyA iti dashasa~gkhyAvacchinnasyaikakAryakaraNArthopAttasyauShadhagaNasya sa~jj~jA; yadvakShyati- “dashemAni jIvanIyAni” ityAdinA||1-3||

pUrvapakShamutthApayati- evamityAdi| tAni tAnIti jIvakakShIrakAkolIprabhRutIni, teShu teShu jIvanIyabRuMhaNIyashukrajananAdiShu, upaplavante punaH punastAnyeva paThyante; ekaM dravyamanekeShu paThyamAnamekameva, tatashca na sa~gkhyA pUryata iti pUrvapakShaH| siddhAntayati- naitadevamityAdi| ekasyAnekatvenAbhidhAne dRuShTAntamAha- yathetyAdi| ekaH puruShaH karmaNAM vyApArANAmodanapacanakumbhakaraNakhanitrakaraNabhUmikhananAnAM karaNe samartho bhavati, ya ityadhyAhAryaM, sa ityuktaguNaM puruShaM pratyavamRuShati; yadyat karmeti odanapAkAdi, yadyat karma karoti tasya tasya karmaNaH kartRusamprayuktaM ‘pAcaka’ iti, karaNasamprayuktaM ‘khAnitrika’ iti, kAryasamprayuktaM ‘kumbhakAra’ iti nAmavisheShaM; guNayogapravRuttaM gauNaM; guNayogashca ‘pAcaka’ ityatra pacikriyAyAM kartRutvaM, ‘khAnitrika’ ityatra khanitrakaraNakakhananaM prati kartRutvaM, kumbhakAra ityatra kumbhopahitaM kartRutvamityebhistribhirguNairabhinno bhinno~abhidhIyate vyavahriyate ceti bhAvaH| tadvat puruShavadauShadhadravyamapi; ekamapi sat kShIrakAkolIdravyaM jIvanabRuMhaNashukrajananalakShaNanAnAguNayogAnnAnAjIvanIyAdishabdenAbhidhIyate vyavahriyate cetyarthaH| atha kimarthaM punarekameva dravyaM bahujIvanIyAdiguNayogAttatra tatra paThyate, santi tAvadbahUni dravyANyekaikajIvanIyAdiguNAni svarUpato bhinnAni, tAnyeva pRuthakkasmAnna paThyanta ityAha- yadi caikamevetyAdi| yathA bahudravyANyekaikajIvanIyAdikAryakaraNasamarthAni bhavanti, tathaikameva dravyamanekajIvanIyAdikAryakaraNasamarthamasti, tatraikameva dravyaM bahukAryakartRu shiShyebhya upadeShTumupadhArayituM ca yujyate~alpaprayatnabodhyatvAdalpaprayatnadhAryatvAcca; na bahUnyekakAryaniyatAni, bahuprayAsopapAdyatvAdbahuprayAsabodhyatvAdbahuprayAsadhAryatvAcca ; kAryaM ca jIvanabRuMhaNAdyubhayorapi pakShayoravishiShTamiti vAkyArthaH| tathAguNayuktam anekajIvanIyAdikAryasamartham| tathAguNayuktatvameva vivRuNoti- yat sarvakarmaNAM jIvanIyAdInAM karaNe samarthaM syAt, tato bahukAryakArakAdekasmAt, anyadbahu pratiniyatakarmakArakaM, ka icchet? na ko~apIcchedityarthaH| upadhArayitum Avartanena smRutyArUDhaM kartum| kastata ityasyAdau ‘tadA’ ityadhyAhAryam||21-22||

adhyAyArthasa~ggrahamAha- yata ityAdi| yataH madanaphalAdeH| yAvanti trayastriMshadyogashatamityAdIni| yairdravyairvirecanashatAni ShaDiti yaireva madanaphalAdibhirmilitairuktAni virecanashatAni ShaDiti| lakShaNArthamityAdigrantho~anatisa~gkShepavistareNoktapa~jcAshanmahAkaShAyopapattisa~ggrAhakaH| alamiti samarthaH| alpabuddherayamityatrAyamitipadamatisa~gkShepa ityanena sambadhyate; yadyapi cehAtisa~gkShepo nAsti, tathA~api buddhisthirIkRutaH pratyavamRushyate| pa~jcAshatko hyayamityatrAyamiti padaM sughaTameva | bAhyeShu pralepAdiShu| AbhyantareShu vamanapAcanAdiShu| saMyogaM dravyANAmucitaM melana(ka)m| prayogaM kAlaprakRutyAdyapekShA yojanA||23-29||
athAto mAtrAshitIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

ShaShTikA~jchAlimudgAMshca saindhavAmalake yavAn| AntarIkShaM payaH sarpirjA~ggalaM madhu cAbhyaset||12||

Commentary: abhyasyAn darshayati- ShaShTikAnityAdi| iha ShaShTika Adau paThyate raktashAlimanu pradhAnatvakhyApanArtham| AntarIkShamiti AntarIkShaM pAnIyam| payaH kShIram| jA~ggalamiti jA~ggaladeshabhavaM mRugAdimAMsam| iha saindhavAbhyAso~annasaMskAratvena mAtrayA~abhipretaH; tena, “trINi dravyANi nAtyupayu~jjIta pippalyo lavaNaM kShAraH” (vi.a.1) iti yadvakShyati tena samaM virodho na bhavati, tatra lavaNAtiyogasya pratiShiddhatvAt||12||

tacca nityaM prayu~jjIta svAsthyaM yenAnuvartate| ajAtAnAM vikArANAmanutpattikaraM ca yat||13||

Commentary: mAtrAshItyAdinA svAsthyaparipAlanopAya ucyate, atibahu ca svasthaparipAlanaM tantre vaktavyaM, taccehAbhidhIyamAnaM granthagauravamAvahati, anabhidhIyamAnaM ca granthasya nyUnatAmApAdayati; atastatsUtramAtreNoddeShTumAha- taccetyAdi| suShThu nirvikAratvenAvatiShThata iti svasthaH, tasya bhAvaH svAsthyam; udvejakadhAtuvaiShamya virahitadhAtusAmyamityarthaH| tacca svAsthyamubhayathA paripAlyate vishuddhAhArAcArAbhyAM sadA kShIyamANasharIrapoShaNena, pratyavAyahetuparihAreNa ca; yathA- dIpaparipAlanaM snehavartidAnAt poShaNena kriyate, tathA shalabhavAtAdinirvApakahetuparihAreNa ca| sharIrapratyavAyahetushca dvividhaH- buddhidoShAdviShamasharIranyAsAdirvAtAdikArakaH, duShpariharashca kAlavisheShaH svabhAvAdiha hemantAdiH kaphacayAdikArakaH| tatra shlokapUrvArdhena svAsthyapoShakahetumAha, uttarArdhena tu ajAtAnAmityAdinA svAsthyavighAtakahetuparihAramAha| yadyapi cAjAtAnAM vikArANAmanutpattiH svabhAvasiddhA vidyata eva, vidyamAne ca karotyartho mukhyo nAsti, tathA~apIdamevAjAtavikArANAmanutpattikaraNaM yattadvikArahetupariharaNaM tathA duShpariharakAlavisheShajanitadoShaharaNaM , yathA vakShyati- “mAdhavaprathame mAsi nabhasyaprathame punaH| sahasyaprathame caiva vAhayeddoShasa~jcayam ” (sU.a.7) iti; tathA hetvantaranirapekShotpadyamAnacakShuHshleShmaharaNArthama~jjanam; evamAdi||13||

ata UrdhvaM sharIrasya kAryamakShya~jjanAdikam| svasthavRuttimabhipretya guNataH sampravakShyate||14||

Commentary: ata UrdhvamityAdi| ataH svAsthyAnuvRuttikAraNakathanAdUrdhvaM, kAryam avashyakAryaM, svasthavRuttimabhipretya svasthavRuttAnuShThAne, akShya~jjanAdyavashyaM kAryamityarthaH; a~jjanashabdo~abhya~jjane~api vartate, tadarthamakShya~jjanamityuktam| a~jjanamevAdAvupAhitaM pradhAnAvayavacakShuHparipAlakatvAt| uktaM ca- “cakShuH pradhAnaM sarveShAmindriyANAM vidurbudhAH| ghananIhArayuktAnAM jyotiShAmiva bhAskaraH” iti| yadi vA svasthavRuttamadhikRutya yada~jjanAdi, taducyate; rogeShu tu yada~jjanAdi, tadrogacikitsAsu vaktavyam| yadyapi caitada~jjanAdi rogaharamapi vaktavyaM, tathA~api prAyaH svasthavRuttamatametaditi svasthavRuttamabhipretyetyuktam||14||

sauvIrama~jjanaM nityaM hitamakShNoH prayojayet| pa~jcarAtre~aShTarAtre vA srAvaNArthe rasA~jjanam||15||

Commentary: sauvIramityAdi| suvIrAnadIbhavaM sauvIram| nityaM pratyaham| akShNoriti dvivacanamakShigolakadvaye~apya~jjanavidhAnArtham| pa~jcarAtrAShTarAtragrahaNamadUrAntarakAle niyamadarshanArtham| tena doShakAlamapekShyArvA~gmadhye UrdhvaM ca kartavyaM srAvaNama~jjanamiti bhavati||15||
cakShustejomayaM tasya visheShAcchleShmato bhayam| tataH shleShmaharaM karma hitaM dRuShTeH prasAdanam||16||
divA tanna prayoktavyaM netrayostIkShNama~jjanam| virekadurbalA dRuShTirAdityaM prApya sIdati||17||
yathA hi kanakAdInAM malinAM vividhAtmanAm||18||
dhautAnAM nirmalA shuddhistailacelakacAdibhiH| evaM netreShu martyAnAma~jjanAshcyotanAdibhiH||19||
hareNukAM priya~gguM ca pRuthvIkAM kesharaM nakham||20||
hrIveraM candanaM patraM tvageloshIrapadmakam| dhyAmakaM madhukaM mAMsI guggulvagurusharkaram||21||
nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthaplakShalodhratvacaH shubhAH| vanyaM sarjarasaM mustaM shaileyaM kamalotpale||22||
shrIveShTakaM shallakIM ca shukabarhamathApi ca| piShTvA limpecchareShIkAM tAM vartiM yavasannibhAm||23||
a~gguShThasammitAM kuryAdaShTA~ggulasamAM bhiShak| shuShkAM nigarbhAM tAM vartiM dhUmanetrArpitAM naraH||24||

vasAghRutamadhUcchiShTairyuktiyuktairvarauShadhaiH||25||

Commentary: snaihikadhUmavartimAha- vasetyAdi| madhUcchiShTaM sikthakam| varauShadhairiti madhurakavisheShaNaM; madhurakANi jIvanIyAni jIvakarShabhakAdIni| yuktiyuktairityanena tathA vasAdigrahaNaM kartavyaM, yathA vartiH kartuM pAryata iti darshayati| vartikaraNaM ca pUrvavat| snaihikI snehanakArikA||25||-

shvetA jyotiShmatI caiva haritAlaM manaHshilA||26||

Commentary: vairecanikadhUmapAnavartiM darshayati- shvetetyAdi| shvetA aparAjitA| gandhAH sugandhadravyANi, teShAM visheShaNamagurupatrAdyAH, aguru ca patrAdyAshca agurupatrAdyAH; agurupatrAdyAshca jvare vakShyamANaH “agurukuShThatagarapatra” (ci.a.3) ityAdigaNo mantavyaH| agurvAdyA iti na kRutaM, kuShThatagarayoratitIkShNatvena mastulu~ggakasrAvabhayAt parihArArtham| vakShyati ca trimarmIye- “dhUmavartiM pibedgandhairakuShThatagaraistathA” (si.a.9) iti, shAlAkye~apyuktaM- “natakuShThe srAvayato dhUmavartiprayojite| mastulu~ggaM visheSheNa tasmAtte naiva yojayet” iti; sushrute~apyuktaM- “elAdinA tagarakuShThavarjyena” (sU.ci.a.40) iti||26||-
gauravaM shirasaH shUlaM pInasArdhAvabhedakau||27||
karNAkShishUlaM kAsashca hikkAshvAsau galagrahaH| dantadaurbalyamAsrAvaH shrotraghrANAkShidoShajaH||28||
pUtirghrANAsyagandhashca dantashUlamarocakaH| hanumanyAgrahaH kaNDUH krimayaH pANDutA mukhe||29||
shleShmapraseko vaisvaryaM galashuNDyupajihvikA| khAlityaM pi~jjaratvaM ca keshAnAM patanaM tathA||30||
kShavathushcAtitandrA ca buddhermoho~atinidratA| dhUmapAnAt prashAmyanti balaM bhavati cAdhikam||31||
shiroruhakapAlAnAmindriyANAM svarasya ca| na ca vAtakaphAtmAno balino~apyUrdhvajatrujAH||32||
prayogapAne tasyAShTau kAlAH samparikIrtitAH||33||

vAtashleShmasamutkleshaH kAleShveShu hi lakShyate| snAtvA bhuktvA samullikhya kShutvA dantAnnighRuShya ca| nAvanA~jjananidrAnte cAtmavAn dhUmapo bhavet| tathA vAtakaphAtmAno na bhavantyUrdhvajatrujAH||35||
paraM dvikAlapAyI syAdahnaH kAleShu buddhimAn||36||
prayoge, snaihike tvekaM, vairecyaM tricatuH pibet| hRutkaNThendriyasaMshuddhirlaghutvaM shirasaH shamaH||37||
bAdhiryamAndhyamUkatvaM raktapittaM shirobhramam||38||
akAle cAtipItashca dhUmaH kuryAdupadravAn| tatreShTaM sarpiShaH pAnaM nAvanA~jjanatarpaNam||39||
snaihikaM dhUmaje doShe vAyuH pittAnugo yadi| shItaM tu raktapitte syAcchleShmapitte virUkShaNam||40||

mAtrAshI syAt| AhAramAtrA punaragnibalApekShiNI||3||

Commentary: mAtrAM mAtrAvadannamashituM bhoktuM shIlaM yasyAsau mAtrAshI, yadi vA mAtrayA~ashituM bhoktuM shIlaM yasya sa tathA| tatreha mAtrA anapAyiparimANam| ashirayamihAvisheSheNa khAdyaprAshyalehyapeyAnAmabhyavahAre vartate| tena mAtrAshI syAdityuktaM khAdyaprAshyalehyapeyAnAM mAtrayA~abhyavaharaNaM noktamiti yaccocyate, tannirastaM bhavati| dRuShTashcAyamashiH khAdyAdyabhyavahAre; yathA- dashamUlaharItakyAM- “ekAbhayAM prAshya tatashca lehAcchuktiM nihanti shvayathuM pravRuddham” (ci.a.12); tathA- “kShIrAshI tat prayojayet” (ci.a.1) iti| itashcAvagantavyamashirayaM sarvAbhyavahAre vartate, yenaitadvivaraNaM sAmAnyenaiva kRutam- AhAramAtrA punariti, na punarashitamAtrA punariti| mAtrAM vyAkaroti- AhAretyAdi| agnerbalamutkRuShTaM madhyamalpaM vA~apekShyotkRuShTA madhyA~alpA vA mAtrA bhavatItyagnibalApekShiNI| punaHshabdo bheShajAdimAtrAM vyAyAmamAtrAM ca vyAvartayati; tena na sarvamAtrA~agnibalApekShiNI; yato bheShajamAtrA vyAdhyAturabalApekShiNI vaktavyA, vyAyAmasya tu doShakShayAgnivRuddhyAdyutpAdashramaklamAdyanutpAdApekShiNI, vyavasthApayitavyA| yadi vA punaHshabdaH paunaHpunye, tenAhAramAtrA punaH punaragnibalamapekShate| etaduktaM bhavati- yadekasmin puruShe ekadA yA~agnibalena vyavasthApitA mAtrA sA na sarvakAlaM bhavati, yata Rutubhedena vayobhedena ca tasyaivAgniH kadAcidvivRuddho bhavati, yathA- hemante yauvane ca, kadAcinmando bhavati, yathA- varShAsu vArdhakye ca; tenAgnibalabhedAnmAtrA~apyekarUpA na bhavati, kintu tatkAlabhavamagnibalamapekShya punaH punarmAtrA~api bhidyata iti||3||
paraM tvataH pravakShyAmi dhUmo yeShAM vigarhitaH| na viriktaH pibeddhUmaM na kRute bastikarmaNi||41||
na raktI na viSheNArto na shocanna ca garbhiNI| na shrame na made nAme na pitte na prajAgare||42||
na mUrcchAbhramatRuShNAsu na kShINe nApi ca kShate| na madyadugdhe pItvA ca na snehaM na ca mAkShikam||43||
dhUmaM na bhuktvA dadhnA ca na rUkShaH kruddha eva ca| na tAlushoShe timire shirasyabhihite na ca||44||
na sha~gkhake na rohiNyAM na mehe na madAtyaye| eShu dhUmamakAleShu mohAt pibati yo naraH||45||
dhUmayogyaH pibeddoShe shiroghrANAkShisaMshraye||46||
ghrANenAsyena kaNThasthe mukhena ghrANapo vamet| Asyena dhUmakavalAn piban ghrANena nodvamet||47||

Rujva~ggacakShustaccetAH sUpaviShTastriparyayam||48||

Commentary: samyagupaviShTaH sUpaviShTaH| triparyayamiti tu yadyapi pUrvamevoktam ‘ApAnAstristrayastrayaH’ ityanena, tathA~api triparyayadhUmapAnaparyantamRujva~ggacakShurAdi kartavyaM nopakramamAtra eveti punarabhidhAnena darshayati| nAsikayA~api randhraikacchidraM pidhAya pibenna punarnAsikayaiva pibediti niyamaH||48||-
caturviMshatikaM netraM svA~ggulIbhirvirecane||49||
dvAtriMshada~ggulaM snehe prayoge~adhyardhamiShyate| Ruju trikoShAphalitaM kolAsthyagrapramANitam||50||

dUrAdvinirgataH parvacchinno nADItanUkRutaH||51||

Commentary: yathAbhihitanalikayA pAne guNaM darshayati- dUrAdityAdi||51||-
yadA corashca kaNThashca shirashca laghutAM vrajet||52||
kaphashca tanutAM prAptaH supItaM dhUmamAdishet| avishuddhaH svaro yasya kaNThashca sakapho bhavet||53||
stimito mastakashcaivamapItaM dhUmamAdishet| tAlu mUrdhA ca kaNThashca shuShyate paritapyate||54||
tRuShyate muhyate jantU raktaM ca sravate~adhikam| shirashca bhramate~atyarthaM mUrcchA cAsyopajAyate||55||
varShe varShe~aNutailaM ca kAleShu triShu nA caret||56||
prAvRuTsharadvasanteShu gatameghe nabhastale| nasyakarma yathAkAlaM yo yathoktaM niShevate||57||
na tasya cakShurna ghrANaM na shrotramupahanyate| na syuH shvetA na kapilAH keshAH shmashrUNi vA punaH||58||
na ca keshAH pramucyante vardhante ca visheShataH| manyAstambhaH shiraHshUlamarditaM hanusa~ggrahaH||59||
pInasArdhAvabhedau ca shiraHkampashca shAmyati| sirAH shiraHkapAlAnAM sandhayaH snAyukaNDarAH||60||
nAvanaprINitAshcAsya labhante~abhyadhikaM balam| mukhaM prasannopacitaM svaraH snigdhaH sthiro mahAn||61||
sarvendriyANAM vaimalyaM balaM bhavati cAdhikam| na cAsya rogAH sahasA prabhavantyUrdhvajatrujAH||62||
candanAguruNI patraM dArvItva~gmadhukaM balAm||63||
prapauNDarIkaM sUkShmailAM viDa~ggaM bilvamutpalam| hrIberamabhayaM vanyaM tva~gmustaM sArivAM sthirAm||64||
jIvantIM pRushniparNIM ca suradAru shatAvarIm| hareNuM bRuhatIM vyAghrIM surabhIM padmakesharam||65||
vipAcayecchataguNe mAhendre vimale~ambhasi| tailAddashaguNaM sheShaM kaShAyamavatArayet||66||
tena tailaM kaShAyeNa dashakRutvo vipAcayet| athAsya dashame pAke samAMshaM chAgalaM payaH||67||
dadyAdeSho~aNutailasya nAvanIyasya saMvidhiH| asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta tailasyArdhapalonmitAm||68||
snigdhasvinnottamA~ggasya picunA nAvanaistribhiH| tryahAttryahAcca saptAhametat karma samAcaret||69||
nivAtoShNasamAcArI hitAshI niyatendriyaH| tailametattridoShaghnamindriyANAM balapradam||70||
ApothitAgraM dvau kAlau kaShAyakaTutiktakam||71||
bhakShayeddantapavanaM dantamAMsAnyabAdhayan| nihanti gandhaM vairasyaM jihvAdantAsyajaM malam||72||
niShkRuShya rucimAdhatte sadyo dantavishodhanam| kara~jjakaravIrArkamAlatIkakubhAsanAH||73||
shasyante dantapavane ye cApyevaMvidhA drumAH| suvarNarUpyatAmrANi trapurItimayAni ca||74||
jihvAnirlekhanAni syuratIkShNAnyanRujUni ca| jihvAmUlagataM yacca malamucchvAsarodhi ca||75||
dhAryANyAsyena vaishadyarucisaugandhyamicchatA||76||
jAtIkaTukapUgAnAM lava~ggasya phalAni ca| kakkolasya phalaM patraM tAmbUlasya shubhaM tathA| tathA karpUraniryAsaH sUkShmailAyAH phalAni ca||77||

yAvaddhyasyAshanamashitamanupahatya prakRutiM yathAkAlaM jarAM gacchati tAvadasya mAtrApramANaM veditavyaM bhavati||4||

Commentary: agnibalApekShitvameva vivRuNoti- yAvaddhItyAdi| yAvaditi yAvatparimANam| hishabdo hetau| asyeti bhoktuH| ashanaM caturvidhamapi bhojyam| ashitaM bhuktam| prakRutiM vAtAdInAM rasAdInAM ca sAmyAvasthAm| anupahatya vikAramakRutvetyarthaH| yathAkAlamiti nishAsheShe| tAvaditi pUrvapramANAvacchinnamashanaM pratyavamRushati| dvitIyamasyeti grahaNamanyatra pratiShedhArtham| tena yasyaiva yAvatI mAtrA nirvikArA, tasyaiva sA mantavyA nAnyeShAM, pratipuruShamagnibalasya bhinnatvAt| yadyapi caikasminnapi puruShe kAlAdibhedenAgnibalabhedo bhavati, tathA~apyekapuruSha ekamAtrAmavadhArya kiyantamapi kAlaM tayaiva mAtrayA agnibalabhedahetvabhAve sati vyavahAro bhavatyeva| mAtrApramANaM mAtreyattA; mAtrApramANashabdena ceha mAtrApramANavaditi boddhavyam; anyathA, tAvacchabdenAvacchinnAshanavAcinA mAtrApramANashabdasya guNavAcinaH sAmAnAdhikaraNyaM na syAt| nanu, prakRutimanupahatyeti na kartavyaM visheShaNaM, na hyAhAro yo yathAkAlaM jarAM yAti sa mAtrAdoShAdvikAraM karoti, karoti tu dravyasvabhAvasaMskArAdidoShAt; yathA mandakalakucAdayo yathAkAlaM jarAM gacchanto~api doShajanakA bhavantyeva; na tAvatA~api tatra mAtrA duShyati, yathA vakShyati trividhakukShIye- “na ca kevalaM mAtrAvattvAdevAhArasya kRutsnamAhAraphalasauShThavamavAptuM shakyaM, prakRutyAdInAmaShTAnAmAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAnAM bhinnaphalatvAt” (vi.a.2) iti| naivaM, dvividhA hi mAtrA rasavimAne vaktavyA- sarvagraharUpA, parigraharUpA ca; tatra samuditasyAhArasya parimANaM sarvagrahaH, madhurAmlAdInAmAhArAvayavAnAM pratyekaM mAtrayA grahaNaM parigrahaH; tena yatrAhArasamudAyaparimANaM samucitameva gRuhyate, AhArAvayavAnAM tu madhurAdInAM svabhAvahitAnAmapyayathoktamAnaM syAt, tatrAhArAvayavamAtrAvaiShamyAddhAtuvaiShamyaM bhavatyeva, ayathAkAlaM jarAgamanaM ca syAt; taduktaM- prakRutimanupahatyeti visheShaNam| anye tu vyAkhyAnayanti- ‘asya’ iti, ‘ashanam’ iti, ashitam iti ca padatrayaM prakaraNAdeva labhyate; yat punaH kriyate tadvisheShapratipAdanArtham| tena, asyetyanena parIkShako bhoktA~adhikriyate, ashanamityanena ca prashastamashanaM prakRutikaraNasaMyogadeshakAlAviruddhamucyate, ashitamityanena ca yathAvidhibhojanamucyate; tadevaM sarvaguNasampanna AhAro mAtrAvAnucyate||4||
hanvorbalaM svarabalaM vadanopacayaH paraH| syAt paraM ca rasaj~jAnamanne ca ruciruttamA||78||
na cAsya kaNThashoShaH syAnnauShThayoH sphuTanAdbhayam| na ca dantAH kShayaM yAnti dRuDhamUlA bhavanti ca||79||
na shUlyante na cAmlena hRuShyante bhakShayanti ca| parAnapi kharAn bhakShyAMstailagaNDUShadhAraNAt||80||
nityaM snehArdrashirasaH shiraHshUlaM na jAyate| na khAlityaM na pAlityaM na keshAH prapatanti ca||81||
balaM shiraHkapAlAnAM visheSheNAbhivardhate| dRuDhamUlAshca dIrghAshca kRuShNAH keshA bhavanti ca||82||
indriyANi prasIdanti sutvagbhavati cAnanam | nidrAlAbhaH sukhaM ca syAnmUrdhni tailaniShevaNAt||83||
na karNarogA vAtotthA na manyAhanusa~ggrahaH| noccaiH shrutirna bAdhiryaM syAnnityaM karNatarpaNAt||84||
snehAbhya~ggAdyathA kumbhashcarma snehavimardanAt| bhavatyupA~ggAdakShashca dRuDhaH kleshasaho yathA||85||
tathA sharIramabhya~ggAddRuDhaM sutvak ca jAyate| prashAntamArutAbAdhaM kleshavyAyAmasaMsaham||86||
sparshane~abhyadhiko vAyuH sparshanaM ca tvagAshritam| tvacyashca paramabhya~ggastasmAttaM shIlayennaraH||87||
na cAbhighAtAbhihataM gAtramabhya~ggasevinaH| vikAraM bhajate~atyarthaM balakarmaNi vA kvacit||88||
susparshopacitA~ggashca balavAn priyadarshanaH| bhavatyabhya~gganityatvAnnaro~alpajara eva ca||89||
kharatvaM stabdhatA raukShyaM shramaH suptishca pAdayoH| sadya evopashAmyanti pAdAbhya~gganiShevaNAt||90||
jAyate saukumAryaM ca balaM sthairyaM ca pAdayoH| dRuShTiH prasAdaM labhate mArutashcopashAmyati||91||
na ca syAdgRudhrasIvAtaH pAdayoH sphuTanaM na ca| na sirAsnAyusa~gkocaH pAdAbhya~ggena pAdayoH||92||
daurgandhyaM gauravaM tandrAM kaNDUM malamarocakam| svedabIbhatsatAM hanti sharIraparimArjanam||93||
pavitraM vRuShyamAyuShyaM shramasvedamalApaham | sharIrabalasandhAnaM snAnamojaskaraM param||94||
kAmyaM yashasyamAyuShyamalakShmIghnaM praharShaNam| shrImat pAriShadaM shastaM nirmalAmbaradhAraNam||95||
vRuShyaM saugandhyamAyuShyaM kAmyaM puShTibalapradam| saumanasyamalakShmIghnaM gandhamAlyaniShevaNam||96||
dhanyaM ma~ggalyamAyuShyaM shrImadvyasanasUdanam| harShaNaM kAmyamojasyaM ratnAbharaNadhAraNam||97||
medhyaM pavitramAyuShyamalakShmIkalinAshanam| pAdayormalamArgANAM shaucAdhAnamabhIkShNashaH||98||
pauShTikaM vRuShyamAyuShyaM shuci rUpavirAjanam| keshashmashrunakhAdInAM kalpanaM samprasAdhanam||99||
cakShuShyaM sparshanahitaM pAdayorvyasanApaham| balyaM parAkramasukhaM vRuShyaM pAdatradhAraNam||100||
IteH prashamanaM balyaM guptyAvaraNasha~gkaram| gharmAnilarajombughnaM chatradhAraNamucyate||101||
skhalataH sampratiShThAnaM shatrUNAM ca niShUdanam| avaShTambhanamAyuShyaM bhayaghnaM daNDadhAraNam||102||

nagarI nagarasyeva rathasyeva rathI yathA| svasharIrasya medhAvI kRutyeShvavahito bhavet||103||

Commentary: sampratyanuktasvasthavidhyupasa~ggrahArthaM tathopadiShTasyAvadhAnena karaNArthamAha- nagarItyAdi| kRutyeShu karaNIyeShUkteShvanukteShu ca| nagaradRuShTAntenAntarapratyavAyahetuvighAtakAriNi kRutye~avadhAnaM darshayati, rathadRuShTAntena ca bAhyasparshAdiparihArake kRutye~avadhAnaM darshayati| nagarocchede hyantaro duShTajanasambandha eva hetuH prAyo bhavati, rathabha~gge tu bAhyashvabhraviShamapatanAdiH||103||

bhavati cAtra- vRuttyupAyAnniSheveta ye syurdharmAvirodhinaH| shamamadhyayanaM caiva sukhamevaM samashnute||104||

Commentary: pradhAnabhUtAM sharIrapratyavekShAM kRutvA svasthena satA yadanyacca kartavyaM tadAha- vRuttyupAyAnityAdi| vRuttiH vartanaM, tasyopAyAH kRuShyAdayo dhanaiShaNAyAM tisraiShaNIye vAcyAH| shamaH shAntiH, adhyayanaM vedAdhyayanaM, niSheveteti sambandhaH| evaM sati sukhaM samashnute prApnoti| etena kRuShyAdibhyo~arthaH, shAntyadhyayanAbhyAM dharmaH, arthadharmAbhyAM ca sukhalakShaNaH kAmaH, iti trivargAnuShThAnaM darshitaM bhavati||104||
tatra shlokAH- mAtrA dravyANi mAtrAM ca saMshritya gurulAghavam| dravyANAM garhito~abhyAso yeShAM, yeShAM ca shasyate||105||
a~jjanaM dhUmavartishca trividhA vartikalpanA| dhUmapAnaguNAH kAlAH pAnamAnaM ca yasya yat||106||
vyApatticihnaM bhaiShajyaM dhUmo yeShAM vigarhitaH| peyo yathA yanmayaM ca netraM yasya ca yadvidham||107||
nasyakarmaguNA nastaHkAryaM yacca yathA yadA| bhakShayeddantapavanaM yathA yadyadguNaM ca yat||108||
yadarthaM yAni cAsyena dhAryANi kavalagrahe| tailasya ye guNA diShTAH shirastailaguNAshca ye||109||
karNataile tathA~abhya~gge pAdAbhya~gge~a~ggamArjane| snAne vAsasi shuddhe ca saugandhye ratnadhAraNe||110||
shauce saMharaNe lomnAM pAdatracchatradhAraNe| guNA mAtrAshitIye~asmiMstathoktA daNDadhAraNe||111||

tatra shAliShaShTikamudgalAvakapi~jjalaiNashashasharabhashambarAdInyAhAradravyANi prakRutilaghUnyapi mAtrApekShINi bhavanti| tathA piShTekShukShIravikRutitilamAShAnUpaudakapishitAdInyAhAradravyANi prakRutigurUNyapi mAtrAmevApekShante||5||

Commentary: mAtrAlakShaNamupadishya vyavahAropayoginaM dravyabhedena mAtrAbhedaM darshayati- tatra shAlItyAdi| tatra laghuvarga eva prathamaM paThyate, pathyatamatvAt; tatrApyAdau raktashAlirAhAradravyapradhAnatvAt| kapi~jjalo gauratittiriH, eNaH kRuShNasAraH, sharabho mahAshRu~ggI hariNaH, shambarastadvisheShaH| annapAnavidhau “shItaH snigdho~aguruH svAduH” (sU.a.27) iti ShaShTikaguNakathane “aguruH” ityakAraprashleSho draShTavyaH, teneha ShaShTikasya laghutvapratipAdanaM na virudhyate| api samuccaye, tena prakRutilaghUni karaNalaghUni ca lAjAdIni mAtrApekShINi bhavantIti labhyate| evaM prakRutigurUNyapItyatrApi saMskAragurushaktupiNDAdigrahaNaM vAcyam| Adishabdo~atra prakAravAcI, shAliShaShTikAdigaNAbhAvAt| vikRutishabdaH piShTekShukShIraiH sambadhyate, kShIravikRutiH kShIrakRutA bhakShyAH; pishitamAnUpaudakAbhyAM sambadhyate||5||

na caivamukte dravye gurulAghavamakAraNaM manyeta, laghUni hi dravyANi vAyvagniguNabahulAni bhavanti; pRuthvIsomaguNabahulAnItarANi, tasmAt svaguNAdapi laghUnyagnisandhukShaNasvabhAvAnyalpadoShANi cocyante~api sauhityopayuktAni, gurUNi punarnAgnisandhukShaNasvabhAvAnyasAmAnyAt, atashcAtimAtraM doShavanti sauhityopayuktAnyanyatra vyAyAmAgnibalAt; saiShA bhavatyagnibalApekShiNI mAtrA||6||

Commentary: nanu, yadi laghu hitamapi svaguNakaraNe mAtrAmapekShate, guru cAhitamapi mAtrAparigRuhItaM hitameva syAt, tat kiM gauravalAghavopadeshenetyAsha~gkyAha- na caivamityAdi| laghUni yadyapyAkAshavAyvagniguNabahulAni bhavanti, tathA~apyAkAshasyAgnidIpanaM prati tathAvidhasAmarthyAbhAvAt vAyvagnyostvagnidIpakatvAd vAyvagniguNabahulAnItyuktam| tasmAt kAraNAllaghUni mAtrayA tAvadagniM dIpayanti; svaguNAdapi vAyvagniguNabAhulyAdagnisandhukShaNasvabhAvAni syuH| mAtrAvyatikrame samAne~api laghugurudravyayorlaghudravyasya visheShaM darshayati- alpadoShANi cocyante~api sauhityopayuktAni; sauhityaM mAtrAtikrameNa tRuptiH| gurUNItyAdau punaHshabdo vyAvRuttyarthaH| asAmAnyAditi virodhArthe na~j, asitamiti yathA; tenAsAmAnyAditi agniviruddhapRuthvItoyaguNabAhulyAdityarthaH| ‘anyasAmAnyAt’ itipAThapakShe~apyanyashabdo viruddhavacana eva, tena tathA~api sa evArthaH| atashcetyAdinA mAtrAvyatikrame gurau garIyAMsaM doShaM darshayati| nanu, dRushyante kecana bhArikAdayaH puruShA sauhityopayuktagurudravyAhAre~api nirdoShAH, tat kimucyate~atimAtraM doShavantItyAsha~gkyAha- anyatretyAdi| vyAyAmakRutamagnibalaM vyAyAmAgnibalam| yadyapi kAlAhitabalo~agnirmAtrA~adhikagurudravyakShamo bhavati, yaduktaM- “paktA bhavati hemante mAtrAdravyagurukShamaH” (sU.a.6) iti, tathA~api vyAyAmAhitabalo vahnirnitarAM balavAn bhavatItyayameva pradhAnaparigrahAduktaH| ye tu vyAyAmAditi cAgnibalAditi hetudvayaM varNayanti, teShAmevaM sati vyAyAmApekShiNyashanamAtrA syAditi prakaraNaviruddho~arthaH syAt| pratij~jAtamarthaM nyAyasampAditamupasaMharati- saiShetyAdi| seti agnibalApekShiNI pratij~jAtA mAtrA, eSheti nyAyenAgnyapekShitvena nirvAhitA||6||

na ca nApekShate dravyaM; dravyApekShayA ca tribhAgasauhityamardhasauhityaM vA gurUNAmupadishyate, laghUnAmapi ca nAtisauhityamagneryuktyartham||7||

Commentary: nanu, yadyapyagnibalApekShiNI mAtrA, tat kasmAdekarUpa evAgnau laghUnAM dravyANAM bhUyasI mAtrA bhavati, gurUNAM tatastribhAgocitA ardhA vetyAha- na cetyAdi| dravyamapekShata ityarthaH| tribhAgasauhityaM manAggurubhiH| evaM gauravaprakarShApakarShAdanyadapi kalpanIyam| laghUnAmapi nAtisauhityamityatra sauhityashabdastRuptimAtre vartate, tena laghUni tRuptyatikrameNa na bhoktavyAni, evaM hi teShAM mAtrAtikramo na syAt | agneryuktiH svamAnAvasthitiH, tadartham| nanu, gurUNAM tAvadatimAtropayogo~agniparipAlanArthaM niShidhyatAM, yena gurUNyagnyasamAnAni; laghUni punaragnisamAnAni, tatteShAM kathamatimAtropayogo vahnimAndyamAvahatIti? brUmaH- laghUnAM dravyANAM sAmAnyamabhibhUyAtimAtratvamevAgnimAndyaM karoti, yathA- cakShustaijasaM, tejaHsahakRutaM ca pashyati, tadeva tejotiyogAdupahanyate; tathA shastramashmasambhavam, ashmayogAcca tIkShNaM sampadyate, ashmanyeva ca mithyAyogAt pratihataM bhavati; taduktaM shAlAkye- yattejo jyotiShAM dIptaM shArIraM prANinAM ca yat| saMyuktaM tejasA tejastaddhi rUpANi pashyati|| tadeva cakShustAnyeva jyotIMShyati tu pashyataH| vikAraM bhajate~atyarthamathavA~api vinashyati|| shastrasyAshmA yathA yonirnishitaM ca tadashmani| tIkShNaM bhavatyatiyogAttatraiva pratihanyate iti||7||

mAtrAvaddhyashanamashitamanupahatya prakRutiM balavarNasukhAyuShA yojayatyupayoktAramavashyamiti||8||

Commentary: evaM tAvadvyutpAditA~agnibaladravyApekShiNI mAtrA, mAtrAnvitaM ca bhojyaM bhoktavyamityuktaM, mAtrAshitatve ko guNa ityAha- mAtrAvaddhItyAdi| ihAvashyamiti niyamo virodhikAraNAntarAbhAve sati boddhavyaH; yato yadyapi pUrvavadashanAshitopayoktRupadaiH prashastabhojanAdivAcibhiH prakRutikaraNAdiguNasampannamannaM labhyate, tathA~api kAlaviparyayapraj~jAparAdhAsAtmyashabdasparsharUparasagandhAH santyevAhArajanyabalAdivirodhakAH; yadAha- “santi hyRute~apyahitAhArAdanyA rogaprakRutayaH” (sU.a.28) iti; tena mAtrAparigRuhItAH shubhA api prakRutyAdayaH prAyo balAdihetavo bhavantIti mAtrAvadAhArastutyarthamavashyamiti kRutam| sukhayuktamAyuH sukhAyuH, yadi vA sukhaM cAyushceti mantavyaM; svarUpeNApi cAyurmRugyamiti prAk pratipAditameva||8||

bhavanti cAtra- guru piShTamayaM tasmAttaNDulAn pRuthukAnapi| na jAtu bhuktavAn khAdenmAtrAM khAdedbubhukShitaH||9||

Commentary: bhavanti cAtreti| tantrakArasya samayo~ayaM- yat pUrvavyAkhyAtArthasa~ggrahArthaM yadA shlokena vaktumArabhate tadA ‘bhavati cAtra’ iti karoti| piShTamayaM piShTavikAraH| tasmAditi gurutvAt| pRuthukAH ‘cippiTA’ iti lokaprasiddhAH| na jAtu na kadAcit| mAtrAM khAdediti anapAyiparimANavantaM khAdet||9||
vallUraM shuShkashAkAni shAlUkAni bisAni ca| nAbhyasedgauravAnmAMsaM kRushaM naivopayojayet||10||
kUrcikAMshca kilATAMshca shaukaraM gavyamAhiShe| matsyAn dadhi ca mAShAMshca yavakAMshca na shIlayet||11||

dvitayamiha shAstraprayojanaM yadAturavyAdhiharaNaM svasthasya svAsthyarakShaNaM ca; yadAha- svasthAturaparAyaNam (sU.a.1) iti; tenotpannavyAdhipratIkAradvArA~a~aturarakShaNaM bheShajacatuShkamabhidhAya svasthacatuShko~abhidhAtavyaH; tatrApi svAsthyaparipAlanahetuShu mAtrAvadannaM pradhAnaM; yadAha- prANinAM punarmUlamAhAro balavarNaujasAM ca (su.sU.a.1) iti; tacceha mAtrAvadannaM vidhIyata ityAdau mAtrAshitIya evAbhidhIyate| mAtrAshitamadhikRutya kRutyo~adhyAyo mAtrAshitIyaH| yadyapyadhyAyAdau ‘mAtrAshI’ iti padamanushrUyate, tathA~api ‘mAtrAshIyaH’ iti sa~jj~jApraNayane kaShToccAraNabhayAttadarthaparaparyAyashabdeneyaM sa~jj~jA kRutA; yathA “navegAndhAraNIya” (sU.a.7) ityAdikA sa~jj~jA||1-2||

srAvaNA~jjanaprakaraNopapattimAha- cakShurityAdi| cakShurindriyasya taijasasya shleShmata ApyAttaijasaviruddhatvena hetunA, visheShAditi vAtApittabhayAdadhikatvena bhayaM bhavati| shleShmajaye ca srAvaNaM pradhAnaM, tasmAt srAvyamityarthaH| srAvaNA~jjanakAlaM niyamayati- nishAyAmityAdi| dhruvamavashyaM nishAyAmeva, a~jjanaM pratyAsannatvAt srAvaNA~jjanam| jatUkarNenApi srAvaNarasA~jjanaM nishAyAmeva vihitaM; yaduktaM- “saptAhAdrasA~jjanaM naktam” iti| shAlAkye~apyuktaM- “virekadurbalA dRuShTirAdityaM prApya sIdati | rAtrau svapnaguNAccAkShi puShyatya~jjanakarShi(rshi)tam” iti| sauvIrA~jjanaM tu virecanaM na bhavati, cakShuHprasAdamAtraM karoti, tena taddivAkriyamANaM na virodhi| anye tu vyAkhyAnayanti- dhruvaM nityakartavyaM sauvIrA~jjanaM yattannishi kartavyaM, srAvaNA~jjanaM tu shleShmodrekaviShaye(yi) vamanavat pUrvAhNa eva kartavyam||16-17||-

a~jjanaguNamAha- yathA hItyAdi| shuddhiH svAbhAvikI; sA~a~agantudhUlyAdyapanayanena nirmalA sati bhAti| AshcyotanaM netravirekArthaM dravauShadhadAnaM, taccehAnabhihitamapi phalaikyAdabhihitam, Adishabdena puTapAkAdInAM grahaNam||18-19||-

ihaivA~jjanAnte dhUmapAnaM vidhAsyati- “nAvanA~jjananidrAnte” ityAdinA; ato~a~jjanAnantaraM dhUmo~abhidhIyate; uktaM ca shAlAkye- “tIkShNA~jjanenA~jjitalocanasya yaH sampraduShTo na nireti netrAt| shleShmA shiraHsthaH sa tu pItamAtre dhUme prashAntiM labhate kShaNena” iti| hareNukAmityAdi| hareNukA reNukA| pRuthvIkA kRuShNajIrakam| kesharaM nAgakesharam| padmakaM padmakAShTham| dhyAmakaM gandhatRuNam| nyagrodhAdInAM plakShAntAnAM tvacaH, tAsAM visheShaNaM shubhA iti| vanyaM kaivartamustakam| shukabarhaM granthiparNakam| shareShIkA sharapuShpasya nAlI ‘sharikA’ iti prasiddhA| atra vidhAnaM- piShTairbheShajaiH sharikA tathA veShTayitavyA yathA aShTA~ggulAyatA a~gguShThapariNAhA ca vartiH syAt, tasyAM ca shuShkAyAM satyAM shareShIkAmAkRuShya snehenAbhyajyAgninaikasminnagre~avadahya vakShyamANadhUmapAnanalikAyAmagrarandhre niveshyAto dhUmaH peyaH | prAyogikI ca nityapeyadhUmavartisa~jj~jA| sukhAmityanenAkaTukatvamanatyayatvaM ca darshayati||20-24||-

dhUmapAnaguNAn darshayati- gauravamityAdi| shiroruhAH keshAH; kapAlAshca shirasa eva| balino~apIti balavatkAraNA apItyarthaH| Urdhvajatrujatvenaiva shirogatA api labdhAste punarabhidhIyante visheShavidhAnArtham||27-32||-

dhUmapAnakAlaM darshayati- prayogetyAdi| prayogapAne prAyogikadhUmapAne ete~aShTau kAlAH, snaihikapAne tu vAtavRuddhyupalakShitaH kAlaH, vairecanikapAne tu shleShmavRuddhyupalakShito mantavyaH| prAyogika eva prAyaH svasthavRuttAdhikAre, tena tatkAla eva kaNTharaveNAbhidhIyate; yadi vA prayogapAne satatapAne svasthAdhikAra iti yAvat; tena dhUmatrayasyApyete kAlA bhavanti| vAtakaphAtmashabdena vAtAtmAnaH kaphAtmAno vAtakaphAtmAnashca gRuhyante| peyAH syurityAdAvApAnA dhUmAbhyavahAramokShAH; ekaikasmin snAnAdidhUmapAnakAle tririti AvRuttitrayaM kartavyAH; te cAvRuttitraye~api tridhA tridhA kartavyAH; ekaikasmin dhUmapAnakAle nava dhUmAbhyavahAramokShAH kartavyAH; trIMstrInabhyavahArAn kRutvA vishrAmo~antarA kartavya ityarthaH||33-35||-

aShTasu kAleShvekasminnekasmin divase yasmin dhUme yAvAn yAvAn pAnakAlaniyamastaM darshayati- paramityAdi| kAleShu snAtvetyAdikAleShu| prayoge prAyogikadhUme| snaihike tvekamiti snaihikadhUme ekameva kAlaM vyApya dhUmaM pibediti yojyam| tricaturiti vairecye doShabalApekSho vikalpaH||36-37||-

bAdhiryetyAdi| dhUmaja ityavidhiprayuktadhUmakRute yadi vAyuH pittAnugo vRuddhastadA nAvanA~jjanatarpaNaM snaihikaM snehakRutaM kartavyaM, shItaM shItadravyakRutaM kartavyaM nAvanAdyeva, virUkShaNamapi nAvanAdyeva||38-40||
na virikta ityAdau pratiniShedhyaM nakArakaraNaM niShedhagauravadarshanArtham| dhUmaM na bhuktveti punardhUmagrahaNaM dadhnA bhuktavato visheShapratiShedhArtham||41-45||-

dhUmayogya ityAdau ghrANeneti chedaH| pratilomaM gata AsyapIto ghrANaM gata ityarthaH| hishabdadvayaM ca hetau| tenAyamarthaH- yasmAt pratilomaM vimArgaM gato dhUmastasmAccakShuShI hiMsyAt, yasmAddhiMsyAt tasmAd ghrANena nodvamediti||46-47||-

netraM nalikA| caturviMshatikaM caturviMshatya~ggulam| adhyardhaM sArdhamityarthaH; iha vairecanikanetrameva caturviMshatya~ggulapramANaM sArdhaM sat ShaTtriMshada~ggulapramANaM prAyogikadhUmapAne; tattu jatUkarNapratyayAdboddhavyam| yadAha- “sArdhastryaMshayutaH pUrNo hastaH prAyogikAdiShu” iti| trikoShAphalitamiti tribhiH parvabhirbhinnaiH samanvitam||49-50||-
keciddhUmasamyakpAnAdilakShaNaM granthaM paThanti| tatra, yadA corashcetyAdi samyagdhUmapAnalakShaNam, avishuddha ityAdyayogalakShaNaM, tAlvityAdyatiyogalakShaNam||52-55||-

dhUmanasyayornAsAdvArasAmAnyAddhUmamanu nasyaM brUte- varSha ityAdi| aNUnAM srotasAM hitamityaNutailaM, taccAgre vakShyamANam| shiraHkapAlAnAmeva sirAH sandhayaH snAyukaNDarAshca| uttamA~ggeShviti bahuvacanaM shiraso~abhyarhitatvAt; yadi vA jarA valIpalitAdilakShaNA yA sA uttamA prakarShaprAptA~a~ggeShu mastakAdiShu niShidhyate||56-62||-

candanetyAdau dArvyAstvak dArvItvak, jIvantI suvarNanAlA svanAmaprasiddhA, surabhI shUkashimbA, padmasya kesharaM padmakesharam| mAhendre AntarikShe| shataguNe tailAditi yojyam| dashaguNamityetadapi tailAditi yojanIyam| atra tu kvAthyabheShajaM tAvanmAnaM grAhyaM yAvatA kvAthArthopAttaM pAnIyaM bheShajacaturguNaM bhavati, “kvAthyAccaturguNaM vAri” ityasyAbAdhitatvAt, na tu bheShajAcchataguNe~ambhasItyevaM vyAkhyeyaM; yadAha jatUkarNaH- “paktvA~athAmbushataprasthe dashabhAgasthitena tu| tailaprasthaM pacettena chAgIkShIreNa saMyutam” iti| yadi vA, tailapramANAnumAnenaiva “snehAccaturguNaM kvAthyaM” iti paribhAShayA kvAthyadravyaparimANaM vyavasthApanIyam| picuneti tUlakapiNDikayA| nAvanaistribhiH vAratrayeNetyarthaH| tryahAttryahAditi ekaikaM dinamantarIkRutya, saptAhamiti antaritadinAni varjayitvA; tenaikaikasmin Rutau trayodashAhAnnasyaprayogaH samApyate||63-70||-

sthAnapratyAsattyA dantakAShThaguNAn darshayati- ApothitetyAdi| dvikAlaM sAyaM prAtariti| dantAn punAtIti dantapavanaM dantakAShTham| niShkRuShya malamiti sambandhaH| kakubhaH arjunaH| evaMvidhA evaMrasA ityarthaH||71-75||-
kaTukaM latAkastUrI| yadyapi lava~ggasya vRuntamabhipretaM tathA~api bahUnAM phalasya grAhyatvAcchatriNo gacchantIti nyAyena sAmAnyena phalamityuktam||76-77||

hanvorityAdi snehagaNDUShaguNAH| nityamityAdi niShevaNAdityantaM shirastailaguNAH| mUrdhni tailaniShevaNAdityukte~api snehArdrashirasa iti yat karoti, tena yAvatA tailenArdrashirAH syAttAvanmUrdhni tailaM sevyamiti darshayati| snehAbhya~ggAdityAdi| upA~ggasnehadAnAt, akSho rathasya cakranibandhanakAShTham| bahudRuShTAntakaraNaM tu kasyacit ki~jcit prasiddhaM bhaviShyati na hi sarvaM sarvatra prasiddhamityabhiprAyeNa; yadi vA snehasya nAnAkAryakaraNashaktyupadarshanArtham| sparshane sparshanendriye vAyuradhikaH; vaidyakadarshane pA~jcabhautikatvAdindriyasyetyarthaH| tvacyashca paramabhya~gga iti cakArAdvAtahitashca, etenAshritasya vAtAdhikasya sparshanendriyasya, Ashrayasya ca tvaco hita ityuktaM bhavati| balena sampAdyaM karma balakarma gurubhAraharaNAdi||78-89||

kharatvamityAdi pAdAbhya~ggaguNAH| prathamaM pAdayoriti padaM kharatvAdivisheShaNArthaM, dvitIyaM tu balAdeH kAlAntarotpAdasUcanArthaM, tRutIyaM tu sphuTanavisheShaNArthaM, caturthaM tu sirAsnAyuvisheShaNArthaM, shiShTaM tu pAdAbhya~ggeneti padaM dUrAntaritasya pAdAbhya~ggasya smaraNArtham||90-92||
abhya~ggapUrvakatvAdudvartanasya tamanu parimArjanamudvartanaM brUte- daurgandhyamityAdi| svedena bIbhatsatA svedabIbhatsatA| sharIrasya balena sandhAnaM yojanaM karotItyarthaH||93-94||

shrImaditi shobhAyuktam| pariShadi shastaM pAriShadam| shastaM ma~ggalyam| vyasanaM sarpapishAcAdyabhighAtaH| ratnavadAbharaNAni, ratnaM tu vishuddhamANikyahIrakamuktAphalasuvarNAdi| shaucAdhAnaM pAnIyena mRudA ca| abhIkShNashaH punaH punaH| shuci shucitAkArakam| kalpanaM chedanaM, samprasAdhanaM maNDanam; etacca yathAyogyatayA yojanIyaM; keshAnAM prasAdhanaM samyagbandhanAdi; shmashrUNAM kalpanameva, nakhasya tu kalpanamalaktakAdidAnena prasAdhanaM ca| AdigrahaNena nAsAlomakalpanAdi gRuhyate| pAdayoriti sparshanahitamityanena vyasanApahamityanena ca sambadhyate| pAdatraM pAdadhrI, pAduketi yAvat| atra ca vRuShyatvacakShuShyatve prabhAvAt; yadi vA pAdasambaddhanetrapoShikAnADIpratyavAyaharaNAccakShuShyam| ItI rogAdidurdaivam| guptiH pishAcAdibhyo rakShA, sha~gkaraM kalyANakaram| avaShTambhanaM balapradam| bhayaghnaM sarpAdibhyaH||95-102||

mAtretyAdi adhyAyArthasa~ggrahaH| mAtroktA yAvaddhyasyAshanamityAdinA| tathA dravyANi tatra shAlItyAdinA| mAtrAM cAshritya gurulAghavamiti prakRutilaghUnyapi mAtrAmevApekShante ityevamprakAreNoktam| pAnasya mAnaM pAnamAnam, ApAnAstristrayastraya ityAdi| nastaHkAryaM yaditi aNutailam| yatheti picunetyAdi| yadeti prAvRuTsharadityAdi| sheShaM sugamam||105-111||

vallUraM shuShkamAMsam| nAbhyasenna nirantaramupayu~jjyAt| anabhyAsahetumAha- gauravAditi| mAMsaM kRusham apuShTaM rogAduparatamRugAdisambhavamityarthaH | etaccApathyatvAdeva niShiddhaM, na gauravAditi bruvate| kUrcikaH kShIreNa samaM dadhi takraM vA pakvaM; kilATaH kUrcikapiNDaH, naShTakShIrasya ghano bhAga ityanye| shaukaramiti shUkaramAMsaM, shaukarasAhacaryAdgavyamAhiShe api mAMse eva boddhavye| yavakaH shUkadhAnyavisheShaH| vakShyati hi- “yavakaH shUkadhAnyAnAmapathyatamatve prakRuShTatamo bhavati” (sU.a.25) iti||10-11||
athAtastasyAshitIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
vasante nicitaH shleShmA dinakRudbhAbhirIritaH| kAyAgniM bAdhate rogAMstataH prakurute bahUn||22||
tasmAdvasante karmANi vamanAdIni kArayet| gurvamlasnigdhamadhuraM divAsvapnaM ca varjayet||23||
vyAyAmodvartanaM dhUmaM kavalagrahama~jjanam| sukhAmbunA shaucavidhiM shIlayet kusumAgame||24||
candanAgurudigdhA~ggo yavagodhUmabhojanaH| shArabhaM shAshamaiNeyaM mAMsaM lAvakapi~jjalam||25||
bhakShayennirgadaM sIdhuM pibenmAdhvIkameva vA| vasante~anubhavet strINAM kAnanAnAM ca yauvanam||26||
mayUkhairjagataH snehaM grIShme pepIyate raviH| svAdu shItaM dravaM snigdhamannapAnaM tadA hitam||27||
shItaM sasharkaraM manthaM jA~ggalAnmRugapakShiNaH| ghRutaM payaH sashAlyannaM bhajan grIShme na sIdati||28||
madyamalpaM na vA peyamathavA subahUdakam| lavaNAmlakaTUShNAni vyAyAmaM ca vivarjayet ||29||
divA shItagRuhe nidrAM nishi candrAMshushItale| bhajeccandanadigdhA~ggaH pravAte harmyamastake||30||
vyajanaiH pANisaMsparshaishcandanodakashItalaiH| sevyamAno bhajedAsyAM muktAmaNivibhUShitaH||31||
kAnanAni ca shItAni jalAni kusumAni ca| grIShmakAle niSheveta maithunAdvirato naraH||32||
AdAnadurbale dehe paktA bhavati durbalaH| sa varShAsvanilAdInAM dUShaNairbAdhyate punaH||33||
bhUbAShpAnmeghanisyandAt pAkAdamlAjjalasya ca| varShAsvagnibale kShINe kupyanti pavanAdayaH||34||
tasmAt sAdhAraNaH sarvo vidhirvarShAsu shasyate| udamanthaM divAsvapnamavashyAyaM nadIjalam||35||
vyAyAmamAtapaM caiva vyavAyaM cAtra varjayet| pAnabhojanasaMskArAn prAyaH kShaudrAnvitAn bhajet||36||
vyaktAmlalavaNasnehaM vAtavarShAkule~ahani| visheShashIte bhoktavyaM varShAsvanilashAntaye||37||
agnisaMrakShaNavatA yavagodhUmashAlayaH| purANA jA~ggalairmAMsairbhojyA yUShaishca saMskRutaiH||38||
pibet kShaudrAnvitaM cAlpaM mAdhvIkAriShTamambu vA| mAhendraM taptashItaM vA kaupaM sArasameva vA||39||
pragharShodvartanasnAnagandhamAlyaparo bhavet| laghushuddhAmbaraH sthAnaM bhajedakledi vArShikam||40||
varShAshItocitA~ggAnAM sahasaivArkarashmibhiH| taptAnAmAcitaM pittaM prAyaH sharadi kupyati||41||
tatrAnnapAnaM madhuraM laghu shItaM satiktakam| pittaprashamanaM sevyaM mAtrayA suprakA~gkShitaiH||42||
lAvAn kapi~jjalAneNAnurabhrA~jcharabhAn shashAn| shAlIn sayavagodhUmAn sevyAnAhurghanAtyaye||43||
tiktasya sarpiShaH pAnaM vireko raktamokShaNam| dhArAdharAtyaye kAryamAtapasya ca varjanam||44||
vasAM tailamavashyAyamaudakAnUpamAmiSham| kShAraM dadhi divAsvapnaM prAgvAtaM cAtra varjayet||45||
divA sUryAMshusantaptaM nishi candrAMshushItalam| kAlena pakvaM nirdoShamagastyenAviShIkRutam||46||
haMsodakamiti khyAtaM shAradaM vimalaM shuci| snAnapAnAvagAheShu hitamambu yathA~amRutam ||47||
shAradAni ca mAlyAni vAsAMsi vimalAni ca| sharatkAle prashasyante pradoShe cendurashmayaH||48||

ityuktamRutusAtmyaM yacceShTAhAravyapAshrayam| upashete yadaucityAdokaHsAtmyaM taducyate||49||

Commentary: upasaMharati- ityuktamityAdi| RutusAtmyaprasa~ggenAbhyAsasAtmyaM darshayati- upashete ityAdi| upashete sukhayati, apathyamapi sadvikAraM na janayati| kuta ityAha- aucityAt abhyAsAdityarthaH; apathyamapi hi nirantarAbhyAsAdviShamivAshIviShasya nopaghAtakaM bhavatIti bhAvaH||49||

deshAnAmAmayAnAM ca viparItaguNaM guNaiH| sAtmyamicchanti sAtmyaj~jAshceShTitaM cAdyameva ca||50||

Commentary: deshasAtmyaM rogasAtmyaM ca darshayati- deshAnAmityAdi| deshAnAmanUpAdInAM, guNaiH snehagauravAdibhiH saha viparItaguNaM snehagauravaviparItaguNaraukShyalAghavayuktaM jA~ggalamAMsamadhvAdi; adanIyamAdyaM, ceShTitaM ca vyAyAmAdi, deshasAtmyamicchantyAyurvedavida ityarthaH| evamAmayAnAM ca viparItaguNamityAdi vyAkhyeyam| guNashabdashceha dharmamAtravacanaH, yathocyate- dravyaguNo dravyadharma ityarthaH| tena viparItaprabhAvAdInAmapi grahaNaM bhavati| Amayashabdena cAmayaheturapi gRuhItavyaH| tata AmayaviparItAnAm, AmayahetuviparItAnAM, tathA prabhAvavaiparItyAttadviparItArthakAriNAM ca grahaNaM bhavati| tadudAharaNAni yathAvasaraM nidAne kariShyAmaH| AdyagrahaNenauShadhAhArayorgrahaNaM, ceShTitagrahaNena svapnAbhya~ggAdInAM grahaNaM vyAkhyeyam||50||
