tatra shlokaH- RutAvRutau nRubhiH sevyamasevyaM yacca ki~jcana| tasyAshitIye nirdiShTaM hetumat sAtmyameva ca||51||

Commentary: uktamadhyAyArthamupasaMharati- RutAvityAdi| atra hemante asevyaM kaNTharaveNa yadyapi na pratipAditaM tathA~api ‘sa yadA nendhanaM yuktaM labhate’ ityabhidhAnAdalpabhojanaparihAra ukta eva bhavati; tena, RutAvRutAviti vIpsA kRutA~arthavatI bhavati; yadi vA chatriNo gacchantIti nyAyAdvIpsoktA| hemantaparihAravidhivacca shishiraparihAravidhirvyAkhyeyaH| hetumaditi upapattimat, aucityAdihetunirdeshopapannamityarthaH||51||

tasyAshitAdyAdAhArAdbalaM varNashca vardhate| yasyartusAtmyaM viditaM ceShTAhAravyapAshrayam||3||

Commentary: ashitAdyAditi ashitapItalIDhajagdhAt| balaM varNashceti cakAreNa pUrvAdhyAyoktasukhAyuShI api gRuhyete; yadi vA balavarNAbhyAmeva nAntarIyakaM kRutsnaM dhAtusAmyakAryaM sukhAdi gRuhyate| viditamityanena samyakj~jAnapUrvakamRutusAtmyAnuShThAnaM darshayati| ceShTAgrahaNena vyavAyavyAyAmAbhya~ggAdInAM grahaNam| ceShTAhAravyapAshrayaM ceShTAhAragocaram||3||

iha khalu saMvatsaraM ShaDa~ggamRutuvibhAgena vidyAt| tatrAdityasyodagayanamAdAnaM ca trInRutU~jchishirAdIn grIShmAntAn vyavasyet, varShAdIn punarhemantAntAn dakShiNAyanaM visargaM ca||4||

Commentary: Rutuj~jAnamantarA RutusAtmyaj~jAnaM na sambhavatItyRutUnAmupayuktasvarUpaj~jAnArthamAha- ihetyAdi| RutupratipAdanaprastAve saMvatsaraM vidyAditi saMvatsarapratipAdanamRutUnAmeva militAnAM saMvatsaratvapratipAdanArtham| melakashca buddhyA vyavahriyate , na tu paramArthataH RutUnAM melako~asti| RutUnAM saMvatsarAtmakatvaM punaH punasta evartavaH parAvartanta iti j~jAnArthamavashyaM pratipAdanIyam| iheti iha prakaraNe, ShaDa~ggaM vidyAt; anyatra tu rogabhiShagjitIyAdau tattatkAryavashAdanyathA~api| uktaM ca- “shItoShNavarShalakShaNaH kAla” ityAdi| ShaDa~ggamiti samAhAre dviguH, RutuvyatirekeNa saMvatsarasyAvidyamAnatvAt; yadi vA samudAyibhyo~anyaH samudAya ityAshritya bahuvrIhiH kAryaH| tatreti RutuvibhAgakathane| udag uttarAM dishaM prati, ayanaM gamanamudagayanam| AdadAti kShapayati pRuthivyAH saumyAMshaM prANinAM ca balamityAdAnam| trIn shishirAdInityanenaiva labdhe~api grIShmAntatve grIShmAntAniti shishirasyAdiriti vigrahasya tathA~a~adishabdasya prakAravAcitAyAH pratiShedhArtham| evaM hemantAntAniti ca vyAkhyeyam| dakShiNAM dishaM prati ayanaM dakShiNAyanam| visRujati janayati ApyamaMshaM prANinAM ca balamiti visargaH| sa~jj~jApraNayanaM ca vyavahArArthaM, niruktipratIyamAnArthapratipAdanArthaM ca||4||

visarge punarvAyavo nAtirUkShAH pravAnti, itare punarAdAne; somashcAvyAhatabalaH shishirAbhirbhAbhirApUraya~jjagadApyAyayati shashvat, ato visargaH saumyaH| AdAnaM punarAgneyaM; tAvetAvarkavAyU somashca kAlasvabhAvamArgaparigRuhItAH kAlarturasadoShadehabalanirvRuttipratyayabhUtAH samupadishyante||5||

Commentary: visargadharmaM nirdishati- visarge punarityAdi| yadyapi cAdAnamAdau paThitaM, tathA~api pratilomatantrayuktyA~a~adau visargaguNakathanaM; yadi vA prathamamAdAnasyottarAyaNarUpasya prashastatvAdagre~abhidhAnam, iha tu visargasya balajanakatvenAbhipretatvAdagre~abhidhAnam| nAtirUkShA iti saumyavisargakAlasambandhena mandIkRutaraukShyAH pravAntIti| itare punarAdAna iti aprashAntAtirUkShAshca, AgneyAdAnasambandhAhitarUkShatvAt | somashcetyAdi prakRutena visargeNa sambadhyate| avyAhatabala iti kAlamArgameghavAtAdibhistadA sUryasya somaparipanthino hatabalatvAt| shishirAbhiH shItAbhiH| shashvaditi chedaH| saumyaH somaguNapradhAnaH| Agneyam agniguNapradhAnam, apratihatabalatvenetyarthaH| nanvetAvataivAdityacandravAtAnAM balavattvamabalavattvaM ca kathaM bhavatItyAha- tAvetAvityAdi| kAlo devatArUpaH, sa ca nityarUpo~api prANinAmadRuShTena nAnArUpeNa gRuhItaH san kadAcit sUryabalavAyubalasomabalAdIn karoti; svabhAvaH sUryasya saumyAMshakShayakartRutvAdirvAyorvirUkShaNAdiH somasyApyAyanAdiH; mArgo dakShiNa uttarashca, tatra dakShiNaH karkaTAdayo dhanurantAH, makarAdiruttaraH| ete ca kAlasvabhAvamArgaparigrahA yathAsambhavaM boddhavyAH; na hi some mArgaparigrahaH ka(ki)~jcidvisheShamAvahati, vAyoshca mArgaparigraha eva nAsti| parigRuhItAH sambaddhAH| kAlartvAdInAM nirvRuttipratyayabhUtA niShpattikAraNabhUtAH, upadishyante ‘AcAryaiH’ iti sheShaH; kAlaH saMvatsaro~ayanadvayaM ca, RutavaH shishirAdayaH, dehasya balaM dehabalam| anye tu bruvate- saMvatsarasyAyanadvayasya ca RutumelakarUpatvAdRutugrahaNenaiva grahaNaM labdhaM, tena kAlagrahaNamRutuvisheShaNaM, tena kAlarUpaH Ruturiti strINAmevArtavadarshanaM yadRutustadvyAvartyate| pratyayabhUtA ityatra bhUtashabda upamAne| kecidvyAkhyAnayanti- ‘arkavAyU’ ityekatayA paThitvA ‘somashca’ iti yat pRuthak paThati, tenArkavAyvormilitayorAdAnaM prati kAraNatvaM, visargaM prati pRuthageva somasya kAraNatvamiti darshayati| evaM balaharaNabalakaraNAdiShvapi boddhavyam||5||

tatra ravirbhAbhirAdadAno jagataH snehaM vAyavastIvrarUkShAshcopashoShayantaH shishiravasantagrIShmeShu yathAkramaM raukShyamutpAdayanto rUkShAn rasAMstiktakaShAyakaTukAMshcAbhivardhayanto nRuNAM daurbalyamAvahanti||6||

Commentary: tatretyAdi| AdadAna ucchoShayan| jagataH sthAvaraja~ggamasya| snehaM sAraM saumyabhAgamityarthaH| na kevalaM raviH, vAyavashca shoShayantaH snehamiti sambandhaH| tIvrAshca rUkShAshca tIvrarUkShAH; yadi vA tIvraM raukShyaM yeShAM te tIvrarUkShAH; etaccAdAne tIvreNa raviNA sambandhAdvAyorbhavati yogavAhitvAdvAyoH| uktaM hi- “yogavAhI(haH) paraM vAyuH saMyogAdubhayArthakRut” (ci.a.3) ityAdi| yathAkramamiti shishire raukShyamalpaM tiktaM rasamalpaM ca daurbalyaM, tathA vasante madhyaM raukShyaM kaShAyaM rasaM madhyaM daurbalyaM, tathA grIShme prakRuShTaM raukShyaM kaTukaM rasaM mahacca daurbalyaM darshayati| yadyapi ca kaShAyo raso rUkShatamaH kaTukashca rUkShataraH, yaduktaM- “raukShyAt kaShAyo rUkShANAM pravaro madhyamaH kaTuH” (sU.a.26) ityAdi; raukShyaprakarShashca grIShme, madhyabalaM ca raukShyaM vasante, tathA~api vAyvagniguNabAhulyAt kaTukasya vAyvagniguNabahule grIShmakAla evotpattiH, pavanapRuthivyutkarShavati tu vasante pavanapRuthivyutkarShajanyasya kaShAyasyotpattiH| yaduktaM- “vAyvagniguNabhUyiShThatvAt kaTukaH, pavanapRuthivyatirekAt kaShAyaH” (sU.a.26) iti| pRuthivyAdyutkarShashca kAlavisheShaprabhAvakRutaH kAryadarshanAdunneyaH| abhivardhayanta iti vacanAdyathAsvakAle tiktAdInAmabhivRuddhiH sUcyate, tena na tadaikarasatvam| atra ca kramavadraukShyotpattitiktAdyutpattI api daurbalyotpattau kAraNaM, yato raukShyamutpAdayanta iti tiktakaShAyakaTukAnabhivardhayanta iti ca hetugarbhavisheShaNadvayaM kRutvA daurbalyamAvahantItyuktam||6||

varShAsharaddhemanteShu tu dakShiNAbhimukhe~arke kAlamArgameghavAtavarShAbhihatapratApe, shashini cAvyAhatabale, mAhendrasalilaprashAntasantApe jagati, arUkShA rasAH pravardhante~amlalavaNamadhurA yathAkramaM tatra balamupacIyate nRuNAmiti||7||

Commentary: varShetyAdi| tushabdaH pUrvapakShavyAvRuttau| dakShiNAbhimukhe dakShiNAshAM gantumudyata evArke, tena viShuvadudayopalakShitamadhyadeshAduttareNa vartamAno~api raviryadaiva dakShiNAshAM gantumudyato bhavati tadaiva kShIyamANabalo bhavati, uttarAshAgamanaprakarShAhitabalaprakarShatayA tu stokastokakramApacIyamAnabalo~api tathA durbalo na lakShyate| evamuttarAyaNe~api vyAkhyeyam| kAlaH pUrvaM vyAkhyAtaH, mArga iha dakShiNAbhimukhaH, meghasya vAto meghavAtaH, varShaNaM varShaH, etairabhihatapratApe~arka iti sambandhaH| vAtastviha meghasambandhAhitashaityo~arkatApaparipanthI bhavati, shashino~avyAhatabalatvaM sUryasya paripanthino~abhihatapratApatvAdanuguNameghavAtavarShaNayogAcca| jagati sthAvaraja~ggame| atra ca “pRuthivyagnibhUyiShThatvAdamlaH”, “salilAgnibhUyiShThatvAllavaNaH” (sU.a.26) ityuktaM, tat kathaM saumye visarge tayoshcAgneyayorutpAda iti na vAcyam, yato balaprakarShavato~arkasya kShIyamANabalasyApi viShuvaparyantaM balavattvamastyeveti vyutpAditameva||7||

bhavati cAtra- AdAvante ca daurbalyaM visargAdAnayornRuNAm| madhye madhyabalaM, tvante shreShThamagre ca nirdishet||8||

Commentary: samprati shishirAdau balahrAsaH pratipAdito varShAdau ca balotkarShaH; tatra shishire durbalA varShAsu balavantaH prANino bhavantItyAdidurgrahaM niSheddhumAha- AdAvante cetyAdi| visargasyAdau varShAsu, AdAnasyAnte grIShme, daurbalyaM prakarShaM prAptaM nirdishediti sambandhaH; tathA madhye visargasya sharadi, AdAnasya madhye vasante, madhyaM nAtikShINaM nAtivRuddhaM balaM vinirdishediti yojyaM; tathA~ante visargasya hemante, agre ca prathame AdAnasya shishire, shreShThaM balaM vinirdishediti yojanA| evaM manyate- visargaprakarShAhitabalaprakarShaH puruSha AdAnasyAdau shishire stokakShIyamANabalo~api balavAn bhavati, yathA- pauShamAsAntAhitavRuddhiprakarShA nishA mAghaphAlgunayoH kShIyamANA~api divasAnmahatyeva bhavati| anena nyAyena varShAsu daurbalyaM, vasantasharadoshca madhyamaM balaM boddhavyam| evaM kAlarturasadehabalakAraNatvamarkAdInAM vyavasthApitaM, doShakAraNatvaM tvagre RutuvidhAnanirdeshe~abhidhAsyate||8||
shIte shItAnilasparshasaMruddho balinAM balI| paktA bhavati hemante mAtrAdravyagurukShamaH||9||
sa yadA nendhanaM yuktaM labhate dehajaM tadA| rasaM hinastyato vAyuH shItaH shIte prakupyati||10||
tasmAttuShArasamaye snigdhAmlalavaNAn rasAn| audakAnUpamAMsAnAM medyAnAmupayojayet||11||
bileshayAnAM mAMsAni prasahAnAM bhRutAni ca| bhakShayenmadirAM shIdhuM madhu cAnupibennaraH||12||
gorasAnikShuvikRutIrvasAM tailaM navaudanam| hemante~abhyasyatastoyamuShNaM cAyurna hIyate||13||
abhya~ggotsAdanaM mUrdhni tailaM jentAkamAtapam| bhajedbhUmigRuhaM coShNamuShNaM garbhagRuhaM tathA||14||
shIteShu saMvRutaM sevyaM yAnaM shayanamAsanam| prAvArAjinakauSheyapraveNIkuthakAstRutam||15||
gurUShNavAsA digdhA~ggo guruNA~aguruNA sadA| shayane pramadAM pInAM vishAlopacitastanIm||16||
Ali~ggyAgurudigdhA~ggIM supyAt samadamanmathaH| prakAmaM ca niSheveta maithunaM shishirAgame||17||
varjayedannapAnAni vAtalAni laghUni ca| pravAtaM pramitAhAramudamanthaM himAgame||18||
hemantashishirau tulyau shishire~alpaM visheShaNam| raukShyamAdAnajaM shItaM meghamArutavarShajam||19||
tasmAddhaimantikaH sarvaH shishire vidhiriShyate| nivAtamuShNaM tvadhikaM shishire gRuhamAshrayet||20||
kaTutiktakaShAyANi vAtalAni laghUni ca| varjayedannapAnAni shishire shItalAni ca||21||
mAtrAshitIye mAtrAvadAhArasya balAdihetutvaM pratipAditaM, tacca RutusAtmyamapekShya kRutasyAhArasya bhavati; tena, RutupravibhAgapUrvakamRutusAtmyAbhidhAyakaM tasyAshitIyaM brUte||1-2||

vasanta ityAdinA vasantavidhimAha| nicitaH sa~jcito vasantapUrvakAle, Irito vilAyito vasante| kAyAgnimiti kAyanirvartakamagniM jATharaM, na tu dhAtvagnivisheShamAtram| tata ityatra cakAro luptanirdiShTo boddhavyaH, tena tato~agnivadhAccetyarthaH; yadi vA tato~agnivadhAnantaram| vamanAdIni vamanapradhAnAni; tena, AdAnamadhyatvena yadi vAtapittaprakopastathAvidho bhavati tadA virecanAsthApanAnuvAsanAnAmapi pravRuttirbhavati, shirovirecanaM tu kaphajayArthaM kartavyameva| vasantashabdena vamanaM prati caitra eva boddhavyaH; yena, doShacayAdyarthaM pa~jcakarmapravRuttyarthaM cAbhidhAtavyaprAvRuDAdyRutukrameNa phAlgunacaitrau vasanto bhavati, na vaishAkhaH| anenaivAbhiprAyeNa pUrvashloke~api sAmAnyena nicita iti kRutaM, na tu hemante nicita iti; hemanta ityukte hi rasotpattikramAbhihitamArgashIrShapauShAtmake hemante prakRutatvAddoShacayo budhyate, sa ca nAbhipretaH; uktastu doShacayAdikramoktapauShamAghAtmake hemante shleShmacayaH| sukhAmbunA sukhoShNAmbunA| lAvakapi~jjalaM mAMsamiti sambandhaH| bhakShayediti cchedaH| anubhavediti bhAShayA shleShmakShayArthaM stokaM maithunamanujAnAti||22-26||

mayUkhairityAdinA graiShmavidhimAha| mayUkhaiH tejobhiH| snehaH sAra ityarthaH| pepIyate atyarthaM pibati| manthaH- “saktavaH sarpiShA yuktAH shItavAripariplutAH| nAtyacchA nAtisAndrAshca mantha ityabhidhIyate”| madyamalpamiti ekAntamadyasAtmyena; naveti madyasya svabhAvapAkAbhyAmamlasya grIShmaviruddhatvena; subahUdakamiti madyasAtmyasyaiva, madyasyoShNAmlatvAdyapavAdArthaM bahutaraM pAnIyaM prakShipya pAtavyamiti darshayati; tenaitat phalati- yanmadyaM grIShme na pAtavyameva tAvat; madyasAtmyAnAM sAtmyamadyatyAge sAtmyatyAgajA rogA bhavanti, tena tasyAlpaM vA subahUdakaM vA deyamityarthaH| muktaiva maNirmuktAmaNiH| grIShmakAle caNDAtape madhyAhna ityarthaH| maithunoparatistu divAnishaM boddhavyA||27-32||

varShAvidhimAha- AdAnetyAdi| dehasya durbalatve paktA~api durbalo bhavati, dehabalAnuvidhAyitvAdvahneH| etacca balinAM balI bhavatItyatra vyutpAditam| sa durbalo vahniH| anilAdInAmiti anilapradhAnAnAm| varShAsu vAtAdayaH kutaH kupyantItyAha- bhUbAShpAdityAdi| bhUbAShpaH prabhAvAdeva tridoShakopakaH| meghanisyando vAtashleShmakArakaH| amlapAkatA jalasya varShAsvabhAvakRutA pittashleShmakarI| agnibale kShINa ityanenAdAnAhitamagnimAndyamapi doShaprakopakamiti darshayati| agnimAndyaM cApAkavidAhAbhyAM kaphapittakAri, dhAtupoShakarasAnutpAdAcca dhAtukShayeNa vAtakAri| etena varShAsu vahnimAndyena vAtAdikopaH, vAtAdikopena ca vahnimAndyamiti darshitam| yaduktaM vAgbhaTe- “bhUbAShpeNAmlapAkena malinena ca vAriNA| vahninaiva ca mandena teShvityanyo~anyadUShiShu|| sAdhAraNo vidhiH kAryastridoShaghno~agnidIpanaH” (vA.sU.a.3) iti| udakapradhAno mantha udamanthaH| pAnam udakAdi, bhojanaM raktashAlyAdi, tayoH saMskArAH saMskAravantyannapAnAnItyarthaH| kShaudraM ca yadyapi vAtaprakopi, tathA~api vArShikakledashamanArthaM svalpamAtrayA kShaudrAnvitapadena vihitam| visheShashIta iti hetugarbhavisheShaNaM; tenAtyarthashIte divase yasmAnmahAtyayasya vAtasya kopo bhavati tatastajjayArthaM varShAkAlaprabhAvakriyamANapittacayAnuguNayorapyamlalavaNayorupayogaH kartavya iti darshitaM bhavati||33-40||

sharadvidhimAha- varShetyAdi| ucitam abhyastam, ‘uca samavAye’ ityasmAddhAtoH; shItamucitAnya~ggAni yeShAM, teShAm| sahasaiveti padenAkrameNa sharadi tIvrAtapasambandhAdanabhyastAt pittaprakopo nyAyya iti darshayati| Acitamiti varShAsu| prAya ityanena varShAsu pittacayapratikUlaM vidhiM prayatnenAcarato na bhavatyapi pittacayaH, sharadi tu prakopo na bhavatIti darshayati; etacca sAmAnyanyAyena shleShmaNo vAtasya ca cayaprakopayorboddhavyaM; yadi vA, prAyaH pittaM prakupyati shleShmA cAnubalatvenetyarthaH| yaduktaM- “tasya cAnubalaH kaphaH” (ci.a.3) iti| laghviti agnisandhukShaNArtham| atra vahneH samAnenApi pittena dravAMshasambandhenAgnimAndyaM kriyate| yaduktaM grahaNyadhyAye- “AplAvayaddhantyanalaM jalaM taptamivAnalam” (ci.a.15)| utsargasiddha eva bhojanasya mAtrAvattve mAtrayeti vacanaM mAtrAtikrameNeha visheShato bhUridoShatvadarshanArtham| suprakA~gkShitaiH sububhukShitaiH| urabhro meShaH| ghanAtyaya iti punarvacanaM sharatpravesha evaitaduktavidhikaraNaM granthAdhikyAt sUcayatIti vyAkhyAnayanti; vayaM tu pashyAmaH- paryAyashabdAnAM punaH punaH karaNe yatra tAtparyaM shAstre pratIyate tatra tadeva vAcyaM, yatra tu tAtparyAntaraM na pratIyate tatra vAkyabhedenaiva punarabhidhAnamiti| dhArAdharANAM meghAnAmatyayo~adarshanam| tena, pravyaktAyAM sharadi tiktasarpiHpAnaM virekAdi ca kAryam| kramashcAtrAcAryasyAbhipretaH, tena prathamaM tiktasarpiShpAnaM, tena pittAprashAntau virekaH, tenApyashAntau shoNitaduShTau ca satyAM raktamokShaNaM; raktaM cAtra kAlasvabhAvAddUShyatyeva prAyaH; yadAha- “sharatkAlasvabhAvAcca shoNitaM sampradUShyati” (sU.a.24) iti| divetyAdi|- sUryAMshutApAdeva diveti labdhe diveti sakaladinavyAptyartham| sUryataptamiti vaktavyeM~ashugrahaNaM meghAvaraNarahitAMshusUryagrahaNArtham | santaptamityatra saMshabdaH paritastApopadarshanArthaH| evaM nishItyAdi ca vyAkhyeyam| candrAMshugrahaNena ca nishi saumyAMshasambandhaM lakShayati| kAleneti sharatkAlasvabhAvena| pakvamiti varShAsvabhinavabhUmisambandhajanitapaicchilyavyamlatvAdidoSharahitam| yataH pakvaM tato nirdoShaM doShAjanakamityarthaH| agastyenAviShIkRutamityagastyodayena prabhAvAdvarShAsu meghasambaddhoragalUtAdisambandhAtsaviShamaviShaM bhavatIti vAcyam| haMsodakamiti evambhUtodakasya sa~jj~jA; haMsashabdena sUryAcandramasAvabhidhIyete, tAbhyAM shodhitamudakaM haMsodakaM; yadi vA haMsasevAyogyaM haMsodakaM, haMsAH kila vishuddhamevodakaM bhajante| avagAhaH ciraM jalAvasthAnam| shAradAnIti mAlyavisheShaNamanArtavakusumaniShedhArtham| pradoSha iti nishApravesha eva paraM candrarashmisevA; nopari, shishirabhayAt| atra pUrvartusAtmyaparityAgo bhaviShyadRutusAtmyAbhyAsashca pUrvartvantasaptAhAgAmyRutvAdisaptAhayoH kartavyaH| yaduktaM vAgbhaTe- “RutvorantyAdisaptAhAvRutusandhiriti smRutaH| tatra pUrvo vidhistyAjyaH sevanIyaH paraH kramAt” (vA.sU.a.3) iti||41-48||

vardhamAnabalaprakarShavattayA hemantasyAbhipretatvAttatsAtmyamevAgre prAha- shIta ityAdinA| shIte shItaguNayukte hemante, yadyapi cAnukte shIta iti visheShaNe hemantaH shIta eva labhyate, tathA~api na pUrvaM kvaciddhemante shItatvaM pratipAditamiti pratipAdyate; yadi vA yadaiva hemante shItaM mahadbhavati tadaiva visheSheNa vahnirbalI bhavati, nopakramamAtreNApi, RutuvyApattau shItAyoga iti ca shIta iti padena labhyate| himasambandhAdvisheSheNa shIto~anilaH shItAnilaH; visheSheNa shItatvaM vAyoryogavAhitvAcchItakAlasambandhAdeva labdhaM punarabhidhIyate~agnisaMrodhahetutvAt | vAyurhi himasambandhAdeva bahirnirgacchaccharIroShmaNo rodhaM kRutvA kumbhakArapavanAhitapa~gkalepa ivAntarasya vahnervRuddhimAvahati| etena yaducyate- asamAnAcchItavAtAt kathamagnivRuddhirityetadapAstam| nahyatra shIto vAto~agnitvena pariNamate, kiM tarhi nirgacchattejaHpratIpIbhUtaH| shItAnilasya sparshaH sharIrasambandha ityarthaH| balinAM prANinAM hemantasvabhAvAdbalI bhavati; anena prANibalavattvamagnibalavattve heturiti darshayati| uktaM ca hastivaidyake bAlagajAnAM nIrogatvapratipAdane; yathA- “avyAhatAdabhiprAyAt prItiH, prIterbalaM, balAt| agniragneshca dhAtUnAM balaM , nAshastato rujAm” iti| mAtrayA yad guru atimAtramityarthaH, dravyatashca dravyasvabhAvatashca yad guru navadhAnyAdi, tatkShamaH| evambhUto balI vahniryadA yuktaM gurubhUtaM cAnnaM na labhate, tadA dehajaM rasaM hinasti kShayaM nayati; dehArthaM dehajAtaM vA dehajaM dhAturUpaM rasamityarthaH| ata indhanAbhAve sati rasadhAtukShayAdvAyuH prakupyati hemante| hetvantaramAha vAtakope- shItaH shIta iti; yasmAdayaM shItaguNo vAyuH, tasmAcchItakAle hemantalakShaNe samAnaM kAraNamAsAdya kupyatItyarthaH| atra vRuddho vAyurmedasvino yathA~agnivRuddhiM karoti, na tu vaiShamyamanativRuddhatvAt, tathA~agnivRuddhimeva karoti| yaduktaM- “medasA~a~avRutamArgatvAdvAyuH koShThe visheShataH| caran sandhukShayatyagnimAhAraM shoShayatyapi” (sU.a.21) ityAdinA~aShTauninditIye| tasmAditi dehajarasakShayabhayAt| prakaraNalabdhe~api tuShArasamaya iti yat punaH karoti, tadvisheSheNa tuShArapAte visheSheNa snigdhAdInAM bhojanArtham| medyAnAM medurANAm| audakAnUpamAMsAdayashca hemantakAlakaphacayasaMvardhakA api mahAtyayavAtavikArapratipakShatvena vyavAyAdikaphacayapratipakShayuktatvAccAbhipretAH | audakAH kUrmAdayo~annapAne vakShyamANAH, anUpAH sRumarakhaDgAdayaH, bileshayA godhAprabhRutayaH, prasahA gokharAdayaH| bhRutaM bhaTTitramiti prasiddham| hemante~abhyasyata iti punarhemantagrahaNaM hemantaM vyApyaivoShNodakasevopadarshanArtham| jentAkaH svedavisheSho vakShyamANaH| garbhagRuhaM gRuhakoShThakam| hemanta ityanenArthalabdhe~api shIte shIteShviti padaM varShAkAlAdAvapi shItaprAptau saMvRutayAnAdisevopadarshanArtham| prAvAro guruprAvaraNaM kambalAdi, ajinaM vyAghrAdicarma, kauSheyaM koShakArakITatantumayaM, praveNI goNIti prasiddhA, kuthakashcitrakambalaH| guruNA~aguruNeti agurughanapralepenetyarthaH| vishAlAvAyAmena, upacitau pariNAhena| maithunasevopadeshashceha prANinAM balavattvena shItapratIkArakatvena cIyamAnakaphaviruddhatvena ca; sushrute~api hemante maithunasevoktA; yaduktaM- “tatrApanItahArAshca priyA nAryaH svala~gkRutAH| ramayeyuryathAkAmaM balAdapi madotkaTAH” iti||9-18||

shishiravidhimAha- hemantetyAdi| visheShaNaM visheShaH; shishirasyAdAnArambhatvena raukShyaM, tathA meghamArutavarShAH shishire~adhikA bhavanti tajjaM ca shItamadhikaM hemantAdastItyarthaH| tasmAditi hemantatulyatvAdvishiShTaraukShyashItayuktatvAcca haimantiko vidhiH| nivAtamuShNaM tviti tushabdaH pakShAntaraparigrahArthaH; hemantoktanivAtoShNagRuhAcchishire rUkShAtishIte~adhikamuShNaM gRuhamAshrayedityabhiprAyaH| kecidatrAsevyapratipAdakaM granthaM paThanti, sa tvanArShaH||19-21||
(ativyavAyabhArAdhvakarmabhishcAtikarshitAH | krodhashokabhayAyAsaiH krAntA ye cApi mAnavAH||1||
lAghavaM karmasAmarthyaM sthairyaM duHkhasahiShNutA | doShakShayo~agnivRuddhishca vyAyAmAdupajAyate||32||
shramaH klamaH kShayastRuShNA raktapittaM pratAmakaH| ativyAyAmataH kAso jvarashchardishca jAyate||33||

vyAyAmahAsyabhAShyAdhvagrAmyadharmaprajAgarAn| nocitAnapi seveta buddhimAnatimAtrayA||34||

Commentary: idAnIM vyAyAmatulyatvenAnyAnapyatimAtratvena niSheddhumAha- vyAyAmetyAdi| yadyapyativyAyAmo niShiddhastathA~apIha punarabhidhIyate atibhAShyAdiShvapi taddoShashramaklamAdiprAptyarthaM; yadi vA pUrvamanabhyastavyAyAmAtisevA niShiddhA, iha tu abhyastasyApi niShedhaH| yadAha- nocitAnapi; ucitAnapyabhyastAnapItyarthaH| apishabdAdanabhyastAnAM nitarAM niShedho labhyate| bhAShaNaM bhAShyam, adhvashabdenAdhvagamanaM, grAmyadharmo maithunam||34||

etAnevaMvidhAMshcAnyAn yo~atimAtraM niShevate| gajaM siMha ivAkarShan sahasA sa vinashyati||35||

Commentary: evaMshabdena gurubhAraharaNadarpashilAcAlanAdi gRuhyate| siMhaH kila svalpapramANaH svabalodrekAdgajaM karShan pATayan svadehAnucitavyAyAmAt pashcAdvAtakShobheNa vipadyate, tenAyaM dRuShTAntaH sa~ggatArthaH; yadi vA siMho~aShTApado~abhipretaH, sa ca kila gajaM vyApAdya pRuShThe kShipati, tatastatkothAdvipadyate, tena dRuShTAnto vyAkhyeyaH||35||
bAlavRuddhapravAtAshca ye coccairbahubhAShakAH| te varjayeyurvyAyAmaM kShudhitAstRuShitAshca ye||2||)
ucitAdahitAddhImAn kramasho viramennaraH| hitaM krameNa seveta kramashcAtropadishyate||36||
prakShepApacaye tAbhyAM kramaH pAdAMshiko bhavet| ekAntaraM tatashcordhvaM dvyantaraM tryantaraM tathA||37||

krameNApacitA doShAH krameNopacitA guNAH| santo yAntyapunarbhAvamaprakampyA bhavanti ca||38||

Commentary: evaM kRute kiM syAdityAha- krameNetyAdi| krameNeti krameNaiva| doShA iti doShajanakAnyabhyastAnyapathyAni| guNA iti guNajanakAni pathyAni| apunarbhAvaM yAnti doShA iti sambandhaH| akrameNa tu sahasA~apathyatyAge doShA bhavantyeva| yaduktam- “asAtmyajA hi rogAH syuH sahasA tyAgashIlanAt” (vA.sU.a.3) iti| aprakampyA apracAlyA bhavanti guNA iti sambandhaH| pathyamapi hyanabhyastaM sahasopayujyamAnamarucyagnivadhAdI~jjanayati||38||
samapittAnilakaphAH kecidgarbhAdi mAnavAH| dRushyante vAtalAH kecitpittalAH shleShmalAstathA||39||
teShAmanAturAH pUrve vAtalAdyAH sadAturAH| doShAnushayitA hyeShAM dehaprakRutirucyate||40||

viparItaguNasteShAM svasthavRuttervidhirhitaH| samasarvarasaM sAtmyaM samadhAtoH prashasyate||41||

Commentary: teShAmiti sadAturANAM vAtalAdInAm| viparItaguNo vAtAdigataraukShyAdiviparItasnehAdiguNa ityarthaH| samAH sarve rasA yatra tattathA; samatvaM cehAnurUpatvamabhipretaM, natu tulyamAnatvaM; na hi svasthabhojane yAvAnmadhura upayujyate, tAvanmAnAH kaTvAdayo~apIti; yadi vA samashabdo~aviruddhavacanaH, tenopodikAmatsyAdipratipAdanIyaviruddharasavarjitaM sarvarasamityarthaH| evaM ca prakRutyapekShaH samadhAtuM prati sarvarasopayogaH Rutuvihitena tasmAttuShArasamaye snigdhAmlalavaNAn rasAn (sU. a.6) ityAdinA visheShavidhAnena yuktaH san sarvarasamevAmlalavaNarasotkaTaM bhojanaM hemante phalati; vAtaprakRutestu kaTutiktakaShAyavarjitaM prabhUtamadhurAmlalavaNabhojanaM hemante bhavati; evamanyatrApi dehaprakRutyRutusvabhAvaparyAlocanayA~anuguNaM tarkaNIyam| yaduktaM vAgbhaTena- “nityaM sarvarasAbhyAsaH svasvAdhikyamRutAvRutau” (vA.sU.a.3) iti||41||
dve adhaH sapta shirasi khAni svedamukhAni ca| malAyanAni bAdhyante duShTairmAtrAdhikairmalaiH||42||
malavRuddhiM gurutayA lAghavAnmalasa~gkShayam| malAyanAnAM budhyeta sa~ggotsargAdatIva ca||43||

tAn doShali~ggairAdishya vyAdhIn sAdhyAnupAcaret| vyAdhihetupratidvandvairmAtrAkAlau vicArayan||44||

Commentary: tAniti malavRuddhikShayAtmakAn malavRuddhikShayajanitAniti yAvat, doShANAM vAtAdInAM, li~ggaiH kShayavRuddhisambandhaiH, Adishya buddhvA, ye sAdhyAstAnupAcaret| vyAdhipratidvandvaiH vyAdhipratyanIkaiH, hetupratidvandvaiH hetupratyanIkaiH; pratidvandvashabdena ca viparItArthakAriNAmapi grahaNam| mAtrAkAlagrahaNaM ca prAdhAnyAt; tena, doShabheShajAdInAmapi grahaNaM boddhavyaM; yadi vA kAlagrahaNa eva doShAdInAmavarodho vyAkhyeyaH||44||
viShamasvasthavRuttAnAmete rogAstathA~apare| jAyante~anAturastasmAt svasthavRuttaparo bhavet||45||
mAdhavaprathame mAsi nabhasyaprathame punaH| sahasyaprathame caiva hArayeddoShasa~jcayam||46||
snigdhasvinnasharIrANAmUrdhvaM cAdhashca nityashaH| bastikarma tataH kuryAnnasyakarma ca buddhimAn||47||
yathAkramaM yathAyogyamata UrdhvaM prayojayet| rasAyanAni siddhAni vRuShyayogAMshca kAlavit||48||
rogAstathA na jAyante prakRutistheShu dhAtuShu| dhAtavashcAbhivardhante jarA mAndyamupaiti ca||49||
vidhireSha vikArANAmanutpattau nidarshitaH| nijAnAmitareShAM tu pRuthagevopadekShyate||50||
na vegAn dhArayeddhImA~jjAtAn mUtrapurIShayoH| na retaso na vAtasya na chardyAH kShavathorna ca||3||
nodgArasya na jRumbhAyA na vegAn kShutpipAsayoH| na bAShpasya na nidrAyA niHshvAsasya shrameNa ca||4||
ye bhUtaviShavAyvagnisamprahArAdisambhavAH| nRuNAmAgantavo rogAH praj~jA teShvaparAdhyati||51||
IrShyAshokabhayakrodhamAnadveShAdayashca ye| manovikArAste~apyuktAH sarve praj~jAparAdhajAH||52||
tyAgaH praj~jAparAdhAnAmindriyopashamaH smRutiH| deshakAlAtmavij~jAnaM sadvRuttasyAnuvartanam||53||
AgantUnAmanutpattAveSha mArgo nidarshitaH| prAj~jaH prAgeva tat kuryAddhitaM vidyAdyadAtmanaH||54||

Aptopadeshapraj~jAnaM pratipattishca kAraNam| vikArANAmanutpattAvutpannAnAM ca shAntaye||55||

Commentary: atha kiM hitamityAha- Aptopadesha ityAdi| AptA j~jAnavanto rAgadveSharahitAH puruShAH, yadvakShyati- “rajastamobhyAM nirmuktAH” (sU.a.11) ityAdi; pratipattirupadiShTArthasya samyagavabodhaH; etaddvayaM kAraNaM vikArANAmanutpattau hetuvarjanena, utpannAnAM ca shAntaye kAraNaM taccikitsAnuShThAnenetyarthaH||55||
pApavRuttavacaHsattvAH sUcakAH kalahapriyAH| marmopahAsino lubdhAH paravRuddhidviShaH shaThAH||56||
parApavAdaratayashcapalA ripusevinaH| nirghRuNAstyaktadharmANaH parivarjyA narAdhamAH||57||
buddhividyAvayaHshIladhairyasmRutisamAdhibhiH| vRuddhopasevino vRuddhAH svabhAvaj~jA gatavyathAH||58||
sumukhAH sarvabhUtAnAM prashAntAH shaMsitavratAH| sevyAH sanmArgavaktAraH puNyashravaNadarshanAH||59||

AhArAcAraceShTAsu sukhArthI pretya ceha ca| paraM prayatnamAtiShThedbuddhimAn hitasevane||60||

Commentary: AhArAcAraceShTAsviti nirdhAraNe saptamI, tenAhArAcAraceShTAnAM madhye yaddhitaM tasya sevane prayatnamAtiShThediti phalati; AcAraH shAstravihitamanuShThAnam||60||
na naktaM dadhi bhu~jjIta na cApyaghRutasharkaram| nAmudgayUShaM nAkShaudraM noShNaM nAmalakairvinA ||61||
jvarAsRukpittavIsarpakuShThapANDvAmayabhramAn| prApnuyAtkAmalAM cogrAM vidhiM hitvA dadhipriyaH||62||
tatra shlokAH- vegA vegasamutthAshca rogAsteShAM ca bheShajam| yeShAM vegA vidhAryAshca yadarthaM yaddhitAhitam||63||
ucite cAhite varjye sevye cAnucite kramaH| yathAprakRuti cAhAro malAyanagadauShadham||64||
bhaviShyatAmanutpattau rogANAmauShadhaM ca yat| varjyAH sevyAshca puruShA dhImatA~a~atmasukhArthinA||65||
vidhinA dadhi sevyaM ca yena yasmAttadatrijaH| navegAndhAraNe~adhyAye sarvamevAvadanmuniH||66||
etAn dhArayato jAtAn vegAn rogA bhavanti ye| pRuthakpRuthakcikitsArthaM tAnme nigadataH shRuNu||5||
bastimehanayoH shUlaM mUtrakRucchraM shirorujA | vinAmo va~gkShaNAnAhaH syAlli~ggaM mUtranigrahe||6||
svedAvagAhanAbhya~ggAn sarpiShashcAvapIDakam | mUtre pratihate kuryAttrividhaM bastikarma ca||7||
pakvAshayashiraHshUlaM vAtavarco~apravartanam | piNDikodveShTanAdhmAnaM purIShe syAdvidhArite||8||
svedAbhya~ggAvagAhAshca vartayo bastikarma ca| hitaM pratihate varcasyannapAnaM pramAthi ca||9||
meDhre vRuShaNayoH shUlama~ggamardo hRudi vyathA| bhavet pratihate shukre vibaddhaM mUtrameva ca||10||
tatrAbhya~ggo~avagAhashca madirA caraNAyudhAH| shAliH payo nirUhashca shastaM maithunameva ca||11||
sa~ggo viNmUtravAtAnAmAdhmAnaM vedanA klamaH| jaThare vAtajAshcAnye rogAH syurvAtanigrahAt||12||
snehasvedavidhistatra vartayo bhojanAni ca| pAnAni bastayashcaiva shastaM vAtAnulomanam||13||
kaNDUkoThArucivya~ggashothapANDvAmayajvarAH| kuShThahRullAsavIsarpAshchardinigrahajA gadAH||14||
bhuktvA pracchardanaM dhUmo la~gghanaM raktamokShaNam| rUkShAnnapAnaM vyAyAmo virekashcAtra shasyate||15||
manyAstambhaH shiraHshUlamarditArdhAvabhedakau| indriyANAM ca daurbalyaM kShavathoH syAdvidhAraNAt||16||
tatrordhvajatruke~abhya~ggaH svedo dhUmaH sanAvanaH| hitaM vAtaghnamAdyaM ca ghRutaM cauttarabhaktikam||17||
hikkA shvAso~aruciH kampo vibandho hRudayorasoH| udgAranigrahAttatra hikkAyAstulyamauShadham||18||
vinAmAkShepasa~gkocAH suptiH kampaH pravepanam| jRumbhAyA nigrahAttatra sarvaM vAtaghnamauShadham||19||
kArshyadaurbalyavaivarNyama~ggamardo~arucirbhramaH| kShudveganigrahAttatra snigdhoShNaM laghu bhojanam||20||
kaNThAsyashoSho bAdhiryaM shramaH sAdo hRudi vyathA| pipAsAnigrahAttatra shItaM tarpaNamiShyate||21||
pratishyAyo~akShirogashca hRudrogashcArucirbhramaH| bAShpanigrahaNAttatra svapno madyaM priyAH kathAH||22||
jRumbhA~a~ggamardastandrA ca shirorogo~akShigauravam| nidrAvidhAraNAttatra svapnaH saMvAhanAni ca||23||
gulmahRudrogasammohAH shramaniHshvAsadhAraNAt| jAyante tatra vishrAmo vAtaghnyashca kriyA hitAH||24||
veganigrahajA rogA ya ete parikIrtitAH| icchaMsteShAmanutpattiM vegAnetAnna dhArayet||25||

imAMstu dhArayedvegAn hitArthI pretya ceha ca| sAhasAnAmashastAnAM manovAkkAyakarmaNAm||26||

Commentary: vegAnAmavidhAryatvenoktatvAllobhAdInAmapi vegA avidhAryAH syurityAha- imAMstvityAdi| pretya janmAntare| iheti iha janmani| sahasA AtmashaktimanAlocya kriyata iti sAhasaM, tattu gajAbhimukhadhAvanAdi| ashastAnAm aprashastAnAmaniShTaphalAnAmiti yAvat| manovAkkAyakarmaNAmityatra karmashabdo vyApAravacanaH||26||

lobhashokabhayakrodhamAnavegAn vidhArayet| nairlajjyerShyAtirAgANAmabhidhyAyAshca buddhimAn||27||

Commentary: ashastaM manasaH karma darshayati- lobhetyAdi| lobhaH viShaye~anucitA prArthanA, shokaH putrAdivinAshajaM dainyam, bhayam apakArakAnusandhAnajaM dainyam, krodhaH pradveSho yena prajvalitamivAtmAnaM manyate, mAnaH sadasadguNAdhyAropeNAtmanyutkarShapratyayaH| jugupsitagopanecchA lajjA, tadabhAvo nairlajjyaM; samAne dravye parasambandhapratiShedhecchA IrShyA; atirAga ucita eva viShaye punaH punaH pravartanecchA| abhidhyA manasA parAbhidrohacintanaM, yadi vA paradravyaviShaye spRuhA||27||

paruShasyAtimAtrasya sUcakasyAnRutasya ca| vAkyasyAkAlayuktasya dhArayedvegamutthitam||28||

Commentary: ashastaM vacanakarmAha- paruShasyetyAdi| paruShaM parodvejakaM vacanam| atimAtraM bahu| sUcakaM parAniShTajanakAbhidhAyakam | anRutam apArthakam| akAlayuktam aprastAvAgatam||28||

dehapravRuttiryA kAcidvidyate parapIDayA| strIbhogasteyahiMsAdyA tasyAvegAnvidhArayet||29||

Commentary: ashastaM dehakarmAha- dehetyAdi| parapIDayA parapIDAnimittamityarthaH| strIbhogaH parastrIbhogaH, steyaM paradravyagrahaNaM, hiMsA vidhirahitA prANipIDA; AdigrahaNAdgurvAdyabhimukhapAdaprasAraNAdi gRuhyate||29||

puNyashabdo vipApatvAnmanovAkkAyakarmaNAm| dharmArthakAmAn puruShaH sukhI bhu~gkte cinoti ca||30||

Commentary: evaM kRute yadbhavati taddarshayati- puNyetyAdi| puNyaH pAvanaH shabdo yasyAsau puNyashabdaH| bhu~gkte cinoti ceti utpannAdavirodhataH phalopayogena bhu~gkte; cinoti cotpAdayati cAparAnityarthaH||30||

sharIraceShTA yA ceShTA sthairyArthA balavardhinI| dehavyAyAmasa~gkhyAtA mAtrayA tAM samAcaret||31||

Commentary: avidhAryapravRuttInmUtrAdIn vidhAryapravRuttIn sAhasAdIMshca darshayitvA vidhAryAvidhAryapravRuttiM vyAyAmamAha- sharIretyAdi| dehasya vyAyAmo dehavyAyAmaH, dehagrahaNAnmanovyAyAmaM cintanAdi nirAkaroti; sa~gkhyAtA sa~jj~jitA| yA ca iShTA abhipretA, etena bhAraharaNAdyA~aniShTA kAryavashAt kriyamANA ceShTA nirasyate, ca~gkramaNarUpA tu kriyA prApyate| sthairyaM sthiratA sharIrasya, tadarthA| mAtrayA anapAyiparimANena; etAvatI ceyaM sharIraceShTA mAtrAvatI yAvatyA lAghavAdayo vakShyamANA bhavanti, ceShTAtiyogavakShyamANAshca shramabhramAdayo na bhavanti| sushrute~apyuktaM- “yattu ca~gkramaNaM nAtidehapIDAkaraM bhavet| tadAyurbalamedhAgnipradamindriyabodhanam” (su.ci.a.24) iti||31||

pUrvAdhyAyAbhyAM svasthahita AhAraH prAdhAnyenoktaH, tasya cAhArasya svasthahitatvamAhArapAkajamUtrapurIShANAmavidhAritavegAnAM bahirgamane sati bhavatIti mUtrAdivegAvidhAraNopadeshakaM na vegAndhAraNIyamAha| ihApi navegadhAraNashabdasyAbhAvAnmAtrAshitIyavat paryAyashabdena sa~jj~jA boddhavyA||1-2||

yathoktavyAyAmaguNAnAha- lAghavamityAdi| doShakShayo~atra shleShmakShayo~abhipretaH; yadi vA~agnikartRutvena tridoShakShayo~api| uktaM hi- “shamaprakopau doShANAM sarveShAmagnisaMshritau” iti| vyAyAmAtipravRuttidoShamAha- shrama ityAdi| klama iha mana-indriyaglAniH| kShayo dhAtukShayaH| pratamaka eva pratAmakaH shvAsavisheShaH||32-33||

hitasya sevanamahitasya parityAgaH kartavya iti pUrvamuktaM, tacca hitasevanamahitaparivarjanaM cAkrameNa kriyamANamakramAcaritavyAyAmAdivat pratyavAyakaraM paraM bhavati, atastatkramamAha- ucitAdityAdi| ucitAt abhyastAt| kramasho vakShyamANena krameNa| hitam anabhyastahitam| ko~asau krama ityAha- kramashcetyAdi| prakShepo hitasya, apacayo~ahitasya, tAbhyAM hitAhitAbhyAm| pAdaH caturtho bhAgaH, tadrUpoM~ashaH pAdAMshaH, tena kRutaH kramaH pAdAMshikaH; anye tu pAdasyAMshaH pAdAMsha iti ShoDashaM bhAgaM varNayanti | sa ca hitAhitayoryugapatprakShepApacaye pAdAMshikaH kramaH, prathamamekAntaramekAhamantarA kRutvetyarthaH; tataH prathamahitapAdaprakShepAhitapAdApacayAbhyAsAdUrdhvaM dvitIyapAdaprakShepApacaye dvyantaraM dvyahamantarIkRutya kramo bhavet; tathA dvitIyapAdAbhyAsAdUrdhvaM tRutIyapAdaprakShepApacaye tryahamantarIkRutya kramo bhavet; caturthapAdaprakShepApacaye tu kAlaniyamo nAsti, ata UrdhvaM prakShepApacayAbhAvAccatuShpAdasampUrNasya pathyasyAnavadhisevyatvAt| ayaM piNDArthaH- apathyA yavakAdayo~abhyastAste tyAjyAH, raktashAlyAdayaH pathyA anabhyastAste sevyAH; tatra prathamadine yavakapAdatrayaM raktashAlInAmekaH pAdaH ; dvitIye divase dvau pathyasya pAdau dvAvapathyasya, evaM tRutIye, evaM dvitIyapAdAbhyAso dvyantaro bhavati; caturthe trayaH pAdAH pathyasya eko~apathyasya, evaM pa~jcame ShaShThe ca, evaM tRutIyapAdAbhyAsastryantaro bhavati; saptadinaprabhRuti tu catuShpAdapathyAbhyAsaH| yadi vA~antarashabdo vyavadhivacanaH, tathAshabdAccaturantaramiti ca labhyate; tenAyamarthaH- prathame divase~apathyapAdatrayaM pathyasyaikaH pAdaH, dvitIye sarvamapathyaM, tRutIye dvau pathyasya dvAvapathyasya, evaM caturthe; pa~jcame tu dine pathyasya bhAga ekastrayo~apathyasya, evaM dvyantarIkRutau bhavataH; ShaShThe pathyabhAgatrayamapathyabhAga ekaH, evaM saptame~aShTame ca; tato navame bhAgadvayaM pathyasya cApathyasya ca, evaM trINyahAnyantarIkRutAni bhavanti; tato dashame sarvaM pathyam, evamekAdashe dvAdashe trayodashe ca, caturdashe tu pathyabhAgatrayameko~apathyabhAgaH; evaM caturantaratA tathAshabdasUcitA bhavati; pa~jcadashAhAt prabhRuti sampUrNapathyataiva||36-37||

iha svasthahitaM sAmAnyenaiva raktashAlyAdi pratipAditaM, svasthashca prakRutibhedena nAnAprakAraH, atasteShAM hitamapi nAnAprakArameva, tena tatpratipAdanArthaM prakRutibhedameva tAvadAha- samapittAniletyAdi| samA avaikArikamAnAvasthitAH pittAnilakaphA yasya sa tathA| garbhAdi garbhAdhAnAdi, shukrashoNitajIvasammUrcchanAdIti yAvat | vAtalA vAtapradhAnAH, evaM pittalAH shleShmalAshca| sarvatra garbhAdIti yojyam| atra pittagrahaNamAdau chando~anurodhAt, yadi vA pittasamAnasya vahnergauravapradarshanArthaM; yadi vA prakRutyArambhe vAtasyAprAdhAnyakhyApanArthaM, vAtaprakRutirhi sarvatra pratyavaro bhavati| iha ca pratyekadoShaprakRutigrahaNenaiva dvandvaprakRutirapi grAhyaH, saMyogasya saMyoginAmAntarIyakatvAt, nidAna iva vAtAdijvarAbhidhAnena dvandvajajvarAbhidhAnaM, tena rogabhiShagjitIyoktA dvandvajA api tisraH prakRutayo gRuhItA bhavanti; anye tu dvitIyakecidgrahaNAdgranthAdhikyena tadgrahaNaM varNayanti| teShAmiti samavAtapittashleShmaprakRutyAdInAM ca madhye| pUrve iti samaprakRutayaH| sadAturA iti svasthavyavahArabhAjo~api sphuTitA~ggatvaviShamAgnitvAdiyuktA yasmAdityarthaH| svasthA apyete kasmAdrogiNa ityAha- doShAnushayitetyAdi| doShAnushayitA ulbaNavAtAdibhAvitA~avyabhicAriNIti yAvat| dehaprakRutiH dehasvAsthyamiti yAvat| etenaiteShAM vAtalAdInAM mukhyaM svAsthyaM nAsti, kiM tarhi upacArasvasthA eta iti darshayati| nanu, garbhAdItyanena shukrashoNitajIvAnAM saMsarge yathAbhUtA vAtAdayaH samA vikRutA vA tathAbhUtaiva prakRutirbhavati, sA ca prakRutiryAvajjIvamanuvartate riShTaM vinA, yaduktaM sushrute- “prakopo vA~anyabhAvo vA kShayo vA nopajAyate| prakRutInAM svabhAvena, jAyate tu gatAyuShi” (su.shA. a. 4) iti; tatra yadA samaprakRutervAtaprakRutervA~a~akShepakAdirvAtavikAro bhavati, tadA vAtasya prakRutibhUtasyAdhikyaM bhavatyeva; yadA ca vAtaprakRuteH pittavikAro bhavati, tadA vAtaprakRuteranyathAbhAvaH pittaprakRutitvaM bhavati; yadA tu samaprakRuteranyataradoShakShayo bhavati prAkRutasvakarmahAnilakShaNastadA~asau prakRutikShayo bhavati; yaduktaM doShakShayalakShaNe- “karmaNaH prAkRutAddhAnirvRuddhirvA~api virodhinAm” (sU. a.18) iti| atrocyate- prakRutisamAnarogotpattau na prakRutibhUtasya vRuddhiH, kiM tarhi hetvantarajanitasya vAtAdestatra vikArakAritvaM , prakRutibhUtastu doShastatropadarshako bhavati, yaduktaM- “kAladUShyaprakRutibhirdoShastulyo hi santatam| niShpratyanIkaH kurute tasmAjj~jeyaH suduHsahaH” (ci. a.3) iti; vAtaprakRutestu pittavikArotpattau vAtaH prakRutibhUtastathaiva karacaraNasphuTanAdikaM kurvannAste, na tasyAgantunA pittavikAreNa ki~jcit kriyate; vAtAdInAM tu svamAnAt kShayaH prAkRutakarmahAnilakShaNo na shukrashoNitasaMsargakAlajasya prakRutibhUtasya doShasya bIjabhUtasya kShayamAvahatIti na prakRutibhUtadoShakShayaH; yadi vA, prakRuteH prakopAnyathAbhAvakShayA na bhavantIti prakRutitveneti brUmaH; tena samaprakRutirvAtaprakRutirna bhavati, vAtaprakRutiH pittaprakRutirna bhavati samaprakRutirvA; vikArAvasthA tu hInAdhikavAtatvAdilakShaNA bhavatItyarthaH| naca vAcyaM- prakRutibhUtAnAM vAtAdInAM dUShaNAtmakAnAM kathaM na sharIrabAdhakatvaM, sahajAtatvena tathAvidhavinAshakavikArAkartRutvAt; yaduktaM sushrute- “viShajAto yathA kITo viSheNa na vipadyate| tadvatprakRutibhirdehastajjAtatvAnna bAdhyate” (su.shA. a.4) iti; na bAdhyate nAtibAdhyata iti boddhavyaM, vAtAdiprakRuternityavAtAdivikAragRuhItatvAt| taduktamiha “vAtalAdyAH sadAturAH” iti| uktaM cAshvavaidyake- “sarvAn prANabhRuto hanti nUnaM kAyagataM viSham| asmiMshcApi samutpannA dRushyante kRumayo yathA|| tathA ca viShamo doShaH prakRutiM nAtibAdhate” iti| naca vAtAdayo vRuddhAH shukrashoNitasaMsarge yathA duShTatvAdvAtavikAravantaM garbhaM kurvanti tathA garbhajanakatvameva shukrashoNitayoH kasmAnna nighnantIti vAcyaM, vAtAdiprakopANAmeva hInamadhyottamAnAM nAnAshaktitvAt; prabalA vAtAdayo vinAshayanti, hInAstu vikRutimAtraM janayanti||39-40||

svAsthyotpattikAraNamabhidhAya svAsthyapratibandhakadoShasa~jcayanirharaNamabhidhAtuM doShasa~jcayasya lakShaNAnyeva tAvadvaktumAha- dve adha ityAdi| dve gudali~gge| khAni chidrANi | sapta shirasIti dve shrotre, dvau nAsApuTau, dve akShiNI, mukhaM ca; svedamukhAnIti lomakUpAni; etAni sarvANi malasyAyanAni| duShTairiti gobalIvardanyAyena kShINaiH, mAtrAdhikairiti vRuddhaiH; yenottaratra kShayavRuddhyorapi lakShaNaM vadati| malavRuddhiM gurutayA malAyanagurutayetyarthaH, lAghavAnmalAyanAnAM sa~gkShayaM malasya svamAnAdapi kShayamityarthaH; yadi vA duShTairiti mAtrAdhikairityasya visheShaNam, evaM sati lAghavAnmalasa~gkShayamiti prakRutisthAllAghavAnmalakShayamityadhikasya malasya kShayaM prakRutisthatvamityartho vyAkhyeyaH| sa~ggotsargAdatIva ceti atIvasa~ggAdapravRuttermalakShayam, atIvotsargAnmalavRuddhiM jAnIyAdityarthaH||42-43||

viShametyAdi| anAturashabdenAturyAt prAgevAnAgatAbAdhena svasthapareNa bhavitavyamiti shikShayati| mAdhavo vaishAkhastasya prathamashcaitraH, evaM nabhasyasya bhAdrasya prathamaH shrAvaNaH, tathA sahasyasya pauShasya prathamo mArgashIrShaH; ete ca mAsAshcaitrashrAvaNamArgashIrShA rogabhiShagjitIye vimAne (vi.a.8) shodhanArthaM vakShyamANaprAvRuDAdyRutukrameNa vasantaprAvRuTsharadantargatA bhavanti| dRuDhabalasaMskAre~api paThyate- “prAvRuT shukranabhau j~jeyau sharadUrjasahau punaH| tapasyashca madhushcaiva vasantaH shodhanaM prati” (si.a.6) iti, sushrute~api RutucaryAdhyAye doShopacayaprakopopashamananimittamIdRusha eva RutukramaH paThitaH| tena, shodhanamabhidhIyamAnaM shodhanArthoktartukrameNaiva vyAkhyeyam| vasantAdInAmantamAseShu tu vamanAdyabhidhAnaM sampUrNaprakope bhUte nirharaNopadeshArthaM; prathameShu hi mAseShu phAlgunAShADhakArtikeShu prakopaH prakarShaprApto na bhavati, citasya hyasamyakprakupitasyAvilInasya samya~gnirharaNaM na bhavatIti| ata eva kapilabale~api paThyate- “madhau sahe nabhasi ca mAsi doShAn pravAhayet| vamanaishca virekaishca nirUhaiH sAnuvAsanaiH” iti| haricandreNa tu, sahashabdo~ayamakArAnto mArgashIrShavacanastasya sahasya prathame kArtike iti vyAkhyAtam| tanmatAnusAriNA vAgbhaTena coktaM- “shrAvaNe kArtike caitre mAsi sAdhAraNe kramAt| grIShmavarShAhimacitAn vAyvAdInAshu nirharet” (vA.sU.a.3) iti| “kArtike shrAvaNe caitre mAsi sAdhAraNe kramAt| varShAdisa~jcitAn doShAn trimAsAntaritAn haret”- ityasya tu shlokasya kenApi paThitasyAviruddhAnveShaNe buddhimatAM na vyApAraH| UrdhvaM ceti vamanena, adha iti virekeNa, bastikarmashabdenAsthApanAnuvAsane; etacca sarvaM vamanAdi yathAyogyatayA, na yathAsa~gkhyena; tena vamanaM madhau pradhAnaM, sahasyaprathame virekaH, nabhasyaprathame bastiriti bhavati| yathAkramaM yathAnupUrvaM, yathAyogyaM yadyasya yujyate; etacca pUrveNa vamanAdinA, uttareNa ca rasAyanAdi prayojayedityanena yojyam| siddhAnIti dRuShTaphalAni| rogAstathA na jAyanta iti vamanAdInAcarataH; dhAtavashcAbhivardhanta iti rasAyanavRuShyayogAnupayojayata iti yojanIyam| nijAnAmiti chedaH| itareShAmityAgantUnAm| Agantavashceha bhUtaviShavAtAdijanyAstathA mAnasAshcAbhipretAH; yenaitaddvitayamapyabhidhAyA~a~agantUnAmanutpattAvityAdyupasaMhAramAgantukatvenaiva kariShyati||45-50||

jAtAniti jAtamAtrAn| vegaH pravRuttyunmukhatvaM mUtrapurIShAdInAm| mUtragrahaNamAdau mUtrasya purIShAdyapekShayA bahuvegatvAt| mUtrapurIShayoriti kShutpipAsayoriti ca samAsakaraNaM prAyasho~anayoH sahotpAdadarshanArtham| pratiniShedhyaM nakArakaraNaM niShedhyagauravopadarshanArtham| niHshvAsasya shrameNa ceti shramotthasya niHshvAsasyAvidhAryatvaM darshayati, yato~anantaraM vakShyati “shramaniHshvAsadhAraNAt” iti; sushrute~apyuktaM- “shrAntasya niHshvAsavinigraheNa hRudroga mUrcche athavA~api gulmaH” (sU.u.a.55) iti||3-4||

ye bhUtetyAdi| bhUtAH pishAcAdayaH, AdigrahaNAt pAtabandhanAdInAM grahaNam| praj~jA buddhistadaparAdho~aj~jAnadurj~jAne, etanmUlAshcaite bhUtAbhiSha~ggAdaya IrShyAdayashca| yadyapi ca nijA api praj~jAparAdhamUlA eva; yaduktaM- “praj~jAparAdhAddhyahitAnarthAn pa~jca niShevate” (sU.a.28) iti, tathA~api te prAdhAnyAt praj~jAparAdhajanitabAhyavAtAdirUkShabhojanAdijanyatvena tathA~antarA vAtAdijanyatvena pRuthaktvenocyante ||51-52||

AgantumAnasaparihAre hetumAha- tyAga ityAdi| indriyopashamaH indriyANAM svaviShaye~alampaTatvaM, smRutiH putrAdInAM vinashvaratvasvabhAvAdyanusmaraNaM; yaduktam- “smRutvA svabhAvaM bhAvAnAM smaran duHkhAdvimucyate” (shA.a.1); etacca dvayaM mAnasarogapratighAtakam| deshaj~jAnAcchUnyagRuhATavyupasargagRuhItadeshavarjanAdi bhavati, kAlaj~jAnAt paurNamAsyAdivakShyamANabhUtAdyabhighAtakAlAdivarjanam , Atmaj~jAnAt svashaktiparyAlocanayA pracarato balavadagnighAtAdiparivarjanAdi vyAkhyeyam| sadvRuttamindriyopakramaNIye vakShyamANam| prAgeveti anutpanneShveva rogeShu||53-54||

AptopadeshagrahaNArthamanAptAn varjyAn pApavRuttetyAdinA, sevyAMshcAptAn buddhItyAdinA darshayati| vRuttaM ceShTitaM sharIravyApAraH, sattvaM manaH; eShAM pApatvaM pApahetutvAt| shaThAH krUrAH| nirghRuNA niShkRupAH| buddhyAdibhirvRuddhAH prabhUtaprashastabuddhyAdiyuktA ityarthaH| gatavyathA gatashokAdaya ityarthaH| sumukhAH prasannamukhAH| shaMsitavratAH kathitavratAH ||56-59||

dadhno~anekaprakAraniShiddhatvAddi~gmAtrodAharaNArthaM dadhibhojanavidhimAha- na naktamityAdi| atra na naktamityatra noShNamityatra ca nakAraH kriyayA sambadhyate, tena nishi uShNaM dadhi sarvathaiva na sevyam| aghRutasharkaramityAdau ca niShedho na~jA sambadhyate, tenobhayapratiShedhAt sasharkaraM bhu~jjItetyAdi vAkyArtho bhavati| tena ghRutAdInAM madhye~anyatamasambandhenApi dadhyupayojyaM bhavati| na naktamityAdivadihApi nakArasya kriyAsambandhe mudgasUpasahitasyApyaghRutasharkaratvamastyeva dadhna ityanupAdeyatvaM syAt| jatUkarNe- nApi ghRutAdInAM militAnAmayogAddadhyasevyamuktam| yaduktaM- “nAshnIyAddadhi naktamuShNaM vA na ghRutamadhusharkarAmudgAmalakairvinA vA” iti||61-62||
adhyAyArthasa~ggrahe hitAhitamiti sevyAsevyaM vyAyAmahAsyAdi| bhaviShyatAmanutpattau bheShajamiti mAdhavaprathame mAsItyAdinotpannAnAM ca shAntaya ityantena||63-66||

yadvegavidhAraNe ye rogAsteShAM yaccikitsitaM tadalpavaktavyatvAt prakaraNAgatatvAcca brUte- bastimehanayorityAdi| mehanaM shishnaH | vinamanaM sharIrasya vinAmaH| avapIDako bahumAtraprayogaH, mAtrAdhikatvena hi bheShajaM doShAn pIDayatIti kRutvA; anyatrApyuktam- “avapIDakasarpirbhiH koShNairghRutatailikaistathA~abhya~ggaiH” iti| trividhamiti nirUhAnuvAsanottarabastyAtmakam| piNDikA jAnuja~gghAmadhyamAMsapiNDikA| vartayaH phalavartayaH| pramAthi anulomanam| caraNAyudhaH kukkuTaH| rujA jaThara iti sambandhaH| ‘bhojanAni’ ‘pAnAni’ ‘bastaya’ iti trayaM vAtAnulomanaM shastamiti yojyam| koTho varaTIdaShTAkAraH shothaH| vya~ggaH shyAmavarNaM maNDalaM mukhe| hRullAsaH utkleshaH| ardhAvabhedaH ardhamastakavedanA| AdyaM khAdyaM bhojanamityarthaH| cakArAt svedAdayo~api vAtaghnA iti sUcayati| yadyapi sushrute mUtrAdInAM trayodashAnAM vidhAraNAttrayodashodAvartA abhidhIyante, tathA~apIhAShTodarIye mUtrapurIShavAtashukravamikShavathuvighAtajA eva paraM ShaDudAvartA abhidhAtavyAH; udgArAdinirodhajAnAM vAtanirodhaja evodAvarte~antarbhAvAbhiprAyAt; yadi vA mUtrAdivighAtaja eva vikAre carakAcAryasya udAvartasa~jj~jA~abhipretA, nAnyatreti na virodhaH| muhurmuhura~ggAnAmAkShepaNamAkShepaH; parvaNAmAku~jcanaM sa~gkocaH| suptiH sparshAj~jAnam| bhramaNaM bhramo yena cakrasthitamivAtmAnaM manyate| sAdaH a~ggAvasAdaH| tarpayatIti tarpaNam| saMvAhanaM pANinA pAdAdipradeshe sukhamabhihananamunmardanaM ca||5-25||
athAta indriyopakramaNIyamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

pa~jcendriyArthAH- shabdasparsharUparasagandhAH||11||

Commentary: indriyArthA indriyaviShayAH| atra ca sparshagrahaNena sparshasya sparshAshrayasya ca dravyasya sparshaikArthasamavetasya ca parimANAdeH sparshagrAhyasya grahaNam| evaM rUpAdiShvapi vAcyam||11||

pa~jcendriyabuddhayaH- cakShurbuddhyAdikAH; tAH punarindriyendriyArthasattvAtmasannikarShajAH, kShaNikA, nishcayAtmikAshca, ityetat pa~jcapa~jcakam||12||

Commentary: asAdhAraNena kAraNenendriyeNa vyapadiShTA buddhaya indriyabuddhayaH| cakShuShA asAdhAraNena kAraNena janitA buddhishcakShurbuddhiH; evaM shrotrAdibuddhiShu vAcyam| iha cakShurbuddhirAdAvupadishyate, cakShurbuddhereva bahuviShayatvAt| indriyabuddhyutpAdasAmagrImAha- tAH punarityAdi| sannikarShaH sambandhaH; sa ca kvacit saMyogaH, kvacit samavAyaH; tena cakShurbuddhyAdAvAtmA manasA saMyujyate, mana indriyeNa, indriyamarthena; shrotrabuddhau tu shrotrashabdayoH samavAya iti visheShaH| kShaNikA iti AshutaravinAshinyaH, na tu bauddhasiddhAntavadekakShaNAvasthAyinyaH| nishcayAtmikA vastusvarUpaparicchedAtmikA | kShaNikatve~api vastuparicchedakatvaM pradIpArcirjvalanavadbuddhInAmaviruddhamityarthaH ||12||

mano manortho buddhirAtmA cetyadhyAtmadravyaguNasa~ggrahaH shubhAshubhapravRuttinivRuttihetushca, dravyAshritaM ca karma; yaducyate kriyeti||13||

Commentary: mano~artho vakShyamANo ‘manasastu cintyamarthaH’ ityanena| buddhiriha manobuddhirvivakShitA, indriyabuddhInAM pa~jcapa~jcakenaiva grahaNAt| AtmAnamadhikRutyAdhyAtmam; AtmAnamadhikRutya yAni dravyANi ye ca guNAH, teShAM sa~ggraho~adhyAtmadravyaguNasa~ggrahaH| tatra guNA rUpAdibuddhayaH, sheShaM dravyam| etaduktaM bhavati- Atmano~apakArakopakArakANAM dravyaguNAnAmayaM sa~ggraha iti| yo~ayaM sa~ggrahaH shubhasya dharmasya sukhasya ca pravRuttau heturbhavati, ashubhasyAdharmasyAsukhasya ca nivRuttau heturbhavati; tatroktasa~ggrahasya samyagyogaH shubhasya pravRuttAvashubhasya nivRuttau heturbhavati, ayogAtiyogamithyAyogAstu ashubhasya pravRuttau hetavaH; yadi vA shubhasya pUrvavyAkRutasya, ashubhasya ca pUrvavyAkRutasya pravRutteH saMsArasya, nivRuttermokShasya yathoktasa~ggraho heturiti vyAkhyeyaM; tatra sa~ggrahasya shubhAshubhahetutvaM pUrvavadeva vyAkhyeyaM; durj~jAtastu sa~ggrahaH saMsArasya heturbhavati, tattvato j~jAtastu mokShaheturiti vyAkhyeyam| adhyAtmadravyaguNAdadhikamanuktaM shubhAdihetumAha- dravyAshritaM cetyAdi| karmetyucyamAne vamanAdiShvapi tathA~a~asyAsvapnAdiShvapi karmashabdavAcyeShu prasaktiH syAt, atastadvyAvRuttyarthaM dravyAshritamiti padaM; tathA~api dharmAdharmayoH karmashabdavAcyayoH prasaktiH syAdityata uktaM- yaducyate kriyeti| karmaNaH pRuthakkRutvA~abhidhAnaM pa~jcakarmAdiShu karmaNo~apraviShTatvAt||13||

tatrAnumAnagamyAnAM pa~jcamahAbhUtavikArasamudAyAtmakAnAmapi satAmindriyANAM tejashcakShuShi, khaM shrotre, ghrANe kShitiH, Apo rasane, sparshane~anilo visheSheNopapadyate| tatra yadyadAtmakamindriyaM visheShAttattadAtmakamevArthamanugRuhNAti, tatsvabhAvAdvibhutvAcca||14||

Commentary: samprati vaidyakasiddhAntena pA~jcabhautikAnAmapi cakShurAdInAM yathA taijasatvAdivyapadesho bhavati tadAha- tatretyAdi| anumAnena pratIyanta ityanumAnagamyAni; anumAnaM ca- cakShurbuddhyAdayaH karaNakAryAH, kriyAtvAt; chidikriyAvat| mahAbhUtAni khAdIni, teShAM vikAraH pariNAmavisheShaH, samudAyo melakaH, sa AtmA samavAyikAraNaM yeShAM tAni| visheSheNa adhikatvena| etaduktaM bhavati- pA~jcabhautikatve~api tejodhikatvAccakShustaijasaM vyapadishyate; evaM ghrANAdiShvapi pRuthivyAdyadhikatvena pArthivatvAdivyapadeshaH| atha kathaM cakShustejodhikaM, ghrANaM pRuthivyadhikamityAdyavadhAryata ityAha- tatretyAdi| yadindriyaM visheShAdbhUyastvena yadAtmakaM yadbhUtArabdhaM, tadindriyaM tadAtmakameva tadbhUtAtmakameva, arthaM viShayamanugRuhNAti anudhAvati; yattejaHpradhAnaM tattejaHpradhAnameva viShayaM gRuhNAtItyarthaH, evaM pArthivAdiShvapi vAcyam| tatra hetumAha- tatsvabhAvAdvibhutvAcca| tatsvabhAvAditi grAhyANAM rUpAdInAM yaH svabhAvastaijasatvAdiH,cakShurAdInAmapi tatsvabhAvAdevetyarthaH; vibhutvAditi shaktatvAt, samAnajAtIyataijasAdigrahaNa eva cakShurAdInAM shaktatvAdityarthaH| tadanena granthenaitadanumAnamupadishyate- yat- cakShustaijasaM, rUpAdInAM madhye rUpasyaiva prakAshakatvAdbAhyAlokavat; rasanamApyaM, rUpAdInAM madhye rasasyaiva prakAshakatvAddantodakavat; tathA gandhaH svajAtIyaguNotkarShavadindriyagrAhyaH, bhUtavisheShaguNatvAdrUpavadityAdi||14||

tadarthAtiyogAyogamithyAyogAt samanaskamindriyaM vikRutimApadyamAnaM yathAsvaM buddhyupaghAtAya sampadyate, sAmarthyayogAt punaH prakRutimApadyamAnaM yathAsvaM buddhimApyAyayati||15||

Commentary: shubhAshubhapravRuttiheturiti yaduktaM tadupapAdayati- tadarthetyAdi| tat indriyam, arthasya rUpAderatiyogo rUpAdyatidarshanam, ayogo hInamAtrarUpAdidarshanaM sarvasho rUpAdyadarshanaM ca, mithyAyogo vikRutabIbhatsarUpAdidarshanam| samanaskaM manasA sahitaM, vikRutiM vikAramApadyamAnaM; samanaskamiti visheShaNaM kurvan cakShurAdyupaghAtAnmanaso~apyudvignatvadainyAdilakShaNo vikAro bhavatIti darshayati| yathAsvaM yA yasyAtmIyA buddhiH| sAmarthyayogAt samayogAt| punaHshabdaH pUrvapakShAdvyAvartayati| prakRutiM svabhAvam, ApadyamAnam anuvidhIyamAnam; ‘indriyam’ iti sheShaH| yathAsvaM buddhimApyAyayatIti AtmIyAmAtmIyAM buddhiM sAtatyena janayatItyarthaH||15||

manasastu cintyamarthaH| tatra manaso manobuddheshca ta eva samAnAtihInamithyAyogAH prakRutivikRutihetavo bhavanti||16||

Commentary: pUrvaM mana uktaM, tasya grAhyaM viShayamAha- manasastu cintyamartha iti| indriyanirapekShaM mano yadgRuhNAti taccintyaM (yadi vA, indriyagRuhItamevArthaM yat punarindriyanirapekShaM mano gRuhNAti taccintyam )| etacca prAdhAnyAduktaM; tena manorthAnAM sukhAdInAmanupAdAnaM doShatvena naivodbhAvanIyam| ta evetyAdi manoviShayasya cintyasya samayogastathA~atihInamithyAyogAshca| prakRutiH avikAraH svabhAva iti yAvat; vikRutiH vikAraH| tatra cintyasya samyagyogo manaso manobuddheshca prakRutiheturbhavati, atiyogAdayastu cintyasya manaso manobuddheshca cintanadhyAnAdilakShaNAyA vikRuterhetavo bhavantIti vAcyam| acintanAticintanabhayAnakacintanairmano~api vikRutaM manobuddhimapi vikRutAM janayatIti bhAvaH||16||

tatrendriyANAM samanaskAnAmanupataptAnAmanupatApAya prakRutibhAve prayatitavyamebhirhetubhiH; tadyathA- sAtmyendriyArthasaMyogena buddhyA samyagavekShyAvekShya karmaNAM samyak pratipAdanena, deshakAlAtmaguNaviparItopAsanena ceti| tasmAdAtmahitaM cikIrShatA sarveNa sarvaM sarvadA smRutimAsthAya sadvRuttamanuShTheyam||17||

Commentary: tadIdRushe kartavyamAha- tatretyAdi| anupatApAya anupaghAtAya; upaghAtakahetuvarjanenetyabhiprAyaH| prakRutibhAve nirvikAratvakaraNe; bheShajopayogenetyabhiprAyaH| sAtmyendriyArthasaMyogeneti indriyArthasamayogena| buddhyA samyagidaM mama hitamidaM mamAhitamityavekShyAvekShya| karmaNAM pravRuttInAM samyakpratipAdaneneti ahitakarmaparityAgena hitakarmAcaraNena ca| etena praj~jAparAdhamUlAhitapravRuttiniShedhena hitArthapravRuttyupadeshaH kRuto bhavati| etena cAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogapraj~jAparAdhaparihArAbhyAmanAgatAbAdhapratiShedharUpA ceShToktA bhavati| utpannavikArapratiShedhopAyastu deshakAletyAdinA kathyate; guNashabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate, Atmashabdena prakRutivikArayorgrahaNam| tasmAt karmaNAM kriyArUpANAM shAstravihitatvena pratipAditAnAM samyaganuShThAnamArogyahetuH| tacca karma hitaM sadvRuttAnuShThAnarUpam| tasmAt kAraNAdAtmahitaM kartumicchatA, smRutimAsthAyAvadhAnena sadvRuttopadeshaM smRutvetyarthaH, satAM vRuttamanuShThAnaM dehavA~gmanaHpravRuttirUpaM sadvRuttamanuShTheyam| iha janmani janmAntare ca shAntishaucAcArAdiyogajanitadharmaprabhAvAttrivargamavyAkulamupayu~jjAnAstiShThantIti ‘santa’ ityucyante, adhArmikAstu vidyamAnA apyaprashastAvasthAnatvena| ‘asanta’ ityucyante||17||

taddhyanutiShThan yugapat sampAdayatyarthadvayamArogyamindriyavijayaM ceti; tat sadvRuttamakhilenopadekShyAmo~agnivesha ! tadyathA- devagobrAhmaNaguruvRuddhasiddhAcAryAnarcayet, agnimupacaret, oShadhIH prashastA dhArayet, dvau kAlAvupaspRushet, malAyaneShvabhIkShNaM pAdayoshca vaimalyamAdadhyAt, triHpakShasya keshashmashrulomanakhAn saMhArayet, nityamanupahatavAsAH sumanAH sugandhiH syAt, sAdhuveshaH, prasiddhakeshaH , mUrdhashrotraghrANapAdatailanityaH, dhUmapaH, pUrvAbhibhAShI, sumukhaH, durgeShvabhyupapattA, hotA, yaShTA, dAtA, catuShpathAnAM namaskartA, balInAmupahartA, atithInAM pUjakaH, pitRubhyaH piNDadaH, kAle hitamitamadhurArthavAdI, vashyAtmA, dharmAtmA, hetAvIrShyuH, phale nerShyuH, nishcintaH, nirbhIkaH, hrImAn, dhImAn, mahotsAhaH, dakShaH, kShamAvAn, dhArmikaH, AstikaH, vinayabuddhividyAbhijanavayovRuddhasiddhAcAryANAmupAsitA , chatrI daNDI maulI sopAnatko yugamAtradRugvicaret , ma~ggalAcArashIlaH, kucelAsthikaNTakAmedhyakeshatuShotkarabhasmakapAlasnAnabalibhUmInAM parihartA, prAk shramAd vyAyAmavarjI syAt, sarvaprANiShu bandhubhUtaH syAt, kruddhAnAmanunetA, bhItAnAmAshvAsayitA, dInAnAmabhyupapattA, satyasandhaH, sAmapradhAnaH , paraparuShavacanasahiShNuH, amarShaghnaH, prashamaguNadarshI, rAgadveShahetUnAM hantA ca||18||

Commentary: sadvRuttAnuShThAnaM darshayati- tadityAdi| sadvRuttAnuShThAnena nAnyashriyamabhilaShedityAdyanuShThAnenendriyaM yantryate, yantraNAbhyAsAttadindriyaM jIyata ityuktamindriyavijayaM ceti; yasmAdeva~gguNaM sadvRuttAnuShThAnaM tat tasmAt sadvRuttamupadekShyAmaH; akhilena kArtsnyena| dvau kAlau sAyaM prAtaH, upaspRushet snAyAt; yadi vA upaspRushet sandhyAmupAsIta| triH pakShasyeti pa~jcabhiH pa~jcabhirdinaiH, yadi vA kShArapANivacanaprAmANyAt pakShashabdo~ayaM mAse vartate, patati pa~jcadashAhAbhyAM pakSharUpAbhyAM mAsa iti pa~jcadashAhaH pakSho~abhidhIyate, evaM patati RuturmAsAbhyAM pakSharUpAbhyAmiti mAso~api pakShAbhidheyaH; uktaM ca kShArapANau- “trirmAsasya romanakhAn saMhArayet” iti| anupahatavAsA amlAnavAsAH| prasiddhakeshaH prasAdhitakeshaH; iha keshaprasAdhanAbhidhAnAt pUrvaM keshasaMharaNe vacanaM tIrthAdiprAptanimittena kRutamuNDanasnAtakAdiviShayam| pUrvAbhibhAShI prathamasambhAShaNashIlaH| durgeShvabhyupapattA durgatipatitAnAM rakShitA| yaShTA yaj~jakArakaH| vashyAtmA vashyendriyaH, Atmashabdo~ayamindriyavacanaH| hetAvIrShyuriti yena hetunA~ayaM dhanavAn vidyAvAn vA jAtaH sa heturme kathaM bhavediti prayatnavatA bhavitavyamiti darshayati| phale nerShyurityanena parasya na dhanAdiphalasambandhanivAraNecchA kartavyeti darshayati| nirbhIka iti upasthite~aparihArye bhayahetau boddhavyaM, shakyaparihAreShu tu dRuShTAdRuShTapratyavAyahetuShu bhetavyameva| abhijano vishuddhakulam| sarvaprANiShu bandhubhUta iti tu yadyapi rAjadviShTapatitAdInAmadharmabhayAccikitsAM na karoti, tathA~api teShvapi karuNArdrahRudayatvena mantavyam| abhyupapattA upakArArthaM svIkartA| satyasandhaH pratij~jAtArthanirvAhakaH| amarShaH akShamA, tAM hantIti amarShaghnaH| prashamaM shAntiM guNatvena draShTuM shIlaM yasya sa prashamaguNadarshI||18||

nAnRutaM brUyAt, nAnyasvamAdadIta, nAnyastriyamabhilaShennAnyashriyaM, na vairaM rocayet, na kuryAt pApaM, na pApe~api pApI syAt, nAnyadoShAn brUyAt, nAnyarahasyamAgamayen, nAdhArmikairna narendradviShTaiH sahAsIta nonmattairna patitairna bhrUNahantRubhirna kShudrairna duShTaiH, na duShTayAnAnyAroheta, na jAnusamaM kaThinamAsanamadhyAsIta, nAnAstIrNamanupahitamavishAlamasamaM vA shayanaM prapadyeta, na giriviShamamastakeShvanucaret, na drumamArohet, na jalogravegamavagAheta, na kulacchAyAmupAsIta , nAgnyutpAtamabhitashcaret, noccairhaset, na shabdavantaM mArutaM mu~jcet, nAnAvRutamukho jRumbhAM kShavathuM hAsyaM vA pravartayet, na nAsikAM kuShNIyAt, na dantAn vighaTTayet, na nakhAn vAdayet, nAsthInyabhihanyAt, na bhUmiM vilikhet, na chindyAttRuNaM, na loShTaM mRudnIyAt, na viguNama~ggaishceShTeta, jyotIMShyaniShTamamedhyamashastaM ca nAbhivIkSheta, na hu~gkuryAcchavaM , na caityadhvajagurupUjyAshastacchAyAmAkrAmet, na kShapAsvamarasadanacaityacatvaracatuShpathopavanashmashAnAghAtanAnyAseveta , naikaH shUnyagRuhaM na cATavImanupravishet, na pApavRuttAn strImitrabhRutyAn bhajeta, nottamairvirudhyeta, nAvarAnupAsIta, na jihmaM rocayet, nAnAryamAshrayet, na bhayamutpAdayet, na sAhasAtisvapnaprajAgarasnAnapAnAshanAnyAseveta, nordhvajAnushciraM tiShThet, na vyAlAnupasarpenna daMShTriNo na viShANinaH, purovAtAtapAvashyAyAtipravAtA~jjahyAt, kaliM nArabheta, nAsunibhRuto~agnimupAsIta nocchiShTaH, nAdhaH kRutvA pratApayet, nAvigataklamo nAnAplutavadano na nagna upaspRushet, na snAnashATyA spRusheduttamA~ggaM, na keshAgrANyabhihanyAt, nopaspRushya te eva vAsasI bibhRuyAt, nAspRuShTvA ratnAjyapUjyama~ggalasumanaso~abhiniShkrAmet, na pUjyama~ggalAnyapasavyaM gacchennetarANyanudakShiNam||19||

Commentary: nAnRutaM brUyAdityasya rAjayakShmaNi “kAkAMstittirishabdena” (ci. a.8) ityAdyayathAbhAShaNopadeshena virodho na vAcyaH, yataH parApakAraphalamasatyabhAShaNamanRutavyAhAradoSheNa spRushyate, natu parasya jIvanArthamanyathAbhAShaNam; uktaM ca- “prANAtyaye sarvadhanApahAre pa~jcAnRutAnyAhurapAtakAni”| Agamayet budhyeta| adhArmikasa~gganiShedhenaiva patitAdisa~gganiShedhe labdhe punastadabhidhAnaM visheShapratiShedhArtham| bhrUNahA garbhaghAtakaH| anupahitam anupadhAnaM gaNDukAdirahitam| na drumamArohediti sAmAnyo vidhiH, asya ca visheSheNa rasAyanavakShyamANAmalakIvRukShArohaNopadeshena mahAphalena bAdhA bhavatyeva| kuShNIyAt vighaTTayet| iha sadvRuttopadeshe yatra na nakhAn vAdayedityAdau sAkShAddRuShTamadRuShTaM vA phalaM na dRushyate tatrApyadRuShTaphalaM vacanaprAmANyAdeva boddhavyam| na shavaM hu~gkuryAdityatrAgamaH- “yaH shavaM hu~gkaroti tena somo bahirnirasto bhavati” iti| caityo grAmapradhAnataruH, AghAtanaM vadhasthAnam| avarA nIcAH| jihmaM kuTilam| ArAddUrAt pApebhyo yAta AryaH, tadviparIto~anAryaH| atishabdaH svapnAdibhiH saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate| iha ca prakaraNe sAhasanaktadadhibhojanAdInAM yeShAM prakaraNAntara eva niShedhaH kRutastAni punarniShidhyante prakaraNavashAdeva, prakaraNaprApto hyarthaH prAgukto~api punarabhidhIyamAnaH prakRutagranthasya nyUnatAmudasyati, punarabhidhIyamAnArthagauravaM ca darshayati, na punaruktadoShamAvahati| yaduktam- “adhikaraNavashAddArDhyAdguNadoShaprAptito~arthasambandhAt| stutyarthaM saMshayataH shiShyadhiyAM cAbhivRuddhyartham|| tantre syAt punaruktaM punaruktaM neShyate taddhi” iti| UrdhvajAnuH daNDAyamAnaH| vyAlAH sarpAH| asunibhRutaH asamAhitaH, nAdhaHkRutvA agnimiti sambandhaH| te eva vAsasI snAnavAsasItyarthaH, yadi vA snAnakAlAt pUrvaM dhRute| apasavyaM vAmam||19||

nAratnapANirnAsnAto nopahatavAsA nAjapitvA nAhutvA devatAbhyo nAnirUpya pitRubhyo nAdattvA gurubhyo nAtithibhyo nopAshritebhyo nApuNyagandho nAmAlI nAprakShAlitapANipAdavadano nAshuddhamukho noda~gmukho na vimanA nAbhaktAshiShTAshucikShudhitaparicaro na pAtrIShvamedhyAsu nAdeshe nAkAle nAkIrNe nAdattvA~agramagnaye nAprokShitaM prokShaNodakairna mantrairanabhimantritaM na kutsayanna kutsitaM na pratikUlopahitamannamAdadIta, na paryuShitamanyatra mAMsaharitakashuShkashAkaphalabhakShyebhyaH, nAsheShabhuk syAdanyatra dadhimadhulavaNasaktusarpibhyaH, na naktaM dadhi bhu~jjIta, na saktUnekAnashnIyAnna nishi na bhuktvA na bahUnna dvirnodakAntaritAt, na chittvA dvijairbhakShayet||20||

Commentary: anirUpya anivedya| AkIrNe bahujanAkIrNe| annasya prokShaNAbhimantraNAni vede boddhavyAni| kutsitaM svarUpata eva kadarthatvena ninditam| haritakam ArdrakAdi, shuShkashAkaM shuShkapatrAdi, bhakShyA modakAdayaH| nAsheShabhuk syAt niHsheShabhojI na syAdityarthaH| naktaM dadhibhojananiShedhe AgamaH- “divA kapitthe vasati rAtrau dadhni ca saktuShu| alakShmIH kalahAdhArA kovidAre kRutAlayA” iti| ekAniti ghRutasharkarArahitAn| nodakAntaritAn nodakamantarA pItvetyarthaH||20||

nAnRujuH kShuyAnnAdyAnna shayIta, na vegito~anyakAryaH syAt, na vAyvagnisalilasomArkadvijagurupratimukhaM niShThIvikA(vAta)varcomUtrANyutsRujet, na panthAnamavamUtrayenna janavati nAnnakAle, na japahomAdhyayanabalima~ggalakriyAsu shleShmasi~gghANakaM mu~jcet||21||

Commentary: nAdyAdanRujuH, na shayItAnRujuriti ca yojyam||21||

na striyamavajAnIta, nAtivishrambhayet, na guhyamanushrAvayet, nAdhikuryAt| na rajasvalAM nAturAM nAmedhyAM nAshastAM nAniShTarUpAcAropacArAM nAdakShAM nAdakShiNAM nAkAmAM nAnyakAmAM nAnyastriyaM nAnyayoniM nAyonau na caityacatvaracatuShpathopavanashmashAnAghAtanasalilauShadhidvijagurusurAlayeShu na sandhyayornAtithiShu nAshucirnAjagdhabheShajo nApraNItasa~gkalpo nAnupasthitapraharSho nAbhuktavAnnAtyashito na viShamastho na mUtroccArapIDito na shramavyAyAmopavAsaklamAbhihato nArahasi vyavAyaM gacchet||22||

Commentary: nAtivishrambhayet nAtiprashrayavatIM kuryAt| nAdhikuryAn na sarvatrAdhikRutAM kuryAt| ashastAM kuShThAdisambandhena| nAnyayonimityasyAnte abhigacchet iti sheShaH, anyayoniH asavarNA| oShadhyAdibhirAlayashabdaH sambadhyate| nAtithiShviti na niShiddhAsu maithunaM pratipatpUrNimAprabhRutiShu| ajagdhabheShajaH anupayuktavRuShyabheShajaH| anupasthitapraharShaH ajAtadhvajocchrAyaH| arahasi avijane||22||
na sato na gurUn parivadet, nAshucirabhicArakarmacaityapUjyapUjAdhyayanamabhinirvartayet||23||

na vidyutsvanArtavIShu nAbhyuditAsu dikShu nAgnisamplave na bhUmikampe na mahotsave nolkApAte na mahAgrahopagamane na naShTacandrAyAM tithau na sandhyayornAmukhAdgurornAvapatitaM nAtimAtraM na tAntaM na visvaraM nAnavasthitapadaM nAtidrutaM na vilambitaM nAtiklIbaM nAtyuccairnAtinIcaiH svarairadhyayanamabhyasyet||24||

nAtisamayaM jahyAt, na niyamaM bhindyAt, na naktaM nAdeshe caret, na sandhyAsvabhyavahArAdhyayanastrIsvapnasevI syAt, na bAlavRuddhalubdhamUrkhakliShTaklIbaiH saha sakhyaM kuryAt, na madyadyUtaveshyAprasa~ggaruciH syAt, na guhyaM vivRuNuyAt, na ka~jcidavajAnIyAt, nAhammAnI syAnnAdakSho nAdakShiNo nAsUyakaH, na brAhmaNAn parivadet, na gavAM daNDamudyacchet, na vRuddhAnna gurUnna gaNAnna nRupAn vA~adhikShipet, na cAtibrUyAt, na bAndhavAnuraktakRucchradvitIyaguhyaj~jAn bahiShkuryAt||25||

Commentary: atisamayo militvA bahubhiH kRuto niyamaH| na sandhyAsvityAdau punaH strIniShedhaH sandhyAsu yAvadakartavyasya nyUnatAparihArArthamuktaH, pUrvaM tu strI yathA na sevyA tannikhilenopadishatA na sandhyayorityuktam, iti prakaraNabhedAnna paunaruktyam| klIbo hInasattvaH| kliShTo nindito rogAdinA| gaNAn militAn| kRucchradvitIya Apadi sahAyaH| bahiShkuryAt avajAnIyAt||25||

nAdhIro nAtyucchritasattvaH syAt, nAbhRutabhRutyaH, nAvishrabdhasvajanaH, naikaH sukhI, na duHkhashIlAcAropacAraH, na sarvavishrambhI, na sarvAbhisha~gkI, na sarvakAlavicArI||26||

Commentary: naikaH sukhI syAditi na sukhahetUnyAmraphalAdInyeka evAvibhajyopayu~jjyAdityarthaH| shIlaM svAbhAvikaM vRuttam, AcAraH shAstropadeshAnurUpo vyavahAraH, upacAraH paricchadaH, eteShAM ca duHkhatvaM duHkhahetutvAt| sarvavishrambhI sarveShu vishvAsI||26||

na kAryakAlamatipAtayet, nAparIkShitamabhinivishet, nendriyavashagaH syAt, na ca~jcalaM mano~anubhrAmayet, na buddhIndriyANAmatibhAramAdadhyAt, na cAtidIrghasUtrI syAt, na krodhaharShAvanuvidadhyAt, na shokamanuvaset, na siddhAvutsekaM yacchennAsiddhau dainyaM, prakRutimabhIkShNaM smaret, hetuprabhAvanishcitaH syAddhetvArambhanityashca, na kRutamityAshvaset, na vIryaM jahyAt, nApavAdamanusmaret||27||

Commentary: ca~jcalamiti kriyAvisheShaNaM, yadi vA manovisheShaNam| buddherindriyANAM buddhIndriyANAm| atidIrghasUtrI shataikavinipAtAsha~gkI, kiMvA dIrghasUtrI cirakriyaH| na shokamanuvasediti na ciraM shokavashagaH syAt| utsekam atigarvam | prakRutim utpattikAraNaM smaret; prakRutiM pa~jcabhUtasamudAyalakShaNAmanityAM smaranna rAgadveShAdibhirabhibhUyate| hetuprabhAvanishcita iti asti shubhAshubhahetUnAM shubhAshubhaphalasambandha iti nishcayamupeyAt, nAtra kathaM tAvAn syAdityarthaH| hetvArambhanityaH shubhahetuyo(yA)gAdyArambhaparaH||27||

nAshuciruttamAjyAkShatatilakushasarShapairagniM juhuyAdAtmAnamAshIrbhirAshAsAnaH, agnirme nApagaccheccharIrAdvAyurme prANAnAdadhAtu viShNurme balamAdadhAtu indro me vIryaM shivA mAM pravishantvApa ApohiShThetyapaH spRushet, dviH parimRujyoShThau pAdau cAbhyukShya mUrdhani khAni copaspRushedadbhirAtmAnaM hRudayaM shirashca||28||

Commentary: uttamAjyaM gosarpiH| AshIrbhirAshAsAna iti cchedaH| ‘agnirme’ ityAdinA ‘ApohiShThA’ ityantaH snAnamantraH||28||

iha khalu pa~jcendriyANi, pa~jcendriyadravyANi, pa~jcendriyAdhiShThAnAni, pa~jcendriyArthAH, pa~jcendriyabuddhayo bhavanti, ityuktamindriyAdhikAre||3||

Commentary: iheti iha prakaraNe pa~jcendriyANi, tena prakaraNAntare darshanAntaraparigraheNa vakShyamANaikAdashendriyAbhidhAnena samaM na virodhaH; yataH sarvapAriShadamidaM shAstraM, tenAyurvedAviruddhavaisheShikasA~gkhyAdidarshanabhedena viruddhArtho~abhidhIyamAno na pUrvAparavirodhamAvahatItyarthaH| manastu yadyapi vaisheShikamate~apIndriyaM, shAstrakAreNApi madhurarasaprastAve “ShaDindriyaprasAdanaH” (sU. a.26) ityabhidhAnAdanumatameva, tathA~apIha prakaraNe cakShurAdibhyo vakShyamANAdhikadharmayogitayA nendriyatvena paThitam| indriyAdIni svayameva vyAkariShyati- tatra cakShurityAdinA| ityetAvadevoktamindriyAdhikAre, ‘pUrvAcAryaiH’ iti sheShaH; etenAnyashAstre~apIndriyAdhikAre etAvadevoktamiti phalati||3||

brahmacaryaj~jAnadAnamaitrIkAruNyaharShopekShAprashamaparashca syAditi||29||

Commentary: maitrI sarvabhUteShvAtmanIvApratikUlA pravRuttiH| nanu maitrIparaH syAditi viruddhametat, yena shAstrakAra evAyaM digdhaviddhasvayammRutAdimAMsaparityAgena vayasthatvAdiguNayuktAnAM mRugAdInAM sadyaskaM mAMsaM sevyatvenopadishan sAkShAnmaitrIviruddhAM hiMsAmevAha; naivaM, rAgata eva prANinAM hiMsApUrvakamAMsabhakShaNe prApte~ayamAyurvedopadeShTA mAMsasya kvacidroge kasyaciddhitatvaM kvaciccAhitatvamupadishati, natu mAMsabhakShaNaM hiMsAM vA vidadhAti; na hyayaM madirAyA api svasthavRutte rogivRutte vA hitatvamupadishan madirApAnaM pratyupadeShTA bhavati; evaM ca rogAdhikAre rAjayakShmAdau mAMsopadeshastathA sharadRutucaryAdau “lAvAn kapi~jjalAneNAn” (sU.a.6) ityAdigrantho lAvAdimAMsahitatvopadeshArtho na hiMsAvidhAyakaH; tena rogiNaH svasthAshca hiMsAphalabhAjo bhavantyeva; yathA- “shyenenAbhicaran yajeta” ityatrAbhicArasya kAmata eva prAptatvAcchyenasyAbhicArasAdhanatvamAtrameva vidhirbrUte, tena shyenenAbhicArakaraNe~adharmo bhavatyeva; ayaM tvatra visheShaH- yadi hiMsopArjitamAMsopayogaM vinA puruSho na jIvati, ato hiMsAM karoti, tadA “sarvatrAtmAnaM gopAyIta” iti vedavacanavihitatvAttathAvidhahiMsA na pratyavAyahetuH, jIvanopAyAntarasambhave tu puShTyAdiprayojanA hiMsA pratyavAyahetureva; ki~jca bhavatu vA~a~ayurvedavihitA hiMsA, tathA~api hiMsA doShArthamucyate; na hyAyurvedavidhayo dharmasAdhanamevopadishanti, kiM tarhyArogyasAdhanaM “dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam” (sU.a.1) ityukteH||29||
tatra shlokAH- pa~jcapa~jcakamuddiShTaM mano hetucatuShTayam| indriyopakrame~adhyAye sadvRuttamakhilena ca||30||
svasthavRuttaM yathoddiShTaM yaH samyaganutiShThati| sa samAH shatamavyAdhirAyuShA na viyujyate||31||
nRulokamApUrayate yashasA sAdhusammataH| dharmArthAveti bhUtAnAM bandhutAmupagacchati||32||
parAn sukRutino lokAn puNyakarmA prapadyate| tasmAdvRuttamanuShTheyamidaM sarveNa sarvadA||33||

yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdanuktamiha pUjitam| vRuttaM tadapi cAtreyaH sadaivAbhyanumanyate||34||

Commentary: anuktasadvRuttopasa~ggrahArthamAha- yaccAnyadapItyAdi| vRuttam AcAraH| ihAyurvede~anuktamapyAcAropadeshakeShu dharmashAstreShu pUjitaM, yathA- “nAkasmAdvikaco bhavenna parashasyeShu gAM carantIM dhAvantIM vA parasya brUyAt” ityAdi, sarvamAtreyasyAnumataM sAkShAdAyurvedAviShayatvena granthavistarabhayAcca na proktamityabhiprAyaH|||34||

atIndriyaM punarmanaH sattvasa~jj~jakaM, ‘cetaH’ ityAhureke, tadarthAtmasampadAyattaceShTaM ceShTApratyayabhUtamindriyANAm||4||

Commentary: cakShurAdibhyo vishiShTena dharmeNa mano darshayati- atIndriyamityAdi| atikrAntamindriyamatIndriyaM; cakShurAdInAM yadindriyatvaM bAhyaj~jAnakAraNatvaM, tadatikrAntamityarthaH; yadyapi mano~api sukhAdij~jAnaM prati kAraNatvenendriyaM, tathA~apIndriyacakShurAdyadhiShThAyakatvavisheShAdatIndriyamityuktaM; yadi vA~atIndriyamiti cakShurAdibhyo~apyatIndriyebhyaH sUkShmataraM, duravabodhAt| sattvamityeShA sa~jj~jA yasya tattathA| ceta ityAhureka iti paramatasyApratiShedhAt svayamapyanumatam| paryAyakathanaM shAstre vyavahArArtham| taditi manaH, artho mano~arthaH, sa ca sukhAdishcintyavicAryAdishca, AtmA cetanapratisandhAtA, anayoH sampat tadarthAtmasampat, etadAyattA ceShTA vyApAro yasya tattathA; tatrArthasampat sukhAdInAM sannikarShashcintyAdInAmAbhimukhyaM ca, AtmasampadarthagrahaNe prayatnashAlitvaM, manashceShTA ca sukhAdij~jAnaM tathA cintyacintanAdi tathA cakShurAdIndriyapreraNaM ca| indriyANAM cakShurAdInAM yA ceShTA svaviShayarUpAdij~jAnalakShaNA, tatra pratyayabhUtaM kAraNabhUtaM mana iti yojyam| etenaitaduktaM bhavati- yadA sukhAdayashcintyAdayo~api viShayA bhavantyA~a~atmA ca prayatnavAn bhavati tadA manaH svaviShaye pravartate, indriyANi cAdhitiShThati, indriyANi ca mano~adhiShThitAnyeva svaviShayaj~jAne pravartante||4||

svArthendriyArthasa~gkalpavyabhicaraNAccAnekamekasmin puruShe sattvaM, rajastamaHsattvaguNayogAcca; na cAnekatvaM, nahyekaM hyekakAlamanekeShu pravartate ; tasmAnnaikakAlA sarvendriyapravRuttiH||5||

Commentary: idAnIM tanmana ekasmin puruShe upAdhibhedAdanekaM paramArthatastvekamiti darshayati- svArthetyAdi| sattvaM manaH| anekam anekamiva, svArthendriyArthasa~gkalpavyabhicaraNAt tathA rajastamaHsattvaguNayogAcca| cakAraH parasparasamuccaye| svArthasya mano~arthasya cintyasya vyabhicaraNAdekaM cintyamarthaM parityajyAnyasyArthasya grahaNAdityarthaH; etenaitaduktaM bhavati- yadekameva mano yadA dharmaM cintayettadA dharmacintakaM, yadA dharmaM parityajya tadeva kAmaM cintayati tadA kAmacintakam, ityevamAdinA dharmabhedenAbhinnamapi bhinnamabhidhIyate; evamindriyArthavyabhicaraNe~api yadA rUpaM gRuhNAti tadA rUpagrAhakaM, yadA gandhaM gRuhNAti tadA gandhagrAhakamityAdi vAcyam; evaM sa~gkalpavyabhicaraNe~api vyAkhyeyaM, tatra sa~gkalpaH pratipannAnAM bhAvAnAmupakArakaM mamedamapakArakaM mamedamiti vA guNato doShato vA kalpanam; etadvyabhicaraNe ca kadAcidguNakalpakaM kadAciddoShakalpakamiti manobhedo vyAkhyeyaH| tathA ekapuruShe ekameva mano yadA bahurajoyuktaM bhavati tadA krodhAdimadbhavati, yadA bahutamoyuktaM bhavati tadA~aj~jAnabhayAdimadbhavati, yadA sattvayuktaM bhavati tadA satyashaucAdiyuktaM bhavati, tatashcAnekamiva mano bhavati| tadetat pratipAditamanekatvaM paramArthato na bhavatItyAha- na cetyAdi| na cAnekatvaM manasa ityarthaH| cakArAdamahattvaM ca manasa iti samuccinoti| yaduktam- “aNutvamatha caikatvaM dvau guNau manasaH smRutau” (shA.a.1) iti| kuto nAnekatvamityAha- na hItyAdi| anekamekakAlamanekeShu pravartate; anekaM yanmanaH devadattayaj~jadattaviShNumitreShu sharIriShu dRuShTaM tadekakAlaM yugapadanekeShu rUpaj~jAnashabdaj~jAnagandhaj~jAneShu vartate evaM dRuShTaM, tadyadi ekapuruShe~api bahUni manAMsi syustadA tAnyapi yugapadekapuruSha eva rUpAdij~jAneShu pravarteran, na tu pravartante, tasmAdekamevaikapuruShe mana ityarthaH| dIrghAM shaShkulIM bhakShayato yugapat pa~jcaj~jAnAnyutpadyanta iti tu j~jAnaM yugapadutpalapatrashatavyaktibhedaj~jAnavadbhrAntam| paramArthato yugapajj~jAnotpattau hi sati viShayasannikarShe sarvadaiva hi yugapajj~jAnAni syuH| ata eva hi kAraNAnmahattvamapi manaso nAsti, mahattve hi sati yugapatpa~jcendriyAdhiShThAnAjj~jAnotpattiH syAt, na ca bhavati, tasmAdekamaNu ca mana iti| yasmAccaikapuruShe ekaM mano~aNuparimANaM ca, tasmAt kAraNAnnaikakAlA sarvendriyapravRuttiH na yugapadindriyANi svaviShayopalabdhau pravartanta ityarthaH| indriyANi mano~adhiShThitAni pravartante, tena yadA manashcakShuradhitiShThati tadA na ghrANAdIni, evaM yadA ghrANamadhitiShThati tadA na cakShurAdIni||5||

yadguNaM cAbhIkShNaM puruShamanuvartate sattvaM tatsattvamevopadishanti munayo bAhulyAnushayAt||6||

Commentary: nanu yadyekasminneva puruShe kadAcidrajoyuktaM kadAcittamoyuktaM kadAcit sattvayuktaM mano bhavati, tat kathamayaM sAttviko~ayaM rAjasa ityAdivyapadesho bhavatItyAha- yadguNamityAdi| yena guNena sattvAdinA yuktaM yadguNam, abhIkShNaM punaH punaH, sattvaM manaH, anuvartate~anubadhnAti, tatsattvaM sAttvikaM rAjasaM tAmasaM vA upadishanti, bAhulyAnushayAt bhUrisambandhAdityarthaH| etaduktaM bhavati- satyapi guNAntarAnvaye sattvabAhulyAt sattvakAryANi satyashaucAdIni yasya bhavanti sa sAttvika iti vyapadishyate; evamaparamapi vyAkhyeyam||6||

manaHpuraHsarANIndriyANyarthagrahaNasamarthAni bhavanti||7||

Commentary: uktaM manashceShTApratyayabhUtamindriyANAM tadvyAkaroti- mana ityAdi| manaHpuraHsarANi manodhiShThitAni||7||

tatra cakShuH shrotraM ghrANaM rasanaM sparshanamiti pa~jcendriyANi||8||

Commentary: pa~jcendriyANItyuktaM tadvivRuNoti- tatra cakShurityAdi| caShTe rUpaM rUpavantaM ca prakAshayatIti cakShuH| taccobhayanayagolakAdhiShThAnamekameva| shRuNotyaneneti shrotram| jighratyaneneti ghrANam| rasatyAsvAdayatyaneneti rasanam| spRushatyaneneti sparshanam||8||

pa~jcendriyadravyANi- khaM vAyurjyotirApo bhUriti||9||

Commentary: indriyANAM prAdhAnyenArambhakaM dravyamindriyadravyam; indriyeShu cakShurAdau nirdiShTaM, prAdhAnyAt| yaduktaM shAlAkye- “shrotratvakghrANarasanaiH shreShThairapi samanvitaH | balavarNAdyupeto~api naShTadRuk kuDyasannibhaH” iti| indriyadravyanirdeshe tu uditatvena nirdeshaH kRuto vakShyamANena “mahAbhUtAni khaM vAyuragnirApaH kShitistathA” (shA.a.1) iti granthakramAnurodhena||9||

pa~jcendriyAdhiShThAnAni- akShiNI karNau nAsike jihvA tvak ceti||10||

Commentary: indriyAdhiShThAnamindriyAshrayaH| yadyapi cAkShiNI karNau nAsApuTe dve tathA~apyekendriyAdhiShThAnatvenaikameveti kRutvA “pa~jca” ityuktam||10||
iti svasthacatuShko dvitIyaH||2||

svasthAdhikAre AhArAcAraceShTAsu paraM prayatnamAtiShThedityuktaM, tatrAhAraceShTAH kAshcit pUrvAdhyAyatrayeNa pratipAditAH, tenAvashiShTasyAcArasyAbhidhAnArthaM tathendriyamanasAmatiyogAyogamithyAyogaparihArarUpaceShTopadarshanArthaM cendriyopakramaNIyamAha| tatrApi vakShyamANaceShTAcArayoH prAyeNendriyAdiviShayatvenendriyAdInyeva tAvadAha| indriyasyopakramaNaM vyAkartumArambhaH, tamindriyopakramamindriyavyAkaraNamadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAya indriyopakramaNIyaH||1-2||
abhyuditAsu dikShu dAhavatIShu dikShu| mahAgrahopagamanaM candrasUryagrahaNam| avapatitaM hInavarNam| tAntaM rUkShasvaram| atiklIbam ativilambitoccAraNam||23-24||

sa~ggrahe hetucatuShTayaM samAtihInamithyAyogAH| samAH shataM varShashataM; yadyapi sadvRuttAnuShThAne~api daivaviparyayeNAntarA maraNaM vyAdhayo vA bhavanti, tathA~api prAdhAnyAddaivakRutavyAdheH puruShAparAdhAviShayatvAduktaM samAH shatamityAdi; yaduktaM- “parihAryANi yatnena sadA pariharannaraH| bhavatyanRuNatAM prAptaH sAdhUnAmiha paNDitaH” (sU.a.28) iti||30-33||
athAtaH khuDDAkacatuShpAdamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
paktau hi kAraNaM pakturyathA pAtrendhanAnalAH| vijeturvijaye bhUmishcamUH praharaNAni ca||11||
AturAdyAstathA siddhau pAdAH kAraNasa~jj~jitAH| vaidyasyAtashcikitsAyAM pradhAnaM kAraNaM bhiShak||12||

mRuddaNDacakrasUtrAdyAH kumbhakArAdRute yathA| nAvahanti guNaM vaidyAdRute pAdatrayaM tathA||13||

Commentary: samprati vyatirekadRuShTAntena vaidyaprAdhAnyaM darshayati- mRuddaNDetyAdinA| nAvahanti na niShpAdayanti| guNaM sAdhyamityarthaH||13||

gandharvapuravannAshaM yadvikArAH sudAruNAH| yAnti yaccetare vRuddhimAshUpAyapratIkShiNaH||14||

Commentary: anvayena vyatirekeNa ca pRuthagdRuShTAntaM darshayitvA kaushalenaikatraiva dRuShTAnte gandharvapuretyAdinA~anvaye guNaM vyatireke ca doShaM darshayati| ekatrapakShe nAshamAshu yAntIti sambandhaH, itare apare~anabhij~javaidyopakrAntA gandharvapuravadAshu vRuddhiM yAntIti sambandhaH| upAyapratIkShiNa iti vRuddhau shAntau ca| Ashu vikArashAntau j~jo bhiShakkAraNam, AshuvRuddhau cAj~jaH||14||-
varamAtmA huto~aj~jena na cikitsA pravartitA||15||
pANicArAdyathA~acakShuraj~jAnAdbhItabhItavat| naurmArutavashevAj~jo bhiShak carati karmasu||16||

yadRucchayA samApannamuttArya niyatAyuSham| bhiSha~gmAnI nihantyAshu shatAnyaniyatAyuShAm||17||

Commentary: yadRucchayeti vaidyasamyagj~jAnapUrvakapravRuttiM vinA karmavashAdityarthaH| samApannaM samyagupakrAntam| niyatAyuShamityanenAyurbalenaiva vyAdhimuttIryamANamityarthaH | AtmAnamabhiShajaM bhiShaktvena manyata iti bhiSha~gmAnI| aniyatAyuShAmiti yatrAyuHkAraNaM balavat karma nAsti, tatra puruShakArAparAdhena vaidyadoShAnmaraNaM bhavatIti darshayati||17||

tasmAcchAstre~arthavij~jAne pravRuttau karmadarshane| bhiShak catuShTaye yuktaH prANAbhisara ucyate||18||

Commentary: shAstre shAstrAvadhAraNe | arthavij~jAne shAstrArthAvabodhe| pravRuttau svayaM karmakaraNe| yukta udyukta udyoganiShpAditaguNaprakarSha iti yAvat| prANAn gacchato vyAvartayatIti prANAbhisaraH||18||
hetau li~gge prashamane rogANAmapunarbhave| j~jAnaM caturvidhaM yasya sa rAjArho bhiShaktamaH||19||
shastraM shAstrANi salilaM guNadoShapravRuttaye| pAtrApekShINyataH praj~jAM cikitsArthaM vishodhayet||20||
vidyA vitarko vij~jAnaM smRutistatparatA kriyA| yasyaite ShaDguNAstasya na sAdhyamativartate||21||
vidyA matiH karmadRuShTirabhyAsaH siddhirAshrayaH| vaidyashabdAbhiniShpattAvalamekaikamapyataH||22||
yasya tvete guNAH sarve santi vidyAdayaH shubhAH| sa vaidyashabdaM sadbhUtamarhan prANisukhapradaH||23||
shAstraM jyotiH prakAshArthaM darshanaM buddhirAtmanaH| tAbhyAM bhiShak suyuktAbhyAM cikitsannAparAdhyati||24||
cikitsite trayaH pAdA yasmAdvaidyavyapAshrayaH| tasmAt prayatnamAtiShThedbhiShak svaguNasampadi||25||

maitrI kAruNyamArteShu shakye prItirupekShaNam| prakRutistheShu bhUteShu vaidyavRuttishcaturvidheti||26||

Commentary: vaidyena ca yAdRushyA buddhyA vyavahartavyaM, tAM darshayati- maitrItyAdi| maitrI pUrvameva vyAkRutA| ArteShu ArtiyukteShu| kAruNyaM paraduHkhaprahANecchA| shakye sAdhayituM shakye, sAdhyavyAdhigRuhIta iti yAvat| prakRutiriha maraNaM, prakRutirucyate svabhAvaH; tathA- “idamasmAnmuhUrtAt....svabhAvamApatsyate” (sU.a.30), maraNamityarthaH; maraNasamIpagatatvAducyate “prakRutisthe” iti| tasminnupekShA kartavyA; na tatra bheShajadAnAdi kartavyaM, yashohAnyAdibhayAt||26||
tatra shlokau- bhiShagjitaM catuShpAdaM pAdaH pAdashcaturguNaH| bhiShak pradhAnaM pAdebhyo yasmAdvaidyastu yadguNaH||27||
j~jAnAni buddhirbrAhmI ca bhiShajAM yA caturvidhA| sarvametaccatuShpAde khuDDAke samprakAshitamiti||28||

bhiShagdravyANyupasthAtA rogI pAdacatuShTayam| guNavat kAraNaM j~jeyaM vikAravyupashAntaye||3||
