Commentary: atra bhiShagAdAvuktaH pradhAnatvAt, vakShyati hi- “pradhAnaM bhiShagatra tu” iti; tadanu bheShajaM, cikitsAyAM pradhAnakAraNabhUtatvAt; tadanu paricArakaH, bheShajaprayogasya kalkakvAthAdisAdhyasya tadadhInatvAt| yadyapyAturAdhikaraNamArogyaM pAdaiH sampAdyate , sa eva ca vaidyAdInAmupakAryaH, upakAryashca pradhAnaM bhavati, tathA~apIha vyAdhiprashame sAdhye yathA vaidyAdipAdatrayasya vyApAro na tathA~a~aturasyetyaprAdhAnyavivakShayA pashcAduktaH| pAdashcaturtho bhAgaH, shlokAdipAdavadvaidyAdiShu pAdasa~jj~jAkaraNenAnyataravaikalyenApi cikitsA na bhavatIti darshayati| guNavaditi vakShyamANa-shruteparyavadAtatvAdiguNavat| iha ca vaidyAdayo vyApriyamANA eva vikAraprashamane kAraNaM bhavanti, yataH kAraNatvaM kArye vyApAravatAmeva bhavati; tathA hi- devadattaH pAcaka ityukte tuShabusaprakShepAdikriyayaiva pAkaM karotIti gamyate; etena yaducyate- “caturNAM bhiShagAdInAM” ityAdinA shlokena vaidyAdInAM pravRuttishcikitsA vyAdhiprashamaheturabhidhAtavyA, iha tu vaidyAdaya eveti pUrvAparavirodhaH; tanna bhavati, iha vaidyAdipravRuttervaidyAdigrahaNenaiva grahaNAt| caturNAmityAdau shloke vaidyAdInAM dharmiNAM dharmarUpAyAshca pravRutterbhedaM puraskRutya cikitsAyAH kriyArUpAyAH kathanam| ete vaidyAdayo vikArashamane kAraNameveti niyamaH, na punaretaireva vikAraprashamanamiti niyamaH, yato vaidyAdIn pratyAkhyAyApi rogashAntirbhavati; vakShyati hi mahAcatuShpAde- “ye hyAturAH kevalAdbheShajAdRute samuttiShThante” (sU.a.10) ityAdinA||3||

vikAro dhAtuvaiShamyaM, sAmyaM prakRutirucyate| sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyaM, vikAro duHkhameva ca||4||

Commentary: atra vikAravyupashAntaya ityuktaM, tena vikArasvarUpaj~jAnArthamAha- vikAro dhAtuvaiShamyamityAdi| dhAtavo vAtAdayo rasAdayashca tathA rajaHprabhRutayashca, teShAM vaiShamyaM vyavahriyamANasvAsthyahetoH svamAnAnnyUnatvamadhikatvaM vA| sAmyaM dhAtusAmyaM; prakRutiH Arogyam| ucyategrahaNAdvaidyakasiddhAnte hIyaM prakRutivikAravyavasthA, anyadarshanasiddhAntaparigrahe tu vikAraH ShoDashakaH, prakRutirguNAnAM sAmyAvasthA bhavatIti darshayati| nanu, rAtridinabhojanAnAM tAsu tAsvavasthAsu shleShmaprakopAdinA nityaM dhAtuvaiShamyamasti, tatkuto dhAtusAmyamityAha- sukhasa~jj~jakamityAdi| sukhahetuH sukham, evaM duHkhaheturduHkhaM; yato na duHkhaM vyAdhiH, tathA hi sati na jvarAdInAM vyAdhitvaM syAt; ata eva sushrute~apyuktaM- “tattu saptavidhe vyAdhAvupanipatati” (su.sU. a.24) iti; sa~jj~jakagrahaNAt paramArthato~asukhamapi loke sukhamiti yad vyavahriyate, tadiha gRuhyata iti darshayati; tena, divArAtribhojanAvasthAdijanitaM dhAtuvaiShamyamudvejakavikArAkartRutvena sukhamiti vyavahriyate, tena yo hyalpaH sa nAstyeveti kRutvA~alpe~api dhAtuvaiShamye dhAtusAmyavyavahAraH siddho bhavati; tathA sa~jj~jakagrahaNena laukikasukhaM na paramArthataH sukhamiti darshayati, yato vakShyati “sarvaM kAraNavadduHkhaM” (shA. a.1) ityAdi; ‘eva ca’ grahaNena duHkhaM paramArthato~api duHkhameveti darshayati, na sukhamiva vyavahAramAtreNa| atra ca dhAtuvaiShamyeNa kAraNenopacArAttatkAryajvarAdayo~abhidhIyante, yato dhAtuvaiShamyajo hi vikAro na dhAtuvaiShamyamAtraM, yadvakShyati- “svadhAtuvaiShamyanimittajA ye vikArasa~gghA bahavaH sharIre” (sU. a.19) ityAdi, tathA “vikRutimApannA nAnAvidhairvikAraiH sharIramupatapanti” (vi. a.1) ityAdi, tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “vAtapittakaphashoNitasannipAtavaiShamyanimittAH ” (sU.a.1) iti| atra pakShe dhAtuvaiShamyajashcedvikArastadA janitavikAraM dhAtuvaiShamyaM kva pravishatu; kiM vikAre, uta Arogye? na tAvadArogye, yataH “ityuktaM kAraNaM kAryaM dhAtusAmyamihocyate| dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam” (sU. a.1) ityanena granthenArogyaM dhAtusAmyamityuktaM; na ca roge pravishati, rogahetutvenaiva kathitatvAt; atha mataM dhAtuvaiShamyaM bhavati, vikAro na bhavatIti; eShA dashA nAstyeva; yato~avashyaM pramANAdhiko doShaH svali~ggAdhiko bhavati, kShINo vA kShINasvalakShaNa iti; iha tarhi dhAtuvaiShamyameva vikAro~astu, evamayaM grantho~api mukhyo bhavati; dhAtuvaiShamyajavikArapratipAdakastu grantha AviShkRutatamajvarAdipratipAdakatvena vyavasthApyatAM, tena dhAtuvaiShamyaM ca dhAtuvaiShamyajAshca jvarAdayo vikArA bhavanti; dhAtuvaiShamyajAteShvapi hi jvarAdiShu dhAtuvaiShamyarUpatA~astyeva; ki~jca svamAnakShINA doShAH ki~jcidvikAraM na janayanti, kShINalakShaNaM vaiShamyameva paraM yAnti; vacanaM hi- “kShINA jahati li~ggaM svaM samAH svaM karma kurvate” (sU.a.7) iti; nAtra dhAtuvaiShamyamAtraM vikAra iti bruvatAmayaM panthAH; ye tu dhAtuvaiShamyajo vikAra iti vyavasthitAH, te tvajanitavyapadeshyavikAraM dhAtuvaiShamyaM rAtridinAvasthAdikRutadhAtuvaiShamyavadalpatvenAvyapadeshyatayA dhAtusAmya eva prakShipantIti; tilakAlakamaShakaprabhRutInAM tu dhAtuvaiShamyajatveneha carake rogatvaM suvyaktameva, duHkhahetutvaM ca teShAM j~jAtAnAM manoduHkhakartRutvena||4||

caturNAM bhiShagAdInAM shastAnAM dhAtuvaikRute| pravRuttirdhAtusAmyArthA cikitsetyabhidhIyate||5||

Commentary: vikAralakShaNAnantaraM vikAraprashamahetoshcikitsAyA lakShaNamAha- caturNAmityAdi| caturNAmiti padaM vaidyAdInAM militAnAmeva grAhakam| shastAnAmiti vakShyamANashrute paryavadAtatvamityAdiguNayogena prashastAnAm| dhAtuvaikRute roge cikitsAdhikaraNabhUte| dhAtusAmyArthA ArogyakaraNArthetyarthaH| dhAtuvaikRuta iti padaM spaShTArthaM, yena dhAtusAmyArthA pravRuttirdhAtuvaikRute eva vaidyAdInAM bhavati| pravRuttirvaidyasya idaM kartavyamidaM na kartavyamityAdikopadesharUpA, dravyasya tUpayoge sati svakAryArambharUpA, paricArakapravRuttirbheShajasaMskaraNAturaparicaryAdirUpA, AturapravRuttirvaidyoktAnuShThAnavyAdhisvarUpakathanAdikA||5||

shrute paryavadAtatvaM bahusho dRuShTakarmatA| dAkShyaM shaucamiti j~jeyaM vaidye guNacatuShTayam||6||

Commentary: pUrvasUtritavaidyaguNAn darshayati- shruta ityAdi| shrutamAdau shreShThavaidyaguNatvAt, evamanyatrApi vyAkhyeyam| paryavadAtatvaM vishuddhaj~jAnavattvaM gurushAstrasevanAdinA| shaucamadRuShTadvAropakArakam| jitahastatvAdayo~apare~api vaidyaguNA atraiva guNacatuShTaye~antarbhAvanIyAH||6||

bahutA tatrayogyatvamanekavidhakalpanA| sampacceti catuShko~ayaM dravyANAM guNa ucyate||7||

Commentary: bahutA bheShajaguNaH, alpaM hi bheShajaM guNavadapyavidyamAnamiva, asAdhakatvAt| tatra pratikartavye vyAdhau yogyatvaM tatrayogyatvam| anekavidhakalpanA nAnAprakArasvarasAdyupayuktakalpanAyogyatvamityarthaH; yataH prANinaH kecit svarasadviShaH, kecit kalkadviSha evamAdi; evaM vyAdhisvabhAvAdapi kAcit kalpanA hitA bhavati, yathA- jvare kaShAya ityAdi; tenAnekakalpanAyogyatvAdyadyatra yujyate tattatra kriyate| sampaditi krimisalilAdyanupahatatvena rasAdisampat||7||

upacAraj~jatA dAkShyamanurAgashca bhartari| shaucaM ceti catuShko~ayaM guNaH paricare jane||8||

Commentary: upacAraj~jatA yUSharasAdikaraNasaMvAhanasvApanAdij~jatA||8||

smRutirnirdeshakAritvamabhIrutvamathApi ca| j~jApakatvaM ca rogANAmAturasya guNAH smRutAH||9||

Commentary: nirdeshakAritvaM vaidyopadiShTArthakartRutvam| abhIrutvaM guNaH, bhIrutvasya rogakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “viShAdo rogavardhanAnAM” (sU.a.25) iti| athApi cetishabdena kvacidbhIrutvamapyasmRutirapi guNo bhavatIti darshayati; yathonmAde “sarpeNoddhRutadaMShTreNa” ityAdinA trAsanamuktaM cikitsAyAM, tatra yadyapyabhIruH syAdrogI tadA cikitsA na phalati; asmRutistu jvaravegAgamanakAlAsmaraNe~abhipretA, yaduktaM- “jvaravegaM ca kAlaM ca cintaya~jjvaryate tu yaH| tasyeShTaishca vicitraishca prayogairnAshayet smRutim” (ci.a.3) iti||9||

kAraNaM ShoDashaguNaM siddhau pAdacatuShTayam| vij~jAtA shAsitA yoktA pradhAnaM bhiShagatra tu||10||

Commentary: evaM vaidyAdInAM caturNAmapi kAraNatve siddhe vaidyasya prAdhAnyaM darshayati- kAraNamityAdi| vij~jAtA auShadhasya| shAsitA paricArakasya- evaM kurvevaM mA kurviti| yoktA Aturasya| etena vaidyaparAdhInA bheShajAdInAM pravRuttiH, vaidyastu svatantraH, tatashca vaidyaH pradhAnamiti vAkyArthaH||10||

svasthacatuShkAnantaraM svasthAturayorubhayorapi hitatvena nirdeshacatuShko~abhidhIyate| svasthAturahitaM vaidyabheShajAdi nirdishatIti nirdeshacatuShkaH, tatrApi svasthAturahiteShu pradhAnabhUtacikitsA~ggavaidyAdipAdacatuShTayAbhidhAyakatvena khuDDAkacatuShpAdo~abhidhIyate| khuDDAkashabdo~alpavacanaH; yathA- khuDDikA garbhAvakrAntiH, alpetyarthaH| vaidyauShadhaparicArakarogiNashcikitsAyAshcatvAraH pAdAH, catuShpAdaM taM khuDDAkamabhidheyatayA~adhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyaH khuDDAkacatuShpAdaH| atrotpannasya tu pratyayasya “adhyAyAnuvAkayorluk ca” (pA.a.5pA.2sU.60) iti luk| khuDDAkatvaM cAsya vakShyamANamahAcatuShpAdamapekShya||1-2||

etadevAbhyarhitatvAddRuShTAntadvayena darshayati- paktAvityAdi| paktau pAke kartavye, pAtrasthAnIya AturaH, paricAraka indhanarUpaH, analo bheShajarUpaH| kAraNamiti upakaraNam| bhUmiH yuddhAnuguNo deshaH| atrApi pUrvavadevAturAdisthAnIyatvaM bhUmyAdInAm||11-12||
aj~javaidyasya cikitsApravRuttiM niShedhayati- varamityAdi| na varam anucitameva| pravartitetibhAShayA aj~javaidyena balAt kRuteti darshayati| pANicArAt hastaparAmarshAt| karmasu cikitsAsu||15-16||

pAtrApekShINIti guNavati pAtre saguNAni, doShavati pAtre doShavanti bhavantItyarthaH| vishodhayet sadgurusacchAstrasevAdibhirityarthaH| vidyA vaidyakashAstraj~jAnam| vitarkaH shAstramUla UhApohaH| vij~jAnaM shAstrAntaraj~jAnaM; kiMvA sahajaM vishuddhaM j~jAnam| tatparateha vyAdhicikitsAyAM prayatnAtishayatvam| kriyA punaH punashcikitsAkaraNam| matiH sahajavishuddhamatiH| abhyAsaH karmAbhyAsaH| siddhiH prAyasho vyAdhiprashamakatvam| AshrayaH sadgurvAshraya ityarthaH| vaidyashabdAbhiniShpattAvityanena pAramArthikavaidyatvaniShpattAviti darshayati| eta ityanenaiva labdhe~api vidyAdaya iti vacanaM pUrvoktaguNavyudAsArthaM, tadvyudAsashca vidyAdiShvevAntarbhAvanIyaH; etacca prabandhena pRuthak pRuthagguNakathanaM vaidyasya guNotpAdane yatnAtishayaM kArayituM tathA dravyAdibhyaH pAdebhyo vaidyasyaiva pradhAnatopadarshanArthaM; vaidyo hi pAdatrayaM viguNamapi kalpanayA shikShayA mantraNena ca sampAdya cikitsituM pArayati, natu guNavadvaidyaM vinA dravyAdayaH pAdA guNavanto~api kShamAH||19-23||

shAstrashabdena shAstrAbhyAsakRutA matiH, sA hi jyotiH bAhyAloka iva, prakAshArthaM vastUnAM grahaNayogyatAM kartumityarthaH| darshanamiva darshanaM cakShurivetyarthaH| yadyapi buddhirAtmana eva bhavati, tathA~apyAtmana ityanena sahajAM buddhiM darshayati, yataH sahajAM buddhiM vinA shAstrajA buddhiryA vainAyakItyabhidhIyate, sA na samyakcikitsAsamarthA bhavatIti| tAbhyAmiti sahajavishuddhabuddhishAstrAbhyAM sahajavainAyakabuddhibhyAm||24-25||
sa~ggrahe brAhmI buddhiH caturvidhA maitrIkAruNyAdikA||27-28||
athAto jvaranidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

samprAptirjAtirAgatirityanarthAntaraM vyAdheH||11||

Commentary: yadyapi samprAptyanantaraM li~ggaprAdurbhAvaH, tathA~api samprAptervyAdhinirUpaNaM pratyalpaprayojanatvAccheShataH samprAptimAha- samprAptirityAdi| jAtiH janma; samprAtpyAgatijAtishabdairyo~artho~abhidhIyate sA vyAdheH samprAptirityarthaH| a(ta)traike vyAdhijanmamAtramantyakAraNavyApArajanyaM samprAptimAhuH| iyaM ca samprAptiryadyapi nidAnAdivad vyAdhibodhikA na bhavati, tathA~api nAnutpannasya vyAdherlakShaNaM bhavatIti kRutvA upapattervyAdhyupalambhakatvaM varNayanti| etaccAnye na manyante, yato naivaM sati samprAptitaH kashcidvisheSho vyAdheradhigamyate| na cAyaM niyamaH- yadutpanna eva paraM vyAdhirupalabhyate, yato nidAnapUrvarUpAbhyAmanutpanno~api vyAdhirbhAvitvena budhyate| tasmAd vyAdhijanakadoShavyApAravisheShayuktaM vyAdhijanmeha samprAptishabdena vAcyam, ata eva paryAye ‘AgatiH’ ityuktam| Agatirhi utpAdakAraNasya vyAdhijananaparyantaM gamanam| iyaM ca samprAptirvyAdhivisheShaM bodhayatveva| yathA jvare- ‘sa yadA prakupitaH pravishyAmAshayam’ ityArabhya ‘tadA jvaramabhinirvartayati’ ityantena yA samprAptirucyate, tayA jvarasyAmAshayadUShakatvAgnyupaghAtakatvarasadUShakatvAdayo dharmAH pratIyante| na ca vAcyaM- doShANAmayamAmAshayadUShakatvAdirdharmaH , tatashca kAraNadharmANAM nidAnagrahaNenaiva grahaNaM bhavatIti; yataH, kAraNadharmo~apyayaM vyAdhijanakadoShavyApArarUpaH samprAptishabdena visheShabodhanArthaM pRuthak kRutvocyate; yathA- li~ggatvAvisheShe~api bhAvivyAdhibodhakatvavisheShAt pUrvarUpaM pRuthagucyate, ata eva vAgbhaTe~apyevameva samprAptilakShaNamuktaM- “yathAduShTena doSheNa yathA cAnuvisarpatA| nirvRuttirAmayasyAsau samprAptirjAtirAgatiH ” (vA. ni.a.1) iti||11||

balakAlavisheShaH punarvyAdhInAmRutvahorAtrAhArakAlavidhiviniyato bhavati||12||

Commentary: samprati samprApteH prativyAdhivyaktibhinnAyAH sarvatra vyAdhau tatprayojanAbhAvAnna bhedo vaktavyaH, yastUpayukto bhavati samprAptivisheShastamabhidhAsyatyeva, “sa yadA prakupitaH pravishyAmAshayam” ityAdinA granthena; ataH sarvasamprAptyanabhidhAnAnnyUnatAdoShaparihArArthaM sarvavyAdhisAdhAraNAn samprAptibhedAnAha- sA sa~gkhyetyAdi|- sA samprAptiH sa~gkhyAdibhirbhidyate iti sa~gkhyAdibhinne vyAdhau bhinnA bhavatItyarthaH; yato na bhinnAnAM bhAvAnAmabhinnotpattirbhavati, kintarhi bhinnaiva bhavati; yadyapi ca prativyAdhi vyaktA~api samprAptirbhinnaiva bhavati, tathA~api sa bhedaH samprApteriha prayojanAbhAvAnnocyate; yataH, sa~gkhyAprAdhAnyavidhyAditulyAsu jvaravyaktiShu ekarUpanidAnali~ggacikitsitAsu bhedapratipAdane na ki~jcit prayojanamasti, sa~gkhyAdibhinne tu jvarAdau nidAnali~ggacikitsAbhedo~asti, ataH sa~gkhyAdibhedajanakAyAH samprApterbhedakathanamucitameva||12(1)|| sa~gkhyAbhedamudAharati- sa~gkhyA tAvadityAdi| yadyapi prAdhAnyAdibhedabhinne~api vyAdhau sa~gkhyAbhedo~astyeva, tathA~apIha yaiva shAstrasiddhA aShTaudarIyAdipratipAditA sa~gkhyA saiva sa~gkhyAshabdena prAptA| ata evAShTau jvarA ityabhidhAya dvividhaM shoNitapittamiti kramAt prAptaM raktapittaM nodAhRutaM; yataH dvividhatvaM hi raktapittasya vidhibhede pravishati na sa~gkhyAyAM, ‘dvividhaM shoNitapittam’ iti vidhishabdenaivoktatvAt||12(2)|| prAdhAnyaM punarityAdau taratamAbhyAmiti taratamashabdAbhidheyAbhyAM vRuddhibhyAm| taratamashabdayorviShayaM vibhajate- dvayorityAdi|- dvayostara iti dvayordoShayorvRuddhayostaraprayogo bhavati- vRuddhatara iti| evaM triShu tama iti triShu doSheShu vRuddheShu satsu tamaprayogo bhavati- vRuddhatama iti| tadevaM dvandvArabdhe vikAre~anyataradoShasya tarashabdalakShitena prAdhAnyena samprAptirbhidyate, tathA tridoShArabdhe vikAre tamashabdalakShitAnyatamadoShaprAdhAnyAt samprAptirbhidyate, ityuktaM bhavati||12(3)|| samprAptibhedaM kramAgataM vidhimAha- vidhirnAma dvividhA vyAdhayo nijAgantubhedenetyAdinA| vidhiriti vidhikRuta ityarthaH| tena dvividhatvAdayo bhedA yato bhavanti sa vidhiH; vidhishca prakAro bheda ityarthaH| sAdhyAsAdhyamRududAruNabhedeneti sAdhyAsAdhyagatena mRududAruNabhedena; tena, mRudusAdhyaM sukhasAdhyaM, dAruNasAdhyaM kRucchrasAdhyaM rohiNIvalayAdi, tathA mRudvasAdhyaM yApyaM, dAruNAsAdhyaM pratyAkhyeyamiti bhedacatuShTam| yadyapi ca sa~gkhyAprAdhAnyAdikRuto~api vyAdhervidhibhedo bhavatyeva, tathA~api sa~gkhyAdibhedAnAM svasa~jj~jayaiva gRuhItatvAdgobalIvardanyAyAt sa~gkhyAdyagRuhIte vyAdhiprakAre~ayaM vidhishabdo vartanIyaH||12(4)|| kramAgataM vikalpamAha- samavetAnAmityAdi|- samavetAnAmiti sarveShAM; tena, ekasho dvisho militAnAM ca doShANAM grahaNam| aMshamaMshaM prati balamaMshAMshabalaM, tasya vikalpa utkarShApakarSharUpoM~ashAMshabalavikalpaH; evambhUto doShANAmaMshAMshabalavikalpo~asminnartha iti asmin prakaraNe vikalpa ucyate| prakaraNAntare tu vikalpashabdena bhedamAtramucyate; yathA- “vikalpo na tvasAdhyAnAM” (sU.a.10) ityAdAviti bhAvaH| tatra doShANAmaMshAMshavikalpo yathA- vAte prakupite~api kadAcidvAtasya shItAMsho balavAn bhavati, kadAcillaghvaMshaH, kadAcidrUkShAMshaH, kadAcillaghurUkShAMsha ityAdi; evaM pittakaphayorapyudAhAryoM~ashAMshavikalpaH; ayaM cAMshAMshabalavikalpo doShANAM shItAdiguNodbhUtahetubhedAdbhavati||12(5)|| balakAlavisheShamAha- baletyAdi|- balasya kAlo balakAlaH, tasya visheSho vasantapUrvAhNAdirbalakAlavisheShaH| RutavashcAhorAtrAhArayoH kAlAshca RutvahorAtrAhArakAlAH, teShAM bhedo vidhiH, tatra visheSheNa niyato balakAlavisheShaH RutvahorAtrAhArakAlavidhiviniyataH; tatra Rutuviniyato balakAlavisheSho yathA- shleShmajvarasya vasantaH, ahorAtraviniyato yathA- shleShmajvarasya pUrvAhNaH pradoShashca, AhAraviniyato yathA- shleShmajvarasya bhuktamAtrakAlaH, evamAdyunneyam| kecittu vidhishabdena pUrvakRutaM karma bruvate, tatrApi karmaniyato balakAlavisheShaH pacyamAnakarmakAla eva j~jeyaH| eShu ca balakAleShu yadyapi vyAdherabhUtaprAdurbhAvarUpA samprAptirna bhavati, tathA~api vyAdhisantAne tatkAlaM vyAdhyutpattau samprAptirbhinnaiva bhavatIti mantavyam| iyaM ca kAlavisheShaprAptyA balavadvyAdhijanikA samprAptirvyAdhervisheShaM sphuTameva bodhayati| yataH pUrvAhNe balasamprAptyA jvarasya kaphajatvamunnIyate, madhyAhne ca balaprAptyA pittajatvamityAdi| iha ca samprAptereva visheShAH sa~gkhyAdikRutA uktAH, na tu nidAnAdInAM visheShAH; yato nidAnAdivisheShAH prativyAdhivakShyamANabhedenaivopayuktAH| yato yAdRug jvare nidAnaM na tAdRug raktapitte; ye ca pUrvarUpAdivisheShA jvare, na te raktapittAdau, kintu bhinnajAtIyA eva| sa ca bhedo nidAnAdInAM vyAdhibhedagamakatvenopayukto vyAdhibhedakathana eva vaktavyaH| samprAptestu sa~gkhyAdibhedaH sarvavyAdhiShvekajAtIyatvena na visheShagamaka iti ihaiva sarvavyAdhinidAne kathyate; nidAnAdivisheShAstu prativyAdhivishiShTatvena neha prapa~jcenocyante| ata eva cAtraivAdhyAye samprApteH sAmAnyAbhidhAnenaivoktatvAt samprAptiM parityajya nidAnAdivisheShaM pratijAnIte- tasya nidAnapUrvarUpali~ggopashayavisheShAnanuvyAkhyAsyAma iti||12||

tasmAdvyAdhIn bhiShaganupahatasattvabuddhirhetvAdibhirbhAvairyathAvadanubuddhyeta||13||

Commentary: yasmAdime nidAnAdaya uktena nyAyena vyAdhiparIkShAyAmupayuktAH, tasmAdvyAdhIn bhiShag hetvAdibhiH parIkSheteti yojanA| na ca vAcyaM yat- nidAnAdInAM madhye cedanyatamenApi vyAdhiparicchedaM kartuM samarthastat kiM pa~jcakAbhidhAneneti; yato yAvanto j~jAnopAyA vyAdhInAM te sarva evopadarshanIyAH| tatra yo nidAnaM vismRutavAn, tasya pUrvarUpAdibhirvyAdhiH parIkShyate; tathA yatra ca pUrvarUpAdayo vismRutAH sandigdhA vA, tatropashayena parIkShA bhavati; evaM kaphajatvasandehe jvarasya samprAptirapi pUrvAhNe bhuktamAtre vA bhavantI kaphajatvaM gamayatItyAdi prayojanamanusaraNIyam| tathA pUrvarUpeNApi li~ggasAmAnyanishcaya uktaH; yaduktaM- “hAridravarNaM rudhiraM ca mUtraM vinA pramehasya hi pUrvarUpaiH| yo mUtrayettaM na vadet pramehaM raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaH” (ci.a.6) iti| tathA li~gganishcite~api vyAdhau pUrvarUpeNAsAdhyatvamuktaM, yathA- “pUrvarUpANi sarvANi jvaroktAnyatimAtrayA| yaM vishanti vishatyenaM mRutyurjvarapuraHsaraH” (i.a.5) iti| tasmAnnidAnAdipa~jcakamabhidhAtavyameva| nanu, li~ggena vyAdhiH parIkShaNIya iti vacanAlli~ggavyatirikto vyAdhirityuktaM bhavati; tatra ca na li~ggasamudAyavyatirikto vyAdhirupalabhyate, viShamArambhivisargitvAdayo hi santApasahitA jvarAH, tathA pratishyAyakAsAdyekAdasharUpamelaka eva yakShmA| naivaM, li~ggatvena shAstre pratipAditAnAM tadatiriktavyAdhyabhAve li~ggatvAnupapatteH, vacanaM hi- “viShamArambhamUlaishca jvara eko nirucyate” (ni.a.8) iti| vikArashcaiha doShadUShyamelakavisheSho jvarAdishabdenocyate| sa ca doShadUShyavisheShAtmA jvaro~arucyAdibhyo doShadUShyavaiShamyavisheShebhyo~arthAntarameva| na ca vAcyaM jvarali~ggArucya~ggamardAdirUpadhAtuvaiShamyavisheShamelako jvaro~astu, alaM tadatiriktajvarakalpanayA, li~ggali~ggibhAvashca samudAyasamudAyibhedAdbhaviShyatIti; yata evamapyarucya~ggamardAdidhAtuvaiShamyAnugato dhAtuvaiShamyavisheSho jvararUpo~avayavIti bhinna eva vaktavyaH; ja~gghAbAhushirontarAdhyavayavAnatiriktameva sharIramavayavirUpam| duHkhameva vyAdhiriti pUrvameva parAkRutaM, tena duHkharUpatvAdvyAdheravayavitvaM na sambhavatIti na vAcyam| li~ggAni tu svarUpeNa vyAdhayo bhavanti, te ca boddhavyavyAdhyapekShayA li~ggAni bhavanti| taduktaM- “vyAdhayaste tadAtve tu li~ggAnIShTAni nAmayAH” (ni.a.8) iti| li~ggali~ggibhAvashca jij~jAsAvashAdbhavati| yadvakShyati- “viShamArambhamUlAnAM li~ggamekaM jvaro mataH| viShamArambhamUlaishca jvara eko nirucyate” (ni.a.8) iti| asya cArthamapasmAranidAne prakaraNAgataM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| tasmAt susthitaM vyAdhigamakatvaM nidAnAdipa~jcakasyetyarthaH||13||

ityarthasa~ggraho nidAnasthAnasyoddiShTo bhavati| taM vistareNopadishanto bhUyastaramato~anuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||14||

Commentary: itItyAdau iti parisamAptau| nidAnasthAnasyeti sarvavyAdhinidAnasya| arthasa~ggraha ityanenaiva sa~gkShepArthAbhidhAne labdhe uddiShTa iti sa~gkShepAbhidhAyipadakaraNena sa~gkShepasyApi sa~gkShepAbhidhAnametaditi darshayati| tamiti sAmAnyanidAnoddesham, ato nidAnoddeshamAtrato bhUyastaramupadishanto vistareNa vyAkhyAsyAma iti yojanA| tenaitadatisa~gkShepakathanApekShayA prapa~jcakathanameveha vistarashabdArtha iti darshayati; tena nidAnAdInAM yAvadvistarakathanamuttaratropapannaM bhavati||14||

tatra prathamata eva tAvadAdyA@mllobhAbhidrohakopaprabhavAnaShTau vyAdhInnidAnapUrveNa krameNa vyAkhyAsyAmaH, tathA sUtrasa~ggrahamAtraM cikitsAyAH| cikitsiteShu cottarakAlaM yathopacitavikArAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH ||15||

Commentary: tatretyAdinA jvarAdyaShTavidharogasya nidAnasthAne kathanaM pratijAnIte| prathamata eva tAvadityanena pashcAccikitsAbhidheyAnarshaH- prabhRutIn sUcayati| Adya nityanena Adau dakShAdhvaroddhvaMse utpannA ye teShAmiha kathanaM darshayati| yadyapi ca rAjayakShmA pRuthagevotpannaH, vacanaM hi- “ativyavAyAt punarnakShatrarAjasya yakShmA” (ni.a.8) iti, tathA~apyasya prAdhAnyAdihAbhidhAnam| yadyapi ca dakShAdhvaroddhvaMsodbhUtAnapasmArAntAnabhidhAya pRuthagutpannasya yakShmaNo~abhidhAnamucitaM, tathA~apyunmAdApasmArayorAgantutvena shoShamapyabhidhAyAnte~abhidhAnam| lobhAbhidrohaprabhavAnityanena janapadoddhvaMsanIye “prAgapi cAdharmAdRute na rogotpattirabhUt” (vi.a.3) ityanena vakShyamANAnAM jvarAdInAM lobhAbhidrohajanyatAM darshayati, anenAdharmajatvaM jvarAdInAmuktaM bhavati| nidAnapUrveNeti nidAnaprathamena| krameNeti rogasAmAnyoktanidAnapUrvarUparUpopashayasamprAptirUpeNa| ayaM ca kramaH kvacit prayojanavashAdbAdhyate; yathA~atraiva jvare~agre hi rUpamabhidhAya pUrvarUpamabhidhAtavyam| kramabhedaprayojanaM ceha yat- rUpANyatra pratijvaramabhidhAtavyAni, na tu prAgrUpANi pratijvaramabhidhAtavyAni; tena sarvasAdhAraNatvAt sarvamabhidhAya prAgrUpaM sAmAnyamabhidhAtavyam| tathA, sUtrasa~ggrahamAtraM cikitsAyA vyAkhyAsyAma iti sambandhaH| nidAne ca cikitsAbhidhAnaprayojanaM prAgevoktam| sUtramiti kRutvA yat sa~ggrahamiti karoti tena sUtrasyApi sa~gkShepeNAbhidhAnaM darshayati; tathA cikitsAsUtramapIha ki~jcinna vaktavyaM, yathA- la~gghanakAlayavAgvAdayaH| cikitsiteShvityanenaiva cottarakAlatve labdhe punaruttarakAlamiti vacanaM cikitsitasthAne~api jvarAdyabhidhAnottarakAlameva yathopacitavikArANAM nidAnAdikathanaM darshayati| yathopacitamiti ye ye upacitA vikArAH shothArshaHprabhRutayastAn| kiMvA, ‘yathAcitam’ iti pAThaH, tatrApi yathApradhAnamityartha unneyaH| cikitsite ca vikArANAM nidAnAdyabhidhAnaM nidAnAdinA~avyavadhAnena pratIte viShaye cikitsA samyak pratIyata ityabhiprAyeNa| ata eva ca jvarAdInAmapi punarnidAnAdyabhidhAsyati, iha tu jvarAdInAM nidAnAdyabhidhAnaM bahuvaktavyatvena sthAnabhedaM kRutvA kRutam| sthAnabhedakaraNena ca cikitsAvadAyurvede nidAnasyApi j~jeyatvena prAdhAnyaM darshayati||15||

iha khalu jvara evAdau vikArANAmupadishyate, tatprathamatvAcchArIrANAm||16||

Commentary: iha khalviti aShTavidhavyAdhinidAne vaktavye| shArIrANAmityanena kAmakrodhAdimAnasaM rogaM prati na jvarasya prathamatvamiti darshayati||16||

atha khalvaShTAbhyaH kAraNebhyo jvaraH sa~jjAyate manuShyANAM; tadyathA- vAtAt, pittAt, kaphAt, vAtapittAbhyAM, vAtakaphAbhyAM, pittakaphAbhyAM, vAtapittakaphebhyaH, AgantoraShTamAt kAraNAt||17||

Commentary: jvarasya nirUpaNIyasya kAraNakRutaM bhedamAha- athetyAdi| etacca kAraNaM vAtAdi sannikRuShTam| manuShyANAmitivacanena gogajashakunyAdInAM nAvashyamidaM jvarAShTatvamanugAmIti darshayati; tathAhi- hastyAdInAM pAkalAdayo nAShTavidhAH pratipAdyante| Agantoriti vaktavye aShTamAditi vacanamAgantorabhighAtAdicatuShkAraNabhede~apyekatvopadarshanArtham| Aganturhi kAraNabhedotpanno~apyekarUpa eva, yata AgantuH sarvo vyathApUrvameva bhavati; yastu tatra, “kAmashokabhayAdvAyuH” (ci.a.3) ityAdinA bhedo vaktavyaH, sa vAtAdikRuta eveti bhAvaH||17||

tasya nidAnapUrvarUpali~ggopashayavisheShAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH ||18||

Commentary: tasyetyAdau tasyeti jvarasya| visheShAniti nidAnAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate| nidAnAdivisheShAshceha rogAntararaktapittAdyapekShayA tathA parasparaM vAtAdijvarApekShayA ca yathAsambhavaM boddhavyAH| tena pUrvarUpavisheSha iha raktapittAdipUrvarUpApekShayA boddhavyaH, pUrvarUpasya visheSheNehAnabhidhAnAt| upashayavisheShAnabhidhAnaM ca nidAnavisheShAbhidhAnAdeva labhyate, yato nidAnaviparyayeNopashayamabhidhAsyati| pUrvarUpaM ceha vishiShTamavyaktali~ggavisheSharUpameva j~jeyam| samprAptestu vakShyamANAyA ihApratij~jAnaM, tasyAH sarvaroge samprAptibhedAbhidhAne ca kathitatvAt, tathA nidAnAdivat samprAptervyAdhibodhanaM pratyapradhAnatvAcca; yashca samprAptibhedo~abhidhAtavyaH sa sarvarogasAdhAraNa eva; bhedastu tasyA vAtAdidoShamAtrakRuta eva, vAtAdibhedashca nidAnabheda eva| anye tu bruvate- samprAptiM nAbhidhAsyatyevAyaM, yadetat ‘sa yadA prakupitaH’ ityAdyabhidhAsyati, tannidAnarUpavAtAdidharmakathanamiti kRutvA nidAnAntargatameva||18||

rUkShalaghushItavamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanAtiyogavyAyAmavegasandhAraNAnashanAbhighAta- vyavAyodvegashokashoNitAtiShekajAgaraNaviShamasharIranyAsebhyo~atisevitebhyo vAyuH prakopamApadyate||19||

Commentary: rUkShetyAdi| vAtaprakopaNaM prati rUkShasya pradhAnatvenAgre~abhidhAnaM, rUkSho hi guNo vAtaguNeShu pradhAnam| AsthApanaM yadyapi vAtaharamuktam- “AsthApanAnuvAsanaM tu khalu sarvopakramebhyo vAtavikAreShu pradhAnam” (sU.a.20) iti vacanAt, tathA~apIhAsthApanasyAtiyogo vAtaheturukta eveti na doShaH| vacanaM hi- “utkleshAgnivadhau snehAnnirUhAt pavanAdbhayam” (si.a.4) iti| nirUhashcAnuvAsanaM kRutvA yukta eva, mAtrAkRutashca sAdhAraNavAtahara iti siddhAntaH||19||

sa yadA prakupitaH pravishyAmAshayamUShmaNA saha mishrIbhUyAdyamAhArapariNAmadhAtuM rasanAmAnamanvavetya rasasvedavahAni srotAMsi pidhAyAgnimupahatya paktisthAnAdUShmANaM bahirnirasya kevalaM sharIramanuprapadyate, tadA jvaramabhinirvartayati||20||

Commentary: sa yadetyAdinA samprAptimAha| yadeti vacanAdeva~gkupito~api vAyuryadA~a~amAshayapraveshAdisamprAptiyukto bhavati tadaiva jvaraM karoti, nAnyadeti darshayati| pravishyAmAshayamityanena jvarakarturdoShasyAmAshayadUShakatvaM darshayati| ata eva sarvajvareShvAmAshayavishuddhyarthaM la~gghanamutsargato vadanti| yadyapi cAmAshayapraveshAdevoShmaNA~api mishratvaM labhyata eva, yata AmAshaya eva vahnisthAnaM, “nAbhistanAntaraM jantorAmAshaya iti smRutaH” (vi.a.2) iti vacanAt, tathA~api vahnisthAnasyAmAshayaikadeshatvenAmAshayapraveshe~api nAvashyaM grahaNIrUpavahnisthAnaduShTirvisheSheNa labhyata iti; ata evoktam- UShmaNA saha mishrIbhUyeti| rasanAmAnamityucyamAne AhArarase~api madhurarasAdau prasaktiH syAt, ata uktam- AhArapariNAmadhAtumiti; AhArapariNAmabhavo dhAturAhArapariNAmadhAtuH, tamiti| AhArapariNAmadhAtutvaM ca paramparayA raktAdiShvapyastItyAha- Adyamiti; prathamamityarthaH| rasamiti vaktavye rasanAmAnamiti yat karoti tena rasatIti rasa iti vyutpattimAtreNa raktAdiShu rasasa~jj~jAM niShedhayati, yatraiva rasasa~jj~jA rUDhA taM grAhayati; evamanyatrApi ca yat padamadhikArthamiha pratIyate tat spaShTArthameva, yatastrividhashiShyabuddhihitameva vispaShTArthaM tantraM yujyate| anviti yathoktakrameNa| avetyeti gatvA| pidhAyeti avarudhya| paktisthAnAt pAcakAgnisthAnAt| UShmANamiti pAcakavahnim| bahiriti paktisthAnavyatiriktasharIre| yadyapi coShmANaM nirasyetivacanAdeva paktisthAnAditi labhyate, tathA~api paktisthAnAditivacanena paktisthAnAt kRutsnasya vahnernirasanaM darshayati, iha coShmashabdena pAcakAgniM vyapadishan pAcakasya vahnerUShmarUpatAM darshayati, bAhyavahnisadRushajvAlAkaraM pittaM niShedhayati| ata eva ca vahnernirasanAdagnimAndyaM jvare darshitaM bhavati| vAyushcAtrAtivRuddhatvena vahnernirAsakaH, tenAgnidIptiM na karoti; yatra hi prerakamAtro bhavati vAyustatra vahnervRuddhiM karoti; yathA - medasvinaH koShThe caran vAyuragnivRuddhikaro bhavati||20||

tasyemAni li~ggAni bhavanti; tadyathA- viShamArambhavisargitvam, UShmaNo vaiShamyaM, tIvratanubhAvAnavasthAnAni jvarasya, jaraNAnte divasAnte nishAnte gharmAnte vA jvarasyAbhyAgamanamabhivRuddhirvA, visheSheNa paruShAruNavarNatvaM nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShatvacAmatyarthaM klRuptIbhAvashca; anekavidhopamAshcalAcalAshca vedanAsteShAM teShAma~ggAvayavAnAM; tadyathA- pAdayoH suptatA, piNDikayorudveShTanaM, jAnunoH kevalAnAM ca sandhInAM vishleShaNam, UrvoH sAdaH, kaTIpArshvapRuShThaskandhabAhvaMsorasAM ca bhagnarugNamRuditamathitacaTitAvapATitAvanunnatvamiva , hanvoshcAprasiddhiH, svanashca karNayoH, sha~gkhayornistodaH, kaShAyAsyatA AsyavairasyaM vA, mukhatAlukaNThashoShaH, pipAsA, hRudayagrahaH, shuShkacchardiH, shuShkakAsaH, kShavathUdgAravinigrahaH, annarasakhedaH, prasekArocakAvipAkAH, viShAdajRumbhAvinAmavepathushramabhramapralApaprajAgararomaharShadantaharShAH, uShNAbhiprAyatA, nidAnoktAnAmanupashayo viparItopashayashceti vAtajvarasya li~ggAni bhavanti||21||

Commentary: li~ggAnyAha- tadyathA viShametyAdi| taditi sAmAnyena strIli~ggapuMli~gganapuMsakali~ggavakShyamANarUpapratyavamarshakaM , sarvali~ggapratyavamarshe hi taditi sarvanAma yuktam| yatheti udAharaNe| Arambha utpAdaH, visargo mokShaH, tau viShamau yasya sa viShamArambhavisargI; viShamatvaM ca kadAcicchiro gRuhItvA bhavati, kadAcit pRuShThaM, kadAcijja~gghe ityAdi; evaM mokSho~api kadAcicchiro~agre mucyate ityAdi; kiMvA, jvarArambhamokShakAlAnavasthitatvameva vaiShamyam| UShmaNo vaiShamyamiti kvaciccharIrapradeshe mahAnUShmA, kvacinmanda ityAdi| tIvratanubhAvAnavasthAnAnIti tIvrabhAvastanubhAvashca jvarasya kAlApratiniyata ityarthaH| etatsarvaM vAyoranavasthitatvenopapannam| yacca vAyorjaraNAntadivasAntAdiShu balavatkAryakartRutvamuktaM, tadapi prAyikatvena j~jeyam| anyathA, etadevArambhAdivaiShamyaM na syAt| yadi kAlavisheShe jaraNAntAdau sharIrapradeshavisheShe ca ja~gghAdau pratiniyamena vAtakopaH syAt, tadA sharIrapradeshavisheShe vAtasthAne ja~gghAdau kAlavisheShe jaraNAntAdau ca vAtaprakopaH prAyiko j~jeyaH| etameva prAyikavAtakAlamAshrityAha- jaraNAnta ityAdi| gharmAnta iti prAvRuShi muktibhAvavato jvarasya satatakAderabhyAgamanaM, nityAnuShaktasya tvativRuddhiriti vyavasthA| paruShAruNatvaM ca nakhAdiShveva pravyaktamupalabhyata iti kRutvA nakhAdaya ihocyante| tvaggrahaNenaiva vadanagrahaNe labdhe~api vadanagrahaNaM vadanatvaci visheSheNa paruShatvAdidarshanArtham| klRuptIbhAvaH apravRuttiH, sA ca yogyatayA mUtrapurIShayoreva nakhAdiShUktayormantavyA; kiMvA, klRuptIbhAvo bhedaH sphuTanamiti yAvat; sa ca nakhAdInAm| calAshca kAshcidvedanA acalAshca kAshcinnityAnuShaktatveneti calAcalAH; kiMvA atyarthaM calAshcalAH| piNDikA jAnvadho ja~gghAmadhyamAMsapiNDikA | bhagnaM ki~jcidavasheSheNa cchinnaM, rugNaM ki~jcicchinnaM, mRuditaM pArshvAvamoTitam, avapATitam ekadeshotpATitam, avanunnaM preritam; eShAM ca bhagnAdInAM lokata evArthAvagatiH, yato laukikairevaite shabdAH prasiddhatvena tatra tatra shAstre~abhidhIyante | hanvoraprasiddhiriti hanvoH svavyApArAkaraNam| Asyavairasyamiti arasaj~jatA| annarasakhedaH annarase khedo~avasAdo~annarasakhedaH, sarvaraseShvanicchetyarthaH| arucistu vakShyamANA vaktre praviShTAnnAnabhyavaharaNAdboddhavyA| uShNAbhiprAyatA uShNapriyatA| nidAnoktAnAmanupashaya iti vacanenaiva viparIta upashayo~arthalabdho~api spaShTArthamucyate; kiMvA, arthApatteranaikAntikatvena ucyate; yathA- navajvare divAsvapne pratiShiddhe~arthApattyA purANajvare divAsvapnaH prApnoti, atha ca tatra divAsvapno na vihita ityarthApatteranaikAntikatvaM vadanti| nidAnoktAnAmityatroktagrahaNAdyadeva nidAnatvenoktaM tasyaivAnupashayitvaM nidarshayati na punaryasyApAtato nidAnatvaM pratibhAti; tena, madAtyayAdau madyAdernidAnatvena pratIyamAnasyApi upashayitvameva||21||
uShNAmlalavaNakShArakaTukAjIrNabhojanebhyo~atisevitebhyastathA tIkShNAtapAgnisantApashramakrodhaviShamAhArebhyashca pittaM prakopamApadyate||22||

tadyadA prakupitamAmAshayAdUShmANamupasRujyAdyamAhArapariNAmadhAtuM rasanAmAnamanvavetya rasasvedavahAni srotAMsi pidhAya dravatvAdagnimupahatya paktisthAnAdUShmANaM bahirnirasya prapIDayat kevalaM sharIramanuprapadyate, tadA jvaramabhinirvartayati||23||

tasyemAni li~ggAni bhavanti; tadyathA- yugapadeva kevale sharIre jvarasyAbhyAgamanamabhivRuddhirvA bhuktasya vidAhakAle madhyandine~ardharAtre sharadi vA visheSheNa, kaTukAsyatA, ghrANamukhakaNThauShThatAlupAkaH, tRuShNA, mado, bhramo, mUrcchA, pittacchardanam, atIsAraH, annadveShaH, sadanaM, khedaH, pralApaH, raktakoThAbhinirvRuttiH sharIre, haritahAridratvaM nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShatvacAm, atyarthamUShmaNastIvrabhAvaH, atimAtraM dAhaH, shItAbhiprAyatA, nidAnoktAnupashayo viparItopashayashceti pittajvarali~ggAni bhavanti||24||

iha khalu heturnimittamAyatanaM kartA kAraNaM pratyayaH samutthAnaM nidAnamityanarthAntaram| tattrividham- asAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH, praj~jAparAdhaH, pariNAmashceti||3||

Commentary: tadevaM jvaranidAne vaktavye sarvavyAdhisAdhAraNameva nidAnaM vaktumudyataH sAmAnyapUrvakatvAdvisheShasya, tatrApyutpannasya vyAdherlakShaNaM yuktamiti kRutvA utpattihetumeva vyavahArArthaM lakShaNArthaM ca paryAyairAha- iha khalvityAdi| iheti iha prakaraNe kAraNAbhidhAyake hetvAdayo~anarthAntare ; prakaraNAntare arthAntare~api hetvAdishabdA bhavantIti darshayati; yathA- vakShyati- “heturakRutakatvAt” (vi.a.8) iti, tathA “dashaivAyatanAni syuH” (sU.a.29), tathA “kartA, mantA, veditA, boddhA” (shA.a.4) ityAdau, pratyayasya laDAdau, utthAnasya udgamanAdau| hetvAdibhUriparyAyakathanaM shAstre vyavahArArthaM, tathA hetvAdishabdAnAmarthAntare~api vartamAnatve paryAyAntareNa samaM sAmAnAdhikaraNyAt kAraNa eva vRuttirniyamyate; tena, ekasminnarthe yasmiMste shabdAH pravartante tat kAraNamitarahetvAdyarthebhyo vyavacchidyate; tena, lakShaNArthaM ca paryAyAbhidhAnaM bhavati| evamanyatrApi vyAdhyAdiparyAyAbhidhAne~api vyAkhyeyam| iha cAShTasa~gkhyAyA ma~ggalatvena, tathA~aShTavidhavyAdhijvarAdyabhidhAnAnuSha~ggAccAShTAveva hetuparyAyA uktAH; tenApare~api yonimUlamukhaprakRutyAdayo hetuparyAyA boddhavyAH, te ca tantravistarabhayAnnoktAH| evaM rogaparyAyAntarAnabhidhAne~api granthavistarabhayAdyanusaraNIyam| hetorbhedamAha- tat trividhamityAdi| etaccAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAdi dIrgha~jjIvitIye tisraiShaNIye ca prapa~jcitamiti neha prapa~jcyate| atra pAThAdeva tritve siddhe trividhamitivacanaM bahuprapa~jcasyApyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAdestraividhyAnatikramopadarshanArthaM, tathA pratyekamayogAtiyogamithyAyogabhedAttrividhatvadarshanArthaM ca| etacca hetutritayamuktamapi punaH prakaraNavashAducyamAnamiha na punaruktaM doShamAvahati| etaccAsAtmyendriyArthAdestraividhyaM mUlakAraNaM prati niyAmakaM, tena “jvarasantApAdraktapittamudIryate” (ni.a.8) ityAdyuktarogAdirUpapratyAsannakAraNAnavarodho nodbhAvanIyaH| kiMvA, raktapittAdikAraNe jvarAdAvapyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAdyeva mUlakAraNaM, tena jvarAdikArye raktapittAdau jvarAdikAraNameva mUlakAraNaM bhavati| “kAlabuddhIndriyArthAnAM yogo mithyA na cAti ca” (sU.a.1) iti pUrvoktakramabhedenehAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogasyAdAvabhidhAnena sarveShAmevaiShAM rogakartRutve prAdhAnyaM darshayati, mA bhUdekAntAbhidhAnena pradhAnatAniyamaH| yadyapi ca mUlabhUtatvena praj~jAparAdhaH pradhAnaM bhavati , tathA~api pratyAsannakAraNatvena tathA~abuddhipUrvakasyApyutkaTashabdamithyAyogAderapi kAraNatvenAsAtmyendriyArthasaMyogo~api pradhAnam| yadyapi kAlo duShpariharatvena pradhAnaM, tathA~api so~apIndriyArthaparAdhInatvenApradhAnaM, kAlAtiyogAdayo hIndriyArthashItAdyatiyogAdibhya eva prAyo bhavanti||3||
snigdhagurumadhurapicchilashItAmlalavaNadivAsvapnaharShAvyAyAmebhyo~atisevitebhyaH shleShmA prakopamApadyate||25||

sa yadA prakupitaH pravishyAmAshayamUShmaNA sahamishrIbhUyAdyamAhArapariNAmadhAtuM rasanAmAnamanvavetya rasasvedavahAni srotAMsi pidhAyAgnimupahatya paktisthAnAdUShmANaM bahirnirasya prapIDayan kevalaM sharIramanuprapadyate, tadA jvaramabhinirvartayati||26||

tasyemAni li~ggAni bhavanti; tadyathA- yugapadeva kevale sharIre jvarasyAbhyAgamanamabhivRuddhirvA bhuktamAtre pUrvAhNe pUrvarAtre vasantakAle vA visheSheNa, gurugAtratvam, anannAbhilAShaH, shleShmaprasekaH, mukhamAdhuryaM, hRullAsaH, hRudayopalepaH, stimitatvaM, chardiH, mRudvagnitA, nidrAdhikyaM, stambhaH, tandrA, kAsaH, shvAsaH, pratishyAyaH, shaityaM, shvaityaM ca nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShatvacAm, atyarthaM ca shItapiDakA bhRushama~ggebhya uttiShThanti, uShNAbhiprAyatA, nidAnoktAnupashayo viparItopashayashca; iti (shleShmajvarali~ggAni bhavanti)||27||

Commentary: yugapaditi ekakAlam; ekadaiva kaphajvare sarvasharIravyAptyA AgamanamabhivRuddhirvA bhavatIti darshayati| shItapiDakAstantrAntare shvetapiDakA ucyante| ‘tasyemAni li~ggAni bhavanti’ ityetAvataiva kaphajvarali~ggatve labdhe punaH ‘shleShmajvarali~ggAni bhavanti’ iti vacanaM kimarthaM? brUmaH- tasyetipadena svadoShamAtrapratyavamarsho~api syAt, tena doShali~ggataiva paraM li~ggAnAM mA syAdityetadarthaM punarabhidhAnam; kiMvA, pUrvapratij~jayA li~ggAnAM prAgavaccheda uktaH, uttareNa shleShmajvarali~ggAni bhavantItyanenAntyAvaccheda ucyate; evamanyatrApi vAtajvarAdau pUrvarUpe ca punaruktiH parihartavyA||27||

viShamAshanAdanashanAdannaparivartAdRutuvyApatterasAtmyagandhopaghrANAdviShopahatasya codakasyopayogAdgarebhyo girINAM copashleShAt snehasvedavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanashirovirecanAnAmayathAvatprayogAt mithyAsaMsarjanAdvA strINAM ca viShamaprajananAt prajAtAnAM ca mithyopacArAd yathoktAnAM ca hetUnAM mishrIbhAvAdyathAnidAnaM dvandvAnAmanyatamaH sarve vA trayo doShA yugapat prakopamApadyante, te prakupitAstayaivAnupUrvyA jvaramabhinirvartayanti||28||

Commentary: viShamAshanAdityAdinA dvAndvikasAnnipAtikajvarAnAha| anashanaM yadyapi na pittashleShmakaraM, tathA~apyagnimAndyakaratvAttridoShakaramapi bhavati; kiMvA eShu viShamAshanAdiShu yathAyogyatayA dvandvakAraNatvaM tridoShakAraNatvaM conneyaM, tenAnashanaM vAtapittakaraM boddhavyaM; yattu pittaharatvamuktamanashanasya, tattu pittadravAMshakShayAt| vacanaM hi- “kaphapitte drave dhAtU sahete la~gghanaM mahat” iti| annaparivartAditi sahasaivAkrameNa kRutAbhyastAnnaparivartAt| asAtmyagandho gandhadravyasya nAsikayA~antaHpraveshAdyathA doShakaro bhavati na tathA~asAtmyarUpAdayaH, te hi nAvashyaM sharIraM vishanti, tena nehAsAtmyarUpAdaya uktAH| yathAnidAnamiti yadA dvayornidAnaM sevyate tadA dvandvaH, yadA trayANAM nidAnaM sevyate tadA trayo doShAH; dvandve~api yadA vAtapittayornidAnaM sevyate tadA vAtapittarUpaM dvandvam; evamanyadapi kupyatItyarthaH| sarve trayo doShA ityanenaiva labdhe~api yugapaditivacanaM kramaprakopapratiShedhArthaM, yugapadeva prakopamApadyante na krameNetyarthaH||28||

tatra tathoktAnAM jvarali~ggAnAM mishrIbhAvavisheShadarshanAddvAndvikamanyatamaM jvaraM sAnnipAtikaM vA vidyAt||29||

Commentary: jvarali~ggAnAmityAdau mishrIbhAvavisheSho vAtapittali~ggaM vA, vAtashleShmali~ggaM vA, pittashleShmali~ggaM vA| anyatamamiti vAtapittajvarAdikam||29||

abhighAtAbhiSha~ggAbhicArAbhishApebhya Aganturhi vyathApUrvo~aShTamo jvaro bhavati| sa ki~jcitkAlamAgantuH kevalo bhUtvA pashcAddoShairanubadhyate| tatrAbhighAtajo vAyunA duShTashoNitAdhiShThAnena, abhiSha~ggajaH punarvAtapittAbhyAm, abhicArAbhishApajau tu sannipAtenAnubadhyete||30||

Commentary: AgantujvaramAha- abhighAtetyAdi| abhighAto laguDAdyabhighAtaH, abhiSha~ggaH kAmAdyabhiSha~ggaH, abhicAro~atharvamantrAdirjvarakaraH, abhishApastu gurusiddhAdyabhishapanam; etat pradhAnatvena caturvidhaM kAraNamihoktaM; tena, oShadhigandhabhUtAbhiSha~ggaduShTagrahanirIkShaNAdayo~apyAgantujvarahetavo boddhavyAH; kiMvA, abhighAtagrahaNena sharIrAbhihananavAcinA~asAtmyagandhAdayo grAhyAH, abhiSha~ggeNa tu bhUtAbhiSha~ggAdayaH| vyathApUrvamiti Agantau prathamaM vyathA bhavati, pashcAddoShAnubandhakRutAni lakShaNAnIti darshayati; kiMvA, vyathApUrvamitivacanAdAgantau jvare vyathaiva pUrvarUpamiti vadanti| rUpaM tu yadeva jvarasya prAtyAtmikaM santAparUpaM tadeva vAtajvarAdilakShaNarahitaM boddhavyaM prathamataH, uttarakAlInadoShAnubandhe tu yathAvakShyamANadoShali~ggAnyeva bhavanti| aShTama itivacanenAbhighAtAdihetucatuShTayayogaprAptaM cAturvidhyaM niShedhya vyathApUrvakatvenaikarUpayogAdekavidhatvaM caturNAM darshayati; cAturvidhye hyAgantornAShTamatvaM, navamatvAdayo~api syuH| ki~jcitkAlamiti stokakAlaM; kecit tryahaM vadanti, anye saptAhamAhuH| Agantau hi saptAhAdUrdhvaM doShali~ggAni bhavantIti dRuShTam| tatra yasyAgantoryAdRusho doShAnubandho bhavati tamAha- tatrAbhighAtetyAdi| vAtapittAbhyAmiti kashcidvAtena, kashcit pittena, kashcidvAtapittAbhyAm| vacanaM hi- “kAmashokabhayAdvAyuH, krodhAt pittaM, trayo malAH| bhUtAbhiSha~ggAt kupyanti bhUtasAmAnyalakShaNAH” (ci.a.3) iti| bhUtAbhiSha~gge tu yadyapi tridoShaprakopa uktaH, tathA~api tatra vAtapittayorevaitadvacanabalAt prAdhAnyam||30||

sa saptavidhAjjvarAdvishiShTali~ggopakramasamutthAnatvAdvishiShTo veditavyaH, karmaNA sAdhAraNena copacaryate | ityaShTavidhA jvaraprakRutiruktA||31||

Commentary: AgantornijAdbhedamAha- sa ityAdi| visheShali~ggatA AgatorvyathApUrvakavyAkhyAne vyAkRutA, samutthAnavisheSho~apyabhighAtAdiruktaH, upakramavisheSho~api ‘sAdhAraNena karmaNA copacaryate’ iti vacanenaivAtra kathyate| sAdhAraNeneti daivayuktivyapAshrayeNa; daivavyapAshrayaM hi balima~ggalahomAdi, yuktivyapAshrayaM hi laghvashanApatarpaNayavAgUkaShAyapAnAdi| prakRutirukteti svabhAvo~api vAtAdijvarANAM nidAnAdyupahita ukta ityarthaH||31||

jvarastveka eva santApalakShaNaH| tamevAbhiprAyavisheShAddvividhamAcakShate, nijAgantuvisheShAcca| tatra nijaM dvividhaM trividhaM caturvidhaM saptavidhaM cAhurbhiShajo  vAtAdivikalpAt||32||

Commentary: nijAgantuvisheShAcca dvividhamiti sambandhaH| nijaM dvividhamityAdau dvaividhyaM (saMsRuShTAsaMsRuShTajanyatvena ) shItoShNAbhiprAyabhedAt, trividhaM tridoShabhedAt, caturvidhaM pratyekaM vAtAdidoShajanyabhedAt| tatra cAturvidhye dvandvajvarAH pratikShipyante, teShAM pratyekaM vAtAdijvarasadRushatvAt; tridoShajvarastu asAdhyatAyogAt kRucchrasAdhyatAyogAdvA pRuthagucyate||32||

tasyemAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti; tadyathA- mukhavairasyaM, gurugAtratvam, anannAbhilAShaH, cakShuShorAkulatvam, ashrvAgamanaM, nidrAdhikyam, aratiH, jRumbhA, vinAmaH, vepathuH, shramabhramapralApajAgaraNaromaharShadantaharShAH, shabdashItavAtAtapasahatvAsahatvam, arocakAvipAkau, daurbalyam, a~ggamardaH, sadanam, alpaprANatA, dIrghasUtratA, Alasyam, ucitasya karmaNo hAniH, pratIpatA svakAryeShu, gurUNAM vAkyeShvabhyasUyA, bAlebhyaH pradveShaH, svadharmeShvacintA, mAlyAnulepanabhojanaparikleshanaM, madhurebhyashca bhakShebhyaH pradveShaH, amlalavaNakaTukapriyatA ca, iti jvarasya pUrvarUpANi bhavanti prAksantApAt; api cainaM santApArtamanubadhnanti||33||

Commentary: tasyemAnItyAdinA sarvajvarasAdhAraNaM pUrvarUpamAha| etAni ca pUrvarUpANyAgantorapItyeke vadanti; anye tu nijAnAmevaitAnIti vadanti, Agantostu vyathaiva pUrvarUpam| atrApyanannAbhilAShArocakayoH pUrvavadbhedaH| daurbalyaM sharIrabalahAniH, alpaprANatA ca mAnasabalahAnirboddhavyA; kiMvA daurbalyaM mAMsApacayaH| dIrghasUtratA cireNa kAryakartRutvam| jvarapUrvarUpANi bhavanti prAksantApAditi cchedaH, jvararUpasantApAt prAgetAni pUrvarUpANi bhavantItyarthaH| apica santApArtamanubadhnantItyanena pravyakte~api jvare kAnicitpUrvarUpANi mukhavairasyArucyAdIni bhavantIti darshayati| na caivaM pUrvarUpAnuvRuttau riShTatvaM vAcyaM; yataH sarvapUrvarUpANAmatimAtrAnuvartanaM riShTamuktam| vacanaM hi- “pUrvarUpANi sarvANi jvaroktAnyatimAtrayA| yaM vishanti vishatyenaM mRutyurjvarapuraHsaraH” (i.a.5) iti; kiMvA, asya shlokasyAnya evArthaH, tamindriye vakShyAmaH| na cArucyAdInAM vyaktajvarabhAvitvena pUrvarUpatvaM hanyate, yato li~ggAntarayuktAnyarucyAdIni li~ggAni bhavanti, li~ggAntaravirahitAni tu pUrvarUpANi||33||

ityetAnyekaikasho jvarali~ggAni vyAkhyAtAni bhavanti vistarasamAsAbhyAm||34||

Commentary: ekaikasho jvarali~ggAnItyatra li~ggashabdena nidAnapUrvarUpAdInyucyante| vistarasamAsAbhyAmiti vistareNa vAtAdijvaroktAH, samAsena saMsargasannipAtajAH; yastvatra samAsenoktaH sa cikitsite prapa~jcanIya iti bhAvaH||34||

jvarastu khalu maheshvarakopaprabhavaH, sarvaprANabhRutAM prANaharo, dehendriyamanastApakaraH, praj~jAbalavarNaharShotsAhahrAsakaraH , shramaklamamohAhAroparodhasa~jjananaH; jvarayati sharIrANIti jvaraH, nAnye vyAdhayastathA dAruNA bahUpadravA dushcikitsyAshca yathA~ayam| sa sarvarogAdhipatiH, nAnAtiryagyoniShu ca bahuvidhaiH shabdairabhidhIyate| sarve prANabhRutaH sajvarA eva jAyante sajvarA eva mriyante ca; sa mahAmohaH, tenAbhibhUtAH prAgdaihikaM dehinaH karma ki~jcidapi na smaranti, sarvaprANabhRutAM ca jvara evAnte prANAnAdatte||35||

Commentary: samprati jvarasya mahAprabhAvatAM darshayituM pUrvotpattiprakAramAha- jvarastvityAdi| maheshvarakopaprabhava ityanena jvaracikitsite “dvitIye hi yuge sharvamakrodhavratamAsthitam” (ci.a.3) ityAdigranthe vakShyamANAM jvarotpattimAha| krodhabhavatvena ca shleShmajanyasyApyAgneyatvaM darshayati; krodho hyagnirUpaH, tena tanmayo~api jvarastathaiva; ata evoktam- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti jvaro nAstyUShmaNA vinA| tasmAt pittaviruddhAni tyajet pittAdhike~adhikam” (vA.ci.a.1) iti| na ca rudrakopabhavatvena lobhAbhidrohaprabhavatvaM jvarasya virudhyate; yato rudrakopodbhUta eva jvaro lobhAbhidrohasvarUpapApAcAraprAptyA purA manuShyeShu bhUtaH| sarvaprANinAM jvara eva prANahara iti maraNakAle sarvaprANinAM jvara eva prANahara iti darshayati| dehendriyamanastApakara ityatra pratyekaM tApalakShaNaM jvaracikitsite boddhavyaM “vaicittyamaratirglAnirmanaHsantApalakShaNam” (ci.a.3) ityAdinA| jvarayati santApayati| itishabdo hetau; tena, yasmAduktamaheshvarakrodhaprabhavatvAdiyuktaH, tasmAt| sarvarogANAmadhipatiriveti sarvarogAdhipatiH| nAnAvidhaiH shabdairiti hastiShu pAkalo, goShu kheriko , matsyAnAmindrajAlo, viha~ggAnAM bhrAmaraka ityAdishabdaiH| sarvaprANabhRutaH sajvarA eva jAyante sajvarA eva mriyante ca tat kimiti teShAM janmani maraNe vA santApAtmA jvaro na lakShyata ityAha- sa mahAmoha iti; janmamaraNayormahAmoharUpo jvaro bhavati, na santApAtmetyarthaH| ata evoktaM- “jvaraprabhAvo janmAdau nidhane ca mahattamaH” (ci.a.3) iti| janmani mahAmoharUpatAmAha- tenetyAdi| prAgdaihikaM janmAntarakRutam| nanu, shuddhasattvAnugamAt prAgdaihikaM smaraNaM yuktaM; vacanaM hi- “yadA tenaiva shuddhena manasA yujyate, tadA jAtimatikrAntAmapi smarati” (shA.a.3) iti| na, tasya shuddhamanaHsattvAnuvRutterapavAdatvAdetatparityajyAnyatra jvarasya prAgdaihikavismArakatvaM j~jeyam| maraNe mahAmohatAmAha- sarvaprANabhRutAmityAdi| jvara eva mahAmoharUpa eveti bhAvaH; tena mriyamANAH sarve mahAmohaM pravishantItyarthaH||35||

tatra pUrvarUpadarshane jvarAdau vA hitaM laghvashanamapatarpaNaM vA, jvarasyAmAshayasamutthatvAt; tataH kaShAyapAnAbhya~ggasnehasvedapradehapariShekAnulepanavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanopashamana- nastaHkarmadhUpadhUmapAnA~jjanakShIrabhojanavidhAnaM ca yathAsvaM yuktyA prayojyam||36||

Commentary: samprati sUtritaM cikitsAsUtramAha- tatretyAdi| yadyapi cikitsite jvarAdau la~gghanaM vakShyati, tathA~apIha pAkShikalaghvashanavidhAnaM na virodhi, laghvashanasyApi lAghavakartRutvenaiva la~gghanatvAt; kiMvA, yatra vAtAdijvare la~gghanaM na kartavyaM tatra laghvashanaM boddhavyam, apatarpaNaM ca la~gghanameva| atha kimiti vAtike~api jvare vAtakArakaM laghvashanamapatarpaNaM vA kAryamityAha- AmAshayasamutthatvAdityAdi| AmAshayasambandhena vAto~api manAgla~gghanIyaH sthAnApekShayA bhavatIti bhAvaH| vacanaM hi- “sthAnaM jayeddhi pUrvaM sthAnasyAvirodhena” iti||36||

jIrNajvareShu tu sarveShveva sarpiShaH pAnaM prashasyate yathAsvauShadhasiddhasya; sarpirhi snehAdvAtaM shamayati, saMskArAt kaphaM, shaityAt pittamUShmANaM ca; tasmAjjIrNajvareShu sarveShveva sarpirhitamudakamivAgnipluShTeShu dravyeShviti||37||
bhavanti cAtra-  yathA prajvalitaM veshma pariShi~jcanti vAriNA| narAH shAntimabhipretya tathA jIrNajvare ghRutam||38||
snehAdvAtaM shamayati, shaityAt pittaM niyacchati| ghRutaM tulyaguNaM doShaM saMskArAttu jayet kapham||39||
nAnyaH snehastathA kashcit saMskAramanuvartate| yathA sarpirataH sarpiH sarvasnehottamaM matam||40||

atastrividhA vyAdhayaH prAdurbhavanti- AgneyAH, saumyAH, vAyavyAshca; dvividhAshcApare- rAjasAH, tAmasAshca||4||

Commentary: hetorhetutvaM kArye bhavatIti hetukAryaM vyAdhimAha- atastrividhA ityAdi| na cAtra yathAsa~gkhyam, ekarUpAdapi hetostrividhavyAdhyutpAdAt| atrApi trividhavacanamAnantye~api rogANAmAgneyatvAdyanatikramopadarshanArtham| AgneyAH paittikAH, saumyAH kaphajAH, vAyavyAH vAtajAH| yadyapi pradhAnatvena vAyavyA eva prathamaM nirdeShTuM yujyante, tathA~apIha jvare pittasya pradhAnatvAdAgneyAbhidhAnam| AgneyasaumyavAyavyA iti samAsenaikaikasmAdapyasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogAdestrividharogotpattitvaM darshayati, asamAse hi yathAsa~gkhyamapi sha~gkyeta| anyathA~api vyAdhInuktahetujAnAha- dvividhAshcApare ityAdi| rAjasatAmasAnAM ca vicchidya pATheneha tantre shArIravyAdhyadhikArapravRutte~anadhikAratvenAprapa~jcanIyatvaM darshayati, abhidhAnaM ca rAjasatAmasayoriha vyAdhikathanasya nyUnatAparihArArtham| AgantavashcAbhighAtAdijA rogA AgneyAdiShvevAntarbhavanti; yatastatrApi hi doShaprakopo~avyapadeshyo~astyeva; kiMvA, apare iti apradhAnAH, paro hi shreShTha ucyate; apradhAnatve coktaivopapattiH||4||

gadyokto yaH punaH shlokairarthaH samanugIyate| tadvyaktivyavasAyArthaM dviruktaM tanna garhyate||41||

Commentary: nanu snehAdvAtaM shamayatItyAdigrantho gadyenaivoktaH, tat kimarthaM shlokenocyata ityAha- gadyokto ya ityAdi| tadvyaktivyavasAyArthamityatra tadvyaktirgadyoktArthasya vyaktiH prasannateti yAvat, vyavasAyaH adhyavasAyo grahaNamityarthaH; yasmAt pUrvoktArthaspaShTIkaraNArthaM punaH shlokenAbhidhAnaM, tasmAt prayojanAntarayuktatvAnna punaruktidoSha iti bhAvaH| gadyoktApekShayA shlokAbhidhAnaM sukhagrahaNaM bhavatIti lokasiddhameva| atra ca gadyokta ityupalakShaNaM, tena shlokokto~api shlokenocyata iti boddhavyaM; yathA- AragvadhIye| evaM gadyokto~api gadyeneti boddhavyaM; yathA- prapa~jcena kAraNAdyabhidhAyoktam- “evamasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH praj~jAparAdhaH pariNAmashca” (sU.a.11) ityAdi| tathA shlokenokto~api gadyenocyate, yathA- “brahmaNA hi yathA proktaM” (sU.a.1) ityAdi shlokenAbhidhAya Adye~adhyAye punaranyatroktaM- “yamAyurvedamashvinau mahyaM prAyacchetAm” (ci.a.1.pA.4) ityAdi| atra shlokAbhidhAnameva sukhagrahaNArthamiti j~jeyam| kiMvA, tadvyaktivyavasAyArthamiti yathAyogyatayA boddhavyam| tena, prapa~jcAbhidhAnamarthavyaktyarthaM boddhavyaM, sa~gkShepAbhidhAnaM tu vyavasAyArthaM; tena gadyashlokAbhidhAnAbhyAM vyaktivyavasAyau kriyete| tatra prapa~jcAbhidhAne~arthasya vyaktiH sphuTaiveti, sa~gkShepAbhidhAnaM tu prapa~jcApekShayA sukhagrahaNaM bhavati||41||
tatra shlokAH- trividhaM nAmaparyAyairhetuM pa~jcavidhaM gadam| gadalakShaNaparyAyAn vyAdheH pa~jcavidhaM graham||42||
jvaramaShTavidhaM tasya prakRuShTAsannakAraNam| pUrvarUpaM ca rUpaM ca bheShajaM sa~ggraheNa ca||43||
vyAjahAra jvarasyAgre nidAne vigatajvaraH| bhagavAnagniveshAya praNatAya punarvasuH||44||

tatra vyAdhirAmayo gada Ata~gko yakShmA jvaro vikAro roga ityanarthAntaram||5||

Commentary: vyAdhInAmAgneyAdivibhAgaM darshayitvA vyavahArArthaM lakShaNArthaM ca paryAyAnAha- tatra vyAdhirityAdi| atrApi paryAyANAmanarthAntareNAta~gkAdishabdAnAM bhayAdyarthatAvyudAsAdvyAdhilakShaNatvaM bodhyam| Ata~gkashabdena hi bhayamapyucyate, vikArashabdena hi indriyAdayo~api ShoDasha vikArA ucyante| tathA vyAdhyAdishabdAnAM vyutpattyA rogadharmA lakShaNIyAH| tathA hi- vividhaM duHkhamAdadhAtIti vyAdhiH; prAyeNAmasamutthatvenAmaya ityucyate; Ata~gka iti duHkhayuktatvena kRucchrajIvanaM karoti, vacanaM hi- “Ata~gkaH kRucchrajIvane” iti; yakShmashabdena ca rAjayakShmavadanekarogayuktatvaM vikArANAM darshayati; jvarashabdena ca dehamanaHsantApakaratvaM; vikArashabdena ca sharIramanasoranyathAkaraNatvaM vyAdherdarshayati; rogashabdena ca rujAkartRutvam||5||

tasyopalabdhirnidAnapUrvarUpali~ggopashayasamprAptitaH||6||

Commentary: idAnIM vyAdherjanakahetumabhidhAya tathA taddhetujanyaM ca vyAdhimuktvA tasya vyAdherj~jAnopAyamAha- tasyetyAdi| avij~jAte hi vyAdhau cikitsA na pravartate, ataH sAmAnyena vyAdhij~jAnopAyanidAnapa~jcakAbhidhAnaM yuktam||6||

tatra nidAnaM kAraNamityuktamagre||7||

Commentary: nidAnaM vivRuNoti- tatretyAdi| agre uktamiti ‘iha khalu’ ityAdinA ‘pariNAmashca’ ityantena| kAraNaM ca vyAdhInAM sannikRuShTaM vAtAdi, viprakRuShTaM cArthAnAmayogAdi; punarviprakRuShTaM kAraNaM raktapittasya jvarasantApa ityAdi; punashca vyAdhInAM sAmAnyena viprakRuShTaM kAraNamuktaM yathA- “prAgapi cAdharmAdRute na rogotpattirabhUt” (vi.a.3) ityAdi; tadetat sarvamapi kAraNashabdena grAhyam| tatrAdharmakAryatvena vyAdhInAM daivavyapAshrayaprAyashcittabalima~ggaletyAdicikitsAsAdhyatvaM pratIyate, rudrakopabhavatvena ca jvarasya mahAprabhAvatvaM tathA~a~agneyatvaM ca pratIyate; krodho hyAgneyaH, tena tanmayo jvaro~apyAgneyaH| tathAca vacanam- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti jvaro nAstyUShmaNA vinA| tasmAt pittaviruddhAni tyajet pittAdhike~adhikam” (vA.ci.a.1) iti| vAtAdijanyatvaj~jAnena ca vAtAdiviparItabheShajasAdhyatvaM tathA~anudbhUtavAtAdivikArAntarasambandho~api bhAvI kalpyate| asAtmyarUkShAdihetusevAdarshanena ca bhAvI vyAdhistajjanya unnIyate| vyAdhiparIkShAyAM ca sandehe jAte yasya vyAdherhetusevA dRushyate, sa parikalpyate; evamAdi hetunA vyAdhiparIkShaNam||7||

pUrvarUpaM prAgutpatti lakShaNaM vyAdheH||8||

Commentary: nidAnAnantarIyakatvAt pUrvarUpAdInAM nidAnAnantaraM pUrvarUpAdInyucyante , ataH pUrvarUpalakShaNamAha- pUrvetyAdi| utpatteH prAk prAgutpatti| etena utpatteH pUrvaM yadbhaviShyadvyAdherlakShaNaM tat pUrvarUpam| nidAnasevA tu bhAvivyAdhibodhikA bhavatyapi nidAnashabdagRuhItatvAdeva tathA lakShaNashabdAnabhidheyatvAcca na pUrvarUpashabdenocyate| uktaM hyanyatra- “sthAnasaMshrayiNaH kruddhA bhAvivyAdhiprabodhakam| li~ggaM kurvanti yaddoShAH pUrvarUpaM taducyate” iti| na ca vAcyaM yadanutpannasyAvidyamAnasya vyAdheH kathaM lakShaNaM bhavatIti; yato meghAdapi bhAvinI vRuShTiranumIyate, tathA rohiNyudayaM dRuShTvA kRuttikodayo~anumIyate| tacca pUrvarUpaM dvividham- ekaM bhAvivyAdhyavyaktarUpaM, yaduktam- “avyaktaM lakShaNaM tasya pUrvarUpamiti smRutam” (ci.a.11) iti, tathA “li~ggamavyaktamalpatvAdvyAdhInAM tadyathAyatham” (vA. ni. a.1) iti ; dvitIyaM tu doShadUShyasammUrcchanAvasthAjanyamavyaktali~ggAdanyadeva; yathA- jvare bAlapradveSharomaharShAdi; na hyetat pUrvarUpaM jvarAvasthAyAM niyamena vyaktaM bhavati, kintu jvarapUrvakAla eva; yatra tu vyaktaM bhavati, sa cAsAdhyo mataH| ata evaivambhUtapUrvarUpAbhiprAyeNaivAriShTe vakShyati- “pUrvarUpANi sarvANi jvaroktAnyatimAtrayA| yaM vishanti vishatyenaM mRutyurjvarapurassaraH” (iM.a.5) iti; tathA- “anyasyApi ca rogasya pUrvarUpANi yaM naram| vishantyanena kalpena tasyApi maraNaM dhruvam” (iM.a.5) iti| etaddhi yadyavyaktalakShaNapUrvarUpAbhiprAyeNa vacanaM syAttadA sarvajvarANAmasAdhyatvaM syAt, yataH pUrvarUpAvasthAyAmavyaktAni lakShaNAni jvare jAte vyaktAni sarvANi sarvatraiva bhavanti; tasmAt pUrvarUpAvasthApratiniyatapUrvarUpAbhiprAyeNaivaitadvacanam| avyaktatA ca lakShaNAnAmiyameva- yadalpatvenAsphuTatvam| yattu pUrvarUpaM doShadUShyasammUrcchanAvasthAniyataM tad vyAdhimAtrasya gamakaM, na taddoShavisheShaM gamayati| etatpUrvarUpAbhiprAyeNa ca vAgbhaTe~apyuktaM yat- “prAgrUpaM yena lakShyate| utpitsurAmayo doShavisheSheNAnadhiShThitaH ” (vA. ni.a.1) iti| yattu avyaktali~ggaM rUpaM pUrvarUpaM, taddoShavisheShamapi vyAdhergamayati, yaduktaM hArIte- “iti pUrvarUpamaShTAnAM jvarANAM sAmAnyataH, visheShatastu jRumbhA~ggamardabhUyiShThaM hRudayodvegi vAtajam” ityAdi, tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “sAmAnyato, visheShAttu jRumbhA~atyarthaM samIraNAt| pittAnnayanayordAhaH kaphAnnAnnAbhinandanam” (su.u.a.39) iti, etaddhi pUrvarUpaM bhAvijvarali~ggamevAvyaktamalpatveneti j~jeyam| vyakte hi jvare vAtAdije jRumbhAdayaH pUrvarUpApekShayA~atyarthaM bhavanti| evaM pUrvarUpadvaividhye yatra vishiShTaM pUrvarUpamasti tatra sAkShAdevAbhidhIyate, yatra vishiShTaM nAsti tatra li~ggamAtraM vakShyati; tenAvyaktAnyeva li~ggAni pUrvarUpamiti tatra j~jAtavyam ||8||

prAdurbhUtalakShaNaM punarli~ggam| tatra li~ggamAkRutirlakShaNaM cihnaM saMsthAnaM vya~jjanaM rUpamityanarthAntaram||9||

Commentary: lakShaNamAha- prAdurbhUtetyAdi| utpannavyAdheH svarUpaM, tathA vAtAdyAmapakvAdivisheShaNavishiShTaM vyAdhiM nidAnopashayasamprAptivyatiriktaM yadbodhayati, talli~ggam| anena ca vyAdhipratiniyataM li~ggaM yathA- jvarasya santApaH, tathA atisaraNamatIsArasyetyAdi gRuhyate; tathA vAtAdikRutaM ca vAtAdijvarasya viShamArambhavisargitvAdi gRuhyate; tathA AmapakvajIrNajvaralakShaNAdIni vishiShTavyAdhibodhakAni gRuhyante; tathA upadravAshcAsAdhyatAdyavasthApannavyAdhibodhakatvena lakShaNAnyeva| riShTaM tu maraNasya pUrvarUpameva| nidAnAdayastu yadyapyutpannavyAdhigamakA api bhavanti, tathA~api pRuthaglakShaNAnirdeshAnna te iha li~ggashabdenocyante| vyavahArArthaM tathA lakShaNArthaM ca li~ggaparyAyAnAha- tatra li~ggamityAdi| asminnarthe~anarthAntaramiti li~ggalakShaNe~arthe~abhidheye~anarthAntaraM, prakaraNAntare tvarthAntare~api li~ggAdayo bhavanti; yathA- “balI li~ggaM samarpayet” (ci.a.2) ityatra shepha ucyate, tathA “saMsthAnamAkRutirj~jeyA suShamA viShamA ca yA” (i.a.7); tathA “lakShaNavaccodAharaNavacca” (vi.a.8), tathA “tailasarpirbhyAM vya~jjanAnyupakalpayet”, tathA “rUpasya sattvasya ca santatiryA” (shA.a.2) ityAdau| nanu, yatheha ‘asminnarthe’ ityuktaM tathA hetuvyAdhisamprAptiparyAyAbhidhAne~api ‘asminnarthe’ iti vaktavyam| na, hetuparyAyAbhidhAne tAvat ‘iha khalu’ ityanenaiva tadartha ukta eva, samprAptiparyAyakathane ca vyAdheriti padenaiva ‘asminnarthe’ itipadasyArtho labhyata eva, gadaparyAyeShu tu nArthAntaratA prAyo dRushyate, tena tatra ‘asminnarthe’ iti na kRutam| ayaM cAcAryAbhiprAyo yat- yatrAnyArthatAM shabdasya pashyati, tatraiva ‘asminnarthe’ iti karoti, yathA- ‘samavetAnAM punardoShANAmaMshAMshavikalpo vikalpo~asminnarthe’ iti| vikalpashabdo hyayamanyatrApi vartate, yathA- “anyaishca vikalpairvikalpitAnAM” (vi.a.1), tathA “vikalpo na tvasAdhyAnAM” (sU.a.10) ityAdi| nanu pUrvarUpopashayayoH kimiti paryAyAnabhidhAnam? brUmaH- pUrvarUpasya tAvat paryAyAbhidhAnaM yadeva rUpasya tadeva; yataH, rUpAdaya eva hi pUrvashabdayuktAH pUrvarUpaparyAyA bhavanti; upashayastu cikitsA, tasyAstu paryAyAshcikitsita eva svAdhikAratvena vaktavyA iti neha punaruktAH||9||

upashayaH punarhetuvyAdhiviparItAnAM viparItArthakAriNAM cauShadhAhAravihArANAmupayogaH sukhAnubandhaH||10||

Commentary: upashayamAha- upashaya ityAdi| upashayanamupashayaH sukhAnubandha ityarthaH| hetunA, tathA vyAdhinA, tathA hetuvyAdhibhyAM ca viparItA hetuvyAdhiviparItAH; teShAmauShadhAhAravihArANAM, tathA hetuvyAdhiviparItArthakAriNAM cauShadhAnnavihArANAM; sukhAnubandha iti sukharUpo~anubandhaH, anubandhashca sukhakAraNamityarthaH | ayaM copashayo gUDhali~gge ca vyAdhau j~jAnopAyo bhavati| yaduktaM- “gUDhali~ggaM vyAdhimupashayAnupashayAbhyAM parIkSheta” (vi.a.4) iti; uktaM ca trishothIye- “snehoShNamardanAbhyAM ca praNashyet sa ca vAtikaH” (sU.a.18)| atra ca viparItArthakAri tadevocyate yadaviparItatayA~a~apAtataH pratIyamAnaM viparItasyArthaM prashamalakShaNaM karoti| atrodAharaNAni likhyante- hetuviparItamauShadhaM yathA- shItakaphaje jvare shuNThyAdyuShNaM bheShajaM, hetuviparItamannaM yathA- shramAnilaje jvare rasaudanaH, hetuviparIto vihAro yathA- divAsvapnotthakaphe rAtrau jAgaraNaM, vyAdhiviparItamauShadhaM yathA- atIsAre stambhanaM pAThAdi, vyAdhiviparItamannaM yathA- atIsAre stambhanaM masUrAdi, vyAdhiviparIto vihAro yathA- udAvarte pravAhaNaM, hetuvyAdhiviparItamauShadhaM yathA- vAtashothe vAtaharaM shothaharaM ca dashamUlaM, hetuvyAdhiviparItamannaM yathA- shItotthajvare uShNA jvaraghnI ca yavAgUH, hetuvyAdhiviparIto vihAro yathA- snigdhadivAsvapnajAyAM tandrAyAM rUkShaM tandrAviparItaM ca rAtrijAgaraNaM , hetuviparItArthakAryauShadhaM yathA- pittapradhAne pacyamAne shothe pittakara uShNa upanAhaH, hetuviparItArthakAryannaM yathA- pacyamAne pittapradhAne shothe vidAhyannaM, hetuviparItArthakArI vihAro yathA- vAtonmAde santrAsanaM, vyAdhiviparItArthakAryauShadhaM yathA- chardyAM vamanakArakaM madanaphalAdi; vyAdhiviparItArthakAryannaM yathA- atIsAre virekakArakaM kShIraM, uktaM hi- “bahudoShasya dIptAgneH saprANasya na tiShThati| paittiko yadyatIsAraH payasA taM virecayet” (ci. a.19) iti; vyAdhiviparItArthakArI vihAro yathA- chardyAM vamanasAdhyAyAM vamanArthaM pravAhaNaM; hetuvyAdhiviparItArthakAryauShadhaM yathA- agninA pluShTe~agurvAdinA lepaH, uShNaM hi hetAvagnau vyAdhau ca dAhe~anuguNaM pratibhAti; hetuvyAdhiviparItArthakAryannaM yathA- madyapAnotthe madAtyaye madakArakaM madyaM; hetuvyAdhiviparItArthakArI vihAro yathA- vyAyAmajanitasammUDhavAte jalaprataraNAdirUpo vyAyAmaH, ayaM hetau vyAyAme vyAdhau ca sammUDhavAte~anuguNaH pratibhAti| nanUpashayavadanupashayo~api vyAdhiparIkShako~asti, ucyate ca- “gUDhali~ggaM vyAdhimupashayAnupashayAbhyAM parIkSheta” (vi. a.4), tathA vAgbhaTe~apyuktaM- “viparIto~anupashayaH sa hyasAtmyamiti smRutaH” (vA. ni. a.1) iti; satyamasti ca, paraM nidAnagrahaNenaiva gRuhItatvAnna pRuthagucyate; anupashayo~api hetusevayaiva bhavati||10||

sa~gkShepeNa hetuli~ggAbhidhAyakaM sUtrasthAnamanu prapa~jcena hetuli~ggAbhidhAyakaM nidAnasthAnamucyate; hetuli~ggaj~jAnapUrvikA hi cikitsA sAdhvI bhavati| yacca cikitsAsUtramAtramabhidhAtavyaM, tadupashayAntargatameveti kRutvA; kiMvA, hetuli~ggAbhidhAnasyApi cikitsArthatvAccikitsAsUtramAtrAbhidhAnamiha | tatrApi ca shArIravikAreShu pradhAnatvAjjvarasyaiva nidAnamAdAvucyate| yathA ca jvaraH pradhAnaM tathA~atraiva ‘jvarastu khalu’ ityAdinA vakShyati; tathA cikitsite~api vakShyati- “dehendriyamanastApI sarvarogAgrajo balI” (ci.a.3) ityAdi| yattu vakShyati- “purA gulmotpattirabhUt” (ni.a.8) iti; tatra purAshabda AdyAvirbhAve gulmasya vartate, natu jvarasya prAgbhAve; dakShAdhvaroddhvaMse hi jvaraparigRuhItAnAM prANinAM dikShu vidrAvaNAdinA gulmotpatteruktatvAt| nidAnaM kAraNamihocyate, tacceha vyAdhijanakaM vyAdhibodhakaM ca sAmAnyenocyate| tatra vyAdhijanakaM nidAnaM hetuH, vyAdhibodhakaM ca kAraNaM nidAnapUrvarUparUpopashayasamprAptirUpam| tatra heturUpaM nidAnaM janakaM ca bhavati, vyAdherbodhakaM ca bhavati| ata eva prathamam ‘iha khalu’ ityAdinA hetumabhidhAya tasyopalabdhirnidAnetyAdinA punarheturapyuktaH| jvarasya nidAnaM jvaranidAnam| kiMvA, nidAnashabdo janakakAraNavacana eva; taM jvarasya janakakAraNaM nidAnamadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyo jvaranidAnam| tena pUrvarUpAdInAmapi j~japtihetUnAM tathA cikitsAsUtrasya ca grahaNam||1-2||

uShNetyAdinA pittajvaramAha- tadyathetyAdi|- pUrvavadvyAkhyeyam| dravatvAdagnimupahatyetivacanAduShNasyApi pittasya dravatvenAgniviparItena guNenAgnihantRutAM darshayati| vakShyati hi grahaNyadhyAye- “AplAvayaddhantyanalaM jalaM taptamivAnalam” (ci.a.15) iti| bahirnirasya prapIDayaditivacanena pittajvare vAtajvara iva na sahasA vahnikShepaNaM bhavati, kintu shanaiH stokakrameNeti darshayati| yugapadeveti na vaiShamyeNa| abhyAgamanamabhivRuddhirveti ca pUrveNa yugapadevetyAdinA pareNa ca visheSheNetyantena ca granthena sambadhyate| koThAbhinirvRuttiH sharIra iti cchedaH||22-24||

snigdhetyAdinA shleShmajvaramAha| sa yadetyAdi pUrvavat kaphajvare~api vyAkhyeyam| nanu, shleShmaNa AmAshayaH sthAnaM, tat kiM pravishyAmAshayamiti vacanena? naivaM, shleShmaNa uro~api pradhAnaM sthAnaM, tenehoraHsthasyApi shleShmaNa AmAshayapraveshaM darshayati| yatra kevalAmAshayavRutti pittaM, tatra ‘AmAshayaM pravishya’ iti na kRutaM, kintu ‘AmAshayAdUShmANamupasRujya’ iti kRutaM; pittaM hyAmAshayapraviShTameva bhavati, taccAmAshayaikadeshasthaM grahaNIrUpAmAshayaikadeshaM vahnisthAnaM svasthAnAdgacchatIti yuktam||25-26||

yathAsvauShadhasiddhasyeti vAtAdijvare vAtajvarAdiharadravyasiddhasya| kathaM sarpiH sarvatra kAryamityAha- sarpirhi snehAdityAdi| saMskArAt kaphamiti kaTutiktAdikaphaharasaMskArAt| yadyapi ca ‘yathAsvauShadhasiddhasya’ iti vacanAdvAte~api vAtaharasaMskRutameva sarpirvihitaM , tathA~api vAte rUkShaviparItena snehenApi sarpirvAtaharameva, pitte~apyuShNaviparItashaityAnvitaM, kaphe tu sarpiShaH snehashaityAdinA samAnena kashcinna svAbhAviko virodhiguNo~asti kintu saMskArAddhitameveti darshayati| UShmANaM ceti jvaraprabhAvabhUtamUShmANaM; na pittoShmANaM, tasya pittagrahaNenaiva grahaNAt| anena jvarasyoShmaharaNena sarpiSho jvaravyAdhipratyanIkatvaM darshitaM bhavati| atra vAtashamanaM sarpiSho~abhidhAya pittashamane~abhidhAtavye kaphashamanamucyate, sheShato vaktavyoShmarUpavyAdhipratyanIkatayA~api pittashamanahetoH shaityasya samAnaguNatvAt; yadi tviha madhye pittaprashamanamucyate, tadA punaH saMskArAt kaphamityuktvA shaityAdUShmANamiti vaktavyaM syAt| yatra tu shlokapAThe vyAdhipratyanIkatvaM ghRutasya pRutha~gnoktaM; tatra, ‘snehAdvAtaM shamayati’ ityAdau vAtamanu pittameva kRutamiti sAdhu kRutam| tasmAditi doShavyAdhipratyanIkatvAt| jIrNajvareShviti vacanenAmajvare niShedhayati, sAme hi samAnaguNatvAt sarpirahitam| shAntimiti santApashAntim| abhipretyeti buddhyA svIkRutya, tathA jIrNajvare ghRutaM ‘dadAti’ iti sheShaH| nanvatra, shloke sarpirguNakathane kimiti vyAdhirUpoShmashamanaM nocyate? brUmaH- pittoShmAvyatiriktatvena jvaroShmaNaH pittashamanenaiva labdhatvAt| nanu yadyevaM gadyapAThe pRutha~gna tarhi paThanIya UShmA? brUmaH- yAvAnUShmA shArIraH sa paitta eva, yato brUte- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti” (vA.ci.a.1) ityAdi, tathA “pittAdUShmoShmaNaH paktirnarANAmupajAyate” (sU.a.17) iti; kintu, nAsAvUShmA kadAcit pittena sAmye~apyeko bhavati, yathA- kaphajvare; kadAcittvadhike pitte vahnirUpa UShmA mando bhavati, yathA- pittAgnimAndye; tadevamUShmA pittAdbhinno~abhinnashca bhavati; tatra bhedaM gRuhItvA gadyapAThe pRuthag jvaroShmA paThitaH, shlokapAThe tvabhedavivakShayA na pRuthak paThitaH| jvare tu pittoShmA jvaraprabhAveNa vardhate, sa ca prabhAvo jvarasya doShadUShyavisheShAtmakasya, tathA “jvarastripAdastrishiraH” ityAdyuktaprANivisheShasya j~jeyaH| nanu sarpiH kathaM pittaM hanti? yataH, yathA pittaviparItashaityaM sarpiShi, tathA pittasamAnaH sneho~apyasti| naivaM, pitte “sasnehaM” (sU.a.1) itIShadarthena sashabdenAlpasya snehasyAbhidhAnAt, uShNatvaM tu pitte pradhAnam| yadyapi pittaM jalenApyArabdhaM, tathA~api tatra shaityamabhibhUyAgnikRutamauShNyamevAdhikaM bhavati, tathA tejaso raukShyeNa jalakRutasneho~api pitte~abhibhUyate, dravatvaM tu jalakRutaM tejasA nAbhibhUyate, dRushyate hyagnisampRukte jale dravatvamalpasnehatA uShNatA ceti| kiMvA, kimanena taptajaladRuShTAntena, adRuShTakRuta evAyaM bhUtAnAmutpAdaH; tena, kashciteva guNaH pA~jcabhautikatve~api dravyANAmAvirbhUto bhavati, natu sarve; yathA- shAliShu toyakRutaM madhuratvaM, na tu gauravamityuktaM sUtrasthAne| utsargataH sasnehasyApi pittasya kadAcittejobhUyastvena rUkShatvamapi bhavati jIrNajvare, tena snigdhashItaM sarpirhitaM tatra bhavatIti na doShaH| ata evoktaM cikitsite- “rUkShaM tejo jvarakaraM” (ci.a.3) ityAdi| na ca vAcyaM- yat- sAMsiddhikamapi cet pittasya snigdhatvamapaiti tadA vAtasyApi raukShyaM kimiti nApaitIti; yato vicitrA eva hi guNA apratikShepaNIyAH pratikShepaNIyAshca; tatra ye na sarvadA dRushyante vAtashaitya-pittasnehAdayaH, ta eva pratikShepaNIyAH; nAnye, tathaiva dRuShTatvAt| tulyaguNamiti sarvathA tulyaguNam| nanu saMskArAt kaphahantRutve saMskAreNaiva kapho hanyate , kastatra sarpiSho vyApAra ityAha- nAnya ityAdi| nAnya iti tailAdiH| saMskAramanuvartata iti saMskArakadravyakAryaM karoti| etenaitaddarshayati- yat- tenaiva dravyeNa yAdRu~gmAnena ghRutaM saMskriyate, anyatra tailAdisnehastathaiva yadi saMskriyate tadA ghRutamevAnyasnehebhyo visheSheNa saMskArakadravyakAryaM karoti; ayaM ghRutaprabhAvo~adhikaH, tena saMskArAt kaphavijaye ghRutameva kartavyamityarthaH| prapa~jcitashcAyamarthaH snehAdhyAye||37-40||

sa~ggrahe yadyapi hetuparyAyAH pUrvamuktAstadanu hetutraividhyaM, tathA~api chando~anurodhena tadviparyayakathanam| nAmarUpA yogarUDhAH paryAyA nAmaparyAyAH| pa~jcavidhaM gadamiti AgneyAdibhedena| ‘gadaparyAyanAmAni’ iti pAThe yalli~ggaparyAyAbhidhAnaM tasya vyAdhipa~jcavidhagrahashabdenaiva ‘tasyopalabdhiH’ ityAdigranthAntarniviShTasakalArthasya gRuhItatvAdgrahaNam; ‘gadalakShaNaparyAyAn’ iti pAThe tu pUrvapakSho nAstyeva, pAThastu nAyamatiprasiddhaH| prakRuShTAsannakAraNaM jvarasya rUkShAdi prakRuShTam, AsannaM vAtAdi; tathA prakRuShTaM rudrakopaH, AsannaM tu rUkShAdi| yadyapi rUpAt pashcAt pUrvarUpamuktaM, tathA~api chandonurodhAt pUrvarUpamagre kRutaM; kiMvA, vAtAdijavishiShTajvaralakShaNAnAmavyaktAnAM vishiShTajvarapUrvarUpatAM sUcayatA pUrvarUpaM pUrva~gkRutaM; vAtAdijvaralakShaNAni hyavyaktAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti||42-44||
athAto raktapittanidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
pittaM yathAbhUtaM lohitapittamiti sa~jj~jAM labhate, tad vyAkhyAsyAmaH||3||

yadA janturyavakoddAlakakoradUShaprAyANyannAni bhu~gkte, bhRushoShNatIkShNamapi cAnyadannajAtaM niShpAvamAShakulatthasUpakShAropasaMhitaM, dadhidadhimaNDodashvitkaTvarAmlakA~jjikopasekaM vA, vArAhamAhiShAvikamAtsyagavyapishitaM, piNyAkapiNDAlushuShkashAkopahitaM, mUlakasarShapalashunakara~jjashigrumadhushigru(khaDayUSha ) bhUstRuNasumukhasurasakuTherakagaNDIrakAlamAlakaparNAsakShavakaphaNijjhakopadaMshaM, surAsauvIratuShodakamaireyamedakamadhUlakashuktakuvalabadarAmlaprAyAnupAnaM vA, piShTAnnottarabhUyiShTham; uShNAbhitapto vA~atimAtramativelaM vA~a~amaM payaH pibati, payasA samashnAti rauhiNIkaM , kANakapotaM vA sarShapatailakShArasiddhaM, kulatthapiNyAkajAmbavalakucapakvaiH shauktikairvA saha kShIraM pibatyuShNAbhitaptaH ; tasyaivamAcarataH pittaM prakopamApadyate, lohitaM ca svapramANamativartate| tasmin pramANAtivRutte pittaM prakupitaM sharIramanusarpadyadeva yakRutplIhaprabhavANAM lohitavahAnAM ca srotasAM lohitAbhiShyandagurUNi mukhAnyAsAdya pratirundhyAt tadeva lohitaM dUShayati||4||

Commentary: yadA janturityAdinA nidAnamucyate| yavakaH vrIhivisheShaH; uddAlaH vanakodravaH; koradUShaH yadyapyannapAne pittahara uktastathA~apyasya niShpAvAdiyuktasya saMyogamahimnA raktapittanidAnatvaM j~jeyam, evamanyatrApi raktapittanidAnatvenehoktakShIrAdau j~jeyam| dadhimaNDaH mastu, udashvit ardhajalaM takraM, kaTvaraM nirjalaM, kiMvA amlaM takram| madhushigruH svalpashobhA~jjanakaH| khaDayUShaH rAgakarpUra iti khyAtaH| sumukhAdayaH phaNijjhakAntAH parNAsabhedAH| upadaMshamiti mUlakAdIni khAdayitvA yAvakAdyannaM bhu~gkte ityarthaH| madhUlakaH godhUmavisheShaH| shuktaH sandhAnavisheShaH| piShTAnnamuttaratra bhojanasya bhUyiShThaM yatra tat piShTAnnottarabhUyiShTham| ativelamiti punaH punaH| rauhiNIkaM rohiNIshAkam| shauktikairiti badarIphalaiH| AmamityuttareNa sambadhyate| svapramANamativartate pravardhata ityarthaH| yadevetyanena evamapi prakupitasya pittasya ya evAMsha uktasamprAptimAn bhavati sa eva raktaM dUShayati nAnya iti darshayati| lohitAbhiShyandagurUNi pravRuddhalohitasyandena gurUNi utsannAni vivRutAnIti yAvat| pratirundhyAt ‘vRuddhena shoNitena’ iti sheShaH; ‘pratipadyate’ iti pAThapakShe tu ‘shoNitam’ iti sheShaH, tena shoNitaM pratipadyata ityarthaH| yakRutplIhaprabhavANAmityasya visheShaNaM- lohitavahAnAmiti| cakAro~avadhAraNe| vakShyati ca raktapittacikitsite- “plIhAnaM ca yakRuccaiva tadadhiShThAya vartate| srotAMsi raktavAhIni tanmUlAni hi dehinAm” (ci.a.4) iti||4||

saMsargAllohitapradUShaNAllohitagandhavarNAnuvidhAnAcca pittaM lohitapittamityAcakShate||5||

Commentary: evaM raktadUShake pitte yathA raktapittasa~jj~jA bhavati, tadAha- saMsargAdityAdi| saMsargAt lohitasambandhAt| lohitagandhavarNAnuvidhAnAditi lohitasadRushagandhavarNayuktatvAt| etena, ‘raktayuktaM pittaM raktapittam’ iti prathamA niruktiH, ‘rakte dUShye pittam’ iti dvitIyA, ‘raktavat pittaM raktapittam’ iti tRutIyA darshyate| uktaM ca cikitsite- “saMsargAddUShaNAttattu sAmAnyAdgandhavarNayoH| raktasya pittamAkhyAtaM raktapittaM manIShibhiH”- (ci.a.4) iti| etadeva ca raktapittasya sAmAnyalakShaNaM- yad- raktagandhavarNAnuvidhAnaM; visheShalakShaNaM tu UrdhvAdibhedena kaphAdisambandhAdeveha boddhavyaM; cikitsite~api ‘sAndraM sapANDu’ (ci.a.4) ityAdinA lakShaNaM vakShyati||5||

tasyemAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti; tadyathA- anannAbhilAShaH, bhuktasya vidAhaH, shuktAmlagandharasa udgAraH, charderabhIkShNamAgamanaM, charditasya bIbhatsatA, svarabhedo, gAtrANAM sadanaM, paridAhaH, mukhAddhUmAgama iva, lohalohitamatsyAmagandhitvamiva cAsyasya, raktaharitahAridratvama~ggAvayavashakRunmUtrasvedalAlAsi~gghANakAsyakarNamalapiDakolikApiDakAnAm , a~ggavedanA, lohitanIlapItashyAvAnAmarciShmatAM ca rUpANAM svapne darshanamabhIkShNamiti (lohitapittapUrvarUpANi bhavanti)||6||

Commentary: pUrvarUpe charditasya bIbhatsatA vaivarNyavaigandhyAdiyogAt| piDakolikA netramalaH| a~ggavedanA a~ggamardaH||6||

upadravAstu khalu daurbalyArocakAvipAkashvAsakAsajvarAtIsArashophashoShapANDurogAH svarabhedashca||7||

Commentary: vyAdherasAdhyatvasya dharmasya khyApakAn li~ggavisheShAnupadravAkhyAnAha- upadravAstvityAdi| etenopadravasya li~ggabhUtatvena nidAnapa~jcakAnatiriktatvam| raktapitte caite upadravAH prAyobhAvitvena niyatA ityabhidhIyante; jvare tUpadravA niyatA na santi, tena tatra noktAH; evaM gulmAdAvapi prAyobhAvitvenopadravakathanaM vyAkhyeyam| svarabhedashceti pRuthakpAThena svarabhedasya prAyobhAvitvamAha||7||

mArgau punarasya dvau UrdhvaM, cAdhashca| tadbahushleShmaNi sharIre shleShmasaMsargAdUrdhvaM pratipadyamAnaM karNanAsikAnetrAsyebhyaH pracyavate, bahuvAte tu sharIre vAtasaMsargAdadhaH pratipadyamAnaM mUtrapurIShamArgAbhyAM pracyavate, bahushleShmavAte tu sharIre shleShmavAtasaMsargAddvAvapi mArgau pratipadyate, tau mArgau pratipadyamAnaM sarvebhya eva yathoktebhyaH khebhyaH pracyavate sharIrasya||8||

tatra yadUrdhvabhAgaM tat sAdhyaM, virecanopakramaNIyatvAdbahvauShadhatvAcca; yadadhobhAgaM tadyApyaM, vamanopakramaNIyatvAdalpauShadhatvAcca; yadubhayabhAgaM tadasAdhyaM, vamanavirecanAyogitvAdanauShadhatvAcceti||9||

raktapittaprakopastu khalu purA dakShayaj~joddhvaMse rudrakopAmarShAgninA prANinAM parigatasharIraprANAnAmabhavajjvaramanu||10||

Commentary: raktapittasyApyAgneyatvapratipAdanArthaM pUrvotpattimAha- raktetyAdi| kopayuktaH amarShaH, amarShaH abhiniveshaH; anyatrApi ca kopAmarShayorbheda uktaH; yathA- “amarShasaMrambhavinagnabhAvAH santarjanAbhidravaNauShNyaroShAH” (ci.a.9) iti||10||

tasyAshukAriNo dAvAgnerivApatitasyAtyayikasyAshu prashAntyai prayatitavyaM mAtrAM deshaM kAlaM cAbhisamIkShya santarpaNenApatarpaNena vA mRudumadhurashishiratiktakaShAyairabhyavahAryaiH pradehapariShekAvagAhasaMsparshanairvamanAdyairvA tatrAvahiteneti||11||

Commentary: santarpaNeneti adhogasya, apatarpaNeneti Urdhvagasya| saMspRushyata iti saMsparshanaM muktAdi||11||
bhavanti cAtra-  sAdhyaM lohitapittaM tadyadUrdhvaM pratipadyate| virecanasya yogitvAdbahutvAdbheShajasya ca||12||
virecanaM tu pittasya jayArthe paramauShadham| yashca tatrAnvayaH shleShmA tasya cAnadhamaM smRutam||13||
bhavedyogAvahaM tatra madhuraM caiva bheShajam| tasmAt sAdhyaM mataM raktaM yadUrdhvaM pratipadyate||14||
raktaM tu yadadhobhAgaM tadyApyamiti nishcitam| vamanasyAlpayogitvAdalpatvAdbheShajasya ca||15||
vamanaM hi na pittasya haraNe shreShThamucyate| yashca tatrAnvayo vAyustacchAntau cAvaraM smRutam||16||
taccAyogAvahaM tatra kaShAyaM tiktakAni ca| tasmAdyApyaM samAkhyAtaM yaduktamanulomagam ||17||
raktapittaM tu yanmArgau dvAvapi pratipadyate| asAdhyamiti tajj~jeyaM pUrvoktAdeva kAraNAt||18||
nahi saMshodhanaM ki~jcidastyasya pratimArgagam| pratimArgaM ca haraNaM raktapitte vidhIyate||19||
evamevopashamanaM sarvasho nAsya vidyate| saMsRuShTeShu ca doSheShu sarvajicchamanaM matam ||20||
ebhyastu khalu hetubhyaH ki~jcitsAdhyaM na sidhyati||21||
preShyopakaraNAbhAvAddaurAtmyAdvaidyadoShataH| akarmatashca sAdhyatvaM kashcidrogo~ativartate||22||
raktapittasya vij~jAnamidaM tasyopadishyate||23||
yat kRuShNamathavA nIlaM yadvA shakradhanuShprabham| raktapittamasAdhyaM tadvAsaso ra~jjanaM ca yat||24||
bhRushaM pUtyatimAtraM ca sarvopadravavacca yat| balamAMsakShaye yacca tacca raktamasiddhimat||25||
yena copahato raktaM raktapittena mAnavaH| pashyeddRushyaM viyaccApi taccAsAdhyaM na saMshayaH||26||

tatrAsAdhyaM parityAjyaM, yApyaM yatnena yApayet| sAdhyaM cAvahitaH siddhairbheShajaiH sAdhayedbhiShak||27||

Commentary: yatneneti vacanAdyApyayApanaM yatnaM vinA na bhavatIti darshayati||27||
tatra shlokau- kAraNaM nAmanirvRuttiM pUrvarUpANyupadravAn| mArgau doShAnubandhaM ca sAdhyatvaM na ca hetumat||28||
nidAne raktapittasya vyAjahAra punarvasuH| vItamoharajodoShalobhamAnamadaspRuhaH||29||

Adyotpattau jvarasantApAdraktapittotpatterjvaramanu raktapittanidAnamucyate| pittaM yathAbhUtamityAdinA pittamevAvasthAvashAllohitapittamityucyata iti darshayati, natu raktaM ca pittaM ca raktapittamiti||1-3||

sAdhyatvAdivisheShasya tathA kaphAdisambandhasya ca mArgavisheShakRutasya pratipAdanArthaM mArgamAha- mArgAvityAdi| bahushleShmaNi sharIre shleShmasaMsargAditi vacanena Urdhvage raktapitte shleShmasambandhaH kAraNAntaracitenApi shleShmaNA bhavatIti darshayati| yattu raktapittanidAnajanyatvaM kaphasya, tannAvashyaM bhavati; ata eva “snigdhoShNamuShNarUkShaM ca raktapittasya kAraNam| adhogasyottaraM prAyaH” (ci.a.4) ityAdau prAyaHshabdaM kRutavAn| evaM ‘bahuvAte tu’ ityatrApi vyAkhyeyam| khebhya iti randhrebhyaH| virecanopakramaNIyatvAditi etacca shlokena svayameva vyAkariShyati||8-9||

Urdhvagasya virecanayogyatAM vivecayati- virecanamityAdi| Urdhvage raktapitte pittaM pradhAnamanubandhashca shleShmA, raktapittAkhyavyAdhirjetavyaH; tatra pittasya jayArthe virecanaM tAvat paramauShadhaM, “virecanaM pittaharANAm” (sU.a.25) iti vacanAditi bhAvaH, yashca tatrAnvayaH anubandhasvarUpaH shleShmA, tasya ca jayArthe anadhamamadhamaM na bhavati madhyamamityarthaH; vacanaM hi- “pittaM vA kaphapittaM vA pittAshayagataM haret| sraMsanaM” (ci.a.3) iti| yogAvahaM ca tatreti tatrordhvage raktapitte tadvirecanaM yogAvahaM bhavati, pratimArgaharaNarUpatvAdityarthaH; anena ca vyAdhipratyanIkatvamucyate| evaM vyAdhipradhAnakAraNe pitte pradhAnashamaka(na)tvAt, tathA madhyakupite ca kaphe madhyabheShajatvAt, pratimArgaharaNarUpatayA ca vyAdhipratyanIkatvAd virecanamUrdhvage sAdhu bheShajam| madhuraM caiva bheShajamityatra evashabdo~apyarthaH; tena, tiktakaShAyau tAvadbheShaje bhavata eva pittakaphapratyanIkatvAt, madhuramapi la~gghanAdinA kaphe jite bheShajaM bhavatItyarthaH||12-14||

adhoge vamanasyAyogitAM vivecayati- vamanaM hItyAdi| pittasya raktapittamUlasya haraNe na shreShThaM vamanaM; vamanaM hi kaphAnugaM pittaM harati, na pitte prAdhAnyena kriyate| tacchAntau cAvaramiti vAtaharaNe tvapradhAnameva vamanaM, vAtaharaNe~ayuktatvAdeva vamanasya| taccAyogAvahamiti tadvamanaM pratimArgaharaNarUpatayA yogAvahamapi sat pittavAtayoruktena nyAyenAyaugikatvenAyogAvahamityarthaH| kaShAyaM tiktakAni ca ayogAvahAnIti yojanA, kaShAyatiktayorvAtapratikUlatvAdityarthaH; evaM madhuramekamavashiShTamadhoge raktapitte bheShajaM bhavati; tenAlpauShadhatvaM siddham| amlalavaNakaTukAnAM tu pittaviruddhatvena raktapitte prasaktirapi nAstIti bhAvaH||15-17||

pUrvoktAditi vamanavirecanAyaugikatvAdanauShadhatvAcca| vamanavirecanAyaugikatvaM vyutpAdayati- na hItyAdi| saMshodhanamiti sAmAnyavacanena bastishirovirecanayorapi pratikShepaM sUcayati| yadadhobhAgaM virecanaM tadadhobhAgaM raktapittaM kopayati, yadUrdhvabhAgaM vamanaM tadUrdhvabhAgaM raktapittaM kopayati; ato nAstyubhayamArge raktapitte shodhanam| athAnuguNameva shodhanaM kaphacchardyAmiva vamanaM raktapitte bhavatItyAha- pratimArgaM cetyAdi| raktapittavyAdhimahimnA pratimArgaharaNameva bheShajaM bhavati nAnyadityarthaH| athAtraivaM saMshodhanaM mA bhavatu bheShajaM, saMshamanaM bheShajaM bhavatvityAha- evamevetyAdi| ubhayamArgAnusAritvena vAtakaphAnubandhatvAd yathA yaugikaM saMshodhanaM nAsti tathopashamanamapi yugapadvAtakaphashamakatvAbhAvAnnAstItyarthaH| sarvasho na vidyata iti ki~jcidapi na vidyata iti| etadevopashamanabheShajAbhAvaM sphoTayati- saMsRuShTeShvityAdi| saMsRuShTeShviti sannipAteShviti boddhavyam| sarvajiditi anubandhabhUtavAtakaphamUlabhUtapittajit; madhuraM hi kaphakAri, tiktakaShAyau tu vAtakarau, sheShAstu pittakarA eveti bhAvaH| kiMvA, evameveti vinA bheShajaM nopashamanaM raktapittasya bhavatIti yojanIyam| trividhodarkamiti trividhAyatIyaphalaM, tacca sAdhyatva yApyatva pratyAkhyeyatvarUpam||18-20||-

asAdhyatopoddhAtenetaravyAdhisAdhAraNAnyapyasAdhyatApattikAraNAnyAha- ebhyastvityAdi| upakaraNAbhAvAditi bheShajAbhAvAt| daurAtmyAditi AturasyAnAtmavattvAt| akarmata ityatra kutsAyAM na~j, aputra iti yathA; tena, akarmataH asamyakcikitsAta ityarthaH; kiMvA akarmata iti adharmAdasAdhyavyAdhijanakAt| kashciditivacanena acikitsayA na sarve tilAlakamashakAdayo~avashyamasAdhyA bhavantIti darshayati, teShAmacikitsAyAmapi sAdhyatvAt| preShyAdidoSheNa prakRute raktapitte~asAdhyatvaM darshayannAha- tatretyAdi| tatreti raktapitte| asAdhyatvamekamiti asAdhyatvameva paraM syAt| sAdhyayApyaparikramAditi sAdhyayApyamArgAbhyAM parikramAdubhayamArgAnusAritvAdityarthaH; kiMvA, sAdhyayApyayoH parikramaH sAdhyayApyaparikramaH, tasmAt; tatra sAdhyaparikramo yApyamArgagAmitvam, evaM yApyasya parikramo~asAdhyamArgagAmitvam| ayaM ca mArgaparikramaH mArgaparityAgAdaparityAgAdvA~asAdhya eva; aparityAge tAvadubhayamArgatvenaivAsAdhyatvaM; parityAge~asAdhyatvamuktaM, vakShyati hi cikitsite- “mArgAnmArgaM caredyadvA tacca raktamasiddhimat” (ci.a.4) iti| kiMvA, sAdhyayApyaparikramAditi sAdhyasya yApyatvena parikramAdityarthaH||21-22||-
