UrdhvagasyApi raktapittasya lAkShaNikImasAdhyatAmAha- raktapittasyetyAdi| ete ca kRuShNAdayo varNA gambhIradhAtusambandhAdbhavanti, tatashcAsAdhyatvaM yuktameva| vAsaso ra~jjanaM ca yaditi prakShAlitamapi sadvAso ra~jjayati, na kShAlanenApaitIti boddhavyam; anyathA ‘sarvameva raktaM vAsaso ra~jjanaM bhavati’ iti vacanamanarthakaM syAt| kiMvA ‘ara~jjanam’ iti pAThaH; tena, raktasya vAsaso ra~jjakasyAra~jjanameva vikRutiH| bhRushaM pUtIti dhAtvantarasambandhAdatidurgandhi| sarvopadravavaditi uktadaurbalyAdyupadravayuktam| dRushyaM ghaTapaTAdi| viyad AkAsham| raktaM raktavarNamityarthaH| yadyapyAkAshamapi dRushyaM bhavati mImAMsakanaye, tathA~api prAya AkAshe evAsAdhyaraktapitte raktatvaM pratIyata iti na punaruktam||23-26||

kAraNamityAdi sa~ggrahaH| nAmanirvRuttimiti lohitasaMsargAdityAdinA| na ceti na ca sAdhyatvam; anena ca yApyamapi sa~ggRuhItam, asAdhyabhedo hi yApyam| hetumaditi virecanasya yaugikatvAdihetuvarNanaM sa~ggRuhNAti| vItA apagatA mohAdayo yasya sa tathA||28-29||
athAto gulmanidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
iha khalu pa~jca gulmA bhavanti; tadyathA- vAtagulmaH, pittagulmaH, shleShmagulmo, nicayagulmaH, shoNitagulma iti||3||

eShAM tu khalu pa~jcAnAM gulmAnAM prAgabhinirvRutterimAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti; tadyathA- anannAbhilaShaNam, arocakAvipAkau, agnivaiShamyaM, vidAho bhuktasya, pAkakAle cAyuktyA chardyudgArau, vAtamUtrapurIShavegAnAM cAprAdurbhAvaH, prAdurbhUtAnAM cApravRuttirIShadAgamanaM vA, vAtashUlATopAntrakUjanApariharShaNAtivRuttapurIShatAH, abubhukShA, daurbalyaM, sauhityasya cAsahatvamiti||15||

Commentary: tadyathetyAdinA pUrvarUpANyAha| ayuktyeti chardyudgArakAraNamantareNa vyAdhiprabhAvAdevetyarthaH| ativRuttapurIShatA udAvartaH||15||

sarveShvapi khalveteShu gulmeShu na kashcidvAtAdRute sambhavati gulmaH| teShAM sAnnipAtikamasAdhyaM j~jAtvA naivopakrameta, ekadoShaje tu yathAsvamArambhaM praNayet, saMsRuShTAMstu sAdhAraNena karmaNopacaret| yaccAnyadapyaviruddhaM manyeta tadapyavacArayedvibhajya gurulAghavamupadravANAM, gurUnupadravAMstvaramANashcikitsejjaghanyamitarAn| tvaramANastu visheShamanupalabhamAno gulmeShvAtyayike karmaNi vAtacikitsitaM praNayet, snehasvedau vAtaharau snehopasaMhitaM ca mRudu virecanaM bastIMshca; amlalavaNamadhurAMshca rasAn yuktyA~avacArayet| mArute hyupashAnte svalpenApi prayatnena shakyo~anyo~api doSho niyantuM gulmeShviti||16||
bhavati cAtra-  gulminAmanilashAntirupAyaiH sarvasho vidhivadAcaritavyA| mArute hyavajite~anyamudIrNaM doShamalpamapi karma nihanyAt||17||

tatra shlokaH- sa~gkhyA nimittaM rUpANi pUrvarUpamathApi ca| diShTaM nidAne gulmAnAmekadeshashca karmaNAm||18||

Commentary: sa~ggrahe ekadeshashca karmaNAmiti cikitsitAnAm||18||
evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- kathamiha bhagavan pa~jcAnAM gulmAnAM visheShamabhijAnImahe; nahyavisheShavidrogANAmauShadhavidapi bhiShak prashamanasamartho bhavatIti||4||
tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- samutthAnapUrvarUpali~ggavedanopashayavisheShebhyo visheShavij~jAnaM gulmAnAM bhavatyanyeShAM ca rogANAmagnivesha! tattu khalu gulmeShUcyamAnaM nibodha||5||

yadA puruSho vAtalo visheSheNa jvaravamanavirecanAtIsArANAmanyatamena karshanena karshito vAtalamAhAramAharati, shItaM vA visheSheNAtimAtram , asnehapUrve vA vamanavirecane pibati, anudIrNAM vA chardimudIrayati, udIrNAn vAtamUtrapurIShavegAnniruNaddhi, atyashito vA pibati navodakamatimAtram, atisa~gkShobhiNA vA yAnena yAti, ativyavAyavyAyAmamadyashokarucirvA, abhighAtamRucchati vA, viShamAsanashayanasthAnaca~gkramaNasevI vA bhavati, anyadvA ki~jcidevaMvidhaM viShamamatimAtraM vyAyAmajAtamArabhate, tasyApacArAdvAtaH prakopamApadyate||6||

Commentary: vAtalo visheSheNeti vacanAt pittalAderapi yathoktamAcarato vAtagulmo bhavati, vAtalasya tvatyarthamiti darshayati| shItaM vA visheSheNeti atyarthashItamityarthaH| atimAtramiti cchedaH| ativyavAyavyAyAmAdirucirvA ‘bhavati’ iti sheShaH; vyavAyAdirucyA vyavAyAdyAcaraNaM lakShayati||6||

sa prakupito vAyurmahAsroto~anupravishya raukShyAt kaThinIbhUtamAplutya piNDito~avasthAnaM karoti hRudi bastau pArshvayornAbhyAM vA; sa shUlamupajanayati granthIMshcAnekavidhAn, piNDitashcAvatiShThate, sa piNDitatvAd ‘gulma’ ityabhidhIyate; sa muhurAdhamati , muhuralpatvamApadyate; aniyatavipulANuvedanashca bhavati calatvAdvAyoH, muhuH pipIlikAsampracAra ivA~ggeShu, todabhedasphuraNAyAmasa~gkocasuptiharShapralayodayabahulaH; tadAturaH sUcyeva sha~gkuneva cAbhisaMviddhamAtmAnaM manyate, api ca divasAnte jvaryate , shuShyati cAsyAsyam, ucchvAsashcoparudhyate, hRuShyanti cAsya romANi vedanAyAH prAdurbhAve; plIhATopAntrakUjanAvipAkodAvartA~ggamardamanyAshiraHsha~gkhashUlabradhnarogAshcainamupadravanti; kRuShNAruNaparuShatva~gnakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShashca bhavati, nidAnoktAni cAsya nopasherate, viparItAni copasherata iti vAtagulmaH||7||

Commentary: raukShyAt kaThinIbhUtamiti mahAsrotovisheShaNaM; tacca prakupitasya vAyo raukShyeNa tathoktajvarakarshanAdihetukRutAcca raukShyAt koShThasya kaThinatvamupapannam| Aplutyeti vyApya, koShThameva| anyatrApyuktam- “AplutaM mAruteneha sharIraM yasya kevalam” (iM. a. 10) iti; AplutaM vyAptamityarthaH| yadA tu ‘raukShyAt kaThinIbhUta’ iti pAThastadA vAtavisheShaNaM, vAtasya kaThinatvamatyarthaM prakopeNa ghanatvameva boddhavyam| piNDita iti kuNDalIbhUtaH| nAbhyAM veti cchedaH| piNDitashceti dvitIyapiNDitashabdena mAMsAdyuttuNDanena gulmapradeshasyApi piNDitatvamucyate; pUrveNa piNDitashabdena tu vAyoH piNDitatvamiti na paunaruktyam| anekavidhAniti cchedaH| granthIMshcAnekavidhAniti dIrghavRuttasthUlAdibhedena bhinnAn| piNDitatvAd ‘gulma’ ityucyate ityanena latAdigulmasAdRushyanibandhanAM gulmasa~jj~jAM darshayati| Adhamati vistArIbhavati| aniyatavipulANuvedana iti kadAcidvipulavedanaH kadAcidalpavedanashcAniyamena bhavati| atraiva hetumAha- calatvAdvAyoriti| AyAmaH vistaraNaM, harShaH romaharShaH, pralayaH nAshaH, udayaH janma; sphuraNAdInAM janmanAshau bahudhA bhavata ityarthaH| atrApi calatvameva vAyorheturboddhavyaH| hRuShyanti cAsya romANIti vedanAprAdurbhAve pratiniyamena, sphuraNAdau tu harSho vinA~api vedanAmiti j~jeyam||7||

taireva tu karshanaiH karshitasyAmlalavaNakaTukakShAroShNatIkShNashuktavyApannamadyaharitakaphalAmlAnAM vidAhinAM ca shAkadhAnyamAMsAdInAmupayogAdajIrNAdhyashanAdraukShyAnugate cAmAshaye vamanamativelaM sandhAraNaM vAtAtapau cAtisevamAnasya pittaM saha mArutena prakopamApadyate||8||

tat prakupitaM mAruta AmAshayaikadeshe saMvartya tAneva vedanAprakArAnupajanayati, ya uktA vAtagulme; pittaM tvenaM vidahati kukShau hRudyurasi kaNThe ca; sa vidahyamAnaH sadhUmamivodgAramudgiratyamlAnvitaM, gulmAvakAshashcAsya dahyate dUyate dhUpyate UShmAyate svidyati klidyati shithila iva sparshAsaho~alparomA~jcashca bhavati; jvarabhramadavathupipAsAgalatAlumukhashoShapramohaviDbhedAshcainamupadravanti; haritahAridratva~gnakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShashca bhavati; nidAnoktAni cAsya nopasherate, viparItAnyupasherata iti pittagulmaH||9||

taireva tu karshanaiH karshitasyAtyashanAdatisnigdhagurumadhurashItAshanAt piShTekShukShIratilamAShaguDavikRutisevanAnmandakamadyAtipAnAddharitakAtipraNanayAdAnUpaudakagrAmyamAMsAtibhakShaNAt sandhAraNAdabubhukShasya cAtipragADhamudapAnAt sa~gkShobhaNAdvA sharIrasya shleShmA saha mArutena prakopamApadyate||10||

taM prakupitaM mAruta AmAshayaikadeshe saMvartya tAneva vedanAprakArAnupajanayati ya uktA vAtagulme; shleShmA tvasya shItajvarArocakAvipAkA~ggamardaharShahRudrogacchardinidrAlasyastaimityagauravashirobhitApAnupajanayati, api ca gulmasya sthairyagauravakAThinyAvagADhasuptatAH, tathA kAsashvAsapratishyAyAn rAjayakShmANaM cAtipravRuddhaH, shvaityaM tva~gnakhanayanavadanamUtrapurISheShUpajanayati, nidAnoktAni cAsya nopasherate, viparItAni copasherata iti shleShmagulmaH||11||

tridoShahetuli~ggasannipAte tu sAnnipAtikaM gulmamupadishanti kushalAH| sa vipratiShiddhopakramatvAdasAdhyo nicayagulmaH||12||

Commentary: vipratiShiddhopakramatvAditi parasparaM vAtAdiviruddhopakramatvAt| iha ca vipratiShiddhopakramatvaM vikRutiviShamasannipAtena boddhavyam| tena, sAdhyatridoShajvarAdau vAtAdiviruddhopakramatvaM sadapi nAsAdhyatAmApAdayati||12||

shoNitagulmastu khalu striyA eva bhavati na puruShasya, garbhakoShThArtavAgamanavaisheShyAt| pAratantryAdavaishAradyAt satatamupacArAnurodhAdvA vegAnudIrNAnuparundhatyA Amagarbhe vA~apyacirapatite~athavA~apyaciraprajAtAyA Rutau vA vAtaprakopaNAnyAsevamAnAyAH kShipraM vAtaH prakopamApadyate||13||

sa prakupito yonimukhamanupravishyArtavamuparuNaddhi, mAsi mAsi tadArtavamuparudhyamAnaM kukShimabhivardhayati| tasyAH shUlakAsAtIsAracchardyarocakAvipAkA~ggamardanidrAlasyastaimityakaphaprasekAH samupajAyante, stanayoshca stanyam, oShThayoH stanamaNDalayoshca kArShNyam, atyarthaM glAnishcakShuShoH, mUrcchA, hRullAsaH, dohadaH, shvayathushca pAdayoH, IShaccodgamo romarAjyAH, yonyAshcATAlatvam, api ca yonyA daurgandhyamAsrAvashcopajAyate, kevalashcAsyA gulmaH piNDita eva spandate, tAmagarbhAM garbhiNImityAhurmUDhAH||14||

dakShAdhvaroddhvaMse raktapittamanu gulma utpanna iti raktapittamanu gulmanidAnam| iha pa~jcetivacanAccikitsite~adhikAn gulmAn sUcayati; vakShyati hi- “vyAmishrali~ggAnaparAMstu gulmAMstrInAdishedauShadhakalpanArtham” (ci.a.5) iti| nicayaH sannipAtaH, tatkRuto gulmo nicayagulmaH| iha pratyekavAtAdigulmakriyAmelakAdeva dvandvajagulmAH sAdhyanta iti kRutvA na pRuthaguktAH| sannipAtagulmastu vAtAdigulmakriyAmelakena sAdhyo na bhavatyeva vAtAdisaMyogamahimnA; tena, atiriktAsAdhyatvayogAnnicayagulmaH pRuthaguktaH| etadeva gulme~asminnasAdhyatvaM pratipAdayituM sannipAtashabdaM sAdhyajvarAdisannipAte~api vartamAnaM parityajya nicayashabdaH kRutaH; atyarthaM hi asAdhyarUpashcAyaM nicayaH||1-3||

pittAdikRuteShvapi tu gulmeShu samprAptisiddhasya vAtasya prAdhAnyamAha- sarveShvapItyAdi| sAdhAraNeneti saMsRuShTobhayadoShapratyanIkena| yaccAnyadapIti saMsarge ekadoShopashamakamapi| aviruddhamiti upadravANAM gurUNAmaviruddham| vibhajyeti gurulAghavaM vibhajya| tenaikadoShaprashamanamapi tadeva kartavyaM yadgurUpadravaprashamanaM bhavatIti bhAvaH| etadevAha- gurUnityAdi| sarvagulmAnAM vAtamUlatvena vAtanirapekShacikitsAvisheShAnupalambhe vAtacikitsaiva tvarayA kartavyetyAha- tvaramANastvityAdi| Atyayike karmaNi ‘kriyamANe’ iti sheShaH| alpamapIti karmavisheShaNam||16-17||

samutthAnetyAdau li~ggAntarniviShTA vedanA pRuthagucyate, gulmAdiShvantargateShu vedanApradhAnavikAreShu prAyo vedanayaiva visheShAvadhAraNaM bhavatIti darshayitum| samprAptestvihAkathanaM gulmavisheShAgamakatvenaiva boddhavyaM, gulmavij~jAnaM cehAdhikRutaM; sa~gkhyAdibhedabhinnA tu sAmAnyasamprAptiH sarvaroganidAnaprastAva evokteti bhAvaH| balakAlabhinnA tu samprAptiryadyapi vAtikatvAdivisheShaM gamayatyapi, tathA~apyalpatvAttathA li~ggagRuhItatvAcca sA nAdriyate| divasAntajaraNAntAdibalasamprAptirhi vAtAderli~ggamadhya eva paThyate tatra tatra; tena li~ggagrahaNenaiva tat sustham| prAgrUpaM ca yadyapi pRuthagvAtAdigulmagamakaM sAkShAnna paThitaM, tathA~api visheShali~ggAvyaktatArUpaM vishiShTaM prAgrUpaM visheShali~ggakathanenaivoktameva; tena, vAtAdigulmavisheShagamakanidAnAdimadhye pUrvarUpapATho nyAyya eva; kiMvA, pUrvarUpavisheSho~apyatra raktapittAdirogAntarApekShayA sAmAnyokto~api visheSho j~jeyaH||4-5||

raukShyAnugate cAmAshaye iti rUkShaNahetubhI rUkShIkRute ityarthaH; kiMvA raukShyAnugate cAmAshaye sati vamanaM sevamAnasyeti yojanIyam| AmAshayaikadeshe saMvartyetivacanAt pittagulmasya kaphagulmasya ca bastiH sthAnaM na bhavatIti darshayati; vacanaM hi- “nAbhistanAntaraM jantorAmAshaya iti smRutaH” (vi.a.2) iti; vAtagulmasya tu bastirapi sthAnaM bhavati, ata eva tatra sAmAnyena mahAsrota iti kRutaM, mahAsrotograhaNena ca bastirapi gRuhyate; tathA vAtagulma eva ‘hRudi bastau’ ityAdi kRutam| dAhadUyanAdayaH pittavedanAvisheShA asakRudvyAkhyAtAH| davathuH ‘dhakdhak’ iti loke kathyate||8-9||
shleShmagulme abubhukShasyeti abubhukShitasya; ‘atisuhitasya’ iti vA pAThaH| yadyapi rAjayakShmA tridoShajaH, tathA~api kaphagulma eva rogamahimnA ajanitadoShatrayeNa janyata iti boddhavyam||10-11||

shoNitagulme striyA eveti vacanAdeva na puruShasyeti labdhe punarna puruShasyeti vacanaM spaShTArtham| garbhArthaH koShTho garbhakoShThastasmin garbhakoShThe ya ArtavasyAgamanarUpo visheSho raktagulmakAraNaM, sa striyA eva bhavati; tenaivaMrUpa ArtavapratibandhajanyaH shoNitagulmaH puruShasya na bhavati| sAmAnyashoNitaduShTijanyastu puruShasyApi bhavati; tathAhi vakShyati- “kapho vAte jitaprAye pittaM shoNitameva ca| yadi kupyati vA tasya kriyamANe cikitsite” (ci.a.5) ityAdi; tathA ‘gulmopakushavIsarpa’ (sU.a.24) ityAdayo ‘raktajA gadAH’ ityuktam| pAratantryAdihetutrayaM vegavidhAraNe, pAratantryAdeva striyo vegaM vidhArayanti| avaishAradyam aj~jAnaM; tena, vegavidhAraNena mahAn vyAdhirbhavatItyaj~jAnAdvegaM vidhArayanti| upacArAnurodhAditi bhartrAdyupacAraparatvAt| yonimukhamiti garbhAshayadvAram| stanayoH stanyamiti rogaprabhAvAdeva boddhavyam| ArtavarodhalakShaNasya vyAdherayaM prabhAvo yat stanyaM karoti, dRuShTatvAt| tena, yaducyate- “striyA hyApannasattvAyAstridhA rasaH sampadyate- svasharIrapuShTaye, stanyAya, garbhAbhivRuddhaye ca” (shA.a.6) iti vacanAd “garbha eva stanyaM bhavati” tannirastaM mantavyam| dohadashabdeneha nAryA uccAvacabhAvatRuShNAyogo dohadAbhidhAno j~jeyaH| yaduktaM kShArapANinA- “dohadinI vA syAnnArI shoNitagulminI” iti| na tviha dvaihRudyakRuto dohado~abhipretaH, sa hi garbhahRudayasya mAtRuhRudayena sambandhAdbhavati; vacanaM hi- “mAtRujaM hyasya hRudayaM, tadasya mAtRuhRudayena sambaddhaM bhavati rasavAhinIbhiH saMvAhinIbhiH, tasmAttayostAbhirbhaktiH sampadyate” (shA.a.4) iti; shoNitagulme ca cetanA nAsti, tena naivaMrUpamiha dvaihRudyaM dohadam| tena garbhabhrAntyA yatki~jcidabhyavahArecchAdilakShaNaM dohadaM tasyA bhavati, asatyapi viShasambandhe yathA sha~gkAviShAdviShali~ggAni bhavanti; vacanaM hi- “sha~gkAviSheNopahatAH kurvanti viShalakShaNam” iti| ATAlatvaM vistRutatvaM; yonivistAreNa ca romarAjyA api vistaraNaM vitanyamAnacarmaromNA caivopapannam| kevalaH spandata iti naikadeshena; garbho hyekadeshenApi spandate, tenaitallakShaNaM garbhasha~gkAvyAvartakam| nanu yaduktaM raktagulme- “samagarbhali~ggaH” iti, tathA “mAse vyatIte dashame cikitsyaH” (ci.a.5) iti; tadanupapannaM, yato garbhAdvishiShTaM piNDitaspandanaM vidyata eva; tathA navatvaM sukhasAdhyatAhetutvenoktam, iha ca kathaM kAlAtikrameNopakramaNIyatvamucyate? brUmaH- samagarbhali~ggatvaM tAvadbhUrigarbhasamali~ggatAbhiprAyeNoktaM; kiMvA, samasyAvaikArikasya dashamAsikaparyantasya garbhasya li~ggAni yasya sa samagarbhali~ggaH, tena vaikArikasuptanAgodarAderlakShaNaM neha bhavatIti darshayati| dashamamAsacikitsyatvaM ceha vyAdhimahimnA boddhavyaM, dashamamAsa evAyaM shithilIbhUtaH san cikitsyo bhavatIti vyAdhiprabhAvaH| dRuShTA ca vyAdhiprabhAvakRutA kAlApekShA- “jvare peyAH kaShAyAshca sarpiH kShIraM virecanam| ShaDahe ShaDahe deyam” ityAdiShu| yattu samagarbhali~ggatvena garbhasha~gkAnirAsArthaM raktagulmasya dashamamAsApekShaNaM; tanna, dashamamAsAdarvAgapi piNDitaspandanena raktagulmasyAvadhAraNam, tathA dashamamAsAdUrdhvamapi garbhAvasthAnasya dRuShTatvena garbhasha~gkAnapagamAcca; vakShyati hi dashamamAsAdUrdhvamavasthAnaM garbhasya- “vaikArikamata UrdhvamavasthAnaM” (shA.a.4) iti||13-14||
athAtaH pramehanidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
tridoShakopanimittA viMshatiH pramehA bhavanti vikArAshcApare~aparisa~gkhyeyAH| tatra yathA tridoShaprakopaH pramehAnabhinirvartayati tathA~anuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||3||

uShNAmlalavaNakShArakaTukAjIrNabhojanopasevinastathA~atitIkShNAtapAgnisantApashrama krodhaviShamAhAropasevinashca tathAvidhasharIrasyaiva kShipraM pittaM prakopamApadyate, tattu prakupitaM tayaivAnupUrvyA pramehAnimAn ShaT kShiprataramabhinirvartayati||24||
teShAmapi tu khalu pittaguNavisheSheNaiva nAmavisheShA bhavanti; tadyathA- kShAramehashca, kAlamehashca, nIlamehashca, lohitamehashca, mA~jjiShThamehashca, hAridramehashceti||25||
te ShaDbhireva kShArAmlalavaNakaTukavisroShNaiH pittaguNaiH pUrvavadyuktA bhavanti||26||
sarva eva te yApyAH saMsRuShTadoShamedaHsthAnatvAdviruddhopakramatvAcceti||27||
tatra shlokAH pittapramehavisheShavij~jAnArthA bhavanti-||28||
gandhavarNarasasparshairyathA kShArastathAvidham| pittakopAnnaro mUtraM kShAramehI pramehati||29||
masIvarNamajasraM yo mUtramuShNaM pramehati| pittasya parikopeNa taM vidyAt kAlamehinam||30||
cAShapakShanibhaM mUtramamlaM mehati yo naraH| pittasya parikopeNa taM vidyAnnIlamehinam||31||
visraM lavaNamuShNaM ca raktaM mehati yo naraH| pittasya parikopeNa taM vidyAdraktamehinam||32||
ma~jjiShThodakasa~gkAshaM bhRushaM visraM pramehati| pittasya parikopAttaM vidyAnmA~jjiShThamehinam||33||
haridrodakasa~gkAshaM kaTukaM yaH pramehati| pittasya parikopAttaM vidyAddhAridramehinam||34||
ityete ShaT pramehAH pittaprakopanimittA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||35||

kaShAyakaTutiktarUkShalaghushItavyavAyavyAyAmavamanavirecanAsthApana-shirovirecanAtiyogasandhAraNAnashanAbhighAtAtapodvegashokashoNitAtiSheka- jAgaraNaviShamasharIranyAsAnupasevamAnasya tathAvidhasharIrasyaiva kShipraM vAtaH prakopamApadyate||36||

sa prakupitastathAvidhe sharIre visarpan yadA vasAmAdAya mUtravahAni srotAMsi pratipadyate tadA vasAmehamabhinirvartayati; yadA punarmajjAnaM mUtrabastAvAkarShati tadA majjamehamabhinirvartayati; yadA tu lasIkAM mUtrAshaye~abhivahanmUtramanubandhaM cyotayati lasIkAtibahutvAdvikShepaNAcca vAyoH khalvasyAtimUtrapravRuttisa~ggaM karoti, tadA sa matta iva gajaH kSharatyajasraM mUtramavegaM, taM hastimehinamAcakShate; ojaH punarmadhurasvabhAvaM, tad yadA raukShyAdvAyuH kaShAyatvenAbhisaMsRujya mUtrAshaye~abhivahati tadA madhumehaM karoti||37||
imAMshcaturaH pramehAn vAtajAnasAdhyAnAcakShate bhiShajaH, mahAtyayikatvAdviruddhopakramatvAcceti||38||
teShAmapi pUrvavadguNavisheSheNa nAmavisheShA bhavanti; tadyathA- vasAmehashca, majjamehashca, hastimehashca, madhumehashceti||39||
tatra shlokA vAtapramehavisheShavij~jAnArthA bhavanti-||40||
vasAmishraM vasAbhaM vA muhurmehati yo naraH| vasAmehinamAhustamasAdhyaM vAtakopataH||41||
majjAnaM saha mUtreNa muhurmehati yo naraH| majjamehinamAhustamasAdhyaM vAtakopataH||42||
hastI matta ivAjasraM mUtraM kSharati yo bhRusham| hastimehinamAhustamasAdhyaM vAtakopataH||43||
kaShAyamadhuraM pANDu rUkShaM mehati yo naraH| vAtakopAdasAdhyaM taM pratIyAnmadhumehinam||44||
ityete catvAraH pramehA vAtaprakopanimittA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||45||
evaM tridoShaprakopanimittA viMshatiH pramehA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||46||

trayastu khalu doShAH prakupitAH pramehAnabhinirvartayiShyanta imAni pUrvarUpANi darshayanti; tadyathA- jaTilIbhAvaM kesheShu, mAdhuryamAsyasya, karapAdayoH suptatAdAhau, mukhatAlukaNThashoShaM, pipAsAm, AlasyaM, malaM kAye, kAyacchidreShUpadehaM, paridAhaM suptatAM cA~ggeShu, ShaTpadapipIlikAbhishca sharIramUtrAbhisaraNaM, mUtre ca mUtradoShAn, visraM sharIragandhaM, nidrAM, tandrAM ca sarvakAlamiti||47||

Commentary: trayastviti trayo~apItyarthaH| tena, sarvapramehANAmapyetadeva samAnaM pUrvarUpamiti darshayati||47||
upadravAstu khalu pramehiNAM tRuShNAtIsArajvaradAhadaurbalyArocakAvipAkAH pUtimAMsapiDakAlajIvidradhyAdayashca tatprasa~ggAdbhavanti||48||
tatra sAdhyAn pramehAn saMshodhanopashamanairyathArhamupapAdayaMshcikitsediti||49||
bhavanti cAtra-  gRudhnumabhyavahAryeShu snAnaca~gkramaNadviSham| pramehaH kShipramabhyeti nIDadrumamivANDajaH||50||
mandotsAhamatisthUlamatisnigdhaM mahAshanam| mRutyuH prameharUpeNa kShipramAdAya gacchati||51||
yastvAhAraM sharIrasya dhAtusAmyakaraM naraH| sevate vividhAshcAnyAshceShTAH sa sukhamashnute||52||
tatra shlokAH- heturvyAdhivisheShANAM pramehANAM ca kAraNam| doShadhAtusamAyogo rUpaM vividhameva ca||53||
dasha shleShmakRutA yasmAt pramehAH ShaT ca pittajAH| yathA ca vAyushcaturaH pramehAn kurute balI||54||
sAdhyAsAdhyavisheShAshca pUrvarUpANyupadravAH| pramehANAM nidAne~asmin kriyAsUtraM ca bhAShitam||55||

iha khalu nidAnadoShadUShyavisheShebhyo vikAravighAtabhAvAbhAvaprativisheShA bhavanti| yadA hyete trayo nidAnAdivisheShAH parasparaM nAnubadhnantyathavA kAlaprakarShAdabalIyAMso~athavA~anubadhnanti na tadA vikArAbhinirvRuttiH, cirAdvA~apyabhinirvartante, tanavo vA bhavantyayathoktasarvali~ggA vA; viparyaye viparItAH; iti sarvavikAravighAtabhAvAbhAvaprativisheShAbhinirvRuttiheturbhavatyuktaH||4||

Commentary: ihetyAdau nidAnAdInAM visheShAH parasparAnubandhitvAdayo~agre vakShyamANA j~jeyAH| vikArANAM vighAtasyotpattipratibandhasya bhAvo vighAtabhAvaH, vikArANAM vighAtasyAbhAvo vikArajananamiti vikAravighAtabhAvAbhAvau, tayoH prativisheShA vikAravighAtabhAvAbhAvaprativisheShAH| tatra vikArANAM vighAtabhAvasya prativisheShAH- vikArAjananaM, tathA cireNa ca jananam, aNuvikArajananaM vA, asarvali~ggavikArajananaM vA~agre vakShyamANam| vighAtAbhAvaprativisheShAstu vikArAjananAdiviparyayeNAgre vakShyamANAH| uktaphakkikArthaM vyAkaroti- yadetyAdi| parasparaM nAnubadhnanti parasparaM pratikUlA bhavanti, anubandho hyanukUle~abhipretaH| tatra tadeva nidAnaM doShamanubadhnAti, yadbhUyaHsAmAnyAdavirodhena doShaM dUShayati| doShasya dUShyAnubandhitvaM yad- dUShyaM vyAdhikAraNaM sAmAnyaguNatvAdidharmayogAdavirodhena dUShayati| tathA dUShyasya ca doShAnubandhitvaM yad- doShasya dUShaNaM prati shithilatvasamAnaguNatvAdinA~a~anukUlyenAvasthAnam| tathA doShasya cedameva nidAnAnubandhitvaM yat- nidAnaM doShajananaM prati samAnaguNatvaM, samAnaguNatayA hi doSho nidAnasya vyAdhijananaM pratyanukUlo bhavati| etadudAharaNAnAM ca viparyayeNAnanubandho boddhavyaH| nidAnasya ca doShAnanubandhaH samAnAsamAnaguNayogAt ki~jciddoShajanane boddhavyaH, sarvathA doShavaiparItye tathA doShajananaM pratyudAsInatve ca nidAnasya nidAnatvameva na syAt; janakaM hi nidAnamucyate| athavA kAlaprakarShAditi anubadhnantIti sambandhaH; kAlaprakarShAdanubadhnantIti kAlaprakarShAt parasparaM nidAnAdayo~anuguNA bhavanti yadA, tadA vikArA cirAdabhinirvartanta iti j~jeyam| yadA parasparaM nAnubadhnanti, na tadA vikArAbhinirvRuttirbhavatIti yojanIyam| kAlaprakarShAccAnubandho nidAnasya doSheNa tadA bhavati, yadA heturvicchedaM kRutvA punaH sevyate; kAla eva vA cireNa samAnaguNatayA heturUpaH prApyata ityAdi tarkyam| abalIyAMso~athavA~anubadhnantIti nidAnaM yadA~alpaM bhavati tadA stokadoShaM karoti, doShashca stokaH stokaM ca dUShyaM dUShayatItyAdi j~jeyam| yadA cA(vA~a)balIyAMso~anubadhnanti, tadA tanavo vA vikArA bhavanti, ayathoktasarvali~ggA vA bhavantIti yojyaM; tanavaH alpamAtrAH, ayathoktasarvali~ggA iti yena prakAreNa li~ggAnyuktAni na tena prakAreNa sarvANi li~ggAni bhavantItyarthaH| evamete nidAnAdInAmananubandhavisheShakRutA vikAravighAtabhAvasya prativisheShA uktAH| samprati nidAnAdInAM parasparAnubandhavisheShakRutAn vikArANAM vighAtAbhAvavisheShAnAha- viparyaye viparItA iti| viparyaya iti nidAnAdInAmanubandhe tathA shIghrAnubandhe tathA balavatAM cAnubandhe; viparItA iti nirvartamAnA vikArAH, tathA shIghraM nirvartamAnAH, tathA mahAnto yathoktasarvali~ggAshceti yathAsa~gkhyaM boddhavyam| upasaMharati- itItyAdi| etacca prakaraNaM sarvavikArasAdhAraNamapi pramehasya parasparAnubandhibhireva nidAnAdibhirjanyatvaM bhavatIti khyApayituM pramehanidAne kRutam||4||

tatreme trayo nidAnAdivisheShAH shleShmanimittAnAM pramehANAmAshvabhirnirvRuttikarA bhavanti; tadyathA- hAyanakayavakacInakoddAlakanaiShadhetkaTamukundakamahAvrIhipramodakasugandhakAnAM navAnAmativelamatipramANena copayogaH, tathA sarpiShmatAM navahareNumAShasUpyAnAM, grAmyAnUpaudakAnAM ca mAMsAnAM, shAkatilapalalapiShTAnnapAyasakRusharAvilepIkShuvikArANAM, kShIranavamadyamandakadadhidravamadhurataruNaprAyANAM copayogaH, mRujAvyAyAmavarjanaM, svapnashayanAsanaprasa~ggaH, yashca kashcidvidhiranyo~api shleShmamedomUtrasa~jjananaH, sa sarvo nidAnavisheShaH||5||

Commentary: samprati prakRute kaphajAdimehe parasparAnubandhino nidAnAdivisheShAnAha- tatretyAdi| iha kapha evAgre~abhidhIyate, bhUripramehakartRutvAt| hAyanakAdayo dhAnyavisheShAH| ativelamiti punaH punaH| hareNuH vartulakalAyaH| tilataNDulamAShakRutamannaM kRusharA| mRujA udvartanam| sarvaH sa nidAnavisheSha iti evambhUtameva nidAnaM pramehakartuH shleShmaNaH kAraNamityarthaH||5||

bahudravaH shleShmA doShavisheShaH||6||

Commentary: bahudravaH shleShmA doShavisheSha iti bahudrava eva kapho mehajanako nAlpadrava iti||6||

bahvabaddhaM medo mAMsaM sharIrajakledaH shukraM shoNitaM vasA majjA lasIkA rasashcaujaHsa~gkhyAta iti dUShyavisheShAH||7||

Commentary: abaddhamiti asaMhatam| atra tu bahutvamaghanatvaM ca yathAyogyatayA boddhavyam| tena, medasi mAMse vasAmajj~joshca dvayamapi, sheSheShu bahutvam| ojaHsa~gkhyAta iti ojorUpa eva| vakShyati hi pramehacikitsite- “majjA rasaujaH pishitaM ca dUShyAH” (ci.a.5) iti| itishabdo bahvabaddhamedaAdIn pratyavamRushati; kiMvA ‘sa~gkhyAtAH’ iti pAThaH sugamaH||7||

trayANAmeShAM nidAnAdivisheShANAM sannipAte kShipraM shleShmA prakopamApadyate, prAgatibhUyastvAt; sa prakupitaH kShiprameva sharIre visRuptiM labhate, sharIrashaithilyAt; sa visarpa~j sharIre medasaivAdito mishrIbhAvaM gacchati, medasashcaiva bahvabaddhatvAnmedasashca guNaiH samAnaguNabhUyiShThatvAt; sa medasA mishrIbhavan dUShayatyenat, vikRutatvAt; sa vikRuto duShTena medasopahitaH sharIrakledamAMsAbhyAM saMsargaM gacchati, kledamAMsayoratipramANAbhivRuddhatvAt; sa mAMse mAMsapradoShAt pUtimAMsapiDakAH sharAvikAkacchapikAdyAH sa~jjanayati, aprakRutibhUtatvAt; sharIrakledaM punardUShayan mUtratvena pariNamayati, mUtravahAnAM ca srotasAM va~gkShaNabastiprabhavANAM medaHkledopahitAni gurUNi mukhAnyAsAdya pratirudhyate; tataH pramehAMsteShAM sthairyamasAdhyatAM vA janayati, prakRutivikRutibhUtatvAt||8||

Commentary: sannipAte melake| prakopamApadyata iti pramehakaraNAyodyato bhavati| kutaH pramehakaraNAyodyato bhavatItyAha- prAgatibhUyastvAt| prAgiti utpAdakAla eva| yasmAt pramehakaraNaM pratyabhimukho bhUyAMshca kapho bhUtastata ityarthaH| pramehanidAnena hi kapho~ayaM pramehakaraNAbhimukha eva janito bhUrishca; tato bhUritvAt tathA pramehakaraNashaktiyogAcca tathA prakupyatIti yuktam| visRuptiM visaraNam| medasashca guNAnAM guNaiH samAnaguNabhUyiShThatvAdityAdi|- medaso guNAnAM madhurasnehagauravAdInAM shleShmaNo guNairgurushItAdibhirbhUrisAmAnyAdityarthaH; samAnaM hi samAnena milatIti bhAvaH| vikRutatvAditivacanena prakRutena shleShmaNA sambandho medodUShako na bhavati, kintarhi vikRutenaiveti darshayati| atipramANavRuddhatvAditi atishayitapramANayogena vRuddhatvAt; na guNAtiyogamAtreNa vRuddhatvamiha, kintarhyavayavopacayenetyarthaH| pUtimAMsavatyaH piDakAH pUtimAMsapiDakAH| aprakRutibhUtatvAditi mAMsapradoSheNa nAnAvidhasharAvikAdijanakatvashaktitvAditIha boddhavyam| tena, aprakRutabhUtatvAditivacanaM hi visheShArthatvAnna punaruktam| AsAdya pratirudhyata iti gatvA~avatiShThate| prakRutivikRutibhUtatvAditi prakRutibhUtairguNaiH sarvaireva vikRutatvAt; sarva eva yasmAcchleShmaNo guNA vikRutAstasmAt prakopaprakarShAt sthiro bhavati, atiprakarShAttvasAdhya ityarthaH| kiMvA prakRutibhUtaH shleShmA samAne dUShye medovasAdau, vikRutibhUtashcAsamAne shoNitAdau; tena samAnAsamAnatvAdityarthaH| tathA ca samAnadUShyaprAptyA balitvam, asamAnadUShyaprAptyA ca viruddhopakramatvaM kaphasya bhavati; tatashca sthairyamasAdhyatA vA yukteti mantavyam||8||

sharIrakledastu shleShmamedomishraH pravishan mUtrAshayaM mUtratvamApadyamAnaH shlaiShmikairebhirdashabhirguNairupasRujyate vaiShamyayuktaiH; tadyathA- shvetashItamUrtapicchilAcchasnigdhagurumadhurasAndraprasAdamandaiH, tatra yena guNenaikenAnekena vA bhUyastaramupasRujyate tatsamAkhyaM gauNaM nAmavisheShaM prApnoti||9||

te tu khalvime dasha pramehA nAmavisheSheNa bhavanti; tadyathA- udakamehashca, ikShuvAlikArasamehashca, sAndramehashca, sAndraprasAdamehashca, shuklamehashca, shukramehashca, shItamehashca, sikatAmehashca, shanairmehashca, AlAlamehashceti||10||
te dasha pramehAH sAdhyAH; samAnaguNamedaHsthAnakatvAt, kaphasya prAdhAnyAt, samakriyatvAcca||11||
tatra shlokAH shleShmapramehavisheShavij~jAnArthA bhavanti-||12||
acchaM bahu sitaM shItaM nirgandhamudakopamam| shleShmakopAnnaro mUtramudamehI pramehati||13||
atyarthamadhuraM shItamIShatpicchilamAvilam| kANDekShurasama~gkAshaM shleShmakopAt pramehati||14||
yasya paryuShitaM mUtraM sAndrIbhavati bhAjane| puruShaM kaphakopena tamAhuH sAndramehinam||15||
yasya saMhanyate mUtraM ki~jcit ki~jcit prasIdati| sAndraprasAdamehIti tamAhuH shleShmakopataH||16||
shuklaM piShTanibhaM mUtramabhIkShNaM yaH pramehati| puruShaM kaphakopena tamAhuH shuklamehinam||17||
shukrAbhaM shukramishraM vA muhurmehati yo naraH| shukramehinamAhustaM puruShaM shleShmakopataH||18||
atyarthamadhuraM shItaM mUtraM mehati yo bhRusham| shItamehinamAhustaM puruShaM shleShmakopataH||19||
mUrtAnmUtragatAn doShAnaNUnmehati yo naraH| sikatAmehinaM vidyAttaM naraM shleShmakopataH||20||
mandaM mandamavegaM tu kRucchraM yo mUtrayecchanaiH| shanairmehinamAhustaM puruShaM shleShmakopataH||21||
tantubaddhamivAlAlaM picchilaM yaH pramehati| AlAlamehinaM vidyAttaM naraM shleShmakopataH||22||
ityete dasha pramehAH shleShmaprakopanimittA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||23||

dakShAdhvare gulmamanu pramehotpAdAt pramehAbhidhAnaM; vacanaM hi- “haviHprAshAnmehakuShThayorjanma” (ni.a.8) iti| tridoShaprakopanimittA iti sarvameheShveva tridoShAH kAraNam, adhikatvAcca shlaiShmikAdivyapadesha iti darshayati| sushrute~apyuktaM- “sarva eva mehAH sarvadoShajAH” (ni.a.6) iti| vikArA iti pramehali~ggopadravarUpAH; kiMvA, anye~api ye kecana tridoShajAste grAhyAH||1-3||

uShNetyAdinA pittamehanidAnam| ShaT kShiprataramiti shleShmapramehApekShayA; shleShmaNo hi kShiprakAri pittaM, tena kShipratarotpAdo yuktaH| pUrvavadyuktA bhavantIti vaiShamyahAnivRuddhiyuktairityarthaH ||24-26||

saMsRuShTadoShamedaHsthAnatvAditi saMsRuShTaM sannikRuShTaM doShasya pittasya medasashca sthAnaM yasmAt; pittasya hyAmAshayaH sthAnaM, tathA medaso~api yat sthAnaM vapAvahanaM, tadapyAmAshayaikadesha eva; tena doShadUShyayoH sthAnapratyAsattyA dUShaNaM nityaM pratyAsannatvAddurjayamiti bhAvaH| kiMvA saMsRuShTadoShaM medorUpaM sthAnaM yasya sa tathA, eSha viruddhopakramatve hetuH| tena, yasmAt pittarUpeNa doSheNa sambaddhaM medorUpaM sthAnaM, tasmAdviruddhopakramatA| yaddhi pittasya madhurashItAdi pathyaM, tadapathyaM medasaH; yacca medasaH kaTukAdi pathyaM, tadapathyaM pittasya| cakArAdvyAdhiprabhAvAcca yApyatvamiti darshayati||27-35||

rUkShetyAdi vAtamehasya nidAnam| mUtrabastAvAkarShati mUtrabastau sthita AkarShati, arthAnmUtrabastimeva nayati| lasIkA mAMsatvagantare udakabhAgaH| vakShyati hi shArIre- “yanmAMsatvagantare udakaM, tallasIkAshabdaM labhate” (shA.a.7) ityAdi| anubandhamiti avicchedena| cyotayatIti pAtayati| raukShyAdvAyuH kaShAyatvenAbhisaMsRujyeti madhuramapyojo vAyuH prabhAvAt kaShAyarasayuktaM kRutvA raukShyAnmUtrAshaye~abhivahati, mUtrAshayaM raukShyAcchedayitvA rUkShaM ca kRutvA nayatyojaH; svamahimnA ca vAyurojaH kaShAyaM karoti, yato vAto hi vRuddhaH prabhAvAt kaShAyarasaM karoti||36-37||
mahAtyayikatvAditi majjaprabhRutisArabhUtadhAtukShayakaratvAt| viruddhopakramatvaM tu yadvAyoH snigdhAdi pathyaM, tanmedaso~apathyamityAdi j~jeyam||38-46||
tatprasa~ggAdbhavantIti pramehAtyanubandhAdbhavantItyarthaH||48-49||

yAdRushe puruShe prameho bhavati prAyastamAha- gRudhnumityAdi|- gRudhnuM lubdham| nIDadrumaH pakShiNAM vAsavRukShaH| mRutyuH prameharUpeNetyAdivacanAnmandotsAhAdiyukte prameho jAto~asAdhya eva bhavatIti darshayati| vividhAshcAnyAshceShTA iti dhAtusAmyakarA ityarthaH||50-52||
sa~ggrahe vyAdhivisheShANAmityanena ‘iha khalu’ ityAdigranthaM sa~ggRuhNAti| sAdhyAsAdhyavisheShA ityatrAsAdhyavisheShatvena pittajAnAM yApyAnAM grahaNam||53-55||

samprati yathA kaphamehAH kaphaguNayogAddasha bhavanti tathA prAha- sharIretyAdi| vaiShamyamiha vRuddhikRutameva boddhavyaM, kShayarUpavaiShamyasyaivaMrUpavyAdhyajanakatvAt| vaiShamya eva vRuddhavRuddhataratvAdinA hAnivRuddhI boddhavye; tena shvetAdiguNavRuddhyA ye shukramehAdaya uktAH, teShvapItare shleShmaguNA hAnivRuddhirUpavaiShamyayuktAH santItyarthaH| kiMvA vaiShamye sati kvaciddvayoH kvacittrayANAM kvaciccaturNAM guNAnAM vRuddhirbhavatIti darshayati| tena guNasa~gkhyotkarShApakarShAddhAnivRuddhI j~jeye| naceha shvetAdidashaguNayogAdyathAsa~gkhyaM dasha pramehAH, kintu vyastasamastaguNayogAcca; ata evAha- yena guNenaikaikenAnekena vetyAdi| sAndraprasAdashabdenaika eva guNo gaNanIyaH; sAndramehavyapadeshastu sAndraprasAdaguNaikadeshenodbhUtena j~jeyaH| tatsamAkhyamityAdau tatsamAkhyaM vA gauNaM vA nAmavisheShaM prApnotIti yojanIyam| tadguNasya samA AkhyA yasya tat tatsamAkhyaM nAma, yathA- shItameha-shuklameha-sAndrameheShu; atra hi shItAdiguNAkhyayaiva mehA vyapadishyante, itareShu tUdakamehAdiShu na shvetAdiguNasa~jj~jAtulyaM nAma, kiM tarhi shleShmaNo naikaguNayuktodakAditulyatvena guNayogapravRuttatvAdgauNamudakameha iti; acchasitashItAdikaphaguNayogAdgauNamudakameha iti nAma bhavati| evamanyatrApyanusaraNIyam| udakAdayastviha kaphaguNamelakalakShaNArthAstattatkaphaguNayuktA upAttAH sa~jj~jAkaraNArtham||9-11||

visheShavij~jAnArthA bhavantIti parasparabhinnalakShaNapratipAdakA ityarthaH| udakopamamiti udakavarNAditulyam| nanu, ikShuvAlikAmehe kANDekShurasasa~gkAshamiti kimityucyate, ikShuvAlikAkANDekShvorarthAntaratvAt| naivam, ikShuvAlikArasasya tathA kANDekShurasasya caikarUpatApratipAdanArthamubhayorupAdAnaM; kiMvA,  kANDekShurasatulyo~api tathekShuvAlikArasatulyashcekShuvAlikAmeho bhavatItyubhayopAdAnAddarshayati | saMhanyate styAnIbhavati| mUrtAniti kaThinAn| doShAniti jAtau bahuvacanaM, yena doSho~atraika eva prabhUtaH kaphaH| tantubaddhaM tantuvaddIrghamityarthaH| lAlAmivAlAlaM, samantAllAlArUpamityarthaH| prati prati mehaM ca shleShmakopata ityAdivacanaM sukhagrahaNArtham | naceha vAcyam- yat- yathA shleShmaguNA dasha pramehA~jjanayanti, tathA kimityaparAnapi guNasaMsargAdvikalpAntareNa na kurvantIti; yato bhAvasvabhAvo~ayaM- yathA dRuShTa eva paraM kalpyate nAdRuShTaH; nahi satyapi bhUtasaMsargabhUyastve rasabhUyastvaM bhavatIti vyavasthitameva||12-23||
athAtaH kuShThanidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
bhavanti cAtra-  sAdhyo~ayamiti yaH pUrvaM naro rogamupekShate| sa ki~jcitkAlamAsAdya mRuta evAvabudhyate||12||
yastu prAgeva rogebhyo rogeShu taruNeShu vA| bheShajaM kurute samyak sa ciraM sukhamashnute||13||
yathA hyalpena yatnena chidyate taruNastaruH| sa evAtipravRuddhastu chidyate~atiprayatnataH||14||
evameva vikAro~api taruNaH sAdhyate sukham| vivRuddhaH sAdhyate kRucchrAdasAdhyo vA~api jAyate||15||
tatra shlokaH- sa~gkhyA dravyANi doShAshca hetavaH pUrvalakShaNam| rUpANyupadravAshcoktAH kuShThAnAM kauShThike pRuthak||16||

sapta dravyANi kuShThAnAM prakRutirvikRutimApannAni bhavanti| tadyathA- trayo doShA vAtapittashleShmANaH prakopaNavikRutAH, dUShyAshca sharIradhAtavastva~gmAMsashoNitalasIkAshcaturdhA doShopaghAtavikRutA iti| etat saptAnAM saptadhAtukameva~ggatamAjananaM kuShThAnAm, ataHprabhavANyabhinirvartamAnAni kevalaM sharIramupatapanti||3||

Commentary: sapta dravyANIti trayo doShAshcatvAri dUShyANi| prakRutiriti kAraNamityarthaH| saptadravyANAM visheShaNaM- vikRutimApannAnIti| kiMvA ‘prakRutivikRutimApannAni’ iti pAThaH, tadA prakRutyA kuShThakAraNena vikRutimApannAnItyarthaH| etena ca yadA kuShThajanakahetuvyatirekeNa vAtAdInAM vikRutirbhavati na tadA kuShThotpAdo bhavati, kintu visarpotpAda iti darshayati; visarpe hi “raktaM lasIkA tva~gmAMsaM dUShyaM doShAstrayo malAH| sarva eva prakupyanti visarpANAM samudbhave” (ci. a.21) iti vacanAdeta eva sapta vikRutAH kAraNamityuktam| yadyapi kuShThavisarpayordoShadUShyakRutaM sAmyamasti, tathA~api visarpaNashIlena raktapradhAnena ca doSheNa visarpajanma, anyathA tu kuShThajanmeti vyAdhibhedotpattiH| ata eva “vividhaM sarpati yato visarpastena sa~jj~jitaH” (ci. a.21) ityuktam| tathA, vishiShTashoNitaduShTivashAdeva visarpe prabalA vedanA bhavati, tathA raktacikitsAyAH prAdhAnyopadeshAcca raktaprAdhAnyaM visarpe j~jeyam| vacanaM hi- “ekatastAni sarvANi raktamokShaNamekataH” (ci. a.21) iti| anye tu bruvate- visarpe nAvashyaM doShadUShyasaptakaduShTiH, kintu saptAnAM tatra duShTiryogyatayA darshyate, kuShThe tu sarvatra pratiniyamena saptakaduShTiriti| yathA kuShThArambhakA doShAH kupyanti yathA ca dUShyANi, tadAha- tadyathetyAdi| prakopaNavikRutA iti kuShThanidAnaprakopaNavikRutAH; anyathA prakopaNavacanamanarthakaM syAt, vinA prakopaNaM vyAdhijanakavikRutyabhAvAt| doShopaghAtavikRutA ityanena doShopaghAtAdeva dhAtUnAM vikRutirbhavatIti darshayati, na doShamantarA dhAtavo dUShyantItyarthaH| kiMvA, kuShThakAraNAnAM dhAtUnAM kShayavRuddhimAtrarUpavikRutiM nirAkRutya doShAbhisambandharUpAM duShTiM grAhayati| saptadhAtukaM saptadhAtumelakaH| eva~ggatamiti uktakrameNa vikRutiM gatam| AjananaM kAraNam| ataHprabhavANIti etatkAraNabhUtAni| abhinirvartamAnAnIti abhitaH prasarpamANAni| kevalaM kRutsnaM dUShyacatuShTayAtiriktamapItyarthaH| etena, prathamotpattau kuShThe caturdhAtuduShTiniyamaH , utpannasya tvasthisirAdidUShaNamapi bhavatIti darshayati| tatra sushrute kuShThasya prathamaM tvagAshrayasya pashcAduttarottaradhAtUnAmanugamanamuktam- “evaM kuShThaM samutpannaM tvaci kAlaprakarShataH| krameNa dhAtUn vyApnoti” (su. ni.a.5) ityAdinA granthena, tadihApyaviruddhameva| yena, sarvakuShTheShu prathamaM tvacyeva vaikRutaM bhavati visheSheNa, pashcAdvaisheShikI duShTiH kAlaprakarShAdraktAdiShu bhavati| caturdhAtuduShTishceha kuShThotpAde sAmAnyaduShTyabhiprAyeNoktA, vaisheShikI tu duShTisteShAM krameNaiva bhavati| vaisheShikaduShTishceha ‘kevalaM sharIramupatapanti’ iti vacanAdvyAkhyeyA| ata eva sushrute vaisheShikaduShTyabhiprAyeNaiva- “kaNDUrvipUyakashcaiva kuShThe shoNitasaMshraye” (su. ni.a.5) ityAdinA vishiShTaduShTilakShaNamuktam| iha tu yA sAmAnyena caturdhAtuduShTiruktA na sA tallakShaNayuktA, kintu kuShThotpAdamAtraj~jeyA; tena na virodhaH||3||

na ca ki~jcidasti kuShThamekadoShaprakopanimittam, asti tu khalu samAnaprakRutInAmapi kuShThAnAM doShAMshAMshavikalpAnubandhasthAnavibhAgena vedanAvarNasaMsthAnaprabhAvanAmacikitsitavisheShaH| sa saptavidho~aShTAdashavidho~aparisa~gkhyeyavidho vA bhavati| doShA hi vikalpanairvikalpyamAnA vikalpayanti vikArAn, anyatrAsAdhyabhAvAt| teShAM vikalpavikArasa~gkhyAne~atiprasa~ggamabhisamIkShya saptavidhameva kuShThavisheShamupadekShyAmaH||4||

Commentary: samprati tridoShajanyatve~api sarvakuShThAnAM yathA vAtikAdivyapadesho bhavati tadAha- na ca ki~jcidityAdi| samAnaprakRutInAmiti avAntaravikalparahitatulyavAtAdisaptakAraNAnAm, avAntarabhedAbhAve hi kAraNAnAM kAryasyApyekarUpatvameva syAt| doShAMshAMshavikalpasya tathA sthAnasya ca vibhAgena vedanAvisheShaH kuShThe bhavatIti vAkyArthaH| doShANAmaMshamaMshaM prati vikalpoM~ashAMshavikalpaH; kvacidvAyuH svasya rUkShAMshena prakupito bhavati, kvacicchaityAMshenetyAdi| tathA doShadUShyarUpasthAnavibhAgena ca vedanAvisheSho bhavati; vacanaM hi- “tatra rasAdisthAneShu prakupitAnAM doShANAM yasmin yasmin sthAne ye ye vyAdhayo bhavanti” (sU.a.28) ityAdi| sthAnaM ca yadyapi caturvidhadUShyarUpamiha niyataM, tathA~apyeSha doShasyaiva dUShye vyAptyAdikRutaH sthAnavibhAgo j~jeyaH| tatra vedanAvisheShaH- “kApAlaM todabahulaM” (ci.a.7) ityAdi, varNavisheShaH- “yat kAkaNantikAvarNaM” (ci.a.7) ityAdi, saMsthAnavisheShaH- “yadRuShyajihvAsaMsthAnaM” (ci.a.7) ityAdi, prabhAvavisheShaH- sAdhyatAsAdhyatAdi, nAmavisheShaH- kApAla ityAdi| yatashca samAne~api hi kAraNe doShAMshAMshabalavikalpasthAnavibhAgena vedanAdivisheShaH kuShThabhedako~asti, ataH saptavidha ityAdi yojanIyam| saptavidha iti atraiva vakShyamANamahAkuShThabhedena, aShTAdashavidhastu cikitsAvakShyamANabhedena, aparisa~gkhyeyastu vedanAdyavAntarabhedena| kuto~aparisa~gkhyAtA eva vikalpA bhavantItyAha- doShA hItyAdi| vikalpanairiti vividhabhedavikalpanairaMshAMshavikalpAdibhiH, vikalpyamAnA bhidyamAnAH, vikalpayanti bhedayanti; vyAdhikAraNadoShabhedAt kAryasyApi vyAdherbhedo bahuvidho bhavatIti bhAvaH| so~ayaM doShabhedakRuto bhedo~asAdhye vyAdhau neha kriyata ityAha- anyatretyAdi| asAdhyamiha pratyAkhyeyamabhipretaM, yApyabhedo hyasAdhyasya kriyata eva yApanArtham| evaM manyate- pratyAkhyeye vyAdhau sannapi doShabhedakRuto bhedo~acikitsyatvena cikitsAvisheShApravartakatvAnneha kriyate, sAdhye tu cikitsAbhedArthaM kriyata iti yuktam| sampratItaraprakAratyAgaM sahetukaM darshayan saptavidhAbhidhAnaM pratijAnIte- teShAmityAdi| vikalpaiH sarvairvikArakathanaM vikalpavikArasa~gkhyAnam| atiprasa~ggamiti atyabhidhAnadoShaprasa~ggam| nanu, yadi saptavidhakuShThe~aparaikAdashacikitsAvakShyamANakuShThAntarbhAvo bhavati, tadA saptavidhatvaM tathA~aShTAdashavidhatvaM ceti vidhAdvayaM bhavati; yathA jvarANAmekavidhatvadvividhatvAdi, atra hi sarvAsveva vidhAsu sarvAntarbhAvo~asti; na ceha saptamahAkuShThe kShudrakuShThapravesho~asti, ki~jcaivaM kShudrakuShThApraveshe kathamihAcAryo nidAne saptakuShThAbhidhAnena kRutI syAt? ucyate- iha saptavidhakuShThAbhidhAnenaikadoShajadvidoShajatridoShajakuShThAbhidhAnaM kRutaM-  ‘vAte~adhikatare kApAlakuShThaM’ ityAdinA, na caitatprakAratrayAt prakArAntaraM kShudrakuShThAnAmapyasti; tena kShudrakuShTheShu yat kuShThaM yaddoShajaM vaktavyaM tasyehoktataddoShalakShaNayuktatvenAvarodho vyAkhyeyaH, paraM kShudrakuShThe mahAkuShThoktadoShalakShaNAnAmalpatvaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| atra “carmAkhyamekakuShThaM tu kiTimaM savipAdikam| kuShThaM tvalasakaM j~jeyaM prAyo vAtakaphAtmakam” (ci.a.7) ityAdi cikitsite vakShyamANagranthAnurodhAt kShudrakuShThAntarbhAvo vyAkhyeyaH||4||

iha vAtAdiShu triShu prakupiteShu tvagAdIMshcaturaH pradUShayatsu  vAte~adhikatare kapAlakuShThamabhinirvartate, pitte tvaudumbaraM, shleShmaNi maNDalakuShThaM, vAtapittayorRuShyajihvaM, pittashleShmaNoH puNDarIkaM, shleShmamArutayoH sidhmakuShThaM, sarvadoShAbhivRuddhau kAkaNakamabhinirvartate; evameSha saptavidhaH kuShThavisheSho bhavati| sa caiSha bhUyastaratamataH prakRutau vikalpyamAnAyAM bhUyasIM vikAravikalpasa~gkhyAmApadyate||5||

Commentary: kuShThAnAM kApAlAdisa~jj~jAH kapAlAdisAdRushyaprayuktAstathA shAstravyavahArasiddhAshca boddhavyAH; nahi sidhmasa~jj~jAyAmanvayo~asti, tena shAstravyavahArasiddhaiva sidhmasa~jj~jA| prakRutau vikalpyamAnAyAmiti kuShThajanakakAraNe bhidyamAne| vikalpasa~gkhyA bhedarUpasa~gkhyA| iha ca kShudrakuShThAnabhidhAnamuktanyAyena mahukuShThAntargatatvAdeveti boddhavyam||5||

tatredaM sarvakuShThanidAnaM samAsenopadekShyAmaH- shItoShNavyatyAsamanAnupUrvyopasevamAnasya tathA santarpaNApatarpaNAbhyavahAryavyatyAsaM, madhuphANitamatsyalakucamUlakakAkamAcIH satatamatimAtramajIrNe ca samashnataH, cilicimaM ca payasA, hAyanakayavakacInakoddAlakakoradUShaprAyANi cAnnAni kShIradadhitakrakolakulatthamAShAtasIkusumbhasnehavanti,  etairevAtimAtraM suhitasya ca vyavAyavyAyAmasantApAnatyupasevamAnasya, bhayashramasantApopahatasya ca sahasA shItodakamavatarataH, vidagdhaM cAhArajAtamanullikhya vidAhInyabhyavaharataH, chardiM ca pratighnataH, snehAMshcAticarataH, trayo doShAH yugapat prakopamApadyante; tvagAdayashcatvAraH shaithilyamApadyante; teShu shithileShu doShAH prakupitAH sthAnamadhigamya santiShThamAnAstAneva tvagAdIn dUShayantaH kuShThAnyabhinirvartayanti||6||

Commentary: shItoShNavyatyAsaM shItoShNaparivartanam| anAnupUrvyeti yathoktakramatyAgena; kramatyAgashcoShNaM niShevya sahasA shItasevA, tadviparyayashca; tathA anucite kAle shItoShNasevA| evaM santarpaNApatarpaNAbhyavahAryavyatyAsamapi anAnupUrvyopasevyamAnasyeti j~jeyam| cilicimastantrakRutA~a~atreyabhadrakApyIye darshito rohitabhedaH| sthAnamadhigamyeti kuShThajananAnuguNaM shithilatvagAdisthAnaM prApya; kiMvA sthAnamiti janayitavyakuShThasharIradeshaM prApyetyarthaH| santiShThamAnA iti vacanena sthirA eva doShAH kuShThajanakA bhavanti, na hi saraNashIlAstu iti darshayati||6||

teShAmimAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti; tadyathA- asvedanamatisvedanaM pAruShyamatishlakShNatA vaivarNyaM kaNDUrnistodaH suptatA paridAhaH pariharSho lomaharShaH kharatvamUShmAyaNaM gauravaM shvayathurvIsarpAgamanamabhIkShNaM ca kAye kAyacchidreShUpadehaH pakvadagdhadaShTabhagnakShatopaskhaliteShvatimAtraM vedanA svalpAnAmapi ca vraNAnAM duShTirasaMrohaNaM ceti||7||

Commentary: asvedanAdipUrvarUpaM prabhAvAt| pariharSho jhinajhinikA ||7||

tato~anantaraM kuShThAnyabhinirvartante, teShAmidaM vedanAvarNasaMsthAnaprabhAvanAmavisheShavij~jAnaM bhavati; tadyathA- rUkShAruNaparuShANi viShamavisRutAni kharaparyantAni tanUnyudvRuttabahistanUni suptavatsuptAni hRuShitalomAcitAni nistodabahulAnyalpakaNDUdAhapUyalasIkAnyAshugatisamutthAnAnyAshubhedIni jantumanti kRuShNAruNakapAlavarNAni ca kapAlakuShThAnIti vidyAt(1);   tAmrANi tAmrakhararomarAjIbhiravanaddhAni bahalAni bahubahalapUyaraktalasIkAni kaNDUkledakothadAhapAkavantyAshugatisamutthAnabhedIni sasantApakrimINi pakvodumbaraphalavarNAnyaudumbarakuShThAnIti vidyAt(2);   snigdhAni gurUNyutsedhavanti shlakShNasthirapItaparyantAni shuklaraktAvabhAsAni shuklaromarAjIsantAnAni bahubahalashuklapicchilasrAvINi bahukledakaNDUkrimINi saktagatisamutthAnabhedIni parimaNDalAni maNDalakuShThAni vidyAt(3);   paruShANyaruNavarNAni bahirantaHshyAvAni nIlapItatAmrAvabhAsAnyAshugatisamutthAnAnyalpakaNDUkledakrimINi dAhabhedanistoda(pAka)bahulAni shUkopahatopamavedanAnyutsannamadhyAni tanuparyantAni karkashapiDakAcitAni dIrghaparimaNDalAnyRuShyajihvAkRutIni RuShyajihvAnIti vidyAt (4);   shuklaraktAvabhAsAni raktaparyantAni raktarAjIsirAsantatAnyutsedhavanti bahubahalaraktapUyalasIkAni kaNDUkrimidAhapAkavantyAshugatisamutthAnabhedIni puNDarIkapalAshasa~gkAshAni puNDarIkANIti vidyAt (5);   paruShAruNAni vishIrNabahistanUnyantaHsnigdhAni shuklaraktAvabhAsAni bahUnyalpavedanAnyalpakaNDUdAhapUyalasIkAni laghusamutthAnAnyalpabhedakrimINyalAbupuShpasa~gkAshAni sidhmakuShThAnIti vidyAt (6);  kAkaNantikAvarNAnyAdau pashcAttu sarvakuShThali~ggasamanvitAni pApIyasA sarvakuShThali~ggasambhavenAnekavarNAni kAkaNAnIti vidyAt| tAnyasAdhyAni, sAdhyAni punaritarANi||8||

Commentary: udvRuttabahistanUnIti ucchalIkRutabAhyadehAni| suptavat suptAni atyarthAsparshaj~jAnItyarthaH| kapAlaH sthAlyAdikhaNDaH| saktAni cirabhAvIni gatyAdIni yeShAM te tathA| RuShyajihvalakShaNe bahiriti kuShThaparyante, antariti vikRutamadhyamucyate | RuShyo hariNavisheShaH| puNDarIkapalAshashabdena padmapuShpadalamiha| vishIrNabahistanUnItyatra tanushabdaH pradeshe vartate; tena vishIrNaparyantadeshAnItyarthaH| sidhmakuShThaM yathoktalakShaNaM sidhmapuShpikAvyatiriktameva bruvate; sidhmapuShpikAbhiprAyeNa ca sushrute sidhmakuShThaM kShudrakuShTheShu paThitam| dadru tu sushrute mahAkuShThe paThitamapIha kShudrakuShThe paThitamuttarottaradhAtvanupraveshAbhAvAt tathA~atyarthapIDArahitatvAcca, sushrute tu tadanubandhitvaprakarShAnmahAkuShThe paThitam| sarvakuShThali~ggasamanvitAnItyetetAvataivArthe labdhe punaH pApIyasA sarvakuShThali~ggasambhavenetivacanAdyadeva pApIyaH kuShThali~ggaM, tadeva kAkaNake bhavati nAnyaditi darshayati| pApIyaseti atyarthapIDAkRutA| kiMvA pApIyasetyAdipunarvacanena sarvakuShThali~ggAnAM kAkaNake pApArabdhatvenAsAdhyatAmatyarthapIDAkartRutAM ca darshayati||8||

tatra yadasAdhyaM tadasAdhyatAM nAtivartate, sAdhyaM punaH ki~jcit sAdhyatAmativartate kadAcidapacArAt| sAdhyAni hi ShaT kAkaNakavarjyAnyacikitsyamAnAnyapacArato vA doShairabhiShyandamAnAnyasAdhyatAmupayAnti||9||

Commentary: kadAcidityanenAgre vakShyamANasacikitsyamAnatApakShAntaraM darshayati| apacArato veti utpanne~api kuShThe nidAnasevanAt| abhiShyandamAnAnIti ApUryamANAni||9||

sAdhyAnAmapi hyupekShyamANAnAM tva~gmAMsashoNitalasIkAkothakledasaMsvedajAH krimayo~abhimUrcchanti; te bhakShayantastvagAdIn doShAH punardUShayanta imAnupadravAn pRuthak pRuthagutpAdayanti- tatra vAtaH shyAvAruNavarNaM paruShatAmapi ca raukShyashUlashoShatodavepathuharShasa~gkocAyAsastambhasuptibhedabha~ggAn, pittaM dAhasvedakledakothasrAvapAkarAgAn, shleShmA tvasya shvaityashaityakaNDUsthairyagauravotsedhopasnehopalepAn, krimayastu tvagAdIMshcaturaH sirAH snAyUshcAsthInyapi ca taruNAnyAdadate ||10||
asyAM caivAvasthAyAmupadravAH kuShThinaM spRushanti; tadyathA- prasravaNama~ggabhedaH patanAnya~ggAvayavAnAM tRuShNAjvarAtIsAradAhadaurbalyArocakAvipAkAshca, tathAvidhamasAdhyaM vidyAditi||11||
pramehamanu prAgutpattau kuShThotpAdAt kuShThanidAnamucyate| vacanaM hi- “haviHprAshAnmehakuShThayoH” (ni.a.8) iti||1-2||
ki~jcitkAlamiti asAdhyavyAdhikAlam| mRuta eveti maraNopakaNThagataH| avabudhyata ityatra ‘sAdhyavyAdhyupekShAphalaM mRutyum’ iti sheShaH||12-16||
doShAH punardUShayanta iti tvagAdIneva| taruNAnIti komalAni nAsAsthyAdIni| Adadate bhakShayanti||10-11||
athAtaH shoShanidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tatrAparikShINabalamAMsashoNito balavAnajAtAriShTaH sarvairapi shoShali~ggairupadrutaH sAdhyo j~jeyaH| balavAnupacito hi sahatvAdvyAdhyauShadhabalasya kAmaM subahuli~ggo~apyalpali~gga eva mantavyaH||15||

Commentary: aparikShINabalAbhidhAne~api balavAniti padaM sahajabalayuktatvopadarshanArthaM; sahajabalo hyupakShINabalo~apyakShINabalavadbhavatIti bhAvaH| sahatvAdvyAdhyauShadhabalasyeti yasmAdbalavAn vyAdhibalaM tathauShadhabalaM ca sahate, tena na tAbhyAmabhibhUyata ityarthaH| alpali~gga eveti alpali~gga iva sukhasAdhya ityarthaH||15||

durbalaM tvatikShINabalamAMsashoNitamalpali~ggamajAtAriShTamapi bahuli~ggaM jAtAriShTaM ca vidyAt, asahatvAdvyAdhyauShadhabalasya; taM parivarjayet, kShaNenaiva hi prAdurbhavantyariShTAni, animittashcAriShTaprAdurbhAva iti||16||
tatra shlokaH- samutthAnaM ca li~ggaM ca yaH shoShasyAvabudhyate| pUrvarUpaM ca tattvena sa rAj~jaH kartumarhati||17||

iha khalu catvAri shoShasyAyatanAni bhavanti; tadyathA- sAhasaM sandhAraNaM kShayo viShamAshanamiti||3||

Commentary: AyatanAnIti kAraNAni| sa~gkhyeyasAhasAdinirdeshAdeva sa~gkhyAyAM labdhAyAM catvArIti punarvacanaM sAhasAdInAmavAntarabalavadvigrahAdibhede~apyekajAtIyatApratipAdanArtham||3||

tatra sAhasaM shoShasyAyatanamiti yaduktaM tadanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- yadA puruSho durbalo hi san balavatA saha vigRuhNAti, atimahatA vA dhanuShA vyAyacchati, jalpati vA~apyatimAtram, atimAtraM vA bhAramudvahati, apsu vA plavate cAtidUram, utsAdanapadAghAtane vA~atipragADhamAsevate, atiprakRuShTaM vA~adhvAnaM drutamabhipatati, abhihanyate vA, anyadvA ki~jcidevaMvidhaM viShamamatimAtraM vA vyAyAmajAtamArabhate, tasyAtimAtreNa karmaNoraH kShaNyate| tasyoraH kShatamupaplavate vAyuH| sa tatrAvasthitaH shleShmANamuraHsthamupasa~ggRuhya pittaM ca dUShayan viharatyUrdhvamadhastiryak ca| tasya yoM~ashaH sharIrasandhInAvishati tenAsya jRumbhA~a~ggamardo jvarashcopajAyate, yastvAmAshayamabhyupaiti tena rogA bhavanti urasyA arocakashca , yaH kaNThamabhiprapadyate kaNThastenoddhvaMsyate svarashcAvasIdati, yaH prANavahAni srotAMsyanveti tena shvAsaH pratishyAyashca jAyate, yaH shirasyavatiShThate shirastenopahanyate; tataH kShaNanAccaivoraso viShamagatitvAcca vAyoH kaNThasya coddhvaMsanAt kAsaH satatamasya sa~jjAyate, sa kAsaprasa~ggAdurasi kShate shoNitaM ShThIvati, shoNitAgamanAccAsya daurbalyamupajAyate; evamete sAhasaprabhavAH sAhasikamupadravAH spRushanti| tataH sa upashoShaNairetairupadravairupadrutaH shanaiH shanairupashuShyati| tasmAt puruSho matimAn balamAtmanaH samIkShya tadanurUpANi karmANyArabheta kartuM; balasamAdhAnaM hi sharIraM, sharIramUlashca puruSha iti||4||
bhavati cAtra-  sAhasaM varjayet karma rakSha~jjIvitamAtmanaH| jIvan hi puruShastviShTaM karmaNaH phalamashnute||5||

sandhAraNaM shoShasyAyatanamiti yaduktaM tadanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- yadA puruSho rAjasamIpe bhartuH samIpe vA gurorvA pAdamUle dyUtasabhamanyaM vA satAM samAjaM strImadhyaM vA samanupravishya yAnairvA~apyuccAvacairabhiyAn bhayAt prasa~ggAddhrImattvAddhRuNitvAdvA niruNaddhyAgatAn vAtamUtrapurIShavegAn tadA tasya sandhAraNAdvAyuH prakopamApadyate, sa prakupitaH pittashleShmANau samudIryordhvamadhastiryak ca viharati; tatashcAMshavisheSheNa pUrvavaccharIrAvayavavisheShaM pravishya shUlamupajanayati, bhinatti purIShamucchoShayati vA, pArshve cAtirujati, aMsAvavamRudgAti, kaNThamurashcAvadhamati, shirashcopahanti, kAsaM shvAsaM jvaraM svarabhedaM pratishyAyaM copajanayati; tataH sa upashoShaNairetairupadravairupadrutaH shanaiH shanairupashuShyati| tasmAt puruSho matimAnAtmanaH shArIreShveva yogakShemakareShu prayateta visheSheNa; sharIraM hyasya mUlaM, sharIramUlashca puruSho bhavati||6||
bhavati cAtra-  sarvamanyat parityajya sharIramanupAlayet| tadabhAve hi bhAvAnAM sarvAbhAvaH sharIriNAm||7||

yadA vA puruSho~atiharShAdatiprasaktabhAvaH strIShvatiprasa~ggamArabhate, tasyAtimAtraprasa~ggAdretaH kShayameti| kShayamapi copagacchati retasi yadi manaH strIbhyo naivAsya nivartate, tasya cAtipraNItasa~gkalpasya maithunamApadyamAnasya na shukraM pravartate~atimAtropakShINaretastvAt, tathA~asya vAyurvyAyacchamAnasharIrasyaiva dhamanIranupravishya shoNitavAhinIstAbhyaH shoNitaM pracyAvayati, tacchukrakShayAdasya punaH shukramArgeNa shoNitaM pravartate vAtAnusRutali~ggam| athAsya shukrakShayAcchoNitapravartanAcca sandhayaH shithilIbhavanti, raukShyamupajAyate, bhUyaH sharIraM daurbalyamAvishati , vAyuH prakopamApadyate; sa prakupito vashikaM sharIramanusarpannudIrya shleShmapitte parishoShayati mAMsashoNite, pracyAvayati shleShmapitte saMrujati pArshve, avamRudgAtyaMsau , kaNThamuddhvaMsati, shiraH shleShmANamupatkleshya pratipUrayati shleShmaNA, sandhIMshca prapIDayan karotya~ggamardamarocakAvipAkau ca, pittashleShmotkleshAt pratilomagatvAcca vAyurjvaraM kAsaM shvAsaM svarabhedaM pratishyAyaM copajanayati; sa kAsaprasa~ggAdurasi kShate shoNitaM ShThIvati, shoNitagamanAccAsya daurbalyamupajAyate, tataH sa upashoShaNairetairupadravairupadrutaH shanaiH shanairupashuShyati| tasmAt puruSho matimAnAtmanaH sharIramanurakSha~jchukramanurakShet| parA hyeShA phalanirvRuttirAhArasyeti||8||

Commentary: hRudayasthAyI rasa iti dhAturUpo~annarasapoShya ityarthaH; anye tu, hRudayasthAyI rasa iti ojo bruvate| yathopadekShyamANarUpeNeti ‘sandhayaH shithilIbhavanti’ ityAdigranthavakShyamANalakShaNena||8||
bhavati cAtra-  AhArasya paraM dhAma shukraM tadrakShyamAtmanaH| kShayo hyasya bahUn rogAnmaraNaM vA niyacchati||9||

viShamAshanaM shoShasyAyatanamiti yaduktaM, tadanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- yadA puruShaH pAnAshanabhakShyalehyopayogAn prakRutikaraNasaMyogarAshideshakAlopayogasaMsthopashayaviShamAnAsevate, tadA tasya tebhyo vAtapittashleShmANo vaiShamyamApadyante; te viShamAH sharIramanusRutya yadA srotasAmayanamukhAni prativAryAvatiShThante tadA janturyadyadAhArajAtamAharati tattadasya mUtrapurIShamevopajAyate bhUyiShThaM nAnyastathA sharIradhAtuH; sa purIShopaShTambhAdvartayati, tasmAcchuShyato visheSheNa purIShamanurakShyaM tathA~anyeShAmatikRushadurbalAnAM; tasyAnApyAyamAnasya viShamAshanopacitA doShAH pRuthak pRuthagupadravairyu~jjanto bhUyaH sharIramupashoShayanti| tatra vAtaH shUlama~ggamardaM kaNThoddhvaMsanaM pArshvasaMrujanamaMsAvamardaM svarabhedaM pratishyAyaM copajanayati; pittaM jvaramatIsAramantardAhaM ca; shleShmA tu pratishyAyaM shiraso gurutvamarocakaM kAsaM ca, sa kAsaprasa~ggAdurasi kShate shoNitaM niShThIvati, shoNitagamanAccAsya daurbalyamupajAyate| evamete viShamAshanopacitAstrayo doShA rAjayakShyANamabhinirvartayanti| sa tairupashoShaNairupadravairupadrutaH shanaiH shanaiH shuShyati| tasmAt puruSho matimAn prakRutikaraNasaMyogarAshideshakAlopayogasaMsthopashayAdaviShamamAhAramAharet||10||
bhavati cAtra-  hitAshI syAnmitAshI syAtkAlabhojI jitendriyaH| pashyan rogAn bahUn kaShTAn buddhimAn viShamAshanAt||11||

etaishcaturbhiH shoShasyAyatanairupasevitairvAtapittashleShmANaH prakopamApadyante| te prakupitA nAnAvidhairupadravaiH sharIramupashoShayanti| taM sarvarogANAM kaShTatamatvAdrAjayakShmANamAcakShate bhiShajaH; yasmAdvA pUrvamAsIdbhagavataH somasyoDurAjasya tasmAdrAjayakShmeti||12||

Commentary: kaShTatamatvAdityatra cakAro luptanirdiShTo draShTavyaH; tena kaShTatamatvAcca tathA candramasaH prAgutpannatvAcceti hetudvayaM j~jeyam| yadA kaShTatamatvAttadA ‘rAjeva yakShmA rAjayakShmeti’ niruktirboddhavyA| uDurAjasyeti vacanAd rAjasa~jj~jatvaM somasya darshayati; tatashca ‘rAj~jo yakShmA rAjayakShmA’ iti niruktirbhavati||12||

tasyemAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti; tadyathA- pratishyAyaH, kShavathurabhIkShNaM, shleShmaprasekaH, mukhamAdhuryam, anannAbhilAShaH, annakAle cAyAsaH, doShadarshanamadoSheShvalpadoSheShu vA bhAveShu pAtrodakAnnasUpApUpopadaMshapariveshakeShu, bhuktavatashcAsya hRullAsaH, tathollekhanamapyAhArasyAntarAntarA, mukhasya pAdayoshca shophaH , pANyoshcAvekShaNamatyartham, akShNoH shvetAvabhAsatA cAtimAtraM, bAhvoshca pramANajij~jAsA, strIkAmatA, nirghRuNitvaM, bIbhatsadarshanatA cAsya kAye, svapne cAbhIkShNaM darshanamanudakAnAmudakasthAnAnAM shUnyAnAM ca grAmanagaranigamajanapadAnAM shuShkadagdhabhagnAnAM ca vanAnAM kRukalAsamayUravAnarashukasarpakAkolUkAdibhiH saMsparshanamadhirohaNaM yAnaM vA shvoShTrakharavarAhaiH keshAsthibhasmatuShA~ggArarAshInAM cAdhirohaNamiti (shoShapUrvarUpANi bhavanti)||13||

Commentary: pUrvarUpeShu pratishyAyAdiH prAyaH kaphayuktapUrvarUpotpAdo vAyunA~api pradhAnena kriyamANe shoShe uraHsthashleShmasaMsargAdboddhavyaH; yatashca prAyeNa kapho~atra sthAnamahimnA prakupito bhavati, tena shoShaM kaphapradhAnali~ggatvena shleShmaroga iti ca bruvate| adoSheShviti pAtrAdivisheShaNam| pANyoshcAvekShaNAdipUrvarUpaM prabhAvAt| bIbhatsadarshanatA kAya iti kAyasya vivarNavigandhatvAdinA| nigamo nagaravisheSho bahuvasatiH; janapadaM maNDalam| adhirohaNaM ceti kRukalAsAdInAmeva sharIrAdhirohaNam| svapne shvoShTrakharagamanaM cehAdi~gniyamena boddhavyaM, tena riShTaM na bhavati; yattu vakShyati- “shvabhiruShTraiH kharairvA~api yAti yo dakShiNAM disham” ityAdi, taddakShiNadi~gniyatatvAdriShTaM j~jeyam| yatra pUrvarUpaM svapnarUpamasti rAjayakShmonmAdAdau tatrocyate, jvarAdau tvavidyamAnatvAnnocyate| yattu riShTaM riShTAdhikAre jvarAdInAM svapnarUpaM pUrvarUpaM vakShyati- “pretaiH saha piben madyaM” (iM.a.5) ityAdinA, tadriShTameva||13||

ata UrdhvamekAdasharUpANi tasya bhavanti; tadyathA- shirasaH paripUrNatvaM, kAsaH, shvAsaH, svarabhedaH, shleShmaNashchardanaM, shoNitaShThIvanaM, pArshvasaMrojanam, aMsAvamardaH, jvaraH, atIsAraH, arocakashceti||14||

Commentary: ekAdasharUpANItivacanena ekAdasharUpANyeva sampUrNarAjayakShmaNi bhavantIti darshayati| kAsashvAsAdayashca ye ekAdasharUpA udAharaNArthaM vyAkhyAtA na te pratiniyamArthaM, tena cikitsite vakShyamANamekAdasharUpacatuShTayaM bhinnalakShaNaM na virodhi||14||
jvaranidAnoktasambandhAdrAjayakShmanidAnamucyate||1-2||

bahuli~ggaM jAtAriShTaM ca vidyAditi bahuli~ggamivAsAdhyaM tathA jAtAriShTamiva mArakaM vidyAdityarthaH| nanu, riShTaM vinA maraNaM nAsti, vacanaM hi- “maraNaM cApi tannAsti yannAriShTapuraHsaram” (iM.a.2) iti, tat kathamajAtAriShTo jAtAriShTa ivAdUramaraNatveneha j~jAtavya ityAha- kShaNena hItyAdi| asAdhye hi riShTaM bhavati, asAdhyatA ca balamAMsakShayakRutA~astyeva; tena, avashyaM riShTena bhavitavyamityarthaH| athAjAtAriShTe kAraNAsevayA~ariShTaM na bhaviShyatyevetyAha- animittatashcAriShTaprAdurbhAva iti| na hi riShTaM dRuShTaM ki~jcitkAraNAntaramapekShate , kintvanimittata eva bhavati| tena hetvasevayA~apyariShTotpAdo bhaviShyatIti kRutvA AshvAsaH kartavyaH; ki~jcanimittamevAriShTaM bhavati tena riShTAnutpAde sati nAshvAsaH kartavya ityarthaH||16-17||

padAghAtanaM padbhyAmunmardanam| atiprakRuShTamiti atidUram| uraHkShatamupaplavate vyApnotItyarthaH| uraHsthamiti svabhAvAdevoraHstham| urasyA iti urogatA hRuddravashUlAdayaH | AmAshayagatena corasyarogakaraNamuraso~apyAmAshayapratyAsannatvAt| balena samyagAdhIyate dhAryata iti balasamAdhAnaM sharIram| sharIramUlashca puruSha iti saMyogapuruSha ityarthaH||4-5||

samAjamiti sabhAm| uccAvacairiti uccanIcaiH| abhiyAniti gacchan| bhayAdityAdi rAjasamIpAdIShu yathAyogyatayA boddhavyam| yogena ye kShemakarAste yogakShemakarAH, te ceha mUtrapurIShAvidhAraNAdayaH| visheSheNetivacanAcchArIreShveva visheSheNa yatnaM kuryAnmAnasayogakShemApekShayeti darshayati| Atmana iti padaM parasharIrayogakShemApekShayA svasharIrayogakShemakaraNasyopAdeyatAdarshanArtham| atha kathaM mAnasayogakShemApekShayA tathA parasharIrayogakShemApekShayA svasharIrayogakShemaH shreShTha ityAha- sharIramityAdi| asya puruShasya| sarvapuruShArtheShu kartavyeShu yasmAccharIraM mUlamiti kAraNaM, tasmAt svasharIrayogakShemamevAcaredvisheSheNa, pashcAt parasharIramAnasayogakShemamityarthaH| svasharIre hyupahate parasharIropakArastathA~adhyAtmikashubhacintA ca vyAkulA bhavatIti bhAvaH| kiMvA, yogAH sharIrasya balavarNAdyutkarShayogAH, kShemAshcAnAgatAbAdhapratiShedhAH, teShu| nanu yadyevamAdhyAtmike~api bhAve sharIraM mUlaM, tat kiM puruSho~apradhAnameva? netyAha- sharIramUlashca puruSha iti| sharIrasyApyutpattau dharmAdharmasahAyo bhoktA sukhaduHkhAnAmAtmA mUlaM kAraNamityarthaH| mUlashabdashcAyaM bhAvapradhAnaH; tena sharIramUlatvaM yasyAtmanaH sa ‘sharIramUlaH’ iti puMli~gganirdesha upapannaH| sarvAbhAva iti dharmAdicaturvargAbhAva ityarthaH||6-7||

samprati kShayeShu shoShakAraNeShu prAyaH shoShajanakatvena pradhAnaM shukrakShayaM shoShakAraNaM yadA vetyAdinA prAha| atipraNItasa~gkalpasyeti atimahatA prayatnena kRutadhvajocchrAyasya| vyAyacchamAnasyeti vyavAyamAcarataH| vAtAnusRutali~ggamiti vAtali~ggayuktaM duShTavAtali~ggayuktamiti yAvat| sharIraM karmabhUtaM, daurbalyaM kartRubhUtam, AvishatIti yojanA| vashikamiti shUnyaM, shukrashoNitakShayAdriktamityarthaH; etacca hetugarbhavisheShaNam; etena yasmAdvashikaM sharIraM, tasmAdanusarpatItyarthaH| parA phalanirvRuttiriti shreShThA AhAraphalasampattirityarthaH| paraM dhAma iti utkRuShTasAram; utkRuShTatvaM ca shukrasyAtiprasAdarUpatvAt| etacca shoShakAraNeShu kShayeShu kevalashukrakShayopasaMharaNaM prAdhAnyAt, nAnyashoShahetvabhAvAditi boddhavyam| rUkShAdyannapAnasevAjanito raktAdikShayo~api rAjayakShmakAraNatvenoktaH||8-9||

prakRutikaraNAdayo rasavimAne prapa~jcanIyAH| atra copashayashabdena upayoktA yo rasavimAne vaktavyaH sa eva gRuhyate| yatastatroktaM- “upayoktA punaryastamAhAramAharati, yadAyattamokasAtmyam” (vi.a.1) iti| anena hi tatropayoktRuparIkShayA sAtmyameva parIkShyata ityuktam| ayanamukhAnIti gatidvArANi; ayanaM gatiH| parivAryeti avarudhya| tathA sarveShAmatyarthakRushadurbalAnAM purIShamanurakShyamiti yojanA| enameva cArthaM vakShyati- “shoShI mu~jcati gAtrANi purIShasraMsanAdati(pi)| sarvadhAtukShayArtasya balaM tasya hi viDbalam” (ci.a.8) iti| kAsaprasa~ggAditi kAsAtisambandhAdityarthaH||10-11||
athAta unmAdanidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tatrAyamunmAdakarANAM bhUtAnAmunmAdayiShyatAmArambhavisheSho bhavati; tadyathA- avalokayanto devA janayantyunmAdaM, guruvRuddhasiddhamaharShayo~abhishapantaH, pitaro darshayantaH , spRushanto gandharvAH, samAvishanto yakShAH, rAkShasAstvAtmagandhamAghrApayantaH, pishAcAH punarAruhya vAhayantaH||12||

Commentary: darshayanta ityatra ‘AtmAnam’ iti sheShaH||12||

tasyemAni rUpANi bhavanti; tadyathA- atyAtmabalavIryapauruShaparAkramagrahaNadhAraNasmaraNaj~jAnavacanavij~jAnAni , aniyatashconmAdakAlaH||13||

Commentary: atyAtmashabdo balAdibhiH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| AtmAnamatiricyeti atyAtma; tenAtmAnanurUpabalAdiyogo bhavatItyarthaH||13||

unmAdayiShyatAmapi khalu devarShipitRugandharvayakSharAkShasapishAcAnAM guruvRuddhasiddhAnAM vA eShvantareShvabhigamanIyAH puruShA bhavanti; tadyathA- pApasya karmaNaH samArambhe, pUrvakRutasya vA karmaNaH pariNAmakAle, ekasya vA shUnyagRuhavAse catuShpathAdhiShThAne vA, sandhyAvelAyAmaprayatabhAve vA parvasandhiShu vA mithunIbhAve, rajasvalAbhigamane vA, viguNe vA~adhyayanabalima~ggalahomaprayoge, niyamavratabrahmacaryabha~gge vA, mahAhave vA, deshakulapuravinAshe vA, mahAgrahopagamane vA, striyA vA prajananakAle, vividhabhUtAshubhAshucisparshane vA, vamanavirecanarudhirasrAve, ashuceraprayatasya vA caityadevAyatanAbhigamane vA, mAMsamadhutilaguDamadyocchiShTe vA, digvAsasi vA, nishi nagaranigamacatuShpathopavanashmashAnAghAtanAbhigamane vA, dvijagurusurayatipUjyAbhidharShaNe vA, dharmAkhyAnavyatikrame vA, anyasya vA karmaNo~aprashastasyArambhe, ityabhighAtakAlA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||14||

Commentary: parvasandhiH amAvAsyA paurNamAsI ca| digvAsasIti nagne| nishItyAdau punashcatuShpathavacanaM nishi punaranyena sahApi catuShpathagamanapradarshanArtham ; ekasyetyAdau tu divA~apyekasya catuShpathagamanaM bruvate| dharmAkhyAnavyatikrama iti avidhinA dharmaprakAshane||14||

trividhaM tu khalUnmAdakarANAM bhUtAnAmunmAdane prayojanaM bhavati; tadyathA- hiMsA, ratiH, abhyarcanaM ceti| teShAM taM prayojanavisheShamunmattAcAravisheShalakShaNairvidyAt| tatra hiMsArthinonmAdyamAno~agniM pravishati, apsu nimajjati, sthalAcchvabhre vA patati, shastrakashAkAShThaloShTamuShTibhirhantyAtmAnam, anyacca prANavadhArthamArabhate ki~jcit, tamasAdhyaM vidyAt; sAdhyau punardvAvitarau||15||

Commentary: ratiH krIDA| abhyarcanaM pUjA| unmattAcAravisheShalakShaNairvidyAditi unmattasyAcAravisheSharUpairlakShaNairhiMsArthAdyunmAditaM vidyAt| tatra hiMsArthinonmAdito hiMsAnuguNamagnipraveshAdyAcarati, ratyarthinA conmAditaH krIDArthaM pracarati, pUjArthinA gRuhIto pUjAM ceShTate| iha ca devAdivacanena devAdyanucarA devAdisadharmANo grAhyAH, devAdayastu na mAnuShAnAvishanti| uktaM hi sushrute- “na te manuShyaiH saha saMvishanti navA manuShyAn kvacidAvishanti| ye tvAvishantIti vadanti mohAtte bhUtavidyAviShayAdapohyAH” (su.u.taM.a.61) ityAdi| hiMsArthigRuhItasyAsAdhyatvena tadvij~jAnArthaM sAmAnyoktAnyapi lakShaNAni shRu~ggagrAhikayA brUte||15||
tayoH sAdhanAni- mantrauShadhimaNima~ggalabalyupahArahomaniyamavrataprAyashcittopavAsa svastyayanapraNipAtagamanAdIni||16||
evamete pa~jconmAdA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||17||

te tu khalu nijAgantuvisheSheNa sAdhyAsAdhyavisheSheNa ca pravibhajyamAnAH pa~jca santo dvAveva bhavataH| tau ca parasparamanubadhnItaH kadAcidyathoktahetusaMsargAt| tayoH saMsRuShTameva pUrvarUpaM bhavati, saMsRuShTameva ca li~ggam| tatrAsAdhyasaMyogaM sAdhyAsAdhyasaMyogaM cAsAdhyaM vidyAt, sAdhyaM tu sAdhyasaMyogam| tasya sAdhanaM sAdhanasaMyogameva vidyAditi||18||

Commentary: tAviti tau nijAgantU| parasparamanubadhnItaH kadAciditi na sarvadA| yathoktahetusaMsargAditi nijAgantuhetumelakAt| tatreti nijAgantuhetusaMsarge| asAdhyasaMyogamiti yadA tridoShajonmAde hiMsArthinA devAdinA~anubandho bhavati, tadA~asAdhyayoH saMyogo bhavati| sAdhyAsAdhyasaMyogastu ekadoShaje unmAde hiMsArthyunmAdayogAttathA ratyarthonmAde tridoShonmAdAnubandhAccetyAdi j~jeyam| sAdhyasaMyogasya sAdhyarUpatayaiva sAdhyatAyAM siddhAyAM punaH sAdhyamitivacanaM sAdhyarUpavikArAntarasambandhe vikArabhUyastvenAsAdhyasha~gkApratiShedhArtham| sAdhanasaMyogameveti nijAgantusAdhanamelakamityarthaH||18||
bhavanti cAtra-  naiva devA na gandharvA na pishAcA na rAkShasAH| na cAnye svayamakliShTamupaklishnanti mAnavam||19||
ye tvenamanuvartante klishyamAnaM svakarmaNA| na sa taddhetukaH klesho na hyasti kRutakRutyatA||20||
praj~jAparAdhAt sambhUte vyAdhau karmaja AtmanaH| nAbhishaMsedbudho devAnna pitRUnnApi rAkShasAn||21||
AtmAnameva manyeta kartAraM sukhaduHkhayoH| tasmAcchreyaskaraM mArgaM pratipadyeta no traset||22||
devAdInAmapacitirhitAnAM copasevanam| te ca tebhyo virodhashca sarvamAyattamAtmani||23||
tatra shlokaH- sa~gkhyA nimittaM prAgrUpaM lakShaNaM sAdhyatA na ca| unmAdAnAM nidAne~asmin kriyAsUtraM ca bhAShitam||24||
iha khalu pa~jconmAdA bhavanti; tadyathA- vAtapittakaphasannipAtAgantunimittAH||3||

tatra doShanimittAshcatvAraH puruShANAmevaMvidhAnAM kShipramabhinirvartante; tadyathA- bhIrUNAmupakliShTasattvAnAmutsannadoShANAM samalavikRutopahitAnyanucitAnyAhArajAtAni vaiShamyayuktenopayogavidhinopayu~jjAnAnAM tantraprayogamapi viShamamAcaratAmanyAshca sharIraceShTA viShamAH samAcaratAmatyupakShINadehAnAM vyAdhivegasamudbhramitAnAmupahatamanasAM vA kAmakrodhalobhaharShabhayamohAyAsashokacintodvegAdibhirbhUyo~abhighAtAbhyAhatAnAM vA manasyupahate buddhau ca pracalitAyAmabhyudIrNA doShAH prakupitA hRudayamupasRutya manovahAni srotAMsyAvRutya janayantyunmAdam||4||

unmAdaM punarmanobuddhisa~jj~jAj~jAnasmRutibhaktishIlaceShTAcAravibhramaM vidyAt||5||

Commentary: unmAdapratyAtmalakShaNamAha- unmAdaM punarityAdi| vibhramamiti manaHprabhRutibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate| atra manovibhramAccintyAnarthAnna cintayate, acintyAMshca cintayate; uktaM hi- “manasashca cintyamarthaH” (sU.a.8) iti| buddhivibhramAttu nityamanityamiti, priyaM cApriyamiti pashyati; vacanaM hi- “viShamAbhinivesho yo nityAnitye priyApriye| j~jeyaH sa buddhivibhraMshaH, samaM buddhirhi pashyati” (shA.a.1) iti| sa~jj~jAM j~jAnaM, tadvibhramAdagnyAdidAhaM na budhyate; kiMvA sa~jj~jA nAmollekhena j~jAnam| smRutivibhramAttu na smarati, ayathAvadvA smarati| bhaktiricchA, tadvibhramAcca yatrecchA pUrvamAsIttatrAnicchA bhavati| shIlavibhramAdakrodhanaH krodhano bhavati| ceShTAvibhramAdanucitaceShTo bhavati| AcAraH shAstrashikShAkRuto vyavahAraH; tadvibhramAdashaucAdyAcarati||5||

tasyemAni pUrvarUpANi; tadyathA- shirasaH shUnyatA, cakShuShorAkulatA, svanaH karNayoH, ucchvAsasyAdhikyam, AsyasaMsravaNam, anannAbhilAShArocakAvipAkAH, hRudgrahaH, dhyAnAyAsasammohodvegAshcAsthAne, satataM lomaharShaH, jvarashcAbhIkShNam, unmattacittatvam, udarditvam , arditAkRutikaraNaM ca vyAdheH, svapne cAbhIkShNaM darshanaM bhrAntacalitAnavasthitAnAM rUpANAmaprashastAnAM ca tilapIDakacakrAdhirohaNaM vAtakuNDalikAbhishconmathanaM nimajjanaM ca kaluShANAmambhasAmAvarte cakShuShoshcApasarpaNamiti (doShanimittAnAmunmAdAnAM pUrvarUpANi bhavanti)||6||

Commentary: asthAne ityaviShaye; tena adhyAnaviShaye dhyAnam, asammohaviShaye ca moha ityAdi j~jeyam| unmattacittatvamiti udbhrAntacittatvam| udarditatvamiti UrdhvakAye pIDitatvam| arditAkRutikaraNaM ca vyAdheriti arditasya vyAdherAkRutikaraNaM; tenArdhavaktrabhramaNAdikaraNamityarthaH| kiMvA vyAdheriti prathamoktena tasyetyanena sambadhyate, tena tasya vyAdherbuddhyAdibhramarUpasyonmAdasya yathoktAni pUrvarUpANIti yojanA| cakShuShoshcApasarpaNamiti cakShurvyapagama ityarthaH||6||

tato~anantaramevamunmAdAbhinirvRuttireva| tatredamunmAdavisheShavij~jAnaM bhavati; tadyathA- parisaraNamajasram, akShibhruvauShThAMsahanvagrahastapAdA~ggavikShepaNamakasmAt , satatamaniyatAnAM ca girAmutsargaH, phenAgamanamAsyAt, abhIkShNaM smitahasitanRutyagItavAditrasamprayogAshcAsthAne, vINAvaMshasha~gkhashamyAtAlashabdAnukaraNamasAmnA, yAnamayAnaiH, ala~gkaraNamanala~gkArikairdravyaiH, lobhashcAbhyavahAryeShvalabdheShu, labdheShu cAvamAnastIvramAtsaryaM ca, kArshyaM, pAruShyam, utpiNDitAruNAkShatA, vAtopashayaviparyAsAdanupashayatA ca; iti vAtonmAdali~ggAni bhavanti(1); amarShaH, krodhaH, saMrambhashcAsthAne, shastraloShTrakashAkAShThamuShTibhirabhihananaM sveShAM pareShAM vA, abhidravaNaM, pracchAyashItodakAnnAbhilAShaH, santApashcAtivelaM, tAmraharitahAridrasaMrabdhAkShatA, pittopashayaviparyAsAdanupashayatA ca; iti pittonmAdali~ggAni bhavanti(2); sthAnamekadeshe, tUShNImbhAvaH, alpashashca~gkramaNaM, lAlAshi~gghANakasravaNam, anannAbhilAShaH, rahaskAmatA, bIbhatsatvaM, shaucadveShaH, svapnanityatA, shvayathurAnane, shuklastimitamalopadigdhAkShatvaM, shleShmopashayaviparyAsAdanupashayatA ca; iti shleShmonmAdali~ggAni bhavanti(3); tridoShali~ggasannipAte tu sAnnipAtikaM vidyAt; tamasAdhyamAcakShate kushalAH||7||

Commentary: tato~anantaramevetivacanAt pUrvarUpAnantaraM shIghramevonmAdo bhavatIti darshayati; anye rogA yathA pUrvarUpe bhUte~api cireNa bhavanti, na tathonmAda ityarthaH| unmAdavisheShavij~jAnamiti vAtAdyunmAdali~ggamityarthaH| parisaraNaM bhramaNam| shamyA dakShiNahastena vAdanaM, tAlastu vAmahastena vAdanaM; yaduktaM vishAkhinA- “shamyA dakShiNahastena, vAmahastena tAlakaH| ubhAbhyAM vAdanaM yattu sannipAtaH sa ucyate” iti| asAmneti uccaiH| ayAnairiti hastyAdiyAnavyatiriktaiH| labdheShu cAvamAna iti prApteShvabhyavahAryeShvAhAryeShvanupayogo~avadhIraNaM ca; na kevalamavamAnaH, kintu tIvraM mAtsaryaM ca; abhyavahAryaM labdhvA na kasyaciddAtumicchatItyarthaH| vAte upashaya upashayahetuH snehAdirvAtopashayaH, tasya viparyAso rUkShAdiH, tenAnupashayitA asukhamityarthaH| cakArAdvAtAnuguNasnehAdyupashayatA ca gRuhyate| amarSha ityAdi pittonmAdali~ggam| saMrambha ArabhaTI| sveShAmiti AtmIyAnAm| kaphonmAdali~gge raho vijanam||7||

sAdhyAnAM tu trayANAM sAdhanAni- snehasvedavamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanopashamana nastaHkarmadhUmadhUpanA~jjanAvapIDapradhamanAbhya~ggapradehapariShekAnulepanavadhabandhanAvarodhana- vitrAsanavismApanavismAraNApatarpaNasirAvyadhanAni, bhojanavidhAnaM ca yathAsvaM yuktyA, yaccAnyadapi ki~jcinnidAnaviparItamauShadhaM kAryaM tadapi syAditi||8||
bhavati cAtra-  unmAdAn doShajAn sAdhyAn sAdhayedbhiShaguttamaH| anena vidhiyuktena karmaNA yat prakIrtitam||9||

yastu doShanimittebhya unmAdebhyaH samutthAnapUrvarUpali~ggavedanopashayavisheShasamanvito bhavatyunmAdastamAgantukamAcakShate| kecit punaH pUrvakRutaM karmAprashastamicchanti tasya nimittam| tasya ca hetuH praj~jAparAdha eveti bhagavAn punarvasurAtreyaH| praj~jAparAdhAddhyayaM devarShipitRugandharvayakSharAkShasapishAcaguruvRuddhasiddhAcAryapUjyAnavamatyAhitAnyAcarati, anyadvA ki~jcidevaMvidhaM karmAprashastamArabhate; tamAtmanA hatamupaghnanto devAdayaH kurvantyunmattam||10||

Commentary: kecit punarityAdau ‘tasya nimittaM’ itipadamAvRutya pUrveNa pareNa ca yojanIyam| tatra praj~jAparAdha eva tasya nimittamiti bruvatA aprashastaprAktanakarmajanyatvaM na pratikShipyate, yataH prAktanamapi hi karma praj~jAparAdhajameva| kiMvA, tasya nimittaM praj~jAparAdha evetyanena tasyetyaprashastakarmaNo~api praj~jAparAdha eva kAraNamiti darshyate; tena karmajasya praj~jAparAdhAntarniviShTatvamucyate| AtmanA hatamiti AtmanA kRutenAshubhakarmaNA hatam| upaghnanta ityAveshaM kurvantaH||10||

tatra devAdiprakopanimittenAgantukonmAdena puraskRutasyemAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti; tadyathA- devagobrAhmaNatapasvinAM hiMsArucitvaM, kopanatvaM, nRushaMsAbhiprAyatA, aratiH, ojovarNacchAyAbalavapuShAmupataptiH, svapne ca devAdibhirabhibhartsanaM pravartanaM ceti; tato~anantaramunmAdAbhinirvRuttiH||11||

Commentary: puraskRutasyeti abhishapanIyatayA vyavasthApitasya| nRushaMsAbhiprAyatA parApakArarucitvam| ojasa upataptyA ojaHkAryabalAdirahitaH| pravartanaM preraNam||11||
autpAdikaM shoShamabhidhAya dakShayaj~je kuShThAnantarotpannamunmAdaM brUte| vacanaM hi- “bhayatrAsashokairunmAdApasmArANAm” (ni.a.8) iti||1-2||
tayorityAdau gamanaM devatIrthAdigamanam||16-17||

samprati devAdyunmAdahetuparihArArthaM devAdyunmAde~api prakRutameva karma kAraNaM darshayati- naivetyAdi| anuvartanta itivacanAdduShkRutakarmapreritA eva devAdayo~ashubhakarmANamabhinivishantIti darshayati; yadi hyevameva devAdayaH karmanirapekShA unmattaM kuryustadA sarvAneva kuryuriti bhAvaH| na sa taddhetukaH klesha iti nAsau devAdikRuta unmAda ityarthaH| atha kathaM devAdyAveshajanito~apyayaM na devAdikRuta ityAha- nahyasti kRutakRutyateti; na yasmAdashubhakarmaNA kRute unmAde punardevAdikRutyatvamasti, na hi kRutaM punaH kriyate, devAdayashca karmaparAdhInA eveti bhAvaH| kiMvA, ‘nahyasya kRutakRutyatA’ iti pAThaH| tatra kRutenaiva prAktanakarmaNA unmAdito na kRutyaH karaNIyaH puruSho bhavati; anyathA, sarveShAmevAvisheSheNa devAdyunmAdaH syAt; tasmAdyenaivonmAdaphalajanakaM karma kRutaM, sa eva devAdibhiH karmaparAdhInairabhigamyate; anenAbhiprAyeNAha- nahyasya kRutakRutyateti|- akRutapApakarmaNo na devAdyabhigamanIyatA~astItyarthaH| yasmAddevAdayo~atra karmaparAdhInAstasmAddevAdayo nopAlambhyAH||19-20||

na ca devAdibhyo bhetavyamityAha- praj~jAparAdhAdityAdi| nAbhishaMsediti nopAlabheta| AtmAnamityAdau Atmaiva shubhAshubhakarmakaraNAt sukhaduHkhayoryathAsa~gkhyaM kAraNaM bhavatIti vAkyArthaH| no trasediti devAdibhyaH, evamevAmI shubhakarmANamapi gRuhNantIti kRutvA no traset| apacitiH pUjA| te cetyAdau te ceti devApacitihitopasevane| tebhyo virodhashceti tebhyo devAdibhyo virodho yato bhavatyashubhakarmabhyaH, tat sarvamAtmanyAyattam| etena, AtmAdhInamevedamunmAdakAraNasya parivarjanaM parisevanaM ca darshayati||21-24||

upakliShTasattvAnAmiti rajastamobhyAmupahatecetasAm| utsannadoShANAmiti pravRuddhodbhrAntadoShANAm| samalaiH ashucibhiH, vikRutaiH vairodhikaiH, upahitAni mishrIkRutAnIti samalavikRutopahitAni; kiMvA samalaiH malinaiH, vikRutaiH kuShThivya~ggAdibhiH parijanaiH, upahitAni upaDhaukitAnIti samalavikRutopahitAni| vaiShamyayuktenopayogavidhineti yaH prakRutikaraNAdirAhAropayogavidhirvaktavyaH, tena vaiShamyayuktena; vaiShamyaM ca prakRutyAdInAmashastatvaM prakRutigurutvAdibhiH kRutaM j~jeyam| tantraM sharIraM, tasya paripAlanArthaM sadvRuttoktaH prayogaH; sharIraceShTAshabdena tu gamanAdi gRuhyate, tena na paunaruktyam| tantrashabdaH sharIre vartate; yaduktaM- “tantrayantreShu bhinneShu tamo~antyaM pravivikShatAm” (i.a.12) iti| vyAdhivegasamudbhramitAnAmiti vyAdhibalenAprakRutisthitAnAm| upahatamanasAmiti kAmAdibhiH sambadhyate| bhUya iti punaH punaH| upasRutyeti vyApya||3-4||
avarodhanaM tamograhAvarodhanAdi| vidhiyukteneti unmAdacikitsite prapa~jcavakShyamANavidhiyuktenetyarthaH||8-9||
athAto~apasmAranidAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tasmin hi dakShAdhvaradhvaMse dehinAM nAnAdikShu vidravatAmabhidravaNataraNadhAvanaplavanala~gghanAdyairdehavikShobhaNaiH purA gulmotpattirabhUt, haviShprAshAt pramehakuShThAnAM, bhayatrAsashokairunmAdAnAM, vividhabhUtAshucisaMsparshAdapasmArANAM, jvarastu khalu maheshvaralalATaprabhavaH , tatsantApAdraktapittam, ativyavAyAt punarnakShatrarAjasya rAjayakShmeti||11||
bhavanti cAtra-  apasmAro hi vAtena pittena ca kaphena ca| caturthaH sannipAtena pratyAkhyeyastathAvidhaH||12||
sAdhyAMstu bhiShajaH prAj~jAH sAdhayanti samAhitAH| tIkShNaiH saMshodhanaishcaiva yathAsvaM shamanairapi||13||
yadA doShanimittasya bhavatyAganturanvayaH| tadA sAdhAraNaM karma pravadanti bhiShagvidaH||14||

sarvarogavisheShaj~jaH sarvauShadhavishAradaH| bhiShak sarvAmayAn hanti na ca mohaM nigacchati ||15||

Commentary: nidAnasthAnoktasarvarogaj~jAnaphalamAha- sarvetyAdi| na ca mohaM nigacchatIti nidAnasthAnAdyanukte~api prameye sUkShme~api bahudRuShTatvena na mohaM gacchati, kinntu tadapyUhyata ityarthaH||15||

nidAnArthakaro rogo rogasyApyupalabhyate||16||

Commentary: akhileneti yAvannidAnasthAnatayA vyAdhyaShTakaM pratij~jAtaM tAvadakhilenoktam| tena cikitsAsthAnavaktavyanidAnAbhidhAnAnna nyUnatvaM; yacca jvarAdinidAnamapi punarvaktavyaM tadasyaiva prapa~jca iti bhAvaH|16|-
tadyathA- jvarasantApAdraktapittamudIryate| raktapittAjjvarastAbhyAM shoShashcApyupajAyate ||17||
plIhAbhivRuddhyA jaTharaM jaTharAcchotha eva ca| arshobhyo jaTharaM duHkhaM gulmashcApyupajAyate||18||
pratishyAyAdbhavet kAsaH kAsAt sa~jjAyate kShayaH| kShayo rogasya hetutve shoShasyApyupalabhyate||19||

te pUrvaM kevalA rogAH pashcAddhetvarthakAriNaH| ubhayArthakarA dRuShTAstathaivaikArthakAriNaH ||20||

Commentary: nanu yatra rogasya kAraNaM rogo bhavati, tatra kiM kAraNabhUtarogo~apradhAnamevetyAsha~gkyAha- te pUrvamityAdi|- te jvarAdayo raktapittAdyutpAdAt pUrvaM kevalAH santo rogA eva rujAkartRutvena svayameva pradhAnA iti; pashcAddhetvarthakAriNa iti pashcAdraktapittAdyutpAdakA bhavantItyarthaH| athaivamapi raktapittAdikaM janayitvA jvarAdayo hetuvadarogarUpA bhavanti na vetyAha- ubhayetyAdi| ubhayArthakarA iti hetvarthaM raktapittAdijananarUpaM, rogArthaM ca pIDAlakShaNaM kurvanti; na vyAdhyantarajananamAtraM kRutvA nivartanta ityarthaH| prakArAntaramAha- tathaivaikArthakAriNa iti| ekasyaiva hetorarthaM kurvantIti ekArthakAriNaH||20||

kashciddhi rogo rogasya heturbhUtvA prashAmyati| na prashAmyati cApyanyo hetvarthaM kurute~api ca||21||

Commentary: etadeva pakShadvayaM prAtilomyena vivRuNoti- kashciddhItyAdi| atra yo hetvarthaM vyAdhijananaM kRutvA prashAmyati, sa ekArthakArI; yastu hetvarthaM vyAdhyantarajananaM kRutvA svayamapyanuvartate, sa ubhayArthakArI; yadA kAsaM samArabhyApi svayamanuvartate, tadA pratishyAyaH svayaM ca rujAkartRutvena rogArthakaraH, kAsajanakatvena hetvarthakarashca bhavati; yadA tu kAsaM janayitvA svayaM nivartate, tadA kAsakAle nivRuttatvAt hetvarthamAtraM karotItyudAhAryam||21||

evaM kRucchratamA nRUNAM dRushyante vyAdhisa~gkarAH| prayogAparishuddhatvAttathA cAnyonyasambhavAt||22||

Commentary: vyAdhisa~gkarA vyAdhimelakAH| kutaH punarevaM bhavatItyAha- prayogetyAdi|- prayogAparishuddhatvaM yathA- AmAtIsAre stambhanaM kRutaM doShaM saMstabhya shUlAnAhAdhmAnAdi janayati| hetvantaramAha- anyonyasambhavAditi; parasparakAraNarUpatvAdityarthaH| pratishyAyo hi svarUpeNaiva kAsasya kAraNaM, sa ca rAjayakShmaNa ityAdi||22||

prayogaH shamayedvyAdhiM yo~anyamanyamudIrayet| nAsau vishuddhaH, shuddhastu shamayedyo na kopayet||23||

Commentary: prayogAparishuddhiM vivRuNoti- prayoga ityAdi| na kopayediti vyAdhyantaraM na kuryAdityarthaH| anyonyasambhavashca jvarasantApAdraktapittamudIryata ityAdinaivokta iti na punarvivriyate||23||
eko heturanekasya tathaikasyaika eva hi| vyAdherekasya cAneko bahUnAM bahavo~api ca||24||
jvarabhramapralApAdyA dRushyante rUkShahetujAH| rUkSheNaikena cApyeko jvara evopajAyate||25||
hetubhirbahubhishcaiko jvaro rUkShAdibhirbhavet| rUkShAdibhirjvarAdyAshca vyAdhayaH sambhavanti hi||26||
li~ggaM caikamanekasya tathaivaikasya lakShyate| bahUnyekasya ca vyAdherbahUnAM syurbahUni ca||27||
viShamArambhamUlAnAM li~ggamekaM jvaro mataH| jvarasyaikasya cApyekaH santApo li~ggamucyate||28||
viShamArambhamUlaishca jvara eko nirucyate| li~ggairetairjvarashvAsahikkAdyAH santi cAmayAH||29||
ekA shAntiranekasya tathaivaikasya lakShyate| vyAdherekasya cAnekA bahUnAM bahvya eva ca||30||
shAntirAmAshayotthAnAM vyAdhInAM la~gghanakriyA| jvarasyaikasya cApyekA shAntirla~gghanamucyate||31||
tathA laghvashanAdyAshca jvarasyaikasya shAntayaH| etAshcaiva jvarashvAsahikkAdInAM prashAntayaH||32||
sukhasAdhyaH sukhopAyaH kAlenAlpena sAdhyate| sAdhyate kRucchrasAdhyastu yatnena mahatA cirAt||33||
yAti nAsheShatAM vyAdhirasAdhyo yApyasa~jj~jitaH| paro~asAdhyaH kriyAH sarvAH pratyAkhyeyo~ativartate||34||
nAsAdhyaH sAdhyatAM yAti sAdhyo yAti tvasAdhyatAm| pAdApacArAddaivAdvA yAnti bhAvAntaraM gadAH||35||
vRuddhisthAnakShayAvasthAM rogANAmupalakShayet | susUkShmAmapi ca prAj~jo dehAgnibalacetasAm||36||
