vyAdhyavasthAvisheShAn hi j~jAtvA j~jAtvA vicakShaNaH| tasyAM tasyAmavasthAyAM catuHshreyaH prapadyate||37||
prAyastiryaggatA doShAH kleshayantyAturAMshciram| teShu na tvarayA kuryAddehAgnibalavit kriyAm||38||
prayogaiH kShapayedvA tAn sukhaM vA koShThamAnayet| j~jAtvA koShThaprapannAMstAn yathAsannaM haredbudhaH||39||

iha khalu catvAro~apasmArA bhavanti vAtapittakaphasannipAtanimittAH||3||

Commentary: catvAra iti vacanamAgantusambandhe~apyapasmArANAM catuShkapratipAdanArtham; apasmAro hi nonmAdavat svatantreNAgantunA kriyate||3||

j~jAnArthaM yAni coktAni vyAdhili~ggAni sa~ggrahe| vyAdhayaste tadAtve tu li~ggAnIShTAni nAmayAH||40||

Commentary: samprati nidAne li~ggatvenoktAnAM vyAdhInAM pRuthagvyAdhitvamapi bhavatItyAha- j~jAnArthamityAdi| sa~ggraha iti vyAdhinidAnAdisa~ggrahe| ye nidAnasthAne j~jAnArthaM pradhAnabhUtajvarAdij~jAnArthaM vyAdhayaH santi, te~avipAkArucyAdayaH svAtantryeNotpadyamAnA vyAdhaya eva vyAdhitvenaiva vyapadeShTavyA ityarthaH| tadAtve tu li~ggAnIti yadA jvarAdiparatantrA jAyante~arucyAdayaH, tadA pAratantryAlli~ggAnyeva te, nAmayAH; Amayo hi svatantraH svacikitsAprashamanIyo bhavatItyAyurvedasthitiH, jvarali~ggarUpAstvarucyAdayo jvaracikitsAprashamanIyA eveti bhAvaH||40||

vikAraH prakRutishcaiva dvayaM sarvaM samAsataH| taddhetuvashagaM hetorabhAvAnnAnuvartate||41||

Commentary: samprati nidAnAdhikRutasya hetorvibhavamAha- vikAra ityAdi| vikAraH vaiShamyam| prakRutiH sAmyam| sarvamiti anena shArIraM tathA~a~adhyAtmikaM copasa~ggRuhNAti| hetuvashagamiti hetvadhInotpAdam| etena, ArogyarUpaprakRutyarthinA sAmyahetuH sevanIyaH, tathA vikArarUparogaparihArArthinA ca vikAraheturvarjanIyaH| na ca vAcyaM- yad- dadhyAdishothajananahetoruparame~api tajjanitashothAnuvRuttidarshanAnmRuShaitadvacanaM- ‘hetorabhAvAnnAnuvartate’ iti, yata uparate~api dadhyAdau dadhyAdijanito doShasantAnaH shothAdijanakastatrAnuvartata eva||41||
tatra shlokAH- hetavaH pUrvarUpANi rUpANyupashayastathA| samprAptiH pUrvamutpattiH sUtramAtraM cikitsitAt||42||
jvarAdInAM vikArANAmaShTAnAM sAdhyatA na ca| pRuthagekaikashashcoktA hetuli~ggopashAntayaH||43||
hetuparyAyanAmAni vyAdhInAM lakShaNasya ca| nidAnasthAnametAvat sa~ggraheNopadishyate||44||

ta evaMvidhAnAM prANabhRutAM kShipramabhinirvartante; tadyathA- rajastamobhyAmupahatacetasAmudbhrAntaviShamabahudoShANAM samalavikRutopahitAnyashucInyabhyavahArajAtAni vaiShamyayuktenopayogavidhinopayu~jjAnAnAM tantraprayogamapi ca viShamamAcaratAmanyAshca sharIraceShTA viShamAH samAcaratAmatyupakShayAdvA doShAH prakupitA rajastamobhyAmupahatacetasAmantarAtmanaH shreShThatamamAyatanaM hRudayamupasRutyopari tiShThante, tathendriyAyatanAni ca| tatra cAvasthitAH santo yadA hRudayamindriyAyatanAni ceritAH kAmakrodhabhayalobhamohaharShashokacintodvegAdibhiH sahasA~abhipUrayanti, tadA janturapasmarati||4||

Commentary: udbhrAntaviShamabahudoShANAmiti atrodbhrAntatvenonmArgitvaM, viShamatvena kadAcidapasmAravegakartRutvaM darshyate| samaletyAdi unmAdavyAkhyAnatulyam| atyupakShayAdveti atyupakShINadehatvAdityarthaH; unmAdanidAne~api samalavikRutetyAdigranthe ‘atyupakShINadehAnAM’ (ni.a.7) ityuktam| shreShThatamAyatanamiti anenAnyo~api sharIradesho~antarAtmanaH sthAnaM, hRudayaM tu shreShThatamaM, tatraiva cetanAvisheShanibandhanAditi darshayati| upasRutyeti vyApya| upari tiShThante iti hRudayasyopari indriyAyatanAni copasRutya tiShThante iti yojanA| ‘paryavatiShThante’ iti pATho vyakta eva| tatrAvasthitA iti hRudaye indriyAyataneShu ca lInatvenAvasthitAH| te ca lInAH santaH kAmAdibhirIritAH punarhRudayamindriyAyatanAni ca visheSheNa pUrayanti yadA, tadA apasmarati apasmAravegayukto bhavatIti vAkyArthaH||4||

apasmAraM punaH smRutibuddhisattvasamplavAdbIbhatsaceShTamAvasthikaM tamaH praveshamAcakShate||5||

Commentary: apasmArapratyAtmalakShaNamAha- apasmAraM punarityAdi| samplavAditi vikRutigamanAt| bIbhatsA phenavamanA~ggabha~ggAdirUpA ceShTA yasmin tadbIbhatsaceShTam| AvasthikaM tamaHpraveshamiti kAdAcitkaM tamaHpraveshaM; tamaHpravesho~aj~jAnasAdharmyAt, apasmAravegavAn hi tamaHpraveshe iva na ki~jcidbudhyate||5||

tasyemAni pUrvarUpANi bhavanti; tadyathA- bhrUvyudAsaH satatamakShNorvaikRutamashabdashravaNaM lAlAsi~gghANaprasravaNamanannAbhilaShaNamarocakAvipAkau hRudayagrahaH kukSherATopo daurbalyamasthibhedo~a~ggamardo mohastamaso darshanaM mUrcchA bhramashcAbhIkShNaM svapne ca madanartanavyadhanavyathanavepanapatanAdInIti||6||
tato~anantaramapasmArAbhinirvRuttireva||7||

iti catvAro~apasmArA vyAkhyAtAH||8||

Commentary: tatredamityAdi| visheShavij~jAnaM vAtAdyapasmArali~ggamityarthaH| kShaNena sa~jj~jAM pratilabhamAnamiti vAtApasmAre shIghraM prabodho bhavatIti darshayati| AdhmAtagrIvamiti pUritastabdhagrIvam| Aviddhashiraskamiti vakrashiraskam| anavasthitacapalarUpadarshanaM patanakAle j~jeyaM, patitastu na budhyata eva| evamanyatrApi rUpadarshanaM boddhavyam| sushrute~api patanakAla eva rUpadarshanamuktaM; yathA- “yo brUyAdvikRutaM sattvaM kRuShNaM mAmanudhAvati| tato me cittanAshaH syAt so~apasmAro~anilAtmakaH” (su.u.a.61) ityAdi| pittApasmAre yadyapi visheShalakShaNe kShaNena sa~jj~jAM pratilabhamAnamityuktaM, tathA~api vAtikApekShayA kAlaprakarSho~atra j~jeyaH; pittAdapi hi vAyuH shIghrakArI bhavati| ugraM hiMsakamiva, bhairavaM tu ahiMsakamapi bhayajanakaM shmashAnAdi, AdIptaM jvalitam| cirAdapasmarantamiti bhUyasA kAlenApasmAravegavantam||8||

teShAmAganturanubandho bhavatyeva kadAcit, tamuttarakAlamupadekShyAmaH| tasya visheShavij~jAnaM yathoktali~ggairli~ggAdhikyamadoShali~ggAnurUpaM ca ki~jcit||9||

Commentary: bhavatyevetyatra evakAro~atyantAyogavyavacchede; yathA- nIlaM sarojaM bhavatyeva, na ca na bhavati| kadAciditi padaM tvatyantAyogavyavacchedArthatAmeva dyotayati| etena, sarvApasmAre bhUtasambandho bhavati, na ca svatantro~apasmAro bhautiko bhavatIti darshayati| uttarakAlamiti cikitsite, yadyapi cApasmAracikitsite~api prapa~jco na vaktavyaH, tathA~api tatronmAdavidhyatideshAdunmAdoktavistAra eveti kRutvA ihoktaM- ‘tamuttarakAlamupadekShyAmaH’ iti; uktaM hi- “yasyAnubandhaM tvAgantuM doShali~ggAdhikAkRutim| pashyettasya bhiShakkuryAdAgantUnmAdabheShajam” (ci.a.10) iti| yathoktali~ggairiti pa~jcamIsthAne tRutIyA, tena yathoktApasmArali~ggebhyo li~ggAdhikyaM li~ggAtiriktatvaM; taccAdoShali~ggAnurUpaM doShali~ggAsadRushamityarthaH| ki~jciditi na sarvaM, kintu stokaM doShali~ggavilakShaNaM li~ggamAgantvanubandhe bhavati| etena ca svAtantryeNAgantvapasmArasambhavo na bhavatIti darshayati; yadi hi svatantra evAgantuH syAttadA na stokamAgantuli~ggaM syAt, kintu sarvameva||9||

hitAnyapasmAribhyastIkShNAni saMshodhanAnyupashamanAni ca yathAsvaM, mantrAdIni cAgantusaMyoge||10||

Commentary: hitAnItyAdinA cikitsAsUtramAha| upashamanAni ca hitAnIti yojanA||10||
iti carakasaMhitAyAM dvitIyaM nidAnasthAnaM samAptam
unmAdAnantaraM prAgutpattAvapasmArotpAdAdapasmAranidAnamucyate||1-2||

sampratyuktAnAM gadAnAmutpattimAha- tasminnityAdi| yadyapi ca jvara eva tatra prathama utpannastathA~apyasau pRuthageva rudrakrodharUpa utpanna iti kRutvA pashcAducyate, gulmAdayastu yaj~jadhvaMsAnantarakAlabhUtA ekasAmagrIjAtatvena prathamamucyante; jvarasya tu sarvaprathamotpattirjvaranidAna evokteti bhAvaH| purA iti Adyutpattau| lalATaprabhava iti lalATabhavakrodhAgniprabhava ityarthaH| anvayaH anubandhaH| sAdhAraNamiti doShapratyanIkaM vamanAdi, devAdipratyanIkaM ca balima~ggalAdi||11-14||

samprati nidAnaprakaraNAdrogANAmapi keShA~jcidvyAdhiM prati kAraNatvaM yat sambhavati, tadvaktumAha- nidAnArthetyAdi| nidAnasyArthaH prayojanaM vyAdhijananaM, tat karotIti nidAnArthakaraH; vyAdhijanaka ityarthaH| nidAnarUpa iti vaktavye yannidAnArthakara iti brUte, tena vyAdhinA vyAdhyante kriyamANe~api mUlabhUtavyAdhijanaka eva heturvyAdhijanye~api vyAdhau mUlavyAdhijananAvAntaravyApAro nidAnamiti darshayati| tena, rogajanye~api roge mUlabhUtAsAtmyendriyArthAdi kAraNatrayameva kAraNaM bhavatIti na caturthakAraNAntarApattirityatiprasa~ggo vAcyaH; jvarakAraNAnyeva hi uShNAdInyatimAtrANi jvaramabhinirvartya raktapittamapi kAraNAntaravardhitashaktIni janayantItyAdyanusaraNIyam| gulmashcApyupajAyate iti arshobhya eva| kAsAt sa~jjAyate kShaya iti kAsAddhAtukShayo jAyate, sa ca dhAtukShayo rogasya shoShAbhidhAnasya heturupalabhyata iti yojanA||16-19||

hetuprakaraNAddhetudharmAntaramAha- eko heturityAdi| etatpakShacatuShTayodAharaNAnyAha- jvaretyAdi| yadyapi rUkShaM bahUnAM kAraNaM, tathA~api deshakAlAdivashAt kadAcidekasyaiva jvarasya kAraNaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| rUkShAdibhiriti rUkShoShNalavaNAdibhiH | jvarAdyA iti jvararaktapittagulmAdyAH||24-26||

li~ggasyApi hetoriva cAturvidhyamAha- li~ggamityAdi| tathaivaikasya lakShyata iti ekaM li~ggamiti sambandhaH| viShamArambhamUlAnAmiti viShamArambhaprathamAnAM; viShamArambhavisargitvamUShmaNo vaiShamyamityAdyuktajvarali~ggAnAmityarthaH| jvaraM hyekaM (santApAtmakaM ) dRuShTvA viShamArambhavisargitvAdayo~asya bhUtA bhaviShyanti vartanta iti vA li~ggyate| jvara eko nirucyata iti j~jAyata ityarthaH| li~ggairetairityAdi| etairviShamArambhavisargitvAdyairjvarAdayaH santi ‘yuktA’ iti sheShaH| viShamArambhAdayo hi vAtajvare tathA vAtashvAse vAtahikkAyAM vA yathAsambhavaM dRushyanta eva||27-29||
etaccAturvidhyaM cikitsAyAmapi brUte- eketyAdi||30-32||

cikitsAbhidhAnaprasa~ggena cikitsApravRuttiviShayaM sAdhyabhedaM tathA cikitsAnivRuttiviShayaM cAsAdhyabhedamAha- sukhetyAdi|- sukhopAya iti sukhalabhyavaidyAdyupAyaH ; kiMvA, sukhopAyaH san sAdhyate alpenaiva yatnena sAdhyata ityarthaH| yAti nAsheShatAmiti na sarvathA nivartate| paro~asAdhya iti yApyApekShayA utkRuShTo~asAdhyaH| asyaiva vivaraNaM- pratyAkhyeya iti| kriyAH cikitsAH| bhAvAntaramiti sukhasAdhyaH kRucchrasAdhyo bhavati, kRucchrashca yApyaH, yApyashca pratyAkhyeya iti||33-35||

vyAdheH sukhasAdhyatvAbhidhAnaprasa~ggena vRuddhyAdyavasthAntaramAha- vRuddhItyAdi| na kevalaM rogANAM kintu dehAgnibalacetasAmapivRuddhisthAnakShayAvasthAmupalakShayediti yojanA| etadvyAdhyavasthAj~jAnaprayojanamAha- vyAdhyavasthetyAdi| catuHshreya iti catushreyaHkArakaM cikitsitaM, prapadyate budhyata ityarthaH||36-37||

vyAdhiprakArAnabhidhAya cikitsopayuktAn doShaprakArAnAha- prAya ityAdi| tiryaggatAshca doShA unmArgagatatvena na samyak shIghraM vA bheShajena yojayituM pAryante, tena ciraM kleshayantIti yuktam| dehAgnibalavidityanena tiryaggatadoShe tvarayA bhUri bheShajaprayogeNa kriyamANA cikitsA dehamagnibalaM ca hantIti sUcayati| prayogairiti alpamAtradIrghakAlaprayogaiH| sukhaM veti sukhaM yathA bhavati tathA AsannaM haredityarthaH; yacchodhanaM vamanAdi yatrAmAshayAdigate doShe AsannaM haraNayogyatayA bhavati, tena haredityarthaH||38-39||

sa~ggrahe ‘sUtramAtraM cikitsitAt’ ityantenApasmArAdhyAyArthasa~ggraha ukta iti boddhavyam| ‘jvarAdInAM’ ityAdigranthena tu nidAnasthAnoktArthasa~ggrahaM karoti| yadyapi jvarasya jvaranidAne~asAdhyatA noktA, tathA~api ‘aShTAnAM’ itipadaM ‘chatriNo gacchanti’ iti nyAyena boddhavyam| kiMvA, aShTAnAM hetuli~ggopashAntaya iti yojanIyam; asAdhyatA yathAyogyatayaiva boddhavyA| pRuthaktvena caikaikashashceti pRuthagekaikashaH| tena, pRuthaktvena sarvasAdhAraNahetvAdayo nidAnasthAnAdAvuktAH, tathaikaikashashca jvarAdInAM hetuli~ggopashAntayaH sve sve adhyAye uktAH| atra ca li~ggagrahaNena pUrvali~ggagrahaNam, upashAntigrahaNena copashayagrahaNaM, samprAptestu pratirogamabhidhAnAdagrahaNaM vyAkhyeyam| hetuparyAyanAmAnIti ‘heturnimittaM’ (ni.a.1) ityAdinA, vyAdhiparyAyanAmAnIti tathA lakShaNaparyAyanAmAnIti cAdyAdhyAyoktAnyeva j~jeyAni; samprAptestu ‘samprAptirjAtirAgatiH’ (ni.a.1) iti nAmakathanaM lakShaNaprayojakameva prAyaH, teneha na sa~ggRuhItam| kiMvA hetava ityAdisthAnasa~ggraha eva, apasmArAdhyAyArthasa~ggrahastu sthAnasa~ggraheNaivAvyavahitena kRutatvAnna punaH pRuthakkRutaH| tatra hetava ityAdi sarvarogahetvAdisa~ggrahaNam| asmin pakShe pRuthaktveneti jvarAdInAmityanena sambadhyate, ekaikashashceti hetuli~ggopashayashAntibhiH sambadhyate| sa~ggraheNeti vacanAccikitsitaprapa~jcanIyaM nidAnaM sUcayati| kecidatra nidIyate nibadhyate hetvAdipa~jcakamaneneti nidAnamiti nidAnashabdavyutpattiM kurvanti, nidAnashabdena ca gavAM dohanakAlanibandhanarajjurucyate iti bruvate| jvaranidAne ca nidAnashabdo vyAkRuta eva||42-44||
ashabdashravaNamiti avidyamAnashabdashravaNashabdam| ATopaH guDaguDAshabdavisheSho vAtajanyaH shrUyata ityarthaH||6-7||
athAto rasavimAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tathAyukte hi samudaye samudAyaprabhAvatattvamevamevopalabhya tato dravyavikAraprabhAvatattvaM vyavasyet||11||

Commentary: atha kathaM tarhi vikRutiviShamasamavAyaprabhAvaj~jAnamityAha- tathAyukte hItyAdi| tathAyukte samudaya iti vikRutiviShamasamavAye| samudayaprabhAvatattvamiti melakaprabhAvatattvam| samadhRute hi madhusarpiShi sUryAvartAkhye vA doShasamudaye na saMyujyamAnamadhughRutaguNakramAgataM mArakatvaM, na ca vAtAdidoShaprabhAvagataM sUryavRuddhyA vardhiShNutvaM sUryAvartasya, kiM tu saMyogamahimakRutamevetyarthaH| yacca gatidvayaM doSharasamelakasya, tena prakRutisamasamavAyarUpaM sannipAtaM jvaranidAne doShali~ggamelakenaivoktavAn| yaduktaM- “pRuthaguktalakShaNasaMsargAddvAndvikamanyatamaM sAnnipAtikaM vA jvaraM vidyAt” (ni.a.1) iti| yastu vikRutiviShamasamavetastridoShakRuto jvarastasya cikitsite- “kShaNe dAhaH kShaNe shItaM” (ci.a.3) ityAdinA lakShaNamuktam| na hi shyAvaraktakoThotpattyAdi tatroktaM vAtAdijvare kvacidasti| evaM rase~api yatrAmrAte madhuratvaM prakRutisamasamavetaM, tatrAmrAtaM madhurametanmAtramevoktaM; tena, madhurasAmAnyaguNAgataM tasya vAtapittaharatvamapi labhyata eva| yatra vArtAke kaTutiktatvena vAtakaratvaM prAptamapi ca vikRutiviShamasamavAyAttanna bhavati, tatrAcAryeNa “vArtAkaM vAtaghnaM” (sU.a.27) ityuktameva| evamityAdi tattadudAharaNaM shAstraprasRutamanusaraNIyam| yattu prakRutisamasamavAyakRutarasadoShaguNadvArA prAptamapi dravyaguNaM vikAralakShaNaM ca brUte, tat prakarShArthaM spaShTArthaM ceti j~jeyam||11||

tasmAdrasaprabhAvatashca dravyaprabhAvatashca doShaprabhAvatashca vikAraprabhAvatashca tattvamupadekShyAmaH||12||

Commentary: upasaMharati- tasmAdityAdi| tattvamiti rasAdiprabhAvatattvam| yattu pUrvaM “tatrAdau rasadravyadoShavikAraprabhAvAnupadekShyAmaH” ityanena rasAdiprabhAvavyAkhyAnapratij~jAnaM kRutaM, tattu rasaprabhAvAnumAnenaiva dravyaprabhAvakathanAt, tathA doShaprabhAveNa ca vikAraprabhAvakathanAccaritArthaM syAt| iha tu vikRutiviShamasamavAyAtmake dravye vikAre vA rasadoShaprabhAvAnumAnena na dravyavikAraprabhAvAnumAnamastIti kRutvA pRuthak pRuthagrasAdiprabhAvatattvAbhidhAnapratij~jAnamiti na paunaruktyam| iha dravyANAM vIryaprabhAva-vipAkaprabhAvau ca dravyaprabhAve rasaprabhAve vA~antarbhAvanIyau| tatra yau rasAnuguNau vIryavipAkaprabhAvau, tau rase; yau tu rasakramoktavIryavipAkaviparItau vIryavipAkau, tau dravyaprabhAve boddhavyau| upadekShyAma iti nikhilena tantreNa rasAdiprabhAvatattvaM pRuthagupadekShyAma ityarthaH; rasAdiprabhAvaH prapa~jcena nikhile tantra eva vaktavyaH||12||

tatraiSha rasaprabhAva upadiShTo bhavati| dravyaprabhAvaM punarupadekShyAmaH| tailasarpirmadhUni vAtapittashleShmaprashamanArthAni dravyANi bhavanti||13||

Commentary: sa~gkShepAbhidhAnametadeveti darshayannAha- tatraiSha ityAdi| eSha iti ‘rasAH ShaD’ ityAdinA ‘tattvamupadekShyAmaH’ ityantena granthenokta ityarthaH| upadiShTo bhavatIti sa~gkShepeNa kathito bhavati| anye tu ‘tatraiSha rasaprabhAva uddiShTo bhavati’ iti paThanti| asmin pakShe dravyadoShavikAraprabhAvo~api yo~atra uddiShTaH so~api rasadvArA, tena rasasyaiva prapa~jcAbhihitatvAttasyaivAbhidhAnamupasaMharati na dravyAdInAmiti j~jeyam| dravyaprabhAvamityAdau punariti sAmAnyena dravyaprabhAvakathanAt punaH shRu~ggagrAhikayA tailAdidravyaprabhAvaM kathayiShyAma ityarthaH| prashamanArthAnIti prashamanaprayojanAni||13||

tatra tailaM snehauShNyagauravopapannatvAdvAtaM jayati satatamabhyasyamAnaM; vAto hi raukShyashaityalAghavopapanno viruddhaguNo bhavati, viruddhaguNasannipAte hi bhUyasA~alpamavajIyate, tasmAttailaM vAtaM jayati satatamabhyasyamAnam| sarpiH khalvevameva pittaM jayati, mAdhuryAcchaityAnmandatvAcca ; pittaM hyamadhuramuShNaM tIkShNaM ca| madhu ca shleShmANaM jayati, raukShyAttaikShNyAt kaShAyatvAcca; shleShmA hi snigdho mando madhurashca | yaccAnyadapi ki~jciddravyamevaM vAtapittakaphebhyo guNato viparItaM syAttaccaitA~jjayatyabhyasyamAnam||14||

Commentary: satatamabhyasyamAnamiti avicchedenopayujyamAnam| viruddhaguNa iti tailaguNebhyo viparItaguNaH| viruddhaguNasannipAte iti viruddhaguNayormelake| nanu viruddhaguNayormadhye bhUyasA~alpaM jIyate, tat kathaM tailaM vAtaM jayati? na hyasya vAtaM prati bhUyastvaM yuktamityAha- satatamabhyasyamAnamiti| satatopayogena hi tailaM vAtAdadhikaM bhavati, tena vAtaM jayatItyarthaH| sarpiH khalvevameveti sarpirapi satatamabhyasyamAnamityarthaH| amadhuramiti raukShyalAghavAvRuShyatvAdinA madhuraviparItaM kaTurasamityarthaH| iha ca prabhAvashabdena sAmAnyena dravyashaktirucyate, nAcintyashaktiH; tena tailAdInAM snehauShNyAdiguNAdapi vAtAdishamanaM dravyaprabhAvAdeva bhavati| sarpiShi ca yadyapi madhuro rasaH pittaprashame vyApriyate, tathA~api mAdhuryashaityamandatvaiH pittashamanaM sarpiHkAryameva, tena dravyaprabhAva eva vAcyaH | yadA tu rasadvArA kAryaM dravyasya cintyate, tadA rasaprabhAva iti vyapadesho bhavati| evaM kaShAyAnurase madhuni ca samAdhAnaM vAcyam| anye tu bruvate- yat- tailAdInAM vAtAdishamanatvaM pratyacintya eva prabhAvo~ayamucyate; tatra ca tailavAtashamanatvaM pratyacintya eva prabhAvo~ayamucyate; tatra ca tailavAtayorviruddhaguNayormelake tailameva vAtaM jayati, na tu vAtastailamiti tailasyAcintyaprabhAvaH; evaM sarpirmadhunorapi pittashleShmaharaNe prabhAvAjj~jeye| etaccAnye necchanti, yatastailAdInAM satatamabhyasyamAnamiti padenAdhikyameva vAtAdijayakAraNamuktaM; tathA yaccAnyadapi ki~jciddravyamityAdigranthena dravyAcintyaprabhAvaM parityajya sAmAnyena guNavaiparItyamevAbhyAsAdvAtAdijayaheturucyate||14||

atha khalu trINi dravyANi nAtyupayu~jjItAdhikamanyebhyo dravyebhyaH; tadyathA- pippalI, kShAraH, lavaNamiti||15||

Commentary: abhyasyadravyaM prabhAvodAharaNArthamabhidhAyAnabhyasyAnAha- athetyAdi| adhikamanyebhya iti vacanAdanyadapi citrakabhallAtakAdyeva~jjAtIyaM nAtyupayoktavyaM, pippalyAdidravyaM tvanyebhyo~apyadhikamatyupayoge varjanIyamiti darshayati||15||

pippalyo hi kaTukAH satyo madhuravipAkA gurvyonAtyarthaM snigdhoShNAH prakledinyo bheShajAbhimatAshcatAH sadyaH; shubhAshubhakAriNyo bhavanti; ApAtabhadrAH, prayogasamasAdguNyAt; doShasa~jcayAnubandhAH;- satatamupayujyamAnA hi guruprakleditvAcchleShmANamutkleshayanti, auShNyAt pittaM, na ca vAtaprashamanAyopakalpante~alpasnehoShNabhAvAt; yogavAhinyastu khalu bhavanti; tasmAt pippalIrnAtyupayu~jjIta||16||

Commentary: ‘kaTukAH satyo madhuravipAkAH’ ityAdi pippalIguNakathanamanabhyAsaprayoge doShavaiparItyena doShaprashamanopadarshanArthaM; tathA, atyabhyAse ‘guruprakleditvAcchleShmANamutkleshayanti’ ityAdigranthavaktavyadoShakaraNayogyatopadarshanArthaM ca| bheShajAbhimatAshca sadya iti cchedaH| sadya iti anabhyAse| shubhAshubhakAriNyo bhavantIti sadyaH shubhakAriNyaH, atyabhyAsaprayoge tvashubhakAriNyaH| etadeva shubhAshubhakAritvaM darshayati- ApAtabhadrA ityAdinA| prayogasamasAdguNyAditi samasya prayogasya sadguNatvAt, same~alpakAle alpamAtre ca pippalyAdiprayoge sadguNA bhavantItyarthaH| doShasa~jcayAnubandho~atyupayogo yAsAM tA doShasa~jcayAnubandhAH| etadeva doShasa~jcayAnubandhatvaM vivRuNoti- satatamityAdi| pippalIdharmakathanaprastAvAdguNAntaramAha- yogavAhinyastvityAdi| yogavAhitvena kaTukAnAmapi pippalInAM vRuShyaprayogeShu yogaH, tathA jvaragulmakuShThaharAdiprayogeShu jvarAdIn hanti pippalI| ayaM ca pippalyatiyoganiShedho~apavAdaM parityajya j~jeyaH| tena, pippalIrasAyanaprayogastathA gulmAdiShu ca pippalIvardhamAnakaprayogo na virodhamAvahati| ukte hi viShaye yathoktavidhAnena nirdoShA eva pippalya iti RuShivacanAdunnIyate| anye tu, annasaMskaraNe pippalyAdInAmatiprayogo niShidhyate, na tu svAtantrayeNeti bruvate| satatamupayujyamAnA iti atimAtratvena tathA satataprayogeNa ceti j~jeyam||16||

kShAraH punarauShNyataikShNayalAghavopapannaH kledayatyAdau pashcAdvishoShayati , sa pacanadahanabhedanArthamupayujyate; so~atiprayujyamAnaH keshAkShihRudayapuMstvopaghAtakaraH sampadyate| ye hyenaM grAmanagaranigamajanapadAH satatamupayu~jjate ta AndhyaShANDhyakhAlityapAlityabhAjo hRudayApakartinashca bhavanti, tadyathA- prAcyAshcInAshca; tasmAt kShAraM nAtyupayu~jjIta||17||

Commentary: hRudayApakartina iti hRudayaparikartanarUpavedanAyuktAH||17||

lavaNaM punarauShNyataikShNyopapannam, anatiguru, anatisnigdham, upakledi, visraMsanasamartham, annadravyarucikaram, ApAtabhadraM prayogasamasAdguNyAt, doShasa~jcayAnubandhaM, tadrocanapAcanopakledanavisraMsanArthamupayujyate| tadatyarthamupayujyamAnaM glAnishaithilyadaurbalyAbhinirvRuttikaraM sharIrasya bhavati| ye hyenadgrAmanagaranigamajanapadAH satatamupayu~jjate, te bhUyiShThaM glAsnavaH shithilamAMsashoNitA aparikleshasahAshca bhavanti| tadyathA- bAhlIkasaurAShTrikasaindhavasauvIrakAH; te hi payasA~api saha lavaNamashnanti| ye~apIha bhUmeratyUSharA deshAsteShvoShadhivIrudvanaspativAnaspatyA na jAyante~alpatejaso vA bhavanti, lavaNopahatatvAt| tasmAllavaNaM nAtyupayu~jjIta| ye hyatilavaNasAtmyAH puruShAsteShAmapi khAlityapAlityAni valayashcAkAle bhavanti||18||

Commentary: glAniH mAMsApacayo harShakShayo vA| na kevalaM lavaNAtiyogasharIropaghAtakaraH; kintu bhUmerapyupaghAtakara ityAha- ye~apIhetyAdi| USharA iti lavaNapradhAnAH| lavaNaM nAtyupayu~jjIteti nAtimAtraM lavaNaM satatamupayu~jjIta, annadravyasaMskArakaM tu stokamAtramabhyAsenApyupayojanIyameva| bAhlIkAdivyatirikte~api deshe ye~atilavaNamashnanti teShAmapi doShAnAha- ye hItyAdi| etena cAnyatrApi deshe~atimAtralavaNasAtmyAnAM lavaNAtyupayogakRuta eva shaithilyAdidoSha unnIyate, na deshasvabhAvakRutaH||18||

tasmAtteShAM tatsAtmyataH krameNApagamanaM shreyaH| sAtmyamapi hi krameNopanivartyamAnamadoShamalpadoShaM vA bhavati||19||

Commentary: teShAmiti atikShAralavaNasAtmyAnAm| tatsAtmyata iti atimAtrakShArAdatimAtralavaNAcca sAtmyAt| krameNeti navegAndhAraNIyoktasAtmyaparityAgakrameNa| iha ca sAtmyashabdenaukasAtmyamabhipretam| alpadoShamadoShaM veti pakShadvaye~atyarthasAtmyamalpadoShaM bhavati, anyattvadoShamiti vyavasthA||19||

sAtmyaM nAma tad yadAtmanyupashete; sAtmyArtho hyupashayArthaH| tattrividhaM pravarAvaramadhyavibhAgena; saptavidhaM tu rasaikaikatvena sarvarasopayogAcca| tatra sarvarasaM pravaram, avaramekarasaM, madhyaM tu pravarAvaramadhyastham| tatrAvaramadhyAbhyAM sAtmyAbhyAM krameNaiva pravaramupapAdayet sAtmyam| sarvarasamapi ca sAtmyamupapannaH prakRutyAdyupayoktraShTamAni sarvANyAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAnyabhisamIkShya hitamevAnurudhyeta||20||

Commentary: sAtmyaM nAmeti okasAtmyaM nAmetyarthaH| (okAditi abhyAsAt |) upashayArtha iti upashayashabdAbhidheya ityarthaH| taditi okasAtmyam| trividhamiti pravarAvaramadhyabhedena| saptavidhantu ekaikarasena ShaT, saMsRuShTarasopayogAccaikam, evaM saptavidham| saMsRuShTashabdena dvirasAdayaH ShaDrasaparyantA gRuhyante| pravarAvaramadhyasthamiti dvirasAdipa~jcarasaparyantam| avaramadhyamAbhyAM lakShitaH puruShaH| pravaramiti sarvarasam| sAtmyamupapAdayet abhyasedityarthaH| krameNeti yathoktAbhyAsakrameNa| upapAditasarvarasasAtmyenApi cAhAraH prashastaprakRutyAdisampanna eva kartavya ityAha- sarvarasamityAdi| abhisamIkShyeti hitAhitatvena vicArya| hitameveti padena yadeva prakRutyAdinA hitaM tadevAnurudhyeta sevetetyarthaH||20||

iha khalu vyAdhInAM nimittapUrvarUparUpopashayasa~gkhyAprAdhAnyavidhivikalpa balakAlavisheShAnanupravishyAnantaraM doShabheShajadeshakAlabalasharIrasArAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutivayasAM mAnamavahitamanasA yathAvajj~jeyaM bhavati bhiShajA, doShAdimAnaj~jAnAyattatvAt kriyAyAH| na hyamAnaj~jo doShAdInAM bhiShag vyAdhinigrahasamartho bhavati| tasmAddoShAdimAnaj~jAnArthaM vimAnasthAnamupadekShyAmo~agnivesha!||3||

Commentary: iha khalvityAdinA sthAnasambandhamAha| iha samprAptibhedasa~gkhyAprAdhAnyAdigrahaNenaiva samprAptimupadishan sa~gkhyAdibhedena sarvaiva samprAptiH kathitA bhavatIti darshayati| nimittAdInAM tu na tAdRusho bhedo~alpagranthavaktavyo~asti, yena bhedena te~apIha kathyeran, ataste sAmAnyenaivoktAH| anupravishyeti buddhvA | doShAdayaH sUtrasthAna eva prapa~jcitAH| mAnamiti prabhAvAdivisheShaH| etajj~jAne hetumAha- doShAdItyAdi| kriyAyA iti cikitsAyAH||3||

tatra khalvimAnyaShTAvAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAni bhavanti; tadyathA- prakRutikaraNasaMyogarAshideshakAlopayogasaMsthopayoktraShTamAni (bhavanti)||21||

Commentary: AhArasya vidhiH prakAro vidhAnaM vA ityAhAravidhiH, tasya visheSho hitatvamahitatvaM ca, tasyAyatanAni hetUnItyAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAni| AhAraprakArasya hitatvamahitatvaM ca prakRutyAdihetukamityarthaH| upayoktA aShTamo yeShAM tAnyupayoktraShTamAni||21||

eShAM visheShAH shubhAshubhaphalAH parasparopakArakA bhavanti; tAn bubhutseta, buddhvA ca hitepsureva syAt; naca mohAt pramAdAdvA priyamahitamasukhodarkamupasevyamAhArajAtamanyadvA ki~jcit||23||

Commentary: eShAmityAdau shubhaphalA visheShA ashubhaphalAshca parasparopakArakA bhavantIti j~jeyam| tatra prakRutyA lAghavAdiH shubhaphalaH, gurvAdishcAshubhaphalaH| karaNAdyAdheyo~api visheShaH shAstroktaH shubhaH, niShiddhastvashubhaH| deshAsAtmyaM ninditadeshabhavatvAdi ca dravyasyAshubhaphalam| evaM kAlAsAtmyamashubhaphalaM cAjIrNabhojanAdi, tathA okAsAtmyaM cAshubhamashubhaphalamiti j~jeyaM; viparItaM tu shubhaphalam| mohAditi aj~jAnAt, pramAdAditi j~jAtvA~api rAgAdityarthaH| priyamiti tadAtvamAtrapriyam| ahitamityasya vivaraNam- asukhodarkamiti|- asukhaM duHkharUpam, udarka uttarakAlInaM phalaM, yasya sa tathA| anyadveti bheShajavihArAdi||23||

tatrAdau rasadravyadoShavikAraprabhAvAn vakShyAmaH| rasAstAvat ShaT- madhurAmlalavaNakaTutiktakaShAyAH| te samyagupayujyamAnAH sharIraM yApayanti, mithyopayujyamAnAstu khalu doShaprakopAyopakalpante||4||

Commentary: adhyAyArthaM vaktuM pratijAnIte- tatrAdAvityAdi| yadyapi ca doShabheShajetyAdau doShApekShatvAdbheShajasya doSha Adau kRutaH, tathA~apIha rasadravyarUpabheShajasyApekShitarogaprashamakartRutvena tathA doShasyApi ca rasadravyayoreva kAraNatvena bheShajashabdasUcite rasadravye evAgre kRute, pashcAttu doShagrahaNagRuhItau doShavikArau| prakRuShTo bhAvaH prabhAvaH shaktirityarthaH; sa cehAcintyashcintyashca grAhyaH| yena, ‘tatra khalvanekaraseShu’ ityAdinA dravyavikArayoH prabhAvaM rasadvArA doShadvArA ca cintyamapi vakShyati| yApayantIti sAmyenAvasthApayanti| mithyAshabda ihAyogAtiyogamithyAyogeShu vartate||4||

tatredamAhAravidhividhAnamarogANAmAturANAM cApi keShA~jcit kAle prakRutyaiva hitatamaM bhu~jjAnAnAM bhavati- uShNaM, snigdhaM, mAtrAvat, jIrNe vIryAviruddham, iShTe deshe, iShTasarvopakaraNaM, nAtidrutaM, nAtivilambitam, ajalpan, ahasan, tanmanA bhu~jjIta, AtmAnamabhisamIkShya samyak||24||

doShAH punastrayo vAtapittashleShmANaH| te prakRutibhUtAH sharIropakArakA bhavanti, vikRutimApannAstu khalu nAnAvidhairvikAraiH sharIramupatApayanti||5||

Commentary: doShA iti shArIradoShAH| punaHshabdo mAnasadoShaM vyAvartayati||5||

AtmAnamabhisamIkShya bhu~jjIta samyak; idaM mamopashete idaM nopasheta ityevaM viditaM hyasyAtmana AtmasAtmyaM bhavati; tasmAdAtmAnamabhisamIkShya bhu~jjIta samyagiti||25||

Commentary: tasyeti uShNAdiguNayuktasyAnnasya| sAdguNyamiti prashastaguNayogitAm| parihrAsayatIti bhinnasa~gghAtaM karoti||25(1-2)|| mAtrAvaditi prashaMsAyAM matup; tena prashastamAtramityarthaH| apIDayaditi anatimAtratvena svasthAnasthitaM sadvAtAdIn sthAnApIDanAdaprakopayat| gudamanuparyetIti pariNataM sadanurUpatayA niHsaratItyarthaH| UShmANaM vahnim||25(3)|| pUrvasyeti dinAntarakRutasya| apariNatamiti asamyagjAtam| AhAraraseneti AhArapariNAmagatena madhurAdinA; kiMvA AhArajena rasena| svasthAnastheShu doSheShvityAdi jIrNAhArasya lakShaNam||25(4)|| viruddhavIryAhArajairiti kuShThAndhyavisarpAdyairAtreyabhadrakApyIyoktaiH||25(5)|| manovighAtakarairbhAvairiti trividhakukShIye (vi.a.2) vakShyamANaiH kAmAdibhishcittopatApakaraishcittavikArairityarthaH| tatheShTaishca sarvopakaraNairbhu~jjAno manovighAtaM na prApnotIti yojanA; aniShTabhojanAdermanovighAto bhavati||25(6)|| utsnehanam unmArgagamanam| avasadanam avasAdaH| apratiShThAnaM hRudayasthatvena koShThApraveshaH| bhojyagatAnAM doShANAM keshAdInAM, sAdguNyasya ca svAdutvAdeH, upalabdhirna niyatA bhavati kadAcidupalabhyate kadAcinneti| tatra doShAnupalabdhyA sadoShasyaiva bhakShaNaM, sAdguNyAnupalabdhyA ca prItyabhAvaH||25(7)|| viShamaM ca pacyata iti cirakAlabhojanenAgnisambandhasya vaiShamyAditi bhAvaH||25(8)|| ya evAtidrutamashnato doShA iti utsnehanAdayaH||25(9)|| nopasheta itItyatra itishabdena sAtmyAsAtmyavidhAnopadarshakena vicAraphalamokasAtmyasevanaM darshayati| Atmana iti padenAtmanaivAtmasAtmyaM pratipuruShaM j~jAyate, na shAstropadesheneti darshayati||25||

bhavati cAtra- rasAn dravyANi doShAMshca vikArAMshca prabhAvataH| veda yo deshakAlau ca sharIraM ca sa no bhiShak||26||

Commentary: adhyAyoktarasaprabhAvAdij~jAnaM stauti- rasAnityAdi| sa no bhiShagiti no~asmAkaM sammata ityarthaH||26||
tatra shlokau- vimAnArtho rasadravyadoSharogAH prabhAvataH| dravyANi nAtisevyAni trividhaM sAtmyameva ca||27||
AhArAyatanAnyaShTau bhojyasAdguNyameva ca| vimAne rasasa~gkhyAte sarvametat prakAshitam||28||

tatra doShamekaikaM trayastrayo rasA janayanti, trayastrayashcopashamayanti| tadyathA- kaTutiktakaShAyA vAtaM janayanti, madhurAmlalavaNAstvenaM shamayanti; kaTvamlalavaNAH pittaM janayanti, madhuratiktakaShAyAstvenacchmayanti; madhurAmlalavaNAH shleShmANaM janayanti, kaTutiktakaShAyAstvenaM shamayanti||6||

Commentary: rasAnAmasaMsRuShTAnAM karmAha- tatretyAdi| anena ca rasakarmopadeshena doShANAmapi tattadrasotpAdyatvaM tathA tattadrasopashamanIyatvamuktaM bhavati| kaTutiktakaShAyA vAtaM janayantIti asati paripanthinIti j~jeyaM, tenArkAguruguDUcyAdInAM tiktAnAmapi vAtAjanakatve na doShaH| tatra hyuShNavIryatA paripanthinI vidyate, tena na te vAtaM janayantItyAdyanusaraNIyam| enamiti padena yashca kaTvAdijo vAyustameva madhurAdayaH sarvAtmavaiparItyAdvisheSheNa shamayantIti darshayati; jAgaraNAdije hi vAyau jAgaraNAdiviparItAH svapnAdaya eva visheSheNa pathyAH| evaM pittashleShmaNorapi enadenaMshabdayostAtparyaM darshayati||6||

rasadoShasannipAte tu ye rasA yairdoShaiH samAnaguNAH samAnaguNabhUyiShThA vA bhavanti te tAnabhivardhayanti, viparItaguNA viparItaguNabhUyiShThA vA shamayantyabhyasyamAnA iti| etadvyavasthAhetoH ShaTtvamupadishyate rasAnAM paraspareNAsaMsRuShTAnAM, tritvaM ca doShANAm||7||

Commentary: atha kayA yuktyA rasA doShA~jjanayanti shamayanti cetyAha rasadoShetyAdi| sannipAte iti antaHsharIramelake| tushabdo visheShe, tena viparItaguNA eva visheSheNa viparItaguNabhUyiShThApekShayA shamayantIti darshayati| rasAnAM tu yathA upacArAdguNA bhavanti tadabhihitaM “guNAguNAshrayA noktAH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA sUtre| abhyasyamAnA iti na sakRudupayujyamAnAH| atha kasmAdrasadoShasaMsargabhUyastvaM parityajya rasaShaTtvaM doShatritvaM cocyate? ityAha- ityetadityAdi| vyavastheti rasadoShasaMsargaprapa~jcasa~gkShepaH | paraspareNAsaMsRuShTAnAmiti padaM doShANAmityanenApi yojyam||7||

saMsargavikalpavistaro hyeShAmaparisa~gkhyeyo bhavati, vikalpabhedAparisa~gkhyeyatvAt||8||

Commentary: rasadoShasaMsargaprapa~jcAnabhidhAne hetumAha- saMsargetyAdi| yasmAt saMsargabhedavistaro~aparisa~gkhyeyastasmAt ShaTtvaM tritvaM cocyate| vikalpabhedAparisa~gkhyeyatvAditi saMsargavikalpasya bhedo vijAtIyaprakAraH, tasyAparisa~gkhyeyatvAt| etena, yathA rasAnAmavAntaravyaktibhede~api madhuratvAdisAmAnyayogAnmadhurAdivyapadeshena ShaTtvamucyate; tathA madhurAmlamadhuralavaNAdisaMsargANAmapi satyapyavAntarabhede sAmAnyenopasa~ggrahaM kRutvA triShaShTitvasa~gkhyAniyamo bhaviShyatIti nirasyate, yato madhurAmlAdisaMsarge~api vijAtIyo madhurataramadhuratamAdibhedakRuto bhedo~aparisa~gkhyeyo bhavati| vacanaM hi- “rasAstaratamAbhyAM tAM sa~gkhyAmatipatanti hi” (sU.a.26) iti||8||

tatra khalvanekaraseShu dravyeShvanekadoShAtmakeShu ca vikAreShu rasadoShaprabhAvamekaikashyenAbhisamIkShya tato dravyavikArayoH prabhAvatattvaM vyavasyet||9||

Commentary: atha kathaM tarhi saMsRuShTAnAM rasAnAM doShANAM ca prabhAvo j~jeya ityAha- tatra khalvityAdi| tatra cAnekarasadravyasyAnekadoShavikArasya ca pratyekarasadoShaprabhAvamelakena prabhAvaM kathayan rasasaMsargadoShasaMsargayorapi tAdRushameva prabhAvaM kathayati, yato rasadoShasaMsargaprabhAvAvatra dravyavikArAshrayitvAdrasadoShayordravyavikAraprabhAvatvenocyete | anena nyAyena sAkShAdanukto~api ekarasadravyaikadoShavikArayorapi prabhAvo~asaMsRuShTarasadoShaprabhAvakathanAdukta eva j~jeyaH| ekaikashyenAbhisamIkShyeti pratyekamuktarasAdiprabhAveNAnekarasaM dravyamanekadoShaM ca vikAraM samuditaprabhAvamabhisamIkShya||9||

na tvevaM khalu sarvatra| na hi vikRutiviShamasamavetAnAM nAnAtmakAnAM paraspareNa copahatAnAmanyaishca vikalpanairvikalpitAnAmavayavaprabhAvAnumAnenaiva samudAyaprabhAvatattvamadhyavasAtuM shakyam||10||

Commentary: ayaM ca rasadoShaprabhAvadvArA dravyavikAraprabhAvanishcayo na sarvatra dravye vikAre cetyAha- na tvevaM khalu sarvatreti| atraiva hetumAha- nahItyAdinA~adhyavasAtuM shakyamityantena| vikRutiviShamasamavetAnAmiti vikRutisamavetAnAM tathA viShamasamavetAnAM ceti vikRutiviShamasamavetAnAm| samavetAnAmiti militAnAM rasAnAM doShANAM ca| tatra rasasya vikRutisamavAyo yathA- madhure taNDulIyake; madhuro hi prakRutyA snehavRuShyatvAdikaraH, taNDulIyake tu vikRutisamavetatvena tanna karoti| viShamasamavetAstu tile kaShAyakaTutiktamadhurAH; yadi hIme rasAH samayA mAtrayA samavetAH syustatastilo~api pittashleShmaharastridoShaharo vA syAt, pittakaphakarastvayaM; tenAtra rasAnAM kvacit kartRutvamakartRutvaM ca kvaciditi vaiShamyamunnIyate| nAnAtmakAnAmityAdihetutrayaM tu vikRutisamavAyaviShamasamavAyayorevopalambhakam | tena, nAnAtmakatvAdibhirvikRutisamavAyaviShamasamavAyau bhavataH| nAnAtmakAnAmiti nAnArUpahetujanitAnAM ; tena hetubhedabalAdeva rasadoShayorvikRuto viShamo vA melako bhavatItyarthaH| kiMvA, nAnAtmakAnAmiti nAnApramANAnAm| evaM ca nAnApramANatvaM viShamasamavAye hetuH| paraspareNa copahatAnAmiti anyonyamupaghAtitaguNAnAm| parasparaguNopaghAtastu yadyapi doShANAM prAyo nAstyeva, tathA~apyadRuShTavashAt kvacidbhavatIti j~jeyaM; rasAnAM tu prabalenAnyopaghAto bhavatyeva| anyaishca vikalpanairiti anyaishca bhedakaiH, tatra rasasya bhedakAH svarasakalkAdayaH; ekasyaiva hi dravyasya kalpanAvisheSheNa guNAntarANi bhavanti| doShasya tu dUShyAntarANyeva guNAntarayogAdbhedakAni bhavanti| yaduktaM- “sa eva kupito doShaH samutthAnavisheShataH| sthAnAntaragatashcaiva vikArAn kurute bahUn” (sU.a.18) iti| asmin vyAkhyAne rasAnAM doShANAM ca ya utkarShApakarShakRuto viShamasamavAyaH pRuthagucyate, sa na yujyate; yato viShamasamavAye~apyutkRuShTasya rasasya tathA doShasya cotkRuShTA guNA apakRuShTasya cApakRuShTA guNA bhavantIti kRutvA~avayavaprabhAvAnanumAnenaiva samudAyaprabhAvAnumAnaM shakyam| athocyeta- viShamamelake rasasya doShasya ca na ta eva guNA utkRuShTA apakRuShTA vA bhavanti kintu guNAntarameva bhavati, hanta tarhi vikRuta evAyaM samavAyo visadRushakAryakAraNatvAt| tadevaM dUShaNadarshanAdanyathA vyAkhyAyate- yat- dvividho melako bhavati rasAnAM doShANAM ca prakRutyanuguNaH, prakRutyananuguNashca; tatra yo militAnAM prAkRutaguNAnupamardena melako bhavati, sa prakRutisamasamavAyashabdenocyate; yastu prAkRutaguNopamardena bhavati, sa vikRutiviShamasamavAyo~abhidhIyate; vikRutyA hetubhUtayA viShamaH prakRutyananuguNaH samavAyo vikRutiviShamasamavAya ityarthaH| atraiva vikRutiviShamasamavAye nAnAtmakatvAdihetutrayaM yathAvivRutameva yojanIyam| ye tu vikRutiviShamasamavAyau pRuthageva kurvanti, viShamasamavAyasya vaiShamyatAratamyenAtibahuprapa~jcitatvAd viShamAvayavaguNAnumAnaM duHshakamiti kRutvA, tadapi dravyavikAraprabhAveNaiva vyapadishanti||10||

nidAne j~jAtahetvAdipa~jcakasya cikitsopayogitayA doShabheShajAdivisheShaj~jAnamapekShitaM bhavati, ato vakShyamANadoShabheShajAdivisheShaj~jApakaM vimAnasthAnaM brUte| tatrApi ca doShabheShajayoH prAdhAnyAttadvisheShaj~jApakaM rasavimAnaM prathamaM brUte| imaM ca sthAnasambandhaM svayameva darshayiShyati| visheSheNa mIyate j~jAyate doShabheShajAdyaneneti vimAnaM, doShabheShajAdInAM prabhAvAdivisheSha ityarthaH; evambhUtaM vimAnamabhidheyatayA yatra tiShThati tadvimAnasthAnam| rasavimAnamadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyo rasavimAnam||1-2||

tatretyAdau idamiti vakShyamANam| AhAravidhirvidhIyate yenoShNasnigdhAdinA vakShyamANena tadAhAravidhividhAnam| AturANAM ca keShA~jciditi padena raktapittinAM shItameva, kapharogiNAM rUkShameva hitamityAdiviparyayaM darshayati| keShA~jcidbhu~jjAnAnAmidamAhAravidhividhAnaM hitatamaM bhavatIti yojanA| prakRutyaiveti svabhAvenaiva hitatamaM hitatamamityuktaM; tena yat prakRutyA hitaM tat kadAcideva ka~jcideva puruShamAsAdyAhitaM bhavati, tacca kAdAcitkatvAdanAdRutaM; tena prAyikatvAdenaM hitatamaM vakShyAma iti bhAvaH| uShNamityAdau samyagiti chedaH|| 24||

doShavikArau ca yadyapi trividhakukShIye (vi.a.2) prabhAvavistAreNa vaktavyau, tathA~apIha sa~gkShepeNoktAveva; tena doShavikAraprabhAvAvapyuktAviti yaducyate sa~ggrahe tat sAdhu| tailAdidravyatrayakathanaM ca dravyaprabhAvagRuhItamiti kRutvA na pRuthak sa~ggrahe paThitam||27-28||
athAtastrividhakukShIyaM vimAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

trividhaM kukShau sthApayedavakAshAMshamAhArasyAhAramupayu~jjAnaH; tadyathA- ekamavakAshAMshaM mUrtAnAmAhAravikArANAm, ekaM dravANAm, ekaM punarvAtapittashleShmaNAm; etAvatIM hyAhAramAtrAmupayu~jjAno nAmAtrAhArajaM ki~jcidashubhaM prApnoti||3||

Commentary: trividhamiti triprakAram| avakAshAMshamiti koShThAvakAshabhAgam| AhArasyeti AhAranimittamityarthaH| tena dvAvavakAshAvAhArasya vaktavyau, ekastu doShANAmiti trividhaM vakShyamANamuktam| doShAvakAshasthApanaM hyAhAropakArakatvAdAhArasyetyucyate, doShAvakAshAnavasthAne hyAhAro doShairdUShyata iti vaktavyam| kiMvA, AhArasyAvakAshAMshamAmAshayarUpaM kukShau vakShyamANavibhAgena trividhaM sthApayedityarthaH| kukShyaMshabhAgaM yathAkartavyamAha- tadyathetyAdi| mUrtAnAmiti AshyakhAdyAnAM, dravANAmiti lehyapeyAnAm| iha cAMshashabdo na samapravibhAge vartate, kintu yathocitavibhAge; tena mUrtAnAM bahubhAgo bhavatIti j~jeyam| vAtapittashleShmaNAM yadyapi bhinnAni sthAnAni, tathA~api mUrtAhArAdibhAgApekShayA militAnAM ki~jcitsthAnaM bhavatItyekatvenAdhyAropyAtra ekamiti kRutam| nanu kukShyaMshavibhAgena kRute~apyAhAre prakRutigurvAdiduShTadravyajadoSho dRushyata ityAha- nAmAtrAhArajamiti; prakRutyAdidoShakRutaM tu prApnotyevetyarthaH||3||

na ca kevalaM mAtrAvattvAdevAhArasya kRutsnamAhAraphalasauShThavamavAptuM shakyaM, prakRutyAdInAmaShTAnAmAhAravidhivisheShAyatanAnAM pravibhaktaphalatvAt||4||

Commentary: tadeva sphorayati- na cetyAdi| sauShThavaM suShThutvaM bhAdrakyamityarthaH| pravibhaktaphalatvAditi pravibhinnaphalatvAt||4||
tatrAyaM tAvadAhArarAshimadhikRutya mAtrAmAtrAphalavinishcayArthaH prakRutaH| etAvAneva hyAhArarAshividhivikalpo yAvanmAtrAvattvamamAtrAvattvaM ca||5||

tatra mAtrAvattvaM pUrvamuddiShTaM kukShyaMshavibhAgena, tadbhUyo vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH| tadyathA- kukSherapraNIDanamAhAreNa, hRudayasyAnavarodhaH, pArshvayoravipATanam, anatigauravamudarasya, prINanamindriyANAM, kShutpipAsoparamaH, sthAnAsanashayanagamanocchvAsaprashvAsahAsyasa~gkathAsu sukhAnuvRuttiH, sAyaM prAtashca sukhena pariNamanaM , balavarNopacayakaratvaM ca; iti mAtrAvato lakShaNamAhArasya bhavati||6||

amAtrAvattvaM punardvividhamAcakShate- hInam, adhikaM ca| tatra hInamAtramAhArarAshiM balavarNopacayakShayakaramatRuptikaramudAvartakaramanAyuShyavRuShyamanaujasyaM sharIramanobuddhIndriyopaghAtakaraM sAravidhamanamalakShmyAvahamashIteshca vAtavikArANAmAyatanamAcakShate, atimAtraM punaH sarvadoShaprakopaNamicchanti kushalAH| yo hi mUrtAnAmAhArajAtAnAM sauhityaM gatvA dravaistRuptimApadyate bhUyastasyAmAshayagatA vAtapittashleShmANo~abhyavahAreNAtimAtreNAtiprapIDyamAnAH sarve yugapat prakopamApadyante, te prakupitAstamevAhArarAshimapariNatamAvishya kukShyekadeshamannAshritA viShTambhayantaH sahasA vA~apyuttarAdharAbhyAM mArgAbhyAM pracyAvayantaH pRuthak pRuthagimAn vikArAnabhinirvartayantyatimAtrabhoktuH| tatra vAtaH shUlAnAhA~ggamardamukhashoShamUrcchAbhramAgnivaiShamya- pArshvapRuShThakaTigrahasirAku~jcanastambhanAni karoti, pittaM punarjvarAtIsArAntardAhatRuShNAmadabhramapralapanAni, shleShmA tu chardyarocakAvipAkashItajvarAlasyagAtragauravANi||7||

Commentary: sAravidhamanamiti rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) vakShyamANatvaksArAdividhamanam| AhAravikArANAmiti karaNe sauhityayogAt ShaShThI| dravaistRuptimiti bhUyaHpadavisheShaNAdatitRuptimityarthaH| AmAshayagatA iti vacanenAgnisahAya(samAna)syaiva vAyoH kopo bhavati, na pakvAshayagatasyeti darshayati| kukShyekadeshamannAshritAH saha dUShitenAhAreNetyarthaH||7||

na ca khalu kevalamatimAtramevAhArarAshimAmapradoShakaramicchanti , api tu khalu gururUkShashItashuShkadviShTaviShTambhividAhyashuciviruddhAnAmakAle cAnnapAnAnAmupasevanaM, kAmakrodhalobhamoherShyAhrIshokamAnodvegabhayopataptamanasA vA yadannapAnamupayujyate, tadapyAmameva pradUShayati||8||
bhavati cAtra- mAtrayA~apyabhyavahRutaM pathyaM cAnnaM na jIryati| cintAshokabhayakrodhaduHkhashayyAprajAgaraiH||9||
taM dvividhamAmapradoShamAcakShate bhiShajaH- visUcikAm, alasakaM ca||10||
tatra visUcikAmUrdhvaM cAdhashca pravRuttAmadoShAM yathoktarUpAM vidyAt||11||

alasakamupadekShyAmaH- durbalasyAlpAgnerbahushleShmaNo vAtamUtrapurIShavegavidhAriNaH sthiragurubahurUkShashItashuShkAnnasevinastadannapAnamanilaprapIDitaM shleShmaNA ca vibaddhamArgamatimAtrapralInamalasatvAnna bahirmukhIbhavati, tatashchardyatIsAravarjyAnyAmapradoShali~ggAnyabhidarshayatyatimAtrANi| atimAtrapraduShTAshca doShAH praduShTAmabaddhamArgAstiryaggacchantaH kadAcideva kevalamasya sharIraM daNDavat stambhayanti, tatastaM daNDAlasakamasAdhyaM bruvate| viruddhAdhyashanAjIrNAshanashIlinaH punarAmadoShamAmaviShamityAcakShate bhiShajaH, viShasadRushali~ggatvAt; tat paramasAdhyam, AshukAritvAdviruddhopakramatvAcceti||12||

Commentary: alasakamupadekShyAma ityAdinA punarvisheShahetuH prAyo~abhinirvartaka ucyate, sAmAnyena tvatimAtrAhArarUpa ukta eveti j~jeyam| anilaprapIDitaM shleShmaNA ca vibaddhamArgamiti doShadvayavyApAravacanAdvAtashleShmaNoralasake prAdhAnyamucyate, pittaM tu sAmAnyavacanasiddhamapradhAnamastyeva tRuShNAmadabhramAdili~ggamiti j~jeyam| praduShTAmabaddhamArgA iti atrApakva AhAro~annaraso vA apakva Ama ucyate| kevalaM kRutsnam| viruddhAdhyashanAjIrNAshanashIlina iti viruddhAshanam, adhyashanam, ajIrNAshanaM ca; ajIrNasyApakvasyAshanamajIrNAshanam, ajIrNe bhojanasyAdhyashanashabdena labdhatvAt| AmadoShamAmaviShamAcakShata ityatra viShasadRushali~gga evAmapradoSho~abhipretaH, ata eva viShasadRushali~ggatvAdityuktam| viruddhopakramatvAditi AmApekShayA yaduShNaM kriyate tadviShaviruddhaM, yacca viShApekShayA shItaM kriyate tadAmaviruddham| viShasadRushatA cAmasyAmajanakahetuvisheShaprabhAvAdbhavati madhughRutasamasaMyoga iva viShatvam||12||

tatra sAdhyamAmaM praduShTamalasIbhUtamullekhayedAdau pAyayitvA salavaNamuShNaM vAri, tataH svedanavartipraNidhAnAbhyAmupAcaredupavAsayeccainam| visUcikAyAM tu la~gghanamevAgre viriktavaccAnupUrvI| AmapradoSheShu tvannakAle jIrNAhAraM punardoShAvaliptAmAshayaM stimitagurukoShThamanannAbhilAShiNamabhisamIkShya pAyayeddoShasheShapAcanArthamauShadhamagnisandhukShaNArthaM ca, natvevAjIrNAshanam; AmapradoShadurbalo hyagnirna yugapaddoShamauShadhamAhArajAtaM ca shaktaH paktum| api cAmapradoShAhArauShadhavibhramo~atibalatvAduparatakAyAgniM sahasaivAturamabalamatipAtayet| AmapradoShajAnAM punarvikArANAmapatarpaNenaivoparamo bhavati, sati tvanubandhe kRutApatarpaNAnAM vyAdhInAM nigrahe nimittaviparItamapAsyauShadhamAta~gkaviparItamevAvacArayedyathAsvam| sarvavikArANAmapi ca nigrahe hetuvyAdhiviparItamauShadhamicchanti kushalAH, tadarthakAri vA| vimuktAmapradoShasya punaH paripakvadoShasya dIpte cAgnAvabhya~ggAsthApanAnuvAsanaM vidhivat snehapAnaM ca yuktyA prayojyaM prasamIkShya doShabheShajadeshakAlabalasharIrAhArasAtmyasattvaprakRutivayasAmavasthAntarANi vikArAMshca samyagiti||13||

Commentary: vartiriti phalavartiH| AnupUrvIti peyAdikrama ityarthaH| jIrNAhAramiti visUcikAlasakayorevAhArasya jIrNatAM darshayati| doShAvaliptAmAshayastimitagurukoShThatvAdi puruShavisheShaNamapi lakShaNaM j~jeyam| na tvajIrNAshanamiti punarniShedhakaraNenAjIrNAshane pramAdAdajIrNaprashamanAbhiprAyeNa kriyamANabheShajasya mahAtyayatAM ‘doShadurbalo hyagniH’ ityAdinA vakShyamANAM darshayati| kRutApatarpaNAnAmityanena doShANAmAmatAkShayaM sUcayati; samyakkRute hyapatarpaNe nAmAnubandho~asti | tatashca nirAmadoShArabdhe visUcikAlasakavyavasthite shUlajvarAdau Ata~gkaviparItaM nirAmashUlajvarAdiharameva yujyate| yathAsvamiti yadyasya shUlAderAta~gkasya viparItaM tattatra kAryamityarthaH| Ata~gkaviparItashabdena ca tadarthakAri gRuhItaM mantavyam| ata evottaratra ‘tadarthakAri vA’ iti sarvavikArabheShajakathane upapannaM bhavati; anyathA kathamihAnabhihitaM tadarthakAri tatrAprastutamucyate| vimuktAmapradoShasyetyAdinA~abhya~ggAdividhAnaM vyAdhijanitAtidaurbalyAdidoShaprashamanArtham||13||

bhavati cAtra- AhAravidhyAyatanAni cAShTau samyak parIkShyAtmahitaM vidadhyAt| anyashca yaH kashcidihAsti mArgo hitopayogeShu bhajeta taM ca||14||

Commentary: anuktavidhyupagrahArthamAha- anyashcetyAdi| anyashceti grahaNyatisArAdivakShyamANAmadoShakShayakaro bheShajarUpo mArga ihAmapradoShe hita iti sambandhaH||14||
ashitaM khAditaM pItaM lIDhaM ca kva vipacyate| etattvAM dhIra! pRucchAmastanna AcakShva buddhiman||15||
nAbhistanAntaraM jantorAmAshaya iti smRutaH| ashitaM khAditaM pItaM lIDhaM cAtra vipacyate||17||
AmAshayagataH pAkamAhAraH prApya kevalam| pakvaH sarvAshayaM pashcAddhamanIbhiH prapadyate||18||
tatra shlokaH- tasya mAtrAvato li~ggaM phalaM coktaM yathAyatham| amAtrasya tathA li~ggaM phalaM coktaM vibhAgashaH||19||
rasavimAne rAshiruktaH, tasya rAshermAtrAmAtrAvataH phalaprapa~jcaM doShavikAraprapa~jcaM darshayituM trividhakukShIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

kukShyaMshavibhAgeneti ekamavakAshAMshaM mUrtAnAmityAdinA| uddiShTamiti sa~gkShepeNa kathitam| sAyaM prAtashcetivacanAt sAyaM bhojane kRute yadi prAtaH, prAtashca kRute yadi sAyaM, sukhena pariNamanaM tathA sthAnAsanAdiShu sukhAnuvRuttirbhavati, tadA mAtrAvadbhojanamanena kRutamiti j~jeyam||5-6||

atimAtrAshanajanyatvenAmapradoShe vaktavye~anyatashca yata AmapradoSho bhavati tamAha- na ca khalvityAdi| kAmAdibhirmAnasa upaghAtaH prabhAvAdevAnnaM dUShayati| evamashucyapyannamashucitvena j~jAtaM manasa upaghAtakatvAdAmadUShakaM bhavati| AmasyApakvasyAhArasya pradoSha AmapradoShaH| Amameva pradUShayatIti atra karmakartRutve ‘ac’, duShTaM bhavatItyarthaH; kiMvA, AmamapakvaM sadduShTadoShasamparkAccharIraM dUShayatIti j~jeyam||8-9||
dvividhamityAdau alasaka eva daNDAlasakAmaviShayoravarodho j~jeyaH; tayorapi hi doSho~apravartamAnatvAdalasIbhUta eva bhavati||10-11||
AmAshayapramANopadarshanArthaM ca gurupRucchottaragranthamAha- ashitamityAdi| sarvAshrayamiti sarvasharIram||15-19||
athAto janapadoddhvaMsanIyaM vimAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tathA shastraprabhavasyApi janapadoddhvaMsasyAdharma eva heturbhavati| ye~atipravRuddhalobhakrodhamohamAnAste durbalAnavamatyAtmasvajanaparopaghAtAya shastreNa parasparamabhikrAmanti, parAn vA~abhikrAmanti, parairvA~abhikrAmyante||21||

Commentary: shastraprabhavasyApIti bahujanamArakasya shastraprabhavasyetyarthaH| AtmasvajanaparopaghAtAyeti atra AtmanaH svajanasya parasya copaghAto bhavati prAya ityarthaH||21||

rakShogaNAdibhirvA vividhairbhUtasa~gghaistamadharmamanyadvA~apyapacArAntaramupalabhyAbhihanyante||22||

Commentary: rAkShasAdyutsAdo~api janAnAmadharmakRuta eva bhavatItyAha- rakShogaNetyAdi| anyadvA apacArAntaramiti yathoktAdharmakAraNAdanyadadharmakAraNamashaucAdItyarthaH||22||

tathA~abhishApaprabhavasyApyadharma eva heturbhavati| ye luptadharmANo dharmAdapetAste guruvRuddhasiddharShipUjyAnavamatyAhitAnyAcaranti; tatastAH prajA gurvAdibhirabhishaptA bhasmatAmupayAnti prAgevAnekapuruShakulavinAshAya, niyatapratyayopalambhAdaniyatAshcApare ||23||

Commentary: prAgeveti jhaTiti, anekapuruShakulavinAshAyAbhishaptA bhasmatAM yAntItyarthaH| niyatapratyayopalambhAdaniyatAshcApare bhasmatAM yAntIti yojanA| aniyatA amilitA ityarthaH| pratiniyatapuruShAbhishApAt pratiniyatA eva bhasmatAM yAnti, na sarve janA ityarthaH||23||

prAgapi cAdharmAdRute nAshubhotpattiranyato~abhUt| AdikAle hyaditisutasamaujaso~ativimalavipulaprabhAvAH pratyakShadevadevarShidharmayaj~javidhividhAnAH shailasArasaMhatasthirasharIrAH prasannavarNendriyAH pavanasamabalajavaparAkramAshcArusphico~abhirUpapramANAkRutiprasAdopacayavantaH satyArjavAnRushaMsyadAnadamaniyamatapopavAsabrahmacaryavrataparA vyapagatabhayarAgadveShamohalobhakrodhashokamAnaroganidrAtandrAshramaklamAlasyaparigrahAshca puruShA babhUvuramitAyuShaH| teShAmudArasattvaguNakarmaNAmacintyarasavIryavipAkaprabhAvaguNasamuditAni prAdurbabhUvuH shasyAni sarvaguNasamuditatvAt pRuthivyAdInAM kRutayugasyAdau| bhrashyati tu kRutayuge keShA~jcidatyAdAnAt sAmpannikAnAM sattvAnAM sharIragauravamAsIt, sharIragauravAcchramaH, shramAdAlasyam, AlasyAt sa~jcayaH, sa~jcayAt parigrahaH, parigrahAllobhaH prAdurAsIt kRute| tatastretAyAM lobhAdabhidrohaH, abhidrohAnRutavacanam, anRutavacanAt kAmakrodhamAnadveShapAruShyAbhighAtabhayatApashokacintodvegAdayaH pravRuttAH| tatastretAyAM dharmapAdo~antardhAnamagamat| tasyAntardhAnAt yugavarShapramANasya pAdahrAsaH, pRuthivyAdeshca guNapAdapraNAsho~abhUt| tatpraNAshakRutashca shasyAnAM snehavaimalyarasavIryavipAkaprabhAvaguNapAdabhrAMshaH| tatastAni prajAsharIrANi hIyamAnaguNapAdairAhAravihArairayathApUrvamupaShTabhyamAnAnyagnimArutaparItAni prAgvyAdhibhirjvarAdibhirAkrAntAni| ataH prANino hrAsamavApurAyuShaH kramasha iti||24||

Commentary: AdyAvirbhAve ca rogANAmadharma eva kAraNamityAha- prAgapi cetyAdi| yaj~jaH yaj~jadevatA, vidhiH yaj~javidhAyako vedaH, vidhAnaM yaj~jakarma| javaH vegaH| parigrahaH mamatA| amitamivAtibahutvenAyuryeShAM te amitAyuShaH| satye hi caturvarShashatamAyuH; yaduktaM bhagavatA vyAsena- “puruShAH sarvasiddhArthAshcaturvarShashatAyuShaH| kRute” iti| sAmpannikAnAm IshvarANAm| kRute iti kRutayugasya sheShe| hIyamAnaguNapAdairiti yathA yathA tretAyAH kShayo bhavati, tathA tathA AhAravihAraguNapAdahrAso bhavannAsta iti darshayati| vihAro~api cAdharmavatAM hInaguNo bhavati, tena na yathAvaccharIropaShTambhanaM karoti| upaShTabhyamAnAnIti dhAtusAmyena pAlyamAnAni||24||
bhavatashcAtra- yuge yuge dharmapAdaH krameNAnena hIyate| guNapAdashca bhUtAnAmevaM lokaH pralIyate||25||
saMvatsarashate pUrNe yAti saMvatsaraH kShayam| dehinAmAyuShaH kAle yatra yanmAnamiShyate||26||
iti vikArANAM prAgutpattiheturukto bhavati||27||
evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamagnivesha uvAca- kinnu khalu bhagavan! niyatakAlapramANamAyuH sarvaM na veti||28||
taM bhagavAnuvAca- ihAgnivesha! bhUtAnAmAyuryuktimapekShate| daive puruShakAre ca sthitaM hyasya balAbalam||29||
daivamAtmakRutaM vidyAt karma yat paurvadaihikam| smRutaH puruShakArastu kriyate yadihAparam||30||
balAbalavisheSho~asti tayorapi ca karmaNoH| dRuShTaM hi trividhaM karma hInaM madhyamamuttamam||31||
tayorudArayoryuktirdIrghasya ca sukhasya ca| niyatasyAyuSho heturviparItasya cetarA||32||
daivaM puruShakAreNa durbalaM hyupahanyate||33||
daivena cetarat karma vishiShTenopahanyate| dRuShTvA yadeke manyante niyataM mAnamAyuShaH||34||
karma ki~jcit kvacit kAle vipAke niyataM mahat| ki~jcittvakAlaniyataM pratyayaiH pratibodhyate||35||

tasmAdubhayadRuShTatvAdekAntagrahaNamasAdhu| nidarshanamapi cAtrodAhariShyamaH- yadi hi niyatakAlapramANamAyuH sarvaM syAt, tadA~a~ayuShkAmANAM na mantrauShadhimaNima~ggalabalyupahArahomaniyamaprAyashcittopavAsasvastyayanapraNipAtagamanAdyAH kriyA iShTayashca prayojyeran; nodbhrAntacaNDacapalagojoShTrakharaturagamahiShAdayaH pavanAdayashca duShTAH parihAryAH syuH, na prapAtagiriviShamadurgAmbuvegAH, tathA na pramattonmattodbhAntacaNDacapalamohalobhAkulamatayaH, nArayaH, na pravRuddho~agniH, ca vividhaviShAshrayAH sarIsRuporagAdayaH, na sAhasaM, nAdeshakAlacaryA, na narendraprakopa iti; evamAdayo hi bhAvA nAbhAvakarAH syuH, AyuShaH sarvasya niyatakAlapramANatvAt| na cAnabhyastAkAlamaraNabhayanivArakANAmakAlamaraNabhayamAgacchet praNinAM, vyarthAshcArambhakathAprayogabuddhayaH syurmaharShINAM rasAyanAdhikAre, nApIndro niyatAyuShaM shatruM vajreNAbhihanyAt, nAshvinAvArtaM bheShajenopapAdayetAM , na maharShayo yatheShTamAyustapasA prApnuyuH, na ca viditaveditavyA maharShayaH sasureshAH samyak pashyeyurupadisheyurAcareyurvA| api ca sarvacakShuShAmetat paraM yadaindraM cakShuH , idaM cApyasmAkaM tena pratyakShaM; yathA- puruShasahasrANAmutthAyotthAyAhavaM kurvatAmakurvatAM cAtulyAyuShTvaM, tathA jAtamAtrANAmapratIkArAt pratIkArAcca, aviShaviShaprAshinAM cApyatulyAyuShTvameva, na ca tulyo yogakShema udapAnaghaTAnAM citraghaTAnAM cotsIdatAM; tasmAddhitopacAramUlaM jIvitam, ato viparyayAnmRutyuH| api ca deshakAlAtmaguNaviparItAnAM karmaNAmAhAravikArANAM ca kramopayogaH samyak, tyAgaH sarvasya cAtiyogAyogamithyAyogAnAM, sarvAtiyogasandhAraNam , asandhAraNamudIrNAnAM ca gatimatAM, sAhasAnAM ca varjanam, ArogyAnuvRuttau hetumupalabhAmahe samyagupadishAmaH samyak pashyAmashceti||36||

Commentary: ataH paramuttaramupasaMharati - tasmAdityAdi| ubhayadRuShTatvAditi daivasya puruShakAreNa, tathA puruShakArasya daivena bAdhadarshanAt| ekAntagrahaNamiti niyatamevAyuriti tathA aniyatamevAyuH sarvamiti cetyarthaH| nidRushyate~abhimataH pakShaH sAdhyate~aneneti nidarshanaM yuktarityarthaH| atreti anaikAntikapakShe| yadItyAdinA prakaraNenAyurjanakasya dRuShTasya hetoH sevA tathA AyurvighAtakasya hetorasevA sarvaprAmANikajanAvivAdasiddhA darshyate| sA ca sarvA yadi niyatamAyuH syAttadA aki~jcitkarI syAt, aniyate cAyuShi ki~jcitkarI syAt; tasmAdaniyatamapyAyurbhavatIti bhAvaH| na ca sarvatraivAdRuShTameva kAraNaM dRuShTamaki~jcitkarameveti vadato dRuShTasyApi trivRutAdervirekAdikartRutvaM vyaktameva; adRuShTasyaiva tu kAraNatvaM dRuShTekAryAnupapatteH kalpanIyaM; tenAdRuShTasya kAraNatvaM dRuShTakAraNamUlamityarthaH; na ca dRuShTakAraNocchedaH kalpayitumapi pAryate| iShTayaH yaj~jAH| atyarthasarpaNashIlA uragAH sarIsRuporagAH| AcareyurvA ‘bheShajam ’ iti sheShaH| cakShuShAM paramiti atyarthAbhrAntatvena| atulyAyuShTvamiti ye AhavaM kurvate te shastreNa mriyante, ye tu na kurvate te shastreNa na prAyo mriyante| pratIkArAdapratIkArAccAtulyAyuShTvamiti yojanA| na ca tulya ityAdau citraghaTo yashcitrita iva sthApyate, sa hi pAnIyavahanAdipratyavAyahetvabhAvAcciraM tiShThati; udapAnaghaTastu jalasambandhAt tathA vahanasamaye patanAdinA ca shIghramutsIdati| hitopacAramUlamiti hitopacAramUlamapi| kramopayogaH samyagiti yojanA| sarvAtiyogasandhAraNaM sarvAtiyogAnAM varjanam||36||

ataH paramagnivesha uvAca- evaM satyaniyatakAlapramANAyuShAM bhagavan! kathaM kAlamRutyurakAlamRutyurvAbhavatIti||37||

Commentary: evaM satItyAdi| yattAvat kAlaniyataM tasyAkAle maraNAbhAvAdeva nAkAlamRutyurasti, yattvakAlaniyataM tasyApyaniyatatvAt kathaM kAlamRutyurakAlamRutyurvA bhavati? aniyate hyAyuShi kAlaniyamo nAsti, niyatakAlAccArvAgakAlamRutyurucyata iti pRucchArthaH||37||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- shrUyatAmagnivesha! yathA yAnasamAyukto~akShaH prakRutyaivAkShaguNairupetaH sa ca sarvaguNopapanno vAhyamAno yathAkAlaM svapramANakShayAdevAvasAnaM gacchet, tathA~a~ayuH sharIropagataM balavatprakRutyA yathAvadupacaryamANaM svapramANakShayAdevAvasAnaM gacchati; sa mRutyuH kAle| yathA ca sa evAkSho~atibhArAdhiShThitatvAdviShamapathAdapathAdakShacakrabha~ggAdvAhyavAhakadoShAdaNimokShAdanupA~ggAt paryasanAccAntarA~avasAnamApadyate, tathA~a~ayurapyayathAbalamArambhAdayathAgnyabhyavaharaNAdviShamAbhyAvaharaNAdviShamasharIranyAsAdatimaithunAdasatsaMshrayAdudIrNa- vegavinigrahAdvidhAryavegAvidhAraNAdbhUtaviShavAyvagnyupatApAdabhighAtAdAhArapratIkAravivarjanAccAntarA~avasAnamApadyate, sa mRutyurakAle; tathA jvarAdInapyAta~gkAnmithyopacaritAnakAlamRutyUn pashyAma iti||38||

Commentary: yathAkAlamiti yAvatA kAlena pratyavAyashUnyasyAkShasya kShayo bhavati tasminnevetyarthaH| svapramANakShayAdeveti yugAnurUpavarShashatAdipramANakShayAdityarthaH| apathAditi sarvathA amArgagamanAt| aNimokShAditi kIlamokShAt| anupA~ggAditi snehAdAnAt| paryasanAt parikShepAt| mithyopacaritAniti asamyakcikitsatAn| akAlamRutyUniti akAlamRutyukarAn||38||

athAgniveshaH papraccha- kinnu khalu bhagavan! jvaritebhyaH pAnIyamuShNaM prayacchanti bhiShajo bhUyiShThaM na tathA shItam, asti ca shItasAdhyo~api dhAturjvarakara iti||39||

Commentary: samprati mithyopacArashrutyA uShNatoyaM jvare~apyAgneye mithyopacAraH syAdityAsha~gkyAha- kinnvityAdi| shItasAdhyo~apidhAtuH pittamuShNarUpamityarthaH| pAnIyaM yasmAt sarvajvaritebhyo dIyate, tasmAt pAnIyamevAtra pRucchati||39||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- jvaritasya kAyasamutthAnadeshakAlAnabhisamIkShya pAcanArthaM pAnIyamuShNaM prayacchanti bhiShajaH| jvaro hyAmAshayasamutthaH, prAyo bheShajAni cAmAshayasamutthAnAM vikArANAM pAcanavamanApatarpaNasamarthAni bhavanti; pAcanArthaM ca pAnIyamuShNaM, tasmAdetajjvaritebhyaH prayacchanti bhiShajo bhUyiShTham| taddhi teShAM pItaM vAtamanulomayati, agniM codaryamudIrayati, kShipraM jarAM gacchati, shleShmANaM parishoShayati, svalpamapi ca pItaM tRuShNAprashamanAyopakalpate; tathAyuktamapi caitannAtyarthotsannapitte jvare sadAhabhramapralApAtisAre vA pradeyam, uShNena hi dAhabhramapralApAtisArA  bhUyo~abhivardhante, shItena copashAmyantIti||40||

Commentary: utsannapitte pravRuddhapitte||40||

bhavati cAtra- shItenoShNakRutAn rogA~jchamayanti bhiShagvidaH| ye tu shItakRutA rogAsteShAmuShNaM bhiShagjitam||41||

Commentary: na kevalaM jvare eva shItoShNasamutthatvabhedena uShNashItopacAraH, kintu sarvatraiva vyAdhAvevamityAha- shItenetyAdi| bhiShajashca te j~jAnavantashceti bhiShagvidaH||41||
evamitareShAmapi vyAdhInAM nidAnaviparItaM bheShajaM bhavati; yathA- apatarpaNanimittAnAM vyAdhInAM nAntareNa pUraNamasti shAntiH, tathA pUraNanimittAnAM vyAdhInAM nAntareNApatarpaNam||42||
apatarpaNamapi ca trividhaM- la~gghanaM, la~gghanapAcanaM, doShAvasecanaM ceti||43||

tatra la~gghanamalpabaladoShANAM , la~gghanena hyagnimArutavRuddhyA vAtAtapaparItamivAlpamudakamalpo doShaH prashoShamApadyate; la~gghanapAcane tu madhyabaladoShANAM, la~gghanapAcanAbhyAM hi sUryasantApamArutAbhyAM pAMshubhasmAvakiraNairiva cAnatibahUdakaM madhyabalo doShaH prashoShamApadyate; bahudoShANAM punardoShAvasecanameva kAryaM, na hyabhinne kedArasetau palvalApraseko~asti, tadvaddoShAvasecanam||44||

janapadamaNDale pa~jcAlakShetre dvijAtivarAdhyuShite kAmpilyarAjadhAnyAM bhagavAn punarvasurAtreyo~antevAsigaNaparivRutaH pashcime gharmamAse ga~ggAtIre vanavicAramanuvicara~jchiShyamagniveshamabravIt||3||

Commentary: janapadavasatyupalakShitaM maNDalaM janapadamaNDalaM, ‘pa~jcAlakShetre’ iti tasya visheShaNam| dvijAtivarAdhyuShita iti vacanena mahAjanasevite~api deshe~adharmavashAjjanapadoddhvaMso vakShyamANo bhavatIti darshayati| pashcime gharmamAsa iti jyeShThe| vanavicAramanuvicaranniti vanaM vicarya vicaryAnuvicarannityarthaH||3||

dRushyante hi khalu saumya! nakShatragrahagaNacandrasUryAnilAnalAnAM dishAM cAprakRutibhUtAnAmRutuvaikArikA bhAvAH, acirAdito bhUrapi ca na yathAvadrasavIryavipAkaprabhAvamoShadhInAM pratividhAsyati, tadviyogAccAta~gkaprAyatA niyatA| tasmAt prAguddhvaMsAt prAk ca bhUmervirasIbhAvAduddharadhvaM saumya! bhaiShajyAni yAvannopahatarasavIryavipAkaprabhAvANi bhavanti| vayaM caiShAM rasavIryavipAkaprabhAvAnupayokShyAmahe ye cAsmAnanukA~gkShanti, yAMshca vayamanukA~gkShAmaH| na hi samyaguddhRuteShu saumya! bhaiShajyeShu samyagvihiteShu samyak cAvacAriteShu janapadoddhvaMsakarANAM vikArANAM ki~jcit pratIkAragauravaM bhavati||4||

Commentary: RutuvikArAya bhUtA RutuvaikArikAH; RutuvikArashcopalakShaNaM, tena jaladeshavAtavikArAya bhUtA iti mantavyaM; yato bhUmyAdInAmapi vikRutiM vakShyati| kiMvA RutvananurUpA RutuvaikArikAH; tena, RutvananurUpalakShaNameva nakShatrAdInAM vikRutirityuktaM bhavati; grIShme hi nakShatrANi nirmalAni bhavanti, tAni yadi tuShAracchannAni grIShme bhavanti, tadA vikRutAni bhavantIti boddhavyam| bhUrapi cetyapivacanAjjalAnilau ca grAhayati; tena, bhUstAvadoShadhInAM pradhAnaM kAraNaM, sA rasAdInna pratividhAsyati; jalavAtAvapi cauShadhInAM rasAdInna pratividhAsyata ityuktaM bhavati| pratividhAsyatIti janayiShyati| uddharadhvamiti bahuvacanaM bahvantevAsiyuktAgniveshAbhiprAyeNa; agniveshastu pradhAnatvenaika eveti ‘agnivesha’ itipadena tathA ‘saumya’ itipadena sambodhyate; bheShajoddharaNaM tu bahubhireva kartavyamityabhiprAyeNa bahuvacanam| bhavati hi pradhAnaM sambodhya gaNasampAdyakriyAyAM bahuvacanaM; yathA- senApate yudhyadhvamiti| anye tu saumyapadaM bheShajavisheShaNaM kurvanti| ye cAsmAnanukA~gkShanti ye cAsmAn bhiShajo~anukA~gkShantItyarthaH, yAMshca vayamanukA~gkShAmashcikitsyatvena| etena, ye vaidyamanukA~gkShanti te vaidyapriyatvena sAdhyAH, asAdhyA hi vaidyadviSha uktAH; vaidyAshca yAnicchanti te sAdhyarogA eva, asAdhyAn hi vaidyA necchanti| etenAnyeShAmapi yeShAM bheShajasAdhyA rogAste AsAmoShadhInAM rasAdInupayokShyantItyarthaH| yadi ca ye asmadgatAH, yAMshca vayaM  prayojanavashAdanugatAH, te upayokShyantIti vyAkhyAyate, tadA Atreyasya pakSharAgitvenAptatvaM na sambhavati, “sarvaprajAnAM pitRuvaccharaNyaH” (ci.a.5) iti vacanAccAsya nIrAgatvamuktam||4||

evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- uddhRutAni khalu bhagavan! bhaiShajyAni, samyagvihitAni, samyagavacAritAni ca; api tu khalu janapadoddhvaMsanamekenaiva vyAdhinA yugapadasamAnaprakRutyAhAradehabalasAtmyasattvavayasAM manuShyANAM kasmAdbhavatIti||5||

Commentary: udddhRutAnIti vacanamabhUte bhUtavacceti prayogAdboddhavyaM, yathA- acirakartavye kRutamiti vadanti; na hi vacanakAla eva oShadhInAmuddharaNaM sambhavatIti| ekeneti ekajAtIyena| asamAnaprakRutyAdInAM samAnakAraNAbhAvAnna tulyarUpo vyAdhirbhavitumarhatIti prashnArthaH||5||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- evamasAmAnyAvatAmapyebhiragnivesha! prakRutyAdibhirbhAvairmanuShyANAM ye~anye bhAvAH sAmAnyAstadvaiguNyAt samAnakAlAH samAnali~ggAshca vyAdhayo~abhinirvartamAnA janapadamuddhvaMsayanti| te tu khalvime bhAvAH sAmAnyA janapadeShu bhavanti; tadyathA- vAyuH, udakaM, deshaH, kAla iti||6||

Commentary: samAnali~ggA iti tulyali~ggAH||6||

tatra vAtamevaMvidhamanArogyakaraM vidyAt; tadyathA-yathartuviShamamatistimitamaticalamatiparuShamatishItamatyuShNamatirUkShamatyabhiShyandinamatibhairavArAvamatipratihata- parasparagatimatikuNDalinamasAtmyagandhabAShpasikatApAMshudhUmopahatamiti (1); udakaM tu khalvatyarthavikRutagandhavarNarasasparshaM kledabahulamapakrAntajalacaraviha~ggamupakShINajaleshayamaprItikaramapagataguNaM vidyAt (2); deshaM punaH prakRutivikRutavarNagandharasasparshaM kledabahulamupasRuShTaM sarIsRupavyAlamashakashalabhamakShikAmUShakolUkashmAshAnikashakunijambUkAdibhistRuNolUpopavanavantaM pratAnAdibahulamapUrvavadavapatitashuShkanaShTashasyaM dhUmrapavanaM pradhmAtapatatrigaNamutkruShTashvagaNamudbhrAntavyathitavividhamRugapakShisa~gghamutsRuShTanaShTadharmasatyalajjAcArashIlaguNajanapadaM shashvatkShubhitodIrNasalilAshayaM pratatolkApAtanirghAtabhUmikampamatibhayArAvarUpaM rUkShatAmrAruNasitAbhrajAlasaMvRutArkacandratArakamabhIkShNaM sasambhramodvegamiva satrAsaruditamiva satamaskamiva guhyakAcaritamivAkranditashabdabahulaM cAhitaM vidyAt (3); kAlaM tu khalu yathartuli~ggAdviparItali~ggamatili~ggaM hInali~ggaM cAhitaM vyavasyet (4); imAnevandoShayuktAMshcaturo bhAvA~jjanapadoddhvaMsakarAn vadanti kushalAH; ato~anyathAbhUtAMstu hitAnAcakShate||7||
viguNeShvapi khalveteShu janapadoddhvaMsakareShu bhAveShu bheShajenopapAdyamAnAnAmabhayaM bhavati rogebhya iti||8||
bhavanti cAtra- vaiguNyamupapannAnAM deshakAlAnilAmbhasAm| garIyastvaM visheSheNa hetumat sampravakShyate||9||
vAtAjjalaM jalAddeshaM deshAt kAlaM svabhAvataH| vidyAdduShparihAryatvAdgarIyastaramarthavit ||10||
vAyvAdiShu yathoktAnAM doShANAM tu visheShavit| pratIkArasya saukarye vidyAllAghavalakShaNam||11||
caturShvapi tu duShTeShu kAlAnteShu yadA narAH| bheShajenopapAdyante na bhavantyAturAstadA||12||
yeShAM na mRutyusAmAnyaM sAmAnyaM na ca karmaNAm| karma pa~jcavidhaM teShAM bheShajaM paramucyate||13||
rasAyanAnAM vidhivaccopayogaH prashasyate| shasyate dehavRuttishca bheShajaiH pUrvamuddhRutaiH||14||
satyaM bhUte dayA dAnaM balayo devatArcanam| saddhRuttasyAnuvRuttishca prashamo guptirAtmanaH||15||
hitaM janapadAnAM ca shivAnAmupasevanam| sevanaM brahmacaryasya tathaiva brahmacAriNAm||16||
sa~gkathA dharmashAstrANAM maharShINAM jitAtmanAm| dhArmikaiH sAttvikairnityaM sahAsyA vRuddhasammataiH||17||
ityetadbheShajaM proktamAyuShaH paripAlanam| yeShAmaniyato mRutyustasmin kAle sudAruNe||18||
iti shrutvA janapadoddhvaMsane kAraNAni punarapi bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- atha khalu bhagavan! kutomUlameShAM vAyvAdInAM vaiguNyamutpadyate? yenopapannA janapadamuddhvaMsayantIti||19||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- sarveShAmapyagnivesha! vAyvAdInAM yadvaiguNyamutpadyate tasya mUlamadharmaH, tanmUlaM vA~asatkarma pUrvakRutaM; tayoryoniH praj~jAparAdha eva| tadyathA- yadA vai deshanagaranigamajanapadapradhAnA dharmamutkramyAdharmeNa prajAM vartayanti, tadAshritopAshritAH paurajanapadA vyavahAropajIvinashca tamadharmamabhivardhayanti, tataH so~adharmaH prasabhaM dharmamantardhatte, tataste~antarhitadharmANo devatAbhirapi tyajyante; teShAM tathA~antarhitadharmaNAmadharmapradhAnAnAmapakrAntadevatAnAmRutavo vyApadyante; tena nApo yathAkAlaM devo varShati na vA varShati vikRutaM vA varShati, vAtA na samyagabhivAnti, kShitirvyApadyate, salilAnyupashuShyanti, oShadhayaH svabhAvaM parihAyApadyante vikRutiM; tata uddhvaMsante janapadAH spRushyAbhyavahAryadoShAt ||20||

doShAvasecanamanyadvA bheShajaM prAptakAlamapyAturasya naivaMvidhasya kuryAt| tadyathA- anapavAdapratIkArasyAdhanasyAparicArakasya vaidyamAninashcaNDasyAsUyakasya tIvrAdharmAruceratikShINabalamAMsashoNitasyAsAdhyarogopahatasya mumUrShuli~ggAnvitasya ceti| evaMvidhaM hyAturamupacaran bhiShak pApIyasA~ayashasA yogamRucchatIti||45||

Commentary: anapavAdapratIkAro vAcyapratIkAraH| adhanasyAnupakaraNatvena na cikitsA pAryate kartumityarthaH| vaidyamAnI durabhimAnAdvaidyopadeshaM na karoti| tIvrAdharmaruceH pratikriyAyAmadharmo bhavati, na ca cikitsA sidhyatyadharmapratibandhAt| mumUrShuli~ggAnvitasyeti riShTayuktasya| pApIyaseti pApahetunA pApajanakenAyashasA||45||
bhavati cAtra- tadAtve cAnubandhe vA yasya syAdashubhaM phalam| karmaNastanna kartavyametadbuddhimatAM matam||46||
(alpodakadrumo yastu pravAtaH pracurAtapaH| j~jeyaH sa jA~ggalo deshaH svalparogatamo~api ca||47||
pracurodakavRukSho yo nivAto durlabhAtapaH| anUpo bahudoShashca, samaH sAdhAraNo mataH)||48||
tatra shlokAH- pUrvarUpANi sAmAnyA hetavaH sasvalakShaNAH| deshoddhvaMsasya bhaiShajyaM hetUnAM mUlameva ca||49||
prAgvikArasamutpattirAyuShashca kShayakramaH| maraNaM prati bhUtAnAM kAlAkAlavinishcayaH||50||
yathA cAkAlamaraNaM yathAyuktaM ca bheShajam| siddhiM yAtyauShadhaM yeShAM na kuryAdyena hetunA||51||
tadAtreyo~agniveshAya nikhilaM sarvamuktavAn| deshoddhvaMsanimittIye vimAne munisattamaH||52||

dvividho heturvyAdhijanakaH prANinAM bhavati- sAdhAraNaH, asAdhAraNashca; tatrAsAdhAraNaM pratipuruShaniyataM vAtAdijanakamAhArAdyabhidhAya bahujanasAdhAraNaM vAtajaladeshakAlarUpaM sAdhAraNarogakAraNamabhidhAtuM janapadoddhvaMsanIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

saMvatsarashate pUrNa iti saMvatsareNa shatatameM~ashe pUrNe| yatra yanmAnamiShyata iti yatra yuge yanmAnamiShyate, tasya shatatameM~ashe pUrNe varSha ekaH kShayaM yAti| tena, kalau shatavarShAyuShi yadA shatatamoM~asho yAti kShayaM tadA navanavatiH paramAyurbhavatItyAdyanusaraNIyam||25-27||

yuktimapekShata iti daivapuruShakArayoryogamapekShate niyatatve~aniyatatve cetyarthaH| balaM cAbalaM ca balAbalaM; tatrAyuSho niyatatvena balam, aniyatatvenAbalaM j~jeyam| yadyapi paurvadaihikaM karmAsthiratvena gataM, tathA~api tajjanitAdRuShTasya vidyamAnatvAt taddvArA tatkarma kAraNaM bhavatyeveha janmanyapi| puruShakArastviha janmani kRutaM karma sAmAnyenocyate| tatra balima~ggalAdi adRuShTajananatvAd vyApriyate, tathA bheShajAdi rasarudhirAdidvArA ||28-32||-

udArayoriti prashastatvenottamayoH| dIrghasyeti rasAyanAdinA shatAdapi dIrghasya; sukhasyeti nIrogatvena; niyatasyeti yuganiyatasya, kalau varShashatapramANasyetyarthaH; shatAdarvA~ganiniyatamapIha niyatashabdenocyate; tena na tatra tasya daivapuruShakArajanyatvaM ghaTate, tathA~api tasyAprashastadaivapuruShakArajanyatvAt daivapuruShakArajanyatvaM bhavatIti yuktaM; ki~jcAniyatAyuSha eva puruShA rasAyanAdhikAriNo bhavanti, niyatAyuShaM prati rasAyanasyAki~jcitkaratvAt; rasAyanAdikRutaM cAyuraniyataM prashastatvena prashastadaivapuruShakArajanyaM bhavatIti yuktam| kiMvA, dIrghatve sati niyatasyAyuSho heturiti yojanA; tena yuganiyataM ca shatavarShaM, tathA tadadhikaM cAniyataM mahatA karmaNaiva kriyate; puruShakAreNa tu mahatA~asya sukhitvaM rogAnupaghAtAt kriyate; rasAyanena ca jarAdivyAdhipratighAtaH kriyate; rasAyanalabhyamapyAyurbalavatkarmaniyatameveti bhAvaH| viparItasya dIrghatvenAniyatasya tathA rogayuktatvenAsukhasya| itareti hInayorddaivapuruShakArayoryuktirityarthaH| madhyamAmadhyamasya dIrghatvenAdIrghatvenAniyatasya, tathA sukhAsukhatvenAniyatasyAyuSho madhyamayoH karmaNoryuktirityarthaH| kAraNamiti daivapuruShakArayoH parasparabAdhane upapattimityarthaH| daivamityAdi| durbalamAyurjananaM daivaM balavatA mArakeNa dRuShTApathyabhojanAdinA viparItamaraNakAryajananAdupahanyate; vishiShTena balavatA, itarat karma dRuShTaM puruShakArAkhyam, upahanyate parAbhUyate| etaddaivakartRukadRuShTaparAbhavadarshanAddaivaniyatameva sarvamAyuriti kecinmanyanta ityAha - dRuShTvetyAdi| yadi dRuShTamAyuH kAraNaM syAt, na tadA bheShajaiH samyagupapAditAnAM mRutyuH syAt; yatashca satyapi cikitsite karmavashAttu mRutyurbhavati; tena, yatrApi cikitsA jIvayatIti manyante, tatrApi karmaivAsti jIvanakAraNamiti dRuShTashaktitvAdavadhArayAma iti bhAvaH| daivapuruShakArayorubhayorapi bAdhyatvaM darshayannekAntena niyatAyuHpakShaM vyudasyati- karmetyAdi| na kvacit karma na bhavati; yaducyate- “nAbhuktaM kShIyate karma kalpakoTishatairapi| avashyameva bhoktavyaM kRutaM karma shubhAshubham” iti| ki~jcittvakAlaniyatamiti, yathA- idaM mArakaM karma na tu kvacitkAle pa~jcaviMshavarShAdau niyataM, tena yasmin kAle puruShakArAkhyaM dRuShTakarmAnuguNaM prApnoti tasmin kAle sahakArisAnnidhyopabRuMhitabalaM mArayati, yadA tu dRuShTamapathyasevAdi na prApnoti na tadA mArayati, pratyayaiH pratibodhyata iti dRuShTakAraNairudriktaM kriyate| ye tu bruvate- ki~jcit karma kAlaniyataM yadA pacyate, tasmin kAle pacyata eveti kAlaniyamaH; vipAkaniyataM tu- idaM karma vipacyata eva, na tu vipacyata iti na; kAlavipAkaniyataM tu yathA- idaM karma asminneva kAle vipacyata eveti; etacca kAlavipAkaniyatatvAdbalavaducyate; etadeva dRuShTAbAdhanIyamiti; teShAM mate, abhuktamapi kShIyate durbalakarma prAyashcittAdineti boddhavyaM, paraM viparyaye~api tadA ki~jcittvavipAkakAlaniyatamiti vaktavyaM syAt; ki~jcittvakAlaniyatamiti vacanAttu kAlaniyatamapi||33-35||

na kevalaM shItoShNasamutthayoreva paraM hetuviparyayeNa cikitsA, kintvapatarpaNAdije~api hetuviparItenetyAha- evamityAdi| apatarpaNasantarpaNAbhyAM ca sarvaM cikitsitaM gRuhItaM, na hyapatarpaNasantarpaNAbhyAM vinA~anyadvidhAnAntaramasti cikitsAyAH; yena sarva evopakramAH santarpaNApatarpaNabhedA eva| ata eva visheShaj~jAnArthamapatarpaNabhedAnAha- apatarpaNamityAdi| la~gghanapAcanamitivacanena yatra pAcanaM kriyate tatrAvashyaM stokamAtrayA la~gghanamapikriyata iti darshayati, pAcanakAle hi yadi bRuMhaNaM kriyate tadA bRuMhaNenAgneH pratikUlena pAcanaM na syAdityarthaH| avakiraNairivetyatra ivashabdo~anatibahUdakamivetyevaMrUpo j~jeyaH| anyadveti la~gghanAdi bRuMhaNAdi ca||42-44||

yathartuviShamamiti RutvananurUpam| apagataguNamiti jIvanapipAsAharatvAdyuktajalaguNarahitam| prakRutivarNAdervikRutA varNAdayo yasya deshasya taM prakRutivikRutavarNagandharasasparsham| shmAshAnikashakuniH gRudhraH| apUrvavaditi paricitamapyupahatatvenApUrvamiva dRushyate| utsRuShTAshca naShTAshca dharmasatyalajjAguNA janairyatra sa tathA; tatra ye dharmAdiyuktAste utsRujanti dharmAdIni, ye tu dharmAdIni sarvathA aj~jAnAnnAcaranti tAn prati naShTAnyeva dharmAdIni| guhyakAkrAnto hi desho yathA Akrandanashabdabahulo bhavati tAdRusham||7-8||

vaiguNyamityAdinA duShTAnAM vAtAdInAM yasya ya utkarSho yena ca hetunA tadAha| svabhAvato duShparihAryatvAditi svabhAvAdeva vAtApekShayA jalaM duShpariharaM bhavati, jalAcca deshaH, deshAcca kAlaH| vAto hi nivAtadeshasevayA duShTaH parihriyate, na tathA jalaM, taddhi dehavRuttyarthamavashyaM sevyaM; jalamapi ca yadi mahatA prayatnena tyajyate, deshastu jalApekShayA duShpariharo bhavati, tadvyatirekeNAvasthAtumashakyatvAt; desho~api yadi deshAntaragamanena tyajyate, kAlastu sarvathA tyaktumashakya iti sarveShveva garIyAn| ‘garIyaH param’ iti pAThe yadyataH paraM, tattato garIyo vidyAditi yojanA| etadviparyayeNa lAghavamAha- vAyvAdiShvityAdi| pratIkArasya saukarya iti yathoktavidhayA vAtAdiparityAgasya sukaratvenetyarthaH||9-11||

yeShAM na mRutyusAmAnyamiti na mRutyujanakadaivasAmyaM yeShAmastItyarthaH| sAmAnyaM na ca karmaNAmiti naca mArakakarmasAmAnyaM yeShAmastItyarthaH| keciddhi sambhUyaiva janmAntare grAmadAhAdikarma kurvate sma, tatkarmabalAt saMhatamRutyava eva bhavanti; kiMvA pRuthagapi mArakaM karma kRutaM keShA~jcidekakAlaM vipacyamAnaM bhavati, te~api samakAlabhRutyavo bhavanti| tatra, na mRutyusAmAnyamityanenotpannariShTatvAdeva kecidasAdhyA iti darshayati, na karmasAmAnyamityanena keciccAjAtariShTA api niyatamArakakarmavashAdasAdhyA bhavantIti darshayati; kiMvA na mRutyusAmAnyamityanena ca mArako vyAdhiH sAdhAraNa ucyate, na karmasAmAnyamityanena ca mArakavyAdhijanakaM karmocyate| pUrvamuddhRutairiti vyApatteH pUrvaM gRuhItaiH| guptiH mantrAdinA rakShA| aniyata iti vacanena durbalakarmArabdho hi mRutyuH pAryata evaivaM pratikartumiti darshayati||12-18||

kutomUlaM kimmUlamityarthaH| tasya mUlamadharma iti aihikamadharmaM darshayati| tanmUlaM veti tasya vAtAdivaiguNyasya mUlaM pUrvakRutaM vA karma| tenaihiko vA~adharmo janmAntarakRuto vA~adharmo vAtAdivaiguNyasya kAraNamiti brUte| tadyadA deshetyAdinA tvaihikamevAdharmaM yadvakShyati hetutayA tat pratyakShatvena sphuTasiddhAntArthaM, natu janmAntarakRutAdharmasyAkAraNatveneti j~jeyam| tayoriti aihikajanmAntarIyayoradharmayoH| yoniriti kAraNam| spRushyAbhyavahAryadoShAditi spRushyasya vA jalAderabhyavahAryasya ca kRutsnasya duShTatvAt| etacca prAdhAnyena j~jeyaM; tena duShTapavanagandhadoSho~api j~jeyaH, asAtmyagandho~api duShTavAte uktaH||19-20||
anubandhe veti uttarakAlam| kecidalpodakadrumo yastvityAdigranthaM jA~ggalAdideshalakShaNamatra paThanti||46-48||

sa~ggrahe pUrvarUpANIti nakShatrAdivikArAH| sasvalakShaNAH sasvavikRutilakShaNAH, tacca lakShaNaM tatra vAtamevaMvidhamityAdinA proktam| yathAyuktaM ca bheShajaM siddhiM yAtIti anenoShNapAnIyadAnopapattyA sarvaM sa~ggRuhItam||49-52||
athAtastrividharogavisheShavij~jAnIyaM vimAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

trividhaM khalu rogavisheShavij~jAnaM bhavati; tadyathA AptopadeshaH, pratyakSham, anumAnaM ceti||3||

Commentary: rogANAM visheSho yathA vakShyamANo vij~jAyate yena tadrogavisheShavij~jAnam, upadeshapratyakShAnumAnarUpaM pramANatrayam| atra tu yukteranumAnAntargatatvAdeva na pRuthakkaraNam| etacca pramANatrayaM kvacidroge militaM, kvaciddvayaM, kvacidekaM parIkShAyAM vartate; yena, nAntare vahnimAndyAdau pratyakShamavashyaM vyApriyate||3||

tatrAptopadesho nAmAptavacanam| AptA hyavitarkasmRutivibhAgavido niShprItyupatApadarshinashca| teShAmeva~gguNayogAdyadvacanaM tat pramANam| apramANaM punarmattonmattamUrkharaktaduShTAduShTavacanamiti ; pratyakShaM tu khalu tadyat svayamindriyairmanasA copalabhyate| anumAnaM khalu tarko yuktyapekShaH||4||

Commentary: tisraiShaNIye prathamamanumAnAdilakShaNAnyuktAni, punariha ‘tatropadesho nAma’ ityAdinA~a~aptopadeshAdilakShaNAbhidhAnaM prakaraNAgatatvAt kriyate, prAkaraNiko hyartho~anucyamAno nyUno bhavati| avitarketyAdi|- vitarkaH kathantA anishcitaj~jAnamiti yAvat, smRutiH smaraNaj~jAnaM, vibhAga ekadeshaH; etadviparyayAnnishcayenAnubhavena ca kArtsnyena ca ye bhAvAn jAnate, te~avitarkasmRutivibhAgavidaH| vitarkAdivedI tu nAptaH, pratipAdyavastvasheShavisheShAvij~jAnAt| smRutij~jAnaM ca yadyapi pramANamUlameva, tathA~api vartamAnakShaNe smRutij~jAnaviShayArthasya nAvashyavidyamAnateti na tat pramANamiti bhAvaH; kiMvA, smRutij~jAnaM smRutishAstrajaM j~jAnaM gaNitaj~jAnaM ca; etacca j~jAnadvayaM sAkShAdarthAdarshakaM duravabodhena mithyAj~jAnatvasambhavAdapramANamapIti nopAdeyam| atha samyagj~jAnavanto~api rAgAdivashAdanyathA vyAharantItyAha- niShprItyupatApadarshina iti|- niShprItyA nirupatApena ca draShTuM shIlaM yeShAM te tathA| etena yathArthadarshI nirdoShashcApto bhavatItyuktaM bhavati| evambhUtaM cAptatvaM kasyacidbrahmAdeH sarvatraiva bhavati, laukikasya tu yasminneva viShaye vitarkAdi na bhavati tatraivopadeshaH pramANamiti j~jeyam| apramANamiti nAvashyaM pramANatayA~avadhAryate, rAgAdiduShTatvAdityarthaH| duShTashcAsAvaduShTashceti duShTAduShTaH, tena pitA hi putrasya duShTo~apyaduShTatvAdApta eva bhavati; kiMvA duShTo va~jcakaH| svayamindriyairmanasA cetyanena yadAtmanendriyaishcakShurAdibhiravyavadhAnena gRuhyate rUpAdi tat pratyakShamiti bAhyaM pratyakShaM gRuhNAti; manasA cetyanena ca manasA~avyavadhAnena yadupalabhyate sukhAdi, tacca mAnasaM pratyakShaM gRuhNAti| tarko~atrApratyakShaM j~jAnam| yuktiH sambandho~avinAbhAva ityarthaH; tenAvinAbhAvajaM parokShaj~jAnamanumAnamityarthaH||4||

trividhena khalvanena j~jAnasamudAyena pUrvaM parIkShya rogaM sarvathA sarvamathottarakAlamadhyavasAnamadoShaM bhavati, na hi j~jAnAvayavena kRutsne j~jeye j~jAnamutpadyate| trividhe tvasmin j~jAnasamudaye pUrvamAptopadeshAjj~jAnaM, tataH pratyakShAnumAnAbhyAM parIkShopapadyate| kiM hyanupadiShTaM pUrvaM yattat pratyakShAnumAnAbhyAM parIkShamANo vidyAt| tasmAddvividhA parIkShA j~jAnavatAM pratyakSham, anumAnaM ca; trividhA vA sahopadeshena||5||

Commentary: j~jAnasamudAyeneti j~jAnasamudAyaH pramANasa~gghAtaH; tena samudAyena ‘ayamevaM rogaH’ ityevambhUtanishcayo~adhyavasAnam| trividhe tvityAdi| j~jAyate~aneneti j~jAnaM pramANam| prathamAptopadesho vyAdhiM bodhayati, tatashcAptopadiShTaM vyAdhiM pratyakShAnumAnAbhyAM yathoktali~ggAdiparIkShayA nishcinoti; AgamAnupadiShTe ca vyAdhau avaidya iva na pratyakSheNAnumAnena ca vyAdhimupalabhata ityAha- kiM hyanupadiShTamityAdi| evaM manyate- vyAdhivisheShAstAvadduradhigamanIyAH, nopadeshamantareNa shakyA vij~jAtuM, ye~adhigatavaidyakashAstrAste pratipAdayantyeva vyAdhivisheShAn; tasmAdAgamena ye vyAdhInAM hetvAdivisheShAH pratipAditAstAn pratyakShAnumAnAbhyAmupalabhamAno vyAdhiM nishcinoti; anupadeshavAMstAnupalabhamAno~api hetvAdivisheShAnashikShitaratnaparIkSho yathA ratnAnAM visheShaM pashyannapi nAvadhArayati ratnavisheShaM, tathA nAvadhArayati vyAdhivisheShamiti bhAvaH| j~jAnavatAmiti AptopadeshavatAm| trividhA vetyanena vyAdhiparIkShAsamaye hyAptopadesho~api vyApriyate grahaNImArdavasvapnadarshanAdipratipattau, tathA duradhigamasthAnasaMshrayAdipratipattau, tathA koShThamRududAruNatvAdiparIkShAyAM cAturavacanarUpAptopadesho~api vyApriyata iti darshayati||5||

tatredamupadishanti buddhimantaH- rogamekaikamevamprakopaNamevaMyonimevamutthAnamevamAtmAnamevamadhiShThAnamevaMvedanamevaM saMsthAnamevaMshabdasparsharUparasagandhamevamupadravamevaMvRuddhisthAnakShayasamanvitamevamudarka mevannAmAnamevaMyogaM vidyAt; tasminniyaM pratIkArArthA pravRuttirathavA nivRuttirityupadeshAjj~jAyate||6||

Commentary: tatretyAdinA~a~aptopadeshagamyamAha| prakopaNaM vAyo rUkShatvAdihetuH| yoniH vAtAdayaH| AtmA svabhAvaH; yathA- rohiNyA dAruNatvaM, sannyAsasya shIghropakramaNIyatvAdi| adhiShThAnaM sharIramavayavA manashca| iyaM pratIkArArthA pravRuttiH, yathA- jvare la~gghanapAcanAdyarthA pravRuttiH| nivRuttishca pratIkArArthA yathA- navajvare divAsvapnasnAnAdau nivRuttirityAdi mantavyam||6||

pratyakShatastu khalu rogatattvaM bubhutsuH sarvairindriyaiH sarvAnindriyArthAnAturasharIragatAn parIkSheta, anyatra rasaj~jAnAt; tadyathA- antrakUjanaM, sandhisphuTanama~ggulIparvaNAM ca, svaravisheShAMshca, ye cAnye~api keciccharIropagatAH shabdAH syustA~jchrotreNa parIkSheta; varNasaMsthAnapramANacchAyAH , sharIraprakRutivikArau, cakShurvaiShayikANi yAni cAnyAnyanuktAni tAni cakShuShA parIkSheta; rasaM tu khalvAturasharIragatamindriyavaiShayikamapyanumAnAdavagacchet, na hyasya pratyakSheNa grahaNamupapadyate, tasmAdAturapariprashnenaivAturamukharasaM vidyAt, yUkApasarpaNena tvasya sharIravairasyaM, makShikopasarpaNena sharIramAdhuryaM, lohitapittasandehe tu kiM dhArilohitaM lohitapittaM veti shvakAkabhakShaNAddhArilohitamabhakShaNAllohitapittamityanumAtavyam, evamanyAnapyAturasharIragatAn rasAnanumimIta; gandhAMstu khalu sarvasharIragatAnAturasya prakRutivaikArikAn ghrANena parIkSheta; sparshaM ca pANinA prakRutivikRutiyuktam| iti pratyakShato~anumAnAdupadeshatashca parIkShaNamuktam||7||

Commentary: a~ggulIparvaNAM ca sphuTanamiti sambandhaH| anye~api ceti kAsahikkAshabdAdayaH| yAni cAnyAnItyanena lakShaNaprabhAdIni gRuhyante| yUkApasarpaNena sharIravairasyamiti virasAddhi sharIrAdyUkA apasarpanti; evaM yUkAdyanapasarpaNena prAkRutarasayuktaM sharIramanumAtavyam| dhArilohitamiti jIvashoNitamityarthaH; shvakAkabhakShaNAdij~jeyaM yaddhAri raktaM tat pittAduShTatvenAvirasaM shvAdayo bhakShayanti, natu pittaduShTaM raktapittamiti bhAvaH| atra evaMshabdasparsharUparasagandhamityupadeshaM kRutvA shabdAnantaraM cakShurgrAhyaM rUpaM darshaya~j shabdAdiparIkShAyAshca kramaniyamAbhAvaM sUcayati||7||
