ime tu khalvanye~apyevameva bhUyo~anumAnaj~jeyA bhavanti bhAvAH| tadyathA- agniM jaraNashaktyA parIkSheta, balaM vyAyAmashaktyA, shrotrAdIni shabdAdyarthagrahaNena, mano~arthAvyabhicaraNena, vij~jAnaM vyavasAyena, rajaHsa~ggena, mohamavij~jAnena, krodhamabhidroheNa, shokaM dainyena, harShamAmodena, prItiM toSheNa, bhayaM viShAdena, dhairyamaviShAdena, vIryamutthAnena , avasthAnamavibhrameNa, shraddhAmabhiprAyeNa, medhAM grahaNena, sa~jj~jAM nAmagrahaNena, smRutiM smaraNena, hriyamapatrapaNena, shIlamanushIlanena, dveShaM pratiShedhena, upadhimanubandhena , dhRutimalaulyena, vashyatAM vidheyatayA, vayobhaktisAtmyavyAdhisamutthAnAni kAladeshopashayavedanAvisheSheNa, gUDhali~ggaM vyAdhimupashayAnupashayAbhyAM, doShapramANavisheShamapacAravisheSheNa, AyuShaH kShayamariShTaiH, upasthitashreyastvaM kalyANAbhiniveshena, amalaM sattvamavikAreNa, grahaNyAstu mRududAruNatvaM svapnadarshanamabhiprAyaM dviShTeShTasukhaduHkhAni cAturapariprashnenaiva vidyAditi||8||

Commentary: bhUyo~anumAnaj~jeyA ityanenAnumAnagamyatayA vakShyamANA kecidagnibalAdaya AturopadeshagamyA api bhavantIti sUcayati| mano~arthAvyabhicaraNeneti satIndriyANAmarthasambandhe yadidaM kadAcicchabdaM pratyeti, kadAcidrasamityAdyayaugapadyena sarvArthAn pratyeti, tenAsti kAraNAnantaramindriyArthagrAhakaM mana ityanumIyate| j~jAnaM vyavasAyeneti vyavasAyaH pravRuttiH, yathA- peyajale pAnArthA pravRuttiH; tenAnumIyate jalaj~jAnamasya jAtaM, kathamanyathA j~jAnakAryArthakriyAyAM pravartata iti| rajaH sa~ggeneti nAryAdisa~ggena tatkAraNaM rajo~anumIyate| abhidrohaH parapIDArthA pravRuttiH| dainyaM rodanAdi| AmodaH nRutyagItavAditrAdyutsavakaraNam| toShaH mukhanayanaprasAdAdiH; etena prItistoShamAtraM, harShastu prItivisheSho mana-udrekakAraka ityuktaM bhavati| dhairyaM vipadyapi manaso~adainyam| vIryam ArabdhaduShkarakAryeShvavyAvRuttirmanasaH| utthAneneti kriyArambheNa| avasthAnaM sthiramatitvam| avibhrameNeti abhrAntyA| shraddhAm icchAm| abhiprAyeNeti abhyarthanena| grahaNeneti granthAdidhAraNena| smRutimiti smRutijanakaM saMskAraM; smaraNena hi tatkAraNaM saMskAro~anumIyate| hriyamiti lajjAm| apatrapeNeti lajjitAkAreNa| shIlamiti sahajaM vastuShu rAgam| anushIlaneneti anushIlanaM santatashIlanaM tena; satataM yamarthaM sevate tacchIlo~ayamityanumIyate| pratiShedheneti vyAvRuttyA| upetya dhIyate iti upadhiH chadma ityarthaH, tamanubandhenetyuttarakAlInaphalena; uttarakAlaM hi bhrAtrAdivadhena phalena j~jAyate- yadayamunmattacchadmapracArI candragupta iti| vidheyatayeti vidheyapracAreNa| vayaHprabhRutIni vyAdhisamutthAnAntAni catvAri yathAsa~gkhyaM kAlAdivisheSheNa j~jAyante| tatra kAlavisheSheNa ShoDashavarShAdinA vayo bAlyAdi j~jAyate; deshena tu bhaktiricchA j~jAyate, yathA hi- ayaM madhyadeshIyastenAsya godhUmamAShAdiShvicchA~anumIyate; yasmAccedamasyopashete tenedamasya sAtmyamiti j~jAyate; vedanAvisheSheNa vyAdhisamutthAnaM j~jAyate, yathA- yasmAdayaM santApavedanAvAn tasmAdasya jvaravyAdhisamutthAnaM bhUtamityAdi j~jeyam| gUDhali~ggamitivisheShaNenAgUDhali~gge vyAdhau li~ggairevAvadhArite nopashayAnupashayAbhyAM parIkShA karaNIyeti darshayati| apacAravisheSheNeti mahatA~apacAreNa bhUridoSho bhavati, svalpeNa svalpa iti| kalyANAbhinivesheneti shreyaskaramArgAnuShThAnena; etaddhi acirabhAvishreyasAmeva bhavati| sattvamiti sattvaguNodrekam| avikAreNeti rAgadveShavikArAbhAvena| pariprashnenaivetivacanena yadyapi grahaNImArdavAdyanumAnAdapi pAryate j~jAtuM, tathA~apyanumAnasya buddhiprayAsabahutvenAturapRucchayaiva sukhopacArarUpayA vidyAd grahaNImArdavAdInIti darshayati| abhiprAyaH bhojanAdIcchA| dviShTeShTashabdena tu dviShTepsitapreShyAdigrahaNam||8||
bhavanti cAtra- Aptatashcopadeshena pratyakShakaraNena ca| anumAnena ca vyAdhIn samyagvidyAdvicakShaNaH||9||
sarvathA sarvamAlocya yathAsambhavamarthavit| athAdhyavasyettattve ca kArye ca tadanantaram||10||
kAryatattvavisheShaj~jaH pratipattau na muhyati| amUDhaH phalamApnoti yadamohanimittajam||11||
j~jAnabuddhipradIpena yo nAvishati tattvavit | AturasyAntarAtmAnaM na sa rogAMshcikitsati||12||
tatra shlokau- sarvarogavisheShANAM trividhaM j~jAnasa~ggraham| yathA copadishantyAptAH pratyakShaM gRuhyate yathA||13||
ye yathA cAnumAnena j~jeyAstAMshcApyudAradhIH| bhAvAMstrirogavij~jAne vimAne muniruktavAn||14||
janapadoddhvaMsanIye~avisheSheNa sarve~api rogA uktAH, teShAM visheSho yathA j~jAtavyastadupadeShTuM trividharogavisheShavij~jAnIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

yathAsambhavamityanena sarvatra parIkShaNIye sarvapramANAsambhava iti darshayati| athetyAdi atha pratyekashabdAdiviShayaparIkShAnantaram| tattve vyAdhitattve, tathA kArye ca tatra sAdhye vyAdhau kartavyalakShaNe, tadanantaramadhyavasyet; yadyuktaM tattvaM bhavati, yacca kAryamuktaM, tatrAdhyavasAyaM nishcayaM kuryAdityarthaH| anantaramiti avidyamAnAntarayogyamityarthaH| kAryatattvavisheShAdhyavasAyaphalamAha- kAryetyAdi| pratipattiH karmaNAM yathArhatayA~anuShThAnam| amUDha iti pratipattAvamUDha ityarthaH| j~jAnaM shAstraM, tatkRutA buddhiH j~jAnabuddhiH| Avishati buddhyA~avagAhata ityarthaH| antarAtmAnamiti vaidyapakShe antaHsharIram||9-14||
athAtaH srotasAM vimAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
prANodakAnnavAhAnAM duShTAnAM shvAsikI kriyA| kAryA tRuShNopashamanI tathaivAmapradoShikI||26||
vividhAshitapItIye rasAdInAM yadauShadham| rasAdisrotasAM kuryAttadyathAsvamupakramam||27||
mUtraviTsvedavAhAnAM cikitsA mautrakRucchrikI| tathA~atisArikI kAryA tathA jvaracikitsikI||28||
tatra shlokAH- trayodashAnAM mUlAni srotasAM duShTilakShaNam| sAmAnyaM nAmaparyAyAH kopanAni parasparam||29||
doShahetuH pRuthaktvena bheShajoddesha eva ca| srotovimAne nirdiShTastathA cAdau vinishcayaH||30||
kevalaM viditaM yasya sharIraM sarvabhAvataH| shArIrAH sarvarogAshca sa karmasu na muhyati||31||

yAvantaH puruShe mUrtimanto bhAvavisheShAstAvanta evAsmin srotasAM prakAravisheShAH| sarve hi bhAvA puruShe nAntareNa srotAMsyabhinirvartante, kShayaM vA~apyabhigacchanti| srotAMsi khalu pariNAmamApadyamAnAnAM dhAtUnAmabhivAhIni bhavantyayanArthena||3||

Commentary: mUrtimanta iti asarvagatadravyaparimANavantaH, asarvagatadravyaparimANaM hi mUrtirucyate| bhAvavisheShA iti utpattimanto visheShAH| atra hetumAha- sarva ityAdi| abhinirvartanta iti santAnanyAyena| srotAMsItyAdi| khalushabdo hetau| pariNAmamApadyamAnAnAmiti pUrvapUrvarasAdirUpatAparityAgenottarottararaktAdirUpatAmApadyamAnAnAm| ayanArthenetivacanAnna sthirANAM dhAtUnAmabhivAhIni bhavanti srotAMsi, kintu deshAntaraprApaNenAbhivAhIni bhavanti| evaM manyate- raktasya vRuddhiH shoNitarUpatayA pariNamatA rasena militena kartavyA, sa ca sthAnAntarasthasya rasasya rudhireNa samaM melako na gamanamArgaM srotaHsa~jj~jakamantarA bhavati| ayaM tAvadabhisandhiH- srotaHkAraNiko hi dhAtUnAM prAyo raktAdInAmuttaradhAtupoShakabhAgapariNAmo bhavati, taccApyuttaradhAtupoShaNaM nAntareNa sroto bhavati; yashca rakte nyAyaH, sa sarvatra shArIre bhAve; na cAnyasrotasA~anyadhAtupuShTiH sambhavati, sarvapoShyANAM bhinnadeshatvAt; na hyabhinnena srotasA bhinnadeshavRukShayoH secanamasti| manastu yadyapi nityatvena na poShyaM, tathA~api tasyendriyapradeshagamanArthaM sroto~astyeva| tacca manaHprabhRutInAmatIndriyANAM kRutsnameva sharIraM srotorUpaM vakShyati| doShANAM tu sarvasharIracaratvena yathAsthUlasroto~anabhidhAne~api sarvasrotAMsyeva gamanArthaM vakShyante, sUkShmajij~jAsAyAM tu vAtAdInAmapi pradhAnabhUtA dhamanyaH santyeva; yaduktaM sushrute- “tAsAM vAtavAhinyo dasha” (su.shA.a.7) ityAdi| naca carake sushrute iva dhamanIsirAsrotasAM bhedo vivakShitaH||3||

api caike srotasAmeva samudayaM puruShamicchanti, sarvagatatvAt sarvasaratvAcca doShaprakopaNaprashamanAnAm| na tvetadevaM, yasya hi srotAMsi, yacca vahanti, yaccAvahanti, yatra cAvasthitAni, sarvaM tadanyattebhyaH||4||
atibahutvAt khalu kecidaparisa~gkhyeyAnyAcakShate srotAMsi, parisa~gkhyeyAni punaranye||5||
teShAM tu khalu srotasAM yathAsthUlaM katicitprakArAnmUlatashca prakopavij~jAnatashcAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; ye bhaviShyantyalamanuktArthaj~jAnAya j~jAnavatAM, vij~jAnAya cAj~jAnavatAm||6||

tadyathA- prANodakAnnarasarudhiramAMsamedosthimajjashukramUtrapurIShasvedavahAnIti; vAtapittashleShmaNAM punaH sarvasharIracarANAM sarvANi srotAMsyayanabhUtAni, tadvadatIndriyANAM punaH sattvAdInAM kevalaM cetanAvaccharIramayanabhUtamadhiShThAnabhUtaM ca| tadetat srotasAM prakRutibhUtatvAnna vikArairupasRujyate sharIram||7||

tatra prANavahAnAM srotasAM hRudayaM mUlaM mahAsrotashca, praduShTAnAM tu khalveShAmidaM visheShavij~jAnaM bhavati; tadyathA- atisRuShTamatibaddhaM kupitamalpAlpamabhIkShNaM vA sashabdashUlamucchvasantaM dRuShTvA prANavahAnyasya srotAMsi praduShTAnIti vidyAt| udakavahAnAM srotasAM tAlumUlaM kloma ca, praduShTAnAM tu khalveShAmidaM visheShavij~jAnaM bhavati; tadyathA- jihvAtAlvoShThakaNThaklomashoShaM pipAsAM cAtipravRuddhAM dRuShTvodakavahAnyasya srotAMsi praduShTAnIti vidyAt| annavahAnAM srotasAmAmAshayo mUlaM vAmaM ca pArshvaM, praduShTAnAM tu khalveShAmidaM visheShavij~jAnaM bhavati; tadyathA- anannAbhilaShaNamarocakavipAkau chardiM ca dRuShTvA~annavahAnyasya srotAMsi praduShTAnIti vidyAt| rasavahAnAM srotasAM hRudayaM mUlaM dasha ca dhamanyaH| shoNitavahAnAM srotasAM yakRunmUlaM plIhA ca| mAMsavahAnAM ca srotasAM snAyurmUlaM tvak ca| medovahAnAM srotasAM vRukkau mUlaM vapAvahanaM ca| asthivahAnAM srotasAM medo mUlaM jaghanaM ca| majjavahAnAM srotasAmasthIni mUlaM sandhayashca| shukravahAnAM srotasAM vRuShaNau mUlaM shephashca| praduShTAnAM tu khalveShAM rasAdivahasrotasAM vij~jAnAnyuktAni vividhAshitapItIye; yAnyeva hi dhAtUnAM pradoShavij~jAnAni tAnyeva yathAsvaM praduShTAnAM dhAtusrotasAm| mUtravahAnAM srotasAM bastirmUlaM va~gkShaNau ca, praduShTAnAM tu khalveShAmidaM visheShavij~jAnaM bhavati; tadyathA- atisRuShTamatibaddhaM prakupitamalpAlpamabhIkShNaM vA bahalaM sashUlaM mUtrayantaM dRuShTvA mUtravahAnyasya srotAMsi praduShTAnIti vidyAt| purIShavahAnAM srotasAM pakvAshayo mUlaM sthUlagudaM ca, praduShTAnAM tu khalveShAmidaM visheShavij~jAnaM bhavati; tadyathA- kRucchreNAlpAlpaM sashabdashUlamatidravamatigrathitamatibahu copavishantaM dRuShTvA purIShavahAnyasya srotAMsi praduShTAnIti vidyAt| svedavahAnAM srotasAM medo mUlaM lomakUpAshca, praduShTAnAM tu khalveShAmidaM visheShavij~jAnaM bhavati; tadyathA- asvedanamatisvedanaM pAruShyamatishlakShNatAma~ggasya paridAhaM lomaharShaM ca dRuShTvA svedavahAnyasya srotAMsi praduShTAnIti vidyAt||8||

Commentary: prANavahAnAmiti prANasa~jj~jakavAtavahAnAm| etacca prANAkhyavishiShTasya vAyorvishiShTasrotaH, sAmAnyena tu vAyoH sarvA eva dhamanya iti na virodhaH| mUlamiti prabhavasthAnam| atisRuShTaM vA atibaddhaM veti vikalpena boddhavyam, atisRuShTAtibaddhayorekatrAsambhavAt| alpAlpaM vA tathA~abhIkShNaM veti ca vikalpaH| kloma hRudayasthapipAsAsthAnam| vapAvahanaM vapA udarasthA snigdhavartikA yAmAhurjanAstailavartiketi| sushrute tu “medovahAnAM mUlaM vRukkau kaTI ca” (su.shA.a.) ityuktaM; tadatrAtIndriyArthadarshigamye nAsmadvidhAnAM buddhayaH prabhavanti | asthyapi dravarUpamastyeva srotovAhyamiti kRutvA asthivahAnAmityuktam| yadyapi vividhAshitapItIye rasAdInAM duShTilakShaNamuktaM na rasAdisrotasAM, tathA~api rasAdiduShTyA rasAdivahadhamanInAmapi duShTeH sAdhAraNatvenoktaM- rasAdivahasrotasAM vij~jAnAnyuktAnIti| ye tu bruvate- rasAdiduShTerabhinnaiva tadvahadhamanIduShTiriti, teShAM mate pRuthagdhamanIduShTyabhidhAnamanupapannaM, tathA dhamanIduShTyA yaddhAtuduShTiM vakShyati “teShAM prakopAt sthAnasthAshcaiva” ityAdinA tadanupapannam| dhamanIduShTyA tu tadvAhyaduShTiravashyaM bhavatIti kRutvA dhAtuduShTilakShaNaireveha dhamanIduShTiruktA, raktAdidhAtuduShTyatiriktaM tu dhamanIduShTilakShaNam “atipravRuttiH” ityAdinA~atraiva vakShyati| asvedanAdikaM svedavahaduShTilakShaNaM kuShThapUrvarUpe~apyasti; tena yatrAnyatkuShThapUrvarUpadarshanaM bhavati tatra kuShThapUrvarUpatA nishcetavyA, etAvanmAtralakShaNodaye tu svedavahadhamanIduShTiriti| dhamanInAmiha mUlaj~jAne yadyapi sAkShAt prayojanaM noktaM, tathA~api mUlopaghAtAdvRukShANAmiva dhamanInAM mahAnupaghAto bhavatIti j~jeyam, ata eva sushrute srotomUlaviddhalakShaNAnyuktAni||8||

srotAMsi, sirAH, dhamanyaH, rasAyanyaH, rasavAhinyaH, nADyaH, panthAnaH, mArgAH, sharIracchidrANi, saMvRutAsaMvRutAni, sthAnAni, AshayAH, niketAshceti sharIradhAtvavakAshAnAM lakShyAlakShyANAM nAmAni bhavanti| teShAM prakopAt sthAnasthAshcaiva mArgagAshca sharIradhAtavaH prakopamApadyante, itareShAM prakopAditarANi ca| srotAMsi srotAMsyeva, dhAtavashca dhAtUneva pradUShayanti praduShTAH| teShAM sarveShAmeva vAtapittashleShmANaH praduShTA dUShayitAro bhavanti, doShasvabhAvAditi||9||

Commentary: srotasAM vyavahArArthaM paryAyAnAha- srotAMsItyAdi| saMvRutAsaMvRutAnItyekA sa~jj~jA, tatrAgre saMvRutAni mUle~asaMvRutAni| sthAnAdiparyAyAn keciddhamanImUlasya paryAyAnAcakShate; anye tvetAnapi dhamanIparyAyAnAhuH, dhamanyo~api hi rasAdisthAnaM bhavantyeveti kRutvA| sthAnasthA iti AshayasthAH| mArgagAshcaiveti dhamanIbhirgacchantaH| itareShAM cetyAdinoktamarthaM srotAMsi cetyAdinA vivRuNoti| srotAMsi dhAtavashca duShTAH pratyAsannAni srotAMsi dhAtvantarANi ca svadoShasa~gkrAntyA dUShayantItyarthaH| doShasvabhAvAditi doShANAmevAyaM svabhAvo yaddUShakatvaM , na dhAtvantarANAM; tena dhAtunA duShTirdhAtuduShTiH dhAtugatadoShakRutaiva j~jeyA||9||
bhavanti cAtra- kShayAt sandhAraNAdraukShyAdvyAyAmAt kShudhitasya ca| prANavAhIni duShyanti srotAMsyanyaishca dAruNaiH||10||
auShNyAdAmAdbhayAt pAnAdatishuShkAnnasevanAt| ambuvAhIni duShyanti tRuShNAyAshcAtipIDanAt||11||
atimAtrasya cAkAle cAhitasya ca bhojanAt| annavAhIni duShyanti vaiguNyAt pAvakasya ca||12||
gurushItamatisnigdhamatimAtraM samashnatAm| rasavAhIni duShyanti cintyAnAM cAticintanAt||13||
vidAhInyannapAnAni snigdhoShNAni dravANi ca| raktavAhIni duShyanti bhajatAM cAtapAnalau||14||
abhiShyandIni bhojyAni sthUlAni ca gurUNi ca| mAMsavAhIni duShyanti bhuktvA ca svapatAM divA||15||
avyAyAmAddivAsvapnAnmedyAnAM cAtibhakShaNAt| medovAhIni duShyanti vAruNyAshcAtisevanAt||16||
vyAyAmAdatisa~gkShobhAdasthnAmativighaTTanAt| asthivAhIni duShyanti vAtalAnAM ca sevanAt||17||
utpeShAdatyabhiShyandAdabhighAtAt prapIDanAt| majjavAhIni duShyanti viruddhAnAM ca sevanAt||18||
akAlayonigamanAnnigrahAdatimaithunAt| shukravAhIni duShyanti shastrakShArAgnibhistathA||19||
mUtritodakabhakShyastrIsevanAnmUtranigrahAt| mUtravAhIni duShyanti kShINasyAbhikShatasya ca||20||
sandhAraNAdatyashanAdajIrNAdhyashanAttathA| varcovAhIni duShyanti durbalAgneH kRushasya ca||21||
vyAyAmAdatisantApAcchItoShNAkramasevanAt | svedavAhIni duShyanti krodhashokabhayaistathA||22||

AhArashca vihArashca yaH syAddoShaguNaiH samaH| dhAtubhirviguNashcApi srotasAM sa pradUShakaH||23||

Commentary: AhArashcetyAdinA sAmAnyena sarvasrotoduShTimAha| doShaguNaiH sama ityanena doShAtivardhakatvaM darshayati| kShINAshca doShA nAnyaduShTiM kurvanti, kiM tu svayameva kShINasvali~ggA bhavantItyAdi veditavyam| dhAtubhirviguNa iti dhAtuvirodhakasvabhAva ityarthaH, natu dhAtuviparItaguNe viguNaH; divAsvapnamedyAdayo hi medasA samAnaguNA eva medodUShakA uktAH||23||

atipravRuttiH sa~ggo vA sirANAM granthayo~api vA| vimArgagamanaM cApi srotasAM duShTilakShaNam||24||

Commentary: atipravRuttirityAdinA sAmAnyena srotoduShTilakShaNamAha| atipravRuttiriha srotovAhyasya rasAderboddhavyA; evaM sa~ggo~api rasAdereva| vimArgagamanaM ca yathA- malasya mUtramArgagamanamityAdi||24||

svadhAtusamavarNAni vRuttasthUlAnyaNUni ca| srotAMsi dIrghANyAkRutyA pratAnasadRushAni ca||25||

Commentary: svadhAtusamavarNAnIti vAhyadhAtutulyavarNAni| pratAnaH latAprapa~jcaH||25||
pUrvasminnadhyAye parIkShAmabhidhAya tatparIkShaNIyaM sharIraM duShTAduShTasrotovibhAgena vaktuM srotasAM vimAnamucyate||1-2||

prANodaketyAdinA cikitsAmAha| prANavahAnAM shvAsikI, udakavahAnAM tRuShNopashamanI, annavahAnAmAmapradoShikIti boddhavyam| mUtrAdivahAnAmapi trayANAM mautrakRucchrikyAdayo yathAsa~gkhyaM tisrashcikitsA j~jeyAH||26-28||

sa~ggrahe duShTilakShaNaM sAmAnyaM vAtAdyavisheShitaM duShTilakShaNamityarthaH, srotoduShTilakShaNAnIha vAtAdidoShabhedena noktAnItyarthaH ; vAtAdivisheSheNa ceha vistarabhayAdduShTirnoktA; tena vAtAdivisheShali~ggAdhikyAdduShTirnirNetavyA| Adau vinishcaya iti adhyAyAdau puruShasya dhamanImayatvAdivAdanishcaya ityarthaH| kevalamityAdinA atroktadhamanyAdibhedena sharIraj~jAnasyopAdeyatAmAha||29-31||

sarvagatatvAditi srotasAM sarvasharIrAvayavagatatvAdityarthaH| sarvasaratvAdityuttareNa sambadhyate| doShaprakopaNamapathyaM doShaprashamanaM vA pathyaM sarvasmi~j sharIrapradeshe doSharUpaM sat tathA bheShajarUpaM sadgacchati; tena sarvatra sroto vidyate; tena srotomayaH puruSha iti pUrvapakShaH| taM niShedhati- na tvityAdi| yasya hi srotAMsi yadghaTitAnItyarthaH, yacca vahantIti yadrasAdi vahantItyarthaH, yaccAvahantIti yacca puShyantItyarthaH, yatra cAvasthitAnIti yatra mAMsAdau sambaddhAnItyarthaH, tat sarvaM dhamanIbhyo~anyat; tasmAnna srotorUpa eva puruSha ityarthaH||4-5||

prakopavij~jAnatashceti yathA srotasAM prakopo vij~jAyate tathA vyAkhyAsyAma iti yojanA| anuktArthaj~jAnAyeti anuktasrotoj~jAnAya| j~jAnavatAmiti anuktArthaj~jAnasamarthAnAm| j~jAnavanto hyanena li~ggenAnuktamapi sroto~anumimate| vij~jAnAya cAj~jAnavatAmiti yathoktamAtraj~jAnAya ca mandabuddhInAmityarthaH| tadvaditi sarvasharIracarANAm| cetanAvaccharIramityanenAcetanakeshanakhAdipradeshaM sattvAdigamane niShedhati, doShAstu tatrApi yAntIti| ayanabhUtamiti mArgabhUtam| adhiShThAnabhUtamiti sthAnarUpam||6-7||

yathAkramaM srotasAM duShTikAraNamAha- kShayAdityAdi| dAruNairityatra ‘karmabhiH’ iti sheShaH| gurUNi ca bhajatAmiti pUrvoktena sambandhaH| medyAnAM medurANAm| akAlayonigamanAditi aharShakAlagamanAt, tathA~anucitayonau gamanAt| nigrahAditi shukraveganigrahAt| mUtritetyAdau mUtravegayuktasya udakAdisevanAditi j~jeyam||10-22||
athAto rogAnIkaM vimAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tatrAnubandhyAnubandhakRuto visheShaH- svatantro vyaktali~ggo yathoktasamutthAnaprashamo bhavatyanubandhyaH, tadviparItalakShaNastvanubandhaH| anubandhyalakShaNasamanvitAstatra yadi doShA bhavanti tattrikaM sannipAtamAcakShate, dvayaM vA saMsargam| anubandhyAnubandhavisheShakRutastu bahuvidho doShabhedaH| evameSha sa~jj~jAprakRuto bhiShajAM doSheShu vyAdhiShu ca nAnAprakRutivisheShavyUhaH ||11||

Commentary: enameva doShAnubandhamanubandhyAnubandhabhedena darshayitumanubandhyAnubandhalakShaNamevAha- tatretyAdi| anubandhyasya anubandhasya ca visheSho~anubandhyAnubandhavisheShaH ‘svatantra’ ityAdigranthalakShaNIyaH| svatantra ityasyaiva vivaraNaM- vyaktali~gga ityAdi| yathoktasamutthAnaprashama iti svahetusamutthitaH svacikitsayaiva prashamanIyaH| kiMvA, svatantra ityenApi svavikArakaraNe prAdhAnyamucyate ; svatantro hi doShaH prakopakAle vikArAn karoti, asvatantrastu svatantraprakopakAla eva vikAraM pradhAnadoSheritaH san karoti| tadviparItalakShaNa iti anenAvyaktali~ggo~asvahetuprakupitaH paracikitsAprashamanIyashcAnubandha iti labhyate; anubandho hyabalavattvena na li~ggaM vyaktaM karoti, tathA parahetunA ki~jcidanuguNena kRutaH paracikitsayaiva ki~jcidanuguNayA shAmyati| yathA- sharadi shleShmA pittahetunA jalAdyamlavipAkena janyate, sa ca pittacikitsayaiva tiktasarpirAdikayA kaphe~apyanuguNayA shAmyati| dvayaM vA~anubandhyalakShaNaM prAptaM saMsargamAcakShata iti yojanA| anubandhyashabdashcAyaM vyaktali~ggatAdidharmayukte doShe vartate| tenApradhAnAnugamanIye sannipAte anubandhAbhAve~apyanubandha iti vyapadesho bhavatyeva anubandhyAnubandharUpasaMsargavisheSheNa kRutaH| sa~jj~jAprakRuta iti anubandhyAnubandhasannipAtasaMsargajvarAtisArAdisa~jj~jAkRuta ityarthaH| nAnAprakRutivisheShavyUha iti yathoktanAnAkAraNavisheShakRuto jvarAtisArAdirUpo vyadhInAM doShANAM ca samUha ityarthaH| bhiShajAmitipadena ca vaidyAnAmeveyaM samayasiddhA~anubandhyAdisa~jj~jeti darshayati||11||

agniShu tu shArIreShu caturvidho visheSho balabhedena bhavati| tadyathA- tIkShNo, mandaH, samo, viShamashceti| tatra tIkShNo~agniH sarvApacArasahaH, tadviparItalakShaNastu mandaH, samastu khalvapacArato vikRutimApadyate~anapacAratastu prakRutAvavatiShThate, samalakShaNaviparItalakShaNastu viShama iti| ete caturvidhA bhavantyagnayashcaturvidhAnAmeva puruShANAm| tatra samavAtapittashleShmaNAM prakRutisthAnAM samA bhavantyagnayaH, vAtalAnAM tu vAtAbhibhUte~agnyadhiShThAne viShamA bhavantyagnayaH, pittalAnAM tu pittAbhibhUte hyagnyadhiShThAne tIkShNA bhavantyagnayaH, shleShmalAnAM tu shleShmAbhibhUte~agnyadhiShThAne mandA bhavantyagnayaH||12||

Commentary: doShabhedavikArabhedamabhidhAya sharIrasthiteH pradhAnakAraNasyAgnerbhedamAha- agniShvityAdi| shArIreShviti sAmAnyavacanena sarvasharIragatAnagnIn grAhayati, vivaraNe tu jaTharAgnereva ‘tIkShNo~agniH sarvApacArasahaH’ ityAdinA yaccAturvidhyamuktaM, tajjaTharAgnitIkShNatAdimUlakameva tvagagnyAditIkShNatvAdikamiti j~jApayati| vacanaM hi- “tanmUlAste hi tadvRuddhikShayavRuddhikShayAtmakAH” (ci.a.15) iti| yadyapi samo~agniH shastatvenAgre~abhidhAtuM yujyate, tathA~api samatashca tIkShNasyaiva prAdhAnyopadarshanArthamihAgre~abhidhAnaM; samasya hi prAdhAnyaM nirvikAratvenaiva susthitaM, tIkShNasya tu sarvApacArasahatvena prAdhAnyam| tadviparItalakShaNa iti svalpApacAramapi yo na sahate, sa manda ityarthaH| samalakShaNaviparItalakShaNa iti kadAcidviShamo~apacArAdapi na vikriyate, kadAcidvikriyate| samavAtapittashleShmaNAmityukte~api prakRutisthAnAmiti padaM vRuddhAnAM samavAtapittashleShmaNAM pratiShedhArtham| prakRutishabdasya kAraNAdyanekArthatAvyudAsArthaM samavAtapittashleShmaNAmiti kRutam| vAtAbhibhUte~agnyadhiShThAne iti vacanena vAtalAnAmapi yadaivAgnyadhiShThAnopaghAto vAtena kriyate, tadaiva vaiShamyaM bhavati| evaM pittAbhibhUta ityAdAvapi vyAkhyeyam||12||

tatra kecidAhuH- na samavAtapittashleShmANo jantavaH santi, viShamAhAropayogitvAnmanuShyANAM; tasmAcca vAtaprakRutayaH kecit, kecit pittaprakRutayaH, kecit punaH shleShmaprakRutayo bhavantIti| taccAnupapannaM, kasmAt kAraNAt? samavAtapittashleShmANaM hyarogamicchanti bhiShajaH, yataH prakRutishcArogyam, ArogyArthA ca bheShajapravRuttiH, sA ceShTarUpA, tasmAt santi samavAtapittashleShmANaH; na khalu santi vAtaprakRutayaH pittaprakRutayaH shleShmaprakRutayo vA| tasya tasya kila doShasyAdhikyAt sA sA doShaprakRutirucyate manuShyANAM, na ca vikRuteShu doSheShu prakRutisthatvamupapadyate, tasmAnnaitAH prakRutayaH santi; santi tu khalu vAtalAH pittalAH shleShmalAshca, aprakRutisthAstu te j~jeyAH||13||

Commentary: viShamAhAropayogitvAditi nAyaM puruShastulAdhAradhRutamivAhAramupayu~gkte, tenAvashyamatra vAtAdiShvanyatamo~api doSho vikRuto bhavatIti bhAvaH| samavAtapittashleShmANamityAdinA asti tAvadArogyaM puruSheShu vaidyavyavahArasiddhamiti darshayati| tena, yAdRugidaM doShANAM kalAkAShThAdivaiShamyaM parityajyAvirbhUtavikArAkAritvenAdUrAntaraM sAmyamiShyate, tAdRugeva prakRutAvapi sAmyamastyeveti bhAvaH| anye tu vaiShamyaM nAdriyanta eva, vyapadeshyarogAjanakatvAt| doShaprakRutiriti duShTadoShabhAvitA prakRutirityarthaH||13||

teShAM tu khalu caturvidhAnAM puruShANAM catvAryanupraNidhAnAni shreyaskarANi bhavanti| tatra samasarvadhAtUnAM sarvAkArasamam, adhikadoShANAM tu trayANAM yathAsvaM doShAdhikyamabhisamIkShya doShapratikUlayogIni trINyanu(nna)praNidhAnAni shreyaskarANi bhavanti yAvadagneH samIbhAvAt, same tu samameva kAryam; evaM ceShTA bheShajaprayogAshcApare| tAn vistareNAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||14||

Commentary: doShe pravRuddhe pratikUlatayA yogIni doShapratikUlayogIni| trINi vAtapittashleShmapratikUlAni| same tviti samatAM gate vahnau, yathocitavidhAnena (vAtaprakRutyAdInAM ) samamevAnupraNidhAnaM kartavyam| evamityanena prakAreNa ceShTAbheShajayorapi prayogA vAtAdInAM bhavanti; ye tu, evamityanena caturvidhenoktena prakAreNeti vadanti, te samaprakRutInAM ca samavyAyAmAdiceShTA bheShajaM ca RutucaryAvidheyaM vamanAdikArakaM sUcyate~aneneti vyAkhyAnayanti||14||

trayastu puruShA bhavantyAturAH, te tvanAturAstantrAntarIyANAM bhiShajAm| tadyathA- vAtalaH, pittalaH, shleShmalashceti| teShAmidaM visheShavij~jAnaM- vAtalasya vAtanimittAH, pittalasya pittanimittAH, shleShmalasya shleShmanimittA vyAdhayaH prAyeNa balavantashca bhavanti||15||

tatra vAtalasya vAtaprakopaNAnyAsevamAnasya kShipraM vAtaH prakopamApadyate, na tathetarau doShau; sa tasya prakopamApanno yathoktairvikAraiH sharIramupatapati balavarNasukhAyuShAmupaghAtAya| tasyAvajayanaM- snehasvedau vidhiyuktau, mRudUni ca saMshodhanAni snehoShNamadhurAmlalavaNayuktAni, tadvadabhyavahAryANi, abhya~ggopanAhanodveShTanonmardanapariShekAvagAhanasaMvAhanAvapIDanavitrAsanavismApanavismAraNAni, surAsavavidhAnaM, snehAshcAnekayonayo dIpanIyapAcanIyavAtaharavirecanIyopahitAstathA shatapAkAH sahasrapAkAH sarvashashca prayogArthAH, bastayaH, bastiniyamaH sukhashIlatA ceti||16||

pittalasyApi pittaprakopaNAnyAsevamAnasya kShipraM pittaM prakopamApadyate, na tathetarau doShau; tadasya prakopamApannaM yathoktairvikAraiH sharIramupatapati balavarNasukhAyuShAmupaghAtAya| tasyAvajayanaM- sarpiShpAnaM, sarpiShA ca snehanam, adhashca doShaharaNaM, madhuratiktakaShAyashItAnAM cauShadhAbhyavahAryANAmupayogaH, mRudumadhurasurabhishItahRudyAnAM gandhAnAM copasevA, muktAmaNihArAvalInAM ca paramashishiravArisaMsthitAnAM dhAraNamurasA, kShaNe kShaNe~agryacandanapriya~ggukAlIyamRuNAlashItavAtavAribhirutpalakumudakokanadasaugandhikapadmAnugataishca vAribhirabhiprokShaNaM, shrutisukhamRudumadhuramano~anugAnAM ca gItavAditrANAM shravaNaM, shravaNaM cAbhyudayAnAM, suhRudbhiH saMyogaH, saMyogashceShTAbhiH strIbhiH shItopahitAMshukasragdhAriNIbhiH, nishAkarAMshushItalapravAtaharmyavAsaH, shailAntarapulinashishirasadanavasanavyajanapavanasevanaM, ramyANAM copavanAnAM sukhashishirasurabhimArutopahitAnAmupasevanaM, sevanaM ca padmotpalanalinakumudasaugandhikapuNDarIkashatapatrahastAnAM , saumyAnAM ca sarvabhAvAnAmiti||17||

Commentary: yathoktairiti mahArogAdhyAyoktaiH| adhashca doShaharaNamiti virecanAdityarthaH| agryacandanaM dhavalacandam| hastAnAmiti kalApAnAm||17||

shleShmalasyApi shleShmaprakopaNAnyAsevamAnasya kShipraM shleShmA prakopamApadyate, na tathetarau doShau; sa tasya prakopamApanno yathoktairvikAraiH sharIramupatapati balavarNasukhAyuShAmupaghAtAya| tasyAvajayanaM- vidhiyuktAni tIkShNoShNAni saMshodhanAni, rUkShaprAyANi cAbhyavahAryANi kaTukatiktakaShAyopahitAni, tathaiva dhAvanala~gghanaplavanaparisaraNajAgaraNaniyuddhavyavAyavyAyAmonmardanasnAnotsAdanAni, visheShatastIkShNAnAM dIrghakAlasthitAnAM ca madyAnAmupayogaH, sadhUmapAnaH sarvashashcopavAsaH, tathoShNaM vAsaH, sukhapratiShedhashca sukhArthameveti||18||

Commentary: shleShmavijayArthaM rUkShasyaiva hitatvena rUkShANIti vaktavye yadrUkShaprAyANIti karoti, tenAtyartharUkShAnnasya vAtAnuguNatvena tathA dhAtvapoShakatvena cAsevyatvaM darshayati; uktaM hi rasavimAne- “snigdhamashnIyAt; snigdhaM hi bhuktaM svadate, bhuktamaudaryamagnimudIrayati” (vi.a.1) ityAdi| la~gghanam utplutya gamanaM, parisaraNaM kuNDalarUpabhramaNam| sarvashashcopavAsa iti sarvala~gghanAni| yaduktaM- “catuShprakArA saMshuddhiH pipAsA mArutAtapau| pAcanAnyupavAsashca vyAyAmashceti la~gghanam” (sU.a.22) iti| upavAsashabdo hyatra la~gghane vartate| sukhArthamiti AyatisukhArthaM; sukhapratiShedhAddhi shleShmakShaye bhUte shleShmavikArAbhAvalakShaNaM sukhaM bhavati||18||

bhavati cAtra- sarvarogavisheShaj~jaH sarvakAryavisheShavit| sarvabheShajatattvaj~jo rAj~jaH prANapatirbhavediti||19||

Commentary: yathoktAdhyAyaj~jAnAdeva sarvarogAbhij~jaM stauti- sarvetyAdinA| prANAn pAti rakShatIti prANapatiH||19||
tatra shlokAH- prakRutyantarabhedena rogAnIkavikalpanam| parasparAvirodhashca sAmAnyaM rogadoShayoH||20||
doShasa~gkhyA vikArANAmekadeshaH prakopaNam| jaraNaM prati cintA ca kAyAgnerdhukShaNAni ca||21||
narANAM vAtalAdInAM prakRutisthApanAni ca| rogAnIke vimAne~asmin vyAhRutAni maharShiNA||22||

dve rogAnIke bhavataH prabhAvabhedena- sAdhyam, asAdhyaM ca; dve rogAnIke balabhedena- mRudu, dAruNaM ca; dve rogAnIke adhiShThAnabhedena- mano~adhiShThAnaM, sharIrAdhiShThAnaM ca; dve rogAnIke nimittabhedena- svadhAtuvaiShamyanimittam, AgantunimittaM ca; dve rogAnIke Ashayabhedena- AmAshayasamutthaM, pakvAshayasamutthaM ceti| evametat prabhAvabalAdhiShThAnanimittAshayabhedAddvaidhaM sadbhedaprakRutyantareNa bhidyamAnamathavA~api sandhIyamAnaM syAdekatvaM bahutvaM vA| ekatvaM tAvadekameva rogAnIkaM, duHkhasAmAnyAt ; bahutvaM tu dasha rogAnIkAni prabhAvabhedAdinA bhavanti; bahutvamapi sa~gkhyeyaM syAdasa~gkhyeyaM vA| tatra sa~gkhyeyaM tAvadyathoktamaShTodarIye, aparisa~gkhyeyaM punaryathA- mahArogAdhyAye rugvarNasamutthAnAdInAmasa~gkhyeyatvAt||3||

Commentary: balabhedenetyatra mRudu alpabalaM, dAruNaM tu mahAbalaM j~jeyam| dAruNaM ki~jcitkAlAtipAtAdeva balavattvAnmArayati| yaduktaM- “santi hyevaMvidhA rogAH sAdhyA dAruNasammatAH| ye hanyuranupakrAntA mithyArambheNa vA punaH” (sU.a.18) iti| AmAshayasamutthatvena AmAshayAshrayAH kaphapittajAH sarve gadA gRuhyante, pakvAshayasamutthagrahaNena sarve vAtajAH; evaM sarvavikArAvarodhaH| dvaidhaM saditi dvaividhyaM sat| bhedaprakRutyantareNeti bhedakAraNAntareNa| athavA~api sandhIyamAnamiti ekIkriyamANam, ekabuddhikArakAnugatadharmAntareNeti boddhavyam| duHkhasAmAnyAditi duHkhakartRutvena sarvarogAnugatena sAdhAraNena rUpeNa sarva eva rogA ekarUpA bhavanti| bahutvamapIti uktaprabhAvabhedAdikRutatvAdapi bahutvamityarthaH| sa~gkhyeyatvamaShTodarIye “aShTacatvAriMshadrogAdhikaraNAnyasmin sa~ggrahe” (sU.a.19) ityAdinoktam| asa~gkhyeyatvaM mahArogAdhyAye tathA trishophIye ca “ta evAparisa~gkhyeyA bhidyamAnA bhavanti hi| rujAvarNasamutthAnasthAnasaMsthAnanAmabhiH” (sU.a.18) ityanenoktam||3||

na ca sa~gkhyeyAgreShu bhedaprakRutyantarIyeShu vigItirityato doShavatI syAdatra kAcit pratij~jA, na cAvigItirityataH syAdadoShavatI| bhettA hi bhedyamanyathAbhinatti, anyathA purastAdbhinnaM bhedaprakRutyantareNa bhindan bhedasa~gkhyAvisheShamApAdayatyanekadhA, na ca pUrvaM bhedAgramupahanti| samAnAyAmapi khalu bhedaprakRutau prakRutAnuprayogAntaramapekShyam | santi hyarthAntarANi samAnashabdAbhihitAni, santi cAnarthAntarANi paryAyashabdAbhihitAni| samAno hi rogashabdo doSheShu ca vyAdhiShu ca; doShA hyapi rogashabdamAta~gkashabdaM yakShmashabdaM doShaprakRutishabdaM vikArashabdaM ca labhante, vyAdhayashca rogashabdamAta~gkashabdaM yakShmashabdaM doShaprakRutishabdaM vikArashabdaM ca labhante| tatra doSheShu caiva vyAdhiShu ca rogashabdaH samAnaH, sheSheShu tu visheShavAn||4||

Commentary: nanu sa~gkhyeyatvamasa~gkhyeyatvaM ca viruddhAvetau dharmau, tathaikatvamanekatvaM ceti viruddhau, tat kathaM viruddhatvena khyAtau dharmAvekasmin roge ghaTetAmityAha- na cetyAdi| sa~gkhyeyAgreShviti sa~gkhyeyarogaparimANeShu, agrashabdaH parimANe vartate; yathA- ekaikasya bhedAgramaparisa~gkhyeyaM bhavati, bhedasa~gkhyArUpaM parimANamityarthaH| bhedaprakRutyantarIyeShviti bhedakAraNAntarabhaveShu| viruddhA gItiH vigItiH kathanaM ; yathA- ‘ekaM cAnekaM ca tat’ ityAdikA viruddhA gItiH| ata iti yathoktavigItiyogAt, na doShavatI kAcit pratij~jA; yathA- ekAnekarUpAntaragamanarUpA atroktA syAditi yojanA| vigItau doShAbhAvaM darshayitvA bhedakAraNAntarakRutAyAmavigItAvapi doSho bhavatIti darshayannAha- na cAvigItirityAdi| yadi hi ‘ekaM rogAnIkaM rujAsAmAnyAt’ ityabhidhAya punaH ‘ekaM rogAnIkaM prabhAvabhedAt’ ityaviruddhA ekatAkhyAyikA~avigItiH kriyate, sA viruddhaiva syAt; yato na prabhAvabhedena rogANAmekatvamupapannaM, kintu dvaidhameveti bhAvaH| vigItau doShAbhAve hetumAha- bhettA hItyAdi|- bhettA puruShaH, bhedyaM rogam, anyathA dvitvAdinA bhinatti, anyathA ekatvena purastAdbheditaM cAnyathA bhinattIti| asyArthaM vyAkaroti- bhedaprakRutyantareNetyAdinA| anekadheti dve rogAnIke, tathA dasha rogAnIkAnItyAdi| na ca pUrvaM bhedAgraM bhedapramANamupahanti| evaM manyate- yaddharmayogavivakShayaikatvamuktaM, taddharmayogavivakShayaiva yadi bahutvamapyucyate rogANAM tato virodho bhavati, na hi tadevaikaM cAnekaM cetyupapannaM; yadA tu dharmAntarayogavivakShayA bahutvamucyate, na tadA virodhaH; bahutvAbhidhAnakAle bahUnAmeva rogadharmANAM vivakShitatvAt; tena rogANAmekatvamekadharmaviShayaM, bahutvaM ca bahudharmaviShayamiti nAsti virodhaH| nanu yatrAsamAnaM bhedakAraNaM tatra kAraNAntarakRutatvAduktanyAyena vigItiH sAdhvI bhavatu, yatra tu dasha rogAnIkAni prabhAvAdidvaividhyAducyante, tatra kathaM dve rogAnIke iti dvitvakRutaM dvaividhyamabhidhAya punardvitvAdibhedenaiva dashatvamucyate? samAno hyayaM dvishabdo dvitve dashatve ca rogANAM heturityAha- samAnAyAmapIti; samAnashabdAbhidheyatvenApAtataH samAnatvena pratibhAsamAnAyAmityarthaH| prakRutAnuprayogAntaramapekShyamiti prakRutasya samAnashabdenAbhihitasya yadbhedakhyApakaM pashcAtprayogAntaraM, tadapekShaNIyaM vigItisamAdhAnArthamityarthaH| etenaitaddarshayati- yadyapi dvishabdo rogaprabhAve tathA rogabalAdau ca samAnaH, tathA~apyekatra ‘prabhAvabhedAt’ ityanuprayogAntaramapekShya prabhAvadvaividhye vartate, tathA ‘balabhedAt’ ityanuprayogAntaramapekShya ca dvishabdo baladvaividhye vartata ityAdi| tenArthAntarAbhidhAyibhirdvishabdairbhidyamAnasya dashatvamapyupapannaM tathA dvitvaM ceti bhAvaH| dRuShTAntArthamekena shabdenAnekArthAbhidhAnamAha- santi hItyAdi| arthAntarANi paryAyashabdAnabhihitA arthAH| tatrodAharaNamAha- samAno hItyAdi|- doSheShu vyAdhiShu ca samAna ubhayavAcakatvena tulyo rogashabdaH; tena rogadoShasamAnatvenAbhidheyasamAnAnAM rogAta~gkayakShmAdishabdAnAM sarveShAmeva vakShyamANAnAM grahaNam| sheSheShviti hetvAdiShu| visheShavAniti abhidhAnarUpavisheShavAnityarthaH||4||

tatra vyAdhayo~aparisa~gkhyeyA bhavanti, atibahutvAt| doShAstu khalu parisa~gkhyeyA bhavanti, anatibahutvAt| tasmAdyathAcitraM vikArAnudAharaNArtham, anavasheSheNa ca doShAn vyAkhyAsyAmaH| rajastamashca mAnasau doShau| tayorvikArAH kAmakrodhalobhamoherShyAmAnamadashokacitto(nto)dvegabhayaharShAdayaH| vAtapittashleShmANastu khalu shArIrA doShAH| teShAmapi ca vikArA jvarAtIsArashophashoShashvAsamehakuShThAdayaH| iti doShAH kevalA vyAkhyAtA vikAraikadeshashca||5||
tatra khalveShAM dvayAnAmapi doShANAM trividhaM prakopaNaM; tadyathA- asAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaH, praj~jAparAdhaH, pariNAmashceti||6||

prakupitAstu khalu te prakopaNavisheShAddUShyavisheShAcca vikAravisheShAnabhinirvartayantyaparisa~gkhyeyAn||7||

Commentary: nanu parimitAddoSharUpAt kAraNAt kathamaparimitA vikArA bhavantItyAha- prakupitAstvityAdi| hetuvisheShaduShTo hi sa eva doSho dUShyAntaragatashca vibhinnashaktiyogAdbahUn vikArAn karotIti yuktameva| uktaM ca- “sa eva kupito doShaH samutthAnavisheShataH| sthAnAntaragatashcaiva vikArAn kurute bahUn” (sU.a.18) iti||7||

te ca vikArAH parasparamanuvartamAnAH kadAcidanubadhnanti kAmAdayo jvarAdayashca||8||

Commentary: vikArANAM shArIramAnasAnAM parasparaM saMsargamAha- te ca vikArA ityAdi| anuvartamAnA ityanena yadaiva jvarAdayaH kAmAdayo vA balavattvena cirakAlamanuvartante, tadaivAnubadhnanti prAyaH; yadA tu stokakAlAvasthAyino bhavanti, na tadA prAyo~anubadhnantItyarthaH| kiMvA, anuvartamAnAH parasparabalamabhivardhayantaH| atra ca parasparashabdena shArIrANAM shArIreNa, mAnasAnAM mAnasena, shArIrANAM mAnasena, mAnasAnAM shArIreNa cAnubandho j~jeyaH||8||

niyatastvanubandho rajastamasoH parasparaM, na hyarajaskaM tamaH pravartate ||9||

Commentary: vikArAnubandhaM darshayitvA doShAnubandhamAha- niyatastvityAdi||9||

(prAyaH) shArIradoShANAmekAdhiShThAnIyAnAM sannipAtaH saMsargo vA samAnaguNatvAt; doShA hi dUShaNaiH samAnAH||10||

Commentary: shArIradoShAnubandhamAha- shArIretyAdi| ekAdhiShThAnIyAnAmityanenaikasharIrAdhiShThAnapratyAsattyA ca saMsargA doShANAM bhavantIti darshayati| samAnaguNatvAditi hetuM vivRuNoti- doShA hItyAdi| dUShaNairiti hetubhiH; prAyo hi shArIrANAM vAtAdInAM samAna eva heturbhavati; yathA- hyamlaM lavaNaM kaTu ca pittakaraM ; tatrAmlaM sakaphaM pittaM karoti, lavaNaM ca sapittaM kaphaM karoti, kaTu tu savAtaM pittaM karoti| tathA vasantaH shleShmakArako~apyAdAnatvena vAtapitte ca karoti, tathA varShAsvapi pittaM cIyamAnaM sharadi prakupya kaphAnugatameva kupyati, tathA grIShmo vAtacayaM rUkShatvena kurvan uShNatvena manAk pittacayamapi karotItyanusaraNIyam||10||
pUrvAdhyAye srotorUpAdhiShThAnabhedena rogAnabhidhAya prabhAvAdibhedena rogAnabhidhAtuM rogAnIkaM vimAnamucyate| rogAnIkamiti rogasamUhaH||1-2||

na tathetarau doShAviti satyA~api hetusevayetyarthaH; anyathA vAtaprakopaNasevayA pittashleShmaNorvRuddhireva nAsti| vitrAsanAdayo yadyapi vAtakArakAstathA~api vAtajanitonmAdavinAshakatvena coktA iti j~jeyam| unmAde hi vitrAsanAdi bheShajamabhidhAyoktaM- “tena yAti shamaM tasya sarvato viplutaM manaH” (ci.a.9) iti| sarvashaH prayogArthA iti pAnAbhya~ggabastyAdibhiH prayojanIyA ityarthaH| bastiniyama iti bastau yathoktaniyamasevetyarthaH; kiMvA bastiniyamashabdena siddhau vakShyamANakarma-kAla-yogarUpaM bastisa~gkhyAniyamaM kartavyatayA darshayati| vakShyati hi- “triMshanmatAH karmasu bastiyogAH kAlastato~ardhena tatashca yogaH” (si.a.1) iti| sukhashIlatA satatasukhasevitvam||15-16||
sa~ggrahe jarayatIti jaraNo vahniH, taM prati cintA ‘agniShu’ ityAdinA kRutA| prakRutisthApanAnIti bheShajAni||20-22||

tatrApi rogashabdAbhidheyatayA samAne~api doShe tathA vikAre ca parisa~gkhyeyAparisa~gkhyeya(tva)rUpA vigItirastyatha cAdoSha ityabhiprAyeNAha- tatretyAdi| ekaikasmin doShe bahavo vikArA bhavantItyabhiprAyeNa vikArApekShayA doShANAmanatibahutvaM j~jeyam| yathAcitramiti yathAvinyAsaM, tena yAneva pUrvAcAryA vikArAnadhikatamatvenoktavantastAneva vyAkhyAsyAmaH; natu sarvAn, ashakyatvAt| kiMvA, ‘yathocitam ’ iti pAThaH| anavasheSheNa ca doShAnityanena doShA anatibahutvenAnavasheSheNApyabhidhAtuM shakyanta iti prakAshayati| tatra mAnasadoShavikArayoranalpavaktavyatvenAgre~abhidhAnam||5-6||
athAto vyAdhitarUpIyaM vimAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
cikitsitaM tu khalveShAM samAsenopadishya pashcAdvistareNopadekShyAmaH| tatra sarvakrimINAmapakarShaNamevAditaH kAryaM, tataH prakRutivighAtaH, anantaraM nidAnoktAnAM bhAvAnAmanupasevanamiti||14||

tatrApakarShaNaM- hastenAbhigRuhya vimRushyopakaraNavatA~apanayanamanupakaraNena vA; sthAnagatAnAM tu krimINAM bheShajenApakarShaNaM nyAyataH, taccaturvidhaM; tadyathA- shirovirecanaM, vamanaM, virecanam, AsthApanaM ca; ityapakarShaNavidhiH| prakRutivighAtastveShAM kaTutiktakaShAyakShAroShNAnAM dravyANAmupayogaH, yaccAnyadapi ki~jcicchleShmapurIShapratyanIkabhUtaM tat syAt; hati prakRutivighAtaH| anantaraM nidAnoktAnAM bhAvAnAmanupasevanaM- yaduktaM nidAnavidhau tasya vivarjanaM tathAprAyANAM cApareShAM dravyANAm| iti lakShaNatashcikitsitamanuvyAkhyAtam| etadeva punarvistareNopadekShyate||15||

athainaM krimikoShThamAturamagre ShaDrAtraM saptarAtraM vA snehasvedAbhyAmupapAdya shvobhUte enaM saMshodhanaM pAyayitA~asmIti kShIraguDadadhitilamatsyAnUpamAMsapiShTAnnaparamAnnakusumbhasnehasamprayuktairbhojyaiH sAyaM prAtashcopapAdayet samudIraNArthaM krimINAM koShThAbhisaraNArthaM ca bhiShak| atha vyuShTAyAM rAtryAM sukhoShitaM suprajIrNabhaktaM ca vij~jAyAsthApanavamanavirecanaistadaharevopapAdayedupapAdanIyashcet syAt sarvAn parIkShyavisheShAn parIkShya samyak||16||

Commentary: koShThAbhisaraNArthamiti kShIraguDAdilobhena deshAntaraM parityajya koShThagamanArtham| tadahareveti ekasmin dine; etaccaikadina eva bhUrikarmakaraNaM vyAdhiprabhAvAdboddhavyam| etaccaikAhena sarvakaraNaM yadi sharIrabalAdisampadyuktaH puruSho bhavati tadaiva paraM kartavyaM, nAnyathetyAha- upapAdanIyashcet syAdityAdinA||16||

athAhareti brUyAt- mUlakasarShapalashunakara~jjashigrumadhushigrukharapuShpAbhUstRuNasumukhasurasakuTherakagaNDIrakAlamAlakaparNAsakShavakaphaNijjhakAni sarvANyathavA yathAlAbhaM; tAnyAhRutAnyabhisamIkShya khaNDashashchedayitvA prakShAlya pAnIyena suprakShAlitAyAM sthAlyAM samAvApya gomUtreNArdhodakenAbhiShicya sAdhayet satatamavaghaTTayan darvyA, tamupayuktabhUyiShThe~ambhasi gataraseShvauShadheShu sthAlImavatArya suparipUtaM kaShAyaM sukhoShNaM madanaphalapippalIviDa~ggakalkatailopahitaM svarjikAlavaNitamabhyAsicya bastau vidhivadAsthApayedenaM; tathA~arkAlarkakuTajADhakIkuShThakaiDaryakaShAyeNa vA, tathA shigrupIlukustumburukaTukAsarShapakaShAyeNa, tathA~a~amalakashRu~ggaveradAruharidrApicumardakaShAyeNa madanaphalAdisaMyogasampAditena, trivAraM saptarAtraM vA~a~asthApayet||17||

Commentary: madhushigruH shobhA~jjanaH| atra kvAthyadravyajalAdimAnaM kvAthaparibhAShayA kartavyam| upayuktabhUyiShThe prakShINabhUyiShTha ityarthaH| gataraseShvauShadheShviti jale sa~gkrAntaraseShu| anena kaShAyasiddhilakShaNena yAvatA jalena pAkena cauShadhAni gatarasAni bhavanti, tAvadeva jalaM deyaM, tAvAMshca pAkaH kartavyaH, nAvashyaM paribhAShayA sarvatreti kramaM darshayati| suparipUtamiti vastragAlitam| bastau kaShAyAdimAnaM siddhau vakShyamANena j~jeyam| alarkaH mandAraH||17||

pratyAgate ca pashcime bastau pratyAshvastaM tadaharevobhayatobhAgaharaM saMshodhanaM pAyayedyuktyA; tasya vidhirupadekShyate- madanaphalapippalIkaShAyasyArdhA~jjalimAtreNa trivRutkalkAkShamAtramAloDya pAtumasmai prayacchet, tadasya doShamubhayato nirharati sAdhu; evameva kalpoktAni vamanavirecanAni pratisaMsRujya pAyayedenaM buddhyA sarvavisheShAnavekShamANo bhiShak||18||

athainaM samyagviriktaM vij~jAyAparAhNe shaikharikakaShAyeNa sukhoShNena pariShecayet| tenaiva ca kaShAyeNa bAhyAbhyantarAn sarvodakArthAn kArayecchashvat; tadabhAve kaTutiktakaShAyANAmauShadhAnAM kvAthairmUtrakShArairvA pariShecayet| pariShiktaM cainaM nivAtamAgAramanupraveshya pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakashRu~ggaverasiddhena yavAgvAdinA krameNopAcaret, vilepIkramAgataM cainamanuvAsayedviDa~ggatailenaikAntaraM dvistrirvA||19||

yadi punarasyAtipravRuddhA~jchIrShAdAn krimIn manyeta shirasyaivAbhisarpataH kadAcit, tataH snehasvedAbhyAmasya shira upapAdya virecayedapAmArgataNDulAdinA shirovirecanena||20||

Commentary: apAmArgataNDulAdineti apAmArgataNDulIyoktena||20||

yastvabhyavahAryavidhiH prakRutivighAtAyoktaH krimINAmatha tamanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- mUlakaparNIM samUlAgrapratAnAmAhRutya khaNDashashchedayitvolU(dU)khale kShodayitvA pANibhyAM pIDayitvA rasaM gRuhNIyAt, tena rasena lohitashAlitaNDulapiShTaM samAloDya pUpalikAM kRutvA vidhUmeShva~ggAreShUpakuDya viDa~ggatailalavaNopahitAM krimikoShThAya bhakShayituM prayacchet, anantaraM cAmlakA~jjikamudashvidvA pippalyAdipa~jcavargasaMsRuShTaM salavaNamanupAyayet| anena kalpena mArkavArkasahacaranIpanirguNDIsumukhasurasakuTherakagaNDIrakAlamAlakaparNAsakShavakaphaNijjhaka- bakulakuTajasuvarNakShIrIsvarasAnAmanyatamasmin kArayet pUpalikAH; tathA kiNihIkirAtatiktakasuvahAmalakaharItakIbibhItakasvaraseShu kArayet pUpalikAH; svarasAMshcaiteShAmekaikasho dvandvashaH sarvasho vA madhuvilulitAn prAtaranannAya pAtuM prayacchet||21||

Commentary: mUlakaparNI shobhA~jjanaH| upakuDyeti pAcayitvA, ‘kuDa dAhe’, iti dhAtuH paThyate| pippalyAdipa~jcavargo~atraiva peyAdikramoktapa~jcakolam| sahacaraH jhiNTikA| madhuvilulitAniti madhunA~a~aloDitAn||21||

athAshvashakRudAhRutya mahati kili~jjake prastIryAtape shoShayitvodUkhale kShodayitvA dRuShadi punaH sUkShmacUrNAni kArayitvA viDa~ggakaShAyeNa triphalAkaShAyeNa vA~aShTakRutvo dashakRutvo vA~a~atape suparibhAvitAni bhAvayitvA dRuShadi punaH sUkShmANi cUrNAni kArayitvA nave kalashe samAvApyAnuguptaM nidhApayet| teShAM tu khalu cUrNAnAM pANitalaM yAvadvA sAdhu manyeta tat kShaudreNa saMsRujya krimikoShThine leDhuM prayacchet||22||

Commentary: suparItyAdi yathA suparibhAvitAni bhavanti tathA bhAvayitvetyarthaH| anuguptamiti vAtAdyananugamanIyaM kRutarakShaM ca yathA bhavati||22||

tathA bhallAtakAsthInyAhRutya kalashapramANena cApothya snehabhAvite dRuDhe kalashe sUkShmAnekacchidrabradhne sharIramupaveShTya mRudAvalipte samAvApyoDupena pidhAya bhUmAvAkaNThaM nikhAtasya snehabhAvitasyaivAnyasya dRuDhasya kumbhasyopari samAropya samantAdgomayairupacitya dAhayet, sa yadA jAnIyAt sAdhu dagdhAni gomayAni vigatasnehAni ca bhallAtakAsthInIti tatastaM kumbhamuddharet| atha tasmAddvitIyAt kumbhAt snehamAdAya viDa~ggataNDulacUrNaiH snehArdhamAtraiH pratisaMsRujyAtape sarvamahaH sthApayitvA tato~asmai mAtrAM prayacchet pAnAya; tena sAdhu viricyate, viriktasya cAnupUrvI yathoktA| evameva bhadradArusaralakAShThasnehAnupakalpya pAtuM prayacchet||23||
anuvAsayeccainamanuvAsanakAle ||24||

athAhareti brUyAt- shAradAnnavAMstilAn sampadupetAn; tAnAhRutya suniShpUtAnniShpUya, sushuddhAn shodhayitvA , viDa~ggakaShAye sukhoShNe prakShipya nirvApayedAdoShagamanAt, gatadoShAnabhisamIkShya, supralUnAn pralu~jcya, punareva suniShpUtAn niShpUya, sushuddhAn shodhayitvA, viDa~ggakaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH suparibhAvitAn bhAvayitvA, Atape shoShayitvA, ulU(dU)khale sa~gkShudya, dRuShadi punaH shlakShNapiShTAn kArayitvA, droNyAmabhyavadhAya, viDa~ggakaShAyeNa muhurmuhuravasi~jcan pANimardameva mardayet; tasmiMstu khalu prapIDyamAne yattailamudiyAttat pANibhyAM paryAdAya, shucau dRuDhe kalashe nyasyAnuguptaM nidhApayet||25||

Commentary: niShpUyeti mRuttikAdyavakarAnnicitya| shodhayitveti prakShAlya| AdoShagamanAdityatra tiladoShagamanaM tilatvaglagnamalAdigamanaM j~jeyam| pralu~jcya nistuShIkRutya| abhyavadhAyeti Aropya| pANibhyAM paryAdAyeti pANilagnaM punaH punaH punargRuhItvA||25||

athAhareti brUyAt- tilvakoddAlakayordvau bilvamAtrau piNDau shlakShNapiShTau viDa~ggakaShAyeNa, tadardhamAtrau shyAmAtrivRutayoH, ato~ardhamAtrau dantIdravantyoH, ato~ardhamAtrau ca cavyacitrakayoriti| etaM sambhAraM viDa~ggakaShAyasyArdhADhakamAtreNa pratisaMsRujya, tattailaprasthaM samAvApya, sarvamAloDya, mahati paryoge samAsicyAgnAvadhishrityAsane sukhopaviShTaH sarvataH snehamavalokayannajasraM mRudvagninA sAdhayeddarvyA satatamavaghaTTayan| sa yadA jAnIyAdviramati shabdaH, prashAmyati ca phenaH, prasAdamApadyate snehaH, yathAsvaM ca gandhavarNarasotpattiH, saMvartate ca bhaiShajyama~ggulibhyAM mRudyamAnamanatimRudvanatidAruNamana~gguligrAhi ceti, sa kAlastasyAvatAraNAya| tatastamavatArya shItIbhUtamahatena vAsasA paripUya, shucau dRuDhe kalashe samAsicya, pidhAnena pidhAya, shuklena vastrapaTTenAvacchAdya, sUtreNa subaddhaM suniguptaM nidhApayet| tato~asmai mAtrAM prayacchet pAnAya, tena sAdhu viricyate; samyagapahRutadoShasya cAnupUrvI yathoktA| tatashcainamanuvAsayedanuvAsanakAle| etenaiva ca pAkavidhinA sarShapAtasIkara~jjakoShAtakIsnehAnupakalpya pAyayet sarvavisheShAnavekShamANaH| tenAgado bhavati||26||

evaM dvayAnAM shleShmapurIShasambhavAnAM krimINAM samutthAnasaMsthAnavarNanAmaprabhAvacikitsitavisheShA vyAkhyAtAH sAmAnyataH| visheShatastu svalpamAtramAsthApanAnuvAsanAnulomaharaNabhUyiShThaM teShvevauShadheShu purIShajAnAM krimINAM cikitsitaM kartavyaM, mAtrAdhikaM punaH shirovirecanavamanopashamanabhUyiShThaM teShvevauShadheShu shleShmajAnAM krimINAM cikitsitaM kAryam; ityeSha krimighno bheShajavidhiranuvyAkhyAto bhavati| tamanutiShThatA yathAsvaM hetuvarjane prayatitavyam| yathoddeshamevamidaM krimikoShThacikitsitaM yathAvadanuvyAkhyAtaM bhavati||27||

iha khalu dvau puruShau vyAdhitarUpau bhavataH- guruvyAdhitaH, laghuvyAdhitashca| tatra- guruvyAdhita ekaH sattvabalasharIrasampadupetatvAllaghuvyAdhita iva dRushyate, laghuvyAdhito~aparaH sattvAdInAmadhamatvAdguruvyAdhita iva dRushyate| tayorakushalAH kevalaM cakShuShaiva rUpaM dRuShTvA~adhyavasyanto vyAdhigurulAghave vipratipadyante||3||

Commentary: dvAvityAdau vyAdhiH jAto yasya sa vyAdhitaH, tasyeva rUpaM yayostau vyAdhitarUpau; vyAdhitasadRushAvityarthaH| tena, vyAdhitarUpAvityanena gurulaghuvyAdhiyuktasadRushau boddhavyau| yo hi guruvyAdhiH sampannasattvAdinA laghuvyAdhirdRushyate, nAsAvapi laghunA vyAdhinA vyAdhitaH, kiM tu guruvyAdhita evAsau| sa tu guruNaiva vyAdhinA vyAdhito guruvyAdhiradUradarshinA laghuvyAdhiriva dRushyate, evaM viparyAsAllaghuvyAdhito~apara ityAdAvapi vyAkhyeyam| adhamatvAditi hyavaratvAdityarthaH| cakShuShaiveti itaraj~jAnasAdhanopalakShaNaM; tena sparshAdinA~api visheShAnavagAhakeneti boddhavyam| rUpamiti virUpam| adhyavasyanta iti nishcayaM kurvantaH| gurulAghave vipratipadyanta iti gurulaghutve na pratipadyante||3||
bhavanti cAtra- apakarShaNamevAdau krimINAM bheShajaM smRutam| tato vighAtaH prakRuternidAnasya ca varjanam||28||
ayameva vikArANAM sarveShAmapi nigrahe| vidhirdRuShTastridhA yo~ayaM krimInuddishya kIrtitaH||29||
saMshodhanaM saMshamanaM nidAnasya ca varjanam| etAvadbhiShajA kAryaM roge roge yathAvidhi||30||
tatra shlokau- vyAdhitau puruShau j~jAj~jau bhiShajau saprayojanau| viMshatiH krimayasteShAM hetvAdiH saptako gaNaH||31||
ukto vyAdhitarUpIye vimAne paramarShiNA| shiShyasambodhanArthAya vyAdhiprashamanAya ca||32||

nahi j~jAnAvayavena kRutsne j~jeye vij~jAnamutpadyate| vipratipannAstu khalu rogaj~jAne upakramayuktij~jAne cApi vipratipadyante| te yadA guruvyAdhitaM laghuvyAdhitarUpamAsAdayanti, tadA tamalpadoShaM matvA saMshodhanakAle~asmai mRudu saMshodhanaM prayacchanto bhUya evAsya doShAnudIrayanti| yadA tu laghuvyAdhitaM guruvyAdhitarUpamAsAdayanti, tadA taM mahAdoShaM matvA saMshodhanakAle~asmai tIkShNaM saMshodhanaM prayacchanto doShAnatinirhRutya sharIramasya kShiNvanti| evamavayavena j~jAnasya kRutsne j~jeye j~jAnamabhimanyamAnAH pariskhalanti| viditaveditavyAstu bhiShajaH sarvaM sarvathA yathAsambhavaM parIkShyaM parIkShyAdhyavasyanto na kvacidapi vipratipadyante, yatheShTamarthamabhinirvartayanti ceti||4||

Commentary: atraiva viruddhapratipattau hetumAha- nahItyAdi| j~jAnAvayaveneti ekadeshaj~jAnena| vipratipattiphalamAha- vipratipannAstvityAdi| upakramasya bheShajaprayogasya vikAreNa samaM yojanA upakramayuktiH, tasyA j~jAne viruddhapratipattimanto bhavanti| etadeva vyAkaroti- te yadetyAdi| AsAdayantIti budhyante| udIrayantIti prakopayantyeva paraM, natvalpabalatvAddharantItyarthaH| atinirhRutyeti atiyogena hRutvetyarthaH| j~jAnasyeti j~jAnasAdhanasya| yathAsambhavamiti yAni yatra j~jAnasAdhanAni bhavanti, taistatra| parIkShyaM sattvAdi| na kvacidapIti gauravalAghavAdau||4||
bhavanti cAtra- sattvAdInAM vikalpena vyAdhirUpamathAture | dRuShTvA vipratipadyante bAlA vyAdhibalAbale||5||
te bheShajamayogena kurvantyaj~jAnamohitAH| vyAdhitAnAM vinAshAya kleshAya mahate~api vA||6||
prAj~jAstu sarvamAj~jAya parIkShyamiha sarvathA| na skhalanti prayogeShu bheShajAnAM kadAcana||7||

iti vyAdhitarUpAdhikAre vyAdhitarUpasa~gkhyAgrasambhavaM vyAdhitarUpahetuvipratipattau kAraNaM sApavAdaM sampratipattikAraNaM cAnapavAdaM nishamya, bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesho~ataH paraM sarvakrimINAM purIShasaMshrayANAM samutthAnasthAnasaMsthAnavarNanAmaprabhAvacikitsitavisheShAn papracchopasa~ggRuhya pAdau||8||

Commentary: samprati vyAdhigurulAghavasya durj~jeyatAprasa~ggena durj~jeyakrimikhyApakamapi prakaraNamArabhate- iti vyAdhitetyAdi| sa~gkhyAgrasambhavamiti sa~gkhyApramANasambhavamityarthaH; agrashabdo hi parimANavAcI| vyAdhitarUpasya hetuH sattvAdibalavattvAbalavattve, tatkRuto vipratipattirvyAdhitarUpahetuvipratipattiH, tatra| kAraNam ekadeshena j~jAnam| sApavAdamiti sadoSham| samyak pratipattiH sampratipattiH||8||

athAsmai provAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- iha khalvagnivesha! viMshatividhAH krimayaH pUrvamuddiShTA nAnAvidhena pravibhAgenAnyatra sahajebhyaH; te punaH prakRutibhirvibhajyamAnAshcaturvidhA bhavanti; tadyathA- purIShajAH, shleShmajAH, shoNitajA, malajAshceti||9||

Commentary: pUrvamuddiShTA iti aShTodarIye sa~jj~jAmAtrakathitAH| anyatra sahajebhya ityanena sharIrasahajAstvavaikArikAH krimayo viMshaterapyadhikA bhavantIti darshayati| prakRutibhiriti kAraNaiH| malajA iti bAhyamalajAH||9||

tatra malo bAhyashcAbhyantarashca| tatra bAhyamalajAtAn malajAn sa~jcakShmahe | teShAM samutthAnaM- mRujAvarjanaM; sthAnaM- keshashmashrulomapakShmavAsAMsi; saMsthAnam- aNavastilAkRutayo bahupAdAshca; varNaH- kRuShNaH, shuklashca; nAmAni- yUkAH, pipIlikAshca; prabhAvaH- kaNDUjananaM, koThapiDakAbhinirvartanaM ca; cikitsitaM tu khalveShAmapakarShaNaM, malopaghAtaH, malakarANAM ca bhAvAnAmanupasevanamiti||10||

Commentary: pipIlikAM likShAM kecidAhuH| krimINAM sa~jj~jA svashAstravyavahArasiddhA deshAntaraprasiddhA ca boddhavyA| prabhAva iti svashaktisampAdyamityarthaH||10||

shoNitajAnAM tu khalu kuShThaiH samAnaM samutthAnaM; sthAnaM- raktavAhinyo dhamanyaH; saMsthAnam- aNavo vRuttAshcApAdAshca, sUkShmatvAccaike bhavantyadRushyAH; varNaH- tAmraH; nAmAni- keshAdA, lomAdA, lomadvIpAH, saurasA, auDumbarA, jantumAtarashceti; prabhAvaH- keshashmashrunakhalomapakShmApadhvaMsaH, vraNagatAnAM ca harShakaNDUtodasaMsarpaNAni, ativRuddhAnAM ca tvaksirAsnAyumAMsataruNAsthibhakShaNamiti; cikitsitamapyeShAM kuShThaiH samAnaM, taduttarakAlamupadekShyAmaH||11||

Commentary: harShakaNDvAdayo vraNadesha eva j~jeyAH||11||

shleShmajAH kShIraguDatilamatsyAnUpamAMsapiShTAnnaparamAnnakusumbhasnehAjIrNapUtiklinnasa~gkIrNaviruddhAsAtmyabhojanasamutthAnAH; teShAmAmAshayaH sthAnaM, te pravardhamAnAstUrdhvamadho vA visarpantyubhayato vA; saMsthAnavarNavisheShAstu- shvetAH pRuthubradhnasaMsthAnAH kecit, kecidvRuttapariNAhA gaNDUpadAkRutayaH shvetAstAmrAvabhAsAshca, kecidaNavo dIrghAstantvAkRutayaH shvetAH; teShAM trividhAnAM shleShmanimittAnAM krimINAM nAmAni- antrAdAH, udarAdAH, hRudayacarAH , curavaH, darbhapuShpAH, saugandhikAH, mahAgudAshceti; prabhAvo- hRullAsaH, AsyasaMsravaNam, arocakAvipAkau, jvaraH, mUrcchA, jRumbhA, kShavathuH, AnAhaH, a~ggamardaH, chardiH kArshyaM, pAruShyaM, ceti||12||

Commentary: paramAnnaM pAyasam| sa~gkIrNabhojanaM ghRuNAviShayamalAdimishritavya~jjanAdibhojanam| bradhnaH carmalatA||12||

purIShajAstulyasamutthAnAH shleShmajaiH; teShAM sthAnaM pakvAshayaH, te pravardhamAnAstvadho visarpanti, yasya punarAmAshayAbhimukhAH syuryadantaraM tadantaraM tasyodgAraniHshvAsAH purIShagandhinaH syuH; saMsthAnavarNavisheShAstu- sUkShmavRuttaparINAhAH shvetA dIrghA UrNAMshusa~gkAshAH kecit, kecit punaH sthUlavRuttaparINAhAH shyAvanIlaharitapItAH; teShAM nAmAni kakerukAH, makerukAH, lelihAH; sashUlakAH, sausurAdAshceti; prabhAvaH- purIShabhedaH, kArshyaM, pAruShyaM, lomaharShAbhinirvartanaM ca, ta eva cAsya gudamukhaM paritudantaH kaNDUM copajanayanto gudamukhaM paryAsate, ta eva jAtaharShA gudaniShkramaNamativelaM kurvanti; ityeSha shleShmajAnAM purIShajAnAM ca krimINAM samutthAnAdivisheShaH||13||

Commentary: yadantaramiti yasmin kAle, tadantaraM tatkAlameva| UrNAMshusa~gkAshA iti meShalomatulyAH| paryAsata iti kShipanti, kiMvA gudaM parivAryAsate| ativelamiti punaH punaH||13||
pUrvAdhyAye vyAdhiM pratipAdya vyAdhitasya puruShasya bhedaM cikitsopayogitayA pratipAdayituM tathA tatprasa~ggAcca krimIn pratipAdayituM vyAdhitarUpIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

apakarShaNaM hastAdi saMshodhanAni ca| prakRuteH kAraNasya shleShmAdirUpasya vighAtaH prakRutivighAta ityarthaH| upakaraNavateti sandaMshAdyupakaraNayuktena| tat syAditi vighAtaH syAditi yojanA| nidAnoktAnAM bhAvAnAmanupasevanamiti vivaraNAnuvAdaH| asya vivaraNaM- yaduktamityAdi| tathAprAyANAmiti shleShmajapurIShajakriminidAnasadRushAnAmityarthaH| lakShaNata iti sa~gkShepataH; sa~gkShepo hi vistarasya grAhakaM lakShaNaM bhavati||14-15||

pashcime tRutIyapuTake| saMsRujyeti mishrIkRutya| shaikharikakaShAyeNeti viDa~ggakaShAyeNa, viDa~ggakaShAyo hi vaidyakavyavahArAt shaikharikakaShAya ucyate| vilepyAH kramAgatamiti kRutayavAgvAdikramamityarthaH||18-19||
bradhnaH gudaH, iha tu kalashAdhobhAgaH| sharIramupaveShTyeti veShTayitvA| uDupaH pidhAnam| sa iti bhallAtakasnehasAdhakaH| dvitIyAditi adhaHsthAdghaTAt||23-24||

uddAlakaH bahuvAraH| bilvamAtrau palapramANau| paryogaH kaTAhaH| yathAsvamiti yAvanmAtraM yaddravyaM tailasaMskArakaM, tadAnurUpyeNa varNAdisampattirityarthaH| saMvartate iti vartivadbhavati| alpamAtramiti AsthApanAnulomaharaNadravyAtiriktaM bheShajamalpamAtraM kartavyamityarthaH||26-27||
etadevApakarShaNAditrayaM rogAntare shabdAntareNocyata ityAha- ayamevetyAdi| atra saMshodhanamapaharaNaM, saMshamanaM vighAtaH, nidAnavarjanaM tu shabdenApi samAnam||28-32||

etadeva sukhagrahaNArthaM shlokenAha- sattvetyAdi| vyAdhirUpamiti vyAdhergatirUpamityarthaH| ‘vyAdhitarUpam’ iti tu pAThaH sugamaH| bAlA iti alpaj~jAH| atiyogeneti asamyagyogena; tenAtiyogamithyAyogayorgrahaNaM bhavati||5-7||
athAto rogabhiShagjitIyaM vimAnaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

sambhAShAvidhimata UrdhvaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH- bhiShak bhiShajA saha sambhASheta| tadvidyasambhAShA hi j~jAnAbhiyogasaMharShakarI bhavati, vaishAradyamapi cAbhinirvartayati, vacanashaktimapi cAdhatte, yashashcAbhidIpayati, pUrvashrute ca sandehavataH punaH shravaNAcchrutasaMshayamapakarShati, shrute cAsandehavato bhUyo~adhyavasAyamabhinirvartayati, ashrutamapi ca ka~jcidarthaM shrotraviShayamApAdayati, yaccAcAryaH shiShyAya shushrUShave prasannaH krameNopadishati guhyAbhimatamarthajAtaM tat paraspareNa saha jalpan piNDena vijigIShurAha saMharShAt, tasmAttadvidyasambhAShAmabhiprashaMsanti kushalAH||15||
dvividhA tu khalu tadvidyasambhAShA bhavati- sandhAyasambhAShA, vigRuhyasambhAShA ca||16||

vayastashceti kAlapramANavisheShApekShiNI hi sharIrAvasthA vayo~abhidhIyate| tadvayo yathAsthUlabhedena trividhaM- bAlaM, madhyaM, jIrNamiti| tatra bAlamaparipakvadhAtumajAtavya~jjanaM sukumAramakleshasahamasampUrNabalaM shleShmadhAtuprAyamAShoDashavarShaM, vivardhamAnadhAtuguNaM punaH prAyeNAnavasthitasattvamAtriMshadvarShamupadiShTaM; madhyaM punaH samatvAgatabalavIryapauruShaparAkramagrahaNadhAraNasmaraNavacanavij~jAnasarvadhAtuguNaM balasthitamavasthitasattvamavishIryamANadhAtuguNaM pittadhAtuprAyamAShaShTivarShamupadiShTam; ataH paraM hIyamAnadhAtvindriyabalavIryapauruShaparAkramagrahaNadhAraNasmaraNavacanavij~jAnaM bhrashyamAnadhAtuguNaM vAyudhAtuprAyaM krameNa jIrNamucyate AvarShashatam| varShashataM khalvAyuShaH pramANamasmin kAle; santi ca punaradhikonavarShashatajIvino~api manuShyAH; teShAM vikRutivarjyaiH prakRutyAdibalavisheShairAyuSho lakShaNatashca pramANamupalabhya vayasastritvaM vibhajet||122||

Commentary: vayaHsvarUpamAha- kAletyAdi| kAlapramANavisheShApekShiNIti kAlasya pramANavisheSheNa yogAdbhavatItyarthaH| yathAsthUlabhedenetivacanAd bAlabAlatarAdyavasthAbhedAdadhikamapi vayo bhavatIti darshayati| bAlo dvividhaH- aparipakvadhAturAShoDashavarShAt, tathA vardhamAnadhAturAtrishattamAt | tadetayorbAlabhedayorupayuktatvena bhedamAha- tatretyAdi| ShoDashavarShIyo hi bAlo~alpamRudubheShajopacaryatvAdinA shAstre vaktavyaH, tadUrdhvaM bAlo~api nAlpabheShajatvAdinA tathopacaryate| krameNeti naikadaiva, ShaShTivarShAdUrdhvaM dhAtvAdihAniriti darshayati| asmin kAla iti kalau| athAdhikavarShashatajIvinAM kathaM vayastritvaM vibhaktavyamityAha- teShAmityAdi| prakRutyAdayo dasha parIkShyA atraiva prakRutivikRutisAretyAdinoktAH; atra vikRutivarjyAnAmityanena vikRuteH parityAgaH kRutaH| tena prakRutisArAdInAM balavisheShaiH pravarAvaramadhyabhedabhinnaprakRutyAdibhedena kRutaiH pravarAvaramadhyarUpairAyuShaH pramANaM pravarAvarAdyupalabhya vayastritvaM vibhajanIyam| etena yasya prakRutibalamuttamaM shleShmaprakRuteH samaprakRutervA tasyAyudIrghaM bhavati, hIne tu prakRutibale hInam; evaM sArAdAvapi j~jeyam| evaM vayaHprakRutyAdInAM sarveShAmevottamena balena yuktaH sa shatAdhikaM jIvati| tena, tasya viMshativarShAdhikashataM yadyAyurupalabhyate, tadA pUrvoktavayovibhAgAnumAnAdAShaTtriMshadvarShANi sa bAlo bhavati, dvisaptativarShashca sa madhyaH, sheShe tu vRuddhaH; yastu prakRutyAdInAM madhyamatvenAlpAyurashItivarSho~avadhAryate, sa pa~jcaviMshativarShANi bAlaH, pa~jcAshataM madhyaH, tato vRuddha ityAdi vibhajanIyam| na kevalaM prakRutyAdinA~a~ayuravadhAryaM, kintvAyurlakShaNairapi sharIrapratibaddhaiH shArIre vaktavyairityAha - AyuSho lakShaNatashceti| AyurlakShaNenApi vayo~avadhArya bAlyAdivayovibhAgaH kartavya ityarthaH| ayaM ca stokanyUnAdhikashatAyuShAM bAlyAdivibhAgaH kartavyaH; yeShAM tu viMshativarShAdi paramAyuSho mAnaM na teShAM tadanumAnena vayobhedaH, te hyaprAptamadhyAvasthA eva mriyante||122||

evaM prakRutyAdInAM vikRutivarjyAnAM bhAvAnAM pravaramadhyAvaravibhAgena balavisheShaM vibhajet| vikRutibalatraividhyena tu doShabalaM trividhamanumIyate| tato bhaiShajyasya tIkShNamRudumadhyavibhAgena traividhyaM vibhajya yathAdoShaM bhaiShajyamavacArayediti||123||

Commentary: prakRutyAdivibhAgena sharIrabalaparIkShAmuktAmupasaMharati- evamityAdi| doShabalaM tu yathA sharIrarUpadeshaparIkShayA parIkShyaM tadAha- vikRutibaletyAdi||123||

AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnahetoH punarindriyeShu jAtisUtrIye ca lakShaNAnyupadekShyante||124||

Commentary: sharIrabaladoShabalaparIkShArthaM sharIraparIkShAM pratij~jAtAmabhidhAya punarAyuH pramANaj~jAnArthaM sharIraparIkShAmatidishati- AyuSha ityAdi| indriyeShviti indriyasthAnAdhyAyeShu| tatrendriye varNAdivikRutyA riShTarUpayA hrasitamAyurj~jAtavyaM, jAtisUtrIye shArIre ca janmapratibaddhairlakShaNairdIrghAyuShTvamalpAyuShTvaM ca j~jAtavyam ||124||

kAlaH punaH saMvatsarashcAturAvasthA ca| tatra saMvatsaro dvidhA tridhA ShoDhA dvAdashadhA bhUyashcApyataH pravibhajyate tattatkAryamabhisamIkShya| atra khalu tAvat ShoDhA pravibhajya kAryamupadekShyate- hemanto grIShmo varShAshceti shItoShNavarShalakShaNAstraya Rutavo bhavanti, teShAmantareShvitare sAdhAraNalakShaNAstraya RutavaH- prAvRuTsharadvasantA iti| prAvRuDiti prathamaH pravRuShTaH kAlaH, tasyAnubandho hi varShAH| evamete saMshodhanamadhikRutya ShaT vibhajyante RutavaH||125||

Commentary: deshaparIkShAM samApya kAlaparIkShAmAha- kAla ityAdi| saMvatsaro~ayanabhedena dvividhaH, shItoShNavarShabhedena trividhaH, Rutubhedena ShoDhA, mAsabhedena dvAdashadhA, pakShabhedAccaturviMshatidhA , praharAdinA~anekadheti j~jeyam| tattat kAryamiti ayanAdij~jeyabhedena sampAdyaM kAryamityarthaH| sAdhAraNa iti anatishItoShNavarShaH| prAvRuShaM vibhajate- prAvRuDityAdi| prathamapravRuShTashabdenA~a~aShADhashrAvaNAvucyete| etacca dvimAsamRutubhedabhAgamAdiM kRutvA sheShamAsadvikena varShAdayo yathAkramaM j~jeyAH| ayaM ca Rutukramo na rasotpattyAdau, kintu sharIrashodhanapravRuttAveveti darshayatA ‘saMshodhanamadhikRutya’ ityuktam, evameva ca kramaM siddhau vakShyati- “prAvRuT shukranabhau j~jeyau sharadUrjasahau punaH| tapasyashca madhushcaiva vasantaH shodhanaM prati” (si.a.6) iti| asminnRutukrame shishiro nAsti| ye tu bruvate- ga~ggAyA dakShiNakUle varShA bahu bhavati tena tatra prAvRuDAdikramaH, ga~ggottarakUle shItaM bahu bhavati tena tatra hemantashishirau bhavataH; uktaM hi kAshyapena- yat- “bhUyo varShati parjanyo ga~ggAyA dakShiNe jalam| tena prAvRuDavarShAkhyau RutU teShAM prakalpitau|| ga~ggAyA uttare kUle himavadambusa~gkule | bhUyaH shItamatasteShAM hemantashishirAvRutU” iti| ettacca na, atra ‘saMshodhanamadhikRutya’ iti vacanAt| yadi deshakRuto~ayaM bhedaH syAttadA tameva bhedakaM brUyAt, na saMshodhanam| tena, kAshyapoktadeshabhedena prAvRuDAdikramo na tAvadihAbhimataH| avikalpakAshca sharIrauShadhAnAmiti na sharIrasya kRutrimatApAditaguNena bhedakAH, tathauShadhasya ca na pramANotkarShApakarShabhedakArakA ityarthaH| vikalpakAshca sharIrauShadhAnAmiti yadA~a~atyayikatvenAvashyakartavyA bhavanti vamanAdayaH, tadauShadhasya kRutrimaguNopadhAnena yathAvakShyamANena, tathA sharIrasya ca vikalpakA bhavanti||125||

tatra sAdhAraNalakShaNeShvRutuShu vamanAdInAM pravRuttirvidhIyate, nivRuttiritareShu| sAdhAraNalakShaNA hi mandashItoShNavarShatvAt sukhatamAshca bhavantyavikalpakAshca sharIrauShadhAnAm, itare punaratyarthashItoShNavarShatvAdduHkhatamAshca bhavanti vikalpakAshca sharIrauShadhAnAm||126||

tatra hemante hyatimAtrashItopahatatvAccharIramasukhopapannaM bhavatyatishItavAtAdhmAtamatidAruNIbhUtamavabaddhadoShaM ca, bheShajaM punaH saMshodhanArthamuShNasvabhAvamatishItopahatatvAnmandavIryatvamApadyate, tasmAttayoH saMyoge saMshodhanamayogAyopapadyate sharIramapi ca vAtopadravAya| grIShme punarbhRushoShNopahatatvAccharIramasukhopapannaM bhavatyuShNavAtAtapAdhmAtamatishithilamatyarthapravilInadoShaM, bheShajaM punaH saMshodhanArthamuShNasvabhAvamuShNAnugamanAttIkShNataratvamApadyate, tasmAttayoH saMyoge saMshodhanamatiyogAyopapadyate sharIramapi pipAsopadravAya| varShAsu tu meghajalAvatate gUDhArkacandratAre dhArAkule viyati bhUmau pa~gkajalapaTalasaMvRutAyAmatyarthopaklinnasharIreShu bhUteShu vihatasvabhAveShu ca kevaleShvauShadhagrAmeShu toyatoyadAnugatamArutasaMsargAd gurupravRuttIni vamanAdIni bhavanti, gurusamutthAnAni ca sharIrANi| tasmAdvamanAdInAM nivRuttirvidhIyate varShAnteShvRutuShu , na cedAtyayikaM karma| Atyayike punaH karmaNi kAmamRutuM vikalpya kRutrimaguNopadhAnena yathartuguNaviparItena bheShajaM saMyogasaMskArapramANavikalpenopapAdya pramANavIryasamaM kRutvA tataH prayojayeduttamena yatnenAvahitaH||127||

AturAvasthAsvapi tu kAryAkAryaM prati kAlAkAlasa~jj~jA; tadyathA- asyAmavasthAyAmasya bheShajasyAkAlaH , kAlaH punaranyasyeti; etadapi hi bhavatyavasthAvisheSheNa; tasmAdAturAvasthAsvapi hi kAlAkAlasa~jj~jA| tasya parIkShA- muhurmuhurAturasya sarvAvasthAvisheShAvekShaNaM yathAvadbheShajaprayogArtham| na hyatipatitakAlamaprAptakAlaM vA bheShajamupayujyamAnaM yaugikaM bhavati; kAlo hi bhaiShajyaprayogaparyAptimabhinirvartayati||128||

Commentary: AturAvasthAlakShaNaM kAlamAha- AturAvasthAsvityAdi| tatrodAharaNaM yathA- navajvare na kaShAyakAlaH, atikrAntaShaDahe jvare kaShAyakAla ityAdi| bhaiShajyaprayogaparyAptimiti bheShajaprayogasAdhyasiddhimityarthaH ||128||

pravRuttistu pratikarmasamArambhaH| tasya lakShaNaM bhiShagauShadhAturaparicArakANAM kriyAsamAyogaH||129||

Commentary: kAlamabhidhAya kramaprAptAM pravRuttimAha- pravRuttistvityAdi| pratikarma cikitsA||129||

upAyaH punarbhiShagAdInAM sauShThavamabhividhAnaM ca samyak| tasya lakShaNaM- bhiShagAdInAM yathoktaguNasampat deshakAlapramANasAtmyakriyAdibhishca siddhikAraNaiH samyagupapAditasyauShadhasyAvacAraNamiti||130||

Commentary: parishiShTamupAyamAha- upAya ityAdi| yathoktaguNasampadityanena sauShThavamuktam||130||

evamete dasha parIkShyavisheShAH pRuthak pRuthak parIkShitavyA bhavanti||131||

Commentary: evamityAdinA tu samyagabhividhAnaM brUte||131||

parIkShAyAstu khalu prayojanaM pratipattij~jAnam| pratipattirnAma yo vikAro yathA pratipattavyastasya tathA~anuShThAnaj~jAnam||132||

Commentary: kiMprayojanA parIkShetyasyottaraM- parIkShAyAstvityAdi| pratipattishabdArthaM vibhajate- ya ityAdi| pratipattavya iti anuShThAnena yojayitavyaH||132||

yatra tu khalu vamanAdInAM pravRuttiH, yatra ca nivRuttiH, tadvyAsataH siddhiShUttaramupadekShyAmaH||133||

Commentary: ‘kva ca vamanAdInAM pravRuttiH, kva ca nivRuttiH’ ityasyottaramatideshenAha- yatra tvityAdi||133||

pravRuttinivRuttilakShaNasaMyoge tu gurulAghavaM sampradhArya samyagadhyavasyedanyataraniShThAyAm| santi hi vyAdhayaH shAstreShUtsargApavAdairupakramaM prati nirdiShTAH| tasmAdgurulAghavaM sampradhArya samyagadhyavasyedityuktam||134||

Commentary: ‘pravRuttinivRuttilakShaNasaMyoge kiM naiShThikam’ ityasyottaraM- pravRuttItyAdi| adhyavasyediti adhyavasAyaM kuryAdityarthaH| anyataraniShThAyAmiti anyatarapakShavyavasthAyAm| atra gurulAghave j~jAte gurupratikriyAnishcayo~anukto~api j~jAyate; tena shAstrakAreNa guruvyAdhipratIkAraniShThAyAmadhyavasAyaM kuryAditi sAkShAnna kRutam| etadeva guruvyAdhipratIkAraM laghuvyAdhyupapAdakena vacanabha~ggyantareNAha- santi hItyAdi| samyagadhyavasyediti utsargalaghuM parityajyApavAdagurumupakramyatayA~adhyavasyet; balavantamupadravaM vetyAdinA hi durbalaM parityajya balavaccikitsAmabhidhAsyati||134||

yAni tu khalu vamanAdiShu bheShajadravyANyupayogaM gacchanti tAnyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH| tadyathA- phalajImUtakekShvAkudhAmArgavakuTajakRutavedhanaphalAni, phalajImUtakekShvAkudhAmArgavapatrapuShpANi AragvadhavRukShakamadanasvAdukaNTakapAThApATalAshAr~ggeShTAmUrvAsaptaparNanaktamAlapicumardapaTolasuShavIguDUcI- citrakasomavalkashatAvarIdvIpIshigrumUlakaShAyaiH, madhukamadhUkakovidArakarvudAranIpavidulabimbIshaNapuShpIsadApuShpApratyakpuShpAkaShAyaishca, elAhareNupriya~ggupRuthvIkAkustumburutagaranaladahrIveratAlIshoshIrakaShAyaishca , ikShukANDekShvikShuvAlikAdarbhapoTagalakAla~gkRu(~gka)takaShAyaishca, sumanAsaumanasyAyanIharidrAdAruharidrAvRushcIrapunarnavAmahAsahAkShudrasahAkaShAyaishca, shAlmalishAlmalikabhadraparNyelAparNyupodikoddAlakadhanvanarAjAdanopacitrAgopIshRu~ggATikAkaShAyaishca, pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakashRu~ggaverasarShapaphANitakShIrakShAralavaNodakaishca, yathAlAbhaM yatheShTaM vA~apyupasaMskRutya vartikriyAcUrNAvalehasnehakaShAyamAMsarasayavAgUyUShakAmbalikakShIropadheyAnmodakAnanyAMshca bhakShyaprakArAn vividhAnanuvidhAya yathArhaM vamanArhAya dadyAdvidhivadvamanam| iti kalpasa~ggraho vamanadravyANAm| kalpameShAM vistAreNottarakAlamupadekShyAmaH||135||

Commentary: samprati ‘kAni ca vamanAdiShu bheShajadravyANi yogaM gacchanti’ ityasyottaraM- yAnItyAdI| shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA, somavalkaH khadiraH; suShavI kAravellakaH| dvIpI kaNTakArI, dvIpishatruriti pAThe shatAvarI j~jeyA| vidulo vetasaH, shatapuShpA ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpA raktArkaH | kAla~gkRuto kAsamardaH , poTagalo hoggalaH| sumanA jAtI, saumanasyAyanI jAtikalikA jAtikoSho vA| shAlmaliko rohitakaH, svalpashAlmalirvA, bhadraparNI bhAdAlI, elAparNI rAsnA, uddAlaH bahuvAraH, gopI sArivA| vartikriyA vartirUpadIrghabhakShyakaraNam| atra ‘AragvadhAdi’ ‘madhvAdi’ iti pRuthagvargakaraNaM prAyaH samAnaguNatAM vicchedapAThena darshayituM kRutam| kalpanaM kalpaH prayoga ityarthaH| uttarakAlamiti kalpasthAne||135||

virecanadravyANi tu shyAmAtrivRuccatura~ggulatilvakamahAvRukShasaptalAsha~gkhinIdantIdravantInAM kShIramUlatvakpatrapuShpaphalAni yathAyogaM taistaiH kShIramUlatvakpatrapuShpaphalairvikliptAvikliptaiH , ajagandhAshvagandhAjashRu~ggIkShIriNInIlinIklItakakaShAyaishca, prakIryodakIryAmasUravidalAkampillakaviDa~ggagavAkShIkaShAyaishca, pIlupriyAlamRudvIkAkAshmaryaparUShakabadaradADimAmalakaharItakIbibhItakavRushcIrapunarnavAvidArigandhAdikaShAyaishca, sIdhusurAsauvIrakatuShodakamaireyamedakamadirAmadhumadhUlakadhAnyAmlakuvalabadarakharjUrakarkandhubhishca, dadhidadhimaNDodashvidbhishca, gomahiShyajAvInAM ca kShIramUtrairyathAlAbhaM yatheShTaM vA~apyupasaMskRutya vartikriyAcUrNAsavalehasnehakaShAyamAMsarasayUShakAmbalikayavAgUkShIropadheyAn modakAnanyAMshca bhakShyapra(vi)kArAn vividhAMshca yogAnanuvidhAya yathArhaM virecanArhAya dadyAdvirecanam| iti kalpasa~ggraho virecanadravyANAm| kalpameShAM vistareNa yathAvaduttarakAlamupadekShyAmaH||136||

Commentary: vikliptiH dravyAntarasaMyogaH, avikliptiH kevalaprayogaH; tena vikliptAvikliptairiti saMyuktAyuktairityarthaH| kShIriNI dugdhikA, klItakaM yaShTImadhu| masUravidalA shyAmalatA| prathamaM tu shyAmA shyAmamUlA trivRudevoktA||136||

AsthApaneShu tu bhUyiShThakalpAni dravyANi yAni yogamupayAnti teShu teShvavasthAntareShvAturANAM, tAni dravyANi nAmato vistareNopadishyamAnAnyaparisa~gkhyeyAni syuratibahutvAt; iShTashcAnatisa~gkShepavistaropadeshastantre, iShTaM ca kevalaM j~jAnaM, tasmAdrasata eva tAnyatra vyAkhyAsyAmaH| rasasaMsargavikalpavistaro hyeShAmaparisa~gkhyeyaH, samavetAnAM rasAnAmaMshAMshabalavikalpAtibahutvAt| tasmAddravyANAM caikadeshamudAharaNArthaM raseShvanuvibhajya rasaikaikashyena ca nAmalakShaNArthaM ShaDAsthApanaskandhA rasato~anuvibhajya vyAkhyAstante||137||

Commentary: bhUyiShThakalpAnIti bahuprayogANi prAyaHprayojyAni ca| iShTashcAnatisa~gkShepavistaropadesha iti anatisa~gkShepavistareNa shAstre kathanamiShTam| iShTaM ca kevalaM j~jAnamiti anatisa~gkShepavistarAbhidhAnena yadanuktaM tasyApi yathAsAmAnyadvArA j~jAnaM bhavati tadapIShTaM granthakartuH shrotushcetyarthaH| tasmAdrasata eveti rasaM prAdhAnyenoddishya rasAshrayadravyasyAnatisa~gkShepavistAropadeshenetyarthaH| tAnIti AsthApanopayogIni dravyANi| atra ca rasadvArA nirdeshe~api rasasaMsargasyAtibahutvena kRutsnadravyanirdeshavadasa~gkhyeyatA syAditi kRutvA ShaDbhireva rasairnirdeshaH kartavya AsthApanopayogidravyANAmiti darshayannAha- rasetyAdi| udAharaNArthamiti madhurAdirasasyAdhArabhUtasya dravyasyodAharaNArtham| raseShvanuvibhajyeti raseShu madhurAdiShu dravyANAmekadeshamAdhAratayopadishyetyarthaH| rasaikaikashyeneti na rasasaMsargeNa| nAmalakShaNArthaM ShaDAsthApanaskandhA iti sAkShAduktAnAM jIvakAdInAM nAmArthaM, tathA anuktAnAM madhurAdidravyANAM tajjAtIyatvena lakShaNArthamAsthApanayogidravyasamUhA vyAkhyAsyanta iti; kiMvA, nAmalakShaNArthamiti nAmaj~jAnArtham| AsthApyate~aneneti AsthApanaM jIvakAdidravyaM; skandhaH samUhaH| rasato~anuvibhajyeti madhurAdirasatayA nirdishyetyarthaH||137||

yattu ShaDvidhamAsthApanamekarasamityAcakShate bhiShajaH, taddurlabhatamaM saMsRuShTarasabhUyiShThatvAddravyANAm| tasmAnmadhurANi madhuraprAyANi madhuravipAkAni madhuraprabhAvANi ca madhuraskandhe madhurANyeva kRutvopadekShyante, tathetarANi dravyANyapi||138||

Commentary: ayaM ca madhurAdirasena dravyagaNanirdesho na madhurAdyekarasasyaiva dravyasya sa~ggraheNa yathA parairAkhyAyate tathA~asmAbhirapIShyate, kintu yatra satyapi rasAntare madhurAdayaH pradhAnaM, yadvA dravyaM madhurAdikAryakAri vipAkaprabhAvAt , tadapi madhurAdigaNa evAsmAbhiH paThanIyamiti darshayannAha- yattvityAdi| ekarasamiti shuddhaikarasam| madhuraprAyANIti utkRuShTamadhurarasAni| tathetarANIti amlAdIni amlaprAyANi amlapAkAni ca amlameva kRutvopadekShyAmaH; tathA lavaNAdiShvapyevameva tathetarANItipadena darshayati||138||

tadyathA- jIvakarShabhakau jIvantI vIrA tAmalakI kAkolI kShIrakAkolI mudgaparNI mAShaparNI shAlaparNI pRushniparNyasanaparNI madhuparNI medA mahAmedA karkaTashRu~ggI shRu~ggATikA chinnaruhA cchatrA~aticchatrA shrAvaNI mahAshrAvaNI sahadevA vishvadevA shuklA kShIrashuklA balA~atibalA vidArI kShIravidArI kShudrasahA mahAsahA RuShyagandhA~ashvagandhA vRushcIraH punarnavA bRuhatI kaNTakArikorubUko moraTaH shvadaMShTrA saMharShA shatAvarI shatapuShpA madhUkapuShpI yaShTImadhu madhUlikA mRudvIkA kharjUraM parUShakamAtmaguptA puShkarabIjaM kasherukaM rAjakasherukaM rAjAdanaM katakaM kAshmaryaM shItapAkyodanapAkI tAlakharjUramastakamikShurikShuvAlikA darbhaH kushaH kAshaH shAlirgundretkaTakaH sharamUlaM rAjakShavakaH RuShyaproktA dvAradA bhAradvAjI vanatrapuShyabhIrupatrI haMsapAdI kAkanAsikA kuli~ggAkShI kShIravallI kapolavallI kapotavallI somavallI gopavallI madhuvallI ceti; eShAmevaMvidhAnAmanyeShAM ca madhuravargaparisa~gkhyAtAnAmauShadhadravyANAM chedyAni khaNDashashchedayitvA bhedyAni cANusho bhedayitvA prakShAlya pAnIyena suprakShAlitAyAM sthAlyAM samAvApya payasA~ardhodakenAbhyAsicya sAdhayeddarvyA satatamavaghaTTayan; tadupayuktabhUyiShThe~ambhasi gataraseShvauShadheShu payasi cAnupadagdhe sthAlImupahRutya suparipUtaM payaH sukhoShNaM ghRutatailavasAmajjalavaNaphANitopahitaM bastiM vAtavikAriNe vidhij~jo vidhivaddadyAt; shItaM tu madhusarpirbhyAmupasaMsRujya pittavikAriNe vidhivaddadyAt| iti madhuraskandhaH||139||

Commentary: vIrA jAlandharaM shAkam| asa(sha)naparNI aparAjitA| madhuparNI vika~gkatam| chatrA kokilAkShaH| aticchatrA aruNakokilAkShaH| mahAshrAvaNI alambuShA| shuklA sharkarA| kShIrashuklA bRuhacchRu~ggATikA | kShudrasahA kumArI| RuShyagandhA RuShyajA~ggalakaH, balAbhedo vA| moraTaH mUrvA| saMharShA bandAkaH| madhukaparNI madhukabhedaH| madhUlikA markaTahastatRuNam| rAjAdanaM ve~jculikIti khyAtam| kasheruH ci~jcoDakaH| rAjakasheruH kasherubhedaH| shItapAkI shItalA| odanapAkI nIlajhiNTI| RuShyaproktA balAbhedaH| dvAradA shAkataruH| bhAradvAjI vanakArpAsI| vanatrapuShI bRuhatphalA goDumbA| abhIrupatrI shatAvarIbhedaH| kuli~ggAkShI peTikA, kuli~ggApAThapakShe uccaTA| kShIravallI kShIralatA| kapolapallI ‘kavaDaveNDuA’ iti khyAtA| kapotavallI sUkShmailA| somavallI somalatA| gopavallI anantamUlam| madhuvallI yaShTImadhubhedaH||139||

AmrAmrAtakalakucakaramardavRukShAmlAmlavetasakuvalabadaradADimamAtulu~ggagaNDIrAmalakanandItakashItaka- tintiNDIkadantashaThairAvatakakoshAmradhanvanAnAM phalAni, patrANi cAmrAtakAshmantakacA~ggerINAM caturvidhAnAM cAmlikAnAM dvayoshca kolayoshcAmashuShkayordvayoshcaiva shuShkAmlikayorgrAmyAraNyayoH, AsavadravyANi ca surAsauvIrakatuShodakamaireyamedakamadirAmadhushuktashIdhudadhidadhimaNDodashviddhAnyAmlAdIni ca, eShAmevaMvidhAnAmanyeShAM cAmlavargaparisa~gkhyAtAnAmauShadhadravyANAM chedyAni khaNDashashchedayitvA bhedyAni cANusho bhedayitvA dravaiH sthAlyAmabhyAsicya sAdhayitvopasaMskRutya yathAvattailavasAmajjalavaNaphANitopahitaM sukhoShNaM bastiM vAtavikAriNe vidhij~jo vidhivaddadyAt| ityamlaskandhaH||140||

Commentary: amlaskandhe nandItakaH karparanandI, shItakaH amlaloTaH, airAvataH nAgara~ggam| amlikA kandapradhAnA kAmarUpe prasiddhA amlikAbheda evetyAhuH| dravaiH sthirANIti dravamajjanAt sthirIbhUtAnItyarthaH(?)||140||

saindhavasauvarcalakAlaviDapAkyAnUpakUpyavAlukailamaulakasAmudraromakaudbhidauSharapATeyakapAMshujAnyevamprakArANi cAnyAni lavaNavargaparisa~gkhyAtAni, etAnyamlopahitAnyuShNodakopahitAni vA snehavanti sukhoShNaM bastiM vAtavikAriNe vidhij~jo vidhivaddadyAt| iti lavaNaskandhaH||141||

Commentary: kUpyAdayo lavaNabhedA deshAntaraprasiddhAH; tena deshAntarIyebhyo j~jeyAH| romakaM rUmAnadIbhavam||141||

pippalIpippalImUlahastipippalIcavyacitrakashRu~ggaveramaricAjamodArdrakaviDa~ggakustumburupIlutejovatyelAkuShTha- bhallAtakAsthihi~gguniryAsakilimamUlakasarShapalashunakara~jjashigrukamadhushigrukakharapuShpabhUstRuNasumukhasurasakuTherakArjaka- gaNDIrakAlamAlakaparNAsakShavakaphaNijjhakakShAramUtrapittAnIti; eShAmevaMvidhAnAM cAnyeShAM kaTukavargaparisa~gkhyAtAnAmauShadhadravyANAM chedyAni khaNDashashchedayitvA bhedyAni cANusho bhedayitvA gomUtreNa saha sAdhayitvopasaMskRutya yathAvanmadhutailalavaNopahitaM sukhoShNaM bastiM shleShmavikAriNe vidhij~jo vidhivaddadyAt| iti kaTukaskandhaH||142||

Commentary: tejasvinI tejovatI| kilimaM devadAru||142||

candananaladakRutamAlanaktamAlanimbatumburukuTajaharidrAdAruharidrAmustamUrvAkirAtatiktakakaTukarohiNItrAyamANA- kAravellikAkarIrakaravIrakebukakaThillakavRuShamaNDUkaparNIkarkoTakavArtAkukarkashakAkamAcIkAkodumbarikAsuShavyativiShA- paTolakulakapAThAguDUcIvetrAgravetasavika~gkatabakulasomavalkasaptaparNasumanArkAvalgujavacAtagarAguruvAlakoshIrANIti , eShAmevaMvidhAnAM cAnyeShAM tiktavargaparisa~gkhyAtAnAmauShadhadravyANAM chedyAni khaNDashashchedayitvA bhedyAni cANusho bhedayitvA prakShAlya pAnIyenAbhyAsicya sAdhayitvopasaMskRutya yathAvanmadhutailalavaNopahitaM sukhoShNaM bastiM shleShmavikAriNe vidhij~jo vidhivaddadyAt, shItaM tu madhusarpirbhyAmapasaMsRujya pittavikAriNe vidhij~jo vidhivaddadyAt| iti tiktaskandhaH||143||

Commentary: tiktavarge karkashaH paTolabhedaH||143||

tatra j~jAnavij~jAnavacanaprativacanashaktisampannenAkopanenAnupaskRutavidyenAnasUyakenAnuneyenAnunayakovidena kleshakShameNa priyasambhAShaNena ca saha sandhAyasambhAShA vidhIyate| tathAvidhena saha kathayan visrabdhaH kathayet, pRucchedapi ca visrabdhaH, pRucchate cAsmai visrabdhAya vishadamarthaM brUyAt, na ca nigrahabhayAdudvijeta, nigRuhya cainaM na hRuShyet, na ca pareShu vikattheta, na ca mohAdekAntagrAhI syAt, na cAviditamarthamanuvarNayet, samyak cAnunayenAnunayet, tatra cAvahitaH syAt| ityanulomasambhAShAvidhiH||17||

Commentary: tatretyAdinA sandhAyasambhAShAvidhimAha| visrabdhaH kathayediti jalpavitaNDoktanigrahAbhItaH| kathayediti brUyAt| nigRuhya cainaM na hRuShyediti anulomasambhAShArUpavAde ca yAni sambhavanti nigrahasthAnAni tattvavighAtIni hetvAbhAsApasiddhAntanyUnAdhikarUpANi, tairapi nigRuhya na hRuShyet| jalpoktanigrahasthAnAni tvatrAgrAhyANyeva| aviditamiti prativAdino~aviditam| anunayecca samyaganunayeneti sambandhaH; tena cAtra chalajAtiprayogo na kartavya iti shikShayati| tatra cAvahitaH syAditi samyaganunaye~avadhAnaM kuryAt||17||

priya~ggvanantAmrAsthyambaShThakIkaTva~ggalodhramocarasasama~ggAdhAtakIpuShpapadmApadmakesharajambvAmraplakShavaTa- kapItanodumbarAshvatthabhallAtakAsthyashmantakashirIShashiMshapAsomavalkatindukapriyAlabadarakhadira- saptaparNAshvakarNasyandanArjunArimedailavAlukaparipelavakadambashallakIji~gginIkAshakasherukarAjakasherukaTphalavaMsha- padmakAshokashAladhavasarjabhUrjashaNakharapuShpApurashamImAcIkavarakatu~ggAjakarNasphUrjakabibhItakakumbhIpuShkarabIja- bisamRuNAlatAlakharjUrataruNAnIti , eShAmevaMvidhAnAM cAnyeShAM kaShAyavargaparisa~gkhyAtAnAmauShadhadravyANAM chedyAni khaNDashashchedayitvA bhedyAni cANusho bhedayitvA prakShAlya pAnIyenAbhyAsicya sAdhayitvopasaMskRutya yathAvanmadhutailalavaNopahitaM sukhoShNaM bastiM shleShmavikAriNe vidhij~jo vidhivaddadyAt, shItaM tu madhusarpirbhyAmupasaMsRujya pittavikAriNe dadyAt| iti kaShAyaskandhaH||144||

Commentary: kaShAyavarge ashvakarNaH priyAlashAlaH, paripelavaM kaivartamustakaM, ji~gginI svanAmakhyAtA, mAcIkaH devadAruH, ajakarNaH shAlabhedaH, kumbhI ‘kumbhIka’ iti khyAtA, kiMvA haThaH, mRuNAlaM mRuNAlanAlikA, tAlakharjUrataruNAnIti tAlakharjUrA~gkurA ityarthaH| atra ca skandheShu yaddravyaM skandhadvaye paThyate tadubhayaguNayuktatvenobhayatrapi yogIti j~jeyam||144||
tatra shlokAH- ShaDvargAH parisa~gkhyAtA ya ete rasabhedataH| AsthApanamabhipretya tAnvidyAtsArvayaugikAn||145||
sarvasho hi praNihitAH sarvarogeShu jAnatA| sarvAnrogAnniyacchanti yebhya AsthApanaM hitam||146||
yeShAM yeShAM prashAntyarthaM ye ye na parikIrtitAH| dravyavargA vikArANAM teShAM te parikopakAH||147||
ityete ShaDAsthApanaskandhA rasato~anuvibhajya vyAkhyAtAH||148||

tebhyo bhiShagbuddhimAn parisa~gkhyAtamapi yadyaddravyamayaugikaM manyeta, tattadapakarShayet; yadyaccAnuktamapi yaugikaM manyeta, tattadvidadhyAt; vargamapi vargeNopasaMsRujedekamekenAnekena vA yuktiM pramANIkRutya| pracaraNamiva bhikShukasya bIjamiva karShakasya sUtraM buddhimatAmalpamapyanalpaj~jAnAya bhavati; tasmAdbuddhimatAmUhApohavitarkAH, mandabuddhestu yathoktAnugamanameva shreyaH| yathoktaM hi mArgamanugacchan bhiShak saMsAdhayati kAryamanatimahattvAdvA vinipAtayatyanatihrasvatvAdudAharaNasyeti||149||
