Commentary: sampratyuktavargeShu vyAdhyAdiparyAlocanayA yaugikatvamapekShya yaugikaprakShepamayaugikoddharaNaM ca darshayannAha- tebhya ityAdi| buddhimAnitipadena buddhimataiva prakShepoddhArau gaNe kartavyau, nAlpabuddhinohApohakaraNAsamartheneti darshayati| ekaM vargamekena vargeNopasRujedanekena vA vargeNeti yojyam| yuktiM pramANIkRutyeti idamatra yaugikamidamayaugikamiti UhaM pramANIkRutyetyarthaH| pracaraNaM bhikShAmUlaM taNDulAdi pAtrastham| nanu mandabuddheH kathaM yathoktAnanugamanaM? yathoktamayaugikamUhena buddhimantaH pratipadyante tatraiva tanmandadhIH prayu~jjAno na kathamanarthamAvahedityAha- yathoktaM hItyAdi| anatimahattvAdvA vinipAtayatItyanena mandabuddheryathoktamAcarata UhaM vinA na mahatI vyApadbhavatIti darshayati| yataH shAstre hi yo vidhiryathoktaH, sa prAyo yaugika eva bhavati tatra; yatrApi sharIrAdibhedenAyaugikaH, tatrApi stokamAtreNa yaugika ityarthaH| anatihrasvatvAdudAharaNasyeti shAstre udAharaNatvenoktasya vidheranatisa~gkShepAdityarthaH| etena yadi stokaM rogasAdhanodAharaNaM syAt, Uhyameva bahu, tadA mandabuddhiH sAkShAdudAharaNaviShayAj~jAnAt tathA svayamuhAkShamatvAcca na rogashAntilakShaNaM kAryaM kartuM kShamaH syAt; yatastUdAharaNAni bahUni, tena tairevodAharaNAtmakaprayogaustatsAdhyatvenoktavyAdhIn sAdhayatIti yuktam| imau cAvApoddhArau gaNokta eva dravye prAyau j~jeyau| yaduktaM sushrute- “gaNoktamapi yaddravyaM bhavedvyAdhAvayaugikam| taduddhareta, prakShipettu yanmanyedyaugikaM tu tat” (su.ci.a.1) iti| ye tu saMyogamahimnA kAryakarA agastyaharItakyAdayaH, na teShvAvApoddhArau kartavyau| enameva cArthamabhipretyoktaM sushrute- “eSha cAgamasiddhatvAttathaiva phaladarshanAt| mantravat samprayoktavyo na mImAMsyaH katha~jcana” (su.ci.a.1) iti||149||

ataH paramanuvAsanadravyANyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH| anuvAsanaM tu sneha eva| snehastu dvividhaH- sthAvarAtmakaH, ja~ggamAtmakashca| tatra sthAvarAtmakaH snehastailamatailaM ca| taddvayaM tailameva kRutvopadekShyAmaH, sarvatastailaprAdhAnyAt| ja~ggamAtmakastu vasA, majjA, sarpiriti| teShAM tailavasAmajjasarpiShAM yathApUrvaM shreShThaM vAtashleShmavikAreShvanuvAsanIyeShu, yathottaraM tu pittavikAreShu, sarva eva vA sarvavikAreShvapi yogamupayAnti saMskAravidhivisheShAditi||150||

Commentary: kramaprAptamanuvAsanadravyamAha- ataH paramityAdi| atra tailamiti tailabhUtaM sarShapasnehAdi| tailaprAdhAnyAditi sthAvarasneheShu tilatailasyaiva prAdhAnyAdityarthaH| etena taile yo vidhiH sa sArShapAdau boddhavyaH, tailashabdena tu sArShapAdInAmiha grahaNaM tilabhavasnehasya prAdhAnyaprakhyApanArthaM ; tailashabdena sArShapAdInAM grahaNaM bhavatyeva| yaduktaM sushrute- “niShpattestadguNatvAcca tailatvamitareShvapi” (su.sU.a.15) iti||150||

shirovirecanadravyANi punarapAmArgapippalImaricaviDa~ggashigrushirIShatumburupilvajAjyamodAvArtAkIpRuthvIkailAhareNukAphalAni ca, sumukhasurasakuTherakagaNDIrakAlamAlakaparNAsakShavakaphaNijjhakaharidrAshRu~ggaveramUlakalashunatarkArIsarShapapatrANi ca, arkAlarkakuShThanAgadantIvacApAmArgashvetAjyotiShmatIgavAkShIgaNDIrapuShpyavAkpuShpIvRushcikAlIvayasthAtiviShAmUlAni ca, haridrAshRu~ggaveramUlakalashunakandAshca, lodhramadanasaptaparNanimbArkapuShpANi ca, devadArvagurusaralashallakIji~gginyasanahi~gguniryAsAshca, tejovatIvarA~gge~ggudIshobhA~jjanakabRuhatIkaNTakArikAtvacashceti| shirovirecanaM saptavidhaM, phala-patra-mUla-kanda-puShpa-niryAsa-tvagAshrayabhedAt| lavaNakaTutiktakaShAyANi cendriyopashayAni tathA~aparANyanuktAnyapi dravyANi yathAyogavihitAni shirovirecanArthamupadishyanta iti||151||

Commentary: parisheShyAcchirovirecanAnyAha- shirovirecanetyAdi| phalAni ceti cakAreNa tasmAduktadravyAda~ggAntaropayogaM ca darshayati| tena shigrorvakShyamANatvagupayogashca bhavati, evamanyatrApyudAhAryam| sumukhAdayaH parNAsabhedAH, tarkArI jayantI| gaNDIrapuShpI shamaThaH, vayasthA brAhmI| varA~ggaM guDatvak| indriyopashayAnItyanena yAni lavaNAdIni indriyAnupaghAtakAni tAnyeva shirovirecane yojyAni; tathA~aparANIti madhurAmlakaShAyANyapi yAni shirovirecane yaugikAni||151||
tatra shlokAH- lakShaNAcAryashiShyANAM parIkShA kAraNaM ca yat| adhyeyAdhyApanavidhI sambhAShAvidhireva ca||152||
ShaDbhirUnAni pa~jcAshadvAdamArgapadAni ca| padAni dasha cAnyAni kAraNAdIni tattvataH||153||
samprashnashca parIkShAdernavako vamanAdiShu| bhiShagjitIye rogANAM vimAne samprakAshitaH||154||
bahuvidhamidamuktamarthajAtaM bahuvidhavAkyavicitramarthakAntam| bahuvidhashubhashabdasandhiyuktaM bahuvidhavAdanisUdanaM pareShAm||155||
imAM matiM bahuvidhahetusaMshrayAM vijaj~jivAn paramatavAdasUdanIm| na sajjate paravacanAvamardanairna shakyate paravacanaishca marditum||156||
doShAdInAM tu bhAvAnAM sarveShAmeva hetumat| mAnAt samyagvimAnAni niruktAni vibhAgashaH||157||

ata UrdhvamitareNa saha vigRuhya sambhAShAyAM jalpecchreyasA yogamAtmanaH pashyan| prAgeva ca jalpAjjalpAntaraM parAvarAntaraM pariShadvisheShAMshca samyak parIkSheta| samyakparIkShA hi buddhimatAM kAryapravRuttinivRuttikAlau shaMsati, tasmAt parIkShAmabhiprashaMsanti kushalAH| parIkShamANastu khalu parAvarAntaramimAn jalpakaguNA~j shreyaskarAndoShavatashca parIkSheta samyak; tadyathA- shrutaM vij~jAnaM dhAraNaM pratibhAnaM vacanashaktiriti, etAn guNAn shreyaskarAnAhuH; imAn punardoShavataH, tadyathA- kopanatvamavaishAradyaM bhIrutvamadhAraNatvamanavahitatvamiti| etAn guNAn gurulAghavataH parasya caivAtmanashca tulayet||18||

Commentary: itareNeti avishiShTena| vAde tu vishiShTo gururbrahmacArI vA~adhikRutaH; uktaM hi nyAye- “taM shiShyagurusabrahmacArivishiShTashreyorthibhiranasUyubhirabhyupeyAt” (nyA. da. 4/2/40) iti| sambhAShAyAmiti pravRuttakathopalakShaNaM, tena jalpe vitaNDAyAM ceti j~jeyam| parAvarAntaramiti prativAdina Atmanashca pratibhAdivisheShamityarthaH| jalpAntaramiti sAmayikasarvArthAdivisheShitaM jalpakavisheShamityarthaH||18||
tatra trividhaH paraH sampadyate- pravaraH, pratyavaraH, samo vA, guNavinikShepataH; natveva kArtsnyena||19||

pariShattu khalu dvividhA- j~jAnavatI, mUDhapariShacca| saiva dvividhA satI trividhA punaranena kAraNavibhAgena- suhRutpariShat, udAsInapariShat, pratiniviShTapariShacceti | tatra pratiniviShTAyAM pariShadi j~jAnavij~jAnavacanaprativacanashaktisampannAyAM mUDhAyAM vA na kathaM cit kenacit saha jalpo vidhIyate; mUDhAyAM tu suhRutpariShadyudAsInAyAM vA j~jAnavij~jAnavacanaprativacanashaktIrantareNApyadIptayashasA mahAjanavidviShTenApi saha jalpo vidhIyate| tadvidhena ca saha kathayatA AviddhadIrghasUtrasa~gkulairvAkyadaNDakaiH kathayitavyam, atihRuShTaM muhurmuhurupahasatA paraM nirUpayatA ca parShadamAkArairbruvatashcAsya vAkyAvakAsho na deyaH; kaShTashabdaM ca bruvatA vaktavyo nocyate, athavA punarhInA te pratij~jA, iti| punashcAhU(hva)yamAnaH prativaktavyaH- parisaMvatsaro bhavAn shikShasva tAvat; na tvayA gururupAsito nUnam, athavA paryAptametAvatte; sakRudapi hi parikShepikaM nihataM nihatamAhuriti nAsya yogaH kartavyaH katha~jcit| apyevaM shreyasA saha vigRuhya vaktavyamityAhureke; natvevaM jyAyasA saha vigrahaM prashaMsanti kushalAH||20||

pratyavareNa tu saha samAnAbhimatena vA vigRuhya jalpatA suhRutpariShadi kathayitavyam, athavA~apyudAsInapariShadyavadhAnashravaNaj~jAnavij~jAnopadhAraNavacanaprativacanashaktisampannAyAM kathayatA cAvahitena parasya sAdguNyadoShabalamavekShitavyaM, samavekShya ca yatrainaM shreShThaM manyeta nAsya tatra jalpaM yojayedanAviShkRutamayogaM kurvan; yatra tvenamavaraM manyeta tatraivainamAshu nigRuhNIyAt| tatra khalvime pratyavarANAmAshu nigrahe bhavantyupAyAH; tadyathA- shrutahInaM mahatA sUtrapAThenAbhibhavet, vij~jAnahInaM punaH kaShTashabdena vAkyena, vAkyadhAraNAhInamAviddhadIrghasUtrasa~gkulairvAkyadaNDakaiH, pratibhAhInaM punarvacanenaikavidhenAnekArthavAcinA , vacanashaktihInamardhoktasya vAkyasyAkShepeNa , avishAradamapatrapaNena, kopanamAyAsanena, bhIruM vitrAsanena, anavahitaM niyamaneneti| evametairupAyaiH paramavaramabhibhavecchIghram||21||
tatra shlokau- vigRuhya kathayedyuktyA yuktaM ca na nivArayet| vigRuhyabhAShA tIvraM hi keShA~jciddrohamAvahet||22||
nAkAryamasti kruddhasya nAvAcyamapi vidyate| kushalA nAbhinandanti kalahaM samitau satAm||23||
evaM pravRutte vAde kuryAt||24||

prAgeva tAvadidaM kartuM yateta- sandhAya parShadA~ayanabhUtamAtmanaH prakaraNamAdeshayitavyaM, yadvA parasya bhRushadurgaM syAt, pakShamathavA parasya bhRushaM vimukhamAnayet; pariShadi copasaMhitAyAmashakyamasmAbhirvaktum, eShaiva te pariShadyatheShTaM yathAyogaM yathAbhiprAyaM vAdaM vAdamaryAdAM ca sthApayiShyatItyuktvA tUShNImAsIta||25||

Commentary: tathA~apravRutte vAde kiM kuryAdityAha- prAgevetyAdi| ayanabhUtamiti abhyAsAnmArgIbhUtamiva abhyastamityarthaH| parasya bhRushadurgamiti prativAdino~aviditatvena durgamiva durgaM; tat pUrvaM sandhitayA pariShadA~a~adeshayet| pakShAntaramAha- pakShamathavetyAdi| parasya prativAdinaH pakShaM bhRushamatyarthaM sabhAyAM yathA vimukhaM bhavati, tathA vAdaM pravartayet; etena nAsti paraloko nAsti karmaphalamityAdi yadi parasya pakSho bhavati, tadaitasya pakShasya svAbhAvikadviShTatvena yatki~jcit svapakShasAdhanamucyate, tadeva pariShadapi gRuhNAtItyuktaM bhavati| upasaMhitAyAmiti sandhinA yuktAyAM tUShNImAsIteti yojanA| upasaMhitA hi pariShat parokShoNAbhimatatvenopadarshitameva sarvaM kariShyati, tadalamihAtyarthavacanena mAhAtmyakhaNDakeneti bhAvaH||25||

tatredaM vAdamaryAdAlakShaNaM bhavati- idaM vAcyam, idamavAcyam, evaM parAjito bhavatIti||26||

Commentary: vAdamaryAdAlakShaNamAha- tatredamityAdi| vAdashabdena ceha vigRuhya pakShapratipakShavacanamAtramucyate; sandhAyasambhAShayA tu tattvabubhutsorvAda uktaH||26||

imAni tu khalu padAni bhiShagvAdamArgaj~jAnArthamadhigamyAni bhavanti; tadyathA- vAdaH, dravyaM, guNAH, karma, sAmAnyaM, visheShaH, samavAyaH, pratij~jA, sthApanA, pratiShThApanA, hetuH, dRuShTAntaH, upanayaH, nigamanam, uttaraM, siddhAntaH, shabdaH, pratyakSham, anumAnam, aitihyam, aupamyaM, saMshayaH, prayojanaM, savyabhicAraM, jij~jAsA, vyavasAyaH, arthaprAptiH, sambhavaH, anuyojyam, ananuyojyam, anuyogaH, pratyanuyogaH, vAkyadoShaH, vAkyaprashaMsA, chalam, ahetuH, atItakAlam, upAlambhaH, parihAraH, pratij~jAhAniH, abhyanuj~jA, hetvantaram, arthAntaraM, nigrahasthAnamiti||27||

Commentary: samprati vAdamArgaj~jAnArthaM vAdAbhij~jeyAni dravyaguNAdInyupadarshayannAha- imAnItyAdi| bhiShajAM vAdamArgo bhiShagvAdamArgaH| vAdAdayaH svayamevAcAryeNAgre vivriyanta iti neha sa~jj~jAkathane vivriyante||27||

buddhimAnAtmanaH kAryagurulAghavaM karmaphalamanubandhaM deshakAlau ca viditvA yuktidarshanAdbhiShagbubhUShuH shAstramevAditaH parIkSheta| vividhAni hi shAstrANi bhiShajAM pracaranti loke; tatra yanmanyeta sumahadyashasvidhIrapuruShAsevitamarthabahulamAptajanapUjitaM trividhashiShyabuddhihitamapagatapunaruktadoShamArShaM supraNItasUtrabhAShyasa~ggrahakramaM svAdhAramanavapatitashabdamakaShTashabdaM puShkalAbhidhAnaM kramAgatArthamarthatattvavinishcayapradhAnaM sa~ggatArthamasa~gkulaprakaraNamAshuprabodhakaM lakShaNavaccodAharaNavacca, tadabhiprapadyeta shAstram| shAstraM hyevaMvidhamamala ivAdityastamo vidhUya prakAshayati sarvam||3||

Commentary: ihAdhyayanavidhyAdiShu kartavyeShu yAdRuk shAstramadhyeyaM, tadevAyurvedArthipuruShamupadarshya darshayannAha- buddhimAnityAdi| kAryaM kartavyaM, tasya gauravaM bahuprayAsasAdhyatvena, lAghavaM vA svalpaprayAsasAdhyatveneti kAryagurulAghavam| karmaphalamiti kAryaphalam, etacca tAdAtvikaM phalamIpsitam| anubandhamiti kAryasyaivAyatIyaM phalam| deshakAlAviti kartavyakAryAnuguNau deshakAlAvityarthaH| etat sarvaM viditvA, yuktidarshanAdupapattidarshanAdyadi bhiShagbhavitumicchuH syAt, tadA shAstraM tAvadAditaH parIkSheta| evaM manyate- ya AyurvedAdhyayanalakShaNe kArye svashaktyapekShayA gauravaM manyate sa na vartate, yashcAyurvedaphalenArogyAdinA arthI na bhavati sa ca tathA, yashcAnupAdeyAyurvedaj~jAne deshe sthitaH sa ca tathA, yasya ca vapuSho vArdhakyalakShaNaH kAlaH sa cAyurvedAdhyayanAntagamanAshaktatvAdeva yathoktAnupapattidarshanAdbhiShagbhavituM necchati, ato na tAn pratyAyurvedashAstraparIkShAmapyupadishAmaH; yastu yathoktaviparItadharmayogI sa cAyurvedAdhyayanopAdAnAdbhiShagbubhUShuH shAstraM parIkSheta| vividhAnIti agaNitAni| sumahadyashasvi ca dhIrapuruShAsevitaM ca; kiMvA sumahadyashasvidhIrapuruShairAsevitamiti vigrahaH| AptajanapUjitamiti bahuvidhairAptairyathArhamanumatam| utkRuShTamadhyAlpabuddhayastrividhAH shiShyAH| apagatapunaruktamiti kartavye yaddoShapAThaM karoti, tenAdhikaraNavashaprAptaM yat karoti tat punaruktamadoShaM bhavati| vacanaM hi- “adhikaraNavashAddurgAdguNadoShaprAptito~arthasambandhAt | stutyarthaM saMshayataH shiShyadhiyAM cAbhivRuddhyartham|| alpato~antaritatvAdvisheShaNeShvapi ca tantrakRudbhistu| yattantre syAt punaruktaM neShyate tadvibhAvya vivaraNam” iti| svAdhAramiti shobhanAbhidheyam| anavapatitamiti agrAmyashabdam| akaShTashabdamiti akRucchroccAryashabdaM, kiMvA prasiddhAbhidheyashabdam| puShkalAbhidhAnamiti samyagarthasamarpakavAkyam| kramAgatArthamiti paripATyAgatArtham| sa~ggatArthamiti pratipAditArtham| asa~gkulaprakaraNamiti amishrIbhUtaprakaraNam | lakShaNavaditi AyurvedapradhAnArthahetuli~ggauShadhAkhyAsAdhAraNadharmakathanavat; kiMvA prashastashAstralakShaNavat| udAharaNavaditi dRuShTAntavat||3||

tatra vAdo nAma sa yat pareNa saha shAstrapUrvakaM vigRuhya kathayati| sa ca dvividhaH sa~ggraheNa- jalpaH, vitaNDA ca| tatra pakShAshritayorvacanaM jalpaH, jalpaviparyayo vitaNDA| yathA- ekasya pakShaH punarbhavo~astIti, nAstItyaparasya; tau ca svasvapakShahetubhiH svasvapakShaM sthApayataH, parapakShamudbhAvayataH, eSha jalpaH| jalpaviparyayo vitaNDA| vitaNDA nAma parapakShe doShavacanamAtrameva||28||

Commentary: tatretyAdinA vAdalakShaNam| iha vAdashabdena vigRuhyavAdo~abhipretaH, tattvabubhutsuvAdastu sandhAyasambhAShayaivoktaH| shAstrapUrvakamityanenArthAdikalahavAdaM niShedhati| tatra vAde vigRuhyasambhAShArUpatvAdeva chalajAtinigrahasthAnAnaM vijigIShApravRuttAnAM prayogo labhyate| pakShAshritayoriti pakShaM sAdhayatorityarthaH; tena, vitaNDAyAmapyuttaravAdinaH parapakShadUShaNalakShaNaH pakSho~astyeva, paraM svamataM na sAdhayatIti bhedaH| yathaikasyetyAdi jalpodAharaNam| parapakShe doShavacanamAtramityanena na svapakShasAdhanavacanaM vaitaNDikasyeti darshayati||28||
dravya-guNa-karma-sAmAnya-visheSha-samavAyAH svalakShaNaiH shlokasthAne pUrvamuktAH||29||
atha pratij~jA- pratij~jA nAma sAdhyavacanaM; yathA- nityaH puruSha iti||30||

atha sthApanA- sthApanA nAma tasyA eva pratij~jAyA hetudRuShTAntopanayanigamanaiH sthApanA| pUrvaM hi pratij~jA, pashcAt sthApanA, kiM hyapratij~jAtaM sthApayiShyati; yathA- nityaH puruSha iti pratij~jA; hetuH- akRutakatvAditi; dRuShTAntaH - yathA~a~akAshamiti; upanayaH- yathA cAkRutakamAkAshaM, tacca nityaM, tathA puruSha iti; nigamanaM- tasmAnnitya iti||31||

Commentary: sthApayati siddhamarthaM paraM prati sAdhayatIti sthApanA| sA ca sAdhyaM paraM prati hetvAdibhishcaturbhiH sAdhayati| pratij~jA~api paraM prati sthApanA bhavati, yataH pa~jcAvayavamevAnumAnaM bhavati, sA tviha sthApyatvenaiva labdheti na sthApanAyAmihodAhRutA||31||

atha pratiShThApanA- pratiShThApanA nAma yA tasyA eva parapratij~jAyA viparItArthasthApanA| yathA- anityaH puruSha iti pratij~jA ; hetuH- aindriyakatvAditi; dRuShTAntaH- yathA ghaTa iti, upanayo- yathA ghaTa aindriyakaH sa cAnityaH, tathA cAyamiti; nigamanaM- tasmAdanitya iti||32||

Commentary: pratiShThApanApadaM prathamaM sampratyavasaraprAptA pratiShThApaneti darshayati; dvitIyaM tu pratiShThApanA nAmeti tasyA evetyAdinA vakShyamANasya lakShaNasyopadarshanArtham| evaM ‘sthApanA nAma’ ityAdAvapi punaruktasya prayojanaM vAcyam| pratiShThApanApadagatasya pratishabdasyArthaM vyAkaroti- viparItArthasthApaneti; pratishabdo~ayaM viparItArtha ityarthaH| iyaM ca pratiShThApanA AnvIkShikyAM prakaraNasamAkhyaM hetudUShaNam||32||

atha hetuH- heturnAmopalabdhikAraNaM; tat pratyakSham, anumAnam, aitihyam, aupamyamiti; ebhirhetubhiryadupalabhyate tat tattvam||33||

Commentary: hetushcAvinAbhAvali~ggavacanaM yadyapi, tathA~apIha li~ggapragrAhakANi pratyakShAdipramANAnyeva yathoktahetumUlatvena hetushabdenAheti boddhavyam; anyathA punaH pratyakShAdyabhidhAnaM punaruktaM syAt| upalabdhikAraNamiti vyApakasya sAdhyasyopalabdhikAraNam| tattattvamiti talli~ggamityarthaH||33||

atha dRuShTAntaH- dRuShTAnto nAma yatra mUrkhaviduShAM buddhisAmyaM, yo varNyaM varNayati | yathA- agniruShNaH, dravamudakaM, sthirA pRuthivI, AdityaH prakAshaka iti; yathA AdityaH prakAshakastathA sA~gkhyaj~jAnaM prakAshakamiti||34||

Commentary: mUrkhaviduShAM buddhisAmyamityanena laukikAnAM paNDitAnAM ca yo~artho~avivAdasiddhaH sa dRuShTAnto bhavati, na paNDitamAtrasiddhaH| yo~api lokaprasiddho dRuShTAnta ucyate, sa yAvanna pratipAdyapuruShaM prati sAdhyate, na tAvaddRuShTAntatAmAsAdayatIti bhAvaH| atha buddhisAmyamAtreNa sAdhyasAdharmyabhAvAdiShTatvAd dRuShTAnto bhavatItyAha- yo varNyaM varNayati; yaH sAdhyaM sAdhayatItyarthaH| prasiddhasAdhyasAdhanasambandhashca dRuShTAntaH sAdhyaM sAdhayatIti bhAvaH| agnyAdayashca lokaprasiddhatvenodAhRutAH; tenaiteShAmapi sAdhyasAdhanodAharaNamAdityAdivat kvaciddvandve~ayamayamiveti darshayati||34||
upanayo nigamanaM coktaM sthApanApratiShThApanAvyAkhyAyAm||35||

athottaram- uttaraM nAma sAdharmyopadiShTe hetau vaidharmyavacanaM, vaidharmyopadiShTe vA hetau sAdharmyavacanam| yathA- ‘hetusadharmANo vikArAH, shItakasya hi vyAdherhetubhiH sAdharmyaM himashishiravAtasaMsparshAH’, iti bruvataH paro brUyAt- hetuvidharmANo vikArAH, yathA sharIrAvayavAnAM dAhauShNyakothaprapacane hetuvaidharmyaM himashishiravAtasaMsparshA iti| etat saviparyayamuttaram||36||

atha siddhAntaH- siddhAnto nAma sa yaH parIkShakairbahuvidhaM parIkShya hetubhishca sAdhayitvA sthApyate nirNayaH| sa caturvidhaH- sarvatantrasiddhAntaH, pratitantrasiddhAntaH, adhikaraNasiddhAntaH, abhyupagamasiddhAntashceti| tatra sarvatantrasiddhAnto nAma tasmiMstasmin sarvasmiMstantre tattat prasiddhaM; yathA santi nidAnAni, santi vyAdhayaH, santi siddhyupAyAH sAdhyAnAmiti| pratitantrasiddhAnto nAma tasmiMstasminnekaikasmiMstantre tattat prasiddhaM; yathA- anyatrAShTau rasAH ShaDatra, pa~jcendriyANyatra ShaDindriyANyanyatra tantre, vAtAdikRutAH sarve vikArA yathA~anyatra, atra vAtAdikRutA bhUtakRutAshca prasiddhAH| adhikaraNasiddhAnto nAma sa yasminnadhikaraNe prastUyamAne siddhAnyanyAnyapyadhikaraNAni bhavanti, yathA- ‘na muktaH karmAnubandhikaM kurute, nispRuhatvAt iti prastute siddhAH karmaphala-mokSha-puruSha-pretyabhAvA bhavanti| abhyupagamasiddhAnto nAma sa yamarthamasiddhamaparIkShitamanupadiShTamahetukaM vA vAdakAle~abhyupagacchanti bhiShajaH; tadyathA- dravyaM pradhAnamiti kRutvA vakShyAmaH, guNAH pradhAnamiti kRutvA vakShyAmaH, vIryaM pradhAnamiti kRutvA vakShyAmaH, ityevamAdiH| iti caturvidhaH siddhAntaH||37||

Commentary: bahuvidhaM parIkShya hetubhiH sAdhayitvA sthApyata ityasya vivaraNaM- nirNaya iti; nirNIyata iti nirNayaH| etacca siddhAntalakShaNamabhyupagamasiddhAnte nAsti, tena tatra buddhivyavasthitatvena coktaM siddhAntatvaM j~jeyam| siddhAntaM vibhajate- sa ityAdi| pratitantrasiddhAnte ShaDrasA aShTau rasA iti parasparaviruddhe~api vAde svayuktivyavasthApanabalAttu siddhAntatvaM j~jeyam| yasminnityAdau adhikaraNe iti abhidheyapradhAnatve | anyAnyapIti sAkShAdanabhidhIyamAnAnyapi| anubadhnAtIti AnubandhikaM janmAntare~apyanugAmItyarthaH| mukta iti pratyAsannamuktiH, sarvathAmuktastvasharIratvAt karma na karoti; kiMvA AnubandhikaM visheSheNa na karoti| siddhA ityAdi| yadIha karmaphalaM na syAttadA mumukShuNA~api kriyate karma, phalodvigno hyayaM na tat karma karoti; yadi ca mokSho na syAttadA mukta iti vacanaM na syAt; tathA yadi ca puruSho na syAttadA kasya vA bandhaH, kasya vA mokShaH syAt; yadA janmAntaraM na syAttadA karmaNo janmAntarAnubandhitvamanupapannaM syAditi; na mukta ityAdivadatA adhikaraNabalAdeva siddhAH siddhAntatvena karmaphalAdayaH svIkRutA bhavanti| asiddhamityasya vivaraNam- aparIkShitamityAdi||37||

tato~anantaramAcAryaM parIkSheta; tadyathA- paryavadAtashrutaM paridRuShTakarmANaM dakShaM dakShiNaM shuciM jitahastamupakaraNavantaM sarvendriyopapannaM prakRutij~jaM pratipattij~jamanupaskRutavidyamanaha~gkRutamanasUyakamakopanaM kleshakShamaM shiShyavatsalamadhyApakaM j~jApanasamarthaM ceti| eva~gguNo hyAcAryaH sukShetramArtavo megha iva shasyaguNaiH sushiShyamAshu vaidyaguNaiH sampAdayati||4||

Commentary: adhyetavyaM shAstraM parIkShya yasmAttacchAstramadhyetavyaM tasyAcAryasya parIkShAmAha- tata ityAdi| dakShamiti avAmabuddhim| upakaraNavantamiti anenAnupakaraNe gurau cikitsAvRuttyabhAvAt karmadarshanaM na bhavati| anupaskRutavidyamiti shAstrAntaraj~jAnena nAstyevopaskRutA vidyA yasya sa tathA; ya Ayurvedaj~jaH sa~jshAstrAntareNApi saMskRuto bhavati, sa tu nitarAmupAdeyaH| Artava iti yathocitakAlabhavaH||4||

atha shabdaH- shabdo nAma varNasamAmnAyaH; sa caturvidhaH- dRuShTArthashca, adRuShTArthashca, satyashca, anRutashceti| tatra dRuShTArtho nAma- tribhirhetubhirdoShAH prakupyanti, ShaDbhirupakramaishca prashAmyanti, sati shrotrAdisadbhAve shabdAdigrahaNamiti| adRuShTArthaH punaH- asti pretyabhAvaH, asti mokSha iti| satyo nAma- yathArthabhUtaH; santyAyurvedopadeshAH, santi siddhyupAyAH sAdhyAnAM vyAdhInAM, santyArambhaphalAnIti| satyaviparyayashcAnRutaH||38||

Commentary: shabdashabdeneha sa~gketabalAdarthaprakAshikA varNamAlocyate| Aptopadeshashabdastu dvividhaH- paramAptabrahmAdipraNItaH, tathA laukikAptapraNItashca; aitihyashabdena paramAptapraNIto~avaruddhaH, laukikAptapraNItashca shabdaikadesharUpaH satyaprakAravihito j~jeyaH| varNasamAmnAya iti varNamelaka ityarthaH| varNAnAM yadyapyatra sahasthAyinAM melako nAsti, tathA~apyekasmRutisamAnarUpitvena kiMvA pUrvapUrvAnubhavajanitasaMskArasahitAntyavarNAnubhavAroheNa melako j~jeyaH| dRuShTArtha iti pramANAntaropalabdhiyogyArthaH| tribhirhetubhiriti praj~jAparAdhAdibhiH| ShaDupakramA la~gghanAdayo la~gghanabRuMhaNIyoktAH| eteShAM vAkyAnAmihaiva dRushyate~artha iti dRuShTArthatvam| satyaviparyayaH- ‘na santyAyurvedopadeshAH’ ityAdirj~jeyaH||38||

atha pratyakShaM- pratyakShaM nAma tadyadAtmanA cendriyaishca svayamupalabhyate; tatrAtmapratyakShAH sukhaduHkhecchAdveShAdayaH, shabdAdayastvindriyapratyakShAH||39||

Commentary: Atmaneti manasA, tena mAnasapratyakShaM sukhAdyamavarudhyate| indriyaishcetyanena bAhyaM pratyakShaM gRuhyate| svayamupalabhyata iti sAkShAdupalabhyate; anena cendriyavyApAre satyapi yadanumAnavij~jAnaM tadasAkShAtkAritvAnna pratyakShamiti darshayati||39||

athAnumAnam- anumAnaM nAma tarko yuktyapekShaH; yathA- agniM jaraNashaktyA, balaM vyAyAmashaktyA, shrotrAdIni shabdAdigrahaNenetyevamAdi||40||

Commentary: tarko yuktyapekSha ityanumAnalakShaNaM vividharogavij~jAnIya eva vyAkRutam| anumAnodAharaNamAha- agniM jaraNashaktyetyAdinA||40||

athaitihyam- aitihyaM nAmAptopadesho vedAdiH||41||

Commentary: alaukikAptopadesha aitihyapadenocyata ityAha- vedAdiriti||41||

athaupamyam- aupamyaM nAma yadanyenAnyasya sAdRushyamadhikRutya prakAshanaM; yathA- daNDena daNDakasya, dhanuShA dhanuHstambhasya, iShvAsenA~a~arogyadasyeti||42||

Commentary: yadanyenetyAdau anyeneti prasiddhena, anyasyeti aprasiddhasya| sAdRushyamadhikRutyeti sAdRuyaM pratipAdyaM sa~jj~jAsa~jj~jisambandhaM prati kAraNatayA adhikRutya; yadA tu bhaTTanayenopamAnaM vyAkhyeyaM tadA sAdRushyaM pratipAdyatayA adhikRutyeti yojanIyaM, teShAM sAdRushyapratipattirupamAnArthaH| nyAye ca sa~jj~jAsa~jj~jisambandhapratItirupamAnaphalaM, tacca prathamavyAkhyAnAdbhavati; uktaM hi tatra- “prasiddhasAdharmyAt sAdhyasAdhanamupamAnam” (nyA. da. 1/1/6) iti| daNDena daNDakasyeti daNDena prasiddhenAprasiddhasya daNDakasya sAdharmyamAptAcchrutavAn kumbhakAradaNDavadvikAradarshane satyayamasau daNDakasa~jj~jo vikAra iti pratyeti, kiMvA bhaTTanayena prasiddhaM daNDagataM sAdharmyamaprasiddhadaNDakAkhyavikArasambandhitayA pratyeti; evamanyatrApyudAharaNe j~jeyam| iShvAseneti iShumokShakeNa, yathA iShumokShakeNa lakShye~anativiprakRuShTe nAparAdhyate, tathA~a~arogyadena vaidyaina vaidyaguNairAturaM sAdhayatA||42||

atha saMshayaH- saMshayo nAma sandehalakShaNAnusandigdheShvartheShvanishcayaH ; yathA- dRuShTA hyAyuShmallakShaNairupetAshcAnupetAshca tathA sakriyAshcAkriyAshca puruShAH shIghrabha~ggAshcirajIvinashca, etadubhayadRuShTatvAt saMshayaH- kimasti khalvakAlamRutyuruta nAstIti||43||

Commentary: sandehalakShaNAnusandigdheShvartheShvityanena sandehayogyaM viShayaM darshayati; anena ca nyAyokta “samAnAnekadharmopapatteH” (nyA. da. 1/1/23) ityAdivacanAd viShayaM saMshayasya darshayati| saMshayalakShaNam “anishcayaH” iti j~jeyam; anishcayaH pAkShikaviruddhadharmAvamarshakaraM j~jAnaM, yathA- sthANurvA puruSho veti| dRuShTA hItyAdinA saMshayotpattisAmagrImAha| tatrAyuShyalakShaNopetAnAmakriyANAM shIghrabha~gge tathA sakriyANAM ca cirajIvane dRuShTe akAlamRutyurastIti buddhiH| etadviparyaye cAkAlamRutyurnAstIti buddhiH||43||

atha prayojanaM- prayojanaM nAma yadarthamArabhyanta ArambhAH; yathA- yadyakAlamRutyurasti tato~ahamAtmAnamAyuShyairupacariShyAmyanAyuShyANi ca parihariShyAmi, kathaM mAmakAlamRutyuH prasaheteti||44||

Commentary: yadarthamiti yannimittam| prasaheteti mArayedityarthaH||44||

atha savyabhicAraM- savyabhicAraM nAma yadvyabhicaraNaM; yathA- bhavedidamauShadhamasmin vyAdhau yaugikamathavA neti||45||

Commentary: savyabhicAramiti anaikAntikamityarthaH| athavA neti na bhavediti| anaikAntikaM cAtrauShadhaM yaugikatvAyaugikatvAbhyAM saMshayajanakameva; tena saMshayena samabhekatA na sha~gkanIyA~anaikAntikasya||45||

atha jij~jAsA- jij~jAsA nAma parIkShA; yathA bheShajaparIkShottarakAlamupadekShyate||46||

Commentary: uttarakAlamiti ihaiva parIkShAprakaraNe; kiMvA rasAyane “bheShajaM dvividhaM ca tat” (ci.a.1pA.1) ityAdinA||46||
atha vyavasAyaH- vyavasAyo nAma nishcayaH; yathA- vAtika evAyaM vyAdhiH, idamevAsya bheShajaM ceti||47||

athArthaprAptiH- arthaprAptirnAma yatraikenArthenoktenAparasyArthasyAnuktasyApi siddhiH; yathA- nAyaM santarpaNasAdhyo vyAdhirityukte bhavatyarthaprAptiH- apatarpaNasAdhyo~ayamiti, nAnena divA bhoktavyamityukte bhavatyarthaprAptiH- nishi bhoktavyamiti||48||

tamupasRutyArirAdhayiShurupacaredagnivacca devavacca rAjavacca pitRuvacca bhartRuvaccApramattaH| tatastatprasAdAt kRutsnaM shAstramadhigamya shAstrasya dRuDhatAyAmabhidhAnasya sauShThave~arthasya vij~jAne vacanashaktau ca bhUyo bhUyaH prayateta samyak||5||

Commentary: agnyAdibahudRuShTAntadarshanena yena yena bhAvenAgnyAdayaH sevyante, tathA tathA guruH sevyata iti darshayati| dRuDhatAyAmiti shAstragrahaNasya sthairye| abhidhAnasyeti shAstrAbhidhAnasya| vacanashaktau arthakIrtanasAmarthye||5||

atha sambhavaH- yo yataH sambhavati sa tasya sambhavaH; yathA- ShaDdhAtavo garbhasya, vyAdherahitaM, hitamArogyasyeti||49||

Commentary: sambhavati vidyate asmAditi sambhavaH, kAraNaM hi avyaktasvajanmakAryamuktam, yataH kAraNaM satkAryavAdimate kAryayuktameva| tena ShaDdhAtau garbho~astyeva, evamahite~api vyAdhirastyeva, sa uttarakAlaM vyajyate iti sA~gkhyamatenoktam| tatashca yadanyatra sambhavodAharaNamuktaM yathA- ‘sambhavati khAryAM droNa’ ityAdi, tatsamAnametadapyudAharaNaM bhavati||49||

athAnuyojyam- anuyojyaM nAma yadvAkyaM vAkyadoShayuktaM tat| sAmAnyato vyAhRuteShvartheShu vA visheShagrahaNArthaM yadvAkyaM tadapyanuyojyaM; yathA- ‘saMshodhanasAdhyo~ayaM vyAdhiH’ ityukte ‘kiM vamanasAdhyo~ayaM, kiMvA virecanasAdhyaH’ ityanuyujyate||50||

Commentary: anuyojyAntaramAha- sAmAnyata ityAdi||50||

athAnanuyojyam- ananuyojyaM nAmAto viparyayeNa; yathA- ayamasAdhyaH||51||

Commentary: ananuyojyamAha- ato viparyayeNeti| yathoktAnuyojyadvayodAharaNaviparyayeNa j~jeyam||51||

athAnuyogaH- anuyogo nAma sa yat tadvidyAnAM tadvidyaireva sArdhaM tantre tantraikadeshe vA prashnaHprashnaikadesho vA j~jAnavij~jAnavacanaprativacanaparIkShArthamAdishyate| yathA- ‘nityaH puruShaH’ iti pratij~jAte yat paraH ‘ko hetuH’ ityAha, so~anuyogaH||52||
atha pratyanuyogaH- pratyanuyogo nAmAnuyogasyAnuyogaH; yathA- asyAnuyogasya punaH ko heturiti||53||

atha vAkyadoShaH- vAkyadoSho nAma yathA khalvasminnarthe nyUnam, adhikam, anarthakam, apArthakaM, viruddhaM ceti; etAni hyantareNa na prakRuto~arthaH praNashayet| tatra nyUnaM- pratij~jAhetUdAharaNopanayanigamanAnAmanyatamenApi nyUnaM nyUnaM bhavati; yadvA bahUpadiShTahetukamekena hetunA sAdhyate tacca nyUnam| athAdhikam- adhikaM nAma yannyUnaviparItaM, yadvA~a~ayurvede bhAShyamANe bArhaspatyamaushanasamanyadvA yatki~jcidapratisambaddhArthamucyate, yadvA sambaddhArthamapi dvirabhidhIyate tat punaruktadoShatvAdadhikaM; tacca punaruktaM dvividham- arthapunaruktaM, shabdapunaruktaM ca; tatrArthapunaruktaM yathA- bheShajamauShadhaM sAdhanamiti, shabdapunaruktaM punarbheShajaM bheShajamiti| athAnarthakam- anarthakaM nAma yadvacanamakSharagrAmamAtrameva syAt pa~jcavargavanna cArthato gRuhyate| athApArthakam- apArthakaM nAma yadarthavacca paraspareNAsaMyujyamAnArthakaM; yathA- cakra-na(ta)kra-vaMsha-vajra-nishAkarA iti| atha viruddhaM- viruddhaM nAma yaddRuShTAntasiddhAntasamayairviruddhaM; tatra pUrvaM dRuShTAntasiddhAntAvuktauH samayaH punastridhA bhavati; yathA- AyurvaidikasamayaH, yAj~jikasamayaH, mokShashAstrikasamayashceti; tatrAyurvaidikasamayaH- catuShpAdaM bheShajamiti, yAj~jikasamayaH- AlabhyA yajamAnaiH pashava iti, mokShashAstrikasamayaH- sarvabhUteShvahiMseti; tatra svasamayaviparItamucyamAnaM viruddhaM bhavati| iti vAkyadoShAH||54||

Commentary: vAkyadoShAnudAharati- athetyAdi| asminnartha itivacanena chalahetvAbhAsAdipadagRuhItAnapi vAkyadoShatvena darshayati; chalAdayo hi vAkyadoShA eva, paraM pRuthaggRuhItatvAdiha nocyante; tathA shAstrAntaroktAshcAsiddhAdayo~anayA bhAShayA sUcyante vAkyadoShAH| yadvetyAdau yadA puruShanityatve ye hetava uktA ‘anAditvAt, akRutakatvAt, nirvikAratvAt’ iti, teShu yadi sakalahetvabhidhAnaM pratij~jAya ekaM hetuM brUte, tadA pratij~jAtArthasya nyUnArthatvAnnyUnaM bhavatIti j~jeyaM; yadA heturvaktavyastadA eka eva vaktavyo yujyate, ekasyApi hetoH sAdhyasAdhanasamarthatvAt; tena tatra bahuhetukathanamevAdhikatvAddoSha eva bhavatIti j~jeyam| prakRuta iti sAdhyatvena pratij~jAtaH| bArhaspatyamaushanasaM ca nItishAstram| apratisambaddhArthamityanena bArhaspatyAdyapi yadi dhanaiShaNAbhidhAnaprasa~ggena prasa~ggAgataM bhavati, tadA stokakrameNocyamAnamAyurvedopakArakatvena nAdhikamiti darshayati| punaraktadoShAditi doShavataH punaruktAdityarthaH| doShavattvaM ca yathA punaruktasya, tathoktameva| pa~jcavargavaditi ka-kha-ga-gha-~gAdivargasamudAyavat, tatra tvabhidheyo~artho na pratibhAti| arthavaditi pratyekaM padarUpatayA prasiddhArtham| paraspareNAyujyamAnamiti vAkyarUpatayA~arthApratyAyakaM; cakrAdayo hi shabdAH kriyAM vinA na vAkyarUpArthAbhidhAyakA ityarthaH| viruddhe dRuShTAntaviruddhaM yathA- yathA shItaM jalaM tApakaM tathA jvaro~apIti| siddhAntaviruddhaM yathA- vaidyo brUte- na bheShajaM rogaharamiti; Ayurvede catuShpAdameva bheShajamiti siddhAnta eva, tathA catuShpAdasa~jj~jA samayakRutA j~jeyA| evaM yAj~jikAnAmAlabhyasa~jj~jA samayakRutA| tatra yadi svasamayaviparItamabhidadhAti tadA samayaviruddhaM bhavati||54||

atha vAkyaprashaMsA- vAkyaprashaMsA nAma yathA khalvasminnarthe tvanyUnam, anadhikam, arthavat, anapArthakam, aviruddham, adhigatapadArthaM ceti yattadvAkyamananuyojyamiti prashasyate||55||

Commentary: ananuyojyamiti nAnuyogArham||55||

atha cchalaM- chalaM nAma parishaThamarthAbhAsamanarthakaM vAgvastumAtrameva| taddvividhaM- vAkchalaM, sAmAnyacchalaM ca| tatra vAkchalaM nAma yathA- kashcidbrUyAt- navatantro~ayaM bhiShagiti, atha bhiShag brUyAt- nAhaM navatantra ekatantro~ahamiti; paro brUyAt- nAhaM bravImi nava tantrANi taveti, api tu navAbhyastaM te tantramiti; bhiShak brUyAt- na mayA navAbhyastaM tantram, anekadhA~abhyastaM mayA tantramiti; etadvAkchalam| sAmAnyacchalaM nAma yathA- vyAdhiprashamanAyauShadhamityukte, paro brUyAt- sat satprashamanAyeti kiM nu bhavAnAha; san hi rogaH, sadauShadhaM; yadi ca sat satprashamanAya bhavati, tatra sat kAsaH, sat kShayaH, satsAmAnyAt kAsaste kShayaprashamanAya bhaviShyatIti| etat sAmAnyacchalam||56||

Commentary: chalamityAdi| parishaThamiti va~jcanApravRuttam| arthavadivAbhAsata ityarthAbhAsaH| etadeva vivRuNoti- apArthakamityAdi| apagatasamIcInArthatvena vAgvastumAtramityarthaH| chalaM hyabhipretArthAdarthAntaraM parikalpya paravacanopaghAtAya pratikalpyate| yaduktaM nyAye “vacanavighAto~arthavikalpopapattyA cchalam” (nyA. da. 1/2/10) iti| atra vAkchale evopacAracchalaM nyAyoktaM sambhavati| sAmAnyashabdokte hyarthe vakturabhiprAyAdarthAntarakalpanA vAkchalaM; tena ‘ma~jcAH kroshanti’ ityatrApi ma~jcashabdo mukhyaH san ma~jce vartate, upacArAttu ma~jcastheShu puruSheShu ma~jcashabdaprayoge sati ‘kathamacetanA ma~jcAH kroshanti’?, ityAkShepo vAkchala eva pravishatIti bhAvaH| navatantro~ayamityAdi vyaktam| sAmAnyacchalalakShaNamatrAnuktaM, tatra nyAyoktalakShaNameva j~jeyaM; yathA- ‘sambhavato~arthasyAtisAmAnyayogAdasambhUtArthakalpanA sAmAnyacchalam’ (nyA. da. 1/2/13) iti| sat satprashamAyeti satA sataH prashamaH kriyate iti tava matamiti kRutvA cchalavAdI pUrvapakShaM karoti, tenAvivakShitena sattvasAmAnyena pratyavasthAnAt sAmAnyacchalaM bhavati||56||

athAhetuH- aheturnAmaprakaraNasamaH, saMshayasamaH, varNyasamashceti| tatra prakaraNasamo nAmAheturyathA- anyaH sharIrAdAtmA nitya iti; paro brUyAt- yasmAdanyaH sharIrAdAtmA, tasmAnnityaH; sharIraM hyanityamato vidharmiNA cAtmanA bhavitavyamityeSha cAhetuH; nahi ya eva pakShaH sa eva heturiti| saMshayasamo nAmAheturya eva saMshayahetuH sa eva saMshayacchedahetuH; yathA- ayamAyurvedaikadeshamAha, kinnvayaM cikitsakaH syAnna veti saMshaye paro brUyAt- yasmAdayamAyurvedaikadeshamAha tasmAccikitsako~ayamiti, na ca saMshayacchedahetuM visheShayati, eSha cAhetuH; na hi ya eva saMshayahetuH, sa eva saMshayacchedaheturbhavati| varNyasamo nAmAhetuH- yo heturvarNyAvishiShTaH; yathA- kashcidbUyAt- asparshatvAdbuddhiranityA shabdavaditi; atra varNyaH shabdo buddhirapi varNyA, tadubhayavarNyAvishiShTatvAdvarNyasamo~apyahetuH||57||

Commentary: ahetuH asAdhakaheturityarthaH| prakriyate sAdhyatvenAdhikriyata iti vyutpattyA prakaraNaM pakShaH , tena samaH prakaraNasamaH| anyaH sharIrAdAtmA nitya iti pratij~jAyAM sharIrAdanyatvaM nityatvaM cAtmanaH sAdhyam| ato vidharmiNeti sharIrAdanityAdvidharmiNA nityenetyarthaH| ya eva pakSha ityanenAnyatvaM ca sharIrAdAtmano na siddhamiti darshayati, sati hi nityatve cetanAdhArasya sharIrAdanyatvamapi sidhyati; cArvAkapakShe tu sharIrameva cetanamanityaM ceti taM pratyubhayamapi sAdhyaM; na ca sAdhyaM sAdhanaM bhavati, asiddhatvAditi bhAvaH| ayamAyurvedaikadeshamAheti AyurvedaikadeshAbhidhAnaM cikitsakAcikitsakagamakatvena saMshayahetuH, ekadeshakathanaM hi shAstrAnabhyAse~api kutashcicchravaNAdapi bhavatIti bhAvaH| na saMshayacchedahetuM visheShayatIti na saMshayacchedahetuM vishiShTaM darshayatItyarthaH| eSha cAheturiti yathokto heturahetuH saMshayocchede ityarthaH| varNyena sAdhyena dRuShTAnto~apyasiddhatvena sama iti varNyasamaH| varNyaH shabda iti asparshatvayogAdanityatvena shabdo~api sAdhyaH, na ca sAdhyo dRuShTAnto bhavati| ubhayavarNyAvishiShTatvAditi ubhayatra varNye dRuShTAnte ca varNyasya sAdhyasya sAdhyatvenAvishiShTatvAdityarthaH||57||
tatropAyAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- adhyayanam, adhyApanaM, tadvidyasambhAShA cetyupAyAH||6||

tatrAyamadhyayanavidhiH- kalyaH kRutakShaNaH prAtarutthAyopavyUShaM vA kRutvA~a~avashyakamupaspRushyodakaM devarShigobrAhmaNaguruvRuddhasiddhAcAryebhyo namaskRutya same shucau deshe sukhopaviShTo manaHpuraHsarAbhirvAgbhiHsUtramanukrAman punaH punarAvartayed buddhvA samyaganupravishyArthatattvaM svadoShaparihArArthaM paradoShapramANArthaM ca; evaM madhyandine~aparAhNe rAtrau ca shashvadaparihApayannadhyayanamabhyasyet| ityadhyayanavidhiH||7||

athAtItakAlam- atItakAlaM nAma yat pUrvaM vAcyaM tat pashcAducyate, tat kAlAtItatvAdagrAhyaM bhavatIti; pUrvaM vA nigrahaprAptamanigRuhya parigRuhya pakShAntaritaM pashcAnnigRuhIte, tattasyAtItakAlatvAnnigrahavacanamasamarthaM bhavatIti||58||

Commentary: yat pUrvaM vAcyaM tat pashcAducyate iti yathA nigamanamabhidhAya pashcAt pratij~jocyate| nigrahaprAptamiti nigrahaNIyaM j~jAtam||58||

athopAlambhaH- upAlambho nAma hetordoShavacanaM; yathA- pUrvamahetavo hetvAbhAsA vyAkhyAtAH||59||

Commentary: hetordoShavacanamityanena kAlAtyayApadiShTAsiddhayordvayorapIhAnuktayorgrahaNaM kartavyam; udAharaNArthaM tvahetava uktAH| hetuvadAbhAsanta iti hetvAbhAsAH||59||
atha parihAraH- parihAro nAma tasyaiva doShavacanasya pariharaNaM; yathA- nityamAtmani sharIrasthe jIvali~ggAnyupalabhyante, tasya cApagamAnnopalabhyante, tasmAdanyaH sharIrAdAtmA nityashceti||60||
atha pratij~jAhAniH- pratij~jAhAnirnAma sA pUrvaparigRuhItAM pratij~jAM paryanuyukto yat parityajati, yathA prAk pratij~jAM kRutvA nityaH puruSha iti, paryanuyuktastvAha- anitya iti||61||
athAbhyanuj~jA- abhyanuj~jA nAma sA ya iShTAniShTAbhyupagamaH||62||
atha hetvantaraM- hetvantaraM nAma prakRutahetau vAcye yadvikRutahetumAha||63||
athArthAntaram- arthAntaraM nAmaikasmin vaktavye~aparaM yadAha| yathA- jvaralakShaNe vAcye pramehalakShaNamAha||64||

atha nigrahasthAnaM- nigrahasthAnaM nAma parAjayaprAptiH; tacca trirabhihitasya vAkyasyAparij~jAnaM pariShadi vij~jAnavatyAM, yadvA ananuyojyasyAnuyogo~anuyojyasya cAnanuyogaH| pratij~jAhAniH, abhyanuj~jA, kAlAtItavacanam, ahetuH, nyUnam, adhikaM, vyartham, anarthakaM, punaruktaM, viruddhaM, hetvantaram, arthAntaraM ca nigrahasthAnam||65||
iti vAdamArgapadAni yathoddeshamabhinirdiShTAni bhavanti||66||

vAdastu khalu bhiShajAM pravartamAno pravartetAyurveda eva, nAnyatra| atra hi vAkyaprativAkyavistarAH kevalAshcopapattayaH sarvAdhikaraNeShu| tAH sarvAH samavekShyAvekShya sarvaM vAkyaM brUyAt, nAprakRutakamashAstramaparIkShitamasAdhakamAkulamavyApakaM vA| sarvaM ca hetumadbrUyAt| hetumanto hyakaluShAH sarva eva vAdavigrahAshcikitsite kAraNabhUtAH, prashastabuddhivardhakatvAt; sarvArambhasiddhiM hyAvahatyanupahatA buddhiH||67||

Commentary: idAnIM yathoktavAda evAyurvede AyurvedAdhyAyibhiH kartavyaH, evambhUtasyaiva vAdasya vivakShitatvaM samyagj~jAnajanakatvAdityAha- vAda ityAdi| atha kimarthaM vAdaviShayAH santItyAha- atra hItyAdi| sarvAdhikaraNeShu ‘santi’ iti sheShaH| avyApakaM veti brUyAditi pUrveNa sambandhaH| vAdo vigrahaH sharIramiva yeShAM te vAdavigrahA jalpabhedA vitaNDAbhedAshca| prashastabuddhikartRutvena kathaM vAdashcikitsAyAM kAraNaM bhavatItyAha- sarvetyAdinA| na kevalaM cikitsAsiddhiM karotyanupahatA buddhiH, kintu sarvArambhasiddhiM karotItyarthaH||67||

imAni khalu tAvadiha kAnicit prakaraNAni bhiShajAM j~jAnArthamupadekShyAmaH| j~jAnapUrvakaM hi karmaNAM samArambhaM prashaMsanti kushalAH| j~jAtvA hi kAraNa-karaNa-kAryayoni-kArya-kAryaphalAnubandha-desha-kAla-pravRuttyupAyAn samyagabhinirvartamAnaH kAryAbhinirvRuttAviShTaphalAnubandhaM kAryamabhinirvartayatyanatimahatA yatnena kartA||68||

Commentary: samprati buddhervardhanakAraNatadvidyasambhAShAvidhyabhidhAnaprasa~ggeNAyurvedopayuktakAraNAdyabhidhAyakAnyapi prakaraNAni buddhivardhanAnyabhidhAtuM pratijAnIte- imAnItyAdi| j~jAnapUrvakamiti kartavyakAryAnuguNapadArthaj~jAnapUrvakamityarthaH| yAni j~jAtvA kriyamANaM kAryaM sAdhu bhavati tAnyAha- j~jAtvA hItyAdi| abhinirvartamAna iti Abhimukhyena vartamAnaH| iShTaM tAdAtvikaM phalamanubandhashcAyatIyaphalaM yasya tadiShTaphalAnubandham||68||

tatra kAraNaM nAma tad yat karoti, sa eva hetuH, sa kartA||69||

Commentary: uktAni kAraNAdIni vyAkaroti- tatretyAdinA| yaditi kAraNapratyavamarshAnnapuMsakam| karotIti svAtantryeNa karoti| teneha kAraNashabdena svatantrakAraNaM kartRulakShaNamucyate||69||

karaNaM punastad yadupakaraNAyopakalpate kartuH kAryAbhinirvRuttau prayatamAnasya||70||

Commentary: karaNaM vivRuNoti- karaNaM punarityAdi| upakaraNAyeti kartuH sampAdye kArye sannihitaM sahakAritayA vyApriyate| kAryAbhinirvRuttAviti kAryAbhinirvRuttimuddishya| yatamAnasyeti yatnaM kurvataH| etena yaH kArye kAraNAntaraprerakaH, sa cAtra kartA kAraNashabdenocyate; yattu kartradhInavyApAre sAdhakatamaM, tat karaNam| kartRutvaM ca tasyaiva mukhyaM yo hi buddhiprayatnayuktatvAditarakAraNaprerako bhavati, acetane tu kartRutvavyapadeshaH svAtantryavivakShayA bhAktaH||70||

kAryayonistu sA yA vikriyamANA kAryatvamApadyate||71||

Commentary: kAryasya yoniH samavAyikAraNaM kAryayoniH| yetyAdi yA yoniH kAraNarUpA vikriyamANA rUpAntaramApadyamAnA kAryatvamApadyate kAryarUpA bhavatItyarthaH| tatra ghaTasya mRuttikA kAryayoniH; mRudeva hyavasthAntaraprAptyA ghaTo bhavati||71||

kAryaM tu tadyasyAbhinirvRuttimabhisandhAya kartA pravartate||72||

Commentary: abhinirvRuttimabhisandhAyeti kartavyatAbuddhiM sthirIkRutya||72||

kAryaphalaM punastad yatprayojanA kAryAbhinirvRuttiriShyate||73||

Commentary: kAryaphalashabdeneha tAdAtvikaM kAryaphalaM j~jeyaM, yathA- kumbhakArasya ghaTakaraNe tanmUlyaprAptiH; anubandhastvAyatIyaM phalaM, yathA- ghaTamUlyaviniyogaH kuTumbapoShaNAdau||73||

anubandhaH khalu sa yaH kartAramavashyamanubadhnAti kAryAduttarakAlaM kAryanimittaH shubho vA~apyashubho bhAvaH||74||

Commentary: anubadhnAtIti uttarakAlaM kartAramupatiShThate| shubho vA~apyashubho veti shubhasya kAryasya shubhaH, ashubhasya cAshubhaH||74||

deshastvadhiShThAnam||75||

Commentary: deshastvadhiShThAnamiti kAryAnuguNo~ananuguNo vA AdhArarUpo deshaH||75||

kAlaH punaH pariNAmaH||76||

Commentary: pariNAma iti pariNAmI RutvayanAdirUpaH kAlaH| tena nityagaM kAlaM nirasyati, tasya sarvasAdhAraNatvena kAryaM pratyanapekShaNIyatvAt||76||

pravRuttistu khalu ceShTA kAryArthA; saiva kriyA, karma, yatnaH, kAryasamArambhashca||77||

Commentary: pravRutteshceShTAdishabdAH paryAyA eva lakShaNam||77||

athAdhyApanavidhiH- adhyApane kRutabuddhirAcAryaH shiShyamevAditaH parIkSheta; tadyathA- prashAntamAryaprakRutikamakShudrakarmANamRujucakShurmukhanAsAvaMshaM tanuraktavishadajihvamavikRutadantauShThamaminminaM dhRutimantamanaha~gkRutaM medhAvinaM vitarkasmRutisampannamudArasattvaM tadvidyakulajamathavA tadvidyavRuttaM tattvAbhiniveshinamavya~ggamavyApannendriyaM nibhRutamanuddhatamarthatattvabhAvakamakopanamavyasaninaM shIlashaucAcArAnurAgadAkShyaprAdakShiNyopapannamadhyayanAbhikAmamarthavij~jAne karmadarshane cAnanyakAryamalubdhamanalasaM sarvabhUtahitaiShiNamAcAryasarvAnushiShTipratikaramanuraktaM ca, eva~gguNasamuditamadhyApyamAhuH||8||

Commentary: iha shiShyaguNeShu RujucakShurmukhanAsAvaMshatvAdayo guNAH sahajalakShaNatvenopAdeyAH; ato viparItalakShaNo hi jaDo bhavati| tadvidyavRuttamiti Ayurvedaj~jAcAram| nibhRutamiti vinItam| anuddhatamiti anaha~gkRutam| anurAgashabdenAdhyAyanAnurAga ucyate, anuraktamityanena ca gurAvanuraktatvamucyate| dAkShyaM darshayitvA~apyanalasamiti yat karoti tena dAkShyAdArabdhe~api kArye bahuprayAsasAdhye~analasamityAha| anushiShTipratikaramiti Aj~jAkaram||8||

evaMvidhamadhyayanArthinamupasthitamArirAdhayiShumAcAryo~anubhASheta - udagayane shuklapakShe prashaste~ahani tiShyahastashravaNAshvayujAmanyatamena nakShatreNa yogamupagate bhagavati shashini kalyANe kalyANe ca karaNe maitre muhUrte muNDaH kRutopavAsaH snAtaH kAShAyavastrasaMvItaH sagandhahastaH samidho~agnimAjyamupalepanamudakumbhAn mAlyadAmadIpahiraNyahemarajatamaNimuktAvidrumakShaumaparidhIn kushalAjasarShapAkShatAMshca shuklAni sumanAMsi grathitAgrathitAni medhyAn bhakShyAn gandhAMshca ghRuShTAnAdAyopatiShThasveti||9||
sa tathA kuryAt||10||

tamupasthitamAj~jAya same shucau deshe prAkpravaNe udakpravaNe vA catuShkiShkumAtraM caturasraM sthaNDilaM gomayodakenopaliptaM kushAstIrNaM suparihitaM paridhibhishcaturdishaM yathoktacandanodakumbhakShaumahemahiraNyarajatamaNimuktAvidrumAla~gkRutaM medhyabhakShyagandhashuklapuShpalAjasarShapAkShatopashobhitaM kRutvA, tatra pAlAshIbhirai~ggudIbhiraudumbarIbhirmAdhukIbhirvA samidbhiragnimupasamAdhAya prA~gmukhaH shuciradhyayanavidhimanuvidhAya madhusarpirbhyAM tristrirjuhuyAdagnimAshIHsamprayuktairmantrairbrahmANamagniM dhanvantariM prajApatimashvinAvindramRuShIMshca sUtrakArAnabhimantrayamANaH pUrvaM svAheti||11||
shiShyashcainamanvAlabheta| hutvA ca pradakShiNamagnimanuparikrAmet| parikramya brAhmaNAn svasti vAcayet; bhiShajashcAbhipUjayet||12||

athainamagnisakAshe brAhmaNasakAshe bhiShaksakAshe cAnushiShyAt- brahmacAriNA shmashrudhAriNa satyavAdinA~amAMsAdena medhyasevinA nirmatsareNAshastradhAriNA ca bhavitavyaM, na ca te madvacanAt ki~jcidakAryaM syAdanyatra rAjadviShTAt prANaharAdvipulAdadharmyAdanarthasamprayuktAdvA~apyarthAt; madarpaNena matpradhAnena madadhInena matpriyahitAnuvartinA ca shashvadbhavitavyaM, putravaddAsavadarthivaccopacaratA~anuvastavyo~aham , anutsekenAvahitenAnanyamanasA vinItenAvekShyAvekShyakAriNA~anasUyakena cAbhyanuj~jAtena pravicaritavyam, anuj~jAtena (cAnanuj~jAtena ca) pravicaratA pUrvaM gurvarthopAharaNe yathAshakti prayatitavyaM, karmasiddhimarthasiddhaM yasholAbhaM pretya ca svargamicchatA bhiShajA tvayA gobrAhmaNamAdau kRutvA sarvaprANabhRutAM sharmAshAsitavyamaharaharuttiShThatA copavishatA ca, sarvAtmanA cAturANAmArogyAya prayatitavyaM, jIvitahetorapi cAturebhyo nAbhidrogdhavyaM, manasA~api ca parastriyo nAbhigamanIyAstathA sarvameva parasvaM, nibhRutaveshaparicchadena bhavitavyam, ashauNDenApApenApApasahAyena ca, shlakShNashukladharmyasharmyadhanyasatyahitamitavacasA deshakAlavicAriNA smRutimatA j~jAnotthAnopakaraNasampatsu nityaM yatnavatA ca; na ca kadAcidrAjadviShTAnAM rAjadveShiNAM vA mahAjanadviShTAnAM mahAjanadveShiNAM vA~apyauShadhamanuvidhAtavyaM, tathA sarveShAmatyarthavikRutaduShTaduHkhashIlAcAropacArANAmanapavAdapratikAraNAM mumUrShUNAM ca, tathaivAsannihiteshvarANAM strINAmanadhyakShANAM vA; na ca kadAcit strIdattamAmiShamAdAtavyamananuj~jAtaM bhartrA~athavA~adhyakSheNa, AturakulaM cAnupravishatA viditenAnumatapraveshinA sArdhaM puruSheNa susaMvItenAvAkshirasA smRutimatA stimitenAvekShyAvekShya manasA sarvamAcaratA samyaganupraveShTavyam, anupravishya ca vA~gmanobuddhIndriyANi na kvacit praNidhAtavyAnyanyatrAturAdAturopakArArthAdAturagateShvanyeShu vA bhAveShu, na cAturakulapravRuttayo bahirnishcArayitavyAH, hrasitaM cAyuShaH pramANamAturasya jAnatA~api tvayA na varNayitavyaM tatra yatrocyamAnamAturasyAnyasya vA~apyupaghAtAya sampadyate; j~jAnavatA~api ca nAtyarthamAtmano j~jAne vikatthitavyam, AptAdapi hi vikatthamAnAdatyarthamudvijantyaneke||13||

Commentary: te bhavitavyamiti tvayA bhavitavyam| pravicaritavyamiti cikitsArthaM vyavahartavyam| gobrAhmaNamAdau kRutveti prathamaM gobrAhmaNAnAM sharma AshAsitavyaM, tatashcetareShAM prANinAm| upavishatA ceti cchedaH| shuNDA madyashAlA, tatpracArI shauNDaH; ashauNDastu tadapracArI| shuklamiva shuklaM, nirdoShatvAdetadvacanam| yatnavatA bhavitavyamiti sambandhaH| rAj~jo dviShTo rAjadviShTaH, yastu rAjAnaM dveShTi sa rAjadveShI| AcArasyopacaraNamAcAropacAraH| anadhyakShANAM vA na pratikartavyamiti yojanA| pravRuttaya iti vArtAH| tatreti na varNayitavyamityanena sambadhyate| anyasya AturaputrapitrAdeH; anyatra udAsIne jIvitahrAsakathanaM yashaskarameva| na vikatthitavyaM na shlAghA kartavyA| AptAdapi hIti atrAptaH satyavAgucyate, anyatrApi satyamevAptaM vakShyati; yathAkAlaprAptameva brUyAdityarthaH||13||

na caiva hyasti sutaramAyurvedasya pAraM, tasmAdapramattaH shashvadabhiyogamasmin gacchet, etacca kAryam, evambhUyashca vRuttasauShThavamanasUyatA parebhyo~apyAgamayitavyaM, kRutsno hi loko buddhimatAmAcAryaH shatrushcAbuddhimatAm, atashcAbhisamIkShya buddhimatA~amitrasyApi dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM pauShTikaM laukyamabhyupadishato vacaH shrotavyamanuvidhAtavyaM ceti| ataH paramidaM brUyAt- devatAgnidvijaguruvRuddhasiddhAcAryeShu te nityaM samyagvartitavyaM, teShu te samyagvartamAnasyAyamagniH sarvagandharasaratnabIjAni yatheritAshca devatAH shivAya syuH, ato~anyathA vartamAnasyAshivAyeti| evaM bruvati cAcArye shiShyaH ‘tathA’ iti brUyAt| yathopadeshaM ca kurvannadhyApyaH, ato~anyathA tvanadhyApyaH| adhyApyamadhyApayan hyAcAryo yathoktaishcAdhyApanaphalairyogamApnotyanyaishcAnuktaiH shreyaskarairguNaiH shiShyamAtmAnaM ca yunakti| ityadhyApanavidhiruktaH||14||

Commentary: na caiva hItyAdi| yasmAdAyurvedo~api j~jAtuM na shakyate prAyastenAyurvedaj~jAnArthamudyamaM gacchet| asminniti dustare Ayurvede| anuktasadvRuttakaraNArthamAha- etaccetyAdi|- etacceti ‘athainamagnisakAshe’ ityAdigranthoktamanuShTheyam| evambhUyashca vRuttasauShThavamiti uktasadRushaM ca sAdhuvRuttamityarthaH| laukyaM lokAnumatam| itishabdo~avadhAraNe, tena yadevAmitrasya dhanyAdiguNayuktaM vacastadevAnuvidhAtavyaM shrotavyaM ca| yathoktairiti shAstrAntare; na hyasmin shAstre~adhyayanaphalaM sAkShAt kvaciduktam||14||

upAyaH punastrayANAM kAraNAdInAM sauShThavamabhividhAnaM ca samyak kAryakAryaphalAnubandhavarjyAnAM, kAryANAmabhinirvartaka ityatastUpAyaH ; kRute nopAyArtho~asti, na ca vidyate tadAtve, kRutAccottarakAlaM phalaM, phalAccAnubandha iti||78||

Commentary: upAyamAha- upAyaH punarityAdi| sauShThavamiti suShThutvaM kartrAdInAM kAryAnuguNayogitvamityarthaH| abhividhAnaM ca samyagiti kAraNAdInAM kAryAnuguNyenAvasthAnaM, yathA- bheShajasya shirovirecanakArakasya tApanapicudAnamityAdi; yathA vA paTakAraNAnAM tantvAdInAM paTavApanayogyatayA~avasthAnam| etaccopAyarUpaM sauShThavamabhividhAnaM ca kAryAditrikarahitAnAM kAraNAdInAM j~jeyamityAha- kAryetyAdi| upAyasya svarUpAntaramAha - kAryANAmabhinirvartaka ityatastUpAya iti| asatyupAye kAraNAdIni kAryaM na kurvantItyarthaH| atha kathaM kAryAdiShUpAyatvaM na sambhavatItyAha- kRuta ityAdi| upAyo hi kAryakArakaH, tatra kRute utpanne kArye nopAyArtho~asti, na hi kRutaM punaH kriyate; tena kAryagatamapyupAyatvaM na punaH kAryotpAde svIkurmaH| athAnutpanne kArye upAyarUpatA bhaviShyatItyAha- na ca vidyate tadAtve; ‘kAryam’ iti sheShaH; tadAtve kAryotpatteH pUrvaM kAryameva nAsti, tena tadAtve~apyupAyatvaM kAryasya nAstIti| yadA ca kArya evopAyatvamupAyottarakAlInatvena nAsti tadA kAryottarakAlajayoH phalAnubandhayorapi upAyArtho nAstItyAha- kRutAccottarakAlamityAdi||78||

etaddashavidhamagre parIkShyaM, tato~anantaraM kAryArthA pravRuttiriShTA| tasmAdbhiShak kAryaM cikIrShuH prAk kAryasamArambhAt parIkShayA kevalaM parIkShyaM parIkShya karma samArabheta kartum||79||

Commentary: upasaMharati- etadityAdi||79||

tatra cedbhiShagabhiShagvA bhiShajaM kashcidevaM khalu pRucched- vamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanashirovirecanAni prayoktukAmena bhiShajA katividhayA parIkShayA katividhameva parIkShyaM, kashcAtra parIkShyavisheShaH, kathaM ca parIkShitavyaH, kimprayojanA ca parIkShA, kva ca vamanAdInAM pravRuttiH, kva ca nivRuttiH, pravRuttinivRuttilakShaNasaMyoge ca kiM naiShThikaM, kAni ca vamanAdInAM bheShajadravyANyupayogaM gacchantIti||80||

Commentary: sampratyuktaM kAraNAdidashakaM vaidyopayuktabhiShagAdidRuShTAntena darshayituM tatra cedityAdiprakaraNamArabhate| abhiShagveti ki~jcidbhiShagityarthaH| katividhaM parIkShyamiti katiprakAraM parIkShaNIyam| pravRuttinivRuttilakShaNasaMyoga iti pravRuttyanuguNanivRuttyanuguNayorlakShaNayorekatra melake| kiM naiShThikamiti niShThA nishcayastadbhavaM naiShThikaM; kiM nishcayena kartavyamityarthaH||80||

sa evaM pRuShTo yadi mohayitumicchet, brUyAdenaM- bahuvidhA hi parIkShA tathA parIkShyavidhibhedaH, katamena vidhibhedaprakRutyantareNa bhinnayA parIkShayA kena vA vidhibhedaprakRutyantareNa parIkShyasya bhinnasya bhedAgraM bhavAn pRucchatyAkhyAyamAnaM ; nedAnIM bhavato~anyena vidhibhedaprakRutyantareNa bhinnayA parIkShayA~anyena vA vidhibhedaprakRutyantareNa parIkShyasya bhinnasyAbhilaShitamarthaM shrotumahamanyena parIkShAvidhibhedenAnyena vA vidhibhedaprakRutyantareNa parIkShyaM bhittvA~anyathA~a~acakShANa icchAM pUrayeyamiti||81||

Commentary: yadi mohayitumicchediti yadi vigRuhyasambhAShApravRuttatvena mohayitumicchedityarthaH| tatheti bahuvidha ityarthaH| vidhirUpo bhedo vidhibhedaH, tasya prakRutyantaramiti kAraNAntaram| bhedAgramiti bhedaparimANaM, bhedaparimANaM ceha bhedasa~gkhyApariccheda eva j~jeyaH| AkhyAyamAnamiti cchedaH| kimarthamevaM punaH pRucchasItyAkA~gkShAyAmAha- nedAnImityAdi| bhavato~anyathA shrotumabhilaShitamarthamahamanyathA~a~acakShANo na bhavata icchAM pUrayeyaM; tena tvameva tAvadvisheShayitvA pRuccheti vAkyArthaH| yadA tu, ‘vedAnIM na pUrayeyam ’ itipAThaH, tadA vedAnImityagre AcakShANa icchAM na pUrayeyamiti yojyaM; kiMvA, neti pUrveNa yujyate| tena, katamena vidhibhedaprakRutyantareNAkhyAyamAnaM bhavAnicchati, kena vA vidhibhedaprakRutyantareNAkhyAyamAnamicchati na, iti yojyam| idAnImityAdi tu pUrvavadAsha~gkAyAM vacanam| etadvisheShapRucchayA pRucchako vyAkulo bhavatIti bhAvaH| parIkShyasyArthaM bhavataH shrotumabhilaShitamanyathA AcakShANa iti yojanA||81||

sa yaduttaraM brUyAttat samIkShyottaraM vAcyaM syAdyathoktaM ca prativacanavidhimavekShya; samyak yadi tu brUyAnna cainaM mohayitumicchet, prAptaM tu vacanakAlaM manyeta, kAmamasmai brUyAdAptameva nikhilena||82||

Commentary: tat samIkShyeti tadvacanaM samIkShya yadaupayikaM bhavati| yathoktaM prativacanavidhimityatraivAdhyAye vigRuhyasambhAShAvidhAvuktamavekShyottaraM vAcyam| pakShAntaramAha- samyagityAdi| samyagyadi tu brUyAditi yadi sandhAyasambhAShAyAM brUyAt| prAptamiti ucitam, ucite hi vacanakAle vaktavyameva; Aptameveti yathArthamevetyarthaH||82||

dvividhA tu khalu parIkShA j~jAnavatAM- pratyakSham, anumAnaM ca| etaddhi dvayamupadeshashca parIkShA syAt| evameShA dvividhA parIkShA, trividhA vA sahopadeshena||83||

Commentary: tadeva yathArthamuttaraM pUrvaprashneShu yathAkrameNAha- dvividhAtvityAdi| j~jAnavatAmityAptopadesharUpashAstrajanitaj~jAnavatAm| pakShAntare parIkShAtraividhyamAha- etaddhItyAdi| etacca parIkShAyA dvaividhyaM traividhyaM vA trividharogavisheShavij~jAnIya eva vyAkhyAtam||83||

dashavidhaM tu parIkShyaM kAraNAdi yaduktamagre, tadiha bhiShagAdiShu saMsArya sandarshayiShyAmaH- iha kAryaprAptau kAraNaM bhiShak, karaNaM punarbheShajaM, kAryayonirdhAtuvaiShamyaM, kAryaM dhAtusAmyaM, kAryaphalaM sukhAvAptiH, anubandhaH khalvAyuH, desho bhUmirAturashca, kAlaH punaH saMvatsarashcAturAvasthA ca, pravRuttiH pratikarmasamArambhaH, upAyastu bhiShagAdInAM sauShThavamabhividhAnaM ca samyak| ihApyasyopAyasya viShayaH pUrveNaivopAyavisheSheNa vyAkhyAtaH| iti kAraNAdIni dasha dashasu bhiShagAdiShu saMsArya sandarshitAni, tathaivAnupUrvyaitaddashavidhaM parIkShyamuktaM ca||84||

Commentary: bhiShagAdiShu saMsAryeti bhiShagAdIni copayuktAnyudAharaNAni kRutvA| dhAtuvaiShamyamiti viShamatAM gatA dhAtavaH; dhAtava eva hi viShamAmavasthAM parityajya samAvasthAmApadyamAnA ArogyAkhyasya dhAtusAmyasya samavAyikAraNatayA kAryayonitAmApadyante| sukhAvAptiriti arogyAvAptiH| uktaM ca- “sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyaM” (sU.a.9) iti| AyushcAnubandhaphalarUpaM yadyapyatra rogigataM na vaidyagataM, tathA~api vaidyena kA~gkShitatvAdvaidyagatameva tadvij~jeyam| tenAnubandhalakShaNe kartAramabhipraitIti yaduktaM tadupapannam| kartA hyatra bhiShak, tenAturagatamapyAyurbhiShagapekShitatvena bhiShaja eva phalamiti j~jeyam| pratikarma cikitsA| ihApyasyetyAdi| atrApi kAryaphalAnubandhavyatiriktAnAM kAraNAdInAM sauShThavamabhividhAnaM ca yathoktanyAyenopAya iti darshayati||84||
tasya yo yo visheSho yathA yathA ca parIkShitavyaH, sa tathA tathA vyAkhyAsyate||85||

kAraNaM bhiShagityuktamagre, tasya parIkShA- bhiSha~gnAma yo bhiShajyati, yaH sUtrArthaprayogakushalaH, yasya cAyuH sarvathA viditaM yathAvat| sa ca sarvadhAtusAmyaM cikIrShannAtmAnamevAditaH parIkSheta guNiShu guNataH kAryAbhinirvRuttiM pashyan, kaccidahamasya kAryasyAbhinirvartane samartho na veti; tatreme bhiShagguNA yairupapanno bhiShagdhAtusAmyAbhinirvartane samartho bhavati; tadyathA- paryavadAtashrutatA, paridRuShTakarmatA, dAkShyaM, shaucaM, jitahastatA, upakaraNavattA, sarvendriyopapannatA, prakRutij~jatA, pratipattij~jAtA ceti||86||

karaNaM punarbheShajam| bheShajaM nAma tadyadupakaraNAyopakalpate bhiShajo dhAtusAmyAbhinirvRuttau prayatamAnasya visheShatashcopAyAntebhyaH| taddvividhaM vyapAshrayabhedAt- daivavyapAshrayaM, yuktivyapAshrayaM ceti| tatra daivavyapAshrayaM- mantrauShadhimaNima~ggalabalyupahArahomaniyamaprAyashcittopavAsasvastyayanapraNipAtagamanAdi, yuktivyapAshrayaM- saMshodhanopashamane ceShTAshca dRuShTaphalAH| etaccaiva bheShajama~ggabhedAdapi dvividhaM- dravyabhUtamH, adravyabhUtaM ca| tatra yadadravyabhUtaM tadupAyAbhiplutam| upAyo nAma bhayadarshanavismApanavismAraNakShobhaNaharShaNabhartsanavadhabandhasvapnasaMvAhanAdiramUrto bhAvavisheSho yathoktAH siddhyupAyAshcopAyAbhiplutA iti| yattu dravyabhUtaM tadvamanAdiShu yogamupaiti| tasyApIyaM parIkShA- idamevamprakRutyaiva~gguNamevamprabhAvamasmin deshe jAtamasminnRutAvevaM gRuhItamevaM nihitamevamupaskRutamanayA ca mAtrayA yuktamasmin vyAdhAvevaMvidhasya puruShasyaivatAvantaM doShamapakarShatyupashamayati vA, yadanyadapi caivaMvidhaM bheShajaM bhavettaccAnena visheSheNa yuktamiti||87||

Commentary: visheShatashcopAyAntebhya ityanena kAryayonipravRuttideshakAlopAyebhyo~anyadyadyat karturupakaraNaM bhavati tat karaNamiti darshayati| kAryayonirhi loke vikAryakarmatayA sAdhakatamAt karaNAt pRuthagucyate, pravRuttyupAyayostu kartRukaraNAdidharmatvena na karaNasa~jj~jA, deshakAlau tu na sAdhakatamau; tenopAyAntebhyo yathoktavisheSheNa yat karturupakaraNaM bhavati, tat karaNam| atra daivavyapAshrayayuktivyapAshrayadvaividhye tu sattvAvajayo~api bheShajamavaruddhaM j~jeyaM; sattvAvajayo hi dRuShTadvAropakArI yuktivyapAshraye, tathA~adRuShTadvAropakArI tu daivavyapAshraye pravishati| ata evoktaM yuktivyapAshrayavyAkaraNe- ceShTAshca dRuShTaphalA iti| ceShTAshabdena manashceShTA~api sattvAvajayalakShaNA gRuhyate| punarauShadhasya prakArAntareNa dvaividhyamAha- a~ggabhedAdityAdi| a~ggaM sharIraM svarUpamiti yAvat; tena svarUpabhedAdityarthaH| dravyabhUtaM dravyarUpam evamadravyarUpam| upAyAbhiplutamiti upAyavyAptam, upAyagrahaNagRuhItamiti yAvat| evaM manyate- bhayAdayo~amUrtA bhAvA na sAkShAdArogyakAraNAni bhavanti, kiM tarhi sharIrasthitAneva vAtAdIn tathA kurvanti samatvenotpAdyamAnAn yenArogyaM bhavati, na hyamUrtAni mUrtAnAM sharIradhAtUnAmutpattau samavAyikAraNAni bhavanti; bheShajaM tu dravyabhUtaM samasharIrotpAde samavAyikAraNaM bhavatyeva, tena dravyasyArogyaM prati sAdhakatamatvaM sAdhuH amUrtAnAM tu bhayAdInAM na bheShajavat sAdhakatamatvamiti kRutvA dravyajanya eva dhAtusAmye teShAmupAyatvaM yuktam| evaM sUkShmayA buddhyA bhayAdInAmupAyatvaM, sthUlayA tu buddhyA bheShajatvamapIti kRutvA bhayAdiShu bheShajavyavahArashcAcAryAbhimato dvividhabheShaje~arthe~adravyabhUtabhayAdigrahaNAdunnIyate | na kevalamadravyabhUtaM bheShajamupAyavyAptaM, kiM tvanye~api paricArakAdaya upAyagrahaNagRuhItA evetyAha- yathoktAH siddhyupAyAshceti| yathoktAH siddhyupAyAH paricArakAdayo~atra dashavidhaparIkShye sAkShAdanuktAste~api upAyAbhiplutA evetyarthaH| kiMvA upAyAbhiplutamiti upAyamishritam| tatra bhayAdyamUrtabheShaja eva yathoktA upAyAH kAraNAdisauShThavasamyagabhividhAnarUpA adravyabhUtabheShajapakShagRuhItA ityarthaH| tena, bhayAdiShu tathopAyashabdAbhidheyeShu ca adravyabhUtabheShajashabdaprayogo bhavatIti darshayati| ye tu ‘upAyAntAbhiplutam’ iti paThanti, te deshakAlAveva adravyabhUtabheShajamiti vadanti; vadanti ca dravyashabdena kvAthakalkAdyupayojanIyaM dravyamucyate iti| etacca nAtimanohAri| anena ceti sAdhanabhUtena ca ‘evamprakRutyA’ ityAdinoktena tathA sAdhyena ca ‘evaMvidhasya puruShasya’ ityAdinoktena visheSheNa yuktamabhUdityarthaH||87||

kAryayonirdhAtuvaiShamyaM, tasya lakShaNaM vikArAgamaH| parIkShA tvasya vikAraprakRuteshcaivonAtiriktali~ggavisheShAvekShaNaM vikArasya ca sAdhyAsAdhyamRududAruNali~ggavisheShAvekShaNamiti||88||

Commentary: tasya lakShaNaM dhAtuvaiShamyasya pratyAtmarUpamityarthaH| vikAraprakRuteriti vikArakAraNasya doShasyetyarthaH||88||

kAryaM dhAtusAmyaM, tasya lakShaNaM vikAropashamaH| parIkShA tvasya- rugupashamanaM, svaravarNayogaH, sharIropacayaH, balavRuddhiH, abhyavahAryAbhilAShaH, rucirAhArakAle, abhyavahRutasya cAhArasya kAle samyagjaraNaM, nidrAlAbho yathAkAlaM, vaikAriNAM ca svapnAnAmadarshanaM, sukhena ca pratibodhanaM, vAtamUtrapurISharetasAM muktiH, sarvAkArairmanobuddhIndriyANAM cAvyApattiriti||89||

Commentary: sarvAkArairiti sarvashubhalakShaNaiH||89||

kAryaphalaM sukhAvAptiH, tasya lakShaNaM- manobuddhIndriyasharIratuShTiH||90||

Commentary: sukhAvAptiriti AtmaguNasukhaprAptiH||90||

anubandhastu khalvAyuH, tasya lakShaNaM- prANaiH saha saMyogaH||91||

Commentary: prANaiH saha saMyoga iti prANalakShaNena vAyunA yoga ityarthaH| tena prANashabdasyAyuSho bhinnArthatvAllakShyalakShaNayorabhedaH ||91||
deshastu bhUmirAturashca||92||

tatra bhUmiparIkShA Aturaparij~jAnahetorvA syAdauShadhaparij~jAnahetorvA| tatra tAvadiyamAturaparij~jAnahetoH| tadyathA- ayaM kasmin bhUmideshe jAtaH saMvRuddho vyAdhito vA; tasmiMshca bhUmideshe manuShyANAmidamAhArajAtam, idaM vihArajAtam, idamAcArajAtam, etAvacca balam, evaMvidhaM sattvam, evaMvidhaM sAtmyam, evaMvidho doShaH, bhaktiriyam, ime vyAdhayaH, hitamidam, ahitamidamiti prAyograhaNena | auShadhaparij~jAnahetostu kalpeShu bhUmiparIkShA vakShyate||93||

Aturastu khalu kAryadeshaH| tasya parIkShA AyuShaH pramANaj~jAnahetorvA syAd, baladoShapramANaj~jAnahetorvA| tatra tAvadiyaM baladoShapramANaj~jAnahetoH; doShapramANAnurUpo hi bheShajapramANavikalpo balapramANavisheShApekSho bhavati| sahasA hyatibalamauShadhamaparIkShakaprayuktamalpabalamAturamatipAtayet; na hyatibalAnyAgneyavAyavIyAnyauShadhAnyagnikShArashastrakarmANi vA shakyante~alpabalaiH soDhum; asahyAtitIkShNavegatvAddhitAni sadyaHprANaharANi syuH| etaccaiva kAraNamapekShamANA hInabalamAturamaviShAdakarairmRudusukumAraprAyairuttarottaragurubhiravibhramairanAtyayikaishcopacarantyauShadhaiH; visheShatashca nArIH, tA hyanavasthitamRuduvivRutaviklavahRudayAH prAyaH sukumAryo~abalAH parasaMstabhyAshca| tathA balavati balavadvyAdhiparigate svalpabalamauShadhamaparIkShakaprayuktamasAdhakameva bhavati| tasmAdAturaM parIkSheta prakRutitashca, vikRutitashca, sAratashca, saMhananatashca, pramANatashca, sAtmyatashca, sattvatashca, AhArashaktitashca, vyAyAmashaktitashca, vayastashceti, balapramANavisheShagrahaNahetoH||94||

Commentary: bhUmirUpaM deshamabhidhAyAturarUpamAha- Aturastu khalvityAdi| kAryadesha iti kartavyadhAtusAmyAdhAra ityarthaH| balasya doShasya ca pramANaM baladoShapramANam| iyamiti agre ‘tasmAdAturaM parIkSheta’ ityAdigranthavakShyamANA| atha kimarthaM baladoShapramANaparIkShA kartavyetyAha- doShapramANetyAdi| doShapramANApekShayA bheShajapramANaM kriyate, tenaiva samyak sAdhyasiddhiryasmAdbhavati tasmAdbalapramANaparIkShA sharIrasya kartavyeti prakaraNArthaH| balapramANavisheShApekSha iti yadi balavaccharIraM bhavati tadaiva doShapramANApekShayA mahauShadhapramANaM bhavati, viparyaye tu na bhavati| etadeva viparyayeNa vyAkaroti- sahasetyAdi| alpabale rogiNyaparIkShakaprayuktamevAtimAtraM bheShajaM bhavatItyuktaM, na tu parIkShakaprayuktamiti| sadyaHprANaharANi syuriti ‘alpabale’ ityarthAdgRuhyate| aviShAdakaraM sharIramanasoraglAnikaram| uttarottaraM pramANalakShaNagurutvaM yeShAM, taiH| tena yadi durbale mahAdoShaH, sa ca bhUrimAtrabheShajasAdhyastathA~api tadAtvavyApattibhayAnna sahasA bheShajabhUyastvaM kartavyaM, kintUttarottaramabhyAsavashAdbalamapekShya bheShajabhUyastvaM kartavyamiti darshayati| avibhramairiti pAkakAle~apyavaikArikaiH| anAtyayikairiti na mahAvipattikaraiH| yathoktaguNaM bheShajaM visheSheNa strINAM kartavyamityAha- visheShata ityAdi| hRudayashabdena hRudayasthaM mana iti j~jeyam| mRuduvivRutam agambhIram| viklavaM stokakleshAbhibhavanIyam, anena ca durbalacetastvamuktam| parasaMstabhyAH na svayamAtmAnaM sattvabalAt stambhayanti| tathetyAdinA svalpapramANabheShajadoShamAha| balavadyAdhiparigate iti vacanena ya eva balavAn vyAdhirbalavataH sa evAnalpabheShajAsAdhyaH; yastu balavato~apyalpabalaH so~alpabheShajasAdhya eva| parIkShAhetumabhidhAya yathA sharIraM parIkShaNIyaM tadAha- tasmAdityAdi| balapramANavisheShagrahaNahetorityatra dehabalaM doShabalaM ca sAmAnyena gRuhyate| yena vikRutitaH sharIraj~jAnaM doShabalaj~jAnahetorbhavati, tadeva ‘prakRutyAdInAM vikRutivarjyAnAM’ ityAdinA vakShyati| kiMvA balaM sharIrabalamevocyate; tatra ca vikRutibalenApi sharIrabalaM budhyata iti kRutvA iha sAmAnyenoktam, uttaratra tu vikRutyA doShapramANaM prAyo vij~jAyata iti kRutvA ‘vikRutibalatraividhyena doShabalatraividhyamanumIyate ’ ityuktam||94||

tatra prakRutyAdIn bhAvAnanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH | tadyathA- shukrashoNitaprakRutiM, kAlagarbhAshayaprakRutiM, AturAhAravihAraprakRutiM, mahAbhUtavikAraprakRutiM ca garbhasharIramapekShate| etAni hi yena yena doSheNAdhikenaikenAnekena vA samanubadhyante, tena tena doSheNa garbho~anubadhyate; tataH sA sA doShaprakRutirucyate manuShyANAM garbhAdipravRuttA| tasmAcchleShmalAH prakRutyA kecit, pittalAH kecit, vAtalAH kecit, saMsRuShTAH kecit, samadhAtavaH kecidbhavanti| teShAM hi lakShaNAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH||95||

Commentary: prakRutimiti svabhAvam| etAnIti shukrAdIni| atra shukre shoNite vA yAdRugavastho doShastAdRuggarbhe prakRutirbhavati; tathA shukrashoNitamelakakAle RuturUpe yo doSha utkaTo bhavati, sa prakRutimArabhate; evaM garbhAshayasthashca doShaH; mAturAhAravihArau tatkAlInau yaddoShakaraNasvabhAvau, sA ca prakRutirgarbhasharIre bhavati| eShu ca prakRutyArambhakeShu kAraNeShu yadbalavadbhavati kAraNAntarabRuMhitaM ca, tadeva prakRutyArambhakaM bhavati| kAlAdayashca shukrashoNitameva kurvantaH prakRutijanakA bhavantIti tantrAntare shukrashoNitagatadoSheNaiva prakRutyutpAdo darshitaH| garbhAdipravRutteti garbhasyAdimelake pravRuttA| atra ca samairdoShairvRuddhairgarbhajanmaiva na bhavatIti vikRutadoShatrayaprakRuteranabhidhAnAditi j~jeyam| prakRutivikArashca sUtrasthAna eva vyAkRutaH ||95||

shleShmA hi snigdhashlakShNamRudumadhurasArasAndramandastimitagurushItavijjalAcchaH| tasya snehAcchleShmalAH snigdhA~ggAH, shlakShNatvAcchlakShNA~ggAH, mRudutvAddRuShTisukhasukumArAvadAtagAtrAH, mAdhuryAt prabhUtashukravyavAyApatyAH, sAratvAt sArasaMhatasthirasharIrAH, sAndratvAdupacitaparipUrNasarvA~ggAH, mandatvAnmandaceShTAhAravyAhArAH, staimityAdashIghrArambhakShobhavikArAH, gurutvAt sArAdhiShThitAvasthitagatayaH, shaityAdalpakShuttRuShNAsantApasvedadoShAH, vijjalatvAt sushliShTasArasandhibandhanAH, tathA~acchatvAt prasannadarshanAnanAH prasannasnigdhavarNasvarAshca bhavanti| ta eva~gguNayogAcchleShmalA balavanto vasumanto vidyAvanta ojasvinaH shAntA AyuShmantashca bhavanti||96||

Commentary: mRudutvaM jalakRutam| avadAtagAtrA iti mRudutvAdevAvadAtatvam| ashIghrashabda ArambhAdibhiH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| sAragatayo na skhalanti, adhiShThitagatayaH sarveNa padena mahImAkrAmanti, avasthitagataya iti avasthitatvena na capalA gatirbhavati| prasanne darshanAnane yasya sa tathA| vasumattvAdi prakRutirUpaM yadbhavati, tat prakRutiprabhAvAjj~jeyam||96||

pittamuShNaM tIkShNaM dravaM visramamlaM kaTuka~jca| tasyauShNyAt pittalA bhavantyuShNAsahA, uShNamukhAH, sukumArAvadAtagAtrAH , prabhUtavipluvya~ggatilapiDakAH, kShutpipAsAvantaH, kShipravalIpalitakhAlityadoShAH, prAyomRudvalpakapilashmashrulomakeshAshca; taikShNyAttIkShNaparAkramAH, tIkShNAgnayaH, prabhUtAshanapAnAH, kleshAsahiShNavo, dandashUkAH; dravatvAcchithilamRudusandhimAMsAH, prabhUtasRuShTasvedamUtrapurIShAshca; visratvAt prabhUtapUtikakShAsyashiraHsharIragandhAH; kaTvamlatvAdalpashukravyavAyApatyAH; ta eva~gguNayogAt pittalA madhyabalA madhyAyuSho madhyaj~jAnavij~jAnavittopakaraNavantashca bhavanti||97||

Commentary: dandashUkAH punaH punarbhakShaNashIlAH| prabhUtAshanatvaM tu bahubhakShaNatvena| prabhUtaH pUtiH kakShAprabhRutiShu gandho yeShAM te tathA||97||

vAtastu rUkShalaghucalabahushIghrashItaparuShavishadaH| tasya raukShyAdvAtalA rUkShApacitAlpasharIrAH pratatarUkShakShAmasannasaktajarjarasvarA jAgarUkAshca bhavanti, laghutvAllaghucapalagaticeShTAhAravyAhArAH, calatvAdanavasthitasandhyakShibhrUhanvoShThajihvAshiraHskandhapANipAdAH, bahutvAdbahupralApakaNDarAsirApratAnAH, shIghratvAcchrIghrasamArambhakShobhavikArAH shIghratrAsarAgavirAgAH shrutagrAhiNo~alpasmRutayashca, shaityAcchItAsahiShNavaH pratatashItakodvepakastambhAH, pAruShyAt paruShakeshashmashruromanakhadashanavadanapANipAdAH, vaishadyAt sphuTitA~ggAvayavAH satatasandhishabdagAminashca bhavanti; ta eva~gguNayogAdvAtalAH prAyeNAlpabalAshcAlpAyuShashcAlpApatyAshcAlpasAdhanAshcAlpadhanAshca bhavanti||98||
saMsargAt saMsRuShTalakShaNAH||99||

sarvaguNasamuditAstu samadhAtavaH| ityevaM prakRutitaH parIkSheta||100||

Commentary: sarvaguNasamuditA iti sarvaprakRutiShUktaprashastaguNayuktAH; yaduktaM vAgbhaTe- ‘samadhAtuH samastAsu shreShThA’ (vA.sU.a.1) iti| yadi ca prashastaguNavAn na syAt, na tadA shreShThatvaM syAt| sAmyasthitAshca doShAH sAmyaprabhAvAdeva guNAn paraM kurvate, na doShAniti j~jeyam||100||

vikRutitashceti vikRutirucyate vikAraH| tatra vikAraM hetu-doSha-dUShya-prakRuti-desha-kAla-balavisheShairli~ggatashca parIkSheta, na hyantareNa hetvAdInAM balavisheShaM vyAdhibalavisheShopalabdhiH| yasya hi vyAdherdoSha-dUShya-prakRuti-desha-kAla-balasAmyaM bhavati, mahacca hetuli~ggabalaM, sa vyAdhirbalavAn bhavati; tadviparyayAccAlpabalaH; madhyabalastu doShadUShyAdInAmanyatamasAmAnyAddhetuli~ggamadhyabalatvAccopalabhyate||101||

Commentary: sAmyaM bhavatIti parasparatulyaguNatA bhavati| mahacca hetuli~ggabalamiti hetavo li~ggAni ca balavanti bhUyAMsi ca| anyatamasAmAnyAditi doShAdInAM yena kenacit sAmAnye satItyarthaH||101||
sAratashceti sArANyaShTau puruShANAM balamAnavisheShaj~jAnArthamupadishyante; tadyathA- tvagraktamAMsamedo~asthimajjashukrasattvAnIti||102||
tatra snigdhashlakShNamRuduprasannasUkShmAlpagambhIrasukumAralomA saprabheva ca tvak tvaksArANAm| sA sAratA sukhasaubhAgyaishvaryopabhogabuddhividyArogyapraharShaNAnyAyuShyatvaM cAcaShTe||103||

karNAkShimukhajihvAnAsauShThapANipAdatalanakhalalATamehanaM snigdharaktavarNaM shrImadbhrAjiShNu raktasArANAm| sA sAratA sukhamuddhatAM medhAM manasvitvaM saukumAryamanatibalamakleshasahiShNutvamuShNAsahiShNutvaM cAcaShTe||104||

sha~gkhalalATakRukATikAkShigaNDahanugrIvAskandhodarakakShavakShaHpANipAdasandhayaH sthiragurushubhamAMsopacitA mAMsasArANAm| sA sAratA kShamAM dhRutimalaulyaM vittaM vidyAM sukhamArjavamArogyaM balamAyushca dIrghamAcaShTe||105||
varNasvaranetrakeshalomanakhadantauShThamUtrapurISheShu visheShataH sneho medaHsArANAm| sA sAratA vittaishvaryasukhopabhogapradAnAnyArjavaM sukumAropacAratAM cA caShTe||106||
pArShNigulphajAnvaratnijatrucibukashiraHparvasthUlAH sthUlAsthinakhadantAshcAsthisArAH| te mahotsAhAH kriyAvantaH kleshasahAH sArasthirasharIrA bhavantyAyuShmantashca||107||
mRudva~ggA balavantaH snigdhavarNasvarAH sthUladIrghavRuttasandhayashca majjasArAH| te dIrghAyuSho balavantaH shrutavittavij~jAnApatyasammAnabhAjashca bhavanti||108||

saumyAH saumyaprekShiNaH kShIrapUrNalocanA iva praharShabahulAH snigdhavRuttasArasamasaMhatashikharadashanAH prasannasnigdhavarNasvarA bhrAjiShNavo mahAsphicashca shukrasArAH| te strIpriyopabhogA balavantaH sukhaishvaryArogyavittasammAnApatyabhAjashca bhavanti||109||

smRutimanto bhaktimantaH kRutaj~jAH prAj~jAH shucayo mahotsAhA dakShA dhIrAH samaravikrAntayodhinastyaktaviShAdAH suvyavasthitagatigambhIrabuddhiceShTAH kalyANAbhiniveshinashca sattvasArAH| teShAM svalakShaNaireva guNA vyAkhyAtAH||110||

tatra sarvaiH sArairupetAH puruShA bhavantyatibalAH paramasukhayuktAH kleshasahAH sarvArambheShvAtmani jAtapratyayAH kalyANAbhiniveshinaH sthirasamAhitasharIrAH susamAhitagatayaH sAnunAdasnigdhagambhIramahAsvarAH sukhaishvaryavittopabhogasammAnabhAjo mandajaraso mandavikArAH prAyastulyaguNavistIrNApatyAshcirajIvinashca||111||
ato viparItAstvasArAH||112||
madhyAnAM madhyaiHsAravisheShairguNavisheShA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||113||
iti sArANyaShTau puruShANAM balapramANavisheShaj~jAnArthamupadiShTAni bhavanti||114||

kathaM nu sharIramAtradarshanAdeva bhiSha~gmuhyedayamupacitatvAdbalavAn, ayamalpabalaH kRushatvAt, mahAbalo~ayaM mahAsharIratvAt, ayamalpasharIratvAdalpabala iti; dRushyante hyalpasharIrAH kRushAshcaike balavantaH; tatra pipIlikAbhAraharaNavat siddhiH| atashca sArataH parIkShetetyuktam ||115||

saMhananatashceti saMhananaM, saMhatiH , saMyojanamityeko~arthaH| tatra samasuvibhaktAsthi, subaddhasandhi, suniviShTamAMsashoNitaM, susaMhataM sharIramityucyate| tatra susaMhatasharIrAH puruShA balavantaH, viparyayeNAlpabalAH, madhyatvAt saMhananasya madhyabalA bhavanti||116||

Commentary: saMhatiriti nibiDasandhAnatetyarthaH||116||

pramANatashceti sharIrapramANaM punaryathAsvenA~ggulipramANenopadekShyate utsedhavistArAyAmairyathAkramam| tatra pAdau catvAri ShaT caturdashA~ggulAni, ja~gghe tvaShTAdashA~ggule ShoDashA~ggulaparikShepe ca, jAnunI catura~ggule ShoDashA~ggulaparikShepe, triMshada~ggulaparikShepAvaShTAdashA~ggulAvUru, ShaDa~gguladIrghau vRuShaNAvaShTA~ggulapariNAhau, shephaH ShaDa~gguladIrghaM pa~jcA~ggulapariNAhaM, dvAdashA~ggulipariNAho bhagaH, ShoDashA~ggulavistArA kaTI, dashA~ggulaM bastishiraH, dashA~ggulavistAraM dvAdashA~ggulamudaraM, dashA~ggulavistIrNe dvAdashA~ggulAyAme pArshve, dvAdashA~ggulaM stanAntaraM, dvya~ggulaM stanaparyantaM, caturvishatya~ggulavishAlaM dvAdashA~ggulotsedhamuraH, dvya~ggulaM hRudayam, aShTA~ggulau skandhau, ShaDa~ggulAvaMsau, ShoDashA~ggulau prabAhU, pa~jcadashA~ggulau prapANI, hastau dvAdashA~ggulau , kakShAvaShTA~ggulau, trikaM dvAdashA~ggulotsedham, aShTAdashA~ggulotsedhaM pRuShThaM, catura~ggulotsedhA dvAviMshatya~ggulapariNAhA shirodharA, dvAdashA~ggulotsedhaM caturviMshatya~ggulapariNAhamAnanaM, pa~jcA~ggulamAsyaM, cibukauShThakarNAkShimadhyanAsikAlalATaM catura~ggulaM, ShoDashA~ggulotsedhaM dvAtriMshada~ggulapariNAhaM shiraH; iti pRuthaktvenA~ggAvayavAnAM mAnamuktam| kevalaM punaHsharIrama~gguliparvANi caturashItiH| tadAyAmavistArasamaM samucyate| tatrAyurbalamojaH sukhamaishvaryaM vittamiShTAshcApare bhAvA bhavantyAyattAH pramANavati sharIre; viparyayastvato hIne~adhike vA||117||

Commentary: pramANatashcetyAdinA prashastaM pramANama~ggAvayavAnAmAha| pAdau utsedhena catvAri, vistAreNa ShaT, dairghyeNa caturdashA~ggulAnIti yathAkramaM bhavataH| ja~gghA jAnvadhastAducyate| parikShepaH pariNAhaH| jAnuH ja~gghorusandhiH| pariNAhaparimANaM ca yaducyate tanmadhyasthAnasya, tenAsamapariNAhamAneShu ja~gghAdiShu madhyasthAnametajj~jeyam| kaThyA utsedhaparimANaM noktaM, tasyA utsedhasyorvantarAdhisandhitvena pRuthagutsedhapramANasyAvidyamAnatvAt| prabAhuraMsAdarvAk kaphoNiparyantam| prapANiH kaphoNyadhastAt| trikamiti gudAsthnaH prabhRuti kaTIkapAlordhvaparyantam| cibukaM ca oShThashca karNau ca akShimadhyaM ca nAsikA ca lalATaM ca prati prati catura~ggulam| ShaDa~ggulotsedhaM shira iti pRuShThamanu grIvAyA upari j~jeyam| kevalamiti pAdatalAt prabhRuti shiraHparyantaM caturashItya~ggulaM bhavati, evaM sArdhatrihastapramANatvaM sharIrasya svahastena bhavati| atra ca pratyavayavotsedhena caturashItya~ggulAdadhikaM yaccharIraM bhavati, tadavayavAnAmavayavAntaradairdhyAnupraviShTAnAM grahaNAt; tena pratyavayavadairdhyamAnena na caturashItya~ggulaM gaNanIyaM kiM tu samuditameva sharIram| tatra pAdasyA~ggulAni catvAri, ja~gghAyA aShTAdasha, jAnunashcatvAri, UrvoraShTAdasha, pRuShThasyAShTAdasha, grIvAyAshcatvAri, shirasaH ShaT, evaM caturashItya~ggulAni ghaTante| sushrutena samaM yo~atra mAnavirodhaH so~atrA~ggulimAnabhedAcchamayitavyaH| tatra hi saviMshama~ggulishataM puruShamAnamuktam| tena tatrA~gguli(la)mAnamevAlpaM j~jeyam| AyAmavistArasamamiti yathoktapratyavayavAyAmavistArayuktaM; kiMvA, yAvatA~a~ayAmena caturashItya~ggulaM, tAvadyadi vistRutabAhudvayapramANena ca vistAreNa sharIraM bhavati, tadA AyAmavistArasamaM bhavati| tatreti yathoktapramANavati sharIre iti yojanIyam| hIne iti hInapramANe| adhike iti adhikapramANe||117||

sAtmyatashceti sAtmyaM nAma tadyat sAtatyenopasevyamAnamupashete| tatra ye ghRutakShIratailamAMsarasasAtmyAH sarvarasasAtmyAshca te balavantaH kleshasahAshcirajIvinashca bhavanti, rUkShasAtmyAH punarekarasasAtmyAshca ye te prAyeNAlpabalA alpakleshasahA alpAyuSho~alpasAdhanAshca bhavanti, vyAmishrasAtmyAstu ye te madhyabalAH sAtmyanimittato bhavanti||118||

Commentary: sAtmyatashcetyatra sAtmyashabdena okasAtmyamucyate, prakRutisAtmyAdInAM bheShajAdiparIkShayaiva parIkShitatvAditi j~jeyam| alpasAdhanA iti alpabheShajAH, ekarasasAtmyAnAM pa~jcarasA asAtmyatvenApathyA iti bhAvaH||118||

sattvatashceti sattvamucyate manaH| taccharIrasya tantrakamAtmasaMyogAt| tat trividhaM balabhedena- pravaraM, madhyam, avaraM ceti; atashca pravaramadhyAvarasattvAH puruShA bhavanti| tatra pravarasattvAH sattvasArAste sAreShUpadiShTAH, svalpasharIrA hyapi te nijAgantunimittAsu mahatIShvapi pIDAsvavyathA dRushyante sattvaguNavaisheShyAt; madhyasattvAstvaparAnAtmanyupanidhAya saMstambhayantyAtmanA~a~atmAnaM parairvA~api saMstabhyante; hInasattvAstu nAtmanA nApi paraiH sattvabalaM prati shakyante upastambhayituM, mahAsharIrA hyapi te svalpAnAmapi vedanAnAmasahA dRushyante, sannihitabhayashokalobhamohamAnA raudrabhairavadviShTabIbhatsavikRutasa~gkathAsvapi ca pashupuruShamAMsashoNitAni cAvekShya viShAdavaivarNyamUrcchonmAdabhramaprapatanAnAmanyatamamApnuvantyathavA maraNamiti||119||

Commentary: tantrakamiti preraka dhArakaM ca| te sAreShUpadiShTA iti ya eva sattvasArAsta eva pravarasattvA iti j~jeyA ityarthaH| sattvaguNavaisheShyAditi sattvaguNena saMstambhitavedanAvikAratvAdavyathA iva dRushyanta ityarthaH| parAnAtmanyupanidhAyeti paraM vedanAsahaM dRuShTvA, ‘cedayaM vedanAsahastadahamapi vedanAsaho bhavAmi’ iti kRutvA vedanAM sahata ityarthaH||119||

AhArashaktitashceti AhArashaktirabhyavaharaNashaktyA jaraNashaktayA ca parIkShyA; balAyuShI hyAhArAyatte||120||

Commentary: jaraNashaktyA cetivacanAdyo bahu bhu~gkte pariNamayati ca, asAvAhArashaktimAnihocyate, na tu vastugapariNatigRuhItaH||120||

vyAyAmashaktitashceti vyAyAmashaktirapi karmashaktyA parIkShyA| karmashaktyA hyanumIyate balatraividhyam ||121||

Commentary: karma bhAravahanAdi, tatra shaktiH karmashaktiH||121||
(agniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute| anenAvadhinA sthAnaM vimAnAnAM samarthitam|)

pUrvAdhyAye vyAdhitarUpabhrAntij~jAnamuktaM, tacca buddhidoShAdbhavati, tena vishuddhabuddhyutpAdahetUnAmadhyayanAdhyApanatadvidyasambhAShANAM kathanAya rogabhiShagjitIyo~abhidhIyate| rogabhiShagjitaM cikitsitamadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyo rogabhiShagjitIyaH| rogacikitsAkAritvaM cAsya cikitsopayuktasya samyagj~jAnasAdhanasyAdhyayanavidhyAdestathA karaNakAraNAdeshcAbhidhAnAjj~jeyam||1-2||

saMharShaH spardhA, j~jAnArthamabhiyogasaMharShau karotIti j~jAnAbhiyogasaMharShakarI| vaishAradyamiti paravacanAbhibhavapANDityam; etacca sabhAyAmabhyAsAdbhavati| bhUyo~adhyavasAyamiti dRuDhanishcayam| atha kathaM shrutatvamapi kasyacidguhyasyArthasya syAttadAha- jalpan piNDeneti|- piNDeneti sAroddhAreNa| nanu guhyashcet sAratastat kathamayaM vijigIShustamAhetyAha- saMharShAditi| spardhayA tu guhyo~apyartho vijayArthamabhidhIyata iti bhAvaH| sandhAyasambhAShA naye ‘saMvAda’ ityucyate| vigRuhyasambhAShA tu jalpavitaNDArUpA j~jeyA||15-16||

yathA hemantAdiShu duHkhatamatvaM bhavati tadAha- tatra hemanta ityAdi| avabaddhadoShamiti atibaddhadoSham| tayoriti yathoktasharIrabheShajayoH| toyasya toyadAnugatamArutasya ca saMsargastasmAt| gurupravRuttInIti guroryathA na sukhakAriNI pravRuttirbhavati, tathA~asyApItyarthaH; kiMvA bahupratividheyapravRuttIni gurupravRuttIni| gurusamutthAnAnIti saMshodhanakliShTAni sharIrANi tadA mahatA prayatnena cireNa ca kAlena prakRutiM prApnuvantItyarthaH| varShAnteShviti hemantagrIShmavarShAsu| hemantAdiShvapyAtyayike vyAdhau saMshodhanaM darshayannAha- na cedityAdi| vikalpyeti alpaguNayuktaM kRutvA| kRutrimaguNopadhAnaM yathA- shIte shItapratIkArArthamuShNasadanAdikaraNam; uktaM cAnyatra- “shIte shItapratIkAramuShNe coShNanivAraNam| kRutvA kuryAt kriyAM prAptAM kriyAkAlaM na hApayet”- (su.sU.a.35) iti| Rutau pratIkAraM darshayitvA bheShajapratIkAramAha- bheShajamityAdi| saMyogavikalpo yathA- shIte trivRutAyA uShNena gomUtreNAloDanaM; pramANavikalpo yathA- ayogapratIkArArthamatimAtratrivRuddAnamityAdi| atra ca pramANavikalpastathA kartavyo yathA prANAvirodhaH syAt, tathA saMyogavikalpashca tathA kartavyo yathA viruddhavIryabheShajamelako na syAditi darshayannAha- pramANavIryasamaM kRutveti||126-127||

sArvayaugikAniti sarveShvAsthApanasAdhyeShu rogeShu vAtavyAdhijvaragulmAdiShu yathoktadoShasambandhe sati yaugikAnityarthaH| etadeva vivRuNoti- sarvasho hItyAdi| sarvasha iti samastavargeNa ardhavargeNa yathAlAbhaM vA||145-146||

idAnIM sarvavargANAM sarveShvAsthApanasAdhyarogeShu yaugikatvaM yaduktaM tatra pittajvare kaTuvargeNAsthApanaM pittakaratvAjjvaravardhakaM bhavati, tena na doShavisheSheNa sarvagaNAnAM yaugikatvametaduktaM, kintu sAmAnyena sarvAsthApanasAdhyarogahitatvaM, doShavisheSheShu tu tatra tatrAnanuguNavargasya prakopakasya niShedha eveti darshayannAha- yeShAmityAdi| yeShAM yeShAmiti vAtAdivikArANAmuktAnAmiha| tatra madhuraskandhaH kaphaprashAntyarthamanuktaH, tena kaphavardhakaH; evamamlAdivargeShvapi j~jeyam| kiMvA sArvayaugikAnityanenoktAnAM vargANAM samAsavyAsayogena sakalAsthApanasAdhyarogaharatvamucyate, na pratyekaM; pratyekaM tu vargANAM sAdhyatvenAnuktarogAhantRutvamucyate yeShAmityAdinA||147-148||

sa~ggrahe lakShaNAcAryashiShyANAmiti shAstrAcAryashiShyANAM parIkShA, lakShaNaM hi shAstramucyate| kAraNaM ca yaditi shAstrAdiparIkShAkAraNaM ca yadityarthaH, ‘evambhUtaM shAstramamala ivAdityaH’ ityAdishAstraparIkShAkAraNam| AcAryaparIkShAkAraNaM tu ‘evaMvidho hyAcAryaH’ ityAdi| shiShyaparIkShAkAraNaM tu ‘adhyApyamadhyApayan hyAcAryaH’ ityAdi| adhyeyam adhyetavyaM, tasya vidhiradhyayanavidhireva||152-154||
