idamuktamarthajAtamiti lakShaNAcAryashiShyaparIkShAdirUpamabhidheyajAtamuktam| arthakAntamiti yathA sambaddhArthatvAdinA guNena kamanIyArthaM bhavati tathoktamityarthaH| shabdasya vAkye yojanaM shabdasandhiH| doShAdInAmityAdinA vimAnasthAnArthasa~ggrahaM karoti| hetumaditi upapattimadyathA bhavati tathA doShAdimAnAdityarthaH| niruktAnIti niruktyoktAni| niruktishca doShAdayo visheSheNa mIyante j~jAyante ebhiriti vimAnAni||155-157||

guNavinikShepata iti guNaparimANAdutkRuShTaguNatvena pravara ityarthaH; pratyavaraH hInaguNaH, samaguNaH samo vAdyapekShayetyarthaH| natveva kArtsnyeneti na kulashIladharmAdinA~api pravarAdirihAbhipreta ityarthaH| mUDhapariShadityatra mUDheva mUDhA ki~jcitkRutye, sarvathA mUDhAyAM tu na kashcidbrUte| na kenaciditi nAdhamenApItyarthaH| AviddhaM vakram| kathayitavyamiti vaktavyam| upahasatA paraM prativAdinam| tathA pariShadaM nirUpayatA AkArairiti sambandhaH| kaShTashabdamiti nAtiprasiddhArtham| nocyata iti tvayA nocyata iti vaktavyaM; kaShTashabdasya hyarthaM mUDhA pariShanna jAnAtyeva, tatashca kaShTashabdasyAnarthakatAyAH pariShadaM prApya sukhasAdhyatvamiti bhAvaH | tathA kaShTashabdaM vadaMstvevaM vAcyaM- hInA te pratij~jeti| parisaMvatsaro~adhyayanaM gurumupAsthAya punaradhIShva| paryAptametAvatta iti ‘pakShAvasAdAya’ iti sheShaH| parikShepikamiti pratikShepikashabdam| nAsya yogaH kartavya iti na sakRutparAbhUtasya pakShasya punaH pratikShepakahetunA yogaH kartavya ityarthaH| katha~jcidityAdinA shreyasA samaM vigRuhyasambhAShAyAmekIyamatamAha; natvevetyAdinA AtmamatamAha||19-20||

sAdguNyasya vidyamAnaguNatAyAstathA doShasya balaM sAdguNyadoShabalam| shreShThaM manyeteti yatra vAdaviShaye prativAdinamadhikaM pashyedityarthaH| tatra parasya puraHsaravAdaviShaye tathA vAdo nivartanIyaH, yathA AviShkRutaH prakaTIkRutaH sabhAyAM nAyogaH syAt; anabhIShTaviShaye tathA vAdanivRuttiH kartavyA yathA ko~api na jAnAtyevaM tatra vaktumakShama ityarthaH| tatraiveti tatraiva hInapakShe pravRuttaM nigRuhNIyAditi yojanA| mahatA sUtrapATheneti shrutahIno hyaparicayAddIrghasUtrapAThaM kartumakShamaH | vij~jAnahInamiti aj~jAtArtham| nAnArthavAcineti anekArthavAcinA, ekavidheneti ekavidhena shabdena; pratibhAhIno hyanekArthaM nAvadhArayati yat kenAbhiprAyeNAyaM prayukto~anena shabda iti| vacanashaktihIno~ardhoktavAkyAkShepAnna punarvaktaM kShamo bhavatIti dRuShTam| avishAradamiti adRuShTasabham; adRuShTasabho hyapatrapaNenAtIva lajjitaH sanna ki~jcit pratipadyate| evamiti ‘tadyathA shrutahInam’ ityAdigranthoktam| pravRutte vAde kuryAditi cchedaH||21-24||
pUrvamuktA dIrgha~jjIvitIye||29-30||

uttaramityAdi| uttarashabdeneha jAtyuttaramuttarAbhAsamIpsitaM; yato~asAdhakasAdharmyamAtrapratyavasthAnamevottaravikaraNe darshayiShyati| uktaM ca nyAye- “sAdharmyavaidharmyAbhyAM pratyavasthAnaM jAtiH” (nyA. da. 1/2/18) iti| etacca sAdharmyavaidharmyodAharaNArtham| tena nyAyoktA jAtyuttarA utkarShApakarShasamAdayo~apyanuktA ihaivAnuboddhavyAH| hetusadharmANa iti hetusadRushAH| shItakaH shItaM, himashishiravAtagatAH saMsparshAH shItasya hetubhiH sAdharmyamiti kRutvA yojanA| tena himAdInAM hetUnAM ye shItasparshAste shItake~apIti sAdharmyaM hetuvikArayoriti| paro brUyAditi prativAdI vadet| dAhauShNyakothaprapacane ‘vikAre’ iti sheShaH| hetuvaidharmyaM hetuvaisAdRushyam| himAdisaMsparshAH himAdijanyasparshAH, sharIrAvayavadAhAdivikAre uShNe visadRushA iti vAkyArthaH| evaM tAvad vaidharmyokte hetau viparyayAdyadA hetusAmyamuttaraM kriyate, tadA viparyayo bhavati| evamevodAharaNadvayaM saviparyayaM sampUrNamuttaraM bhavatItyarthaH||35-36||

arthaprAptiriti arthApattirityarthaH| iha ukteneti vacanAcchrutArthApattireva vivakShitA, dRuShTArthApattirapi tvetatsAmAnyatvenaiva j~jeyA| iyaM cArthApattiranyathopapattyA na pramANamiti na pramANaprakaraNe paThitA, yA tu doSharahitA sA~anumAnAntargataiveti bhAvaH| yo hyapatarpaNasAdhyo~api na syAttaM prati ‘nAyaM santarpaNasAdhyaH’ itivacanamevAsamarthavisheShaNatayA na syAdityarthApattirnetyabhiprAyaH, ubhayathA~apyasAdhye hi ‘asAdhyaH’ ityetAvadeva vaktavyaM syAt| evamanyatrApyudAharaNe j~jeyam||47-48||

anuyogamAha- athetyAdi| prashna itishabdena yathoktashAstre sampUrNaprashno gRuhyate, yathA~atraiva ‘tatra cedbhiShak bhiShajaM pRucched’ ityAdinA yAvaduktaM tat sampUrNaM j~jeyam; atraiva caikadesho~api prashnasya j~jeyaH||52-53||

tatreti shAstradRuDhatAdau| tadvidyasambhAShA tacchAstrAdhyAyinA saha sambhAShaNam | kalyaH nIrogaH| kRutakShaNa iti ananyavyApAratvenAdhyayanAya kRutakAlaparigrahaH| prAtarvA utthAya, upavyUShaM vA utthAyeti yojanA| upavyUShamiti ki~jciccheShAyAM rAtrau| manapuraHsarAbhiriti ekAgramanaHpraNItAbhiH| svadoShaparihAraparadoShapramANArthamiti svakIyAdhyayanadoShaparihArArthaM, parakIyAdhyayanadoShapramANArthaM parakIyAdhyayanadoShaj~jAnArthamityarthaH| pramIyate~aneneti pramANaM j~jAnamAtramIpsitam| samyag buddhvA~arthatattvaM, buddhvA cAdhIyAno nirdoShAdhyayano bhavati, samyagadhyayanaj~jAnAcca parasya sadoShamadhyayanaM pratipadyate| ityadhyayanavidhiriti pUrvapratij~jAtAdhyayanavidherupasaMharaNam| yathoktena vidhinA~adhyayanaM kriyamANaM susa~ggRuhItaM bhavati| dRuShTAdRuShTasampattyA~adhyayanakAlavarjanaM vedAdhyayane niShiddhamevAtrApi tajj~jeyamiti na visheSheNoktam||6-7||

yathA nityamAtmanItyAdinA prakaraNasamatvenoktahetau doShamuddharati| nityamiti sarvadA| jIvali~ggAni pratisandhAnasmaraNAdIni| tasyApagamAnnopalabhyanta ityanena mRutasharIre cetanAdyabhAvAdanyadeva tatkAraNamunnIyate, yadapagamAnna cetayate mRutasharIraM, tasmAdanyatvamAtmanaH siddhaM, tatashca sharIrAdanyatvAccharIravidharmitvena pUrvavyutpAditena nityatvamapi sidhyatItyAha- nityashceti||60-61||

iShTAniShTAbhyupagamo yathA- “bhavAn caura” ityukte svadoShamaparihRutya vacanaM- bhavAnapi caura iti| etaddhi vacanaM svIyamaniShTaM cauratvaM parasya ceShTaM cauratvamabhyanujAnAti| tadevaM vacanaM nyAye “matAnuj~jA” shabdenocyate||62-64||

nigrahasya parAjayasya sthAnamiva sthAnaM kAraNamiti nigrahasthAnam| pariShadi vij~jAnavatyAmityanena yadi pariShattasya trirabhihitasyArthaM vijAnAti, prativAdI ca na jAnAti, tadA tasya nigrahasthAnaM bhavati| anyAnapyuktAneva nigrahasthAnatvenAha - ananuyojyasyAnuyoga ityAdi| ete ca vyAkRutA eva| atra cApratibhAdayo~api nyAyoktA antarbhAvanIyA buddhimadbhiH, Ayuvede tathAvidhopakArakatvAbhAvAdetat prapa~jcaviShayamapi na prapa~jcitaM; nyAyavidAM tvetadanuktamapi sugamameva , tadavedinAM ca manAkprapa~jcoktamapi nAlaM j~jAnAyetyalaM prapa~jcena||65-66||

tiShyaH puShyanakShatram, ashvayug ashvinI| shashini kalyANe iti uktanakShatreShvadhyayanArthino yataH shashI kalyANakaro bhavati, udita eva shashinyadhyayanaM kartavyam| maitre muhUrta iti anukUle muhUrte; muhUrtAshca shivabhujagAdayaH| muNDaH kRutavApanaH| gandhena yukto hastaH pa~jcA~ggulo gandhahastaH| hiraNyashabdenAghaTitaM hema gRuhyate, hemashabdena ca ghaTitam| paridhayo hastapramANA homakuNDacatuHpArshve sthApyAH pAlAshAdidaNDA ucyante| atra copArjitavastusAnnidhyameva phalapradamiti RuShivacanAdunnIyate, (tena anyopAhRutamapIShTagandhAdi nodbhAvanIyam)||9-10||

kiShkuriha hastapramANam| suparihitamiti suveShTitam| upadhAyeti Aropya| juhuyAditi adhyApaka ityabhiprAyaH| brahmAdIn svAheti mantreNa mantrayamANa AcAryaH pUrvamagniM juhuyAditi yojanA| tena brahmAdyRugbhirAshIHprayuktAbhiH ‘brahmaNe svAhA’ ityAdibhirhomaH kartavyaH| shiShyashcainamanvAlameteti shiShyo~api guruhomAnantarameva juhuyAdityarthaH||11-12||

kashca parIkShyavisheShaH? kathaM ca parIkShitavyaH? iti prashnadvayottaraM dAtumAha- tasyetyAdi| yo yo visheSha iti kAraNAdInAM yo yo dRuShTakarmatvAdiH sajAtIyAdvaidyAturAdestathA vijAtIyAcca bheShajAdervisheSha ityarthaH| yathA parIkShitavya ityasyodAharaNaM ‘kaccidahamasya’ ityevaM(prakAra)granthe vakShyamANaM j~jeyam| bhiShajyati cikitsati| sarvatheti hitAhitasukhaduHkhatvAdinA| sa ceti kAraNaM bhiSha~gna pareNa parIkShaNIyaH, kiM tvAtmanA~apyAtmAnaM parIkSheteti darshayati | atha kathamAtmAnaM parIkShetetyAha- guNiShvityAdi| AtmAnaM guNayogatayA parIkShetetyarthaH| guNata iti hetau pa~jcamI| kacciditi icchAprakAshane| pratipattiH utpannAyAmApadi jhaTiti kartavyakaraNam||85-86||

kramaprAptaM deshamAha- desha ityAdi| Aturashabdeneha sha~gkyamAnAturyatayA svasthavRuttopapAdanIyaH svastho~api gRuhyate| so~api parIkShyata eva svasthavRuttaprayogArtham| parishabdo visheShArthaH, tenAturasya sakaladeshakRutavisheSheNa j~jAnamAturaparij~jAnam| evaM bheShajaparij~jAne~api deshakRutavisheShaj~jAnaM parij~jAnaM boddhavyam| saMvRuddha iti vardhitaH| evaMvidhaM sAtmyamiti okasAtmyamityarthaH| idaM hitamityanena ca deshApekShayA viparItaguNasAtmyaM brUte| prAyograhaNeneti cchedaH, prAyograhaNena naikAntataH parIkSheteti yojanA| prAyaHshabdena ca deshenAhArAdyanumAnaM na nishcitaM kiM tu prAyobhAvIti darshayati| kalpeShviti madanAdikalpeShu| tatra ca yadyapi prathama eva kalpe bhUmiparIkShA vaktavyA, tathA~apyantarakalpeShvapi tadarthasyAtideshena kathanAdbahuvacanaM kRutam, uttarakalpavaktavyAnyapi hi dravyANi yathokta eva deshe grAhyANIti darshanArtham||92-93||
pratataH prasRutaH| sannaH hInaH, saktaH baddhaH, jarjaraH bhagnapAtradhvanisamaH| satatasandhishabdagAmina iti sandhisphuTanashabdavantaH||98-99||

sAratashcetyAdau sArashabdena vishuddhataro dhAturucyate| saprabheveti prabhAyuktA tvak| tvaksArANAmiti cchedaH| atheyaM sAratA kiM karotItyAha- sA sAratetyAdi| evamanyatrApi sA sAratetyAdi vyAkhyAtavyam| shrImaditi shobhAyuktam| aratniH kaphoNikA| shikharadashanA iti shobhanadashanAH| strIpriya upabhogaH sambhogo yeShAM te tathA| samare vikramya yudhyantIti samaravikrAntayodhinaH| svasthitA iti na parasthitAH| tulyaguNavistIrNApatyA iti janitAtmasadRushApatyAH| prAyaHshabdo niyamena niShedhayati| madhyAnAmiti stokasArANAm| madhyaiH sAravisheShairiti ye tatra sambhavanti sArAstadyuktaiH sAraguNairityarthaH| upacitatvAditi sthUlatvAt| mahAsharIratvAditi atipramANasharIratvAt| pipIlikAbhAraharaNavaditi svalpAH pipIlikA yathA sArasharIratvena mahAntaM bhAraM nayanti, tathA~alpakRushasharIrA ityarthaH||102-115||
athAtaH katidhApuruShIyaM shArIraM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
yA yadindriyamAshritya jantorbuddhiH pravartate| yAti sA tena nirdeshaM manasA ca manobhavA||32||
bhedAt kAryendriyArthAnAM bahvyo vai buddhayaH smRutAH| AtmendriyamanorthAnAmekaikA sannikarShajA||33||
a~ggulya~gguShThatalajastantrIvINAnakhodbhavaH| dRuShTaH shabdo yathA buddhirdRuShTA saMyogajA tathA||34||

buddhIndriyamanorthAnAM vidyAdyogadharaM param| caturviMshatiko hyeSha rAshiH puruShasa~jj~jakaH||35||

Commentary: atra ca buddhivRuttInAM j~jAnAnAM kathanenaivAha~gkAro~api sUcita eva; yato~aha~gkAropajIvitaivAtmAdisaMvaliteyaM buddhiH ‘ahaM pashyAmi’ ityAdirUpA bhavati; tena buddheraha~gkArasya coktatvAdavashiShTamavyakaM kAryadvArA brUte- buddhItyAdi| paramiti avyaktam| buddhyAdInAM yogaM melakaM dharatIti yogadharam; avyaktaM hi prakRutirUpaM puruShArthapravRuttaM buddhyAdimelakaM bhogasampAdakaM sRujati| evaM vyutpAditaM caturviMshatikamupasaMharati- caturviMshatika ityAdi| yadi vA karmendriyANyabhidhAya mahAbhUtAnItyAdinA arthA evAshrayabhUtakhAdikathanenocyante, yA yadindriyamAshrityetyAdinA tu sphuTopalabhyamAnA buddhivRuttibhedA ucyante, buddhyaha~gkAratanmAtrANyavyaktAni tu sUkShmANi noktAni, tAni sarvANyeva buddhIndriyamanorthAnAmityAdigranthe parashabdenocyante, tena yogadharaM paramityanena mUlaprakRutistathA prakRutivikRutayashca mahadAdayaH saptocyante; evaM caturviMshatiko rAshirbhavati| paratvaM ca vikArApekShayA prakRutInAmupapannameva||35||

rajastamobhyAM yuktasya saMyogo~ayamanantavAn| tAbhyAM nirAkRutAbhyAM tu sattvavRuddhyA nivartate||36||

Commentary: sampratyevaMrUpapuruShasya sakAraNaM saMsaraNaM mokShahetuM cAha- raja ityAdi| saMyogo~ayamiti caturviMshatirAshirUpo melakaH| tAbhyAmiti rajastamobhyAm| sattvavRuddhyA kAraNabhUtayA rajastamonivRuttyA puruSharUpaH saMyogo nivartate mokSho bhavatItyarthaH| sattvaM vRuddhaM vishuddhaj~jAnajananAd rajastamasI saMsArakAraNe vijitya prakRutipuruShavivekaj~jAnAnmokShamAvahati||36||
atra karma phalaM cAtra j~jAnaM cAtra pratiShThitam| atra mohaH sukhaM duHkhaM jIvitaM maraNaM svatA||37||
evaM yo veda tattvena sa veda pralayodayau| pAramparyaM cikitsAM ca j~jAtavyaM yacca ki~jcana||38||
bhAstamaH satyamanRutaM vedAH karma shubhAshubham| na syuH kartA ca boddhA ca puruSho na bhavedyadi||39||
nAshrayo na sukhaM nArtirna gatirnAgatirna vAk| na vij~jAnaM na shAstrANi na janma maraNaM na ca||40||
na bandho na ca mokShaH syAt puruSho na bhavedyadi| kAraNaM puruShastasmAt kAraNaj~jairudAhRutaH||41||
na cet kAraNamAtmA syAdbhAdayaH syurahetukAH| na caiShu sambhavej j~jAnaM na ca taiH syAt prayojanam||42||
kRutaM mRuddaNDacakraishca kumbhakArAdRute ghaTam| kRutaM mRuttRuNakAShThaishca gRuhakArAdvinA gRuham||43||
yo vadet sa vadeddehaM sambhUya karaNaiH kRutam| vinA kartAramaj~jAnAdyuktyAgamabahiShkRutaH||44||

kAraNaM puruShaH sarvaiH pramANairupalabhyate| yebhyaH prameyaM sarvebhya AgamebhyaH pramIyate||45||

Commentary: sarvaiH pramANairiti pratyakShAdibhiH| yebhya iti karaNa evApAdAnavivakShayA pa~jcamI| Agamayanti bodhayantIti AgamAH pramANAnyeva; anye tvAgamapramANAbhyAM shAstrANyeva bruvate||45||
na te tatsadRushAstvanye pAramparyasamutthitAH| sArUpyAdye ta eveti nirdishyante navA navAH||46||
bhAvAsteShAM samudayo nirIshaH sattvasa~jj~jakaH| kartA bhoktA na sa pumAniti kecidvyavasthitAH||47||

teShAmanyaiH kRutasyAnye bhAvA bhAvairnavAH phalam| bhu~jjate sadRushAH prAptaM yairAtmA nopadishyate||48||

Commentary: etaddUShayati- teShAmityAdi| teShAM j~jAnasantAnavAdinAm, anyena kRutasyaudanapAkAdeH phalamannAdi anye bhu~jjata iti prApnoti| etaccAsa~ggataM, yataH phalaM bhokShyAmIti kRutvA bhAviphalapratyAshayA pravRuttiryuktA, na tvanyasya bhogyatAM phalasya pashyan kashcit pravartate; yo~api sUpakArAdiH parArthaM pravartate, so~api parArthena svArthaM sAdhayitukAma eveti bhAvaH||48||

karaNAnyAnyatA dRuShTA kartuH kartA sa eva tu| kartA hi karaNairyuktaH kAraNaM sarvakarmaNAm||49||

Commentary: paramataM dUShayitvA svamatamAha- karaNetyAdi| karaNasya sharIrasya pariNAmino~anyAnyatA dRuShTA| kartA cAtmA, sa eva na vinAshItyarthaH| atraiva dRuShTAntamAha- kartA hItyAdi| yathA~anekashilpavit kartA karaNairvAMshIsandaMshayantrAdibhiH kAShThapATanalauhaghaTanAdi karoti, tathA~a~atmA~apItyarthaH||49||
nimeShakAlAdbhAvAnAM kAlaH shIghrataro~atyaye| bhagnAnAM na punarbhAvaH kRutaM nAnyamupaiti ca||50||
mataM tattvavidAmetadyasmAttasmAt sa kAraNam| kriyopabhoge bhUtAnAM nityaH puruShasa~jj~jakaH||51||

aha~gkAraH phalaM karma dehAntaragatiH smRutiH| vidyate sati bhUtAnAM kAraNe dehamantarA||52||

Commentary: AtmasadbhAve hetvantaramAha- aha~gkAra ityAdi| ete~aha~gkAradayaH sthira eva paramAtmani bhavanti, pUrvAparakAlAvasthAyivastudharmatvAditi bhAvaH| dehamantareti dehaM vinA; dehAtirikte kAraNe satyaha~gkAro bhavatItyarthaH||52||

prabhavo na hyanAditvAdvidyate paramAtmanaH| puruSho rAshisa~jj~jastu mohecchAdveShakarmajaH||53||

Commentary: ‘prabhavaH puruShasya kaH’ ityasyottaraM- prabhava ityAdi| prabhavaH kAraNam| rAshisa~jj~ja iti ShaDdhAtusamudAyarUpashcaturviMshatirAshirUpo vA| mohecchAdveShajanitakarmajo mohecchAdveShakarmajaH| mohAddhi bhAveShu icchA dveShashca bhavati, tataH pravRuttiH, pravRutterdharmAdharmau, tau ca sharIraM janayato bhogArtham||53||
AtmA j~jaH karaNairyogAj j~jAnaM tvasya pravartate| karaNAnAmavaimalyAdayogAdvA na vartate||54||
pashyato~api yathA~a~adarshe sa~gkliShTe nAsti darshanam| tattvaM jale vA kaluShe cetasyupahate tathA||55||
karaNAni mano buddhirbuddhikarmendriyANi ca| kartuH saMyogajaM karma vedanA buddhireva ca||56||
naikaH pravartate kartuM bhUtAtmA nAshnute phalam| saMyogAdvartate sarvaM tamRute nAsti ki~jcana||57||

na hyeko vartate bhAvo vartate nApyahetukaH| shIghragatvAtsvabhAvAttvabhAvo na vyativartate||58||

Commentary: atraiva sAmagrIjanyatve sarvakAryANAmupapattimAha- na hyeka ityAdi| eko bhAvaH kAraNarUpaH sahakArikAraNAntararahito na kAryakaraNe vartata ityarthaH; evaM tAvadekaM kAraNaM kArye na vartate, kAryaM ca hetuM vinA na bhavatItyAha- vartate nApyahetuka iti; hetuM vinA bhAva utpattidharmA na vartate na bhavatItyarthaH| tena karaNayuktAtmajanyaM kAryaM na kevalAdAtmano heturUpAdbhavatItyuktaM bhavati| atha hetuM vinA cedbhAvo na bhavati, tat kimabhAve~api shArIrANAM bhAvAnAM hetvapekShA na vetyAha- shIghragatvAdityAdi| shIghragatvAt svabhAvAllakShito~abhAvo na svabhAvaM vyativartate shIghragatvasvabhAvaM na tyajatItyarthaH| tena, ahetuka evAbhAvo bhavati, bhAvastu sahetukaH| uktaM hi “utpattiheturbhAvanAM na nirodhe~asti kAraNam” (sU.a.16) iti| kiMvA, shIghragatvAdasthiratvAdabhAvo nAvasthAntaramAtmanAshaM prati gacchatIti granthArthaH||58||
katidhA puruSho dhIman! dhAtubhedena bhidyate| puruShaH kAraNaM kasmAt, prabhavaH puruShasya kaH||3||
kimaj~jo j~jaH, sa nityaH kiM kimanityo nidarshitaH| prakRutiH kA, vikArAH ke, kiM li~ggaM puruShasya ca||4||
niShkriyaM ca svatantraM ca vashinaM sarvagaM vibhum| vadantyAtmAnamAtmaj~jAH kShetraj~jaM sAkShiNaM tathA||5||
niShkriyasya kriyA tasya bhagavan! vidyate katham| svatantrashcedaniShTAsu kathaM yoniShu jAyate||6||
vashI yadyasukhaiH kasmAdbhAvairAkramyate balAt| sarvAH sarvagatatvAcca vedanAH kiM na vetti saH||7||
na pashyati vibhuH kasmAcchailakuDyatiraskRutam| kShetraj~jaH kShetramathavA kiM pUrvamiti saMshayaH||8||
j~jeyaM kShetraM vinA pUrvaM kShetraj~jo hi na yujyate| kShetraM ca yadi pUrvaM syAt kShetraj~jaH syAdashAshvataH||9||
sAkShibhUtashca kasyAyaM kartA hyanyo na vidyate| syAt kathaM cAvikArasya visheSho vedanAkRutaH||10||
atha cArtasya bhagavaMstisRuNAM kAM cikitsati| atItAM vedanAM vaidyo vartamAnAM bhaviShyatIm||11||
bhaviShyantyA asamprAptiratItAyA anAgamaH| sAmpratikyA api sthAnaM nAstyarteH saMshayo hyataH||12||
kAraNaM vedanAnAM kiM, kimadhiShThAnamucyate| kva caitA vedanAH sarvA nivRuttiM yAntyasheShataH||13||
sarvavit sarvasannyAsI sarvasaMyoganiHsRutaH| ekaH prashAnto bhUtAtmA kairli~ggairupalabhyate||14||

anAdiH puruSho nityo viparItastu hetujaH| sadakAraNavannityaM dRuShTaM hetujamanyathA||59||

Commentary: ‘sa nityaH kimanityaH’ ityasyottaram- anAdirityAdi| anAdishca puruSho~avyaktarUpa AtmashabdAbhidheyaH| viparIta iti AdimAn rAshirUpaH puruSha ityarthaH| atraivAnAdernityatve shAstrAntarasammatimapyAha- sadityAdi| saditi trividhasamaye pramANagamyabhAvarUpam | etena, prAgabhAvasyAkAraNavato~apyabhAvarUpatayA~anityatvaM na vyabhicArakam| hetujamanyatheti atrApi bhAvarUpamiti yojanIyam| tena, hetujanyasyApi pradhvaMsasyAvinAshitvaM parihRutaM bhavati||59||
tadeva bhAvAdagrAhyaM nityatva na kutashcana| bhAvAjj~jeyaM tadavyaktamacintyaM vyaktamanyathA||60||
avyaktamAtmA kShetraj~jaH shAshvato vibhuravyayaH| tasmAdyadanyattadvyaktaM, vakShyate cAparaM dvayam||61||
vyaktamaindriyakaM caiva gRuhyate tadyadindriyaiH| ato~anyat punaravyaktaM li~ggagrAhyamatIndriyam||62||
khAdIni buddhiravyaktamaha~gkArastathA~aShTamaH| bhUtaprakRutiruddiShTA vikArAshcaiva ShoDasha||63||
buddhIndriyANi pa~jcaiva pa~jca karmendriyANi ca| samanaskAshca pa~jcArthA vikArA iti sa~jj~jitAH||64||

iti kShetraM samuddiShTaM sarvamavyaktavarjitam| avyaktamasya kShetrasya kShetraj~jamRuShayo viduH||65||

Commentary: enameva prakRutivikArasamUhaM kShetrakShetraj~jabhedena vibhajate- itItyAdi| avyaktavarjitamiti prakRutyudAsInavarjitaM, prakRuteshcodAsInapuruShacaitanyena caitanyamastyeva||65||

jAyate buddhiravyaktAdbuddhyA~ahamiti manyate| paraM khAdInyaha~gkArAdutpadyante yathAkramam||66||

Commentary: samprati mahApralayAntaraM yathA~a~adisarge buddhyAdyutpAdo bhavati tadAha- jAyata ityAdi| buddhyA~ahamiti manyata iti buddherjAtenAha~gkAreNAhamiti manyata ityarthaH| khAdInIti khAdIni sUkShmANi tanmAtrarUpANi, tathaikAdashendriyANi| vacanaM hi “prakRutermahAMstato~aha~gkArastasmAdgaNashca ShoDashakaH” (sAM.kA.22) iti| yathAkramamiti yasmAdaha~gkArAdutpadyate tena krameNa; tatra vaikRutAt sAttvikAdaha~gkArAttaijasasahAyAdekAdashendriyANi bhavanti, bhUtAdestvaha~gkArAttAmasAttaijasasahAyAt pa~jcatanmAtrANi| yaduktaM- “sAtvika ekAdashakaH pravartate vaikRutAdaha~gkArAt| bhUtAdestanmAtraH sa tAmasastaijasAdubhayam” (sAM.kA.25) iti| tata iti Aha~gkArikakAryAnantaraM tanmAtrebhya utpannasthUlabhUtasambandhAt| sampUrNasarvA~ggo jAta iti Adisargo(rge) jAtaH||66||
puruShaH pralaye ceShTaiH punarbhAvairviyujyate||67||
avyaktAdvyaktatAM yAti vyaktAdavyaktatAM punaH| rajastamobhyAmAviShTashcakravat parivartate||68||
yeShAM dvandve parA saktiraha~gkAraparAshca ye| udayapralayau teShAM na teShAM ye tvato~anyathA||69||
prANApAnau nimeShAdyA jIvanaM manaso gatiH| indriyAntarasa~jcAraH preraNaM dhAraNaM ca yat||70||
deshAntaragatiH svapne pa~jcatvagrahaNaM tathA| dRuShTasya dakShiNenAkShNA savyenAvagamastathA||71||
icchA dveShaH sukhaM duHkhaM prayatnashcetanA dhRutiH| buddhiH smRutiraha~gkAro li~ggAni paramAtmanaH||72||
yasmAt samupalabhyante li~ggAnyetAni jIvataH| na mRutasyAtmali~ggAni tasmAdAhurmaharShayaH||73||
sharIraM hi gate tasmi~j shUnyAgAramacetanam| pa~jcabhUtAvasheShatvAt pa~jcatvaM gatamucyate||74||
acetanaM kriyAvacca manashcetayitA paraH| yuktasya manasA tasya nirdishyante vibhoH kriyAH||75||
cetanAvAn yatashcAtmA tataH kartA nirucyate| acetanatvAcca manaH kriyAvadapi nocyate||76||

yathAsvenAtmanA~a~atmAnaM sarvaH sarvAsu yoniShu| prANaistantrayate prANI nahyanyo~astyasya tantrakaH||77||

Commentary: samprati svatantratve~apyaniShTayonigamanamAkShiptaM samAdadhAti- yathAsvenetyAdi| sarvAsu naragohastikITAdiyoniShu| prANaistantrayate prANairyojayati, AtmanaivAyaM dharmAdharmasahAyenAtmAnaM sarvayoniShu nayati, na paraprerito yAti; yato nAnyaH puruSho~asya prerako~asti IshvarAbhAvAt; kiMvA satyapi Ishvare tasyApi karmaparAdhInatvAt| idameva cAsyAniShTayonigamane svAtantryaM yad aniShTayonigamanahetvadharmakaraNe svAtantryam, adharmakaraNArabdhasvakarmaNaivAyamanicchannapi nIyata ityaniShTayonigamanaM bhavati; svAtantryaM ca yathoktaM bhavati||77||

khAdayashcetanAShaShThA dhAtavaH puruShaH smRutaH| cetanAdhAturapyekaH smRutaH puruShasa~jj~jakaH||16||

Commentary: khAdaya ityAdi| khAdayaH “khaM vAyuragnirApaH kShitistathA” iti vakShyamANAH; cetanAShaShThA ityatra cetanAshabdena cetanAdhAraH samanaska AtmA gRuhyate; khAdigrahaNena cendriyANi khAdimayAnyavaruddhAni| ayaM ca vaisheShikadarshanaparigRuhItashcikitsAshAstraviShayaH puruShaH; ayameva “pa~jcamahAbhUtasharIrisamavAyaH puruShaH” (su. sU. 1) ityanena sushrutenApyuktaH| smRuta iti bhAShayA pUrvAcAryANAmapyayaM puruShashabdavAcyo~abhipreto nAsmatkalpita iti darshayati| puri sharIre shete iti vyutpattyA ya AtmA puruShashabdenocyate tamAha- cetanetyAdi| atra puruSha iti kartavye yat ‘puruShasa~jj~jaka’ iti karoti tena na cetanAdhAturUpaH puruShashcikitsAyamabhipretaH, kintu shAstrAntaravyavahArAnurodhAdihApyayaM puruShashabdena sa~jj~jita iti darshayati; cikitsAviShayastu ShaDdhAtuka eva puruShaH, ata eva tatra sa~jj~jitagrahaNaM na kRutam| ayaM ca puruShashabdo gavAdAvapi ShaDdhAtusamudAye yadyapi vartate, tathA~api sarvapradhAne nara eva visheSheNa vartate; tena nAtiprasiddho gavAdau puruShashabdaH||16||

punashca dhAtubhedena caturviMshatikaH smRutaH| mano dashendriyANyarthAH prakRutishcAShTadhAtukI||17||

Commentary: ShaDdhAturUpameva puruShaM punaH sA~gkhyadarshanabhedAccaturviMshatikabhedenAha- punashcetyAdi| caturviMshatikameva vibhajate- mana ityAdi| yadyapi pa~jcaviMshatitattvamayo~ayaM puruShaH sA~gkhyairucyate, yadAha- “mUlaprakRutiravikRutirmahadAdyAH prakRutivikRutayaH sapta| ShoDashakastu vikAro na prakRutirna vikRutiH puruShaH” (sAM.kA.3) iti, tathA~apIha prakRutivyatiriktaM codAsInaM puruShamavyaktatvasAdharmyAdavyaktAyAM prakRutAveva prakShipya avyaktashabdenaiva gRuhNAti; tena ‘caturviMshatikaH puruShaH’ ityaviruddham| udAsInasya hi sUkShmasya bhedapratipAdanamihAnatiprayojanamiti na kRutam| dashendriyANIti pa~jca karmendriyANi, pa~jca buddhIndriyANi ca| aShTadhAtukIti khAdipa~jcakabuddhyavyaktAha~gkArarUpA; vakShyati hi- “khAdIni buddhiravyaktamaha~gkArastathA~aShTamaH” iti||17||

vashI tat kurute karma yat kRutvA phalamashnute| vashI cetaH samAdhatte vashI sarvaM nirasyati||78||

Commentary: ‘vashI yadyasukhaiH kasmAdbhAvairAkramyate’ ityasyottaraM- vashItyAdi| vashI svecchAdhInapravRuttiH (iShTe~aniShTe vA~a~atmA ,); tena, vashI sannayaM tAni karmANi karoti shubhAnyashubhAni vA ApAtaphalarAgAt, yAni kRutvA tatkarmaprabhAvAcchubhenAshubhena vA phalena yogamApnoti| etena kartavye karmaNyasya vashitvaM, kRutakarmaphalaM tvasyAnicchato~api bhavati; tena tatprati nAsya vashitvam| anyadapi vashitvaphalamAha- vashI cetaH samAdhatta iti| aniShTe~arthe vashI sannayaM mano nivartayati; yadi hyayaM vashI na syAt, na mano nivartayituM shaknuyAt| aparamapi vashitvagamakaM karmAha- vashI sarvaM nirasyatIti| vashI sannayaM mokShArthaM pravRuttaH sarvArambhaM shubhAshubhaphalaM tyajatItyarthaH| iha svatantraH parAtmanA IshvarAdinA preritapravRuttirucyate; vashI tu svayamapi pravartamAna icchAvashAt pravartate, na preritapravRuttirUpatvenepsite~anIpsite ca vartate iti svAtantryavashitvayorbhedaH||78||

dehI sarvagato~apyAtmA sve sve saMsparshanendriye| sarvAH sarvAshrayasthAstu nAtmA~ato vetti vedanAH||79||

Commentary: ‘sarvAH sarvagatatvAcca vedanAH kiM na vetti saH’ ityasyottaramAha- dehItyAdi| sarvagata iti sarvagato~api san, saMsparshanendriya iti saMsparshanayukte sharIre, vedanAH sukhaduHkharUpA vetti, sarvAshrayasthAstu na vettIti yojanA| yasmAt sarvagato~apyAtmA svakIya eva sparshanavati sharIre paraM vedanA vetti, tena sarvAshrayasthAH sarvavedanA na vettIti vAkyArthaH| sarvAshrayasthA iti sarvaparasharIragatAH | parasharIre cAtmA khakarmopArjitendriyAbhAvAdvidyamAno~api nopalabhate sukhaduHkhe| sve sve sharIra iti vaktavye yat ‘saMsparshanendriye’ iti karoti, tena svasharIre~api yatra keshanakhAdau sparshanendriyaM nAsti tatra nAtmA ki~jcidupalabhata iti darshayati||79||
vibhutvamata evAsya yasmAt sarvagato mahAn| manasashca samAdhAnAt pashyatyAtmA tiraskRutam||80||
nityAnubandhaM manasA dehakarmAnupAtinA| sarvayonigataM vidyAdekayonAvapi sthitam||81||

AdirnAstyAtmanaH kShetrapAramparyamanAdikam| atastayoranAditvAt kiM pUrvamiti nocyate||82||

Commentary: ‘kShetraj~jaH kShetramathavA’ ityAdiprashnasyottaram- AdirityAdi| kShetrapAramparyamiti kShetrasyAvyaktavarjitasya mahadAditrayoviMshatikasya paramparAsantateranAditvenaiva kShetrakShetraj~jayoridaM prathamamiti vyapadesho naiva bhavatItyarthaH| nanu yadi kShetraparamparA~apyanAdistadA tasyAtmavaducchedo na prApnoti, yadanAdi tannityaM bhavati, yathA- Atmeti dRuShTaM? brUmaH- anAditve~api yat svarUpenaivAnAdi tannocchidyate, yathA- AtmA; yattu ucchittidharmakaM buddhyAdi, taducchidyata eva; santAnastu paramArthataH santAnibhyo~atirikto nAstyeva, yadanAdiH syAt; tena, santAnasyAnAditvaM bhAktameva| ki~jcaivambhUtasya buddhyAdisantAnasyocchede mokShapratipAdaka Agama eva pramANatvena j~jeyaH||82||

j~jaH sAkShItyucyate nAj~jaH sAkShI tvAtmA yataH smRutaH| sarve bhAvA hi sarveShAM bhUtAnAmAtmasAkShikAH||83||

Commentary: ‘sAkShibhUtashca kasyAyam’ ityasyottaraM- j~ja ityAdi| j~jo j~jAnavAn sAkShIti loke kathyate, natvaj~jaH pAShANAdiH| tena, j~jatvenAsatyapyanyasmin kartari sAkShItyucyate iti vAkyArthaH| sarveShAmiti khAdibhUtAnAm| sarve bhAvA iti sarve bhUtadharmA darshanayogyAH| AtmasAkShikA iti AtmopalabhyamAnAH||83||
naikaH kadAcidbhUtAtmA lakShaNairupalabhyate| visheSho~anupalabhyasya tasya naikasya vidyate||84||
saMyogapuruShasyeShTo visheSho vedanAkRutaH| vedanA yatra niyatA visheShastatra tatkRutaH||85||
cikitsati bhiShak sarvAstrikAlA vedanA iti| yayA yuktyA vadantyeke sA yuktirupadhAryatAm||86||
punastacchirasaH shUlaM jvaraH sa punarAgataH| punaH sa kAso balavAMshchardiH sA punarAgatA||87||
ebhiH prasiddhavacanairatItAgamanaM matam| kAlashcAyamatItAnAmartInAM punarAgataH||88||
tamartikAlamuddishya bheShajaM yat prayujyate| atItAnAM prashamanaM vedanAnAM taducyate||89||
ApastAH punarAgurmA yAbhiH shasyaM purA hatam| yathA prakriyate setuH pratikarma tathA~a~ashraye||90||
pUrvarUpaM vikArANAM dRuShTvA prAdurbhaviShyatAm| yA kriyA kriyate sA ca vedanAM hantyanAgatAm||91||
pAramparyAnabandhastu duHkhAnAM vinivartate| sukhahetUpacAreNa sukhaM cApi pravartate||92||
na samA yAnti vaiShamyaM viShamAH samatAM na ca| hetubhiH sadRushA nityaM jAyante dehadhAtavaH||93||
yuktimetAM puraskRutya trikAlAM vedanAM bhiShak| hantItyuktaM cikitsA tu naiShThikI yA vinopadhAm||94||
upadhA hi paro heturduHkhaduHkhAshrayapradaH| tyAgaH sarvopadhAnAM ca sarvaduHkhavyapohakaH||95||
koShakAro yathA hyaMshUnupAdatte vadhapradAn | upAdatte tathA~arthebhyastRuShNAmaj~jaH sadA~a~aturaH||96||
yastvagnikalpAnarthA~j j~jo j~jAtvA tebhyo nivartate| anArambhAdasaMyogAttaM duHkhaM nopatiShThate||97||

dhIdhRutismRutivibhraMshaH samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAm| asAtmyArthAgamashceti j~jAtavyA duHkhahetavaH||98||

Commentary: ‘kAraNaM vedanAnAM kim’ ityasyottaramAha- dhIdhRutItyAdi| ayaM cArthaH prakaraNAgatatvAducyamAno na punaruktatAmAvahati| dhIdhRutismRutayaH praj~jAbhedAH| ete ca shiShyavyutpattyarthaM praj~jAbhedatvenAnyathA vyutpAdya ihocyante| samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAmiti kAlasya samprAptistathA karmaNashca samprAptiH| karmasamprAptiH pacyamAnakarmayogaH| kAlasamprAptigrahaNena ceha ye kAlavyaktAste gRuhyante, nAvashyaM kAlajanyAH; yataH svAbhAvikAnapi kAlajanyAn tathA tRutIyakAdInapyAsAtmyendriyArthAdijanyAn kAlajatvenaivehAbhidhAsyati| karmajAstu praj~jAparAdhajanyA eveha karmajanyatvena visheSheNa shiShyavyutpattyarthaM pRuthagucyante, kAlavya~jcyatvena ca karmajA iha kAlasamprAptijanyeShvavaroddhavyAH| praj~jAparAdhAvarodhashca yathA karmajAnAM, tathA prathamAdhyAya evoktam| ki~jcAcAryeNonmAdanidAne svayamevoktaM yat- “praj~jAparAdhAt sambhUte vyAdhau karmaja AtmanaH” (ni. 7) ityAdi, tathA janapadoddhvaMsanIye ca vimAne punaruktaM- “vAyvAdInAM yadvaiguNyamutpadyate tasya mUlamadharmaH, tanmUlaM vA~asatkarma pUrvakRutaM, tayoryoniH praj~jAparAdha eva” (vi. 3) iti| tasmAdiha samprAptiH kAlakarmaNAmityanena na kAlajanyA gadA ucyante, kiM tu kAlavya~jjyAH||98||

viShamAbhinivesho yo nityAnitye hitAhite| j~jeyaH sa buddhivibhraMshaH samaM buddhirhi pashyati||99||

Commentary: dhIvibhraMshaM vivRuNoti- viShametyAdi| viShamAbhiniveshaH ayathAbhUtatvenAdhyavasAnaM nitye~anityamiti, evaM hite~ahitamahite vA hitamiti yA buddhiH sa buddhibhraMshaH| atha kathamayaM buddhivibhraMshashabdenocyata ityAha- samaM buddhirhi pashyati; ucitA buddhiH samaM yathAbhUtaM yasmAt pashyati, tasmAdasamadarshanaM buddhivibhraMsha ucita evetyarthaH||99||

viShayapravaNaM sattvaM dhRutibhraMshAnna shakyate| niyantumahitAdarthAddhRutirhi niyamAtmikA||100||

Commentary: dhRutibhraMshamAha- viShayetyAdi| viShayapravaNaM viShayeShu prasajjat| niyantumiti vyAvartayitum| dhRutirhi niyamAtmiketi yasmAd dhRutirakAryaprasaktaM mano nivartayati svarUpeNa, tasmAnmanoniyamaM kartumashaktA dhRutiH svakarmabhraShTA bhavatItyarthaH||100||
lakShaNaM manaso j~jAnasyAbhAvo bhAva eva ca| sati hyAtmendriyArthAnAM sannikarShe na vartate||18||
vaivRuttyAnmanaso j~jAnaM sAnnidhyAttacca vartate| aNutvamatha caikatvaM dvau guNau manasaH smRutau||19||

tattvaj~jAne smRutiryasya rajomohAvRutAtmanaH| bhrashyate sa smRutibhraMshaH smartavyaM hi smRutau sthitam||101||

Commentary: smRutibhraMshaM vivecayati- tattvetyAdi| tattvaj~jAne smRutiryasya bhrashyata iti yojanA| smartavyaM hi smRutau sthitamiti smartavyatvena sammatasyArthasya smaraNaM prashastasmRutidharmaH| tatra ca tattvaj~jAnasya shiShTAnAM smartavyatvena sammatasya yadasmaraNaM, tat smRutyaparAdhAdbhavatItyarthaH||101||
dhIdhRutismRutivibhraShTaH karma yat kurute~ashubham| praj~jAparAdhaM taM vidyAt sarvadoShaprakopaNam||102||
udIraNaM gatimatAmudIrNAnAM ca nigrahaH| sevanaM sAhasAnAM ca nArINAM cAtisevanam||103||
karmakAlAtipAtashca mithyArambhashca karmaNAm| vinayAcAralopashca pUjyAnAM cAbhidharShaNam||104||
j~jAtAnAM svayamarthAnAmahitAnAM niShevaNam| paramaunmAdikAnAM ca pratyayAnAM niShevaNam||105||
akAlAdeshasa~jcArau maitrI sa~gkliShTakarmabhiH| indriyopakramoktasya sadvRuttasya ca varjanam||106||
IrShyAmAnabhayakrodhalobhamohamadabhramAH| tajjaM vA karma yat kliShTaM kliShTaM yaddehakarma ca||107||
yaccAnyadIdRushaM karma rajomohasamutthitam| praj~jAparAdhaM taM shiShTA bruvate vyAdhikAraNam ||108||

buddhyA viShamavij~jAnaM viShamaM ca pravartanam| praj~jAparAdhaM jAnIyAnmanaso gocaraM hi tat||109||

Commentary: sa~gkShepeNa praj~jAparAdhalakShaNamAha- buddhyetyAdi| viShamamiti anucitaM, viShamavij~jAnaM svarUpata eva praj~jAparAdhaH| viShamapravartanaM ca praj~jAparAdhakAryatvena praj~jAparAdhashabdenocyate| manaso gocaraM hi taditi tadviShamapravartanaM viShamaj~jAnaM ca manaHkAryapraj~jAviShayatvena manaso gocaramityarthaH| viShamapravartanaM ca manogocarajanyatvenopacArAduktaM, visadRushamanoviShayaj~jAnAdviShamavAgdehapravRuttirapi bhavati||109||
nirdiShTA kAlasamprAptirvyAdhInAM vyAdhisa~ggrahe| cayaprakopaprashamAH pittAdInAM yathA purA||110||
mithyAtihInali~ggAshca varShAntA rogahetavaH| jIrNabhuktaprajIrNAnnakAlAkAlasthitishca yA||111||
pUrvamadhyAparAhNAshca rAtryA yAmAstrayashca ye| eShu kAleShu niyatA ye rogAste ca kAlajAH||112||

anyedyuShko dvyahagrAhI tRutIyakacaturthakau| sve sve kAle pravartante kAle hyeShAM balAgamaH||113||

Commentary: viShamajvarAnapi kAlavisheShapravartamAnamAtratvena kAlaje darshayannAha- anyedyuShka ityAdi| dvyahagrAhI caturthakaviparyayaH| vakShyati hi- “viShamajvara evAnyashcaturthakaviparyayaH| madhye ahanI jvarayatyAdAvante ca mu~jcati” (ci. 3) iti| kathaM svakIya eva kAle pravartatanta ityAha- kAle hyeShAM balAgama iti| ukta eva kAle yasmAd balavanto bhavanti, tasmAttatraiva sa~jjAtabalAH santo vyajyanta ityarthaH||113||

ete cAnye ca ye kecit kAlajA vividhA gadAH| anAgate cikitsyAste balakAlau vijAnatA||114||

Commentary: eteShAM cikitsAkramamAha- ete cetyAdi| anye cetyanenAnyAnapi kAlavisheShaprAptiprAdurbhAvinaH| shothakuShThAdIn sUcayati||114||

kAlasya pariNAmena jarAmRutyunimittajAH| rogAH svAbhAvikA dRuShTAH svabhAvo niShpratikriyaH||115||

Commentary: svAbhAvikAnapi kAlapariNAmavyajyamAnatayA iha kAlaje~avarodhayitumAha- kAlasyetyAdi| jarAmRutyurUpAnnimittAjjAtA jarAmRutyunimittajAH, mRutyushabdeneha yugAnurUpAyuHparyavasAnabhavakAlamRutyurgrAhyaH ; kiMvA jarAmRutyvoryannimittaM tasmAjjAtA jarAmRutyunimittajAH, jarAmRutyunimittaM ca prANinAM sAdhAraNadehanivartakabhUtasvabhAvo~adRuShTaM ca| atha svAbhAvikAnAM kA cikitsetyAha- svabhAva ityAdi| niShpratikriya iti sAdhAraNacikitsayA rasAyanavarjyayA na pratikriyate, rasAyanena tu pratikriyata eva; tena, “asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA” (ci. 1 pA. 1) ityAdirasAyanaprayogeNa samaM na virodhaH; kiMvA, svAbhAvikA jarAdayo rasAyanajanitaprakarShAduttarakAlaM punaravashyaM bhavantIti niShpratikriyatvenoktAH||115||

nirdiShTaM daivashabdena karma yat paurvadehikam| hetustadapi kAlena rogANAmupalabhyate||116||

Commentary: samprati karmasamprAptikRutamapi gadaM kAlavisheShavyajyamAnatayA darshayannAha- nirdiShTamityAdi| kAleneti pacyamAnatAlakShitena kAlena (yuktaM sat) karma kAraNaM bhavatItyarthaH||116||

na hi karma mahat ki~jcit phalaM yasya na bhujyate| kriyAghnAH karmajA rogAH prashamaM yAnti tatkShayAt||117||

Commentary: karmaNaH phalasambandhiniyamamAha- na hItyAdi| mahaditi visheShaNena ki~jcidamahat karma prAyashcittabAdhanIyaphalaM na dadAtyapi phalamiti darshayati| karmajAnAmacikitsyatvamAha- kriyAghnA ityAdi| tatkShayAditi karmakShayAt; karmakShayashca karmaphalopabhogAdeva paraM bhavati||117||
atyugrashabdashravaNAcchravaNAt sarvasho na ca| shabdAnAM cAtihInAnAM bhavanti shravaNAjjaDAH||118||
paruShodbhIShaNAshastApriyavyasanasUcakaiH| shabdaiH shravaNasaMyogo mithyAsaMyoga ucyate||119||
asaMsparsho~atisaMsparsho hInasaMsparsha eva ca| spRushyAnAM sa~ggraheNoktaH sparshanendriyabAdhakaH||120||
yo bhUtaviShavAtAnAmakAlenAgatashca yaH| snehashItoShNasaMsparsho mithyAyoga sa ucyate||121||
rUpANAM bhAsvatAM dRuShTirvinashyatyatidarshanAt| darshanAccAtisUkShmANAM sarvashashcApyadarshanAt||122||
dviShTabhairavabIbhatsadUrAtishliShTadarshanAt | tAmasAnAM ca rUpANAM mithyAsaMyoga ucyate||123||
atyAdAnamanAdAnamokasAtmyAdibhishca yat| rasAnAM viShamAdAnamalpAdAnaM ca dUShaNam||124||
atimRudvatitIkShNAnAM gandhAnAmupasevanam| asevanaM sarvashashca ghrANendriyavinAshanam||125||
pUtibhUtaviShadviShTA gandhA ye cApyanArtavAH| tairgandhairghrANasaMyogo mithyAyogaH sa ucyate||126||

asAtmyamiti tadvidyAdyanna yAti sahAtmatAm||127||

Commentary: asAtmyArthaM darshayati- asAtmyamityAdi| saheti militaM sharIreNa| AtmatAm avikRutarUpatAM na yAti; etena, yadupayuktaM prAkRutarUpopadhAtakaM bhavati, tadasAtmyamiti||127||

mithyAtihInayogebhyo yo vyAdhirupajAyate| shabdAdInAM sa vij~jeyo vyAdhiraindriyako budhaiH||128||

Commentary: itthamasAtmyArthajasya vyAdherindriyadvArabhUtatvenaindriyakatvaM darshayannAha- mithyetyAdi| hInayogenehAyogo grAhyaH| aindriyaka iti indriyadvArabhUtaH||128||

vedanAnAmashAntAnAmityete hetavaH smRutAH| sukhahetuH samastvekaH samayogaH sudurlabhaH||129||

Commentary: duHkharUpavedanAhetuM prapa~jcoktamupasaMharati- vedanAnAmityAdi| ashAntAnAmiti duHkhAnAm| atha sukharUpavedanAhetuH ka ityAha- sukhetyAdi| samayoga iti kAlabuddhIndriyArthAnAM samyagyogaH| sudurlabha iti kAlAdisamyagyogasya ayogAdivirahatvena sudurlabhatvAt| prAyo hi kAlAdInAM madhye anyatareNApyayogAdinA puruShaH sambadhyate; tena ca nityAturA eva puruShA bhavanti, alpaM ca rogamanAdRutya svasthavyapadeshaH puruShANAM kriyata iti bhAvaH||129||
nendriyANi na caivArthAH sukhaduHkhasya hetavaH| hetustu sukhaduHkhasya yogo dRuShTashcaturvidhaH||130||
santIndriyANi santyarthA yogo na ca na cAsti ruk| na sukhaM, kAraNaM tasmAdyoga eva caturvadhaH||131||

nAtmendriyaM mano buddhiM gocaraM karma vA vinA| sukhaduHkhaM, yathA yacca boddhavyaM tattathocyate||132||

Commentary: paramArthatastvAtmendriyamanobuddhyarthAdRuShTAnyeva tathAyuktAni sukhaduHkhakAraNAnIti darshayannAha- nAtmetyAdi| gocara indriyArthaH| karma adRuShTam| tatra AtmAnaM vinA na loShTAdau sukhaduHkhe bhavataH| indriyArthAdInAM ca sukhaduHkhakAraNatvaM spaShTameva| karmApi ca shubhaM sukhakAraNam, ashubhaM ca duHkhakAraNam| yadyAtmAdaya eva kAraNaM, tarhi kimarthaM kAlAdyayogAtiyogAdaya ihocyanta ityAha- yathetyAdi| yad boddhavyaM sukhaduHkhaM yathA boddhavyaM kAryavashAdbhavati, tattathaivocyate nAnyathA| tena sAtmyAsAtmyendriyArthajanyatvena sukhaduHkhe iha pratIyamAne cikitsAyAmupayukte bhavataH, nAtmAdijanyatveneha sukhaduHkhe abhidhIyete; na hyAtmAdayo duHkhahetutayA pratipannA apIha heyatayA pratipAdyante; kintvasAtmyendriyArthayogAdaya eva duHkhahetavastyajyante, sukhahetavaH sAtmyendiyArthayogAdayastUpAdIyanta iti bhAvaH||132||

sparshanendriyasaMsparshaH sparsho mAnasa eva ca| dvividhaH sukhaduHkhAnAM vedanAnAM pravartakaH||133||

Commentary: idAnIM sakalakAraNavyApakaM yogaM vyutpAdayitumaindriyakaM mAnasaM ca sparshaM darshayitumAha- sparshanetyAdi| sparshanendriyasaMsparsha ityanenendriyANAmarthena sambandhaM sparshanendriyakRutaM darshayati; cakShurAdInyapi spRuShTamevArthaM jAnanti; yadi hyaspRuShTameva cakShuH shrotraM ghrANaM vA gRuhNAti, tadA vidUramapi gRuhNIyAt, na ca gRuhNAti, tasmAt spRuShTvaivendriyANyarthaM pratipadyate; mAnasastu sparshashcintyAdinA~arthena samaM sUkShmo~astyeva, yena manaH kishcideva cintayati, na sarvaM; tena yanmanasA spRushyate tadeva mano gRuhNAtIti sthitiH||133||
icchAdveShAtmikA tRuShNA sukhaduHkhAt pravartate| tRuShNA ca sukhaduHkhAnAM kAraNaM punarucyate||134||
upAdatte hi sA bhAvAn vedanAshrayasa~jj~jakAn| spRushyate nAnupAdAne nAspRuShTo vetti vedanAH||135||

vedanAnAmadhiShThAnaM mano dehashca sendriyaH| keshalomanakhAgrAnnamaladravaguNairvinA||136||

Commentary: ‘vedanAnAM kimadhiShThAnam’ ityasyottaramAha- vedanAnAmityAdi| dehaH sendriya iti anena nirindriyo deho keshalemAdiko nirastaH| tadeva spaShTArthaM vivRuNoti- keshetyAdi| kiMvA, indriyANyapi prAdhAnyakhyApanArthaM prathag vedanAshrayatvenendriyagrahaNenocyante| vedanAyA dehendriyagatatvaM tadAdhAratvena pratIyamAnatvAjj~jeyam| dravaM mUtram| guNAH shabdAdayaH| sharIragatA ete hi keshAdayo na vedanAdhArA ityanubhava eva pramANam| yA tu mUtrapurIShagatA vedanA grahaNImUtrakRucchrAdau vaktavyA, sA mUtrapurIShAdhArasharIrapradeshasyaiva bodhyA||136||

yoge mokShe ca sarvAsAM vedanAnAmavartanam| mokShe nivRuttirniHsheShA yogo mokShapravartakaH||137||

Commentary: ‘kva caitA vedanAH sarvA’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM- yoga ityAdi| yogaH ‘anArambhAt’ ityAdigranthavakShyamANaH| mokSha AtyantikasharIrAdyucchedaH| niHsheSheti na punarbhavati| etena, yoge nivRuttA vedanA punarbhavatIti sUcayati| mokShapravartaka iti mokShakAraNam| kiMvA, ‘yogamokShau nivartakau’ iti pAThaH; tadA asmin pakShe yadyapi yogamokShayorvedanAnivartakatvaM ‘yoge mokShe ca’ ityAdinA shlokArdhenoktaM, tathA~api yogamokShayoriha kartRutA vedanAnivRuttiM prati dRushyata iti na paunaruktyam||137||
AtmendriyamanorthAnAM sannikarShAt pravartate| sukhaduHkhamanArambhAdAtmasthe manasi sthire||138||
nivartate tadubhayaM vashitvaM copajAyate| sasharIrasya yogaj~jAstaM yogamRuShayo viduH||139||
cintyaM vicAryamUhyaM ca dhyeyaM sa~gkalpyameva ca| yatki~jcinmanaso j~jeyaM tat sarvaM hyarthasa~jj~jakam||20||
indriyAbhigrahaH karma manasaH svasya nigrahaH| Uho vicArashca, tataH paraM buddhiH pravartate||21||
Aveshashcetaso j~jAnamarthAnAM chandataH kriyA| dRuShTiH shrotraM smRutiH kAntiriShTatashcApyadarshanam||140||
ityaShTavidhamAkhyAtaM yoginAM balamaishvaram| shuddhasattvasamAdhAnAttat sarvamupajAyate||141||

mokSho rajastamo~abhAvAt balavatkarmasa~gkShayAt| viyogaH sarvasaMyogairapunarbhava ucyate||142||

Commentary: atha kathaM mokSho bhavati, kashcetyAha- mokSha ityAdi| balavatkarmasa~gkShayAditi avashyabhoktavyaphalasya karmaNaH kShayAt| sarvasaMyogairiti sarvairAtmasambandhibhiH sharIrabuddhyaha~gkArAdibhiH| na punaH sharIrAdisambandho bhavatItyapunarbhavaH ||142||
satAmupAsanaM samyagasatAM parivarjanam| vratacaryopavAsau ca niyamAshca pRuthagvidhAH||143||
dhAraNaM dharmashAstrANAM vij~jAnaM vijane ratiH| viShayeShvaratirmokShe vyavasAyaH parA dhRutiH||144||
karmaNAmasamArambhaH kRutAnAM ca parikShayaH| naiShkramyamanaha~gkAraH saMyoge bhayadarshanam||145||
manobuddhisamAdhAnamarthatattvaparIkShaNam| tattvasmRuterupasthAnAt sarvametat pravartate||146||

smRutiH satsevanAdyaishca dhRutyantairupajAyate| smRutvA svabhAvaM bhAvAnAM smaran duHkhAt pramucyate||147||

Commentary: atha smRutiH kathaM duHkhapramoShe kAraNamityAha- smRutvetyAdi| svabhAvamiti pratyAtmaniyatarUpam| guruvacanAddhi prathamapratipannamAtmAdInAM rUpaM parasparabhinnaM parasparAnupakArakatvena vyavasthitaM smaran na kvacidapi pravartate, apravartamAnashca na duHkhena pravRuttijanyena yujyata ityarthaH||147||
vakShyante kAraNAnyaShTau smRutiryairupajAyate| nimittarUpagrahaNAt sAdRushyAt saviparyayAt||148||
sattvAnubandhAdabhyAsAjj~jAnayogAt punaH shrutAt| dRuShTashrutAnubhUtAnAM smAraNAt smRutirucyate||149||
etattadekamayanaM muktairmokShasya darshitam| tattvasmRutibalaM, yena gatA na punarAgatAH||150||
ayanaM punarAkhyAtametadyogasya yogibhiH| sa~gkhyAtadharmaiH sA~gkhyaishca muktairmokShasya cAyanam||151||
sarvaM kAraNavadduHkhamasvaM cAnityameva ca| na cAtmakRutakaM taddhi tatra cotpadyate svatA||152||
yAvannotpadyate satyA buddhirnaitadahaM yayA| naitanmameti vij~jAya j~jaH sarvamativartate||153||

tasmiMshcaramasannyAse samUlAH sarvavedanAH| sasa~jj~jAj~jAnavij~jAnA nivRuttiM yAntyasheShataH||154||

Commentary: caramasannyAsa iti pashcAdbhAvisakalakarmasannyAse| prathamaM hi mokShopayogitvena guruvacanAt kriyAsannyAsaH kRuta eva, paraM khAnubhavaviraktena na kRutaH; abhyAsAdudbhUtena j~jAnena sAkShAddRuShTabhAvasvabhAvena yaH sarvasannyAsaH kriyate, tatra samUlAH sarvavedanA j~jAnAdayashca sharIroparamAdevoparamante| samUlA iti sakAraNAH, kAraNaM ca buddhyAdayaH| sa~jj~jA AlocanaM nirvikalpakaM, j~jAnaM savikalpakaM, vij~jAnaM buddhyavasAyaH; kiMvA, sa~jj~jA nAmollekhena j~jAnaM, vij~jAnaM shAstraj~jAnam| tattvaj~jAnamapi hi mokShaM janayitvA nivartata eva, kAraNAbhAvAt||154||

ataH paraM brahmabhUto bhUtAtmA nopalabhyate| niHsRutaH sarvabhAvebhyashcihnaM yasya na vidyate| j~jAnaM brahmavidAM cAtra nAj~jastajj~jAtumarhati||155||

Commentary: ‘sarvavid’ ityAdiprashnasyottaram- ataH paramityAdi| brahmabhUta iti prakRutyAdirahitaH| cihnaM yasya na vidyate ityanena muktAtmanaH prANApAnAdyAtmali~ggAbhAvAdgamakaM cihnaM nAstyeveti darshadyati| na kSharati anyathAtvaM na gacchatItyakSharam| avidyamAnaM lakShaNaM yasyeti alakShaNam| etasyaiva mokShasyetarapuruShAj~jeyatAM darshayati- j~jAnamityAdi| brahmavidAmevAtra manaH pratyeti, nAj~jAnAmaha~gkArAdivAsanAgRuhItAnAmityarthaH||155||

tatra shlokaH- prashnAH puruShamAshritya trayoviMshatiruttamAH| katidhApuruShIye~asminnirNItAstattvadarshinA||156||

Commentary: sa~ggraho vyaktaH||156||
indriyeNendriyArtho hi samanaskena gRuhyate| kalpyate manasA tUrdhvaM guNato doShato~athavA||22||
jAyate viShaye tatra yA buddhirnishcayAtmikA| vyavasyati tayA vaktuM kartuM vA buddhipUrvakam||23||

ekaikAdhikayuktAni khAdInAmindriyANi tu| pa~jca karmAnumeyAni yebhyo buddhiH pravartate||24||

Commentary: mano~abhidhAyendriyANyabhidhatte, tatrApi jyAyastvAd buddhIndriyANi, prAgAha- ekaiketyAdi| khAdInAM madhye ekaikenAdhikena bhUtena yuktAnIndriyANi pa~jca cakShurAdIni; ekaikAdhikapadena pa~jcApi pA~jcabhautikAni, paraM cakShuShi tejo~adhikamityAdyuktaM sUcayati| karmAnumeyAnIti kAryAnumeyAni; kAryaM cakShurbuddhyAdi| yebhyo buddhiH pravartata iti yAni buddhIndriyANi, tAnImAni pa~jceti darshayati| yadyapi ca sA~gkhye Aha~gkArikANIndriyANi, yaduktaM- “sAttvika ekAdashakaH pravartate vaikRutAdaha~gkArAt” (sAM.kA.25) iti, tathA~api matabhedAdbhautikatvamindriyANAM j~jeyaM; kiMvA, aupacArikametadbhautikatvamindriyANAM j~jeyam; upacArabIjaM ca yadguNabhUyiShThaM yadindriyaM gRuhNAti, tattadbhUyiShThamityucyate; cakShustejo gRuhNAti, tena taijasamucyata ityAdi j~jeyam||24||
hastau pAdau gudopasthaM vAgindriyamathApi ca| karmendriyANi pa~jcaiva pAdau gamanakarmaNi||25||
pAyUpasthaM visargArthaM hastau grahaNadhAraNe| jihvA vAgindriyaM vAk ca satyA jyotistamo~anRutA||26||

mahAbhUtAni khaM vAyuragnirApaH kShitistathA| shabdaH sparshashca rUpaM ca raso gandhashca tadguNAH||27||

Commentary: sampratyuddeshakramAnurodhAdarthe~abhidhAtavye~arthAnAM prakRutigrahaNagRuhItapa~jcabhUtaguNatayA parAdhInatvAdaShTadhAtuprakRutigRuhItAni bhUtAnyeva tAvadAha- mahAbhUtAnItyAdi| shabdAdayo yathAsa~gkhyaM khAdInAM naisargikA guNA j~jeyAH| yastu guNotkarSho~abhidhAtavyaH sa hi anupraviShTabhUtasambandhAdeva | tena pRuthivyAM caturbhUtapraveshAt pa~jcaguNatvam, evaM jalAdAvapi caturguNatvAdi j~jeyam||27||

teShAmekaguNaH pUrvo guNavRuddhiH pare pare| pUrvaH pUrvaguNashcaiva kramasho guNiShu smRutaH||28||

Commentary: naisargikaM guNamabhidhAya bhUtAntarapraveshakRutaM guNamAha- teShAmityAdi| ekaguNaH pUrva iti pUrvo dhAtuH kharUpaH shabdaikaguNaH| puMli~ggatA ca khAdInAM dhAturUpatAbuddhisthIkRutatvAt ; uktaM hi- “khAdayashcetanAShaShThA dhAtavaH” iti| yathA yathA ca paratvaM tathA tathA ca guNavRuddhiryathAsa~gkhyam| nanu, etAvatA~apyekaguNatvadviguNatvAdi na niyamena j~jAyate ko guNaH kva bhUte ityAha- pUrva ityAdi|- guNiShu khAdiShu dhAtuShu pUrvo guNaH krameNa yathAsa~gkhyaM vartate; na kevalaM pUrvaH kintu pUrvasyApi yo guNaH, sa ca pUrvaguNa uttare bhUte vartate| tena khe pUrve pUrvaH shabda(bdo)guNo vartate; vAyau tu sparshaH kramaprAptaH pUrvo bhavati, pUrvaguNashca shabda iti dviguNatvam; evamagnyAdau ca j~jeyam| gandhastUttaraguNAntarAbhAvAnna pUrvo bhavati, tathA~api ‘gandhashca tadguNAH’ iti granthe tadguNA itipadApekShayA gandhasya pUrvatvaM kalpanIyaM; kiMvA, pUrva iti chatriNo gacchantItinyAyenoktaM, tenApUrvo~api gandhaH kramAgataH pRuthivyAM j~jeyaH||28||
kharadravacaloShNatvaM bhUjalAnilatejasAm| AkAshasyApratIghAto dRuShTaM li~ggaM yathAkramam||29||
lakShaNaM sarvamevaitat sparshanendriyagocaram| sparshanendriyavij~jeyaH sparsho hi saviparyayaH||30||

arthAH shabdAdayo j~jeyA gocarA viShayA guNAH||31||

Commentary: arthAnAha- arthA ityAdi| arthashabdena tu ye shabdAdayo~abhidhIyante te sthUlakhAdirUpA eva j~jeyAH; yenAkAshapariNAma eva shabdaH, vAtapariNAmaH sparsha ityAdi darshanam| shabdAdigrahaNenAtrAkAshAdigrahaNaM yat, tadAkAshAdipariNAmA eva shabdAdaya iti yuktameva| etena yacchrotragrAhyaM tat sarvamAkAshaM shabdashca, yat sparshena gRuhyate tat sarvaM vAyuH sparshashcetyAdi j~jeyam||31||

nidAnasthAne j~jAtahetvAdinA tathA vimAne pratItarasadoShAdimAnena kartavyacikitsAyA adhikaraNaM sharIraM j~jAtavyaM bhavati; yato~apratipanne~asheShavisheShataH sharIre na sharIravij~jAnAdhInA cikitsA sAdhvI bhavati; ataH sharIraM kAraNotpattisthitivRuddhyAdivisheShaiH pratipAdayituM shArIraM sthAnamucyate| atrApi cAtyantaduHkhoparamamokShakAraNacikitsopayuktapuruShabhedAdipratipAdakatayA pradhAnatvena katidhApuruShIyo~adhyAyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

samprati prakRutigaNapraviShTAyA buddherupadarshanArthaM tasyA buddhervRuttibhedAt j~jAnavisheSharUpANyAha- yetyAdi| yadindriyamAshrityeti yadindriyapraNAlikAmAshritya mahacchabdAkhyasya buddhitattvasya vRuttivisheSharUpANi j~jAnAnIndriyapraNAlikayA bhavanti, tadindriyajanyatvenaiva tAni vyapadishyante- cakShurbuddhiH, shrotrabuddhirityAdivyapadeshena | manobhavA ca buddhishcintyAdiviShayA manasA nirdishyate; manobuddhiriti vyapadishyata ityarthaH| indriyamanobhedena ShaTtvaM buddhInAM pratipAdya buddhibahutvaM prAha- bhedAdityAdi| kAryasya indriyArthasya ca bhedAt tatsambandhena bhidyamAnA bahvyo buddhayo bhavanti; kAryaM sukhaduHkhabhedAH; sukhaduHkhaprapa~jcena hi taktAryeNa kAraNaM j~jAnamapi bahu bhavati| idAnIM sarvabAhyaj~jAnasAdhanamAha- AtmetyAdi| AtmA avyaktam| ekaiketi pratyekam| buddheranekAtmAdimelakajanyatve dRuShTAntamAha - a~ggulItyAdi| anena dRuShTAntena shabdadvayamAha; a~ggulya~gguShThatalajashabda ekaH, ayaM cA~gguShThayantritamadhyamA~ggulyAH karatalasaMyogAjjAyamAnatalashabda ucyate; tantrIvINAnakhodbhavashca vINAshabda ekaH; anye tvekamevA~ggulyAdijaM vINAshabdaM varNayanti| etena, yathA shabdo~a~ggulAdyanyatamavaikalye~api na bhavati, tathA buddhirapyAtmAdInAmanyatamavaikalye~api na bhavatIti darshayati||32-34||

punashcaturviMshatike puruShe karmaphalAdi darshayan doShahIne puruShe karmaphalAdyabhAvamarthoddarshayati- atretyAdi| phalamatreti yathoktasamudAyapuruShe| karmeti adRuShTam| phalamiti adRuShTaphalam| svatA mamatA| j~jAnaM ca yadyapi caturviMshatitattvAtiriktasyodAsInasyaiva, tathA~api taccetanayA prakRutirapi cetanAmApadya cetanaiva bhavatIti yuktam ‘atra j~jAnam’ iti| vacanaM hi- “tasmAttatsaMyogAdacetanaM cetanAvadiva li~ggam ” (sAM. kA. 20) iti| pralayodayAviti jIvitamaraNe| pAramparyamiti sharIraparamparAm| cikitsAM ceti naiShThikI AtyantikaduHkhacikitsA mokShasAdhanA j~jAtavyA| yacca ki~jcanetyanenAnuktamapi kRutsnaM j~jeyamavaruNaddhi||37-38||

puruShaH kAraNaM kasmAditi prashnasyottaraM- bhAstama ityAdi| bhAH pratibhA| tamaH mohaH| puruSha iha prakaraNe AtmA~abhipretaH| AshrayaH sharIram| gatishca prayojanAnusandhAnAdbhavati , evamAgatirapi| kAraNaM puruShastasmAditi bhAstamaHsatyAdau kAraNaM puruSha ityarthaH| etadeva bhAAdikAraNatvamAtmana Aha- na cedityAdi| evaM manyate- bhAstamasI dharmAdharmajanye, dharmAdharmau cAsatyAtmani nirAshrayau na bhavitumarhataH; tathA satyaM dharmajanakatayA upAdeyam, anRutaM cAdharmajanakatayA~anupAdeyam, etaccAtmani sthire~asati dharmAdharmajanakatvaM nAsti, tatashca satyAsatyabhedo~apyaki~jcitkaratvAnnAsti; evaM shubhAshubhakarmaNyapi vAcyaM; tathA kartA ca kAraNapratisandhAtA na bhavati, pratisandhAturAtmano~abhAvAdityarthaH; tathA boddhA ca pUrvAparAvasthApratisandhAtaiva bhavati; sharIraM cAtmano bhogAyatanaM nAtmAnaM vinA bhavati; evaM sukhAdAvapyAtmanaH kAraNatvamunneyam; vij~jAnaM shAstrArthaj~jAnaM, shAstrANi pratisandhAtrA~a~atmanaiva kRutAni| na caiShu sambhavejj~jAnamiti AtmAnaM j~jAtAraM vinA na bhAdiShu j~jAnaM sambhavet, j~jAturAtmano~abhAvAdityarthaH| na ca taiH syAt prayojanamiti bhAdInAmAtmArthatvenAsatyAtmani bhAdyutpatteH prayojanaM na syAt, prayojanAbhAvAccotpAdo na syAt; sarveShAmeva hi bhAvAnAmAtmasthau dharmAdharmau puruShabhogArthamutpAdakau, asati bhoktari bhojyenApi na bhavitavyaM kAraNAbhAvAt||39-42||

AtmAnaM vinA sharIrAnutpAde dRuShTAntadvayaM prameyagauravAdAha- kRutaM mRuddaNDetyAdi| sambhUya karaNaiH kRutamityAtmanirapekShairbhUtaiH kRutamityarthaH| yuktyA anumAnarUpayA Agamena ca rahito yuktyAgamabahiShkRutaH; pratyakShaM cAtra noktaM, tasyAtmAnaM prati prAyo~ayogyatvAt||43-44||

nirAtmavAdimatamutthApayati- na te ityAdi| asmi~j sharIre te ka eva pRuthivIjalAdayo bhAvAH, ye ta eveti vyapadishyante; te na bhavanti pUrvAnubhUtA nAnubhavantItyarthaH| yadi te na bhavanti, kathaM tarhi ‘te’ ityabhij~jAnamityAha- tatsadRushAstvanye pUrvasadRushA ityarthaH| pAramparyasamutthitA iti sadRushasantAnavyavasthitAH| sArUpyAditi sadRusharUpatvAt| teShAM samudaya iti kShaNabha~gginAM melaka ityarthaH| nirIsha iti sthAyyAtmarahitaH| sattvasa~jj~jaka iti prANisa~jj~jakaH| keciditi bauddhAH| bauddhA hi nirAtmakaM kShaNikaj~jAnAdisamudAyamAtraM sharIramicchanti; pratisandhAnaM ca kShaNikAnAmapi j~jAnAdInAM kAryakAraNabhAvAdekaphalasantatAvicchanti||46-47||

athAyamAtmasadbhAvaH sthiro~astu, sharIrArambhakANAM bhUtAnAM kA vA gatirityAha- nimeShetyAdi| bhAvAnAmiti sharIrAdibhAvAnAm| atyaya iti vinAshe; sharIrasya svAgnipacyamAnasya nimeShakAlAdapi shIghraM vinAsho bhavatItyarthaH| amIShAM ca bhAvAnAM bhagnAnAM na punarbhAvaH punarAgamanaM nAstItyarthaH| tena, yena sharIreNa yat kRutaM taccharIraM tatphalaM na prApnotItyuktaM bhavati| atha mA bhavatvevaM tataH kimityAha- kRutamityAdi|- kRutaM karma yAgAdi na phalarUpatayA~anyamupaiti, evaM sati devadattakRutena shubhakarmaNA yaj~jadattAdayo~api sukhabhAjaH syuH; tasmAt kShaNabha~ggisharIrAdatiriktaH karmakartA tatphalabhoktA cAstIti bhAvaH| kriyopabhoga iti kriyAyAM tatphalabhoge ca| bhUtAnAmiti prANinAm||50-51||

‘kimaj~jo j~jaH’ ityasyottaram- AtmetyAdi| karaNAnIha manobuddhIndriyANi| na vartate j~jAnamiti yojanA| nanu yadyayamAtmA j~jaH , tat kimityasya sarvadA j~jAnaM na bhavatItyAha- pashyato~apItyAdi| pashyato~apIti cakShuShmato~apItyarthaH| tattvamiti darshanavisheShaNam| tena, mlAne darpaNe jale vA darshanaM bhavadapyayathArthagrAhitayA na tattvarUpaM bhavatItyarthaH| cetasItyupalakShaNaM, tena cakShurAdAvapyupahata iti j~jeyam||54-55||

karaNaprastAvAj j~jAne karmaNi vedanAyAM ca yAvat karaNamAtmanastadAha- karaNAnItyAdi| saMyogajamiti karmaNA vedanayA buddhyA ca yojyam| nAshnute phalameka iti yojyam| eka iti niShkaraNaH| saMyogAdvartata iti karaNasamudAyAdutpadyate | tamRuta iti saMyogaM vinA||56-57||

katidheti katiprakAraH| puruSha ityanena cAvisheSheNa puruShashabdAbhidheyo~arthobhidhIyate; yataH ‘khAdayashcetanAShaShThA’ ityAdinA, tathA caturviMshatikabhedabhinnashca karmapuruSha eva sharIrI vAcyaH, tathA ‘cetanAdhAturapyekaH smRutaH puruShasa~jj~jakaH’ ityanenAtmaiva sharIrarahitaH puruShashabdArthatvena vAcyaH| puruShadhAraNAddhAtuH; tena dhAtubhedeneti puruShadhAraNArthabhedena| dhImanniti visheShaNena ya eva dhImAn sa eva puruShabhedAdikamimaM vakShyamANaM susUkShmaM vaktuM samartha iti darshayati| puruShaH kAraNaM kasmAditi kasmAddhetoH puruShaH saMsAre pradhAnaM sthAyikAraNamityarthaH| prabhavatyasmAditi prabhavaH kAraNam| yoniShviti jAtiShu| sarvA iti parapuruShagatA api| kShetraj~jaH AtmA| kShetram avyaktavarjitaM sarvaM vakShyamANam| j~jeyamityAdi| asati kShetre kShetraj~jAnAbhAvAnna kShetraj~jatvamupapadyate iti bhAvaH| sAkShibhUta iti sAkShisadRushaH| visheSho vedanAkRuta iti putrAdij~jAnarUpavedanAjanito harShAdivisheSha ityarthaH| tisRuNAmiti atItAnAgatavartamAnAnAM duHkharUpANAM madhye kAM cikitsati| atItAmityAdau kiMshabdo~adhyAhAryaH, tena kimatItAM cikitsati, kiM vartamAnAM, kiMvA bhaviShyatImiti yojyam| sthAnaM nAstIti kShaNikatvena cikitsAyAH pravRuttiyogyakAlAvasthAnaM nAsti| vedanAnAM kAraNamadhiShThAnaM ca yadyapi dIrgha~jjIvitIye~apyuktaM, tathA~apIha prakaraNavashAdvisheShapratItyAkA~gkShayA ca vishiShTAH punaH prashnAH| prashnArthAshcAmI uttaragranthe AcAryeNa prapa~jcanIyA iti neha vyAkaraNIyAH||3-15||

kiM tannityatvamityAha- tadevetyAdi| bhAvAdutpattidharmakAt| tannityatvaM na kuto~api bhAvAdbhavati, nityaM hi na kuto~api bhavati| tatashcAtmA bhAvaM prati nirapekShatvAt sarvebhyo bhAvebhyo~apyagre nityaM sadeva| taccaivambhUtaM nityamavyaktaM j~jeyam| acintyamityavyaktavisheShaNam| avyaktaM ca mUlaprakRutiH| vyaktamanyatheti prakRuteranyatamakAryaM mahadAdikamanityam; AkAshamapi vikArarUpatayA~anityameva; udAsInapuruShastu nitya evAvyaktashabdenaiva lakShita ityuktameva| avyaktadharmAntaravyApakAn paryAyAnAha- avyaktamityAdi| punaH prakArAntareNa vyaktAvyaktArthamAha - vakShyata ityAdi| aparaM dvayamiti prakArAntarakRutaM vyaktAvyaktadvayam| li~ggagrAhyamiti anumAnagrahyam| atIndriyamityanena cendriyagrahaNAyogyaM yat kenApi shabdAdili~ggena gRuhyate na tadavyaktaM, kintu yannityAnumeyaM mano~aha~gkArAdi tadevAvyaktam||60-62||

‘prakRutiH kA vikArAH ke’ ityasyottaraM- khAdInItyAdi| khAdIni sUkShmabhUtakhAdIni tanmAtrashabdAbhidheyAni| buddhiH mahacchabdAbhidheyA| avyaktaM mUlaprakRutiH| aha~gkAraH buddhivikAraH; sa ca trividhaH- bhUtAdiH, taijasaH, vaikArikashca| bhUtAnAM sthAvaraja~ggamAnAM prakRutirbhUtaprakRutiH| atra cAvyaktaM prakRutireva paraM, buddhyAdayastu svakAraNavikRutirUpA api svakAryApekShayA prakRutirUpA iha prakRutitvenoktAH| yaduktaM- “mUlaprakRutiravikRutirmahadAdyAH prakRutivikRutayaH sapta” (sAM.kA.3) iti| vikArA nAha- vikArA ityAdi| evashabdo bhinnakrame~avadhAraNe, tena vikArA eva ShoDasha paraM na prakRutayaH| buddherindriyANi buddhIndriyANi| pa~jcArthA iti sthUlA AkAshAdayaH shabdAdirUpAH; guNaguNinorhi paramArthato bhedo nAstyevAsmin darshane||63-64||

evamAdisarge prakRutermahadAdisargaM darshayitvA mahApralaye prakRutAvavyaktarUpAyAM buddhyAdInAM layamAha- puruSha ityAdi| iShTairbhAvairiti puruShopabhogArthamiShTairbuddhyAdibhiH| anye tu evambhUtasa~ggaM janmani , buddhyAdiviyogaM ca maraNe bruvate| tanna, janmamaraNayorbuddhyAdInAM vidyamAnatvAt| uktaM hi- “atIndriyaistairatisUkShmarUpairAtmA kadAcinna vimuktapUrvaH| naivendriyairnaiva manomatibhyAM na cApyaha~gkAravikAradoShaiH” (shA. a. 2) iti| tathA~anyatrApyuktaM- “pUrvotpannamasaktaM niyataM mahadAdisUkShmaparyantam| saMsarati nirupabhogaM bhAvairadhivAsitaM li~ggam” (sAM. kA. 40) iti| tasmAnmahApralaya eva prakRutau layaH, tathA~a~adisarga eva prakRutermahadAdisRuShTiriti| etadeva prapa~jcaM layaM ca prakRuterAha- avyaktAdityAdi| avyaktAditi prakRuteH, vyaktatAmiti mahadAdimahAbhUtaparyantaprapa~jcarUpatAM yAti| vyaktAditi mahAbhUtaprapa~jcAdyavasthAtaH punaravyaktarUpatAM yAti gacchati; mahApralaye hi mahAbhUtAni tanmAtreShu layaM yAnti, tanmAtrANi tathendriyANi cAha~gkAre layaM yAnti, aha~gkAro buddhau, buddhishca prakRutAviti layakramaH| ayaM ca layakramo mokShe~api bhavati| paraM tu tatra taM puruShaM prati punaH sargaM nArabhate prakRutiH| ayaM saMsAraH kuto bhavatItyAha- raja ityAdi| AviShTo yuktaH| cakravat parivartata iti punaH punarlayasargAbhyAM yujyate| dvandva iti rajastamorUpe mithune| aha~gkAraparA iti aha~gkArAnmamedamityAdimithyAj~jAnaparAH| udayapralayau janmamaraNe, kiMvA layasargau| ato~anyatheti ye rAgadveShavimuktA niraha~gkArAshca teShAM nodayapralayau bhavataH||67-69||

‘kiM li~ggaM puruShasya ca’ ityasyottaraM- prANApAnAvityAdi| prANApAnau ucchvAsaniHshvAsau| nimeShAdyA iti AdyashabdagrahaNena unmeShAdyAH prekShaNavisheShA gRuhyante| manaso gatiriti manasA pATaliputragamanAdirUpA| indriyAntarasa~jcAro~api manasa eva, yathA cakShuH parityajya manaH sparshanamadhitiShThatItyAdi| preraNaM ca tathA dhAraNaM ca manasa eveti j~jeyam| deshAntaragatiH svapne iti chedaH| pa~jcatvagrahaNaM maraNaj~jAnam| savyenAvagama iti savyenAkShNA sa evAyaM dakShiNAkShidRuShTo ghaTa ityavagama ityarthaH| cetanA j~jAnamAtram| buddhistu UhApohaj~jAnam| atha kathametAnyAtmAnaM gamayantItyAha- yasmAdityAdi| jIvata iti pa~jcabhUtAtiriktAtmasaMyuktasya | pa~jcatvaM tu yadyapi jIvato na bhavati kintu mRutasyaiva, tathA~api pa~jcatvaM mRutasharIre dRushyamAnaM viparyayAt pa~jcatvAbhAvAjjIvaccharIrali~ggaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| atraivodAhRutAshca prANApAnAdayo na bhUtamAtre bhavanti, nirAtmakeShviShTakAmRutasharIrAdiShvadarshanAt| na ca mana eva bhUtAtiriktamAtmA bhavitumarhati, yatastasyApi karaNarUpasya preraNAdyAtmanA kartrA kartavyam| nApIndriyANyAtmatvena svIkartuM pAryante, yatastathA sati indriyAntaropalabdhamarthaM nendriyANi yaj~jadattopalabdhamarthaM devadatta iva pratisandhAtuM samarthAni bhaveyuH; asti cendriyAntaropalabdhArthapratisandhAnaM, yathA- surabhicandanaM spRushAmItyatra| tasmAnmana-indriya-bhUtAtirikta AtmA tiShThatIti j~jeyam| atra yadyapi buddhishabdena cetanAdhRutismRutyaha~gkArAH prApyanta eva buddhiprakAratvena, tathA~api pRuthakpRuthagarthagamakatvena punaH pRuthagupAttAH| tathAhi- cetanA guNatvena acetanakhAdibhUtAtiriktadharmeNAtmAnaM gamayati, dhRutistu niyamAtmikA niyantAramAtmAnaM gamayati, buddhistu UhApohayorekaM kAraNaM gamayatyAtmAnaM, smRutistu pUrvAnubhUtArthasmartAraM sthAyinamAtmAnaM gamayatItyAdyanusaraNIyam| AtmAdhiShThAnAbhAve sharIre prANAdyabhAvamAha- sharIramityAdi| shUnyAgAramiva shUnyAgAraM yathA adhiShThAtRushUnyam, evaM mRutasharIramapi| ShaDdhAtukaM sharIraM, tatra ShaShThe Atmani gate pa~jcabhUtAtmakaM sharIraM bhavati, tena pa~jcatvaM gatamucyate|||70-74||

‘niShkriyasya kriyA tasya katham’ ityasyottaram- acetanamityAdi| cetayitA para iti para AtmA cetayitA paraM na tu sAkShAt kriyAvAn| nanu, yadyevaM kathaM tasya kriyetyAha- yuktasyetyAdi| AtmAdhiShThitasyaiva manasaH kriyA upacArAdAtmanaH kriyetyucyata ityarthaH| etadevopapAdayati- cetanAvAnityAdi| cetanena hyAtmanA~adhiShThitaM manaH kriyAsu pravartate, cetanAnadhiShThitaM tu manaH kriyAsu na pravartate; tena yatkRutA sA kriyA sa eva kriyAvAniti vyapadeShTuM yujyate, natvacetanaM manaH; tat parAdhInakriyatvena paramArthataH kriyAvadapi kartRutvena nocyata iti vAkyArthaH; nocyate iti ‘kartRu’ iti sheShaH||75-76||

‘na pashyati vibhuH kasmAt’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM vaktuM pravRutto vibhutvasAdhakArthaguNahetuprAptyA vibhutvameva tAvadAtmanaH sAdhayati- vibhutvamityAdi| vibhutvaM sarvagataparimANayogitvam| ata eveti uktasarvagatatvAt| etadeva spaShTArthaM sAkShAdbrUte- yasmAdityAdi| sarvagatatvaM sarvato~apyupalabhyamAnatvena sarvagatAkAshAdiparimANasyapyasti, tena tadvyavacchedArthaM ‘mahAn’ iti padaM; tena sarvatropalabhyamAnaM mahAparimANayogidravyaM vibhurucyata iti phalati| vibhutvaM vyutpAdya kuDyAditirohitaj~jAnaM naikAntena bhavatIti darshayannAha- manasa ityAdi| samAdhAnaM samAdhiH| anena, yoginaH samAdhibalAttirohitamapi pashyantIti darshayati| ye tu tirohitaM na pashyanti tatrApyupapattimAha- nityetyAdi| sarvayonigatamapyAtmAnaM manasA~anubandhagatamekayonAvavasthitaM vidyAditi yojyam| dehanirvartakena karmaNA anupAta Atmani sambandho yasya, tena manasA dehakarmAnupAtinA| etena, yadyapyAtmA kuDyAdibhiratirohitastathA~api yadasyopalabdhisAdhanaM manastasyaikasminneva sharIre vyavasthitasya vyavadhAnAnna pashyatyayaM tiraskRutamityuktaM bhavati||80-81||

‘syAt kathaM cAvikArasya’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM- naika ityAdi| avikArasya paramAtmano vedanAkRuto visheSho nAstyeva , yatra tu vedanAkRuto visheShaH sa rAshirUpaH paramAtmavyatirikta eveti vAkyArthaH| bhUtAnAmadhiShThAtA AtmA bhUtAtmA, ayaM bhUtAtmA eko bhUtavyatirikto na lakShaNaiH prANApAnAdibhiruktairupalabhyate| kuto nopalabhyata ityAha- visheSha ityAdi| ekasya bhUtarahitasya; yadAtmano visheSho vedanAdirnopalabhyata eva, tenAnupalabdhirevAtra pramANamityarthaH| saMyogapuruShaH caturviMshatikaH| nanvevamapi caturviMshatyantarniviShTasya bhUtAtmano~api vedanAkRutavisheSheNa bhavitavyaM, yataH samudAyadharmaH samudAyinAmeva bhavati, yathA- mASharAshergurutvaM pratyekaM mAShANAmeva gauraveNa bhavatItyAha- vedanetyAdi| vedanA sukhaduHkharUpA| yatra buddhyAdisamUhe niyatA vyavasthitA vedanA, tatraiva tatkRuto dainyaharShAdivisheSho~api niyataH; tatraiva buddhyAdirAshau vartate nAtmanIti bhAvaH| buddhyAdigatena guNatrayapariNAmarUpeNa sukhaduHkhAdinA asukhaduHkha evAtmA tatsambandhAt sukhaduHkhAdimAn bhavati||84-85||

‘athavA~a~artasya’ ityAdiprashnasyottaramAha- cikitsatItyAdi| atItavedanAcikitsA na mukhyA, kintu lokaprasiddhopacAreNocyata iti vAkyArthaH| prasiddhavacanairiti lokaprasiddhavacanaiH| pratikarma cikitsA| Ashraya iti sharIre| pUrvarUpamityAdinA anAgatavedanAcikitsAM samarthayati| pUrvarUpaM yadyapi bhaviShyatAmeva bhavati rogANAM, tathA~api bhaviShyatAmiti padena bhUte~api vyAdhau yAni rUpANi bhavanti tAni nirAkaroti| uktaM hi- “prAksantApAt, api cainaM santApArtamanubadhnanti” (ni. a. 1) ityanena rogAvasthAyAmapi pUrvarUpasadbhAvaH| evamatItAnAgatavedanAcikitsA vyutpAditA| vartamAnacikitsAmapi darshayan pAramArthikaM matamAha- pAramparyetyAdi| pAramparyAnubandhaH santAnanyAyenAnubandhaH| duHkhAnAmiti rogANAm| sukhahetUpacAreNeti ArogyahetucikitsAsevayA| sukhamiti Arogyam| evaM manyate- yadA cikitsA sukhahetuH sevyate tadA duHkhahetusevAbhAvAdduHkhaM notpadyate, utpannaM ca duHkhaM rogarUpaM kShaNabha~ggitvena svayameva nashyati, sukhahetusAnnidhyAt sukhamArogyamutpadyate; tena cikitsayA anAgataM duHkhaM hetupratibandhAnnirudhyate, sukhaM ca janyate iti siddhAntaH | etadevAha- na samA ityAdi| samAshca viShamAshca kShaNabha~ggitvasvabhAvAnna vaiShamyAvasthAM sAmyAvasthAM vA yAntItyarthaH| hetubhiH sadRushA iti samahetoH samAH, tathA viShamahetoshca viShamAH| etaccikitsAprAbhRutIye~adhyAye prapa~jcitameva| cikitsAprastAvena sakaladuHkhahAriNIM cikitsAM mokShaphalAmAha- cikitsA tvityAdi| niShThA atyantaduHkhamokSho mokSharUpaH, tadarthaM bhUtA naiShThikI| vinopadhAmiti tRuShNAM vinA, tRuShNAshUnyA pravRuttirmokShaphalA bhavatItyarthaH||86-94||

paro heturiti mUlakAraNam| duHkharUpeNaiva duHkhAshrayaH sharIram| bhogatRuShNayA hi pravartamAno dharmAdharmAn duHkhasharIrotpAdakAnupAdatte, sarvopadhAtyAgAttu na rAgadveShAbhyAM kvacit pravartate, apravartamAnashca na dharmAdharmAnupAdatte, evamanAgatadharmAdharmoparamaH, upAttadharmAdharmayostu rAgadveShashUnyasyopabhogAdeva kShayaH ; tena sarvathA karmakShayAdduHkhasharIrAbhAva iti bhAvaH| atraiva tRuShNAyA duHkhakAraNatve dRuShTAntamAha- koShakAra ityAdi| koShakAraH svanAmaprasiddhaH kITaH| sadA~a~atura iti sadA saMsAraduHkhagRuhItaH| anArambhAditi rAgadveShapUrvakArambhavirahAt| asaMyogAditi ArambhashUnyatvena dharmAdharmocchedakRutAccharIrAsaMyogAt; sharIrAbhAve ca nirAshrayamakAraNakaM duHkhaM na bhavatIti bhAvaH||95-97||

atra caturviMshatike prathamoddiShTaM mano lakShayitumAha- lakShaNamityAdi| yathA j~jAnasyAbhAvo j~jAnasya bhAvashca manogamako bhavati tadAha- satItyAdi| vaivRuttyAnmanasa iti indriyeNAsaMyogAt, sAnnidhyAditi indriyeNa manasaH sambandhAt| evaM manyate- yadA yugapadindriyArthA indriyaiH saMyujyante tadA kvacidindriyArthe j~jAnaM bhavati kvacinna bhavatIti dRuShTaM, tenemau j~jAnabhAvAbhAvau j~jAnakAraNAntaraM darshayataH; yacca tat kAraNAntaraM tanmanaH| tacca kAraNaM manorUpaM yadyAtmavadyugapat sarvendriyavyApakaM svIkriyate kiMvA anekasa~gkhyamindriyavat svIkriyate, tadA punarapi yugapadindriyArthasambandhe pa~jcabhirj~jAnairbhavitavyaM vibhunA vA manasA, anekairvA manobhiryugapadadhiShThitatvAdindriyANAM; na ca bhavanti yugapajj~jAnAni, tasmAdyugapajj~jAnAnudayAlli~ggAnmano~aNurUpamekaM ca sidhyatItyAha- aNutvamityAdi||18-19||

evaM buddhyAdibhraMshatrayarUpapraj~jAparAdhajanyaM karma praj~jAparAdhatvena darshayannAha- dhItyAdi| sarvadoShashabdena vAtAdayo rajastamasI ca gRuhyante| karmakAlAtipAtaH cikitsAkAlAtivartanam| mithyArambha iti ayogAtiyogamithyAyogarUpaH| vinayAcAralopenaiva prAptamapi yat punaH pUjyAnAmabhidharShaNAdyabhidhIyate, tadvisheSheNa prakopakatvakhyApanArthamudAharaNArthaM ca| sa~gkliShTakarmabhiriti patitaiH| kliShTamiti ninditam||102-108||

vyAdhInAM kAlasamprAptimAha- nirdiShTetyAdi| vyAdhisa~ggraha iti kiyantaHshirasIye “cayaprakopaprashamAH pittAdInAM yathAkramam| bhavantyekaikashaH ShaTsu kAleShvabhragamAdiShu” (sU. 17) ityanena tathA hyudAharaNena ca| tena, kAlasamprAptirvyAdhInAM yathA- cayaprakopaprashamAH pittAdInAM purA nirdiShTA iti yojyam| udAharaNAntaramAha- mithyetyAdi| jIrNetyAdau jIrNAdyavasthAtrayavishiShTasyAnnasya kAlaH, tathA~annasyAkAlo~ajIrNAdyavasthAlakShitaH| prajIrNaM vidagdham| rAtreryAmAstrayashca ya iti trayo bhAgAH pUrvarAtramadhyarAtrApararAtrarUpAH, na tu yAmaH prahara iti j~jeyam| anyatrApi ca bhAgatraye yAmavibhAgaM kRutvA abhidhAnashAstre triyAmA nishA~abhidhIyate| teShu kAleShviti jIrNAnnakAlAdiShu; jIrNe aparAhNe rAtrisheShe ca vAtikA gadAH, bhuktamAtre pUrvAhNe pUrvarAtre ca kaphajA gadAH, prajIrNe madhyAhne madhyarAtre ca pittajA niyatA rogAH| annAkAle cAjIrNalakShaNe bhojanAt trayo~api doShA bhavantIti j~jeyam| kiMvA, ‘jIrNabhuktaprajIrNAnnakAlA’ iti cchedaH, tena jIrNAdyavasthAyuktAnnakAlAH pUrvavadeva j~jeyAH; tathA ‘kAlasthitishca yA’ iti yojanA; kAlasthitishabdena bAlyAdivayastraividhyamucyate| tatra bAlye shlaiShmikAH, yauvane paittikAH, vArdhakye vAtikA gadA vardhanta iti j~jeyam||110-112||

kramAgatamasAtmyendriyArthasaMyogaM vivRuNoti- atyugretyAdi| sarvasho na ceti sarvathograshabdAshravaNAt | spRushyAnAmiti spRushyatvenoktAnAM shAstre~abhya~ggotsAdanAdInAm| bhUtAH saviShikrimipi shAcAdayaH| yo bhUtaviShavAtAdInAM saMsparshaH, tathA~akAlenAgataH snehashItoShNasaMsparshashceti yojanA| tatrAkAle snehasaMsparsho yathA- ajIrNe kaphavRuddhikAle abhya~ggasparshaH, evaM shIte shItasparshaH, uShNe coShNasparsho~akAlenAgato j~jeyaH| sarvashashcApyadarshanAditi bhAsvatAM sUkShmANAM ca sarvathA~adarshanAt| atishliShTamiti netrapratyAsannam| tAmasAnAM ca rUpANAM darshanAdvinashyati dRuShTiriti sambandhaH| mithyAyogaH sa iti dviShTabhairavAdidarshanarUpaH| atisUkShmadarshanaM ca mithyAyoga eva j~jeyaH| okasAtmyAdibhiriti viShamAdAnamiti sambandhaH| okasAtmyAdivaiShamyeNa ca rAshidoShavarjaM prakRutyAdisaptadoShA grahItavyAH| trividha iti ayogAtiyogamithyAyogarUpaH||118-126||

samprati samyagyogasyopAdeyatAmayogAdInAM ca heyatAM darshayituM yogameva caturvidhaM kAraNatvena darshayannAha- nendriyANItyAdi| nanu kathamindriyArthayoH sukhaduHkhakAraNatvenopalabhyamAnayorapyakAraNatvamityAha- santItyAdi| yogo na ceti indriyArthayoH sambandho na ca| na sukhamiti cchedaH| indriyArthayoryogAbhAve akAraNatvena, sati tu yoge kAraNatvena, yoga evAnvayavyatirekAbhyAM kAraNamavadhAryata iti bhAvaH| ayaM ca yoga indriyArthAvadhikRutya spaShTatvenoktaH; tena, praj~jAkAlayorapi boddhavyaH| etacchendriyamarthaM cAnupAdeyaM kRutvA caturvidhayogasya kAraNatvaM yogAnAmeva heyopAdeyatvopadarshanArthaM kRutam||130-131||

sukhaduHkhotpattikramamAha- icchetyAdi| sukhAdicchArUpA tRuShNA, duHkhAcca dveSharUpA tRuShNA pravartate| iyaM cotpannA tRuShNA Ipsite~arthe pravartayantI dviShTe ca nivartayantI pravRuttinivRuttiviShayasya sukhaduHkhahetutAmapekShya sukhaduHkhe janayatIti vAkyArthaH| yathoktaM tRuShNAyAH sukhaduHkhahetutvaM darshayannAha- upAdatte hItyAdi| vedanAshrayasa~jj~jakAniti vedanAkAraNatvenoktAn kAlAdyayogAdirUpAn| atha tRuShNA cet sukhaduHkhakAraNaM, tat kimindriyArthenApareNa kAraNenetyAha- spRushyata ityAdi| anupAdAna iti avidyamAnArtharUpe sparshakAraNe arthaM vinA nArthasya sparsho bhavati| atha na bhavatvarthasparshaH, tataH kimityAha- nAspRuShTo vetti vedanA iti; arthasparshashUnyaH san na sukhaduHkhe anutpannatvAdeva vettItyarthaH||134-135||

yathA yogo vedanAnivartako bhavati, yashca yogastamAha- AtmetyAdi| anArambhAditi viShayopAdAnArthaM manasA~anArambhAt | Atmasthe manasIti viShaye nivRute kevalAtmaj~jAnasthe| sthire iti acale, Atmaj~jAnaprasakta eveti yAvat| tadubhayamiti sukhaduHkhe| yoge yogadharmAntaraprAptimAha- vashitvamityAdi| vashitvaM vakShyamANamaShTavidhamaishvaryabalam| sasharIrasyetipadena sharIreNa sahaiva vashitvaM bhavatIti darshayati||138-139||

manoguNamabhidhAya manoviShayamAha- cintyamityAdi| cintyaM kartavyatayA akartavyatayA vA yanmanasA cintyate| vicAryam upapattyanupapattibhyAM yadvimRushyate| UhyaM ca yat sambhAvanayA Uhyate ‘evametadbhaviShyati ’ iti| dhyeyaM bhAvanAj~jAnaviShayam| sa~gkalpyaM guNavattayA doShavattayA vA~avadhAraNAviShayam| yat ki~jcidityanena sukhAdyanuktaviShayAvarodhaH| manaso j~jeyamiti indriyanirapekShamanogrAhyam| ete ca mano~arthAH shabdAdirUpA eva; tena ShaShThArthakalpanayA na caturviMshatisa~gkhyAtirekaH| sukhAdayastu shabdAdivyatiriktA mano~arthA buddhibhedagrahaNenaiva grAhyAH| manoviShayamabhidhAya manaH karmAha- indriyetyAdi| indriyAbhigrahaH indriyAdhiShThAnaM manasaH karma, tathA svasya nigraho manasaH karma; mano hyaniShTaviShayaprasRutaM manasaiva niyamyate, “manashca guNAntarayuktaM sadviShayAntarAnniyamayati” ityAhureke| yaduktam- “viShayapravaNaM cittaM dhRutibhraMshAnna shakyate| niyantumahitAdarthAddhRutirhi niyamAtmikA” iti| tena, dhRutyA kAraNabhUtayA (mana ) AtmAnaM niyamayatIti na svAtmani kriyAvirodhaH| manaH karmAntaramAha- Uho vicArashceti|- atroha Alocana(nA)j~jAnaM nirvikalpa(ka)m, vicAro heyopAdeyatayA vikalpanam| caturvidhaM hi vikalpakAraNaM sA~gkhyA manyante; tatra bAhyamindriyarUpam, AbhyantaraM tu mano~aha~gkAro buddhishceti tritayam| tatrendriyANyAlocayanti nirvikalpena gRuhNantItyarthaH, manastu sa~gkalpayati heyopAdeyatayA kalpayatItyarthaH, aha~gkAro~abhimanyate ‘mamedamahamatrAdhikRutaH’ iti manyata ityarthaH, buddhiradhyavasyati ‘tyajAmyenaM doShavantamupAdadAmyenaM guNavantam’ ityadhyavasAyaM karotItyarthaH| Uhastu yadyapi bAhyacakShurAdikarma, tathA~api tatrApi mano~adhiShThAnamastIti manaH- karmatayoktaH| vacanaM hi “sAntaHkaraNA buddhiH sarvaM viShayamavagAhate yasmAt| tasmAttrividhaM karaNaM dvAri, dvArANi sheShANi” (sAM. kA. 35) iti | tataH paraM buddhiH pravartata iti UhavicArAnantaraM buddhiradhyavasAyaM karotItyarthaH| aha~gkAravyApArashcAbhimananamihAnukto~api buddhivyApAreNaiva sUcito j~jeyaH| buddhirhityajAmyenamupAdadAmIti vA~adhyavasAyaM kurvatI aha~gkArAbhimata eva viShaye bhavati; tena buddhivyApAreNaivAha~gkAravyApAro~api gRuhyate| buddhau hi sarvakaraNavyApArArpaNaM bhavati| yaduktam- “ete pradIpakalpAH parasparavilakShaNA guNavisheShAH| kRutsnaM puruShasyArthaM prakAshya buddhau prayacchanti ” (sAM.kA.36)||20-21||

Avesha ityAdi| AveshaH parapurapraveshaH| cetaso j~jAnamiti paracittaj~jAnam| arthAnAM chandataH kriyeti arthAnAmicchAtaH karaNam| dRuShTiH atIndriyadarshanam| shrotram atIndriyashravaNam| smRutiH sarvabhAvatattvasmaraNam| kAntiH amAnuShI kAntiH| iShTatashcApyadarshanamiti yadecchati tadA darshanayogya eva na dRushyate, yadA cecchati tadA dRushyate| kiMvA, Aveshashcetasa iti paracetasaH praveshaH, j~jAnamiti sarvamatItAnAgatAdij~jAnaM, sheShaM pUrvavat| aishvaramiti yogaprabhAvAdupapannaishvaryakRutam| shuddhasattvasamAdhAnAditi nIrajastamaskasya manasa Atmani samyagAdhAnAt||140-141||

prastAvAnmokShopAyamAha- satAmityAdi| parA dhRutiriti atishayitaM manoniyamanam| karmaNAmasamArambha iti anAgatadharmAdharmasAdhanAnAmakaraNam| kRutAnAM ca parikShaya iti janmAntaraiH kRutAnAM karmaNAM phalopabhogAt parikShayaH| naiShkamyaM saMsAraniShkramaNecchA| anaha~gkAra iti mamedam, ahaM ‘karomi’ ityAdibuddhivarjanam| saMyoga iti AtmasharIrAdisaMyoge| manobuddhisamAdhAnamiti manobuddhyorAtmani samAdhAnam| sarvametaditi ‘karmaNAmasamArambhaH’ ityAdyuktam | tattvasmRutiH AtmAdInAM yathAbhUtAnusmaraNaM ; sA ca nAtmA sharIrAdyupakAryaH, sharIrAdayashcAmI AtmavyatiriktAH, ityAdismaraNarUpasmRutiH||143-146||

idAnIM smRutiprastAvAt smRutikAraNAnyAha- vakShyanta ityAdi| nimittagrahaNaM kAraNaj~jAnaM, kAraNaM hi dRuShTvA kAryaM smarati| rUpagrahaNam AkAragrahaNam | yathA- vane gavayaM dRuShTvA gAM smarati| sAdRushyAd yathA- pituH sadRushaM puruShaM dRuShTvA pitaraM smarati| saviparyayAditi atyarthavaisAdRushyAdapi smaraNaM bhavati; yathA- atyarthakurUpaM dRuShTvA pratiyoginamatyarthasurUpaM smarati| sattvAnubandhAditi manasaH praNidhAnAt, smartavyasmaraNAya praNihitamanAH smartavyaM smarati| abhyAsAditi abhyastamarthamabhyAsabalAdeva smarati| j~jAnayogAditi tattvaj~jAnayogAt; upajAtatattvaj~jAno hi tadbalAdeva sarvaM smarati| punaH shrutAditi shruto~apyartho vismRutaH punarekadeshaM shrutvA smaryate| smRutikAraNamabhidhAya smRutirUpamAha- dRuShTetyAdi|- dRuShTaM pratyakShopalakShaNaM, shrutaM tvAgamapratItaM , tena sarvapUrvAnubhUtAvarodhaH| kvacit, ‘smaraNaM smRutirucyate’ iti pAThaH, tatrApi nArthabhedaH||148-149||

evaM smRutiM sAmAnyena pratipAdya tattvasmRutermokShasAdhakatvaM darshayannAha- etadityAdi| ekamayanamiti shreShThaH panthAH| muktairiti jIvanmuktairiti j~jeyaM, sarvathAmuktAnAM sharIrAbhAvenopadarshakatvAbhAvAt| tattvasmRutibalamiti tattvasmRutirUpaM balaM; kiMvA, tattvasmRutirbalaM yatra mokShasAdhanamArge tattattvasmRutibalam| yeneti yena yathA| gatA iti mokShaM gatAH na punarAgatA iti muktiM yAtA na punarAgacchanti||150-151||

idAnIM sa~gkShepeNa saMsArahetumaj~jAnaM, tathA mokShahetuM ca samyagaj~jAnaM darshayannAha - sarvamityAdi| sarvaM kAraNavaditi sarvamutpadyamAnaM buddhyaha~gkArasharIrAdi| duHkhamiti duHkhahetureva| asvamiti sarvaM kAraNavadevAtmavyatiriktaM paramArthataH| na cAtmakRutakamiti na cAtmanodAsInena kRutam| tatreti kAraNavati buddhisharIrAdau| svateti mamatA ‘mameyaM buddhiH’ ityAdirUpA| atha kiyantaM kAlamiyaM bhrAntyA yutotpadyate ityAha- yAvadityAdi| satyA buddhiH samyagaj~jAnam| yayA satyayA buddhyA| naitad buddhyAdyahaM, kintu bhinna evAhaM; tathA naitad buddhyAdi mama, kintu prakRuteH prapa~jca iti vij~jAya| j~jaH tattvasAkShAtkAravAn| sarvamativartata iti sarvaM buddhyAdi tyajati||152-153||

etadevohavicArapUrvakatvaM buddhervivRuNoti- indriyeNetyAdi| gRuhyate iti UhamAtreNa nirvikalpena gRuhyate| guNata iti upAdeyatayA| doShata iti heyatayA| buddhyadhyavasAyaM vivRuNoti- jAyata ityAdi| viShaye tatreti manasA kalpite viShaye| nishcayAtmiketi sthirasvarUpA adhyavasAyarUpetyarthaH| vyavasyatIti anuShThAnaM karoti, udyukto bhavatItyarthaH; buddhyadhyavasitamarthaM vaktuM kartuM vA~anutiShThatIti yAvat| buddhipUrvakamityanena yadeva buddhipUrvakamanuShThAnaM tadevaivaMvidhaM bhavati nonmattAdyanuShThAnamiti darshayati||22-23||

atha karmendriyANyAha- hastAvityAdi| hastAvekaM pAdau caikamindriyamekarUpakarmakartRutayA| gudopasthaM caikaikam| vAca upAdAnahAnArthaM bhedamAha- vAk cetyAdi| jyotiriva jyotiH, dharmakartRutvenobhayalokaprakAshakAritvAt ; etadviparyayeNa tamaH anRutA||25-26||

bhUtAnAmasAdhAraNaM lakShaNamAha- kharetyAdi| apratIghAtaH apratihananamasparshatvamiti yAvat; sparshavaddhi gativighAtakaM bhavati nAkAshaH, asparshavattvAt| sarvamevaitaditi kharatvAdi| sparshanendriyagocaramiti sparshanendriyaj~jeyam| kathametat sarvaM sparshanendriyaj~jeyamityAha- sparshanetyAdi| saviparyaya iti sparshAbhAva ityarthaH| yadindriyaM yadgRuhNAti, tattasyAbhAvamapi gRuhNAti; tena, AkAshasyAsparshatvamapi sparshanendriyagrAhyamiti yuktam| dravatvaM calatvaM ca sA~gkhyamate sparshanagrAhyatvAt sthUlabhUtavAtadharmaH sparsha eva; yaddhi sparshanena gRuhyate, tat sarvaM mahAbhUtavAtapariNAma eva| etAni ca khAdIni sUkShmANi tanmAtrarUpANi j~jeyAni, sthUlabhUtAni tu khAdIni vikAratayA tatroktAni| prakRutivarge sUkShmarUpAstanmAtrA uktAH| vacanaM hi- “tanmAtrANyavisheShAstebhyo bhUtAni pa~jca pa~jcabhyaH| ete smRutA visheShAH shAntA ghorAshca mUDhAshca” (sAM.kA.38) iti; tenehApi khAdIni tanmAtrashabdoktAni sUkShmANi boddhavyAni||29-30||
athAto~atulyagotrIyaM shArIraM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

atulyagotrasya rajaHkShayAnte rahovisRuShTaM mithunIkRutasya| kiM syAccatuShpAtprabhavaM ca ShaDbhyo yat strIShu garbhatvamupaiti puMsaH||3||

Commentary: atulyagotrasyeti atulyagotrasya puMsaH| tulyagotrANAM hi maithune~adharmo bhavati, dharmashAstreShu niShiddhatvAt| rajaHkShayAnte iti rajaHpravRuttyante; ‘ante’ itipadena rajaHpravRuttitryahaM niShedhayati| rahovisRuShTamiti vijane visRuShTam| shukravisargashca vijana eva pratibandhakalajjAbhAvAt samyagbhavatIti raha ityanena darshayati| mithunIkRutasyetyanena samya~gmaithunaprayogaM darshayati, viparItasuratAdIMshca niShedhati| catuShpAdatvaShaTprabhavatve uttaragranthe eva vyakte| ayaM ca shiShyaprashnatayA niveshito granthaH a(prA)j~jAshiShyasya AcAryasanmatimAtrArtho j~jeyaH; tena yaH shiShyashcatuShpadAdivisheShaM sUkShmaM bIjasya jAnAti, sa kathaM shukrashabdAbhidheyaM na vettIti na vAcyam||3||

shukraM tadasya pravadanti dhIrA yaddhIyate garbhasamudbhavAya| vAyvagnibhUmyabguNapAdavattat ShaDbhyo rasebhyaH prabhavashca tasya||4||

Commentary: pashnasyottaraM- shukramityAdi| dhIyata Aropyata ityarthaH| vAyvAdipAdavaditi vaktavye yad guNapadamadhikaM karoti, tena prashastaguNavatAmeva vAyvAdInAM vishuddhashukrArambhakatvamiti darshayati| vAyvAdiShu shukrArambhakeShu pAdavyapadeshena sarveShAM tulyashukrArambhakatvaM darshayati| AkAshaM tu yadyapi shukre pA~jcabhautike~asti, tathA~api na puruShasharIrAnnirgatya garbhAshayaM gacchati, kintu bhUtacatuShTayameva kriyAvad yAti, AkAshaM tu vyApakameva tatragatena shukreNa sambaddhaM bhavati, tenAkAshasya gamanAbhAvAdiha garbhAshayagamanAbhidhAnaprastAve shukragatatvenAnabhidhAnam| anyatrApi ca bhUtAnAM gamanaprastAve AkAshaM parityaktameva| yathA- “bhUtaishcaturbhiH sahitaH susUkShmairmanojavo dehamupaiti dehAt” iti| shukraM ca ShaDrasAhArotpannameva vishuddhaM bhavatIti kRutvoktaM- ShaDbhyo rasebhya ityAdi| yattu madhurasya shukrajanakatvamamlAdInAM ca shukravighAtakatvamucyate, tadatyarthopayogAditi j~jeyam||4||
