sampUrNadehaH samaye sukhaM ca garbhaH kathaM kena ca jAyate strI| garbhaM cirAdvindati saprajA~api bhUtvA~athavA nashyati kena garbhaH||5||

Commentary: ‘sampUrNadehaH kathaM jAyate’ ityekaH prashnaH, ‘samaye kathaM jAyate’ iti dvitIyaH, ‘sukhaM kathaM jAyate’ iti tRutIyaH| saprajA~apIti avandhyA~api satI kathaM cireNa garbhaM vindati||5||
shukrAsRugAtmAshayakAlasampad yasyopacArashca hitaistathA~annaiH | garbhashca kAle ca sukhI sukhaM ca sa~jjAyate samparipUrNadehaH||6||
yonipradoShAnmanaso~abhitApAcchukrAsRugAhAravihAradoShAt| akAlayogAdbalasa~gkShayAcca garbhaM cirAdvindati saprajA~api||7||
asRu~ggiruddhaM pavanena nAryA garbhaM vyavasyantyabudhAH kadAcit| garbhasya rUpaM hi karoti tasyAstadasRugasravi vivardhamAnam||8||
tadagnisUryashramashokarogairUShNAnnapAnairathavA pravRuttam| dRuShTvA~asRugekaM na ca garbhasa~jj~jaM kecinnarA bhUtahRutaM vadanti||9||
ojoshanAnAM rajanIcarANAmAhArahetorna sharIramiShTam| garbhaM hareyuryadi te na mAturlabdhAvakAshA na hareyurojaH||10||

kanyAM sutaM vA sahitau pRuthagvA sutau sute vA tanayAn bahUn vA| kasmAt prasUte sucireNa garbhameko~abhivRuddhiM ca yame~abhyupaiti||11||

Commentary: kanyAmityAdi prashnAShTakam| kanyAM kasmAt pRuthak prasUta iti prathamaH, sutaM pRuthag veti dvitIyaH, sahitau kanyAsutau veti tRutIyaH, sutau sahitAviti caturthaH, sute sahite iti pa~jcamaH, tanayAn bahUn veti ShaShTaH, sucirAt kathaM strI prasUta iti saptamaH, yame yugme kathameko~abhivRuddhimabhyupaitItyaShTamaH||11||
raktena kanyAmadhikena putraM shukreNa tena dvividhIkRutena| bIjena kanyAM ca sutaM ca sUte yathAsvabIjAnyatarAdhikena||12||
shukrAdhikaM dvaidhamupaiti bIjaM yasyAH sutau sA sahitau prasUte| raktAdhikaM vA yadi bhedameti dvidhA sute sA sahite prasUte||13||
bhinatti yAvadbahudhA prapannaH shukrArtavaM vAyuratipravRuddhaH| tAvantyapatyAni yathAvibhAgaM karmAtmakAnyasvavashAt prasUte||14||
AhAramApnoti yadA na garbhaH shoShaM samApnoti parisrutiM vA| taM strI prasUte sucireNa garbhaM puShTo yadA varShagaNairapi syAt||15||
karmAtmakatvAdviShamAMshabhedAcchukrAsRujorvRuddhimupaiti kukShau| eko~adhiko nyUnataro dvitIya evaM yame~apyabhyadhiko visheShaH||16||

kasmAddviretAH pavanendriyo vA saMskAravAhI naranAriShaNDau| vakrI tatherShyAbhiratiH kathaM vA sa~jjAyate vAtikaShaNDako vA||17||

Commentary: kasmAdityAdi prashnAShTakam| naraShaNDo nAriShaNDashceti naranAriShaNDau||17||
bIjAt samAMshAdupataptabIjAt strIpuMsali~ggI bhavati dviretAH| shukrAshayaM garbhagatasya hatvA karoti vAyuH pavanendriyatvam||18||
shukrAshayadvAravighaTTanena saMskAravAhaM kurute~anilashca| mandAlpabIjAvabalAvaharShau klIbau ca heturvikRutidvayasya||19||
mAturvyavAyapratighena vakrI syAdbIjadaurbalyatayA pitushca| IrShyAbhibhUtAvapi mandaharShAvIrShyAratereva vadanti hetum||20||
vAyvagnidoShAdvRuShaNau tu yasya nAshaM gatau vAtikaShaNDakaH saH| ityevamaShTau vikRutiprakArAH karmAtmakAnAmupalakShaNIyAH||21||

garbhasya sadyo~anugatasya kukShau strIpunnapuMsAmudarasthitAnAm| kiM lakShaNaM? kAraNamiShyate kiM sarUpatAM yena ca yAtyapatyam||22||

Commentary: garbhasyetyAdipa~jca prashnAH| sadyo~anugatasyeti sadyogRuhItasya| kAraNamityAdi| kAraNaM kiM tat, yena kAraNena sarUpatAM sAdRushyamapatyaM garbho yAtItyarthaH| ayaM ca pa~jcamaH prashnaH||22||
niShThIvikA gauravama~ggasAdastandrApraharShau hRudaye vyathA ca| tRuptishca bIjagrahaNaM ca yonyAM garbhasya sadyo~anugatasya li~ggam||23||
savyA~ggaceShTA puruShArthinI strI strIsvapnapAnAshanashIlaceShTA| savyAttagarbhA na ca vRuttagarbhA savyapradugdhA striyameva sUte||24||
putraM tvato li~ggaviparyayeNa vyAmishrali~ggA prakRutiM tRutIyAm| garbhopapattau tu manaH striyA yaM jantuM vrajettatsadRushaM prasUte||25||
garbhasya catvAri caturvidhAni bhUtAni mAtApitRusambhavAni| AhArajAnyAtmakRutAni caiva sarvasya sarvANi bhavanti dehe||26||
teShAM visheShAdbalavanti yAni bhavanti mAtApitRukarmajAni| tAni vyavasyet sadRushatvahetuM sattvaM yathAnUkamapi vyavasyet||27||

kasmAt prajAM strI vikRutAM prasUte hInAdhikA~ggIM vikalendriyAM vA| dehAt kathaM dehamupaiti cAnyamAtmA sadA kairanubadhyate ca||28||

Commentary: kasmAdityAdinA vikalendriyAM vetyantenaikaH prashnaH; tatra vikRutAmityasya vivaraNaM- hInetyAdi| dehAdityAdirdvitIyaH| sadA kairanubadhyate iti tRutIyaH| ye tu vikRutAmitipadena kurUpAM, hInAdhikA~ggImitipadena ca hInA~ggAdirUpAmeva kurUpAtiriktAM vadanti, teShAM mate prashnabhedaH syAt, tathA~adhyAyAnte ca vakShyamANA prashnasa~gkhyA~atiriktA bhavati||28||
bIjAtmakarmAshayakAladoShairmAtustathA~a~ahAravihAradoShaiH| kurvanti doShA vividhAni duShTAH saMsthAnavarNendriyavaikRutAni||29||
varShAsu kAShTAshmaghanAmbuvegAstaroH saritsrotasi saMsthitasya| yathaiva kuryurvikRutiM tathaiva garbhasya kukShau niyatasya doShAH||30||
bhUtaishcaturbhiH sahitaH susUkShmairmanojavo dehamupaiti dehAt| karmAtmakatvAnna tu tasya dRushyaM divyaM vinA darshanamasti rUpam||31||
sa sarvagaH sarvasharIrabhRucca sa vishvakarmA sa ca vishvarUpaH| sa cetanAdhAturatIndriyashca sa nityayuk sAnushayaH sa eva ||32||
rasAtmamAtApitRusambhavAni bhUtAni vidyAddasha ShaT ca dehe| catvAri tatrAtmani saMshritAni sthitastathA~a~atmA ca caturShu teShu||33||
bhUtAni mAtApitRusambhavAni rajashca shukraM ca vadanti garbhe| ApyAyyate shukramasRuk ca bhUtairyaistAni bhUtAni rasodbhavAni||34||
bhUtAni catvAri tu karmajAni yAnyAtmalInAni vishanti garbham| sa bIjadharmA hyaparAparANi dehAntarANyAtmani yAti yAti||35||
rUpAddhi rUpaprabhavaH prasiddhaH karmAtmakAnAM manaso manastaH| bhavanti ye tvAkRutibuddhibhedArajastamastatra ca karma hetuH||36||
atIndriyaistairatisUkShmarUpairAtmA kadAcinna viyuktarUpaH| na karmaNA naiva manomatibhyAM na cApyaha~gkAravikAradoShaiH||37||
rajastamobhyAM hi mano~anubaddhaM j~jAnaM vinA tatra hi sarvadoShAH| gatipravRuttyostu nimittamuktaM manaH sadoShaM balavacca karma||38||

rogAH kutaH saMshamanaM kimeShAM harShasya shokasya ca kiM nimittam| sharIrasattvaprabhavA vikArAH kathaM na shAntAH punarApateyuH||39||

Commentary: ‘rogAH kutaH’ ityekaH prashnaH| ‘saMshamanaM kim’ iti dvitIyaH| ‘harShasya kiM nimittam’ iti tRutIyaH| ‘shokasya kiM nimittam’ iti caturthaH| ‘sharIrasattvaprabhavA vikArAH kathaM na shAntAH punarApateyuH’ iti pa~jcamaH| evaM sa~ggrahavakShyamANaM ShaTtriMshakaM prashnAnAM pUryate||39||

praj~jAparAdho viShamAstathA~arthA hetustRutIyaH pariNAmakAlaH| sarvAmayAnAM trividhA ca shAntirj~jAnArthakAlAH samayogayuktAH||40||

Commentary: praj~jAparAdhAdayaH prakaraNavashAt punarucyante| pariNAmakAla iti kAlapariNAma ityarthaM||40||

dharmyAH kriyA harShanimittamuktAstato~anyathA shokavashaM nayanti| sharIrasattvaprabhavAstu rogAstayoravRuttyA na bhavanti bhUyaH||41||

Commentary: dharmyA dharmasAdhanAH, tAshca harShakAraNadharmakartRutvena harShakAraNaM bhavanti| tato~anyatheti adharmyAH kriyAH| tayoravRuttyeti sharIramanasoH santAnocchedAt| mokShe hi sharIramanasI nivartete, tataH sarvathA rogasantAnanivRuttirbhavati||41||

rUpasya sattvasya ca santatiryA noktastadAdirnahi so~asti kashcit| tayoravRuttiH kriyate parAbhyAM dhRutismRutibhyAM parayA dhiyA ca||42||

Commentary: nanu yasya nivRuttirbhavati tadAdimadbhavati, tat kiM sharIramanaHsantatirAdimatI, yena tasyA nivRuttirvAstavikaroganivRuttikAraNamucyata ityAha- rUpasyetyAdi| rUpasya sharIrasya, rUpaM hi sharIraM rUpyamANatvena rUpashabdenocyate, yathA- “rUpAddhi rUpaprabhavaH” ityatroktam| nokta ityAgameShu| kuto nokta ityAha- na hi so~astIti; abhAvAdeva nokta ityarthaH| atha yadyanAdimatI sharIramanaHsantatiH, tat kathaM tasyA nivRuttirityAha- tayorityAdi| tayoriti sharIrasattvayoH santanyamAnayoH| parAbhyAmiti shreShThAbhyAm| dhRutyAdayastu yathA mokShakAraNaM tathoktaM katidhApuruShIye| anAdirapi ca sharIrasantatiryathA vinashyati, tathA ca tatraivoktam||42||

satyAshraye vA dvividhe yathokte pUrvaM gadebhyaH pratikarma nityam| jitendriyaM nAnupatanti rogAstatkAlayuktaM yadi nAsti daivam||43||

Commentary: prakArAntareNa shArIramAnasarogANAM cikitsAM shAstre vyavahriyamANAmAha- satItyAdi| Ashrayashabdena sharIramanasI gRuhyete| pUrvaM gadebhya iti anutpanneShveva rUpeShu | pratikarma nityamiti anAgatacikitsA nityam| jitendriyamityanena ca rogahetupraj~jAparAdhAsAtmyendriyArthavarjanaM darshayati, pratikarmanityatayA cAshakyaparihArakAlakRutadoShacikitsAM darshayati| tatkAlayuktamiti tatkAle~avashyaM rogakartRutayA pacyamAnam; etena, balavaddaivamavashyaM rogaM dadAtIti darshayati||43||

daivaM purA yat kRutamucyate tat tat pauruShaM yattviha karma dRuShTam| pravRuttiheturviShamaH sa dRuShTo nivRuttiheturhi samaH sa eva||44||

Commentary: prakaraNAddaivAkhyaM karma tadanuSha~ggat puruShakAramapyAha- daivamityAdi| tena, prakaraNAducyamAnatayA janapadoddhvaMsanIyoktakarmalakShaNena samaM na paunaruktyam| pureti janmAntare| iheti iha janmani| pravRuttiheturiti rogapravRuttihetuH| viShama iti adharmarUpaM daivaM, rogajanakashca puruShakAraH| samastu daivaM dharmarUpaM, rogaparipanthI ca puruShakAraH| sa iti puMli~gganirdeshastu karmaNi (pulli~gga )dharmAdharmarUpatayA tathA puruShakArasya pratyavamarshAjj~jeyaH| anye tu pravRuttiheturityanena saMsArapravRuttiheturiti, tathA nivRuttiheturityanena mokShaheturiti ca varNayanti||44||

haimantikaM doShacayaM vasante pravAhayan graiShmikamabhrakAle| ghanAtyaye vArShikamAshu samyak prApnoti rogAnRutujAnna jAtu ||45||

Commentary: atha kathaM kAlavRuttadoShanimittarogaparihAraH pratikarmaNA kartavya ityAha- haimantikamityAdi| vasanta iti caitre| abhrakAla iti shrAvaNe| ghanAtyaya iti mArgashIrShe| yaduktaM- “mAdhavaprathame mAsi” (sU.a.7) ityAdi| pravAhayannityanena yathAyogyatayA vamanAdineti j~jeyam||45||
naro hitAhAravihArasevI samIkShyakArI viShayeShvasaktaH| dAtA samaH satyaparaH kShamAvAnAptopasevI ca bhavatyarogaH||46||
matirvacaH karma sukhAnubandhaM sattvaM vidheyaM vishadA ca buddhiH| j~jAnaM tapastatparatA ca yoge yasyAsti taM nAnupatanti rogAH||47||
tatra shlokaH| ihAgniveshasya mahArthayuktaM ShaTtriMshakaM prashnagaNaM maharShiH| atulyagotre bhagavAn yathAvannirNItavAn j~jAnavivardhanArtham||48||
pUrvAdhyAye sharIrasyAdisarga AdhyAtmiko naiShThikamokSharUpacikitsopayukta uktaH, samprati garbhAdirUpaM sargamabhidhAtumatulyagotrIyo~abhidhIyate ||1-2||

pa~jcAnAM prashnAnAmuttaraM- shukretyAdi| sampacchabdaH shukrAdibhiH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| shukrAsRugAshayAnAmaduShTatvaM sampad, Atmanastu shukrashoNitasaMyogAdhiShTAtuH shubhajIvakarmayuktatvaM sampat, kAlasya tvanatitIkShNatvAdi sampat| upacAro garbhiNyupacAraH| kAla iti navame dashame vA mAse| yaduktaM- “kAlaH punarnavamaM mAsamupAdAyAdashamAt” (shA. a. 4) iti| sukhIti vyAdhinA kenacinna grastaH| sukhamiti akleshena| akAlayogAditi RutukAlAtikrameNa puruSheNa saMyogAt, RutukAlashca ShoDasharAtraM yAvat| yaduktaM hArIte- “ShoDasha divasA RutukAlaH” iti| sushrute tu dvAdasharAtramRutukAla uktaH| ‘bhUtvA~athavA nashyati kena garbhaH’ ityasyottaram- asRugityAdi| pavaneneti duShTavAtena| kRute asRu~gnirodhe garbhabhramo bhavatItyAha- garbhasya rUpamityAdi| garbhAshaye hi vivardhamAnaM rudhiraM prabhAvAdgarbhali~ggAni kAniciddarshayatItyarthaH| asRugekamiti asRugeva param| na ca garbhasa~jj~jamiti na garbhaM granthAdyAkArakam| bhUtairgarbhAnAharaNe hetumAha- ojoshanAnAmityAdi| ojaH aShTabindukamashnantIti ojoshanAH| yadi tvanAhArabhUtamapi garbhaM hareyustadA mAturnitarAmAhArabhUtamojo labdhAvakAshatvena hareyuH| labdhAvakAshA iti prAptagarbhiNyabhigamanakAraNAH||6-10||

raktenetyAdyuttaram| adhikeneti padaM raktena shukreNa ca yojanIyam| dvividhIkRutena dvikhaNDIkRutena| yathAsvaM bIje~anyataro bhAgo~adhiko yatra tena bIjena; etena yadi dvividhe bhAge ekatra raktamadhikam, aparatra shukram, eSha vibhAgo bhavati, tadA kanyAsutau bhavata ityuktaM bhavati| yAvadbahudhA bhinattIti yAvatIM bahusa~gkhyAM karoti catuHpa~jcAdirUpAm| prapanna AgataH shukrArtavaM vAyuriti sambandhaH| yathAvibhAgamiti yathA shukraraktavibhAgo bhavati tathA kanyAH sutAshca svabIjAdhikyApekShayA bhavantIti| karmAtmakAni karmakAraNakAni| asvavashAt karmaparAdhInatvena| AhAramityAdau garbhiNyA AhAraprAptyA garbhasyAhAraprAptiH| shukrAsRujoryaH sthUlasUkShmarUpo viShamAMshabhedo bhavati, sa jAyamAnagarbhakarmavashAdeva bhavatItyAha- karmAtmakatvAditi||12-16||

bIjAditi shukrashoNitAt| upataptabIjAditi upataptabIjajanakabIjabhAgAt| strIpuMsali~ggIti strIpuruShasAdhAraNanAsikAcakShurAdili~ggayuktaH, yAni tu strIpuMsayorasAdhAraNAnyupasthadhvajastanashmashruprabhRutIni tAni cAsya na sambhavantIti| asAdhAraNAni li~ggAni vRuddhena shukreNa raktena vA janyAni, iha samaraktashukrArabdhena nAstyanyataravRuddhiriti nopasthadhvajAdivisheShali~ggabhavanam| dvidhA strItvapuruShatvopajanakatvena sthitaM reto bIjaM yasya sa dviretAH| kiMvA, strIpuMsali~ggIti strIpuMsayoryalli~ggamupasthadhvajarUpaM, tadyukta eva strIpuruShali~ggI; uttarakAlabhAvIni tvasya stanashmashruprabhRutIni na bhavanti| asmin pakShe bIjopatApenottarakAlabhAvistanAdipratibandhaH kriyate, nopasthadhvajotpAdapratibandhaH karmavashAdeveti bruvate| kiMvA upasthadhvajau balavantau, yena tau garbhakAla eva bhavataH; stanAdi tUttarakAlabhAvitayA durbalaM, durbalena bIjopatApena na balavatorupasthadhvajayorbAdhaH, kintu durbalAnAmeva stanAdInAmiti| yatra samAMshe shukrashoNite bhavataH, tatra saMyogamahimnaiva bIjAMshatApo bhavatIti j~jeyam| pavanendriyaM vivRuNoti- shukrAshayamityAdi| shukrAshayaM shukrasthAnam| pavanendriyatvamiti pavanashukratvam| shukraM hIndriyamucyate, pavanasya cedameveha shukratvaM- yad vyavAyakAle shukrasadRusharUpatayA pravartanaM; asya hi vAyureva paraM vyavAyakAle yAti| shukrAshayadvAretyAdi saMskAravAhavivaraNam| dvAravighaTTaneneti dvAradUShaNena| saMskAreNa bastivAjIkaraNAdinA paraM yasya shukramaduShTadvAraM sat pravartate sa saMskAravAhaH| atra ca saMskAravAhena sushrutoktA AsekyasaugandhikakumbhIkA antarbhAvanIyAH, yata ete~api saMskAravisheSheNaiva shukraM tyajanti; yaduktaM tatra- “pitroratyalpavIryatvAdAsekyaH puruSho bhavat| sa shukraM prAshya labhate dhvajocchrAyamasaMshayam|| yaH pUtiyonyAM jAyeta sa saugandhikasa~jj~jakaH| sa yonishephasorgandhamAghnAya labhate balam|| sve gude~abrahmacaryAdyaH strIShu puMvat pravartate| kumbhIkaH sa tu vij~jeyaH” (su. shA. 2) iti| naranArIShaNDAvAha- mandetyAdi| mandavegamalpaM ca bIjaM yayostau tathA| abalAviti nisargabalarahitau| aharShAviti anutsAhau| klIbAviti duShTabIjau| atra yathoktaguNA strI strIShaNDasya, yathoktaguNaH puruShastu puruSha ShaNDasya heturiti vij~jeyam| etau tvabIjAveva j~jeyau; yaduktaM sushrute- “ashukrastveva ShaNDakaH” (su. shA. 2) iti| mAturvyavAyapratigheneti vyavAyakAle mAturvyavAyAnicchA viShamA~gganyAso vA vyavAyapratighaH, tena yasya shukraM garbhAshayaM niyamAnnopaiti sa vakrItyucyate | bIjadaurbalyatayA ca piturvakrIsyAditi yojanA| atra durbalasya karma daurbalyaM tasya bhAvo daurbalyatA, tena piturbIjasya durbalakriyatayetyarthaH| paravyavAyaM dRuShTvA prAptadhvajocchrAyo vyavAyashakto bhavati, sa IrShyAratiH| yaduktaM sushrute- “dRuShTvA vyavAyamanyeShAM vyavAye yaH pravartate| IrShyakaH sa tu vij~jeyaH” (su. shA. 2) iti| karmAtmakAnAmitipadena ete klaibyabhedAH prAktanakarmabalAdeva prAyo bhavantIti darshayati||18-21||

bIjagrahaNaM shukrasya yonau niShiktasyAniHsaraNam| savyA~ggpradhAnatayA ceShTate yA sA savyA~ggaceShTA| striyA iva svapnAdayo yasyAH sA strIsvapnapAnAshanashIlaceShTA| savyena pArshvena Atto gRuhIto garbho yayA sA savyAttagarbha; kiMvA ‘savyA~ggagarbhA’ iti pAThaH| na ca vRuttagarbheti dIrghagarbhetyarthaH| savye stane prakRuShTaM dugdhaM yasyAH sA savyapradugdhA| vyAmishrali~ggA tu savyadakShiNA~ggaceShTAdinA j~jeyA| prakRutiM tRutIyAmiti napuMsakam| garbhopapattAvityAdinAsArUpyakAraNamAha| garbhopapattau bIjagrahaNakAle mano yaM jantuM vrajed yaM prANinaM manasA dhyAyati| etacca bIjagrahaNakAlInaM manasA~anudhyAnaM prabhAvAdeva cintyamAnasadRushamapatyaM karotIti j~jeyaM; kiMvA tatkAlInacintayaiva bIjaM cintyamAnajantusadRushArambhashaktikaM kriyate, dRuShTashca mAnasAnAmapi bhAvAnAM bhUtavisheShakaraNe shaktivisheShaH; yathA- sa~gkalpaH shukrodIraNaM karoti, tathA dohadAprAptau taccintayA garbhavikRutiH, IrShyAbhayAdInAM caujaHshukrakShayakartRutvamityAdi| etadeva ca sAdRushyakAraNaM pashyatA punarvaktavyaM yathA- “yA yA yathAvidhaM putramAshAsIta” ityupAdAya “sA sA tAMstA~jjanapadAn manasA~anukramet” (shA. a. 8) iti| jantvanudhyAnaM sAdRushyakAraNamabhidhAya sAdRushyakAraNAntaramAha- garbhasyetyAdi| catvArIti nirvisheShamAkAshaM varjayitvA| bhUtAni caturvidhAnIti vivRuNoti- mAtetyAdi| mAtRusambhavAni raktagatAni, pitRusambhavAni shukragatAni, AhArajAni tu shukrashoNitasaMyogottarakAlaM mAturAhAsambhUtarasajAni, AtmajAni tvAtmapratibaddhakarmavashabhUtAni j~jeyAni| tatra shubhakarmaNA sadRusharUpajanakAni, ashubhakarmaNA tu visadRusharUpajanakAnIti j~jeyam| yAni tvAtmani sUkShmANi bhUtAni AtivAhikasharIrarUpANi, tAni sarvasAdhAraNtvenAvisheShasAdRushyakAraNAnIti neha boddhavyAni| tatraivaM caturvidhAnAM sAdRushye kiM bhavati kAraNaM, kimbhUtaM cetyAha- teShAmityAdi| visheShAditipadena sarvANyeva sAdRushyakAraNAni bhavanti, kintu yAni balavanti tAni visheShAdbhUyiShTaM sAdRushyaM janayantIti darshayati| atra cAhArajabhUtAnAM prAktanakarmApekShayaiva sAdRushyakAraNatvaM bhavatIti kRutvA nAhArajAnAM grahaNaM kRutaM, tena karmajeShvevAhArajAnAmavarodho j~jeyaH; pUrvaM tu ‘AhArajAni’ iti padena teShAM vidyamAnatAmAtramuktaM j~jeyam| kiMvA, mAtRujAdIni hi mAtrAdibhiH sadRushaM kurvanti, natvAhArajAtAnyAhArasadRushaM kurvanti, tena teShAmihAnupAdAnam| tathA hyuttarAdhyAye “yAni khalvasya rasajAni” (shA.a.3) ityAdinA prANAnubandhAdIni vaktavyAni, na ca tAni sAdRushyarUpatayeha bhavitumarhanti| dehasAdRushyahetumabhidhAya manaHsAdRushyahetumAha- sattvamityAdi| anUkaM prAktanA~avyavahitA dehajAtiH; tena yathAnUkamiti yo devasharIrAdavyavadhAnenAgatya bhavati sa devasattvo bhavati, yaH pashusharIrAdeti sa pashusattvo bhavatItyAdi| apishabdAt karmasambandhaM jAtisambandhaM ca darshayati; tena karmavashAdapi sattvaM rAjasaM, tAmasaM, sAttvikaM vA bhavati; tathA mAnuShAdijAtyanurUpaM ca bhavati||23-27||
AtmIyaM karma Atmakarma, Ashayo garbhAshayaH, doSho vaiguNyam| ashmaghanAni pAShANakhaNDAH; vegAH kAShThAdInAM trayANAm||29-30||

dvitIyaprashnasyottaraM- bhUtairityAdi| susUkShmairityanena cAtIndriyatvaM darshayati| AkAshamihAkriyatvena dehAntaragamanakarmaNi noktam| manasA javate gacchatIti manojavaH| etena cAtmano vyApakasya yadyapi dehAntaragatirnAsti, tathA~apyasya manogatireva bhUtasahitA gatishabdenocyata iti darshitaM bhavati| dehAditi mriyamANadehAt| dehamiti utpadyamAnadeham| karmAtmakatvAditi karmAdhInatvAt| tena, karma dharmAdharmarUpaM yatrainaM bhogArthaM nayati, tadeva dehamayaM yAtItyuktaM bhavati| atha gacchan kimityayaM nopalabhyate mriyamANapuruShAdityAha- na tvityAdi| tasyAtmana AtivAhikasharIrayuktasya dRushyaM rUpaM nAsti, atisUkShmarUpatvAditi bhAvaH| atha kiM sarva evainaM gacchantaM na pashyantItyAha- divyaM vinA darshanamiti|- divyaM darshanaM yogicakShuH , tena yogina eva pashyantyenamiti darshayati| asyaivAtivAhikasharIrayuktasyAtmano dharmAntarANyAha- sa sarvaga ityAdi| sarvasharIrabhRuditi sarvasharIrANi bhartuM yogyaH| vishvakarmakaraNakShamo vishvakarmA| vishvarUpatAM ca narapashvAdisharIrarUpatayA karmavashAdbhajata iti vishvarUpaH| nityaM buddhyAdibhiryujyata iti nityayuk| sahAnushayena rAgAdinA vartata iti sAnushayaH| AtivAhikasharIrarUpabhUtacatuShTayavyAkaraNArthaM sharIre yAni sambhavanti bhUtAni tAnyevAha- rasetyAdi| etAni bhUtAni sArUpyahetuprastAvoktAnyapi prakaraNavashAttathA vaktavyarajaHshukrAdyanuktarUpapratipAdanArthaM ca punarucyante| Atmani saMshritAnIti AtmakarmaNA~a~atmanyAtivAhikadeharUpatayA nibaddhAni| sthitastathA~a~atmeti AtmA teShu bhUteShu dehAntarAdikriyArthaM sthitaH| yA ca gatirdehAntarAdinA~a~atmanaH, sA tadbhUtavyavasthitasyaivocyate na vyApakasya, tasya (sarvatra ) sarvagatatvAdityarthaH| mAtApitRusambhavAni rajashca shukramiti yathAsa~gkhyaM mAtApitRusambhavAni| AtmalInAnIti nityamAtmasambaddhAni| AtmalInabhUtAnAM dharmAntaramAha- sa bIjadharmetyAdi| sa AtmalInabhUtasantAno bIjadharmA bIjasvarUpaH, bIjaM hi svasadRushama~gkuraM karoti; tena, ayamapyAtmalIno bhUtasantAnaH sadRushaM deharUpaM bhUtAntarasa~ggaM kurvan bIjadharmA bhavati| ‘sA bIjadharmiNi’ iti vA pAThaH, tadA sA ‘bhUtasantatiH’ ityadhyAhAryam| AtmanIti manoyuktAtmani| yAti gacchati sati dehAntarANi yAtIti yojanA| Atmanashca gamanaM manogamanameva| ‘parAparANi’ iti vA pAThaH; tadA parANi shreShThAni devAdisharIrANi, aparANi ashreShThAni krimyAdisharIrANIti yojanIyam| nanvaparidRushyamAnA bhUtacatuShTayI manaHpravRuttiyuktA bIjadharmiNI kimarthaM svIkartavyA, yataH paridRushyamAnamevedaM ShADbhautikaM sharIraM shukrashoNitakAraNakamastvityAha- rUpAddhItyAdi| rUpyata iti rUpaM bhautikaM sharIram| tena, abhautikAccharIrAdbhautikaM sharIraM bhavatItyAgamaprasiddham| tenAgamAdeva sA~gkhyadarshanarUpAdAtivAhikasharIrAd vyaktaM sharIramutpadyata iti vAkyArthaH| yadyapi shukrarajasI kAraNe, tathA~api yadaivAtivAhikaM sUkShmabhUtarUpasharIraM prApnutaH, tadaiva te sharIraM janayataH, nAnyadA, yadi shukrashoNitamAtivAhikasharIranirapekShaM garbhaM janayet, tadA asatyapi jIvAdhiShThAne janayet, na tu janayati, tasmAdAtmasthasUkShmabhUtAdeva bIjarUpAcchukrashoNitayuktAdgarbhajanmeti| etaccAtmasthabhUtaM mAtApitRujabhUtena samaM sharIrakAraNaM karmavashAdeva bhavatItyAha- karmetyAdi| karmAtmakAnAmiti karmakAraNakAnAM; kiMvA yasmAd rUpavattantubhyo rUpavAn paTa utpadyata iti prasiddhaM, tenAtivAhikasharIreNa kartavyasharIrasadRushena bhavitavyaM, kAraNasadRushaM hi kAryaM bhavati; tatashcAtmadharmitvaM sUkShmANAmAtmasthitabhUtAnAM siddhamiti bhAvaH| atha manaH sAttvikarAjasatAmasabhedAdbhinnaM kutastatra tatra puruShe bhavatItyAha- manaso manasta iti| pUrvajanmanyavyavahite yAdRu~gmanaH, iha janmanyapi tAdRugeva mano bhavati| uktaM cAnyatra “janma janma yadabhyastaM dAnamadhyayanaM tapaH| tenaivAbhyAsayogena tadevAbhyasyate punaH” iti| atrApi ca mana-utpattau karmAtmakAnAmiti yojyam | tena karmavashAdeva manobhedo bhavati| nanvevaM sati AtmasthasUkShmabhUtAnAmekarUpatvenaikarUpeNaiva sharIreNa sarvaprANinAM bhavitavyamityAha- bhavantItyAdi| AkRutiH saMsthAnam| rajastamasI anekataratamAdibhedabhinne tathA karma cAnekadhA bhinnaM satyapyabhinne sUkShmabhUtarUpe kAraNe bhedakAraNaM bhavatItyarthaH||31-36||

‘AtmA sadA kairanubadhyate’ ityasyottaram- atIndriyairityAdi| tairiti bIjadharmitvenoktaiH| aha~gkAravikArA eva doShAH, kiMvA rajastamasI doShau| ayaM ca sUkShmabhUtAdyanubandho manasa evetyAha- raja ityAdi| rajastamobhyAM hetubhUtAbhyAM manaH sarvairbhUtAdibhiranubaddhaM bhavati| atraiva hetumAha- j~jAnAdityAdi| j~jAnAditi tattvaj~jAnAt; tattvaj~jAnaM vinA manaH sarvairdoShairyuktaM bhavati, tattvaj~jAnAttu nirdoShaM bhavatItyarthaH| sadoShatve manasaH kiM bhavatItyAha- gatItyAdi| gatiH dehAntaragamanaM, pravRuttiH dharmAdharmakriyAsu pravRuttiH; sadoShatvena manaH saMsAraheturbhavatIti vAkyArthaH| gatipravRuttyorhetvantaramAha- balavacca karmetyAdi| balavaditi niyatavipAkaM; ‘phalavat’ iti vA pAThaH, tathA~api sa evArthaH| niyataM karmaphalaM karmabalAdeva bhavati| atra ca prashnottareShu yadadhikamucyate ‘gatipravRuttyoH’ ityAdinA, tat prakaraNavashAdeva j~jeyam||37-38||

hetvantaraM rogAbhAvakAraNamAha- nara ityAdi| sama iti bhUteShu samacittaH| sukhAnubandhamiti li~ggavipariNAmAnmatyA vacasA ca yojyam| tena kAyavA~gmanaHkarmANyuttarakAlInasukhaphalAni shubhAni gRuhyante| sattvaM vidheyaM svAyattaM manaH| vishadA buddhiriti na kashmalA buddhiH| buddhishceha UhApohavatI vivakShitA| matistu smRuticintAdi| j~jAnaM tattvaj~jAnam| sheShaM sugamam||46-48||
athAtaH khuDDikAM garbhAvakrAntiM shArIraM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

rasajashcAyaM garbhaH| na hi rasAdRute mAtuH prANayAtrA~api syAt, kiM punargarbhajanma| na caivAsamyagupayujyamAnA rasA garbhamabhinirvartayanti, na ca kevalaM samyagupayogAdeva rasAnAM garbhAbhinirvRuttirbhavati, samudAyo~apyatra kAraNamucyate| yAni tu khalvasya garbhasya rasajAni, yAni cAsya rasataH sambhavataH sambhavanti, tAnyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- sharIrasyAbhinirvRuttirabhivRuddhiH prANAnubandhastRuptiH puShTirutsAhashceti (rasajAni)||12||

Commentary: prANayAtrA~api syAditi garbhadhAraNakAraNabhUtAyA mAturapi prANasthitirityarthaH| na caivAsamyagupayujyamAnA ityAdinA asAtmyarasopayogasya garbhopaghAtitvaM darshayati| asAtmyarasopayoginAM prajAbhavanaM yat, tadasAtmyaseviprajAbhavananyAyatulyamiti neha punardarshitam| samudAyo~apyatra kAraNamityanena tu asamyagrasasevinAM cApatyabhavane kAraNaM dharmAdi darshayati| abhinirvRuttiH a~ggapratya~ggavyaktatA| prANAnubandha iti balAnubandhaH puShTiH upacayaH| vRuddhistu dairghyeNa vRuddhiH| utsAhaH balam| iti shabdaH prakAre; tenaivamprakArANyanyAnyapi varNAdIni rasajAnIti darshayati| evaM pUrvatrApi itishabdo vyAkhyeyaH| yadA tvitishabdaH parisamAptyarthastadA~apyAviShkRutAnAM rasajAnAM parisamAptirj~jeyA; tena anAviShkRutA varNAdayo~api rajasA labhyante||12||

asti khalu sattvamaupapAdukaM; yajjIvaM spRuksharIreNAbhisambadhnAti, yasminnapagamanapuraskRute shIlamasya vyAvartate, bhaktirviparyasyate, sarvendriyANyupatapyante, balaM hIyate, vyAdhaya ApyAyyante, yasmAddhInaH prANA~jjahAti, yadindriyANAmabhigrAhakaM ca ‘mana’ ityabhidhIyate; tattrividhamAkhyAyate- shuddhaM, rAjasaM, tAmasamiti| yenAsya khalu mano bhUyiShThaM, tena dvitIyAyAmAjAtau samprayogo bhavati; yadA tu tenaiva shuddhena saMyujyate, tadA jAteratikrAntAyA api smarati| smArtaM hi j~jAnamAtmanastasyaiva manaso~anubandhAdanuvartate, yasyAnuvRuttiM puraskRutya puruSho ‘jAtismara’ ityucyate| yAni khalvasya garbhasya sattvajAni, yAnyasya sattvataH sambhavataH sambhavanti, tAnyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- bhaktiH shIlaM shaucaM dveShaH smRutirmohastyAgo mAtsaryaM shauryaM bhayaM krodhastandrotsAhastaikShNyaM mArdavaM gAmbhIryamanavasthitatvamityevamAdayashcAnye, te sattvavikArA yAnuttarakAlaM sattvabhedamadhikRutyopadekShyAmaH| nAnAvidhAni khalu sattvAni, tAni sarvANyekapuruShe bhavanti, na ca bhavantyekakAlam, ekaM tu prAyovRuttyA~a~aha ||13||

Commentary: astItyAdinA manasa aupapAdukatvamAkShiptaM samAdadhAti| apishabdo~avadhAraNe| atra ca ‘yajjIvaM spRuksharIreNAbhisambadhnAti’ ityAdinA manaso~asAdhAraNadharmakathanamevaupapAdukasAdhanaM bhavati, manovyatirekeNaitaducyamAnadharmANAmasiddheH| nityamAtmAnaM spRushatIti spRuk, sharIramAtivAhikasharIraM; tena spRuksharIreNa kAraNabhUtena jIvamAtmarUpamabhisambadhnAti bhogAyatanasharIreNetyarthaH| AtivAhikasharIrasadbhAvashca “bhUtaishcaturbhiH sahitaH susUkShmairmanojavo dehamupaiti dehAt” (shA. 2) ityanena pratipAditaH|kiMvA, jIvam AtmAnaM, spRuksharIreNeti sparshavatA sharIreNa, yanmano~abhisambadhnAti tadupapAdukamastIti yojanA| evaM manyate- yadi mano~atrAtmanaH sharIrasambandhena svIkriyate tadA vyApakatvAdAtmanaH sarvatraivopalabdhyA bhavitavyaM, na ca bhavati; tasmAdyatraiva sparshavati sharIre manaH pratibaddhaM bhavati tatraivAyaM sukhAdyupalabhate| spRugitivisheShaNena sharIrasya mUtranakhakeshAdau manogamanAbhAvAdAtmano~anupalabdhiM darshayati| apagamanapuraskRute iti dehAntaragamanAbhimukhe| bhaktiH icchA| yasmAddhIna iti manasA tyaktaH| yeneti yathAbhUtena sAttvikena rAjasena tAmasena vA manasA bhUyiShThamityabhiprAyaH| dvitIyAyAmAjAtAviti dvitIyajanmani; pUrvajanmani yAdRushaM manastAdRushameva janmAntare prAyo bhavatItyarthaH| kecittu, ‘tena na dvitIyAyAM’ ityAdi paThanti| tatrApi prAyo dvitIye janmani tulyena manasA yogo na bhavati, kadAcittu bhavatItyarthaH| yaduktaM ‘nAsya ki~jcit paurvadehikamaviditaM syAt’ iti, tat paurvadehikaM j~jAnaM kvacidbhavatIti darshayannAha- yadA tvityAdi| shuddheneti vishuddhasattvaguNena| tasyaiveti vakShyamANena yasyetyanena sambadhyate| yoniyantrapIDAyAM hi udbhUtena tamasA viplutaM mano nAtikrAntajanmagataM smarati; yastUdbhUtasattvastamasA nAbhibhUyate, sa smaratyevAtikrAntajanmAnubhUtamiti bhAvaH| puraskRutyeti kAraNatvenAvadhArya| ayaM ca manodharmasamUha indriyopakramaNIyokto~api punariha prakaraNavashAducyamAno na punaruktadoShamAvahati| yadyapi sattvasya garbhajanakatvaM sAkShAnnoktaM, tathA~api sattvasya yadupapAdukatvaM garbhaM prati tenaiva sattvasya garbhajanakatvaM pratij~jAtaM mantavyam| tena ‘yAni khalvasya garbhasya sattvajAni’ ityAdinA garbhe sattvajabhAvakathanamupapannameva| garbhakAraNasyApi ca sattvasyopapAdukabhAShayA kAraNatvaM yaduktaM taddehAddehAntaragamanarUpamanodharmasya garbhakAraNatvAtiriktasya pratipAdanArtham| nAnAvidhAnIti nAnAvidhasAttvikarAjasatAmaMsavRuttibhinnAni| tAnyekapuruShe bhavantItyanenaika eva puruShaH kadAciddharmakriyAyAM sAttviko bhavati, kadAcit kAmacintAyAM rAjasaH, kadAcinmohe tamomaya iti darshayati| na bhavantyekakAlamiti ekadaiva sAttvikAdayo dharmA na bhavanti, kintu paryAyeNa bhavanti| nanu yadyekapuruSha eva sarve sAttvikAdayo bhavanti, tat katham ‘ayaM sAttvikaH’ ityAdivyapadesho bhavatItyAha- ekaM tvityAdi| prAyovRuttyeti bhUyiShThA yasya sAttvikavRuttayo bhavanti sa sAttvikaH, yasya bhUyiShThaM rAjasyo vRuttayo bhavanti sa rAjasa ucyate ityAdi| etadeva pUrvamuktaM- “yadguNaM cAbhIkShNaM puruShamanuvartate sattvaM, tatsattvamevopadishanti bAhulyAnushayAt” (sU. 8) iti||13||

evamayaM nAnAvidhAnAmeShAM garbhakarANAM bhAvAnAM samudAyAdabhinirvartate garbhaH; yathA- kUTAgAraM nAnAdravyasamudAyAt, yathA vA- ratho nAnArathA~ggasamudAyAt; tasmAdetadavocAma- mAtRujashcAyaM garbhaH, pitRujashca, Atmajashca, sAtmyajashca, rasajashca, asti ca sattvamaupapAdukamiti (hovAca bhagavAnAtreyaH)||14||

Commentary: evaM mAtrAdikAraNavyutpAdanena garbhasya samudAyaprabhavatAM vyutpAditAM dRuShTAntena draDhayannAha- evamayamityAdi| kUTAgAraM vartulAkAraM gRuhaM jentAkasvedapratipAditam; anye tu vastrAdikRutaM sa~jcArigRuhaM kUTAgAramAhuH| atra ca prakaraNe yadyapi mAtrAdInAM sarveShAM samuditAnAmeva garbhaM prati kAraNatvaM, tathA~api mAtApitrAtmasattvAni vihAya sAtmyarasayoreva kAraNatvavyutpAdane yat ‘samudAyo~apyatra kAraNam’ ityuktaM tatraivaM manyate- atra yathA mAtrAdayashcatvAro~avashyaM garbhaM prati kAraNabhUtA na tathA sAtmyaM raso vA; yena shukrashoNitasattvAtmasaMsargAdeva garbho bhavati, nAvashyaM garbhamelake sAtmyarasayorapekShA; garbhamelakottarakAlaM sAtmyarasAbhyAM garbhasya hi puShTyAdayo janyante, tena sAtmye rase cAvashyaM samudAyApekShAM darshayatA tatraiva ‘samudAyo~apyatra kAraNam’ ityuktaM, mAtrAdayastu parasparasamudAyamapekShamANA api nAvashyaM sAtmyarasasamudAyamAdigarbhamelake~apekShanta iti kRutvA punastatra samudAyApekShitvaM noktam| samudAyAdeShAM bhAvAnAmityanena granthena yat parasparasamudAyApekShitvaM mAtrAdInAM caturNAM, taduktameva| yadapi garbhaM pratyavisheSheNa sAtmyarasayorapi kAraNatvaM, ‘sAtmyajashcAyaM, rasajashcAyaM’ ityanenoktaM, tadgarbhamelakottarakAlaM kAraNatvena, tathA mAtApitrorapi vishuddhashukrashoNitotpAdahetutayA pAramparyeNa kAraNatvAditi j~jeyam||14||

bharadvAja uvAca- yadyayameShAM nAnAvidhAnAM garbhakarANAM bhAvAnAM samudAyAdabhinirvartate garbhaH kathamayaM sandhIyate, yadi cApi sandhIyate kasmAt samudAyaprabhavaH san garbho manuShyavigraheNa jAyate, manuShyashca manuShyaprabhava ucyate; tatra cediShTametadyasmAnmanuShyo manuShyaprabhavastasmAdeva manuShyavigraheNa jAyate, yathA- gaurgoprabhavaH, yathA- cAshvo~ashvaprabhava iti; evaM sati yaduktamagre samudayAtmaka iti tadayuktam| yadi ca manuShyo manuShyaprabhavaH, kasmAjjaDAndhakubjamUkavAmanamimminavya~ggonmattakuShThikilAsibhyo jAtAH pitRusadRusharUpA na bhavanti| athAtrApi buddhirevaM syAt- svenaivAyamAtmA cakShuShA rUpANi vetti, shrotreNa shabdAn, ghrANena gandhAn, rasanena rasAn, sparshanena sparshAn, buddhyA boddhavyamityanena hetunA na jaDAdibhyo jAtAH pitRusadRushA bhavanti| atrApi pratij~jAhAnidoShaH syAt, evamukte hyAtmA satsvindriyeShu j~jaH syAdasatsvaj~jaH; yatra caitadubhayaM sambhavati j~jatvamaj~jatvaM ca, savikArashcAtmA | yadi ca darshanAdibhirAtmA viShayAn vetti, nirindriyo darshanAdivirahAdaj~jaH syAt, aj~jatvAdakAraNam, akAraNatvAcca nAtmeti vAgvastumAtrametadvacanamanarthaM syAditi (hovAca bharadvAjaH)||15||

Commentary: punarbharadvAjaH pRucchati- yadyayamityAdi| kathaM sandhIyata iti kayA paripAThyA milatItyarthaH| manuShyavigraheNa jAyata iti manuShyajAtau kasmAnmanuShyavigraheNaiva jAyata ityarthaH| samudAyAtmaka iti yaduktaM tadayuktamiti atra mAtrAdyatiriktajAteH kAraNatvakathanena tathA jAtereva manuShyAdirUpAyA balavatkAraNatvena yathoktamAtrAdisamudAyaprabhavatvaM na yuktamiti bhAvaH| dUShaNAntaramAha- yadi cetyAdi| jaDo jaDabuddhiH, minminaH sAnunAsikAvyaktasvaraH| pitRusadRusharUpA ityatra pitRushabdena mAtApitarau grAhyau| kAraNasadRusharUpatvena cenmanuShyA bhavanti tadA jaDAdirUpakAraNajAtA api kAraNasadRushatvena jaDAdirUpAH syuriti bhAvaH| atra jaDAdibahUdAharaNakaraNaM pakShasya bahUdAharaNasiddhatvena dRuDhatvapratipAdanArtham| kRutapUrvapakShe samAdhAnamAsha~gkate- athAtretyAdi| svenaiveti AtmakarmopArjitenaiva| tena, indriyANi yasmAdAtmajAnyuktAni na tu mAtApitRurUpamanuShyajanyAni, tatashca pitrorindriyaM pratyakAraNatvena na tadindriyasadRushAnIndriyANyasya bhavantIti bhAvaH| svenaiveti shrotrAdibhirabhisambadhyate| jaDAdibhirjAtA ityatra AdishabdaH prakAravAcI, tena kubjakuShTyAdInAM grahaNam| kubjatvakuShThAdyAdhArabhUtaM hi sharIraM nAtmajaM, kintu mAtApitRujameva; tatashca kubjAdijAtasya kubjatvAdiprasa~ggenaivApakRutatvaM tadavasthameva| Asha~gkitaM samAdhAnaM dUShayati- atrApItyAdi| pratij~jAdoShaH syAditi “atmA j~jaH” (shA. 1) ityAdinA Atmano j~jatvapratij~jAyAH, tathA “nirvikAraH parastvAtmA” (sU. 1) ityAdinA kRutAyA nirvikAratvapratij~jAyA doShaH syAditi bhAvaH| asatsvaj~ja ityanena kadAcidaj~jatvAt pratij~jAtaM j~jatvaM vyAhatam, indriyAdhInatvena j~jatvamAtmanaH parAdhInaM sanna vAstavaM syAditi bhAvaH| yatretyAdinA savikAratvaM sAdhayati| j~jatvaparityAgenAj~jatve prakRuteranyathAbhUtatvena vikAro bhavatIti bhAvaH| savikAra iti ‘vikAravAn’ ityartho matublopAjj~jeyaH| Atmana indriyAdhInatvena j~jatve dUShaNAntaramAha- yadi cetyAdi| aj~jatvAdakAraNamiti aj~jatvAt j~jAnapUrvakasharIrapreraNAdau na kAraNaM syAdityarthaH| akAraNatvAcca nAtmeti sharIrapreraNAdau buddhiniShpAdye~akAraNatvAdacetanapa~jcabhUtAtiriktashcetanAbhidha AtmashabdavAcya ityarthaH| vAgvastumAtramiti artharahitashabdamAtrametad- yaducyate- AtmA svena cakShuShA rUpaM pashyatItyAdi||15||

Atreya uvAca- purastAdetat pratij~jAtaM- sattvaM jIvaM spRuksharIreNAbhisambadhnAtIti| yasmAttu samudAyaprabhavaH san sa garbho manuShyavigraheNa jAyate, manuShyo manuShyaprabhava ityucyate, tadvakShyAmaH- bhUtAnAM caturvidhA yonirbhavati- jarAyvaNDasvedodbhidaH| tAsAM khalu catasRuNAmapi yonInAmekaikA yoniraparisa~gkhyeyabhedA bhavati, bhUtAnAmAkRutivisheShAparisa~gkhyeyatvAt| tatra jarAyujAnAmaNDajAnAM ca prANinAmete garbhakarA bhAvA yAM yAM yonimApadyante, tasyAM tasyAM yonau tathAtathArUpA bhavanti; yathA- kanakarajatatAmratrapusIsakAnyAsicyamAnAni teShu teShu madhUcchiShTavigraheShu, tAni yadA manuShyabimbamApadyante tadA manuShyavigraheNa jAyante, tasmAt samudAyaprabhAvaH san garbho manuShyavigraheNa jAyate; manuShyashca manuShyaprabhava ucyate, tadyonitvAt||16||

Commentary: AtreyaH samAdadhAti- purastAdityAdi|- etacca ‘kathamayaM sandhIyate’ ityasyottaram| sattvaM shukrArtavasandhAnakAraNamityarthaH| bhUtAnAmiti prANinAm| yoniH jAtiH, yadA~api yonishabdaH kAraNavacanastadA~api jarAyujAdirUpayonijAtA api jarAyujAdaya evocyante, kArye kAraNopacArAt| AkRutiH saMsthAnaM, tasyA visheShAH parasparavisadRushAkRutaya eva nara-kari-turagAdi-rUpAH| sambhave yonibhedaM darshayitvA yathA yonyanukAro bhavati tadAha- tatretyAdi| garbhakArA bhAvAH shukrAdayaH| madhUcchiShTavigraheShviti sikthakena mRuttikAyAM nirmitasa~jcakarUpavigraheShu| manuShyabimbamiti manuShyAkAraM sikthakakRutaM sa~jcakam| kanakAdibahudravyodAharaNaM yathA kanakAdInAM bahUnAmapi manuShyasa~jcakasikthakasthAnAM manuShyAkRutijanakatvaM, tathA shukrAdInAmapi bahUnAM manuShyayonipatitAnAM manuShyavigrahakartRutvamiti sAdharmyodAharaNArtham| samudAyAtmakaH sanniti yadyapi samudAyajanyastathA~api yonirUpakAraNamahimnA svayonisadRusha eva bhavati nAnyayonisadRushaH; na ca kAraNadharmaH paryanuyogamarhati| tena, shukrAdisamudAyo~api kAraNaM bhavati, mAtApitarau visheSheNa garbhasya sajAtIyatve kAraNaM bhavata iti na kAcit kShatiH| tadyonitvAditi visheSheNa manuShyasya kAraNatvAt||16||

yaccoktaM- yadi ca manuShyo manuShyaprabhavaH, kasmAnna jaDAdibhyo jAtAH pitRusadRusharUpA bhavantIti; tatrocyate- yasya yasya hya~ggAvayavasya bIje bIja bhAga upatapto bhavati, tasya tasyA~ggAvayavasya vikRutirupajAyate, nopajAyate cAnupatApAt; tasmAdubhayopapattirapyatra| sarvasya cAtmajAnIndriyANi, teShAM bhAvAbhAvaheturdaivaM; tasmAnnaikAntato jaDAdibhyo jAtAH pitRusadRusharUpA bhavanti||17||

Commentary: bIja iti shukrashoNite| bIjasyA~ggapratya~gganirvartako bhAgo bIjabhAgaH| ubhayopapattirapyatreti pitRusadRusharUpA bhavanti na bhavanti cetyarthaH| AtmajAnIti AtmapratibaddhakarmajAni| bhAvAbhAvaheturdaivamiti indriyabhAve indriyajanakaM shubham, indriyAbhAve cAshubhaM daivaM heturityarthaH| upasaMharati- tasmAdityAdi| evaM manyate- manuShyabIjaM hi pratya~ggabIjabhAgasamudAyAtmakaM svasadRushapratya~ggasamudAyarUpapuruShajanakam, indriyANi ca bhogasAdhanAni AtmapratibaddhakarmAdhInAni; tena pitA yadi kuShThyapi bhavati, bIjaM cAduShTaM bhavati kuShThAdhAratvagAdijanakaM, tato niShkuShThAnyeva tvagAdInyanupataptatvagAdibIjAt sadRushAni jAyante; yadA tvativRuddhakuShThatayA pitrorbIjamapi kuShThajanakadoSheNa duShTaM bhavati, tadA duShTatvagAdibIjabhAgAt kuShThaduShTaiva tvag jAyate| yaduktaM- “dampatyoH kuShThabAhulyAdduShTashoNitashukrayoH| yadapatyaM tayorjAtaM j~jeyaM tadapi kuShThitam” (su. ni. 5) iti| evaM kuShThino~api yadi hetubalAd bIje kuShThajanako doSho bhavati, tadA kuShThino~api kuShThavadapatyaM bhavati| andhatvAdAvindriyopaghAtarUpe durdaivameva kAraNaM; taccAndhApatye~apyavashyamasti; tena yadA~andhe~apatye dRuShTyupaghAtakamashubhaM bhavati, tadA kAkatAlIyanyAyAdandhajAto~apyandho dRushyate| evaM kubjAdau jaDAdau ca vyAkhyeyam||17||

na cAtmA satsvindriyeShu j~jaH, asatsu vA bhavatyaj~jaH; na hyasattvaH kadAcidAtmA, sattvavisheShAccopalabhyate j~jAnavisheSha iti||18||

Commentary: yA cAj~jatvaprasaktirAtmanyuktA, tatrAha- na cetyAdi| indriyabhAve tathendriyAbhAve~api nityaM j~jAnavAnevAtmA iti pratij~jArthaH | na hyasattvaH kadAcidityatra hishabdo hetau; tena yasmAt sarvadA samanaska evAtmA, tena bAhyendriyAbhAve~apyantaHkaraNamanoyogAnnityamAtmA manaHkaraNako j~jAnavAnevAyamityarthaH| yattvetadbAhyaviShayagataM j~jAnaM, tat sattvasyendriyAdhiShThAnavisheShAdbhavati; tena, indriyabhAve indriyajanyaM vishiShTaM j~jAnaM bhavati; yattu kevalamanojanyamAtmaj~jAnaM, tad bhavatyeva sarvadA; tasmAdyannityabhAvi manosannidhimAtrajanyamAtmaj~jAnaM, tat sadaivAsti||18||

bhavanti cAtra- na karturindriyAbhAvAt kAryaj~jAnaM pravartate| yA kriyA vartate bhAvaiH sA vinA tairna vartate||19||

Commentary: na cAsya j~jAnajananashaktiH parAhatA bhavatItyAshayenAha- netyAdi| yatvaitadaindriyakaM viShayopabhogavattadbhavati kadAcit, kadAciccendriyAbhAvAnna bhavatItyadhyAtmavido manyante; ki~jca bAhyaj~jAne~api j~jAnajananashakta evAyamAtmA, paraM karaNAbhAvAt kadAcinna pravartate| kAryaj~jAnamiti kAryapravRuttijanakabAhyaviShayaj~jAnaM; tena nirviShayaM j~jAnamAtmana indriyAbhAve bhavatIti sUcayati | bhAvairityatra ‘yaiH’ iti sheShaH| vartate utpadyate| atraiva dRuShTAntamAha- jAnannapItyAdi| jAnannapIti ghaTaM kartuM jAnannapItyarthaH| mRudo mRuttikAyA abhAvAt||19||-
shrUyatAM cedamadhyAtmamAtmaj~jAnabalaM mahat||20||
indriyANi ca sa~gkShipya manaH sa~gkShipya ca~jcalam| pravishyAdhyAtmamAtmaj~jaH sve j~jAne paryavasthitaH||21||
gRuhNIShva ce(ve)damaparaM bharadvAja vinirNayam||22||
nivRuttendriyavAkceShTaH suptaH svapnagato yadA| viShayAn sukhaduHkhe ca vetti nAj~jo~apyataH smRutaH||23||
nAtmaj~jAnAdRute caikaM j~jAnaM ki~jcit pravartate| na hyeko vartate bhAvo vartate nApyahetukaH||24||

tasmAjj~jaH prakRutishcAtmA draShTA kAraNameva ca| sarvametadbharadvAja nirNItaM jahi saMshayam||25||

Commentary: upasaMharati- tasmAdityAdi| atra cAtmano j~jatvAj~jatvaprasaktyA~a~apAditaM savikAratvamAtmano nityaj~jAnasAdhanenaiva parihRutamiti kRutvA na pRuthak parihRutam| bharadvAjashabdeneha nAtreyagururucyate, kintu anya eva bharadvAjagotraH kashcit; tena, tasya saMshayacchedanamAtreyeNopapannameva||25||
tatra shlokau- heturgarbhasya nirvRuttau vRuddhau janmani caiva yaH| punarvasumatiryA ca bharadvAjamatishca yA||26||
pratij~jApratiShedhashca vishadashcAtmanirNayaH| garbhAvakrAntimuddishya khuDDIkAM tatprakAshitam||27||

puruShasyAnupahataretasaH striyAshcApraduShTayonishoNitagarbhAshayAyA yadA bhavati saMsargaH RutukAle, yadA cAnayostathAyukte saMsarge shukrashoNitasaMsargamantargarbhAshayagataM jIvo~avakrAmati sattvasamprayogAttadA garbho~abhinirvatete, sa sAtmyarasopayogAdarogo~abhivardhate samyagupacAraishcopacaryamANaH, tataH prAptakAlaH sarvendriyopapannaH paripUrNasharIro balavarNasattvasaMhananasampadupetaH sukhena jAyate samudayAdeShAM bhAvAnAM- mAtRujashcAyaM garbhaH pitRujashcAtmajashca sAtmyajashca rasajashca, asti ca khalu sattvamaupapAdukamiti hovAca bhagavAnAtreyaH||3||

Commentary: puruShasyetyAdi| anupahataretasa iti padenaiva puruShasyeti labhyate, yataH puruShasyaiva retaso garbhajanakatvamuktaM; tena puruShasyeti padena ya eva sampUrNadhAtuH puruShashabdavAcyo bAlavyatiriktastaM grAhayati| striyAshceti padamarthalabdhaM sad yauvanavatIM striyaM lambhayati| saMsargaH maithunam| Rutau puShpadarshane prashastaH kAlaH RutukAlaH; tena RutukAlasyAditryahaM niShedhayati| yataH “rajasvalAbhigamanamalakShmImukhAnAM” (sU. 25) ityAdinA Rutau tryahaM niShiddham| ArtavadarshanaM ca sharadAdyRutusAdharmyAd Rutushabdenocyate| yathA RutAvuptAni bIjAni prarohanti, tathA ArtavadarshanAkhye~api Rutau shukrarUpaM bIjamuptamiti RutusAdharmyam| na kevalamevambhUtaH saMsarga eva garbhakAraNaM, kiM tu jIvAdhiShThAne satItyAha- yadetyAdi| tathAyukta iti aduShTaretasaH puruShasya aduShTayonyAdeshca striyAH saMsarge| ayaM cArthaH puruShasyetyAdinaiva labdho~api punaH shukrashoNitasaMsargamityAdigranthavakShyamANAdhikadharmavidhyarthamanUdyate, tena na paunaruktyam| kiMvA, puruShasyetyAdinA pUrvaM maithunAt prAganupahataretastvAdyuktaM, tathAyukte cetyanena tu maithunasamaye~api shukrayonyAdInAmaduShTirucyate| maithunakAle hi IrShyAdinA shukraduShTiH sambhAvyate| shukrashoNitasaMsargamiti shukrashoNitamelakam| antarityanena garbhAshayabAhyagataM saMsargamakAraNaM garbhasya niShedhayati| jIvashabdena cetanAdhAturAtmA| nanvAtmA vyApakaH, tat kathamayamavakrAmatItyAha- sattvetyAdi| sattvasamprayogAditi manogamanAdityarthaH| tad yathoktaM- “yuktasya manasA tasya nirdishyante vibhoH kriyAH” (shA.a.1) iti| yadyapyAtmA vibhutvAt sarvagatatvena na kvacidapi yAti, tathA~api yatrAsya karmavashAnmano yAti, tatraiva caitanyopalabdherAtmA~api gata iti vyapadishyata iti bhAvaH| athaivamutpanno garbhaH kathamabhivardhate, kathaM vA jAyata ityAha- samyagupacArairiti; garbhahitakarairAhAravihArairityarthaH| prAptakAla iti prAptaprasavakAlaH, prasavakAlo navamadashamamAsau| paripUrNasharIra iti sarvA~ggopacitadehaH| sampacchabdo balAdibhiH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| samudayAditi samya~gmelakAt| eShAmityanena puruShasyetyAdigranthoktAn reta-Artava-jIva-sattva-sAtmya-rasa-samyagupacArAn pratyavamRushati| etadeva samudAyaprabhavatvaM garbhasya pratyekaM mAtrAdigarbhakAraNavyutpAdanena darshayannAha- mAtRujashcetyAdi| sAtmyajashcetyatra sAtmyashabdena rasavyatiriktarUpAdi, tathA AcArashca sAtmyo grAhyaH| sAtmyarasastu ‘rasaja’ ityanenaiva gRuhItaH| aupapAdukamiti AtmanaH sharIrAntarasambandhopapAdakam| etacca vyAkRutameva pUrvam| atra yadyapi puruShasyAnupahataretasa ityanena pitaiva prathamamuktaH, tathA~api mAtRupradhAnatAM garbhasya darshayituM mAtRujashcAyamiti prathamaM kRutaM; mAtA ca garbhe pradhAnaM kAraNaM, yena AsekAt prabhRuti prasavaparyantaM mAtureva guNadoShAvanuvidadhAti garbhaH; prathamaM tu puruShasya maithune svAtantryAt tathA sharIradhArakapradhAnAsthikAraNatvAccAgre~abhidhAnaM kRutam||3||

tasmAdetadbrUmahe- amAtRujashcAyaM garbho~apitRujashcAnAtmajashcAsAtmyajashcArasajashca, na cAsti sattvamaupapAdukamiti (hovAca bharadvAjaH )||4||

Commentary: pUrvapakShoddhAreNa siddhAntaM grAhayituM mAtrAdigarbhakAraNAni bharadvAjamukhenAkShipati- netyAdi| netItyanena sAmAnyenAtreyavacanasyoktasyAkShepaH| kiM kAraNamityanena kasmAdAtreyavacanametadviruddhamityatra kAraNaM pRucchato nahi mAtetyAdinoktamAtrAdikAraNAnAmakAraNatvaM bharadvAjaH pratijAnIte||4 (1)|| yadi hItyAdinA mAtrAdInAmakAraNatve hetuM brUte| kiMvA, mAtrAdInAmakAraNatvaM bharadvAjena pratij~jAtaM tatra ‘kiM kAraNamiti’ hetuprashnaH, tataH ‘nahi mAtA’ ityAdinA hetukathanam| asya cAyamarthaH- yat- na mAtrAdayo garbhakAraNatvena pratyakSheNa dRushyante, tato na mAtrAdayo garbhakAraNam| yadi hItyAdinA tUpapattivirodho~api mAtrAdikAraNatve~astIti darshayati; tena na paunaruktyam| maithunadharmaH vyavAyaH| putrakAmAH putrAneva janayeyuH, duhitRukAmA duhitRUrvA janayeyuriti yojanA| natu kAshcit striya ityatra maithunamApadyamAnA eva striyaH puruShAshca parideveran na ceti yojanA | mAtApitradhInatvena garbhasya yadaivecchantyapatyaM, tadaiva maithunamApadyamAnAH sApatyAH syuH; tatashca sarvApatyatvena na kecit parideverannityarthaH||4 (2)|| AtmajatvaM garbhasya niShedhayati- na cAtmetyAdi| manuShyakarituragAdirUpeNa AtmAnaM janayatItyarthaH| sattvAditi janyasyAtmano vidyamAnatvAt, na ca vidyamAno janyata ityarthaH| asattvAditi kAraNabhUtasyAtmano~ajAtapakShe~asattvAnna kAraNatvamupapannamityarthaH| atraiva dUShANAntaramAha- tiShThatvityAdi| yoniShvivi jAtiShu| ato vA bhUya iti yathoktaguNayuktAdapyadhikaM shakrAdiparamardhitulyamityarthaH||4 (3)|| taccobhayamiti saprajatvamanapatyatvaM ca| ubhayatreti sAtmyasevinyasAtmyasevinyapi||4 (4)|| yo rasAnnopayu~gkte iti rasashcedgarbhakAraNaM taM ca sarva eva strIpuruShAH sevante, tena sarva eva sApatyAH syuriti bhAvaH| atha rasajo garbha ityasya shreShTharasa ityartho varNyate, tatrApi dUShaNamAha- shreShThetyAdi||4 (5)|| ‘asti ca sattvamaupapAdukam’ iti yaduktaM, taddUShayati- na khalvapItyAdi| paurvadehikamiti pUrvadehAnubhUtam| aviditamadRuShTaM veti iha janmanyapi pUrvadehAnubhUtaM nAviditamadRuShTaM vA syAt; viditaM pratyakShavyatiriktapramANopalabdhaM, dRuShTaM tu pratyakShopalabdham, etadviparyayAdaviditamadRuShTaM ca vij~jeyam| na ca ki~jcidapi smaratIti naca pUrvajanmAnubhUtaM smaratItyarthaH| evaM manyate- yanmanaH paurvadehikamanubhavati tacceha janmanyapyanuvartate, tathA yat tena janmAntare~anubhUtaM tadiha janmanyapi tathaiva smaratu; yathA- devadatto bAlyAnubhUtaM yauvane smarati, na cAyaM tathA smarati; tena na pUrvAparajanmanyekaM sattvamiti| tasmAdityAdinA dUShaNadUShitamarthaM punarnigamanena darshayati||4||

neti bhagavAnAtreyaH, sarvebhya ebhyo bhAvebhyaH samuditebhyo garbho~abhinirvartate||5||

Commentary: bharadvAjamatamAtreyavacasA dUShayati- netItyAdi| samuditebhya iti vacanAt pratyekaM mAtrAdInAmitarakAraNanirapekShANAM garbhakAraNatvaM niShedhayati| tena, mAtrAdigarbhakAraNasAnnidhye~api garbhakAraNAntarajIvAvakramAdyabhAvAd garbhAnutpAdo yukta eva| na ca sAmagrIjanye kArye ekadeshasyAjanakatvenAkAraNatvam| evaM sati tantUnAmapi paTakAraNAnAM kAraNAntarAsAnnidhye paTAjanakatvenAkAraNatvaM syAditi bhAvaH| idameva garbhasya mAtrAdijanyatvaM yat- mAtrAdivyatirekeNAnutpadyamAnatvam||5||

mAtRujashcAyaM garbhaH| na hi mAturvinA garbhotpattiH syAt, na ca janma jarAyujAnAm| yAni khalvasya garbhasya mAtRujAni, yAni cAsya mAtRutaH sambhavataH sambhavanti, tAnyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- tvakca lohitaM ca mAMsaM ca medashca nAbhishca hRudayaM ca kloma ca yakRucca plIhA ca vRukkau ca bastishca purIShAdhAnaM cAmAshayashca pakvAshayashcottaragudaM cAdharagudaM ca kShudrAntraM ca sthUlAntraM ca vApA ca vapAvahanaM ceti (mAtRujAni)||6||

Commentary: evaMvidhameva mAtustAvat kAraNatvamAha- mAtRujashcAyaM garbha ityAdinA| garbhotpattau mAtuH kAraNatvaM darshayitvA jarAyujajanmani kAraNatvamAha- na ca janmetyAdi| jarAyuH amarA, yena veShTitA manuShyAdayaH prajAyante; jarAyuNA veShTitA jAyante iti jarAyujAmanuShyAdayaH saMsvedajAnAM mashakAdInAmudbhijjAdInAM bhekAdInAM ca mAtaraM vinA~api janma bhavati| aNDajAnAmapi yadyapi mAtA kAraNaM bhavatyeva janmani, tathA~api jarAyujasya mAnuShasyeha prakaraNe~abhipretatvenANDajAn vihAya jarAyujAnAmiti kRutam| kiMvA, jarAyujasyAbhivyaktirUpe janmani yAvadabhivyakti yathA mAtA kAraNaM bhavati, na tathA~aNDaje; tatra kUrmAdAvaNDotpattimAtra eva mAtA kAraNaM, na janmanyabhivyaktirUpe| yattu ‘piturvinA na jarAyujAnAM janma’ iti vakShyati, tajjarAyujotpAde pituravashyApekShaNIyatvopadarshanArtham; aNDajAstu matsyAdayaH pitaraM vinA~api RutuvisheShaprAptyaiva bhavantIti bhAvaH| mAtRujAnItyasya vivaraNaM- yAnyasya mAtRutaH sambhavataH sambhavantIti sambhavato garbhasya yAni mAtRuta iti mAturAgatAcchoNitAt sambhavantyutpadyante, tAni mAtRujAni tvagAdInyanuvyAkhyAsyAma iti yojanA| evamanyatrApi yAni tvityAdigrantho vyAkhyeyaH| mAtRujatvaM ca tvagAdInAmAgamagamyageva| purIShAdhAnaM pakvAshayaH| uttaragudAdharagudau gudottarAdharabhAgau| vapAvahanaM ‘tailavartikA’ iti kathyate ||6||

pitRujashcAyaM garbhaH| nahi piturRute garbhotpattiH syAt, na ca janma jarAyujAnAm| yAni khalvasya garbhasya pitRujAni, yAni cAsya pitRutaH sambhavataH sambhavanti, tAnyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- keshashmashrunakhalomadantAsthisirAsnAyudhamanyaH shukraM ceti (pitRujAni)||7||

Commentary: shukramiti vicchidyapAThena shukrasya sarvadhAtusArasyopAdeyatAM darshayati||7||

AtmajashcAyaM garbhaH| garbhAtmA hyantarAtmA yaH, taM ‘jIva’ ityAcakShate shAshvatamarujamajaramamaramakShayamabhedyamacchedyamaloDyaM vishvarUpaM vishvakarmANamavyaktamanAdimanidhanamakSharamapi| sa garbhAshayamanupravishya shukrashoNitAbhyAM saMyogametya garbhatvena janayatyAtmanA~a~atmAnam, Atmasa~jj~jA hi garbhe| tasya punarAtmano janmAnAditvAnnopapadyate, tasmAnna jAta evAyamajAtaM garbhaM janayati, ajAto hyayamajAtaM garbhaM janayati; sa caiva garbhaH kAlAntareNa bAlayuvasthavirabhAvAn prApnoti, sa yasyAM yasyAmavasthAyAM vartate tasyAM tasyAM jAto bhavati, yA tvasya puraskRutAtasyAM janiShyamANashca, tasmAt sa eva jAtashcAjAtashca yugapadbhavati; yasmiMshcaitadubhayaM sambhavati jAtatvaM janiShyamANatvaM ca sa jAto janyate, sa caivAnAgateShvavasthAntareShvajAto janyayatyAtmanA~a~atmAnam| sato hyavasthAntaragamanamAtrameva hi janma cocyate tatra tatra vayasi tasyAM tasyAmavasthAyAM; yathA- satAmeva shukrashoNitajIvAnAM prAk saMyogAdgarbhatvaM na bhavati, tacca saMyogAdbhavati; yathA- satastasyaiva puruShasya prAgapatyAt pitRutvaM na bhavati, taccApatyAdbhavati; tathA satastasyaiva garbhasya tasyAM tasyAmavasthAyAM jAtatvamajAtatvaM cocyate||8||

Commentary: Atmaja ityAdinA AtmajatvaM vyutpAdayati| antarAtmocyata ityanena garbhakAraNabhUtamAtmAnaM ShaDdhAtusamudAyavartyAtmashabdAbhidheyAd vyAvartayati| AcakShata iti AgameShu shAshvatAdishabdairbruvate vRuddhAH| aloDyamiti akShobhyam| garbhatvena janayatyAtmAnamiti garbhasvarUpo yaH ShaDdhAtuka AtmA taM janayatItyarthaH| garbhasyAtmashabdAbhidheyatAmAha- Atmasa~jj~jA hi garbhe iti| tasyetyanena paramAtmAnaM pratyavamRushati| yasmAdasyAnAditvAjjanma nopapadyate tasmAjjAta evAyamajAtaM garbhaM janayatIti pakSho~ana, iti yojyam| atha jAtaH sa na cejjanayati kathaM tarhi janayatItyaha- ajAto hyayamiti; nityo hyayamityarthaH| tena nityatvenAkAshavanna jAtaH sannantarAtmA garbhasvarUpamAtmAnaM janayati| atashcAntarAtmarUpatayA nityavidyamAnatvenAjAtaH san garbharUpAvasthAyAM jAta ucyate| evamajAtatvaM jAtatvaM cAtmani dvayamapi vyapadishyate| etadevAtmani jAtatvamajAtatvaM ca darshayituM dRuShTAntArthaM garbha eva jAtatvamajAtatvaM ca darshayati- sa caivetyAdi| puraskRuteti agre bhaviShyantI| yathA- bAlasya vRuddhatvAvasthA~ajAtA janyata iti ca, tathA ajAto janayatyAtmanA~a~atmanamiti ca shabdaprayogasamarthanamAtrametad vivakShAbhedAdboddhavyam| anena cAtmanyavasthAbhedakRutajAtatvasamarthanena ‘jAto vAjanayet, ajAto vA’ ityAdigranthakRutapUrvapakShaH shabdaprayogasamarthanatayA parihRutaH| paramArthatastu nityatvenAjAta evAtmA Atmano~ajAtAvasthAM garbhAdirUpAM janayati| tena, nAsataH kAraNatvaM sato vA janyatvamiti pakShaH sthita eva| sato hItyAdinA satkAryapakShaM sA~gkhyamataM darshayati| kiMvA vayobhedena yadevAvasthAntaragamanaM tadeva janmeti darshayati| tasyAM tasyAmavasthAyAmiti cchedaH| pitRutvamiti pitRutvena vyapadesha ityarthaH||8||

na khalu garbhasya na ca mAturna piturna cAtmanaH sarvabhAveShu yatheShTakAritvamasti; te ki~jcit svavashAt kurvanti, ki~jcit karmavashAt, kvaciccaiShAM karaNashaktirbhavati, kvacinna bhavati| yatra sattvAdikaraNasampattatra yathAbalameva yatheShTakAritvam, ato~anyathA viparyayaH| na ca karaNadoShAdakaraNamAtmAsambhavati garbhajanane, dRuShTaM ceShTA yoniraishvaryaM mokShashcAtmavidbhirAtmAyattam| nahyanyaH sukhaduHkhayoH kartA| na cAnyato garbho jAyate jAyamAnaH, nA~gkurotpattirabIjAt||9||

Commentary: yaduktaM- yadyAtmA AtmAnaM janayati tadA vashitvAdiguNayuktaM janayediti, tatrottaramAha- na khalvityAdi| garbhasya sarvabhAveShu na mAtrAdInAM yatheShTakAritvamiti yojyam| atra ca yadyapyAtmaiva prakRutaH, tathA~api tulyasamAdhAnatvena mAtApitarAvapyupAttau| yathA AtmanaH sarvabhAveShu yatheShTakAritveneShTayonigamanAdiprasaktiH samAdhIyate, tathA mAtApitrorapi yatheShTakAritvena putrAneva janayeyurityAdipUrvapakShaH parihRuto bhavati| atha kuta evAtmAdInAM yatheShTakAritvaM kvacinna bhavatItyAha- ki~jcidityAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| tatra mAtApitarau svavashau maithunaM garbhakAraNaM sAtmyarasasevAdikaM cAcarataH, garbhasya jIvAdhiShThAnAdau tu karmAdhIne paravashau; tathA, AtmA~api garbhasya caitanye tathA dharmAdharmahetukriyAnuShThAne svavashaH, karmajanye iShTAniShTayonyAdigamane tu dharmAdharmaparAdhIna eva; tena karmAdhIne viShaye na mAtrAdInAM yatheShTakAritvam| yatheShTakAritvamapi mAtrAdInAM kvaciddarshayannAha- kvaciccaiShAmityAdi| karaNamupakaraNaM sAdhanopAya iti yAvat| sattvaM manaH, Adi pradhAnaM yeShAM tAni sattvAdIni mana-indriyashukrashoNitAdIni| yathAbalamiti yathAkarma; balashabdenehAdRuShTamucyate | etena, yatra mAtrAdInAM putrecchAyAmiShTayonigamanAdikaraNashaktirbhavati , karma cAnuguNaM bhavati, tatrepsitaputrAdiShviShTayonigamanAdi kAryaM bhavati; yathA- yadi tatra vishuddhabhUrishukraH puruSho bhavati, strI ca vishuddhayonyAshrayatvAdiguNayuktA, putrajanakaM ca karmaM tayorbalavat, tadA putrajanmAbhisandhAya maithunamApadyamAnau IpsitaM putraM janayataH; tathA AtmA~api vishuddhasattvAdiguNayuktaH shubhakarmavAn tatkAle iShTAM yonimanudhyAyati, tadA~abhIShTayonigamanaM sampAdayatyAtmana ityAdi yatheShTakAritvodAharaNaM j~jeyam| ato~anyathA iti sattvAdikaraNAshaktau viguNe ca daive| viparyaya iti na yatheShTakAritvam| kiMvA, kvacicca maithunAdAveShAM pitrAdInAM svavashatvaM, tat kimiti jIvopakramAdAvapi na svavashatvameShAM bhavatItyAha- kvaciccaiShAmityAdi| kvacideva kArye yasmAt ki~jcit karaNaM mAtrAdInAM shaktaM na sarvatra, tena sarveShveva garbhasya bhAveShu na svavashatvamiti bhAvaH| yatrApi caite mAtrAdayaH svavashAH santaH kurvanti, tatrApi svIyasvIyakaraNayuktA eva kurvantItyAha- yatra sattvetyAdi| yathAbalamiti yathAshakti| anena ca mAtrAdayo garbhasya yeShu visheSheShu shaktAH, teShu sattvAdikaraNasampattau yatheShTakAriNo bhavanti, na tvashakye viShaye upahatakaraNA vA yatheShTakAriNo bhavantIti darshayati| ato~anyathA viparyaya ityasya cArtho~agre vyAkRutaH| nanu sattvAdikaraNadoShAccedayamAtmA garbhaM na janayati tathAvidhaM, hanta tarhyakAraNamevAyamAtmA, kAraNaM hi yadbhavati tat karotyeva kAryamityAha- na cetyAdi| karaNadoShAdakurvan garbhaM kadAcidAtmAna garbhajanane kAraNaM bhavatIti na, apitu bhavatyeva kAraNam; evaM manyate- mRudAdyabhAvAt ghaTamakurvannapi kumbhakAraH kAraNameva ghaTasya bhavati, ghaTajananashaktiyuktatvAt; tathA AtmA~api karaNadoShAdakurvannapi tathAvidhaM garbhaM, tajjananashaktatvena bhUyodRuShTatvAt kAraNameva bhavati| tatheShTayonigamane prasaktirapi prodbhAvitA AtmanaH kAraNatvena sA kvacidbhavatItyapi darshayannAha- dRuShTaM cetyAdi| AtmAdhInA yoniH puruShaM prati iShTA yoniH; tathA aishvaryAdayashcAtmAdhInA dRuShTAH, yathoktaM katidhApuruShIye- “Aveshashcetaso j~jAnaM” (shA. 1) ityAdinA| AtmanaH kAraNatve hetvantaramAha- na hyanya ityAdi|- hi yasmAdAtmano~anyaH sukhaduHkhayoH kartA nAsti, kiM tvAtmaiva sukhaduHkhasAdhanendriyakarmasharIrAdikartA; tena AtmA kAraNaM garbhasya sukhaduHkhAdyAdhArasyeti bhAvaH| atha bhUtAnyeva kasmAt saMyogavashAccetanAmAsAdya sukhAdikAraNAni na bhavantItyAha- na cAnyata ityAdi| anyata iti vijAtIyAt| jAyamAna iti utpadya mAnaH| sadRushameva kAraNAt kAryamutpadyate; yena na shaNasyA~gkurotpattirnArikelabIjAdbhavati; abIjAditi kAryatvenAbhimatA~gkurasyAbIjAt| etena, garbhasya yaccaitanyaM tadacetanebhyo bhUtebhyo na bhavati, kintu cetanAdhAtorAtmana eveti darshayati||9||

yAni tu khalvasya garbhasyAtmajAni, yAni cAsyAtmataH sambhavataH sambhavanti, tAnyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH tadyathA- tAsu tAsu yoniShUtpattirAyurAtmaj~jAnaM mana indriyANi prANApAnau preraNaM dhAraNamAkRutisvaravarNavisheShAH sukhaduHkhe icchAdveShau cetanA dhRutirbuddhiH smRutiraha~gkAraH prayatnashceti (AtmajAni)||10||

Commentary: evamAtmajatvaM garbhasya vyutpAdyAtmajAn visheShAnAha- yAnItyAdi| preraNaM dhAraNaM cendriyANAmeva| atra ca tattaddevAdipashvAdiyonigamanAdau dharmAdharmajanye dharmAdharmasyApi janakatvenAtmaiva mUlakAraNamucyate; Atmaj~jAnaprANApAnapreraNAdau tu manaHkaraNa AtmaivAvyavadhAnena kAraNam||10||

sAtmyajashcAyaM garbhaH| nahyasAtmyasevitvamantareNa strIpuruShayorvandhyatvamasti, garbheShu vA~apyaniShTo bhAvaH| yAvat khalvasAtmyasevinAM strIpuruShANAM trayo doShAH prakupitAH sharIramupasarpanto na shukrashoNitagarbhAshayopaghAtAyopapadyante, tAvat samarthA garbhajananAya bhavanti| sAtmyasevinAM punaH strIpuruShANAmanupahatashukrashoNitagarbhAshayAnAmRutakAle sannipatitAnAM jIvasyAnavakramaNAdgarbhA na prAdurbhavanti| nahi kevalaM sAtmyaja evAyaM garbhaH, samudayo~atra kAraNamucyate| yAni khalvasya garbhasya sAtmyajAni, yAni cAsya sAtmyataH sambhavataH sambhavanti, tAnyanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH; tadyathA- ArogyamanAlasyamalolupatvamindriyaprasAdaH svaravarNabIjasampat praharShabhUyastvaM ceti (sAtmyajAni)||11||

Commentary: sAtmyajashcetyAdinA sAtmyajatvaM vyutpAdayati, asAtmyasevAM ca garbhopaghAtinIM darshayan sAtmyasevAyA garbhaM prati kAraNatvaM draDhayati| asAtmyasevinAmapi prajAbhavanopapattiM darshayan ‘asAtmyasevinashca nikhilenApatyAH syuH’ iti pUrvapakShaM pariharati| sAtmyasevinAM punarityAdinA tu granthena ‘sAtmyasevinAmekAntena prajA syAt’ iti yaduktaM tat pariharati| sannipatitAnAmiti vyavAyamApannAnAm| atra svaravarNau sAtmyajatvena tathA Atmajatvena coktau, tena dvAvapyatra kAraNamiti j~jeyam||11||

pUrvAdhyAye shukrashoNite garbhakAraNatvenokte, natu kRutsnaM garbhakAraNamuktam, ataH sampUrNagarbhakAraNAbhidhAnArthaM khuDDikAgarbhAvakrAntirucyate| khuDDikAmiti alpAm| garbhasyAvakrAntiH melakaH, utpattiriti yAvat||1-2||

Atmano j~jatve sAdhanAntaramAha- shrUyatAmityAdi| AtmAnamadhi adhyAtmam| Atmano j~jAnasya balamAtmaj~jAnabalam| sa~gkShipyeti viShayebhyo vyAvartya| manaH sa~gkShipyeti mano~apyAtmavyatiriktaviShayAnnigRuhya| ca~jcalamiti svabhAvataH| sve j~jAne iti Atmaj~jAne| sarvabhAvAn parIkShata iti vinA~apIndriyaiH samAdhibalAdeva yasmAt sarvaj~jo bhavati, tasmAjj~jasvabhAva eva nirindriyo~apyAtmA||20-21||-

aparamapi laukikaM nirindriyasya j~jAnasadbhAvodAharaNamAha- gRuhNIShvetyAdi| svapnagata iti svapnadarshanAvasthAM prAptaH| Atmaj~jAnaviShayaj~jAnayorvisheShamAha- nAtmetyAdi| Atmaj~jAnAnnityAdvinA, ki~jcijj~jAnaM viShayajam, ekam sahAyaM, na pravartate indriyAdikaraNarUpasahAyaM vinA notpadyate| Atmaj~jAnaM ca nityameva sA~gkhye~apyuktaM - “cicchaktirapariNAminI” ityAdinA “AtmanaH” ityantena| atropapattimAha- na hyeko vartate bhAva iti| bhAvaH utpattidharmA, ekaH san kAraNarahitaH san, na vartate notpadyate| tathA bhAvaH kAraNajanyatve satyapi ahetuka iti akartRuko na vartate notpadyate, kintu kartRukumbhakArAdhiShThitAnyeva mRuccakrAdIni pravartante; tasmAdviShayaj~jAnAnyapi indriyamanorthaistathA kartrA cAtmanA janyanta iti bhAvaH||22-24||

sa~ggrahe hetushabdo garbhAdiShu janmAnteShu sambadhyate| pratij~jApratiShedho bharadvAjakRuto j~jeyaH| tatsAdhanaM ca yadAtreyasya tat ‘vishadashcAtmanirNayaH’ ityanenoktam| taditi sAmAnyena mAtrAdipratyavamarshAnnapuMsakam||26-27||
athAto mahatIM garbhAvakrAntiM shArIraM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tRutIye mAsi sarvendriyANi sarvA~ggAvayavAshca yaugapadyenAbhinirvartante||11||

Commentary: a~ggAni shiraHprabhRutIni, tadavayavAshcetya~ggAvayavAH| yaugapadyeneti vacanena “kumArasya shiraH pUrvamabhinirvartate” (shA. 6) ityAdivakShyamANAnyekIyamatAni niShedhayati| yaugapadyena hi sarvA~gganirvRuttiriti siddhAntaH||11||

tatrAsya kecida~ggAvayavA mAtRujAdInavayavAn vibhajya pUrvamuktA yathAvat| mahAbhUtavikArapravibhAgena tvidAnImasya tAMshcaivA~ggAvayavAn kAMshcit paryAyAntareNAparAMshcAnuvyAkhyAsyAmaH| mAtRujAdayo~apyasya mahAbhUtavikArA eva| tatrAsyAkAshAtmakaM shabdaH shrotraM lAghavaM saukShmyaM vivekashca, vAyvAtmakaM sparshaH sparshanaM raukShyaM preraNaM dhAtuvyUhanaM ceShTAshca shArIryaH, agnyAtmakaM rUpaM darshanaM prakAshaH paktirauShNyaM ca, abAtmakaM raso rasanaM shaityaM mArdavaM snehaH kledashca, pRuthivyAtmakaM gandho ghrANaM gauravaM sthairyaM mUrtishceti||12||

Commentary: keciditi na sarve| tatra mAtRujAdya~ggakathanena shabdAdayo ya iha bhUtavikAratvena vakShyante te na sarve proktAH, kiM tu kecideva tvagAdayaH| paryAyAntareNetivacanAdye mAtRujAdayaH ‘tvak ca lohitaM ca’ (shA.a.3) ityAdinoktAsta iha na sAkShAdvaktavyAH, kintu ye tvaggatA mUrtisnehamArdavAdayaste bhUtajanyatvenocyamAnAstvaco~abhidhAyakA bhavanti| evaM shoNitAdigatabhUtavikArakathanena shoNitAdikathanaM j~jeyam| tvagAdayo vakShyamANA iti bhUtavikArasamudAyarUpA eva| tvagAdInAM mAtRujAdirUpeNa yadabhidhAnaM, tanmAtrAdyadhInatvapratipattyartham| punashceha bhUtajanyatvenAbhidhAnama~ggAnAM kShaye vA vRuddhau vA satyAM tatkAraNabhUtabhUtopayogapratiShedhAbhyAM vRuddhikShayajananaj~jAnArtham| yada~ggaM yadbhUtaprabhavaM tada~ggaM tadbhUtapradhAnena dravyeNa vardhate, kShIyate ca tadviparItena| lAghavaM yadyapi vAyau paThanti- “rUkShaH shIto laghushcaiva” (sU.a.1) ityAdinA, tathA~api AkAshe~atishayitaM j~jeyaM, tenehAkAshavikAre paThanti; AkAshaM hi atyarthasUkShmatvAdvAtAdapi laghu| viveko vicchedaH| dhAtuvyUhanaM dhAturacanA dhAtuvahanaM ca| dRushyate~aneneti darshanaM cakShurindriyam| mUrtiH kAThinyam||12||

evamayaM lokasammitaH puruShaH| yAvanto hi loke mUrtimanto bhAvavisheShAstAvantaH puruShe, yAvantaH puruShe tAvanto loke iti; budhAstvevaM draShTumicchanti||13||

Commentary: etadbhUtavikAramayatvaM sharIrasya lokasAmyena j~jAtaM sanmokShasyApi paramAbhIShTasya kAraNaM bhavatIti lokasAmyaM darshayannAha- evamayamityAdi| evamiti pa~jcabhUtavikAramayatvena| lokasammiti iti lokatulyaH| iha ca bhUtavikAramayatvaM yaccharIrasyoktaM tena bhUtavikAramayatvamadhikRutya sAdRushyamuktaM lokapuruShayoH; yattvAdhyAtmikaM lokapuruShayoH sAmyaM puruShavicaye vaktavyaM, tadapIhAnuktamapi ‘yAvanto hi’ ityAdivisheShAbhidhAnena sUcitaM j~jeyam| tena, yAvanto bhAvavisheShA AdhyAtmikA antarAtmasattvAha~gkArAdayo, bhautikA vA mUrtikledAdayaH, te puruShagatA lokenApi samAnA iti j~jeyam| etacca lokapuruShayoH sAmyaM puruShavicaye vyaktaM bhaviShyati| etacca lokapuruShayoH sAmyakathanaM mumukShUNAmevopayuktamiti darshayannAha- budhAstvevamityAdi| budhAH samyagj~jAnavantaH, mokShayuktA iti yAvat| lokapuruShasAmyakathanaM ca mokShArthameveti puruShavicaye svayameva vakShyati||13||

evamasyendriyANya~ggAvayavAshca yaugapadyenAbhinirvartante~anyatra tebhyo bhAvebhyo ye~asya jAtasyottarakAlaM jAyante; tadyathA- dantA vya~jjanAni vyaktIbhAvastathAyuktAni cAparANi| eShA prakRutiH, vikRutiH punarato~anyathA| santi khalvasmin garbhe kecinnityA bhAvAH, santi cAnityAH kecit| tasya ya evA~ggAvayavAH santiShThante, ta eva strIli~ggaM puruShali~ggaM napuMsakali~ggaM vA bibhrati| tatra strIpuruShayorye vaisheShikA bhAvAH pradhAnasaMshrayA guNasaMshrayAshca, teShAM yato bhUyastvaM tato~anyatarabhAvaH| tadyathA- klaibyaM bhIrutvamavaishAradyaM moho~anavasthAnamadhogurutvamasahanaM shaithilyaM mArdavaM garbhAshayabIjabhAgastathAyuktAni cAparANi strIkarANi, ato viparItAni puruShakarANi, ubhayabhAgAvayavA napuMsakakarANi bhavanti||14||

Commentary: prakRutAM tRutIyamAsabhavAmindriyAdya~ggAbhinirvRuttimupasaMharati- evamasyetyAdi| yugapadeva yaugapadyaM; yaugapadyamityabhidhAnamindriyANAmapi sarvA~ggAbhinirvRutteH samakAlatopadarshanArtham| kiM dantAdayo~api tRutIyamAse bhavantItyAsha~gkyAha- anyatretyAdi| vya~jjanAni shmashrustanAdIni| vyaktIbhAvaH shukrarajasorAvirbhAvaH| tathAyuktAnIti jAtottarakAlajatvena dantAdisadRushAni cA~ggAni buddhyAdIni | eShA prakRutiriti indriyANya~ggAvayavAshca yugapadbhavanti, dantAdayashca jAtasyApi cireNa bhavantItyevaMrUpo manuShyasvabhAva ityarthaH| anyatheti kadAcit sadanta eva jAyata ityAdikA vikRutirmanuShyasya| atha kasmAddantAdayo garbhAdijAyamAnA vikRutitvenocyanta ityAha- santItyAdi| khalushabdo hetau| nityA iti yAvaccharIrabhAvinaH karacaraNAdayaH, anityAshca na yAvaccharIrabhAvino dantAdayaH| etena, anityasvabhAvAnAM dantAdInAM garbhAdyajAyamAnatvAnnityatvaM vikRutiriti yuktamityarthaH| atha nityAnityeShu madhye ke stryAdili~ggaM bibhratItyAha- tasyetyAdi| santiShThanta iti yAvaccharIraM tiShThanti| etena, ya eva nityA upasthAdayasta eva strIli~ggatAM puMli~ggatAM vA bibhrati| tatropastharUpo nityo bhAvaH strIli~ggaM, shephashca puMli~ggam, upasthali~ggAkAravirahitaM ca randhramAtraM napuMsakali~ggaM bhavati| kiMvA, striyA yalli~ggaM stanAdi, puruShasya vA shmashruprabhRuti, napuMsakasya vA strIpuMsamAnAkArarUpaM jAtottarakAlabhAvi, tadapi ya eva nityA bhAvA uraHkapolaprabhRutayasta eva kAlavashAdbibhratIti vAkyArthaH| ura eva hi stanArambhakabIjayuktaM striyA uttarakAlaM stanavadbhavati, evaM kapola eva shmashrubIjayuktaH shmashruvAn bhavati| na cAvashyaM yat stanashmashruprabhRutInAM bIjaM cedasti sharIre, tat kimiti garbhAt prabhRuti stanAdi na jAyata iti; yato bIjamahimA~ayaM- yat svakAla eva kAryaM karoti| yathA- avanipatitamapi shAlyAdibIjamRutuprAptAvevA~gkuraM janayati; na ca svabhAva upAlambhamarhati| ‘yadaivA~ggAvayayavAH santiShThante, tadaiva stryAdili~ggaM bibhrati’ ityAdipAThapakShe tu vyakta evArthaH| atha kutaH samAne shukrAdau kAraNe stryAdivisheSho bhavatItyAha- vaisheShikA iti| vaisheShikA vishiShTAH parasparavyAvRuttA iti yAvat| pradhAnasaMshrayA iti AtmasaMshrayAH| guNasaMshrayA iti shukrashoNitagatabhUtasaMshrayAH; guNashabdeneha bhUtAnyucyante| yata iti saptamyAM tasiH; tena yasmin vaisheShike bhAve bhUyastvaM daivavashAdbhavati, tato bhAvAdanyatarasya strIrUpasya puMrUpasya vA garbhasyotpattirbhavati; yadi strIkarA bhAvA klaibyAdayo bhUyAMso bhavanti tadA strI jAyate, viparyaye pumAnityarthaH| tatra strIkarAn bhAvAnAha- tadyathetyAdi| avaishAradyaM mohaH| shaithilyam anibiDasaMyogatA, yathA- dRuDhashaNatantuviralavApitapaTasya shaithilyaM; mArdavaM tu nibiDasaMyogasyApi sahajAvayavamArdavaM, yathA- paTTasUtre nirantaravApitapaTasya mRudutvam| klaibyAdyanavasthAnaparyantaM pradhAnasaMshrayaM, sheShaM guNasaMshrayam| tathAyuktAnItyanena yonibIjabhAgAdIni grAhayati| ete cAdhogurutvAdayo rajodhika eva bIje bhavantIti j~jeyam| tena, “raktena kanyAmadhikena” (shA. 2) iti yaduktaM tadanena samaM na viruddhaM bhavati| viparItAni aklaibyAdInItyarthaH| ubhayabhAgAvayavA iti strIpuruShakArakA avayavAH| napuMsakakarANIti napuMsakanirdesho~avyaktaguNAbhiprAyeNa| tena prathamaM napuMsakakarANIti avyaktaguNasandohAbhiprAyeNa prayuktaM, tataH kAni tAnItyapekShAyAM visheShaparigrahAdubhayabhAgAvayavA iti puMli~ggena nirdesho j~jeyaH|||14||

tasya yatkAlamevendriyANi santiShThante, tatkAlameva cetasi vedanA nirbandhaM prApnoti; tasmAttadA prabhRuti garbhaH spandate, prArthayate ca janmAntarAnubhUtaM yat ki~jcit, taddvaihRudayyamAcakShate vRuddhAH| mAtRujaM cAsya hRudayaM mAtRuhRudayenAbhisambaddhaM bhavati rasavAhinIbhiH saMvAhinIbhiH; tasmAttayostAbhirbhaktiH saMspandate | taccaiva kAraNamavekShamANA na dvaihRudayyasya vimAnitaM garbhamicchanti kartum| vimAnane hyasya dRushyate vinAsho vikRutirvA| samAnayogakShemA hi tadA bhavati garbheNa keShucidartheShu mAtA| tasmAt priyahitAbhyAM garbhiNIM visheSheNopacaranti kushalAH||15||

Commentary: santiShThanta iti abhinirvartante| vedanA sukhaduHkhopalabdhiH| nirbandhaM prApnotIti sambandhaM prApnoti, indriyotpAdasamakAlameva sukhaduHkhaj~jo bhavatIti vAkyArthaH| tasmAditi sukhaduHkhasambandhAt; sukhotpAdanArthaM duHkhaparihArArthaM ca spandate calati, tathA prArthayate ca sukhahetUn janmAntarAnubhUtAnityarthaH| tadgarbhaprArthanAyuktaM mAtRuhRudayaM dvaihRudayyamiti vRuddhA j~jAnavRuddhA AcakShate| dvihRudayasya bhAvad dvaihRudayyaM mAtRuhRudayaM garbhahRudayena samaM hRudayadvayaM bhavati| nanu garbhahRudayaM kathaM mAtRuhRudayena sambaddhaM bhavatItyAha- mAtRujamiti; mAtRukAraNakArtavajam| rasavAhinIbhiriti garbhapoShaNArthAbhirmAtRuhRudayagarbhanAbhipratibaddhAbhI rasavAhinIbhiH| etena, yad garbhaH prArthayate, tayA prArthanayA rasavAhinIbhirhRudayamAgatayA mAtA~api tatprArthanAvatI bhavati evaM mAtRuprArthanayA~api garbhaH prArthanAvAn bhavati| tayoriti mAtRugarbhayoH| bhaktiH icchA| tAbhiriti rasavAhinIbhiH| saMspandata iti mAtRuhRudayAdgarbhahRudayaM yAti, garbhahRudayAcca mAtRuhRudayamityarthaH| garbhasya vinAsho vikRutirveti mahatA icchAvighAtena vinAshaH, svalpena tu vikRutiH; kiMvA garbhecchApUrvikA mAturicchA, tadvighAtena vinAsho garbhasya, sA hIcchA vihatA sAkShAdgarbhasambandhitayA sukumArataraM garbhaM vAtaprakopAdvinAshayati; yA tu mAturicchA vihatA, sA mAtari vAtakShobhaM janayatI samAnayogakSheme garbhe~api manAgvikRutijananAdvikRutiM janayati| etadeva darshayati- samAnayogakShemA hItyAdi|- yogaH sukhahetuyogaH, kShemaH pratyavAyaparihAraH, etau yogakShemau mAturgarbheNa samAnau bhavataH| keShucidartheShvitivacanAdatulyayogakShematA ca kvacidbhavatIti darshayati| tena, nAvashyaM mAturvikArAH kShudAdayo garbhe vikRutimAvahanti, garbhasya vA mAtarIti darshayati| garbhiNI visheSheNetivacanAdagarbhiNyapi strI RutukAle priyahitopacaraNIyA| yaduktaM- “sahacaryashcainAM priyahitAbhyAM satatamupacareyuH” (shA. 8) ityAdi||15||

tasyA garbhApatterdvaihRudayyasya ca vij~jAnArthaM li~ggAni samAsenopadekShyAmaH| upacArasAdhanaM hyasya j~jAne, j~jAnaM ca li~ggataH, tasmAdiShTo li~ggopadeshaH| tadyathA- ArtavAdarshanamAsyasaMsravaNamanannAbhilAShashchardirarocako~amlakAmatA ca visheSheNa shraddhApraNayanamuccAvaceShu bhAveShu gurugAtratvaM cakShuShorglAniH stanayoH stanyamoShThayoH stanamaNDalayoshca kArShNyamatyarthaM shvayathuH pAdayorIShallomarAjyudgamo yonyAshcATAlatvamiti garbhe paryAgate rUpANi bhavanti||16||

Commentary: upacArasAdhanaM yathocitopacArakaraNam| asyeti gRuhItasya garbhasya tathA dvaihRudayyasya ca| tatra gRuhItagarbhopacAro yathA- “sha~gkitA cedgarbhamApannA kShIramanupaskRutaM kAle kAle pibet” (shA.a.8) ityAdi dvihRudayopacAraM cAtraiva vakShyati| j~jAnamiti garbhasya dvihRudayasya ca j~jAnam| amlakAmatA visheSheNeti cchedaH| shraddhA icchA| uccAvaceShviti uccanIceShu, bhakShaNIyatvena kRuteShu cAkRuteShu cetyarthaH| IShat pAdayoH shvayathuH| cATAlatvaM vivRutatvam| etAni ca lakShaNAni svarUpeNa garbhasya bhavanti, tRutIyamAsayuktAni tu dvaihRudayyasya ca li~ggAni bhavantIti j~jeyam||16||
sA yadyadicchettattadasyai dadyAdanyatra garbhopaghAtakarebhyo bhAvebhyaH||17||

garbhopaghAtakarAstvime bhAvA bhavantiH; tadyathA- sarvamatigurUShNatIkShNaM dAruNAshca ceShTAH; imAMshcAnyAnupadishanti vRuddhAH- devatArakSho~anucaraparirakShaNArthaM na raktAni vAsAMsi bibhRuyAnna madakarANi madyAnyabhyavaharenna yAnamadhirohenna mAMsamashnIyAt sarvendriyapratikUlAMshca bhAvAn dUrataH parivarjayet, yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit striyo vidyuH||18||

yatashca garbhaH sambhavati, yasmiMshca garbhasa~jj~jA, yadvikArashca garbhaH, yayA cAnupUrvyA~abhinirvartate kukShau, yashcAsya vRuddhihetuH, yatashcAsyAjanma bhavati, yatashca jAyamAnaH kukShau vinAshaM prApnoti, yatashca kArtsnyenAvinashyan vikRutimApadyate, tadanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||3||

Commentary: yata iti yataH kAraNAt| yadvikAra iti yanmaya ityarthaH| yayA~a~anupUrvyA yenAnukrameNetyarthaH| kArtsnyenAvinashyanniti maraNamagacchan||3||

tIvrAyAM tu khalu prArthanAyAM kAmamahitamapyasyai hitenopahitaM dadyAt prArthanAvinayanArtham| prArthanAsandhAraNAddhi vAyuH prakupito~antaHsharIramanucaran garbhasyApadyamAnasya vinAshaM vairUpyaM vA kuryAt||19||

Commentary: prArthanA IpsitArthayA~jcA, tasyAstu tIvratvaM balavadicchAjanyatvameva| hitopahitamiti hitena yuktaM, kiMvA kalpanayA hitam| prArthanAyA vinayanaM visphoTanaM, tadartham| prArthanA ca prArthitalAbhenaivApayAti| prArthanAvimAnane doShamAha- prArthanetyAdi| prArthanAyAH samyagdhAraNaM prArthanAsandhAraNam| etacca stokakrameNApi prArthitAdAne sati bhavati, yathoktavidhinA vA hitAdAne sati icchA manAk samagrA vA khaNDitA bhavati| icchAvighAtashca manaHkShobhakarabhayAdivadvAtaprakopako bhavati| ApadyamAnasyetyanena garbhasyAtitaruNatvena manAgapi vAtakShobhAsahatvaM darshayati| vairUpyavinAshavikalpastu vAtaprakopaprakarShApakarShakRuto j~jeyaH||19||

caturthe mAsi sthiratvamApadyate garbhaH, tasmAttadA garbhiNI gurugAtratvamadhikamApadyate visheSheNa||20||

Commentary: tRutIyamAsAnupUrvIkathanaprastAvAgataM garbhasya visheShamabhidhAya kramAgatAM caturthamAsAnupUrvImAha- caturtha ityAdi| sthiratvamiti nibiDatvam| ata eva nibiDena gurutareNa garbheNAkrAntA garbhiNI gurugAtrA bhavatIti yuktam||20||

pa~jcame mAsi garbhasya mAMsashoNitopacayo bhavatyadhikamanyebhyo mAsebhyaH, tasmAttadA garbhiNI kArshyamApadyate visheSheNa||21||

Commentary: adhikamanyebhya ityanena mAsAntareShvapi stokakrameNa mAMsAdivRuddhiM darshayati| yena shArIreNa bhAvena garbha upacIyate, tena garbhiNI hIyata iti yuktameva| yato garbhamAMsAdipoShaNenaiva kShINa AhAraraso na mAturmAMsAdi samyak poShayati||21||

ShaShThe mAsi garbhasya balavarNopacayo bhavatyadhikamanyebhyo mAsebhyaH, tasmAttadA garbhiNI balavarNahAnimApadyate visheSheNa||22||

Commentary: balavarNayorupacayo balavarNopacayaH; kiMvA, upacayo dhAtupuShTiH||22||

saptame mAsi garbhaH sarvairbhAvairApyAyyate, tasmAttadA garbhiNI sarvAkAraiH klAntatamA bhavati||23||

Commentary: sarvabhAvairiti mAMsashoNitAdibhiH| yugapadeva sarvaiH saptame garbha ApyAyyate, pUrveShu tu mAseShu na sarvairyugapaditi visheShaH| sarvAkArairiti sarvamAMsashoNitAdijanyarUpaiH| klAntatameti hInatamA||23||

aShTame mAsi garbhashca mAtRuto garbhatashca mAtA rasahAriNIbhiH saMvAhinIbhirmuhurmuhurojaH parasparata AdadAte garbhasyAsampUrNatvAt | tasmAttadA garbhiNImuhurmahurmudA yuktA bhavati muhurmuhushca mlAnA, tathA garbhaH; tasmAttadA garbhasya janma vyApattimadbhavatyojaso~anavasthitatvAt | taM caivArthamabhisamIkShyAShTamaM mAsamagaNyamityAcakShate kushalAH||24||

Commentary: aShTama ityAdi| rasavAhinIbhiriti mAtRuhRudaye garbhanADyAM ca sambaddhAbhI rasavAhinIbhiH| parasparata oja AdadAte iti mAturojo garbha Adatte, garbhasya caujo mAtA Adatte| ojo~anavasthAne hetumAha- garbhasyAsampUrNatvAditi| yasmAdgarbho~asampUrNaH, tasmAdaniShpannAshrayaM garbhaujo~anavasthitaM bhavati| mAturojo garbhaM gacchatIti yaducyate, tadgarbhauja eva mAtRusambaddhaM sanmAtroja iti vyapadishyate; yadi tu mAtureva yadojastadgarbhaM gacchatItyarthaH syAt, tadA garbhasyAsampUrNatvAditi hetuH sampUrNamAtRudehasthitasyaujaso gamane~asa~ggataH syAt; tathA, yathA garbhaujaso mAtaryavasthAnasamaye janma garbhamaraNakaraM bhavati, tathA mAturojaso garbhovasthAne sati yadgarbhajanma, tatra mAturapi maraNaM syAt; na caitadiShTaM, yenobhayathA~api garbhasyaivAtra maraNamucyate na mAtuH, ‘tadA garbhasya janma vyApattimadbhavati’ itivacanena| jatUkarNe~apyaShTame janma garbhavinAshAyaiva darshitam| yaduktaM- “strIgarbhAvanyonyasya oja AdadAte~aShTame, tasmAttadA prasUtirgarbhavinAshAyaiva” iti| anye tu varNayanti- yata- “satyapi mAturojaso garbhagamane janmAdRuShTavashAdeva garbhasyaiva maraNAya bhavati, na mAtuH” iti| sushrutavyAkhyAtArastu- “aShTamamAse nairRutabhAgatvAcca garbhasya satyapyojo~anavasthAne tulye garbhasyaiva nAsho na mAtuH” iti varNayanti| garbhiNI muhurmuhurmudA yuktA bhavatIti garbhaujoyogAddharShayuktA bhavati, ojovigamanAttu muhurmuhurglAnA bhavatIti yojyam| tathA garbha iti garbhiNIvadgarbho~api muhurmuhurmudAyuyukto bhavati, muhurmuhurglAno bhavati| tasmAditi pUrvoktaM garbhavyApattihetuM sAkShAdbrUte| ojaso~anavasthitatvAditi etacca vyAkRutameva| aShTamamAsasya visheShAntaramAha- taM caivetyAdi| taM caivArthamiti garbhavyApattirUpamartham| agaNyamiti na gaNanayA garbhiNyAM pratipAdanIyam| yadi hi garbhiNI gaNyamAnamaShTamaM mAsaM garbhajanmavyApattikaraM shRuNuyAt tato bhItA syAt, tadbhayAcca garbhasya vAtakShobhAd vyApat syAditi bhAvaH||24||

tasminnekadivasAtikrAnte~api navamaM mAsamupAdAya prasavakAlamityAhurAdashamAnmAsAt| etAvAn prasavakAlaH, vaikArikamataH paraM kukShAvavasthAnaM garbhasya||25||

Commentary: tasminniti aShTame mAsi| AdashamAditi vacanaM prashastataraprasavakAlAbhiprAyeNa| sushrute dvAdashamAsaparyantaM samyakprasavakAlAbhidhAnaM stokadoShayorekAdashadvAdashamAsayoralpadoShatvenAdoShapakSha eva nikShepAd boddhavyam||25||

evamanayA~a~anupUrvyA~abhinirvartate kukShau||26||

Commentary: dattamuttaramupasaMharati- evamityAdi||26||

mAtRutaH pitRuta AtmataH sAtmyato rasataH sattvata ityetebhyo bhAvebhyaH samuditebhyo garbhaH sambhavati| tasya ye ye~avayavA yato yataH sambhavataH sambhavanti tAn vibhajya mAtRujAdInavayavAn pRuthak pRuthaguktamagre||4||

Commentary: ye ye bhAvA mAtRujapitRujaprabhRutayastvaglohitAdayaH, yato yato mAtrAdeH sambhavanti, tAn mAtRujAdInavayavAn pRuthagvibhajya, agre pUrvAdhyAye; tenAtra mAtRujAdayo noktA iti vAkyArthaH phalati| ayaM cArtho yadyapi pUrvAdhyAya evokto “mAtRujashcAyaM” (shA. 3) ityAdinA, tathA~api prashnakramavishuddhyanurodhAt punariha kRutaH; yena prathamaM kAraNaM, tadanu kAryarUpo garbhaH, tadanu garbhadharmo~abhidheya iti krameNa prashnaH shobhate||4||

shukrashoNitajIvasaMyoge tu khalu kukShigate garbhasa~jj~jA bhavati||5||

Commentary: yattu “shukrashoNitasaMsargamantargarbhAshayagataM” ityAdinA, “garbho~abhinirvartate” (shA.a.3) ityantenoktaM, tatrAyamasau garbhashabdAbhidheyo~artha iti nAbhihitam, apekShate ca; teneha garbhasa~jj~jAbhidheyArthavyAkaraNamapunaruktameva| kukShigate iti kukShyekadeshagatagarbhAshayagate| saMyoge iti samyagyoge; tena jIvasyAtivAhikasharIreNa yogaH sa~ggRuhyate, na cAtmano vyApakatvena yo yogo garbhajanakaH| evambhUtashca saMyogo yadyapi kukShAveva bhavati, tathA~api siddhamevArthaM shiShyaM pratipAdayituM “kukShigate” iti padaM kRutam||5||

garbhastu khalvantarikShavAyvagnitoyabhUmivikArashcetanAdhiShThAnabhUtaH| evamanayA yuktyA pa~jcamahAbhUtavikArasamudAyAtmako garbhashcetanAdhiShThAnabhUtaH; sa hyasya ShaShTho dhAturuktaH||6||

Commentary: garbhastvityAdi| garbhArambhakANyapi bhUmyAdIni parityajyAntarikShamAdau kRutaM, vakShyamANabhUtagrahaNAnurodhAt| vakShyati hi- ‘antarikShaM pUrvamanyebhyo guNebhya upAdatte’ ityAdi| cetanAdhiShThAnabhUta iti Atmano bhogAyatanasvarUpa ityarthaH, cetanAshabdena hyAtmocyate; kiMvA, bhUtashabdaH sAdRushye; tenAdhiShThAnamivAtmanaH sharIraM, na tu paramArthato nirAshrayasyAtmano bhogAyatanatvavyatirekeNa sharIramAshrayo bhavati| anayA yuktyeti anayA bhUtavikArarUpayA yojanayA pa~jcamahAbhUtavikArasamudAyAtmako bhavati, anyayA yuktyA katidhApuruShIyoktashcaturviMshatiko bhavati, tathA mAtRujAdirUpacintayA mAtrAdisamudAyAtmako bhavatItyarthaH| na caiteShAM pakShANAM virodho~asti; yato mAtRujAdivyapadeshe~api pa~jcamahAbhUtavikAratvamaviruddhameva, yena mAtRujAdayo~apyasya mahAbhUtavikArA eva; uktaM hi- “rasAtmamAtApitRusambhavAni bhUtAni vidyAddasha ShaT ca dehe” (shA. 2) iti; caturviMshatikatve~api ca pa~jcamahAbhUtAtmakarUpataiva tatra prapa~jcitA| sa hItyAdi| asyeti garbhasya||6||

yayA cAnupUrvyA~abhinirvartate kukShau tAM vyAkhyAsyAmaH- gate purANe rajasi nave cAvasthite shuddhasnAtAM striyamavyApannayonishoNitagarbhAshayAmRutumatImAcakShmahe| tayA saha tathAbhUtayA yadA pumAnavyApannabIjo mishrIbhAvaM gacchati, tadA tasya harShodIritaH paraH sharIradhAtvAtmA shukrabhUto~a~ggAda~ggAt sambhavati| sa tathA harShabhUtenAtmanodIritashcAdhiShThitashca bIjarUpo dhAtuH puruShasharIrAdabhiniShpattyocitena pathA garbhAshayamanupravishyArtavenAbhisaMsargameti||7||
