Commentary: gata iti nivRutte | purANa iti RutukAlAtikramasa~jcite| nave cAvasthita itivacanena nave~apyanavasthite garbhakAraNatvaM nAstIti darshayati| shuddhasnAtAmityanena shuddhasnAtaiva strI gamyA nAsnAtA, ashuddhatvAditi darshayati| styAyatyasyAM garbha iti strI; anena vandhyAM nirasyati| RutumatImityatra prashaMsAyAM matup| tayA saheti tayA striyA| tathAbhUtayeti tAdRugRutuyuktayA| harShaH prItivisheShaH, tenodIritaH preritaH| para iti sAraH; kiMvA parakAlotpannaH paraH, shukraM hi sarvadhAtubhyaH paramutpadyate | sharIradhAtvAtmeti sharIradhAturUpaH| shukrabhUta iti shukrarUpa evA~ggAda~ggAt sambhavati vyajyate| tena nA~ggebhyaH shukramutpadyate, kintu shukrarUpatayaiva sthitaM vyajyate| vacanaM hi- “sarvatrAnugataM dehe shukraM” (ci. a. 2pA. 4) iti| harShabhUteneti harShamayatAM gatena; udIritashcAdhiShThitashcetyanena udIraNakAle tathA niHsaraNakAle harShamayAtmAdhiShThAnaM shukrasya garbhAshayaprAptikAraNaM darshayati; yadi shukrapravRuttikAle puruSho harSharahitaH syAnna tadA samyak shukrapravRuttiH, tathA vegavighAtAnna garbhAshayaprAptirbhavati| bIjarUpo dhAtuH shukram| abhisaMsargAM samya~gmUrcchanam||7||

tatra pUrvaM cetanAdhAtuH sattvakaraNo guNagrahaNAya pravartate; sa hi hetuH kAraNaM nimittamakSharaM kartA mantA veditA boddhA draShTA dhAtA brahmA vishvakarmA vishvarUpaH puruShaH prabhavo~avyayo nityo guNI grahaNaM pradhAnamavyaktaM jIvo j~jaH pudgalashcetanAvAn vibhurbhUtAtmA cendriyAtmA cAntarAtmA ceti| sa guNopAdAnakAle~antarikShaM pUrvataramanyebhyo guNebhya upAdatte, yathA- pralayAtyaye sisRukShurbhUtAnyakSharabhUta AtmA sattvopAdAnaH pUrvataramAkAshaM sRujati, tataH krameNa vyaktataraguNAn dhAtUn vAyvAdikAMshcaturaH; tathA dehagrahaNe~api pravartamAnaH pUrvataramAkAshamevopAdatte, tataH krameNa vyaktataraguNAn dhAtUn vAyvAdikAMshcaturaH| sarvamapi tu khalvetadguNopAdAnamaNunA kAlena bhavati||8||

Commentary: sattvaM manaH karaNaM yasya sa sattvakaraNaH; AtmA niShkriyatvena kriyAvatA manasA yat kAryaM karoti, tacca kAryaM manasA kriyamANamapyacetanena cetanAvata Atmana evocyate| vacanaM hi- “cetanAvAn yatashcAtmA tataH kartA nirucyate” (shA. 1) iti| guNagrahaNAyetyatra guNashabdena guNaguNinorabhedopacArAdguNavanti bhUtAnyucyante| kiMvA, guNo~apradhAnaM, pradhAnaM cAtmA, tadvyatiriktAni ca bhUtAni guNAH| kasmAdAtmA bhUtAni gRuhNAtyapradhAnarUpANItyAsha~gkAyAmAtmanaH prAdhAnyakhyApakAn paryAyAnAha- sa hItyAdi| na kSharatItyakSharam| guNI bhUtarUpaguNavAnityarthaH| gRuhNAti bhUtAnIti grahaNam| etaiH paryAyairAtmano~abhidheyasyetarapadArthopakAryatvenAshrayatvaM prasiddhaM darshyate| pUrvataraM prathamameva| anyebhyo guNebhya iti vAyvAdibhyaH| atra garbhe bhUtagrahaNakrame dRuShTAntamAha- yathetyAdi| pralayasya mahApralayasya, atyaye iti Adisarga ityarthaH| sisRukShuriti sraShTumicchuH| bhUtAni AkAshAdIni| sattvopAdAna iti manaHkaraNaH| mahApralaye hi vikArasya prakRutau layAt prakRutipuruShAveva paramavyaktarUpau tiShThataH, tatashca sargArambhe prakRutermahadAdiprapa~jca utpadyate krameNa; tatra prathamamAkAshamutpadyate, tato vAyvAdIni vyaktAnIti sA~gkhyasiddhAntaH| AkAshasya ca janyatvaM sA~gkhyamatenaiva j~jeyam| dehagrahaNe~apIti garbhasvarUpagrahaNe~api| upAdatta iti shukrashoNitagatamAkAshamAkAshamayatayA svIkaroti| vyaktataraguNAniti AkAshamekaguNamapekShya shabdasparshaguNo vAyurvyaktataraH , tamapekShya shabdasparsharUpaguNa tejo vyaktataramityAdi | ayaM ca bhUtagrahaNakrama Agamasiddha eva, nAtra yuktistathAvidhA hRudaya~ggamA~asti| etacca bhUtagrahaNaM laghunaiva kAlena bhavatIti darshayannAha- sarvamityAdi||8||
sa sarvaguNavAn garbhatvamApannaH prathame mAsi sammUrcchitaH sarvadhAtukaluShIkRutaH kheTabhUto bhavatyavyaktavigrahaH sadasadbhUtA~ggAvayavaH||9||
dvitIye mAsi ghanaH sampadyate piNDaH peshyarbudaM vA| tatra ghanaH puruShaH, peshI strI, arbudaM napuMsakam||10||

mAtrAdInAM khalu garbhakarANAM bhAvAnAM sampadastathA vRuttasya sauShThavAnmAtRutashcaivopasnehopasvedAbhyAM kAlapariNAmAt svabhAvasaMsiddheshca kukShau vRuddhiM prApnoti||27||

Commentary: ‘yashcAsya vRuddhihetuH’ iti prashnasyottaraM- mAtrAdInAmityAdi| AdigrahaNAt pitrAtmasAtmyarasasattvAni “mAtRujashcayaM” (shA.a.4) ityAdigranthoktAni gRuhyante| vRuttasya mAturAcArarUpasya sauShThavaM suShThutvaM vRuttasauShThavam| mAtRuta iti padaM vRuttasauShThavena tathA upasnehopasvedAbhyAM ca sambadhyate| rasasAtmyasauShThavaM tu mAtrAdisampadA labdhameva| upasneho dhAtuniShyandasambandhaH, upasvedaH sharIrasyoShmaNA paraM garbhasya svedanam; upasvedashca garbhavRuddhikaro bhavatyeva, yathA- aNDajAnAM pakShaterupasvedanaM vRuddhikaraM dRuShTam| kAlapariNAmAditi yathA yathA kAlaprakarShastathA tathA vardhate garbhaH| vRuddhihetvantaramAha- svabhAvasaMsiddheshceti| svabhAvenaiva karmajanyena garbho bhavati vardhiShNurityarthaH| karmaNA hi bhogalakShaNasharIranirvartakenArabhyamANaM garbhasharIraM vardhiShNusvabhAvamevArabdhaM, tena vardhata eva||27||

mAtrAdInAmeva tu khalu garbhakarANAM bhAvAnAM vyApattinimittamasyAjanma bhavati||28||

Commentary: ‘kutashcAsyAjanma bhavati’ ityasyottaraM- mAtretyAdi| vyApattinimittamiti vyApattikAraNakaM; tatra mAturvyApacchoNitagarbhAshayAdiduShTiH, piturvyApacchukraduShTirityAdyanusaraNIyam||28||

ye hyasya kukShau vRuddhihetusamAkhyAtA bhAvAsteShAM viparyayAdudare vinAshamApadyate, athavA~apyacirajAtaH syAt||29||

Commentary: ‘yatashca jAyamAnaH’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM- ye hyasyetyAdi| vRuddhihetusamAkhyAtA bhAvAH “mAtrAdInAM tu khalu garbhakarANAM bhAvAnAM sampadaH” ityAdigranthoktAH| athavA~apyacirajAta iti yadA mAtrAdInAM sarvathA doShavattvena viparyayo bhavati, tadA vinAshamApadyate garbhaH; yadA tvalpadoShavattayA manAgviparyayo bhavati, tadA acirajAto vipadyata iti j~jeyam ||29||

yatastu kArtsnyenAvinashyan vikRutimApadyate, tadanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- yadA striyA doShaprakopaNoktAnyAsevamAnAyA doShAH prakupitAH sharIramupasarpantaH shoNitagarbhAshayAvupapadyante , na ca kArtsnyena shoNitagarbhAshayau dUShayanti, tadeyaM garbhaM labhate strI; tadA tasya garbhasya mAtRujAnAmavayavAnAmanyatamo~avayavo vikRutimApadyata eko~athavA~aneke, yasya yasya hyavayavasya bIje bIjabhAge vA doShAH prakopamApadyante, taM tamavayavaM vikRutirAvishati| yadA hyasyAH shoNite garbhAshayabIjabhAgaH pradoShamApadyate, tadA vandhyAM janayati; yadA punarasyAH shoNite garbhAshayabIjabhAgAvayavaH pradoShamApadyate, tadA pUtiprajAM janayati; yadA tvasyAH shoNite garbhAshayabIjabhAgAvayavaH strIkarANAM ca sharIrabIjabhAgAnAmekadeshaH pradoShamApadyate, tadA stryAkRutibhUyiShThAmastriyaM vArtAM nAma janayati, tAM strIvyApadamAcakShate||30||

Commentary: avashiShTaprashnasyottaraM darshayitumAha- yatastvityAdi| atrAvinashyannityatra vinAshena vikRutirabhipretA, vikRutAvapi vinAshashabdo dRuShTaH; yathA- asacchIlatvena vikRute puruShe ‘vinaShTo~ayam’ iti vyapadeshaH; evaM ca satyekadeshenApi vikRutau vinAshashabdadarshane kArtsnyeneti visheShaNaM yuktaM bhavati| doShaprakopaNenaiva doShaprakopaNasevAyAM labdhAyAM punardoShaprakopaNoktAnyAsevamAnAyA iti padaM doShANAM svahetusevayA balavantaM prakopaM darshayituM, parahetusevayA~api hi stokamAtrayA anubandharUpadoShaprakopo bhavati; yathA- amlena pittaM janyamAnaM shleShmAnugataM janyate| ‘natu kArtsnyena dUShayanti’ iti vacanena kArtsnyena duShTau garbhajanmaiva na bhavatIti darshayati| mAtRujAnAmiti tvaglohitAdInAm| anyatama iti jAtAvekavacanam| tatraiko~apyavayavo~anyatamaH, tathA aneke~avayavA anyatamashabdena proktAH | ata eva ‘eko~athavA~aneke’ ityanyatamavivaraNamupapannaM bhavati| anyathA tvanyatamapadenaikasyaivAvayavasya gRuhItatvAt ‘aneke’ iti vivaraNamasa~ggataM syAt| kutaH punarekasyAnekasya vA vikRutirbhavatItyAha- yasyetyAdi| bIja iti kRutsna evArambhake bIje| bIjabhAge vetyavayavabIjasyaikadeshe| etAM vikRutimeva shRu~ggagrAhikatayA vaktumAha- yadetyAdi| shoNita iti Artave| garbhAshayajanako bIjabhAgo garbhAshayabIjabhAgaH; kiMvA garbhAshayasya tathA bIjasya cArtavarUpasya janako bhAgaH| garbhAshayArtave ca mAtRujAvayavamadhye patite shoNitajanye eva; tena, ArtavetarabIjabhAgasya duShTirupapannA| ArtavaM ca yadyapi dvAdashavarShAdUrdhvaM vyajyate, tathA~api ArtavotpattirgarbhakAla eva bhavati| yena satAmevArtavadantashmashruprabhRutInAM kAle vyaktirbhavati; tena, ArtavArambhakasyApi bIjasya garbhakAle pradoSha upapannaH | pradoSha ityatra prashabdena duShTiprakarShaM prakRuShTavandhyatArUpakAryajanakaM darshayati| garbhAshayasya tathA~a~artavasya copaghAtena striyA vandhyatvaM vyaktameva| garbhAshayabIjabhAgAvayava ityatrApi pUrvavadvyAkhyeyam| avayavashabdena garbhAshayasyArtavasya caikadesha ihocyate| pUtiprajAmiti mriyamANApatyAm; anye tu klinnA~ggapratya~ggAM pUtimAhuH| strIkarANAM sharIrabIjabhAgAnAmiti strItvavya~jjakastanopasthalomarAjyAdijanakabIjabhAgAnAm| astriyamiti asampUrNastrIlakShaNAm| vArtAM nAmeti vArtAsa~jj~jA shAstrasamayakRutA| strIvyApaditi strInimittA~a~artavadoShakRutA vyApat| evaM tAM puruShavyApadamAcakShate ityatrApi puruShavyApadvyAkhyeyA||30||

evameva puruShasya yadA bIje bIjabhAgaH pradoShamApadyate, tadA vandhyaM janayati; yadA punarasya bIje bIjabhAgAvayavaH pradoShamApadyate, tadA pUtiprajaM janayati; yadA tvasya bIje bIjabhAgAvayavaH puruShakarANAM ca sharIrabIjabhAgAnAmekadeshaH pradoShamApadyate, tadA puruShAkRutibhUyiShThamapuruShaM tRuNaputrikaM nAma janayati; tAM puruShavyApadamAcakShate||31||

Commentary: bIje iti shukre| shukrarUpabIjajanako bhAgo bIjabhAgaH| tadA vandhyamityanena puruShavandhyaM brUte, ihApi pradoShavyAkhyA pUtiprajAvyAkhyA ca pUrvavat| apuruShamiti asamastapuruShalakShaNayuktam| tRuNaputrikasa~jj~jA~api shAstrasamayasiddhaiva| vArtAtRuNaputrikayorvyavAyecchA paraM bhavati, natu vyavAyasAmarthyamiti bruvate||31||

etena mAtRujAnAM pitRujAnAM cAvayavAnAM vikRutivyAkhyAnena sAtmyajAnAM rasajAnAM sattvajAnAM cAvayavAnAM vikRutirvyAkhyAtA bhavati||32||

Commentary: evaM mAtApitRujAvayavaikadeshavikRutivat sAtmyarasasattvajAvayavavikRutyatideshArthamAha- etenetyAdi| sAtmyavibhramAttu sAtmyajAnAmArogyAnAlasyAdInAmanyatamena hIyate| evaM rasasattvayorapyunneyam||32||

nirvikAraH parastvAtmA sarvabhUtAnAM nirvisheShaH; sattvasharIrayostu visheShAdvisheShopalabdhiH||33||

Commentary: Atmajo~apyayaM garbha uktaH, tat kathamiha tadvikRutyA vikRutirgarbhasya nocyata ityAha- nirvikAra ityAdi| para ityanena manaHsharIrAdisamudAyAdAtmAnaM vyavacchinatti| sarvabhUtAnAM nirvisheSha iti sarveShu bhUteShu vartamAno~apyayaM paramAtmA tulya eva| yastu tatra sukhaduHkhAdivisheSha upalabhyate, sa sharIravisheShasya tathA manovisheShasya ca sukhaduHkhAdivisheShakAraNasya visheShAdupalabhyate; etadeva ‘sharIrasattvayostu’ ityAdinoktam| sukhAdayastu na paramAtmavikArAH, kintu buddhidharmA eveti darshitameva| yAni cAtmajatvena garbhe “tAsu tAsu yoniShUtpattiH” (shA. 3) ityAdinA granthena darshitAni, tAnyapi paramAtmavikArA na bhavanti, kintu sattvarajastamaHprabalatArUpavikArajamanovikArajanyadharmAdharmajanyAnyeva| tena, sUkShmacintAyAmAtmajAni yAnyuktAni, tAnyapi sattvajAnyeva| tatashcehAtmajAvayavavikAro~api sattvajAvayavavikAra eva boddhavya iti bhAvaH||33||

tatra trayaH sharIradoShA vAtapittashleShmANaH, te sharIraM dUShayanti; dvau punaH sattvadoShau rajastamashca, tau sattvaM dUShayataH| tAbhyAM ca sattvasharIrAbhyAM duShTAbhyAM vikRutirupajAyate, nopajAyate cApraduShTAbhyAm||34||

Commentary: ‘sharIrasattvayostu’ ityAdinA sharIramanasI duHkharUpavikAre~api kAraNamukte; tatraiva ca yairdoShaiH sharIraM, manashca yAbhyAM doShAbhyAM yuktaM duHkhakAraNaM bhavati, tAnAha- tatra traya ityAdi| vikRutirupajAyata iti shArIramAnasarogarUpA vikRutirupajAyate||34||

tatra sharIraM yonivisheShAccaturvidhamuktamagre||35||

Commentary: samprati, sharIrasattvayostu visheShAdityanena darshitA~j sharIrasattvavisheShAnevAha- tatretyAdi| caturvidhamiti jarAyujANDajodbhijjasaMsvedajam| agre iti khuDDikAyAm||35||

trividhaM khalu sattvaM- shuddhaM, rAjasaM, tAmasamiti| tatra shuddhamadoShamAkhyAtaM kalyANAMshatvAt, rAjasaM sadoShamAkhyAtaM roShAMshatvAt, tAmasamapi sadoShamAkhyAtaM mohAMshatvAt| teShAM tu trayANAmapi sattvAnAmekaikasya bhedAgramaparisa~gkhyeyaM taratamayogAccharIrayonivisheShebhyashcAnyonyAnuvidhAnatvAcca| sharIraM hyapi sattvamanuvidhIyate, sattvaM ca sharIram| tasmAt katicitsattvabhedAnanUkAbhinirdeshena nidarshanArthamanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||36||

Commentary: kalyANAMshatvAditi shubharUpAMshatvAt | mano hi kalyANabhAga-roShabhAga-mohabhAgaistribhAgaM; tatra roShAMshamohAMshau sadoShau, adharmahetutayA| bhedAgramiti bhedapramANam| taratamayogAditi shucitara-shucitamamanobhedayogAt| sharIravisheShA bAla-yuva-sthavirAdivisheShAH, yonivisheShAstu manuShyapashvAdijAtivisheShAH; kiMvA, sharIrasya narapashvAdijAtikRutA visheShAH sharIrayonivisheShAH, tebhyaH| atha sharIrabhedAt kathaM manobhedo bhavatItyAha- anyonyAnuvidhAnAcca| etadeva vibhajate- sharIraM hyapItyAdi| sattvAnurUpaM sharIraM bhavati, yadi shuddhasattvaM bhavati tadA devAdisharIraM bhavatItyAdi; tathA sharIrAnurUpaM ca sattvaM bhavati; yathA- pashusharIre tAmasaM, manuShyasharIre rAjasaM, devasharIre sAttvikamityAdi j~jeyam| kiMvA, anyonyAnuvidhAnAditi sattvarajastamasAM parasparAnuvidhAnAdityarthaH| asmin pakShe ‘sharIraM hyapi sattvamanuvidhIyate’ ityAdinA granthena vyavahitamapi sharIrAnuvidhAnaM manaso durbodhatvAd vyAkriyata iti vyAkhyeyam| sattvabhedAniti manobhedAn| anUkAbhinirdeshena sAdRushyanirdeshena||36||

tadyathA- shuciM satyAbhisandhaM jitAtmAnaM saMvibhAginaM j~jAnavij~jAnavacanaprativacanasampannaM smRutimantaM kAmakrodhalobhamAnamoherShyAharShAmarShApetaM samaM sarvabhUteShu brAhmaM vidyAt (1)| ijyAdhyayanavratahomabrahmacaryaparamatithivratamupashAntamadamAnarAgadveShamohalobharoShaM pratibhAvacanavij~jAnopadhAraNashaktisampannamArShaM vidyAt (2)| aishvaryavantamAdeyavAkyaM yajvAnaM shUramojasvinaM tejasopetamakliShTakarmANaM dIrghadarshinaM dharmArthakAmAbhiratamaindraM vidyAt (3)| lekhAsthavRuttaM prAptakAriNamasamprahAryamutthAnavantaM smRutimantamaishvaryalambhinaM vyapagatarAgerShyAdveShamohaM yAmyaM vidyAt (4)| shUraM dhIraM shucimashucidveShiNaM yajvAnamambhovihAraratimakliShTakarmANaM sthAnakopaprasAdaM vAruNaM vidyAt (5)| sthAnamAnopabhogaparivArasampannaM dharmArthakAmanityaM shuciM sukhavihAraM vyaktakopaprasAdaM kauberaM vidyAt (6)| priyanRutyagItavAditrollApakashlokAkhyAyiketihAsapurANeShu kushalaM gandhamAlyAnulepanavasanastrIvihArakAmanityamanasUyakaM gAndharvaM vidyAt (7)| ityevaM shuddhasya sattvasya saptavidhaM bhedAMshaM vidyAt kalyANAMshatvAt; tatsaMyogAttu brAhmamatyantashuddhaM vyavasyet||37||

Commentary: saMvibhAginamiti samyakphalavibhajanashIlam| atithau yathocitamarghyAdiyuktaM vratamAcaratIti atithivrataH| lekhA kartavyAkartavyamaryAdA, tatra sthitaM vRuttaM yasya sa lekhAsthavRuttaH, tam; ala~gghitakartavyAkartavyamityarthaH| asamprahAryamiti ashakyavAraNam| aishvaryaM labhata iti aishvaryalambhI| sthAne ucite kopaH prasAdashca yasya sa sthAnakopaprasAdaH| sukhavihAramiti sukhakrIDanam| ullApaH stotram| vihAraH krIDA, kiMvA strIbhiH samaM viharaNaM strIvihAraH| gAndharvamiti gAndharvasattvam| evaM brAhmamityAdAvapi j~jeyam| evaM ca brAhmAdibhiH sattvavAcakaiH padairevaMshabdapratyavamRuShTaiH sattvasya saptavidhabhedakathanaM samAnakAraNAdupapannaM bhavati| shuddhasyeti sattvaguNabahulasya| atha kathamete brAhmAdayaH shuddhasattvasyaiva bhedA ityAha- kalyANAMshatvAditi| tatsaMyogAditi kalyANAMshasattvasya samyagyogAt||37||

shUraM caNDamasUyakamaishvaryavantamaupadhikaM raudramananukroshamAtmapUjakamAsuraM vidyAt (1)| amarShiNamanubandhakopaM chidraprahAriNaM krUramAhArAtimAtrarucimAmiShapriyatamaM svapnAyAsabahulamIrShyuM rAkShasaM vidyAt (2)| mahAshanaM straiNaM strIrahaskAmamashuciM shucidveShiNaM bhIruM bhIShayitAraM vikRutavihArAhArashIlaM paishAcaM vidyAt (3)| kruddhashUramakruddhabhIruM tIkShNamAyAsabahulaM santrastagocaramAhAravihAraparaM sArpaM vidyAt (4)| AhArakAmamatiduHkhashIlAcAropacAramasUyakamasaMvibhAginamatilolupamakarmashIlaM praitaM vidyAt (5)| anuShaktakAmamajasramAhAravihAraparamanavasthitamamarShaNamasa~jcayaM shAkunaM vidyAt (6)| ityevaM khalu rAjasasya sattvasya Sha~gvidhaM bhedAMshaM vidyAt, roShAMshatvAt||38||

Commentary: aupadhikamiti chadmapracAriNam| ananukroshamiti nirdayam| striyA samaM rahasi sthAtumicchatIti strIrahaskAmaH| kruddhashUramakruddhabhIrumiti krodhe sati shUraM, krodhe~asati bhIrum| gocarashabdena gocare viShaye pracAro lakShyate, tena santrastagocaramiti santrastaviShayapracAram| pishAcAdbhinna eva yathoktAcAraH pretaH, tena praitamapi sattvaM pRuthaguktam||38||

nirAkariShNumamedhasaM jugupsitAcArAharaM maithunaparaM svapnashIlaM pAshavaM vidyAt (1)| bhIrumabudhamAhAralubdhamanavasthitamanuShaktakAmakrodhaM saraNashIlaM toyakAmaM mAtsyaM vidyAt (2)| alasaM kevalamabhiniviShTamAhAre sarvabuddhya~ggahInaM vAnaspatyaM vidyAt (3)| ityevaM tAmasasya sattvasya trividhaM bhedAMshaM vidyAnmohAMshatvAt||39||

Commentary: saraNashIlamiti gamanashIlam| buddhya~ggAni UhApohavicArasmRutyAdIni uktAni||39||

ityaparisa~gkhyeyabhedAnAM trayANAmapi sattvAnAM bhedaikadesho vyAkhyAtaH; shuddhasya sattvasya saptavidho brahmarShishakrayamavaruNakuberagandharvasattvAnukAreNa, rAjasasya ShaDvidho daityapishAcarAkShasasarpapretashakunisattvAnukAreNa, tAmasasya trividhaH pashumatsyavanaspatisattvAnukAreNa, kathaM ca yathAsattvamupacAraH syAditi||40||

Commentary: sukhasmaraNArthaM shuddhAdibhedena bandhIkRutya sattvabhedAnAha- shuddhasyetyAdi| vanaspatisattvAnukAreNetyanto grantho bhedaikadesho vyAkhyAta ityanena saMyojanIyaH, kriyAntarAbhAvAt| ete ca sattvabhedAH prAyeNa bhavanti manuShyeShviti kRutvA eta evodAharaNArthamuktAH; evamanuktA api viShNu-sha~gkara-vyAghrAdisattvAnukAreNa sattvabhedA boddhavyA eveti darshayati| kathamityAdi kathaM nAma yathAsattvaM sarvaprANimanobhirmanuShyANAmupacAraH syAdityetadarthamudAharaNarUpA amI sattvabhedA vyAkhyAtA iti vAkyArthaH||40||

kevalashcAyamuddesho yathoddeshamabhinirdiShTo bhavati garbhAvakrAntisamprayuktaH ; tasya cArthasya vij~jAne sAmarthyaM garbhakarANAM ca bhAvAnAmanusamAdhiH, vidhAtashca vighAtakarANAM bhAvAnAmiti||41||

Commentary: yathApratij~jaM vyAkhyAtArthamupasaMharati- kevala ityAdi| kevalaH kRutsnaH| uddesha iti ‘yatashcAyaM garbhaH’ ityAdigranthakRutaH| yathoddeshamiti uddeshakramAnatikrameNa| sAmarthyamiti prayojanam| anusamAdhiH anuShThAnam| vighAtaH varjanam| vighAtakarANAmiti garbhavighAtakarANAm||41||
tatra shlokAH- nimittamAtmA prakRutirvRuddhiH kukShau krameNa ca| vRuddhihetushca garbhasya pa~jcArthAH shubhasa~jj~jitAH||42||
ajanmani ca yo heturvinAshe vikRutAvapi| imAMstrInashubhAn bhAvAnAhurgarbhavighAtakAn||43||
shubhAshubhasamAkhyAtAnaShTau bhAvAnimAn bhiShak| sarvathA veda yaH sarvAn sa rAj~jaH kartumarhati||44||
avAptyupAyAn garbhasya sa evaM j~jAtumarhati| ye ca garbhavighAtoktA bhAvAstAMshcApyudAradhIH||45||
khuDDIkAgarbhAvakrAntiprapa~jcatvAnmahatyA garbhAvakrAnteranantaramabhidhAnam||1-2||

dAruNAshceShTA vyavAyAdikAH | devatArakSho~anucarebhyaH parirakShaNaM devatArakSho~anucaraparirakShaNam| yadityAdi| yaccAnyat striyo garbhakAlAsevyatvena vidyustadapi varjayet| vadanti hi striyaH- “na garbhiNI kUpamavalokayet, na nadIpAraM yAyAt” ityAdi| vRuddhastrIvacanamapyAgamamUlameva, iha tu granthavistarabhayAnna darshitamiti bhAvaH||17-18||

sarvadhAtukaluShIkRuta iti avyaktasarvadhAtutayA kaluShIkRutaH| dhAtushabdena ca bhUtAnyucyante, kiMvA rasAdidhAtubIjAni| kheTaH shleShmA; tena kheTabhUta iti shleShmasadRusha ityarthaH| avyaktavigraha ityasya vivaraNaM- sadasadbhUtA~ggAvayava iti; vidyamAnAvidyamAnA~ggapratya~gga ityarthaH; a~ggAnAM ca bIjarUpatayA sthitatvena sattvam, avyaktabhAvAccAsattvam | kiMvA, sadasadbhUtA~ggAvayavo ghanaH sampadyate iti yojanA| ghanaH kaThinaH| piNDo granthyAkAraH| peshI dIrghA mAMsapeshyAkArA| arbudaM vartulonnatam||9-10||

athaiteShu madhye ke te garbhasya shubhA ye garbhe~anuShTheyAH, ke vA ashubhA ye varjanIyA ityAha- nimittamityAdi| nimittamiti ‘yatashca garbhaH sambhavati’ iti granthoddiShTo~arthaH| Atmeti garbharUpa AtmA ‘yasmiMshca garbhasa~jj~jA’ iti granthoddiShTo~arthaH| prakriyate~asmAdgarbha iti prakRutiH ‘yadvikArashca garbhaH’ iti granthoddiShTo~arthaH| vRuddhiH kukShau krameNa ceti ‘yayA~anupUrvyA kukShAvabhinirvartate garbhaH’ iti granthoddiShTo~arthaH| vRuddhiheturiti ‘yashcAsya vRuddhihetuH’ ityAdinoddiShTo~arthaH| ajanmani ca yo heturityanena ‘yatashcAsyAjanma bhavati’ ityuddiShTo~artho gRuhyate| vinAshe ca yo heturityanena ‘yatashca jAyamAnaH kukShau vinAshaM prApnoti’ ityukto~artho gRuhyate| vikRutAvapAye heturityanena ‘yatashca kArtsnyena’ ityAdinoktArthasa~ggrahaH| garbhavighAtatvenoktA garbhavighAtoktAH||42-45||
athAtaH puruShavicayaM shArIraM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
shuddhasattvasya yA shuddhA satyA buddhiH pravartate| yayA bhinattyatibalaM mahAmohamayaM tamaH||16||
sarvabhAvasvabhAvaj~jo yayA bhavati niHspRuhaH| yogaM yayA sAdhayate sA~gkhyaH sampadyate yayA||17||
yayA nopaityaha~gkAraM nopAste kAraNaM yayA| yayA nAlambate ki~jcit sarvaM sannyasyate yayA||18||
yAti brahma yayA nityamajaraM shAntamavyayam | vidyA siddhirmatirmedhA praj~jA j~jAnaM ca sA matA||19||

loke vitatamAtmAnaM lokaM cAtmani pashyataH| parAvaradRushaH shAntirj~jAnamUlA na nashyati||20||

Commentary: loke vitatamAtmAnamiti lokarUpamAtmAnaM, tathA lokaM cAtmani sharirAtmamelakarUpe pashyataH, ‘vyavasthitaM’ iti sheShaH| parAvaradRusha iti param AtmAnam, avarANi AtmavyatiriktAni pravRutyAdIni, yaH pashyati tasya parAvaradRushaH| j~jAnamUletyanena mohamUlAmasthirAM shAntiM nirasyati||20||

pashyataH sarvabhAvAn hi sarvAvasthAsu sarvadA| brahmabhUtasya saMyogo na shuddhasyopapadyate||21||

Commentary: atha jIvanmuktasya kimiti sukhaduHkhahetudharmAdharmasaMyogo na bhavatItyAha- pashyata ityAdi| pashyati iti pashyata eva paraM, na tu rajyato nApi dviShata ityarthaH| brahmabhUtasyeti brahmasadRushasya jIvanmuktasyeti vyAkhyeyaM; sarvathA mukte hi j~jAnamapi nAsti, tena pashyata iti na syAt| saMyoga iti dharmAdharmasambandhaH||21||

nAtmanaH karaNAbhAvAlli~ggamapyupalabhyate| sa sarvakaraNAyogAnmukta ityabhidhIyate||22||

Commentary: atha muktAtmanaH kiM lakShaNamityAha- netyAdi| Atmana iti muktAtmanaH| karaNAbhAvAditi manaHprabhRutikaraNAbhAvAt| uktaM hi- “karaNAni manobuddhirbuddhikarmendriyANi ca” (shA.a.1) iti, manaHprabhRutyabhAvAcca sharIrAbhAvo~apyarthalabdha eva; sarvAbhAvAccAtmani kimapi lakShaNaM nAsti, svarUpeNa cAtmA~atIndriya eva; tena AtmA upalabdhiyogyatAbhAvAnnopalabhyate, talli~ggAnyapyabhAvAdeva nopalabhyanta iti bhAvaH||22||
vipApaM virajaH shAntaM paramakSharamavyayam| amRutaM brahma nirvANaM paryAyaiH shAntirucyate||23||
etattat saumya! vij~jAnaM yajj~jAtvA muktasaMshayAH| munayaH prashamaM jagmurvItamoharajaHspRuhAH||24||
tatra shlokau- saprayojanamuddiShTaM lokasya puruShasya ca| sAmAnyaM mUlamutpattau nivRuttau mArga eva ca||25||
shuddhasattvasamAdhAnaM satyA buddhishca naiShThikI| vicaye puruShasyoktA niShThA ca paramarShiNA||26||

‘puruSho~ayaM lokasammitaH’ ityuvAca bhagavAn punarvasurAtreyaH| yAvanto hi loke (mUrtimanto ) bhAvavisheShAstAvantaH puruShe, yAvantaH puruShe tAvanto loke; ityevaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- naitAvatA vAkyenoktaM vAkyArthamavagAhAmahe, bhagavatA buddhyA bhUyastaramato~anuvyAkhyAyamAnaM shushrUShAmaha iti||3||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- aparisa~gkhyeyA lokAvayavavisheShAH, puruShAvayavavisheShA apyaparisa~gkhyeyAH; teShAM yathAsthUlaM katicidbhAvAn sAmAnyamabhipretyodAhariShyAmaH, tAnekamanA nibodha samyagupavarNyamAnAnagnivesha!| ShaDdhAtavaH samuditAH ‘puruSha’ iti shabdaM labhante; tadyathA- pRuthivyApastejo vAyurAkAshaM brahma cAvyaktamiti, eta eva ca ShaDdhAtavaH samuditAH ‘puruSha’ iti shabdaM labhante||4||

tasya puruShasya pRuthivI mUrtiH, ApaH kledaH, tejo~abhisantApaH, vAyuH prANaH, viyat suShirANi, brahma antarAtmA| yathA khalu brAhmI vibhUtirloke tathA puruShe~apyAntarAtmikI vibhUtiH, brahmaNo vibhUtirloke prajApatirantarAtmano vibhUtiH puruShe sattvaM, yastvindro loke sa puruShe~aha~gkAraH, AdityastvAdAnaM, rudro roShaH, somaH prasAdaH, vasavaH sukham, ashvinau kAntiH, marudutsAhaH, vishvedevAH sarvendriyANi sarvendriyArthAshca, tamo mohaH, jyotirj~jAnaM, yathA lokasya sargAdistathA puruShasya garbhAdhAnaM, yathA kRutayugamevaM bAlyaM, yathA tretA tathA yauvanaM, yathA dvAparastathA sthAviryaM, yathA kalirevamAturyaM, yathA yugAntastathA maraNamiti| evametenAnumAnenAnuktAnAmapi lokapuruShayoravayavavisheShANAmagnivesha! sAmAnyaM vidyAditi||5||

Commentary: tasyetyAdinA puruShe ShaDdhAtUn darshayati| mUrtiH kAThinyam| loke ShaDdhAtavo vyaktA eveti na punarvivecitAH| brAhmIti AtmavisheShasya jagatsraShTurvibhUtiH| prajApatiH dakShanAmA| AdAnaM grahaNam; Adityo~apyAdadAtItyAdAnasAmyamAdityasya| iha ca manaHprabhRutiShu prAjApatyAdirUpatA Agamasiddhaiva j~jeyA| sarvendiyArthA vishvedevA eva| sargAdiriti pralayAnantaraH kAlaH| anuktAnAmityanena matiH bRuhaspatiH, kAmaH gandharvaH, ityAdi sAmAnyamUhyam||5||
evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca- evametat sarvamanapavAdaM yathoktaM bhagavatA lokapuruShayoH sAmAnyam| kinnvasya sAmAnyopadeshasya prayojanamiti||6||

bhagavAnuvAca- shRuNvagnivesha! sarvalokamAtmanyAtmAnaM ca sarvaloke samamanupashyataH satyA buddhiH samutpadyate| sarvalokaM hyAtmani pashyato bhavatyAtmaiva sukhaduHkhayoH kartA nAnya iti| karmAtmakatvAcca hetvAdibhiryuktaH sarvaloko~ahamiti viditvA j~jAnaM pUrvamutthApyate~apavargAyeti| tatra saMyogApekShIlokashabdaH| ShaDdhAtusamudAyo hi sAmAnyataH sarvalokaH||7||

tasya hetuH, utpattiH, vRuddhiH, upaplavaH, viyogashca| tatra heturutpattikAraNaM, utpattirjanma, vRuddhirApyAyanam, upaplavo duHkhAgamaH, ShaDdhAtuvibhAgo viyogaH sajIvApagamaH sa prANanirodhaH sa bha~ggaH sa lokasvabhAvaH| tasya mUlaM sarvopaplavAnAM ca pravRuttiH, nivRuttiruparamaH| pravRuttirduHkhaM, nivRuttiH sukhamiti yajj~jAnamutpadyate tat satyam| tasya hetuH sarvalokasAmAnyaj~jAnam| etatprayojanaM sAmAnyopadeshasyeti||8||

Commentary: hetvAdipa~jcakaM nirdishya vibhajate- tasya heturityAdi| tasya mUlamiti tasya jIvApagamasya kAraNam| sarvopaplavAnAM ceti sarvaduHkhAnAm| pravRuttiH rAgadveShamUlA pravRuttiH| nivRuttiriti apravRuttiH| uparamashabdastu tasyetyanena tathA sarvopaplavAnAM cetyanena ca sambadhyate| tena duHkhAnAM maraNasya coparamo nivRuttikRuta eva; nivRuttijanyatvena ca kAryakAraNayorabhedopacArAduparamo~api nivRuttishabdasya sAmAnAdhikaraNyenocyate| pravRuttirduHkhamiti ca tathA nivRuttiH sukhamiti ca kAryakAraNayorabhedopacArAdboddhavyam| satyaj~jAnasvarUpamAha - iti yajj~jAnamityAdi| itIti pUrvapratyavamarshakam| etasmin satyaj~jAne lokapuruShasAmAnyaj~jAnasya hetutvaM darshayannAha- tasyetyAdi||8||
athAgnivesha uvAca- kimmUlA bhagavan! pravRuttiH, nivRuttau ca ka upAya iti||9||

bhagavAnuvAca- mohecchAdveShakarmamUlA pravRuttiH| tajjA hyaha~gkArasa~ggasaMshayAbhisamplavAbhyavapAtavipratyayAvisheShAnupAyAstaruNamiva drumamativipulashAkhAstaravo~abhibhUya puruShamavatatyaivottiShThante; yairabhibhUto na sattAmativartate| tatraiva~jjAtirUpavittavRuttabuddhishIlavidyAbhijanavayovIryaprabhAvasampanno~ahamityaha~gkAraH, yanmanovAkkAyakarma nApavargAya sa sa~ggaH, karmaphalamokShapuruShapretyabhAvAdayaH santi vA neti saMshayaH, sarvAvasthAsvananyo~ahamahaM sraShTA svabhAvasaMsiddho~ahamahaM sharIrendriyabuddhismRutivisheSharAshiriti grahaNamabhisamplavaH, mama mAtRupitRubhrAtRudArApatyabandhumitrabhRutyagaNo gaNasya cAhamityabhyavapAtaH, kAryAkAryahitAhitashubhAshubheShu viparItAbhinivesho vipratyayaH, j~jAj~jayoH prakRutivikArayoH pravRuttinivRuttyoshca sAmAnyadarshanamavisheShaH, prokShaNAnashanAgnihotratriShavaNAbhyukShaNAvAhanayAjanayajanayAcanasalilahutAshanapraveshAdayaH samArambhAH procyante hyanupAyAH| evamayamadhIdhRutismRutiraha~gkArAbhiniviShTaH saktaH sasaMshayo~abhisamplutabuddhirabhyavapatito~anyathAdRuShTiravisheShagrAhI vimArgagatirnivAsavRukShaH sattvasharIradoShamUlAnAM sarvaduHkhAnAM bhavati| evamaha~gkArAdibhirdoShairbhrAmyamANo nAtivartate pravRuttiM, sA ca mUlamaghasya||10||
nivRuttirapavargaH; tat paraM prashAntaM tattadakSharaM tadbrahma sa mokShaH||11||

tatra mumukShUNAmudayanAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH| tatra lokadoShadarshino mumukShorAdita evAcAryAbhigamanaM, tasyopadeshAnuShThAnam, agnerevopacaryA, dharmashAstrAnugamanaM, tadArthAvabodhaH, tenAvaShTambhaH, tatra yathoktAH kriyAH, satAmupAsanam, asatAM parivarjanam, asa~ggatirdurjanena, satyaM sarvabhUtahitamaparuShamanatikAle parIkShya vacanaM, sarvaprANiShu cAtmanIvAvekShA, sarvAsAmasmaraNamasa~gkalpanamaprArthanamanabhibhAShaNaM ca strINAM, sarvaparigrahatyAgaH, kaupInaM pracchAdanArthaM, dhAturAganivasanaM, kanthAsIvanahetoH sUcIpippalakaM, shaucAdhAnatorjalakuNDikA, daNDadhAraNaM, bhaikShacaryArthaM pAtraM, prANadhAraNArthamekakAlamagrAmyo yathopapanno~abhyavahAraH, shramApanayanArthaM shIrNashuShkaparNatRuNAstaraNopadhAnaM, dhyAnahetoH kAyanibandhanaM, vaneShvaniketavAsaH, tandrAnindrAlasyAdikarmavarjanaM, indriyArtheShvanurAgopatApanigrahaH, suptasthitagataprekShitA hAravihArapratya~ggaceShTAdikeShvArambheShu smRutipUrvikA pravRuttiH, satkArastutigarhAvamAnakShamatvaM, kShutpipAsAyAsashramashItoShNavAtavarShAsukhaduHkhasaMsparshasahatvaM, shokadainyamAnodvegamadalobharAgerShyAbhayakrodhAdibhirasa~jcalanam, aha~gkArAdiShUpasargasa~jj~jA, lokapuruShayoH sargAdisAmAnyAvekShaNaM, kAryakAlAtyayabhayaM, yogArambhe satatamanirvedaH, sattvotsAhaH, apavargAya dhIdhRutismRutibalAdhAnaM; niyamanamindriyANAM cetasi, cetasa Atmani, Atmanashca; dhAtubhedena sharIrAvayavasa~gkhyAnamabhIkShNaM, sarvaM kAraNavadduHkhamasvamanityamityabhyupagamaH, sarvapravRuttiShvaghasa~jj~jA , sarvasannyAse sukhamityabhiniveshaH; eSha mArgo~apavargAya, ato~anyathA badhyate; ityudayanAni vyAkhyAtAni||12||
bhavanti cAtra- etairavimalaM sattvaM shuddhyupAyairvishudhyati| mRujyamAna ivAdarshastailacelakacAdibhiH||13||
grahAmbudarajodhUmanIhArairasamAvRutam| yathA~arkamaNDalaM bhAti bhAti sattvaM tathA~amalam||14||
jvalatyAtmani saMruddhaM tat sattvaM saMvRutAyane| shuddhaH sthiraH prasannArcirdIpo dIpAshaye yathA||15||

pUrvAdhyAye~abhihitaM “yAvanto hi loke bhAvAstAvantaH puruShe” (shA.a.4) iti, tacca na prapa~jcitaM bahuvAcyatvAt; ataH prapa~jcAbhidhAnArthaM puruShavicayaM brUte| puruShasya vicayanaM lokasAmAnyena gaNanaM puruShavicayaH, tamadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyaH puruShavicayaH||1-2||

shuddhasattvamabhidhAya tajjanyAM mokShasAdhanatvenAtyarthopAdeyAM satyAM buddhiM vividhairupayuktaiH svarUpairAha- shuddhetyAdi| mahAmohaH anAdimithyAj~jAnam| niHspRuha iti upAditsAjihAsAshUnyaH| yogamiti viShayavyAvRuttasya manasa Atmanyeva paraM yogam| sa~gkhyA tattvaj~jAnaM, tayA vartata iti sA~gkhyaH| nopAste kAraNamiti na sukhaduHkhakAraNaM sevate| nAlambate ki~jciditi kvacidapyAsthAnaM na karoti| sannyasyata iti sarvatrodAsIno bhavati| brahmeti mokSham| vidyAsiddhyAdayashca yadyapi j~jAnavisheShe~api prasiddhAH, tathA~apIha prakaraNAt tattvaj~jAnaparA eva j~jeyAH||16-19||
vipApamityAdinA mokShasvarUpaprakAshakAn paryAyAnAha| yajj~jAtveti j~jAnaM prApyetyarthaH; kiMvA, svaprakAshakatvAjj~jAnasya j~jAnamapi j~jeyaM bhavatIti boddhavyam||23-24||

sa~ggrahe shuddhasattvasamAdhAnamityanena ‘etairavimalaM’ ityAdinA ‘dIpAshaye yathA’ ityantena granthenoktArthaH sa~ggRuhItaH| ‘shuddhasattvasya’ ityAdinA satyA buddhiruktA| naiShThikIti satyAbuddhereva visheShaNaM; naiShThikI mokShasAdhikA; niShThA mokShaH||25-26||

sammitaH tulyaH| lokasammitatvameva vibhajate- yAvanto hItyAdi| bhagavatA buddhyA~anuvyAkhyAyamAnamiti yojanA| lokasya tarutRuNapashvAdirUpA avayavAH, tathA puruShasya ca snAyukaNDarAdhamanyAdirUpA avayavA aparisa~gkhyeyAH; tena, kArtsnyAbhidhAnamashakyam; ato ye ye lokapuruShayoH sthUlA avayavAH, te te sAmAnyapratipAdanArthamucyanta iti vAkyArthaH| brahmaNo vivaraNam- avyaktamiti||3-4||

anapavAdamiti abAdhyamAnam| kinnvasya prayojanamiti Ayurvede kimapyetat sAmyakathane prayojanamityarthaH| satyA buddhirutpadyate iti asya yojanAyAM ‘ki~jcAsyAH prayojanam’ iti sheSho j~jeyaH| yathA ca lokapuruShasAmyaM satyabuddhijanakaM bhavati tadAha- sarvalokaM hItyAdi| Atmani pashyata iti Atmano~abhedena pashyataH| Atmashabdena ShaDdhAtusamudAyAtmakaH puruSha ihocyate; tena, yatki~jcillokagataM sukhaduHkhajanakaM, tadAtmarUpameva; tena bAhyalokakRutamapi AtmakRutameva vaiShayikaM nityaduHkhAnusaktaM heyaM sukhaM, tathA nisargaheyaM duHkhaM ca pashyan rAgadveShanirmuktaH san satyaj~jAnavAn bhavatIti bhAvaH| atha satyaj~jAnasyApi kiM prayojanamityAha- karmetyAdi| lokapuruShasAmyaj~jAne~api satyaj~jAnasyApavargAnuShThAnaM prayojanamiti vAkyArthaH| atra karmAtmakatvAditi karmAdhInatvAt| hetvAdayo~agre vakShyamANAH | karmaparavashaH san hetvAdibhiryukto~ayamAtmA pravartate, tat karma tattvaj~jAnAt pravRuttyuparame sati kAraNAbhAvAnnopapadyate; utpannaM ca karma araktasya tattvaj~jAnena, adRuShTasya copabhogAt, AtyantikakarmakShayAdAtyantikakarmaphalAbhAvarUpo mokSho bhavatIti bhAvaH| saMyogApekShIti ShaDdhAtumelake puruSharUpe vartate ityarthaH| lokashabdeneha prakaraNe lokata iti kRutvA puruSha evocyate, na jagadrUpo lokaH| yataH, hetvAdayo ye~atra karmaparavashatvena loke vaktavyAH, te puruSha eva sambhavanti| sarvashabdena sarvaprANino grAhayati||6-7||

pravRutteH saMsArarUpAyAH, tathA nivRuttermokSharUpAyAH kAraNamupAyaM ca pRucchati- kimmUletyAdi| mohetyAdyuttaram| mohecchAdveShakarmamUleti mohAnmithyAj~jAnarUpAdicchAdveShau, tayoshca dharmAdharmarUpaM karma, tacca mUlaM saMsArasyetyarthaH| kathamete mohAdayaH saMsArakAraNamityAha- tajjA hItyAdi| atra cAha~gkArAdau yathAyogyatayA mohAdInAM kAraNatvaM j~jeyam| aha~gkArAdayashcAShTAvagre vakShyamANA j~jeyAH| avatatyeti vyApya| na sattAmativartate iti na saMsAre sthitimativartate| atrAdyuktamaha~gkAraM vivRuNoti- tatraivamityAdi| jAtyAdibhiH prabhAvAntaiH sampanna utkRuShTo~ahamiti j~jAnamaha~gkAraH| yadityAdi sa~ggavivaraNam| karmaphalAdayaH santi na veti yajj~jAnaM, tat saMshayaH| abhisamplavamAha- sarvetyAdi| Atmano~abhimata anAtmanyabhisamplavo~abhisamplavaH; Atmano~anAtmagocaratayA AtmabuddhirityarthaH| sarvAvasthAsviti sarvAsu sharIrAvasthAsu ShaDdhAtusamudAyarUpa evAnanya iti yajj~jAnaM tadiha j~jeyaM; paramAtmanastu sarvAvasthAsvananyatvamiti yajj~jAnaM, tat samyagj~jAnameva| evamahaM sraShTA~ahaM svabhAvasaMsiddha ityatrApi sharIra evAha~gkAraviShayo j~jeyaH| ahaM sharIrendriyabuddhivisheSharAshirityatra sharIrAdiShvacetaneShvaha~gkArAspadatvena cetanatvAbhimAno viruddha iti j~jeyam| mametyAdinA abhyavapAtamAha; abhyavapAtaH paramArthato~anAtmIye mamatA| kAryetyAdinA vipratyayaM brUte| viparItAbhinivesho viparyayeNa j~jAnaM; yathA- kArye akAryam, akArye kAryamityAdi| j~jAj~jayorityAdinA~avisheShamAha| avisheSho visheShApratItiH, vipratyayastu visheShANAM viparyayeNa grahaNamiti bhedaH| prokShaNetyAdinA anupAyamAha| anupAyA iti anyopAyAH santo~api paramapuruShArthe mokShe anupAyAH| triShavaNaM trisandhyasnAnam| sampratyaha~gkArAdInAM dhIdhRutismRutivibhraMshamUlatvenAdhIdhRutismRutyabhidhAnapUrvakaM saMsArarUpapravRuttinityAnubandhashArIramAnasaduHkhakAraNatvaM vyutpAditAnAmaha~gkArAdInAM sa~gkShipyAha- evamityAdinA| nivAsavRukSha iva nivAsavRukShaH; tena yathA nivAsavRukShaH pakShiNAM nityamAshrayo bhavati, evamaha~gkArAdiyukto~api rogasya nivAso bhavatIti darshayati| bhrAmyamANa iti punaH punarapi sharIrAntarANi nIyamAnaH| nAtivartate pravRuttimiti saMsAraM na parityajati| evaM mohecchAjanyakarmamUlatAM pravRutterdarshayitvA, pravRutterapi karmakAraNatAmAha- sA ca mUlamaghasyeti| pravRuttirapi dharmAdharmarUpasyAghasya mUlam; iha ca dharmAdharmAvavisheSheNa saMsAraduHkhakAraNatayA aghashabdenoktau||9-10||

samprati nivRuttAvupAyaM vaktuM nivRuttimeva tAvadupAdeyatApratipAdakaparyAyairAha- nivRuttirityAdi| ‘ut’ ityavyayaM mokSha ityarthe; udayanAni hi mokShopAyA ityarthaH| lokadoShadarshina iti hetugarbhaM visheShaNaM; tena nityaM duHkhAkrAntalokadarshanAdviraktasya sata iti darshayati| AcArya iha mokShashAstropadeShTA| tenAvaShTambha iti shAtrAvabodhena dhairyaM karaNIyaM, manAgapi tatra kathantA na kartavyetyarthaH| yathoktAH kriyAH ‘kartavyAH’ iti sheShaH| AtmanIvAvekSheti yathA AtmanyanapakAryatAbuddhistathA sarvaprANiShu kartavyA| asa~gkalpanamiti abhAvanam| kaupInaM pracchAdanArthamiti kaTiveShTanArthaM; kiMvA kaupInArthaM pracchAdanArthaM ca| sUcIpippalakaM sUcIsthApanapAtram| bhaikShacaryArthaM pAtraM bhikShApAtramityarthaH| prANayAtrArthamityanena yAvanmAtreNAhAreNa prANayAtrA bhavati tAvanmAtra AhAraH kartavyaH, na tu rAgAditi darshayati| evaM shramApanayanArthamityAdAvapi tAvanmAtraprayojanatA vyAkhyeyA| kAyanibandhanaM yogapaTTam| aniketavAsa iti agRuhavAsaH, etena vane~api na gRuhaM kRutvA sthAtavyamiti darshayati| indriyArtheShu shabdAdiShu anurAgasya tathopatApasya ca dveSharUpasya nigrahaH kartavyaH| smRutipUrvikA pravRuttiriti ko~ahaM, kimarthaM rAgatyAgAdikamArabhyate, ityAdi sarvadA smartavyamityarthaH| satkAraH pUjA, satkAre stutau ca satyAmahRuShTatvaM, tathA garhAyAmavamAne ca nirdveShatvaM satkArAdikShamitvaM j~jeyam| kShudhAdiShu cAnudvegaH kShudhAdisahatvam| asaMvasanam asaMvAsaH| aha~gkArAdayo~aShTAvihaivoktAH| upasargasa~jj~jeti anarthahetutvabhAvanA| lokapuruShayoH sargAdisAmAnyAvekShaNAmiti yathA ihaiva lokapuruShayorAdisargataH prabhRuti sAmAnyamuktaM, tathA~avekShaNamityarthaH| kAryakAlAtyayabhayamiti mokShAnuguNakartavyasya kAlAtipAtabhayaM karaNIyam| niyamanamindriyANAM cetasIti indriyANi bAhmaviShayanivRuttAni manasyeva niyatAni kartavyAni; cetasashcintyAdiviShayebhyo vyAvRuttasya paramAtmanyAtmaj~jAnArthaM niyamanaM kartavyam; AtmanashcAtmani niyamanamiti yojanA| tena, AtmA~apIndriyAdiviShayebhyo vyAvartyAtmani niyantavyaH| dhAtubhedena sharIrAvayavasa~gkhyAnamiti sharIrasya rasamalasnAyvAdirUpatayA j~jAnam| sharIraM hi rasamalasnAyvAdirUpatayA bhAvyamAnaM vairAgyaheturbhavati; yathA- “majjA~asthnA rajasA plIhnA yakRutA shakRutA~api ca| pUrNAH snAyusirAbhishca striyashcarmaprasevikAH” ityAdikA vairAgyabhAvanA| kAraNavadityanena nityAtmavyatiriktaM sarvamanityaM darshayati| duHkhamiti duHkhahetuH| asvamiti AtmavyatiriktamanAtmIyaM ca| sarvasannyAse sarvapravRuttyuparame||11-12||

avimalamiti kriyAvisheShaNam| grahaH rAhuH| sattvasya pa~jcaivendriyANi j~jAnAvarakANi bhavantIti kRutvA sUryasyApi pa~jcaiva grahAdayashcAvarakA uktAH| jvalatIti kevalAtmaj~jAnajanakatvena prakAshate| Atmani saMruddhamiti indriyebhyo vyAvRutyAtmaniyatam| saMvRutAyana iti AtmapakShe~api saMvRutendriyarUpacchidre AtmanIti j~jeyam| dIpAshayaH dIpadhArikA, gRuhaM vA||13-15||
athAtaH sharIravicayaM shArIraM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
sharIravicayaH sharIropakArArthamiShyate| j~jAtvA hi sharIratattvaM sharIropakArakareShu bhAveShu j~jAnamutpadyate| tasmAccharIravicayaM prashaMsanti kushalAH||3||

yatra tvevaMlakShaNena sAmAnyena sAmAnyavatAmAhAravikArANAmasAnnidhyaM syAt, sannihitAnAM vA~apyayuktatvAnnopayogo ghRuNitvAdanyasmAdvA kAraNAt, sa ca dhAturabhivardhayitavyaH syAt, tasya ye samAnaguNAH syurAhAravikArA asevyAshca, tatra samAnaguNabhUyiShThAnAmanyaprakRutInAmapyAhAravikArANAmupayogaH syAt| tadyathA- shukrakShaye kShIrasarpiShorupayogo madhurasnigdhashItasamAkhyAtAnAM cApareShAM dravyANAM, mUtrakShaye punarikShurasavAruNImaNDadravamadhurAmlalavaNopakledinAM, purIShakShaye kulmAShamAShakuShkuNDAjamadhyayavashAkadhAnyAmlAnAM, vAtakShaye kaTukatiktakaShAyarUkShalaghushItAnAM, pittakShaye~amlalavaNakaTukakShAroShNatIkShNAnAM, shleShmakShaye snigdhagurumadhurasAndrapicchilAnAM dravyANAm| karmApi yadyasya dhAtorvRuddhikaraM tattadAsevyam| evamanyeShAmapi sharIradhAtUnAM sAmAnyaviparyayAbhyAM vRuddhihrAsau yathAkAlaM kAryau| iti sarvadhAtUnAmekaikasho~atideshatashca vRuddhihrAsakarANi vyAkhyAtAni bhavanti||11||

Commentary: samprati samAnaguNabhUyiShThena vijAtIyena vRuddhimAha- yatretyAdi| evaM lakShaNeneti tulyajAtirUpeNa| uktArthaM vivRuNoti- ghRuNitvAdityAdi| anyasmAdvA kAraNAdityabhakShyAmagarbhashukrAdibhakShaNajanyAdharmotpatteH| tatretyanena asannihitAn ghRuNayA kAraNAntareNa ca sannihitAnapyasevyAn pratyavamRushati| anyaprakRutInAmiti vijAtIyAnAm| atrodAharaNamAha- tadyathetyAdi| shukre kShINe yadi shukrAntaraM na prApyate, prAptaM vA ghRuNAdivashAdanupayojyaM syAt, tadA samAnaguNabhUyiShThAnAM kShIrAdInAmupayogaH kartavya ityarthaH| mUtrAdAvapi ghRuNAdinA sajAtIyaprayogAviShaye samAnaguNabhUyiShThaprayogamAha- mUtretyAdi| kuShkuNDaM palalAdicchatrikA| ajamadhyaM chAgAntarAdhiH| dravyANAmupayoga iti yojanA| AhAraM vRuddhikaramabhidhAya vihAramapi vRuddhikaramAha- karmetyAdi| karmashabdenehAsyAcintAdayo~api gRuhyante| karma tu prAyaH prabhAvAdeva vRuddhikaraM bhavatIti kRutvA~atra samAnaguNatAparigraho na kRutaH| sAkShAdanuktAnAmapi dhAtUnAmuktanyAyAnusAreNa vRuddhihrAsamabhidarshayati- evamityAdi| yathAkAlamiti kriyAkAlAnatipAtena| uktaM prakaraNamupasaMharati- iti sarvetyAdi| ekaikasha ityanena mAMsamApyAyyate mAMsenetyAdinoktaM gRuhNAti| atideshatashcetyanena evamanyeShAmapi dhAtUnAmityAdinoktaM gRuhNAti||11||

dhAtavaH punaH shArIrAH samAnaguNaiH samAnaguNabhUyiShThairvA~apyAhAravikArairabhyasyamAnairvRuddhiM prApnuvanti, hrAsaM tu viparItaguNairviparItaguNabhUyiShThairvA~apyAhArairabhyasyamAnaiH||9||

Commentary: atha rasAdidhAtUnAM vRuddhihrAsAvuktau yAdRushAbhyAmAhArAbhyAM kriyete taddarshayitumAha- dhAtava ityAdi| shArIrA iti padenAdhyAtmikAn buddhyAdIn vyavacchinatti, yato na buddhyAdayaH samAnaguNAdvardhante, asamAnaguNAdvA hrasanti| samAnA eva paraM guNA yasya tatsamAnaguNaM, yathA- mAMsaM mAMsasya; samAnaguNabhUyiShThaM yadalpasamAnaguNaM, yathA- shukrasya kShIraM; kShIrasyAtidravatvAcchuke~alpasamAnaguNam| abhyasyamAnairityanena sakRudupayogAd vRuddhiM hrAsaM ca niShedhayati| viparItA eva paraM guNA yasya tadviparItaguNam| alpasamAnaguNaM tu viparItaguNabhUyiShTham||9||

tatreme sharIradhAtuguNAH sa~gkhyAsAmarthyakarAH; tadyathA- gurulaghushItoShNasnigdharUkShamandatIkShNasthirasaramRudukaThinavishadapicchilashlakShNakharasUkShmasthUlasAndradravAH| teShu ye guravaste gurubhirAhAravikAraguNairabhyasyamAnairApyAyyante, laghavashca hrasanti; laghavastu laghubhirApyAyyante, guravashca hrasanti| evameva sarvadhAtuguNAnAM sAmAnyayogAdvRuddhiH, viparyayAddhrAsaH| tasmAnmAMsamApyAyyate mAMsena bhUyastaramanyebhyaH sharIradhAtubhyaH, tathA lohitaM lohitena, medo medasA, vasA vasayA, asthi taruNAsthnA, majjA majj~jA, shukraM shukreNa, garbhastvAmagarbheNa||10||

Commentary: atha ke te sharIradhAtuguNA ye bheShajaguNaiH samAnA asamAnA vA ucyanta ityAha- tatretyAdi| sharIradhAtuguNA iti visheShaNenAprastutatvenAnabhidheyAnAtmaguNAn buddhyAdIn nirasyati| parAdayastu yadyapi sharIradhAtuguNA bhavanti, tathA~api te vRuddhiM hrAsaM ca pratyanatiprayojanatvAdihAnuktAH| rasastu pradhAnatvena prakaraNAntarokta eveti nehoktaH| sparshastu shItoShNasa~ggRuhIta eva| shabdarUpagandhAstu parAdivad vRuddhau hrAse ca nAtiprayojanA iti noktAH| sa~gkhyA j~jAnaM gaNanA vA, tatra sAmarthyaM kurvantIti sa~gkhyAsAmarthyakarAH | ete hi gurvAdayo j~jAtA viMshatirgurvAdayo bhavantIti yajj~jAnaM, sa~gkhyAsAmarthyarUpaM tat kurvanti| parasparaviparyayAtmakAn dvandvAn dashaguNAn darshayitvA teShAM ca dravyasambaddhAnAM shRu~ggagrAhikayA karmAha- teShvityAdi| laghavashca hrasantIti cchedaH| sheShashItAdiguNAnAM vRuddhimatideshenAha- evamityAdi| sAmAnyayogAditi samAnaikarUpArthayogAt | tacca sAmAnyaM sarvathA samAnaguNajAtirUpaM bhavati; yathA- poShyapoShakayormAMsayoH| kvacicca vijAtIye~api guNA eva poShyapoShakavRuttayo bhavanti; yathA- kShIrashukrayoH| tatrAtyarthavRuddhikartRutvena prathamaM jAtirUpameva sAmAnyaM sarvaguNasAmAnyayuktamudAharati - tasmAdityAdi| bhUyastaramanyebhya ityanena mAMsena samAnaguNabhUyiShThatayA raktAdivRuddhirati kriyate, bhUyasI tu sarvathA sAmAnyayogAnmAMsasya vRuddhiH kriyata iti darshayati| lohitaM lohitenetyevamAdau ‘bhUyastaramanyebhyaH’ ityanuvartanIyam| garbhastvAmagarbheNetyatra AmagarbheNANDAdirUpeNa samuditAnAM mAMsAdInAM samyaganiShpannAnAM ca vRuddhirucyate||10||

kArtsnyena sharIravRuddhikarAstvime bhAvA bhavanti; tadyathA- kAlayogaH, svabhAvasaMsiddhiH, AhArasauShThavam, avighAtashceti||12||

Commentary: vRuddhiprastAvAt sarvasharIravRuddhikarAnAha- kArtsnyenetyAdi| kAlayoga iti vRuddhikArakayauvanAdikAlayogaH| yauvanAdau hi saptadashavatsarAdikAlalakShaNe kAlamahimraiva vRuddhirbhavati| svabhAvashabdenAdRuShTamucyate| tena svabhAvasaMsiddhasharIravRuddhiheturadRuShTam| AhArasauShThavamiti AhArasampat| avighAtashceti sharIravRuddhivighAtakarAtivyavAyamanobhighAtAdivirahaH||12||

balavRuddhikarAstvime bhAvA bhavanti| tadyathA- balavatpuruShe deshe janma balavatpuruShe kAle ca, sukhashca kAlayogaH, bIjakShetraguNasampacca, AhArasampacca, sharIrasampacca, sAtmyasampacca, sattvasampacca, svabhAvasaMsiddhishca, yauvanaM ca, karma ca, saMharShashceti||13||

Commentary: vRuddhiprastAvAcca balavRuddhikarAn bhAvAnAha- baletyAdi| deshamahimnA balavantaH puruShA yasmin deshe saindhavAdau sa balavatpuruSho deshaH, tatra jAto deshamahimnaiva balavAn bhavati; yathA saindhavA balavantaH puruShAH| pariNAmasyApi prashastasya hetutAmAha- balavatpuruShe kAle ceti| kAlo hemantashishirAdirUpaH| hemante shishire vA kAle jAyamAnasya sa kAlo balaM janayati| sukhashca kAlayoga iti sAdhAraNakAlayogaH| bIjasya shukrarUpasya, tathA kShetrasyArtavagarbhAshayarUpasya, guNAnAM prashastadharmANAM sampat bIjakShetraguNasampat| atra bIjakShetrayornirdoShatA~api sampat syAt, tena nirdoShatAtiriktasAratvAdibIjakShetraguNaprAptyarthaM guNagrahaNaM j~jeyam| sattvasampacceti sattvasampadA~api sharIre balaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| vacanaM hi- “sharIraM hyapi sattvamanuvidhIyate” (shA.a.4) iti| svabhAvasaMsiddhiH balajanakakarmasaMsiddhiH| karma vyAyAmAdi karmetyarthaH; vyAyAmAdikarmAbhyAsAddhi balaM bhavati||13||

AhArapariNAmakarAstvime bhAvA bhavanti| tadyathA- UShmA, vAyuH, kledaH, snehaH, kAlaH, samayogashceti ||14||

Commentary: prashastaguNAbhidhAnaprastAvAdAhArapariNAmasyApi prashastasya hetutAmAha- AhAretyAdi| kAla iti pAkakAlo nishAvasAnAdirUpaH| samayoga iti AhArasya prakRutyAdyaShTAhAravidhivisheShAyatanasamyagyogaH||14||

tatra tu khalveShAmUShmAdInAmAhArapariNAmakarANAM bhAvAnAmime karmavisheShA bhavanti| tadyathA- UShmA pacati, vAyurapakarShati, kledaH shaithilyamApAdayati, sneho mArdavaM janayati, kAlaH paryAptimabhinirvartayati, samayogastveShAM pariNAmadhAtusAmyakaraH sampadyate||15||

Commentary: atra cAhArapariNAmakareShu UShmaiva sAkShAt pAke vyApriyate, vAyvAdayastu tasya pacato vyApAravisheSheNa sahAyatAM yAntIti darshayannAha- tatretyAdi| vAyurapakarShatIti UShmasthAnAd vidUrasthitamannamUShmasamIpaM nayati| yaduktam- “annamAdAnakarmA tu prANaH koShThaM prakarShati” (ci. 15) iti| vAyurapakarShatItyupalakShaNaM, tena agnyuttejanamapi samAnAkhyasya vAyorboddhavyam| uktaM hi- “samAnenAvadhUto~agriH ... pacati” (ci. 15) iti| paryAptimiti pAkaniShpattiM; satyapyUShmAdivyApAre kAlavashAdeva pAko bhavati, noShmAdivyApAramAtrAditi bhAvaH| samayogastveShAmiti eShAmAhAradravyANAM prakRutyAdInAM yaH samayogaH, sa pariNAmakaro dhAtusAmyakarashca bhavati; yadA hi prakRutyAdiviruddha AhAro bhavati, tadA prakRutyAdidoShAdeva na samyakpariNAmo bhavati| etadUShmAdivyApArapratipAdakaM granthAntaraM yathA- “annamAdAnakarmA tu prANaH koShThaM prakarShati| taddravairbhinnasa~gghAtaM snehena mRudutAM gatam| samAnenAvadhUto~agnirudaryaH pavanena tu| kAle pakvaM samaM samyak pacatyAyurvivRuddhaye” (ci.a.15) iti||15||

pariNamatastvAhArasya guNAH sharIraguNabhAvamApadyante yathAsvamaviruddhAH; viruddhAshca vihanyurvihatAshca virodhibhiH sharIram||16||

Commentary: atha kayA paripAThyA pariNAmamApadyamAna AhAro dhAtusAmyakaro bhavatItyAha- pariNamata ityAdi| pariNamata iti vartamAnanirdeshena yo yathA yathA AhArAMshaH pariNamate sa tathA tathA sharIraguNarUpatAM yAti, na kRutsnAhArapariNAmamapekShata iti darshayati| yathAsvamaviruddhA iti ye AhAraguNA yasmin sharIraguNe~aviruddhAsta eva tadrUpatAM yAnti| yathA- AhArasya kaThino bhAgo mAMsAsthyAdikaThinabhAgapoShako bhavati, dravAMshastu shoNitAdirUpo bhavatItyAdi| viruddhAshca vihanyuriti sharIraguNaviruddhAstu AhAraguNA vihanyuH hrAsayeyurityarthaH| atha te sharIraguNA AhAraguNavihatAH santaH kiM kurvantItyAha- vihatA ityAdi| vihatAstu virodhibhiH sharIraM vihanyuriti yojanA; virodhibhiriti viparItairAhAraguNaiH, vihatA iti kShayaM nItAH| kiMvA virodhibhiriti yathA dugdhamatsyAdiviruddhAharairvihatAH sharIraguNAH sharIraM hanyuH; cakArAd viruddhaguNaishca kShayaM nItAH sharIraM hanyuriti darshayati||16||

sharIraguNAH punardvividhAH sa~ggraheNa- malabhUtAH, prasAdabhUtAshca| tatra malabhUtAste ye sharIrasyAbAdhakarAH syuH| tadyathA- sharIracchidreShUpadehAH pRuthagjanmAno bahirmukhAH, paripakvAshca dhAtavaH, prakupitAshca vAtapittashleShmANaH, ye cAnye~api keciccharIre tiShThanto bhAvAH sharIrasyopaghAtAyopapadyante, sarvAMstAnmale sa~jcakShmahe; itarAMstu prasAde , gurvAdIMshca dravAntAn guNabhedena, rasAdIMshca shukrAntAn dravyabhedena||17||

Commentary: atha katiprakArAste sharIraguNA ityAha- sharIretyAdi| sa~ggraheNa sa~gkShepeNa; tena vistareNa dhAtUpadhAtvAdivibhAgena bahavashca bhavanti| bhUtashabdaH svarUpe| AbAdhakarA iti pIDAkarA ityarthaH| pRuthagjanmAna iti picolikAsi~gghANakAdibhedena nAnArUpAH| bahirmukhA ityanena ya eva cchidramalAH prabhUtatayA bahirniHsaraNAbhimukhaH, ta eva pIDAkartRutvena malAkhyAH; ye tu srota-upalepamAtrakArakAste guNakartRutayA na malAkhyAH| paripakvAshca dhAtava iti pAkAt pUyatAM gatAshca shoNitAdayo~api malAkhyAH; kiMvA ‘aparipakvA’ iti pAThaH, tadA sAmA dhAtavo malAkhyA iti j~jeyam| kupitAshceti padena vAtAdayaH sAmAnyena kShINA vRuddhA vA gRuhyante; vikRutimAtraM hi vAtAdInAM kopaH| ye cAnye~apItyAdinA vimArgagatAn pIDAkArakA~j sharIradhAtUn tathA~ajIrNAdIn grAhayanti| mala iti ekavacanaM jAtau| itarAniti avikArakarAn sva(sa)mAnasthitapurIShavAtAdIn; purIShavAtAdayo~api sharIrAvaShTambhakAH prasAdA eva, guNakartRutvAt| malaprasAdabhedena sharIragatabhAvAnabhidhAya punardravyaguNabhedAnAha- gurvAdIMshcetyAdi| gurvAdayo dravAntAH pashcAduktA eva| atra ca ye malA upadhAtavashca noktAste gurvAdiguNAdhAratvena grAhyAH; kiMvA, itarAMstu nirAbAdhAn malAdIn prasAde sa~jcakShmahe, tathA gurvAdIMshca (tathA rasAdIMshca ) nirvikArAn dravyaguNarUpAn prasAde sa~jcakShmahe iti vyAkhyeyam||17||

teShAM sarveShAmeva vAtapittashleShmANo duShTA dUShayitAro bhavanti, doShasvabhAvAt| vAtAdInAM punardhAtvantare kAlAntare praduShTAnAM vividhAshitapItIye~adhyAye vij~jAnAnyuktAni| etAvatyeva duShTadoShagatiryAvat saMsparshanAccharIradhAtUnAm| prakRutibhUtAnAM tu khalu vAtAdInAM phalamArogyam| tasmAdeShAM prakRutibhAve prayatitavyaM buddhimadbhiriti||18||

Commentary: atha yadetat purIShAdInAM malatvaM taddUShaNAdbhavati, tena teShAM dUShakahetumAha- teShAmityAdi| teShAmiti purIShAdInAM rasAdInAM ca| duShTA iti svahetUpacitAH, kShINAstu nAnyaduShTiM doShAH kurvantIti pratipAditameva| atha dhAtvantarAshrayiNAM vAtAdInAM duShTAnAM kiM lakShaNaM, yena te j~jAtavyA ityAha- vAtAdInAmityAdi| vij~jAnAnIti lakShaNAni; rasAdyAshrayaduShTavAtAdilakShaNaM tAvaddhividhAshitapItIye proktam| “keshamUtranakhAdyAshrayaduShTadoShalakShaNaM tu yada(tta)tra noktaM tat kathaM j~jeyamityAha- etAvatyevetyAdi| keshAdau duShTAnAmapi vAtAdInAM gatirnAstIti vAkyArthaH| yAvat saMsparshanAditi sparshanendriyaM vyApya, tena sharIradhAtUnAM dUShaNe sparshanendriyaparyantameva duShTadoShagatirbhavati; tena na keshAdiShu duShTadoShagatiH| yattu palitAdikeshe mRutanakhe vA puShpaM tat sparshavaccharIrasaMsthitenaiva doSheNa kRutaM, na punarbhRutanakhe kesheShvapi svamArgacArI doShaH pracarati” iti bruvate| vayaM tu brUmaH- vividhAshitapItIyoktaduShTyA sarvaduShTyupasa~ggraho bhavatIti darshayannAha- etAvatyevetyAdi| yAvat saMsparshanAditi sparshasambandhAt; tena, sharIradhAtUnAM yAvat sparshanAdduShTadoShagatirbhavati, sA ca sarvA vividhAshitapItIyoktaiva, na tato~adhikA duShTirdehasyAsti| tatra hi “malAnAshritya duShTAstu bhedashoShapradUShaNam” (sU.a.28) iti granthena kRutsnamalagrahaNAt keshanakhau malau gRuhItAveva| etena tu nakhAgrakeshAgrasphuTanAdimRutanakhAgrakeshAgragatena doSheNaiva kRutaM bhavati| atha duShTA vAtAdayo duShTilakShaNAni kurvanti, prakRutisthAstu kiM kurvantItyAha- prakRutibhUtAnAmityAdi||18||

bhavati cAtra- sharIraM sarvathA sarvaM sarvadA veda yo bhiShak| AyurvedaM sa kArtsnyena veda lokasukhapradam||19||

Commentary: sampratyuktaprakaraNajanyasharIraj~jAnasya phalamAha- sharIramityAdi||19||

evaMvAdinaM bhagavantamAtreyamagnivesha uvAca shrutametadyaduktaM bhagavatA sharIrAdhikAre vacaH| kinnu khalu garbhasyA~ggaM pUrvamabhinirvartate kukShau, kuto mukhaH kathaM cAntargatastiShThati, kimAhArashca vartayati, kathambhUtashca niShkrAmati, kaishcAyamAhAropacArairjAtaH sadyo hanyate, kairavyAdhirabhivardhate, ki~jcAsya devAdiprakopanimittA vikArAH sambhavanti Ahosvinna, ki~jcAsya kAlAkAlamRutyvorbhAvAbhAvayorbhagavAnadhyavasyati, ki~jcAsya paramAyuH, kAni cAsya paramAyuSho nimittAnIti||20||

Commentary: sharIravicAyakaM prakaraNaM samApya garbhasharIravicAyakaM prakaraNamArabhate- evaMvAdinamityAdi| kukShAvityantenaikaH prashnaH, kutomukhaH kathaM cAntargatastiShThatIti dvitIyaH, niShkrAmatItyantena tRutIyaH, kaishcAyamAhAropacArairjAtaH sadyo hanyata iti caturthaH, kairavyAdhirabhivardhata iti pa~jcamaH, AhosvinnetyantaH ShaShThaH| sheShaM prashnatrayaM pUrvaprashnadvayasya vyavacchedakameva, evaM nava prashnAH| adhyavasyatIti nishcinoti||20||

tamevamuktavantamagniveshaM bhagavAn punarvasurAtreya uvAca- pUrvamuktametadgarbhAvakrAntau yathA~ayamabhinirvartate kukShau, yaccAsya yadA santiShThate~a~ggajAtam| viprativAdAstvatra bahuvidhAH sUtrakRutAmRuShINAM santi sarveShAM; tAnapi nibodhocyamAnAn- shiraH pUrvamabhinirvartate kukShAviti kumArashirA bharadvAjaH pashyati, sarvendriyANAM tadadhiShThAnamiti kRutvA; hRudayamiti kA~gkAyano bAhlIkabhiShak, cetanAdhiShThAnatvAt; nAbhiriti bhadrakApyaH, AhArAgama iti kRutvA; pakvAshayagudamiti bhadrashaunakaH, mArutAdhiShThAnatvAt; hastapAdamiti baDishaH, tatkaraNatvAt puruShasya; indriyANIti janako vaidehaH, tAnyasya buddhyadhiShThAnAnIti kRutvA; parokShatvAdacintyamiti mArIciH kashyapaH; sarvA~ggAbhinirvRuttiryugapaditi dhanvantariH; tadupapannaM, sarvA~ggAnAM tulyakAlAbhinirvRuttatvAddhRudayaprabhRutInAm| sarvA~ggAnAM hyasya hRudayaM mUlamadhiShThAnaM ca keShA~jcidbhAvAnAm, naca tasmAt pUrvAbhinirvRuttireShAM; tasmAddhRudayaprabhRutInAM sarvA~ggAnAM tulyakAlAbhinirvRuttiH, sarve bhAvA hyanyonyapratibaddhAH; tasmAdyathAbhUtadarshanaM sAdhu||21||

Commentary: yathAkramamuttarANyAha- pUrvamityAdi|- pUrvamuktamiti yaccAsya yadA santiShThate~a~ggajAtaM tadapi garbhAvakrAntau “evamasya yugapadindriyANya~ggAvayavAshca yaugapadyenAbhinirvartante~anyatra tebhyo bhAvebhyo ye~asya jAtasyottarakAlaM jAyante” (shA. 4) ityAdinA granthenoktam| yadyapi ‘kathamabhinirvartate kukShau’ iti neha pRuShTaM, tathA~apyabhinirvRuttikramopadarshanena ‘kinnu khalu garbhasyA~ggaM pUrvamabhinirvartate’ iti prashnasya yathoktotpAdakramopadarshanAduttaratvaM bhavatIti mattvoktaM - uktametadgarbhAvakrAntau yathA~ayamabhinirvartate kukShAviti| uktAmapi yugapada~ggAbhinirvRuttiM matAntaroddhAreNa sthirIkartumAha- viprativAdAstvatretyAdi| pakvAshayashca gudaM ceti pakvAshayagudaM; kiMvA pakvAshayasamIpasthaM gudaM pakvAshayagudam , uttaragudamityarthaH| indriyANIti indriyAdhiShThAnAni nayanagolakAdIni| tadupapannamiti dhanvantarivacanamupapannam; atra hetumAha- sarvA~ggAnAmityAdinA hRudayaprabhRutInAmityantena| atra ca pratij~jAhetvorekatvaM nAsha~gkanIyaM; dhanvantarivacanamupapannamiti pratij~jA, tadabhihitArthasya yugapada~ggAbhinirvRuttirUpasya siddhatvAditi hetvarthaH pratij~jArthAddhinna eva| ye tu ‘tulyakAlAbhivRuddhatvAt ’ iti paThanti, teShAM hetvartho vyakta eva| yena, uttarakAlamapi sarvA~ggAnAM yugapadvRuddhidarshanaM ; samAnakAlavardhamAnAnAM phalAnAmiva samAnakAlameva janmAnumIyate, asamAnakAlajAtAnAM hi na samAnakAlA samA vRuddhirbhavati| pUrvarShINAM matAni hRudayapUrvAbhinirvRuttidUShaNenaiva samAnanyAyAddUShayannAha- sarvA~ggAnAM hyasyetyAdi| mUlamiva mUlaM, tadupaghAtena sarvA~ggopaghAtAt| adhiShThAnamiti AshrayaH| tatraujaHprabhRutInAmadhiShThAnaM hRudayaM bhavati; na ca tasmAt pUrvAbhinirvRuttiriti na ca tathAvidhamUlatvAnnApyadhiShThAnatvAcca pUrvAbhinirvRuttirbhavati| yadi hi mUlaM kAraNamiti mataM syAt, tadA kAryebhyo~a~ggebhyaH prAk hRudayaM syAdapi; na cehA~ggAnAM hRudayaM kAraNaM kintu pradhAnaM, prAdhAnyaM ca tadupaghAtena sarvopaghAtAditi| yashcApyAshrayAshrayibhAvaH, sa cApi sahotpannatvAdeva hRudayamAshrayi tadAshritaujaHprabhRutInAM bhavatIti bhAvaH| tadevaM ceddhRudasya pradhAnasyApi pUrvotpAdo nAsti, tadA shiraHprabhRutInAmapi pUrvotpAdo nAstyeveti kRutvopasaMharannAha- tasmAdityAdi| yugapadabhinirvRuttau hetvantaramAha- sarvabhAvA hItyAdi| bhAvA iti shArIrA bhAvAH| anyonyapratibaddhA iti yasmAt sarvabhAvAH parasparapratibaddhA eva sirAsnAyvAdibhirjAyante, tena samAnanibandhanatvAd yugapadeva bhavanti| yathAbhUtadarshanamiti yathArthadarshanaM, tacca dhanvantarimatameva||21||

garbhastu khalu mAtuH pRuShThAbhimukha UrdhvashirAH sa~gkucyA~ggAnyAste~antaHkukShau ||22||

Commentary: garbhastvityAdi dvitIyaprashnasyottaram||22||

vyapagatapipAsAbubhukShastu khalu garbhaH paratantravRuttirmAtaramAshritya vartayatyupasnehopasvedAbhyAM garbhAshaye sadasadbhUtA~ggAvayavaH, tadanantaraM hyasya kashcillomakUpAyanairupasnehaH kashcinnAbhinADyayanaiH| nAbhyAM hyasya nADI prasaktA, nADyAM cAparA, aparA cAsya mAtuH prasaktA hRudaye, mAtRuhRudayaM hyasya tAmaparAmabhisamplavate sirAbhiH syandamAnAbhiH ; sa tasya raso balavarNakaraH sampadyate, sa ca sarvarasavAnAhAraH| striyA hyApannagarbhAyAstridhA rasaH pratipadyate- svasharIrapuShTaye, stanyAya, garbhavRuddhaye ca| sa tenAhAreNopaShTabdhaH (paratantravRuttirmAtaramAshritya) vartayatyantargataH||23||

Commentary: vyapagata ityAdi ‘kimAhArashca vartayati’ iti prashnasyottaram| paratantravRuttiriti mAtrAdhInavRuttiH| etadeva vivRuNoti- mAtaramityAdi| upasnehaH nisyandaH| sadasadbhUtA~ggAvayava iti cchedaH| tadanantaramiti a~ggapratya~ggavyaktau satyAm| nAbhisaMsaktA nADI nAbhinADI| ayanairiti mArgaiH| aparA garbhasya nAbhinADIpratibaddhA ‘amarA’ iti loke khyAtA| abhisamplavate iti vyApnoti| etaccAparAdijanma garbhAdRuShTavashAdbhavati||23||

sa copasthitakAle janmani prasUtimArutayogAt parivRuttyAvAkshirA niShkrAmatyapatyapathena, eShA prakRutiH, vikRutiH punarato~anyathA| paraM tvataH svatantravRuttirbhavati||24||

Commentary: kathambhUtaH sa niShkrAmatItyasyottaraM- sa copasthitakAla ityAdi|- upasthitakAla iti pratyAsannakAle| vikRutiH punarato~anyathetyanena vikRutyAcaraNenApi nirgamo bhavatIti darshayati| svatantravRuttirbhavatIti svaya~gkRutena stanyapAnAdinA vartate, na garbhastha iva mAturevAhAreNa paraM vartata ityarthaH||24||
tasyAhAropacArau jAtisUtrIyopadiShTAvavikArakarau cAbhivRuddhikarau bhavataH||25||
tAbhyAmeva ca viShamasevitAbhyAM jAtaH sadya upahanyate tarurivAciravyaparopito vAtAtapAbhyAmapratiShThitamUlaH||26||

AptopadeshAdadbhutarUpadarshanAt samutthAnali~ggacikitsitavisheShAccAdoShaprakopAnurUpA devAdiprakopanimittA vikArAH samupalabhyante||27||

Commentary: ki~jcAsyetyAdiprashnasyottaram- AptopadeshAdityAdi| Aptopadesho~atra kumAratantropadesho brahmAdipraNItaH| tatra hi kumArANAM devAdinimittavikArAH pratipAdyante; devAdigrahaNena ca tadanucarA api gRuhyante| skandagrahAdayaH sushrutoktA devAdayashcAShTau| yaduktaM- “devAstathA shatrugaNAshca teShAM gandharvayakShAH pitaro bhuja~ggAH| tathaiva rakShAMsi pishAcajAtireSho~aShTako devagaNo grahAkhyaH” (sU.u.a.60) iti| anumAnamapyatrAha- adbhutetyAdi| na yadbhavati tadadbhutam, Ashcaryamiti yAvat; taccAmAnuShabalaj~jAnashobhAdi j~jeyaM; etaddhi doShAjanyatvAd devAdikAraNaM gamayati| samutthAnAdivisheSha AgantUnAmAgantuvikAreShu sphuTa eva| adoShaprakopAnurUpA iti doShaprakopajanyarogavidharmANaH||27||

kAlAkAlamRutyvostu khalu bhAvAbhAvayoridamadhyavasitaM naH- “yaH kashcin mriyate sa kAla eva mriyate, na hi kAlacchidramasti” ityeke bhAShante| taccAsamyak| na hyacchidratA sacchidratA vA kAlasyopapadyate, kAlasvalakShaNasvabhAvAt| tatrAhurapare- yo yadA mriyate sa tasya niyato mRutyukAlaH; sa sarvabhUtAnAM satyaH, samakriyatvAditi| etadapi cAnyathA~arthagrahaNam| na hi kashcinna mriyata iti samakriyaH| kAlo hyAyuShaH pramANamadhikRutyocyate| yasya ceShTaM yo yadA mriyate sa tasya mRutyukAla iti, tasya sarve bhAvA yathAsvaM niyatakAlA bhaviShyanti; tacca nopapadyate, pratyakShaM hyakAlAhAravacanakarmaNAM phalamaniShTaM, viparyaye ceShTaM; pratyakShatashcopalabhyate khalu kAlAkAlavyaktistAsu tAsvavasthAsu taM tamarthamabhisamIkShya, tadyathA- kAlo~ayamasya vyAdherAhArasyauShadhasya pratikarmaNo visargasya, akAlo veti| loke~apyetadbhavati- kAle devo varShatyakAle devo varShati, kAle shItamakAle shItaM, kAle tapatyakAle tapati, kAle puShpaphalamakAle ca puShpaphalamiti| tasmAdubhayamasti- kAle mRutyurakAle ca; naikAntikamatra| yadi hyakAle mRutyurna syAnniyatakAlapramANamAyuH sarvaM syAt; evaM gate hitAhitaj~jAnamakAraNaM syAt, pratyakShAnumAnopadeshAshcApramANAni syurye pramANabhUtAH sarvatantreShu, yairAyuShyANyanAyuShyANi copalabhyante| vAgvastumAtrametadvAdamRuShayo manyante- nAkAle mRutyurastIti||28||

Commentary: kAlAkAletyAdau idamadhyavasitamityanena prakaraNavyavasthApanIyo~ayamarthaH ‘tasmAdubhayamasti kAle mRutyurakAle ca’ iti granthavakShyamANaM pratyavamRushati| ekIyamatamAha- yaH kashcidityAdi| na hi kAlacchidramastIti kAlarahitaH kashcidavakAsho~asti, yaM kAlashUnyamavakAshamAsAdyAkAlamRutyuH syAditi bhAvaH| etaddUShayati- taccetyAdinA| sAntaraM yadavayavi dravyaM tat sacchidramityucyate, yacca nirantaraM tadacchidram| tena kAlasya niravayavasya sacchidratA~acchidratA vA na sambhavati; tena yaducyate- ‘kAlasyAcchidratvAnna kAlamRutyurasti’ iti, tadayuktamiti bhAvaH| yattvakAlamRutyuvyApakatvena kAlasyopacaritacchidratvaM taduttaravakShyamANaikIyamatadUShaNenaiva dUShitam | kAlasvalakShaNasvabhAvAditi kAlasvalakShaNe sacchidratAyA acchidratAyAshcAbhAvAdityarthaH| ekIyamatAntaramAha- tatrAhurityAdi| yo yadA mriyate sa eva tasya niyato mRutyukAla iti kathaM j~jAyate ityAha- sa sarvabhUtAnAM satyaH samakriyatvAditiH, yasmAt kAlaH sarvabhUtAnAmavisheSheNa mArakatayA samakriyaH, na rAgAt ki~jcidbhUtaM na mArayati, na dveShAdvA ki~jciddhanti, kintu sarvANyeva nihanti, tena sarvabhUtAnAmayaM satyo rAgadveShashUnya ityarthaH| tatashca rAgadveShashUnyatayA ucitakAle eva paraM mArayati, nAnucita iti bhAvaH| dUShayati- etadapItyAdinA| na hi kashcinna mriyata iti kRutvA samakriyaH kAlo bhavatyeva| yattu shatavarShAdilakShaNamAyuHpramANamadhikRutya bhavatA samakriyaH kAlo~abhidhIyate; yadi shatavarShAdyAyuHpramANe~api samakriyaH syAt, tadA na shatavarShAdarvAgUrdhvaM vA kashcinmriyeta, dRushyate caitat; tasmAdevambhUtasamakriyatve kAlasya ucitashatavarShAdyAyuHprApterarvA~gbharaNamakAlamRutyushabdAbhidheyamihAyurvede tannirastaM bhavatIti bhAvaH| akAlamRutyupratiShedhe dUShaNAntaramAha- yasyetyAdi| sarvabhAvA iti mRutyuvyatiriktA apyAhAravacanAdayaH| pratyakShamiti suvyaktapramANe netyarthaH| kAlAkAlavyaktistAsu tAsvavasthAsviti tAstA avasthAH sharIrAdestaM taM vyAdhyAhArAdikamarthaM buddhisthIkRutya kAlAkAlashabdenocyanta ityarthaH| tatra tRutIyadinajvarayuktAyAM tRutIyajvariNo~avasthAyAM tRutIyajvaraM prati kAlo~ayamasyeti vyapadishyate, viparyaye cAkAla iti vyapadeshaH; tathA glAnyAdiyuktAyAM sharIrAvasthAyAmAhArarUpamarthamuddishya kAlo~ayamAhArasyeti j~jAnaM bhavati, viparyaye cAkAlo~ayamityudAharaNamunneyam| visargasyeti vyAdhimokShasya| iha prakaraNe kAlashabdenocitaH kAlo~abhidhIyate, akAlashabdenAnucitaH kAlaH; na tu kAlavirahaH| siddhAntamupasaMharati- tasmAdityAdi| naikAntikamiti kAlamRutyureva paraM bhavati, kiMvA akAlamRutyureva paraM bhavatItyaikAntikapakSho nAsti| akAlamRutyorabhAvapakShe dUShaNAntaramAha- yadi hItyAdi| hitAhitaj~jAnamakAlamRutyupratiShedhAryaM vidhIyate, sa eva cedakAlamRutyurnAsti tadA hitAhitaj~jAnaM niShprayojanaM syAdityarthaH| pratyakShAnumAnopadeshAshcApramANAni syuriti AyurvedasambaddhA pratyakShAdaya AyuShyAnAyuShyopadarshakA AyuShyAnAyuShyArthAbhAvAdapramANabhUtAH syuriti bhAvaH| dUShitaM pakShaM niHsAratayA darshayannAha- vAgityAdi||28||

varShashataM khalvAyuShaH pramANamasmin kAle||29||

Commentary: ‘ki~jcAsya paramAyuH’ ityasya prashnasyottaramAha- varShashatamityAdi| asmin kAle iti kalau||29||

tasya nimittaM prakRutiguNAtmasampat sAtmyopasevanaM ceti||30||

Commentary: sheShaprashnasyottaraM- tasyetyAdi| prakRutiguNAtmasampaditi prakRutisampat, guNasampat, Atmasampat| tatra prakRutisampat samavAtAdiprakRutitA, samaprakRutirhi cirAyurbhavati; guNasampattu sArasaMhananAdibhirAyuShmallakShaNairyogaH, kiMvA prakRutermAtRupitrAdyupakaraNasya guNasampat sA prakRutiguNasampat; Atmanastu cirAyuShTvakArakadharmayuktatA sampat||30||
tatra shlokAH- sharIraM yadyathA tacca vartate kliShTamAmayaiH| yathA kleshaM vinAshaM ca yAti ye cAsya dhAtavaH||31||
vRuddhihrAsau yathA teShAM kShINAnAmauShadhaM ca yat| dehavRuddhikarA bhAvA balavRuddhikarAshca ye||32||
pariNAmakarA bhAvA yA ca teShAM pRuthak kriyA| malAkhyAH samprasAdAkhyA dhAtavaH prashna eva ca||33||
navako nirNayashcAsya vidhivat samprakAshitaH| tathyaH sharIravicaye shArIre paramarShiNA||34||

tatra sharIraM nAma cetanAdhiShThAnabhUtaM pa~jcamahAbhUtavikArasamudAyAtmakaM samayogavAhi | yadA hyasmi~j sharIre dhAtavo vaiShamyamApadyante tadA kleshaM vinAshaM vA prApnoti| vaiShamyagamanaM hi punardhAtUnAM vRuddhihrAsagamanamakArtsnyena prakRutyA ca||4||

Commentary: samuditasyaiva tAvaccharIrasya svarUpamAha- tatretyAdi| cetanAshabdena j~jAnakAraNamAtmocyate, bhUtashabda upamAne; tena, cetanAyA AtmasambandhinyAH sharIre evopalambhAdAtmanaH sharIramadhiShThAnamiti bhavati; paramArthastu cetanA AtmAshrayA, AtmA ca nirAshraya eva; kiMvA cetanasyAtmano~adhiShThAnabhUtamiti cetanAdhiShThAnabhUtam| pa~jcAnAM mahAbhUtAnAM vikArA rasAdayaH sharIrArambhakAH, teShAM samudAyo melakaH, sa AtmA svarUpaM yasya tattathA| samudAyashabdena ca samudAyArambhakA dhAtava evocyante; tena, na saMyogamAtrasya sharIratvaprasaktiH| kiMvA, samudAyaH saMyoga evocyatAM, tathA~api samudAya AtmA kAraNaM yasya sharIrasya dravyarUpasya tat pa~jcamahAbhUtavikArasamudAyAtmakaM sharIrameva| samena ucitapramANena dhAtUnAM melakena samya~gnIrogatayA vahatIti samayogavAhi| yadA tu dhAtUnAM nyUnAtiriktatvena viShamo melako bhavati, tadA asamayogavAhIti darshayannAha- yadA hItyAdi| laghunA vaiShamyeNa rogamAtrajanakena kleshaM, mahatA tvasAdhyarogajanakena vaiShamyeNa vinAshaM maraNaM prApnoti sharIram| atha kiM tadvaiShamyamityAha- vaiShamyagamanamityAdi| vaiShamyagamanaM vaiShamyAvasthAprAptiH, vaiShamyameva kAdAcitkamityarthaH; yadi hi vaiShamyamityeva brUyAt, tadA sahajasiddhamapi dhAtUnAM yannyUnAtiriktatvena vaiShamyaM tadapi shiShyeNa gRuhyeta; tena, gamanapadaprakShepAt sahajaM vaiShamyaM parityajya svapramANApekShayaiva kadAcidutpadyamAnaM vaiShamyaM darshayati| vRuddhihrAsagamanaM ceha vyastaM samastaM ca vaiShamyaM j~jeyam| vRuddhihrAsasyaiva visheShAnAha- akArtsnyena prakRutyA ceti; akArtsnyeti ekadeshena, prakRutyeti sakalena svabhAvena| etena ca rasAdInAM cAMshena vRuddhihrAsau, tathA kArtsnyena vRuddhihrAsAvupagRuhItau bhavataH| anye tu, ‘akArtsnyena’ itipadaM kleshaM vinAshaM vA prApnotItyanena samaM yojayanti| tena, yadA~api dhAtavo vaiShamyamApadyante, tadA~api nAvashyaM kleshavinAshau bhavataH, akArtsnyenetipadena kleshavinAshavyabhicArasyAbhihitatvAt; dRuShTaM caitat, yathA- vRuShyaprayogAcchukravRuddhau satyAmapi na kleshavinAshau bhavataH, tathA bAlasya vardhamAnadhAtorapi guNa eva paraM dRushyate| tacca nAtisundaraM, yato bAlasya vardhamAnadhAtorapi vayo~anurUpAH prAkRutamAnasthitA eva dhAtavo bhavanti, tena na te prAkRutamAnA vRuddhA ucyante; yA tu vRuShyaprayogajA shukravRuddhiH, sA yadi vikArakArikA na bhavati tadA tu prAkRutamAnAntargataiva| etadeva dhAtUnAM prAkRutamAnaM- yadavikArakAritvam| a~jjalyAdimAnaM tu adUrAntareNAbhihitamapi nityaparokShatayA punaH svAbhAvikadhAtulakShaNaireva j~jAtavyaM; tasmAcchukrasya yAvatI vRuddhiradoShA, tAvatI prAkRutamAnAvasthArUpaiva| prAkRutamAnAtiriktau ceha vRuddhihrAsau vaiShamyagamanashabdenocyete, tasmAdAdyaiva vyAkhyA| tathA na kevalaM vRuddhihrAsagamanameva vaiShamyagamanaM, kintu prakRutyA ca vaiShamyagamanaM dhAtUnAM bhavatIti vyAkhyAnayanti; tathAhi- “prakRutisthaM yadA pittaM mArutaH shleShmaNaH kShaye” (sU.a.17) ityAdau prakRutisthasyApi doShasya vikArakartRutvamucyate, vikArakArakasya ca doShasya prakRutisthatA~api vaiShamyArthakriyAkAritvena vaiShamyashabdenocyate| tadapi nAtisundaram| yena, pradeshAntareShvapi trividhAM gatiM pratipAdya prakRutisthatA dhAtUnAM nirvikArA evoktA; yathA- “kShINA jahati li~ggaM svaM, samAH svaM karma kurvate| doShAH pravRuddhAH svaM li~ggaM darshayanti yathAbalam” (sU.a.17); tathA “vikAro dhAtuvaiShamyaM sAmyaM prakRutirucyate| sukhasa~jj~jakamArogyaM vikAro duHkhameva ca” (sU.a.9) evamAdiShu| yattu “prakRutisthaM yadA pittaM” ityAdau svamAnAvasthitasyApi pittAdervikArakartRutvaM, taccharIrapradeshAntaranItasya pittAdestatra tatra pradeshe vRuddhasyaiva vikArakartRutvaM; svamAnasthito~api doShaH pradeshAntaraM nItaH san tatpradeshasthadoShApekShayA vRuddha eva bhavati, tena tatrApi vRuddhasyaiva vikArakartRutvaM, prapa~jcitashcAyamarthastatraiva granthe| yatrApi svamAnasthitAnAmeva raktAdInAM vAtAdiduShTyA vikArakartRutvaM, tatrApi vAtAdaya eva vRuddhAH prAdhAnyena vikArakarAH, raktAdayo~api tatra duShTadoShasambandhAdhInasvaguNA vRuddhasvaguNA vA bhavanti, tato guNahAnivRuddhibhyAM vRuddhihrAsau dUShye~api tiShThata eveti na prakRutisthasya vikArakAritvamiti pashyAmaH||4||

yaugapadyena tu virodhinAM dhAtUnAM vRuddhihrAsau bhavataH| yaddhi yasya dhAtorvRuddhikaraM tattato viparItaguNasya dhAtoH pratyavAyakaraM sampadyate||5||

Commentary: upayuktabheShajena yathA vRuddhihrAsau bhavatastadAha- yaugapadyenetyAdi| virodhinAmiti parasparaviruddhaguNAnAm| etadevopapattyA sAdhayannAha- yaddhItyAdi| yaddhi bheShajaM, yathA- kShIraM kaphashukrAdivRuddhikaraM, tat kaphashukrAderviparItaguNasya vAtAdeH pratyavAyakaraM bhavati, hrAsakaraM bhavatItyarthaH| viparItasyeti kartavye yadviparItaguNasyeti karoti, tena jAtivaiparItyAdguNavaiparItyameva hrAsakAraNaM prAdhAnyena darshayati| tena, gomUtraM dravatvena jAtyA samAnamapi kaTUShNarUkShAdiviparItaguNayogAt kaphasyApahArakameva||5||

tadeva tasmAdbheShajaM samyagavacAryamANaM yugapannyUnAtiriktAnAM dhAtUnAM sAmyakaraM bhavati, adhikamapakarShati nyUnamApyAyayati||6||

Commentary: upapAditaM yaugapadyena dhAtUnAM vRuddhihrAsagamanamupasaMharannAha- tadevetyAdi| samyagupacaryamANamityanena ucitamAtrAdiprayogaM, tathA dhAtusAmyAvadhibheShajaprayogaM ca darshayati; mAtrAdiviguNaM hi bheShajaM na svocitAM kriyAM karoti; yathA- vRuddhasya kaphasya kShINasya ca pittasya kShayavRuddhibhyAM sAmyArthaM yadupayujyate kaTvAdi tat sAmyApattyuttarakAlamapyupayujyamAnaM pittavRuddhyA kaphakShayeNa ca punarvaiShamyamAvahati; tasmAdetaddoShavyAvRuttyarthaM samyagupacaryamANamiti kRutam| nanu, pUrvamuktaM bheShajena virodhinAM dhAtUnAM vRuddhihrAsau bhavataH, upasaMhAre tu dhAtUnAM sAmyakara bheShajaM bhavatItyucyate, tatkathaM nArthabheda ityAsha~gkya vRuddhihrAsakarameva dhAtusAmyakaraM bhavatIti darshayannAha- adhikamapakarShati, nyUnamApyAyayatIti| evambhUtaM ca dhAtusAmyakaraNaM yatraiva virodhinAM vRuddhihrAsau vidyete tatraiva j~jeyaM, na sarvatra| tena yatra vRuddhireva paraM doShANAM na kShayaH kasyacit, tatra yathA vRuddhasya doShasya kShayAdhAnamuktaM na tathA kShINasya vardhanamiti j~jeyam||6||

etAvadeva hi bhaiShajyaprayoge phalamiShTaM svasthavRuttAnuShThAne ca yAvaddhAtUnAM sAmyaM syAt| svasthA hyapi dhAtUnAM sAmyAnugrahArthameva kushalA rasaguNAnAhAravikArAMshca paryAyeNecchantyupayoktuM sAtmyasamAj~jAtAn; ekaprakArabhUyiShThAMshcopayu~jjAnAstadviparItakarasamAj~jAtayA ceShTayA samamicchanti kartum||7||

Commentary: uktadhAtusAmyasyopAdeyatAM darshayituM bheShajaprayogasya tathA svasthavRuttAnuShThAnasya dhAtusAmyAtiriktaM phalaM niShedhayannAha- etAvadevetyAdi| etAvadevetyanena vakShyamANadhAtusAmyaM pratyavamRushati| dhAtusAmyAtmako rogaprashamo hi bheShajasAdhyo na dhAtusAmyAdatiricyate, tathA svasthasyojaskararasAyanenApi dhAtusAmyameva vishiShTamAdhIyate; tena dhAtusAmyAdatiriktamAyurvedasAdhyaM nAstIti bhAvaH| uktaM ca- “dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam” (sU.a.1) iti| nanu svasthe dhAtusAmyaM siddhameva, na ca siddhaM sAdhyate, tat kathaM svasthavRuttAnuShThAne~api dhAtusAmyameva phalamityAha- svasthA hyapItyAdi| sAmyAnugrahArthamiti sata eva sAmyasya parAparasAmyotpAdena paripAlanArtham| rasA madhurAdayaH| guNA gurvAdayaH| AhAravikArAH AdyakhAdyalehyapeyarUpA yavAgvAdayaH| paryAyeNeti ucitena krameNa; sa ca kramo yathA- madhuramupayujya tajjanyakaphavRuddhyAdipratibandhArthaM kaTvAdyupayojyamityAdirasakramaH, tathA gurumupayujya tatkAryapratibandhArthaM laghUpayoga ityevamprakAro guNAnAmupayogakramaH, AhAravikAreShvapi khAdyAdyupayujya tatpAkAryaM peyopayoga ityAdikaH kramaH| guNashabdena ca rasA api prApyante, tathA~api rasAH prAdhAnyAt pRuthaguktAH| sAtmyasamAj~jAtAniti rasaguNAnityasya tathA AhAravikArAMshcetyasya visheShaNam| sAtmyAshca te abhyAsena tathA samatvena ca svAbhAvikapathyatvenAj~jAtA iti sAtmyasamAj~jAtAH, samashabdena hyatra pathyamucyate; kiMvA sarvadA sAtmyatvena samAj~jAtAH sAtmyasamAj~jAtAH; tena, asAtmyAnAM rasAdInAmupayogameva pratikShipati| atha yatra tAvadrasAdayaH paryAyeNopayujyante tatra sAdhu, yatra tvekaprakArA eva rasAdayaH kutashciddhetorabhyasyante tatra ko vidhirityAha- ekaprakAretyAdi| tata upayuktaikaprakArarasAdibhUyiShThAd rasAderviparItamarthaM karotIti tadviparItakarI samAj~jAtA ceShTA, tayA ceShTayA samaM kartumicchantIti| ekaprakArabhUyiShThAdyupayogenAdhIyamAnavaiShamyaM sharIraM samaM samadhAtuM kartumicchanti| etadudAharaNaM yathA- madhuraprakArabhUyiShThaM ya AhAraprakAramupayu~gkte tasya madhurasamAnakaphAdivRuddhimAsha~gkya kaphAdikarmakShayakarI yA vyAyAmAdiceShTA tayA sAmyamAdhIyate| kiMvA, tadviparItakarI tathA samatvena ca Aj~jAtA yA ceShTA sA tadviparItakarasamAj~jAtA, tena kriyamANamatiyogAdi niShedhayati||7||

deshakAlAtmaguNaviparItAnAM hi karmaNAmAhAravikArANAM ca kriyopayogaH samyak, sarvAtiyogasandhAraNam, asandhAraNamudIrNAnAM ca gatimatAM, sAhasAnAM ca varjanaM, svasthavRuttametAvaddhAtUnAM sAmyAnugrahArthamupadishyate||8||

Commentary: samprati prastAvAgataM svasthavRuttaM samAsenAha- deshetyAdi| deshAdibhirguNashabdaH sambadhyate| Atmashabdeneha sharIramucyate| deshaviparItaM karma yathA- marau svapnaH, kAlaviparItaM karma yathA- vasante vyAyAmaH, AtmaviparItaM karma yathA- sthUlasharIre vyAyAmajAgaraNAdi| evamAhAraprabhedAshca deshakAlAdiviparItA unneyAH| karmaNAM kriyA, AhAravikArANAM copayoga iti yathAsa~gkhyaM yojanIyam| samyagiti kriyayA upayogena ca samaM j~jeyam| atikrAnto yogamityatiyogo mithyAtiyogAyogarUpo j~jeyaH; tena, sarveShAM kAlabuddhIndriyArthamithyAyogAdInAM varjanaM sarvAtiyogasandhAraNam| kAlamithyAyogAdestu duShpariharasya pratikriyaiva varjanam| gatimatAmiti purIShAdInAM bahirgamanashIlAnAm| sAhasAnAm ayathAbalamArambhAdInAm||8||

puruShavicayaM mokShopayuktatvena puruShopakArakamabhidhAya, vyAkriyamANacikitsopayuktaM sharIropakArakaM sharIravicayaM brUte| sharIrasya vicayanaM vicayaH sharIrasya pravibhAgena j~jAnamityarthaH| sharIropakArArthamiti sharIrArogyArtham| atha kathaM sharIraj~jAnaM sharIropakArakamityAha- j~jAtvA hItyAdi| sharIrasya raktAdirUpasya svabhAvarUpaM tattvaM j~jAtvaiva idamasya vRuddhasya dhAtorasamAnaguNatayA hrAsakatvenopakArakamiti, tathoktaviparyayAccApakArakamiti j~jAnaM jAyate, nopakAryasharIratattvaj~jAne~asatIti vAkyArthaH||1-3||
kaishcAyamityAdiprashnasyottaraM- tasyetyAdi| jAtisUtrIyopadiShTAviti anAgatAvekShaNenAnAgate bhUtavatprayogAdboddhavyam| aciravyaparopitaH adIrghakAlAropitaH||25-26||

sa~ggrahe ye cAsya dhAtava iti yAdRushAshcAsya dhAtava ityarthaH| etacca ‘vaiShamyagamanaM punardhAtUnAM’ ityAdigranthena dhAtudharmaprakAshakatvenoktaM j~jeyam| anye tu ye cAsya dhAtava ityanena ‘mAMsaM mAMsena vardhate’ ityAdi dhAturUpANAM punarmAMsAdInAM sa~ggraho~ayamiti vadanti| vRuddhihrAsau yathA teShAmityanena ‘dhAtavaH punaH’ ityAdigranthArthaM gRuhNAti| kShINAnAmauShadhaM ca yaditi mAMsamApyAyyate mAMsenetyAdi sa~ggRuhNAti| yA ca teShAM pRuthak kriyetyanena teShAmAhArapariNAmakarANAmUShmaprabhRutInAM pRuthakkarma yaduktaM ‘UShmA pacati’ ityAdinA granthena tadgRuhyate||31-34||
athAtaH sharIrasa~gkhyAshArIraM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
sharIrasa~gkhyAmavayavashaH kRutsnaM sharIraM pravibhajya sarvasharIrasa~gkhyAnapramANaj~jAnahetorbhagavantamAtreyamagniveshaH papraccha||3||
nava mahanti chidrANi- sapta shirasi, dve cAdhaH||12||
etAvaddRushyaM shakyamapi nirdeShTum||13||

anirdeshyamataH paraM tarkyameva| tadyathA- nava snAyushatAni, sapta sirAshatAni, dve dhamanIshate, catvAri peshIshatAni, saptottaraM marmashataM, dve sandhishate, ekonatriMshatsahasrANi nava ca shatAni ShaTpa~jcAshatkAni sirAdhamanInAmaNushaH pravibhajyamAnAnAM mukhAgraparimANaM, tAvanti caiva keshashmashrulomAnIti| etadyathAvatsa~gkhyAtaM tvakprabhRuti dRushyaM, tarkyamataH param| etadubhayamapi na vikalpate, prakRutibhAvAccharIrasya||14||

Commentary: ataH paraM tarkyameveti atastvagAdeH paraM yat snAyvAdi tat prAyastarkyameva anumAnagamyamevetyarthaH| yadyapi snAyvAdyapi pratyakShaM bhavati, tathA~apIha vakShyamANasa~gkhyAyuktaM sarvaM snAyvAdi na pratyakSheNa sukaragrahamiti tarkyamityuktam| snAyvAdibhedAnevAha- nava snAyushatAnItyAdi| aNushaH pravibhajyamAnAnAmiti aNuprabhedena bhidyamAnAnAm| mukhAgraparimANamiti mukharUpasyAgrasya parimANam| atra yAnyeva sapta sirAshatAni dhamanIshatadvayaM coktaM tadeva sUkShmapratAnAgrabhedagaNanayA ekonatriMshatsahasrANi nava ca shatAni ShaTpa~jcAshatkAni bhavanti, sthUlagaNanatayA tu pUrvasa~gkhyA sirAdhamanyantarbhavatIti na virodhaH| tAvanti caiva keshashmashrulomAnIti ekonatriMshatsahasrANi navashatAni ShaTpa~jcAshatkAni keshashmashrulomnAM bhavantItyarthaH| etacca keshAdisa~gkhyAnaM sthUlasirAmukhagatakeshAdivibhAgena j~jeyaM, sUkShmatamavibhAgena tu keshAdInAM bahutvamapi shAstrAntaroktaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| etat tvakprabhRuti dRushyaM tarkyaM ca snAyvAdi yathAvat sa~gkhyAtamiti yojanA| samprati yathoktaM tvagAdInAM mAnaM prakRutisthe sharIre na vyabhicaratIti darshayannAha- etadubhayamityAdi| ubhayamiti dRushyaM tarkyaM ca| prakRutibhAvAditi avikRutatvAccharIrasya| yatra tu sharIraM vikRutaM bhavati tatra yathoktaM tvagAdimAnamapi vikRutaM bhavatIti bhAvaH| kiMvA, etadyathAvatsa~gkhyAtamiti chedaH| ekIyamatamAha- ‘tvakprabhRuti dRushyaM tarkyameva caike’ iti pAThaH| arthastu- tvakprabhRuti yaduktaM dRushyaM tadapi tarkyamevetyeke AcAryA bruvate, tadubhayamiti tadekIyamatamasmanmataM ca, na vikalpate iti yathoktAvayavasa~gkhyA(vya)tirekeNa na vyavasthApyate; prakRutibhAvAccharIrasyeti pUrvavad vyAkhyeyam| etena yattvagAdi tarkyameva vA bhavatu, dRushyaM tarkyabhedabhinnaM vA bhavatu, tathA~api yathoktaM sa~gkhyAM nAtikrAmatIti vAkyArthaH||14||

yattva~jjalisa~gkhyeyaM tadupadekShyAmaH; tat paraM pramANamabhij~jeyaM, tacca vRuddhihrAsayogi, tarkyameva| tadyathA- dashodakasyA~jjalayaH sharIre svenA~jjalipramANena, yattu pracyavamAnaM purIShamanubadhnAtyatiyogena tathA mUtraM rudhiramanyAMshca sharIradhAtUn, yattu sarvasharIracaraM bAhyA tvagbibharti, yattu tvagantare vraNagataM lasIkAshabdaM labhate, yaccoShmaNA~anubaddhaM lomakUpebhyo niShpatat svedashabdamavApnoti, tadudakaM dashA~jjalipramANaM; navA~jjalayaH pUrvasyAhArapariNAmadhAtoH, yaM ‘rasa’ ityAcakShate; aShTau shoNitasya, sapta purIShasya, ShaT shleShmaNaH, pa~jca pittasya, catvAro mUtrasya, trayo vasAyAH, dvau medasaH, eko majjAyAH, mastiShkasyArdhA~jjaliH, shukrasya tAvadeva pramANaM, tAvadeva shlaiShmikasyaujasa iti| etaccharIratattvamuktam||15||

Commentary: nanu yathA prakRutisthe sharIre yathoktaM mAnaM tvagAdi na vyabhicarati, tathA kiM prakRutisthe sharIre tadudakAdyapi yathoktaM mAnaM na vyabhicaratItyAha- yattva~jjalItyAdi| yattu udakAdi a~jjalisa~gkhyeyamagre vakShyamANaM, tadudakAdeH paramutkRuShTaM pramANam| tena prakRutisthe~api sharIre udakAdi vRuddhihrAsayogi bhavatIti tarkyameva| etena, yadudakAderiha pramANamabhidhAtavyaM tat prakRuShTasyodakAdeH pramANaM; tenoktapramANAt ki~jcinnyUnamapi tathA~adhikamapi yadudakAdimAnaM tadapi prakRutamAnameva| dashodakA~jjaya ityAdAvabhidhAyApi tadudakaM dashA~jjalipramANamiti punaryat karoti, tena madhyagranthakRutalasIkAsvedAdisa~jj~jayA udakasyAnanyatAM darshayati| pUrvasyeti prathamasya| vasA mAMsasnehaH| mastiShkaH shirogatasnehaH| shlaiShmikasyaujasa ityanena yadojo~aShTabindukaM tadvyatiriktasyaujasa ojovahadhamanIvAhyasya vishuddhashleShmasamAnaguNasyArdhA~jjalipramANatAM darshayati| ojo hi parAvarabhedena dvividhamarthedashamahAmUlIye darshitameva||15||

tatra yadvisheShataH sthUlaM sthiraM mUrtimadgurukharakaThinama~ggaM nakhAsthidantamAMsacarmavarcaHkeshashmashrulomakaNDarAdi tat pArthivaM gandho ghrANaM ca; yaddravasaramandasnigdhamRudupicchilaM rasarudhiravasAkaphapittamUtrasvedAdi tadApyaM raso rasanaM ca; yat pittamUShmA ca yo yA ca bhAH sharIre tat sarvamAgneyaM rUpaM darshanaM ca; yaducchvAsaprashvAsonmeShanimeShAku~jcanaprasAraNagamanapreraNadhAraNAdi tadvAyavIyaM sparshaH sparshanaM ca; yadviviktaM yaducyate mahAnti cANUni srotAMsi tadAntarIkShaM shabdaH shrotraM ca; yat prayoktRu tat pradhAnaM buddhirmanashca| iti sharIrAvayavasa~gkhyA yathAsthUlabhedenAvayavAnAM nirdiShTA||16||
