Commentary: sharIrAvayavasa~gkhyAM pramANato~abhidhAya pArthivAdibhedenAvayavAnabhidhAtumAha- tatretyAdi| saraM ki~jcidgatimat| mandaM mandakriyam| viviktamiti vibhaktam| yaducyata iti vacanamityarthaH| shabdagrahaNeneha vacanavyatiriktaH shabdaH shArIro gRuhyate, vacanasya yaducyata itipadenaiva gRuhItatvAt| prayoktRu iti yaccharIrAdiprerakaM cetanam| yathAsthUlabhedeneti vacanAt sUkShmAvayavabhedena paramANurUpeNAsa~gkhyeyatAM vakShyamANAM sUcayati| atibahutvAdityanenAtibahutvamapi ga~ggAvAlukAnAmivAsa~gkhyAtaheturbhavatIti darshayati||16||

sharIrAvayavAstu paramANubhedenAparisa~gkhyeyA bhavanti, atibahutvAdatisaukShmyAdatIndriyatvAcca| teShAM saMyogavibhAge paramANUnAM kAraNaM vAyuH karmasvabhAvashca||17||

Commentary: atisaukShmyAditi atisUkShmabuddhibodhyatvAt| atIndriyatvaM ca paramANUnAM svabhAvasiddhamevAsmadAdIn prati| yattu sUkShmamatIndriyaM vA tat parisa~gkhyAtuM nitarAmeva duHshakaM bhavatIti yuktaM hetutrayamaparisa~gkhyAne| athaite viShayakalitAH paramANavaH kathaM sharIrArambhe saMyujyante, sharIravinAshe ca viyujyanta ityAha- teShAmityAdi| nanu yadi vAyuH kAraNaM paramANUnAM saMyogavibhAge, tat kimiti sarvadA tau na karotItyAha- karmasvabhAvashceti| na kevalo vAyuH kintu karmasvabhAvaparigRuhIta eva| tena yadA saMyojakasvabhAvena karmaNA parigRuhIto vAyurbhavati tadA paramANUnAM saMyogaM kurva~jcharIramArabhate; yadA tu viyojanasvabhAvena karmaNA vAyuH parigRuhIto bhavati tadA vibhAgaM paramANUnAM vinAsharUpaM janayatItyarthaH||17||

tadetaccharIraM sa~gkhyAtamanekAvayavaM dRuShTamekatvena sa~ggaH, pRuthaktvenApavargaH| tatra pradhAnamasaktaM sarvasattAnivRuttau nivartate iti||18||

Commentary: idAnIM sharIrasa~gkhyAnaphalamAha- tadetadityAdi| paramArthato~anekAvayavamapi ta(sa)ccharIraM sa~gkhyAne mohAdekatvena dRuShTaM sa~gga ucyate sa~ggaheturbhavatItyarthaH| ekatvena hi sharIraM pashyan tadupakArAya pravartamAno rAgadveShAbhyAM sakto bhavati| apavarga iti apavargaheturityarthaH| sharIraM hi pRuthagavayavabhedena bhAvyamAnaM na mamatAspadaM bhavati, mamatAbhAvAcca na tadupakArakApakArakeShu rAgadveShau bhavataH, tadabhAvAcca pravRuttyuparame sati dharmAdharmAbhAvAdapavargo bhavatItyarthaH| sharIrapRuthaktvasa~gkhyAne yathA mokSho bhavati tadAha- tatretyAdi| pradhAnam AtmA| tatreti sharIrapRuthaktvabhAvanAyAm| asaktamiti yathoktakrameNa rAgadveSharahitam| sarvasattAnivRuttAviti sarvatropakArake vA~apakArake ca bhAve AsthAnivRuttau satyAm| nivartata iti saMsAro nivartate||18||
tatra shlokau- sharIrasa~gkhyAM yo veda sarvAvayavasho bhiShak| tadaj~jAnanimittena sa mohena na yujyate||19||
amUDho mohamUlaishca na doShairabhibhUyate| nirdoSho niHspRuhaH shAntaH prashAmyatyapunarbhavaH||20||

tamuvAca bhagavAnAtreyaH- shRuNu matto~agnivesha! sarvasharIramAcakShANasya yathA prashnamekamanA yathAvat| sharIre ShaT tvacaH; tadyathA- udakadharA tvagbAhyA, dvitIyA tvasRugdharA, tRutIyA sidhmakilAsasambhavAdhiShThAnA, caturthI dadrUkuShThasambhavAdhiShThAnA, pa~jcamI tvalajIvidradhisambhavAdhiShThAnA, ShaShThI tu yasyAM chinnAyAM tAmyatyandha iva ca tamaH pravishati yAM cApyadhiShThAyArUMShi jAyante parvasu kRuShNaraktAni sthUlamUlAni dushcikitsyatamAni ca; iti ShaT tvacaH| etAH ShaDa~ggaM sharIramavatatya tiShThanti||4||

Commentary: AcakShANasyetyatra ‘mataM’ iti sheShaH; tena sarvaM sharIramAcakShANasya me mataM shRuNviti yojanA| tatashca ‘naTasya shRuNoti’ iti- vadanupayoge ShaShThI| kiM ca ‘me vacanaM shRuNu’ ityanena matAntaramapyasti sharIrAvayavasa~gkhyAna iti sUcayati| tatashca sushrute- “sapta tvacaH, trINyasthishatAni” (su. shA. 5) ityAdinA yadiha pratipAditasa~gkhyAviruddhamucyate, tacchalyashAstropayuktatvAditi darshayati| yaduktaM sushrute- “trINi saShaShTIni shatAnyasthnAM vedavido bhAShante, shalyatantre tu trINyeva shatAni” (su. shA. 5) iti| anena vacanena yo~anyo~api tvagAdisa~gkhyAbhedashcarakasushrutayoH sa svatantropayuktasa~gkhyopAdAnAdunneyaH | sidhmakilAsasambhavAdhiShThAneti sidhmakilAsau yato doShAt sambhavatastasya doShasyAdhiShThAnabhUtA; evamuttaratrApi vyAkhyeyam| tAmyatItyasya vivaraNam- ‘andha iva tamaH pravishati’ iti; kiMvA tAmyatIti tamoyukta iva ceShTate| arUMShIti vraNAni| parvasviti avayavasandhiShu||4||

tatrAyaM sharIrasyA~ggavibhAgaH; tadyathA- dvau bAhU, dve sakthinI, shirogrIvam, antarAdhiH, iti ShaDa~ggama~ggam||5||

Commentary: ShaDa~ggatAmuktAM sharIrasya vibhajate- tatrAyamityAdi| shirashca grIvA ca shirogrIvam; etaccaikyavivakShayA j~jeyam| antarAdhiH madhyam||5||

trINi saShaShTIni shatAnyasthnAM saha dantolUkhalanakhena | tadyathA- dvAtriMshaddantAH, dvAtriMshaddantolUkhalAni, viMshatirnakhAH, ShaShTiH pANipAdA~ggulyasthIni, viMshatiH pANipAdashalAkAH, catvAri pANipAdashalAkAdhiShThAnAni, dve pArShNyorasthinI, catvAraH pAdayorgulphAH, dvau maNikau hastayoH, catvAryaratnyorasthIni, catvAri ja~gghayoH, dve jAnunI, dve jAnukapAlike, dvAvUrunalakau, dvau bAhunalakau, dvAvaMsau, dve aMsaphalake, dvAvakShakau, ekaM jatru, dve tAluke, dve shroNiphalake, ekaM bhagAsthi, pa~jcacatvAriMshat pRuShThagatAnyasthIni, pa~jcadasha grIvAyAM, caturdashorasi, dvayoH pArshvayoshcaturviMshatiH parshukAH, tAvanti sthAlakAni, tAvanti caiva sthAlakArbudAni, ekaM hanvasthi, dve hanumUlabandhane, ekAsthi nAsikAgaNDakUTalalATaM, dvau sha~gkhau, catvAri shiraHkapAlAnIti; evaM trINi saShaShTIni shatAnyasthnAM saha dantolUkhalanakheneti||6||

Commentary: saShaShTInIti ShaShTyA~adhikAni| dantAnAmulUkhalA yatrAshritA dantAH| yadyapi nakhA vividhAshitapItIye malabhAgapoShyatvena male eva prakShiptAH, tathA~apIhAsthitArUpayogasyApi vidyamAnatvAdasthigaNanAyAM paThitAH| pratya~gguli parvatrayaM, tena viMshatya~gguligatamasthnAM viMshatitrayaM bhavati| vRuddhA~gguShThe yaddhastapAdapraviShTaM tattRutIyaM parva j~jeyam| vRuddhA~gguShThashalAkA~api svalpapramANA j~jeyA| a~ggulInAM shalAkA yatra saMlagnAstacchalAkAdhiShThAnam| jAnu ja~gghorvoH sandhiH| akShakau arvAk jatrusandheH kIlakau| tAluke tAlvasthinI| bhagAsthi abhimukhaM kaTIsandhAnakArakaM tiryagasthi| sthAlakAnIti parshukAnAM mUlasthAnalagnAni | sthAlakArbudAni tu parshukAmUlAnyarbudAkArANyasthIni | nAsikAgaNDakUTalalATAnAmekamUlatvAdekamevAsthi gaNanIyaM, ye tu pRuthaggaNanAM kurvanti teShAM nAsAgaNDakUTalalATAnAM trayANAM trINyevAsthInIti na sa~gkhyApUraNam||6||

pa~jcendriyAdhiShThAnAni; tadyathA- tvag, jihvA, nAsikA, akShiNI, karNau ca| pa~jca buddhIndriyANi; tadyathA- sparshanaM, rasanaM, ghrANaM, darshanaM, shrotramiti| pa~jca karmendriyANi; tadyathA- hastau, pAdau, pAyuH, upasthaH, jihvA ceti||7||
hRudayaM cetanAdhiShThAnamekam||8||

dasha prANAyatanAni; tadyathA- mUrdhA, kaNThaH, hRudayaM, nAbhiH, gudaM, bastiH, ojaH, shukraM, shoNitaM, mAMsamiti| teShu ShaT pUrvANi marmasa~gkhyAtAni||9||

Commentary: iha dashaprANAyataneShu dashaprANAyatanIyoktau sha~gkhau parityajya nAbhirmAMsaM ca gRuhItaM, tena nAbhimAMsayorapi prANAyatanatvaM tathA sha~gkhayoshca pAThadvayadarshanAdboddhavyam| yaduktaM dashaprANAyatanIye- “dashaivAyatanAnyAhuH prANA yeShu pratiShThitAH, sha~gkhau marmatrayaM kaNTho raktaM shukraujasI gudam” (sU.a.29) iti||9||

pa~jcadasha koShThA~ggAni; tadyathA- nAbhishca, hRudayaM ca, kloma ca, yakRucca, plIhA ca, vRukkau ca, bastishca, purIShAdhArashca, AmAshayashca, pakvAshayashca, uttaragudaM ca, adharagudaM ca, kShudrAntraM ca, sthUlAntraM ca, vapAvahanaM ceti||10||

Commentary: kloma pipAsAsthAnam| bastiH mUtrAshayaH| uttaragudaH yatra purIShamavatiShThate, yena tu purIShaM niShkrAmati tadadharagudam| vapAvahanaM medaHsthAnaM ‘tailavartikA’ iti khyAtam||10||

ShaTpa~jcAshat pratya~ggAni ShaTsva~ggeShUpanibaddhAni, yAnyaparisa~gkhyAtAni pUrvama~ggeShu parisa~gkhyAyamAneShu, tAnyanyaiH paryAyairiha prakAshyAni bhavanti| tadyathA- dve ja~gghApiNDike, dve UrupiNDike, dvau sphicau, dvau vRuShaNau, ekaM shephaH, dve ukhe, dvau   va~gkShaNau, dvau kukundarau, ekaM bastishIrSham, ekamudaraM, dvau stanau, dvau shleShmabhuvau , dve bAhupiNDike, cibukamekaM, dvAvoShThau, dve sRukkaNyau, dvau dantaveShTakau, ekaM tAlu, ekA galashuNDikA, dve upajihvike, ekA gojihvikA, dvau gaNDau, dve karNashaShkulike, dvau karNaputrakau, dve akShikUTe, catvAryakShivartmAni, dve akShikanInike, dve bhruvau, ekA~avaTuH, catvAri pANipAdahRudayAni||11||

Commentary: ShaTpa~jcAshat pratya~ggAnIti ‘tadyathA- dve ja~gghApiNDike’ ityAdigranthavakShyamANAni| yAnItyAdi yAni vakShyamANAni ShaTpa~jcAshat pratya~ggAni, pUrvama~ggeShu hastAdiShu ShaTsu, parisa~gkhyAyamAneShvaparisa~gkhyAtAni, tAnyanyaiH paryAyaiH prakAshyAni bhavantIti yojanA| paryAyAshca ja~gghApiNDikAdayaH shabdA eva| etena hastAdiShaDa~ggakathanenaiva tadAshritA api ja~gghApiNDikAdaya uktA eva, samprati tvavayavavisheShavyavahArArthaM ja~gghApiNDikAdayaH pRuthaguktA iti vAkyArthaH| ‘pUrvama~ggeShu’ ityasya sthAne ‘pUrvamanyeShu’ iti vA pAThaH; tatrApyanyashabdena hastAdIni ShaDa~ggAni grAhyANi| ukhe iti kakShashiropArshvayornimnabhAgau| kukundarau sphicorupari unnatabhAgau| bastishiro nAbheradhaH| shleShmabhuvau kaNThasya pArshvayorvyavasthitau kaThinau bhAgau| sRukkaNyau vadanAnte| dve upajihvike iti jihvAyA adhogatA jihvA tathA uparigatA grAhyA| ekA gojihviketi gaurvAk, tasyAH kAraNabhUtA jihvA gojihvA; tena vacanakAraNabhUtA pradhAnajihvaiva gRuhyate| karNashaShkulike karNagatAvartakau| karNaputrakau tu bAhyakarNAveva| akShikUTake akShigolake| dve akShikanInike ityatra kanInikAshabdena nAsAyAH samamakShisandhirabhidhIyate| avaTuH ghATA| catvAri pANipAdahRudayAnIti pANyoH pAdayoshca talAni madhyAni catvArItyarthaH| etAvataiva ShaTpa~jcAshat pratya~ggAni pUryante||11||

pUrvAdhyAye dhAtubhedena sharIramabhidhAya etadeva sharIramavayavasa~gkhyAbhedena pratipAdayituM sharIrasa~gkhyAdhyAyo~abhidhIyate| avayavasa~gkhyAbhedena ca sharIraj~jAnaM prAdhAnyena sAkShAt sAdhanaM cikitsopayuktaM kathayiShyatyadhyAyAnte ‘sharIrasa~gkhyAM yo veda’ ityAdinA| avayavashaH sharIraM pravibhajya sharIrasa~gkhyAM papraccheti yojanA| pRucchAprayojanamAha- sarvasharIrasa~gkhyAnapramANaj~jAnahetoriti|- sa~gkhyAnasya pramANamiyattA sa~gkhyAnapramANaM, tacca ‘ShaT tvacaH’ ityAdigranthavAcyaM; kiMvA sa~gkhyAnaM ca pramANaM ca sa~gkhyAnapramANaM; tatra ‘ShaT tvacaH’ ityAdi sa~gkhyAnaM, ‘dashodakA~jjalayaH’ ityAdi sharIrAvayavapramANaM; kiMvA ‘sa~gkhyA-nAma-pramANaj~jAnahetoH’ iti pAThaH, tatra sa~gkhyAnasya pramANasya ca dattamevodAharaNaM, nAmaj~jAnaM tu ‘ekA gojihvikA’ ityAdigranthena bhavatIti vyAkhyAnayanti||1-3||
nava mahAnti chidrANIti granthaM vyAkaroti- sapta shirasi dve cAdha iti| etAvaddRushyamiti etAvattvagAdi dRushyaM prAyaH pratyakShopalabdhiviShayamityarthaH||12-13||

imameva gadyoktamarthaM shlokenAha- sharIretyAdi| tadaj~jAnanimitteneti sharIraikatArUpamithyAj~jAnajanyena| moheneti ‘ahaM sthirasharIrI eko, mamedamupakArakaM, mamedamupakArakam’ ityAdirUpeNa mohena| mohamUlairiti mohakAraNakaiH| doShairiti rAgadveShaiH; nirdoShatvena niHspRuho bhavati, rAgadveShamUlA hIcchA tadabhAvAnna bhavati, niHspRuhashca san sarvakriyoparamAcchAnto bhavati, shAntashca san prashAmyati saMsaraNe vishrAmyati; tatashca nAsya punarbhavo janmarUpo bhavatIti||19-20||
akShiNI karNau ca pRuthaktve~api ekaikendriyAdhiShThAnatvenaikatvenaiva grAhye| evaM hastau pAdau ca ekatayA grAhyau||7-8||
athAto jAtisUtrIyaM shArIraM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tataH puShpAt prabhRuti trirAtramAsIta brahmacAriNyadhaHshAyinI, pANibhyAmannamajarjarapAtrAdbhu~jjAnA , na ca kA~jcinmRujAmApadyeta| tatashcaturthe~ahanyenAmutsAdya sashiraskaM snApayitvA shuklAni vAsAMsyAcchAdayet puruShaM ca| tataH shuklavAsasau sragviNau sumanasAvanyonyamabhikAmau saMvaseyAtAM snAnAt prabhRuti yugmeShvahaHsu putrakAmau, ayugmeShu duhitRukAmau||5||

na ca nyubjAM pArshvagatAM vA saMseveta| nyubjAyA vAto balavAn sa yoniM pIDayati, pArshvagatAyA dakShiNe pArshve shleShmA sa cyutaH pidadhAti garbhAshayaM, vAme pArshve pittaM tadasyAH pIDitaM vidahati raktaM shukraM ca, tasmAduttAnA bIjaM gRuhNIyAt; tathAhi yathAsthAnamavatiShThante doShAH| paryApte cainAM shItodakena pariShi~jcet| tatrAtyashitA kShudhitA pipAsitA bhItA vimanAH shokArtA kruddhA~anyaM ca pumAMsamicchantI maithune cAtikAmA vA na garbhaM dhatte, viguNAM vA prajAM janayati| atibAlAmativRuddhAM dIrgharogiNImanyena vA vikAreNopasRuShTAM varjayet| puruShe~apyeta eva doShAH| ataH sarvadoShavarjitau strIpuruShau saMsRujyeyAtAm||6||
sa~jjAtaharShau maithune cAnukUlAviShTagandhaM svAstIrNaM sukhaM shayanamupakalpya manoj~jaM hitamashanamashitvA nAtyashitau dakShiNapAdena pumAnArohet vAmapAdena strI||7||

tatra mantraM prayu~jjIta- “ahirasi Ayurasi sarvataH pratiShThA~asi dhAtA tvA dadatu vidhAtA tvA dadhAtu brahmavarcasA bhava” iti| “brahmA bRuhaspatirviShNuHsomaHsUryastathA~ashvinau| bhago~atha mitrAvaruNau vIraM dadatu me sutam” ityuktvA saMvaseyAtAm||8||

sA cedevamAshAsIta- bRuhantamavadAtaM haryakShamojasvinaM shuciM sattvasampannaM putramiccheyamiti, shuddhasnAnAt prabhRutyasyai manthamavadAtayavAnAM madhusarpirbhyAM saMsRujya shvetAyA goH sarUpavatsAyAH payasA~a~aloDya rAjate kAMsye vA pAtre kAle kAle saptAhaM satataM prayacchet pAnAya| prAtashca shAliyavAnnavikArAn dadhimadhusarpirbhiH payobhirvA saMsRujya bhu~jjIta, tathA sAyamavadAtasharaNashayanAsanapAnavasanabhUShaNA ca syAt| sAyaM prAtashca shashvacchvetaM mahAntaM vRuShabhamAjAneyaM vA haricandanA~ggadaM pashyet| saumyAbhishcainAM kathAbhirmanonukUlAbhirupAsIta| saumyAkRutivacanopacAraceShTAMshca strIpuruShAnitarAnapi cendriyArthAnavadAtAn pashyet| sahacaryashcainAM priyahitAbhyAM satatamupacareyustathA bhartA| na ca mishrIbhAvamApadyeyAtAmiti| anena vidhinA saptarAtraM sthitvA~aShTame~ahanyAplutyAdbhiH sashiraskaM saha bhartrA ahatAni vastrANyAcchAdayedavadAtAni, avadAtAshca srajo bhUShaNAni ca bibhRuyAt||9||

Commentary: haryakShaM siMhavikramaM; haryakShatA sAmudrakaiH stutA, tenopAdeyA| iccheyamityanekArthatvAddhAtUnAM labheyamityarthaH; tena ‘AshAsIta’ ityasya ‘iccheyaM’ ityanena na paunaruktyamiti vyAkhyAnayanti| kAle kAle iti sAyamprAtaH| atra ca manthapAnasya tathA shAliyavAnnabhojanasya ca vihitatvAdubhAvapi kAle kAle mAtrayA karaNIyau| sharaNaM gRuham| AjAneyam uttamakulajAtamashvam| haricandanashabdena shvetacandanaM vivakShitaM, harishabdasyAnekArthatvAt; harishabdena shvetasyaiva grahaNaM, prashastatvAt; a~ggadaH a~ggarAgaH; kiMvA a~ggadaH bAhubhUShaNam| pashyediti upalabheta; tena shrotramanobhyAmapi avadAtatvagrahaNaM labhyate||9||

tata Rutvik prAguttarasyAM dishyagArasya prAgpravaNamudakpravaNaM vA pradeshamabhisamIkShya, gomayodakAbhyAM sthaNDilamupalipya, prokShya codakena, vedImasmin sthApayet| tAM pashcimenAhatavastrasa~jcaye shvetArShabhe vA~apyajina upavished brAhmaNaprayuktaH, rAjanyaprayuktastu vaiyAghre carmaNyAnaDuhe vA, vaishyaprayuktastu raurave bAste vA| tatropaviShTaH pAlAshIbhirai~ggudIbhiraudumbarIbhirmAdhUkIbhirvA samidbhiragnimupasamAdhAya, kushaiH paristIrya, paridhibhishca paridhAya, lAjaiH shuklAbhishca gandhavatIbhiH sumanobhirupakiret| tatra praNIyodapAtraM pavitrapUtamupasaMskRutya sarpirAjyArthaM yathoktavarNAnAjAneyAdIn samantataH sthApayet||10||

tataH putrakAmA pashcimato~agniM dakShiNato brAhmaNamupavishyAnvAlabheta saha bhartrA yatheShTaM putramAshAsAnA| tatastasyA AshAsAnAyA Rutvik prajApatimabhinirdishya yonau tasyAH kAmaparipUraNArthaM kAmyAmiShTiM nirvartayed ‘viShNuryoniM kalpayatu’ ityanayarcA| tatashcaivAjyena sthAlIpAkamabhighArya trirjuhuyAdyathAmnAyam| mantropamantritamudapAtraM tasyai dadyAt sarvodakArthAn kuruShveti| tataH samApte karmaNi pUrvaM dakShiNapAdamabhiharantI pradakShiNamagnimanuparikrAmet saha bhartrA| tato brAhmaNAn svasti vAcayitvA~a~ajyasheShaM prAshnIyAt pUrvaM pumAn, pashcAt strI; na cocchiShTamavasheShayet| tatastau saha saMvaseyAtAmaShTarAtraM, tathAvidhaparicchadAveva ca syAtAM , tatheShTaputraM janayetAm||11||

yA tu strI shyAmaM lohitAkShaM vyUDhoraskaM mahAbAhuM ca putramAshAsIta, yA vA kRuShNaM kRuShNamRududIrghakeshaM shuklAkShaM shukladantaM tejasvinamAtmavantam; eSha evAnayorapi homavidhiH| kintu paribarho varNavarjaM syAt| putravarNAnurUpastu yathAshIreva tayoH paribarho~anyaH kAryaH syAt||12||
shUdrA tu namaskArameva kuryAt (devAgnidvijagurutapasvisiddhebhyaH )||13||

yA yA ca yathAvidhaM putramAshAsIta tasyAstasyAstAM tAM putrAshiShamanunishamya tAMstA~jjanapadAnmanasA~anuparikrAmayet| tato yA yA yeShAM yeShAM janapadAnAM manuShyANAmanurUpaM putramAshAsIta sA sA teShAM teShAM janapadAnAM manuShyANAmAhAravihAropacAraparicchadAnanuvidhatsveti vAcyA syAt| ityetat sarvaM putrAshiShAM samRuddhikaraM karma vyAkhyAtaM bhavati||14||

na khalu kevalametadeva karma varNavaisheShyakaraM bhavati| api tu tejodhAturapyudakAntarikShadhAtuprAyo~avadAtavarNakaro bhavati, pRuthivIvAyudhAtuprAyaH kRuShNavarNakaraH, samasarvadhAtuprAyaH shyAmavarNakaraH||15||

Commentary: varNavisheShakaraM hetvantaramAha- na tu khalvityAdi| tejodhAtuH kRuShNavarNe shyAmavarNe ca vartate||15||

sattvavaisheShyakarANi punasteShAM teShAM prANinAM mAtApitRusattvAnyantarvatnyAH shrutayashcAbhIkShNaM svocitaM ca karma sattvavisheShAbhyAsashceti||16||

Commentary: varNavisheShahetumabhidhAya sattvabhedahetumAha- sattvetyAdi| mAtApitRusattvAnIti mAtApitranukAreNa sattvAni prAyaH prabhAvAdeva bhavanti| antarvatnI garbhiNI| shrutayashcAbhIkShNamiti yathA garbhiNI gItAdi shRuNoti, tathAsattvamapatyaM janayati| svocitaM ca karmeti garbheNopArjitaM karma svaphalAnurUpaM sattvaM janayati| sattvavisheShAbhyAsashceti yathAvidhaM sattvaM puruSho~abhyasyati janmAntare tathAsattva eva jAyate| vacanaM hi- “janma janma yadabhyastaM dAnamadhyayanaM tapaH| tenaivAbhyAsayogena taccaivAbhyasate naraH” iti||16||

yathoktena vidhinopasaMskRutasharIrayoH strIpuruShayormishrIbhAvamApannayoH shukraM shoNitena saha saMyogaM sametyAvyApannamavyApannena yonAvanupahatAyAmapraduShTe garbhAshaye garbhamabhinirvartayatyekAntena| yathA- nirmale vAsasi suparikalpite ra~jjanaM samuditaguNamupanipAtAdeva rAgamabhinirvartayati, tadvat; yathA vA kShIraM dadhnA~abhiShutamabhiShavaNAdvihAya svabhAvamApadyate dadhibhAvaM, shukraM tadvat||17||

Commentary: samprati garbhotpattikramamAha- yathoktenetyAdi| yathoktena vidhineti pa~jcakarmoktena| ra~jjanaM rAgadravyam| dadhyabhiShutamiti dadhnA stokamAtreNa mishritam| Apadyate dadhibhAvamiti dadhitvamApadyate| tadvaditi yathA kShIraM dadhi bhavati, ra~jjanaM rAgo vA bhavati, tathA shukraM garbhamabhinirvartayati| shukraM yathoktaM shoNitayuktamityarthaH||17||

evamabhinirvartamAnasya garbhasya strIpuruShatve hetuH pUrvamuktaH| yathA hi bIjamanupataptamuptaM svAM svAM prakRutimanuvidhIyate vrIhirvA vrIhitvaM yavo vA yavatvaM tathA strIpuruShAvapi yathoktaM hetuvibhAgamanuvidhIyete||18||

Commentary: yathoktaM hetuvibhAgamanuvidhIyete iti “raktena kanyAmadhikena putraM shukreNa” (shA.a.2) ityAdigranthoktavibhAgaM strIpuruShajanakamanuvidhIyete||18||

tayoH karmaNA vedoktena vivartanamupadishyate prAgvyaktIbhAvAt prayuktena samyak| karmaNAM hi deshakAlasampadupetAnAM niyatamiShTaphalatvaM, tathetareShAmitaratvam| tasmAdApannagarbhAM striyamabhisamIkShya prAgvyaktIbhAvAdgarbhasya puMsavanamasyai dadyAt| goShThe jAtasya nyagrodhasya prAguttarAbhyAM shAkhAbhyAM shu~gge anupahate AdAya dvAbhyAM dhAnyamAShAbhyAM sampadupetAbhyAM gaurasarShapAbhyAM vA saha dadhni prakShipya puShyeNa pibet, tathaivAparA~jjIvakarShabhakApAmArgasahacarakalkAMshca yugapadekaikasho yatheShTaM vA~apyupasaMskRutya payasA, kuDyakITakaM matsyakaM vodakA~jjalau prakShipya puShyeNa pibet, tathA kanakamayAn rAjatAnAyasAMshca puruShakAnagnivarNAnaNupramANAn dadhni payasyudakA~jjalau vA prakShipya pibedanavasheShataH puShyeNa, puShyeNaiva ca shAlipiShTasya pacyamAnasyoShmANamupAghrAya tasyaiva ca piShTasyodakasaMsRuShTasya rasaM dehalyAmupanidhAya dakShiNe nAsApuTe svayamAsi~jcet picunA| yaccAnyadapi brAhmaNA brUyurAptA vA striyaH puMsavanamiShTaM taccAnuShTheyam| iti puMsavanAni||19||

Commentary: samprati strItve puruShatve ca raktAdhikatvaM tathA shukrAdhikatvaM ca pUrvoktaM hetumanUdya vaidikaM putrajanakaM vidhAnAntaramAha- tayorityAdi| vedokteneti Ayurvedoktena| prAgvyaktIbhAvAditi yAvanna strItvaM puMstvaM vA garbhasya vyaktaM bhavati tAvadeva tadvakShyamANaM karma li~ggaparivRuttikaraM bhavati| vyaktistu dvitIye mAse bhavati; yaduktaM- “dvitIye mAse ghanaH sampadyate” (shA. 4) ityAdi; kiMvA tRutIye mAse a~ggapratya~ggAbhivyaktervyaktIbhAvo j~jeyaH, dvitIye tu mAse granthyAdirUpe garbhe pratya~ggavyaktIbhAvo na vyaktaH; tena vakShyamANaM karma mAsadvayaM yAvat kartavyam| prayukteneti pUrveNa sambadhyate| niyataM nishcitam| tathetareShAmitaratvamiti karmaNAM deshakAlaviguNAnAmaniShTaphalaM nishcitamityarthaH| puMsavanamiti puMstvakArakaM karma| goShThaH gavAM vishrAmasthAnam| atra ca sthAnAdivisheShaparigraha eva phalado bhavatIti vacanAdunnIyate, nAtrAsmAdRushAM yuktayaH prabhavanti| dhAnyamAShashabdena vrIhimAShaM grAhayanti, suvarNamAShaM ca vyAvartayanti| gaurasarShapaH shvetasarShapaH| puShyeNeti puShyanakShatreNa| yatheShTamityanena dvishastrisho vA pibedityapi darshayati| kuDyakITaH ‘kavaDigaNA ’ iti khyAtaH; kiMvA jyeShThI kuDyakITaH| jatUkarNe~apyatra prayoge ‘bhittimatsyaH’ iti paThyate, bhittimatsyashabdena ca pAshcAtye ‘jyeShThI’ ucyate| matsyakaH hrasvamatsyaH| dehalI gRuhadvArAdhaHkAShThaM, tatropanidhAya ‘shira’ iti sheShaH; kiMvA AtmAnameva dehalyAmupanidhAyeti mantavyam| yaduktaM jatUkarNe- “dehalyAmAsInA” iti||19||

ata UrdhvaM garbhasthApanAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH- aindrI brAhmI shatavIryA sahasravIryA~amoghA~avyathA shivA~ariShTA vATyapuShpI viShvaksenakAntA cetyAsAmoShadhInAM shirasA dakShiNena vA pANinA dhAraNaM, etAbhishcaiva siddhasya payasaH sarpiSho vA pAnam, etAbhishcaiva puShye puShye snAnaM, sadA ca tAH samAlabheta| tathA sarvAsAM jIvanIyoktAnAmoShadhInAM sadopayogastaistairupayogavidhibhiH| iti garbhasthApanAni vyAkhyAtAni bhavanti||20||

Commentary: samprati sthitasya garbhasya garbhopaghAtakabhAvaprabhAvakhaNDakatvena yat punaH sthitikArakaM tadgarbhasthApanamucyate- ata UrdhvamityAdinA| aindrI gorakShakarkaTI| shatavIryAsahasravIrye dUrvAdvayam| amoghA pATalA| avyathA guDUcI| ariShTA kaTurohiNI| vATyapuShpI pItabalA| viShvaksenakAntA priya~gguH||20||

garbhopaghAtakarAstvime bhAvA bhavanti; tadyathA- utkaTaviShamakaThinAsanasevinyA vAtamUtrapurIShavegAnuparundhatyA dAruNAnucitavyAyAmasevinyAstIkShNoShNAtimAtrasevinyAH pramitAshanasevinyA garbho mriyate~antaH kukSheH, akAle vA sraMsate, shoShI vA bhavati; tathA~abhighAtaprapIDanaiH shvabhrakUpaprapAtadeshAvalokanairvA~abhIkShNaM mAtuH prapatatyakAlegarbhaH, tathA~atimAtrasa~gkShobhibhiryAnairyAnena, apriyAtimAtrashravaNairvA| pratatottAnashAyinyAH punargarbhasya nAbhyAshrayA nADI kaNThamanuveShTayati, vivRutashAyinI nakta~jcAriNI conmattaM janayati, apasmAriNaM punaH kalikalahashIlA, vyavAyashIlA durvapuShamahrIkaM straiNaM vA, shokanityA bhItamapacitamalpAyuShaM vA, abhidhyAtrI paropatApinamIrShyuM straiNaM vA, stenA tvAyAsabahulamatidrohiNamakarmashIlaM vA, amarShiNI caNDamaupadhikamasUyakaM vA svapnanityA tandrAlumabudhamalpAgniM vA, madyanityA pipAsAlumalpasmRutimanavasthitacittaM vA, godhAmAMsaprAyA shArkariNamashmariNaM shanairmehiNaM vA, varAhamAMsaprAyA raktAkShaM krathanamatiparuSharomANaM vA, matsyamAMsanityA ciranimeShaM stabdhAkShaM vA, madhuranityA pramehiNaM mUkamatisthUlaM vA, amlanityA raktapittinaM tvagakShirogiNaM vA, lavaNanityA shIghravalIpalitaM khAlityarogiNaM vA, kaTukanityA durbalamalpashukramanapatyaM vA, tiktanityA shoShiNamabalamanupacitaM vA, kaShAyanityA shyAvamAnAhinamudAvartinaM vA, yadyacca yasya yasya vyAdhernidAnamuktaM tattadAsevamAnA~antarvatnI tannimittavikArabahulamapatyaM janayati| pitRujAstu shukradoShA mAtRujairapacArairvyAkhyAtAH| iti garbhopaghAtakarA bhAvA bhavantyuktAH | tasmAdahitAnAhAravihArAn prajAsampadamicchantI strI visheSheNa varjayet| sAdhvAcArA cAtmAnamupacareddhitAbhyAmAhAravihArAbhyAmiti||21||

Commentary: bAlasyAcirajAtasyApi garbhavyapadesho bhavati, tena kukSherbahirapi maraNasadbhAve antaHkukSheriti visheShaNamupapannam| pratatottAnashAyinI uttAnashayanashIlA| vivRute anAvRute deshe shayanashIlA vivRutashAyinI| vivRutashAyinI tathA nakta~jcAriNI ca rakShaHprabhRutibhUtAbhigamanIyA bhavati; tatashca bhUtairabhibhUto garbha unmatto bhavatIti yuktam| kaliH vAcikaH, kalahastu shArIrakaH | straiNaM strIvasham| abhidhyAtrI manasA drohaNashIlA| aupadhikaM shAThyapracAriNam| krathanam akasmAducchvAsAvarodhaH, tadvAnapi ‘krathana’ ityucyate| madhuranityeha garbhiNIvihitaM kShIraM vihAyAnyamadhurAnusevinI boddhavyA; kShIrasya tu vihitatvena prAshastyam| tatra ShaNNAmapi rasAnAmatyarthopayoge doShamabhidhAya yat punarmadyAdInAmatyarthasevane pRuthagdoShaM brUte, taddravyaprabhAvasya doShavisheShAbhidhAnArthamiti j~jeyam| yadvastusevayA ye vikArA iha garbhasyocitanidAnA dRushyante te tAvaducitotpAdA eva| yathA- nidrAtisevayA tandrAluH, madhurasevayA mehI, amlena raktapittAdiyukta ityAdi| ye tu hetvasadRushA vikArA garbhasya dRushyante, yathA- godhAmAMsena sharkarAshmarItyAdi, te~api dravyaprabhAvAdeva j~jeyAH| yadyapi garbhagrahaNAt prAgapi striyA apathyasevA~a~artavaduShTidvArA garbhe vikAraM janayati, tathA puruShasyApathyasevA shukraduShTidvArA garbhe duShTiM janayatIti ihaiva ‘pitRujAstu’ ityAdinA granthena vaktavyaM, tathA~api gRuhItagarbhAyAH striyA apacAravisheSheNAvyavadhAnAdgarbhaduShTikarA bhavantIti kRutvA ‘tattadAsevamAnA~antarvatnI’ ityuktam| mAtRujairapacArairvyAkhyAtA iti yathA mAturapacArAnurUpA garbhavyAdhayo bhavanti; evaM piturapi vyavAyAt prAgapacAreNa shukraduShTyA~apacArAnurUpA vyAdhayo bhavantItyarthaH| strI visheSheNetyanena puruSho~api varjayediti darshayati| sAdhvAcAreti ma~ggalAcArashIlA||21||

vyAdhIMshcAsyA mRudumadhurashishirasukhasukumAraprAyairauShadhAhAropacArairupacaret, na cAsyA vamanavirecanashirovirecanAni prayojayet, na raktamavasecayet, sarvakAlaM ca nAsthApanamanuvAsanaM vA kuryAdanyatrAtyayikAdvyAdheH| aShTamaM mAsamupAdAya vamanAdisAdhyeShu punarvikAreShvAtyayikeShu mRudubhirvamanAdibhistadarthakAribhirvopacAraH syAt| pUrNamiva tailapAtramasa~gkShobhayatA~antarvatnI bhavatyupacaryA||22||
sA cedapacArAd dvayostriShu vA mAseShu puShpaM pashyennAsyA garbhaH sthAsyatIti vidyAt; ajAtasAro hi tasmin kAle bhavati garbhaH||23||

sA ceccatuShprabhRutiShu mAseShu krodhashokAsUyerShyAbhayatrAsavyavAyavyAyAmasa~gkShobhasandhAraNaviShamAshanashayanasthAnakShutpipAsAtiyogAt kadAhArAdvA puShpaM pashyet, tasyA garbhasthApanavidhimupadekShyAmaH| puShpadarshanAdevainAM brUyAt- shayanaM tAvanmRudusukhashishirAstaraNasaMstIrNamIShadavanatashiraskaM pratipadyasveti| tato yaShTImadhukasarpirbhyAM paramashishiravAriNI saMsthitAbhyAM picumAplAvyopasthasamIpe sthApayettasyAH, tathA shatadhautasahasradhautAbhyAM sarpirbhyAmadhonAbheH sarvataH pradihyAt, sarvatashca gavyena cainAM payasA sushItena madhukAmbunA vA nyagrodhAdikaShAyeNa vA pariShecayedadho nAbheH, udakaM vA sushItamavagAhayet, kShIriNAM kaShAyadrumANAM ca svarasaparipItAni celAni grAhayet, nyagrodhAdishu~ggAsiddhayorvAkShIrasarpiShoH picuM grAhayet, atashcaivAkShamAtraM prAshayet, prAshayedvA kevalaM kShIrasarpiH, padmotpalakumudaki~jjalkAMshcAsyai samadhusharkarAn lehArthaM dadyAt, shRu~ggATakapuShkarabIjakasherukAn bhakShNArthaM, gandhapriya~ggvasitotpalashAlUkodumbarashalATunyagrodhashu~ggAni vA pAyayedenAmAjena payasA, payasA cainAM balAtibalAshAliShaShTikekShumUlakAkolIshRutena samadhusharkaraM raktashAlInAmodanaM mRudusurabhishItalaM bhojayet, lAvakapi~jjalakura~ggashambarashashahariNaiNakAlapucchakarasena vA ghRutasusaMskRutena sukhashishiropavAtadeshasthAM bhojayet, krodhashokAyAsavyavAyavyAyAmebhyashcAbhirakShet, saumyAbhishcainAM kathAbhirmanonukUlAbhirupAsIta; tathA~asyA garbhastiShThati||24||
yasyAH punarAmAnvayAt puShpadarshanaM syAt, prAyastasyAstadgarbhopaghAtakaraM bhavati, viruddhopakramatvAttayoH||25||

yasyAH punaruShNatIkShNopayogAdgarbhiNyA mahati sa~jjAtasAre garbhe puShpadarshanaM syAdanyo vA yonisrAvastasyA garbho vRuddhiM na prApnoti niHsrutatvAt; sa kAlamavatiShThate~atimAtraM, tamupaviShTakamityAcakShate kecit| upavAsavratakarmaparAyAH punaH kadAhArAyAH snehadveShiNyA vAtaprakopaNoktAnyAsevamAnAyA garbho vRuddhiM na prApnoti parishuShkatvAt; sa cApi kAlamavatiShThate~atimAtram , aspandanashca bhavati, taM tu nAgodaramityAcakShate||26||

nAryostayorubhayorapi cikitsitavisheShamupadekShyAmaH- bhautikajIvanIyabRuMhaNIyamadhuravAtaharasiddhAnAM sarpiShAM payasAmAmagarbhANAM copayogo garbhavRuddhikaraH; tathA sambhojanametaireva siddhaishca ghRutAdibhiH subhikShAyAH , abhIkShNaM yAnavAhanApamArjanAvajRumbhaNairupapAdanamiti||27||

yasyAH punargarbhaH prasupto na spandate tAM shyenamatsyagavayashikhitAmracUDatittirINAmanyatamasya sarpiShmatA rasena mAShayUSheNa vA prabhUtasarpiShA mUlakayUSheNa vA raktashAlInAmodanaM mRudumadhurashItalaM bhojayet| tailAbhya~ggena cAsyA abhIkShNamudarabastiva~gkShaNorukaTIpArshvapRuShThapradeshAnIShaduShNenopacaret||28||

yasyAH punarudAvartavibandhaH syAdaShTame mAse na cAnuvAsanasAdhyaM manyeta tatastasyAstadvikAraprashamanamupakalpayennirUham| udAvarto hyupekShitaH sahasA sagarbhAM garbhiNIM garbhamathavA~atipAtayet| tatra vIraNashAliShaShTikakushakAshekShuvAlikAvetasaparivyAdhamUlAnAM bhUtIkAnantAkAshmaryaparUShakamadhukamRudvIkAnAM ca payasA~ardhodakenodgamayya rasaM priyAlabibhItakamajjatilakalkasamprayuktamIShallavaNamanatyuShNaM ca nirUhaM dadyAt| vyapagatavibandhAM cainAM sukhasalilapariShiktA~ggIM sthairyakaramavidAhinamAhAraM bhuktavatIM sAyaM madhurakasiddhena tailenAnuvAsayet| nyubjAM tvenAmAsthApanAnuvAsanAbhyAmupacaret||29||

yasyAH punaratimAtradoShopacayAdvA tIkShNoShNAtimAtrasevanAdvA vAtamUtrapurIShavegavidhAraNairvA viShamAsha(sa)nashayanasthAnasampIDanAbhighAtairvA krodhashokerShyAbhayatrAsAdibhirvA sAhasairvA~aparaiH karmabhirantaHkukShergarbho mriyate, tasyAH stimitaM stabdhamudaramAtataM shItamashmAntargatamiva bhavatyaspandano garbhaH, shUlamadhikamupajAyate, na cAvyaH prAdurbhavanti, yonirna prasravati, akShiNI cAsyAH sraste bhavataH, tAmyati, vyathate, bhramate, shvasiti, aratibahulA ca bhavati, na cAsyA vegaprAdurbhAvo yathAvadupalabhyate; ityevaMlakShaNAM striyaM mRutagarbheyamiti vidyAt||30||

Commentary: ashmAntargatamiveti antargataprastaramivetyarthaH| AvI prasavakAlashUlam||30||

tasya garbhashalyasya jarAyuprapAtanaM karma saMshamanamityAhureke, mantrAdikamatharvavedavihitamityeke, paridRuShTakarmaNA shalyahartrA haraNamityeke| vyapagatagarbhashalyAM tu striyamAmagarbhAM surAsIdhvariShTamadhumadirAsavAnAmanyatamamagre sAmarthyataH pAyayedgarbhakoShThashuddhyarthamartivismaraNArthaM praharShaNArthaM ca, ataH paraM samprINanairbalAnurakShibhirasnehasamprayuktairyavAgvAdibhirvA tatkAlayogibhirAhArairupacareddoShadhAtukledavishoShaNamAtraM kAlam| ataH paraM snehapAnairbastibhirAhAravidhibhishca dIpanIyajIvanIyabRuMhaNIyamadhuravAtaharasamAkhyAtairupacaret| paripakvagarbhashalyAyAH punarvimuktagarbhashalyAyAstadahareva snehopacAraH syAt||31||

Commentary: ‘eke’ iti vacanena apratiShedhena ca jarAyupAtanakarmAdInAM trayANAmapi mRutagarbhApaharaNaM prati samyaksAdhanatA nAstIti darshayati| doShadhAtukledavishoShaNamAtraM kAlamityanena doShadhAtukledavishoShaNAvadhitAM yathoktakramasya darshayati||31||

paramato nirvikAramApyAyyamAnasya garbhasya mAse mAse karmopadekShyAmaH| prathame mAse sha~gkitA cedgarbhamApannA kShIramanupaskRutaM mAtrAvacchItaM kAle kAle pibet, sAtmyameva ca bhojanaM sAyaM prAtashca bhu~jjIta; dvitIye mAse kShIrameva ca madhurauShadhasiddhaM; tRutIye mAse kShIraM madhusarpirbhyAmupasaMsRujya; caturthe mAse kShIranavanItamakShamAtramashnIyAt; pa~jcame mAse kShIrasarpiH; ShaShThe mAse kShIrasarpirmadhurauShadhasiddhaM; tadeva saptame mAse| tatra garbhasya keshA jAyamAnA mAturvidAhaM janayantIti striyo bhAShante; tanneti bhagavAnAtreyaH, kintu garbhotpIDanAdvAtapittashleShmANa uraH prApya vidAhaM janayanti, tataH kaNDUrupajAyate, kaNDUmUlA ca kikkisAvAptirbhavati| tatra kolodakena navanItasya madhurauShadhasiddhasya pANitalamAtraM kAle kAle~asyai pAnArthaM dadyAt, candanamRuNAlakalkaishcAsyAH stanodaraM vimRudgIyAt, shirIShadhAtakIsarShapamadhukacUrNairvA, kuTajArjakabIjamustaharidrAkalkairvA, nimbakolasurasama~jjiShThAkalkairvA, pRuShatahariNashasharudhirayutayA triphalayA vA; karavIrapatrasiddhena tailenAbhya~ggaH; pariShekaH punarmAlatImadhukasiddhenAmbhasA; jAtakaNDUshca kaNDUyanaM varjayettvagbhedavairUpyaparihArArtham, asahyAyAM tu kaNDvAmunmardanoddharShaNAbhyAM parihAraH syAt; madhuramAhArajAtaM vAtaharamalpamasnehalavaNamalpodakAnupAnaM ca bhu~jjIta| aShTame tu mAse kShIrayavAgUM sarpiShmatIM kAle kAle pibet; tanneti bhadrakApyaH, pai~ggalyAbAdho hyasyA garbhamAgacchediti; astvatra pai~ggalyAbAdha ityAha bhagavAn punarvasurAtreyaH, na tvevaitanna kAryam; evaM kurvatI hyarogA~a~arogyabalavarNasvarasaMhananasampadupetaM j~jAtInAmapi shreShThamapatyaM janayati| navame tu khalvenAM mAse madhurauShadhasiddhena tailenAnuvAsayet| atashcaivAsyAstailAt picuM yonau praNayedgarbhasthAnamArgasnehanArtham| yadidaM karma prathamaM mAsaM samupAdAyopadiShTamAnavamAnmAsAttena garbhiNyA garbhasamaye garbhadhAriNIkukShikaTIpArshvapRuShThaM mRudUbhavati, vAtashcAnulomaH sampadyate, mUtrapurIShe ca prakRutibhUte sukhena mArgamanupadyete, carmanakhAni ca mArdavamupayAnti, balavarNau copacIyete; putraM ceShTaM sampadupetaM sukhinaM sukhenaiShA kAle prajAyata iti||32||

Commentary: garbhasya pratimAsikaM karmAha- paramata ityAdi| tanneti bhagavAnAtreya iti yugapadeva tRutIye mAse~a~ggapratya~gganiShpatteH keshA api tadaiva jAtAH krameNa vardhante na saptame mAse iti bhAvaH atha kathaM tarhi saptame mAsi visheSheNa kaNDUrbhavatItyAha- garbhotpIDanAdityAdi| kikkisaH carmavidaraNam| stanAvudaraM ca stanodaram| kolaM badarI| parihAraH ‘kaNDvAH’ iti sheShaH| pai~ggalyaM pi~ggalanetratA| sA ca yadyapi pittakRutA, yaduktaM shAlAkye- “pitte~atyarthapraduShTe tu netrayoH pi~ggalAkShitA” iti; tathA~apIhAShTamamAsIyagarbhe kShIrayavAgvAhArasambandhaprabhAvAdeva pai~ggalyaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| na tvevaitanna kAryamiti pai~ggalyasyAlpadoShatvAduttarakAlaM sukarapratikriyatvAcca kShIrayavAgvavacAraNe bahuguNalAbhAt kartavyameva kShIrayavAgUsevanamiti bhAvaH| atashcaiveti madhurauShadhasiddhatailAt| garbhadhAriNI aparA| atra putramiti prashastatve noktaM, tena kanyAM ceti boddhavyam; ato na pratimAsIyena karmaNA putrajanmaiva paraM bhavatIti vyAkRutam||32||

prAk caivAsyA navamAnmAsAt sUtikAgAraM kArayedapahRutAsthisharkarAkapAle deshe prashastarUparasagandhAyAM bhUmau prAgdvAramudagdvAraM vA bailvAnAM kAShThAnAM taindukai~ggudakAnAM bhAllAtakAnAM vAra(ru)NAnAM khAdirANAM vA; yAni cAnyAnyapi brAhmaNAH shaMseyuratharvavedavidasteShAM; vasanAlepanAcchAdanApidhAnasampadupetaM vAstuvidyAhRudayayogAgnisalilodUkhalavarcaHsthAnasnAnabhUmimahAnasamRutusukhaM ca||33||

Commentary: yatra garbhiNI prasUtA yatra ca tiShThati tat sUtikAgAramucyate| bilvAdInAM kAShThAnAmagAraM kArayediti sambandhaH| vAraNaH punnAgaH, varuNo vA| vasanaM vastram, AcchAdanam AstaraNam, apidhAnaM kapATam| vAstuvidyAhRudayaM vAstuvidyAtattvaM, tadyogAdagnyAdInAM sthAnaM yatra gRuhe tattathA; vAstuvinmatena vibhaktAgnyAdisthAnaM tadgRuhaM kartavyamityarthaH| vartamAnartumapekShya sukhamRutusukham||33||

tatra sarpistailamadhusaindhavasauvarcalakAlaviDlavaNaviDa~ggakuShThakilimanAgara- pippalIpippalImUlahastipippalImaNDUkaparNyelAlA~ggalIvacAcavyacitrakacirabilva- hi~ggusarShapalashunakatakakaNakaNikAnIpAtasIbalvajabhUrjakulatthamaireyasurAsavAH sannihitAH syuH; tathA~ashmAnau dvau, dve ku(ca)NDamusale, dve udUkhale, kharavRuShabhashca , dvau ca tIkShNau sUcIpippalakau sauvarNarAjatau, shastrANi ca tIkShNAyasAni, dvau ca bilvamayau parya~gkau, taindukai~ggudAni ca kAShThAnyagnisandhukShaNAni, striyashca bahvyo bahushaH prajAtAH sauhArdayuktAH satatamanuraktAH pradakShiNAcArAH pratipattikushalAH prakRutivatsalAstyaktaviShAdAH kleshasahinyo~abhimatAH, brAhmaNAshcAtharvavedavidaH; yaccAnyadapi tatra samarthaM manyeta, yaccAnyacca brAhmaNA brUyuH striyashca vRuddhAstat kAryam||34||

Commentary: sarpistailAdInAM cAtra gRuhe sthApanIyAnAM vaktavya eva tAvadupayogaH; bahutvena yeShAM tu na vaktavyasteShAmapyayamupayoga unneyaH| kilimaM devadAru| kaNaH ‘kuNDaka’ iti khyAtaH; kaNikA tu kuNDakAt sthUlAstaNDulAvayavA ucyante| taNDulA yena kuDyante tanmusalam| kuNDamusale iti hrasvamusale, kiMvA ‘caNDamusale’ iti pAThaH; tadA gurutaramusale ityarthaH| yadyapi musalagrahaNaM niShiddhaM, tathA~apyuttarakAlaM dvAre musalasthApanaM vaktavyamiti sAdhu musalopAdAnam| sUcyAkAre shastre sUcIpippalakau; kiMvA sUcI yatra sthApyate sa sUcIpippalakaH| parya~gkaH khaTvA| samarthaM manyeteti upayuktaM manyeta||34||

tataH pravRutte navame mAse puNye~ahani prashastanakShatrayogamupagate prashaste bhagavati shashini kalyANe kalyANe ca karaNe maitre muhUrte shAntiM hutvA gobrAhmaNamagnimudakaM cAdau praveshya gobhyastRuNodakaM madhulAjAMshca pradAya brAhmaNebhyo~akShatAn sumanaso nAndImukhAni ca phalAnIShTAni dattvodakapUrvamAsanasthebhyo~abhivAdya punarAcamya svasti vAcayet| tataH puNyAhashabdena gobrAhmaNaM samanuvartamAnA pradakShiNaM pravishet sUtikAgAram| tatrasthA ca prasavakAlaM pratIkSheta||35||

Commentary: shAntiM kRutveti shAntihomaM kRutvA| nAndImukhAni ca phalAni nAndImukhashrAddhAya hitAni phalAni; kiMvA nAndI murajaH, tanmukhAkRutIni phalAni kharjUrAdIni| puNyAhashabdo ma~ggalashabdaH| pradakShiNaM yathA bhavati tathA gobrAhmaNaM samanuvartamAnA ||35||

tasyAstu khalvimAni li~ggAni prajananakAlamabhito bhavanti; tadyathA- klamo gAtrANAM, glAnirAnanasya, akShNoH shaithilyaM, vimuktabandhanatvamiva vakShasaH, kukSheravasraMsanam, adhogurutvaM, va~gkShaNabastikaTIkukShipArshvapRuShThanistodaH, yoneH prasravaNam, anannAbhilAShashceti; tato~anantaramAvInAM prAdurbhAvaH, prasekashca garbhodakasya||36||

AvIprAdurbhAve tu bhUmau shayanaM vidadhyAnmRudvAstaraNopapannam| tadadhyAsIta sA| tAM tataH samantataH parivArya yathoktaguNAH striyaH paryupAsIrannAshvAsayantyo vAgbhirgrAhiNIyAbhiH sAntvanIyAbhishca||37||

sA cedAvIbhiH sa~gklishyamAnA na prajAyetAthainAM brUyAt- uttiShTha, musalamanyataraM gRuhIShva, anenaitadulUkhalaM dhAnyapUrNaM muhurmuhurabhijahi muhurmuhuravajRumbhasva ca~gkramasva cAntarA~antareti; evamupadishantyeke| tannetyAha bhagavAnAtreyaH| dAruNavyAyAmavarjanaM hi garbhiNyAH satatamupadishyate, visheShatashca prajananakAle pracalitasarvadhAtudoShAyAH sukumAryA nAryA musalavyAyAmasamIrito vAyurantaraM labdhvA prANAn hiMsyAt, duShpratIkAratamA hi tasmin kAle visheSheNa bhavati garbhiNI; tasmAnmusalagrahaNaM parihAryamRuShayo manyante, jRumbhaNaM ca~gkramaNaM ca punaranuShTheyamiti| athAsyai dadyAt kuShThailAlA~ggalikIvacAcitrakacirabilvacavyacUrNamupaghrAtuM, sA tanmuhurmuhurupajighret, tathA bhUrjapatradhUmaM shiMshapAsAradhUmaM vA| tasyAshcAntarA~antarA kaTIpArshvapRuShThasakthideshAnIShaduShNena tailenAbhyajyAnusukhamavamRudnIyAt | anena karmaNA garbho~avAk pratipadyate||38||

sa yadA jAnIyAdvimucya hRudayamudaramasyAstvAvishati, bastishiro~avagRuhNAti, tvarayantyenAmAvyaH, parivartate~adho garbha iti; asyAmavasthAyAM parya~gkamenAmAropya pravAhayitumupakrameta| karNe cAsyA mantramimamanukUlA strI japet- ‘kShitirjalaM viyattejo vAyurviShNuH prajApatiH| sagarbhAM tvAM sadA pAntu vaishalyaM ca dishantu te| prasUShva tvamavikliShTamavikliShTA shubhAnane!| kArtikeyadyutiM putraM kArtikeyAbhirakShitam’ iti||39||

tAshcainAM yathoktaguNAH striyo~anushiShyuH- anAgatAvIrmA pravAhiShThAH; yA hyanAgatAvIH pravAhate vyarthamevAsyAstat karma bhavati, prajA cAsyA vikRutA vikRutimApannA ca, shvAsakAsashoShaplIhaprasaktA vA bhavati| yathA hi kShavathUdgAravAtamUtrapurIShavegAn prayatamAno~apyaprAptakAlAnna labhate kRucchreNa vA~apyavApnoti , tathA~anAgatakAlaM garbhamapi pravAhamANA; yathA caiShAmeva kShavathvAdInAM sandhAraNamupaghAtAyopapadyate, tathA prAptakAlasya garbhasyApravAhaNamiti| sA yathAnirdeshaM kuruShveti vaktavyA syAt| tathA ca kurvatI shanaiH pUrvaM pravAheta, tato~anantaraM balavattaram| tasyAM ca pravAhamANAyAM striyaH shabdaM kuryuH- ‘prajAtA prajAtA dhanyaM dhanyaM putram’ iti| tathA~asyA harSheNApyAyyante prANAH||40||

yadA ca prajAtA syAttadaivainAmavekSheta- kAcidasyA aparA prapannA na veti| tasyAshcedaparA na prapannA syAdathainAmanyatamA strI dakShiNena pANinA nAbherupariShTAdbalavannipIDya savyena pANinA pRuShThata upasa~ggRuhya tAM sunirdhUtaM nirdhunuyAt| athAsyAH pArShNyA shroNImAkoTayet| asyAH sphicAvupasa~ggRuhya supIDitaM pIDayet| athAsyA bAlaveNyA kaNThatAlu parimRushet| bhUrjapatrakAcamaNisarpanirmokaishcAsyA yoniM dhUpayet| kuShThatAlIsakalkaM balvajayUShe maireyasurAmaNDe tIkShNe kaulatthe va yUShe maNDUkaparNIpippalIsampAke vA samplAvya pAyayedenAm| tathA sUkShmailAkilimakuShThanAgara viDa~ggapippalIkAlAgurucavyacitrakopaku~jcikAkalkaM kharavRuShabhasya vA jIvato dakShiNaM karNamutkRutya dRuShadi jarjarIkRutya balvajakvAthAdInAmAplAvanAnAmanyatame prakShipyAplAvya muhUrtasthitamuddhRutya tadAplAvanaM pAyayedenAm| shatapuShpAkuShThamadanahi~ggusiddhasya cainAM tailasya picuM grAhayet| atashcaivAnuvAsayet| etaireva cAplAvanaiH phalajImUtekShvAkudhAmArgavakuTajakRutavedhanahastipippalyupahitairAsthApayet| tadAsthApanamasyAH saha vAtamUtrapurIShairnirharatyaparAmAsaktAM vAyorevApratilomagatvAt | aparAM hi vAtamUtrapurIShANyanyAni cAntarbahirmArgANi sajjanti||41||

Commentary: sunirdhUtamiti kriyAvisheShaNam| AkoTayediti pIDayet| bAlakRutA veNI bAlaveNI| balvajayUShaH balvajakvAthaH| maNDUkapippalI maNDUkaparNI; kiMvA maNDUkA maNDUkaparNI, pippalI pippalyeva, tayoH sampAkaH kvAtha ityarthaH| tathetyanena balvajayUShAdau sUkShmailAdInAM pAnaM vidhIyate| kharavRuShabhashcaNDabalIbardaH| etaireva ceti balvajayuShAdibhiH| antarbahirmArgANi sajjantIti bahirgamanashIlAni purIShAdIni, antaH abhyantaradeshe saMsaktAni bhavanti||41||

tasyAstu khalvaparAyAH prapatanArthe karmaNi kriyamANe jAtamAtrasyaiva kumArasya kAryANyetAni karmANi bhavanti; tadyathA- ashmanoH sa~gghaTTanaM karNayormUle, shItodakenoShNodakena vA mukhapariShekaH , tathA sa kleshavihatAn prANAn punarlabheta| kRuShNakapAlikAshUrpeNa cainamabhiniShpuNIyuryadyaceShTaH syAd yAvat prANAnAM pratyAgamanam (tattat sarvameva kAryam)| tataH pratyAgataprANaM prakRutibhUtamabhisamIkShya snAnodakagrahaNAbhyAmupapAdayet||42||

athAsya tAlvoShThakaNThajihvApramArjanamArabhetA~ggulyA suparilikhitanakhayA suprakShAlitopadhAnakArpAsasapicumatyA| prathamaM pramArjitAsyasya cAsya shirastAlu kArpAsapicunA snehagarbheNa pratisa~jchAdayet| tato~asyAnantaraM saindhavopahitena sarpiShA kAryaM pracchardanam||43||

tataH kalpanaM nADyAH| atastasyAH kalpanavidhimupadekShyAmaH- nAbhibandhanAt prabhRutyaShTA~ggulamabhij~jAnaM kRutvA chedanAvakAshasya dvayorantarayoH shanairgRuhItvA tIkShNena raukmarAjatAyasAnAM chedanAnAmanyatamenArdhadhAreNa chedayet| tAmagre sUtreNopanibadhya kaNThe~asya shithilamavasRujet| tasya cennAbhiH pacyeta, tAM lodhramadhukapriya~ggusuradAruharidrAkalkasiddhena tailenAbhyajyAt, eShAmeva tailauShadhAnAM cUrNenAvacUrNayet| iti nADIkalpanavidhiruktaH samyak||44||

Commentary: aShTA~ggulamabhij~jAnaM kRutveti aShTA~ggule cihnaM kRutvA| ardhadhAraH tiryagdhAraH shastravisheShaH| tAmiti cchinnAvashiShTA~ggulAM nADIm| kaNThe~avasRujediti nADyagrabaddhaM sUtraM kumArasya kaNThe nibadhnIyAt||44||

asamyakkalpane hi nADyA AyAmavyAyAmottuNDitA-piNDalikA-vinAmikA-vijRumbhikAbAdhebhyo bhayam| tatrAvidAhibhirvAtapittaprashamanairabhya~ggotsAdanapariShekaiH sarpirbhishcopakrameta gurulAghavamabhisamIkShya||45||

Commentary: nADyA avidhikalpane doShamAha- asamyagityAdi| AyAmo dairghyaM, vyAyAmo vistAraH, tAbhyAmuttuNDitA AyAmavyAyAmottuNDitA, dIrghapInatvayutetyarthaH; piNDalikA parimaNDalayutA; vinAmikA antocchUnA madhyanimnA; vijRumbhikA tu muhurmuhurvRuddhimatI| gurulAghavamabhisamIkShyeti nADIpAkakArakapitte tathA vAte cAyAmavyAyAmottuNDitAdivikAracatuShTayakArake yo doSho guruH sa upacaritavyastvarayetyarthaH||45||

ato~anantaraM jAtakarma kumArasya kAryam| tadyathA- madhusarpiShI mantropamantrite yathAmnAyaM prathamaM prAshituM dadyAt| stanamata Urdhvametenaiva vidhinA dakShiNaM pAtuM purastAt prayacchet| athAtaH shIrShataH sthApayedudakumbhaM mantropamantritam||46||

Commentary: jAtamAtrasya vedoktaM karma jAtakarma| yathAmnAyamiti yathAgamaM mantropamantrite| etenaiva vidhineti stana(nya)mapyabhimantritaM pAyayedityarthaH||46||

athAsya rakShAM vidadhyAt- AdAnIkhadirakarkandhupIluparUShakashAkhAbhirasyA gRuhaM samantataH parivArayet| sarvatashca sUtikAgArasya sarShapAtasItaNDulakaNakaNikAH prakireyuH| tathA taNDulabalihomaH satatamubhayakAlaM kriyetAnAmakarmaNaH | dvAre ca musalaM dehalImanu tirashcInaM nyaset| vacAkuShThakShaumakahi~ggusarShapAtasIlashunakaNakaNikAnAM rakShoghnasamAkhyAtAnAM cauShadhInAM poTTalikAM baddhvA sUtikAgArasyottaradehalyAmavasRujet, tathA sUtikAyAH kaNThe saputrAyAH, sthAlyudakakumbhaparya~gkeShvapi, tathaiva ca dvayordvArapakShayoH| kaNakakaNTakendhanavAnagnistindukakAShThendhanashcAgniH sUtikAgArasyAbhyantarato nityaM syAt| striyashcainAM yathoktaguNAH suhRudashcAnushcAnujAgRuyurdashAhaM dvAdashAhaM vA| anuparatapradAnama~ggalAshIHstutigItavAditramannapAnavishadamanuraktaprahRuShTajanasampUrNaM ca tadveshma kAryam| brAhmaNashcAtharvavedavit satatamubhayakAlaM shAntiM juhuyAt svastyayanArthaM kumArasya tathA sUtikAyAH| ityetadrakShAvidhAnamuktam||47||

Commentary: AdAnI ghoShakabhedaH| taNDulabalihomaH kiyatkAlaM kartavya ityAha- AnAmakarmaNa iti|- dashAhaM yAvadityarthaH; dashAhe tu nAmakarma bhaviShyati| jatUkarNe~apyuktaM- “taNDulabalihomo dvikAlamAdashAham” iti| rakShoghnasamAkhyAtAnAmityanena guggulvAdIn grAhayati| uttaradehalyAmiti dvAropari; anye tu dehalIM dvArAdhaHkAShThamAhuH||47||

sUtikAM tu khalu bubhukShitAM viditvA snehaM pAyayeta paramayA shaktyA sarpistailaM vasAM majjAnaM vA sAtmyIbhAvamabhisamIkShya pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakashRu~ggaveracUrNasahitam| snehaM pItavatyAshca sarpistailAbhyAmabhyajya veShTayedudaraM mahatA~acchena vAsasA; tathA tasyA na vAyurudare vikRutimutpAdayatyanavakAshatvAt| jIrNe tu snehe pippalyAdibhireva siddhAM yavAgUM susnigdhAM dravAM mAtrashaH pAyayet| ubhayataHkAlaM coShNodakena ca pariShecayet prAk snehayavAgUpAnAbhyAm| evaM pa~jcarAtraM saptarAtraM vA~anupAlya krameNApyAyayet| svasthavRuttametAvat sUtikAyAH||48||

Commentary: kumArasya jAtakarmAbhidhAya sUtikAyAH kartavyamAha- sUtikAM tvityAdi| bubhukShitAmityanena yAvatA kAlena bubhukShitA bhavati tadA snehapAnaM kartavyam| paramayA shaktyeti uttamayA shaktyA lakShitA snehaM pibet; ‘yAvatA snehena balavirodho na bhavati tAvanmAtraM snehaM pibet’ ityadhyAhartavyam| sAtmyIbhAvamabhisamIkShyeti sarpirAdiShu yadyasyAH sAtmyaM tat tasyai deyam| accheneti nirmalena| ubhayataHkAlamiti padamuShNodakena pariShecayedityanena yojyam| tadeva kAladvayamAha- prAgityAdi| paurvAhNikaH snehapAnapariShekaH kArayitavyaH, tathA jIrNe snehe pariShecitAM yavAgUH pAyayitavyetyarthaH| ayaM tu vyavahAro nAnUpadeshe prabalakaphatvAt prANinAM, kintu jA~ggaladeshavyavahAra iti j~jeyam||48||

tasyAstu khalu yo vyAdhirutpadyate sa kRucchrasAdhyo bhavatyasAdhyo vA, garbhavRuddhikShayitashithilasarvadhAtutvAt, pravAhaNavedanAkledanaraktaniHsrutivisheShashUnyasharIratvAcca; tasmAttAM yathoktena vidhinopacaret; bhautikajIvanIyabRuMhaNIyamadhuravAtaharasiddhairabhya~ggotsAdanapariShekAvagAhanAnnapAnavidhibhirvisheShatashcopacaret; visheShato hi shUnyasharIrAH striyaH prajAtA bhavanti||49||

Commentary: sUtikAyA mithyopacAreNa vyAdhirbhavan kRucchrasAdhyo~asAdhyo vA yathA bhavati tathA darshayan yathoktakramasyAvadhAnena kartavyatAM darshayitumAha- tasyAstvityAdi| garbhavRuddhyA dhAtvantarApoShaNena kShayitAshca shithilIkRutAshca sarve dhAtavo yasyAH sA tathA| garbhavyapagama etAvaccharIrashUnyatve hetuH tathA pravAhaNavedanAkledaraktaniHsrutishca visheSheNa heturityAha- pravAhaNetyAdi| yathokteneti snehapAnAdinA| etena yathoktavidhikaraNameva dushcikitsyasya sUtikAvyAdhernidAnavarjanarUpamuttamaM bheShajamiti darshayati| yattUtpanne vyAdhau vihitaM bheShajaM tat prAyo na sidhyatIti kRutvA nehoktam| bhautikaM bhUtaharam||49||

dashame tvahani saputrA strI sarvagandhauShadhairgaurasarShapalodhraishca snAtA laghvahatashucivastraM paridhAya pavitreShTalaghuvicitrabhUShaNavatI ca saMspRushya ma~ggalAnyucitAmarcayitvA ca devatAM shikhinaH shuklavAsaso~avya~ggAMshca brAhmaNAn svasti vAcayitvA kumAramahatAnAM ca vAsasAM sa~jcaye prAkshirasamudakshirasaM vA saMveshya devatApUrvaM dvijAtibhyaH praNamatItyuktvA kumArasya pitA dve nAmanI kArayennAkShatrikaM nAmAbhiprAyikaM ca| tatrAbhiprAyikaM ghoShavadAdyantasthAntamUShmAntaM vA~avRuddhaM tripuruShAnUkamanavapratiShThitaM, nAkShAtrikaM tu nakShatradevatAsamAnAkhyaM dvyakSharaM caturakSharaM vA||50||

Commentary: ucitAmiti yA yasya devatA sadA pUjyatvenocitA tAmarcayitvA| shikhina iti pAvakAn; kiMvA shikhA cUDA tadvato brAhmaNAnamuNDAn| nakShatradevatAsaMyuktamiti yasmin nakShatre kumAro jAtastasya nakShatrasya yA devatA jyotiHshAstre, tasyA nAma kartavyamityarthaH| kiMvA ‘dve nAmanI kArayettannAkShatrikamAbhiprAyikaM ca’ ityAdipAThaH| tatrApi nAkShatrikaM vyAkhyAtameva; AbhiprAyikeShu ghoShavadityAdi visheShaNam| ghoShA vargacaturthA ‘ghajhaDhadhabhAH’, antasthA ‘yaralavAH’, ‘shaShasahA’ UShmANaH||50||

vRutte ca nAmakarmaNi kumAraM parIkShitumupakrametAyuShaH pramANaj~jAnahetoH| tatremAnyAyuShmatAM kumArANAM lakShaNAni bhavanti| tadyathA- ekaikajA mRudavo~alpAH snigdhAH subaddhamUlAH kRuShNAH keshAH prashasyante, sthirA bahalA tvak, prakRutyA~atisampannamIShatpramANAtivRuttamanurUpamAtapatropamaM shiraH, vyUDhaM dRuDhaM samaM sushliShTasha~gkhasandhyUrdhvavya~jjanasampannamupacitaM valibhamardhacandrAkRuti lalATaM, bahalau vipulasamapIThau samau nIcairvRuddhau pRuShThato~avanatau sushliShTakarNaputrakau mahAcchidrau karNau, IShatpralambinyAvasa~ggate same saMhate mahatyau bhruvau, same samAhitadarshane vyaktabhAgavibhAge balavatI tejasopapanne sva~ggApA~gge cakShuShI, RujvI mahocchvAsA vaMshasampanneShadavanatAgrA nAsikA, mahadRujusuniviShTadantamAsyam, AyAmavistAropapannA shlakShNA tanvI prakRutivarNayuktA jihvA, shlakShNaM yuktopacayamUShmopapannaM raktaM tAlu, mahAnadInaH snigdho~anunAdI gambhIrasamuttho dhIraH svaraH, nAtisthUlau nAtikRushau vistAropapannAvAsyapracchAdanau raktAvoShThau, mahatyau hanU, vRuttA nAtimahatI grIvA, vyUDhamupacitamuraH, gUDhaM jatru pRuShThavaMshashca, viprakRuShTAntarau stanau, asampAtinI sthire pArshve, vRuttaparipUrNAyatau bAhU sakthinI a~ggulayashca, mahadupacitaM pANipAdaM, sthirA vRuttAH snigdhAstAmrAstu~ggAH kUrmAkArAH karajAH, pradakShiNAvartA sotsa~ggA ca nAbhiH, urastribhAgahInA samA samupacitamAMsA kaTI, vRuttau sthiropacitamAMsau nAtyunnatau nAtyavanatau sphicau, anupUrvaM vRuttAvupacayayuktAvUrU, nAtyupacite nAtyapacite eNIpade pragUDhasirAsthisandhI ja~gghe, nAtyupacitau nAtyapacitau gulphau, pUrvopadiShTaguNau pAdau kUrmAkArau, prakRutiyuktAni vAtamUtrapurIShaguhyAni tathA svaprajAgaraNAyAsasmitaruditastanagrahaNAni, yacca ki~jcidanyadapyanuktamasti tadapi sarvaM prakRutisampannamiShTaM, viparItaM punaraniShTam| iti dIrghAyurlakShaNAni||51||

Commentary: nAmakarmaNIti nAmakaraNasamayakriyamANahomAdikarmaNi, nAmaiva vA karma nAmakarma| sthireti ashlathA| IShatpramANAtivRuttaM shira iti utsargApavAdanyAyena boddhavyam| tena yaduktaM pUrvaM- “ShaDa~ggulotsedhaM dvAtriMshada~ggulapariNAhaM shiraH” etaccAbhidhAyoktaM- “tatrAyurbalaM” ityAdi yAvat “pramANavati sharIre; viparyayastu hIne~adhike vA” (vi.a.8) iti; tatra shirasi ki~jcitpramANAdhikatA etadvacanAdapavAdabhUtA~apyatIva prashastA bhavatIti j~jeyam| evaM ‘mahadupacitaM pANipAdam’ ityatrApi vyAkhyeyam| anurUpamityanena sharIrAnurUpatAM shiraso darshayannuktalakShaNAdanativRuddhiM shiraso darshayati; ativRuddhaM hi sharIrAnanurUpaM bhavati, taccAprashastameva| Urdhvavya~jjanamiti UrdhvarekhAtrayarUpalakShaNayuktaM; jatUkarNe hi trirekhaM lalATamuktam| nIcairvRuddhAviti anudgatau santAvanukramavavRuddhau| asa~ggate dUrAntare| vyaktabhAgavibhAge iti pravyaktakRuShNashuklAdivibhAge| shobhanAni vartmAdIni a~ggAni apA~gge ca yayoste sva~ggApA~gge| atra a~ggagrahaNenaiva apA~ggasya labdhasyApi punaH karaNaM visheSheNApA~ggashobhopadarshanArtham | AsyapracchAdanau AsyaM pracchAdayituM kShamau mukhAvarakau| pRuShThavaMshashca gUDha iti yojanIyam| asampAtinI sunirgate, kiMvA alakShye| prakRutiyukteti dehAnurUpA| eNIpade iti eNIja~gghAsadRushe| prakRutiyuktAnIti nAtibahUni nAtyalpAni ca||51||

ato dhAtrIparIkShAmupadekShyAmaH| atha brUyAt- dhAtrImAnaya samAnavarNAM yauvanasthAM nibhRutAmanAturAmavya~ggAmavyasanAmavirUpAmajugupsitAM deshajAtIyAmakShudrAmakShudrakarmiNIM kule jAtAM vatsalAmarogAM jIvadvatsAM puMvatsAM dogdhrImapramattAmanuccArashAyinImanantyAvasAyinIM kushalopacArAM shucimashucidveShiNIM stanastanyasampadupetAmiti||52||

Commentary: samAnavarNAmiti tulyajAtIyAm| yauvanasthAmityanena bAlAvRuddhayorasampUrNakShINadhAtutvena tayornirAsaM karoti| nibhRutAmiti vinItAm | avirUpAmiti avikRutAvayavAm| avya~ggAmiti ahInA~ggIm| deshajAtIyAM samAnadeshajAm| anantyAvasAyinImiti shUdrAbhiprAyeNa, shUdrasya hi savarNatvena cANDAlAdistrI prasaktA, sA ca niShidhyate; brAhmaNAdInAM tvasavarNatvenaiva sA nirastA; kiMvA brAhmaNAdInAmapi patitabrAhmaNyAdyA anantyAvasAyinImitishabdena kShipyate||52||

tatreyaM stanasampat- nAtyUrdhvau nAtilambAvanatikRushAvanatipInau yuktapippalakau sukhaprapAnau ceti (stanasampat)||53||

Commentary: yuktapippalakAviti uccaiHstanavRuntau||53||
stanyasampattu prakRutivarNagandharasasparsham, udapAtre ca duhyamAnamudakaM vyeti prakRutibhUtatvAt; tat puShTikaramArogyakaraM ceti (stanyasampat)||54||

ato~anyathA vyApannaM j~jeyam| tasya visheShAH- shyAvAruNavarNaM kaShAyAnurasaM vishadamanAlakShyagandhaM rUkShaM dravaM phenilaM laghvatRuptikaraM karshanaM vAtavikArANAM kartRu vAtopasRuShTaM kShIramabhij~jeyaM ; kRuShNanIlapItatAmrAvabhAsaM tiktAmlakaTukAnurasaM kuNaparudhiragandhi bhRushoShNaM pittavikArANAM kartRu ca pittopasRuShTaM kShIramabhij~jeyam, atyarthashuklamatimAdhuryopapannaM lavaNAnurasaM ghRutatailavasAmajjagandhi picchilaM tantumadukapAtre~avasIdachleShmavikArANAM kartRu shleShmopasRuShTaM kShIramabhij~jeyam||55||

teShAM tu trayANAmapi kShIradoShANAM prativisheShamabhisamIkShya yathAsvaM yathAdoShaM ca vamanavirecanAsthApanAnuvAsanAni vibhajya kRutAni prashamanAya bhavanti| pAnAshanavidhistu duShTakShIrAyA yavagodhUmashAliShaShTikamudgahareNukakulatthasurAsauvIrakamaireyamedakalashunakara~jjaprAyaH syAt| kShIradoShavisheShAMshcAvekShyAvekShya tattadvidhAnaM kAryaM syAt| pAThAmahauShadhasuradArumustamUrvAguDUcIvatsakaphalakirAtatiktakakaTukarohiNIsArivAkaShAyANAM ca pAnaM prashasyate, tathA~anyeShAM tiktakaShAyakaTukamadhurANAM dravyANAM prayogaH kShIravikAravisheShAnabhisamIkShya mAtrAM kAlaM ca| iti kShIravishodhanAni||56||

Commentary: cikitsAmAha- teShAmityAdi| prativisheShamabhisamIkShyeti prati prati vAtAdInAM koShThAshrayitvodIrNatvAdishodhanAnuguNaM visheShamabhivIkShya| yathAsvamityanena shleShmaNi vamanaM, pitte virecanaM, vAyAvAsthApanAnuvAsane, ityAtmIyamAtmIyaM saMshodhanaM darshayati| yathAdoShamityanena pravRuddhe doShe~atimAtraM saMshodhanaM, stoke stokamAtraM darshayati| vibhajyeti yathAsvamityanena yojyam| ‘prakRutivisheSham’ iti yadA pAThastadA prakRutivisheShamapi dhAtryA avekShya vamanAdInAM bahutvAlpatvavisheShaH kartavya ityarthaH| tattadvidhAnaM kAryaM syAditi tattadvRuddhadoShapratikUlamAhAravidhAnaM kAryaM syAt| kaShAyANAmiti bahuvacanAd vyastasamastAnAM pAThAdInAM kaShAyA gRuhyante||56||

kShIrajananAni tu madyAni sIdhuvarjyAni, grAmyAnUpaudakAni ca shAkadhAnyamAMsAni, dravamadhurAmlalavaNabhUyiShThAshcAhArAH, kShIriNyashcauShadhayaH, kShIrapAnamanAyAsashca, vIraNaShaShTikashAlIkShuvAlikAdarbhakushakAshagundretkaTamUlakaShAyANAM ca pAnamiti (kShIrajananAni)||57||

Commentary: kShIriNyashca dugdhikAkalambikAdayo dRushyamAnakShIrAH||57||

dhAtrI tu yadA svAdubahulashuddhadugdhA syAttadAsnAtAnuliptA shuklavastraM paridhAyaindrIM brAhmIM shatavIryAM sahasravIryAmamoghAmavyathAM shivAmariShTAM vATyapuShpIM viShvaksenakAntAM vA bibhratyoShadhiM kumAraM prA~gmukhaM prathamaM dakShiNaM stanaM pAyayet| iti dhAtrIkarma||58||

Commentary: amoghAdayo~anantaraM vyAkRutA eva| avyathA guDUcI||58||

ato~anantaraM kumArAgAravidhimanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- vAstuvidyAkushalaH prashastaM ramyamatamaskaM nivAtaM pravAtaikadeshaM dRuDhamapagatashvApadapashudaMShTrimUShikapata~ggaM suvibhaktasalilolUkhalamUtravarcaHsthAnasnAnabhUmimahAnasamRutusukhaM yathartushayanAsanAstaraNasampannaM kuryAt; tathA suvihitarakShAvidhAnabalima~ggalahomaprAyashcittaM shucivRuddhavaidyAnuraktajanasampUrNam| iti kumArAgAravidhiH||59||

shayanAsanAstaraNaprAvaraNAni kumArasya mRudulaghushucisugandhIni syuH; svedamalajantumanti mUtrapurIShopasRuShTAni ca varjyAni syuH; asati sambhave~anyeShAM tAnyeva ca suprakShAlitopadhAnAni sudhUpitAni shuddhashuShkANyupayogaM gaccheyuH||60||

dhUpanAni punarvAsasAM shayanAstaraNaprAvaraNAnAM ca yavasarShapAtasIhi~ggugugguluvacAcorakavayaHsthAgolomIjaTilApala~gkaShAshokarohiNIsarpanirmokANi ghRutayuktAni syuH||61||

Commentary: vayaHsthA brAhmI, golomI shvetadUrvA, jaTilA mAMsI||61||

maNayashca dhAraNIyAH kumArasya khaDgarurugavayavRuShabhANAM jIvatAmeva dakShiNebhyo viShANebhyo~agrANi gRuhItAni syuH; aindryAdyAshcauShadhayo jIvakarShabhakau ca, yAni cAnyAnyapi brAhmaNAH prashaMseyuratharvavedavidaH||62||

Commentary: maNaya iti muktAdimaNayaH, atharvavedoktAshca| khaDgAdInAM shRu~ggAgrANi dhAraNIyAni syuriti yojanA| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “rurukhaDgAdInAM jIvatAM dakShiNashRu~ggAgrANi nikRuttAni dhArayet” iti| jIvakarShabhakau prajAsthApanoktau| oShadhaya aindryAdyA dasha tatraivoktAH||62||
krIDanakAni khalu kumArasya vicitrANi ghoShavantyabhirAmANi cAgurUNi cAtIkShNAgrANi cAnAsya praveshIni cAprANaharANi cAvitrAsanAni syuH||63||
na hyasya vitrAsanaM sAdhu| tasmAttasmin rudatyabhu~jjAne vA~anyatra vidheyatAmagacchati rAkShasapishAcapUtanAdyAnAM nAmAnyAhvayatA kumArasya vitrAsanArthaM nAmagrahaNaM na kAryaM syAt||64||

yadi tvAturyaM ki~jcit kumAramAgacchet tat prakRutinimittapUrvarUpali~ggopashayavisheShaistattvato~anubudhya sarvavisheShAnAturauShadhadeshakAlAshrayAnavekShamANashcikitsitumArabhetainaM madhuramRudulaghusurabhishItasha~gkaraM karma pravartayan| evaMsAtmyA hi kumArA bhavanti| tathA te sharma labhante cirAya| aroge tvarogavRuttamAtiShTheddeshakAlAtmaguNaviparyayeNa vartamAnaH, krameNAsAtmyAni parivartyopayu~jjAnaH sarvANyahitAni varjayet| tathA balavarNasharIrAyuShAM sampadamavApnotIti||65||
evamenaM kumAramAyauvanaprApterdharmArthakaushalAgamanAccAnupAlayet||66||
iti putrAshiShAM samRuddhikaraM karma vyAkhyAtam| tadAcaran yathoktairvidhibhiH pUjAM yatheShTaM labhate~anasUyaka iti||67||
tatra shlokau- putrAshiShAM karma samRuddhikArakaM yaduktametanmahadarthasaMhitam| tadAcaran j~jo vidhibhiryathAtathaM pUjAM yatheShTaM labhate~anasUyakaH||68||
sharIraM cintyate sarvaM daivamAnuShasampadA| sarvabhAvairyatastasmAcchArIraM sthAnamucyate||69||
iti carakasaMhitAyAM cathurthaM shArIrasthAnaM sampUrNam

strIpuMsayoravyApannashukrashoNitagarbhAshayayoH shreyasIM prajAmicchatostadarthAbhinirvRuttikaraM karmopadekShyAmaH||3||

Commentary: strIpuMsayoriti kramanirdeshaM kRutvA ‘avyApannashoNitagarbhAshayashukrayoH’ iti nirdesho yathAkramAnurodhAdyadyapi yujyate, tathA~apyalpAkSharaM pUrvaM nipatatIti nyAyamAshritya kramabhedena nirdeshaH kRutaH| shreyasIM prajAmicchatorityatra shreyasI prajA guNavAn putro guNavatI ca kanyA~abhipretA, yato~atra kanyotpAdavidhAnamapi leshataH kariShyati; tena nirguNayoH kanyAputrayostathA napuMsakasya cAshreyastvena vyudAsaH; anye tu putrameva shreyasIM prajAmAhuH; yato~atra sarvaM putramevoddishya vidhAnaM prAyaH kariShyati| tadarthAbhinirvRuttikaramiti shreyaHprajArUpaprayojananiShpAdakam||3||

athApyetau strIpuMsau snehasvedAbhyAmupapAdya, vamanavirecanAbhyAM saMshodhya, krameNa prakRutimApAdayet| saMshuddhau cAsthApanAnuvAsanAbhyAmupAcaret; upAcarecca madhurauShadhasaMskRutAbhyAM ghRutakShIrAbhyAM puruShaM, striyaM tu tailamAShAbhyAm||4||

Commentary: athApItyAdau athashabdo~adhikAre, apishabdo visheShArthaH| tenAvyApannashukrashoNitagarbhAshayayorapi strIpuMsayoH shreyaHprajAjanakaguNAdhAnArthaM snehAdikarmakaraNamiti darshayati| yadyapyetAviti padenaivAdhikRutau strIpuMsau labdhau, tathA~api punaryataH strIpuMsAviti karoti tena yugapadeva strIpuMsau snehanAdivakShyamANakarmaNA yojyAviti darshayati| krameNeti peyAdikrameNa| sa ca kramo vamane virecane ca pRuthak pRuthak pradeshAntaroktakramanyAyena boddhavyaH| punaH ‘saMshuddhau ca’ iti vacanAt samyakshuddhayorevAsthApanAnuvAsane kartavye, nAsamyakshuddhayoriti darshayati| madhurauShadhashabdena sarvamadhurauShadhagrahaNaM, madhurasya visheSheNa shukravRuddhikaratvAt; anye tu madhurauShadhashabdena jIvanIyagaNamicchanti||4||
samprati pArisheShyAjjAtisUtrIya ucyate| jAtishabdena janmakAraNamucyate, tasya sUtraM janmopAyakathanaM, tadadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyo jAtisUtrIyaH||1-2||

puShpAditi ArtavadarshanAt| brahmacAriNIti adhaHshAyinIti ca trirAtramityanena sambadhyate| adhaHshAyinIti noccashayyAshAyinI| pANibhyAmannamajarjarapAtrAdbhu~jjAneti pANyoruparyasphuTitaM pAtraM dattvA tatrasthamannaM bhu~jjAnA| na ca kA~jcinmRujAmiti sharIrAvayaveShu kRutsnasharIre vA mArjanam| puruShaM ca caturthe~ahani utsAdyetyAdigranthoktakriyayA yojayediti yojanA| snAnAt prabhRutIti saMvaseyAtAmityanena sambadhyate| tena snAnAt prabhRuti maithunaM vidhIyate na tu snAnadinAt prabhRuti, putrakAmayoryugmadinavidhAnAt| yugmadinaM tu prathamartudinAt prabhRutyeva gaNanIyam| yaduktaM hArIte- “caturthIShaShThyaShTamIdvAdashIShu guNavantamAyuShmantaM putraM janayati, pa~jcamInavamyekAdashIShu kanyAM guNavatIM, saptamyAM durbhagAM kanyAm” iti| nyubjAmiti adhomukhIm| paryApte iti samApte maithune| maithune cAtikAmeti nivRuttecche~api puruShe maithunamicchantI| anyena vA vikAreNeti kuShThAdinA jugupsitena rogeNa| Arohet shayanamiti sambandhaH| ‘ahirasi’ ityAdi ‘dadatu me sutam’ ityanto mantraH||5-8||

sthaNDilaM pUjanasthAnam | vedIM piNDikAm| tAM pashcimeneti vedikAyAH pashcime| shvetArShabhe vA~apyajine iti shvetavRuShabhacarmaNi vetyarthaH| brAhmaNaprayukta iti yadi brAhmaNena putreShTyarthaM prayuktaH syAt tadA sa Rutvik shvetavastrasa~jcaye shvetavRuShabhacarmaNi vA upavishet| rAjanyaprayuktastu vaiyAghrAdicarmaNi ‘upavishet’ iti sheShaH| ruruH hariNavisheShaH| paridhibhiriti caturbhiH palAshabRuhaddaNDaiH| paridhAyeti veShTayitvA| pavitrameva pUtaM mantreNa pavitrapUtaM, taccodapAtravisheShaNam| upasaMskRutyeti tadudapAtrameva saMskAramantrairupasaMskRutya| sarpirAjyArthamiti navanItaM ghRutArthaM; kiMvA sarpirghRutameva, AjyArthamiti mantrapUtaghRutakaraNArtham; Ajyashabdena mantrAbhimantritaM ghRutamucyate| pashcimato~agniM dakShiNato brAhmaNamiti yathA pUrveNAgnirvAme ca brAhmaNo bhavati tathetyarthaH| anulabheteti RutvikprayuktA RutvigvidhAnamanukuryAdityarthaH| prajApatimabhinirdishyeti brahmANamabhimantraya| yonau kAmapUraNArthamagnAviShTiM nirvapet iShTiM kuryAt| viShNuryonimityAdikA iShTisAdhikA Ruk| pAkamiti carum| abhighAryeti mishrIkRutya| yathAmnAyamiti yathAvedam| kintu paribarho varNavarjamiti paribarhaH shayanAsanapuShpAdiparicchadaH; tena yathAvidhA putrecchA tathAvarNaH paribarhaH kartavya iti vAkyArthaH| shUdrAvidhAnamAha- shUdrA tvityAdi| namaskArameva kuryAditi shUdrAyA mantre home cAnadhikArAt namaskAramAtrakaraNam||10-14||

mRudubhirvamanAdibhiriti mRududravyakRutairalpamAtraishca vamanAdibhirityarthaH| tadarthakAribhirveti yathA vamanArthakAri niShThIvanaM, virecanArthakAriNI phalavartiH, ityAdibhirupacAraH kartavyaH| sandhAraNaM vegasandhAraNam| kadAhAraH kutsitAhAraH| shishiraM shItam| yaShTImadhukasiddhaM sarpiH yaShTImadhukasarpiH| celAni grAhayedityatra ‘yoniM’ iti sheShaH| atashcaiveti nyagrodhAdishu~ggAt| kiMvA ‘kShIrasarpiShaH’ ityasmin pAThe kShIrotthitaM sarpiH kShIrasarpiH||22-24||

AmAnvayAditi AmajanakahetoH sakAshAdityarthaH| viruddhopakramatvAditi garbhasrAve hi stambhanaM kartavyaM, tacca shItaM mRudu madhuraM ca; taccAmaviruddham, AmajanakatvAt; iti viruddhopakramatA| anyo veti ArtavalakShaNavyatiriktaH| yadyapi kecidityuktaM, tathA~apyapratiShedhAdAcAryasyApyetat sammatam||25-26||

cikitsitavisheShamityatra visheShashabdena garbhavyAdhyantarApekShayA cikitsitavisheSho j~jeyaH; upaviShTakanAgodarayostu vishiShTaiveha cikitsA vaktavyA; kiMvA ‘yasyAH punargarbhaH prasupto na spandate’ ityAdinA yo~avasthAyAM visheSho vaktavyastamapekShyoktaM- cikitsitavisheShamiti| bhautikaM bhUtopaghAtahitaM vacAguggulvAdi; kiMvA mahApaishAcikaM ghRutaM vakShyamANaM draShTavyam| subhikShAyA iti sububhukShAyAH| na cAnuvAsanasAdhyaM manyeteti sAmatvAdudAvartasya nAnuvAsanasAdhyatA bhavatIti j~jeyam| tadvikAraprashamanamiti udAvartaprashamanamityarthaH| tadudAvartaprashamanaM nirUhamAha- tatretyAdi| parivyAdho vetasabhedaH| udgamayya rasamiti kvAthaM niShpAdya| kvAthAdiparimANaM ca nirUhaparimANaparibhAShayaiva kartavyam| nyubjAmiti adhomukhIm||27-29||
upadeShTavyArthAbhidhAyinI vAk grAhaNIyA| avajRumbhasveti gAtrANi prasArayasva| antaraM labdhveti hetumAsAdya||36-40||

shItodakenoShNodakena veti vikalpo Rutubhedena j~jeyaH; grIShmakAle shItodakena, shItakAle tUShNodakenetyarthaH| kleshavihatAniti yoniyantrapIDanAdikleshaparAhatAn| kRuShNakapAlikA IShikA nalamu~jjavaMshAdibhavA, tatkRutaH shUrpaH kRuShNakapAlikAshUrpaH; tena niShpuNIyuH vIjayeyurityarthaH| atha kiyantaM kAlaM tadvIjanamityAha- yAvat prANAnAM pratyAgamanamiti | udakagrahaNaM malamArgashaucArtham| upadhAnam AvaraNaM, taccehA~ggulyA kArpAsapicunaiva||42-43||

udakaM vyetIti udakaM visheSheNa eti vyApnotItyarthaH| jatUkarNe~apyuktam- “udake visarpat kShIraM prashastam” iti| vAtAdiduShTakShIralakShaNAnyAha- shyAvetyAdi| lavaNAnurasamiti shleShmaduShTe kShIre doShadUShyasammUrcchanaprabhAvAjj~jeyaM, yena shleShmaduShTe lavaNarasatA bhavati; etatpRuthaglakShaNayogAcca dvandvasannipAtaduShTirapyunneyA||54-55||

suprakShAlitopadhAnAnIti sudhautottarapracchAdanAni| shuddhashuShkANIti dhautAnyapi yadA malAdirAgeNApi rahitAni bhavanti shuShkANi ca tadaivopayojyAni; sudhautaM hyArdramapi syAt, tathA gADharAga(gi)malAdibhAvitaM dhautamapyashuddhaM syAt, tasmAduktaM- shuddhashuShkANIti||59-60||

prakRutItyAdau prakRutiH vAtAdayaH, nimittaM bAhyaM rUkShAdi vAtAdikAraNam | sarvavisheShAnityAdau AturashabdenAturyaheturvyAdhirgRuhyate, Ashrayashabdena tu sharIram| shaM kalyANaM karotIti sha~gkaram| deshakAletyAdau Atmashabdena sharIramucyate, tena deshasya tathA kAlasya tathA sharIrasya ca yo guNaH shItAdistadviparItAhArAcArAdisevAyAM vartamAnaH svasthavRuttaM kuryAt| anyatrApi svasthavRutte proktaM- “deshakAlAdiguNaviparItAnAmAhAravihArANAM kriyopayogaH samyak” (shA.a.6) iti| svasthavRuttAntaramAha- krameNetyAdi| kShIrataH kShIrAnne, tato~annameva| tatrApyanne madhurAdi yadbAlAnAM sAtmyaM bhavati tena krameNa navegAndhAraNIyoktena “ucitAdahitAddhImAn kramasho viramennaraH” (sU.a.7) ityAdisvasthavRuttoktena krameNopayu~jjAna ityarthaH| tathA, vastvantarasAtmyasevAyAmapi| bAlasyaivameva vyAkhyAnam| svasthavRuttAcaraNaphalamAha- tathetyAdi||63-66||

putrAshiShAM samRuddhikaramiti putraprArthanAnurUpaphalakaramityarthaH| putrAshiShAmityadhyAyArthasa~ggrahashlokaH| j~ja iti puruShavisheShaNaM prAdhAnyAt kRutam| tena puruShaputralAbhena nAryA api putralAbho~arthAdeva labhyate| anurUpaputralAbhe kathaM me putraH syAdityasUyAM na vahatItyanasUyakaH| kecicchArIrasthAnashabdavyutpattidarshakaM shlokaM paThanti- sharIramityAdi| sa ca vyaktArtha eva||67-69||
athAto varNasvarIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

nIlashyAvatAmraharitashuklAshca varNAH sharIrasya vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutivarNA bhavantyuktAH sharIrasya| tatra prakRutivarNamardhasharIre vikRutivarNamardhasharIre, dvAvapi varNau maryAdAvibhaktau dRuShTvA; yadyevaM savyadakShiNavibhAgena, yadyevaM pUrvapashcimavibhAgena, yadyuttarAdharavibhAgena, yadyantarbahirvibhAgena, AturasyAriShTamiti vidyAt; evameva varNabhedo mukhe~apyanyatra vartamAno maraNAya bhavati||9||

Commentary: nIletyAdinA (vikRutijAyamAnatayA ) vikRutivarNAnAha| iha, ‘aparAn’ iti vacanena vikRutivarNasa~gkarajA varNA j~jeyAH| vikRutivarNAntaramAha- prAgityAdi| prAgvikRutAniti pUrvavarNAdanyathAbhUtAnityarthaH| tenApi, yena shyAmena satA rasAyanopayogAdgauravarNatvaM prAptaM, sa ca tyaktarasAyanaH kAlavashAt punaH shyAmavarNo bhavati tasyApi pUrvagauravarNAdvikRutiH shyAmavarNo bhavan riShTaM syAdityAha- abhUtvotpannAniti; tena nAyaM doShaH; atra hi pUrvabhUta eva varNaH punarbhavati, tena na riShTam| maryAdAvibhaktAviti samasImAvyavasthApitau| pUrvapashcimavibhAgeneti abhimukhapRuShThabhAgenetyarthaH| antarbahirvibhAgeneti atrAntargato varNo mukhanAsAkarNashrotrAntargatatayA unneyaH| anyatreti avAntare hastapAdAdau||9||

varNabhedena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH||10||

Commentary: varNabhedeneti yathA varNavibhAgena riShTaM, tathA glAnyAdivibhAgenApItyarthaH| harSha ihopacayo j~jeyaH, mAnasaharShasyeha cAkShuShAdhikAre~asa~ggatatvAt||10||

tathA pipluvya~ggatilakAlakapiDakAnAmanyatamasyAnane janmAturasyaivamevAprashastaM vidyAt||11||

Commentary: tathetyAdau pipluprabhRutInAmapi varNavat savyadakShiNAdivibhAgena janma riShTaM bhavatItyevamevashabdenocyate||11||

nakhanayanavadanamUtrapurIShahastapAdauShThAdiShvapi ca vaikArikoktAnAM varNAnAmanyatamasya prAdurbhAvo hInabalavarNendriyeShu lakShaNamAyuShaH kShayasya bhavati||12||

Commentary: nakhetyAdau balahAnyAdyabhAve sati na riShTam||12||

yaccAnyadapi ki~jcidvarNavaikRutamabhUtapUrvaM sahasotpadyetAnimittameva hIyamAnasyAturasya shashvat, tadariShTamiti vidyAt| iti varNAdhikAraH||13||

Commentary: yaccetyAdinA~anuktavarNariShTaM sa~ggRuhNAti| abhUtapUrvamiti pUrvavyAkRutarasAyanavihitavarNaprAdurbhAvavyudAsArtham| sahasotpadyata ityanena riShTAnAM shIghrasvabhAvaM darshayati| animittamiti pUrvoktArthameva| hIyamAnasya shashvaditi svabhAvakathanaM, riShTotpattyA hIyamAnatA shashvadavashyaM bhavati||13||

svarAdhikArastu- haMsakrau~jcanemidundubhikalavi~gkakAkakapotajarjarAnukArAH prakRutisvarA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH| eDakakalagrastAvyaktagadgadakShAmadInAnukIrNAstvAturANAM svarA vaikArikA bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo~api vidyAt prAgvikRutAnabhUtvotpannAn | iti prakRutivikRutisvarA vyAkhyAtA bhavanti||14||

Commentary: kramAgataM svaramAha- svaretyAdi| jarjaraH vAdyabhANDavisheShaH| yAMshcetyAdi pUrvavad vyAkhyeyam| eDako meShaH, kiMvA araNyacchAgalaH; kalaH sUkShmaH; grastaH sarvathA~anuccAraH; kShAmaH rUkShaH; dInaH duHkhoccAryamANasvaraH; anukIrNa uparyuparyuccAryamANaH||14||
tatra prakRutivaikArikANAM svarANAmAshvabhinirvRuttiH svarAnekatvamekasya cAnekatvamaprashastam| iti svarAdhikAraH||15||
iti varNasvarAdhikArau yathAvaduktau mumUrShatAM lakShaNaj~jAnArthamiti||16||
bhavanti cAtra- yasya vaikAriko varNaH sharIra upapadyate| ardhe vA yadi vA kRutsne nimittaM na ca nAsti saH||17||
nIlaM vA yadi vA shyAvaM tAmraM vA yadi vA~aruNam| mukhArdhamanyathA varNo mukhArdhe~ariShTamucyate||18||
sneho mukhArdhe suvyakto raukShyamardhamukhe bhRusham| glAnirardhe tathA harSho mukhArdhe pretalakShaNam||19||
tilakAH piplavo vya~ggA rAjayashca pRuthagvidhAH| AturasyAshu jAyante mukhe prANAn mumukShataH||20||
puShpANi nakhadanteShu pa~gko vA dantasaMshritaH| cUrNako vA~api danteShu lakShaNaM maraNasya tat||21||
oShThayoH pAdayoH pANyorakShNormUtrapurIShayoH| nakheShvapi ca vaivarNyametat kShINabale~antakRut||22||
yasya nIlAvubhAvoShThau pakvajAmbavasannibhau| mumUrShuriti taM vidyAnnaro dhIro gatAyuSham||23||
eko vA yadi vA~aneko yasya vaikArikaH svaraH| sahasotpadyate jantorhIyamAnasya nAsti saH||24||
yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdvaikRutaM svaravarNayoH| balamAMsavihInasya tat sarvaM maraNodayam ||25||
tatra shlokaH- iti varNasvarAvuktau lakShaNArthaM mumUrShatAm| yastau samyagvijAnAti nAyurj~jAne sa muhyati||26||

iha khalu varNashca svarashca gandhashca rasashca sparshashca cakShushca shrotraM ca ghrANaM ca rasanaM ca sparshanaM ca sattvaM ca bhaktishca shaucaM ca shIlaM cAcArashca smRutishcAkRutishca prakRutishca vikRutishca balaM ca glAnishca medhA ca harShashca raukShyaM ca snehashca tandrA cArambhashca gauravaM ca lAghavaM ca guNAshcAhArashca vihArashcAhArapariNAmashcopAyashcApAyashca vyAdhishca vyAdhipUrvarUpaM ca vedanAshcopadravAshca cchAyA ca praticchAyA ca svapnadarshanaM ca dUtAdhikArashca pathi cautpAtikaM cAturakule bhAvAvasthAntarANi ca bheShajasaMvRuttishca bheShajavikArayuktishceti parIkShyANi pratyakShAnumAnopadeshairAyuShaH pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAnena bhiShajA||3||

Commentary: indriyasthAnapratipAdyaM kRutsnaM viShayamAha- ihetyAdi| iha indriyasthAne| khalushabdo vAkyAla~gkAre| iha ca yadyapIndriyANyeva viShayavarNAdigrAhakatayA agre vaktuM yujyante, tathA~api teShAmatIndriyatvena tadAshrayariShTAnAmavyaktatvaM ; tena, pravyaktAni varNAdInyeva pravyaktariShTAdhikaraNAnyagre~abhidhIyante| varNAdiShvapi ca yathA vyaktatvaM tathA pUrvanipAtaH| meghAdishabdastu yadyapi varNAdapi vyaktastathA~api shabdavisheSha eveha tAlvAdisampAdyaH svarashabdAbhidheyo riShTAdhikaraNatvenAbhimataH, sa ca varNApekShayA~avyakta eva| ihetyAdAvasamAsena pratyekamapi varNAdInAM riShTAdhikaraNatvaM darshayati; samAse hi samudAyasyaiva riShTAdhikaraNakatayA parIkShitavyatvaM sha~gkyeta| varNashabdena ca varNasahacaritAshcakShurgrAhyA raukShyAdayo~api gRuhyante; ata eva varNaprastAva eva vakShyati- yat- “varNagrahaNena glAniharSharaukShyasnehA vyAkhyAtAH” iti| svarAdigrahaNena ca svarAdyabhAvo~api gRuhyate, tenA~gguliparvashabdAbhAva-gandhAbhAvAdayo~api riShTAnyavarudhyante| sparshagrahaNena ca sparshopalabhyakAThinyAdyavarodhaH| sattvaM manaH; sattvavikRuterudAharaNaM yathA- “autsukyaM bhajate sattvaM ceto bhIrAvishatyapi” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bhaktiH icchA| shIlaM sahajaM vRuttam| AcAraH shAstrashikShAkRuto vyavahAraH| bhaktyAdayo yadyapi sattvavikAratvena sattvagrahaNenaiva labhyante; yaduktaM- “bhaktiH shIlaM shaucaM dveShaH smRutirmohastyAgo~amAtsaryaM bhayaM krodhastandrotsAhastaikShNyaM mArdavaM gAmbhIryamanavasthitatvamityevamAdayaH sattvavikArAH” (shA.a.3) iti; tathA~api bhaktyAdInAmapi pRuthagariShTAdhikaraNatveneha pRuthakkaraNam| nidrAdaurbalyAttandreti tandrAshabdena nidrocyate; atra ca riShTamuktaM yathA- “nidrA nityA bhavati vA na vA” (iM.a.11) iti| Arambha iti ariShTavyAdhyutpAdArambhaH ; yaduktaM- “shvayathuryasya kukShistho hastapAdaM pradhAvati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| gaurave riShTaM yathA- “niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca retashcAmbhasi majjati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| lAghave riShTaM- gurUNAma~ggAnAM lAghavaM j~jeyam| guNariShTaM yathA- “guNAH sharIradeshAnAM shItoShNamRududAruNAH| viparyAsena lakShyante sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhAH” (iM.a.12) iti| AhArariShTaM yathA- “AhAramupayu~jjAno bhiShajA sUpakalpitam” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| AhArapariNAmariShTaM yathA- “durbalo bahu bhu~gkte yo prAgabhuktvA~annamAturaH| alpamUtrapurIShashca” (iM.a.7) iti| upAya upagamanaM vyAdhimelaka ityarthaH; yaduktaM- “sahasA jvarasantApastRuShNA mUrcchA balakShayaH| vishleShaNaM ca sandhInAM” (iM.a.8) iti| vyAdhyapagamanamapAyaH; yaduktaM- “yaM naraM sahasA rogo durbalaM parimu~jcati” (iM.a.9) ityAdi| vyAdhishceti vyAdhireva riShTaM yathA- “vAtAShThIlA susaMvRuttA dAruNA hRudi tiShThati” (iM.a.10) iti| chAyA bhautikI pa~jcarUpA, praticchAyA tu dehacchAyA; praticchAyayA ca netrakumArikA~api praticchAyArUpA gRuhItavyA| ayaM ca chAyAdibhedaH pannarUpIyendriye darshayitavyaH | Aturakule bhAvAvasthAriShTaM yathA- “agnipUrNAni pAtrANi bhinnAni vishikhAni ca| bhiSha~gmumUrShatAM veshma pravishanneva pashyati” (iM.a.12) ityAdi| bheShajasaMvRuttau riShTaM yathA- “yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH saMvartayitumauShadham| yatamAno na shaknoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam” (iM.a.12) iti| bheShajasya vikAreNa samaM yuktirbheShajavikArayuktiH; tatra riShTaM yathA- “vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam” (iM.a.12) iti| sheShaM tu riShTodAharaNaM vyaktam| iti samAptau| pratyakShapUrvakatvAt sarvapramANAnAmihAdau pratyakShaM kRutam| yadyapi varNAdaya AyurlakShaNapratipAditA dIrghAyuHpramANajij~jAsAyAmapi parIkShyante, tathA~apIha riShTaprakaraNe AyuHpramANAvasheShaj~jAnArthameva parIkShaNIyAH, ata uktaM- pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsamAneneti||3||

tatra tu khalveShAM parIkShyANAM kAnicit puruShamanAshritAni, kAnicicca puruShasaMshrayANi| tatra yAni puruShamanAshritAni tAnyupadeshato yuktitashca parIkSheta, puruShasaMshrayANi punaH prakRutito vikRutitashca||4||

Commentary: puruShamanAshritAni dUtAdyAshrayANi riShTAni| yuktitashcetyanumAnata ityarthaH, atra yukterapi riShTatvAvadhAraNe kShamatvAt| pratyakShaM hi dUtAdInAM svarUpamAtraM gRuhNAti, riShTaM tu dUtAdInAmAgamAdeva j~jAyate| puruShAshrayivarNAdigatariShTagrahaNe tu pratyakShamapi tattadariShTavisheShagrahaNe tattadvisheSheNa vyApriyata iti matvA~atra tatpratiShiddham| anumAnaM tu riShTatvena pratipAditamanimittatvAdidharmavicAre vyApriyate, evaM sarvatra| prakRutitashceti puruShAshrayavikRutij~jAnahetutayA prakRutI riShTaj~jAne vyApriyate, yataH prakRutij~jAnAdhInaM vikRutij~jAnaM bhavati; prakRutivikRutiparIkShA tvatrAdhikRutaiH prasiddhaiH pratyakShAdibhireva j~jeyA||4||

tatra prakRutirjAtiprasaktA ca, kulaprasaktA ca, deshAnupAtinI ca, kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo~anupAtinI ca, pratyAtmaniyatA ceti| jAtikuladeshakAlavayaHpratyAtmaniyatA hi teShAM teShAM puruShANAM te te bhAvavisheShA bhavanti||5||

Commentary: prakRutiM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| jAtiprasaktA yathA- brAhmaNajAtau shaucaM, kulaprasaktA yathA- ki~jcideva kulaM shucyAcAravadbhavati, deshAnupAtinI yathA- antarvedivAsinaH shucayo bhavanti, kAlAnupAtinI yathA- kRutayuge shaucaM, vayo~anupAtinI yathA- bAlye~ashaucaM, pratyAtmaniyatA yathA- kashcideva puruShaH prakRutyA shucirbhavati; ityAdyudAharaNIyam| kutaH punarjAtyAdiniyatA prakRutirbhavatItyatra hetumAha- jAtikuletyAdi| te te bhAvavisheShA iti shucitvAshaucAdayaH ||5||

vikRutiH punarlakShaNanimittA ca, lakShyanimittA ca, nimittAnurUpA ca||6||

Commentary: riShTAdhikArAdhikRutAM vikRutiM vivecayituM sarvAneva vikRutibhedAnAha- vikRutirityAdi||6||

tatrAdita eva varNAdhikAraH| tadyathA- kRuShNaH, shyAmaH , shyAmAvadAtaH, avadAtashceti prakRutivarNAH sharIrasya bhavanti; yAMshcAparAnupekShamANo vidyAdanUkato~anyathA vA~api nirdishyamAnAMstajj~jaiH||8||

Commentary: prakRutij~jAnAntarIyakatvAdvikRutij~jAnasya prakRutivarNAneva tAvadAha- kRuShNa ityAdi| avadAto gauraH| iha ca prAyeNa ye varNAH prakRutyA bhavanti te prakRutivarNA ucyante, ye tu prAyeNa vikRutyA bhavanti te vikRutivarNA ucyante, iti j~jeyam| tena prakRutivarNA api kadAcidvikRutivarNA bhavanti, tathA vikRutivarNA api janmaprabhRutijAyamAnatayA kadAcit prakRutivarNA bhavantIti j~jeyam| anuktaprakRutivarNAtideshArthamAha- yAMshcetyAdi| upetya IkShamANa iti upekShamANaH| anUkata iti sAdRushyataH; anena ca shyAmetyAdivarNashabdena nirdishyamAnAn vidyAditi yojanA| tajj~jairiti varNabhedanAmaj~jaiH||8||

shArIre cikitsAdhikaraNaM sharIraM pratipAdya cikitsA vaktavyA, sA ca sAdhya eva roge vaktavyA nAsAdhyaroge, yaduktaM- “arthavidyAyashohAnimupakroshamasa~ggraham| prApnuyAnniyataM vaidyo yo~asAdhyaM samupAcaret” (sU.a.10) iti; na ca riShTapratipattimantarA~asAdhyatvapratipattiriti riShTapratipAdakamindriyasthAnameva cikitsAsthAnAt prAgucyate | indrashabdena prANa ucyate, tasyAntagatasya li~ggaM riShTAkhyamindriyaM; yaduktaM vyAkaraNe- “indriyamindrali~ggaM” (pA.a.5.2.13) ityAdi; tasyendriyasya sthAnamindriyasthAnam| tatrApi cendriyasthAne vaktavye vyaktatamariShTAbhidhAyakatayA varNasvarIyamindriyamucyate, atra hi yAni riShTAni vaktavyAni tAnItarariShTebhyashcakShurAdigrAhyatayA vyaktatamAni| varNasvarAvadhikRutya kRuto varNasvarIyaH, indriyasya riShTarUpasya pratipAdako~adhyAya indriyaH, taM vyAkhyAsyAmaH| evamanyatrApi puShpitakamityAdyapIndriyavisheShaNaM vyAkhyeyam||1-2||

prakRutervaikArikA anyathAbhUtA iti prakRutivaikArikAH| svarAnekatvamiti kadAcideDakasvaratvaM, kadAcit kalasvaratvamityAdi| ekasya cAnekatvamiti ekasyaiva svarasya cAnekatvamiva pratibhAti| animittamiti sarvatra sambadhyate||15-16||

ayamevArtho gadyoktaH spaShTArthaM sukhagrahaNArthaM ca shlokenocyate- yasyetyAdinA| tilakA ityAdau mukhe iti mukhArdhe| oShThAviti dvivacanamuktvA~api yat ‘ubhau’ iti karoti, tena sakalauShThavyAptiM darshayati| mumUrShurityukatvA~api yat ‘gatAyuShaM’ iti karoti, tena riShTayukto mumUrShargatAyurIti darshayati; ajAtariShTastu pratikriyAbhAvAnmumUrShuragatAyurapi bhavati| maraNodayamiti maraNakAraNamiti j~jAnArtham||17-26||
athAtaH puShpitakamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaha||1||
puShpaM yathA pUrvarUpaM phalasyeha bhaviShyataH| tathA li~ggamariShTAkhyaM pUrvarUpaM mariShyataH||3||
apyevaM tu bhavet puShpaM phalenAnanubandhi yat| phalaM cApi bhavet ki~jcidyasya puShpaM na pUrvajam ||4||
na tvariShTasya jAtasya nAsho~asti maraNAdRute| maraNaM cApi tannAsti yannAriShTapuraHsaram||5||

mithyAdRuShTamariShTAbhamanariShTamajAnatA| ariShTaM vA~apyasambuddhametat praj~jAparAdhajam||6||
