Commentary: yatra kutracidriShTamaraNavyabhicArij~jAnaM bhavati tadbhrAntamiti darshayannAha- mithyetyAdi| ariShTAbhamiti ariShTasadRusham| mithyAdRuShTamiti riShTatvena j~jAtam; etadanariShTe riShTaj~jAnaM praj~jAparAdhajaM; tathA riShTamapi sUkShmarUpatayA mArake vyAdhAvasambandhaM bhavati, etadapi praj~jAparAdhajaM mithyAj~jAnam| tena riShTe satyapi maraNaM na bhavatIti j~jAnaM bhrAntaM, tathA riShTaM vinA~api kvacinmaraNaM bhavatIti j~jAnaM bhrAntam| tatashca siddho~avyabhicAro maraNariShTayoriti vAkyArthaH||6||

j~jAnasambodhanArthaM tu li~ggairmaraNapUrvajaiH| puShpitAnupadekShyAmo narAn bahuvidhairbahUn ||7||

Commentary: j~jAyate maraNamaneneti j~jAnaM riShTaM, tasya samyagbodhanaM j~jAnasambodhanam| maraNapUrvajairiti maraNapUrvabhAvibhiH| puShpitA yathA vRukShAdayo gandhavanto bhavanti tathA riShTagandhaprayuktA ye bhavanti te puShpitAH, tAn puShpitAn| bahuvidhairli~ggairbahUn puShpitAniti yojanA||7||
nAnApuShpopamo gandho yasya bhAti divAnisham| puShpitasya vanasyeva nAnAdrumalatAvataH||8||
tamAhuH puShpitaM dhIrA naraM maraNalakShaNaiH| sa nA saMvatsarAddehaM jahAtIti vinishcayaH||9||
evamekaikashaH puShpairyasya gandhaH samo bhavet| iShTairvA yadi vA~aniShTaiH sa ca puShpita ucyate||10||
samAsenAshubhAn gandhAnekatvenAthavA punaH| Ajighredyasya gAtreShu taM vidyAt puShpitaM bhiShak||11||
AplutAnAplute kAye yasya gandhAH shubhAshubhAH| vyatyAsenAnimittAH syuH sa ca puShpita ucyate||12||
tadyathA- candanaM kuShThaM tagarAguruNI madhu| mAlyaM mUtrapurIShe ca mRutAni kuNapAni ca||13||
ye cAnye vividhAtmAno gandhA vividhayonayaH| te~apyanenAnumAnena vij~jeyA vikRutiM gatAH||14||
idaM cApyatideshArthaM lakShaNaM gandhasaMshrayam| vakShyAmo yadabhij~jAya bhiSha~gmaraNamAdishet||15||
viyonirviduro gandho yasya gAtreShu jAyate| iShTo vA yadi vA~aniShTo na sa jIvati tAM samAm||16||
...rasaj~jAnamataH param| AturANAM sharIreShu vakShyate vidhipUrvakam||17||
yo rasaH prakRutisthAnAM narANAM dehasambhavaH| sa eShAM carame kAle vikAraM bhajate dvayam||18||
kashcidevAsyavairasyamatyarthamupapadyate| svAdutvamaparashcApi vipulaM bhajate rasaH||19||
tamanenAnumAnena vidyAdvikRutimAgatam| manuShyo hi manuShyasya kathaM rasamavApnuyAt||20||
makShikAshcaiva yUkAshca daMshAshca mashakaiH saha| virasAdapasarpanti jantoH kAyAnmumUrShataH||21||
atyartharasikaM kAyaM kAlapakvasya makShikAH| api snAtAnuliptasya bhRushamAyAnti sarvashaH||22||

tatra shlokaH- sAmAnyena mayoktAni li~ggAni rasagandhayoH| puShpitasya narasyaitatphalaM maraNamAdishet||23||

Commentary: sa~ggrahashloke sAmAnyena puShpitasyeti vacanAdrasariShTe~api puShpitatvamasya vivakShitaM, tena rasariShTe~api saMvatsarAbhyantare maraNamiti phalati||23||

varNasvarAnantaraM gandhasyAdhikRutatvAnnirdiShTatvAcca tadAshrayiriShTapratipAdakaM puShpitakamucyate- puShpaM yathetyAdi| prakaraNArtho yadyapi sakalendriyasAdhAraNatayA prathamAdhyAya eva vaktuM yujyate, tathA~apIha puShpAnukAreNa gandhAshrayiriShTasya vAcyatvAt, puShpaM prakRutaM, tatprasa~ggAcca riShTasya puShpadharmakhyApakamapi prakaraNamihocyate| puShpaM yathetyAdau avyabhicaritaphalasambandhameva puShpaM j~jeyam, ata eva ‘apyevaM tu’ ityAdinA phalapuShpayoH parasparavyabhicAraM darshayati||1-3||

puShpaphaladRuShTAntena riShTamaraNayordurbodhatvAt puShpaphalavyabhicAramapi shiShyo gRuhNIyAditi tannirAsArthamAha- apyevamityAdi| phalenAnubandhIti yathA- vetasapuShpam| yasya puShpaM na pUrvajamiti yathA- ashvatthAdiphalam| jAtasyeti sampUrNasya, ki~jcidudite hyariShTe~asampUrNe nAvashyaM mRutyuH| anye tu jAtasya niyatasyeti varNayanti; dvividhaM hi riShTaM- niyataM cAniyataM ca; tatra niyataM “mRutameva tamAtreyo vyAcacakShe punarvasuH” (iM.a.7) ityAdi, aniyataM yathA- “saMshayaprAptamAtreyo manyate tasya jIvitam” (iM.a.9), “arogaH saMshayaM gatvA kashcideva pramucyate” (iM.a.5) iti; tathA~aniyatAriShTAbhiprAyeNaiva sushrute~apyuktaM- “dhruvaM tvariShTe maraNaM brAhmaNaistat kilAmalaiH| rasAyanatapojapyatatparairvA nivAryate” iti| (su.sU.a.) etaccAnye na manyante, AcAryeNa riShTamaraNayoravyabhicArasya mahatA prayatnena darshitatvAt| saMshayaprAptamiti vacanaM maraNapratipAdakamevAcAryeNa bha~ggyantareNoktaM, yathA~a~acAryasya riShTArthastathA tadgrantha eva vyAkhyAsyAmaH| yattu rasAyanAdinA bAdhyatvaM riShTasya tadanumatameva, rasAyanamaheshvaraprasAdAdayo hi sarvalokamaryAdAmapi hantuM kShamAH, atastena tadvyabhicAramavekShyeha granthaH kriyate; maheshvaro hi bhasmIbhUtaM kAmaM punarjIvayati sma, tapasA ca rAmeNa mRuto~api vipraputraH punarjIvita ityAdyanusaraNIyam| anye tu kAlamRutyAveva riShTapUrvakaM maraNaM bhavatIti varNayanti, vadanti ca- “yadyakAlamRutyau riShTaM bhavati tadA varNAdyaM mRutyupradaM riShTaM tadviphalaM syAt, yena kAlamRutyAvucitAcaraNe~api paraM mRutyurbhavati nAkAlamRutyau, tatra riShTe jAte yadyucitA kriyA kriyate na tadA mRutyurbhavitumarhati; tena kAlamRutyugatameva riShTam” iti| tacca na, avisheSheNa kAlAkAlamaraNe riShTasadbhAvaniyamAbhidhAnAt| akAlamRutyau ca yadaiva kriyApathamatikrAnte~apacArajanito vyAdhirbhavati, tadaiva paraM riShTaM bhavati, ata evoktaM- “kShaNena hi riShTAni prAdurbhavanti” iti| yashcainaM (vaM) na svIkaroti tasya niyatAyuSho~apacArajanyavyAdherasAdhyatA kadA~api na syAt; yena, yathA- apacArajA doShA atishayapramAdAdasAdhyavyAdhijanakA bhavanti, tathA maraNapUrvariShTajanakA api bhavanti||4-5||

vanasyetyukte~api yat ‘nAnAdrumalatAvataH’ iti karoti, tena bhinnajAtIyaM vanaM grAhayati; vanaM hi svajAtIyavRukShANAmapisyAt, yathA- campakavanamashokavanamityAdi; nAnAtvaM ca puShpANAmekajAtIyAnAmapi kalikAdyavasthAbhedAdapi syAt, tasmAt sAdhu visheShaNaM- nAnAdrumalatAvata iti| maraNalakShaNairyathoktairgandhaistaM puShpitamAhuriti yojyam| saMvatsarAditi saMvatsarAbhyantare| evamiti divAnisham| samAsenetyAdinA puShpavyatiriktashavAdyashubhagandhayogenApi puShpitatvaM, ‘paribhAShyate’ iti sheShaH; samAseneti melakena| AplutetyAdau AplutAnAplutavisheShavyatyAsaH, tathA shubhAshubhagandhAnAM vyatyAsashca j~jeyaH| puShpitatvAbhidhAnaM ca yatra yatra, tatra tatra saMvatsarAntaM jIvitaM pUrvavacanAdbhavati| tadyathetyAdinA shubhAshubhadravyANyAha| mRutAnIti mAnuShavyatiriktAni gavAdIni mRutAni, kuNapAni tu mAnuShasharIrANI| vividhayonaya ityanena nAnAdravyakRutadhUpavartyAdigandhAn grAhayati; vividhAtmAna ityanena tu akRutrimanAnAdravyagandhA ucyante| anenAnumAneneti ‘AplutAnAplute’ ityAdigranthoktariShTAnusAreNa| atideshArthamiti anuktaj~jAnArtham| viyoniriti nirhetukaH| vidUra iti sthAyI||8-16||-
vairasyamiti aniShTarasatAm| kathamiti AkShepe; tena na kathamapItyarthaH| avApnuyAditi jAnIyAt| atyartharasikamiti atisvAdurasam| kAlapakvAsyeti pUrNakAlasya| sarvasha iti sarvagAtreShu||17-22||
athAtaH parimarshanIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
varNe svare ca gandhe ca rase coktaM pRuthak pRuthak| li~ggaM mumUrShatAM samyak sparsheShvapi nibodhata||3||

sparshaprAdhAnyenaivAturasyAyuShaH pramANAvasheShaM jij~jAsuH prakRutisthena pANinA sharIramasya kevalaM spRushet, parimarshayedvA~anyena| parimRushatA tu khalvAturasharIramime bhAvAstatra tatrAvaboddhavyA bhavanti| tadyathA- satataM spandamAnAnAM sharIradeshAnAmaspandanaM, nityoShmaNAM shItIbhAvaH, mRudUnAM dAruNatvaM, shlakShNAnAM kharatvaM, satAmasadbhAvaH , sandhInAM sraMsabhraMshacyavanAni; mAMsashoNitayorvItIbhAvaH, dAruNatvaM, svedAnubandhaH, stambho vA; yaccAnyadapi ki~jcidIdRushaM sparshAnAM lakShaNaM bhRushavikRutamanimittaM syAt| iti lakShaNaM spRushyAnAM bhAvAnAmuktaM samAsena||4||

Commentary: sparsheneti vaktavye yat ‘sparshaprAdhAnyena’ iti karoti, tena asparshagrAhyamapi cakShurlohitatvAdi riShTamiha sparshaparIkShyamadhye oghAdAyAtaM vaktavyamiti darshayati| prakRutistheneti nAtyuShNashItena| kevalamiti kRutsnam| gurudArAdeH svayaM sparsho yadA na yujyate tadA kartavyamAha- parimarshayedvA~anyeneti| satAmasadbhAva iti atra ca vRuShNAdInAM satAmiti j~jeyaM, sthUlAvayavAnAM riShTe~apyabhAvadarshanAt| sraMsaH manAggamanaM, bhraMshastu sudUrAdhogamanaM, dhAvanaM tu pArshvato gamanam| vItIbhAvaH atikShINatvam| lakShaNamiti maraNalakShaNam| samAseneti cchedaH||4||

tadvyAsato~anuvyAkhyAsyAmaH- tasya cet parimRushyamAnaM pRuthaktvena pAdaja~gghorusphigudarapArshvapRuShTheShikApANigrIvAtAlvoShThalalATaM svinnaM shItaM stabdhaM dAruNaM vItamAMsashoNitaM vA syAt, parAsurayaM puruSho na cirAt kAlaM mariShyatIti vidyAt| tasya cet parimRushyamAnAni pRuthaktvena gulphajAnuva~gkShaNagudavRuShaNameDhranAbhyaMsastanamaNikaparshukAhanunAsikAkarNAkShibhrUsha~gkhAdIni srastAni vyastAni cyutAni sthAnebhyaH skannAni vA syuH, parAsurayaM puruSho~acirAt kAlaM mariShyatIti vidyAt||5||

tathA~asyocchvAsamanyAdantapakShmacakShuHkeshalomodaranakhA~ggulIrAlakShayet| tasya ceducchvAso~atidIrgho~atihrasvo vA syAt, parAsuriti vidyAt| tasya cenmanye parimRushyamAne na spandeyAtAM, parAsuriti vidyAt| tasya ceddantAH parikIrNAH shvetA jAtasharkarAH syuH, parAsuriti vidyAt| tasya cet pakShmANi jaTAbaddhAni syuH, parAsuriti vidyAt| tasya ceccakShuShI prakRutihIne, vikRutiyukte- atyutpiNDite, atipraviShTe, atijihme, ativiShame, atimuktabandhane, atiprasrute, satatonmiShite, satatanimiShite, nimiShonmeShAtipravRutte, vibhrAntadRuShTike, viparItadRuShTike, hInadRuShTike, vyastadRuShTike , nakulAndhe, kapotAndhe, alAtavarNe, kRuShNapItanIlashyAvatAmraharitahAridrashuklavaikArikANAM varNAnAmanyatamenAtiplute vA syAtAM, tadA parAsuriti vidyAt| athAsya keshalomAnyAyacchet, tasya cet keshalomAnyAyamyamAnAni pralucyeran na cedvedayeyustaM parAsuriti vidyAt| tasya cedudare sirAH prakAshera~j shyAvatAmranIlahAridrashuklA vA syuH, parAsuriti vidyAt| tasya cennakhA vItamAMsashoNitAH pakvajAmbavavarNAH syuH, parAsuriti vidyAt| athAsyA~ggulIrAyacchet; tasya ceda~ggulaya AyamyamAnA na sphuTeyuH, parAsuriti vidyAt||6||

tatra shlokaH- etAn spRushyAn bahUn bhAvAn yaH spRushannavabudhyate| Ature na sa sammohamAyurj~jAnasya gacchati||7||

Commentary: etAn spRushyAniti bAhulyAduktam; evaM spRushannityetadapi bAhulyAduktam| ‘Ayurj~jAnasyeti’ pAThapakShe ShaShThI sambandhavivakShAyAm||7||
indriyArthAnugatariShTapArisheShyAt sparshagatariShTAbhidhAyakaM parimarshanIyamindriyamucyate; imameva cAdhyAyasambandhaM darshayannAha- varNe svare cetyAdi||1-3||

pRuShTheShikA pRuShThavaMshaH| pRuthaktveneti ekaikashyena| maNikaH karabAhusandhiH| manye galapArshvagate dhamanyau| ucchvAsadairghyahrAsau nAsAgradattakarasparshAdupalabhyete| parikIrNA iti malaliptAH| dantAdishvetatvaM cakShurgrAhyamapi sparshaparIkShaNIyadantadharmaprastAvAducyate| cakShuShI prakRutihIne vikRutiyukte iti sAmAnyavacanaM; tasya vivaraNam- atyutpiNDite ityAdi| atyutpiNDite iti atyarthanirgate | atijihme atikuTile| ativiShame iti ekaM saMvRutam, aparaM vistRutamiti| nimeShonmeShakriyAyAmatyarthaM pravartete iti nimeShonmeShAtipravRutte| viparItadRuShTike iti keyUradRuShTike; kiMvA viparItadRuShTike anyathAgrAhiNI| hInadRuShTike adUradarshinI, naShTadRuShTike vA| nakulAndhakapotAndhalakShaNe granthaH- “nakulAndhastu rUpANi divA shuklAni pashyati| kapotAndhastu rUpANi divA kRuShNAni pashyati” iti| alAtastu taptA~ggAraH| iha cakShurgatAriShTAbhidhAnaprastAvAdasparshagrAhmamapi cakShuShoralAtavarNatvAdikamucyate| udarAnugatAH sirAstviha sparshanagrAhyA bhavantIti uktAH; tatprasa~ggAccakShurgrAhyAH sirAvarNA apyuktAH| Ayacchediti sphoTayet| nakhA~gguligatAriShTaparIkShAyAM tu sparsho~api vyApriyata eveti kRutvA tadariShTamapIhoktam||5-6||
athAta indriyAnIkamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

tatra shlokaH- etadindriyavij~jAnaM yaH pashyati yathAtatham| maraNaM jIvitaM caiva sa bhiShak j~jAtumarhati||27||

Commentary: indriyavij~jAnamindriyagatariShTavij~jAnam| jIvitaj~jAnaM ceha riShTashUnyendriyaj~jAne sati bhavatIti j~jeyam||27||
indriyANi yathA jantoH parIkSheta visheShavit| j~jAtumicchan bhiSha~gmAnamAyuShastannibodhata ||3||
anumAnAt parIkSheta darshanAdIni tattvataH| addhA hi viditaM j~jAnamindriyANAmatIndriyam||4||
svasthebhyo vikRutaM yasya j~jAnamindriyasaMshrayam | AlakShyetAnimittena lakShaNaM maraNasya tat||5||
ityuktaM lakShaNaM samyagindriyeShvashubhodayam| tadeva tu punarbhUyo vistareNa nibodhata||6||

ghanIbhUtamivAkAshamAkAshamiva medinIm| vigItamubhayaM hyetat pashyan maraNamRucchati||7||

Commentary: ghanIbhUtamiti kaThinatAM gataM; kiMvA bhUtashabdaH kRutArthe, yathA- upadhAnIbhUtam| tena, ivashabdashcopamAne bhavati| anye tu ghanIbhUtaM pRuthivIrUpatAM yAtaM vadanti| AkAshamiva medinImiti shUnyarUpAM medinIm| vigItamiti viparItatvena j~jAtam| ubhayamityanena yaugapadyena pRuthivyAkAshaviparItopalambho riShTaM, naikaikashyena| ayaM cAriShTamahimA yadevaMrUpameva riShTaM bhavati, evamuktAriShTeShu tathA tathotpAdaH svamahimnaiva j~jeyaH| etAni cAriShTAni sAmAnyenaivendriyAriShTAbhidhAyakaprakaraNalabdhAnyapi prAyobhAvitvena shRu~ggagrAhikayA~abhidhIyante||7||

yasya darshanamAyAti mAruto~ambaragocaraH| agnirnAyAti cAdIptastasyAyuHkShayamAdishet||8||

Commentary: darshanamiti cakShurgocaratAm| ambaragocara ityanena bhUmiShThadevatArUpavAtadarshanaM niShedhayati| etena ‘eSha vAyuH, ityAkAravAn’ ititi mArutapratyakShaj~jAnamariShTam| nAyAti darshanamiti sambandhaH||8||

jale suvimale jAlamajAlAvatate naraH| sthite gacchati vA dRuShTvA jIvitAt parimucyate||9||

Commentary: sthite iti sthire| gacchati vahamAne| yeShu ceha riShTeShu maraNakAlaniyamo noktastatra saMvatsaramavadhirbhavati, tataH pareNa hi riShTe maraNAnabhidhAnAt||9||

jAgrat pashyati yaH pretAn rakShAMsi vividhAni ca| anyadvA~apyadbhutaM ki~jcinna sa jIvitumarhati||10||

Commentary: pretAnityAdibahuvacanAnnaikapretAdidarshanaM riShTamiti bhAvaH||10||

yo~agniM prakRutivarNasthaM nIlaM pashyati niShprabham| kRuShNaM vA yadi vA shuklaM nishAM vrajati saptamIm||11||

Commentary: prakRutivarNasthamiti vaivarNyavikRutyAdikArakasaviShAnnavarNAdiviraheNa svIya eva lohitakapile varNe vyavasthitam| saptamIM nishAM vrajati, tenAShTAhAnmaraNam||11||

marIcInasato meghAnmeghAn vA~apyasato~ambare| vidyuto vA vinA meghaiH pashyan maraNamRucchati||12||

Commentary: marIcInasata ityatra prakaraNAnmarIcishabdena meghajyotirucyate| marIcInAM visheShaNam- asata iti| vidyuto vA vinA meghAditi abhrAntacchaTA eva sarvadA meghasambandhopalabhyamAnA grAhyA, nAnyA vidyuditi; tA hi vinA meghadarshanamapi sudUrAt svasthairapyupalabhyante||12||
mRunmayImiva yaH pAtrIM kRuShNAmbarasamAvRutAm| AdityamIkShate shuddhaM candraM vA na sa jIvati||13||
aparvaNi yadA pashyet sUryAcandramasorgraham| avyAdhito vyAdhito vA tadantaM tasya jIvitam||14||
naktaM sUryamahashcandramanagnau dhUmamutthitam| agniM vA niShprabhaM rAtrau dRuShTvA maraNamRucchati||15||
prabhAvataH prabhAhInAnniShprabhAMshca prabhAvataH| narA vili~ggAn pashyanti bhAvAn bhAvA~jjihAsavaH ||16||
vyAkRutIni vivarNAni visa~gkhyopagatAni ca| vinimittAni pashyanti rUpANyAyuHkShaye narAH||17||
yashca pashyatyadRushyAn vai dRushyAn yashca na pashyati| tAvubhau pashyataH kShipraM yamakShayamasaMshayam||18||
ashabdasya ca yaH shrotA shabdAn yashca na budhyate| dvAvapyetau yathA pretau tathA j~jeyau vijAnatA ||19||
saMvRutyA~ggulibhiH karNau jvAlAshabdaM ya AturaH| na shRuNoti gatAsuM taM buddhimAn parivarjayet||20||

viparyayeNa yo vidyAdgandhAnAM sAdhvasAdhutAm| na vA tAn sarvasho vidyAttaM vidyAdvigatAyuSham||21||

Commentary: viparyayeNetyAdinA ghrANAriShTamucyate| na vA tAn sarvasho vidyAditi sarvathaiva gandhA~jchubhAnashubhAn vA na vetti||21||

yo rasAnna vijAnAti na vA jAnAti tattvataH| mukhapAkAdRute pakvaM tamAhuH kushalA naram||22||

Commentary: tattvata iti svakIyena rUpeNa| mukhapAkashabdo rasanAdoShopalakShaNaM; tena, pittaduShTarasanatvAdrasAnyathAtvagrAhakasya vyudAso~avarudhyate| pakvamiti sampUrNAyuHkAlam||22||

uShNA~jchItAn kharA~jchlakShNAnmRudUnapi ca dAruNAn| spRushyAn spRuShTvA tato~anyatvaM mumUrShusteShu manyate||23||

Commentary: tato~anyatvamiti uShNe shItatvaM, shlakShNe kharatvamityAdi manyate||23||
antareNa tapastIvraM yogaM vA vidhipUrvakam| indriyairadhikaM pashyan pa~jcatvamadhigacchati||24||
indriyANAmRute dRuShTerindriyArthAnadoShajAn| naraH pashyati yaH kashcidindriyairna sa jIvati||25||

svasthAH praj~jAviparyAsairindriyArtheShu vaikRutam| pashyanti ye~asadbahushasteShAM maraNamAdishet||26||

Commentary: svasthA iti avikRutendriyamanasaH| praj~jAviparyAsairiti sheShIbhUtAsuprabhAvakRutaH praj~jAviparyAsaH| asaditi ayathAbhUtam| bahusha ityanena sakRuddarshanasya nAriShTatvam||26||
uddeshakramAnurodhAdindriyagocarAriShTAbhidhAnArthamindriyAnIkamucyate| indriyANAmanIkaM samUhaH, tamadhikRutya kRutamindriyAnIkam||1-2||

darshanaM cakShuH; darshanAdIni cakShurAdIni pa~jcendriyANi| indriyANAM parIkShA na pratyakSheNetyAha- addhA hItyAdi| addheti avitatham| indriyANAmatIndriyatvAdanumAnenaiva parIkShaNamiti sheShaH ||3-4||

svasthebhya iti prakRutisthebhya indriyebhyaH; ‘utpannam’ iti sheShaH| indriyasaMshrayamiti bAhyendriyajanyam| animitteneti vikRutij~jAnajanakabAhyahetuvyatirekeNa; indriyagatikRutaj~jAnajanakadoShanirAsastu ‘svasthebhyaH’ iti visheShaNenaiva kRutaH| ashubhodayamiti maraNakAraNam| punaHshabdaH prakAshane, yathA- “doShAH punastrayaH” (vi.a.1) iti| bhUyaHshabdaH punaHpunararthe, kiMvA bhUyaHshabdo mahadarthaH; tena, punarbhUyaHshabdayorbhinnArthatvam||5-6||

shuddhamiti meghAnantaritam| rAtrAvityanena divA vahniniShprabhatvadarshanamariShTaM naiveti darshayati| vili~ggAniti vigatasahajali~ggAn| tena prabhAvyatiriktA~jjanAdi(?)li~ggaviparyaye riShTaM bhavati| bhAvAniti prANAn; kiMvA bhAvAniti pa~jcamahAbhUtAni sharIrarUpANi| vyAkRutInIti vividhAkRutIni| vivarNAnIti viruddhavarNAni| visa~gkhyopagatAnIti viparItasa~gkhyAyuktAni| vinimittAnIti vigatanimittAni| vyAkRutyAdikArakahetuvyatirekeNa vyAkRutyAdiyuktarUpadarshanamariShTamityarthaH| rUpANIti rUpavanti dravyANi||13-18||
ashabdasyetyAdinA shrotrAriShTamAha| jvAlAyAH shabda iva shabdo jvAlAshabdaH, tam||19-20||

samprati sarvendriyariShTaM sAmAnyena brUte- antareNetyAdi| antareNeti vinA| yogamityasya visheShaNaM- vidhipUrvakamiti; anena yathAvidhikRutasyaiva yogasyAtIndriyaj~jAne samarthatvamuktam| adhikamiti asmadAdIndriyAviShayam| pa~jcatvamiti maraNam| dRuShTiH upalabdhiH, tayA dRuShTyA dRuShTishaktirupacArAducyate; tena Rute dRuShTimiti upalabdhiM vinA; tatashcendriyANAmupalabdhishAktiM vinA ya indriyairupalabdhumashakyAn pashyedindriyaiH, na sa jIvati| adoShajAnityanena ca doShasvabhAvAdindriyAshakyArthagrahaNaM nirAkaroti| yathA- a~gguliyantritaM cakShurvAtaduShTyA~a~asannavastudvayamindriyAviShayaM pashyati, tathA pittaduShTarasanaM guDaM na madhuraM pratyetItyAdi bodhyam||24-25||
athAtaH pUrvarUpIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
dhyAnAyAsau tathodvegau mohashcAsthAnasambhavaH| aratirbalahAnishca mRutyurunmAdapUrvakaH||18||
AhAradveShiNaM pashyan luptacittamudarditam| vidyAddhIro mumUrShuM tamunmAdenAtipAtinA||19||
krodhanaM trAsabahulaM sakRutprahasitAnanam| mUrcchApipAsAbahulaM hantyunmAdaH sharIriNam||20||
nRutyan rakShogaNaiH sAkaM yaH svapne~ambhasi sIdati | sa prApya bhRushamunmAdaM yAti lokamataH param||21||
asattamaH pashyati yaH shRuNotyapyasataH svanAn| bahUn bahuvidhAn jAgrat so~apasmAreNa badhyate||22||
mattaM nRutyantamAvidhya preto harati yaM naram| svapne harati taM mRutyurapasmArapuraHsaraH||23||
stabhyete pratibuddhasya hanU manye tathA~akShiNI| yasya taM bahirAyAmo gRuhItvA hantyasaMshayam||24||
shaShkulIrvA~apyapUpAn vA svapne khAdati yo naraH| sa cettAdRuk chardayati pratibuddho na jIvati||25||

etAni pUrvarUpANi yaH samyagavabudhyate| sa eShAmanubandhaM ca phalaM ca j~jAtumarhati||26||

Commentary: eShAmanubandhamiti etatpUrvarUpottarakAlabhAvinaM vyAdhim| phalaM caiShAM mRutyurUpam||26||
imAMshcApyaparAn svapnAn dAruNAnupalakShayet| vyAdhitAnAM vinAshAya kleshAya mahate~api vA||27||
yasyottamA~gge jAyante vaMshagulmalatAdayaH| vayAMsi ca vilIyante svapne mauNDyamiyAcca yaH||28||
gRudhrolUkashvakAkAdyaiH svapne yaH parivAryate| rakShaHpretapishAcastrIcaNDAladraviDAndhrakaiH ||29||
vaMshavetralatApAshatRuNakaNTakasa~gkaTe| saMsajjati hi yaH svapne yo gacchan prapatatyapi||30||
bhUmau pAMshUpadhAnAyAM valmIke vA~atha bhasmani| shmashAnAyatane shvabhre svapne yaH prapatatyapi ||31||
kaluShe~ambhasi pa~gke vA kUpe vA tamasA~a~avRute| svapne majjati shIghreNa srotasA hriyate ca yaH||32||
snehapAnaM tathA~abhya~ggaH pracchardanavirecane| hiraNyalAbhaH kalahaH svapne bandhaparAjayau||33||
upAnadyuganAshashca prapAtaH pAdacarmaNoH| harShaH svapne prakupitaiH pitRubhishcAvabhartsanam||34||
dantacandrArkanakShatradevatAdIpacakShuShAm | patanaM vA vinAsho vA svapne bhedo nagasya vA||35||
raktapuShpaM vanaM bhUmiM pApakarmAlayaM citAm| guhAndhakArasambAdhaM svapne yaH pravishatyapi||36||
raktamAlI hasannuccairdigvAsA dakShiNAM disham| dAruNAmaTavIM svapne kapiyuktena yAti vA||37||
kAShAyiNAmasaumyAnAM nagnAnAM daNDadhAriNAm| kRuShNAnAM raktanetrANAM svapne necchanti darshanam||38||
kRuShNA pApA nirAcArA dIrghakeshanakhastanI| virAgamAlyavasanA svapne kAlanishA matA||39||
ityete dAruNAH svapnA rogI yairyAti pa~jcatAm| arogaH saMshayaM gatvA kashcideva pramucyate||40||
manovahAnAM pUrNatvAddoShairatibalaistribhiH| srotasAM dAruNAn svapnAn kAle pashyati dAruNe||41||
nAtiprasuptaH puruShaH saphalAnaphalAMstathA| indriyeshena manasA svapnAn pashyatyanekadhA||42||

dRuShTaM shrutAnubhUtaM ca prArthitaM kalpitaM tathA| bhAvikaM doShajaM caiva svapnaM saptavidhaM viduH||43||

Commentary: svapnAnAM phalavattvamaphalavattvaM coktaM, taddarshayituM svapnaprakArAnAha- dRuShTamityAdi| dRuShTamiti cakShuShA| anubhUtaM tu sheShendriyaj~jAtam| kalpitamiti manasA bhAvitam| prArthitaM yA~jcAviShayIkRutam| bhAvikamiti bhAvishubhAshubhaphalasUcakam| doShajamiti ulbaNavAtAdidoShajanyam||43||
tatra pa~jcavidhaM pUrvamaphalaM bhiShagAdishet| divAsvapnamatihrasvamatidIrghaM ca buddhimAn||44||
dRuShTaH prathamarAtre yaH svapnaH so~alpaphalo bhavet| na svapedyaM punardRuShTvA sa sadyaH syAnmahAphalaH||45||
akalyANamapi svapnaM dRuShTvA tatraiva yaH punaH| pashyet saumyaM shubhAkAraM tasya vidyAcchubhaM phalam||46||
tatra shlokaH- pUrvarUpANyatha svapnAn ya imAn vetti dAruNAn| na sa mohAdasAdhyeShu karmANyArabhate bhiShak||47||
pUrvarUpANyasAdhyAnAM vikArANAM pRuthak pRuthak| bhinnAbhinnAni vakShyAmo bhiShajAM j~jAnavRuddhaye||3||
pUrvarUpANi sarvANi jvaroktAnyatimAtrayA| yaM vishanti vishatyenaM mRutyurjvarapuraHsaraH||4||
anyasyApi ca rogasya pUrvarUpANi yaM naram| vishantyanena kalpena tasyApi maraNaM dhruvam||5||
pUrvarUpaikadeshAMstu vakShyAmo~anyAn sudAruNAn| ye rogAnanubadhnanti mRutyuryairanubadhyate ||6||
balaM ca hIyate yasya pratishyAyashca vardhate| tasya nArIprasaktasya shoSho~antAyopajAyate||7||
shvabhiruShTraiH kharairvA~api yAti yo dakShiNAM disham| svapne yakShmANamAsAdya jIvitaM sa vimu~jcati||8||
pretaiH saha pibenmadyaM svapne yaH kRuShyate shunA| sughoraM jvaramAsAdya jIvitaM sa vimu~jcati||9||
lAkShAraktAmbarAbhaM yaH pashyatyambaramantikAt| sa raktapittamAsAdya tenaivAntAya nIyate||10||
raktasragraktasarvA~ggo raktavAsA muhurhasan| yaH svapne hriyate nAryA sa raktaM prApya sIdati||11||
shUlATopAntrakUjAshca daurbalyaM cAtimAtrayA| nakhAdiShu ca vaivarNyaM gulmenAntakaro grahaH||12||
latA kaNTakinI yasya dAruNA hRudi jAyate| svapne gulmastamantAya krUro vishati mAnavam||13||
kAye~alpamapi saMspRuShTaM subhRushaM yasya dIryate| kShatAni ca na rohanti kuShThairmRutyurhinasti tam||14||
nagnasyAjyAvasiktasya juhvato~agnimanarciSham| padmAnyurasi jAyante svapne kuShThairmariShyataH||15||
snAtAnuliptagAtre~api yasmin gRudhnanti makShikAH| sa prameheNa saMsparshaM prApya tenaiva hanyate||16||
snehaM bahuvidhaM svapne caNDAlaiH saha yaH pibet| badhyate sa prameheNa spRushyate~antAya mAnavaH||17||

indriyagatariShTamabhidhAya sattvAdInAmagre sUcitAnAmariShTamagre vaktuM yujyate; tattvalpavaktavyatvAdulla~gghya bahuvaktavyaM pUrvarUpariShTamabhidhAtuM pUrvarUpIyo~abhidhIyate, prathamAdhyAye tu sattvAdInAmagre~abhidhAnamindriyaiH samaM buddhisAdhanatvAdiprasa~ggAgataM j~jeyam| vyAdhistu yadyapi bahuvaktavyaH katamAnisharIrIye~agre sUtritashca, tathA~api pUrvarUpapUrvakatvAd vyAdheH pUrvaM pUrvarUpanirUpaNamiha; sUtre tvagre vyAdhivacanena pUrvaM rUpAd vyAdheH pUrvarUpabodhyasya prAdhAnyaM darshayati||1-2||
udarditamiti udardayuktaM; yadvA, udarditam UrdhvavAtArditam| Avidhyeti adhaHshirasaM kRutvA||18-23||
tAdRugiti apUpashaShkulIrUpam||24-25||

kleshAya mahate~api vetyatrArogiNAM kleshAya mahata iti boddhavyaM, rogiNAM tu maraNAyaiva; yata uttaratropasaMhAre ‘ityete dAruNAH svapnAH’ ityAdau yathoktameva vibhAgaM kariShyati| vayAMsIti pakShiNaH| gRudhrAdikAkAntaiH parivAryata iti sambandhaH| saMsajjatIti saMyukto bhavati| kiMvA, ‘pramuhyati’ iti pAThaH; tatra pramuhyatIti vaMshAdisa~gkaTe lagnaH sanna nirgamamArgamAsAdayati| prapatatyapIti bhUmAvityAdinA yojyam| pAMshUpadhAnAyAmiti dhUlisaMyuktAyAm| kiMvA, bhUmAvityAdi prapatatItyanena yojyam| upAnat pAdatrANam| raktapuShpamiti vanavisheShaNam| guhAndhakArasambAdhamiti guhAndhakArarUpaM kaShTakArakam| digvAsA nagnaH san| kapiyuktena ‘yAnena’ iti sheShaH| kashcideva pramucyata iti arogAn prati naitat svapnAnAM riShTatvaM; tena, arogeShveteShAM maraNavyabhicAreNa naikAntatvena riShTatvamiti vadanti||27-40||

yathaitat svapnadarshanaM bhavati tadAha- manovahAnAmityAdi| manovahAni srotAMsi yadyapi pRutha~gnoktAni, tathA~api manasaH “kevalaM cetanAvaccharIramayanabhUtaM” (vi.a.5) ityabhidhAnAt sarvasharIrasrotAMsi gRuhyante, visheSheNa tu hRudayAshritatvAnmanasastadAshritA dasha dhamanyo manovahA abhidhIyante| tribhiriti tribhirapItyarthaH; tena, pRuthagapi doShaiH pUraNaM j~jeyam| nAtiprasupta iti nAtinidrAbhibhUta ityarthaH| indriyesheneti indriyaprerakeNa||41-42||

pUrvaM dRuShTAdikalpitAntaM pa~jcavidhasvapnamaphalam| aphalasvapnAntaramAha- divAsvapnamityAdi| divAdRuShTaM sarvaM svapnaM, tathA rAtridRuShTamapi atidIrghamatihrasvaM ca svapnamaphalaM vidyAt, phalashUnyatvAditi| pArisheShyAdbhAvikaM doShajanyaM ca saphalam| tatra bhAvikaM shubhAshubharUpatayA shubhAshubhaphalapradaM, yattu doShajanyaM taddoShaprakopajanyavyAdhirUpaphalasUcakatayA saphalam| atra cAdhyAye yeShAmeva svapnarUpavishiShTariShTasambhavasta evoktAH; tena grahaNyAdInAM kimiti svapnAriShTAni, noktAnIti na vAcyaM; tatra vishiShTariShTAsambhavAdevAnabhidhAnaM j~jeyam| ‘dRuShTaH prathamayAme yaH’ ityAdigranthaM kecidatra paThanti| sa vyaktArtha eva||44-47||

bhinnAbhinnAnIti sAdhAraNAsAdhAraNAni| tatra ‘pUrvarUpANi’ ityAdinA ‘tasyApi maraNaM dhruvam’ ityantena sarvavyAdhipUrvarUpariShTaM sAdhAraNamuktaM, ‘pUrvarUpaikadeshAMstu’ ityAdinA tu prativyAdhibhinnapUvarUpAriShTamucyate| anye tu bhinnAbhinnAnIti uktAnuktAnIti bruvate; tatra jvarAdipUrvarUpANyuktAni, ‘shvabhiruShTraiH kharaiH’ ityAdi tu pUrvarUpamanuktam| sarvANIti samastAni| atimAtrayeti atyulbaNatvena| jvarapuraHsara iti jvarAnantarabhAvI| anena kalpenetyanena sarvANi cAtimAtrayA ceti darshayati||3-5||

rogAnanubadhnantIti rogeNa pashcAdbhAvinA~avashyaM yujyante| mRutyuryairanubadhyate iti yai rogairmRutyuranubadhyate| etenaitat phalati- pUrvarUpANAM yairvyAdhibhirniyataH sambandhaste~avashyaM mArakA bhavantItyarthaH| “shvoShTravarAhakharairyAnaM” (ni.a.6) ityAdi shoShanidAne~apyuktaM, tena dakShiNadishAgamanavisheShitameva tadriShTam||6-9||
antikAditi samIpAt| raktaM prApyeti raktapittaM prApya| sIdati mriyate||10-11||
ATopaH kukShau shabdavadvAtabhramaNam| gRuhyate aneneti graho li~ggamityarthaH||12-13||
saMspRuShTamiti shastratRuNAdisaMspRuShTam||14-15||

yadyapi snAtAnuliptagAtre ityAdiriShTaM puShpitake “apisnAtAnuliptasya” (iM.a.2) ityAdinoktaM, tathA~apIha prameheNa maraNopadarshanArthaM punarucyate| tatra ca yadA pramehapUrvarUpAntarANi bhavanti, etacca lakShaNaM bhavati, tadA prameheNa mRutyuH; yadA tu pramehapUrvarUpANi na bhavanti, tadA yena kenApi vyAdhinA mRutyurj~jeyaH||16-17||
athAtaH katamAnisharIrIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
katamAni sharIrANi vyAdhimanti mahAmune!| yAni vaidyaH pariharedyeShu karma na siddhyati||3||
ityAtreyo~agniveshena prashnaM pRuShTaH sudurvacam| AcacakShe yathA tasmai bhagavAMstannibodhata||4||
yasya vai bhAShamANasya rujatyUrdhvamuro bhRusham| annaM ca cyavate bhuktaM sthitaM cApi na jIryati||5||
balaM ca hIyate shIghraM tRuShNA cAtipravardhate| jAyate hRudi shUlaM ca taM bhiShak parivarjayet||6||
hikkA gambhIrajA yasya shoNitaM cAtisAryate| na tasmai bheShajaM dadyAt smarannAtreyashAsanam||7||
AnAhashcAtisArashca yametau durbalaM naram| vyAdhitaM vishato rogau durlabhaM tasya jIvitam||8||
AnAhashcAtitRuShNA ca yametau durbalaM naram| vishato vijahatyenaM prANA nAticirAnnaram||9||
jvaraH paurvAhNiko yasya shuShkakAsashca dAruNaH| balamAMsavihInasya yathA pretastathaiva saH||10||
yasya mUtraM purIShaM ca grathitaM sampravartate| nirUShmaNo jaThariNaH shvasano na sa jIvati||11||
shvayathuryasya kukShistho hastapAdaM visarpati| j~jAtisa~gghaM sa sa~gkleshya tena rogeNa hanyate||12||
shvayathuryasya pAdasthastathA sraste ca piNDike| sIdatashcApyubhe ja~gghe taM bhiShak parivarjayet||13||
shUnahastaM shUnapAdaM shUnaguhyodaraM naram| hInavarNabalAhAramauShadhairnopapAdayet||14||
uroyukto bahushleShmA nIlaH pItaH salohitaH| satataM cyavate yasya dUrAttaM parivarjayet||15||
hRuShTaromA sAndramUtraH shUnaH kAsajvarArditaH | kShINamAMso naro dUrAdvarjyo vaidyena jAnatA||16||
trayaH prakupitA yasya doShAH kaShTAbhilakShitAH | kRushasya balahInasya nAsti tasya cikitsitam||17||
jvarAtisArau shophAnte shvayathurvA tayoH kShaye| durbalasya visheSheNa narasyAntAya jAyate||18||
pANDurashca kRusho~atyarthaM tRuShNayA~abhipariplutaH| DambarI kupitocchvAsaH pratyAkhyeyo vijAnatA||19||

hanumanyAgrahastRuShNA balahrAso~atimAtrayA| prANAshcorasi vartante yasya taM parivarjayet||20||

Commentary: prANAshcorasi vartanta iti vAyava urasi prakupitA vahanti ; yadi tu jIvitaM prANA ihocyante, tadA tasyorasi vartante, mRuta eva puruSho bhavati, tatashca tasmin kAle riShTenAsAdhyatAM j~jAtvA rogiparityAge vaidyasyAprasiddhirbhavatyeveti kRutvA prANA vAyava ihocyante iti bruvate; vayaM tu brUmaH- sadyomaraNIyAriShTavadetat pratyAsannamRutyugamakameva bhaviShyatIti||20||
tAmyatyAyacchate sharma na ki~jcidapi vindati| kShINamAMsabalAhAro mumUrShuracirAnnaraH||21||
viruddhayonayo yasya viruddhopakramA bhRusham| vardhante dAruNA rogAH shIghraM shIghraM sa hanyate||22||
balaM vij~jAnamArogyaM grahaNI mAMsashoNitam | etAni yasya kShIyante kShipraM kShipraM sa hanyate||23||
ArogyaM hIyate yasya prakRutiH parihIyate| sahasA sahasA tasya mRutyurharati jIvitam||24||
tatra shlokaH- ityetAni sharIrANi vyAdhimanti vivarjayet| na hyeShu dhIrAH pashyanti siddhiM kA~jcidupakramAt||25||
samprati pUrvarUpIyAnantaraM bhAvivyAdhyAshrayAriShTAbhidhAnArthaM katamAnisharIrIyamindriyamucyate| katamAni sharIrANyadhikRutya kRutaM katamAnisharIrIyam||1-2||

prashnamiti pRucchAviShayam| Urdhvamura iti uraUrdhvabhAga ityarthaH| etadadhyAyapratipAdyAnAM cAsAdhyavyAdhInAM maraNasUcakena riShTena samaM maraNasUcakatayA sAdharmyAdanariShTAnAmapi vyAdhInAmabhidhAnamiti bruvate| yadi eta evAsAdhyavyAdhayo maraNapUrvarUpatayA riShTarUpA eva bhavanti tathA~api na kAcit kShatiH| tenAriShTAdhikArAdariShTatvameva etadadhyAyavAcyAnAM vyAdhInAmicchAmaH||3-6||

gambhIrajA iti gambhIranAbhyAdideshajA, na tu gambhIrA; tasyAH svarUpata evAsAdhyatvenoktatvAt ‘shoNitaM cAtisAryate’ iti visheShaNamanarthakaM syAt| vyAdhitamityanena hi AnAhAtisArAtiriktavyAdhigRuhItamiti darshayati| AnAhAtisArayo rogatve siddhe~api ‘rogau’ iti visheSheNa rujAkartRutvopadarshanArtham| ihAlabhya eva jIvite ‘durlabham’ ityuktaM; yathA- sarvathA~alabhye durlabhamiti| anye tu durlabhabhAShayA aniyataM maraNe riShTamiti bruvate, evam “saMshayaprAptamAtreyo jIvitaM tasya manyate” (iM.a.9) ityAdAvapi vyAkhyAnayanti| aniyatariShTatA~asvArasyaM tvasmAbhiH puShpitaka evoktam| “saMshayaprAptamAtreyo jIvitaM tasya manyate” ityasya cArthaM yasyashyAvanimittIye vakShyAmaH||7-10||

mUtraM grathitamiti ghanIbhUtaM j~jeyam| j~jAtisa~gghaM sa sa~gkleshyetivacanena ciramasya rogo~anuvartate, tataH pratyAshayA j~jAtayastatpratIkArArthaM klishyanti, tatastu mriyata eva na pratikartuM pAryate| piNDike iti ja~gghAmAMsapiNDike||11-14||

uroyu(mu)kta iti uraHprabhavatvenAnumIyamAnaH| kaShTAbhilakShitA iti durupakramatvena j~jAtAH| kiMvA ‘koShThA(ShThe~a)bhilakShitA’ iti pAThaH, sa vyakta eva| DambarI stabdhAkShAvalokI; kiMvA DambarI saMrambhavAn| kupita ucchvAso yasya sa kupitocchvAsaH||15-19||

Ayacchate a~ggAni kShipati| viruddhayonaya iti parasparaviruddhadharmANaH | viruddhayonayo~api svalpatayaikadUShyatayA vA aviruddhopakramA api bhavantItyata uktaM- viruddhopakramA iti| ArogyaM hIyata iti atroktarogavyatiriktarogavRuddhyA ArogyahAnirbodhyA| prakRutiH parihIyata iti svabhAvaH sushIlatvAdirUpaH kShIyate; kiMvA, prakRutirjanmapratibaddhA shleShmaprakRutyAdirUpA hIyate||21-25||
athAtaH pannarUpIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

dRuShTyAM yasya vijAnIyAt pannarUpAM kumArikAm| praticchAyAmayImakShNornainamiccheccikitsitum||3||

Commentary: pannarUpAmiti naShTarUpAm| kumArikAmiti puruShAntaranayanagatAM kumArikAM; kiMvA, AturanayanagatAmeva| yaduktaM hArIte- “adarshanamasa~gghAte netre naShTakumArike” iti| praticchAyAmayImiti praticchAyArUpAm||3||

jyotsnAyAmAtape dIpe salilAdarshayorapi| a~ggeShu vikRutA yasya cchAyA pretastathaiva saH||4||

Commentary: anyatrApi chAyAvikRutimAha- jyotsnetyAdi| a~ggeShu vikRuteti shirobAhuja~gghAdiShu chAyAdhikaraNabhUteShu bhavantI praticchAyA yasya vikRutA bhavatItyarthaH| tena vyastasamastA~ggavikRutA~api chAyA gRuhyate| anye tu- vibhaktivipariNAmAda~ggAnAmiti vyAkhyAnayanti; tathA ca sugama evArthaH||4||
chinnA bhinnA~a~akulA cchAyA hInA vA~apyadhikA~api vA| naShTA tanvI dvidhA cchinnA vikRutA vishirA ca yA||5||
etAshcAnyAshca yAH kAshcit praticchAyA vigarhitAH| sarvA mumUrShatAM j~jeyA na cellakShyanimittajAH||6||

saMsthAnena pramANena varNena prabhayA tathA| chAyA vivartate yasya svastho~api preta eva saH||7||

Commentary: samprati chAyArUpaM sAmAnyena darshaya~jchAyAshrayAriShTamAha- saMsthAnenetyAdi| etacca chAyApraticchAyayoH samAnaM sUtram| tatra saMsthAnena pramANena ca praticchAyAH svarUpakathanaM, tathA varNena prabhayA ca chAyAyAH svarUpakathanam| tatra saMsthAnena pramANena ca sadRushI chAyA praticchAyA j~jeyA; varNena prabhayA ca lakShitA varNaprabhAshrayA~agre vakShyamANA pa~jcavidhA cchAyA j~jeyA| atra yattadornityAbhisambandhAt ‘sA’ ityadhyAhAryate| tena saMsthAnAdibhiryA chAyA praticchAyArUpA, sA yasya vivartate anyathA bhavati, sa preta eveti yojanA||7||
saMsthAnamAkRutirj~jeyA suShamA viShamA ca sA| madhyamalpaM mahaccoktaM pramANaM trividhaM nRuNAm||8||
pratipramANasaMsthAnA jalAdarshAtapAdiShu| chAyA yA sA praticchAyA cchAyA varNaprabhAshrayA||9||
khAdInAM pa~jca pa~jcAnAM chAyA vividhalakShaNAH| nAbhasI nirmalA nIlA sasnehA saprabheva ca||10||
rUkShA shyAvAruNA yA tu vAyavI sA hataprabhA| vishuddharaktA tvAgneyI dIptAbhA darshanapriyA||11||
shuddhavaidUryavimalA susnigdhA cAmbhasI matA| sthirA snigdhA ghanA shlakShNA shyAmA shvetA ca pArthivI||12||
vAyavI garhitA tvAsAM catasraH syuH sukhodayAH | vAyavI tu vinAshAya kleshAya mahate~api vA||13||
syAttaijasI prabhA sarvA sA tu saptavidhA smRutA| raktA pItA sitA shyAvA haritA pANDurA~asitA||14||
tAsAM yAH syurvikAsinyaH snigdhAshca vipulAshca yAH| tAH shubhA rUkShamalinAH sa~gkShiptAshcAshubhodayAH ||15||
varNamAkrAmati cchAyA bhAstu varNaprakAshinI| AsannA lakShyate cchAyA bhAH prakRuShTA prakAshate||16||
nAcchAyo nAprabhaH kashcidvisheShAshcihnayanti tu| nRuNAM shubhAshubhotpattiM kAle chAyAprabhAshrayAH||17||
kAmalA~akShNormukhaM pUrNaM sha~gkhayormuktamAMsatA| santrAsashcoShNagAtratvaM yasya taM parivarjayet||18||
utthApyamAnaH shayanAt pramohaM yAti yo naraH| muhurmuhurna saptAhaM sa jIvati vikatthanaH ||19||
saMsRuShTA vyAdhayo yasya pratilomAnulomagAH| vyApannA grahaNI prAyaH so~ardhamAsaM na jIvati||20||
uparuddhasya rogeNa karshitasyAlpamashnataH| bahu mUtrapurIShaM syAdyasya taM parivarjayet||21||
durbalo bahu bhu~gkte yaH prAgbhuktAdannamAturaH | alpamUtrapurIShashca yathA pretastathaiva saH||22||
iShTaM ca guNasampannamannamashnAti yo naraH| shashvacca balavarNAbhyAM hIyate na sa jIvati||23||
prakUjati prashvasiti shithilaM cAtisAryate| balahInaH pipAsArtaH shuShkAsyo na sa jIvati||24||
hrasvaM ca yaH prashvasiti vyAviddhaM spandate ca yaH| mRutameva tamAtreyo vyAcacakShe punarvasuH||25||
UrdhvaM ca yaH prashvasiti shleShmaNA cAbhibhUyate| hInavarNabalAhAro yo naro na sa jIvati||26||
UrdhvAgre nayane yasya manye cAratakampane| balahInaH pipAsArtaH shuShkAsyo na sa jIvati||27||
yasya gaNDAvupacitau jvarakAsau ca dAruNau| shUlI pradveShTi cApyannaM tasmin karma na sidhyati||28||
vyAvRuttamUrdhajihvAsyo bhruvau yasya ca vicyute| kaNTakaishcAcitA jihvA yathA pretastathaiva saH||29||
shephashcAtyarthamutsiktaM niHsRutau vRuShaNau bhRusham| atashcaiva viparyAso vikRutyA pretalakShaNam||30||
nicitaM yasya mAMsaM syAttvagasthiShveva dRushyate| kShINasyAnashnatastasya mAsamAyuH paraM bhavet||31||
tatra shlokaH- idaM li~ggamariShTAkhyamanekamabhijaj~jivAn| AyurvedavidityAkhyAM labhate kushalo janaH||32||

vyAdhirUpAnantaraM vedanopadravau uddiShTau, tau ca pUrvAdhyAya eva “shUlATopAntrakUjAshca” (iM.a.5) ityAdinA tathA anyatra “AnAhashcAtisArashca” (iM.a.6) ityAdinA riShTarUpatayA uktAveveti kRutvA chAyApraticchAyArUpAriShTasya kramaprAptasyAbhidhAyakaM pannarUpIyamucyate| pannarUpAmadhikRutya kRutaM pannarUpIyam||1-2||

etAneva chAyAvikRutibhedAnAha- chinnetyAdi| Akuleti anishcitapratibimbA| vikRutA vikRutAnukAriNI | yadyapyariShTAdhikAre~animittameva yadbhavati tadariShTamuktaM, tathA~api punaH spaShTArthaM ‘na cellakShyanimittajAH’ ityuktam||5-6||

praticchAyAkAraNabhUte saMsthAnapramANe eva vivRuNoti- saMsthAnamityAdi| AkRutiH AkAraH| pratItyAdi praticchAyAvivaraNaM, ‘chAyA varNaprabhAshrayA’ ityAdi tu chAyAvivaraNaM bhaviShyati| pratipramANasaMsthAnetyatra prati sAdRushye; tena pramANasadRushI, saMsthAnasadRushI ca| pramANasaMsthAnasadRushatayA jalAdiShu yA chAyA, sA praticchAyA| chAyA tu yA pa~jcavidhA sA varNaprabhAshrayA varNaprabhAsahacaritopalabhyata ityarthaH||8-9||

khAdInAmityAdinA chAyAM vibhajate| saprabheti dIptAbhA| vAyavI garhiteti vAyavI riShTAya prAyo bhavati| yasya janmaprabhRuti vAyavI, sa cApi prabhUtakleshabhAgbhavatItyAha- vAyavItyAdi| vinAshAyeti akasmAdutpannA vinAshAya, sahajA tu vAyavI kleshAyeti j~jeyam||10-13||

samprati chAyAshrayatvena varNabheda uktaH, tatra varNabhedAstadariShTaM ca prathamAdhyAya evoktaM; prabhAyAstu bhedaM riShTaM cAha- syAttaijasItyAdi| prabhA ca yadyapi prathamAdhyAye sa~ggrahe noktA; tathA~api tatra cchAyAshrayatvena varNabhedA uktAH, tatra varNabhedAstadariShTaM ca prathamAdhyAye sa~ggraheNoktaM, chAyAshrayatvena tatra prabhA~api sUciteti j~jeyam| ashubhodayA iti akasmAdutpAde maraNodayAH, sahajotpAde tu bahuduHkharUpA ashubhodayA iti j~jeyam||14-15||

prabhAcchAyayordurlakShyatvena bhedakaM lakShaNamAha- varNamityAdi| varNamAkrAmatIti chAyAkrAnto varNo nopalabhyate samyak| AsannA lakShyate cchAyA, yathA- citragatA chAyA pratyAsannaiva lakShyate| bhAH prakRuShTA prakAshate; yathA- maNimauktikAdInAM prabhA dUrAdupalabhyata ityarthaH| visheShA iti chAyAprabhayoH shubhAshubharUpavisheShAH| cihnayantIti gamayanti| kAle iti paripAkakAle||16-17||

kAmalA~akShNoriti kAmalina iva pItAkShatvam| vikatthana iti nindAparaH| saMsRuShTA iti parasparasambaddhAH, kiMvA saMsRuShTadoShajanyAH| pratilomAnulomagA iti adhomArgordhvamArgagatAH| vyApannA grahaNIti cchedaH; kiMvA, vyApannA grahaNI yasya sa ‘vyApannagrahaNI’ iti pAThaH| prAyaH so~ardhamAsaM na jIvatIti anenArdhamAsamatikramyApi maraNaM bhavati, na tu maraNavyabhicAraH||18-20||

prAgbhuktAditi yAvadannaM bhu~gkte sma pUrvadineShu tato bahu bhu~gkte ityarthaH| iShTamiti iShTarasam| guNasampannamiti pathyam| shithilamiti pUrveNa sambadhyate, tena shlatha iva prakUjati| prashvasitIti antaH shvAsaM nayati| vyAviddhamiti kuTilam||21-26||

UrdhvAgre iti Urdhvamukhe| Aratakampane avishrAntakampane| utsiktamiti antaHpraviShTam| atashcaiva viparyAsa iti shepho~atiniHsRutaM, vRuShaNau cAtipraviShTau| vikRutyeti svabhAvaM vinA; tena svabhAvotsiktashephAdi na riShTaM, kintvanimittaM kAdAcitkaM sadeva riShTam| nicitamiti kShINaM, nishabdasya pratiShedhArthatvAt| evaM ca tathA mAMsaM kShINaM bhavati, yathA tvagasthiShveva lagnA dRushyate; kiMvA nicitamupacitaM mAMsaM syAt, tvagasthiShveva dRushyate tvagasthimAtrAvasheSho vA bhavatIti yAvat||27-32||
athAto~avAkshirasIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
asthishvetA dvijA yasya puShpitAH pa~gkasaMvRutAH| vikRutyA na sa rogaM taM vihAyArogyamashnute||13||
stabdhA nishcetanA gurvI kaNTakopacitA bhRusham| shyAvA shuShkA~athavA shUnA pretajihvA visarpiNI||14||
dIrghamucchvasya yo hrasvaM naro niHshvasya tAmyati| uparuddhAyuShaM j~jAtvA taM dhIraH parivarjayet||15||
hastau pAdau ca manye ca tAlu caivAtishItalam| bhavatyAyuHkShaye krUramathavA~api bhavenmRudu||16||
ghaTTaya~jjAnunA jAnu pAdAvudyamya pAtayan| yo~apAsyati muhurvakramAturo na sa jIvati||17||
dantaishchindannakhAgrANi nakhaicchinda~jchiroruhAn| kAShThena bhUmiM vilikhanna rogAt parimucyate||18||
dantAn khAdati yo jAgradasAmnA virudan hasan| vijAnAti na cedduHkhaM na sa rogAdvimucyate||19||
muhurhasan muhuH kShveDan shayyAM pAdena hanti yaH| uccaishchidrANi vimRushannAturo na sa jIvati||20||
yairvindati purA bhAvaiH sametaiH paramAM ratim| tairevAramamANasya glAsnormaraNamAdishet||21||
na bibharti shiro grIvA na pRuShThaM bhAramAtmanaH| na hanU piNDamAsyasthamAturasya mumUrShataH||22||
sahasA jvarasantApastRuShNA mUrcchA balakShayaH| vishleShaNaM ca sandhInAM mumUrShorupajAyate||23||
gosarge vadanAdyasya svedaH pracyavate bhRusham| lepajvaropataptasya durlabhaM tasya jIvitam||24||
nopaiti kaNThamAhAro jihvA kaNThamupaiti ca| AyuShyantaM gate jantorbalaM ca parihIyate||25||
shiro vikShipate kRucchrAnmu~jcayitvA prapANikau| lalATasrupratasvedo mumUrShushcyutabandhanaH ||26||
tatra shlokaH- imAni li~ggAni nareShu buddhimAn vibhAvayetAvahito mumUrShuShu| kShaNena bhUtvA hyupayAnti kAnicinnacAphalaM li~ggamihAsti ki~jcana||27||
avAkshirA vA jihmA vA yasya vA vishirA bhavet| janto rUpapraticchAyA nainamiccheccikitsitum||3||
jaTIbhUtAni pakShmANi dRuShTishcApi nigRuhyate | yasya jantorna taM dhIro bheShajenopapAdayet||4||
yasya shUnAni vartmAni na samAyAnti shuShyataH| cakShuShI copadihyete yathA pretastathaiva saH||5||
bhruvorvA yadi vA mUrdhni sImantAvartakAn bahUn| apUrvAnakRutAn vyaktAn dRuShTvA maraNamAdishet||6||
tryahametena jIvanti lakShaNenAturA narAH| arogANAM punastvetat ShaDrAtraM paramucyate ||7||
AyamyotpATitAn keshAn yo naro nAvabudhyate| anAturo vA rogI vA ShaDrAtraM nAtivartate||8||
yasya keshA nirabhya~ggA dRushyante~abhyaktasannibhAH| uparuddhAyuShaM j~jAtvA taM dhIraH parivarjayet||9||
glAyate nAsikAvaMshaH pRuthutvaM yasya gacchati| ashUnaH shUnasa~gkAshaH pratyAkhyeyaH sa jAnatA||10||
atyarthavivRutA yasya yasya cAtyarthasaMvRutA| jihmA vA parishuShkA vA nAsikA na sa jIvati||11||
mukhaM shabdashravAvoShThau shuklashyAvAtilohitau| vikRutyA yasya vA nIlau na sa rogAdvimucyate||12||
uktAnuktariShTaparigrAhake~adhyAyadvaye vaktavye chAyariShTAbhidhAyakatvasAdharmyAdavAkshirasIyo~abhidhIyate||1-2||
asthivacchvetA asthishvetAH| visarpiNI bahirnirgatA| niHshvasyeti antarocchvAsaM nItvA| apAsyati muhuriti mukhamAkShipati| asAmnA iti uccaiH| uccaishchidrANIti nAsAkarNAkShisrotAMsi||13-20||

glAsnoriti kShIyamANasya| bhAramAtmana iti UrdhvasharIram| pRuShThamiti sharIrAdhobhAgaH| gosarge iti pratyUShe| lepajvaraH svalpashItayuktaH kaphajvaraH| kRucchrAditi ashIghraM mu~jcayitvA, prapANikau maNibandhAdUrdhvaM kUrparaparyantaM (shiro vikShipati)||21-27||

avAkshirA iti UrdhvapAdaH| etacchAyAprakaraNavaktavyamapi shIghramArakatvakhyApanArthamiha shIghramArakariShTeShu paThitam| atra hyariShTAni tryahAdimArakANi vaktavyAni| na samAyAntIti na parasparaM milanti| apUrvAniti asahajAn| akRutAniti prayatnenAkRutAn||3-7||

Ayamyeti balAdAkRuShya| yadyapi “tasya keshalomAni” (iM.a.3) ityAdinaiva etadariShTamityuktaM, tathA~apIhAturasvasthaviShayapratipAdanArthaM punarabhidhAnam| ki~jca, tatra ‘pralucyeran’ iti padena keshAnAmanutpATanamuktaM, neha tatheti visheShaH||8-9||
glAyata iti daurbalyaM bhajate| ashUna iti paramArthato~ashUnaH| vivRuteti nirgatA| saMvRuteti praviShTA| shabdashravau karNau| vikRutyeti sahajaM vinA, tathA hetuM vinetyarthaH||10-12||
athAto yasyashyAvanimittIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca retashcAmbhasi majjati| yasya tasyAyuShaH prAptamantamAhurmanIShiNaH||18||
niShThyUte yasya dRushyante varNA bahuvidhAH pRuthak| tacca sIdatyapaH prApya na sa jIvitumarhati ||19||
pittamUShmAnugaM yasya sha~gkhau prApya vimUrcchati | sa rogaH sha~gkhako nAmnA trirAtrAddhanti jIvitam||20||
saphenaM rudhiraM yasya muhurAsyAt prasicyate| shUlaishca tudyate kukShiH pratyAkhyeyastathAvidhaH||21||
balamAMsakShayastIvro rogavRuddhirarocakaH| yasyAturasya lakShyante trIn pakShAnna sa jIvati||22||
tatra shlokau- vij~jAnAni manuShyANAM maraNe pratyupasthite| bhavantyetAni sampashyedanyAnyevaMvidhAni ca||23||
tAni sarvANi lakShyante na tu sarvANi mAnavam| vishanti vinashiShyantaM tasmAdbodhyAni sarvataH||24||
yasya shyAve paridhvaste harite cApi darshane| Apanno vyAdhirantAya j~jeyastasya vijAnatA||3||
niHsa~jj~jaH parishuShkAsyaH samRuddho vyAdhibhishca yaH| uparuddhAyuShaM j~jAtvA taM dhIraH parivarjayet||4||
haritAshca sirA yasya lomakUpAshca saMvRutAH| so~amlAbhilAShI puruShaH pittAnmaraNamashnute||5||
sharIrAntAshca shobhante sharIraM copashuShyati| balaM ca hIyate yasya rAjayakShmA hinasti tam||6||
aMsAbhitApo hikkA ca chardanaM shoNitasya ca| AnAhaH pArshvashUlaM ca bhavatyantAya shoShiNaH||7||
vAtavyAdhirapasmArI kuShThI shophI tathodarI| gulmI ca madhumehI ca rAjayakShmI ca yo naraH||8||
acikitsyA bhavantyete balamAMsakShaye sati| anyeShvapi vikAreShu tAn bhiShak parivarjayet||9||
virecanahRutAnAho yastRuShNAnugato naraH| viriktaH punarAdhmAti yathA pretastathaiva saH||10||
peyaM pAtuM na shaknoti kaNThasya ca mukhasya ca| urasashca vishuShkatvAdyo naro na sa jIvati ||11||
svarasya durbalIbhAvaM hAniM ca balavarNayoH| rogavRuddhimayuktyA ca dRuShTvA maraNamAdishet||12||
UrdhvashvAsaM gatoShmANaM shUlopahatava~gkShaNam| sharma cAnadhigacchantaM buddhimAn parivarjayet||13||
apasvaraM bhAShamANaM prAptaM maraNamAtmanaH| shrotAraM cApyashabdasya dUrataH parivarjayet||14||
yaM naraM sahasA rogo durbalaM parimu~jcati| saMshayaprAptamAtreyo jIvitaM tasya manyate||15||
atha cejj~jAtayastasya yAceran praNipAtataH| rasenAdyAditi brUyAnnAsmai dadyAdvishodhanam||16||
mAsena cenna dRushyeta visheShastasya shobhanaH| rasaishcAnyairbahuvidhairdurlabhaM tasya jIvitam||17||

yasya shyAvanimittIyo~api uktAnuktariShTAbhidhAyakatayA ucyate| yasya shyAvashabdena lakShaNayA ‘yasya shyAve’ ityAdigranthoktaM riShTaM grAhyam| tena, yasyashyAvarUpanimittaM riShTamadhikRutya kRuto~adhyAyo yasyashyAvanimittIyaH||1-2||
niShThyUta ityAdau bahuvidhavarNayogaH pUrvAriShTAdvisheShaH| sIdatIti majjati| “yasya pittaM” (sU.a.18) ityAdinA sUtrasthAnokto~api sha~gkhaka iha maraNasUcakatayA riShTatvenocyate||18-22||
vij~jAnAnIti lakShaNAni nayanAdivaikRutAni j~jeyAni| sarvANi lakShyanta iti nAnApuruSheShu lakShyante| na tu sarvANi mAnavaM vishantIti ekapuruShaM na sarvANi vishantIti||23-24||

samRuddha upacitaH| sharIrAntA hastapAdAdayaH| shobhanta iti rAjante, kiMvA shobhAyuktA bhavanti| vAta eva vyAdhiryasya rogiNaH sa vAtavyAdhiH| tAniti balamAMsakShayayuktAn| virecanena hRuta AnAho yasya sa tathA| ayuktyeti anucitarUpeNa||3-13||

apasvaramiti vikRutasvaraM yathA bhavati tathA bhAShamANam| kiM bhAShamANamityAha- maraNamAtmana iti; mariShyAmi mariShyAmIti bhAShamANamityarthaH| shrotAraM cetyAdi riShTAnantaraM ‘saMshayaprAptamAtreyaH’ ityAdau aniyatAriShTatayA AtreyasyAtra maraNaM prati sandeha iti brUte| tacca na, riShTasya maraNAvyabhicAritvamAcAryeNa prayatnenoktaM, vyutpAditaM cAsmAbhiH; ki~jca na ca vItasaMshayasyAtreyasya saMshayo~asti; tena shiShyavyutpattyarthamayamAcAryaH saMshayaM darshayati, tathA nirNayaM karoti; yathA- “dRuShTvA pramehaM madhuraM sapicchaM madhUpamaM syAdvividho vicAraH” (ci.a.6) ityAdau saMshayaM darshayitvA nirNayaM darshitavAn; tathehApi durbalasya sahasA rogamuktau riShTaM vA syAt, sarvathA santarpaNAdvyAdhikShayo vA syAditi sandehaH; riShTapakShe tu maraNaM, tatra ‘atha cet’ ityAdinA parIkShAmArabhate; parIkShAyAM ca mAMsarasena visheShAlAbhe riShTatvAvadhAraNaM bhavatIti suvyavastho~ayaM granthaH| durlabhamiti aprApyam||14-17||
athAtaH sadyomaraNIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
sadyastitikShataH prANA@mllakShaNAni pRuthak pRuthak| agnivesha! pravakShyAmi saMspRuShTo yairna jIvati||3||
vAtAShThIlA susaMvRuddhA tiShThantI dAruNA hRudi| tRuShNayA~abhiparItasya sadyo muShNAti jIvitam||4||
piNDike shithilIkRutya jihmIkRutya ca nAsikAm| vAyuH sharIre vicaran sadyo muShNAti jIvitam||5||
bhruvau yasya cyute sthAnAdantardAhashca dAruNaH| tasya hikkAkaro rogaH sadyo muShNAti jIvitam||6||
kShINashoNitamAMsasya vAyurUrdhvagatishcaran| ubhe manye same yasya sadyo muShNAti jIvitam||7||
antareNa gudaM gacchan nAbhiM ca sahasA~anilaH| kRushasya va~gkShaNau gRuhNan sadyo muShNAti jIvitam||8||
vitatya parshukAgrANi gRuhItvorashca mArutaH| stimitasyAyatAkShasya sadyo muShNAti jIvitam||9||
hRudayaM ca gudaM cobhe gRuhItvA mAruto balI| durbalasya visheSheNa sadyo muShNAti jIvitam||10||
va~gkShaNaM ca gudaM cobhe gRuhItvA mAruto balI| shvAsaM sa~jjanaya~jjantoH sadyo muShNAti jIvitam||11||
nAbhiM mUtraM bastishIrShaM purIShaM cApi mArutaH| pracchinnaM janaya~jchUlaM sadyo muShNAti jIvitam||12||
bhidyete va~gkShaNau yasya vAtashUlaiH samantataH| bhinnaM purIShaM tRuShNA ca sadyaH prANA~jjahAti saH||13||
AplutaM mAruteneha sharIraM yasya kevalam| bhinnaM purIShaM tRuShNA ca sadyo jahyAt sa jIvitam||14||
sharIraM shophitaM yasya vAtAshophena dehinaH| bhinnaM purIShaM tRuShNA ca sadyo jahyAt sa jIvitam||15||
AmAshayasamutthAnA yasya syAt parikartikA| bhinnaM purIShaM tRuShNA ca sadyaH prANA~jjahAti saH||16||
pakvAshayasamutthAnA yasya syAt parikartikA| tRuShNA gudagrahashcograH sadyo jahyAt sa jIvitam||17||
pakvAshayamadhiShThAya hatvA sa~jj~jAM ca mArutaH| kaNThe ghurghurakaM kRutvA sadyo harati jIvitam||18||
dantAH kardamadigdhAbhA mukhaM cUrNakasannibham| siprAyante ca gAtrANi li~ggaM sadyo mariShyataH||19||
tRuShNAshvAsashirorogamohadaurbalyakUjanaiH| spRuShTaH prANA~jjahAtyAshu shakRudbhedena cAturaH||20||

tatra shlokaH- etAni khalu li~ggAni yaH samyagavabudhyate| sa jIvitaM ca martyAnAM maraNaM cAvabudhyate||21||

Commentary: sa jIvitaM cAvabudhyata iti yathoktariShTAbhAvena jIvitaM budhyate, riShTasadbhAve ca maraNaM budhyata iti||21||
vyavahitamaraNapratipAdakamariShTamabhidhAya pratyAsannamaraNapratipAdakaM riShTaM vaktuM sadyomaraNIyo~abhidhIyate| sadyaHshabdeneha kecit saptarAtramicchanti, apare trirAtram||1-2||

titikShata iti titikShata eva; prANAnAM priyatvena svayaM hananAyogyatvAt| piNDike iti ja~gghApiNDike| antareNa gudaM nAbhiM ceti gudanAbhimadhye| hRudayaM gRuhItveti hRudayaM svavikAreNa prApya | bastishIrShamiti bastyUrdhvabhAgam| pracchinnamiti pracchinnamiva pracchinnaM, chedanAkAravedanAyuktatvAt| Aplutamiti vyAptam| shothitamiti shophayuktam| parikartikA parikartanAkArA vedanA| ghurghurakamiti ghurghurakamityAkAraM shabdaM, sa kaphAvaruddhena shvAsena bhavati| mukhaM cUrNakasannibhaM shvaityAt| siprAyanta iti siprA nadI, tadvat svedAtiprAdurbhAvAdAcarantIti siprAyante; kiMvA siprAyanta iti shithilIbhavanti, anekArthatvAddhAtUnAm||3-20||
athAto~aNujyotIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

aNujyotiranekAgro dushchAyo durmanAH sadA| ratiM na labhate yAti paralokaM samAntaram||3||

Commentary: jyotiH sakalasharIrAntargataM tejaH, aNujyotirmandAgniH| anekAgraH vyAkulacittaH, durmanA ityanena tu manodaurbalyamucyate; tena na paunaruktyam| samAntaramiti samAmadhye||3||
baliM balibhRuto yasya praNItaM nopabhu~jjate| lokAntaragataH piNDaM bhu~gkte saMvatsareNa saH||4||
saptarShINAM samIpasthAM yo na pashyatyarundhatIm| saMvatsarAnte jantuH sa sampashyati mahattamaH||5||
vikRutyA vinimittaM yaH shobhAmupacayaM dhanam| prApnotyato vA vibhraMshaM samAntaM tasya jIvitam||6||

bhaktiH shIlaM smRutistyAgo buddhirbalamahetukam| ShaDetAni nivartante ShaDbhirmAsairmariShyataH||7||

Commentary: bhaktiH icchA| ahetukamiti kriyAvisheShaNam| sa~gkhyeyanirdeshAdeva ShaTtve labdhe punaH ShaDiti padaM ShaNNAM samuditAnAmeva nivRuttirariShTamiti darshayitum||7||
dhamanInAmapUrvANAM jAlamatyarthashobhanam| lalATe dRushyate yasya ShaNmAsAnna sa jIvati||8||
lekhAbhishcandravakrAbhirlalATamupacIyate| yasya tasyAyuShaH ShaDbhirmAsairantaM samAdishet||9||
sharIrakampaH sammoho gatirvacanameva ca| mattasyevopalabhyante yasya mAsaM na jIvati||10||
retomUtrapurIShANi yasya majjanti cAmbhasi| sa mAsAt svajanadveShTA mRutyuvAriNi majjati||11||
hastapAdaM mukhaM cobhe visheShAdyasya shuShyataH| shUyete vA vinA dehAt sa ca mAsaM na jIvati||12||
lalATe mUrdhni bastau vA nIlA yasya prakAshate| rAjI bAlendukuTilA na sa jIvitumarhati||13||
pravAlaguTikAbhAsA yasya gAtre masUrikAH| utpadyAshu vinashyanti na cirAt sa vinashyati||14||
grIvAvamardo balavA~jjihvAshvayathureva ca| bradhnAsyagalapAkashca yasya pakvaM tamAdishet||15||
sambhramo~atipralApo~atibhedo~asthnAmatidAruNaH | kAlapAshaparItasya trayametat pravartate||16||
pramuhya lu~jcayet keshAn parigRuhNAtyatIva ca| naraH svasthavadAhAramabalaH kAlacoditaH||17||
samIpe cakShuShoH kRutvA mRugayetA~ggulIkaram| smayate~api ca kAlAndha UrdhvagAnimiShekShaNaH ||18||
shayanAdAsanAda~ggAt kAShThAt kuDyAdathApi vA| asanmRugayate ki~jcit sa muhyan kAlacoditaH||19||
ahAsyahAsI sammuhyan praleDhi dashanacchadau| shItapAdakarocchvAso yo naro na sa jIvati||20||
AhvayaMstaM samIpasthaM svajanaM janameva vA| mahAmohAvRutamanAH pashyannapi na pashyati||21||

ayogamatiyogaM vA sharIre matimAn bhiShak| khAdInAM yugapaddRuShTvA bheShajaM nAvacArayet||22||

Commentary: khAdInAmiti khAdikAryANAM dhAtUnAM, kiMvA khAdikAryANAM shrotrAdInAm| yogyaviShayAgrahaNamayogaH| avidyamAnaviShayagrahaNamatiyogaH||22||
atipravRuddhyA rogANAM manasashca balakShayAt| vAsamutsRujati kShipraM sharIrI dehasa~jj~jakam||23||
varNasvarAvagnibalaM vAgindriyamanobalam| hIyate~asukShaye nidrA nityA bhavati vA na vA||24||
bhiShagbheShajapAnAnnagurumitradviShashca ye| vashagAH sarva evaite boddhavyAH samavartinaH||25||
eteShu rogaH kramate bheShajaM pratihanyate| naiShAmannAni bhu~jjIta na codakamapi spRushet||26||

pAdAH sametAshcatvAraH sampannAH sAdhakairguNaiH| vyarthA gatAyuSho dravyaM vinA nAsti guNodayaH||27||

Commentary: pAdA bhiShagAdayaH| sAdhakairguNairiti “shrute paryavadAtatvaM” (sU.a.9) ityAdibhiH ShoDashaguNaiH sampannAH| kasmAdvaidyAdayo gatAyuSho rogAnna sAdhayantItyAha- dravyaM vinA nAsti guNodaya iti|- dravyaM kAraNaM vinA ArogyalakShaNo guNodayo nAsti| kAraNaM cehArogyotpattAvagatAyuShTvaM, tacca nAstIti bhAvaH||27||

parIkShyamAyurbhiShajA nIrujasyAturasya ca| Ayurj~jAnaphalaM kRutsnamAyurj~je hyanuvartate||28||

Commentary: Ayurj~jAnaphalaM vidyamAnAyuShi bheShajadAnam||28||

tatra shlokaH- kriyApathamatikrAntAH kevalaM dehamAplutAH| cihnaM kurvanti yaddoShAstadariShTaM nirucyate||29||

Commentary: riShTalakShaNamAha- kriyApathamatikrAntA ityAdi| atikrAntA iti gatAH| dUtAdigatariShTalakShaNametanna bhavati, kintu sharIragatariShTalakShaNaM; tena nAvyAptirlakShaNasya vAcyA| sarvariShTavyApakaM tu lakShaNaM yathA- AyuSho~antarga(ga)tasya li~ggamiti| tacca indriyapadenaivoktamiti prathamAdhyAya eva indriyapadavyAkhyAyAM proktam| nanu nirnimittaM riShTamityuktam, iha doShajanyatvaM riShTAnAmucyata iti na kathaM virodhaH? na, nirnimittatvaM hyanupalabhyamAnanimittatvamuktaM; tena rUkShAdihetuprAptimantareNa pratyAsannamaraNaprabhAvakupitadoShajanyatvaM tattadariShTAnAmucyate, tenehApyupalabhyamAnavyaktanimittatAsadbhAvAnna virodhaH||29||
sadyaHkAlaniyataM riShTamabhidhAya kAlavisheShaniyatAriShTAbhidhAyakamaNujyotIyamucyate| aNujyotishceha yathAshrutaM rogaM varjayitvA sa~jj~jAyAmanukriyate||1-2||

balimiti vAyasAnAM vidhivaddattamannam| mahattama iti maraNarUpaM tamaH| vikRutyeti prasiddhaM dhanAdikAraNaM vinA| vinimittamiti sharIrasambaddhadhanAdisUcakalakShaNaM vinA; sharIrasambaddhalakShaNavashAdeva kasmiMshcitkAle dhanAdi tadapacayo vA bhavati; tacca lakShaNanimittatvAdariShTamiti prathamAdhyAya evoktam| upacayamiti sharIra evopacayam| ato vibhraMshamiti shobhAdyabhAvam||4-6||
jAlamiti jAlAkAram| candravakrAbhiriti bAlacandravakrAbhiH||8-9||

reta ityAdyariShTaM ‘niShThyUtaM ca purIShaM ca’ (iM.a.9) ityAdinA yadyapyuktaM, tathA~apIha samAsavacanAt samuditAnAmeva retaHprabhRutInAM majjanaM svajanadveShe sati mArakaM bhavatIti j~jeyam||10-11||

ubhe iti vacanaM samuditahastAdishoShameva darshayati| pravAlakRutaguTikAvadAbhAsanta iti pravAlaguTikAbhAsAH| kAlapAshaparItasyeti shIghraM mariShyataH| parigRuhNAti svasthavadAhAramiti yojanA, abalaH san svasthavadAhAramatyarthaM karotItyarthaH||12-17||

samIpa ityAdi| cakShuShoH samIpe~a~ggulIkaraM kRutvA tat pashyan mRugayate prArthayate, smayate ca vismito bhavati| UrdhvagamanimiShaM ca IkShaNaM yasya sa tathA| asat avidyamAnaM shayanAsanAdi mRugayate prArthayate||18-19||
ahAsyahAsIti ahAsyaviShaye hAsyavAn| dashanacchadau oShThau| shItashabda ucchvAsAntaiH sambadhyate| janamiti gobalIvardanyAyena svajanam||20-21||
vAsamiva vAsaM, sharIramAtmano gRuhamiva bhavati| na vA bhavatIti sarvathA na bhavatItyarthaH||23-24||

samavartina iti yamasya; anye tu samavartishabdena kAlamRutyuM bruvate, cashabdenoktavakShyamANasakalAriShTagrahaNaM kurvanti; tena sarvameva riShTaM kAlamRutyoH paraM bhavatIti varNayanti| atra ca dveShamanu rogakramaNaM niShphalo bheShajaprayogashcApi syAdityAha- eteShvityAdi| bheShajaM pratihanyata iti samyakkRutamapi bheShajaM hanyata ityarthaH| naiShAmannAni bhu~jjIteti prAyeNa tadannasyAvishuddhatvAt| evamudakapratiShedhe~api bodhyam||25-26||
athAto gomayacUrNIyamindriyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
svAcAraM hRuShTamavya~ggaM yashasyaM shuklavAsasam| amuNDamajaTaM dUtaM jAtiveshakriyAsamam||67||
anuShTrakharayAnasthamasandhyAsvagraheShu ca| adAruNeShu nakShatreShvanugreShu dhruveShu ca||68||
vinA caturthIM navamIM vinA riktAM caturdashIm| madhyAhnamardharAtraM ca bhUkampaM rAhudarshanam||69||
vinA deshamashastaM cAshastautpAtikalakShaNam| dUtaM prashastamavyagraM nirdishedAgataM bhiShak||70||
dadhyakShatadvijAtInAM vRuShabhANAM nRupasya ca||71||
ratnAnAM pUrNakumbhAnAM sitasya turagasya ca| suradhvajapatAkAnAM phalAnAM yAvakasya ca||72||
kanyApuMvardhamAnAnAM baddhasyaikapashostasthA| pRuthivyA uddhRutAyAshca vahneH prajvalitasya ca||73||
modakAnAM sumanasAM shuklAnAM candanasya ca| manoj~jasyAnnapAnasya pUrNasya shakaTasya ca||74||
nRubhirdhenvAH savatsAyA vaDavAyAH striyAstathA| jIva~jjIvakasiddhArthasArasapriyavAdinAm||75||
haMsAnAM shatapatrANAM cAShANAM shikhinAM tathA| matsyAjadvijasha~gkhAnAM priya~ggUnAM ghRutasya ca||76||
rucakAdarshasiddhArtharocanAnAM ca darshanam| gandhaH surabhirvarNashca sushuklo madhuro rasaH||77||
mRugapakShimanuShyANAM prashastAshca giraH shubhAH| chatradhvajapatAkAnAmutkShepaNamabhiShTutiH||78||
bherImRuda~ggasha~gkhAnAM shabdAH puNyAhanisvanAH| vedAdhyayanashabdAshca sukho vAyuH pradakShiNaH||79||
ma~ggalAcArasampannaH sAturo vaishmiko janaH||80||
shraddadhAno~anukUlashca prabhUtadravyasa~ggrahaH| dhanaishvaryasukhAvAptiriShTalAbhaH sukhena ca||81||
dravyANAM tatra yogyAnAM yojanA siddhireva ca| gRuhaprAsAdashailAnAM nAgAnAmRuShabhasya ca||82||
hayAnAM puruShANAM ca svapne samadhirohaNam| somArkAgnidvijAtInAM gavAM nRUNAM payasvinAm||83||
arNavAnAM prataraNaM vRuddhiH sambAdhaniHsRutiH| svapne devaiH sapitRubhiH prasannaishcAbhibhAShaNam||84||
darshanaM shuklavastrANAM hradasya vimalasya ca| mAMsamatsyaviShAmedhyacchatrAdarshaparigrahaH||85||
svapne sumanasAM caiva shuklAnAM darshanaM shubham| ashvagorathayAnaM ca yAnaM pUrvottareNa ca| rodanaM patitotthAnaM dviShatAM cAvamardanam||86||
sattvalakShaNasaMyogo bhaktirvaidyadvijAtiShu| sAdhyatvaM na ca nirvedastadArogyasya lakShaNam||87||
ArogyAdbalamAyushca sukhaM ca labhate mahat| iShTAMshcApyaparAn bhAvAn puruShaH shubhalakShaNaH||88||

tatra shlokau- uktaM gomayacUrNIye maraNArogyalakShaNam| dUtasvapnAturotpAtayuktisiddhivyapAshrayam||89||

Commentary: uktamityAdyadhyAyasa~ggrahaH| dUtAdiShu pRutha~gmaraNArogyalakShaNamihoktaM vyaktameva| yuktyAshrayaM maraNalakShaNaM yathA- ‘yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH sampAdayitumauShadham’ ityAdigranthoktam| siddhyAshrayaM maraNalakShaNaM yathA- ‘vij~jAtaM’ ityAdigranthoktam| ArogyalakShaNaM yuktyAshrayaM siddhyAshrayaM ca yathA- ‘iShTAlAbhaH sukhena ca’ iti granthoktam||89||

itIdamuktaM prakRutaM yathAtathaM tadanvavekShyaM satataM bhiShagvidA| tathA hi siddhiM ca yashashca shAshvataM sa siddhakarmA labhate dhanAni ca||90||

Commentary: itItyAdinendriyasthAnoktaM prameyajAtaM mahAphalatvenAvashyabodhyatayopadarshayannupasaMharati||90||
yasya gomayacUrNAbhaM cUrNaM mUrdhani jAyate| sasnehaM bhrashyate caiva mAsAntaM tasya jIvitam||3||
nikaShanniva yaH pAdau cyutAMsaH paridhAvati| vikRutyA na sa loke~asmiMshciraM vasati mAnavaH||4||
yasya snAtAnuliptasya pUrvaM shuShyatyuro bhRusham| ArdreShu sarvagAtreShu so~ardhamAsaM na jIvati||5||
yamuddishyAturaM vaidyaH saMvartayitumauShadham | yatamAno na shaknoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam||6||
vij~jAtaM bahushaH siddhaM vidhivaccAvacAritam| na sidhyatyauShadhaM yasya nAsti tasya cikitsitam||7||
AhAramupayu~jjAno bhiShajA sUpakalpitam| yaH phalaM tasya nApnoti durlabhaM tasya jIvitam||8||
dUtAdhikAre vakShyAmo lakShaNAni mumUrShatAm| yAni dRuShTvA bhiShak prAj~jaH pratyAkhyAyAdasaMyamam||9||
muktakeshe~athavA nagne rudatyaprayate~athavA| bhiShagabhyAgataM dRuShTvA dUtaM maraNamAdishet||10||
supte bhiShaji ye dUtAshchindatyapi ca bhindati| Agacchanti bhiShak teShAM na bhartAramanuvrajet||11||
juhvatyagniM tathA piNDAn pitRubhyo nirvapatyapi| vaidye dUtA ya AyAnti te ghnanti prajighAMsavaH||12||
kathayatyaprashastAni cintayatyathavA punaH| vaidye dUtA manuShyANAmAgacchanti mumUrShatAm||13||
mRutadagdhavinaShTAni bhajati vyAharatyapi| aprashastAni cAnyAni vaidye dUtA mumUrShatAm||14||
vikArasAmAnyaguNe deshe kAle~athavA bhiShak| dUtamabhyAgataM dRuShTvA nAturaM tamupAcaret||15||
dInabhItadrutatrastamalinAmasatIM striyam| trIn vyAkRutIMshca ShaNDAMshca dUtAn vidyAnmumUrShatAm||16||
a~ggavyasaninaM dUtaM li~gginaM vyAdhitaM tathA| samprekShya cograkarmANaM na vaidyo gantumarhati||17||
AturArthamanuprAptaM kharoShTrarathavAhanam| dUtaM dRuShTvA bhiShagvidyAdAturasya parAbhavam||18||
palAlabusamAMsAsthikeshalomanakhadvijAn| mArjanIM musalaM shUrpamupAnaccarma vicyutam ||19||
tRuNakAShThatuShA~ggAraM spRushanto loShTamashma ca| tatpUrvadarshane dUtA vyAharanti mumUrShatAm||20||
yasmiMshca dUte bruvati vAkyamAturasaMshrayam| pashyennimittamashubhaM taM ca nAnuvrajedbhiShak||21||
tathA vyasaninaM pretaM pretAla~gkArameva vA| bhinnaM dagdhaM vinaShTaM vA tadvAdIni vacAMsi vA||22||
raso vA kaTukastIvro gandho vA kauNapo mahAn| sparsho vA vipulaH krUro yadvA~anyadashubhaM bhavet||23||
tatpUrvamabhito vAkyaM vAkyakAle~athavA punaH| dUtAnAM vyAhRutaM shrutvA dhIro maraNamAdishet||24||
pathyAturakulAnAM ca vakShyAmyautpAtikaM punaH||25||
avakShutamathotkruShTaM skhalanaM patanaM tathA| AkroshaH samprahAro vA pratiShedho vigarhaNam||26||
vastroShNIShottarAsa~ggashchatropAnadyugAshrayam| vyasanaM darshanaM cApi mRutavyasaninAM tathA||27||
caityadhvajapatAkAnAM pUrNAnAM patanAni ca| hatAniShTapravAdAshca dUShaNaM bhasmapAMshubhiH||28||
pathacchedo biDAlena shunA sarpeNa vA punaH| mRugadvijAnAM krUrANAM giro dIptAM dishaM prati||29||
shayanAsanayAnAnAmuttAnAnAM ca darshanam| ityetAnyaprashastAni sarvANyAhurmanIShiNaH||30||
etAni pathi vaidyena pashyatA~a~aturaveshmani| shRuNvatA ca na gantavyaM tadAgAraM vipashcitA||31||
imAmapi ca budhyeta gRuhAvasthAM mumUrShatAm||32||
praveshe pUrNakumbhAgnimRudbIjaphalasarpiShAm| vRuShabrAhmaNaratnAnnadevatAnAM ca nirgatim||33||
agnipUrNAni pAtrANi bhinnAni vishikhAni ca| bhiSha~g mumUrShatAM veshma pravishanneva pashyati||34||
chinnabhinnAni dagdhAni bhagnAni mRuditAni ca| durbalAni ca sevante mumUrShorvaishmikA janAH||35||
shayanaM vasanaM yAnaM gamanaM bhojanaM rutam| shrUyate~ama~ggalaM yasya nAsti tasya cikitsitam||36||
shayanaM vasanaM yAnamanyaM vA~api paricchadam| pretavadyasya kurvanti suhRudaH preta eva saH||37||
annaM vyApadyate~atyarthaM jyotishcaivopashAmyati| nivAte sendhanaM yasya tasya nAsti cikitsitam||38||
Aturasya gRuhe yasya bhidyante vA patanti vA| atimAtramamatrANi durlabhaM tasya jIvitam||39||
bhavanti cAtra- yaddvAdashabhiradhyAyairvyAsataH parikIrtitam| mumUrShatAM manuShyANAM lakShaNaM jIvitAntakRut||40||
tat samAsena vakShyAmaH paryAyAntaramAshritam| paryAyavacanaM hyarthavij~jAnAyopapadyate||41||
atyarthaM punareveyaM vivakShA no vidhIyate| tasminnevAdhikaraNe yat pUrvamabhishabditam||42||
vasatAM caramaM kAlaM sharIreShu sharIriNAm| abhyugrANAM vinAshAya dehebhyaH pravivatsatAm||43||
iShTAMstitikShatAM prANAn kAntaM vAsaM jihAsatAm| tantrayantreShu bhinneShu tamo~antyaM pravivikShatAm||44||
vinAshAyeha rUpANi yAnyavasthAntarANi ca| bhavanti tAni vakShyAmi yathoddeshaM yathAgamam||45||
prANAH samupatapyante vij~jAnamuparudhyate| vamanti balama~ggAni ceShTA vyuparamanti ca||46||
indriyANi vinashyanti khilIbhavati cetanA | autsukyaM bhajate sattvaM ceto bhIrAvishatyapi||47||
smRutistyajati medhA ca hrIshriyau cApasarpataH| upaplavante pApmAna ojastejashca nashyati||48||
shIlaM vyAvartate~atyarthaM bhaktishca parivartate| vikriyante praticchAyAshchAyAshca vikRutiM prati||49||
shukraM pracyavate sthAnAdunmArgaM bhajate~anilaH| kShayaM mAMsAni gacchanti gacchatyasRugapi kShayam||50||
UShmANaH pralayaM yAnti vishleShaM yAnti sandhayaH| gandhA vikRutimAyAnti bhedaM varNasvarau tathA||51||
vaivarNyaM bhajate kAyaH kAyacchidraM vishuShyati| dhUmaH sa~jjAyate mUrdhni dAruNAkhyashca cUrNakaH||52||
satataspandanA deshAH sharIre ye~abhilakShitAH| te stambhAnugatAH sarve na calanti katha~jcana||53||
guNAH sharIradeshAnAM shItoShNamRududAruNAH| viparyAsena vartante sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhAH||54||
nakheShu jAyate puShpaM pa~gko danteShu jAyate| jaTAH pakShmasu jAyante sImantAshcApi mUrdhani||55||
bheShajAni na saMvRuttiM prApnuvanti yathAruci| yAni cApyupapadyante teShAM vIryaM na sidhyati||56||
nAnAprakRutayaH krUrA vikArA vividhauShadhAH| kShipraM samabhivartante pratihatya balaujasI||57||
shabdaH sparsho raso rUpaM gandhashceShTA vicintitam | utpadyante~ashubhAnyeva pratikarmapravRuttiShu||58||
dRushyante dAruNAH svapnA daurAtmyamupajAyate| preShyAH pratIpatAM yAnti pretAkRutirudIryate||59||
prakRutirhIyate~atyarthaM vikRutishcAbhivardhate| kRutsnamautpAtikaM ghoramari(ni)ShTamupalakShyate||60||
ityetAni manuShyANAM bhavanti vinashiShyatAm| lakShaNAni yathoddeshaM yAnyuktAni yathAgamam||61||
maraNAyeha rUpANi pashyatA~api bhiShagvidA| apRuShTena na vaktavyaM maraNaM pratyupasthitam||62||
pRuShTenApi na vaktavyaM tatra yatropaghAtakam| Aturasya bhavedduHkhamathavA~anyasya kasyacit||63||
abruvanmaraNaM tasya nainamiccheccikitsitum| yasya pashyedvinAshAya li~ggAni kushalo bhiShak||64||
li~ggebhyo maraNAkhyebhyo viparItAni pashyatA| li~ggAnyArogyamAgantu vaktavyaM bhiShajA dhruvam||65||
dUtairautpAtikairbhAvaiH pathyAturakulAshrayaiH| AturAcArashIleShTadravyasampattilakShaNaiH||66||
pArisheShyAdgomayacUrNIyamucyate||1-2||

shubhabhavanalakShaNaM svAcAramityAdinA brUte| amuNDamiti asashikhakRutavapano~abhipretaH| jAtyAdibhirAtureNa saha samo jAtiveshakriyAsamaH| agraheShviti aprashastasthAnasthitakrUragrahAnadhiShThiteShu kAleShvityarthaH| adAruNeShu nakShatreShvanugreShu dhruveShu ceti dAruNAnIti tIkShNAni, yaduvAca varAhaH- “mUlashivashakrabhujagAdhipAni tIkShNAni” (bRu.saM.a.18) iti; shiva ArdrA, shakro jyeShThA, bhujagAdhipa AshleShA| ugrANi ca varAhoktAni yathA- “ugrANi pUrvabharaNIpitryANi” (bRu.saM.a.98) iti| tatra pUrvashabdena pUrvaphAlgunI, pUrvAShADhA, pUrvabhAdrapadA ca| pitryaM maghA| varAhoktadAruNAdIni nakShatrANi varjayitvA~anyeShu nakShatreShu dUtA AgatAH shubhA bhavanti| riktAmiti caturthyAdivisheShaNam| caturthI navamI caturdashI ca riktocyate| tathA rikteti visheShaNena caturthyAdInAM niShphalatvasUcanena karmArambhaM pratyanupAdeyatopadishyate| shastamautpAtikamAkasmikaM lakShaNaM yasya tacchastautpAtikalakShaNam||67-70||

dadhyakShatetyAdinA mArgAdiShu prashastadarshanAnyAha| suradhvajaH shakradhvajaH| kanyApuMvardhamAnAnAmiti a~gkAropitAH kumAryaH kumArAshca vardhamAnAH, puruShottamavat samAsaH; anye tu vardhamAnAH sharAvA ityAhuH; te cAlepanAdinA maNDitA iti boddhavyam| ekapashuH shreShThapashurityarthaH| shakaTasya pUrNasya nRubhiriti sambandhaH| vaDavAyAH striyAshca savatsAyA iti yojanA| jIva~jjIvakaH pakShI svanAmaprasiddhaH| priyavAdI cAtakaH||71-79||-
yojanAyAM satyAM siddhiH yojanAsiddhiH| sambAdhaniHsRutiH sa~gkaTanistaraNam| dviShatAM cAvamardanamityantaM svapne j~jeyam||80-86||
sattvasya guNasya lakShaNaiH saha saMyogaH sattvalakShaNasaMyogaH| na ca nirveda iti Atmanyanavaj~jetyarthaH||87-88||

cUrNamityasya visheShaNaM- sasnehamiti| nikaShanniveti gharShanniva| vikRutyetyanena sahajaM pAdagharShaNAdi niShedhati| pUrvamuraH shuShyatItyabhidhAnAdeva sheShagAtrArdratAyAM labdhAyAM punaH ‘ArdreShu sarvagAtreShu’ iti vacanAdvisheSheNAparagAtrANAmArdratAM darshayati| yamuddishyeti yasyArthe| siddhamiti anena rUpeNa bahusho j~jAtam| AhAramityAdyariShTaM rogiviShayaM, tena “iShTaM ca guNasampannaM” (iM.a.7) ityAdigranthoktena svasthaviShayeNAriShTena samaM na paunaruktyam||3-8||

aprayate iti apavitre| supte iti nidrANe| na bhartAramiti na dUtapreShakamAturamityarthaH| dUtAshca yadyapi rogihitamicchanti, na prajighAMsavashca bhavanti, na ca svabhAvAd dUtAH prajighAMsavo ghnanti, tathA~api yathA~a~aturasya vinAsho bhavati tathA daivapreritAH santa Agacchanto dUtAH prajighAMsava iva tathA ghnantIveti kRutvA ‘prajighAMsavo ghnanti’ ityucyante| tenAtra ivashabdo luptanirdiShTo draShTavyaH| cintayatyaprashastAnIti sambandhaH| vyAharatyapi vaidye mRutadagdhavinaShTAnIti yojanA| vikArasAmAnyaguNo desho yathA- raktapitte jvalanasannihito deshaH, vikArasAmAnyaguNaH kAlo yathA- raktapitte madhyAhna ityAdi j~jeyam| trIniti trisa~gkhyA eva dUtA aprashastAH| ShaNDA napuMsakAH| a~ggavyasanI chinnanAsAdiH| ugrakarmA mAraNAdyakAryapravRuttaH| palAletyAdau tRuNakAShThAdiparispRusho dUtAH| tatpUrvadarshane iti vaidyapUrvadarshane, palAlabusAdIni spRushanta Aturasya mumUrShatAM vyAharantIti yojanA| pretAla~gkArameva cetyantaM yaM pashyet taM ca nAnuvrajediti sambandhaH| tadvAdIni bhinnAdivAdIni| tIvra iti indriyodvejakaH| sparsho vipulo yathA tIvrogrAdisparshaH| tatpUrvamiti dUtavacanAt pUrvam| abhito vAkyamiti sarvabhUtakAlavacanam| vyAhRutamiti AturAvasthAkathanam||9-24||-

autpAtikamiti ariShTasUcakanimittam| avakShutaM chikkA| utkRuShTaM santrastarutam| pratiShedhaH ‘mA gaccha’ ityevaMrUpaH| vyasanaM vastrAdInAM yat sphuTanAdi| vyasanIti vya~ggaH, kalahavAn vA| pUrNAH pUrNakumbhAdayaH| dUShaNaM bhasmapAMshubhiriti bhasmapAMshvavakiraNam| pathaccheda iti biDAlAdibhirmArgala~gghanam| mRugadvijAH krUrAH shRugAlagRudhrAdayaH| dIptA dik yasyAM sUryo vartate, kiMvA dakShiNA dik dIptocyate| shayanaM khaTvAdi, AsanaM pIThAdi||25-31||-

vishikhAnIti khaNDitAni; kiMvA ‘vashikAni’ iti pAThaH, tadA shUnyAnItyarthaH| vaishmikA janA iti gRuhapratiShThitA janAH| pretavat mRutasya yathA kriyate shayanAdi tathA| suhRuda iti vacanenAsuhRudbhirdveShAdama~ggalArthaM kRutaM pretavacchayanAdi niShedhayati| jyotiH agniH, nivAte sendhanashca san yadi nirvAti tadA riShTam| amatrANIti sharAvasthAlyAdIni||32-39||

samprati dvAdashAdhyAyoktaM riShTaM duradhigamArthaM sa~ggraheNa spaShTIkaraNArthamAha- dvAdashabhirityAdi| paryAyAyAntaramAshritamiti sa~jj~jAntareNa kIrtitam| arthavij~jAnAyeti pUrvAbhidhAne shabdasyAnekArthAbhidhAyitvAdinA yatra sandeho mithyAj~jAnaM vA bhavati, tasya shabdAntareNAbhidhAnAd vyakto~artho bhavatIti darshayati||40-42||

abhyugrANAmiti abhyudgatAnAm| pravivatsatAmiti pravastumudyatAnAm| kAntaM vAsamityanena sarvaprANinAmeva sarvAvasthAsu sharIraM kAmyaM bhavatIti darshayati| kAntamapi sharIrarUpaM vAso jIvitaM vA balAdeva svakarmaNA tyajyamAnamapi ihopacArAdivashabdalopAdvA svAtantryeNa nirdishyate; yathA- jihAsatAmiti, tatha titikShatAmiti| tantraM sharIraM, tasya yantraM sirAsnAyvAdirUpaM tantrayantram| tamo~antyamiti maraNarUpaM tamaH| vinAshAyeha rUpANIti prANasamupatApAdIni| khilIbhavatIti apathagrAhiNI bhavati| pApmAna iti pApajanitarogAH, adharmyAshca kriyAH| chAyAshca vikRutiM prati ‘gacchanti’ iti sheShaH, tena pratyekaM chAyA vikRutiM gacchatItyarthaH| dhUmaH sa~jjAyate mUrdhnIti prakRutaM bAShpanirgamaM vinA bahalo dhUma iva shirasi bhavati| dAruNAkhyashca cUrNaka iti “yasya gomayacUrNAbhaM” ityAdigranthoktashcUrNakaH| sthAneShvanyeShu tadvidhA iti sharIradeshAntareShu| bahuvacanena snehAdayo viparyAsena vartanta ityarthaH| saMvRuttimiti niShpattim| upapadyante sidhyanti| nAnAprakRutaya iti parasparaM viruddhasvabhAvAH| pratikarmapravRuttiH cikitsApravRuttiH| autpAtikamiti AkasmikaM; tasya visheShaNaM- ariShTamiti; tena riShTasUcakamautpAtikamiti phalati||43-61||
samprati j~jAtasya riShTasya yathA~aprakAshyatvaM tadAha- maraNAyetyAdi| AturasyopaghAtakamiti yojyam| bhavedduHkhamanyasyeti sambandhaH||62-64||

hanta maraNaM cedAturasya bhAvi nocyate, tat kimArogyamapi bhAvi na vaktavyamevetyAha- li~ggebhya ityAdi| maraNamAkhyApayantIti maraNAkhyAni, tebhyo viparItAni ArogyasUcakAni| Agantviti pashcAtkAlabhAvi| autpAtikairbhAvairiti shubhasUcanArthamakasmAdutpannairbhAvaiH; sAmAnyena shubhAshubhasUcakaM yadakasmAdudbhavati tadautpAtikamucyate| dravyasampattilakShaNairityantairArogyamAgantu vaktavyamiti yojanA||65-66||
athAto~abhayAmalakIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

abheShajamiti j~jeyaM viparItaM yadauShadhAt| tadasevyaM niShevyaM tu pravakShyAmi yadauShadham||15||

Commentary: abheShajamapi pUrvoddiShTaM vivRuNoti- abheShajamityAdi| viparItaM rogajananalakShaNArthakAri||15||
rasAyanAnAM dvividhaM prayogamRuShayo viduH| kuTIprAveshikaM caiva vAtAtapikameva ca||16||
kuTIprAveshikasyAdau vidhiH samupadekShyate| nRupavaidyadvijAtInAM sAdhUnAM puNyakarmaNAm||17||
nivAse nirbhaye shaste prApyopakaraNe pure| dishi pUrvottarasyAM ca subhUmau kArayet kuTIm||18||
vistArotsedhasampannAM trigarbhAM sUkShmalocanAm| ghanabhittimRutusukhAM suspaShTAM manasaH priyAm||19||
shabdAdInAmashastAnAmagamyaM strIvivarjitAm| iShTopakaraNopetAM sajjavaidyauShadhadvijAm ||20||
athodagayane shukle tithinakShatrapUjite| muhUrtakaraNopete prashaste kRutavApanaH||21||
dhRutismRutibalaM kRutvA shraddadhAnaH samAhitaH| vidhUya mAnasAn doShAn maitrIM bhUteShu cintayan||22||
devatAH pUjayitvA~agre dvijAtIMshca pradakShiNam| devagobrAhmaNAn kRutvA tatastAM pravishet kuTIm||23||
tasyAM saMshodhanaiH shuddhaH sukhI jAtabalaH punaH| rasAyanaM prayu~jjIta tatpravakShyAmi shodhanam||24||
harItakInAM cUrNAni saindhavAmalake guDam| vacAM viDa~ggaM rajanIM pippalIM vishvabheShajam||25||
pibeduShNAmbunA jantuH snehasvedopapAditaH| tena shuddhasharIrAya kRutasaMsarjanAya ca||26||
trirAtraM yAvakaM dadyAt pa~jcAhaM vA~api sarpiShA| saptAhaM vA purANasya yAvacchuddhestu varcasaH||27||
shuddhakoShThaM tu taM j~jAtvA rasAyanamupAcaret| vayaHprakRutisAtmyaj~jo yaugikaM yasya yadbhavet||28||
harItakIM pa~jcarasAmuShNAmalavaNAM shivAm| doShAnulomanIM laghvIM vidyAddIpanapAcanIm||29||
AyuShyAM pauShTikIM dhanyAM vayasaH sthApanIM parAm| sarvarogaprashamanIM buddhIndriyabalapradAm||30||
kuShThaM gulmamudAvartaM shoShaM pANDvAmayaM madam| arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM purANaM viShamajvaram||31||
hRudrogaM sashirorogamatIsAramarocakam| kAsaM pramehamAnAhaM plIhAnamudaraM navam||32||
kaphaprasekaM vaisvaryaM vaivarNyaM kAmalAM krimIn| shvayathuM tamakaM chardiM klaibyama~ggAvasAdanam||33||
srotovibandhAn vividhAn pralepaM hRudayorasoH| smRutibuddhipramohaM ca jayecchIghraM harItakI||34||
(ajIrNino rUkShabhujaH strImadyaviShakarshitAH| severannAbhayAmete kShuttRuShNoShNArditAshca ye)||35||
tAn guNAMstAni karmANi vidyAdAmalakIShvapi| yAnyuktAni harItakyA vIryasya tu viparyayaH||36||
atashcAmRutakalpAni vidyAt karmabhirIdRushaiH| harItakInAM shasyAni bhiShagAmalakasya ca||37||
oShadhInAM parA bhUmirhimavA~j shailasattamaH| tasmAtphalAni tajjAni grAhayetkAlajAni tu||38||
ApUrNarasavIryANi kAle kAle yathAvidhi| AdityapavanacchAyAsalilaprINitAni ca||39||
yAnyajagdhAnyapUtIni nirvraNAnyagadAni ca| teShAM prayogaM vakShyAmi phalAnAM karma cottamam||40||
pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlAnAM bhAgAn dashapalonmitAn| harItakIsahasraM ca triguNAmalakaM navam||41||
vidArigandhAM bRuhatIM pRushniparNIM nidigdhikAm| vidyAdvidArigandhAdyaM shvadaMShTrApa~jcamaM gaNam||42||
bilvAgnimanthashyonAkaM kAshmaryamatha pATalAm| punarnavAM shUrpaparNyau balAmeraNDameva ca||43||
jIvakarShabhakau medAM jIvantIM sashatAvarIm| sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca||44||
ityeShAM pa~jcamUlAnAM pa~jcAnAmupakalpayet| bhAgAn yathoktAMstatsarvaM sAdhyaM dashaguNe~ambhasi||45||
dashabhAgAvasheShaM tu pUtaM taM grAhayedrasam| harItakIshca tAH sarvAH sarvANyAmalakAni ca||46||
tAni sarvANyanasthIni phalAnyApothya kUrcanaiH| vinIya tasminniryUhe cUrNAnImAni dApayet||47||
maNDUkaparNyAH pippalyAH sha~gkhapuShpyAH plavasya ca| mustAnAM saviDa~ggAnAM candanAguruNostathA||48||
madhukasya haridrAyA vacAyAH kanakasya ca| bhAgAMshcatuShpalAn kRutvA sUkShmailAyAstvacastathA||49||
sitopalAsahasraM ca cUrNitaM tulayA~adhikam| tailasya dvyADhakaM tatra dadyAttrINi ca sarpiShaH||50||
sAdhyamaudumbare pAtre tat sarvaM mRudunA~agninA| j~jAtvA lehyamadagdhaM ca shItaM kShaudreNa saMsRujet||51||
kShaudrapramANaM snehArdhaM tat sarvaM ghRutabhAjane| tiShThetsammUrcchitaM tasya mAtrAM kAle prayojayet||52||
yA noparundhyAdAhAramekaM mAtrA jarAM prati| ShaShTikaH payasA cAtra jIrNe bhojanamiShyate||53||
vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAstathA cAnye tapodhanAH| rasAyanamidaM prAshya babhUvuramitAyuShaH||54||
muktvA jIrNaM vapushcAgryamavApustaruNaM vayaH| vItatandrAklamashvAsA nirAta~gkAH samAhitAH||55||
medhAsmRutibalopetAshcirarAtraM tapodhanAH| brAhmaM tapo brahmacaryaM cerushcAtyantaniShThayA||56||
rasAyanamidaM brAhmamAyuShkAmaH prayojayet| dIrghamAyurvayashcAgryaM kAmAMshceShTAn samashnute||57||
(iti brAhmarasAyanam)

yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAM sahasraM piShTasvedanavidhinA payasa UShmaNA susvinnamanAtapashuShkamanasthi cUrNayet| tadAmalakasahasrasvarasaparipItaM sthirApunarnavAjIvantInAgabalAbrahmasuvarcalAmaNDUkaparNIshatAvarIsha~gkhapuShpIpippalIvacAviDa~ggasvaya~gguptAmRutA- candanAgurumadhukamadhUkapuShpotpalapadmamAlatIyuvatIyUthikAcUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktaM punarnAgabalAsahasrapalasvarasaparipItamanAtapashuShkaM dviguNitasarpiShA kShaudrasarpiShA vA kShudraguDAkRutiM kRutvA shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe bhasmarAsheradhaH sthApayedantarbhUmeH pakShaM kRutarakShAvidhAnamatharvavedavidA, pakShAtyaye coddhRutya kanakarajatatAmrapravAlakAlAyasacUrNAShTabhAgasaMyuktamardhakarShavRuddhyA yathoktena vidhinA prAtaH prAtaH prayu~jjAno~agnibalamabhisamIkShya, jIrNe ca ShaShTikaM payasA sasarpiShkamupasevamAno yathoktAn guNAn samashnuta iti||58||
bhavanti cAtra- idaM rasAyanaM brAhmaM maharShigaNasevitam| bhavatyarogo dIrghAyuH prayu~jjAno mahAbalaH||59||
kAntaH prajAnAM siddhArthashcandrAdityasamadyutiH| shrutaM dhArayate sattvamArShaM cAsya pravartate||60||
dharaNIdharasArashca vAyunA samavikramaH| sa bhavatyaviShaM cAsya gAtre sampadyate viSham||61||

(iti dvitIyaM brAhmarasAyanam)

Commentary: amRutavallI guDUcI| somavalkaH viTkhadiraH| kShIrasarpiH kShIrasamutthitasarpiH| ayashcUrNasya caturtho bhAgaH, yata etadayashcUrNaM caturthabhAgamata evAsmin prayoge jatUkarNena “ayashcUrNapAdayuktam” iti kRutam| amarANAmamRutaM jarAdiharaM, nAgAnAM ca sudhA jarAmaraNaharI, ityubhayopAdAnaM dRuShTAnte| brahma mokShaH| mokShasAdhanatvaM ceha rasAyanasya vishuddhasattvakartRutayocyate|| 77-80||

cikitsitaM vyAdhiharaM pathyaM sAdhanamauShadham| prAyashcittaM prashamanaM prakRutisthApanaM hitam||3||

Commentary: tatrAdau vyavahArArthaM sthAnAbhidheyasya bheShajasya paryAyAnAha- cikitsitamityAdi| karoti caivamAdau pradhAnAbhidheyaparyAyAbhidhAnaM, yathA- nidAne heturUpAdiparyAyakathanam| etacca paryAyAbhidhAnaM prAdhAnyena catuShpAdasyaiva bheShajasya, yaduktaM- “catuShpAdaM ShoDashakalaM bheShajamiti bhiShajo bhAShante” (sU.a.10) iti| evambhUtabheShajA~ggarUpatayA tu sthAvaraja~ggamadravyarUpasya bheShajasya bheShajatvamevAntaravyavahArakRutaM j~jeyam| prAyashcittamiti bheShajasa~jj~jA prAyashcittavadbheShajasyAdharmakAryavyAdhiharatvena||3||-

... bheShajaM dvividhaM ca tat| svasthasyorjaskaraM ki~jcit ki~jcidArtasya roganut||4||

Commentary: dvaividhyaM vivRuNoti- svasthasyetyAdi| ki~jciditi na sarvam| svasthatvena vyavahriyamANasya puMso jarAdisvAbhAvikavyAdhiharatvena tathA~apraharShavyayAyakShayitvAnupacitashukratvAdyaprashastashArIrabhAvaharatvena UrjaH prashastaM bhAvamAdadhAtIti svasthasyorjaskaram| Artasya roganuditi visheShaNena jvarAdinA~a~artasya jvarAdiharam| roganuditi vacanenaivArtavisheShatAyAM labdhAyAM yat ‘Artasya’ iti karoti, tena sahajajarAdikRutAM pIDAmanudvejikAM parityajya jvarAdinA~asvAbhAvikena rogeNa pIDitasyeti darshayati||4||
bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalirbalA| parNyashcatasraH pippalyaH shvadaMShTrA bRuhatIdvayam||62||
shRu~ggI tAmalakI drAkShA jIvantI puShkarAguru| abhayA cAmRutA RuddhirjIvakarShabhakau shaTI||63||
