mustaM punarnavA medA sailA candanamutpalam| vidArI vRuShamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA||64||
eShAM palonmitAn bhAgA~jchatAnyAmalakasya ca| pa~jca dadyAttadaikadhyaM jaladroNe vipAcayet||65||
j~jAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyauShadhAnyatha taM rasam| taccAmalakamuddhRutya niShkulaM tailasarpiShoH||66||
paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA dattvA cArdhatulAM bhiShak| matsyaNDikAyAH pUtAyA lehavatsAdhu sAdhayet||67||
ShaTpalaM madhunashcAtra siddhashIte pradApayet| catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAH pippalIdvipalaM tathA||68||
palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt| ityayaM cyavanaprAshaH paramukto rasAyanaH||69||
kAsashvAsaharashcaiva visheSheNopadishyate| kShINakShatAnAM vRuddhAnAM bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanaH||70||
svarakShayamurorogaM hRudrogaM vAtashoNitam| pipAsAM mUtrashukrasthAn doShAMshcApyapakarShati||71||
asya mAtrAM prayu~jjIta yoparundhyAnna bhojanam| asya prayogAccyavanaH suvRuddho~abhUt punaryuvA||72||
medhAM smRutiM kAntimanAmayatvamAyuHprakarShaM balamindriyANAm| strIShu praharShaM paramagnivRuddhiM varNaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam||73||
rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllabheta jIrNo~api kuTIpraveshAt| jarAkRutaM rUpamapAsya sarvaM bibharti rUpaM navayauvanasya||74||
(iti cyavanaprAshaH)

athAmalakaharItakInAmAmalakabibhItakAnAM harItakIbibhItakAnAmAmalakaharItakIbibhItakAnAM vA palAshatvagavanaddhAnAM mRudA~avaliptAnAM kukUlasvinnAnAmakulakAnAM palasahasramulUkhale sampothya dadhighRutamadhupalalatailasharkarAsaMyuktaM bhakShayedanannabhugyathoktena vidhinA; tasyAnte yavAgvAdibhiH pratyavasthApanam , abhya~ggotsAdanaM sarpiShA yavacUrNaishca, ayaM ca rasAyanaprayogaprakarSho dvistAvadagnibalamabhisamIkShya , pratibhojanaM yUSheNa payasA vA ShaShTikaH sasarpiShkaH, ataH paraM yathAsukhavihAraH kAmabhakShyaH syAt| anena prayogeNarShayaH punaryuvatvamavApurbabhUvushcAnekavarShashatajIvino nirvikArAH paraM sharIrabuddhIndriyabalasamuditAshcerushcAtyantaniShThayA tapaH||75||

Commentary: kukUlakaH karIShAgniH| akulakAnAmiti anasthnAm| dravyAdInAmatra mAnaM noktaM, tena pradhAnasya cUrNasya dadhyAdibhirmilitaiH samAnamAnatvaM; kiMvA pratyekameva dadhyAdInAM cUrNasamatvam| palalaM tilacUrNam| bhakShayediti vacanaM lehye~api alpAbhyavaharaNamAtrArthatvAdupapannam| anannabhugiti sarvathA~a~ahArAntarAbhuk| tasyAnta iti etatprayogaparityAgakAle| pratyavasthApanamiti yavAgvAdikramavisheShaNaM; tena prayogAnte yadA annasaMsarjanaM kartavyaM, tadA yavAgvAdikrameNetyuktasyArthasya pratyavasthApanaM kriyata ityarthaH| yUSheNa payasA veti vikalpo~agnibalApekShayA||75||

(iti pa~jcamo harItakIyogaH)

Commentary: abhayetyAdinA sandehanirAsArthamuktaprayogasa~gkhyAM darshayati| evamanyatrApi sa~gkhyApraNayanamante j~jeyam|| 81||

harItakyAmalakabibhItakapa~jcapa~jcamUlaniryUhe pippalImadhukamadhUkakAkolIkShIrakAkolyAtmaguptAjIvakarShabhakakShIrashuklAkalkasamprayuktena vidArIsvarasena kShIrAShTaguNasamprayuktena ca sarpiShaH kumbhaM sAdhayitvA prayu~jjAno~agnibalasamAM mAtrAM jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamuShNodakAnupAnamashna~jjarAvyAdhipApAbhicAravyapagatabhayaH sharIrendriyabuddhibalamatulamupalabhyApratihatasarvArambhaH paramAyuranavApnuyAt||76||

Commentary: atra harItakyAdau kShIrashuklA kShIravidArikA| atra harItakyAdikvAthasya tveko bhAgaH, kShIrasyAShTau bhAgAH, sarpiSha eko bhAgaH| kumbho droNadvayam| vacanaM hi- “droNastu dviguNaH sUrpo vij~jeyaH kumbha eva ca” iti||76||

harItakyAmalakabibhItakaharidrAsthirAbalAviDa~ggAmRutavallIvishvabheShajamadhukapippalIsomavalkasiddhena kShIrasarpiShA madhusharkarAbhyAmapi ca sannIyAmalakasvarasashataparipItamAmalakacUrNamayashcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM pANitalamAtraM prAtaH prAtaH prAshya yathoktena vidhinA sAyaM mudgayUSheNa payasA vA sasarpiShkaM shAliShaShTikAnnamashnIyAt, trivarShaprayogAdasya varShashatamajaraM vayastiShThati, shrutamavatiShThate, sarvAmayAH prashAmyanti, viShamaviShaM bhavati gAtre, gAtramashmavat sthirIbhavati, adhRuShyo bhUtAnAM bhavati||77||
bhavanti cAtra- yathA~amarANAmamRutaM yathA bhogavatAM sudhA| tathA~abhavanmaharShINAM rasAyanavidhiH purA||78||
na jarAM na ca daurbalyaM nAturyaM nidhanaM na ca| jagmurvarShasahasrANi rasAyanaparAH purA||79||
na kevalaM dIrghamihAyurashnute rasAyanaM yo vidhivanniShevate| gatiM sa devarShiniShevitAM shubhAM prapadyate brahma tatheti cAkShayam ||80||
tatra shlokaH- abhayAmalakIye~asmin ShaDyogAH parikIrtitAH| rasAyanAnAM siddhAnAmAyuryairanuvartate||81||
svasthasyorjaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam||5||
prAyaH, prAyeNa rogANAM dvitIyaM prashame matam| prAyaHshabdo visheShArtho hyubhayaM hyubhayArthakRut||6||
dIrghamAyuH smRutiM medhAmArogyaM taruNaM vayaH| prabhAvarNasvaraudAryaM dehendriyabalaM param||7||
vAksiddhiM praNatiM kAntiM labhate nA rasAyanAt| lAbhopAyo hi shastAnAM rasAdInAM rasAyanam||8||
apatyasantAnakaraM yat sadyaH sampraharShaNam| vAjIvAtibalo yena yAtyapratihataH striyaH||9||
bhavatyatipriyaH strINAM yena yenopacIyate| jIryato~apyakShayaM shukraM phalavadyena dRushyate||10||
prabhUtashAkhaH shAkhIva yena caityo yathA mahAn| bhavatyarcyo bahumataH prajAnAM subahuprajaH||11||
santAnamUlaM yeneha pretya cAnantyamashnute| yashaH shriyaM balaM puShTiM vAjIkaraNameva tat||12||
svasthasyorjaskaraM tvetaddvividhaM proktamauShadham| yadvyAdhinirghAtakaraM vakShyate taccikitsite||13||
cikitsitArtha etAvAn vikArANAM yadauShadham| rasAyanavidhishcAgre vAjIkaraNameva ca||14||

pUrvasthAnoktalakShaNAbhAvenAvadhAritAyuShmadbhAvena cikitsA dharmArthayashaskarI kartavyetyanantaraM cikitsAbhidhAyakaM sthAnamucyate| rasAyanavAjIkaraNasAdhanamapi yathA cikitsocyate, tathA~anantarameva vakShyati| tatrApi jvarAdicikitsAyAH prAgrasAyanavAjIkaraNayormahAphalatvenAdAvabhidhAnam| tayorapi ca rasAyanameva varShasahasrAyuShTvAdikAraNatayA mahAphalamiti tadabhidhIyate, tatrApi cAbhayAmalakIyashcikitsAsthAnArthasUtrAbhidhAyakatayA~agre~abhidhIyate||1-2||

kuTIpraveshena yat kriyate tat kuTIprAveshikam| vAtAtapasevayA~api yat kriyate tad vAtAtapikam| trigarbhAM prathamamekaM gRuhaM, tasyAbhyantare dvitIyam, evaM  trigarbhAstrayo garbhA antarANi yasyAM sA; trigarbhAmiti antastriprakoShThAm| sUkShmalocanAmiti alpadvArajAlakAm| shukle shuklapakShe| sajjA vaidyAdayo yasyAM sA tathA| tithinakShatrapUjita iti shubhatithinakShatrayogAt pUjite| kRutavApana iti kRutakShauraH| mAnasAn doShAniti kAmakrodhAdIn| saMshodhanairiti vamanavirecanAsthApanashirovirecanaiH| sukhIti arogaH| jAtabala iti saMshodhanApahRutamalatayA saMsarjanAdikrameNa punarjAtabalaH| yadyapIha saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaprayogAt sarvANyeva saMshodhanAni sammatAni, tathA~apIha rasAyane visheSheNa yaugikatvAddharItakyAdiprayoga evoktaH; anye tu harItakyAdiprayogeNaiva paraM saMshodhanaM kartavyamityAhuH, saMshodhanairiti bahuvacanaM punaryAvacchuddherharItakyAdiprayogasyaiva karaNaM darshayati||16-24||
yAvakamiti yavAnnam| trirAtrAdivikalpatrayaM hInamadhyottamashuddhiviShayam||25-28||

yadyapi dravyAntarANi dashavarShashatAyuShkararasAyanAdhikRutAni santi, tathA~api harItakyAmalake eva rogaharatvAyuShkaratvarUpobhayadharmayogAdadhyAyAdau guNakarmabhyAmucyete; tatrApi yadyapi “AmalakaM vayaHsthApanAnAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktam, tathA~api rogaharatve harItakI prakarShavatIti kRutvA harItakyagre~abhihitA| harItakyAdiShu pa~jcarasatvAdyutpAdo~adRuShTavashAdbhUtasanniveshavisheShaprabhAvakRutaH; tena nAtropapattayaH kramante| shivAmiti kalyANakAriNIM, prashastaguNayuktatvAt| sarvarogaprashamanImiti saMyogasaMskArAdinA| sarvarogaharatvamabhidhAyApi kuShThAdihantRutvAbhidhAnaM visheSheNa kuShThAdihantRutvopadarshanArtham| pravartakatve~apyatIsAragrahaNIharatvaM vibaddhadoShapravartakatayA j~jeyaM; yaduktaM- “stokaM stokaM vibaddhaM vA sashUlaM yo~atisAryate| abhayApippalIkalkaiH sukhoShNaistaM virecayet” iti| buddhismRutipradatvamabhidhAyApi smRutibuddhipramohaharatvAbhidhAnaM tatra vishiShTashaktyupadarshanArtham| vIryasya tu viparyaya ityanenAmalakasya shItavIryatvamuktam| shasyAnIti asthirahitAni phalAni||29-37||

yadyapi “himavAnauShadhabhUmInAm” (sU.a.25) ityuktaM, tathA~api rasAyane himavatprabhavANyeva bheShajAni grAhyANIti darshayitumauShadhInAmityAdyabhidhAnam| kAle kAle iti phalapAkakAle ityarthaH| yathAvidhIti yathA bheShajagrahaNaM ma~ggaladevatArcanAdipUrvakaM syAttathA~avashyaM rasAyane karttavyam| agadAnItyanena pavanadahanAdyadoShaM phalasya darshayati||38-40||

pa~jcAnAmityAdau pratidravyaM dashapalabhAgagrahaNam , uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “iti pa~jca pa~jcamUlAni, teShAM pratidravyaM dashapalAni” iti| harItakIsahasramiti harItakIphalasahasram| shUrpaparNyau mudgamAShaparNyau| vIrA jAlandharaM shAkam| kUrcanaM jarjarIkaraNasAdhanaM shilAputrakamusalAdi| vinIyeti prakShipya| plavaH kaivartamustakam| kanakaM nAgakesharam| tvak guDatvak| audumbare iti tAmramaye| snehArdhamiti sarpistailArdham| ekam anaparAhNikamAhAram||41-57||

piShTasvedanavidhineti yathA piShTakaM toyaparipUritapAtroparidattatRuNAdisaMsthitaM svedyate, tathA tat svedanIyamityarthaH| svarasaparipItamiti svarasabhAvitam| brahmasuvarcalAdyauShadhAnyAyurvedasamutthAnIye vakShyamANAni| yuvatiH navamAlikA| aShTamo bhAgo~aShTabhAgaH| kShudraguDAkRutimiti phANitAkRutim| ardhakarShavRuddhyeti ardhakarShAtprabhRuti vardhayet| yathoktavidhineti kuTIprAveshikena vidhinA| yathoktAn guNAniti pUrvaprayogaphalashrutipaThitAn| dharaNIdharasAra iti uShTramukhavat; tena dharaNIdharAH parvatAH, teShAM sAro lauhaM, tadvatsAra ityarthaH| aviShamiti viShamavikAri||58-61||

parNyashcatasra iti shAlaparNI, pRushniparNI, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI ca| tAmalakI bhUmyAmalakI| kAkanAsA nAsAphalA, ‘kAkatuNDaka’ ityanye| gatarasatvamiha dravyANAM caturbhAgasthitajale bhavati| niShkulamiti nirasthi| tailasarpiShoriti samAsanirdeshAdubhAbhyAmeva dvAdashapalAni, na pRuthak pRuthak| matsyaNDikA khaNDasaMhatiH| atra ShaTpalatvena samayorapi madhusarpiShordravyAntarayuktatvenAviruddhatvam||62-74||

bheShajaprasa~ggAdabheShajadvaividhyamAha- abheShajamityAdi| bAdhanamiha tadAtvamAtrabAdhakaM, yathA- svalpamapathyam| sAnubAdhanaM ca dIrghakAlAvasthAyikuShThAdivikArakAri||- dvividhaM bheShajamuktaM vibhajate- svasthasyetyAdi| tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanaM prAya iti cchedaH| yadvRuShyaM prAyo bhavati, tathA rasAyanaM yat prAyo bhavati, Artasya rogaharaM yadbAhulyena, tat svasthorjaskaramucyate; yattu dvitIyamArtarogaharaM, tat prAyeNa jvarAdishamanaM rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavati; yathA- kShatakShINoktaM sarpirguDAdi rasAyanaM vRuShyaM ca bhavati, tathA pANDurogokto yogarAjo rasAyanatvenoktaH, tathA kAsAdhikAre~agastyaharItakI rasAyanatvenoktetyAdyanusaraNIyam| rasAyanoktAnAM ca jvarAdiharatvamatra suvyaktameva rasAyanagrantheShu| anye tu bruvate- yadvyAdhimAtraharaM na tadrasAyanaM, kintu sharIrasaMyogadArDhyAddIrghAyuHkartRutvasAdhAraNadharmayogAdupacaritavyAdhiharaM rasAyanamihocyata iti| nanu yadi svasthorjaskaramapi vyAdhiharaM, vyAdhiharaM ca svasthorjaskaraM tat kiM ki~jciditi padena bheShajakarmavyavasthAdarshakena kriyate? brUmaH- bAhulyena svasthorjaskaratvaM vyAdhiharatvaM ca vyavasthApyate, na ceha sarvArtarogaharasya svasthorjaskaratvamiti pratij~jAyate, yena pAThAsaptaparNAdInAmapi rasAyanatvaM sAdhanIyashaktitvAdArttarogaharatvena yaducyate tadapi rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca bhavatIti lavamAtropadarshanaM kriyate, tat svasthArtayorubhayArthakartRutvam| prAyaHshabdatAtparyaM vivRuNoti- prAya ityAdi| visheShArtha iti bAhulyArtha ityarthaH||5-6||

rasAyanakAryamAha- dIrghamityAdi| prabhAdInAM trayANAmaudAryaM yojanIyam| vAksiddhiH yaducyate tadavashyaM bhavatItyarthaH| praNatiH lokavandyatA| kathametadrasAyanena kriyata ityAha- lAbhetyAdi| rasAdigrahaNena smRutyAdayo~api gRuhyante||7-8||

vAjIkaraNakAryamAha- apatyetyAdi| apatyasantAnaH apatyaparamparA, tena putrapautrakaramityarthaH; vAjIkaraNajanitAcchukrAjjAtaH putraH putrajananasamartho bhavatItyarthaH| atipriyatvaM cehopacitashukratayA nirantaravyavAyakartRutvAt; yaduktaM- “virUpamapi yoddhAraM bhRutyamicchanti pArthivAH| vyavAyavyAyataM mUrkhaM dhRuShTaM patimiva striyaH” iti| upacIyata iti puShTiM prApnoti| akShayamivAkShayam| phalavaditi garbhajanakam| caityo devatAyatanam| arcyaH arcanIyaH | AnantyamivAnantyaM; dIrghasantAnatAmityarthaH||9-12||

cikitsita iti jvarAdicikitsite| nanu rasAyanavAjIkaraNe api jvarAdicikitsite eva, tat kiM vishiShyocyate- ‘vakShyate taccikitsite’ ityAha- cikitsitArtha ityAdi| satyaM, rasAyanaM vAjIkaraNaM ca jvarAdivyAdhiharatvAccikitsitashabdenocyata ityarthaH| atha vyAdhiharatvAccikitsite vaktavyatvAcca rasAyanavAjIkaraNe kva nu vaktavye ityAha- rasAyanetyAdi| vidhiH vidhAnaM rasAyanAbhidhAnamityarthaH | agre iti anantaram| vAjIkaraNaM cAgre ‘abhidhAsyate’ iti sheShaH||13-14||
athAtaH prANakAmIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

prANakAmAH shushrUShadhvamidamucyamAnamamRutamivAparamaditisutahitakaramacintyAdbhutaprabhAvamAyuShyamArogyakaraM vayasaH sthApanaM nidrAtandrAshramaklamAlasyadaurbalyApaharamanilakaphapittasAmyakaraM sthairyakaramabaddhamAMsaharamantaragnisandhukShaNaM prabhAvarNasvarottamakaraM rasAyanavidhAnam| anena cyavanAdayo maharShayaH punaryuvatvamApurnArINAM ceShTatamA babhUvuH, sthirasamasuvibhaktamAMsAH, susaMhatasthirasharIrAH, suprasannabalavarNendriyAH, sarvatrApratihataparAkramAH, kleshasahAshca| sarve sharIradoShA bhavanti grAmyAhArAdamlalavaNakaTukakShArashuShkashAkamAMsatilapalalapiShTAnnabhojinAM virUDhanavashUkashamIdhAnyaviruddhAsAtmyarUkShakShArAbhiShyandibhojinAM klinnagurupUtiparyuShitabhojinAM viShamAdhyashanaprAyANAM divAsvapnastrImadyanityAnAM viShamAtimAtravyAyAmasa~gkShobhitasharIrANAM bhayakrodhashokalobhamohAyAsabahulAnAm; atonimittaM hi shithilIbhavanti mAMsAni, vimucyante sandhayaH, vidahyate raktaM, viShyandate cAnalpaM medaH, na sandhIyate~asthiShu majjA, shukraM na pravartate, kShayamupaityojaH; sa evambhUto glAyati, sIdati, nidrAtandrAlasyasamanvito nirutsAhaH shvasiti, asamarthashceShTAnAM shArIramAnasInAM, naShTasmRutibuddhicchAyo rogANAmadhiShThAnabhUto na sarvamAyuravApnoti| tasmAdetAn doShAnavekShamANaH sarvAn yathoktAnahitAnapAsyAhAravihArAn rasAyanAni prayoktumarhatItyuktvA bhagavAn punarvasurAtreya uvAca-||3||

AmalakAnAM subhUmijAnAM kAlajAnAmanupahatagandhavarNarasAnAmApUrNarasapramANavIryANAM svarasena punarnavAkalkapAdasamprayuktena sarpiShaH sAdhayedADhakam, ataH paraM vidArIsvarasena jIvantIkalkasamprayuktena, ataH paraM caturguNena payasA balAtibalAkaShAyeNa shatAvarIkalkasaMyuktena; anena krameNaikaikaM shatapAkaM sahasrapAkaM vA sharkarAkShaudracaturbhAgasamprayuktaM sauvarNe rAjate mArtike vA shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe sthApayet; tadyathoktena vidhinA yathAgni prAtaH prAtaH prayojayet, jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamashnIyAt| asya prayogAdvarShashataM vayo~ajaraM tiShThati, shrutamavatiShThate, sarvAmayAH prashAmyanti, apratihatagatiH strIShu, apatyavAn bhavatIti||4||
bhavatashcAtra- bRuhaccharIraM girisArasAraM sthirendriyaM cAtibalendriyaM ca| adhRuShyamanyairatikAntarUpaM prashastipUjAsukhacittabhAk ca||5||
balaM mahadvarNavishuddhiragryA svaro ghanaughastanitAnukArI| bhavatyapatyaM vipulaM sthiraM ca samashnato yogamimaM narasya||6||

AmalakasahasraM pippalIsahasrasamprayuktaM palAshataruNakShArodakottaraM tiShThet, tadanugatakShArodakamanAtapashuShkamanasthi cUrNIkRutaM caturguNAbhyAM madhusarpirbhyAM sannIya sharkarAcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM ghRutabhAjanasthaM ShaNmAsAn sthApayedantarbhUmeH| tasyottarakAlamagnibalasamAM mAtrAM khAdet, paurvAhNikaH prayogo nAparAhNikaH, sAtmyApekShashcAhAravidhiH| asya prayogAdvarShashatamajaraM vayastiShThatIti samAnaM pUrveNa||7||

Commentary: palAshataruNaH taruNapalAshaH; anena bAlavRuddhapalAshavarjanamucyate| kShArodakottaramiti yathA kShArodakaM bhAvyAdupari bhavati tathA kartavyamiti darshayati| caturbhAgaH pAdaH| samAnaM pUrveNeti pUrvayogaphalashrutyaitadapi yuktamityarthaH||7||

AmalakacUrNADhakamekaviMshatirAtramAmalakasvarasaparipItaM madhughRutADhakAbhyAM dvAbhyAmekIkRutamaShTabhAgapippalIkaM sharkarAcUrNacaturbhAgasamprayuktaM ghRutabhAjanasthaM prAvRuShi bhasmarAshau nidadhyAt; tadvarShAnte sAtmyapathyAshI prayojayet; asya prayogAdvarShashatamajaramAyustiShThatIti samAnaM pUrveNa||8||

Commentary: varShAnte varShAkAlAnte||8||

viDa~ggataNDulacUrNAnAmADhakamADhakaM pippalItaNDulAnAmadhyardhADhakaM sitopalAyAH sarpistailamadhvADhakaiH ShaDbhirekIkRutaM ghRutabhAjanasthaM prAvRuShi bhasmarAshAviti sarvaM samAnaM pUrveNa yAvadAshIH||9||

Commentary: yAvadAshIriti AshIH phalashrutiH; tena ‘tadvarShAnte’ ityAdigranthoktavidhividhAnaM darshayati||9||

yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAM sahasramArdrapalAshadroNyAM sapidhAnAyAM bAShpamanudvamantyAmAraNyagomayAgnibhirupasvedayet, tAni susvinnashItAnyuddhRutakulakAnyApothyADhakena pippalIcUrNAnAmADhakena ca viDa~ggataNDulacUrNAnAmadhyardhena cADhakena sharkarAyA dvAbhyAM dvAbhyAmADhakAbhyAM tailasya madhunaH sarpiShashca saMyojya shucau dRuDhe ghRutabhAvite kumbhe sthApayedekaviMshatirAtram, ata UrdhvaM prayogaH; asya prayogAdvarShashatamajaramAyustiShThatIti samAnaM pUrveNa||10||

Commentary: pUrveNeti pUrvayogaphalashrutiparyantaM pUrvayogenAsya samAnamityarthaH||10||

dhanvani kushAstIrNe snigdhakRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNavarNamRuttike vA vyapagataviShashvApadapavanasalilAgnidoShe karShaNavalmIkashmashAnacaityoSharAvasathavarjite deshe yathartusukhapavanasalilAdityasevite jAtAnyanupahatAnyanadhyArUDhAnyabAlAnyajIrNAnyadhigatavIryANi shIrNapurANaparNAnyasa~jjAtAnyaparNAni tapasi tapasye vA mAse shuciH prayataH kRutadevArcanaH svasti vAcayitvA dvijAtIn cale sumuhUrte nAgabalAmUlAnyuddharet, teShAM suprakShAlitAnAM tvakpiNDamAmramAtramakShamAtraM vA shlakShNapiShTamAloDya payasA prAtaH prayojayet, cUrNIkRutAni vA pibet payasA, madhusarpirbhyAM vA saMyojya bhakShayet, jIrNe ca kShIrasarpirbhyAM shAliShaShTikamashnIyAt| saMvatsaraprayogAdasya varShashatamajaraM vayastiShThatIti samAnaM pUrveNa||11||

Commentary: dhanvanIti jA~ggaladeshe| karShaNaM halAdinA| anadhyArUDhAnIti na mahatA pArshvasthena vRukSheNAkrAntAni| tapasi mAghe| tapasye iti phAlgune| cale sumuhUrta iti indre muhUrte| AmnamAtramiti palaparimANam||11||

balAtibalAcandanAgurudhavatinishakhadirashiMshapAsanasvarasAH punarnavAntAshcauShadhayo dasha nAgabalayA vyAkhyAtAH| svarasAnAmalAbhe tvayaM svarasavidhiH- cUrNAnAmADhakamADhakamudakasyAhorAtrasthitaM mRuditapUtaM svarasavat prayojyam||12||

bhallAtakAnyanupahatAnyanAmayAnyApUrNarasapramANavIryANi pakvajAmbavaprakAshAni shucau shukre vA mAse sa~ggRuhya yavapalle mAShapalle vA nidhApayet, tAni caturmAsasthitAni sahasi sahasye vA mAse prayoktumArabheta shItasnigdhamadhuropaskRutasharIraH| pUrvaM dashabhallAtakAnyApothyAShTaguNenAmbhasA sAdhu sAdhayet, teShAM rasamaShTabhAgAvasheShaM pUtaM sapayaskaM pibet sarpiShA~antarmukhamabhyajya| tAnyekaikabhallAtakotkarShApakarSheNa dashabhallAtakAnyAtriMshataH prayojyAni, nAtaH paramutkarShaH| prayogavidhAnena sahasrapara eva bhallAtakaprayogaH| jIrNe ca sasarpiShA payasA shAliShaShTikAshanamupacAraH, prayogAnte ca dvistAvat payasaivopacAraH| tatprayogAdvarShashatamajaraM vayastiShThatIti samAnaM pUrveNa||13||

Commentary: shuciH jyeShThaH, shukrastu AShADhaH, saha AgrahAyaNaH, sahasyaH pauShaH| etacca bhallAtakaM mAsacatuShTayasthitaM yavapallAdau uddhRutamAtraM na prayojyaM, kintu yathokta eva kAle shItaguNayukte| mukhadAhaparihArArthaM sarpiShA~antarmukhamabhyajyeti| nAtaH paramiti triMshataH pareNa prayogo na bhallAtakasya| sahasraparo bhallAtakaprayoga iti upayuktabhallAtakasampiNDanayA yadA sahasraM pUryate tadaivoparamaH kartavyaH, sahasrAdarvAgapi ca prayogaparityAgaH prakRutyAdyapekShayA bhavatyeva| sahasrasa~gkhyApUraNaM cehaikena vardhanahrAsakrameNa na bhavati, tena punarAvRuttyA ca triMshatparyantaM prayogaH kartavyaH, yathA hi bhallAtakaprayogAbhyAsena sahasrasa~gkhyApUraNaM bhavati tathA kRutvA parityAgaH kartavyaH| anye tvatra sushrute arshashcikitsitoktashataparyantaM bhallAtakaprayogeNa samaM virodhaM pashyantaH sushrutaprayogasyApyanyathA vyAkhyAnena triMshatkamAtraM prayogamicchanti; tacca vyAkhyAnaM nAtisa~ggatam| ki~jca sahasradvayasya tatropayogo vihitaH, atra sahasraparyantaH prayogaH; tena vyAdhiviShayo~anya eva sa prayogaH, ayaM tu rasAyanaviShayaH||13||

bhallAtakAnAM jarjarIkRutAnAM piShTasvedanaM pUrayitvA bhUmAvAkaNThaM nikhAtasya snehabhAvitasya dRuDhasyopari kumbhasyAropyoDupenApidhAya kRuShNamRuttikAvaliptaM gomayAgnibhirupasvedayet; teShAM yaH svarasaH kumbhaM prapadyeta, tamaShTabhAgamadhusamprayuktaM dviguNaghRutamadyAt; tatprayogAdvarShashatamajaraM vayastiShThatIti samAnaM pUrveNa||14||

Commentary: piShTasvedanaM tat, yatrasthaM piShTakamupasvedyate; tadupari yat pidhAnapAtraM tacceha sacchidraM grAhyam, anyathoparisthabhallAtakatApAccyutaH sneho nAdho yAti||14||

bhallAtakatailapAtraM sapayaskaM madhukena kalkenAkShamAtreNa shatapAkaM kuryAditi samAnaM pUrveNa||15||

Commentary: bhallAtakatailamiti anantaroktavidhAnena gRuhIto bhallAtakasnehaH||15||

bhallAtakasarpiH , bhallAtakakShIraM, bhallAtakakShaudraM, guDabhallAtakaM, bhallAtakayUShaH, bhallAtakatailaM, bhallAtakapalalaM, bhallAtakasaktavaH, bhallAtakalavaNaM, bhallAtakatarpaNam, iti bhallAtakavidhAnamuktaM bhavati||16||

Commentary: bhallAtakasarpirityAdayo dashaprayogAH| atra ca yathAyogyatayA bhallAtakena sarpirAdInAM saMskAraH saMyogashca j~jeyaH| yaduktaM jatUkarNe- “bhallAtakasaMyuktasaMskRutAni ca ghRutakShIrakShaudraguDayUShatailapalalasaktulavaNatarpaNAni” iti| evaM ca sarpiHkShIrayUShatailAnAM saMskAro yathAnyAyaM bhallAtakena, kShaudrapalalasaktutarpaNAnAM bhallAtakena yogaH, guDalavaNayostu saMskAraH saMyogo vA| lavaNe saMskArapakShe hi lavaNasamaM bhallAtakamantardhUmadagdhaM grAhyam| anye tu sarpirAdInAM sarveShAmeva bhallAtakena saMskAraM vyAkhyAnayanti| iha saktuprayogo~adravottaratvAdivisheShakarmaNA bhedanIyaH||16||
bhavanti cAtra- bhallAtakAni tIkShNAni pAkInyagnisamAni ca| bhavantyamRutakalpAni prayuktAni yathAvidhi||17||
ete dashavidhAstveShAM prayogAH parikIrtitAH| rogaprakRutisAtmyaj~jastAn prayogAn prakalpayet||18||
kaphajo na sa rogo~asti na vibandho~asti kashcana| yaM na bhallAtakaM hanyAcchIghraM medhAgnivardhanam||19||
(iti bhallAtakavidhiH)prANakAmAH purA jIrNAshcyavanAdyA maharShayaH| rasAyanaiH shivairetairbabhUvuramitAyuShaH||20||
brAhmaM tapo brahmacaryamadhyAtmadhyAnameva ca| dIrghAyuSho yathAkAmaM sambhRutya tridivaM gatAH||21||
tasmAdAyuHprakarShArthaM prANakAmaiH sukhArthibhiH| rasAyanavidhiH sevyo vidhivatsusamAhitaiH||22||

tatra shlokaH- rasAyanAnAM saMyogAH siddhA bhUtahitaiShiNA| nirdiShTAH prANakAmIye saptatriMshanmaharShiNA ||23||

Commentary: pAdAnusa~ggrahe saptatriMshatprayogA uktAH; tatra balAdibhiraShTAbhiH punarnavAntaishca dashabhiraShTAdashaprayogAH, apare tu vyAhRutA vyaktA eva||23||

(iti nAgabalArasAyanam)

Commentary: punarnavAntA dasha ShaDvirecanashatAshritIye “amRutA~abhayA dhAtrI mu(yu)ktA shreyasI shvetA~atirasA maNDUkaparNI sthirA punarnavA” (sU.a.4) iti sarvA vayaHsthApanoktAH| nAgabalayA vyAkhyAtA iti nAgabalAvatteShAmapi prayogaH| balAdInAM svarasenaiva vidhAnam| nAgabalAvadbhojanAdikaM j~jeyam| svarasAlAbhe~anukalpamAha- svarasAnAmityAdi|| 12||
(ityAmalakaghRutam)
pUrvapAde hyAmalakarasAyanAnyuktAni, ihApyAmalakarasAyanAni santIti prANakAmIyamanantaramucyate| prANakAmashabdamadhikRutya kRutamiti prANakAmIyam||1-2||

ekaikashaH shatapAkamityarthaH| ekaikapAkasAdhanaM pRuthak kartavyaM; tena trishatadhA pAko bhavati| atra ca kalkopalepAdinopakShINamapi yadavashiShTaM bhavati tadeva grAhyaM, vacanabalAt| sauvarNAdipAtreShu yathApUrvaM varaguNatvam, anyathA samAnaguNatve sarveShAM mRutpAtrasya sulabhatvenAtidurlabhataraM sauvarNapAtraM nopadeshamarhati| yathoktena vidhineti kuTIprAveshikena| girisAraH loham||4-6||
agnisamAnIti dAhasphoTakartRutayA| sambhRutyeti niShpAdya||17-22||
iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM cikitsitasthAne rasAyanAdhyAye prANakAmIyo nAma rasAyanapAdo dvitIyaH||2||
athAtaH karapracitIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
jaraNAnte~abhayAmekAM prAgbhuktAd dve bibhItake| bhuktvA tu madhusarpirbhyAM catvAryAmalakAni ca||41||
prayojayan samAmekAM triphalAyA rasAyanam| jIvedvarShashataM pUrNamajaro~avyAdhireva ca||42||
(iti triphalArasAyanam)traiphalenAyasIM pAtrIM kalkenAlepayennavAm| tamahorAtrikaM lepaM pibet kShaudrodakAplutam||43||
prabhUtasnehamashanaM jIrNe tatra prashasyate| ajaro~aruk samAbhyAsAjjIveccaiva samAH shatam||44||
(iti triphalArasAyanamaparam)madhukena tugAkShIryA pippalyA kShaudrasarpiShA| triphalA sitayA cApi yuktA siddhaM rasAyanam||45||
(iti triphalArasAyanamaparam)sarvalauhaiH suvarNena vacayA madhusarpiShA| viDa~ggapippalIbhyAM ca triphalA lavaNena ca||46||
saMvatsaraprayogeNa medhAsmRutibalapradA| bhavatyAyuHpradA dhanyA jarAroganibarhaNI||47||
(iti triphalArasAyanamaparam)
anamlaM ca kaShAyaM ca kaTu pAke shilAjatu| nAtyuShNashItaM dhAtubhyashcaturbhyastasya sambhavaH||48||
hemnashca rajatAttAmrAdvarAt kRuShNAyasAdapi| rasAyanaM tadvidhibhistadvRuShyaM tacca roganut||49||
vAtapittakaphaghnaishca niryUhaistat subhAvitam| vIryotkarShaM paraM yAti sarvairekaikasho~api vA||50||
prakShiptoddhRutamapyenat punastat prakShipedrase| koShNe saptAhametena vidhinA tasya bhAvanA||51||
pUrvoktena vidhAnena lohaishcUrNIkRutaiH saha| tat pItaM payasA dadyAddIrghamAyuH sukhAnvitam||52||
jarAvyAdhiprashamanaM dehadArDhyakaraM param| medhAsmRutikaraM dhanyaM kShIrAshI tat prayojayet||53||
prayogaH saptasaptAhAstrayashcaikashca saptakaH| nirdiShTastrividhastasya paro madhyo~avarastathA||54||
jAtervisheShaM savidhiM tasya vakShyAmyataH param||55||
hemAdyAH sUryasantaptAH sravanti giridhAtavaH| jatvAbhaM mRudu mRutsnAcchaM yanmalaM tacchilAjatu||56||
madhurashca satiktashca japApuShpanibhashca yaH| kaTurvipAke shItashca sa suvarNasya nisravaH||57||
rUpyasya kaTukaH shvetaH shItaH svAdu vipacyate| tAmrasya barhikaNThAbhastiktoShNaH pacyate kaTu||58||
yastu guggulukAbhAsastiktako lavaNAnvitaH| kaTurvipAke shItashca sarvashreShThaH sa cAyasaH||59||
gomUtragandhayaH sarve sarvakarmasu yaugikAH| rasAyanaprayogeShu pashcimastu vishiShyate||60||
yathAkramaM vAtapitte shleShmapitte kaphe triShu| visheShataH prashasyante malA hemAdidhAtujAH||61||
shilAjatuprayogeShu vidAhIni gurUNi ca| varjayet sarvakAlaM tu kulatthAn parivarjayet||62||
te hyatyantaviruddhatvAdashmano bhedanAH param| loke dRuShTAstatasteShAM prayogaH pratiShidhyate||63||
payAMsi takrANi rasAH sayUShAstoyaM samUtrA vividhAH kaShAyAH| AloDanArthaM girijasya shastAste te prayojyAH prasamIkShya kAryam||64||
na so~asti rogo bhuvi sAdhyarUpaH shilAhvayaM yaM na jayet prasahya| tat kAlayogairvidhibhiH prayuktaM svasthasya corjAM vipulAM dadAti||65||
(iti shilAjaturasAyanam)tatra shlokaH- karapracitike pAde dasha ShaT ca maharShiNA| rasAyanAnAM siddhAnAM saMyogAH samudAhRutAH||66||

karapracitAnAM yathoktaguNAnAmAmalakAnAmuddhRutAsthnAM shuShkacUrNitAnAM punarmAghe phAlgune vA mAse triHsaptakRutvaH svarasaparipItAnAM punaH shuShkacUrNIkRutAnAmADhakamekaM grAhayet, atha jIvanIyAnAM bRuMhaNIyAnAM stanyajananAnAM shukrajananAnAM vayaHsthApanAnAM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAnAmauShadhagaNAnAM candanAgurudhavatinishakhadirashiMshapAsanasArANAM cANushaH kRuttAnAmabhayAbibhItakapippalIvacAcavyacitrakaviDa~ggAnAM ca samastAnAmADhakamekaM dashaguNenAmbhasA sAdhayet, tasminnADhakAvasheShe rase supUte tAnyAmalakacUrNAni dattvA gomayAgnibhirvaMshavidalasharatejanAgnibhirvA sAdhayedyAvadapanayAdrasasya, tamanupadagdhamupahRutyAyasIShu pAtrIShvAstIrya shoShayet, sushuShkaM tat kRuShNAjinasyopari dRuShadi shlakShNapiShTamayaHsthAlyAM nidhApayet samyak, taccUrNamayashcUrNAShTabhAgasamprayuktaM madhusarpirbhyAmagnibalamabhisamIkShya prayojayediti||3||
bhavanti cAtra- etadrasAyanaM pUrvaM vasiShThaH kashyapo~a~ggirAH| jamadagnirbharadvAjo bhRuguranye ca tadvidhAH||4||
prayujya prayatA muktAH shramavyAdhijarAbhayAt| yAvadaicchaMstapastepustatprabhAvAnmahAbalAH||5||
idaM rasAyanaM cakre brahmA vArShasahasrikam| jarAvyAdhiprashamanaM buddhIndriyabalapradam||6||
(ityAmalakAyasaM brAhmarasAyanam) tapasA brahmacaryeNa dhyAnena prashamena ca| rasAyanavidhAnena kAlayuktena cAyuShA||7||
sthitA maharShayaH pUrvaM, nahi ki~jcidrasAyanam| grAmyAnAmanyakAryANAM sidhyatyaprayatAtmanAm||8||
saMvatsaraM payovRuttirgavAM madhye vaset sadA| sAvitrIM manasA dhyAyan brahmacArI yatendriyaH||9||
saMvatsarAnte pauShIM vA mAghIM vA phAlgunIM tithim| tryahopavAsI shuklasya pravishyAmalakIvanam||10||
bRuhatphalADhyamAruhya drumaM shAkhAgataM phalam| gRuhItvA pANinA tiShThejjapan brahmAmRutAgamAt||11||
tadA hyavashyamamRutaM vasatyAmalake kShaNam| sharkarAmadhukalpAni snehavanti mRudUni ca||12||
bhavantyamRutasaMyogAttAni yAvanti bhakShayet| jIvedvarShasahasrANi tAvantyAgatayauvanaH||13||
sauhityameShAM gatvA tu bhavatyamarasannibhaH| svayaM cAsyopatiShThante shrIrvedA vAk ca rUpiNI||14||
(ityaindraM rasAyanam)
triphalAyA rase mUtre gavAM kShAre ca lavaNe| krameNa ce~ggudIkShAre kiMshukakShAra eva ca||15||
tIkShNAyasasya patrANi vahnivarNAni sAdhayet | catura~gguladIrghANi tilotsedhatanUni ca||16||
j~jAtvA tAnya~jjanAbhAni sUkShmacUrNAni kArayet| tAni cUrNAni madhunA rasenAmalakasya ca||17||
yuktAni lehavat kumbhe sthitAni ghRutabhAvite| saMvatsaraM nidheyAni yavapalle tathaiva ca||18||
dadyAdAloDanaM mAse sarvatrAloDayan budhaH| saMvatsarAtyaye tasya prayogo madhusarpiShA||19||
prAtaH prAtarbalApekShI sAtmyaM jIrNe ca bhojanam| eSha eva ca lauhAnAM prayogaH samprakIrtitaH||20||
nAbhighAtairna cAta~gkairjarayA na ca mRutyunA| sa dhRuShyaH syAdgajaprANaH sadA cAtibalendriyaH||21||
dhImAn yashasvI vAksiddhaH shrutadhArI mahAdhanaH | bhavet samAM prayu~jjAno naro lauharasAyanam||22||
anenaiva vidhAnena hemnashca rajatasya ca| AyuHprakarShakRutsiddhaH prayogaH sarvaroganut||23||
(iti lauhAdirasAyanam)
aindrI matsyAkhyako brAhmI vacA brahmasuvarcalA| pippalyo lavaNaM hema sha~gkhapuShpI viShaM ghRutam||24||
eShAM triyavakAn bhAgAn hemasarpirviShairvinA| dvau yavau tatra hemnastu tilaM dadyAdviShasya ca||25||
sarpiShashca palaM dadyAttadaikadhyaM prayojayet| ghRutaprabhUtaM sakShaudraM jIrNe cAnnaM prashasyate||26||
jarAvyAdhiprashamanaM smRutimedhAkaraM param| AyuShyaM pauShTikaM dhanyaM svaravarNaprasAdanam||27||
paramojaskaraM caitat siddhamaindraM rasAyanam| nainat prasahate kRutyA nAlakShmIrna viShaM na ruk||28||
shvitraM sakuShThaM jaTharANi gulmAH plIhA purANo viShamajvarashca| medhAsmRutij~jAnaharAshca rogAH shAmyantyanenAtibalAshca vAtAH||29||
maNDUkaparNyAH svarasaH prayojyaH kShIreNa yaShTImadhukasya cUrNam| raso guDUcyAstu samUlapuShpyAH kalkaH prayojyaH khalu sha~gkhapuShpyAH||30||
AyuHpradAnyAmayanAshanAni balAgnivarNasvaravardhanAni| medhyAni caitAni rasAyanAni medhyA visheSheNa ca sha~gkhapuShpI||31||
(iti medhyarasAyanAni)
pa~jcAShTau sapta dasha vA pippalIrmadhusarpiShA| rasAyanaguNAnveShI samAmekAM prayojayet||32||
tisrastisrastu pUrvAhNe bhuktvA~agre bhojanasya ca| pippalyaH kiMshukakShArabhAvitA ghRutabharjitAH||33||
prayojyA madhusammishrA rasAyanaguNaiShiNA| jetuM kAsaM kShayaM shoShaM shvAsaM hikkAM galAmayAn||34||
arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM pANDutAM viShamajvaram| vaisvaryaM pInasaM shophaM gulmaM vAtabalAsakam||35||
(iti pippalIrasAyanam)
kramavRuddhyA dashAhAni dashapaippalikaM dinam| vardhayet payasA sArdhaM tathaivApanayet punaH||36||
jIrNe jIrNe ca bhu~jjIta ShaShTikaM kShIrasarpiShA| pippalInAM sahasrasya prayogo~ayaM rasAyanam||37||
piShTAstA balibhiH sevyAH, shRutA madhyabalairnaraiH| cUrNIkRutA hrasvabalairyojyA doShAmayAn prati||38||
dashapaippalikaH shreShTho madhyamaH ShaT prakIrtitaH| prayogo yastriparyantaH sa kanIyAn sa cAbalaiH||39||
bRuhaNaM svaryamAyuShyaM plIhodaravinAshanam| vayasaH sthApanaM medhyaM pippalInAM rasAyanam||40||
(iti pippalIvardhamAnaM rasAyanam)
AmalakarasAyanatvasAmyAdanantaraM karapracitIya ucyate||1-2||

jaraNAnta ityAdau madhusarpirbhyAmiti abhayAM bibhItake AmalakAnItyanena ca yujyate| madhukenetyAdirekaH prayogaH| sarvalauhairityAdyaparaH| lauhairityukte suvarNe prApte suvarNenetipadaM lohatvenAbhiprasiddhasyAgrahaNanirAsArtham||41-47||

shilAjaturasAyanaM darshayituM shilAjatuno~abhyarhitasya guNAneva tAvadAha- anamlamityAdi| varAditi shreShThAt| sushrute yadyapi trapusIsabhavaM prakShipya ShaDvidhashilAjatu sAmAnyena roge rasAyanAdhikAre coktaM, tathA~apIha rasAyanAdhikAre tadadhikRutacaturvidhamevoktam||48-50||

shilAjatubhAvanAvidhimAha- prakShiptetyAdi| prakShiptAnantaramuddhRutaM prakShiptoddhRutam| lauhaiH saheti bhAgAniyame lohasamAnabhAgatA shilAjatunaH| prayogaH saptasaptAhA iti saptasaptAhavyApakaprayoga ityarthaH; evaM trayashcaikashca saptaka ityatrApi boddhavyam||51-54||-

savidhimiti vidhAnasahitam| shilAjatuvidhAnaM ca yathAkramaM ‘vAtapitte’ ityAdigranthena vaktavyam| hemAdishabdeneha hemAdisambhavasthAnabhUtashilocyate, yato na sAkShAt suvarNAdibhya eva shilAjatu sravati| mRutsnaM masRuNam, acchaM svaccham| yastu rUpyabhave kaTurase viruddhaH svAduH pAka uktaH sa utsargApavAdanyAyena j~jeyaH| vIryaM tu tAmrabhavasyoShNasya tathA trayANAM ca shItatvayuktAnAmatyuShNashItavIryatAyA avakAsho nAsti, ataH sAmAnyaguNakathane nAtyuShNashItamitipadena uShNasya shItasya ca vIryasya prakarSho niShidhyate; tenAnuShNAshItatvaM vidhIyate; tatashca shilAjatuni vIryaM shItamuShNaM vA~abhihitamapi na balavadbhavatIti labhyate||55-61||

shilAjatuprayogeShviti bahuvacanamAloDanAdibhedena prayogabhedaM buddhisthIkRutya j~jeyam| shilAjatuprayoge guruniShedhe~api visheShavacanAt kShIrAdiprayogaH| sarvakAlamiti yAvadrasAyanAhitA guNAH santi| kecittu yAvajjIvaM kulatthavarjanamAhuH; yaduktaM sushrute- “tadbhAvitaH kapotAMshca kulatthAMshca vivarjayet” (su.ci.a.13) iti| shilAjatuprayogaM stauti- na so~astItyAdi||62-66||

karapracitAnAmitipadaM svayampatitagrahaNaM niShedhayati| mAghe phAlgune vetigrahaNavacanAttathaiva gRuhItAnAmadhikAra ityAgamAdunnIyate| svarasa ihAmalakasyaiva bhavati, adhikArAt| shAkaH bRuhatpatrastaruH| kRuttAnAmiti cchinnAnAm| iha gomayAgnyAdyupakaraNaniyamenaiva shaktyutkarSho bhavatIti RuShivacanAdunnIyate| yaduktaM- “RuShayastveva jAnanti yogasaMyogajaM phalam” iti| evamanyatrApi itikartavyatAniyamo vyAkhyeyaH| kRuShNAjinasyeti kRuShNasArAjinasya||3-6||

samprati rasAyanasya tapobrahmacaryadhyAnAdiyuktasyaiva mahAphalatvaM bhavatIti darshayannAha- tapasetyAdi| kAlayuktena cAyuSheti aniyatakAlayuktena cAyuShetyarthaH, niyatakAlAyuShaM prati tu na rasAyanaM phalavadityuktameva| sthitA iti dIrghakAlajIvinaH| viparyayeNa tapaHprabhRutivirahe rasAyanasyAphalatAmAha- na hItyAdi||7-8||

brahmacAritvenendriyaniyame labdhe~api yatendriyapadasambandha indriyaniyamAtishayopadarshanArthaH| pauShAdiShu saMvatsarAntatvaM niyamadinAdArabhya varShapUraNena j~jeyam| phAlgunImityasyAnte prApyeti sheShaH| “na drumamArohet” (sU.a.8) ityasyeha Aruhya drumamiti vacanenApavAdaH| japan brahmeti o~gkAraM japan| amRutAgamAditi amRutAgamaparyantam| sauhityameShAmiti karaNe ShaShThI| vAgrUpiNIti tadadhiShThAtrI devatA||9-14||

kShAra iti parisrAvitakShArodake| kShAre lAvaNa iti jyotiShmatyAH kShAre| sAdhayediti nirvApayet| lauhAnAmityanenaiva lohAntarniviShTayoH suvarNarajatayorgrahaNe siddhe punastayorvacanaM tayorvisheSheNAdaropadarshanArtham| rasAyanaprabhAvAdeva mahAdhanatvamiti j~jeyam||15-23||
matsyAkhyako ‘macchu’ iti loke khyAtaH; anye tu aindrIbhedaM matsyAkhyakamAhuH| triyavakAniti triyavapramANAn | ghRutaprabhUtamityannavisheShaNam| kRutyA abhicAraH||24-29||
maNDUkaparNyA ityAdayashcatvAro yogAH||30-31||

pa~jcetyAdau sa~gkhyAvyatikrameNAnuktasa~gkhyAnAmapi pippalInAmupayogaM sUcayati| yadyapi “trINi dravyANi nAtyupayu~jjIta pippalIM kShAraM lavaNam” (vi.a.1) ityuktaM, tathA~apIha dravyAntarasaMyuktAnAM pippalInAmabhyAso na viruddhaH; kiMvA, uktapippalIrasAyanavyatirekeNotsargApavAdanyAyAt sa niShedho j~jeyaH| kiMshukaH palAshaH||32-35||

pippalIvardhamAnamAha- kramavRuddhyetyAdi| dashapippalyo yatra vardhante taddinaM dashapaippalikaM, tena pratyahaM dashapippalyo vardhanIyA ityarthaH; tatashconaviMshatidinairvRuddhihAnikrameNaikenaiva sahasraM pUrNaM bhavati| ‘cUrNIkRutA’ ityatra ‘shItIkRutA’ iti vA pAThaH| pippalIvardhamAnakramabhuktamutkRuShTaM darshayannaparamapi vardhamAnakramadvayaM madhyamatvAvaratvAbhyAmAha- dashetyAdi| ShaT prakIrtita iti ShaDvRuddhyA pUrvAcAryairuktaH| triparyanta ityasyAnte pippalItrayAvasthAnAt pippalItrikeNaiva vRuddhirbhavati, tato dashapippalIke dashaivAnte bhavanti||36-40||
athAta AyurvedasamutthAnIyaM rasAyanapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
yathAsthUlamanirvAhya doShA~jchArIramAnasAn| rasAyanaguNairjanturyujyate na kadAcana||36||
yogA hyAyuHprakarShArthA jarAroganibarhaNAH| manaHsharIrashuddhAnAM sidhyanti prayatAtmanAm||37||
tadetanna bhavedvAcyaM sarvameva hatAtmasu| arujebhyo~advijAtibhyaH shushrUShA yeShu nAsti ca||38||
ye rasAyanasaMyogA vRuShyayogAshca ye matAH| yaccauShadhaM vikArANAM sarvaM tadvaidyasaMshrayam||39||
prANAcAryaM budhastasmAddhImantaM vedapAragam| ashvinAviva devendraH pUjayedatishaktitaH||40||
ashvinau devabhiShajau yaj~javAhAviti smRutau| yaj~jasya hi shirashchinnaM punastAbhyAM samAhitam||41||
prashIrNA dashanAH pUShNo netre naShTe bhagasya ca| vajriNashca bhujastambhastAbhyAmeva cikitsitaH||42||
cikitsitashca shItAMshurgRuhIto rAjayakShmaNA| somAbhipatitashcandraH kRutastAbhyAM punaH sukhI||43||
bhArgavashcyavanaH kAmI vRuddhaH san vikRutiM gataH| vItavarNasvaropetaH kRutastAbhyAM punaryuvA||44||
etaishcAnyaishca bahubhiH karmabhirbhiShaguttamau| babhUvaturbhRushaM pUjyAvindrAdInAM mahAtmanAm||45||
grahAH stotrANi mantrANi tathA nAnAhavIMShi ca| dhUmrAshca pashavastAbhyAM prakalpyante dvijAtibhiH||46||
prAtashca savane somaM shakro~ashvibhyAM sahAshnute| sautrAmaNyAM ca bhagavAnashvibhyAM saha modate||47||
indrAgnI cAshvinau caiva stUyante prAyasho dvijaiH| stUyante vedavAkyeShu na tathA~anyA hi devatAH||48||
ajarairamaraistAvadvibudhaiH sAdhipairdhruvaiH| pUjyete prayatairevamashvinau bhiShajAviti||49||
mRutyuvyAdhijarAvashyairduHkhaprAyaiH sukhArthibhiH| kiM punarbhiShajo martyaiH pUjyAH syurnAtishaktitaH||50||
shIlavAnmatimAn yukto dvijAtiH shAstrapAragaH| prANibhirguruvat pUjyaH prANAcAryaH sa hi smRutaH||51||
vidyAsamAptau bhiShajo dvitIyA jAtirucyate| ashnute vaidyashabdaM hi na vaidyaH pUrvajanmanA||52||
vidyAsamAptau brAhmaM vA sattvamArShamathApi vA| dhruvamAvishati j~jAnAttasmAdvaidyo dvijaH smRutaH||53||
nAbhidhyAyenna cAkroshedahitaM na samAcaret| prANAcAryaM budhaH kashcidicchannAyuranitvaram||54||
cikitsitastu saMshrutya yo vA~asaMshrutya mAnavaH| nopAkaroti vaidyAya nAsti tasyeha niShkRutiH||55||
bhiShagapyAturAn sarvAn svasutAniva yatnavAn| AbAdhebhyo hi saMrakShedicchan dharmamanuttamam||56||
dharmArthaM cArthakAmArthamAyurvedo maharShibhiH| prakAshito dharmaparairicchadbhiH sthAnamakSharam||57||
nArthArthaM nApi kAmArthamatha bhUtadayAM prati| vartate yashcikitsAyAM sa sarvamativartate||58||
kurvate ye tu vRuttyarthaM cikitsApaNyavikrayam| te hitvA kA~jcanaM rAshiM pAMshurAshimupAsate||59||
dAruNaiH kRuShyamANAnAM gadairvaivasvatakShayam| chittvA vaivasvatAn pAshAn jIvitaM yaH prayacchati||60||
dharmArthadAtA sadRushastasya nehopalabhyate| na hi jIvitadAnAddhi dAnamanyadvishiShyate||61||
paro bhUtadayA dharma iti matvA cikitsayA| vartate yaH sa siddhArthaH sukhamatyantamashnute||62||
tatra shlokau- AyurvedasamutthAnaM divyauShadhividhiM shubham| amRutAlpAntaraguNaM siddhaM ratnarasAyanam||63||
siddhebhyo brahmacAribhyo yaduvAcAmareshvaraH| AyurvedasamutthAne tat sarvaM samprakAshitam||64||

RuShayaH khalu kadAcicchAlInA yAyAvarAshca grAmyauShadhyAhArAH santaH sAmpannikA mandaceShTA nAtikalyAshca prAyeNa babhUvuH| te sarvAsAmitikartavyatAnAmasamarthAH santo grAmyavAsakRutamAtmadoShaM matvA pUrvanivAsamapagatagrAmyadoShaM shivaM puNyamudAraM medhyamagamyamasukRutibhirga~ggAprabhavamamaragandharvakinnarAnucaritamanekaratnanicayamacintyAdbhutaprabhAvaM brahmarShishiddhacAraNAnucaritaM divyatIrthauShadhiprabhavamatisharaNyaM himavantamamarAdhipatiguptaM jagmurbhRugva~ggiro~atrivasiShThakashyapAgastyapulastyavAmadevAsitagautamaprabhRutayo maharShayaH||3||

Commentary: RuShINAM shAlInatvaM yAyAvaratvaM ca karmavisheShaparigrahAt| sampannamanu upayujyanta iti sAmpannikAH| nAtikalyA iti nAtinIrogAH| itikartavyatA vyApAraH| indraparyAyakathanaM stutyarthaM; stutishceyamindrasyAyuryedaprakAshakatvAt||3||

tAnindraH sahasradRugamaragururabravIt- svAgataM brahmavidAM j~jAnatapodhanAnAM brahmarShINAm| asti nanu vo glAniraprabhAvatvaM vaisvaryaM vaivarNyaM ca grAmyavAsakRutamasukhamasukhAnubandhaM ca; grAmyo hi vAso mUlamashastAnAM, tat kRutaH puNyakRudbhiranugrahaH prajAnAM, svasharIramavekShituM kAlaH kAlashcAyamAyurvedopadeshasya brahmarShINAm; AtmanaH prajAnAM cAnugrahArthamAyurvedamashvinau mahyaM prAyacchatAM, prajApatirashvibhyAM, prajApataye brahmA, prajAnAmalpamAyurjarAvyAdhibahulamasukhamasukhAnubandhamalpatvAdalpatapodamaniyamadAnAdhyayanasa~jcayaM matvA puNyatamamAyuHprakarShakaraM jarAvyAdhiprashamanamUrjaskaramamRutaM shivaM sharaNyamudAraM bhavanto mattaH shrotumarhatAthopadhArayituM prakAshayituM ca prajAnugrahArthamArShaM brahma ca prati maitrIM kAruNyamAtmanashcAnuttamaM puNyamudAraM brAhmamakShayaM karmeti||4||
tacchrutvA vibudhapativacanamRuShayaH sarva evAmaravaramRugbhistuShTuvuH, prahRuShTAshca tadvacanamabhinanandushceti||5||

athendrastadAyurvedAmRutamRuShibhyaH sa~gkramyovAca- etat sarvamanuShTheyam, ayaM ca shivaH kAlo rasAyanAnAM, divyAshcauShadhayo himavatprabhavAH prAptavIryAH; tadyathA- aindrI, brAhmI, payasyA, kShIrapuShpI, shrAvaNI, mahAshrAvaNI, shatAvarI, vidArI, jIvantI, punarnavA, nAgabalA, sthirA, vacA, chatrA, aticchatrA, medA, mahAmedA, jIvanIyAshcAnyAH payasA prayuktAH ShaNmAsAt paramAyurvayashca taruNamanAmayatvaM svaravarNasampadamupacayaM medhAM smRutimuttamabalamiShTAMshcAparAn bhAvAnAvahanti siddhAH||6||

Commentary: mahAshrAvaNI alambuShA| aticchatrA madhurikA||6||
(itIndroktaM rasAyanam)

brahmasuvarcalA nAmauShadhiryA hiraNyakShIrA puShkarasadRushapatrA, AdityaparNI nAmauShadhiryA ‘sUryakAntA’ iti vij~jAyate suvarNakShIrA sUryamaNDalAkArapuShpA ca, nArInAmauShadhiH ‘ashvabalA’ iti vij~jAyate yA balvajasadRushapatrA , kAShThagodhA nAmauShadhirgodhAkArA, sarpAnAmauShadhiH sarpAkArA, somo nAmauShadhirAjaH pa~jcadashaparvA sa soma iva hIyate vardhate ca, padmA nAmauShadhiH padmAkArA padmaraktA padmagandhA ca, ajA nAmauShadhiH ‘ajashRu~ggI’ iti vij~jAyate, nIlA nAmauShadhistu nIlakShIrA nIlapuShpA latApratAnabahuleti; AsAmoShadhInAM yAM yAmevopalabheta tasyAstasyAH svarasasya sauhityaM gatvA snehabhAvitAyAmArdrapalAshadroNyAM sapidhAnAyAM digvAsAH shayIta, tatra pralIyate, ShaNmAsena punaH sambhavati, tasyAjaM payaH pratyavasthApanaM; ShaNmAsena devatAnukArI bhavati vayovarNasvarAkRutibalaprabhAbhiH, svayaM cAsya sarvavAcogatAni prAdurbhavanti, divyaM cAsya cakShuH shrotraM ca bhavati, gatiryojanasahasraM dashavarShasahasrANyAyuranupadravaM ceti||7||

Commentary: brahmasuvarcalAprabhRutayo yathoktalakShaNA divyauShadhayo nAtiprasiddhAH| AdityaparNI sUryAvartameva deshavisheShajAtaM kecidvarNayanti| ashvabaleti j~jAyata iti RuShibhirevAnena nAmnA j~jAyate, na laukikaiH, lokAprasiddhatvAt| soma iva vardhate hIyata iti yathA somavRuddhikShayau, tathA tatkAlameva tasya vRuddhikShayau bhavataH| pralIyata iti druto bhavati, anye tu mUrcchatIti varNayanti| pratyavasthApanamiti AhArasevAyAM yojyamityarthaH| sarvavAcogatAni sarvavAkyavisheShAH||7||
bhavanti cAtra- divyAnAmoShadhInAM yaH prabhAvaH sa bhavadvidhaiH| shakyaH soDhumashakyastu syAt soDhumakRutAtmabhiH||8||
oShadhInAM prabhAveNa tiShThatAM sve ca karmaNi| bhavatAM nikhilaM shreyaH sarvamevopapatsyate||9||
vAnaprasthairgRuhasthaishca prayatairniyatAtmabhiH| shakyA oShadhayo hyetAH sevituM viShayAbhijAH||10||
yAstu kShetraguNaisteShAM madhyamena ca karmaNA| mRuduvIryatarAstAsAM vidhirj~jeyaH sa eva tu||11||
paryeShTuM tAH prayoktuM vA ye~asamarthAH sukhArthinaH| rasAyanavidhisteShAmayamanyaH prashasyate||12||
balyAnAM jIvanIyAnAM bRuMhaNIyAshca yA dasha| vayasaH sthApanAnAM ca khadirasyAsanasya ca||13||
kharjUrANAM madhUkAnAM mustAnAmutpalasya ca| mRudvIkAnAM viDa~ggAnAM vacAyAshcitrakasya ca||14||
shatAvaryAH payasyAyAH pippalyA jo~ggakasya ca| RudhdyA nAgabalAyAshca dvAradAyA dhavasya ca||15||
triphalAkaNTakAryoshca vidAryAshcandanasya ca| ikShUNAM sharamUlAnAM shrIparNyAstinishasya ca||16||
rasAH pRuthak pRuthaggrAhyAH palAshakShAra eva ca| eShAM palonmitAn bhAgAn payo gavyaM caturguNam||17||
dve pAtre tilatailasya dve ca gavyasya sarpiShaH| tat sAdhyaM sarvamekatra susiddhaM snehamuddharet||18||
tatrAmalakacUrNAnAmADhakaM shatabhAvitam| svarasenaiva dAtavyaM kShaudrasyAbhinavasya ca||19||
sharkarAcUrNapAtraM ca prasthamekaM pradApayet| tugAkShIryAH sapippalyAH sthApyaM sammUrcchitaM ca tat||20||
sucaukShe mArtike kumbhe mAsArdhaM ghRutabhAvite| mAtrAmagnisamAM tasya tata UrdhvaM prayojayet||21||
hematAmrapravAlAnAmayasaH sphaTikasya ca| muktAvaidUryasha~gkhAnAM cUrNAnAM rajatasya ca||22||
prakShipya ShoDashIM mAtrAM vihAyAyAsamaithunam| jIrNe jIrNe ca bhu~jjIta ShaShTikaM kShIrasarpiShA||23||
sarvarogaprashamanaM vRuShyamAyuShyamuttamam| sattvasmRutisharIrAgnibuddhIndriyabalapradam||24||
paramUrjaskaraM caiva varNasvarakaraM tathA| viShAlakShmIprashamanaM sarvavAcogatapradam||25||
siddhArthatAM cAbhinavaM vayashca prajApriyatvaM ca yashashca loke| prayojyamicchadbhiridaM yathAvadrasAyanaM brAhmamudAravIryam||26||
(itIndroktarasAyanamaparam)
samarthAnAmarogANAM dhImatAM niyatAtmanAm| kuTIpraveshaH kShaNinAM paricchadavatAM hitaH||27||
ato~anyathA tu ye teShAM sauryamArutiko vidhiH| tayoH shreShThataraH pUrvo vidhiH sa tu suduShkaraH||28||
rasAyanavidhibhraMshAjjAyeran vyAdhayo yadi| yathAsvamauShadhaM teShAM kAryaM muktvA rasAyanam||29||
satyavAdinamakrodhaM nivRuttaM madyamaithunAt| ahiMsakamanAyAsaM prashAntaM priyavAdinam||30||
japashaucaparaM dhIraM dAnanityaM tapasvinam| devagobrAhmaNAcAryaguruvRuddhArcane ratam||31||
AnRushaMsyaparaM nityaM nityaM karuNavedinam | samajAgaraNasvapnaM nityaM kShIraghRutAshinam||32||
deshakAlapramANaj~jaM yuktij~jamanaha~gkRutam| shastAcAramasa~gkIrNamadhyAtmapravaNendriyam||33||
upAsitAraM vRuddhAnAmAstikAnAM jitAtmanAm| dharmashAstraparaM vidyAnnaraM nityarasAyanam||34||
guNairetaiH samuditaiH prayu~gkte yo rasAyanam| rasAyanaguNAn sarvAn yathoktAn sa samashnute||35||
(ityAcArarasAyanam)
AyurvedasamutthAnIyo nAma rasAyanapAdaH pArisheShyAducyate| AyurvedasamutthAnamasminnastIti matvarthIyacchapratyayeNAyurvedasamutthAnIyaH||1-2||

manaHshuddhyaiva prayatAtmatAyAM labdhAyAM punastadabhidhAnamitaramAnasaguNeShu prayatAtmatAyA abhyarhitatopadarshanArtham| arujebhyo~advijAtibhyo yeShu ca puruSheShu shushrUShA nAsti teShu caitanna vAcyamiti yojanA||36-38||

samprati rasAyanAdisiddhirvaidyAdhInA, tena vaidyastutimArabhate- ya ityAdi| prANAcAryamityatra ‘prANivaryaM’ iti vA pAThaH; tatra prANinAM varyaH shreShThaH prANivaryaH| yaj~jaM vahata iti yaj~javAhau| etadyaj~javAhatvameva darshayati- dakShasya hItyAdi| pUShNaH sUryasya, bhago~api sUryabhedaH| somAbhipatita iti somAbhipatanayogena pIDita ityarthaH; ‘somAtipacita’ iti vA pAThaH, tatrApyatipacanena somapAnAtiyogaM darshayati| grahAH somapAnapAtrANi| stotrANi stavAH stAvakavA(Ru)caH; shastrANIti kecit, saMshasyate~aneneti kRutvA sAmaRugvyatiriktaM stotramAhuH; shastrANi astrANyeva, vaShaTyuktAni shastrANi ca yaj~je kalpyanta eva| dhUmrAshca pashava iti dhUmravarNapashavaH; evaMvarNAshca pashavaH shreShThA bhavanti| savana iti yaj~jasthAne| sautrAmaNI yaj~javisheShaH| atishaktita iti nijashakterapyatirekeNa||39-51||

vaidyashabdadvijashabdayoH pravRuttinimittamAha- vidyetyAdi| tena vidyAyogAd vaidyatvaM tathA vidyAsamAptilakShaNajanmanA dvijatvaM bhavatItyuktaM bhavati| brAhmaM vA ArShaM vA iti vikalpo vaidyavisheShAbhiprAyAdbhavati ; tayoryo naiShThikacikitsArthastasya brAhmam, itarasya tu lokAnugrAhiNa ArShamiti vyavasthA||52-54||

saMshrutyeti pratij~jAya| cikitsaiva paNyaM vikretavyamiti cikitsApaNyam| te hitvetyAdau dharmArthaM kriyamANacikitsA mahAphalatvena kA~jcanarAshitulyA, itarA tvasArakalpA pAMshurAshitulyA| vaivasvatakShayamiti yamagRuham||55-62||
sa~ggrahe ratnarasAyanamiti hemAdiratnasaMyuktaM rasAyanam| AyurvedasamutthAne prakAshitatayA divyauShadhividhyAdi yaduvAca brahmacAribhyo~amareshvaraH, tat samprakAshitamiti yojanA||63-64||

asukhAnubandhamiti rogarUpamasukhamanubadhnAtItyasukhAnubandham | mUlamiti kAraNam| kRutaH prajAnAmanugraha iti grAme sthitvA AyurvedoktArogyasAdhanadharmAdiprakAshanena prajAnugrahaH kRuta evetyarthaH| ayaM shabda ubhAbhyAM kAlashabdAbhyAM yojanIyaH| prajApataye brahmeti cchedaH| prajAnAmalpAdikamAyurmattveti yojanA| alpatvAt ‘AyuSha’ iti sheShaH| alpastapaHprabhRutInAM sa~jcayo~asmin alpe AyuShi tat tathA| pratishabdo maitryAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate| athashabdashcAdhikAre| tena, maitrIkAruNyAdInyadhikRutya yaM brahmA prajApataye~adAt, tamanushrotumarhateti yojanA| yadyapi ca RuShayo bharadvAjadvArA indrAdadhigatAyurvedAH, tathA~api grAmyavAsakRutamanoglAnyA na tathA sphuTArtho vartata iti sha~gkayA punarindrastAnupadishati||4-5||

etAddivyaM rasAyanamRuShibhistadvidhairvA sevyamiti darshayannAha- divyAnAmityAdi| viShayAbhijA iti svocitapuNyadeshe jAtA ityarthaH, apuNye tu deshe divyauShadhijanmaiva na bhavati, bhavantyo~api nirvIryA bhavantIti bhAvaH||8-10||

samprati brahmasuvarcalAdInAM yathA mRuduvIryatvaM bhavati, tadAha- yAstvityAdi| kShetraguNairiti himAlayAdiprashastadeshavyatiriktakShetradharmaiH| teShAmiti RuShivyatiriktAnAM vAnaprasthAdInAm| madhyamena ca karmaNeti asamyakprayogeNa; kiMvA, anatimahatA~adRuShTena||11-12||

balyAnAmityAdau jo~ggakam aguru| dvAradA shAkataruH, kapikacchurvA| shrIparNI gAmbhArI| palAshakShAraH palAshakShArodakam| sucaukShe iti suvishuddhe| agnisamAmiti agnyanurUpAm| ShoDashIM mAtrAmiti AmalakAdicUrNayuktaghRutApekShayA ShoDashabhAgo hemAdicUrNAdgrAhyaH||13-26||
kuTIprAveshikarasAyanaviShayAn vAtAtapikarasAyanaviShayAMshca puruShAnAha- samarthAnAmityAdi| kShaNinAmiti kRutakShaNAnAm| sUryamArutasevayA~api kriyata iti sauryamArutikaH||27-29||
sAmAnyena rasAyanaviShayapuruShaguNAnAha- satyavAdinamityAdi| karuNayA sattvAni pashyatIti karuNavedI| asa~gkIrNaH asa~gkIrNabhojI | nityaM rasAyanaprayogo yasya sa nityarasAyanaH||30-35||
athAtaH saMyogasharamUlIyaM vAjIkaraNapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
anenAshva ivodIrNo balI li~ggaM samarpayet|33|(iti bRuMhaNIguTikA) mAShANAmAtmaguptAyA bIjAnAmADhakaM navam||33||
jIvakarShabhakau vIrAM medAmRuddhiM shatAvarIm| madhukaM cAshvagandhAM ca sAdhyet kuDavonmitAm||34||
rase tasmin ghRutaprasthaM gavyaM dashaguNaM payaH| vidArINAM rasaprasthaM prasthamikShurasasya ca||35||
dattvA mRudvagninA sAdhyaM siddhaM sarpirnidhApayet| sharkarAyAstugAkShIryAH kShaudrasya ca pRuthak pRuthak||36||
bhAgAMshcatuShpalAMstatra pippalyAshcAvapet palam| palaM pUrvamato lIDhvA tato~annamupayojayet||37||
ya icchedakShayaM shukraM shephasashcottamaM balam|38|(iti vAjIkaraNaM ghRutam) sharkarA mAShavidalAstugAkShIrI payo ghRutam||38||
godhUmacUrNaShaShThAni sarpiShyutkArikAM pacet| tAM nAtipakvAM mRuditAM kaukkuTe madhure rase||39||
sugandhe prakShipeduShNe yathA sAndrIbhavedrasaH| eSha piNDaraso vRuShyaH pauShTiko balavardhanaH||40||
anenAshva ivodIrNo balI li~ggaM samarpayet| shikhitittirihaMsAnAmevaM piNDaraso mataH| balavarNasvarakaraH pumAMstena vRuShAyate||41||
(iti vAjIkaraNapiNDarasAH )
ghRutaM mAShAn sabastANDAn sAdhayenmAhiShe rase| bharjayettaM rasaM pUtaM phalAmlaM navasarpiShi||42||
IShatsalavaNaM yuktaM dhAnyajIrakanAgaraiH| eSha vRuShyashca balyashca bRuMhaNashca rasottamaH||43||
(iti vRuShyamAhiSharasaH)caTakAMstittirirase tittirIn kaukkuTe rase| kukkuTAn bArhiNarase hAMse bArhiNameva ca||44||
navasarpiShi santaptAn phalAmlAn kArayedrasAn| madhurAn vA yathAsAtmyaM gandhADhyAn balavardhanAn||45||
(ityanye vRuShyarasAH)tRuptiM caTakamAMsAnAM gatvA yo~anupibet payaH| na tasya li~ggashaithilyaM syAnna shukrakShayo nishi||46||
(iti vRuShyamAMsam)mAShayUSheNa yo bhuktvA ghRutADhyaM ShaShTikaudanam| payaH pibati rAtriM sa kRutsnAM jAgarti vegavAn||47||
(iti vRuShyamAShayogaH)na nA svapiti rAtriShu nityastabdhena shephasA| tRuptaH kukkuTamAMsAnA bhRuShTAnAM nakraretasi||48||
(iti vRuShyaH kukkuTamAMsaprayogaH)niHsrAvya matsyANDarasaM bhRuShTaM sarpiShi bhakShayet| haMsabarhiNadakShANAmevamaNDAni bhakShayet||49||
(iti vRuShyo~aNDarasaH)
bhavatashcAtra- srotaHsu shuddheShvamale sharIre vRuShyaM yadA nA mitamatti kAle| vRuShAyate tena paraM manuShyastadbRuMhaNaM caiva balapradaM ca||50||
tasmAt purA shodhanameva kAryaM balAnurUpaM na hi vRuShyayogAH| sidhyanti dehe maline prayuktAH kliShTe yathA vAsasi rAgayogAH||51||
tatra shlokau- vAjIkaraNasAmarthyaM kShetraM strI yasya caiva yA| ye doShA nirapatyAnAM guNAH putravatAM ca ye||52||
dasha pa~jca ca saMyogA vIryApatyavivardhanAH| uktAste sharamUlIye pAde puShTibalapradAH||53||

vAjIkaraNamanvicchet puruSho nityamAtmavAn| tadAyattau hi dharmArthau prItishca yasha eva ca||3||

Commentary: avAjI vAjIvAtyarthaM maithune shaktaH kriyate yena tadvAjIkaraNam| uktaM hi- “vAjIvAtibalo yena yAtyapratihataH striyam” ityAdi| anvicchediti rasAyanAnmahAphalAt tadapekShayA~alpaphalaM vAjIkaraNaM pashcAdicchet| puruSha iti padena taruNapuruShagrAhiNA bAlavRuddhau niShiddhavyavAyau nirAkaroti| uktaM hi- “atibAlo hyasampUrNasarvadhAtuH striyo vrajan| upatapyeta sahasA taDAgamiva kAjalam|| shuShkaM rUkShaM yathA kAShThaM jantujagdhaM vijarjaram| spRuShTamAshu vishIryeta tathA vRuddhaH striyo vrajan” iti| nityamityanena na rasAyanavat sakRutprayogo vRuShyasya, kintvAhAravat sarvadopayoga iti darshayati| AtmavAnityanena durAtmano vRuShyakaraNaM niShedhati, sa hi vRuShyopayogAdupacitadhAtuH sannagamyAgamanamapi kuryAt| dharmAdayo vRuShayAyattA eva yathA bhavanti tadAha- putrasyetyAdi| AyatanaM kAraNam| ete guNA iti dharmAdayaH; vRuShyaprayogajanitaH putro dharmAdIn pituH sampAdayatItyarthaH| vAjIkaraNasevayA ceha yuktyaiva RutukAle ca maithunaM prAdhAnyenAbhipretaM, tena tisraiShaNIye traya upastambhAH (sU.a.11) ityAdigranthena brahmacaryaM yaduktaM, tad RutukAle yathAvidhikRutamaithunApratiShedhakamiti na virodhaH||3||-
vAjIkaraNamagryaM ca kShetraM strI yA praharShiNI||4||
iShTA hyokaikasho~apyarthA paraM prItikarA smRutAH| kiM punaH strIsharIre ye sa~gghAtena pratiShThitAH||5||
(sa~gghAto hIndriyArthAnAM strIShu nAnyatra vidyate)| stryAshrayo hIndriyArtho yaH sa prItijanano~adhikam| strIShu prItirvisheSheNa strIShvapatyaM pratiShThitam||6||
dharmArthau strIShu lakShmIshca strIShu lokAH pratiShThitAH| surUpA yauvanasthA yA lakShaNairyA vibhUShitA||7||
nAnAbhaktyA tu lokasya daivayogAcca yoShitAm||8||
taM taM prApya vivardhante naraM rUpAdayo guNAH| vayorUpavacohAvairyA yasya paramA~gganA||9||
pravishatyAshu hRudayaM daivAdvA karmaNo~api vA| hRudayotsavarUpA yA yA samAnamanaHshayA||10||
samAnasattvA yA vashyA yA yasya prIyate priyaiH| yA pAshabhUtA sarveShAmindriyANAM parairguNaiH||11||
yayA viyukto nistrIkamaratirmanyate jagat| yasyA Rute sharIraM nA dhatte shUnyamivendriyaiH||12||
shokodvegAratibhayairyAM dRuShTvA nAbhibhUyate| yAti yAM prApya visrambhaM dRuShTvA hRuShyatyatIva yAm||13||
apUrvAmiva yAM yAti nityaM harShAtivegataH| gatvA gatvA~api bahusho yAM tRuptiM naiva gacchati||14||
sA strI vRuShyatamA tasya nAnAbhAvA hi mAnavAH| atulyagotrAM vRuShyAM ca prahRuShTAM nirupadravAm||15||
acchAyashcaikashAkhashca niShphalashca yathA drumaH||16||
aniShTagandhashcaikashca nirapatyastathA naraH| citradIpaH saraH shuShkamadhAturdhAtusannibhaH||17||
niShprajastRuNapUlIti mantavyaH puruShAkRutiH| apratiShThashca nagnashca shUnyashcaikendriyashca nA||18||
mantavyo niShkriyashcaiva yasyApatyaM na vidyate| bahumUrtirbahumukho bahuvyUho bahukriyaH||19||
bahucakShurbahuj~jAno bahvAtmA ca bahuprajaH| ma~ggalye~ayaM prashasyo~ayaM dhanyo~ayaM vIryavAnayam||20||
bahushAkho~ayamiti ca stUyate nA bahuprajaH| prItirbalaM sukhaM vRuttirvistAro vipulaM kulam||21||
yasho lokAH sukhodarkAstuShTishcApatyasaMshritAH| tasmAdapatyamanvicchan guNAMshcApatyasaMshritAn||22||
vAjIkaraNanityaH syAdicchan kAmasukhAni ca| upabhogasukhAn siddhAn vIryApatyavivardhanAn||23||
sharamUlekShumUlAni kANDekShuH sekShuvAlikA||24||
shatAvarI payasyA ca vidArI kaNTakArikA| jIvantI jIvako medA vIrA carShabhako balA||25||
RuddhirgokShurakaM rAsnA sAtmaguptA punarnavA| eShAM tripalikAn bhAgAn mAShANAmADhakaM navam||26||
vipAcayejjaladroNe caturbhAgaM ca sheShayet| tatra peShyANi madhukaM drAkShA phalgUni pippalI||27||
AtmaguptA madhukAni kharjUrANi shatAvarI| vidAryAmalakekShUNAM rasasya ca pRuthak pRuthak||28||
sarpiShashcADhakaM dadyAt kShIradroNaM ca tadbhiShak| sAdhayedghRutasheShaM ca supUtaM yojayet punaH||29||
sharkarAyAstugAkShIryAshcUrNaiH prasthonmitaiH pRuthak| palaishcaturbhirmAgadhyAH palena maricasya ca||30||
tvagelAkesharANAM ca cUrNairardhapalonmitaiH| madhunaH kuDavAbhyAM ca dvAbhyAM tatkArayedbhiShak||31||
palikA gulikAstyAnAstA yathAgni prayojayet| eSha vRuShyaH paraM yogo bRuMhaNo balavardhanaH||32||
ya icchedakShayaM shukraM shephasashcottamaM balam|38|(iti vAjIkaraNaM ghRutam)

svasthojaskaratvasAmAnyAt rasAyanamanu vAjIkaraNaM vAcyaM, tatrApi vAjIkaraNe pravRuttyupadarshakaprakaraNayuktatvAdAdau saMyogasharamUlIya ucyate| saMyogaH sharamUlAnAmasminnastIti saMyogasharamUlIyaH||1-2||
dvitIyaprayoge rase iti kvAthe||33-37||-
utkArikA mUShikotkarAkArA (?)| shikhitittirihaMsAnAM piNDarasairvyastasamastAshcatvAraH piNDarasAH||38-41||

nishItyanena sakalanishAmaithune~apiti darshayati| haMsetyAdi haMsabarhidakShANAmaNDaprayogA yadyapi bhinnAH, tathA~api prayogApekShayA eka evAyaM prayogaH| evaM sa~ggrahoktAH haMsabarhidakShANAmekaprayogeNa pa~jcadashaprayogAH pUryante||42-49||-
vRuShyayogAshca shuddhadehaireva kartavyA iti darshayannAha- srotaHsvityAdi| mitamiti mAtrAvat| kliShTe iti mlAne||50-51||
sa~ggrahe yasya caiva yeti yasya yA vRuShyetyarthaH||52-53||

sarvavAjIkaraNebhyaH pradhAnarUpaM vAjIkaraNamAha- vAjItyAdi| kShetramiva kShetraM, tatra shukrarUpabIjaprarohaNAt| arthA iti shabdAdayaH, te ca strIgatAdhararasa-kalavi~gkaruta-rUpAdayaH prasiddhA eva| dharmArthau strIShviti sahaiva patnyA dharmashcarya ityAdyupadeshAddharmaH, tathA~anuraktA gRuhiNI artharakShaNAdi karotItyartha ityarthaH| striyA lakShmyAH saMyoge dhanasampadbhavatIti strIShu lakShmIH pratiShThitetyarthaH| vashyA AyattA| shikShiteti kAmashAstroktagItavAditralAsyAdicatuHShaShTikalAshikShitA||4-7||-

rUpAdivyatirekeNApi kAcit kasyacit karmavashAdvRuShyA strI bhavatIti darshayannAha- nAnetyAdi| daivayogAditi prAktanakarmavashAt| vivardhanta iti vRuShyatvaM sampAdayanti| hAvo naraM prati strINAM shRu~ggAraceShTAvisheShaH| uktaM ca bharatena- “prakAsharUpakaM sattvaM sattvotplavAH samudgatAH| tebhyo hAvAdiniShpattirityAhuH paramarShayaH” iti| daivAditi prAktanakarmaNaH| karmaNa iti aihikAdvashIkaraNAdikarmaNaH| manaHshayaH kAmaH| pAshabhUteti mana-indriyabandhahetutvAt| ‘nAnAbhAvA hi mAnavAH’ ityanena rUpAdiguNayogena (na) sarvapuruShAn prati strINAM priyatvamiti darshayati||8-15||-

samprati vRuShyaprayogasAdhyasya putrasyopAdeyatAM darshayannAha- acchAya ityAdi| ekashAkha iti ekasvarUpa ityarthaH| citralikhito dIpashcitradIpaH| adhAturdhAtusannibha iti asuvarNAdirUpaH suvarNAdivadAbhAsate yo jAtuShaka~gkaNAdiH| pUlI napuMsakadharmitvAt| tRuNapUlI puruShAkRutiriti bhAShayA puruShArthakriyAvirahitvaM darshayati| kAmasukhAni cetyanena putrotpAdAriktaM nAtishlAghyaM phalaM darshayati| kAmasukhAni hi aihikAnyeva paraM na putravadubhayalokopakArakANi| upabhoge maithune sukhaM kurvantItyupabhogasukhAH; kiMvA, upabhoktuM sukhA upabhogasukhAH| vIryaM shukram||16-23||-

kANDekShuH bRuhadikShuH| ikShuvAlikA khaggAlikA| payasyA kShIravidArI| vIrA kShIrakAkolI| phalguH kAShThodumbarikA| shatAvarItyantena kalkacchedaH| vaMsharocanA tugAkShIrI, anye vaMsharocanAnukAri pArthivadravyaM tAladhIti vadanti| styAnA iti ghanAH||24-32||-
athAta AsiktakShIrikaM vAjIkaraNapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
AsiktakShIramApUrNamashuShkaM shuddhaShaShTikam| udUkhale samApothya pIDayet kShIramarditam||3||
gRuhItvA taM rasaM pUtaM gavyena payasA saha| bIjAnAmAtmaguptAyA dhAnyamASharasena ca||4||
balAyAH shUrpaparNyoshca jIvantyA jIvakasya ca | RuddhyarShabhakakAkolIshvadaMShTrAmadhukasya ca||5||
shatAvaryA vidAryAshca drAkShAkharjUrayorapi| saMyuktaM mAtrayA vaidyaH sAdhayettatra cAvapet||6||
tugAkShIryAH samAShANAM shAlInAM ShaShTikasya ca| godhUmAnAM ca cUrNAni yaiH sa sAndrIbhavedrasaH||7||
sAndrIbhUtaM ca kuryAt prabhUtamadhusharkaram| guli(Ti)kA badaraistulyAstAshca sarpiShi bharjayet||8||
tA yathAgni prayu~jjAnaH kShIramAMsarasAshanaH| pashyatyapatyaM vipulaM vRuddho~apyAtmajamakShayam||9||
caTakAnAM sahaMsAnAM dakShANAM shikhinAM tathA| shishumArasya nakrasya bhiShak shukrANi saMharet||10||
gavyaM sarpirvarAhasya kuli~ggasya vasAmapi| ShaShTikAnAM ca cUrNAni cUrNaM godhUmakasya ca||11||
ebhiH pUpalikAH kAryAH shaShkulyo vartikAstathA| pUpA dhAnAshca vividhA bhakShyAshcAnye pRuthagvidhAH||12||
eShAM prayogAdbhakShyANAM stabdhenApUrNaretasA| shephasA vAjivadyAti yAvadicchaM striyo naraH||13||
(iti vRuShyapUpalikAdiyogAH)AtmaguptAphalaM mAShAn kharjUrANi shatAvarIm| shRu~ggATakAni mRudvIkAM sAdhayet prasRutonmitam||14||
kShIraprasthaM jalaprasthametat prasthAvasheShitam| shuddhena vAsasA pUtaM yojayet prasRutaistribhiH||15||
sharkarAyAstugAkShIryAH sarpiSho~abhinavasya ca| tat pAyayeta sakShaudraM ShaShTikAnnaM ca bhojayet||16||
jarAparIto~apyabalo yogenAnena vindati| naro~apatyaM suvipulaM yuveva ca sa hRuShyati||17||
kharjUrImastakaM mAShAn payasyAM ca shatAvarIm| kharjUrANi madhUkAni mRudvIkAmajaDAphalam||18||
palonmitAni matimAn sAdhayet salilADhake| tena pAdAvasheSheNa kShIraprasthaM vipAcayet||19||
kShIrasheSheNa tenAdyAd ghRutADhyaM ShaShTikaudanam| sasharkareNa saMyoga eSha vRuShyaH paraM smRutaH||20||
jIvakarShabhakau medAM jIvantIM shrAvaNIdvayam| kharjUraM madhukaM drAkShAM pippalIM vishvabheShajam||21||
shRu~ggATakaM vidArIM ca navaM sarpiH payo jalam| siddhaM ghRutAvasheShaM taccharkarAkShaudrapAdikam||22||
ShaShTikAnnena saMyuktamupayojyaM yathAbalam| vRuShyaM balyaM ca varNyaM ca kaNThyaM bRuMhaNamuttamam||23||
dadhnaH saraM sharaccandrasannibhaM doShavarjitam| sharkarAkShaudramaricaistugAkShIryA ca buddhimAn||24||
yuktyA yuktaM sasUkShmailaM nave kumbhe shucau paTe| mArjitaM prakShipecchIte ghRutADhye ShaShTikaudane||25||
pibenmAtrAM rasAlAyAstaM bhuktvA ShaShTikaudanam | varNasvarabalopetaH pumAMstena vRuShAyate||26||
candrAMshukalpaM payasA ghRutADhyaM ShaShTikaudanam| sharkarAmadhusaMyuktaM prayu~jjAno vRuShAyate||27||
(iti vRuShyaH ShaShTikaudanaprayogaH)tapte sarpiShi nakrANDaM tAmracUDANDamishritam| yuktaM ShaShTikacUrNena sarpiShA~abhinavena ca||28||
paktvA pUpalikAH khAdedvAruNImaNDapo naraH| ya icchedashvavadgantuM prasektuM gajavacca yaH||29||
bhavatashcAtra- etaiH prayogairvidhivadvapuShmAn vIryopapanno balavarNayuktaH| harShAnvito vAjivadaShTavarSho bhavet samarthashca varA~gganAsu||30||
yadyacca ki~jcinmanasaH priyaM syAdramyA vanAntAH pulinAni shailAH| iShTAH striyo bhUShaNagandhamAlyaM priyA vayasyAshca tadatra yogyam ||31||

tatra shlokaH- AsiktakShIrike pAde ye yogAH parikIrtitAH| aShTAvapatyakAmaiste prayojyAH pauruShArthibhiH||32||

Commentary: pauruShArthibhiriti shukrArthibhiH||32||
(ityapatyakarI ShaShTikAdiguTikA)
(ityapatyakaraH svarasaH)
(iti vRuShyapUpalikAH)

AsiktakShIrikaM vRuShyapAdAbhidhAnaprasa~ggAt padAntasya vishiShTasambandhAvayavatayocyate| (AsiktakShIramiti padamastyasminniti) AsiktakShIrI, tatra svArthikaH kapratyayaH; kiMvA, Dhakpratyayena vaisheShikashabdavat ‘AsiktakShIrika’ iti sAdhanIyam||1-2||

AsiktakShIramiti kShIrasekavRuddham| yaduktaM jatUkarNe- “kShIrasekavRuddhaM ShaShTikaM pakvaM” ityAdi| shuddhaShaShTikamiti gauraShaShTikam| atra balAdirasAnAM tulyamAnatA; kiMvA, mAtrAshabdasyAlpavacanatvAdbalAdirasAnAmalpamAtratvam| prakShepyacUrNapramANamAha- yaiH sa sAndrIbhavedrasa iti; yAvanmAnena cUrNena rasasya sAndratA bhavati tAvanmAtraM cUrNaM grAhyam| prabhUtatvaM madhusharkarayoryAvatA~atyarthamadhuratvaM syAttAvajj~jeyam| atra ca prayogamahimnaiva madhuyuktasyApi prayogasya bharjanakriyAyAmagnisaMyogo na virodhamAvahati; tathA hi sushrute~api triphalAyaskRutau madhuno~agnisambandho bhavatyeva| Atmajamiti harShabhUtAtmajaM, shukramiti yAvat||3-9||

dakShaH kukkuTaH| shukrANIti yadyapyuktaM, tathA~api caTakAdishukragrahaNasyAshakyatvAt samAnaguNAni tadaNDAnyapIha gRuhyante| vartikA vartyAkArA bhakShyAH| dhAnA iti dhAnAkArA bhakShyAH| ayaM tulyadravyatayA vividhabhakShyarUpo~apyeka eva yogaH||10-17||
ajaDA shUkashimbI||18-20||
jIvaketyAdau vidAryantaiH kalkaiH kShIrajalAbhyAM ghRutaM sAdhanIyam||21-23||

yuktyeti yathA kaTutvAdyadhikaM na bhavati tathA maricAdiyogaH kartavyaH| mArjitamiti sughRuShTam| rasAlAlakShaNaM- “sacAturjAtakAjAji saguDArdrakanAgaram| rasAlA syAcchikhariNI sughRuShTaM sasaraM dadhi” iti||24-26||
candrAMshukalpamiti atyarthashuklam||27-29||
atra yogyamiti vRuShyaprayogasamartham||30-31||
iti shrIcakrapANidattaviracitAyAmAyurvedadIpikAyAM carakatAtparyaTIkAyAM cikitsAsthAne vAjIkaraNAdhyAye AsiktakShIriko nAma vAjIkaraNapAdo dvitIyaH||2||
athAto mAShaparNabhRutIyaM vAjIkaraNapAdaM vyakhyAsyAmaH||1||

karShaM madhukacUrNasya ghRutakShaudrasamAMshikam | prayu~gkte yaH payashcAnu nityavegaH sa nA bhavet||19||

Commentary: karShamityAdikAntAH pa~jcadasha prayogAH||19||
(iti vRuShyaM shatAvarIghRutam)
ghRutakShIrAshano nirbhIrnirvyAdhirnityago yuvA| sa~gkalpapravaNo nityaM naraH strIShu vRuShAyate||20||
kRutaikakRutyAH siddhArthA ye cAnyo~anyAnuvartinaH| kalAsu kushalAstulyAH sattvena vayasA ca ye||21||
kulamAhAtmyadAkShiNyashIlashaucasamanvitAH| ye kAmanityA ye hRuShTA ye vishokA gatavyathAH||22||
ye tulyashIlA ye bhaktA ye priyA ye priyaMvadAH| tairnaraH saha visrabdhaH suvayasyairvRuShAyate||23||
abhya~ggotsAdanasnAnagandhamAlyavibhUShaNaiH| gRuhashayyAsanasukhairvAsobhirahataiH priyaiH||24||
viha~ggAnAM rutairiShTaiH strINAM cAbharaNasvanaiH| saMvAhanairvarastrINAmiShTAnAM ca vRuShAyate||25||
mattadvirephAcaritAH sapadmAH salilAshayAH| jAtyutpalasugandhIni shItagarbhagRuhaNi ca||26||
nadyaH phenottarIyAshca girayo nIlasAnavaH| unnatirnIlameghAnAM, ramyacandrodayA nishAH||27||
vAyavaH sukhasaMsparshAH kumudAkaragandhinaH| ratibhogakShamA rAtryaH sa~gkocAguruvallabhAH||28||
sukhAH sahAyAH parapuShTaghuShTAH phullA vanAntA vishadAnnapAnAH| gAndharvashabdAshca sugandhayogAH sattvaM vishAlaM nirupadravaM ca||29||
siddhArthatA cAbhinavashca kAmaH strI cAyudhaM sarvamihAtmajasya| vayo navaM jAtamadashca kAlo harShasya yoniH paramA narANAm||30||
tatra shlokaH- praharShayonayo yogA vyAkhyAtA dasha pa~jca ca| mAShaparNabhRutIye~asmin pAde shukrabalapradAH ||31||
mAShaparNabhRutAM dhenuM gRuShTiM puShTAM catuHstanIm| samAnavarNavatsAM ca jIvadvatsAM ca buddhimAn||3||
rohiNImathavA kRuShNAmUrdhvashRu~ggImadAruNAm| ikShvAdAmarjunAdAM vA sAndrakShIrAM ca dhArayet||4||
kevalaM tu payastasyAH shRutaM vA~ashRutameva vA| sharkarAkShaudrasarpirbhiryuktaM tadvRuShyamuttamam||5||
shukralairjIvanIyaishca bRuMhaNairbalavardhanaiH| kShIrasa~jjananaishcaiva payaH siddhaM pRuthak pRuthak||6||
yuktaM godhUmacUrNena saghRutakShaudrasharkaram| paryAyeNa prayoktavyamicchatA shukramakShayam||7||
medAM payasyAM jIvantIM vidArIM kaNTakArikAm| shvadaMShTrAM kShIrikAM mAShAn godhUmA~jchAliShaShTikAn||8||
payasyardhodake paktvA kArShikAnADhakonmite| vivarjayet payaHsheShaM tat pUtaM kShaudrasarpiShA||9||
yuktaM sasharkaraM pItvA vRuddhaH saptatiko~api vA| vipulaM labhate~apatyaM yuveva ca sa hRuShyati||10||

maNDalairjAtarUpasya tasyA eva payaH shRutam| apatyajananaM siddhaM saghRutakShaudrasharkaram||11||

Commentary: jAtarUpasyeti suvarNasya; maNDalarUpA~a~akRutiriha suvarNasya prabhAvAdvRuShyaprayogopakAriNI bhavatIti vacanAjj~jeyam| tasyA eveti mAShaparNabhRutadhenvAH||11||
triMshat supiShTAH pippalyaH praku~jce tailasarpiShoH| bhRuShTAH sasharkarAkShaudrAH kShIradhArAvadohitAH||12||
pItvA yathAbalaM cordhvaM ShaShTikaM kShIrasarpiShA| bhuktvA na rAtrimastabdhaM li~ggaM pashyati nA kSharat||13||
(iti vRuShyaH pippalIyogaH)shvadaMShTrAyA vidAryAshca rase kShIracaturguNe| ghRutADhyaH sAdhito vRuShyo mAShaShaShTikapAyasaH||14||
(iti vRuShyapAyasayogaH)
phalAnAM jIvanIyAnAM snigdhAnAM rucikAriNAm| kuDavashcUrNitAnAM syAt svaya~gguptAphalasya ca||15||
kuDavashcaiva mAShANAM dvau dvau ca tilamudgayoH| godhUmashAlicUrNAnAM kuDavaH kuDavo bhavet||16||
sarpiShaH kuDavashcaikastat sarvaM kShIramarditam | paktvA pUpalikAH khAdedbahvyaH syuryasya yoShitaH||17||

ghRutaM shatAvarIgarbhaM kShIre dashaguNe pacet| sharkarApippalIkShaudrayuktaM tadvRuShyamuttamam||18||

Commentary: ghRutaM shatAvarItyAdau sharkarAdInAM prakShepyANAmanyatodRuShTanyAyAdghRutAt pAdikatvaM (ghRutasya prAsthikatvam )||18||
mASharNabhRutIyasambandho~api pUrvavat||1-2||

ghRutakShIrAshana ityAdinA tu vRuShyatvArthina AhArAcArAbhidhAnam| nityamityanena vyavAyanityatayA shukramArgAnavarodhena vyavAyashaktiM darshayati| kRutamekaM kRutyaM yaiste tathA, etacca anyo~anyArtharAgakAraNam| siddhArthA iti siddhasAdhyAH, akRutArthA hi vyAkulamanaso na kAmakShamAH| vRuShAyata iti upacitapravRuttyunmukhashukro bhavati||20-25||

‘mattadvirephAcaritAH’ ityAdi ‘gRuhaNi ca’ ityantaM yogyatayA RutuvibhAgenAnuktamapi grIShma eva j~jeyaM, tathA ‘meghAnAM’ ityantaM prAvRuShi, tathA ‘gandhinaH’ ityantaM sharadi, ‘vallabhAH’ ityantaM ca vidhAnaM hemantashishirayorj~jeyam| sa~gkocaM ku~gkumaM, sa~gkocAguruNoH samAlabhanArthaM vallabhA yAsu nishAsu tAstathA||26-28||
sukhA ityAdigranthavidhAnaM tu vasantAbhiprAyavihitamanyatrApyaviruddham| Atmajasyeti manmathasya| jAtamadaH kAlo vasantAdiH||29-31||

gRuShTim ekavAraprasUtAm| catuHstanImityanena sampUrNacatuHstanIM darshayati| rohiNImiti lohitavarNAm| UrdhvashRu~ggatvaM vishuddhabahukShIrAyA eva bhavatIti vacanAjj~jeyam| ikShvAdeti ikShudaNDabhakShA| arjunAdA arjunavRukShapatrabhakShA| ikShvAdA vA, arjunAdA vA, mAShaparNabhRutA veti vikalpatrayam| payaH shRutamashRutaM veti dvau yogau| sharkarAkShaudrasarpirbhiryuktaM taditi tRutIyaH| etatprayogo~api jatUkarNe- “tasyAH kShIraM sharkarAkShaudrayuktaM vA kevalaM shRutamashRutaM vA” iti||3-5||
paryAyeNeti pRuthak pRuthak prayoktavyaM; tena pa~jcabhirgaNaiH pa~jca yogA bhavanti||6-7||
vivarjayediti medAdikalkaM varjayet| vRuddhaH saptaterarvAgiti j~jeyam| saptatikasya tu yadyapi shukranivRuttiruktA, tathA~api vRuShyaprabhAvAdbhavatIti vij~jeyam||8-10||
praku~jcaM palam| kShIradhArAvadohitA iti pippalIkalkAdupari kShIradhArAvadohaH kartavyaH; kShIraM ca tAvaddohyaM yAvatA pAnayogyAH pippalyo bhavanti||12-14||

phalAnAmityAdi| phalAnAmiti jIvanIyAnAmityAdibhistribhiH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| jIvanIyAnAmiti ShaTkakaShAyavargoktAnAM jIvakarShabhAdInAM dashAnAm| snigdhAnAmiti snehopagAnAM mRudvIkAdInAM dashAnAM saptakakaShAyavargoktAnAm| tathA rucikAriNAmiti catuShkakaShAyavargoktAnAmAmrAdInAM hRudyAnAM dashAnAmiti| eShAM jIvanIyaprabhRutInAM phalAnAM cUrNitAnAM militvA kuDavo grAhyaH| anyadatirohitArtham| tathA hyayaM prayogo jatUkarNe ca paThyate- “drAkShAkharjUramAShAjaDAgodhUmashAlighRutAnAM kuDavaH, tilamudgau dvikauDavikau cUrNayitvA” ityAdi||15-17||
athAtaH pumA~jjAtabalAdikaM vAjIkaraNapAdaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
mAShAtmaguptAgodhUmashAliShaShTikapaiShTikam| sharkarAyA vidAryAshca cUrNamikShurakasya ca||23||
saMyojya masRuNe kShIre ghRute pUpalikAH pacet| payo~anupAnAstAH shIghraM kurvanti vRuShatAM parAm||24||
(iti vRuShyA mAShAdipUpalikAH)sharkarAyAstulaikA syAdekA gavyasya sarpiShaH| prastho vidAryAshcUrNasya pippalyAH prastha eva ca||25||
ardhADhakaM tugAkShIryAH kShaudrasyAbhinavasya ca| tatsarvaM mUrcchitaM tiShThenmArtike ghRutabhAjane||26||
mAtrAmagnisamAM tasya prAtaH prAtaH prayojayet| eSha vRuShyaH paraM yogo balyo bRuMhaNa eva ca||27||
shatAvaryA vidAryAshca tathA mAShAtmaguptayoH| shvadaMShTrAyAshca niShkvAthA~jjaleShu ca pRuthak pRuthak||28||
sAdhayitvA ghRutaprasthaM payasyaShTaguNe punaH| sharkarAmadhuyuktaM tadapatyArthI prayojayet||29||
(iti vRuShyaghRutabhRuShTamatsyamAMsAni)
ghRutapAtraM shataguNe vidArIsvarase pacet| siddhaM punaH shataguNe gavye payasi sAdhayet||30||
sharkarAyAstugAkShIryAM kShaudrasyekShurakasya ca| pippalyAH sAjaDAyAshca bhAgaiH pAdAMshikairyutam||31||
guli(Ti)kAH kArayedvaidyo yathA sthulamudumbaram| tAsAM prayogAt puruShaH kuli~gga iva hRuShyati||32||
(iti vRuShyotkArikA)
sitopalApalashataM tadardhaM navasarpiShaH| kShaudrapAdena saMyuktaM sAdhayejjalapAdikam||33||
sAndraM godhUmacUrNAnAM pAdaM stIrNe shilAtale| shucau shlakShNe samutkIrya mardanenopapAdayet||34||
shuddhA utkArikAH kAryashcandramaNDalasannibhAH| tAsAM prayogAdgajavannArIH santarpayennaraH||35||
yat ki~jcinmadhuraM snigdhaM jIvanaM bRuMhaNaM guru| harShaNaM manasashcaiva sarvaM tadvRuShyamucyate||36||
dravyairevaMvidhaistasmAdbhAvitaH pramadAM vrajet| Atmavegena codIrNaH strIguNaishca praharShitaH||37||
gatvA snAtvA payaH pItvA rasaM vA~anu shayIta nA| tathA~asyApyAyate bhUyaH shukraM ca balameva ca||38||
yathA mukulapuShpasya su(kha) gandho nopalabhyate| labhyate tadvikAshAttu tathA shukraM hi dehinAm||39||
narte vai ShoDashAdvarShAt saptatyAH parato na ca| AyuShkAmo naraH strIbhiH saMyogaM kartumarhati||40||
atibAlo hyasampUrNasarvadhAtuH striyaM vrajan| upashuShyeta sahasA taDAgamiva kAjalam||41||
shuShkaM rUkShaM yathA kAShThaM jantudagdhaM vijarjaram| spRuShTamAshu vishIryeta tathA vRuddhaH striyo vrajan||42||
jarayA cintayA shukraM vyAdhibhiH karmakarShaNAt| kShayaM gacchatyanashanAt strINAM cAtiniShevaNAt||43||
kShayAdbhayAdavishrambhAcchokAt strIdoShadarshanAt| nArINAmarasaj~jatvAdavicArAdasevanAt||44||
tRuptasyApi striyo gantuM na shaktirupajAyate| dehasattvabalApekShI harShaH shaktishca harShajA||45||
rasa ikShau yathA dadhni sarpistailaM tile yathA| sarvatrAnugataM dehe shukraM saMsparshane tathA||46||
tat strIpuruShasaMyoge ceShTAsa~gkalpapIDanAt| shukraM pracyavate sthAnAjjalamArdrAt paTAdiva||47||
harShAttarShAt saratvAcca paicchilyAdgauravAdapi| aNupravaNabhAvAcca drutatvAnmArutasya ca||48||
aShTAbhya ebhyo hetubhyaH shukraM dehAt prasicyate| carato vishvarUpasya rUpadravyaM yaducyate||49||

bahalaM madhuraM snigdhamavisraM guru picchilam| shuklaM bahu ca yacchukraM phalavattadasaMshayam||50||

Commentary: prashastashukraguNAnAha- bahalamityAdi||50||
pumAn yathA jAtabalo yAvadicchaM striyo vrajet| yathA cApatyavAn sadyo bhavettadupadekShyate||3||
na hi jAtabalAH sarve narAshcApatyabhAginaH| bRuhaccharIrA balinaH santi nArIShu durbalAH||4||
santi cAlpAshrayAH strIShu balavanto bahuprajAH| prakRutyA cAbalAH santi santi cAmayadurbalAH||5||
narAshcaTakavat kecid vrajanti bahushaH striyam| gajavacca prasi~jcanti kecinna bahugAminaH||6||
kAlayogabalAH kecit kecidabhyasanadhruvAH| kecit prayatnairvyajyante vRuShAH kecit svabhAvataH||7||
tasmAt prayogAn vakShyAmo durbalAnAM balapradAn| sukhopabhogAn balinAM bhUyashca balavardhanAn||8||
pUrvaM shuddhasharIrANAM nirUhaiH sAnuvAsanaiH| balApekShI prayu~jjIta shukrApatyavivardhanAn||9||
ghRutatailarasakShIrasharkarAmadhusaMyutAH| bastayaH saMvidhAtavyAH kShIramAMsarasAshinAm||10||

yena nArIShu sAmarthyaM vAjIvallabhate naraH| vrajeccAbhyadhikaM yena vAjIkaraNameva tat||51||

Commentary: vAjIkaraNashabdaniruktimAha- yenetyAdi| vrajeccAbhyadhikamiti punaH punargacchet; ‘vyajyate’ iti vA pAThaH, tatrApi bhUyo gamanena nArIShu puMstvena vyajyate| ‘vyajyAt’ iti pAThe~api sa evArtho vidvadbhiH sucintanIyaH| anena niruktena trividhamapi vRuShyamavarudhyate; yathA- shukravRuddhikaraM ca mAShAdi, tathA srutikaraM sa~gkalpAdi, shukrasrutivRuddhikaraM kShIrAdi| yaduktamanyatra- “shukrasrutikaraM ki~jcit ki~jcicchukravivardhanam| srutivRuddhikaraM ki~jcit trividhaM vRuShyamucyate” iti| trividhamapi hIdaM vyavAye balavattvaM punaH punarvyavAyashaktiM ca karoti||51||
tatra shlokau- heturyogopadeshasya yogA dvAdasha cottamAH| yat pUrvaM maithunAt sevyaM sevyaM yanmaithunAdanu||52||
yadA na sevyAH pramadAH kRutsnaH shukravinishcayaH| niruktaM ceha nirdiShTaM pumA~jjAtabalAdike||53||
piShTvA varAhamAMsAni dattvA maricasaindhave| kolavadgulikAH kRutvA tapte sarpiShi vartayet ||11||
vartanastambhitAstAshca prakShepyAH kaukkuTe rase| ghRutADhye gandhapishune dadhidADimasArike||12||
yathA na bhindyAdguli(Ti)kAstathA taM sAdhayedrasam| taM piban bhakShayaMstAshca labhate shukramakShayam||13||
mAMsAnAmevamanyeShAM medyAnAM kArayedbhiShak| guTikAH sarasAstAsaM prayogaH shukravardhanaH||14||
(iti vRuShyau pUpalikAyogau)
mAShAna~gkuritA~jchuddhAn vituShAn sAjaDAphalAn| ghRutADhye mAhiSharase dadhidADimasArike||15||
prakShipenmAtrayA yukto dhAnyajIrakanAgaraiH| bhuktaH pItashca sa rasaH kurute shukramakShayam||16||
ArdrANi matsyamAMsAni shapharIrvA subhArjitAH| tapte sarpiShi yaH khAdet sa gacchet strIShu na kShayam||17||
ghRutabhRuShTAn rase cchAge rohitAn phalasArike| anupItarasAn snigdhAnapatyArthI prayojayet||18||
kuTTakaM matsyamAMsAnAM hi~ggusaindhavadhAnyakaiH| yuktaM godhUmacUrNena ghRute pUpalikAH pacet||19||
mAhiShe ca rase matsyAn snigdhAmlalavaNAn pacet| rase cAnugate mAMsaM pothayettatra cAvapet||20||
maricaM jIrakaM dhAnyamalpaM hi~ggu navaM ghRutam| mAShapUpalikAnAM tadgarbhArthamupakalpayet||21||
etau pUpalikAyogau bRuMhaNau balavardhanau| harShasaubhAgyadau putryau paraM shukrAbhivardhanau||22||
pArisheShyAt pumA~jjAtabalAdika ucyate| pumA~jjAtabalAdayaH shabdA asmin vidyanta iti pumA~jjAtabalAdikaH; AsiktakShIrikavacchabdasiddhiH||1-2||
ikShurakaH kokilAkShaH||23-27||
sharkarAmadhusaMyuktamityatra prakShepanyAyAt pAdikatvaM sharkarAmadhunoH||28-29||
pAdAMshikairiti ghRutApekShayA pAdapramANaiH||30-32||
samutkIryeti vistIrya| utkArikAH kAryA ityatra punaH pAkenaivotkArikAkaraNam||33-35||

anuktavAjIkaraNaM sa~ggRuhNannAha- yatki~jcidityAdi| bhAvita iti vacanAt prayogeNa sharIrabhAvanAyAM satyAM strIsevA sambhavatIti darshayati| Atmavegeneti sa~gkalpajAtenAtmavegena| bAlasya taDAgadRuShTAntena punarapi shukrasadbhAvaM kaphaprAdhAnyaM ca darshayati; vRuddhasya tu jantujagdhatvAdidRuShTAntena vinaShTasyApunarbhAvaM shukrasya tathA~abhUyiShThatAM ca darshayati| nanu tRuptasya sharIrabalaM bhavatyeva, tat kiM tRuptasya striyo gantumasAmarthyamityAha- dehetyAdi| etena satyapi tRuptijanite bale kShayAdinA dehamanasorupahatatvAddharSho na bhavati, harShAbhAvAd vyavAyashaktirna bhavatItyuktaM bhavati||36-45||

samprati, sambhavati shukraM yathA dehe, sthitaM yathA ca pravartate, tadAha- rasa ityAdi| ikShvAdidRuShTAntatrayeNAnatiprayatnAlpaprayatnamahAprayatnavAhyashukrAn puruShAn yathAkramaM darshayati| saMsparshana iti saMsparshanavati, tena keshAdau saMsparshanAvyApteH shukramapi nAstIti darshayati| strIpuruShasaMyogo mishrIbhAvaH| ceShTA vyavAyaceShTA, sa~gkalpo yoShidanurAgaH, pIDanaM nArIpuruShayoH parasparasammUrcchanam; atra ca nArIpuruShasaMyogaH pradhAnaM kAraNaM, tatsahakAriNi ceShTAdIni| ArdrapaTadRuShTAntenAshrayAnupaghAtena shukrasravaNaM darshayati| aparamapi shukrapravRuttihetumAha- harShAdityAdi| harShaH sa~gkalpapUrvakashukrodrekadhvajocchrAyAdikArIcchA| tarShaH vanitAbhilAShaH| saratvam asthairyam| anupravaNabhAvaH aNutve sati bahirnirgamanasvabhAvaH| drutatvAnmArutasya ceti shukraprerakasya vAyorabhidravaNashIlatvAdityarthaH| ete ca yadyapi hetavastathA~api prAdhAnyAt prathamapratipAditastrIpuruShasaMyogAdirUpahetUnAM samaShTau naivAmI gaNitAH| carata iti nAnAmAnuShapashvAdijAtiShu bhramataH| vishvarUpasyeti AtmanaH| tathA hyAtmaparyAyeShUktaM- “sa vishvakarmA sa ca vishvarUpaH” (shA.a.2) iti| rUpadravyamiti rUpaprAktanakAraNam| etena, avyaktasyAtmano vyaktasharIranirvRuttau shukraM heturityuktaM bhavati| shukraM ceha prakaraNAgatatvenoktaM; tena ArtavamapyAtmano rUpadravyaM j~jeyam||46-49||

jAtabalatve satyapi nAvashyamapatyabhAgitvaM bhavatIti kRutvA ‘yathA jAtabalaH’ ityukte~api ‘yathA cApatyavAn bhavet’ ityuktam| tadeva shukravaicitryaM sphoTayati- na hItyAdi| ‘na hi jAtabalAH sarve’ ityekaH pakShaH, tathA ‘narA nApatyabhAginaH sarve’ iti dvitIyaH pakSho j~jeyaH| etacchukrabalabhedaprasa~ggAdaparAnapi shukrabalavisheShAnAha- bRuhaccharIrA ityAdi| alpAshrayA alpasharIrAH, ete ca shukrasAratvena nArIShu balavanto bahuprajAshca bhavanti| gajavat prasi~jcantIti shukraM bahu visRujanti| kAlayogena hemantAdikAlasambandhena vyavAye balavanto bhavantIti kAlayogabalAH| abhyasanadhruvA iti vyavAyAbhyAsenaiva vyavAyasamarthA bhavanti| evaM prayatnairvyajyanta iti vRuShyaprayogaiH strIShu pravartante| sukhopabhogAniti sukhAnuShThAnAn| nirUhAnuvAsanashuddhAnAM vRuShyaprayogAH phaladA bhavantIti nirUhAnuvAsanAbhidhAnam||3-10||
heturityAdi| sa~ggraho vyaktaH||52-53||
vartanastambhitA iti vartanena kaThinIkRutAH| dadhidADimasArAbhyAM saMskRutaM dadhidADimasArikam| dADimasArashca dADimarasaH| mAMsAnAmityAdi atideshayogo dvitIyaH| medyAnAmiti medurANAm||11-14||
ajaDA shUkashimbI| bhuktaH pItashceti pUrvayogavaddhanabhAgasya bhojanaM, dravasya ca pAnaM j~jeyam||15-16||
matsyashabdena pradhAnakalpanayA rohitaM vadanti| phalasArika iti dADimAmalakAdiphalasArasaMskRutam||17-18||
kuTTakamiti kuTTanenANushaH kRutam||19-22||
athAto jvaracikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

kevalaM samanaskaM ca jvarAdhiShThAnamucyate| sharIraM, balakAlastu nidAne sampradarshitaH||30||

Commentary: kevalamiti kRutsnaM, tena bAhyendriyANAmapyavarodhaH| anena dehamanasI apyavashyaM jvareNa tapyete ityuktam| balasyAbhivRuddhilakShaNasya jvarAbhyAgamanalakShaNasya vA kAlo balakAlaH, sa ca nidAne “divasAnte gharmAnte jaraNAnte vA jvarAgamanamabhivRuddhirvA” (ni.a.1) ityevamprakAragranthenoktaH||30||
