vAtaje shramaje caiva purANe kShataje jvare| la~gghanaM na hitaM vidyAcchamanaistAnupAcaret||272||
vikShipyAmAshayoShmANaM yasmAdgatvA rasaM nRuNAm| jvaraM kurvanti doShAstu hIyate~agnibalaM tataH||273||
yathA prajvalito vahniH sthAlyAmindhanavAnapi| na pacatyodanaM samyaganilaprerito bahiH||274||
paktisthAnAttathA doShairUShmA kShipto bahirnRuNAm| na pacatyabhyavahRutaM kRucchrAt pacati vA laghu||275||
ato~agnibalarakShArthaM la~gghanAdikramo hitaH| saptAhena hi pacyante saptadhAtugatA malAH||276||
nirAmashcApyataH prokto jvaraH prAyo~aShTame~ahani| udIrNadoShastvalpAgnirashnan guru visheShataH||277||
mucyate sahasA prANaishciraM klishyati vA naraH| etasmAtkAraNAdvidvAn vAtike~apyAdito jvare||278||
nAti gurvati vA snigdhaM bhojayet sahasA naram| jvare mArutaje tvAdAvanapekShyApi hi kramam||279||
kuryAnniranubandhAnAmabhya~ggAdInupakramAn| pAyayitvA kaShAyaM ca bhojayedrasabhojanam||280||
jIrNajvaraharaM kuryAt sarvashashcApyupakramam| shleShmalAnAmavAtAnAM jvaro~anuShNaH kaphAdhikaH||281||
paripAkaM na saptAhenApi yAti mRudUShmaNAm| taM krameNa yathoktena la~gghanAlpAshanAdinA||282||

sAmA ye ye ca kaphajAH kaphapittajvarAshca ye||283||

Commentary: samprati vAtajAdInAmapyAvasthAyAM la~gghanaM, tathA kaphajAdInAmapi svarUpeNaiva sAmAnyena lAghavakaraM la~gghanamAha- sAmA ityAdi| sAmA ityanena vAtikasyApi sAmasya la~gghanIyatvaM brUte| uktaM hyanyatra- “sAme vAte~api la~gghanam” iti| kaphaje tu nirAme~api la~gghanaM shasyate| kaphapittajashabdena kaphayuktapittajasyaiva la~gghanIyatvaM na kevalaM nirAmapittajasya, sAmapittajasya tu AmakShayArthaM la~gghanaM shasyata eva| yaduktamanyatra- “sAme pitte~api la~gghanam| kuryAdevAmapaktyarthaM” iti| yattUktaM- “kaphapitte drave dhAtu sahete la~gghanaM mahat” iti; tadapi sAmatvena sadravapittApekShyA, kShINadravAMshe tu pitte la~gghanaM na kartavyameva| la~gghanIyoktamitivacanena la~gghanabRuMhaNIyoktaM dashavidhaM la~gghanamavasthAniShiddhavamanAdisarvathAniShiddhavyAyAmAdirahitaM ca grAhyam||283||-

vamanaishca virekaishca bastibhishca yathAkramam||284||

Commentary: pUrvaM yad ‘vamanairharet’ ityuktaM tatsaMsRuShTadoSheShu jvareShu kaphAdhikyena, samprati tu ekaikadoShaje vamanaishcetyAdinA vamanAdIni prAheti na paunaruktyam||284||-
saMsRuShTAn sannipatitAn buddhvA taratamaiH samaiH||285||
jvarAn doShakramApekShI yathoktairauShadhairjayet| vardhanenaikadoShasya kShapaNenocchritasya vA||286||
sannipAtajvarasyAnte karNamUle sudArUNaH||287||
shothaH sa~jjAyate tena kashcideva pramucyate| raktAvasecanaiH shIghraM sarpiShpAnaishca taM jayet||288||

shItoShNasnigdharUkShAdyairjvaro yasya na shAmyati||289||

Commentary: shAkhAnusArItyatra yadyapi “shAkhA raktAdayo dhAtavaH” (sU.a.11) ityuktaM, tathA~apIha raktadUShako visheSheNa jvaro j~jeyaH, raktAshraye eva doShe raktamokShasya visheSheNa samarthatvAt| raktamokShasthAnaM ca bAhumadhyaM j~jeyaM; yaduktamanyatra- “shItoShNasnigdharUkShAdyairjvaro yasya na shAmyati| shAkhAnusArI tasyAshu mu~jcedbAhvoH kramAt sirAH” iti| shItoShNAdisevAvacanAt sakaladoShAnurUpacikitsAkrame sati raktaduShTyaiva prAyo jvarAnubandho bhavatIti darshayati||289||-

visarpeNAbhighAtena yashca visphoTakairjvaraH||290||

Commentary: vikArAntarAnubandhajvaracikitsAmAha- visarpeNetyAdi| kaphottarashca pittottarashceti kRutvaikasheShAt kaphapittottaratvaM j~jeyaM; kiMvA kaphapittayormilitayoruttaratvaM j~jeyam| tenAnUrdhvage pitte deyameva sarpiH||290||-

daurbalyAddehadhAtUnAM jvaro jIrNo~anuvartate||291||

Commentary: daurbalyAdityAdau dehagrahaNenAtmAdito vyAvRutya rasAdiShudhAtushabdaM pravartayati, rasAdaya eva hi visheSheNa dehadhArakAH| bRuMhaNaM puShTijananam||291||-
karma sAdhAraNaM jahyAttRutIyakacaturthakau ||292||

jvarapratyAtmikaM li~ggaM santApo dehamAnasaH| jvareNAvishatA bhUtaM na hi ki~jcinna tapyate||31||

Commentary: jvarapratyAtmikaM li~ggamityAdinA~a~atmalakShaNamAha| Atmali~ggamiti avyabhicArilakShaNam| iha santApashabdena sAmAnyena pIDA vaktavyA, sA ca dehavisheShaNAbhidhAnAttApalakShaNaiva bhavati, manasi tu tathA cendriyeShu dehaguNagRuhIteShu vaicittyAdirUpA “vaicittyaM” ityAdigranthavaktavyA j~jeyA| jvaraprabhAve santApo~acintyakAryatayoktaH, iha tu jvarAvyabhicAritveneti visheShaH| anye tu, arucyAdiyuktaH santApaH prabhAvo bhavati, arucyAdirahitastvAtmalakShaNaM bhavati| santApasya pratyAtmalakShaNatve hetumAha- jvareNetyAdi| bhUtashabdena sarvaprANina ucyante| tatashca jvareNa bhUtamAvishatA na ki~jcinmanuShyAdi na tapyate, kintu tapyata eva, tato jvarAvyabhicAritayA jvarAtmalakShaNameva tadupapannamiti bhAvaH| atra pakShe gajAdiShvapi kUTapAkalAdishabdAbhidheyeShu jvareShvantardAharUpA vedanA bhavatIti j~jeyam| kiMvA, atra dehasantApau militau vA paryAyeNa vA jvarAtmali~ggaM bhavetAM; na tAvat paryAyeNa, tathA hi sati kvacijjvare dehasantApa eva kvacijjvare manaHsantApa eva bhavatIti vAcyaM, tatashcAnayorvyabhicArAnnAvyabhicArili~ggatvaM; tasmAnmilitAveva dehamanaHsantApAvAtmalakShaNaM jvarasyeti vAcyam; evaM vyavasthite kasmAt sarvajvareShu dehamanastApau bhavata ityAha- jvareNetyAdi| jvareNa bhUtamAvishatA nahi ki~jciccharIraM mano vA na tapyate, kintu tapyata eva; ato dehamanastApaH sarvajvareShUpapanna ityarthaH| asmiMshca pakShe shArIramAnasajvarabhedopadarshane “shArIro jAyate pUrvaM dehe” ityAdinA shArIrasya yaddehamAtrAshrayatvaM mAnasasya yanmanomAtrAshrayatvaM vaktavyaM tat sUkShmakAlAbhiprayeNa; tasmiMshca sUkShmakAle jvara ubhayAtApako~apyanantarotpadyamAnobhayatApitvadharmApekShayA bhavatyeva dehamanastApI, yathA prathamakShaNotpannaM dravyaM nirguNam, anantarotpadyamAnaM saguNaM dravyamuktaM dravyalakShaNe||31||
Aganturanubandho hi prAyasho viShamajvare| vAtapradhAnaM sarpirbhirbastibhiH sAnuvAsanaiH||293||
snigdhoShNairannapAnaishca shamayedviShamajvaram| virecanena payasA sarpiShA saMskRutena ca||294||
viShamaM tiktashItaishca jvaraM pittottaraM jayet| vamanaM pAcanaM rUkShamannapAnaM vila~gghanam||295||
yogAH parAH pravakShyante viShamajvaranAshanAH||296||
prayoktavyA matimatA doShAdIn pravibhajya te| surA samaNDA pAnArthe bhakShyArthe caraNAyudhaH||297||
tittirishca mayUrashca prayojyA viShamajvare| pibedvA ShaTpalaM sarpirabhayAM vA prayojayet||298||
triphalAyAH kaShAyaM vA guDUcyA rasameva vA| nIlinImajagandhAM ca trivRutAM kaTurohiNIm||299||
pibejjvarAgame yuktyA snehasvedopapAditaH| sarpiSho mahatIM mAtrAM pItvA vA chardayet punaH||300||
upayujyAnnapAnaM vA prabhUtaM punarullikhet| sAnnaM madyaM prabhUtaM vA pItvA svapyAjjvarAgame||301||
AsthApanaM yApanaM vA kArayedviShamajvare| payasA vRuShadaMshasya shakRudvA tadahaH pibet||302||
vRuShasya dadhimaNDena surayA vA sasaindhavam| pippalyAstriphalAyAshca dadhnastakrasya sarpiShaH||303||
pa~jcagavyasya payasaH prayogo viShamajvare| rasonasya satailasya prAgbhaktamupasevanam||304||
medyAnAmuShNavIryANAmAmiShANAM ca bhakShaNam| hi~ggutulyA tu vaiyAghrI vasA nasyaM sasaindhavA||305||
purANasarpiH siMhasya vasA tadvat sasaindhavA| saindhavaM pippalInAM ca taNDulAH samanaHshilAH||306||
netrA~jjanaM tailapiShTaM shasyate viShamajvare| pala~gkaShA nimbapatraM vacA kuShThaM harItakI||307||
sarShapAH sayavAH sarpirdhUpanaM jvaranAshanam| ye dhUmA dhUpanaM yacca nAvanaM cA~jjanaM ca yat||308||
manovikAre nirdiShTaM kAryaM tadviShamajvare| maNInAmoShadhInAM ca ma~ggalyAnAM viShasya ca||309||
somaM sAnucaraM devaM samAtRugaNamIshvaram||310||
pUjayan prayataH shIghraM mucyate viShamajvarAt| viShNuM sahasramUrdhAnaM carAcarapatiM vibhum||311||
stuvannAmasahasreNa jvarAn sarvAnapohati| brahmANamashvinAvindraM hutabhakShaM himAcalam||312||
ga~ggAM marudgaNAMshceShTyA pUjaya~jjayati jvarAn| bhaktyA mAtuH pitushcaiva gurUNAM pUjanena ca||313||
brahmacaryeNa tapasA satyena niyamena ca| japahomapradAnena vedAnAM shravaNena ca||314||
jvarAdvimucyate shIghraM sAdhUnAM darshanena ca| jvare rasasthe vamanamupavAsaM ca kArayet||315||
sekapradehau raktasthe tathA saMshamanAni ca| virecanaM sopavAsaM mAMsamedaHsthite hitam||316||
shApAbhicArAdbhUtAnAmabhiSha~ggAcca yo jvaraH||317||
daivavyapAshrayaM tatra sarvamauShadhamiShyate| abhighAtajvaro nashyet pAnAbhya~ggena sarpiShaH||318||
raktAvasekairmadyaishca sAtmyairmAMsarasaudanaiH| sAnAho madyasAtmyAnAM madirArasabhojanaiH||319||
kShatAnAM vraNitAnAM ca kShatavraNacikitsayA| AshvAseneShTalAbhena vAyoH prashamanena ca||320||
harShaNaishca shamaM yAnti kAmashokabhayajvarAH| kAmyairarthairmanoj~jaishca pittaghnaishcApyupakramaiH||321||
sadvAkyaishca shamaM yAti jvaraH krodhasamutthitaH| kAmAt krodhajvaro nAshaM krodhAt kAmasamudbhavaH||322||

jvarasya vegaM kAlaM ca cintaya~jjvaryate tu yaH||323||

Commentary: jvaravegakAlacintAjo~api jvaraH kAmAdivanmAnasApacArAdbhavatIti taccikitsAmAha- jvarasyetyAdi||323||-
jvarapramokShe puruShaH kUjan vamati ceShTate| shvasanvivarNaH svinnA~ggo vepate lIyate muhuH||324||
pralapatyuShNasarvA~ggaH shItA~ggashca bhavatyapi| visa~jj~jo jvaravegArtaH sakrodha iva vIkShyate ||325||
sadoShashabdaM ca shakRuddravaM sravati vegavat| li~ggAnyetAni jAnIyAjjvaramokShe vicakShaNaH||326||
bahudoShasya balavAn prAyeNAbhinavo jvaraH| satkriyAdoShapaktyA cedvimu~jcati sudAruNam||327||
kRutvA doShavashAdvegaM kramAduparamanti ye| teShAmadAruNo mokSho jvarANAM cirakAriNAm||328||

vigataklamasantApamavyathaM vimalendriyam| yuktaM prakRutisattvena vidyAt puruShamajvaram||329||

Commentary: samprati prashAntajvaralakShaNaprashnasyottaraM- vigatetyAdi| prakRutisattveneti sahajasattvena||329||
sajvaro jvaramuktashca vidAhIni gurUNi ca| asAtmyAnyannapAnAni viruddhAni ca varjayet||330||
vyavAyamaticeShTAshca snAnamatyashanAni ca| tathA jvaraH shamaM yAti prashAnto jAyate na ca||331||
vyAyAmaM ca vyavAyaM ca snAnaM ca~gkramaNAni ca| jvaramukto na seveta yAvanna balavAn bhavet||332||
asa~jjAtabalo yastu jvaramukto niShevate| varjyametannarastasya punarAvartate jvaraH||333||
durhRuteShu ca doSheShu yasya vA vinivartate| svalpenapyapacAreNa tasya vyAvartate punaH||334||
cirakAlaparikliShTaM durbalaM hInatejasam | acireNaiva kAlena sa hanti punarAgataH||335||
athavA~api parIpAkaM dhAtuShveva kramAnmalAH| yAnti jvaramakurvantaste tathA~apyapakurvate||336||
dInatAM shvayathuM glAniM pANDutAM nAnnakAmatAm| kaNDUruktoThapiDakAH kurvantyagniM ca te mRudum||337||
evamanye~api ca gadA vyAvartante punargatAH| anirghAtena doShANAmalpairapyahitairnRuNAm||338||
nirvRutte~api jvare tasmAdyathAvasthaM yathAbalam| yathAprANaM hareddoShaM prayogairvA shamaM nayet||339||
mRudubhiH shodhanaiH shuddhiryApanA bastayo hitAH| hitAshca laghavo yUShA jA~ggalAmiShajA rasAH||340||
abhya~ggodvartanasnAnadhUpanAnya~jjanAni ca| hitAni punarAvRutte jvare tiktaghRutAni ca||341||
gurvyabhiShyandyasAtmyAnAM bhojanAt punarAgate| la~gghanoShNopacArAdiH kramaH kAryashca pUrvavat||342||
kirAtatiktakaM tiktA mustaM parpaTako~amRutA| ghnanti pItAni cAbhyAsAt punarAvartakaM jvaram||343||
dvividho vidhibhedena jvaraH shArIramAnasaH| punashca dvividho dRuShTaH saumyashcAgneya eva vA||32||
antarvego bahirvego dvividhaH punarucyate| prAkRuto vaikRutashcaiva sAdhyashcAsAdhya eva ca||33||
punaH pa~jcavidho dRuShTo doShakAlabalAbalAt| santataH satato~anyedyustRutIyakacaturthakau||34||
punarAshrayabhedena dhAtUnAM saptadhA mataH| bhinnaH kAraNabhedena punaraShTavidho jvaraH||35||

tasyAM tasyAmavasthAyAM jvaritAnAM vicakShaNaH| jvarAkriyAkramApekShI kuryAttattaccikitsitam||344||

Commentary: uktAnuktacikitsAparigrahArthamAha- tasyAmityAdi||344||

rogarAT sarvabhUtAnAmantakRuddAruNo jvaraH| tasmAdvisheShatastasya yateta prashame bhiShak||345||

Commentary: jvaracikitsAyAM yatnaM kArayitumAha- rogarADityAdi||345||

tatra shlokaH- yathAkramaM yathAprashnamuktaM jvaracikitsitam| AtreyeNAgniveshAya bhUtAnAM hitakAmyayA||346||

Commentary: yathAkramamiti adhyAyArthasa~ggrahashlokaH| bhUtAnAM hitakAmyayetyanena sarvabhUtahiteyaM cikitseti darshayati||346||

shArIro jAyate pUrvaM dehe, manasi mAnasaH| vaicittyamaratirglAnirmanasastApalakShaNam||36||

Commentary: ‘pRuthagbhinnasya cAkRutim’ iti prashnasya kramAgatamuttaraM- shArIra ityAdi| pUrvamiti vacanAduttarakAlaM shArIro jvaro manasyapi bhavati, evaM mAnaso manasyutpAdAnantaraM dehe~api bhavatIti j~jeyam| evaM ca yadyapi sarvajvarANAM dehamanodhiShThAnatvaM, tathA~api yo dehAshrayI prathamaM sharIradoSheNa balavatA prArabdhaH syAt sa taddoShacikitsayaiva cikitsyaH; evaM mAnaso~api mAnasadoShacikitsayaiva cikitsya iti darshayituM shArIramAnasabhedopadarshanaM sAdhu| nanu shArIrasya jvarasya santApalakShaNaM vyaktaM, mAnasasya tu jvarasya kathaM santApaH, yattasya lakShaNaM bhavatItyAha- vaicittyamityAdi| vaicittyAdayo mAnasasantApashabdenocyante, tApashabdasya pIDAvacanatvAdityarthaH| manastApaprastAvena ‘dehendriyamanastApI’ ityatra ya indriyatApo jvarasyoktastaM ca vyAcakShate- indriyANAM cetyAdi| vaikRutyamiti svabhAvAnyathAtvaM, taccArthAgrahaNAdyanumeyam||36||-

vAtapittAtmakaH shItamuShNaM vAtakaphAtmakaH||37||

Commentary: saumyAgneyabhedayoH pratilomavyAkhyAkrameNa vivaraNaM- vAtapittAtmaka ityAdi| vAtApittAtmaka iti vAtapittakAraNakaH| atra ca kevalavAtArabdhaH, tathA kevalakaphArabdhashca shItasvabhAvakAraNatayA saumyatvenoShNamicchati, tathA vAtakaphAtmako~apyupalabhyate, tathA kevalapittAtmako~apyAgneyatvAdanuShNAbhiprAya iti vyaktaM, tenedAnIM vAtapittAtmakaH shItena vAtena pittena coShNena kRutastasya durupapannAyAmAgneyatAyAM bruvate- vAtapittAtmakaH shItamiti| evaM vyavasthite vAtapittajvare cedvAyuH saMyogamahimnA viparItAnukArI dRuShTaH, tat kiM kaphasaMyukto~api vAyurviparItamarthaM karotItyAsha~gkyAha- uShNaM vAtakaphAtmaka iti; vAtakaphAtmako visheSheNoShNamicchatItyarthaH| vyAmishralakShaNa iti uktavyAmishradoShalakShaNajvaravyatiriktaH kaphapaittikaH sAnnipAtikashca, sa coShNashItAbhiprAyatayA saumyAgneyarAshidvayAtirikta eva jvaraH; yathA- a~ggulIdvayavyatiriktaM trya~ggulam| evaM shArIramAnasamishrIbhAve~api cintanIyam| jvara icchatIti vacanaM jvarayuktapuruShecchAyA jvare upacArAjj~jeyam||37||-

yogavAhaH paraM vAyuH saMyogAdubhayArthakRut||38||

Commentary: vAtapittajvare shItAbhiprAyatAmupapAdayituM vAyoryogavAhitAmAha- yogavAha ityAdi| yogAdyogino guNaM vahatIti yogavAhaH| paramiti atyartham| saMyogAditi uShNena shItena ca saMyogAt| ubhayArthakRuditi yathAsa~gkhyamiha uShNashItArthakArI| etadeva vibhajate- dAhakRudityAdi| ‘pittena’ iti vaktavye yat ‘tejasA’ iti karoti, tena bAhyenApyAtapAdinA yukto vAyurdAhaM karotIti lokaprasiddhamarthaM dRuShTAntArthaM sUcayati| shItakAritvaM tu vAyoH shItatvenaiva yat siddhaM tat somarUpakaphapAnIyAdiyogAdvisheSheNa bhavatIti j~jeyam||38||-
antardAho~adhikastRuShNA pralApaH shvasanaM bhramaH||39||
sandhyasthishUlamasvedo doShavarcovinigrahaH| antarvegasya li~ggAni jvarasyaitAni lakShayet||40||
santApo~abhyadhiko bAhyastRuShNAdInAM ca mArdavam| bahirvegasya li~ggAni sukhasAdhyatvameva ca||41||
prAkRutaH sukhasAdhyastu vasantasharadudbhavaH| uShNamuShNena saMvRuddhaM pittaM sharadi kupyati||42||
citaH shIte kaphashcaivaM vasante samudIryate| varShAsvamlavipAkAbhiradbhiroShadhibhistathA||43||
sa~jcitaM pittamudriktaM sharadyAdityatejasA| jvaraM sa~jjanayatyAshu tasya cAnubalaH kaphaH||44||
prakRutyaiva visargasya tatra nAnashanAdbhayam| adbhiroShadhibhishcaiva madhurAbhishcitaH kaphaH||45||
hemante, sUryasantaptaH sa vasante prakupyati| vasante shleShmaNA tasmAjjvaraH samupajAyate||46||

AdAvante ca madhye ca buddhvA doShabalAbalam||47||

Commentary: tadetAn visheShAn buddhvA cikitsA kartavyeti darshayannAha- AdAvityAdi| sharadvasantayorAdau madhye cAnte ca jvarasya doShabalAbalaM buddhveti yojanA||47||-
kAlaprakRutimuddishya nirdiShTaH prAkRuto jvaraH||48||
prAyeNAnilajo duHkhaH kAleShvanyeShu vaikRutaH| hetavo vividhAstasya nidAne sampradarshitAH||49||

hetubhirbahubhirjAto balibhirbahulakShaNaH||50||

Commentary: nanu balibhirbahubhishca hetubhirjAto bahulakShaNa eva bhaviShyati, tat kiM ‘bahulakShaNaH’ iti padena? ucyate- puruShasyAgnibalAdivisheSheNa doShahetavo yathoktadoShaguNA api na bahulakShaNaM rogaM kurvanti, tathA samprAptivisheShAbhAvAcca na bahulakShaNatvaM bhavati| yaduktam- “ekaM dvau trIn bahUn vA~api dehe dhAtvAdiyogataH| darshayanti vikArAMstu kupitAH pavanAdayaH” iti| shIghramiti utpannamAtra eva||50||-

saptAhAdvA dashAhAdvA dvAdashAhAttathaiva ca||51||

Commentary: saptAhAdvetyAdi| saptAhAdvAtottaraH sapralApabhramashvAsastIkShNo hanti, eva~gguNa eva paittiko dashAhAt, tathaiva~gguNa eva kaphajo dvAdashAhAddhanti, shIghratama-shIghratara-shIghravikArakAritvAdvAtapittakaphAnAmiti varNayanti| vAshabdashca vikalpArthaH; tena saptAhAdiShvapyarvAgapi pareNa vA hananaM lakShyate| anye tu saptAhAt sapralApaH, dashAhAt sabhramaH, dvAdashAhAt sashvAso hantIti vyAkhyAnayanti||51||-

jvaraH kShINasya shUnasya gambhIro dairgharAtrikaH||52||

Commentary: gambhIraH antarvegaH; kiMvA, gambhIradhAtusthaH | dairgharAtrikaH dIrghakAlAnubandhI; kiMvA dIrghAM rAtriM maraNarUpAM karotIti dairgharAtrikaH||52||-
srotobhirvisRutA doShA guravo rasavAhibhiH||53||
sarvadehAnugAH stabdhA jvaraM kurvanti santatam| dashAhaM dvAdashAhaM vA saptAhaM vA suduHsahaH||54||
sa shIghraM shIghrakAritvAt prashamaM yAti hanti vA| kAladUShyaprakRutibhirdoShastulyo hi santatam||55||
niShpratyanIkaH kurute tasmAjj~jeyaH suduHsahaH| yathA dhAtUMstathA mUtraM purIShaM cAnilAdayaH||56||
yugapaccAnupadyante niyamAt santate jvare| sa shuddhyA vA~apyashuddhyA vA rasAdInAmasheShataH||57||
saptAhAdiShu kAleShu prashamaM yAti hanti vA| yadA tu nAtishudhyanti na vA shudhyanti sarvashaH||58||
dvAdashaite samuddiShTAH santatasyAshrayAstadA| visargaM dvAdashe kRutvA divase~avyaktalakShaNam||59||
durlabhopashamaH kAlaM dIrghamapyanuvartate| iti buddhvA jvaraM vaidya upakrAmettu santatam ||60||
raktadhAtvAshrayaH prAyo doShaH satatakaM jvaram||61||
sapratyanIkaH kurute kAlavRuddhikShayAtmakam| ahorAtre satatako dvau kAlAvanuvartate||62||

vijvaraM jvarasandehaM paryapRucchat punarvasum| vivikte shAntamAsInamagniveshaH kRutA~jjaliH||3||

Commentary: vijvaramiti vijvarashabdo nIrogopadarshakaH ; yato jvarashabdena cAtra sAmAnyena rogo~abhimataH, yathA- “jvaro vikAro rogashca” ityAdi| nIrogatveneha rogaprashamanapRucchAshrayatAM gurorbravIti| jvarasandehamiti jvaranidAnoktAtiriktajvaradharmaviShayaM sandeham| vivikta ityAdinA evaM guravaH praShTavyA iti darshayati||3||
dehendriyamanastApI sarvarogAgrajo balI| jvaraH pradhAno rogANAmukto bhagavatA purA||4||
tasya prANisapatnasya dhruvasya pralayodaye| prakRutiM ca pravRuttiM ca prabhAvaM kAraNAni ca||5||
pUrvarUpamadhiShThAnaM balakAlAtmalakShaNam| vyAsato vidhibhedAcca pRuthagbhinnasya cAkRutim||6||
li~ggamAmasya jIrNasya sauShadhaM ca kriyAkramam| vimu~jcataH prashAntasya cihnaM yacca pRuthak pRuthak||7||
jvarAvasRuShTo rakShyashca yAvatkAlaM yato yataH| prashAntaH kAraNairyaishca punarAvartate jvaraH||8||
yAshcApi punarAvRuttaM kriyAH prashamayanti tam| jagaddhitArthaM tat sarvaM bhagavan! vaktumarhasi||9||
tadagniveshasya vaco nishamya gururabravIt| jvarAdhikAre yadvAcyaM tat saumya! nikhilaM shRuNu||10||
kAlaprakRutidUShyANAM prApyaivAnyatamAdbalam| anyedyuShkaM jvaraM doSho ruddhvA medovahAH sirAH||63||
sapratyanIko janayatyekakAlamaharnishi| doSho~asthimajjagaH kuryAttRutIyakacaturthakau||64||
gatirdvyekAntarA~anyedyurdoShasyoktA~anyathA paraiH| anyedyuShkaM jvaraM kuryAdapi saMshritya shoNitam||65||
mAMsasrotAMsyanugato janayettu tRutIyakam| saMshrito medaso mArgaM doShashcApi caturthakam ||66||
anyedyuShkaH pratidinaM dinaM hitvA tRutIyakaH| dinadvayaM yo vishramya pratyeti sa caturthakaH||67||
adhishete yathA bhUmiM bIjaM kAle ca rohati| adhishete tathA dhAtuM doShaH kAle ca kupyati||68||
sa vRuddhiM balakAlaM ca prApya doShastRutIyakam| caturthakaM ca kurute pratyanIkabalakShayAt||69||

kRutvA vegaM gatabalAH sve sve sthAne vyavasthitAH| punarvivRuddhAH sve kAle jvarayanti naraM malAH||70||

Commentary: atha satatakAdau yathA vRuddho doSho jvaravegaM janayati, tasya yathopashamo bhavati, tadAha- kRutvetyAdi| satatakAdau doShA vegaM kRutvA gatabalA bhavanti, gatabalAshca punaH sve sve raktAdau sthAne sthitA bhavanti, punasta eva vRuddhAH sve kAle jvarayanti||70||
kaphapittAttrikagrAhI pRuShThAdvAtakaphAtmakaH| vAtapittAcchirogrAhI trividhaH syAttRutIyakaH||71||
caturthako darshayati prabhAvaM dvividhaM jvaraH| ja~gghAbhyAM shlaiShmikaH pUrvaM shirasto~anilasambhavaH||72||

viShamajvara evAnyashcaturthakaviparyayaH| trividho dhAturekaiko dvidhAtusthaH karoti yam||73||

Commentary: samprati madhye ahanI jvarayatyAdAvante ca yo mu~jcati sa caturthakaviparyayatvena caturthakagrahaNagRuhIta eveti darshayannAha- viShametyAdi| trividho dhAturiti vAtAdiH| dvidhAtustha iti asthimajjagataH| ayaM ca viShamajvara iveti sAmAnyenoktaM, tathA~api caturthakasya prakArarUpaviShamajvara eveti mantavyam| atra tantrAntaram- “asthimajjobhayagate caturthakaviparyayaH| tryahAddvyahaM jvarayati hyAdAvante ca mu~jcati” iti||73||

prAyashaH sannipAtena dRuShTaH pa~jcavidho jvaraH| sannipAte tu yo bhUyAn sa doShaH parikIrtitaH||74||

Commentary: caturthakaviparyayeNa saMyuktapa~jcavidhajvarANAM samAnaM dharmamAha- prAyasha ityAdi| prAyashograhaNAt satatakAdInAM dvandvAdijanyatvamapi sUcayati| nanu, yadi sannipAtArabdhatvameShAM tarhi yaducyate caturthake shlaiShmikatvAdi, tat kathamityAha - sannipAte tu yo bhUyAnityAdi; yata ‘Aganturanubandho hi prAyasho viShamajvara’ iti granthena bhUtAnubandho vaktavyaH; jatUkarNe~api tRutIyakacaturthakaviparyayAvuktvA~abhihitaM- “viShamajvarAstridoShajatve~apyadhikadoShalabdhAkhyAH” iti| ete pa~jcApi jvarAH keShA~jcidviShamajvaratvena sammatAH| tathAhi- viShamatvaM viShama(vega)kAlatvena bhavati; yaduktamanyatra- “viShamo viShamArambhakriyAkAlo~anuSha~ggavAn” (vA. ni.a.2) iti| santate tu dvAdashAhavisargeNa trayodashAhe punaranubandhAt kAlevaiShamyamasti, tena so~api viShama iti| anye tu, santataM parityajya satatakAdIMshcaturo viShamajvarAnicchanti; yataH santate kAlavaiShamyaM tAdRushaM nAsti; uktaM ca kharanAdena- “jvarAH pa~jca mayoktA ye pUrvaM santatakAdayaH| catvAraH santataM hitvA j~jeyAste viShamajvarAH” iti| anye tu- tRutIyakacaturthakAveva viShamau, viShamANAM cireNotpAdAt; yadAha dAruvAhaH- “sUkShmasUkShmatarAsyeShu dUradUratareShu ca| doSho raktAdimArgeShu shanairalpaM cireNa yat|| yAti dehaM na vA(~a)sheShaM bhUyiShThaM pratipadyate| kramo~ayaM tena vicchinnasantApo lakShyate jvare” ityAhuH||74||
RutvahorAtradoShANAM manasashca balAbalAt| kAlamarthavashAccaiva jvarastaM taM prapadyate||75||
gurutvaM dainyamudvegaH sadanaM chardyarocakau| rasasthite bahistApaH sA~ggamardo vijRumbhaNam||76||
raktoShNAH piDakAstRuShNA saraktaM ShThIvanaM muhuH| dAharAgabhramamadapralApA raktasaMsthite||77||
antardAhaH satRuNmohaH saglAniH sRuShTaviTkatA| daurgandhyaM gAtravikShepo jvare mAMsasthite bhavet||78||
svedastIvrA pipAsA ca pralApo vamyabhIkShNashaH| svagandhasyAsahatvaM ca medaHsthe glAnyarocakau||79||
virekavamane cobhe sAsthibhedaM prakUjanam| vikShepaNaM ca gAtrANAM shvAsashcAsthigate jvare||80||
hikkA shvAsastathA kAsastamasashcAtidarshanam| marmacchedo bahiH shaityaM dAho~antashcaiva majjage||81||
shukrasthAnagataH shukramokShaM kRutvA vinAshya ca| prANaM vAyvagnisomaishca sArdhaM gacchatyasau vibhuH||82||
rasaraktAshritaH sAdhyo medomAMsagatashca yaH| asthimajjagataH kRucchraH shukrastho naiva siddhyati||83||
hetubhirlakShaNaishcoktaH pUrvamaShTavidho jvaraH| samAsenopadiShTasya vyAsataH shRuNu lakShaNam||84||
shiroruk parvaNAM bhedo dAho romNAM praharShaNam| kaNThAsyashoSho vamathustRuShNA mUrcchA bhramo~aruciH||85||
svapnanAsho~ativAgjRumbhA vAtapittajvarAkRutiH| shItako gauravaM tandrA staimityaM parvaNAM ca ruk||86||
shirograhaH pratishyAyaH kAsaH svedApravartanam| santApo madhyavegashca vAtashleShmajvarAkRutiH||87||
muhurdAho muhuH shItaM svedastambho muhurmuhuH| mohaH kAso~arucistRuShNA shleShmapittapravartanam||88||
... sannipAtaja ucyate||89||
sannipAtajvarasyordhvaM trayodashavidhasya hi| prAksUtritasya vakShyAmi lakShaNaM vai pRuthak pRuthak||90||
bhramaH pipAsA dAhashca gauravaM shiraso~atiruk| vAtapittolbaNe vidyAlli~ggaM mandakaphe jvare||91||
shaityaM kAso~arucistandrApipAsAdAharugvyathAH| vAtashleShmolbaNe vyAdhau li~ggaM pittAvare viduH||92||
chardiH shaityaM muhurdAhastRuShNA moho~asthivedanA| mandavAte vyavasyanti li~ggaM pittakapholbaNe||93||
sandhyasthishirasaH shUlaM pralApo gauravaM bhramaH| vAtolbaNe syAd dvyanuge tRuShNA kaNThAsyashuShkatA||94||
raktaviNmUtratA dAhaH svedastRuD balasa~gkShayaH| mUrcchA ceti tridoShe syAlli~ggaM pitte garIyasi||95||
AlasyArucihRullAsadAhavamyaratibhramaiH| kapholbaNaM sannipAtaM tandrAkAsena cAdishet||96||
pratishyA chardirAlasyaM tandrA~arucyagnimArdavam| hInavAte pittamadhye li~ggaM shleShmAdhike matam||97||
hAridramUtranetratvaM dAhastRuShNA bhramo~aruciH| hInavAte madhyakaphe li~ggaM pittAdhike matam||98||
shirorugvepathuH shvAsaH pralApashchardyarocakau| hInapitte madhyakaphe li~ggaM syAnmArutAdhike||99||
shItako gauravaM tandrA pralApo~asthishiro~atiruk| hInapitte vAtamadhye li~ggaM shleShmAdhike viduH||100||
paTolaH sArivA mustaM pAThA kaTukarohiNI| nimbaH paTolastriphalA mRudvIkA mustavatsakau||101||
varcobhedo~agnidaurbalyaM tRuShNA dAho~arucirbhramaH| kaphahIne vAtamadhye li~ggaM pittAdhike viduH||102||
sannipAtajvarasyordhvamato vakShyAmi lakShaNam| kShaNe dAhaH kShaNe shItamasthisandhishirorujA||103||
sAsrAve kaluShe rakte nirbhugne cApi darshane | sasvanau sarujau karNau kaNThaH shUkairivAvRutaH||104||
tandrA mohaH pralApashca kAsaH shvAso~arucirbhramaH| paridagdhA kharasparshA jihvA srastA~ggatA param||105||
ShThIvanaM raktapittasya kaphenonmishritasya ca| shiraso loThanaM tRuShNA nidrAnAsho hRudi vyathA||106||
svedamUtrapurIShANAM cirAddarshanamalpashaH| kRushatvaM nAtigAtrANAM pratataM kaNThakUjanam||107||
koThAnAM shyAvaraktAnAM maNDalAnAM ca darshanam| mUkatvaM srotasAM pAko gurutvamudarasya ca||108||

doShe vibaddhe naShTe~agnau sarvasampUrNalakShaNaH||109||

Commentary: sannipAtasyAsAdhyatAkRucchrasAdhyatAlakShaNamAha- doSha ityAdi| atra doShashabdo vibaddhopapadAnmale vartate| naShTe~agnAviti itarajvarApekShayA~adhikatayA naShTe~agnAvityarthaH| sarvANi ca sampUrNAni balIyAMsi lakShaNAni yasya sa sarvasampUrNalakShaNaH| asAdhyakRucchrasAdhyAbhidhAnena sukhasAdhyo na bhavatIti darshitam| yaduktaM- “sannipAto duHshcikitsyAnAM” (sU.a.25) iti, tathA ca bhAlukinA- “mRutyunA saha yoddhavyaM sannipAtaM cikitsatA” iti||109||-

nidAne trividhA proktA yA pRuthagjajvarAkRutiH||110||

Commentary: nidAna ityAdi| nidAne jvaranidAne, proktA “tatra yathoktAnAM li~ggAnAM” (ni.a.1) ityAdinA granthena prAguktetyarthaH; punaH prakaraNAgatatvAducyata iti na paunaruktyam| tayA coktaM svalakShaNamiti tayA dvandvarUpayA dvandvalakShaNaM, tathA sannipAtarUpayA sannipAtalakShaNamuktamityarthaH||110||-
AganturaShTamo yastu sa nirdiShTashcaturvidhaH||111||
abhighAtAbhiSha~ggAbhyAmabhicArAbhishApataH| shastraloShTakashAkAShThamuShTyaratnitaladvijaiH||112||
tadvidhaishca hate gAtre jvaraH syAdabhighAtajaH| tatrAbhighAtaje vAyuH prAyo raktaM pradUShayan||113||
kAmashokabhayakrodhairabhiShaktasya yo jvaraH||114||
so~abhiSha~ggAjvaro j~jeyo yashca bhUtAbhiSha~ggajaH| kAmashokabhayAdvAyuH, krodhAt pittaM, trayo malAH||115||
bhUtAbhiSha~ggAt kupyanti bhUtasAmAnyalakShaNAH| bhUtAdhikAre vyAkhyAtaM tadaShTavidhalakShaNam||116||
viShavRukShAnilasparshAttathA~anyairviShasambhavaiH| abhiShaktasya cApyAhurjvarameke~abhiSha~ggajam||117||
cikitsayA viShaghnyaiva sa shamaM labhate naraH| abhicArAbhishApAbhyAM siddhAnAM yaH pravartate||118||
sannipAtajvaro ghoraH sa vij~jeyaH suduHsahaH| sannipAtajvarasyoktaM li~ggaM yattasya tat smRutam||119||
cittondriyasharIrANAmartayo~anyAshca naikashaH| prayogaM tvabhicArasya dRuShTvA shApasya caiva hi||120||
svayaM shrutvA~anumAnena lakShyate prashamena vA| vaividhyAdabhicArasya shApasya ca tadAtmake||121||
yathAkarmaprayogeNa lakShaNaM syAt pRuthagvidham| dhyAnaniHshvAsabahulaM li~ggaM kAmajvare smRutam||122||
shokaje bAShpabahulaM trAsaprAyaM bhayajvare| krodhaje bahusaMrambhaM bhUtAveshe tvamAnuSham||123||
mUrcchAmohamadaglAnibhUyiShThaM viShasambhave| keShA~jcideShAM li~ggAnAM santApo jAyate puraH||124||
pashcAttulyaM tu keShA~jcideShu kAmajvarAdiShu| kAmAdijAnAmuddiShTaM jvarANAM yadvisheShaNam||125||
kAmAdijAnAM rogANAmanyeShAmapi tat smRutam| manasyabhihate pUrvaM kAmAdyairna tathA balam||126||
jvaraH prApnoti vAtAdyairdeho yAvanna dUShyati| dehe cAbhiha(dru)te pUrvaM vAtAdyairna tathA balam||127||

te pUrvaM kevalAH pashcAnnijairvyAmishralakShaNAH||128||

Commentary: AgantornijAdbhedakaM dharmamAha- te pUrvamityAdi| kevalA iti nijadoSharahitAH| nijairiti nijadoShalakShaNaiH| hetvauShadhavishiShTAshceti nijajjvarAdvishiShTahetavo vishiShTauShadhAshca bhavanti; tatra vishiShTo heturabhighAtAdiH, bheShajaM ca pariShekamantrAdi||128||-
saMsRuShTAH sannipatitAH pRuthagvA kupitA malAH||129||
rasAkhyaM dhAtumanvetya paktiM sthAnAnnirasya ca| svena tenoShmaNa caiva kRutvA dehoShmaNo balam||130||
srotAMsi ruddhvA samprAptAH kevalaM dehamulbaNAH| santApamadhikaM dehe janayanti narastadA||131||

srotasAM sanniruddhatvAt svedaM nA nAdhigacchati||132||

Commentary: svedaM nA nAdhigacchatItyatra prAya iti yojyaM, kvacijjvare svedasyApyabhihitatvAt| nA iti puruShaH||132||-

jvaro vikAro rogashca vyAdhirAta~gka eva ca| eko~artho nAmaparyAyairvividhairabhidhIyate||11||

Commentary: jvaro vikAra ityAdi| prashnagranthAsUcitasyApi paryAyakathanaM vRuttameva, tathA~api punaHprakaraNavashAdabhidhAnamiti na punaruktadoSha iti bruvate; kiMvA jvarasyaivAdhikRutasyaitatparyAyakathanam| vikArAdayashca yadyapi sAmAnyena rogAbhidhAyinaH, tathA~api prakaraNAdiha jvara eva vishiShTe vyAdhau vartante| yathA- brAhmaNaM bhojayedityatra bhojanaprakaraNAt sAmAnyo~api brAhmaNashabda AmantritabrAhmaNe vartate| tasmiMshca vyAkhyAne jvarAdiparyAyAbhidheyarUpA vivRutiH ‘jvaro vikAraH’ ityAdinA ucyata iti nApi punaruktisha~gkA| nAmashabdaH prakAshane, tena eko~artho nAma jvaralakShaNo rogalakShaNo vA paryAyairucyata ityarthaH| paryAyA ekArthAbhidhAyino bhinnajAtIyAH shabdAH; kiMvA, nAmaparyAyairiti nAmarUpaiH paryAyaiH; vyavahriyamANaiH paryAyairityarthaH| yataH paryAyo~avyavahriyamANo~api bhavati, yathA- AyuShi nityagAnubandhashabdarUpau paryAyAvuktau||11||
arucishcAvipAkashca gurutvamudarasya ca||133||
hRudayasyAvishuddhishca tandrA cAlasyameva ca| jvaro~avisargI balavAn doShANAmapravartanam||134||
lAlApraseko hRullAsaH kShunnAsho virasaM mukham| stabdhasuptaguruvaM ca gAtrANAM bahumUtratA||135||
na viD jIrNA na ca glAnirjvarasyAmasya lakShaNam| jvaravego~adhikastRuShNA pralApaH shvasanaM bhramaH||136||

kShut kShAmatA laghutvaM ca gAtrANAM jvaramArdavam||137||

Commentary: kShut kShAmatetyAdinA nirAmajvaralakShaNamAha| atra ca kShudAdayo doShapAkAdbhavanto vinA~apyaShTAhaM nirAmadoShArabdhajvaralakShaNaM bhavanti| aShTAhastu kShudAdIn vinA doShapAke~asatyapi bheShajadAnayogyAM jvarasya vyAdhernirAmatAM brUte, ata eva “pAcanaM shamanIyaM vA kaShAyaM pAyayettu tam” iti vikalpadvayena yadA~aShTAhe kShudAdidoShapAkalakShaNAnudayastadA doShapAkArthaM pAcanIyaM deyam, atha kShudhAdisamudayo~api jAtastadA shamanIyaM deyaM sarvathA nirAmatvAjjvarasya| etAmeva sarvathAnirAmatAmupadishatA kharanAdenoktaM yat- “na ca niHsaptataivaikA nirAmajvaralakShaNam| cirAdapi hi pacyante sannipAtajvare malAH|| saptarAtrAtivRuttiM ca kShAmatAdi ca lakShaNam| tasmAdetaddvayaM dRuShTvA nirAmaM jvaramAdishet” iti| aShTAhAdarvAgdoShapAkajanitakShudAdidarshanAnnirAmatA sushrutenAShTAhAdarvAgbheShajadAna darshayatA pratipAditA| yaduktam- “arvAgapi ca deyaM syAdbheShajaM doShapAkataH” (su.u.a.39) iti| tasmAt kShudAdayo~aShTAhashca vyastaM samastaM ca lakShaNaM yathoktanyAyAjj~jeyam||137||-

navajvare divAsvapnasnAnAbhya~ggAnnamaithunam||138||

Commentary: sauShadhaM ca kriyAkramamityanena yadyapyauShadhamAdAvuktaM, tathA~api tasya kriyAkramavisheShaNatayA aprAdhAnyamiti kRutvA auShadhamatikramya ‘navajvare’ ityAdinA kriyAkramaM brUte| kriyAyAshcikitsAyAH kramaH paripATI| tatrApyahitasyaiva prathamaM niShedhaH| annashabdena gurvannamabhidhatte| hArItena hi- “navajvare vyavAyAdi pratyekaM doShakopanam| gurvannabhojanAccApi viShTambho doShakopanam ” ityuktam| kaShAyAMshceti jAtau bahuvacanaM; tena kaShAyaM varjayedityarthaH| uktaM hyatra jatUkarNena- “kaShAyarasagurUShNasnigdhAnnasnAnAbhya~ggAn navajvare varjayet” iti||138||-

jvare la~gghanamevAdAvupadiShTamRute jvarAt||139||

Commentary: jvare ityAdi| la~gghanashabdenehAnashanaM vivakShitaM, yadyapi “catuShprakArA saMshuddhiH” (sU.a.22) ityAdinA la~gghanabRuMhaNIye dashavidhameva la~gghanamuktaM, tathA~api teShAmihAvasthAvisheSheNa viniyogAlla~gghanameveti niyamo~apavAdaviShayaM tyaktvA samuccIyamAnAvadhAraNe j~jeyaH, yathA- “naraM ca nArAyaNameva cobhau svataH sutau sa~jjanayAmbabhUva” ityatra| tenAvasthAyAM vamanamapi bhavati vakShyamANam| yattu la~gghanabRuMhaNIye kaphapittajvaracchardyAdiShu madhye jvaraM paThitvoktaM- “pAcanaistAn bhiShak prAj~jaH prAyeNAdAvupAcaret” (sU.a.22) iti, tatra bheShajaprayogasyAdau pAcanaM kartavyamiti brUte, na jvarAdau; tenehAdau la~gghanAbhidhAnaM na virudhyate| hArIte tu “pittashleShmavishuddhyarthaM kuryAdvamanamAditaH” iti yaduktaM, tat ‘kaphapradhAnAn’ ityAdivakShyamANAvasthAyAM j~jeyam| kShayashabdena dhAtukShayakRutaM jvaraM kiMvA rAjayakShmajvaraM gRuhNAti, anilashabdena nirAmAnilagrahaNaM; kiMvA kShayanilashabdena dhAtukShayakupitAnilagrahaNam| yaduktaM- “vAyordhAtukShayAt kopo mArgasyAvaraNena ca” (ci.a.28) iti| yastu mArgAvaraNena vAyuH kupyati, sa AvarakadharmitayA prAyeNa sAmo bhavati, tatra ca la~gghanaM mAtrayA kartavyameva| yaduktaM- “sAme vAte~api la~gghanam| kuryAdevAmapaktyarthaM yuktyA, na tu yathA kaphe” iti| anilajvaramuktvA~api kAmAdijvarAbhidhAnaM teShu kAlAntareNa vAtasambandho bhavati, tena prathamamapi vAtAsambandhe kAmAdijvarANAmala~gghanIyatvopadarshanArtham||139||-
la~gghanena kShayaM nIte doShe sandhukShite~anale||140||
vijvaratvaM laghutvaM ca kShuccaivAsyopajAyate | prANAvirodhinA cainaM la~gghanenopapAdayet||141||

la~gghanaM svedanaM kAlo yavAgvastiktako rasaH||142||

Commentary: prakRutasya la~gghanasya pAcanatAM darshayannaparANyapi svedAdIni pAcanAnyAha- la~gghanamityAdi| kAla iti aShTAhaH| tiktako raso~atra yavAgUpAnIyAdisaMskArakatvena j~jeyaH, svatantrabheShajaprayogastaruNe niShiddha eva| uktaM hi- “bheShajaM hyAmadoShasya bhUyo jvalayati jvaram” iti| ‘avipakvAnAM doShANAm’ iti kRutvA~api ‘taruNe jvare’ iti yat karoti, tenAShTAhAdUrdhvamataruNe jvare~apakveShu doSheShu prAdhAnyena kaShAyapAnaM pAcanamadhikRutaM, na la~gghanAdaya iti darshayati||142||-
tRuShyate salilaM coShNaM dadyAdvAtakaphajvare ||143||
madyotthe paittike cAtha shItalaM tiktakaiH shRutam| dIpanaM pAcanaM caiva jvaraghnamubhayaM hi tat||144||

mustaparpaTakoshIracandanodIcyanAgaraiH||145||

Commentary: mustetyAdiH pAnIyasAdhakaH ShaDa~ggaprayogaH| atra shuNThI atiktA~apyAmAshayaduShTikArakajvarahitatvAdvihitA; atra shRutashItaM jalaM dadyAditi jalasaMskArashrutyA na kvAthaparibhAShayA kvAthakaraNaM, kintu jalasaMskAraparibhAShayA| paribhAShA ca svatantrAnuktA~api vRuddhavyavahArasiddhA pramANIbhUtaiva| sA ca “yadapsu shRutashItAsu ShaDa~ggAdi prayujyate| karShamAtraM tato dravyaM sAdhayet prAsthike~ambhasi|| ardhashRutaM prayoktavyaM pAne peyAdisaMvidhau” iti; paribhAShArthashca vyakta eva||145||-

tasya prakRutiruddiShTA doShAH shArIramAnasAH| dehinaM na hi nirdoShaM jvaraH samupasevate||12||

Commentary: prakRutishabdeneha svabhAvaH, tathA yatkAraNamayaM kAryaM bhavati taducyate; tatra pratyAsannakAraNarUpAM prakRutimAha- tasyetyAdi| uddiShTeti sa~gkShepAdabhihitA| doShANAM jvaraprakRutitve hetumAha- dehinamityAdi| sarvadoShAvyabhicArAjjvarasya doShaprakRutitvaM siddhamiti bhAvaH| dehishabdena sharIravAn puruSho~abhipreto na kevala AtmA, tasya nirvikAratvAt| ‘samupasevate’ iti bhAShayA bhUtavisheSharUpasya jvarasyAveshaM darshayati; vigrahashca jvarasya svatantre vaktavya eva- ‘jvarastripAdastrishirAH’ ityAdinoktaH||12||

kShayastamo jvaraH pApmA mRutyushcoktA yamAtmakAH| pa~jcatvapratyayAnnRUNAM klishyatAM svena karmaNA||13||

Commentary: svabhAvarUpAM jvaraprakRutimAha- kShaya ityAdi| dehakShayahetutvAt kShayaH, mohakartRutvAttamaH, pApanirvartyatvAt pApmA, mRutyukAraNatvAnmRutyurjvara evocyate| atra ca ‘uktAH’ iti tathA ‘yamAtmakAH’ iti bahuvacanamekasminnarthe jvare kShayakartRutvAdidharmabhedavivakShayA j~jeyam| yamAtmakA iti yamasvarUpAH; yamo hi yathA mArakaH, tathA~amI mArakA ityato yamAtmakA ityarthaH| kiMvA ‘yamAtmajAH’ iti pAThaH; atrApi yamaputratvena pitRusamAnakriyAkartRutvamucyate| ki~jca kShayAdayaH svanAmaprasiddhA yamasvarUpA bhinnA eva jvarAt, iha tu jvarasya yamAtmakatvAbhidhAnaprasa~ggAtte~apyucyante| asmin vyAkhyAne mRutyushabdena mRutyusUcakaM riShTamucyate, yato na mRutyureva mRutyukaro bhavati| yamAtmakatve hetumAha- pa~jcatvapratyayAnnRUNAM klishyatAM svena karmaNeti| etena, yathA yamaH svakarmaklishyamAnAnAM prANinAM pa~jcatve heturbhavati, tathA kShayAdayo~api prAktanakarmaNA klishyamAnAn mArayantItyarthaH| ‘pa~jcatvapratyayA’ iti vA pAThaH, tathA~api sa evArtho j~jeyaH ||13||-

... pravRuttistu parigrahAt| nidAne pUrvamuddiShTA rudrakopAcca dAruNAt||14||

Commentary: kramAgatAM pravRuttimAha- pravRuttistvityAdi| pravRuttiH prathamAvirbhAvaH| parigrahAditi janapadoddhvaMsanIye “bhrashyati tu kRutayuge” (vi.a.3) ityAdinA parigrahAjjvarAdipravRuttimuktAM smArayati| tathA rudrakopAddAruNAdyA pravRuttirjvarasya, sA nidAne pUrvamuddiShTA; “jvarastu khalu maheshvarakopaprabhavaH” (ni.a.1) iti granthena nidAne sa~gkShepeNoktetyarthaH| pUrvamiti padena rudrakopaprabhavA prathamA, parigrahaprabhavA tu dvitIyA pravRuttiriti darshayati||14||

kaphapradhAnAnutkliShTAn doShAnAmAshayasthitAn||146||

Commentary: avisheSheNa taruNAtaruNajvare~avasthAvidheyaM vamanamAha- kaphapradhAnAnityAdi| kaphaH pradhAno yeShAM te kaphapradhAnAH| utkliShTAniti hRullAsAdinA bahirgamanonmukhAn| AmAshayasthitAnityanena sarvasharIraM parityajyAmAshayagamanaM darshayati| jvarakarAnityanena jvarakarAn hi doShAnevaMvidhAneva navajvare vamanairharet, nAnyatheti darshayati| kAle iti yathoktAyAmavasthAyAm| vamanairiti bahuvacanena prakRutyAdyapekShayA bahUnAM vamanadravyayogAnAM prayogaM darshayati| vamyAnAmityanena avamyagarbhiNyAdiShu vamanaM niShedhayati| atra ca svayamevotkliShTatvAddoShasya doShotkleshaprayojanakau snehasvedau na kriyete, alpau vA kriyete||146||-
anupasthitadoShANAM vamanaM taruNejvare||147||
hRudrogaM shvAsamAnAhaM mohaM ca janayedbhRusham| sarvadehAnugAH sAmA dhAtusthA asunirharAH ||148||
vamitaM la~gghitaM kAle yavAgUbhirupAcaret||149||
yathAsvauShadhasiddhAbhirmaNDapUrvAbhirAditaH| yAvajjvaramRudUbhAvAt ShaDahaM vA vicakShaNaH||150||
tasyAgnirdIpyate tAbhiH samidbhiriva pAvakaH| tAshca bheShajasaMyogAllaghutvAccAgnidIpanAH||151||
vAtamUtrapurIShANAM doShANAM cAnulomanAH| svedanAya dravoShNatvAddravatvAttRuTprashAntaye||152||
AhArabhAvAt prANAya saratvAllAghavAya ca| jvaraghnyo jvarasAtmyatvAttasmAt peyAbhirAditaH||153||
jvarAnupacareddhImAnRute madyasamutthitAt| madAtyaye madyanitye grIShme pittakaphAdhike||154||

tatra tarpaNamevAgre prayojyaM lAjasaktubhiH||155||

Commentary: ‘Urdhvage tarpaNaM pUrvaM’ (ci.a.4) iti vacasA yavAgUM bAdhitvA Urdhvage raktapitte tarpaNaM yadyapi vihitameva, tathA~apyUrdhvagaraktapittino yo jvarastatrApi tarpaNAdikramavidhAnametat| tarpaNaM toyapariplutAH saktavaH| jvarApahAni phalAni drAkShAdADimAdIni| vacanaM hi- “drAkShAdaDimakharjUrapriyAlaiH saparUShakaiH| tarpaNArheShu kartavyaM tarpaNaM jvaranAshanam” iti||155||-
tataH sAtmyabalApekShI bhojayejjIrNatarpaNam||156||
tanunA mudgayUSheNa jA~ggalAnAM rasena vA| annakAleShu cApyasmai vidheyaM dantadhAvanam||157||
yo~asya vaktrarasastasmAdviparItaM priyaM ca yat| tadasya mukhavaishadyaM prakA~gkShAM cAnnapAnayoH||158||
dhatte rasavisheShANAmabhij~jatvaM karoti yat| vishodhya drumashAkhAgrairAsyaM prakShAlya cAsakRut||159||

pAcanaM shamanIyaM vA kaShAyaM pAyayedbhiShak||160||

Commentary: samprati kaShAyapAnaviShayamAha- pAcanamityAdi| pAcanamiti AmadoShapacanam| shamanIyamiti pakvadoShopashamanam| etacca vikalpadvayaM yogyatayA yathAkramamAmadoShaviShayaM tathA pakvadoShaviShayaM j~jeyam| ShaDahe~atIte iti jvarAhAdArabhya ShaDahe~atikrAnte; ataH saptame~ahani laghvannaM mAtrayA svarUpeNa ca yat, tatpratibhojitaM jvaritamaShTame~ahani kaShAyaM pAyayediti vAkyArthaH| evaM ca pUrvoktAShTAhakRutanirAmatAvyavasthAyAH pAcanasya shamanIyasya vA upayoga upapanno bhavati| nanu peyAprayoge “yAvajjvaramRudubhAvAt ShaDahaM vA vicakShaNaH” ityuktaM, tatashca peyayaiva tAvat ShaDaho vyApyate, pUrvaM ca jvarAdau la~gghanamuktaM, taccAnirdiShTakAlamapi ‘la~gghanena kShayaM nIte’ ityAdigranthoktala~gghitaphalaM yAvatA kAlena bhavati tAvatkAlaM kartavyaM; hArItena tu kAlo~api darshitaH, yathA- “la~gghanaM la~gghanIyAnAM kuryAddoShAnurUpataH| trirAtramekarAtraM vA ShaDrAtramathavA jvare” iti; tena jvarala~gghanadinaistathA ShaDahena ca samaM jvarAhAdArabhyAShTAhAtikramo~api bhavati, tatashca jvarAhAdArabhyAShTAhe pAcanashamanIyakaShAyo bhavatu, tasmAt peyAprayogaShaDahe~atIte “pAcanaM shamanIyaM vA kaShAyaM pAyayet” ityabhiprAyaH , tathA ‘jvare peyAH kaShAyAshca kShIraM sarpirvirecanam| ShaDahe ShaDahe deyaM vIkShya doShabalAbale” (ci.a.30) ityanena granthenApi peyAprayogaShaDahAdUrdhvaM kaShAyaShaDaha uktaH, na tu jvarotpAdAdiShaDahAdUrdhvam| atra brUmaH- “yAvajjvaramRudUbhAvAt ShaDahaM vA vicakShaNaH” ityanenApi jvarotpAdadinAdArabhya ShaDahaparyantaM peyAprayoga ucyate, peyA hi jvare prAdhAnyena doShapAcanArthaM prayujyate| yaduktaM- “la~gghanaM svedanaM kAlo yavAgvastiktako rasaH| pAcanAnyavipakvAnAM doShANAM taruNe jvare” iti| la~gghanAdipAcanIyatvaM doShANAmaShTAhadarvAgeva, aShTAhAdUrdhvaM tu kaShAyeNaiva pAcanamuktam | tatrAla~gghanIye vAtajvare AdidinAt prabhRuti peyA ShaDahamapi vyApnoti , ekadvitradinala~gghite jvare peyA pa~jcacatustridinaprayogeNa jvaradinAdArabhya ShaDahaparyantaM kartavyA| yatra tu doShANAmapi sAmatayA sannipAtajvare vA la~gghanameva ShaDrAtraM ShaDrAtrAdikrameNa vA kriyate, tatra prAdeshike vidhau nAyaM peyAShaDrAtraniyama autsargikaH pravartate| ki~jcAtimAtrala~gghanaprayoge peyA na doShapAcanArthaM kriyate, kintu bhUrila~gghanakShayitAgneH sandhukShaNArthaM, tatrAgnisandhukShaNe jAte punarauShadhapAnameva bhavati| “jvare peyAH kaShAyashca” (ci.a.30) ityAdau peyA samAnakAryANAM la~gghanAdInAmupalakShaNabhUtA; tatashca peyA yatra pratiShiddhA madyotthajvarAdau tatra tarpaNAdikrameNApi ShaDaho grAhyaH| tena, prathamaShaDahe utsargato la~gghanAdipAcanaM kartavyamiti peyA ShaDahe deyeti; vacanamapyatrocyate, tathAhi sushrute- “la~gghanAmbuyavAgUbhiryadA doSho na pacyate| tadA taM mukhavairasyatRuShNArocakanAshanaiH|| kaShAyaiH pAcanairhRudyairjvaraghnaiH samupAcaret” (su.u.taM.a.39) ityuktvA, kaShAyapAnakAlaniyame proktaM- “saptarAtrAt paraM kecinmanyante deyamauShadham” (su.u.taM.a.39) ityAdi| tatashca la~gghanAdiShaDahe~atikrAnte saptarAtrAdbheShajadAnaM sushrutenAsthApyApratiShedhAdanumatameva| tathA carake “la~gghanaM svedanaM” ityAdinA taruNajvare la~gghanAdi vihitaM, taruNatA ca jvarasya saptAhamAtraM bhavati| yaduktaM puShkalAvate- “AsaptarAtraM taruNaM jvaramAhurmanIShiNaH| madhyaM dvAdasharAtraM tu, purANamata uttaram” iti| saptAhAdUrdhvamataruNe jvare utsargatastAvalla~gghanapeyAdi na vihitameva carakeNApi, tathA hArItenApi la~gghanoShNodakamustAdishRutajalapAnapeyAbhidhAnAnantaramuktam- “etAM kriyAM prayu~jjIta ShaDrAtraM saptame~ahani| pibet kaShAyasaMyogAn jvaraghnAn sAdhusAdhitAn ” iti| tathA kharanAdenApi- “la~gghitAla~gghitaM tasmAdvamitaM vA jvarArditam| tatsAtmyatvAdatastasminnAdau jvaramupAcaret|| yavAgUbhiryathAdoShaM” ityAdinA tarpaNAdikramaM cAbhidhAyoktam- “iti ShaDrAtrikaH prokto navajvaraharo vidhiH| tataH paraM pAcanIyaM shamanaM vA jvare hitam” iti| tantrAntare ca yadetat saptame~ahani kaShAyapAnavidhAnaM, tadaShTAhe vihitakaShAyapAnena samamadUrAntaratvAnna virodhIti mantavyaM, tasmAjjvarAhAdArabhya ShaDahe~atIte laghvannapratibhojite kaShAyapAnaM, tathA ShaDahaM yAvat yavAgUpacAra iti, tathA “jvare peyAH kaShAyAshca” (ci.a.30) ityAdaya utsargavidhayaH, tenaiShAM kvacidbAdhanamapi bhavatIti yuktameva||160||-
stabhyante na vipacyante kurvanti viShamajvaram||161||
dvitIye hi yuge sharvamakrodhavratamAsthitam| divyaM sahasraM varShANAmasurA abhidudruvuH||15||
tapovighnAshanAH kartuM tapovighnaM mahAtmanaH| pashyan samarthashcopekShAM cakre dakShaH prajApatiH||16||
punarmAheshvaraM bhAgaM dhruvaM dakShaH prajApatiH| yaj~je na kalpayAmAsa procyamAnaH surairapi||17||
RucaH pashupateryAshca shaivya Ahatayashca yAH| yaj~jasiddhipradAstAbhirhInaM caiva sa iShTavAn||18||
athottIrNavrato devo buddhvA dakShavyatikramam| rudro raudraM puraskRutya bhAvamAtmavidAtmanaH||19||
sRuShTvA lalATe cakShurvai dagdhvA tAnasurAn prabhuH| bAlaM krodhAgnisantaptamasRujat satranAshanam||20||
tato yaj~jaH sa vidhvasto vyathitAshca divaukasaH| dAhavyathAparItAshca bhrAntA bhUtagaNA dishaH||21||
atheshvaraM devagaNaH saha saptarShibhirvibhum| tamRugbhirastuvan yAvacchaive bhAve shivaH sthitaH||22||
shivaM shivAya bhUtAnAM sthitaM j~jAtvA kRutA~jjaliH| bhiyA bhasmapraharaNastrishirA navalocanaH||23||
jvAlAmAlAkulo raudro hrasvaja~gghodaraH kramAt| krodhAgniruktavAn devamahaM kiM karavANi te||24||
tamuvAceshvaraH krodhaM jvaro loke bhaviShyasi| janmAdau nidhane ca tvamapacArAntareShu ca||25||
doShA baddhAH kaShAyeNa stambhitvAttaruNe jvare| na tu kalpanamuddishya kaShAyaH pratiShidhyate||162||

yUShairamlairanamlairvA jA~ggalairvA rasairhitaiH||163||

Commentary: yavAgUttarakAlaM bhojanasAdhanamAha- yUShairityAdi| yadi kaphaprabalatA balavadagnishca tadA yUShaiH, vAtaprAbalye tu durbalatve ca rasairiti vyavasthA| amlavikalpo~api sAtmyApekShayA~agnyapekShayA ca j~jeyaH| vakShyati hi- “mandAgnaye~amlasAtmyAya tatsAmlamapi kalpayet” iti| amlaM cAtra jvaraghnaM dADimAdyeva kAryam| laghviti mAtrAlaghu prakRutilaghu ca raktashAlyAdikam||163||-

ata UrdhvaM kaphe mande vAtapittottare jvare||164||

Commentary: dashAhAt parataH prAyaH kartavyamAha- ata ityAdi| kaphe mande iti mande~api kaphe; yadi kapho nAstyeva doSharUpastadA sarpirvAtapittottare jvare deyamityarthaH| paripakveShviti sarvathA pakveShu| sarpiriti vaktavye adhikapAnagrahaNenAnuvAsanAbhya~ggAdinA sarpiSha upayogamasmin kAle niShedhayati| anuvAsanAbhya~ggau hi pashcAtkAlavaktavyau| iyaM ca mandakaphavAtapittottaratvarUpA~avasthA prAyeNa dashAhAdUrdhvaM kAlamahimnaiva sarvajvare vyaktA bhavati; yathA- vRuddhe puruShe prabalavAtatvaM, taruNajvare sAmadoShatA, tathA~a~amAshayasamutthatayA kaphaprabalatvaM bhavati; dashAhAduttaraM tu la~gghanAdinA kaphaH kShINo bhavati, jvarasantApena ca rUkSheNa dhAtushoShaNAcca vAtapitte vardhete| yattu peyAkaShAyasarpiHkShIravirecanAnAM ShaDahe ShaDahe deyatvaM tat prAyikam| tena dashAhAdUrdhvaM dvitIyaShaDaha evAvasthAvisheShaprAptau sarpirdAnaM na virodhi||164||-
nirdashAhamapi j~jAtvA kaphottaramala~gghitam||165||
na sarpiH pAyayedvaidyaH kaShAyaistamupAcaret | yAvallaghutvAdashanaM dadyAnmAMsarasena ca||166||

dAhatRuShNAparItasya vAtapittottaraM jvaram||167||

Commentary: dAhetyAdina kShIrAvasthAmAha| baddhapracyutadoShaM vetyatra baddhadoShatvam apravartamAnadoShatvaM, pracyutadoShatvaM tu stokena pravartamAnadoShatvam| tatra kShIraM tAvad yathA baddhe pravartakaM bhavati, tathA pracyute~api savibandhadoShapravartakatayopakArakaM bhavati, ata eva kShIraguNeShu-“purIShe grathite pathyaM”, tathA “atIsAre ca pathyaM” (sU.a.1) ityuktam| kiMvA, baddhadoShe gavyaM kShIraM saratvAddeyaM, pracyute tu sa~ggrAhitvAcchAgaM deyam||167||-

kriyAbhirAbhiH prashamaM na prayAti yadA jvaraH||168||

Commentary: ‘AbhiH kriyAbhiryadA na prashamaM yAti jvarastadA virecanaiH shamayet’ iti bhAShayA virecanasya bahuvyApatkatayA itarakarmAsiddhAveva kartavyatAM darshayati| virecanairiti bahuvacanena vamanavirecane api gRuhyete; yaduktaM- “ubhayamapi doShamalavirecanAdvirecanashabdaM labhate” (ka.a.1) iti, tathA virecanayogavivaraNe vamanavirecanayogAnevAbhidhAsyati||168||-
jvarakShINasya na hitaM vamanaM na virecanam||169||
kAmaM tu payasA tasya nirUhairvA harenmalAn| nirUho balamagniM ca vijvaratvaM mudaM rucim||170||

pittaM vA kaphapittaM vA pittAshayagataM haret||171||

Commentary: virecanAsthApanayordoShabhedena sthAnabhedena ca viShayamAha- pittamityAdi| vamanasya tu doShabhedena sthAnabhedena ca viShayaH ‘kaphapradhAnAn’ ityAdinaivokta iti neha punarucyate; paraM pUrvamavasthAvihitaM vamanaM svayamutkliShTadoShe j~jeyam, etacca jIrNajvaravihitaM vamanaM snehasvedAbhyAM doShamutkleshya kartavyamiti visheShaH| pittAshaya AmAshayAdhobhAga eva| sraMsanamiti cchedaH||171||-

jvare purANe sa~gkShINe kaphapitte dRuDhAgnaye||172||

Commentary: anuvAsanaviShayamAha- jvara ityAdi| prakaraNAgatAyAmapi purANatAyAM ‘purANe’ iti padamatyarthapurANatAmAha||172||-

gaurave shirasaH shUle vibaddheShvindriyeShu ca||173||

Commentary: gaurava ityAdinA shirovirecanaviShayamAha| shirasa iti pUrveNottareNa ca yojyam| indriyANAM vibandhaH svaviShayapravRuttau jADyam||173||-
abhya~ggAMshca pradehAMshca pariShekAvagAhane||174||
vibhajya shItoShNakRutaM kuryAjjIrNe jvare bhiShak| tairAshu prashamaM yAti bahirmArgagato jvaraH||175||

dhUpanA~jjanayogaishca yAnti jIrNajvarAH shamam||176||

Commentary: tva~gmAtrasheShA iti dhAtvantaratyAgena tva~gmAtrAvasthitadoShajanyAH, yeShAM cAganturbhUtarUpo~anvayaH kAraNaM bhavati jvarANAM, te dhUpAdinA shamaM yAnti||176||-
iti kriyAkramaH siddho jvaraghnaH samprakAshitaH||177||

santApaH sArucistRuShNA sA~ggamardo hRudi vyathA| jvaraprabhAvo, janmAdau nidhane ca mahattamaH||26||

Commentary: santApa ityAdinA prabhAvamAha| prabhAvashcAnaupAdhikA shaktirucyate, tena santApAdInAM prabhAvavyapadeshaH| yatashcAyaM rogaprabhAvaH, tato vAtashleShmakRute~api jvare~anuShNarUpastApo bhavati, tathA janmAdau nidhane ca mahattamorUpatvaM jvaraprabhAva ityarthaH| prakRutishcetyAdinA prakaraNasa~ggrahaM karoti, ‘ityasya prakRutiH proktA’ ityanena tu prastAvasa~ggrahaH kRutaH, adhyAyAnte tvadhyAyArthasa~ggrahaM kariShyati| etacca punaH punaH sa~ggrahakaraNaM tantrarmatvAcchiShyabuddhisamAdhAnArthaM kRutaM j~jeyam||26||-

nidAne kAraNAnyaShTau pUrvoktAni vibhAgashaH||27||

Commentary: nidAna ityAdinA kAraNamAha| aShTau kAraNAnIti rUkShAdayastrayo jvarArambhakavAtAdikartRutvenoktAH, tathA “yathoktAnAM hetUnAM mishrIbhAvAt” (ni.a.1) ityAdinA tu dvandvAnAM sannipAtasya ca kAraNamuktaM, tathA AgantoH kAraNaM tatra kaNTharaveNaivoktam| anye tu vAtAdIneva jvarArambhakasamprAptiprAptAn “iha khalvaShTAbhyaH kAraNebhyo jvaraH sa~jjAyate” (ni.a.1) ityAdigranthena nidAnoktAn kAraNAnIti padena grAhayanti; prakRutishabdena tu bIjabhUtA avyavahitasambaddhA doShA gRuhyante, rUkShAdayastu doShaprakopakAraNabhUtA na jvarakAraNAnIti vadanti| tasmin pakShe rUkShAdInAM jvarahetubhUtAnAmihAgrahaNaM syAt; rUkShAdInAM tu jvare hetutvaM doShaprakopAvAntaravyApAratvena bhavatyeva, yathA- yAgasya svargakartRutvam| dvividhaM ca kAraNaM rogANAM- vyavahitaM rUkShAdi, pratyAsannaM ca doShA iti shAstrasiddhAnta eva| ‘nidAne’ iti padenaiva pUrvatve labdhe, pUrvoktAnIti padamiha vaktavyajvaranidAnavyudAsArtham||27||
yeShAM tveSha kramastAni dravyANyUrdhvamataH shRuNu| raktashAlyAdayaH shastAH purANAH ShaShTikaiH saha||178||
lAjapeyAM sukhajarAM pippalInAgaraiH shRutAm||179||
pibejjvarI jvaraharAM kShudvAnalpAgnirAditaH| amlAbhilAShI tAmeva dADimAmlAM sanAgarAm||180||
sRuShTaviT paittiko vA~atha shItAM madhuyutAM pibet| peyAM vA raktashAlInAM pArshvabastishiroruji||181||
shvadaMShTrAkaNTakAribhyAM siddhAM jvaraharAM pibet| jvarAtisArI peyAM vA pibet sAmlAM shRutAM naraH||182||
pRushniparNIbalAbilvanAgarotpaladhAnyakaiH| shRutAM vidArIgandhAdyairdIpanIM svedanIM naraH||183||
kAsI shvAsI ca hikkI ca yavAgUM jvaritaH pibet| vibaddhavarcAH sayavAM pippalyAmalakaiH shRutAm||184||
sarpiShmatIM pibet peyAM jvarI doShAnulomanIm| koShThe vibaddhe saruji pibet peyAM shRutAM jvarI||185||
mRudvIkApippalImUlacavyAmalakanAgaraiH| pibet sabilvAM peyAM vA jvare saparikartike||186||
balAvRukShAmlakolAmlakalashIdhAvanIshRutAm| asvedanidrastRuShNArtaH pibet peyAM sasharkarAm||187||

mudgAnmasUrAMshcaNakAn kulatthAn samakuShTakAn||188||

Commentary: mudgAnityAdirjvarahitayUShadravyasa~ggrahaH| yUShakaraNaM ca yavAgUsAdhanavat| mudgaH svanAmaprasiddhaH||188||-

paTolapatraM saphalaM kulakaM pApacelikam||189||

Commentary: kulakaM kAravellakam| pApacelikaM pAThAshAkam| kaThillakaM raktapunarnavA||189||-
lAvAn kapi~jjalAneNAMshcakorAnupacakrakAn||190||
kura~ggAn kAlapucchAMshca hariNAn pRuShatA~jchashAn| pradadyAnmAMsasAtmyAya jvaritAya jvarApahAn||191||
IShadamlAnanamlAn vA rasAn kAle vicakShaNaH| kukkuTAMshca mayUrAMshca tittirikrau~jcavartakAn||192||
gurUShNatvAnna shaMsanti jvare keciccikitsakAH| la~gghanenAnilabalaM jvare yadyadhikaM bhavet||193||

gharmAmbu cAnupAnArthaM tRuShitAya pradApayet||194||

Commentary: gharmAmbu uShNAmbu| gharmAmbvAdishlekaM caike~anArShaM vadanti; tanna, anupAnavyavasthAyAmuShNapAnIyamadyayorhitatvaM pUrvamanuktameveti tadupAdAnaM; tathAca tantrAntare- “jvare pibedanuShNAmbu madyasAtmyastu yo bhavet| tasmai doShabalaM dRuShTvA yuktyA madyaM vidhIyate” iti||194||-
gurUShNasnigdhamadhurAn kaShAyAMshca navajvare||195||
AhArAn doShapaktyarthaM prAyashaH parivarjayet| annapAnakramaH siddho jvaraghnaH samprakAshitaH||196||
ata UrdhvaM pravakShyante kaShAyA jvaranAshanAH| pAkyaM shItakaShAyaM vA mustaparpaTakaM pibet||197||
sanAgaraM parpaTakaM pibedvA sadurAlabham| kirAtatiktakaM mustaM guDUcIM vishvabheShajam||198||
pAThAmushIraM sodIcyaM pibedvA jvarashAntaye| jvaraghnA dIpanAshcaite kaShAyA doShapAcanAH||199||
kali~ggakAH paTolasya patraM kaTukarohiNI||200||
kirAtatiktamamRutA candanaM vishvabheShajam| guDUcyAmalakaM mustamardhashlokasamApanAH||202||
kaShAyAH shamayantyAshu pa~jca pa~jcavidhA~jjvarAn| santataM satatAnyedyustRutIyakacaturthakAn||203||
vatsakAragvadhau pAThAM ShaDgranthAM kaTurohiNIm| mUrvAM sAtiviShAM nimbaM paTolaM dhanvayAsakam||204||
vacAM mustamushIraM ca madhukaM triphalAM balAm| pAkyaM shItakaShAyaM vA pibejjvaraharaM naraH||205||
madhUkamustamRudvIkAkAshmaryANi parUShakam| trAyamANAmushIraM ca triphalAM kaTurohiNIm||206||
jAtyAmalakamustAni tadvaddhanvayavAsakam||207||
vibaddhadoSho jvaritaH kaShAyaM saguDaM pibet| triphalAM trAyamANAM ca mRudvIkAM kaTurohiNIm||208||
pittashleShmaharastveSha kaShAyo hyAnulomikaH| trivRutAsharkarAyuktaH pittashleShmajvarApahaH||209||
bRuhatyau vatsakaM mustaM devadAru mahauShadham| kolavallI ca yogo~ayaM sannipAtajvarApahaH||210||
shaTI puShkaramUlaM ca vyAghrI shRu~ggI durAlabhA| guDUcI nAgaraM pAThA kirAtaM kaTurohiNI||211||
eSha shaTyAdiko vargaH sannipAtajvarApahaH| kAsahRudgrahapArshvArtishvAsatandrAsu shasyate||212||
bRuhatyau pauShkaraM bhArgI shaTI shRu~ggI durAlabhA| vatsakasya ca bIjAni paTolaM kaTurohiNI||213||
bRuhatyAdirgaNaH proktaH sannipAtajvarApahaH| kAsAdiShu ca sarveShu dadyAt sopadraveShu ca||214||

kaShAyAshca yavAgvashca pipAsAjvaranAshanAH| nirdiShTA bheShajAdhyAye bhiShaktAnapi yojayet||215||

Commentary: bheShajAdhyAye bheShajacatuShke; catuShke~api hi ‘adhIyante asminnarthA’ iti kRutvA adhyAyashabdo vartata eva| yogamAtreNa tu tatra ShaDvirecanashatAshritIye~adhyAye (sU.a.4) jvaraghnatRuShNAghnau mahAkaShAyau proktau; tayoshca pratyekadravyakRutAH kaShAyA bahavo bhavantIti kaShAyA iti bahuvacanaM sAdhu| yavAgvashca apAmArgataNDulIye (sU.a.2) proktAH||215||
jvarAH kaShAyairvamanairla~gghanairlaghubhojanaiH| rUkShasya ye na shAmyanti sarpisteShAM bhiShagjitam||216||
rUkShaM tejo jvarakaraM tejasA rUkShitasya ca| yaH syAdanubalo dhAtuH snehavadhyaH sa cAnilaH||217||

kaShAyAH sarva evaite sarpiShA saha yojitAH| prayojyA jvarashAntyarthamagnisandhukShaNAH shivAH||218||

Commentary: samprati sarpIMShi prAha- kaShAyA ityAdi| ya ete jvaraghnA kaShAyA uktAste sarpiShA saha yojitAH sarpiHsAdhanatvena prayuktAH prayojyAH; yathoktakaShAyadravyaiH svaviShaya eva sarpIMShi sAdhayitvA prayojyAnIti vAkyArthaH| anye tu kaShAyANAM sarpiShA mishrIkRutAnAmanena vacasA prayogamicchanti||218||
pippalyashcandanaM mustamushIraM kaTurohiNI| kali~ggakAstAmalakI sArivA~ativiShA sthirA||219||
drAkShAmalakabilvAni trAyamANA nidigdhikA| siddhamitairghRutaM sadyo jIrNajvaramapohati||220||
kShayaM kAsaM shiraHshUlaM pArshvashUlaM halImakam| aMsAbhitApamAgniM ca viShamaM sanniyacchati||221||
vAsAM guDUcIM triphalAM trAyamANAM yavAsakam| paktvA tena kaShAyeNa payasA dviguNena ca||222||
pippalImustamRudvIkAcandanotpalanAgaraiH| kalkIkRutaishca vipaceddhRutaM jIrNajvarApaham||223||
balAM shvadaMShTrAM bRuhatIM kalasIM dhAvanIM sthirAm| nimbaM parpaTakaM mustaM trAyamANAM durAlabhAm||224||
kRutvA kaShAyaM peShyArthe dadyAttAmalakIM shaTIm| drAkShAM puShkaramUlaM ca medAmAmalakAni ca||225||
ghRutaM payashca tat siddhaM sarpirjvaraharaM param| kShayakAsashiraHshUlapArshvashUlAMsatApanut ||226||
jvaribhyo bahudoShebhya UrdhvaM cAdhashca buddhimAn| dadyAt saMshodhanaM kAle kalpe yadupadekShyate||227||
madanaM pippalIbhirvA kali~ggairmadhukena vA| yuktamuShNAmbunA peyaM vamanaM jvarashAntaye||228||
kShaudrAmbunA rasenekShorathavA lavaNAmbunA| jvare pracchardanaM shastaM madyairvA tarpaNena vA||229||
mRudvIkAmalakAnAM vA rasaM praskandanaM pibet| rasamAmalakAnAM vA ghRutabhRuShTaM jvarApaham||230||
lihyAdvA traivRutaM cUrNaM saMyuktaM madhusarpiShA| pibedvA kShaudramAvApya saghRutaM triphalArasam||231||
AragvadhaM vA payasA mRudvIkAnAM rasena vA| trivRutAM trAyamANAM vA payasA jvaritaH pibet||232||
jvarAdvimucyate pItvA mRudvIkAbhiH sahAbhayAm| payo~anupAnamuShNaM vA pItvA drAkShArasaM naraH||233||
AlasyaM nayane sAsre jRumbhaNaM gauravaM kramaH| jvalanAtapavAyvambubhaktidveShAvanishcitau||28||
avipAkAsyavairasye hAnishca balavarNayoH| shIlavaikRutamalpaM ca jvaralakShaNamagrajam||29||
kAsAcchvAsAcchiraHshUlAtpArshvashUlAccirajvarAt| mucyate jvaritaH pItvA pa~jcamUlIshRutaM payaH||234||
eraNDamUlotkvathitaM jvarAt saparikartikAt| payo vimucyate pItvA tadvadbilvashalATubhiH||235||
trikaNTakabalAvyAghrIguDanAgarasAdhitam| varcomUtravibandhaghnaM shophajvaraharaM payaH||236||
sanAgaraM samRudvIkaM saghRutakShaudrasharkaram| shRutaM payaH sakharjUraM pipAsAjvaranAshanam||237||
caturguNenAmbhasA vA shRutaM jvaraharaM payaH| dhAroShNaM vA payaH sadyo vAtapittajvaraM jayet||238||
jIrNajvarANAM sarveShAM payaH prashamanaM param| peyaM taduShNaM shItaM vA yathAsvaM bheShajaiH shRutam||239||
prayojayejjvaraharAnnirUhAn sAnuvAsanAn| pakvAshayagate doShe vakShyante ye ca siddhiShu||240||
paTolAriShTapatrANi soshIrashcatura~ggulaH| hrIberaM rohiNI tiktA shvadaMShTrA madanAni ca||241||
sthirA balA ca tat sarvaM payasyardhodake shRutam| kShIrAvasheShaM niryUhaM saMyuktaM madhusarpiShA||242||
kalkairmadanamustAnAM pippalyA madhukasya ca| vatsakasya ca saMyuktaM bastiM dadyAjjvarApaham||243||
shuddhe mArge hRute doShe viprasanneShu dhAtuShu| gatA~ggashUlo laghva~ggaH sadyo bhavati vijvaraH||244||
AragvadhamushIraM ca madanasya phalaM tathA| catasraH parNinIshcaiva niryUhamupakalpayet||245||
priya~ggurmadanaM mustaM shatAhvA madhuyaShTikA| kalkaH sarpirguDaH kShaudraM jvaraghno bastiruttamaH||246||
guDUcIM trAyamANAM ca candanaM madhukaM vRuSham| sthirAM balAM pRushniparNIM madanaM ceti sAdhayet||247||
rasaM jA~ggalamAMsasya rasena sahitaM bhiShak| pippalIphalamustAnAM kalkena madhukasya ca||248||
IShatsalavaNaM yuktyA nirUhaM madhusarpiShA| jvaraprashamanaM dadyAdbalasvedarucipradam||249||
jIvantIM madhukaM medAM pippalIM madanaM vacAm| RuddhiM rAsnAM balAM vishvaM shatapuShpAM shatAvarIm||250||
piShTvA kShIraM jalaM sarpistailaM ca vipacedbhiShak| AnuvAsanikaM snehametaM vidyAjjvarApaham||251||
paTolapicumardAbhyAM guDUcyA madhukena ca| madanaishca shRutaH sneho jvaraghnamanuvAsanam||252||
candanAgurukAshmaryapaTolamadhukotpalaiH| siddhaH sneho jvaraharaH snehabastiH prashasyate||253||
yaduktaM bheShajAdhyAye vimAne rogabheShaje| shirovirecanaM kuryAdyuktij~jastajjvarApaham||254||
yacca nAvanikaM tailaM yAshca tailaM yAshca prAgdhUmavartayaH| mAtrAshitIye nirdiShTAH prayojyAstA jvareShvapi||255||

abhya~ggAMshca pradehAMshca pariShekAMshca kArayet| yathAbhilAShaM shItoShNaM vibhajya dvividhaM jvaram||256||

Commentary: abhya~ggAMshcetyAdinA kramAgataM bahiHparimArjanamAha| yathAbhilAShamiti yatheccham| shItoShNaM vibhajyeti shItasamutthaM jvaramuShNasamutthaM ca jvaraM vibhajya; tatra shItasamutthe uShNAbhya~ggAdayaH, uShNe ca shItAH kartavyAH||256||

sahasradhautaM sarpirvA tailaM vA candanAdikam| dAhajvaraprashamanaM dadyAdabhya~jjanaM bhiShak||257||

Commentary: atra ca pratilomavyAkhyayA shItAbhiprAyiNo~abhya~ggAdInAha- sahasretyAdi| sahasrashabdo vipulArthaH; tenAnekadhA dhautaM sarpirityarthaH sUcitaH||257||

atha candanAdyaM tailamupadekShyAmaH- candanabhadrashrIkAlAnusAryakAlIyakapadmApadmakoshIrasArivAmadhukaprapauNDarIkanAgapuShpodIcyavanyapadmotpalanalinakumuda- saugandhikapuNDarIkashatapatrabisamRuNAlashAlUkashaivAlakasherukAnantAkushakAshekShudarbhasharanalashAlimUlajambuvetasavAnIragundrA- kakubhAsanAshvakarNasyandanavAtapothashAlatAladhavatinishakhadirakadarakadambakAshmaryaphalasarjaplakShavaTakapItanodumbarAshvattha- nyagrodhadhAtakIdUrvetkaTashRu~ggATakama~jjiShThAjyotiShmatIpuShkarabIjakrau~jcAdanabadarIkovidArakadalI- saMvartakAriShTashataparvAshItakumbhikAshatAvarIshrIparNIshrAvaNImahAshrAvaNIrohiNIshItapAkyodanapAkIkAlabalApayasyAvidArI- jIvakarShabhakamedAmahAmedAmadhurasarShyaproktAtRuNashUnyamocarasATarUShakabakulakuTajapaTolanimbashAlmalInArikela- kharjUramRudvIkApriyAlapriya~ggudhanvanAtmAguptAmadhUkAnAmanyeShAM ca shItavIryANAM yathAlAbhamauShadhAnAM kaShAyaM kArayet| tena kaShAyeNa dviguNitapayasA teShAmeva ca kalkena kaShAyArdhamAtraM mRudvagninA sAdhayettailam| etattailamabhya~ggAt sadyo dAhajvaramapanayati| etaireva cauShadhairashlakShNapiShTaiH sushItaiH pradehaM kArayet| etaireva ca shRutashItaM salilamavagAhapariShekArthaM prayu~jjIta||258||
iti candanAdyaM tailam| madhvAranAlakShIradadhighRutasalilasekAvagAhAshca sadyo dAhajvaramapanayanti shItasparshatvAt||259||
bhavanti cAtra- pauShkareShu sushIteShu padmotpaladaleShu ca| kadalInAM ca patreShu kShaumeShu vimaleShu ca||260||
candanodakashIteShu shIte dhArAgRuhe~api vA| himAmbusikte sadane dAhArtaH saMvishet sukham||261||
hemasha~gkhapravAlAnAM maNInAM mauktikasya ca| candanodakashItAnAM saMsparshAnurasAn spRushet||262||
sragbhirnIlotpalaiH padmairvyajanairvividhairapi| shItavAtAvahairvyajjyeccandanodakavarShibhiH ||263||
nadyastaDAgAH padminyo hradAshca vimalodakAH| avagAhe hitA dAhatRuShNAglAnijvarApahAH||264||
priyAH pradakShiNAcArAH pramadAshcandanokShitAH| sAntvayeyuH paraiH kAmairmaNimauktikabhUShaNAH||265||
shItAni cAnnapAnAni shItAnyupavanAni ca| vAyavashcandrapAdAshca shItA dAhajvarApahAH||266||

athoShNAbhiprAyiNAM jvaritAnAmabhya~ggAdInupakramAnupadekShyAmaH- agurukuShThatagarapatranaladashaileyadhyAmakahareNukAsthauNeyakakShemakailAvarA~ggadalapuratamAlapatrabhUtIkarohiShasaralashallakI- devadArvagnimanthabilvasyonAkakAshmaryapATalApunarnavAvRushcIrakaNTakArIbRuhatIshAlaparNIpRushniparNImAShaparNImudgaparNIgokShurakairaNDa- shobhA~jjanakavaruNArkacirabilvatilvakashaTIpuShkaramUlagaNDIrorubUkapattUrAkShIvAshmAntakashigrumAtulu~ggapIlukamUlakaparNI- tilaparNIpIluparNImeShashRu~ggIhiMsrAdantashaThairAvatakabhallAtakAsphotakANDIrAtmajaikeShIkAkara~jjadhAnyakAjamoda- pRuthvIkAsumukhasurasakuTherakakAlamAlakaparNAsakShavakaphaNijjhakabhUstRuNashRu~ggaverapippalIsarShapAshvagandhArAsnAruhArohAvacAbalAtibalA- guDUcIshatapuShpAshItavallInAkulIgandhanAkulIshvetAjyotiShmatIcitrakAdhyaNDAmlacA~ggerI- tilabadarakulatthamAShANAmevaMvidhAnAmanyeShAM coShNavIryANAM yathAlAbhamauShadhAnAM kaShAyaM kArayet, tena kaShAyeNa teShAmeva ca kalkena surAsauvIrakatuShodakamaireyamedakadadhimaNDAranAlakaTvaraprativinItena tailapAtraM vipAcayet| tena sukhoShNena tailenoShNAbhiprAyiNaM jvaritamabhya~jjyAt, tathA shItajvaraH prashAmyati; etaireva cauShadhaiH shlakShNapiShTaiH sukhoShNaiH pradehaM kArayet, etaireva ca shRutaM sukhoShNaM salilamavagAhanArthaM pariShekArthaM ca prayu~jjIta shItajvaraprashamArtham||267||

Commentary: agurvAdye kShemakaH corakaH, rohiShaH ‘rAmakarpUra’ iti khyAtaH, shigruH shobhA~jjanabhedaH, mUlakaparNI gugguluH, tilaparNI ‘hulhula’ iti khyAtA, pIluparNI moraTA, mUrvetyanye, gaNDIraH shamaThabhedaH, sa hi jalasthalajabhedAdvividhaH, AtmajA putra~jjIvakhyAtA, ekaiShikA ambaShThA, sumukhAdayaH parNAsabhedAH, ruhA vRukSharuhA, rohA a~jjalikArikA, shItaparNI vRukShakalambukA, nAkulI cavikA, gandhanAkulI rAsnAbhedaH, adhyaNDA shUkashimbI| anyeShAM cetyanena rogabhiShagjitIyAdyuktoShNadravyANi grAhayati| sauvIratuShodake trivRutkalpe vakShyamANe, maireyaM surAkRutA surA, medako jagalaH, kaTvaraM sasnehadadhidravaH| pAtram ADhakam| atra kaShAyAdIni dravadravyANi snehasamAni pratyekaM kartavyAni; yaduktaM- “pa~jcaprabhRuti yatra syurdravANi snehasaMvidhau| tatra snehasamAnyAhuH” iti||267||
ityagurvAdyaM tailam
bhavanti cAtra- trayodashavidhaH svedaH svedAdhyAye nidarshitaH| mAtrAkAlavidA yuktaH sa ca shItajvarApahaH||268||
sA kuTI tacca shayanaM taccAvacchAdanaM jvaram| shItaM prashamayantyAshu dhUpAshcAgurujA ghanAH||269||
cArUpacitagAtryashca taruNyo yauvanoShmaNA| AshleShAcchamayantyAshu pramadAH shishirajvaram||270||
svedanAnyannapAnAni vAtashleShmaharANi ca| shItajvaraM jayantyAshu saMsargabalayojanAt||271||

svasthorjaskaramabhidhAya vyAdhinirghAtakaracikitsitaM vaktavyam| sarvarogapradhAnatvena jvarasyaivAdau cikitsitaM tatrocyate| jvarasya ca yathA prAdhAnyaM tathA~atraiva vakShyati| jvaracikitsitAbhidhAyako~adhyAyo jvaracikitsitamucyate, abhidhAnAbhidheyayorabhedopacArAt| evamuttarAdhyAyeShvapi vyAkhyeyam||1-2||
samprati vAtajAdInAM jvarANAM pUrvaM niShiddhaM la~gghanamapakRuShya visheShacikitsAmAha- vAtaja ityAdi| shamanairiti kaShAyasarpiHpAnAdibhiH shamanaiH||272-282||-

saMsargasannipAtacikitsAsUtramAha- saMsRuShTAnityAdi| taratamaiH samairiti saMsarge ekolbaNe ulbaNataraiH; sannipAte ca vRuddhataravRuddhatamadoShArabdhe doShAnusAreNaiva; tathA dvyulbaNatare~api sannipAte dvau doShau tareNaiva j~jeyau, vRuddhavRuddhataravRuddhatamadoShArabdhe ca tridoShe~atyarthavRuddhA doShAstamairj~jeyAH| yena ‘triShu tamaH’ iti yaduktaM tatriShu madhye ekasya prakarShAvadhAraNe bhavati; yadA tu triShu dvau prakRuShTau vivakShitau tadA ekaprakRuShTApekShayA ‘dvayostaraH’ ityasyaiva viShayaH| samaistu samadoShArabdhasaMsargaH sannipAtashca j~jeyaH| doShakramApekShIti doShApekShItyanena anekasakaladoShagatavRuddhavRuddhataratvAdivisheShe cikitsitopayukte apekShaNIyatvamuktaM, kramApekShItyanena ca jvaritacikitsitoktala~gghanAdikramApekShA darshitA| yathoktairauShadhairiti la~gghanAdibhira~jjanaparyantaiH| nanu tridoShaje jvare cikitsA nopapadyate, yato na tridoShashamanaM prAyo dravyaM bhavati, yaddhi vAtasya pathyaM tacchleShmaNyapathyaM, yat pitte pathyaM tacca prAyaH shleShmaNyapathyaM; yathA hi tiktakaShAyaM kaphapittaharaM tadvAtakaraM, yacca madhuraM vAtapittaharaM tat kaphakaraM, yattu tridoShaharamAmalakAdi tat stokaM pratiniyatarogaviShayaM nAvashayaM jvarayaugikaM ca, sannipAtashcAyaM mahAtyayikaH, tat kathamasya cikitsA kartavyetyAha- vardhanenetyAdi| pa~jcaviMshatiprakAro~atra sannipAta ucyate “dvyulbaNaikolbaNaiH ShaT syurhInamadhyAdikaishca ShaT” (sU.a.17) ityAdinA; tatra svamate kShINadvAdashasu sannipAteShu jvarArambhakatvaM nAsti, kShINA hi doShAH svali~ggahAnimAtravikArA nAdhikaM jvarAdikaM kartuM samarthAH; sheSheShu tu trayodashasu tridoShaharadravyasyAbhAvAdabhyarhitadoShApekShayA cikitsocyate, gatyantarAbhAvAt| tatra vardhanenaikadoShasyetyanenaikadoShasya vardhanenApItyarthaH; ekashabdena ca dvitrivRuddho doSha evA pekShito na vRuddhataro nApi vRuddhatamaH| tayorhi ativRuddhayorvardhanenAtimAtravRuddhyA~atyahitameva syAt| vardhanenaikadoShasyetyanena vRuddhataravRuddhatamadoShadvayakShapaNakenaikadoShavardhanena; yathA- vRuddhe kaphe vRuddhatarayoshca vAtapittayormadhuraM, taddhi vRuddhataravAtapittadvayahantRutayA kaphaM kShINaM vardhayadapi jvaraM balavaddoShahantRutayA harati; tathA vRuddhe kaphe vRuddhatare c pitte madhuraprayogo j~jeyaH| evamudAharaNAntarANi j~jeyAni| atashca vardhanenaikadoShasyetyanena dvyulbaNAnAM trayANAM tathA hInamadhyAdhikadoShANAM sannipAtAnAM cikitsoktA| kShapaNenaikadoShasyetyanena ca kShINadvayasaMvardhakamapi yanmahAtyayavRuddhataravRuddhatamadoShakShayakaraM bhavati tadbheShajaM kartavyaM; vRuddhatamo hyapratikRutaH sadyo hanti, tatpratikriyAyAM ca kShINayorvRuddhiralpAtyayA, sA krameNa pratikartavyeti bhAvaH| anenaikolbaNAstrayaH sannipAtAshcikitsitAH| asminnarthe tantrAntaraM “nyUnaikadoShasaMvRuddhirevaM vRuddhajayo~api vA| sannipAte tu kartavyaH sannipAtavashena tu” iti| parishiShTasamasannipAtacikitsAmAha- kphasthAnAnupUrvyA veti| vAshabdo vyavasthitavikalpavAcI, kaphasya sthAnaM kaphasthAnam, AmAshayordhvabhAga ityarthaH; AnupUrvI anukramaH; tena kaphasthAnupUrvyA jayediti kaphasthAnaM prathamaM jayet, sthAnagrahaNena sthAninaH kaphasyApi grahaNam| kaphajayastu sAkShAnnoktaH, tatsthAnasyaivAmAshayasya jvarArambhakadoSheNa duShTasya cikitsyatvopadarshanArtham | uktaM hi- “jvaro hyAmAshayasamutthaH” (vi.a.3) iti| evaM ca samA api doShA jvarArambhakA yasmAdAmAshayaM visheSheNa dUShayitvA jvaraM kurvanti, tasmAt sthAnAnuguNaiva jvare prathamaM cikitsA kartavyA| sthAnidoShApekShayA hi sthAnameva prathamaM cikitsyam| yaduktaM- “sthAnaM jayeddhi pUrvaM” iti| kaphasya sthAnaM kaphasthAnam| tatra la~gghanapAcanAdikriyA jvare prathamaM pratipAditAH kriyante| etacca yadyapi sarvajvarasAdhAraNaM cikitsitaM, tathA~api sannipAte balavattaravAtacikitsApUrvakajvaracikitsAprasaktinirAsArthaM samasannipAte procyate| jvarAdanyatra hi sannipAte sama eva vAtaH pUrvaM cikitsyate; uktaM hi- “vAtasyAnujayet pittaM, pittasyAnu jayet kapham” ityAdi| kaphasthAnAnupUrvyA cikitsite kriyamANe yo doSha ulbaNo bhavati tatra ‘vardhanenaikadoShasya kShapaNenocchritasya vA’ iti cikitsA kAryA| etadeva bhelenoktaM- “sannipAtajvare pUrvaM kuryAdAmakaphApaham| pashcAcchleShmaNi sa~gkShINe shamayet pittamArutau” iti| anye kaphasthAnamAmAshayarUpaM sthAnaM yasya tat kaphasthAnaM pittamiti pashcAtpadalopAduShTramukhavadbahuvrIhiM vadanti, tatashca pittAnupUrvyA jayedityarthaH| tadarthAnuvAdakaM ca sushrutavacanaM paThanti- “shamayet pittamevAdau jvareShu samavAyiShu| durnivArataraM taddhi jvarArteShu visheShataH” (su.ci.a.39) iti| tatraivaM tarhi spaShTArthaM ‘pittAnupUrvyA’ ityevameva paThet| sushrutavacanaM hi jIrNatridoShAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam, etacca prathamotpannasannipAtajvaracikitsitaM kaphasthAnAnupUrvyA j~jeyam| ye tu kapashca sthAnaM ceti dvandvaM kurvate, teShAM mate kaphasyAmAshayasyApi ca jvarasthAnasya pUrvaM jayaH kartavya ityarthaH, sa ca ShaShThItatpuruShe~api sthAnasyAmAshayasya sthAnikaphApekShayA kriyamANacikitsayA labhyata eveti nArthavirodhaH| iyaM caikadoShavardhanAdirUpA sannipAtacikitsA yadyapi na vishuddhA, yaduktaM- “prayogaH shamayedvyAdhiM yo~anyamanyamudIrayet| nAsau vishuddhaH shuddhastu shamayedyo na kopayet” (ni.a.8) iti, tathA~api sannipAtacikitsAyAM gatyantarAsambhave sati alpadoShabahuguNatayA kriyata iti j~jeyam| anye tu ‘vardha’ cchedane, ityasmAdvardhaneneti sAdhayanti, vardhanashabdena ca mUlacchedakArakaM saMshodhanamucyate; ekagrahaNena ca na yugapadvAtAdInAM bastyAdishodhanaM kartavyaM, kintvekaikeneti darshayati; kShapaNenocchritasyetyanena saMshodhanaviShaye saMshamanamucyate; sheShasya tu vyAkhyA pUrvavat| anena shlokena trayodashavidhasannipAtArabdhajvaracikitsitamuktaM bhavati| kShINavRuddhadoShavikalpakRutaShaDvidhasannipAteShu yo jvarastatra na kevalaM vRuddhasya doShadvayasyaikasya vA vRuddhasya jvarArambhakasya cikitsA kAryA, kintu svamAnakShINavardhanamapi tatra kartavyaM bhavati; svamAnakShINadvAdashasannipAtasya tu jvarAnArambhakatvameva||285-286||-

sannipAtaprastAvAttajjaM trishothIyoktashothamanUdya cikitsAmAha- sannipAtetyAdi| kashcideva pramucyate ityanena dAruNatvamasya darshayati; “santi hyevaMvidhA rogAH sAdhyA dAruNasammatAH| ye hanyuranupakrAntA mithyArambheNa vA punaH” (sU.a.18); kiMvA sAdhya evAyaM prAyo bhavati, kadAcicca kRucchrasAdhya iti| nanu trishothIye “jvarAnte durjayo~antAya shophastasyopajAyate” (sU.a.18) ityanenAnupakramaNIyatvamasyoktam, iha tu kashcideva pramucyata iti kathaM na virodhaH? maivaM, tatrApi durjayo bhavati, antAya vetyarthaH; ato na virodhaH||287-288||-

bhUtAnubandhinostRutIyakacaturthakayoshcikitsAmAha- karmetyAdi| karma sAdhAraNamiti bhUtAnubandhe doShe ca sAdhAraNI cikitsA daivavyapAshrayA balyAdirUpA, yuktivyapAshrayA doShAnurUpakaShAyapAnAdirUpA ca| viShamajvarashabdena tRutIyacaturthakAvevAbhimatau, caturthakena caturthakaviparyayo~api gRuhyate| tiktashItairanupAnairbheShajaishceti vij~jeyam| kaShAyoShNamiti uShNAH kaShAyAH||292-295||-

doShAdIn pravibhajyeti doShakAladeshaprakRutyAdInapekShya yadyatra yaugikaM tattatra kAryamityarthaH| ShaTpalamiti gulme vakShyamANam| nIlinI nIlikA, nIlabuhnA vA| nIlinyAdishca virecanayogo jvarAgamanadine virekAt kAryakaro bhavati prabhAvAt| mahatI mAtrA ahorAtrapariNamanIyA; anyatra tu ShaTpalI mAtrA mahatI mAtroktA| anyatra “anyedyuShko dvyahagrAhI tRutIyakacaturthakau” ityArabhya yAvat “anAgate cikitsyAste balakAlau vijAnatA” ityantena vegadinAt prAg yA cikitsoktA sehoktavamanAdivyatiriktA j~jeyA| vamanAdayAstviha prakopadine kriyamANAH prakupitasya doShasya koShThamAgatasya samyak sadyohA bhavantIti kRutvA kriyante iti j~jeyam| sAnnaM prabhUtaM madyaM pItvA punarullikhediti yojanA, tathA madyaM sAnnaM pItvA tadahaH svapediti yojanA| yApanA mustAdikA bastayo vakShyamANAH| vRuShadaMsho biDAlaH| vRuShasyetyatrApi shakRuditi sambandhaH| medyAnAmiti medurANAM, kiMvA medhyAnAM pavitrANAm| vaivyAghrItyatra puMli~ggameva prayojakaM vacanAdunnIyate| siMho vyAghra eveti vadanti| ‘a~jju’ vyaktimrakShaNagatiShu, iti pAThAnmrakShaNamAtre~apya~jjanaM syAdityata Aha- netrA~jjanamiti| manovikAre unmAde~apasmAre ca| dhAraNAditi cchedaH; agadAnAM ca sevanAditi yojanA||296-309||-

daivavyapAshrayacikitsAmAha- somamityAdi| saha umayeti somaH, tam| sAnucaramiti nandyAdigaNayuktam| samAtRugaNamiti samAtRusamUham| prayataH pavitraH| sahasramUrdhanamiti “sahasrashIrShA” ityAdi vedapratipAditam| nAmasahasreNetyAdi mahAbhAratoktanAmasahasreNa| iShTyeti yaj~jena||309-316||-

shApetyAdinA~a~agantujvaracikitsAmAha| nashyediti prashAmyatItyarthaH| sAnAha iti abhighAtajvara eva sAnAhaH| kShatAnAmiti uraHkShatinAm| kShatacikitsayA vraNacikitsayA ca vraNinAM jvaro~apaitItyarthaH| ayaM hyupadravarUpo jvaraH; upadravashca mUlavyAdhicikitsayaiva shAmyatIti bhAvaH| vAyoH prashamaneneti kAmAdijvareShu vAtAnubandhAdupapannam| sadvAkyairiti shobhanairvacanaiH| kAmAdInAM pratidvandvena cikitsAmAha- kAmAdityAdi||317-322||-

sampratyauShadhamabhidhAya ‘vimu~jcati’ ityAdiprashnasyottaramAha- jvarapramokShe ityAdi| lIyata iti muhyati| uShNasarvA~ggaH shItasarvA~ggashca bhavatyapIti uShNasarvA~ggo vA shItasarvA~ggo vA bhavatItyarthaH| sadoShashabdamiti sadoShaM sashabdaM ca| etAni ca lakShaNAni sannipAtajvare eva bhavantIti j~jeyaM; nAnyatra, adarshanAdeva| ata eva baddudoShasya balina ityAdi granthaM kecit paThantyevAtra| etAni lakShaNAni jvaramokShakAle kShINenApi doSheNa kriyante, yathAnirvApyatA pradIpenAloko mahAn kriyate||324-328||

‘jvarAvashiShTo rakShyashca yAvatkAlaM yato yataH’ iti prashnasyottaraM- sajvara ityAdi| ‘tathA jvaraH shamaM yAti prashAnto jAyate na ca’ ityanena ‘yataH’ iti prashnasya jvaramuktAsevyahetuprashnarUpasyottaraM j~jeyam| ‘vyavAyamaticeShTAshca’ ityatra vyavAyaM kRutvA~api punaH ‘vyAyAmaM ca’ ityAdau vyavAyapAThena vyavAyasyAtyantaniShiddhatocyate; anye tu pramAdapATha evAyamityAhuH| snAnamUrjaskaramapi prabhAvAjjvaraM pratyAnayati; yaduktamanyatra- “snAnamAshu jvaraM kuryAjjvaramuktasya dehinaH| tasmAnmuktajvaraH snAnaM viShavat parivarjayet” iti||330-332||
anantaram ‘asa~jjAtabalo yastu’ ityAdi granthaM kAshmIrAH paThanti; te ca prakRutyAdisUtre~apyasya granthasyAnuguNaM prashnagranthaM paThanti||333-343||

dvividha ityAdinA vidhibhedamAha| ete ca bhedA vivaraNe vyaktA bhaviShyanti| saumya iti shItakAraNArabdhatvena somadevatAkaH, Agneyo~apyuShNakAraNArabdhatvenAgnidevatAkaH| punaH pa~jcavidho dRuShTa ityatra na pa~jcavidhena bhedena sarvajvaravyAptiH, yataH “prAyashaH sannipAtena dRuShTaH pa~jcavidho jvaraH” iti vakShyati| tatashca kevalavAtAdijvarANAM na santatAdibhedena grahaNaM; tathA santatAdInAM kAlaniyamo vaktavyaH, tatashca ye kAlAniyatAste santatAdibhinnA eva; tasmAddoShakAlabalAbalAdye jvarA bhavanti, te pa~jcadvidhA eveti vAkyArthaH| doShakAlabalAbalAditi doShakRutAt kAlabalAbalAt; kAlabalAbale jvarakAlaprakarShAprakarShau| tatra santate jvare balavatA doSheNa saptAhAdiH prakRuShTatvAdbalavAn kAlo niyamyate, satatake tu santatakAlApekShayA hInabalena doSheNAbalo jvarakAlaH, sa hyahorAtre dvikAlenAtra vyApako bhavati, tathA~ayameva satatakajvarakAlo hInabalakAlAnyedyuShkApekShayA balavAn bhavati; evamanyedyuShkAdijvarakAlo~api vyAkhyeyaH | kiMvA, doShakAlo duShTikAlo jvarakAla ityarthaH, tasya balAbalAt prakarShAprakarShAdityarthaH| kAlaprakarShAprakarShaniyamAshca vyAkhyAtA eva| anye tu, doShashca kAlashca doShakAlau, tayorbalAbalAditi vadanti| tatra doShabalAt kAlabalAcca santato bhavati; yaduktaM- “kAladUShyaprakRutibhirdoShastulyo hi santatam” ityAdinA| doShakAlabalatvamabalatvaM ca vivaraNagranthenoktaM; tathA doShasyAbalatvaM sapratyanIkatayA satatakAdiShu bhavati, tathA jvaravegavigame ca satatakAdau kAlasyAbalatvaM bhavati| atra pakShe doShakAlabalAbalAbhyAM sarvajvarA vyApyante, tatashca santatAdipa~jcajvaraniyamo durghaTaH syAt| anye tu vyutkramAbhidhAnena ‘doShabalAbalakAlAt’ iti kRutvA vyAkhyAnayanti| etaccAshabdaM vyAkhyAnam| tRutIyakacaturthakAviti samAsanirdeshena tRutIyacaturthakayorAgantvanubandhatvAdisAdhAraNadharmayogitAM darshayati||32-35||
antardAha ityAdinA antarvegabahirvegavivaraNam||39-41||

prAkRuta ityAdinA prakaraNena prAkRutavaikRutavivaraNam| tatreha kAlasvabhAvaprakupito doShaH prakRutirucyate , tajjAtIyAcca doShAdudbhUto jvaraH prAkRuta ucyate| yadvakShyati- “kAlaprakRutimuddishya nirdiShTaH prAkRuto jvaraH” iti| evamapi varShAkAlaprakRutibhUtena vAtena kRuto jvaraH prAkRutaH syAt, tanniShedhAyAha- sukhasAdhyastu vasantasharadudbhava iti| tushabdo~avadhAraNe| tena, ya eva sukhasAdhyo vasantasharadudbhavaH prAkRutaH sa eveha prAkRutashabdenocyata ityarthaH; varShAkAlabhavavAtikastu na sukhasAdhya iti, tena nAsau prAkRuta ucyate| prAkRutavaikRutasa~jj~jAvyavahAro hi yathAkramaM sukhasAdhya-kRucchrasAdhyabodhaprayojanakaH ; tadyadi kRucchre~api vAtaje prAkRutatvaM syAttadA kiM prAkRutavyavahAreNa| yatashca vasantasharadudbhavAveva prAkRutau, tena tayoreva ‘uShNaM’ ityAdina granthena vivaraNaM prapa~jcena kariShyati na vAtikasyeti| atrArthe jatUkarNe- “saumyAgneyAvuShNashItakAmau, jIrNastrayodashe| dine, vasantasharadoH prAkRuto~anyatra vaikRutaH” iti| yadyapi vasantajaH pUrvamuktastathA~api pratilomavyAkhyayA ‘uShNaM’ ityAdinA sharadudbhavaM nirdishati| uShNaM pittaM citaM varShAsu sharadyudIrNenAtapena kupyatIti vij~jeyam| shIte iti hemante| uShNamityAdinA nirdiShTasya varShAsvityAdi bhAShyam| nanu yadi varShAsvamlavipAkitvaM sarvAsAmoShadhInAM, tadA pratidravyAbhihitavipAkasyAvyavasthA syAt, tasya kAlavashenAmlatvadarshanAt | maivaM, yathA niShThApAkena yanmadhuraM dravyaM, tadyathA~a~avasthikena pAkenAmlaM bhavati, yaduktaM- “paraM tu pacyamAnasya vidagdhasyAmlabhAvataH” (ci.a.15) ityAdinA, tathehApi kAlamahimnA~amlavipAkitvamapi bhaviShyati; evaM hemante yanmadhurapAkitvamoShadhInAM tatrApi vyAkhyeyam| anye tu, varShAsu vahnimAndyAdvidAhanimittamoShadhInAmamlavipAkitvamiti bruvate| yaduktaM- “varShAsu vidahatyannaM........| tadA hi sarvamevAnnaM prAyo hyasya vidahyate” iti| evamapi tairhemante madhurapAkitvaM noktameva; tasmAt kAlamahimnaiva pAkAntaramoShadhInAM sAdhu| Ashviti pittasyAshukAritvAcchIghraM janayati| anubala iti anubandharUpaH kapho bhavati| evaM jvarasya la~gghanIyatAmAha- prakRutyaivetyAdi| visargasya prakRutyeti visargarUpakAlajayA prakRutyA saumyAdirUpayA~anashanAdbhayaM na bhavati| visargo hi saumyaH snigdhaH , tatra balavantashca puruShAH tena tatrotpanno jvara AmAshayasamutpannatvena la~gghanArho la~gghanIya eva| kiMvA, ‘prakRutyaiva visargAcca’ iti pAThaH| tadA prakRutyeti jvarakAraNena kaphapittarUpeNa la~gghanahetunA, tathA visargAcca kAlAlla~gghane bhayaM nAsti| uktaM hi- “kaphapitte drave dhAtU sahete la~gghanaM mahat” iti| hemante citaH kapho vasante kupyatIti yuktameva, yato doShacayAdikrame shishiro nAstyeva| AdAnamadhye tasyApi vAtapittaM bhavedanviti tasyApi vasantajakaphajvarasya vAtapittam anviti anubandharUpaM bhavati| tatra vasantAdau durbalaM vAtapittaM, madhye tu madhyaM, ante tu prabalaM bhavati; evaM sharadyapi kapho bhavati||42-46||-
