kAlaprakRutimuddishya nirdiShTaH prAkRuto jvara iti prAkRuta jvarabodhikA paribhAShA| kAlaprakRutimiti kAlasvabhAvasambaddhaM doSham; uddishyeti kAraNatvena lakShyIkRutya| nanvevamapi varShAkAlaprakRutinA vAtena kRuto jvaraH prAkRutaH syAdityAha- prAyeNAnilajo duHkha iti; anilajo jvaraH kAlaprakRutisamAno~api duHkho bhavati, viruddhopakramatvAt| yato jvarasyAmAshayotthatvena la~gghanAdi pathyaM, tacca vAyorapathyamiti viruddhopakramatvAdduHkhatvena na prAkRutatvaM vAtikasya; yataH prAkRutatve~api yaH sukhasAdhyaH sa eva prAkRuta ucyata iti bhAvaH| evaM tAvat sarvo vAtajo vaikRutaH, tathA vasantasharadvyatiriktakAlabhavaH | kaphajastathA paittiko~api vaikRuta eveti darshayannAha- kAleShvanyeShu vaikRuta iti; ‘kaphajaH pittajo vA ’ iti sheShaH| atha vaikRutasya jvarasya ko heturityAha- hetava ityAdi| anye tu bruvate- varShAkAle vAtajo~api prAkRutaH, kintvayaM kRucchraH, vasantasharadudbhavastu prAkRutaH sukhasAdhyo bhavatIti visheShaH; tathA ca vAgbhaTena- “prAkRutashcAnilodbhavaH” (vA. ni.a.2) iti kRutamiti||48-49||

srotobhirityAdinA santatAdibhedamAha| gurava iti vRuddhAH| dashAhamityAdi dashAhAdIn vyApya| suduHsahaH ‘bhavati’ iti sheShaH| shIghramiti dashAhAdaya eva prabhUtatarakAlAntarApekShayA shIghrashabdavAcyAH| dashAhAdivikalpashca yathAkramaM pittakaphAnilottarasannipAtArabdhatvAt santatajvarasya j~jeyaH| yaduktamanyatrApi- “pittakaphAnilavRuddhyA dashadivasa-dvAdashAha- saptAhAt| hanti vimu~jcati vA~a~ashu tridoShajo dhAtumalapAkAt” iti| tathA “dasha-dvAdasha-saptAhaiH pittashleShmAnilAdhikaH| dagdhvoShmaNA dhAtumalAn hanti mu~jcati vA jvaraH” iti| hananamocanavikalpastu rasAdInAmapyashuddhyA shuddhyA ca vaktavyaH| kasmAdevamayaM duHsahaH shIghrakArI ca santato bhavatItyAha- kAletyAdi| kAlaH varShAdiH, dUShyaH rasAdiH, prakRutiH dehaprakRutiH shleShmaprakRutyAdikA| nanu kAlAditulyatA doShasya kadAcideva sambhavati, yathA- vasante, shleShmaprakRutau, medasi dUShye, kapho doShaH; evaM sharadi pittamapi j~jeyam; itareShAM tu tridoShAdInAM kAlAditulyatvaM duShprApam; atastatkRutasantataH kathaM bhavatu, santatashca dvAdashAshrayatvena tridoShaja eva vaktavyaH| ucyate- tulya ityabhidhAyApi yat ‘niShpratyanIkaH’ iti karoti, tena kAlAdyanuguNatAmeva kAlAditulyatAM sphoTayati | kAlAdInAM cAsamAnAnAmapi balavatA doSheNa parigRuhItAnAM pratIpArthakaraNAsAmarthyenAnuguNataiva bhavati; yathA- balavato rAj~jo hRudayena pratikUlA api kShudrarAjAno~anuguNA eva bhavanti| ki~jca, tridoShArabdha evAsmanmate santataH, tasya cAnyataraM doShaM prati kAlAdInAM tulyatvaM sambhavatyeva| atraike ‘tasmAjj~jeyaH suduHsahaH’ ityato~anantaraM ‘yathA dhAtUn’ ityAdi paThanti, itashca ‘prAyaH prAgapatarpaNaiH’ ityantaM paThitvA ‘raktadhAtvAshrayaH’ ityAdinA satatakAdilakShaNaM paThanti| anye tu- ‘suduHsahaH’ iti paThitvA satatAnyedyuShkalakShaNe paThanti, tadanu ‘yathA dhAtUn’ ityAdigranthaM, tataH punarAcAryAntaramatenAnyedyuShkAdijvaratrayalakShaNaM paThanti| tatra prathamapAThakrame ‘yathA dhAtUn’ ityAdinA santatasyotpAdAdikramaM bruvate| dhAtUniti rasAdidhAtusaptakam| rasaduShTyabhidhAnena visheSheNa rasaduShTirj~jeyA| yatheti yena prakAreNa gurutvastabdhatvAdinA| yugapaditi ekakAlam| niyamAditi sarvAneva dhAtvAdIn sarva eva doShAshcAnupadyante| sa shuddhyA vetyAdi| sa santataH; yadA sarve rasAdayaH sarvathA vishuddhA bhavanti tadA prashAmyati saptAhAdiShu, yadA rasAdayaH sarve sarvathA vA~avishuddhA bhavanti tadA hantItyarthaH| atha yadA stokA shuddhistadA kA vidhetyAha- yadA tvityAdi| nAtishudhyantIti sarva eva nAtivishuddhA bhavanti sAvasheShadoShA bhavantItyarthaH| na vA shudhyanti sarvasha iti rasAdiShu madhye katicicchudhyanti, katiciccAvishuddhA vartanta ityarthaH| dvAdasheti sapta dhAtavastrayo doShA mUtraM purIShaM ca| doShANAM ceha shuddhiH prakRutigamanena j~jeyA| dvAdashAshrayatvena santatasyaikadoShArabdhatvaM yaducyate, tannirastameva j~jeyam| visargamiti parityAgam| visargasvarUpamAha- avyaktalakShaNamiti; avyaktaM lakShaNaM yasya tamavyaktalakShaNaM visargam; etena, tadA~api jvaro lIno~astyeva, paraM lakShaNAni tasya vyaktAni na bhavantIti darshayati; tadanu trayodashadinAdArabhya dIrghakAlamanuvartate, tato durlabhopashamo bhavatIti yuktamuktam| ebhishca dhAtvAdidvAdashAshrayitva-dashAhAdivyApakatvAdibhirdharmaiH santato bhinna eva vAtAdijvarebhyaH kAlAniyamena dvitryAdidineShu vyavacchedenAnusaktebhyaH| yastu tantrAntare “tathA santata evAnyaH svalpadurbalakAraNaH| ekadoSho dvidoSho vA svalpopadravalakShaNaH|| atulyadUShyaprakRutiH” ityAdinA granthenocyate, so~asmAdanya eveti tantrAntare~apyanyashabdaprayogAt pratipAditamiti na virodhaH||53-60||-

satatakaM vivRuNoti- raktadhAtvAshraya ityAdi| prayograhaNAt satatako raktavyatiriktaM mAMsAdidhAtumapyAshrayata iti darshayati| sapratyanIka iti kAlAdiShu madhye~anyatamaH pratyanIkaH| kAlavRuddhikShayAtmakamiti kAle vRuddhikShayocite kAle vRuddhiH kShayashca yasya sa kAlavRuddhikShayAtmA| tena , doShAnuguNe kAle jvaro bhavati, doShAnuguNakAlavyatirikte ca kAle kShayo bhavati| jvarasya kAlaprakRutidUShyANAM madhye~anyatamAdbalaprAptau satyAmapi doShasamprApti mahimnA hi kAlabhAvitvaniyamo j~jeyaH||61-62||

medovahA ityatra medovahanADIrodhAdeva medoduShTirj~jeyA| uktaM hi- “teShAM srotasAM rodhAt sthAnasthAshcaiva mArgagAshca sharIradhAtavaH prakopamApadyante” (vi.a.5) iti| ‘mAMsasrotAMsyanusRutaH’ ityAdi tRutIyakacaturthakalakShaNaM kecit paThanti| atrApi srotoduShTyA dhAtuduShTiravagantavyA| ye tu tRutIyakacaturthakayordUShyapratipAdakaM granthaM na paThanti, teShAM tantrAntarapratyayAddUShyAvarodhaH| tRutIyakacaturthakasa~jj~jayaiva tRutIyadinacaturthadinabhAvitvaM j~jeyam||63-67||

jvarANAM vicchedAbhyAgame dRuShTAntamAha- adhishete ityAdi| adhishete iti adhiShThAya tiShThati| dhAtumiti satatakAdidUShyatvena paThitaM raktAdidhAtum| kAle iti svakAle| yadi svakAle jvaraM karoti doShaH, tadA tRutIyakacaturthakayoH kimiti vishrAmadine~api doShAnuguNe pUrvAhNAdikAle na karotItyAha- sa vRuddhiM cetyAdi| na kevalaM kAlamAtramapekShate, kintu vRuddhimapyapekShate tRutIyakAdikaraNe doShaH; sA ca vRuddhistRutIyake tryaheNa, caturthake caturaheNaiva bhavatIti bhAvaH| pratyanIkasya kAlaprakRutyAderdoShaviruddhasya balakShayaH; tena doShavRuddhyA yadA pratyanIkasya kShayo bhavati tadA jvarayatItyarthaH||68-69||

doShodrekavisheSheNa tRutIyakacaturthakayoH prabhAvamAha- kaphapittAdityAdi| pRuShThamabhIti pRuShThAt, pRuShThagrAhItyarthaH; kiMvA, pRuShThAditi lyablope pa~jcamI, tena pRuShThamadhiShThAyetyarthaH| ja~gghAbhyAM pUrvamiti ja~gghayoH prathamaM pIDAM karoti| atra ca na svapradhAnaH paittikashcaturthakaH pittagRudhrasIvadbhavatyevAnabhidhAnAditi mantavyaM; hArIte tu pittajanyatvaM yaduktaM tadanubandharUpapittajanyatvaM, pRuthakprabhAvAkartRutvAt; na hi prabhAvashcaturthakAbhyupagamavirodhI ||71-72||

samprati santatajvara eva yathA satatakAdirUpo bhavati, tathA satatakAdayaH santatAdirUpA bhavanti, tadAha- RutvahorAtretyAdi| balAbalAditi mano~antena sambadhyate, balaM cAbalaM ca balAbalam| arthavashAditi karmavashAt| RutvAdInAM balAttathA RutvAdyabalAjjvarastaM taM satatAdijvaroktaM kAlaM prapadyate| tatra RutubalAdvAtottaraH satatako varShAkAlajaH pratyanIkAM sharadaM prApya anyedyuShkAdirUpo bhavati| ahorAtrabalAbalAbalAt kAlavisheShaprAptiryathA- vasantasya madhyeShvahorAtreShu vAtikashcAturthiko jAto yaH sa vasantasya pashcimAnyahorAtrANi rUkShANi prApya balavAn tRutIyakAdirUpo bhavati, tathoktadineShveva shlaiShmikaH satatako jAtaH sheShadineShu shleShmapratyanIkeShu anyedyuShkAdirUpo bhavati| doShabalAbalAdduShTahetusevAbhUtAjjvaraparAvRuttiryuktaiva| manobalAt satatajvarI manonivRuttyAdinA anyedyuShkAdijvaravAn bhavati; manodaurbalyAdbhayAdinA caturthakAdijvarI tRutiyakAdijvaravAn bhavati| karmavashAjjvaraparAvRuttau shubhakarmaNA duHkhajvaraparAvRuttyA yo yaH sukhaH sa bhavati; pApakarmaNA tu duHkhajvaro bhavatIti j~jeyam||75-83||

sampratyaShTavidhajvarAkRutau vaktavyAnAha- hetubhirityAdi| hetavo~api jvaravisheShagamakatvenAkRutirUpA bhavantyeveti kRutvA hetukathanamapi yat kRutaM tadapyucitam| pUrvamiti nidAne| samAsenopadiShTasyeti ye nidAne dvAndvikasAnnipAtikAgantavaH samAsenoktAH, teShAmiha vistareNa lakShaNaM shRuNviti; ye punarekadoShajanyA vAtajvarAdayaste tatraiva prapa~jcenoktA iti neha punarvaktavyAH| bhramaH yena cakrasthitamivAtmAnaM manyate, kiMvA bhramaH bhrAntiH| shItakaH shItatA| staimityamiti vastrAvaguNThitatvamiva| santApo madhyavega iti nAtitIvraH santApaH| svedastambha iti svedApravartanam||84-88||-

sannipAtajvarasyordhvamiti atrordhvashabdenAdhikavAcinA prakRutisamasamavAyArabdhasannipAtajvarAdyAnyadhikAni vikRutiviShamasamavAyArabdhajvarasya lakShaNAni, tAni vakShyAmItyartha iti kecidvyAkhyAnayanti; yadiha sAsrAvakaluShanirbhugnalocanatvAdi vaktavyaM na tat pRuthagvAtAdijvaroktalakShaNamelake bhavati, kintu vikRutiviShamasamavAyArabdhe jvare saMyogamahimnA bhavatIti| vayaM tu brUmaH- yadyUrdhvashabdena vikRutiviShamasamavAyArabdhajvaralakShaNAbhidhAnamiha pratij~jAyate, tadA yat pratyekadoShalakShaNamelakenopapannaM lakShaNaM ‘kShaNe dAhaH kShaNe shItaM’ ityAdi, tadihAnabhihitaM syAt; sAmAnyena yAnyatra prAyaH prAdurbhavanti tAni vikRutiviShamasamavAyArabdhAni tathA prakRutisamasamavAyArabdhAni ca lakShaNAnyucyante; ata Urdhvamiti padasya cAtaH pareNetyarthaH| nirbhugne iti atikuTile| paridagdhA dagdhavat kRuShNavarNA| kharasparshA gojihvAvat| srastA~ggatA niHsahAvayavatA| ShThIvanaM raktasya pittasya vA mukhena svalpodgiraNam| shiraso loThanamiti itastato nayanam| kRushatvaM nAtigAtrANAM doShapUrNatvena| pratataM nirantaram| koTho bhAlukIye- “varaTIdaShTasa~gkAshaH kaNDUmAMllohito~asrakaphapittAt| kShaNikotpAdavinAshaH ‘koTha’ iti nigadyate tajj~jaiH” iti| mUkatvaM mandavacanatvam, avacanatA vA||89-108||-

AgantuM caturvidhaM vibhajannAha- AganturityAdi| kashA ‘sAra’ iti khyAtA, muShTiH ‘kIla’ iti khyAtaH| hate abhihate| prAyo raktamiti atyarthaM raktaM dUShayan mAMsAdi cAlpaM dUShayatItyarthaH| yadyapi nidAne~api “tatrAbhighAtajena vAyunA duShTashoNitAdhiShThAnena” (ni.a.1) ityuktaM, tathA~apIha raktasya sAkShAdduShTiH, tathA mAMsAdInAM manAgduShTiH sUcyata iti visheShaH||111-113||-

abhiSha~ggajvareShu doShAnubandhavisheShAnAha- kAmetyAdi| nanu nidAne- “abhiSha~ggajaH punarvAtapittAbhyAmanubadhyate” (ni.a.1) ityuktaM, tat kimiha bhUtAbhiSha~ggajasya tridoShAnubandha ucyate- na, tatra kAmAdyabhiSha~ggajo yaH prAyo bhavati, tadabhiprAyeNoktaM “vAtapittAbhyAmanubadhyate” (ni.a.1) iti; kAmAdikeShu hi kvacidvAtaH kvacit pittamiti vAtapittAnubandho j~jeyaH| bhUtasAmAnyalakShaNA iti devAdayo~aShTau unmAde bhUtA uktAH, teShAM madhye AveshakartRubhUtasya yallakShaNaM tena samAnyatra doShalakShaNAni bhUtajvare bhavanti| atra kAshmIrAH “viShavRukShAnilasparshAt” ityAdigranthaM viShajvarAbhidhAyakaM paThanti, viShajo~apyabhiSha~ggaja eva pravishati| ye tu na paThanti, tanmate~apyabhiSha~ggaje eva viShauShadhigandhajasyApyavarodhaH| anye tu viShajaM viShajanitapittakRutatvena doShaja eva kShipanti| abhicAraH hiMsArtho~atharvamantrahomAdiH| abhishApaH abhishapanameva| siddhA mantrauShadhatapaHshamAdisiddhAH| ‘sannipAtajvarasyoktaM’ ityAdigranthamatra kAshmIrAH paThanti, sa ca nAtiprasiddhaH||114-127||-

saMsRuShTA ityAdinA sarvajvarasAdhAraNAM samprAptimante brUte| samprAptirapi hi sarvajvarANAmAkRutireva, tena notsUtramasyAbhidhAnam | kiMvA, kramaprApte sAmajvaralakShaNe vaktavye~arucyAdInAM sAmajvaralakShaNAnAmutpAde upapattiM darshayituM samprAptirucyate| saMsRuShTA iti yugmabhUtAH| sannipatitA iti trayo~api militAH| paktimiti paktihetutayA jATharAgniM brUte| sthAnAditi grahaNyAH, grahaNI hi jATharAgnisthAnam| sveneti doShoShmaNA; teneti jATharAgnyUShmaNA| dehoShmaNa iti sakaladehacAriNaH prAkRutoShmaNaH| vAtashleShmaNostu yadyapi pittavaduShmA nAsti, tathA~api tayorbhUtatvena UShmA yo~asti, sa iha grAhyaH; vaktavyaM hi grahaNyadhyAye- “bhaumApyAgneyavAyavyAH pa~jcoShmANaH sanAbhasAH” (ci.a.15) iti| kiMvA, tenetyanena divyarUpajvarAdhiShThAnaprabhAvakRutaM doShANAmUShmANaM grAhayati; kiMvA, jvarasAmAnyasamprAptiprAptapittoShmANaM nidarshayati , sarvatra hi jvare pittamavashyaM bhavati; yaduktaM- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti jvaro nAstyUShmaNA vinA” (vA.ci.a.1) iti| kevalamiti samastam||129-131||-

avisargIti nityAnuShaktaH| doShANAmiti malasambaddhAnAM doShANAm| apravartanam avisargaH| kShunnAsha iti bubhukShAbhAvaH| na viD jIrNeti na purIShaM pakvam| na ca glAniriti na kShINamAMsatA||133-136||-

la~gghanaphalamAha- la~gghanenetyAdi| prANAvirodhineti balAvirodhinA, virodhashcAtikShayakaratvenehocyate| ArogyaM balavata eva bhavatIti balAdhiShThAnamArogyamuktam| yadityanenArogyaM pratyavamRushati||140-141||-

la~gghanAdikAle eva avasthAvisheShe deyaM jalamAha- tRuShyata ityAdi| vAtakaphajvare iti vAtajvare, kaphajvare, vAtakaphajvare ca| madyotthe kaphAdijvare~api shItalaM jalaM j~jeyam| tiktakaiH shRutamiti vakShyamANamustAdibhiH shRutam| ubhayamiti uShNaM tathA tiktakashRutashItaM ca| tridoShakaphapittajvarayostu yadyapIha pAnIyaM noktaM; tathA~api sAmAnyena vimAnasthAne yaduktaM- “kinnu khalu jvaritebhyaH pAnIyamuShNaM prayacchanti” (vi.a.3) ityAdinA, tatprAmANyAduShNameva jalaM deyaM; vAtapaittike tu jvare~atyarthadAhAdikArake shItalameva deyamityapi vimAna eva “atyarthotsannapitte” (vi.a.3) ityAdinA granthena sUcitam||143-144|-

uktAvasthAvyatirekeNa vamane doShamAha- anupasthitetyAdi| sarvadehAnugA iti sUkShmasirAtvagAdyanugatAH | sAmA iti sAmatvena styAnA apracalAshca| dhAtusthA iti dhAtuShu atyantAnupraveshavyavasthitAH| na sukhena nihriyante iti asunirharAH; kiMvA, asUn prANAn nirharantIti asunirharAH| atrArthA phalAnAmityAdinA dRuShTAntamAha| AmAnAM phalAnAM yathA svarasA nirharaNe sAtyayA bhavanti, tathA yathoktA api doShA ityarthaH; sAtyayA iti savyApadaH ||147-148||-

vamanala~gghanayoranantaraM yadvidheyaM tadAha- vamitamityAdi| vamitaM la~gghitamiti avasthAvashAt kadAcidvamitaM, kadAcilla~gghitaM, kadAcicca vamitala~gghitam| vamanAnantaraM hi yadA samyagvishuddhirna bhUtA tadA tadaharla~gghanamapi kriyate| kAle iti annadAnayogye kAle| yathAsvauShadhasiddhAbhiriti yathAviShayaM yasyAM yavAgvAM yadbheShajaM pippalInAgarAdi vaktavyaM, tatsiddhAbhiH; kiMvA, yasmi~jjvare yadbheShajaM pAcanaM vaktavyaM, tatsiddhAbhiH| uktaM hi sushrute- “annakAle hitA peyA yathAsvaM pAcanaiH kRutA” (su.u.a.39) iti| maNDapUrvAbhiriti maNDapradhAnAbhiH| tatra prathamaM maNDaM pItvA tadanu tanupeyAbhAgo yojyaH| yAvajjvaramRudUbhAvAditi yAvajjvarasya doShapAkAttIkShNatA nivartate; asati jvaramRudubhAve~api ShaDahaM yAvat| ayaM ca ShaDahaH kiM peyAdinAt prabhRuti AhosvijjvarotpAdadinAditi pakShadvayamuttaratra ‘jvaritaM ShaDahe~atIte’ ityatra nirlocayiShyAmaH| svedanAyetyAdau ‘bhavanti’ iti sheShaH| jvarasAtmyatvamabhidhAya yavagUnAmaviShayaM jvaritamAha- Ruta ityAdi| Rute madyasamutthitAditi madyakAraNe jvare niShedhaH| tathA madAtyaye~api vyAdhAvanyahetujo~api yo jvaraH, tathA grIShme, tathA pittakaphAdhike yo jvaraH, tathordhvaraktapittino yo jvaraH, teShu sarveShu peyA na deyA| iha madAtyayAdInAM peyArheShu jAto~api jvaraH peyAnarhaH| ‘pittakaphAdhike’ ityanena pittakaphayo ratimAtrodgame sati peyAyA adAnaM bodhayati| tena, kaphaje jvare pittaje jvare~anudbhUtadoShe ca peyA dAtavyA| tathA hi tantrAntare- “kaphaje~api yadA kShINo la~gghanAdikramAt kaphaH| shastA eva yavAgvastu tathA pitte~apyayaM kramaH” iti| tathA~atreva- “paittiko vA~atha shItAM madhuyutAM pibet| lAjapeyAM” ityanena pitte~api yavAgUM vakShyati| yattu- “pAMshudhAne yathA vRuShTiH kledayatyati kardamam| tathA shleShmaNi saMvRuddhe yavAgUH shleShmavardhanI” iti hArItenoktaM, tadativRuddhakaphaviShayaM j~jeyam| anye tu militapittakaphAdhikeShu puruSheShu yavAgUpratiShedhamicchanti| yadi tu ‘Urdhvage kaphapitte ca’ iti pAThastadA vAtajvariNo~api yadA UrdhvagaM kaphapittaM vamanenAyAti svayaM tadA~api peyA na deyetyarthaH | sushrute tu “kaphapittaparItasya UrdhvAsRukpittinastathA| madyanityasya na hitA yavAgUH” (su.u.taM.a.39) ityuktaM, tena ‘Urdhvage raktapitte’ iti pATho yuktaH||149-154||-

jIrNaM tarpaNaM yasya taM jIrNatarpaNam| mudgayUShasya jA~ggalarasasya ca vikalpaH sAtmyApekSho balApekShashca j~jeyaH| durbalo hi durbalAgniH prAyo bhavati, tasya ca mudgayuSho laghutvena deyaH, itarasya tu jA~ggalo rasaH||156-159||-

yatashca parigrahabhavatvaM vistaroktaM rudrakopabhavatvaM ca sa~gkShepoktam, ato rudrakopodbhavatvameva vivRuNoti- dvitIye hItyAdi| vinA krodhaM caryate yat tadakrodhavratam| tapovighnAshanAH tapovighnopajIvinaH| dhruvamiti avashyadeyam| satranAshanamiti yaj~janAshanam| shaive iti kalyANakare| apacArAntareShviti jvaranidAnasevAsu| atra ca satyayuge~api janmamaraNayormoharUpajvarasya vidyamAnatvAd dvitIyayuge~api janmaraNayorbhavanaM na jvarasyAnupapannam| tena, yo janmAdau nidhane ca vyavasthitaH sa idAnImapacArAntareShu bhaviShyasIti yojanIyam| kiMvA, satyayuge ca janmamaraNayormoharUpajvaro niShkalmaShANAM puruShANAM nAsIdeveti mantavyam| kalyANakarasvarUpasyApi shivasya prANipIDAkarajvaravisargaH prANinAmevAdharmaprabhAvAdavashyopabhogyAM pIDAM dRuShTveti mantavyam||15-25||

samprati kaShAyashabdasAmAnyena navajvaraniShiddhakaShAyasya mahAtyayakArakasya navajvare prayoge doShamAha- stabhyanta ityAdi| stabhyanta iti avicaladharmANo bhavanti| na vipacyanta iti cireNApi na sukhaM pacyante| stambhitvAditi stambhanasvabhAvatvAt| uktaM hi- “kaShAyaH stambhanaH shItaH” (sU.a.26) iti| ayamartho hArIte~apyuktaH- “na kaShAyaM prashaMsanti narANAM taruNe jvare| kaShAyeNAkulIbhUtA doShA jetuM sudustarAH” iti| pUrvaM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIye pa~jcarasakRuteShvapi svarasAdiShu kaShAyashabda uktaH, tadiha yadi kaShAyashabdena sAmAnyena madhurAdikRutAnAM svarasAdInAM pratiShedhaH syAt, tadA ShaDa~ggapAnIyasya pa~jcavidhakalpanAyAmavashyaniveshanIyasya tathA yavAgUsAdhanArthasya ca pAThena tattaddravasya niShedhaH syAt; yena, ShaDa~ggasya tathA yavAgUsAdhanadravasya ca prayogo~atra pa~jcavidhakalpanAyAmantarbhAvanIyaH, bheShajaprayogasya pa~jcavidhakalpanArthe~antarbhAvAt; ataH sarvakalpanAkaShAyapratiShedho mA syAdityAha- na tvityAdi| natu kalpamuddishyeti svarasakalkashRutashItaphANTarUpakalpanaM lakShyIkRutya; yaH kaShAyakaShAya iti yaH kaShAyairAmalakAdibhiH kRutaH svarasAdirUpaH kaShAyaH sa niShidhyata ityarthaH| na cAnena kaShAyarasakRutasvarasAdiniShedhena madhurAdikRutasvarasAdInAM taruNajvare prayogo bhavati, svarasAdibheShajasyAtigurostaruNajvare~avidhAnAt| tena, kaShAyakaShAyapratiShedhena tiktadravyakRutaShaDa~ggAdikalpanAkaShAyasya vihitasyAvirodhaH sAdhyate, na tvavihitasvarasAdividhAnaM kriyate| svarasAdigurubheShajasya taruNajvare niShedhavacanaM- “bheShajaM hyAmadoShasya bhUyo jvalayati jvaram” (su.u.taM.a.39) iti| anye tu bruvate- yat- ShaDarAtrAt parataH saptame divase kaShAyapAnaM vihitaM “pAcanaM shamanIyaM ca” ityAdinA svatantreNa; tatra saptame divase taruNa eva jvaro bhavati, taruNe ca jvare kaShAyapAnaM niShiddhamiti virodhaM pashyan madhurAdidravyakRutakaShAyasya saptame~ahanyapratiShedhaH, kaShAyakaShAyasya tu saptame~ahni pratiShedha ityupadarshanArthaM ‘na tu kalpanamuddishya’ ityAdi kRutaM; tatashca jvarAdiShaDahe sarvakaShAyapratiShedha eva, saptamadivasaprApte tu taruNe kaShAyadravyakRutakaShAyamAtrapratiShedha iti vAkyArtho bhavati||161-162||-

uktasarpiShpAnApavAdaviShayamAha- nirdashAhamityAdi| nirgato dashAho yasya sa nirdashAhaH| ala~gghitamiti asa~jjAtala~gghitalakShaNam, iyaM cAvasthA prabalasAmadoShArabdhatvAjjvarasya tathA~asamyagupacArAcca bhavatIti j~jeyam| kaShAyaistaM kaphottaramala~gghitaM copAcaret| yAvallaghutvAditi cchedaH| laghutve tu jAte kaphottaratA~ala~gghitatA ca nApayAti na tadA sarpiShpAnamevAnuvRuttaM kartavyamityarthaH| kaphottare~ala~gghite~api nirdashAhajvare mAMsarasena kimarthamevamashanaM kaphaviruddhaM deyamityAha- balaM hItyAdi| balakRucca taditi mAMsarasenAshanaM balakArakamityarthaH||165-166||-

jvareNAkShINasya shodhanamuktvA jvarakShINasya shodhanamAha- jvarakShINasyetyAdi| payaseti payaHpAnena| payastvanulomakatayA doShaharaM bhavati| anulomakatvaM ca virecanatvena vyavahriyata iti virecanAdeyatve kShIramuktam| atra kShIrasya pUrvoktaviShayeNaiva guNAnAM labdhatvAdavashiShTaM nirUhaguNamAha- nirUha ityAdi||169-170||-

antaHparimArjanamabhidhAya bahiHparimArjanamAha- abhya~ggAMshcetyAdi| prAdehaH sAmAnyena bahalo~abahalashca lepa iha gRuhyate| ye tu sushrutamatena bahalaM vishoShiNaM pradehaM grAhayanti, tanmatena dAhaprashamane lepo bahalaH kartavyaH syAt, sa ca tanureva kartavyaH, uktaM hi- “shlakShNapiShTaghano lepashcandanasyApi dAhakRut” (ci.a.30) ityAdi| vibhajya shItoShNakRutamiti uShNAbhiprAyaM shItAbhiprAyaM ca vibhajya yathAsa~gkhyaM shItakRutAn tathoShNakRutAn; vakShyati hi- “abhya~ggAMshca pradehaMshca pariShekAMshca kArayet| yathAbhilAShaM shItoShNaM vibhajya dvividhaM jvaram” iti| shItoShNatA ca dravyamahimnA saMskAreNa ca j~jeyA||174-175||-

kramaprAptauShadhaprashnasyottarArdhamAha- yeShAmityAdi| ‘raktashAlyAdayaH shastAH shAlayaH ShaShTikaiH saha’ iti kecit paThanti, atra ‘shAlayaH’ iti padena yavakAdInAM nirAsaH kriyate| kecittu ‘raktashAlyAdayaH shastAH purANAH’ iti paThanti, tatra yadyapi ‘shUkadhAnyaM shamIdhAnyaM samAtItaM prashasyate’ (sU.a.27) ityuktameva, tathA~api pramAdAdapurANagrahaNaniShedhArthaM ‘purANAH’ iti padam ||177-178||-

lAjapeyAmityAdikA dasha yavAgvaH| tatra prathamA shleShmaNIti haricandraH; kiMvA lAjapeyAM sukhajarAmityekA, tathA pippalInAgaraiH shRutAmiti dvitIyA, evaM sheShAbhiH samamekAdasha peyAH| sanAgarAM sRuShTaviT pibediti yojanA, sanAgarAmeva shItAM madhuyutAM pibet paittika ityaparA| shuNThyAstu madhurapAkitvena pAcanatvena ca pitte prayogaH| iha vidArIgandhAdyaM hrasvapa~jcamUlam| sayavAmiti padena ShaShTitaNDulakAryAM pibediti| sabilvAmityAdinA dhAvanIshRutAmityantena caikA yavAgUH| parikartikA kartikAkArA vedanA| kalashI siMhapucchI| dhAvanI kaNTakArI| atra ca yavAgUnAM sAdhanadravyajalataNDulaparimANe vRuddhavaidyavyavahArAH pUjitAH pramANIkartavyAH| atrAgniveshasaMhitAyAmadhIyate- “kvAthyadravyA~jjaliM kShuNNaM shrapayitvA jalADhake| pAdasheSheNa tenAtha yavAgUrupakalpayet|| karShArdhaM vA kaNAshuNThyoH kalkadravyasya vA palam| vinIya pAcayed yuktyA vAriprasthena cAparAm ” iti| aparAmiti kvAthasAdhyayavAgvA uktAyA bhinnAM kalkasAdhyAmityarthaH| evaM ca kalkapalena yA tatra yavAgUsAdhanaparibhAShA, sA ihApi dravyapalakalkena yavAgUsAdhanamupadishatA~anumataiva, tathAhi jIvantyAdiyavAgvAmaShTabhirdravyaiH kolapramANaiH sAdhanamuktam| yattu tatra vRukShAmlayuktetyAdyuktaM, tadamlatAmAtrArthaM vRukShAmladAnaM, na tadaShTamAShakapramANaM; kiMvA, tadapyaShTamAShakamAnapramANamastu, tathA~apyadUrAntarArthatayA kalkapalasAdhanopadeshikA paribhAShA~anumataiva bhavatyaShTamAShakAdhikapalakalkasAdhanopadeshena; uktaM hi- “jIvantyajAjIshaThipuShkarAhvaiH sakAravIdIpyakabilvamadhyaiH| sayAvashUkairbadarapramANairvRukShAmlayuktA ghRutatailabhRuShTA|| arshotisArAnilagulmashophahRudrogamandAgnihitA yavAgUH|| yA pa~jcakolairvidhinaiva tena siddhA bhavet sA~api samA tayaiva” (ci.a.12) iti; tasmAdetadyavAgUktamAnali~ggadarshanAt kalkapalasAdhyayavAgvabhidhAyikA paribhAShA~anumataiva, tadanyA tatsahacaritA karShArdhakaNAshuNThImAnadarshikA~anumataiva| kvAthasAdhyayavAgvAdidravyamAne tu vRuddhavyavahArapUjiteyaM paribhAShA- “yadapsu shRutashItAsu ShaDa~ggAdi prayujyate| karShamAtraM tato dravyaM sAdhayet prAsthike~ambhasi|| ardhashRutaM prayoktavyaM pAne peyAdisaMvidhau” iti| AdishabdenAtra yUSharasAdigrahaNam| “kvAthyadravyA~jjaliM kShuNNaM” ityAdiparibhAShAyAstathA~anuktaparibhAShAyAshca kartavyavyavasthA, tathA sakalayavAgUsAdhanataNDulajalAdimAnavyavasthAvicArashcApAmArgataNDulIya (sU.a.4) eva nirlocito~anusaraNIyaH||179-187||-

kapi~jjalaH gauratittiriH| eNaH kRuShNasAraH| upacakrakaH cakoraH| kAlapucchaH hariNavisheShaH| hariNaH tAmravarNaH| pRuShataH binducitrito hariNaH| rasakaraNe sUdashAstraM- “palAni dvAdasha prasthe ghane~atha tanuke tu ShaT| mAMsasya vaNTanaM kuryAt palamacchatare rase” iti| yatra tu rasasya dravyAntareNa sAdhanaM, tatra yavAgUvat sAdhanaM vyAkhyeyam| mAtrAvikalpaj~ja ityanena tAvatyA mAtrayA, tena ca saMskArakRutena vikalpenAnuShNalaghunA lAvAdayo deyAH, yena gauravAdagnivadhamuShNatvAdvA jvarAvRuttiM na janayantIti darshayati||190-193||-
gurUShNetyAdinA gurUShNAdiniShedhaH; pUrvaM tu kaShAyaniShedho yadyapi sAmAnyena kRutaH, tathA~apIhAnnapratiShedhaprastAvAdatyahitapratiShedhAcca punaH kriyate||195-196||

pAkyamiti shRutam| shItakaShAyastu dravyaM sa~gkShuNNamuShNodake prakShipya nishAsthitam| atra shItakaShAyaparibhAShA- “dravyAdApothitAttoye pratapte nishi saMsthitAt| yaH kaShAyo~abhiniryAti sa shItaH samudAhRutaH” (sU.a.4) iti| atrApi yadyapi dravyasya pAnIyasya ca mAnaM noktaM, tathA~api kvAthyadravyasamaM dravyaM grAhyaM, pAnIyaM tu yAvanmAnaH peyaH kvAtho bhavati tAvanmanaM grAhyaM, nahyatra pAnIyahrAso~asti; kiMvA paribhAShayaiva jalaM deyaM- “ShaDbhiH palaishcaturbhirvA salilAcchItaphANTayoH| AplutaM bheShajapalaM rasAkhyAyAM paladvayam” iti| shItakaShAyaH svalpavIryatayA tathA shaityaguNayogAccAtpabaladoShe dAhAbhibhUteca deyaH| parpaTakaM sadurAlabhaM veti tRutIyo yogo mandAgnipittakaphe| kirAtatiktAdishcaturtho vAtakaphe| pAThAdishca pitte| kirAtatiktAdinA ca bhelake sati pAThAsaptakaM jatUkarNapratyayAt kaphapitte bhavati| uktaM hi tatra- “bhUnimbaghanaguDUcIshuNThyudIcyoshIrahvayapAThAH” iti| atra kvAthakaraNe dravyAdimAnasyAnuktatvAnnyAyato mAnavyavasthA| tatreha yadyapi kvAthasaMvidhAnaM visheSheNa noktaM, tathA~api vyAdhitarUpIye yat kvAthakaraNasaMvidhAnamuktaM- “chedyAni khaNDashashchedayitvA medyAni cANusho bhedayitvA, prakShAlya, pAnIyenAbhyAsi~jcet” ityAdinA “gataraseShvauShadheShu sthAlImavatArya paripUtaM kaShAyaM” (vi.a.7) ityantena, tadeva sarvakaShAyakaraNasaMvidhAnaM j~jeyam| tatra hi yadyapi kvAthyadravyamAnaM tathA dravamAnaM sthApyakaShAyamAnaM ca noktaM, tathA~api yAvaddravyaM yAvatA jalena pakvaM sat gatarasaM bhavati, tAvati jale tAvaddravyaM deyamiti labhyate; tathA yAvatA kvAthasheSheNa gatarasAnyauShadhAni bhavanti tAvAn kvAthaH sthApyata iti ca labhyate; etaccauShadhAnAM gatarasatvaM dravabhAgatrayakShaya eva bhavatIti dRushyate, tena caturbhAgAvashiShTatA sarvakvAthe visheShavacanaM vinA kartavyA| kvAthArthajaladAnaM tu dravyApekShayA bhavati| tatra mRuduni dravye caturguNena jalena, kaThine~aShTaguNena, kaThinatare tu ShoDashaguNena pAke sati caturbhAgAvasheShe gatarasatvaM bhavati; etadapi dRushyate- snehAdisAdhanakabhUrikvAthakaraNe iyaM prayujyate; yatra tvalpaM kvAthyadravyaM tatra yathA yathA~alpatvaM bhavati tathA tathA mRudunyalpe~api dravye bhUrijalaM dIyate, stokena jalena kvAthyadravyasya gatarasatvAbhAvAt| tena, karShAdArabhya palaparyantakvAthe mRudunyapi ShoDashaguNaM jalaM dIyate, palAdUrdhvaM tu kuDavaparyantamaShTaguNaM jalaM dIyate| tadevamanirdiShTadravyajalasheShamAnamapyAcAryeNa gatarasatvAbhidhAnAt sarvakaShAyadravyAdiparimANamuktam| yadi hi dravyAdInAM niyataM pramANaM brUyAt, tadA dravyApekShayA tathA snehAdisAdhanApekShayA deyakvAthyApekShayA ca yadbhinnaM parimANaM tanna gRuhItaM syAt| tadarthAbhidhAyikAshca svatantrAntaraparibhAShA likhyante| pAtavyakaShAye kRuShNAtreyaH- “kvAthyadravyapale kuryAt prasthArdhaM pAdasheShitam” iti; anyatrApyuktaM- “kvAthyadravyapale vAri dviraShTaguNamiShyate” iti; tathA “karShAdau tu palaM yAvaddadyAt ShoDashikaM jalam| tatastu kuDavaM yAvattoyamaShTaguNaM bhavet” iti; sushrute ca snehAdikvAthaparibhAShA- “caturguNenAShTaguNena ShoDashaguNena vA~ambhasA~abhyAShicya caturbhAgAvashiShTaM kvAthayitvA~avatArayet ” (su.ci.a.31); ityAdipAThabhedAccaturguNAShTaguNaShoDashaguNajaladApikAH shrUyante, tAH kaThinAdidravyabhedAdboddhavyAH| yaduktaM- “mRudau caturguNaM deyaM, kaThine~aShTaguNaM tathA| kaThinAt kaThinatare deyaM ShoDashikaM jalam” iti| evaM tantrAntaraparibhAShAyAM ca vyavasthA vaktavyA| agniveshe hi shrUyate- “dravyamApothitaM kvAthyaM dattvA ShoDashika jalam| pAdasheShaM ca kartavyameSha kvAthavidhiH smRutaH|| caturguNenAmbhasA vA dvitIyaH samudAhRutaH” iti; atra madhyavidhayA~aShTaguNatvamapi pAnIyasya labhyate; tenApyuktaM- “dravyANAM madhyapAkArthaM yatra mAtrA na darshitA| pAdAMshAdauShadhAttatra jalaM dadyAccaturguNam|| caturbhAgAvashiShTaM ca kaShAyaM kArayedbhiShak” iti| evamanyA api tantrAntaraparibhAShA avirodhena neyAH| atraike vadanti- yadetadvyAdhitarUpIye kaShAyakaraNamuddiShTaM tannirUhAdhikAre, tadvishiShTArthaviShaya eva, tathAvidhakaShAyakaraNaM nAnyatra; yathA balAtaile- “balAshataM guDUcyAshca pAdaM rAsnAShTabhAgikam| jalADhakashate paktvA” (ci.a.28) ityAdyuktaM mAnaM na kvAthAntare yAti, kintu tatraiva niyamitamiti| maivaM, viShayavisheShoddeshavihito~api vidhirviShayAntare~api vRuddhavaidyavyavahArAnumatyA tathA tantrAntaraparibhAShAsaMvAdena ca viShamatantraM vA dRuShTvA samAnatvenaiva vyavasthApyate; yathA ikShvAkukalpe uktaM- “yAvat syAttantumattoye patitaM tu na shIryate” (ka.a.3) ityAdi lehapAkalakShaNaM viShayavisheShoktaM viShayAntare~api sAdhAraNaM bhavati| atra peyakvAthamAtrA~api tu iyattayA noktA, tasyAH puruShAdyapekShayA nAnAtvAt; sAmAnyena ca yaduktaM- “doShapramANAnurUpo hi bhaiShajyapramANavikalpo balapramANavisheShApekSho bhavati” (vi.a.8) iti; etena, yAvanmAtramauShadhaM balAgnyAdyapekShayopapadyate yasya puruShasya, tAvanmAtramauShadhaM tasya deyamityuktaM bhavati| uktaM cAnyatra- “mAtrAyA nAstyavasthAnaM doShamagniM balaM vayaH| vyAdhiM dravyaM ca koShThaM ca vIkShya mAtrAM prayojayet” iti| tatrAdUrAntarA madhyapuruShAbhiprAyeNa yA mAtrA bhavati, sA sUcitaiva tantrakartrA “palaM vatsakabIjasya shrapayitvA rasaM pibet” (ci.a.19) ityAdinA, tathA paToladye~api “palaM tathaiShAM saha cUrNitAnAM jale shRutaM doShaharaM pibennA” ityAdinA| sushrute~ayuktaM- “vyAdhyAdiShu tu madhyeShu kvAthasyA~jjaliriShyate” (su.sU.a.39) iti, pale ca kvAthye ShoDashapalasya pAdasheShatAyAM catuHpalarUpo~a~jjalireva bhavati| dAruko~apyAha- “jaghanyA dvipalA proktA mAtrA, madhyA catuShpalA| uttamA ShaTpalA proktA kvAthasnehauShadheShu tu” iti| anyatra coktam- “uttamasya palaM mAtrA, tribhishcAkShaishca madhyamA| jaghanyasya palArdhaM tu snehakvAthyauShadheShu ca” iti| etAshcAdUrAntarArthA balAgnyAdimAnena vyavahriyamANA eva paribhAShAH| anyaccintyate- yadetaccaturguNatvAdinA jalamuktaM, tat kiM kRutadvaiguNyaM sarvatra grahItavyam, uktaM hi- “shuShkadravyeShvidaM mAnaM dviguNaM taddravArdrayoH” iti; maivaM, suniShaNNakAderghRutadravyasya dvAtriMshatpalaparimANe dravaprasthe siddhe~api yadayaM- “triMshatpalAni prastho~atra vij~jeyo dvipalAdhikaH” (ci.a.14) iti karoti, tena tantrAntaraparibhAShAnumataM kuDavAdAveva mAne dvaiguNyaM bhavati, kuDavapUrvamAne tu dravArdrANAM dvaiguNyaM nAstIti darshayati| yena, pUrvaparibhAShayaiva dvaiguNye labdhe yat punardvAtriMshatpalaprasthakIrtanaM, tat pUrvaparibhAShAvyabhicAre sati kvacidvaiguNyaM darshayati| tena, raktikAdau tatparibhAShArthavyabhicArastantrAntarapramANAdunnIyate| tathAcAtreyaH- “dvaiguNyaM kuDavAdau tu shuShkamAnAddravasya hi| ArdrasyAtyalpavIryatvAjj~jeyamanyatra tat samam” iti; tathA jatUkarNe~apyuktam- “ArdrANAM ca dravANAM ca dviguNAH kuDavAdayaH” iti; anyatrApyuktaM- “raktikAdiShu mAneShu yAvanna kuDavo bhavet| shuShke dravArdrayoshcaiva tulyaM mAnaM prakIrtitam” iti| evaM ca kuDavAdimAnayogyasyApi yatra dravyasya palollekhena mAnaM gRuhyate, tatrApi na dvaiguNyam| tena “rAsnAsahasraniryUhe tailadroNaM vipAcayet” (ci.a.28) ityAdiShu palollekhena jalaM gRuhyamANaM na dviguNaM bhavati| kvacit palollekhamAnavidhAne~api tantrAntaradarshanAt kuDavAdivivakShAM kRutvA palollekhAgate~api drave dvaiguNyaM bhavati| yathA kShatakShINacikitsite “madhukAShTapaladrAkShAprasthakvAthe” (ci.a.11) ityAdinA yaH prayoga uktaH, sa jatUkarNe “drAkShAyAH prasthaH, madhukasyArdhakvAthaH” ityAdinA granthena paThitaH; tena, jatUkarNe madhukasyArdhaprasthollekhapAThAt kRutadvaiguNyameva dravaM bhavati, tatpratyayAccehApi madhukAShTapalollekhavihitakvAthye kuDavadvayavivakShayA kRutadvaiguNyameva jalaM deyam| evamanyatrApyanusaraNIyam| anye tu, “kuDavAdAvityatra atadguNasaMvij~jAnabahuvrIhiNA kuDave na dvaiguNyamasti” iti bruvate; tatashca sushrute “snehakuDave sAdhye bheShajapalaM piShTaM kalkaM” (su.ci.a.31) ityuktaM, tat kuDave snehacatuHpale bheShajapalaM bhavatIti kRutvA snehaprasthe~aShTapalakalkadAnavyavahAra upapannaH; yadi tu kuDavenAShTau palAni snehasya gRuhyante, tadA prasthe catuHpalakalkadAnamavyavahArasiddhaM syAt; etannAtisAdhu; yatastaiva snihakuDave sAdhye kvAthyadravyaprastho vidheya ityuktaM, tatra yadi kuDavena snehapalacatuShTayaM gRuhyate tadA catuHpale snehe ShoDashapalakvAthyagrahaNaM syAt, na ca tathA vyavaharati, kvAthyaShoDashapalaM hi aShTapale sneha eva gRuhyate, tasmAdasAdhakametat kuDavAdvaiguNyasyeti| dvaiguNyaM kuDave yuktaM, yathA~agastyaharItakyAM madhunaH kuDavaM yadihoktaM, tattantrAntare “madhunashca palAShTakam” iti paThyate; tathA tantrAntare- “trAyamANA catuHpalaM dashake~ambhasi sheShite| kuDave kuDavAn sarpiHkShIradhAtrIrasAn pacet” iti shrUyate; tatra yadi catuHpalaH kuDavaH syAt, tadA~atroktatrAyamANAghRutena saha virodhaH syAt; uktaM hi- “jale dashaguNe sAdhyaM trAyamANAcatuHpalam” ityAdi, yAvat “rasasyAmalakAnAM ca kShIrasya ca ghRutasya ca| palAni pRuthagaShTAShTau dattvA samyagvipAcayet” (ci.a.5) iti, tathA~anyatrApyuktam- “ArdradravyadravadravyapalairaShTabhireva ca| shuShkadravyacatuShkeNa kuDavaH samudAhRutaH” iti; tasmAt kuDave dvaiguNyaM sAdhu| ArdradvaiguNye tu, yeShAM dravyANAM shuShkANAmupayoga uktasteShAmArdraprayoge dvaiguNyaM bhavati; ye tu nityamArdrA evopayujyante, na teShAM dvaiguNyam| yaduktaM- “vAsAkuTajakUShmANDashatapatrIsahAcarAH | nityamArdrAH prayoktavyA na teShAM dviguNaM bhavet” iti| etat sarvaM peyakvAthaprasa~ggenoktaM snehapAke~api cintanIyam| snehapAke tu snehAt pAdikaH kalko deyaH, tathAhi vakShyati- “jalasnehauShadhAnAM tu pramANaM yatra neritam| tatra syAdauShadhAt snehaH snehAttoyaM caturguNam” (ka.a.12) iti| caturguNa eva sneho dravatve~api na dvaiguNyAt kalkAdaShTaguNo bhavati| anyatrApyuktaM- “kvAthyAccaturguNaM vAri pAdasthaM syAccaturguNam| snehAt snehasamaM kShIraM kalkastu snehapAdikaH” iti| yattu, aShTapala eva snehe kalkasya palamAnatvaM, tadAgamasiddhamapi na vyavahriyate; uktaM hi kRuShNAtreye- “snehapAkavidhau yatra pramANaM noditaM kvacit| snehasya kuDavaM tatra pacet kalkapalena tu” iti| tathA sushrute~api snehakuDave kalkapalamuktam| tadetadakalkasAdhyatvaM snehasya svarasenAtiguruNA sAdhye snehe puShpakalkasAdhye vA vyavasthApanIyam| dravyasya hi sasAratvaniH- sAratvAbhyAM kalkasyAlpatvabhUyastve dRuShTe| yaduktaM shaunakavacanamanuvadatA vAgbhaTena- “snehe sidhyati shuddhAmbuniShkvAthasvarasaiH kramAt| kalkasya yojayedaMshaM caturthaM ShaShThamaShTamam” iti; tathA “shaNasya kovidArasya karbudArasya shAlmaleH| kalkADhyatvAt puShpakalkaM prashaMsanti catuHpalam” iti| atra snehaprasthApekShayA catuHpalaH kalkaH snehAdaShTamabhAga eva bhavatItyAdivisheShavacanena “kalkashca snehApAdikaH” iti sAmAnyavacanasya bAdhA kvacidviShayavisheShe bhavatIha na virodhamAvahati| bhavatu, alamatiprapa~jcena, sarvathA vyavahArAnugatameva shAstraM pramANIkartavyam||197-199||-
pa~jca pa~jcavidhaM jvaramiti yathAsa~gkhyaM santatAdiShu kali~ggAdayo j~jeyAH| anye tu pa~jcasu pa~jcaiva yaugikAnAhuH ||200-203||
vatsakAragvadhamityAdinA balAmityantena kecidyogatrayaM, kecidekameva yogaM vadanti| nishi sthitamiti shItakaShAyam||204-206||-
jAtItyAdau jAtIpallavAH| saguDaM pibedityatra guDasya prakShepyatvena kvAthyadravyApekShayA pAdikatvam| evamanyatrApi prakShepe boddhavyam||207-209||
atra kaShAyaprakaraNAgatatvAt sannipAtacikitsAvasaramapyulla~gghya sannipAtaharau shaTyAdibRuhatyAdiprayogau paThati||210-214||

idAnIM sarpiHprayogAnabhidhAtuM sarpiSho viShayamAha - jvarA ityAdi| vamanairityanenehAvasthAvidheyavamanaprayogAn sarpiHShaDahabhAvino darshayati| la~gghanavacanena ca la~gghanasamAnakAlAH svedAdayo gRuhyante| rUkShasyeti vacanena kaShAyAdiprayoge satyapi sAmatAnubandhAt kaphottaratayA vA yatra rUkShatvaM na bhavati tatra sarpirna dAtavyamiti darshayati| atra kaShAyairityAdyasamAsanirdeshena vyastaiH samastairapi kaShAyAdiprayogai rUkShasya sarpiHpAnaM kartavyamiti darshayati| nanvavisheSheNa sarvajvareShu kaShAyAnantaraM sarpirucyate, tatkathamupapannaM bhavatItyAha- rUkShaM teja ityAdi| tatra tejaHshabdo yadyapi pittAnalasnehashaktidyutiShu grIShme ca vartate, tathA~apIha tejaHshabdenoShmA~abhidhIyate; tena rUkShasvarUpa UShmA sarvatra jvarakara ityuktaM bhavati| sa coShmA AmAshayavikShiptasyAgnestathA dehabhavo jvaraprabhAvakRutashca jvararUpo j~jeyaH| yaduktaM- “svena tenoShmaNA caiva kRutvA dehoShmaNau balam| santApamadhikaM dehe janayanti” ityAdi| ayaM ca UShmA sUkShmavicAre yadyapi pittasya bhavati, yaduktaM- “UShmA pittAdRute nAsti jvaro nAstyUShmaNA vinA” (vA.ci.a.1) iti, pittaM ca yadyapi “sasnehamuShNaM tIkShNaM ca” (sU.a.10) ityAdinA granthena snigdhamuktaM, tathA~apyavasthAvashAt pittaM nirAmaM sanniHsnehaM bhavati, snehashca pittaguNo dravayoganimittako na sAMsiddhikaH; tena snehApagamaH pittasyohyata evAvasthAyAM; tena niHsnehasya pittasyoShmA rUkSha eva bhavati| iyaM ca vyAdhyavasthA vyAdhiprabhAvAdeva jIrNAvasthAyAM bhavati, yathA- madAtyayasyAnte vAtapittatvaM; yaduktaM “pittamArutaparyantaH prAyeNa hi madAtyayaH” (ci.a.24) iti| kShArapANinA~apyuktaM- “jvaroShmaNA rUkShiteShu dhAtuShu balavAn mAruto jvarAnubandhaM viShamajvarANAmanyatamaM vA kuryAt” ityAdi| tatra rUkSheNa tejasA jvarakAlasambandhAdrUkShitasya jvariNo yo~anubandho dhAturanilaH syAt sa ca snehavadhya iti sarpiHkRutasnehaguNavadhya ityarthaH; cakArAdrUkShaM tejo yajjvarakaraM tadapi sarpiHkRutasnehavadhyamiti samuccinoti| dhAturiti visheShaNena vAyordhAraNAtmakatA ucyate; tatashca dhAraNAtmakasya vAyoH prakopo mahAtyaya iti sUcayati| anu pashcAdbalaM bhavati yasya so~anubalaH| tena sarvajvareShu kaShAyAdinA dvAdashAhena ca kAlena kaphaMshavikShaye sati jvaroShmA vRuddho bhavati, tadvirUkShaNAcca vAyurapi vRuddho bhavati| atra jvaroShmaNi pittadharme sarpistAvacchaityAdvihitaM bhavatIti prasiddhatvAnoktaM; snehAMshenaiva tu sarpiryathA pittoShmANaM jvarakaraM rUkShasvarUpaM tathA vAtaM ca snehAcchamayati, tat ‘rUkShaM teja’ ityAdinA shlokenoktaM bhavati| anye tu tejaHshabdeneha pittameva grAhayanti| pittaM hi dvividhaM- sadravaM nirdravaM ca| yat sadravaM tat sasnehaM, yattu la~gghanAdinA kShapitArdrabhAgaM nirdravaM tadrUkShaM bhavati, tadiha ‘rUkShaM teja’ ityanena gRuhyate| anye tu ‘yaH syAdanubalo dhAtuH’ ityanenAnubandharUpaM kaphaM grAhayanti, tato~anubandhaH kapho rUkShaM pittaM vAtashca snehAsAdhyo bhavatItyarthaH; snehashabdena ca prakaraNAt sarpirucyate, sarpishca kaphajit saMskArAdbhavati; yaduktaM- “ghRutaM tulyaguNaM doShaM saMskArAttu jayet kapham” iti (ni.a.1); ki~jca “ata UrdhvaM kaphe mande” ityAdinA triShvapi doSheShu sarpiHprayogo~anumataH; tadihApi traya eva doShA yathoktavyAkhyayA sarpirviShayAH pratipAditA bhavantIti| asmakaM tu pUrva eva vyAkhyAne svarasaH| anye tu ‘rUkShe tejo jvarakaraM’ iti paThanti| tatra rUkShe iti kaShAyAdibhI rUkShIkRutasharIre iti j~jeyaM, sheShaM ca pUrvavat| ayaM ca pAThaH pUrvaTIkAkRudbhirbhAsadatta-svAmidAsAShADhavarma-brahmadevaprabhRutibhirapi vyAkhyAtatvAnna pratikShepaNIyaH| kharanAdenApi samAno~ayaM pAThaH| uktaM hi tatra- “kaShAyapAnAdvamanAlla~gghanAllaghubhojanAt| rUkShitAnAM jvaro mokShe sarpiHpAnamudIkShate|| rUkShatejo~adhike dehe” ityAdinA||216-217||

pippalya ityAdi| pippalyAdau ghRute pippalyAdInAM visheShAnukteH kaShAyatvaM kalkatvaM caike bruvate, anye tu kalkamevecchanti| dravakAryaM tu dravasyAnuktatvAttoyenaiva kartavyaM, “dravakArye~api cAnukte sarvatra salilaM smRutam” (ka.a.12) iti vacanAt| nanu yatra kalkatvena dravyashrutiH, dravaM ca na shrutaM, tatra jalaM grahItavyaM, yathA- “tryUShaNatriphalAkalke bilvamAtre guDAt pale| sarpiSho~aShTapalaM paktvA mAtrAM mandAnalaH pibet” (ci.a.15) iti; yatra tu kaShAyatvaM kalkatvaM vA noktaM tatra kvAthakalkAveva kartavyau, yaduktaM sushrute- “kalkakvAthAvanirdeshe gaNAttasmAt prayojayet” (su.ci.a.31) iti| maivaM, sushrutoktaparibhAShA hIyaM gaNaviShayA eva, ‘gaNAttasmAt prayojayet’ iti vacanAt; na ca pippalyAdayo~amI gaNatvenoktAH, gaNo~api yatrAdhikaraNena shrutastatraiva kvAthakalkakaraNaM; yaduktamanyatra- “yatrAdhikaraNenoktirgaNasya snehasaMvidhau| tatraiva kalkaniryUhAviShyete snehavedibhiH” iti; ki~jca sAmAnyena dravyasya snehasAdhanAbhidhAne yadi kalkakaShAyatvaM syAttadA balAtailAdau “balAkaShAyakalkAbhyAM tailaM kShIrasamaM pacet” (ci.a.29) iti na kuryAt kalkakaShAyayorupAdAnaM, sAmAnyasAdhanavacanenaiva labdhatvAt, tasmAt kalkamAtreNaiva pippalyAdidravyaM jalaM ca caturguNaM deyam; evamanyatrApi boddhavyam| atra ca paktavyaghRutasya pramANAnirdeshAdavyavasthitamAnameva sarpiricchAtaH paktavyaM, yatra tu prasthAdimAnanirdeshaM karoti tatra tAvanmAtreNaiva snehasAdhyarogopashamo bhavatIti j~jeyam| tathAhi vAtavyAdhau prabhUtasnehasAdhye bhUyasImeva snehamAtrAM vakShyati, prapauNDarIkAdye nasyayogitayA kuDavamAnaM snehaM vakShyati, kuShThoktatiktakaShaTpalAdau atyalpapAkasaMvidhAnena pakvasya ghRutasya kAryakartRutvaM bhavatIti bheShajaprabhAvadarshI maharShirbodhayati| tatra yadi kuShThasya dIrgharogatayA bhUyo bhUyastiktaShaTpalalepena prayojanaM tadA punaH punaH ShaTpalamAnaM paktavyaM ghRutaM, “yathA kurvanti sa upAya” (sU.a.26) iti vacanAt| evamagastyaharItakyAdAvapi pratiniyatamAnakathanaprayojanaM vAcyam| tasmAnna yAdRucchikaM kvacidAcAryasya mAnAbhidhAnamanabhidhAnaM ca| tAmalakI ‘bhUmyAmalakI’ iti khyAtA| halImakaM kAmalAbhedam| sanniyacchati samIkaroti||219-221||

vAsAdye ghRute kvAthasya parimANaM yadyapi noktaM, tathA~api dviguNa eva kvAtho grAhyaH; snehapAke caturguNa eva dravaH, “snehAttoyaM caturguNam” (ka.a.12) iti vacanAt; jalashabdashcAtra dravopalakShaNaH| atra ca “dvAbhyAmapi cAturguNyam” iti paribhAShayA yadyapi kShIraM kaShAyavadviguNamatra labhyate, tathA~api trividhashiShyabuddhihitAya spaShTArthaM kShIradvaiguNyAbhidhAnamiti bruvate| tatra kShIrasya mAnAnuktau “kvAthyAccaturguNaM vAri pAdasthaM syAccaturguNam| snehAt snehasamaM kShIraM kalkashca snehapAdikaH” iti vacanAt kShIrasya dravAntarasattve sati snehasamatvameva syAt; tatashca kaShAyabhAgatrayaM kShIraM caikabhAgamiti kRutvA dvAbhyAmapi cAturguNyamiti paribhAShA syAt; tasmAt kartavyaM kShIradvaiguNyavacanam| anye tu- “dvAbhyAmapi cAturguNyamiti paribhAShayA pratyekameva draveNa cAturguNyamicchanti”, tatashceha kaShAyasya cAturguNyaM kShIrasya tu dvaiguNyaM bhavati| tatra “ekenApi cAturguNyaM, dvAbhyAmapi cAturguNyaM, tribhirapi cAturguNyaM, caturbhiH samam” iti vacanena caturbhiH snehasamatAbhidhAnena snehacAturguNyameva dravasyoktam| ato dvAbhyAM tribhirapi tathA cAturguNyaM kartavyaM yathA snehAccaturguNaM syAt, tacca militvaiva cAturguNyaM bhavati na pratyekam| caturguNadravaparibhAShA tu pa~jcaprabhRutidravasAnnidhye visheShavacanAdbAdhyate| vacanaM hi- “pa~jcaprabhRuti yatra syurdravANi snehasaMvidhau| tatra snehasamAnyAhurarvAk syAttu caturguNam” iti||222-223||
balAdye~api kvAthapayasoH pUrvoktakvAthakShIrasAhacaryAt pratyekaM dviguNatvaM j~jeyam||224-226||

samprati kramasUcitavamanavirecanayogAnAha- jvaribhya ityAdinA| bahudoShebhya ityanena alpadoSheShu saMshodhanaM niShiddhamiti sphorayati| kAla iti yathoktavamanavirecanayogyajvarAvasthAyAm| kalpa iti kalpasthAne| madanapippalIyuktaM kaphe, kali~ggayuktaM pittashleShmaNi, madhukayuktaM tu dAhaprAye | kShaudrayogAnmadhurIkRutamambu kShaudrAmbu| saindhavayogAllavaNIkRutamambu lavaNAmbu| praskandanamiti virecanam| AvApyeti upayojya||227-233||
yadyapi nidAne~api pUrvarUpANyuktAni, tathA~apIha prakaraNavashAdyani prAyaH prAdurbhavanti, tAni paThyante- AlasyamityAdi||28-29||

pAThakramAgatakShIraprayogAnAha- kAsAdityAdi| atra pa~jcamUlyAdidravyasya tathA kShIrasya pAnIyasya ca mAnAnuktau vRuddhavaidyavyavahArasiddhayA paribhAShayA mAnakalpanA; yaduktaM- “dravyAdaShTaguNaM kShIraM kShIrAttoyaM caturguNam| kShIrAvasheShaH kartavyaH kShIrapAke tvayaM vidhiH” iti| etacca dravyasyArdhapalaM, kShIraM palacatuShTayaM, pAnIyaM palAni ShoDasha dattvA, kShIrAvasheShaH pAkaH kartavyaH; evamprakArA mAnavyavasthA| yatra tu mAShaparNIbhRutIye “medAM payasyAM jIvantIM vidArIM kaNTakArikAm| shvadaMShTrAM kShIrikAM mAShAn godhUmAMshchAliShaShTikAn|| payasyardhodake paktvA kArShikAnADhakonmite| vivarjayet kShIrasheShaM” (ci.a.2) ityAdinA kShIradravyAdimAnamuktaM tattatraiva viShaye j~jeyaM, tantrAntaraparibhAShA- gRuhItatvAdasya mAnasya| pradeshAntarayogoktaM hi mAnaM tadeva pradeshAntare~api mAnali~ggaM bhavati yat paribhAShAnugataM, yattu paribhAShAntarabAdhakaM mAnaM tat svaviShaya evAvatiShThate; yathA- “sAdhayecchuddhashuShkasya lashunasya catuShpalam| kShIre jalAShTaguNite kShIrasheShaM ca nA pibet” (ci.a.5) iti; evamanyadapi tantrAntare yat paribhAShAviruddhamAnakathanaM tattatraiva prayoge vyavasthitaM j~jeyam| parikartikA parikartanAkArA gudAdivedanA| nAgaramityAdau kShaudrasya pAkAnarhatvenottarakAlaM dravyAntaratulyamAnasyaiva prakShepo j~jeyaH| uShNaM shItaM ceti vikalpa icchAvisheShakRutaH; prabale vAte uShNaM, pitte tvatibale shItam||234-239||

nirUhavidhau jvaraharAniti vacanena jvaraharairdravyairnirUhAnuvAsanakalpanAM darshayati| paTolAdye nirUhe payasyardhodake shRutamiti vacanena kShIratulyasya jalasya grahaNamardhashabdasya samavibhAgavacanatvAjj~jeyam| atra ca kvAthakalkasnehAdimAnavyavasthA siddhisthAne vaktavyaiva boddhavyA| guDUcyAdau sAdhayedrasamiti kvAthaM kuryAt| IShatsalavaNamiShatkShaudrasarpiShA yuktamiti yojyam||240-249||

jIvantyAdye~anuvAsane yamake kShIraM snehasamaM, jalaM tu triguNamiti snehAccAturguNyaM dravasya kAryam| madanaishca shRutaH sneha ityatrAnantaroktaH sarpistailarUpa eva yamakasneho j~jeyaH| evaM ‘siddhaH sneha’ ityatrApi j~jeyam||250-253||
yaduktamityAdinA shirovirecanadravyamAha| bheShajAdhyAye iti apAmArgataNDulIye (sU.a.2)| yacca nAvanikaM tailamiti aNutailam||254-255||

sUcitaM candanAdyaM tailaM brUte- athetyAdi| athashabdo~adhikAre| candanAdyena dravyeNa saMskRutaM tailamapi candanAdyamucyate| candanaM raktacandanaM, bhadrashriyaM shvetacandanaM, kAlAnusAryaM shItalaM, nalinaM padmabhedaH, bisaM mRuNAlasUtraM, vetasaH sugandhimUlaM, vAnIrastadbhedo~apyasugandhimUlaH, ashvakarNaH shAlabhedaH, ariShTaH parvatIyanimbaH, syandanaH nemivRukShaH, vAtapothaH palAshaH, tinishaH va~jjulaH, kadaraH viTkhadiraH, kapItanaH ‘gandhamuNDa’ iti khyAtaH, vaTaH niShpraroho vaTaH, nyagrodhastu prarohavAn, jyotiShmatI kA~ggaNikA, saMvartakaH bibhItakaH, shataparvA shvetadUrvA, shItakumbhikA , kAShThapATalA, mahAshrAvaNI alambuShA sthUlaphalA, shItapAkI gaNDadUrvA, odanapAkI nIlabheNDI, kAlA kAkolI, RuShyaproktA RuddhiH, tRuNashUnyaM ketakI| yathAlAbhamityanena duHkhaprApyabheShajaparityAgenApi candanAdipAkaM darshayati| dviguNaM payo yasmin kvAthe tena dviguNapayasA kvAthena| atra kalkamAnAnirdeshe~api snehapAdikatvaM kalkasya, “kalkashca snehapAdikaH” iti vacanAt| atra yadyapi tailamuShNaM ghRutaM ca shItalaM, shItaM ca dAhaprashamane prashastaM, tathA~api sUkShmamArgAnusAritayA vyavAyitayA tathA sparshanenAdhikavAtaharatayA tailamevAbhya~ggaprastAve candanAdyaM kRutaM na ghRutam; anye ghRutAdapi tailaM saMskAravAhitaramiti kRutvA tailamihoktamiti bruvate| nanu candanAdyamiti sa~jj~jAkaraNena kiM? pradeshAntare vyavahArArthamiti cet; na, vinA~api sa~jj~jAkaraNe pradeshAntare yaugikasa~jj~jayA vyavahAro dRuShTaH, yathA- “ShaTpalaM pAyayet sarpiH” (ci.a.5), tathA “vAsAghRutaM dAdhikaM ca pibettryUShaNameva ca” (ci.a.17) ityAdau; tathA kRutAyAmapi sa~jj~jAyAM vyavahAro na dRushyate, yathA- “etat prAyogikaM sarpiH pArUShakamiti smRutam” (ci.a.29) iti, tathA ShaDbhAgakaShAyakAdisa~jj~jAM kRutvA na ca tAbhiH pradeshAntare vyavahAraH kRutaH| maivaM pArUShakAdisa~jj~jayA yadyapi shAstre vyavahAro nAsti, tathA~api tadvidyAnAM vaidyAnAM tayA sa~jj~jayA vyavahAro bhaviShyati, etadarthaM sa~jj~jAkaraNam| sa~jj~jAnAM ca prayogakathanasamaye~akaraNe~api yogasiddhAH sa~jj~jA bhavantyeva ShaTpalAdikAH| tena pradeshAntare~api yaugikasa~jj~jAvyavahAro bhavati kvacit, kvaciccAnyathopAdeyatayA vaidyaprasiddhyA ca prayogasamaya eva sa~jj~jA kriyata iti na kAcit kShatiH| evamanyatrApi sa~jj~jAkaraNe vyAkhyeyam| ashlakShNapiShTairiti vacanena shlakShNapiShTalepasya dAhakartRutAM sucayati; yaduktaM- “shlakShNapiShTaghano lepashcandanasyApi dAhakRut| tvagagatasyoShmaNo rodhAcchItakRuttvanyathA~aguroH” (ci.a.30) iti||258-259||

saMsparshAnurasAn spRushediti vacanAnna ciraM dhArayediti darshayati; ciradhAraNe hi teShAmapyuShNatA syAt| vAyavashcandrapAdAshca shItA iti atra shItA iti visheShaNaM vAyoH; na candrapAdAnAM, teShAM sarvadA shItatvAt; kiMvA candrapAdA api uShNakAle uShNasamparkAduShNA bhavanti, tannirAsArthaM shItA iti||260-266||

svedAdhyAye trayodashavidhasyoktatvAt punastrayodashavidhavacanaM sarveShAmeva karaNArthaM; kiMvA adhikAnAgnisvedaniShedhArtham| trayodashavidhasvedAntargatA~api kuTI visheSheNa hitatvAt punarucyate| tacca shayanamiti kuTIparikaratayA pratipAditaM shayanam; evamAcchAdanamapi| etacca shayanAcchAdanaM pRuthagapyatra hitamiti pRuthakpAThAddarshayati| ghanA iti bahalAH| svedanAni uShNAni kukkuTamadirAkulatthAdIni| saMsargabalayojanAdityatra anantarokta evoShNAbhiprAyajvarakaro vAtakaphasaMsargaH saMsargashabdena gRuhyate; tena vAtakaphasaMsarge yadA vAto balavAn tadA gurUShNasnigdhabhUyiShThamannapAnaM, yadA tu kapho balavAMstadA laghUShNarUkShaprAyaM vidheyamityarthaH| ayaM ca vAtakaphajo jvaro visheSheNa vAyoryogavAhitayA shIto bhavatIti kRutvehoktaH ; tena kevalakaphajaH kevalavAtajo~api shItAbhiprAyo j~jeya eva||268-271||
athAto raktapittacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
gatirUrdhvamadhashcaiva raktapittasya darshitA| UrdhvA saptavidhadvArA dvidvArA tvadharA gatiH||15||
sapta cchidrANi shirasi dve cAdhaH, sAdhyamUrdhvagam| yApyaM tvadhogaM, mArgau tu dvAvasAdhyaM prapadyate||16||
yadA tu sarvacchidrebhyo romakUpebhya eva ca| vartate tAmasa~gkhyeyAM gatiM tasyAhurAntikIm||17||
yaccobhayAbhyAM mArgAbhyAmatimAtraM pravartate| tulyaM kuNapagandhena raktaM kRuShNamatIva ca||18||
saMsRuShTaM kaphavAtAbhyAM kaNThe sajjati cApi yat| yaccApyupadravaiH sarvairyathoktaiH samabhidrutam||19||
hAridranIlaharitatAmrairvarNairupadrutam| kShINasya kAsamAnasya yacca tacca na sidhyati||20||
yadvidoShAnugaM yadvA shAntaM shAntaM prakupyati| mArgAnmArgaM caredyadvA yApyaM pittamasRuk ca tat||21||

ekamArgaM balavato nAtivegaM navotthitam| raktapittaM sukhe kAle sAdhyaM syAnnirupadravam||22||

Commentary: ekamArgamityAdinA sAdhyalakShaNam| ekamArgamiti sAmAnyavacane~apyUrdhvamArgameva labhyate, adhogasyaikamArgagasyApi yApyatvAt| sukhe kAle iti hemante shishire ca| atra mArgeNa tathA doSheNa tathA lakShaNena sAdhyAsAdhyayApyabhedAH pRuthaguktAH| tatra ca sAdhyalakShaNayApyalakShaNamelake yApyatvameva; yApyAsAdhyamelake~asAdhyatvameva, yathA- ekadoShaM yadadhogataM tadekadoShatvAt sAdhyaM kintvadhogatatvAdyApyaM; yattridoShamadhogataM tadadhogatatvena yApyaM, kintu tridoShatvAdasAdhyameveti j~jeyam| yaduktaM- “nAsAdhyaH sAdhyatAM yAti sAdhyo yAti tvasAdhyatAm” (ni.a.8) iti; “sAdhyA yApyatvamAyAnti yApyAshcAsAdhyatAM tathA” (ni.a.8) iti ca||22||
snigdhoShNamuShNarUkShaM ca raktapittasya kAraNam| adhogasyottaraM prAyaH, pUrvaM syAdUrdhvagasya tu||23||
UrdhvagaM kaphasaMsRuShTamadhogaM mArutAnugam| dvimArgaM kaphavAtAbhyAmubhAbhyAmanubadhyate||24||
akShINabalamAMsasya raktapittaM yadashnataH| taddoShaduShTamutkliShTaM nAdau stambhanamarhati||25||
galagrahaM pUtinasyaM mUrcchAyamaruciM jvaram| gulmaM plIhAnamAnAhaM kilAsaM kRucchramUtratAm||26||
kuShThAnyarshAMsi vIsarpaM varNanAshaM bhagandaram| buddhIndriyoparodhaM ca kuryAt stambhitamAditaH||27||
tasmAdupekShyaM balino baladoShavicAriNA | raktapittaM prathamataH pravRuddhaM siddhimicchatA||28||
prAyeNa hi samutkliShTamAmadoShAccharIriNAm| vRuddhiM prayAti pittAsRuktasmAttalla~gghyamAditaH||29||
mArgau doShAnubandhaM ca nidAnaM prasamIkShya ca| la~gghanaM raktapittAdau tarpaNaM vA prayojayet||30||
hrIberacandanoshIramustaparpaTakaiH shRutam| kevalaM shRutashItaM vA dadyAttoyaM pipAsave||31||
Urdhvage tarpaNaM pUrvaM peyAM pUrvamadhogate| kAlasAtmyAnubandhaj~jo dadyAt prakRutikalpavit||32||
jalaM kharjUramRudvIkAmadhUkaiH saparUShakaiH| shRutashItaM prayoktavyaM tarpaNArthe sasharkaram||33||
tarpaNaM saghRutakShaudraM lAjacUrNaiH pradApayet| UrdhvagaM raktapittaM tat pItaM kAle vyapohati||34||
mandAgneramlasAtmyAya tat sAmlamapi kalpayet| dADimAmalakairvidvAnamlArthaM cAnudApayet||35||
viharantaM jitAtmAnaM pa~jcaga~gge punarvasum| praNamyovAca nirmohamagnivesho~agnivarcasam||3||
bhagavan raktapittasya heturuktaH salakShaNaH| vaktavyaM yat paraM tasya vaktumarhasi tadguro||4||
gururuvAca- mahAgadaM mahAvegamagnivacchIghrakAri ca| hetulakShaNavicchIghraM raktapittamupAcaret||5||
tasyoShNaM tIkShNamamlaM ca kaTUni lavaNAni ca| gharmashcAnnavidAhashca hetuH pUrvaM nidarshitaH||6||
tairhetubhiH samutkliShTaM pittaM raktaM prapadyate| tadyonitvAt prapannaM ca vardhate tat pradUShayat||7||
tasyoShmaNA dravo dhAturdhAtordhAtoH prasicyate| svidyatastena saMvRuddhiM bhUyastadadhigacchati||8||

saMyogAddUShaNAttattu sAmAnyAdgandhavarNayoH| raktasya pittamAkhyAtaM raktapittaM manIShibhiH||9||

Commentary: raktapittasa~jj~jAnimittamAha- saMyogAdityAdi| raktasya saMyogAttathA raktasya dUShaNAttathA raktasya gandhavarNayoH pitte sAmAnyAt pittaM raktapittamucyate iti vAkyArthaH||9||

plIhAnaM ca yakRuccaiva tadadhiShThAya vartate| srotAMsi raktavAhIni tanmUlAni hi dehinAm||10||

Commentary: raktapittasya sthAnamAha- plIhAnaM cetyAdi| vartate Urdhvamadhashca yAti; ‘vardhate’ iti vA pAThaH| kasmAdyakRutplIhnoreva tadvartata ityAha- srotAMsItyAdi| yasmAdraktasyApi yakRutplIhAnAveva pradhAnaM sthAnaM, tena raktasaMyogAdiniShpannasya raktapittasya tadeva sthAnamiti bhAvaH||10||
sAndraM sapANDu sasnehaM picchilaM ca kaphAnvitam| shyAvAruNaM saphenaM ca tanu rUkShaM ca vAtikam||11||
raktapittaM kaShAyAbhaM kRuShNaM gomUtrasannibham| mecakAgAradhUmAbhama~jjanAbhaM ca paittikam||12||
ekadoShAnugaM sAdhyaM dvidoShaM yApyamucyate||13||
yattridoShamasAdhyaM tanmandAgnerativegavat| vyAdhibhiH kShINadehasya vRuddhasyAnashnatashca yat||14||
shAliShaShTikanIvArakoradUShaprashAntikAH| shyAmAkashca priya~ggushca bhojanaM raktapittinAm||36||
mudgA masUrAshcaNakAH samakuShThADhakIphalAH| prashastAH sUpayUShArthe kalpitA raktapittinAm||37||
paTolanimbavetrAgraplakShavetasapallavAH| kirAtatiktakaM shAkaM gaNDIraH sakaThillakaH||38||
kovidArasya puShpANi kAshmaryasyAtha shAlmaleH| annapAnavidhau shAkaM yaccAnyadraktapittanut||39||
shAkArthaM shAkasAtmyAnAM tacchastaM raktapittinAm| svinnaM vA sarpiShA bhRuShTaM yUShavadvA vipAcitam||40||
pArAvatAn kapotAMshca lAvAn raktAkShavartakAn| shashAn kapi~jjalAneNAn hariNAnkAlapucchakAn||41||
raktapitte hitAn vidyAdrasAMsteShAM prayojayet| IShadamlAnanamlAn vA ghRutabhRuShTAn sasharkarAn||42||
kaphAnuge yUShashAkaM dadyAdvAtAnuge rasam| raktapitte yavAgUnAmataH kalpaH pravakShyate||43||
padmotpalAnAM ki~jjalkaH pRushniparNI priya~ggukAH| jale sAdhyA rase tasmin peyA syAdraktapittinAm||44||
candanoshIralodhrANAM rase tadvat sanAgare| kirAtatiktakoshIramustAnAM tadvadeva ca||45||
dhAtakIdhanvayAsAmbubilvAnAM vA rase shRutA| masUrapRushniparNyorvA sthirAmudgarase~atha vA||46||
rase hareNukAnAM vA saghRute sabalArase| siddhAH pArAvatAdInAM rase vA syuH pRuthakpRuthak||47||
ityuktA raktapittaghnyaH shItAH samadhusharkarAH| yavAgvaH kalpanA caiShA kAryA mAMsaraseShvapi||48||
shashaH savAstukaH shasto vibandhe raktapittinAm| vAtolbaNe tittiriH syAdudumbararase shRutaH||49||
mayUraH plakShaniryUhe nyagrodhasya ca kukkuTaH| rase bilvotpalAdInAM vartakakrakarau hitau||50||
tRuShyate tiktakaiH siddhaM tRuShNAghnaM vA phalodakam| siddhaM vidArigandhAdyairathavA shRutashItalam||51||

j~jAtvA doShAvanubalau balamAhArameva ca| jalaM pipAsave dadyAdvisargAdalpasho~api vA||52||

Commentary: samprati pAnIyadAnaviShayaprakAramAha- j~jAtvetyAdi| doShAviti vAtakaphau, pittaM tu nAyakameva nAnubalam| visargAditi virateH, yAvadicchamityarthaH| pakShAntaramAha- alpasho~api vA, stokaM stokamityarthaH| atra yadi balavAnagniH sharIraM ca mahattadA visargaparyantaM jalaM deyaM; viparyaye tu pAnIyaM nAtipathyaM, tenAlpasho deyam||52||

nidAnaM raktapittasya yatki~jcit samprakAshitam| jIvitArogyakAmaistanna sevyaM raktapittibhiH||53||

Commentary: raktapittanidAnavarjanArthamAha- nidAnamityAdi||53||-
vakShyate bahudoShANAM kAryaM balavatAM ca yat||54||
akShINabalamAMsasya yasya santarpaNotthitam| bahudoShaM balavato raktapittaM sharIriNaH||55||
kAle saMshodhanArhasya taddharennirupadravam| virecanenordhvabhAgamadhogaM vamanena ca||56||
trivRutAmabhayAM prAj~jaH phalAnyAragvadhasya vA| trAyamANAM gavAkShyA vA mUlamAmalakAni vA||57||
virecanaM prayu~jjIta prabhUtamadhusharkaram| rasaH prashasyate teShAM raktapitte visheShataH||58||
vamanaM madanonmishro manthaH sakShaudrasharkaraH| sasharkaraM vA salilamikShUNAM rasa eva vA||59||
vatsakasya phalaM mustaM madanaM madhukaM madhu| adhovahe raktapitte vamanaM paramucyate||60||
Urdhvage shuddhakoShThasya tarpaNAdiH kramo hitaH| adhogate yavAgvAdirna cetsyAnmAruto balI||61||
balamAMsaparikShINaM shokabhArAdhvakarshitam| jvalanAdityasantaptamanyairvA kShINamAmayaiH||62||
garbhiNIM sthaviraM bAlaM rUkShAlpapramitAshinam| avamyamavirecyaM vA yaM pashyedraktapittinam||63||
shoSheNa sAnubandhaM vA tasya saMshamanI kriyA| shasyate raktapittasya paraM sA~atha pravakShyate||64||
aTarUShakamRudvIkApathyAkvAthaH sasharkaraH| madhumishraH shvAsakAsaraktapittanibarhaNaH||65||
aTarUShakaniryUhe priya~gguM mRuttikA~jjane| vinIya lodhraM kShaudraM ca raktapittaharaM pibet||66||
padmakaM padmaki~jjalkaM dUrvAM vAstUkamutpalam| nAgapuShpaM ca lodhraM ca tenaiva vidhinA pibet||67||
prapauNDarIkaM madhukaM madhu cAshvashakRudrase| yavAsabhRu~ggarajasormUlaM vA goshakRudrase||68||
vinIya raktapittaghnaM peyaM syAttaNDulAmbunA| yuktaM vA maghusarpirbhyAM lihyAdgoshvashakRudrasam||69||
khadirasya priya~ggUNAM kovidArasya shAlmaleH| puShpacUrNAni madhunA lihyAnnA raktapittikaH||70||
shRu~ggATakAnAM lAjAnAM mustakharjUrayorapi| lihyAccUrNAni madhunA padmAnAM kesharasya ca||71||
dhanvajAnAmasRuglihyAnmadhunA mRugapakShiNAm| sakShaudraM grathite rakte lihyAt pArAvataM shakRut||72||
ushIrakAlIyakalodhrapadmakapriya~ggukAkaTphalasha~gkhagairikAH| pRuthak pRuthak candanatulyabhAgikAH sasharkarAstaNDuladhAvanAplutAH||73||
raktaM sapittaM tamakaM pipAsAM dAhaM ca pItAH shamayanti sadyaH| kirAtatiktaM kramukaM samustaM prapauNDarIkaM kamalotpale ca||74||
hrIberamUlAni paTolapatraM durAlabhA parpaTako mRuNAlam| dhana~jjayodumbaravetasatva~gnyagrodhashAleyayavAsakatvak||75||
tugAlatAvetasataNDulIyaM sasArivaM mocarasaH sama~ggA| pRuthak pRuthak candanayojitAni tenaiva kalpena hitAni tatra||76||
nishi sthitA vA svarasIkRutA vA kalkIkRutA vA mRuditAH shRutA vA| ete samastA gaNashaH pRuthagvA raktaM sapittaM shamayanti yogAH||77||

mudgAH salAjAH sayavAH sakRuShNAH soshIramustAH saha candanena| balAjale paryuShitAH kaShAyA raktaM sapittaM shamayantyudIrNam||78||

Commentary: balAjala iti balAsAdhitashItajale| paryuShitAH kaShAyA iti shItakaShAyAH||78||
vaidUryamuktAmaNigairikANAM mRuccha~gkhahemAmalakodakAnAm| madhUdakasyekShurasasya caiva pAnAcchamaM gacchati raktapittam||79||
ushIrapadmotpalacandanAnAM pakvasya loShTasya ca yaH prasAdaH| sasharkaraH kShaudrayutaH sushIto raktAtiyogaprashamAya deyaH||80||
priya~ggukAcandanalodhrasArivAmadhUkamustAbhayadhAtakIjalam| samRutprasAdaM saha yaShTikAmbunA sasharkaraM raktanibarhaNaM param||81||
kaShAyayogairvividhairyathoktairdIpte~anale shleShmaNi nirjite ca| yadraktapittaM prashamaM na yAti tatrAnilaH syAdanu tatra kAryam||82||
chAgaM payaH syAt paramaM prayoge gavyaM shRutaM pa~jcaguNe jale vA| sasharkaraM mAkShikasamprayuktaM vidArigandhAdigaNaiH shRutaM vA||83||
drAkShAshRutaM nAgarakaiH shRutaM vA balAshRutaM gokShurakaiH shRutaM vA| sajIvakaM sarShabhakaM sasarpiH payaH prayojyaM sitayA shRutaM vA||84||

shatAvarIgokShurakaiH shRutaM vA shRutaM payo vA~apyatha parNinIbhiH| raktaM nihantyAshu visheShatastu yanmUtramArgAt sarujaM prayAti||85||

Commentary: parNinIbhiriti parNinyaH parNinIcatuShTayam||85||
visheShato viTpathasampravRutte payo mataM mocarasena siddham| vaTAvarohairvaTashu~ggakairvA hrIberanIlotpalanAgarairvA||86||
kaShAyayogAn payasA purA vA pItvA~anu cAdyAt payasaiva shAlIn| kaShAyayogairathavA vipakvametaiH pibet sarpiratisrave ca||87||

vAsAM sashAkhAM sapalAshamUlAM kRutvA kaShAyaM kusumAni cAsyAH| pradAya kalkaM vipacedghRutaM tat sakShaudramAshveva nihanti raktam||88||

Commentary: ArdrAyA eva vAsAyA vidhAnAnukathanAnna dvaiguNyam| vAsAkusumakalke ca kecit puShpakalkasyAtIva bAhulyaM bhavatIti kRutvA prasthe ghRute catuShpalaM puShpakalkaM vadanti| sakShaudramiti vacanena ghRutAt pAdikatvaM tantrAntarapratyayAjj~jeyam; uktaM hi- “snehapAdaH smRutaH kalkaH kalkavanmadhusharkare” iti| agniveshe~apyuktaM- “mAtrA kShaudraghRutAnAM ca snehakvAtheShu pUrvavat” iti| pUrvavaditi pAdikA||88||
palAshavRuntasvarasena siddhaM tasyaiva kalkena madhudraveNa| lihyAdghRutaM vatsakakalkasiddhaM tadvat sama~ggotpalalodhrasiddham||89||
syAttrAyamANAvidhireSha eva sodumbare caiva paTolapatre| sarpIMShi pittajvaranAshanAni sarvANi shastAni ca raktapitte||90||
abhya~ggayogAH pariShecanAni sekAvagAhAH shayanAni veshma| shIto vidhirbastividhAnamagryaM pittajvare yat prashamAya diShTam||91||
tadraktapitte nikhilena kAryaM kAlaM ca mAtrAM ca purA samIkShya| sarpirguDA ye ca hitAH kShatebhyaste raktapittaM shamayanti sadyaH||92||
kaphAnubandhe rudhire sapitte kaNThAgate syAdgrathite prayogaH| yuktasya yuktyA madhusarpiShoshca kShArasya caivotpalanAlajasya||93||
mRuNAlapadmotpalakesharANAM tathA palAshasya tathA priya~ggoH| tathA madhUkasya tathA~asanasya kShArAH prayojyA vidhinaiva tena||94||
shatAvarIdADimatintiDIkaM kAkolimede madhukaM vidArIm| piShTvA ca mUlaM phalapUrakasya ghRutaM pacet kShIracaturguNaM j~jaH||95||
kAsajvarAnAhavibandhashUlaM tadraktapittaM ca ghRutaM nihanyAt| yat pa~jcamUlairatha pa~jcabhirvA siddhaM ghRutaM tacca tadarthakAri||96||
kaShAyayogA ya ihopadiShTAste cAvapIDe bhiShajA prayojyAH| ghrANAt pravRuttaM rudhiraM sapittaM yadA bhavenniHsRutaduShTadoSham||97||
rakte praduShTe hyavapIDabandhe duShTapratishyAyashirovikArAH| raktaM sapUyaM kuNapashca gandhaH syAd ghrANanAshaH kRumayashca duShTAH||98||
nIlotpalaM gairikasha~gkhayuktaM sacandanaM syAttu sitAjalena| nasyaM tathA~a~amrAsthirasaH sama~ggA sadhAtakImocarasaH salodhraH||99||
drAkShArasasyekShurasasya nasyaM kShIrasya dUrvAsvarasasya caiva| yavAsamUlAni palANDumUlaM nasyaM tathA dADimapuShpatoyam||100||
priyAlatailaM madhukaM payashca siddhaM ghRutaM mAhiShamAjikaM vA| AmrAsthipUrvaiH payasA ca nasyaM sasArivaiH syAt kamalotpalaishca||101||
bhadrashriyaM lohitacandanaM ca prapauNDarIkaM kamalotpale ca| ushIravAnIrajalaM mRuNAlaM sahasravIryA madhukaM payasyA||102||
shAlIkShumUlAni yavAsagundrAmUlaM nalAnAM kushakAshayoshca| kucandanaM shaivalamapyanantA kAlAnusAryA tRuNamUlamRuddhiH||103||
mUlAni puShpANi ca vArijAnAM pralepanaM puShkariNImRudashca| udumbarAshvatthamadhUkalodhrAH kaShAyavRukShAH shishirAshca sarve||104||
pradehakalpe pariShecane ca tathA~avagAhe ghRutatailasiddhau| raktasya pittasya ca shAntimicchan bhadrashriyAdIni bhiShak prayu~jjyAt||105||
dhArAgRuhaM bhUmigRuhaM sushItaM vanaM ca ramyaM jalavAtashItam| vaidUryamuktAmaNibhAjanAnAM sparshAshca dAhe shishirAmbushItAH||106||
patrANi puShpANi ca vArijAnAM kShaumaM ca shItaM kadalIdalAni| pracchAdanArthaM shayanAsanAnAM padmotpalAnAM ca dalAH prashastAH||107||
priya~ggukAcandanarUShitAnAM sparshAH priyANAM ca varA~gganAnAm| dAhe prashastAH sajalAH sushItAH padmotpalAnAM ca kalApavAtAH||108||
sariddhradAnAM himavaddarINAM candrodayAnAM kamalAkarANAm| mano~anukUlAH shishirAshca sarvAH kathAH saraktaM shamayanti pittam||109||
tatra shlokau- hetuM vRuddhiM sa~jj~jAM sthAnaM li~ggaM pRuthak praduShTasya| mArgau sAdhyamasAdhyaM yApyaM kAryakramaM caiva||110||
pAnAnnamiShTameva ca varjyaM saMshodhanaM ca shamanaM ca| gururuktavAnyathAvaccikitsite raktapittasya||111||
iti vAsAghRutam
iti shatAvaryAdighRutam
Adyutpattau jvarasantApAdraktapittotpatterjvaracikitsitamanu raktapittacikitsitamabhidhIyate||1-2||

gatikRutaM sAdhyAdibhedaM darshayituM gatibhedamevAha- gatirUrdhvamityAdi| gatiprakArAntaramapyasAdhyasyAha- yadA tu sarvacchidrebhya ityAdi| yaccobhayAbhyAmityAdinA kRuShNamatIva cetyantenAsAdhyatAlakShaNamAha| atra mArgAbhyAmityanena na yaugapadyena mArgapravRuttirvyavasthitA, kintu pratyekaM, mArgadvayapravRuttasyAsAdhyatvena pUrvamevoktatvAt| kuNapagandheneti shavagandhena| kaNThe sajjatIti kaNThAdbahirna yAti| yathoktairiti nidAnoktaiH; tatra hi upadravAH khalu daurbalyArocakAdayaH svarabhedAntA uktAH| hAridravarNAdibhiryuktaM kShINasya kAsino na sidhyatIti j~jeyam| yadvidoShAnugamityanenAnubandharUpadoShadvayayogAdyApyatvamucyate; yattu pUrvaM dvidoShajaM yApyamityuktaM tadanubandhyadoShadvayajanyAbhiprAyeNeti na paunaruktyam| mArgAnmArgaM carediti UrdhvagaM mukhaM parityajya nAsAM yAtItyAdi j~jeyam, Urdhvagasya tvadhogamane~adhogatvAdeva yApyatvaM bhavati, adhogaM tu mArgAntaramagacchadapi svata eva yApyaM; tasmAnnordhvAdhomArgaparivarto~atra vivakShitaH||15-21||

snigdhoShNamityAdi nidAnoktamapi prAyikatvAdvisheShopadarshanArthaM punarihocyate| prAyaHshabdena kadAcidrUkShoShNamapi Urdhvagasya heturbhavati, tathA snigdhoShNamapi adhogasyeti darshayati| evaM ca nidAnamArgAniyame sati ‘mArgau doShAnubandhaM ca nidAnaM prasamIkShya ca’ ityatra mArgAdi pa~jca (yacca) paThitaM...| yadyapyadhoge rUkShoShNameva paraM hetustathA~api snigdhoShNaM kadAcit kAraNaM bhavati, snigdhakRutashca kapho~apyadhoge bhavati; evamUrdhvage~api cintanIyam| UrdhvagaM kaphasaMsRuShTamityAdAvapi prAyaHshabdasambandhAdvyabhicAro j~jeyaH||23-24||

ashnata ityanena santarpaNotthitaM darshayati| utkliShTamiti pravRuttyunmukham, AmadoShAshritatvAt| baladoShavicAriNeti yadaiva balahrAsaM sampashyeddhInadoShatvaM vA tadaiva stambhanaM kAryam||25-28||

samprati kRutsnaM la~gghanahetumAha- mArgAvityAdi| tatrordhvamArgaH, sAmaM pittaM, kapho doShaH, snigdhoShNaM ca nidAnaM la~gghanaprayojakaM; tadvyatiriktaM tu mArgAdi bhojanarUpatarpaNaprayojakam| tarpayatIti tarpaNamashanam| tena yavAgUstarpaNaM ca grAhyam| ye tu tarpaNashabdena saktutarpaNameva grAhayanti teShAM yavAgUdAnapakSho na sa~ggRuhItaH syAt||29-30||

kevalamiti hrIberAdirahitaM; jalamevaikaM kevalamauShadhadveShiNe puruShAya deyam| pUrvamiti padena pashcAdbalahrAsakArakaM niShedhayati| kAlaH hemantAdiH, anubandhaH doShAnubandhaH| prakRutiH svAbhAvikI dravyANAM gurulAghavAdirUpA, kalpanaM kalpaH saMskAra ityarthaH| etena kAlaM doShAnubandhaM ca j~jAtvA yasya yatsvabhAvaM dravyaM yuktaM bhavati tena tarpaNaM yavAgUrvA kAryetyarthaH| kharjUrAdinA jalaM ShaDa~ggavidhAnenaiva kartavyam| etacca jalamatra madhuramapyUrdhvage kaphasaMsRuShTe~api raktapitte yaugikaM bhavati, raktapittavyAdhipratyanIkatvAt||31-35||
pa~jcaga~ggaH deshavisheShaH| vaktavyaM yat paramiti uktaraktapittahetulakShaNAtiriktaM cikitsitamityarthaH||3-4||

nidAne yadyapi raktapittasya hetulakShaNAni pratipAditAnyeva, tathA~apIha cikitsAparikaratayA prakaraNavashAddhetavaH sa~gkShepeNa lakShaNAni ca prAyaHprAdurbhAvIni punaH kathyante| gharma AtapaH| annavidAhastu svarUpavidAhidravyabhakShaNAdbhavati, tathA pittenAnnavahasrotaso duShTatvAdavidAhibhojanenApi bhavati| yaduktamanyatra- “srotasyannavahe pittaM paktau vA yasya tiShThati| vidAhi bhuktamanyadvA tasyApyannaM vidahyate” (su.sU.a.46) iti||5-6||

tairhetubhirityAdinA samprAptimAha| raktaM prapadyate raktaM gacchatItyarthaH| yadyapi “pittaM svedo raso lasIkA rudhiramAmAshayashca pittasthAnAni, tatrApyAmAshayo visheSheNa pittasthAnam” (sU.a.20) iti vacanena svabhAvAdeva raktaM yAti, tathA~api raktapittasamprAptau pradhAnasthAnAdAmAshayarUpAt pittasyeha raktagamanaM j~jeyaM; raktagamanaM ca pittasya samprAptimahimnA bhavati| tadyonitvAditi tadyonitvaM hetuH raktaprapannasya pittasya vardhane j~jeyaM; tena yasmAdraktayoni pittaM tasmAdraktaM prApya vardhata ityarthaH| uktaM hi- “asRujaH pittaM” (ci.a.15) iti| taditi raktaM pradUShayat| dravo dhAturiti dravarUpoM~ashaH| dhAtordhAtoriti mAMsAdeH| svidyataH prasicyate atikSharati; tena pittoShmaNA svidyamAnadhAtubhyashcyutena dravarUpeNa dhAtunA yuktaM sapittaM bhUyo~atitarAM vRuddhiM gacchatIti yojanA||7-8||

tasya doShasambandhavisheSheNa li~ggAnyAha- sAndramityAdi| kaShAyavadAbhA yasya tat kaShAyAbhaM, pATalamityarthaH| kRuShNasya vastrAdeH sasAragandhakAdibhirmasRuNIkRutasya yo varNaH sa mecakaH| nanu pittameva raktapittamityuktaM, tat kathaM shlaiShmikaM bhavati? ucyate- sAmAnyasamprAptau pittameva raktapittanirvartakaM, yathA- sarvagulmeShu vAyuH, yathA- sarvajvareShu pittamArambhakaM; tadeva yadolbaNena kaphena svalakShaNakAriNA yuktaM raktapittakaraM bhavati, tadA sAmAnyasamprAptisamprAptaM pittamutsRujya shleShmaNaiva sAndratvAdisvalakShaNakAriNA vyapadishyate- shlaiShmikaM raktapittamiti; yathA- shlaiShmike gulme sAmAnyasamprAptyAgatavAtaM parityajya shleShmaNaiva vyapadesho bhavati, yathA vA kaphajvare sarvajvarAnapAyikAraNamanAdRutya visheShalakShaNakAriNA shleShmaNaiva vyapadesho bhavati; evaM vAtike~api raktapitte vyAkhyeyam| yattu kaphavAtavirahitena kevalenaiva pittena balavatA janitaM raktapittaM paittikaraktapittalakShaNaM bhavati tat paittikaM raktapittamityucyate| lakShaNenaiva doShavyapadesho bhavati; tena yadyaddoShajanitalakShaNayuktaM raktapittaM bhavati tattaddoShajamiti vyapadishyate| shlaiShmikAdiraktapittApekShayA paittike raktapitte~atyulbaNaM pittaM bhavati, yatastatraiva pittaM svalakShaNAni karoti, nAnyatra; evaM vyavasthite yaducyate- kevalapaittikasya raktapittasya mArgo nAsti, yato vAtaraktamadho yAti, kaphArabdhamUrdhvamiti pratipAditaM; tadapi na, yataH paittikasyApyUrdhvagamanamadhogamanaM vA bhavatyeva; paraM paittikaM yadUrdhvaM yAti tanmArgamahimnA kaphasaMyuktaM bhavati, yaccAdho yAti tadvAtasthAnasambandhAdvAtAnugataM bhavati| mArgasambandhAnugatashca doShaH svalakShaNakArakatvAnnAnubandhaH, tenAsau paittike raktapitte~api ‘ekadoShAnugaM sAdhyaM’ ityAdivacaneShu na gRuhyate| yataH svatantro vyaktali~ggashca doSho~anubandhyaH; tadviparItastu anubandhaH; tena yathoktalakShaNakAriNA doSheNAnubandhyena vAtikatvAdivyapadesho raktapitteShu, na mArgasambandhAnugatenAsvalakShaNakAriNA~anubandharUpeNeti| anye tu “pradeshAntaracitena pittena yadottarakAlaM raktapittasya sambandho bhavati tadaiva paittikaM raktapittaM bhavati” iti bruvate||11-12||-

samprati sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgamAha- eketyAdi| ekadoShAnugamiti uktaikadoShalakShaNayuktam, evaM dvidoShamapi doShadvayalakShaNayuktam, evaM tridoShamapi j~jeyam| na tu mArgasambandhAnugatamapi doShaM prakShipya dvidoShatvaM tridoShatvaM vA gaNanIyaM, tathAhi sati kevalaM rakapittaM na syAdeva; tathA samprAptisamprAptaM doShaM gRuhItvA mArgasambandhAnugatena vAyunA kaphena vA yogAddvidoShajatvameva sarvadA syAt, na ‘ekadoShAnugaM sAdhyaM’ iti yaduktaM tat syAt; tasmAdyathoktameva sAdhu| mandAgnerativegavaditi pRuthagevAsAdhyalakShaNaM, vyAdhibhiH kShINadehasyetyAdi ca pRuthageva||13-14||

shAlItyAdinA~annamAha| prashAntikA jalamadhye prAyo bhavati| priya~gguH ka~gguH| koradUShasya raktapittahetutvaM niShpAvamAShasUpAdiyuktasyaiva saMyogamahimnA nidAne proktam, ayaM tu kaShAyamadhuralaghutvAt koradUShaH kevalo raktapittahara evetIha paThyate| evaM gaNDIro~api nidAne surAsauvIrakAdiyukta eva hetutvenoktaH, sa tu kevalo hita eva; kiMvA sthalajajalajabhedena gaNDIro dvividhaH; tatra haritavargapaThito yaH sa nidAnaM bhavati, itarastu jalajaH shAkavarge paThito yaH sa iha kaphAdhike raktapitte j~jeyaH| yUShavadvA vipAcitamiti yUSho yathA dADimAdyamladravyayukto jale vipAcyate tathA~ayamapItyartha; kiMvA yUShayuktaM yathA bhavati tathA vipAcitamityarthaH| raktAkShaH cakorakaH| yUShashca shAkaM ceti yUShashAkam||36-48||

AvasthikaM bhojanamAha- shasha ityAdi| atra shashaH kaShAyatvAdraktapittaharo bhavatyeva, vibandhahareNa vAstukena saMskRutatvAdvibandhaharo~api bhavati| evaM tittirimayUrAdayo yadyapyuShNatvena vAtaharAstathA~api raktapitte na hitA uShNatvena; tatashca teShAM sAdhane udumbararasAdayo raktapittaharA niyujyante; tathA sati vAtaM raktapittaM ca ghnanti| pratiniyatasAdhakadravyopanyAsAt saMyogamahimnaiva kAryakarA bhavantIti j~jAyate| na shashaH kaShAyo~api vibandhaM karoti, vAstukasaMskArAt; na tittiriprabhRutayo raktapittaM kopayanti, udumbararasAdisaMskArAt; evaM viparItaphalasambhavo nAsti, saMyogashakteracintyatvAt| vAstukarase eva shashasya sAdhanaprayogaH, itarasAhacaryAt| uktaM hi- “vipacettu vAstukarase shashaM vibandhe purIShasya” iti| siddhaM vidArigandhAdyairiti shAliparNyAdipa~jcamUlashRutamudakam||49-51||

vakShyate ityAdinA saMshodhanAni pradhAnabheShajatvAducyante| akShINabalamAMsasyetyanena sahajA balAhAnirucyate, balavata ityanena kAlakRutaM balamucyate| kAle saMshodhanayogye~anatyuShNashItakAle| nirupadravamiti kriyAvisheShaNaM, kiMvA raktapittavisheShaNam| virecanenordhvabhAgamityAdinA anulomaharaNaM raktapitte niShedhayati| uktaM ca- “pratimArgaM ca haraNaM raktapitte vidhIyate” (ni.a.2) iti| raktapitte visheShata ityanena raktapittAdanyatra kalkAdayo~apyeShAM bhavanti| vamanamiti vamanakArako yogo vamanamucyate| madanasya doShAdyapekShayA karShAdikA mAtrA kalpe vakShyamANA j~jeyA| sasharkare salile tathekShurase madanayogAdeva vamanakartRutvaM j~jeyam| adhovahe ityatrApi shuddhakoShThasyeti yojyam| na cet syAnmAruto balItyanena yadi mAruto balI syAttadA mAMsaudana eva deya iti jvaroktaM vidhiM sUcayati||54-61||

saMshamanaviShayamAha- balamAMsetyAdi| shoSheNeti rAjayakShmaNA| aTarUShakamRudvIketyAdi kAmalAharaM kecidAhuH| aTarUShakaniryUha ityAdau priya~ggvAdInAM militAnAM kalkaH karShaH, kShaudrasya ca karSho grAhyaH, paribhAShAbalAt| uktaM cAgniveshena- “karShashcUrNasya kalkasya guDikAnAM ca sarvashaH| mAtrA kShaudraghRutAdInAM kvAthasneheShu cUrNavat” iti| anye tu bruvate- cUrNAdInAM karShamAnatvaM svatantraprayoge bhavati| atra cATarUShakvAthaH kvAthaparibhAShayA kAryaH, kalkashca kalkaparibhAShayA kAryaH| priya~ggvAdInAM pratyekaM karShamAnatve bheShajabhUyastvaM bhavati, tenAtra militaiH karShamAnasya kartavyatA yuktA| tenaiva vidhineti aTarUShakaniryUhakShaudrayutam| khadirasyetyAdau puShpacUrNAnIti bahuvacanatvAdraktapittanuditi visheShaNaM puruShasya j~jeyam | dhanvajAnAmiti jA~ggalAnAm||62-72||

ushIretyAdau pRuthak pRuthagiti vIpsAyAM, tena pratyekamushIrAdInAM candanasamAnAM prayogaM darshayati; tathA cAShTau prayogA bhavanti| sasharkarA iti vacanenAtra sharkarA samabhAgaiva deyA; uktaM hyagniveshe- “mAShikaM hi~ggu, sindhUtthalavaNAdyAstu shANikAH| sitopalAguDakShArAH samA, eShA prakalpanA” iti| yatra sharkarAyAH prakShepyatvaM tatra prakShepanyAyenaiva sharkarA deyA| kirAtAdike~api pRuthak pRuthak candanayojitAnItyanena samacandanatvaM pratyekaM dravyaprayogANAm| tenaiva kalpenetyanena sasharkaratvaM taNDuladhAvanAplutatvaM cocyate| kramukaM paTTikAlodhram| dhana~jjayaH arjunaH| latA priya~gguH| sama~ggA varAhakrAntA, ‘lajjAluH’ iti loke| nishisthitA ityAdinA kirAtatiktAdInAM kalpanAmAha| nishisthitA vetyanena shItakaShAya ucyate| mRuditA iti phANTIkRutAH; kalkagrahaNena cUrNasyApi grahaNaM kriyate, yataH sushrute ShaDeva kalpAH pAThabhedAt pAThyante- “kShIraM rasaH kalkamatho kaShAyaH shRutashca shItashca tathaiva phANTaH| kalpAH ShaDete khalu bheShajAnAM yathottaraM te laghavaH pradiShTAH” (su.sU.a.44) iti| anye tu cUrNamapi phANTashabdena gRuhyate iti bruvate| yadA tatra phANTagrahaNAdeva sa pAThaH sushrute pramANaM, tadA cUrNashabdena ca kalpAntaramevocyate (?)| iha tu phANTasya shrutatvAt kRuShNAtreyAdipaThita eva phANTo grAhyaH| yaduktaM- “kShuNNasya salile tapte mRuditasyoddhRutasya ca| yo raso gRuhyate tajj~jaiH sa phANTaH samprakIrtitaH” iti| teneha nirdravaH kalka eva cUrNashabdenocyate| samprati vyastasamastaprayogameShAmAha- ete ityAdi| gaNasha iti ushIrAdigaNashaH, kirAtatiktAdigaNashaH, tugAdigaNashashceti| atra ca pratyekapratyoge samacandanatvaM shrutaM, yadA gaNashaH prayogo bhavati tadA~api candanasya samo bhAgo deya iti vyAkhyAnayanti vRuddhAH||73-77||

vaidUryAdibhiH saha sthitaM jalaM vaidUryAdijalaM j~jeyam| ushIretyAdau shItakaShAye prasAda iti prasannaM jalaM grAhyam| priya~ggvAdau abhayam ushIram| samRutprasAdamityatra mRutprasAdo~apyanantaraM prakShepyaH; evaM yaShTikAprayoge~api||79-81||
tatrAnilaH syAditi tatra balavAn vAtaH syAt| prayoga iti abhyAse| sajIvakamityAdau sajIvakaM sarShabhakaM ca shRutaM yat payastat sasarpistathA sitayA ca yuktaM prayojyaM peyamiti j~jeyam||72-84||

vaTashu~ggA avikasitanavavaTapallavAH| kaShAyayogAniti aTarUShakAdIn kalkIkRutAn payasA pItvetyarthaH| etairiti vakShyamANaiH; kiMvA etaireva kaShAyayogairyathAyogyatayA sarpiH sAdhanIyam| atisrave iti atimAtraraktapittasrutau||83-87||

madhudraveNeti pAdikena madhunA dravIkRutam| trAyamANAyA evaM sarpiH pUrvavat paktavyam; udumbarapaTolapatrAbhyAM cAparam| pittajvaranAshanAnItyanena sakalacikitsitavAcyAni pittajvaraharANi j~jeyAni, jvaracikitsite tu ghRutAni jIrNajvarahantRutayoktAni na pittajvarahantRutayA; anye tu yAnyeva jIrNajvaraharANi ghRutAni tAnyeva pittajvaraharANi bhavanti, teShAM tu “rUkShaM teja” (ci.a.3) ityAdinA jvaraviShayatayA samAnatvena nirdiShTaM pittaviShayatvam| pradeshAntare~api “jale dashaguNe sAdhyaM trAyamANAcatuHpalam” ityAdi yAvat “pittaraktabhavaM gulmaM visarpaM paittikaM jvaram” (ci.a.5) iti, tathA “trAyantikA” ityAdi yAvat “vAtarakte kShatakShINe visarpe paittike jvare” (ci.a.29) ityAdIni sakalacikitsite paThitAni pittajvaraharaghRutAni kartavyAni||89-90||
abhya~ggayogA ityAdinA sarve ye dAhajvaraharA uktAH pittajvaraprashamanakatvena tAnatidishati||91-92||

rudhire sapitte iti raktapitte| yuktyA yuktasyeti mAtrayA yuktasya kShArasya prayogaH; yuktishabdo~atra mAtrAvacanaH| yadyapi kShArastIkShNa uktastathA~api kaNThasthakaphavilayanArthamutpalanAlAdikRutaguNAnuvidhAnAt kShAro dIyata eva raktapitte; raktapittaharatvaprabhAvAdutpalanAladikShAro bhavatyeva raktapittaharaH, yena tIkShNAni dravyANi parityajyotpalanAlAdInyeva kShArArthamAha| nanu, utpalAdInAmagnidAhAcchItatvamapayAtyeva, uktaM ca vArtike kShIrasvAmidattena- “shItaM jahati bhUyiShThaM dagdhaM sapadi somatAm” iti ceddRuShTo hi bhasmanyapi guNodaya iti||93-94||
phalapUrako bIjapUrakaH| pa~jca pa~jcamUlAni rasAyanoktAni| tadarthakArIti anantaroktashatAvaryAdighRutAnukAri||95-96||

ghrANapravRuttaraktapittacikitsitamAha- kaShAyayogA ityAdi| kaShAyayogA iti ushIrakAlIyaketyAdinA ye kaShAyayogA uktAste ghrANapravRutte raktapitte pradeyAH| avapIDashca dravyamApothitaM kRutvA pIDayitvA raso dIyate yaH sa ucyate; ayaM ca niHsRute raktadoShe sati deyaH; viparyaye doShamAha- rakta ityAdi| sitAjaleneti sharkarAjalena| nIlotpalAdIni kalkIkRutya avapIDo deyaH| priyAlatailamityAdau madhukakalkena payasA draveNa sAdhyaM priyAlatailaM ghRutaM mAhiShamAjaM vA| AmrAsthipUrvairiti ‘nasyaM tathA~a~amrAsthirasaH sama~ggA’ ityAdiyogoktaiH| sArivAkamalotpalAni ca kalkaH, payo drava iti j~jeyam||97-101||

bhadrashriyAdIni pralepArthamAha| vAnIram ushIrabheda eva sugandhimUlam| kAlAnusAryA shItalam| shishirAshca sarve ityantena lepavidhAnam| padmotpalAnAM ca kalApavAtA iti padmotpalasamUhakRutavAtA ityarthaH||102-109||
hetumityAdinA~adhyAyArthasa~ggraho vyakta eva||110-111||
athAto gulmacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

sarvaprajAnAM pitRuvaccharaNyaH punarvasurbhUtabhaviShyadIshaH| cikitsitaM gulmanibarhaNArthaM provAca siddhaM vadatAM variShThaH||3||

Commentary: sarvaprajAnAmityAdinA guroH stutirdharmajanakatayA tathottaragranthashraddheyatayA| bhUte bhaviShye cAvyAhataj~jAnatayA prabhureva bhavatIti bhUtabhaviShyadIshaH| siddhamiti sAdhyAvyabhicAri sarvameva cikitsitaM yadyapi siddhameva vaktavyaM, tathA~apyatra prakaraNe stutyarthaM siddhapadaM j~jeyam||3||
RutAvanAhAratayA bhayena virUkShaNairvegavinigrahaishca| saMstambhanollekhanayonidoShairgulmaH striyaM raktabhavo~abhyupaiti||18||
yaH spandate piNDita eva nA~ggaishcirAt sashUlaH samagarbhali~ggaH| sa raudhiraH strIbhava eva gulmo mAse vyatIte dashame cikitsyaH||19||
kriyAkramamataH siddhaM gulminAM gulmanAshanam| pravakShyAmyata UrdhvaM ca yogAn gulmanibarhaNAn||20||
rUkShavyAyAmajaM gulmaM vAtikaM tIvravedanam| baddhaviNmArutaM snehairAditaH samupAcaret||21||
bhojanAbhya~jjanaiH pAnairnirUhaiH sAnuvAsanaiH| snigdhasya bhiShajA svedaH kartavyo gulmashAntaye||22||
srotasAM mArdavaM kRutvA jitvA mArutamulbaNam| bhittvA vibandhaM snigdhasya svedo gulmamapohati||23||
snehapAnaM hitaM gulme visheSheNordhvanAbhije| pakvAshayagate bastirubhayaM jaTharAshraye||24||
dIpte~agnau vAtike gulme vibandhe~anilavarcasoH| bRuMhaNAnyannapAnAni snigdhoShNAni prayojayet||25||
punaH punaH snehapAnaM nirUhAH sAnuvAsanAH| prayojyA vAtagulmeShu kaphapittAnurakShiNA||26||
kapho vAte jitaprAye pittaM shoNitameva vA| yadi kupyati vA tasya kriyamANe cikitsite||27||
yatholbaNasya doShasya tatra kAryaM bhiShagjitam| AdAvante ca madhye ca mArutaM parirakShatA||28||
vAtagulme kapho vRuddho hatvA~agnimaruciM yadi| hRullAsaM gauravaM tandrAM janayedullikhettu tam||29||
shUlAnAhavibandheShu gulme vAtakapholbaNe| vartayo guTikAshcUrNaM kaphavAtaharaM hitam||30||
pittaM vA yadi saMvRuddhaM santApaM vAtagulminaH| kuryAdvirecyaH sa bhavet sasnehairAnulomikaiH||31||

gulmo yadyanilAdInAM kRute samyagbhiShagjite| na prashAmyati raktasya so~avasekAt prashAmyati||32||
