Commentary: raktasrAvaNaM gulmapradeshe eva shRu~ggAdinA, raktAdhiShThAnatvAdgulmasya; bAhusirAvyadhena raktasrAvaNaM gulmasyetaracikitsayA~aprashame j~jeyam| raktAdhiShThAnatvaM ca gulmapAkaprastAve darshanIyam||32||
snigdhoShNenodite gulme paittike sraMsanaM hitam| rUkShoShNena tu sambhUte sarpiH prashamanaM param||33||
pittaM vA pittagulmaM vA j~jAtvA pakvAshayasthitam| kAlavinnirharet sadyaH satiktaiH kShIrabastibhiH||34||
payasA vA sukhoShNena satiktena virecayet| bhiShagagnibalApekShI sarpiShA tailvakena vA||35||
tRuShNAjvaraparIdAhashUlasvedAgnimArdave| gulminAmarucau cApi raktamevAvasecayet||36||
chinnamUlA vidahyante na gulmA yAnti ca kShayam| raktaM hi vyamlatAM yAti, tacca nAsti na cAsti ruk||37||

hRutadoShaM parimlAnaM jA~ggalaistarpitaM rasaiH| samAshvastaM sasheShArtiM sarpirabhyAsayet punaH||38||

Commentary: hRutadoShamiti shoNitAvasekena hRutadoShaM, parimlAnamiti kShINakAyam||38||

raktapittAtivRuddhatvAt kriyAmanupalabhya ca| yadi gulmo vidahyeta shastraM tatra bhiShagjitam||39||

Commentary: kriyAmiti shoNitAvasekarUpAM kriyAm| vidahyeta pacyate||39||

guruH kaThinasaMsthAno gUDhamAMsAntarAshrayaH| avivarNaH sthirashcaiva hyapakvo gulma ucyate||40||

Commentary: guruH kaThinetyAdinA~apakvapacyamAnapakvagulmalakShaNamAha| gUDhamAMsashcAsau antarAshrayashceti gUDhamAMsAntarAshrayaH| sthira iti unnataH||40||
viTshleShmapittAtiparisravAdvA taireva vRuddhaiH paripIDanAdvA| vegairudIrNairvihatairadho vA bAhyabhighAtairatipIDanairvA||4||
rUkShAnnapAnairatisevitairvA shokena mithyApratikarmaNA vA| viceShTitairvA viShamAtimAtraiH koShThe prakopaM samupaiti vAyuH||5||
kaphaM ca pittaM ca sa duShTavAyuruddhUya mArgAn vinibaddhya tAbhyAm| hRunnAbhipArshvodarabastishUlaM karotyatho yAti na baddhamArgaH||6||
pakvAshaye pittakaphAshaye vA sthitaH svatantraH parasaMshrayo vA| sparshopalabhyaH paripiNDitatvAdgulmo yathAdoShamupaiti nAma||7||

pa~jcAtmakasya prabhavaM tu tasya vakShyAmi li~ggAni cikitsitaM ca||8||

Commentary: gulmasthAnAnyAha- bastAvityAdi| bastau nAbhyAM hRudi pArshvayorvA gulmasya pa~jca sthAnAni bhavanti| yadyapi bastyAdIni pa~jcaiva, tathA~api pa~jcagrahaNamadhikasthAnaniShedhArtham| raudhirasyApi gulmasya garbhAshayapArshvasthitatvena pArshve evAshaye bhavataH| anye tu raudhiravyatiriktAnAmetat pa~jcasthAnatvaM, raudhirasya tu garbhAshaya eva vishiShTaM sthAnaM bhavati|8|
rUkShAnnapAnaM viShamAtimAtraM viceShTitaM vegavinigrahashca| shoko~abhighAto~atimalakShayashca nirannatA cAnilagulmahetuH||9||
yaH sthAnasaMsthAnarujAM vikalpaM viDvAtasa~ggaM galavaktrashoSham| shyAvAruNatvaM shishirajvaraM ca hRutkukShipArshvAMsashirorujaM ca||10||
karoti jIrNe~abhyadhikaM prakopaM bhukte mRudutvaM samupaiti yashca| vAtAt sa gulmo na ca tatra rUkShaM kaShAyatiktaM kaTu copashete||11||
kaTvamlatIkShNoShNavidAhirUkShakrodhAtimadyArkahutAshasevA| AmAbhighAto rudhiraM ca duShTaM paittasya gulmasya nimittamuktam||12||
jvaraH pipAsA vadanA~ggarAgaH shUlaM mahajjIryati bhojane ca| svedo vidAho vraNavacca gulmaH sparshAsahaH paittikagulmarUpam||13||

shItaM guru snigdhamaceShTanaM ca sampUraNaM prasvapanaM divA ca| gulmasya hetuH kaphasambhavasya sarvastu diShTo nicayAtmakasya||14||

Commentary: shItamityAdinA kaphagulmahetulakShaNakathanam| atrAntare hetutrayakathanAvasAne doShatrayamelakasya kAryamAha- sarvastu diShTo nicayAtmakasyeti|- nicayAtmakaH sAnnipAtikaH| sAnnipAtikashca nicayarUpagulmajanmatayA vyapadeshena vikRutiviShamasamavAyAt saMyogamahimnA ca darshayati||14||

staimityashItajvaragAtrasAdahRullAsakAsArucigauravANi| shaityaM rugalpA kaThinonnatatvaM gulmasya rUpANi kaphAtmakasya||15||

Commentary: autpAdikaM nicayagulmamabhidhAya prakRutashleShmagulmalakShaNamAha- staimityetyAdi||15||

nimittali~ggAnyupalabhya gulme dvidoShaje doShabalAbalaM ca| vyAmishrali~ggAnaparAMstu gulmAMstrInAdishedauShadhakalpanArtham||16||

Commentary: dvidoShajagulmahetuli~ggAtideshArthamAha- nimittetyAdi| doShabalAbalaM cetyanenaikolbaNaM dvandvaM grAhayati| trIniti ca vAtapittaja-pittakaphaja-vAtashleShmajAn| auShadhakalpanArthamityanena prakRutisamasamavAyatvAt svavilakShaNakAryAkartRutayA pratyekadoShe dvandvajagulmA abhiniviShTA eva, pratyekoktacikitsAmelakena cikitsyA ityetanmAtropadarshanArthaM teShAmabhidhAnam| etenAShTottarIyoktapa~jcasa~gkhyAvirodho~api na bhavati, dvAndvikagulmabhedasyAprayojakatvAt; sannipAtagulme tu pratyekadoShajalakShaNAdatiriktAni lakShaNAni tatprabhAvashcAsAdhyatvAdirvaktavya eveti yuktaM tasya bhedenopAdAnam| jvare~api dvandvajvarANAM pRuthaglakShaNayogena dvAndvikatvaM yuktamiti j~jeyam||16||

mahArujaM dAhaparItamashmavadghanonnataM shIghravidAhi dAruNam| manaHsharIrAgnibalApahAriNaM tridoShajaM gulmamasAdhyamAdishet||17||

Commentary: mahArujamityAdinA sannipAtajalakShaNAnyAha| kecidetallakShaNavyatiriktalakShaNastu yaH pratyekadoShajoktasaMsargamAtralakShaNaH prakRutisamavAyasannipAtajanyaH sa sAdhya eva gulma iti vadanti||17||

dAhashUlArtisa~gkShobhasvapnanAshAratijvaraiH| vidahyamAnaM jAnIyAdgulmaM tamupanAhayet||41||

Commentary: tamupanAhayediti uShNadravyakRutaM lepaM pAcanArthaM dadyAdityarthaH||41||
vidAhalakShaNe gulme bahistu~gge samunnate| shyAve saraktaparyante saMsparshe bastisannibhe||42||
nipIDitonnate stabdhe supte tatpArshvapIDanAt| tatraiva piNDite shUle sampakvaM gulmamAdishet||43||
tatra dhAnvantarIyANAmadhikAraH kriyAvidhau| vaidyAnAM kRutayogyAnAM vyadhashodhanaropaNe||44||
antarbhAgasya cApyetat pacyamAnasya lakShaNam| hRutkroDashUnatA~antaHsthe bahiHsthe pArshvanirgatiH||45||
pakvaH srotAMsi sa~gkledya vrajatyUrdhvamadho~api vA| svayampravRuttaM taM doShamupekSheta hitAshanaiH ||46||
dashAhaM dvAdashAhaM vA rakShan bhiShagupadravAn| ata UrdhvaM hitaM pAnaM sarpiShaH savishodhanam||47||
shItalairgurubhiH snigdhairgulme jAte kaphAtmake||48||
avamyasyAlpakAyAgneH kuryAlla~gghanamAditaH| mando~agnirvedanA mandA gurustimitakoShThatA||49||
sotkleshA cAruciryasya sa gulmI vamanopagaH| uShNairevopacaryashca kRute vamanala~gghane||50||
yojyashcAhArasaMsargo bheShajaiH kaTutiktakaiH| sAnAhaM savibandhaM ca gulmaM kaThinamunnatam||51||
dRuShTvA~a~adau svedayedyuktyA svinnaM ca vilayedbhiShak| la~gghanollekhane svede kRute~agnau sampradhukShite||52||
kaphagulmI pibet kAle sakShArakaTukaM ghRutam| sthAnAdapasRutaM j~jAtvA kaphagulmaM virecanaiH||53||
sasnehairbastibhirvA~api shodhayeddAshamUlikaiH| mande~agnAvanile mUDhe j~jAtvA sasnehamAshayam||54||
guTikAcUrNaniryUhAH prayojyAH kaphagulminAm| kRutamUlaM mahAvAstuM kaThinaM stimitaM gurum||55||
doShaprakRutigulmartuyogaM buddhvA kapholbaNe||56||
baladoShapramANaj~jaH kShAraM gulme prayojayet| ekAntaraM dvyantaraM vA tryahaM vishramya vA punaH||57||
sharIrabaladoShANAM vRuddhikShapaNakovidaH| shleShmANaM madhuraM snigdhaM mAMsakShIraghRutAshinaH||58||
chittvA chittvA~a~ashayAt kShAraH kSharatvAta kShArayatyadhaH| mande~agnAvarucau sAtmye madye sasnehamashnatAm||59||
la~gghanollekhanaiH svedaiH sarpiHpAnairvirecanaiH||60||
bastibhirguTikAcUrNakShArAriShTagaNairapi| shlaiShmikaH kRutamUlatvAdyasya gulmo na shAmyati||61||
tasya dAho hRute rakte sharalohAdibhirhitaH| auShNyAttaikShNyAcca shamayedagnirgulme kaphAnilau||62||
tayoH shamAcca sa~gghAto gulmasya vinivartate| dAhe dhAnvantarIyANAmatrApi bhiShajAM balam||63||

vyAmishradoShe vyAmishra eSha eva kriyAkramaH||64||

Commentary: vyAmishradoShe iti saMsargaje sannipAtaje ca vyAmishraH||64||

siddhAnataH pravakShyAmi yogAn gulmanibarhaNAn| tryUShaNatriphalAdhAnyaviDa~ggacavyacitrakaiH||65||

Commentary: samprati siddhAn yogAnAha- siddhAnityAdi| siddhAniti vakShyamANayogastutiH shiShyapravartikA| tryUShaNAdye dravAntarAnabhidhAnAt kShIrameva caturguNaM bhavati||65||-
eta eva ca kalkAH syuH kaShAyaH pA~jcamUlikaH ||66||
dvipa~jcamUliko vA~api tadghRutaM gulmanut paramiti tryUShaNAdighRutamaparam(ShaTpalaM vA pibet sarpiryaduktaM rAjayakShmaNi)||67||
prasannayA vA kShIrArthaM surayA dADimena vA| dadhnaH sareNa vA kAryaM ghRutaM mArutagulmanut||68||
hi~ggusauvarcalAjAjIbiDadADimadIpyakaiH| puShkaravyoShadhanyAkavetasakShAracitrakaiH||69||
shaTIvacAjagandhailAsurasaishca vipAcitam| shUlAnAhaharaM sarpirdadhnA cAnilagulminAm||70||
hapuShAvyoShapRuthvIkAcavyacitrakasaindhavaiH| sAjAjIpippalImUladIpyakairvipacedghRutam||71||
sakolamUlakarasaM sakShIradadhidADimam| tat paraM vAtagulmaghnaM shUlAnAhavimokShaNam||72||
yonyarshograhaNIdoShashvAsakAsArucijvarAn| bastihRutpArshvashUlaM ca ghRutametadvyapohati||73||
pippalyA picuradhyardho dADimAddvipalaM palam| dhAnyAtpa~jca ghRutAcchuNThyAH karShaH kShIraM caturguNam||74||
siddhametairghRutaM sadyo vAtagulmaM vyapohati| yonishUlaM shiraHshUlamarshAMsi viShamajvaram||75||
ghRutAnAmauShadhagaNA ya ete parikIrtitAH| te cUrNayogA vartyastAH kaShAyAste ca gulminAm||76||
koladADimagharmAmbusurAmaNDAmlakA~jjikaiH| shUlAnAhaharI peyA bIjapUrarasena vA||77||
cUrNAni mAtulu~ggasya bhAvitAni rasena vA| kuryAdvartIH saguTikA gulmAnAhArtishAntaye||78||
hi~ggu trikaTukaM pAThAM hapuShAmabhayAM shaTIm| ajamodAjagandhe ca tintiDIkAmlavetasau||79||
dADimaM puShkaraM dhAnyamajAjIM citrakaM vacAm| dvau kShArau lavaNe dve ca cavyaM caikatra cUrNayet||80||
cUrNametat prayoktavyamannapAneShvanatyayam| prAgbhaktamathavA peyaM madyenoShNodakena vA||81||
pArshvahRudbastishUleShu gulme vAtakaphAtmake| AnAhe mUtrakRucchre ca shUle ca gudayonije ||82||
grahaNyarshovikAreShu plIhni pANDvAmaye~arucau| urovibandhe hikkAyAM kAse shvAse galagrahe||83||
bhAvitaM mAtulu~ggasya cUrNametadrasena vA| bahusho guTikAH kAryAH kArmukAH syustato~adhikam||84||
mAtulu~ggaraso hi~ggu dADimaM biDasaindhave| surAmaNDena pAtavyaM vAtagulmarujApaham||85||
shaTIpuShkarahi~ggvamlavetasakShAracitrakAn| dhAnyakaM ca yavAnIM ca viDa~ggaM saindhavaM vacAm||86||
sacavyapippalImUlAmajagandhAM sadADimAm| ajAjIM cAjamodAM ca cUrNaM kRutvA prayojayet||87||
rasena mAtulu~ggasya madhushuktena vA punaH| bhAvitaM guTikAM kRutvA supiShTAM kolasammitAm||88||
gulmaM plIhAnamAnAhaM shvAsaM kAsamarocakam| hikkAM hRudrogamarshAMsi vividhAM shiraso rujam||89||
pANDvAmayaM kaphotkleshaM sarvajAM ca pravAhikAm| pArshvahRudbastishUlaM ca guTikaiShA vyapohati||90||
nAgarArdhapalaM piShTvA dve pale lu~jcitasya ca| tilasyaikaM guDapalaM kShIreNoShNena nA pibet||91||
vAtagulmamudAvartaM yonishUlaM ca nAshayet| pibederaNDajaM tailaM vAruNImaNDamishritam||92||
tadeva tailaM payasA vAtagulmI pibennaraH| shleShmaNyanubale pUrvaM hitaM pittAnuge param||93||
sAdhayecchuddhashuShkasya lashunasya catuShpalam| kShIrodake~aShTaguNite kShIrasheShaM ca nA pibet||94||
vAtagulmamudAvartaM gRudhrasIM viShamajvaram| hRudrogaM vidradhiM shothaM sAdhayatyAshu tatpayaH||95||

tailaM prasannA gomUtramAranAlaM yavAgrajam| gulmaM jaTharamAnAhaM pItamekatra sAdhayet||96||

Commentary: tailaM prasannetyAdau yaugikatvAjjatUkarNasaMvAdAccairaNDatailaM j~jeyam| uktaM hi- “AranAlamUtrakShAraiH saMyojya tailamairaNDam” ityAdi||96||

pa~jcamUlIkaShAyeNa sakShAreNa shilAjatu| pibettasya prayogeNa vAtagulmAt pramucyate||97||

Commentary: pa~jcamUlItyatra prathamakalpanayA shAlaparNyAdipa~jcamUlIgrahaNaM j~jeyam||97||

vATyaM pippalIyUSheNa mUlakAnAM rasena vA| bhuktvA snigdhamudAvartAdvAtagulmAdvimucyate||98||

Commentary: pippalIpradhAno yUShaH pippalIyUShaH||98||
shUlAnAhavibandhArtaM svedayedvAtagulminam| svedaiH svedavidhAvuktairnADIprastarasa~gkaraiH||99||
bastikarma paraM vidyAdgulmaghnaM taddhi mArutam| sve sthAne prathamaM jitvA sadyo gulmamapohati||100||
tasmAdabhIkShNasho gulmA nirUhaiH sAnuvAsanaiH| prayujyamAnaiH shAmyanti vAtapittakaphAtmakAH||101||
gulmaghnAni ca tailAni vakShyante vAtarogike||102||
tAni mArutaje gulme pAnAbhya~ggAnuvAsanaiH| prayuktAnyAshu sidhyanti tailaM hyanilajitparam ||103||
nIlinIcUrNasaMyuktaM pUrvoktaM ghRutameva| samalAya pradAtavyaM shodhanaM vAtagulmine||104||
nIlinItrivRutAdantIpathyAkampillakaiH saha| shodhanArthaM ghRutaM deyaM sabiDakShAranAgaram||105||
nIlinIM triphalAM rAsnAM balAM kaTukarohiNIm| pacedviDa~ggaM vyAghrIM ca palikAni jalADhake||106||
tena pAdAvasheSheNa ghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet| dadhnaH prasthena saMyojya sudhAkShIrapalena ca||107||
tato ghRutapalaM dadyAdyavAgUmaNDamishritam| jIrNe samyagviriktaM ca bhojayedrasabhojanam||108||
gulmakuShThodaravya~ggashophapANDvAmayajvarAn| shvitraM plIhAnamunmAdaM ghRutametadvyapohati||109||
kukkuTAshca mayUrAshca tittirikrau~jcavartakAH| shAlayo madirA sarpirvAtagulmabhiShagjitam||110||
hitamuShNaM dravaM snigdhaM bhojanaM vAtagulminAm| samaNDavAruNIpAnaM pakvaM vA dhAnyakairjalam||111||
mande~agnau vardhate gulmo dIpte cAgnau prashAmyati| tasmAnnA nAtisauhityaM kuryAnnAtivila~gghanam||112||
sarvatra gulme prathamaM snehasvedopapAdite| yA kriyA kriyate siddhiM sA yAti na virUkShite||113||
bhiShagAtyayikaM buddhvA pittagulmamupAcaret| vairecanikasiddhena sarpiShA tiktakena vA||114||
dve pale ca masUrANAM sAdhyamaShTaguNe~ambhasi| shRutAccheShaM ghRutasamaM sarpiShashca catuShpalam||115||
pibet sammUrcchitaM tena gulmaH shAmyati paittikaH| jvarastRuShNA ca shUlaM ca bhramo mUrcchA~arucistathA||117||
jale dashaguNe sAdhyaM trAyamANAcatuShpalam| pa~jcabhAgasthitaM pUtaM kalkaiH saMyojya kArShikaiH||118||
rohiNI kaTukA mustA trAyamANA durAlabhA| kalkaistAmalakIvIrAjIvantIcandanotpalaiH||119||
rasasyAmalakAnAM ca kShIrasya ca ghRutasya ca| palAni pRuthagaShTAShTau dattvA samyagvipAcayet||120||
pittaraktabhavaM gulmaM vIsarpaM paittikaM jvaram| hRudrogaM kAmalAM kuShThaM hanyAdetadghRutottamam||121||

rasenAmalakekShUNAM ghRutapAdaM vipAcayet| pathyApadaM pibetsarpistatsiddhaM pittagulmanut||122||

Commentary: ghRutapAdamiti samuditAmalakekShurasApekShayA ghRutasya pAdikatvam| pathyApAdamityatra harItakyA gurutvena ghRutApekShayA pAdatvenAShTamo bhAgo bhavati; eke tu “yatashca pAdanirdeshashcaturbhAgastatastu saH” (ka.a.12) iti vacanAccaturthameva bhAgaM prasthe ghRute~aShTapalarUpaM vadanti||122||
drAkShAM madhUkaM kharjUraM vidArIM sashatAvarIm| parUShakANi triphalAM sAdhayetpalasammitam||123||
jalADhake pAdasheShe rasamAmalakasya ca| ghRutamikShurasaM kShIramabhayAkalkapAdikam||124||
sAdhayettadghRutaM siddhaM sharkarAkShaudrapAdikam| prayogAt pittagulmaghnaM sarvapittavikAranut||125||
vRuShaM samUlamApothya pacedaShTaguNe jale| sheShe~aShTabhAge tasyaiva puShpakalkaM pradApayet||126||
tena siddhaM ghRutaM shItaM sakShaudraM pittagulmanut| raktapittajvarashvAsakAsahRudroganAshanam||127||
dvipalaM trAyamANAyA jaladviprasthasAdhitam| aShTabhAgasthitaM pUtaM koShNaM kShIrasamaM pibet||128||
pibedupari tasyoShNaM kShIrameva yathAbalam| tena nirhRutadoShasya gulmaH shAmyati paittikaH||129||

drAkShAbhayArasaM gulme paittike saguDaM pibet| lihyAtkampillakaM vA~api virekArthaM madhudravam||130||

Commentary: kampillakaM guNDArocanikAm||130||

dAhaprashamano~abhya~ggaH sarpiShA pittagulminAm| candanAdyena tailena tailena madhukasya vA||131||

Commentary: tailena madhukasya veti madhukasAdhitena tailena||131||
ye ca pittajvaraharAH satiktAH kShIrabastayaH| hitAste pittagulmibhyo vakShyante ye ca siddhiShu||132||
shAlayo jA~ggalaM mAMsaM gavyAje payasI ghRutam| kharjUrAmalakaM drAkShAM dADimaM saparUShakam||133||
AhArArthaM prayoktavyaM pAnArthaM salilaM shRutam| balAvidArIgandhAdyaiH pittagulmacikitsitam||134||
AmAnvaye pittagulme sAme vA kaphavAtike| yavAgUbhiH khaDairyUShaiH sandhukShyo~agnirvila~gghite||135||
shamaprakopau doShANAM sarveShAmagnisaMshritau| tasmAdagniM sadA rakShennidAnAni ca varjayet||136||
vamanaM vamanArhAya pradadyAt kaphagulmine| snigdhasvinnasharIrAya gulme shaithilyamAgate||137||
pariveShTya pradIptAMstu balvajAnathavA kushAn| bhiShakkumbhe samAvApya gulmaM ghaTamukhe nyaset||138||
sa~ggRuhIto yadA gulmastadA ghaTamathoddharet| vastrAntaraM tataH kRutvA bhindyAdgulmaM pramANavit||139||
vimArgAjapadAdarshairyathAlAbhaM prapIDayet| mRudnIyAdgulmamevaikaM na tvantrahRudayaM spRushet||140||
tilairaNDAtasIbIjasarShapaiH parilipya ca| shleShmagulmamayaHpAtraiH sukhoShNaiH svedayedbhiShak||141||
savyoShakShAralavaNaM dashamUlIshRutaM ghRutam| kaphagulmaM jayatyAshu sahi~ggubiDadADimam||142||
iti dashamUlIghRutambhallAtakAnAM dvipalaM pa~jcamUlaM palonmitam| sAdhyaM vidArIgandhAdyamApothya salilADhake||143||
pAdasheShe rase tasmin pippalIM nAgaraM vacAm| viDa~ggaM saindhavaM hi~ggu yAvashUkaM biDaM shaTIm||144||
citrakaM madhukaM rAsnAM piShTvA karShasamaM bhiShak| prasthaM ca payaso dattvA ghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet||145||
etadbhallAtakaghRutaM kaphagulmaharaM param| plIhapANDvAmayashvAsagrahaNIrogakAsanut||146||
pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakanAgaraiH| palikaiH sayavakShArairghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet||147||
kShIraprasthaM ca tat sarpihanti gulmaM kaphAtmakam| grahaNIpANDurogaghnaM plIhakAsajvarApaham||148||
trivRutAM triphalAM dantIM dashamUlaM palonmitam| jale caturguNe paktvA caturbhAgasthitaM rasam||149||
sarpireraNDajaM tailaM kShIraM caikatra sAdhayet| sa siddho mishrakasnehaH sakShaudraH kaphagulmanut||150||
kaphavAtavibandheShu kuShThaplIhodareShu ca| prayojyo mishrakaH sneho yonishUleShu cAdhikam||151||
yaduktaM vAtagulmaghnaM sraMsanaM nIlinIghRutam| dviguNaM tadvirekArthaM prayojyaM kaphagulminAm||152||
sudhAkShIradrave cUrNaM trivRutAyAH subhAvitam| kArShikaM madhusarpibhyAM lIDhvA sAdhu viricyate||153||
jaladroNe vipaktavyA viMshatiH pa~jca cAbhayAH| dantyAH palAni tAvanti citrakasya tathaiva ca||154||
aShTabhAgAvasheShaM tu rasaM pUtamadhikShipet| dantIsamaM guDaM pUtaM kShipettatrAbhayAshca tAH||155||
tailArdhakuDavaM caiva trivRutAyAshcatuShpalam| cUrNitaM palamekaM tu pippalIvishvabheShajam||156||
tat sAdhyaM lehavacchIte tasmiMstailasamaM madhu| kShipeccUrNapalaM caikaM tvagelApatrakesharAt||157||
tato lehapalaM lIDhvA jagdhvA caikAM harItakIm| sukhaM viricyate snigdho doShaprasthamanAmayam||158||
gulmaM shvayathumarshAMsi pANDurogamarocakam| hRudrogaM grahaNIdoShaM kAmalAM viShamajvaram||159||
kuShThaM plIhAnamAnAhameShA hanyupasevitA| niratyayaH kramashcAsyA dravo mAMsarasaudanaH||160||
siddhAH siddhiShu vakShyante nirUhAH kaphagulminAm| ariShTayogAH siddhAshca grahaNyarshashcikitsite||161||
yaccUrNaM guTikA yAshca vihitA vAtagulminAm| dviguNakShArahi~ggvamlavetasAstAH kaphe hitAH||162||
ya eva grahaNIdoShe kShArAste kaphagulminAm| siddhA niratyayAH shastA dAhastvante prashasyate||163||
prapurANAni dhAnyAni jA~ggalA mRugapakShiNaH| kaulattho mudgayUShashca pippalyA nAgarasya ca||164||
shuShkamUlakayUShashca bilvasya varuNasya ca| cirabilvA~gkurANAM ca yavAnyAshcitrakasya ca||165||
bIjapUrakahi~ggvamlavetasakShAradADimaiH| takreNa tailasarpirbhyAM vya~jjanAnyupakalpayet||166||
pa~jcamUlIshRutaM toyaM purANaM vAruNIrasam| kaphagulmI pibetkAle jIrNaM mAdhvIkameva vA||167||
yavAnIcUrNitaM takraM biDena lavaNIkRutam| pibet sandIpanaM vAtakaphamUtrAnulomanam ||168||
sa~jcitaH kramasho gulmo mahAvAstuparigrahaH| kRutamUlaH sirAnaddho yadA kUrma ivonnataH||169||
daurbalyArucihRullAsakAsavamyaratijvaraiH | tRuShNAtandrApratishyAyairyujyate na sa sidhyati||170||
gRuhItvA sajvarashvAsaM vamyatIsArapIDitam| hRunnAbhihastapAdeShu shophaH karShati gulminam||171||
raudhirasya tu gulmasya garbhakAlavyatikrame| snigdhasvinnasharIrAyai dadyAt snehavirecanam||172||
palAshakShArapAtre dve dve pAtre tailasarpiShoH| gulmashaithilyajananIM paktvA mAtrAM prayojayet||173||
prabhidyeta na yadyevaM dadyAdyonivishodhanam | kShAreNa yuktaM palalaM sudhAkShIreNa vA punaH||174||
AbhyAM vA bhAvitAn dadyAdyonau kaTukamatsyakAn| varAhamatsyapittAbhyAM laktakAn vA subhAvitAn||175||
adhoharaishcordhvaharairbhAvitAn vA samAkShikaiH| kiNvaM vA saguDakShAraM dadyAdyonivishodhanam||176||
raktapittaharaM kShAraM lehayenmadhusarpiShA| lashunaM madirAM tIkShNAM matsyAMshcAsyai pradApayet||177||
bastiM sakShIragomUtraM sakShAraM dAshamUlikam| adRushyamAne rudhire dadyAdgulmaprabhedanam||178||
pravartamAne rudhire dadyAnmAMsarasaudanam| ghRutatailena cAbhya~ggaM pAnArthaM taruNIM surAm||179||
rudhire~atipravRutte tu raktapittaharIH kriyAH| kAryA vAtarugArtAyAH sarvA vAtaharIH punaH||180||
ghRutatailAvasekAMshca tittirIMshcaraNAyudhAn| surAM samaNDAM pUrvaM ca pAnamamlasya sarpiShaH||181||
prayojayeduttaraM vA jIvanIyena sarpiShA| atipravRutte rudhire satiktenAnuvAsanam||182||
tatra shlokAH- snehaH svedaH sarpirbastishcUrNAni bRuMhaNaM guDikAH| vamanavirekau mokShaH kShatajasya ca vAtagulmavatAm||183||
sarpiH satiktasiddhaM kShIraM prasraMsanaM nirUhAshca| raktasya cAvasecanamAshvAsanasaMshamanayogAH||184||
upanAhanaM sashastraM pakvasyAbhyantaraprabhinnasya| saMshodhanasaMshamane pittaprabhavasya gulmasya||185||
snehaH svedo bhedo la~gghanamullekhanaM virekashca| sarpirbastirguTikAshcUrNamariShTAshca sakShArAH||186||
gulmasyAnte dAhaH kaphajasyAgre~apanItaraktasya| gulmasya raudhirasya kriyAkramaH strIbhavasyoktaH||187||
pathyAnnapAnasevA hetUnAM varjanaM yathAsvaM ca| nityaM cAgnisamAdhiH snigdhasya ca sarvakarmANi||188||
heturli~ggaM siddhiH kriyAkramaH sAdhyatA na yogAshca| gulmacikitsitasa~ggraha etAvAn vyAhRuto~agniveshasya||189||
ityAmalakAdyaM ghRutam
iti kShIraShaTpalakaM ghRutam
iti mishrakaH snehaH
iti hi~ggvAdicUrNaM guTikA ca
iti bhallAtakAdyaM ghRutam
iti trAyamANAdyaM ghRutam
iti dantIharItakI
nidAnoktakramAnurodhAdraktapittamanu gulmacikitsitaM brUte||1-2||

RutAvityAdinA shoNitagulmamAha| RutAviti puShpadarshanakAle| striyamityanena kumArImativRuddhAM ca niShedhayati| piNDita eveti garbhastva~ggaiH spandate| samagarbhali~gga iti stanapInatvAdi garbhasamAnaM li~ggaM bhavati| strIbhava eveti anena puruShasya raktagulmotpattiM niShedhayati| mAse vyatIte dashame cikitsya iti prabhAvAddashamamAsAtikrame evAsya sukhA cikitsA bhavati, arvAk cikitsAyAM tu shoNitAtisrutigarbhAshayopaghAtAdi syAt| yaducyate- garbhasamAnali~ggatvenAsya dashamamAsAdUrdhvaM rudhiragulmAvadhAraNaM bhavati, tenArvAkcikitsA~atra nokteti; tanna, dashamamAsAtikrame~api garbhAvasthAnadarshanAt| uktaM hi- “puShTo yadA varShagaNairapi syAt” (shA.a.2) tathA sampiNDitatvaM garbhalakShaNAdviruddhalakShaNamuktaM; tena dashamamAsAdarvAgapi shoNitagulmAvadhAraNaM bhavatyeva; tasmAt pUrvoktameva sAdhu||18-19||

ata Urdhvamiti kriyAkramAbhidhAnAduttaram| snehairiti caturbhirapi snehaiH| snehopayogAnAha- bhojanetyAdi| visheSheNeti vacanena na sarvaM sarvatra; visheShatastu snehapAnaM nAbherUrdhvaM jAte gulme| pakvAshayagata iti pakvAshayasa~ggatAdhobhAge| bastiriti nirUho~anuvAsanaM ca| jaTharAshraya iti nAbhigate nAbhipArshvagate ca| ubhayamiti nirUhasnehabastI| vAtagulmeShviti vacanAdvAtapradhAneShu gulmeShvapi yathoktaM kartavyaM darshayati| uktaM hi “gulminAmanilashAntirupAyaiH” (ni.a.3) ityAdi| kaphapittAnurakShiNeti tathA snehaH kartavyo yathA kaphapitte na vardhete||20-26||

vAtacikitsayA vRuddhakaphapittaraktacikitsAmAha- kapho vAte ityAdi| jitaprAya iti vacanAt kaphAdyavRuddhyA vAto yathA jitaprAyo bhavati tathA vAtacikitsA kAryA| yatholbaNasyeti vAtacikitsayA ya ulbaNo doSho bhavati kaphAdiH, tasya cikitsA kartavyA| tasyAmapi cikitsAyAM vAtavRuddhiryathA na bhavati tathA kartavyamiti darshayannAha- AdAvityAdi||27-28||

gulme yadyapi vamanaM niShiddhaM, tathA~apyavasthAyAM vamanaM tadapavAdarUpaM darshayannAha- vAtagulma ityAdi| vartaya iti phalavartayaH| Anulaumikairiti vacanena tIvravirecanaM vAtakopanaM niShedhayati||29-31||
rUkShoShNena tu sambhUte paittike iti yojyam| rUkShoShNatayaiva pittaM vRuddhaM bhavati| tailvakaM sarpirudare vaktavyama||33-35||

tRuShNAjvaretyAdinA gulmavidAhe upakramamAha| raktAvasecanaM kRutaM cecchinnamUlA gulmA na vidahyante; chinnamUlA iti cchinnashoNitA ityarthaH| chinnamUlatvameva sphorayati- raktaM hItyAdi| vyamlatAM vidAham| tacca nAstIti shoNitamavasekAnnAstItyarthaH| tasya raktasyAbhAvAdrugapi nAsti||36-37||

atra yadyapi nidAne eva gulmasya hetulakShaNAnyuktani, tathA~api prakaraNavashAt punastAnyabhidhIyante; nidAnoktAdvisheShashca kashciducyate| nidAne vAyoreva kopena vRuddherhetubhirAvaraNamuktam, atipIDanairvetyanena tadevocyate| taireveti viTshleShmapittaiH| mithyApratikarma mithyAkRutaM vamanAdikaM pa~jcakarma||4-5||

kaphaM ca pittaM cetyAdinA samprAptimAha| iyaM ca shoNitajagulmavyatiriktAnAM caturNAM samprAptiH| tatra kaphaM ca pittaM ceti kadAcit pittaM kadAcit kaphaH| tatra kaphaje svatantro vRuddhaH kaphaH, pittaje svahetuvRuddhaM svatantraM pittaM, sannipAte ca yathoktaguNau pittakaphau, uddhUya vAyuH gulmaM karoti; vAtagulme tu svatantraH prakupito vAyuH prakRutisthau pittakaphAvuddhUya gulmaM karotIti j~jeyam| mArgAniti UrdhvAdhastirya~gmArgAn| adho na yAtIti atra cakAro luptanirdiShTaH; tenordhvaM na yAti tiryak ca na yAtIti j~jeyam| kiMvA vAyoH koShThasyAdhogamanameva prAyo bhavati, tena tanniShedhaH sAkShAduktaH, itaramArgagamananiShedhastu samAnanyAyatayA labhyate| pakvAshaye iti pittAshayAmAshayayoradhobhAge eva| svatantra iti vAtagulme, parasaMshraya iti pakvAshaye| pittakaphAshayayoH kaphajaH paittiko nicayagulmashca parasaMshrayo bhavatIti j~jeyam| paripiNDitatvAdgulma ityanena yathA aj~jA api latAsamUhAdau sa~gghAtenAvasthite ‘gulma’ iti vyapadishanti, tathehApi sa~gghAtenAvasthAnAdgulmetyabhidhAnaM prApnoti| yathAdoShamiti yatholbaNaM doSham| nAmeti ca sa~jj~jA; vAtajo~ayaM, pittajo~ayamityAdikA||6-7||

samprati pRuthaktvena hetuli~ggacikitsAbhidhAnaM pratijAnIte- pa~jcAtmakasyetyAdi| pa~jcAtmakasya pa~jcasvarUpasya| prabhavatyasmAditi prabhavaH kAraNaM; kAraNAni pa~jca vAtapittakaphasannipAtarUpANi| tiShThatyasminniti sthAnaM bastyAdi, saMsthAnamAkRutiH, rujA pIDA, eShAM vikalpaH kShaNe kShaNe~anyathAtvam| shishirajvaraH shItajvaraH| karotIti pUrveNa sambadhyate| jIrNe~abhyadhikaM prakopaM samupaiti yashca| na copashete iti na sukhaM janayati||8-11||
kaTvamletyAdinA pittagulmamAha| AmAbhighAtashabdenAmAbhighAtaH pittajanako j~jeyaH| rudhiraM ca duShTamityanena duShTAdrudhirAnmalabhUtasya pittasya janma darshayati||12-13||

vidAhalakShaNe iti dAhAdiShvityarthaH| bahistu~gge iti bAhyata unnate| samunnate iti samatvenonnate, na nimnoccavibhAgena| nipIDitAnantaramunnate nipIDitonnate| stabdhe iti vartule| supte iti mandavedane ityarthaH| dhAnvantarIyANAmiti dhanvantaritantrAdhyAyinAM shalyavidAmityarthaH| kRutA shastrakarmaNi yogyA yaiste kRutayogyAH| gulmasya ca pAkaH sushrute niShiddhaH- “sa yasmAdAtmani cayaM gacchatyapsviva budbudaH| antaHsarati yasmAcca na pAkamupnayAtyataH” (u.taM.a.42) iti; tathA~apIha kRutavAstuparigrahasya gulmasya pAka ucyate, yastu akRutavAstuparigrahaH sa na pacyata itIhApyanumataM; yastu kRutavAstuparigrahatayA pacyata iti ucyate tasya vidradhitvena pAko jAyata iti sa~jj~jAmAtreNa visaMvAdaH| antarbhAgasyeti koShThamadhyasthitasya| yadyapi sarva eva gulmaH koShThasthastathA~apIha yo bahirunnatashcito na bhavati sa iha tatstho~abhipretaH| hRutkroDashUnatA~antaHsthe iti antaHsthapAke hRutkroDasya shUnatA bhavati; bahiHsthe pArshvanirgatiH, pArshvanirgatirgulma eva dRushyate| kecittu shlokamenaM na paThanti||42-45||

vrajatyUrdhvamiti sashabdenAntaHsthenAbhipretaH| upekSheta hitAshanairiti hitAshanastiShThet na ki~jcidbheShajaM kuryAt| rakShannupadravAniti upadravebhyo jvarAdibhyo rakShannityarthaH| savishodhanamiti visheSheNa shodhanaM sarpiHpAnam| tiktamiti tiktadravyasAdhitam||46-47||-

shItalairityAdinA kaphagulmamanusRutya cikitsAkramamAha| sakShArakaTukamiti kShArakaTudravyasAdhitam| apasRutamiti calitam| dAshamUlikairiti dashamUlakRutabastayo bastisUtrIye (si.a.3) vaktavyAH| mUDhe iti sammUrcchite, AvRute iti yAvat| guTikAcUrNaniryUhA iti vaktavyA guTikAdayaH| kShArAriShTAgnikarmabhirityatra kShArasyAtrAprastutayA shalyatantre eva tAvadvistareNAbhidhAnam, atrApi ca grahaNyadhyAye kShArA vaktavyAH; agnikarmAtrApi sa~gkShepeNa gulmasthAne vaktavyaM, parAdhikAre vistArAnabhidhAnAt||48-55||-

kShArasya mahAtyayatvena doShAdij~jAnapUrvikAmantarA~antarA pravRuttimAha- doShetyAdi| tatra kShArAnuguNo doShaH kaphaH, prakRutiH shlaiShmikI, gulmashca sthiraH, RuturhemantaH shishiro vA| ekAntaramityAdi| doShAdiShu sarveShu kShArAnuguNeShvekAntaraM vishramya, anyatamAnuguNye dvyantaraM tryahaM vA vishramya; baladoShApekShayA vA vikalpaH| sharIrabaladoShANAM vRuddhikShapaNakovida iti sharIrabalavRuddhau doShasya ca kShapaNe paNDitaH| mAMsakShIraghRutAshina ityanena mAMsAdibhojanena kShAraprayoge sharIrabalarakShA kartavyeti darshayati||56-59||-

sharalohAdibhirityanena rUkShadAhaM darshayati| dAhashca gulmadeshe eva kartavyaH| dAhakShArayoH parAdhikAratvena parabalasyAbhipreyastvaM, tena tatpareNaiva dAhakShArayogamAha- dAha ityAdi| kShAratantrasyAShTA~gge pRuthaganabhidhAnAcchalyatantramevAnushastrakShAravidhAyakaM kShAratantramucyate||60-63||-
eta eveti tryUShaNetyAdyuktAH| prasannA madyavisheShaH| kShIrArthamiti kShIrasthAne prasannA deyA, evaM svarasAdibhirapi kShIrArtho vyAkhyeyaH||66-68||
hi~ggvAdye hi~ggvAdInAM kalkaH; dadhi caturguNaM, dravatvAt||69-70||

hapuShAdikalkaH, kolarasAdIni pa~jcadravANi snehasamAni, “pa~jcaprabhRuti yatra syurdravANi snehasaMvidhau| tatra snehasamAni” iti vacanAt; dADimasyApi rasAntarasAnnidhyAddrava eva grAhyaH; uktaM hi vishvAmitre- “pRuthvIkAjIrakavyoShahapuShAjAjisaindhavaiH| sacavyapippalImUlarvahnidIpyakasaMyutaiH|| dADimakolamUlAnAM rase dadhni payasyapi| siddhaM ghRutaM jayedgulmaM vahnisandIpanaM param” iti||71-73||

picuH karShaH, tenAdhyardhapicuriti sArdhaH karShaH| atra ca ghRute klkabhUyastvaM bhavannapi kalpanIyaM, vacanAdeva| uktaM hi nyAyavidbhiH- “nirdeshaH shrUyate nUnaM dravyANAM yatra yAdRushaH| tasmin sa saMvidhAtavyaH shabdAbhAve prasiddhitaH” iti| atra punarghRutaM siddhamiti pippalyAdInAM lehatvena prayoganirAsArthaM ghRutasAdhanArthaM coktam||74-75||

ghRutoktabheShajAnAM cUrNAdiShvapi prayogamAha- ghRutAnAmityAdi| vartya iti phalavartyaH| uktadravyANAM cUrNatve kRute~anupAnArthaM dravANyAha- koletyAdi| kaShAyakaraNapakShe visheShavidhAnAnukteH sAmAnyavidhinaiva kaShAyakaraNaM j~jeyam||76-78||

hi~ggvAdau ajamodAdIni khyAtAni| dvau kShArau sarjikAyAvashUkajau| prAgbhaktamiti bhojanasya prAk; pariNAmena vA yathA bhojanAt pratyAsannaM bhavati| bahusha iti saptAhaM, “saptAhaM tena bhAvanA” iti vacanAt| kArmukA iti karmaNi samarthAH||79-84||
lu~jcitasyeti nistuShIkRutasya| atra cauShadhayogo vyAdhimahimnaiva bhavatIti j~jeyam| pUrvamiti pUrvayogoktameraNDatailam| paramiti uttarayogoktameraNDatailaM payoyuktaM pAyayedityarthaH||85-93||

sAdhayedityAdau shuddhashuShkasya nistuShIkRutasya ApUrNavIryasya ca kShIrodake~aShTaguNite ityatra “bhAge~anukte samAnaM” iti vacanAt kShIraM caturguNaM (ShoDashapalAni) jalaM ca caturguNamiti militvA~aShTaguNitaM kShIrAvashiShTaM sAdhayet; gulmasya bahubheShajasAdhyatayA ShoDashapalakShIramAnaM na doShAvahaM bhavati| kShIrarasonayoshca yadyapi sahopayogo viruddhaH, tathA~api vyAdhimahimnA maharShivacanAdavivAdaH||94-95||
nADIprastarasa~gkarairityanena gulme svedAntarasyAyaugikatvaM sUcayati||99-101||-

Ashu sidhyantIti shIghraM gulmaM jayanti| tatra hetumAha- tailaM hyanilajit paramiti; yasmAttailaM vAtajit tasmAdvAtagulmaM vAtavikAraM shIghraM jayati| anye tu tailaM tvanilajitvaraM nIlinIcUrNasaMyuktaM samalAya dAtavyaM, tathA pUrvoktaM ca tryUShaNAdyaM ghRutaM nIlinIcUrNasaMyuktaM dAtavyamiti yojayanti| prathamavyAkhyAne tu ghRutamevetyanena pUrvoktatryUShaNaghRutAdikaM nIlinIcUrNasaMyuktaM deyamityartho j~jeyaH||102-104||

nIlinItyAdau kalko na shrUyate, kalkAbhAve ca pAkaj~jAnaM nAsti, pAkasya hi mRudvAdinA traividhyamuktaM, tasmAt kalkAnabhidhAne~api pAkaj~jAnArthamapi kalko deyaH; sa ca kvAthadravyaireva yogyatayA sAnnidhyAcca deya iti vadanti| maivaM, vicitratvAdghRutAdisAdhanashakteH yathokte yathoktameva paraM j~je(de)yaM natvanuktaM kalpanIyaM; kalpanAyAM ca yuktirnAstyeva, yato vinA~api kalkadAnaM kvAthAdidraveNa snehapAko bhavatyeva, vinA~api kalkaM snehapAkaj~jAnasyoktatvAt; tasmAdAcAryeNa yathoktaM tathaiva kAryam| atra viriktasya peyAdikramamautsargikaM bAdhayitvA rasabhojanaM prayogasAtmyatvAducyate; yathA- AvartakIghRutaviriktasya kA~jjikakodravAnnabhojanam (a. saM. ci. a. 21)||105-109||
kukkuTetyAdinA gulmine~annapAnaM vidhIyate| atisauhityamatila~gghanaM cobhayorapyagnivadhahetutayA varjitam| yaduktaM- “nAbhojanena kAyAgnirdIpyate nAtibhojanAt” (ci.a.15) ityAdi||110-113||

rohiNI kaTukA kaTurohiNI| karShAMshA iti karShapramANAH| paTolatrivRutoH pale iti vacanAt pratyekaM palam| aShTaguNe iti ghRutAdaShTaguNe| ghRutasamamiti ghRutaM catuShpalamatroktaM; tena kvAthaghRutAbhyAmaShTapalaM peyam; aShTapalI ca mAtrA gulmoktatvAdeva bhavati| yaduktaM- “gulminaH sarpadaShTAshca visarpopahatAshca ye| teShAM mAtrA vinirdiShTA palAnyaShTau visheShataH” iti||114-117||
catuShpalAyAM trAyamANAyAM dashaguNaM jalaM catvAriMshatpalAni deyam| kalkairiti tAmalakyAdikalkaiH, kaTurohiNyAdInAM ca kalkairiti yojanIyam||118-121||
drAkShAM madhUkamityAdau kvAthasheShasya prasthasya sAhacaryAdghRutAdInAmapi prasthamAnatvam||123-125||

vRuShaM samUlamityAdau kvAthasyAShTaguNajaladAne~aShTabhAgasheShatvamiti raktapittoktavAsAghRutAdvisheShaH| tatra hi sAmAnyaparibhAShayA vRuShAccaturguNaM jalaM caturbhAgAvashiShTaM ca gRuhyate| tena prayogAntaratvAdraktapittoktavAsAghRutAtidesho na kRutaH| sakShaudramityanena prakShepanyAyAt pAdikatvaM madhunaH||126-127||
yathAbalamiti yathA virecanAtiyogo na bhavati||128-129||

ye ca pittajvaraharA ityAdau yadyapi pittajvaraharatvena sAkShAdbastayo noktAH, tathA~api paTolAdaya eva ye tiktA bastaya uktAsta eva pittajvaraharA bhavantIti kRutvehoktaM- pittajvaraharA iti| pittaharA ye ca siddhau vaktavyAste~apyatra j~jeyAH||132-136||

shaithilyamAgata iti shithiladoShatayA shastranirhAryadoShatAmApanne gulme taM ghaTamukhe nyaset| ghaTamanthanayantreNa samyaggRuhItvA prapIDayed bhindyAditi yojanA| antrahRudayasya tyAgaH sphuTanAdibhayAt||137-141||
savyoShetyAdau dashamUlasya kvAthe vyoShAdInAM sheShANAM kalkaiH sAdhitaM ghRutaM kaphagulmaM jayatItyarthaH||142-146||
pippalyAdyuktaM ShaTpalaM ghRutaM samenaiva dugdhena shrapaNIyam| “caturguNe drave sAdhyaM” iti vacanAdatra triguNaM jalaM j~jeyam||147-148||

trivRutAmityAdau pa~jcadashapalAni kvAthyAni; tatra caturguNaM jalaM deyaM, palollekhavihitatvAt ShaShTipalAni bhavanti; kShIramapi sAhacaryAt pa~jcadashapalam; etadubhayadravapAdaH sneho~atra paktavyaH| kiMvA “snehasamaM kShIraM” iti vacanAt snehasamena kShIreNa kvAthena ca pa~jcadashapalena pa~jcapalaH sneho dravapAdikaH kartavyaH| jatUkarNAbhiprAyAttu trivRutAdipa~jcadashapale prasthamAnollekhena prasthacatuShTayaM jalasya deyam| yatastena sAmAnyenaivoktaM- “trivRutAdantItriphalAdashamUlaiH samairurubUkatailaM sarpishca shRutaM payasA samamudAvartashUlAdau” iti||149-151||
dviguNamiti dvipalapramANaM, tatra hi ghRutapalaM peyamuktam||152-153||

tailArdhakuDavamiti tailaM catuShpalam| lehavaditi lehapAkalakShaNena paktavyamityarthaH| iha caturjAtakAnmilitAt palam| doShaprasthamiti sArdhatrayodashapalaM; uktaM hi bhojena- “vamane ca vireke ca tathA shoNitamokShaNe| sArdhatrayodashapalaM prasthamAhurmanIShiNaH” iti||154-160||
grahaNyarshashcikitsite nirdiShTA ityarthaH| dAhastvante iti vacanena dAhasya kriyAntarAsiddhAvante eva kartavyatAmAha||161-168||
sa~jcita ityAdinA kramAdasAdhyatAprAptaM gulmamAha| mahAvAstuparigraha iti bhUrideshavyApakaH||169-171||

garbhakAlavyatikrame iti dashamamAsarUpasya garbhakAlasya vyatikrame| kShArapAtre iti kShArodakasyADhakadvayam| mAtrAmiti yogyapramANam| palalaM tilapiShTam| kShArashcAtra palAshakShAra eva, prakRutatvAt| tAbhyAmiti kShArasudhAkShIrAbhyAm| kaTukamatsyaH shapharI shuShkamatsyaH| laktakAn vastrAvayavAn| kiNvaM surAbIjam| raktapittaharaM kShAramiti nIlotpalakShAram| amlasya sarpiShaH amladravyasAdhitasya ghRutasya| uttaraM bhojanottarakAlaM pAnaM, kiMvottarabastiH| jIvanIyaM sarpirvAtarakte vaktavyam| satiktena tiktadravyasAdhitenAnuvAsanamiti||172-182||
sneha ityAdinA punaH sa~gkShepeNa sa~ggrahaM karoti| yogAshcetyanena pratyekaM vAtAdigulmacikitsite sa~ggRuhItA api punaH sa~ggrahAbhidhAnena sa~ggRuhItAH||183-189||
athAtaH pramehacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

nirmohamAnAnushayo nirAshaH punarvasurj~jAnatapovishAlaH| kAle~agniveshAya sahetuli~ggAnuvAca mehA~jshamanaM ca teShAm||3||

Commentary: nirgatA mohAdayo yasya sa tathA; anushayaH kopaH| nirgatA AshA yasya sa nirAshaH nIrAgaH| nidAnoktamapi hetuli~ggAdi punaH prakaraNavashAt sakalamucyate||3||
saMshodhanaM nArhati yaH pramehI tasya kriyA saMshamanI prayojyA| manthAH kaShAyA yavacUrNalehAH pramehashAntyai laghavashca bhakShyAH||18||
ye viShkirA ye pratudA viha~ggAsteShAM rasairjA~ggalajairmanoj~jaiH| yavaudanaM rUkShamathApi vATyamadyAt sasaktUnapi cApyapUpAn||19||
mudgAdiyUShairatha tiktashAkaiH purANashAlyodanamAdadIta| dantI~ggudItailayutaM pramehI tathA~atasIsarShapatailayuktam||20||
saShaShTikaM syAttRuNadhAnyamannaM yavapradhAnastu bhavet pramehI| yavasya bhakShyAn vividhAMstathA~adyAt kaphapramehI madhusamprayuktAn||21||
nishisthitAnAM triphalAkaShAye syustarpaNAH kShaudrayutA yavAnAm| tAn sIdhuyuktAn prapibet pramehI prAyogikAnmehavadhArthameva||22||
ye shleShmamehe vihitAH kaShAyAstairbhAvitAnAM ca pRuthagyavAnAm| saktUnapUpAn saguDAn sadhAnAn bhakShyAMstathA~anyAn vividhAMshca khAdet||23||
kharAshvagohaMsapRuShadbhRutAnAM tathA yavAnAM vividhAshca bhakShyAH| deyAstathA veNuyavA yavAnAM kalpena godhUmamayAshca bhakShyAH||24||

saMshodhanollekhanala~gghanAni kAle prayuktAni kaphapramehAn| jayanti pittaprabhavAn virekaH santarpaNaH saMshamano vidhishca||25||

Commentary: saMshodhanagrahaNenaivollekhane prApte punarvamanasya kaphajayapradhAnatvakhyApanArthamullekhanapadena kathanam; anye tUllekhanaM kaphameheShu la~gghanaM vadanti| pittamehAnAM yApyatvAt ‘jayanti’ iti padena pittajAnAM yApanamevocyate; kiMvA~atyantaduShTe medasi pittajAnAmasAdhyatvaM, ‘sAdhyAstu medo yadi na praduShTam’ ityanena ye vaktavyAstAn prati jayantIti sAdhu||25||
dArvIM surAhvAM triphalAM samustAM kaShAyamutkvAthya pibet pramehI| kShaudreNa yuktAmathavA haridrAM pibedrasenAmalakIphalAnAm||26||
harItakIkaTphalamustalodhraM pAThAviDa~ggArjunadhanvanAshca| ubhe haridre tagaraM viDa~ggaM kadambashAlArjunadIpyakAshca||27||
dArvI viDa~ggaM khadiro dhavashca surAhvakuShThAgurucandanAni| dArvyagnimanthau triphalA sapAThA pAThA ca mUrvA ca tathA shvadaMShTrA||28||
yavAnyushIrANyabhayAguDUcIcavyAbhayAcitrakasaptaparNAH| pAdaiH kaShAyAH kaphamehinAM te dashopadiShTA madhusamprayuktAH||29||
ushIralodhrA~jjanacandanAnAmushIramustAmalakAbhayAnAm| paTolanimbAmalakAmRutAnAM mustAbhayApadmakavRukShakANAm||30||
lodhrAmbukAlIyakadhAtakInAM nimbArjunAmrAtanishotpalAnAm| shirIShasarjArjunakesharANAM priya~ggupadmotpalakiMshukAnAm||31||
ashvatthapAThAsanavetasAnAM kaTa~gkaTeryutpalamustakAnAm| paitteShu meheShu dasha pradiShTAH pAdaiH kaShAyA madhusamprayuktAH||32||
sarveShu meheShu matau tu pUrvau kaShAyayogau vihitAstu sarve| manthasya pAne yavabhAvanAyAM syurbhojane pAnavidhau pRuthak ca||33||
siddhAni tailAni ghRutAni caiva deyAni meheShvanilAtmakeShu| medaH kaphashcaiva kaShAyayogaiH snehaishca vAyuH shamameti teShAm||34||
kampillasaptacchadashAlajAni baibhItarauhItakakauTajAni| kapitthapuShpANi ca cUrNitAni kShaudreNa lihyAt kaphapittamehI||35||
pibedrasenAmalakasya cApi kalkIkRutAnyakShasamAni kAle| jIrNe ca bhu~jjIta purANamannaM mehI rasairjA~ggalajairmanoj~jaiH||36||
dRuShTvA~anubandhaM pavanAt kaphasya pittasya vA snehavidhirvikalpyaH| tailaM kaphe syAt svakaShAyasiddhaM pitte ghRutaM pittaharaiH kaShAyaiH||37||
trikaNTakAshmantakasomavalkairbhallAtakaiH sAtiviShaiH salodhraiH| vacApaTolArjunanimbamustairharidrayA padmakadIpyakaishca||38||
ma~jjiShThayA cAgurucandanaishca sarvaiH samastaiH kaphavAtajeShu| meheShu tailaM vipaced, ghRutaM tu paitteShu, mishraM triShu lakShaNeShu||39||
phalatrikaM dArunishAM vishAlAM mustAM ca niHkvAthya nishAM sakalkAm| pibet kaShAyaM madhusamprayuktaM sarvaprameheShu samuddhateShu||40||
lodhraM shaTIM puShkaramUlamelAM mUrvAM viDa~ggaM triphalAM yamAnIm| cavyaM priya~gguM kramukaM vishAlAM kirAtatiktaM kaTurohiNIM ca||41||
bhAr~ggIM nataM citrakapippalInAM mUlaM sakuShThAtiviShaM sapATham| kali~ggakan kesharamindrasAhvAM nakhaM sapatraM maricaM plavaM ca||42||
droNe~ambhasaH karShasamAni paktvA pUte caturbhAgajalAvasheShe| rase~ardhabhAgaM madhunaH pradAya pakShaM nidheyo ghRutabhAjanasthaH||43||
madhvAsavo~ayaM kaphapittamehAn kShipraM nihanyAddvipalaprayogAt| pANDvAmayArshAMsyaruciM grahaNyA doShaM kilAsaM vividhaM ca kuShTham||44||
iti madhvAsavaH

iti madhvAsavaH kvAthaH sa evAShTapalaM ca dantyA bhallAtakAnAM ca catuShpalaM syAt| sitopalA tvaShTapalA visheShaH kShaudraM ca tAvat pRuthagAsavau tau||45||

Commentary: kvAthaH sa eveti tAvanmAnajalenaiva dantyaShTapalaM bhallAtakacatuHpalaM lodhrAdIni ca karShamAnAni dattvA kvAthaH kartavya ityarthaH| kShaudraM ca tAvaditi kvAthApekShayA~aShTabhAgamityarthaH||45||

AsyAsukhaM svapnasukhaM dadhIni grAmyaudakAnUparasAH payAMsi| navAnnapAnaM guDavaikRutaM ca pramehahetuH kaphakRucca sarvam||4||

Commentary: AsyAsukhamiti sukhajanikA AsyA na duHkhajanikA, evaM svapnasukhaM ca j~jeyaM; shayyAdidoSheNa duHkhasvapnaM duHkhAsyA ca na pramehahetuH| guDavaikRutaM guDakRutA bhakShyAH||4||
sArodakaM vA~atha kushodakaM vA madhUdakaM vA triphalArasaM vA| sIdhuM pibedvA nigadaM pramehI mAdhvIkamagryaM cirasaMsthitaM vA||46||
mAMsAni shUlyAni mRugadvijAnAM khAdedyavAnAM vividhAMshca bhakShyAn| saMshodhanAriShTakaShAyalehaiH santarpaNotthA~j shamayet pramehAn||47||
bhRuShTAn yavAn bhakShayataH prayogAcchuShkAMshca saktUnna bhavanti mehAH| shvitraM ca kRucchraM kaphajaM ca kuShThaM tathaiva mudgAmalakaprayogAn||48||

santarpaNottheShu gadeShu yogA medasvinAM ye ca mayopadiShTAH| virUkShaNArthaM kaphapittajeShu siddhAH prameheShvapi te prayojyAH||49||

Commentary: santarpaNottheShu gadeShu yogA santarpaNIyAdhyAye “triphalAragvadhaM pAThAM” (sU.a.23) ityAdyuktAH||49||

vyAyAmayogairvividhaiH pragADhairudvartanaiH snAnajalAvasekaiH| sevyatvagelAgurucandanAdyairvilepanaishcAshu na santi mehAH||50||

Commentary: sevyam ushIram| candanAdyairityatra AdigrahaNena hi shaileyAdInAM grahaNaM syAt||50||

kledashca medashca kaphashca vRuddhaH pramehahetuH prasamIkShya tasmAt| vaidyena pUrvaM kaphapittajeShu meheShu kAryANyapatarpaNAni||51||

Commentary: sampratyutsargataH kaphapittapramehANAmapatarpaNamAha- kledashcetyAdi| yadyapyapatarpaNena gulmAdidoSho bhavati, tathA~api gulmAdiprAdurbhAvo yathA na bhavettathA~apatarpaNaM kartavyamiti kledashca medashcetyAdinA darshayati||51||

yA vAtamehAn prati pUrvamuktA vAtolbaNAnAM vihitA kriyA sA| vAyurhi meheShvatikarshitAnAM kupyatyasAdhyAn prati nAsti cintA||52||

Commentary: pUrvacikitsite yAni “siddhAni tailAni ghRutAni caiva deyAni meheShvanilAtmakeShu” ityAdinoktAni, tAni vAtAnubaddhamehaviShayANIti darshayannAha- yA vAtamehAnityAdi| vAtolbaNatvameva kutaH kaphajeShu pittajeShu ca bhavatItyAha- vAyurityAdi| asAdhyAniti utpattitaH||52||

yairhetubhirye prabhavanti mehAsteShu prameheShu na te niShevyAH| hetorasevA vihitA yathaiva jAtasya rogasya bhaveccikitsA||53||

Commentary: yairhetubhirityAdishlokArthaparibhAShA sarvarogeShvevAnumatA, iha pramehasya cirakAlAnubandhitayA hetusevAnirAsArthamucyate||53||

hAridravarNaM rudhiraM ca mUtraM vinA pramehasya hi pUrvarUpaiH| yo mUtrayettaM na vadet pramehaM raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaH||54||

Commentary: samprati pramehalakShaNasya raktapittalakShaNasAmye raktapitte pramehacikitsA mA bhUditi kRutvA prameharaktapittabhedakaM lakShaNamAha- hAridravarNamityAdi||54||

dRuShTvA pramehaM madhuraM sapicchaM madhUpamaM syAddvividho vicAraH| kShINeShu doSheShvanilAtmakaH syAt santarpaNAdvA kaphasambhavaH syAt||55||

Commentary: dRuShTvetyAdi| kShINeShu doSheShviti kShINeShu kaphamedaHprabhRutiShu| doShatvaM ceha dUShye medaAdAvavivakShitaM, tathA~api doShasambandhAddoShashabdo~atra j~jeyaH; kiMvA doSheShviti kaphapitteShu; dvayoshca bahuvacanaM vyaktyapekShayA bahutvAt| yadi hi vAtikaH syAttadA hetvabhAvAt kapho~avRuddhaH syAdityarthaH; santarpaNAttu yadi j~jAtaM tarpaNajanitakaphavRuddhatvaM, tadA vAtanidAnAbhAvAnnAyaM vAtajaH kintu kaphaja ityavadhAryata iti bhAvaH||55||

sapUrvarUpAH kaphapittamehAH krameNa ye vAtakRutAshca mehAH| sAdhyA na te, pittakRutAstu yApyAH, sAdhyAstu medo yadi na praduShTam||56||

Commentary: sampratyuktAnuktapramehANAM sAdhyAsAdhyayApyatvopadarshanArthamAha- sapUrvarUpA ityAdi| saha pUrvarUpeNa “svedo~a~ggagandhaH” ityAdinA vartanta iti sapUrvarUpAH| tatra kaphamehAH sAdhyA uktAste pUrvarUpeNa saha vartamAnA asAdhyA bhavanti, pittamehA yApyA uktAste pratyAkhyeyA bhavanti| sAdhyAvasthAyAmapi pUrvarUpayogena yadyapi sarvarogANAmasAdhyatvamuktam, uktaM ca yathA- “anyasyApi ca rogasya pUrvarUpANi yaM naram| vishantyanena kalpena tasyApi maraNaM dhruvam” (i.a.5) iti; tatra sarvapUrvarUpAnubandhe sarvarogANAmasAdhyatvamuktam, iha tu asamastapUrvarUpAnubandhe~apyasAdhyatvaM bhavatIti visheShavacanAllabhyate| tathA krameNa ca ye vAtakRutAste pUrvarUparahitA apyasAdhyAH| krameNeti yathoktanidAnakrameNa| etena ya eva nidAnoktAhetvAdiyogena vAtajAshcatvAro jAyante te mehA asAdhyAH; ye tu kaphajAH pittajA vA vAtAnubandhatvena vAtajAste sAdhyA yApyA vA| ata eva tAn prati “siddhAni tailAni ghRutAni caiva deyAni meheShvanilAtmakeShu” ityanena cikitsoktA| pUrvarUparAhityena pittakRute pramehe kadAcit sAdhyatvamapi bhavatItyapavAdavidhiM darshayitumutsargaprAptAM paittikayApyatAmanuvadati- pittakRutAstu yApyA iti| avasthAsAdhyAn paittikAnAha- sAdhyAstvityAdi| na praduShTamiti na prakarSheNa duShTam; aduShTamedasaH paittikAH sAdhyA bhavantItyarthaH| kiMvA praduShTAH kaphapittamehAstAvadasAdhyAH, tathA kaphapittamehA ye dhAtvapakarShaNAdvAtakRutA bhavanti te~api sapUrvarUpAH santo~asAdhyA bhavanti| ye tu pUrvarUpatvena kiyantaHshirasIyoktaM pramehaM viMshatipramehAtiriktaM varNayanti, te “viMshatireva mehAH” iti sa~gkhyAniyamenaiva pratyAdiShTAH||56||
medashca mAMsaM ca sharIrajaM ca kledaM kapho bastigataM pradUShya| karoti mehAn samudIrNamuShNaistAneva pittaM paridUShya cApi||5||
kShINeShu doSheShvavakRuShya bastau dhAtUn pramehAnanilaH karoti| doSho hi bastiM samupetya mUtraM sandUShya mehA~jjanayedyathAsvam||6||

sAdhyAH kaphotthA dasha, pittajAH ShaT yApyA, na sAdhyaH pavanAccatuShkaH| samakriyatvAdviShamakriyatvAnmahAtyayatvAcca yathAkramaM te||7||

Commentary: samakriyatvAditi kaphasya doShasya dUShyasya medaHprabhRuteH samAnatvAt kaTutiktAdikriyAyAH| viShamakriyatvAditi pittasya saMshamanacikitsAyAH kaTvAdirUpAyA viShamatvAt| mahAtyayatvAditi majjAdigambhIradhAtvapakarShakatvena mahAvyApattikartRukatvAdAshukAritvAcca; cakArAnnidAnoktaM viShamakriyatvaM vAtAtmakAnAM samuccinoti| yathAkramamiti yathAsa~gkhyam||7||

kaphaH sapittaH pavanashca doShA medo~asrashukrAmbuvasAlasIkAH| majjA rasaujaH pishitaM ca dUShyAH pramehiNAM, viMshatireva mehAH||8||

Commentary: kapha ityAdinA sarvamehAnAM doShadUShyasa~ggrahamAha| rasashca ojashceti rasaujaH, ojaso~api madhumehe dUShyatvAt| yadyapi medaHprabhRutayo dUShyA iha ucyante, tathA~api medomAMsasharIrakledAnAmavashyambhAvitayA parigrahaH| majjAdayashca sarvamehe na punaravashyaM dUShyante, stokaM vA duShTA bhavanti; kiMvA sarvamehAnAmeva tridoShatvaM tathA sakaladUShyatvaM ca ‘kaphaH sapitta’ ityAdinA granthenocyate; medomAMsAdIni tvatyarthadUShyopadarshanArthaM pRuthaguktAni; yataH kiyantaHshirasIye sakalamehavAcakaM madhumehaM kathayatA doShatrayaprakopo~apyuktaH| tathAhi- “samArutasya pittasya kaphasya ca muhurmuhuH| darshayatyAkRutiM gatvA kShayamApyAyate punaH” (sU.a.17) ityuktaM; tathA sushruto~apyAha- “vAtapittamedobhiranvitaH shleShmA mehA~jjanayati” (su. ni.a.6) iti| kaphAdInAM dvyulbaNAdisaMsargasyAnantyenAdhikapramehasa~gkhyAprasaktinirAsArthamAha- viMshatireva mehA iti||8||
jalopamaM cekShurasopamaM vA ghanaM ghanaM copari viprasannam| shuklaM sashukraM shishiraM shanairvA lAleva vA vAlukayA yutaM vA||9||
vidyAt pramehAn kaphajAn dashaitAn kShAropamaM kAlamathApi nIlam| hAridramA~jjiShThamathApi raktametAn pramehAn ShaDushanti pittAt||10||
majjaujasA vA vasayA~anvitaM vA lasIkayA vA satataM vibaddham| caturvidhaM mUtrayatIha vAtAccheSheShu dhAtuShvapakarShiteShu||11||

varNaM rasaM sparshamathApi gandhaM yathAsvadoShaM bhajate pramehaH| shyAvAruNo vAtakRutaH sashUlo majjAdisAdguNyamupaityasAdhyaH||12||

Commentary: sa~gkShepeNa kaphajAdipramehalakShaNamAha- varNamityAdi| tatra kaphaje shveto varNo, madhuro rasaH, shItaH sparshaH, Amashca gandho bhavati| evaM pittamehe~api j~jeyAH| vAyostvatinirvarNatvena prAbhAvikaM kAyavarNamAha- shyAvAruNa ityAdi| majjAdisAdguNyaM majjalasIkAdisamAnaguNatAM yAti| yadyapi vAtiko meho~asAdhya evoktastathA~api punarihAsAdhyavacanena ya eva utpattitaH prabhUtAkRutiH sa eva shyAvAruNatvAdi sakalaM lakShaNaM bibharti; yastUttarakAlaM cAnubaddhaH sa sAdhyo bhavati; tatra majjAdisAdguNyaM nAvashyaM bhavatIti darshayati| kiMvottarakAlameva ye vAtAnubandhAH shyAvAruNavarNAdiyuktA bhavanti te~apyasAdhyA bhavantIti| tathA kaphapittajA api majjAdiyogAdasAdhyA eva; uktaM ca- “sarva eva pramehAstu kAlenApratikAriNaH| madhumehatvamAyAnti tadA~asAdhyA bhavanti hi” (su. ni. a. 6)||12||
svedo~a~ggagandhaH shithilA~ggatA ca shayyAsanasvapnasukhe ratishca| hRunnetrajihvAshravaNopadeho ghanA~ggatA keshanakhAtivRuddhiH||13||
shItapriyatvaM galatAlushoSho mAdhuryamAsye karapAdadAhaH| bhaviShyato mehagadasya rUpaM mUtre~abhidhAvanti pipIlikAshca||14||
sthUlaH pramehI balavAnihaikaH kRushastathaikaH paridurbalashca| sambRuMhaNaM tatra kRushasya kAryaM saMshodhanaM doShabalAdhikasya||15||
snigdhasya yogA vividhAH prayojyAH kalpopadiShTA malashodhanAya | UrdhvaM tathA~adhashca male~apanIte meheShu santarpaNameva kAryam||16||
gulmaH kShayo mehanabastishUlaM mUtragrahashcApyapatarpaNena| pramehiNaH syuH, paritarpaNAni kAryANi tasya prasamIkShya vahnim||17||

jAtaH pramehI madhumehino vA na sAdhya uktaH sa hi bIjadoShAt| ye cApi kecit kulajA vikArA bhavanti tAMshca pravadantyasAdhyAn||57||

Commentary: mehAnAmasAdhyatAprakArAntaramAha- jAta ityAdi| pramehI yaH pramehiNo jAtaH so~apyasAdhyo bhavati| atrApi hetumAha- sa hi bIjadoShAditi; pramehArambhakadoShaduShTabIjajAtapramehitvAt| madhumehashabdenAtra mehamAtramucyate, yadi tu vAtika upekShito vA meho madhumeha ucyate, tadetarapramehayuktamAtApitRujanitapramehiNo nAsAdhyatvaM syAt| ki~jca madhumehino janitasya madhumehitvameva kAraNAnurUpatayA yuktam| tatashca madhumehI madhumehino vA jAto na sAdhya iti vaktumucitam| tasmAdapatye sAmAnyena pramehavacanenApi tatkAraNe pitari kAryAnurUpaH prameho madhumehashabdavAcyo j~jeyaH| mehashabdo~ayaM sAmAnyena sarvameheShu vartata eva, yataH kiyantaHshirasIye yA piDakA madhumehasambandhitvenoktAstA iha “pramehiNAM yA piDakA” ityanena sAmAnyapramehasambandhitayA~anuditAH, tasmAnmadhumehashabdaH sarvapramehe madhumehavisheShe ca vartate; yathA tRuNashabdaH sarvatRuNe tRuNavisheShe ca vartate| prapa~jcitashcAyamarthaH kiyantaHshirasIye iti neha pratanyate| kulajapramehAsAdhyatAprasa~ggenApareShAmapyasAdhyatAmAha- ye cApItyAdi| kulajA iti pitRupitAmahAdikAraNodbhUtAH| anenaiva sAmAnyena vacanena pramehasyApi kulajasyAsAdhyatAyAM siddhAyAM punastadvacanaM santAnAnubandhitvopadarshanArtham| uktaM hi- “prameho~anusa~gginAm” (sU.a.25) iti||57||

pramehiNAM yAH piDakA mayoktA rogAdhikAre pRuthageva sapta| tAH shalyavidbhiH kushalaishcikitsyAH shastreNa saMshodhanaropaNaishca||58||

Commentary: pramehapiDakAcikitsAsUtramAha- pramehiNAmityAdi| rogAdhikAre iti rogacatuShke| atra shalyAdhikAratvena “anyAdhikAreShu na vistaroktiH” (ci.a.26) iti vacanAnna vistaraH kRutaH||58||
tatra shlokAH- heturdoSho dUShyaM mehAnAM sAdhyatAnurUpashca| mehI dvividhastrividhaM bhiShagjitamatikShapaNadoShaH||59||
AdyA yavAnnavikRutirmanthA mehApahAH kaShAyAshca| tailaghRutalehayogA bhakShyAH pravarAsavAH siddhAH||60||
vyAyAmavidhirvividhaH snAnAnyudvartanAni gandhAshca| mehAnAM prashamArthaM cikitsite diShTametAvat||61||
nidAnoktasambandhakramAdeva gulmacikitsitAdanu mehacikitsitamucyate||1-2||

kShuNNashuShkayavAnAM maNDarahita odano yavaudanaH| vATyaH sa eva samaNDo nistuSheddalitAnAM yavAnAM bhavati| atasI khyAtA, ye tilAtasIti paThanti teShAM mate tilarUpA~atasI(?) vivakShitA| tRuNadhAnyAni shyAmAkAdIni| apUpAn yavapiShTakRutAn| dhAnAn bhRuShTayavAn| veNuyavA yavAkArANi vaMshabIjAnItyarthaH||18-24||

dArvImityAdyuktaM yogadvayaM sarvameheShu| surAhvaH devadAru| harItakyAdayo dasha yathAsa~gkhyaM kaphameheShu; kiMvA sarve sarvakaphameheShu, ushIrAdyuktAshca pittameheShu sarveShu j~jeyAH| kaTa~gkaTerI dAruharidrA| manthasya pAne iti manthapAnArthaM, bhojane iti bhojyasaMskAre, evaM pAnasaMskAre~api| siddhAni tailAnIti etaireva kaShAyaiH siddhAni| anilAtmakeShviti kaphapittameheShvevavAtAnubandheShu, utpattivishiShTAnilajAnAmasAdhyatvenAcikitsyatvAt||26-34||
kaphapittamehIti kaphamehI pittamehI ca| kalkIkRutAnIti kampillakAdInyeva kalkIkRutAni||35-36||

anubandhamiti pashcAdanugatam| tailaM kaphe syAt svakaShAyasiddhamiti kaphe kaphAnubandhe ca kaphaghnauShadhakaShAyaiH siddhaM tailaM syAt, evaM pitte pittAnubandhe ca pittaghnauShadhakaShAyasiddhaM ghRutaM deyaM syAt| sarvairityukte pRuthagapi sarvaiH snehasAdhanaM syAdata Aha- samastairiti ; militairityarthaH| mishramiti tailaghRutayamakam| triShu lakShaNeShviti tridoShalakShaNamelake sati; tridoShajatvamanubandhyAnubandhakRutaM kaphapittajameheShveva mantavyaM; ki~jca sarveShAmeva mehAnAM tridoShajatvAdudbhUtatridoShajatvaM kadAcidbhavatIti j~jeyam||37-40||
lodhramityAdau kramukaM paTTikAlodhraM pUgaM vA| indrasAhvAm indravAruNIm||41-44||

sArodakamiti sAraiH khadirAdisAraiH ShaDa~ggavidhinA kRutamudakaM sArodakaM j~jeyam, evaM kushodakaM j~jeyam| madhunA madhurIkRutamudakaM madhUdakam| shUlyAnIti shUlapakvAnItyarthaH | mRugadvijAnAmityatra yaugikatvAjjA~ggalamRugadvijAnAmiti j~jeyam| prayogAditi abhyAsAt||46-48||

medashca mAMsaM cetyAdinA kaphajAdimehasamprAptiH| kaphajA eva mehA bhUyastvena sAdhyatvena cAdAvucyante| kShINeShviti kaphapitteShu, dvayoshca bahuvacanaM vyaktyapekShayA j~jeyam; kShINeShviti vRuddhavAtApekShayA kShINeShu; tena vRuddhe kaphe pitte vA yo vAyuH krameNa vRuddho bhavati sa nehAsAdhyamehacatuShTayakaraNe vivakShita iti darshayati , tatra cikitsAvidhAnAt sAdhyatvamasti- “yA vAtamehAn pratipUrvamuktA vAtolbaNAnAM vihitA kriyA sA| vAyurhi meheShvatikarshitAnAM kupyatyasAdhyAn prati nAsti cintA” iti| dhAtUniti majjaujolasIkAkhyAn| sarvamehAnAM sAmAnyasamprAptimAha- doSho hItyAdi||5-6||

jalopamamityAdinA dashabhiH shleShmaguNaiH kRutAn dashapramehAnAha| etacca nidAne sphuTamanusartavyam| ghanaM copari viprasannamityanena sAndraprasAdamehamAha| majjayA majjamehaH, ojasA madhumehaH, vasayA vasAmehaH, lasikayA hastimeha iti j~jeyAH| sheSheShviti medaHprabhRutiShu rasAdyuktadhAtuvyatirikteShu| apakarShiteShviti kShINeShu; kShayasteShAM pramehArambhakeNa vAtenaiva, upoShaNAdibhiH karshanAdvA kriyate||9-11||
svedo~a~ggagandha ityAdinA pUrvarUpamAha||13-14||
paridurbalaH hInabalaH| kRushasya iti mAMsakRushasya| doShabalAdhikasya doSheNa balena cAdhikasya| kShayaH dhAtukShayaH||15-17||
heturityAdiH sa~ggrahaH| trividhaM bhiShagjitamiti saMshodhanaM, saMshamanaM nidAnavarjanaM ca| AdyA iti bhakShaNIyAH| sheShaM sugamam||59-61||
athAtaH kuShThacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

hetuM dravyaM li~ggaM kuShThAnAmAshrayaM prashamanaM ca| shRuNvagnivesha! samyagvisheShataH sparshanaghnAnAm||3||

Commentary: nidAne hetvAdaya uktA api cikitsopakaraNatayA ki~jcidvisheShapratipAdanArthaM punarucyante| Ashrayamiti AdhAram| prashamanaM ceti cakArAt pUrvarUpasamprAptyorvakShyamANayorgrahaNaM; kiMvA li~ggena pUrvarUpaM, hetunA ca samprAptirboddhavyA| anyAnyapi pipluvya~ggAdIni sparshanaghnAni santi, tena visheShato yAni kuShThAni sparshanaghnAni teShAM hetvAdIni shRuNu; kiMvA kuShThAnAmanantyAdyAni visheShataH sparshanaghnAnyaShTAdasha teShAM hetvAdi shRuNviti yojanA| uktaM hi- “kuShThAni saptavidhAnyaShTAdashavidhAnyaparisa~gkhyeyavidhAni ca” (ni.a.5) iti||3||

ata UrdhvamaShTAdashAnAM kuShThAnAM kapAlodumbaramaNDalarShyajihvapuNDarIkasidhmakAkaNakaikakuShThacarmAkhya- kiTimavipAdikAlasakadadrucarmadalapAmAvisphoTakashatArurvicarcikAnAM lakShaNAnyupadekShyAmaH||13||
kRuShNAruNakapAlAbhaM yadrUkShaM paruShaM tanu| kApAlaM todabahulaM tatkuShThaM viShamaM smRutam||14||
dAhakaNDUrujArAgaparItaM lomapi~jjaram| udumbaraphalAbhAsaM kuShThamaudumbaraM viduH||15||
shvetaM raktaM sthiraM styAnaM snigdhamutsannamaNDalam| kRucchramanyonyasaMsaktaM kuShThaM maNDalamucyate||16||
karkashaM raktaparyantamantaH shyAvaM savedanam| yadRuShyajihvAsaMsthAnamRuShyajihvaM taducyate||17||
sashvetaM raktaparyantaM puNDarIkadalopamam| sotsedhaM ca sadAhaM ca puNDarIkaM taducyate||18||
shvetaM tAmraM tanu ca yadrajo ghRuShTaM vimu~jcati| alAbUpuShpavarNaM tat sidhmaM prAyeNa corasi||19||
yat kAkaNantikAvarNamapAkaM tIvravedanam| tridoShali~ggaM tat kuShThaM kAkaNaM naiva sidhyati||20||
iti saptamahAkuShThAni
asvedanaM mahAvAstu yanmatsyashakalopamam| tadekakuShTaM, carmAkhyaM bahalaM hasticarmavat||21||
shyAvaM kiNakharasparshaM paruShaM kiTimaM smRutam| vaipAdikaM pANipAdasphuTanaM tIvravedanam||22||
kaNDUmadbhiH sarAgaishca gaNDairalasakaM citam| sakaNDUrAgapiDakaM dadrumaNDalamudgatam||23||
raktaM sakaNDu sasphoTaM sarugdalati cApi yat| taccarmadalamAkhyAtaM saMsparshAsahamucyate||24||
pAmAshvetAruNashyAvAH kaNDUlAH piDakA bhRusham| sphoTAH shvetAruNAbhAso visphoTAH syustanutvacaH||25||
raktaM shyAvaM sadAhArti shatAruH syAdbahuvraNam| sakaNDUH piDakA shyAvA bahusrAvA vicarcikA||26||
ityekAdasha kShudrakuShThAni
virodhInyannapAnAni dravasnigdhagurUNi ca| bhajatAmAgatAM chardiM vegAMshcAnyAnpratighnatAm||4||
vyAyAmamatisantApamatibhuktvopasevinAm| shItoShNala~gghanAhArAn kramaM muktvA niSheviNAm||5||
gharmashramabhayArtAnAM drutaM shItAmbusevinAm| ajIrNAdhyashinAM caiva pa~jcakarmApacAriNAm||6||
navAnnadadhimatsyAtilavaNAmlaniSheviNAm| mAShamUlakapiShTAnnatilakShIraguDAshinAm||7||
vyavAyaM cApyajIrNe~anne nidrAM ca bhajatAM divA| viprAn gurUn dharShayatAM pApaM karma ca kurvatAm||8||
vAte~adhikatare kuShThaM kApAlaM maNDalaM kaphe| pitte tvaudumbaraM vidyAt kAkaNaM tu tradoShajam||27||
vAtapitte shleShmapitte vAtashleShmaNi cAdhike| RuShyajihvaM puNDarIkaM sidhmakuShThaM ca jAyate||28||
carmAkhyamekakuShThaM ca kiTimaM savipAdikam| kuShThaM cAlasakaM j~jeyaM prAyo vAtakaphAdhikam||29||
pAmA shatArurvisphoTaM dadrushcarmadalaM tathA| pittashleShmAdhikaM prAyaH kaphaprAyA vicarcikA||30||
sarvaM tridoShajaM kuShThaM doShANAM tu balAbalam| yathAsvairlakShaNairbuddhvA kuShThAnAM kriyate kriyA||31||
doShasya yasya pashyet kuShTheShu visheShali~ggamadriktam| tasyaiva shamaM kuryAttataH paraM cAnubandhasya||32||

kuShThavisheShairdoShA doShavisheShaiH punashca kuShThAni| j~jAyante tairheturhetustAMshca prakAshayati||33||

Commentary: samprati doshavisheShajAtasya kuShThavisheShasya tathA kuShThajanakasya ca hetoH parasparabodhakatvamAha- kuShThavisheShairityAdi| kuShThavisheShairdoShA iti kuShThavisheShaiH kApalAdibhirdoShA vAtAdayo j~jAyante; tathA doShavisheShaiH punaH kuShThAniti vAtAdhiko~ayaM paittiko~ayamiti kuShThadoShe parij~jAte doShavisheShaj~jAnAdvishiShTAni kuShThAni j~jAyante; yathA- idaM vAtottaraM kuShThaM, tasmAt kApAlam; idaM pittAdhikatvAnmaNDalamityAdi| tathA yaH kuShTheShvaparij~jAto hetuH sa doShavisheShairj~jAyate; yathA- kuShThaM vAtottaraM dRuShTvA vAtottarakuShThajanakAni rUkShaviruddhAshanAdIni kAraNAni j~jAyante| hetubhishca doShavisheShajanakaiH kuShThAni j~jAyante, yasmAdanena vAtottarakuShThajanakaM sevitaM tasmAdasya vAtottaraM kApAlaM kuShThaM bhaviShyatIti| kiMvA kuShThAdoShayoranyonyagamakatvaM kAryakAraNatayA parasparagamakatvAdupapannamiti darshayannAha- tairiti; taiH kuShThaiH kAryarUpairheturnAma doShaH anumIyate, hetushca doSharUpastAn kAryarUpakuShThavisheShAnavagamayatItyarthaH||33||
raukShyaM shoShastodaH shUlaM sa~gkocanaM tathA~a~ayAmaH| pAruShyaM kharabhAvo harShaH shyAvAruNatvaM ca||34||
kuShTheShu vAtali~ggaM, dAho rAgaH parisravaH pAkaH| visro gandhaH kledastathA~a~ggapatanaM ca pittakRutam||35||
shvaityaM shaityaM kaNDUH sthairyaM cotsedhagauravasnehAH| kuShTheShu tu kaphali~ggaM jantubhirabhibhakShaNaM kledaH||36||
sarvairli~ggairyuktaM matimAn vivarjayedabalam| tRuShNAdAhaparItaM shAntAgniM jantubhirjagdham||37||
vAtakaphaprabalaM yadyadekadoSholbaNaM na tat kRucchram| kaphapitta-vAtapittaprabalAni tu kRucchrasAdhyAni||38||
vAtottareShu sarpirvamanaM shleShmottareShu kuShTheShu| pittottareShu mokSho raktasya virecanaM cAgre||39||
vamanavirecanayogAH kalpoktAH kuShThinAM prayoktavyAH| pracchanamalpe kuShThe mahati ca shastaM sirAvyadhanam||40||
bahudoShaH saMshodhyaH kuShThI bahusho~anurakShatA prANAn| doShe hyatimAtrahRute vAyurhanyAdabalamAshu||41||
snehasya pAnamiShTaM shuddhe koShThe pravAhite rakte| vAyurhi shuddhakoShThaM kuShThinamabalaM vishati shIghram||42||
vAtAdayastrayo duShTAstvagraktaM mAMsamambu ca| dUShayanti sa kuShThAnAM saptako dravyasa~ggrahaH||9||
ataH kuShThAni jAyante sapta caikAdashaiva ca| na caikadoShajaM ki~jcit kuShThaM samupalabhyate||10||
doShotkliShTe hRudaye vAmyaH kuShTheShu cordhvabhAgeShu| kuTajaphalamadanamadhukaiH sapaTolairnimbarasayuktaiH||43||
shItarasaH pakvaraso madhUni madhukaM ca vamanAni| kuShTheShu trivRutA dantI triphalA ca virecane shastA||44||
sauvIrakaM tuShodakamAloDanamAsavAshca sIdhUni| shaMsantyadhoharANAM yathAvirekaM kramashceShTaH||45||
dArvIbRuhatIsevyaiH paTolapicumardamadanakRutamAlaiH| sasnehairAsthApyaH kuShThI sakali~ggayavamustaiH||46||
vAtolbaNaM viriktaM nirUDhamanuvAsanArhamAlakShya| phalamadhukanimbakuTajaiH sapaTolaiH sAdhayetsneham||47||
saindhavadantImaricaM phaNijjhakaH pippalI kara~jjaphalam| nasyaM syAtsaviDa~ggaM krimikuShThakaphaprakopaghnam ||48||
vairecanikairdhUmaiH shlokasthAneritaiH prashAmyanti| kRumayaH kuShThakilAsAH prayojitairuttamA~ggasthAH||49||
sthirakaThinamaNDalAnAM svinnAnAM prastarapraNADIbhiH| kUrcairvighaTTitAnAM raktotklesho~apanetavyaH||50||
AnUpavArijAnAM mAMsAnAM poTTalaiH sukhoShNaishca| svinnotsannaM vilikhet kuShThaM tIkShNena shastreNa||51||
rudhirAgamArthamathavA shRu~ggAlAbUni yojayet kuShThe| pracchitamalpaM kuShThaM virecayedvA jalaukobhiH||52||
ye lepAH kuShThAnAM yujyante nirhRutAsradoShANAm| saMshodhitAshayAnAM sadyaH siddhirbhavetteShAm||53||
yeShu na shastraM kramate sparshendriyanAshanAni yAni syuH| teShu nipAtyaH kShAro raktaM doShaM ca visrAvya||54||
pAShANakaThinaparuShe supte kuShThe sthire purANe ca| pItAgadasya kAryo viShaiH pradeho~agadaishcAnu||55||
stabdhAni suptasuptAnyasvedanakaNDulAni kuShThAni| kUrcairdantItrivRutAkaravIrakara~jjakuTajAnAm||56||
jAtyarkanimbajairvA patraiH shastraiH samudraphenairvA| ghRuShTAni gomayairvA tataH pradehaiH pradehyAni||57||
sparshAj~jatvamatisvedo na vA vaivarNyamunnatiH| koThAnAM lomaharShashca kaNDUstodaH shramaH klamaH||11||
vraNAnAmadhikaM shUlaM shIghrotpattishcirasthitiH| dAhaH suptA~ggatA ceti kuShThalakShaNamagrajam||12||
mArutakaphakuShThaghnaM karmoktaM pittakuShThinAM kAryam| kaphapittaraktaharaNaM tiktakaShAyaiH prashamanaM ca||58||
sarpIMShi tiktakAni ca yaccAnyadraktapittanut karma| bAhyAbhyantaramagryaM tat kAryaM pittakuShTheShu||59||
doShAdhikyavibhAgAdityetat karma kuShThanut proktam| vakShyAmi kuShThashamanaM prAyastvagdoShasAmAnyAt||60||
dArvI rasA~jjanaM vA gomUtreNa prabAdhate kuShTham| abhayA prayojitA vA mAsaM savyoShaguDatailA||61||
mUlaM paTolasya tathA gavAkShyAH pRuthak palAMshaM triphalAtvacashca | syAttrAyamANA kaTurohiNI ca bhAgArdhikA nAgarapAdayuktA||62||
palaM tathaiShAM saha cUrNitAnAM jale shRutaM doShaharaM pibennA| jIrNe rasairdhanvamRugadvijAnAM purANashAlyodanamAdadIta||63||
kuShThAni shophaM grahaNIpradoShamarshAMsi kRucchrANi halImakaM ca| ShaDrAtrayogena nihanti caiSha hRudbastishUlaM viShamajvaraM ca||64||
mustaM vyoShaM triphalA ma~jjiShThA dAru pa~jcamUlyau dve| saptacchadanimbatvak savishAlashcitrako mUrvA||65||
cUrNaM tarpaNabhAgairnavabhiH saMyojitaM samadhvAjyam | siddhaM kuShThanibarhaNametat prAyogikaM bhakShyam||66||
shvayathuM sapANDurogaM shvitraM grahaNIpradoShamarshAMsi| braghnabhagandarapiDakAkaNDUkoThAMshca vinihanti||67||
iti mustAdicUrNamtriphalAtiviShAkaTukAnimbakali~ggakavacApaTolAnAm| mAgadhikArajanIdvayapadmakamUrvAvishAlAnAm||68||
bhUnimbapalAshAnAM dadyAdvipalaM tatastrivRuddviguNA| tasyAshca punarbrAhmI taccUrNaM suptinut paramam||69||
lelItakaprayogo rasena jAtyAH samAkShikaH paramaH| saptadashakuShThaghAtI mAkShikadhAtushca mUtreNa||70||
shreShThaM gandhakayogAt suvarNamAkShikaprayogAdvA| sarvavyAdhinibarhaNamadyAt kuShThI rasaM ca nigRuhItam||71||
vajrashilAjatusahitaM sahitaM vA yogarAjena| sarvavyAdhiprashamanamadyAtkuShThI nigRuhya nityaM ca||72||
khadirasuradArusAraM shrapayitvA tadrasena toyArthaH| kShaudraprasthe kAryaH kArye te cAShTapalike ca||73||
tatrAshcUrNAnAmaShTapalaM prakShipettathA~amUni| triphalaile tva~gmaricaM patraM kanakaM ca karShAMsham||74||
matsyaNDikA madhusamA tanmAsaM jAtamAyase bhANDe| madhvAsavamAcarataH kuShThakilAse shamaM yAtaH||75||
khadirakaShAyadroNaM kumbhe ghRutabhAvite samAvApya| dravyANi cUrNitAni ca ShaTpalikAnyatra deyAni||76||
triphalAvyoShaviDa~ggarajanImustATarUShakendrayavAH| sauvarNI ca tathA tvak chinnaruhA ceti tanmAsam||77||
nidadhIta dhAnyamadhye prAtaH prAtaH pibettato yuktyA| mAsena mahAkuShThaM hantyevAlpaM tu pakSheNa||78||
arshaHshvAsabhagandarakAsakilAsapramehashoShAMshca| nA bhavati kanakavarNaH pItvA~ariShTaM kanakabindum||79||
iti kanakabindvariShTamkuShTheShvanilakaphakRuteShvevaM peyastathA~api paitteShu| kRutamAlakvAthashcApyeSha visheShAt kaphakRuteShu||80||

triphalAsavashca gauDaH sacitrakaH kuShTharogavinihantA| kramukadashamUladantIvarA~ggamadhuyogasaMyuktaH||81||

Commentary: triphalAsavashca gauDa ityAdau gauDa iti sharkarAsthAne guDena kRuto gauDaH| kramukaM hrakhapUgaphalaM, varA~ggaM guDatvak| atra triphalAdInAM mAne~anukte~api AsavAntaroktadravyamAnavibhAgena mAnaM grAhyam||81||
laghUni cAnnAni hitAni vidyAt kuShTheShu shAkani ca tiktakAni| bhallAtakaiH satriphalaiH sanimbairyuktAni cAnnAni ghRutAni caiva||82||
purANadhAnyAnyatha jA~ggalAni mAMsAni mudgAshca paTolayuktAH| shastA, na gurvamlapayodadhIni nAnUpamatsyA na guDastilAshca||83||
elA kuShThaM dArvI shatapuShpA citrako viDa~ggashca| kuShThAlepanamiShTaM rasA~jjanaM cAbhayA caiva||84||
citrakamelAM bimbIM vRuShakaM trivRudarkanAgarakam| cUrNIkRutamaShTAhaM bhAvayitavyaM palAshasya||85||
kShAreNa gavAM mUtrasrutena tenAsya maNDalAnyAshu| bhidyante vilayanti ca liptAnyarkAbhitaptAni||86||
mAMsI maricaM lavaNaM rajanI tagaraM sudhA gRuhAddhUmaH| mUtraM pittaM kShAraH pAlAshaH kuShThahA lepaH||87||
trapu sIsamayashcUrNaM maNDalanut phalgucitrakau bRuhatI| godhArasaH salavaNo dAru ca mUtraM ca maNDalanut||88||
kadalIpalAshapATaliniculakShArAmbhasA prasannena| mAMseShu toyakAryaM kAryaM piShTe ca kiNve ca||89||
tairmedakaH sujAtaH kiNvairjanitaM pralepanaM shastam| maNDalakuShThavinAshanamAtapasaMsthaM kRumighnaM ca||90||
mustaM madanaM triphalA kara~jja Aragvadhakali~ggayavAH| dArvI sasaptaparNA snAnaM siddhArthakaM nAma||91||
eSha kaShAyo vamanaM virecanaM varNakastathodgharShaH| tvagdoShakuShThashophaprabAdhanaH pANDurogaghnaH||92||
kuShThaM kara~jjabIjAnyeDagajaH kuShThasUdano lepaH| prapunnADabIjasaindhavarasA~jjanakapitthalodhrAshca||93||
shvetakaravIramUlaM kuTajakara~jjayoH phalaM tvaco dArvyAH| sumanaHpravAlayukto lepaH kuShThApahaH siddhaH||94||
lodhrasya dhAtakInAM vatsakabIjasya naktamAlasya| kalkashca mAlatInAM kuShTheShUnmardanAlepau||95||
shairIShI tvak puShpaM kArpAsyA rAjavRukShapatrANi| piShTA ca kAkamAcI caturvidhaH kuShThanullepaH||96||
iti lepAH dArvyA rasA~jjanasya ca nimbapaTolasya khadirasArasya| AragvadhavRukShakayostriphalAyAH saptaparNasya||97||
iti ShaT kaShAyayogAH kuShThaghnAH saptamashca tinishasya| snAne pAne ca hitAstathA~aShTamashcAshvamArasya||98||
AlepanaM pragharShaNamavacUrNanameta eva ca kaShAyAH| tailaghRutapAkayoge ceShyante kuShThashAntyartham||99||
triphalA nimbapaTolaM ma~jjiShThA rohiNI vacA rajanI| eSha kaShAyo~abhyasto nihanti kaphapittajaM kuShTham||100||
etaireva ca sarpiH siddhaM vAtolbaNaM jayati kuShTham| eSha ca kalpo diShTaH khadirAsanadArunimbAnAm||101||
kuShThArkatutthakaTphalamUlakabIjAni rohiNI kaTukA| kuTajaphalotpalamustaM bRuhatIkaravIrakAsIsam||102||
eDagajanimbapAThA durAlabhA citrako viDa~ggashca| tiktAlAbukabIjaM kampillakasarShapau vacA dArvI||103||
etaistailaM siddhaM kuShThaghnaM yoga eSha cAlepaH| udvartanaM pragharShaNamavacUrNanameSha eveShTaH||104||

shvetakaravIrakaraso gomUtraM citrako viDa~ggashca| kuShTheShu tailayogaH siddho~ayaM sammato bhiShajAm||105||

Commentary: shvetakaravIrarasa ityAdau karavIrarasagomUtrayordravatvaM, sheShasya kalkatvam||105||
iti shvetakaravIrAdyaM tailam shvetakaravIrapallavamUlatvagvatsako viDa~ggashca| kuShThArkamUlasarShapashigrutvagrohiNI kaTukA||106||
etaistailaM siddhaM kalkaiH pAdAMshikairgavAM mUtram| dattvA tailacaturguNamabhya~ggAt kuShThakaNDUghnam||107||
iti shvetakaravIrapallavAdyaM tailam tiktAlAbukabIjaM dve tutthe rocanA haridre dve| bRuhatIphalameraNDaH savishAlashcitrako mUrvA||108||
kAsIsahi~ggushigrutryUShaNasuradArutumburuviDa~ggam| lA~ggAlakaM kuTajatvak kaTukAkhyA rohiNI caiva||109||
sarShapatailaM kalkairetairmUtre caturguNe sAdhyam| kaNDUkuShThavinAshanamabhya~ggAnmArutakaphahantRu||110||
iti tiktekShvAkvAditailam kanakakShIrI shailA bhArgI dantyAH phalAni mUlaM ca| jAtIpravAlasarShapalashunaviDa~ggaM kara~jjatvak||111||
saptacchadArkapallavamUlatva~gnimbacitrakAsphotAH| gu~jjairaNDaM bRuhatImUlakasurasArjakaphalAni||112||
kuShThaM pAThA mustaM tumburumUrvAvacAH saShaDgranthAH | eDagajakuTajashigrutryUShaNabhallAtakakShavakAH||113||
haritAlamavAkpuShpI tutthaM kampillako~amRutAsa~jj~jaH| saurAShTrI kAsIsaM dArvItvak sarjikAlavaNam||114||
kalkairetaistailaM karavIrakamUlapallavakaShAye| sArShapamathavA tailaM gomUtracaturguNaM sAdhyam||115||
sthApyaM kaTukAlAbuni tatsiddhaM tena maNDalAnyAshu| bhindyAdbhiShagabhya~ggAtkRumIMshca kaNDUM ca vinihanyAt||116||
iti kanakakShIrItailam
kuShThaM tamAlapatraM maricaM samanaHshilaM sakAsIsam| tailena yuktamuShitaM saptAhaM bhAjane tAmre||117||
tenAliptaM sidhmaM saptAhAhyeti tiShThato gharme| mAsAnnavaM kilAsaM snAnaM muktvA vishuddhatanoH||118||
iti sidhme lepaH

sarShapakara~jjakoShAtakInAM tailAnyathe~ggudInAM ca| kuShTheShu hitAnyAhustailaM yaccApi khadirasArasya||119||

Commentary: sarShapakara~jjetyAdinA kuShTheShvannapAnasAdhane sArShapatailAdIni deyAnIti darshayati; anye tu kuShTheShu sAmAnyena tailashrutau sArShapAdInyeva deyAni na tilatailamityanena darshitamiti varNayanti||119||
jIvantI ma~jjiShThA dArvI kampillakaH payastuttham| eSha ghRutatailapAkaH siddhaH siddhe ca sarjarasaH||120||
deyaH samadhUcchiShTo vipAdikA tena shAmyate~abhyaktA| carmaikakuShThakiTimaM kuShThaM shAmyatyalasakaM ca||121||
iti vipAdikAharaghRutatailekiNvaM varAharudhiraM pRuthvIkA saindhavaM ca lepaH syAt| lepo yojyaH kustumburUNi kuShThaM ca maNDalanut||122||
pUtIkadArujaTilAH pakvasurA kShaudramudgaparNyau ca| lepaH sakAkanAso maNDalakuShThApahaH siddhaH||123||
citrakashobhA~jjanakau guDUcyapAmArgadevadArUNi| khadiro dhavashca lepaH shyAmA dantI dravantI ca||124||
lAkShArasA~jjanailAH punarnavA ceti kuShThino lepAH| dadhimaNDayutAH sarve deyAH ShaNmArutakaphakuShThaghnAH||125||
eDagajakuShThasaindhavasauvIrakasarShapaiH kRumighnaishca| kRumikuShThamaNDalAkhyaM dadrUkuShThaM ca shamamupaiti||126||
eDagajaH sarjaraso mUlakabIjaM ca sidhmakuShThAnAm| kA~jjikayuktaM tu pRutha~gmatamidamudvartanaM lepAH||127||
vAsA tiphalA pAne snAne codvartane pralepe ca| bRuhatIsevyapaTolAH sasArivA rohiNI caiva||128||
khadirAvaghAtakakubharohItakalodhrakuTajadhavanimbAH| saptacchadakaravIrAH shasyante snAnapAneShu||129||
jalavApyalohakesharapatraplavacandanaM mRuNAlAni| bhAgottarANi siddhaM pralepanaM pittakaphakuShThe||130||
yaShTyAhvalodhrapadmakapaTolapicumardacandanarasAshca| snAne pAne ca hitAH sushItalAH pittakuShThibhyaH||131||
AlepanaM priya~ggurhareNukA vatsakasya ca phalAni| sAtiviShA ca sasevyA sacandanA rohiNI kaTukA||132||
tiktaghRutairdhautaghRutairabhya~ggo dahyamAnakuShTheShu| tailaishcandanamadhukaprapauNDarIkotpalayutaishca||133||
klede prapatati cA~gge dAhe visphoTake sacarmadale| shItAH pradehasekA vyadho vireko ghRutaM tiktam||134||

khadiraghRutaM nimbaghRutaM dArvIghRutamuttamaM paTolaghRutam| kuShTheShu raktapittaprabaleShu bhiShagjitaM siddham||135||

Commentary: khadiraghRutamityAdau khadirAdibhirghRutAni sAdhyAni; tatra ca khadirasya sAraM, nimbasya tvak, paTolasya ca patraM grAhyaM, vRuddhavyavahArAt| uktaM ca- “sAraH syAt khadirAdInAM, nimbAdInAM tvacastathA| phalaM tu dADimAdInAM, paTolAderdalaM tathA” iti||135||
triphalAtvaco~ardhapalikAH paTolapatraM ca kArShikAH sheShAH| kaTurohiNI sanimbA yaShTyAhvA trAyamANA ca||136||
eSha kaShAyaH sAdhyo dattvA dvipalaM masUravidalAnAm| salilADhake~aShTabhAge sheShe pUto raso grAhyaH||137||
te ca kaShAye~aShTapale catuShpalaM sarpiShashca paktavyam| yAvatsyAdaShTapalaM sheShaM peyaM tataH koShNam||138||
tadvAtapittakuShThaM vIsarpaM vAtashoNitaM prabalam| jvaradAhagulmavidradhivibhramavisphoTakAn hanti||139||
nimbapaTolaM dArvIM durAlabhAM tiktarohiNIM triphalAm| kuryAdardhadalAMshaM parpaTakaM trAyamANAM ca||140||
salilADhakasiddhAnAM rase~aShTabhAgasthite kShipet pUte| candanakirAtatiktakamAgadhikAstrAyamANAM ca||141||
mustaM vatsakabIjaM kalkIkRutyArdhakArShikAn bhAgAn| navasarpiShashca ShaTpalametatsiddhaM ghRutaM peyam||142||
kuShThajvaragulmArshograhaNIpANDvAmayashvayathuhAri| pAmAvisarpapiDakAkaNDUmadagaNDanutsiddham||143||
iti tiktaShaTpalakaM ghRutam saptacchadaM prativiShAM shampAkaM tiktarohiNIM pAThAm| mustamushIraM triphalAM paTolapicumardaparpaTakam||144||
dhanvayavAsaM candanamupakulyAM padmakaM haridre dve| ShaDgranthAM savishAlAM shatAvarIM sArive cobhe||145||
vatsakabIjaM yAsaM mUrvAmamRutAM kirAtatiktaM ca| kalkAn kuryAnmatimAnyaShTyAhvaM trAyamANAM ca||146||
kalkashcAturbhAgo jalamaShTaguNaM raso~amRutaphalAnAm| dviguNo ghRutAtpradeyastatsarpiH pAyayetsiddham||147||
kuShThAni raktapittaprabalAnyarshAMsi raktavAhIni| vIsarpamamlapittaM vAtAsRuk pANDurogaM ca||148||
visphoTakAnsapAmAnunmAdaM kAmalAM jvaraM kaNDUm| hRudrogagulmapiDakA asRugdaraM gaNdamAlAM ca||149||
hanyAdetat sarpiH pItaM kAle yathAbalaM sadyaH| yogashatairapyajitAnmahAvikArAnmahAtiktam||150||

iti mahAtiktakaM ghRutam doShe hRute~apanIte rakte bAhyAntare kRute shamane | snehe ca kAlayukte na kuShThamanuvartate sAdhyam||151||

Commentary: na kuShThamanuvartata iti sAdhyamevetyarthaH||151||
khadirasya tulAH pa~jca shiMshapAsanayostule| tulArdhAH sarva evaite kara~jjAriShTavetasAH||152||
parpaTaH kuTajashcaiva vRuShaH kRumiharastathA| haridre kRutamAlashca guDUcI triphalA trivRut||153||
saptaparNashca sa~gkShuNNA dashadroNeShu vAriNaH| aShTabhAgAvasheShaM tu kaShAyamavatArayet||154||
dhAtrIrasaM ca tulyAMshaM sarpiShashcADhakaM pacet| mahAtiktakakalkaistu yathoktaiH palasammitaiH||155||
nihanti sarvakuShThAni pAnAbhya~gganiShevaNAt| mahAkhadiramityetat paraM kuShThavikAranut||156||
iti mahAkhadiraM ghRutam
prapatatsu lasIkAprasruteShu gAtreShu jantujagdheShu| mUtraM nimbaviDa~gge snAnaM pAnaM pradehashca||157||
vRuShakuTajasaptaparNAH karavIrakara~jjanimbakhadirAshca| snAne pAne lepe krimikuShThanudaH sagomUtrAH||158||
pAnAhAravidhAne prasecane dhUpane pradehe ca| kRuminAshanaM viDa~ggaM vishiShyate kuShThahA khadiraH||159||
eDagajaH saviDa~ggo mUlAnyAragvadhasya kuShThAnAm| uddAlanaM shvadantA goshvavarAhoShTradantAshca||160||
edagajaH saviDa~ggo dve ca nishe rAjavRukShamUlaM ca| kuShThoddAlanamagryaM sapippalIpAkalaM yojyam||161||
shvitrANAM savisheShaM yoktavyaM sarvato vishuddhAnAm| shvitre sraMsanamagryaM malapUrasa iShyate saguDaH||162||
taM pItvA susnigdho yathAbalaM sUryapAdasantApam| saMseveta viriktastryahaM pipAsuH pibet peyAm||163||
shvitre~a~gge ye sphoTA jAyante kaNTakena tAnbhindyAt| sphoTeShu visruteShu prAtaH prAtaH pibet pakSham||164||
malapUmasanaM priya~gguM shatapuShpAM cAmbhasA samutkvAthya| pAlAshaM vA kShAraM yathAbalaM phANitopetam||165||
yaccAnyat kuShThaghnaM shvitrANAM sarvameva tacchastam| khadirodakasaMyuktaM khadirodakapAnagryaM vA||166||
samanaHshilaM viDa~ggaM kAsIsaM rocanAM kanakapuShpIm| shvitrANAM prashamArthaM sasaindhavaM lepanaM dadyAt||167||
kadalIkShArayutaM vA kharAsthi dagdhaM gavAM rudhirayuktam| hastimadAdhyuShitaM vA mAlatyAH korakakShAram||168||
nIlotpalaM sakuShThaM sasaindhavaM hastimUtrapiShTaM vA| mUlakabIjAvalgujalepaH piShTo gavAM mUtre||169||
kAkodumbarikA vA sAvalgujacitrakA gavAM mUtre| piShTA manaHshilA vA saMyuktA barhipittena||170||
lepaH kilAsahantA bIjAnyAvalgujAni lAkShA ca| gopittama~jjane dve pippalyaH kAlaloharajaH||171||
shuddhyA shoNitamokShairvirUkShaNairbhakShaNaishca saktUnAm| shvitraM kasyacideva praNashyati kShINapApasya||172||
dAruNaM cAruNaM shvitraM kilAsaM nAmabhistribhiH| vij~jeyaM trividhaM tacca tridoShaM prAyashashca tat||173||
doShe raktAshrite raktaM tAmraM mAMsasamAshrite| shvetaM medaHshrite shvitraM guru taccottarottaram||174||
yat parasparato~abhinnaM bahu yadraktalomavat| yacca varShagaNotpannaM tacchvitraM naiva sidhyati||175||
araktaloma tanu yat pANDu nAticirotthitam| madhyAvakAshe cocchUnaM shvitraM tatsAdhyamucyate||176||

vacAMsyatathyAni kRutaghnabhAvo nindA surANAM gurudharShaNaM ca| pApakriyA pUrvakRutaM ca karma hetuH kilAsasya virodhi cAnnam||177||

Commentary: vacAMsItyAdinA tvaihikaM vA~gmAnasaM pApaM karmoktaM, pApakriyetyanena janmAntarakRutamadharmaM grAhayati||177||
tatra shlokAH- heturdravyaM li~ggaM vividhaM ye yeShu cAdhikA doShAH| kuShTheShu doShali~ggaM samAsato doShanirdeshaH||178||
sAdhyamasAdhyaM kRucchraM kuShThaM kuShThApahAshca ye yogAH| siddhAH kilAsaheturli~ggaM gurulAghavaM tathA shAntiH||179||
iti sa~ggrahaH praNIto maharShiNA kuShThanAshane~adhyAye| smRutibuddhivarghanArthaM shiShyAya hutAshaveshAya||180||
haviShprAshAnmehakuShThayorjanma uktaM, tena mehamanu kuShThacikitsitamucyate||1-2||

kapAlaH ghaTakharparaH | viShamaM dushcikitsyam| lomapi~jjaramiti romabhiH pi~jjaraM kapilam | utsannamaNDalamiti udgatamaNDalam| RuShyaH nIlaNDo hariNaH, RuShyajihvAsaMsthAnamiti tajjihvAkAram| prAyeNa corasIti urasi bAhulyena bhavati, shleShmapradhAnatvAt; kadAcidanyatrApi bhavatIti bhAvaH| kAkaNantikA gu~jjA| kuShThatvenaiva tridoShali~ggatve siddhe punastadvacanaM prabalatridoShali~ggatvopadarshanArtham||13-20||
mahAvAstviti mahAsthAnam| matsyashakalopamamiti matsyatvaksadRusham| kiNavat kharaH sparsho yasya tat kiNakharasparsham; kiNaH vraNasthAnam||21-26||

virodhInyAtreyabhadrakApyIye- “na matsyAn payasA~abhyavaharet” (sU.a.26) ityAdinoktAni| shItoShNetyAdi| shItoShNAdInAM yathAkrameNa sevyatvamuktaM, tadviparItena sevinAm; evaM la~gghanAhArayorapi j~jeyam| gharmAdibhirArtatve sati drutamavishramya shItAmbusevinAmiti yojyam| ajIrNAdhyashinAmiti ajIrNam Amamannam, apakvamiti yAvat; tadbhu~jjAnAnAm| adhyashinAmiti AhAre~apariNate bhu~jjAnAnAm| pa~jcakarmApacAriNAmiti pa~jcakarmaNi kriyamANe~apacAriNAM niShiddhasevinAm| vyavAyaM cApyajIrNe iti vidagdhAdirUpe~annAjIrNe strIsevanam kurvatAm| pApaM karma ca kurvatAmiti pApakarmaNaiva viprAdidharShaNe labdhe punastadvacanaM visheShahetutvopadarshanArtham||4-8||
cikitsArthaM vAtAdyAdhikaM kuShTheShvAha- vAta ityAdi| RuShyajihvAdiShu vAtapittAdhikyAdi yathAsa~gkhyaM j~jeyam||27-30||

uktaikadoShajatvAdinA kuShTheShvavirodhaM darshayannAha- sarvamityAdi| tridoShajatvaM sarveShu kuShTheShu vyavasthitameva; doShabalAbalavivakShayA cikitsArthamekadoShajatvAdivyapadesha iti bhAvaH| anubandhasyeti apradhAnasya||31-32||
kuShThagatadoShaj~jAnArthaM vAtAdili~ggAnyAha- raukShyamityAdi| dAhAdayaH pittali~ggAni||34-36||
cikitsApravRuttinivRuttyarthaM sAdhyAsAdhyakuShThAnyAha- sarvairityAdi||37-38||

yathAkramaM cikitsAmAha- vAtottareShvityAdi| agre iti sarpirAdiShu yojyaM; tena vAtottarAdiShu sarpirAdi prathamaM kartavyaM, tadanu vakShyamANA cikitsA kAryetyarthaH| bahusha iti bahUn vArAn; stokastokanirharaNena punaH punaH shodhyaH; ekadA hi bhUridoShaharaNe balakShayo mahAtyayaH syAt| ata evAha- doShe hyatimAtrahRute ityAdi| doShe iti jAtAvekavacanaM; tena kaphapittayorapi grahaNam; kiMvA doSha iti ekavacanenaiva ekadoShasyApyatimAtraharaNe vAyurhanyAditi| koShThe shuddhe rakte pravAhite ca snehasya pAnaM j~jeyam| ashuddhakoShThasya snehapAnaM vyAdhivardhanaM bhavati| uktaM hi- “sheShadoShe vyAdhirativardhate” iti| shodhanena tu niHsheShIkRute doShe sasheShadoShatA nAsti||39-42||

doShadUShyasa~ggrahamAha- vAtAdaya ityAdinA| vAtAdInAM tritve siddhe~api traya iti vacanaM sarvakuShTheShu trayANAmapi duShTidarshanArtham| dravyasa~ggraha iti dravyamArambhakaM kAraNamucyate| arthalabdhamapi saptakamitipadaM sarvatra saptakaniyamArthaM punarucyate| yadyapi visarpANAmutpAde etAnyeva sapta kAraNAni, yaduktaM- “raktaM lasIkA tva~gmAMsaM dUShyaM doShAstrayo malAH| visarpANAM samutpattau vij~jeyAH sapta dhAtavaH” (ci.a.21) iti; tathA~api kuShThaM cirakriyaiH sthirairdoShairjanyate, visarpastu visaraNashIlairiti visheShaH| anye tu visarpA vAtAdibhirekaikasho~api bhavantItyAhuH; yaduktaM- “pRuthak trayastribhishcaiko visarpA dvandvajAstrayaH” (ci.a.21) iti; tanna, tridoShajatve~api visarpANAmekadoShajakuShThavadekadoShajatvAdivyapadeshastatrocyate| sapta caikAdashaiva ceti vicchedapAThena saptAnAM kuShThAnAM mahAkuShThatvam, ekAdashAnAM ca kShudrakuShThatvamiti bodhayati| nidAne~anabhihitAnAmapi kShudrakuShThAnAmiha cikitsArthaM vidhAnam||9-10||
