kuTajetyAdinA vamanadravyANyAha| shItarasaH shItakaShAyaH | yathAvirekaM kramashceShTa iti pradhAnamadhyAvarashuddhyapekShayA peyAdikramastrisho dvisha ekasho vA kAryaH; uktaM hi- “peyAM vilepImakRutaM kRutaM ca yUShaM rasaM trInubhayaM tathaikam| krameNa seveta naro~annakAlAn pradhAnamadhyAvarashuddhishuddhaH” (si.a.1) iti| AsthApanAnuvAsane yadyapi “nAsthApyAH kuShThinaH” (si.a.2) ityAdinA kuShThe niShiddhe, tathA~apyAsthApanAnuvAsanaikasAdhyAyAmavasthAyAM kartavye eva; yaduktaM- “pravRuttinivRuttilakShaNasaMyoge tu gurulAghavaM sampradhArya samyagadhyavasyet” (vi.a.8) iti; tenAha- vAtolbaNamityAdi| sUtrasthAne yadyapi ekaiva vairecaniko dhUma uktastathA~api tatroktadravyairvyastasamastairbahavo dhUmA bhavantIti bahuvacanamiha kRutam||43-49||

nADyeva nADI svedAdhyAye uktA| kUrcaM shastravisheShamAhuH| raktotkleshaH utkliShTaM raktam| svinnatvenotsannaM svinnotsannam| rudhirAgamArthaM vilikhediti sambandhaH| nirhRuto~asradoSho yeShAM te nirhRutAsradoShAH||50-53||
na shastraM kramata iti sirAdisa~gkaTatvAnna shastraM yogyaM bhavati| sparshendriyanAshanAnIti tvagindriyaharANi| suptasuptAnIti suptavat suptAni acetanAni, sarvathA sparshAj~jAnItyarthaH||54-57||
sparshetyAdi pUrvarUpam| na vA sveda iti sambandhaH| asvedAtisvedau tu svedavahasroto~avarodhAnavarodhakRutau j~jeyau| shIghrotpattishcirasthitishca vraNAnAmeva||11-12||
sarpIMShi tiktakAni tiktaShaTpalAdIni| pittakuShThinAM kaphapittaraktaharaNAdIni kAryANIti yojyam||58-59||

dArvI dAruharidrA| rasA~jjanaM dArvIkvAthakRutam| abhayAprayoge guDatailayoH kuShThanidAnatvenoktayorapi saMyogamahimnA harItakyA samaM prayogaH kuShThaghno bhavati| mUlaM paTolasyeti paTolamUlaM, tathA gavAkShyA api mUlam| palAMshaM palaparimANam| triphalAtvacashca pratyekaM palAMshAH| yadyapi kalyANakaghRutoktAShTAviMshatipadena triphalAyAH pratyekaM bhAgaH sarvatra vyavasthApitaH, tathA~api tasyaivArthasya dyotanArthaM punaH pRuthakshabdaM grAhayati; kiMvA trAyamANAyAH kaTurohiNyAshca pRuthagbhAgArdhikatvaM darshayati, triphalAyAstu prasa~ggata eva pRuthagbhAgagrahaNaM siddham| trAyamANAkaTurohiNyoH pratyekaM ShaTshANamAtraM, nAgarasya cobhayorardhabhAgapUrakatvenArdhapalApekShayA caturthapAdadvayena shANacatuShTayaM bhavati, evaM trAyamANAkaTurohiNInAgaraiH palamekaM, paTolamUlAdibhiH pa~jcapalAnIti militvA ShaTpalAni; tathA satyeShAM paTolAdInAM cUrNIkRutAnAmiti jarjarIkRutAnAM, ShaTpalAnAM palamAkRuShya jale shRutaM pibet; evaM ShaDdinaM prayojyam| ShaDdinaprayogeNaivAsya prAyaH kuShThaharatvamunnIyate| etadvyAkhyAnasammatipradAni tantrAntarANi likhyante| tathAhi agniveshaH- “paTolamUlaM triphalA vishAlA ca palonmitA| palArdhaM trAyamANA ca tathA kaTukarohiNI|| karShArdhaM nAgaraM dattvA ShaTpalAnyavacUrNayet| jale shRutaM pibet koShNaM cUrNasyAtra palaM palam” ityAdi| cakShuShyeNo~apyAha- “paTolamUlaM triphalA vishAlA ca palAMshikA| kaTukA trAyamANA ca palardhA pAdanAgarA|| tasmAt ShaDbhAgamutkvAthya jale doShaharaM pibet” iti| anye tu vyAkhyAnayanti yat- palAMshashabdena karSha ucyate; tena paTolamUlasya pRuthakkarShaH, tathA gavAkShImUlasya karShaH, tathA kriphalAyA militvA karShaH, trAyamANA ca nAgarapAdayuktA satI karShArdhA bhavati, evaM kaTurohiNI ca nAgarapAdayuktA satI karShArdhA bhavati, evaM militvA palaM cUrNIkRutaM jale shRutaM pibediti| etacca tantrAntaravirodhAt tathA triphalasamudAyabhAgasya cAnyAyasiddhatvAnnAtisAdhu; “paTolamUlatriphalAgavAkShItrivRutApalaiH| trAyantI kaTukA dvAbhyAM kRutvA nAgarapAdikam|| cUrNaM palaM pibettasmAcchRutaM jIrNe rasAnnabhug” ityAdijatUkarNavacanavirodhAcca| jIrNe rasairityAdi| vireke~atra rasabhojanaM prayogayaugikatvAt; AvartakIghRutaviriktasya kA~jjikakodravAnnabhojanavat| dhanvamRugadvijAnAM rasaiH shAlyodanamAdadItetyarthaH||60-64||
tarpaNabhAgairiti saktubhAgaiH| prAyogikamiti satatopayojyam| kecittriphaletyAdi yogaM na paThanti||65-69||

lelIta(ha)kaH pAShANabheda auttarApathikaH, ucyate hi nighaNTau- “AsIddaityo mahAbAhurlelihAno mahAsuraH| yojanAnAM trayastriMshat kAyenAcchAdya tiShThati|| viShNucakreNa sa~jcchinno papAta dharaNItale| vasA tasya samAkhyAtA lelIha(ta)ka iti kShitau” ityAdi| jAtyA iti AmalakyAH||70-72||
kArye te cAShTapAlike iti khadirasuradArusAre aShTapalamAne kartavye| kanakaM nAgakesharam||73-75||
kanakabindau madhusharkare vinA AsavAniShpatteH pUrvAnusAroktamAne madhusharkare ihApi j~jeye| sauvarNItvak dAruharidrAtvak| kecit kanakabinduM paThitvA madhvAsavaM paThanti||76-80||
laghUnItyAdinA sevyamAhAramAha| bhallAtakAdInAmannasaMskArakatvaM ghRutasAdhakatvaM ca yathAsvaparibhAShayA j~jeyam| na gurvityAdinA niShedhyamAha||82-83||

eletyAdinA lepAnAha| bimbI aShThopamaphalA| arkaH kuruvindo maNivisheShaH, tAmramityanye| vilayantIti apayAnti| mAMseShu toyakAryamiti mAMsaprakShAlanodake tathA piShTe tathA kiNve ca toyakAryaM kAryam| toyakAryaM kShArAmbhasA kAryamiti yojyam| atra mAMsapiShTAbhyAM kiNvaM kAryaM, kiNvaishca medakaH sAdhanIyaH| medakaH jagalaH| sujAtaH sa~jjanitaH, pralepanamiti yojyam| mustamityAdau varNaka iti varNakaramAlepanam| tvagdoShashabdena gobalIvardanyAyena kilAsavya~ggAdInAM grahaNam| kuShThamityAdiko yogo jalapiShTo j~jeyaH| tenAragvadhIyokte “kara~jjabIjaiDagajaM sakuShThaM gomUtrapiShTaM ca paraH pradehaH” (sU.a.3) ityatra gomUtrapiShTatvaM visheShaH, tena na paunaruktyam| udvartanAlepAvityAdau unmardanam udvartanaM j~jeyam| shairIShI tvagityAdau pratyekadravyakRutatvena caturbhirdravyaishcaturvidho lepo j~jeyaH| anye tu caturbhirapi militairavacUrNanodvartanajalapiShTalepanarasakriyAlepanabhedeneha caturvidhalepaM vadanti| etaccaturvidhAcatuShTayamAragvadhIyaprayogeShu yadyapi dRushyate, tathA~apyAlepanena siddhatvAnnAtiramaNIyam||84-96||

dArvyA ityAdau dArvIsambandhino rasA~jjanasyaiko yogaH; sheShAstu ShaT, saptamastinishasya, aShTamo~ashvamArasya| ashvamArastu yadyapi mUlaviShatvenoktastathA~api kuShTheShu viShaprayogasyApi hitatvAt sAdhuH||97-101||

kuShThArketyAdau etaistailaM siddhamityatra prAdhAnyAttilatailaM j~jeyaM, yatra tu visheShastatra ‘kanakakShIrI shailA’ ityAdau ‘sArShapamathavA tailam’ ityuktam; anye tu kuShTheShvAlepe sArShapaM grAhayanti, pAne tu visheShAnuktau tilatailameva bhavati||102-104||
shvetakaravIrapallavetyAdau karavIrarasasya gomUtrasya ca sAmyam||106-107||
dve tutthe iti mayUratutthaM kharparikAtutthaM ca||108-110||
kanakakShIrI ‘ka~gkuShTha’ iti khyAtA| avAkpuShpI apAmArgaH; kiMvA ‘hedvAdullI’ iti khyAtA| amRutAsa~jj~jaH kharparikAtuttham||111-116||
vyeti apayAti| gharme iti Atape| snAnaM muktveti snAnaM varjayitvA~ayaM prayogaH kartavyaH||117-118||

ghRutatailapAka iti yamakapAkaH| atra ca siddhe snehe kShepyayoH sarjarasamadhUcchiShTayorapi kalkArthopAttajIvantIma~jjiShThAdidravyaiH samAnatvaM sAhacaryAjj~jeyaM; kiMvA snehAdaShTamo bhAgaH sarjarasamadhUcchiShTayoH, anyatra dRuShTatvAt; tathAhi “samUlAderaNDAt” ityAdau dviprasthasnehaparimANe madhUcchiShTapalAnyaShTAvuktAni| pUtIketyAdau pakvasurA gorakShakarkaTI, kShaudravallI guDUcI| ShaNmArutakaphakuShThaghnA iti kiNvaM varAharudhiramityAdyuktAH ShaD bhavanti| anye citrakAdIneva shlokapAdoktAn ShaD varNayanti| avaghAtaH karNikAkAraH| rohItakaH ‘rohiDA’ iti khyAtaH| vApyaM kuShThaM, lohamaguru, plavaM kaivartamustakam| bhAgottarANi yathottaramekabhAgavRuddhAni| rasA iti kvAthAH| tailairityAdau candanAdInAM tailasAdhanarUpa eva yogo j~jeyaH||120-134||

triphalAtvaca ityAdau pratyekaM harItakyAdInAmardhapalaM, paTolapatraM cArdhapalaM; sheShAH kaTurohiNyAdayaH| masUravidalAnAmiti nistuShamasUrANAM, na tu masUravidalA~atra shyAmA; uktaM hi jatUkarNe puMli~ggena- “masUravidalAt palam” iti| aShTabhAge sheShe iti ShoDashapale; ata evoktaM ‘tatra kaShAye~aShTapale’ iti prathamAdvivacanAntaM, tena ShoDashapalamAha| atra cAShTAviMshatyuttarapalashatamAnasyAShTabhAgasheShe ShoDashapalAni bhavanti, tacca dravaShoDashapalamaShTapalashabdenAkRutadvaiguNyenaivocyate; pale~api yadi dravadvaiguNyaM syAttadA ShoDashapalena dvAtriMshatpalAni syuH, na cehADhakAShTabhAgasheShe dvAtriMshatpalatvaM, kintu ShoDashapalameva; tenaitasmAdevAShTapalashabdenAkRutadvaiguNyAddravaShoDashapalagrahaNAdunnIyate yat- palollekhyamAne dvaiguNyaM nAsti; ki~jca kuDavAdAveva dravadvaiguNyamihAnumataM tantrAntareNApyanumatamiti| yAvat syAdaShTapalamityanena kaShAyacatuShpalena saMyutasyAShTapalaM sthApyamiti darshayati | eShA ca mAtrA kuShThinAM bhUrimAtradravyasAdhyatvenottamA j~jeyA||136-139||

nimbamityAdinA tiktaShaTpalakamAha| “sarpishcApyanavaM hitam” iti vacanasya bAdhakamiha yogamahimnA sarpiSho navatvaM j~jeyam| prathamaM ‘sarpiShaH’ iti padaM mAnArthaM, dvitIyaM tu ‘ghRutaM’ iti padaM peyatvopadarshanArthaM; tathA prathamaM siddhamiti pakvaM, dvitIyaM tu prasiddhikhyApakam||140-143||

saptacchadamityAdinA mahatiktaghRutamAha| shampAka AragvadhaH| kalkashcAturbhAga iti ghRutAccaturtho bhAgaH; etacca sAmAnyaparibhAShAsiddhamapi spaShTArthamucyate| amRutaphalAnAmiti AmalakAnAm| atrApi trisarpirvacane ekaM kalkAdibhAgArthaM, dvitIyaM peyatvopadarshanArthaM, tRutIyaM mahAtiktakasa~jj~jAdarshanArtham||144-150||

khadirasya tulA ityAdikaM kecidanArShaM vadanti| sAdhayedityatra ‘sarpiH’ iti sheShaH| tatra ghRutamAnAnuktau kvAthasheShasyADhakAdhikadroNasya niyatatvAt tatkvAthacaturthabhAgaM prasthAdhikADhakamAnaM ghRutaM sAdhyam||152-156||
khadira iti kuShThahantRutvena khadiro dravyAntareShu vishiShyate prakarShavAn bhavatItyarthaH| shvadantA iti kukkuradantAH| uddAlanamiti prashamanam| pAkalaM kuShTham||157-161||

tvagdoShAdhikArAnuSha~ggAttvagdoShavisheShasya shvitrasya cikitsAmAha- shvitrANAmityAdi| nanvapararogANAM nidAnAdyabhidhAya cikitsocyate, shvitrasya tu prathamaM cikitsA pashcAddhetvAdIti ko~abhiprAyaH? ucyate- yeyaM kuShThacikitsoktA sA shvitrANAmapi vidheyA; tadyadi nidAnAdi shvitrasyocyate tadA sA cikitsA vyavahitA syAt, tena cikitsaiva tAvaducyate| shvitrANAM savisheShaM prayoktavyamiti yadetat kuShThoddAlanamuktaM tacchvitrANAM savisheShaM gADhataraM kartavyamityarthaH| sarvato vishuddhAnAmiti vamanAdibhiH shuddhAnAm| malapUH kAkodumbarikA| shvitre~a~gge iti shvitrayukte~a~gge| kanakapuShpI suvarNakShIrI| mAlasyAH korakakShAramiti mAlatImukulakShAraM, korako mukula ucyate| a~jjane dve iti sauvIraM rasA~jjanakaM ca| kasyacideva prashAmyatItyanena shvitrANAM durapagamatAmAha||162-172||

nAmabhiriti uktadAruNAdibhireva| prAyaHshabdenaikadoShaM dvidoShaM ca bhavati| doShe ityAdinoktaM traividhyaM vibhajati| sushrute tu “tvaggatameva kilAsam” (ni.a.5) ityuktaM, tacca na kuShThavadraktAdigatakuShThalakShaNakArakaM shvitramityabhiprAyeNoktam| iha tu yadraktAdyAshrayitvaM shvitrasyocyate, tadraktAdidoShamAtrAbhiprAyeNa na raktAdigatasamastakuShThalakShaNakAritayA; tenAtrApi tva~gmAtravikRutikArakatvaM shvitrasya sammatameveti na virodhaH | gurviti anupakramam| araktetyAdinA sAdhyakilAsalakShaNamAha||173-176||

heturdravyamityAdinA sa~ggrahaH| yeShu yeShu kapAlAdiShu ye ye cAdhikA doShAsteShAM nirdeshaH samAsato doShanirdesha iti| ‘raukShyaM shoShastodaH’ ityAdinoktaM doShali~ggam| gurulAghavamiti ‘shvitraM guru taccottarottaram’ ityanenoktam||178-180||
athAto rAjayakShmacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
prAgrUpaM bahurUpasya tajj~jeyaM rAjayakShmaNaH|38|
yathAsvenoShmaNA pAkaM shArIrA yAnti dhAtavaH| srotasA ca yathAsvena dhAtuH puShyati dhAtutaH||39||
srotasAM sannirodhAcca raktAdInAM ca sa~gkShayAt| dhAtUShmaNAM cApacayAdrAjayakShmA pravartate||40||
tasmin kAle pacatyagniryadannaM koShThasaMshritam| malIbhavati tat prAyaH kalpate ki~jcidojase||41||
tasmAt purIShaM saMrakShyaM visheShAdrAjayakShmiNaH| sarvadhAtukShayArtasya balaM tasya hi viDbalam||42||
rasaH srotaHsu ruddheShu svasthAnastho vidahyate | sa UrdhvaM kAsavegena bahurUpaH pravartate||43||
jAyante vyAdhayashcAtaH ShaDekAdasha vA punaH| yeShAM sa~gghAtayogena rAjayakShmeti kathyate||44||
kAsoM~asatApo vaisvaryaM jvaraH pArshvashirorujA| chardanaM raktakaphayoH shvAsavarcogado~aruciH||45||
rUpANyekAdashaitAni yakShmaNaH ShaDimAni vA| kAso jvaraH pArshvashUlaM svaravarcogado~aruciH||46||
sarvairardhaistribhirvA~api li~ggairmAMsabalakShaye| yukto varjyashcikitsyastu sarvarUpo~apyato~anyathA||47||
ghrANamUle sthitaH shleShmA rudhiraM pittameva vA| mArutAdhmAtashiraso mArutaM shyAyate prati||48||
pratishyAyastato ghoro jAyate dehakarshanaH| tasya rUpaM shiraHshUlaM gauravaM ghrANaviplavaH||49||
jvaraH kAsaH kaphotkleshaH svarabhedo~aruciH klamaH| indriyANAmasAmarthyaM yakShmA cAtaH prajAyate||50||

picchilaM bahalaM visraM haritaM shvetapItakam| kAsamAno rasaM yakShmI niShThIvati kaphAnugam||51||

Commentary: sa UrdhvaM kAsavegena bahurUpaH pravartate iti yaduktaM yakShmarUpaM tadvivRuNoti- picchilamityAdi||51||

aMsapArshvAbhitApashca santApaH karapAdayoH| jvaraH sarvA~ggagashceti lakShaNaM rAjayakShmaNaH||52||

Commentary: rAjayakShmaNo jvarasya vishiShTaM lakShaNamAha- aMsetyAdi| lakShaNaM rAjayakShmaNa iti aMsapArshvAbhitApakarapAdasantAparUpaH sarvA~ggagajvaro rAjayakShmalakShaNamityarthaH||52||
vAtAtpittAtkaphAdraktAt kAsavegAt sapInasAt| svarabhedo bhavedvAtAdrUkShaH kShAmashcalaH svaraH||53||
tAlukaNThapariploShaH pittAdvaktumasUyate| kaphAdbhedo vibaddhashca svaraH khurakhurAyate ||54||
sanno raktavibaddhatvAt svaraH kRucchrAt pravartate| kAsAtivegAt kaShaNaH pInasAtkaphavAtikaH||55||
pArshvashUlaM tvaniyataM sa~gkocAyAmalakShaNam| shiraHshUlaM sasantApaM yakShmiNaH syAtsagauravam||56||

abhisanne sharIre tu yakShmiNo viShamAshanAt| kaNThAtpravartate raktaM shleShmA cotkliShTasa~jcitaH||57||

Commentary: saraktaM kaphamasyatIti yaduktaM tallakShaNaM vivRuNoti- abhisanna ityAdi| abhitaH sanno~abhisannaH| ‘abhiShyande’ iti pAThapakShe~abhiShyandagRuhIta ityarthaH; kintvabhipUrvasyandateH kathaM rUpasiddhirbhavatIti cintanIyam| sa~jcitotkliShTamiti vaktavye pUrvanipAtaniyamAdutkliShTasa~jcita iti kRutam||57||
raktaM vibaddhamArgatvAnmAMsAdInnAnupadyate | AmAshayasthamutkliShTaM bahutvAt kaNThameti ca||58||
vAtashleShmavibaddhatvAdurasaH shvAsamRucchati| doShairupahate cAgnau sapicchamatisAryate||59||
divaukasAM kathayatAmRuShibhirvai shrutA kathA| kAmavyasanasaMyuktA paurANI shashinaM prati||3||
rohiNyAmatisaktasya sharIraM nAnurakShataH| AjagAmAlpatAmindordehaH snehaparikShayAt||4||
duhitRUNAmasambhogAccheShANAM ca prajApateH| krodho niHshvAsarUpeNa mUrtimAn niHsRuto mukhAt||5||
prajApaterhi duhitRUraShTAviMshatimaMshumAn| bhAryArthaM pratijagrAha na ca sarvAsvavartata||6||
guruNA tamavadhyAtaM bhAryAsvasamavartinam| rajaHparItamabalaM yakShmA shashinamAvishat||7||
so~abhibhUto~atimahatA gurukrodhena niShprabhaH| devadevarShisahito jagAma sharaNaM gurum||8||
atha candramasaH shuddhAM matiM buddhvA prajApatiH| prasAdaM kRutavAn somastato~ashvibhyAM cikitsitaH||9||
sa vimuktagrahashcandro virarAja visheShataH| ojasA vardhito~ashvibhyAM shuddhaM sattvamavApa ca||10||
krodho yakShmA jvaro roga ekArtho duHkhasa~jj~jakaH| yasmAt sa rAj~jaH prAgAsIdrAjayakShmA tato mataH||11||
sa yakShmA hu~gkRuto~ashvibhyAM mAnuShaM lokamAgataH| labdhvA caturvidhaM hetuM samAvishati mAnavAn||12||
pRuthagdoShaiH samastairvA jihvAhRudayasaMshritaiH| jAyate~arucirAhAre dviShTairarthaishca mAnasaiH||60||
kaShAyatiktamadhurairvidyAnmukharasaiH kramAt| vAtAdyairaruciM jAtAM mAnasIM doShadarshanAt||61||

arocakAt kAsavegAddoShotkleshAdbhayAdapi| chardiryA sA vikArANAmanyeShAmapyupadravaH||62||

Commentary: chardiM vibhajate- arocakAdityAdi| vikArANAmanyeShAmapyupadrava iti evambhUtA chardirna yakShmamAtraniyatA,kintvanyeShAmapi vikArANAmevambhUtA chardirupadravarUpA bhavati; kiMvA evambhUtA yA chardiH sA yakShmiNa upadravo bhavati, tathA~arocakAdibhya utthitA cchardiranyeShAmapi hikkAdInAmupadravo bhavatItyarthaH||62||
sarvastridoShajo yakShmA doShANAM tu balAbalam| parIkShyAvasthikaM vaidyaH shoShiNaM samupAcaret||63||
pratishyAye shiraHshUle kAse shvAse svarakShaye| pArshvashUle ca vividhAH kriyAH sAdhAraNIH shRuNu||64||
pInase svedamabhya~ggaM dhUmamAlepanAni ca| pariShekAvagAhAMshca yAvakaM vATyameva ca||65||
lavaNAmlakaTUShNAMshca rasAn snehopabRuMhitAn| lAvatittiridakShANAM vartakAnAM ca kalpayet||66||
sapippalIkaM sayavaM sakulatthaM sanAgaram| dADimAmalakopetaM snigdhamAjaM rasaM pibet||67||
tena ShaDvinivartante vikArAH pInasAdayaH| mUlakAnAM kulatthAnAM yUShairvA sUpakalpitaiH ||68||
yavagodhUmashAlyannairyathAsAtmyamupAcaret| pibetprasAdaM vAruNyA jalaM vA pA~jcamUlikam||69||
dhAnyanAgarasiddhaM vA tAmalakyA~athavA shRutam| parNinIbhishcatasRubhistena cAnnAni kalpayet||70||
kRusharotkArikAmAShakulatthayavapAyasaiH| sa~gkarasvedavidhinA kaNThaM pArshvamuraH shiraH||71||
svedayet patrabha~ggeNa shirashca pariShecayet| balAguDUcImadhukashRutairvA vAribhiH sukhaiH||72||
bastamatsyashirobhirvA nADIsvedaM prayojayet| kaNThe shirasi pArshve ca payobhirvA savAtikaiH||73||
audakAnUpamAMsAni salilaM pA~jcamUlikam| sasnehamAranAlaM vA nADIsvede prayojayet||74||
jIvantyAH shatapuShpAyA balAyA madhukasya ca| vacAyA veshavArasya vidAryA mUlakasya ca||75||
audakAnUpamAMsAnAmupanAhAH susaMskRutAH| shasyante sacatuHsnehAH shiraHpArshvAMsashUlinAm||76||
shatapuShpA samadhukaM kuShThaM tagaracandane| AlepanaM syAt saghRutaM shiraHpArshvAMsashUlanut||77||
balA rAsnA tilAH sarpirmadhukaM nIlamutpalam| pala~gkaShA devadAru candanaM kesharaM ghRutam||78||
vIrA balA vidArI ca kRuShNagandhA punarnavA| shatAvarI payasyA ca kattRuNaM madhukaM ghRutam||79||
catvAra ete shlokArdhaiH pradehAH parikIrtitAH| shastAH saMsRuShTadoShANAM shiraHpArshvAMsashUlinAm||80||
nAvanaM dhUmapAnAni snehAshcauttarabhaktikAH| tailAnyabhya~ggayogIni bastikarma tathA param||81||
shRu~ggAlAbujalaukobhiH praduShTaM vyadhanena vA| shiraHpArshvAMsashUleShu rudhiraM tasya nirharet||82||
pradehaH saghRutashceShTaH padmakoshIracandanaiH| dUrvAmadhukama~jjiShThAkesharairvA ghRutAplutaiH||83||
prapauNDarIkanirguNDIpadmakesharamutpalam | kasherukAH payasyA ca sasarpiShkaM pralepanam||84||
candanAdyena tailena shatadhautena sarpiShA| abhya~ggaH, payasA sekaH shastashca madhukAmbunA||85||
mAhendreNa sushItena candanAdishRutena vA| pariShekaH prayoktavya iti saMshamanI kriyA||86||
doShAdhikAnAM vamanaM shasyate savirecanam| snehasvedopapannAnAM sasnehaM yanna karshanam||87||
shoShI mu~jcati gAtrANi purIShasraMsanAdapi| abalApekShiNIM mAtrAM kiM punaryo viricyate||88||

ayathAbalamArambhaM vegasandhAraNaM kShayam| yakShmaNaH kAraNaM vidyAccaturthaM viShamAshanam||13||

Commentary: ayathAbalamArambhAdiyakShmahetutraye vihArarUpe AhArarUpatayA bhinnajAtIyatvAdviShamAshanaM ‘caturthaM viShamAshanam’ iti pRuthak paThitam| nirdeshAdeva catuShke labdhe caturthamiti padaM sAhasAdInAM prabhedAnAM bahutve~api sAhasAdicaturvidhAnatikramopadarshanArtham ||13||
yogAn saMshuddhakoShThAnAM kAse shvAse svarakShaye| shiraHpArshvAMsashUleShu siddhAnetAnprayojayet||89||
balAvidArigandhAdyairvidAryA madhukena vA| siddhaM salavaNaM sarpirnasyaM syAtsvaryamuttamam||90||
prapauNDarIkaM madhukaM pippalI bRuhatI balA| kShIraM sarpishca tatsiddhaM svaryaM syAnnAvanaM param||91||
shiraHpArshvAMsashUlaghnaM kAsashvAsanibarhaNam| prayujyamAnaM bahusho ghRutaM cauttarabhaktikam||92||
dashamUlena payasA siddhaM mAMsarasena ca| balAgarbhaM ghRutaM sadyo rogAnetAn prabAdhate||93||
bhaktasyopari madhye vA yathAgnyabhyavacAritam| rAsnAghRutaM vA sakShIraM sakShIraM vA balAghRutam||94||
lehAn kAsApahAn svaryA~j shvAsahikkAnibarhaNAn| shiraHpArshvAMsashUlaghnAn snehAMshcAtaH paraM shRuNu||95||
ghRutaM kharjUramRudvIkAsharkarAkShaudrasaMyutam | sapippalIkaM vaisvaryakAsashvAsajvarApaham||96||
dashamUlashRutAt kShIrAt sarpiryadudiyAnnavam| sapippalIkaM sakShaudraM tat paraM svarabodhanam||97||
shiraHpArshvAMsashUlaghnaM kAsashvAsajvarApaham| pa~jcabhiH pa~jcamUlairvA shRutAdyadudiyAdghRutam||98||
pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlAnAM rase kShIracaturguNe| siddhaM sarpirjayatyetadyakShmaNaH saptakaM balam||99||
kharjUraM pippalI drAkShA pathyA shRu~ggI durAlabhA| triphalA pippalI mustaM shRu~ggATaguDasharkarAH||100||
vIrA shaTI puShkarAkhyaM surasaH sharkarA guDaH| nAgaraM citrako lAjAH pippalyAmalakaM guDaH||101||
shlokArdhairvihitAnetAMllihyAnnA madhusarpiShA| kAsashvAsApahAnsvaryAnpArshvashUlApahAMstathA||102||
sitopalAM tugAkShIrIM pippalIM bahulAM tvacam| antyAdUrdhvaM dviguNitaM lehayenmadhusarpiShA||103||
cUrNitaM prAshayedvA tacchvAsakAsakaphAturam | suptajihvArocakinamalpAgniM pArshvashUlinam||104||

hastapAdA~ggadAheShu jvare rakte tathordhvage| vAsAghRutaM shatAvaryA siddhaM vA paramaM hitam||105||

Commentary: hastetyAdau vAsAghRutaM raktapittoktaM gulmoktaM ca; shatAvarIghRutaM yonivyApaccikitsitavakShyamANam||105||
durAlabhAM shvadaMShTrAM ca catasraH parNinIrbalAm| bhAgAnpalonmitAn kRutvA palaM parpaTakasya ca||106||
paceddashaguNe toye dashabhAgAvasheShite| rase supUte dravyANAmeShAM kalkAn samAvapet||107||
shaTyAH puShkaramUlasya pippalItrAyamANayoH| tAmalakyAH kirAtAnAM tiktasya kuTajasya ca||108||
phalAnAM sArivAyAshca supiShTAn karShasammitAn| tatastena ghRutaprasthaM kShIradviguNitaM pacet||109||
jvaraM dAhaM bhramaM kAsamaMsapArshvashirorujam| tRuShNAM chardimatIsArametat sarpirvyapohati||110||
jIvantIM madhukaM drAkShAM phalAni kuTajasya ca| shaTIM puShkaramUlaM ca vyAghrIM gokShurakaM balAm||111||
nIlotpalaM tAmalakIM trAyamANAM durAlabhAm| pippalIM ca samaM piShTvA ghRutaM vaidyo vipAcayet||112||
etadvyAdhisamUhasya rogeshasya samutthitam| rUpamekAdashavidhaM sarpiragryaM vyapohati||113||
balAM sthirAM pRushniparNIM bRuhatIM sanidigdhikAm| sAdhayitvA rase tasminpayo gavyaM sanAgaram||114||
drAkShAkharjUrasarpirbhiH pippalyA ca shRutaM saha| sakShaudraM jvarakAsaghnaM svaryaM caitat prayojayet||115||
Ajasya payasashcaivaM prayogo jA~ggalA rasAH| yUShArthe caNakA mudgA makuShThAshcopakalpitAH||116||
jvarANAM shamanIyo yaH pUrvamuktaH kriyAvidhiH| yakShmiNAM jvaradAheShu sasarpiShkaH prashasyate||117||
kaphapraseke balavA~j shlaiShmikashchardayennaraH| payasA phalayuktena mAdhukena rasena vA||118||
sarpiShmatyA yavAgvA vA vamanIyopasiddhayA| vAnto~annakAle laghvannamAdadIta sadIpanam||119||
yavagodhUmamAdhvIkasidhvariShTasurAsavAn| jA~ggalAni ca shUlyAni sevamAnaH kaphaM jayet||120||
shleShmaNo~atiprasekena vAyuH shleShmANamasyati| kaphaprasekaM taM vidvAn snigdhoShNenaiva nirjayet||121||
kriyA kaphapraseke yA vamyAM saiva prashasyate| hRudyAni cAnnapAnAni vAtaghnAni laghUni ca||122||
prAyeNopahatAgnitvAt sapicchamatisAryate| prApnoti cAsyavairasyaM na cAnnamabhinandati||123||
tasyAgnidIpanAn yogAnatIsAranibarhaNAn| vaktrashuddhikarAn kuryAdarucipratibAdhakAn||124||
sanAgarAnindrayavAn pAyayettaNDulAmbunA| siddhAM yavAgUM jIrNe ca cA~ggerItakradADimaiH||125||
pAThA bilvaM yamAnI ca pAtavyaM takrasaMyutam| durAlabhA shRu~ggaveraM pAThA ca surayA saha||126||
jambvAmramadhyaM bilvaM ca sakapitthaM sanAgaram| peyAmaNDena pAtavyamatIsAranivRuttaye||127||
etAneva ca yogAMstrIn pAThAdIn kArayet khaDAn| sasUpyadhAnyAnsasnehAn sAmlAnsa~ggrahaNAn param||128||
vetasArjunajambUnAM mRuNAlIkRuShNagandhayoH| shrIparNyA madayantyAshca yUthikAyAshca pallavAn||129||
mAtulu~ggasya dhAtakyA dADimasya ca kArayet| snehAmlalavaNopetAn khaDAn sA~ggrAhikAn param||130||
cA~ggeryAshcukrikAyAshca dugdhikAyAshca kArayet| khaDAndadhisaropetAn sasarpiShkAnsadADimAn||131||
mAMsAnAM laghupAkAnAM rasAH sA~ggrAhikairyutAH| vya~jjanArthaM prashasyante bhojyArthaM raktashAlayaH||132||
sthirAdipa~jcamUlena pAne shastaM shRutaM jalam| takraM surA sacukrIkA dADimasyAthavA rasaH||133||
paraM mukhasya vairasyanAshanaM rocanaM shRuNu ||134||
yuddhAdhyayanabhArAdhvala~gghanaplavanAdibhiH| patanairabhighAtairvA sAhasairvA tathA~aparaiH||14||
ayathAbalamArambhairjantorurasi vikShate| vAyuH prakupito doShAvudIryobhau pradhAvati||15||
sa shiraHsthaH shiraHshUlaM karoti galamAshritaH| kaNThoddhvaMsaM ca kAsaM ca svarabhedamarocakam||16||
pArshvashUlaM ca pArshvastho varcobhedaM gude sthitaH| jRumbhAM jvaraM ca sandhistha uraHsthashcoraso rujam||17||
kShaNanAdurasaH kAsAt kaphaM ShThIvet sashoNitam| jarjareNorasA kRucchramuraHshUlAtipIDitaH||18||
iti sAhasiko yakShmA rUpairetaiH prapadyate| ekAdashabhirAtmaj~jo bhajettasmAnna sAhasam||19||
dvau kAlau dantapavanaM bhakShayenmukhadhAvanam| tadvat prakShAlayedAsyaM dhArayet kavalagrahAn||135||
pibeddhUmaM tato mRuShTamadyAddIpanapAcanam| bheShajaM pAnamannaM ca hitamiShTopakalpitam||136||
tva~gmustamelA dhAnyAni mustamAmalakaM tvacam| dArvItvaco yavAnI ca tejohvA pippalI tathA||137||
yavAnI tintiDIkaM ca pa~jcaite mukhadhAvanAH| shlokapAdeShvabhihitA rocanA mukhashodhanAH||138||
guTikAM dhArayedAsye cUrNairvA shodhayenmukham| eShAmAloDitAnAM vA dhArayet kavalagrahAn||139||
surAmAdhvIkasIdhUnAM tailasya madhusarpiShoH| kavalAn dhArayediShTAn kShIrasyekShurasasya ca||140||
yavAnIM tintiDIkaM ca nAgaraM sAmlavetasam| dADimaM badaraM cAmlaM kArShikaM copakalpayet||141||
dhAnyasauvarcalAjAjIvarA~ggaM cArdhakArShikam| pippalInAM shataM caikaM dve shate maricasya ca||142||
sharkarAyAshca catvAri palAnyekatra cUrNayet| jihvAvishodhanaM hRudyaM taccUrNaM bhaktarocanam||143||
hRutplIhapArshvashUlaghnaM vibandhAnAhanAshanam| kAsashvAsaharaM grAhi grahaNyarshovikAranut||144||
iti tAlIshAdyaM cUrNaM guTikAshca
tAlIshapatraM maricaM nAgaraM pippalI shubhA| yathottaraM bhAgavRuddhyA tvagele cArdhabhAgike||145||
pippalyaShTaguNA cAtra pradeyA sitasharkarA| kAsashvAsAruciharaM taccUrNaM dIpanaM param||146||
hRutpANDugrahaNIdoShashoShaplIhajvarApaham| vamyatIsArashUlaghnaM mUDhavAtAnulomanam||147||
kalpayedguTikAM caitaccUrNaM paktvA sitopalAm| guTikA hyagnisaMyogAccUrNAllaghutarAH smRutAH||148||
shuShyatAM kShINamAMsAnAM kalpitAni vidhAnavit| dadyAnmAMsAdamAMsAni bRuMhaNAni visheShataH||149||
shoShiNe bArhiNaM dadyAdbarhishabdena cAparAn| gRudhrAnulUkAMshcAShAMshca vidhivat sUpakalpitAn||150||
kAkAMstittirishabdena varmishabdena coragAn| bhRuShTAn matsyAntrashabdena dadyAdgaNDUpadAnapi||151||
lopAkAn sthUlanakulAn biDAlAMshcopakalpitAn| shRugAlashAvAMshca bhiShak shashashabdena dApayet||152||
siMhAnRukShAMstarakShUMshca vyAghrAnevaMvidhAMstathA| mAMsAdAn mRugashabdena dadyAnmAMsAbhivRuddhaye||153||
gajakhaDgitura~ggANAM veshavArIkRutaM bhiShak| dadyAnmahiShashabdena mAMsaM mAMsAbhivRuddhaye||154||
mAMsenopacitA~ggAnAM mAMsaM mAMsakaraM param| tIkShNoShNalAghavAcchastaM visheShAnmRugapakShiNAm||155||
mAMsAni yAnyanabhyAsAdaniShTAni prayojayet| teShUpadhA, sukhaM bhoktuM tathA shakyAni tAni hi||156||
jAna~jjugupsannaivAdyAjjagdhaM vA punarullikhet| tasmAcchadmopasiddhAni mAMsAnyetAni dApayet||157||
barhitittiridakShANAM haMsAnAM shUkaroShTrayoH| kharagomahiShANAM ca mAMsaM mAMsakaraM param||158||
yoniraShTavidhA coktA mAMsAnAmannapAnike| tAM parIkShya bhiShagvidvAn dadyAnmAMsAni shoShiNe||159||
prasahA bhUshayAnUpavArijA vAricAriNaH| AhArArthaM pradAtavyA mAtrayA vAtashoShiNe||160||
pratudA viShkirAshcaiva dhanvajAshca mRugadvijAH| kaphapittaparItAnAM prayojyAH shoSharogiNAm||161||
vidhivatsUpasiddhAni manoj~jAni mRudUni ca| rasavanti sugandhIni mAMsAnyetAni bhakShayet||162||
mAMsamevAshnataH shoSho mAdhvIkaM pibato~api ca| niyatAnalpacittasya ciraM kAye na tiShThati||163||
vAruNImaNDanityasya bahirmArjanasevinaH| avidhAritavegasya yakShmA na labhate~antaram||164||
prasannAM vAruNIM sIdhumariShTAnAsavAnmadhu| yathArhamanupAnArthaM pibenmAMsAni bhakShayan||165||
madyaM taikShNyauShNyavaishadyasUkShmatvAt srotasAM mukham| pramathya vivRuNotyAshu tanmokShAt sapta dhAtavaH||166||
puShyanti dhAtupoShAcca shIghraM shoShaH prashAmyati| mAMsAdamAMsasvarase siddhaM sarpiH prayojayet||167||
sakShaudraM, payasA siddhaM sarpirdashaguNena vA| siddhaM madhurakairdravyairdashamUlakaShAyakaiH||168||
kShIramAMsarasopetairghRutaM shoShaharaM param| pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakanAgaraiH||169||
sayAvashUkaiH sakShIraiH srotasAM shodhanaM ghRutam| rAsnAbalAgokShurakasthirAvarShAbhusAdhitam||170||
jIvantIpippalIgarbhaM sakShIraM shoShanudghRutam| yavAgvA vA pibenmAtrAM lihyAdvA madhunA saha||171||
siddhAnAM sarpiShAmeShAmadyAdannena vA saha| shuShyatAmeSha nirdiShTo vidhirAbhyavahArikaH||172||
bahiHsparshanamAshritya vakShyate~ataH paraM vidhiH| snehakShIrAmbukoShTheShu svabhyaktamavagAhayet||173||
srotovibandhamokShArthaM balapuShTyarthameva ca| uttIrNaM mishrakaiHsnehaiH punarAktaiH sukhaiH karaiH||174||
mRudnIyAt sukhamAsInaM sukhaM cotsAdayennaram| jIvantIM shatavIryAM ca vikasAM sapunarnavAm||175||
ashvagandhAmapAmArgaM tarkArIM madhukaM balAm| vidArIM sarShapaM kuShThaM taNDulAnatasIphalam||176||
mAShAMstilAMshca kiNvaM ca sarvamekatra cUrNayet| yavacUrNatriguNitaM dadhnA yuktaM samAkShikam||177||
etadutsAdanaM kAryaM puShTivarNabalapradam| gaurasarShapakalkena kalkaishcApi sugandhibhiH||178||
gandhaiH samAlyairvAsobhirbhUShaNaishca vibhUShitaH||179||
spRushyAn saMspRushya sampUjya devatAH sabhiShagdvijAH| iShTavarNarasasparshagandhavat pAnabhojanam||180||
iShTamiShTairupahitaM sukhamadyAt sukhapradam| samAtItAni dhAnyAni kalpanIyAni shuShyatAm||181||
laghUnyahInavIryANi svAdUni gandhavanti ca| yAni praharShakArINi tAni pathyatamAni hi||182||
yaccopadekShyate pathyaM kShatakShINacikitsite| yakShmiNastat prayoktavyaM balamAMsAbhivRuddhaye||183||
abhya~ggotsAdanaishcaiva vAsobhirahataiH priyaiH| yathartuvihitaiH snAnairavagAhairvimArjanaiH||184||
bastibhiH kShIrasarpirbhirmAMsairmAMsarasaudanaiH| iShTairmadyairmanoj~jAnAM gandhAnAmupasevanaiH||185||
suhRudAM ramaNIyAnAM pramadAnAM ca darshanaiH| gItavAditrashabdaishca priyashrutibhireva ca||186||
harShaNAshvAsanairnityaM gurUNAM samupAsanaiH| brahmacaryeNa dAnena tapasA devatArcanaiH||187||
satyenAcArayogena ma~ggalyairapyahiMsayA| vaidyaviprArcanAccaiva rogarAjo nivartate||188||
yayA prayuktayA ceShTyA rAjayakShmA purA jitaH| tAM vedavihitAmiShTimArogyArthI prayojayet||189||
hrImattvAdvA ghRuNitvAdvA bhayAdvA vegamAgatam| vAtamUtrapurIShANAM nigRuhNAti yadA naraH||20||
tadA vegapratIghAtAt kaphapitte samIrayan| UrdhvaM tiryagadhashcaiva vikArAn kurute~anilaH||21||
pratishyAyaM ca kAsaM ca svarabhedamarocakam| pArshvashUlaM shiraHshUlaM jvaramaMsAvamardanam||22||
a~ggamardaM muhushchardiM varcobhedaM trilakShaNam| rUpANyekAdashaitAni yakShmA yairucyate mahAn||23||
IrShyotkaNThAbhayatrAsakrodhashokAtikarshanAt| ativyavAyAnashanAcchukramojashca hIyate||24||
tataH snehakShayAdvAyurvRuddho doShAvudIrayan| pratishyAyaM jvaraM kAsama~ggamardaM shirorujam||25||
shvAsaM viDbhedamaruciM pArshvashUlaM svarakShayam| karoti cAMsasantApamekAdashagadAnimAn ||26||
li~ggAnyAvedayantyetAnyekAdasha mahAgadam| samprAptaM rAjayakShmANaM kShayAt prANakShayapradam||27||
vividhAnyannapAnAni vaiShamyeNa samashnataH| janayantyAmayAn ghorAnviShamAnmArutAdayaH||28||
srotAMsi rudhirAdInAM vaiShamyAdviShamaM gatAH| ruddhvA rogAya kalpante puShyanti ca na dhAtavaH||29||
pratishyAyaM prasekaM ca kAsaM chardimarocakam| jvaramaMsAbhitApaM ca chardanaM rudhirasya ca||30||
pArshvashUlaM shiraHshUlaM svarabhedamathApi ca| kaphapittAnilakRutaM li~ggaM vidyAdyathAkramam||31||
iti vyAdhisamUhasya rogarAjasya hetujam| rUpamekAdashavidhaM hetushcoktashcaturvidhaH||32||
pUrvarUpaM pratishyAyo daurbalyaM doShadarshanam| adoSheShvapi bhAveShu kAye bIbhatsadarshanam||33||
ghRuNitvamashnatashcApi balamAMsaparikShayaH| strImadyamAMsapriyatA priyatA cAvaguNThane||34||
makShikAghuNakeshAnAM tRuNAnAM patanAni ca| prAyo~annapAne keshAnAM nakhAnAM cAbhivardhanam||35||
patatribhiH pata~ggaishca shvApadaishcAbhidharShaNam| svapne keshAsthirAshInAM bhasmanashcAdhirohaNam||36||
jalAshayAnAM shailAnAM vanAnAM jyotiShAmapi| shuShyatAM kShIyamANAnAM patatAM yacca darshanam||37||
tridoShajatvasAmAnyAt kuShThamanu rAjayakShmacikitsitamucyate| unmAdApasmArau dakShAdhvaroddhvaMsotpannAvapyAgantutvAnubandhatvAt pashcAduktau||1-2||

samprati yakShmarUpANi prapa~jcena vyAkhyAtumAha- rUpaM tvasyetyAdi| nirdekShyAmIti prapa~jcena kathayiShyAmi| tatra rUpavyAkaraNe kartavye rUpiNa eva tAvad yakShmaNaH sharIradhAtupoShaNavirodhakasya utpAdakramaM sharIradhAtupoShaNakramakathanapUrvamAha- yathAsvenetyAdi| yathAsvena yathAtmIyena, UShmaNA rasAgnyAdirUpeNa trayodashavidhena| dhAtuH puShyati dhAtuneti dhAtunA rasena, dhAtU raktAdirUpaH; kiMvA kramapariNAmapakShe rasena raktaM, raktena mAMsaM puShyatIti j~jeyam| evaM dhAtupoShaNakramaM darshayitvA yakShmaNi tadvirodhamAha- srotasAmityAdi| sannirodhAditi yakShmakArakadoSheNAvaruddhatvAt; raktAdisa~gkShayo~api srotovarodhAttathA poShakarasAprAbalyAcca j~jeyaH; dhAtUShmApacayo~api dhAtukShayAddoShaprabhAvAcca j~jeyaH| yathA dhAtupoShakarasahAnirbhavati tathA~a~aha- tasminnityAdi| ojase iti sArabhAgAya, rasAyeti yAvat| visheShAdrAjayakShmiNa itivacanenAnyeShAmapi durbalAnAM purIShaM rakShyamiti sUcayati| viDbalamiti viDAdhAram| yashcApi rasa utpadyate sa ca dhAtUnna puShNAti, kintu svasthAnastho vidahyate; svasthAnastha iti hRudayasthaH| sarvairiti ekAdashabhiH| ardhairiti ShaDbhiH, ekAdashasya jyeShThabhAgaparigrahAt ShaDevArdhaM bhavati; dRuShTA caiShA vidhA, yathA- “triMshanmatAH karmasu bastayo hi, kAlastato~ardhena tatashca yogaH” (si.a.1) ityAdau, triMshadbastyardharUpaH kAlaH shreShThabhAgaparigrahAt ShoDashabastirUpa eva, “kAle trayo~ante puratastathaikaH snehA nirUhAntaritAshca ShaT syuH” (si.a.1) ityanenoktaH| tribhirityatra yAni kAni trINi yakShmaNo rUpANi j~jeyAni, shRu~ggagrAhikayA~anirdeshAt| anye tu ‘aMsapArshvAbhitApashca’ ityAdivakShyamANalakShaNatrayaM varNayanti| kecittu ‘aMsapArshvAbhitApashca’ ityAdikaM yakShmasambandhijvaralakShaNaM vadanti| anyatheti balamAMsayoge sati||38-47||

pratishyAyaM vivRuNoti- ghrANetyAdi| mArutAdhmAtashiraso mArutapUrNashirasaH| mArutaM prati shyAyate gacchatItyarthaH| mArutAnugataM ghrANAt sravati| ghrANaviplavaH gandhAghrANAdirUpaH| yakShmA cAtaH prajAyata iti anenoktalakShaNapratishyAyasyaiva pUrvarUpatAmapi sUcayati||48-50||

svarabhedaM vibhajate- vAtAdityAdi| vaktumasUyata iti vaktuM necchati| khurakhurAyata iti khurakhurAshabdaM karoti| sannaH avasannaH| kaShaNa iti kaNThaM kaShati, hinastIti yAvat| pArshvashUlaM tvaniyatamiti na sa~gkocarUpeNa niyataM, kintu kadAcidAyAmarUpaM kadAcit sa~gkocarUpaM, na sarvadAbhAvi| shiraHshUlatvena vAyuH, sasantApatvena pittaM, sagauravatvena shleShmA, evaM tridoShajanyatvaM j~jeyam||53-56||

kevalarudhiracchardanena yuktaM vivRuNoti- raktamityAdi| vibaddhamArgatvAditi raktasya mAMsAdyabhigame yo mArgastannirodhAnmAMsAdabhigacchadraktaM mAMsAshaye eva kRutAdhiShThAnaM prasravaNajalamiva vibaddhamArgatvAdbahu bhavati, bahutvenotkliShTaM dvArAntarAgamanAt kaNThameti| evaM raktasya poShakarasenAsambandhAt kShIyamANasyAmAshaye eva bahutvaM j~jeyam| tena raktAdInAM ca sa~gkShayAdityanena raktakShayo ya uktaH sa upapanna eva||58-59||

divaukasAmityAdinA prAgutpattiM yakShmaNo darshayati| etayA ca prAgutpattyA dhAtukShayo rAjayakShmaNaH pradhAnaM kAraNaM, tathA bhAryAsvasamavartitayA~adharmashca kAraNaM, bhavatIti darshyate| kAmavyasanasaMyuktA strIpuMsa~ggasambandhA | dehaH snehaparikShayAditi dehasArakShayAt; snehashabdena hi sAravAcinA shukraujasI grAhye| avadhyAtamiti krodhena cintitam| gurukrodheneti yakShmarUpeNa| shuddhAM matiM buddhveti svAparAdhajanitamAtmanaH kShayaM buddhvA candramasaH svadoShaparihArArthaM shuddhAM buddhiM j~jAtvA| vimuktagraha iti graheNa yakShmAkhyena vimuktaH| sattvaM manaH| shuddhamiti nirdoSham||3-12||

rogAdhikAre “pa~jca bhaktasyAnashanasthAnAnIti vAtapittakaphadveShAyAsAH” (sU.a.19) ityanena yadyapi tridoShajA~arucirnoktA, tathA~api cikitsArthaM dvandvajagulmavattridoShajA~arucirucyate| vakShyati- “caturo~arocakAn hanyurvAtAdyekajasarvajAn” iti| iyaM ca tridoShajA~aruciH prakRutisamavAyArabdhA, tena rogAdhikAre pratyekadoShajArucigrahaNenaiva gRuhItA| prakRutisamasamavAyArabdhatvenaiva tridoShajAruceH pRuthaglakShaNaM noktam; ato vAtAdilakShaNamelakameva tasyA lakShaNam| kaShAyamukharasatA vAtajAyAM, tiktamukharasatA pittajAyAM, madhuramukharasatA kaphajAyAM, tridoShajAyAM tu tridoShamukharasatonneyA| doShadarshanAditi dviShTadarshanAt||60-61||

samprati sarveShAM yakShmaNAM sAmAnyarUpaM tridoShajatvaM pratipAdya, doShabalAbalabhedena ca bhedaM sUcayitvA, sAmAnyAM visheShAM ca cikitsAM sUcayannAha- sarva ityAdi| vividhA iti bhinnAH, sAdhAraNIrityanenAbhinnAshca shRuNviti yojyam| tatra vividhAH pratyekaM pInasAdivihitA j~jeyAH, sAdhAraNIstu ShaDa~ggAjarasAdirUpAH sAdhAraNavihitA j~jeyAH||63-64||
sapippalIkamityAdike rase yavAgUsAdhanavaddravyAdimAnaM j~jeyaM; mAMsamAnaM tu palAni dvAdasha| sUpasaMskRutairiti suShThUpasaMskRutaiH| teneti pa~jcamUlyAdisaMskRutajalena||65-70||

tilataNDulamAShaistu kRusharA j~jeyA| patrabha~ggeneti patrabha~ggakvAthena; patrabha~ggAshca vAtaharapallavAH| savAtikairiti vAtikottaravAtikaiH; tantrAntare tu vAtikAnyuttaravAtikAni ca gaNena paThitAni; yathA- “bilvo~agnimanthaH kAshmaryaM shreyasI pATalA balA| shAlaparNI pRushniparNI bRuhatI kaNTakArikA|| vardhamAno mUlakaM ca vAtikAnyavatArayet| karamardaM sabadaraM kulatthAH shuShkamUlakam|| shvadaMShTrA veNuparNI ca sAshvagandhA shatAvarI| RuShyaproktAM guDUcI ca madhukaM shigrureva ca|| yavAnyAragvadhashcaiva yaccAnyatki~jcidIdRusham| sarvametadvijAnIyAdbhiShaguttaravAtikam” iti| nADIsvedaM prayojayediti nADIsvedaM yathAyogyatayA prayojayet| jIvantyAdInAM pratyekamupanAhA j~jeyAH| vesavAro yathA- “nirasthi pishitaM piShTaM svinnaM guDaghRutAnvitam| kRuShNAmarIcasaMyuktaM vesavAra iti smRutaH” iti||71-76||
pala~gkaShA gugguluH| payasyA kShIrakAkolI| shiraHpArshvAMsashUlinAM shastA iti yojyam||77-81||

shRu~ggAlAbujalaukobhirityatra pittaduShTe jalaukA, kaphaduShTe rakte~alAbu j~jeyaM; yaduktaM- “pittAnvitaM jalaukobhiralAbvA tu kaphAnvitam| shoNitaM vAtaduShTaM tu viShANenAshu nirharet” iti| vyadhanaM tu sirAvyadharUpam||82-86||
yanna karshanamityanena mRuduvamanavirecanaM yanna karshanAyeti darshayati||87-88||

prapauNDarIkamityAdau kShIraM dravam| ye tu ‘kShIrasarpiH’ ityekapadena paThanti, te kShIrotthaM sarpirjalenaiva pAcayanti| ghRutaM cauttarabhaktikamiti uktameva ghRutaM bhaktottaraM shiraHshUlAdiharaM bhavati| dashamUleneti atrAvAntarasAhacaryAddashamUlasya kvAtho j~jeyaH, balAyA eva kalkaH; kiMvA ‘dashamUlena payasA’ iti pAThaH; tena dashamUlasiddhena kShIreNetyarthaH| rAsnAghRutaM vA rAsnAkShIraM vA rogAnetAn prabAdhata iti yojanA; tathA balAghRutaM balAkShIraM ca prabAdhate iti yojanA| kAse vakShyamANaM yad rAsnAghRutaM, balAghRutaM ca vAtarakte vakShyamANaM, tat kShIreNa sahopayuktametAn rogAn prabAdhata ityAcAryo vakShyati| sapippalIkaM sakShaudramityatra pippalIkShaudrayoH prakShepyatvaM j~jeyam| pa~jcabhiH pa~jcamUlairvA yadghRutamudiyAttat sapippalIkaM sakShaudraM svarabodhanamityAdiyojanA| pa~jcAnAmityAdinA yogAntaramAha| rase kShIracaturguNa iti pa~jcAnAM pa~jcamUlInAM kvAthastriguNaH, ghRutasamaM ca kShIraM j~jeyam| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “dashamUlashRutakShIrAjjAtaM sarpirnavaM pippalImadhuyuktaM yat, pa~jcapa~jcamUlakvathitAdutthitaM ca yat tribhAgakvathitatulyapayaske pakvam” iti| phalashrutau ‘yakShmaNaH saptakaM balam’ ityanena ‘svarabhedaM’ ityAdinA ye sapta gadAH paThitAste j~jeyAH; teShu ca hikkA paThitA, sA ca rAjayakShmalakShaNeShu yadyapi na paThitA, tathA~apyupadravarUpA j~jeyA| puShkarAkhyaM puShkaramUlam||89-102||

sitopalAdAvantyAdUrdhvaM dviguNitamiti antyAyAstvaca eko bhAgaH, bahulAyA bhAgadvayaM, pippalyA bhAgacatuShTayaM, tugAkShIrI vaMshalocanAnukAri pArthivaM dravyaM, tasyAShTabhAgAH, sitopalAyAstu ShoDasha| Urdhvashabdena cehAtItamucyate, vivakShyamANordhvAdhobhAgasyAsthAnAt; tena kvacit UrdhvamityAdAvAgato~api Urdhvashabdashcarati||103-104||

durAlabhAdye paceddashaguNe toye ityanena ghRutAddashaguNatoyeneti j~jeyaM, dravyAddashaguNatoyena kvAthasyAlpatvaM syAt; prasthaghRutAttu dashaguNatoye dashabhAgAvashiShTe prasthamAnatvaM kaShAyasya bhavati, tacca jatUkarNAnumatam||106-110||
jIvantyAdau pUrvayogoktaM kShIrayuktameva kvAthaM dravamicchanti; TIkAkRutastu bahavo jalameva dravaM vadanti||111-113||
balAmityAdi| atra ghRute kShIrakvAthakalkasAdhye kvAthakShIre militvA caturguNe, kalkadravyaM cAShTabhAgena j~jeyaM, madhu ca prakShepArthe yojyam||114-116||

jvarANAmityAdinA~a~avasthikaM vidhimAha| vAmanIyAni madanaphalAdIni| sadIpanamiti dIpanashuNThyAdisAdhitam| vamyAM saiva prashasyata ityatra kaphapraseko dvividhaH- svatantraH kaphakRutaH, tathA vAtaparAdhInoktaH; evaM chardimapi dvidhA vibhajya kaphaprasekakriyAnusAreNa shleShmapradhAnAyAM vamanAdi, vAtapradhAnAyAM snigdhoShNasevAnurUpA kriyA shasyata iti yojyam| khaDo vyAkRutaH| anye~api vadanti- “pishitena rasastatra, yUSho dhAnyaiH, khalaH phalaiH| mUlaishca tilakalkAmlaprAyaH kAmbalikaH smRutaH” iti||117-133||-

nidAnoktamapi rAjayakShmahetvAdi punaH prakaraNavashAt ki~jcinnidAnoktavisheShavidhitsayocyate| uktaM kAraNacatuShkaM prapa~jcayati- yuddhetyAdi| sahasA shaktimanAlocya yAni kriyante tAni sAhasAni| ubhAviti kaphapitte| kShaNanAdityAdinA raktakaphaniShThIvanamekameva lakShaNam ‘uraHshUlAtipIDitaH’ ityantenocyate| uraHshUlam uroruk, raktaniShThIvanavisheShaNameva; tenaikAdasharUpatvaM pUryate eva||14-19||
dvau kAlAviti sAyamprAtaH| dantapavanamiti kara~jjakaravIrAdibhistiktakaTukaiH| tadvaditi tiktakaTukRutairjalaiH| tejohvA cavikA| mukhashodhanA iti mukhagatadoShashodhanAH||134-140||
yavAnIShADave varA~ggaM tvak| pippalInAmekaM shatamiti AkRutimAnAt||141-144||

tAlIshAdye shubhA iti visheShaNaM pippalyAH| uktaM hi hArIte- “tAlIshaM maricaM shuNThI pippalyo bhAgavardhitAH| tvagele~ardhAMshake dadyAccharkarA~aShTapalaM bhavet” ityAdi| tathA jatUkarNaH- “tAlIshamaricanAgarakRuShNAH karShAH, tvagele ardhAMshe, dvikuDavA sitA, guTikA vipAcyatAm” iti| tvagelayorardhabhAgatvam| guTikApakShe jalena sitopalAM paktvA guDikAH kurvanti vRuddhAH||145-148||

kalpitAnIti samyak saMskAreNa saMskRutAni| varmishabdena sarpAkAro dIrgho matsyavisheSho grAhyaH| gaNDUpadaH bhUmilatA| lopAkaH alpashRugAlo lA~ggUlapradhAnaH| sampratyasyAnyamAMsaprayogamAha- mAMsAnItyAdi| anabhyAsAditi abhakShyatvena| upadheti anyashabdena dAnamiti yAvat| tatheti sa~jj~jAntareNa dAne sukhaM yathA bhavati tathA bhoktuM shakyate| abhakShyatve tu j~jAte doShamAha- jAnannityAdi| yoniraShTavidheti “prasahA” (su.sU.a.27) ityAdinA proktA| sakShaudramiti cchedaH| payasetyAdi dvitIyaM ghRutam| madhurakANi yAni tAni ceha kalkArtham| pippalItyAdinA~aniyatamAnaM ghRutaM caturguNena kShIreNa sAdhyate, ShaTpaloktadravyaghRutamAnavat||149-172||

uttIrNamityAdau punarAktairiti mishrakasnehairAktaiH karaiH punaH punaH mardayet; punarAktamiti pAThe tu punarmishrakaiH snehairAktamityarthaH| utsAdayediti udvartayet| vikasA ma~jjiShThA| tarkArI jayA| samAkShikamiti IShanmAkShikam||173-178||-

ataH paraM manasa AnukUlyaM yakShmArambhakadoShaM hantItyato sarvAsu ceShTAsu sadaiva manonukUlaM syAttathaiva vartanIyaM, yayA ca yuktyA daivavyapAshrayacikitsA kartavyA tadAha- gandhairityAdi||179-189||
hrImattvAdityAdinA vegasandhAraNajamAha| varcobhedaM trilakShaNamiti pRuthagvAtAdijanitatridoShali~ggayuktamityarthaH||20-23||

IrShyetyAdinA dhAtukShayajamAha| oja iti rasaH, rase~apyojaHshabdo vartate; yaduktaM- “malIbhavati tat prAyaH kalpate ki~jcidojase” iti; kiMvA ojo dehasya sAram| snehakShayAditi dehasArashukraujaHkShayAt| kShayAt prANakShayapradamityatra kShayahetutvAt kShayaH; ‘prANakShayAvaham’ iti vA pAThaH||24-27||

vividhAnItyAdinA viShamAshanajamAha| vaiShamyeNeti prakRutikaraNAdyaShTAhAravidhivaiShamyeNa| vaiShamyAdatipravRuddhA vAtAdayo viShamamunmArgeNa gatAH santaH rudhirAdInAM srotAMsi ruddhvA rogAya yakShmarUpAya kalpanta iti yojanA| yathAkramamiti pratishyAyamityAdiprathamashlokArdhavihitaM kaphakRutaM, dvitIyashlokArdhavihitaM pittakRutaM, sheShaM tu vAtakRutam| atra pratyekamekAdashalakShaNapAThena ekAdashalakShaNayogenaiva rAjayakShmaNaH sampUrNatvaM prAyo bhavatIti darshayati| yattu ShaDlakShaNatvaM trilakShaNatvaM vA yakShmaNo vakShyati, tadasampUrNalakShaNasyaiva j~jeyam| nanu shoShANAmayathAbalamArambhAdijatvabhedena cAturvidhyakathanena kiM? yatastAni tAnyeva lakShaNAni sarvatra bhavanti; tathAca sarve~api tridoShajAH tenaikarUpatvAbhidhAnameva yuktam; uktaM ca shalye- “ekAdashAnAmekatra sAnnidhyAttantrayuktitaH| kriyANAM cAvibhAgena prAgekotpAdanena ca|| eka eva mataH shoShaH sannipAtAtmako gadaH” (su.u.a.41) iti, ihApi coktaM- “sarvastridoShajo yakShmA” ityAdi| maivaM, hetulakShaNacikitsitena caturNAmapi bhedAdbhinna eveti yuktam| tatra hetavo~ayathAbalamArambhAdaya uktA eva; li~ggaM ca bhinnaM sAhasaje kaNThoddhvaMsa uroruk jRumbhA ca; vegasandhAraNaje ca a~ggamardo muhushchardistathA varcobhedastrilakShaNaH, anyatra hi varcobhedastrilakShaNo na bhavati; kShayaje shvAsapArshvashUlAMsasantApAH; viShamAshanaje chardanaM rudhirasya; sAhasaje pratishyAyAbhAvaH, sheSheShu pratishyAya ityAdilakShaNabhedaH| cikitsitabhedastu asAdhAraNalakShaNe cikitsAbhedakRuta eva; tasmAdbhedo yakShmaNAM yukta eva; tantrAntare tu sthUladRuShTyA abheda uktaH; ihApi sthUladRushA “sarvastridoShajo j~jeyaH” ityAdinA~abheda ukta eva; sUkShmacintAyAM tvayameva bheda ukto j~jeyaH| punashca “kAso~a~ggatApa” ityAdinA doShalakShaNAni vakShyati, tat sAmAnyena yakShmaNaH prAyobhAvilakShaNaM caturShvapi samuccityoktamiti j~jeyaM; tena na paunaruktyam||28-32||

samprati caturNAmapi sAdhAraNaM pUrvarUpamAha- pUrvarUpamityAdi| pratishyAyashca rUpe paThitaH; tena pratishyAyaH pUrvarUpAntarasahitaH pUrvarUpaM bhavati, rUpAntarasahitastu rUpamiti visheShaH| na caika eva pratishyAyaH pUrvarUpArtho~api vyAdhyavasthAyAM vartamAnatvAdariShTaM bhavati, “pUrvarUpANi sarvANi” (iM.a.5) ityAdinA sarvapUrvarUpAnuvartanaM vyAdhau riShTamuktam| kAye bIbhatsadarshanamiti vikRutidarshanam| makShikAdInAmannapAne ca patanAnIti yojyam| patatryAdibhirabhidharShaNaM svapne j~jeyaM; patatriNaH pakShiNaH, shvApadA vyAghrAdayaH| keshAsthirAshInAmityAdau yacca darshanamityantaM ‘svapne’ ityunuvartate||33-37||-
athAta unmAdacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

buddhismRutij~jAnataponivAsaH punarvasuH prANabhRutAM sharaNyaH| unmAdahetvAkRutibheShajAni kAle~agniveshAya shashaMsa pRuShTaH||3||

Commentary: buddhiH UhApohavatI, smRutiH atItArthaviShayaj~jAnaM, tapaH cAndrAyaNAdi, teShAM nivAsa Ashraya ityarthaH| unmAdahetvadItyAdau hetugrahaNenAtra vaktavyAH samprAptisthitirUpakAlA unmAdagamyahetuviShayatayA gRuhyante| AkRutigrahaNenAbhidheyasyonmAdasvarUpasya grahaNaM j~jeyam||3||

devarShigandharvapishAcayakSharakShaHpitRUNAmabhidharShaNAni| AgantuheturniyamavratAdi mithyAkRutaM karma ca pUrvadehe||16||

Commentary: devarShItyAdinA~a~agantUnmAdamAha| iha ye~asurAdayaHsushrutoktAste~anAviShkRutatamA vij~jeyAH| vakShyati ca- “ityaparisa~gkhyeyAnAM grahANAmAviShkRutatamA hyaShTAvete vyAkhyAtA” iti| atra ca rakShaHshabdena rAkShasabrahmarAkShasayorgrahaNaM, tena vivaraNe brahmarAkShasonmatto~apyuktaH| abhidharShaNam AveshaH| niyametyAdinA aihikaM karma devAdyAveshakAraNaM brUte; mithyAkRutaM karma cetyanena pUrvajanmakRutaM karma Aha||16||

amartyavAgvikramavIryaceShTo j~jAnAdivij~jAnabalAdibhiryaH| unmAdakAlo~aniyatashca yasya bhUtotthamunmAdamudAharettam||17||

Commentary: amartyetyAdinA~a~agantUnAM sAmAnyali~ggAnyAha| amartyaiH amAnuShairvAgAdibhirlakShitaM bhUtotthamudAharet| aniyata iti vAtikAdivanna AhArajIrNAdikAlaniyataH; ye tu ‘niyata’ iti paThanti, teShAM vakShyamANaniyatatithyAdInAM grahaNamabhipretam||17||

adUShayantaH puruShasya dehaM devAdayaH svaistu guNaprabhAvaiH| vishantyadRushyAstarasA yathaiva cchAyAtapau darpaNasUryakAntau||18||

Commentary: adUShayanta IShaddUShayantaH| guNaprabhAvairiti aNimAdiguNaprabhAvaiH| tarasA ativegena| dRuShTAntadvayamAha- chAyetyAdi| chAyA yathA darpaNam, AtapaH sUryakAntama, adUShayannevAdRushyamAnaguNaprabhAveNAvishati, tathA devAdayo~api dehaM vishantItyarthaH||18||

AghAtakAlo hi sa pUrvarUpaH prokto nidAne~atha surAdibhishca| unmAdarUpANi pRutha~gnibodha kAlaM ca gamyAn puruShAMshca teShAm||19||

Commentary: AghAtakAla iti AveshAvakAshaH; sa ca nidAne “tadyathA- pApasya karmaNaH samArambhe” (ni.a.7) ityAdinoktaH| kAlaM tithirUpam||19||

tadyathA- saumyadRuShTiM gambhIramadhRuShyamakopanamasvapnabhojanAbhilAShiNamalpasvedamUtrapurIShavAtaM shubhagandhaM phullapadmavadanamiti devonmattaM vidyAt; guruvRuddhasiddharShINAmabhishApAbhicArAbhidhyAnAnurUpaceShTAhAravyAhAraM tairunmattaM vidyAt; aprasannadRuShTimapashyantaM nidrAluM pratihatavAcamanannAbhilAShamarocakAvipAkaparItaM ca pitRubhirunmattaM vidyAt; (caNDaM sAhasikaM tIkShNaM gambhIramadhRuShyaM) mukhavAdyanRutyagItAnnapAnasnAnamAlyadhUpagandharatiM raktavastrabalikarmahAsyakathAnuyogapriyaM shubhagandhaM ca gandharvonmattaM vidyAt; asakRutsvapnarodanahAsyaM nRutyagItavAdyapAThakathAnnapAnasnAnamAlyadhUpagandharatiM raktaviplutAkShaM dvijAtivaidyaparivAdinaM rahasyabhAShiNaM ca yakShonmattaM vidyAt; naShTanidramannapAnadveShiNamanAhAramapyatibalinaM shastrashoNitamAMsaraktamAlyAbhilAShiNaM santarjakaM ca rAkShasonmattaM vidyAt; prahAsanRutyapradhAnaM devavipravaidyadveShAvaj~jAbhiH stutivedamantrashAstrodAharaNaiH kAShThAdibhirAtmapIDanena ca brahmarAkShasonmattaM vidyAt; asvasthacittaM sthAnamalabhamAnaM nRutyagItahAsinaM baddhAbaddhapralApinaM sa~gkarakUTamalinarathyAcelatRuNAshmakAShThAdhirohaNaratiM bhinnarUkShasvaraM nagnaM vidhAvantaM naikatra tiShThantaM duHkhAnyAvedayantaM naShTasmRutiM ca pishAconmattaM vidyAt||20||

Commentary: svapnabhojanAbhilAShI na bhavatIti asvapnabhojanabhilAShI| devAdishabdeneha sushrutamatAddevAdyanukAriNastadanucarA j~jeyAH| uktaM hi sushrutena- “na te manuShyaiH saha saMvishanti na vA manuShyAn kvacidAvishanti| ye tvAvishantIti vadanti mohAtte bhUtavidyAviShayAdapohyAH|| teShAM grahANAM paricArakA ye koTIsahasrAyutapadmasa~gkhyAH|| asRugvasAmAMsabhujaH subhImA nishAvihArAshca tamAvishanti” (su.u.a.60) iti| RuShisadharmatayA gurvAdInAmasUtritAnAmapyudAharaNam| gurvAdyabhishApAdayo yAdRushenAbhiprAyeNa bhavanti tadanurUpaceShTAdayo~api tairunmattasya bhavantIti gurvAdigranthArthaH| anannAbhilAShaH annAprArthanA, arocakastu prArthite~apyupayogasamaye~anabhilAShaH| caNDamiti mAraNAtmakam| stutiH stAvako granthaH| udAharaNamiti paThanaM stutyAdInAmeva| sthAnamalabhamAnamiti sthAnameva nAstIti bhAShamANam| baddhAbaddhatvaM sambaddhAsambaddhatvam| sa~gkaraH tRuNAdicaya ityarthaH||20||

tatra caukShAcAraM tapaHsvAdhyAyakovidaM naraM prAyaH shuklapratipadi trayodashyAM ca chidramavekShyAbhidharShayanti devAH, snAnashuciviviktasevinaM dharmashAstrashrutivAkyakushalaM prAyaH ShaShThyAM navamyAM carShayaH, mAtRupitRuguruvRuddhasiddhAcAryopasevinaM prAyo dashamyAmamAvasyAyAM ca pitaraH, gandharvAH stutigItavAditraratiM paradAragandhamAlyapriyaM caukShAcAraM prAyo dvAdashyAM caturdashyAM ca, sattvabalarUpagarvashauryayuktaM mAlyAnulepanahAsyapriyamativAkkaraNaM prAyaH shuklaikAdashyAM saptamyAM ca yakShAH, svAdhyAyataponiyamopavAsabrahmacaryadevayatigurupUjA~aratiM bhraShTashaucaM brAhmaNamabrAhmaNaM vA brAhmNavAdinaM shUramAninaM devAgArasalilakrIDanaratiM prAyaH shuklapa~jcamyAM pUrNacandradarshane ca brahmarAkShasAH, rakShaHpishAcAstu hInasattvaM pishunaM straiNaM lubdhaM shaThaM prAyo dvitIyAtRutIyAShTamIShu; ityaparisa~gkhyeyAnAM grahANAmAviShkRutatamA hyaShTAvete vyAkhyAtAH||21||

Commentary: tatra caukShAcAramityAdinA~abhigamanIyapuruShAn kAlaM ca pRuthagAha| caukShaH shuciH AcAro yasya sa caukShAcAraH| caukShAcArAdishubhakarmayuktAH shubhakarmatayA yadyapi unmAdAnarhAstathA~api prAktanakarmavashAtte devAdibhirunmAdyanta iti j~jeyam| ativAkkaraNamiti atibhAShamANam| chidramiti ucchiShTAvasthAnAdirUpamapacAram| samprati bhUtavidyAdhikAratvAdbhautikonmAdasya leshakathanamihAshUnyatArthaM, tenApare~apyunmAdakabhUtAH santIti darshayannAha- aparisa~gkhyeyAnAmityAdi||21||

sarveShvapi tu khalveShu yo hastAvudyamya roShasaMrambhAnniHsha~gkamanyeShvAtmani vA nipAtayet sa hyasAdhyo j~jeyaH; tathA yaH sAshrunetro meDhrapravRuttaraktaH kShatajihvaH prasrutanAsikashchidyamAnacarmA~apratihanyamAnavANiH satataM vikUjan durvarNastRuShArtaH pUtigandhashca sa hiMsArthinonmatto j~jeyaH; taM parivarjayet||22||

Commentary: asAdhyabhUtajonmAdamAha- sarveShvityAdi| hiMsArthI mArAtmakaH| apratihanyamAnavANiriti nityavAgityarthaH| trividho bhUto bhavati ratyarcanahiMsAbhedena| tatra hiMsArthinA gRuhIto~asAdhyo bhavati, ata evAsAdhyabhUtonmAde uktaM- hiMsArthinonmata iti||22||

ratyarcanAkAmonmAdinau tu bhiShagabhiprAyAcArAbhyAM buddhvA tada~ggopahArabalimishreNa| mantrabhaiShajyavidhinopakramet||23||

Commentary: ratyarcanArthibhUtagRuhItacikitsAmAha- ratyarcanetyAdi| ratikAmo~arcanAkAmashca ratyarcanAkAmau, tAbhyAmunmAditau ratyarcanAkAmonmAditau| abhiprAyAcArAbhyAM buddhveti abhiprAyeNa yaH kAmyamarthamicchati sa ratikAmaH, yastu pUjAmicchati sa arcanAkAmaH; evamAcAreNa yaH kAmyArthaprAptyarthaM ceShTate sa ratikAmaH, yo~arcanArthaM puShpadhUpAdikamanviShyati so~arcanAkAmaH, iti buddhvA tada~ggaratyupahArAdi kartavyaM; tasyA raterarcanAyAshca yada~ggasAdhanaM tattadvartanena tattada~ggopahArarUpabalinA bhaiShajyamantravidhinA copacAraH kartavya iti vAkyArthaH||23||
tatra dvayorapi nijAgantunimittayorunmAdayoH samAsavistarAbhyAM bheShajavidhimanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||24||
unmAde vAtaje pUrvaM snehapAnaM visheShavit| kuryAdAvRutamArge tu sasnehaM mRudu shodhanam||25||
kaphapittodbhave~apyAdau vamanaM savirecanam| snigdhasvinnasya kartavyaM shuddhe saMsarjanakramaH||26||
nirUhaM snehabastiM ca shirasashca virecanam| tataH kuryAdyathAdoShaM teShAM bhUyastvamAcaret||27||
hRudindriyashiraHkoShThe saMshuddhe vamanAdibhiH| manaHprasAdamApnoti smRutiM sa~jj~jAM ca vindati||28||
shuddhasyAcAravibhraMshe tIkShNaM nAvanama~jjanam| tADanaM ca manobuddhidehasaMvejanaM hitam||29||
yaH sakto~avinaye paTTaiH saMyamya sudRuDhaiH sukhaiH| apetalohakAShThAdye saMrodhyashca tamogRuhe||30||
tarjanaM trAsanaM dAnaM harShaNaM sAntvanaM bhayam| vismayo vismRuterhetornayanti prakRutiM manaH||31||
pradehotsAdanAbhya~ggadhUmAH pAnaM ca sarpiShaH| prayoktavyaM manobuddhismRutisa~jj~jAprabodhanam||32||
ataH siddhatamAnyogA~jchRuNUnmAdavinAshanAn||33||
hi~ggusauvarcalavyoShairdvipalAMshairghRutADhakam| caturguNe gavAM mUtre siddhamunmAdanAshanam||34||
vishAlA triphalA kauntI devadArvelavAlukam| sthirA nataM rajanyau dve sArive dve priya~ggukA||35||
nIlotpalailAma~jjiShThAdantIdADimakesharam| tAlIshapatraM bRuhatI mAlatyAH kusumaM navam||36||
viDa~ggaM pRushniparNI ca kuShThaM candanapadmakau| aShTAviMshatibhiH kalkairetairakShasamanvitaiH||37||
caturguNe jale samyagghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet| apasmAre jvare kAse shoShe mande~anale kShaye||38||
vAtarakte pratishyAye tRutIyakacaturthake| chardyarshomUtrakRucchreShu visarpopahateShu ca||39||
kaNDUpANDvAmayonmAdaviShamehagadeShu ca| bhUtopahatacittAnAM gadgadAnAmacesAm||40||
shastaM strINAM ca vandhyAnAM dhanyamAyurbalapradam| alakShmIpAparakShoghnaM sarvagrahavinAshanam||41||
kalyANakamidaM sarpiH shreShThaM puMsavaneShu caiti kalyANakaM ghRutam
ebhya eva sthirAdIni jale paktvaikaviMshatim||42||
rase tasmin pacet sarpirgRuShTikShIre caturguNe| vIrArdramAShakAkolIsvaya~gguptarShabhardhibhiH||43||
medayA ca samaiH kalkaistat syAt kalyANakaM mahat| bRuMhaNIyaM visheSheNa sannipAtaharaM param||44||
iti mahAkalyANakaM ghRutam
jaTilAM pUtanAM keshIM cAraTIM markaTIM vacAm| trAyamANAM jayAM vIrAM corakaM kaTurohiNIm||45||
vayaHsthAM shUkarIM chatrAmaticchatrAM pala~gkaShAm| mahApuruShadantAM ca kAyasthAM nAkulIdvayam||46||
kaTambharAM vRushcikAlIM sthirAM cAhRutya tairghRutam| siddhaM cAturthakonmAdagrahApasmAranAshanam||47||
mahApaishAcikaM nAma ghRutametadyathA~amRutam| buddhismRutikaraM caiva bAlAnAM cA~ggavardhanam||48||
iti mahApaishAcikaM ghRutam

viruddhaduShTAshucibhojanAni pradharShaNaM devagurudvijAnAm| unmAdaheturbhayaharShapUrvo mano~abhighAto viShamAshca ceShTAH||4||

Commentary: sampratyunmAdahetumAha- viruddhetyAdi| viruddhaM payaHsaMyuktamatsyAdi, duShTaM garAdi atyarthadoShajanakaM ca, ashuci apavitram| bhayaharShapUrvo mano~abhighAta iti atra pUrvashabdaH kAraNavAcI, tena bhayaharShakAraNako mano~abhighAta ityarthaH| etadviruddhAhArAdi yathAsambhavaM kAraNaM j~jeyam| bhayaharShAvupalakShaNau, tena krodhAdayo~api manobhighAtakA atra j~jeyAH| krodhAdinA pratyAhate manasi bhayaharShapUrvaka evonmAdo bhavati||4||
lashunAnAM shataM triMshadabhayAstryUShaNAt palam| gavAM carmamasIprastho dvyADhakaM kShIramUtrayoH||49||
purANasarpiShaH prastha ebhiH siddhaM prayojayet| hi~ggucUrNapalaM shIte dattvA ca madhumANikAm||50||
taddoShAgantusambhUtAnunmAdAn viShamajvarAn| apasmArAMshca hantyAshu pAnAbhya~jjananAvanaiH||51||
iti lashunAdyaM ghRutamlashunasyAvinaShTasya tulArdhaM nistuShIkRutam| tadardhaM dashamUlasya dvyADhake~apAM vipAcayet||52||
pAdasheShe ghRutaprasthaM lashunasya rasaM tathA| kolamUlakavRukShAmlamAtulu~ggArdrakai rasaiH||53||
dADimAmbusurAmastukA~jjikAmlaistadardhikaiH| sAdhayettriphalAdArulavaNavyoShadIpyakaiH||54||
yavAnIcavyahi~ggvamlavetasaishca palArdhikaiH| siddhametat pibecchUlagulmArshojaTharApaham||55||
bradhnapANDvAmayaplIhayonidoShajvarakRumIn| vAtashleShmAmayAn sarvAnunmAdAMshcApakarShati||56||
ityaparaM lashunAdyaM ghRutam
hi~ggunA hi~gguparNyA ca sakAyasthavayaHsthayA| siddhaM sarpirhitaM tadvadvayaHsthAhi~ggucorakaiH||57||
kevalaM siddhamebhirvA purANaM pAyayedghRutam| pAyayitvottamAM mAtrAM shvabhre rundhyAdgRuhe~api vA||58||
visheShataH purANaM ca ghRutaM taM pAyayedbhiShak| tridoShaghnaM pavitratvAdvisheShAdgrahanAshanam||59||
guNakarmAdhikaM pAnAdAsvAdAt kaTutiktakam| ugragandhaM purANaM syAddashavarShasthitaM ghRutam||60||
lAkShArasanibhaM shItaM taddhi sarvagrahApaham| medhyaM virecaneShvagryaM prapurANamataH param||61||
nAsAdhyaM nAma tasyAsti yat syAdvarShashatasthitam| dRuShTaM spRuShTamathAghrAtaM taddhi sarvagrahApaham||62||
etAnauShadhayogAn vA vidheyatvamagacchati||63||
a~jjanotsAdanAlepanAvanAdiShu yojayet| shirISho madhukaM hi~ggu lashunaM tagaraM vacA||64||
kuShThaM ca bastamUtreNa piShTaM syAnnAvanA~jjanam| tadvadvyoShaM haridre dve ma~jjiShThAhi~ggusarShapAH||65||
shirIShabIjaM conmAdagrahApasmAranAshanam| piShTvA tulyamapAmArgaM hi~ggvAlaM hi~ggupatrikAm||66||
vArtiH syAnmaricArdhAMshA pittAbhyAM goshRugAlayoH| tayA~a~jjayedapasmArabhUtonmAdajvarArditAn||67||
bhUtArtAnamarArtAMshca narAMshcaiva dRugAmaye| maricaM cAtape mAMsaM sapittaM sthitama~jjanam||68||
vaikRutaM pashyataH kAryaM doShabhUtahatasmRuteH| siddhArthako vacA hi~ggu kara~jjo devadAru ca||69||
ma~jjiShThA triphalA shvetA kaTabhItvak kaTutrikam| samAMshAni priya~ggushca shirISho rajanIdvayam||70||
bastamUtreNa piShTo~ayamagadaH pAnama~jjanam| nasyamAlepanaM caiva snAnamudvartanaM tathA||71||
apasmAraviShonmAdakRutyAlakShmIjvarApahaH| bhUtebhyashca bhayaM hanti rAjadvAre ca shasyate||72||
sarpiretena siddhaM vA sagomUtraM tadarthakRut| praseke pInase gandhairdhUmavartiM kRutAM pibet||73||
vairecanikadhUmoktaiH shvetAdyairvA sahi~ggubhiH| shallakolUkamArjArajambUkavRukabastajaiH||74||
mUtrapittashakRullomanakhaishcarmabhireva ca| sekA~jjanaM pradhamanaM nasyaM dhUmaM ca kArayet||75||
... paittike tu prashasyate| tiktakaM jIvanIyaM ca sarpiH snehashca mishrakaH||76||
shItAni cAnnapAnAni madhurANi mRudUni ca| sha~gkhakeshAntasandhau vA mokShayejj~jo bhiShak sirAm| unmAde viShame caiva jvare~apasmAra eva ca||77||

ghRutamAMsavitRuptaM vA nivAte sthApayet sukham| tyaktvA matismRutibhraMshaM sa~jj~jAM labdhvA pramucyate ||78||

Commentary: mAMsaM ca yadyapi “nivRuttAmiShamadyo yaH” ityAdinonmAde niShiddhaM, tathA~apyevaMvidhaprayogeNa mAMsasya yaugikatvamAha| yathA- bhayaharShayorunmAdakAraNatve~api tau punarunmAde vidheyatvenocyete, “sAntvanaM harShaNaM bhayam” ityAdinA| anye tu nivRuttamAMsatvamAgantUnmAdaprashamanamiti vyAkhyAnayanti; teneha nije mAMsavidhAne bhinnaviShayatayA na virodha iti varNayanti | kintu nidAnoktasyApi mAMsasya yat svajanyavyAdhiprashamakatvaM tadapyatidRuShTatvAdaviruddhameva, tena pUrvameva samAdhAnamatra samIcInamiti pashyAmaH||78||
AshvAsayet suhRudvA taM vAkyairdharmArthasaMhitaiH| brUyAdiShTavinAshaM vA darshayedadbhutAni vA||79||
baddhaM sarShapatailAktaM nyasedvottAnamAtape| kapikacchvA~athavA taptairlohatailajalaiH spRushet||80||
kashAbhistADayitvA vA subaddhaM vijane gRuhe| rundhyAcceto hi vibhrAntaM vrajatyasya tathA shamam||81||
sarpeNoddhRutadaMShTreNa dAntaiH siMhairgajaishca tam| trAsayecchastrahastairvA taskaraiH shatrubhistathA||82||
athavA rAjapuruShA bahirnItvA susaMyatam| trAsayeyurvadhenainaM tarjayanto nRupAj~jayA||83||
dehaduHkhabhayebhyo hi paraM prANabhayaM smRutam| tena yAti shamaM tasya sarvato viplutaM manaH||84||
iShTadravyavinAshAttu mano yasyopahanyate| tasya tatsadRushaprAptisAntvAshvAsaiH shamaM nayet||85||
kAmashokabhayakrodhaharSherShyAlobhasambhavAn| parasparapratidvandvairebhireva shamaM nayet||86||
buddhvA deshaM vayaH sAtmyaM doShaM kAlaM balAbale| cikitsitamidaM kuryAdunmAde bhUtadoShaje||87||
devarShipitRugandharvairunmattasya tu buddhimAn| varjayeda~jjanAdIni tIkShNAni krUrakarma ca||88||
sarpiShpAnAdi tasyeha mRudu bhaiShajyamAcaret| pUjAM balyupahArAMshca mantrA~jjanavidhIMstathA||89||
shAntikarmeShTihomAMshca japasvastyayanAni ca| vedoktAn niyamAMshcApi prAyashcittAni cAcaret||90||
bhUtAnAmadhipaM devamIshvaraM jagataH prabhum| pUjayan prayato nityaM jayatyunmAdajaM bhayam||91||
rudrasya pramathA nAma gaNA loke caranti ye| teShAM pUjAM ca kurvANa unmAdebhyaH pramucyate||92||
balibhirma~ggalairhomairoShadhyagadadhAraNaiH| satyAcAratapoj~jAnapradAnaniyamavrataiH||93||
devagobrahmaNAnAM ca gurUNAM pUjanena ca| AgantuH prashamaM yAti siddhairmantrauShadhaistathA||94||
yaccopadekShyate ki~jcidapasmAracikitsite| unmAde tacca kartavyaM sAmAnyAddhetudUShyayoH||95||

tairalpasattvasya malAH praduShTA buddhernivAsaM hRudayaM pradUShya| srotAMsyadhiShThAya manovahAni pramohayantyAshu narasya cetaH||5||

Commentary: tairityAdinA samprAptimAha| alpasattvasya alpasattvaguNasya| hRudayaM yadyapi buddhinivAsatvenArthedashamahAmUlIyAdau pratipAditameva; tathA~api buddhinivAsatvopadarshanamiha kRutaM, hRudayopaghAtAdbuddhyupaghAto vakShyamANo yukta eva; AshrayopaghAtenAshritasyopaghAtaH siddha eva| srotAMsi ca manovahAnItyanena hRudayadeshasambandhidhamanyo visheSheNa manovahA darshayati; kiMvA kevalameva sharIraM mano~abhyanusyUtaM jagrAha| uktaM hi- “kevalamevAsya manasaH sharIramadhiShThAnabhUtaM” (vi.a.5) iti| ceta iti manaH||5||

nivRuttAmiShamadyo yo hitAshI prayataH shuciH| nijAgantubhirunmAdaiH sattvavAn na sa yujyate||96||

Commentary: nivRuttAmiSha ityAdirvyAkhyAta eva pUrvam||96||

prasAdashcendriyArthanAM buddhyAtmamanasAM tathA| dhAtUnAM prakRutisthatvaM vigatonmAdalakShaNam||97||

Commentary: kriyamANonmAdacikitsAyAH kashAtADanAdirUpatvenAtikaShTAyAH sphoTanArthaM vigatonmAdalakShaNamAha- prasAda ityAdi||97||

tatra shlokaH- unmAdAnAM samutthAnaM lakShaNaM sacikitsitam| nijAgantunimittAnAmuktavAn bhiShaguttamaH||98||

Commentary: unmAdAnAmityAdiH sa~ggrahaH||98||
dhIvibhramaH sattvapariplavashca paryAkulA dRuShTiradhIratA ca| abaddhavAktvaM hRudayaM ca shUnyaM sAmAnyamunmAdagadasya li~ggam||6||
sa mUDhacetA na sukhaM na duHkhaM nAcAradharmau kuta eva shAntim| vindatyapAstasmRutibuddhisa~jj~jo bhramatyayaM ceta itastatashca||7||
tasyodbhavaM pa~jcavidhaM pRuthak tu vakShyAmi li~ggAni cikitsitaM ca||8||
rUkShAlpashItAnnavirekadhAtukShayopavAsairanilo~ativRuddhaH| cintAdijuShTaM hRudayaM pradUShya buddhiM smRutiM cApyupahanti shIghram||9||
asthAnahAsasmitanRutyagItavAga~ggavikShepaNarodanAni| pAruShyakArshyAruNavarNatAshca jIrNe balaM cAnilajasya rUpam||10||
ajIrNakaTvamlavidAhyashItairbhojyaishcitaM pittamudIrNavegam| unmAdamatyugramanAtmakasya hRudi shritaM pUrvavadAshu kuryAt||11||
amarShasaMrambhavinagnabhAvAH santarjanAtidravaNauShNyaroShAH | pracchAyashItAnnajalAbhilAShAH pItA ca bhAH pittakRutasya li~ggam||12||
sampUraNairmandaviceShTitasya soShmA kapho marmaNi sampravRuddhaH| buddhiM smRutiM cApyupahatya cittaM pramohayan sa~jjanayedvikAram||13||
vAkceShTitaM mandamarocakashca nArIviviktapriyatA~atinidrA| chardishca lAlA ca balaM ca bhu~gkte nakhAdishauklyaM ca kaphAtmakasya||14||

yaH sannipAtaprabhavo~atighoraH sarvaiH samastaiH sa ca hetubhiH syAt| sarvANi rUpANi bibharti tAdRugvirudghabhaiShajyavidhirvivarjyaH||15||

Commentary: ya ityAdinA sAnnipAtikamAha| sarvairityukte pratyekamapi sarvahetUnAM janakatvaM syAdata Aha- samastairiti| viruddhabhaiShajyavidhitvAdvivarjyaH| kecidatra tAdRukshabdena ya eva samastahetujaH sarvalakShaNashca sa eva varjyo na tvalpahetulakShaNa iti vadanti||15||
idAnImupodghAtitaM rAjayakShmacikitsitamabhidhAya kramaprAptamunmAdacikitsitaM brUte| ayaM kramashcarakasaMskRutAM pa~jcAdhyAyImarsho~atIsAravIsarpamadAtyayadvivraNIyarUpAM parityajya j~jeyaH||1-2||

tatretyAdinA bheShajavidhAnamAha | visheShaviditi vAtasya nirAvaraNarUpaM visheShaM jAnan snehapAnaM vAtaje dadyAditi darshayati, sAvaraNe tu tanniShiddhameva; yaduktaM- “medaHkaphAbhyAmanilo niruddhaH shUlA~ggasuptishvayathUn karoti| snehaM niyu~jjannabudhastu tasmai saMvardhayatyeva hi tAn vikArAn” (si.a.1) iti| ihAvRutamArge kuryAdityAdinA visheShamAha| sasnehamiti IShatsneham| kaphapittodbhave iti kaphodbhave pittodbhave ca; tatra kaphodbhave vamanaM, pittodbhave virecanam| teShAmiti bastyAdInAm| bhUyastvaM punaH punaH prayogamAcaret; yathAdoShamityanena doShabhUyastve sati punaH punarapi prayogaM kuryAt| shodhanaphalamAha- hRudityAdi| hRudayAdishuddhyA ca manaHprasAdAdyapi bhavatyeva; tathA coktaM- “sharIramapi sattvamanuvidhIyate” (shA.a.5) ityAdi| saMvejanamiti udvejanam| avinaye iti parijanamAraNAdAvavinaye| paTTairityanena paTTabandhanaM na vraNakArI bhavatIti darshayati| saMyamyeti yathA niHsartuM na shaknoti tathA sthApanIyaH| lohAdyapanayanaM tamogRuhe AtmavadhaniShedhArthaM; tamogRuhaM ca shUnyagRuhatayonmAdanidAnoktamapi rogamahimnA~avasthAyAM hitaM bhavati| tarjanaM vAcA, trAsanaM rAjapuruShAdibhiH| vismRuterhetoriti unmAdahetubhayaharShAdivismArakatayA prabhAvAnmanaH prakRuShTaM svabhAvaM nayati; yathA- viShamajvare jvarakAlAsmaraNaM jvaraharaNam|24-32||- vishAletyAdAvaShTAviMshatikatvaM kalkadravyANAM pAThAdeva siddhaM, tat kimucyate~aShTAviMshatibhiH kalkairiti? ucyate- atra yadyapi triphalAyAH pratyekameko bhAgo gRuhyate utsargataH, tathA~api triphalAyAH pratyekabhAgagrahaNadArDhyArthamaShTAviMshatibhirityuktam| sushrute- “harItakyAmalakabibhItakAni triphalA” (su.sU.a.38) iti paribhAShayA triphalAshabdena harItakyAdaya ucyante, tathA~atrApi “jaraNAnte~abhayAmekAM prAgbhuktAddve bibhItake| bhuktvA tu madhusarpirbhyAM catvAryAmalakAni ca|| prayojayet samAmekAM triphalAyA rasAyanam” (ci.a.1) iti vacanAddharItakyAdiShu triphalAsa~jj~jA darshitA; tena triphalAshabdena dravyatrayamucyate; yathA dashamUlashabdena dasha bheShajAni, pa~jcamUlashabdena pa~jca, yathA vA “nIlotpalailAma~jjiShThAdantIdADimakesharam” iti padena ShaDdravyANyucyante| mAnaM copadishyamAnaM pratyekadravyApekShayeha bhavati; yathA gulmacikitsite- “nIlinIM triphalAM” ityAdi yAvat “vyAghrIM palikAni jalADhake” (ci.a.5) iti; tathA~agastyaharItakyAM dashamUlyAdInAM dvipalaM pratyekameva bhavati, yato dravyaprAdhAnyenopadishyamAnaM bhagamAnaM prayogeShu pratidravyeShveva bhavati na samudAye| yadA tu mAnaprAdhAnyena nirdeshastadA samucitasyaiva dravyasya mAnagrahaNaM; yathA- “lashunasyAviniShTasya tulArdhaM nistuShIkRutam| tadardhaM dashamUlasya dvyADhake pAcayedapAm” ityatra ShaShThyantatvAddashamUlasyAprAdhAnyaM, yathA- ‘rAj~jaH puruShaH’ ityatrApradhAnyaM; teneha lashunasya visheShyatayA pradhAnaM mAnaM tadvisheShaNabhUtaM ca dashamUlamapradhAnam, apradhAnatvAcca na pratyekaM niyatabhAgAH; tena lashunArdhamAnatvameva dashamUlasya bhavati| yathA vA “dvipa~jcamUlatulArdharasena” ityatrApi dvipa~jcamUlasya samuditasyaiva tulArdhavisheShaNIbhUtasya kvAthArthaM tulArdhabhAgo gRuhyate, evaM “triphalAyAstrayo bhAgAstrayastrikaTukasya ca” (ci.a.16) ityatrApi samuditAdeva trayo bhAgA natu pratyekaM, tathA hi navabhAgAH syuH| tathA “tryUShaNatriphalAkalke bilvamAtre” (ci.a.15) ityatra tu kalkavisheShaNIbhUtatvena tryUShaNatriphalAkalkasyaiva bilvamAnatvaM, na pratyekaM shuNThyAdInAM harItakyAdInAM ca kalkIkRutAnAM bilvamAnatvam| evamanyatrApi samudAyabhAgapramANe AcAryAbhiprAyavisheSha unneyaH| dravyapradhAnanirdeshe tu pratyekadravyANi gaNo vA paThyatAM tathA~api pratyekameva bhAgo bhavati, avayavapradhAnatvAnnirdeshasya| yadA samudAyapradhAnanirdesho visheShAllikhyate, tadA pratyekanirdiShTali~ggAnAmapi samudAyasya bhAgo bhavati; “palamekaM nidadhyAcca tvagelApatrakesharAt” (ci.a.1pA.1) ityatra caturbhyo~apyekameva palaM gRuhyate na pratyekam| tathA “tailasarpiShoH| paladvAdashake bhRuShTvA” (ci.a.1pA.1) ityatra tailasarpiShormilitayoreva dvAdashapalaM na pratyekamiti pratyekaM dravyapramANAni tathA mAnapUrvanirdeshaM vyutpAdayatA sa~gkShepeNa darshitameva | evaM vyavasthite~api mahAnIloktapRuthakshabdena siddhasyApi triphalApRuthagbhAgaM darshayati| yathA “pippalIM nAgaraM pAThAM shvadaMShTrAM ca pRuthakpRuthak| bhAgAn tripalikAn kRutvA” ityatra pRuthakpRuthagiti tripalaM karoti; tathA paribhAShAsiddhasyApi snehapAdikakalkabhAgasyAbhidhAnaM tatra tatra taile ghRute ca karoti| triphalAshabdena yadyapi drAkShAkashmaryaparUShakANi cocyante; yaduktamanyatra- “pathyAmalakadhAtrIbhistriphalA mahatI smRutA| cakShuShyA sarvadoShaghnI sraMsanI bRuMhaNI ca sA|| hrasvA kAshmaryamRudvIkAparUShakaphalairbhavet” iti, tathA~apIha harItakyAditriphalAyA eva pradhAnatayotsargato grahaNaM bhavati| anye tu tAlIshapatramityatra tAlIshaM ca patraM cetI dravyadvayagrahaNasha~gkA syAt, tenaShTAviMshatipadena sA na bhavatvetadarthamaShTAviMshatibhiriti kRutaM, triphalAyAH pratyekaM grahaNaM nyAyasiddhameveti vadanti| anye tvaShTAviMshatyauShadhamiShyata ityAdAvaShTAviMshatyauShadhasa~jj~jayA vyavahAro~asya bhavatItyetadarthamaShTAviMshatibhiriti kRutam| caturguNavacanamiha paribhAShayA shuddhajalAccaturguNadAnArtham||33-41||-

sthirAdInItyukte vidArIgandhAdipa~jcamUlamapi syAdata Aha- ekaviMshatimiti| tena kalyANoktA ekaviMshatirgRuhyate| gRuShTirekavAraprasUtA gauH| atra kShIreNaiva cAturguNye prApte~ayaM kaShAyaH “ekenApi cAturguNyam” ityAdiparibhAShAyA aviShayatvena cAturguNyaparibhAShayA kShIramAnasAhacaryAdvA caturguNo j~jeyaH| kecittvekaviMshatipadenaikaviMshativArAn sarpistayaiva vidhayA paktavyamiti vadanti| tanna, yato jatUkarNe- “kvAthe kRumiharAntAnAM catuHShaShTipale payasi ca pacet sarpiH” ityanena utsargata eka evAsya pAka uktaH| viDa~ggAntashabdena ca kalyANoktaiviMshatisthirAdidravyagrahaNameva bhavati| ArdramAShaH ashuShkamAShaH; ‘dvimASha’ iti vA pAThaH, tatra mASharAjamAShayorgrahaNam||42-44||

jaTilAmityAdi| jaTilA mAMsI| pUtanA harItakI| keshI bhUtakeshI| cAraTI kumbhI, ‘brahmayaShTikA’ ityanye| markaTI shUkashimbI| jayA jayantI| vIrA kShIrakAkolI, ‘shAlaparNI’ ityapare| corakaH caNDAlakaH| vayaHsthA brAhmI guDUcI vA| shUkarI ‘vArAhIkanda’ iti khyAtA| chatrA madhurikA, aticchatrA shatapuShpA; kiMvA chatrAticchatre droNapuShpIdvayam| pala~gkaShA gugguluH| mahApuruShadantA shatAvarI| (anye tu viShNukrAntAM vadanti, jaTilAM shatAvarImAhuH )| kAyasthA sUkShmailA| nAkulIdvayaM rAsnAdvayam| kaTambharA kaTabhI| vRushcikAlI ‘vRushcikapatrI’ iti khyAtA| alpapaishAcikasyAbhAvAnmahApaishAcikamityatra mahacchabdaH pUjAvacanaH||45-48||

lashunAnAM shatamityatra lashunakandAnAM shatapalamAnam| tadardhaM dashamUlasyeti pa~jcaviMshati palAni| tryUShaNAt palamityatra samuditAt palam| madhumANikAmiti dravatvAd dvaiguNyena mANikAyA dvikuDavarUpAyAH ShoDashapalaM bhavati| lashunarasAdInAM pratyekaM prasthamAnatvaM j~jeyam||49-56||

hi~ggunA hi~gguparNyA cetyekaM ghRutam| sakAyasthavayaHsthayeti dvitIyam| vayaHsthetyAdinA tRutIyam| hi~gguparNI vaMshapatrikA, anyetu ‘hi~gguparNI’ iti khyAtAmAhuH| vayaHsthA brAhmI| kAyasthA sUkShmailA| ugragandhamityAdikaM kecidanArShaM vadanti| kevalam etadghRutamasAdhitam| etairiti anantaroktaghRutasAdhanadravyaiH||57-62||-

etAniti vakShyamANAn shirIShAdIn| nAvanaM cA~jjanaM ceti nAvanA~jjanam| hi~ggvAlamiti atrAlaM haritAlam| amarArtAMshceti devagRuhItAn| doSheNa bhUtena vA hatA smRutiryasya sa doShabhUtahatasmRutiH| agada iti viShaharaH| kRutyA abhicAraH| rAjadvAre ca shasyata iti vashIkaraNatvAt| gandhairiti agurvAdyaistagaravarjitaiH, uktaM hi sUtrasthAne dhUmavidhau- “gandhAshcAgurupatrAdyAH” (sU.a.5) iti| shvetAdyairiti “shvetA jyotiShmatI caiva haritAlaM manaHshilA” (sU.a.5) iti sUtrasthAna evoktaiH| shallakAdInAM yathAsambhavaM mUtrAdIni grAhyaNi||63-75||-

tiktakaM mahAtiktakam| jIvanIyaM sarpirvAtarakte vakShyate| mishrakaH snehaH gulmacikitsitoktaH| sha~gkhena keshAntena ca samaM sandhiH sha~gkhakeshAntasandhiH; tatra ca pratyAsannamarmaparityAgena sushrutoktaM sirAvibhAgamavalokya sirAvyadhaH kartavyaH||76-77||

brUyAdiShTavinAshamityAdinodbhrAntacittasya punashcintAkAraNaiH svadeshAnayanamevAha, dRushyate ca ghaTTanacalitasya punarghaTTanenaiva samyaksthApanaM, tadvadihApi j~jeyam| siMhairiti vyAghraiH| dAntairiti shikShitaiH| bahiriti grAmAdbahiH| dehaduHkhabhayebhya iti kapikacchulepanatADanAdibhyo dehaduHkhakAraNebhyaH||79-84||

iShTadravyetyAdinA pUrvamasUtrito~apyamunmAdaH prakaraNAccikitsyate; yathA tRuShNAdhyAye pa~jca tRuShNAH pratipAdya gurvannajAyA adhikAyAshcikitsocyata ityAhuH; kintu cintAdiduShTahRudaya ityAdinoktasAmAnyonmAdena gRuhIta evAyamartho~atra cikitsite iti pashyAmaH| pa~jconmAdavyavasthAyAmasya vAtike evAvarodha ucitaH, iShTadravyavinAshasya vAtaprakopakAritvAt| evaM kAmAdibhaveShvapi vAcyam||85-86||
krUrakarmeti tADanAdikam| shAntikarmetyAdinA daivavyapAshrayacikitsAmAha| sAmAnyAddhetudUShyoriti unmAdenApasmAreNa ca samo heturmanobhighAtAdiH, dUShyaM ca hRudayaM samAnamityarthaH||87-95||

dhIvibhrama ityAdinA sAmAnyamunmAdapUrvarUpamAhetyeke| dhIvibhramAdi tviha sAmAnyamunmAdali~ggamevoktam| kuta eva shAntimiti kuto~api shAntiM nivRuttiM na vindati| sa~jj~jA nAmollekhena j~jAnam| bhramatyayaM ceta iti ashvAn rathiriva bhrAmayati; atra Nijartho~antarbhUtaH||6-7||

tasyodbhavamityAdau yadyapi pa~jcAnAM madhye~asAdhyasya sAnnipAtikasya cikitsitaM na vaktavyaM, tathA~api chatriNo gacchantIti nyAyena bAhulyamAshritya cikitsitaM vakShyAmItyuktam| cintetyAdi cintA AdiH yeShAM te, tena kAmakrodhAdayo gRuhyante; Adishabdo~atra prakAravAcI| asthAne aviShaye hAsadInyasthAnahAsasmitAdIni||8-10||

ajIrNetyAdinA pittonmAdamAha| citamityanena cayapUrvakatvena pittasya mahAntaM kopaM darshayati, cayapUrvako hi doShakopo balavattvAnmahAnbhavati| anye tviha citashabdena prakopamicchanti| atyugramiti tIvravegam| pUrvavadityanena vAtonmAdavaccintAdijuShTamityAdigranthoktAM samprAptimatidishati| amarShaH akShAntiH, saMrambha ArabhaTI, vinagrabhAvaH avastratvam| atidravaNaM tvaritagamanam| pracchAyaH pravRuddhacchAyo deshaH||11-12||

sampUraNairityAdinA kaphonmAdamAha| soShmA kapha iti saha UShmaNA kapha unmAdaM karoti na kevala iti, unmAdakaraNe kaphasya UShmasahitatvarUpaM svabhAvaM darshayati; kiMvoShmashabdena vIryaM shaktirUpamucyate, tena soShmA kapha iti utkliShTashaktikaH kapha ityarthaH| marmaNIti hRudaye| nArIviviktayoH priyatA nArIviviktapriyatA; viviktaM vijanam||13-14||
athAto~apasmAracikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
sarvataH suvishuddhasya samyagAshvAsitasya ca| apasmAravimokShArthaM yogAn saMshamanA~jchRuNu||16||
goshakRudrasadadhyamlakShIramUtraiH samairghRutam| siddhaM pibedapasmArakAmalAjvaranAshanam||17||
iti pa~jcagavyaM ghRutam
dve pa~jcamUlyau triphalA rajanyau kuTajatvacam| saptaparNamapAmArgaM nIlinIM kaTurohiNIm||18||
shampAkaM phalgumUlaM ca pauShkaraM sadurAlabham| dvipalAni jaladroNe paktvA pAdAvasheShite||19||
bhArgIM pAThAM trikaTukaM trivRutAM niculAni ca| shreyasImADhakIM mUrvAM dantIM bhUnimbacitrakau||20||
dve sArive rohiShaM ca bhUtIkaM madayantikAm| kShipetpiShTvA~akShamAtrANi tena prasthaM ghRutAt pacet||21||
goshakRudrasadadhyamlakShIramUtraishca tatsamaiH| pa~jcagavyamiti khyAtaM mahattadamRutopamam||22||
apasmAre tathonmAde shvayathAvudareShu ca| gulmArshaHpANDurogeShu kAmalAyAM halImake||23||
shasyate ghRutametattu prayoktavyaM dine dine| alakShmIgraharogaghnaM cAturthakavinAshanam||24||
iti mahApa~jcagavyaM ghRutam
brAhmIrasavacAkuShThasha~gkhapuShpIbhireva ca| purANaM ghRutamunmAdAlakShmyapasmArapApanut||25||
ghRutaM saindhavahi~ggubhyAM vArShe bAste caturguNe| mUtre siddhamapasmArahRudgrahAmayanAshanam||26||
vacAshampAkakaiTaryavayaHsthAhi~ggucorakaiH| siddhaM pala~gkaShAyuktairvAtashleShmAtmake ghRutam||27||
tailaprasthaM ghRutaprasthaM jIvanIyaiH palonmitaiH| kShIradroNe pacet siddhamapasmAravinAshanam||28||
kaMse kShIrekShurasayoH kAshmarye~aShTaguNe rase| kArShikairjIvanIyaishca ghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet||29||
vAtapittodbhavaM kShipramapasmAraM niyacchati| tadvat kAshavidArIkShukushakvAthashRutaM ghRutam||30||
madhukadvipale kalke droNe cAmalakIrasAt| tadvat siddho ghRutaprasthaH pittApasmArabheShajam||31||
abhya~ggaH sArShapaM tailaM bastamUtre caturguNe| siddhaM syAdgoshakRunmUtraiH snAnotsAdanameva ca||32||
kaTabhInimbakaTva~ggamadhushigrutvacAM rase| siddhaM mUtrasamaM tailamabhya~ggArthe prashasyate||33||
pala~gkaShAvacApathyAvRushcikAlyarkasarShapaiH| jaTilApUtanAkeshInAkulIhi~ggucorakaiH||34||
lashunAtirasAcitrAkuShThairviDbhishca pakShiNAm| mAMsAshinAM yathAlAbhaM bastamUtre caturguNe||35||
siddhamabhya~jjanaM tailamapasmAravinAshanam| etaishcaivauShadhaiH kAryaM dhUpanaM sapralepanam||36||
pippalIM lavaNaM citrAM hi~ggu hi~ggushivATikAm| kAkolIM sarShapAn kAkanAsAM kaiTaryacandane||37||
shunaHskandhAsthinakharAn parshukAM ceti peShayet| bastamUtreNa puShyarkShe pradehaH syAt sadhUpanaH||38||
apetarAkShasIkuShThapUtanAkeshicorakaiH| utsAdanaM mUtrapiShTairmUtrairevAvasecanam||39||
jalaukaHshakRutA tadvaddagdhairvA bastaromabhiH| kharAsthibhirhastinakhaistathA gopucchalomabhiH||40||
kapilAnAM gavAM mUtraM nAvanaM paramaM hitam| shvashRugAlabiDAlAnAM siMhAdInAM ca shasyate||41||
bhArgI vacA nAgadantI shvetA shvetA viShANikA| jyotiShmatI nAgadantI pAdoktA mUtrapeShitAH||42||
yogAstrayo~ataH ShaD bindUn pa~jca vA nAvayedbhiShak| triphalAvyoShapItadruyavakShAraphaNijjhakaiH||43||
shyAmApAmArgakAra~jjaphalairmUtre~atha bastaje| sAdhitaM nAvanaM tailamapasmAravinAshanam||44||
pippalI vRushcikAlI ca kuShThaM ca lavaNAni ca| bhArgI ca cUrNitaM nastaH kAryaM pradhamanaM param||45||
kAyasthAM shAradAnmudgAnmustoshIrayavAMstathA| savyoShAn bastamUtreNa piShTvA vartIH prakalpayet||46||
apasmAre tathonmAde sarpadaShTe garArdite| viShapIte jalamRute caitAH syuramRutopamAH||47||
mustaM vayaHsthAM triphalAM kAyasthAM hi~ggu shAdvalam| vyoShaM mAShAn yavAnmUtrairbAstamaiShArShabhaistribhiH||48||
piShTvA kRutvA ca tAM vartimapasmAre prayojayet| kilAse ca tathonmAde jvareShu viShameShu ca||49||
puShyoddhRutaM shunaH pittamapasmAraghnama~jjanam| tadeva sarpiShA yuktaM dhUpanaM paramaM matam||50||
nakulolUkamArjAragRudhrakITAhikAkajaiH| tuNDaiH pakShaiH purIShaishca dhUpanaM kArayedbhiShak||51||
AbhiH kriyAbhiH siddhAbhirhRudayaM samprabudhyate| srotAMsi cApi shudhyanti tataH sa~jj~jAM sa vindati||52||

yasyAnubandhastvAganturdoShali~ggAdhikAkRutiH| dRushyeta tasya kAryaM syAdAgantUnmAdabheShajam||53||

Commentary: sampratyapasmAre sUtreNAnubandhali~ggacikitsAmAha- yasyetyAdi| doShali~ggAdhikAkRutiriti apasmAroktadoShali~ggebhyo~adhikA~a~agantUnmAdasadRushI AkRutiryasya sa tathA; tenAgantuli~ggaM doShajeShu bhavati, naca doShali~ggaM vinA~a~agantuli~ggatA sambhavati; tatashcAgantvapasmAraH pRutha~g na bhavati, kintu doShajasyAnubandharUpaH pashcAtkAlInaH sa AgantuH; tena “catvAro~apasmArAH” (sU.a.19) iti yaduktaM tasyAganturanubandho bhavatyeva kadAciditi| anenAnubandharUpataiva bhUtApasmAre darshitA; na tUnmAdavat svAtantryeNa kartavyaM bhUtAnAm| anyatrApyuktam- “apasmAro mahAvyAdhiH sa syAddoShata eva tu” iti| anye tu bhImadantAdayaH svatantrAgantvapasmAralakShaNacikitsAnirdeshArthamatra granthaM varNayanti; na sa~gkhyAniyamashca doShajApasmArANAmevaM bhavati||53||
anantaramuvAcedamagniveshaH kRutA~jjaliH| bhagavan! prAk samuddiShTaH shlokasthAne mahAgadaH||54||
atattvAbhinivesho yastaddhetvAkRutibheShajam| tatra noktamataH shrotumicchAmi tadihocyatAm||55||
shushrUShave vacaH shrutvA shiShyAyAha punarvasuH| mahAgadaM saumya! shRuNu sahetvAkRutibheShajam||56||
malinAhArashIlasya vegAn prAptAnnigRuhNataH| shItoShNasnigdharUkShAdyairhetubhishcAtisevitaiH||57||
hRudayaM samupAshritya manobuddhivahAH sirAH| doShAH sandUShya tiShThanti rajomohAvRutAtmanaH||58||
rajastamobhyAM vRuddhAbhyAM buddhau manasi cAvRute| hRudaye vyAkule doShairatha mUDho~alpacetanaH ||59||
viShamAM kurute buddhiM nityAnitye hitAhite| atattvAbhiniveshaM tamAhurAptA mahAgadam||60||
snehasvedopapannaM taM saMshodhya vamanAdibhiH| kRutasaMsarjanaM medhyairannapAnairupAcaret||61||
brAhmIsvarasayuktaM yat pa~jcagavyamudAhRutam| tat sevyaM sha~gkhapuShpI ca yacca medhyaM rasAyanam||62||
suhRudashcAnukUlAstaM svAptA dharmArthavAdinaH| saMyojayeyurvij~jAnadhairyasmRutisamAdhibhiH ||63||

smRuterapagamaM prAhurapasmAraM bhiShagvidaH| tamaHpraveshaM bIbhatsaceShTaM dhIsattvasamplavAt||3||

Commentary: smRuterapagama ityAdinA~apasmArasa~jj~jAM vyutpAdayannapasmArasvarUpamAha| smRuterapagamameva vishinaShTi- tamaHpraveshamiti| bIbhatsaceShTamiti tamaHpraveshena j~jAnAbhAvatvAdbIbhatsaceShTA phenavamanA~ggavikShepaNAdikA yasminnupagate taM bIbhatsaceShTam| bIbhatsaceShTe smRutyapagamAdau ca hetumAha- dhIsattvasamplavAditi| samplavaH vibhramaH, svarUpAnyathAtvamiti yAvat||3||
prayu~jjyAttailalashunaM payasA vA shatAvarIm| brAhmIrasaM kuShTharasaM vacAM vA madhusaMyutAm||64||
dushcikitsyo hyapasmArashcirakArI kRutAspadaH | tasmAdrasAyanairenaM prAyashaH samupAcaret||65||

jalAgnidrumashailebhyo viShamebhyashca taM sadA| rakShedunmAdinaM caiva sadyaH prANaharA hi te||66||
