Commentary: jalAgnItyAdinA jalAdisAnnidhye yadi vego bhavatyapasmArasya tadA maraNameva bhavatIti darshayati||66||
tatra shlokau- hetuM kurvantyapasmAraM doShAH prakupitA yathA| sAmAnyataH pRuthaktvAcca li~ggaM teShAM ca bheShajam||67||
mahAgadasamutthAnaM li~ggaM covAca sauShadham| munirvyAsasamAsAbhyAmapasmAracikitsite ||68||
vibhrAntabahudoShANAmahitAshucibhojanAt | rajastamobhyAM vihate sattve doShAvRute hRudi||4||
cintAkAmabhayakrodhashokodvegAdibhistathA| manasyabhihate nRUNAmapasmAraH pravartate||5||
dhamanIbhiH shritA doShA hRudayaM pIDayanti hi| sampIDyamAno vyathate mUDho bhrAntena cetasA||6||
pashyatyasanti rUpANi patati prasphuratyapi| jihvAkShibhrUH sravallAlo hastau pAdau ca vikShipan||7||
pRuthagdoShaiH samastaishca vakShyate sa caturvidhaH||8||
kampate pradasheddantAn phenodvAmI shvasityapi| paruShAruNakRuShNAni pashyedrUpANi cAnilAt||9||
pItaphenA~ggavaktrAkShaH pItAsRugrUpadarshanaH| satRuShNoShNAnalavyAptalokadarshI ca paittikaH||10||
shuklaphenA~ggavaktrAkShaH shIto hRuShTA~ggajo guruH| pashya~jchuklAni rUpANi shlaiShmiko mucyate cirAt||11||
sarvairetaiH samastaistu li~ggairj~jeyastridoShajaH| apasmAraH sa cAsAdhyo yaH kShINasyAnavashca yaH||12||
pakShAdvA dvAdashAhAdvA mAsAdvA kupitA malAH| apasmArAya kurvanti vegaM ki~jcidathAntaram||13||
tairAvRutAnAM hRutsrotomanasAM samprabodhanam| tIkShNairAdau bhiShak kuryAt karmabhirvamanAdibhiH||14||
vAtikaM bastibhUyiShThaiH paittaM prAyo virecanaiH| shlaiShmikaM vamanaprAyairapasmAramupAcaret||15||
AdyutpattAvunmAdena sahotpannatvAdunmAdamanu apasmAracikitsitamucyate||1-2||
AshvAsitasyeti ApyAyitabalasya| goshakRudityAdau dadhyAdibhirapi goshabdo yojyaH; tena pa~jcagavyamidamalpaM bhavati| sAmyaM cAtra goshakRudrasAdInAM paribhAShAsiddhamapi spaShTArthamucyate||16-17||

dve pa~jcamUlyAvityAdau nirdiShTaM pa~jcamUladvayaM dashamUlAkhyaM grAhyam| nIlinI nIlikA| shampAka AragvadhaH| phalguH kAShThodumbarikA| dvipalatvaM yathA pratyekaM dashamUlyAdInAM tatpratipAditamevonmAde| niculo hijjalaH| shreyasI hastipippalI| dve sArive iti shyAmalatA~anantamUlI ca||18-24||

brAhmItyAdau purANamiti ghRutavisheShaNaM, tena purANaM ghRutamatra sAdhyaM bhavati| vArShe bAste iti vRuShacchAgabhave mUtre| atra ca yadyapi “strINAM tIkShNaM gavAM mUtraM na tu puMsAM tathAvidham| pittAMshikAstriyo yasmAt saumyAstu puruShA smRutA” ityanena striyA mUtraM prashastamuktaM, tathA~apIha visheShaparigrahAt puMlli~ggayoreva mUtraM yaugikamiti| kaiTaryaH pArvato nimbaH| vayaHsthA guDUcI| vAtashleShmAtake iti dvandvApasmArAnirdeshAdvAtAtmake shleShmAtmake ceti j~jeyam; anye tu gulmavadanuktamapi prakRutisamasamavAyArabdhadvandvajaM ‘vAtashleShmAtmake’ ityanena sUcitamapasmAraM vadanti||25-27||

tailaprasthamityAdau palonmitaiH kalkairiti bhavati, dravasthAne kShIrasyaiva vidyamAnatvAt| kaMse iti ADhake| kAshmarye iti gambhArIbhave| rase iti kvAthe| tadvadityanena pUrvayogaphalashrutiM darshayati| tadvatsiddho ghRutaprasthaH ityanena pUrvayogoktaM ‘kShipraM’ ityAkarShati, tena kShipraM pittApasmArabheShajaM bhavatIti phalati||28-31||

abhya~gga ityAdinA~akalkameva tailaM paktavyam| goshakRudityAdau goshakRutotsAdanaM, gomUtreNa ca yogyatayA snAnam| kaTabhItyAdau kaTabhyAdInAM caturNAmapi tvacaM gRuhItvA kvAthaH snehatriguNaH kartavyaH, caturthastu mUtrabhAgenaiva snehasamena pUryate||32-33||

pala~gkaShetyAdau pUtanApUrvA yA keshI pUtanAkeshI golomItyarthaH| tathA hi jatUkarNe pUtanAkeshItyatra golomI paThyate| uktaM hi- “vRushcikAlIpathyAgolomInAkulIlasunakuShThaiH, sarShapajaTilAcorakahi~gguvacAmadhukacitrakArkaiH, mAMsAdapakShipurIShairbastamUtre shRutairetadabhya~gge” iti| atirasA jalajaM yaShTImadhu||34-36||
citrA dantI| hi~ggushivATikA vaMshapatrikA| skandhAsthIti skandhasyAsthi| puShyarkShapeShaNena nakShatrayogakRutaM saMskAramupadishati||37-38||
apetarAkShasIsvarasaH| jalaukaHshakRutetyAdau tadvaditi utsAdanam||39-40||

kapilAnAM gavAM mUtre visheShakarI shaktirbhavatIti AptavacanAdunnIyate| siMhAdInAM ca shasyate ityatra mUtramiti yojyam| bhArgItyAdau nAgadantI kAShThapATalA| shvetA shvetAparAjitA shvetasyandA| shvetA viShANikA shatAvarI| triphaletyAdau pItadru devadAru| lavaNAni saindhavAdIni pa~jca, kiMvA lavaNavargoktAni sarvANyeva yathAlAbhaM grAhyANi||41-45||

kAyasthAmityAdau shAradAnmudgAniti haritamudgAn, te hi prAyaH sharadi bhavanti| vartiH netrA~jjanavartiH| viShapIte iti pItaviShe| jalamajjanena mRuta iva iti jalamRutaH, tasya lakShaNaM- “viShTabdhapAyumUrdhAkShamAdhmAtodaramehanam| vidyAjjalamRutaM jantuM shItapAdakarAnanam” iti| bAstamaiShArShabhairiti chAgameShavRuShabhasambhavaiH||46-49||
puShyoddhRutamiti puShyanakShatre gRuhItam| kITaH vRushcikAdiH||50-52||
asmin pradeshe saindhavAH kAshmIrAshca ‘bhagavan’ ityAdinA~atattvAbhiniveshasya lakShaNacikitsAgranthaM paThanti; sa cAnArSha iti vRuddhAH||54-63||
tailalashunAdayaH pa~jca yogAH| anena cirakAriNIM cikitsAM darshayati||64-65||
sa~ggrahe kurvantItyAdinA samprAptiM gRuhNAti||67-68||

yAdRushAnAmapasmAro bhavati tAnAha- vibhrAntetyAdi| vibhrAntA unmArgagAmino bahavashca doShA yeShAM teShAM vibhrAntabahudoShANAm| vihate sattve iti sattvAkhyaguNe vihate; natu sattvashabdena mana ucyate, tasya ‘manasyabhihate’ ityanena grahaNaM kariShyati||4-5||

dhamanIbhiriti yadyapi sAmAnyenoktaM, tathA~api hRudayapIDAyogyatayA hRudayAshritA eva dhamanyo visheSheNa gRuhyante| atra ca vAtAdInAM prakope pRuthak pRuthak heturnoktaH, tasyonmAdasAdhAraNatvena labdhatvAt| uktaM hi- “yaccopadekShyate ki~jcidapasmAracikitsite| unmAde tacca kartavyaM sAmAnyAddhetudUShyayoH” (ci.a.9) iti| yastvapasmArasya vishiShTo heturunmAdAt sa “ahitAshubhojanAt” ityAdinokta eva||6-7||-

pRuthagityAdinA caturvidhApasmAralakShaNamAha| pItAsRugrUpadarshana iti pItalohitarUpadarshI| satRuShNoShNetyAdi satRuShNoShNashcAsAvanalavyAptalokadarshI ceti samAsaH| shukletyAdinA shlaiShmika ucyate| hRuShTA~ggajaH hRuShTaromA| cirAditi vacanena vAtapittayoracireNa mokShaM sUcayati| kShINasyAnavashca yaH sa ekadoShajo~apyasAdhya iti bhAvaH| pakShAdvetyAdau vyutkramya vegakAlanirdeshena uktakAlAdUrdhvamarvAgapi cApasmAravego bhavatIti sUcayati| ki~jcidathAntaramiti ki~jcitkAlAntaraM vegaM kurvanti, stokakAlAntaramiti yAvat||8-13||
tairityAdinA cikitsAmAha| prabodhanamiti doShavirahitatvena samyaksvavyApArakaram| prAya ityAdau prAyaHshabdo visheShArthaH; tenAnyA~api bhavati sUcitA||14-15||
athAtaH kShatakShINacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

udArakIrtirbrahmarShirAtreyaH paramArthavit| kShatakShINacikitsArthamidamAha cikitsitam||3||

Commentary: brahmarShirityanena devarShitvarAjarShitve Atreyasya niShedhati| cikitsArthamiti pratikriyArtham| cikitsitaM cikitsAbhidhAyakagrantham||3||
jIvakarShabhakau vIrAM jIvantIM nAgaraM shaTIm| catasraH parNinIrmede kAkolyau dve nidigdhike||35||
punarnave dve madhukamAtmaguptAM shatAvarIm| RuddhiM parUShakaM bhArgIM mRudvIkAM bRuhatIM tathA||36||
shRu~ggATakaM tAmalakIM payasyAM pippalIM balAm| badarAkShoTakharjUravAtAmAbhiShukANyapi||37||
phalAni caivamAdIni kalkAn kurvIta kArShikAn| dhAtrIrasavidArIkShucchAgamAMsarasaM payaH||38||
kuryAt prasthonmitaM tena ghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet| prasthArdhaM madhunaH shIte sharkarArdhatulAM tathA||39||
dvikArShikANi patrailAhematva~gmaricAni ca| vinIya cUrNitaM tasmAllihyAnmAtrAM sadA naraH||40||
amRutaprAshamityetannarANAmamRutaM ghRutam| sudhAmRutarasaM prAshyaM kShIramAMsarasAshinA||41||
naShTashukrakShatakShINadurbalavyAdhikarshitAn| strIprasaktAn kRushAn varNasvarahInAMshca bRuMhayet||42||
kAsahikkAjvarashvAsadAhatRuShNAsrapittanut| putradaM vamimUrcchAhRudyonimUtrAmayApaham||43||
ityamRutaprAshaghRutam
ityamRutaprAshaghRutam shvadaMShTroshIrama~jjiShThAbalAkAshmaryakattRuNam| darbhamUlaM pRuthakparNIM palAsharShabhakau sthirAm||44||
palikaM sAdhayetteShAM rase kShIracaturguNe| kalkaH svaguptAjIvantImedarShabhakajIvakaiH||45||
shatAvaryRuddhimRudvIkAsharkarAshrAvaNIbisaiH| prasthaH siddho ghRutAdvAtapittahRuddra(dbha)vashUlanut||46||
mUtrakRucchrapramehArshaHkAsashoShakShayApahaH| dhanuHstrImadyabhArAdhvakhinnAnAM balamAMsadaH||47||
ityelAdiguTikA
iti shvadaMShTrAdighRutam madhukAShTapaladrAkShAprasthakvAthe ghRutaM pacet| pippalyaShTapale kalke prasthaM siddhe ca shItale||48||
pRuthagaShTapalaM kShaudrasharkarAbhyAM vimishrayet| samasaktu kShatakShINe raktagulme ca taddhitam||49||
dhAtrIphalavidArIkShujIvanIyarasairghRutam| ajAgopayasoshcaiva sapta prasthAn pacedbhiShak||50||
siddhashIte sitAkShaudradviprasthaM vinayecca tat| yakShmApasmArapittAsRukkAsamehakShayApaham||51||
vayaHsthApanamAyuShyaM mAMsashukrabalapradam| ghRutaM tu pitte~abhyadhike lihyAdvAte~adhike pibet||52||
lIDhaM nirvApayet pittamalpatvAddhanti nAnalam| AkrAmatyanilaM pItamUShmANaM niruNaddhi ca||53||
kShAmakShINakRushA~ggAnAmetAnyeva ghRutAni tu| tvakkShIrIsharkarAlAjacUrNaiH styAnAni yojayet||54||
sarpirguDAn samadhvaMshA~jjagdhvA cAnu payaH pibet| reto vIryaM balaM puShTiM tairAshutaramApnuyAt||55||
iti sarpirguDAH balA vidArI hrasvA ca pa~jcamUlI punarnavA| pa~jcAnAM kShIrivRukShANAM shu~ggA muShTyaMshakA api||56||
eShAM kaShAye dvikShIre vidAryAjarasAMshike| jIvanIyaiH pacet kalkairakShamAtrairghRutADhakam||57||
sitApalAni pUte ca shIte dvAtriMshataM kShipet| godhUmapippalIvAMshIcUrNaM shRu~ggATakasya ca||58||
samAkShikaM kauDavikaM tat sarvaM khajamUrcchitam| styAnaM sarpirguDAn kRutvA bhUrjapatreNa veShTayet||59||
tA~jjagdhvA palikAn kShIraM madyaM vA~anupibet kaphe| shoShe kAse kShate kShINe shramastrIbhArakarshite||60||
raktaniShThIvane tApe pInase corasi sthite| shastAH pArshvashiraHshUle bhede ca svaravarNayoH||61||
iti dvitIyasarpirguDAH tvakkShIrIshrAvaNIdrAkShAmUrvarShabhakajIvakaiH| vIrardhikShIrakAkolIbRuhatIkapikacchubhiH||62||
kharjUraphalamedAbhiH kShIrapiShTaiH palonmitaiH| dhAtrIvidArIkShurasaprasthaiH prasthaM ghRutAt pacet||63||
sharkarArdhatulAM shIte kShaudrArdhaprasthameva ca| dattvA sarpirguDAn kuryAtkAsahikkAjvarApahAn||64||
yakShmANaM tamakaM shvAsaM raktapittaM halImakam| shukranidrAkShayaM tRuShNAM hanyuH kArshyaM sakAmalam||65||
iti tRutIyAH sarpirguDAH navamAmalakaM drAkShAmAtmaguptAM punarnavAm| shatAvarIM vidArIM ca sama~ggAM pippalIM tathA||66||
pRuthagdashapalAn bhAgAn palAnyaShTau ca nAgarAt| yaShTyAhvasauvarcalayordvipalaM maricasya ca||67||
kShIratailaghRutAnAM ca tryADhake sharkarAshate| kvathite tAni cUrNAni dattvA bilvasamAn guDAn||68||
kuryAttAn bhakShayet kShINaH kShataH shuShkashca mAnavaH| tena sadyo rasAdInAM vRuddhyA puShTiM sa vindati||69||
iti caturthasarpirguDAH gokShIrArdhADhakaM sarpiH prasthamikShurasADhakam| vidAryAH svarasAtprasthaM rasAtprasthaM ca taittirAt||70||
dadyAt sidhyati tasmiMstu piShTAnikShurasairimAn| madhUkapuShpakuDavaM priyAlakuDavaM tathA||71||
kuDavArdhaM tugAkShIryAH kharjUrANAM ca viMshatim| pRuthagbibhItakAnAM ca pippalyAshca caturthikAm||72||
triMshatpalAni khaNDAcca madhukAt karShameva ca| tathA~ardhapalikAnyatra jIvanIyAni dApayet||73||
siddhe~asmin kuDavaM kShaudraM shIte kShiptvA~atha modakAn| kArayenmaricAjAjIpalacUrNAvacUrNitAn||74||
vAtAsRukpittarogeShu kShatakAsakShayeShu ca| shuShyatAM kShINashukrANAM rakte corasi saMsthite||75||
kRushadurbalavRuddhAnAM puShTivarNabalArthinAm| yonidoShakRutasrAvahatAnAM cApi yoShitAm||76||
garbhArthinInAM garbhashca sravedyAsAM mriyeta vA| dhanyA balyA hitAstAbhyaH shukrashoNitavardhanAH||77||
iti pa~jcamasarpirmodakAH
iti pa~jcamasarpirmodakAH bastideshe vikurvANe strIprasaktasya mArute| vAtaghnAn bRuMhaNAn vRuShyAn yogAMstasya prayojayet||78||
sharkarApippalIcUrNaiH sarpiShA mAkShikeNa ca| saMyuktaM vA shRutaM kShIraM pibet kAsajvarApaham||79||
phalAmlaM sarpiShA bhRuShTaM vidArIkShurase shRutam| strIShu kShINaH pibedyUShaM jIvanaM bRuMhaNaM param||80||
saktUnAM vastrapUtAnAM manthaM kShaudraghRutAnvitam| yavAnnasAtmyo dIptAgniH kShatakShINaH pibennaraH||81||
jIvanIyopasiddhaM vA jA~ggalaM ghRutabharjitam| rasaM prayojayet kShINe vya~jjanArthaM sasharkaram||82||
gomahiShyashvanAgAjaiH kShIrairmAMsarasaistathA| yavAnnaM bhojayedyUShaiH phalAmlairghRutasaMskRutaiH||83||
dIpte~agnau vidhireShaH syAnmande dIpanapAcanaH| yakShmiNAM vihito grAhI bhinne shakRuti ceShyate||84||
palikaM saindhavaM shuNThI dve ca sauvarcalAt pale| kuDavAMshAni vRukShAmlaM dADimaM patramarjakAt||85||
ekaikaM maricAjAjyordhAnyakAddve caturthike| sharkarAyAH palAnyatra dasha dve ca pradApayet||86||
kRutvA cUrNamato mAtrAmannapAne prayojayet| rocanaM dIpanaM balyaM pArshvArtishvAsakAsanut||87||
iti ShADavaH
iti saindhavAdicUrNam ekA ShoDashikA dhAnyAddve dve~ajAjyajamodayoH| tAbhyAM dADimavRukShAmlaM dvirdviH sauvarcalAtpalam||88||
shuNThyAH karShaM dadhitthasya madhyAt pa~jca palAni ca| taccUrNaM ShoDashapale sharkarAyA vimishrayet||89||
ShADavo~ayaM pradeyaH syAdannapAneShu pUrvavat| mandAnale shakRudbhede yakShmiNAmagnivardhanaH||90||
iti ShADavaH pibennAgabalAmUlamardhakarShavivardhitam | palaM kShIrayutaM mAsaM kShIravRuttiranannabhuk||91||
eSha prayogaH puShTyAyurbalArogyakaraH paraH| maNDUkaparNyAH kalpo~ayaM shuNThImadhukayostathA||92||
yadyat santarpaNaM shItamavidAhi hitaM laghu| annapAnaM niShevyaM tatkShatakShINaiH sukhArthibhiH||93||
yaccoktaM yakShmiNAM pathyaM kAsinAM raktapittinAm| tacca kuryAdavekShyAgniM vyAdhiM sAtmyaM balaM tathA||94||
dhanuShA~a~ayasyato~atyarthaM bhAramudvahato gurum| patato viShamoccebhyo balibhiH saha yudhyataH||4||
vRuShaM hayaM vA dhAvantaM damyaM vA~anyaM nigRuhNataH| shilAkAShThAshmanirghAtAn kShipato nighnataH parAn||5||
adhIyAnasya vA~atyuccairdUraM vA vrajato drutam| mahAnadIM vA tarato hayairvA saha dhAvataH||6||
sahasotpatato dUraM tUrNaM cAtipranRutyataH| tathA~anyaiH karmabhiH krUrairbhRushamabhyAhatasya ca||7||
vikShate vakShasi vyAdhirbalavAn samudIryate| strIShu cAtiprasaktasya rUkShAlpapramitAshinaH||8||

upekShite bhavettasminnanubandho hi yakShmaNaH| prAgevAgamanAttasya tasmAttaM tvarayA jayet||95||

Commentary: kShatakShINasya tvarayA pratikartavyatAmAha- upekShite ityAdi| tasyeti yakShmaNaH||95||
tatra shlokau- kShatakShayasamutthAnaM sAmAnyapRuthagAkRutim| asAdhyayApyasAdhyatvaM sAdhyAnAM siddhimeva ca||96||
uktavA~jjyeShThashiShyAya kShatakShINacikitsite| tattvArthavidvItarajastamodoShaH punarvasuH||97||
uro virujyate tasya bhidyate~atha vibhajyate| prapIDyete tataH pArshve shuShyatya~ggaM pravepate||9||
kramAdvIryaM balaM varNo ruciragnishca hIyate| jvaro vyathA manodainyaM viDbhedo~agnivadhAdapi||10||
duShTaH shyAvaH sudurgandhaH pIto vigrathito bahuH| kAsamAnasya ca shleShmA saraktaH sampravartate||11||
avyaktaM lakShaNaM tasya pUrvarUpamiti smRutam||12||
urorukshoNitacchardiH kAso vaisheShikaH kShate| kShINe saraktamUtratvaM pArshvapRuShThakaTigrahaH||13||

alpali~ggasya dIptAgneH sAdhyo balavato navaH| parisaMvatsaro yApyaH sarvali~ggaM tu varjayet||14||

Commentary: cikitsApravRuttyarthaM sAdhyAdivibhAgamAha- alpetyAdi| parisaMvatsaraH varShAtItaH||14||
uro matvA kShataM lAkShAM payasA madhusaMyutAm| sadya eva pibejjIrNe payasA~adyAt sasharkaram||15||
pArshvabastirujI cAlpapittAgnistAM surAyutAm| bhinnaviTkaH samustAtiviShApAThAM savatsakAm||16||
lAkShAM sarpirmadhUcchiShTaM jIvanIyagaNaM sitAm| tvakkShIrIM samitAM kShIre paktvA dIptAnalaH pibet||17||
ikShvAlikAbisagranthipadmakesharacandanaiH| shRutaM payo madhuyutaM sandhAnArthaM pibet kShatI||18||
yavAnAM cUrNamAdAya kShIrasiddhaM ghRutaplutam| jvare dAhe sitAkShaudrasaktUn vA payasA pibet||19||
madhUkamadhukadrAkShAtvakkShIrIpippalIbalAH| kAsI pArshvAsthishUlI ca lihyAtsaghRutamAkShikAH||20||
elApatratvaco~ardhAkShAH pippalyardhapalaM tathA| sitAmadhukakharjUramRudvIkAshca palonmitAH||21||
sa~jcUrNya madhunA yuktA guTikAH samprakalpayet| akShamAtrAM tatashcaikAM bhakShayennA dine dine||22||
kAsaM shvAsaM jvaraM hikkAM chardiM mUrcchAM madaM bhramam| raktaniShThIvanaM tRuShNAM pArshvashUlamarocakam||23||
shoShaplIhADhyavAtAMshca svarabhedaM kShataM kShayam| guTikA tarpaNI vRuShyA raktapittaM ca nAshayet||24||
rakte~ativRutte dakShANDaM yUShaistoyena vA pibet| caTakANDarasaM vA~api raktaM vA chAgajA~ggalam||25||
cUrNaM paunarnavaM raktashAlitaNDulasharkaram| raktaShThIvI pibet siddhaM drAkShArasapayoghRutaiH||26||
madhUkamadhukakShIrasiddhaM vA taNDulIyakam| mUDhavAtastvajAmedaH surAbhRuShTaM sasaindhavam||27||
kShAmaH kShINaH kShatoraskastvanidraH sabale~anile| shRutakShIrasareNAdyAt sakShaudraghRutasharkaram||28||
sharkarAM yavagodhUmau jIvakarShabhakau madhu| shRutakShIrAnupAnaM vA lihyAt kShINaH kShatI kRushaH||29||
kravyAdamAMsaniryUhaM ghRutabhRuShTaM pibecca saH| pippalIkShaudrasaMyuktaM mAMsashoNitavardhanam||30||
nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthaplakShashAlapriya~ggubhiH| tAlamastakajambUtvakpriyAlaishca sapadmakaiH||31||
sAshvakarNaiH shRutAt kShIrAdadyAjjAtena sarpiShA| shAlyodanaM kShatoraskaH kShINashukrashca mAnavaH||32||
yaShTyAhvanAgabalayoH kvAthe kShIrasamaM ghRutam| payasyApippalIvAMshIkalkasiddhaM kShate shubham||33||
kolalAkShArase tadvat kShIrAShTaguNasAdhitam| kalkaiH kaTva~ggadArvItvagvatsakatvakphalairghRutam||34||

apasmArarogeNa viShamoccapatanAdibhya uraHkShato~api bhavati, tataH kShatakShINo bhavati, tatsambandhAdapasmAramanu kShatakShINacikitsitamucyate| tatra kShatakShINarUpAd vakShyamANastrIsevAdikAraNakashukraujaHkShayAcca jAto vyAdhiH pradhAnam ‘uro virujyate’ ityAdinA vakShyamANalakShaNakaH kAraNe kAryopacArAt ‘uraHkShata’ ityucyate; yadA ‘kShINakShata’ iti pAThastadA~api kShINashabdena shukraujaHkShayayuktaH puruSha ucyate; tathA kShINe ca puruShe kShataM bhavatIti hetoH ‘kShatakShINa’ ityucyate| anye tu kShatashca kShayashca iti kShatakShaya ityAhuH; tena rogadvayametat| tathA ‘uroruk shoNitacchardiH’ ityAdinA kShatasya kShINasya ca lakShaNaM kariShyati; tasmin pakShe ‘avyaktaM lakShaNaM tasya’ iti, tathA ‘sAdhyo balavato navaH’ ityAdAvekavacananirdesho~anupapannaH, tenaikasyaiva kShatakShINasya hetukRutaM lakShaNadvaividhyaM; kiMvA kShatakShayakAraNayoH kShatadhAtukShayayostadvidhalakShaNakAraNAbhidhAnaM pUrvarUpAvasthAyAM vyAdhipratikriyArthaM j~jeyam||1-2||

dve nidigdhike iti vacanena bRuhatI kShudrA ca grAhyA| payasyA kShIravidArI| vAtAmAbhiShukANi tu auttarApathikAni phalAni| evamAdIni evamprakArANyanyAni vAtapittaharANi| dhAtrIrasAnAM ca yadyapi “pa~jcaprabhRuti yatra syurdravANi snehasaMvidhau| tatra snehasamAnyAhuH” iti vacanena prasthamAnatvaM siddhaM, tathA~api etatparibhAShArthadArDhyArthamevaitanmAnakathanaM j~jeyam| palArdhakatvamiha maricAdInAM militAnAM, samAhArapradhAnatvAnnirdeshasya; vRuddhAstu pratyekameva palArdhakatvaM vadanti| sudhA bhaumI bhojyA, amRutaM tu devabhojyam||35-43||

shvadaMShTretyAdau kvAthyadravyaparimANAnusAreNa pAdonaprasthatrayaM jalaM dattvA caturbhAgAvasheSheNa catushcatvAriMshatkvAthaphalAni bhavanti| kShIraM cAtra caturguNaM ghRutAt; kiMvA kvAthacaturguNaM kShIram||44-47||
madhuketyAdAvapi kvAthyamAnAnusAreNa kvAthasya sArdhaprastho bhavati| samasaktu iti samasaktughRutam||48-49||

ghRutaM tvityAdinA lehayogyAni yAni sharkarAdiyogAdghRutAnyuktAni tAni pitte lehyatayA kartavyAni, yAni tu sharkarAdirahitatvena pAnayogyAni tAni vAte kartavyAnIti darshayati; kiMvA styAnAvasthAyogIni upayogAllehyatayA pitte prayoktavyAni, tAnyeva vilInAvasthAmApannAni vAyau prayoktavyAni| ghRutalehasya ghRutapAnasya ca pRuthak phalamAha- nirvApayedityAdi| alpatvAditi lehatvenaivAlpatvAt, lehasya karShamAnatvenoktatvAt| AkramatIti jayati| niruNaddhIti pratihanti; ‘na ruNaddhi’ iti kecit paThanti| kShAmetyAdau kShAmaH klAntadehaH, kShINaH durbalaH, kRushaH hInamAMsaH| tvakkShIryAdInAM tAvanmAnaM j~jeyaM yAvatA ghRutasya styAnatvam| samadhvaMshAnityanena madhunaH tvakkShIryAdisamAnatAmAha||50-55||

baletyAdi| kShIrivRukShA vaTodumbarAshvatthaplakShakapItanAH| uktaM ca shAlAkye “udumbaro vaTo~ashvattho madhUkaH plakSha eva ca| pa~jcaite kShIriNo vRukShA asmiMstantre prakIrtitAH” iti| muShTyaMshakA iti palamAnAH| atra ca balAdInAM trayodashapalopanItAnAmaShTaguNe jale kvAthashcaturthAMshAvasheSha iti ShaDviMshatikvAthapalAni, etatkaShAyAdviguNaM kShIraM, vidArIrasashchAgamAMsarasashca kaShAyasamaH; evaM triMshatpalAdhikaM palashatamiha ghRutADhake paktavyaM bhavati| anye tu kvAthyAt ShoDashaguNajaladAnaparibhAShayA sAdhite kvAthe dvipa~jcAshatkvAthapalAnyAhuH; etadanusAreNa kShIrAdimAnamapyadhikaM bhavatItyAhuH| kintu kvAthatrayodashapale~atra pAnIyaM tathA paktavyaM yathA ghRutasamaH kvAtho bhavati| kvAtho hyatra caturguNadravasAdhye ghRute snehasama eva bhavati| etatkvAthadviguNaM kShIraM samashca vidArIrasashchAgamAMsarasashca deyaH; kiMvA vidAryAjamAMsarasayormilitvA dvyADhakAMsho deyaH| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “vRushcIvaM pa~jcamUlaM balAM vidArIM vaTAdishu~ggAMshca| niShkvAthya dvikShIre chAgavidArIrase ca same| jIvanIyagaNakalkaiH paktvA ghRutADhakaM” iti| atra hi kvAthyadravyamAnamaniyatamiti visheShaH, kvAthastu snehasama eva| khajaH manthAnadaNDaH, dashA~ggulo vA hastaH| bhUrjapatraveShTanaM ca shaktyutkarShArtham||56-61||
tvakkShIrItyAdau shrAvaNI muNDitikA, vIrA vidArIkandaH||62-65||

drAkShAmityAdau yaShTyAhvasauvarcalayormilitvA dvipalam| maricasya ‘dvipalaM’ iti sheShaH| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “ghRutatailapayastryADhake sitAM ca tulAM prapAcya drAkShAvidArIvRushcIvashatAvarIkRuShNAshuNThIbalAdhAtrIshca dashapalikAH prapAcayet, yaShTyAhvaM rucakaM ca palikam” ityAdi| kvathita iti bhAShayA kShINe eva kShIre cUrNaprakShepaM darshayati||66-69||
gokShIretyAdau gokShIraM kAraNatayocyate na ghRutapAkArthaM, tathAhi sati prakShepyacUrNena modakA na bhaveyuH| caturthikAM palam||70-77||

vikurvANe iti shUlAdivikAraM kurvANe| sharkaretyAdau prakShepanyAyena kShIre sharkarAdiprakShepaH| vastrapUtAnAmiti vastrAntarAlapatitAnAm| mande~agnau yakShmiNAM yo vihitaH bhinne shakRuti ca yo grAhI sa vidhiriShyata iti j~jeyam||78-84||
palikamiti palamAnam||85-87||

ShoDashikA palam| dADimavRukShAmlaM dvirdviriti pUrvadvipalApekShayA dviguNaM pratyekaM catuHpalamiti darshayati| pUrvavadityanena pUrvayogasamAnaphalamAha| atra jatUkarNaH- “palike dhAnyakarucake dvau jIrakadIpyakau shuNThyAshca palaM kapitthadADimavRukShAmlAnAM kuDavam” ityAdi||88-90||

nAgabaletyAdau ardhakarShavivardhitamiti ardhakarSheNaiva vardhitaM palaM mAsamekaM peyaM kevalaM kShIravartinA| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “nAgabalAmUlamardhakarShavRuddhyA palamAnaM mAsaM peyaM kShIramAtravRuttinA” iti||91-92||
shItaM cApi sparshe shAntikAri vidAhi bhavati, tadarthamavidAhItyuktam||93-94||

cikitsA ca nidAnAdinA j~jAtasyaiva vyAdherbhavati, tena kShatanidAnameva tAvadAha- dhanuShetyAdi| Ayasyata iti sharIramAyAsyataH| balibhiriti svApekShayA balAdhikaiH| nigRuhNata iti vArayataH| nirghAtaH astravisheShaH, kiMvA nirghAtaH shilAdInAM preraNavisheSho~atibalasampAditaH| abhyAhatasya parairabhihatasya| vyAdhiriti vakShyamANalakShaNaH kShatakShayAkhyo vyAdhiH; anye tu vyAdhishabdena kShatamevAhuH, “doShAdiShvapi vyAdhishabdo vartate” iti vacanAt| na cAsmin rAjayakShmarUpatA sha~gkanIyA, yata uraHkShatastridoShajanya eva, bhinnasamprAptishca “ayathAbalamArambhairjantorurasi vikShate| vAyuH prakupito doShAvudIryobhau vidhAvati” (ci.a.8) ityAdinoktA, lakShaNAni bhinnAnyeva “uro virujyate” ityAdinA vakShyamANalakShaNebhya uktAni| ata evehAnayorbhedaM vakShyati “upekShite bhavedasminnanubandho hi yakShmaNaH” iti| strIShu cAtiprasaktasya rUkShAlpapramitAshinaH balavAn vyAdhiH samudIryata iti sambandhaH| pramitAshanam ekarasAbhyAsaH, kiMvA~atItakAlabhojanam||4-8||
sa~ggrahe sAmAnyapRuthagAkRutimiti kShatotthasya kShayotthasya ca ‘uro virujyata’ ityAdi pRuthaglakShaNaM kRutam||96-97||

kShatakShayalakShaNamAha- ura ityAdinA| bhidyata iti vidIryate| agnivadhAdapIti atrAgnivadhaM vinA vyAdhimahimnA viDbhedo bhavatIti darshayati| anye tu ‘viDbhedo~agnivadhastathA’ iti paThanti| duShTaH vyApannaH| kShIyata iti dhAtukShayavAn bhavati; na kevalaM kShatAdeva kShIyate, kintu atistrIsevAdinA kRutAcchukraujaH- kShayAdapi kShIyate itaradhAtukShayavAn bhavati||9-11||-

pUrvarUpamAha- avyaktamityAdi| avyaktamiti alpatvena yathoktalakShaNato~asampUrNam| urorugityAdigranthastu prAyeNa vyAkRutaH| kAso vaisheShika iti vishiShTaH, sa ca visheSho ‘duShTaH shyAvaH’ ityAdinA prokto j~jeyaH; kiMvA vaisheShiko~adhiko j~jeyaH| kShINe iti shukraujasI kShINe| anye tu urorugityAdinA~avasthAdvayasya lakShaNadvayametadvarNayanti||12-13||

j~jAtarogavisheSheNa kartavyAM cikitsAmAha- uro matvetyAdi| urasaH sadyaH kShataM matvA lAkShAM pibediti yojanA| sasharkaramiti sharkarAsahitamannam| bhinnaviTkaH samustAtiviShApAThAM lAkShAM pibet| atra ye ‘dvivatsakAm’ iti paThanti te vatsakabhAgadvayaM grAhayanti; kiMvA vatsakadvayameva dvivatsakashabdena gRuhyate; tathA hi- “bRuhatphalaH shvetapuShpaH snigdhapatraH pumAn bhavet| shyAmA cAruNapuShpA strI phalapuShpaistathA~aNubhiH” (ka.a.5) iti kalpe kuTajaH strIpuruShavibhAgena dvividha uktaH| sandhAnArthamiti kShatoraHsandhAnArtham| madhUkashabdeneha madhUkapuShpaM grAhyam||15-20||
elApatratvaca ityAdinA elAdiguTikAmAha| yuktyeti yAvatA madhunA guTikA bhavanti tAvanmAnaM madhu deyam||21-24||

dakShaH goShThakukkuTaH| chAgajA~ggalamiti chAgabhavaM jA~ggalahariNAdibhavaM vA| cUrNaM paunarnavamityAdau siddhamiti sAdhitam| cUrNasAdhanaM drAkShArasAdidraveNa agnisaMyogAt kartavyam| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “punarnavAraktashAlIdrAkShAsitAcUrNaM payoghRutayutaM siddham” iti||25-26||

madhUketyAdau madhUkamadhukakalkena kShIreNa samaM sAdhitaM taNDulIyakashAkam| sabale iti balavatyanile| kravyAdAH mAMsabhujo mRugapakShiNaH| kShIrAjjAteneti kShIrAvasthAyAmeva gRuhItena| yaShTyAhvetyAdau samakvAthakShIrAbhyAM ghRutAccAturguNyam| vAMshI vaMshalocanA| koletyAdau tadvaditi kShate hitam; atra kolalAkShArasasya ca ghRutAccAturguNyaM, kShIraM cAShTaguNaM vadanti; kiMvA kolalAkShArasayoH samatvameva kShIreNa; ayaM ca nyAyo~apasmArAdhyAye nirdiShTaH||27-34||
athAtaH shvayathucikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

bhiShagvariShThaM surasiddhajuShTaM munIndramatryAtmajamagniveshaH| mahAgadasya shvayathoryathAvat prakoparUpaprashamAnapRucchat||3||

Commentary: juShTamiti sevitam| prakopayatIti prakopo heturityarthaH, kiMvA kAryakAraNayorabhedopacArAt prakopashabdena shvayathukAraNamucyate; rUpashabdena rUpapUrvarUpayorgrahaNaM; shamanena cikitsocyate||3||

tasmai jagAdAgadavedasindhupravartanAdripravaro~atrijastAn| vAtAdibhedAttrividhasya samya~gnijAnijaikA~ggajasarvajasya||4||

Commentary: agadArtha ArogyArtho yo vedaH so~agadavedaH, sa eva gambhIraprasannatvAt sindhuriva sindhuH, tasya pravartane~adripravaro himAlaya ivetyarthaH; yathA himAlayo ga~ggAyAH pravartakastathA~atrijo~api Ayurvedapravartaka ityarthaH| tAniti prakopAdIn yA~j shiShyaH pRuShTavAn| ekA~ggajasarvajasyetyatra sarvajashabdena sarvasharIrajasya grahaNam, ekA~ggajashabdena ca sAmAnyena sharIrAvyApakasya grahaNaM; tena sarvArdhagAtrAvayavAshritatvena yattraividhyaM vaktavyaM tatraikA~ggajenArdhagAtrAshritAvayavAshritayoriha grahaNaM j~jeyam||4||

kRushasya rogairabalasya yo bhavedupadravairvA vamipUrvakairyutaH| sa hanti marmAnugato~atha rAjimAn parisraveddhInabalasya sarvagaH||15||

Commentary: sampratyasAdhyatvamAha- kRushasyetyAdi| vamipUrvakairiti trishothIye “chardiH shvAso~arucistRuShNA jvaro~atIsAra eva ca| suptiH shoShaH sadaurbalyaH shothopadravasa~ggrahaH” (sU.a.18) ityanenoktaiH| marmAnugato rAjimAniti ca pRuthaglakShaNaM, parisravedityAdi ca pRuthak pRuthagasAdhyalakShaNam||15||

nidAnadoShartuviparyayakramairupAcarettaM baladoShakAlavit||16||

Commentary: sAmAnyena cikitsAsUtramAha- nidAnetyAdi| nidAnAdiviparItakramaiH la~gghanAdibhirupAcaredityarthaH| baladoShakAlavidityanena nidAnAderviparItA kriyoktA; balaM tathA doShamAmAdibhedabhinnaM tathA kAlaM ca vyAdhyavasthArUpaM viditvA yA yujyate sA kartavyeti darshayati| nidAnetyAdau doShashabdena vAtAdayo gRuhyante, Rutushabdena ca nityagaH kAlaH| tenaiva tadvishiShTavAcakatayA baladoShakAlaviditi vacanaM na punaruktam| anye tu prathamena doShashabdena dUShyadhAtugrahaNaM, dvitIyena tu vAtAdigrahaNamityAhuH; prathamavyAkhyAne tu doShashabdenaiva dUShyasyApi doShAdhArasya grahaNaM j~jeyam||16||
athAmajaM la~gghanapAcanakramairvishodhanairulbaNadoShamAditaH| shirogataM shIrShavirecanairadho virecanairUrdhvaharaistathordhvajam||17||
upAcaret snehabhavaM virUkShaNaiH prakalpayet snehavidhiM ca rUkShaje| vibaddhaviTke~anilaje nirUhaNaM ghRutaM tu pittAnilaje satiktakam||18||
payashca mUrcchAratidAhatarShite vishodhanIye tu samUtramiShyate| kaphotthitaM kShArakaTUShNasaMyutaiH samUtratakrAsavayuktibhirjayet||19||

grAmyAbjAnUpaM pishitamabalaM shuShkashAkaM navAnnaM gauDaM piShTAnnaM dadhi tilakRutaM vijjalaM madyamamlam| dhAnA vallUraM samashanamatho gurvasAtmyaM vidAhi svapnaM cArAtrau shvayathugadavAn varjayenmaithunaM ca||20||

Commentary: grAmyetyAdinA nidAnatvenaiva prAptaniShedhAnapi mahAtyayAvaha- tvAdatyarthaniShedhopadarshanArthamAha| gauDamiti guDavikAraM, tasya vikAre aN| dhAnA a~gkuritabhRuShTayavAH| vallUraM shuShkamAMsam| samashanaM pathyApathyayorekatra bhojanam||20||
vyoShaM trivRuttiktakarohiNI ca sAyorajaskA triphalArasena| pItaM kaphotthaM shamayettu shophaM gavyena mUtreNa harItakI ca||21||
harItakInAgaradevadAru sukhAmbuyuktaM sapunarnavaM vA| sarvaM pibettriShvapi mUtrayuktaM snAtashca jIrNe payasA~annamadyAt||22||
punarnavAnAgaramustakalkAn prasthena dhIraH payasA~akShamAtrAn| mayUrakaM mAgadhikAM samUlAM sanAgarAM vA prapibet savAte||23||
dantItrivRuttryUShaNacitrakairvA payaH shRutaM doShaharaM pibennA| dviprasthamAtraM tu palArdhikaistairardhAvashiShTaM pavane sapitte||24||
sashuNThipItadrurasaM prayojyaM shyAmorubUkoShaNasAdhitaM vA| tvagdAruvarShAbhumahauShadhairvA guDUcikAnAgaradantibhirvA||25||
saptAhamauShTraM tvathavA~api mAsaM payaH pibedbhojanavArivarjI| gavyaM samUtraM mahiShIpayo vA kShIrAshano mUtramatho gavAM vA||26||
takraM pibedvA gurubhinnavarcAH savyoShasauvarcalamAkShikaM ca| guDAbhayAM vA guDanAgaraM vA sadoShabhinnAmavibaddhavarcAH||27||
viDvAtasa~gge payasA rasairvA prAgbhaktamadyAdurubUkatailam | srotovibandhe~agnirucipraNAshe madyAnyariShTAMshca pibet sujAtAn||28||
gaNDIrabhallAtakacitrakAMshca vyoShaM viDa~ggaM bRuhatIdvayaM ca| dviprasthikaM gomayapAvakena droNe pacet kUrcikamastunastu ||29||
tribhAgasheShaM ca supUtashItaM droNena tat prAkRutamastunA ca| sitopalAyAshca shatena yuktaM lipte ghaTe citrakapippalInAm||30||
vaihAyase sthApitamAdashAhAt prayojayaMstadvinihanti shophAn| bhagandarArshaHkrimikuShThamehAn vaivarNyakArshyAnilahikkanaM ca||31||
iti kaMsaharItakI
iti gaNDIrAdyariShTaH kAshmaryadhAtrImaricAbhayAkShadrAkShAphalAnAM ca sapippalInAm| shataM shataM jIrNaguDAttulAM ca sa~gkShudya kumbhe madhunA pralipte||32||
saptAhamuShNe dviguNaM tu shIte sthitaM jaladroNayutaM pibennA| shophAn vibandhAn kaphavAtajAMshca nihantyariShTo~aShTashato~agnikRucca||33||
iti triphalAdyariShTaH
ityaShTashato~ariShTaH punarnave dve ca bale sapAThe dantIM guDUcImatha citrakaM ca| nidigdhikAM ca tripalAni paktvA droNAvasheShe salile tatastam||34||
pUtvA rasaM dve ca guDAt purANAttule madhuprasthayutaM sushItam| mAsaM nidadhyAdghRutabhAjanasthaM palle yavAnAM paratastu mAsAt||35||
cUrNIkRutairardhapalAMshikaistaM patratvagelAmaricAmbulohaiH | gandhAnvitaM kShaudraghRutapradigdhe jIrNe pibed vyAdhibalaM samIkShya||36||
hRutpANDurogaM shvayathuM pravRuddhaM plIhajvarArocakamehagulmAn| bhagandaraM ShaDjaTharANi kAsaM shvAsaM grahaNyAmayakuShThakaNDUH||37||
shAkhAnilaM baddhapurIShatAM ca hikkAM kilAsaM ca halImakaM ca| kShipraM jayedvarNabalAyurojastejonvito mAMsarasAnnabhojI||38||
iti citrakaghRutam
iti punarnavAdyariShTaH phalatrikaM dIpyakacitrakau ca sapippalIloharajo viDa~ggam| cUrNIkRutaM kauDavikaM dviraMshaM kShaudraM purANasya tulAM guDasya||39||
mAsaM nidadhyAdghRutabhAjanasthaM yaveShu tAneva nihanti rogAn| ye cArshasAM pANDuvikAriNAM ca proktA hitAH shophiShu te~apyariShTAH||40||
iti triphalAdyariShTaH kRuShNA sapAThA gajapippalI ca nidigdhikA citrakanAgare ca| sapippalImUlarajanyajAjImustaM ca cUrNaM sukhatoyapItam||41||
hanyAttridoShaM cirajaM ca shophaM kalkashca bhUnimbamahauShadhasya| ayorajastryUShaNayAvashUkacUrNaM ca pItaM triphalArasena||42||
kShAradvayaM syAllavaNAni catvAryayorajo vyoShaphalatrike ca| sapippalImUlaviDa~ggasAraM mustAjamodAmaradArubilvam||43||
kali~ggakAshcitrakamUlapAThe yaShTyAhvayaM sAtiviShaM palAMsham| sahi~ggukarShaM tvaNushuShkacUrNaM droNaM tathA mUlakashuNThakAnAm||44||
syAdbhasmanastat salilena sAdhyamAloDya yAvadghanamapradagdham| styAnaM tataH kolasamAM tu mAtrAM kRutvA sushuShkAM vidhinopayu~jjyAt||45||
plIhodarashvitrahalImakArshaHpANDvAmayArocakashoShashophAn| visUcikAgulmagarAshmarIshca sashvAsakAsAH praNudet sakuShThAH||46||
iti kShAraguDikA
shuddhyAmayAbhaktakRushAbalAnAM kShArAmlatIkShNoShNagurUpasevA| dadhyAmamRucchAkavirodhiduShTagaropasRuShTAnnaniShevaNaM ca||5||
arshAMsyaceShTA na ca dehashuddhirmarmopaghAto viShamA prasUtiH| mithyopacAraH pratikarmaNAM ca nijasya hetuH shvayathoH pradiShTaH||6||
iti kShAraguDikA prayojayedArdrakanAgaraM vA tulyaM guDenArdhapalAbhivRuddhyA| mAtrA paraM pa~jcapalAni mAsaM jIrNe payo yUSharasAshca bhaktam||47||
gulmodarArshaHshvayathupramehA~j shvAsapratishyAlasakAvipAkAn| sakAmalAshoShamanovikArAn kAsaM kaphaM caiva jayet prayogaH||48||

rasastathaivArdrakanAgarasya peyo~atha jIrNe payasA~annamadyAt| jatvashmajaM ca triphalArasena hanyAttridoShaM shvayathuM prasahya||49||

Commentary: rasastathaivetyAdau pUrvayogavadardhapalAbhivRuddhiH guDayuktatvaM cetyAdi sarvaM tathaiveti padena gRuhyate||49||
iti shilAjatuprayogaH dvipa~jcamUlasya pacet kaShAye kaMse~abhayAnAM ca shataM guDasya| lehe susiddhe~atha vinIya cUrNaM vyoShaM trisaugandhyamuShAsthite ca||50||
prasthArdhamAtraM madhunaH sushIte ki~jcicca cUrNAdapi yAvashUkAt| ekAbhayAM prAshya tatashca lehAcchuktiM nihanti shvayathuM pravRuddham||51||
shvAsajvarArocakamehagulmaplIhatridoShodarapANDurogAn| kArshyAmavAtAvasRugamlapittavaivarNyamUtrAnilashukradoShAn||52||
iti kaMsaharItakI paTolamUlAmaradArudantItrAyantipippalyabhayAvishAlAH| yaShTyAhvayaM tiktakarohiNI ca sacandanA syAnniculAni dArvI||53||
karShonmitaistaiH kvathitaH kaShAyo ghRutena peyaH kuDavena yuktaH| vIsarpadAhajvarasannipAtatRuShNAviShANi shvayathuM ca hanti||54||
sacitrakaM dhAnyayavAnyajAjIsauvarcalaM tryUShaNavetasAmlam| bilvAt phalaM dADimayAvashUkau sapippalImUlamathApi cavyam||55||
piShTvA~akShamAtrANi jalADhakena paktvA ghRutaprasthamatha prayu~jjyAt| arshAMsi gulmaM shvayathuM ca kRucchraM nihanti vahniM ca karoti dIptam||56||
pibedghRutaM vA~aShTaguNAmbusiddhaM sacitrakakShAramudAravIryam| kalyANakaM vA~api sapa~jcagavyaM tiktaM mahadvA~apyatha tiktakaM vA||57||
kShIraM ghaTe citrakakalkalipte dadhyAgataM sAdhu vimathya tena| tajjaM ghRutaM citrakamUlagarbhaM takreNa siddhaM shvayathughnamagryam||58||
arsho~atisArAnilagulmamehAMshcaitannihantyagnibalapradaM ca| takreNa cAdyAt saghRutena tena bhojyAni siddhAmathavA yavAgUm||59||
iti citrakaghRutam jIvantyajAjIshaTipuShkarAhvaiH sakAravIcitrakabilvamadhyaiH| sayAvashUkairbadarapramANairvRukShAmlayuktA ghRutatailabhRuShTA||60||
arsho~atisArAnilagulmashophahRudrogamandAgnihitA yavAgUH| yA pa~jcakolairvidhinaiva tena siddhA bhavet sA ca samA tayaiva||61||
kulatthayUShashca sapippalIko maudgashca satryUShaNayAvashUkaH| rasastathA viShkirajA~ggalAnAM sakUrmagodhAshikhishallakAnAm||62||
suvarcalA gRu~jjanakaM paTolaM savAyasImUlakavetranimbam| shAkArthinAM shAkamiti prashastaM bhojye purANashca yavaH sashAliH||63||
AbhyantaraM bheShajamuktametadbarhirhitaM yacchRuNu tadyathAvat| snehAn pradehAn pariShecanAni svedAMshca vAtaprabalasya kuryAt||64||
shaileyakuShThAgurudArukauntItvakpadmakailAmbupalAshamustaiH| priya~gguthauNeyakahemamAMsItAlIshapatraplavapatradhAnyaiH||65||
shrIveShTakadhyAmakapippalIbhiH spRukkAnakhaishcaiva yathopalAbham| vAtAnvite~abhya~ggamushanti tailaM siddhaM supiShTairapi ca pradeham||66||
jalaishca vAsArkakara~jjashigrukAshmaryapatrArjakajaishca siddhaiH| svinno mRudUShNai ravitaptatoyaiH snAtashca gandhairanulepanIyaH||67||
savetasAH kShIravatAM drumANAM tvacaH sama~jjiShThalatAmRuNAlAH| sacandanAH padmakavAlakau ca paitte pradehastu satailapAkaH||68||
Aktasya tenAmbu raviprataptaM sacandanaM sAbhayapadmakaM ca| snAne hitaM kShIravatAM kaShAyaH kShIrodakaM candanalepanaM ca||69||

... trividho nijashca sarvArdhagAtrAvayavAshritatvAt||7||

Commentary: trividha iti sarvArdhagAtrAvayavAshritatvena nijastrividhaH; cakArAdAganturapi yathoktabhedAttrividha ityarthaH||7||
kaphe tu kRuShNAsikatApurANapiNyAkashigrutvagumApralepaH| kulatthashuNThIjalamUtrasekashcaNDAgurubhyAmanulepanaM ca||70||
bibhItakAnAM phalamadhyalepaH sarveShu dAhArtiharaH pradiShTaH| yaShTyAhvamustaiH sakapitthapatraiH sacandanaistatpiDakAsu lepaH||71||
rAsnAvRuShArkatriphalAviDa~ggaM shigrutvaco mUShikaparNikA ca| nimbArjakau vyAghranakhaH sadUrvA suvarcalA tiktakarohiNI ca||72||
sakAkamAcI bRuhatI sakuShThA punarnavA citrakanAgare ca| unmardanaM shophiShu mUtrapiShTaM shastastathA mUlakatoyasekaH||73||

shophAstu gAtrAvayavAshritA ye te sthAnadUShyAkRutinAmabhedAt| anekasa~gkhyAH katicicca teShAM nidarshanArthaM gadato nibodha||74||

Commentary: shothAstvityAdi| sthAnaM galAdi, dUShyA raktAdayaH, AkRutiH AkAro dIrghatvAdiH, nAmabhedastu shalyAdiShu vistareNokto~api ‘kaNThashAlUka’ ityAdinA leshenAbhihitAH; evaM sthAnAdibhedakRutAdatibahutvAdbahusa~gkhyA j~jeyA iti yojyam||74||

antargale ghurghurikAnvitaM ca shAlUkamucchvAsanirodhakAri||75||

Commentary: ghurghurikAnvitamiti ghurghurAkArashabdena vedanayA vA yuktam||75||

galasya sandhau cibuke gale ca sadAharAgaH shvasanAsu cograH| shopho bhRushArtistu biDAlikA syAddhanyAdgale cedvalayIkRutA sA||76||

Commentary: galasya sandhAviti galavadanasandhau| shvasanAsviti shvAsavahanADIShu| biDAlikAyAM tridoShAshrayaH kAraNatvenAnuvartate| valayIkRutA seti kRutsnagalaveShTakatvena valayAkArA syAt| sushrute~apyuktaM- “taM sarvathaivAprativAryavIryaM vivarjanIyaM valayaM vadanti” (su. ni. a. 16) iti| iyaM ca tridoShajA~api raktapittAdhikA j~jeyA||76||
syAttAluvidradhyapi dAharAgapAkAnvitastAluni sA tridoShAt| jihvopariShTAdupajihvikA syAt kaphAdadhastAdadhijihvikA ca||77||
yo dantamAMseShu tu raktapittAt pAko bhavet sopakushaH pradiShTaH| syAddantavidradhyapi dantamAMse shophaH kaphAcchoNitasa~jcayotthaH||78||

bAhyAH sirAH prApya yadA kaphAsRukpittAni sandUShayatIha vAyuH| tairbaddhamArgaH sa tadA visarpannutsedhali~ggaM shvayathuM karoti||8||

Commentary: bAhyAH sirA ityAdisamprAptikathanam| bAhyA iti agambhIrAH| sirAshabdena srotasAM sAmAnyena grahaNam| baddhamArga iti AvRutamArgaH| utsedhenAvyabhicAriNA li~ggyata iti utsedhali~ggaH||8||

uraHsthitairUrdhvamadhastu vAyoH sthAnasthitairmadhyagataistu madhye| sarvA~ggagaH sarvagataiH kvacitsthairdoShaiH kvacit syAcchvayathustadAkhyaH||9||

Commentary: uraHsthitairityAdinA vishiShTashothAnAM samprAptivisheShamAha| Urdhvamiti uraHprabhRutyUrdhvasharIre| adha iti pakvAshayaprabhRutau| vAyoH sthAnaM pakvAshayaH| madhyagatairiti uraHpakvAshayamadhyagataiH| kvaciditi kaNThatAlvAdideshe| tadAkhya iti ‘galashotha’ ityAdishabdAkhya iti; kiMvA UrdhvashothAdhaHshotha ityAdishabdAkhya iti sarvatra yojanIyam||9||
galasya pArshve galagaNDa ekaH syAdgaNDamAlA bahubhistu gaNDaiH| sAdhyAH smRutAH pInasapArshvashUlakAsajvaracchardiyutAstvasAdhyAH||79||
teShAM sirAkAyashirovirekA dhUmaH purANasya ghRutasya pAnam| syAlla~gghanaM vaktrabhaveShu cApi pragharShaNaM syAt kavalagrahashca||80||
a~ggaikadesheShvanilAdibhiH syAt svarUpadhArI sphuraNaH sirAbhiH| granthirmahAnmAMsabhavastvanartirmedobhavaH snigdhatamashcalashca||81||
saMshodhite sveditamashmakAShThaiH sA~gguShThadaNDairvilayedapakvam| vipATya coddhRutya bhiShak sakoshaM shastreNa dagdhvA vraNavaccikitset||82||
adagdha IShat parisheShitashca prayAti bhUyo~api shanairvivRuddhim| tasmAdasheShaH kushalaiH samantAcchedyo bhavedvIkShya sharIradeshAn||83||
sheShe kRute pAkavashena shIryAttataH kShatotthaH prasaredvisarpaH| upadravaM taM pravicArya tajj~jastairbheShajaiH pUrvatarairyathoktaiH||84||
nivArayedAdita eva yatnAdvidhAnavit svasvavidhiM vidhAya| tataH krameNAsya yathAvidhAnaM vraNaM vraNaj~jastvarayA cikitset||85||
vivarjayet kukShyudarAshritaM ca tathA gale marmaNi saMshritaM ca| sthUlaH kharashcApi bhavedvivarjyo yashcApi bAlasthavirAbalAnAm||86||

granthyarbudAnAM ca yato~avisheShaH pradeshahetvAkRutidoShadUShyaiH| tatashcikitsedbhiShagarbudAni vidhAnavidgranthicikitsitena||87||

Commentary: arbudacikitsAtideshArthamAha- granthyarbudAnAmityAdi| avisheSha iva avisheSha iha j~jeyaH| sushrute~apyarbudalakShaNamuktaM- “gAtrapradeshe kvacideva doShAH sammUrcchitA mAMsamabhipradUShya| vRuttaM sthiraM mandarujaM mahAntamanalpamUlaM ciravRuddhyapAkam|| kurvanti mAMsocchrayamatyagAdhaM tadarbudaM shAstravido vadanti” (su. ni. a. 11) iti; tasmAt stokavisheShe satyapi srAvAdyavisheShAdgranthivisheShacikitsaivAtidishyate~arbude||87||
tAmrA sashUlA piDakA bhavedyA sA cAlajI nAma parisrutAgrA| shopho~akShatashcarmanakhAntare syAnmAMsAsradUShI bhRushashIghrapAkaH||88||
jvarAnvitA va~gkShaNakakShajA yA vartirnirartiH kaThinAyatA ca| vidArikA sA kaphamArutAbhyAM teShAM yathAdoShamupakramaH syAt||89||
visphoTakAH sarvasharIragAstu sphoTAH sarAgajvaratarShayuktAH||90||
yaj~jopavItapratimAH prabhUtAH pittAnilAbhyAM janitAstu kakShAH | yAshcAparAH syuH piDakAH prakIrNAH sthUlANumadhyA api pittajAstAH||91||
kShudrapramANAH piDakAH sharIre sarvA~ggagAH sajvaradAhatRuShNAH| kaNDUyutAH sArucisaprasekA romAntikAH pittakaphAt pradiShTAH||92||
yAH sarvagAtreShu masUramAtrA masUrikAH pittakaphAt pradiShTAH| vIsarpashAntyai vihitA kriyA yA tAM teShu kuShThe ca hitAM vidadhyAt||93||

sarvastridoSho~adhikadoShali~ggaistacchabdamabhyeti bhiShagjitaM ca||10||

Commentary: sarvashothAnAM tridoShajatve~api vAtajAdivyapadesho vAtajAdicikitsA ca yathA bhinnA bhavati tadAha- sarva ityAdi| adhikAni adhikasya vA doShasya li~ggAnIti adhikadoShali~ggAni, taiH adhikadoShali~ggaiH| tacchabdamiti adhikadoShashabdaM vAtajo~ayamityAdikaM prApnoti; tathA bhiShagjitaM cAdhikadoShali~ggaiH prApnoti, adhikadoShali~ggaprayuktaM cikitsatabhedaM prApnotItyarthaH||10||
bradhno~anilAdyairvRuShaNe svali~ggairantraM nireti pravishenmuhushca| mUtreNa pUrNaM mRudu medasA cet snigdhaM ca vidyAt kaThinaM ca shotham||94||
virecanAbhya~gganirUhalepAH pakveShu caiva vraNavaccikitsA| syAnmUtrasekaH kaphajaM vipATya vishodhya sIvyedvraNavacca pakvam||95||
krimyasthisUkShmakShaNanavyavAyapravAhaNAnyutkaTakAshvapRuShThaiH | gudasya pArshve piDakA bhRushArtiH pakvaprabhinnA tu bhagandaraH syAt||96||
virecanaM caiShaNapATanaM ca vishuddhamArgasya ca tailadAhaH| syAt kShArasUtreNa supAcitena chinnasya cAsya vraNavaccikitsA||97||

ja~gghAsu piNDIprapadopariShTAt syAcchlIpadaM mAMsakaphAsradoShAt| sirAkaphaghnashca vidhiH samagrastatreShyate sarShapalepanaM ca||98||

Commentary: ja~gghAsviti bahuvacanaM vyaktyapekShayA; kiMvA bahuvacanena ja~gghAdiShvityAdipadalopo j~jeyaH| uktaM hi- “shishnauShThanAsAsvapikecidAhuH” ityAdi| tathAhi puShkalAvataH- “grIvAva~gkShaNaja~gghauShThapAdakarNakarAshrayam| shlIpadaM mAMsamedobhyAM vidyAt” iti| piNDIti mAMsapiNDI| prapadaM pAdAgram||98||
mandAstu pittaprabalAH praduShTA doShAH sutIvraM tanuraktapAkam| kurvanti shothaM jvaratarShayuktaM visarpaNaM jAlakagardabhAkhyam||99||
vila~gghanaM raktavimokShaNaM ca virUkShaNaM kAyavishodhanaM ca| dhAtrIprayogA~j shishirAn pradehAn kuryAt sadA jAlakagardabhasya||100||

evaMvidhAMshcApyaparAn parIkShya shothaprakArAnanilAdili~ggaiH| shAntiM nayeddoShaharairyathAsvamAlepanacchedanabhedadAhaiH||101||

Commentary: atrAnuktashothaprakArasa~ggrahArthamAha- evaMvidhAnityAdi||101||

prAyo~abhighAtAdanilaH saraktaH shothaM sarAgaM prakaroti tatra| vIsarpanunmArutaraktanucca kAryaM viShaghnaM viShaje ca karma||102||

Commentary: AgantushothacikitsAmAha- prAya ityAdi| viShaje shothe iti sambandhaH||102||

tatra shlokaH- trividhasya doShabhedAt sarvArdhAvayavagAtrabhedAcca| shvayathordvividhasya tathA li~ggAni cikitsitaM coktam||103||

Commentary: sa~ggrahe sarvArdhagAtrAvayavabhedAcca trividhasyeti sambandhaH| dvividhasyeti nijAgantubhedena||103||

sagauravaM syAdanavasthitatvaM sotsedhamuShmA~atha sirAtanutvam| salomaharShA~a~ggavivarNatA ca sAmAnyali~ggaM shvayathoH pradiShTam||11||

Commentary: sagauravamityAdinA sAmAnyali~ggaM paThati||11||

calastanutvakparuSho~aruNo~asitaH prasuptiharShArtiyuto~animittataH| prashAmyati pronnamati prapIDito divAbalI ca shvayathuH samIraNAt||12||

Commentary: cala ityAdinA vAtajashothali~ggamAha| tanutvagiti abahalatvak| asita iti kRuShNaH| suptiH sparshAj~jAnaM; harShaH ‘jhaNajhaNikA’ iti khyAtA vedanA, kiMvA romaharShaH| animittataH prashAmyatIti vAyoshcalatvena kadAcinnimittaM vinA~api lIno bhavatItyarthaH| kecit ‘nimittataH’ iti paThanti, tena “snehoShNamardanAbhyAM ca praNashyet sa ca vAtikaH” (sU.a.18) iti yaduktaM tadevedamucyate| pronnamatIti sampIDanAnantaramevonnamati||12||

mRuduH sagandho~asitapItarAgavAn bhramajvarasvedatRuShAmadAnvitaH| ya uShyate sparsharugakShirAgakRut sa pittashotho bhRushadAhapAkavAn||13||

Commentary: mRudvityAdinA pittashothamAha| uShyata iti dahyate| sparsharugiti sparshanaM na sahate||13||

guruH sthiraH pANDurarocakAnvitaH prasekanidrAvamivahnimAndyakRut| sa kRucchrajanmaprashamo nipIDito na connamedrAtribalI kaphAtmakaH||14||

Commentary: gururityAdinA kaphashothamAha| arocakAnvita iti arocakavyAdhisahacArI| kRucchrajanmaprashama iti cirotpattivinAshaH| rAtribalI kaphAtmaka iti rAtrau srotorodhajena dehakledenAceShTayA ca kaphasya vRuddhatvAt tajjanitashotho balavAn bhavati, divA tu sphuTasrotasi sharIre ceShTAyukte na kapho balIbhavati kintu vAyuH; tena vAtashotho divA balIbhavati, kaphashothastu hIyate||14||
kShatakShINe marmopaghAto bhavati, shothe~api marmopaghAtaH kAraNaM, tena samAnahetutayA kShatakShayamanu shothacikitsitamucyate||1-2||

Amajamiti AmadoShajanitam, apakvatA ca prAyo doShANAM prathamaduShTau bhavati| kramairiti upakramaiH| adha iti adhobhAgajaM, virecanairupAcaret| Urdhvaharairiti vamanaiH, Urdhvajamiti UrdhvabhAgajam| satiktakaM ghRutamiti tiktadravyasAdhitaM ghRutam| pittAnilaje iti vAtapittajadvandve| mUrcchAdaya iha sa~jjAtA yasya tasmin mUrcchAratidAhatarShite| vishodhanIye iti mUrcchAyukte eva vishodhanIye| samUtretyAdi mUtrasamabhAgaistakrAsavayogaiH||17-19||

atra kaphadoShasyaiva prathamaM cikitsyatvena vyoShamityAdinA kaphashothacikitsAmAha| sAyorajasketi anena mAritamevAtra ayoraja icchanti, rasAyane~api mRutAyorajasa eva prayogopadeshAt| ayorajo na samaM tulyamAnam, ayo hi duShpariNAmaM, tenAyaHprayoge~alpameva lohaM mAtrAnusAreNa j~jeyam| harItakyAdInAM kalkaH sukhAmbunA peyaH| sapunarnavaM vA sarvamiti harItakyAdi| triShvapi vAtAdijeShu| snAtashcetyAdividhirante uktatvAduktasarvaprayogeShu j~jeyaH||21-22||

punarnavetyAdau prasthamAnaM kShIramatibahutvAttadardhAvashiShTaM paktvA peyam| mayUrakamityAdAvapi pUrvayogoktaM kShIraM dravyamAnaM ca j~jeyam| palArdhikairiti dvikarShamAnaiH| atra ca bheShajApekShayA kShIrasya bahutvAt stokakShIradAnaM kecidicchanti sAdhanatvena kartavyamiti, ‘yathA kurvanti sa upAyaH’ (sU.a.26) iti vacanAt| pItadruH devadAruH| UShaNaM maricam| bhojanavArivarjIti bhojanaM vAri ca tyaktavyamityarthaH| gavyamityAdAvapi gavAM mUtramityantena saptAhaM mAsaM veti tathA bhojanavArivarjIti cAnuvartayanti| samUtramityatra mUtrasamaM kShIrAshanamiti sambadhyate||23-28||
kUrcikamastuna ityatra dadhnA saha payasi pakvaM yanmastu tat kUrcikamastu, kevalasya dadhno yanmastu tat prAkRutamastu| vaihAyase iti antarikShe||29-31||
kAshmaryetyAdau uShNe iti uShNakAle| dviguNamiti dvisaptAhaM, shItakAle sthApyam| aShTashata iti sa~jj~jA kAshmaryAdisaptashataM militvA kRutatvAjj~jeyA||32-33||

punarnave dve ityAdau pratyekaM dravyANAM dvipalikatvam| droNAvasheShavidhAnAcca caturdroNaM jalasya j~jeyam| tathA sati caturbhAgAvasheSheNa droNaH kvAtho bhavati| palle yavAnAmiti yavarAshau, kShaudraghRutapradigdhe kumbhe kRutvA mAsaM sthApyamiti j~jeyaM; kiMvA kShaudraghRutapralipte sugandhe bhAjane kRutvA pacet| ShaTjaTharANIti bheShajAsAdhyau chidrodakadarau varjayitvA||34-38||

phalatrikamityAdau dviprasthe triphalAdInAM caturguNaM jalaM dattvA pAdAvasheShaH kaShAya AsavAntare dRuShTatvAjj~jeyaH| cUrNIkRutamiti kaShAyArthaM jarjarIkRutam| anye tu cUrNe eva droNArdhaM paraM jalaM dadati; kiMvA kuDavamAnatvaM cUrNasya deyaM, tena dviraMshaM kShaudramiti dvikuDavamiti yAvat||39-40||
pippalyAdye cUrNe tridoShamiti pratyekaM militairvA vAtAdibhirjanitamiti j~jeyam; na cAtra tridoShasyAsAdhyatvaM yuktam||41-42||
catvAri lavaNAni sAmudravarjaM dIrgha~jjIvitIyoktAni| aNushuShkacUrNamiti sUkShmacUrNaM grAhyam| atra jalamAnamapi cUrNacaturguNaM deyam| styAnamiti ghanam||43-46||

shuddhiH vamanAdishodhanam, AmayA jvarAdayaH, abhaktam abhojanaM viguNaM ca bhojanaM, taiH kRushAnAmabalAnAM ca kShArAdisevA nijasya shvayathorheturiti yojyam| dadhyAdi tu svatantrameva hetuH| Amam apakvaM, duShTaM doShakArakaM navodakAdi, garaH saMyogajaM viSham| naca dehashuddhiriti shodhanArhe~api dehe dehAshuddhiH| marmopaghAta iha doShakRuta eva j~jeyaH; bAhyahetujastu marmopaghAta Agantuhetureva| viShamA prasUtiH akAlagarbhapatanAdikA| pratikarmaNAmiti vamanAdInAM; mithyopacAra iti asamyakkaraNamasamyagupacArashca||5-6||

ArdrakanAgaramiti ashuShkanAgaram| ardhapalAbhivRuddhishca iha guDanAgarAbhyAM j~jeyA, anyathA kevalArdrakavRuddhyA pa~jcapalamAne guDena samaM dashapalatAyAM bhUrimAtratayA~agnivadhAdidoShakArakaM syAt; ardhapalAdArabhya pratidinamardhapalavRuddhyA dashabhirdinaiH pa~jcapalaM bhavati; tatastu pa~jcapalasya yAvanmAsamupayogaH||47-48||

dvipa~jcamUlasyetyAdau nirdiShTatvAt kaMsaH kvAthAdbhavati, tAvanmAnaM dashamUlaM catuHShaShTipalaM grAhyam| anye tu ‘dvipa~jcamUlasya tulAkaShAye kaMso~abhayAnAM ca shataM guDasya’ iti paThanti| vyoShatrisaugandhyayoH mAnAnirdeshena anyatra lehAntaroktacUrNamAnAnusAreNa mAnaM j~jeyam| agastyaharItakyAM guDatulAyAM pippalIcUrNapalacatuShTayamuktaM, tathA cyavanaprAshe matsyaNDikArdhatulAyAM pippalIcUrNapaladvayamuktaM, tadvadihApi guDashate vyoShasya kaTudravyasya palacatuShTayaM; tathA cyavane cAturjAtakasya gandhArthasya palamuktaM, tadanusAreNeha dvipalaM trisaugandhyam| ki~jcicchabdasyAlpavacanatvAdatroktanAgarAdicUrNAdardhamAnaM yAvashUkasya j~jeyaM, kecittu ki~jcicchabdaM karShaparyAyaM vadanti; tantrAntarapratyayAt| jatUkarNasaMvAdAt trisaugandhyasya pratyekaM karShamAnatvaM, tryUShaNayavakShArANAM tu pratyekaM palam| yaduktaM- “dashamUlakaShAyasya kaMse pathyAshataM guDAt| tulAM pacettato dadyAd vyoShakShAracatuHpalam| trisugandhasya karShAMsha prasthArdhaM madhuno hime” ityAdi||50-52||

paTolamUletyAdau kvAthyadravyapalatrayamaShTaguNajalaparibhAShayA kvathanIyaM; tatashcaturbhAgAvasheSheNa ShaTpalamAnaH kaShAyo bhavati| uktaM hi- “karShAdau tu palaM yAvat dadyAt ShoDashakaM jalam| tatashca kuDavaM yAvattoyamaShTaguNaM bhavet” iti||53-54||
sacitraketyAdau kecit ‘bilvAt palaM’ iti paThanti; tanmate bilvaM palamAnaM, sheShaM tu kArShikam||55-57||
dadhyAgatamiti dadhibhAvena pariNatam| takreNeti yathoktadadhimathanajAtena takreNa||58-59||

jIvantItyAdau badarapramANairiti dvishANikaiH| vidhinaiva tenetyatra badaramAnatvaM dravyANAM j~jeyam| sakUrmetyAdau kUrmavidhAnaM matsyamAMsaniShedhe~apyapavAdarUpaM j~jeyam| shallakaH shalalIsa~jj~jaH| suvarcikA sUryAvartaH| gRu~jjanakaM rasonakasadRushaM; kiMvA gRu~jjanakaM shobhA~jjanam| vAyasI kAkamAcI||60-63||

shaileyetyAdau tailaM siddhaM supiShTairiti shaileyAdibhiH supiShTaistailaM siddhamiti vadanti; tathA taireva supiShTaiH pradehaM kathayanti| raviNA sUryeNa taptatoyaiH snAto gandhairagurvAdibhirAlepanIyaH||64-67||
savetasA ityAdinA paitte pradehamAha| kShIridrumA ashvatthAdayaH| satailapAka iti ma~jjiShThAdibhireva kvAthakalkena snehaH paktavyaH| sacandanamityAdau abhayam ushIram||68-69||

sikatA vAlukA| shigrostvak| anulepanaM snAnAnantaramanulepanam| tatpiDakAsviti dAhAdiyuktapiDikAsu| rAsnetyAdinA sarvashotheShUnmardanasekau brUte| vyAghranakhaM nakhI| mUShikaparNI ‘putrashreNI’ iti khyAtA||70-73||
upajihvikeha trishothIyoktA~api tatrAnuktAdhijihvikAprasa~ggenoktA||77-78||
sAdhyAH smRutA ityAdi| pInasAdirahitAH sAdhyAH| sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgAdibhedAH shiraHshothAdiShu sarveShveva j~jeyAH| sireti sirAvyadhaH| visheShacikitsA tu sushrute pratipattavyA||79-80||

a~ggaikadeshetyAdinA granthInAha| svarUpadhArIti vAtena vAtalakShaNadhArI, pittena pittalakShaNadhArI, kaphena kaphalakShaNadhArI ca| granthisa~jj~jayA granthyAkAratvaM darshayati| sphuraNaH vepamAna ityarthaH| medobhavo~anartirbhavati| mahAn granthirmAMsabhavo bhavati| saMshodhite iti kRutashodhane puruShe| vilayediti vimlApayet| sakoshamiti koshasahitamuddhRutya tato dagdhvA vraNavaccikitset| asamyagdagdhe parisheShite ca granthau doShamAha- adagdha ityAdi| svairbheShajairiti visarpabheShajaiH| vivarjayedityAdinA~asAdhyagranthibhedAnAha||81-86||

carmanakhAntara iti carmanakhasandhau| vidArikeha kaphavAtAbhyAmucyate, sushrute vidArikA “sarvajAM sarvalakShaNAm” (su. ni.a.13) iti paThitA, tenehApi kaphavAtAdhikA hInapittA ca vij~jeyA| teShAmityanena alajyakShatavidArikArogAn pratyavamRushati| visrAvaNamiti raktavisrAvaNam| piNDikayeti piNDikAsvedena||88-89||-

sphoTA iha kakShoktasphoTAshcirasthAyinaH| yaj~jopavItapratimA iti yaj~jopavItavyApyasthAnamAtravyApakAH sphoTA eva, kakShA iti kakShAshabdAkhyAH| prakIrNA iti bahuvidhajAtikAH| visarpetyAdau teShviti visphoTa-kakShA-masUrikAkhyeShu vidArikAnantarokteShvityarthaH||90-93||

bradhna ityAdau vRuShaNe iti jAtAvekavacanaM, tena vRuShaNayorapi grahaNam| svali~ggairiti vAtAdili~ggaiH| vAtali~ggena vAtikaH, pittali~ggena paittikaH, kaphali~ggena kaphajo bradhno j~jeya ityarthaH| antraM muhurnireti svasthAnAd vRuShaNaM pravishecceti antravRuddhilakShaNam| mUtreNa tu yadbradhnaM tat pUrNaM mRudu ca bhavati| medasA tu kRutaM snigdhaM kaThinaM ca| evaM ShaDvidho bradhna uktaH| sushrute tu raktajo~api bradhna uktaH, sa iha pittaje evAntarbhAvanIyaH| virecanetyAdinA sAmAnyacikitsAsUtramAha| kaphajAnAM vaisheShikI cikitsocyate- vipATya vishodhya ca sIvyed vipakvaM bradhnaM, vraNavaccopacarediti bhAvaH||94-95||

krimyasthItyAdinA bhagandaraM pa~jcavidhamapIha sa~gkShepAt sAmAnyenAha| eShaNaM shalAkayA gatyavekShaNam| kShArasUtreNa supAcitena chinnasyetyanena shalyatantroktaM kShArasUtravidhAnaM darshayati; prapa~jcastviha parAdhikAratvena na kRutaH; supAciteneti samyagvipAcitakShAreNa||96-97||

mandA ityAdau mandA iti alpavRuddhAH; mandA iti bahuvacanaM vyaktyapekShayA| pittaM prabalaM yeShAM te pittaprabalAH| tanuH raktapAko yasmin tat tanuraktapAkaM; sushrute hi apAkashabdena IShatpAka uktaH “apAkaH shvayathuH pittAt sa j~jeyo jAlagardabhaH” (su. ni. a. 13) iti| raktasya pAkena yuktaM raktapAkaM, natu raktavarNamAtram||99-100||
athAta udaracikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
kaTvamlalavaNAtyuShNatIkShNAgnyAtapasevanaiH| vidAhyadhyashanAjIrNaishcAshu pittaM samAcitam||26||
prApyAnilakaphau ruddhvA mArgamunmArgamAsthitam| nihantyAmAshaye vahniM janayatyudaraM tataH||27||

tasya rUpANi- dAhajvaratRuShNAmUrcchAtIsArabhramAH, kaTukAsyatvaM, haritahAridratvaM ca nakhanayanavadanatva~gmUtravarcasAm, api codaraM nIlapItahAridraharitatAmrarAjIsirAvanaddhaM, dahyate, dUyate, dhUpyate, UShmAyate, svidyate, klidyate, mRudusparshaM kShiprapAkaM ca bhavati; etat pittodaramiti vidyAt||28||
avyAyAmadivAsvapnasvAdvatisnigdhapicchilaiH| dadhidugdhaudakAnUpamAMsaishcApyatisevitaiH||29||
kruddhena shleShmaNA srotaHsvAvRuteShvAvRuto~anilaH| tameva pIDayan kuryAdudaraM bahirantragaH ||30||

tasya rUpANi- gauravArocakAvipAkA~ggamardAH, suptiH, pANipAdamuShkorushophaH, utkleshanidrAkAsashvAsAH, shuklatvaM ca nakhanayanavadanatva~gmUtravarcasAm; api codaraM shuklarAjIsirAsantataM, guru, stimitaM, sthiraM, kaThinaM ca bhavati; etacchleShmodaramiti vidyAt||31||
durbalAgnerapathyAmavirodhigurubhojanaiH| strIdattaishca rajoromaviNmUtrAsthinakhAdibhiH||32||
viShaishca mandairvAtAdyAH kupitAH sa~jcayaM trayaH| shanaiH koShThe prakurvanto janayantyudaraM nRuNAm||33||
tasya rUpANi- sarveShAmeva doShANAM samastAni li~ggAnyupalabhyante, varNAshca sarve nakhAdiShu, udaramapi nAnAvarNarAjIsirAsantataM bhavati; etat sannipAtodaramiti vidyAt||34||
ashitasyAtisa~gkShobhAdyAnayAnAticeShTitaiH| ativyavAyabhArAdhvavamanavyAdhikarshanaiH||35||
vAmapArshvAshritaH plIhA cyutaH sthAnAt pravardhate| shoNitaM vA rasAdibhyo vivRuddhaM taM vivardhayet||36||
tasya plIhA kaThino~aShThIlevAdau vardhamAnaH kacchapasaMsthAna upalabhyate; sa copekShitaH krameNa kukShiM jaTharamagnyadhiShThAnaM ca parikShipannudaramabhinirvartayati||37||

tasya rUpANi- daurbalyArocakAvipAkavarcomUtragrahatamaHpraveshapipAsA~ggamardacchardimUrcchA~ggasAda- kAsashvAsamRudujvarAnAhAgninAshakArshyAsyavairasyaparvabhedakoShThavAtashUlAni, api codaramaruNavarNaM vivarNaM vA nIlaharitahAridrarAjimadbhavati; evameva yakRudapi dakShiNapArshvasthaM kuryAt, tulyahetuli~ggauShadhatvAttasya plIhajaThara evAvarodha iti; etat plIhodaramiti vidyAt||38||
pakShmabAlaiH sahAnnena bhuktairbaddhAyane gude| udAvartaistathA~arshobhirantrasammUrcchanena vA||39||
apAno mArgasaMrodhAddhatvA~agniM kupito~anilaH| varcaHpittakaphAn ruddhvA janayatyudaraM tataH||40||

tasya rUpANi- tRuShNAdAhajvaramukhatAlushoShorusAdakAsashvAsadaurbalyArocakAvipAka- varcomUtrasa~ggAdhmAnacchardikShavathushirohRunnAbhigudashUlAni, api codaraM mUDhavAtaM sthiramaruNaM nIlarAji sirAvanaddharAjikaM vA prAyo nAbhyupari gopucchavadabhinirvartata iti; etadbaddhagudodaramiti vidyAt||41||
sharkarAtRuNakAShThAsthikaNTakairannasaMyutaiH| bhidyetAntraM yadA bhuktairjRumbhayA~atyashanena vA||42||
pAkaM gacchedrasastebhyashchidrebhyaH prasravadbahiH| pUrayan gudamantraM ca janayatyudaraM tataH||43||

tasya rUpANi- tadadho nAbhyAH prAyo~abhivardhamAnamudakodaraM bhavati, yathAbalaM ca doShANAM rUpANi darshayati, api cAturaH salohitanIlapItapicchilakuNapagandhyAmavarca upaveshate, hikkAshvAsakAsatRuShNApramehArocakAvipAkadaurbalyaparItashca bhavati; etacchidrodaramiti vidyAt||44||
snehapItasya mandAgneH kShINasyAtikRushasya vA| atyambupAnAnnaShTe~agnau mArutaH klomni saMsthitaH||45||
srotaHsu ruddhamArgeShu kaphashcodakamUrcchitaH| vardhayetAM tadevAmbu svasthAnAdudarAya tau||46||
tasya rUpANi- anannakA~gkShApipAsAgudasrAvashUlashvAsakAsadaurbalyAni, api codaraM nAnAvarNarAjisirAsantatamudakapUrNadRutikShobhasaMsparshaM bhavati, etadudakodaramiti vidyAt||47||

tatra acirotpannamanupadravamanudakamaprAptamudaraM tvaramANashcikitset; upekShitAnAM hyeShAM doShAH svasthAnAdapavRuttA paripAkAddravIbhUtAH sandhIn srotAMsi copakledayanti, svedashca bAhyeShu srotaHsu pratihatagatistiryagavatiShThamAnastadevodakamApyAyayati; tatra picchotpattau maNDalamudaraM guru stimitamAkoThitamashabdaM mRudusparshamapagatarAjIkamAkrAntaM nAbhyAmevopasarpati| tato~anantaramudakaprAdurbhAvaH| tasya rUpANi- kukSheratimAtravRuddhiH, sirAntardhAnagamanam, udakapUrNadRutisa~gkShobhasaMsparshatvaM ca||48||
tadA~a~aturamupadravAH spRushanti- chardyatIsAratamakatRuShNAshvAsakAsahikkAdaurbalyapArshvashUlArucisvarabhedamUtrasa~ggAdayaH; tathAvidhamacikitsyaM vidyAditi||49||
bhavanti cAtra- vAtAtpittAtkaphAt plIhnaH sannipAtAttathodakAt| paraM paraM kRucchrataramudaraM bhiShagAdishet||50||
pakShAdbaddhagudaM tUrdhvaM sarvaM jAtodakaM tathA| prAyo bhavatyabhAvAya cchidrAntraM codaraM nRuNAm||51||
shUnAkShaM kuTilopasthamupaklinnatanutvacam| balashoNitamAMsAgniparikShINaM ca varjayet||52||
shvayathuH sarvamarmotthaH shvAso hikkA~aruciH satRuT| mUrcchA cchardiratIsAro nihantyudariNaM naram||53||
janmanaivodaraM sarvaM prAyaH kRucchratamaM matam| balinastadajAtAmbu yatnasAdhyaM navotthitam||54||
ajAtashothamaruNaM sashabdaM nAtibhArikam| sadA guDaguDAyacca sirAjAlagavAkShitam||55||
nAbhiM viShTabhya pAyau tu vegaM kRutvA praNashyati| hRunnAbhiva~gkShaNakaTIgudapratyekashUlinaH||56||
karkashaM sRujato vAtaM nAtimande ca pAvake| lolasyAvirase cAsye mUtre~alpe saMhate viShi||57||
ajAtodakamityetairli~ggairvij~jAya tattvataH| upAkramedbhiShagdoShabalakAlavisheShavit||58||
vAtodaraM balamataH pUrvaM snehairupAcaret| snigdhAya sveditA~ggAya dadyAt snehavirecanam||59||
hRute doShe parimlAnaM veShTayedvAsasodaram| tathA~asyAnavakAshatvAdvAyurnAdhmApayet punaH||60||
doShAtimAtropacayAt srotomArganirodhanAt| sambhavatyudaraM tasmAnnityameva virecayet||61||
shuddhaM saMsRujya ca kShIraM balArthaM pAyayettu tam| prAgutkleshAnnivartyaM ca bale labdhe kramAt payaH||62||
yUShai rasairvA mandAmlalavaNairedhitAnalam| sodAvartaM punaH snigdhaM svinnamAsthApayennaram||63||
sphuraNAkShepasandhyasthipArshvapRuShThatrikArtiShu| dIptAgniM baddhaviDvAtaM rUkShamapyanuvAsayet||64||
tIkShNAdhobhAgayukto~asya nirUho dAshamUlikaH| vAtaghnAmlashRutairaNDatilatailAnuvAsanam||65||
avirecyaM tu yaM vidyAddurbalaM sthaviraM shishum| sukumAraM prakRutyA~alpadoShaM vA~atholbaNAnilam||66||
taM bhiShak shamanaiH sarpiryUShamAMsarasaudanaiH| bastyabhya~ggAnuvAsaishca kShIraishcopAcaredbudhaH||67||
siddhavidyAdharAkIrNe kailAse nandanopame| tapyamAnaM tapastIvraM sAkShAddharmamiva sthitam||3||
AyurvedavidAM shreShThaM bhiShagvidyApravartakam| punarvasuM jitAtmAnamagnivesho~abravIdvacaH||4||
bhagavannudarairduHkhairdRushyante hyarditA narAH| shuShkavaktrAH kRushairgAtrairAdhmAtodarakukShayaH||5||
pranaShTAgnibalAhArAH sarvaceShTAsvanIshvarAH| dInAH pratikriyAbhAvAjjahato~asUnanAthavat||6||
teShAmAyatanaM sa~gkhyAM prAgrUpAkRutibheShajam| yathAvacchrotumicchAmi guruNA samyagIritam||7||
sarvabhUtahitAyarShiH shiShyeNaivaM pracoditaH| sarvabhUtahitaM vAkyaM vyAhartumupacakrame||8||
pittodare tu balinaM pUrvameva virecayet| durbalaM tvanuvAsyAdau shodhayet kShIrabastinA||68||
sa~jjAtabalakAyAgniM punaH snigdhaM virecayet| payasA satrivRutkalkenorubUkashRutena vA||69||
sAtalAtrAyamANAbhyAM shRutenAragvadhena vA| sakaphe vA samUtreNa savAte tiktasarpiShA||70||
punaH kShIraprayogaM ca bastikarma virecanam| krameNa dhruvamAtiShThan yuktaH pittodaraM jayet||71||
snigdhaM svinnaM vishuddhaM tu kaphodariNamAturam| saMsarjayet kaTukShArayuktairannaiH kaphApahaiH||72||
gomUtrAriShTapAnaishca cUrNAyaskRutibhistathA| sakShAraistailapAnaishca shamayettu kaphodaram||73||

koladviprasthasaMyuktaM kaShAyamupakalpayet| palikaiH pa~jcakolaistu taiH sarvaishcApi tulyayA||74||

Commentary: sarvA yathoktA iti pratyekaM vAtAdivihitAH sarvA eva sannipAtodare kartavyAH| sopadravaM tu nirvRuttamiti sopadravatayotpannam||74||
udAvartarujAnAhairdAhamohatRuShAjvaraiH| gauravArucikAThinyaishcAnilAdIn yathAkramam||75||
li~ggaiH plIhnyadhikAn dRuShTvA raktaM cApi svalakShaNaiH| cikitsAM samprakurvIta yathAdoShaM yathAbalam||76||
snehaM svedaM virekaM ca nirUhamanuvAsanam| samIkShya kArayedbAhau vAme vA vyadhayet sirAm||77||
ShaTpalaM pAyayet sarpiH pippalIrvA prayojayet| saguDAmabhayAM vA~api kShArAriShTagaNAMstathA||78||
eSha kriyAkramaH prokto yogAn saMshamanA~jchRuNu| pippalI nAgaraM dantI citrakaM dviguNAbhayam||79||
viDa~ggAMshayutaM cUrNametaduShNAmbunA pibet| viDa~ggaM citrakaM shuNThIM saghRutAM saindhavaM vacAm||80||
dagdhvA kapAle payasA gulmaplIhApahaM pibet| rohItakalatAnAM tu kANDakAnabhayAjale||81||
mUtre vA sunuyAttacca saptarAtrasthitaM pibet| kAmalAgulmamehArshaHplIhasarvodarakrimIn||82||
sa hanyAjjA~ggalarasairjIrNe syAccAtra bhojanam| rohItakatvacaH kRutvA palAnAM pa~jcaviMshatim||83||
rohItakatvacA piShTairghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet| plIhAbhivRuddhiM shamayatyetadAshu prayojitam||85||
tathA gulmodarashvAsakrimipANDutvakAmalAH| agnikarma ca kurvIta bhiShagvAtakapholbaNe||86||
paittike jIvanIyAni sarpIMShi kShIrabastayaH| raktAvasekaH saMshuddhiH kShIrapAnaM ca shasyate||87||
yUShairmAMsarasaishcApi dIpanIyasamAyutaiH| yakRuti plIhavat sarvaM tulyatvAdbheShajaM matam||88||
svinnAya baddhodariNe mUtratIkShNauShadhAnvitam||89||
agnidoShAnmanuShyANAM rogasa~gghAH pRuthagvidhAH| malavRuddhyA pravartante visheSheNodarANi tu||9||
mande~agnau malinairbhuktairapAkAddoShasa~jcayaH| prANAgnyapAnAn sandUShya mArgAnruddhvA~adharottarAn||10||
tva~gmAMsAntaramAgamya kukShimAdhmApayan bhRusham| janayatyudaraM tasya hetuM shRuNu salakShaNam||11||
satailalavaNaM dadyAnnirUhaM sAnuvAsanam| parisraMsIni cAnnAni tIkShNaM caiva virecanam||90||
udAvartaharaM karma kAryaM vAtaghnameva ca| chidrodaramRute svedAcchleShmodaravadAcaret||91||
jAtaM jAtaM jalaM srAvyamevaM tadyApayedbhiShak| tRuShNAkAsajvarArtaM tu kShINamAMsAgnibhojanam||92||
apAM doShaharANyAdau pradadyAdudakodare||93||
mUtrayuktAni tIkShNAni vividhakShAravanti ca| dIpanIyaiH kaphaghnaishca tamAhArairupAcaret||94||
sarvamevodaraM prAyo doShasa~gghAtajaM matam||95||
tasmAttridoShashamanIM kriyAM sarvatra kArayet| doShaiH kukShau hi sampUrNe vahnirmandatvamRucchati||96||
tasmAdbhojyAni bhojyAni dIpanAni laghUni ca| raktashAlIn yavAnmudgA~jjA~ggalAMshca mRugadvijAn||97||
payomUtrAsavAriShTAnmadhusIdhuM tathA surAm| yavAgUmodanaM vA~api yUShairadyAdrasairapi||98||
mandAmlasnehakaTubhiH pa~jcamUlopasAdhitaiH| audakAnUpajaM mAMsaM shAkaM piShTakRutaM tilAn||99||
vyAyAmAdhvadivAsvapnaM yAnayAnaM ca varjayet| tathoShNalavaNAmlAni vidAhIni gurUNi ca||100||
nAtisAndraM hitaM pAne svAdu takramapelavam||101||
tryUShaNakShAralavaNairyuktaM tu nicayodarI| vAtodarI pibettakraM pippalIlavaNAnvitam||102||
sharkarAmadhukopetaM svAdu pittodarI pibet| yavAnIsaindhavAjAjIvyoShayuktaM kaphodarI||103||
pibenmadhuyutaM takraM kavoShNaM nAtipelavam| madhutailavacAshuNThIshatAhvAkuShThasaindhavaiH||104||
yuktaM plIhodarI jAtaM savyoShaM tUdakodarI| baddhodarI tu hapuShAyavAnyajAjisaindhavaiH ||105||
pibecchidrodarI takraM pippalIkShaudrasaMyutam| gauravArocakArtAnAM samandAgnyatisAriNAm||106||
shophAnAhArtitRuNmUrcchApIDite kArabhaM payaH||107||
shuddhAnAM kShAmadehAnAM gavyaM chAgaM samAhiSham| devadArupalAshArkahastipippalishigrukaiH||108||
sAshvagandhaiH sagomUtraiH pradihyAdudaraM samaiH| vRushcikAlIM vacAM kuShThaM pa~jcamUlIM punarnavAm||109||
bhUtIkaM nAgaraM dhAnyaM jale paktvA~avasecayet| palAshaM kattRuNaM rAsnAM tadvat paktvA~avasecayet||110||

rUkShANAM bahuvAtAnAM tathA saMshodhanArthinAm||111||

Commentary: ‘dIpanIyAni’ ityatra kecit ‘snehanIyAni’ iti paThanti||111||-
pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakanAgaraiH||112||
sakShArairardhapalikairdviprasthaM sarpiShaH pacet| kalkairdvipa~jcamUlasya tulArdhasvarasena ca||113||
dadhimaNDADhakopetaM tat sarpirjaTharApaham| shvayathuM vAtaviShTambhaM gulmArshAMsi ca nAshayet||114||
nAgaratriphalAprasthaM ghRutatailAttathA~a~aDhakam| mastunaH sAdhayitvaitat pibet sarvodarApaham||115||
caturguNe jale mUtre dviguNe citrakAt pale||116||
kalke siddhaM ghRutaprasthaM sakShAraM jaTharI pibet| yavakolakulatthAnAM pa~jcamUlarasena ca||117||

ebhiH snigdhAya sa~jjAte bale shAnte ca mArute||118||

Commentary: sraste doShAshaya iti doShe snehena vimuktabandhanatvAt sraste ityarthaH||118||-
paTolamUlaM rajanIM viDa~ggaM triphalAtvacam||119||
atyuShNalavaNakShAravidAhyamlagarAshanAt| mithyAsaMsarjanAdrUkShaviruddhAshucibhojanAt||12||
plIhArshograhaNIdoShakarshanAt karmavibhramAt| kliShTAnAmapratIkArAdraukShyAdvegavidhAraNAt||13||
srotasAM dUShaNAdAmAt sa~gkShobhAdatipUraNAt| arshobAlashakRudrodhAdantrasphuTanabhedanAt||14||
atisa~jcitadoShANAM pApaM karma ca kurvatAm| udarANyupajAyante mandAgnInAM visheShataH||15||
kampillakaM nIlinIM ca trivRutAM ceti cUrNayet| ShaDAdyAn kArShikAnantyAMstrIMshca dvitricaturguNAn||120||
kRutvA cUrNamato muShTiM gavAM mUtreNa nA pibet| virikto mRudu bhu~jjIta bhojanaM jA~ggalai rasaiH||121||
maNDaM peyAM ca pItvA nA savyoShaM ShaDahaM payaH| shRutaM pibettatashcUrNaM pibedevaM punaH punaH||122||
hanti sarvodarANyetaccUrNaM jAtodakAnyapi| kAmalAM pANDurogaM ca shvayathuM cApakarShati||123||
gavAkShIM sha~gkhinIM dantIM tilvakasya tvacaM vacAm||124||
pibeddrAkShAmbugomUtrakolakarkandhusIdhubhiH| yavAnI hapuShA dhAnyaM triphalA copaku~jcikA||125||
kAravI pippalImUlamajagandhA shaTI vacA| shatAhvA jIrakaM vyoShaM svarNakShIrI sacitrakA||126||
dvau kShArau pauShkaraM mUlaM kuShThaM lavaNapa~jcakam| viDa~ggaM ca samAMshAni dantyA bhAgatrayaM tathA||127||
trivRudvishAle dviguNe sAtalA syAccaturguNA| etannArAyaNaM nAma cUrNaM rogagaNApaham||128||
nainat prApyAtivartante rogA viShNumivAsurAH| takreNodaribhiH peyaM gulmibhirbadarAmbunA||129||
AnaddhavAte surayA vAtaroge prasannayA| dadhimaNDena viTsa~gge dADimAmbubhirarshasaiH||130||
parikarte savRukShAmlamuShNAmbubhirajIrNake| bhagandare pANDuroge shvAse kAse galagrahe||131||
hRudroge grahaNIdoShe kuShThe mande~anale jvare| daMShTrAviShe mUlaviShe sagare kRutrime viShe||132||
yathArhaM snigdhakoShThena peyametadvirecanamiti nArAyaNacUrNam
hapuShAM kA~jcanakShIrIM triphalAM kaTurohiNIm||133||
nIlinIM trAyamANAM ca sAtalAM trivRutAM vacAm| saindhavaM kAlalavaNaM pippalIM ceti cUrNayet||134||
dADimatriphalAmAMsarasamUtrasukhodakaiH| peyo~ayaM sarvagulmeShu plIhni sarvodareShu ca||135||
shvitre kuShThe sarujake savAte viShamAgniShu| shothArshaHpANDurogeShu kAmalAyAM halImake||136||
vAtaM pittaM kaphaM cAshu virekAt samprasAdhayetiti hapuShAdyaM cUrNamnIlinIM niculaM vyoShaM dvau kShArau lavaNAni ca||137||
citrakaM ca pibeccUrNaM sarpiShodaragulmanutiti nIlinyAdyaM cUrNam
kShIradroNaM sudhAkShIraprasthArdhasahitaM dadhi||138||
jAtaM vimathya tadyuktyA trivRutsiddhaM pibedghRutam| tathA siddhaM ghRutaprasthaM payasyaShTaguNe pibet||139||
snukkShIrapalakalkena trivRutAShaTpalena ca| gulmAnAM garadoShANAmudarANAM ca shAntaye||140||
iti snuhIkShIraghRutam
dadhimaNDADhake siddhAt snukkShIrapalakalkitAt| ghRutaprasthAt pibenmAtrAM tadvajjaTharashAntaye||141||
eShAM cAnu pibet peyAM payo vA svAdu vA rasam| ghRute jIrNe viriktastu koShNaM nAgarakaiH shRutam||142||
pibedambu tataH peyAM yUShaM kaulatthakaM tataH| pibedrUkShastryahaM tvevaM bhUyo vA pratibhojitaH||143||
punaH punaH pibet sarpirAnupUrvyA tayaiva ca| ghRutAnyetAni siddhAni vidadhyAt kushalo bhiShak||144||
gulmAnAM garadoShANAmudarANAM ca shAntaye| pIlukalkopasiddhaM vA ghRutamAnAhabhedanam||145||
kramAnnirhRutadoShANAM jA~ggalapratibhojinAm ||146||
doShasheShanivRuttyarthaM yogAn vakShyAmyataH param| citrakAmaradArubhyAM kalkaM kShIreNa nA pibet||147||
mAsaM yuktastathA hastipippalI vishvabheShajam| viDa~ggaM citrakaM dantI cavyaM vyoShaM ca taiH payaH||148||
kalkaiH kolasamaiH pItvA pravRuddhamudaraM jayet| pibet kaShAyaM triphalAdantIrohitakaiH shRutam||149||
vyoShakShArayutaM jIrNe rasairadyAttu jA~ggalaiH| mAMsaM vA bhojanaM bhojyaM sudhAkShIraghRutAnvitam||150||
kShIrAnupAnAM gomUtreNAbhayAM vA prayojayet| saptAhaM mAhiShaM mUtraM kShIraM cAnannabhuk pibet||151||
mAsamauShTraM payashchAgaM trInmAsAn vyoShasaMyutam| harItakIsahasraM vA kShIrAshI vA shilAjatu||152||
shilAjatuvidhAnena gugguluM vA prayojayet| shRu~ggaverArdrakarasaH pAne kShIrasamo hitaH||153||
tailaM rasena tenaiva siddhaM dashaguNena vA| dantIdravantIphalajaM tailaM dUShyodare hitam||154||
shUlAnAhavibandheShu mastuyUSharasAdibhiH| saralAmadhushigrUNAM bIjebhyo mUlakasya ca||155||
tailAnyabhya~ggapAnArthaM shUlaghnAnyanilodare| staimityArucihRullAse mande~agnau madyapAya ca||156||
ariShTAn dApayet kShArAn kaphastyAnasthirodare| shleShmaNo vilayArthaM tu doShaM vIkShya bhiShagvaraH||157||
pippalIM tilvakaM hi~ggu nAgaraM hastipippalIm| bhallAtakaM shigruphalaM triphalAM kaTurohiNIm||158||
devadAru haridre dve saralAtiviShe vacAm | kuShThaM mustaM tathA pa~jca lavaNAni prakalpya ca||159||
dadhisarpirvasAmajjatailayuktAni dAhayet| annAdUrdhvamataH kShArAdbiDAlakapadaM pibet||160||
madirAdadhimaNDoShNajalAriShTasurAsavaiH| hRudrogaM shvayathuM gulmaM plIhArshojaTharANi ca||161||
visUcikAmudAvartaM vAtAShThIlAM ca nAshayet| kShAraM cAjakarIShANAM srutaM mUtrairvipAcayet||162||
kArShikaM pippalImUlaM pa~jcaiva lavaNAni ca| pippalIM citrakaM shuNThIM triphalAM trivRutAM vacAm||163||
dvau kShArau sAtalAM dantIM svarNakShIrIM viShANikAm| kolapramANAM vaTikAM pibet sauvIrasaMyutAm||164||
shvayathAvavipAke ca pravRuddhe ca dakodare| bhAvitAnAM gavAM mUtre ShaShTikAnAM tu taNDulaiH||165||
yavAgUM payasA siddhAM prakAmaM bhojayennaram| pibedikShurasaM cAnu jaTharANAM nivRuttaye||166||
svaM svaM sthAnaM vrajantyevaM tathA pittakaphAnilAH| sha~gkhinIsnuktrivRuddantIcirabilvAdipallavaiH||167||
shAkaM gADhapurIShAya prAgbhaktaM dApayedbhiShak | tato~asmai shithilIbhUtavarcodoShAya shAstravit||168||
dadyAnmUtrayutaM kShIraM doShasheShaharaM shivam| pArshvashUlamupastambhaM hRudgrahaM cApi mArutaH||169||
janayedyasya taM tailaM bilvakShAreNa pAyayet| tathA~agnimanthasyonAkapalAshatilanAlajaiH||170||
balAkadalyapAmArgakShAraiH pratyekashaH srutaiH| tailaM paktvA bhiShagdadyAdudarANAM prashAntaye||171||
kaphe vAtena pittena tAbhyAM vA~apyAvRute~anile||172||
kShunnAshaH svAdvatisnigdhagurvannaM pacyate cirAt| bhuktaM vidahyate sarvaM jIrNAjIrNaM na vetti ca||16||
sahate nAtisauhityamIShacchophashca pAdayoH| shashvadbalakShayo~alpe~api vyAyAme shvAsamRucchati||17||
vRuddhiH purIShanicayo rUkShodAvartahetukA| bastisandhau rugAdhmAnaM vardhate pATyate~api ca||18||
Atanyate ca jaTharamapi laghvalpabhojanAt| rAjIjanma valInAsha iti li~ggaM bhaviShyatAm||19||
balinaH svauShadhayutaM tailameraNDajaM hitam| suvirikto naro yastu punarAdhmApito bhavet||173||
susnigdhairamlalavaNairnirUhaistamupAcaret| sopastambho~api vA vAyurAdhmApayati yaM naram||174||
kriyAtivRutte jaThare tridoShe cAprashAmyati||175||
j~jAtIn sasuhRudo dArAn brAhmaNAnnRupatIn gurUn| anuj~jApya bhiShak karma vidadhyAt saMshayaM bruvan||176||
akriyAyAM dhruvo mRutyuH kriyAyAM saMshayo bhavet| evamAkhyAya tasyedamanuj~jAtaH suhRudgaNaiH||177||
pAnabhojanasaMyuktaM viShamasmai prayojayet| yasmin vA kupitaH sarpo visRujeddhi phale viSham||178||
bhojayettadudariNaM pravicArya bhiShagvaraH| tenAsya doShasa~gghAtaH sthiro lIno vimArgagaH||179||
viSheNAshupramAthitvAdAshu bhinnaH pravartate| viSheNa hRutadoShaM taM shItAmbupariShecitam||180||
pAyayeta bhiShagdugdhaM yavAgUM vA yathAbalam| trivRunmaNDUkaparNyoshca shAkaM sayavavAstukam||181||
bhakShayet kAlashAkaM vA svarasodakasAdhitam | niramlalavaNasnehaM svinnAsvinnamanannabhuk||182||
mAsamekaM tatashcaiva tRuShitaH svarasaM pibet| evaM vinirhRute doShe shAkairmAsAt paraM tataH||183||
idaM tu shalyahartRUNAM karma syAddRuShTakarmaNAm||184||
vAmaM kukShiM mApayitvA nAbhyadhashcatura~ggulam| mAtrAyuktena shastreNa pATayenmatimAn bhiShak||185||
vipATyAntraM tataH pashcAdvIkShya baddhakShatAntrayoH| sarpiShA~abhyajya keshAdInavamRujya vimokShayet||186||
mUrcchanAdyacca sammUDhamantraM tacca vimokShayet| chidrANyantrasya tu sthUlairdaMshayitvA pipIlikaiH||187||
bahushaH sa~ggRuhItAni j~jAtvA cchitvA pipIlikAn| pratiyogaiH praveshyAntraM preyaiH sIvyedvraNaM tataH||188||
tathA jAtodakaM sarvamudaraM vyadhayedbhiShak| vAmapArshve tvadho nAbhernADIM dattvA ca gAlayet||189||
visrAvya ca vimRudyaitadveShTayedvAsasodaram| tathA bastivirekAdyairmlAnaM sarvaM ca veShTayet||190||
niHsrute la~gghitaH peyAmasnehalavaNAM pibet| ataH paraM tu ShaNmAsAn kShIravRuttirbhavennaraH||191||
trIn mAsAn payasA peyAM pibettrIMshcApi bhojayet| shyAmAkaM koradUShaM vA kShIreNAlavaNaM laghu||192||
naraH saMvatsareNaivaM jayet prAptaM jalodaram| prayogANAM ca sarveShAmanu kShIraM prayojayet||193||
doShAnubandharakShArthaM balasthairyArthameva ca| prayogApacitA~ggAnAM hitaM hyudariNAM payaH| sarvadhAtukShayArtAnAM devAnAmamRutaM yathA||194||
ruddhvA svedAmbuvAhIni doShAH srotAMsi sa~jcitAH| prANAgnyapAnAn sandUShya janayantyudaraM nRuNAm||20||
kukSherAdhmAnamATopaH shophaH pAdakarasya ca| mando~agniH shlakShNagaNDatvaM kArshyaM codaralakShaNam||21||
pRuthagdoShaiH samastaishca plIhabaddhakShatodakaiH| sambhavantyudarANyaShTau teShAM li~ggaM pRuthak shRuNu||22||
tatra shlokau- hetuM prAgrUpamaShTAnAM li~ggaM vyAsasamAsataH| upadravAn garIyastvaM sAdhyAsAdhyatvameva ca||195||
jAtAjAtAmbuli~ggAni cikitsAM coktavAnRuShiH| samAsavyAsanirdeshairudarANAM cikitsite||196||
rUkShAlpabhojanAyAsavegodAvartakarshanaiH| vAyuH prakupitaH kukShihRudbastigudamArgagaH||23||
hatvA~agniM kaphamuddhUya tena rUddhagatistataH| AcinotyudaraM jantostva~gmAMsAntaramAshritaH||24||

tasya rUpANi- kukShipANipAdavRuShaNashvayathuH, udaravipATanam, aniyatau ca vRuddhihrAsau, kukShipArshvashUlodAvartA~ggamardaparvabhedashuShkakAsakArshyadaurbalyArocakAvipAkAH, adhogurutvaM, vAtavarcomUtrasa~ggaH, shyAvAruNatvaM ca nakhanayanavadanatva~gmUtravarcasAm, api codaraM tanvasitarAjIsirAsantatam, AhatamAdhmAtadRutishabdavadbhavati, vAyushcordhvamadhastiryak ca sashUlashabdashcarati, etadvAtodaramiti vidyAt||25||
shothabhedatvAdudarasya shothacikitsAnantaramudaracikitsitamucyate||1-2||

kaTvityAdinA pittodaramAha| atrApi anilakaphAvapradhAnau, pittaM tu pradhAnam| nihantyAmAshaye vahnimityanena sthAnAntarasthadhAtvagnivadhaM kRutvA| hAridraM haridrAbham| dUyata iti vyathate| dhUpyata iti dhUmamiva udvamati| UShmAyata iti pArshvasthenaiva vahninA dahyate| svidyata iti gharmAktaM bhavati| kShiprapAkaM bhavatIti shIghrapAkAjjalodaratAM yAti||26-28||
avyAyAmetyAdinA kaphodaramAha| bahirantraga iti antrAdbAhyagaH||29-31||

durbalAgnerityAdinA sannipAtodaramAha| strIdattairiti strIbhiraj~jAnAt saubhAgyArthaM rajaHprabhRutidAnaM prAyo bhavatIti; strINAmabhidhAnamupalakShaNArthaM, tenAnyadattAnAmapi rajaHprabhRutInAM grahaNaM bhavatyeva| viShashca mandairiti dUShIviShaiH, dUShIviShANyeva hi mandAni bhavanti| traya iti padena vAtAdInAM trayANAmapi svAtantryeNa grahaNaM karoti| varNAshca sarveShAM doShANAmiti sambandhaH| iha sakalalakShaNamelakAbhidhAnenaiva nakhAdivarNAH sarvAshca nAnAvarNA rAjayashca yadyapi gRuhItAstathA~api tadabhidhAnamavashyotpAdadarshanArtham||32-34||

plIhavRuddhirdvividhA- sa~gkShobhAdicyutasya vA vRuddhiH, acyutasya vA shoNitavRuddhyA vRuddhirbhavati| vAmapArshvAshrita iti plIhasvarUpakathanam| shoNitaM vA rasAdibhya iti atrAdishabdaH prakAravAcI; tena rasasya kAraNasya vRuddhyA kAryasya raktasya vRuddhistathA mAMsAdibhyo~api raktavRuddhirbhavati; tenAhAravihArebhyo raktavRuddhiruktA bhavati| prathamaM yA cyutasya vRuddhiruktA sA vAtAdisannipAtatvena caturvidhA j~jeyA; tena raktajaplIhavRuddhyA samaM pa~jca plIhadoShA ye uktAste sa~ggatA bhavanti| uktaM hi- “pa~jca plIhadoShA iti gulmairvyAkhyAtAH” (sU.a.19) iti| aShThIlA dIrgho lohamayo granthirlohakAreShu prasiddhaH| kukShiH pArshvadeshaH| dakShiNapArshvasthamiti sthAnanirdeshaH| yakRujjanmana udarasya pRutha~gnAma AkhyAya tasya plIhodara evAvarodhamAha- tulyetyAdinA||35-38||

pakShmabAlairityAdinA baddhagudodaramAha| baddhAyane iti baddhamArge| udAvartairityAdAvapi ‘baddhAyane gude’ ityanuvartanIyam| antrasammUrcchanena antraparivartanena| pakShmavAlairityAdinA anekahetukRuto gudanirodhaH; tena gudanirodhakatvarUpeNaikarUpameva baddhagudodaraM janayati; tena pakShmAdigudanirodhahetupa~jcakajanyatvAd baddhagudodarANAM pa~jcatvaM nohyam||39-41||

sharkaretyAdinA kShatodaramAha| sharkarAdibhirabhyAhatamantraM bhidyeteti yojanA| pAkaM gacchediti bhinnamevAntaH pAkaM gacchati| bahiriti bahirbhAge antraM gudaM ca pUrayan sa eva raso~antrapAkaprasruta udaraM janayati| tadadho nAbheH prAyo~abhivardhamAnaM dravasyodarArambhakasyAdhogAmitvAd dakodaraM bhavatIti udarAntarApekShayA shIghragatirbhavatItyarthaH| ‘udakodarasya doShANAM ca’ iti vA pAThaH| tatra udakodarasya rUpANi darshayati, doShANAM ca yathAbalaM rUpANi darshayatIti yojanA| yathAbalamiti yo balavAn doSho bhavati tasya rUpANi darshayati||42-44||

snehetyAdinA utpattivishiShTaM jalodaramAha| kloma hRudayAvayavavisheShaH| vardhayetAmiti yathoktau kaphamArutau| tayoshcAmbuvardhakatvaM pipAsAjananenAmbupAnAderiti j~jeyam| sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgamAha- tatretyAdi| anudakaprAptamiti ajAtodakarUpadoShAvasthaM; paripAkenAtra doShANAM dravatvaM svabhAvAdeva j~jeyam| bAhyeShu srotaHsu pratihatagatiriti bahirgantumasamarthaH| atra jalajanmapUrvarUpaM picchotpadyate, tena picchotpattilakShaNameva tAvadAha| picchAsadRusho bhAgaH picchA; anye tu bhaktamaNDasadRushIM picchAmAhuH| sarpatIti calati| udakapUrNadRutivat sa~gkShobhaH mAMsasya picchodakarUpaM prAptasya| tamakaH shvAsavisheShaH| acikitsyamiti viShaprayogashastrapraNidhAnAdidAruNakarmavyatiriktakriyayA acikitsyaM vidyAt||45-49||

paraM paraM kRucchrataramiti yathA yathA paratvanirdeshastathA tathA kRucchrasAdhyatvam| baddhacchidradakodarANAM visheShamAha- pakShAdityAdi| baddhagudamudaraM pakShAdUrdhvaM vinAshAya prAyo bhavati; kadAcit pakShAdUrdhvamapyabhAvAya na bhavatIti prAyaHshabdenAha| jAtodakaM chidrAntraM ca prAyo vinAshAya bhavati; kadAcid viShashastrAbhimatacikitsayA jAtodakaM chidraM baddhagudaM ca sidhyatIti prAyaHshabdena darshayati||50-51||

shUnAkShamityAdinA sAdhyoktAnAmapyasAdhyatAmAha| kuTilopasthamiti vakropastham| upaklinnA tanvI ca tvagyasya sa tathA| agnikShayashcodare prathamata eva yadyapi bhavati, tathA~api asAdhyalakShaNeShu visheSheNAgnikShayo lakShaNAntarayuktashca bhavatIti j~jeyam| janmanaiveti utpattimAtreNa||52-54||

ajAtAmbulakShaNamAha- ajAtashothamityAdi| nAtibhArikamiti nAtiguruNA bhAreNa yutam| nAbhiM viShTabhyeti nAbhiM stambhayitvA| kRutvA vegamiti purIShavAtavegaM kRutvA, vAtapurIShaM visRujyeti yAvat| praNashyatIti lInaM bhavati| karkashamiti vegavantaM; sRujata iti vAtaM sarataH||55-58||

vAtodaramityAdinA cikitsAmAha| parimlAnamiti kShINam| tatheti vastraveShTanena| udare punaH shodhanopapattimAha- doShetyAdi| srotomArganirodhanAditi srotomukhanirodhanAdityarthaH; mArgashabdo~atra mukhavAcI| saMsRujyetyatra peyAdikrameNopapAdya| prAgutkleshAditi utkleshe dRushyamAne| utsargatastu balajanakakAryaM kRutvA payo nivartanIyam| vAtaghnAdibhiH shRutamairaNDatailaM tilatailaM vA~anuvAsanaM syAt| anuvAsairiti anuvAsanaiH||59-67||
