AyurvedavidAmiti bhiShagvedavidAm| duHkhairiti duHkhakAraNaiH| teShAmiti udarANAm| Ayatanamiti kAraNam| sa~gkhyA ca yadyapi rogAdhikAre “aShTAvudarANi” (sU.a.19) ityanenoktA, tathA~api gulmakuShThayoH sa~gkhyAtikramadarshanAt punaratra sa~gkhyAprashnaH; kiMvA prakaraNAgatatvAt sa~gkhyoktA~api punarucyate||3-8||

sAtalA carmakaShA| kShIrabastiriti kShIrapradhAno bastiH| sakaphe iti kaphayukte pitte| samUtreNetyatra ‘payasA’ ityanuvartate| savAte pitte tiktasarpiShA virecanaM trivRutAdidravyayuktena kartavyam| krameNeti kShIraprayogAdikrameNa pittodaraM jayediti yojanA||68-71||

vishuddhamityatra vamanaM vinA vishuddho j~jeyaH, vamanasyodare niShiddhatvAt| cUrNayuktA ayaskRutayaH cUrNAyaskRutayaH “navAyorajaso bhAgAstaccUrNaM madhusarpiShA” (ci.a.16) ityAdyuktAH; kiMvA cUrNAnyatraiva vakShyamANAni, ayaskRutayastu rasAyanoktalohaprayoge j~jeyAH||72-73||

plIhodaracikitsAmAha- udAvartetyAdi| anilAdIn yathAkramamiti udAvartarujAnAhairvAtaM, dAhamohatRuShAjvaraiH pittaM, sheShaiH kaphaM, dRuShTvA cikitsAM kurvIta; ki~jca bAdhitaM raktaM tallakShaNairdRuShTvA cikitsAM kurvIta| tatra raktasya lakShaNAni vidhishoNitIyoktAni, tantrAntare “vidAhaM tRuShNAM vairasyaM gAtragauravaM mUrcchAM” ityAdIni j~jeyAni| plIhnIti plIhodare| yathAdoShamiti ulbaNadoShaprashamanIm| vAme bAhau sirAvyadhaH sAmAnyokto~api sushrutapratyayAt kUrparAkhyasirAvyadho j~jeyaH| pippalIrvA prayojayediti rasAyanoktapippalIvardhamAnaM prayojayet| kShArAriShTagaNAniti grahaNyarshovakShyamANakShArAriShTasamUhAn; ihApi ca viDa~ggamityAdinA kShAraM, tathA rohitakalatetyAdinA~ariShTaM ca vakShyati| dviguNAbhayamiti dvibhAgAbhayam| rohitakalatA ‘rohitaka’ iti khyAtA| kANDakA iti svalpapramANAH khaNDAH| AsunuyAditi drave magnAH kRutvA sandhAnArthaM sthApayet| rohitaketyAdau saptapa~jcAshatpale kvAthye~aShTaguNamudakaM dattvA pAdAvasheSheNa dvipalopetacaturdashasharAvamAnaH kvAtho bhavati| sarvaistaishcApi tulyayeti rohitakatvacaH pa~jcapalAnItyarthaH| piShTairiti pa~jcakolaiH piShTaiH, tathA vibhaktivipariNAmAdrohitakatvacA piShTayeti j~jeyam| agnikarmeti gulmavadatrApyagnikarma vadanti; tacca vAtakapholbaNe plIhodare eva j~jeyam| dIpanIyasamAyutairiti pippalyAdidIpanIyagaNasaMskRutairityarthaH||85-88||-

agnidoSho~atrAgnimAndyameva vivakShitaM; tasyaivehodarakAraNadoShatrayakartRutvamuktaM- “varShAsvagnibale kShINe kupyanti pavanAdayaH” (sU.a.6) iti| malA vAtAdayaH purIShAdayashca| malinairiti doShakArakairviruddhAhArAdibhiH| yadyapi mandAgnitvamalinAnnayoH pratyekamapi doShatrayakartRutvamuktaM, tathA~apIhobhayajanakatvena prakarSho dRushyate, ata eva ca prakarShArthaM ‘sa~jcaya’ iti sampUrvaM kRutavAn| prANetyAdau punaragnidUShaNAbhidhAnena mandasya vahneH punardoShakRutaM nitarAM mAndyaM darshayati| doShasa~jcayakRutena vAyunA prANApAnayordUShaNamaviruddhameva; yato vAyunA~api vAyuduShTirbhavatyeva| tva~gmAMsAntaramiti tva~gmAMsamadhyam||9-11||

nirUhasyotsargata eva satailalavaNatve siddhe satailalavaNamiti padaM tailalavaNayoratrAdhikadAnopadarshanArtham| baddhacchidradakodariNAM ca yadyapyAsthApanaM niShiddhaM, tathA~api tadekasAdhyAyAmavasthAyAM nirUhAnuvAsanamiha j~jeyam| parisraMsInIti anulomanAni| chidrAntraM codaraM nRuNAmityatra yadyapyasAdhyatvamuktaM, tathA~api tatra prAyaHshabdaniveshAdasAdhyatAvyabhicAro~api darshitaH; teneha taccikitsocyate, uttaratrApi ca pipIlikAdaMshAdinA chidrodaracikitsocyate, tathA ‘hanti sarvodarANyetaccUrNaM’ ityanena sarvodaracikitsA vaktavyA| anye tu sarvodarahantRutvakathanaM na pAramArthikamiti vadanti| Rute svedAdityanena svedasya chidrodare udakakAratayA niShedhaM darshayati| tRuShNetyAdinA pratyAkhyeyaM chidrodaramAha||89-92||-
apAM doShaharANItyAdinA utpattivishiShTadakodaracikitsAmAha| udakAdibhya iti udakaprakArebhyo dravAntarebhyaH| niyacchediti nivartayet| anupUrvasha iti krameNa nivartayet||93-94||-
atra sarvodarasAdhAraNIM cikitsAM vaktumAha- sarvamityAdinA| bhojyAni punarbhojyAnIti bhoktavyAni| mandAmletyAdau mandashabdo~alpavacanaH| yAnayAnamiti ashvAdinA yAnam||95-100||-
svAdviti sadyo mathitaM madhuraM jAtam| apelavamiti uddhRutasneham| kavoShNamiti IShaduShNam||101-106||-
utkvAthyeti jale paktvA| avasecayedityatra ‘udaraM’ atyanuvartate||107-110||-

pippalItyAdau ‘sakShArairardhapalikairdviH prasthaM sarpiShaH pacet’ iti pAThe dvishabdaH prasthena tathA~ardhapalikairityanena ca yojyaH; etena pippalyAdInAM dviriti dviguNArdhapalaiH ShaTpalAni bhavanti, prasthena ca dvishabdayojanAdghRutaprasthadvayaM bhavati| kAshmIre tu “palikaiH pippalIkShArairdviprasthaM sarpiShaH pacet” ityeva paThyate| jatUkarNo~apyAha- “dashamUlatulArdharase sakShAraiH pa~jcakolakaiH sArdhaM ghRutArdhaprasthaM sadadhimastvADhakamudaraghnam” iti||112-115||-
caturguNe ityAdau sakShAramityanena yavakShArasyApi citrakavat palaM deyam| uktaM hyanyatra- “agnikShArapalAbhyAM hi mUtracaturguNaM ghRutaprastham” iti||116-117||-

atyuShNetyAdinA hetumAha| karmavibhramAditi vamanAdInAmasamyakkaraNAt| kliShTAnAmapratIkArAditi plIhAdirogaiH kliShTAnAmapratikriyayetyarthaH| raukShyAdutpattiH raukShyasya pratikriyAbhAvenAnuvartanAt| AmAditi AmAnubandhAt| pApaM karma ca kurvatAmityanenAsya mahAduHkharUpasya prabalAdharmajanyatAmAha| mandAgnInAM visheShata iti atyantopahatAgnInAm||12-15||

paToletyAdau ShaDAdyAn kArShikAnityanena paTolamUlAdInAM triphalAyAH samaM ShaNNAM pratyekaM kArShikatvaM, kampillakAdInAM yathAkramaM dvitricaturguNatvam| muShTimiti palam| savyoShaM ShaDahaM shRutaM payaH pibediti virecanadine maNDapeyAvilepInAmanyatamamagnyapekShayA kartavyam, UrdhvaM yathoktapayovRuttinA bhavitavyaM, tataH punaH saptame paTolAdicUrNaM peyam; IdRushaM punaH punaH kartavyam||119-123||-

sha~gkhinI shvetabhallAtakI (?)| kolakarkandhUnAM rasA eva j~jeyAH| yavAnItyAdau upaku~jcikA kRuShNajIrakam| ajamodA ugragandhA| kAravI alpajIrakaM, jIrakashabdena tu mahAjIrakam| dantyA bhAgAstrayaH gRuhItabhAgApekShayA, evaM trivRudvishAlayorapi AdyabhAgApekShayA dvaiguNyam| nArAyaNasa~jj~jAnimittamAha- nainadityAdi| etena nArAyaNasadharmitvAt nArAyaNasa~jj~jetyuktaM bhavati||124-132||-
hapuShetyAdau kAlalavaNaM biDalavaNameva; anye tu sauvarcalAkAraM lavaNamAhuH| dADimAdibhiH sarvairapi ‘peyaH’ iti sambadhyate||133-137||-

kShIradroNamityAdyuktAni ghRutAni tulyakarmANi| tatra ca prathame ghRute dravAnukte jalena kiMvA prakRutadadhimathitenodghRutaghRutenaiva pAkaH| tathetyAdinA ShaTpalena cetyantena dvitIyaM ghRutam| tatheti pUrvaprakArotthitaM ghRutameva| evamuttare ghRute tadvacchabdArthaM varNayanti||138-140||

peyAdInAM trayANAmannAnupAnatvaM kaphapittavAteShu; kiMvA prakRutyagnyapekShayA~anupAnabhedaH kalpanIyaH| nAgarakaiH shRutamityatra ShaDa~ggavidhinA jalasAdhanam| dvitIye divase peyA, yUShaM kaulatthikaM tata iti tRutIye divase; uktaM hi- “prathame nAgarayUShaM, pare~ahani peyAM, tRutIye kulatthodakam” iti| rUkSha iti punaH punaH pibedityanena sambadhyate; tena rUkShasyaitat snehavirecanaM kartavyaM, snigdho nAdhikArIti darshayati; snigdhe tu idameva nAgarAdishRutapAnIyAdinopapAditaM balApekShayA deyam| bhUyo vA pratibhojita iti adhikAni vA dinAni mAtrayA bhojitaH san punaH punaH pibediti yojyam| gulmaghnamiti gulmaharatvenoktaM gulmAdhyAye, mishrakaM gulmoktameva||141-145||

citraketyAdau mAsaM yukta iti cchedaH| tathA hastipippalItyAdau kShIreNa pibediti sambadhyate| viDa~ggAdibhiH kShIramaShTapalaM caturguNajalena sAdhanIyam| pibet kaShAyamityAdau vyoShakShArayoH prakShepyatvam| mAMsaM vetyAdau sudhAkShIrasAdhitaM ghRutaM pUrvoktaM j~jeyam| anannabhugiti gomUtretyAdiyogatraye~api yojyam| kShIrAshIti kShIreNa samaM shilAjatvashnIyAt| shilAjatuvidhAnenetyanantaroktashilAjatuvidhAnameva kShIrAshItyanenoktaM gRuhyate na rasAyanoktaM, vyavahitatvAt| shRu~ggaverArdrakashabdena shuShkArdrakasya kvAthaniShpannaM rasaM niShedhayati| dUShyodaraM sAnnipAtikamudaram| saralA trivRut| ariShTAn pAyayediti cchedaH| pippalItyAdike kShAre dadhyAdInAM dravANAM cUrNapiNDatAkaraNayogyA mAtrA j~jeyA| biDAlapadakaH karShaH| kShAraM cAjakarIShANAmityAdau ajapurIShakShAraM ShaDguNamUtreNaikaviMshativAraM srAvayitvA kShAradravastAvad grAhyaH, sa ca yAvaccUrNasamudAyAddravatvena kRutadvaiguNyaH sannaShTaguNo bhavati| pArshvetyAdau upastambhamiti upashabdaH samIpavAcI| bilvakShAreNeti bilvaphaladAhAt kRutena kShAreNa shvetena siddhaM tailaM pAyayet| tilanAlajaiH kShAraiH siddhaM tailaM pAyayediti sambandhaH||146-171||-

kShunnAsha ityAdinA pUrvarUpAbhidhAnam| svAdvAdInAM yadyapi kaTukAdyapekShayA cireNaiva pAko bhavati, tathA~apIha cirAditi padenAtyarthaM cirAdityabhidhIyate| jIrNAjIrNaM na vetti ceti vAtajanyatvAj~jeyam| ‘rUkShodAvartahetukA’ ityatra ‘baddhodAvartahetukA’ iti vA pAThaH| bastisandhAviti bastinA samaM yatra sharIretaradeshasambandhastatra| Atanyate iti vistIryate| rAjI vyaktA sirA||16-19||

kaphe ityAdau kaphe vAtenAvRute, kaphe pittenAvRute, tAbhyAM kaphapittAbhyAM vA vAte AvRute ityarthaH| svauShadhayutamiti AvarakadoShaharauShadhayutamityarthaH| suvirikta ityAdau viriktasyAdhmAnaM riShTamiti j~jeyam| tenehAnirjite vAte punarAdhmAnaM na riShTaM, atastaccikitsopadesho~atra yujyate; kiMvA upastambhAyuktaM sat punarAdhmAnaM riShTamityAdAyeha ‘sopastambha’ iti kRutaM, sopastambha iti sAvaraNaH||172-174||-

kriyAtivRutta ityanena jAtodakatAM darshayati, tatra hi kriyA niShiddhA “ajAtodakaM” ityAdinA| tridoShe ityanenApi jAtodaka eva tridoShaja iti j~jeyam; ajAtodake tridoShe~api kriyA uktaiva| evambhUtatridoShasya tu kriyAtivRuttapadenaiva lAbhe~api tridoShe iti padaM tridoShasya jAtodakasyApyatra kriyopadarshanArtham| j~jAtyAdisammatigrahaNAdinA viparyaye~ayashoniShedhaH| anuj~jAta iti anumato viShAdiprayoge vaidyaH| yasmin phale viShaM visRujet tat phalaM prayojayediti saMvandhaH| viShaM cAtra daMShTrAviShameva j~jeyam| uktaM hi- “dUShyodare baddhagude kShatAntre ca jalodare| api daMShTrAviShasyaiva prayogo vai vishodhane” iti| sthira iti acapalaH| lIna iti dhAtvantaragataH| pramAthitvAditi kShobhakAritvAt| kAlashAkaM prasiddham| svarasodakAbhyAM sAdhitam| tatashcaiva svarasamiti kAlashAkasvarasam||175-183||-

nAbhyadhashcatura~ggulamiti nAbheradho yathA bhavati tathA catura~ggulaM vAmakukShiM mApayitvA udaramadhyAccatura~ggulaM tyaktvA vAmakukShau nAbhyadhastAt pATanaM kartavyam| vipATya codaraM baddhakShatodarayoH, antraM vIkShya yathocitakriyArthaM, tata udare pATanaM keshAdimArjanaM sammUDhAntramokShashca kartavyaH| chidrAntrasya tu antracchidrANi pipIlikairantracchidrapradeshe daMshayitvA, sa~ggRuhItAni yathA~antrachidrANi bhavanti tathA j~jAtvA, pipIlikAshirashchedaH kAryaH| tatastUbhayorapi baddhachidrAntrayoH niHsRutAntrapraveshavidhiH pratiyogairityanenoktaH kartavyaH||184-188||

tathetyAdinA jAtodakavidhimAha| vyadhayediti nAbhyAshcatura~ggule ityarthaH| ataH paramiti alavaNapeyApAnAdUrdhvaM ShaNmAsAn kShIravRuttiH syAt, tataH kShIramAtravRuttiShaNmAsAdUrdhvaM trInmAsAn payasA saha peyAM pibet, tatashcordhvaM trIn mAsAn ‘shyAmAkaM koradUShaM’ ityAdigranthoktaM kShIreNa bhojayet; evaM saMvatsareNeti yaduktaM tat pUryate| prayogApacitA~ggAnAmiti prayogaiH kShINadehAnAm||189-194||

ruddhvetyAdinA caturNAM doShajanyAnAmudarANAM sAmAnyAt samprAptimAha; “pUrvaM yA samprAptiruktA sA sarvodarANAm” ityeke vadanti; “ruddhvetyAdinA pUrvaM samprAptyanuktasya svedAmbuvAhisrotoduShTirUpasyAbhidhAnAdapaunaruktyam” ityanye| “svedavahasrotasAM medomUlaM romakUpAshca, udakavahasrotasAM tAlu mUlaM kloma ca” (vi.a.5) ityanena bheda ukto j~jeyaH| udarANAM sAmAnyarUpamAha- kukSherityAdi| mando~agniryadyapi kAraNaM, tathA~apyayaM mandAgniriha lakShaNe j~jeyaH| shlakShNagaNDatvamiti masRuNakapolatvam| teShAM li~ggamityatra li~ggashabdena vakShyamANahetusamprAptI api vyAdhigamakatayA sa~ggRuhIte j~jeye| iha samprAptiH kAraNAni vA vaktavyAni visheShasyaiva, tena na sarvasAdhAraNoktahetusamprAptyA punaruktatvam||20-22||
hetumityAdinA sa~ggrahaM brUte| sa~ggrahArthashcAdhyAyokto~anusaraNIyaH||195-196||

karshanairiti kRushatvakAraNairla~gghanAdibhiH| gudasya mArgo gudamArgaH| kaphamuddhUyeti atra kaphasyAprAdhAnyaM, tena kaphenodaravyapadesho~atrAsamIcIna iti darshayati| aniyatau ca vRuddhihrAsau ‘udarasya’ iti sheShaH| asitA rAjyaH sirAshca tAbhiH santataM vyAptam| AdhmAtadRutishabdavaditi vAtapUrNacarmashabdavat||23-25||
athAto~arshashcikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

teShAmayaM visheShaH- shuShkamlAnakaThinaparuSharUkShashyAvAni, tIkShNAgrANi, vakrANi, sphuTitamukhAni, viShamavisRutAni, shUlAkShepatodasphuraNacimicimAsaMharShaparItAni, snigdhoShNopashayAni, pravAhikAdhmAnashishnavRuShaNabastiva~gkShaNahRudgrahA~ggamardahRudayadravaprabalAni, pratatavibaddhavAtamUtravarcAMsi, UrukaTIpRuShThatrikapArshvakukShibastishUlashiro~abhitApakShavathUdgArapratishyAyakAsodAvartAyAmashoShashotha- mUrcchArocakamukhavairasyataimiryakaNDUnAsAkarNasha~gkhashUlasvaropaghAtakarANi, shyAvAruNaparuShanakhanayanavadanatva~gmUtrapurIShasya vAtolbaNAnyarshAMsIti vidyAt||11||
bhavatashcAtra- kaShAyakaTutiktAni rUkShashItalaghUni ca| pramitAlpAshanaM tIkShNamadyamaithunasevanam||12||
la~gghanaM deshakAlau ca shItau vyAyAmakarma ca| shoko vAtAtapasparsho heturvAtArshasAM mataH||13||

mRudushithilasukumArANyasparshasahAni, raktapItanIlakRuShNAni, svedopakledabahulAni, visragandhitanupItaraktasrAvINi , rudhiravahAni, dAhakaNDUshUlanistodapAkavanti, shItopashayAni, sambhinnapItaharitavarcAMsi, pItavisragandhipracuraviNmUtrANi, pipAsAjvaratamakasammohabhojanadveShakarANi pItanakhanayanatva~gmUtrapurIShasya pittolbaNAnyarshAMsIti vidyAt||14||
bhavatashcAtra- kaTUShNalavaNakShAravyAyAmAgnyAtapaprabhAH | deshakAlAvashishirau krodho madyamasUyanam||15||
vidAhi tIkShNamuShNaM ca sarvaM pAnAnnabheShajam| pittolbaNAnAM vij~jeyaH prakope heturarshasAm||16||

tatra yAni pramANavanti, upacitAni, shlakShNAni, sparshasahAni , snigdhashvetapANDupicchilAni, stabdhAni, gurUNi, stimitAni, suptasuptAni, sthirashvayathUni, kaNDUbahulAni, bahupratatapi~jjarashvetaraktapicchAsrAvINi, gurupicchilashvetamUtrapurIShANi, rUkShoShNopashayAni, pravAhikAtimAtrotthAnava~gkShaNAnAhavanti, parikartikAhRullAsaniShThIvikAkAsArocakapratishyAyagauravacchardimUtrakRucchrashoShashotha- pANDurogashItajvarAshmarIsharkarAhRudayendriyopalepAsyamAdhuryapramehakarANi, dIrghakAlAnubandhIni , atimAtramagnimArdavaklaibyakarANi, AmavikAraprabalAni, shuklanakhanayanavadanatva~gmUtrapurIShasya shleShmolbaNAnyarshAMsIti vidyAt||17||
bhavatashcAtra- madhurasnigdhashItAni lavaNAmlagurUNi ca| avyAyAmo divAsvapnaH shayyAsanasukhe ratiH||18||
prAgvAtasevA shItau ca deshakAlAvacintanam| shlaiShmikANAM samuddiShTametat kAraNamarshasAm||19||

hetulakShaNasaMsargAdvidyAddvandvolbaNAni ca| sarvo hetustridoShANAM sahajairlakShaNaiH samam||20||

Commentary: hetulakShaNetyAdau ulbaNapadena dvandvaje tRutIyo~api doSho janako~astyeva, paraM solbaNo na bhavatIti darshayati| sarvo heturiti yathoktasarvahetuH, sahajaH lakShaNaiH saha sarvo hetustridoShANAM bhavati; tena tridoShe sarvahetutvAt sahajAni lakShaNAni bhavantItyarthaH||20||
viShTambho~annasya daurbalyaM kukSherATopa eva ca| kArshyamudgArabAhulyaM sakthisAdo~alpaviTkatA||21||
grahaNIdoShapANDvarterAsha~gkA codarasya ca| pUrvarUpANi nirdiShTAnyarshasAmabhivRuddhaye||22||

arshAMsi khalu jAyante nAsannipatitaistribhiH| doShairdoShavisheShAttu visheShaH kalpyate~arshasAm||23||

Commentary: arshasAM tridoShajanyatve~api ekadoShajatvAdivyapadeshamAha- arshAMsItyAdi| yadyapi sannipatitairityukte trayANAM melako labhyate, tathA~api tribhiriti padaM trayANAmapyatrAnubandhyatvasyopadarshanArtham| doShavisheShAditi ulbaNarUpavAtAdivisheShAt| visheSha iti vAtajo~ayaM, pittajo~ayamityAdiko visheShaH||23||
pa~jcAtmA mArutaH pittaM kapho gudavalitrayam| sarva eva prakupyanti gudajAnAM samudbhave||24||
tasmAdarshAMsi duHkhAni bahuvyAdhikarANi ca| sarvadehopatApIni prAyaH kRucchratamAni ca||25||
haste pAde mukhe nAbhyAM gude vRuShaNayostathA| shotho hRutpArshvashUlaM ca yasyAsAdhyo~arshaso hi saH||26||
hRutpArshvashUlaM sammohashchardira~ggasya rug jvaraH| tRuShNA gudasya pAkashca nihanyargudajAturam||27||
sahajAni tridoShANi yAni cAbhyantarAM valim| jAyante~arshAMsi saMshritya tAnyasAdhyAni nirdishet||28||
shoShatvAdAyuShastAni catuShpAdasamanvite| yApyante dIptakAyAgneH pratyAkhyeyAnyato~anyathA||29||
dvandvajAni dvitIyAyAM valau yAnyAshritAni ca| kRucchrasAdhyAni tAnyAhuH parisaMvatsarANi ca||30||
bAhyAyAM tu valau jAtAnyekadoSholbaNAni ca| arshAMsi sukhasAdhyAni na cirotpAtatAni ca||31||
teShAM prashamane yatnamAshu kuryAdvicakShaNaH| tAnyAshu hi gudaM baddhvA kuryurbaddhagudodaram||32||
tatrAhureke shastreNa kartanaM hitamarshasAm| dAhaM kShAreNa cApyeke, dAhameke tathA~agninA||33||
astyetadbhUritantreNa dhImatA dRuShTakarmaNA| kriyate trividhaM karma bhraMshastatra sudAruNaH||34||
puMstvopaghAtaH shvayathurgude vegavinigrahaH| AdhmAnaM dAruNaM shUlaM vyathA raktAtivartanam||35||
punarviroho rUDhAnAM kledo bhraMsho gudasya ca| maraNaM vA bhavecchIghraM shastrakShArAgnivibhramAt||36||
yattu karma sukhopAyamalpabhraMshamadAruNam| tadarshasAM pravakShyAmi samUlAnAM vivRuttaye||37||
vAtashleShmolbaNAnyAhuH shuShkANyarshAMsi tadvidaH| prasrAvINi tathA~a~ardrANi raktapittolbaNAni ca||38||
tatra shuShkArshasAM pUrvaM pravakShyAmi cikitsitam| stabdhAni svedayet pUrvaM shophashUlAnvitAni ca||39||
citrakakShArabilvAnAM tailenAbhyajya buddhimAn| yavamAShakulatthAnAM pulAkAnAM ca poTTalaiH||40||
gokharAshvashakRutpiNDaistilakalkaistuShaistathA| vacAshatAhvApiNDairvA sukhoShNaiH snehasaMyutaiH||41||
shaktUnAM piNDikAbhirvA snigdhAnAM tailasarpiShA| shuShkamUlakapiNDairvA piNDairvA kArShNagandhikaiH||42||
rAsnApiNDaiH sukhoShNairvA sasnehairhApuShairapi| iShTakasya kharAhvAyAH shAkairgRu~jjanakasya vA||43||
abhyajya kuShThatailena svedayet poTTalIkRutaiH| vRuShArkairaNDabilvAnAM patrotkvAthaishca secayet||44||
mUlakatriphalArkANAM veNUnAM varuNasya ca| agnimanthasya shigroshca patrANyashmantakasya ca||45||
jalenotkvAthya shUlArtaM svabhyaktamavagAhayet| kolotkvAthe~athavA koShNe sauvIrakatuShodake||46||
bilvakvAthe~athavA takre dadhimaNDAmlakA~jjike| gomUtre vA sukhoShNe taM svabhyaktamavagAhayet||47||
kRuShNasarpavarAhoShTrajatukAvRuShadaMshajAm| vasAmabhya~jjane dadyAddhUpanaM cArshasAM hitam||48||
nRukeshAH sarpanirmoko vRuShadaMshasya carma ca| arkamUlaM shamIpatramarshobhyo dhUpanaM hitam||49||
tumburUNi viDa~ggAni devadArvakShatA ghRutam| bRuhatI cAshvagandhA ca pippalyaH surasA ghRutam||50||
varAhavRuShaviT caiva dhUpanaM saktavo ghRutam| ku~jjarasya purIShaM tu ghRutaM sarjarasastathA||51||
haridrAcUrNasaMyuktaM sudhAkShIraM pralepanam| gopittapiShTAH pippalyaH saharidrAH pralepanam||52||
shirIShabIjaM kuShThaM ca pippalyaH saindhavaM guDaH| arkakShIraM sudhAkShIraM triphalA ca pralepanam||53||
pippalyashcitrakaH shyAmA kiNvaM madanataNDulAH| pralepaH kukkuTashakRuddharidrAguDasaMyutaH||54||
dantI shyAmA~amRutAsa~ggaH pArAvatashakRudguDaH| pralepaH syAdgajAsthIni nimbo bhallAtakAni ca||55||
pralepaH syAdalaM koShNaM vAsantakavasAyutam| shUlashvayathuhRudyuktaM culUkIvasayA~athavA||56||
ArkaM payaH sudhAkANDaM kaTukAlAbupallavAH| kara~jjo bastamUtraM ca lepanaM shreShThamarshasAm||57||
abhya~ggAdyAH pradehAntA ya ete parikIrtitAH| stambhashvayathukaNDvartishamanAste~arshasAM matAH||58||
pradehAntairupakrAntAnyarshAMsi prasravanti hi| sa~jcitaM duShTarudhiraM tataH sampadyate sukhI||59||
shItoShNAsnigdharUkShairhi na vyAdhirupashAmyati| rakte duShTe bhiShak tasmAdraktamevAvasecayet||60||
jalaukobhistathA shastraiH sUcIbhirvA punaH punaH| avartamAnaM rudhiraM raktArshobhyaH pravAhayet||61||
gudashvayathushUlArtaM mandAgniM pAyayettu tam| tryUShaNaM pippalImUlaM pAThAM hi~ggu sacitrakam||62||
sauvarcalaM puShkarAkhyamajAjIM bilvapeShikAm| biDaM yavAnIM hapuShAM viDa~ggaM saindhavaM vacAm||63||
tintiDIkaM ca maNDena madyenoShNodakena vA| tathA~arshograhaNIdoShashUlAnAhAdvimucyate||64||
pAcanaM pAyayedvA tadyaduktaM hyAtisArike| saguDAmabhayAM vA~api prAshayet paurvabhaktikIm||65||
pAyayedvA trivRuccUrNaM triphalArasasaMyutam| hRute gudAshraye doShe gacchantyarshAMsi sa~gkShayam||66||
gomUtrAdhyuShitAM dadyAt saguDAM vA harItakIm| harItakIM takrayutAM triphalAM vA prayojayet||67||
sanAgaraM citrakaM vA sIdhuyuktaM prayojayet| dApayeccavyayuktaM vA sIdhuM sAjAjicitrakam||68||
surAM sahapuShApAThAM dadyAt sauvarcalAnvitAm| dadhitthabilvasaMyuktaM yuktaM vA cavyacitrakaiH||69||
bhallAtakayutaM vA~api pradadyAttakratarpaNam| bilvanAgarayuktaM vA yavAnyA citrakeNa ca||70||
citrakaM hapuShAM hi~gguM dadyAdvA takrasaMyutam| pa~jcakolayutaM vA~api takramasmai pradApayet||71||
hapuShAM ku~jcikAM dhAnyamajAjIM kAravIM shaTIm| pippalIM pippalImUlaM citrakaM hastipippalIm||72||
yavAnIM cAjamodAM ca cUrNitaM takrasaMyutam| mandAmlakaTukaM vidvAn sthApayeddhRutabhAjane||73||
vyaktAmlakaTukaM jAtaM takrAriShTaM mukhapriyam| prapibenmAtrayA kAleShvannasya tRuShitastriShu||74||
dIpanaM rocanaM varNyaM kaphavAtAnulomanam| gudashvayathukaNDvartinAshanaM balavardhanam||75||
tvacaM citrakamUlasya piShTvA kumbhaM pralepayet| takraM vA dadhi vA tatra jAtamarshoharaM pibet||76||
vAtashleShmArshasAM takrAt paraM nAstIha bheShajam| tat prayojyaM yathAdoShaM sasnehaM rUkShameva vA||77||
saptAhaM vA dashAhaM vA pakShaM mAsamathApi vA| balakAlavisheShaj~jo bhiShak takraM prayojayet||78||
atyarthamRudukAyAgnestakramevAvacArayet| sAyaM vA lAjashaktUnAM dadyAttakrAvalehikAm||79||
jIrNe takre pradadyAdvA takrapeyAM sasaindhavAm| takrAnupAnaM sasnehaM takraudanamataH param||80||
yUShairmAMsarasairvA~api bhojayettakrasaMyutaiH| yUShai rasena vA~apyUrdhvaM takrasiddhena bhojayet||81||
kAlakramaj~jaH sahasA na ca takraM nivartayet| takraprayogo mAsAntaH krameNoparamo hitaH||82||
apakarSho yathotkarSho na tvannAdapakRuShyate| shaktyAgamanarakShArthaM dArDhyArthamanalasya ca||83||
balopacayavarNArthameSha nirdishyate kramaH| rUkShamardhoddhRutasnehaM yatashcAnuddhRutaM ghRutam||84||
takraM doShAgnibalavittrividhaM tat prayojayet| hatAni na virohanti takreNa gudajAni tu||85||
bhUmAvapi niShiktaM taddahettakraM tRuNolupam| kiM punardIptakAyAgneH shuShkANyarshAMsi dehinaH||86||
srotaHsu takrashuddheShu rasaH samyagupaiti yaH| tena puShTirbalaM varNaH praharShashcopajAyate||87||
vAtashleShmavikArANAM shataM cApi nivartate| nAsti takrAt paraM ki~jcidauShadhaM kaphavAtaje||88||
pippalIM pippalImUlaM citrakaM hastipippalIm| shRu~ggaveramajAjIM ca kAravIM dhAnyatumburu||89||
bilvaM karkaTakaM pAThAM piShTvA peyAM vipAcayet| phalAmlAM yamakairbhRuShTAM tAM dadyAdgudajApahAm||90||
etaishcaiva khaDAn kuryAdetaishca vipacejjalam| etaishcaiva ghRutaM sAdhyamarshasAM vinivRuttaye||91||
shaTIpalAshasiddhAM vA pippalyA nAgareNa vA| dadyAdyavAgUM takrAmlAM maricairavacUrNitAm||92||
shuShkamUlakayUShaM vA yUShaM kaulatthameva vA| dadhitthabilvayUShaM vA sakulatthamakuShThakam||93||
chAgalaM vA rasaM dadyAdyUShairebhirvimishritam| lAvAdInAM phalAmlaM vA satakraM grAhibhiryutam||94||
raktashAlirmahAshAliH kalamo lA~ggalaH sitaH| shAradaH ShaShTikashcaiva syAdannavidhirarshasAm||95||
ye~atyarthaM gADhashakRutasteShAM vakShyAmi bheShajam||96||
sasnehaiH shaktubhiryuktAM prasannAM lavaNIkRutAm| dadyAnmatsyaNDikAM pUrvaM bhakShayitvA sanAgarAm||97||
guDaM sanAgaraM pAThAM phalAmlaM pAyayecca tam| guDaM ghRutayavakShArayuktaM vA~api prayojayet||98||
yavAnIM nAgaraM pAThAM dADimasya rasaM guDam| satakralavaNaM dadyAdvAtavarco~anulomanam||99||
duHsparshakena bilvena yavAnyA nAgareNa vA| ekaikenApi saMyuktA pAThA hantyarshasAM rujam||100||
prAgbhaktaM yamake bhRuShTAn saktubhishcAvacUrNitAn| kara~jjapallavAn dadyAdvAtarco~anulomanAn||101||
madirAM vA salavaNAM sIdhuM sauvIrakaM tathA| guDanAgarasaMyuktaM pibedvA paurvabhaktikam||102||
pippalInAgarakShArakAravIdhAnyajIrakaiH| phANitena ca saMyojya phalAmlaM dApayedghRutam||103||
pippalI pippalImUlaM citrako hastipippalI| shRu~ggaverayavakShArau taiH siddhaM vA pibedghRutam||104||
cavyacitrakasiddhaM vA guDakShArasamanvitam| pippalImUlasiddhaM vA saguDakShAranAgaram ||105||
pippalIpippalImUladadhidADimadhAnyakaiH | siddhaM sarpirvidhAtavyaM vAtavarcovibandhanut||106||
cavyaM trikaTukaM pAThAM kShAraM kustumburUNi ca| yavAnIM pippalImUlamubhe ca viDasaindhave||107||
citrakaM bilvamabhayAM piShTvA sarpirvipAcayet| shakRudvAtAnulomyArthaM jAte dadhni caturguNe||108||
pravAhikAM gudabhraMshaM mUtrakRucchraM parisravam| gudava~gkShaNashUlaM ca ghRutametadvyapohati||109||
nAgaraM pippalImUlaM citrako hastipippalI| shvadaMShTrA pippalI dhAnyaM bilvaM pAThA yavAnikA||110||
cA~ggerIsvarase sarpiH kalkairetairvipAcayet| caturguNena dadhnA ca tadghRutaM kaphavAtanut||111||
arshAMsi grahaNIdoShaM mUtrakRucchraM pravAhikAm| gudabhraMshArtimAnAhaM ghRutametadvyapohati||112||
pippalIM nAgaraM pAThAM shvadaMShTrAM ca pRuthak pRuthak| bhAgAMstripalikAn kRutvA kaShAyamupakalpayet||113||
gaNDIraM pippalImUlaM vyoShaM cavyaM ca citrakam| piShTvA kaShAye vinayet pUte dvipalikaM bhiShak||114||
palAni sarpiShastasmiMshcatvAriMshat pradApayet| cA~ggerIsvarasaM tulyaM sarpiShA dadhi ShaDguNam||115||
mRudvagninA tataH sAdhyaM siddhaM sarpirnidhApayet| tadAhAre vidhAtavyaM pAne prAyogike vidhau||116||
grahaNyarshovikAraghnaM gulmahRudroganAshanam| shothaplIhodarAnAhamUtrakRucchrajvarApaham||117||
kAsahikkArucishvAsasUdanaM pArshvashUlanut| balapuShTikaraM varNyamagnisandIpanaM param||118||
saguDAM pippalIyuktAM ghRutabhRuShTAM harItakIm| trivRuddantIyutAM vA~api bhakShayedAnulomikIm||119||
viDvAtakaphapittAnAmAnulomye~atha nirvRute| gude~arshAMsi prashAmyanti pAvakashcAbhivardhate||120||
barhitittirilAvAnAM rasAnamlAn susaMskRutAn| dakShANAM vartakAnAM ca dadyAdviDvAtasa~ggrahe||121||
trivRuddantIpalAshAnAM cA~ggeryAshcitrakasya ca| yamake bharjitaM dadyAcchAkaM dadhisamanvitam||122||
upodikAM taNDulIyaM vIrAM vAstukapallavAn| suvarcalAM saloNIkAM yavashAkamavalgujam||123||
kAkamAcIM ruhApatraM mahApatraM tathA~amlikAm| jIvantIM shaTishAkaM ca shAkaM gRu~jjanakasya ca||124||
dadhidADimasiddhAni yamake bharjitAni ca| dhAnyanAgarayuktAni shAkAnyetAni dApayet||125||
godhAlopAkamArjArashvAviduShTragavAmapi| kUrmashallakayoshcaiva sAdhayecchAkavadrasAn||126||
j~jAtvA vAtolbaNaM rUkShaM mandAgniM gudajAturam||127||
madirAM shArkaraM jAtaM sIdhuM takraM tuShodakam| ariShTaM dadhimaNDaM vA shRutaM vA shishiraM jalam||128||
kaNTakAryA shRutaM vA~api shRutaM nAgaradhAnyakaiH| anupAnaM bhiShagdadyAdvAtavarco~anulomanam||129||
udAvartaparItA ye ye cAtyarthaM virUkShitAH| vilomavAtAH shUlArtAsteShviShTamanuvAsanam||130||
pippalIM madanaM bilvaM shatAhvAM madhukaM vacAm| kuShThaM shaTIM puShkarAkhyaM citrakaM devadAru ca||131||
piShTvA tailaM vipaktavyaM payasA dviguNena ca| arshasAM mUDhavAtAnAM tacchreShThamanuvAsanam||132||
gudaniHsaraNaM shUlaM mUtrakRucchraM pravAhikAm| kaTyUrupRuShThadaurbalyamAnAhaM va~gkShaNAshrayam||133||
picchAsrAvaM gude shophaM vAtavarcovinigraham| utthAnaM bahusho yacca jayettaccAnuvAsanAt||134||
AnuvAsanikaiH piShTaiH sukhoShNaiH snehasaMyutaiH| dArvantaiH stabdhashUlAni gudajAni pralepayet||135||
digdhAstaiH prasravantyAshu shleShmapicchAM sashoNitAm| kaNDUH stambhaH saruk shophaH srutAnAM vinivartate||136||

nirUhaM vA prayu~jjIta sakShIraM dAshamUlikam| samUtrasnehalavaNaM kalkairyuktaM phalAdibhiH||137||

Commentary: dAshamUlikamiti dashamUlakaShAyayutam| phalAdibhiriti madanaphalAdibhirAsthApanayaugikaiH||137||
harItakInAM prasthArdhaM prasthamAmalakasya ca| syAt kapitthAddashapalaM tato~ardhA cendravAruNI||138||
viDa~ggaM pippalI lodhraM maricaM sailavAlukam| dvipalAMshaM jalasyaitaccaturdroNe vipAcayet||139||
droNasheShe rase tasmin pUte shIte samAvapet| guDasya dvishataM tiShThettat pakShaM ghRutabhAjane||140||
pakShAdUrdhvaM bhavet peyA tato mAtrA yathAbalam| asyAbhyAsAdariShTasya gudajA yAnti sa~gkShayam||141||
grahaNIpANDuhRudrogaplIhagulmodarApahaH| kuShThashophAruciharo balavarNAgnivardhanaH||142||
siddho~ayamabhayAriShTaH kAmalAshvitranAshanaH| kRumigranthyarbudavya~ggarAjayakShmajvarAntakRut||143||
ityabhayAriShTaHdantIcitrakamUlAnAmubhayoH pa~jcamUlayoH| bhAgAn palAMshAnApothya jaladroNe vipAcayet||144||
tripalaM triphalAyAshca dalAnAM tatra dApayet| rase caturthasheShe tu pUte shIte samAvapet||145||
tulAM guDasya tattiShThenmAsArdhaM ghRutabhAjane| tanmAtrayA pibannityamarshobhyo vipramucyate||146||
grahaNIpANDurogaghnaM vAtavarco~anulomanam| dIpanaM cArucighnaM ca dantyariShTamimaM viduH||147||
iti dantyariShTaHharItakIphalaprasthaM prasthamAmalakasya ca| vishAlAyA dadhitthasya pAThAcitrakamUlayoH||148||
dve dve pale samApothya dvidroNe sAdhayedapAm| pAdAvasheShe pUte ca rase tasmin pradApayet||149||
guDasyaikAM tulAM vaidyastat sthApyaM ghRutabhAjane| pakShasthitaM pibedenaM grahaNyarshovikAravAn||150||
hRutpANDurogaM plIhAnaM kAmalAM viShamajvaram| varcomUtrAnilakRutAn vibandhAnagnimArdavam||151||
kAsaM gulmamudAvartaM phalAriShTo vyapohati| agnisandIpano hyeSha kRuShNAtreyeNa bhAShitaH||152||
iti phalAriShTaHdurAlabhAyAH prasthaH syAccitrakasya vRuShasya ca| pathyAmalakayoshcaiva pAThAyA nAgarasya ca||153||
dantyAshca dvipalAn bhAgA~jjaladroNe vipAcayet| pAdAvasheShe pUte ca sushIte sharkarAshatam||154||
prakShipya sthApayet kumbhe mAsArdhaM ghRutabhAvite| pralipte pippalIcavyapriya~ggukShaudrasarpiShA||155||
tasya mAtrAM pibet kAle shArkarasya yathAbalam| arshAMsi grahaNIdoShamudAvartamarocakam||156||
shakRunmUtrAnilodgAravibandhAnagnimArdavam| hRudrogaM pANDurogaM ca sarvametena sAdhayet||157||
iti dvitIyaphalAriShTaH navasyAmalakasyaikAM kuryAjjarjaritAM tulAm| kuDavAMshAshca pippalyo viDa~ggaM maricaM tathA||158||
pAThAM ca pippalImUlaM kramukaM cavyacitrakau| ma~jjiShThailvAlukaM lodhraM palikAnupakalpayet||159||
kuShThaM dAruharidrAM ca surAhvaM sArivAdvayam| indrAhvaM bhadramustaM ca kuryAdardhapalonmitam||160||
catvAri nAgapuShpasya palAnyabhinavasya ca| droNAbhyAmambhaso dvAbhyAM sAdhayitvA~avatArayet||161||
pAdAvasheShe pUte ca shIte tasmin pradApayet| mRudvIkAdvyADhakarasaM shItaM niryUhasammitam||162||
sharkarAyAshca bhinnAyA dadyAddviguNitAM tulAm| kusumasya rasasyaikamardhaprasthaM navasya ca||163||
tvagelAplavapatrAmbusevyakramukakesharAn| cUrNayitvA tu matimAn kArShikAnatra dApayet||164||
tat sarvaM sthApayet pakShaM sucaukShe ghRutabhAjane| pralipte sarpiShA ki~jciccharkarAgurudhUpite||165||
pakShAdUrdhvamariShTo~ayaM kanako nAma vishrutaH| peyaH svAduraso hRudyaH prayogAdbhaktarocanaH||166||
arshAMsi grahaNIdoShamAnAhamudaraM jvaram| hRudrogaM pANDutAM shothaM gulmaM varcovinigraham||167||
kAsaM shleShmAmayAMshcogrAn sarvAnevApakarShati| valIpalitakhAlityaM doShajaM ca vyapohati||168||
iti kanakAriShTaHpatrabha~ggodakaiH shaucaM kuryAduShNena vA~ambhasA| iti shuShkArshasAM siddhamuktametaccikitsitam||169||
cikitsitamidaM siddhaM srAviNAM shRuNvataH param | tatrAnubandho dvividhaH shleShmaNo mArutasya ca||170||
viT shyAvaM kaThinaM rUkShaM cAdho vAyurna vartate| tanu cAruNavarNaM ca phenilaM cAsRugarshasAm||171||
kaTyUrugudashUlaM ca daurbalyaM yadi cAdhikam| tatrAnubandho vAtasya heturyadi ca rUkShaNam||172||
shithilaM shvetapItaM ca viT snigdhaM guru shItalam| yadyarshasAM ghanaM cAsRuk tantumat pANDu picchilam||173||
gudaM sapicchaM stimitaM guru snigdhaM ca kAraNam| shleShmAnubandho vij~jeyastatra raktArshasAM budhaiH||174||
snigdhashItaM hitaM vAte rUkShashItaM kaphAnuge| cikitsitamidaM tasmAt sampradhArya prayojayet||175||
pittashleShmAdhikaM matvA shodhanenopapAdayet| sravaNaM cApyupekSheta la~gghanairvA samAcaret||176||
pravRuttamAdAvarshobhyo yo nigRuhNAtyabuddhimAn| shoNitaM doShamanilaM tadrogA~jjanayedbahUn||177||
raktapittaM jvaraM tRuShNAmagnisAdamarocakam| kAmalAM shvayathuM shUlaM gudava~gkShaNasaMshrayam||178||
kaNDvaruHkoThapiDakAH kuShThaM pANDvAhvayaM gadam| vAtamUtrapurIShANAM vibandhaM shiraso rujam||179||
staimityaM gurugAtratvaM tathA~anyAn raktajAn gadAn| tasmAt srute duShTarakte raktasa~ggrahaNaM hitam||180||
hetulakShaNakAlaj~jo balashoNitavarNavit| kAlaM tAvadupekSheta yAvannAtyayamApnuyAt||181||
agnisandIpanArthaM ca raktasa~ggrahaNAya ca| doShANAM pAcanArthaM ca paraM tiktairupAcaret||182||
yattu prakShINadoShasya raktaM vAtolbaNasya ca| vartate snehasAdhyaM tat pAnAbhya~ggAnuvAsanaiH||183||
yattu pittolbaNaM raktaM gharmakAle pravartate| stambhanIyaM tadekAntAnna cedvAtakaphAnugam||184||
kuTajatva~gniryUhaH sanAgaraH snigdharaktasa~ggrahaNaH| tvagdADimasya tadvat sanAgarashcandanarasashca||185||
candanakirAtatiktakadhanvayavAsAH sanAgarAH kvathitAH| raktArshasAM prashamanA dArvItvagushIranimbAshca||186||
sAtiviShA kuTajatvak phalaM ca sarasA~jjanaM madhuyutAni| raktApahAni dadyAt pipAsave taNDulajalena||187||
kuTajatvaco vipAcyaM palashatamArdraM mahendrasalilena| yAvatsyAdgatarasaM taddravyaM pUto rasastato grAhyaH||188||
mocarasaH sasama~ggaH phalinI ca samAMshikaistribhistaishca | vatsakabIjaM tulyaM cUrNitamatra pradAtavyam||189||
pUtotkvathitaH sAndraH sa raso darvIpralepano grAhyaH| mAtrAkAlopahitA rasakriyaiShA jayatyasRuksrAvam||190||
chagalIpayasA pItA peyAmaNDena vA yathAgnibalam| jIrNauShadhashca shAlIn payasA chAgena bhu~jjIta||191||
raktArshAMsyatisAraM raktaM sAsRugrujo nihantyAshu| balavacca raktapittaM rasakriyaiShA jayatyubhayabhAgam ||192||
iti kuTajAdirasakriyA nIlotpalaM sama~ggA mocarasashcandanaM tilA lodhram| pItvA cchagalIpayasA bhojyaM payasaiva shAlyannam||193||
chAgalipayaH prayuktaM nihanti raktaM savAstukarasaM ca| dhanvaviha~ggamRugANAM raso niramlaH kadamlo vA||194||
pAThA vatsakabIjaM rasA~jjanaM nAgaraM yavAnyashca| bilvamiti cArshasaishcUrNitAni peyAni shUleShu||195||
dArvI kirAtatiktaM mustaM duHsparshakashca rudhiraghnam| rakte~ativartamAne shUle ca ghRutaM vidhAtavyam||196||
kuTajaphalavalkakesharanIlotpalalodhradhAtakIkalkaiH| siddhaM ghRutaM vidheyaM shUle raktArshasAM bhiShajA||197||
sarpiH sadADimarasaM sayAvashUkaM shRutaM jayatyAshu| raktaM sashUlamathavA nidigdhikAdugdhikAsiddham||198||
lAjApeyA pItA sacukrikA kesharotpalaiH siddhA| hantyAshvasrasrAvaM tathA balApRushniparNIbhyAm||199||
hrIverabilvanAgaraniryUhe sAdhitAM sanavanItAm| vRukShAmladADimAmlAmamlIkAmlAM sakolAmlAm||200||
gRu~jjanakasurAsiddhAM dadyAdyamakena bharjitAM peyAm| raktAtisArashUlapravAhikAshothanigrahaNIm||201||
kAshmaryAmalakAnAM sakarbudArAn phalAmlAMshca| gRu~jjanakashAlmalInAM kShIriNyAshcukrikAyAshca||202||
nyagrodhashu~ggakAnAM khaNDAMstathA kovidArapuShpANAm| dadhnaH sareNa siddhAn dadyAdrakte pravRutte~ati||203||
siddhaM palANDushAkaM takreNopodikAM sabadarAmlAm| rudhirasrave pradadyAnmasUrasUpaM ca takrAmlam||204||
payasA shRutena yUShairmasUramudgADhakImakuShThAnAm | bhojanamadyAdamlaiH shAlishyAmAkakodravajam||205||
shashahariNalAvamAMsaiH kapi~jjalaiNeyakaiH susiddhaishca| bhojanamadyAdamlairmadhurairIShat samaricairvA||206||
dakShashikhitittirirasairdvikakudalopAkajaishca madhurAmlaiH| adyAdrasairativaheShvarshaHsvanilolbaNasharIraH||207||
rasakhaDayUShayavAgUsaMyogataH kevalo~athavA jayati| raktamativartamAnaM vAtaM ca palANDurupayuktaH||208||
chAgAntarAdhi taruNaM sarudhiramupasAdhitaM bahupalANDu| vyatyAsAnmadhurAmlaM viTshoNitasa~gkShaye deyam||209||
navanItatilAbhyAsAt kesharanavanItasharkarAbhyAsAt| dadhisaramathitAbhyAsAdarshAMsyapayAnti raktAni||210||
navanItaghRutaM chAgaM mAMsaM ca saShaShTikaH shAliH| taruNashca surAmaNDastaruNI ca surA nihantyasram||211||
prAyeNa vAtabahulAnyarshAMsi bhavantyatisrute rakte| duShTe~api ca kaphapitte tasmAdanilo~adhiko j~jeyaH||212||
dRuShTvA tu raktapittaM prabalaM kaphavAtali~ggamalpaM ca| shItA kriyA prayojyA yatheritA vakShyate cAnyA ||213||
madhukaM sapa~jcavalkaM badarItvagudumbaraM dhavapaTolam| pariShecane vidadhyAdvRuShakakumayavAsanimbAMshca||214||
rakte~ativartamAne dAhe klede~avagAhayeccApi| madhukamRuNAlapadmakacandanakushakAshaniShkvAthe||215||
ikShurasamadhukavetasaniryUhe shItale payasi vA tam| avagAhayet pradigdhaM pUrvaM shishireNa tailena||216||
dattvA ghRutaM sasharkaramupasthadeshe gude trikadeshe ca| shishirajalasparshasukhA dhArA prastambhanI yojyA||217||
kadalIdalairabhinavaiH puShkarapatraishca shItajalasiktaiH| pracchAdanaM muhurmuhuriShTaM padmotpaladalaishca||218||
durvAghRutapradehaH shatadhautasahasradhautamapi sarpiH| vyajanapavanaH sushIto raktasrAvaM jayatyAshu||219||
sama~ggAmadhukAbhyAM tilamadhukAbhyAM rasA~jjanavRutAbhyAm| sarjarasaghRutAbhyAM vA nimbaghRutAbhyAM madhughRutAbhyAM vA||220||
dArvItvaksarpirbhyAM sacandanAbhyAmathotpalaghRutAbhyAm| dAhe klede ca gudabhraMshe gudajAH pratisAraNIyAH syuH||221||
AbhiH kriyAbhirathavA shItAbhiryasya tiShThati na raktam| taM kAle snigdhoShNairmAMsarasaistarpayenmatimAn||222||
avapIDakasarpirbhiH koShNairghRutatailikaistathA~abhya~ggaiH| kShIraghRutatailasekaiH koShNaistamupAcaredAshu||223||
koShNena vAtaprabale ghRutamaNDenAnuvAsayecchIghram| picchAbastiM dadyAt kAle tasyAthavA siddham||224||
yavAsakushakAshAnaM mUlaM puShpaM ca shAlmalam| nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthashu~ggAshca dvipalonmitAH||225||
triprasthaM salilasyaitat kShIraprasthaM ca sAdhayet| kShIrasheShaM kaShAyaM ca pUtaM kalkairvimishrayet||226||
kalkAH shAlmaliniryAsasama~ggAcandanotpalam| vatsakasya ca bIjAni priya~gguH padmakesharam||227||
picchAbastirayaM siddhaH saghRutakShaudrasharkaraH| pravAhikAgudabhraMsharaktasrAvajvarApahaH||228||
prapauNDarIkaM madhukaM picchAbastau yatheritAn| piShTvA~anuvAsanaM snehaM kShIradviguNitaM pacet||229||
hrIveramutpalaM lodhraM sama~ggAcavyacandanam| pAThA sAtiviShA bilvaM dhAtakI devadAru ca||230||
dArvItva~g nAgaraM mAMsI mustaM kShAro yavAgrajaH| citrakashceti peShyANi cA~ggerIsvarase ghRutam||231||
aikadhyaM sAdhayet sarvaM tat sarpiH paramauShadham| arshotisAragrahaNIpANDuroge jvare~arucau||232||
mUtrakRucchre gudabhraMshe bastyAnAhe pravAhaNe| picchAsrAve~arshasAM shUle yojyametattridoShanut||233||
avAkpuShpI balA dArvI pRushniparNI trikaNTakaH| nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthashu~ggAshca dvipalonmitAH||234||
kaShAya eShAM peShyAstu jIvantI kaTurohiNI| pippalI pippalImUlaM nAgaraM suradAru ca||235||
kali~ggAH shAlmalaM puShpaM vIrA candanamutpalam | kaTphalaM citrako mustaM priya~ggvativiShAsthirAH||236||
padmotpalAnAM ki~jjalkaH sama~ggA sanidigdhikA| bilvaM mocarasaH pAThA bhAgAH karShasamanvitAH||237||
catuShprasthe shRutaM prasthaM kaShAyamavatArayet| triMshatpalAni prastho~atra vij~jeyo dvipalAdhikaH||238||
suniShaNNakacA~ggeryoH prasthau dvau svarasasya ca| sarvairetairyathoddiShTairghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet||239||
etadarshaHsvatIsAre raktasrAve tridoShaje| pravAhaNe gudabhraMshe picchAsu vividhAsu ca||240||
utthAne cAtibahushaH shothashUle gudAshraye| mUtragrahe mUDhavAte mande~agnAvarucAvapi||241||
prayojyaM vidhivat sarpirbalavarNAgnivardhanam| vividheShvannapAneShu kevalaM vA niratyayam||242||

bhavanti cAtra- vyatyAsAnmadhurAmlAni shItoShNAni ca yojayet| nityamagnibalApekShI jayatyarshaHkRutAn gadAn||243||

Commentary: vyatyAsAt parasparaparivartanena madhurAmlayoH shItoShNayoshca yojanA||243||
trayo vikArAH prAyeNa ye parasparahetavaH| arshAMsi cAtisArashca grahaNIdoSha eva ca||244||
eShAmagnibale hIne vRuddhirvRuddhe parikShayaH| tasmAdagnibalaM rakShyameShu triShu visheShataH||245||
bhRuShTaiH shAkairyavAgUbhiryUShairmAMsarasaiH khaDaiH| kShIratakraprayogaishca vividhairgudajA~jjayet||246||
yadvAyorAnulomyAya yadagnibalavRuddhaye| annapAnauShadhadravyaM tat sevyaM nityamarshasaiH||247||
yadato viparItaM syAnnidAne yacca darshitam| gudajAbhiparItena tat sevyaM na kadAcana||248||
tatra shlokAH- arshasAM dvividhaM janma pRuthagAyatanAni ca| sthAnasaMsthAnali~ggAni sAdhyAsAdhyavinishcayaH||249||
abhya~ggAH svedanaM dhUmAH sAvagAhAH pralepanAH| shoNitasyAvasekashca yogA dIpanapAcanAH||250||
pAnAnnavidhiragryashca vAtavarco~anulomanaH| yogAH saMshamanIyAshca sarpIMShi vividhAni ca||251||
bastayastakrayogAshca varAriShTAH sasharkarAH| shuShkANAmarshasAM shastAH srAviNAM lakShaNAni ca||252||
dvividhaM sAnubandhAnAM teShAM ceShTaM yadauShadham| raktasa~ggrahaNAH kvAthAH peShyAshca vividhAtmakAH||253||
snehAhAravidhishcAgryo yogAshca pratisAraNAH| prakShAlanAvagAhAshca pradehAH secanAni ca||254||
ativRuttasya raktasya vidhAtavyaM yadauShadham| tatsarvamiha nirdiShTaM gudajAnAM cikitsite||255||

AsInaM munimavyagraM kRutajApyaM kRutakShaNam| pRuShTavAnarshasAM yuktamagniveshaH punarvasum||3||

Commentary: AsInamityAdi| kRutakShaNamiti kRutAvasaram| yuktamucitaM prakopahetvAdiM papraccheti yojanA; kiMvA yuktamiti vyAkhyAnodyuktamiti bhAvaH||3||

prakopahetuM saMsthAnaM sthAnaM li~ggaM cikitsitam| sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgaM ca tasmai tanmunirabravIt||4||

Commentary: prakopasya rogotpAdasya hetuH; tathAhyatra prakopashabdena rogotpAdaM vakShyati; yathA- ‘pittolbaNAnAM vij~jeyaH prakope heturarshasAm’ iti; saMsthAnam AkAraH, saMsthAnaM yadyapi li~gge eva pravishati, tathA~apIha bahuprapa~jcavaktavyatvAt saMsthAnaM pRuthaguktam||4||

iha khalvagnivesha! dvividhAnyarshAMsi- kAnicit sahajAni, kAnicijjAtasyottarakAlajAni| tatra bIjaM gudavalibIjopataptamAyatanamarshasAM sahajAnAm| tatra dvividho bIjopataptau hetuH- mAtApitrorapacAraH, pUrvakRutaM ca karma; tathA~anyeShAmapi sahajAnAM vikArANAm| tatra sahajAni saha jAtAni sharIreNa, arshAMsItyadhimAMsavikArAH||5||

Commentary: ihetyAdinA dvividhAnyarshAMsi pratipAdya sahajAni hetvAdinA prAha- tatra bIjamityAdi| bIjamiha shukrashoNitam| tacca gudavalyArambhakeNa bIjenopataptaM sat sahajAnAM kAraNaM bhavati| gudavalyArambhakeNa ca duShTena bIjena sharIrArambhakasya bIjasyAyamevopatApo yat svayamaduShTasya duShTena sambandhaH| tatashca gudavalIbIjadoShAd gudavalIShvevArshojanma bhavati, sheShAvayavArambhakaM bIjamaduShTatvAnna vikAraM janayati| na bIjaduShTeH sarvathA~anArambhakatvaM, sarvathA bIjAnupaghAtAt; uktaM ca “yasya yasya hya~ggAvayavasya bIje bIjabhAga upatapto bhavati tasya tasya hya~ggAvayavasya vikRutirupajAyate” (shA.a.4) ityAdi| anye tu AhitAgnipAThAt pUrvanipAtAniyamena upataptaM gudavalIbIjaM yasmin tadgudavalIbIjopataptamitipadaM kRutamityAhuH| apacAra iti anucitAhAravihArarUpaH shukrashoNitabhAgavisheShadUShakaH| pUrvakRutaM ca karmeti jAyamAnasya sahajArsho~abhinirvartakaM janmAntarIyaM karma| tacca karma durbalaM sanmAtApitrapacArasahitaM bIjadUShakaM bhavati, balavattu vinA~apacArajanakameva bhavatIti j~jeyam| yathoktahetudvayamanyatrApi sahaje gade~atidishati- tathetyAdinA| tatretyAdinA sahajashabdArthaM vyAkaroti| arshaHshabdAbhidheyamAha- arshAMsItyAdi| adhimAMsavikArA iti adhimAMshavisheShAH||5||
iti hrIverAdighRutam

sarveShAM cArshasAM kShetraM- gudasyArdhapa~jcamA~ggulAvakAshe tribhAgAntarAstisro gudavalayaH kShetramiti; kecittu bhUyAMsameva deshamupadishantyarshasAM- shishnamapatyapathaM galatAlumukhanAsikAkarNAkShivartmAni tvak ceti| tadastyadhimAMsadeshatayA, gudavalijAnAM tvarshAMsIti sa~jj~jA tantre~asmin| sarveShAM cArshasAmadhiShThAnaM- medo mAMsaM tvak ca||6||

Commentary: tribhAgAntarA iti ardhapa~jcA~ggulasya sArdhA~ggularUpatRutIyabhAgAvakAshAH| gudavalaya iti gudasya mAMsavalayaH| asmiMshca vibhAge~ardhapa~jcA~ggule gude gudauShThena gRuhItamardhA~ggulaM bAhyavalyA parigRuhyate| kShetraM desha; arshaHprarohapradesha ityarthaH| kecidityanena tantrAntare~apatyapathAdigatAnAmapi adhimAMsAnAM ‘arshAMsi’ iti sa~jj~jA bhaNyate iti sUcayati | adhiShThAnamiti dUShyam||6||
iti picchAbastiH
iti suniShaNNakacA~ggerIghRutam

tatra sahajAnyarshAMsi kAnicidaNUni, kAnicinmahAnti, kAniciddIrghANi, kAniciddhrasvAni, kAnicidvRuttAni, kAnicidviShamavisRutAni, kAnicidantaHkuTilAni, kAnicidbahiHkuTilAni, kAnicijjaTilAni, kAnicidantarmukhAni, yathAsvaM doShAnubandhavarNAni||7||

Commentary: tatra sahajAnItyAdinA saMsthAnali~gge prAha| jaTilAnIti tRuNA~gkurAkArANi| doShAnubandhavarNAnIti doShAnurUpavarNAni||7||

tairupahato janmaprabhRuti bhavatyatikRusho vivarNaH kShAmo dInaH pracuravibaddhavAtamUtrapurIShaH sharkarAshmarImAn, tathA~aniyatavibaddhamuktapakvAmashuShkabhinnavarcA antarA~antarA shvetapANDuharitapItaraktAruNatanusAndrapicchilakuNapagandhyAmapurIShopaveshI, nAbhibastiva~gkShaNoddeshe pracuraparikartikAnvitaH, sagudashUlapravAhikApariharShapramehaprasaktaviShTambhAntrakUjodAvartahRudayendriyopalepaH pracuravibaddhatiktAmlodgAraH, sudurbalaH, sudurbalAgniH, alpashukraH, krodhano, duHkhopacArashIlaH, kAsashvAsatamakatRuShNAhRullAsacchardyarocakAvipAkapInasakShavathuparItaH, taimirikaH, shiraHshUlI, kShAmabhinnasannasaktajarjarasvaraH, karNarogI, shUnapANipAdavadanAkShikUTaH, sajvaraH, sA~ggamardaH, sarvaparvAsthishUlI ca, antarA~antarA pArshvakukShibastihRudayapRuShThatrikagrahopataptaH, pradhyAnaparaH, paramAlasashceti; janmaprabhRutyasya gudajairAvRuto mArgoparodhAdvAyurapAnaH pratyArohan samAnavyAnaprANodAnAn pittashleShmANau ca prakopayati, ete sarva eva prakupitAH pa~jca vAyavaH pittashleShmANau cArshasamabhidravanta etAn vikArAnupajanayanti; ityuktAni sahajAnyarshAMsi||8||

Commentary: aniyatatvaM vibaddhamuktatvAdiviruddhadharmayugmatraye j~jeyam| antarA~antareti kadAcit, na sarvadA| pracuro vibaddhatvAdiguNayukta udgAro yasya sa tathA| duHkhopacArashIla iti duHkhopacAraheturityarthaH| pradhyAnaM ghUrNanam| kasmAt punarayaM sahajArshoyukta IdRugvyAdhiparigRuhIto bhavatItyAha- janmetyAdi| pratyArohanniti UrdhvaM gacchan| atra krameNa pa~jcavAtaprakopo bhavati| sarvathA vAyurviguNo bhavati; tena sarvatra vAtavikArAH prAyo bhavanti; pittashleShmaprakopAcca tadvikArA api bhavantIti yuktameva| arshasamiti arshoyuktaM puruSham||8||

ata UrdhvaM jAtasyottarakAlajAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH- gurumadhurashItAbhiShyandividAhiviruddhAjIrNapramitAshanAsAtmyabhojanAdgavyamAtsyavArAhamAhiShAjAvikapishitabhakShaNAt kRushashuShkapUtimAMsapaiShTikaparamAnnakShIradadhimaNDatilaguDavikRutisevanAnmAShayUShekShurasapiNyAkapiNDAlukashuShkashAka- shuktalashunakilATatakrapiNDakabisamRuNAlashAlUkakrau~jcAdanakasherukashRu~ggATakatarUTavirUDhanavashUkashamI- dhAnyAmamUlakopayogAdguruphalashAkarAgaharitakamardakavasAshiraspadaparyuShitapUtishItasa~gkIrNAnnAbhyavahArAnmanda- kAtikrAntamadyapAnAdvyApannagurusalilapAnAdatisnehapAnAdasaMshodhanAdbastikarmavibhramAdavyAyAmAdavyavAyAddivAsvapnAt sukhashayanAsanasthAnasevanAccopahatAgnermalopacayo bhavatyatimAtraM, tathotkaTakaviShamakaThinAsanasevanAdudbhrAntayAnoShTrayAnAdativyavAyAdbastinetrAsamyakpraNidhAnAdgudakShaNanAdabhIkShNaM shItAmbusaMsparshAccelaloShTatRuNAdigharShaNAt pratatAtinirvAhaNAdvAtamUtrapurIShavegodIraNAt samudIrNavegavinigrahAt strINAM cAmagarbhabhraMshAdgarbhotpIDanAdviShamaprasUtibhishca prakupito vAyurapAnastaM malamupacitamadhogamAsAdya gudavaliShvAdhatte, tatastAsvarshAMsi prAdurbhavanti||9||

Commentary: gurushItetyAdau pramitam alpam| kRushaM durbalaprANibhavam| paramAnnaM pAyasaH| piNyAkaM tilakalkaH, kilATo naShTakShIrapiNDaH, takrapiNDastu takrajo ghanabhAgaH, visaM sthUlaM, mRuNAlaM tanu, tarUTaM niShkArakaH, krau~jcAdanaM ghe~jculiketi khyAtaH| sa~gkIrNaM mAMsabhaktAdi mishraprakRutikamannam| atikrAntamadyaM vyApannamadyam| avyavAyaH adhivyavAyaH(?), sa cehAvyavAyaviShamavyavAyAdirj~jeyaH| pratatAtinirvAhaNAd dIrghAtimAtrapravAhaNAt||9||

sarShapamasUramAShamudgamakuShThakayavakalAyapiNDiTiNTikerakebukatindukakarkandhukAkaNantikAbimbIbadarakarIrodumbara- kharjUrajAmbavagostanA~gguShThakasherushRu~ggATakashRu~ggIdakShashikhishukatuNDajihvApadmamukulakarNikAsaMsthAnAni sAmAnyAdvAtapittakaphaprabalAni||10||

Commentary: TiNTikeraM karIraphalaM, dakShaH kukkuTaH| sAmAnyAd vAtapittakaphaprabalAnItyanena sarvairdoShairarshasAM nAnAkRutiM darshayati||10||
udarArshasostridoShajatvasAmAnyAd baddhagudodarakAraNatvAccAnantaramarshasAM cikitsitamucyate||1-2||

li~ggAdisAmAnye vAtajAdInAM kiM visheShanishcAyakamityAha- teShAmayaM visheSha iti| ayamiti vakShyamANali~ggahetubhedarUpo visheSho vAtajAdivyavacchedaka ityarthaH| yadyapi visheShAbhidhAne heturevAgre~abhidhAtuM yujyate, tathA~api saMsthAnarUpali~ggAbhidhAnAnuSha~ggAt pratilomavyAkhyAnAdvA li~ggamevAgre~abhidhIyate- shuShkamlAnetyAdinA, tadanu kaShAyetyAdinA hetuM vakShyati; evaM pittakaphajayorapi vyatikrameNa hetuli~ggAbhidhAnaM j~jeyam| pramitAshanamatra atyalpAshanam| Atapasparsho yadyapyuShNastathA~api rUkShatayA vAtajanakaH; uktaM hi- “AtapaH kaTuko rUkShaH” ityAdi||11-13||

mRudvityAdinA pittajaM prAha| shithilAni komalAni| sukumArANi akarkashAni| raktapItasrAvINIti atra raktashabdena lohitavarNa ucyate| rudhiravahAnIti padena raktasrutirevocyate| prathamaM visragandhIti raktavisheShaNaM, dvitIyaM visragandhIti viNmUtravisheShaNam| prathamaM pItAbhidhAnaM varcaso haritapItopadeshArthaM, dvitIyaM tu visragandhena saha pItavarNatopadeshArthaM, tRutIyaM tu pItanakhetyAdau kevalaM pItavarNatopadarshanArtham| kaTUShNetyAdau prathamamuShNapadamuShNasparshopadeshArthaM, dvitIyamuShNapadamuShNavIryopadarshanArtham| ‘kaTvamlalavaNakShAra’ iti vA pAThaH||14-16||
tatra yAnItyAdinA kaphajamAha| pramANavantIti mahApramANAni| suptasuptAnIti atyarthaM nishcetanAni| dIrghakAlAnushayAmIti dIrghakAlAnubandhIni||17-19||
viShTambhaH apracalatvam| ATopaH guDaguDAshabdaH||21-22||
pa~jcAtmeti prANApAnavyAnodAnasamAnarUpaH||24-25||
hastetyAdinA sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgamAha| a~ggasya rugiti sarvA~ggaruk| sheShatvAdAyuSha iti AyuShaH sheShatve satItyarthaH| samanvita iti bhAve ktaH; tena catuHpAdasamanvaye satItyarthaH||26-32||

tatretyAdinA cikitsAmAha| kartanaM chedanam| bhUri tantrANi adhItAni yena sa bhUritantraH| ayaM prakaraNArthaH- shikShitenaiva shastrakarma vidhAnataH kartavyam| punarvirohaH punarutpattiH; rUDhAnAM rUDhavraNAnAm||33-37||

vAtashleShmolbaNAnItyatra yadyapi kaphaje srAva uktaH, tathA~api sa picchArUpAnubandhaH na tu raktasrAvaH, tena shuShkArshograhaNaM; picchAsrAvastu shuShkArdrakAraNamelake~api bhavati| citrakakShArabilvAnAM taileneti citrakAdisiddhena tailena| pulAkaM tucchadhAnyam| kArShNagandhikairiti shobhA~jjanakRutaiH| kharAhvAyA ajamodAyAH| kuShThataileneti kuShThasiddhatailena| jatukA carmacaTikA| vRuShadaMshaH biDAlaH| akShatA iti akhaNDitA yavAH| ghRutapAdAntAshcatvAro dhUpAH; hastimalasarjarasAbhyAM ca pa~jcamo dhUpaH| kiNvaM surAbIjam| madanataNDulA madanaphalashasyam| dantI nikumbhA| amRutAsa~ggaH mayUratuttham| alaM haritAlam| vAsantakavasA uShTravasA| kaTukAlAbuH tiktakAlAbuH| jalaukobhirityAdau avartamAnaM rudhiraM pravAhayediti yojyam| bilvapeshikA bilvamadhyam||38-61||

gomUtrAdhyuShitAmiti rAtrau gomUtrasthApitAm| bhallAtakayutamityatra bhallAtakacUrNasya saktvapekShayA dashamo bhAgaH| uktaM hi- “cUrNaM tarpaNabhAgairnavabhiH saMyojitaM deyam” iti; anye tu tarpaNabhallAtakacUrNayoH samAnayoH stokasya prayogamAhuH||62-71||

takrAriShTe tu grahaNIcikitsAyAM “yavAnyAmalakaM pathyA marIcaM tripalAMshikam| lavaNAni palAMshAni pa~jca caikatra cUrNayet|| takre tadAsutaM jAtaM takrAriShTaM pibennaraH” (ci.a.15) ityuktatakrAriShTAnusAreNehApi takracUrNamAnavyavasthA| etadanusAraprakShiptenaiva cAtra hapuShAdicUrNena mandAmlakaTukaM bhavatItyuktaM; mandAmlakaTukaM sthApayet, vyaktAmlakaTukamiti jAtalakShaNaM; vyaktAmlaM kaTu ceti vyaktAmlakaTukaM; na tu kaTutvamapi vyaktamatra, sandhAnena vyaktakaTutAnutpAdAt| annasya triShu kAleShviti bhojanAdimadhyAnteShu| sasnehaM takraM vAte, kaphe rUkSham||72-75||

takraprayogaH- pUrvAhNe takrameva kevalaM peyaM, tatrAtyarthaM mRudvagninA sAyamapi takrameva sevyam, etat ‘atyarthamRudukAyAgnestakramevAvacArayet’ ityanenoktam| ki~jcitpravRuddhe~agnau prAtastakrameva peyaM, sAyaM tu lAjasaktUnAM takrayuktA~avalehikA deyA| tatastu krameNAgnau vRuddhe takrapeyA takraudanaM takrasaMskRutayUShAdibhojanAni sAyaM deyAni, prAtastu takrameva, saptAhAdistakrakAlo j~jeyaH| atra jatUkarNaH- “prAtastakraprayogaH, krameNotkarShApakarShau, jIrNe ca saindhavAnvitatakreNaudanaM vA, atimandAgnestakrameva” iti| sahaseti ekadA| mAsAnte iti mAse nAtikrAmati| apakarSho yathotkarSha iti yena krameNa takraM vRuddhaM tenaiva mAtrAkrameNa takramapakRuShyata iti| takraprayogahrAse sati annasamudAyAddhrAso na kartavyaH, yoM~ashastakrasyApakRuShTaH sa annAntareNa pUraNIya ityarthaH| kasmAdayaM takraprayogakrama ityAha- shaktItyAdi| rUkShamityAdinoktaM trividhaM takraM kaphapittavAteShu doSheShu, mandatama-mandatara-mandeShvagniShu, baleShu cAdhamamadhyamottameShu, yathAsa~gkhyaM j~jeyam| bhUmAvapItyAdi kecit paThanti| shatamiti viMshatiH shleShmavikArAH, ashItirvAtavikArA iti militvA vikArANAM shatam||76-88||
bilvaM bAlabilvam| phalAmlamiti phalairdADimAdibhiramlAm| grAhibhiryutamiti varcogrAhidashasaMskRutam| raktashAlyAdayo~annapAnavyAkRutAH||89-95||-
yavAnInAgaramityAdau yavAnyAdIni samAni takreNa peyAni; lavaNaM tAvadyAvallavaNarasatA bhavati||96-102||

pippalInAgaretyAdau apakvameva kecidghRutamicchanti| guDakShArasamanvitamityatra ghRute siddhe guDAdInAM prakShepyatvaM j~jeyam| pippalIpippalImUletyAdau dadhi dravaM, sheShANAM kalkaH| jAte dadhnIti sujAte| nAgaramityAdike ghRute cA~ggerIsvarasasyApi caturguNena dadhnA ceti cakArAccAturguNyam| pippalImityAdau bhUrimAnasAnnidhye kvAthasyAnuktamAnatvAt snehasamatvameva; tena dvAdashapale~api kvAthyadravye triprasthaM pAnIyaM dattvA catvAriMshatpalAni sthApyAni| gaNDIramityAdinA kalkadravyANyAha||103-118||
AnulomikAni shAkAnyAha- upodikAmityAdi| suvarcalA sUryAvartA| ruhApatram udagrashAkam| mahApatraH shyonAkaH| dadhidADimAdi saMskAradravyam||119-126||-
shArkaramiti sharkarAkRutam| ariShTaM vakShyamANam||127-129||
pippalyAdye taile kecit tantrAntaradarshanAttoyamapi caturguNaM vadanti; tanna, tantrAntaroktaM yogAntarameva pashyAmaH||130-134||

AnuvAsanikairiti anuvAsanatailasAdhanArthamuktaiH pippalyAdibhiH| ShaDvirecanAshatAshritIyoktAnuvAsanopadarshakakaShAyagrahaNapratiShedhArthaM dArvantairiti visheShaNaM; tena dArvantenoktAnyeva gRuhyante||135-136||

harItakInAmityAdinA abhayAriShTAdayaH pa~jcAriShTA ucyante| triphalAyA iti militatriphalAyA eva palatrayaM, nirdeshasya mAnapradhAnatvAt| harItakItyAdau phalashabdena nirasthiharItakIM grAhayati, tena harItakIprasthArdhaM; kintu jatUkarNe~ayaM yogo dviguNamAnena paThitaH; yathA “harItakIphalaprasthaH, dviguNA hyAmalakakapitthapAThendrAH sacitrakAH, guDasya ca shatadvayam” iti| kramukaM pUgaH paTTikAlodhro vA| surAhvA gorakShakarkaTikA| atra yadyapi AmalakAdidravyadvyADhakamAnaM bhavati, tatra ca sAmAnyaparibhAShayaiva dvidroNajaladAnamardhadroNAvasthAnaM ca labhyate, tathA~api spaShTArthaM jalakvAthAbhidhAnaM j~jeyam| mRudvIkAdvyADhakarasamiti vacanena mRudvIkAyA ADhakadvaye droNadvayaM jalaM dattvA kvAthyasamaM jalaM sthApyamiti darshayati; anye tu drAkShAsvarasadravau tulyAviti vyAkhyAnaM kRutavantaH| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “dhAtrI tulA, kauDavikaM pippalI maricaM kRumighnaM ca, indrAhvaM sArivAdvayaM dArunishA suradAru ghanaM kuShThaM cArdhapalikaM, palikaM ma~jjiShThApAThAtilvakagranthikailvAlukacavyakramukabilvaM sAgnikaM pAkyaM, drAkShAdvayaM ca pRuthakpRuthak kvAthau vimishritau dvau, sitAtule dve, madhu dvikuDavaM ca” ityAdi| atrApi ca sAmAnyaparibhAShA carakoktamAnasamAnA eva| bhinnAyA iti cUrNIkRutAyAH| kusumasvaraso madhu||138-169||

samprati raktArshasAM vAtakaphAnubandhaM lakShaNaM ca darshayan bhinnAM cikitsAmAha- cikitsitamityAdi| atra ca tantre pittajasyeva raktajAnyarshAMsi duShTasrAvayuktAni srAvINIti j~jeyAni| viT shyAvamiti nirdeshAdviTshabdo napuMsakali~ggo~apyastItyunnIyate| malinamiti atyarthaduShTam| hetvAdivisheShaj~jena srAvasyopekShA kAryeti sUcayati| vartate iti pravartate| vAte~anubale snehanaM, kaphe~anubale tUpekShaNaM la~gghanAdi vA kAryamiti bhAvaH||170-184||

sanAgara IShannAgaraH| snigdhasya raktasya sa~ggrahaNaH snigdharaktasa~ggrahaNaH| tadvadityanena pUrvayogaphalaM vidhiM ca darshayati| kuTajatvaca ityAdau palashataM tulA, jaladroNena sAdhyam, aShTabhAgAvasheShaH kaShAyo grAhyaH| tantrAntare~apyuktaM- “droNe~ambhasaH palashataM kuTajatvaco~aShTabhAgasheSham” iti| mahendrasalilam AntarikShaM jalam| darvIpralepano grAhya iti yasyAmavasthAyAM darvIpralepo bhavati tasyAmavatAraNIyaH| ubhayabhAgaraktapittasyAsAdhyatvAdubhayabhAgashabdena kevalordhvagaM kevalAdhogaM ceShyate; tatrApyadhogasya yApyatvAttadyApanameveha nihanyAditi padenocyate||185-192||
kadamla IShadamlaH| kuTajaphalavalkashabdena indrayavAH kuTajatvak cocyate| sadADimarasamityatra siddhaM sarpiH||193-198||

gRu~jjanaketyAdinA yogAntaraM, gRu~jjanakaH palANDubhedaH| karbudAraH kA~jcanabhedaH| bhojanamityAdau bhojanamadyAditi yojyam| dvikakud uShTraH| antarAdhi sharIramadhyaM, tacca taruNacchAgasyaivAdyAt| madhurAmlaM prathamaM madhuraM, pashcAtki~jcidamlam| dadhisarasya mathitaM dadhisaramathitam| navanItaghRutaM sadyaskanavanItaghRutam; anye tu navanItaM ghRutaM ca chAgaM vadanti; yato ajA raktastambhanAtmikA proktA||199-211||
yavAsaH durAlabhA| shishireNa taileneti shItaladravyasAdhitena tailena| shishiretyAdi shishirajalA ca sukhasparshA ca; tena tIvrashItatvaM nivArayati||212-221||

adhunA ashakyaraktasrutau kShINadhAtutarpaNArthaM bRuMhaNamAha- AbhirityAdi| avapIDakasarpiH bhojanasyordhvaM yat pIyate; kiMvA bhUrimAtraM sarpiravapIDakamucyate| tamiti sravadraktaM puruSham||222-223||
picchAbastimAha- yavAsetyAdi| yavAsaH durAlabhA| atra ca kalkAdimAnaM bastivadvij~jeyam||224-229||
yavAgrajaH kShAraH yavakShAraH| cA~ggerIsvaraso~atra caturguNo grAhyaH, dravAntarAsAnnidhyAt||230-233||

avAkpuShpI adhaHpuShpI| atra kvAthyadravyaM ShoDashapalam| yadyapyatrotsargatashcatuShprasthameva jalaM deyaM, tathA sheShacaturbhAgaH prastha eva bhavati, tathA~api caturguNajaladAnasya caturthabhAgasheShatayA sthApyakaShAyasya utsargavidhau sUcanArthamidaM carakavacanam| tathA ‘triMshatpalAni tu prastho vij~jeyo dvipalAdhikaH’ ityapi vacanaM paribhAShAsiddhArthAbhidhAyakaM vij~jeyam| ata eva dRuDhabalasaMskAre~api dravadvaiguNyAbhidhAnaM bhaviShyati| triMshatpalavisheShaNatayA dvipalAdhikAnIti nirdeshe prApte prasthavivakShayA puMlli~ggaikavacananirdesho j~jeyaH||234-242||

arshaHsu agnirakShAmabhidhAtumanyatrApi yatrAgnirakShA visheSheNa kartavyA tAnAha- traya ityAdi| vRuddhe parikShayaH agnibale vRuddhe vinAshaH| triShu visheShata ityanenAnyatrApyagnirakShaNaM kAryamiti darshayati||244-246||
yadvAyorityAdinA pUrvoktacikitsAM sAroddhAreNAha||247-248||

arshasAM dvividhamityAdinA adhyAyArthasa~ggrahaH| ariShTagrahaNenaiva shArkarasyApi grahaNe prApte shArkarasya pRuthagabhidhAnaM guDakRutebhyo bhedena vyavahArArthaM, tathA~anupAnAbhidhAnArthaM pRuthakkRutam||249-255||
athAto grahaNIdoShacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
parasparopasaMstabdhA dhAtusnehaparamparA |20|
ShaDbhiH kecidahorAtrairicchanti parivartanam| santatyA bhojyadhAtUnAM parivRuttistu cakravat||21||
(ityuktavantamAcAryaM shiShyastvidamacodayat| rasAdraktaM visadRushAt kathaM dehe~abhijAyate||22||
rasasya ca na rAgo~asti sa kathaM yAti raktatAm| dravAdraktAtsthiraM mAMsaM kathaM tajjAyate nRuNAm||23||
dravadhAtoH sthirAnmAMsAnmedasaH sambhavaH katham| shlakShNAbhyAM mAMsamedobhyAM kharatvaM kathamasthiShu||24||
khareShvasthiShu majjA ca kena snigdho mRudustathA| majj~jashca pariNAmena yadi shukraM pravartate||25||
sarvadehagataM shukraM pravadanti manIShiNaH| tathA~asthimadhyamajj~jashca shukraM bhavati dehinAm||26||
chidraM na dRushyate~asthnAM ca tanniHsarati vA katham| evamuktastu shiShyeNa guruH prAhedamuttaram||27||
tejo rasAnAM sarveShAM manujAnAM yaducyate| pittoShmaNaH sa rAgeNa raso raktatvamRucchati||28||
vAyvambutejasA raktamUShmaNA cAbhisaMyutam| sthiratAM prApya mAMsaM syAt svoShmaNA pakvameva tat ||29||
svatejo~ambuguNasnigdhodriktaM medo~abhijAyate| pRuthivyagnyanilAdInAM sa~gghAtaH svoShmaNA kRutaH||30||
kharatvaM prakarotyasya jAyate~asthi tato nRuNAm| karoti tatra sauShiryamasthnAM madhye samIraNaH||31||
medasastAni pUryante sneho majjA tataH smRutaH| tasmAnmajj~jastu yaH snehaH shukraM sa~jjAyate tataH||32||
vAyvAkAshAdibhirbhAvaiH sauShiryaM jAyate~asthiShu| tena sravati tacchukraM navAt kumbhAdivodakam||33||
srotobhiH syandate dehAt samantAcchukravAhibhiH | harSheNodIritaM vegAt sa~gkalpAcca manobhavAt||34||
vilInaM ghRutavadvyAyAmoShmaNA sthAnavicyutam| bastau sambhRutya niryAti sthalAnnimnAdivodakam)||35||
vyAnena rasadhAturhi vikShepocitakarmaNA| yugapat sarvato~ajasraM dehe vikShipyate sadA||36||
kShipyamANaH khavaiguNyAdrasaH sajjati yatra saH| karoti vikRutiM tatra khe varShamiva toyadaH||37||
iti bhautikadhAtvannapaktRUNAM karma bhAShitam||38||
annasya paktA sarveShAM paktRUNAmadhipo mataH| tanmUlAste hi tadvRuddhikShayavRuddhikShayAtmakAH||39||
tasmAttaM vidhivadyuktairannapAnendhanairhitaiH| pAlayet prayatastasya sthitau hyayurbalasthitiH||40||
yo hi bhu~gkte vidhiM tyAktvA grahaNIdoShajAn gadAn| sa laulyAllabhate shIghraM, vakShyante~ataH paraM tu te||41||
abhojanAdajIrNAtibhojanAdviShamAshanAt| asAtmyagurushItAtirUkShasanduShTabhojanAt||42||
virekavamanasnehavibhramAdvyAdhikarShaNAt| deshakAlartuvaiShamyAdvegAnAM ca vidhAraNAt||43||
duShyatyagniH, sa duShTo~annaM na tat pacati laghvapi| apacyamAnaM shuktatvaM yAtyannaM viSharUpatAm ||44||
tasya li~ggamajIrNasya viShTambhaH sadanaM tathA| shiraso ruk ca mUrcchA ca bhramaH pRuShThakaTigrahaH||45||
jRumbhA~a~ggamardastRuShNA ca jvarashchardiH pravAhaNam| arocako~avipAkashca, ghoramannaviShaM ca tat||46||
saMsRujyamAnaM pittena dAhaM tRuShNAM mukhAmayAn| janayatyamlapittaM ca pittajAMshcAparAn gadAn||47||
yakShmapInasamehAdIn kaphajAn kaphasa~ggatam| karoti vAtasaMsRuShTaM vAtajAMshca gadAn bahUn||48||
mUtrarogAMshca mUtrasthaM kukShirogAn shakRudgatam| rasAdibhishca saMsRuShTaM kuryAdrogAn rasAdijAn||49||

viShamo dhAtuvaiShamyaM karoti viShamaM pacan| tIkShNo mandendhano dhAtUn vishoShayati pAvakaH||50||

Commentary: ajIrNalakShaNamabhidhAya agnidoShalakShaNamAha- viShama ityAdi| tIkShNAgnikAryamAha- tIkShNamityAdi| atra mandendhana ityanena tIkShNo~api yadi shucIndhano bhavati tadA dhAtupoShaNaM bhavatIti darshayati||50||
AyurvarNo balaM svAsthyamutsAhopacayau prabhA| ojastejo~agnayaH prANAshcoktA dehAgnihetukAH||3||
shAnte~agnau mriyate, yukte ciraM jIvatyanAmayaH| rogI syAdvikRute, mUlamagnistasmAnnirucyate||4||

yadannaM dehadhAtvojobalavarNAdipoShakam| tatrAgnirheturAhArAnna hyapakvAdrasAdayaH||5||

Commentary: sAmAnyakAraNamuktvA, agneH sAkShAtkAraNatvaM vyutpAdayannAha- yadannamityAdi| bAhyA api gairikAdayo dhAtushabdenocyante iti tadvyavacchedArthaM dhAtordehavisheShaNam| athAhorAtrajanyeShu dehadhAtvAdiShu kathamagneH kAraNatvamityAha- AhArAditi- etenAhAramapyapekShyaiva rasAdI~jjanayati| AdigrahaNena raktAdIni sa~ggRuhyante||5||

durbalo vidahatyannaM tadyAtyUrdhvamadho~api vA||51||

Commentary: agniprasa~ggAt samAgneH kAryamAha- yuktamityAdi| yukta iti samaH| yuktamannaM pacan dhAtusAmyaM karotItyarthaH| samashabdena samAno vAyuragnisahAyo gRuhyate| kiMvA yuktavAyutayA dhAtusAmyaM karoti, yuktashabdena ca kaphapittasAmyamagnau gRuhyate| yataH “samaH samaiH” (vA.sU.a.1) iti vacanena doShANAM samatvenaiva samAgnitvamuktam|51|
adhastu pakvamAmaM vA pravRuttaM grahaNIgadaH| ucyate sarvamevAnnaM prAyo hyasya vidahyate||52||
atisRuShTaM vibaddhaM vA dravaM tadupadishyate| tRuShNArocakavairasyaprasekatamakAnvitaH||53||
shUnapAdakaraH sAsthiparvaruk chardanaM jvaraH| lohAmagandhistiktAmla udgArashcAsya jAyate||54||

pUrvarUpaM tu tasyedaM tRuShNA~a~alasyaM balakShayaH| vidAho~annasya pAkashca cirAt kAyasya gauravam||55||

Commentary: pUrvarUpe vidAho~annasyeti vishiShTo dAho vidAhaH||55||
agnyadhiShThAnamannasya grahaNAdgrahaNI matA| nAbheruparyahyagnibalenopaShTabdhopabRuMhitA ||56||
apakvaM dhAratyannaM pakvaM sRujati pArshvataH| durbalAgnibalA duShTA tvAmameva vimu~jcati||57||
vAtAt pittAt kaphAcca syAttadrogastribhya eva ca| hetuM li~ggaM rUpabhedA~j shRuNu tasya pRuthak pRuthak||58||
kaTutiktakaShAyAtirUkShashItalabhojanaiH| pramitAnashanAtyadhvaveganigrahamaithunaiH||59||
karoti kupito mandamagniM sa~jchAdya mArutaH | tasyAnnaM pacyate duHkhaM shuktapAkaM kharA~ggatA||60||
kaNThAsyashoShaH kShuttRuShNA timiraM karNayoH svanaH| pArshvoruva~gkShaNagrIvArujo~abhIkShNaM visUcikA||61||
hRutpIDA kArshyadaurbalyaM vairasyaM parikartikA| gRuddhiH sarvarasAnAM ca manasaH sadanaM tathA||62||
jIrNe jIryati cAdhmAnaM bhukte svAsthyamupaiti ca| sa vAtagulmahRudrogaplIhAsha~gkI ca mAnavaH||63||
cirAduHkhaM dravaM shuShkaM tanvAmaM shabdaphenavat| punaH punaH sRujedvarcaH kAsashvAsArdito~anilAt||64||
kaTvajIrNavidAhyamlakShArAdyaiH pittamulbaNam| agnimAplAvayaddhanti jalaM taptamivAnalam||65||
so~ajIrNaM nIlapItAbhaM pItAbhaH sAryate dravam| pUtyamlodgArahRutkaNThadAhArucitRuDarditaH||66||
gurvatisnigdhashItAdibhojanAdatibhojanAt| bhuktamAtrasya ca svapnAddhantyagniM kupitaH kaphaH||67||
tasyAnnaM pacyate duHkhaM hRullAsacchardyarocakAH| AsyopadehamAdhuryakAsaShThIvanapInasAH||68||
hRudayaM manyate styAnamudaraM stimitaM guru| duShTo madhura udgAraH sadanaM strIShvaharShaNam||69||
bhinnAmashleShmasaMsRuShTaguruvarcaHpravartanam| akRushasyApi daurbalyamAlasyaM ca kaphAtmake||70||
yashcAgniH pUrvamuddiShTo rogAnIke caturvidhaH| taM cApi grahaNIdoShaM samavarjaM pracakShmahe||71||
pRuthagvAtAdinirdiShTahetuli~ggasamAgame| tridoShaM nirdishetteShAM bheShajaM shRuNvataH param||72||
annamAdAnakarmA tu prANaH koShThaM prakarShati| taddravairbhinnasa~gghAtaM snehena mRudutAM gatam||6||
samAnenAvadhUto~agnirudaryaH pavanodvahaH| kAle bhuktaM samaM samyak pacatyAyurvivRuddhaye||7||
evaM rasamalAyAnnamAshayasthamadhaH sthitaH| pacatyagniryathA sthAlyAmodanAyAmbutaNDulam||8||
annasya bhuktamAtrasya ShaDrasasya prapAkataH| madhurAdyAt kapho bhAvAt phenabhUta udIryate||9||
paraM tu pacyamAnasya vidagdhasyAmlabhAvataH| AshayAccyavamAnasya pittamacchamudIryate||10||
pakvAshayaM tu prAptasya shoShyamANasya vahninA| paripiNDitapakvasya vAyuH syAt kaTubhAvataH||11||
grahaNImAshritaM doShaM vidagdhAhAramUrcchitam| saviShTambhaprasekArtividAhArucigauravaiH||73||
Amali~ggAnvitaM dRuShTvA sukhoShNenAmbunoddharet| phalAnAM vA kaShAyeNa pippalIsarShapaistathA||74||
lInaM pakvAshayasthaM vA~a~apyAmaM srAvyaM sadIpanaiH| sharIrAnugate sAme rase la~gghanapAcanam||75||
vishuddhAmAshayAyAsmai pa~jcakolAdibhiH shRutam| dadyAt peyAdi laghvannaM punaryogAMshca dIpanAn||76||
j~jAtvA tu paripakvAmaM mArutagrahaNIgadam| dIpanIyayutaM sarpiH pAyayetAlpasho bhiShak||77||
ki~jcitsandhukShite tvagnau saktaviNmUtramArutam| dvyahaM tryahaM vA saMsnehya svinnAbhyaktaM nirUhayet||78||
tata eraNDatailena sarpiShA tailvakena vA| sakShAreNAnile shAnte srastadoShaM virecayet||79||
shuddhaM rUkShAshayaM baddhavarcasaM cAnuvAsayet| dIpanIyAmlavAtaghnasiddhAtailena mAtrayA||80||
nirUDhaM ca viriktaM ca samyak caivAnuvAsitam| laghvannaM pratisambhuktaM sarpirabhyAsayet punaH||81||
dve pa~jcamUle saralaM devadAru sanAgaram| pippalIM pippalImUlaM citrakaM hastipippalIm||82||
shaNabIjaM yavAn kolan kulatthAn suShavIM tathA | pAcayedAranAlena dadhnA sauvIrakeNa vA||83||
caturbhAgAvasheSheNa pacettena ghRutADhakam| svarjikAyAvashUkAkhyau kShArau dattvA ca yuktitaH||84||
saindhavaudbhidasAmudrabiDAnAM romakasya ca| sasauvarcalapAkyAnAM bhAgAndvipalikAn pRuthak||85||
vinIya cUrNitAn tasmAt pAyayet prasRutaM budhaH| karotyagniM balaM varNaM vAtaghnaM bhuktapAcanam||86||
iti dashamUlAdyaM ghRutam

iti dashamUlAdyaM ghRutam tryUShaNatriphalAkalke bilvamAtre guDAt pale| sarpiSho~aShTapalaM paktvA mAtrAM mandAnalaH pibet||87||

Commentary: bilvamAtre iti palamAne kalke, aShTapalamAnamevAtra sarpiH paktavyaM maharShivacanena phaladAyitvAt||87||
iti tryUShaNAdyaM ghRutam
iti tryUShaNAdyaM ghRutam pa~jcamUlAbhayAvyoShapippalImUlasaindhavaiH| rAsnAkShAradvayAjAjIviDa~ggashaTibhirghRutam||88||
shuktena mAtulu~ggasya svarasenArdrakasya ca| shuShkamUlakakolAmbucukrikAdADimasya ca||89||
takramastusurAmaNDasauvIrakatuShodakaiH| kA~jjikena ca tat pakvamagnidIptikaraM param||90||
shUlagulmodarashvAsakAsAnilakaphApaham| sabIjapUrakarasaM siddhaM vA pAyayedghRutam||91||
siddhamabhya~jjanArthaM ca tailametaiH prayojayet| eteShAmauShadhAnAM vA pibeccUrNaM sukhAmbunA||92||
vAte shleShmAvRute sAme kaphe vA vAyunoddhate| dadyAccUrNaM pAcanArthamagnisandIpanaM param||93||
iti pa~jcamUlAdyaM ghRutaM cUrNaM ca
iti pa~jcamUlAdyaM ghRutaM cUrNaM ca majjatyAmA gurutvAdviT pakvA tUtplavate jale| vinA~atidravasa~gghAtashaityashleShmapradUShaNAt||94||
parIkShyaivaM purA sAmaM nirAmaM cAmadoShiNam| vidhinopAcaret samyak pAcanenetareNa vA||95||
citrakaM pippalImUlaM dvau kShArau lavaNAni ca| vyoShaM hi~ggvajamodAM ca cavyaM caikatra cUrNayet||96||
guTikA mAtulu~ggasya dADimasya rasena vA| kRutA vipAcayatyAmaM dIpayatyAshu cAlanam||97||
iti bhUnimbAdyaM cUrNam
iti citrakAdyA guTikA nAgarAtiviShAmustakvAthaH syAdAmapAcanaH| mustAntakalkaH pathyA vA nAgaraM coShNavAriNA||98||
devadAruvacAmustanAgarAtiviShAbhayAH| vAruNyAmAsutAstoye koShNe vA~alavaNAH pibet||99||
varcasyAme sashUle ca pibedvA dADimAmbunA| viDena lavaNaM piShTaM bilvaM citrakanAgaram||100||
sAme vA sakaphe vAte koShThashUlakare pibet| kali~ggahi~ggvativiShAvacAsauvarcalAbhayAH||101||
chardyarshogranthishUleShu pibeduShNena vAriNA| pathyAsauvarcalAjAjIcUrNaM maricasaMyutam||102||
abhayAM pippalImUlaM vacAM kaTukarohiNIm| pAThAM vatsakabIjAni citrakaM vishvabheShajam||103||
pibenniShkvAthya cUrNaM vA kRutvA koShNena vAriNA| pittashleShmAbhibhRutAyAM grahaNyAM shUlanuddhitam||104||
sAme sAtiviShaM vyoShaM lavaNakShArahi~ggu ca| niHkvAthya pAyayeccUrNaM kRutvA vA koShNavAriNA||105||
pippalIM nAgaraM pAThAM sArivAM bRuhatIdvayam| citrakaM kauTajaM bIjaM lavaNAnyatha pa~jca ca||106||
taccUrNaM sayavakShAraM dadhyuShNAmbusurAdibhiH| pibedagnivivRuddhyarthaM koShThavAtaharaM naraH||107||
maricaM ku~jcikAmbaShThAvRukShAmlAH kuDavAH pRuthak| palAni dasha cAmlasya vetasasya palArdhikam||108||
sauvarcalaM biDaM pAkyaM yavakShAraH sasaindhavaH| shaTIpuShkaramUlAni hi~ggu hi~ggushivATikA||109||
tat sarvamekataH sUkShmaM cUrNaM kRutvA prayojayet| hitaM vAtAbhibhUtAyAM grahaNyAmarucau tathA||110||
iti maricAdyaM cUrNam

annamiShTaM hyupahitamiShTairgandhAdibhiH pRuthak| dehe prINAti gandhAdIn ghrANAdInIndriyANi ca||12||

Commentary: karmAntareNApyannasya pAkaH sampadyate, tamAha- annamityAdi| annamiShTaM hyupahitamiti hishabdo~avadhAraNe; iShTashabdeneha priyaM hitaM cocyate na priyamAtram, ahitasya priyamAtrasya na dehavyavasthitiH gandhAditarpakatvaM ca bhavati; upahitamiti upayuktam| iShTairiti priyahitaiH gandharasarUpasparshashabdaiH| atra yadyapi hitatvameva gandhAdInAmAhAragatAnAM dehagatagandhAdipoShaNe pradhAnaM, tathA~api priyatvamapyAhAragatagandhAdInAM tadAtvopakArakatayA grahItuM priyatvahitatvayordvayorapyupAdAnaM kRutam| dehe prINAti gandhAdIniti dehashritAn gandhAdIn poShayati| tathA ghrANAdIni ca ghrANadarshanarasanasparshanashrotrANi iShTairgandhAdibhiH prINAti tarpayati, poShayatIti yAvat| indriyANyapi hi pA~jcabhautikAnyasmaddarshane; tAni ca pratikShaNaM kShIyamANAni||12||

iti maricAdyaM cUrNam caturNAM prasthamamlAnAM tryUShaNasya palatrayam| lavaNAnAM ca catvAri sharkarAyAH palAShTakam| sa~jcUrNya shAkasUpAnnarAgAdiShvavacArayet||111||

Commentary: caturNAM prasthamamlAnAmityatra caturamlaM hRudyavarge prathamoktaM vRukShAmlAmlavetasadADimabadararUpamAhuH; anye tu cavyatvagityAdiprayogavakShyamANakapitthacukrikAvRukShAmladADimAnAM grahaNamAhuH| tantrAntare tu “vRukShAmlamAtulu~ggAmlabadarAmlAmlavetasaiH| caturamlamidaM proktaM pa~jcAmlaM tu sadADimam” ityuktam| tryUShaNAcca palatrayamiti militAt palatrayam| rAgaH kapitthAdidravyakRuto vya~jjanavisheShaH||111||-
cavyatvakpippalImUladhAtakIvyoShacitrakAn||112||
kapitthaM bilvamambaShThAM shAlmalaM hastipippalIm| shilodbhedaM tathA~ajAjIM piShTvA badarasammitam||113||
paribharjya ghRute dadhnA yavAgUM sAdhayedbhiShak| rasaiH kapitthacukrIkAvRukShAmlairdADimasya ca||114||
sarvAtisAragrahaNIgulmArshaHplIhanAshinI| pa~jcakolakayUShashca mUlakAnAM ca soShaNaH||115||
snigdho dADimatakrAmlo jA~ggalaH saMskRuto rasaH| kravyAdasvarasaH shasto bhojanArthe sadIpanaH||116||
takraM tu grahaNIdoShe dIpanagrAhilAghavAt||117||
shreShThaM madhurapAkitvAnna ca pittaM prakopayet| kaShAyoShNavikAshitvAdraukShyAccaiva kaphe hitam||118||
vAte svAdvamlasAndratvAt sadyaskamavidAhi tat| tasmAt takraprayogA ye jaTharANAM tathA~arshasAm||119||
vihitA grahaNIdoShe sarvashastAn prayojayet| yavAnyAmalake pathyA maricaM tripalaMshikam||120||
lavaNAni palAMshAni pa~jca caikatra cUrNayet| takre tadAsutaM jAtaM takrAriShTaM pibennaraH| dIpanaM shothagulmArshaHkrimimehodarApaham||121||
iti takrAriShTaH svasthAnagatamutkliShTamagninirvApakaM bhiShak| pittaM j~jAtvA virekeNa nirharedvamanena vA||122||
avidAhibhirannaishca laghubhistiktasaMyutaiH| jA~ggalAnAM rasairyUShairmudgAdInAM khaDairapi||123||
dADimAmlaiH sasarpiShkairdIpanagrAhisaMyutaiH| tasyAgniM dIpayeccUrNaiH sarpirbhishcApi tiktakaiH||124||
candanaM padmakoshIraM pAThAM mUrvAM kuTannaTam| ShaDgranthAsArivAsphotAsaptaparNATarUShakAn||125||
paTolodumbarAshvatthavaTaplakShakapItanAn| kaTukAM rohiNIM mustaM nimbaM ca dvipalAMshikam||126||
droNe~apAM sAdhayet pAdasheShe prasthaM ghRutAt pacet| kirAtatiktendrayavavIrAmAgadhikotpalaiH||127||
kalkairakShasamaiH peyaM tat pittagrahaNIgade| tiktakaM yadghRutaM coktaM kauShThike tacca dApayet||128||
iti candanAdyaM ghRutam
iti candanAdyaM ghRutam nAgarAtiviShe mustaM dhAtakIM ca rasA~jjanam| vatsakatvakphalaM bilvaM pAThAM kaTukarohiNIm||129||
pibet samAMshaM taccUrNaM sakShaudraM taNDulAmbunA| paittike grahaNIdoShe raktaM yaccopaveshyate||130||
arshAMsi ca gude shUlaM jayeccaiva pravAhikAm| nAgarAdyamidaM cUrNaM kRuShNAtreyeNa pUjitam||131||
iti piNDAsavaH
iti nAgarAdyaM cUrNam bhUnimbakaTukAvyoShamustakendrayavAn samAn| dvau citrakAdvatsakatvagbhAgAn ShoDasha cUrNayet||132||
guDashItAmbunA pItaM grahaNIdoShagulmanut| kAmalAjvarapANDutvamehArucyatisAranut||133||
iti bhUnimbAdyaM cUrNam vacAmativiShAM pAThAM saptaparNaM rasA~jjanam| syonAkodIcyakaTva~ggavatsakatvagdurAlabhAH||134||
dArvIM parpaTakaM pAThAM yavAnIM madhushigrukam| paTolapatraM siddhArthAn yUthikAM jAtipallavAn||135||
jambvAmrabilvamadhyAni nimbashAkaphalAni ca| tadrogashamamanvicchan bhUnimbAdyena yojayet||136||
kirAtatiktaH ShaDgranthA trAyamANA kaTutrikam| candanaM padmakoshIraM dArvItvak kaTurohiNI||137||
kuTajatvakphalaM mustaM yavAnI devadAru ca| paTolanimbapatrailAsaurAShTrayativiShAtvacaH||138||
madhushigroshca bIjAni mUrvA parpaTakastathA| taccUrNaM madhunA lehyaM peyaM madyairjalena vA||139||
hRutpANDugrahaNIrogagulmashUlArucijvarAn| kAmalAM sannipAtaM ca mukharogAMshca nAshayet||140||
iti kirAtAdyaM cUrNam
iti kirAtAdyaM cUrNam grahaNyAM shleShmaduShTAyAM vamitasya yathAvidhi| kaTvamlalavaNakShAraistiktaishcAgniM vivardhayet||141||
palAshaM citrakaM cavyaM mAtulu~ggaM harItakIm| pippalIM pippalImUlaM pAThAM nAgaradhAnyakam||142||
kArShikANyudakaprasthe paktvA pAdAvasheShitam| pAnIyArthaM prayu~jjIta yavAgUM taishca sAdhayet||143||
shuShkamUlakayUSheNa kaulatthenAthavA punaH| kaTvamlakShArapaTunA laghUnyannAni bhojayet||144||
amlaM cAnu pibettakraM takrAriShTamathApi vA| madirAM madhvariShTaM vA nigadaM sIdhumeva vA||145||

bhaumApyAgneyavAyavyAH pa~jcoShmANaH sanAbhasAH| pa~jcAhAraguNAnsvAnsvAnpArthivAdInpacanti hi||13||

Commentary: bhautikavahnivyApAramAha- bhaumetyAdi| bhaumAdayaH pa~jcoShmANaH pArthivAdidravyavyavasthitA jATharAgnisandhukShitabalA antarIyaM dravyaM pacantaH svAn svAn pArthivAdIn pUrvapArthivagandhatvAdyavilakShaNAn guNAn nirvartayanti| etadeva “vividhamashitapItalIDhakhAditaM jantorhitamantaragnisandhukShitabalena yathAsvenoShmaNA samyagvipacyamAnaM” (sU.a.28) ityAdinA sUtrAsthAne~apyuktam| yadyapi bhUtAgninA pArthivAdidravyaM pacyate, tathA~api pArthivAdidravyANAM pAkenaitadeva jananaM yadvishiShTaguNayuktatvaM, tena pAkena janyamAne~api dravye guNA eva janyanta ityabhiprAyeNa pArthivAdInAhAraguNA~jjanayantItyucyate| anena guNajananamevAgninocyate; na dravyajananam| kiMvA AhArAshca guNAshceti vigrahAdAhArashabdena AhArAdhikaraNarUpaM dravyamapi gRuhyate| pArthivAdIniti pArthivApyataijasavAyavIyanAbhasAn| tatra jATharAgniH sarvAnevAhArarasamalavipAkAn pacati, bhautikAstvagnayaH svAn svAn guNA~jjanayanti| uktaM ca- “jAThareNAgninA pUrvaM kRute sa~gghAtabhede pashcAdbhUtAgnayaH pa~jca svaM svaM dravyaM pacanti” iti| ayaM ca bhUtAgnivyApAro dhAtuShvapyasti, yato dhAtuShvapi pa~jcabhUtAni santi, tatrApi dhAtvagnivyApAro bhUtAgnivyApArashca jATharAgnikrameNaivokto j~jeyaH||13||

yathAsvaM svaM ca puShNanti dehe dravyaguNAH pRuthak| pArthivAH pArthivAneva sheShAH sheShAMshca kRutsnashaH||14||

Commentary: agnipakvAnAhAraguNAnAha- yathAsvamityAdi| yathAsvamiti yadyasyAtmIyaM; sajAtIyA dravyaguNA sajAtIyAn dravyaguNAn puShNanti| tena dravyANi pArthivAdidravyarUpANi dehadhAtudoShamalAkhyAni puShNanti, guNAstu pAkasthitagandhasnehauShNyagauravAdayaH dehagandhasnehauShNyagauravAdIn puShNanti| yathAsvamityAdishabdArthaM sphorayati- pArthivA ityAdi| pArthivA AhAradravyaguNA dehagatAn pArthivAneva dravyaguNAn puShNanti| AhAradravyaguNA ityatra dravyagataguNA eva ucyante| dravyapoShaNaM tu guNapoShaNena labhyate, guNapoShaNaM dravyapoShaNamantarA kartumashakyatvAt||14||

saptabhirdehadhAtAro dhAtavo dvividhaM punaH| yathAsvamagnibhiH pAkaM yAnti kiTTaprasAdavat ||15||

Commentary: bhUtAgnivyApAraM darshayitvA dhAtvagnivyApAraM darshayannAha- saptabhirityAdi| dehadhAtAra iti visheSheNa dehadhArakAH| dvividhamiti dviprakAraM pAkam| tadeva prakAradvayamAha- kiTTaprasAdavaditi; kiTTaprasAdarUpamityarthaH| shukrasya yadyapi kiTTavAn pAko na bhavati, tathA~api bahUnAM kiTTavattvAd dvividhamiti nirdeshashchatriNo gacchantIti nyAyAjj~jeyaH| punariti jATharAgnipAkAnantaram||15||

rasAdraktaM tato mAMsaM mAMsAnmedastato~asthi ca| asthno majjA tataH shukraM shukrAdgarbhaH prasAdajaH||16||

Commentary: pAkajanyAnAM rasAdInAmutpAdaM krameNAha- rasAdityAdi| rasAdraktaM prasAdajaM, tato raktAnmAMsaM prasAdajaM, mAMsAnmedaH prasAdajamityAdi yAvacchukrAdgarbhaH prasAdaja iti| prasAdajashabdena rasAdibhyaH prasAdAMshajanyA raktAdayaH, kiTTAMshajanyAstu vakShyamANAH kaphAdaya iti| shukrAttu nirmalatayA prasAdaja eva garbho bhavati, natu malajanyaM ki~jcit| kecittu shukramalatayA shmashrUNi vadanti; tanna, tantre~anabhidhAnAt| tathA shukramalaM yadi shmashrUNi syustadA strINAmapi sashukratayA shmashrUNi bhaveyuH; striyashca sashukrA eva, paraM tAsAM shukraM garbhArambhakaM na bhavatItyAdi pratipAditaM prAk| anye tu garbhaprasAdajashabdena napuMsakena ojo~abhidadhati| prasAdaja ityatra jAtashabdaH poShaNa eva vartate, nApUrvotpAde; raktAdayo hi garbhAtprabhRutyevotpannA rasAdibhiH poShyante; raktAdayo hi garbhaprabhRutyeva poShyante| tatra ca tridhAtUtpAde vyAkhyAtAro varNayanti- tatra rasaH svAgnipacyamAno raktatAM yAti, raktaM mAMsatAmityAdi pUrvapUrvadhAtupariNAmAduttarottaradhAtUtpAdaH; yathA kShIrAddadhi bhavati, dadhno navanItaM, navanItAdghRutaM, ghRutAd ghRutamaNDaH, ityekaH pakShaH| kiMvA rasa eva raktaM prathamaM plAvayati, tatra ca raktasthAnasambandhAdraktasAdRushyamanubhavati, raktaM ca raktasamAnenAMshena poShayati; tato raktamAplAvya mAMsamAplAvayati, tatrApi mAMsapoShaNaM karoti, mAMsasAdRushyatAmanubhavati; evaM uttarottaradhAtUn rasa evAplAvayati vardhayati ca; yathA kedAraniShiktaM kulyAjalaM pratyAsannAM kedArIM tarpayitvA krameNa kedArikAntarANi AplAvayati| kiMvA AhArarasasya utpanno bhinnaireva mArgai rasarudhirAdIni samAnenAMshena tarpayati, tatra ca yaH pratyAsanno dhAtustatpoShako dhAtubhAgastaM shIghraM puShNAti, yastu vidUro dhAtustasya vidUramArgatayA cireNa poShaNaM bhavati, evaM bhinnaireva mArgairdhAtUnAM poShaNaM bhavati; yathA khale utpatitAnAM kapotAnAM bhinnadiggAminAM svIyasvIyamArgeNaiva gacchatAM gamyadeshasya pratyAsannaviprakRuShTatvAdibhedena shIghraM cireNa ca gamanaM bhavati, tadvat| iti kShIradadhinyAya-kedArIkulyAnyAya-khalekapotanyAyAttredhA dhAtupoShaNakramaH| tatreha shabdArthaparyAlocanayA kedArIkulyAnyAyaH kShIradadhinyAyo vA sa~ggata evaH, khalekapotanyAyastu manAgdurghaTaH| tasmin hi pakShe rasAdraktaM prasAdajamityarthavyutpAdanaM duHshakaM, prapa~jcitaM caitadvividhAshitapItIye, tatraivAnusaraNIyaH prapa~jcaH| nanu, vividhAshitapItIye AhArarasAdrasAdipuShTiruktA “puShyanti tvAhArarasAdrasarudhira” (sU.a.28) ityAdinA; tatra rasadvayaM svIkRutam, iha tveka eva raktapoShako rasa iti kathaM na virodhaH? maivaM, tatrApi AhArarasashabdena AhArajaH prasAdo~abhidhIyate, sa ca rasagrahaNagRuhIta eva| yato dvividho rasaH- sthAyI, poShakashceti; tena tatra dhAtupoShakapoShyarasAMshayorbhedavivakShayA bheda uktaH; iha sthAyIpoShakarasAMshAvapyekatayA nirdiShTau, sthAyirasapoShakarasabhAgayoH sthAnabhedAdyabhAvAdekatvam; evaM kRutvA saptadhAtukaM sharIramucyate| etadapi vividhAshitapItIye eva prapa~jcitam||16||

rasAt stanyaM tato raktamasRujaH kaNDarAH sirAH| mAMsAdvasA tvacaH ShaT ca medasaH snAyusambhavaH ||17||
