Commentary: dhAtUnAM poShaNamabhidhAyopadhAtupoShaNamAha- rasAt stanyamityAdi| rasAt stanyaM prasAdajaM, tathA raktamapi rajaHsa~jj~jaM rasAdeva prasAdabhAgajanyam; uktaM ca sushrute- “rasAdeva striyA raktaM rajaHsa~jj~jaM pravartate” (su.sU.a.14) iti| etacca rajo rasajanyamapi sUkShmatayA cireNaiva jAyate; yaduktaM sushrute- “evaM mAsena rasaH shukrabhavati, strINAM cArtavam” (su.sU.a.14) iti| asrajaH kaNDarAH sthUla snAyavaH, medasastu sUkShmasnAyupoShaNaM ‘medasaH snAyusambhavaH’ ityanena vaktavyam| iha hi kaNDarAshabdena sthUlasnAyurucyate, sushrute tu sthUlasirA| te ca stanyAdayo dhAtvantarApoShaNAccharIrapoShakA apyupadhAtushabdenocyante, rasAdayastu sharIradhArakatayA dhAtvantarapoShakatayA ca dhAtushabdenocyante; uktaM ca bhoje- “sirAsnAyurajaHstanyatvaco gativivarjitAH| dhAtubhyashcopajAyante tasmAtta upadhAtavaH” iti| atrApi hi ‘dhAtubhyashcopajAyante’ ityanena jAyanta eva, paraM na janayantItyuktam| shukraM tu ojojanakatvAd dhAtvantargatameva| ojastu iha na dhAtuShu nApyupadhAtuShu paThitaM, tasya saptadhAtusArarUpatayA saptadhAtvantaragatatvAdeva, ata eva tasyAgnirapi pRutha~gnoktaH||17||
kiTTamannasya viNmUtraM, rasasya tu kapho~asRujaH| pittaM, mAMsasya khamalA, malaH svedastu medasaH||18||
syAtkiTTaM keshalomAsthno, majj~jaH sneho~akShiviTtvacAm| prasAdakiTTe dhAtUnAM pAkAdevaMvidharcchataH ||19||
droNaM madhUkapuShpANAM viDa~ggAnAM tato~ardhataH| citrakasya tato~ardhaM syAttathA bhallAtakADhakam||146||
ma~jjiShThAShTapalaM caiva tridroNe~apAM vipAcayet| droNasheShaM tu tacchItaM madhvardhADhakasaMyutam||147||
elAmRuNAlAgurubhishcandanena ca rUShite| kumbhe mAsasthitaM jAtamAsavaM taM prayojayet||148||
grahaNIM dIpayatyeva bRuMhaNaH kaphapittajit| shothaM kuShThaM kilAsaM ca pramehAMshca praNAshayet||149||
iti madhUkAsavaHmadhUkapuShpasvarasaM shRutamardhakShayIkRutam| kShaudrapAdayutaM shItaM pUrvavat sannidhApayet||150||
taM piban grahaNIdoShA~jjayet sarvAn hitAshanaH| tadvaddrAkShekShukharjUrasvarasAnAsutAn pibet||151||
prasthau durAlabhAyA dvau pasthamAmalakasya ca| dantIcitrakamuShTI dve pratyagraM cAbhayAshatam||152||
caturdroNe~ambhasaH paktvA shItaM droNAvasheShitam| saguDadvishataM pUtaM madhunaH kuDavAyutam||153||
tadvat priya~ggoH pippalyA viDa~ggAnAM ca cUrNitaiH| kuDavairghRutakumbhasthaM pakShAjjAtaM tataH pibet||154||
grahaNIpANDurogArshaHkuShThavIsarpamehanut| svaravarNakarashcaiSha raktapittakaphApahaH||155||
iti durAlabhAsavaHharidrA pa~jcamUle dve vIrarShabhakajIvakam| eShAM pa~jcapalAn bhAgAMshcaturdroNe~ambhasaH pacet||156||
droNasheShe rase pUte guDasya dvishataM bhiShak| cUrNitAn kuDavArdhAMshAn prakShipecca samAkShikAn||157||
priya~ggumustama~jjiShThAviDa~ggamadhukaplavAn| lodhraM shAbarakaM caiva mAsArdhasthaM pibettu tam||158||
eSha mUlAsavaH siddho dIpano raktapittajit| AnAhakaphahRudrogapANDurogA~ggasAdanut||159||
prAsthikaM pippalIM piShTvA guDaM madhyaM bibhItakAt| udakaprasthasaMyuktaM yavapalle nidhApayet||160||
tasmAt palaM sujAtAttu salilA~jjalisaMyutam| pibetpiNDAsavo hyeSha rogAnIkavinAshanaH||161||
svastho~apyenaM pibenmAsaM naraH snigdharasAshanaH | icchaMsteShAmanutpattiM rogANAM ye~atra kIrtitAH||162||
iti piNDAsavaH nave pippalimadhvAkte kalase~agurudhUpite| madhvADhakaM jalasamaM cUrNAnImAni dApayet||163||
kuDavArdhaM viDa~ggAnAM pippalyAH kuDavaM tathA| caturthikAMshAM tvakkShIrIM kesharaM maricAni ca||164||
tvagelApatrakashaTIkramukAtiviShAghanAn| hareNvelvAlutejohvApippalImUlacitrakAn||165||
kArShikAMstat sthitaM mAsamata UrdhvaM prayojayet| mandaM sandapayatyagniM karoti viShamaM samam||166||
hRutpANDugrahaNIrogakuShThArshaHshvayathujvarAn| vAtashleShmAmayAMshcAnyAnmadhvariShTo vyapohati||167||
samUlAM pippalIM kShArau dvau pa~jca lavaNAni ca| mAtulu~ggAbhayArAsnAshaTImaricanAgaram||168||
kRutvA samAMshaM taccUrNaM pibet prAtaH sukhAmbunA| shleShmike grahaNIdoShe balavarNAgnivardhanam||169||
etairevauShadhaiH siddhaM sarpiH peyaM samArute| gaulmike ShaTpalaM proktaM bhallAtakaghRutaM ca yat||170||
biDaM kAlotthalavaNaM sarjikAyavashUkajam| saptalAM kaNTakArIM ca citrakaM ceti dAhayet||171||
saptakRutvaH srutasyAsya kShArasya dvyADhakena tu| ADhakaM sarpiShaH paktvA pibedagnivivardhanam||172||
iti kShAraghRutamsamUlAM pippalIM pAThAM cavyendrayavanAgaram| citrakAtiviShe hi~ggu shvadaMShTrAM kaTurohiNIm||173||
vacAM ca kArShikaM pa~jcalavaNAnAM palAni ca| dadhnaH prasthadvaye tailasarpiShoH kuDavadvaye||174||
khaNDIkRutAni niShkvAthya shanairantargate rase| antardhUmaM tato dagdhavA cUrNaM kRutvA ghRutAplutam||175||
pibet pANitalaM tasmi~jjIrNe syAnmadhurAshanaH| vAtashleShmAmayAnsarvAnhanyAdviShagarAMshca saH||176||
bhallAtakaM trikaTukaM triphalAM lavaNatrayam| antardhUmaM dvipalikaM gopurIShAgninA dahet||177||
sa kShAraH sarpiShA pIto bhojye vA~apyavacUrNitaH| hRutpANDugrahaNIdoShagulmodAvartashUlanut||178||
durAlabhAM kara~jjau dvau saptaparNaM savatsakam| ShaDgranthAM madanaM mUrvAM pAThAmAragvadhaM tathA||179||
gomUtreNa samAMshAni kRutvA cUrNAni dAhayet| dagdhvA ca taM pibet kShAraM grahaNIbalavardhanam||180||
bhUnimbaM rohiNIM tiktAM paTolaM nimbaparpaTam| dahenmAhiShamUtreNa kShAra eSho~agnivardhanaH||181||
dve haridre vacA kuShThaM citrakaH kaTurohiNI| mustaM ca bastamUtreNa dahet kShAro~agnivardhanaH||182||
catuShpalaM sudhAkANDAttripalaM lavaNatrayAt| vArtAkIkuDavaM cArkAdaShTau dve citrakAt pale||183||
dagdhAni vArtAkurase guTikA bhojanottarAH| bhuktaM bhuktaM pacantyAshu kAsashvAsArshasAM hitAH||184||
visUcikApratishyAyahRudrogashamanAshca tAH| ityeShA kShAraguTikA kRuShNAtreyeNa kIrtitA||185||
iti kShAraguDikAvatsakAtiviShe pAThAM duHsparshAM hi~ggu citrakam| cUrNIkRutya palAshAgrakShAre mUtrasrute pacet||186||
Ayase bhAjane sAndrAttasmAt kolaM sukhAmbunA| madyairvA grahaNIdoShashothArshaHpANDumAn pibet||187||
iti caturthakShAraH triphalAM kaTabhIM cavyaM bilvamadhyamayorajaH| rohiNIM kaTukAM mustaM kuShThaM pAThAM ca hi~ggu ca||188||
madhukaM muShkakayavakShArau trikaTukaM vacAm| viDa~ggaM pippalImUlaM svarjikAM nimbacitrakau||189||
mUrvAjamodendrayavAn guDUcIM devadAru ca| kArShikaM lavaNAnAM ca pa~jcAnAM palikAnpRuthak||190||
bhAgAn dadhni trikuDave ghRutatailena mUrcchitam| antardhUmaM shanairdagdhvA tasmAt pANitalaM pibet||191||
sarpiShA kaphavAtArshograhaNIpANDurogavAn| plIhamUtragrahashvAsahikkAkAsakrimijvarAn||192||
shoShAtisArau shvayathuM pramehAnAhahRudgrahAn| hanyAt sarvaviShaM caiva kShAro~agnijanano varaH||193||
tridoShe vidhividvaidyaH pa~jca karmANi kArayet||194||
ghRutakShArAsavAriShTAn dadyAccAgnivivardhanAn| kriyA yA cAnilAdInAM nirdiShTA grahaNIM prati||195||
snehanaM svedanaM shuddhirla~gghanaM dIpanaM ca yat||196||
cUrNAni lavaNakShAramadhvariShTasurAsavAH| vividhAstakrayogAshca dIpanAnAM ca sarpiShAm||197||
... kriyAM cAvasthikIM shRuNu| ShThIvanaM shlaiShmike rUkShaM dIpanaM tiktasaMyutam||198||
sakRudrUkShaM sakRutsnigdhaM kRushe bahukaphe hitam| parIkShyAmaM sharIrasya dIpanaM snehasaMyutam||199||
dIpanaM bahupittasya tiktaM madhurasaMyutam| bahuvAtasya tu snehalavaNAmlayutaM hitam||200||
snehameva paraM vidyAddurbalAnaladIpanam||201||
nAlaM snehasamiddhasya shamAyAnnaM sugurvapi| mandAgniravipakvaM tu purIShaM yo~atisAryate||202||
dIpanIyauShadhairyuktAM ghRutamAtrAM pibettu saH| tayA samAnaH pavanaH prasanno mArgamAsthitaH||203||
agneH samIpacAritvAdAshu prakurute balam| kAThinyAdyaH purIShaM tu kRucchrAnmu~jcati mAnavaH||204||
saghRutaM lavaNairyuktaM naro~annAvagrahaM pibet| raukShyAnmande pibetsarpistailaM vA dIpanairyutam||205||
atisnehAttu mande~agnau cUrNAriShTAsavA hitAH| bhinne gudopalepAttu male tailasurAsavAH||206||
udAvartAttu mande~agnau nirUhAH snehabastayaH| doShavRuddhyA tu mande~agnau shuddho doShavidhiM caret||207||
vyAdhiyuktasya mande tu sarpirevAgnidIpanam| upavAsAcca mande~agnau yavAgUbhiH pibedghRutam||208||
annAvapIDitaM balyaM dIpanaM bRuMhaNaM ca tat| dIrghakAlaprasa~ggAttu kShAmakShINakRushAnnarAn||209||
prasahAnAM rasaiH sAmlairbhojayet pishitAshinAm| laghu, tIkShNoShNashodhitvAddIpayantyAshu te~analam||210||
nAbhojanena kAyAgnirdIpyate nAtibhojanAt||211||
yathA nirindhano vahniralpo vA~atIndhanAvRutaH| snehAnnavidhibhishcitraishcUrNAriShTasurAsavaiH ||212||
samyakprayuktairbhiShajA balamagneH pravardhate| yathA hi sAradArvagniH sthiraH santiShThate ciram||213||
snehAnnavidhibhistadvadantaragnirbhavet sthiraH| hitaM jIrNe mitaM cAshnaMshciramArogyamashnute||214||
avaiShamyeNa dhAtUnAmagnivRuddhau yateta nA| samairdoShaiH samo madhye dehasyoShmA~agnisaMsthitaH||215||
pacatyannaM tadArogyapuShTyAyurbalavRuddhaye| doShairmando~ativRuddho vA viShamairjanayedgadAn||216||
nare kShINakaphe pittaM kupitaM mArutAnugam||217||
svoShmaNA pAvakasthAne balamagneH prayacchati| tadA labdhabalo dehe virUkShe sAnilo~analaH||218||
paribhUya pacatyannaM taikShNyAdAshu muhurmuhuH| paktvA~annaM sa tato dhAtU~jchoNitAdIn pacatyapi||219||
tato daurbalyamAta~gkAnmRutyuM copanayennaram| bhukte~anne labhate shAntiM jIrNamAtre pratAmyati||220||
tRuTshvAsadAhamUrcchAdyA vyAdhayo~atyagnisambhavAH| tamatyagniM gurusnigdhashItairmadhuravijjalaiH||221||
annapAnairnayecchAntiM dIptamagnimivAmbubhiH| muhurmuhurajIrNe~api bhojyAnyasyopahArayet||222||
nirindhano~antaraM labdhvA yathainaM na vipAdayet| pAyasaM kRusharAM snigdhaM paiShTikaM guDavaikRutam||223||
adyAttathaudakAnUpapishitAni bhRutAni ca| matsyAnvisheShataH shlakShNAnsthiratoyacarAMstathA||224||
AvikaM ca bhRutaM mAMsamadyAdatyagninAshanam | yavAgUM samadhUcchiShTAM ghRutaM vA kShudhitaH pibet||225||
godhUmacUrNamanthaM vA vyadhayitvA sirAM pibet| payo vA sharkarAsarpirjIvanIyauShadhaiH shRutam||226||
phalAnAM tailayonInAmutkru~jcAshca sasharkarAH| mArdavaM janayantyagneH snigdhA mAMsarasAstathA||227||
pibecchItAmbunA sarpirmadhUcchiShTena saMyutam| godhUmacUrNaM payasA sasarpiShkaM pibennaraH||228||
AnUparasasiddhAn vA trIn snehAMstailavarjitAn| payasA sammitaM cApi ghanaM trisnehasaMyutam||229||
nAristanyena saMyuktAM pibedaudumbarIM tvacam| tAbhyAM vA pAyasaM siddhamadyAdatyagnishAntaye||230||
shyAmAtrivRudvipakvaM vA payo dadyAdvirecanam| asakRut pittashAntyarthaM pAyasapratibhojanam||231||
prasamIkShya bhiShak prAj~jastasmai dadyAdvidhAnavit| yatki~jcinmadhuraM medyaM shleShmalaM gurubhojanam||232||
sarvaM tadatyagnihitaM bhuktvA prasvapanaM divA| medyAnyannAni yo~atyagnAvapratAntaH samashnute||233||
na tannimittaM vyasanaM labhate puShTimeva ca| kaphe vRuddhe jite pitte mArute cAnalaH samaH||234||
bhavanti cAtra- pathyApathyamihaikatra bhuktaM samashanaM matam||235||
viShamaM bahu vA~alpaM vA~apyaprAptAtItakAlayoH| bhuktaM pUrvAnnasheShe tu punaradhyashanaM matam||236||
trINyapyetAni mRutyuM vA ghorAn vyAdhInsRujanti vA| prAtarAshe tvajIrNe~api sAyamAsho na duShyati||237||
divA prabudhyate~arkeNa hRudayaM puNDarIkavat| tasminvibuddhe srotAMsi sphuTatvaM yAnti sarvashaH||238||
vyAyAmAcca vihArAcca vikShiptatvAcca cetasaH| na kledamupagacchanti divA tenAsya dhAtavaH||239||
aklinneShvannamAsiktamanyatteShu na duShyati| avidagdha iva kShIre kShIramanyadvimishritam||240||
naiva dUShyati tenaiva samaM sampadyate yathA| rAtrau tu hRudaye mlAne saMvRuteShvayaneShu ca| yAnti koShThe parikledaM saMvRute dehadhAtavaH||241||
klinneShvanyadapakveShu teShvAsiktaM praduShyati| vidagdheShu payaHsvanyat payastaptamivArpitam||242||
naisheShvAhArajAteShu nAvipakveShu buddhimAn| tasmAdanyatsamashnIyAtpAlayiShyanbalAyuShI||243||
tatra shlokAH- antaragniguNA dehaM yathA dhArayate ca saH| yathA~annaM pacyate yAMshca yathA~a~ahAraH karotyapi||244||
ye~agnayo yAMshca puShyanti yAvanto ye pacanti yAn| rasAdInAM kramotpattirmalAnAM tebhya eva ca||245||
vRuShyANAmAshukRuddheturdhAtukAlodbhavakramaH| rogaikadeshakRuddheturantaragniryathA~adhikaH||246||
praduShyati yathA duShTo yAn rogA~jjanayatyapi| grahaNI yA yathA yacca grahaNIdoShalakShaNam||247||
pUrvarUpaM pRuthak caiva vya~jjanaM sacikitsitam| caturvidhasya nirdiShTaM tathA cAvasthikI kriyA||248||
jAyate ca yathA~atyagniryacca tasya cikitsitam| uktavAniha tat sarvaM grahaNIdoShake muniH||249||
iti madhvariShTaH
jIrNe rasairvA madhurairashnIyAt payasA~api vAiti pa~jcamakShAraH

arshaHkAryatvAdgrahaNIdoShasya arshashcikitsitamanu grahaNIcikitsitaM brUte| grahaNImAshrito~agnidoSho grahaNIdoShaH, evaM cAshrayAshrayiNorabhedopacArAd grahaNIdoShashabdena grahaNyAshrito~agnidoSho~api gRuhyate||1-2||

vRuShyAdidravyANAM dhAtuparamparAkrameNa shukrajananAdikAryaM niShedhayannAha- vRuShyAdInAmityAdi| Adishabdena balyabhedanAdIni grAhayati| vRuShyAdInAM kShIrAdidravyANAM prabhAvo balaM shIghraM puShNAti, tataste kShIrAdayaH prabhAvavardhitabalAH shIghramevAnnakAryaM shukrajananAdi kurvanti, na yathoktadhAtukrameNetyarthaH| kiMvA vRuShyAdInAM kShIrAdidravyANAM yaH prabhAvaH sa Ashu balaM puShNAti svajanyAnAM shukrAdInAmityarthaH; hishabdo~avadhAraNe; evaM vRuShyAdInAM prabhAvAcchukrAdyutpattiH shIghraM bhavati| athotsargataH kiyatA kAlena dhAtuparivRuttirbhavatItyAha- ShaDbhirityAdi| ShaDbhirahorAtrai rasasya shukrarUpatayA parivartanaM bhavatIti kecidicchanti| tatrotpanno raso raktamekenAhorAtreNa yAti, evaM rasotpattidinaM parityajya ShaDahena shukratA bhavati; yadA tu rasotpattidinamapi prakShipyate tadA ShaDbhirdinairatikrAntaiH saptame shukrabhAvatayA parivartanaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| uktaM hi parAshare- “AhAro~adyatanaH shvo hi rasatvaM gacchati nRuNAm| shoNitatvaM tRutIye~ahni, caturthe mAMsatAmapi|| medastvaM pa~jcame, ShaShThe tvasthitvaM, saptame tviyAt| majjatAM, shukratAM yAti niyamAdaShTame nRuNAm” iti| evadapyupayogadinaM sampUrNaM parityajyaiva vyAkhyAtavyamityAhuH| ki~jca rasadhAtoH raktadhAturUpatayA ca pariNamanaM yattadapi ShaShThadinanirvartyameveti| yaduktaM sushrute- “sa khalvApyo rasa ekaikasmin dhAtau trINi trINi kalAsaha srANyavatiShThati dasha ca kalAH, evaM mAsena rasaH shukrIbhavati” (su.sU.a.14) iti| tenaitatpakShadvayamapi kecidityAdinA darshayati| svamatamAha- santatyetyAdi| bhojye upayukte sati dhAtUnAM rasAdInAM cakravat parivRuttirbhavati avishrAntA samutpattirdhAtUnAM bhavati| cakradRuShTAntena tu parivRuttikAlAniyamaM darshayati; yathA cakraM pAnIyoddhAraNArthaM niyuktaM bAhyamAnaM bAhubalaprakarShAt kadAcidAshveva parivartate, kadAcid bAhubalamAndyAccireNa; evaM dhAtavo~api agnyAdisauShThavAcchIghrameva parivartante, agnyAdivaiguNye cireNa parivartante iti; evaM sushrutenApi “shabdArcirjalasantAnavadaNunA visheSheNAnudhAvatyeva sharIraM kevalam” (su.sU.a.14) ityatra dRuShTAntatrayeNa rasapariNAmo~api agnyAdibhedena prakRuShTAprakRuShTakAlaja ukta eva| tatra hi jalasantAnadRuShTAntena cireNa mAsaparyantena shukratApattI rasasyoktA, shabdasantAnadRuShTAntena tu nAtishIghraM nAticirAcca shukrotpattiruktA, arciHsantAnadRuShTAntena tvatishIghraM shukrotpattiruktA| tathA~anyatrApyuktaM- “kecidAhurahorAtrAt, ShaDrAtrAdapare, pare| mAsena yAti shukratvamannaM pAkakramAditi”| tadetat sakalaM cakradRuShTAntena gRuhItaM j~jeyam||20-35||

atha ko~annarasaM raktAdidhAtupoShakaM prerayati; yena tatra tatra rasaH sarpatItyAha- vyAnenetyAdi| rasarUpo dhAtuH, kiMvA rasatIti raso dravadhAturucyate, tena rudhirAdInAmapi dravANAM grahaNaM bhavati; vikShepaH ucitaM prAkRutaM karma yasya sa vikShepocitakarmA; tena vyAnena, yugapaditi ekakAlaM, sarvata iti sarvasmin dehe, vikShipyate iti nIyate, ajasramiti avishrAntaM vikShipyate, sadeti sarvakAlam| nanvevaM sarvatra rasavikShepe kathamekadeshe rasAdau vikArAshrayo dRushyata ityAha- kShipyamANa ityAdi| khavaiguNyAditi srotovaiguNyAt| sajjatIti tiShThati| vikAraM kurute iti rasAshrayivikAraM kurute; raso~api hi vikArakaraNe AshrayatayA vyApriyate, teneha tasya kartRutvaM yuktam| khe varShamiva toyada iti yathA caNDena vAyunA nIyamAno megho yatra sakto bhavati tatraiva varShaM karoti, tathA raso~apItyarthaH| yathA rasa ekadeshe vikAraM karoti, evaM doShA apyekadeshavikAraM kurvantItyAha- doShANAmityAdi| sushruto~apyAha- “kupitAnAM hi doShANAM sharIre paridhAvatAm| yatra sa~ggaH khavaiguNyAdvyAdhistatropajAyate” (su.sU.a.24) iti||36-37||-

uktamagnInAM karma upasaMharati- iti bhautiketyAdi| bhautikAH pa~jca, dhAtvagnayaH sapta, annapaktaikaH| atra ca yAnyagnyantarANi upadhAtumalAdigatAni tAnyapyavaruddhAni bhUtAgniShveva; kiMvA, aprAdhAnyAdanyAnyaki~jcitkarANi noktAni| sarvAgniShu jATharAgneH prAdhAnyamAha- annasyetyAdi| prAdhAnye hetumAha- tanmUlA ityAdi| tanmUlatve hetugarbhavisheShaNamAha- tadvRuddhItyAdi| tasya jATharAgneH vRuddhyA vRuddhyAtmakAH kShayeNa ca kShayAtmakA yasmAdihAgnayastasmAdanvayavyatirekArthavidhAyitvAttanmUlA ityarthaH| yatashcAyamantaragnirmUlaM sarvatra tasmAttaM pAlayediti yojyam| vidhivadyuktairityatra AhAravidhiyogAdupayuktaiH| Ayurbalasthitiriti annapAcakAgnisthitau AyurbalasthityA anye~apyatipreyA varNAdayo lakShaNIyAH| viparyaye doShamAha- yo hItyAdi| grahaNIdoShajAniti grahaNyAshritadoShajAn| etena vakShyamANalakShaNAshcatvAro grahaNIvikArA visheSheNa grahaNIdoShashabdavAcyA gRuhyante, tathA~agnimAndyAjIrNAdayashca grahaNyAshritA rogA gRuhyante| agnimAndyAjIrNAdayastu yadyapi grahaNyAshritatvena grahaNIrogA eva, tathA~apIha grahaNIrUpanADIvyApAravaiparItyena ye jAyante ta eva mukhyagrahaNIshabdavAcyAshcatvAro rogAH| yato ‘adhastu pakvamAmaM vA’ ityAdinA grahaNIgadasAmAnyalakShaNavishiShTameva grahaNIgadaM grahaNIprAkRutavyApAropamardena jAyamAnaM vakShyati| vakShyati ca grahaNyA duShTamaduShTaM ca rUpaM “apakvaM dhArayatyannaM pakvaM sRujati pArshvataH| sA duShTA bahusho bhuktamAmameva vimu~jcati” iti| na ceyaM pakvAnnavimokShalakShaNA duShTiragnidoShe AmAdyajIrNe vA| anena visheShAbhidheyagrahaNIshabdatvaM grahaNyAshritadoShajanyagrahaNIgadasyaivehocyate; agnidoShANAM na visheShAdgrahaNIgadatvam; atisAre yadyapi pakvAnnamu~jcanamasti, tathA~api tasya bhinnasamprAptikatvAt tathA cikitsAbhedAd grahaNIdoShAdanyatvamuktam||38-41||

evaM vyavasthite sAmAnyena grahaNIdoShavikAraNAM hetvAdInyAha- abhojanAdityAdi| kAlashabdena ca saMvatsarAtmakaH kAla ucyate| deshavaiShamyaM deshavyApat; sA ca janapadoddhvaMsanIye proktA| Rutushabdena tu shishirAdyRutuH| kAlavaiShamyeNa sarveShAmRutUnAM vaiShamyaM gRuhyate, RutuvaiShamyeNa dvyekartuvaiShamyamiti visheShaH| shuktatvamiti amlatAm| viSharUpatAmiti yathA viShaM bahuvikArakAri bhavati tathA tadrUpatAm, anena sarva evAjIrNabhedA avaruddhA j~jeyAH, ye tantrAntare “AmaM vidagdhaM viShTabdhaM kaphapittAnilaiH kramAt| ajIrNaM kecidicchanti caturthaM rasasheShataH” (su.sU.a.46) ityanenoktAH||42-44||

tasyeti sAmAnyAjIrNasya lakShaNam| viShTambha iti viShTambho~apracalanarUpatayA~avasthAnam| ghoramannaviShaM ca tat pittena saMsRujyamAnamityAdinA pittAdiduShTasyAjIrNasya lakShaNamAha| etacca pittAdisaMsargakRutaM lakShaNam, ajIrNasya koShThamAtragatatvena yakShmAdivikArakaraNe~asAmarthyopalabdheH| amlapittaM ceti amlaguNodriktaM pittam| asya tantrAntare lakShaNamuktaM- “avipAkaklamotkledatiktAmlodgAragauravaiH| hRutkaNThadAhArucibhishcAmlapittaM vinirdishet” iti| yakShmaNastridoShajatve~api sroto~avarodhe kaphavyApAraprAdhAnyAdiha kaphajatvamuktam| kiTTadhAtuyogena rasasheShAnnasya gadAnAha- mUtrarogAMshcetyAdi| rasAdijAnityatra ye rasAdijA arucyAdaya uktAste bhavantIti j~jeyam||45-49||

tatra grahaNIdoShanirdiShTAgnidoShe vaktavye prakRutij~jAnAnantaratvAdvikRutij~jAnasya prathamaM tAvadavikRutasyAgne rUpamAha- AyurityAdi| AyuH cetanAnuvRuttiH| varNaH gaurAdiH| balaM shaktiH vyAyAmAdyanumeyA| svAsthyashabdenaiva varNAdigrahaNaM yadyapi labhyate, tathA~api “svasthasyaujaskaraM yattu tadvRuShyaM tadrasAyanam” (ci.a.1,pA.1) iti ; tena varNAdInAmavikAratvaM nAvashyaM svasthe bhavatIti varNAdInAM pRuthagupAdAnaM kRutam| utsAhaH duShkareShvapi kAryeShvadhyavasAyaH, upacayaH dehapuShTiH| ojaH hRudayasthaM sarvadhAtusArarUpam| tejaH dehoShmA shukraM vA; yaduktaM shAlAkye- “dRuShTistejomayI proktA shukraM tejashca kevalam| tasmAddRuShTibalApekShI tejovRuddhiM samAcaret” iti| agnaya iti bhUtAgnayaH pa~jca, dhAtvagnayaH sapta, iti dvAdashAgnayaH| prANA iti prANApAnopalakShitAH pa~jcApi vAyavaH; kiMvA prANavAyureva ‘prANAH’ iti shabdena nityaM bahuvacanAntenocyate; yathA- apsarasshabdena ekA~api vidyAdharI kIrtyate| dehAgnihetukA iti dehapoShakapradhAnajATharAgnikAraNakAH| shAnte ityutsanne| yukte iti same| vikRute iti mande viShame tIkShNe vA| mUlamagnistasmAditi tasmAt prAshastyAdanvayavyatirekavidhAnAdAyurvarNAdInAmagnirmUlaM pradhAnaM kAraNamityarthaH| nirucyate iti nishcayenocyate||3-4||

mandAgnivyApAramAha- durbala ityAdi| uktavikAreShu pradhAnatvena adhyAyaprakRutaM grahaNIdoShavikAraM nirdhArayannAha- adhastvityAdi| pakvamAmaM veti vAshabdaH samuccaye; tena ki~jcitpakvaM ki~jcidapakvaM ca| kutaH pakvApakvaM sRujatItyAha- sarvamevAnnaM prayo hyasya vidahyate iti; pakvApakvaM bhavati| atisRuShTamiti vimuktam| tama eva tamakaH||51-54||

samprati grahaNIdoShasya sukhapratipattyarthaM grahaNyAH svarUpaM prAkRutaM karma cAha- agnyadhiShThAnamityAdi| agnyadhiShThAnam agnerAshraya ityarthaH| grahaNIsa~jj~jAnimittamAha- annasyetyAdi| grahaNAditi dhAraNAt, nAbheruparyannasya dhAraNAdityarthaH| kiMvA nAbherupari agnerUrdhvajvalanena balenopastambhitA upabRuMhitA ca sati apakvamannaM dhArayati, pakvaM ca pArshvataH sRujatIti vAmapArshvataH sRujati; yataH grahaNIgudau vAmapArshvAshrayau, tena vAme pArshve pakvaM sRujatIti yuktam| upastambhitA iti agninA pittavyApArakaraNena anukUlitA, upabRuMhiteti agninA bRuMhaNavyApArakaraNena sashaktIkRutA; kiMvA upastambhatvena upabRuMhitA, atra pakShe upastambhasAdhAraNyaM grahaNyA Aha| grahaNyAH prAkRutaM karmAbhidhAya vaikRutaM karmAha- durbaletyAdi| durbalAgnishca abalA ceti, kiMvA durbalamagnibalaM yasyAH sA durbalAgnibalA| duShTA iti doShaduShTA| AmaM vimu~jcatIti apakvamevAnnaM vimu~jcati| pUrvarUpe pakvamAmaM vA vimu~jcatItyanena vidagdharUpamAmamevoktam, iha tvAmaM niyamena vimu~jcatIti na virodhaH||56-57||

vAtapittakaphasannipAtajAn grahaNIbhedAn teShAM pRuthagghetvAdIMshcAha- vAtAdityAdi| tribhya iti sannipAtAt| rUpabhedAniti grahaNIdoShali~ggatvena vakShyamANAn| shuktamivAnnasya pAkaH shuktapAkaH| gRuddhiH sarvarasAnAmiti saptamyarthe ShaShThI| jIrNe jIryati ‘anne’ iti sheShaH| gulmAdisha~gkitvaM gulmAdisadRushapIDAyuktatvena bhavati| paittikagrahaNyAM pittasyAgnisamAnatayA vardhanameva yuktamityAsha~gkya pittasya dravatvenAgnihananaM kriyate iti darshayannAha- AplAvayaddhantyanalamiti; AplAvanaM draveNArdrIkaraNam| uShNasyApi dravatayA agninirvApaNe dRuShTAntamAha- jalaM taptamityAdi| daurbalyaM balahAniH| yashcAgnirityAdishlokaM kecidvaisheShikagrahaNIdoShavyatiriktAgnidoShatrayasya grahaNIrogAntarniveshanamasa~ggatamiti kRutvA~anArShaM vadanti, kintu taM cApItipadenA~agnimAndyAdInAM prAkRutAnAM sAmAnyagrahaNIdoShAbAdhe sati na ki~jcidvirodhaM pashyAmaH; sAmAnyagrahaNIdoShe~api agnimAndyAdaya uktA eveti darshitameva| samavarjamiti samaprakRutipuruShagatatvenoktAgnivarjam||58-72||

samprati samprAptasyAnnasyAgninA yathA pAko bhavati, yathA ca pacyamAnamannaM dehadhAtvAdirUpatAmApadyate, tadAha- annamityAdi| mukhapraveshAdArabhyAnnasya vyApAra ihocyate| AdAnamAhArapraNayanaM karma yasya sa tathA, prakarShatIti nayati| dravairiti pAnIyAdibhiH | bhinnasa~gghAtamiti avayavashaithilyamApannam| kAle iti bubhukShAkAle| bhuktaM samamiti mAtrAprakRutyAdisamam| samAnenAvadhUta iti agnipArshvasthitena samAnena sandhukShitaH, ayaM ca samAnaH prAkRutatvAd bAhyo vAyuriva agneH sandhukShaNo bhavati na vaiShamyakaraH, vikRutastu vaiShamyaM karoti; tena vAtena viShamo~agnirbhavatIti copapannaM bhavati| ete ca dravAdayaH pAcakasyAgneH sahAyA bhavantItyanena granthenocyate; “AhArapariNAmakarAstvime bhAvA bhavanti; tadyathA- UShmA, vAyuH, kledaH, snehaH, kAlaH, samayogashca” (shA.a.6) iti| udaryaH pAcaka ityarthaH| ‘pavanodvaha’ ityagnivisheShaNaM kecit paThanti| samyagiti bhuktavisheShaNaM kecit paThanti; tadA samyagityanena mAtrAsAmyamucyate| samyaggrahaNena tu prakRutyAdisampaducyate| AyurvivRuddhaye iti sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyogAnuvartanAya tadvivRuddhaye ca| rasamalAyeti tAdarthye caturthI| Ashayasthamiti AmAshayastham| adhaHsthita ityanena agnerUrdhvajvalanasvabhAvatayA UrdhvasthAnnapAke sAmarthyaM sUcayati| atrArthe yathetyAdinA dRuShTAntamAha||6-8||

evaM sthUlapAkakramamabhidhAya, avAntaramaNupAkakramamAha- annasyetyAdi| bhuktamAtrasyeti bhuktAnantarameva| ShaDrasasyeti prAshastyenAbhidhAnaM, kiMvA ShaDrasasyApi prathamaM madhuratA niruktA bhavatIti darshayati| prapAkata iti prathamapAkataH; prashabda AdikarmaNi| madhurashcAsau Adyashceti madhurAdyaH; kiMvA ‘madhurAt prAk kapho bhAvAt’ iti pAThaH| phenabhUta iti phenasadRusho~aghana ityarthaH| paramiti AdyamadhurapAkAnantaram| vidagdhasyeti pakvApakvasya| amlabhAvA iti jAtAmlasvarUpataH| AshayAt AmAshayAt| cyavamAnasya adhobhAgaM vAyunA nIyamAnasya, anena ca pittasthAnasambandhaM vidagdhAhArasya darshayati| acchamiti aghanam| udIryate iti pittamutpadyate; amlaM ca pittamamlabhAvAdAhArasya utpadyata iti yuktameva| pakvAshayaM tu prAptasyeti malarUpatayA pakvAshayaM gatasya| shoShyamANasya vahnineti yadyapyUrdhvadAhakShamo vahniH,  tathA~apyasyAdhogatasya vahninA shoShyamANatvaM pakvAshayagatasyApyupapannam| yatashcAdhogamane samyagvahnivyApAro nAsti, ataH ‘pacyamAnasya’ iti padaM parityajya ‘shoShyamANasya’ iti kRutam| paripiNDitapakvasyeti paripiNDitarUpatayA malarUpatayA pakvasya| vAyuH syAt kaTubhAvata iti paripiNDitAvasthodbhUtakaTutA vAyorutpadyate| evamIdRushaH ShaDrasAhArasyAvasthApAko bhavati| nanu yadyatrAvasthApAkavashAt ShaNNAmeva rasAnAM kaphAdikartRutvamucyate, tadA “kaTutiktakaShAyANAM vipAkaH prAyashaH kaTuH” (sU.a.26) ityAdinA yo vipAka ucyate sa virudhyate, avasthApAkenaiva bAdhitatvAt; maivaM, nahyavasthApAko~ayaM rasasvabhAvaM niShThApAkaM bAdhate, kintvavasthAyAM svakAryaM karoti; tena rasAdayo~api svakAryaM kurvanti, avasthApAko~api svakIyaM kAryaM karoti; yathA- madhuratiktAdiShaDrase~anne upayukte madhuro~api svakAryaM karoti, tiktAdayashca svakAryaM kurvanti; ayaM tu visheShaH- yanmadhurAkhyasyAvasthApAkasya madhurAdayaH shleShmajanakA rasA anuguNA bhavanti tadA sa bahushleShmANaM janayati, yadA tvavasthApAko viparItakaTukAdiparigRuhIto bhavati tadA stokamAtraM kaphaM janayati; evaM pittajanake~avasthApAke~api vAcyam| “kaTutiktakaShAyANAM” (sU.a.26) ityAdinoktastridhA vipAkastu rasamalavivekasamakAlo bhinnakAla evAvasthApAkaiH samamiti na virodhaH| sa ca bhinnakAlo~apyavasthApAkakAryadoShAnuguNatayA~ananuguNatayA vA avasthApAkAhitadoShANAM vardhanaM kShapaNaM vA karotIti tasyAbhidhAnaM shAstre prayojanavadeva| yadyapi sarvamannamavasthAyAM vidahyate, tathA~api ye~atyarthaM vidAhinasta eva ‘vidAhinaH’ ityucyante, visheShavidAhakartRutvAt| anye tvAhuH- na ShaDrasAdapyannAt sAmAnyenAvasthApAke kaphAdyutpattiH, kintu ShaDrasAdapyannAt prathame pAke madhuro~ayamudbhUto rasaH sa kaphaM janayati, tathA pittaM vidAhAvasthAyAmudbhUtAdamlarasAdutpadyate, evaM vAyurapi AhArakaTutAvasthAyAM bhavatIti| anye tvAhuH- yat- nAnnasyAgnisaMyogAnmadhurAdyAvasthikaM bhavati, kintu kaphAdisthAneShu manuShyANAM svabhAvAdeva madhurAdayo rasAstiShThanti, te cAnnaM svasvabhAvaM nItvA kaphAdI~jjanayanti| uktaM hi tantrAntare- “madhuro hRudayAdUrdhvaM rasaH koShThe vyavasthitaH| tataH saMvardhate shleShmA sharIrabalavardhanaH|| nAbhIhRudayamadhye ca rasastvamlo vyavasthitaH| svabhAvena manuShyANAM tataH pittaM vivardhate|| adho nAbhyAstu khalvekaH kaTuko~avasthito rasaH| prAyaH shreShThatamastatra prANinAM vardhate~anilaH|| tasmAdvipAkastrividho rasAnAM nAtra saMshayaH” iti| iha tu tatretyAdigranthArthAlocanayA yathokta eva granthArtho nyAyyaH| tantrAntare tu shleShmapittagatamadhurAmlarasau varNayanti, te kaphAdyadhigatA rasA asmAkamapi pAkasahakAritayA anumatA eva| yattu shleShmajanakAMshasyaivAvasthApAke shleShmakartRutvamityuktaM, tadanumatameva; evaM yaH shleShmajanakoM~asha AhAragataH sa sthAnamahimnA tadAhArasya madhuratAmApAdya shleShmANaM visheSheNa janayatIti brUmaH| yattu, anenAvasthApAkena kaphapittayorIraNamAtraM kriyate natu vRuddhiH, vRuddhiH niShThApAke eva bhavatIti vadanti, tadupapattishUnyaM bhAti; ki~jca, avasthApAkAt kaphapittayorvRuddhiH, tathA niShThApAkAcca malarUpatayA utpAda iti yuktaM pashyAmaH||9-11||

grahaNImAshritamityAdau doShamiti sAmAnyavacanAdvAtAdInAM trayANAmapi grahaNam| AmasyApakvasya li~ggairanvitamiti Amali~ggAnvitam| uddharediti vamet| phalAnAmiti madanaphalAnAm| lInamiti anutkliShTam| pakvAshayasthamiti adhogatatvena pakvAshayasamIpagatam| srAvyamiti virecanIyam| sadIpanairiti dIpanadravyasaMyuktairvirecanaprayogaiH| sharIrAnugate iti sharIravyApake| sAme rase iti apakve rase; AmashcAtrApakvarasarUpa eveShTaH, AhArarasasya rasasambandhena sharIravyApakatayA durghaTatvAt| la~gghanam anashanaM, pAcanaM yavAgvAdi| vishuddhAmAshaye ityatra vishuddhirhi virecanala~gghanairyathAyogyatayA j~jeyA| dIpanIyayutamiti ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktadIpanIyagaNasAdhitam| svinnAbhyaktamiti svinnaM cAbhyaktaM ceti svinnAbhyaktam| srastadoShamiti nirUheNa srastadoSham||73-81||

dve pa~jcamUle ityAdau suShavIsvaraso jalasthAnIyaH, AranAlAdi kvAthyaM ca militvA droNaM mAnaM grAhyam| kShArau dattvA ca yuktita ityanena kShArayoralpamAnatvamucyate, kintu prakShepyAnyatamalavaNamAnena pRuthak kShArau deyau; yuktita ityanena tu yogye kAle kShArayogamAha, sa ca yogyakAlo~atra ghRutAvatAraNakAla eva| yadAha jatUkarNaH- “dashamUlaM pa~jcakolaM kulatthaM surabhiM yavam| devadAruM ca saralaM shaNabIjaM ca sAdhayet|| dadhnA sauvIrakeNaiva tena pakve ghRutADhake| dvau kShArau saptalavaNAnyAvaped dvipalAni tu” iti| audbhidam utkArikAlavaNam| romakaM rumAhRudbhavam| pAkyaM pAkajam||82-86||

pa~jcamUlAdye shuktAditrayodashadravANAM pratyekaM snehasamatvam| sabIjapUrakarasamityatrApi pa~jcamUlyAdIni kalkatvenecchanti; kiMvA pUrvameva ghRutaM bIjapurarasasaMyuktaM peyamityarthaH| tailamityAdau etaiH pa~jcamUlyAdibhiH siddhaM tailamabhya~ggArthaM yojyaM, tathA eteShAmeva kalkoktAnAM pa~jcamUlyAdInAM cUrNaM sukhAmbunA peyam| cUrNaviShayamAha- vAte ityAdi| vAtashleShmAvRute grahaNIgade tathA sAme grahaNIgade; kecit “sAme purIShe” iti vadanti; AmaM cAnekavidhamAhuH, yaducyate- “AmamannarasaM kecit kecittu malasa~jcayam| prathamAM doShaduShTiM ca kecidAmaM pracakShate” iti| bhojo~apyAha- “AmAshayasthaH kAyAgnerdaurbalyAdavipAcitaH| Adya AhAradhAturyaH sa Ama iti sa~jj~jitaH” iti| Ishvaraseno~apyAha- “evamAmAshaye~apyannaM bahu samya~gna jIryati| cIyamAnaM tadevAnnaM kAlenAmatvamApnuyAt” ityAdi| tadihApi tadvacanaprAmANyAdAmavyavasthA kartavyA||88-93||

sAmanirAmagrahaNIgadaj~jAnArthaM sAmanirAmaviDlakShaNamAha- majjatItyAdi| Ameti AmAshritA| gurutvAditi AmAhitagurutvAt| pakveti nirAmA; upasaMhariShyatyAmapakvalakShaNAnte ‘parIkShyaivaM purA sAmaM nirAmaM vA’ iti| dvayorapi AmapakvalakShaNayorapavAdamAha- vinA~atidravetyAdi| atidravatvAdAmA~api plavate, atisaMhatA tu pakvA~api atisa~gghAtAdeva majjati, shaityashleShmapradUShaNAcca kaphayogAhitagauravA pakvA~api majjati gurutvAdeva na plavate| nanu saviShTambhaprasekArtItyAdinaiva sAmasyoktatvAt kimanena sAmatAlakShaNena punaruktena? ucyate- vAtakaphAdhikArAttaduktam, idaM tu viDAmatAj~jAnArthamuktamiti visheShaH| parIkShyetyAdau nirAmaM cAmadoShiNamiti kathaM, yAvatA na nirAmatAyAmAmadoShatvamasti? na, AmadoShashabdena grahaNIdoShiNo~abhipretatvAt| itareNeti grahaNIdoShashamanena||94-95||

citraketyAdau lavaNAni cetyatra kapi~jjalAdhikaraNanyAyena lavaNatrayamicchanti; kintvaniyate sa nyAyo bhavati, iha tu pa~jcalavaNAnAM prAdhAnyena dIrgha~jjIvitIye nirdiShTatvAt pa~jcalavaNasya ca shakyopAdAnatvAt pa~jcaiva lavaNAni grAhyANi||96-97||

mustAntakalka iti pashcAduktanAgarAdikalka ityarthaH| arshogranthiH arsho~anugrathitavarcastvam| maricasaMyutamiti paryantaM ‘cUrNaM kRutvA pibet’ ityanuvartate| sAme doShe sati pippalImUlAdiShu ativiShAdi prakShipya cUrNaM kartavyamityarthaH| surAdibhirityatrAdishabdena kA~jjikasauvIrAdigrahaNam||98-110||
cavyetyAdau shAlmalaM shAlmalIveShTakam| shilodbhavaM shailajam| cukrikA cA~ggerI| soShaNa iti samaricaH||112-116||-

takramityAdinA takraguNAbhidhAnam| madhurapAkitvAnna ca pittaprakopaNam; amlatvAt pittaprakopaNe prApte madhurapAkitayA pittaM na prakopayati, nApi pittaM prashamayatItyAhuH| sadyaskamavidAhIti sadyo mathitameva takraM pacyamAnAvasthAyAM vidAhakRunna bhavati, ki~jcitkAlasthitaM tu vidAhI bhavatyeva| yavAnItyAdau takre tadAsutamiti takrADhake Asutam| jAtamiti amlarasatayA jAtam||118-121||
vamanena vetyUrdhvagapittApekShayA j~jeyam| sarpirbhishcApi tiktakairityatra jAtyAkhyAyAM bahuvacanaM; kiMvA kuShThoktaM tiktaghRutadvayamanyacca tiktasAdhitaM ghRutamiti bahuvacanaM sAdhu||122-124||
kuTannaTaM kaivartamustakam| ShaDgranthA vacA| AsphotA ‘asphuramallikA’ iti loke khyAtA| kapItanaH ‘gandhamuNDa’ iti khyAtaH||125-128||

nAgarAdye sakShaudramiti madhuprakShepayuktam| taNDulAmbuneti taNDuladhAvanAmbunA; anye tu taNDulAddviguNamamlaM taNDulena samaM ciraM sthitaM tattaNDulAmbu vadanti| kRuShNAtreyeNa pUjitatvopadarshanAdasya siddhayogatvaM darshyate; kRuShNAtreyaH punarvasorabhinna eveti vRuddhAH||129-131||
bhUnimbAdye guDayutaM shItAmbu guDashItAmbu; guDashcAtra guDavarNatAmAdhuryApattimAtro deyaH||132-133||

vacAmityAdau syonAkakaTva~ggashabdAbhyAM dvAvapi pRuthushimbAlpashimbau syonAkau gRuhyete| tadrogashamamanvicchanniti bhUnimbAdyuktagrahaNIdoShAdirogashAntiM kA~gkShan| bhUnimbAdyeneti bhUnimbAdyuktadravyagaNena yathoktamAnena yojayad vacAdIn; apare tu bhUnimbAdyeneti vacanenAtra bhUnimbAdyuktaguDashItAmbupeyatAmasyApyatidishatIti vadanti||134-140||

pAnIyArthaM pAnAya| kaTvamlakShArapaTuneti kaTvAdiyogAt paTunA indriyottejakenetyarthaH| kaphagrahaNyAM sadyaskameva yadyapi kaShAyatvAttakramucitaM, tathA~api agnidIpanatayA amlameva takraM ‘amlaM cAnupibet’ ityanenaivoktam| nigadaM sIdhumiti nirdoShaM sIdhum||141-145||

prasAdabhAgotpAdamabhidhAya malabhAgotpAdamAha- kiTTamityAdi| rasasya kapha iti rase pacyamAne kiTTaM kapho bhavati, prasAdashca raktaM; evaM raktAdimale~api j~jeyam| mAMsasya khamalA iti karNAkShinAsAsyaprajananamalAH| malaH svedastu medasa iti svedo yadyapi udakavisheSha eva uktastathA~api tasya medomalatvenaivotpatiH; kiMvA, udakAdapi svedo bhavati medomalatayA ca bhavati, yathA- kapho~avasthApAkAd rasamalatayA ca bhavati| asthimalaM nakho~api sushrutaprAmANyAdunneyaH| tatra hi “nakhaloma ca” (su.sU.a.46) ityanenAsthimalatvaM nakhasyoktam| uktaM ca vividhAshitapItIye- “kiTTAt keshanakhAdayaH puShyanti” (sU.a.28) iti; kintu shArIre~asthigaNanAyAM “viMshatirnakhA” (shA.a.7) ityanenAsthitvena proktAH| evamuktena krameNa prasAdakiTTe dvidhA Rucchato bhavata ityarthaH| samprati poShyeNApi raktena rasasyApyAyanaM kriyate, tathA mAMsenApi raktasyetyAdi parasparaM dhAtUnAmutpAdakatvamAha- parasparetyAdi| dhAtusnehaparamparA parasparopasaMstabdheti anyonyamupasnehena saMstabdhatvAt santarpiteti yAvat||18-19||-
ardhakShayIkRutamiti pAkAdardhAvashiShTaM kRutam| pUrvavatsannidhApayediti elAdilipte kumbhe saMsthApayet||146-151||
dantIcitrakamuShTI dve iti citrakadantyormilitvA dvipalam| tadvaditi elAdinA liptabRuhatkumbhastham||152-159||
prAsthikamityAdau pippalIguDabibhItakamajjAnaH pratyekaM prasthamAnAH| snigdharasAshana iti snehavanmAMsarasabhojanaH||160-162||
nave ityAdau tvagelAdInAM kArShikatvam||163-167||
samUlAM pippalImiti pippalIM pippalImUlaM ca| bhallAtakaghRutaM ca gulmoktamiti j~jeyam||168-170||

biDaM kAlotthalavaNamiti biDaM biDalavaNaM, kAlalavaNaM tu sauvarcalalavaNamityarthaH| khaNDIkRutAnIti khaNDaM khaNDaM kRutAni| anugate rase iti nipIte drave| pANitalamiti karShaH| madhurAshanatvamiha kShAraprayogAbhicchedakatvahantRutayA yaugikatvAjj~jeyam||171-178||
gomUtreNa samAMshAnIti gomUtreNa militaM cUrNaM tulyam| asya ca pAnaM pUrvakShAravat sarpiShA j~jeyam||179-180||
mAhiShamUtreNetyAdau cUrNasamatvaM mAhiShamUtrasya, pUrvaprayogadRuShTatvAt||181-182||

catuShpalamityAdau, ‘catuShpalaM sudhAkANDAttriphalAlavaNAni ca’ iti ye paThanti, te triphalAlavaNairmilitvA catuShpalaM vadanti| dagdhAni vArtAkurase iti kShArIbhUtAni punarvArtAkurase guTikAH kartavyAH||183-187||
triphalAmityAdau muShkakaM ghaNTApATalakam| ghRutatailenetyatra dadhisAhacaryAdghRutatailasyApi militasya kuDavatrayam||188-193||-

tridoShe pa~jcakarmANItyatra shirovirecanasyAyaugikatve~apyatra bhUyasAM karmaNAM yaugikatvAt pa~jcakarmANIti kRutaM, kiMvA shirorogAdisadbhAve shirovirecanamapyatra deyameva| vyatyAsAttAM samastAM ceti uktavAtAdikriyAM vyatyAsAdekaikadoShakriyAparivartanena kuryAt, kiMvA militairapi kriyA ekakAlaM kartavyA; kriyAmelanaM ca vAtAdidravyamelanAdeva bhavati||194-195||-
snehanamityAdinA grahaNIdoShabheShajaM sa~gkalayyAha||196-197||-

kriyAM cAvasthikImiti grahaNIdoSha eva avasthAvisheShe kartavyAM kriyAM shRuNu| sakRudrUkShaM sakRutsnigdhaM kRusha iti yadi rUkShameva kriyate tadA kRushasya balahAniH syAt, atha snigdhameva kriyate tadA bahukaphe kaphavRuddhiH syAt, tenobhayApekShayA antarA rUkShamantarA ca snigdhaM kartavyamityarthaH| snehalavaNAmlayutamiti dIpanamityarthaH| sandhukShati vidhivadindhanairiti yathAvidhAnadIpita ityarthaH||198-200||-

uktAnuktasnehaphalamavadhArayannAha- snehamevetyAdi| paramiti shreShTham| snehasya dIpanashreShThatve hetumAha- nAlamityAdinA| nAlamiti na samartham| snehasamiddhasyeti snehadIptasya| snehashabdenAtra sAmAnyavAcinA sarpirevocyate, sarpiSha evAtrAdhikArAt| mandAgnirityAdau avipakvamiti purIShavisheShaNaM; tenAvipakvashabdeneha rasAmasya grahaNaM na bhavati, rasAme “jaTharAmagarArditAH” (sU.a.13) ityatra sneho niShiddhaH, snehApakvapurIShaM prati snehaprayogo viruddha eva; ki~jca dIpanIyauShadhasaMskArAdapi snehasya saMskAraguNAvighAtAdeva apakvapurIShaM prati hitatvaM bhavati; snehAMshastu vAtapraguNatAkaraNatvena sahAyatayA upAdIyate, ata evoktaM- tayA samAna ityAdi| prasanna iti duShTivirahataH| mArgamAsthita iti svAbhAvikamArgamApannaH| samIpacAritvAditi prasannatvAdiguNayoge sati agnipArshvasthitatvAdbalameva vahneH karoti na vaiShamyam, agnidIptikaratvasvabhAvAdityarthaH| annAvagrahamiti annenAvagraho~asyeti annAvagrahaH; annamadhyaprayuktamityarthaH||201-205||

atisnehAnmande~agnau sati cUrNAriShTAdIni yojyAni| bhinne iti vishiShTagudopalepAdagnau mande, tailasurAsavA deyA iti vAkyArthaH| doShavidhiM carediti agnimAndyakArakadoShauShadhavidhiM kuryAt| annAvapIDitaM yathA bhavati tathA yavAgUbhirghRutaM pibet; annAvapIDitaM ca madhyabhojanapItaM ghRutaM bhavati| dIrghakAletyAdau kShAmo vyavasAyashUnyaH , kShINo durbalaH, kRusho hInamAMsaH| prasahAnAM dvaividhyAnmAMsAshinAmiti visheShaNaM, tena tRuNAdaprasahAnAM gavAdInAM niShedhaH| nanu prasahAH “gurUShNasnigdhamadhurA” (sU.a.27) ityannapAne uktaM, iha tu laghutIkShNetyAdinA kathaM lAghavamucyate teShAM? maivaM, bhojayellaghviti yojanAt; tena prasahAnAM madhye ye laghavasteShAM rasenAtra laghvannaM bhojayet| tIkShNetyAdinA prasahaguNAbhidhAnam| anye tu prasahAntarApekShayA ye prasahA laghavasteShamiha laghushabdenopAdAnam, tathA~anye amlAdiyogAt saMskAreNeha lAghavaM sAdhayanti; etena rAjayakShmacikitsite~api prasahaguNAstIkShNoShNalaghutvAdaya uktAste nyAyyA eva||206-210||-

nAbhojanenetyAdinA abhojanAtibhojananirAsaM kRutvA~annasamyakprayogasyAgnijanakatAmAha| abhojanenetyanenAbhojanamalpabhojanaM ca gRuhyate| alpo vA atIndhanAvRuto vA na dIpyate iti yojanA| sAradArvagniriti sAradArvAshrayo~agniH sAradArvagniH| snehavadannaM snehAnnam| mitamiti mAtrAvat, yadyapi ca hitamitAshino~api kAlaviparyayAdinA rogA bhavantyeva, tathA~api hitamitAshinAM nAhArajarogotpattirbhavatIti darshayati| ciramArogyamashnute iti AhArajarogaM na prApnotIti bhAvaH| avaiShamyeNa dhAtUnAmiti dhAtusAmyena kriyamANAyAmagnivRuddhau yateta; etena doShavaiShamyeNa pittodrekarUpeNa yA~agnivRuddhiratyagnirUpA, tAM niShedhayati| samairityAdinA~agnibhedAn samAgniparipAlanArthamAha| madhye iti nAtisamIpe| agnisa~jj~jita iti bhAShayA UShmArUpe jATharAgnau bAhyAgninA sAmyaM niShedhayati| doShairiti sAmAnyokte~api yogyatayA kaphapittavAtairyathAkramameva mandatIkShNaviShamatvAni j~jeyAni| vAcyamiti pratikriyArthaM vacanIyaM cikitsitamiti yAvat||211-216||-

pittaM pAvakasthAne kupitamiti sambandhaH| tacca pittaM mArutAnugatatvAdatyagnikaraM bhavati; evaM dharmabhedAdviruddhakAryakaraM j~jeyam| pittoShmarUpasyApi ca bahneH prAdeshikapittoShmaNo hAnijanakatvaM janyajanakayorbhedatvAdupapannameva j~jeyam| sthiratoyacarAnityanena sthiratoyacAriNAM niShkriyatayA gauravAtishayaM darshayati| tilavAtAmAdInAM dRuShadi piShTAnAmuShNodakamRuditA piNDA utkru~jcA ucyante, ‘utkArikA’ ityanye| ghanaM trisnehasaMyutamityatra ghanashabdena dadhyucyate| pAyasena pratibhojanaM yasmin pittaharaNe tat pAyasapratibhojanam| medyamiti meduraM medojanakaM vA| apratAnta iti abubhukShitaH| vyasanaM maraNamityarthaH | puShTimeva ca labhate iti yojyam||217-234||-

samprati prAguktasamashanAdilakShaNamAha- pathyApathyamityAdi| pathyApathyaM ki~jcidekatra militaM, yathA- raktashAlyannaM yavakAnnaM ca militam| bahubhuktamalpabhuktaM vA tathA~aprAptamatItakAlaM ca bhuktaM viShamamucyate| pUrvAnnetyAdi divA bhuktasyopari tadahareva punarbhujyate tadadhyashanaM; tanniShedhayannAha- prAtarAshe ityAdi| ashanamAsho bhojanamityarthaH| kasmAnna dUShyatItyAha- divetyAdi| sphuTatvamiti vivRutatvaM, vivRutatvAcca srotasAM srotobhirvahanena raso~avyAhatagatirbhavati, tatashca na kledaM srotAMsi yAnti; tathA vyAyAmAdibhishca shoShyamANAni na kledamupayAnti srotAMsi| vyAyAmo gamanAdiH, vihAraH a~ggakShepaNAdikA ceShTA| sroto~aklede kiM bhavatItyAha- aklinneShvityAdi| Asiktamiti prakShiptam| avidagdhe ityAdinA~atra dRuShTAntamAha| mlAne iti sa~gkucite| apakveShviti anyeShu| upasaMharati- naisheShvityAdinA| nAnyat samashnIyAditi yojanA||235-243||

antaragnirityAdinA adhyAyasa~ggrahaM brUte| ye~agnaya iti ‘bhaumApyAgneya ...’ ityAdinoktAH| yAMshceti ‘pa~jcAhAraguNAn’ ityAdyuktamarthaM sa~ggRuhNAti| puShyanti yAvanta iti ‘yathAsvaM svaM’ ityAdyuktaM sa~ggRuhNAti| ye pacanti yAniti ‘saptabhirdehadhAtAraH’ ityAdyuktasa~ggrahaH| AshukAritvena hetunA AshukRuddhetuH| sheShaM vyaktam||244-249||
athAtaH pANDurogacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

sarvAnnasevinaH sarve duShTA doShAstridoShajam| tridoShali~ggaM kurvanti pANDurogaM suduHsaham||26||

Commentary: sarvAnnetyAdinA sAnnipAtikaM vyAkaroti| tridoShali~ggamiti pratyekadoShali~ggasamudAyayuktam||26||
mRuttikAdanashIlasya kupyatyanyatamo malaH| kaShAyA mArutaM, pittamUSharA, madhurA kapham||27||
kopayenmRudrasAdIMshca raukShyAdbhuktaM virUkShayet | pUrayatyavipakvaiva srotAMsi niruNaddhi ca||28||
indriyANAM balaM hatvA tejo vIryaujasI tathA| pANDurogaM karotyAshu balavarNAgninAshanam||29||
shUnagaNDAkShikUTabhrUH shUnapAnnAbhimehanaH| krimikoShTho~atisAryeta malaM sAsRuk kaphAnvitam||30||
pANDurogashcirotpannaH kharIbhUto na sidhyati| kAlaprakarShAcchUno nA yashca pItAni pashyati||31||
baddhAlpaviTkaM sakaphaM haritaM yo~atisAryate| dInaH shvetAtidigdhA~ggashchardimUrcchAtRuShArditaH||32||
sa nAstyasRukkShayAdyashca pANDuH shvetatvamApnuyAt| iti pa~jcavidhasyoktaM pANDurogasya lakShaNam||33||
pANDurogI tu yo~atyarthaM pittalAni niShevate| tasya pittamasRugmAMsaM dagdhvA rogAya kalpate||34||
hAridranetraH sa bhRushaM hAridratva~gnakhAnanaH| raktapItashakRunmUtro bhekavarNo hatendriyaH||35||
dAhAvipAkadaurbalyasadanArucikarShitaH| kAmalA bahupittaiShA koShThashAkhAshrayA matA||36||
kAlAntarAt kharIbhUtA kRucchrA syAt kumbhakAmalA| kRuShNapItashakRunmUtro bhRushaM shUnashca mAnavaH||37||
saraktAkShimukhacchardiviNmUtro yashca tAmyati| dAhArucitRuShAnAhatandrAmohasamanvitaH||38||
sAdhyAnAmitareShAM tu pravakShyAmi cikitsitam||39||
tatra pANDvAmayI snigdhastIkShNairUrdhvAnulomikaiH| saMshodhyo mRudubhistiktaiH kAmalI tu virecanaiH||40||
tAbhyAM saMshuddhakoShThAbhyAM pathyAnyannAni dApayet| shAlIn sayavagodhUmAn purANAn yUShasaMhitAn||41||
mudgADhakImasUraishca jA~ggalaishca rasairhitaiH| yathAdoShaM vishiShTaM ca tayorbhaiShajyamAcaret||42||
pa~jcagavyaM mahAtiktaM kalyANakamathApi vA| snehanArthaM ghRutaM dadyAt kAmalApANDurogiNe||43||
dADimAt kuDavo dhAnyAt kuDavArdhaM palaM palam| citrakAcchRu~ggaverAcca pippalyaShTamikA tathA||44||
taiH kalkairviMshatipalaM ghRutasya salilADhake| siddhaM hRutpANDugulmArshaHplIhavAtakaphArtinut||45||
dIpanaM shvAsakAsaghnaM mUDhavAte ca shasyate| duHkhaprasavinInAM ca vandhyAnAM caiva garbhadam||46||
iti dADimAdyaM ghRutamkaTukA rohiNI mustaM haridre vatsakAt palam| paTolaM candanaM mUrvA trAyamANA durAlabhA||47||
kRuShNA parpaTako nimbo bhUnimbo devadAru ca| taiH kArShikairghRutaprasthaH siddhaH kShIracaturguNaH||48||
raktapittaM jvaraM dAhaM shvayathuM sa bhagandaram| arshAMsyasRugdaraM caiva hanti visphoTakAMstathA||49||
bIjakAriShTa ityeSha AtreyeNa prakIrtitaHiti bIjakAriShTaH

pANDurogAH smRutAH pa~jca vAtapittakaphaistrayaH| caturthaH sannipAtena pa~jcamo bhakShaNAnmRudaH||3||

Commentary: trishothIye yadyapi pANDurogaH pa~jcasa~gkhyAka uktastathA~apIha punastadanuvAdena sushrutoktacatuHsa~gkhyAtvaM niShedhayati| uktaM hi sushrute- “pANDvAmayo~aShTArdhavidhaH pradiShTaH pRuthaksamastairyugapa~jca doShaiH” (su.u.a.44) iti| tatra hi mRudbhakShaNajaH sannipAtaje evAvaruddhaH||3||

iti kaTukAdyaM ghRutam pathyAshatarase pathyAvRuntArdhashatakalkavAn| prasthaH siddho ghRutAt peyaH sa pANDvAmayagulmanut||50||

Commentary: pathyAshatena kvAthaH kartavyaH; atra ca tathA kvAthArthaM jalaM deyaM yathA caturbhAgAvashiShTaM sadghRutacaturguNaM bhavati; ata eva droNamAnaM jalaM deyam| pathyAvRuntArdhashataM harItakIphalabandhAnArdhashatam; anye tu pathyAvRuntacUrNaM harItakIphalasyaiva cUrNaM, tadasthishUnyamityAhuH||50||
iti haridrAdighRutam

iti pathyAghRutam dantyAshcatuShpalarase piShTairdantIshalATubhiH| tadvatprastho ghRutAtsiddhaH plIhapANDvartishophajit||51||

Commentary: dantItyAdau dantyAH kvAtho ghRutAccaturguNaH sthApyaH; tantrAntaradarshanAt prasthamAna evAtra kvAtho bhavati| uktaM hyanyatra- “nikumbhakuDavAkvAthe prasthe tatkalkasaMyutam| sarpiHprasthaM pacet plIhakAmalApANDuroganut” iti||51||

iti dantIghRutam purANasarpiShaH prastho drAkShArdhaprasthasAdhitaH| kAmalAgulmapANDvartijvaramehodarApahaH||52||

Commentary: purANetyAdau jalamanuktadravatvAdbhavati| drAkShAprasthArdhaM tu kalkaH||52||

iti drAkShAghRutam haridrAtriphalAnimbabalAmadhukasAdhitam| sakShIraM mAhiShaM sarpiH kAmalAharamuttamam||53||

Commentary: haridretyAdau dravAntarAbhAvAt kShIrameva caturguNam||53||

iti haridrAdighRutam gomUtre dviguNe dArvyAH kalkAkShadvayasAdhitaH| dArvyAH pa~jcapalakvAthe kalke kAlIyake paraH||54||

Commentary: dArvyAH kalkAkShadvayasAdhito mAhiShasarpiShaH prastha iti yojyam| dArvyAH pa~jcapalakvAthe ityatrApi pUrvaghRutAnusArAt pa~jcapaladArvIkvAtho~api ghRutAddviguNa eva kartavyaH| kAlIyakakalko~api pUrvavadakShadvayamAna eva| pUrvaH pUrve iti pUrve pANDuroge, dArvIkalkagomUtrasiddho ghRutaprasthaH; pare tu kAmalAkhye, paraH dArvIkvAthakAlIyakalkasiddhaH; ‘deyaH’ iti sheShaH||54||-
snehairebhirupakramya snigdhaM matvA virecayet||55||
payasA mUtrayuktena bahushaH kevalena vA| dantIphalarase koShNe kAshmaryA~jjalinA shRutam||56||
drAkShA~jjaliM mRuditvA vA dadyAt pANDvAmayApaham| dvisharkaraM trivRuccUrNaM palArdhaM paittikaH pibet||57||
kaphapANDustu gomUtraklinnayuktAM harItakIm| AragvadhaM rasenekShorvidAryAmalakasya ca||58||
satryUShaNaM bilvapatraM pibennA kAmalApaham| dantyardhapalakalkaM vA dviguDaM shItavAriNA||59||
kAmalI trivRutAM vA~api triphalAyA rasaiH pibet| vishAlAtriphalAmustakuShThadArukali~ggakAn||60||
kArShikAnardhakarShAMshAM kuryAdativiShAM tathA| karShau madhurasAyA dvau sarvametat sukhAmbunA||61||
mRuditaM taM rasaM pUtaM pItvA lihyAcca madhvanu| kAsaM shvAsaM jvaraM dAhaM pANDurogamarocakam||62||
gulmAnAhAmavAtAMshca raktapittaM ca nAshayet| triphalAyA guDUcyA vA dArvyA nimbasya vA rasam||63||
shItaM madhuyutaM prAtaH kAmalArtaH pibennaraH| kShIramUtraM pibet pakShaM gavyaM mAhiShameva vA||64||
pANDurgomUtrayuktaM vA saptAhaM triphalArasam| tarujAn jvalitAnmUtre nirvApyAmRudya cA~gkurAn||65||
mAtulu~ggasya tat pUtaM pANDushothaharaM pibet| svarNakShIrI trivRucchyAme bhadradAru sanAgaram||66||
gomUtrA~jjalinA piShTaM mUtre vA kvathitaM pibet| kShIramebhiH shRutaM vA~api pibeddoShAnulomanam||67||
harItakIM prayogeNa gomUtreNAthavA pibet| jIrNe kShIreNa bhu~jjIta rasena madhureNa vA||68||
saptarAtraM gavAM mUtre bhAvitaM vA~apyayorajaH| pANDurogaprashAntyarthaM payasA pAyayedbhiShak||69||
tryUShaNatriphalAmustaviDa~ggacitrakAH samAH| navAyorajaso bhAgAstaccUrNaM kShaudrasarpiShA||70||
bhakShayet pANDuhRudrogakuShThArshaHkAmalApaham| navAyasamidaM cUrNaM kRuShNAtreyeNa bhAShitam||71||
hantyeSha kAmalAM pittaM pANDuM kAsaM halImakamiti dhAtryavalehaH
iti navAyasacUrNam guDanAgaramaNDUratilAMshAnmAnataH samAn| pippalIdviguNAM kuryAdguTikAM pANDurogiNe||72||
tryUShaNaM triphalA mustaM viDa~ggaM cavyacitrakau| dArvItva~gmAkShiko dhAturgranthikaM devadAru ca||73||
etAn dvipalikAnbhAgAMshcUrNaM kuryAt pRuthak pRuthak| maNDUraM dviguNaM cUrNAcchuddhama~jjanasannibham||74||
gomUtre~aShTaguNe paktvA tasmiMstat prakShipettataH| udumbarasamAnkRutvA vaTakAMstAn yathAgni nA||75||
upayu~jjIta takreNa sAtmyaM jIrNe ca bhojanam| maNDUravaTakA hyete prANadAH pANDurogiNAm||76||
kuShThAnyajIrNakaM shothamUrustambhaM kaphAmayAn| arshAMsi kAmalAM mehaM plIhAnaM shamayanti ca||77||
iti maNDUravaTakAHtApyAdrijaturUpyAyomalAH pa~jcapalAH pRuthak| citrakatriphalAvyoShaviDa~ggaiH palikaiH saha||78||
sharkarAShTapalonmishrAshcUrNitA madhunA~a~aplutAH| abhyasyAstvakShamAtrA hi jIrNe hitamitAshinA||79||
triphalAyAstrayo bhAgAstrayastrikaTukasya ca||80||
doShAH pittapradhAnAstu yasya kupyanti dhAtuShu| shaithilyaM tasya dhAtUnAM gauravaM copajAyate||4||
tato varNabalasnehA ye cAnye~apyojaso guNAH| vrajanti kShayamatyarthaM doShadUShyapradUShaNAt||5||
so~alparakto~alpamedasko niHsAraH shithilendriyaH| vaivarNyaM bhajate, tasya hetuM shRuNu salakShaNam||6||
bhAgashcitrakamUlasya viDa~ggAnAM tathaiva ca| pa~jcAshmajatuno bhAgAstathA rUpyamalasya ca||81||
mAkShikasya ca shuddhasya lauhasya rajasastathA| aShTau bhAgAH sitAyAshca tatsarvaM sUkShmacUrNitam||82||
mAkShikeNAplutaM sthApyamAyase bhAjane shubhe| udumbarasamAM mAtrAM tataH khAdedyathAgni nA||83||
dine dine prayu~jjIta jIrNe bhojyaM yathepsitam| varjayitvA kulatthAni kAkamAcIM kapotakam||84||
yogarAja iti khyAto yogo~ayamamRutopamaH| rasAyanamidaM shreShThaM sarvarogaharaM shivam||85||
pANDurogaM viShaM kAsaM yakShmANaM viShamajvaram| kuShThAnyajIrNakaM mehaM shoShaM shvAsamarocakam||86||
visheShAddhantyapasmAraM kAmalAM gudajAni caiti yogarAjaH
visheShAddhantyapasmAraM kAmalAM gudajAni caiti yogarAjaH kauTajatriphalAnimbapaTolaghananAgaraiH||87||
bhAvitAni dashAhAni rasairdvitriguNAni vA| shilAjatupalAnyaShTau tAvatI sitasharkarA||88||
tvakkShIrI pippalI dhAtrI karkaTAkhyA palonmitA| nidigdhyAH phalamUlAbhyAM palaM yuktyA trigandhakam| cUrNitaM madhunaH kuryAt tripalenAkShikAn guDAn| dADimAmbupayaHpakShirasatoyasurAsavAn||90||
tAn bhakShayitvA~anupibenniranno bhukta eva vA| pANDukuShThajvaraplIhatamakArshobhagandarAn||91||
pUtihRucchukramUtrAgnidoShashoShagarodarAn | kAsAsRugdarapittAsRukshothagulmagalAmayAn||92||
te ca sarvavraNAn hanyuH sarvarogaharAH shivAHiti shilAjatuvaTakAHpunarnavA trivRudvyoShaviDa~ggaM dAru citrakam||93||
kuShThaM haridre triphalA dantI cavyaM kali~ggakAH| pippalI pippalImUlaM mustaM ceti palonmitam||94||
maNDUraM dviguNaM cUrNAdgomUtre dvyADhake pacet| kolavadguTikAH kRutvA takreNAloDya nA pibet||95||
tAH pANDurogAn plIhAnamarshAMsi viShamajvaram| shvayathuM grahaNIdoShaM hanyuH kuShThaM krimIMstathA||96||
iti punarnavAmaNDUramdArvItvak triphalA vyoShaM viDa~ggamayaso rajaH| madhusarpiryutaM lihyAt kAmalApANDurogavAn||97||
tulyA ayorajaHpathyAharidrAH kShaudrasarpiShA| cUrNitAH kAmalI lihyAdguDakShaudreNa vA~abhayAH||98||
triphalA dve haridre ca kaTurohiNyayorajaH| cUrNitaM kShaudrasarpirbhyAM sa lehaH kAmalApahaH||99||
dvipalAMshAM tugAkShIrIM nAgaraM madhuyaShTikAm| prAsthikIM pippalIM drAkShAM sharkarArdhatulAM shubhAm||100||
dhAtrIphalarasadroNe cUrNitaM lehavat pacet| shItaM madhuprasthayutaM lihyAt pANitalaM tataH||101||
hantyeSha kAmalAM pittaM pANDuM kAsaM halImakamiti dhAtryavalehaH tryUShaNaM triphalA cavyaM citrako devadAru ca||102||
viDa~ggAnyatha mustaM ca vatsakaM ceti cUrNayet| maNDUratulyaM taccUrNaM gomUtre~aShTaguNe pacet||103||
shanaiH siddhAstathA shItAH kAryAH karShasamA guDAH| yathAgni bhakShaNIyAste plIhapANDvAmayApahAH||104||
kAsahikkArucishvAsAMshcaiSho~ariShTaH praNAshayetiti dhAtryariShTaH
grahaNyarshonudashcaiva takravATyAshinaH smRutAHiti maNDUravaTakAH ma~jjiShThA rajanI drAkShA balAmUlAnyayorajaH||105||
lodhraM caiteShu gauDaH syAdariShTaH pANDurogiNAmiti gauDo~ariShTaHbIjakAtShoDashapalaM triphalAyAshca viMshatiH||106||
drAkShAyAH pa~jca lAkShAyAH sapta droNe jalasya tat| sAdhyaM pAdAvasheShe tu pUtasheShe samAvapet||107||
sharkarAyAstulAM prasthaM mAkShikasya ca kArShikam| vyoShaM vyAghranakhoshIraM kramukaM sailavAlukam||108||
madhukaM kuShThamityetaccUrNitaM ghRutabhAjane| yaveShu dasharAtraM tadgrIShme dviH shishire sthitam||109||
pibettadgrahaNIpANDurogArshaHshothagulmanut| mUtrakRucchrAshmarImehakAmalAsannipAtajit||110||
bIjakAriShTa ityeSha AtreyeNa prakIrtitaHiti bIjakAriShTaH dhAtrIphalasahasre dve pIDayitvA rasaM tu tam||111||
kShaudrAShTAMshena saMyuktaM kRuShNArdhakuDavena ca| sharkarArdhatulonmishraM pakShaM snigdhaghaTe sthitam||112||
prapibenmAtrayA prAtarjIrNe hitamitAshanaH| kAmalApANDuhRudrogavAtAsRugviShamajvarAn||113||
kShArAmlalavaNAtyuShNaviruddhAsAtmyabhojanAt| niShpAvamAShapiNyAkatilatailaniShevaNAt||7||
vidagdhe~anne divAsvapnAdvyAyAmAnmaithunAttathA| pratikarmartuvaiShamyAdvegAnAM ca vidhAraNAt||8||
kAmacintAbhayakrodhashokopahatacetasaH| samudIrNaM yadA pittaM hRudaye samavasthitam||9||
vAyunA balinA kShiptaM samprApya dhamanIrdasha| prapannaM kevalaM dehaM tva~gmAMsAntaramAshritam||10||
pradUShya kaphavAtAsRuktva~gmAMsAni karoti tat| pANDuhAridraharitAn varNAn bahuvidhAMstvaci||11||

... tasya li~ggaM bhaviShyataH| hRudayaspandanaM raukShyaM svedAbhAvaH shramastathA||12||

Commentary: tasyetyAdinA pUrvarUpamAha| ‘svedAbAdhaH’ iti kecit paThanti||12||

kAsahikkArucishvAsAMshcaiSho~ariShTaH praNAshayetiti dhAtryariShTaH sthirAdibhiH shRutaM toyaM pAnAhAre prashasyate||114||

Commentary: kAmalArtAnAM mRudvIkAmalakIrasaH pAnAhAre prashasyata ityarthaH||114||-
pANDurogaprashAntyarthamiti proktaM maharShiNA||115||
vikalpyametadbhiShajA pRuthagdoShabalaM prati| vAtike snehabhUyiShThaM, paittike tiktashItalam||116||
nipAtayeccharIrAttu mRuttikAM bhakShitAM bhiShak||117||
yuktij~jaH shodhanaistIkShNaiH prasamIkShya balAbalam| shuddhakAyasya sarpIMShi balAdhAnAni yojayet||118||
vyoShaM bilvaM haridre dve triphalA dve punarnave| mustAnyayorajaH pAThA viDa~ggaM devadAru ca||119||
vRushcikAlI ca bhArgI ca sakShIraistaiH samairghRutam| sAdhayitvA pibedyuktyA naro mRuddoShapIDitaH||120||
tadvat kesharayaShTyAhvapippalIkShArashAdvalaiH| mRudbhakShaNAdAturasya laulyAdavinivartinaH||121||
dveShyArthaM bhAvitAM kAmaM dadyAttaddoShanAshanaiH| vi~ggailAtiviShayA nimbapatreNa pAThayA||122||

yathAdoShaM prakurvIta bhaiShajyaM pANDurogiNAm||123||

Commentary: pANDurogoktaM doShavisheShacikitsitaM mRujje~apyatidishati- yathAdoShamityAdi| eSha iti mRujje pANDuroge proktaH||123||-
tilapiShTanibhaM yastu varcaH sRujati kAmalI||124||
shleShmaNA ruddhamArgaM tat pittaM kaphaharairjayet| rUkShashItagurusvAduvyAyAmairveganigrahaiH||125||
kaphasammUrcchito vAyuH sthAnAt pittaM kShipedbalI| hAridranetramUtratvak shvetavarcAstadA naraH||126||
bhavet sATopaviShTambho guruNA hRudayena ca| daurbalyAlpAgnipArshvArtihikkAshvAsArucijvaraiH||127||
barhitittiridakShANAM rUkShAmlaiH kaTukai rasaiH||128||
shuShkamUlakakaulatthairyUShaishcAnnAni bhojayet| mAtulu~ggarasaM kShaudrapippalImaricAnvitam||129||
kaTutIkShNoShNalavaNairbhRushAmlaishcApyupakramaH||130||
ApittarAgAcchakRuto vAyoshcAprashamAdbhavet| svasthAnamAgate pitte purIShe pittara~jjite||131||
yadA tu pANDorvarNaH syAddharitashyAvapItakaH||132||
balotsAhakShayastandrA mandrAgnitvaM mRudujvaraH| strIShvaharSho~a~ggamardashca shvAsastRuShNA~arucirbhramaH||133||
guDUcIsvarasakShIrasAdhitaM mAhiShaM ghRutam||134||
sa pibettrivRutAM snigdho rasenAmalakasya tu| virikto madhuraprAyaM bhajet pittAnilApaham||135||
drAkShAlehaM ca pUrvoktaM sarpIMShi madhurANi ca| yApanAn kShIrabastIMshca shIlayetsAnuvAsanAn||136||
mArdvIkAriShTayogAMshca pibedyuktyA~agnivRuddhaye| kAsikaM cAbhayAlehaM pippalIM madhukaM balAm||137||
tatra shlokau- pANDoH pa~jcavidhasyoktaM hetulakShaNabheShajam||138||
kAmalA dvividhA teShAM sAdhyAsAdhyatvameva ca| teShAM vikalpo yashcAnyo mahAvyAdhirhalImakaH| tasya coktaM samAsena vya~jjanaM sacikitsitam||139||
sambhUte~asmin bhavet sarvaH karNakShveDI hatAnalaH| durbalaH sadano~annadviT shramabhramanipIDitaH||13||
gAtrashUlajvarashvAsagauravArucimAnnaraH| mRuditairiva gAtraishca pIDitonmathitairiva||14||
shUnAkShikUTo haritaH shIrNalomA hataprabhaH| kopanaH shishiradveShI nidrAluH ShThIvano~alpavAk||15||
piNDikodveShTakaTyUrupAdaruksadanAni ca| bhavantyArohaNAyAsairvisheShashcAsya vakShyate||16||
AhArairupacAraishca vAtalaiH kupito~anilaH| janayetkRuShNapANDutvaM tathA rUkShAruNA~ggatAm||17||
a~ggamardaM rujaM todaM kampaM pArshvashirorujam| varcaHshoShAsyavairasyashophAnAhabalakShayAn||18||
pittalasyAcitaM pittaM yathoktaiH svaiH prakopaNaiH| dUShayitvA tu raktAdIn pANDurogAya kalpate||19||
sa pIto haritAbho vA jvaradAhasamanvitaH| tRuShNAmUrcchApipAsArtaH pItamUtrashakRunnaraH||20||
svedanaH shItakAmashca na cAnnamabhinandati| kaTukAsyo na cAsyoShNamupashete~amlameva ca||21||
udgAro~amlo vidAhashca vidagdhe~anne~asya jAyate| daurgandhyaM bhinnavarcastvaM daurbalyaM tama eva ca||22||
vivRuddhaH shleShmalaiH shleShmA pANDurogaM sa pUrvavat| karoti gauravaM tandrA chardiM shvetAvabhAsatAm||23||
prasekaM lomaharShaM ca sAdaM mUrcchAM bhramaM klamam| shvAsaM kAsaM tathA~a~alasyamaruciM vAksvaragraham||24||
shuklamUtrAkShivarcastvaM kaTurUkShoShNakAmatAm| shvayathuM madhurAsyatvamiti pANDvAmayaH kaphAt||25||

grahaNIdoShacikitsite kriyAmANe tIkShNAdinA pittajananAdgrahaNIcikitsitAnantaraM pittapradhAnapANDurogacikitsitamucyate| pANDunA vakShyamANaharitAdivarNebhyaH pradhAnena varNenopalakShito rogaH pANDurogaH| uktaM hi sushrute- “sarveShu caiteShu hi pANDubhAvo yato~adhiko~ataH khalu pANDurogaH” (su.u.a.44) iti| kAmalA-halImakAdicikitsA ca pANDurogabhedatvAdeva teShAmiha vaktavyA; kiMvA ‘pANDurogAdInAM cikitsitaM pANDurogacikitsitam’ iti parigrahAt kAmalAdicikitsitamapi pratij~jAtameva||1-2||

mRuttiketyAdinA mRudbhakShaNajamAha| atra ca doShasambandhe satyapi mRudeva vyapadeshikA na doShAH, tasyA eva cikitsAbhedali~ggabhedakartRutvAt| kaShAyA mArutamityAdinA mRudo~api vAtAdigatali~ggaM darshayati| UShareti kShArAnurasA| rasAdIn bhuktaM ca virUkShayediti yojyam| avipakvaiveti svarUpAvasthitaiva kevalaM srotAMsi pUrayati ruNaddhi ca; srotovirodhena rasAdInAM na samyagbalaM bhavati| balavarNAgninAshanamityanena balAdihAniM darshayati||27-30||
pANDuroga ityAdinA~asAdhyalakShaNamAha| kharIbhUta iti atyartharUkShaH| kAletyAdinA~aparamasAdhyalakShaNam| shvetAtidigdhA~gga iti shvetavarNaliptA~gga ityarthaH||31-33||

pANDurogItyAdinA kAmalAmAha| pANDurogIti vacanAt pANDurogasyaiva hetuvisheSheNa kAmalAdirUpA~avasthA utpadyate; ata eva ca hArIte kAmalAdInAmapi pANDurogatvamevoktam| vacanaM hi- “vAtena pittena kaphena caiva tridoShamRudbhakShaNasambhave ca| dve kAmale caiva halImakashca smRuto~aShTadhaivaM khalu pANDurogaH” iti; anyA tu sushrutoktA kAmalA bhinnA bhavati, “yo hyAmayAnte sahasA~amlamannamadyAdapathyAnyapi tasya pittam| karoti pANDuM vadanaM visheShAt pUrveritau tandribalakShayau ca” (su. u. a. 44) ityAdinA pRuthakkAmalAheturuktaH; vAgbhaTe~api- “bhavet pittolbaNasyAsau pANDurogAdRute~api ca” (vA. ni. a. 13) iti; iha tu pANDuroge~api bhavet pANDurogAdvinA~api bhavet, yathA pramehAshritAH piDikAH prameheShu bhavanti vinA pramehamapi bhavanti; tathA pANDurogiNo~apyuktA kAmalA pRuthagapi bhavati| koShThashAkhAshrayA bahupittA pANDurogapUrvikA bhavati, yA tu kevalaM shAkhAshrayA alpapittA ca vaktavyA sA svatantrA~api bhavatIti kecit, ata eva tasyA rUkShashItetyAdinA pRuthageva hetuM li~ggaM cAdhyAyasheShe vakShyati| bahupittetyanena kevalaM shAkhAshrayAyA alpapittatvaM sUcayati; amlakaTutIkShNopayogaM shAkhAshrayipittasya koShThAnayanArthaM vakShyati| kharIbhUteti kaThoratAmupagatA| kumbhakAmaleti avasthAbhedena koShThagatakAmalAyAH sa~jj~jA; kumbhaH koShThaH, tadAshrayA kAmalA kumbhakAmalA| asyAM ca shotho~api lakShaNaM bhavati| uktaM hi sushrute- “bhedastu tasyAH khalu kumbhasAhvaH shotho mahAMstatra ca parvabhedaH” (su. u. a. 44) iti||34-38||-

tatretyAdinA cikitsAmAha| UrdhvAnulomikairityanena UrdhvaharAnulomanavamanavirecanayorapi grahaNamuktaM; yataH pANDuroge~api “kaphapANDustu gomUtraklinnayuktAM harItakIm” ityAdinA virecanaM vakShyati| tAbhyAmiti pANDurogakAmalAbhyAm| ‘tAbhyAM saMshuddhakoShThAya’ iti pAThapakShe tAbhyAmiti vamanavirecanAbhyAm| vishiShTamityAdi vishiShTabhaiShajyamihaiva kAmalAyAM pANDuroge ca vakShyamANaM j~jeyam||39-43||
dADimetyAdau aShTamikA dvikarShamuktam| uktaM hi- “dve suvarNe palArdhaM syAcchuktiraShTamikA~api ca” (ka.a.12) iti||44-49||

kAshmaryaM gambhArIphalam| shRutamiti phANTakaShAyavidhinA prakShiptaM, drAkShA~jjaliM mRuditvetyanena sphuTameva phANTakaShAyaM darshayati| dvisharkaramityAdau trivRuccUrNaM palArdhaM dvisharkarayuktaM sat sArdhapalamAnaM bhavati| gomUtraklinnayuktAmiti gomUtreNa klinnAM kalkIkRutAM tathA gomUtreNa yuktAmAloDitAM pibet| anye tu Aragvadharasena harItakIM pibediti yojayanti, ikShvAdirasena satrikaTuM bilvapatraM pibediti yojayanti| AragvadhaM satrikaTukaM vidAryA Amalakasya ca rasena pibedityaparo~arthaH| vishAletyAdau phANTakaShAyavaddravyAt palamAnAt catuShpalaM dravaM vadanti vRuddhAH||55-69||
navAyorajaso bhAga iti ekabhAgApekShayA navaguNatvamayorajasaH; tena tryUShaNAdInAM militAnAM cUrNena samamayorajaH||70-71||
maNDUraM purANaM lohakiTTam||72-79||-

doShA ityAdinA samprAptimAha| pittaM pradhAnaM yayoste pittapradhAnAH; bahuvacanaM ca vyaktibahutvApekShayA, natu pAramArthikam| gauravaM kriyAsvasAmarthyAt; gauravaM pANDurogiNo niHsAradhAtutvAditi bruvate| ojaso guNA iti ojaso raktadhAturUpasya ye guNAH; kiMvA ojasa eva ye dashaguNAH kShIrasamAnA uktAste j~jeyAH| ojasaH kShayenaiva snehakShaye labdhe punaH snehakShayAbhidhAnaM visheShakShayAbhidhAnArtham| doShairdUShyANAM prakRuShTAddUShaNAditi doShadUShyapradUShaNAt| niHsAraH apagatadhAtusAraH; “aShTau sArAH” (vi.a.8) ityAdinA proktasAravirahita ityarthaH| shithilendriyaH durbalendriyaH| sa iti pumAn| yadyapi raktapittayorekayonitvAt pitteneha raktavRuddhirbhAvyA, tathA~apIha raktakShayo raktapoShakarasasya pittena kShapaNAd raktapoShakasArabhAgAnutpAdAcca| yadyapi pittaM tejorUpatayA varNakaramihocyate, yaduktaM- “tejodhAturapyudakAntarIkShadhAtuprAyo~avadAtavarNakaraH” (shA.a.8) iti, tathA~api vikRutatvAt pittamiha vikRutavarNakRudeva bhavati||4-6||

triphaletyAdau raupyamalaM rUpyasya yat kiTTaM bhavati tajj~jeyam| mAkShikasyeti mAkShikadhAtoH| ashmajatvAdInAM caturNAM pa~jcabhAgAH pratyekaM; kiMvA pa~jcAshmajatuno bhAgAH, tathA rUpyamalasya ceti rUpyamalasyeti shilAjatuvisheShaNaM; tena rUpyamalarUpaM yaduktaM shilAjatu “rAjataM kaTukaM” (ci.a.1,pA.3) ityAdinA, tadiha gRuhyate||80-86||-

bhAvitAnItyAdi| dviguNatriguNadashAhAni bhAvitAni| rasairiti kauTajAdikvAthaiH| kauTajaM kuTajaphalam| atra bhAvanA shilAjatUktenaiva vidhinA kartavyA; kvAthyakvAthamAne ca tantrAntaraM- “tulyaM girijena jale caturguNe bhAvanauShadhaM kvAthyam| tatkvAthe pAdAMshe pUtoShNe prakShipedgirijam|| tatsamarasatAM yAtaM saMshuShkaM prakShipedrase bhUyaH” iti; evaM cAnyatrApi bhAvanAvidhau kvAthyakkAthamAnau j~jeyau| phalamUlAbhyAM palamiti militvA palam| yuktyA trigandhakamiti yAvatA trigandhena sAdhugandho bhavati tAvanmAtraM trigandhaM j~jeyaM; trigandhaM ca patratvagelA ucyante, “trigandhaM tu samAkhyAtaM tvagelApatrakaiH samaiH| tadeva tu samAkhyAtaM cAturjAtaM sakesaram” iti| pUtyAdibhirdoShashabdaH pratyekaM sambadhyate||87-99||
dvipalAMshAmityAdau drAkShA prAsthikI| dhAtrIphalarasaH dhAtrIsvarasaH||100-101||-

tryUShaNAdInAmaShTAviMshatipalAni, maNDUraM ca dviguNaM, samuditaM cUrNaM caturadhikAshItipalamAnaM bhavati| pRuthagiti pAThAnmaNDUracUrNameva pRutha~gmUtre paktavyaM, tasmin sidhyati tryUShaNAdInAM cUrNaM prakShepyam| shuddhamitipadena maNDUrasya dhmApanagomUtranirvApaNAdinA shuddhiM darshayati| kecittu gomUtramaShTaguNaM pratyAsannamaNDUrAdeva vadanti; ayameva pakShaH sAdhu pratibhAti||102-104||-
bIjakAt ShoDashapalamityatra kecit ‘dvirbIjakapalAnyaShTau’ iti paThanti, tatrApi sa evArthaH| bIjakaH asanaH| vyAghranakhaH nakhIbheda eva| dviH shishire iti viMshatirAtrasthitam||105-110||-
dhAtrItyAdau dhAtrIphalasahasradvayasya svarasa eva grAhyaH||111-113||-

kShAretyAdinA samAnaM hetumAha| niShpAvaH shimbaH| vyAyAmamaithune vidagdhe~anne eva kriyamANe rogahetunI| pratikarmaNAM vamanAdInAmRutUnAM ca vaiShamyaM pratikarmartuvaiShamyam| dhamanIrdasha iti hRudayAshritA dasha dhamanIH| kevalamiti kRutsnam| ‘pradUShya kaphavAtAsRuk’ iti pAThe vikShiptasya vAyoH pittena dUShaNaM, yadA tu ‘kaphapittAsRuk’ iti pAThastadA pittena hRudayasthena sthAnAntarasthasya pittasya duShTirjeyA| samudIrNamityAdinA ceyaM samprAptiH pUrvoktasAmAnyasamprAptereva prapa~jcaH||7-11||-
vikalpyamityanenoktaM vikalpavidhimAha- vAtike ityAdi||115-116||-

nipAtayedityAdinA mRujjapANDurogacikitsAmAha| shAdvalaM dUrvA| mRudbhakShaNAdavinivartinaH saktasyetyarthaH| bhAvitAmiti taddoShanAshanairdravyaiH saMskRutAm| mUrvayA~api vetyanto granthaH pUrveNa sambadhyate||117-122||-

tilapiShTanibhamityAdinA shAkhAshrayakAmalAcikitsitaM lakShaNapUrvakamAha| shleShmaNA ruddhamArgamiti koShThasthena shleShmaNA shAkhAshrayi pittaM kAmalAjanakaM ruddhamArgaM koShThagamanArthaM niShiddhamArgamiti yAvat| etadeva rUkShetyAdinA vistareNAha| shvetavarcA iti koShThasthapittasya malara~jjakasya bahirnirgamAdvRuddhena shleShmaNA shvetavarcA bhavati| krameNeti jvarAntairanuShajjate| alpe pitte shAkhAshrite iti sambandhaH||124-127||-

barhItyAdinA kaphaharaM pittavRuddhikaraM ca samaM cikitsitaM prAha, yataH shAkhAshrayadoShasya vRuddhiH koShThAnayanArtham; uktaM hi- “vRuddhyA~abhiShyandanAt pAkAt srotomukhavishodhanAt| shAkhAM muktvA malAH koShThaM yAnti vAyoshca nigrahAt” (sU.a.28) iti||128-129||-
ApittarAgAcchakRuta iti yAvat koShThamArgastho malo na ra~jjate tAvat pittavardhanam| pUrva iti pUrvoktaH| kAmaliko vidhiriti koShThAshrayikAmalAcikitsitaM kartavyamityarthaH||130-131||-

yadetyAdinA halImakamAha| ayameva tantrAntare lAghavasa~jj~jayA alasasa~jj~jayA cocyate| uktaM hi sushrute- “jvarA~ggamardabhramadAhatandrAkShayAnvito lAghavako~alasashca| taM vAtapittAddharipItanIlaM halImakaM kecidudAharanti” (su.u.a.44) iti| yaccApi tatra bhinnavarcastvaM sA cApi kAmalAvasthaiva na pRuthagrogaH| uktaM hi tantrAntare- “santApo bhinnavarcastvaM bahirante ca pInatA| pANDutA netrarAgashca pAnakIlakShaNaM matam” iti||132-133||-

guDUcItyAdinA halImakacikitsAmAha| drAkShAlehaM ca pUrvoktamiti ‘dvipalAMshAM tugAkShIrI’ ityAdigranthoktamihaiva| yApanAbastayaH siddhisthAne proktAH| kAsikaM cAbhayAlehamiti agastyaharItakIm||134-137||-
pANDoH pashcavidhasyetyAdinA sa~ggrahamAha| sa ca vyakta eva||138-139||

sambhUte~asminniti utpanne pANDuroge| karNakShveDItyAdi sAmAnyaM lakShaNaM; karNakShveDI karNanAdavAn| annadviDityanena annAgraha ucyate, arucimAnityanena prArthitAnnabhakShaNAsAmarthyamucyate| shishiradveShIti shItadveShI; shishiradveShitA ca pittaroge~apyasmin rogamahimnA bhavati| piNDikodveShTanaM piNDikApIDA| ArohaNenAyAsairiti kecidvibhAgaM varNayanti| visheShashcAsya vakShyate iti pANDurogasya vAtajatvAdivisheShagato hetuli~ggavisheSho vakShyata ityarthaH||13-16||
AhArairityAdinA vAtajasya hetulakShaNe prAha| sAmAnyalakShaNAni sarvatra bhavanti, visheShalakShaNaistu visheShAvagatiH||17-18||

pittalasyetyAdinA paittikamAha| sarvo~api pANDurogaH pittajaH, tathA~apyayaM visheSheNa doShAntarAsampRuktaprabalapittajanyatvAt paittika ityucyate; yathA paittikaM raktapittam; ata evAtra pittAtiprabalatopadarshanArthaM pittalasyetyanena pittaprakRutitA~api kAraNatvenoktA, nAnyatra ‘vAtalasya, shleShmalasya’ iti vA kRutam| yathoktairiti yo hyamletyAdinoktairihaiva| raktAdIniti raktaprakArAn, tena balavAtAdInAmapi grahaNam| tRuShNAmUrcchApipAsArta ityatra tRuShNAnimittA mUrcchA tRuShNAmUrcchA, tena pipAsayA samaM na paunaruktyam; anye tu tRuShNAmiha kShudhAmAhuH, kecit ‘tRuShNAmUrcchAparItasya’ iti paThanti||19-22||
vivRuddha ityAdinA kaphajamAha| pUrvavaditi raktAdIn sandUShya||23-25||
athAto hikkAshvAsacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
vedalokArthatattvaj~jamAtreyamRuShimuttamam| apRucchat saMshayaM dhImAnagniveshaH kRutA~jjaliH||3||
ya ime dvividhAH proktAstridoShAstriprakopaNAH| rogA nAnAtmakAsteShAM kasko bhavati durjayaH||4||
agniveshasya tadvAkyaM shrutvA matimatAM varaH| uvAca paramaprItaH paramArthavinishcayam||5||
kAmaM prANaharA rogA bahavo na tu te tathA| yathA shvAsashca hikkA ca prANAnAshu nikRuntataH||6||
anyairapyupasRuShTasya rogairjantoH pRuthagvidhaiH| ante sa~jjAyate hikkA shvAso vA tIvravedanaH||7||
sahasA~atyabhyavahRutaiH pAnAnnaiH pIDito~anilaH| UrdhvaM prapadyate koShThAnmadyairvA~atimadapradaiH||38||
tathA~atiroShabhAShyAdhvahAsyabhArAtivartanaiH| vAyuH koShThagato dhAvan pAnabhojyaprapIDitaH||39||
uraHsrotaH samAvishya kuryAddhikkAM tato~annajAm| tathA shanairasambandhaM kShuvaMshcApi sa hikkate||40||
na marmabAdhAjananI nendriyANAM prabAdhinI| hikkA pIte tathA bhukte shamaM yAti ca sA~annajA||41||
iti kShudrahikkA
atisa~jcitadoShasya bhaktacchedakRushasya ca| vyAdhibhiH kShINadehasya vRuddhasyAtivyavAyinaH||42||
AsAM yA sA samutpannA hikkA hantyAshu jIvitam| yamikA ca pralApArtitRuShNAmohasamanvitA||43||
akShINashcApyadInashca sthiradhAtvindriyashca yaH| tasya sAdhayituM shakyA yamikA hantyato~anyathA||44||

yadA srotAMsi saMrudhya mArutaH kaphapUrvakaH| viShvagvrajati saMruddhastadA shvAsAnkaroti saH||45||

Commentary: yadetyAdinA shvAsasamprAptimAha| srotAMsIti prakRutatvAt prANodakavAhIni srotAMsi| kaphapUrvaka iti kaphapradhAnaH| viShvagvrajati sarvato gacchati||45||
uddhUyamAnavAto yaH shabdavahuHkhito naraH| uccaiH shvasiti saMruddho mattarShabha ivAnisham||46||
pranaShTaj~jAnavij~jAnastathA vibhrAntalocanaH| vikRutAkShyAnano baddhamUtravarcA vishIrNavAk||47||
dInaH prashvasitaM cAsya dUrAdvij~jAyate bhRusham| mahAshvAsopasRuShTaH sa kShiprameva vipadyate||48||
iti vyapetA hikkA
dIrghaM shvasiti yastUrdhvaM na ca pratyAharatyadhaH| shleShmAvRutamukhasrotAH kruddhagandhavahArditaH||49||
UrdhvadRuShTirvipashyaMshca vibhrAntAkSha itastataH| pramuhyan vedanArtashca shuShkAsyo~aratipIDitaH||50||
UrdhvashvAse prakupite hyadhaHshvAso nirudhyate| muhyatastAmyatashcordhvaM shvAsastasyaiva hantyasUn||51||
yastu shvasiti vicchinnaM sarvaprANena pIDitaH| na vA shvasiti duHkhArto marmacchedarugarditaH||52||
AnAhasvedamUrcchArto dahyamAnena bastinA| viplutAkShaH parikShINaH shvasan raktaikalocanaH||53||
vicetAH parishuShkAsyo vivarNaH pralapannaraH| chinnashvAsena vicchinnaH sa shIghraM prajahAtyasUn||54||
pratilomaM yadA vAyuH srotAMsi pratipadyate| grIvAM shirashca sa~ggRuhya shleShmANaM samudIrya ca||55||
karoti pInasaM tena ruddho ghurghurukaM tathA| atIva tIvravegaM ca shvAsaM prANaprapIDakam||56||
pratAmyatyativegAcca kAsate sannirudhyate| pramohaM kAsamAnashca sa gacchati muhurmuhuH||57||
shleShmaNyamucyamAne tu bhRushaM bhavati duHkhitaH| tasyaiva ca vimokShAnte muhUrtaM labhate sukham||58||
athAsyoddhvaMsate kaNThaH kRucchrAcchaknoti bhAShitum| na cApi nidrAM labhate shayAnaH shvAsapIDitaH||59||
pArshve tasyAvagRuhNAti shayAnasya samIraNaH| AsIno labhate saukhyamuShNaM caivAbhinandati||60||
ucchritAkSho lalATena svidyatA bhRushamartimAn| vishuShkAsyo muhuH shvAso muhushcaivAvadhamyate||61||
meghAmbushItaprAgvAtaiH shleShmalaishcAbhivardhate| sa yApyastamakashvAsaH sAdhyo vA syAnnavotthitaH||62||
iti tamakashvAsaH
jvaramUrcchAparItasya vidyAt pratamakaM tu tam| udAvartarajo~ajIrNaklinnakAyanirodhajaH||63||
tamasA vardhate~atyarthaM shItaishcAshu prashAmyati| majjatastamasIvA~asya vidyAt santamakaM tu tam||64||
iti manaHshilAdighRutam
rUkShAyAsodbhavaH koShThe kShudro vAta udIrayan| kShudrashvAso na so~atyarthaM duHkhenA~ggaprabAdhakaH||65||
hinasti na sa gAtrANi na ca duHkho yathetare| na ca bhojanapAnAnAM niruNaddhyucitAM gatim||66||
nendriyANAM vyathAM nApi kA~jcidApAdayedrujam| sa sAdhya ukto balinaH sarve cAvyaktalakShaNAH||67||
eShAM prANaharA varjyA ghorAste hyAshukAriNaH||68||
bheShajaiH sAdhyayApyAMstu kShipraM bhiShagupAcaret| upekShitA daheyurhi shuShkaM kakShamivAnalaH||69||
kaphavAtAtmakAvetau pittasthAnasamudbhavau| hRudayasya rasAdInAM dhAtUnAM copashoShaNau||8||
tasmAt sAdhAraNAvetau matau paramadurjayau| mithyopacaritau kruddhau hata AshIviShAviva||9||
kAraNasthAnamUlaikyAdekameva cikitsitam| dvayorapi yathAdRuShTamRuShibhistannibodhata||70||
hikkAshvAsArditaM snigdhairAdau svedairupAcaret| AktaM lavaNatailena nADIprastarasa~gkaraiH||71||
tairasya grathitaH shleShmA srotaHsvabhivilIyate| khAni mArdavamAyAnti tato vAtAnulomatA||72||
yathA~adriku~jjeShvarkAMshutaptaM viShyandate himam| shleShmA taptaH sthiro dehe svedairviShyandate tathA||73||
svinnaM j~jAtvA tatastUrNaM bhojayet snigdhamodanam| matsyAnAM shUkarANAM vA rasairdadhyuttareNa vA||74||
tataH shleShmaNi saMvRuddhe vamanaM pAyayettu tam| pippalIsaindhavakShaudrairyuktaM vAtAvirodhi yat||75||
nirhRute sukhamApnoti sa kaphe duShTavigrahe| srotaHsu ca vishuddheShu caratyavihato~anilaH||76||
lInashceddoShasheShaH syAddhUmaistaM nirharedbudhaH| haridrAM patrameraNDamUlaM lAkShAM manaHshilAm||77||
udAvarte tathA~a~adhmAne mAtulu~ggAmlavetasaiH| hi~ggupIlubiDaishcAnnaM yuktaM syAdanulomanam||87||
madhUcchiShTaM sarjarasaM ghRutaM mallakasampuTe| kRutvA dhUmaM pibecchRu~ggaM bAlaM vA snAyu vA gavAm||79||
syonAkavardhamAnAnAM nADIM shuShkAM kushasya vA| padmakaM gugguluM lohaM shallakIM vA ghRutAplutam||80||

svarakShINAtisArAsRukpittadAhAnubandhajAn| madhurasnigdhashItAdyairhikkAshvAsAnupAcaret||81||

Commentary: shItAdyairityAdishabdena pittaharapicchilAdigrahaNam||81||
na svedyAH pittadAhArtA raktasvedAtivartinaH| kShINadhAtubalA rUkShA garbhiNyashcApi pittalAH||82||
koShNaiH kAmamuraHkaNThaM snehasekaiH sasharkaraiH| utkArikopanAhaishca svedayen mRudubhiH kShaNam||83||
tilomAmAShagodhUmacUrNairvAtaharaiH saha| snehaishcotkArikA sAmlaiH sakShIrairvA kRutA hitA||84||
navajvarAmadoSheShu rUkShasvedaM vila~gghanam| samIkShyollekhanaM vA~api kArayellavaNAmbunA||85||
atiyogoddhataM vAtaM dRuShTvA vAtaharairbhiShak| rasAdyairnAtishItoShNairabhya~ggaishca shamaM nayet||86||
hikkAshvAsAmayI hyeko balavAn durbalo~aparaH| kaphAdhikastathaivaiko rUkSho bahvanilo~aparaH||88||
kakAdhike balasthe ca vamanaM savirecanam| kuryAt pathyAshine dhUmalehAdishamanaM tataH||89||
vAtikAn durbalAn bAlAn vRuddhAMshcAnilasUdanaiH| tarpayedeva shamanaiH snehayUSharasAdibhiH||90||
anutkliShTakaphAsvinnadurbalAnAM vishodhanAt| vAyurlabdhAspado marma saMshoShyAshu haredasUn||91||
dRuDhAn bahukaphAMstasmAdrasairAnUpavArijaiH| tRuptAnvishodhayetsvinnAn bRuMhayeditarAn bhiShak||92||
barhitittiridakShAshca jA~ggalAshca mRugadvijAH| dashamUlIrase siddhAH kaulatthe vA rase hitAH||93||
nidigdhikAM bilvamadhyaM karkaTAkhyAM durAlabhAm| trikaNTakaM guDUcIM ca kulatthAMshca sacitrakAn||94||
jale paktvA rasaH pUtaH pippalIghRutabharjitaH| sanAgaraH salavaNaH syAdyUSho bhojane hitaH||95||
rAsnAM balAM pa~jcamUlaM hrasvaM mudgAn sacitrakAn| paktvA~ambhasi rase tasmin yUShaH sAdhyashca pUrvavat||96||
pallavAnmAtulu~ggasya nimbasya kulakasya ca| paktvA mudgAMshca savyoShAn kShArayUShaM vipAcayet||97||
dattvA salavaNaM kShAraM shigrUNi maricAni ca| yuktyA saMsAdhito yUSho hikkAshvAsavikAranut||98||
kAsamardakapatrANAM yUShaH shobhA~jjanasya ca| shuShkamUlakayUShashca hikkAshvAsanivAraNaH||99||
sadadhivyoShasarpiShko yUSho vArtAkajo hitaH| shAliShaShTikagodhUmayavAnnAnyanavAni ca||100||
hi~ggusauvarcalAjAjIbiDapauShkaracitrakaiH| siddhA karkaTashRu~ggyA ca yavAgUH shvAsahikkinAm||101||
dashamUlIshaTIrAsnApippalImUlapauShkaraiH| shRu~ggItAmalakIbhArgIguDUcInAgarAmbubhiH||102||
yavAgUM vidhinA siddhAM kaShAyaM vA pibennaraH| kAsahRudgrahapArshvArtihikkAshvAsaprashAntaye||103||
puShkarAhvashaTIvyoShamAtulu~ggAmlavetasaiH| yojayedannapAnAni sasarpirbiDahi~ggubhiH||104||
dashamUlasya vA kvAthamathavA devadAruNaH| tRuShito madirAM vA~api hikkAshvAsI pibennaraH||105||
pAThAM madhurasAM rAsnAM saralaM devadAru ca| prakShAlya jarjarIkRutya surAmaNDe nidhApayet||106||
taM mandalavaNaM kRutvA bhiShak prasRutasammitam| pAyayettu tato hikkA shvAsashcaivopashAmyati||107||
hi~ggu sauvarcalaM kolaM sama~ggAM pippalIM balAm| mAtulu~ggarase piShTamAranAlena vA pibet||108||
sauvarcalaM nAgaraM ca bhArgIM dvisharkarAyutam| uShNAmbunA pibedetaddhikkAshvAsavikAranut||109||
bhArgInAgarayoH kalkaM maricakShArayostathA| pItadrucitrakAsphotAmUrvANAM cAmbunA pibet||110||
madhUlikA tugAkShIrI nAgaraM pippalI tathA| utkArikA ghRute siddhA shvAse pittAnubandhaje||111||
shvAvidhaM shashamAMsaM ca shallakasya ca shoNitam| pippalIghRutasiddhAni shvAse vAtAnubandhaje||112||
suvarcalAraso dugdhaM ghRutaM trikaTukAnvitam| shAlyodanasyAnupAnaM vAtapittAnuge hitam||113||
shirIShapuShpasvarasaH saptaparNasya vA punaH| pippalImadhusaMyuktaH kaphapittAnuge mataH||114||
madhukaM pippalImUlaM guDo goshvashakRudrasaH | ghRutaM kShaudraM kAsashvAsahikkAbhiShyandinAM shubham||115||
kharAshvoShTravarAhANAM meShasya ca gajasya ca| shakRudrasaM bahukaphe caikaikaM madhunA pibet||116||
kShAraM cApyashvagandhAyA lihyAnnA kShaudrasarpiShA| mayUrapAdanAlaM vA shakalaM shallakasya vA||117||
shvAvijjANDakacAShANAM romANi kurarasya vA| shRu~ggyekadvishaphAnAM vA carmAsthIni khurAMstathA||118||
sarvANyekaikasho vA~api dagdhvA kShaudraghRutAnvitam| cUrNaM lIDhvA jayet kAsaM hikkAM shvAsaM ca dAruNam||119||
ete hi kaphasaMruddhagatiprANaprakopajAH | tasmAttanmArgashuddhyarthaM deyA lehA na niShkaphe||120||
kAsine cchardanaM dadyAt svarabha~gge ca buddhimAn| vAtashleShmaharairyuktaM tamake tu virecanam||121||
udIryate bhRushataraM mArgarodhAdvahajjalam| yathA tathA~anilastasya mArgaM nityaM vishodhayet||122||
shaTIcorakajIvantItva~gmustaM puShkarAhvayam| surasaM tAmalakyelA pippalyaguru nAgaram||123||
vAlakaM ca samaM cUrNaM kRutvA~aShTaguNasharkaram| sarvathA tamake shvAse hikkAyAM ca prayojayet||124||
muktApravAlavaidUryasha~gkhasphaTikama~jjanam| sasAragandhakAcArkasUkShmailAlavaNadvayam ||125||
tAmrAyorajasI rUpyaM sasaugandhikasIsakam | jAtIphalaM shaNAdbIjamapAmArgasya taNDulAH||126||
eShAM pANitalaM cUrNaM tulyAnAM kShaudrasarpiShA| hikkAM shvAsaM ca kAsaM ca lIDhamAshu niyacchati||127||
a~jjanAttimiraM kAcaM nIlikAM puShpakaM tamaH| malyaM kaNDUmabhiShyandamarma caiva praNAshayet||128||
pRuthak pa~jcavidhAvetau nirdiShTau rogasa~ggrahe| tayoH shRuNu samutthAnaM li~ggaM ca sabhiShagjitam||10||
rajasA dhUmavAtAbhyAM shItasthAnAmbusevanAt| vyAyAmAdgrAmyadharmAdhvarUkShAnnaviShamAshanAt||11||
AmapradoShAdAnAhAdraukShyAdatyapatarpaNAt| daurbalyAnmarmaNo ghAtAddvandvAcchuddhyatiyogataH||12||
atIsArajvaracchardipratishyAyakShatakShayAt| raktapittAdudAvartAdvisUcyalasakAdapi||13||
pANDurogAdviShAccaiva pravartete gadAvimau| niShpAvamAShapiNyAkatilatailaniShevaNAt||14||
piShTashAlUkaviShTambhividAhigurubhojanAt| jalajAnUpapishitadadhyAmakShIrasevanAt||15||
abhiShyandyupacArAcca shleShmalAnAM ca sevanAt| kaNThorasaH pratIghAtAdvibandhaishca pRuthagvidhaiH||16||
shaTIpuShkaramUlAnAM cUrNamAmalakasya ca| madhunA saMyutaM lehyaM cUrNaM vA kAlalohajam||129||
sasharkarAM tAmalakIM drAkShAM goshvashakRudrasam| tulyaM guDaM nAgaraM ca prAshayennAvayettathA||130||
lashunasya palANDorvA mUlaM gRu~jjanakasya vA| nAvayeccandanaM vA~api nArIkShIreNa saMyutam||131||
sukhoShNaM ghRutamaNDaM vA saindhavenAvacUrNitam| nAvayenmAkShikIM viShThAmalaktakarasena vA||132||
nArIkShIreNa siddhaM vA sarpirmadhurakairapi| pItaM nasto niShiktaM vA sadyo hikkAM niyacchati||133||
sakRuduShNaM sakRucchItaM vyatyAsAddhikkinAM payaH| pAne nastaHkriyAyAM vA sharkarAmadhusaMyutam||134||
adhobhAgairghRutaM siddhaM sadyo hikkAM niyacchati| pippalImadhuyuktau vA rasau dhAtrIkapitthayoH||135||
lAjAlAkShAmadhudrAkShApippalyashvashakRudrasAn| lihyAt kolamadhudrAkShApippalInAgarANi vA||136||
shItAmbusekaH sahasA trAso vismApanaM bhayam| krodhaharShapriyodvegA hikkApracyAvanA matAH||137||
hikkAshvAsavikArANAM nidAnaM yat prakIrtitam| varjyamArogyakAmaistaddhikkAshvAsavikAribhiH||138||
hikkAshvAsAnubandhA ye shuShkoraHkaNThatAlukAH| prakRutyA rUkShadehAshca sarpirbhistAnupAcaret||139||
dashamUlarase sarpirdadhimaNDe ca sAdhayet| kRuShNAsauvarcalakShAravayaHsthAhi~ggucorakaiH||140||
tejovatyabhayA kuShThaM pippalI kaTurohiNI||141||
bhUtIkaM pauShkaraM mUlaM palAshashcitrakaH shaTI| sauvarcalaM tAmalakI saindhavaM bilvapeshikA||142||
tAlIsapatraM jIvantI vacA tairakShasammitaiH| hi~ggupAdairghRutaprasthaM pacettoye caturguNe||143||
etadyathAbalaM pItvA hikkAshvAsau jayennaraH| shothAnilArshograhaNIhRutpArshvaruja eva ca||144||
iti tejovatyAdighRutam
manaHshilAsarjarasalAkShArajanipadmakaiH| ma~jjiShThailaishca karShAMshaiH prasthaH siddho ghRutAddhitaH||145||
jIvanIyopasiddhaM vA sakShaudraM lehayeddhRutam| tryUShaNaM dAdhikaM vA~api pibedvAsAghRutaM tathA||146||
yatki~jcit kaphavAtaghnamuShNaM vAtAnulomanam| bheShajaM pAnamatraM vA taddhitaM shvAsahikkine||147||
