vAtakRudvA kaphaharaM kaphakRudvA~anilApaham| kAryaM naikAntikaM tAbhyAM prAyaH shreyo~anilApaham||148||
sarveShAM bRuMhaNe hyalpaH shakyashca prAyasho bhavet| nAtyarthaM shamane~apAyo bhRusho~ashakyashca karshane||149||
tasmAcchuddhAnashuddhAMshca shamanairbRuMhaNairapi| hikkAshvAsArditA~jjantUn prAyashaH samupAcaret||150||

tatra shlokaH- durjayatve samutpattau kriyaikatve ca kAraNam| li~ggaM pathyaM ca hikkAnAM shvAsAnAM ceha darshitam||151||

Commentary: durjaya ityAdiko~adhyAyArthasa~ggraho vyaktaH||151||

mArutaH prANavAhIni srotAMsyAvishya kupyati| uraHsthaH kaphamuddhUya hikkAshvAsAn karoti saH||17||

Commentary: mArutaH prANavAhInityAdinA samptAptimAha| iyaM hikkAshvAsayoH sAdhAraNI samprAptiH, vaisheShikIM cAgre vakShyati| prANoparodhAyeti prAyaH prANaharaNAyeti prAyaH prANaharaNAyetyarthaH| pa~jca pa~jca ceti hikkAH pashca, shvAsAH pa~jca, ityarthaH||17||-
ubhayoH pUrvarUpANi shRuNu vakShyAmyataH param||18||
kaNThorasorgurutvaM ca vadanasya kaShAyatA| hikkAnAM pUrvarUpANi kukSherATopa eva ca||19||
AnAhaH pArshvashUlaM ca pIDanaM hRudayasya ca| prANasya ca vilomatvaM shvAsAnAM pUrvalakShaNam||20||
prANodakAnnavAhIni srotAMsi sakapho~anilaH| hikkAH karoti saMrudhya tAsAM li~ggaM pRuthak shRuNu||21||
kShINamAMsabalaprANatejasaH sakapho~anilaH| gRuhItvA sahasA kaNThamuccairghoShavatIM bhRusham||22||
karoti satataM hikkAmekadvitriguNaM tathA| prANaH srotAMsi marmANi saMrudhyoShmANameva ca||23||
sa~jj~jAM muShNAti gAtrANAM stambhaM sa~jjanayatyapi| mArgaM caivAnnapAnAnAM ruNaddhyupahatasmRuteH||24||
sAshruviplutanetrasya stabdhasha~gkhacyutabhruvaH| saktajalpapralApasya nirvRutiM nAdhigacchataH||25||
mahAmUlA mahAvegA mahAshabdA mahAbalA| mahAhikketi sA nRUNAM sadyaH prANaharA matA||26||
iti mahAhikkA
hikkate yaH pravRuddhastu kRusho dInamanA naraH| jarjareNorasA kRucchraM gambhIramanunAdayan||27||
sa~jjRumbhan sa~gkShipaMshcaiva tathA~a~ggAni prasArayan| pArshve cobhe samAyamya kUjan stambharugarditaH||28||
nAbheH pakvAshayAdvA~api hikkA cAsyopajAyate| kShobhayantI bhRushaM dehaM nAmayantIva tAmyataH||29||
ruNaddhyucchvAsamArgaM tu pranaShTabalacetasaH| gambhIrA nAma sA tasya hikkA prANAntikI matA||30||
vyapetA jAyate hikkA yA~annapAne caturvidhe| AhArapariNAmAnte bhUyashca labhate balam||31||
pralApavamyatIsAratRuShNArtasya vicetasaH| jRumbhiNo viplutAkShasya shuShkAsyasya vinAminaH||32||
paryAdhmAtasya hikkA yA jatrumUlAdasantatA| sA vyapeteti vij~jeyA hikkA prANoparodhinI||33||
kShudravAto yadA koShThAdvyAyAmaparighaTTitaH| kaNThe prapadyate hikkAM tadA kShudrAM karoti saH||34||
atiduHkhA na sA coraHshiromarmaprabAdhinI| na cocchvAsAnnapAnAnAM mArgamAvRutya tiShThati||35||
vRuddhimAyasyato yAti bhuktamAtre ca mArdavam| yataH pravartate pUrvaM tata eva nivartate||36||
hRudayaM kloma kaNThaM ca tAlukaM ca samAshritA| mRudvI sA kShudrahikketi nRuNAM sAdhyA prakIrtitA||37||
pANDurogakAraNatvAddhikkAshvAsayoH pANDurogAnantaramabhidhAnam| vakShyati hi- “pANDurogAdviShAccaiva pravartete gadAvimau” iti| hikkAshvAsau ca samAnakAraNacikitsitatvAdekAdhyAye evoktau||1-2||

vaidikaM laukikaM ca arthatattvaM jAnAtIti vedalokArthatattvaj~jaH| dvividhA iti sAmAnyAsAmAnyabhedena; kiMvA mRududAruNabhedena, nijAnijabhedena ca| tridoShA iti vAtAdibhiH pRutha~gmilitairvA| triprakopaNA iti asAtmyendriyArthasaMyogapariNAmapraj~jAparAdhakAraNakAH| kAmamiti anumatau| bahava iti jvara-sha~gkhaka-rohiNyAdayaH| yathA shvAsashca hikkA cetyanena shIghraM prANahAritvaM hikkAshvAsayordarshayati| ante iti maraNasamaye| sa~jjAyate iti avashyaM hikkAshvAsayoranyataro jAyate||3-7||
sahasetyAdinA~annajAmAha| iyaM ca yadyapi annajA uktA, tathA~api doShAdijanitaiva| pAnabhojyaprapIDita ityanenAnnasya kAraNatvenoktatvAdiyam ‘annajA’ itisa~jj~jA||38-41||

atItyAdinA sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgamAha| atishayena sa~jcitA doShA yasya sa tathA| bhaktacchedakRushasyeti abhojanadurbalasya| AsAM pa~jcAnAM yA hikkA atItyAdinA proktalakShaNasya puruShasya bhavati sA jIvitaM hanti| yamikA cetyanena kShudrA annajA ca yA sAdhyatvenoktA sA yamalavegena jAyamAnA yamikA j~jeyA; pUrvoktAnuvegena yA jAyamAnA sA mahAhikkA, sA svarUpeNaivAsAdhyA, tasyA atItyAdiyogenAsAdhyatAvidhAnamanarthakam| tathA mahatyAdihikkAnAM tisRUNAmasampUrNalakShaNAnAM sAdhyatvaM, kShudrAnnajayostu sampUrNalakShaNayorapi sAdhyatvaM, mahAhikkAditrayaM nisargata evAsAdhyam| anye tu bruvate- mahAhikkAdayo~api kadAcit sAdhyA bhavantyeva, tatra prANAntiketi vacanaM prAyaH prANaharA ityabhiprAyeNoktam| tathAhi jatUkarNe- “AdyA duHsAdhyA, yamikA tRuShNAmohavatAM sadyaHprANahRut, gambhIrA vyapete ca” ityuktam| akShINa iti akShINamAMsaH||42-44||

uddhUyamAnetyAdinA mahAshvAsalakShaNamAha| uddhUyamAna iti UrdhvaM dhUyamAnavAtaH| uccairiti dIrgham| mattarShabhaH mattabalIvardaH| dIna iti dInavat| ‘dInaM prashvasitaM’ iti vA pAThaH; tadA hi prashvasitasya dInatve ‘dUrAdvij~jAyate’ iti yadvakShyati tadanupapannaM syAt||46-48||

dIrghamityAdinordhvashvAsamAha| dIrghaM shvasiti shvAsasya bahirnirgamanaM dIrghakAlaM karoti| na ca pratyAharatyadha iti shvAsamadho na nayati| kruddhagandhavahaH duShTavAyuH| shvAsasya dIrghakAlamuddhUyane adho~anayane cokte hetumAha- UrdhvashvAse ityAdinA||49-51||

yastvityAdinA chinnashvAsalakShaNamAha| shvasiti vicchinnamiti niHshvasya punaH kShaNAntena shvasiti| na vA shvasiti na shvAsaM labhate| marmacchedarUpA ruk| bastinirodhaH mUtranirodha ityarthaH| raktaikalocanatvamiha vyAdhiprabhAvAt| vicchinnaH vimuktasandhibandhaH| ete trayaH shvAsA nisargato~asAdhyAH||52-54||

pratilomamityAdinA tamakashvAsamAha| shleShmANaM samudIrya cetyanena sAmAnyasamprAptyuktasyApi shleShmaNaH punarabhidhAnAdiha visheSheNa kAraNatvaM darshayati| ghurghurukamiti kaNThe ghurghurukashabdam| sannirudhyate iti nishceShTo bhavati| tasyaiva ceti ‘shleShmaNaH’ iti sheShaH| AsIna upaviShTaH| ucchritAkSha iti ucchUnAkShaH| muhushcaivAvadhamyate iti kShaNaM kShaNaM shvasanena vAyunA~avadhamyate||55-62||

pittasambandhAjjvarAdiyogena tamakasyaiva pratamakasa~jj~jAM darshayannAha- jvaretyAdi| udAvartetyAdinA pratamakahetulakShaNe prAha| pratamaka eva santamakaH| rajo dhUliH, kAyanirodho vegAnAM nirodhaH; kiMvA klinnakAyo vRuddhaH, nirodhaH veganirodhaH| tamaseti andhakAreNa, kiMvA tamasA tamoguNena| yadyapi tamakasya shItena vRuddhiruktA, tathA~api pratamakasya pittasambandhatvAt ‘shItaishcAshu prashAmyati’ iti yaduktaM tadupapannaM bhavati; kiMvA yathA madyotthavikArasya madyaM prashamanaM bhavati, tathA shItasamutthasyApi tadAtvamAtre shItaiH prashamanaM j~jeyam| pratamakastamakabheda eveti kRutvA shvAsAnAM pa~jcasa~gkhyAsiddhiH||63-64||

rUkShetyAdinA kShudrashvAsamAha| rUkShAdAyAsAcca udbhavo yasya sa rUkShAyAsodbhavaH| kShudravAta iti svalpavAtaH| na so~atyarthamiti nAtyarthaM duHkhakaraH| na duHkha iti na duHkhasAdhyaH| sarve cAvyaktalakShaNA ityanena sAdhyatvenoktAnAM mahAshvAsAdInAM vyaktasarvalakShaNatAvyatiriktAyAmevAvasthAyAM sAdhyatAM pratipAdayati||65-67||-
prANaharA mahAshvAsAdayaH sampUrNalakShaNA varjyAH| sAdhyayApyAniti bahuvacanaM sAdhyayApyabhedabahutvAjj~jeyam||68-69||

pittasthAnasamudbhavAvityanena pittasyordhvasthAnasambandha eva, natu vAtakaphavadArambhakatvamiti darshayati; pittasthAnashabdenAmAshayo~abhipretaH| sAdhAraNAviti prAyastulyacikitsyatvAt| AshIviShAviva dRuShTiniHshvAsaviShasarpAviva| mithyoparito~anyo~api rogo hanti, tadihAshIviShadRuShTAntena mithyopacAre sati shIghrahantRutvamAha||8-9||

samprati bhinnayorapi hikkAshvAsayoryathA samAnaM cikitsitaM bhavati tathA darshayan samAnaM cikitsitamAha- kAraNetyAdi| kAraNaM bAhyakAraNaM, sthAnaM nAbhyAdi, mUlaM doShaH| snigdhairiti svedairityasya visheShaNam; anye tu snigdhamiti paThanti| lavaNavattailaM lavaNatailam| ku~jjeShviti viTapeShu | matsyAdInAmityAdau matsyAdInAmapi rasaH svarasaH kalkena kartavyaH| dadhyuttaraM dadhisaraH| IdRushaM ca bhojanaM vamanAnuguNakaphavRuddhyartham| uktaM hi- “shleShmottarashchardayati hyaduHkham” (si.a.1) iti| vAtAvirodhItyanena annaM rUkShaM, tIkShNaM ca vamanaM, niShedhayati| duShTaH vigraho yasya sa duShTavigrahaH||70-76||

vamanasheShadoShaharaNArthaM dhUmamAha- lIna ityAdinA| etena dhUmo vamanaM vinA~api svalpadoShe kartavya eva, tatrApi dhUmaviShayadoShasya vidyamAnatvAt| alaM haritAlam| dhUmavartistu tasyAshItIyoktadhUmavartividhAnena kartavyA| atra ca dhUmapAnanalikAmAnaM vakShyamANakAsaharadhUmanalikAmAnasamAnamicchanti, hikkAshvAsayorapi kAsasamAnatvAt| madhUcchiShTaM sikthakam| mallakasampuTe cAtrAnuktamapi pAtavyadhUmanirgamArthamUrdhvaM cchidraM kartavyam| padmakAdiShvapi mallaketyAdyanuvartate| vardhamAna eraNDaH| lohaH agaruH| shallakI svanAmakhyAtA||77-80||

pittadAhArtA iti pittArtA dAhArtAshca| raktaM svedashcAtivartamAnau yeShAM te raktasvedAtivartinaH| pittalAH pittaprakRutayaH| koShNairityAdinA svedyAnAM sthAnavishiShTaM svedamAha| kAmamiti icchAyAM satyAm, utkArikopanAhaiH svedayet| ullekhanaM vamanam| atiyogoddhatamiti vamanAdyatiyogavRuddhaM; kiMvA atiyogena atimAtroddhatam||82-87||

cikitsAbhedArthaM hikkAshvAsino~avasthAbhedamAha- hikketyAdi| etAshcatasro~avasthAH sAkShAduktAH- balavAn, durbalaH, vAtAdhikaH, kaphAdhikashceti; rUkShabahvanilavisheShaNenApi rUkShasnigdhAvasthAdvayam| tatra bahukaphe balarUpasUcite cAvasthAdvaye kriyAM brUte- kaphAdhike ityAdi| tata iti vamanavirecanAnantaram| tathA cApare~avasthAdvaye samAnacikitsitamAha- vAtikAnityAdi| bAlavRuddhayoshcAtrAsampUrNakShINadhAtutvena durbalayordurbalodAharaNArthamevopAdAnam| etacca sa~gkShepeNa cikitsAsUtramuktam| tena balavAn vAtAdhika ityAdyavasthAyAM mishritAyAmuktacikitsAyA api mishraNaM kalpanIyaM; yathA- pratyekadoShoktacikitsA doShasaMsarge vikalpyate||88-90||

aviShayapraviShTashodhane doShamAha- anutkliShTetyAdinA| marma iti hRudayAdIni| dRuDhAniti balavataH| rasairAnUpavArijaistRuptAnityanena kaphotkleshakaraNe tRuptiM darshayati| svinnAniti sveditAn| itarAniti durbalAn bahuvAtAMshca| kaphAdhikAyAmavasthAyAM tarpaNarUpaviparItakriyAkaraNe~anukte~api kaphavRuddhyA doShotklesha eva j~jeyaH| iha dashamUlarasAdau barhitittirAdInAM siddhiH rasavidhAnenaiva j~jeyA||91-93||

nidigdhikAmityAdi| yUShavidhAnasAmAnyapaThitasyApi kulatthasya yUShaprakRutitvAdyUShasAdhanopayaugikaM mAnaM gRuhyate; sheShadravyaM tu yUShasAdhanamAnena gRuhyate| pippalIsAdhite ghRute pippalIyukte ghRute vA bharjita iti pippalIghRutabharjitaH| evaM rAsnAmityAdau rasasya prAdhAnyam| pUrvavadityanena pippalIghRutabharjanAdikamatidishati| kShAreNa yukto yUShaH kShArayUShaH, kShAraH apAmArgAdiH| kAsamardAdInAM yathAyogyatayA prakShepaH| jalamAnAdinA saMskAra unneyaH| dashamUlItyAdau kaShAyashabdaH pAnIyasthAnavihitatvAdardhashRute jale eva vartate||94-104||

AsphotA aparamalliketi khyAtA| madhUlikA alpagodhUmAH| shvAvidhamiti shallakasya mAMsam| mayUrapAdanAlamiti nAlaM mayUrapicchasyaiva nAlam| ghRutamatra prasthamAnam| shakalamiti matsyashakalAkAram| jANDakaH marudeshodbhavaH prANI pRuShThamAtre sa~gkocamupayAti| eko~advividhAbhinnaH shapho yeShAM te ekashaphA ashvAdayaH, dvishaphA hariNAdayaH| tanmArgashuddhyarthamiti prANamArgashuddhyartham||105-120||
kAsina iti hikkAshvAsayukta eva kAsI| udIryata ityAdau anilaH kaphamArganirodhAdudIryata iti darshayati||121-122||
shaTItyAdike samaM cUrNamiti vAlakAntaM dravyaM samam| aShTaguNasharkaramiti ekabhAgApekShayA~aShTaguNasharkaram| sarvatheti pAnabhojanalehAdiShu||123-124||

muktetyAdau sasAraH sphaTika eva| lavaNadvayaM sauvarcalaM saindhavaM ca| saugandhyaM mANikyabhedaH| sIsakaM sauvIrA~jjanaM, kecit kaserukamiShannIlapItamaNimAhuH| pANitalaM karShaH| malyamiti maladigdhAkShitAm||125-128||

pRuthagiti pratyekaM pa~jcavidhau| rogasa~ggrahe iti aShTodarIye| atra ca rajasetyAdinA prAyo vAtaprakopakagaNo vicchidyoktaH pravarteti gadAvimAvityantena, niShpAvetyAdinA kaphakAraNatayA hikkAshvAsayoH kaphaprakopakahetugaNo~abhihitaH; tadanena vAtajanakakaphajanakahetuvargadvayavicchedapAThena vAtakaphayoratra svahetukupitatvena svAtantryaM darshayati, nAnubandharUpatvam||10-16||

kAlaloho loha eva, kecittIkShNaM lohaM varNayanti| gRu~jjanakaM lohitapalANDuH| mAkShikImiti makShikAbhavAm| madhurakairiti jIvanIyaiH| sakRuditi kadAcit| vyatyAsAditi viparyAsAt; uShNaM payaH kRutvA shItaM kartavyam| madhusaMyogashcAtra viruddhatvAduShNe na kartavyaH||129-134||
adhobhAgairiti virecanadravyaiH| dashamUlItyAdau dadhimaNDaH mastuH| dashamUlakvAthadadhimaNDAnAM ca militvA cAturguNyam| vayasthA brAhmI| kAyasthA surasA||135-140||-

tejovatyAdau tejovatI cavikA| hi~ggupAdairityatra hi~ggupAdashabdena hi~ggu ekakarShApekShayA shANamAnaM gRuhyate| tathAhi ayameva yogo hArItena “tejovatI” ityAdinA paThitvA uktaH- “kalkaistairakShasammitaiH| hi~ggushANena saMyuktairghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet” ityAdi||141-144||
vAsAghRutamiti gulmoktam| tryUShaNamiti “tryUShaNaM triphalAM” (ci.a.18) ityAdinA tryUShaNasa~jj~jayaiva kAsacikitsite vakShyamANam||145-146||

anuktacikitsApakShagrahaNArthamAha- yatki~jcidityAdi| anaikAntikaM kartavyavidhimAha- vAtakRudityAdi| atra hikkAshvAsayoshcikitsite vidhitrayaM- tatra tAvat kaphavAtaharaM pradhAnamevoktaM, yattu avashiShTaM tatra doShasya vidyamAnatayA anaikAntena karaNaM j~jeyam, evamukte~api anaikAntena cikitsAdvayakaraNe vAtaharasyaiva prAdhAnyaM j~jeyam| tAbhyAmityAdi| anilApahaM ca bRuMhaNaM samAnaM bhavati| tatropapattimAha- sarveShAmityAdinA| gadAntarAnapi jvarAdIn hikkAshvAsavadbRuMhaNArhAnAha- bRuMhaNe kriyamANe hyalpo~apAyo bhavati; shakyaH pratIkAro bhavati, bRuMhaNajanitabalAnAM sukhajayavyApattikatvAditi bhAvaH| shamane tu nAtyarthamapAyo bhavati| karshane tu kriyamANe~ashakyo~apAyo bhavati bhRushashca bhavati| ashakya iti asAdhyaH| etadapi karshanena alpabale puruShe bheShajAdinA rogajayasya duHshakatvAditi j~jeyam| ata eva shamanairbRuhaNairiti upasaMhAraM kariShyati| kiMvA bRuMhaNarUpe shamane kriyamANe nAvashyamapAyo bhavati, bhavannapi alpaH shakyashca bhavati, karshane tu kriyamANe apAyo bhavatIti yojyam| nyAyopapAditaM bRuMhaNashamanaM bRuMhaNaM vA prAyaH kartavyatayopasaMharannAha- tasmAdityAdi| atra shamanamashuddhaviShayaM, bRuMhaNaM ca shuddhaviShayaM kecidAhuH; shamanasyaiva tu bRuMhaNatvaM kecidudAharanti||147-150||
lakShaNagrahaNagRuhItaM pUrvarUpaM hikkAnAM ‘kaNThorasoH’ ityAdinA, shvAsAnAm ‘AnAhaH’ ityAdinA~a~aha| vilomatvamiti paryAkulatvam||18-20||

prANodaketyAdinA vishiShTahikkAsamprAptimAha| kShINamAMsabalaprANatejasa iti atra prANo vAyuH, utsAho vA; tejo~agniH| uccairgRuhItvA ghoShavatImiti yojyam| dvisantatAM trisantatAmanekaguNAM vA karoti; tatra dvisantatA ekopakrame vAradvayaM bhavati| saMrudhyoShmANamiti dehoShmANam| saMsaktavacanatayA pralApo yasya sa saktajalpapralApaH| mahAmUleti gambhIrAshrayadoShamUlA| mahAshabdatvaM ca uccairghoShavatImityanenaivoktamapi mahAhikkAsa~jj~jopAdAnArthamiha punaruktaM, tena ‘mahAhikkA’ iti sa~jj~jA||21-26||
tatra higiti kAyati shabdaM karotIti hikkA| gambhIramanunAdayanniti hikkAyA anu gambhIraM shabdaM kurvan| sa~gkShipanna~ggAnIti yojyam| gambhIradeshabhavatvAd ‘gambhIrA’ iti sa~jj~jA||27-30||

vyapetA pariNatetyarthaH| AhArapariNAmAnte iti AhArapariNAme vRutte; etenAhAre~api utpadyate, ante balavatI bhavati tAM ‘vyapetA’ iti sa~jj~jayA darshayati| vinAmina iti sharIravinAmakasya| asantateti anatidIrghA||31-33||

kShudretyAdinA kShudrahikkAmAha| kShudravAtaH alpavAtaH; kecit kShudravAtamudAnamAhuH| Ayasyata iti AyAsaM kurvataH mArdavaM yAtIti sambandhaH| yataH pravartate pUrvaM tata eva nivartata iti utpadyamAnaiva nivartamAnavegA bhavati; mahAhikkAdivadanubaddhA na bhavati; utpAdakahetorvyAyAmAdereva nivartate, vyAyAmAdinA hikkAjanakavAtasya kShudrasya vikShepAt samprAptibha~ggeneti bhAvaH| kShudravAtajanitAtvAt kShudrA hikkA||34-37||
athAtaH kAsacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
tapasA yashasA dhRutyA dhiyA ca parayA~anvitaH| AtreyaH kAsashAntyarthaM prAha siddhaM cikitsitam||3||
vAtAdijAstrayo ye ca kShatajaH kShayajastathA| pa~jcaite syurnRuNAM kAsA vardhamAnAH kShayapradAH||4||
viShamAsAtmyabhojyAtivyavAyAdveganigrahAt| ghRuNinAM shocatAM nRUNAM vyApanne~agnau trayo malAH||24||
kupitAH kShayajaM kAsaM kuryurdehakShayapradam| durgandhaM haritaM raktaM ShThIvet pUyopamaM kapham||25||
sthAnAdutkAsamAnashca hRudayaM manyate cyutam | akasmAduShNashItArto bahvAshI durbalaH kRushaH||26||
snigdhAcchamukhavarNatvak shrImaddarshanalocanaH | pANipAdatalaiH shlakShNaiH satatAsUyako ghRuNI||27||
jvaro mishrAkRutistasya pArshvaruk pInaso~aruciH| bhinnasaMhatavarcastvaM svarabhedo~animittataH||28||
ityeSha kShayajaH kAsaH kShINAnAM dehanAshanaH| sAdhyo balavatAM vA syAdyApyastvevaM kShatotthitaH||29||
navau kadAcit sidhyetAmetau pAdaguNAnvitau| sthavirANAM jarAkAsaH sarvo yApyaH prakIrtitaH||30||

trInsAdhyAnsAdhayetpUrvAn pathyairyApyAMshca yApayet| cikitsAmata UrdhvaM tu shRuNu kAsanibarhiNIm||31||

Commentary: trIn pUrvAniti doShajAn| sAdhyAniti sAdhyatvenoktAn| yApyAniti bahuvacanaM vyaktyapekShayA, kiMvA kShayajakShatajakAsAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam||31||
rUkShasyAnilajaM kAsamAdau snehairupAcaret| sarpirbhirbastibhiH peyAyUShakShIrarasAdibhiH||32||
vAtaghnasiddhaiH snehAdyairdhUmairlehaishca yuktitaH| abhya~ggaiH pariShekaishca snigdhaiH svedaishca buddhimAn||33||
bastibhirbaddhaviDvAtaM shuShkordhvaM cordhvabhaktikaiH| ghRutaiH sapittaM sakaphaM jayet snehavirecanaiH||34||

kaNTakArIguDUcIbhyAM pRuthak triMshatpalAdrase| prasthaH siddho ghRutAdvAtakAsanudvahnidIpanaH||35||

Commentary: kaNTakArItyAdau rase iti kvAthe||35||
iti kaNTakArIghRutam
pippalIpippalImUlacavyacitrakanAgaraiH| dhAnyapAThAvacArAsnAyaShTyAhvakShArahi~ggubhiH||36||
kolamAtrairghRutaprasthAddashamUlIrasADhake| siddhAccaturthikAM pItvA peyAmaNDaM pibedanu||37||
tacchvAsakAsahRutpArshvagrahaNIdoShagulmanut| pippalyAdyaM ghRutaM caitadAtreyeNa prakIrtitam||38||
iti dvipa~jcamUlAdighRutam
tryUShaNaM triphalAM drAkShAM kAshmaryANi parUShakam| dve pAThe devadArvRuddhiM svaguptAM citrakaM shaTIm||39||
brAhmIM tAmalakIM medAM kAkanAsAM shatAvarIm| trikaNTakaM vidArIM ca piShTvA karShasamaM ghRutAt||40||
prasthaM caturguNe kShIre siddhaM kAsaharaM pibet| jvaragulmAruciplIhashirohRutpArshvashUlanut||41||
kAmalArsho~anilAShThIlAkShatashoShakShayApaham| tryUShaNaM nAma vikhyAtametaddhRutamanuttamam||42||
droNe~apAM sAdhayedrAsnAM dashamUlIM shatAvarIm| palikAM mANikAMshAMstu kulatthAnbadarAnyavAn||43||
tulArdhaM cAjamAMsasya pAdasheSheNa tena ca| ghRutADhakaM samakShIraM jIvanIyaiH palonmitaiH||44||
siddhaM taddashabhiH kalkairnasyapAnAnuvAsanaiH| samIkShya vAtarogeShu yathAvasthaM prayojayet||45||
pa~jcakAsAn shiraHkampaM shUlaM va~gkShaNayonijam| sarvA~ggaikA~ggarogAMshca saplIhordhvAnilA~jjayet||46||
iti citrakAdilehaH
viDa~ggaM nAgaraM rAsnA pippalI hi~ggu saindhavam| bhArgI kShArashca taccUrNaM pibedvA ghRutamAtrayA||47||
sakaphe~anilaje kAse shvAsahikkAhatAgniShu| dvau kShArau pa~jcakolAni pa~jcaiva lavaNAni ca||48||
shaTInAgarakodIcyakalkaM vA vastragAlitam| pAyayeta ghRutonmishraM vAtakAsanibarhaNam||49||
durAlabhAM shaTIM drAkShAM shRu~ggaveraM sitopalAm| lihyAt karkaTashRu~ggIM ca kAse tailena vAtaje||50||
duHsparshAM pippalIM mustaM bhArgIM karkaTakIM shaTIm| purANaguDatailAbhyAM cUrNitaM vA~api lehayet||51||
viDa~ggaM saindhavaM kuShThaM vyoShaM hi~ggu manaHshilAm| madhusarpiryutaM kAsahikkAshvAsaM jayellihan||52||
citrakaM pippalImUlaM vyoShaM hi~ggu durAlabhAm| shaTIM puShkaramUlaM ca shreyasIM surasAM vacAm||53||
bhArgIM chinnaruhAM rAsnAM shRu~ggIM drAkShAM ca kArShikAn| kalkAnardhatulAkvAthe nidigdhyAH palaviMshatim ||54||
dattvA matsyaNDikAyAshca ghRutAcca kuDavaM pacet| siddhaM shItaM pRuthak kShaudrapippalIkuDavAnvitam||55||
catuShpalaM tugAkShIryAshcUrNitaM tatra dApayet| lehayet kAsahRudrogashvAsagulmanivAraNam||56||
dashamUlIM svaya~gguptAM sha~gkhapuShpIM shaTIM balAm| hastipippalyapAmArgapippalImUlacitrakAn||57||
bhArgIM puShkaramUlaM ca dvipalAMshaM yavADhakam| harItakIshataM caikaM jale pa~jcADhake pacet||58||
yavaiH svinnaiH kaShAyaM taM pUtaM taccAbhayAshatam| pacedguDatulAM dattvA kuDavaM ca pRuthagghRutAt||59||
tailAt sapippalIcUrNAt siddhashIte ca mAkShikAt| lihyAddve cAbhaye nityamataH khAdedrasAyanAt||60||
tadvalIpalitaM hanti varNAyurbalavardhanam| pa~jcakAsAn kShayaM shvAsaM hikkAM ca viShamajvaram||61||
hanyAttathA~arshograhaNIhRudrogArucipInasAn| agastyavihitaM shreShThaM rasAyanamidaM shubham||62||
ityagastyaharItakI
saindhavaM pippalIM bhArgIM shRu~ggaveraM durAlabhAm| dADimAmlena koShNena bhArgInAgaramambunA||63||
pibet khadirasAraM vA madirAdadhimastubhiH| athavA pippalIkalkaM ghRutabhRuShTaM sasaindhavam||64||
shirasaH pIDane srAve nAsAyA hRudi tAmyati| kAsapratishyAyavatAM dhUmaM vaidyaH prayojayet||65||
dashA~ggulonmitAM nADImathavA~aShTA~ggulonmitAm| sharAvasampuTacchidre kRutvA jihmAM vicakShaNaH||66||
vairecanaM mukhenaiva kAsavAn dhUmamApibet| tamuraH kevalaM prAptaM mukhenaivodvamet punaH||67||
sa hyasya taikShNyAdvicchidya shleShmANamurasi sthitam| niShkRuShya shamayet kAsaM vAtashleShmasamudbhavam||68||
manaHshilAlamadhukamAMsImuste~ggudaiH pibet| dhUmaM tasyAnu ca kShIraM sukhoShNaM saguDaM pibet||69||
eSha kAsAn pRuthagdoShasannipAtasamudbhavAn| dhUmo hanyAdasaMsiddhAnanyairyogashatairapi||70||
prapauNDarIkaM madhukaM shAr~ggeShTAM samanaHshilAm| maricaM pippalIM drAkShAmelAM surasama~jjarIm||71||
kRutvA vartiM pibeddhUmaM kShaumacelAnuvartitAm| ghRutAktAmanu ca kShIraM guDodakamathApi vA||72||
manaHshilailAmaricakShArA~jjanakuTannaTaiH| vaMshalekhanasevyAlakShaumalaktakarohiShaiH ||73||
pUrvakalpena dhUmo~ayaM sAnupAno vidhIyate| manaHshilAle tadvacca pippalInAgaraiH saha||74||
tvagai~ggudI bRuhatyau dve tAlamUlI manaHshilA| kArpAsAsthyashvagandhA ca dhUmaH kAsavinAshanaH||75||
grAmyAnUpaudakaiH shAliyavagodhUmaShaShTikAn| rasairmAShAtmaguptAnAM yUShairvA bhojayeddhitAn||76||
yavAnIpippalIbilvamadhyanAgaracitrakaiH| rAsnAjAjIpRuthakparNIpalAshashaTipauShkaraiH||77||
snigdhAmlalavaNAM siddhAM peyAmanilaje pibet| kaTIhRutpArshvakoShThArtishvAsahikkApraNAshinIm||78||
dashamUlarase tadvatpa~jcakolaguDAnvitAm| siddhAM samatilAM dadyAtkShIre vA~api sasaindhavAm||79||
mAtsyakaukkuTavArAhairAmiShairvA ghRutAnvitAm| siddhAM sasaindhavAM peyAM vAtakAsI pibennaraH||80||
vAstuko vAyasIshAkaM mUlakaM suniShaNNakam| snehAstailAdayo bhakShyAH kShIrekShurasagauDikAH||81||
dadhyAranAlAmlaphalaprasannApAnameva ca| shasyate vAtakAse tu svAdvamlalavaNAni ca||82||
iti vAtakAsacikitsA
paittike sakaphe kAse vamanaM sarpiShA hitam| tathA madanakAshmaryamadhukakvathitairjalaiH||83||
yaShTyAhvaphalakalkairvA vidArIkShurasAyutaiH| hRutadoShastataH shItaM madhuraM ca kramaM bhajet||84||
paitte tanukaphe kAse trivRutAM madhurairyutAm| dadyAdghanakaphe tiktairvirekArthe yutAM bhiShak||85||
snigdhashItastanukaphe rUkShashItaH kaphe ghane| kramaH kAryaH paraM bhojyaiH snehairlehaishca shasyate||86||
shRu~ggATakaM padmabIjaM nIlIsArANi pippalI| pippalImustayaShTyAhvadrAkShAmUrvAmahauShadham||87||
lAjA~amRutaphalA drAkShA tvakkShIrI pippalI sitA| pippalIpadmakadrAkShA bRuhatyAshca phalAdrasaH||88||
kharjUraM pippalI vAMshI shvadaMShTrA ceti pa~jca te| ghRutakShaudrayutA lehAH shlokArdhaiH pittakAsinAm||89||
sharkarAcandanadrAkShAmadhudhAtrIphalotpalaiH| paitte, samustamaricaH sakaphe, saghRuto~anile||90||
mRudvIkArdhashataM triMshatpippalIH sharkarApalam| lehayenmadhunA gorvA kShIrapaM ca shakRudrasam||91||
tvagelAvyoShamRudvIkApippalImUlapauShkaraiH| lAjAmustashaTIrAsnAdhAtrIphalabibhItakaiH||92||
sharkarAkShaudrasarpirbhirlehaH kAsavinAshanaH| shvAsaM hikkAM kShayaM caiva hRudrogaM ca praNAshayet||93||
pippalyAmalakaM drAkShAM lAkShAM lAjAM sitopalAm| kShIre paktvA ghanaM shItaM lihyAt kShaudrAShTabhAgikam||94||
vidArIkShumRuNAlAnAM rasAn kShIraM sitopalAm| pibedvA madhusaMyuktaM pittakAsaharaM param||95||
madhurairjA~ggalarasaiH shyAmAkayavakodravAH| mudgAdiyUShaiH shAkaishca tiktakairmAtrayA hitAH||96||
ghanashleShmaNi lehAstu tiktakA madhusaMyutAH| shAlayaH syustanukaphe ShaShTikAshca rasAdibhiH||97||
sharkarAmbho~anupAnArthaM drAkShekShUNAM rasAH payaH| sarvaM ca madhuraM shItamavidAhi prashasyate||98||
kAkolIbRuhatImedAyugmaiH savRuShanAgaraiH| pittakAse rasAn kShIraM yUShAMshcApyupakalpayet||99||
sharAdipa~jcamUlasya pippalIdrAkShayostathA| kaShAyeNa shRutaM kShIraM pibet samadhusharkaram||100||
sthirAsitApRushniparNIshrAvaNIbRuhatIyugaiH| jIvakarShabhakAkolItAmalakyRuddhijIvakaiH||101||
shRutaM payaH pibet kAsI jvarI dAhI kShatakShayI| tajjaM vA sAdhayet sarpiH sakShIrekShurasaM bhiShak||102||
jIvakAdyairmadhurakaiH phalaishcAbhiShukAdibhiH| kalkaistrikArShikaiH siddhe pUtashIte pradApayet||103||
sharkarApippalIcUrNaM tvakkShIryA maricasya ca| shRu~ggATakasya cAvApya kShaudragarbhAnpalonmitAn||104||
guDAn godhUmacUrNena kRutvA khAdeddhitAshanaH| shukrAsRugdoShashoSheShu kAse kShINakShateShu ca||105||
sharkarAnAgarodIcyaM kaNTakArIM shaTIM samam| piShTvA rasaM pibetpUtaM vastreNa ghRutamUrcchitam||106||
mahiShyajAvigokShIradhAtrIphalarasaiH samaiH| sarpiH siddhaM pibedyuktyA pittakAsanibarhaNam||107||
iti pittakAsacikitsA
balinaM vamanairAdau shodhitaM kaphakAsinam| yavAnnaiH kaTurUkShoShNaiH kaphaghnaishcApyupAcaret||108||
pippalIkShArikairyUShaiH kaulatthairmUlakasya ca| laghUnyannAni bhu~jjIta rasairvA kaTukAnvitaiH||109||
dhAnvabailarasaiH snehaistilasarShapabilvajaiH| madhvamloShNAmbutakraM vA madyaM vA nigadaM pibet||110||
pauShkarAragvadhaM mUlaM paTolaM tairnishAsthitam| jalaM madhuyutaM peyaM kAleShvannasya vA triShu||111||
kaTphalaM kattRuNaM bhArgIM mustaM dhAnyaM vacAbhaye| shuNThIM parpaTakaM shRu~ggIM surAhvaM ca shRutaM jale||112||
madhuhi~gguyutaM peyaM kAse vAtakaphAtmake| kaNTharoge mukhe shUne shvAsahikkAjvareShu ca||113||
pAThAM shuNThIM shaTIM mUrvAM gavAkShIM mustapippalIm| piShTvA gharmAmbunA hi~ggusaindhavAbhyAM yutAM pibet||114||
nAgarAtiviShe mustaM shRu~ggIM karkaTakasya ca| harItakIM shaTIM caiva tenaiva vidhinA pibet||115||
tailabhRuShTaM ca pippalyAH kalkAkShaM sasitopalam| pibedvA shleShmakAsaghnaM kulattharasasaMyutam||116||
kAsamardAshvaviTbhRu~ggarAjavArtAkajo rasaH| sakShaudraH kaphakAsaghnaH surasasyAsitasya ca||117||
devadAru shaTI rAsnA karkaTAkhyA durAlabhA| pippalI nAgaraM mustaM pathyAdhAtrIsitopalAH||118||
madhutailayutAvetau lehau vAtAnuge kaphe| pippalI pippalImUlaM citrako hastipippalI||119||
pathyA tAmalakI dhAtrI bhadramustA ca pippalI| devadArvabhayA mustaM pippalI vishvabheShajam||120||
vishAlA pippalI mustaM trivRutA ceti lehayet| caturo madhunA lehAn kaphakAsaharAn bhiShak||121||
sauvarcalAbhayAdhAtrIpippalIkShAranAgaram| cUrNitaM sarpiShA vAtakaphakAsaharaM pibet||122||
dashamUlADhake prasthaM ghRutasyAkShasamaiH pacet| puShkarAhvashaTIbilvasurasavyoShahi~ggubhiH||123||
peyAnupAnaM tat peyaM kAse vAtakaphAtmake| shvAsarogeShu sarveShu kaphavAtAtmakeShu ca||124||
iti guDUcyAdighRutam

pUrvarUpaM bhavetteShAM shUkapUrNagalAsyatA| kaNThe kaNDUshca bhojyAnAmavarodhashca jAyate||5||

Commentary: pUrvarUpamAha- pUrvetyAdi| shUkairiva pUrNaH shUkapUrNaH gala AsyaM ca yasya tasya bhAvaH shUkapUrNagalAsyatA| bhojyAnAmavarodhaH aruciH, ashaktirvA~abhyavaharaNe||5||
samUlaphalapatrAyAH kaNTakAryA rasADhake| ghRutaprasthaM balAvyoShaviDa~ggashaTicitrakaiH||125||
sauvarcalayavakShArapippalImUlapauShkaraiH| vRushcIrabRuhatIpathyAyavAnIdADimardhibhiH||126||
drAkShApunarnavAcavyadurAlambhAmlavetasaiH| shRu~ggItAmalakIbhArgIrAsnAgokShurakaiH pacet||127||
kalkaistat sarvakAseShu hikkAshvAseShu shasyate| kaNTakArIghRutaM hyetat kaphavyAdhinisUdanam||128||
iti kaNTakArIghRutamkulattharasayuktaM vA pa~jcakolashRutaM ghRutam| pAyayet kaphaje kAse hikkAshvAse ca shasyate||129||
iti kulatthAdighRutam

dhUmAMstAneva dadyAcca ye proktA vAtakAsinAm| koshAtakIphalAnmadhyaM pibedvA samanaHshilam||130||

Commentary: koshAtakI ghoShakaH||130||
tamakaH kaphakAse tu syAccet pittAnubandhajaH| pittakAsakriyAM tatra yathAvasthaM prayojayet||131||
vAte kaphAnubandhe tu kuryAt kaphaharIM kriyAm| pittAnubandhayorvAtakaphayoH pittanAshinIm||132||
Ardre virUkShaNaM, shuShke snigdhaM, vAtakaphAtmake| kAse~annapAnaM kaphaje sapitte tiktasaMyutam||133||
kAsamAtyayikaM matvA kShatajaM tvarayA jayet| madhurairjIvanIyaishca balamAMsavivardhanaiH||134||
pippalI madhukaM piShTaM kArShikaM sasitopalam| prAsthikaM gavyamAjaM ca kShIramikShurasastathA||135||
yavagodhUmamRudvIkAcUrNamAmalakAdrasaH| tailaM ca prasRutAMshAni tat sarvaM mRudunA~agninA||136||
pacellehaM ghRutakShaudrayuktaH sa kShatakAsahA| shvAsahRudrogakArshyeShu hito vRuddhe~alparetasi||137||
kShatakAsAbhibhUtAnAM vRuttiH syAt pittakAsikI| kShIrasarpirmadhuprAyA saMsarge tu visheShaNam||138||
vAtapittArdite~abhya~ggo gAtrabhede ghRutairhitaH| tailairmArutarogaghnaiH pIDyamAne ca vAyunA||139||
hRutpArshvArtiShu pAnaM syAjjIvanIyasya sarpiShaH| sadAhaM kAsino raktaM ShThIvataH sabale~anale||140||
mAMsocitebhyaH kShAmebhyo lAvAdInAM rasA hitAH| tRuShNArtAnAM payashchAgaM sharamUlAdibhiH shRutam||141||
rakte srotobhya AsyAdvA~apyAgate kShIrajaM ghRutam| nasyaM pAnaM yavAgUrvA shrAnte kShAme hatAnale||142||
stambhAyAmeShu mahatIM mAtrAM vA sarpiShaH pibet| kuryAdvA vAtarogaghnaM pittaraktAvirodhi yat||143||
nivRutte kShatadoShe tu kaphe vRuddha uraH kShate| dAlyate kAsino yasya sa dhUmAnnA pibedimAn||144||
dve mede madhukaM dve ca bale taiH kShaumalaktakaiH| vartitairdhUmamApIya jIvanIyaghRutaM pibet||145||
manaHshilApalAshAjagandhAtvakkShIrinAgaraiH| bhAvayitvA pibet kShaumamanu cekShuguDodakam||146||
piShTvA manaHshilAM tulyAmArdrayA vaTashu~ggayA| sasarpiShkaM pibeddhUmaM tittiripratibhojanam||147||
bhAvitaM jIvanIyairvA kuli~ggANDarasAyutaiH| kShaumaM dhUmaM pibet kShIraM shRutaM cAyoguDairanu||148||
iti kShatajakAsacikitsA
sampUrNarUpaM kShayajaM durbalasya vivarjayet| navotthitaM balavataH pratyAkhyAyAcaret kriyAm||149||
tasmai bRuMhaNamevAdau kuryAdagneshca dIpanam| bahudoShAya sasnehaM mRudu dadyAdvirecanam||150||
shampAkena trivRutayA mRudvIkArasayuktayA| tilvakasya kaShAyeNa vidArIsvarasena ca||151||
sarpiH siddhaM pibedyuktyA kShINadeho vishodhanam| (hitaM taddehabalayorasya saMrakShaNaM matam )||152||
pitte kaphe ca sa~gkShINe parikShINeShu dhAtuShu| ghRutaM karkaTakIkShIradvibalAsAdhitaM pibet||153||
vidArIbhiH kadambairvA tAlasasyaistathA shRutam| ghRutaM payashca mUtrasya vaivarNye kRucchranirgame||154||
shUne savedane meDhre pAyau sashroNiva~gkShaNe| ghRutamaNDena madhunA~anuvAsyo mishrakeNa vA||155||
jA~ggalaiH pratibhuktasya vartakAdyA bileshayAH| kramashaH prasahAshcaiva prayojyAH pishitAshinaH||156||
auShNyAt pramAthibhAvAcca srotobhyashcyAvayanti te| kaphaM, shuddhaishca taiH puShTiM kuryAtsamyagvahanrasaH||157||
dvipa~jcamUlItriphalAcavikAbhArgicitrakaiH| kulatthapippalImUlapAThAkolayavairjale||158||
shRutairnAgaraduHsparshApippalIshaTipauShkaraiH| kalkaiH karkaTashRu~ggyA ca samaiH sarpirvipAcayet||159||
siddhe~asmiMshcUrNitau kShArau dvau pa~jca lavaNAni ca| dattvA yuktyA pibenmAtrAM kShayakAsanipIDitaH||160||
adhaHpratihato vAyurUrdhvasrotaHsamAshritaH| udAnabhAvamApannaH kaNThe saktastathorasi||6||
Avishya shirasaH khAni sarvANi pratipUrayan| Abha~jjannAkShipan dehaM hanumanye tathA~akShiNI||7||
netre pRuShThamuraHpArshve nirbhujya stambhayaMstataH| shuShko vA sakapho vA~api kasanAtkAsa ucyate||8||
guDUcIM pippalIM mUrvAM haridrAM shreyasIM vacAm| nidigdhikAM kAsamardaM pAThAM citrakanAgaram||161||
jale caturguNe paktvA pAdasheSheNa tatsamam| siddhaM sarpiH pibedgulmashvAsArtikShayakAsanut||162||
kAsamardAbhayAmustapAThAkaTphalanAgaraiH| pippalIkaTukAdrAkShAkAshmaryasurasaistathA||163||
akShamAtrairghRutaprasthaM kShIradrAkShArasADhake| pacecchoShajvaraplIhasarvakAsaharaM shivam||164||
dhAtrIphalaiH kShIrasiddhaiH sarpirvA~apyavacUrNitam| dviguNe dADimarase vipakvaM vyoShasaMyutam||165||
pibedupari bhaktasya yavakShAraghRutaM naraH| pippalIguDasiddhaM vA cchAgakShIrayutaM ghRutam||166||
etAnyagnivivRuddhyarthaM sarpIMShi kShayakAsinAm| syurdoShabaddhakoShThoraHsrotasAM ca vishuddhaye||167||
harItakIryavakvAthadvyADhake viMshatiM pacet| svinnA mRuditvA tAstasmin purANaM guDaShaTpalam||168||
dadyAnmanaHshilAkarShaM karShArdhaM ca rasA~jjanAt| kuDavArdhaM ca pippalyAH sa lehaH shvAsakAsanut||169||
iti harItakIlehaHshvAvidhaH sUcayo dagdhAH saghRutakShaudrasharkarAH| shvAsakAsaharA barhipAdau vA kShaudrasarpiShA||170||
eraNDapatrakShAraM vA vyoShatailaguDAnvitam| lihyAdetena vidhinA surasairaNDapatrajam||171||
drAkShApadmakavArtAkapippalIH kShaudrasarpiShA| lihyAttryUShaNacUrNaM vA purANaguDasarpiShA||172||
citrakaM triphalAjAjI karkaTAkhyA kaTutrikam| drAkShAM ca kShaudrasarpirbhyAM lihyAdadyAdguDena vA||173||
padmakaM triphalAM vyoShaM viDa~ggaM suradAru ca| balAM rAsnAM ca tulyAni sUkShmacUrNAni kArayet||174||
sarvairebhiH samaM cUrNaiH pRuthak kShaudraM ghRutaM sitAm| vimathya lehayellehaM sarvakAsaharaM shivam||175||
jIvantIM madhukaM pAThAM tvakkShIrIM triphalAM shaTIm| mustaile padmakaM drAkShAM dve bRuhatyau vitunnakam||176||
sArivAM pauShkaraM mUlaM karkaTAkhyAM rasA~jjanam| punarnavAM loharajastrAyamANAM yavAnikAm||177||
bhArgIM tAmalakImRuddhiM viDa~ggaM dhanvayAsakam| kShAracitrakacavyAmlavetasavyoShadAru ca||178||
cUrNIkRutya samAMshAni lehayet kShaudrasarpiShA| cUrNAtpANitalaM pa~jca kAsAnetad vyapohati||179||
iti padmakAdilehaH
lihyAnmaricacUrNaM vA saghRutakShaudrasharkaram| badarIpatrakalkaM vA ghRutabhRuShTaM sasaindhavam||180||
svarabhede ca kAse ca lehametaM prayojayet| patrakalkaM ghRutairbhRuShTaM tilvakasya sasharkaram||181||
peyA cotkArikA ccharditRuTkAsAmAtisAranut| gaurasarShapagaNDIraviDa~ggavyoShacitrakAn| sAbhayAn sAdhayettoye yavAgUM tena cAmbhasA||182||
sasarpirlavaNAM kAse hikkAshvAse sapInase| pANDvAmaye kShaye shothe karNashUle ca dApayet||183||
kaNTakArIrase siddho mudgayUShaH susaMskRutaH| sagaurAmalakaH sAmlaH sarvakAsabhiShagjitam||184||
vAtaghnauShadhaniShkvAthaM kShIraM yUShAn rasAnapi| vaiShkirapratudAn bailAn dApayet kShayakAsine||185||
kShatakAse ca ye dhUmAH sAnupAnA nidarshitAH| kShayakAse~api tAneva yathAvasthaM prayojayet||186||
dIpanaM bRuMhaNaM caiva srotasAM ca vishodhanam| vyatyAsAtkShayakAsibhyo balyaM sarvaM hitaM bhavet||187||
sannipAtabhavo~apyeSha kShayakAsaH sudAruNaH| sannipAtahitaM tasmAt sadA kAryaM bhiShagjitam||188||
doShAnubalayogAcca haredrogabalAbalam| kAseShveShu garIyAMsaM jAnIyAduttarottaram||189||

bhojyaM pAnAni sarpIMShi lehAshca saha pAnakaiH| kShIraM sarpirguDA dhUmAH kAsabhaiShajyasa~ggrahaH||190||

Commentary: vistaroktaM kAsabheShajaM sa~ggRuhNAti- bhojyamityAdi||190||

tatra shlokaH- sa~gkhyA nimittaM rUpANi sAdhyAsAdhyatvameva ca| kAsAnAM bheShajaM proktaM garIyastvaM ca kAsinaH||191||

Commentary: sa~gkhyetyAdiradhyAyArthasa~ggrahaH sugamaH||191||

pratighAtavisheSheNa tasya vAyoH saraMhasaH| vedanAshabdavaishiShTyaM kAsAnAmupajAyate||9||

Commentary: evaM sAmAnyoktasya kAsasya bhedahetumAha- pratIghAtetyAdi| pratIghAta ityAvaraNaM, sa ca kaphAdi| saraMhasaH savegasya| vedanA pIDA, shabdaH kAsashabdaH, sa~jj~jA vA; tayorvaishiShTyaM vishiShTatvaM bhinnatvamiti yAvat||9||
rUkShashItakaShAyAlpapramitAnashanaM striyaH| vegadhAraNamAyAso vAtakAsapravartakAH||10||
hRutpArshvoraHshiraHshUlasvarabhedakaro bhRusham| shuShkoraHkaNThavakrasya hRuShTalomnaH pratAmyataH||11||
nirghoShadainyastananadaurbalyakShobhamohakRut| shuShkakAsaH kaphaM shuShkaM kRucchrAnmuktvA~alpatAM vrajet||12||
snigdhAmlalavaNoShNaishca bhuktapItaiH prashAmyati| UrdhvavAtasya jIrNe~anne vegavAnmAruto bhavet||13||
kaTukoShNavidAhyamlakShArANAmatisevanam| pittakAsakaraM krodhaH santApashcAgnisUryajaH||14||
pItaniShThIvanAkShitvaM tiktAsyatvaM svarAmayaH| urodhUmAyanaM tRuShNA dAho moho~arucirbhramaH||15||
pratataM kAsamAnashca jyotIMShIva ca pashyati| shleShmANaM pittasaMsRuShTaM niShThIvati ca paittike||16||
gurvabhiShyandimadhurasnigdhasvapnAviceShTanaiH| vRuddhaH shleShmA~anilaM ruddhvA kaphakAsaM karoti hi||17||
mandAgnitvArucicchardipInasotkleshagauravaiH| lomaharShAsyamAdhuryakledasaMsadanairyutam||18||
bahulaM madhuraM snigdhaM niShThIvati ghanaM kapham| kAsamAno hyarug vakShaH sampUrNamiva manyate||19||
ativyavAyabhArAdhvayuddhAshvagajavigrahaiH| rUkShasyoraH kShataM vAyurgRuhItvA kAsamAvahet||20||
sa pUrvaM kAsate shuShkaM tataH ShThIvet sashoNitam| kaNThena rujatA~atyarthaM virugNeneva corasA||21||
sUcIbhiriva tIkShNAbhistudyamAnena shUlinA| duHkhasparshena shUlena bhedapIDAbhitApinA||22||
parvabhedajvarashvAsatRuShNAvaisvaryapIDitaH| pArAvata ivAkUjan kAsavegAtkShatodbhavAt||23||
hikkAshvAsAnantaraM samAnacikitsitatvAt tathA hikkAshvAsakAsAnAM parasparAnubandhitvAcca kAsacikitsitamucyate||1-2||

atra cAtreyasyAbhidhAnAdeva shiShyaprashno~anumIyate, nApRuShTA guravo vadantIti nyAyAt| kShayaja iti kShayo dhAtukShayaH; tena rAjayakShmasambandhAnAM kShINadhAtupuruShabhavAnAM tathA jarAkAsasya ca dhAtukShayajasya kShayajashabdena grahaNaM bhavati| kShatajena uraHkShatapUrvakayakShmabhavasya tathA kShatakShINasya ca kAsasya grahaNaM bhavati| pa~jceti sa~gkhyayA sakalakAsAvarodhamatraiva yathoktavyAkhyAnena darshayati| kShayapradA iti dehakShayapradAH, mArakA iti yAvat; kiMvA dhAtukShayapradAH, kShayajo~api kAsaH punarvishiShTakShayaprado bhavati, yathA- jvarotpannaM raktapittaM punarjvarakaraM bhavati; uktaM hi- “jvarasantApAdraktamudIryate| raktapittAjjvaraH” (ni.a.8) iti||3-4||

viShametyAdinA kShayajamAha| atra ca viShamAsAtmyabhojyena tathA vyavAyena tathA veganigraheNa viShamAshanaja-dhAtukShayaja-vegasandhAraNajAnAM yakShmaNAM lakShaNabhUtakAsahetutrayaM pRuthaguktaM bhavati| atra prasannadRuShTitvAdi vyAdhiprabhAvAdbhavati| mishrAkRutiriti mishradoShali~ggo jvaro bhavati| bhinnetyAdi bhinnavarcastvamanimittato bhavati, tathA svarabhedo~apyanimitto bhavati| dehanAshana iti asAdhya ityarthaH| pAdaguNAnvitAviti vaidyAdipAdacatuShTayaguNavantau| na cAtra kadAcitsidhyetAmityabhidhAnena yApyatvasAdhyatvAnAmekaviShayatvaM; yato navayoreva catuShpAdasampattyA sAdhyatvamuktam, ato~anyathA kShatajo yApya ukta iti bhinnaviShayatA| kShayajakAsabhedaM yApyatayA darshayannAha- sthavirANAmityAdi| sthavirANAmityuktvA~api jarAkAsa iti vacanena sthavirANAM yo jarayA dehakShayakArikayA kRutaH sa yApyaH, yastu doShakRutaH sa sAdhya eva bhavatIti darshayati| anye tu jarAkAsaM doShakRuteShvevAntarbhAvayanti||24-30||
rUkShasyetyAdinA cikitsAmAha| shuShka UrdhvaH deho yasya sa shuShkordhvastaM, shuShkakAsagRuhItaM vA; sapittamUrdhvabhaktikairghRutairjayet, shuShkordhvameva sakaphaM snehavirecanairjayet||32-34||
caturthikAmiti palam||36-38||
tryUShaNAdye ‘dve pAThe’ ityanena svalpapatrAM dvitIyAM pAThAM grAhayanti| svaguptA shUkashimbI||39-42||
droNe~apAmityAdau vakShyamANAni ajamAMsAntAni kvAthyAni droNe eva sAdhyAni| mANikA aShTau palAni| jIvanIyAnIti jIvantyAdIni dasha ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAni||43-46||
ghRutamAtrayeti cUrNAloDanaucitayA ghRutamAtrayA| vastragAlitamiti vastrapUtam| karkaTakImiti karkaTashRu~ggIm||47-52||
citrakamityAdau shreyasImiti hastipippalIm| ardhatulAkvAtha iti atra tulArdhashabdollekhena kriyamANatvAd droNArdhajalena kvAthaH kartavyaH||53-56||

dashamUlItyAdau harItakIshatamiti harItakIphalashatam| yavaiH svinnairiti yavA yadA svinnA bhavanti tadA taM kaShAyaM pUtaM gRuhItvA harItakIshataM ca tadeva gRuhItvA guDatulAM ca dattvA punaH pAkaH kartavyaH| yavAnAM ca svinnatA caturbhAgAvasheSha eva kaShAye bhavatIti kRutvA caturbhAgAvashiShTamevAtra kaShAyaM kurvanti| ghRutatailakuDave cAtrAShTapalamAne eva, kuDave~api dvaiguNyasya pratipAditatvAt; tantrAntare cAtraiva yoge “madhunashca palAShTakam” ityuktam| tulyamAnatve~api cAtra ghRutamadhunordravyAntarayogasya vidyamAnatvAnna viruddhatvam; dravyAntarayoge sati madhughRutayostulyamAnatA~api na viruddhA bhavati| atra ca harItakIphalaM svinnaM ghRutataile prathamaM manAgbharjayanti avayavadArDhyArthaM, tataH kvAthAdiprakShepaH, avatArasamaye ca pippalIcUrNaprakShepaH, shItIbhUte ca madhu yam, idaM vRuddhavaidyAnAM karmAhuH| lihyAditi etaM prakRutaM lehaM lihyAt| dve cAbhaye ato rasAyanAt khAdet| nityaM nirantaramityarthaH; kiMvA dve abhaye lihyAt tathA dve cAbhaye khAdet, ityanena abhayAdvayasambaddhalehyabhAgaM lihyAt tatastadabhayAdvayaM khAdedityarthaH| agastyavihitamityanenAsya mahAjanasampradAyAgatatvenAtyarthasiddhatvamucyate||57-62||
khadirasAramiti khadirakAShThasAram| sasaindhavamiti IShatsaindhavena, avyaktalavaNamiti yAvat| atra madirAdibhiH ‘pibet’ ityanuvartate||63-64||

shirasa ityAdinA dhUmayogyAvasthopadarshanapUrvakaM dhUmamAhashirasaH pIDane ityAdi| shUlagauravAdinA shirasaH pIDane| dashA~ggulonmitAmityAdinA sUtrasthAnoktadhUmapAnavishiShTanalikAdividhAnamiha kAse vidhIyate| ayaM ca dhUmastathA vamanArthashca dhUmastantrAntare pRuthagevoktaH, tathAhi pa~jca dhUmAH snehana-prAyogika-vairecanikAH kAsaghno vAmanIyashca sushrute proktAH; tathA~apIha kAsaghnavAmanIyayo recanakArakatayA virecanIya evAvarodho j~jeyaH; parantu virecanIyatve~api kAsaghnasyAyaM nalikAmAnAdibheda ukta iti visheSho j~jeyaH| chidre iti upari nalikAmAne cchidre| jihmAmiti vakrAm| mukhenaiveti vacanena prAguktanAsApAnaM niShedhati||65-68||

manaHshiletyAdau alaM haritAlam, i~ggudaH putrajIvakaH| asya ca dhUmasya pashcAt kShIrapAnaM tIkShNenAnena dhUmena kriyamANaujaHkShayAdibhayaparihArArtham| sannipAtajashca kAso yadyapyatra noktastathA~api prakRutisamasannipAtakRutastu kAso bhavatyeveti vacanAdunnIyate; kiMvA sAnnipAtikaH kShayajakAsaH| vakShyate hi- “sannipAtabhavo hyeSha kShayakAsaH sudAruNaH| sannipAtahitaM tasmAt kAryamatra bhiShagjitam” iti| prapauNDarIketyAdau shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA| kRutvA vartimiti mAtrAshitIyoktavidhAnena vartiM kRutvA| kShaumasya celaH kShaumacelaH| vaMshalekhanaM vaMshanIlikA| AlaM haritAlam| sevyam ushIram| rohiShaM gandhatRuNam| pUrvakalpena pUrvoktavidhinA | nAgarairityantenaiko yogaH||69-75||

AtmaguptAnAmiti shUkashimbIphalAnAm| pa~jcakolaguDAnvitAmiti prakShiptapa~jcakolaguDAm| samatilAmiti samatilataNDulasAdhitAm| AmiShairiti matsyAdyAmiShaiH sataNDulaiH siddhAm| vAyasI kAkamAcI||76-82||

vamanaM sarpiSheti vamanadravyayuktena sarpiShA vamanaM kartavyam| yaShTyAhvaphalakalkairiti atra phalaM madanaphalam| pittakAse eva kAsaveganiHsAryamANasya kaphasya tanutAyAM ghanatAyAM ca pRuthak cikitsAmAha- paitte ityAdi| tiktakairyutAM trivRutAmiti sambandhaH| krama iti peyAdikramaH| paramiti peyAdikramAdUrdhvam| shasyata ityatra ‘upacAraH’ iti sheShaH| nIlIsAramiti nIlinIphalasAram| amRutaphalam Amalakam| sharkarAdiH kevalaH kevale paitte, sakaphe paitte samustamaricaH, saghRutastu sharkarAdiranilAnubandhe paitte j~jeyaH| mRudvIkArdhashataM triMshatpippalIshca vyakte, sa~gkhyAparigrahAt| goH kShIrapamiti kShIramAtrAshanam| pippalyAmalakamityAdau ghanashleShmaNIti ghanatAmApannakaphe| kAkolItyAdau pratyekaM yugmairiti sambadhyate| sharAdipa~jcamUlI tRuNapa~jcamUlam| abhiShukAdaya auttarApathikA vAtapittaharA “vAtAmAbhiShukAkShoDamukUlakanikocakAH” (sU.a.27) iti granthoktAshcatvAro j~jeyAH| jIvakAdayashca jIvanIyagaNoktAH| sharkarAdInAM ca kShayoktasarpirguDoktamAnAnusAreNa mAnamatra j~jeyam| sharkaretyAdau rasamiti kalkasyaiva rasam||83-107||
balinamityAdinA kaphakAsacikitsAmAha| pippalIkShArikairiti pippalIkShArasaMskRutaiH| dhAnvabailarasairiti dhanvajabileshayarasaiH| kAleShvannasya ca triShviti bhojanAdimadhyAvasAneShu||108-111||

madhuhi~gguyutamityatra ‘mAkShikaM hi~ggusindhUttha’ ityAdivacanAnusAreNa hi~ggumadhunI prakSheptavye| tenaiva vidhineti uShNodakena hi~ggusaindhavopetaM pibedityarthaH| surasasyAsitasya kRuShNaparNAshasya| madhunA lehAniti atrArdhashlokoktA lehA j~jeyAH||112-122||
dashamUlADhake iti dashamUlasya kvAthyasyADhakamAnatvaM, tena “kvAthaH kvAthyasamo mataH” iti vacanAt kvAtho~apyADhakamAno bhavati||123-124||
kaNTakArIghRute balAdikalkadravyasya militvA kuDavamAnatvam||125-129||

tamakaH kAsopadravarUpaH| kapho~anubandho~asyeti kaphAnubandhaH, tasmin kaphAnubandhe pavane| pittAnubandhayorityatrApi vAtakaphayoranubandhatvaM, pittasya tu prAdhAnyam; ata eva pittanAshinI kriyoktA tatra| Ardre iti tanukaphe||131-133||
kAsamityAdinA kShatajakAsacikitsAmAha| pippalyAdike lehe yavAdayastailAntAH pratyekaM prasRutamAnAH||134-137||

vRuttiriti cikitsA| saMsarge tviti vAtapittAdisaMsarge| visheShaNamiti cikitsAvisheSho ‘vAtapittArdite’ ityAdinA vakShyamANo j~jeyaH| vAtapittArdita ityAdinA kShatakAse evAvasthikIM cikitsAmAha| jIvanIyaM sarpirvAtarakte vakShyamANam| mahatIM mAtrAmiti ahorAtreNa pariNamanIyAM prAyo~aShTapalapramANAm| nivRutte kShatadoShe iti kShatavraNe prashAnte| kShaumalaktakairvartitairiti yathoktoShadhena kShaumalepAdvartIkRutaiH| pibet kShaumamityatra kShaumaM bhAvayitvA dhUmaM pibedityarthaH| tittiripratibhojanamiti tittirirasAnupAnam| kShaumaM dhUmaM pibediti kShaumaM dagdhvA dhUmaM pibet| ayoguDairiti lohaguDaiH shRutaM kShIram||138-148||

pratyAkhyAyAcaret kriyAmityanena uktalakShaNe~api kShayaje kAdAcitkIM siddhiM darshayati| shampAka AragvadhaH| karkaTakI karkaTashRu~ggI| tAlasasyaM tAlaphalam| ghRutamaNDo ghRutoparistyAnabhAgaH| auShNyAdityAdau kaphamiti cchedaH| shuddhaishca tairiti shuddhaiH srotobhiH||149-157||
dvipa~jcamUlItyAdau kShAralavaNAnAM ca yuktyA dAnavacanena stokamAtraM dAnaM lavaNIkaraNaprayojanArthaM darshayati||158-160||

samprAptimAha- adha ityAdi| udAnabhAvamApanna iti UrdhvagatisvabhAvamApannaH| khAnIti srotAMsi| nirbhujyeti AkShipya| stambhayan netrAdInyeva| kasanAditIti yathoktagatimattvAt tathA uraHprabhRutishAtanAcca ‘kAsa’ ityanvarthasa~jj~jayocyate| ‘kasa’ gatishAtanayoH, ityasya dhAtorayaM prayogaH||6-8||
guDUcItyAdau shreyasI rAsnA| tatsamamiti kvAthasamam||161-162||
kShIrasiddhairiti kShIrasvinnaiH| yavakShArasAdhitaM ghRutaM yavakShAraghRutam||163-167||
etena vidhineti vyoShatailaguDAnvitam| vitunnakaM suniShaNNakam| pANitalaM karShaH||168-179||
patrakalkaM tilvakasyeti sambandhaH| utkAriketi ‘patrakalkaM’ ityAdinoktA utkArikA| gaNDIraH shamaThaH| gaurAmalaka ArdrAmalakaH| sAmla iti dADimAdiyogAdamlaH||180-186||

vyatyAsAditi kriyAparivartanAt| kShayajakAsasya sannipAtodbhava ityAdinA sAnnipAtikatvamabhidhAya, doShodrekavisheShAnubandharUpeNa cikitsAvisheShasUtramAha- doShAnubandhayogAcca haredrogabalAbalamiti ; atra ‘buddhvA’ ityadhyAhAryam| doShANAmanubandhaH utkarShApakarShAdinA sambandhaH, tadapekSho yogaH; atra pa~jcamI hetau; tena doShAnubandharUpeNa bheShajayogena rogasya kShayakAsasya balavantamabalaM ca doShaM haret| anye tu ‘doShAnubandhayogAcca kuryAdrogabalAbalam’ iti paThanti| tatra doShAnubandhayogAdrogabalAbalaM buddhvA kuryAdbhiShagjitamiti sambandhaH| kAseShviti vAtapittakaphakShatakShayajeShu||187-189||
rUkShetyAdinA vAtajasya hetulakShaNe Aha| pratAmyata iti tamasIva pravishataH| UrdhvavAtasyeti UrdhvagatayA prakupitavAtasya||10-13||

kaTvityAdinA pittakAsahetuli~gge prAha| agnisUryaja iti agnisUryabhavaH santApa ityarthaH| urodhUmAyanamiti uraso dhUmodvamanamiva| pittaje~apyasmi~j shleShmaniShThIvanaM vyAdheruraHprabhRutikaphasthAnabhUtatvena shleShmapittasaMsargajatayeti j~jeyam||14-16||
gurvityAdinA shleShmajamAha||17-19||
ativyavAyetyAdinA kShatajamAha| uraH kShataM gRuhItveti kShatamuraH prApyetyarthaH| ayaM ca kAsaH sAhasajayakShmarUpe~apyukto j~jeyaH||20-23||
athAto~atIsAracikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
doShAH sannicitA yasya vidagdhAhAramUrcchitAH| atIsArAya kalpante bhUyastAn sampravartayet||14||
na tu sa~ggrahaNaM deyaM pUrvamAmAtisAriNe| vibadhyamAnAH prAgdoShA janayantyAmayAn bahUn||15||
daNDakAlasakAdhmAnagrahaNyarshogadAMstathA| shothapANDvAmayaplIhakuShThagulmodarajvarAn||16||
tasmAdupekShetotkliShTAn vartamAnAn svayaM malAn| kRucchraM vA vahatAM dadyAdabhayAM sampravartinIm||17||
tayA pravAhite doShe prashAmyatyudarAmayaH| jAyate dehalaghutA jaTharAgnishca vardhate||18||
pramathyAM madhyadoShANAM dadyAddIpanapAcanIm| la~gghanaM cAlpadoShANAM prashastamatisAriNAm||19||
pippalI nAgaraM dhAnyaM bhUtIkamabhayA vacA| hrIveraM bhadramustAni bilvaM nAgaradhAnyakam||20||
pRushniparNI shvadaMShTrA ca sama~ggA kaNTakArikA| tisraH pramathyA vihitAH shlokArdhairatisAriNAm||21||
vacAprativiShAbhyAM vA mustaparpaTakena vA| hrIverashRu~ggaverAbhyAM pakvaM vA pAyayejjalam||22||
yukte~annakAle kShutkShAmaM laghUnyannAni bhojayet| tathA sa shIghramApnoti rucimagnibalaM balam||23||
takreNAvantisomena yavAgvA tarpaNena vA| surayA madhunA cAdau yathAsAtmyamupAcaret||24||
yavAgUbhirvilepIbhiH khaDairyUShai rasaudanaiH| dIpanagrAhisaMyuktaiH kramashca syAdataH param||25||
shAlaparNIM pRushniparNIM bRuhatIM kaNTakArikAm| balAM shvadaMShTrAM bilvAni pAThAM nAgaradhAnyakam||26||
shaTIM palAshaM hapuShAM vacAM jIrakapippalIm| yavAnIM pippalImUlaM citrakaM hastipippalIm||27||
vRukShAmlaM dADimAmlaM ca sahi~ggu biDasaindhavam| prayojayedannapAne vidhinA sUpakalpitam||28||
vAtashleShmaharo hyeSha gaNo dIpanapAcanaH| grAhI balyo rocanashca tasmAcchasto~atisAriNAm||29||
Ame pariNate yastu vibaddhamatisAryate| sashUlapicchamalpAlpaM bahushaH sapravAhikam||30||
yUSheNa mUlakAnAM taM badarANAmathApi vA| upodikAyAH kShIriNyA yavAnyA vAstukasya vA||31||
suvarcalAyAshca~jcorvA shAkenAvalgujasya vA| shaTyAH karkArukANAM vA jIvantyAshcirbhaTasya vA||32||
loNikAyAH sapAThAyAH shuShkashAkena vA punaH| dadhidADimasiddhena bahusnehena bhojayet||33||
kalkaH syAdbAlabilvAnAM tilakalkashca tatsamaH| dadhnaH saro~amlasnehAdyaH khaDo hanyAt pravAhikAm||34||
yavAnAM mudgamAShANAM shAlInAM ca tilasya ca| kolAnAM bAlabilvAnAM dhAnyayUShaM prakalpayet||35||
aikadhyaM yamake bhRuShTaM dadhidADimasArikam| varcaHkShaye shuShkamukhaM shAlyannaM tena bhojayet||36||
dadhnaH saraM vA yamake bhRuShTaM saguDanAgaram| surAM vA yamake bhRuShTAM vya~jjanArthe pradApayet||37||
phalAmlaM yamake bhRuShTaM yUShaM gRu~jjanakasya vA| lopAkarasamamlaM vA snigdhAmlaM kacchapasya vA||38||
barhitittiridakShANAM vartakAnAM tathA rasAH| snigdhAmlAH shAlayashcAgryA varcaHkShayarujApahAH||39||
antarAdhirasaM pUtvA raktaM meShasya cobhayam| paceddADimasArAmlaM sadhAnyasnehanAgaram||40||
odanaM raktashAlInAM tenAdyAt prapibecca tat| tathA varcaHkShayakRutairvyAdhibhirvipramucyate||41||
gudaniHsaraNe shUle pAnamamlasya sarpiShaH| prashasyate nirAmANAmathavA~apyanuvAsanam||42||
cA~ggerIkoladadhyamlanAgarakShArasaMyutam| ghRutamutkvathitaM peyaM gudabhraMsharujApaham||43||
iti cA~ggerIghRutamsacavyapippalImUlaM savyoShaviDadADimam| peyamamlaM ghRutaM yuktyA sadhAnyAjAjicitrakam||44||
iti gudabhraMshe cavyAdighRutam

dashamUlopasiddhaM vA sabilvamanuvAsanam| shaTIshatAhvAbilvairvA vacayA citrakeNa vA||45||

Commentary: dashamUlopasiddhamityAdau anuvAsanamiti anuvAsanasnehaH| atrAnuvAsane snehastu prAyodarshanAttailameva; anye tu ghRutasya prakrAntatvAddhRutamevAhuH| shaTItyAdinA~apyanuvAsanasnehatrayamucyate||45||
iti gudabhraMshe~anuvAsanam

stabdhabhraShTagude pUrvaM snehasvedau prayojayet| susvinnaM taM mRudUbhUtaM picunA sampraveshayet||46||

Commentary: picunA sampraveshayediti picunA~a~acchAditaM pIDayitvA praveshayet| picuH sthUlakarpaTikA||46||

bhagavantaM khalvAtreyaM kRutAhnikaM hutAgnihotramAsInamRuShigaNaparivRutamuttare himavataH pArshve vinayAdupetyAbhivAdya cAgnivesha uvAca- bhagavan! atIsArasya prAgutpattinimittalakShaNopashamanAni prajAnugrahArthamAkhyAtumarhasIti||3||

Commentary: prAgutpattiriti prAkkAlotpattiH||3||

atha bhagavAn punarvasurAtreyastadagniveshavacanamanunishamyovAca- shrUyatAmagnivesha! sarvametadakhilena vyAkhyAyamAnam| AdikAle khalu yaj~jeShu pashavaH samAlabhanIyA babhUvurnAlambhAya prakriyante sma| tato dakShayaj~jaM pratyavarakAlaM manoH putrANAM nariShyannAbhAgekShvAkunRugasharyAtyAdInAM kratuShu pashUnAmevAbhyanuj~jAnAt pashavaH prokShaNamavApuH| atashca pratyavarakAlaM pRuShadhreNa dIrghasatreNa yajatA pashUnAmalAbhAdgavAmAlambhaH pravartitaH| taM dRuShTvA pravyathitA bhUtagaNAH, teShAM copayogAdupAkRutAnAM gavAM gauravAdauShNyAdasAtmyatvAdashastopayogAccopahatAgnInAmupahatamanasAM cAtIsAraH pUrvamutpannaH pRuShadhrayaj~je||4||

Commentary: AdikAle iti kRutayuge| samAlabhanIyA iti mantreNa abhimantryaiva parityAjyA babhUvuH; na AlambhArthaM prakriyante sma iti AlambhAya mAraNAya na prakriyante sma na saMskriyante sma ityarthaH| nariShyannAbhAgAdimanuputreShvekameva manuputramudAhArya yadyAdishabdaH kriyate tadA teShAM kvacidanyatra samudAyena pAThAt buddhibhramaH syAt, tena sAkShAjj~jAnArthaM katipaye paThitAH; apaThitAshcAdishabdena prakAravAcinA itihAsaj~jAnArthaM purANeShUnneyAH| pashUnAmabhyanuj~jAnAditi pashUnAmeva preraNayA; preraNA caiShAM vishiShTApUrvotpAdArthamevocyate AgameShu- ‘kratvarthahiMsAyAM vadhakavadhyayorubhayorapi mahatpuNyamutpadyate’ iti; kiMvA pashUnAmevAbhyanuj~jAnAditi vede pashUnAM vadhyatvenAbhyanuj~jAnAt| prokShaNamiti vidhipUrvakaM mAraNam| pRuShadhraH rAjavisheShaH| dIrghasatreNeti dIrghakAlanirvartyena| vyathitA iti adRuShTapUrvaM gavAM vadhaM dRuShTvA duHkhitAH santaH| upAkRutAnAmiti abhimantrya hatAnAm| uktaM hi- “upAkRutaH pashurasau yo~abhimantrya kratau hataH” iti| anena ca prAgutpattinidarshanena mAnasopaghAto gurvAdisevA cAtIsArakAraNaM bhavatItyupadarshyate||4||
vibaddhavAtavarcAstu bahushUlapravAhikaH| saraktapicchastRuShNArtaH kShIrasauhityamarhati||47||
yamakasyopari kShIraM dhAroShNaM vA pibennaraH| shRutameraNDamUlena bAlabilvena vA payaH ||48||
evaM kShIraprayogeNa raktaM picchA ca shAmyati| shUlaM pravAhikA caiva vibandhashcopashAmyati||49||

pittAtisAraM punarnidAnopashayAkRutibhirAmAnvayamupalabhya yathAbalaM la~gghanapAcanAbhyAmupAcaret| tRuShyatastu mustaparpaTakoshIrasArivAcandanakirAtatiktakodIcyavAribhirupacAraH| la~gghitasya cAhArakAle balAtibalAsUrpaparNIshAlaparNIpRushniparNIbRuhatIkaNTakArikAshatAvarIshvadaMShTrAniryUhasaMyuktena yathAsAtmyaM yavAgUmaNDAdinA tarpaNAdinA vA krameNopacAraH| mudgamasUrahareNumakuShThakADhakIyUShairvA lAvakapi~jjalashashahariNaiNakAlapucchakarasairIShadamlairanamlairvA kramasho~agniM sandhukShayet| anubandhe tvasya dIpanIyapAcanIyopashamanIyasa~ggrahaNIyAn yogAn samprayojayediti||50||

Commentary: AmAnvayamiti Amayuktam| la~gghanapAcanAbhyAmupAcaredityanena yat pUrvamAmAtisAre sAmAnyavidhAnamuktaM tadiha nAnumanyate; pittaM hi saraM, tatra ca pravartane kriyamANe~atiyogabhayaM syAditi bhAvaH| yattu virecanamiha vaktavyaM tat sAmagrIvisheShasampattAveva| la~gghitasya cetyAdau sUrpaparNI mudgamAShaparNyau| nirvyUhashabdena ca ShaDa~ggavidhAnasiddhaM jalamucyate, yavAgvAdisAdhane tasyaivAdhikArAt| anubandhe tvasyeti pittAtisArAnubandhe| imAniti vakShyamANAn||50||
sakShaudrAtiviShaM piShTvA vatsakasya phalatvacam| pibet pittAtisAraghnaM taNDulodakasaMyutam||51||
kirAtatiktako mustaM vatsakaH sarasA~jjanaH| bilvaM dAruharidrA tvak hrIberaM sadurAlabham||52||
candanaM ca mRuNAlaM ca nAgaraM lodhramutpalam| tilA mocaraso lodhraM sama~ggA kamalotpalam||53||
utpalaM dhAtakIpuShpaM dADimatva~gmahauShadham| kaTphalaM nAgaraM pAThA jambvAmrAsthidurAlabhAH||54||
yogAH ShaDete sakShaudrAstaNDulodakasaMyutAH| peyAH pittAtisAraghnAH shlokArdhena nidarshitAH||55||
jIrNoShadhAnAM shasyante yathAyogaM prakalpitaiH| rasaiH sA~ggrAhikairyuktAH purANA raktashAlayaH||56||
pittAtisAro dIpAgneH kShipraM samupashAmyati| ajAkShIraprayogeNa balaM varNashca vardhate||57||
bahudoShasya dIptAgneH saprANasya na tiShThati| paittiko yadyatIsAraH payasA taM virecayet||58||
palAshaphalaniryUhaM payasA saha pAyayet| tato~anupAyayet koShNaM kShIrameva yathAbalam||59||
pravAhite tena male prashAmyatyudarAmayaH| palAshavat prayojyA vA trAyamANA vishodhinI||60||
sAMsargyAM kriyamANAyAM shUlaM yadyanuvartate| srutadoShasya taM shIghraM yathAvadanuvAsayet||61||
shatapuShpAvarIbhyAM ca payasA madhukena ca| tailapAdaM ghRutaM siddhaM sabilvamanuvAsanam||62||
kRutAnuvAsanasyAsya kRutasaMsarjanasya ca| vartate yadyatIsAraH picchAbastirataH param||63||
pariveShTya kushairArdrairArdravRuntAni shAlmaleH| kRuShNamRuttikayA~a~alipya svedayedgomayAgninA||64||
sushuShkAM mRuttikAM j~jAtvA tAni vRuntAni shAlmaleH| shRute payasi mRudnIyAdApothyolUkhale tataH||65||
piNDaM muShTisamaM prasthe tat pUtaM tailasarpiShoH| snehitaM mAtrayA yuktaM kalkena madhukasya ca||66||
bastimabhyaktagAtrAya dadyAt pratyAgate tataH| snAtvA bhu~jjIta payasA jA~ggalAnAM rasena vA||67||
pittAtisArajvarashothagulmajIrNAtisAragrahaNIpradoShAn| jayatyayaM shIghramatipravRuddhAn virecanAsthApanayoshca bastiH ||68||
pittAtisArI yastvetAM kriyAM muktvA niShevate| pittalAnyannapAnAni tasya pittaM mahAbalam||69||
kuryAdraktAtisAraM tu raktamAshu pradUShayet| tRuShNAM shUlaM vidAhaM ca gudapAkaM ca dAruNam||70||
tatra cchAgaM payaH shastaM shItaM samadhusharkaram| pAnArthaM bhojanArthaM ca gudaprakShAlane tathA||71||
odanaM raktashAlInAM payasA tena bhojayet| rasaiH pArAvatAdInAM ghRutabhRuShTaiH sasharkaraiH||72||
shashapakShimRugANAM ca shItAnAM dhanvacAriNAm| rasairanamlaiH saghRutairbhojayettaM sasharkaraiH||73||
rudhiraM mArgamAjaM vA ghRutabhRuShTaM prashasyate| kAshmaryaphalayUSho vA ki~jcidamlaH sasharkaraH||74||
nIlotpalaM mocarasaM sama~ggA padmakesharam| ajAkShIrayutaM dadyAjjIrNe ca payasaudanam||75||
durbalaM pAyayitvA vA tasyaivopari bhojayet| prAgbhaktaM navanItaM vA dadyAt samadhusharkaram||76||
prAshya kShIrotthitaM sarpiH kapi~jjalarasAshanaH| tryahAdArogyamApnoti payasA kShIrabhuk tathA||77||
pItvA shatAvarIkalkaM payasA kShIrabhugjayet| raktAtisAraM pItvA vA tayA siddhaM ghRutaM naraH||78||
ghRutaM yavAgUmaNDena kuTajasya phalaiH shRutam| peyaM tasyAnu pAtavyA peyA raktopashAntaye||79||
tvak ca dAruharidrAyAH kuTajasya phalAni ca| pippalI shRu~ggaveraM ca drAkShA kaTukarohiNI||80||
ShaDbhiretairghRutaM siddhaM peyAmaNDAvacAritam| atIsAraM jayecchIghraM tridoShamapi dAruNam||81||
kRuShNamRunmadhukaM sha~gkhaM rudhiraM taNDulodakam| pItamekatra sakShaudraM raktasa~ggrahaNaM param||82||
pItaH priya~ggukAkalkaH sakShaudrastaNDulAmbhasA| raktasrAvaM jayecchIghraM dhanvamAMsarasAshinaH||83||
kalkastilAnAM kRuShNAnAM sharkarApa~jcabhAgikaH| Ajena payasA pItaH sadyo raktaM niyacchati||84||
palaM vatsakabIjasya shrapayitvA rasaM pibet| yo rasAshI jayecchIghraM sa paittaM jaTharAmayam||85||
pItvA sasharkarAkShaudraM candanaM taNDulAmbhasA| dAhatRuShNApramehebhyo raktasrAvAcca mucyate||86||
gudo bahubhirutthAnairyasya pittena pacyate| secayettaM sushItena paTolamadhukAmbunA||87||
pa~jcavalkamadhUkAnAM rasairikShurasairghRutaiH| chAgairgavyaiH payobhirvA sharkarAkShaudrasaMyutaiH||88||
prakShAlanAnAM kalkairvA sasarpiShkaiH pralepayet| eShAM vA sukRutaishcUrNaistaM gudaM pratisArayet||89||
dhAtakIlodhracUrNairvA samAMshaiH pratisArayet| tathA sravati no raktaM gudaM taiH pratisAritam||90||
pakvatA prashamaM yAti vedanA copashAmyati| yathoktaiH secanaiH shItaiH shoNite~atisravatyapi||91||
gudava~gkShaNakaTyUru secayedghRutabhAvitam| candanAdyena tailena shatadhautena sarpiShA||92||
alpAlpaM bahusho raktaM sashUlamupaveshyate||93||
yadA vAyurvibaddhashca kRucchraM carati vA na vA| picchAbastiM tadA tasya yathoktamupakalpayet||94||
prapauNDarIkasiddhena sarpiShA cAnuvAsayet| prAyasho durbalagudAshcirakAlAtisAriNaH||95||
pavano~atipravRutto hi sve sthAne labhate~adhikam||96||
balaM tasya sapittasya jayArthe bastiruttamaH| raktaM viTsahitaM pUrvaM pashcAdvA yo~atisAryate||97||
shatAvarIghRutaM tasya lehArthamupakalpayet| sharkarArdhAMshikaM lIDhaM navanItaM navoddhRutam||98||
kShaudrapAdaM jayecchIghraM taM vikAraM hitAshinaH| nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthashu~ggAnApothya vAsayet||99||
ahorAtraM jale tapte ghRutaM tenAmbhasA pacet| tadardhasharkarAyuktaM lihyAt sakShaudrapAdikam||100||

yastvevaM durbalo mohAt pittalAnyeva sevate||101||

Commentary: valIpAkamiti gudavalIpAkam||101||-

athAvarakAlaM vAtalasya vAtAtapavyAyAmAtimAtraniSheviNo rUkShAlpapramitAshinastIkShNamadyavyavAyanityasyodAvartayatashca vegAn vAyuH prakopamApadyate, paktA copahanyate; sa vAyuH kupito~agnAvupahate mUtrasvedau purIShAshayamupahRutya, tAbhyAM purIShaM dravIkRutya, atIsArAya prakalpate| tasya rUpANi- vijjalamAmaM viplutamavasAdi rUkShaM dravaM sashUlamAmagandhamIShacchabdamashabdaM vA vibaddhamUtravAtamatisAryate purIShaM, vAyushcAntaHkoShThe sashabdashUlastiryak carati vibaddha ityAmAtisAro vAtAt| pakvaM vA vibaddhamalpAlpaM sashabdaM sashUlaphenapicchAparikartikaM hRuShTaromA viniHshvasa~j shuShkamukhaH kaTyUrutrikajAnupRuShThapArshvashUlI bhraShTagudo muhurmuhurvigrathitamupaveshyate purIShaM vAtAt; tamAhuranugrathitamityeke, vAtAnugrathitavarcastvAt||5||

Commentary: athetyAdinA vAtAtIsArAdInAM pRutha~gnimittalakShaNe brUte| vAtalasyetyanena vAtaprakRutiM prApya vAtAtapAdInAM vAtAtIsArajanane sAmarthyAtishayo darshyate; tenAnyaprakRuterapi vAtAtapAdayo~atIsArasya kAraNaM bhavantIti j~jeyam| evaM pittalashleShmalashabdayorapi tAtparyaM vyAkhyeyam| pramitAshanam atItakAlAshanam| vegAnudAvartayata iti udvRuttamAvartayato vegAnityarthaH| purIShAshayamupahRutyeti pakvAshayaM nItvA| tAbhyAmiti mUtrasvedAbhyAm| tasya rUpANItyAdinA AmavAtAtIsAralakShaNamAha| Amamiti AmAnugatam | viplutamiti prasaraNashIlam| avasAdIti bhUmau patitaM lInaM bhavati| pakvaM vetyAdinA pakvavAtAtisAramAha| viniHshvasinniti shabdaM kurvan| tamAhuranugrathitamiti vigrathitapurIShAtisArAvasthAM prAptaM vAtAtisAram| vAtagrathitavarcastvAdityanena yatra pakvavAtAtisAre~api vAtAnugrathitavarcastvaM na bhavati nAsAvanugrathitasa~jj~ja iti darshayati||5||
shleShmAtisAre prathamaM hitaM la~gghanapAcanam||102||
yojyashcAmAtisAraghno yathokto dIpano gaNaH| la~gghitasyAnupUrvyAM ca kRutAyAM na nivartate||103||
bilvaM karkaTikA mustamabhayA vishvabheShajam||104||
vacA viDa~ggaM bhUtIkaM dhAnyakaM devadAru ca| kuShThaM sAtiviShA pAThA cavyaM kaTukarohiNI||105||
pippalI pippalImUlaM citrakaM hastipippalI| yogA~jchlokArdhavihitAMshcaturastAn prayojayet||106||
shRutA~jchleShmAtisAreShu kAyAgnibalavardhanAn| ajAjImasitAM pAThAM nAgaraM maricAni ca||107||
dhAtakIdviguNaM dadyAnmAtulu~ggarasAplutam| rasA~jjanaM sAtiviShaM kuTajasya phalAni ca||108||
dhAtakIdviguNaM dadyAt pAtuM sakShaudranAgaram| dhAtakI nAgaraM bilvaM lodhraM padmasya kesharam||109||
jambUtva~gnAgaraM dhAnyaM pAThA mocaraso balA| sama~ggA dhAtakI bilvamadhyaM jambvAmrayostvacaH||110||
kapitthAni viDa~ggAni nAgaraM maricAni ca| cA~ggerIkolatakrAmlAMshcaturastAn kaphottare||111||
shlokArdhavihitAn dadyAt sasnehalavaNAn khaDAn| kapitthamadhyaM lIDhvA tu savyoShakShaudrasharkaram||112||
kaNAM madhuyutAM pItvA takraM pItvA sacitrakam||113||
jagdhvA vA bAlabilvAni mucyate jaTharAmayAt| bAlabilvaM guDaM tailaM pippalIM vishvabheShajam| lihyAdvAte pratihate sashUlaH sapravAhikaH||114||
bhojyaM mUlakaShAyeNa vAtaghnaishcopasevanaiH| vAtAtisAravihitairyUShairmAMsarasaiH khaDaiH||115||
pUrvoktamamlasarpirvA ShaTpalaM vA yathAbalam| purANaM vA ghRutaM dadyAdyavAgUmaNDamishritam||116||
vAtashleShmavibandhe vA kaphe vA~atisravatyapi| shUle pravAhikAyAM vA picchAbastiM prayojayet||117||
pippalIbilvakuShThAnAM shatAhvAvacayorapi| kalkaiH salavaNairyuktaM pUrvoktaM sannidhApayet||118||
pratyAgate sukhaM snAtaM kRutAhAraM dinAtyaye| bilvatailena matimAnsukhoShNenAnuvAsayet||119||
vacAntairathavA kalkaistailaM paktvA~anuvAsayet| bahushaH kaphavAtArtastathA sa labhate sukham||120||

sve sthAne mAruto~avashyaM vardhate kaphasa~gkShaye| sa vRuddhaH sahasA hanyAttasmAttaM tvarayA jayet||121||

Commentary: samprati sarvAtisAreShu pakvAshayavyApakatvena vAyuravashyaM vRuddho bhavati, sa cAshukAritayA tvarayA jetavya iti darshayannAha- sve sthAne ityAdi| kaphasa~gkShayAdityanena kaphasa~gkShaye rUkShasharIratayA vAyuH kupyati, shleShmashoNite vRuddhe tadupasnehitasharIre vAyurnivRuttaprasaro bhavatIti||121||

vAtasyAnu jayet pittaM, pittasyAnu jayet kapham| trayANAM vA jayet pUrvaM yo bhavedbalavattamaH||122||

Commentary: pUrvaM jvarAdhyAye sannipAtacikitsAyA “kaphasthAnAnupUrvyA vA” (ci.a.3) ityanena kaphapittavAtAnAM krameNa cikitsoktA atIsAre~api tridoShaje kadAcit syAdityAsha~gkyAtra vishiShTaM kramamAha- vAtasyAnvityAdi| ayaM ca kramo nirAmasannipAtAtisAre eva j~jeyaH; sAme tu prathamamAmasyaiva cikitsitaM kartavyam| samatridoShAtisAracikitsAkramabhidhAya viShamatridoShAtisAracikitsAkramamAha- trayANAmityAdi||122||

tatra shlokaH- prAgutpattinimittAni lakShaNaM sAdhyatA na ca| kriyA cAvasthikI siddhA nirdiShTA hyatisAriNAm||123||

Commentary: prAgutpattItyAdinA~adhyAyArthasa~ggrahaH||123||

pittalasya punaramlalavaNakaTukakShAroShNatIkShNAtimAtraniSheviNaH pratatAgnisUryasantApoShNamArutopahatagAtrasya krodherShyAbahulasya pittaM prakopamApadyate| tat prakupitaM dravatvAdUShmANamupahatya purIShAshayavisRutamauShNyAd dravatvAt saratvAcca bhittvA purIShamatisArAya prakalpate| tasya rUpANi- hAridraM haritaM nIlaM kRuShNaM raktapittopahitamatidurgandhamatisAryate purIShaM, tRuShNAdAhasvedamUrcchAshUlabradhnasantApapAkaparIta iti pittAtisAraH||6||

Commentary: pittalasyetyAdinA pittAtisAramAha| dravatvAdUShmANamupahatyeti yadyapi pittamuShNamagneH samAnatayA vardhakaM bhavatIti yujyate, tathA~api dravatvAdUShmANamagnirUpaM hantItyarthaH| purIShAshayavisRutamiti purIShAshayagataM pittam| bradhnaH gudaH||6||

shleShmalasya tu gurumadhurashItasnigdhopasevinaH sampUrakasyAcintayato divAsvapnaparasyAlasasya shleShmA prakopamApadyate| sa svabhAvAd gurumadhurashItasnigdhaH srasto~agnimupahatya saumyasvabhAvAt purIShAshayamupahatyopakledya purIShamatisArAya kalpate| tasya rUpANi- snigdhaM shvetaM picchilaM tantumadAmaM guru durgandhaM shleShmopahitamanubaddhashUlamalpAlpamabhIkShNamatisAryate sapravAhikaM, gurUdaragudabastiva~gkShaNadeshaH kRute~apyakRutasa~jj~jaH salomaharShaH sotklesho nidrAlasyaparItaH sadano~annadveShI ceti shleShmAtisAraH||7||

Commentary: shleShmalasyetyAdinA shleShmAtisAramAha| sampUrakasyeti atimAtrAshanashIlasya| shleShmaNo~agnyupaghAte hetumAha- saumyasvabhAvAditi; saumyasyAgnerviruddhatvAdupaghAtaM karotIti yuktameveti bhAvaH| purIShAshayamupahatyeti purIShAshayaM gatvA, hantergatihiMsArthakatvAdatra gatyarthatA; kiMvA purIShAshayashabdena sthAnena sthAnina upacArAt purIShamevocyate, yathA- ‘ma~jcAH kroshanti’ itivat, tatashca purIShamupahatyeti sambandhaH| kRute~apyakRutasa~jj~ja iti kRute~api vege na vegaM kRutaM budhyata ityarthaH| atra ca pittAtisAre shleShmAtisAre ca sAmatAlakShaNaM yadyapi noktaM, tathA~api sAmavAtAtIsArasambandhakRutavijjalatvAmagandhitvaprakArairlakShaNaistayorapyAmAtisArarUpA~avasthA j~jeyaiva| tathAhi cikitsAvasare ‘pittAtisAraM punarnidAnopashayAkRutibhirAmAnvayaM viditvA’ ityAdinA~a~amAtisAre pRuthak cikitsAM vakShyati, shleShmAtisAre tu sAme nirAme ca rUkShoShNAdirUpA cikitsA samAnaiveti kRutvA pRuthagAmashleShmAtIsAracikitsA noktA; kShArapANinA sarvAtisArANAmeva sAmatA pRuthaguktA; vacanaM hi- “vAtAtisAraH sAmashca sashUlaH phenilastanuH| shyAvaH sashabdo durgandho vibaddho~alpAlpa eva ca|| evaM pittakaphe sAmamatIsAraM vinirdishet” iti| atrApi prAsRutayogikAyAM siddhau (si.a.8) sarvadoShANAmevAmasambandhAt pRuthagbhedA uktAH||7||

atishItasnigdharUkShoShNagurukharakaThinaviShamaviruddhAsAtmyabhojanAdabhojanAt kAlAtItabhojanAd yatki~jcidabhyavaharaNAt praduShTamadyapAnIyapAnAdatimadyapAnAdasaMshodhanAt pratikarmaNAM viShamagamanAdanupacArAjjvalanAdityapavanasalilAtisevanAdasvapnA- datisvapnAdvegavidhAraNAdRutuviparyayAdayathAbalamArambhAdbhayashokacittodvegAtiyogAt kRumishoShajvarArshovikArAtikarShaNAdvA vyApannAgnestrayo doShAH prakupitA bhUya evAgnimupahatya pakvAshayamanupravishyAtIsAraM sarvadoShali~ggaM janayanti||8||

Commentary: atishItetyAdinA tridoShajAtIsAramAha| atra ca shItAdInAM yathAsambhavaM vAtAdikartRutvaM j~jeyaM; kiMvA sarveShAmeva tridoShakartRutvaM j~jeyam| uktaM hi- “shamaprakopau sarveShAM doShANAmagnisaMshritau” (ci.a.5) iti| yatki~jcidabhyavaharaNAditi pathyApathyabhojanAt| anupacArAditi pratikarmaNAmevAsamyagupacArAdityarthaH| salilAtisevanAdityatra avagAhAdinA bAhyasevanaM salilasyocyate, atipAnaM tu prAgevoktam| vyApannAgneriti vacanAdyathoktahetUnAmagnivadhadvAraiva prAyastridoShakartRutvaM darshayati||8||

api ca shoNitAdIn dhAtUnatiprakRuShTaM dUShayanto dhAtudoShasvabhAvakRutAnatIsAravarNAnupadarshayanti| tatra shoNitAdiShu dhAtuShvatipraduShTeShu hAridraharitanIlamA~jjiShThamAMsadhAvanasannikAshaM raktaM kRuShNaM shvetaM varAhabhedaHsadRushamanubaddhavedanamavedanaM vA samAsavyatyAsAdupaveshyate shakRud grathitamAmaM sakRut, sakRudapi pakvamanatikShINamAMsashoNitabalo mandAgnirvihatamukharasashca; tAdRushamAturaM kRucchrasAdhyaM vidyAt| ebhirvarNairatisAryamANaM sopadravamAturamasAdhyo~ayamiti pratyAcakShIta; tadyathA- pakvashoNitAbhaM yakRutkhaNDopamaM medomAMsodakasannikAshaM dadhighRutamajjatailavasAkShIravesavArAbhamatinIlamatiraktamatikRuShNamudakamivAcchaM punarmecakAbhamatisnigdhaM haritanIlakaShAyavarNaM karburamAvilaM picchilaM tantumadAmaM candrakopagatamatikuNapapUtipUyagandhyAmAmamatsyagandhi makShikAkAntaM kuthitabahudhAtusrAvamalpapurIShamapurIShaM vA~atisAryamANaM tRuShNAdAhajvarabhramatamakahikkAshvAsAnubandhamativedanamavedanaM vA srastapakvagudaM patitagudavaliM muktanAlamatikShINabalamAMsashoNitaM sarvaparvAsthishUlinamarocakAratipralApasammohaparItaM sahasoparatavikAramatisAriNamacikitsyaM vidyAt; iti sannipAtAtisAraH||9||

Commentary: apicetyAdinA vikRutiviShamasamavAyArabdhatridoShajalakShaNamAha| atiprakRuShTaM pradUShayanta iti atiprakRuShTaM yathA bhavati tathA pradUShayanta ityarthaH| mAMsadhAvanaM mAMsaprakShAlanodakam| samAsavyatyAsAdupaveshyata iti samAsaH yathoktalakShaNAnAM melakaH, vyatyAsaH amelakaH| sakRuditi kadAcit| vigatarasaM mukhaM yasya sa virasamukhaH| ebhiH vakShyamANaiH| vesavArAbhaM vesavArasadRushaM; tallakShaNaM ca “nirasthi pishitaM piShTaM” (su.sU.a.46) ityAdinoktam| mecakAbhamiti snigdhakRuShNam| makShikAkAntamiti makShikApriyaM, ‘makShikAkrAntaM’ iti pAThe pakShikAparItamityarthaH| tRuShNetyAdinA sopadravamityanena sUcitAnupadravAnAha| muktanAlamiti muktagudam| sahasoparatavikAratvaM yadyapi riShTe saMshayitamaraNamuktaM, tathA~apIhAtIsAraM prApya nishcitamaraNaj~jApakatayocyate||9||

tamasAdhyatAmasamprAptaM cikitsed yathApradhAnopakrameNa hetUpashayadoShavisheShaparIkShayA ceti||10||

Commentary: yathApradhAnopakrameNeti doShatraye yaH pradhAno bhavati tasyopakrameNetyarthaH| hetvAdiparIkShA cehottarakAlabhAvinI, tenAtra vishiShTA cikitsaivocyate||10||

AgantU dvAvatIsArau mAnasau bhayashokajau| tattayorlakShaNaM vAyoryadatIsAralakShaNam||11||

Commentary: AgantU ityAdinA bhayashokajAvatIsArau prAha| AgantU iti Agantuhetujanitabhayashokajau| mAnasAviti mAnasadoShabhayashokajanitau| etena mAnasatvamAgantutvaM cAnayorna virodhi bhavati| anayorlakShaNamatideshenAha- tattayorlakShaNamityAdinA||11||
mAruto bhayashokAbhyAM shIghraM hi parikupyati| tayoH kriyA vAtaharI harShaNAshvAsanAni ca||12||
ityuktAH ShaDatIsArAH, sAdhyAnAM sAdhanaM tvataH| pravakShyAmyanupUrveNa yathAvattannibodhata||13||

agnibalahAnisAmAnyAd grahaNIdoShacikitsitamanu atIsAracikitsite vaktavye upodghAtAyAtaiH pANDurogAdibhirvyavadhAnaM kRutaM, samprati tu yathoktopodghAtAyAtapANDurogAdInabhidhAya prakRutamevAtIsAracikitsitamucyate||1-2||

doShAH sannicitA ityAdinA cikitsAmAha| vidagdhashabdenAtrApakvAhAravAcinA caturvidhamapyAmaM, vidagdhaM, viShTabdhaM, rasasheShaM cAjIrNaM gRuhyate| sampravartayedityanena pravartamAnasyopekShayA pravartanaM, tathA stokaM vahatAM virecanayogAt pravartanaM; yadvakShyati- ‘kRucchraM vA vahatAM dadyAdabhayAM sampravartinIm’ iti| na tu sa~ggrahaNaM pUrvaM deyamAmAtisAriNe ityatra pUrvamiti visheShaNenottarakAlaM deyamAmAtIsAre sa~ggrahaNaM darshayati| prathamaM cAmAtIsArasyopekShayA virecanadAnena pravartanamuktamiti virodhe iyaM vyavasthA- yat pravRuddhe Ame balavati ca puruShe pravartanameva kartavyaM, yadA tu durbalaH pumAn kShINashcAmastadA prathamamupekShayA pravartanaM kRutvA sa~ggrahaNaM kartavyaM; tasyAM hyavasthAyAmasa~ggrahaNe Aturasya balabhraMshAnmaraNameva syAt| anye tu pUrvaM sa~ggrahaNaM na deyamiti pradhAnamambaShThAshAlmalakuTajatvagAdisa~ggrahaNaM na deyaM, mustodIcyAdi tu pAcanasa~ggrahaNaM deyamiti varNayanti| iyaM cAmAtisAracikitsA sarvAmAtisArANAM sAdhAraNI j~jeyA| kRucchraM vA vahatAmiti savibandhaM vahatAm| pramathyAmiti pAcanadIpanIyaM kaShAyaM; pramathyAshabdo hi vRuddhaparamparayA pAcanadIpanakaShAye vaidyakashAstre paribhAShitaH shrUyate; yathA- viDa~ggakaShAyaH shaikharikakaShAyashabdena vaidyairucyate| bahudoShe pravartanaM, tathA madhyadoShe pramathyoktA, alpadoShe ca sAme prathamakartavyamAha- la~gghanamityAdi||14-19||

tisraH pramathyA iti yathAkramaM kaphapittavAteShu vibhajya deyA iti vadanti; tathA vacAprativiShAdivihitAni trINyapi jalAni kaphapittavAteShu yathAkramaM vadanti| ShaDa~ggavidhinA~atra jalasAdhanaM j~jeyam||20-22||

yukte~annakAle iti samyagbubhukShAkAle| avantisomaM kA~jjikam| kA~jjikatakradInAM ca dravANAM tarpaNAloDanArthamihAbhidhAnam| yavAgUrviraladravA vilepI bahusikthA ca;| dIpanagrAhigaNau ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktau| ataH paramiti yavAgvAdyupacArAnantaram||23-25||
shAliparNItyAdinA yavAgvAdisaMskAradravyANyAha||26-29||

sapravAhikamityatra pravAhikAlakShaNaM “vAyurvivRuddho nicitaM balAsaM nudatyadhastAdahitAshanasya| pravAhato~alpaM bahusho malAktaM pravAhikAM tAM pravadanti tajj~jAH” (su.u.taM.a.40) ityanena sushrutoktaM j~jeyam| kShIriNI dugdhikA, suvarcalA sUryabhaktA, ca~jcuH nADIcaH, karkAruH kUShmANDabhedaH, cirbhaTaH karkaTI, loNikA svanAmakhyAtA; shuShA kAsamardaH, rUkShadeshajaM shAkamityeke||30-33||

kalkaH syAdityAdinA khaDaH| dhAnyayUShamiti dhAnyapradhAnaM yUShaM yathoktameva| yamake iti ghRutataile| dadhidADimasArAbhyAM saMskRutaM dadhidADimasArikam| shAlInAM yadyapi baddhavarcastvamuktaM, tathA~apIha khaDayUSharasavisheShayuktAnAM saMyogashaktyA varcaHkShaye hitatvaM darshayannAha- snigdhAmlAH shAlayashcAgryA varcaHkShayarujApahA iti| tenAdyAt prapibecca tamiti uktAntarAdhirasAdhikRutena draveNa sandhIyAdyAt pRuthak ca dravaM pibet| varcaHkShayakRutaiH mukhashoShadaurbalyodAvartAdibhiH||34-41||

sUtritamamlaghRutamAha- cA~ggerItyAdi| atra cA~ggerIrasakolarasadadhnAM dravatvaM, nAgarakShArayoshca kalkatvam| peyamamlaM ghRutamityatra amlArthamanantaroktameva dravaM cA~ggerIsvarasAdi deyaM, cavyAdayashca dasha kalkAH; uktaM ca tantrAntare- “pa~jcakolaviDAjAjIdhAnyadADimavetasaiH| pacedamlaM ghRutaM tadvannAgarakShArasaMyutam” iti||42-44||
sauhityaM tRuptiH||47-49||
phalatvacamiti phalaM ca tvak ceti phalatvacam| mRuNAlam uShIram| sama~ggA khAdirI; ‘varAhakrAntA’ ityanye||51-56||
na tiShThati na nivartate| palAshavaditi uktapalAshaphalavidhAnena| sAMsargyAmiti peyAdikrame| shatapuShpetyAdau varI shatAvarI| anuvAsanaM ‘dadyAt’ iti sheShaH||57-62||

pariveShTyetyAdinA picchAbastimAha| shRute payasItyatra pAnIyamAtreNaiva payaH shRutaM j~jeyam| prastha iti shRute payasItyasya visheShaNam| vRuntAni shAlmaleH ulUkhale Apothya tata ApothitAt piNDaM muShTisamaM shRute prasthe payasi mRudnIyAditi yojanA| mAtrayeti vacanAt tailasarpiShoratra tAvatI mAtrA yAvatyA snehanamAtraM bhavati, tathA yaShTImadhukalkasyApi tAvatI mAtrA yAvatyA ghano bastirbhavati||63-68||

pittAtisArItyAdinA pittAtisArasyaiva hetuvisheShakRutAvasthAbhedarUpaM raktAtisAraM darshayati| ayaM ca raktAtisAro yadyapi pittAtisArottarakAlabhAvitayehoktaH, tathA~api pittAtiprakopeNa raktaduShTyA ca prathamamapi bhavatyevAyaM dRuShTatvAditi j~jeyam| tenAtrotpattikramAbhidhAnamatantratam | yathA “pANDurogI tu yo~atyarthaM” (ci.a.16) ityAdinoktakAmalotpAde yathoktakramaM vinA~api kAmalA bhavati| evamapi cAsya raktAtIsArasya pittajanyatvAt paittike evAvarodhaH; tena ShaTsa~gkhyA na vyAhanyate| atIsArasya yat prasRutAyAM siddhau AmaraktashakRutpittavAtakaphAnatIsArakArakAnabhidhAyoktaM- “ShaNNAmeShAM dvisaMsargAttriMshadbhedA bhavanti te| kevalaiH saha ShaTtriMshat” (si.a.8) iti, tadapyatraiva ShaTke~antarbhAvanIyaM, tatra sUkShmabhedagaNanayA sa bhedaH kRuta ityavirodhaH||69-70||
tatra chAgamityAdau vya~jjanArthamiti bhojyopakaraNArtham| payasA teneti chAgena payasA| mRugasyedaM mArgam, ajasyedamAjaM, rudhiramiti yojanA||71-76||
prAshyetyAdau kShIrotthitaM sarpiH payasA prAshyeti sambandhaH| kapi~jjalaH gauratittiriH| kShIraM bhu~gkte iti kShIrabhuk| tayeti shatAvaryA| yavAgUmaNDena peyamiti sambandhaH||77-79||
ShaDbhiretairitipadaM yathAlAbhaniShedhArtham||80-81||

kRuShNamRudityAdau rudhiraM shoNitaM, kecit ku~gkumamAhuH| sharkarApa~jcabhAgika iti atra sharkarAyAH pa~jcamena bhAgena kRuShNatiladAnam; uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “kRuShNatilA~j sharkarApAdikA~jchAgIpayasA” iti||82-84||
palamityAdau rasamiti kvAtham| rasAshIti mAMsarasena bhu~jjAnaH||85-86||
kShaudrasaMyutairityantaM secayedityanuvartate||87-88||
prakShAlanAnAmiti prakShAlanArthamuktAnAM paTolamadhukAdInAm| pratisArayet avacUrNayet||89-92||-

picchAbastiM tadA tasya yathoktamiti atraiva ‘pariveShTya’ ityAdigranthoktam| gude snehaM prayojayediti atra snehabhAvitapicupraNayanena gude snehaprayogamicchanti; anye tu prakRutatvAdanuvAsanenaivAtra prayogamAhuH||93-95||-

sve sthAne iti pakvAshayakaTyAdau| bastiriti sAmAnyavacanAdanuvAsanaM nirUhashca j~jeyaH| shatAvarIghRutamiti “shatAvarImUlatulAshcatasraH” (ci.a.30) ityAdinA yonivyApaduktaM shatAvarIghRutam| vikAramiti ‘raktaM saviT’ ityAdinoktam||96-100||-
dIpano gaNa iti ‘shAliparNI pRushniparNI’ ityAdinoktaH||102-103||-

kaphaghnaistamupAcaredityuktaM, tena kaphaghnAn bilvakarkaTaketyAdinA yogAnAha| dhAtakIdviguNamiti ekadravyApekShayA dviguNayA dhAtakyA yuktam| ajAjImityAdau asitAmiti pippalIm| jatUkarNe hyayaM yogaH “pAThA~ajAjIvyoShaphalapUraM dhAtakIdviguNam”| ityuktaH||104-112||-

kaNAM madhuyutAmityatra kaNA pippalI; anye ‘kaNAn’ iti paThanti, kaNAnityanena ca ShaShTikataNDulAn grAhayanti| vAte pratihate iti baddhe vAte| upasevanairiti vya~jjanaiH| pUrvoktamamlasarpiriti “cA~ggerIkoladadhyamlaM” ityAdinoktam||113-116||

picchAbastiM prayojayediti yaduktaM tatra picchAbastervisheShamAha- pippalItyAdi| pUrvoktamiti atraiva pUrvoktaM picchAbastiM pippalyAdikalkairyuktaM, sannidhApayediti dApayet| bilvataileneti siddhau “dashamUlaM balA rAsnA” (si.a.4) ityAdinA vakShyamANabilvatailena| vacAntairiti “pippalIbilvakuShThAnAM shatAhvAvacayorapi” ityatroktairvacAntaiH||117-120||

kasmAt punarvAtAtisAralakShaNamanayorbhavatItyAha- mAruta ityAdi| yasmAd bhayashokajanito~atra mArutaH kAraNaM bhavati, tasmAdvAtAtIsAralakShaNAni bhavantIti yuktamityarthaH| na cAnayorvAtajanyatvena vAtajalakShaNayuktatvena vAtajenaiva grahaNamastviti vAcyaM; yato~anayorvAtajAdbhinnA~api cikitsA bhaviShyati harShaNAshvAsanarUpA, cikitsAbhedArthameva vyAdhInAM bhedo~abhidhIyate| ki~jca, lakShaNabhedo~apyatra ‘mArutaH shIghraM hi parikupyati’ ityanenoktaH| yato bhayashokaje~atIsAre shIghrakArI vAyurbhavatIti shIghraM kupyatIti padenocyate; tena nidAnAnantaraM jhaTiti utpAda evAtra vishiShTamapi lakShaNam| sannipAtAtisAre bhayashokau kAraNatvenoktau, tau hi hetvantarasahitau tatra kAraNaM bhavata iti naikakAraNatA tridoShajabhayashokajAnAm| bhayashokajayoshca yadyapi tulyaM lakShaNamihoktaM, tathA~api cikitsAbhedAttayorbheda uktaH; tathAhi- bhayaje AshvAsanaM, shokaje harShaNamiti cikitsAbhedaH| sushrute tu- “taistairbhAvaiH shocato~alpAshanasya bAShpoShmA vai vahnimAvishya jantoH” (su.u.ta.a.40) ityAdinA shokajaH prabandhenoktaH, sa ihoktashokajAdanya eva vishiShTahetujanyaH, iha tvasau sAnnipAtike~avaruddho j~jeyaH| tathAhi- tatra bAShpoShmaNo~api kAraNatvamuktaM, tena shokAnashanato vAyuH bAShpoShmaNA ca pittakaphAvapi tatra kAraNatvena darshitau, ata eva ca tasyAsAdhyatvamapi tatroktam; atrApi ca tridoShaje shoko~api kAraNatvenoktaH| yastu sushrute “annAjIrNAt pradrutAH” (su.u.ta.a.40) ityAdinA~ajIrNajaH pRuthaguktaH, tasyehoktatridoShaje~avarodho vyakta eva; yatastatraiva ‘doShAH’ iti bahuvacanena annAjIrNasya tridoShakAraNatvamuktaM, ihApi ca ‘vyApanne~agnau’ ityanena agnimAndyajanitAjIrNasya tridoShajAtisAre kAraNatvamuktameva; tena sushrutoktasarvAtisArAvarodho~atra j~jeyaH||12-13||
athAtashchardicikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

dviShTapratIpAshucipUtyamedhyabIbhatsagandhAshanadarshanaishca| yacchardayettaptamanA manodhnairdviShTArthasaMyogabhavA matA sA||18||

Commentary: dviShTetyAdinA dviShTArthajAmAha| dviShTAdayo gandhenAshanena darshanena ca yathAyogyatayA sambadhyante| ashanaM bhakShaNam| dviShTaM pratipuruShAprItijanakaM, pratIpaM vacAdi, kecit pratIpaM vAtamAhuH, ashuci ucchiShTAdi, amedhyaM malinaM, bIbhatsaM jugupsitam| manoghnairityanena dviShTAdInAM madhye yatki~jcit ashucyAdi yaM puruShaM prApya manoghnaM na bhavati taM prati tacchardikArakaM na bhavati, mano~anupaghAtakatvAditi sUcayati||18||

kShINasya yA chardiratipravRuddhA sopadravA shoNitapUyayuktA| sacandrikAM tAM pravadantyasAdhyAM sAdhyAM cikitsedanupadravAM ca||19||

Commentary: asAdhyalakShaNayuktAM chardiM parityAgArthamAha- kShINasyetyAdi| atipravRuddheti sadA~anubaddhA| sopadravetyatra viTsvedetyAdinA rogopadravA j~jeyAH| sacandrikAmiti dhAtusnehamaNDalAkArayuktAm ||19||
AmAshayotkleshabhavA hi sarvAshchardyo matA la~gghanameva tasmAt| prAkkArayenmArutajAM vimucya saMshodhanaM vA kaphapittahAri||20||
cUrNAni lihyAnmadhunA~abhayAnAM hRudyAni vA yAni virecanAni| madyaiH payobhishca yutAni yuktyA nayantyadho doShamudIrNamUrdhvam||21||
vallIphalAdyairvamanaM pibedvA yo durbalastaM shamanaishcikitset| rasairmanoj~jairlaghubhirvishuShkairbhakShyaiH sabhojyairvividhaishca pAnaiH||22||
susaMskRutAstittiribarhilAvarasA vyapohantyanilapravRuttAm| chardiM tathA kolakulatthadhAnyabilvAdimUlAmlayavaishca yUShaH||23||
vAtAtmikAyAM hRudayadravArto naraH pibet saindhavavaddhRutaM tu| siddhaM tathA dhAnyakanAgarAbhyAM dadhnA ca toyena ca dADimasya||24||
vyoSheNa yuktAM lavaNaistribhishca ghRutasya mAtrAmathavA vidadhyAt| snigdhAni hRudyAni ca bhojanAni rasaiH sayUShairdadhidADimAmlaiH||25||
pittAtmikAyAmanulomanArthaM drAkShAvidArIkShurasaistrivRut syAt| kaphAshayasthaM tvatimAtravRuddhaM pittaM haret svAdubhirUrdhvameva||26||
