shuddhAya kAle madhusharkarAbhyAM lAjaishca manthaM yadi vA~api peyAm| pradApayenmudgarasena vA~api shAlyodanaM jA~ggalajai rasairvA||27||
sitopalAmAkShikapippalIbhiH kulmAShalAjAyavasaktugRu~jjAn| kharjUramAMsAnyatha nArikelaM drAkShAmatho vA badarANi lihyAt||28||
srotojalAjotpalakolamajjacUrNAni lihyAnmadhunA~abhayAM ca| kolAsthimajjA~jjanamakShikAviDlAjAsitAmAgadhikAkaNAn vA||29||
drAkShArasaM vA~api pibet sushItaM mRudbhRuShTaloShTaprabhavaM jalaM vA| jambvAmrayoH pallavajaM kaShAyaM pibet sushItaM madhusaMyutaM vA||30||
nishi sthitaM vAri samudgakRuShNaM soshIradhAnyaM caNakodakaM vA| gavedhukAmUlajalaM guDUcyA jalaM pibedikShurasaM payo vA||31||
sevyaM pibet kA~jcanagairikaM vA sabAlakaM taNDuladhAvanena| dhAtrIrasenottamacandanaM vA tRuShNAvamighnAni samAkShikANi||32||
kalkaM tathA candanacavyamAMsIdrAkShottamAbAlakagairikANAm| shItAmbunA gairikashAlicUrNaM mUrvAM tathA taNDuladhAvanena||33||
kaphAtmikAyAM vamanaM prashastaM sapippalIsarShapanimbatoyaiH| piNDItakaiH saindhavasamprayuktairvamyAM kaphAmAshayashodhanArtham||34||
godhUmashAlIn sayavAn purANAn yUShaiH paTolAmRutacitrakANAm| vyoShasya nimbasya ca takrasiddhairyUShaiH phalAmlaiH kaTubhistathA~adyAt||35||
rasAMshca shUlyAni ca jA~ggalAnAM mAMsAni jIrNAnmadhusIdhvariShTAn| rAgAMstathA ShADavapAnakAni drAkShAkapitthaiH phalapUrakaishca||36||
mudgAnmasUrAMshcaNakAn kalAyAn bhRuShTAn yutAnnAgaramAkShikAbhyAm| lihyAttathaiva triphalAviDa~ggacUrNaM viDa~ggaplavayoratho vA||37||
sajAmbavaM vA badarAmlacUrNaM mustAyutAM karkaTakasya shRu~ggIm| durAlabhAM vA madhusamprayuktAM lihyAt kaphacchardivinigrahArtham||38||
manaHshilAyAH phalapUrakasya rasaiH kapitthasya ca pippalInAm| kShaudreNa cUrNaM maricaishca yuktaM liha~jjayecchardimudIrNavegAm||39||

yaiShA pRuthaktvena mayA kriyoktA tAM sannipAte~api samasya buddhyA| doSharturogAgnibalAnyavekShya prayojayecchAstravidapramattaH||40||

Commentary: yaiShetyAdinA sAnnipAtikyAshcikitsodhyate| samasyeti ekIkRutya| doSharturogAgnibalAnyavekShyeti doShAdInAM balaM vIkShya yadbalavat tatpradhAnA cikitsA kartavyA| rogaH chardireva||40||
manobhighAte tu manonukUlA vAcaH samAshvAsanaharShaNAni| lokaprasiddhAH shrutayo vayasyAH shRu~ggArikAshcaiva hitA vihArAH||41||
gandhA vicitrA manaso~anukUlA mRutpuShpashuktAmlaphalAdikAnAm| shAkAni bhojyAnyatha pAnakAni susaMskRutAH ShADavarAgalehAH||42||
yUShA rasAH kAmbalikA khaDAshca mAMsAni dhAnA vividhAshca bhakShyAH| phalAni mUlAni ca gandhavarNarasairupetAni vamiM jayanti||43||
gandhaM rasaM sparshamathApi shabdaM rUpaM ca yadyat priyamapyasAtmyam| tadeva dadyAt prashamAya tasyAstajjo hi rogaH sukha eva jetum||44||

chardyutthitAnAM ca cikitsitAt svAccikitsitaM kAryamupadravANAm| atipravRuttAsu virecanasya karmAtiyoge vihitaM vidheyam||45||

Commentary: atipravRuttAsvityAdi| atipravRuttAsu chardiShu virecanasyAtiyoge yatkarma vihitaM saMshodhanavyApattisiddhau (si.a.6) tadiha vidheyamityarthaH||45||
vamiprasa~ggAt pavano~apyavashyaM dhAtukShayAddhRuddhimupaiti tasmAt| cirapravRuttAsvanilApahAni kAryANyupastambhanabRuMhaNAni||46||
sarpirguDAH kShIravidhirghRutAni kalyANakatryUShaNajIvanAni| vRuShyAstathA mAMsarasAH salehAshciraprasaktAM ca vamiM jayanti||47||

tatra shlokaH- hetuM sa~gkhyAM lakShaNamupadravAn sAdhyatAM na yogAMshca| chardInAM prashamArthaM prAha cikitsitaM munivaryaH||48||

Commentary: hetumityAdinA sa~ggrahaH| upadravAniti viTsvedetyAdinoktAnupadravAn| munivarya iti munishreShThaH||48||

yashasvinaM brahmatapodyutibhyAM jvalantamagnyarkasamaprabhAvam| punarvasuM bhUtahite niviShTaM papraccha shiShyo~atrijamagniveshaH||3||

Commentary: brahmaNaH tattvaj~jAnasya tapasashca dyutI brahmatapodyutI, tAbhyAM jvalantam||3||
yAshchardayaH pa~jca purA tvayoktA rogAdhikAre bhiShajAM variShTha!| tAsAM cikitsAM sanidAnali~ggAM yathAvadAcakShva nRuNAM hitArtham||4||
tadagniveshasya vaco nishamya prIto bhiShakshreShTha idaM jagAda| yAshchardayaH pa~jca purA mayoktAstA vistareNa bruvato nibodha||5||

tAsAM hRudutkleshakaphaprasekau dveSho~ashane caiva hi pUrvarUpam||6||

Commentary: yadyapi hetvabhidhAnapUrvakaM pUrvarUpAbhidhAnaM yujyate, hetUttarakAlabhAvitvAdeva pUrvarUpasya; tathA~apyalpavaktavyatvAt tAsAmityAdinA pUrvarUpamAha| pUrvarUpaM li~ggAlpatvAducyate, evamanyatrApi sAkShAtsUcitapUrvarUpAbhidhAne j~jeyam||6||
vyAyAmatIkShNauShadhashokarogabhayopavAsAdyatikarshitasya| vAyurmahAsrotasi sampravRuddha utkleshya doShAMstata Urdhvamasyan||7||
AmAshayotkleshakRutAM ca marma prapIDayaMshchardimudIrayettu| hRutpArshvapIDAmukhashoShamUrdhanAbhyartikAsasvarabhedatodaiH||8||
udgArashabdaprabalaM saphenaM vicchinnakRuShNaM tanukaM kaShAyam| kRucchreNa cAlpaM mahatA ca vegenArto~anilAcchardayatIha duHkham||9||
ajIrNakaTvamlavidAhyashItairAmAshaye pittamudIrNavegam| rasAyanIbhirvisRutaM prapIDya marmordhvamAgamya vamiM karoti||10||
mUrcchApipAsAmukhashoShamUrdhatAlvakShisantApatamobhramArtaH| pItaM bhRushoShNaM haritaM satiktaM dhUmraM ca pittena vamet sadAham||11||
snigdhAtigurvAmavidAhibhojyaiH svapnAdibhishcaiva kapho~ativRuddhaH| uraH shiro marma rasAyanIshca sarvAH samAvRutya vamiM karoti||12||
tandrAsyamAdhuryakaphaprasekasantoShanidrArucigauravArtaH| snigdhaM ghanaM svAdu kaphAdvishuddhaM salomaharSho~alparujaM vamettu||13||
samashnataH sarvarasAn prasaktamAmapradoShartuviparyayaishca| sarve prakopaM yugapat prapannAshchardiM tridoShAM janayanti doShAH||14||
shUlAvipAkArucidAhatRuShNAshvAsapramohaprabalA prasaktam| chardistridoShAllavaNAmlanIlasAndroShNaraktaM vamatAM nRuNAM syAt||15||
viTsvedamUtrAmbuvahAni vAyuH srotAMsi saMrudhya yadordhvameti| utsannadoShasya samAcitaM taM doShaM samuddhUya narasya koShThAt||16||
viNmUtrayostat samavarNagandhaM tRuTshvAsahikkArtiyutaM prasaktam| pracchardayedduShTamihAtivegAttayA~arditashcAshu vinAshameti||17||
sharIre mArgadvayaM pradhAnam- adho gudam, UrdhvaM ca mukhaM; tadadhomArgAtipravRuttadoShamatIsAramabhidhAya, UrdhvAtidoShapravRuttirUpA chardirucyate, iti chardyadhyAyasambandhaH||1-2||

AmAshayetyAdinA sAdhyAnAM cikitsAmAha| yasmAdAmAshayotkleshAt sarvAshchardayo bhavanti, AmAshayotthe ca roge la~gghanAdi kaphaharaM bheShajaM yuktaM, tasmAlla~gghanameva kartavyamiti bhAvaH| la~gghanamalpadoShaviShayaM, shodhanaM ca bahudoShaviShayamiti vyavasthA| saMshodhanashabdena ceha virecanavamane api gRuhyete; anye tvatra saMshodhanashabdena pratimArgaharaNatayA atyarthahitaM virecanameva varNayanti| saMshodhanayogAnAha- cUrNAnItyAdi| phalAdyairiti phalAni jImUtekShvAkuprabhRutIni phalamAtrAsiddhi (si.a.11) paThitAni, taiH| shamanairiti doShanibarhaNaM vinA doShasAmyakaraiH; uktaM hi puShkalAvate- “na shodhayati yaddoShAn samAnnodIrayatyapi| samIkaroti viShamAMstat saMshamanamucyate” iti||20-22||

susaMskRutA ityAdinA vaisheShikI vAtajAcikitsocyate| hRudayadrava iti parishrAntasyeva hRudayakShobhaH| saindhavavaditi saindhavaprakShepaM; kecit saindhavavat siddhamiti yojayanti| toyena ca dADimasyeti dADimarasena| vyoSheNetyAdau vyoShAdInAM peyaghRutamAtrAyAM prakShepyatvam||23-25||

kaphAshayasthamiti kaphasthAnamAmAshayordhvabhAgo vakShaH, tatstham| haredUrdhvameveti vamanenaiva haret| yadi vA~api peyAmiti mandAgniM pratta peyA j~jeyA| kulmAShA utsinnayavapiShTakRutA bhakShyAH; pAriyAtrAstu mudgAnmasUrAnutsvinnamRuditAn kulmAShAnAhuH| gRu~jjaH samaNDo yavaudanaH| kharjUramAMsAnIti kharjUraphalasasyAni | kharjUretyAdau lihyAdityatra ‘sitopalAmAkShikapippalIbhiH’ ityanuvartanIyam| srotoja sroto~jjanam| kolamajjA kolAbhyantaram| abhayAM vetyatrApi ‘madhunA lihyAt’ iti sambadhyate| kolAsthItyAdAvapi ‘madhunA lihyAt’ ityanuvartate| mRudbhRuShTaloShTaprabhavaM jalaM veti mRunmayaloShTanirvApaNabhavaM jalamityarthaH| samudgakRuShNaM pippalImudgasahitam| nishi sthitamityAdau soShIradhAnyamiti dvitIyaH, caNakodakaM veti tRutIyo yogaH| tathA gavedhukAdiyogadvaye~api shItakaShAyavidhirj~jeyaH| kA~jcanagairikamiti gairikaM dAkShiNAtyaprasiddhaM kA~jcanavarNam| sabAlakaM taNDuladhAvaneneti vidhAnaM ‘sevyaM pibet’ ityanena tathA ‘kA~jcanagairikaM vA’ ityanena ca dvitIyayogena sambadhyate| drAkShottamA gostanI drAkShetyarthaH| uttamacandanaM dhavalacandanam||26-33||

samAkShikANIti pashcAduktayogatrayadravyANi samAkShikANi kartavyAni| piNDItakairiti madanaiH| kaphasyAmAshayasya ca shodhanArthaM kaphAmAshayashodhanArtham| yadyapi godhUmayavau madhuratvayogAt kaphakarau, tathA~api purANatayA na kaphakarAviti kRutvA kaphacchardyAM vihitau| uktaM hi- “prAyaH shleShmalaM madhuramanyatra madhunaH purANAcca shAliyavagodhUmAt” (sU.a.27) iti| rAgAH kapitthAdidravyakRutAH| manaHshilAyAshcUrNaM maricaishca yuktaM kShaudreNa yutaM phalapUrakarasairlihan, tathA kapitthasya rasaiH pippalInAM cUrNaM maricaishca yuktaM kShaudreNa yutaM lihanniti yojyam||34-39||

manobhidhAte iti manovighAtajacchardyAm| lokaprasiddhAH shrutaya iti laukikArthAnugatA AkhyAyiketihAsAH| vihArAH krIDAH| lehA iti vya~jjanarUpA lehAH| rAgAdInAM lakShaNamasakRuduktam| gandhavarNarasairupetAnIti prashastagandhAdiyutAni| gandhamityAdinA AtyayikacchardiprashamArthamasAtmyadAnamapyabhidhatte| prashame hi tasyA iti gandhAdInAM priyANAmupayogena chardyAH prashame sati, tajjo hi roga iti gandhAdInAmasAtmyajanitarogo jetuM sukha eva sukhopAya eva bhavati, mUlavyAdhermahAtyayasya jitatvAdityabhiprAyaH| ‘sukhameva jetum’ iti pAThe sukhaM yathA bhavati tathA jetuM ‘pAryate’ iti sheShaH||41-44||
vamiprasa~ggAt chardyanubandhAt pavanasya vRuddhirbhavati; tatropastambhanaM chardInAM pavanasya vA, bRuMhaNaM dhAtUnAm| lehAH cyavanaprAshAdayaH||46-47||
rogAdhikAre iti aShTodarIye (sU.a.19)||4-5||

vyAyAmetyAdinA vAtajAyA hetulakShaNe prAha| mahAsrotasIti koShThe| doShAniti bahuvacanaM bahUnAmutkleshanIyAnAM vidyamAnatvAt tathA raktAderapi chardyAdau doShashabdenAbhidhAnAt| UrdhvakShepaNamAmAshayotkleshenodIrito vAyureva karoti| kiMvA AmAshayodvegakRutAniti dvitIyAbahuvacanaM doShAnityasya visheShaNam| marmeti hRudayam| kaShAyamiti kaShAyarasaM kaShAyavarNaM vA||7-9||
ajIrNetyAdinA pittajAyA hetulakShaNe brUte| ajIrNeti ajIrNe bhojanam| rasAyanIbhiriti srotobhiH| mUrdhetyAdi santApena sambadhyate| dhUmraM dhUmravarNam||10-11||
snigdhetyAdinA kaphajAmAha| santoSho~atra tRuptiH, anye tu santoSho mAnasa evAtra vyAdhiprabhAvAdbhavati| alparujamiti kriyAvisheShaNam||12-13||

samashnata ityAdinA tridoShajAmAha| samashnataH sarvarasAniti pathyApathyamelakarUpatayA bhajataH, uktaM hi- “pathyApathyamihaikatra bhuktaM samashanaM matam” (ci.a.15) ityatra; na tu sarvarasAn bhu~jjAnasyetyarthaH; sarvarasabhojanaM hi pathyameva, teneha tasya tridoShakartRutvaM na syAt| prasaktamiti nirantaram| Amasya pradoShaH AmapradoShaH||14-15||
viTsvedetyAdinA upadravayuktAM chardimupadravAdasAdhyAmAha| viNmUtrayostatsamagandhavarNaM chardayatIti vAyunA viNmUtrasrotasAM dUShitatvAjj~jeyam||16-17||
athAto visarpacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
rUkShoShNaiH kevalo vAyuH pUraNairvA samAvRutaH| praduShTo dUShayan dUShyAn visarpati yathAbalam||29||

tasya rUpANi- bhramadavathupipAsAnistodashUlA~ggamardodveShTanakampajvaratamaka- kAsAsthisandhibhedavishleShaNavepanArocakAvipAkAshcakShuShorAkulatvamasrAgamanaM pipIlikAsa~jcAra iva cA~ggeShu, yasmiMshcAvakAshe visarpo visarpati so~avakAshaH shyAvAruNAbhAsaH shvayathumAn nistodabhedashUlAyAmasa~gkocaharShasphuraNairatimAtraM prapIDyate, anupakrAntashcopacIyate shIghrabhedaiH sphoTakaistanubhiraruNAbhaiH shyAvairvA tanuvishadAruNAlpAsrAvaiH, vibaddhavAtamUtrapurIShashca bhavati, nidAnoktAni cAsya nopasherate viparItAni copasherata iti vAtavisarpaH||30||
pittamuShNopacAreNa vidAhyamlAshanaishcitam| dUShyAn sandUShya dhamanIH pUrayan vai visarpati||31||

tasya rUpANi- jvarastRuShNA mUrcchA mohashchardirarocako~a~ggabhedaH svedo~atimAtramantardAhaH pralApaH shiroruk cakShuShorAkulatvamasvapnamaratirbhramaH shItavAtavAritarSho~atimAtraM haritahAridranetramUtravarcastvaM haritahAridrarUpadarshanaM ca, yasmiMshcAvakAshe visarpo~anusarpati so~avakAshastAmraharitahAridranIlakRuShNaraktAnAM varNAnAmanyatamaM puShyati, sotsedhaishcAtimAtraM dAhasambhedanaparItaiH sphoTakairupacIyate tulyavarNAsrAvaishcirapAkaishca, nidAnoktAni cAsya nopasherate viparItAni copasherata iti pittavisarpaH||32||
svAdvamlalavaNasnigdhagurvannasvapnasa~jcitaH| kaphaH sandUShayan dUShyAn kRucchrama~gge visarpati||33||

tasya rUpANi- shItakaH shItajvaro gauravaM nidrA tandrA~arocako madhurAsyatvamAsyopalepo niShThIvikA chardirAlasyaM staimityamagninAsho daurbalyaM ca, yasmiMshcAvakAshe visarpo~anusarpati so~avakAshaH shvayathumAn pANDurnAtiraktaH snehasuptistambhagauravairanvito~alpavedanaH kRucchrapAkaishcirakAribhirbahulatvagupalepaiH sphoTaH shvetapANDubhiranubadhyate, prabhinnastu shvetaM picchilaM tantumaddhanamanubaddhaM snigdhamAsrAvaM sravati, UrdhvaM ca gurubhiH sthirairjAlAvatataiH snigdhairbahulatvagupalepairvraNairanubadhyate~anuSha~ggI ca bhavati, shvetanakhanayanavadanatva~gmUtravarcastvaM, nidAnoktAni cAsya nopasherate viparItAni copasherata iti shleShmavisarpaH||34||
vAtapittaM prakupitamatimAtraM svahetubhiH| parasparaM labdhabalaM dahadgAtraM visarpati||35||

tadupatApAdAturaH sarvasharIrama~ggArairivAkIryamANaM manyate, chardyatIsAramUrcchAdAhamohajvaratamakArocakAsthisandhibhedatRuShNAvipAkA~ggabhedAdibhishcAbhibhUyate, yaM yaM cAvakAshaM visarpo~anusarpati so~avakAshaH shAntA~ggAraprakAsho~atirakto vA bhavati, agnidagdhaprakAraishca sphoTairupacIyate, sa shIghragatvAdAshveva marmAnusArI bhavati, marmaNi copatapte pavano~atibalo bhinattya~ggAnyatimAtraM pramohayati sa~jj~jAM, hikkAshvAsau janayati, nAshayati nidrAM, sa naShTanidraH pramUDhasa~jj~jo vyathitacetA na kvacana sukhamupalabhate, aratiparItaH sthAnAdAsanAcchayyAM krAntumicchati, kliShTabhUyiShThashcAshu nidrAM bhajati, durbalo duHkhaprabodhashca bhavati; tamevaMvidhamagnivisarpaparItamacikitsyaM vidyAt||36||
kaphapittaM prakupittaM balavat svena hetunA| visarpatyekadeshe tu prakledayati dehinam||37||

tadvikArAH- shItajvaraH shirogurutvaM dAhaH staimityama~ggAvasadanaM nidrA tandrA moho~annadveShaH pralApo~agninAsho daurbalyamasthibhedo mUrcchA pipAsA srotasAM pralepo jADyamindriyANAM prAyopaveshanama~ggavikShepo~a~ggamardo~aratirautsukyaM copajAyate, prAyashcAmAshaye visarpatyalasaka ekadeshagrAhI ca, yasmiMshcAvakAshe visarpo visarpati so~avakAsho raktapItapANDupiDakAvakIrNa iva mecakAbhaH kAlo malinaH snigdho bahUShmA guruH stimitavedanaH shvayathumAn gambhIrapAko nirAsrAvaH shIghrakledaH svinnaklinnapUtimAMsatvak krameNAlparuk parAmRuShTo~avadIryate kardama ivAvapIDito~antaraM prayacchatyupaklinnapUtimAMsatyAgI sirAsnAyusandarshI kuNapagandhI ca bhavati sa~jj~jAsmRutihantA ca; taM kardamavisarpaparItamacikitsyaM vidyAt||38||

sthiragurukaThinamadhurashItasnigdhAnnapAnAbhiShyandisevinAmavyAyAmAdisevinAmapratikarmashIlAnAM shleShmA vAyushca prakopamApadyate, tAvubhau duShTapravRuddhAvatibalau pradUShya dUShyAn visarpAya kalpete; tatra vAyuH shleShmaNA vibaddhamArgastameva shleShmANamanekadhA bhindan krameNa granthimAlAM kRucchrapAkasAdhyAM kaphAshaye sa~jjanayati, utsannaraktasya vA pradUShya raktaM sirAsnAyumAMsatvagAshritaM granthInAM mAlAM kurute tIvrarujAnAM sthUlAnAmaNUnAM vA dIrghavRuttaraktAnAM, tadupatApAjjvarAtisArakAsahikkAshvAsashoSha- pramohavaivarNyArocakAvipAkaprasekacchardirmUrcchA~ggabha~gganidrAratisadanAdyAH prAdurbhavantyupadravAH; sa etairupadrutaH sarvakarmaNAM viShayamatipatito vivarjanIyo bhavatIti granthivisarpaH||39||

Commentary: sthiretyAdinA granthivisarpamAha| duShTapravRuddhAviti parasparadUShakatvena pravRuddhau| kRucchrapAkasAdhyAmiti ca kRucchrapAkAM kRucchrasAdhyAM ca; kRucchrapAkatA ca cireNa pAkAjj~jeyA| utsannaraktasyeti vRuddharaktasya| sirAsnAyumAMsetyAdau granthivisarpaM kuruta iti yojyaM; tena tIvrarujAdiyuktAnAM granthInAmAshrayaM granthivisarpaM kuruta ityarthaH| tadupatApAditi tena granthivisarpeNa pIDanAt| sarvakarmaNAM viShayamatipatito bhavatIti sarvacikitsAviShayatAmatikrAnto bhavatItyarthaH| sashabdena ceha yathoktopadravayukta eva granthivisarpaH pratyavamRushyate| ayaM ca granthivisarpastantrAntare apacIsa~jj~jayA kathyata ityAhuH||39||

upadravastu khalu rogottarakAlajo rogAshrayo roga eva sthUlo~aNurvA, rogAt pashcAjjAyata ityupadravasa~jj~jaH| tatra pradhAno vyAdhiH, vyAdherguNabhUta upadravaH, tasya prAyaH pradhAnaprashame prashamo bhavati| sa tu pIDAkarataro bhavati pashcAdutpadyamAno vyAdhiparikliShTasharIratvAt; tasmAdupadravaM tvaramANo~abhibAdheta||40||

Commentary: visarpANAM bahUpadravatayA anuSha~ggAdihaivopadravasvarUpaM vyAkaroti- upadravastvityAdi| tushabdaH mUlavyAdhivyavacchede, athavA tushabdaH prakAshane| rogottarakAlaja iti rogamadhyakAlajaH; etena rogasahotpannasya li~ggasya vyavacchedaH| yAni ca li~ggAnyapi kadAcidrogottarakAlajAni bhavanti tAni rogeNa saha prAya utpadyamAnatayA na rogottarakAlajAnyeva, tena na teShAmupadravatvam| rogAshraya iti rogArambhakadoShaprakopajanyatayA rogeNa samaM tulyakAraNaH| etena galagaNDe jAte svahetUtpannAnAM jvarAdInAM rogottarakAlajAnAmapyupadravatvaM niShedhayati| roga evetyanena mUlavyAdheH pRuthagrogashabdena vyavahriyamANamupadravaM grAhayati; tena vyAdhyavasthAyA rogottarakAlajAyA vyavacchedaM karoti| tatashca shothasya yA vraNarUpA~avasthA tasyA vyudAsaH, tathA sarvAsAmapi vyAdhyavasthAnAmavasthAlakShaNayuktAnAM vyudAsaH kRuto bhavati; avasthA vyAdheravashyambhAvitayA mUlavyAdhisvarUpA eva, upadravastu nAvashyaM bhavati| yadyapi kecinmahAbaladoShArabdhA vyAdhaya upadravayuktA evotpadyante, sahotpanne copadravArtho nAsti, tathA~api ye gadA upadravarUpA jAyante te tatra sahotpannA api yogyatayA upadravA bhaNyante| paramArthatastu sahabhAvino nopadravalakShaNayuktAH, kintu rogasa~gkaratvena tatra jAyanta iti| etadupadravalakShaNArtho eva sushrutaH- “tatraupasargiko nAma yaH pUrvotpannaM vyAdhiM jaghanyakAlajAto vyAdhirupasRujati sa tanmUla evopadravasa~jj~jaH” (su.sU.a.35) iti| upadravaprakAramAha- sthUlo~aNurveti| upadravasa~jj~jAniruktimAha- pashcAjjAyata iti upadravasa~jj~ja iti| etena upadravati vyAdhyutpAdasamIpe upaitIti upadravaH, iti niruktiH kRutA bhavati| vyAdherguNabhUta iti mUlavyAdhyapekShayA~apradhAnamityarthaH| guNabhUtatve eva hetumAha- tasya prAyaH pradhAnaprashame shama iti|- mUlavyAdhiprashamAdhInaprashamatvAdupadravasyAprAdhAnyamityarthaH| prAyaHshabdena ca vyabhicAravAcinA kvacidupadravasya svatantrA cikitsA~apyuktA| upadravasya AshucikitsyatvaM vyutpAdayannAha- sa tvityAdi| vyAdhiparikliShTasharIratvAditi digyoge pa~jcamI; tena vyAdhiparikliShTasya pashcAdutpadyamAnatayA pIDAkarataro bhavatIti vAkyArthaH| upasaMharati- tasmAdityAdi| abhibAdheteti tvarayA cikitset; sA ca cikitsA mUlavyAdhiprashamanena tathA svatantrA~api bhavatItyuktameva||40||

sarvAyatanasamutthaM sarvali~ggavyApinaM sarvadhAtvanusAriNamAshukAriNaM mahAtyayikamiti sannipAtavisarpamacikitsyaM vidyAt||41||

Commentary: samprati prakrAntaM sannipAtavisarpamAha- sarvetyAdi| sarvAyatanasamutthamiti sarvahetubhavam| sarvali~ggavyApinamiti vAtAdijoktasarvalakShaNayuktam| sarvadhAtvanusAriNamiti visarpAshrayatvenoktAnAmanuktAnAmapi ca dhAtUnAmAshrayitvaM darshayati| tathA hi masUrikAyA visarparUpAyA eva tantrAntare sakaladhAtvAshrayatvamuktaM, tadutsargato visarpANAM doShAtimAtraduShTyA saptadhAtuketaradhAtuduShTirapi bhavatIti||41||

tatra vAtapittashleShmanimittA visarpAstrayaH sAdhyA bhavanti; agnikardamAkhyau punaranupasRuShTe marmaNi anupagate vA sirAsnAyumAMsaklede sAdhAraNakriyAbhirubhAvevAbhyasyamAnau prashAntimApadyeyAtAm, anAdaropakrAntaH punastayoranyataro hanyAddehamAshvevAshIviShavat; tathA granthivisarpamajAtopadravamArabheta cikitsitum, upadravopadrutaM tvenaM pariharet; sannipAtajaM tu sarvadhAtvanusAritvAdAshukAritvAdviruddhopakramatvAccAsAdhyaM vidyAt||42||

Commentary: marmaNIti hRudayAdipradhAnamarmaNi| sAdhAraNakriyAbhiriti ArambhakadoShayoH samAnAbhiH kriyAbhiH| abhyasyamAnAviti satatamupacaryamANau| anAdaropakrAnta iti asamyagupakrAntaH| tena pUrvaM sarvathA~anupakrame “ye hanyuranupakrAntAH” (sU.a.18) ityanena mArakatvamuktam, iha tu asamyagupakrame iti visheShaH||42||
tatra sAdhyAnAM sAdhanamanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH||43||
la~gghanollekhane shaste tiktakAnAM ca sevanam| kaphasthAnagate sAme rUkShashItaiH pralepayet||44||
pittasthAnagate~apyetat sAme kuryAccikitsitam| shoNitasyAvasekaM ca virekaM ca visheShataH||45||
mArutAshayasambhUte~apyAditaH syAdvirUkShaNam| raktapittAnvaye~apyAdau snehanaM na hitaM matam||46||
vAtolbaNe tiktaghRutaM paittike ca prashasyate| laghudoShe, mahAdoShe paittike syAdvirecanam||47||
na ghRutaM bahudoShAya deyaM yanna virecayet| tena doSho hyupaShTabdhastva~gmAMsarudhiraM pacet||48||
tasmAdvirekamevAdau shastaM vidyAdvisarpiNaH| rudhirasyAvasekaM ca taddhyasyAshrayasa~jj~jitam||49||
iti vIsarpanut proktaM samAsena cikitsitam| etadeva punaH sarvaM vyAsataH sampravakShyate||50||
madanaM madhukaM nimbaM vatsakasya phalAni ca| vamanaM sampradAtavyaM visarpe kaphapittaje||51||
paTolapicumardAbhyAM pippalyA madanena ca| visarpe vamanaM shastaM tathA cendrayavaiH saha||52||
yAMshca yogAn pravakShyAbhi kalpeShu kaphapittinAm| visarpiNAM prayojyAste doShanirharaNAH shivAH||53||
kailAse kinnarAkIrNe bahuprasravaNauShadhe| pAdapairvividhaiH snigdhairnityaM kusumasampadA||3||
vamadbhirmadhurAn gandhAn sarvataH svabhyala~gkRute| viharantaM jitAtmAnamAtreyamRuShivanditam||4||
maharShibhiH parivRutaM sarvabhUtahite ratam| agnivesho guruM kAle vinayAdidamuktavAn||5||
bhagavan! dAruNaM rogamAshIviShaviShopamam| visarpantaM sharIreShu dehinAmupalakShaye||6||
sahasaiva narAstena parItAH shIghrakAriNA| vinashyantyanupakrAntAstatra naH saMshayo mahAn||7||
sa nAmnA kena vij~jeyaH sa~jj~jitaH kena hetunA| katibhedaH kiyaddhAtuH kinnidAnaH kimAshrayaH||8||
sukhasAdhyaH kRucchrasAdhyo j~jeyo yashcAnupakramaH| kathaM kairlakShaNaiH kiM ca bhagavan! tasya bheShajam||9||
tadagniveshasya vacaH shrutvA~a~atreyaH punarvasuH| yathAvadakhilaM sarvaM provAca munisattamaH||10||
mustanimbapaTolAnAM candanotpalayorapi| sArivAmalakoshIramustAnAM vA vicakShaNaH||54||
kaShAyAn pAyayedvaidyaH siddhAn vIsarpanAshanAn| kirAtatiktakaM lodhraM candanaM sadurAlabham||55||
nAgaraM padmaki~jjalkamutpalaM sabibhItakam| madhukaM nAgapuShpaM ca dadyAdvIsarpashAntaye||56||
prapauNDarIkaM madhukaM padmaki~jjalkamutpalam| nAgapuShpaM ca lodhraM ca tenaiva vidhinA pibet||57||
drAkShAM parpaTakaM shuNThIM guDUcIM dhanvayAsakam| nishAparyuShitaM dadyAttRuShNAvIsarpashAntaye||58||
paTolaM picumardaM ca dArvIM kaTukarohiNIm| yaShTyAhvAM trAyamANAM ca dadyAdvIsarpashAntaye||59||
paTolAdikaShAyaM vA pibettriphalayA saha| masUravidalairyuktaM ghRutamishraM pradApayet||60||
paTolapatramudgAnAM rasamAmalakasya ca| pAyayeta ghRutonmishraM naraM vIsarpapIDitam||61||
yacca sarpirmahAtiktaM pittakuShThanibarhaNam| nirdiShTaM tadapi prAj~jo dadyAdvIsarpashAntaye||62||
trAyamANAghRutaM siddhaM gaulmike yadudAhRutam| visarpANAM prashAntyarthaM dadyAttadapi buddhimAn||63||
trivRuccUrNaM samAloDya sarpiShA payasA~api vA| gharmAmbunA vA saMyojya mRudvIkAnAM rasena vA||64||
virekArthaM prayoktavyaM siddhaM vIsarpanAshanam| trAyamANAshRutaM vA~api payo dadyAdvirecanam||65||
triphalArasasaMyuktaM sarpistrivRutayA saha| prayoktavyaM virekArthaM visarpajvaranAshanam||66||
rasamAmalakAnAM vA ghRutamishraM pradApayet| sa eva gurukoShThAya trivRuccUrNayuto hitaH||67||
shAkhAduShTe tu rudhire raktamevAdito haret||68||
bhiShagvAtAnvitaM raktaM viShANena vinirharet| pittAnvitaM jalaukobhiH, kaphAnvitamalAbubhiH||69||
yathAsannaM vikArasya vyadhayedAshu vA sirAm| tva~gmAMsasnAyusa~gkledo raktakledAddhi jAyate||70||
antaHsharIre saMshuddhe doShe tva~gmAMsasaMshrite| Adito vA~alpadoShANAM kriyA bAhyA pravakShyate||71||
udumbaratva~gmadhukaM padmaki~jjalkamutpalam| nAgapuShpaM priya~ggushca pradehaH saghRuto hitaH||72||
nyagrodhapAdAstaruNAH kadalIgarbhasaMyutAH| bisagranthishca lepaH syAcchatadhautaghRutAplutaH||73||
kAlIyaM madhukaM hema vanyaM candanapadmakau| elA mRuNAlaM phalinI pralepaH syAddhRutAplutaH||74||
shAdvalaM ca mRuNAlaM ca sha~gkhaM candanamutpalam| vetasasya ca mUlAni pradehaH syAt sataNDulaH||75||
sArivA padmaki~jjalkamushIraM nIlamutpalam| ma~jjiShThA candanaM lodhramabhayA ca pralepanam||76||
naladaM ca hareNushca lodhraM madhukapadmakau | dUrvA sarjarasashcaiva saghRutaM syAt pralepanam||77||
yAvakAH saktavashcaiva sarpiShA saha yojitAH| pradeho madhukaM vIrA saghRutA yavasaktavaH||78||
balAmutpalashAlUkaM vIrAmagurucandanam| kuryAdAlepanaM vaidyo mRuNAlaM ca bisAnvitam||79||
yavacUrNaM samadhukaM saghRutaM ca pralepanam| hareNavo masurAshca samudgAH shvetashAlayaH||80||
pRuthak pRuthak pradehAH syuH sarve vA sarpiShA saha| padminIkardamaH shIto mauktikaM piShTameva vA||81||
sha~gkhaH pravAlaH shuktirvA gairikaM vA ghRutAplutam| (pRuthagete pradehAshca hitA j~jeyA visarpiNAm )| prapauNDarIkaM madhukaM balA shAlUkamutpalam||82||
nyagrodhapatradugdhIke saghRutaM syAt pralepanam| bisAni ca mRuNAlaM ca saghRutAshca kasherukAH||83||
shatAvarIvidAryoshca kandau dhautaghRutAplutau| shaivAlaM nalamUlAni gojihvA vRuShakarNikA||84||
indrANishAkaM saghRutaM shirIShatvagbalAghRutam | nyagrodhodumbaraplakShavetasAshvatthapallavaiH||85||
tvakkalkairbahusarpirbhiH shItairAlepanaM hitam| pradehAH sarva evaite vAtapittolbaNe shubhAH||86||
sakaphe tu pravakShyAmi pradehAnaparAn hitAn| triphalAM padmakoshIraM sama~ggAM karavIrakam||87||
nalamUlAnyanantAM ca pradehamupakalpayet| khadiraM saptaparNaM ca mustamAragvadhaM dhavam||88||
kuraNTakaM devadAru dadyAdAlepanaM bhiShak| Aragvadhasya patrANi tvacaM shleShmAtakasya ca||89||
indrANishAkaM kAkAhvAM shirIShakusumAni ca| shaivAlaM nalamUlAni vIrAM gandhapriya~ggukAm||90||
triphalAM madhukaM vIrAM shirIShakusumAni ca| prapauNDarIkaM hrIberaM dArvItva~gmadhukaM balAm||91||
pRuthagAlepanaM kuryAddvandvashaH sarvasho~api vA| pradehAH sarva evaite deyAH svalpaghRutAplutAH||92||
vAtapittolbaNe ye tu pradehAste ghRutAdhikAH| ghRutena shatadhautena pradihyAt kevalena vA||93||
ghRutamaNDena shItena payasA madhukAmbunA| pa~jcavalkakaShAyeNa secayecchItalena vA||94||
vAtAsRukpittabahulaM visarpaM bahusho bhiShak| secanAste pradehA ye ta eva ghRutasAdhanAH||95||
te cUrNayogA vIsarpavraNAnAmavacUrNanAH| dUrvAsvarasasiddhaM ca ghRutaM syAdvraNaropaNam||96||
dArvItva~gmadhukaM lodhraM kesharaM cAvacUrNanam| paTolaH picumardashca triphalA madhukotpale||97||
pradehAH sarva evaite kartavyAH samprasAdanAH ||98||
kShaNe kShaNe prayoktavyAH pUrvamuddhRutya lepanam| adhAvanoddhRute pUrve pradehA bahusho~aghanAH||99||
deyAH pradehAH kaphaje paryAdhAnoddhRute ghanAH| tribhAgA~gguShThamAtraH syAt pralepaH kalkapeShitaH||100||
nAtisnigdho na rUkShashca na piNDo na dravaH samaH| na ca paryuShitaM lepaM kadAcidavacArayet||101||
na ca tenaiva lepena punarjAtu pralepayet| kledavIsarpashUlAni soShNAbhAvAt pravartayet||102||
lepo hyupari paTTasya kRutaH svedayati vraNam| svedajAH piDakAstasya kaNDUshcaivopajAyate||103||
uparyupari lepasya lepo yadyavacAryate| tAneva doShA~jjanayet paTTasyopari yAn kRutaH||104||
atisnigdho~atidravashca lepo yadyavacAryate| tvaci na shliShyate samya~gna doShaM shamayatyapi||105||
tanvAliptaM na kurvIta saMshuShko hyApuTAyate| na cauShadhiraso vyAdhiM prApnotyapi ca shuShyati||106||
tanvAliptena ye doShAstAneva janayedbhRusham| saMshuShkaH pIDayedvyAdhiM niHsneho hyavacAritaH||107||
annapAnAni vakShyAmi visarpANAM nivRuttaye| la~gghitebhyo hito mantho rUkShaH sakShaudrasharkaraH||108||
madhuraH ki~jcidamlo vA dADimAmalakAnvitaH| saparUShakamRudvIkaH sakharjUraH shRutAmbunA||109||
tarpaNairyavashAlInAM sasnehA cAvalehikA| jIrNe purANashAlInAM yUShairbhu~jjIta bhojanam||110||
mudgAnmasUrAMshcaNakAn yUShArthamupakalpayet| anamlAn dADimAmlAn vA paTolAmalakaiH saha||111||
jA~ggalAnAM ca mAMsAnAM rasAMstasyopakalpayet| rUkShAn parUShakadrAkShAdADimAmalakAnvitAn||112||
raktAH shvetA mahAhvAshca shAlayaH ShaShTikaiH saha| bhojanArthe prashasyante purANAH suparisrutAH||113||
yavagodhUmashAlInAM sAtmyAnyeva pradApayet| yeShAM nAtyucitaH shAlirnarA ye ca kaphAdhikAH||114||

vidAhInyannapAnAni viruddhaM svapanaM divA| krodhavyAyAmasUryAgnipravAtAMshca vivarjayet||115||

Commentary: visarpe varjyAnyAha- vidAhInItyAdi||115||
kuryAccikitsitAdasmAcchItaprAyANi paittike| rUkShaprAyANi kaphaje snaihikAnyanilAtmake||116||
vAtapittaprashamanamagnivIsarpaNe hitam| kaphapittaprashamanaM prAyaH kardamasa~jj~jite||117||
raktapittottaraM dRuShTvA granthivIsarpamAditaH| rUkShaNairla~gghanaiH sekaiH pradehaiH pA~jcavalkalaiH||118||
sirAmokShairjalaukobhirvamanaiH savirecanaiH| ghRutaiH kaShAyatiktaishca kAlaj~jaH samupAcaret||119||
UrdhvaM cAdhashca shuddhAya rakte cApyavasecite| vAtashleShmaharaM karma granthivIsarpiNe hitam||120||
utkArikAbhiruShNAbhirupanAhaH prashasyate| snigdhAbhirveshavArairvA granthivIsarpashUlinAm||121||
dashamUlopasiddhena tailenoShNena secayet| kuShThatailena coShNena pAkyakShArayutena ca||122||
gomUtraiH patraniryUhairuShNairvA pariShecayet| sukhoShNayA pradihyAdvA piShTayA cAshvagandhayA||123||
shuShkamUlakakalkena naktamAlatvacA~api vA| bibhItakatvacAM vA~api kalkenoShNena lepayet||124||
balAM nAgabalAM pathyAM bhUrjagranthiM bibhItakam| vaMshapatrANyagnimanthaM kuryAdgranthipralepanam||125||
dantI citrakamUlatvak sudhArkapayasI guDaH| bhallAtakAsthi kAsIsaM lepo bhindyAcchilAmapi||126||
bahirmArgAsthitaM granthiM kiM punaH kaphasambhavam| dIrghakAlasthitaM granthiM bhindyAdvA bheShajairimaiH||127||
mUlakAnAM kulatthAnAM yUShaiH sakShAradADimaiH| godhUmAnnairyavAnnairvA sasIdhumadhusharkaraiH||128||
sakShaudrairvAruNImaNDairmAtulu~ggarasAnvitaiH| triphalAyAH prayogaishca pippalIkShaudrasaMyutaiH||129||
mustabhallAtashaktUnAM prayogairmAkShikasya ca| devadAruguDUcyoshca prayogairgirijasya ca||130||
dhUmairvirekaiH shirasaH pUrvoktairgulmabhedanaiH| ayolavaNapAShANahematAmraprapIDanaiH||131||
AbhiH kriyAbhiH siddhAbhirvividhAbhirbalI sthiraH| granthiH pAShANakaThino yadA naivopashAmyati||132||
athAsya dAhaH kShAreNa sharairhemnA~atha vA hitaH| pAkibhiH pAcayitvA vA pATayitvA samuddharet||133||
mokShayedbahushashcAsya raktamutkleshamAgatam| punashcApahRute rakte vAtashleShmajidauShadham||134||
dhUmo virekaH shirasaH svedanaM parimardanam| aprashAmyati doShe ca pAcanaM vA prashasyate||135||
praklinnaM dAhapAkAbhyAM bhiShak shodhanaropaNaiH| bAhyaishcAbhyantaraishcaiva vraNavat samupAcaret||136||
kampillakaM viDa~ggAni dArvIM kAra~jjakaM phalam| piShTvA tailaM vipaktavyaM granthivraNacikitsitam||137||
dvivraNIyopadiShTena karmaNA cApyupAcaret| deshakAlavibhAgaj~jo vraNAn vIsarpajAn budhaH||138||
iti granthivisarpacikitsA

vividhaM sarpati yato visarpastena sa smRutaH| parisarpo~athavA nAmnA sarvataH parisarpaNAt||11||

Commentary: vividhamityAdinA yathAkramaM prashnAnAmuttaramAha| vividhaM sarpatIti adha UrdhvaM tiryak tathA sphoTashophAdibhiH prasaratIti visarpaH| parisarpashabdArthaM vyAkaroti- parisarpo~athavetyAdi| paritaH sarvataH, parishabdaH sarvato~arthe ityarthaH; kiMvA parisarpaNashabdena sarpaNamAtramucyate, sarvataHshabdena parishabdArtho vyAkriyate, tenoktaM- sarvataH parisarpaNAditi||11||
ya eva vidhiruddiShTo granthInAM vinivRuttaye| sa eva galagaNDAnAM kaphajAnAM nivRuttaye||139||
galagaNDAstu vAtotthA ye kaphAnugatA nRuNAm| ghRutakShIrakaShAyANAmabhyAsAnna bhavanti te||140||
yAnIhoktAni karmANi visarpANAM nivRuttaye| ekatastAni sarvANi raktamokShaNamekataH||141||
visarpo na hyasaMsRuShTo raktapittena jAyate| tasmAt sAdhAraNaM sarvamuktametaccikitsitam||142||
visheSho doShavaiShamyAnna ca noktaH samAsataH| samAsavyAsanirdiShTAM kriyAM vidvAnupAcaret||143||
tatra shlokAH- niruktaM nAmabhedAshca doShA dUShyANi hetavaH| Ashrayo mArgatashcaiva visarpagurulAghavam||144||
li~ggAnyupadravA ye ca yallakShaNa upadravaH| sAdhyatvaM, na ca, sAdhyAnAM sAdhanaM ca yathAkramam||145||
iti piprakShave siddhimagniveshAya dhImate| punarvasuruvAcedaM visarpANAM cikitsitam||146||
sa ca saptavidho doShairvij~jeyaH saptadhAtukaH| pRuthak trayastribhishcaiko visarpo dvandvajAstrayaH||12||
vAtikaH paittikashcaiva kaphajaH sAnnipAtikaH| catvAra ete visarpA vakShyante dvandvajAstrayaH||13||
Agneyo vAtapittAbhyAM granthyAkhyaH kaphavAtajaH| yastu kardamako ghoraH sa pittakaphasambhavaH||14||

raktaM lasIkA tva~gmAMsaM dUShyaM doShAstrayo malAH| visarpANAM samutpattau vij~jeyAH sapta dhAtavaH||15||

Commentary: pRuthagityAdinA nirdiShTaM saptavidhatvaM darshayati| raktamityAdinA saptadhAtutvaM sphuTayati| raktAdidoShatvaM kuShThe yadyapyasti, tathA~api visarpaNashIlairdoShairvisarpAH, kuShThAni tu cirakriyairdoShairjAyanta ityAdi kuShThacikitsite eva prapa~jcitamanusaraNIyam| doShAstrayo malA ityatra doShashabdenaiva vAtAdiprAptau malA iti atyarthaduShTyAM sharIramalinIkaraNatvaM pratipAdayitumuktam| uktaM cAnyatra- “sharIradUShaNAddoShA malinIkaraNAnmalAH| dhAraNAddhAtavashca syurvAtapittakaphAstrayaH” iti||15||
lavaNAmlakaTUShNAnAM rasAnAmatisevanAt| dadhyamlamastushuktAnAM surAsauvIrakasya ca||16||
vyApannabahumadyoShNarAgaShADavasevanAt| shAkAnAM haritAnAM ca sevanAcca vidAhinAm||17||
kUrcikAnAM kilATAnAM sevanAnmandakasya ca| dadhnaH shANDAkipUrvANAmAsutAnAM ca sevanAt||18||
tilamAShakulatthAnAM tailAnAM paiShTikasya ca| grAmyAnUpaudakAnAM ca mAMsAnAM lashunasya ca||19||
praklinnAnAmasAtmyAnAM viruddhAnAM ca sevanAt| atyAdAnAddivAsvapnAdajIrNAdhyashanAt kShatAt||20||
kShatabandhaprapatanAddharmakarmAtisevanAt | viShavAtAgnidoShAcca visarpANAM samudbhavaH||21||
etairnidAnairvyAmishraiH kupitA mArutAdayaH| dUShyAn sandUShya raktAdIn visarpantyahitAshinAm||22||
bahiHshritaH shritashcAntastathA cobhayasaMshritaH| visarpo balameteShAM j~jeyaM guru yathottaram||23||
bahirmArgAshritaM sAdhyamasAdhyamubhayAshritam| visarpaM dAruNaM vidyAt sukRucchraM tvantarAshrayam||24||
antaHprakupitA doShA visarpantyantarAshraye| bahirbahiHprakupitAH sarvatrobhayasaMshritAH||25||
marmopaghAtAt sammohAdayanAnAM vighaTTanAt| tRuShNAtiyogAdvegAnAM viShamANAM pravartanAt||26||
vidyAdvisarpamantarjamAshu cAgnibalakShayAt| ato viparyayAdbAhyamanyairvidyAt svalakShaNaiH||27||

yasya sarvANi li~ggAni balavadyasya kAraNam| yasya copadravAH kaShTA marmago yashca hanti saH||28||

Commentary: yasya sarvANIti antarAshrayabahirAshrayavisarpalakShaNAni||28||

pUrvAdhyAye chardivegavighAtAdvisarpANAmutpatteshchardyanantaraM visarpasya cikitsitamucyate| chardeshca raktadUShakatvaM vidhishoNitIye “chardervegapratIghAtAt” (sU.a.28) ityAdinA “sharatkAlasvabhAvAcca shoNitaM sampradUShyati” (sU.a.28) ityantenoktam||1-2||

rUkShoShNairityAdinA pRuthagghetulakShaNamAha| atra ca rUkShAdibhiH svatantraH, pUraNena ca mArgAvarodhAt kupitaH paratantro vAyurj~jeyaH| uShNaM ca yadyapi na sAkShAdvAtajanakaM tathA~api rUkShasambandhAduShNaM vAtaM karoti| uShNasambaddhatvasAmAnyasamprAptisamprAptamiha yat pittaM tajjanyata iti j~jeyam| davathuH cakShurAdiShvatyarthatApaH, davathushca paittiko~apyatra utsargasiddhavisarpArthagAmipittaraktasambhavAdbhavati||29-30||

pittamityAdinA paittikamAha| dhamanIH pUrayanniti padaM yadyapi paittike evAktaM, tathA~api ‘samAneShvartheShvekatrAbhihito vidhiranyatrApyanusa~jjanIyaH’ iti nyAyAdanyavisarpeShvapi j~jeyam| ayaM ca samAno vidhiH pittapradhAnatvAdvisarpANAM pittavikAre evoktaH| shItavAtashItatoyayostRuShNA shItavAtavAritarShaH| avakAshe iti deshe||31-32||

svAdvamletyAdinA kaphajamAha| hetvantareShvapi shleShmaNo vidyamAneShu svAdvAdInAmabhidhAnameShAmeva prAyo visarpajanakatvAt| evaM vAtapittajanakahetvabhidhAne~api varNanIyam| kRucchrama~gge visarpati shIghra sharIre na visarpati| shItakaH shItam| Urdhvamiti ata UrdhvakAlam; kiMvA UrdhvakAye, shleShmaNa Urdhvakaye evAvasthAnAt| jAlAvatatairiti jAlAvatatairivetyarthaH| anuSha~ggI cirakAlasthAyI||33-34||

vAtapittamityAdinA~agnivisarpalakShaNamAha| parasparaM labdhabalamiti vAtapittaM cAnyonyaM vardhitashaktikam| shAntA~ggAraprakAsha iti nirvANA~ggArasadRushaH kRuShNa ityarthaH| sthAnAt urdhvAvasthAnAt| krAntuM gantum| evaMvidhamityanena agnivisarpasya ‘anupahate marmaNi’ ityAdinA sAdhyatvena vakShyamANA~avasthA vyavasthitA||35-36||

kaphapittamityAdinA kardamavisarpamAha| prAyAshcAmAshaye visarpatIti kardamasya kaphapittajanyatvAt kaphapittayoshca AmAshayasthitatvAditi bhAvaH| alasaka iti mandavisarpI| ekadeshagrAhI na sarvasharIravyApakaH| malinaH maladigdhaH| stimitavedana iti mandavedanaH| gambhIrapAkaH antaHpAkaH| antaraM prayacchatIti avakAshaM dadAti| etasya kardamasArUpyAt kardamasa~jj~jA j~jeyA| taM kardamavisarpaparItamacikitsyaM vidyAditi yathoktasarvalakShaNaM kardamamasAdhyaM vidyAt; asampUrNalakShaNaM prati tu cikitsAM vakShyatyeva||37-38||

tatra sAdhyAnAmityAdinA cikitsAmAha| ullekhanaM vamanam| kaphasthAnagata iti UrdhvakAyagate| pittasthAnatvena madhyasharIraM, mArutAshayashabdena ca pakvAshayAdhaHsharIraM gRuhyate| vAtolbaNe tiktaghRutaM paittike ca prashasyate laghudoShe iti cchedaH; tena laghudoShe paittike iti yojyam| bahudoShAyeti pittasya prakRutatvAd bahupittAyetyarthaH| teneti avirecanaghRutena| taddhyasyAshritasa~jj~jitamiti tat shoNitamasya visarpasya Ashrayatvena kathitaM, tena shoNitAvasekAdAshrayocchedena visarpocchedo bhavatItyarthaH||43-49||
vyAsata iti vistareNa| kaphapittaje iti vyastasamastakaphapittaje||50-53||

kailAse ityAdi| prashno~atra deshaguNopadarshanaparaH, shobhane hi deshe sumanaso guravaH shiShyaiH pRuShTAH samyagvadanti| kusumasampadA puShpaphalasampattyA| madhurAn gandhAn iShTAn gandhAn| viharantaM vicarantam| jitAtmAnaM jitendriyam| AshIviShAH sarpAH| upalakShaye pashyAmi| anupakrAntA gadAH kecidvinashyanti, yathAvya~ggatilakAdayaH; kicittu upakrAntA api cireNa ghnanti, yathA- mehagulmAdayaH; anena tu gRuhItAH shIghrameva vinashyantIti tvarAvisheShaM cikitsite darshayati| sa~jj~jitaH kena hetuneti kasmAddhetorvakShyamANavisarpA visarpasa~jj~jayA AkhyAtA ityarthaH| kiyaddhAturiti katidhAtukAraNakaH| kathaM kairlakShaNairiti kathambhUtaH kairlakShaNairj~jeya ityarthaH||3-10||

kirAtatiktAdirapi kaShAyayoga eva| tenaiva vidhineti mustAdiyogoktakaShAyavidhinA| nishAparyuShitamiti shItakaShAyam| ayaM ca shItakaShAyavidhiH paTolamityAdAvapi yojyaH| masUravidalairiti masUrANAM vidalaiH; na cAtra vidalA shyAmA, tasyAH strIli~ggatvAt||54-61||

triphalArasetyAdau triphalArasAdibhiH samaM mishritaM ghRutaM deyam| gurukoShThAyeti krUrakoShThAya; anye doShapUrNakoShThaM gurukoShThamAhuH| doShe koShThagate bhUya ityatra bhUyaHshabdaH prAyovAcI||62-67||-

shAkhAshrayadoShairduShTe rakte cikitsAmAha- shAkhAduShTa ityAdi| shAkhAduShTe rakte doShavisheSheNa raktAvasekopAyamAha- vAtAnvitamityAdi| raktAvasekavidhAnaM ceha parAdhikAratvAnnoktaM, tacca sushrute j~jeyam| yathAsannamiti yA vikArapratyAsannA sirA tAM vyadhayet| sirAvyadhashca sarvasAdhAraNaH| raktAnapaharaNe doShamAha- tva~gmAMsetyAdi||68-70||

saMshuddhe iti virecanashoNitamokShaNAbhyAm| Adita iti utpattAveva| bAhyA iti AlepapariShekAdikAH| nyagrodhapAdA iti vaTaprarohAH| kadalIgarbhaH garbhasthA kadalI| kAleyaM kAleyakakAShThamiti khyAtam| hema iti nAgakesharacUrNam| vanyaM kaivartamustakam| shAdvalaM durvA| mRuNAlam ushIram | vIrA vidArIkandaH| hareNavaH vartulakalAyAH| shvetashAlayaH akaNDitashukladhAnyAni| dugdhikA svanAmakhyAtA| mRuNAlaM padmanAlikA| vRuShakarNI mUShikaparNikA| kAkAhvA kAShThodumbarikA| indrANiH nirguNDI| balAghRutamiti chedaH| plakShaH alpadIrghapatraH parkaTI| pradehAnaparAnityanena pUrvoktapradehA api sakaphe hitA iti sUcayatItyeke; pUrvoktapradehApekShayaiva ‘aparAn’ iti padaM kRutaM, tena pUrvoktapradehAnAM bhinnaviShayANAM kaphe~anadhikAra iti pashyAmaH| anantA utpalasArivA| kuraNTakaH amlAnakaH| shleShmAtakaH ‘bahuvAraka’ iti prasiddhaH| indrANIshAkaM kecit matsyAkShakamAhuH, nirguNDImevApare| gandhapriya~gguH priya~ggureva| shevAlamityAdirvyastasamastayogaH| sarva evetyatra ete iti kaphavihitAH pradehAH| vAtapittolbaNe ityatra yadyapi vAtolbaNe sAkShAt pradehA na vihitAH, tathA~api raktapittolbaNe ye vihitAH kaphe vA, tatraiva dravyaguNamAlocya ye vAtaharadravyakRutA lakShyante ta evAdhikartavyA iti j~jeyam| ghRutamaNDaH ghRutasantAnikA ghRutoparibhavA| pa~jcavalkaM tantrAntare- “nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthaplakShavetasavalkalaiH| sarvairekatrasaMyuktaiH pa~jcavalkalamucyate” ityanenoktam| anye tu vetasasthAne gandhamuNDamatra grAhayanti| pradehArthoktadravyANyeva pariShecane ghRutasAdhane vraNAvacUrNane~api vidadhyAt| dArvItyAdau etatprakShAlanamiti etairdArvyAdibhiH prakShAlanArthakvAthaH kartavyaH, tathA ghRutaM caitaireva sAdhanIyaM, tathA cUrNaM ca pralepanaM kartavyam||71-97||-

samprasAdanA iti savarNakarAH, savarNatve sAdhye kartavyA ityarthaH; kiMvA samprasAdanA iti raktapittaprasAdanAH; tenAyamarthaH- ya ete raktapitte pradehAH kartavyA uktAste kShaNe kShaNe pUrvaM lepanamuddhRutya prayoktavyAH, na cireNa nApi pUrvapralepanoparItyarthaH| ashuShkAvasthAyAM pUrvalepe uddhRute sati bahushaH aghanA pratanukAshca kartavyAH| kaphapradehAnAM visheShamAha- deyA ityAdi| paryAdhAnoddhRuta iti shuShkoddhRute||98-107||

bheShajamabhidhAyAnnapAnamAha- annapAnAnItyAdi| jIrNe iti avalehikArUpe~anne jIrNe| jA~ggalAnAmityAdau rUkShAnityanena rasasaMskArakasnehaviraheNa matsyAdyatisnigdhamAMsApekShayA rUkShamAMsakRutatvena rUkShatvaM j~jeyam| raktA shvetA mahAhvAshceti raktashAlayaH shvetashAlayo mahAshAlayashca; shvetashAlirmAgadhe ‘puNDarIkashAliH’ iti khyAtaH| yavagodhUmetyAdi yavagodhUmasAtmyAnAM tAvat sAtmyaM yavagodhUmameva prayojayet| yeShAM ca shAlirnAtyucito nAbhyastasteShAM yavagodhUmAveva deyau, tayoH kaphaviruddhAtvAd visarpahitatvAcca| uktaM hi- “sarvaM madhuraM kaphakaramanyatra purANAcchAliyavagodhUmAt” (sU.a.27) iti||108-114||
visarpe doShabhedena cikitsAmAha- kuryAdityAdi||116-117||

granthivisarpacikitsAmAha- raktapittottaramityAdi| utkArikAbhirityAdinopanAhamAha| upanAha uShNo bahalo lepaH| pAkyakShArayuteneti pAkena sushrutAdyuktavidhAnena kRutaH kShAraH pAkyakShAraH, kiMvA ‘yavakShArayutena’ iti pAThaH| gomUtrairityAdau patram eraNDAdipatram| naktamAlaH kara~jjaH| bibhItakatvacAmityatra kalkeneti yojyam| dantItyAdau yo lepo shilAmapi bhindyAt sa kaphagranthiM nitarAmeva bhindyAditi bhAvaH| imairiti vakShyamANaiH| girijaM shilAjatu; girijaprayogashca rasAyanokto j~jeyaH| mustasaktavaH “mustaM vyoSha” (ci.a.7) ityAdinA kuShThoktAH| bhallAtakasaktavaH rasAyanoktAH| mAkShikasyeti dhAtumAkShikasya| pUrvoktairgulmabhedanairiti vimArgAjapadAdarshaiH| ayolavaNetyAdi taptAyaHprabhRutibhiH pIDanairityarthaH| sharairhemneti shareNa hemnA vA tApitena| pAkibhiriti pAcanapiNDaiH| punashcetyAdinA uktA api dhUmAdayaH punarapanItagranthiviShayatayA vidhIyante, tena ceha na punaruktiH||118-138||
granthicikitsitamuktaM galagaNDagaNDamAlAyAmapyatidishannAha- ya evetyAdinA| galagaNDAnAmiti vacanAd gaNDamAlA~api vivakShitA||139-140||

visarpe raktamokShaNastutimAha- yAnItyAdi| raktamokShaNameva kutaH pradhAnamityAha- visarpo netyAdi| sAdhAraNamiti vAtakaphavisarpe raktapittaharaM cikitsitam| na ca nokta iti ukta ityarthaH||141-143||
niruktamityAdisa~ggrahaH| yallakShaNa upadrava iti yAdRuglakShaNa upadravaH| na ceti na sAdhyamityarthaH| piprakShave praShTumicchave||144-146||
saptavidho doShairiti doShabhedAt saptavidho bhavati| etena sAdhyAsAdhyabhedo~apyasya sambhavatIti darshayati||12-14||

jAyate kaishca hetubhirityasyottaraM- lavaNAmletyAdi| uShNAnAmiti uShNavIryANAM, saindhavAmalakAdInAM lavaNAmlakaTUnAmapi shItavIryatvAduShNAnAmiti kRutam| haritAnAmiti haritashAkavargapaThitAnAmArdrakAdInAm| kUrcikA dadhikUrcikA takrakUrcikA ca, kilATaH naShTakShIrapiNDaH| mandakasyeti mandajAtasya dadhnaH| shANDAkipUrvANAmiti shANDAkIsandhAnAnAm| ajIrNe~ashanamajIrNAshanaM, kiMvA ajIrNasyApariNatasyAshanam; avidagdhe pUrvadinAnne~ashanamadhyashanam| vyAmishraiH sammishraiH||16-22||

sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgaj~jAnArthaM shAkhAshritatvAdInAha- bahirityAdi| yathottaramiti bahiHshritAdantaHshritaH, antaHshritAdubhayAshrito gururityarthaH| antarAshraye iti antaHsharIre, bahiriti shAkhAyAM, sarpati||23-25||
antarAshrayAdi visarpalakShaNamAha- marmopaghAtAdityAdi| marmeti hRudayam| vidyAt svalakShaNairiti vakShyamANavisarpalakShaNaiH||26-27||
athAtastRuShNAcikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

j~jAnaprashamatapobhiH khyAto~atrisuto jagaddhite~abhirataH| tRuShNAnAM prashamArthaM cikitsitaM prAha pa~jcAnAm||3||

Commentary: j~jAnetyAdau j~jAnaM tattvaj~jAnaM, prashamaH shAntiH, tapaH cAndrAyaNAdi| cikitsitaM cikitsAvidhAyako granthaH, nidAnAdyabhidhAnaM ca cikitsArthameva, nidAnAdij~jAnapUrvakatvAccikitsAyAH | pa~jcAnAmiti vacanena pa~jcAnAmapi cikitsAviShayatvaM darshayati, nahi kAsashvAsavadasyAsAdhyatvaM kasyAshcidatretyarthaH, tathA sushrutoktAtiriktatRuShNAdvayAntarbhAvaM pa~jcasveva sUcayati| uktaM hi sushrute- “tisraH smRutAstAH kShatajA caturthI kShayAttathA hyAmasamudbhavA ca| syAt saptamI bhaktanimittajA ca” (su.u.a.48) iti||3||

sarvAstvatiprasaktA rogakRushAnAM vamiprasaktAnAm| ghoropadravayuktAstRuNA maraNAya vij~jeyAH||18||

Commentary: idAnIM tRuShNAnAmasAdhyatAlakShaNamAha- sarvAstvityAdi| ghoropadravayukteti pIDAkaropadravavatI||18||
nAgniM vinA hi tarShaH pavanAdvA tau hi shoShaNe hetU| abdhAtorativRuddhAvapAM kShaye tRuShyate naro hi||19||
gurvannapayaHsnehaiH sammUrcchadbhirvidAhakAle ca| yastRuShyedvRutamArge tatrApyanilAnalau hetU||20||
tIkShNoShNarUkShabhAvAnmadyaM pittAnilau prakopayati| shoShayato~apAM dhAtuM tAveva hi madyashIlAnAm||21||
taptAsviva sikatAsu hi toyamAshu shuShyati kShiptam| teShAM santaptAnAM himajalapAnAdbhavati sharma||22||

shishirasnAtasyoShmA ruddhaH koShThaM prapadya tarShayati| tasmAnnoShNaklAnto bhajeta sahasA jalaM shItam ||23||

Commentary: shItamlAnajAmantarbhAvayannAha- shishiretyAdi| shishiraM shItam| UShmA ruddha iti shItasparshajalena bahiranirgacchan romakUpairuShmA~avaruddhaH pratIpIkRutaH, etena etasyApi pittajatvamuktam| na sahasetyanena vishramya shItajalasevAyAM na tathAvidhA tRuShNA bhavatIti darshayati||23||

li~ggaM sarvAsvetAsvanilakShayapittajaM bhavatyatha tu| pRuthagAgamAccikitsitamataH pravakShyAmi tRuShNAnAm||24||

Commentary: samprati annasammUrcchanAdinA yathoktakrameNa anila-kShaya-pittajAvarodhamabhidhAya sarvAsAmevAnila-kShaya-pittajatvamupadarshayannAha- li~ggaM sarvAsvityAdi| anila-kShaya-pittajamityatra kShayajamiti abdhAtukShayajameva| sAmAnye~api tRuShNAnAM bhedena cikitsAbhidhAne hetumAha- atha tvityAdi| pRuthagAgamAditi pRuthagghetutvAt, AgacchatyasmAditi Agamo hetuH; vAtAdihetubhedAccikitsitabhedaM vakShyAmItyarthaH| kiMvA pRuthak cikitsitaM vakShyAmi, AgamAditi AyurvedAgamaprAmANyAt; Agame tRuShNAnAM bhedena cikitsAbhidhAnAdahamapi pRuthak cikitsAM vakShyAmItyarthaH||24||
apAM kShayAddhi tRuShNA saMshoShya naraM praNAshayedAshu| tasmAdaindraM toyaM samadhu pibettadguNaM vA~anyat||25||
ki~jcittuvarAnurasaM tanu laghu shItalaM sugandhi surasaM ca| anabhiShyandi ca yattatkShitigatamapyaindravajj~jeyam||26||
shRutashItaM sasitopalamathavA sharapUrvapa~jcamUlena| lAjAsaktusitAhvAmadhuyutamaindreNa vA mantham||27||
vATyaM vA~a~amayavAnAM shItaM madhusharkarAyutaM dadyAt| peyAM vA shAlInAM dadyAdvA koradUShANAm||28||
payasA shRutena bhojanamathavA madhusharkarAyutaM yojyam| pArAvatAdikarasairghRutabhRuShTairvA~apyalavaNAmlaiH||29||
tRuNapa~jcamUlamu~jjAtakaiH priyAlaishca jA~ggalAH sukRutAH| shastA rasAH payo vA taiH siddhaM sharkarAmadhumat||30||
shatadhautaghRutenAktaH payaH pibecchItatoyamavagAhya| mudgamasUracaNakajA rasAstu bhRuShTA ghRute deyAH||31||
madhuraiH sajIvanIyaiH shItaishca satiktakaiH shRutaM kShIram| pAnAbhya~jjanasekeShviShTaM madhusharkarAyuktam||32||
tajjaM vA ghRutamiShTaM pAnAbhya~ggeShu nasyamapi ca syAt| nArIpayaH sasharkaramuShTryA api nasyamikShurasaH||33||
kShIrekShurasaguDodakasitopalAkShaudrasIdhumArdvIkaiH | vRukShAmlamAtulu~ggairgaNDUShAstAlushoShaghnAH||34||
jambvAmrAtakabadarIvetasapa~jcavalkapa~jcAmlaiH| hRunmukhashiraHpradehAHsaghRutA mUrcchAbhramatRuShNAghnAH syuH||35||
dADimadadhitthalodhraiH savidArIbIjapUrakaiH shirasaH| lepo gaurAmalakairghRutAranAlAyutaishca hitaH||36||
shaivalapa~gkAmburuhaiH sAmlaiH saghRutaishca shaktubhirlepaH| mastvAranAlArdravasanakamalamaNihArasaMsparshAH||37||
shishirAmbucandanArdrastanataTapANitalagAtrasaMsparshAH| kShaumArdranivasanAnAM varA~gganAnAM priyANAM ca||38||
himavaddarIvanasaritsaro~ambujapavanendupAdashishirANAm| ramyashishirodakAnAM smaraNaM kathAshca tRuShNAghnAH||39||

vAtaghnamannapAnaM mRudu laghu shItaM ca vAtatRuShNAyAm| kShayakAsanucchRutaM kShIraghRutamUrdhvavAtatRuShNAghnam ||40||

Commentary: vAtaghnetyAdinA tRuShNAnAM vaisheShikIM cikitsAmAha| kShayakAsaharaiH shRutaM kShayakAsanucchRutam| UrdhvavAtaH shvAsaH| vAtapittaje tarShe ityatra saMsargajA tRuShNA asUtritA~api asUtritadvandvajagulmAbhidhAnanyAyenocyate||40||-
paitte drAkShAcandanakharjUroshIramadhuyutaM toyam||41||
lohitashAlitaNDulakharjUraparUShakotpaladrAkShAH| madhu pakvaloShTameva ca jale sthitaM shItalaM peyam||42||
lohitashAliprasthaH salodhramadhukA~jjanotpalaH kShuNNaH| pakvAmaloShTajalamadhusamAyuto mRunmaye peyaH||43||
vaTamAtulu~ggavetasapallavakushakAshamUlayaShTyAhvaiH| siddhe~ambhasyagninibhAM kRuShNamRudaM kRuShNasikatAM vA||44||
taptAni navakapAlAnyathavA nirvApya pAyayetAccham| ApAkasharkaraM vA~amRutavallyudakaM tRuShAM hanti||45||
kShIravatAM madhurANAM shItAnAM sharkarAmadhuvimishrAH| shItakaShAyA mRudbhRuShTasaMyutAH pittatRuShNAghnAH||46||
vyoShavacAbhallAtakatiktakaShAyAstathA~a~amatRuShNAghnAH| yaccoktaM kaphajAyAM vamyAM taccaiva kAryaM syAt||47||
stambhArucyavipAkAlasyacchardiShu kaphAnugAM tRuShNAm| j~jAtvA dadhimadhutarpaNalavaNoShNajalairvamanamiShTam||48||
dADimamamlaphalaM vA~apyanyat sakaShAyamatha leham| peyamathavA pradadyAdrajanIsharkarAyuktam ||49||
kShayakAsena tu tulyA kShayatRuShNA sA garIyasI nRUNAm| kShINakShatashoShahitaistasmAttAM bheShajaiH shamayet||50||
pAnatRuShArtaH pAnaM tvardhodakamamlalavaNagandhADhyam| shishirasnAtaH pAnaM madyAmbu guDAmbu vA tRuShitaH||51||
bhaktoparodhatRuShitaH snehatRuShArto~athavA tanuyavAgUm| prapibedguruNA tRuShito bhuktena taduddharedbhuktam||52||
madyAmbu vA~ambu koShNaM balavAMstRuShitaH samullikhet pItvA| mAgadhikAvishadamukhaH sasharkaraM vA pibenmantham||53||
balavAMstu tAlushoShe pibeddhRutaM tRuShyamadyAcca| sarpirbhRuShTaM kShIraM mAMsarasAMshcAbalaH snigdhAn||54||
atirUkShadurbalAnAM tarShaM shamayennRuNAmihAshu payaH| chAgo vA ghRutabhRuShTaH shIto madhuro raso hRudyaH||55||
snigdhe~anne bhukte yA tRuShNA syAttAM guDAmbunA shamayet| tarShaM mUrcchAbhihatasya raktapittApahairhanyAt||56||
tRuTdAhamUrcchAbhramaklamamadAtyayAsraviShapitte | shastaM svabhAvashItaM, shRutashItaM sannipAte~ambhaH||57||
hikkAshvAsanavajvarapInasaghRutapItapArshvagalaroge| kaphavAtakRute styAne sadyaHshuddhe ca hitamuShNam||58||
pANDUdarapInasamehagulmamandAnalAtisAreShu| plIhni ca toyaM na hitaM kAmamasahye pibedalpam||59||
pUrvAmayAturaH san dInastRuShNArdito jalaM kA~gkShan| na labheta sa cenmaraNamAshvevApnuyAddIrgharogaM vA||60||
tasmAddhAnyAmbu pibettRuShyan rogI sasharkarAkShaudram| yadvA tasyAnyatsyAt sAtmyaM rogasya tacceShTam||61||
tasyAM vinivRuttAyAM tajjanya upadravaH sukhaM jetum| tasmAttRuShNAM pUrvaM jayedbahubhyo~api rogebhyaH||62||

tatra shlokaH- hetU yathA~agnipavanau kurutaH sopadravAM ca pa~jcAnAm| tRuShNAnAM pRuthagAkRutirasAdhyatA sAdhanaM coktam||63||

Commentary: heturityAdyadhyAyasa~ggrahaH| agnipavanau iti yathA~agnipavanau kurutaH sopadravAM ‘tRuShNAM’ iti sheShaH| upadravAshca mukhashoShAdayaH pUrvamuktAH ||63||
kShobhAdbhayAcchramAdapi shokAtkrodhAdvila~gghanAnmadyAt| kShArAmlalavaNakaTukoShNarUkShashuShkAnnasevAbhiH||4||
dhAtukShayagadakarShaNavamanAdyatiyogasUryasantApaiH| pittAnilau pravRuddhau saumyAndhAtUMshca shoShayataH||5||
rasavAhinIshca nAlIrjihvAmUlagalatAlukaklomnaH | saMshoShya nRuNAM dehe kurutastRuShNAM mahAbalAvetau||6||
pItaM pItaM hi jalaM shoShayatastAvato na yAti shamam| ghoravyAdhikRushAnAM prabhavatyupasargabhUtA sA||7||

prAgrUpaM mukhashoShaH, svalakShaNaM sarvadA~ambukAmitvam| tRuShNAnAM sarvAsAM li~ggAnAM lAghavamapAyaH||8||

Commentary: tRuShNAprAgrUpamAha- prAgrUpamityAdi| prAgrUpakathane eva madhye tRuShNAnAmavyabhicArilakShaNamAha- svalakShaNamityAdi| svalakShaNamiti avyabhicArilakShaNaM; yathA- jvarasya santApaH, shvayathorutsedhaH| punaH prakRutaM prAgrUpamAha- li~ggAnAM lAghavamapAya iti|- li~ggAnAM vakShyamANavAtAdijatRuShNAli~ggAnAM lAghavamalpatvaM keShA~jciccAbhAvaH pUrvarUpaM tRuShNAnAmityarthaH| tena pUrvarUpAvasthAyAM vakShyamANalakShaNAni kAnicinna bhavantyeva, yAni ca bhavanti tAnyalpatayA~asphuTAni bhavanti| uktaM ca- “avyaktaM lakShaNaM tasya pUrvarUpamiti smRutam” (ci.a.11) iti| kiMvA yadetat prAgrUpaM mukhashoShaH, svalakShaNaM sarvadAmbukAmitvaM, etat prAgrUpaM svalakShaNaM ca tRuShNAnAM; tena mukhashoShAmbukAmitve svalakShaNe tathA pUrvarUpe ca bhavataH, pUrvarUpAvasthAyAM tvaprabale mukhashoShAmbukAmitve j~jeye| ye tu ‘prAgrUpaM mukhashoShaH svarakShayaH sarvadA~ambukAmitvam’ iti paThanti, teShAM mate tRuShNAyAH svalakShaNaM noktaM syAt| uktaM ca hArIte~api tRuShNAsvalakShaNaM- “svalakShaNaM tu tRuShNAnAM sarvadA~ambupipAsitA” iti| kiMvA mukhashoShasvarakShaye eva pUrvarUpaM, sarvadA~ambukAmitvaM ca svalakShaNaM, li~ggAnAM ca lAghavaM rogarUpAyAstRuShNAyA apAyo gamanamityarthaH; ayameva tRuShNAvyuparamo yadvakShyamANali~ggAnAmalpatvaM, sarvathocchedo hi tRuShNAlakShaNAnAM na bhavatyeva, sahajatRuShNAgrastatvenaitallakShaNAnAmalpamAtratayA~avasthAnAt| kaishcittu li~ggAnAM lAghavamAshUtpAdaH, sa ca apAyo maraNamiti kRutvA tRuShNAnAmasAdhyatAlakShaNamidamucyate, tannAtimanoharam||8||
mukhashoShasvarabhedabhramasantApapralApasaMstambhAn| tAlvoShThakaNThajihvAkarkashatAM cittanAshaM ca||9||
jihvAnirgamamaruciM bAdhiryaM marmadUyanaM sAdam| tRuShNodbhUtA kurute, pa~jcavidhAM li~ggataH shRuNu tAm||10||

abdhAtuM dehasthaM kupitaH pavano yadA vishoShayati| tasmi~jshuShke shuShyatyabalastRuShyatyatha vishuShyan||11||

Commentary: abdhAtumityAdinA pa~jcAnAM samprAptyAdyAha| dehasthamiti dehe nAnArasAdirUpatayA sthitam| shuShke~abdhAtau shuShyatIti yojyam||11||

nidrAnAshaH shiraso bhramastathA shuShkavirasamukhatA ca sroto~avarodha iti ca syAlli~ggaM vAtatRuShNAyAH||12||

Commentary: srotovarodha iti atyupaghAtaH ||12||
pittaM matamAgneyaM kupitaM cettApayatyapAM dhAtum| santaptaH sa hi janayettRuShNAM dAholbaNAM nRUNAm||13||
tiktAsyatvaM shiraso dAhaH shItAbhinandatA mUrcchA| pItAkShimUtravarcastvamAkRutiH pittatRuShNAyAH||14||

tRuShNA yA~a~amaprabhavA sA~apyAgneyA~a~amapittajanitatvAt | li~ggaM tasyAshcArucirAdhmAnakaphaprasekau ca||15||

Commentary: tRuShNetyAdinA~a~amajAmAha| Amashabdena ceha lakShaNayA AmasamAnacikitsita AmasamAnalakShaNashca kapho~api gRuhyate| tenAmaprabhavAyA vyutpAdanena kaphajA~api sushrutoktA gRuhItaiveha| sA~apyAgneyetyanena pUrvaparij~jAtaM sarvAsAM vAtapittajanyatvaM samunnayati| vAtashca tRuShNAkAraNatvenokto~apyatrApradhAnaM, pittameva tu pradhAnamitIha vAtAkathanAdunnIyate| anyatrApyuktaM- “darshanaM paktirUShmA ca kShuttRuShNA dehamArdavam| prabhAprasAdau medhA ca pittakarmAvikArajam” (sU.a.18) iti| AmapittajanitatvAditi AmAvarodhavRuddhapittajanitatvAdityarthaH||15||

deho rasajo~ambubhavo rasashca tasya kShayAcca tRuShyeddhi| dInasvaraH pratAmyan saMshuShkahRudayagalatAluH ||16||

Commentary: deho rasaja ityAdinA kShayajAmAha| AhArarasAt sarvadhAtupoShako dhAturasa utpadyate, sa ca raso dehapoShako~ambubhava iti Apya ityarthaH| tasya kShayAditi rasakShayAt tRuShyate; rasakShayAdambukShayo bhavati, tena cAmbukShayeNa puruShaH pAnIyaprArthanArUpatRuShNayA yukto bhavatIti yuktamiti darshayati| uktaM hi sushrute- “doShadhAtumalakShINo balakShINo~api mAnavaH| svayonivardhanaM yattadannapAnaM prakA~gkShati” (su.sU.a.15) iti; ihApi coktaM ‘tasya kShayAcca tRuShyeddhi’ iti||16||

bhavati khalu yopasargAttRuShNA sA shoShiNI kaShTA| jvaramehakShayashoShashvAsAdyupasRuShTadehAnAm ||17||

Commentary: bhavatItyAdinopasargajAmAha| upasargAditi jvarAdyupadravAt, jvarAdyupadravarUpatayeti yAvat| kaShTeti kaShTasAdhyA| evaM prAksUtritavAtapittAmAmbukShayopasargAtmikAH pa~jca tRuShNA vyAhRutAH| atraiva sushrutoktA kaphajA AmajAyAmavaruddhA, kShatajA upasargAtmikAyAmavaruddhA, annajA cAmajAyAmevAntarbhAvanIyA||17||
visarpe prAyeNa tRuShNA upadravarUpA bhavatIti visarpAnantaraM tRuShNAcikitsitamucyate||1-2||

samprati tRuShNAntarANAmuktatRuShNAsvevAntarbhAvaM darshayannuktavaktavyatRuShNAnAmapi vAta-pitta-kShayajanyatvamAha- nAgnimityAdi| kasmAt punaragnivAtau vinA tarSho na bhavatItyAha- tau hItyAdi| tau hi ativRuddhau pittavAtarUpau agnipavanau abdhAtoH shoShaNe hetU, tasmAnnAgnivAtau vinA tarSha ityuktamityarthaH| evamagnivAtAbhyAM kRute~apAM kShaye svarUpAdeva narastRuShyati| evaM pittavAtakRutAbdhAtukShayajatRuShNAbhedamabhidhAya antarbhAvanIyatRuShNAbhedAnAha- gurvannetyAdi| sammUrcchadbhiriti ekatAM gacchadbhiH| atra vAto vRuddhaH sammUrcchane~annasya tRuShNAkaraH, vidAhakAle ca yA tRuShNA tatra pittaM tRuShNAkaram| madyajAmapyantarbhAvayannAha- tIkShNoShNetyAdi| sikatAsu vAlukAsu| teShAmityupashamakathanam| sharmeti sukham||19-22||

apAM kShayAdityAdinA cikitsAmAha| aindramiti AntarikSham| tadguNaM vA~anyaditi yaduktaM tatrAha- ki~jcidityAdi| ki~jciditi manAk| tuvaro~anurasatayA rasyate AsvAdyate yasmin tattuvarAnurasam| antarikShaM jalaM hyavyaktasarvarasayuktam “avyaktIbhAvastu rasAnAM prakRutau bhavatyanurasasamanvite vA dravye” (ci.a.sU.26) iti| aindravadityanena antarikShAnukAri kShitisamAbaddhaM bhavati| anye tu tuvarashabdena kaShAyamAhuH, tena ki~jcitkaShAyAnurasamityarthaH| tanviti svaccham| sugandhIti aniShTagandharahitam; uktaM hi sushrute- “aniShTagandhatA gandhadoShaH” (su.sU.a.45) iti| aprAtikUlyena rasanayA AsvAdyate iti surasaM; na tu vyaktasuShThurasaM surasam’; uktaM hi sushrute- “vyaktarasatA rasadoShaH” iti (su.sU.a.45)||25-26||

sharapUrvapa~jcamUleneti “sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca” (ci.a.1pA.1) ityatroktena sharAdipa~jcamUlena| AmayavAnAM vATyamiti IShadbhRuShTAdalitayavamaNDaH| mu~jjAtaka uttarApathaprasiddhaH| sukRutA iti susaMskRutAH| tairiti tRuNapa~jcamUlyAdibhiH| madhurairiti madhurarasaiH| shItairiti shItavIryaiH| tajjamiti madhurAdishRutakShIrajam||27-33||

mArdvIkaM mRudvIkArasakRutaM madyam| gaNDUShaH mukhapUrako dravaH| pa~jcAmlaM “kolAmlaM cikrikAmlaM ca mAtulu~ggAmlavetasam| caturamlamiti proktaM pa~jcAmlaM tu sadADimam” iti vacanAjj~jeyam| dadhitthaH kapitthaH| gaurAmalakairiti ArdratayA gauravarNairAmalakaiH| mastvAranAlastimitaM vasanaM mastvAranAlavasanam| indupAdAH candrarashmayaH||34-39||

paitte ityatra ‘tarShe’ iti sheShaH| lohitashAliprastha ityAdau lodhrAdInAM militAnAM catuShpalaM, prakShepyanyAyAt pAdikaM madhu, pakvAmaloShTaprasAdanaM (cAloDanayogyamAtraM ) dattvA shAlitaNDulaprasthaH kShapAyAM sthApyate, tadannaM (tasya pAnayogyamAtramadhuprakShepaM) mRunmaye pAtre pIyata iti vRuddhairupadarshitaH karmamArgaH| navakapAlAni nUtanasharAvAdikhaNDAn| ApAkasharkaramiti pAkanimittasharkarAsahitam| amRutavallI guDUcI| mRudbhRuShTasaMyutA iti bhRuShTamRudyuktAH||41-46||

anyat sakaShAyamiti AmalAdisakaShAyaleham| pAnatRuShArta iti atishayamadyapAnajatRuTpIDitaH| bhaktoparodhaH bhaktacchedaH | mAgadhikAvishadamukha ityatra mukhavaishadyamAtrakArikA pippalI prayoktavyA| tAlushoShe yadyapi ghRutaM niShiddhaM “tRuShNAmUrcchAparItAshca garbhiNyastAlushoShiNaH” (sU.a.13) iti, tathA~apIha balavattRuShyAnuyuktaM ghRutapAnaM vishiShTatvAnna virodhi| snigdhe~anne bhukte yA tRuShNA tatra yadyapi guDAmbu snigdhaguNayuktatvAnna hitam, uktaM hi- “yadAhAraguNaiH pAnaM viparItaM tadiShyate” (sU.a.27) iti; tathA~api madhurarasatayA tRuShNAharatvAt prabhAvAdvopayujyate| tarShaM mUrcchetyAdinA aupasargikatRuShNAcikitsocyate||47-56||

shItamuShNaM ca jalaM kutra deyaM varjyaM vA kutretyAha- tRuDityAdi| viShapitte iti viShe pitte ca| sannipAte iti sannipAtajvarodbhUtatRuShNAyAm| na hitamiti pANDvAdiroge tRuShNAyAmapi toyaM na hitam| asahye ‘tarShe’ iti sheShaH| eShvasahyatRuShNAyAM jalAdAne doShamAha- pUrvetyAdi| pUrvAmayAtura iti pUrvotpannagadapIDitaH| tajjanyopadrava iti tRuShNAprashamanArthaM pIyamAnapAnIyajaH| sukhaM jetumiti mahAtyayakarIM tRuShNAmapekShya jetuM sukhopAyo bhavatItyarthaH||57-62||

kShobhAdityAdyuktanidAnasya yathAyogyatayA vAtakartRutvaM vAtapittakartRutvaM conneyam| pittAnilAvityAdiH sarvatRuShNAsamprAptigranthaH| saumyAn dhAtUniti kapharasodakAni somaguNAtiriktAni| pradUShayata iti shoShaNena dUShayataH| klomna iti dvitIyAbahuvacanAntam| dehe ityanena etAsAM tRuShNAnAM shArIratvaM darshayati| yA hi mAnasI tRuShNA sA shArIre “icchAdveShAtmikA tRuShNA sukhaduHkhAt pravartate” (shA.a.1) ityAdAvuktA; iyaM tu dehAshrayadoShakAraNA satI dehajaiveti bhAvaH| svAbhAvikatRuShNAyAmapi vAtapitte Arambhake eva tat kiM sA~apyatra na gRuhyate? maivaM, tasyA ucitadravapAnenaivAbhipretena prashamAdiha asvAbhAvikavyAdhiprakaraNe nAdhikAra iti hRudi kRutvA| svAbhAvikatRuShNAkaravAtapittAbhyAM vakShyamANatRuShNArambhakavAtapittayorvisheShamAha- pItaM pItamityAdi| prakRutatRuShNArambhakau pittavAtau pItaM pItaM jalaM shoShayataH, ato jalashoShaNatvAddhetorna shamaM yAti puruShaH; svAbhAvikyAM jalaM pItvA shAntimadhigacchatIti bhAvaH| upadravarUpatRuShNotpAdamAha- ghoretyAdi| upasargabhUtA iti upadravarUpA||4-7||

sarvatRuShNAnAmupadravAnAha- mukhashoShetyAdi| udbhUteti vRuddhA| ye tu mukhashoShAdIni lakShaNAnyAhustanmate tRuShNopadravAnAmabhidhAnaM na syAt, upadravAshcAdhyAyasa~ggrahe sa~ggRuhItAH; tenAtishayavRuddhA mukhashoShAdaya upadravAH, vRuddhAstu li~ggamiti vyavasthA||9-10||

pittamityAdinA pittajAmAha| sharIrasa~gkhyAshArIre pittamApyamuktaM “yaddravasarasnigdhamandamRudupicchilaM rasarudhiravasAkaphapittamUtrasvedAdi tadApyaM raso rasanaM ca” (shA.a.7) ityanena, tathA tatraiva “yat pittamUShmA yo, yA ca sharIre bhAH, tat sarvamAgneyam” ityanena dvayAtmakatvaM pittasya yadyapyuktaM, tathA~apyAgneyAkAratvAd bAhulyAt pittamAgneyameveti darshayannAha- pittaM matamAgneyamiti; dvayAtmakatve~api ca pittasyAgneyAMshaprAdhAnyAdanyatrApi saumyAgneyavAyavyavikArabhede paittikavikArA Agneyatvena gRuhItA eva | santaptaH sa hIti abdhAtuH santaptaH| ‘santaptaM hi’ iti pAThapakShe pittameva janayediti yojyam| yadA~abdhAturjanayati tadA pittasantapta eva janayatIti pittasyaiva kartRutvam||13-14||
athAto viShacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
prAgutpattiM guNAn yoniM vegA@mlli~ggAnyupakramAn| viShasya bruvataH samyagagnivesha nibodha me||3||
nidrAM tandrAM klamaM dAhaM sapAkaM lomaharShaNam| shophaM caivAtisAraM ca janayejja~ggamaM viSham||15||
sthAvaraM tu jvaraM hikkAM dantaharShaM galagraham| phenavamyarucishvAsamUrcchAshca janayedviSham ||16||
ja~ggamaM syAdadhobhAgamUrdhvabhAgaM tu mUlajam| tasmAddaMShTrAviShaM maulaM hanti maulaM ca daMShTrajam ||17||
muhurmuhuH shironyAsaH shothaH srastauShThakarNAtA | jvaraH stabdhAkShigAtratvaM hanukampo~a~ggamardanam||229||
romApagamanaM glAniraratirvepathurbhramaH| catuShpadAM bhavatyetaddaShTAnAmiha lakShaNam||230||
devadAru haridre dve saralaM candanAguru| rAsnA gorocanA~ajAjI guggulvikShuraso natam||231||
cUrNaM sasaindhavAnantaM gopittamadhusaMyutam| catuShpadAnAM daShTAnAmagadaH sArvakArmikaH||232||
saubhAgyArthaM striyaH svedarajonAnA~ggajAnmalAn| shatruprayuktAMshca garAn prayacchantyannamishritAn||233||
taiH syAt pANDuH kRusho~alpAgnirgarashcAsyopajAyate| marmapradhamanAdhmAnaM shvayathuM hastapAdayoH||234||
jaTharaM grahaNIdoSho yakShmA gulmaH kShayo jvaraH | evaMvidhasya cAnyasya vyAdherli~ggAni darshayet||235||
svapne mArjAragomAyuvyAlAn sanakulAn kapIn| prAyaH pashyati nadyAdI~jchuShkAMshca savanaspatIn||236||
kAlashca gauramAtmAnaM svapne gaurashca kAlakam| vikarNanAsikaM vA~api prapashyedvihatendriyaH ||237||
tamavekShya bhiShak prAj~jAH pRucchet kiM kaiH kadA saha| jagdhamityavagamyAshu pradadyAdvamanaM bhiShak||238||
sUkShmaM tAmrarajastasmai sakShaudraM hRudvishodhanam| shuddhe hRudi tataH shANaM hemacUrNasya dApayet||239||
hema sarvaviShANyAshu garAMshca viniyacchati| na sajjate hemapA~gge viShaM padmadale~ambuvat||240||
nAgadantItrivRuddantIdravantIsnukpayaHphalaiH| sAdhitaM mAhiShaM sarpiH sagomUtrADhakaM hitam||241||
shirIShatvak trikaTukaM triphalAM candanotpale||242||
dve bale sArivAsphotAsurabhInimbapATalAH| bandhujIvADhakImUrvAvAsAsurasavatsakAn||243||
pAThA~gkolAshvagandhArkamUlayaShTyAhvapadmakAn| vishAlAM bRuhatIM lAkShAM kovidAraM shatAvarIm||244||
kaTabhIdantyapAmArgAn pRushniparNIM rasA~jjanam| shvetabhaNDAshvakhurakau kuShThadArupriya~ggukAn||245||
vidArIM madhukAt sAraM kara~jjasya phalatvacau| rajanyau lodhramakShAMshaM piShTvA sAdhyaM ghRutADhakam||246||
tulyAmbucchAgagomUtratryADhake tadviShApaham| apasmArakShayonmAdabhUtagrahagarodaram||247||
pANDurogakrimIgulmaplIhorustambhakAmalAH| hanuskandhagrahAdIMshca pAnAbhya~jjananAvanaiH||248||
hanyAt sa~jjIvayeccApi vibodbandhamRutAnnarAn| nAmnedamamRutaM sarvaviShANAM syAddhRutottamam||249||
ityamRutaghRutam
ityamRutaghRutam bhavanti cAtra- chatrI jharjharapANishca caredrAtrau tathA divA| tacchAyAshabdavitrastAH praNashyantyAshu pannagAH||250||
daShTamAtro dashedAshu taM sarpaM loShTameva vA| uparyariShTAM badhnIyAddaMshaM chindyAddahettathA||251||
vajraM marakataH sAraH picuko viShamUShikA| karketanaH sarpamaNirvaidUryaM gajamauktikam||252||
dhAryaM garamaNiryAshca varauShadhyo viShApahAH| khagAshca shArikAkrau~jcashikhihaMsashukAdayaH||253||

tatra shlokaH- itIdamuktaM dvividhasya vistarairbahuprakAraM viSharogabheShajam| adhItya vij~jAya tathA prayojayan vrajedviShANAmaviShahyatAM budhaH||254||

Commentary: itIdamityAdisa~ggrahaH| vrajedviShANAmaviShahyatAmiti viShANi taM soDhuM na pArayantIti bhAvaH||254||
tRuNmohadantaharShaprasekavamathaklamA bhavantyAdye| vege rasapradoShAdasRukpradoShAddvitIye tu||18||
vaivarNyabhramavepathumUrcchAjRumbhA~ggacimicimAtamakAH | duShTapishitAttRutIye maNDalakaNDUshvayathukoThAH||19||
vAtAdijAshcaturthe dAhacchardya~ggashUlamUrcchAdyAH| nIlAdInAM tamasashca darshanaM pa~jcame vege||20||
ShaShThe hikkA, bha~ggaH skandhasya tu saptame~aShTame maraNam| nRUNAM, catuShpadAM syAccaturvidhaH, pakShiNAM trividhaH||21||
sIdatyAdye bhramati ca, catuShpado vepate, tataH shUnyaH | mandAhAro mriyate shvAsena hi caturthavege tu||22||
dhyAyati vihagaH prathame vege, prabhrAmyati dvitIye tu| srastA~ggashca tRutIye viShavege yAti pa~jcatvam||23||
laghu rUkShamAshu vishadaM vyavAyi tIkShNaM vikAsi sUkShmaM ca| uShNamanirdeshyarasaM dashaguNamuktaM viShaM tajj~jaiH||24||
raukShyAdvAtamashaityAtpittaM saukShmyAdasRuk prakopayati| kaphamavyaktarasatvAdannarasAMshcAnuvartate shIghram||25||
shIghraM vyavAyibhAvAdAshu vyApnoti kevalaM deham| tIkShNatvAnmarmaghnaM prANaghnaM tadvikAsitvAt||26||
durupakramaM laghutvAdvaishadyAt syAdasaktagatidoSham| doShasthAnaprakRutIH prApyAnyatamaM hyudIrayati||27||
syAdvAtikasya vAtasthAne kaphapittali~ggamIShattu| tRuNmohAratimUrcchAgalagrahacchardiphenAdi ||28||
pittAshayasthitaM paittikasya kaphavAtayorviShaM tadvat| tRuTkAsajvaravamathuklamadAhatamotisArAdi ||29||
kaphadeshagaM kaphasya ca darshayedvAtapittayoshceShat| li~ggaM shvAsagalagrahakaNDUlAlAvamathvAdi||30||

dUShIviShaM tu shoNitaduShTyAruHkiTimakoThali~ggaM ca| viShamekaikaM doShaM sandUShya haratyasUnevam||31||

Commentary: dUShIviShalakShaNamAha- dUShItyAdi| koThaH varaTIdaMshashothAkAraH| kAlAntaraprakopi viShaM dUShIviSham| uktaM cAnyatra “dUShitaM deshakAlAdidivAsvapnairabhIkShNashaH| yasmAddUShayate dhAtUn tasmAddUShIviShaM smRutam” iti| evambhUtaM ca garameva prAyo bhavati, tathA sthAvaraM ja~ggamaM ca bhavati| yaduktaM sushrute- “jIrNaM viShaghnauShadhibhirhataM vA dAvAgnivAtAtapashoShitaM vA| svabhAvato vA guNaviprahInaM viShaM hi dUShIviShatAmupaiti” (su.ka.a.2) iti| ihApi dUShIviShAH kITA hInavIryaviShA vaktavyAH| viShamekaikamityAdinA syAdvAtikasyetyAdinA yaduktaM tasyaikaikadoShasyAtyarthakopamAha| sandUShyeti atyarthaM dUShayitvA||31||

kSharati viShatejasA~asRuk tat khAni nirudhya mArayati jantum| pItaM mRutasya hRudi tiShThati daShTaviddhayordaMshadeshe syAt||32||

Commentary: anuktaprANaharaNasAmagrImAha- kSharatItyAdinA| pItaM viShaM visheSheNa mRutasya hRudi tiShThati| daShTaviddhayoshca daMshadeshe viShaM syAt| viddhaH digdhaviddhaH| atra kashcinmRuta iva bhavati, kashcicca pavanAdamRuta iva| yaduktaM kAshyape- “mRuta iva cenmartyaH syAdasAdhyali~ggairvihInashca| sa jIvayituM shakyaH kRutA caitasya hRudayarakShA cet” iti||32||
nIlauShThadantashaithilyakeshapatanA~ggabha~ggavikShepAH| shishirairna lomaharSho nAbhihate daNDarAjI syAt||33||
kShatajaM kShatAcca nAyAtyetAni bhavanti maraNali~ggAni| ebhyo~anyathA cikitsyAsteShAM copakramA~jchRuNu me||34||
mantrAriShTotkartananiShpIDanacUShaNAgnipariShekAH| avagAharaktamokShaNavamanavirekopadhAnAni||35||
hRudayAvaraNA~jjananasyadhUmalehauShadhaprashamanAni | pratisAraNaM prativiShaM sa~jj~jAsaMsthAnapanaM lepaH||36||
mRutasa~jjIvanameva ca viMshatirete caturbhiradhikAH| syurupakramA yathA ye yatra yojyAH shRuNu tathA tAn||37||

daMshAttu viShaM daShTasyAvisRutaM veNikAM bhiShagbaddhvA| niShpIDayedbhRushaM daMshamuddharenmarmavarjaM vA||38||

Commentary: avisRutamiti avyAptasharIram| veNikAM baddhveti viShavA(dhA)raNikAM baddhvA| anena ca sAmAnyAbhidhAnena mantravyApAro~apyariShTAnAM kathitaH, mantrAdbhinnA cAriShToktA| uktaM cAnyatra- “ariShTAmapi mantraishca badhnIyAnmantrakovidaH| sA tu rajjvAdibhirbaddhA viShapratikarI matA” (su.ka.a.5) iti| niShpIDayediti niShpIDanena viShaM gAlayet| uddharediti utkRutyApaharet| marmavarjyamiti marmaNyupaghAtaM niShedhayatyavraNe| yavacUrNena pAMshunA vA mukhapUraNaM viShasambandhaparihArArtham||38||-
pracchanashRu~ggajalaukAvyadhanaiH srAvyaM tato raktam||39||
rakte viShapraduShTe duShyet prakRutistatastyajet prANAn| tasmAt pragharShaNairasRugavartamAnaM pravartyaM syAt||40||
trikaTugRuhadhUmarajanIpa~jcalavaNarocanAH savArtAkAH| gharShaNamatipravRutte vaTAdibhiH shItalairlepaH||41||
raktaM hi viShAdhAnaM vAyurivAgneH pradehasekaistat| shItaiH skandati tasmin skanne vyapayAti viShavegaH||42||
viShavegAnmadamUrcchAviShAdahRudayadravAH pravartante| shItairnivartayettAn vIjyashcAlomaharShAt syAt||43||
taruriva mUlacchedAddaMshacchedAnna vRuddhimeti viSham| AcUShaNamAnayanaM jalasya seturyathA tathA~ariShTAH||44||
tva~gmAMsagataM dAho dahati viShaM srAvaNaM harati raktAt| pItaM vamanaiH sadyo haredvirekairdvitIye tu||45||
Adau hRudayaM rakShyaM tasyAvaraNaM pibedyathAlAbham| madhusarpirmajjapayogairikamatha gomayarasaM vA||46||
ikShuM supakvamathavA kAkaM niShpIDya tadrasaM varaNam| chAgAdInAM vA~asRugbhasma mRudaM vA pibedAshu||47||
kShArAgadastRutIye shophaharairlekhanaM samadhvambu| gomayarasashcaturthe vege sakapitthamadhusarpiH||48||
kAkANDashirIShAbhyAM svarasenAshcyotanA~jjane nasyam| syAtpa~jcame~atha ShaShThe sa~jj~jAyAH sthApanaM kAryam||49||
gopittayutA rajanI ma~jjiShThAmaricapippalIpAnam| viShapAnaM daShTAnAM viShapIte daMshanaM cAnte||50||
shikhipittArdhayutaM syAt palAshabIjamagado mRuteShu varaH| vArtAkuphANitAgAradhUmagopittanimbaM vA||51||
gopittayutairguTikAH surasAgranthidvirajanImadhukakuShThaiH | shastA~amRutena tulyA shirIShapuShpakAkANDakarasairvA||52||
kAkANDasurasagavAkShIpunarnavAvAyasIshirIShaphalaiH| udbandhaviShajalamRute lepaupadhinasyapAnAni ||53||
spRukkAplavasthauNeyakA~gkShIshaileyarocanAtagaram| dhyAmakaku~gkumamAMsIsurasAgrailAlakuShThaghnam||54||
bRuhatI shirIShapuShpaM shrIveShTakapadmacAraTivishAlAH| suradArupadmakesharasAvarakamanaHshilAkauntyaH||55||
jAtyarkapuShparasarajanIdvayahi~ggupippalIlAkShAH| jalamudgaparNicandanamadhukamadanasindhuvArAshca||56||
shampAkalodhramayUrakagandhaphalAnAkulIviDa~ggAshca| puShye saMhRutya samaM piShTvA guTikA vidheyAH syuH||57||
sarvaviShaghno jayakRudviShamRutasa~jjIvano jvaranihantA| ghreyavilepanadhAraNadhUmagrahaNairgRuhasthashca||58||
bhUtaviShajantvalakShmIkArmaNamantrAgnyashanyarIn hanyAt| duHsvapnastrIdoShAnakAlamaraNAmbucaurabhayam||59||
dhanadhAnyakAryasiddhiH shrIpuShTyAyurvivardhano dhanyaH| mRutasa~jjIvana eSha prAgamRutAdbrahmaNA vihitaH||60||
mantrairdhamanIbandho~avamArjanaM kAryamAtmarakShA ca| doShasya viShaM yasya sthAne syAttaM jayetpUrvam||61||
vAtasthAne svedo dadhnA natakuShThakalkapAnaM ca| ghRutamadhupayo~ambupAnAvagAhasekAshca pittasthe||62||
kShArAgadaH kaphasthAnagate svedastathA sirAvyadhanam| dUShIviShe~atha raktasthite sirAkarma pa~jcavidham||63||
bheShajamevaM kalpyaM bhiShagvidA~a~alakShya sarvadA sarvam| sthAnaM jayeddhi pUrvaM sthAnasthasyAviruddhaM ca||64||
viShadUShitakaphamArgaH srotaHsaMrodharuddhavAyustu| mRuta iva shvasenmartyaH syAdasAdhyali~ggairvihInashca||65||
carmakaShAyAH kalkaM bilvasamaM mUrdhni kAkapadamasya| kRutvA dadyAtkaTabhIkaTukaTphalapradhamanaM ca||66||
chAgaM gavyaM mAhiShaM vA mAMsaM kaukkuTameva vA| dadyAt kAkapade tasmiMstataH sa~gkramate viSham||67||
nAsAkShikarNajihvAkaNThanirodheShu karma nastaH syAt| vArtAkubIjapUrajyotiShmatyAdibhiH piShTaiH||68||
a~jjanamakShyuparodhe kartavyaM bastamUtrapiShTaistu| dAruvyoShaharidrAkaravIrakara~jjanimbasurasaistu||69||
shvetA vacA~ashvagandhA hi~ggvamRutA kuShThasaindhave lashunam| sarShapakapitthamadhyaM TuNTukakara~jjabIjAni ||70||
vyoShaM shirIShapuShpaM dvirajanyau vaMshalocanaM ca samam| piShTvA~ajasya mUtreNa goshvapittena saptAham||71||
vyatyAsabhAvito~ayaM nihanti shirasi sthitaM viShaM kShipram| sarvajvarabhUtagrahavisUcikAjIrNamUrcchArtIH||72||
unmAdApasmArau kAcapaTalanIlikAshirodoShAn| shuShkAkShipAkapillArbudArmakaNDUtamodoShAn||73||
kShayadaurbalyamadAtyayapANDugadAMshcA~jjanAttathA mohAn| lepAdviShadigdhakShatalIDhadaShTapItaviShaghAtI||74||
arshaHsvAnaddheShu ca gudalepo yonilepanaM strINAm| mUDhe garbhe duShTe lalATalepaH pratishyAye||75||
vRuddhau kiTime kuShThe shvitravicarcikAdiShu lepaH| gaja iva tarUn viShagadAnnihantyagadagandhahastyeShaH||76||
patrAgurumustailA niryAsAH pa~jca candanaM spRukkA| tva~gnaladotpalabAlakahareNukoshIravanyanakhAH||77||
suradArukanakaku~gkumadhyAmakakuShThapriya~ggavastagaram| pa~jcA~ggAni shirIShAdvyoShAlamanaHshilAjAjyaH||78||
shvetakaTabhIkara~jjau rakShoghnI sindhuvArikA rajanI| surasA~jjanagairikama~jjiShThAnimbaniryAsAH||79||
vaMshatvagashvagandhAhi~ggudadhitthAmlavetasaM lAkShA| madhumadhukasomarAjIvacAruhArocanAtagaram||80||
agado~ayaM vaishravaNAyAkhyAtastryambakeNa ShaShTya~ggaH| apratihataprabhAvaH khyAto mahAgandhahastIti||81||
pittena gavAM peShyo guTikAH kAryAstu puShyayogena| pAnA~jjanapralepaiH prasAdhayet sarvakarmANi||82||
pillaM kaNDUM timiraM rAtryAndhyaM kAcamarbudaM paTalam| hanti satataprayogAddhitamitapathyAshinAM puMsAm||83||
viShamajvarAnajIrNAndadruM kaNDUM visUcikAM pAmAm| viShamUShikalUtAnAM sarveShAM pannagAnAM ca| Ashu viShaM nAshayati samUlajamatha kandajaM sarvam||84||
etena liptagAtraH sarpAn gRuhNAti bhakShayecca viSham| kAlaparIto~api naro jIvati nityaM nirAta~gkaH||85||
Anaddhe gudalepo yonau lepashca mUDhagarbhANAm| mUrcchArtiShu ca lalATe pralepanamAhuH pradhAnatamam||86||
bherImRuda~ggapaTahA~jchatrANyamunA tathA dhvajapatAkAH| liptvA~ahiviShanirastyai pradhvanayeddarshayenmatimAn||87||
yatra ca sannihito~ayaM na tatra bAlagrahA na rakShAMsi| na ca kArmaNavetAlA vahanti nAtharvaNA mantrAH||88||
sarvagrahA na tatra prabhavanti na cAgnishastranRupacaurAH| lakShmIshca tatra bhajate yatra mahAgandhahastyasti||89||
piShyamANa imaM cAtra siddhaM mantramudIrayet| ‘mama mAtA jayA nAma jayo nAmeti me pitA||90||
so~ahaM jayajayAputro vijayo~atha jayAmi ca| namaH puruShasiMhAya viShNave vishvakarmaNe||91||
sanAtanAya kRuShNAya bhavAya vibhavAya ca| tejo vRuShAkapeH sAkShAttejo brahmendrayoryame||92||
yathA~ahaM nAbhijAnAmi vAsudevaparAjayam| mAtushca pANigrahaNaM samudrasya ca shoShaNam||93||
anena satyavAkyena sidhyatAmagado hyayam| hilimilisaMspRuShTe rakSha sarvabheShajottame svAhA ||94||
iti mahAgandhahastInAmA~agadaHRuShabhakajIvakabhArgImadhukotpaladhAnyakesharAjAjyaH| sasitagirikolamadhyAH peyAH shvAsajvarAdiharAH||95||
hi~ggu ca kRuShNAyuktaM kapittharasayuktamagryalavaNaM ca| samadhusitau pAtavyau jvarahikkAshvAsakAsaghnau||96||
lehaH kolAsthya~jjanalAjotpalamadhughRutairvamyAm| bRuhatIdvayADhakIpatradhUmavartistu hikkAghnI||97||
shikhibarhibalAkAsthIni sarShapAshcandanaM ca ghRutayuktam| dhUmo gRuhashayanAsanavastrAdiShu shasyate viShanut||98||
ghRutayukte natakuShThe bhujagapatishiraH shirIShapuShpaM ca| dhUmAgadaH smRuto~ayaM sarvaviShaghnaH shvayathuhRucca||99||
jatusevyapatraguggulubhallAtakakakubhapuShpasarjarasAH| shvetA ca dhUma uragAkhukITavastrakriminudagryaH||100||
taruNapalAshakShAraM srutaM paceccUrNitaiH saha samAMshaiH| lohitamRudrajanIdvayashuklasurasama~jjarImadhukaiH||101||
lAkShAsaindhavamAMsIhareNuhi~ggudvisArivAkuShThaiH| savyoShairbAhlIkairdarvIvilepanaM ghaTTayedyAvat||102||
sarvaviShashothagulmatvagdoShArshobhagandaraplIhnaH| shothApasmArakrimibhUtasvarabhedapANDugadAn||103||
mandAgnitvaM kAsaM sonmAdaM nAshayeyuratha puMsAm| guTikAshchAyAshuShkAH kolasamAstAH samupayuktAH||104||
viShapItadaShTaviddheShvetaddigdhe ca vAcyamuddiShTam| sAmAnyataH, pRuthaktvAnnirdeshamataH shRuNu yathAvat||105||
ripuyuktebhyo nRubhyaH svebhyaH strIbhyo~athavA bhayaM nRupateH| AhAravihAragataM tasmAt preShyAn parIkSheta||106||
atyarthasha~gkitaH syAdbahuvAgathavA~alpavAgvigatalakShmIH| prAptaH prakRutivikAraM viShapradAtA naro j~jeyaH||107||
dRuShTvaivaM na tu sahasA bhojyaM kuryAttadannamagnau tu| saviShaM hi prApyAnnaM bahUnvikArAn bhajatyagniH||108||
shikhibarhavicitrArcistIkShNAkShamarUkShakuNapadhUmashca | sphuTati ca sashabdamekAvarto vihatArcirapi ca syAt||109||
pAtrasthaM ca vivarNaM bhojyaM syAnmakShikAMshca mArayati| kShAmasvarAMshca kAkAn kuryAdvirajeccakorAkShi||110||
pAne nIlA rAjI vaivarNyaM svAM ca nekShate chAyAm| pashyati vikRutAmathavA lavaNAkte phenamAlA syAt||111||
pAnAnnayoHsaviShayorgandhena shirorugghRudi ca mUrcchA ca| sparshena pANishothaH suptya~ggulidAhatodanakhabhedAH||112||
mukhage tvoShThacimicimA jihvA shUnA jaDA vivarNA ca| dvijaharShahanustambhAsyadAhalAlAgalavikArAH||113||
AmAshayaM praviShTe vaivarNyaM svedasadanamutkledaH| dRuShTihRudayoparodho bindushataishcIyate cA~ggam||114||
pakvAshayaM tu yAte mUrcchAmadamohadAhabalanAshAH| tandrA kArshyaM ca viShe pANDutvaM codarasthe syAt||115||
dantapavanasya kUrco vishIryate dantauShThamAMsashophashca| keshacyutiH shiroruggranthayashca saviShe~atha shirobhya~gge||116||
duShTe~a~jjane~akShidAhasrAvAtyupadehashotharAgAshca| khAdyairAdau koShThaH spRushyaistvagdUShyate duShTaiH||117||
snAnAbhya~ggotsAdanavastrAla~gkAravarNakairduShTaiH| kaNDvartikoThapiDakAromodgamacimicimA shothAH||118||
ete karacaraNadAhatodaklamAvipAkAshca| bhUpAdukAshvagajavarmaketushayanAsanairduShTaiH||119||
mAlyamagandhaM mlAyati shirorujAlomaharShakaram | stambhayati khAni nAsAmupahanti darshanaM ca dhUmaH||120||
kUpataDAgAdijalaM durgandhaM sakaluShaM vivarNaM ca| pItaM shvayathuM koThAn piDakAshca karoti maraNaM ca||121||
AdAvAmAshayage vamanaM tvaksthe pradehasekAdi| kuryAdbhiShak cikitsAM doShabalaM caiva hi samIkShya||122||
... shRuNu ja~ggamasyAtaH| savisheShacikitsitamevAdau tatrocyate tu sarpANAm||123||
iha darvIkaraH sarpo maNDalI rAjimAniti| trayo yathAkramaM vAtapittashleShmaprakopaNAH||124||
darvIkaraH phaNI j~jeyo maNDalI maNDalAphaNaH| bindulekhavicitrA~ggaH pannagaH syAttu rAjimAn||125||
visheShAdrUkShakaTukamamloShNaM svAdu shItalam| viShaM yathAkramaM teShAM tasmAdvAtAdikopanam||126||
darvIkarakRuto daMshaH sUkShmadaMShTrApado~asitaH| niruddharaktaH kUrmAbho vAtavyAdhikaro mataH||127||
pRuthvarpitaH sashothashca daMsho maNDalinA kRutaH| pItAbhaH pItaraktashca sarvapittavikArakRut||128||
kRuto rAjimatA daMshaH picchilaH sthirashophakRut| snigdhaH pANDushca sAndrAsRuk shleShmavyAdhisamIraNaH||129||
vRuttabhogo mahAkAyaH shvasannUrdhvekShaNaH pumAn| sthUlamUrdhA samA~ggashca strI tvataH syAdviparyayAt||130||
klIbastrasatyadhodRuShTiH svarahInaH prakampate| striyA daShTo viparyastairetaiH puMsA naro mataH||131||
vyAmishrali~ggairetaistu klIbadaShTaM naraM vadet| ityetaduktaM sarpANAM strIpu~gklIbanidarshanam||132||
pANDuvaktrastu garbhiNyA shUnauShTho~apyasitekShaNaH| jRumbhAkrodhopajihvArtaH sUtayA raktamUtravAn||133||
sarpo gaudhera(ya)ko nAma godhAyAM syAccatuShpadaH| kRuShNasarpeNa tulyaH syAnnAnA syurmishrajAtayaH||134||
gUDhasampAditaM vRuttaM pIDitaM lambitArpitam| sarpitaM ca bhRushAbAdhaM, daMshA ye~anye na te bhRushAH||135||

taruNAH kRuShNasarpAstu gonasAH sthavirAstathA| rAjimanto vayomadhye bhavantyAshIviShopamAH||136||

Commentary: vayobhedena darvIkarAdInAM tIvratAmAha- taruNA ityAdi| sarpitaM yadanatimagnadaMShTrApadam| AshIviShopamA iti AshIviShA dRuShTiniHshvAsaviShAH||136||
sarpadaMShTrAshcatasrastu tAsAM vAmAdharA sitA| pItA vAmottarA daMShTrA raktashyAvA~adharottarA ||137||
yanmAtraH patate bindurgobAlAt saliloddhRutAt| vAmAdharAyAM daMShTrAyAM tanmAtraM syAdaherviSham||138||
ekadvitricaturvRuddhaviShabhAgottarottarAH| savarNAstatkRutA daMshA bahUttaraviShA bhRushAH||139||
sarpANAmeva viNmUtrAt kITAH syuH kITasammatAH| dUShIviShAH prANaharA iti sa~gkShepato matAH||140||
gAtraM raktaM sitaM kRuShNaM shyAvaM vA piDakAnvitam| sakaNDUdAhavIsarpapAki syAt kuthitaM tathA||141||
kITairdUShIviShairdaShTaM li~ggaM prANaharaM shRuNu| sarpadaShTe yathA shotho vardhate sogragandhyasRuk||142||
daMsho~akShigauravaM mUrcchA sa rugArtaH shvasityapi| tRuShNAruciparItashca bhaveddUShIviShArditaH||143||
daMshasya madhye yat kRuShNaM shyAvaM vA jAlakAvRutam| dagdhAkRuti bhRushaM pAki kledashothajvarAnvitam||144||
dUShIviShAbhirlUtAbhistaM daShTamiti nirdishet| sarvAsAmeva tAsAM ca daMshe lakShaNamucyate||145||
