shophaH shvetAsitA raktAH pItA vA piDakA jvaraH| prANAntiko bhavecchvAso dAhahikkAshirograhAH||146||
AdaMshAcchoNitaM pANDu maNDalAni jvaro~aruciH| lomaharShashca dAhashcApyAkhudUShIviShArdite||147||
mUrcchA~ggashothavaivarNyakledashabdAshrutijvarAH| shirogurutvaM lAlAsRukchardishcAsAdhyamUShikaiH||148||
shyAvatvamatha kArShNyaM vA nAnAvarNatvameva vA| mohaH purIShabhedashca daShTe syAt kRukalAsakaiH||149||
dahatyagnirivAdau tu bhinattIvordhvamAshu ca| vRushcikasya viShaM yAti daMshe pashcAttu tiShThati||150||
daShTo~asAdhyastu dRugghrANarasanopahato naraH| mAMsaiH patadbhiratyarthaM vedanArto jahAtyasUn||151||
visarpaH shvayathuH shUlaM jvarashchardirathApi ca| lakShaNaM kaNabhairdaShTe daMshashcaiva vishIryate||152||
hRuShTaromocciTi~ggena stabdhali~ggo bhRushArtimAn| daShTaH shItodakeneva siktAnya~ggAni manyate||153||
ekadaMShTrArditaH shUnaH saruk syAt pItakaH satRuT| chardirnidrA ca maNDUkaiH saviShairdaShTalakShaNam||154||
matsyAstu saviShAH kuryurdAhashopharujastathA| kaNDUM shothaM jvaraM mUrcchAM saviShAstu jalaukasaH||155||
dAhatodasvedashothakarI tu gRuhagodhikA | daMshe svedaM rujaM dAhaM kuryAcchatapadIviSham||156||
kaNDUmAnmashakairIShacchothaH syAnmandavedanaH| asAdhyakITasadRushamasAdhyamashakakShatam||157||
sadyaHprasrAviNI shyAvA dAhamUrcchAjvarAnvitA| pIDakA makShikAdaMshe tAsAM tu sthagikA~asuhRut||158||
shmashAnacaityavalmIkayaj~jAshramasurAlaye| pakShasandhiShu madhyAhne sArdharAtre~aShTamIShu ca||159||
na siddhyanti narA daShTAH pAShaNDAyataneShu ca| dRuShTishvAsamalasparshaviShairAshIviShaistathA||160||
(yena kenApi sarpeNa sambhavaH sarva eva ca)||161||
bhItamattAbaloShNakShuttRuShArte vardhate viSham| viShaM prakRutikAlau ca tulyau prApyAlpamanyathA ||162||
vAriviprahatAH kShINA bhItA nakulanirjitAH| vRuddhA bAlAstvaco muktAH sarpA mandaviShAH smRutAH||163||
sarvadehAshritaM krodhAdviShaM sarpo vimu~jcati| tadevAhArahetorvA bhayAdvA na pramu~jcati||164||
vAtolbaNaviShAH prAya ucciTi~ggAH savRushcikAH| vAtapittolbaNAH kITAH shlaiShmikAH kaNabhAdayaH||165||
yasya yasya hi doShasya li~ggAdhikyAni lakShayet| tasya tasyauShadhaiH kuryAdviparItaguNaiH kriyAm||166||
hRutpIDordhvAnilaH stambhaH sirAyAmo~asthiparvaruk| ghUrNanodveShTanaM gAtrashyAvatA vAtike viShe||167||
sa~jj~jAnAshoShNanishvAsau hRuddAhaH kaTukAsyatA| daMshAvadaraNaM shotho raktapItashca paittike||168||
vamyarocakahRullAsaprasekotkleshagauravaiH| sashaityamukhamAdhuryairvidyAcchleShmAdhikaM viSham||169||
khaNDena ca vraNAlepastailAbhya~ggashca vAtike| svedo nADIpulAkAdyairbRuMhaNashca vidhirhitaH||170||
sushItaiH stambhayet sekaiH pradehaishcApi paittikam| lekhanacchedanasvedavamanaiH shlaiShmikaM jayet||171||
viSheShvapi ca sarveShu sarvasthAnagateShu ca| avRushcikocciTi~ggeShu prAyaH shIto vidhirhitaH||172||
vRushcike svedamabhya~ggaM ghRutena lavaNena ca| sekAMshcoShNAn prayu~jjIta bhojyaM pAnaM ca sarpiShaH||173||
etadevocciTi~gge~api pratilomaM ca pAMshubhiH| udvartanaM sukhAmbUShNaistathA~avacchAdanaM ghanaiH||174||
shvA tridoShaprakopAttu tathA dhAtuviparyayAt| shiro~abhitApI lAlAsrAvyadhovaktrastathA bhavet||175||
anye~apyevaMvidhA vyAlAH kaphavAtaprakopaNAH| hRucchirorugjvarastambhatRuShAmUrcchAkarA matAH||176||
kaNDUnistodavaivarNyasuptikledopashoShaNam| vidAharAgarukpAkAH shopho granthiniku~jcanam||177||
daMshAvadaraNaM sphoTAH karNikA maNDalAni ca| jvarashca saviShe li~ggaM viparItaM tu nirviShe||178||
tatra sarve yathAvasthaM prayojyAH syurupakramAH| pUrvoktA vidhimanyaM ca yathAvadbruvataH shRuNu||179||
hRudvidAhe praseke vA virekavamanaM bhRusham| yathAvasthaM prayoktavyaM shuddhe saMsarjanakramaH||180||
shirogate viShe nastaH kuryAnmUlAni buddhimAn| bandhujIvasya bhArgyAshca surasasyAsitasya ca||181||
dakShakAkamayUrANAM mAMsAsRu~gmastake kShate| upadheyamadhodaShTasyordhvadaShTasya pAdayoH||182||
pippalImaricakShAravacAsaindhavashigrukAH| piShTA rohitapittena ghnantyakShigatama~jjanAt||183||
kapitthamAmaM sasitAkShaudraM kaNThagate viShe| lihyAdAmAshayagate tAbhyAM cUrNapalaM natAt||184||
viShe pakvAshayagate pippalIM rajanIdvayam| ma~jjiShThAM ca samaM piShTvA gopittena naraH pibet||185||
raktaM mAMsaM ca godhAyAH shuShkaM cUrNIkRutaM hitam| viShe rasagate pAnaM kapittharasasaMyutam||186||
shelormUlatvagagrANi bAdaraudumbarANi ca| kaTabhyAshca pibedraktagate, mAMsagate pibet||187||
sakShaudraM khadirAriShTaM kauTajaM mUlamambhasA| sarveShu ca bale dve tu madhUkaM madhukaM natam||188||
pippalIM nAgaraM kShAraM navanItena mUrcchitam| kaphe bhiShagudIrNe tu vidadhyAtpratisAraNam||189||
mAMsIku~gkumapatratvagrajanInatacandanaiH| manaHshilAvyAghranakhasurasairambupeShitaiH||190||
pAnanasyA~jjanAlepAH sarvashothaviShApahAH| candanaM tagaraM kuShThaM haridre dve tvageva ca||191||
manaHshilA tamAlashca rasaH kaishara eva ca| shArdUlasya nakhashcaiva supiShTaM taNDulAmbunA||192||
hanti sarvaviShANyeva vajrivajramivAsurAn| rase shirIShapuShpasya saptAhaM maricaM sitam||193||
bhAvitaM sarpadaShTAnAM nasyapAnA~jjane hitam| dvipalaM natakuShThAbhyAM ghRutakShaudracatuShpalam||194||
api takShakadaShTAnAM pAnametat sukhapradam| sindhuvArasya mUlaM ca shvetA ca girikarNikA||195||
pAnaM darvIkarairdaShTe nasyaM samadhu pAkalam| ma~jjiShThA madhuyaShTI ca jIvakarShabhakau sitA||196||
kAshmaryaM vaTashu~ggAni pAnaM maNDalinAM viShe| vyoShaM sAtiviShaM kuShThaM gRuhadhUmo hareNukA||197||
tagaraM kaTukA kShaudraM hanti rAjImatAM viSham| gRuhadhUmaM haridre dve samUlaM taNDulIyakam||198||
kShIrivRukShatvagAlepaH shuddhe kITaviShApahaH||199||
muktAlepo varaH shothadAhatodajvarApahaH| candanaM padmakoshIraM shirIShaH sindhuvArikA||200||
kShIrashuklA nataM kuShThaM pATalodIcyasArivAH| shelusvarasapiShTo~ayaM lUtAnAM sArvakArmikaH||201||
(yathAyogaM prayoktavyaH samIkShyAlepanAdiShu)| madhUkaM madhukaM kuShThaM shirIShodIcyapATalAH| sanimbasArivAkShaudrAH pAnaM lUtAviShApaham||202||
kusumbhapuShpaM godantaH svarNakShIrI kapotaviT| dantI trivRutsaindhavaM ca karNikApAtanaM tayoH||203||
kaTabhyarjunashairIShashelukShIridrumatvacaH| kaShAyakalkacUrNAH syuH kITalUtAvraNApahAH||204||
tvacaM ca nAgaraM caiva samAMshaM shlakShNapeShitam| peyamuShNAmbunA sarvaM mUShikANAM viShApaham||205||
kuTajasya phalaM piShTaM tagaraM jAlamAlinI| tiktekShvAkushca yogo~ayaM pAnapradhamanAdibhiH||206||
vRushcikondurulUtAnAM sarpANAM ca viShaM haret| samAno hyamRutenAyaM garAjIrNaM ca nAshayet||207||
sarve~agadA yathAdoShaM prayojyAH syuH kRukaNTake| kapotaviNmAtulu~ggaM shirIShakusumAdrasaH||208||
sha~gkhinyArkaM payaH shuNThI kara~jjo madhu vArshcike| shirIShasya phalaM piShTaM snuhIkShIreNa dArdure||209||
mUlAni shvetabhaNDInAM vyoShaM sarpishca matsyaje| kITadaShTakriyAH sarvAH samAnAH syurjalaukasAm||210||
vAtapittaharI cApi kriyA prAyaH prashasyate| vArshciko hyucciTi~ggasya kaNabhasyaunduro~agadaH ||211||
vacAM vaMshatvacaM pAThAM nataM surasama~jjarIm| dve bale nAkulIM kuShThaM shirIShaM rajanIdvayam||212||
guhAmatiguhAM shvetAmajagandhAM shilAjatu| kattRuNaM kaTabhIM kShAraM gRuhadhUmaM manaHshilAm||213||
rohItakasya pittena piShTvA tu paramo~agadaH| nasyA~jjanAdilepeShu hito vishvambharAdiShu||214||
svarjikA~ajashakRutkShAraH surasA~athAkShipIDakaH | madirAmaNDasaMyukto hitaH shatapadIviShe||215||
kapitthamakShipIDo~arkabIjaM trikaTukaM tathA| kara~jjo dve haridre ca gRuhagodhAviShaM jayet||216||
kAkANDarasasaMyukto viShANAM taNDulIyakaH| pradhAno barhipittena tadvadvAyasapIlukaH||217||
shirIShaphalamUlatvakpuShpapatraiH samairdhRutaiH| shreShThaH pa~jcashirISho~ayaM viShANAM pravaro vadhe||218||
catuShpadbhirdvipadbhirvA nakhadantakShataM tu yat| shUyate pacyate cApi sravati jvarayatyapi||219||
somavalko~ashvakarNashca gojihvA haMsapadyapi| rajanyau gairikaM lepo nakhadantaviShApahaH||220||
durandhakAre viddhasya kenacidviShasha~gkayA| viShodvegAjjvarashachardirmUrcchA dAho~api vA bhavet||221||
glAnirmoho~atisArashcApyetaccha~gkAviShaM matam| cikitsitamidaM tasya kuryAdAshvAsayan budhaH||222||
sitA vaigandhiko drAkShA payasyA madhukaM madhu| pAnaM samantrapUtAmbu prokShaNaM sAntvaharShaNam||223||
shAlayaH ShaShTikAshcaiva koradUShAH priya~ggavaH| bhojanArthe prashasyante lavaNArthe ca saindhavam||224||
taNDulIyakajIvantIvArtAkasuniShaNNakAH| cuccUrmaNDUkaparNI ca shAkaM ca kulakaM hitam||225||
dhAtrI dADimamamlArthe yUShA mudgahareNubhiH| rasAshcaiNashikhishvAvillAvataittirapArShatAH||226||
viShaghnauShadhasaMyuktA rasA yUShAshca saMskRutAH| avidAhIni cAnnAni viShArtAnAM bhiShagjitam||227||
viruddhAdhyashanakrodhakShudbhayAyAsamaithunam| varjayedviShamukto~api divAsvapnaM visheShataH||228||
amRutArthaM samudre tu mathyamAne surAsuraiH| jaj~je prAgamRutotpatteH puruSho ghoradarshanaH||4||
dIptatejAshcaturdaMShTro harikesho~analekShaNaH| jagadviShaNNaM taM dRuShTvA tenAsau viShasa~jj~jitaH||5||
iti pa~jcashirISho~agadaH
iti gandhahastInAmA~agadaH

ja~ggamasthAvarAyAM tadyonau brahmA nyayojayat| tadambusambhavaM tasmAddvividhaM pAvakopamam||6||

Commentary: tadambusambhavaM tasmAd dvividhamiti tadambusambhavaM samudrotpannaM, tasmAt samudrata utpannatvAdambusambhavaM, tathA tasmAd brahmaNA yonidvayaniyuktatvAd dvividhamityarthaH| ambusambhavatvena cAsya varShAprakopitvaM vakShyamANaM yuktam; ambuyonibhUtatvena cAsya jalena prabhAvAt prashamanaM kriyata iti j~jeyam| uktaM hi bhagavatA vyAsena- “adbhyo~agnirbrahmataH kShatramashmano lohamutthitam| tasmAt sarvatragaM tejaH svAsu yoniShu shAmyati” iti| aShTavegamiti manuShyApekShayA~aShTavegam | dashaguNAdyagre vakShyamANam| upakramAH cikitsAnuShThAnabhedAH||6||-
tadvarShAsvambuyonitvAt sa~gkledaM guDavadgatam||7||
sarpatyambudharApAye tadagastyo hinasti ca| prayAti mandavIryatvaM viShaM tasmAddhanAtyaye||8||
iti kShArAgadaH
sarpAH kITondurA lUtA vRushcikA gRuhagodhikAH| jalaukAmatsyamaNDUkAH kaNabhAH sakRukaNTakAH||9||
shvasiMhavyAghragomAyutarakShunakulAdayaH| daMShTriNo ye viShaM teShAM daMShTrotthaM ja~ggamaM matam||10||
mustakaM pauShkaraM krau~jcaM vatsanAbhaM balAhakam| karkaTaM kAlakUTaM ca karavIrakasa~jj~jakam||11||
pAlakendrAyudhaM tailaM meghakaM kushapuShpakam| rohiShaM puNDarIkaM ca lA~ggalakya~jjanAbhakam||12||
sa~gkocaM markaTaM shRu~ggIviShaM hAlAhalaM tathA| evamAdIni cAnyAni mUlajAni sthirANi ca||13||

garasaMyogajaM cAnyadgarasa~jj~jaM gadapradam| kAlAntaravipAkitvAnna tadAshu haratyasUn||14||

Commentary: sthAvaraja~ggamArabdhameva tRutIyaM viShamAha- garasaMyogajamityAdi| garArthaH saMyogo yeShAM te garasaMyogA dravyabhedAH, tebhyo jAtaM garasaMyogajam| ‘gara’ iti tantre sa~jj~jA yasya tad garasa~jj~jam| tacca cirakArirogajanakamaprANaharam | etadevAha- kAlAntaretyAdi| sushrute~api trividhameva viShamuktaM- “sthAvaraM ja~ggamaM caiva kRutrimaM cApi yadviSham” (su.ka.a.2) ityanena| yattu dUShIviShamagre vakShyati tat trividhAntargataM darshayiShyAmaH| garaM tu dvividhaM- nirviShadravyasaMyogakRutaM, tathA saviShadravyasaMyogakRutaM ca; tatrAdyaM garasa~jj~jam, uttaraM tu kRutrimamiti vyavasthA| tenemAmeva vyavasthAM gRuhItvoktaM rasAyane- “daMShTrAviShe mUlaviShe sagare kRutrime viShe” (ci.a.1,pA.) iti| tathA vRuddhakAshyape~apyuktaM- “saMyogajaM ca dvividhaM tRutIyaM viShamucyate| garaM syAdaviShaM tatra saviShaM kRutrimaM matam” iti||14||

shItopashamaprAdhAnyasAmAnyAttRuShNAcikitsitamanu viShacikitsitamucyate- prAgityAdi| prAgutpattiH AdyotpattiH| yoniriti adhiShThAnam| li~ggAnIti dehasambandhiviShasya li~ggAni, tathA annAdigatasya ca li~ggAni| atra nApRuShTA guravo vadantIti nyAyAcchiShyaprashna unneyaH| viShaM ca yadyapi rogAdhikAre na sUtritaM sAkShAt, tathA~api viShajamadAbhidhAnAttatkAraNatayA sUtritameva rogAdhikAre j~jeyaM; tena notsUtramiha viShAbhidhAnamiti||1-3||

nidrAmityAdinA ja~ggamaviShasya tathA jvaramityAdinA sthAvaraviShasya li~ggAni sarvavegagatAni prAha| ja~ggamasthAvarayoH parasparopaghAtAtmakadharmamabhidhAtuM hetumatparasparopaghAtakatvamevAhaja~ggamamityAdi| tasmAditi parasparaM viruddhamArgagAmitvAt| etena ca yadvakShyati- “viShapAnaM daShTAnAM viShapIte daMshanaM cAnte” iti, tadupapannaM bhavati| nanu “viShaM viShaghnamuktaM yat prabhAvastatra kAraNAm” (sU.a.26) iti AtreyabhadrakApyIye prabhAveNa viShasya viShaharaNAbhidhAnopapattivarNanaM tadvirudhyate; maivaM, yadi dravyaprabhAvaH kAraNaM na syAt tadA yatki~jcidUrdhvabhAgaM madanaphalAdi taddaMShTrAviShaharaM syAt, yaccAdhobhAgaM trivRutAdi tanmaulaviShaM nihanyAt; nacaitaddRuShTaM, tasmAt prabhAvasyaivAtmaguNatAmAtrakAraNametadadhobhAgatvamUrdhvabhAgatvaM ceti||15-17||

annamishritAniti bhakShyamishritAn| garashcAsyopajAyata iti vakShyamANamarmapradhamAnAdilakShaNo vyAdhirjAyate| vihatendriya iti rogopahatendriyaH| pRucchedityAdau pRucchAyAM garAvadhAraNameva phalamavagamyate| avagamyeti garakAraNamavagamya| sUkShmamityAdau amRutatAmracUrNaM mAShamAnaM yAvaddeyam, amRutenaiva vamanaM bhavati| hemapa iti hema yaH pibatIti sa hemapaH| nAgadantI dantIbhedaH| phalaM madanaphalaM, natu ‘palaiH’ iti pAThaH| ayaM yogo jatukarNe paThyate- “nAgadantIsnukkShIraphalairgomUtrasiddhaM mAhiShaM ghRutaM pAyayet” iti||229-241||-
shirIShatvagityAdau AsphotA aparamallikA| surabhI parNAsabhedaH| bandhujIvaH putrajIvakaH| ashvakhurakaH syandanaH; kiMvA kokilAkShaH||242-249||

chatrItyAdau chatrI divA, rAtrau jharjharapANishcarediti vadanti; anye tUbhayatrApyubhayaM bruvate| jharjharakaH ‘khurkhuraka’ iti khyAtaH| chAyAshabdau yathAsa~gkhyaM chatrajharjharayoH| tAbhyAM tadAtve vitrastAH| daMshakAle kartavyamAha- daShTamAtra ityAdi| dhAraNAdeva viShApahamAha- vajramityAdi| sAra iti sarajUvisheShaNam(?)| picuko maNiruttarApathe prasiddhaH| viShamUShikA viShamaNiH| karketanamaNiH padmarAgaH| garamaNishabdena nAnAmaNInAM grahaNam| varauShadhya iti tantrAntaroktAH akShIvajAtapippalAjaruhAkAyoShI (?) prabhRutayaH; uktaM ca- “akShIvajAtasya pippalasya maNiH sarvaviShApahaH” ityAdi||250-253||

tRuNmohetyAdinA krameNAShTaviShavegalakShaNamAha| sushrute ekaikakalAtikrameNa saptavegA udIritAH; iha kalAla~gghanenaiva saptavegAH, aShTame tu saptakalAla~gghanottarakAlaM mArako vego daShTasya daMshadeshagamanAya pItaviShasya hRudayagamanAya bhavatIti sushrutena samamavirodhaH| vAtAdijA iti yathAyogyatayA uddhatAnyataraikadoShadvidoShatridoShajAH| mUrcchAdyA ityatrAdishabdaH prakAravAcI| caturthAdivegeShvanuktamapi medaAdidUShyamunnetavyaM, sushrutavacanAt| nIlAdInAmityatra Adishabdena pradhAnavAcinA nIlapradhAnetaravarNadarshanaM bhavati| ShaShThe hikketi cchedaH| viShavegaprastAvAccatuShpAdapakShiNo~api viShavegAnAha| etadviShavegAbhidhAne ca prayojanaM- yadviShavegamRutasyApi mAMsamupayojyaM pItaviShasya hRudayaM daShTasya ca daMshadeshaM muktvetyAdyuktavidhAnena, vegaj~jAnenAprAptanaiShThikavegasya yathoktavidhinA mAMsaM nopAdeyaM, yatastasya viShArditasya sarvaM sharIraM viShavadbhavati| catuShpadAdInAmalpavegatvaM sattvAlpatvAt| avasIdatItyAdi| dvitIye, shUnya ityAdi tRutIye||18-23||

viShaguNAnAha- laghvityAdi| pratyekaM guNAnAM kAryamAha raukShyAdityAdi| ashaityAditi uShNatvAt| saukShmyAdasRukprakopaNamasRujo~api sUkShmamArgAnusAritvAt| avyaktarasatvaM ca kaphakopanAya avyaktarasatvakaphayorekajalarUpakAryatvAddhavati| annarasAMshcAnuvartate iti avyaktarasatvena jalaM yathA gandhagrahaNe yogavAhi bhavati, tathA viShamapi annarasAn jhaTityanugataM bhavati, tataH shIghraM tena bhAvitamannaM bhavati| shIghretyAdau shIghratvAdAshu vyApnoti, vyavAyitvAt kevalaM dehaM vyApnotIti j~jeyam| vyavAyitvaM sarvataH prasaraNashIlatvaM pAnIyapatitattailavat| tIkShNatvAnmarmaghnamiti marmaNAM saumyAnAM mRudUnAM tIkShNena viruddhatvaM boddhavyam| vikAsitvAditi hiMsanashIlatvAt; vipUrvo hi kasatirhiMsArthaH| laghutvAditi anavasthitatvAt; yasya cAnavasthitatvaM tasya bheShajenAsambandhAdupakramaNamaki~jcitkaram| asaktA avishrAntA doSheShu gatiryasya tat asaktagatidoShaM, vishadaM hi picchAbhAgarahitatvAt kvacinna sajjati| atra ca guNAnAM pratiniyamena viruddhakarmakaraNe viShasyAshivatvameva niyAmakaM j~jeyaM; tena raukShyAdibhiH shleShmakShayAdi nAsha~gkanIyam| sushrute ca viShaguNe yat pAkitvamuktaM, tadAshukAriviShe niShprayojanamiti nehoktaM; tathAhi- viShaM naitAvantaM kAlamapekShate yena yAvattasya pAko bhavatyavicAryaH| sushrute ca kAlAntaraprakopitvamapi dUShIviShagocaratayoktaM, tadihApi dUShIviShe cintanIyamiti||24-27||

samprati sthAnavisheSheNa prakRutivisheShaprAptyA ca li~ggavisheShAnAha- vAtikasyetyAdi| viShaM madyaM ca yadyapi tridoShakopanaM, tathA~api sthAnaprakRutivisheShaprAptyA tadanuguNadoShaprakopamadhikaM karoti, sheShayostu manAgityarthaH| vAtikasyeti vAtaprakRuteH| vAtasthAne pakvAshayAdau| kaphapittali~ggamIShaditi vacanAd vAtali~ggaM balavadbhavati, tacca tRuNmUrcchetyAdinoktaM j~jeyam; evamuttaratrApi yojyam| kaphavAtayostadvaditi IShadityarthaH; tRuDAdi tu balavalli~ggaM, tat pittasyetyarthaH| kaphetyAdau cakArAt kaphaprakRuterityarthaH| IShadvAtapittayoriti yojyam||28-30||
etadvisheShaj~jAnArthaM lakShaNamAha- nIlauShThetyAdi| daNDarAjiH daNDAkArA rekhA ||33-34||

mantretyAdi| mantrasya viShahareShu shreShThatvAdagre~abhidhAnaM; yaduktaM “viShaM tejomayairmantraiH satyabrahmatapomayaiH| yathA nivAryate kShipraM prayuktairna tathauShadhaiH” (su.ka.a.5) iti| ariShTA dvividhA- mantreNa rajjvAdibhirvA viShoparibandhaH| upadhAnaM viShasa~gkramaNArthaM mastake bheShajadAnam| hRudayAvaraNaM hRudayarakShAkaramauShadham| prativiShaM viShAntaraprayogaH| mRutasa~jjIvanaM viSheNa mRutasyAmRuta iva sa~jjIvanakaraM bheShajam| sheShaM vyaktaM vivaraNagranthena sphuTaM bhaviShyati||35-37||

pracchanAdibhI raktamokShaNamupakramamAha| upakramANAM ca vyatikramAbhidhAnena niyamena kramayogaM niShedhayati| raktasrAvaNopapattimAha- rakte ityAdi| prakRutiriti dehadhAtvAdisvabhAvaH| pragharShaNairiti pragharShaNairapi, pracchanAdibhiH pragharShaNena cetyarthaH| pragharShaNaM patrAdibhiH| pragharShaNena pratisAraNamupakrameShUktam| gharShaNamiti chedaH| viShAdhAnamiti viShasya prasArakam| skandati sthiraM bhavati| skanne iti sthire| vIjyaH vyajanapavanaiH||39-43||
tarurivetyAdinA chedAdInAM viShaharaNopapattimAha| seturyatheti prasaranirodhaka ityarthaH| dvitIye ‘vege’ iti sheShaH||44-45||

AdAviti sarvopakramAdau| tasyeti hRudayasya| yathAlAbhamiti vakShyamANahRudayAvaraNayogeShu yathAprAptihRudayAvaraNam| kShArAgado vakShyamANaH| tRutIye ‘vege’ iti sheShaH| kAkANDA shimbIbhedaH| gopittayutA rajanI AshcotanAdiShu j~jeyA| ante iti sarvopakramasheShe saptame vege sarpeNa daMshanaM kAryam||46-50||

aShTame tu vege shikhipittetyAdinA mRutasa~jjIvanayogAnAha| mRuta iti mRuta iva| udbandhetyAdau mRute iti udbandhAdibhistribhiH sambadhyate| lepaupadhinasyapAnAnIti lepAdayashcAmI udbandhAdiShu yathAyogyatayA j~jeyAH| lepaupadhItyAdau upadhiryo mUrdhni kAkapadaM kRutvA viShaharaNAya dIyate||51-53||

spRukketyAdau kA~gkShI saurAShTrikA| kuShThaghnaH khadiraH| sAvarakaM lodhram| kauntI reNukA| mayUrakaH apAmArgaH, gandhaphalA priya~gguH, nAkulI rAsnA| dhAraNashabdena sharIre dhAraNaM brUte; dhAraNaM cauShadhashabdenopakrameShu pravishati| gRuhastha iti gRuhe~avatiShThan| kArmaNaH paradrohArtho mantrAdiyogaH, mantraH abhicAramantraH| strIdoShAniti strIdattagarAdidoShAn| prAgamRutAditi amRutotpatteH prAk; etena cAmRutasamAnatvamasya darshyate||54-60||

mantrairityAdau avamArjanamiti viShasya pratilomena mArjanaM mantraireva kAryam| AtmarakShA bhUtAveshaniShedhArtham| jayediti sthAninaM doShaM jayet| svedo yadyapi pratiShiddhaH svedAdhyAye, tathA~apyavasthAvisheShe ‘vAtasthAne’ ityAdinA vidhIyate| svedastu peyAdibhojanAdividhAnavadasya prayogAccaturviMshatyupakrameShu noktaH; kiMvA agnishabdena svedo~api gRuhyate, peyAdi copashamanashabdenAvashyaM boddhavyam| pittasthe iti pittasthAnasthe| dUShIviSha ityAdau sirA iti sirAvyadhaH, karma pa~jcavidhaM vamanAdi; kiMvA sirAkarma pa~jcavidhamiti pa~jcasirAvyadhaH| sthAnamiti sthAnagatavAtAdi| sthAnasthasyeti sthAnagataviShasyAviruddhaM ca ‘kuryAt’ iti sheShaH||61-64||

srotaHsaMrodhena ruddho vAyurucchvAsanishvAsalakShaNo yasya sa tathA| asAdhyali~ggairiti prAguktanIlauShThAdibhiH| carmakaShAyA iti carmacaTikAyAH, kiMvA saptalAyAH| kAkapadamiti kAkapadAkAraM vraNam| kaTabhItyAdau kaTukaphalA tiktAlAbuH, kiMvA kaTu trikaTu| jyotiShmatItyAdIni ShaTvirecanashatAshritAyoktAni shirovirecanAni| dArvItyAdau shvetA kaTabhI| vyatyAsabhAvita iti gopittena bhAvayitvA ashvapittena bhAvitaH, tathA ashvapittena bhAvayitvA gopittena bhAvitaH||65-76||

RuShabhaketyAdinA viShopadravashvAsAdicikitsocyate| sitagiriH shvetA~aparAjitA, kolamadhyaM badaramajjA| bhujagapatishira iti dvimukhasarpashiraH| vastrakRumiH yUkA| palAshakShAraM srutamiti sushrutoktakShAraparisrAvaNavidhinA srAvitam| lohitamRut gairikam| surasama~jjarI parNAsabhedaH||77-104||

pRuthaktvAnnirdeshamataH shRuNviti nAnAvidhaviShasya lakShaNaM bheShajasya pRutha~gnirdeshaM ca shRuNviti| ripuyuktebhya iti shatruprayuktebhyaH| strIbhya iti saubhAgyArthamabhakShyadAne~apyaj~jAnAt pravRuttAbhyaH strIbhyaH| AhAravihAragata iti AhAravihArau sevamAnaH| preShyAniti sUpakArAdIn| parIkShopAyamAha- atyarthetyAdi| vigatalakShmIH niHshobhaH| bhojyamiti bhoktavyam| kuryAt tadannamagnau prakShipet| pAtrasthamityAdAvapi ‘saviShaM’ ityanuvartate| virajyeta cakorAkShIti saviShamannaM dRuShTvA cakorAkShi virajyate| kAkAMshca kShAmasvarAn darshanenaiva kuryAditi j~jeyam| pAne iti madyAdau peye| chAyAmiti pratibimbam| lavaNAkte iti pAnavisheShaNam| mukhage ityAdinA mukhAdisambandhiviShalakShaNam| binduH bindvAkArA tvagvikRutiH| dantetyAdinA dantadhAvanakUrcAdInAM viShaduShTAnAmeva lakShaNaM prakAraNAjj~jeyam| dantapavanasya kUrcaH dantamalashodhanakUrcaH| vishIryata iti shIrNaH syAt| khAdyairiti bhojyaiH| spRushyairiti abhya~ggAdibhiH| mAlyamiti viShaduShTaM mAlyam| nAsAmupahantIti cchedaH| darshanamiti cakShuH| kiMvA stambhayatItyAdi dhUmasyaiva kAryam||95-122||-

maNDalIti maNDalayuktaH| bindunA lekhayA ca vicitrama~ggaM yasya sa bindulekhavicitrA~ggaH| darvIkarAdInAM prapa~jcastviha parAdhikAratvena na kRutaH| visheShAdityAdau rUkShamadhikaM darvIkarANAm, amloShNaM maNDalinAM, svAdushItaM rAjimatAM, tridoShakopanatve~api vAtAdikopanaM visheShAdiha j~jeyam| viShaM ca yadyapyavyaktarasayuktaM, tathA~apIha kaTukAdirasAbhidhAnamanurasAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyaM, yathA- Atape kaTukatvaM, tadvadihApi; kiMvA avyaktarasatAyAmeva manAkkaTukAdInAmadhikatvaM j~jeyam| pRuthvarpita iti avagADhadaMShTrApadaH ||123-129||

vRuttabhoga ityAdinA sarpANAM puruShAdibhedaM viShatIvratAdij~jAnArthaM tatkRutacikitsAbhedaj~jAnArthaM cAha| sa ca bheda ihAnukto~api tantrAntarAjj~jeyaH| tathAhi- “sAvitre pacyate, rAtrau striyastIvraviShAH, tathA~ahni puruShAH sadA” iti| tathA- “strIdaShTe bhiShajA kAryaH sUpacArastvanArambhe” iti| mahAkAyaH bahulasharIraH| klIbaH napuMsakaH| gADhasampAditam atimAtrAvagADham| urdhvaM parivRuttamudvRuttam| pIDitam atimAtrarujAkaram| lambitArpitam arpitasakaladaMShTrAprAptalakShaNam||130-135||

sarpadaMShTrA ityAdinA daMShTrAbhedaM daMshaviShaj~jAnArthamAha| raktashyAvA~adharottareti dakShiNAdharA raktA, dakShiNottarA tu shyAvA| ekadvitricaturvRuddhaviShabhAgottarottarA iti ekadvitricatUrUpeNa vRuddho viShabhAga uttarottaraM yAsviti vAkyArthaH| savarNA yathAsvadaMShTrAsamAnavarNAH| bahUttaraviShA iti uttarottaraM bahuviShAH| bhRushA iti duHkhasAdhyAH| duHkhasAdhyatvamapi yathottaraM j~jeyam| nanu, pUrvaM darvIkarAdInAM daMshasya varNabheda uktaH, idAnIM tu daMShTrAbhedena varNabheda ucyate, tena sarvatraiva darvIkarAdau sarvavarNopapattiH, tatashca pUrvoktadaMshavarNavirodhaH; uktaM cAtraivArthe AShADhavarmaNA yat- “darvIkaramaNDalinorasitaH pItashca varNato daMshaH” iti lakShaNena, yasmAdanekavarNAstu daMshAH” (?)| atrocyate- daMShTrAnukArivarNatA daMshamAtrasthite viShe bhavati, darvIkakarAdyullekhavihitastu yo varNo doShakRutaH sa pravisRute viShe bhavatIti avasthAbhedAnna virodhaH| uktaM ca parihAravArtike “daMshe tvete varNAH, sAvarNyaM doShaje visRute” iti||137-139||

kITAn vyAkartumAha - sarpANAmityAdi| viNmUtrAditi kITashabdaniruktyarthamanayorupAdAnaM, tenAnyAnyapi sarpashukrashavapUtyaNDAni kITakAraNAni bhavantIti j~jeyam| uktaM hi sushrute- “sarpANAM shukraviNmUtrashavapUtyaNDasambhavAH| vAyvagnyambuprakRutayaH kITAstu vi(tri)vidhAH smRutAH” (su.ka.a.8) iti| kITAshca yadyapi sushrute vAtapittakaphasannipAtakopanAH kumbhInasAdayaH saptaShaShTiH pratipAditAH, tathA~apIha sa~jj~jeyAbhidhitsayA dUShIviShaprANaharabhedenaivocyante; evaM lUtAdiShvapi sa~jj~jeyabhedAddvaividhyoktirj~jeyA| dUShIviShAH cirakAriviShAH, prANaharAH jhaTiti prANaharaviShAH| saha ugragandhyasRujA vartata iti sogragandhyasRuk sogragandhi lohitam||140-143||

daMshasya madhya ityAdinA dUShIviShalUtAdaShTalakShaNam| lUtAshcAnyatrAShTau sAdhyA asAdhyAshcAShTau trimaNDalAsauvarNikAdaya uktAstAsAM tathA mUShikakRukaNTakavRushcikocciTi~ggamaNDUkamatsyajalaukAshatapadImashakamakShikANAM sushrutAdiShu prapa~jcArthibhiH prapa~jco~anusaraNIyaH; iha tu tantrakAreNa parAdhikAratvAt prapa~jco na kriyate||144-146||

AdaMshAdityAdi AkhuviShalakShaNam| kaNabhashca kITavisheSha iti sushrute kITamadhye eva paThitaH| ekadaMShTrArpita iti ekayaiva daMShTrayA kRuta ityarthaH| matsyAstu pittAsthyAraviShA uktAH| jalaukasashca ShaT saviShAH kRuShNAkarburAdaya uktAH sandaMshaviShAH| gRuhagodhikAM jyeShThAmityAhuH; anye tu saraTamAhuH| shatapadI kAruNDA| asAdhyamashakakShatamiti pa~jcasu mashakeShu pArvatIyakRutamasAdhyamAhuH| uktaM hi sushrute “pArvatIyastu kITaiH prANaharai stulyalakShaNaH” (su.ka.a.8) iti| sthagikA~asuhRuditi kAntArikAdiShu sushrutoktaShaNamakShikAsu sthagikAkhyA makShikA prANaharItyarthaH||147-158||

samprati sthAnakAlasvabhAvapradeshaiH sarpadaShTAnAmasAdhyatAmAha- shmashAnetyAdi| caityaH grAmadevatAshrayo mahAtaruH| pakShasandhiShviti amAvAsyApaurNamAsIShu| pAShaNDAH kApAlikAdayaH| AshIviShairityasyaiva lakShaNaM- dRuShTishvAsamalasparshaviShairiti| uktaM hi tantrAntare- “dRuShTishvAsAdibhirdivyAH sarpA AshIviShAH, AshughAtitvAt” iti||159-160||-

viShavRuddhihetumAha- bhItetyAdi| prakRutikAlau tulyau viShasya, yathA- prabalapittaprakRutiruShNashca kAla iti j~jeyam| alpamanyatheti bhItatvAdiviparyaye alpaM viShaM bhavati| vArItyAdau vRuddhA iti gonasavarjaM j~jeyAH, gonasya tu vArdhakye eva vRuddhaviShatvaM prAguktam| sarvadehAshritaM krodhAditi sarvadehAshritamapi daMShTrAsveva viShaM visheSheNa j~jeyaM; yathA- shukraM sarvasharIragamapi vRuShaNayoreva visheSheNAvatiShThati||161-164||
cikitsArthaM vAtolbaNaviShatvAdibhedenocciTi~ggAdInAha- vAtolbaNetyAdi| hRutpIDetyAdinA viShagatAdhikavAtAdili~ggamAha||165-169||
vAtAdibhedena cikitsAmAha- khaNDenetyAdi| pulAkaH tucchadhAnyam| ghanairiti pAMsubhireva ghanaiH||170-174||

shvA tridoShetyAdi saviShakukkurAdilakShaNam| yatraiva ca shunastridoShakopo bhavati daivAdalarkagrahAveshAt tatraiva saviShashirobhitApitvAdi bhavatIti j~jeyam| kecittu shirobhitApAdi yathoktaM kukkure tathA taddaShTe ca bhavatIti vadanti| vistarashcAsya sushruta eva| anye~apyevaMvidhA iti anye~api shRugAlatarakShvAdaya evaMvidhAH santaH kRucchrashirorogAdikarA bhavantItyarthaH| uktaM hi sushrute- “shvashRugAlatarakShvarkShavyAghrAdInAM yadA~anilaH| shleShmapraduShTo muShNAti sa~jj~jAM sa~jj~jAvahAshritaH” (su.ka.a.7) iti| kaNDUnistoda ityAdinA sAmAnyena saviShakITAdidaMshali~ggamaviShaprANidaMshali~ggaM cocyate| karNikA mAMsakandI| sarve iti caturviMshatirapi yathoktopakramAH| pUrvoktamityatra vakShyamANacikitsitaM pUrvoktavidhAvapi avasthAvisheShavidheyatayA kartavyamityarthaH; yadA ‘pUrvoktA’ iti pAThaH, tadA upakramA ityasya visheShaNametat| UrdhvaM daShTasya pAdayorityatrApi kShatayoreva pAdayorviShasa~gkramaNArthaM mAMsAsRugdAnaM j~jeyam| tAbhyAmiti sitAkShaudrAbhyAm| nataM tagaram| sheluH shleShmAtakaH| mAMsagate ityuttareNa sambadhyate| khadirashcAriShTashceti khadirAriShTaH, kiMvA khadirakRuto~ariShTaH| samadhukaM natamiti cchedaH||175-188||

pippalItyAdipratisAraNaM daMshe eva| maricaM sitamiti shobhA~jjanakabIjam| shvetA ceti girikarNikAvisheShaNaM, tena shvetA~aparAjitA gRuhyate| kecidgirikarNikAM syandanAmAhuH| pAkalaM kuShTham||189-198||-

muktA mauktikam| kShIrashuklA vidArI| karNikApatanaM tayoriti anantaroktakITalUtAdaMshayoryA karNikA tasyAH pAtanamityarthaH| jAlamAlinI devatADakaH| tiktekShvAkuH kaTukAlAbUH| vArshcike iti vRushcikaviShe| durduraH bhekaH| shvetabhaNDI aparAjitA| vArshcike ityAdi ucciTi~ggasya viShe vArshcike yo yoga uktaH sa kartavyaH| evaM kaNabhasyApi viShe aundure yo yoga uktaH sa kartavyaH||199-211||

nAkulI rAsnA| guhA pRushniparNI, atiguhA shAlaparNI| ajagandhA phophAndheti khyAtA| pitteneti gopittena| vishvambharAdayaH kITA eva shleShmakopanAH sushrutoktAH| akShapIDakaH shvetapItashimbIbhedaH| vAyasI kAkamAcI| shreShThaH pa~jcashirISho~ayamiti padaM trishirIShAdyapekShayA pa~jcashirIShasya shreShThatvaM brUte, pravara iti padaM viShaharayogAntareShu shreShThatAmAha, tena na punaruktiH; kiMvA shreShTha iti shreShThashirIShaphalAdikRutaH||212-218||
dvipadA vanamAnuShamarkaTAdayaH| ashvakarNaH sarjabhedaH||219-220||

durandhakAre ityAdinA sha~gkAviShamAha| kenaciditi nirviSheNApi| viShasha~gkayA viShodvegAditi viShasha~gkayaiva viShaprAdurbhAvAdityarthaH; sha~gkA ceyaM prabhAvAdeva viShajanikA| vaigandhikaH gandhaka eva shodhitaH||221-223||
koradUShaH kodravaH| kulakaM kAravellakam; anye paTolabhedamAhuH||224-228||
amRutArthamityAdinA prAgutpattyabhidhAnaM viShasya mahAprabhAvadarshanArtham| harikesha iti pi~ggalakeshaH| sa puruShaH viShamucyate viShAdanAddhetoH; evaM ca viShashabdaniruktiruktA bhavati||4-5||

viShasya varShAsu visheShaprakope sharadi copashame hetumAha- tadvarShAsvityAdi| guDo yathA piNDito~ambuyonitvAdvarShAsu sa~gkledaM yAti, tathA viShamapi klinnaM visarpati utkliShTashaktikaM ca bhavati, ata eva dUShIviShArtA atipIDitA bhavanti; ambudharANAM vRuddhikAraNaM varShAgamaH; agastyaprabhAvashca taM hinasti||7-8||

parAdhikAratvAdviShasya sarpA ityAdinA ja~ggamasthAvarayonidvayaM sa~gkShepAdevAha| yadyapi viShaguNA agre uddiShTAH, tathA~api guNAnAM guNyapekShatvAdagre viShasya guNinaH sthAvaraja~ggamabhedabhinnasyAbhidhAnam; uddeshe tu prathamaM guNAbhidhAnaM viShasya kAryakaraNe guNaprAdhAnyakhyApanArtham| sarpAdInAM bhedA agre eva vaktavyAH, tena tatraiva vyAkartavyAH| AdigrahaNAducciTi~ggAdInAM tantrAntaroktAnAM grahaNam| atra adaMShTriNo~api daMShTrisarpaprAdhAnyAddaMShTriNa ityuktAH; tathA daMShTrotthamiti daMShTrotthasya sarvaviShaprAdhAnyAdadaMShTrotthAnAmapi unduruviShAdInAM grahaNam| uktaM hyanyatra “ja~ggamasya viShasyoktAnyadhiShThAnAni ShoDasha| tatra dRuShTidaMShTrAniHshvAsanakhamUtrapurIShashukralAlArtavamukhasandaMshavishardhitagudAsthipittashUkashavAni” (su.ka.a.3) iti| tathA~anyatrApi “shukramUtrapurIShANi dehe nipatitAni tu| dAruNaM garamityAhuH” iti||9-10||

sthAvaraje viShe mUlajAnIti padaM mUlajasya bahutvAt prAdhAnyAcca| tena patrapuShpAdijAnAmapi viShANAM grahaNaM; yaduktaM sushrute- “mUlaM patraM phalaM puShpaM tvak kShIraM sAra eva ca|| niryAso dhAtavashcaiva kandashca dashamaH smRutaH” (su.ka.a.2) iti| kandastviha mUlavisheShatvAnmUlashabdenaiva gRuhItaH| eteShAM ca sa~jj~jAsambandhe shabarakirAtAdaya eva tadvidyAH pramANaM, te hi guruparamparayA vyAkhyAnayanti||11-13||
athAto madAtyayacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
madyaM hRudayamAvishya svaguNairojaso guNAn| dashabhirdasha sa~gkShobhya ceto nayati vikriyAm||29||
laghUShNatIkShNasUkShmAmlavyavAyyAshugameva ca| rUkShaM vikAshi vishadaM madyaM dashaguNaM smRutam||30||
guru shItaM mRudu shlakShNaM bahalaM madhuraM sthiram| prasannaM picchilaM snigdhamojo dashaguNaM smRutam||31||
gurutvaM lAghavAcchaityamauShNAdamlasvabhAvataH| mAdhuryaM mArdavaM taikShNyAtprasAdaM cAshubhAvanAt||32||
raukShyAt snehaM vyavAyitvAt sthiratvaM shlakShNatAmapi| vikAsibhAvAtpaicchilyaM vaishadyAtsAndratAM tathA||33||
saukShmyAnmadyaM nihantyevamojasaH svaguNairguNAn| sattvaM tadAshrayaM cAshu sa~gkShobhya janayenmadam||34||
rasavAtAdimArgANAM sattvabuddhIndriyAtmanAm| pradhAnasyaujasashcaiva hRudayaM sthAnamucyate||35||
atipItena madyena vihatenaujasA ca tat| hRudayaM yAti vikRutiM tatrasthA ye ca dhAtavaH||36||
ojasyavihate pUrvo hRudi ca pratibodhite| madhyamo vihate~alpe ca vihate tUttamo madaH||37||
naivaM vighAtaM janayenmadyaM paiShTikamojasaH| vikAshirUkShavishadA guNAstatra hi nolbaNAH||38||
hRudi madyaguNAviShTe harShastarSho ratiH sukham| vikArAshca yathAsattvaM citrA rAjasatAmasAH||39||
jAyante mohanidrAntA madyasyAtiniShevaNAt| sa madyavibhramo nAmnA ‘mada’ ityabhidhIyate||40||
pIyamAnasya madyasya vij~jAtavyAstrayo madAH| prathamo madhyamo~antyashca lakShaNaistAn pracakShmahe||41||
praharShaNaH prItikaraH pAnAnnaguNadarshakaH| vAdyagItaprahAsAnAM kathAnAM ca pravartakaH||42||
na ca buddhismRutiharo viShayeShu na cAkShamaH| sukhanidrAprabodhashca prathamaH sukhado madaH||43||
muhuH smRutirmuhurmoho(~a)vyaktA sajjati vA~gmuhuH| yuktAyuktapralApashca pracalAyanameva ca||44||
sthAnapAnAnnasA~gkathyayojanA saviparyayA| li~ggAnyetAni jAnIyAdAviShTe madhyame made||45||
madhyamaM madamutkramya madamAprApya cottamam| na ki~jcinnAshubhaM kuryurnarA rAjasatAmasAH||46||
ko madaM tAdRushaM vidvAnunmAdamiva dAruNam| gacchedadhvAnamasvantaM bahudoShamivAdhvagaH||47||
tRutIyaM tu madaM prApya bhagnadArviva niShkriyaH| madamohAvRutamanA jIvannapi mRutaiH samaH||48||
ramaNIyAn sa viShayAnna vetti na suhRujjanam| yadarthaM pIyate madyaM ratiM tAM ca na vindati||49||
kAryAkAryaM sukhaM duHkhaM loke yacca hitAhitam| yadavastho na jAnAti ko~avasthAM tAM vrajedbudhaH||50||
sa dUShyaH sarvabhUtAnAM nindyashcAgrAhya eva ca| vyasanitvAdudarke ca sa duHkhaM vyAdhimashnute||51||
suraiH sureshasahitairyA purA paripUjitA| sautrAmaNyAM hUyate yA karmibhiryA pratiShThitA||3||
yaj~jauhI yA yayA shakraH somAtipatito bhRusham| nirojastamasA~a~aviShTastasmAddurgAt samuddhRutaH||4||
vidhibhirvedavihitairvA yajadbhirmahAtmabhiH| dRushyA spRushyA prakalpyA ca yaj~jIyA yaj~jasiddhaye||5||
pretya ceha ca yacchreyaH shreyo mokShe ca yat param| manaHsamAdhau tat sarvamAyattaM sarvadehinAm||52||
madyena manasashcAsya sa~gkShobhaH kriyate mahAn| mahAmArutavegena taTasthasyeva shAkhinaH||53||
madyaprasa~ggaM taM cAj~jA mahAdoShaM mahAgadam| sukhamityadhigacchanti rajomohaparAjitAH||54||
madyopahatavij~jAnA viyuktAH sAttvikairguNaiH| shreyobhirviprayujyante madAndhA madalAlasAH||55||
madye moho bhayaM shokaH krodho mRutyushca saMshritaH| sonmAdamadamUrcchAyAH sApasmArApatAnakAH||56||
yatraikaH smRutivibhraMshastatra sarvamasAdhuvat| ityevaM madyadoShaj~jA madyaM garhanti yatnataH||57||
satyamete mahAdoShA madyasyoktA na saMshayaH| ahitasyAtimAtrasya pItasya vidhivarjitam||58||
kintu madyaM svabhAvena yathaivAnnaM tathA smRutam| ayuktiyuktaM rogAya yuktiyuktaM yathA~amRutam||59||
prANAH prANabhRutAmannaM tadayuktyA nihantyasUn| viShaM prANaharaM tacca yuktiyuktaM rasAyanam||60||

harShamUrjaM mudaM puShTimArogyaM pauruShaM param | yuktyA pItaM karotyAshu madyaM sukhamadapradam||61||

Commentary: vidhipItamadyaguNAnAha- harShamityAdi| harSham utsAhaM kAyikam| mudamiti manaHsantoSham| pauruShamiti shukram| Ashviti vacanena shIghraM harShAdIni karoti na pariNAmaM yAvadapekShate| sukhamadapradamiti sukhapradamadaM, prathamaM madamiti yAvat| anye tu ‘madasukhapradam’ iti paThanti; tatrApi madasukhaM prathamamadArambha eva||61||
rocanaM dIpanaM hRudyaM svaravarNaprasAdanam| prINanaM bRuMhaNaM balyaM bhayashokashramApaham||62||
svApanaM naShTanidrANAM mUkAnAM vAgvibodhanam| bodhanaM cAtinidrANAM vibaddhAnAM vibandhanut||63||
vadhabandhaparikleshaduHkhAnAM cApyabodhanam| madyotthAnAM ca rogANAM madyameva prabAdhakam||64||
ratirviShayasaMyoge prItisaMyogavardhanam| api pravayasAM madyamutsavAmodakArakam||65||
pa~jcasvartheShu kAnteShu yA ratiH prathame made| yUnAM vA sthavirANAM vA tasya nAstyupamA bhuvi||66||
bahuduHkhahatasyAsya shokenopahatasya ca| vishrAmo jIvalokasya madyaM yuktyA niShevitam||67||
annapAnavayovyAdhibalakAlatrikANi ShaT| trIndoShAMstrividhaM sattvaM j~jAtvA madyaM pibetsadA||68||
teShAM trikANAmaShTAnAM yojanA yuktirucyate| yayA yuktyA pibanmadyaM madyadoShairna yujyate||69||
madyasya ca guNAn sarvAn yathoktAn sa samashnute| dharmArthayorapIDAyai naraH sattvaguNocchritaH||70||
sattvAni tu prabudhyante prAyashaH prathame made| dvitIye~avyaktatAM yAnti madhye cottamamadhyayoH||71||
sasyasambodhakaM varShaM, hemaprakRutidarshakaH| hutAshaH, sarvasattvAnAM madyaM tUbhayakArakam||72||
pradhAnAvaramadhyAnAM rUpANAM vyaktidarshakaH| yathA~agnirevaM sattvAnAM madyaM prakRutidarshakam||73||
sugandhimAlyagandharvaM supraNItamamAkulam| miShTAnnapAnavishadaM sadA madhurasa~gkatham||74||
sukhaprapAnaM sumadaM harShaprItivivardhanam| svantaM sAttvikamApAnaM na cottamamadapradam||75||
vaiguNyaM sahasA yAnti madyadoShairna sAttvikAH| madyaM hi balavatsattvaM gRuhNAti sahasA na tu ||76||
saumyAsaumyakathAprAyaM vishadAvishadaM kShaNAt| citraM rAjasamApannaM prAyeNAsvantakAkulam||77||
harShaprItikathApetamatuShTaM pAnabhojane| sammohakrodhanidrAntamApAnaM tAmasaM smRutam||78||

ApAne sAttvikAn buddhvA tathA rAjasatAmasAn| jahyAtsahAyAn yaiH pItvA madyadoShAnupAshnute||79||

Commentary: yairityanena rAjasatAmasAH pratyavamRushyante, taiH samaM piban tatprasaktyA svayamapyatipiban madyadoShAn dvitIyatRutIyamadadoShAn prApnoti||79||
sukhashIlAH susambhAShAH sumukhAH sammatAH satAm| kalAsvabAhyA vishadA viShayapravaNAshca ye||80||
parasparavidheyA ye yeShAmaikyaM suhRuttayA| praharShaprItimAdhuryairApAnaM vardhayanti ye||81||
utsavAdutsavataraM yeShAmanyonyadarshanam| te sahAyAH sukhAH pAne taiH pibansaha modate||82||
rUpagandharasasparshaiH shabdaishcApi manoramaiH| pibanti susahAyA ye te vai sukRutibhiH samAH||83||
pa~jcabhirviShayairiShTairupetairmanasaH priyaiH| deshe kAle pibenmadyaM prahRuShTenAntarAtmanA||84||
sthirasattvasharIrA ye pUrvAnnA madyapAnvayAH| bahumadyocitA ye ca mAdyanti sahasA na te||85||
kShutpipAsAparItAshca durbalA vAtapaittikAH| rUkShAlpapramitAhArA viShTabdhAH sattvadurbalAH||86||
krodhino~anucitAH kShINAH parishrAntA madakShatAH| svalpenApi madaM shIghraM yAnti madyena mAnavAH||87||
UrdhvaM madAtyayasyAtaH sambhavaM svasvalakShaNam| agnivesha! cikitsAM ca pravakShyAmi yathAkramam||88||
strIshokabhayabhArAdhvakarmabhiryo~atikarshitaH| rUkShAlpapramitAshI ca yaH pibatyatimAtrayA||89||
rUkShaM pariNataM madyaM nishi nidrAM vihatya ca| karoti tasya tacchIghraM vAtaprAyaM madAtyayam||90||
hikkAshvAsashiraHkampapArshvashUlaprajAgaraiH| vidyAdbahupralApasya vAtaprAyaM madAtyayam||91||
tIkShNoShNaM madyamamlaM ca yo~atimAtraM niShevate| amloShNatIkShNabhojI ca krodhano~agnyAtapapriyaH||92||
tasyopajAyate pittAdvisheSheNa madAtyayaH| sa tu vAtolbaNasyAshu prashamaM yAti hanti vA||93||
tRuShNAdAhajvarasvedamUrcchAtIsAravibhramaiH| vidyAddharitavarNasya pittaprAyaM madAtyayam||94||
taruNaM madhuraprAyaM gauDaM paiShTikameva vA| madhurasnigdhagurvAshI yaH pibatyatimAtrayA||95||
avyAyAmadivAsvapnashayyAsanasukhe rataH| madAtyayaM kaphaprAyaM sa shIghramadhigacchati||96||
chardyarocakahRullAsatandrAstaimityagauravaiH| vidyAcchItaparItasya kaphaprAyaM madAtyayam||97||

yonisaMskAranAmAdyairvisheShairbahudhA ca yA| bhUtvA bhavatyekavidhA sAmAnyAnmadalakShaNAt||6||

Commentary: yonItyAdau visheShashabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| yoniH kAraNaM, tadvisheShAH- dhAnyaphalamUlasArapuShpapatrakANDatvacaH sharkarAnavamAH sUtrasthAnoktAH| saMskAro~api bahuprakArasaMskArayogaH| nAmavisheShAH surAmadhumaireyAdayaH| AdigrahaNAt prabhAvaguNAdInAM grahaNam| mado lakShaNaM yasya tasmAnmadalakShaNAt sAmAnyAt madyasvarUpAt||6||
viShasya ye guNA dRuShTAH sannipAtaprakopaNAH| ta eva madye dRushyante viShe tu balavattarAH||98||
hantyAshu hi viShaM ki~jcit ki~jcidrogAya kalpate| yathA viShaM tathaivAntyo j~jeyo madyakRuto madaH||99||
tasmAt tridoShajaM li~ggaM sarvatrApi madAtyaye| dRushyate rUpavaisheShyAt pRuthaktvaM cAsya lakShyate||100||
sharIraduHkhaM balavat sammoho hRudayavyathA| aruciH pratatA tRuShNA jvaraH shItoShNalakShaNaH||101||
shiraHpArshvAsthisandhInAM vidyuttulyA ca vedanA| jAyate~atibalA jRumbhA sphuraNaM vepanaM shramaH||102||
urovibandhaH kAsashca hikkA shvAsaH prajAgaraH| sharIrakampaH karNAkShimukharogastrikagrahaH||103||
chardyatIsArahRullAsA vAtapittakaphAtmakAH| bhramaH pralApo rUpANAmasatAM caiva darshanam||104||
tRuNabhasmalatAparNapAMshubhishcAvapUraNam| pradharShaNaM viha~ggaishca bhrAntacetAH sa manyate||105||
vyAkulAnAmashastAnAM svapnAnAM darshanAni ca| madAtyayasya rUpANi sarvANyetAni lakShayet||106||
sarvaM madAtyayaM vidyAt tridoShamadhikaM tu yam| doShaM madAtyaye pashyet tasyAdau pratikArayet||107||
kaphasthAnAnupUrvyA ca kriyA kAryA madAtyaye| pittamArutaparyantaH prAyeNa hi madAtyayaH||108||
mithyAtihInapItena yo vyAdhirupajAyate| samapItena tenaiva sa madyenopashAmyati||109||
jIrNAmamadyadoShAya madyameva pradApayet| prakA~gkShAlAghave jAte yadyadasmai hitaM bhavet||110||
sauvarcalAnusaMviddhaM shItaM sabiDasaindhavam| mAtulu~ggArdrakopetaM jalayuktaM pramANavit ||111||
tIkShoShNenAtimAtreNa pItenAmlavidAhinA| madyenAnnarasotkledo vidagdhaH kShAratAM gataH||112||
antardAhaM jvaraM tRuShNAM pramohaM vibhramaM madam| janayatyAshu tacchAntyai madyameva pradApayet||113||
kShAro hi yAti mAdhuryaM shIghramamlopasaMhitaH| shreShThamamleShu madyaM ca yairguNaistAn paraM shRuNu||114||
madyasyAmlasvabhAvasya catvAro~anurasAH smRutAH| madhurashca kaShAyashca tiktaH kaTuka eva ca||115||
guNAshca dasha pUrvoktAstaishcaturdashabhirguNaiH| sarveShAM madyamamlAnAmuparyupari tiShThati||116||
madyotkliShTena doSheNa ruddhaH srotaHsu mArutaH| karoti vedanAM tIvrAM shirasyasthiShu sandhiShu||117||
doShaviShyandanArthaM hi tasmai madyaM visheShataH| vyavAyitIkShNoShNatayA deyamamle(nye)Shu satsvapi||118||
srotovibandhanunmadyaM mArutasyAnulomanam| rocanaM dIpanaM cAgnerabhyAsAt sAtmyameva ca||119||
rujaH srotaHsvaruddheShu mArute cAnulomite| nivartante vikArAshca shAmyantyasya madodayAH||120||
bIjapUrakavRukShAmlakoladADimasaMyutam| yavAnIhapuShAjAjIshRu~ggaverAvacUrNitam||121||
sasnehaiH shaktubhiryuktamavadaMshairvirocitam | dadyAt salavaNaM madyaM paiShTikaM vAtashAntaye||122||
dRuShTvA vAtolbaNaM li~ggaM rasaishcainamupAcaret| lAvatittiradakShANAM snigdhAmlaiH shikhinAmapi||123||
pakShiNAM mRugamatsyAnAmAnUpAnAM ca saMskRutaiH| bhUshayaprasahAnAM ca rasaiH shAlyodanena ca||124||
snigdhoShNalavaNAmlaishca veshavArairmukhapriyaiH| citrairgaudhUmikaishcAnnairvAruNImaNDasaMyutaiH ||125||
pishitArdrakagarbhAbhiH snigdhAbhiH pUpavartibhiH| mAShapUpalikAbhishca vAtikaM samupAcaret||126||
nAtisnigdhaM na cAmlena yuktaM samaricArdrakam| medyaM prAguditaM mAMsaM dADimasvarasena vA||127||
pRuthaktrijAtakopetaM sadhAnyamaricArdrakam| rasapralepi sampUpaiH sukhoShNaiH sampradApayet||128||
bhukte tu vAruNImaNDaM dadyAt pAtuM pipAsave| dADimasya rasaM vA~api jalaM vA pA~jcamUlikam||129||
dhAnyanAgaratoyaM ca dadhimaNDamathApi vA| amlakA~jjikamaNDaM vA shuktodakamathApi vA||130||
karmaNA~anena siddhena vikAra upashAmyati| mAtrAkAlaprayuktena balaM varNashca vardhate||131||
rAgaShADavasaMyogairvividhairbhaktarocanaiH| pishitaiH shAkapiShTAnnairyavagodhUmashAlibhiH||132||
abhya~ggotsAdanaiH snAnairuShNaiH prAvaraNairghanaiH| ghanairagurupa~gkaishca dhUpaishcAgurujairghanaiH||133||
nArINAM yauvanoShNAnAM nirdayairupagUhanaiH| shroNyUrukucabhAraishca saMrodhoShNasukhAvahaiH||134||
shayanAcchAdanairuShNairuShNaishcAntargRuhaiH sukhaiH| mArutaprabalaH shIghraM prashAmyati madAtyayaH||135||
bhavyakharjUramRudvIkAparUShakarasairyutam | sadADimarasaM shItaM saktubhishcAvacUrNitam||136||
sasharkaraM shArkaraM vA mArdvIkamathavA~aparam| dadyAdbahUdakaM kAle pAtuM pittamadAtyaye||137||
shashAn kapi~jjalAneNA@mllAvAnasitapucchakAn| madhurAmlAn prayu~jjIta bhojane shAliShaShTikAn||138||
paTolayUShamishraM vA chAgalaM kalpayedrasam| satInamudgamishraM vA dADimAmalakAnvitam||139||
drAkShAmalakakharjUraparUShakarasena vA| kalpayettarpaNAn yUShAn rasAMshca vividhAtmakAn||140||
AmAshayasthamutkliShTaM kaphapittaM madAtyaye| vij~jAya bahudoShasya dahyamAnasya tRuShyataH||141||
madyaM drAkShArasaM toyaM dattvA tarpaNameva vA| niHsheShaM vAmayecchIghramevaM rogAdvimucyate||142||
kAle punastarpaNAdyaM kramaM kuryAt prakA~gkShite| tenAgnirdIpyate tasya doShasheShAnnapAcakaH||143||
kAse saraktaniShThIve pArshvastanarujAsu ca| tRuShyate savidAhe ca sotkleshe hRudayorasi||144||
guDUcIbhadramustAnAM paTolasyAthavA bhiShak| rasaM sanAgaraM dadyAt tittiripratibhojanam ||145||
tRuShyate cAtibalavadvAtapitte samuddhate| dadyAddrAkShArasaM pAtuM shItaM doShAnulomanam||146||
jIrNe samadhurAmlena chAgamAMsarasena tam| bhojanaM bhojayenmadyamanutarShaM ca pAyayet||147||
anutarShasya mAtrA sA yayA no dUShyate manaH| tRuShyate madyamalpAlpaM pradeyaM syAdbahUdakam||148||
tRuShNA yenopashAmyeta madaM yena ca nApnuyAt| parUShakANAM pIlUnAM rasaM shItamathApi vA||149||
parNinInAM catasRUNAM pibedvA shishiraM jalam| mustadADimalAjAnAM tRuShNAghnaM vA pibedrasam||150||
koladADimavRukShAmlacukrIkAcukrikArasaH| pa~jcAmlako mukhAlepaH sadyastRuShNAM niyacchati||151||
shItalAnyannapAnAni shItashayyAsanAni ca| shItavAtajalasparshAH shItAnyupavanAni ca||152||
kShaumapadmotpalAnAM ca maNInAM mauktikasya ca| candanodakashItAnAM sparshAshcandrAMshushItalAH||153||
hemarAjatakAMsyAnAM pAtrANAM shItavAribhiH| pUrNAnAM himapUrNAnAM dRutInAM pavanAhatAH||154||
saMsparshAshcandanArdrANAM nArINAM ca samArutAH| candanAnAM ca mukhyAnAM shastAH pittamadAtyaye ||155||
shItavIryaM yadanyacca tat sarvaM viniyojayet| kumudotpalapatrANAM siktAnAM candanAmbunA||156||
hitAH sparshA manoj~jAnAM dAhe madyasamutthite| kathAshca vividhAH shastAH shabdAshca shikhinAM shivAH||157||
toyadAnAM ca shabdA hi shamayanti madAtyayam| jalayantrAbhivarShINi vAtayantravahAni ca||158||
kalpanIyAni bhiShajA dAhe dhArAgRuhANi ca| phalinIsevyalodhrAmbuhemapatraM kuTannaTam||159||
kAlIyakarasopetaM dAhe shastaM pralepanam| badarIpallavotthashca tathaivAriShTakodbhavaH||160||
phenilAyAshca yaH phenastairdAhe lepanaM shubham| surA samaNDA dadhyamlaM mAtulu~ggaraso madhu||161||
seke pradehe shasyante dAhaghnAH sAmlakA~jjikAH| pariShekAvagAheShu vya~jjanAnAM ca sevane||162||
shasyate shishiraM toyaM dAhatRuShNAprashAntaye| mAtrAkAlaprayuktena karmaNA~anena shAmyati ||163||
ullekhanopavAsAbhyAM jayet kaphamadAtyayam||164||
tRuShyate salilaM cAsmai dadyAddhrIberasAdhitam| balayA pRushniparNyA vA kaNTakAryA~athavA shRutam||165||
sanAgarAbhiH sarvAbhirjalaM vA shRutashItalam| duHsparshena samustena mustaparpaTakena vA||166||
jalaM mustaiH shRutaM vA~api dadyAddoShavipAcanam| etadeva ca pAnIyaM sarvatrApi madAtyaye||167||
niratyayaM pIyamAnaM pipAsAjvaranAshanam| nirAmaM kA~gkShitaM kAle sakShaudraM pAyayettu tam||168||
shArkaraM madhu vA jIrNamariShTaM sIdhumeva vA| rUkShatarpaNasaMyuktaM yavAnInAgarAnvitam||169||
yAvagaudhUmikaM cAnnaM rUkShayUSheNa bhojayet| kulatthAnAM sushuShkANAM mUlakAnAM rasena vA||170||
tanunA~alpena laghunA kaTvamlenAlpasarpiShA| paTolayUShamamlaM vA yUShamAmalakasya vA||171||
prabhUtakaTusaMyuktaM sayavAnnaM pradApayet| vyoShayUShamathAmlaM vA yUShaM vA sAmlavetasam||172||
chAgamAMsarasaM rUkShamamlaM vA jA~ggalaM rasam| sthAlyAM vA~atha kapAle vA bhRuShTaM nirdravavartitam ||173||
kaTvamlalavaNaM mAMsaM bhakShayan vRuNuyAnmadhu| vyaktamArIcakaM mAMsaM mAtulu~ggarasAnvitam||174||
prabhUtakaTusaMyuktaM yavAnInAgarAnvitam| bhRuShTaM dADimasArAmlamuShNapUpopaveShTitam||175||
yathAgni bhakShayet kAle prabhUtArdrakapeshikam| pibecca nigadaM madyaM kaphaprAye madAtyaye||176||
sauvarcalamajAjI ca vRukShAmlaM sAmlavetasam| tvagelAmaricArdhAMshaM sharkarAbhAgayojitam||177||
etallavaNamaShTA~ggamagnisandIpanaM param| madAtyaye kaphaprAye dadyAt srotovishodhanam||178||
etadeva punaryuktyA madhurAmlairdravIkRutam| godhUmAnnayavAnnAnAM mAMsAnAM cAtirocanam||179||
peShayet kaTukairyuktAM shvetAM bIjavivarjitAm| mRudvIkAM mAtulu~ggasya dADimasya rasena vA||180||
sauvarcalailAmaricairajAjIbhRu~ggadIpyakaiH| sa rAgaH kShaudrasaMyuktaH shreShTho rocanadIpanaH ||181||
mRudvIkAyA vidhAnena kArayet kAravImapi| shuktamatsyaNDikopetaM rAgaM dIpanapAcanam||182||
AmrAmalakapeshInAM rAgAn kuryAt pRuthak pRuthak| dhAnyasauvarcalAjAjIkAravImaricAnvitAn||183||
guDena madhuyuktena vyaktAmlalavaNIkRutAn| tairannaM rocate digdhaM samyagbhuktaM ca jIryati||184||
rUkShoShNenAnnapAnena snAnenAshishireNa ca| vyAyAmala~gghanAbhyAM ca yuktyA jAgaraNena ca||185||
kAlayuktena rUkSheNa snAnenodvartanena ca| prANavarNakarANAM ca pragharShANAM ca sevayA||186||
sevayA vasanAnAM ca gurUNAmagurorapi| sa~gkocoShNasukhA~ggInAma~gganAnAM ca sevayA||187||
sukhashikShitahastAnAM strINAM saMvAhanena ca| madAtyayaH kaphaprAyaH shIghramevopashAmyati||188||
yadidaM karma nirdiShTaM pRuthagdoShabalaM prati| sannipAte dashavidhe tadvikalpyaM bhiShagvidA||189||
yastu doShavikalpaj~jo yashcauShadhivikalpavit| sa sAdhyAnsAdhayedvyAdhIn sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgavit||190||

yA devAnamRutaM bhUtvA svadhA bhUtvA pittRUMshca yA| somo bhUtvA dvijAtIn yA yu~gkte shreyobhiruttamaiH||7||

Commentary: amRutaM bhUtvetyAdau surAdhiShThAtrI devatA amRutAdirUpeNa devAdIn tarpayatIti darshayati| shreyobhiriti mahatkalyANaiH||7||
vanAni ramaNIyAni sapadmAH salilAshayAH| vishadAnyannapAnAni sahAyAshca praharShaNAH||191||
mAlyAni gandhayogAshca vAsAMsi vimalAni ca| gAndharvashabdAH kAntAshca goShThyashca hRudayapriyAH||192||
sa~gkathAhAsyagItAnAM vishadAshcaiva yojanAH| priyAshcAnugatA nAryo nAshayanti madAtyayam||193||
nAkShobhya hi mano madyaM sharIramavihatya ca| kuryAnmadAtyayaM tasmAdeShTavyA harShaNI kriyA||194||
AbhiH kriyAbhiH siddhAbhiH shamaM yAti madAtyayaH| na cenmadyavidhiM muktvA kShIramasya prayojayet||195||
la~gghanaiH pAcanairdoShashodhanaiH shamanairapi| vimadyasya kaphe kShINe jAte daurbalyalAghave||196||
tasya madyavidagdhasya vAtapittAdhikasya ca| grIShmopataptasya taroryathA varShaM tathA payaH||197||
payasA~abhihRute roge bale jAte nivartayet| kShIraprayogaM madyaM ca krameNAlpAlpamAcaret||198||
vicchinnamadyaH sahasA yo~atimadyaM niShevate| dhvaMsako vikShayashcaiva rogastasyopajAyate||199||
vyAdhyupakShINadehasya dushcikitsyatamau hi tau| tayorli~ggaM cikitsA ca yathAvadupadekShyate||200||
shleShmaprasekaH kaNThAsyashoShaH shabdAsahiShNutA| tandrAnidrAtiyogashca j~jeyaM dhvaMsakalakShaNam||201||
hRutkaNTharogaH sammohashchardira~ggarujA jvaraH| tRuShNA kAsaH shiraHshUlametadvikShayalakShaNam||202||
tayoH karma tadeveShTaM vAtike yanmadAtyaye| tau hi prakShINadehasya jAyete durbalasya vai||203||
bastayaH sarpiShaH pAnaM prayogaH kShIrasarpiShoH| abhya~ggodvartanasnAnAnyannapAnaM ca vAtanut||204||
dhvaMsako vikShayashcaiva karmaNA~anena shAmyati| yuktamadyasya madyottho na vyAdhirupajAyate||205||

nivRuttaH sarvamadyebhyo naro yashca jitendriyaH| shArIramAnasairdhImAn vikArairna sa yujyate||206||

Commentary: sarvathA madyaparityAgaphalamAha- nivRutta ityAdi| jitendriya iti visheShaNaM madyanivRuttAveva prayojakam| shArIramAnasairvikArairiti yogyatayA madyavyApattijanyaireva shArIramAnasairvikAraiH; anyahetujA~j shArIramAnasavikArAn prati madyanivRuttiraki~jcitkarIti bhAvaH| na yujyata iti shArIramAnasavikArairmadyanivRuttyA na yukto bhavati||206||
tatra shlokAH- yatprabhAvA bhagavatI surA peyA yathA ca sA| yaddravyA yasya yA ceShTA yogaM cApekShate yathA||207||
yathA madayate yaishca guNairyuktA mahAguNA| yo mado madabhedAshca ye trayaH svasvalakShaNAH||208||
ye ca madyakRutA doShA guNA ye ca madAtmakAH| yacca trividhamApAnaM yathAsattvaM ca lakShaNam||209||
ye sahAyAH sukhAH pAne cirakShipramadA narAH| madAtyayasya yo heturlakShaNaM yad yathA ca yat||210||
madyaM madyotthitAn rogAn hanti yashca kriyAkramaH| sarvaM taduktamakhilaM madAtyayacikitsite||211||
AshvinaM yA mahattejo balaM sArasvataM ca yA| vIryamaindraM ca yA siddhA somaH sautrAmaNau ca yA||8||
shokAratibhayodveganAshinI yA mahAbalA| yA prItiryA ratiryA vAgyA puShTiryA ca nirvRutiH||9||
yA surA suragandharvayakSharAkShasamAnuShaiH| ratiH suretyabhihitA tAM surAM vidhinA pibet||10||
sharIrakRutasaMskAraH shuciruttamagandhavAn| prAvRuto nirmalairvastrairyathartUddAmagandhibhiH||11||
vicitravividhasragvI ratnAbharaNabhUShitaH| devadvijAtIn sampUjya spRuShTvA ma~ggalamuttamam||12||
deshe yathartuke shaste kusumaprakarIkRute| sarasAsammate mukhye dhUpasammodabodhite||13||
sopadhAne susaMstIrNe vihite shayanAsane| upaviShTo~athavA tiryak svasharIrasukhe sthitaH||14||
sauvarNai rAjataishcApi tathA maNimayairapi| bhAjanairvimalaishcAnyaiH sukRutaishca pibet sadA||15||
rUpayauvanamattAbhiH shikShitAbhirvisheShataH| vastrAbharaNamAlyaishca bhUShitAbhiryathartukaiH||16||
shaucAnurAgayuktAbhiH pramadAbhiritastataH| saMvAhyamAna iShTAbhiH pibenmadyamanuttamam||17||
madyAnukUlairvividhaiH phalairharitakaiH shubhaiH| lavaNairgandhapishunairavadaMshairyathartukaiH||18||
bhRuShTairmAMsairbahuvidhairbhUjalAmbaracAriNAm| paurogavargavihitairbhakShyaishca vividhAtmakaiH||19||
pUjayitvA surAn pUrvamAshiShaH prAk prayujya ca| pradAya sajalaM madyamarthibhyo vasudhAtale||20||
abhya~ggotsAdanasnAnavAsodhUpAnulepanaiH| snigdhoShNairbhAvitashcAnnairvAtiko madyamAcaret||21||
shItopacArairvividhairmadhurasnigdhashItalaiH| paittiko bhAvitashcAnnaiH pibanmadyaM na sIdati||22||
upacArairashishirairyavagodhUmabhuk pibet| shlaiShmiko dhanvajairmAMsairmadyaM mAricakaiH saha||23||
vidhirvasumatAmeSha bhaviShyadvibhavAshca ye| yathopapatti tairmadyaM pAtavyaM mAtrayA hitam||24||
vAtikebhyo hitaM madyaM prAyo gauDikapaiShTikam| kaphapittAdhikebhyastu mArdvIkaM mAdhavaM ca yat||25||
bahudravyaM bahuguNaM bahukarma madAtmakam| guNairdoShaishca tanmadyamubhayaM copalakShyate||26||
vidhinA mAtrayA kAle hitairannairyathAbalam| prahRuShTo yaH pibenmadyaM tasya syAdamRutaM yathA||27||
yathopetaM punarmadyaM prasa~ggAdyena pIyate| rUkShavyAyAmanityena viShavadyAti tasya tat||28||
mohajanakatvasAmAnyAt tathA viShasamAnaguNajanyatvAcca viShacikitsitamanu madAtyayasya cikitsitamucyate||1-2||

madyaM yathA madayati tathA prAha- madyamityAdi| dashabhiriti laghvAdibhirguNaiH, dashApi gurvAdInojoguNAn sa~gkShobhya, na dvitrAdikaiH, ceto vikriyAM nayati vikRutaM karoti| yena guNena madyasya ojoguNakShobho bhavati tadAha- gurutvaM lAghavAdityAdi| prasAdaM cAshubhAvanAditi prasAdAkhyaguNamAshugatvAddhanti; AshugatvaM ca yadyapi prasAdaviruddhaM na bhavati, tathA~api madyameva pratikUlatayA ojaHprasAdaM hanti, tatrAshuguNa Ahanane vyApriyata iti j~jeyam| vyavAyitvAt sthiratvamiti vyavAyitvaM vyApakatvaM, tacca sthiratvaM tadviparItatvAdeva hanti; AshugatvavyavAyitvayoshcAyaM visheShaH- yadAshugaM shIghraM gacchati, vyavAyi tu sarvavyApakam| vikAsitvaM vikasanashIlatvaM saratvamiti yAvat; tacca shlakShNaviparItatvAdeva shlakShNatAM hanti| sAndratA ghanatA| ete vikAsitvAshugatvAdayo guNA yadyapi viMshatiguNagaNanAyAM na paThitAstathA~apyasa~gkhyeyatvAdguNAnAmeShAmapi guNatvaM siddhaM; ye tu tatra paThitAste tAvadAviShkRutatamA j~jeyAH| AshrayopaghAtAdAshritopaghAto bhavatIti darshayannAha- sattvamityAdi| sattvasya ca oja AshrayaH, oja upakAryam; yathA- rAjAshritaH puruShaH| rasavAtetyAdi| rasavAtAdivahAnAM dashadhamanInAM hRudayaM sthAnaM, rasavahA eva yA dasha dhamanyo hRudayAshrayA uktAstA eva vAtAdivahAH| yaduktaM “vAtapittashleShmaNAM sarvasharIracarANAM sarvANi srotAMsyayanabhUtAni” (vi.a.5) iti; raktAdInAM tu sarvasharIracarANAmapi visheSheNa hRudayaM sthAnamuktaM- “ShaDa~ggama~ggaM vij~jAnamindriyANyarthapa~jcakam| AtmA ca saguNashcetashcintyaM ca hRudi saMshritam” (sU.a.30) iti| dhAtava iti sattvabuddhIndriyAdayaH||29-36||

madyaM ceto vikriyAM nayatItyutsargavidheH prathamamade~apavAdamAha- ojasyavihate ityAdi| hRudayAshritabuddhyAdau pratibodhite, hRudayashabdeneha tatsthopacArAddhRudayAshritA buddhyAdayo~abhidhIyante, yathA- ma~jcAH kroshantIti; buddhyAdibodhanaM prathamamadakAryaM madyasya prabhAvAt| madhyamottamamadopapattisAmagrImAha- madhyama ityAdi| vihate iti vighAte; ojasaH alpe vighAte madhyamo mado bhavati| vihate iti visheSheNa atyarthaM hate, uttama iti tRutIyaH||37-38||
hRudItyAdinA sAmAnyena madalakShaNamAha| tarShaH abhilAShaH| yathAsattvamiti prakRutyA rAjase sattve rAjasAH, tAmase ca tAmasAH| citrA iti nAnAprakArAH| mohanidrAntA iti mohanidrAvasAnAH||39-40||

prathamAdimadAnAM lakShaNamAha- praharShaNa ityAdi| pAnAnnaguNadarshaka iti pAnAnnaguNAn samyagbodhayatItyarthaH| viShayeShviti viShayasevAsu, na cAkShama iti nAkShamatAkara ityarthaH| yuktAyuktapralApa iti sambaddhAsambaddhavacanaH| pracalAyanaM ghUrNanam| yojanA saviparyayeti sthAnAdInAM samyagyojanA kadAcidbhavati, kadAcicca sthAnAdiyojanAviparyayo~asamyagyojanArUpo bhavatItyarthaH| madhyamaM madamutkramyetyAdi| yadyapi trividho mada uktaH, tathA~api dvitIyamadAvasAne tRutIyamadAprAptyavasthAyA eva atyarthanindyatAM darshayan tRutIyamadasyAtyantanindyatAM darshayati; yena tasya tRutIyamadasya pUrvarUpAvasthaiva sarvAshubhakaraNAdihetutayA nitAntaM nindyeti bhAvaH| iyaM ca madhyamadAtikramatRutIyamadAprAptishabdAbhidheyA~apyavasthA madhyamamadAntatRutIyamadAdyarUpAvasthAbhidhAyikaiva; yathA- “kumbhamInayormadhye yadA carati candramA” ityatra madhyepadena kumbhAntamInAdirevocyate, paramArthatastayormadhyasyAbhAvAt; tathehApi paramArthato~anyamadakAlAbhAvAd dvitIyAntatRutIyamadAdyabhidhAnamevAtra tRutIyamadAtyarthanindArthaM, na caturthamadopadarshanam| asvantamiti ashobhanAntam| bhagnadArviveti bhagnavRukSha iva patitastiShThati| udarkam uttarakAlam| sa duHkhaM vyAdhimiti madAtyayam||41-51||

surairityAdinA madirAstutyA tathA vakShyamANanindayA vidhinA pIyamAnasurAyAH shubhaphalamavidhipAnAccAtyarthaninditaphalavattvaM darshayati| yA purA paripUjitetyanena prathamaM devaireveyaM paripUjitA, tataH surayogAt sureti copadiShTeti darshayati| sautrAmaNiH surAhaviryaj~jAntarniviShTo yaj~javisheShaH; tasyAM hUyate surA| karmibhiryA pratiShThiteti yAj~jikairabhiShavaNAdibhiH pratiShThitA pratiShThAM prApitA| yaj~jaM vahatIti yaj~jauhI; anena ca laukikayaj~jAntarANyapi surayA kriyanta ityucyate; sautrAmaNihome tu tasyA eva pradhAnA~ggatocyate| shakrashca somAtipatita iti ‘shakro~atipItena somena kShapitabalo nirojasko nirvIryIbhUtaH sa kila punarApyAyya nijaM vIryamApAditaH’ ityeShA shrutiH; atipAnena patitaH atipatitaH | prakalpyA iti abhiShotavyA sandhAnAyeti yAvat| yaj~jIyA yaj~jasiddhaya iti yaj~javidhau kAnicit kratvarthAni yUpabarhyAdIni, kAnicittu puruShArthAni vAsagarbhAdIni, kAnicid yaj~jArthAni puruShArthAni ca yathA sarpiriShTakAdIni, tadiha surA ‘yaj~jIyA’ ityanena vAsanAdivat ‘puruShArthA’ ityucyate, yaj~jasiddhaye bhavatItyanena yUpAdivad yaj~jArthatvaM surAyA ucyate||3-5||

pretya cehetyAdinA ekIyamataM madyanindakaM darshayati| pretyeti janmAntare| taTasthasyeti vacanena vAtAkShobhyatAM darshayati| satyamityAdinA svamatamAha| ete doShAH madyasyaikIyamatoktA ahitAdidharmayuktasyaiva bhavanti, na hitAlpamAtravidhipItasyeti bhAvaH| vidhivarjitamiti kriyAvisheShaNam| madyasyAnnasArUpyadarshanena vidhivadupayoge guNavattAmavidhyupayoge ca doShavattAmAha- kintvityAdi| yuktyA deshakAlamAtrAdyapekShayA yojanayA yuktaM shubham, ashubhaM cAyuktiyuktam| yukteranvayavyatirekAbhyAM kAryamAha- prANA ityAdi| prANahetutvAt prANAH| ayuktiyuktamiti avidhiprayuktam| yuktiyuktaM rasAyanamiti yathA “viShasya tu tilaM dadyAt” (ci.a.1) ityAdiprayoge tilamAnasya rasAyanatvaM, tathA j~jeyam||52-60||

rocanamityAdinA madyaguNAnAha| svApanaM naShTanidrANAM tathA bodhanaM cAtinidrANAmiti kAryadvayakaraNamucitanidrAkaratvaprabhAvAdeva; kiMvA naShTanidrANAM nidrAbhighAtahetvaticintanAdivismArakatayA nidrAkaraM bhavati, atinidrANAM nidrAhetumanovahasrotorodhAdihantRutayA prabodhakaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| madyotthAnAM ca rogANAM madyameva prabAdhakamiti hetuviparItArthakAritAprabhAvAdityarthaH| ratiriti ratikArakamityarthaH| viShayasaMyoge prItisaMyogavardhanamiti viShayANAM shabdAdInAM saMyoge prItiM saMyogaM ca vardhayati; pItamadyo yadA viShayaiH shabdAdibhiH saMyujyate tadA teShvapi prItimAn bhavati, prItashca sukhAkA~gkShI san punasteShu saMyujyate| pravayasAmiti vRuddhAnAm| utsavaH autsukyaM viShayAbhilASha iti yAvat, Amodo harShaH| nanu viShaye svabhAvAdeva prItirbhavati, tat kiM madyena kriyate? ityAsha~gkya prathamamadasya vishiShTaratikartRutvamAha- pa~jcasvityAdi| ratishceha atyarthasukhajanakatvAdevopAdeyeti vij~jeyam| vishrAma iti duHkhArtavishrAmahetuH| jIvaloka iti jIvamAnalokaH ||62-67||

yuktyA niShevitamityatroktAM madyapAnayuktimAha- annapAnetyAdi| tatrAnnaM trividhaM vAtapittakaphakaram, evaM pAnamapi trividhaM, bAlyAdibhedAdvayo~api trividhaM, vyAdhirapi mRudumadhyatIvrabhedena trividhaH, kiMvA saumyAgneyavAyavyabhedena trividhaH, balaM pravarAvaramadhyabhedAttrividhaM, kAlastu shItoShNavarShAlakShaNastrividhaH, trividhaM sattvaM shuddhaM rAjasaM tAmasaM ca| yojaneti samyagyojanArUpA| yuktiM phalenAvadhArayati- yayA yuktyetyAdinA| sattvaguNocchrito madyaguNAn samashnute iti yojyam| tatrAnnApekShayA yuktiryathA- vAtakaramannamupayujya vAtaharaM madyaM peyam, evaM pittakarakaphakaratve~api pittakaphaharAnnopayogaH| evaM pAnAdyapekShayA~api yojanA vyAkhyAtA bhavati| vayastrike~api bAlye sthavire ca tIkShNaM madyaM na peyaM, yauvane tu tIkShNamapIti| vyAdhyapekShayA~api yojanA yathA- mRuduvyAdhau tIkShNoShNaM, uShNe ca shItamadhuraM, varShAkAle tu snigdhaM dIpanaM ca madyam| doShabhedena tu madyaM vAte snigdhoShNaM gauDikAdi, pitte shItamadhuraM shArkarAdi, kaphe rUkShatIkShNaM mAdhavAdi| uktaM hi- “vAtikebhyo hitaM madyaM prAyo gauDikapaiShTikam| kaphapittAdhikebhyastu phAlamAdhavashArkaram” iti| doShagrahaNenaiva vAtalAdiprakRutirapi gRuhItA| sattvabhedenApi sAttvikena tu bahvapi madyaM pAtavyaM, rAjasatAmasaistu svalpameva| sattvAnIti manAMsi| avyaktatAm IShadvyaktatAM, madhye cAvyaktatAM yAntItyarthaH, uttame tu sarvathA~apyavyaktaM bhavatIti bhAvaH| kecittu ‘sasyasambodhakaM varShaM’ ityAdi shlokaM paThanti| tatra hemaprakRutidarshako hutAsho yathA suvarNasya shuddhAshuddhatAM darshayati, tathA madyaM tUbhayakArakamiti manaHprabodhakaM manoguNadarshakaM ca| rUpANAmiti hemarUpANAM; kiMvA ‘rukmANAM’ iti pAThaH| vyaktidarshaka iti AkAradarshakaH||68-73||

sAttvikAdibhedena pAnaM trividhamAha- sugandhItyAdi| shobhano gandho yasya tat sugandhi, gandharvaH gAnam| shobhano~anto yasya tat svantam| sumadamiti samamadam| na cottamamadapradamiti nottamamadakaraM, kadAcidapi madyapAnAttRutIyamadAsha~gkA na bhavati; uttamamadaH sAttvike na bhavatItyarthaH| uttamamadAprAptau hetumAha- vaiguNyamityAdi| sattvasaMyogAditi sattvAkhyaguNayogAt; sattvAkhyo hi guNaH prakAshakatayA na madena mohakenAbhibhUyata iti bhAvaH| etadevAha- sahasetyAdi| rAjasapAnamAha- saumyAsaumyetyAdi| saumyakathA saumyasambandhA, tadviparItA asaumyA| vishadAvishadamiti prasannAprasannam| citramiti sambaddhAsambaddhavAkyAdiyogAnnAnAprakArakam| tathetyAdinA tAmasamAha| sammohaH krodho nidrA ca ante yasya tat sammohakrodhanidrAntam||74-78||

upAdeyAn sAttvikAnAha- sukhashIlA ityAdi| sumukhA iti priyAkArAH| vishadA iti avAmAH| ApAnaM vardhayantIti ApAne prasAdaM vardhayanti na pAnaprasaktiM vardhayantItyarthaH, tasyA ninditatvAt| manoramairityatra ‘sAdhIyAMsaiH’ iti sheShaH| sukRutibhiH samA iti evambhUtapAnasya sukRutilabhyatvAt| sthirasattvetyAdau pUrvAnnA iti madyapAnAt pUrvamupayuktAnnAH| madyapAnvayA iti madyapavaMshajAH, teShAM madyapAnaM madyasAtmyatvAdeva na vikArakaraM bhavati, viShakanyAyA viShamiva||80-87||

madyapAnadoShaguNAnabhidhAya madAtyayAn hetvAdibhirAha- UrdhvamityAdi| sambhavamiti kAraNam| vAtaprAyamityAdau prAyaHshabdenAdhikavAcinA vakShyamANAnAM sarvamadAtyayAnAM tridoShajanyatvaM darshayati| sa tu vAtetyAdau sa tviti paittikaH; vAtolbaNasya paitto madAtyayo vAtapittasaMyogakRutatayA bAhya ivAgnirvAyuyuktaH shIghrakArI bhavati| tatreyaM vyavasthA- yatra sadyaHphalA kriyA tatra shIghrameva shAmyati, akriyAyAM ca shIghraM hanti, sha~gkhakarohiNyAdivat||88-97||

madyasya tridoShakaratve hetumAha- viShasyetyAdi| yadyapi madyamamlaM, viShaM tvavyaktamadhuraM, tathA~api bahuguNasAmAnyAt ta eva madye dRushyanta ityuktam| tathaivAntyo mada iti prANaharo rogakarashcetyarthaH| pRuthaktvamiti vAtikatvAdinA pArthakyam||98-100||

sharIraduHkhamityAdinA sarvamadAtyayasya sAmAnyaM lakShaNaM brUte, kiMvA tridoShamadAtyayasyaiva lakShaNaM; yato rogasa~ggrahe vAtapittakaphasannipAtaishcatvAro madA uktAH| “yashca madyamadaH prokto viShajo raudhirashca yaH| sarva ete madA narte vAtapittakaphatrayAt” (sU.a.24) ityanena madasya vAtAdijatvena cAturvidhyamuktam| tena madAtyayasya cAturvidhyaM madacAturvidhyAt; yato mada eva Atyayiko madAtyaya iti nirucyate| vidyuttulyeti vidyudvatkShaNasthAyinI| sphuraNaM ki~jcitkampanaM, vepanamekadeshe vyaktakampanam||101-106||

utkleshavisheSheNa cikitsAmAha- sarvamityAdi| samasarvadoShe cikitsAmAha- kaphasthAnetyAdi| kaphasthAnAnupUrvyA cAtra cikitsA kaphasthAnodbhUtatayA prathamaM kaphasambandhAt sannipAtajvara iva j~jeyA| Adau kaphaprabalatAmevAha- pittamArutaparyanta iti; anena cArthAt kaphAditvaM lambhayati| samapItena tenaiveti yajjAtIyena madyena madAtyayo janitaH nitarAM tajjAtIyenaiva shAmyati| yathA viShaM maulaM daMShTrIyeNa shAmyati, tathA madyamapi vijAtIyena madyena shAmyatItyeke; kintu tenaivetyanena tAmeva madyajAtiM pratyavamRushati, tenAvashyaM tajjAtIyameva madyaM j~jeyam| yato~anantaraM vakShyati- ‘yacca yasmai hitaM bhavet’ iti| tathA ‘dadyAt salavaNaM madyaM paiShTikaM vAtashAntaye’ ityanena yena kenacinmadyenodbhUte vAtamadAtyaye paiShTikamuktaM, tathA ‘sasharkaraM shArkaraM vA’ ityAdi visheShavidhAnaM bahu kariShyati; tena tajjAtIyamanyajAtIyaM ca madyaM madAtyaye deyam||107-111||

annarasotkleda ityatra ‘amlarasakledaH’ iti kecit paThanti| kShAramAdhuryAya yadA~amlamadyadAnaM, tadA kimiti anyadamlaM na dIyate ityAha- kShAro hItyAdi| uparyuparIti upariShTAdapyupari atyarthaM shreShThamityarthaH||112-116||

madodayA iti madanimittAstarShAdayaH ; kecittu ‘jvarAdayaH’ iti paThanti, tatra jvarapradhAnAstarShAdaya ityartha unneyaH| avadaMsho yamupayujya madyaM pIyate| dakShaH kukkuTaH| veshavAraH khAniShkaH, sa coktalakShaNo~asakRut| pUpavartiH vartyAkArA pUpalikA| rasapralepIti rasapralepanarUpatayA nirvRuttaM ‘rasapraleha’ iti yAvat| agurupa~gkairiti agurulepaiH| ghanairiti bahalaiH| saMrodhoShNasukhAvahairiti saMrodhajanitoShmaNA sukhakArakaiH||117-135||

bhavyetyAdinA paittike vidhimAha| bhavyam auttarApathikam, anye karmara~ggamAhuH| mArdvIkamiti mRudvIkArasakRutam| satInaH vartulakalAyaH| rogAdvimucyata iti prakRutapittamadAtyayAdvimucyata ityarthaH| kramamiti vamanAnantaroktamannasaMsarjanakramam| doShasheShaH koShThopalapako~atra j~jeyaH| guDUcItyAdau rasamiti kvAtham| tittiriH pratibhojanaM pashcAjjIrNe bhojanaM yasmin rase taM tittiripratibhojanam| anutarShaM ca pAyayediti bhojanasamaye tRuShAM lakShIkRutya pAyayet; anupAnaM dApayediti yAvat| etadanupAnasya mAtrAmAha- anutarShasyetyAdi| anutarShasyeti muhurmuhurdIyamAnAnupAnasya| yayA~asya mano na dUShyata iti na vikRutiM yAti; etena tRuShAyAM manodainyamAtrahantRu yanmadyaM bhavati tadanutarShasa~jj~jaM bhavati, natu madaparyantaM madyaM deyamityarthaH| tRuShNAghnamiti shItakaShAyarUpaM rasam| cukrIkA cA~ggerI| badarItyAdau badaryAdipatrANi mathitvA tajjaH pheno grAhyaH| ariShTakaH nimbaH||136-163||-

ullekhanetyAdinA kaphamadAtyayacikitsitam| tRuShyate salilamityAdau ShaDa~ggavidhinA jalasAdhanaM sAdhviti| madhuprakRutikaM mAdhavam| vyoShapradhAno yUSho vyoShayUShaH| nIrasavartitamiti anatidravavartitaM shuShkAkhyaM vya~jjanamityarthaH| vRuNuyAditi vyApnuyAt| ArdrakapeshikA ArdrakadIrghakhaNDAni; ‘prabhUtArdrakapeShitam’ iti vA pAThaH| sauvarcalamityAdau tvagelAmaricAdInAM pratyekameva bhAgArdhatvam| sharkarAbhAgaH pUrvaikadravyabhAgaH| kaTukairyuktAmiti ki~jcidUShaNAm| shvetAmiti mRudvIkAM, shvetA ca drAkShA kAshmIrabhavA j~jeyA| kAravImiti svalpadrAkShAm| AmrAmalakayoH peshItyanena phalagataM sasyaM gRuhyate| sa~gkocoShNasukhA~ggInAM sa~gkocena saMshleSheNa uShNasukhama~ggaM yAsAM tAsAM; kecittu sa~gkocaM ku~gkumamAhuH||164-188||

yadidamityAdinA sAnnipAtikamadAtyayacikitsAmAha| yadyapi trayodashavidhaH sannipAto vRuddhadoShANAmuktastathA~api sarvamadAtyayAnAM tridoShajatvAd yadetadvAtAdimadAtyayacikitsitamuktaM tadekadoSholbaNasannipAtajamadAtyayacikitsitaM bhavati, tena dvyulbaNahInamadhyAdhikabhedasamasannipAtairye dashAvashiShTAH sannipAtAstAnabhipretyedamuktaM- sannipAte dashavidhe tadvikalpyamiti; hInamadhyAdhikadoShatrayodbhUtamadAtyayeShu hInamadhyAdhikadoShabhedena vikalpya cikitsA kartavyA; samasannipAte tu trayANAmapi militvA cikitsA kartavyA||189-190||

madAtyayasya praharShajanikA kriyA kartavyetyAha- vanAnItyAdi| kasmAt punarmadAtyaye praharShiNI cikitsA kAryetyAha- nAkShobhyetyAdi| manaHprItyA sharIraprashamArthaM praharShaNI kriyA kartavyeti bhAvaH| uktakShIraprayogasya viShayaM guNaM cAha- la~gghanairityAdi| tatra kAryakShIravRuttikramaM punarmadyAbhyAsakramaM cAha- payasA~abhihRute ityAdi| krameNeti kAlakrameNa| alpAlpamiti stokaM stokam||191-198||

etadviparyayeNa madyasevAyAM doShamAha- vicchinnetyAdi| dhvaMsakavikShayau vakShyamANalakShaNau| dhvaMsakavikShayau cemau sushrutenApyuktau| kecittu “vicchinnamadyaH sahasA yo~atimadyaM niShevate| tasya pAnAtyayoddiShTA vikArAH sambhavanti hi” iti granthena dhvaMsakavikShayAvarodhaM varNayanti| etayoshcikitsAmAha- tayorityAdi| karmeti cikitsA| tau hItyAdinA prakShINadurbalatayA dhvaMsakavikShayayorvAtapradhAnatAM darshayati| yuktamadyasyeti yathoktavidhinA madyamAcarataH||199-205||
yatprabhAvetyAdiradhyAyasa~ggrahaH| sa~ggrahArtho vyakta eva||207-211||

AshvinaM yA mahatteja ityAdAvapi surAdhiShThAtRudevatAyA eva tejovIryAdikAraNatvAttAdrUpyaM j~jeyam| tejaH sarvadevatAdigaM, tathA sArasvataM balaM mantrabalam| somaH sautrAmaNau ca yetyanena somarUpatocyate, pUrvaM sautrAmaNyAM hUyata ityuktamiti na paunaruktyam| yA prItirityAdau prItyAdikAraNatvena prItyAdirUpatayA nirdesho j~jeyaH||8-10||

vidhinA pibedityatroktavidhimAha- sharIretyAdi| sharIre snAnavasrAdibhirbAhya Abhyantarashca prakRutyAdyapekShayA snigdhoShNAnnAdibhiH kRutaH saMskAro yena sa sharIrakRutasaMskAraH| shuciriti manaHshuciH| yathartUddAmagandhibhiriti RutvavasthAnuguNatayA vihitaiH| yathartuke sarvartusukhe| kusumaprakarIkRute visRujatkusume| sarasAH priyAH, tAsAM sammate| svasharIrasukhe sthita iti yathAsharIrasukhaM sthitaH| sukRutairiti saMskRutaiH| shikShitAbhiriti abhyastopacArAbhiH| gandhapishunairiti gandhADhyaiH| ambaracAriNaH shyenAdayaH| paurogavargA iti sUdashAstrAbhij~jAH| arthibhya iti arthino baladeva-caNDI-yakShAdayaH, tebhyaH||11-20||

sAmAnyaM vidhimuktvA vAtikAdInAM pAnavidhimAha- abhya~ggetyAdi| mAricakairiti maricasaMskRutaiH| vasumatAmiti dhanavatAm| bhaviShyadvibhavA utpadyamAnadhanAH| yathopapatti yathAparicchadopapatti| kaphapittAdhikebhya ityAdau viparyayatantrayuktyA kaphAdhikebhyo mAdhavaM, pittAdhikebhyastu mArdvIkaM; mArdvIkaM mRudvIkAkRutaM, madhukRutaM tu mAdhavam||21-25||

bahudravyamiti nAnAvidhadravyasampAditam| bahuguNamiti bhUrivakShyamANalaghvAdiguNam| bahukarmeti lekhanadIpanAdibahukarmakaram| madAtmakamiti madasvabhAvam| yasmAdevaM svabhAvaM tasmAdguNadoShe ca taM madyamapekShete; ki~jcit puruShamapekShya yaugikatvAdguNakaraM, ki~jcittvayaugikatvAddoShakaraM; yathA- prathame made guNakaraM, doShakaraM ca dvitIyamade iti bhAvaH| vidhineti yathoktavidhinA| kAle iti yasya madyasya ya ucito viparItaguNaH kAlastasmin| hitairannairiti madyahitairannaiH| yathopetamiti yadeva madyamahitamapyupagatam| prasa~ggAditi atiyogena| viShavaditi mohAdikartRutvAt||26-28||
athAto dvivraNIyacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
tau dvau nAnAtvabhedena niruktA viMshatirvraNAH| teShAM parIkShA trividhA, praduShTA dvAdasha smRutAH||17||
sthAnAnyaShTau tathA gandhAH, parisrAvAshcaturdasha| ShoDashopadravA doShAshcatvAro viMshatistathA||18||
tathA copakramAH siddhAH ShaTtriMshat samudAhRutAH| vibhajyamAnA~jchRuNu me sarvAnetAn yatheritAn||19||
kRutyotkRutyastathA duShTo~aduShTo marmasthito na ca| saMvRuto dAruNaH srAvI saviSho viShamasthitaH||20||
utsa~ggyutsanna eShAM ca vraNAn vidyAdviparyayAt| iti nAnAtvabhedena niruktA viMshatirvraNAH||21||
darshanaprashnasaMsparshaiH parIkShA trividhA smRutA| vayovarNasharIrANAmindriyANAM ca darshanAt||22||
hetvartisAtmyAgnibalaM parIkShyaM vacanAdbudhaiH| sparshAnmArdavashaitye ca parIkShye saviparyaye||23||
shveto~avasannavartmA~atisthUlavartmA~atipi~jjaraH | nIlaHshyAvo~atipiDako raktaH kRuShNo~atipUtikaH||24||
ropyaH kumbhImukhashceti praduShTA dvAdasha vraNAH| caturviMshatiruddiShTA doShAH kalpAntareNa vai||25||

tvaksirAmAMsamedo~asthisnAyumarmAntarAshrayAH| vraNasthAnAni nirdiShTAnyaShTAvetAni sa~ggrahe||26||

Commentary: tvagityAdinA sthAnanirdeshaH| antarAshrayaH koShThaH||26||

sarpistailavasApUyaraktashyAvAmlapUtikAH| vraNAnAM vraNagandhaj~jairaShTau gandhAH prakIrtitAH||27||

Commentary: sarpirityAdinA gandhanirdeshaH| shyAvagandhaM dadhyAdestAmraghRuShTasamAnaM gandhamAhuH; kecittu ‘shAvaM’ iti paThanti; shavasya gandhaH shAvaH| amlasahacaritagandho~amlagandha ucyate||27||
lasIkAjalapUyAsRugghAridrAruNapi~jjarAH| kaShAyanIlaharitasnigdharUkShasitAsitAH||28||
iti rUpaiH samuddiShTA vraNasrAvAshcaturdasha| visarpaH pakShaghAtashca sirAstambho~apatAnakaH||29||
mohonmAdavraNarujo jvarastRuShNA hanugrahaH| kAsashchardiratIsAro hikkA shvAsaH savepathuH||30||
snAyukledAtsirAkledAdgAmbhIryAtkRumibhakShaNAt ||31||
asthibhedAt sashalyatvAt saviShatvAcca sarpaNAt| nakhakAShThaprabhedAcca carmalomAtighaTTanAt ||32||
mithyAbandhAdati snehAdatibhaiShajyakarShaNAt| ajIrNAdatibhuktAcca viruddhAsAtmyabhojanAt||33||
shokAt krodhAddivAsvapnAdvyAyAmAnmaithunAttathA| vraNA na prashamaM yAnti niShkriyatvAcca dehinAm||34||
parisrAvAcca gandhAcca doShAccopadravaiH saha| vraNAnAM bahudoShANAM kRucchratvaM copajAyate||35||
tva~gmAMsajaH sukhe deshe taruNasyAnupadravaH| dhImato~abhinavaH kAle sukhasAdhyaH smRuto vraNaH||36||
guNairanyatamairhInastataH kRucchro vraNaH smRutaH| sarvairvihIno vij~jeyastvasAdhyo nirupakramaH ||37||

vraNAnAmAditaH kAryaM yathAsannaM vishodhanam| UrdhvabhAgairadhobhAgaiH shastrairbastibhireva ca||38||

Commentary: avasaraprAptAyAM ShaTtriMshadupakramarUpAyAM cikitsAyAM vaktavyAyAM saMshodhanasya prAdhAnyopadarshanArthaM pRuthagagre~abhidhAnaM- vraNAnAmityAdinA||38||-
yathAkramamatashcordhvaM shRuNu sarvAnupakramAn||39||
shophaghnaM ShaDvidhaM caiva shastrakarmAvapIDanam| nirvApaNaM sasandhAnaM svedaH shamanameShaNam||40||
shodhanau ropaNIyau ca kaShAyau sapralepanau| dve taile tadguNe patraM chAdane dve ca bandhane||41||
bhojyamutsAdanaM dAho dvividhaH sAvasAdanaH| kAThinyamArdavakare dhUpanAlepane shubhe||42||
vraNAvacUrNanaM varNyaM ropaNaM lomarohaNam| iti ShaTtriMshaduddiShTA vraNAnAM samupakramAH||43||
pUrvarUpaM bhiShagbuddhvA vraNAnAM shophamAditaH| raktAvasecanaM kuryAdajAtavraNashAntaye||44||
shodhayedbahudoShAMstu svalpadoShAn vila~gghayet| pUrvaM kaShAyasarpirbhirjayedvA mArutottarAn||45||
nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthaplakShavetasavalkalaiH| sasarpiShkaiH pralepaH syAcchophanirvApaNaH param||46||
vijayA madhukaM vIrA bisagranthiH shatAvarI| nIlotpalaM nAgapuShpaM pradehaH syAt sacandanaH||47||
saktavo madhukaM sarpiH pradehaH syAt sasharkaraH| avidAhIni cAnnAni shophe bheShajamuttamam||48||
sa cedevamupakrAntaH shopho na prashamaM vrajet| tasyopanAhaiH pakvasya pATanaM hitamucyate||49||
tailena sarpiShA vA~api tAbhyAM vA saktupiNDikA| sukhoShNA shophapAkArthamupanAhaH prashasyate||50||
satilA sAtasIbIjA dadhyamlA saktupiNDikA| sakiNvakuShThalavaNA shastA syAdupanAhane||51||
rugdAharAgatodaishca vidagdhaM shophamAdishet| jalabastisamasparshaM sampakvaM pIDitonnatam||52||
umA~atho gugguluH saudhaM payo dakShakapotayoH| viT palAshabhavaH kShAro hemakShIrI mukUlakaH||53||
ityukto bheShajagaNaH pakvashothaprabhedanaH| sukumArasya, kRucchrasya shastraM tu paramucyate||54||

pATanaM vyadhanaM caiva chedanaM lepanaM tathA| pracchanaM sIvanaM caiva ShaDvidhaM shastrakarma tat||55||

Commentary: pATanamityAdinA prokte ShaDvidhashastrakarmaNi tisraiShaNIyoktAdhikadAraNAdishastrakarmAvarodho boddhavyaH, tena na virodhaH||55||
nADIvraNAH pakvashothAstathA kShatagudodaram| antaHshalyAshca ye shophAH pATyAste tadvidhAshca ye||56||
dakodarANi sampakvA gulmA ye ye ca raktajAH| vyadhyAH shoNitarogAshca visarpapiDakAdayaH||57||
udvRuttAn sthUlaparyantAnutsannAn kaThiNAn vraNAn| arshaHprabhRutyadhImAMsaM chedanenopapAdayet||58||
kilAsAni sakuShThAni likhellekhyAni buddhimAn| vAtAsRuggranthipiDakAH sakoThA raktamaNDalam||59||
kuShThAnyabhihataM cA~ggaM shothAMshca pracchayedbhiShak| sIvyaM kukShyudarAdyaM tu gambhIraM yadvipATitam||60||
sUkShmAnanAH koShavanto ye vraNAstAnprapIDayet||61||
kalAyAshca masUrAshca godhUmAH sahareNavaH| kalkIkRutAH prashasyante niHsnehA vraNapIDane||62||
shAlmalItvagbalAmUlaM tathA nyagrodhapallavAH| nyagrodhAdikamuddiShTaM balAdikamathApi vA||63||
AlepanaM nirvapaNaM tadvidyAttaishca secanam| sarpiShA shatadhautena payasA madhukAmbunA||64||
lambAni vraNamAMsAni pralipya madhusarpiShA||65||
sandadhIta samaM vaidyo bandhanaishcopapAdayet| tAnsamAnsusthitA~jj~jAtvA phalinIlodhrakaTphalaiH||66||
sama~ggAdhAtakIyuktaishcUrNitairavacUrNayet| pa~jcavalkalacUrNairvA shukticUrNasamAyutaiH||67||
asthibhagnaM cyutaM sandhiM sandadhIta samaM punaH||68||
samena samama~ggena kRutvA~anyena vicakShaNaH| sthiraiH kavalikAbandhaiH kushikAbhishca saMsthitam||69||
paTTaiH prabhUtasarpiShkairbadhnIyAdacalaM sukham| avidAhibhirannaishca paiShTikaistamupAcaret||70||
glAnirhi na hitA tasya sandhivishleShakArikA| vicyutAbhihatA~ggAnAM visarpAdInupadravAn||71||
shuShkA mahArujaH stabdhA ye vraNA mArutottarAH| svedyAH sa~gkarakalpena te syuH kRusharapAyasaiH||72||
grAmyabailAmbujAnUpairvaishavAraishca saMskRutaiH| utkArikAbhishcoShNAbhiH sukhI syAdvraNitastathA||73||
sadAhA vedanAvanto ye vraNA mArutottarAH| teShAmumAM tilAMshcaiva bhRuShTAn payasi nirvRutAn||74||
tenaiva payasA piShTvA kuryAdAlepanaM bhiShak| balA guDUcI madhukaM pRushniparNI shatAvarI||75||
jIvantI sharkarA kShIraM tailaM matsyavasA ghRutam| saMsiddhA samadhUcchiShTA shUlaghnI snehasharkarA||76||
dvipa~jcamUlakvathitenAmbhasA payasA~athavA | sarpiShA vA satailena koShNena pariShecayet||77||
yavacUrNaM samadhukaM satilaM saha sarpiShA| dadyAdAlepanaM koShNaM dAhashUlopashAntaye||78||
upanAhashca kartavyaH satilo mudgapAyasaH| rugdAhayoH prashamano vraNeShveSha vidhirhitaH||79||
sUkShmAnanA bahusrAvAH koShavantashca ye vraNAH| na ca marmAshritAsteShAmeShaNaM hitamucyate||80||
dvividhAmeShaNIM vidyAnmRudvIM ca kaThinAmapi| audbhidairmRudubhirnAlairlohAnAM vA shalAkayA||81||
gambhIre mAMsale deshe pATyaM lauhashalAkayA| eShyaM vidyAdvraNaM nAlairviparItamato bhiShak||82||
pUtigandhAn vivarNAMshca bahusrAvAnmahArujaH| vraNAnashuddhAn vij~jAya shodhanaiH samupAcaret||83||
triphalA khadiro dArvI nyagrodhAdirbalA kushaH| nimbakolakapatrANi kaShAyAH shodhanA matAH||84||
tilakalkaH salavaNo dve haridre trivRuddhRutam| madhukaM nimbapatrANi pralepo vraNashodhanaH||85||
nAtirakto nAtipANDurnAtishyAvo na cAtiruk| na cotsanno na cotsa~ggI shuddho ropyaH paraM vraNaH||86||
nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthakadambaplakShavetasAH| karavIrArkakuTajAH kaShAyA vraNaropaNAH||87||
candanaM padmaki~jjalkaM dArvItva~gnIlamutpalam| mede mUrvA sama~ggA ca yaShTyAhvaM vraNaropaNam||88||
prapauNDarIkaM jIvantI gojihvA dhAtakI balA| ropaNaM satilaM dadyAt pralepaM saghRutaM vraNe||89||
kampillakaM viDa~ggAni vatsakaM triphalAM balAm| paTolaM picumardaM ca lodhraM mustaM priya~ggukam||90||
khadiraM dhAtakIM sarjamelAmagurucandane| piShTvA sAdhyaM bhavettailaM tat paraM vraNaropaNam||91||
prapauNDarIkaM madhukaM kAkolyau dve ca candane| siddhametaiH samaistailaM paraM syAdvraNaropaNam||92||
dUrvAsvarasasiddhaM vA tailaM kampillakena vA| dArvItvacashca kalkena pradhAnaM vraNaropaNam||93||
yenaiva vidhinA tailaM ghRutaM tenaiva sAdhayet| raktapittottaraM dRuShTvA ropaNIyaM vraNaM bhiShak||94||
kadambArjunanimbAnAM pATalyAH pippalasya ca| vraNapracchAdane vidvAn patrANyarkasya cAdishet||95||
vArkSho~athavA~a~ajinaH kShaumaH paTTo vraNahitaH smRutaH| bandhashca dvividhaH shasto vraNAnAM savyadakShiNaH||96||
lavaNAmlakaTUShNAni vidAhIni gurUNi ca| varjayedannapAnAni vraNI maithunameva ca||97||
nAtishItagurusnigdhamavidAhi yathAvraNam| annapAnaM vraNahitaM hitaM cAsvapanaM divA||98||
stanyAni jIvanIyAni bRuMhaNIyAni yAni ca| utsAdanArthaM nimnAnAM vraNAnAM tAni kalpayet||99||
bhUrjagranthyashmakAsIsamadhobhAgAni gugguluH| vraNAvasAdanaM tadvat kalavi~gkakapotaviT||100||
rudhire~atipravRutte tu cchinne cchedye~adhimAMsake| kaphagranthiShu gaNDeShu vAtastambhAnilArtiShu||101||
gUDhapUyalasIkeShu gambhIreShu sthireShu ca| kLLipteShu cA~ggadesheShu karmAgneH samprashasyate||102||
madhUcchiShTena tailena majjakShaudravasAghRutaiH| taptairvA vividhairlohairdaheddAhavisheShavit||103||
rUkShANAM sukumArANAM gambhIrAnmArutottarAn| dahet snehamadhUcchiShTairlohaiH kShaudraistato~anyathA||104||
bAladurbalavRuddhAnAM garbhiNyA raktapittinAm| tRuShNAjvaraparItAnAmabalAnAM viShAdinAm||105||
nAgnikarmopadeShTavyaM snAyumarmavraNeShu ca| saviSheShu ca shalyeShu netrakuShThavraNeShu ca||106||
rogadoShabalApekShI mAtrAkAlAgnikovidaH| shastrakarmAgnikRutyeShu kShAramapyavacArayet||107||
kaThinatvaM vraNA yAnti gandhaiH sAraishca dhUpitAH| sarpirmajjavasAdhUpaiH shaithilyaM yAnti hi vraNAH||108||
rujaH srAvAshca gandhAshca kRumayashca vraNAshritAH| shaithilyaM mArdavaM cApi dhUpanenopashAmyati||109||
lodhranyagrodhashu~ggAni khadirastriphalA ghRutam| pralepo vraNashaithilyasaukumAryaprasAdhanaH||110||
sarujaH kaThinAH stabdhA nirAsrAvAshca ye vraNAH| yavacUrNaiH sasarpiShkairbahushastAn pralepayet||111||
