mudgaShaShTikashAlInAM pAyasairvA yathAkramam| saghRutairjIvanIyairvA tarpayettAnabhIkShNashaH||112||
kakubhodumbarAshvatthalodhrajAmbavakaTphalaiH| tvacamAshveva gRuhNanti tvakcUrNaishcUrNitA vraNAH||113||
manaHshilailA ma~jjiShThA lAkShA ca rajanIdvayam| pralepaH saghRutakShaudrastvagvishuddhikaraH paraH||114||
ayorajaH sakAsIsaM triphalAkusumAni ca| karoti lepaH kRuShNatvaM sadya eva navatvaci||115||
kAlIyakanatAmrAsthihemakAntArasottamaiH | lepaH sagomayarasaH savarNIkaraNaH paraH||116||
dhyAmakAshvatthaniculamUlaM lAkShA sagairikA| sahemashcAmRutAsa~ggaH kAsIsaM ceti varNakRut||117||
catuShpadAnAM tvaglomakhurashRu~ggAsthibhasmanA| tailAktA cUrNitA bhUmirbhavellomavatI punaH||118||
ShoDashopadravA ye ca vraNAnAM parikIrtitAH| teShAM cikitsA nirdiShTA yathAsvaM sve cikitsite||119||
tatra shlokau- dvau vraNau vraNabhedAshca parIkShA duShTireva ca| sthAnAni gandhAH srAvAshca sopasargAH kriyAshca yAH||120||
vraNAdhikAre saprashnametannavakamuktavAn| munirvyAsasamAsAbhyAmagniveshAya dhImate||121||
parAvaraj~jamAtreyaM gatamAnamadavyatham| agnivesho guruM kAle vinayAdidamabravIt||3||
bhagavan! pUrvamuddiShTau dvau vraNau rogasa~ggrahe| tayorli~ggaM cikitsAM ca vaktumarhasi sharmada!||4||
shrUyatAM vidhivat saumya! tayorli~ggaM ca bheShajam| nijaH sharIradoShottha AganturbAhyahetujaH||6||
vadhabandhaprapatanAddaMShTrAdantanakhakShatAt| Agantavo vraNAstadvadviShasparshAgnishastrajAH||7||
mantrAgadapralepAdyairbheShajairhetubhishca te| li~ggaikadeshairnirdiShTA viparItA nijairvraNaiH ||8||

vraNAnAM nijahetUnAmAgantUnAmashAmyatAm| kuryAddoShabalApekShI nijAnAmauShadhaM yathA||9||

Commentary: AgantuvraNasya bhinnaviShayatayA vistara iha na vaktavyaH; tena tasya cikitsAmapi samAsAdevAha- vraNAnAmityAdi| AgantUnAM vraNAnAM nijahetUnAM satAM mantrAdicikitsayA ashAmyatAM nijAnAM yathauShadhaM vakShyamANaM tathaiva doShabalAvekShI san kuryAditi yojanA| AgantUnAM cehAgantucikitsayA~aprashamanaM nijadoShAnubandhAdeva j~jeyam; ata eveha nijahetUnAmiti kRutam||9||

yathAsvairhetubhirduShTA vAtapittakaphA nRuNAm| bahirmArgaM samAshritya janayanti nijAn vraNAn||10||

Commentary: yathAsvairityAdinA nijavraNahetusamprAptyAdikathanam| atra yathAsvairhetubhiriti vacanena vAtAdInAM svAtantryeNa prakopaM darshayati, svahetuduShTo hi doShaH svatantro bhavati; ki~jca yathAsvairhetubhiriti vacanena ya eva vAtAdikopahetavasta evAtra nijavraNakArakA bhavanti, na punarvraNAnAM vishiShTo heturasti; sAmAnyavAtAdihetostu vishiShTavraNalakShaNakAryotpattiH samprAptibhedAdbhavatIti j~jeyam||10||
stabdhaH kaThinasaMsparsho mandasrAvo~atitIvraruk | tudyate sphurati shyAvo vraNo mArutasambhavaH||11||
sampUraNaiH snehapAnaiH snigdhaiH svedopanAhanaiH| pradehaiH pariShekaishca vAtavraNamupAcaret||12||
tRuShNAmohajvarasve(kle)dadAhaduShTyavadAraNaiH| vraNaM pittakRutaM vidyAdgandhaiH srAvaishca pUtikaiH||13||
shItalairmadhuraistiktaiH pradehapariShecanaiH| sarpiShpAnairvirekaishca paittikaM shamayedvraNam||14||
bahupiccho guruH snigdhaH stimito mandavedanaH| pANDuvarNo~alpasa~gkledashcirakArI kaphavraNaH||15||
kaShAyakaTurUkShoShNaiH pradehapariShecanaiH| kaphavraNaM prashamayettathA la~gghanapAcanaiH ||16||
madyamattasya samprahArAdinA vraNotpattau vraNacikitsArthaM dvivraNIya ucyate||1-2||
tau dvAvityAdi| nAnAtvakArako bhedo nAnAtvabhedaH| prakarSheNa duShTAH praduShTAH||17-19||

ete ca vraNabhedAdayo~agre kRutyotkRutya ityAdinA vyAkriyante| tatra kRutyaH chedanAdyupakramopakramaNIyaH, utkRutyasya tu nAtra ki~jcitkaraNIyamasti paraM ropaNIya eva; kiMvA kRutyaH sAdhyaH, akRutyastvasAdhyaH| kRutyAdayaH ShaT saviparyayA evoktAH, saMvRutAdayastu saptoddiShTAH saviparyayAH santashcaturdasha| utsanna udgatamAMsaH| utsa~ggI sthUlaparyantaH, kiMvA vraNAdbahiH pUyAvakAsharUpotsa~ggavAnutsa~ggI| sushrute tu “tatrAtisaMvRuto~ativivRuttaH” (su.sU.a.22) ityAdinA yadduShTavraNalakShaNamuktaM tadatisaMvRutAdiviShayam, iha tu saMvRutatvavivRutatvamAtramucyate, teneha duShTavraNena saMvRutasya grahaNamudbhAvanIyam ||20-21||

parIkShAtraividhyamuktaM vibhajate- darshanetyAdi| indriyANi ca yadyapyatIndriyatvAdanumAnagamyAni, tathA~apIha tadadhiShThAnAnAmindriyashabdenopAdAnam| agnishca yadyapi “agniM jaraNashaktyA” (vi.a.4) iti vacanAdanumAnaviShaya uktastathA~api prashnenAgniravagamyata eveti kRutveha vacanaparIkShaNIyataivoktA vahneH| saviparyaye iti kAThinyauShNye| anumAnaM ca yadyapi parIkShAdhikAre proktaM “dvividhA parIkShA j~jAnavatAM pratyakShamanumAnaM ca” (vi.a.4) ityAdinA, tathA~apyatrAnumAnasya prAyo vyApArAbhAvAdanupAdAnamiti brUte; kintu darshanAdipUrvakatvAdanumAnasya darshanAdinA anumAnamapyatIndriyAdiShu grAhakaM sa~ggRuhItamiti yuktaM pashyAmaH| darshanashabdashcAtra sAkShAdupalabdhivacanaH, tena vraNagatagandhenApi vraNaparIkShaNaM sa~ggRuhItaM bhavati| darshanashabdena ca gRuhIto~api sparsha iha bhUyasA vyApriyamANatvAt punaruktaH||22-23||

shveto~avasannetyAdinA praduShTavraNAnAha| ropyalakShaNaM tantrAntarAdavagantavyaM, tathAhi bhojaH- “rUDhA rUDhAH prakupyanti sAntardoShAH punaH punaH| bahiH shuddhA ivAbhAnti ropyAste samprakIrtitAH” iti| eteShAmeva shvetAdInAM bhedakAraNAntarabhedena caturviMshatitvaM bhavatIti darshayannAha- caturviMshatirityAdi| kalpAntareNeti vraNaduShTikArakakAraNayogabhedena snAyukledAdinA bhidyamAnAshcaturviMshatibhedA bhavantItyarthaH||24-25||
lasIketyAdinA srAvAnAha||28-30||-
prakArAntaroddiShTA~jcaturviMshatidoShAnAha- snAyukledAdityAdi| atra nakhakAShThaprabheda ekameva kAraNam| carmalomAtighaTTanaM tu kAraNadvayam| cikitsAvarjanIyatvaM niShkriyatvam||31-35||
asAdhyo nirupakrama iti asAdhyatvamabhidhAyApi nirupakramatAbhidhAnena sopakramasAdhyaM yApyaM niShedhayati||36-37||

upakramAnAha- shophaghnamityAdinA| shophaghna upakramo raktAvasekAdirvakShyamANaH| ShaDvidhaM shastrakarmeti pATanAdi; atraivAharaNameShaNaM ca shalyatantroktamadhikaM karmadvayamantarbhAvanIyaM; kiMveShaNaM shastrakarmA~ggaM na shastrakarma, tattu pRuthageva| avapIDanaM kalkAdinA AlepanaM pUyanirgamanArthaM vakShyati| nirvApaNaM dAhauShNyashamanam| shodhanau ropaNIyau ca kaShAyau sapralepanau iti shodhanaropaNakaShAyau tathA shodhanaropaNAlepau| dve taile tadguNe ityatra ghRutasyApi snehatvasAmAnyAt tailenaiva grahaNaM; tena yadyapi catvAri tailaghRutAni pratyekashodhanaropaNabhedAdvakShyati, tathA~api shodhanaropaNakarmadvayakartRutayA dvitvamevAtra tailaghRutayorgaNanIyam| kAshmIrAstu “dvau snehau tadguNau” iti paThanti| patraM chAdane iti patrameka upakramaH, chAdanaM tu dvividhaM bAhyAntarabhedena vakShyamANam| utsAdanaM nimnavraNotthApanam| avasAdanam utsannavraNamAMsakShayakaram| kAThinyamArdavakare dhUpanAlepane iti kAThinyakaraM dhUpanaM, mArdavakaraM dhUpanaM ceti; evamAlepanamapi dvividhaM j~jeyam| vraNAvacUrNanaM dvividhaM vadanti tvagvarNakararomajanakabhedena| evaM ShaTtriMshadupakramA bhavanti; shalyatantre tu ShaShTirupakramA uktAste~apyatraivAntarbhAvanIyAH||39-43||

atha yathAvasthaM vraNopakramAnAha- pUrvarUpamityAdi| shothastu vraNapUrvarUpaM, shothacikitsA~anAgatavraNavihitatvAdvraNopakramatvenoktA| kaShAyapAnaiH sarpirbhishceti kaShAyasarpirbhiH| vijayA balA||44-48||

upanAhairiti soShNabahalalepaiH| kiNvaM surAbIjam| umA atasI| saudhaM payaH snuhIkShIram| hemakShIrI ka~gkuShTham| mukUlakaH dantI| sukumArasyeti cchedaH| kRucchrasyeti asukumArasya, shastraM paraM bhedanamiti sambandhaH||49-54||

pATanAdInAM pRuthagviShayamAha- nADIvraNA ityAdi| sampakva gulmA ye te vyadhyAH| tathA ye ca raktajA iti raktagulmAH| shoNitarogA vidhishoNitIyoktAH| vyadhyA iti sirAvyadhAdisAdhyAH| lekhyAnIti lekhanAvasthAprAptAni||56-60||-
vraNapIDane iti vraNapIDanashca lepo niHsneho vraNamukhaM varjayitvA kartavyaH||61-62||
nyagrodhAdikamiti nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthetyAdinoktamatraiva| balAdikaM ‘vijayA madhukaM vIrA’ ityAdinA shothaharopakramopadiShTam||63-64||-
lambAnItyAdinA sandhAnopakramamAha| shuktiH badarikA||65-67||-

samena samama~ggena kRutveti samenAvikRutenAnyenA~ggena samaM sadRushaM kRutvA sandadhIteti yojyam| kavalikAkushikAbandhau sushrute draShTavyau | vicyutAbhihatA~ggAnAmityAdau ‘AnAhAdInupakramAn’ iti kecit paThanti | svAccikitsitAditi visarpAdicikitsitAt||68-71||-

balA guDUcItyAdi| atra balAdIni piShTAni sharkarAkShIramadhUcchiShTatailAdibhiH samairutkarikAM kRutvA svedaH kartavyaH; anye tu balAdikalkena tailAdisnehaM caturguNe kShIre sAdhayitvA snehapAdikaM madhUcchiShTaprakShepamAhuH| snehasyAtra saMhatAvasthitatvAt madhusharkarAvat ‘snehasharkarA’ iti vyapadeshaH| dvipa~jcamUlakvathiteneti ambhasA payasA sarpiShA tailena veti yojanIyam||72-79||
dvividhAmityAdau audbhidairmRudubhirnAlaiH mRudvIM, lohaiH kaThinAm| pAThyamiti eShaNIyaM pAThyaM ca||80-82||
nimbakolakapatrANItyatra nimba eva mRudurnimbakolaka ucyate; kiMvA kulaketi pAThaH, kulakaH paTolaH||83-85||

nAtirakta ityAdinA shuddhavraNalakShaNamabhidhAya ropaNamAha- nyagrodhetyAdi| kaShAyA iti bahuvacananirdeshAdyathoktavyastasamastaprayogAn sUcayati| dArvyAstvak dArvItvak vraNashodhanI ropaNI ca| ghRutaM taireva sAdhayediti yathoktatailadravyaireva sAdhayediti| ghRutaviShayamAha- raktapittottaramityAdi| ropaNIyamiti vacanAd ropaNameva ghRutaM kartavyaM, natu shodhanArthaM ghRutaM kartavyamityarthaH||86-94||
vArkSha ityAdau vRukShabhavaM valkalaM vArkSham| savyadakShiNa iti vAmadakShiNaH; vAmaparikShepaH savyaH, dakShiNaparikShepo dakShiNaH| atraiva shalyoktacaturdashabandhAvarodhaH kAryaH||95-96||
stanyAni ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAni| ashmakAsIsaM dhAtukAsIsam| adhobhAgAni trivRutAdIni virecanadravyANi||97-100||

chedye iti chedanArhe| klRupteShviti kartiteShu| rUkShasnigdhadAhabhedaviShayaM dAhakavastubhedaM ca darshayannAha- sukumArANAmityAdinA| dAhavisheShaviditi dAhAnAM visheShaM snigdharUkShAdirUpaM tathA binduvalayAdirUpaM jAnAtIti dAhavisheShavit| viShAdinAmiti bhakShitaviShANAm||101-106||
yadyapyupakrameShu kShAraH pRutha~gna paThitaH, tathA~api shastrAgnivyApArakartRutvAcchastrAgnyupakramagRuhIta eveti kRutvA kShAramapyavacArayediti vacanena kShAro~api vihitaH||107-109||
tarpayediti tarpaNArthaM lepaM kArayet||110-112||

kakubhetyAdiprakaraNena tvagjananaM tathA savarNakaraNaM tathA romajananamiti upakramatrayamAha| tvacamAshveva gRuhNantIti satvaco bhavanti| triphalAkusumAnIti triphalAvRukShapuShpANi| latA priya~gguH| kAntA ma~jjiShThA| rasottamaH pAradaH, ghRutaM vA| amRutAsa~ggaH karparikAtuttham||113-119||
dvau vraNAvityAdyadhyAyasa~ggraho vyaktaH||120-121||
paraH mokShaH, avaraM dravyAdi , tajjAnAtIti parAvaraj~jaH| tayorli~ggaM cikitsAM cetyatra hetorapi vyAdhigamakatayA li~ggenaiva grahaNam||3-4||

doShA yadyapi shArIrA eva, tathA~apIha shArIrapadaM snAyukledAdiShvapIha prayuktadoShavyudAsArtham| nijAgantuvraNabhedamAha- mantretyAdi| nijaiH samamAgantavo vraNA viparItA mantrAdibhirbheShajaishca, tathA hetubhishca vadhabandhanAdibhiH, tathA li~ggaikadeshaishca; sa ca li~ggaikadesho yathA- AganturvyathApUrvamudeti pashcAdvAtAdIn kopayati, nije tu pUrvaM vAtAdayaH prakupyanti pashcAdvyathotpadyate| yaduktaM- “AganturvyathApUrvamutpanno jaghanyaM vAtapittashleShmaNAM vaiShamyamApAdayati” (sU.a.20) iti||5-8||

stabdha ityAdinA vAtAdivraNAnAM lakShaNAni tathA cikitsAsUtraM cAha| pradehaiH pariShekaishcetyatra ‘asnigdhaiH’ ityanuvartate| ciraM vikAraM karotIti cirakArI| cikitsAsamAsAbhidhAnaM ca sukhagrahaNArthameva||11-16||
athAtastrimarmIyacikitsitamadhyAyaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
kriyA hitA sA~ashmarisharkarAbhyAM kRucchre yathaiveha kaphAnilAbhyAm| kAryA~ashmarIbhedanapAtanAya visheShayuktaM shRuNu karma siddham||59||
pAShANabhedaM vRuShakaM shvadaMShTrApAThAbhayAvyoShashaTInikumbhAH| hiMsrAkharAshvAshitivArakANAmervArukANAM trapuShasya bIjam||60||
utku~jcikA hi~ggu savetasAmlaM syAddve bRuhatyau hapuShA vacA ca| cUrNaM pibedashmaribhedapakvaM sarpishca gomUtracaturguNaM taiH||61||
mUlaM shvadaMShTrekShurakorubUkAt kShIreNa piShTaM bRuhatIdvayAcca| AloDya dadhnA madhureNa peyaM dinAni saptAshmaribhedanAya||62||
punarnavAyorajanIshvadaMShTrAphalgupravAlAshca sadarbhapuShpAH| kShIrAmbumadyekShurasaiH supiShTaM peyaM bhavedashmarisharkarAsu||63||
truTiM surAhvaM lavaNAni pa~jca yavAgrajaM kundurukAshmabhedau| kampillakaM gokShurakasya bIjamervArubIjaM trapuShasya bIjam||64||
cUrNIkRutaM citrakahi~ggumAsIyavAnitulyaM triphalAdvibhAgam| amlairashuktai rasamadyayuShaiH peyaM hi gulmAshmaribhedanArtham||65||
bilvapramANo ghRutatailabhRuShTo yUShaH kRutaH shigrukamUlakalkAt| shIto~ashmabhit syAddadhimaNDayuktaH peyaH prakAmaM lavaNena yuktaH||66||
jalena shobhA~jjanamUlakalkaH shIto hitashcAshmarisharkarAsu| sitopalA vA samayAvashUkA kRucchreShu sarveShvapi bheShajaM syAt||67||
pItvA~atha madyaM nigadaM rathena hayena vA shIghrajavena yAyAt| taiH sharkarA pracyavate~ashmarI tu shamyenna cecchalyaviduddharettAm||68||
retobhighAtaprabhave tu kRucchre samIkShya doShaM pratikarma kuryAt| kArpAsamUlaM vRuShakAshmabhedau balA sthirAdIni gavedhukA ca||69||
vRushcIra aindrI ca punarnavA ca shatAvarI madhvasanAkhyaparNyau| tatkvAthasiddhaH pavane rasaH syAt pitte~adhike kShIramathApi sarpiH||70||
kaphe ca yUShAdikamannapAnaM saMsargaje sarvahitaH kramaH syAt| evaM na cecchAmyati tasya yu~jjyAt surAM purANAM madhukAsavaM vA||71||
viha~ggamAMsAni ca bRuMhaNAya bastIMshca shukrAshayashodhanArtham| shuddhasya tRuptasya ca vRuShyayogaiH priyAnukUlAH pramadA vidheyAH||72||
raktodbhave tUtpalanAlatAlakAsekShubAlekShukasherukANi| pibet sitAkShaudrayutAni khAdedikShuM vidArIM trapuShANi caiva||73||
ghRutaM shvadaMShTrAsvarasena siddhaM kShIreNa caivAShTaguNena peyam| sthirAdikAnAM kanakAdikAnAmekaikasho vA vidhinaiva tena||74||
kShIreNa bastirmadhurauShadhaiH syAttailena vA svAduphalotthitena| yanmUtrakRucchre vihitaM tu paitte kAryaM tu tacchoNitamUtrakRucchre||75||

vyAyAmasandhAraNashuShkarUkShapiShTAnnavAtArkakaravyavAyAn| kharjUrashAlUkakapitthajambUbisaM kaShAyaM na rasaM bhajeta||76||

Commentary: vyAyAmetyAdinA mUtrakRucchre~apathyAnyAha||76||
iti mUtrakRucchracikitsA
vyAyAmatIkShNAtivirekabasticintAbhayatrAsagadAticArAH| chardyAmasandhAraNakarshanAni hRudrogakartRUNi tathA~abhighAtaH||77||
vaivarNyamUrcchAjvarakAsahikkAshvAsAsyavairasyatRuShApramohAH| chardiH kaphotklesharujo~arucishca hRudrogajAH syurvividhAstathA~anye||78||
hRucchUnyabhAvadravashoShabhedastambhAH samohAH pavanAdvisheShaH| pittAttamodUyanadAhamohAH santrAsatApajvarapItabhAvAH||79||
stabdhaM guru syAt stimitaM ca marma kaphAt prasekajvarakAsatandrAH| vidyAttridoShaM tvapi sarvali~ggaM tIvrArtitodaM kRumijaM sakaNDUm||80||
tailaM sasauvIrakamastutakraM vAte prapeyaM lavaNaM sukhoShNam| mUtrAmbusiddhaM lavaNaishca tailamAnAhagulmArtihRudAmayaghnam||81||
punarnavAM dAru sapa~jcamUlaM rAsnAM yavAn bilvakulatthakolam| paktvA jale tena vipAcya tailamabhya~ggapAne~anilahRudgadadhnam||82||
harItakInAgarapuShkarAhvairvayaHkayasthAlavaNaishca kalkaiH| sahi~ggubhiH sAdhitamagryasarpirgulme sahRutpArshvagade~anilotthe||83||
sapuShkarAhvaM phalapUramUlaM mahauShadhaM shaTyabhayA ca kalkAH| kShArAmbusarpirlavaNairvimishrAH syurvAtahRudrogavikartikAghnAH||84||
kvAthaH kRutaH pauShkaramAtulu~ggapalAshabhUtIkashaTIsurAhvaiH| sanAgarAjAjivacAyavAnIkShAraH sukhoShNo lavaNashca peyaH||85||
pathyAshaTIpauShkarapa~jcakolAt samAtulu~ggAdyamakena kalkaH| guDaprasannAlavaNaishca bhRuShTo hRutpArshvapRuShThodarayonishUle||86||
syAttryUShaNaM dve triphale sapAThe nidigdhikAgokShurakau bale dve| RuddhistruTistAmalakI svaguptA mede madhUkaM madhukaM sthirA ca||87||
shatAvarI jIvakapRushniparNyau dravyairimairakShasamaiH supiShTaiH| prasthaM ghRutasyeha pacedvidhij~jaH prasthena dadhnA tvatha mAhiSheNa||88||
mAtrAM palaM cArdhapalaM picuM vA prayojayenmAkShikasamprayuktAm| shvAse sakAse tvatha pANDuroge halImake hRudgrahaNIpradoShe||89||
shItAH pradehAH pariShecanAni tathA vireko hRudi pittaduShTe| drAkShAsitAkShaudraparUShakaiH syAcchuddhe tu pittApahamannapAnam||90||
yaShTyAhvikAtiktakarohiNIbhyAM kalkaM pibeccApi sitAjalena| kShate ca sarpIMShi hitAni sarpirguDAshca ye tAn prasamIkShya samyak||91||
dadyAdbhiShagdhanvarasAMshca gavyakShIrAshinAM pittahRudAmayeShu| taireva sarve prashamaM prayAnti pittAmayAH shoNitasaMshrayA ye||92||
drAkShAbalAshreyasisharkarAbhiH kharjUravIrarShabhakotpalaishca| kAkolimedAyugajIvakaishca kShIreNa siddhaM mahiShIghRutaM syAt||93||
kasherukAshaivalashRu~ggaveraprapauNDarIkaM madhukaM bisasya| granthishca sarpiH payasA pacettaiH kShaudrAnvitaM pittahRudAmayaghnam||94||
sthirAdikalkaiH payasA ca siddhaM drAkShArasenekShurasena vA~api| sarpirhitaM svAduphalekShujAshca rasAH sushItA hRudi pittaduShTe||95||
svinnasya vAntasya vila~gghitasya kriyA kaphaghnI kaphamarmaroge| kaulatthadhAnyaishca rasairvavAnnaM pAnAni tIkShNAni ca sha~gkarANi||96||
mUtre shRutAH kaTphalashRu~ggaverapItadrupathyAtiviShAH pradeyAH| kRuShNAshaTIpuShkaramUlarAsnAvacAbhayAnAgaracUrNakaM ca||97||
udumbarAshvatthavaTArjunAkhye pAlAsharauhItakakhAdire ca| kvAthe trivRuttryUShaNacUrNasiddho lehaH kaphaghno~ashishirAmbuyuktaH||98||
shilAhvayaM vA bhiShagapramattaH prayojayet kalpavidhAnadiShTam| prAshaM tathA~a~agastyamathApi lehaM rasAyanaM brAhmamathAmalakyAH||99||

tridoShaje la~gghanamAditaH syAdannaM ca sarveShu hitaM vidheyam| hInAtimadhyatvamavekShya caiva kAryaM trayANAmapi karma shastam||100||

Commentary: tridoShaje Adau la~gghanavidhAnaM hRudayasya kaphasthAnatayA tadgate tridoShaje~api kapha evAdau la~gghanena jeya iti matvA kRutam| tridoShaje tUlbaNadoShacikitsAsUtramAha- hInAtItyAdi| hInatvamadhikatvaM madhyamatvaM ca doShANAmavekShya yat karma shastamadhikadoShavijetRutayA tat kAryamiti vAkyArthaH||100||
bhukte~adhikaM jIryati shUlamalpaM jIrNe sthitaM cet suradArukuShTham| satilvakaM dve lavaNe viDa~ggamuShNAmbunA sAtiviShaM pibet saH||101||
jIrNe~adhike snehavirecanaM syAt phalairvirecyo yadi jIryati syAt| triShveva kAleShvadhike tu shUle tIkShNaM hitaM mUlavirecanaM syAt||102||

... sarvaM kRumighnaM kRumihRudgade ca||103||

Commentary: kRumighnamiti vyAdhitarUpIye (vi. a. 7) kRumiharatvenoktaM vidhAnam||103||
iti hRudrogacikitsA
saptottaraM marmashataM yaduktaM sharIrasa~gkhyAmadhikRutya tebhyaH| marmANi bastiM hRudayaM shirashca pradhAnabhUtAni vadanti tajj~jAH||3||
prANAshrayAt, tAni hi pIDayanto vAtAdayo~asUnapi pIDayanti| tatsaMshritAnAmanupAlanArthaM mahAgadAnAM shRuNu saumya rakShAm||4||
sandhAraNAjIrNarajotibhAShyakrodhartuvaiShamyashirobhitApaiH| prajAgarAtisvapanAmbushItairavashyayA maithunabAShpadhUmaiH||104||
saMstyAnadoShe shirasi pravRuddho vAyuH pratishyAyamudIrayettu| ghrANArtitodau kShavathurjalAbhaH srAvo~anilAt sasvaramUrdharogaH||105||
nAsAgrapAkajvaravaktrashoShatRuShNoShNapItasravaNAni pittAt| kAsArucisrAvaghanaprasekAH kaphAdguruH srotasi cApi kaNDUH||106||
sarvo~ativRuddho~ahitabhojanAttu duShTapratishyAya upekShitaH syAt||107||
tatastu rogAH kShavathushca nAsAshoShaH pratInAhaparisravau ca| ghrANasya pUtitvamapInasashca sapAkashothArbudapUyaraktAH||108||
arUMShi shIrShashravaNAkShirogakhAlityaharyarjunalomabhAvAH| tRuTshvAsakAsajvararaktapittavaisvaryashoShAshca tato bhavanti||109||
rodhAbhighAtasravashoShapAkairghrANaM yutaM yashca na vetti gandham| durgandhi cAsyaM bahushaHprakopi duShTapratishyAyamudAharettam||110||
saMspRushya marmANyanilastu mUrdhni viShvakpathasthaH kShavathuM karoti| kruddhaH sa saMshoShya kaphaM tu nAsAshRu~ggATakaghrANavishoShaNaM ca||111||
ucchvAsamArgaM tu kaphaH savAto rundhyAt pratInAhamudAharettam| yo mastulu~ggAdghanapItapakvaH kaphaH sravedeSha parisravastu||112||
vaivarNyadaurgandhyamupekShayA tu syAt pUtinasyaM shvayathurbhramashca| Anahyate yasya vishuShyate ca praklidyate dhUpyati cApi nAsA||113||
na vetti yo gandharasAMshca janturjuShTaM vyavasyettamapInasena| taM cAnilashleShmabhavaM vikAraM brUyAt pratishyAyasamAnali~ggam||114||
sadAharAgaH shvayathuH sapAkaH syAd ghrANapAko~api ca raktapittAt| ghrANAshritAsRukprabhRutIn pradUShya kurvanti nAsAshvayathuM malAshca||115||
ghrANe tathocchvAsagatiM nirudhya mAMsAsradoShAdapi cArbudAni| ghrANAt sravedvA shravaNAnmukhAdvA pittAktamasraM tvapi pUyaraktam||116||
kuryAt sapittaH pavanastvagAdIn sandUShya cArUMShi sapAkavanti| nAsA pradIpteva narasya yasya dIptaM tu taM rogamudAharanti||117||
iti svarabhedacikitsA
kaShAyatiktoShaNarUkShabhojyaiH sandhAraNAbhojanamaithunaishca | pakvAshaye kupyati cedapAnaH srotAMsyadhogAni balI sa ruddhvA||5||
karoti viNmArutamUtrasa~ggaM kramAdudAvartamataH sughoram| rugbastihRutkukShyudareShvabhIkShNaM sapRuShThapArshveShvatidAruNA syAt||6||
AdhmAnahRullAsavikartikAshca todo~avipAkashca sabastishothaH| varco~apravRuttirjaThare ca gaNDAnyUrdhvashca vAyurvihato gude syAt||7||
kRucchreNa shuShkasya cirAt pravRuttiH syAdvA tanuH syAt khararUkShashItA| tatashca rogA jvaramUtrakRucchrapravAhikAhRudgrahaNIpradoShAH||8||
vamyAndhyabAdhiryashiro~abhitApavAtodarAShThIlamanovikArAH| tRuShNAsrapittArucigulmakAsashvAsapratishyArditapArshvarogAH||9||
anye ca rogA bahavo~anilotthA bhavantyudAvartakRutAH sughorAH| cikitsitaM cAsya yathAvadUrdhvaM pravakShyate tacchRuNu cAgnivesha!||10||

bhRushArtishUlaM sphuratIha vAtAt pittAt sadAhArti kaphAdguru syAt| sarvaistridoShaM krimibhistu kaNDUrdaurgandhyatodArtiyutaM shiraH syAt||118||

Commentary: bhRushArtItyAdinA yadyapi pratishyAyotpannatvena shirorogANAM lakShaNamucyate, tathA~api svatantrotpannAnAmapi shirorogANAmetadeva lakShaNaM j~jeyam| evaM mukharogAdilakShaNeShvapi vAcyam| sarvaistridoShamiti vAtAdilakShaNairmilitaistridoShaM syAdityarthaH||118||
mukhAmaye mArutaje tu shoShakArkashyaraukShyANi calA rujashca| kRuShNAruNaM niShpatanaM sashItaM prasraMsanaspandanatodabhedAH||119||
tRuShNAjvarasphoTakatAludAhA dhUmAyanaM cApyavadIrNatA ca| pittAt samUrcchA vividhA rujashca varNAshca shuklAruNavarNavarjyAH||120||
kaNDUrgurutvaM sitavijjalatvaM sneho~arucirjADyakaphaprasekau| utkleshamandAnalatA ca tandrA rujashca mandAH kaphavakraroge||121||
sarvANi rUpANi tu vakraroge bhavanti yasmin sa tu sarvajaH syAt| saMsthAnadUShyAkRutinAmabhedAccaite catuHShaShTividhA bhavanti||122||
shAlAkyatantre~abhihitAni teShAM nimittarUpAkRutibheShajAni| yathApradeshaM tu caturvidhasya kriyAM pravakShyAmi mukhAmayasya||123||
iti mukharoganidAnam
vAtAdibhiH shokabhayAtilobhakrodhairmanoghnAshanagandharUpaiH| arocakAH syuH parihRuShTadantaH kaShAyavakrashca mato~anilena||124||
kaTvamlamuShNaM virasaM ca pUti pittena vidyAllavaNaM ca vakram| mAdhuryapaicchilyagurutvashaityavibaddhasambaddhayutaM kaphena||125||
arocake shokabhayAnilobhakrodhAdyahRudyAshanagandhaje syAt| svAbhAvikaM vakramathArucishca tridoShaje naikarasaM bhavettu||126||
iti netraroganidAnam
nAdo~atirukkarNamalasya shoShaH srAvastanushcAshravaNaM ca vAtAt| shophaH sarAgo daraNaM vidAhaH sapItapUtishravaNaM ca pittAt||127||
vaishrutyakaNDUsthirashophashuklasnigdhashrutiH shleShmabhave~alparuk ca| sarvANi rUpANi tu sannipAtAt srAvashca tatrAdhikadoShavarNaH||128||
iti khAlityaroganidAnam
alpastu rAgo~anupadehavAMshca satodabhedo~anilajAkShiroge| pittAt sadAho~atirujaH sarAgaH pItopadehaH subhRushoShNavAhI||129||
shuklopadehaM bahupicchilAshru netraM kaphAt syAdgurutA sakaNDuH| sarvANi rUpANi tu sannipAtAnnetrAmayAH ShaNNavatistu bhedAt||130||
teShAmabhivyaktirabhipradiShTA shAlAkyatantreShu cikitsitaM ca| parAdhikAre tu na vistaroktiH shasteti tenAtra na naH prayAsaH||131||
taM tailashItajvaranAshanAktaM svedairyathoktaiH pravilInadoSham| upAcaredvartinirUhabastisnehairvirekairanulomanAnnaiH||11||
shyAmAtrivRunmAgadhikAM sadantIM gomUtrapiShTAM dashabhAgamAShAm| sanIlikAM dvirlavaNAM guDena vartiM karA~gguShThanibhAM vidadhyAt||12||
piNyAkasauvarcalahi~ggubhirvA sasarShapatryUShaNayAvashUkaiH| krimighnakampillakasha~gkhinIbhiH sudhArkajakShIraguDairyutAbhiH||13||
syAt pippalIsarShaparADhaveshmadhUmaiH sagomUtraguDaishca vartiH| shyAmAphalAlAbukapippalInAM nADyA~athavA tat pradhamettu cUrNam||14||

rakShoghnatumbIkarahATakRuShNAcUrNaM sajImUtakasaindhavaM vA| snigdhe gude tAnyanulomayanti narasya varco~anilamUtrasa~ggam||15||

Commentary: nidAnAdikrameNa hRudrogacikitsAmAha| gadAticAra iti rogANAmasamyagupacAraH| hRudrogakartRUNIti yathA “bhIShmaH kurUNAM bhayashokahartA”, tena “tRujakAbhyAM kartari” (pA.a.2|2|15|)
teShAM vighAte tu bhiShagvidadhyAt svabhyaktasusvinnatanornirUham| UrdhvAnulomauShadhamUtratailakShArAmlavAtaghnayutaM sutIkShNam||16||
vAte~adhike~amlaM lavaNaM satailaM, kShIreNa pitte tu, kaphe samUtram| sa mUtravarco~anilasa~ggamAshu gudaM sirAshca praguNIkaroti||17||

trivRutsudhApatratilAdishAkagrAmyaudakAnUparasairyavAnnam| anyaishca sRuShTAnilamUtraviDbhiradyAt prasannAguDasIdhupAyI||18||

Commentary: prasannA madyopari svaccho bhAgaH| guDakRutaH sIdhuH guDasIdhuH||18||

bhUyo~anubandhe tu bhavedvirecyo mUtraprasannAdadhimaNDashuktaiH| svasthaM tu pashcAdanuvAsayettaM raukShyAddhi sa~ggo~anilavarcasoshcet||19||

Commentary: bhUyo~anubandhe iti bastiprayoge satyapyudAvartAnubandhe| etacca virecanaM bastidAnAt saptAhAdUrdhvam| yaduktaM- “naro viriktastu nirUhadAnaM vivarjayet saptadinAnyavashyam| shuddho nirUheNa virecanaM ca” (si.a.1) iti||19||
dviruttaraM hi~ggu vacAgnikuShThaM suvarcikA caiva viDa~ggacUrNam| sukhAmbunA~a~anAhavisUcikArtihRudrogagulmordhvasamIraNaghnam ||20||
vacAbhayAcitrakayAvashUkAn sapippalIkAtiviShAn sakuShThAn| uShNAmbunA~a~anAhavimUDhavAtAn pItvA jayedAshu rasaudanAshI||21||
hi~ggUgragandhAbiDashuNThyajAjIharItakIpuShkaramUlakuShTham| yathottaraM bhAgavivRuddhametat plIhodarAjIrNavisUcikAsu||22||

sthirAdivargasya punarnavAyAH shampAkapUtIkakara~jjayoshca| siddhaH kaShAye dvipalAMshikAnAM prastho ghRutAt syAt pratiruddhavAte||23||

Commentary: sthirAdivargasyeti alpapa~jcamUlasya| shampAkapUtIkakara~jjayoshcetyatra pUtIkashabdaH kara~jjavisheShaNam| tathAhi jatUkarNaH- “AragvadhapUtikapunarnavAsthirAdyairghRutaM siddhamH” ityAdi||23||
phalaM ca mUlaM ca virecanoktaM hi~ggvarkamUlaM dashamUlamagryam| snuk citrakashcaiva punarnavA ca tulyAni sarvairlavaNAni pa~jca||24||
snehaiH samUtraiH saha jarjarANi sharAvasandhau vipacet sulipte| pakvaM supiShTaM lavaNaM tadannaiH pAnaistathA~a~anAharujAghnamadyAt||25||
hRutstambhamUrdhAmayagauravAbhyAmudgArasa~ggena sapInasena| AnAhamAmaprabhavaM jayettu pracchardanairla~gghanapAcanaishca||26||
(gulmodarabradhnArshaHplIhodAvartayonishukragade | medaHkaphasaMsRuShTe mArutarakte~avagADhe ca||27||
gRudhrasipakShavadhAdiShu virecanArheShu vAtarogeShu| vAte vibaddhamArge medaHkaphapittaraktena||28||
payasA mAMsarasairvA triphalArasayUShamUtramadirAbhiH| doShAnubandhayogAt prashastameraNDajaM tailam||29||
tadvAtanutsvabhAvAt saMyogavashAdvirecanAcca jayet| medosRukpittakaphonmishrAnilarogajittasmAt||30||
balakoShThavyAdhivashAdApa~jcapalA bhavenmAtrA| mRudukoShThAlpabalAnAM saha bhojyaM tatprayojyaM syat)||31||
ityudAvartacikitsA
tejo~anilAdyaiH saha keshabhUmiM dagdhvA~a~ashu kuryAt khalatiM narasya| ki~jcittu dagdhvA palitAni kuryAddhariprabhatvaM ca shiroruhANAm||132||
ityUrdhvajatrUtthagadaikadeshastantre nibaddho~ayamashUnyatArtham| ataH paraM bheShajasa~ggrahaM tu nibodha sa~gkShepata ucyamAnam||133||
vAtAt sakAsavaisvarye sakShAraM pInase vRutam| pibedrasaM payashcoShNaM snaihikaM dhUmameva vA||134||
shatAhvA tvagbalA mUlaM syonAkairaNDabilvajam| sAragvadhaM pibedvartiM madhUcchiShTavasAghRutaiH||135||
athavA saghRutAn saktUn kRutvA mallakasampuTe| navapratishyAyavatAM dhUmaM vaidyaH prayojayet||136||
sha~gkhamUrdhalalATArtau pANisvedopanAhanam| svabhyakte kShavathusrAvarodhAdau sa~gkarAdayaH||137||
ghreyAshca rohiShAjAjIvacAtarkAricorakAH| tvakpatramaricailAnAM cUrNA vA sopaku~jcikAH||138||
srotaHshRu~ggATanAsAkShishoShe tailaM ca nAvanam| prabhAvyAje tilAn kShIre tena piShTAMstaduShmaNA||139||
mandasvinnAn sayaShTyAhvacUrNAMstenaiva pIDayet| dashamUlasya niShkvAthe rAsnAmadhukakalkavat||140||
siddhaM sasaindhavaM tailaM dashakRutvo~aNu tat smRutam| snigdhasyAsthApanairdoShaM nirharedvAtapInase||141||
snigdhAmloShNaishca laghvannaM grAmyAdInAM rasairhitam| uShNAmbunA snAnapAne nivAtoShNapratishrayaH||142||
cintAvyAyAmavAkceShTAvyavAyavirato bhavet| vAtaje pInase dhImAnicchannevAtmano hitam||143||
paitte sarpiH pibet siddhaM shRu~ggaverashRutaM payaH| pAcanArthaM pibet pakve kAryaM mUrdhavirecanam||144||
pAThAdvirajanImUrvApippalIjAtipallavaiH| dantyA ca sAdhitaM tailaM nasyaM syAt pakvapInase||145||
pUyAsre raktapittaghnAH kaShAyA nAvanAni ca| pAkadAhADhyarUkSheShu shItA lepAH sasecanAH||146||
ghreyanasyopacArAshca kaShAyAH svAdushItalAH| mandapitte pratishyAye snigdhaiH kuryAdvirecanam||147||
ghRutaM kShIraM yavAH shAlirgodhUmA jA~ggalA rasAH| shItAmlAstiktashAkAni yUShA mudgAdibhirhitAH||148||
gauravArocakeShvAdau la~gghanaM kaphapInase| svedAH sekAshca pAkArthaM lipte shirasi sarpiShA||149||
lashunaM mudgacUrNena vyoShakShAraghRutairyutam| deyaM kaphaghnavamanamutkliShTashleShmaNe hitam||150||
apInase pUtinasye ghrANasrAve sakaNDuke| dhUmaH shasto~avapIDashca kaTubhiH kaphapInase||151||
manaHshilA vacA vyoShaM viDa~ggaM hi~ggu gugguluH| cUrNo ghreyaH pradhamanaM kaTubhishca phalaistathA||152||
bhArgImadanatarkArIsurasAdivipAcite| mUtre lAkShA vacA lambA viDa~ggaM kuShThapippalI||153||
kRutvA kalkaM kara~jjaM ca tailaM taiH sArShapaM pacet| pAkAnmukte ghane nasyametanmedonibhe kaphe||154||
snigdhasya vyAhate vege cchardanaM kaphapInase| vamanIyashRutakShIratilamAShayavAgunA||155||
vArtAkakulakavyoShakulatthADhakimudgajAH| yUShAH kaphaghnamannaM ca shastamuShNAmbuseca(va)nam||156||
sarvajit pInase duShTe kAryaM shophe ca shophajit| kShAro~arbudAdhimAMseShu kriyA sheSheShvavekShya ca||157||
iti pInasanAsArogacikitsA
vAtike shiraso roge snehAn svedAn sanAvanAn| pAnAnnamupanAhAMshca kuryAdvAtAmayApahAn||158||
tailabhRuShTairagurvAdyaiH sukhoShNairupanAhanam| jIvanIyaiH sumanasA matsyairmAMsaishca shasyate||159||
rAsnAsthirAdibhiH siddhaM sakShIraM nasyamartinut| tailaM rAsnAdvikAkolIsharkarAbhirathApi vA||160||
balAmadhUkayaShTyAhvavidArIcandanotpalaiH| jIvakarShabhakadrAkShAsharkarAbhishca sAdhitaH||161||
prasthastailasya sakShIro jA~ggalArdhatulArase| nasyaM sarvordhvajatrUtthavAtapittAmayApaham||162||
dashamUlabalArAsnAtriphalAmadhukaiH saha| mayUraM pakShapittAntrashakRuttuNDA~gghrivarjitam||163||
jale paktvA ghRutaprasthaM tasmin kShIrasamaM pacet| madhuraiH kArShikaiH kalkaiH shirorogArditApaham||164||
karNAkShinAsikAjihvAtAlvAsyagalaroganut| mAyUramitivikhyAtamUrdhvajatrugadApaham||165||
etenaiva kaShAyeNa ghRutaprasthaM vipAcayet| caturguNena payasA kalkairebhishca kArShikaiH||166||
jIvantItriphalAmedAmRudvIkardhiparUShakaiH| sama~ggAcavikAbhArgIkAshmarIsuradArubhiH||167||
AtmaguptAmahAmedAtAlakharjUramastakaiH| mRuNAlabisashAlUkashRu~ggIjIvakapadmakaiH ||168||
shatAvarIvidArIkShubRuhatIsArivAyugaiH| mUrvAshvadaMShTrarShabhakashRu~ggATakakaserukaiH||169||
rAsnAsthirAtAmalakIsUkShmailAshaTipauShkaraiH| punarnavAtugAkShIrIkAkolIdhanvayAsakaiH||170||
kharjUrAkShoTavAtAmamu~jjAtAbhiShukairapi | dravyairebhiryathAlAbhaM pUrvakalpena sAdhitam||171||
nasye pAne tathA~abhya~gge bastau caiva prayojayet| shirorogeShu sarveShu kAse shvAse ca dAruNe||172||
manyApRuShThagrahe shoShe svarabhede tathA~ardite| yonyasRukshukradoSheShu shastaM vandhyAsutapradam||173||
RutusnAtA tathA nArI pItvA putraM prasUyate| mahAmAyUramityetadghRutamAtreyapUjitam||174||
iti mahAmAyUraghRutamAkhubhiH kukkuTairhaMsaiH shashaishcApi hi buddhimAn| kalpenAnena vipacet sarpirUrdhvagadApaham||175||
paitte ghRutaM payaH sekAH shItA lepAH sanAvanAH| jIvanIyAni sarpIMShi pAnAnnaM cApi pittanut||176||
candanoshIrayaShTyAhvabalAvyAghranakhotpalaiH| kShIrapiShTaiH pradehaH syAcchRutairvA pariShecanam||177||
tvakpatrasharkarAkalkaH supiShTastaNDulAmbunA| kAryo~avapIDaH sarpishca nasyaM tasyAnu paittike||178||
yaShTyAhvacandanAnantAkShIrasiddhaM ghRutaM hitam| nAvanaM sharkarAdrAkShAmadhUkairvA~api pittaje||179||
kaphaje sveditaM dhUmanasyapradhamanAdibhiH| shuddhaM pralepapAnAnnaiH kaphaghnaiH samupAcaret||180||
purANasarpiShaH pAnaistIkShNairbastibhireva ca| kaphAnilotthite dAhaH sheShayo raktamokShaNam||181||
eraNDanaladakShaumaguggulvagurucandanaiH| dhUmavartiM pibedgandhairakuShThatagaraistathA||182||
sannipAtabhave kAryA sannipAtahitA kriyA| krimije caiva kartavyaM tIkShNaM mUrdhavirecanam||183||
tvagdantIvyAghrakarajaviDa~gganavamAlikAH| apAmArgaphalaM bIjaM naktamAlashirIShayoH| kShavako~ashmantako bilvaM haridrA hi~ggu yUthikA||184||
phaNijjhakashca taistailamavimUtre caturguNe| siddhaM syAnnAvanaM cUrNaM caiShAM pradhamanaM hitam||185||
phalaM shigrukara~jjAbhyAM savyoShaM cAvapIDakaH| kaShAyaH svarasaH kShArashcUrNaM kalko~avapIDakaH||186||
shuktatiktakaTukShaudrakaShAyaiH kavalagrahaHiti shirorogacikitsA
vyAyAmatIkShNauShadharUkShamadyaprasa~gganityadrutapRuShThayAnAt| AnUpamatsyAdhyashanAdajIrNAt syurmUtrakRucchrANi nRuNAmihAShTau||32||
pRutha~gmalAH svaiH kupitA nidAnaiH sarve~athavA kopamupetya bastau| mUtrasya mArgaM paripIDayanti yadA tadA mUtrayatIha kRucchrAt||33||
tIvrA rujo va~gkShaNabastimeDhre svalpaM muhurmUtrayatIha vAtAt| pItaM saraktaM sarujaM sadAhaM kRucchrAnmuhurmUtrayatIha pittAt||34||
basteH sali~ggasya gurutvashothau mUtraM sapicchaM kaphamUtrakRucchre| sarvANi rUpANi tu sannipAtAdbhavanti tat kRucchratamaM hi kRucchram||35||

vishoShayedbastigataM sashukraM mUtraM sapittaM pavanaH kaphaM vA| yadA tadA~ashmaryupajAyate tu krameNa pitteShviva rocanA goH||36||

Commentary: vishoShayedityAdinA catuShprakArAnapyashmarIrogAnAha| tantrAntare~ashmaryastu vAtapittakaphashukrajA uktAH; yadyapi sarvAshmarIShu doShatrayajanyatvamasti, “saMhantyApo yathA divyA mAruto~agnishca vaidyutaH| tadvadbalAsaM bastisthamUShmA saMhanti sanilaH” (su. ni. a. 3) iti sushruta pratipAditaM; tathA~apyutkaTaikadoShAbhiprAyeNa vAtajAdivyapadesho j~jeyaH| vAtajAyAmashmaryAM prabalena vAyunA mUtrashoShe kriyamANe tadgataH kapha evAshmarIrUpaH kriyate, evaM pittAshmaryAmapi j~jeyam, ata eva sushrute shleShmAdhiShThAnAH sarvA evAshmarya uktAH| ashmaryutpAde dRuShTAntamAha- pitteShviva rocanA goriti; pitteShviti bahuvacanaM pittabahutvApekShayA ||36||
kadambapuShpAkRutirashmatulyA shlakShNA tripuTyapyathavA~api mRudvI| mUtrasya cenmArgamupaiti ruddhvA mUtraM rujaM tasya karoti bastau||37||
sasevanImehanabastishUlaM vishIrNadhAraM ca karoti mUtram| mRudnAti meDhraM sa tu vedanArto muhuH shakRunmu~jcati mehate ca||38||
eShA~ashmarI mArutabhinnamUrtiH syAccharkarA mUtrapathAt kSharantI||39||
(reto~abhighAtAbhihatasya puMsaH pravartate yasya tu mUtrakRucchram| syAdvedanA va~gkShaNabastimeDhre tasyAtishUlaM vRuShaNAtivRutte||40||
shukreNa saMruddhagatipravAho mUtraM sa kRucchreNa vimu~jcatIha| tamaNDayoH stabdhamiti bruvanti reto~abhighAtAt pravadanti kRucchram )||41||

shukraM malAshcaiva pRuthak pRuthagvA mUtrAshayasthAH prativArayanti| tadvyAhataM mehanabastishUlaM mUtraM sashukraM kurute vibaddham||42||

Commentary: shukraM malA ityAdinA shukrajamUtrakRucchralakShaNam| mUtrAshayasthA iti mUtramArgasthitAH||42||-
kShatAbhighAtAt kShatajaM kShayAdvA prakopitaM bastigataM vibaddham||43||
tIvrArti mUtreNa sahAshmarItvamAyAti tasminnatisa~jcite ca| AdhmAtatAM vindati gauravaM ca basterlaghutvaM ca viniHsRute~asmin||44||
iti mUtrakRucchranidAnam
dhUmaH pradhamanaM shuddhiradhashchardanala~gghanam||187||
bhojyaM ca mukharogeShu yathAsvaM doShanuddhitam| pippalyagurudArvItvagyavakShArarasA~jjanam||188||
pAThAM tejovatIM pathyAM samabhAgaM vicUrNayet| mukharogeShu sarveShu sakShaudraM tadvidhArayet||189||
sIdhumAdhavamAdhvIkaiH shreShTho~ayaM kavalagrahaH| tejohvAmabhayAmelAM sama~ggAM kaTukAM ghanam||190||
pAThAM jyotiShmatIM lodhraM dArvIM kuShThaM ca cUrNayet| dantAnAM gharShaNaM raktasrAvakaNDUrujApaham||191||
pa~jcakolakatAlIsapatrailAmaricatvacaH| palAshamuShkakakShArayavakShArAshca cUrNitAH||192||
guDe purANe dviguNe kvathite guTikAH kRutAH| karkandhumAtrAH saptAhaM sthitA muShkakabhasmani||193||
kaNTharogeShu sarveShu dhAryAH syuramRutopamAH| gRuhadhUmo yavakShAraH pAThA vyoShaM rasA~jjanam||194||
tejohvA triphalA lodhraM citrakashceti cUrNitam| sakShaudraM dhArayedetadgalarogavinAshanam||195||
kAlakaM nAma taccUrNaM dantAsyagalaroganutiti kAlakacUrNammanaHshilA yavakShAro haritAlaM sasaindhavam||196||
dArvItvak ceti taccUrNaM mAkShikeNa samAyutam| mUrcchitaM ghRutamaNDena kaNTharogeShu dhArayet||197||
mukharogeShu ca shreShThaM pItakaM nAma kIrtitamiti pItakacUrNammRudvIkA kaTukA vyoShaM dArvItvak triphalA ghanam||198||
mUrcchitaM ghRutamaNDena kaNTharogeShu dhArayet| pAThA rasA~jjanaM mUrvA tejohveti ca cUrNitam||199||
kShaudrayuktaM vidhAtavyaM galaroge bhiShagjitam| yogAstvete trayaH proktA vAtapittakaphApahAH||200||
kaTukAtiviShApAThAdArvImustakali~ggakAH| gomUtrakvathitAH peyAH kaNTharogavinAshanAH||201||
svarasaH kvathito dArvyA ghanIbhUto rasakriyA| sakShaudrA mukharogAsRugdoShanADIvraNApahA||202||
tAlushoShe tvatRuShNasya sarpirauttarabhaktikam| nAvanaM madhurAH snigdhAH shItAshcaiva rasA hitAH||203||
mukhapAke sirAkarma shiraHkAyavirecanam| mUtratailaghRutakShaudrakShIraishca kavalagrahAH||204||
sakShaudrAstriphalApAThAmRudvIkAjAtipallavAH| kaShAyatiktakAH shItAH kvAthAshca mukhadhAvanAH||205||
tulAM khadirasArasya dviguNAmarimedasaH| prakShAlya jarjarIkRutya caturdroNe~ambhasaH pacet||206||
droNasheShaM kaShAyaM taM pUtvA bhUyaH pacecchanaiH| tatastasmin ghanIbhUte cUrNIkRutyAkShabhAgikam||207||
candanaM padmakoshIraM ma~jjiShThA dhAtakI ghanam| prapauNDarIkaM yaShTyAhvatvagelApadmakesharam||208||
lAkShAM rasA~jjanaM mAMsItriphalAlodhravAlakam| rajanyau phalinImelAM sama~ggAM kaTphalaM vacAm||209||
yavAsAgurupatta~ggagairikA~jjanamAvapet| lava~gganakhakakkolajAtikoshAn palonmitAn||210||
karpUrakuDavaM cApi kShipecchIte~avatArite| tatastu guTikAHkAryAHshuShkAshcAsyena dhArayet||211||
tailaM cAnena kalkena kaShAyeNa ca sAdhayet| dantAnAM calanabhraMshashaushiryakrimiroganut||212||
mukhapAkAsyadaurgandhyajADyArocakanAshanam| srAvopalepapaicchilyavaisvaryagalashoShanut||213||
dantAsyagalarogeShu sarveShvetat parAyaNam| khadirAdiguTIkeyaM tailaM ca khadirAdikam||214||
iti khadirAdiguTikA tailaM ca
arucau kavalagrAhA dhUmAH samukhadhAvanAH| manoj~jamannapAnaM ca harShaNAshvAsanAni ca||215||
kuShThasauvarcalAjAjIsharkarAmaricaM biDam| dhAtryelApadmakoshIrapippalyutpalacandanam||216||
lodhraM tejovatI pathyA tryUShaNaM sayavAgrajam| ArdradADimaniryAsashcAjAjIsharkarAyutaH||217||
satailamAkShikAstvete catvAraH kavalagrahAH| caturo~arocakAn hanyurvAtAdyekajasarvajAn||218||
kAravImaricAjAjIdrAkShAvRukShAmladADimam| sauvarcalaM guDaH kShaudraM sarvArocakanAshanam||219||
bastiM samIraNe, pitte virekaM, vamanaM kaphe| kuryAddhRudyAnukUlAni harShaNaM ca manoghnaje||220||
ityarocakacikitsA
karNashUle tu vAtaghnI hitA pInasavat kriyA| pradehAH pUraNaM nasyaM pAkasrAve vraNakriyAH||221||
bhojyAni ca yathAdoShaM kuryAt snehAMshca pUraNAn| hi~ggutumbarushuNThIbhistailaM tu sArShapaM pacet||222||
etaddhi pUraNaM shreShThaM karNashUlanivAraNam| devadAruvacAshuNThIshatAhvAkuShThasaindhavaiH||223||
tailaM siddhaM bastamUtre karNashUlanivAraNam| varATakAn samAhRutya dahenmRudbhAjane nave||224||
tadbhasma shcyotayettena gandhatailaM vipAcayet| rasA~jjanasya shuNThyAshca kalkAbhyAM karNashUlanut||225||
shuShkamUlakashuNThAnAM kShAro hi~ggu mahauShadham| shatapuShpA vacA kuShThaM dAru shigru rasA~jjanam||226||
sauvarcalayavakShArasvarjikodbhidasaindhavam| bhUrjagranthirbiDaM mustaM madhushuktaM caturguNam||227||
mAtulu~ggarasashcaiva kadalyA rasa eva ca| sarvairetairyathoddiShTaiH kShAratailaM vipAcayet||228||
bAdhiryaM karNanAdashca pUyasrAvashca dAruNaH| krimayaH karNashUlaM ca pUraNAdasya nashyati ||229||
mukhakarNAkShirogeShu yathoktaM pInase vidhim| kuryAdbhiShak samIkShyAdau doShakAlabalAbalam||230||
iti karNarogacikitsA |
utpannamAtre taruNe netraroge biDAlakaH| kAryo dAhopadehAshrushopharAganivAraNaH||231||
nAgaraM saindhavaM sarpirmaNDena ca rasakriyA| nighRuShTaM vAtike tadvanmadhusaindhavagairikam||232||
tathA shAvarakaM lodhraM ghRutabhRuShTaM biDAlakaH| tadvat kAryo harItakyA ghRutabhRuShTo rujApahaH||233||
paittike candanAnantAma~jjiShThAbhirbiDAlakaH| kAryaH padmakayaShTyAhvamAMsIkAlIyakaistathA||234||
gairikaM saindhavaM mustaM rocanA ca rasakriyA| kaphe kAryA tathA kShaudraM priya~gguH samanaHshilA||235||
sannipAte tu sarvaiH syAdbahirakShNoH pralepanam| pakShmANyaspRushyatA kAryaM sampakve tva~jjanaM tryahAt||236||
AshcyotanaM mArutaje kvAtho bilvAdibhirhitaH| koShNaH sairaNDatarkArIbRuhatImadhushigrubhiH||237||
pRuthvIkAdArvima~jjiShThAlAkShAdvimadhukotpalaiH| kvAthaH sasharkaraH shItaH pUraNaM raktapittanut||238||
nAgaratriphalAmustanimbavAsArasaH kaphe| koShNamAshcyotanaM mishrairoShadhaiH sAnnipAtake||239||
bRuhatyeraNDamUlatvak shigroH puShpaM sasaindhavam| ajAkShIreNa piShTaM syAdvartirvAtAkShiroganut||240||
sumanaHkorakAH sha~gkhastriphalA madhukaM balA| pittaraktApahA vartiH piShTA divyena vAriNA||241||
saindhavaM triphalA vyoShaM sha~gkhanAbhiH samudrajaH| phenaH shaileyakaM sarjo vartiH shleShmAkShiroganut||242||
amRutAhvA bisaM bilvaM paTolaM chAgalaM shakRut| prapauNDarIkaM yaShTyAhvaM dArvI kAlAnusArivA||243||
eShAmaShTapalAn bhAgAn sudhautA~jjarjarIkRutAn| toye paktvA rase pUte bhUyaH pakve rase ghane||244||
karShaM ca shvetamaricAjjAtIpuShpAnnavAt palam| cUrNaM kShiptvA kRutA vartiH sarvaghnI dRukprasAdanI||245||
sha~gkhapravAlavaidUryalauhatAmraplavAsthibhiH| srotojashvetamaricairvartiH sarvAkShiroganut||246||
shANArdhaM maricAddvau ca pippalyarNavaphenayoH| shANArdhaM saindhavAcchANA nava sauvIrakA~jjanAt||247||
piShTaM susUkShmaM citrAyAM cUrNA~jjanamidaM shubham| kaNDUkAcakaphArtAnAM malAnAM ca vishodhanam||248||
bastamUtre tryahaM sthApyamelAcUrNaM subhAvitam| cUrNA~jjanaM hi taimiryakrimipillamalApaham||249||
sauvIrama~jjanaM tutthaM tApyo dhAturmanaHshilA| cakShuShyA madhukaM lohA maNayaH pauShpama~jjanam||250||
saindhavaM shaukarI daMShTrA katakaM cA~jjanaM shubham| timirAdiShu curNaM vA vartirveyamanuttamA||251||
katakasya phalaM sha~gkhaH saindhavaM tryUShaNaM sitA| pheno rasA~jjanaM kShaudraM viDa~ggAni manaHshilA||252||
kukkuTANDakapAlAni vartireShA vyapohati| timiraM paTalaM kAcaM malaM cAshu sukhAvatI||253||
iti sukhAvatI vartiH |triphalAkukkuTANDatvakkAsIsamayaso rajaH| nIlotpalaM viDa~ggAni phenaM ca saritAM pateH||254||
Ajena payasA piShTvA bhAvayettAmrabhAjane| saptarAtraM sthitaM bhUyaH piShTvA kShIreNa vartayet||255||
iti dRuShTipradA vartiH |vadane kRuShNasarpasya nihitaM mAsama~jjanam||256||
tatastasmAt samRuddhRutya sushuShkaM cUrNayedbudhaH| sumanaHkorakaiH shuShkairardhAMshaiH saindhavena ca||257||
etannetrA~jjanaM kAryaM timiraghnamanuttamam| pippalyaH kiMshukaraso vasA sarpasya saindhavam||258||
jIrNaM ghRutaM ca sarvAkShirogaghnI syAdrasakriyA| kRuShNasarpavasA kShaudraM raso dhAtryA rasakriyAH||259||
shastA sarvAkShirogeShu kAcArbudamaleShu ca| dhAtrIrasA~jjanakShaudrasarpirbhistu rasakriyA||260||
pittaraktAkShirogaghnI taimiryapaTalApahA| dhAtrIsaindhavapippalyaH syuralpamaricAH samAH||261||
kShaudrayuktA nihantyAndhyaM paTalaM ca rasakriyA|262|iti netrarogacikitsA |
abhya~jjanasnehanirUhabastisnehopanAhottarabastisekAn| sthirAdibhirvAtaharaishca siddhAn dadyAdrasAMshcAnilamUtrakRucchre||45||
punarnavairaNDashatAvarIbhiH pattUravRushcIrabalAshmabhidbhiH| dvipa~jcamUlena kulatthakolayavaishca toyotkvathite kaShAye||46||
tailaM varAharkShavasA ghRutaM ca taireva kalkairlavaNaishca sAdhyam| tanmAtrayA~a~ashu pratihanti pItaM shUlAnvitaM mArutamUtrakRucchram||47||
etAni cAnyAni varauShadhAni piShTAni shastAnyapi copanAhe| syurlAbhatastailaphalAni caiva snehAmlayuktAni sukhoShNavanti||48||
khAlitye palite valyAM harilomni ca shodhitam||262||
nasyaistailaiH shirovakrapralepaishcApyupAcaret| siddhaM vidArIgandhAdyairjIvanIyairathApi ca||263||
nasyaM syAdaNutailaM vA khAlityapalitApaham| kShIrAt sahacarAdbhRu~ggarAjAcca saurasAdrasAt||264||
prasthaistu kuDavastailAdyaShTyAhvapalakalkitaH| siddhaH shilAsame bhANDe meShashRu~ggAdiShu sthitaH||265||
nasyaM syAdbhiShajA samyagyojitaM palitApaham| bhiShajA kShIrapiShTau vA dugdhikAkaravIrakau||266||
utpATya palite deyau tAvubhau palitApahau| mArkavasvarasAt kShIrAddviprasthaM madhukAt palam||267||
taiH pacet kuDavaM tailAttannasyaM palitApaham| AdityavallyA mUlAni kRuShNashaireyakasya ca||268||
surasasya ca patrANi patraM kRuShNashaNasya ca| mArkavaH kAkamAcI ca madhukaM devadAru ca||269||
pRuthagdashapalAMshAni pippalyastriphalA~a~jjanam| prapauNDarIkaM ma~jjiShThA lodhraM kRuShNAgurUtpalam||270||
AmrAsthi kardamaH kRuShNo mRuNAlaM raktacandanam| nIlI bhallAtakAsthIni kAsIsaM madayantikA||271||
somarAjyasanaH shastraM kRuShNau piNDItacitrakau| puShkarArjunakAshmaryANyAmrajambUphalAni ca||272||
pRuthak pa~jcapalAMshAni taiH piShTairADhakaM pacet| baibhItakasya tailasya dhAtrIrasacaturguNam||273||
kuryAdAdityapAkaM vA yAvacchuShko bhavedrasaH| lohapAtre tataH pUtaM saMshuddhamupayojayet||274||
pAne nasyakriyAyAM ca shirobhya~gge tathaiva ca| etaccakShuShyamAyuShyaM shirasaH sarvaroganut||275||
mahAnIlamiti khyAtaM palitaghnamanuttamamiti mahAnIlatailamprapauNDarIkamadhukapippalIcandanotpalaiH||276||
kArShikaistailakuDavo dviguNAmalakIrasaH| siddhaH sa pratimarshaH syAt sarvamUrdhagadApahaH||277||
(palitaghno visheSheNa kRuShNAtreyeNa bhAShitaH|) kShIraM priyAlayaShTyAhve jIvakAdyo gaNastilAH||278||
kRuShNA vaktre pralepaH syAddharilomanivAraNaH| tilAH sAmalakAshcaiva ki~jjalko madhukaM madhu||279||
bRuMhayedra~jjayecaitat keshAnmUrdhapralepanAt| pacetsaindhavashuktAmlairayashcUrNaM sataNDulam||280||
tenAliptaM shiraH shuddhamasnigdhamuShitaM nishi| tat prAtastriphalAdhautaM syAt kRuShNamRudumUrdhajam||281||
ayashcUrNo~amlapiShTashca rAgaH satriphalo varaH| kuryAccheSheShu rogeShu kriyAM svAM svAccikitsitAt| sheSheShvAdau ca nirdiShTA siddhau cAnyA pravakShyate||282||
iti khAlityAdicikitsA
sarpIMShyuparibhaktAni svarabhede~anilAtmake| tailaishcatuShprayogaishca balArAsnAmRutAhvayaiH||283||
barhitittiridakShANAM pa~jcamUlashRutAn rasAn| mAyUraM kShIrasarpirvA pibettryUShaNameva vA||284||
paittike tu virekaH syAt payashca madhuraiH shRutam| sarpirguDA ghRutaM tiktaM jIvanIyaM vRuShasya vA||285||
kaphaje svarabhede tu tIkShNaM mUrdhavirecanam| vireko vamanaM dhUmo yavAnnakaTusevanam||286||
cavyabhArgyabhayAvyoShakShAramAkShikacitrakAn| lihyAdvA pippalIpathye tIkShNaM madyaM pibecca saH||287||
raktaje svarabhede tu saghRutA jA~ggalA rasAH| drAkShAvidArIkShurasAH saghRutakShaudrasharkarAH||288||
yaccoktaM kShayakAsaghnaM tacca sarvaM cikitsitam| pittajasvarabhedaghnaM sirAvedhashca raktaje||289||
sannipAte hitAH sarvAH kriyA na tu sirAvyadhaH| ityuktaM svarabhedasya samAsena cikitsitam||290||

bhavanti cAtra- vAtapittakaphA nRUNAM bastihRunmUrdhasaMshrayAH| tasmAttatsthAnasAmIpyAddhartavyA vamanAdibhiH||291||

Commentary: uktAnuktacikitsArthamAha- vAtapittakaphA ityAdi| bastihRunmUrdhasaMshrayA iti yathAsa~gkhyena| tatsthAnasAmIpyAdIti vAtAdisthAneShu bastyAdiShu ca vamanAdInAM karmaNAM madhye yasya karmaNaH samIpadoShaharaNarUpaM sAmarthyaM bhavati tena karmaNA hartavyA iti||291||

adhyAtmaloko vAtAdyairloko vAtaravIndubhiH| pIDyate dhAryate caiva vikRutAvikRutaistathA||292||

Commentary: vAtAdInAmeva vikRutAvikRutAnAM dehapIDakadhArakatvaM sadRuShTAntamAha- adhyAtmetyAdi| adhyAtmalokaH cetanalokaH| loka iti jagat| atra dRuShTAnte industhAnIyaH shleShmA, ravisthAnIyaM pittam| vikRutaiH pIDyate, avikRutairdhAryate iti vyavasthA||292||

viruddhairapi na tvete guNairghnanti parasparam| doShAH sahajasAtmyatvAdviShaM ghoramahIniva||293||

Commentary: doShANAM parasparaguNavirodhAt sambhUya kAryakaraNe yathA virodho na bhavati tadAha- viruddhairapIti|- parasparaviruddhairapi, yathA- shleShmaNaH snehapaicchilyagauravAdInAM vAtaguNai raukShyalAghavAdibhirviparItAnAM ca parasparopaghAtakatvaM yaddRuShTaM tadiha doShasaMsarge na bhavati| kuto na ghnantItyAha- sahajasAtmyatvAditi; svAbhAvikasAtmyIbhAvAdityarthaH, sAtmyIbhAvo~anupaghAtakatvam| ayaM ca svabhAvaH karmajanyo vA bhavatu vastusvabhAvAdhIno vA ubhayathA vA bhavatu, tathA~apyacintya eva; dRuShTatvAcca nAtra yuktibAdhA prabhavati; tena parasparaguNopaghAtavyabhicArashcandrikAkRutA sushrute prapa~jcitaH sa na bhavati| viruddhasyApyanupaghAte dRuShTAntamAha- ghoraM viShamahIniveti||293||

tatra shlokaH- trimarmajAnAM rogANAM nidAnAkRutibheShajam| vistareNa pRuthagdiShTaM trimarmIye cikitsite||294||

Commentary: trimarmajAnAmiti sa~ggraho vyaktaH||294||
sekAvagAhAH shishirAH pradehA graiShmo vidhirbastipayovirekAH| drAkShAvidArIkShurasairghRutaishca kRucchreShu pittaprabhaveShu kAryAH||49||
shatAvarIkAshakushashvadaMShTrAvidArishAlIkShukasherukANAm| kvAthaM sushItaM madhusharkarAbhyAM yuktaM pibet paittikamUtrakRucchrI||50||
pibet kaShAyaM kamalotpalAnAM shRu~ggATakAnAmathavA vidAryAH| daNDairakANAmathavA~api mUlaM pUrveNa kalpena tathA~ambu shItam||51||
ervArubIjaM trapuShAt kusumbhAt saku~gkumaH syAdvRuShakashca peyaH| drAkShArasenAshmarisharkarAsu sarveShu kRucchreShu prashasta eShaH||52||
ervArubIjaM madhukaM sadAru paitte pibettaNDuladhAvanena| dArvIM tathaivAmalakIrasena samAkShikAM pittakRute tu kRucchre||53||
kShAroShNatIkShNauShadhamannapAnaM svedo yavAnnaM vamanaM nirUhAH| takraM satiktauShadhasiddhatailamabhya~ggapAnaM kaphamUtrakRucchre||54||
vyoShaM shvadaMShTrAtruTisArasAsthi kolapramANaM madhumUtrayuktam| pibettruTiM kShaudrayutAM kadalyA rasena kaiDaryarasena vA~api||55||
takreNa yuktaM shitivArakasya bIjaM pibet kRucchravinAshahetoH| pibettathA taNDuladhAvanena pravAlacUrNaM kaphamUtrakRucchre||56||
saptacchadAragvadhakebukailAdhavaM kara~jjaM kuTajaM guDUcIm| paktvA jale tena pibedyavAgUM siddhaM kaShAyaM madhusaMyutaM vA||57||

sarvaM tridoShaprabhave tu vAyoH sthAnAnupUrvyA prasamIkShya kAryam| tribhyo~adhike prAgvamanaM kaphe syAt pitte virekaH pavane tu bastiH||58||

Commentary: sarvamityAdi| etadeva vAtAdibheShajaM militaM tridoShaprabhave kRucchre kartavyam| tacca sameShvapi doSheShu vAyoH sthAnAnupUrvyA cikitsitaM kartavyaM, na jvara iva tridoShabhave kaphasthAnAnupUrvyA kartavyaM; mUtrakRucchrasya samatridoShArabdhatve~api vAtasthAnabhavatvena vAyureva prathamaM cikitsya iti bhAvaH| viShamasannipAtArabdhe kriyAmAha- tribhyo~adhike ityAdi| tribhyo~adhike iti granthaH kaphe tathA pitte tathA pavane ityanena ca krameNa sambadhyate||58||

dvivraNIye dvisa~gkhyAvacchinnarogacikitsAbhidhAnAnantaraM trisa~gkhyAvacchinnashirobastihRudayamarmarogacikitsAbhidhAnArthaM trimarmIyacikitsita ucyate| trimarmashabdena hi trimarmAshritA rogAstasyopacArashcAbhidhIyate; tena trimarmIyarogAnadhikRutya kRutaM cikitsitaM trimarmIyacikitsitam||1-2||

kriyA hitA seti yA kaphamArutotthe kRucchre vihitA sA militaiva sharkarAyAmashmaryAM ca kartavyA| kharAshvA ajamodA| cUrNaM pibedityatra jalenaiva pAnam| ikShurakaH kokilAkShaH| kunduruH svanAmakhyAtaH| triphalAdvibhAgamiti triphalAyAH pratyekaM mUlabhAgAd bhAgadvayam| amlairiti kA~jjikAdibhiH| ashuktairiti shuktavarjitaiH| madyaM cAtrAmlagrahaNagRuhItamapi bastishodhanatvAdashamarIbhedakatvaprakarShakhyApanArthaM punarucyate| ashmabhiditi ashmarIbhedI| sitopalA sharkarA| shalyaviduddharediti shalyashAstravettA taduktavidhAnenAshmarImAkarShet| samIkShya doShamiti doShamulbaNaM samIkShya| pratikarma kuryAt pratikarma cikitsitam| madhvasanAkhyaparNyau madhuparNI guDUcI, asanaparNI aparAjitA, ‘dAruparNI’ ityapare| saMsargaje iti tridoShAnugate| viha~ggaH pakShI||59-72||

khAdediti asiddhAnyeva khAdet| ghRutaM shvadaMShTretyAdau sAhacaryAt kecicchvadaMShTrAsvarasamapyaShTaguNaM vadanti; tanna, svarasaH snehasama eva sneheShu bhavati, uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “kalkAccaturguNaH snehaH, svarasaH snehasammitaH” iti; tena kShIravat sarvasneheShu svarasavidhAnaM j~jeyam| sthirAdikAnAmityAdau katakAdiH madhuraskandhe (vi.a.8) “...katakakAshmarya... ” ityAdinokto gaNo j~jeyaH| vidhinaiva teneti pUrvaghRutavidhinaiva; tena shvadaMShTrAsthAne sthirAdIni pratyekaM kalpanIyAni| svAduphalotthiteneti madhUkAkShoTAdiphalaniShpannena tailena||73-75||

ityanenAtra samAsaH| vaivarNyetyAdau hRudrogajA iti vacanAddhRudrogAnantarakAlabhAvitayA vaivarNyAdInAmupadravatvamicchanti; ye tu vaivarNyAdInAM sAmAnyahRudrogalakShaNatvamAhuH, te hRudrogeNa samaM jAyante iti hRudrogajA iti vigrahAlli~ggatvaM vyutpAdayanti| hRudrogAshca kiyantaHshirasIye (sU.a.17) vistareNoktA api cikitsAprakaraNAdiha sa~gkShepeNAbhidhIyante| marmeti hRudayam||77-80||

tailamityAdinA yathAkramaM cikitsAmAha| tailAdInAmatra samabhAgAnAM peyatvaM j~jeyam| vayaHkayastheti vayaHsthAkAyasthayorguDUcyAmalakayoH svarasagrahaNam| agryasarpiriti atrAgryapadamasya sarpiShaH prAdhAnyakhyApanArtham| vikartikeha hRudayaparikartikAkArA vedanA| kvAthaH kRuta ityAdau nAgarAdInAM kalkaM pauShkarAdikvAthe prakShepamAhuH| pathyAshatItyAdau yamakena bhRuShTaH kalkaH guDaprasannAlavaNaishca peya iti vyAkhyeyam| dve triphale ityatra drAkShAkAshmaryaparUShakANi dvitIyA triphalA| truTiH sUkShmailA||81-89||

shItA ityAdi pittahRudrogacikitsitam| kShate iti kShatakShINacikitsite| shreyasI rAsnA| kharjUraM kharjUraphalam| kShaudrAnvitamiti sAdhanottarakAlaM pAdikamadhuyuktam| svAduphaletyAdau svarasA iti rasAH||90-95||

svinnasyetyAdi kaphajahRudrogacikitsAdhikAraH| sha~gkarANIti kalyANakarANI| udumbaretyAdau udumbarAdikvAthe bhAgatraye trivRuttryUShaNacUrNaM pAdikaM prakShepyam| ashishirAmbuyukta iti uShNasalilAnupAnaH| kalpavidhAnadiShTamiti rasAyane vihitam; kalpashabdena ca kShudrarasAyanamucyate| prAsha iti cyavanaprAshaH| Agastyamiti lehavisheShaNam||96-99||

bhukte~adhikamityAdinA sAnnipAtikahRudroge prAyobhAvishUlaM lakShaNabhedena vibhaja~jcikitsati| bhukte~adhikamityAdinA shleShmashUlamucyate| sthitamiti prashAntam| jIrNe~adhikamityAdinA anilashUlaM, jIryatyadhikamityanena ca paittikaM brUte| phalairiti drAkShAkAshmaryAdibhiH| triShvevetyAdinA sAnnipAtikashUlamAha| mUlavirecanaM trivRunmUlAdibhirvirecanam| atra virecanopapattimAha- prAyo~anila ityAdi| atra cAnilakope yadyapi bastirucitaH, tathA~apyAmAshayApekShayA~a~amAshayashodhanaM virecanameva deyam||101-102||-

prakRutapradhAnamarmatrayamavadhArayati- saptottaramityAdi| sharIrasa~gkhyAmadhikRutyeti sharIrasa~gkhyAshArIre (shA.a.7) uktamadhikRutyetyarthaH| hRudayAdimarmaprAdhAnye hetumAha- prANAshrayAditi| hRudayAdInAM prANAshrayatve evopapattimAha- tAnItyAdi| hRudayAdyupaghAtena yasmAdvisheShataH prANopaghAto bhavati, tasmAd hRudayAdyAshritAH prANA ucyante; yathA bhittyupaghAtopahanyamAnaM citraM bhittyAshrayamucyate| tatsaMshritAnAmiti prANAshrayANAM hRudayAdInAM; saMshritashabdena hi saMshraya ucyate| mahAnto gadA yeShu bhavanti teShAM mahAgadAnAM bastyAdInAmanupAlanArthaM rakShAM shRuNu; kiMvA tatsaMshritAnAmiti bastyAdisaMshritAnAM prANAnAmanupAlanArthaM, mahAgadAnAM mahAmarmabastyAdivyApakodAvartAdInAM, rakShAmiti cikitsAm||3-4||

kramAgatashirorogacikitsAyAM vaktavyAyAM shirorogapradhAnatvAdbhUrishirorogahetutvAcca pratishyAyameva tAvadAha| shAlAkye~apyuktaM- “bhUyiShThaM vyAdhayaH sarve pratishyAyanimittajAH| tasmAdrogaH pratishyAyaH pUrvamevopadishyate” iti| yadyapi rAjayakShmacikitsite pratishyAya ukta eva, tathA~api tatra yakShmapUrvarUpatayoktaH, iha tu svatantraH pratishyAya ucyata iti visheShaH| rajaH dhUliH| atisvapnaH divAsvapnaH| avashyAyaH tuShAraH| saMstyAnadoShe iti ghanIbhUtadoShe| ghrANArtItyAdinA vAtAdipratishyAyAnAM caturNAM kramAllakShaNamAha| sasvaramUrdharoga iti svararogaH svarabhedaH| kaphAdgururityAdau gurushabdaH kaNDUvisheShaNam| srotasIti nAsAsrotasi||104-106||-

sarvo~ativRuddha ityAdinA pratishyAyajAn kShavathvAdInAha| atra mukharogaM ye na paThanti te shirorogagrahaNenaiva mukharogasya grahaNamiti manyante| eShAM tu duShTapratishyAyakShavathvAdInAM shAlAkyAdiShu vistaraH, atra tu parAdhikAratvAt sa~gkShepa eva||107-109||

rodhAbhighAtetyAdinA duShTapratishyAyAdInAmarjunalomaparyantAnAM krameNa lakShaNAnyAha| kruddha ityAdau sa iti anilaH| mastulu~ggAditi mastiShkAt| kuryAt sapitta ityAdinA aruMShikAmAha; sA tu shirobhavA j~jeyA||110-117||

bastyAdijAnAM yathAkramaM hetvAdimAha- kaShAyetyAdi| UShaNaH kaTukaH| pakvAshaye ityAdinA udAvartasamprAptili~ggacikitsitAni prAha| nanu kathamapAnaH kupito~apAnasyaiva sa~ggaM karotIti mArutasa~ggashabdenocyate? brUmaH- AtmanaivAyaM duShTaH samyagapravartamAna AtmanaH sa~ggaM karotItyucyate, yathA mana eva manonigrahaM karoti| uktaM ca “indriyAbhigrahaH karma manasaH svasya nigrahaH” (shA.a.1) iti| Urdhvashceti UrdhvagamanasvabhAvaH||5-10||

niShpatanamiti mukhasrAvaH| tRuShNetyAdi pittajamukharogalakShaNam| shAlAkye prapa~jcoktamukharogANAmatraiva caturvidhamukharoge~antarbhAvaM darshayannAha- saMsthAnetyAdi| saMsthAnaM sthAnamoShThAdi, dUShyaM raktAdi, AkRutiH li~ggaM, nAma shItAdAdi, eShAM bhedAd vikalpAccatuHShaShTividhA bhavanti, te ca shAlAkye evonneyAH| sushrute pa~jcaShaShTimukharogA uktAH, tathA~apIha vaidehamatAnusAreNAdUrAntareNeyaM catuHShaShTiH| yathApradeshamiti yathAcikitsApradesham||119-123||

AsyarogAntarniviShTatvAdevArocakAnAha| yadyapi rAjayakShmacikitsite~apyarocakA uktAH, tathA~api shoShoktArocakebhyaH pRuthagutpannA evArocakA abhidhIyanta iti na paunaruktyam| atilobhenAtrArucirucyate, tatrAtilobhena kRutaM satatAbhyAsamarucikAraNaM darshayati| vibaddhasambaddhayutamiti bandhayuktamityarthaH| naikarasamiti anekarasam||124-126||
nAdo~atirugityAdinA karNarogAnAha| ete ca shAlAkye yadyapyaShTAviMshatiruktAH, tathA~apIha caturShveva karNarogeShu sheShANAmapyavarodho vyAkhyeyaH, sheShANAmapi vAtAdijanyatvAt||127-128||

alpastu rAga ityAdinA catvAro~akShirogA abhidhIyante| upadehaH dUShikA| subhRushoShNavAhIti atyarthoShNasrAvI| anuktanetrAmayAnAM sa~gkhyAmAha- netrAmayAH ShaNNavatiriti| netrAmayeShu AcAryANAM vipratipattiH; netrarogANAM ShaTsaptatiM videhaH prAha, karAlastu ShaNNavatim, ashItiM sAtyakiH prAha| teShu karAlamatenaivaitadabhidhAnam, uktaM ca tatra- “viMshatiH sapta vartmasthA, nava sandhau prakIrtitAH| trayodasha tu shuklasthAH, ShaDrogAH kRuShNabhAgajAH|| viMshatiH pa~jca dRuShTisthAH, ShoDashaiva ca sarvagAH” iti| eteShAM j~jAnopAyamAha- teShAmityAdi| abhivyaktiriti lakShaNam| netrarogaprapa~jcAnabhidhAne hetumAha- parAdhikAreShvityAdi||129-131||

tailajvaranAshanAktamiti shItajvaranAshanAgurvAdyAktam| shyAmetyAdiphalavartau shyAmA trivRudbhedaH| dashabhAgA mAShasya yasyAM sA dashabhAgamAShA| dvirlavaNAmiti dvibhAgalavaNAm| guDenetivacanena yAvatA guDena vartiH kartuM yujyate tAvanmAno guDo deyaH| yAvashUkairityantena dvitIyA vartirguDainaiva kartavyA| sha~gkhinI shvetabuhnA| rADhaH madanaphalam| veshmadhUmaH agAradhUmaH| rakShoghnaH sarShapaH| karahATaH madanaH| teShAM vighAte iti phalavarticUrNanAmuktAnAM kAryAkaraNe| UrdhvAnulomauShadhaM vamanavirecanauShadham| vAte~adhika ityAdinA doShabhedena bastAvAvApamAha| udAvarte pittakaphau vAtakopitAveva j~jeyau| sa iti pUrvokto bastiH||11-17||
dviruttaretyAdau yathottaraM dravyANAM dvaiguNyam| suvarcikA svarjikAkShAraH| sukhAmbunA ‘pItam’ iti sheShaH| ugragandhA ajamodA||20-22||
phalaM ca mUlaM ca virecanoktamiti dIrgha~jjIvitIye (sU.a.1) mUlinIphalinIvirecanakarmaNyuktaM; kiMvA kalpe virecanayogeShu vakShyamANam||24-25||
hRudityAdinA udAvartasyaiva hetulakShaNavisheShakRutAmAnAhasa~jj~jAM pradarshya tatra bheShajamAha||26-31||

teja ityAdinA khAlityalakShaNamAha| tejaHshabdena dehoShmA~abhimataH; sa vAtAdyairyuktaH khAlityAdi karotIti yojanIyam| ye tu ‘tejaH savAtaM’ iti paThanti, te tejaHshabdena pittamapi varNayanti| hariprabhatvamiti kapilatvam| shiroruhANAmiti keshAnAm| ashUnyatArthamiti asya kAyacikitsAshAstrasya shAlAkyAbhidheyarogairashUnyatArtham| bheShajasa~ggrahamiti bheShajAbhidhAyakaM grantham||132-133||

athaiteShAM kramAccikitsA~abhidhIyate| pratishyAye dhUmasya niShedho vairecanikadhUmAbhiprAyeNa kRutaH, teneha snaihikadhUmAbhidhAnaM na virodhi| pANisvedaM ca upanAhanaM ceti pANisvedopanAhanam| kShavathusrAvarodhAdAvityatra rodhashabdena pratInAho~abhidhIyate| sa~gkarAdayaH sa~gkaraprastarAdayaH svedAdhyAyoktAH svedAH| tarkArI jayantI| srotaHshRu~ggATanAsAkShishoShe iti ghrANashrotrAkShitarpaNInAM sirANAM sannipAtaH shRu~ggATakaH| nAvanaM tailamuktamAhaprabhAvyAje ityAdi| taduShmaNeti ajAkShIroShmaNA piShTasvedane mandotsvinnAn| sayaShThyAhvacUrNAniti yaShTyAhvacUrNasyApradhAnatvAt tilacUrNAt pAdikatvam| tenaiva pIDayediti ajAkShIreNa| evaM niShpannatailasya dashamUlaniShkvAthAdibhirdashakRutvaH pAkAt siddhaM tailamaNutailaM syAt; aNutA cAsya aNusrotonusAritvAt, tacceha bhAvanayA pAkabhUyastvena niShpIDanavisheSheNa ca kriyate| uktaM hi videhe- “bhAvanAt pAcanAdvA~api tailAnAmaNutailatA| mardanAdapi sarveShAM dehAnAmaNutailatA” iti| siddhAmletyAdinA AhArAcArAvAha| nivAtoShNapratishraya iti nivAtoShNagRuhasthAyI||134-143||
paitte sarpiH pibet siddhamityatra shRu~ggaverasiddhameva sarpirdeyam| raktapittaghnA iti raktapittacikitsoktAH| mandapitte iti IShatpitte||144-148||

deyaM kaphaghnavamanamiti kaphaghnadravyakRutaM vamanaM deyamityarthaH| kaTubhiH phalairiti maricapippalyAdibhiH| pAkAnmukte iti pAkAvasAnAccyute| vyAhate vega iti pInasasya vege mandIbhUte| shophe ceti nAsAshophe||149-157||

dashamUletyAdau dashamUlAdibhiH pratyekaM tripalamAnaiH samaM mayUraM pakShAdivarjitaM jaladroNe eva pacet| jaladroNo hyatra kvAthArthaM pAdAvasheShaH san ghRutaprasthAccaturguNo bhavati| ki~jca dashamUlAdInAM catvAriMshatpalena mayUreNaikena samamadUrAntaraM catuHShaShTipalaM kvAthyaM droNamAne jale deyam| kiMvA dashamUlAdInAM mayUreNa ca militvA yAvat kvAthyaM bhavati taccaturguNaM jalamutsargaparibhAShayaiva deyam| madhurairiti jIvanIyagaNauktairdashabhiH, jIvanIyAni hi madhuratvaprakarShAdiha madhurashabdenocyante||158-165||

etenaiveti dashamUlAdimayUrakvAthena yathoktavidhAnakRutena| dvitIyakharjUrashabdena kharjUraphalaM gRuhyate| akShoTavAtAmAdIni auttarApathikAni| pUrvayogoktakvAthavidhAnaM yadyapyetenaiva kaShAyeNetyAdinA siddhaM, tathA~api punaH pUrvakalpeneti vacanena yathAlAbhamitipadena ca yathAlAbhaM karaNIyatvaM kalka eva, na kvAthe iti darshayati| atra prayogabhede jatUkarNaH- “tatkvAthocitashikhinaM dashamUlashreyasIbalAmadhukaistripalaiH saha sarpiShA jIvanIyakarShaiH pacet payasA kvAthe~asminneva catuShke prasthaM ghRutaM yathAlAbhaM jIvanabRuMhaNavAtAmAkShoTatriphalApUgamadhukaiH kharjUratAlamastakatvagelApauShkarashvadaMShTrAtAmalakIbisabhArgIkaserushRu~ggATakamRuNAla rAsnAsthirAsama~ggAshRu~ggyajaDAbhiH saha tu mAyUraM catuShprayogAdUrdhvajatrugadeShvamRutavat” iti| atra mayUrasthAne mUShakAdIn darshayannAha- AkhubhirityAdinA| AkhunA mayUrApekShayA svalpamAnenApyatraikenApi sAdhanaM kartavyamityAhuH||166-175||
shRutairvetyatra kShIrashRutaiH| sarpishca nasyamityatra avapIDasya pashcAt sarpiShA nasyaM deyam||176-179||

kaphAnilodbhave dAha ityatra kaphodbhave anilodbhave ca sushrutavacanAllalATasha~gkhadeshe dAhaH kartavyaH| uktaM hi sushrute- “shirorogAdhimanthaprabhRutiShu bhrUlalATasha~gkhapradesheShu dahet” (su.sU.a.12) iti| gandhairakuShThatagarairiti agurvAdigandhaiH, kuShThatagaravarjanaM cAtra mastulu~ggasrAvavarjanArtham| uktaM ca shAlAkye- “natakuShThe srAvayato dhUmavartiprayojite| mastulu~ggaM prakarSheNa tasmAtte naiva yojayet” iti| vyAghrakarajaH nakhI| kShavathuH chikkAkArakaH||180-186||-
vyAyAmetyAdinA bastyAshrayarogeShu mUtrakRucchrANyAha| pRuthagityAdinA vAtapittakaphasannipAtajAnAM mUtrakRucchrANAM samprAptimAha| tIvrA hi rugityAdinA caturNAM pratyekaM rUpamAha||32-35||

kadambapuShpAkRutyAdayo visheShA yathAyogyatayA doShabhedAdunneyAH| tatra vAtena kadambapuShpAkRutistripuTI ca, pittenAshmatulyA shlakShNA, mRudvI kaphena shukreNa ca| kShobhAt kShata iti ashmarIkShobhAnmUtramArge bastau vA kShate| tasyA iti ashmaryAH| vyapAyAditi mUtramArgApagamAt| sukhamiti nirvedanam||37-38||-

eShetyAdinA sharkarAmAha| bhinnamUrtiriti aNurUpatayA bheditamUrtiH| ata eva mUtrapathAt kSharantItyuktam| tena vAtena dvidhA tridhA bhinnA~anekadhA vA~ashmarI mUtrapathena kSharantI sharkareva bhavati||39-41||

kShatetyAdinA raktajaM mUtrakRucchramAha| kShatajamiti raktam| kShayAdvA prakopitamiti ativyavAyAcchukrakShaye sati vAyunodIrya bastimAnItam| AdhmAtatAmiti bastipUrNatAm| tasminniti rakte atisa~jcite| evaM sUtrasthAnoddiShTA aShTau mUtraghAtA mUtrakRucchrashabdeneha nirdishya vyAkRutAH| ye tu trimarmIyasiddhau trayodasha mUtrAghAtA vaktavyAste sUtrasthAne~asUtritA api ekAdashakShudrakuShThavadantarbhAvanIyAH| mUtrAghAtamUtrakRucchrayoshcAyaM visheShaH- yanmUtrakRucchre mUtraM kRucchreNa vahati, mUtrAghAte mUtraM shoShyate pratihanyate vA; sushrute~api ca mUtrakRucchramUtrAghAtayorvisheSho~adhyAyabhedenaivoktaH| anye tu mUtrakRucchravisheShAneva mUtrAghAtAnAhuH, yathAyogyatayA vAtapittAdicaturShu mUtrakRucchreShu mUtrAghAtAnantarbhAvayanti; tena na pRutha~gmUtrAghAtAbhidhAnam||43-44||

shuktetyAdi mukharogacikitsitam| shuddhiradha iti virecanam| dArvItvagiti dArvyAstvag| rujApahamiti rogapIDAharam| pa~jcakoletyAdau cUrNasamudAyAdguDo dviguNaH| karkandhUmAtrA iti aShTamAShakamAnAH| kecid rodhrasthAne lohaM paThanti; uktaM hi shAlAkye- “pAThA rasA~jjanaM vyoShaM tejohvA triphalA~agnikaH| gRuhadhUmo yavakShAro shastraM cUrNaM tu kAlakam” iti| vAtapittakaphApahA iti pratyekameva kAlAdayastrayo yogAstridoShaharAH| rasakriyeti ghanIbhUtarasasya sa~jj~jA| tAlushoShe ityAdau atRuShNasyetipadena tRuShNAyuktasya tAlushoShe auttarabhaktikamapi sarpiHpAnaM niShedhayati| tAlushoShe ca “tRuShNAmUrcchAparItAshca garbhiNyastAlushoShiNaH” (sU.a.13) ityAdinA yadyapi snehapAnaM niShiddhaM, tathA~apIha auttarabhaktikaM sarpirvisheShavidhAnAt kartavyameva| sirAkarmeti sirAvyadhanaM; tacca sushrutavacanAt tAluni jihvAyAM ca kartavyam||187-205||

tulAmityAdinA khadirAdiguTikAmAha| dviguNAmarimedasa iti viTkhadirasya tu tule dve eva| patta~ggaM raktacandanam| lava~ggAdInAmatra palamAnatvam| dantAsyagalarogAH shAlAkyoktA j~jeyAH| parAyaNamiti paramayanaM shreShThaM bheShajamiti yAvat| iti mukharogacikitsA||206-214||
arocakacikitsAmAha- arucAvityAdi| kuShThetyAdinA ardhashlokoktAshcatvAro yogA vAtapittakaphasannipAtajeShvarocakeShu kramAjj~jeyAH||215-220||

varATakAnityAdau tadbhasmeti varATakadAhabhasma| shcyotayet gAlayet| gandhatailamiti sugandhadravyakalkayuktaM tailaM, kiMvA gandhadravyAdhivAsitaM tilodbhavaM tailam| shuShkamUlaketyAdike kShArataile madhushuktaM caturguNamiti madhupradhAnaM shuktaM caturguNam| shuktaM ca “yanmastvAdi shucau bhANDe saguDakShaudranAgaram| dhAnyarAshau trirAtrasthaM shuktaM cukraM taducyate” iti| mAtulu~ggakadalIrasau telasamau| anye tu madhushuktAvubhAvapi dApayanti; tatra madhu tailasamaM, shuktaM tu caturguNamiti vadanti; tannAtihRudaya~ggamaM, yato jatUkarNe madhu na paThyata eva, madhunaH shuktagrahaNenaiva gRuhItatvAt| uktaM ca- “mUlakabhasmashatAhvAdvikShAravacAcaturlavaNakuShThadArurasA~jjananAgarashobhA~jjanahi~ggughanabhUrjairmAtulu~ggakadalIrasaishcaturguNashuktaistailaM vipakvaM shrutinAdabAdhiryashUlajantughnam” iti||221-230||

utpannamAtre ityAdinA netrarogacikitsitamAha| biDAlakaH netrabahirlepaH shAlAkye ucyate| nighRuShTamityAdau tadvaditi rasakriyetyarthaH| harItakI tadvaditi harItakIghRutayukto biDAlakaH| sannipAte tu sarvairiti pratyekavAtAdyuktabiDAlakadravyaiH pralepanaM kAryamityarthaH| netrA~jjanaM tryahAdityatra prAyo~akShirogANAM tryaheNa pAkAt tryahAdityuktam| pAkalakShaNaM tantrAntare- “prashastavartmatA cAkShNoH saMrambhAshruprashAntatA| mandavedanatA kaNDUH pakvAkShigadalakShaNam” iti| Ashcyotanam akShisekaH| sumanaHkorakAH jAtImukulakAH| shvetamaricaM shobhA~jjanabIjam| plavaH pakShivisheShaH prasevakagalaH| dvau ca pippalyarNavaphenayoriti shANAvityarthaH| citrAyAmiti citrAnakShatre| tApyo dhAtuH tApInadIbhavo mAkShikadhAtuH| cakShuShyA vanakulatthikA| pauShpama~jjanaM puShpA~jjanam| abhinnacakShuSha iti abhinnatArakasya| kRuShNasarpasyeti mRutakRuShNasarpasya||231-261||-

mUtrakRucchre cikitsAmAha- abhya~jjanetyAdi| sthirAdibhiH pa~jcamUlaiH| vAtaharairiti tatra tatra vAtaharatvena pratipAditaiH| pattUraH shAli~jcakA| ashmabhit pAShANabhedaH| anyAnIti eva~gguNAnyevAnyAni| tailaphalAni tilomAsphotAdIni||45-48||

khAlitye ityAdinA khAlityAdicikitsitamAha| harilomnIti kapilalomnI| sahacaraH jhiNTI| shilAsame bhANDe iti ashmamaye pAtre vA meShashRu~gge saMsthitaH| AdityaparNyA mUlAnIti AdityaparNI sUryAvartaH| kRuShNasairIyakaH kRuShNajhiNTI| somarAjI bAkucI| shastraM kRuShNaM loham| kRuShNapiNDitacitrakAviti kRuShNamadanakRuShNacitrakau| AdityapAkamiti AdityarashmisambandhAdeva pakvam| atra bhAgairiti bahuvacanAt pRuthagbhAge siddhe~api pRuthagiti padaM nyAyasiddhasyApi triphalApRuthagbhAgasya dyotanArtham| kalkabhUyastvaM cAtra vacanAdeva bhavannapi kalpanIyam| tilAH sAmalakA ityAdiyogAH keshara~jjakAH| pacet saindhavetyAdau saindhavAyashcUrNataNDulAnAM samatvam| shuddhamiti prakShAlitam| sheSheShu rogeShviti tRuTshvAsakAsajvararaktapittashoSheShu pInasopadravatayokteShu| sheSheShvAdau ca nirdiShTA ityatra sheShashabdena anuktatrimarmajarogagrahaNam| Adau nirdiShTA iti sAmAnyAdihaiva doShAnullekhena trimarmajarogoddiShTA cikitsA j~jeyA| siddhau cAnyA pravakShyate iti trimarmIyAyAM siddhau vakShyate||262-282||

sarpIMShyuparibhaktAnItyAdinA svabhedacikitsAmAha| vAtAdisvarabhedalakShaNaM yadyapIha noktaM, tathA~api rAjayakShmacikitsoktameva boddhavyam| yadyapi tatra cikitsoktA, tathA~apIha svarabhedasyAdhikRutatvAt punarapyucyate | catuShprayogairiti pAnAbhya~ggagaNDUShabastiprayogaiH| balArAsnAmRutAhvayatailAni vAtavyAdhau vakShyamANAni| tryUShaNaM kAsike proktam| jIvanIyaghRutaM vAtarakte vakShyamANam| vRuShaghRutaM raktapitacikitsoktam| pittajasvarabhedaghnaM cikitsitamiti sambandhaH| iti svarabhedacikitsA||283-290||

graiShmo vidhiriti tasyAshItIyokto grIShmavidhiH| tatra shishirAveva sekAvagAhau yadyapyuktau, tathA~api visheSheNa shishirasekAvagAhakaraNArthaM punarabhidhAnam| daNDairakA ‘hoggala’ iti khyAtA| pUrveNa kalpeneti kvAthena madhusharkarayoryogena ca||49-51||
trapuShAt kusumbhAdityatra bIjamiti sambadhyate||52-53||

kShAroShNetyAdi| kaphakRucchre kShArAdibhiryuktaM bheShajamannapAnaM ca prayojyam| vyoShaM trikaTukam| truTiH elA| sArasaH pakShI svanAmakhyAtaH| kolapramANamiti aShTamAShakamAnam| kaiTaryaH pArvato nimbaH| shitivArakaH shAli~jcaH||54-57||
athAta UrustambhacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
lihyAdvA madhunA cUrNamUrustambhArdito naraH|39|
yuktyA jA~ggalajairmAMsaiH purANaishcaiva shAlibhiH| rUkShaNAdvAtakopashcennidrAnAshArtipUrvakaH||40||
snehasvedakramastatra kAryo vAtAmayApahaH| pIluparNI payasyA ca rAsnA gokShurako vacA||41||
saralAgurupAThAshca tailamebhirvipAcayet| sakShaudraM prasRutaM tasmAda~jjaliM vA~api nA pibet||42||
kuShThashrIveShTakodIcyasaralaM dAru kesharam| ajagandhA~ashvagandhA ca tailaM taiH sArShapaM pacet||43||
sakShaudraM mAtrayA taccApyUrustambhArditaH pibet| (raukShyAnmukta UrustambhAttatashca sa vimucyate )||44||
dve pale saindhavAt pa~jca shuNThyA granthikacitrakAt| dve dve bhallAtakAsthIni viMshatirdve tathA~a~aDhake||45||
AranAlAt pacet prasthaM tailasyaitairapatyadam| gRudhrasyUrugrahArshortisarvavAtavikAranut||46||
palAbhyAM pippalImUlanAgarAdaShTakaTvaraH| tailaprasthaH samo dadhnA gRudhrasyUrugrahApahaH||47||
ityaShTakaTvaratailam
ityaShTakaTvaratailam ityAbhyantaramuddiShTamUrustambhasya bheShajam| shleShmaNaH kShapaNaM tvanyadbAhyaM shRuNu cikitsitam||48||
valmIkamRuttikA mUlaM kara~jjasya phalaM tvacam| iShTakAnAM tatashcUrNaiH kuryAdutsAdanaM bhRusham||49||
mUlairvA~apyashvagandhAyA mUlairarkasya vA bhiShak| picumardasya vA mUlairathavA devadAruNaH||50||
kShaudrasarShapavalmIkamRuttikAsaMyutairbhiShak| gADhamutsAdanaM kuryAdUrustambhe pralepanam||51||
dantIdravantIsurasAsarShapaishcApi buddhimAn| tarkArIshigrusurasAvishvavatsakanimbajaiH||52||
patramUlaphalaistoyaM shRutamuShNaM ca secanam| piShTaM tu sarShapaM mUtre~adhyuShitaM syAt pralepanam||53||
vatsakaH surasaM kuShThaM gandhAstumburushigrukau| hiMsrArkamUlavalmIkamRuttikAH sakuTherakAH||54||
dadhisaindhavasaMyuktaM kAryametaiH pralepanam| (UrustambhavinAshAya bhiShajA jAnatA kramam)||55||
shyonAkaM khadiraM bilvaM bRuhatyau saralAsanau| shobhA~jjanakatarkArIshvadaMShTrAsurasArjakAn||56||
agnimanthakara~jjau ca jalenotkvAthya secayet| pralepo mUtrapiShTairvA~apyUrustambhanivAraNaH||57||
kaphakShayArthaM shakyeShu vyAyAmeShvanuyojayet| sthalAnyAkrAmayet kalyaM sharkarAH sikatAstathA||58||
pratArayet pratisroto nadIM shItajalAM shivAm| sarashca vimalaM shItaM sthiratoyaM punaH punaH||59||
shleShmaNaH kShapaNaM yat syAnna ca mArutamAvahet ||60||
tat sarvaM sarvadA kAryamUrustambhasya bheShajam| sharIraM balamagniM ca kAryaiShA rakShatA kriyA||61||

tatra shlokaH- hetuH prAgrUpali~ggAni karmAyogyatvakAraNam| dvividhaM bheShajaM coktamUrustambhacikitsite||62||

Commentary: heturityAdisa~ggrahaH| karmAyogyatvakAraNamiti pa~jcakarmAyogyatve hetuH ‘vRuddhaye shleShmaNa’ ityAdinokto j~jeyaH| dvividhamiti AntaraM bAhyaM ca| bheShajamiti auShadham||62||
shriyA paramayA brAhmayA parayA ca tapaHshriyA| ahInaM candrasUryAbhyAM sumerumiva parvatam||3||
dhIdhRutismRutivij~jAnaj~jAnakIrtikShamAlayam| agnivesho guruM kAle saMshayaM paripRuShTavAn||4||
bhagavan pa~jca karmANi samastAni pRuthak tathA| nirdiShTAnyAmayanAM hi sarveShAmeva bheShajam||5||
doShajo~astyAmayaH kashcidyasya tAni bhiShagvara!| na syuH shaktAni shamane sAdhyasya kriyayA sataH||6||
astyUrustambha ityukte guruNA tasya kAraNam| sali~ggabheShajaM bhUyaH pRuShTastenAbravIdguruH||7||
snigdhoShNalaghushItAni jIrNAjIrNe samashnataH| dravashuShkadadhikShIragrAmyAnUpaudakAmiShaiH||8||
piShTavyApannamadyAtidivAsvapnaprajAgaraiH| la~gghanAdhyashanAyAsabhayavegavidhAraNaiH||9||
snehAccAmaM citaM koShThe vAtAdInmedasA saha| ruddhvA~a~ashu gauravAdUrU yAtyadhogaiH sirAdibhiH||10||
pUrayan sakthija~gghoru doSho medobalotkaTaH| avidheyaparispandaM janayatyalpavikramam||11||
mahAsarasi gambhIre pUrNe~ambu stimitaM yathA| tiShThati sthiramakShobhyaM tadvadUrugataH kaphaH||12||
gauravAyAsasa~gkocadAharuksuptikampanaiH | bhedasphuraNatodaishca yukto dehaM nihantyasUn||13||
UrU shleShmA samedasko vAtapitte~abhibhUya tu| stambhayetsthairyashaityAbhyAmUrustambhastatastu saH||14||
prAgrUpaM dhyAnanidrAtistaimityArocakajvarAH| lomaharShashca chardishca ja~gghorvoH sadanaM tathA||15||

vAtasha~gkibhiraj~jAnAttasya syAt snehanAt punaH| pAdayoH sadanaM suptiH kRucchrAduddharaNaM tathA||16||

Commentary: Urustambhe snehaprayogajaM doShamAha- vAtasha~gkibhirityAdi| vAtasha~gkA cAsmin suptisa~gkocAdivAtasamAnali~ggadarshanAdbhavati| asya saMsnehanadoShAH kRucchrAduddharaNaM tathetyantenektAH||16||
ja~gghoruglAniratyarthaM shashvaccAdAhavedanA| padaM ca vyathate nyastaM shItasparshaM na vetti ca||17||
saMsthAne pIDane gatyAM cAlane cApyanIshvaraH| anyaneyau hi sambhagnAvUrU pAdau ca manyate||18||
yadA dAhArtitodArto vepanaH puruSho bhavet| UrustambhastadA hanyAt sAdhayedanyathA navam||19||
tasya na snehanaM kAryaM na bastirna virecanam| na caiva vamanaM yasmAttannibodhata kAraNam||20||
vRuddhaye shleShmaNo nityaM snehanaM bastikarma ca| tatsthasyoddharaNe caiva na samarthaM virecanam||21||
kaphaM kaphasthAnagataM pittaM ca vamanAt sukham| hartumAmAshayasthau ca sraMsanAttAvubhAvapi||22||
pakvAshayasthAH sarve~api bastibhirmUlanirjayAt| shakyA na tvAmamedobhyAM stabdhA ja~gghorusaMsthitAH||23||
vAtasthAne hi tacchaityAddvayoH stambhAcca tadgatAH| na shakyAH sukhamuddhartuM jalaM nimnAdiva sthalAt||24||
tasya saMshamanaM nityaM kShapaNaM shoShaNaM tathA| yuktyapekShI bhiShak kuryAdadhikatvAtkaphAmayoH||25||
sadA rUkShopacArAya yavashyAmAkakodravAn| shAkairalavaNairdadyAjjalatailopasAdhitaiH||26||
suniShaNNakanimbArkavetrAragvadhapallavaiH| vAyasIvAstukairanyaistiktaishca kulakAdibhiH||27||
kShArAriShTaprayogAshca harItakyAstathaiva ca| madhUdakasya pippalyA UrustambhavinAshanAH||28||
sama~ggAM shAlmalIM bilvaM madhunA saha nA pibet| tathA shrIveShTakodIcyadevadArunatAnyapi||29||
mustaM harItakIM lodhraM padmakaM tiktarohiNIm||30||
devadAru haridre dve vacAM kaTukarohiNIm| pippalIM pippalImUlaM saralaM devadAru ca||31||
cavyaM citrakamUlAni devadAru harItakIm| bhallAtakaM samUlAM ca pippalIM pa~jca tAn pibet||32||
shAr~ggeShTAM madanaM dantIM vatsakasya phalaM vacAm ||33||
mUrvAmAragvadhaM pAThAM kara~jjaM kulakaM tathA| pibenmadhuyutaM tulyaM cUrNaM vA vAriNA~a~aplutam||34||
sakShaudraM dadhimaNDairvA~apyUrustambhavinAshanam| mUrvAmativiShAM kuShThaM citrakaM kaTurohiNIm||35||
pUrvavadgugguluM mUtre rAtristhitamathApi vA| svarNakShIrImativiShAM mustaM tejovatIM vacAm||36||
surAhvaM citrakaM kuShThaM pAThAM kaTukarohiNIm| lehayenmadhunA cUrNaM sakShaudraM vA jalAplutam||37||
phalIM vyAghranakhaM hema pibedvA madhusaMyutam| triphalAM pippalIM mustaM cavyaM kaTukarohiNIm||38||

trimarmIye ca bahUn rogAn pa~jcakarmasAdhyAn dRuShTvA pa~jcakarmAsAdhye Urustambhe jAtasmaraNa AcArya UrustambhacikitsitamevAha; bhavati hi virodhidarshanAt tadvirodhismaraNaM, yathA nakulasmaraNAt sarpasmaraNam||1-2||

AvasthikaM kramamAha- apatarpaNaja ityAdinA| rUkShaNAdityAdinA snehavidhAnamAvasthikaM, tena sAmAnyenAtra vihitasnehaniShedhena samaM na virodhaH, asya vidherapavAdatvAt| pIluparNI moraTaH, rAsnAbheda ityanye| sakShaudramiti pAdikakShaudram| ajagandhA ajamodA| bhallAtakAsthIni viMshatiriti AkRutimAnena| palAbhyAmiti pippalyAdisamudAyAt palAbhyAm| aShTakaTvara iti tailAdaShTaguNaM kaTvaraM yasmin tailaprasthe sa aShTakaTvaraH; kaTvaraM takram||39-47||

picumardaH nimbaH| dravantI dantIbhedaH| tarkArI jayantI| gandhA iti agurvAdyuktA iha grAhyAH| kuTherakaH parNAsaH| shakyeShu voDhuM shakyeShu| kalyamiti prAtaH| shivAmiti hiMsrajalajanturahitAM sugamyAM ca| nanu jalaprataraNaM kathamasya shleShmakShayakaraM bhavati? yasmAjjalasambandhamAtreNa shleShmavRuddhireva prAptA| ucyate- jalena bahirnirgacchadUShmaNo niruddhasyAntaHpraveshAcchleShmasa~gghAtabhedanaM bhavati, tathA prataraNakriyayA shleShmA vicchidyate, samAnAbhimatA kriyA~apyatra yogyatvAt kriyata eva| uktaM hi- “bhavet kadAcit kAryA~api viruddhAbhimatA kriyA” (ci.a.30) iti||48-59||-
anuktacikitsAparigrahArthamAha- shleShmaNa ityAdi||60-61||

ahInamiti sarvadA yuktam| samastAnIti militAni| doShaja iti padaM mAnasAgantunirAsArthaM; tannirAsastu tayoH pa~jcakarmAviShayatayA prasiddhatvAt| tathA doShajasyApyasAdhyasya sAdhane pa~jcakarmANi na samarthAnIti tannirAsArthamAha- sAdhyasyetyAdi| sAdhyasya sata iti sambandhaH| bhUya Urustambhasya kAraNAdIni pRuShTo gururabravIditi sambandhaH| jIrNAjIrNe iti stokajIrNasheShAjIrNa ityarthaH| AmaM citamiti rasasheSharUpaM, koShThopalepanApyAmaM sa~jcitaM, medasA saheti medaHsahitamAmaM vAtAdInAM rodhakaM j~jeyam| AmaM ca UruM gacchat tridoShasahitameva yAti| sirAdibhiriti sirAdhamanIsrotobhiH| doSho medobalotkaTa iti doSha AmasaMruddho vAtAdiH| yadA ‘doShamedotkaTa’ iti pAThaH, tadA~a~amasya visheShaNam| sakthigraheNaiva yadyapi ja~gghorvorgrahaNaM prAptaM, tathA~api tayorabhidhAnaM visheSheNa tatpUraNopadarshanArtham| avidheyaparispandamiti asvAdhInendriyam, alpavikramamiti alpakriyamakriyaM vA karotItyarthaH| mahAsarasItyAdidRuShTAntena UrustambhArambhakapradhAnasya kaphasya prabalatAmAha| yadyapi, Urustambhasya tridoShajanyatvamiha tathA sUtrasthAne~api “eka Urustambha AmatridoShasamutthAnaH” (sU.a.19) ityanenoktaM, tathA~api kaphaprAdhAnyAdatra kapha upadiShTaH| ata evAgre Uru shleShmetyAdinA UrustambhashabdaniruktimutpAdasAmagrIM cAha| sthairyashaityAbhyAmityanena stambhanakriyAyAM sthairyashaityayoH kaphaguNayoH kAraNatAM darshayati||3-15||

ja~gghoruglAnirityAdi tu lakShaNaM bhinnasAmagrIkaM brUte| anye tu sarvamevaitadUdrdhvAdhaHkRutasnehanaprayogadoShakRutamasAdhyalakShaNamAhuH| shashvaccAdAhavedaneti IShaddAhavedanA, anye tu dAhavarjitavedanAmAhuH||17-19||

samprati snehabastyAdipratiShedhopapattimAha- tasyetyAdi| snehasya doSho yadyapi prAgevoktaH, tathA~apIdAnIM yathA taddoShakArakaM snehanaM bhavati tathA pratipAdyate| shirovirecanaM cAtra sarvathaivAsambhAvyamAnatvAdeva nopanyastamiti j~jeyam| snehanamiti pAnAbhya~ggAbhyAM sneham| bastikarma ceti snehabastikarma, tasyaiva shleShmavRuddhikaratvAt| kiMvA bastikarmavisheShaNaM snehanamiti padaM, tenAnuvAsanameva labhyate; nirUhastu virecanashabdenaiva shodhanAbhidhAyinA gRuhItaH; ata eva UrustambhadoShoddharaNAsamarthashodhanavivaraNe eva nirUho~apyatroktaH| uktadoShaharaNAsAmarthyaM vamanavirecananirUhANAM krameNa vivRuNvannAha- shleShmasthAnagata ityAdi| hartuM sukhamiti vibhaktili~ggavipariNAmAdvakShyamANe~api yojanIyam| tAvubhAviti nirhartumasukhAviti pUrvavadyojanIyam| sarve~api vAtapittashleShmANaH| mUlanirjayAditipadaM vamanAdityanena tathA bastibhirityanena ca yojyaM; mUlanirjayAditi mUlacchedAt| vamanAdInAM sAdhyaM viShayaM darshayitvA asAdhyaM viShayamAha- shakyA ityAdi| tathA~a~amamedasaH stabdhatvena vamanAdInAM ja~gghorusthAne~asamarthatvaM j~jeyam| UrustambhadoShasya vamanAdyahAryatve hetvantaramAha- vAtasthAne ityAdi| vAtasthAne iti ja~gghorurUpe vAtasthAne| tacchaityAditi vAtashaityAt||20-24||

cikitsAmAha- tasyetyAdi| tasyorustambhasya shamanaM kartavyaM na shodhanamityarthaH| kShapaNaM shoShaNamAmakaphayoH kuryAditi yojanA; tatra kShapaNaM sarvathocchedena, shoShaNaM dravabhAgavishoShaNam| vAyasI kAkamAcI| kulakaM kAravellakam| shAlmalaM shAlmalIveShTakam| etAni madhunA pibediti sambandhaH||25-29||-
mustamityAdikAH pa~jca yogA ardhashlokoktA UrugrahApahAH||30-32||-

shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA| svAdukaNTakaM vika~gkatam| pUrvavaditi pUrveNa sambadhyate| gugguluM ca mUtre uShitaM pibediti yojyam| jalAplutaM ‘pibet’ iti sheShaH| phalI nyagrodhaH| hema nAgakesharam||33-38||-
athAto vAtavyAdhicikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
hetusthAnavisheShAcca bhavedrogavisheShakRut|24|
