bradhnahRudrogagulmArshaHpArshvashUlaM ca mArute| sarvA~ggakupite vAte gAtrasphuraNabha~jjane||25||
vedanAbhiH parItashca sphuTantIvAsya sandhayaH| graho viNmUtravAtAnAM shUlAdhmAnAshmasharkarAH||26||
ja~gghorutrikapAtpRuShTharogashoShau gudasthite| hRunnAbhipArshvodararuktRuShNodgAravisUcikAH||27||
kAsaH kaNThAsyashoShashca shvAsashcAmAshayasthite| pakvAshayastho~antrakUjaM shUlATopau karoti ca||28||
kRucchramUtrapurIShatvamAnAhaM trikavedanAm| shrotrAdiShvindriyavadhaM kuryAdduShTasamIraNaH||29||
tvagrUkShA sphuTitA suptA kRushA kRuShNA ca tudyate| Atanyate sarAgA ca parvaruk tvaksthite~anile||30||
rujastIvrAH sasantApA vaivarNyaM kRushatA~aruciH| gAtre cArUMShi bhuktasya stambhashcAsRuggate~anile||31||
gurva~ggaM tudyate~atyarthaM daNDamuShTihataM tathA| saruk shramitamatyarthaM mAMsamedogate~anile||32||
bhedo~asthiparvaNAM sandhishUlaM mAMsabalakShayaH| asvapnaH santatA ruk ca majjAsthikupite~anile||33||
kShipraM mu~jcati badhnAti shukraM garbhamathApi vA| vikRutiM janayeccApi shukrasthaH kupito~anilaH||34||
bAhyAbhyantaramAyAmaM khalliM kubjatvameva ca| sarvA~ggaikA~ggarogAMshca kuryAt snAyugato~anilaH||35||
sharIraM mandarukshophaM shuShyati spandate tathA| suptAstanvyo mahatyo vA sirA vAte sirAgate||36||
vAtapUrNadRutisparshaH shothaH sandhigate~anile| prasAraNAku~jcanayoH pravRuttishca savedanA||37||
ativRuddhaH sharIrArdhamekaM vAyuH prapadyate| yadA tadopashoShyAsRugbAhuM pAdaM ca jAnu ca||38||
tasmin sa~gkocayatyardhe mukhaM jihmaM karoti ca| vakrIkaroti nAsAbhrUlalATAkShihanUstathA||39||
tato vakraM vrajatyAsye bhojanaM vakranAsikam | stabdhaM netraM kathayataH kShavathushca nigRuhyate||40||
dInA jihmA samutkShiptA kalA sajjati cAsya vAk| dantAshcalanti bAdhyete shravaNau bhidyate svaraH||41||
pAdahastAkShija~gghorusha~gkhashravaNagaNDaruk | ardhe tasminmukhArdhe vA kevale syAttadarditam||42||
manye saMshritya vAto~antaryadA nADIH prapadyate| manyAstambhaM tadA kuryAdantarAyAmasa~jj~jitam||43||
antarAyamyate grIvA manyA ca stabhyate bhRusham| dantAnAM daMshanaM lAlA pRuShThAyAmaH shirograhaH||44||
...bahirAyAma ucyate)||45||
pRuShThamanyAshritA bAhyAH shoShayitvA sirA balI| vAyuH kuryAddhanustambhaM bahirAyAmasa~jj~jakam||46||
cApavannAmyamAnasya pRuShThato nIyate shiraH| ura utkShipyate manyA stabdhA grIvA~avamRudyate||47||
dantAnAM dashanaM jRumbhA lAlAsrAvashca vAggrahaH| jAtavego nihantyeSha vaikalyaM vA prayacchati||48||

hanumUle sthito bandhAt saMsrayatyanilo hanU| vivRutAsyatvamathavA kuryAt stabdhamavedanam||49||

Commentary: hanustambhasa~gkocayorlakShaNamAha- hanumUle sthita ityAdi| saMsrayatIti cyAvayati| vivRutAsyatvamathaveti atrAthavAshabdena saMvRutavaktratA pAkShikI cApekShate| saMstabhyeti nishcalIkRutya saMvRutamukhatAM karoti| etaddvayamapi hanustambha eva||49||-

muhurAkShipati kruddho gAtrANyAkShepako~anilaH||50||

Commentary: muhurityAdi AkShepalakShaNam||50||-

pANipAdashiraHpRuShThashroNIH stabhnAti mArutaH||51||

Commentary: pANipAdaM ca saMshoShyetyAdi daNDAkShepakasamprAptikathanam| pANipAdashira ityAdi daNDakalakShaNam||51||-

svasthaH syAdarditAdInAM muhurvege gate~agate||52||

Commentary: arditAdInAM daNDakAntAnAM samAnaM rUpamAha- svasthaH syAdityAdi| arditahanustambhAdiShu yatra muhurmuhurvegitvaM dRushyate tadarditAntargatameva j~jeyam||52||-
hatvaikaM mArutaH pakShaM dakShiNaM vAmameva vA||53||
kuryAcceShTAnivRuttiM hi rujaM vAkstambhameva ca| gRuhItvA~ardhaM sharIrasya sirAH snAyUrvishoShya ca||54||
pAdaM sa~gkocayatyekaM hastaM vA todashUlakRut| ekA~ggarogaM taM vidyAt sarvA~ggaM sarvadehajam||55||
sphikpUrvA kaTipRuShThorujAnuja~gghApadaM kramAt| gRudhrasI stambharuktodairgRuhNAti spandate muhuH||56||
vAtAdvAtakaphAttandrAgauravArocakAnvitA| khallI tu pAdaja~gghorukaramUlAvamoTanI||57||

sarveShveteShu saMsargaM pittAdyairupalakShayet||58||

Commentary: anuktanakhabhedAdiparigrahArthamAha- sthAnAnAmityAdi| sheShAn nakhabhedAdIn nakhagulphAdInAmanurUpairli~ggairbhedashUlAdibhirnirdishediti j~jeyam| kicit ‘sthAnanAmAnurUpaiH’ iti paThanti| tatra nakhasthAnAnurUpaM bhedasa~jj~jAnurUpaM ca li~ggaM nakhasphuTanarUpaM bhavati| evaM cAparavAtavikAreShvapi mahArogokteShu sthAnAnurUpali~ggayogo~anusartavyaH|58|-
vAyordhAtukShayAt kopo mArgasyAvaraNena ca (vA)| vAtapittakaphA dehe sarvasroto~anusAriNaH||59||
vAyureva hi sUkShmatvAddvayostatrApyudIraNaH | kupitastau samuddhUya tatra tatra kShipan gadAn||60||
li~ggaM pittAvRute dAhastRuShNA shUlaM bhramastamaH ||61||
kaTvamlalavaNoShNaishca vidAhaH shItakAmitA| shaityagauravashUlAni kaTvAdyupashayo~adhikam||62||
la~gghanAyAsarUkShoShNakAmitA ca kaphAvRute| raktAvRute sadAhArtistva~gmAMsAntarajo bhRusham||63||
bhavet sarAgaH shvayathurjAyante maNDalAni ca| kaThinAshca vivarNAshca piDakAH shvayathustathA||64||
harShaH pipIlikAnAM ca sa~jcAra iva mAMsage| calaH snigdho mRuduH shItaH shopho~a~ggeShvarucistathA||65||
ADhyavAta iti j~jeyaH sa kRucchro medasA~a~avRutaH| sparshamasthnA~a~avRute tUShNaM pIDanaM cAbhinandati||66||
sambhajyate sIdati ca sUcIbhiriva tudyate| majjAvRute vinAmaH syAjjRumbhaNaM pariveShTanam||67||
shUlaM tu pIDyamAne ca pANibhyAM labhate sukham| shukrAvego~ativego vA niShphalatvaM ca shukrage||68||
bhukte kukShau ca rugjIrNe shAmyatyannAvRute~anile| mUtrApravRuttirAdhmAnaM bastau mUtrAvRute~anile||69||
varcaso~ativibandho~adhaH sve sthAne parikRuntati| vrajatyAshu jarAM sneho bhukte cAnahyate naraH||70||
cirAt pIDitamannena duHkhaM shuShkaM shakRut sRujet| shroNIva~gkShaNapRuShTheShu rugvilomashca mArutaH||71||
sandhicyutirhanustambhaH ku~jcanaM kubjatA~arditaH||72||
pakShAghAto~a~ggasaMshoShaH pa~ggutvaM khuDavAtatA| stambhanaM cADhyavAtashca rogA majjAsthigAshca ye||73||
ete sthAnasya gAmbhIryAdyatnAt sidhyanti vA na vA| navAn balavatastvetAn sAdhayennirupadravAn||74||
kriyAmataH paraM siddhAM vAtarogApahAM shRuNu| kevalaM nirupastambhamAdau snehairupAcaret||75||
vAyuM sarpirvasAtailamajjapAnairnaraM tataH| snehaklAntaM samAshvAsya payobhiH snehayet punaH||76||
yUShairgrAmyAmbujAnUparasairvA snehasaMyutaiH| pAyasaiH kRusharaiH sAmlalavaNairanuvAsanaiH||77||
nAvanaistarpaNaishcAnnaiH susnigdhaM svedayettataH| svabhyaktaM snehasaMyuktairnADIprastarasa~gkaraiH||78||
tathA~anyairvividhaiH svedairyathAyogamupAcaret| snehAktaM svinnama~ggaM tu vakraM stabdhamathApi vA||79||
shanairnAmayituM shakyaM yatheShTaM shuShkadAruvat| harShatodarugAyAmashothastambhagrahAdayaH||80||
svinnasyAshu prashAmyanti mArdavaM copajAyate| snehashca dhAtUnsaMshuShkAn puShNAtyAshu prayojitaH||81||
balamagnibalaM puShTiM prANAMshcApyabhivardhayet| asakRuttaM punaH snehaiH svedaishcApyupapAdayet||82||
yadyanena sadoShatvAt karmaNA na prashAmyati||83||
mRudubhiH snehasaMyuktairauShadhaistaM vishodhayet| ghRutaM tilvakasiddhaM vA sAtalAsiddhameva vA||84||
payasairaNDatailaM vA pibeddoShaharaM shivam| snigdhAmlalavaNoShNAdyairAhArairhi malashcitaH||85||
sroto baddhvA~anilaM rundhyAttasmAttamanulomayet | durbalo yo~avirecyaH syAttaM nirUhairupAcaret||86||
pAcanairdIpanIyairvA bhojanaistadyutairnaram| saMshuddhasyotthite cAgnau snehasvedau punarhitau||87||
svAdvamlalavaNasnigdhairAhAraiH satataM punaH| nAvanairdhUmapAnaishca sarvAnevopapAdayet||88||
visheShatastu koShThasthe vAte kShAraM pibennaraH||89||
pAcanairdIpanairyuktairamlairvA pAcayenmalAn| gudapakvAshayasthe tu karmodAvartanuddhitam||90||
AmAshayasthe shuddhasya yathAdoShaharIH kriyAH| sarvA~ggakupite~abhya~ggo bastayaH sAnuvAsanAH||91||
svedAbhya~ggAvagAhAshca hRudyaM cAnnaM tvagAshrite| shItAH pradehA raktasthe vireko raktamokShaNam||92||
vireko mAMsamedaHsthe nirUhAH shamanAni ca| bAhyAbhyantarataH snehairasthimajjagataM jayet||93||
harSho~annapAnaM shukrasthe balashukrakaraM hitam| vibaddhamArgaM dRuShTvA vA shukraM dadyAdvirecanam||94||
viriktapratibhuktasya pUrvoktAM kArayet kriyAm| garbhe shuShke tu vAtena bAlAnAM cApi shuShyatAm||95||
sitAkAshmaryamadhukairhitamutthApane payaH| hRudi prakupite siddhamaMshumatyA payo hitam||96||
matsyAnnAbhipradeshasthe siddhAn bilvashalATubhiH| vAyunA veShTyamAne tu gAtre syAdupanAhanam||97||
tailaM sa~gkucite~abhya~ggo mAShasaindhavasAdhitam| bAhushIrShagate nasyaM pAnaM cauttarabhaktikam||98||
ardite nAvanaM mUrdhni tailaM tarpaNameva ca||99||
nADIsvedopanAhAshcApyAnUpapishitairhitAH| svedanaM snehasaMyuktaM pakShAghAte virecanam||100||
antarAkaNDarAgulphaM sirA bastyagnikarma ca| gRudhrasIShu prayu~jjIta khallyAM tUShNopanAhanam||101||
pAyasaiH kRusharairmAMsaiH shastaM tailaghRutAnvitaiH| vyAttAnane hanuM svinnAma~gguShThAbhyAM prapIDya ca||102||
pradeshinIbhyAM connAbhya cibukonnAmanaM hitam| srastaM svaM gamayetsthAnaM stabdhaM svinnaM vinAmayet||103||

sarpistailavasAmajjasekAbhya~jjanabastayaH ||104||

Commentary: anuktavisheShacikitsopagrahaNArthamAha- pratyekamityAdi| sthAnaM pakvAshayAdi, dUShyaM rasaraktAdi, AdigrahaNAdAvaraNagrahaNam| sthAnadUShyApekShaH kriyAvisheShastu ‘koShThasthe’ ityAdinaivoktaH|104|-
snigdhAH svedA nivAtaM ca sthAnaM prAvaraNAni ca| rasAH payAMsi bhojyAni svAdvamlalavaNAni ca||105||
balAyAH pa~jcamUlasya dashamUlasya vA rase||106||
ajashIrShAmbujAnUpamAMsAdapishitaiH pRuthak| sAdhayitvA rasAn snigdhAndadhyamlavyoShasaMskRutAn||107||
bhojayedvAtarogArtaM tairvyaktalavaNairnaram| etairevopanAhAMshca pishitaiH samprakalpayet||108||
ghRutatailayutaiH sAmlaiH kShuNNasvinnairanasthibhiH| patrotkvAthapayastailadroNyaH syuravagAhane||109||
svabhyaktAnAM prashasyante sekAshcAnilarogiNAm| AnUpaudakamAMsAni dashamUlaM shatAvarIm||110||
kulatthAn badarAnmAShAMstilAnrAsnAM yavAn balAm| vasAdadhyAranAlAmlaiH saha kumbhyAM vipAcayet||111||
nADIsvedaM prayu~jjIta piShTaishcApyupanAhanam| taishca siddhaM ghRutaM tailamabhya~ggaM pAnameva ca||112||
mustaM kiNvaM tilAH kuShThaM surAhvaM lavaNaM natam| dadhikShIracatuHsnehaiH siddhaM syAdupanAhanam||113||
utkArikAvesavArakShIramAShatilaudanaiH| eraNDabIjagodhUmayavakolasthirAdibhiH||114||
sasnehaiH sarujaM gAtramAlipya bahalaM bhiShak| eraNDapatrairbadhnIyAdrAtrau kalyaM vimokShayet||115||
kShIrAmbunA tataH siktaM punashcaivopanAhitam| mu~jcedrAtrau divAbaddhaM carmabhishca salomabhiH||116||
phalAnAM tailayonInAmamlapiShTAn sushItalAn| pradehAnupanAhAMshca gandhairvAtaharairapi||117||
rUkShashuddhAnilArtAnAmataH snehAn pracakShmahe||118||
vividhAn vividhavyAdhiprashamAyAmRutopamAn| droNe~ambhasaH pacedbhAgAn dashamUlAccatuShpalAn||119||
yavakolakulatthAnAM bhAgaiH prasthonmitaiH saha| pAdasheShe rase piShTairjIvanIyaiH sasharkaraiH||120||
tathA kharjUrakAshmaryadrAkShAbadaraphalgubhiH| sakShIraiH sarpiShaH prasthaH siddhaH kevalavAtanut||121||
niratyayaH prayoktavyaH pAnAbhya~jjanabastiShu| citrakaM nAgaraM rAsnAM pauShkaraM pippalIM shaTIm||122||
piShTvA vipAcayet sarpirvAtarogaharaM param| balAbilvashRute kShIre ghRutamaNDaM vipAcayet||123||
tasya shuktiH praku~jco vA nasyaM mUrdhagate~anile| grAmyAnUpaudakAnAM tu bhitvA~asthIni pacejjale||124||
taM snehaM dashamUlasya kaShAyeNa punaH pacet| jIvakarShabhakAsphotAvidArIkapikacchubhiH||125||
vAtaghnairjIvanIyaishca kalkairdvikShIrabhAgikam| tatsiddhaM nAvanAbhya~ggAttathA pAnAnuvAsanAt||126||
sirAparvAsthikoShThasthaM praNudatyAshu mArutam| ye syuH prakShINamajjAnaH kShINashukraujasashca ye||127||
balapuShTikaraM teShAmetat syAdamRutopamam| tadvatsiddhA vasA nakramatsyakUrmaculUkajA||128||
pratyagrA vidhinA~anena nasyapAneShu shasyate| prasthaH syAttriphalAyAstu kulatthakuDavadvayam||129||
kRuShNagandhAtvagADhakyoH pRuthak pa~jcapalaM bhavet| rAsnAcitrakayordve dve dashamUlaM palonmitam||130||
jaladroNe pacet pAdasheShe prasthonmitaM pRuthak| surAranAladadhyamlasauvIrakatuShodakam||131||
koladADimavRukShAmlarasaM tailaM vasAM ghRutam| majjAnaM ca payashcaiva jIvanIyapalAni ShaT||132||
kalkaM dattvA mahAsnehaM samyagenaM vipAcayet| sirAmajjAsthige vAte sarvA~ggaikA~ggarogiShu||133||
vepanAkShepashUleShu tadabhya~gge prayojayet| nirguNDyA mUlapatrAbhyAM gRuhItvA svarasaM tataH||134||
tena siddhaM samaM tailaM nADIkuShThAnilArtiShu| hitaM pAmApacInAM ca pAnAbhya~jjanapUraNam||135||
mUlakasvarase kShIrasame sthApyaM tryahaM dadhi||136||
tasyAmlasya tribhiH prasthaistailaprasthaM vipAcayet| yaShTyAhvasharkarArAsnAlavaNArdrakanAgaraiH||137||
pa~jcamUlakaShAyeNa piNyAkaM bahuvArShikam||138||
paktvA tasya rasaM pUtvA tailaprasthaM vipAcayet| payasA~aShTaguNenaitat sarvavAtavikAranut||139||
saMsRuShTe shleShmaNA caitadvAte shastaM visheShataH| yavakolakulatthAnAM shreyasyAH shuShkamUlakAt||140||
bilvAccA~jjalimekaikaM dravairamlairvipAcayet| tena tailaM kaShAyeNa phalAmlaiH kaTubhistathA||141||
sarvavAtavikArANAM tailAnyanyAnyataH shRuNu||142||
catuShprayogANyAyuShyabalavarNakarANi ca| rajaHshukrapradoShaghnAnyapatyajananAni ca||143||
niratyayAni siddhAni sarvadoShaharANi ca| sahAcaratulAyAshca rase tailADhakaM pacet||144||
mUlakalkAddashapalaM payo dattvA caturguNam| siddhe~asmi~jcharkarAcUrNAdaShTAdashapalaM bhiShak||145||
vinIya dAruNeShvetadvAtavyAdhiShu yojayet| shvadaMShTrAsvarasaprasthau dvau samau payasA saha||146||
ShaTpalaM shRu~ggaverasya guDasyAShTapalaM tathA| tailaprasthaM vipakvaM tairdadyAt sarvAnilArtiShu||147||
jIrNe taile ca dugdhena peyAkalpaH prashasyate| balAshataM guDUcyAshca pAdaM rAsnAShTabhAgikam||148||
jalADhakashate paktvA dashabhAgasthite rase| dadhimastvikShuniryAsashuktaistailADhakaM samaiH||149||
pacet sAjapayo~ardhAMshaiH kalkairebhiH palonmitaiH| shaTIsaraladArvelAma~jjiShThAgurucandanaiH||150||
padmakAtiviShAmustasUrpaparNIhareNubhiH| yaShTyAhvasurasavyAghranakharShabhakajIvakaiH||151||
palAsharasakastUrInalikAjAtikoShakaiH| spRukkAku~gkumashaileyajAtIkaTuphalAmbubhiH||152||
tvacAkundurukarpUraturuShkashrInivAsakaiH | lava~gganakhakakkolakuShThamAMsIpriya~ggubhiH||153||
sthauNeyatagaradhyAmavacAmadanapallavaiH| sanAgakesharaiH siddhe kShipeccAtrAvatArite||154||
patrakalkaM tataH pUtaM vidhinA tat prayojayet| shvAsaM kAsaM jvaraM hikkAM chardiM gulmAn kShataM kShayam||155||
plIhashoShAvapasmAramalakShmIM ca praNAshayet| balAtailamidaM shreShThaM vAtavyAdhivinAshanam||156||
amRutAyAstulAH pa~jca droNeShvaShTasvapAM pacet||157||
pAdasheShe samakShIraM tailasya dvyADhakaM pacet| elAmAMsInatoshIrasArivAkuShThacandanaiH||158||
balAtAmalakImedAshatapuShpardhijIvakaiH | kAkolIkShIrakAkolIshrAvaNyatibalAnakhaiH||159||
mahAshrAvaNijIvantIvidArIkapikacchubhiH| shatAvarImahAmedAkarkaTAkhyAhareNubhiH||160||
vacAgokShurakairaNDarAsnAkAlAsahAcaraiH| vIrAshallakimustatvakpatrarShabhakabAlakaiH||161||
sahailAku~gkumaspRukkAtridashAhvaishca kArShikaiH| ma~jjiShThAyAstrikarSheNa madhukAShTapalena ca||162||
kalkaistat kShINavIryAgnibalasammUDhacetasaH| unmAdAratyapasmArairArtAMshca prakRutiM nayet||163||
vAtavyAdhiharaM shreShThaM tailAgryamamRutAhvayam| (kRuShNAtreyeNa guruNA bhAShitaM vaidyapUjitam)||164||
rAsnAsahasraniryUhe tailadroNaM vipAcayet| gandhairhaimavataiH piShTairelAdyaishcAnilArtinut||165||
kalpo~ayamashvagandhAyAM prasAraNyAM balAdvaye| kvAthakalkapayobhirvA balAdInAM pacet pRuthak||166||
iti rAsnAtailam mUlakasvarasaM kShIraM tailaM dadhyamlakA~jjikam| tulyaM vipAcayet kalkairbalAcitrakasaindhavaiH||167||
pippalyativiShArAsnAcavikAgurushigrukaiH| bhallAtakavacAkuShThashvadaMShTrAvishvabheShajaiH||168||
puShkarAhvashaTIbilvashatAhvAnatadArubhiH| tatsiddhaM pItamatyugrAn hanti vAtAtmakAn gadAn||169||
iti mUlakAdyaM tailamvRuShamUlaguDUcyoshca dvishatasya shatasya ca| citrakAt sAshvagandhAcca kvAthe tailADhakaM pacet||170||
sakShIraM vAyunA bhagne dadyAjjarjarite tathA| prAktailAvApasiddhaM ca bhavedetadguNottaram||171||
rAsnAshirIShayaShTyAhvashuNThIsahacarAmRutAH||172||
syonAkadArushampAkahayagandhAtrikaNTakAH| eShAM dashapalAn bhAgAn kaShAyamupakalpayet||173||
tatastena kaShAyeNa sarvagandhaishca kArShikaiH| dadhyAranAlamAShAmbumUlakekShurasaiH shubhaiH||174||
pRuthak prasthonmitaiH sArdhaM tailaprasthaM vipAcayet| plIhamUtragrahashvAsakAsamArutaroganut ||175||
etanmUlakatailAkhyaM varNAyurbalavardhanamiti mUlakatailamyavakolakulatthAnAM matsyAnAM shigrubilvayoH| rasena mUlakAnAM ca tailaM dadhipayonvitam||176||
sAdhayitvA bhiShagdadyAt sarvavAtAmayApaham| lashunasvarase siddhaM tailamebhishca vAtanut||177||
tailAnyetAnyRutusnAtAma~gganAM pAyayeta ca| pItvA~anyatamameShAM hi vandhyA~api janayet sutam||178||
yacca shItajvare tailamagurvAdyamudAhRutam| anekashatashastacca siddhaM syAdvAtaroganut||179||
vakShyante yAni tailAni vAtashoNitake~api ca| tAni cAnilashAntyarthaM siddhikAmaH prayojayet||180||
nAsti tailAt paraM ki~jcidauShadhaM mArutApaham| vyavAyyuShNagurusnehAt saMskArAdvalavattaram||181||
gaNairvAtaharaistasmAcchatasho~atha sahasrashaH| siddhaM kShiprataraM hanti sUkShmamArgasthitAn gadAn||182||
kriyA sAdhAraNI sarvA saMsRuShTe cApi shasyate| vAte pittAdibhiH srotaHsvAvRuteShu visheShataH||183||
pittAvRute visheSheNa shItAmuShNAM tathA kriyAm| vyatyAsAt kArayet sarpirjIvanIyaM ca shasyate||184||
dhanvamAMsaM yavAH shAliryApanAH kShIrabastayaH| virekaH kShIrapAnaM ca pa~jcamUlIbalAshRutam||185||
madhuyaShTibalAtailaghRutakShIraishca secanam| pa~jcamUlakaShAyeNa kuryAdvA shItavAriNA||186||
kaphAvRute yavAnnAni jA~ggalA mRugapakShiNaH| svedAstIkShNA nirUhAshca vamanaM savirecanam||187||
jIrNaM sarpistathA tailaM tilasarShapajaM hitam| saMsRuShTe kaphapittAbhyAM pittamAdau vinirjayet||188||
AmAshayagataM matvA kaphaM vamanamAcaret||189||
pakvAshaye virekaM tu pitte sarvatrage tathA| svedairviShyanditaH shleShmA yadA pakvAshaye sthitaH||190||
pittaM vA darshayelli~ggaM bastibhistau vinirharet| shleShmaNA~anugataM vAtamuShNairgomUtrasaMyutaiH||191||
nirUhaiH pittasaMsRuShTaM nirharet kShIrasaMyutaiH| madhurauShadhasiddhaishca tailaistamanuvAsayet||192||
shirogate tu sakaphe dhUmanasyAdi kArayet| hRute pitte kaphe yaH syAduraHsroto~anugo~anilaH||193||
sasheShaH syAt kriyA tatra kAryA kevalavAtikI| shoNitenAvRute kuryAdvAtashoNitakIM kriyAm||194||
pramehavAtamedoghnImAmavAte prayojayet| svedAbhya~ggarasakShIrasnehA mAMsAvRute hitAH||195||
mahAsneho~asthimajjasthe pUrvavadretasA~a~avRute| annAvRute tadullekhaH pAcanaM dIpanaM laghu||196||
mUtralAni tu mUtreNa svedAH sottarabastayaH| shakRutA tailamairaNDaM snigdhodAvartavatkriyA ||197||
svasthAnastho balI doShaH prAk taM svairauShadhairjayet| vamanairvA virekairvA bastibhiH shamanena vA||198||
mArutAnAM hi pa~jcAnAmanyonyAvaraNe shRuNu||199||
li~ggaM vyAsasamAsAbhyAmucyamAnaM mayA~anagha!| prANo vRuNotyudAnAdIn prANaM vRuNvanti te~api ca||200||
udAnAdyAstathA~anyonyaM sarva eva yathAkramam| viMshatirvaraNAnyetAnyulbaNAnAM parasparam||201||
mArutAnAM hi pa~jcAnAM tAni samyak pratarkayet| sarvendriyANAM shUnyatvaM j~jAtvA smRutibalakShayam||202||
vyAne prANAvRute li~ggaM karma tatrordhvajatrukam| svedo~atyarthaM lomaharShastvagdoShaH suptagAtratA||203||
prANe vyAnAvRute tatra snehayuktaM virecanam| prANAvRute samAne syurjaDagadgadamUkatAH||204||
catuShprayogAH shasyante snehAstatra sayApanAH| samAnenAvRute~apAne grahaNIpArshvahRudgadAH||205||
shirograhaH pratishyAyo niHshvAsocchvAsasa~ggrahaH||206||
hRudrogo mukhashoShashcApyudAne prANasaMvRute| tatrordhvabhAgikaM karma kAryamAshvAsanaM tathA||207||
karmaujobalavarNAnAM nAsho mRutyurathApi vA| udAnenAvRute prANe taM shanaiH shItavAriNA||208||
si~jcedAshvAsayeccainaM sukhaM caivopapAdayet| urdhvagenAvRute~apAne chardishvAsAdayo gadAH||209||
syurvAte tatra bastyAdi bhojyaM caivAnulomanam| moho~alpo~agniratIsAra Urdhvage~apAnasaMvRute||210||
vAte syAdvamanaM tatra dIpanaM grAhi cAshanam| vamyAdhmAnamudAvartagulmArtiparikartikAH||211||
li~ggaM vyAnAvRute~apAne taM snigdhairanulomayet| apAnenAvRute vyAne bhavedviNmUtraretasAm||212||
atipravRuttistatrApi sarvaM sa~ggrahaNaM matam| mUrcchA tandrA pralApo~a~ggasAdo~agnyojobalakShayaH||213||
samAnenAvRute vyAne vyAyAmo laghubhojanam| stabdhatA~alpAgnitA~asvedashceShTAhAnirnimIlanam||214||
udAnenAvRute vyAne tatra pathyaM mitaM laghu| pa~jcAnyonyAvRutAnevaM vAtAn budhyeta lakShaNaiH||215||
eShAM svakarmaNAM hAnirvRuddhirvA~a~avaraNe matA| yathAsthUlaM samuddiShTametadAvaraNe~aShTakam||216||
sthAnAnyavekShya vAtAnAM vRuddhiM hAniM ca karmaNAm||217||
dvAdashAvaraNAnyanyAnyabhilakShya bhiShagjitam| kuryAdabhya~jjanasnehapAnabastyAdi sarvashaH||218||
udAnaM yojayedUrdhvamapAnaM cAnulomayet||219||
samAnaM shamayeccaiva tridhA vyAnaM tu yojayet| prANo rakShyashcaturbhyo~api sthAne hyasya sthitirdhruvA||220||
mUrcchA dAho bhramaH shUlaM vidAhaH shItakAmitA||221||
chardanaM ca vidagdhasya prANe pittasamAvRute| ShThIvanaM kShavathUdgAraniHshvAsocchvAsasa~ggrahaH||222||
prANe kaphAvRute rUpANyarucishchardireva ca| mUrcchAdyAni ca rUpANi dAho nAbhyurasaH klamaH||223||
ojobhraMshashca sAdashcApyudAne pittasaMvRute| AvRute shleShmaNodAne vaivarNyaM vAksvaragrahaH||224||
daurbalyaM gurugAtratvamarucishcopajAyate| atisvedastRuShA dAho mUrcchA cArucireva ca||225||
pittAvRute samAne syAdupaghAtastathoShmaNaH| asvedo vahnimAndyaM ca lomaharShastathaiva ca||226||
kaphAvRute samAne syAdgAtrANAM cAtishItatA| vyAne pittAvRute tu syAddAhaH sarvA~ggagaH klamaH||227||
gAtravikShepasa~ggashca sasantApaH savedanaH| gurutA sarvagAtrANAM sarvasandhyasthijA rujaH||228||
vyAne kaphAvRute li~ggaM gatisa~ggastathA~adhikaH | hAridramUtravarcastvaM tApashca gudameDhrayoH||229||
li~ggaM pittAvRute~apAne rajasashcAtivartanam| bhinnAmashleShmasaMsRuShTaguruvarcaHpravartanam||230||
lakShaNAnAM tu mishratvaM pittasya ca kaphasya ca||231||
upalakShya bhiShagvidvAn mishramAvaraNaM vadet| yadyasya vAyornirdiShTaM sthAnaM tatretarau sthitau||232||
doShau bahuvidhAn vyAdhIn darshayetAM yathAnijAn| AvRutaM shleShmapittAbhyAM prANaM codAnameva ca||233||
garIyastvena pashyanti bhiShajaH shAstracakShuShaH| visheShAjjIvitaM prANe udAne saMshritaM balam||234||
syAttayoH pIDanAddhAnirAyuShashca balasya ca| sarve~apyete~aparij~jAtAH parisaMvatsarAstathA||235||
hRudrogo vidradhiH plIhA gulmo~atIsAra eva ca||236||
bhavantyupadravAsteShAmAvRutAnAmupekShaNAt| tasmAdAvaraNaM vaidyaH pavanasyopalakShayet||237||
pa~jcAtmakasya vAtena pittena shleShmaNA~api vA| bhiShagjitamataH samyagupalakShya samAcaret||238||
anabhiShyandibhiH snigdhaiH srotasAM shuddhikArakaiH| kaphapittAviruddhaM yadyacca vAtAnulomanam||239||
sarvasthAnAvRute~apyAshu tat kAryaM mArute hitam| yApanA bastayaH prAyo madhurAH sAnuvAsanAH||240||
prasamIkShya balAdhikyaM mRudu vA sraMsanaM hitam| rasAyanAnAM sarveShAmupayogaH prashasyate||241||
shailasya jatuno~atyarthaM payasA guggulostathA| lehaM vA bhArgavaproktamabhyaset kShIrabhu~gnaraH||242||
abhayAmalakIyoktamekAdashasitAshatam | apAnenAvRute sarvaM dIpanaM grAhi bheShajam||243||
vAtAnulomanaM yacca pakvAshayavishodhanam| iti sa~gkShepataH proktamAvRutAnAM cikitsitam||244||
prANAdInAM bhiShak kuryAdvitarkya svayameva tat| pittAvRute tu pittaghnairmArutasyAvirodhibhiH| kaphAvRute kaphaghnaistu mArutasyAnulomanaiH||245||

loke vAyvarkasomAnAM durvij~jeyA yathA gatiH| tathA sharIre vAtasya pittasya ca kaphasya ca||246||

Commentary: vAtAdInAM durvij~jeyatAM dRuShTAntena darshayati- loka ityAdi|||246||

kShayaM vRuddhiM samatvaM ca tathaivAvaraNaM bhiShak| vij~jAya pavanAdInAM na pramuhyati karmasu||247||

Commentary: kShayamityAdau AvaraNamapi kShayavRuddhisambandhAntarnirdiShTameva, tathA~apyAvaraNasya visheShalakShaNacikitsArthaM pRuthagabhidhAnam| karmasviti cikitsAsu||247||
tatra shlokau- pa~jcAtmanaH sthAnavashAccharIre sthAnAni karmANi ca dehadhAtoH| prakopahetuH kupitashca rogAn sthAneShu cAnyeShu vRuto~avRutashca||248||
prANeshvaraH prANabhRutAM karoti kriyA ca teShAmakhilA niruktA| tAM deshasAtmyartubalAnyavekShya prayojayecchAstramatAnusArI||249||

vAyurAyurbalaM vAyurvAyurdhAtA sharIriNAm| vAyurvishvamidaM sarvaM prabhurvAyushca kIrtitaH||3||

Commentary: vAyorvikArAn j~jApayituM svabhAvaj~jAnAnantarIyakatvAdvikRutij~jAnasya svabhAvameva tAvadAha- vAyurityAdi| yadyapi sharIrendriyasattvAtmasaMyoga AyuH, tathA~api tAdRushasaMyoge pradhAnatvAt prakRutistho vAyurapyAyurucyate| evaM balasyApi heturvAyuriti kRutvA sharIrAdhAratayA balAdhAraheturvAyureva balamityuktaH| vishvatA prabhutA ca vAyorvAtakalAkalIye pratipAditaiva||3||

avyAhatagatiryasya sthAnasthaH prakRutau sthitaH| vAyuH syAtso~adhikaM jIvedvItarogaH samAH shatam||4||

Commentary: vAyorAyurhetutvaM darshayannAha- avyAhatetyAdi| avyAhatagatiH aparityaktasvamArgaH | sthAnastha iti na vimArgaH| prakRutau sthita iti akShINavRuddhaH| vItaroga iti nIrogaH||4||
prANodAnasamAnAkhyavyAnApAnaiH sa pa~jcadhA| dehaM tantrayate samyak sthAneShvavyAhatashcaran||5||
sthAnaM prANasya mUrdhoraHkaNThajihvAsyanAsikAH | ShThIvanakShavathUdgArashvAsAhArAdi karma ca||6||
udAnasya punaH sthAnaM nAbhyuraH kaNTha eva ca| vAkpravRuttiH prayatnaurjobalavarNAdi karma ca||7||
svedadoShAmbuvAhIni srotAMsi samadhiShThitaH| antaragneshca pArshvasthaH samAno~agnibalapradaH||8||
dehaM vyApnoti sarvaM tu vyAnaH shIghragatirnRuNAm| gatiprasAraNAkShepanimeShAdikriyaH sadA||9||
vRuShaNau bastimeDhraM ca nAbhyUrU va~gkShaNau gudam| apAnasthAnamantrasthaH shukramUtrashakRunti ca||10||
sRujatyArtavagarbhau ca yuktAH sthAnasthitAshca te| svakarma kurvate deho dhAryate tairanAmayaH||11||
vimArgasthA hyayuktA vA rogaiH svasthAnakarmajaiH| sharIraM pIDayantyete prANAnAshu haranti ca||12||
sa~gkhyAmapyativRuttAnAM tajjAnAM hi pradhAnataH| ashItirnakhabhedAdyA rogAH sUtre nidarshitAH||13||
tAnucyamAnAn paryAyaiH sahetUpakramA~jchRuNu| kevalaM vAyumuddishya sthAnabhedAttathA~a~avRutam||14||
rUkShashItAlpalaghvannavyavAyAtiprajAgaraiH| viShamAdupacArAcca doShAsRuksravaNAdati||15||
la~gghanaplavanAtyadhvavyAyAmAtiviceShTitaiH| dhAtUnAM sa~gkShayAccintAshokarogAtikarShaNAt||16||
duHkhashayyAsanAt krodhAddivAsvapnAdbhayAdapi| vegasandhAraNAdAmAdabhighAtAdabhojanAt||17||
marmAghAtAdgajoShTrAshvashIghrayAnApataMsanAt| dehe srotAMsi riktAni pUrayitvA~anilo balI||18||

avyaktaM lakShaNaM teShAM pUrvarUpamiti smRutam||19||

Commentary: avyaktaM lakShaNamityAdinA pUrvarUpamAha | AtmarUpamiti vartamAnarogarUpam| apAyo laghutA punariti vAtavyAdhInAmapAyo~apagamanaM sharIrasya laghutA vAtavyAdhili~ggavigamena, sharIrakalyateti yAvat; kiMvA apAyo laghutA na sarvathA vAtali~ggAbhAvaH, yena prakRutali~ggAni santyeva||19||-
sa~gkocaH parvaNAM stambho bhedo~asthnAM parvaNAmapi||20||
(agniveshAya guruNA kRuShNAtreyeNa bhAShitam)iti balAtailam
ityamRutAdyaM tailam
lomaharShaH pralApashca pANipRuShThashirograhaH| khA~jjyapA~ggulyakubjatvaM shoSho~a~ggAnAmanidratA||21||
garbhashukrarajonAshaH spandanaM gAtrasuptatA| shironAsAkShijatrUNAM grIvAyAshcApi huNDanam||22||
bhedastodArtirAkShepo mohashcAyAsa eva ca| evaMvidhAni rUpANi karoti kupito~anilaH||23||

UrustambhabheShajena virUkShaNAdvAtaprakopo bhavatIti sambandhAdUrustambhAnantaraM vAtavyAdhicikitsitamucyate| tatra vAta eva vyAdhirvAtavyAdhiriti pakShe vAta eva tattaddUShyasamprAptaH sarvA~ggaikA~ggarUpatAmApanno vividhapIDAkartRutvAdvAtavyAdhirucyate; yadA tu vAtAdvyAdhirvAtavyAdhiriti pakShastadA vAtadoShAd doShadUShyasammUrcchanavisheSharUpaH sarvA~ggaikA~ggarUpo vyAdhirvAtavyAdhirucyate| jvarAdayastu yadyapi vAtAdutpadyante, tathA~api te doShAntareNApi vAtaM vinA bhavantIti kRutvA nAtra shAstre vAtavyAdhishabdenocyante | ye~api cAtra kaphapittAvRutavAtavikArA vAtavyAdhitvena vaktavyAH, te~api pradhAnaM vAtaM vinA na bhavantIti kRutvA vAtavyAdhirUpA eva| na ca vAcyaM yathA vAtikA nAnAtmajA vyAdhayaH pRuthak cikitsayocyante, tathA pittajAH kaphajAshca cikitsyantAmiti; yataH pittakaphakRutAnAM nAnAtmajAnAM vyAdhInAM na tathA prAdhAnyaM yathA vAtajAnAM; tena vAtajAnAmevAviShkRutatamAnAM pRuthak cikitsocyate, kaphapittajAnAM tvAviShkRutAnAM vamanavirecanAdikA kaphapittacikitseti j~jeyam||1-2||

sthAnavisheShakRutameva vyAdhibhedamAha- tatra koShThAshrite ityAdi| sarvA~ggakupite iti kRutsnadehakupite| gudasthite iti uttaragudasthite| Atanyate vistAryate| bhuktasya stambha iti bhuktavato gAtrastambho bhavatIti| gurva~ggamityAdi mAMsage medege ca lakShaNaM samAnaM, tathA bhedo~asthiparvaNAmityAdi asthimajjagayoH samAnaM lakShaNam| samAne~api lakShaNe vividhAshitapItIyoktavishiShTadhAtulakShaNairvisheSha unneyaH| santateti sAnubandhA | kShipraM mu~jcati badhnAtIti vyavAyakAle kShipraM mu~jcati vA ciraM dhArayate, tathA garbhamapi kShipraM mu~jcati vA ciraM dhArayati| vikRutamiti vya~ggatvAdinAnAvikArayuktaM garbhaM janayati| bAhyetyAdinA snAyugatavAtalakShaNatvenoktAni bahirAyAmAdInyagre vaktavyAni | mandarukshophamiti mandarujaM mandashophaM ca| suptA iti niHspandAH||24-37||-

idAnImatibalAn vAtavikArAnabhidhAtumudyato~arditamAha- ativRuddha ityAdi| ativRuddhagrahaNena vAyorbalavatprakopamAha| ekamiti vAmaM dakShiNaM vA sa~gkocayati bAhuM, pAdaM, jAnu ca; vakraM ca jihmaM karoti| vakraM vrajati bhojanamiti na samaM mukhena khAdati, kintu vakraikadeshena| dIneti agambhIrA| jihmeti kuTilA| samutkShipteti atitvaritA| kaleti avyaktA| bAdhyete shravaNAviti yadyapi ekapArshvAshrayo vikAro~ayaM, tathA~api prabhAvAt karNayorbAdhA~atra bhavati| kevala iti ardhe eva na kRutsne| nanu yadA dehArdhavyApitvamarditasya tadA~arditena ardhA~ggasya ko bhedaH? brUmaH-ardito vegitayA na sarvakAlaM bhavati, ardhA~ggastu sarvakAlaM vyApya bhavati; uktaM hi- “svasthaH syAdarditAdInAM muhurvegAgame gate” iti| kiMvA yathoktavishiShTalakShaNo~arditaH, ardhA~gge tu naitAni sarvANi bhavanti||38-42||

manye ityAdinA antarAyAmamAha| antaryadA nADIH prapadyate iti manyAsambaddhA eva antargatAH sirAH prapadyata ityarthaH| antarAyAmasa~jj~jitamiti evaMvidho manyAstambha antarAyAma ucyate; aparastu manyAstambho vakShyamANabahirAyAma iti vaktavyaH| tantrAntare tu manyAstambha AyAmayoH pUrvarUpatvenoktaH| antarAyamyata iti antaH AkRuShyate| pRuShThAyAma iti pRuShThabahirnirgatiH||43-44||-

pRuShThetyAdi bahirAyAmalakShaNam| pRuShThamanyAshritA iti pRuShThAnugatamanyAsambaddhAH| bAhyA iti sirAvisheShaNam| bAhyAshca sirAH pRuShThagatA eva| kecittu pRuShThamanyAshrita iti vAtavisheShaNaM paThanti| pRuShThato nIyate iti pRuShThaM prati AkRuShyate| jAtavega iti udvegaH | etau cAyAmau “bAhyAbhyantaramAyAmaM khallIM kubjatvameva ca| sarvaikA~ggarogAMshca kuryAt snAyugato~anilaH” ityanena snAyugatAnilajanyAvuktau, iha ca sirAgatavAtajanyatvenoktau, tenobhayavacanAt sirAsnAyugatavAtajanyAveva bhavataH| uktaM hyanyatra- “mahAheturbalI vAyuH sirAH sasnAyukaNDarAH| manyApRuShThAshritA bAhyAH saMshoShyAyAmayedbahiH” ityAdi||45-48||
hatvaikamityAdi pakShavadhalakShaNam| gRuhItvA~ardhamityAdi ekA~ggalakShaNam| sarvA~ggaM sarvadehajamiti sarvA~ggalakShaNam||53-55||

sphikpUrvetyAdi| prathamaM sphicaM stambharuktodairgRuhNAti, pashcAttu kaTipRuShThorujAnuja~gghApadaM gRuhNAti sA gRudhrasI vAtAt; vAtakaphAttu sA pUrvoktalakShaNA satI tandrAdyanvitA bhavati; evaM gRudhrasIdvayaM “dve gRudhrasyau vAtAd vAtakaphAcca” (sU.a.19) ityanenoktaM vivRutaM bhavati||56-57||

vAtasya pittAdisaMsargaM j~jApayannAha- sarveShvityAdi| pittAdyairiti pittakapharaktapurIShAdibhiH| athAvRutasya vAyoH kathaM kupitatvaM bhavati yAvatA AvRuto durbala eva bhavatItyAha- vAyorityAdi| dhAtukShayAditi sArakShayAt| mArgAvaraNena vegapratibandhAdeva kupito bhavati| atha bhavatu mArgarodhAdvAtakopaH, AvarakeNa tu pittena kaphena cAsya kathaM na sambandho bhavatItyAha- vAtapittetyAdi| tritayamelake~api vAyoH prAdhAnyamAha- vAyureva hi sUkShmatvAditi; sUkShmamArgAnusAritayA prerakatvAt| tasmAt triShvapi doSheShu vAyurevoktanyAyena pradhAnam, ataH kupitaH pittakaphau samuddhUya tAbhyAmAvRutamArgo~api tatra tatra pradeshe gadAn karoti; tathA rasAdIMshca tatra tatra kShipan saMshoShayet||58-60||-

AvaraNakRutaM vAtakopaM darshayitvA AvaraNavisheShakRutaM li~ggamAha- li~ggaM pittAvRute ityAdi| kaTvAdyupashaya iti kaTUShNAdikaphaviparItairupashayaH| adhikamiti vAtaharairapyupashayo nAdhiko bhavatIti darshayati| mAMsage iti mAMsAvRute| mAMsagatasya raktAdigatasya ca vAtasya pUrvameva lakShaNamuktam, iha tu raktAdyAvRutasya lakShaNamucyata iti visheShaH| ADhyavAteti Ayurvedasa~jj~jeyaM medasA~a~avRutavAtasya| svasthAne iti pakvAshaye| parikRuntati parikartikAM janayati||61-71||-

sAdhyAsAdhyavibhAgamAha- sandhicyutirityAdi| atra kubjatvapa~ggutvAdayo yadyapi sAkShAnna prapa~jcitAstathA~api sheShAtideshenaiva tallakShaNaM j~jeyam| khuDavAtatA gulphavAtatA, kiMvA sandhigatavAtatA| majjAsthigA iti majjAsthyAvRutamajjAsthigatavAtajanyA ityarthaH| sthAnasya gAmbhIryAditi gambhIrasthAnAshritatvAt; anye tu gAmbhIryaM kRutAspadatvamAhuH| yatnAt sidhyanti vA naveti pAkShikasiddhivacanamitaravaidyAbhiprAyeNa j~jeyam; AcAryastu AcAryaprakhyo vA vaidyaH sAdhayatyeva balAt, itaravaidyastu nAvashyaM sarvatrAvyAhataj~jAno bhavati, tena saMshayAbhidhAnaM; tatashca na pAramArthikI sandigdhatA etAdRushAnAM sAdhyatAM pratIti j~jeyam| navAnAmapyeShAM nirupadravatayA sAdhyatAmAha- navAnityAdi| upadravAshcAtra shRu~ggagrAhikayA~anuktA api sAmAnyopadravalakShaNayuktA eva kecidgadA vij~jeyAH; kiMvA adhyAyasheShe ‘hRudrogo vidradhiH’ ityAdinA vakShyamANA upadravA j~jeyAH||72-74||

avasaraprAptAM kriyAmAha- kriyAmata ityAdi| kevalamityAdau kevalamiti asaMsRuShTam| nirupastambhamiti anAvRutam| kaiH? snehaiH| kathaM copAcaredityAha- sarpirvasAtailamajjapAnairiti| snehapAnaprayogAnantaraM kartavyamAha- naraM tataH snehaklAntamityAdi| snehaklAntamiti snehapAnodvignaM snehaglAnaM ca| samAshvAsyeti vishramayitvA | snehayeditipadaM tarpaNaiH pAnairityantaM yAvadanuvartate| anyairiti kuTIbhUsvedAdibhiH| yathAyogamiti sarvathA snehapUrvakasvedam| snehapUrvakasvedaguNamAha- snehAktaM svinnamityAdi| svedAdhyAye “snehapUrvaM prayuktena” (sU.a.14) ityAdinokto~apyayaM snehapUrvakasvedaguNaH punaH prakaraNAgatatvAducyate| Ashu prayojita iti padaM puShNAtItyanena sambadhyate| anilAmayA na tiShThanti na sthAyino bhavantItyarthaH||75-82||-

yadyanena sadoShatvAdityAdi| atra kevalo nirupastambhashca vAyushcikitsyatvenAdhikRutaH, tasya sadoShatvamanupapannaM; tataH sadoShatvaM karmaNi yojanIyaM; tena karmaNo~avishuddhatvAd vAyurna prashAmyati, karmaNashcoktasyApyatrAshuddhirmalajanakatvAt; vakShyati hi “snigdhAmlalavaNoShNAdyairAhArairhi malashcitaH” ityAdi| kiMvA sadoShatvAdityanenottarakAlInaM vAyoH saMshamanamucyate, asaMsRuShTatvamanupastambhatvaM ca yaduktaM tadupakramArambhakAle j~jeyam| sadoShatvaM ca snehaprayogeNAnupashame saMshodhanakaraNe ca hetuH| samalatvamevottarakAlInaM kuto bhavatItyAha- snigdhetyAdi| durbalo yo~avirecya iti durbalatvaprakarSheNAvirecya ityarthaH| tathA hi “anAsthApyAstvajIrNI” (si.a.2) ityAdau atidurbalaH paThitaH| atyarthaM durbalatayA bastyanarhe~api vidhimAha- pAcanairdIpanIyaishceti| pAcanaM ki~jcinna dIpanaM, yathA paTolaM dIpanaM; dIpanaM ki~jcinna pAcanaM yathA triphalA; uktaM hi sushrute- “triphalA kaphapittaghnI mehakuShThavinAshinI| cakShuShyA dIpanI ca” (su.sU.a.38) iti; ataH pAcanairityasya dIpanairiti visheShaNaM kRutam| bhojyairvA tadyutairiti pAcanadIpanasaMyuktairbhojyaiH| utthite cAgnau iti dIpte vahnau||83-88||-

sthAnavisheSheNa kriyAvisheShamAha- visheShatastvityAdinA adho nAbheH shasyate cAvapIDaka ityantena| kShAraM yavakShAram, uktaM hi “yAvashUkaH sraMsanIyapAcanIyArshoghnAnAM” (sU.a.25); kiMvA kShAramiti grahaNyAdinirdiShTaM dIpanakShAram| udAvartanutkarma trimarmIye “taM tailashItajvaranAshanAktaM” (ci.a.26) ityAdinoktaM j~jeyam| svedA ityAdi tvaggatAnilacikitsitam| praharShaH manoharShaNam| virecanAnantaraM pratibhojito viriktapratibhuktaH| pUrvoktAmiti shukrajananaharShiNIM kriyAm| utthApane iti puShTijanane sitAdibhiH siddhaM payo hitam| aMshumatI shAlaparNI|| matsyAniti nAbhipradeshe kupite vAte matsyA bilvashalATubhiH samaM siddhA deyAH| nAbhipradeshakopashca vAtasyAnukto~apIha tatra bhavashUlatodAdibhirj~jeyaH| veShTyamAna iti avamoTyamAne| upanAhanaM ca vAtaharadravyaireva kartavyam| nasye pAne ca auttarabhaktikaM mAShasaindhavasAdhitameva tailaM j~jeyam| tatra ca mAShasya kvAthaH, saindhavasya kalkaH| sarpiSho~avapIDakaH yatra sarpiH pItvA tatpIDakamannaM bhujyate||89-98||-

arditAdicikitsAmAha- ardite ityAdi| tarpaNamiti nAvanavisheShaNaM; kiMvA tarpaNaM santarpaNameva| antarAkaNDarAgulphaM sireti kaNDarAgulphayormadhye sirAvyadhanaM kartavyam| gRudhrasIShviti bahuvacanaM vyaktibhedatayA| vyAttAnanamiti vivRutAsyam| pradeshinI a~gguShThAnantarA~a~ggulI||99-103||
sarvavAtavikArasamAnaM cikitsitamAha- sarpistailamityAdi||104-105||-

balAyA ityAdau pRuthakshabdAd balAdayastrayaH sAdhanadravyaprayogAH, teShvajashIrShAdayashcatvAraH pRuthak sAdhyAH, evaM dvAdasha rasA bhavanti| kalyamiti prabhAte| phalAnAM tailayonInAmiti tilAtasyAdInAm| pradehAnupanAhAMshcetyatra pradeha upanAhApekShayA tanurlepaH| gandhairiti agurvAdyaiH||106-117||-

rUkShashuddhetyAdau shuddhAnilArtAH kevalavAtapIDitAH| ghRutamaNDaH ghRutasyoparitano bhAgaH| shuktiH ardhapalaM, praku~jcaH palam| tadvatsiddheti balAbilvaprabhRutishRutakShIrasiddhA| culukI shishumAraH| pratyagreti abhinavA| nasyapAneShviti nasyeShu pAneShu ca | kRuShNagandhAtvak shobhA~jjanatvak| mahAsnehamiti catuHsneham| tena siddhaM tailamityatra samamiti nirguNDIrasasamaM, natu samashabdaH sahArthaH; sahArthasya tRutIyayaivoktatvAt| nADI nADIvraNaH; nADIvraNasya sushrutAdiShu pa~jcavidhatvamuktaM j~jeyam| apacI ca hanvasthikakShAdideshabhavA||118-135||-

mUlakasvarasa ityAdau mUlakasvarase samakShIre dadhi sthApyaM; tasyAmlasyeti mUlarasAderamlatA~ggatasya| atra ca tribhiH prasthairiti vacanAt mUlakarasAdInAM pratyekaM prasthamAnatvam| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “vipaced dadhimUlakarasapayasA” ityAdi||136-137||-

pa~jcamUlakaShAyeNetyAdau pa~jcamUlIkaShAyaM tathA piNyAkakvathitaM jalaM ca pRuthagdeyamiti kecidvadanti, vayaM tu pa~jcamUlIkaShAyeNaiva jalasthAnIyena sAdhitapiNyAkasya rasamatrecchAmaH| pAThashca ‘pa~jcamUlIkaShAyeNa piNyAkaM bahuvArShikam| paktvA tasya rasaM pUtvA’ ityAdi paThyate; jAtUkarNe~api “piNyAkaM bahuvArShikaM sthirAdisalile pacet, rase~asminaShTaguNena payasA tailaM sAdhyam” iti| dravairamlairiti kA~jjikatakrAdibhiH| phalAmlairiti amlaphalairdADimAdibhiH||138-141||-

catuShprayogANIti pAnAbhya~jjananasyAnuvAsanayogIni| sahAcaretyAdau mUlakalkAddashapalamityanena sahacaramUlAdeva dashapalaH kalko deyaH; jatUkarNe tvatra mUlakasyaiva kalka uktaH| jIrNe taile ityAdi pIte taile jIrNe sati| kShIreNa peyAvidhAnamatra prayogasAtmyatvAt| guDUcyAH pAdamiti pa~jcaviMshatipalAni| rAsnAShTabhAgikamiti gatApekShayA rAsnAyA aShTabhAgenArdhatrayodashapalAni bhavanti| sAjapayo~ardhAMshamiti chAgakShIrArdhayuktam| sUrpaparNyau mudgamAShaparNyau| rasaH gandharasaH| nalikA svanAmakhyAtA| kaTuphalA latAkastUrI, anye sugandhi dakShiNApathaprasiddhaM padyala(?)mAhuH| turuShkaH silhakaH| nakhIsvalpanakhI| patrakalkamiti sugandhitvAdasya tailasya gandhashAsraparibhAShayA patrakalko deya ityucyate; gandhashAstre ca “cUrNasvarasapuShpANAM siddhashIte~avatArite| dIyate gandhavRuddhyarthaM patrakalko manIShibhiH” iti; tenAtra karpUrAdipatrakalko~avatArite eva deyaH||142-156||-
amRutAyA ityAdau mahAshrAvaNI bRuhanmuNDitikA| kAlA kAlAnusArivA| tridashAhvaH devadAruH||157-164||

rAsnAsahasraniryUhe ityAdau haimavatairiti himAlayabhUtaiH agarukuShThakShemakAdibhiH| elAdyairiti amRutAdye elAmAMsInatetyAdinoktaiH| eSha kalpa ityanantaroktarAsnAkalpo balAdiShvapi vaktavyaH| balAdInAmiti anantaroktAnAM balAprasAraNyashvagandhAnAm||165-166||

vRuShamUletyAdau ashvagandhAcitrakAbhyAM militAbhyAM tulA| prAktailAvApasiddhamiti mUlakasvarasamityAdyuktatailakalkena samaM vRuShamUlAdikvAthena ca siddham| bhavettaddviguNottaramiti pAThe vRuShamUlAdikvAthasiddhAttailAd dviguNaM shreShTham||167-171||

sarvagandhaishceti balAtailoktaiH sarvagandhaiH| sArdhamiti sahitam| mUlakatailAkhyamitisa~jj~jayA tatra rAsnAdInAM mUlenaiva kvAthasAdhanaM darshayati| lashunasvarase ityAdau ebhishceti yavAdikvAthairanantaroktaiH| anekashatashastacca siddhamiti anekashatashastenaiva vidyAnena sAdhitaM sadityarthaH||172-182||

samprati doShAntarAdisaMsRuShTavAtacikitsAmAha- kriyA sAdhAraNItyAdi| sAdhAraNIti yA vAte sA saMsargiNi ca pittAdau samAnA saMsargahiteti yAvat; na kevalaM saMsRuShTe vAyau sAdhAraNI, kintu vAtapittAdibhiH srotaHsvAvRuteShvapi sAdhAraNI kartavyA| vAtena vAtAvaraNamagre vakShyati| kecittu ‘vAte pittAdibhiH’ iti paThanti; ayaM pAThaH sugamaH| vishiShTasUtritAM kriyAmAha- pittAvRute ityAdi| vyatyAsAditi parivartanena shItAM kRutvoShNAm, uShNAM ca kRutvA shItAM kuryAdityarthaH| yApanA bastayaH siddhau vakShyamANAH| pittamAdau vinirjayediti vacanena kaphApekShayA pittasyAshukAritayA pittajayamevopadishati||183-188||

AmAshayagataM matvA kaphamiti vAtAnubandhikaphasyaiveyaM cikitsA| pakvAshaye virekaM tvityatra ‘kaphe’ ityanuvartate| sarvatrage iti anyasthAnagate~api pitte| yadyapi doShAntarasthAnagate taddoShapradhAnameva karma vamanaM bastirvA yuktaH, tathA~apyanena virecanamapi tatra yaugikamiti darshayati| sakaphe iti sakaphe vAte| ‘uraHsrotogate’ iti kecit paThanti, tatra sUkShmasroto~anugate ityarthaH| pramehavAtamedoghnImiti pramehaghnIM vAtaghnIM medoghnIM ca| mahAsneha iti catuHsneho~atraivoktaH| pUrvavadretasA~a~avRute iti shukrasthe vAte yA kriyA pUrvamuktA sA retasA~a~avRute~api vAte kAryA| ullekha iti ullekhanaM vamanam| mUtralAnIti mUtravairecanikAni| shakRutA iti malena| svasthAnastha ityAdi svasthAnastho yasmAt sthAnopabRuMhaNAdbalI doSho bhavati tasmAt prAk svairauShadhairjayet| katamaiH svairauShadhairityAha- vamanairityAdi| shamaneneti kaphAdishamanenaiva; shamanaM ca shodhanAnantaraM shodhanAnarhe vA j~jeyam||189-198||-

mArutAnAmanyonyAvaraNamAha- mArutAnAmityAdi| yadyapi ceha vAyoramUrtatvaM vAtakalAkalIye proktaM, tathA~apIdamamUrtatvamakaThinavAcakaM na tvavayavapratiShedhakaM; tena vAyoH vAyvantareNa gatihananarUpamAvaraNamupapannameva; dRuShTA ca vAyunA vAyvantareNopahatena vAtakuNDalitA bahirapi, tenopapannamAvaraNaM vAtAnAM parasparam| prANo vRuNotyudAnAdInityAdinA viMshatyAvaraNAnyuktAni| prANo vRuNotyudAnAdInityanena catvAryAvaraNAni, prANaM vRuNvanti te~api cetyanena ca catvAri, udAnAdyAstathA~anyonyamityanena dvAdashAvaraNAnyucyante| tatrodAnena vyAnAdInAM trayANAmAvaraNe trINi, tathA vyAnAdyaishcodAnAvaraNe trINi, tathA vyAnena samAnApAnAvaraNe dve, tAbhyAM ca vyAnAvaraNe dve, parishiShTayoshcAnyonyAvaraNe dve, evaM dvAdashAvaraNAni pUrvAShTakayuktAni viMshatirbhavanti| ulbaNAnAmiti vRuddhAnAM; kiMvA ulbaNAnAmiti AviShkRutatamAnAM militAnAM pa~jcAnAM; tenaiteShAmekadvitryAdisaMsargeNAvAryAvarakatayA bhedAdbahuvidhamAvaraNaM bhavatIti darshayati||199-205||-

shirograha ityAdinA aShTAvAvaraNAni prAyobhAvIni anuktasheShopagrahaNArthamAha| UrdhvabhAgikaM karmeti uparyuktasnehapAnanasyAdikam| shvAsAdaya iti shvAsahikkAdayaH| Urdhvageneti udAnena| anuktaj~jAnArthamAvaraNasvarUpamAha- eShAM svakarmaNAmityAdi| atra AvAryANAM balIyasA~a~avaraNAt svakarmahAnirbhavati, Avarakasya tUtsargataH svakarmavRuddhirbhavati, tathA AvaraNena ca AvAryaH prakupito bhavati tadA svakarmaNAM vRuddhirbhavatIti vyavasthA; anye tu AvaraNIyasya svakarmahAniH, Avarakasya tUtsargato vRuddhirbhavatIti vyavasthAmAhuH||206-213||-

anuktAvaraNalakShaNaj~jAnopAyamAha- sthAnAnyavekShyetyAdi| karmavRuddhihAnivyAkhyAnamatrApi pUrvavat| sthAnAnyavekShyetyanena vAtAnAmuktasthAnagatavikAreNa ca vAtavikRutirj~jAtavyeti darshayati| uShNaM kramamanuShNaM cetyatra yadyapyuShNa eva kramo vAte yujyate, tathA~api sthAnApekShayA raktAdidUShyaM kramaviparyayasya kAraNaM j~jeyam||217-218||-

vikRutavAtAnAM prakRutisthApanamAha- udAnaM yojayedUrdhvamityAdi| etacca svamArgayojanaM vAtAnAM yathoktavamanAdikriyAyogavidhAnena kartavyam| samAnaM shamayediti dehamadhyasthitaM kuryAdityarthaH| tridhA vyAnaM tu yojayediti Urdhvamadho madhye tridhA yojayet| prANo rakShya iti sthAne eva yApanIyaH | caturbhyo~apItyanena itaravAtebhyo~asyAtyartharakShaNIyatAmAha| kuto~ayaM visheSharakShaNIya ityAha- sthAne tvasya sthitirdhruveti; asya prANasya, sthAne samyagavasthAne sati, sthitiH jIvanarUpA, dhruvA nishcitA||219-220||-

prANAdInAM pittena kaphena tathA pittakaphAbhyAM cAvaraNalakShaNAnyAha- mUrcchA dAho bhrama ityAdi| mUrcchAdyAni mUrcchA dAha ityAdinA prAguktAni| upaghAtastathoShmaNa iti atra pittenApyAvRute samAne agnyuttejanAbhAvAdUShmaNa upaghAto j~jeyaH| gAtravikShepasa~ggaH gAtravikShepaNoparamaH| rajasa iti Artavasya||221-230||-

mishramAvaraNamiti mishritakaphapittAvaraNam| yathAnijAniti yathAtmIyAn| garIyastveneti adhikatvena| etadgarIyastve hetumAha- visheShAdityAdi| saMshritamiti adhInam| aparij~jAtA iti yAthAtathyenAj~jAtAH| samyagj~jAtA apyupekShaNAd, yAthAtathyena j~jAtA api parisaMvatsarAstatheti yojanIyam||231-235||-

hRudrogetyAdinA upadravAnAha| pa~jcAtmakasyeti prANAdibhedena pa~jcasvarUpasya| prasamIkShyetyAdau balAdhikye sati sraMsanaM mRudu kartavyamityabhiprAyaH| atyarthaM prashasyata iti sambandhaH| lehaM vA bhArgavaproktamiti cyavanaprAshaM, cyavano hi bhArgava ucyate| uktaM hi AyurvedasamutthAne “bhArgavashcyavanaH kAmI vRuddhaH san vikRutiM gataH” (ci.a.1pA.4) iti| vAtasyAnulomanaM cikitsitaM kuryAditi niyojanIyam||236-245||

pa~jcAtmana ityAdisa~ggrahe pa~jcAtmanaH sthAnavashAditi cchedaH| dehadhAtoriti dehadhArakarUpasya vAyoravikRutasyetyarthaH| uktacikitsAkaraNApekShaNIyaM sa~ggraheNAha- tAmityAdi| deshAdyapekShA sUtrasthAne~asmAbhirvivRutA deshAdibhedena pratarkaNIyA, vistarabhItyA tu na prapa~jcyate||248-249||

prANodAnetyAdinA vyavahArArthaM sa~jj~jopadarshanapUrvakaM prANAdInAM sthAnaM karma cAha| dehaM tantrayate iti dhArayate| sthAneShviti vakShyamANAtmIyasthAneShu| AhArAdItyatra AdigrahaNAdannavidhAraNAdIni gRuhyante| karma ceti prANasya vAyorityarthaH| prANodAnayoryadyapi samAnamuraHsthAnaM, tathA~api karmabhedAdbheda eva; yathaikagRuhasthitamAlAkArakumbhakArayoH| prayatanaM prayatnaH, Urja utsAhaH; prayatnAdikarmatvena prayatnaurjobalavarNaniShpAdanamucyate| svedadoShAmbuvAhInItyAdau svedavAhIni tathA ambuvAhIni ca srotAMsi srotovimAne (vi.a.5) pRuthagevoktAni j~jeyAni, doShavahAni ca srotAMsi sarvasharIracarANyeva, uktaM hi “vAtapittashleShmaNAM punaH sarvasharIracarANAM sarvasrotAMsyayanabhUtAni” (vi.a.5) iti| gatItyAdau AdishabdenAku~jcanaprasAraNAdInAM ca grahaNam| antrastha iti antrANi cApAnasthAnamityarthaH| sRujatIti niHsArayatIti yAvat| Artavagarbhau ca sRujatIti sambandhaH| etAni karmANi yAdRushAH kurvanti tadAha- yuktA ityAdi; yuktA iti avyApannAH| sthAnasthitA iti yathoktasthAnasthitAH| yasmAdevambhUtA ato deho dhAryate tairanAmayaH||5-11||

vAtAnAM vaiguNyakAryamAha- vimArgasthA ityAdi| svasthAnakarmajairiti yasya vAyoryat sthAnamuktaM tatsthAnagataiH, tathA ShThIvanAdi yadvAyoH karmoktaM tajjaishca rogaiH sharIraM pIDayanti prANAn vA mahatA rogeNa haranti ca| atra ca vAyoreva bhUripradhAnarogakartRutayA bhinnacikitsAprayojakAH pa~jcabhedA uktA na pittakaphayoH, anatiprayojanatvAt| tathA hi tantrAntare pittamapi pAcaka-ra~jjaka-sAdhakAlocaka-bhrAjakabhedAt pa~jcavidhamuktaM; teShAM ca yathAkramaM jaTharahRudayadRuShTitvaksthAnatvamuktaM; tathA shleShmA~api bodhaka-shleShmaka-tarpakAvalambaka kledakabhedAt pa~jcavidhaH, teShAM ca sthAnAni yathAkramaM hRudayAmAshayajihvAshiraH sandhayaH, karmANi ca yathAkramamavalambana-kledana-rasabodhanAkShatarpaNa-sandhisaMshleShANi pRuthaguktAni| prakRutavAtavyAdhikathanAyAtra sa~gkhyAdinirdeshaH| tajjAnAmiti pa~jcavAtajAnAm| sUtre iti mahArogAdhyAye (sU.a.20)| ucyamAnAniti nakhabhedAdIn yathAsthUlamucyamAnAn| paryAyairiti sa~jj~jAntaraiH| kathaM punaste~ashItinakhabhedAdyA upadiShTAH? ucyate- kevalaM vAyumuddishya kecidgadA vepathvAdaya uktAH, tathA cAvRutaM vAtamuddishya keciduktAH “li~ggaM pittAvRute dAhastRuShNA” ityAdinA||12-14||

samprati nidAnamAha- rUkShetyAdi| viShamAdupacArAditi upacAravairUpyAt| doShAsRugityAdau doShashabdena purIShamapi gRuhyate| apataMsanaM gajAdibhyaH patanaM, kiMvA avataMsanaM dhAtUnAM karShaNam; uktaM hi kharanAde- “vilikhatyatitaikShNyAdyat smRutamullekhanaM hi tat| vikarShatyatidhAtUn yattaccoktamava(pa)taMsanam” iti| riktAnIti tucchAni, snehAdiguNashUnyAnItyarthaH||15-18||-

kupitAnAM kAryamAha- sa~gkoca ityAdi| ete ca sa~gkocAdayo vyAdhayo~api bhavanti; uktaM hi- “vyAdhayaste tadAtve tu li~ggAnIShTAni nAmayAH” (ni.a.8) iti| huNDanaM shiraHprabhRutInAmantaHpraveshaH; anye tu keshabhUmisphuTanaM sha~gkhalalATabhedashca shirohuNDanaM, nAsAhuNDanaM ghrANanAshaH, akShihuNDanam akShivyudAsaH, jatruhuNDanaM vakShoparodhaH, grIvAhuNDanaM grIvAstambhaH| vAtavyAdhivisheShotpAde hetumAha- hetusthAnavisheShAdityAdi| hetuvisheShaH pittAvaraNAdiH, sthAnavisheShaH koShThAdiH, kiMvA hetukRutaH sthAnavisheShaH; uktaM hi- “prakupitAstu prakopaNavisheShAd dUShyavisheShAn dUShayantaH” (vi.a.6) ityAdi| kecittu ‘dehe sthAnavisheShAcca’ iti paThanti||20-23||-
athAto vAtashoNitacikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
raktamArgaM nihantyAshu shAkhAsandhiShu mArutaH| nivishyAnyonyamAvArya vedanAbhirharedasUn||35||
tatra mu~jcedasRuk shRu~ggajalaukaHsUcyalAbubhiH| pracchanairvA sirAbhirvA yathAdoShaM yathAbalam||36||
rugdAhashUlatodArtAdasRuk srAvyaM jalaukasA| shRu~ggaistumbairharet suptikaNDUcimicimAyanAt||37||
deshAddeshaM vrajat srAvyaM sirAbhiH pracchanena vA| a~ggaglAnau na tu srAvyaM rUkShe vAtottare ca yat ||38||
gambhIraM shvayathuM stambhaM kampaM snAyusirAmayAn| glAniM cApi sasa~gkocAM kuryAdvAyurasRukkShayAt||39||
khA~jjyAdIn vAtarogAMshca mRutyuM cAtyavasecanAt| kuryAttasmAt pramANena snigdhAdraktaM vinirharet||40||

virecyaH snehayitvA~a~adau snehayuktairvirecanaiH| rUkShairvA mRudubhiH shastamasakRudvastikarma ca||41||

Commentary: virecanavidhAne snehayuktai rUkShaurveti vikalpadvaye snehayuktavirecanamIShatsnigdhaviShayaM, rUkShaistu virecanamatisnigdhaviShayam| mRudubhirityanena vAtakShobhabhayAdatra tIkShNavirecanaM niShedhayati| bastikarmeti anuvAsananirUharUpam| prAyo~avidAhina iti nitarAmavidAhinaH||41||-
... visheShaM tu nibodha me||42||
bAhyamAlepanAbhya~ggapariShekopanAhanaiH| virekAsthApanasnehapAnairgambhIramAcaret||43||
sarpistailavasAmajjApAnAbhya~jjanabastibhiH| sukhoShNairupanAhaishca vAtottaramupAcaret||44||
virecanairghRutakShIrapAnaiH sekaiH sabastibhiH| shItairnirvApaNaishcApi raktapittottaraM jayet||45||
vamanaM mRudu nAtyarthaM snehasekau vila~gghanam| koShNA lepAshca shasyante vAtarakte kaphottare||46||
kaphavAtottare shItaiH pralipte vAtashoNite| dAhashotharujAkaNDUvivRuddhiH stambhanAdbhavet||47||
raktapittottare coShNairdAhaH kledo~avadAraNam| bhavettasmAdbhiShagdoShabalaM buddhvA~a~acaretkriyAm||48||
divAsvapnaM sasantApaM vyAyAmaM maithunaM tathA| kaTUShNaM gurvabhiShyandi lavaNAmlaM ca varjayet||49||
purANA yavagodhUmanIvArAH shAliShaShTikAH| bhojanArthaM rasArthaM vA viShkirapratudA hitAH||50||
ADhakyashcaNakA mudgA masUrAH samakuShThakAH| yUShArthaM bahusarpiShkAH prashastA vAtashoNite||51||
suniShaNNakavetrAgrakAkamAcIshatAvarI| vAstukopodikAshAkaM shAkaM sauvarcalaM tathA||52||
ghRutamAMsarasairbhRuShTaM shAkasAtmyAya dApayet| vya~jjanArthaM, tathA gavyaM mAhiShAjaM payo hitam||53||
iti sa~gkShepataH proktaM vAtaraktacikitsitam| etadeva punaH sarvaM vyAsataH sampravakShyate||54||
shrAvaNIkShIrakAkolIjIvakarShabhakaiH samaiH| siddhaM samadhukaiH sarpiH sakShIraM vAtaraktanut||55||
balAmatibalAM medAmAtmaguptAM shatAvarIm| kAkolIM kShIrakAkolIM rAsnAmRuddhiM ca peShayet||56||
ghRutaM caturguNakShIraM taiH siddhaM vAtaraktanut| hRutpANDurogavIsarpakAmalAjvaranAshanam||57||
trAyantikAtAmalakIdvikAkolIshatAvarI| kasherukAkaShAyeNa kalkairebhiH paceddhRutam||58||
dattvA parUShakAdrAkShAkAshmaryekShurasAn samAn| pRuthagvidAryAH svarasaM tathA kShIraM caturguNam||59||
etat prAyogikaM sarpiH pArUShakamiti smRutam| vAtarakte kShate kShINe vIsarpe paittike jvare||60||
iti pArUShakaM ghRutam dve pa~jcamUle varShAbhUmeraNDaM sapunarnavam| mudgaparNIM mahAmedAM mAShaparNIM shatAvarIm||61||
sha~gkhapuShpImavAkpuShpIM rAsnAmatibalAM balAm| pRuthagdvipalikaM kRutvA jaladroNe vipAcayet||62||
pAdasheShe samAn kShIradhAtrIkShucchAgalAn rasAn| ghRutADhakena saMyojya shanairmRudvagninA pacet||63||
kalkAnAvApya mede dve kAshmaryaphalamutpalam| tvakkShIrIM pippalIM drAkShAM padmabIjaM punarnavAm||64||
nAgaraM kShIrakAkolIM padmakaM bRuhatIdvayam| vIrAM shRu~ggATakaM bhavyamurumANaM nikocakam||65||
kharjUrAkShoTavAtAmamu~jjAtAbhiShukAMstathA| etairghRutADhake siddhe kShaudraM shIte pradApayet||66||
samyak siddhaM ca vij~jAya suguptaM sannidhApayet| kRutarakShAvidhiM caukShe prAshayedakShasammitam||67||
pANDurogaM jvaraM hikkAM svarabhedaM bhagandaram| pArshvashUlaM kShayaM kAsaM plIhAnaM vAtashoNitam||68||
kShatashoShamapasmAramashmarIM sharkarAM tathA| sarvA~ggaikA~ggarogAMshca mUtrasa~ggaM ca nAshayet||69||
balavarNakaraM dhanyaM valIpalitanAshanam| jIvanIyamidaM sarpirvRuShyaM vandhyAsutapradam||70||
drAkShAmadhu(dhU)katoyAbhyAM siddhaM vA sasitopalam| pibeddhRutaM tathA kShIraM guDUcIsvarase shRutam||71||
jIvakarShabhakau medAmRuShyaproktAM shatAvarIm| madhukaM madhuparNIM ca kAkolIdvayameva ca||72||
mudgamAShAkhyaparNinyau dashamUlaM punarnavAm| balAmRutAvidArIshca sAshvagandhAshmabhedakAH||73||
eShAM kaShAyakalkAbhyAM sarpistailaM ca sAdhayet| lAbhatashca vasAmajjadhAnvaprAtudavaiShkiram||74||
caturguNena payasA tat siddhaM vAtashoNitam| sarvadehAshritaM hanti vyAdhIn ghorAMshca vAtajAn||75||
sthirA shvadaMShTrA bRuhatI sArivA sashatAvarI| kAshmaryANyAtmaguptA ca vRushcIro dve bale tathA||76||
eShAM kvAthe catuHkShIraM pRuthak tailaM pRuthagghRutam| medAshatAvarIyaShTijIvantIjIvakarShabhaiH||77||
paktvA mAtrA tataH kShIratriguNA~adhyardhasharkarA| khajena mathitA peyA vAtarakte tridoShaje||78||
tailaM payaH sharkarAM ca pAyayedvA sumUrcchitam| sarpistailasitAkShaudrairmishraM vA~api pibet payaH||79||
aMshumatyA shRutaH prasthaH payaso dvisitopalaH| pAne prashasyate tadvat pippalInAgaraiH shRutaH||80||
balAshatAvalIrAsnAdashamUlaiH sapIlubhiH| shyAmairaNDasthirAbhishca vAtArtighnaM shRutaM payaH||81||
dhAroShNaM mUtrayuktaM vA kShIraM doShAnulomanam| pibedvA satrivRuccUrNaM pittaraktAvRutAnilaH||82||
kShIreNairaNDatailaM vA prayogeNa pibennaraH| bahudoSho virekArthaM jIrNe kShIraudanAshanaH||83||
kaShAyamabhayAnAM vA ghRutabhRuShTaM pibennaraH| kShIrAnupAnaM trivRutAcUrNaM drAkShArasena vA||84||
kAshmaryaM trivRutAM drAkShAM triphalAM saparUShakAm| shRutaM pibedvirekAya lavaNakShaudrasaMyutam||85||
triphalAyAH kaShAyaM vA pibet kShaudreNa saMyutam| dhAtrIharidrAmustAnAM kaShAyaM vA kaphAdhikaH||86||
yogaishca kalpavihitairasakRuttaM virecayet| mRudubhiH snehasaMyuktairj~jAtvA vAtaM malAvRutam||87||
nirharedvA malaM tasya saghRutaiH kShIrabastibhiH| na hi bastisamaM ki~jcidvAtaraktacikitsitam||88||
bastiva~gkShaNapArshvoruparvAsthijaTharArtiShu| udAvarte ca shasyante nirUhAH sAnuvAsanAH||89||
dadyAttailAni cemAni bastikarmaNi buddhimAn| nasyAbhya~jjanasekeShu dAhashUlopashAntaye||90||
madhuyaShTyAstulAyAstu kaShAye pAdasheShite| tailADhakaM samakShIraM pacet kalkaiH palonmitaiH||91||
shatapuShpAvarImUrvApayasyAgurucandanaiH| sthirAhaMsapadImAMsIdvimedAmadhuparNibhiH||92||
kAkolIkShIrakAkolItAmalakyRuddhipadmakaiH| jIvakarShabhajIvantItvakpatranakhavAlakaiH||93||
prapauNDarIkama~jjiShThAsArivaindrIvitunnakaiH| catuShprayogAttaddhanti tailaM mArutashoNitam||94||
sopadravaM sA~ggashUlaM sarvagAtrAnugaM tathA| vAtAsRukpittadAhArtijvaraghnaM balavarNakRut||95||

hutAgnihotramAsInamRuShimadhye punarvasum| pRuShTavAn gurumekAgramagnivesho~agnivarcasam||3||
agnimArutatulyasya saMsargasyAnilAsRujoH| hetulakShaNabhaiShajyAnyathAsmai gururabravIt||4||
lavaNAmlakaTukShArasnigdhoShNAjIrNabhojanaiH| klinnashuShkAmbujAnUpamAMsapiNyAkamUlakaiH||5||
kulatthamAShaniShpAvashAkAdipalalekShubhiH| dadhyAranAlasauvIrashuktatakrasurAsavaiH||6||
viruddhAdhyashanakrodhadivAsvapnaprajAgaraiH| prAyashaH sukumArANAM miShTAnnasukhabhojinAm ||7||
aca~gkramaNashIlAnAM kupyate vAtashoNitam| abhighAtAdashuddhyA ca praduShTe shoNite nRuNAm||8||
kaShAyakaTutiktAlparUkShAhArAdabhojanAt| hayoShTrayAnayAnAmbukrIDAplavanala~gghanaiH ||9||
uShNe cAtyadhvavaiShamyAdvyavAyAdveganigrahAt | vAyurvivRuddho vRuddhena raktenAvAritaH pathi||10||
kRutsnaM sandUShayedraktaM tajj~jeyaM vAtashoNitam| khuDaM vAtabalAsAkhyamADhyavAtaM ca nAmabhiH||11||
iti madhuparNyAditailam madhukasya shataM drAkShA kharjUrANi parUShakam| madhUkaudanapAkyau ca prasthaM mu~jjAtakasya ca||96||
kAshmaryADhakamityetaccaturdroNe pacedapAm| sheShe~aShTabhAge pUte ca tasmiMstailADhakaM pacet||97||
tathA~a~amalakakAshmaryavidArIkShurasaiH samaiH| caturdroNena payasA kalkaM dattvA palonmitam||98||
kadambAmalakAkShoTapadmabIjakasherukam| shRu~ggATakaM shRu~ggaveraM lavANaM pippalIM sitAm||99||
jIvanIyaishca saMsiddhaM kShaudraprasthena saMsRujet| nasyAbhya~jjanapAneShu bastau cApi niyojayet||100||
vAtavyAdhiShu sarveShu manyAstambhe hanugrahe| sarvA~ggaikA~ggavAte ca kShatakShINe kShatajvare||101||
sukumArakamityetadvAtAsrAmayanAshanam| svaravarNakaraM tailamArogyabalapuShTidam||102||
iti sukumArakatailamguDUcIM madhukaM hrasvaM pa~jcamUlaM punarnavAm| rAsnAmeraNDamUlaM ca jIvanIyAni lAbhataH||103||
palAnAM shatakairbhAgairbalApa~jcashataM tathA| kolabilvayavAnmAShAnkulatthAMshcADhakonmitAn||104||
kAshmaryANAM sushuShkANAM droNaM droNashate~ambhasi| sAdhayejjarjaraM dhautaM caturdroNaM ca sheShayet||105||
tailadroNaM pacettena dattvA pa~jcaguNaM payaH| piShTvA tripalikaM caiva candanoshIrakesharam||106||
patrailAgurukuShThAni tagaraM madhuyaShTikAm| ma~jjiShThAShTapalaM caiva tat siddhaM sArvayaugikam||107||

samadhUcchiShTamA~jjiShThaM sasarjarasasArivam| piNDatailaM tadabhya~ggAdbAtaraktarujApaham||123||

Commentary: samadhUcchiShTetyAdau madhucchiShTAdIni kalkaH, jalaM ca dravaM deyam| piNDatailabhAShayA cAtra vastrapUtamevaitattelaM kartavyamityAhuH| kintu, AranAlADhakasAdhyataile eva sarjarasasthAne madhUcchiShTAdInAM prakShepAt piNDatailamanenocyata iti jatUkarNavacanAdunnIyate; uktaM hi tatra- “kA~jjikasarjarasashRutaM khajitaM bahunA jalena sikthakasarjarasairyuktamabhya~jjanam” iti||123||
iti piNDatailam
iti piNDatailam dashamUlashRutaM kShIraM sadyaH shUlanivAraNam| pariSheko~anilaprAye tadvat koShNena sarpiShA||124||
snehairmadhurasiddhairvA caturbhiH pariShecayet| stambhAkShepakashUlArtaM koShNairdAhe tu shItalaiH||125||
tadvadgavyAvikacchAgaiH kShIraistailavimishritaiH| kvAthairvA jIvanIyAnAM pa~jcamUlasya vA bhiShak||126||
drAkShekShurasamadyAni dadhimastvamlakA~jjikam| sekArthe taNDulakShaudrasharkarAmbu ca shasyate||127||
kumudotpalapadmAdyairmaNihAraiH sacandanaiH| shItatoyAnugairdAhe prokShaNaM sparshanaM hitam||128||
candrapAdAmbusaMsikte kShaumapadmadalacchade| shayane pulinasparshashItamArutavIjite||129||
candanArdrastanakarAH priyA nAryaH priyaMvadAH| sparshashItAH sukhasparshA ghnanti dAhaM rujaM klamam||130||
sarAge saruje dAhe raktaM visrAvya lepayet| madhukAshvatthatva~gmAMsIvIrodumbarashAdvalaiH||131||
jalajairyavacUrNairvA sayaShTyAhvapayoghRutaiH| sarpiShA jIvanIyairvA piShTairlepo~artidAhanut||132||
tilAH priyAlo madhukaM bisaM mUlaM ca vetasAt| Ajena payasA piShTaH pralepo dAharAganut||133||
prapauNDarIkama~jjiShThAdArvImadhukacandanaiH| sitopalairakAsaktumasUroshIrapadmakaiH||134||
lepo rugdAhavIsarparAgashophanivAraNaH| pittaraktottare tvete, lepAn vAtottare shRuNu||135||
vAtaghnaiH sAdhitaH snigdhaH sakShIramudgapAyasaH | tilasarShapapiNDairvA~apyupanAho rujApahaH||136||
audakaprasahAnUpaveshavArAH susaMskRutAH| jIvanIyauShadhaiH snehayuktAH syurupanAhane||137||
stambhatodarugAyAmashothA~ggagrahanAshanAH| jIvanIyauShadhaiH siddhA sapayaskA vasA~api vA||138||
ghRutaM sahacarAnmUlaM jIvantI cchAgalaM payaH| lepaH piShTAstilAstadvadbhRuShTAH payasi nirvRutAH||139||
kShIrapiShTamumAlepameraNDasya phalAni ca| kuryAcchUlanivRuttyarthaM shatAhvAmanile~adhike||140||
samUlAgracchadairaNDakvAthe dviprAsthikaM pRuthak| ghRutaM tailaM vasA majjA cAnUpamRugapakShiNAm||141||
kalkArthe jIvanIyAni gavyaM kShIramathAjakam| haridrotpalakuShThailAshatAhvAshvahanacchadAn ||142||
bilvamAtrAn pRuthak puShpaM kAkubhaM cApi sAdhayet| madhUcchiShTapalAnyaShTau dadyAcchIte~avatArite||143||
shUlenaiSho~arditA~ggAnAM lepaH sandhigate~anile| vAtarakte cyute bhagne kha~jje kubje ca shasyate||144||
shophagauravakaNDvAdyairyukte tvasmin kaphottare| mUtrakShArasurApakvaM ghRutamabhya~jjane hitam||145||
padmakaM tvak samadhukaM sArivA ceti tairghRutam| siddhaM samadhushuktaM syAt sekAbhya~gge kaphottare||146||
kShArastailaM gavAM mUtraM jalaM ca kaTukaiH shRutam| pariSheke prashaMsanti vAtarakte kaphottare||147||
lepaH sarShapanimbArkahiMsrAkShIratilairhitaH| shreShThaH siddhaH kapitthatvagghRutakShIraiH sasaktubhiH||148||
gRuhadhUmo vacA kuShThaM shatAhvA rajanIdvayam| pralepaH shUlanudvAtarakte vAtakaphottare||149||
tagaraM tvak shatAhvailA kuShThaM mustaM hareNukA| dAru vyAghranakhaM cAmlapiShTaM vAtakaphAsranut||150||
madhushigrorhitaM tadvadbIjaM dhAnyAmlasaMyutam| muhUrtaM liptamamlaishca si~jcedvAtakaphottaram||151||
triphalAvyoShapatrailAtvakkShIrIcitrakaM vacAm| viDa~ggaM pippalImUlaM romashaM vRuShakatvacam||152||
RuddhiM tAmalakIM cavyaM samabhAgAni peShayet| kalyaM liptamayaspAtre madhyAhne bhakShayettataH||153||
varjayeddadhishuktAni kShAraM vairodhikAni ca| vAtAsre sarvadoShe~api hitaM shUlArdite param||154||
buddhvA sthAnavisheShAMshca doShANAM ca balAbalam| cikitsitamidaM kuryAdUhApohavikalpavit||155||
tasya sthAnaM karau pAdAva~ggulyaH sarvasandhayaH| kRutvA~a~adau hastapAde tu mUlaM dehe vidhAvati||12||
saukShmyAt sarvasaratvAcca pavanasyAsRujastathA| taddravatvAt saratvAcca dehaM gacchan sirAyanaiH||13||
parvasvabhihataM kShubdhaM vakratvAdavatiShThate| sthitaM pittAdisaMsRuShTaM tAstAH sRujati vedanAH||14||
karoti duHkhaM teShveva tasmAt prAyeNa sandhiShu| bhavanti vedanAstAstA atyarthaM duHsahA nRuNAm||15||
kupite mArgasaMrodhAnmedaso vA kaphasya vA| ativRuddhyA~anile nAdau shastaM snehanabRuMhaNam||156||
vyAyAmashodhanAriShTamUtrapAnairvirecanaiH| takrAbhayAprayogaishca kShapayet kaphamedasI||157||
bodhavRukShakaShAyaM tu prapibenmadhunA saha| vAtaraktaM jayatyAshu tridoShamapi dAruNam||158||
purANayavagodhUmasIdhvariShTasurAsavaiH| shilAjatuprayogaishca guggulormAkShikasya ca||159||

gambhIre raktamAkrAntaM syAccettadvAtavajjayet| pashcAdvAte kriyAM kuryAdvAtaraktaprasAdanIm||160||

Commentary: gambhIre iti avagADhe anuttAne vAtarakte| raktamAkrAntamiti abhibhUtaM vAyunA vAtavajjayediti| etatkriyottarakAlInaM kartavyamAha- pashcAdvAtetyAdi| kaphamedovRute eva nirjitakaphamedasi vAte vAtaraktaprasAdinI kriyA atraivoktasnehaprayogAdikA kAryA; vAtavikAratvAd vAtavyAdhicikitsitena jayet| etacca vAtena raktAbhibhavanaM gambhIra eva vAtarakte prAyo bhavatIti darshayituM ‘gambhIre’ iti kRutam| gambhIrAnugate hi vAtarakte raktaM bahu nAsti, yato raktasya dvitIyA raktadharA tvak sthAnaM; tenottAne eva raktaM balavat, bAhyasthAnatvAdraktasya||160||
raktapittAtivRuddhyA tu pAkamAshu niyacchati| bhinnaM sravati vA raktaM vidagdhaM pUyameva vA||161||
tayoH kriyA vidhAtavyA bhedashodhanaropaNaiH | kuryAdupadravANAM ca kriyAM svAM svAccikitsitAt||162||
tatra shlokAH- hetuH sthAnAni mUlaM ca yasmAt prAyeNa sandhiShu| kupyati prAk ca yadrUpaM dvividhasya ca lakShaNam||163||
pRuthagbhinnasya li~ggaM ca doShAdhikyamupadravAH| sAdhyaM yApyamasAdhyaM ca kriyA sAdhyasya cAkhilA||164||
vAtaraktasya nirdiShTA samAsavyAsatastathA| maharShiNA~agniveshAya tathaivAvasthikI kriyA||165||
svedo~atyarthaM na vA kArShNyaM sparshAj~jatvaM kShate~atiruk| sandhishaithilyamAlasyaM sadanaM piDakodgamaH||16||
jAnuja~gghorukaTyaMsahastapAdA~ggasandhiShu| nistodaH sphuraNaM bhedo gurutvaM suptireva ca||17||
kaNDUH sandhiShu rugbhUtvA bhUtvA nashyati cAsakRut| vaivarNyaM maNDalotpattirvAtAsRukpUrvalakShaNam||18||
uttAnamatha gambhIraM dvividhaM tat pracakShate| tva~gmAMsAshrayamuttAnaM gambhIraM tvantarAshrayam||19||
kaNDUdAharugAyAmatodasphuraNaku~jcanaiH| anvitA shyAvaraktA tvagbAhye tAmrA tatheShyate||20||
gambhIre shvayathuH stabdhaH kaThino~antarbhRushArtimAn| shyAvastAmro~athavA dAhatodasphuraNapAkavAn||21||
rugvidAhAnvito~abhIkShNaM vAyuH sandhyasthimajjasu| chindanniva caratyantarvakrIkurvaMshca vegavAn||22||
karoti kha~jjaM pa~gguM vA sharIre sarvatashcaran| sarvairli~ggaishca vij~jeyaM vAtAsRugubhayAshrayam||23||
tatra vAte~adhike vA syAdrakte pitte kaphe~api vA| saMsRuShTeShu samasteShu yacca tacchRuNu lakShaNam||24||
visheShataH sirAyAmashUlasphuraNatodanam | shothasya kArShNyaM raukShyaM ca shyAvatAvRuddhihAnayaH||25||
dhamanya~ggulisandhInAM sa~gkoco~a~ggagraho~atiruk| ku~jcanastambhane shItapradveShashcAnile~adhike||26||
shvayathurbhRusharuk todastAmrashcimicimAyate| snigdharUkShaiH shamaM naiti kaNDUkledAnvito~asRuji ||27||
vidAho vedanA mUrcchA svedastRuShNA mado bhramaH| rAgaH pAkashca bhedashca shoShashcoktAni paittike||28||
staimityaM gauravaM snehaH suptirmandA ca ruk kaphe| hetulakShaNasaMsargAdvidyAddvandvatridoShajam||29||
ekadoShAnugaM sAdhyaM navaM, yApyaM dvidoShajam| tridoShajamasAdhyaM syAdyasya ca syurupadravAH||30||
asvapnArocakashvAsamAMsakothashirograhAH| mUrcchAyamadaruktRuShNAjvaramohapravepakAH||31||
hikkApA~ggulyavIsarpapAkatodabhramaklamAH| a~ggulIvakratA sphoTA dAhamarmagrahArbudAH||32||
etairupadravairvarjyaM mohenaikena vA~api yat| samprasrAvi vivarNaM ca stabdhamarbudakRucca yat||33||
varjayeccaiva sa~gkocakaramindriyatApanam| akRutsnopadravaM yApyaM sAdhyaM syAnnirupadravam||34||
vAtavyAdhiprabhedAdeva vAtavyAdhicikitsitAnantaraM vAtaraktacikitsitamucyate| vAtaraktAbhyAM janito vyAdhiH vAtaraktaM, kiMvA vAtarakte eva avasthAntaraprApte vAtaraktam||1-2||

vAtashoNitasya raktaharaNArthaM rUpamAha- raktamArgamityAdi| raktasya mArgaM mAruto nihanti shAkhAsandhiShu nivishyeti shAkhAsandhiShu sthitvA, tatashca vAyunA raktanirodhAt, anyonyamAvAryeti raktena vAtaM vAtena ca raktamAvArya, vAtaraktaM vedanAbhirharedasUmiti yojyam| ata evAtra vAtashoNite asRugvimu~jcediti bhAvaH| asRu~gmokShaNena AvaraNavyapagamAdvAyurapi prasanno bhavati, tatashca vyAdhyuparama iti bhAvaH| deshAddeshaM vrajaditi sthAnAntaraprasaraNashIlam| a~ggaglAnAviti a~ggashoShe| srAvaNAhe shoNite~apyatisrAvaNAddoShamAha- gambhIramityAdi| khA~jjyAdIniti khA~jjyapA~ggulyakubjatvAdIn vAtarogAn| kuryAditi cchedaH| pramANeneti avikArimAtrayA||35-40||

visheShamiti vishiShTacikitsitam| bAhyamiti uttAnam| mRudviti vamanavisheShaNam| kaphottare vAtottare ca shItapralepadoShamAha- kaphavAtottare ityAdi| shItalepena vidAho~atra UShmarodhAdbhavatIti j~jeyam| pittottare raktottare ca uShNapralepairdoShamAha- raktapittottare ityAdi| doShabalaM buddhvA Acarediti doShabalaM buddhvA anuguNAmeva kriyAmAcaret; vAtakaphottare uShNAM, raktapittottare shItAM, mishre ca mishrAmiti bhAvaH||42-48||
nIvAraH uDikA| sauvarcalamiti sUryAvartashAkam| vya~jjanArthamiti bhojanasAdhanatayA vya~jjate iti vya~jjanam| etadeveti sa~gkShiptaprayogakathanam| vyAsataH prapa~jcena||49-54||

shrAvaNI muNDitikA| sakShIramityanena dravAntarAbhAvAccaturguNakShIrameva ghRutAdbhavati| trAyantiketyAdau kalkairebhirityanena shatAvaryantAnAM kalkatvaM, kasherukAkaShAyaH, parUShakarasAdInAM pratyekaM ghRutasamAnatvaM, vidArIrasasyApi tathAvacanAt samatvam| atra jatUkarNaH- “tulyarasaiH parUShakakAshmaryakakasherukAvidarIdrAkShekShUNAM catuShke payasi dvikAkolItAmalakIshatAvaryaH piShTvA paced ghRutaM, prayogeNa tadvAtAsravIsarpajvarajit sarpiH pArUShakaM nAma” iti| prAyogikamiti abhyAsopayojyam||55-60||

dve pa~jcamUle ityAdau varShAbhUH shvetapunarnavA| avAkpuShpI ‘adhaHpuShpI’ iti khyAtA| kShIrAdInAM snehasamatvam| vIrA vRuddhiH| bhavyAdaya auttarApathikAH| suguptamiti vAtAdyasparshanIyaM yathA bhavati| caukShe iti shucau||61-70||
drAkShetyAdau sasitopalamiti prakShiptasharkaram| RuShyaproktA atibalA| kAlA ma~jjiShThA| madhuparNI vika~gkataH| dhAnvaprAtudavaiShkiramiti vasAmajjavisheShaNam||71-75||

sthiretyAdau catuHkShIramiti caturguNaM kShIram| pRuthak tailaM pRuthagghRutamityanena sammishrapAkaM niShedhayati| kShIratriguNa sArdhabhAgA sharkarA yasyAM mAtrAyAM sA kShIra triguNA~adhyardhasharkarA| khajaHpa~jcA~ggulo hastaH, manthAnaM vA| mAtrA cAtra militayostailasarpiShorgrAhyA| aMshumatI shAlaparNI| dvisitopala iti sharkarApaladvayayuktaH| iyaM ca kShIramAtrA uttamAgnIn prati| dhAroShNamiti dohakAladhArApatitamagniyogAdvinA uShNIbhUtam| mUtraM cAtra kShIrasamam| satrivRuccUrNaM dhAroShNaM kShIramiti sambandhaH| prayogeNeti abhyAsena| kShIrapradhAno bastiH kShIrabastiH||76-87||

madhuyaShTyA ityAdau madhukatulAyAM jaladroNaM dattvA tailADhakamAnaH kvAtho bhavati| varI shatAvarI| haMsapadI svanAmakhyAtA| payasyA arkapuShpI| vitunnakaM dhAnyakam| catuShprayogAditi pAnAbhya~ggabastinasyaprayogAt||88-95||

agnimArutatulyasyetyanena vAtaraktasya durnivAratvaM shIghrakAritvaM cAha| lavaNetyAdinA hetumAha| prAyashaH sukumArANAmityanena sukumArasharIre lavaNAdihetusevayA shIghraM duShTaM vAtAsraM vAtashoNitaM bhavatIti darshayati| miShTamannaM sukhena bhu~jjate teShAM miShTAnnasukhabhojinAm| atra lavaNAdi yadyapi vAtashoNitahetutayoktaM tathA~api shoNitaduShTikAraNametat prAdhAnyAjj~jeyaM, vAtaduShTikAraNaM tu kaShAyetyAdinoktaM, tatashca lavaNAdi kaShAyAdi ca militaM sad vAtashoNitotpAdakaM bhavati| yattu ‘jAyate vAtashoNitam’ ityanena lavaNAdInAM vAtashoNitakAraNatvamuktaM, tadvAtashoNitajanakashoNitaduShTikAraNadvArA j~jeyam| ashuddhyeti shuddhikAle~asaMshodhanAt| kecit ‘abhighAtAdashuddhyA ca’ ityasya sthAne ‘ashuddhyA vAtavaiShamyAt’ iti paThanti| ashuddhyA ceti cakAreNa lavaNAdi prajAgarairityantaM shoNitaduShTikAraNaM samuccinoti| atra shoNitavAtasya vicchidya hetubahupAThena dvayorapyatra svatantraM prakopaM darshayati| hayoShTrarUpeNa yAnena yAnaM hayoShTrayAnayAnam| uShNe cAtyadhvavaiShamyAditi uShNe kAle atyadhvajanitAdvAtadvaiShamyAt| vAyurityAdinA samprAptimAha| pathIti vAyuvahanasrotasi| kruddha iti vRuddho~api svahetorvAyuH punaH shoNitenAvaraNAdvisheSheNa kruddhaH| vyavahArArthaM tantrAntaraprasiddhasa~jj~jAbhedAnapyAha- khuDamityAdi| khuDadeshaprAptyA khuDaH, khuDashabdena sandhirucyate; vAtasyAvaraNena balamastyasmi~j shoNite iti vAtabalAshaH; ADhyAnAM prAyo bhavatIti ADhyarogaH||3-11||

guDUcItyAdau guDUcyAdInAM pratyekaM shatapalatvaM, kolAdInAM pratyekamADhakamAnatvam| kAshmaryANAmiti ga~ggArIphalAnAm| sArvayaugikamiti pAnAdicatuShprayoge yaugikam| prasavanamiti prasUtikArakam||96-109||
padmavetasetyAdau phenilA upodikA| sauvIrasammitamiti snehasamaM sauvIrakam| lodhrAdibhiH kArShikaiH, ku~gkumaM ca dvikArShikam||110-113||

shatena yaShTimadhukAdityAdau yaShTImadhupalashataM dashaguNena kShIreNa sAdhyaM, tena caturbhAgasthitena kShIreNa tailaM paktavyam| tadevaM madhukAcchate siddhamiti shatadhApAkena madhukapalashatAt siddhamityarthaH| anena ca madhukapalashatasAdhanopadeshena shataM kRutvetyatra shatashabdasya vipulavAcitAM niSheNayati||115-118||

balAkaShAyetyAdinoktashatasahasrapAke atyarthapAkAt snehakShayaM pashyantaH shataguNena sahasraguNena vA draveNaikadaiva pAkaM vyAkhyAnayanti; kintu tAvatI snehamAtrA~atra paktavyA yA pAkopakShayeNa niHsheShA na bhavati, kShIraM cAtra snehavardhakamasti, tena yathAshrutamevAtrAcAryavacanaM pramANamiti pashyAmaH| ki~jca pratyAsanne eva pAke sadrave snehakalkoddharaNamatra kartavyaM, tena snehApepakShayai~api mAtrA~anena bhavati||119-120||
guDUcItyAdau dravAt pAdikaH sneha iti nyAyAt prasthaM tailasya bhavati| khajitamiti mathitam||121-122||

madhurasiddhairiti jIvanIyasiddhasnehaiH| taNDuletyAdau pratyekaM tribhirambushabdaH sambadhyate| shItatoyAnugairiti shItatoyasiktaiH| candrapAdAmbusaMsikte iti tuShArajalasiktai| pulinaM nadItaTaH, pulinasparshena shIto mArutaH, tena vIjite shayane, ‘shayanasya’ iti sheShaH| erakA hoggalaH| payasi nirvRutA iti kShIre nirvApitAH| umA atasI| agracchadAH taruNapatrANi | mUtrakShAretyAdau kShAraH kShArodakam| amlairiti kA~jjikAdibhiH| romashaM kAsIsam| kalyamiti prAtaH| avasthAkartavyamAha- buddhvetyAdi| UhApohavikalpaviditi pUrvoktacikitsitasya UhApohavikalpaj~jaH||124-155||

vAtashoNitasya vaisheShikaM sthAnamAha| tasya sthAnamityAdi| karapAdagrahaNenaiva a~ggulInAM grahaNe prApte a~ggulInAM bahuparvatayA visheSheNAdhiShThAnatvopadarshanArthaM punarabhidhAnam| mUlamAsthAyeti AspadaM kRutvA| dehadhAvane hetumAha- saukShmyAdityAdi|- sUkShmamArgAnusAritvAt| vAtashoNitasya dehaM sarpato visheSheNa parvAvasthAnaM sahetukamAha- taddravatvAdityAdi| sirAyanairiti sirArUpairmArgaiH| vakratvAditi parvaNAM vakratvAt| pittAdisaMsRuShTamiti pittena kaphena ca hetvantarAgatena vAyunA ca yuktam| tasmAditi sandhiShvavasthAnAt||12-15||

kupita ityAdi| medasaH kaphasya vA ativRuddhyA kRutAt mArgasaMrodhAdanile kupite sati Adau snehanaM tathA bRuMhaNaM ca na shastamiti shlokArthaH| atra snehanabRuMhaNaniShedhe sati kartavyamAha- vyAyAmetyAdinA mAkShikasya cetyantena||156-159||

AvasthikaM vidhimAha- raktetyAdi| raktavRuddhyA pittavRuddhyA ceti raktapittAtivRuddhyA| pAkaM niyacchati ‘vAtaraktam’ iti sheShaH| tayorityAdi vRuddhapittavRuddharaktakRutapAkayorvAtaraktayoH| upadravacikitsAmatidishannAha- kuryAdityAdi||161-162||
hetuH sthAnAnItyAdisa~ggrahe doShAdhikyamupadravAH sAdhyaM yApyamasAdhyaM ceti ananukrameNa sa~ggrahaM karoti, upadravANAmabhAvasadbhAvastokabhAvaiH sAdhyatvAsAdhyatvayApyatvakhyApanArtham||163-165||
svedo~atyarthamityAdinA pUrvarUpamAha| svedo~atyarthaM naveti ca yadyapi kuShThapUrvarUpe~apyuktaM, tathA~apyasamAnabhUripUrvarUpasambandhAdanyatarayogapUrvarUpatve nishcayaH||16-18||

vAtashoNitasya avagADhAnavagADhabhedaM cikitsArthamAha- uttAnamityAdi| antarAshrayamiti tva~gmAMsavyatiriktagambhIradhAtvAshrayam| sarvairli~ggairiti uttAnagambhIravAtaraktoktairmilitaiH| ayaM ca tRutIyaH prakAro bAhyAbhyantaraprakAroktaprakAragRuhIta eveti kRutvA rogasa~ggrahe dvividhaM vAtashoNitamuktam| “dvividhaM vAtashoNitamuttAnamavagADhaM cetyeke bhAShante; tattu na samyak, kasmAt? kuShThavaduttAnaM bhUtvA kAlAntareNAvagADhIbhavati” (su.ci.a.5) ityanena sushrutena yaddvaividhyaM khaNDitaM tadAcAryayoH paramAtmanoH sushrutAgniveshayorekasyApyaprAmANyaM na sa~ggatamiti kRutvA avirodhamevAtra vyAkhyAnayAmaH; tathAhi- sushrutena uttAnaM vAtashoNitaM kuShThavadgambhIraM bhavatItyucyate, na tu sarvamevottAnaM bhUtvA gambhIraM bhavatIti pratij~jAyate; tena yo brUte- uttAnamevAvatiShThate, taM prati sushrutavacanaM bAdhakaM; tanna, carake uttAnamevAvatiShThate iti nocyata eva, kintu prathamotpattau ki~jciduttAnamutpadyate, ki~jcittu gambhIramiti, tena na virodhashcarakasushrutayoH||19-23||

tatra vAte~adhike ityAdau rakte pitte kaphe vA ‘adhike’ ityanuvartanIyaM; tena pittavRuddhiH, shoNitavRuddhiH, kaphavRuddhishca j~jeyA| saMsRuShTeShviti dvitriShu militeShu samasteShviti catuHShvapi militeShvadhikeShu| sirAyAmetyAdinA vAtAdyulbaNAnAM caturNAM lakShaNamAha| AyAmaH vistaraNam| shyAvatA shyAvavarNatvam| shvayathurityAdinA asRujItyantena udriktaraktasya lakShaNam| dvandvatridoShajamityatra adhikashoNitAnubandho~api gRuhItavyaH; tena vAtAdicatuShTayAdhikamelakamapi vAtashoNitaM j~jeyam| ata eva ekadvitrisarvAdhikabhedAd dvividhasyApi vAtashoNitasya pUrvaTIkAkRudbhiH pa~jcacatvAriMshadbhedA uktAH| kharanAdena tu prakaraNAntareNa ShaTtriMshadvidhamuktam| uktaM hi- “vAtottaraM pravRuddhAsRuk pa~jcatriMshadvidhaM matam| pittAttriMshadvidhaM yogAt kaphAddashavidhaM matam” iti| ete bhedA anatiprayojanatvAnna vivRutAH||24-29||

sAdhyAdivibhAgamAha- ekadoShAnugamityAdi| yasya ca syurupadravA iti sAdhyatvenoktasyApi vakShyamANopadravayogAdasAdhyatA| tridoShasyAsAdhyatve~api yadvakShyati ‘khajena mathitA peyA vAtarakte tridoShaje’ iti, tadasampUrNalakShaNAbhinavatridoShajAbhiprAyeNa| mUrcchAyaH mUrcchA| pA~ggulyaM pa~ggutA| mohenaikeneti itaropadravANAM melakAdasAdhyatvaM, mohastu eka eva asAdhyatAkara ityarthaH; ye tu ‘mehenaikena’ iti paThanti, te mehavAtashoNitayorviruddhopakramatayA mehayogenAsAdhyatAmAhuH; vAtashoNitasya hi prAyeNa madhurashItopakramaH, tadviparItastu mehasyeti viruddhopakramatA| vivarNamiti viparItavarNaM; vivarNatvamAtraM tu sarvavAtAnugatopadravaH ||30-34||
athAto yonivyApaccikitsitaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
raktapittakarairnAryA raktaM pittena dUShitam| atipravartate yonyAM labdhe garbhe~api sAsRujA ||16||
yonigarbhAshayasthaM cet pittaM sandUShayedasRuk| sA~arajaskA matA kArshyavaivarNyajananI bhRusham||17||

yonyAmadhAvanAt kaNDUM jAtAH kurvanti jantavaH| sA syAdacaraNA kaNDvA tayA~atinarakA~gkShiNI||18||

Commentary: acaraNeti dhAvanAcaraNAdacaraNA| kaNDvA tayeti kRumijanitayonikaNDvA ||18||
cUrNaM puShyAnugaM nAma hitamAtreyapUjitam|96|iti puShyAnugacUrNam taNDulIyakamUlaM tu sakShaudraM taNDulAmbunA||96||
rasA~jjanaM ca lAkShAM ca chAgena payasA pibet| patrakalkau ghRute bhRuShTau rAjAdanakapitthayoH||97||
pittAnilaharau, paitte sarvathaivAsrapittajit| madhukaM triphalAM lodhraM mustaM saurAShTrikAM madhu||98||
madyairnimbaguDUcyau vA kaphaje~asRugdare pibet| virecanaM mahAtiktaM paittike~asRugdare pibet||99||
kAshmaryakuTajakvAthasiddhamuttarabastinA||100||

maithunAdatibAlAyAH pRuShThakaTyUruva~gkShaNam| rujan dUShayate yoniM vAyuH prAkcaraNA hi sA||20||

Commentary: rujanniti duHkhayan| ucitavyavAyakAlAt prAk vyavAyAcaraNAt prAkcaraNA ucyate||20||
garbhiNyAH shleShmalAbhyAsAcchardiniHshvAsanigrahAt| vAyuH kruddhaH kaphaM yonimupanIya pradUShayet||21||
pANDuM satodamAsrAvaM shvetaM sravati vA kapham| kaphavAtAmayavyAptA sA syAdyonirupaplutA||22||
pittalAyA nRusaMvAse kShavathUdgAradhAraNAt| pittasammUrcchito vAyuryoniM dUShayati striyAH||23||
shUnA sparshAkShamA sArtirnIlapItamasRuk sravet| shroNiva~gkShaNapRuShThArtijvarArtAyAH pariplutA||24||
vegodAvartanAdyonimudAvartayate~anilaH| sA rugArtA rajaH kRucchreNodAvRuttaM vimu~jcati||25||
Artave sA vimukte tu tatkShaNaM labhate sukham| rajaso gamanAdUrdhvaM j~jeyodAvartinI budhaiH||26||

akAle vAhamAnAyA garbheNa pihito~anilaH| karNikAM janayedyonau shleShmaraktena mUrcchitaH||27||

Commentary: akAle vAhamAnAyA ityAdi aprApte garbhaniShkramaNakAle pravAhaNaM kurvantyAH| karNikAmiti karNikAkAraM granthim||27||-

raukShyAdvAyuryadA garbhaM jAtaM jAtaM vinAshayet||28||

Commentary: raukShyAditi rUkShaguNotkarShAt| duShTashoNitajamiti vacanAdiha vAyunA~a~artavaduShTirapi kriyate iti darshayati| atra ca yadyapi sAmAnyenaiva garbhavinAsha uktaH, tathA~api putrasyaiva prAdhAnyAt ‘putraghnI’ iti vyapadesho j~jeyaH||28||-
vyavAyamatitRuptAyA bhajantyAstvannapIDitaH||29||
vAyurmithyAsthitA~ggAyA yonisrotasi saMsthitaH| vakrayatyAnanaM yonyAH sA~asthimAMsAnilArtibhiH||30||

garbhasthAyAH striyA raukShyAdvAyuryoniM pradUShayan||31||

Commentary: garbhasthAyA ityAdau raukShyAditi rUkShaguNAt| mAtRudoShAditi mAturgarbhakAle vAtaprakopahetusevArUpApacArAt||31||-

vyavAyakAle rundhantyA vegAn prakupito~anilaH||32||

Commentary: shoShaM yonimukhasyetyanena yonimukhashoShAcchuShkayonisa~jj~jA vyAkRutA bhavati||32||-

ShaDahAt saptarAtrAdvA shukraM garbhAshayaM gatam||33||

Commentary: ShaDahAdityAdinA shukravamanAd ‘vAminI’ ityucyate||33||-

bIjadoShAttu garbhasthamArutopahatAshayA||34||

Commentary: bIjadoShAditi sAmAnyavacanenApi ArtavarUpabIjadoSha eva j~jeyaH, taddoShasyaiva garbhAshayopaghAtakaratvAt| uktaM hi- “yadA hyasyAH shoNite garbhAshayabIjabhAgaH pradoShamApadyate tadA vandhyAM janayati” (shA.a.4) iti| mArutopahatAshayeti mArutopahatagarbhAshayA| astanI IShatstanI||34||-
viShamaM duHkhashayyAyAM maithunAt kupito~anilaH||35||
garbhAshayasya yonyAshca mukhaM viShTambhayet striyAH| asaMvRutamukhI sArtI rUkShaphenAsravAhinI||36||
ityetairlakShaNaiH proktA viMshatiryonijA gadAH||37||
na shukraM dhArayatyebhirdoShairyonirupadrutA| tasmAdgarbhaM na gRuhNAti strI gacchatyAmayAn bahUn||38||
AsAM ShoDasha yAstvantyA Adye dve pittadoShaje||39||
pariplutA vAminI ca vAtapittAtmike mate| karNinyupaplute vAtakaphAccheShAstu vAtajAH||40||
snehanasvedabastyAdi vAtajAsvanilApaham||41||
kArayedraktapittaghnaM shItaM pittakRutAsu ca| shleShmajAsu ca rUkShoShNaM karma kuryAdvicakShaNaH||42||
sannipAte vimishraM tu saMsRuShTAsu ca kArayet| snigdhasvinnAM tathA yoniM duHsthitAM sthApayetpunaH||43||
pANinA nAmayejjihmAM saMvRutAM vardhayet punaH| praveshayenniHsRutAM ca vivRutAM parivartayet||44||
yoniH sthAnApavRuttA hi shalyabhUtA matA striyAH| sarvAM vyApannayoniM tu karmabhirvamanAdibhiH||45||
mRudubhiH pa~jcabhirnArIM snigdhasvinnAmupAcaret| sarvataH suvishuddhAyAH sheShaM karma vidhIyate||46||
vAtavyAdhiharaM karma vAtArtAnAM sadA hitam| audakAnUpajairmAMsaiH kShIraiH satilataNDulaiH||47||
savAtaghnauShadhairnADIkumbhIsvedairupAcaret| aktAM lavaNatailena sAshmaprastarasa~gkaraiH||48||
balAdroNadvayakvAthe ghRutatailADhakaM pacet||49||
sthirApayasyAjIvantIvIrarShabhakajIvakaiH| shrAvaNIpippalImudgapIlumAShAkhyaparNibhiH||50||
sharkarAkShIrakAkolIkAkanAsAbhireva ca| piShTaishcaturguNakShIre siddhaM peyaM yathAbalam||51||
vAtapittakRutAn rogAn hatvA garbhaM dadhAti tat| kAshmaryatriphalAdrAkShAkAsamardaparUShakaiH||52||
punarnavAdvirajanIkAkanAsAsahacaraiH| shatAvaryA guDUcyAshca prasthamakShasamairghRutAt||53||
sAdhitaM yonivAtaghnaM garbhadaM paramaM pibet| pippalIku~jcikAjAjIvRuShakaM saindhavaM vacAm||54||
yavakShArAjamode ca sharkarAM citrakaM tathA| piShTvA sarpiShi bhRuShTAni pAyayet prasannayA||55||
yonipArshvArtihRudrogagulmArshovinivRuttaye| vRuShakaM mAtulu~ggasya mUlAni madayantikAm||56||
pibet salavaNairmadyaiH pippalIku~jcike tathA| rAsnAshvadaMShTrAvRuShakaiH pibecchUle shRutaM payaH||57||
guDUcItriphalAdantIkvAthaishca pariShecayet| saindhavaM tagaraM kuShThaM bRuhatI devadAru ca||58||
samAMshaiH sAdhitaM kalkaistailaM dhAryaM rujApaham| guDUcImAlatIrAsnAbalAmadhukacitrakaiH||59||
nidigdhikAdevadAruyUthikAbhishca kArShikaiH| tailaprasthaM gavAM mUtre kShIre ca dviguNe pacet||60||
vAtArtAyAH picuM dadyAdyonau ca praNayettataH| vAtArtAnAM ca yonInAM sekAbhya~ggapicukriyAH||61||
