(uShNAH snigdhAH prakartavyAstailAni snehanAni ca )| hiMsrAkalkaM tu vAtArtA koShNamabhyajya dhArayet| pa~jcavalkasya pittArtA shyAmAdInAM kaphAturA||62||
pittalAnAM tu yonInAM sekAbhya~ggapicukriyAH| shItAH pittaharAH kAryAH snehanArthaM ghRutAni ca||63||
(pittaghnauShadhasiddhAni kAryANi bhiShajA tathA )| shatAvarImUlatulAshcatasraH samprapIDayet||64||
rasena kShIratulyena pacettena ghRutADhakam| jIvanIyaiH shatAvaryA mRudvIkAbhiH parUShakaiH||65||
piShTaiH priyAlaishcAkShAMshairdviyaShTimadhukairbhiShak| siddhe shIte ca madhunaH pippalyAshca palAShTakam||66||
sitAdashapalonmishrAllihyAt pANitalaM tataH| yonyasRukshukradoShaghnaM vRuShyaM puMsavanaM ca tat||67||
kShataM kShayaM raktapittaM kAsaM shvAsaM halImakam| kAmalAM vAtaraktaM ca vIsarpaM hRucchirograham||68||
unmAdAratyapasmArAn vAtapittAtmakA~jjayetiti bRuhacchatAvarIghRutamevameva kShIrasarpirjIvanIyopasAdhitam||69||
yonyAM shleShmapraduShTAyAM vartiH saMshodhanI hitA||70||
vArAhe bahushaH pitte bhAvitairlaktakaiH kRutA| bhAvitaM payasA~arkasya yavacUrNaM sasaindhavam||71||
vartiH kRutA muhurdhAryA tataH secyA sukhAmbunA| pippalyA maricairmAShaiH shatAhvAkuShThasaindhavaiH||72||
udumbarashalATUnAM droNamabdroNasaMyutam||73||
sapa~jcavalkakulakamAlatInimbapallavam | nishAM sthApya jale tasmiMstailaprasthaM vipAcayet||74||
lAkShAdhavapalAshatva~gniryAsaiH shAlmalena ca| piShTaiH siddhasya tailasya picuM yonau nidhApayet||75||
sasharkaraiH kaShAyaishca shItaiH kurvIta secanam| picchilA vivRutA kAladuShTA yonishca dAruNA||76||
saptAhAcchudhyati kShipramapatyaM cApi vindati| udumbarasya dugdhena ShaTkRutvo bhAvitAttilAt||77||
tailaM kvAthena tasyaiva siddhaM dhAryaM ca pUrvavat| dhAtakyAmalakIpatrasrotojamadhukotpalaiH||78||
jambvAmramadhyakAsIsalodhrakaTphalatindukaiH| saurAShTrikAdADimatvagudumbarashalATubhiH||79||
akShamAtrairajAmUtre kShIre ca dviguNe pacet| tailaprasthaM picuM dadyAdyonau ca praNayettataH||80||
kaTIpRuShThatrikAbhya~ggaM snehabastiM ca dApayet| picchilA srAviNI yonirviplutopaplutA tathA||81||
uttAnA connatA shUnA sidhyet sasphoTashUlinI| karIradhavanimbArkaveNukoshAmrajAmbavaiH||82||
ji~gginIvRuShamUlAnAM kvAthairmArdvIkasIdhubhiH| sashuktairdhAvanaM mishrairyonyAsrAvavinAshanam||83||
pippalyayorajaHpathyAprayogA madhunA hitAH||84||
shleShmalAyAM kaTuprAyAH samUtrA bastayo hitAH| pitte samadhurakShIrA vAte tailAmlasaMyutAH||85||
raktayonyAmasRugvarNairanubandhaM samIkShya ca||86||
tataH kuryAdyathAdoShaM raktasthApanamauShadham| tilacUrNaM dadhi ghRutaM phANitaM shaukarI vasA||87||
kShaudreNa saMyutaM peyaM vAtAsRugdaranAshanam| varAhasya raso medyaH sakaulattho~anilAdhike||88||
sharkarAkShaudrayaShTyAhvanAgarairvA yutaM dadhi| payasyotpalashAlUkabisakAlIyakAmbudam||89||
pAThA jambvAmrayormadhyaM shilodbhedaM rasA~jjanam||90||
ambaShThA shAlmalIshleShaM sama~ggAM vatsakatvacam| bAhlIkAtiviShe bilvaM mustaM lodhraM sagairikam||91||
kaTva~ggaM maricaM shuNThIM mRudvIkAM raktacandanam| kaTphalaM vatsakAnantAdhAtakImadhukArjunam||92||
puShyeNoddhRutya tulyAni sUkShmacUrNAni kArayet| tAni kShaudreNa saMyojya pibettaNDulavAriNA||93||
arshaHsu cAtisAreShu raktaM yaccopaveshyate| doShAgantukRutA ye ca bAlAnAM tAMshca nAshayet||94||
yonidoShaM rajodoShaM shvetaM nIlaM sapItakam| strINAM shyAvAruNaM yacca prasahya vinivartayet||95||
raktayonyarajaskAnAM putraghnyAshca hitaM ghRutam| mRugAjAvivarAhAsRugdadhyamlaphalasarpiShA ||101||
arajaskA pibet siddhaM jIvanIyaiH payo~api vA| karNinyacaraNAshuShkayoniprAkcaraNAsu ca||102||
kaphavAte ca dAtavyaM tailamuttarabastinA| gopitte matsyapitte vA kShaumaM triHsaptabhAvitam||103||
madhunA kiNvacUrNaM vA dadyAdacaraNApaham| srotasAM shodhanaM kaNDUkledashophaharaM ca tat||104||
vAtaghnaiH shatapAkaishca tailaiH prAgaticAriNI| AsthApyA cAnuvAsyA ca svedyA cAnilasUdanaiH||105||
snehadravyaistathA~a~ahArairupanAhaishca yuktitaH| shatAhvAyavagodhUmakiNvakuShThapriya~ggubhiH||106||
balAkhuparNikAshryAhvaiH saMyAvo dhAraNaH smRutaH| vAminyupaplutAnAM ca snehasvedAdikaH kramaH||107||
kAryastataH snehapicustataH santarpaNaM bhavet| shallakIji~gginIjambUdhavatvakpa~jcavalkalaiH||108||
kaShAyaiH sAdhitaH snehapicuH syAdviplutApahaH| karNinyAM vartikA kuShThapippalyarkAgrasaindhavaiH||109||
bastamUtrakRutA dhAryA sarvaM ca shleShmanuddhitam| traivRutaM snehanaM svedo grAmyAnUpaudakA rasAH||110||
dashamUlapayobastishcodAvartAnilArtiShu| traivRutenAnuvAsyA ca bastishcottarasa~jj~jitaH||111||
etadeva mahAyonyAM srastAyAM ca vidhIyate| vasA RukShavarAhANAM ghRutaM ca madhuraiH shRutam||112||
pUrayitvA mahAyoniM badhnIyAt kShaumalaktakaiH| prasrastAM sarpiShA~abhyajya kShIrasvinnAM praveshya ca||113||
badhnIyAdveshavArasya piNDenAmUtrakAlataH| yacca vAtavikArANAM karmoktaM tacca kArayet||114||
sarvavyApatsu matimAnmahAyonyAM visheShataH| nahi vAtAdRute yonirnArINAM sampraduShyati||115||
rohItakAnmUlakalkaM pANDure~asRugdare pibet||116||
jalenAmalakIbIjaM kalkaM vA sasitAmadhum| madhunA~a~amalakAccUrNaM rasaM vA lehayecca tAm||117||
nyagrodhatvakkaShAyeNa lodhrakalkaM tathA pibet| AsrAve kShaumapaTTaM vA bhAvitaM tena dhArayet||118||
plakShatvakcUrNapiNDaM vA dhArayenmadhunA kRutam| yonyA snehAktayA lodhrapriya~ggumadhukasya vA||119||
dhAryA madhuyutA vartiH kaShAyANAM ca sarvashaH| srAvacchedArthamabhyaktAM dhUpayedvA ghRutAplutaiH||120||
saralAgugguluyavaiH satailakaTumatsyakaiH| kAsIsaM triphalA kA~gkShI sama~ggA~a~amrAsthi dhAtakI||121||
paicchilye kShaudrasaMyuktashcUrNo vaishadyakArakaH| palAshasarjajambUtvaksama~ggAmocadhAtakIH||122||
sapicchilApariklinnAstambhanaH kalka iShyate| stabdhAnAM karkashAnAM ca kAryaM mArdavakArakam||123||
dhArayedveshavAraM vA pAyasaM kRusharAM tathA| durgandhAnAM kaShAyaH syAttauvaraH kalka eva vA||124||
cUrNaM vA sarvagandhAnAM pUtigandhApakarShaNam| evaM yoniShu shuddhAsu garbhaM vindanti yoShitaH||125||

pa~jcakarmavishuddhasya puruShasyApi cendriyam||126||

Commentary: yasmAt puruShasya shukramapyatra kAraNaM garbhe, garbhashcApekShitaH, tasmAcchukrasyApi parIkShApUrvikAM cikitsAmAha- pa~jcakarmetyAdi| indriyamiti shukram| parIkShaNAddoShANAM vAtAdInAM varNairyadi duShTaM bhavati tadA vAtAdivarNayogAdvAtAdiharairbheShajairupAcaredityarthaH||126||-
bhavanti cAtra- sali~ggA vyApado yoneH sanidAnacikitsitAH||127||
uktA vistarataH samya~gmuninA tattvadarshinA| punarevAgniveshastu papraccha bhiShajAM varam||128||
Atreyamupasa~ggamya shukradoShAstvayA~anagha!| rogAdhyAye samuddiShTA hyaShTau puMsAmasheShataH||129||
teShAM hetuM bhiShakshreShTha! duShTAduShTasya cAkRutim| cikitsitaM ca kArtsnyena klaibyaM yacca caturvidham||130||
upadraveShu yonInAM pradaro yashca kIrtitaH| teShAM nidAnaM li~ggaM ca cikitsAM caiva tattvataH||131||
samAsavyAsabhedena prabrUhi bhiShajAMvara!| tasmai shushrUShamANAya provAca munipu~ggavaH||132||
bIjaM yasmAdvyavAye tu harShayonisamutthitam| shukraM pauruShamityuktaM tasmAdvakShyAmi tacchRuNu||133||
yathA bIjamakAlAmbukRumikITAgnidUShitam| na virohati sanduShTaM tathA shukraM sharIriNAm||134||
ativyavAyAdvyAyAmAdasAtmyAnAM ca sevanAt| akAle vA~apyayonau vA maithunaM na ca gacchataH||135||
rUkShatiktakaShAyAtilavaNAmloShNasevanAt| nArINAmarasaj~jAnAM gamanAjjarayA tathA||136||
cintAshokAdavisrambhAcchastrakShArAgnivibhramAt| bhayAtkrodhAdabhIcArAdvyAdhibhiH karshitasya ca||137||
vegAghAtAt kShatAccApi dhAtUnAM sampradUShaNAt| doShAH pRuthak samastA vA prApya retovahAH sirAH||138||
... tadvakShyAmi vibhAgashaH| phenilaM tanu rUkShaM ca vivarNaM pUti picchilam||139||
anyadhAtUpasaMsRuShTamavasAdi tathA~aShTamam| phenilaM tanu rUkShaM ca kRucchreNAlpaM ca mArutAt||140||
bhavatyupahataM shukraM na tadgarbhAya kalpate| sanIlamathavA pItamatyuShNaM pUtigandhi ca||141||
dahalli~ggaM viniryAti shukraM pittena dUShitam| shleShmaNA baddhamArgaM tu bhavatyatyarthapicchilam||142||
strINAmatyarthagamanAdabhighAtAt kShatAdapi| shukraM pravartate jantoH prAyeNa rudhirAnvayam||143||
vegasandhAraNAcchukraM vAyunA vihataM pathi| kRucchreNa yAti grathitamavasAdi tathA~a~aShTamam||144||
iti doShAH samAkhyAtAH shukrasyAShTau salakShaNAH| snigdhaM ghanaM picchilaM ca madhuraM cAvidAhi ca||145||
vAjIkaraNayogaistairupayogasukhairhitaiH||146||
raktapittaharairyogairyonivyApadikaistathA| duShTaM yadA bhavecchukraM tadA tat samupAcaret||147||
ghRutaM ca jIvanIyaM yaccyavanaprAsha eva ca| girijasya prayogashca retodoShAnapohati||148||
vAtAnvite hitAH shukre nirUhAH sAnuvAsanAH| abhayAmalakIyaM ca paitte shastaM rasAyanam ||149||
mAgadhyamRutalohAnAM triphalAyA rasAyanam| kaphotthitaM shukradoShaM hanyAdbhallAtakasya ca||150||
yadanyadhAtusaMsRuShTaM shukraM tadvIkShya yuktitaH| yathAdoShaM prayu~jjIta doShadhAtubhiShagjitam||151||
sarpiH payo rasAH shAliryavagodhUmaShaShTikAH| prashastAH shukradoSheShu bastikarma visheShataH||152||

retodoShodbhavaM klaibyaM yasmAcchuddhyaiva sidhyati||153||

Commentary: shuddhyaiveti retaHshuddhyaiva; siddhyati prashAmyati||153||-
bIjadhvajopaghAtAbhyAM jarayA shukrasa~gkShayAt||154||
klaibyaM sampadyate tasya shRuNu sAmAnyalakShaNam| sa~gkalpapravaNo nityaM priyAM vashyAmapi striyam||155||
na yAti li~ggashaithilyAt kadAcidyAti vA yadi| shvAsArtaH svinnagAtrashca moghasa~gkalpaceShTitaH||156||
mlAnashishnashca nirbIjaH syAdetat klaibyalakShaNam| sAmAnyalakShaNaM hyetadvistareNa pravakShyate||157||
shItarUkShAlpasa~gkliShTaviruddhAjIrNabhojanAt | shokacintAbhayatrAsAt strINAM cAtyarthasevanAt||158||
abhicArAdavisrambhAdrasAdInAM ca sa~gkShayAt| vAtAdInAM ca vaiShamyAttathaivAnashanAcchramAt||159||
nArINAmarasaj~jatvAt pa~jcakarmApacArataH| bIjopaghAtAdbhavati pANDuvarNaH sudurbalaH||160||
alpaprANo~alpaharShashca pramadAsu bhavennaraH| hRutpANDurogatamakakAmalAshramapIDitaH||161||
atyamlalavaNakShAraviruddhAsAtmyabhojanAt| atyambupAnAdviShamAt piShTAnnagurubhojanAt||163||
... dhvajabha~ggakRutaM shRuNu||162||
dadhikShIrAnUpamAMsasevanAdvyAdhikarShaNAt| kanyAnAM caiva gamanAdayonigamanAdapi||164||
dIrgharogAM cirotsRuShTAM tathaiva ca rajasvalAm| durgandhAM duShTayoniM ca tathaiva ca parisrutAm ||165||
IdRushIM pramadAM mohAdyo gacchet kAmaharShitaH| catuShpadAbhigamanAcchephasashcAbhighAtataH||166||
adhAvanAdvA meDhrasya shastradantanakhakShatAt| kAShThaprahAraniShpeShAcchUkAnAM cAtisevanAt||167||
retasashca pratIghAtAddhvajabha~ggaH pravartate| (bhavanti yAni rUpANi tasya vakShyAmyataH param)| shvayathurvedanA meDhre rAgashcaivopalakShyate||168||
sphoTAshca tIvrA jAyante li~ggapAko bhavatyapi| mAMsavRuddhirbhaveccAsya vraNAH kShipraM bhavantyapi||169||
pulAkodakasa~gkAshaH srAvaH shyAvAruNaprabhaH| valayIkurute cApi kaThinashca parigrahaH||170||
jvarastRuShNA bhramo mUrcchA cchardishcAsyopajAyate| raktaM kRuShNaM sraveccApi nIlamAvilalohitam||171||
agnineva ca dagdhasya tIvro dAhaH savedanaH| bastau vRuShaNayorvA~api sIvanyAM va~gkShaNeShu ca||172||
kadAcitpicchilo vA~api pANDuH srAvashca jAyate| shvayathurjAyate mandaH stimito~alpaparisravaH||173||
cirAcca pAkaM vrajati shIghraM vA~atha pramucyate| jAyante krimayashcApi klidyate pUtigandhi ca||174||
vishIryate maNishcAsya meDhraM muShkAvathApi ca| dhvajabha~ggakRutaM klaibyamityetat samudAhRutam||175||
klaibyaM jarAsambhavaM hi pravakShyAmyatha tacchRuNu||176||
jaghanyamadhyapravaraM vayastrividhamucyate| atipravayasAM shukraM prAyashaH kShIyate nRuNAm||177||
rasAdInAM sa~gkShayAcca tathaivAvRuShyasevanAt| balavIryendriyANAM ca krameNaiva parikShayAt||178||
parikShayAdAyuShashcApyanAhArAcchramAt klamAt| jarAsambhavajaM klaibyamityetairhetubhirnRuNAm||179||
jAyate tena so~atyarthaM kShINadhAtuH sudurbalaH| vivarNo durbalo dInaH kShipraM vyAdhimathAshnute||180||
... caturthaM kShayajaM shRuNu| atIva cintanAccaiva shokAtkrodhAdbhayAttathA||181||
IrShyotkaNThAmadodvegAn sadA vishati yo naraH| kRusho vA sevate rUkShamannapAnaM tathauShadham||182||
durbalaprakRutishcaiva nirAhAro bhavedyadi| asAtmyabhojanAccApi hRudaye yo vyavasthitaH||183||
rasaH pradhAnadhAturhi kShIyetAshu tato nRuNAm| raktAdayashca kShIyante dhAtavastasya dehinaH||184||
shukrAvasAnAstebhyo~api shukraM dhAma paraM matam| cetaso vA~atiharSheNa vyavAyaM sevate~ati yaH||185||
tasyAshu kShIyate shukraM tataH prApnoti sa~gkShayam| ghoraM vyAdhimavApnoti maraNaM vA sa gacchati||186||
shukraM tasmAdvisheSheNa rakShyamArogyamicchatA| evaM nidAnali~ggAbhyAmuktaM klaibyaM caturvidham||187||
kecit klaibye tvasAdhye dve dhvajabha~ggakShayodbhave| vadanti shephasashchedAdvRuShaNotpATanena ca||188||
mAtApitrorbIjadoShAdashubhaishcAkRutAtmanaH| garbhasthasya yadA doShAH prApya retovahAHsirAH||189||
shoShayantyAshu tannAshAdretashcApyupahanyate| tatra sampUrNasarvA~ggaH sa bhavatyapumAn pumAn||190||
cikitsitamatastUrdhvaM samAsavyAsataH shRuNu||191||
shukradoSheShu nirdiShTaM bheShajaM yanmayA~anagha!| klaibyopashAntaye kuryAt kShINakShatahitaM ca yat||192||
bastayaH kShIrasarpIMShi vRuShyayogAshca ye matAH| rasAyanaprayogAshca sarvAnetAn prayojayet||193||
samIkShya dehadoShAgnibalaM bheShajakAlavit| vyavAyahetuje klaibye tathA dhAtuviparyayAt ||194||
daivavyapAshrayaM caiva bheShajaM cAbhicAraje | samAsenaitaduddiShTaM bheShajaM klaibyashAntaye||195||
vistareNa pravakShyAmi klaibyAnAM bheShajaM punaH| susvinnasnigdhagAtrasya snehayuktaM virecanam||196||
annAshanaM tataH kuryAdathavA~a~asthApanaM punaH| pradadyAnmatimAn vaidyastatastamanuvAsayet||197||
palAshairaNDamustAdyaiH pashcAdAsthApayettataH| vAjIkaraNayogAshca pUrvaM ye samudAhRutAH||198||
bhiShajA te prayojyAH syuH klaibye bIjopaghAtaje| dhvajabha~ggakRutaM klaibyaM j~jAtvA tasyAcaret kriyAm||199||
pradehAn pariShekAMshca kuryAdvA raktamokShaNam| snehapAnaM ca kurvIta sasnehaM ca virecanam||200||
anuvAsaM tataH kuryAdathavA~a~asthApanaM punaH| vraNavacca kriyAH sarvAstatra kuryAdvicakShaNaH||201||
jarAsambhavaje klaibye kShayaje caiva kArayet| snehasvedopapannasya sasnehaM shodhanaM hitam||202||
kShIrasarpirvRuShyayogA bastayashcaiva yApanAH| rasAyanaprayogAshca tayorbheShajamucyate||203||
yaH pUrvamuktaH pradaraH shRuNu hetvAdibhistu tam||204||
yA~atyarthaM sevate nArI lavaNAmlagurUNi ca| kaTUnyatha vidAhIni snigdhAni pishitAni ca||205||
grAmyaudakAni medyAni kRusharAM pAyasaM dadhi | shuktamastusurAdIni bhajantyAH kupito~anilaH||206||
raktaM pramANamutkramya garbhAshayagatAH sirAH| rajovahAH samAshritya raktamAdAya tadrajaH||207||
yasmAdvivardhayatyAshu rasabhAvAdvimAnatA | tasmAdasRugdaraM prAhuretattantravishAradAH||208||
rajaH pradIryate yasmAt pradarastena sa smRutaH| sAmAnyataH samuddiShTaM kAraNaM li~ggameva ca||209||
caturvidhaM vyAsatastu vAtAdyaiH sannipAtataH| ataHparaM pravakShyAmi hetvAkRutibhiShagjitam||210||
rUkShAdibhirmArutastu raktamAdAya pUrvavat| kupitaH pradaraM kuryAllakShaNaM tasya me shRuNu||211||
phenilaM tanu rUkShaM ca shyAvaM cAruNameva ca| kiMshukodakasa~gkAshaM sarujaM vA~atha nIrujam||212||
kaTiva~gkShaNahRutpArshvapRuShThashroNiShu mArutaH| kurute vedanAM tIvrAmetadvAtAtmakaM viduH||213||
amloShNalavaNakShAraiH pittaM prakupitaM yadA| pUrvavat pradaraM kuryAt paittikaM li~ggataH shRuNu||214||
sanIlamathavA pItamatyuShNamasitaM tathA| nitAntaraktaM sravati muhurmuhurathArtimat||215||
dAharAgatRuShAmohajvarabhramasamAyutam| asRugdaraM paittikaM syAcchlaiShmikaM tu pravakShyate||216||
gurvAdibhirhetubhishca pUrvavat kupitaH kaphaH| pradaraM kurute tasya lakShaNaM tattvataH shRuNu||217||
picchilaM pANDuvarNaM ca guru snigdhaM ca shItalam| sravatyasRuk shleShmalaM ca ghanaM mandarujAkaram||218||
chardyarocakahRullAsashvAsakAsasamanvitam| (vakShyate kShIradoShANAM sAmAnyamiha kAraNam||219||
yattadeva tridoShasya kAraNaM pradarasya tu)| trili~ggasaMyutaM vidyAnnaikAvasthamasRugdaram||220||
nArI tvatiparikliShTA yadA prakShINashoNitA| sarvahetusamAcArAdativRuddhastadA~anilaH||221||
raktamArgeNa sRujati pratyanIkabalaM kapham| durgandhaM picchilaM pItaM vidagdhaM pittatejasA||222||
vasAM medashca yAvaddhi samupAdAya vegavAn| sRujatyapatyamArgeNa sarpirmajjavasopamam||223||
shashvat sravatyathAsrAvaM tRuShNAdAhajvarAnvitAm| kShINaraktAM durbalAM sa tAmasAdhyAM vivarjayet||224||
mAsAnniShpicchadAhArti pa~jcarAtrAnubandhi ca| naivAtibahu nAtyalpamArtavaM shuddhamAdishet||225||
gu~jjAphalasavarNaM ca padmAlaktakasannibham | indragopakasa~gkAshamArtavaM shuddhamAdishet||226||
yonInAM vAtalAdyAnAM yaduktamiha bheShajam| caturNAM pradarANAM ca tat sarvaM kArayedbhiShak||227||
raktAtisAriNAM yacca tathA shoNitapittinAm| raktArshasAM ca yat proktaM bheShajaM tacca kArayet||228||
dhAtrIstanastanyasampaduktA vistarataH purA| stanyasa~jjananaM caiva stanyasya ca vishodhanam||229||
vAtAdiduShTe li~ggaM ca kShINasya ca cikitsitam| tatsarvamuktaM ye tvaShTau kShIradoShAH prakIrtitAH||230||
vAtAdiShveva tAn vidyAcchAstracakShurbhiShaktamaH| trividhAstu yataH shiShyAstato vakShyAmi vistaram||231||
ajIrNAsAtmyaviShamaviruddhAtyarthabhojanAt| lavaNAmlakaTukShArapraklinnAnAM ca sevanAt||232||
manaHsharIrasantApAdasvapnAnnishi cintanAt| prAptavegapratIghAtAdaprAptodIraNena ca||233||
paramAnnaM guDakRutaM kRusharAM dadhi mandakam | abhiShyandIni mAMsAni grAmyAnUpaudakAni ca||234||
bhuktvA bhuktvA divAsvapnAnmadyasyAtiniShevaNAt| anAyAsAdabhIghAtAt krodhAccAta~gkakarshanaiH||235||
doShAH kShIravahAH prApya sirAH stanyaM pradUShya ca| kuryuraShTavidhaM bhUyo doShatastannibodha me||236||
vairasyaM phenasa~gghAto raukShyaM cetyanilAtmake| pittAdvaivarNyadaurgandhye snehapaicchilyagauravam||237||
kaphAdbhavati rUkShAdyairanilaH svaiH prakopaNaiH| kruddhaH kShIrAshayaM prApya rasaM stanyasya dUShayet||238||
virasaM vAtasaMsRuShTaM kRushIbhavati tat piban| na cAsya svadate kShIraM kRucchreNa ca vivardhate||239||
tathaiva vAyuH kupitaH stanyamantarviloDayan| karoti phenasa~gghAtaM tattu kRucchrAt pravartate||240||
tena kShAmasvaro bAlo baddhaviNmUtramArutaH| vAtikaM shIrSharogaM vA pInasaM vA~adhigacchati||241||
pUrvavat kupitaH stanye snehaM shoShayate~anilaH| rUkShaM tat pibato raukShyAdbalahrAsaH prajAyate||242||
pittamuShNAdibhiH kruddhaM stanyAshayamabhiplutam| karoti stanyavaivarNyaM nIlapItAsitAdikam||243||
vivarNagAtraH svinnaH syAttRuShNAlurbhinnaviT shishuH| nityamuShNasharIrashca nAbhinandati taM stanam||244||
pUrvavat kupite pitte daurgandhyaM kShIramRucchati| pANDvAmayastatpibataH kAmalA ca bhavecchishoH||245||
kruddho gurvAdibhiH shleShmA kShIrAshayagataH striyAH| snehAnvitatvAttatkShIramatisnigdhaM karoti tu||246||
chardanaH kunthanastena lAlAlurjAyate shishuH| nityopadigdhaiH srotobhirnidrAklamasamanvitaH ||247||
shvAsakAsaparItastu prasekatamakAnvitaH| abhibhUya kaphaH stanyaM picchilaM kurute yadA||248||
lAlAluH shUnavaktrAkShirjaDaH syAttat piba~jchishuH| kaphaH kShIrAshayagato gurutvAt kShIragauravam||249||
karoti guru tat pItvA bAlo hRudrogamRucchati| anyAMshca vividhAtrogAnkuryAtkShIrasamAshritAn||250||
kShIre vAtAdibhirduShTe sambhavanti tadAtmakAH| tatrAdau stanyashuddhyarthaM dhAtrIM snehopapAditAm||251||
saMsvedya vidhivadvaidyo vamanenopapAdayet| vacApriya~gguyaShTyAhvaphalavatsakasarShapaiH||252||
kalkairnimbapaTolAnAM kvAthaiH salavaNairvamet| samyagvAntAM yathAnyAyaM kRutasaMsarjanAM tataH||253||
doShakAlabalApekShI snehayitvA virecayet| trivRutAmabhayAM vA~api triphalArasasaMyutAm||254||
pAyayenmadhusaMyuktAmabhayAM vA~api kevalAm| (pAyayenmUtrasaMyuktAM virekArthaM ca shAstravit )||255||
samyagviriktAM matimAn kRutasaMsarjanAM punaH| tato doShAvasheShaghnairannapAnairupAcaret ||256||
shAlayaH ShaShTikA vA syuH shyAmAkA bhojane hitAH| priya~ggavaH koradUShA yavA veNuyavAstathA||257||
vaMshavetrakalAyAshca shAkArthe snehasaMskRutAH| mudgAn masUrAn yUShArthe kulatthAMshca prakalpayet||258||
nimbavetrAgrakulakavArtAkAmalakaiH shRutAn| savyoShasaindhavAn yUShAndApayetstanyashodhanAn||259||
shashAn kapi~jjalAneNAn saMskRutAMshca pradApayet| shAr~ggeShTAsaptaparNatvagashvagandhAshRutaM jalam||260||
pAyayetAthavA stanyashuddhaye rohiNIshRutam| amRutAsaptaparNatvakkvAthaM caiva sanAgaram||261||
kirAtatiktakakvAthaM shlokapAderitAn pibet| trInetAnstanyashuddhyarthamiti sAmAnyabheShajam||262||
kIrtitaM stanyadoShANAM pRuthaganyaM nibodhata| pAyayedvirasakShIrAM drAkShAmadhukasArivAH||263||
shlakShNapiShTAM payasyAM ca samAloDya sukhAmbunA| pa~jcakolakulatthaishca piShTairAlepayet stanau||264||
shuShkau prakShAlya nirduhyAttathA stanyaM vishudhyati| phenasa~gghAtavatkShIraM yasyAstAM pAyayet striyam||265||
pAThAnAgarashAr~ggeShTAmUrvAH piShTvA sukhAmbunA| a~jjanaM nAgaraM dAru bilvamUlaM priya~ggavaH||266||
stanayoH pUrvavat kAryaM lepanaM kShIrashodhanam| kirAtatiktakaM shuNThIM sAmRutAM kvAthayedbhiShak||267||
taM kvAthaM pAyayeddhAtrIM stanyadoShanibarhaNam| stanau cAlepayet piShTairyavagodhUmasarShapaiH||268||
ShaDvirekAshritIyoktairauShadhaiH stanyashodhanaiH| rUkShakShIrA pibet kShIraM tairvA siddhaM ghRutaM pibet||269||
pUrvavajjIvakAdyaM ca pa~jcamUlaM pralepanam| stanayoH saMvidhAtavyaM sukhoShNaM stanyashodhanam||270||
yaShTImadhukamRudvIkApayasyAsindhuvArikAH| shItAmbunA pibetkalkaM kShIravaivarNyanAshanam||271||
drAkShAmadhukakalkena stanau cAsyAH pralepayet| prakShAlya vAriNA caiva nirduhyAttau punaH punaH||272||
viShANikAjashRu~ggyau ca triphalAM rajanIM vacAm| pibecchItAmbunA piShTvA kShIradaurgandhyanAshinIm||273||
lihyAdvA~apyabhayAcUrNaM savyoShaM mAkShikaplutam| kShIradaurgandhyanAshArthaM dhAtrI pathyAshinI tathA||274||
sArivoshIrama~jjiShThAshleShmAtakakucandanaiH| patrAmbucandanoshIraiH stanau cAsyAH pralepayet||275||
snigdhakShIrA dArumustapAThAH piShTvA sukhAmbunA| pItvA sasaindhavAH kShipraM kShIrashuddhimavApnuyAt||276||
pAyayet picchilakShIrAM shAr~ggeShTAmabhayAM vacAm| mustanAgarapAThAshca pItAH stanyavishodhanAH||277||
takrAriShTaM pibeccApi yaduktaM gudajApaham| vidArIbilvamadhukaiH stanau cAsyAH pralepayet||278||
trAyamANAmRutAnimbapaTolatriphalAshRutam| gurukShIrA pibedAshu stanyadoShavishuddhaye||279||
pibedvA pippalImUlacavyacitrakanAgaram| balAnAgarashAr~ggeShTAmUrvAbhirlepayet stanau||280||
pRushniparNIpayasyAbhyAM stanau cAsyAH pralepayet| aShTAvete kShIradoShA hetulakShaNabheShajaiH||281||
doShadUShyamalAshcaiva mahatAM vyAdhayashca ye||282||
ta eva sarve bAlAnAM mAtrA tvalpatarA matA| nivRuttirvamanAdInAM mRudutvaM paratantratAm||283||
vAkceShTayorasAmarthyaM vIkShya bAleShu shAstravit| bheShajaM svalpamAtraM tu yathAvyAdhi prayojayet||284||
madhurANi kaShAyANi kShIravanti mRudUni ca| prayojayedbhiShagbAle matimAnapramAdataH||285||
atyarthasnigdharUkShoShNamamlaM kaTuvipAki ca| guru cauShadhapAnAnnametadbAleShu garhitam||286||
samAsAt sarvarogANAmetadbAleShu bheShajam| nirdiShTaM shAstravidvaidyaH pravivicya prayojayet||287||

bhavanti cAtra- iti sarvavikArANAmuktametaccikitsitam| sthAnametaddhi tantrasya rahasyaM paramuttamam ||288||

Commentary: iti sarvavikArANAmityAdinA cikitsAsthAnoktamarthamupasa~ggRuhNAti| sarvavikArANAmiti vacanena anuktAnAmapi vikArANAmetaccikitsAbIjasUtramiti darshayati| rahasyamiti atyantopayuktacikitsAbhidhAyakatayA gopyaM, na kasmaicit pApiShThAya prakAshanIyamiti||288||
asmin saptadashAdhyAyAH kalpAH siddhaya eva ca| nAsAdyante~agniveshasya tantre carakasaMskRute||289||
tAnetAn kApilabaliH sheShAn dRuDhabalo~akarot| tantrasyAsya mahArthasya pUraNArthaM yathAtatham||290||

rogA ye~apyatra noddiShTA bahutvAnnAmarUpataH| teShAmapyetadeva syAddoShAdIn vIkShya bheShajam||291||

Commentary: samprati uktAnuktarogacikitsAtideshArthamAha- rogA ye~apyatretyAdi| etadevetyAdi etaccikitsAsthAnAdyuktaM bheShajam; etadeva hi bheShajaM nAmarUpAdinA visheSheNAnuktAnAM sAmAnyatashca vAtAdijanyatayoktAn rogAnapekShya tathAyuktaM sad bheShajaM bhavatItyarthaH| doShAdIniti doShadUShyanidAnAnyagre vakShyamANAni; kiMvA doSha-bheShaja-desha-kAla-bala-sharIrAhAra-sAtmya-sattva-prakRuti-vayAMsi sUtrasthAnoktAni||291||

doShadUShyanidAnAnAM viparItaM hitaM dhruvam| uktAnuktAn gadAn sarvAn samyagyuktaM niyacchati||292||

Commentary: atha kathametadbheShajamanuktAnAM gadAnAM bheShajaM bhavatItyAha- doShadUShyetyAdi| doShA vAtAdayaH, dUShyANi raktAdIni, nidAnAni rUkShAdIni, eShAM vyastAnAM samastAnAM vA yad viparItaM, hitamiti bheShajaM, tat samyagyuktaM saduktAnuktAn gadAn dhruvaM niyacchati; uktAniti nAmarUpAdibhiH, anuktAniti nAmarUpAdivisheSheNAnuktAn| etena yadevaitad doShAdiviparItatayA pratipAditaM bhavati tadaivAnuktAnAmapi gadAnAM doShAdIn buddhvA samyagyuktaM bheShajaM bhavatIti darshayati| yadyapi ca yannidAnaviparItaM bheShajaM taddoShaviparItenaiva grahItuM pAryate, yato nidAnena doShaprakopaH kriyate, tasya ca doShasya viparItaM yathA rUkShanidAnavRuddhe vAyau rUkShe yo viparItaH snehaH sa nidAne~api viparIta eva; tathA~api doShasyaivAMshavaiparItyena bheShajaprayogopadarshanArthaM nidAnaviparItopAdAnamiha| yathA- yadi vAyuH sarvAtmanA prakupitastadA tasya vAyoryadviparItaM tailaM tat kartavyaM, yadA tu shItena vAyurvRuddhastadA sarvAtmanA viruddhaM tailamutsRujya yadeva shItatve hitaM tasyaiva shItaguNasya prashamArthaM hetuviparItamuShNaM bheShajaM prayujyate| ata evoktaM- “shItenoShNakRutAn rogA~j shamayanti bhiShagvidaH” (vi.a.3) ityAdi| iha tu doShAdInAM grahaNAd doShadUShyasamudAyAtmA vyAdhirapi labhyate, tena vyAdhiviparItamapi bheShajamavaruddham| viparItashabdena ceha pratikUlamucyate, na viparItaguNamAtraM; tena viparyastArthakAriNAmapi bheShajAnAM grahaNaM bhavati| yattu samAnameva kShINAnAM doShANAM dhAtUnAM vA bheShajaM bhavati tad doShAdikShayavyAdhivRuddhijanakatayA viparItameva, yena tatra na doShAdayaH pratikartavyAH kintu tatkShayAH, tena kShaye doShAdiviparItaM samyagyuktaM saddoShAdIn niyacchatItyuktaM, tato doShAdisamAnameva viparItamiti na kashciddoShaH||292||

deshakAlapramANAnAM sAtmyAsAtmyasya caiva hi| samyagyogo~anyathA hyeShAM pathyamapyanyathA bhavet||293||

Commentary: atha yena samyagyogena yuktaM bheShajaM kAryakaraM bhavati tameva samyagyogamAha- deshakAletyAdi| eShAM tu deshAdiyogAnAmudAharaNAnyAcAryeNaiva kRutAni ‘AsyAdAmAshayasthAn’ ityAdinA ‘nAtidoShaM ca bahvapi’ ityantena| tatra desha AturarUpa evoktaH, bhUmirUpadeshApekShA tu yojanA sAtmyApekShayojanAbhidhAnenaiva gRuhItA| kAlaH ShaDvidho dinAturauShadhAdibhiH| tatrauShadhakAlo dashavidhaH| pramANamauShadhasya trividham- alpaM, bahu, samaM ca| sAtmyaM dvividhaM deshasharIrayoH; vyAdhisAtmyaM tvauShadhAntarniviShTameva; RutusAtmyaM ca kAlagRuhItaM; pramANasAtmyagrahaNaM samyagyogenaiva kRutam| asAtmyaM yat sAtmyaviparItam| samyagyogaH yathAvatprayogaH| viparyaye doShamAha- anyathA hyeShAM pathyamapyanyathA bhavet; eShAM deshAdInAm, anyatheti asamyagyoge, pathyamapIti bheShajaM doShAdiparItamapi, anyatheti apathyaM bhavati| yAni cAparANi balasattvAdIni dashavidhadoShAdyantargatAni parIkShyANi nehoktAni tAni doShAdiShvantarbhAvanIyAni||293||
AsyAdAmAshayasthAn hi rogAn nastaHshirogatAn| gudAt pakvAshayasthAMshca hantyAshu dattamauShadham||294||
sharIrAvayavottheShu visarpapiDakAdiShu| yathAdeshaM pradehAdi shamanaM syAdvisheShataH||295||
dinAturauShadhavyAdhijIrNali~ggartvavekShaNam | kAlaM vidyAddinAvekShaH pUrvAhNe vamanaM yathA||296||
rogyavekSho yathA prAtarniranno balavAn pibet| bheShajaM laghupathyAnnairyuktamadyAttu durbalaH||297||
bhaiShajyakAlo bhuktAdau madhye pashcAnmuhurmuhuH| sAmudgaM bhaktasaMyuktaM grAsagrAsAntare dasha||298||
apAne viguNe pUrvaM, samAne madhyabhojanam| vyAne tu prAtarashitamudAne bhojanottaram||299||
vAyau prANe praduShTe tu grAsagrAsAntariShyate| shvAsakAsapipAsAsu tvavacAryaM muhurmuhuH||300||
sAmudgaM hikkine deyaM laghunA~annena saMyutam| sambhojyaM tvauShadhaM bhojyairvicitrairarucau hitam||301||
jvare peyAH kaShAyAshca kShIraM sarpirvirecanam| ShaDahe ShaDahe deyaM kAlaM vIkShyAmayasya ca||302||
kShudvegamokShau laghutA vishuddhirjIrNalakShaNam| tadA bheShajamAdeyaM syAddhi doShavadanyathA||303||
cayAdayashca doShANAM varjyaM sevyaM ca yatra yat| RutAvavekShyaM yat karma pUrvaM sarvamudAhRutam||304||
(upakramANAM karaNaM pratiShedhe ca kAraNam| vyAkhyAtamabalAnAM savikalpAnAmavekShaNe||305||
muhurmuhushca rogANAmavasthAmAturasya ca| avekShamANastu bhiShak cikitsAyAM na muhyati)||306||
ityevaM ShaDvidhaM kAlamanavekShya bhiShagjitam| prayuktamahitAya syAt sasyasyAkAlavarShavat||307||
vyAdhInAmRutvahorAtravayasAM bhojanasya ca| visheSho bhidyate yastu kAlAvekShaH sa ucyate||308||
vasante shleShmajA rogAH sharatkAle tu pittajAH| varShAsu vAtikAshcaiva prAyaH prAdurbhavanti hi||309||
nishAnte divasAnte ca varShAnte vAtajA gadAH| prAtaH kShapAdau kaphajAstayormadhye tu pittajAH||310||
vayontamadhyaprathame vAtapittakaphAmayAH| balavanto bhavantyeva svabhAvAdvayaso nRuNAm||311||
jIrNAnte vAtajA rogA jIryamANe tu pittajAH| shleShmajA bhuktamAtre tu labhante prAyasho balam||312||
nAlpaM hantyauShadhaM vyAdhiM yathA~a~apo~alpA mahAnalam| doShavaccAtimAtraM syAtsasyasyAtyudakaM yathA||313||
sampradhArya balaM tasmAdAmayasyauShadhasya ca| naivAtibahu nAtyalpaM bhaiShajyamavacArayet||314||
aucityAdyasya yat sAtmyaM deshasya puruShasya ca| apathyamapi naikAntAttattyajaMllabhate sukham||315||
bAhlIkAH pahlavAshcInAH shUlIkA yavanAH shakAH| mAMsagodhUmamAdhvIkashastravaishvAnarocitAH||316||
matsyasAtmyAstathA prAcyAH kShIrasAtmyAshca saindhavAH| ashmakAvantikAnAM tu tailAmlaM sAtmyamucyate||317||
kandamUlaphalaM sAtmyaM vidyAnmalayavAsinAm| sAtmyaM dakShiNataH peyA manthashcottarapashcime ||318||
madhyadeshe bhavet sAtmyaM yavagodhUmagorasAH| teShAM tatsAtmyayuktAni bhaiShajAnyavacArayet||319||

yogaireva cikitsan hi deshAdyaj~jo~aparAdhyati||320||

Commentary: uktadeshAdiparIkShAvyatirekeNa kevalaM yathoktayogaireva cikitsAM kurvato doShamAha- yogairevetyAdi| deshAdyaj~ja ityanena deshAdyaj~jAnAd deshAdiviguNacikitsAkArakaM puruShaM lakShayati| aparAdhyati na IpsitaM sAdhayati| deshAdyaj~ja ityatrAdishabdena kAlAdInAmuktAnAM tathA pradeshAntaroktavayo-bala-sharIra-prakRuti-sattvAnAM grahaNam| deshAdyaj~jaH kuto~aparAdhyatItyAha- vayobaletyAdi| Adishabdena prakRutisattvAdInAM grahaNam| yasmAdvayobalAdibhedA bahavashcikitsAvekShaNIyAshcikitsakAnAM matAH santi, tasmAd deshAdinirapekShA cikitsA kriyamANA na IpsitaM sAdhayatIti bhAvaH||320||-
tathA~antaHsandhimArgANAM doShANAM gUDhacAriNAm||321||
bhavet kadAcit kAryA~api viruddhAbhimatA kriyA| pittamantargataM gUDhaM svedasekopanAhanaiH||322||
nIyate bahiruShNairhi tathoShNaM shamayanti te| bAhyaishca shItaiH sekAdyairUShmA~antaryAti pIDitaH||323||
so~antargUDhaM kaphaM hanti shItaM shItaistathA jayet| shlakShNapiShTo ghano lepashcandanasyApi dAhakRut||324||
tvaggatasyoShmaNo rodhAcchItakRuccAnyathA~aguroH| chardighnI makShikAviShThA makShikaiva tu vAmayet||325||

tasmAddoShauShadhAdIni parIkShya dasha tattvataH||326||

Commentary: parIkShAphalamupasaMharati- tasmAdityAdi| doShauShadhAdIni upakalpanIye (sU.a.15) ekAdasha paThitAni, vimAne ca dvAdasha paThitAni, tena tadgrahaNenehoktaM dashasa~gkhyatvaM vyAhanyate; tena dRuDhabalenaiva nirUhaprastAve yAni doShauShadhAdIni dasha nirdiShTAni “samIkShya doShauShadhadeshakAlasAtmyAgnisattvaukavayobalAni” (si.a.3) ityanena, tAnyevAtra dasha gRuhyante| etaddashaka evopakalpanIyoktaikAdashakasya parIkShyasya tathA vimAnoktadvAdashakasya cAvarodhaH| tathAhi- upakalpanIye etaddashata anye prakRutisharIrAhArA uktAH; tatra sharIrasya prakRuteshca deshashabdena bhUmyAturagrAhiNA grahaNam, uktaM hi- “desho bhUmirAturashca” (vi.a.8) iti; AhArasya tu sAtmyagrahaNenaiva grahaNam| vimAne ca yo dvAdasho vikAraH paThitaH, sa doShagrahaNagRuhItaH| evaM sarvopakalpanIyAdyuktArthopagraho vyAkhyeyaH| yattu AShADhavarmaprabhRutibhiratadguNabahuvrIhipakShAshrayeNopakalpanIyoktAnAmeva dashatvaM vyAkhyAtamiha, tad hyashAbdamasa~ggataM ca| na yogaireveti na prayogamAtreNa||326||-
nivRutto~api punarvyAdhiH svalpenAyAti hetunA||327||
kShINe mArgIkRute dehe sheShaH sUkShma ivAnalaH| tasmAttamanubadhnIyAt prayogeNAnapAyinA||328||
kAThinyAdUnabhAvAdvA doSho~antaH kupito mahAn||329||
pathyairmRudvalpatAM nIto mRududoShakaro bhavet| pathyamapyashnatastasmAdyo vyAdhirupajAyate||330||
sAtatyAtsvAdvabhAvAdvA pathyaM dveShyatvamAgatam||331||
kalpanAvidhibhistaistaiH priyatvaM gamayet punaH| manaso~arthAnukUlyAddhi tuShTirUrjA rucirbalam||332||
sukhopabhogatA ca syAdvyAdheshcAto balakShayaH| laulyAddoShakShayAdvyAdhervaidharmyAccApi yA ruciH||333||
tatra shlokAH- viMshatirvyApado yonernidAnaM li~ggameva ca||334||
cikitsA cApi nirdiShTA shiShyANAM hitakAmyayA| shukradoShAstathA cAShTau nidAnAkRutibheShajaiH||335||
klaibyAnyuktAni catvAri catvAraH pradarAstathA| teShAM nidAnaM li~ggaM ca bhaiShajyaM caiva kIrtitam||336||
kShIradoShAstathA cAShTau hetuli~ggabhiShagjitaiH| retaso rajasashcaiva kIrtitaM shuddhilakShaNam||337||
uktAnuktacikitsA ca samyagyogastathaiva ca| deshAdiguNashaMsA ca kAlaH Sha~gvidha eva ca||338||
deshe deshe ca yat sAtmyaM yathA vaidyo~aparAdhyati| cikitsA cApi nirdiShTA doShANAM gUDhacAriNAm||339||
yo hi samya~gna jAnAti shAstraM shAstrArthameva ca| na kuryAt sa kriyAM citramacakShuriva citrakRut||340||
agniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute| cikitsitamidaM sthAnaM ShaShThaM parisamApitam||341||
iti carakasaMhitAyAM ShaShThaM cikitsitasthAnaM sampUrNam
divyatIrthauShadhimatashcitradhAtushilAvataH| puNye himavataH pArshve surasiddharShisevite||3||
viharantaM tapoyogAttattvaj~jAnArthadarshinam| punarvasuM jitAtmAnamagnivesho~anu pRuShTavAn||4||
bhagavan! yadapatyAnAM mUlaM nAryaH paraM nRuNAm| tadvighAto gadaishcAsAM kriyate yonimAshritaiH||5||
tasmAtteShAM samutpattimutpannAnAM ca lakShaNam| sauShadhaM shrotumicchAmi prajAnugrahakAmyayA||6||
iti shiShyeNa pRuShTastu provAcarShivaro~atrijaH| viMshatirvyApado yonernirdiShTA rogasa~ggrahe||7||
mithyAcAreNa tAH strINAM praduShTenArtavena ca| jAyante bIjadoShAcca daivAcca shRuNu tAH pRuthak||8||
cUrNaM puShyAnugaM nAma hitamAtreyapUjitam|96|iti puShyAnugacUrNam
vAtalAhAraceShTAyA vAtalAyAH samIraNaH| vivRuddho yonimAshritya yonestodaM savedanam||9||
stambhaM pipIlikAsRuptimiva karkashatAM tathA| karoti suptimAyAsaM vAtajAMshcAparAn gadAn||10||
sA syAt sashabdarukphenatanurUkShArtavA~anilAt| vyApatkaTvamlalavaNakShArAdyaiH pittajA bhavet||11||
dAhapAkajvaroShNArtA nIlapItAsitArtavA| bhRushoShNakuNapasrAvA yoniH syAtpittadUShitA||12||
kapho~abhiShyandibhirvRuddho yoniM ceddUShayet striyAH| sa kuryAt picchilAM shItAM kaNDugrastAlpavedanAm||13||
pANDuvarNAM tathA pANDupicchilArtavavAhinIm| samashnantyA rasAn sarvAndUShayitvA trayo malAH||14||
yonigarbhAshayasthAH svairyoniM yu~jjanti lakShaNaiH| sA bhaveddAhashUlArtA shvetapicchilavAhinI||15||
vAtaraktacikitsAnantaraM pArisheShyAd vAtakRutatvAcca yonivyApaccikitsitamucyate| uktaM hi- “na hi vAtAdRute yonirnArINAM sampraduShyati” iti||1-2||

raktapittakarairityAdau garbhe labdhe~api raktamatipravartate, tenAsyA garbho na tiShThati; sAsRujA raktayonirityarthaH| ye tu ‘sA~aprajA’ iti paThanti, te “yasyAM labdhe~api garbhe asRugatipravartate, sA tAdRusharaktasrutyA aprajA bhavati; iyaM ca raktayonirucyata iti raktAtisrutyaiva labhyate” iti vyAkhyAnayanti| yonau garbhAshaye ca tiShThatIti yonigarbhAshayasthaM pittam| arajasketi anArtavA||16-17||

virecanamityAdau virecanameva trivRutAdi pibet, tathA mahAtiktakaM ghRutaM kuShThoktaM pibediti yojyam| garbhaparisrAve yaccoktamiti jAtisUtrIye (vi.a.8) garbhasrAvacikitsitaM yaduktaM tat kArayet||96-99||-
garbhiNyA ityAdau AsrAvamiti shleShmavilakShaNamAsrAvam| kaphavAtAmayairupaplutatvAt ‘upaplutA’ ityucyate||21-22||
nRusaMvAse iti ramaNasamaye| sarvato vAtapittavikAropaplutatvAt pariplutA||23-24||
yonimudAvartayate iti yonimudAvartavAtAM karoti| udAvRuttamiti UrdhvaM nItam| vikAreNa rajasa UrdhvagamanAt ‘udAvartinI’ ityucyate||25-26||

vyavAyamatitRuptAyA ityAdau atitRuptAyA vyavAyaM bhajantyAH vyavAyakAle mithyAsthitA~ggAyA annapIDito vAyuryonerAnanamantarmukhaM vakrayati; vakrayatItipadena vakratayA~antarmukhanayanamabhipretam||29-30||-
viShamamiti kriyAvisheShaNaM, viShamaM yathA bhavati tathA maithunAdityarthaH| viShTambhayediti vistArayet| mAMsotsanneti utsannamAMsA||35-36||-

doShairyonirupadrutetyanena doShashabdena yonidUShakA yathoktA gadA ucyante; uktaM hi- “rogA hyapi doShashabdaM labhante” (vi.a.6) iti| tasmAditi yonyupadravAt| pradarAdIMshcetyatra yonivyApadvisheShameva pradaramAhuH, tena yonivyApatprakAraM pradararUpaM doShotpAdaM varNayanti; ye tu yonivyApadbhinnameva pradaramicchanti, teShAmatra pradarapAThe virodho nAstyeva||37-38||-

samprati AdyavyApaccatuShTayaM tyaktvA sheShaShoDashavyApatsu vAtAdili~ggacikitsAj~jAnArthaM doShavibhAgaM darshayannAha- AsAmityAdi| Adye dve iti raktayonyarajaske| dehaM vAtAdaya ityAdi| tAsAM vAtAdivibhAgenoktayonivyApadAM vAtAdayo dehaM svairli~ggaiH pIDayanti, tena vAtAdyadhikatvaM tAsAmupapannamiti bhAvaH; anye tu dehashabdenAtra yonisthAnamevocyata ityAhuH||39-40||-

li~ggAnantaraM cikitsAmAha- snehanetyAdi| snehanAdInAmanilApahatve siddhe~api anilApahamiti visheShaNaM visheSheNAnilApahadravyakRutasnehanAdipratipAdanArtham| saMsRuShTAsviti dvandvajAsu| sthApayediti susthitAM kRutvA sthApayet| duHsthitAsthApanaprakAramAha- pANinetyAdi| snigdhasvinnAmiti sarvatrAnuvartate| jihmAmiti vakrAm| vivRutAmiti vivRutamukhIm| parivartayediti parito vartanena saMvRutAM kuryAt| pa~jcabhiritipadaM sakalakarmaNAM mRudutayA kartavyopadarshanArtham| atra ca vamanAdInAM sarvadehopakArakatayA yonigatarogaharaNe~api sAmarthyaM bhavatyeveti j~jeyam| sheShaM karmeti vakShyamANam||41-48||-

balAdroNadvayetyAdau balAdroNadvayasya kvAthe iti, balAyAH droNadvayapramANakvAthe iti vA, ubhayathA~api droNadvayamAna eva kvAtho bhavati| payasyA arkapuShpI| mudgapIlumAShAkhyaiH parNIshabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate; tatra pIluparNI moraTA, kecinmUrvAmAhuH| prasannA madirAyA uparitano bhAgaH| shUle iti yonishUle| tailaM dhAryamiti rujArtAyAM yonau dhAryam| yonau ca praNayediti yonAvuttarabastinA praveshayet| shyAmAdInAmiti rogabhiShagjitIye “shyAmAtrivRuccatura~ggula...” (vi.a.8) ityAdinoktAnAm||49-62||

hatAvarImUlatulA ityAdau ArdrashatAvarImUlapIDanena yAvadraso bhavati tena samaM kShIraghRutaM vakShyamANakalkaiH pAcanIyam| dviyaShTimadhukairiti dvibhAgamadhuyaShTikaiH, kiMvA jalajasthalajayaShTimadhukadvayayuktaiH| evamevetyAdau shatAvarIcatuHshatarasasamenetyarthaH| kShIrotthitaM sarpiH kShIrasarpiH| jIvanIyAnyatra kalkaH||63-69||-
payasA~arkasyeti arkakShIreNa| secyeti pariShi~jcanIyA| pradeshinItulyA pradeshinya~ggulIsamAnA pariNAhena dairghyeNa ca||70-72||-

udumbarashalATUnAmityAdau pa~jcavalkAdisahitAnAmudumbarashalATUnAM droNaM samabhAgajalaM gRuhItavyam| niryAsairiti palAshasyaiva niryAsaiH, lAkShA ca palAshavyatirekeNa bhavatIti j~jeyam| sasharkaraiH kaShAyairiti udumbarashalATvAdikRutakaShAyairevetyarthaH| kAladuShTA cirakAladuShTA| udumbarasya dugdheneti udumbarakShIreNa| kvAthena tasyaiveti udumbarasya kvAthena| saurAShTrikA tuvarI mRuttikA| ajAmUtre kShIre ceti ajAmUtrakShIre pratyekaM dviguNe| uttAneti unnatA| karIraH marujadrumaH| koShAmraH svanAmakhyAtaH| ji~gginI prasiddhA||73-83||-
karmasAdhAraNaM vAtAdijayonidoShoktaM militaM tridoShajAyAM kartavyam||84-85||-
raktayonyAmityAdi| asRugvarNairanubandhaM vIkShyeti asRugvarNavisheShairdoShAnubandhaM parIkShya||86-89||-

pAThetyAdau ambaShThA pAThAbhedaH; anye tu pAThAbhAgadvayagrahaNArthaM punaH ‘ambaShThA’ iti padaM varNayanti| uktaM hi- “ghRute taile ca yoge ca yaddravyaM punarucyate| bhAgato dviguNaM taddhi grahaNIyaM manIShibhiH” iti| shAlmalIshleShamiti shAlmalIveShTakam| bAhlIkamiti ku~gkumam| puShyeNeti puShyanakShatreNoddhRutya; puShyanakShatroddharaNaM cAtrAdRuShTadvAropakArakaM j~jeyam| nIlaM shvetaM sapItakamityAdi rajodoShavisheShaNam||90-95||-

mRugAjAvItyAdau mRugAdInAmasRuk dadhyamlaphalasarpiShA pibediti yojyam| ‘amlakShaudrasarpiShA’ iti vA pAThaH| tailamuttarabastinetyatra jIvanIyasiddhaM tailaM yojyam| gopitte ityAdau dadyAditi yonau dadyAdityarthaH| prAgaticAriNIti prAkcaraNAticaraNe| saMyAva utkArikA| dhAraNaH smRuta iti vAminyA bIjadhAraNakAraka ityarthaH| traivRutaM snehanamiti sarpistailavasAsnehanam| etadeveti traivRutameva anuvAsanabastyuttarabastiShu| AmUtrakAlata iti mUtrakAlaparyantaM bandhanaM kuryAt| sarvayonivyApatsu vAtacikitsAkaraNe hetumAha- nahi vAtAdRuta ityAdi||100-115||-

pANDure pradare iti shvetapradare| bhAvitaM teneti nyagrodhatvakkaShAyeNa bhAvitam| kaTumatsyakaH shapharI, shuShkamatsyo vA| kA~gkShI saurAShTrI mRut| aduShTe ityAdau prAkRute bIje iti sahajaguNasampanne shukrashoNitabIje aduShTe sati; evambhUtasaMsarge jIvopakramaNe satyeva garbhaM yoShitaH vindanti; jIvopakramaNaM pUrvakarmapreritAt suyogAdbhavati||116-125||-

atrAntare ‘punareva’ ityAdigranthaM shukradoShAdilakShaNacikitsAbhidhAyakaM kecit paThanti; taccAnye anArShaM vadanti, upapattiM ca varNayanti yat- shukradoShA vAjIkaraNenaiva cikitsitAH, klaibyaM ca shArIre eva pratipAditam, ataH punarnAbhidhAnamarhati, pradarashcaiveha yonivyApattau cikitsita iti; ye tu paThanti te pUrvoktasa~gkShepasya vistarAbhidhAnametaditi varNayanti| evamasyArShatvavivAde~api kAshmIrAdideshAnumatatvAt ki~jcid vyAkaraNaM kurma eva||127-132||

shukraguNopavarNane hetumAha- bIjaM yasmAdityAdi| yasmAdbIjabhUtaM garbhasya shukraM tasmAdvakShyAmi| vyavAyeShu harSha eva yoniH kAraNaM tasmAdutthitam| pauruShamiti puruShacihnaM, shukreNaiva hi puruSho vyajyate| maithunaM na ca gacchata iti ucitamaithunakAle maithunAgamanaM shukravegapratIghAtAdeva darshayati| avisrambhAditi avishvAsAt||133-138||-
vakShyAmIti duShTaM shukraM vakShyAmi rudhirAnvayamiti rudhirayuktam| shukrAbhidhAnaprasa~ggAdvishuddhashukralakShaNamAha- snigdhamityAdi||139-145||-
mAgadhyamRutetyAdau amRutA AmalakI| bhallAtakasyetyatra rasAyanamiti anuvartate||146-152||-
sa~gkalpetyAdau li~ggashaithilyAditi li~ggAnutthAnAt| moghe niShphale sa~gkalpaceShTite yasya saH||154-157||
vAyoH kShayAd bIjakShayAnupapatteH vAtAdInAM ca sa~gkShayAdityatra prAkRutavAtAdikShaye sharIravaiguNyAdeva shukrAnutpAdo j~jeyaH||158-161||-

shUkAnAM cAtisevanAditi li~ggAtivRuddhyarthaM kRutashUkAtiyogAt| etaM pa~jcavidhaM kecid dhvajabha~ggaM vadanti; tathoktena vAtapittakapharaktasannipAtabhedena pa~jcavidhatvamityarthaH| tatra shvayathurvedanA meDhre ityAdi vAtena, sphoTAshcetyAdi pittena, mAMsavRuddhirityAdi kaphena, jvarastRuShNetyAdi raktena, agninevetyAdi sannipAtena||162-175||-

jaghanyetyAdau pravaraM vaya iti vArdhakyam| prAyashaH kShIyata iti vacanAt kadAcit pravayasAmapi shukrasArANAM vRuShyasevinAM ca na kShIyate shukramiti darshayati| pravayasAM shukrakShaye hetumAha- rasAdInAmityAdi| ete ca rasakShayAdayo hetavo vArdhakyasvabhAvAdeva bhavanti||176-180||-

kecidityAdau dhvajabha~ggakShayodbhave vakShyamANavishiShTadhvajabha~ggakShayodbhave, te cAsAdhye| vRuShaNotpATanena cetyantena dhvajabha~gga uktaH, kShayajaM tu mAtApitrorityAdinocyate| sa pumAn strIShu puruShavyApArakaraNAsamarthatvAdapumAn bhavati||181-190||-

vyavAyahetuje itipadaM bIjadoShotpannasahajavyudAsArtham| dhAtuviparyayAditi doShavaiShamyAt| daivavyapAshrayamityAdinA abhicArAdijaklaibyacikitsAM brUte| abhicArAdijaM ca klaibyaM daivavyapAshrayacikitsAbhidhAnAdeva svIkartavyam||191-195||

palAshairaNDamustAdyairiti eraNDapalAshAdyairmustAdyaishca vyavasthitairityarthaH| tatrairaNDapatrAdiH “eraNDamUlapalAshAt” (si.a.12) ityAdinA granthe vakShyamANaH siddhau, mustAdishca yApanAbastiH| bastidvaye~apyatra bahuvacanaM vyaktisadbhAvApekShayA j~jeyam||196-203||-

yaH pUrvamuktaH pradara ityAdau upadravarUpatayA pUrvamuktaH pradara iti vadanti; kintu raktayonicikitsite asRugdarasa~jj~jayaiva raktayonikathanena nirdiShTadoShabhedena ca tatraiva raktayonirasRugdararUpA vyAkRu(hRu)tA, teneha punarasRugdaralakShaNAbhidhAnaM pUrvaTIkAkRutAmasammatam| iha ye~apyamuM granthaM paThanti, te tasyaivAyaM prabhedaH prapa~jco vA~abhidhIyata iti varNayanti| vayaM tu bhUripustakeShvevaM pAThadarshanAdasya vyAkhyAnaM kurmaH| garbhAshayagatA iti garbhAshayasambaddhAH| asRugdarashabdavyutpattimAha- kupito~anila ityAdi| raktaM pramANamutkramya iti raktaM pramANAdhikaM kRutvA raktamAdAya tadrajo yasmAdvivardhayati (vRuddhena raktena yojayitvA rajo vivardhayati yasmAt ) pavanastasmAdasRugrajomelakarUpatvAdayaM vyAdhirasRugdara ityucyate| ‘pradIryate iti vistArito bhavati’ iti pradaraH, ‘asRug dIryate yasminniti asRugdara’ ityeShA~api niruktiratra boddhavyA| naikAvasthamiti vAtakRutanAnAvasthAyuktam| nArI tvityAdinA etadanubandhakRutAmavasthAmAha||204-224||

vishuddhArtavasya vishuddhArtavakathanaprasa~ggAllakShaNamAha- mAsAdityAdi| pa~jcarAtrAnubandhIti udbhUtatayA pa~jcarAtramanubadhnAtIti pa~jcarAtrAnubandhi, dvAdasharAtrAnubandhitvAdArtavakAlasya; kiMvA dvAdasharAtraparyantaM garbhArambhakatvamArtavasya natu pravRuttiriti j~jeyam| gu~jjAphalasavarNamityAdinA varNabhedashcArtave prakRutibhedAdeva bhavati||225-228||

samprati pradaraM sacikitsitamabhidhAya strIrogAbhidhAnaprasa~ggAdaparamapi strIrogaM stanyadoShamabhidhitsurAha- dhAtrIstanastanyetyAdi| vAtAdiduShTe ityAdi vAtAdivikAreShvevAntarniviShTamityarthaH| trividhAstu yato shiShyAstato vakShyAmIti trividhaprabhedeShu shiShyeShu mandabuddhishiShyANAM sukhapratipattyartham||229-231||
kvAthaM caiva sanAgaramityatra nAgarakRuta eva kvAtho j~jeyaH| pUrvavajjIvakAdyamityatra jIvakAdyaM jIvanIyam||232-281||-

duShTakShIrasevanAdutpannabAlavikArANAM svarUpaM darshayitvA yathAkartavyaM bheShajamAha- doShetyAdi| doShA vAtAdayaH, dUShyANi raktAdIni, malAH shakRunmUtrasvedAdayaH| ete doShAdayo ya eva mahatAM ta eva bAlAnAmapi bhavanti, kintu bAlAn prApya teShAM doShAdInAM mAtrA tvalpatareti visheShaH; tena doShAdimAtrApekShA bheShajamAtrA~apyalpA bhavatIti bhAvaH| nivRuttirvamanAdInAmityAdi| dvividhA bAlA bhavanti- svatantravRuttayaH, paratantravRuttayashca; tatra paratantratvaM bAleShu vIkShya vamanAdInAM nivRuttiH kartavyA, vAkceShTayoshca bAlasya sAmarthyaM vIkShya svatantratAyAM jAtAyAM vamanAdInAM mRudutvaM shAstravidvaidyaH prayojayet, tathA saMshamanamapi bheShajamalpamAtraM yathAvyAdhi bAleShu prayojayediti vAkyArthaH; kiMvA bAleShu mRudutvaM paratantratAM ca vIkShya vamanAdInAM nivRuttirvidhAtavyA, vAkceShTayoshca bAleShu sAmarthyaM vIkShya saMshamanaM bheShajamalpamAtraM yathAvyAdhi prayojayediti yojanIyam| madhurANItyAdinA bAleShu kartavyaM bheShajamAha| atyarthamityAdi prayojayedityanto grantha ArShatve savivAdaH||282-287||

samprati dRuDhabalaH svakIyasaMskAraviShayaM darshayannAha- asminnityAdi| saptadashAdhyAyA iti cikitsAsthAne saptadashAdhyAyAH; te ca carakasaMskRutAn yakShmacikitsitAntAnaShTAvadhyAyAn, tathA~arsho~atIsAravisarpadvivraNIyamadAtyayoktAn vihAya j~jeyAH| (parishiShTasaMskArasyAdRuShTAtishayasampAdyatvAdAtmano~adRuShTAtishayameva darshayannAha- taccha~gkaramityAdi )||289-290||

sharIrApekShasamyagyogodAharaNamAha- AsyAdityAdi| AsyAdityAdau tRutIyAsthAne pa~jcamI; tenAsyena dattamauShadhaM vamanAdyAmAshayasthAn gadAnAshutaraM nihanti| evaM nAsayA dattamauShadhaM shirogatAn hanti| gudena dattaM pakvAshayasthAn hanti| bahiH parisArjanabheShajaprayogaM sharIradeshApekShamAha- sharIrAvayavottheShvityAdi| yathAdeshamiti vyAdhideshe| pradehAdIni pradehapariShekopanAhAdIni||294-295||

deshamanu kAlApekShasamyagyogodAharaNAni kAlavibhAgapUrvakamAha- dinAturauShadhetyAdi| dinAdibhiravekShaNashabdaH sambadhyate; avekShaNam avekShA| atra dinAvekShAdikAlAn kramAdudAharati- dinAvekSha ityAdi| rogyavekSha iti rogiNo visheShaM balavattvamabalavattvaM cAvekShya bhavatItyarthaH| niranna iti auShadhamupayujyApi upakShaNamabhu~jjAnaH| auShadhAvekShAnagadakAlAnAha- bhaiShajyakAlA ityAdi| atra bhuktAdAvityanena kAladvayamucyate; yathA prAtareva nirannaM, tathA prAgbhojanaM ca| tathA pashcAdityanena ca kAladvayameva prAtarbhojanottarakAlaM, aparaM tu sAyaM bhojanottarakAlam| madhyebhuktaM tu yadardhaM bhuktvopayujyate, pashcAt punarardhaM bhujyate| muhurmuhurbhuktaM nAma yadbhojanasamaye pratikShaNaM bhujyate| sAmudgaM nAma yadbhaktasyAdAvante ca bhujyate, tatsamudgavadAhArAvaraNAt ‘sAmudgaM’ ityabhidhIyate| bhuktamiti padaM bhuktAdAvityAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate| antarAbhaktaM nAma yadannena saMyogAt saMskArAdvA tadvimishritaM bhujyate| grAsagrAsAntaraM tu bhuktaM nAma yad grAsAnAM madhyeShu bhujyate| anye tu ‘grAsagrAsAntare’ iti paThanti, ekaM ca bheShajakAlaM vadanti; bhuktamitipadena ca bheShajakAlAntaramabhidhAya dashauShadhakAlapUraNaM kurvanti| ata eva ‘vAyau prANe praduShTe tu grAsagrAsAntariShyate’ iti vacanena cAcAryeNaika eva kAla uktaH| tatra grAsasya grAsAntaramadhye yadauShadhaM tad grAsagrAsAntaramucyate| bhuktamityasya lakShaNaM- bhuktaM laghunA~annena saMyutamiti; laghunA peyAdinA annena saMyutaM yadbhujyate tadbhuktamucyate| sambhojyaM tvauShadhairityAdinA tu yadauShadhasaMskRutamannamupayujyate alaghu laghu vA tat sambhuktashabdenocyate| ye tu ‘grAse grAsAntare’ iti paThanti, te prANe praduShTe grAse grAsAntare vA bheShajopayogena kAladvayaM varNayanti, laghunA~annena saMyutamitipadaM sambhojyamityasyaiva visheShaNaM varNayanti; bhuktamiti tu padaM vivaraNagranthe~api sarvAtmakAlopayojanIyabheShajavisheShaNamiti vyAkhyAnayanti| evaM vyavasthite ‘apAne viguNe’ ityAdibheShajakAlavivaraNaM vyaktameveti na punarvyAhriyate| ete ca kAlA yadyapi rogavisheShaviShayatayA vihitAH, tathA~api bheShajasyaivAmI viguNApAnAdividheyasya kAlA bhavanti| apAnavaiguNyAdayastu gadA iha bheShajaviShayatayopAttAH| tenApAne viguNe yadauShadhaM tasyApyete kAlA ityAdinibandho boddhavyaH| yastu vyAdhyavekShaH kAlaH sa vyAdhyavasthArUpa iha vaktavya iti visheShaH| auShadhAvekShaM kAlamabhidhAya vyAdhyavekShaM kAlamAha- jvare peyA ityAdi| atra ca peyAkaShAyasarpiHkShIravirecanAnAmutsargavidhayA jvarAhAdArabhya ShaDahe yathAkramaM deyatvamucyate| ShaDahAtikrame peyAdAnaM na virodhamAvahati, sAmAnyavidhervirodhavidhinA bAdhanasya sarvatraivAnumatatvAt| tena la~gghitasya kaShAyaShaDahe peyAdAnaM yat prasajyate “la~gghitaM vamitaM kAle yavAgUbhirupAcaret” (ci.a.3) iti vacanena, tadapi na virodhi; tasya ca shlokasya prapa~jco jvaracikitsita eva kRuta iti neha kriyate| kAlaM vIkShyAmayasya tviti avasthArUpaM kAlaM jvaralakShaNasyAmayasya vIkShya ShaDahe peyA deyetyarthaH| jIrNali~ggApekShaM kAlamAha- kShudvegetyAdi| kShuditi bubhukShA bhavati, vegamokSha iti purIShAdinirgamaH| laghutA vishuddhiriti hRudayodgAravishuddhiH| jIrNalakShaNamiti jIrNAnnalakShaNam| etacca jIrNalakShaNaM yadyapi rasavimAne~apyabhihitaM, tathA~apIha kAlAvekShayA prakaraNAgatatvAdabhidhAnaM na punaruktadoShakaram| tadA bheShajamAdeyamiti vacanena prAtaryadauShadhamanannaM dIyate tadbheShajaM pratyavamRushati, yadannottarakAlaM tadajIrNa eva prAtarAshe dIyate; kiMvA bhojanottarakAlamapi yadauShadhaM dIyate tadapi dinAntarabhukte~anne jIrNa eva dIyate| anyathA syAddhi doShavadityatra kecid ‘dvidoShavat’ iti paThanti, tena jIryati jIryamANe ca doShadvayayuktaM syAdityarthaH| ‘syAttu doShavadanyathA’ iti pATha AkaraH| RuturUpakAlAvekShaM samyagyogaM vibhajate- cayAdayashcetyAdi| cayAdaya iti cayaprakopaprashamAH| te ca cayAdayo yathA- kaphasya hemante cayaH, prakopo vasante, grIShme prashama ityAdisvabhAvaH| varjyaM sevyaM ca RutAvuktaM, tatraiva ca gurvannAdi varjyamuktaM, tena tatraiva tajj~jeyam| upakramANAmityAdikaM sArdhaM shlokaM kecit paThanti; tamanArShaM vadanti| uktaSha~gvidhakAlAnavekShaprayoge~aniShTaphalaM sadRuShTAntamAha- ityevamityAdi| yathA sasyasyAkAlavarSheNa pIDA maraNaM vA bhavati, tadvadauShadhamapi ShaDvidhamakAlAnavekShamupayuktaM kleshAya vinAshAya vA bhavati| punaranyathA kAlAvekShaM yogaM darshayantaH kecit paThanti- vyAdhInAmRutvahorAtraniyamAdishlokacatuShTayam, etadapi nAtiprasiddham||296-312||

pramANavisheShAvekShaM yogaM darshayannAha- nAlpamityAdi| yadyapi ceha bheShajasya pramANaM shRu~ggagrAhikayA noktaM, tathA~apIha “doShapramANAnurUpo hi bhaiShajyapramANavikalpo balapramANavisheShApekSho bhavati” (vi.a.8) ityAdinoktaM madhyabheShajapramANaM j~jeyam||313-314||

atha sAtmyAvekShaM samyagyogaM vibhajannAha- aucityAdyasyetyAdi| aucityAditi abhyAsAt, apathyamapi yadyasya puruShasya sAtmyaM tadekAntAt tyajan na sukhaM labhate iti yojanA| ekAntAt jhaTiti sarvathA ca tyajan| etenApathyamapi sAtmyamekAntAt tyajataH sukhaM na bhavatIti darshayati; pathyasya sAtmyasya parityAge tu nitarAmeva duHkhaM bhavatIti darshayati| deshashabdena ceha deshavAcino janapadA abhipretAH| tena deshasAtmyashabdena taddeshajAtatvenaiva puruShairyat sevyate tat sAdhAraNaM sAtmyaM gRuhyate| puruShasAtmyagrahaNena tu yat pratiniyatapuruShasyaivAbhyAsAt sAtmyatAM yAti tat puruShapratiniyataM sAtmyaM gRuhyate| yattu pUrvaM “deshAnAmAmayAnAM ca viparItaguNaM guNaiH| sAtmyamicchanti” (sU.a.6) ityanena deshasAtmyamuktaM, taddeshaviparItaguNatvena taddeshanivAsinAM puruShANAM sAtmyamuktam; idaM tu deshaviparItaguNaM bhavatu mA bhavatu vA, tathA~api taddeshanivAsinAmabhyAsena sAtmyaM tadiha sAtmyamucyata iti visheShaH| puruShasAtmyasya prAyaH pratipuruShaM bhinnatvenAniyatatvAcchRu~ggagrAhikayA udAharaNaM na kRutam| tena deshAbhyAsasAtmyAni prasiddhAnyudAharati- bAhlIkA ityAdi| vaishvAnarocitA iti atrocitashabdenAbhyAsa ucyate| tailaM cAmlaM ceti tailAmlam| dakShiNata iti dakShiNApathe| uttare ca pashcime ceti uttarapashcime| teShAmityatra tacchabdena janapadAH puruShAshca gRuhyante| tena tatsAtmyayuktAnIti uktadeshasAtmyayuktapuruShasAtmyayuktAni| sAtmyopayogaphalamAha- sAtmyaM hyAshu balamityAdi| bahvapIti atimAtramapi||315-319||-

sAmAnyoktacikitsAyAH prakArAntareNApi vishiShTArthakartRutvamAha- tathA~antarityAdi| antarmArgAH koShThAshrayiNaH, sandhimArgA madhyamArgAshrayiNaH| gUDhacAriNAmiti antaHsandhigatatvenAvyaktagatInAM doShANAM viruddhAbhimatA~api kriyA kadAcidbhavati, viruddhAbhimatA viparItatvena khyAtA| kiMvA na kevalaM vayobalAdibhedA bahavo matAH kintu antaHsandhimArgANAM doShANAM gUDhacAriNAM bhedA bahavashcikitsAvekShaNIyA matA iti; tato gUDhacAriNo doShabhedena cikitsAbhedo bhavet kadAcidityAdi yojanIyam| viruddhAbhimatakriyAkaraNodAharaNamAha- pittamantargatamityAdinA| nIyate bahiriti bAhyaromakUpaniHsAraNena nIyate bahiruShNaiH| tatheti tathA uktena prakAreNa uShNaM pittamuShNaiH svedAdibhiH shamayanti| samprati shItena cikitsitena shItashleShmashamanodAharaNamAha- bAhyaishcetyAdi| pIDita iti bahirgacchan niruddhaH| atha pratyanIkasyApi kalpanAvisheShAdanyathAkartRutvamAha- shlakShNapiShTa ityAdi| tvaggatasyoShmaNo rodhAditi tva~gmArgeNa nirgacchata UShmaNo rodhAt| shItakRuccAnyathA~aguroriti aguroruShNasyApi piShTo~aghanashca lepaH shItakRut syAdityarthaH| viruddhakriyAbhidhAnaprasa~ggena samudAyApekShayaikadeshasya viruddhakAryakaraNodAharaNamAha- chardighnItyAdi| dravyeShu svinnajagdheShvevaM teShveva vikriyeti anena makShikAviShThArambhakeShu dravyeShu makShikAjaTharAgnisvinneShu evaM vikriyA makShikAsharIragatatayA viShThAgatatayA ca viruddhA kriyA yathoktA bhavatIti vAkyArthaH; svinnajagdheShviti khAditAnantaramagnipakveShu, vikriyeti viruddhakriyA| kiMvA saMskAreNa pUrvadravyakAryaviruddhodAharaNArthamAha- dravyeShvityAdi| asmin pakShe ‘jagdheShu’ ityasya sthAne ‘dagdheShu’ iti paThanti| tatra lAjasaktUnAM siddhapiNDeShu svinnatayA lAjaviparItA gurutvenAgnivadhAdikArikA kriyA; tathA utpalanAleShu dagdheShu kShAratayA shItaviruddhA kriyA chedanAdikriyA ityAdyudAhAryam| yadA ‘yasmin jagdheShu’ iti pAThaH, tadA~api svinnAnantaraM jagdheShviti kRutvA saktusiddhapiNDaka evodAharaNaM j~jeyam||321-325||-

samprati cikitsayA nivRutte vyAdhau kartavyaM darshayannAha- nivRutto~api punarityAdi| nivRutta iva nivRuttaH, ki~jcidavashiShTadoSharUpamUlaH; na tu sarvathA nivRuttaH, tasya tulyahetunA pratyAgamanavirodhAt, tathA sUkShmAnaladRuShTAntavisadRushatvAcca| kShINe apacitamAMsAdike| mArgIkRute iti vyAdhyapratibandhakatayA mArgasadRushIkRute| sheSha iti analavisheShaNam| apishabdena nivRutto~api yadA svalpena hetunA AyAti tadA prashamAbhimukho nitarAmevAyAtIti darshayati| evaM vyavasthite kartavyamAha- tasmAdityAdi| anubadhnIyAt prayogeNeti punarapyanubandhabheShajaprayogaM kuryAt| anapAyineti rogAntarAkArakeNa| kimarthamanubadhnIyAdityAha- dArDhyArthamiti| prayuktasiddhauShadhakRutavyAdhinivRuttilakShaNasyArthasya dArDhyArthaM, sthairyArthamiti yAvat||327-328||-

aparamapi prayogAnubandhaviShayamAha- kAThinyAdityAdi| kAThinyAditi doShacayarUpasaMhatatvAt| UnabhAvAt acayaprakopAt; acaye~api ca doShANAM prakopo bhavatyeva; yathA- balavadvigrahAdibhirvAyoH, pitasya krodhAdibhiH, shleShmaNashca divAsvapnAdibhiH; ayaM cAcayaprakopo ghanAvayavopacayAkartRutvAt ‘UnabhAvAt prakopa’ ityucyate| doSho~antaHkupito mahAnityatra kAThinyAt kupita UnabhAvAcca kupito mahAn bhavatIti vyavasthA| kAThinyAddhi acayakopo~antareva prAyo bhavati, UnabhAvAttu acayaprakopaH prasaraNasvabhAvatvAttu laghucayabandhasAro(?)~api mahAn bhavati| mRudvalpatAM nIta iti yathAkramaM, tena yaH kAThinyAdantaHkupitaH sa mRudutAM nItaH, sthUlabhAvAnmAhAn kupito~alpatAM nItaH; mRududoShakara iti alpavikArakaraH| kiMvA kAThinyAditi doShadUShyasambandhakRutasthairyAt, UnabhAvAditi yathoktakAThinyaM vinA| antariti sharIrAnuttAnadeshe| mahAniti ca padaM dvAbhyAmapi sambadhyate| ekasya kAraNapracayena mahattvam| pathyamapyashnata iti hitamapi bheShajamupayu~jjAnasya| upajAyata iti mRudutayA alpatayA vA anuvartate| j~jAtvaivamiti pathyamidamasya bheShajam, ayaM tu vyAdhiriti, mahattvAdgambhIratvAdvA sarvathA na nivartate magnaH, evaM j~jAtvA tathaiva pUrvaprayuktaprayogasya vRuddhiM vA abhyAsaM vA kArayet, na tatprayogAshrayaprayogAntaraM kuryAt; vRuddhirmAtrAdhikyam, abhyAsaH satatopayogaH| ayamartho~anyatrApyuktaH- “abhyasyamAnAH kramashastu yogA jayanti rogAn balinaH sthirAMshca| tasmAdakhinnaH puruSho~abhyupeyAdyogaprayogAn samudIrNaroge” iti||329-330||-

uktasatatopayoge yadi pathyaM sAtatyAt satatopayogAddhetordveShyatvamAgataM bhavati, tathA svAdvabhAvAdvA aniShTatvAddveShyatvamAgataM bhavati, tadA~api tadeva pathyaM taistaiH kalpanAvidhibhiH svarasashRutakalkAdibhiH sUdashAstroktaishca vidhAnaiH punarAturasya priyatvamApAdayet| svAdvapi satatopayogAdapriyaM bhavatIti dRuShTam, asvAdu tu svabhAvAdevApriyam| svAdushabdenAtra priyo raso~abhidhIyate| priyatvApAdanaprayojanamAha- manaso~arthAnukUlyAdityAdi|- manaso~anukUlabheShajAdirUpAnukalpanAt| UrjA manobalam| sukhopabhogatA bheShajasyAprAtikUlyenopayogaH| atra cAtitRuShNAdibhyaH sukhopabhogAnte virecane arucau kartavyamabhidhAya rucivisheShe kartavyatAmAha- laulyAditi| atra laulyAdeva hi kasyacitpuruShasya kasmiMshcidvisheShe rucirbhavati; doShakShayAdapi kvacidrucirbhavati; tathA vyAdhiyuktasya ca peye rucirbhavati; vyAdhimahimnA kvacidrucirbhavati, yathA- pANDuroge mRuttikAyAM; vaidharmyAcca rucirbhavati, yathA- snigdhasya rUkShe, madhurasya cAmle; yaduktam- “amlena kecidvihatA manuShyA mAdhuryayoge praNayIbhavanti” (su.sU.a.46) iti; kiMvA vyAdhivaidharmyAdityeka eva hetuH; atrodAharaNaM yathA- shleShmajvare~amlakaTukecchutA| etairlaulyAdibhiH pratyekaM janitA ruciH, Asu ruciShu laulyAdijanitAsu pathyopacAraH syAt, pathyameva deyaM nApathyamityarthaH| atra yadi pathyaM ca bhavati ruciviShayaM ca bhavati tadA sAdhveva, yadA tu ruciviShayamapathyaM syAt tadA kartavyamAha- yogenAdyaM vikalpayediti|- bheShajayogenAdyam icchAviShayaM bhojyaM saMskRutya dadyAdityarthaH| anyaistu laulyAdidoShajA trividhA~atrArucirucyate; tatra laulyajAyAmarucau pathyopacAraH, doShakShayajAyAmarucau yogeneti samyagyogenopacAraH, vyAdhivaidharmyajAyAM cAdyamadanIyaM vyAdhipratyanIkaprayogairupakalpayediti vyAkhyAtam| pUrvameva tu vyAkhyAnamAdriyAmahe||331-333||-
viMshatirityAdisa~ggrahaH subodha eva||334-341||

divyAni tIrthAni ga~ggAdIni, divyAshcauShadhyo brahmasuvarcalaindrIprabhRutayo yasmin tasya divyatIrthauShadhimataH| citradhAtuH nAnAvarNadhAtuH| tattvaj~jAnena samyagj~jAnena arthAn draShTuM shIlaM yasya taM tattvaj~jAnArthadarshinam| mUlamiti kAraNam| tadvighAta iti apatyakAraNavighAtaH| teShAmiti yonigadAnAm| samutpattimiti utpattikAraNaM, kArye kAraNopacArAt| rogasa~ggrahe iti aShTodarIye (sU.a.19)| mithyAcAreNa asamyagAhArAcAreNa, praduShTenArtaveneti duShTArtavena , yonivyApadbhavati| bIjadoShAditi ArtavagatabIjaduShTeH, sA pashcAdvaktavyA| daivAditi prAktanAdharmavashAt| eteShAM ca yathAyogyatayA kAraNatvamagre vakShyamANakAraNatvabhedena yonivyApatsUnneyaM, daivaM tu sarvatraiva sAdhAraNakAraNaM vishiShTadRuShTakAraNAdarshane sati kAryadarshanAdunneyam||3-8||

vAtaletyAdau vAtalAyA iti visheSheNa vAtikayonivyApadutpAdopadarshanArtham| pipIlikAsRuptimiti pipIlikAparisarpaNAkArAM vedanAm| sashabdarukphenatanurUkShArtaveti anRutAvapyevambhUtArtavA bhavati, tena vAtikapradararUpeyaM yonivyApat; evameva paittika-shlaiShmika-sAnnipAtika-yonivyApadAmapi paittika-kaphaja-sAnnipAtikapradaratvaM varNayanti| raktayoniriha asRugdarasa~jj~jayA cikitsAprastAve vaktavyA; tena saiva pradararUpA| the tu etadvyApadAM pradaraM bhinnameva manyante, te pradaracikitsArthaM prakaraNAntaramatrAdhyAye paThiShyanti| samashnantyA iti pathyApathyamelakenopayu~jjantyAH||9-15||
athAto dhAmArgavakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
jIvakarShabhakau vIrAmAtmaguptAM shatAvarIm| kAkolIM shrAvaNIM medAM mahAmedAM madhUlikAm||13||
ekaikasho~abhisa~jcUrNya saha dhAmArgaveNa te| sharkarAmadhusaMyuktA lehA hRuddAhakAsinAm||14||

dhAnyatumburuyUSheNa kalkaH sarvaviShApahaH||15||

Commentary: dhAnyetyAdinaikaM kalkayogamAha| dhAnyatumbarukvAtha eva dhAnyatumburuyUShaH| uktaM hi jatUkaNa “dhAnyatumbururasena kalko viShanut” iti||15|
jAtyAH saumanasAyinyA rajanyAshcorakasya ca| vRushcIrasya mahAkShudrasahAhaimavatasya ca||16||
bimbyAH punarnavAyA vA kAsamardasya vA pRuthak | ekaM dhAmArgavaM dve vA kaShAye parimRudya tu||17||

tacchRutakShIrajaM sarpiH sAdhitaM vA phalAdibhiH||18||

Commentary: tacchRutetyAdinaikaM ghRutayogamAha||18||
tatra shlokau- pallave nava catvAraH kShIra ekaH surAsave| kaShAye viMshatiH kalke dasha dvau ca shakRudrase||19||
anna ekastathA ghreye dasha lehAstathA ghRutam| kalpe dhAmArgavasyoktAH ShaShTiryogA maharShiNA||20||

karkoTakI koThaphalA mahAjAlinireva ca| dhAmArgavasya paryAyA rAjakoshAtakI tathA||3||

Commentary: tatra karkoTakItyAdinA paryAyakathanam| dhAmArgavaH pItaghoShakaH||3||

gare gulmodare kAse vAte shleShmAshayasthite| kaphe ca kaNThavakrasthe kaphasa~jcayajeShu ca||4||

Commentary: sthirAshca guravashca ye ityatra ‘gadAH’ iti sheShaH||4||-

phalaM puShpaM pravAlaM ca vidhinA tasya saMharet||5||

Commentary: vidhineti bheShajagrahaNoktena vidhinA||5||

pravAlasvarasaM shuShkaM kRutvA ca gulikAH pRuthak| kovidArAdibhiH peyAH kaShAyairmadhukasya ca||6||

Commentary: pravAletyAdinA navayogAnAha| pravAlasya svarasaH pravAlasvarasaH| atra kovidArAdikaShAyairguDikAkaraNaM pAnaM ca j~jeyam||6||

... jIrNashuShkANAmataH kalpaH pravakShyate||7||

Commentary: puShpAdiShvityAdinA jImUtakakalpavidhAnena nirdiShTAshcatvAraH kShIraprayogAH, pa~jcamashca surAyogo~atidishyate; te ca ‘payaH puShpe~asya’ (ka. a. 2) ityAdinoktA j~jeyAH| pUrvavaditi pUrveNa sambadhyate|7|-
madhukasya kaShAyeNa bIjakaNThoddhRutaM phalam| saguDaM vyuShitaM rAtriM kovidArAdibhistathA||8||

dadyAdannena saMyuktaM chardihRudrogashAntaye||9||

Commentary: dadyAdityAdinA eko~annayoga ucyate| anne ca dhAmArgavasya saMyogenaiko yogaH||9||

cUrNairvA~apyutpalAdIni bhAvitAni prabhUtashaH| rasakShIrayavAgvAditRupto ghrAtvA vamet sukham||10||

Commentary: cUrNairityAdinA ghreye ekayogamAha| utpalAdInAM cAtra bhedo~avivakShitaH utpalasyaika eva ghreyayogaH| atra Adishabdena saugandhikapadmAdInAM grahaNam| prabhUtashashcUrNairbhAvitAnIti j~jeyam||10||
cUrNIkRutasya vartiM vA kRutvA badarasammitAm| vinIyA~jjalimAtre tu pibedgo~ashvashakRudrase ||11||
pRuShatarShyakura~ggAhvagajoShTrAshvatarAvike| shvadaMShTrakharakha~ggAnAM caivaM peyA shakRudrase ||12||
uktasambandhAddhAmArgavakalpo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

jIvaketyAdinA dasha lehAnAha| madhUlikA ‘markaTahasta’ iti khyAtA| atra leheShu dhAmArgavAditaradravyacUrNasya samAnatvaM; madhusharkarayoshca tAvatI mAtrA yAvatyA lehatvApattirbhavati| pittoShmasahite kaphe iti udyatoShmaguNena pittena yukte kaphe; anye tu pittoShmashabdena pittoShmaNA kRutaM jvaramAhuH||13-14||-
jAtyA ityAdinA ekAdashakaShAyayogAnAha| jAtI saumanasyAyinI, anye yUthikAM vadanti| vRushcIraH shvetapunarnavA| mahAsahA kShudrasahA mudgamAShaparNyau| haimavatI vacA||16-17||-
pallave navetyAdisa~ggrahe vyutkramasa~ggrahAbhidhAnaM chando~anurodhAt| dasha dvau ceti dvAdashetyarthaH||19-20||

jIrNashuShkANAmityAdinA navakaShAyayogAnAha, tathA ‘jAtyAH’ ityAdinA ekAdasha kaShAyayogAn vakShyati; evaM viMshatiH kaShAyayogAH sa~ggrahe vakShyamANAH pUryante| bIjakaNThoddhRutaM phalamiti yatra bIjAni baddhAni santi sa bIjakaNTha uddhRuto yasmin tadbIjakaNThoddhRutaM phalam| atra ca pUrvanipAtAniyama AhitAgnyAdipUrvanipAtavadbodhyaH| evambhUtaM ca phalaM kaShAyeNa saguDena pUritaM rAtrivyuShitaM kartavyam| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- dhAmArgavakalpe- “dhAmArgavaphaleShUddhRutabIjamadhyeShu saguDoShitAH kovidArAdikaShAyA nava” iti| gulminAM cAvasthAyAM vamanaM hitameva, teneha gulmaviShayatayA vamanopadarshanaM na virodhi||7-8||-

cUrNIkRutasyetyAdinA go~ashvashakRudrase iti dvau yogau| tathA pRuShatetyAdidashayogaiH samaM shakRudrasayogasambandhAddvAdasha shakRudyogA ucyante| pRuShataH binducitritahariNaH; RuShyaH nIlANDaH, kura~ggaH ca~jcalagatiH, ashvataraH vegasaraH, shvadaMShTraH caturdaMShTro mRugavisheShaH||11-12||
athAto vatsakakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
atha vatsakanAmAni bhedaM strIpuMsayostathA| kalpaM cAsya pravakShyAmi vistareNa yathAtatham||3||
vatsakaH kuTajaH shakro vRukShako girimallikA| bIjAnIndrayavAstasya tathocyante kali~ggakAH||4||
bRuhatphalaH shvetapuShpaH snigdhapatraH pumAn bhavet| shyAmA cAruNapuShpA strI phalavRuntaistathA~aNubhiH ||5||
raktapittakaphaghnastu sukumAreShvanatyayaH| hRudrogajvaravAtAsRugvIsarpAdiShu shasyate||6||
kAle phalAni sa~ggRuhyA tayoH shuShkANi nikShipet | teShAmantarnakhaM muShTiM jarjarIkRutya bhAvayet ||7||
madhukasya kaShAyeNa kovidArAdibhistathA| nishi sthitaM vimRudyaitallavaNakShaudrasaMyutam||8||
aShTAhaM payasA~a~arkeNa teShAM cUrNAni bhAvayet||9||
jIvakasya kaShAyeNa tataH pANitalaM pibet| phalajImUtakekShvAkujIvantInAM pRuthak tathA||10||

kRushareNAthavA yuktaM vidadhyAdvamanaM bhiShak||11||

Commentary: kRushareNetyAdinA kRusharayoga ucyate| atra ca indrayavacUrNamadhikRutatvAdevocyate||11||

tatra shlokaH- kaShAyairnava cUrNaishca pa~jcoktAH salilaistrayaH| ekashca kRusharAyAM syAdyogAste~aShTAdasha smRutAH ||12||

Commentary: kaShAyairityAdisa~ggrahashloko vyAkhyAtArtha eva||12||
yathoktasambandhAdvatsakakalpAbhidhAnam||1-2||

vatsakanAmAni vyavahArArthaM strIpuruShabhedaM cAha- athetyAdi| atra vatsakastrIpuruShabhedena yadyapi guNabhedaH prayogabhedo vA na pratipAditaH, tathA~api strIrUpavatsake~apuShpaphalatvAdivishiShTalakShaNayukte~apyavisheSheNobhAbhyAmevAmayanivRuttiH syAdityetadarthamubhayorapi samAnaguNatA j~jAtavyA||3-6||

kAle iti ucite kAle| shuShkANIti pakvashuShkANi| teShAmantarnakhamityAdinA kaShAyairnavayogAnAha| kShaudrasaindhavayogo yadyapi sarvavamaneShveva sAmAnyena vihitaH, tathA~apIha ‘lavaNakShaudrasaMyutam’ iti vacanAdutkarSho lavaNasaindhavayorabhidhIyate||7-8||-
aShTAhamityAdinA pa~jca cUrNayogAnAha||9-10||-
athAtaH kRutavedhanakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
kRutavedhananAmAni kalpaM cAsya nibodhata| kShveDaH koshAtakI coktaM mRuda~ggaphalameva ca||3||
atyarthakaTutIkShNoShNaM gADheShviShTaM gadeShu ca| kuShThapANDvAmayaplIhashophagulmagarAdiShu||4||

sushuShkANAM tu jIrNAnAmekaM dve vA yathAbalam||5||

Commentary: kShIrAdItyAdinA kShIrayogA ucyante| kShIrayogacatuShTayaM madirAyogaM ca jImUtakakalpavidhAnAtideshenAha| kShIrAdishabdena kShIrakRutapeyA-kShIrasantAnikA-dadhyuttarANAM grahaNam| ete ca sa~ggrahe~akShIrarUpA api kShIravikAratayA kShIrashabdenaiva gRuhItAH ‘kShIre dvau dvau’ iti vacanena| kusumAdInAmiti kRutavedhanasya puShpAdInAM “payaH puShpe~asya nirvRutte phale peyA payaskRutA| lomashe kShIrasantAnaM dadhyuttaramalomashe” (ka.a.2) iti jImUtakavidhAnoktAnAm| surA caiteShu pUrvavaditi yathA jImUtakakalpavidhAnena kShIrAdayaH kartavyAstathA surA ca kartavyA|5|
kaShAyairmadhukAdInAM navabhiH phalavat pibet| kvAthayitvA phalaM tasya pUtvA lehaM nidhApayet||6||
kRutavedhanakalkAMshaM phalAdyardhAMshasaMyutam | pRuthak cAragvadhAdInAM trayodashabhirAsutam||7||

vartikriyAH ShaT phalavat, phalAdInAM ghRutaM tathA||8||

Commentary: vartikriyAH ShaT phalavaditi “phalapippalIcUrNAni pUrvavat” (ka.a.1) ityAdinA granthena yA vartikriyA uktA madanakalpe, tadvadihApi kRutavedhanacUrNAnAM ShaDvartikriyAH kartavyAH| phalAdInAM ghRutaM tathetyanena kRutavedhanasAdhitakShIrAdutthitaM navanItaM phalAdikaShAyeNa sAdhanIyaM madanaphalaghRutavadityarthaH||8||
koshAtakAni pa~jcAshat kovidArarase pacet| taM kaShAyaM phalAdInAM kalkairlehaM punaH pacet||9||
kShveDasya tatra bhAgaH syAccheShANyardhAMshikAni tu| kaShAyaiH kovidArAdyairevaM tat kalpayet pRuthak||10||

kaShAyeShu phalAdInAmAnUpaM pishitaM pRuthak| koshAtakyA samaM paktvA rasaM salavaNaM pibet||11||

Commentary: kaShAyeShvityAdinA sapta mAMsayogAnAha| samamiti koshAtakItulyaM mAMsam| atra pibedityantena ShaNmAMsarasAH, phalAdItyanena caikaH| phalAdipippalItulyaM tadvadityanena phalAdibhiH samaM mAMsam| tadvaditi vacanAt koshAtakyAH kaShAyeNa sAdhanIyam||11||-

kShveDaM kAsI pibet siddhaM mishramikShurasena ca||12||

Commentary: ikShurasayogamekamAha- kShveDamityAdi| siddhamiti ikShurasena mishritaM sat sAdhitaM pibedityarthaH uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “kShveDamikShurase shRutam” iti||12||
tatra shlokau- kShIre dvau dvau surA caikA kvAthA dvAviMshatistathA| dasha picchA ghRutaM caikaM ShaT ca vartikriyAH shubhAH||13||
lehe~aShTau sapta mAMse ca yoga ikShurase~aparaH| kRutavedhanakalpe~asmin ShaShTiryogAH prakIrtitAH||14||
vamanakalpapArisheShyAt kRutavedhanakalpo~abhidhIyate||1-2||
gADheShviti atyarthagADheShu kuShThAdiShu||3-4||

sushuShkANAmityAdinA nava kaShAyayogAnAha| phalavaditi madanaphalaM yathA yaShTImadhukAdibhiH pIyate, tathaitadapi pAtavyamityarthaH| eke navakaShAyaprayogeShu sheShavidhipratyAyakaM lehaM paThanti- “kvAthayitvA rasaM tasya pUtvA lehaM nidhApayet” ityAdi, tacca sa~ggatArtham| uktaM ca jatUkarNe- “atra jIrNabIjAnAM madanaphalavat kaShAyairlehA bhavanti nava” iti| pRuthagityAdinA trayodasha kaShAyayogAnAha| evaM dvAviMshatiH kaShAyayogA bhavanti| AragvadhAdayastrayodasha madanakalpe “AragvadhavRukShaka ...” (ka.a.1) ityAdinA guDUcyantenoktA j~jeyAH||5-7||
koshAtakAnItyAdi| atraiva kvAthapAdike kalke kartavye kShveDasya pUrNo bhAgo deyaH, phalAdInAM ca pratyekaM kShveDAdardhabhAgikatvam||9-10||
kShIre dvau dvAvityAdisa~ggrahaH| dvau dvAviti catvAraH||13-14||
athAtaH shyAmAtrivRutkalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
pippalI pippalImUlaM maricaM gajapippalI| saralaH kilimaM hi~ggu bhArgI tejovatI tathA||15||
mustaM haimavatI pathyA citrako rajanI vacA| svarNakShIryajamodA ca shRu~ggaveraM ca taiH pRuthak||16||

madhukArdhAMshasaMyuktaM sharkarAmbuyutaM pibet||17||

Commentary: madhuketyAdinaikaH prayogaH| ayaM ca sa~ggrahoktayoH ‘yaShTyAM dvau’ ityanayorekataraH||17||
jIvakarShabhakau medAM shrAvaNIM karkATAhvayAm| mudgamAShAkhyaparNyau ca mahatIM shrAvaNIM tathA||18||
kAkolIM kShIrakAkolImindrAM chinnaruhAM tathA| kShIrashuklAM payasyAM ca yaShTyAhvaM vidhinA pibet||19||

kShIramAMsekShukAshmaryadrAkShApIlurasaiH pRuthak||20||

Commentary: kShIretyAdinA kShIrAdau sapta yogAnAha| pIlu auttarapathikaM phalam||20||-
lihyAdvA madhusarpirbhyAM saMyuktaM sasitopalam||21||
ajagandhA tugAkShIrI vidArI sharkarA trivRut| cUrNitaM kShaudrasarpirbhyAM lIDhvA sAdhu viricyate||22||
sannipAtajvarastambhadAhatRuShNArdito naraH| shyAmAtrivRutkaShAyeNa kalkena ca sasharkaram||23||
sAdhayedvidhivallehaM lihyAt pANitalaM tataH| sakShaudrAM sharkarAM paktvA kuryAnmRudbhAjane nave||24||
kShipecchIte trivRuccUrNaM tvakpatramaricaiH saha| mAtrayA lehayedetadIshvarANAM virecanam||25||
kuDavAMshAn rasAnikShudrAkShApIluparuShakAt| sitopalApalaM kShaudrAt kuDavArdhaM ca sAdhayet||26||
taM lehaM yojayecchItaM trivRuccUrNena shAstravit| etadutsannapittAnAmIshvarANAM virecanam||27||
sharkarAmodakAn vartIrgulikAmAMsapUpakAn| anena vidhinA kuryAt paittikAnAM virecanam||28||
pippalIM nAgaraM kShAraM shyAmAM trivRutayA saha| lehayenmadhunA sArdhaM shleShmalAnAM virecanam||29||
mAtulu~ggAbhayAdhAtrIshrIparNIkoladADimAt| subhRuShTAn svarasAMstaile sAdhayettatra cAvapet||30||
sahakArAt kapitthAcca madhyamamlaM ca yat phalam| pUrvavadbahalIbhUte trivRuccUrNaM samAvapet||31||
tvakpatrakesharailAnAM cUrNaM madhu ca mAtrayA| leho~ayaM kaphapUrNAnAmIshvarANAM virecanam||32||

pAnakAni rasAn yUShAnmodakAn rAgaShADavAn| anena vidhinA kuryAdvirekArthaM kaphAdhike||33||

Commentary: pAnakAnItyAdinA~atideshAnuguNyAt pAnakAdipa~jcayogAnAha| rAgapradhAnaH ShADavo rAgaShADavaH| anena vidhineti pUrvalehoktavidhinA||33||
bhRu~ggailAbhyAM samA nIlI taistrivRuttaishca sharkarA| cUrNaM phalarasakShaudrashaktubhistarpaNaM pibet||34||
vAtapittakaphottheShu rogeShvalpAnaleShu ca| nareShu sukumAreShu nirapAyaM virecanam||35||

sharkarAtriphalAshyAmAtrivRutpippalimAkShikaiH| modakaH sannipAtordhvaraktapittajvarApahaH||36||

Commentary: sharkaretyAdinA modakaH prathamaH| tatra ca “modake dviguNo guDaH” iti vacanAt guDasharkarAM cUrNAddviguNAmicchanti||36||
trivRucchANA matAstisrastisrashca triphalAtvacaH| viDa~ggapippalIkShArashANAstisrashca cUrNitAH||37||
lihyAt sarpirmadhubhyAM ca modakaM vA guDena tu| bhakShayenniShparIhArametacchodhanamuttamam ||38||
gulmaM plIhodaraM shvAsaM halImakamarocakam| kaphavAtakRutAMshcAnyAn vyAdhInetahyapohati||39||

virecane trivRunmUlaM shreShThamAhurmanIShiNaH | tasyAH sa~jj~jA guNAH karma bhedaH kalpashca vakShyate||3||

Commentary: virecane ityAdau trivRunmUlashabdena shyAmamUlAyA aruNamUlAyAshca sAmAnyena mUlaM gRuhyate||3||
viDa~ggapippalImUlatriphalAdhAnyacitrakAn| maricendrayavAjAjIpippalIhastipippalIH||40||
lavaNAnyajamodAM ca cUrNitaM kArShikaM pRuthak| tilatailatrivRuccUrNabhAgau cAShTapalonmitau||41||
dhAtrIphalarasaprasthAMstrIn guDArdhatulAM tathA| paktvA mRudvagninA khAdedbadarodumbaropamAn||42||
guDAn kRutvA na cAtra syAdvihArAhArayantraNA| mandAgnitvaM jvaraM mUrcchAM mUtrakRucchramarocakam||43||
asvapnaM gAtrashUlaM ca kAsaM shvAsaM bhramaM kShayam| kuShThArshaHkAmalAmehagulmodarabhagandarAn||44||
grahaNIpANDurogAMshca hanyuH puMsavanAshca te| kalyANakA iti khyAtAH sarveShvRutuShu yaugikAH||45||
vyoShatvakpatramustailAviDa~ggAmalakAbhayAH | samabhAgA bhiShagdadyAddviguNaM ca mukUlakam||46||
trivRuto~aShTaguNaM bhAgaM sharkarAyAshca ShaDguNam| cUrNitaM guDikAH kRutvA kShaudreNa palasammitAH||47||
bhakShayet kalyamutthAya shItaM cAnu pibejjalam| mUtrakRucchre jvare vamyAM kAse shvAse bhrame kShaye||48||
tApe pANDvAmaye~alpe~agnau shastA niryantraNAshinaH| yogaH sarvaviShANAM ca mataH shreShTho virecane||49||

pathyAdhAtryurubUkANAM prasRutau dvau trivRutpalam||50||

Commentary: pathyetyAdinA caturthaH||50||-
trivRuddhaimavatI shyAmA nIlinI hastipippalI||51||
samUlA pippalI mustamajamodA durAlabhA| kArShikaM nAgarapalaM guDasya palaviMshatim||52||
cUrNitaM modakAn kuryAdudumbaraphalopamAn| hi~ggusauvarcalavyoShayavAnIbiDajIrakaiH||53||
vacAjagandhAtriphalAcavyacitrakadhAnyakaiH| modakAn veShTayeccUrNaistAn satumburudADimaiH||54||
trikava~gkShaNahRudbastikoShThArshaHplIhashUlinAm| hikkAkAsArucishvAsakaphodAvartinAM shubhAH ||55||
trivRutAM kauTajaM bIjaM pippalIM vishvabheShajam| kShaudradrAkShArasopetaM varShAsvetadvirecanam||56||
trivRuddurAlabhAmustasharkarodIcyacandanam| drAkShAmbunA sayaShTyAhvasAtalaM jaladAtyaye||57||
trivRutAM citrakaM pAThAmajAjIM saralaM vacAm| svarNakShIrIM ca hemante piShTvA tUShNAmbunA pibet||58||
sharkarA trivRutA tulyA grIShmakAle virecanam| trivRuttrAyantihapuShAH sAtalAM kaTurohiNIm ||59||
svarNakShIrIM ca sa~jcUrNya gomUtre bhAvayettryaham| eSha sarvartuko yogaH snigdhAnAM maladoShahRut||60||
trivRucchyAmA durAlambhA vatsakaM hastipippalI| nIlinI triphalA mustaM kaTukA ca sucUrNitam||61||
sarpirmAMsarasoShNAmbuyuktaM pANitalaM tataH| pibet sukhatamaM hyetadrUkShANAmapi shasyate||62||
tryUShaNaM triphalA hi~ggu kArShikaM trivRutApalam| sauvarcalArdhakarShaM ca palArdhaM cAmlavetasAt||63||
taccUrNaM sharkarAtulyaM madyenAmlena vA pibet| gulmapArshvArtinutsiddhaM jIrNe cAdyAdrasaudanam||64||

trivRutAM triphalAM dantIM saptalAM vyoShasaindhavam| kRutvA cUrNaM tu saptAhaM bhAvyamAmalakIrase||65||

Commentary: trivRutAM triphalAmityAdikastarpaNayogaH| evaM sarvartukayogena samaM dvau tarpaNayogau bhavataH||65||-
tulyAmlaM trivRutAkalkasiddhaM gulmaharaM ghRutam||66||
shyAmAtrivRutayormUlaM pacedAmalakaiH saha| jale tena kaShAyeNa paktvA sarpiH pibennaraH||67||
shyAmAtrivRutkaShAyeNa siddhaM sarpiH pibettathA| sAdhitaM vA payastAbhyAM sukhaM tena viricyate||68||
trivRunmuShTIMstu sanakhAnaShTau droNe~ambhasaH pacet | pAdasheShaM kaShAyaM taM pUtaM guDatulAyutam||69||
snigdhe sthApyaM ghaTe kShaudrapippalIphalacitrakaiH| pralipte madhunA mAsaM jAtaM tanmAtrayA pibet||70||
grahaNIpANDurogaghnaM gulmashvayathunAshanam| surAM vA trivRutAyogakiNvAM tatkvAthasaMyutAm||71||
yavaiH shyAmAtrivRutkvAthasvinnaiH kulmAShamambhasA| AsutaM ShaDahaM palle jAtaM sauvIrakaM pibet||72||
bhRuShTAn vA satuShA~jchuddhAn yavAMstaccUrNasaMyutAn| AsutAnambhasA tadvat pibejjAtaM tuShodakam||73||

tathA madanakalpoktAn ShADavAdIn pRuthagdasha| trivRuccUrNena saMyojya virekArthaM prayojayet||74||

Commentary: tathetyAdinA ShADavAdiyogAn dashAha| dasha ShADavAdayo “badaraShADavarAgalehamodakotkArikAtarpaNashAkamAMsarasayUShamadyAnAM” (ka.a.1) iti granthena madanakalpoktAH||74||
bhavatashcAtra- tvakkesharAmrAtakadADimailAsitopalAmAkShikamAtulu~ggaiH| madyaistathA~amlaishca manonukUlairyuktAni deyAni virecanAni||75||
shItAmbunA pItavatashca tasya si~jcenmukhaM chardivighAtahetoH| hRudyAMshca mRutpuShpaphalapravAlAnamlaM ca dadyAdupajighraNArtham||76||
tatra shlokAH- eko~amlAdibhiraShTau ca dasha dvau saindhavAdibhiH| mUtre~aShTAdasha yaShTyAM dvau jIvakAdau caturdasha||77||
kShIrAdau sapta lehe~aShTau catvAraH sitayA~api ca| pAnakAdiShu pa~jcaiva ShaDRutau pa~jca modakAH||78||
catvArashca ghRute kShIre dvau cUrNe tarpaNe tathA| dvau madye kA~jjike dvau ca dashAnye ShADavAdiShu||79||
shyAmAyAstrivRutAyAshca kalpe~asmin samudAhRutam| shataM dashottaraM siddhaM yogAnAM paramarShiNA||80||

tribhaNDI trivRutA caiva shyAmA kUTaraNA tathA| sarvAnubhUtiH suvahA shabdaiH paryAyavAcakaiH||4||

Commentary: paryAyatvena vAcakaiH paryAyavAcakaiH||4||
kaShAyA madhurA rUkShA vipAke kaTukA ca sA| kaphapittaprashamanI raukShyAccAnilakopanI||5||
sedAnImauShadhairyuktA vAtapittakaphApahaiH| kalpavaisheShyamAsAdya sarvarogaharA bhavet||6||
mUlaM tu dvividhaM tasyAH shyAmaM cAruNameva ca| tayormukhyataraM viddhi mUlaM yadaruNaprabham||7||
sukumAre shishau vRuddhe mRudukoShThe ca tacchubham | mohayedAshukAritvAcchyAmA kShiNvIta mUrcchayet ||8||
taikShNyAt karShati hRutkaNThamAshu doShaM haratyapi| shasyate bahudoShANAM krUrakoShThAshca ye narAH||9||
guNavatyAM tayorbhUmau jAtaM mUlaM samuddharet| upoShya prayataH shukle shuklavAsAH samAhitaH||10||
gambhIrAnugataM shlakShNamatiryagvisRutaM ca yat| tadvipATyoddharedgarbhaM tvacaM shuShkAM nidhApayet||11||

akShamAtraM tayoH piNDaM vinIyAmlena nA pibet||12||

Commentary: peyAmAtroShita iti pUrvadine peyAmAtrAhAratayA uShitaH; yadyapi cAnyatra virecanapUrvadineShu tathaivAhAro niyamitaH- “snehavaddravamuShNaM ca tryahaM bhuktvA rasaudanam” (sU.a.13) ityanena, tathA~api trivRudvirecanaprayoge pUrvadine visheShavidhAnAt peyAdAnaM j~jeyam| ki~jceyameva tadvacanAt snigdhoShNamAMsarasasAdhitA ca kriyamANA na pUrvoktasnehavaddravauShNamAMsarasaudanaviruddhA bhavati|12|
go~avyajAmahiShImUtrasauvIrakatuShodakaiH| prasannayA triphalayA shRutayA ca pRuthak pibet||13||

ekaikaM saindhavAdInAM dvAdashAnAM sanAgaram| trivRuddviguNasaMyuktaM cUrNamuShNAmbunA pibet||14||

Commentary: ekaikamityAdinA saindhavAdibhirdvAdashayogAnAha| saindhavAdayashca dvAdasha rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) lavaNaskandhoktA j~jeyAH| sanAgaramiti nAgarasahitaM sat pratyekaM saindhavAdInAM cUrNaM dviguNatrivRutAcUrNayuktaM pAtavyam||14||

vamanArthakalpanAnantaraM virecanakalpeShu vaktavyeShu trivRutAyA virecanadravyeShu sukhavirecanatayA pradhAnatvAt trivRutkalpa evAbhidhIyate| trivRutAbheda eva ca shyAmA, tena shyAmAyAstrivRutAyAshca kalpaH shyAmAtrivRutkalpaH| yadyapi cAruNamUlaiva trivRudatrotkRuShTA vaktavyA, tathA~apyadhyAyasa~jj~jAyAM shyAmAyA agre pAThenAshudoShahantRutayA shyAmAyAH prakarShaM darshayati| ye cAtra yogA vaktavyAste~aruNayA vA shyAmayA vA ubhAbhyAM vA doShasharIrAdibalAbalamavekShya kartavyAH||1-2||
pippalItyAdinA pippalyAdidravyabhedena mUtre~aShTAdashayogAnAha||15-16||-
jIvaketyAdinA caturdashayogAn tathA yaShTyAhvamityekaM cAha| ayaM ca sa~ggrahoktayoH ‘yaShTyAM dvau’ iti dvayoranyataraH| kShIrashuklA kShIravidArI| indrA kokilAkShaH| payasyA arkapuShpI||18-19||-
