lihyAdvA madhvityAdinA~aShTau lehAnAha| lihyAdvetyAdinA prathamo lehaH| ajagandhetyAdinA dvitIyaH| ajagandhA ajamodA| shyAmAtrivRudityAdinA tRutIyo lehaH| atra sharkarAtrivRuccUrNAbhyAM samAbhyAM kvAthapAdikAbhyAM lehaH| sakShaudrAmityAdinA caturthaH| atra kShaudrapAko yogamahimnA| trivRuccUrNamAtrApAdikatvaM tvakpatrAdInAM, saugandhamAtraprayojanatvAt | IshvarANAM virecanamiti vacanena sukumAratvAdasnigdhaviShayatAmasya darshayati, IshvarA hi prAyeNa sukumArAH snigdhAshca bhavanti| kuDavAMshAnityAdiH pa~jcamaH| atra trivRuccUrNamanirdiShTamAnaM, tacca prakShepanyAyAllehAt pAdikaM kartavyam| utsannapittAnAm udbhUtapittAnAm| sharkaretyAdinA sitAyogAMshcaturo~atideshAnuguNyAllehAnAM madhya evAha| atra vartyAdayo~api sharkarAkRutA eva j~jeyAH| anena vidhineti ikShvAdirasasaMskAreNa trivRuccUrNayogena ca| pippalIM nAgaramityAdinA ShaShTho lehaH| madhyamiti amlakapitthasya madhyaM bhAgam| amlaM ca yat phalamiti mAtulu~ggAdi| pUrvavaditi kauDavikatvaM mAtulu~ggAdirasAnAM darshayati||21-32||
bhRu~ggailAbhyAmityAdinA tarpaNayogaM prathamamevAha, dvitIyastu tarpaNayogo bhaviShyatIti| bhRu~ggaM guDatvak| taishca sharkareti bhRu~ggalAnIlItrivRudbhiH| phalarasaH dADimarasaH||34-35||
trivRucchANA ityAdineha modake ca yadyapi paThyate yogaH, tathA~apyasya lehenaiva grahaNAdayamaShTamo leho bhavati||37-39||
viDa~ggetyAdinA dvitIyo modakaH||40-45||

vyoShetyAdinA tRutIyo modakaH| ayaM modakastantrAntare ‘abhayAdya’ iti khyAtaH| mukUlakaM dantI| atra mukUlAdInAmekaikadravyApekShayA dvaiguNyAdi bhavati| madhu ca tAvanmAtraM yAvatA modako bhavati| kecidatra vyoShAdimilitacUrNAddantyAdInAM dvaiguNyaM vadanti||46-49||-
trivRuddhaimavatItyAdinA pa~jcamo modakaH pUryate| veShTayediti avacUrNayet||51-55||

trivRutAM kauTajamityAdinA ShaDRutuvihitAn yogAn rUkShANAmapi shasyate ityantenAha| sAtalA carmakashA| jaladAtyaye sharadi| hemante yadyapi prabalashItavAte virecanaM niShiddhaM, tathA~api vyAdhiviShayavihitaM virecanametajj~jeyam| sarvartukayogau anukte Rutau vasantAdau ca j~jeyau| trivRucchyAmetyAdiko~api sarvartuko yogaH| tryUShaNamityAdishcUrNayogo dvitIyaH||56-64||

tulyAmlamityekaM ghRutaM, shyAmetyAdi dvitIyaM, shyAmAtrivRutkaShAyeNetyAdi tRutIyam| sAdhitaM cetyAdinA kShIrayogamekamAha| ghRutena kShIreNa ca ghRutena kShIreNa vaikena militvA catvAro ghRutakShIrairbhavanti||66-68||
trivRunmuShTInityAdinA prathamA surA, surAM vetyAdinA dvitIyA, evaM dvau surAyogau bhavataH| trivRudyogayuktaM kiNvaM yasyAM sA tathA||69-71||

yavairityAdinA sauvIrakatuShodake prAha| etau dvau kA~jjikayogau| kulmASha utsvinnayavapiShTakam| palle iti dhAnyAdirAshau| taccUrNasaMyutAniti trivRuccUrNasaMyutAn| tadvaditi ShaDahaM palle sthitAna||72-73||
samprati dashottaraM yogashatamabhidhAya vAntinirAsArthaM kRutyatrayeNa samaM virecanaprayogAnAha- tvakkesharetyAdi||75-76||
eko~amlAdibhirityAdisa~ggraho vyaktArthaH| yaShTyAM dvAviti ‘yaShTyAhvaM vidhinA’ iti jIvakAdAvekaH, madhuketyAdinA cAparaH||77-80||

sedAnImityAdi| vAtApahauShadhayogena vAtahantRutvamavidyamAnaM bhavati, kaphapittahantRutvaM vidyamAnamadhikaM bhavatIti j~jeyam| kalpavaisheShyamiti kalpanAvisheSham| sarvarogahareti vyastasamastasarvadoShArabdharogaharA||5-6||

trivRutayorbhedamAha- mUlaM tu dvividhamityAdi| mukhyataramiti virecanakriyAyAmevAvyApattikaratvAcchreShThataram| sukumArAH shishavashca yadyapyavirecanIyA uktAstathA~api teShAM vidhIyamAnavirecane hitamiti j~jeyam| mohayedityAdinA shyAmamUlAyA guNakarmaNI brUte| kShiNvIteti dhAtukShayaM kuryAt||7-9||

yadyapi madanakalpa eva guNavadbhUmijAtatvAdi sAmAnyena bheShajAnAmuktameva, tathA~api gambhIrAnugatatvAdivisheShasya tatrAnuktasyehAbhidhAne sati tatprasa~ggAt tatki~jciducyate- guNavatyAmityAdi| shukle iti shuklapakShe| gambhIrAnugamiti dUrapraviShTam| uddharedgarbhamiti mUlasyAsthi uddharet| nidhApayediti yathoktabhaiShajyasthApanavidhAnena sthApayet||10-11||
akShamAtramityAdinA navabhiramlAdibhirdravyairnavayogAnAha| tayoriti shyAmAtrivRudaruNatrivRutayoH| etayoshca militayoH pratyekaM ca prayogA iti prAgeva pratipAditam| amleneti kA~jjikena||12-13||
athAtashcatura~ggulakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

dantIkvAthe~a~jjaliM majj~jAH shampAkasya guDasya ca| dattvA mAsArdhamAsasthamariShTaM pAyayeta ca||15||

Commentary: dantItyAdinA~ariShTayogamAha| guDasya cA~jjalimiti sambandhaH| mAsArdhamAsasthamiti sArdhamAsastham||15||

yasya yat pAnamannaM ca hRudyaM svAdvatha vA kaTu| lavaNaM vA bhavettena yuktaM dadyAdvirecanam||16||

Commentary: yasya yadityAdinA~anuktamaparAparasAdhanaM vidhatte| hRudyena hi virecanayogasya priyatA syAt| pAnamannaM ceti hRudyamityAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate||16||
tatra shlokAH drAkShArase surAsIdhvordadhni cAmalakIrase| sauvIrake kaShAye ca trivRuto bilvakasya ca||17||
lehe~ariShTe ghRute dve ca yogA dvAdasha kIrtitAH| catura~ggulakalpe~asmin sukumArAH sukhodayAH||18||

Aragvadho rAjavRukShaH shampAkashcatura~ggulaH| pragrahaH kRutamAlashca karNikAro~avaghAtakaH||3||

Commentary: vyavahArArthaM paryAyAnAha- Aragvadha ityAdi||3||
jvarahRudrogavAtAsRugudAvartAdirogiShu| rAjavRukSho~adhikaM pathyo mRudurmadhurashItalaH||4||
bAle vRuddhe kShate kShINe sukumAre ca mAnave| yojyo mRudvanapAyitvAdvisheShAccatura~ggulaH||5||
phalakAle phalaM tasya grAhyaM pariNataM ca yat| teShaM guNavatAM bhAraM sikatAsu nidhApayet||6||
saptarAtrAt samuddhRutya shoShayedAtape bhiShak| tato majjAnamuddhRutya shucau bhANDe nidhApayet||7||

drAkShArasayutaM dadyAddAhodAvartapIDite| caturvarShamukhe bAle yAvaddvAdashavArShike||8||

Commentary: drAkShetyAdiH prathamo yogaH| caturvarShamukhe bAle yAvaddvAdashavArShike ityanenAsya prayogasya caturvarShAdarvAgUrdhvaM ca dvAdashavarShAdavashyatayA yaugikatvaM niShedhayati||8||-
surAmaNDena saMyuktamathavA kolasIdhunA||9||
dadhimaNDena vA yuktaM rasenAmalakasya vA| kRutvA shItakaShAyaM taM pibet sauvIrakeNa vA||10||

trivRuto vA kaShAyeNa majj~jaH kalkaM tathA pibet| tathA bilvakaShAyeNa lavaNakShaudrasaMyutam||11||

Commentary: trivRuto vA kaShAyeNa majj~jaH kalkaM tathA pibediti saptamaH| tathetyAdinA~aShTamaH| etatkalkakaShAyayordvayaM jatUkarNe~apyuktameva- ‘trivRudbilvakaShAyAbhyAM sakShaudralavaNau dvau’ iti| tenAtra pAThAntaraM na pramANam| sa~ggrahe ca kariShyati- ‘kaShAye ca trivRuto bilvakasya ca’ iti||11||

kaShAyeNAthavA tasya trivRuccUrNaM guDAnvitam| sAdhayitvA shanairlehaM lehayenmAtrayA naram||12||

Commentary: kaShAyeNetyAdiko leho navamaH||12||

catura~ggulasiddhAdvA kShIrAdyadudiyAdghRutam| majj~jaH kalkena dhAtrINAM rase tatsAdhitaM pibet||13||

Commentary: catura~gguletyAdinA prathamaM ghRutam| majj~ja iti catura~ggulamajj~jaH||13||

tadeva dashamUlasya kulatthAnAM yavasya ca| kaShAye sAdhitaM sarpiH kalkaiH shyAmAdibhiH pibet||14||

Commentary: tadevetyAdinA ca dvitIyaM ghRutam| shyAmAdibhiriti madanakalpapaThitairnavabhiH ‘shyAmAtrivRuddantI ... ’ (ka.a.1) ityAdibhiH||14||
shyAmAtrivRutkalpAnantaraM mRuduvirecanatvasAmAnyAccatura~ggulakalpo~abhidhIyate||1-2||
drAkShetyAdisa~ggraho vyaktaH||17-18||
adhikaM pathya iti jvarAdiShu visheSheNa virecanaprayoge hitaH||4-5||
phalakAle iti ucitaphalakAle| teShAmiti phalAnAm| bhAramiti bhUridravyopalakShaNam| majjAnamiti phalamajjAnam||6-7||
surAmaNDeneti dvitIyaH| athavA kolasIdhuneti tRutIyaH| kolakRutaH sIdhuH kolasIdhuH| sauvIrakeNa vetyantena yogatrayamaparaM vyaktam||9-10||
athAtastilvakakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
tilvakastu mato lodhro bRuhatpatrastirITakaH| tasya mUlatvacaM shuShkAmantarvalkalavarjitAm||3||
cUrNayettu tridhA kRutvA dvau bhAgau shcotayettataH| lodhrasyaiva kaShAyeNa tRutIyaM tena bhAvayet||4||
bhAgaM taM dashamUlasya punaH kvAthena bhAvayet| shuShkaM cUrNaM punaH kRutvA tata UrdhvaM prayojayet||5||

dadhitakrasurAmaNDamUtrairbadarasIdhunA | rasenAmalakAnAM vA tataH pANitalaM pibet||6||

Commentary: dadhimaNDetyAdinA pibedityantena pa~jca yogAH||6||

meShashRu~ggyabhayAkRuShNAcitrakaiH salile shRute| marujAn sunuyAttacca jAtaM sauvIrakaM yadA||7||

Commentary: meShashRu~ggItyAdinA vishiShTasauvIrakeNa yoga ekaH| marujA bhRuShTayavAH||7||-
surAM lodhrakaShAyeNa jAtAM pakShasthitAM pibet||8||
dantIcitrakayordroNe salilasyADhakaM pRuthak| samutkvAthya guDasyaikAM tulAM lodhrasya cA~jjalim||9||

kampillakakaShAyeNa dashakRutvaH subhAvitAm||10||

Commentary: kampillaketyAdinA kampillakayogamAha| kampillakaH guNDArocanikA| mAtrAmiti tilvakacUrNamAtrAm||10||-
catura~ggulakalpena leho~anyaH kArya eva ca||11||
triphalAyAH kaShAyeNa sasarpirmadhuphANitaH| lodhracUrNayutaH siddho lehaH shreShTho virecane||12||
tilvakasya kaShAyeNa kalkena ca sasharkaraH| saghRutaH sAdhito lehaH sa ca shreShTho virecane||13||
aShTAShTau trivRutAdInAM muShTIMstu sanakhAn pRuthak| droNe~apAM sAdhayet pAdasheShe prasthaM ghRutAt pacet||14||
piShTaistaireva bilvAMshaiH samUtralavaNairatha| tato mAtrAM pibet kAle shreShThametadvirecanam||15||
lodhrakalkena mUtrAmlalavaNaishca pacedghRutam| catura~ggulakalpena sarpiShI dve ca sAdhayet||16||
tatra shlokau- pa~jca dadhyAdibhistvekA surA sauvIrakeNa ca| eko~ariShTastathA yoga ekaH kampillakena ca||17||
lehAstrayo ghRutenApi catvAraH samprakIrtitAH| yogAste lodhramUlAnAM kalpe ShoDasha darshitAH||18||
catura~ggulavattilvakasyAnapAyitvAccatura~ggulakalpAnantaraM tilvakakalpo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

antarvalkalavarjitAmiti tilvakasyAntarvalkalaM kaThinaM bhavati, tadarthaM tadvarjanam| shcotayediti vacanena ShaDguNadraveNaikaviMshativArAn srAvayediti j~jeyaM, madanaphalakalpe evambhUtasyaiva srAvaNasya dRuShTatvAt| bhAvanAvidhishca nirantaraM vyAkRuta eva||3-5||
surAmityAdinA surAyogamAha| dantItyAdinaikamariShTayogamAha| dantIcitrakayorADhakaM pRuthak saliladroNe pacet| tilvakacUrNamAvApaH||8-9||-

catura~gguletyAdinA prathamo lehaH| catura~ggulakalpeneti ‘kaShAyeNAthavA tasya’ (ka.a.8) ityAdinoktavidhAnena| tenAtra tilvakakvAthena guDAnvitatrivRuccUrNaM paktvA lehaH kartavyaH| triphalAyA ityAdinA dvitIyo lehaH| tilvakasyetyAdinA tRutIyaH||11-13||

aShTAShTAvityAdinA prathamaM ghRutam| sanakhAniti vidyamAnanakhAn| atra trivRudAdigRuhItalodhrasya pradhAnatvAddviguNo bhAgo bhavati| uktaM hi jatUkarNe- “trivRudAdidviguNo lodhrakvAthaH” iti| samabhAgatve tu lodhraprayogatvasya kena visheShaH syAt, tasmAd yathAvyAkhyAtameva sAdhu| lavaNamapyatra palAMshameva| lodhretyAdi dvitIyaM ghRutam| catura~gguletyAdinA ghRutadvayamatidishyate| evaM ghRutena catvAro yogA bhavanti| catura~ggulaghRute ca “catura~ggulasiddhAt” (ka.a.8) ityAdinA, tathA “tadeva dashamUlasya” (ka.a.8) ityAdinA prokte j~jeye; tathA ca catura~ggulakalpena lodhrAdinA dve lodhraghRute bhavataH||14-16||
pa~jca dadhyAdibhirityAdisa~ggraho vyaktaH||17-18||
athAtaH sudhAkalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

bhAvitA~jchuShkamatsyAn vA mAMsaM vA bhakShayennaraH||19||

Commentary: bhAvitAnityAdinA shuShkamatsyamAMsayogAvAha||19||

kShIreNAmalakaiH sarpishcatura~ggulavat pacet| surAM vA kArayet kShIre ghRutaM vA pUrvavat pacet||20||

Commentary: kShIreNetyAdinA ekaM ghRutam| ghRutaM vetyAdinA ekaM vakShyati| Amalakaishcatura~ggulavaditi vacanAdAmalakarasayuktaM yaccatura~ggulakalpe “catura~ggulasiddhAdvA” (ka.a.8) ityAdinoktaM tasya vidhAnamatidishati| surAM vA kArayet kShIre iti snukkShIrabhAvitamityAdividhinA surAM kuryAt| ghRutaM vA pUrvavat pacedityatra pUrvavadityanena tilvakakalpe pUrvaM yat “lodhrakalkena” (ka.a.9) ityAdigranthavihitaM, tadvidhireva pratyAsannatvAdatidishyate||20||
tatra shlokau- sauvIrakAdibhiH sapta sarpiShA ca rasena ca| pAnakaM ghreyalehau ca yogA yUShAdibhistrayaH||21||
dvau shuShkamatsyamAMsAbhyAM suraikA dve ca sarpiShI| mahAvRukShasya yogAste viMshatiH samudAhRutAH||22||
virecanAnAM sarveShAM sudhA tIkShNatamA matA| sa~gghAtaM hi bhinattyAshu doShANAM kaShTavibhramA||3||
tasmAnnaiShA mRudau koShThe prayoktavyA kadAcana| na doShanicaye cAlpe sati mArgaparikrame ||4||
pANDurogodare gulme kuShThe dUShIviShArdite| shvayathau madhumehe ca doShavibhrAntacetasi||5||
rogairevaMvidhairgrastaM j~jAtvA saprANamAturam| prayojayenmahAvRukShaM samyak sa hyavacAritaH||6||
dvividhaH sa mato~alpaishca bahubhishcaiva kaNTakaiH||7||
sutIkShNaiH kaNTakairalpaiH pravaro bahukaNTakaH| sa nAmnA snugguDA nandA sudhA nistriMshapatrakaH||8||
tau vipATyAharet kShIraM shastreNa matimAn bhiShak| dvivarShaM vA trivarShaM vA shishirAnte visheShataH||9||
bilvAdInAM bRuhatyA vA kaNTakAryAstathaikashaH| kaShAyeNa samAMshaM taM kRutvA~a~ggAreShu shoShayet||10||
tataH kolasamAM mAtrAM pibet sauvIrakeNa vA| tuShodakena kolAnAM rasenAmalakasya vA||11||
sAtalAM kA~jcanakShIrIM shyAmAdIni kaTutrikam ||12||
yathopapatti saptAhaM sudhAkShIreNa bhAvayet| kolamAtrAM ghRutenAtaH pibenmAMsarasena vA||13||

tryUShaNaM triphalAM dantIM citrakaM trivRutAM tathA| snukkShIrabhAvitaM samyagvidadhyAdguDapAnakam||14||

Commentary: tryUShaNamityAdinA pAnakayogamAha| guDapAnakamiti guDasaMskRutapAnakam||14||
trivRutAragvadhaM dantIM sha~gkhinIM saptalAM samam| gomUtre rajanIM kRutvA shoShayedAtape tataH||15||
saptAhaM bhAvayitvaivaM snukkShIreNAparaM punaH| saptAhaM bhAvayecchuShkaM tatastenApi bhAvitam||16||
gandhamAlyaM tadAghrAya prAvRutya paTameva ca| sukhamAshu viricyante mRudukoShThA narAdhipAH||17||

shyAmAtrivRutkaShAyeNa snukkShIraghRutaphANitaiH| lehaM paktvA virekArthaM lehayenmAtrayA naram||18||

Commentary: shyAmetyAdinA lehayogamAha| mAtrayeti anapAyimAtrayA||18||

ShoDashasa~gkhyaprayogAbhidhAyakatilvakakalpAnantaraM yathAkramamadhikasa~gkhyAprayogAbhidhAnakramAdviMshatiyogAbhidhAyakasudhAkalpo~abhidhIyate; itashcAnantaramatiriktasa~gkhyAbhidhAnakrameNaiva UnacatvAriMshatprayogAbhidhAyakasaptalAsha~gkhinIkalpo~abhidhAsyate||1-2||
sauvIraketyAdiH sa~ggraho vyAkRuta eva||21-22||

virecanAnAmiti virecanadravyANAm| kaShTavibhrameti duHkhasAdhyavibhramajanikA| tasmAditi atitIkShNatvAt kaShTavibhramatvAcca| sati mArgaparikrama iti upakramamArgAntare sati na sudhA prayoktavyA, tena gatyantarAsambhava eva sudhA prayoktavyetyarthaH||3-4||

pANDurogetyAdau madhumehashabdena pramehA evocyante; vishiShTastu vAtikamadhumeho~asAdhya eva, tena taM prati virecanopadesho~anarthaka eva syAt; madhumehashabdashca yathA pramohamAtra eva vartate tat pratipAditameva pramehacikitsite| doShavRuddhyA vibhrAntaM ceto yasmin tasmin doShavibhrAntacetasi unmAde| saprANamiti balavantam||5-6||-

pravaro bahukaNTaka iti anatitIkShNatayA~alpakaNTakamahAvRukShataH shreShTha ityarthaH| tAviti svalpakaNTakabahukaNTakau mahAvRukShau| yadyapi madanakalpe “sharadi tvakkandakShIrANi” (ka.a.1) ityuktaM, tathA~api sudhAyA atra shishirAnte kShIragrahaNamapavAdarUpaM j~jeyam| shishirasya sheShA divasAH shishirAntAH||7-9||

bilvAdInAmiti bilvAdipa~jcamUlasya| a~ggAreShu shoShayediti a~ggAroparisthitapAtrasthaM tat sudhAkShIraM bilvAdInAmanyatamasya kaShAyeNa samAnaM shoShaNena kaThinaM kuryAt; tataH kolamAtrA guTikAH kAryAH, tataH sauvIrakAdInAmanyatamena pAtavyA| evaM sauvIrakAdibhedAt sapta yogA bhavanti; tathA~atra bilvAdikaShAyasya bhedena bhedo na vivakShitaH||10-11||-

sAtalAmityAdinA vAtasAdhanaghRutamAMsarasabhedAdyogadvayamAha| sAtalA carmakashA| shyAmAdigrahaNenaiva sAtalAyAmapi labdhAyAM pRuthak sAtalAbhidhAnamekayA~api sAtalayA kRutasudhAyogasya prAdhAnyakhyApanArtham||12-13||
trivRutetyAdinA ghreyayogamAha| gomUtre rajanIM kRutveti rajanIM vyApya gomUtre sthApayitvA| paTameveti yathoktavidhibhAvitaM paTamAvRutyetyarthaH||15-17||
athAtaH saptalAsha~gkhinIkalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
saptalA carmasAhvA ca bahuphenarasA ca sA| sha~gkhinI tiktalA caiva yavatiktA~akShi(kSha)pIDakaH||3||
tatra shlokau- kaShAyA dasha ShaT caiva ShaT taile~aShTau ca sarpiShi| pa~jca madye trayo lehA yogaH kampillake tathA||18||
saptalAsha~gkhinIbhyAM te triMshaduktA navAdhikAH| yogAH siddhAH samastAbhyAmekasho~api ca te hitAH||19||
te gulmagarahRudrogakuShThashophodarAdiShu| vikAsitIkShNarUkShatvAdyojye shleShmAdhikeShu tu||4||
nAtishuShkaM phalaM grAhyaM sha~gkhinyA nistuShIkRutam| saptalAyAshca mUlAni gRuhItvA bhAjane kShipet||5||
akShamAtraM tayoH piNDaM prasannAlavaNAyutam| hRudroge kaphavAtotthe gulme caiva prayojayet||6||
priyAlapIlukarkandhukolAmrAtakadADimaiH| drAkShApanasakharjUrabadarAmlaparUShakaiH||7||
maireye dadhimaNDe~amle sauvIrakatuShodake| sIdhau cApyeSha kalpaH syAt sukhaM shIghravirecanaH||8||
tailaM vidArigandhAdyaiH payasi kvathite pacet| saptalAsha~gkhinIkalke trivRucchyAmArdhabhAgike||9||
dadhimaNDena sannIya siddhaM tat pAyayeta ca| sha~gkhinIcUrNabhAgau dvau tilacUrNasya cAparaH||10||
harItakIkaShAyeNa tailaM tatpIDitaM pibet| atasIsarShapairaNDakara~jjaShveSha saMvidhiH||11||
sha~gkhinIsaptalAsiddhAt kShIrAdyadudiyAdghRutam| kalkabhAge tayoreva trivRucchyAmArdhasaMyute||12||
kShIreNAloDya sampakvaM pibettacca virecanam| dantIdravantyoH kalpo~ayamajashRu~ggyajagandhayoH||13||
kShIriNyA nIlikAyAshca tathaiva ca kara~jjayoH| masUravidalAyAshca pratyakparNyAstathaiva ca||14||
dvivargArdhAMshakalkena tadvat sAdhyaM ghRutaM punaH| sha~gkhinIsaptalAdhAtrIkaShAye sAdhayedghRutam ||15||
trivRutkalpena sarpishca trayo lehAshca lodhravat | surAkampillayoryogaH kAryo lodhravadeva ca||16||

dantIdravantyoH kalpena sauvIrakatuShodake| ajagandhAjashRu~ggyoshca tadvat syAtAM virecane||17||

Commentary: dantIdravantyorityAdinA sandhAnacatuShTayamAha| etat sandhAnacatuShTayaM pUrvasurAyogena samaM ‘pa~jca madye” iti vacanena sa~ggrahagRuhItaM; sauvIrakAdInAM ca madyashabdenAbhidhAnamihAsUtatvasAmAnyAjj~jeyam| dantIdravantyoH kalpeneti anAgatAvekShaNena dantIdravantIkalpe sauvIrakatuShodake ye vaktavye tadvidhAnamihApyatidishati| tatra “ajagandhAkaShAyeNa sauvIrakatuShodake” (ka.a.12) iti vaktavyaM, tenehApyajagandhAkaShAyayuktasaptalAsha~gkhinyoH sauvIrakatuShodake kartavye| atra “tathA dantIdravantyoshca kaShAye sAjagandhayoH| gauDaH kAryo~ajashRu~ggyA ca sa vai sukhavirecanaH” (ka.a.12) ityanenoktasya gauDAriShTasya dantIdravantIkalpoktasya vidhAnamatidishati||17||
pUrvAdhyAyoktasambandhAdeva saptalAsha~gkhinIkalpo~abhidhIyate| iha cAdhyAye ye yogA abhidhIyante te saptalayA vA sha~gkhinyA vA ubhAbhyAM vA sampAdyante shyAmAtrivRudyogavat||1-3||
kaShAyA ityAdisa~ggraho vyAkRutaH||18-19||
te gulmetyAdi| te saptalAsha~gkhinyau||4-5||

akShamAtramityAdinA kalkasya prasannAlavaNayuktasya priyAlAdikaShAyeShu ShoDashayogA bhavanti| atra yadyapi maireyaikShavau na kaShAyau tathA~api bahukaShAyAntargatatvAt kaShAyAveva vaktavyau, sa~ggrahe ‘kaShAyA dasha ShaT’ ityanena vyapadiShTau| kaShAyashabdena kalkakaShAyo~abhipretaH| karkandhUkolabadarashabdena triprakArabadaragrahaNam||6-8||

tailamityAdinA prathamastailayogaH| trivRucchyAmArdhabhAgike iti saptalAsha~gkhinIkalkayorardhabhAgena trivRucchyAmAkalko deyaH| sha~gkhinItyAdinA pa~jcatailayogAnAha, evaM ShaTtailayogA bhavanti| tailaM tatpIDitamiti sha~gkhinIcUrNaM tilacUrNaM ca harItakIkaShAyeNa sandhAya pIDitaM tat tailaM pibediti| atasyAdiShveSha saMvidhiriti vacanena tilasthAne~atasyAdInAM prayogaM vidhatte||9-11||

sha~gkhinIsaptaletyAdi prathamaM ghRutam| dantIdravantyorityAdinA dvidvidravyakalkena saptalAsha~gkhinIkalkArdhena pUrvaghRutavatpAkAcca pa~jcaghRutayogA apare| dravantI dantIbhedaH| ajashRu~ggI viShANikA| kShIriNI dugdhikA| masUravidalA shyAmalatA| pratyakparNI mUShikaparNI| dvivargArdhAMshakalkeneti dantyAdidvivargasha~gkhinIsaptalArdhabhAgikena kalkena| sha~gkhinItyAdinA saptamaM ghRutaM, trivRutkalkenetyAdyaShTamaM ghRutam| atra tvadhikRutatvAt saptalAsha~gkhinyordviguNaH kaShAyo vidhIyate| lodhravaditi lodhrakalpavat; lodhrakalpe yathA trayo lehAH “catura~ggulakalpena” (ka.a.9) ityAdinoktAH, tena lodhrasthAne saptalAsha~gkhinIyogaH kartavyaH| tathA surAyogaH kampillayogashca lodhravaditi atrApi lodhrasthAne saptalAsha~gkhinIprakShepaH kartavyaH||12-16||
athAto dantIdravantIkalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
rase ca dashamUlasya tathA baibhItake rase| harItakIrase caiva lehAnevaM pacet pRuthak ||15||
tayorbilvasamaM cUrNaM tadraseneva bhAvitam| asRuShTe vishi vAtotthe gulme cAmlayutaM shubham||16||
pATayitvekShukANDaM vA kalkenAlipya cAntarA| svedayitvA tataH khAdet sukhaM tena viricyate||17||
mUlaM dantIdravantyoshca saha mudgairvipAcayet| lAvavartIrakAdyaishca te rasAH syurvirecane||18||
tayorvA~api kaShAyeNa yavAgUM jA~ggalaM rasam| mAShayUShaM ca saMskRutya dadyAttaishca viricyate||19||
tatkaShAyAttrayo bhAgA dvau sitAyAstathaiva ca| eko godhUmacUrNAnAM kAryA cotkArikA shubhA||20||
modako vA~asya kalpena kAryastacca virecanam| tayoshcApi kaShAyeNa madyAnyasyopakalpayet||21||
dantIkvAthena cAloDya dantItailena sAdhitAn| guDalAvaNikAn bhakShyAn vividhAn bhakShayennaraH||22||
dantIM dravantIM maricaM yavAnImupaku~jcikAm| nAgaraM hemadugdhAM ca citrakaM ceti cUrNitam||23||
saptAhaM bhAvayenmUtre gavAM pANitalaM tataH| pibetghRutena jIrNe tu viriktashcApi tarpaNam||24||
sarvarogaharaM mukhyaM sarveShvRutuShu yaugikam| cUrNaM tadanapAyitvAdbAlavRuddheShu pUjitam||25||
durbhaktAjIrNapArshvArtigulmaplIhodareShu ca| gaNDamAlAsu vAte ca pANDuroge ca shasyate||26||
palaM citrakadantyoshca harItakyAshca viMshatiH| trivRutpippalikarShau dvau guDasyAShTapalena tat||27||
vinIya modakAn kuryAddashaikaM bhakShayettataH| uShNAmbu ca pibeccAnu dashame dashame~ahni ca||28||
ete niShparihArAH syuH sarvaroganibarhaNAH| grahaNIpANDurogArshaHkaNDUkoThAnilApahAH||29||
dantIdvipalaniryUho drAkShArdhaprasthasAdhitaH | virecanaM pittakAse pANDuroge ca shasyate||30||
dantIkalkaM samaguDaM shItavAriyutaM pibet| virecanaM mukhyatamaM kAmalAharamuttamam||31||
shyAmAdantIrase gauDaH pippalIphalacitrakaiH| lipte~ariShTo~anilashleShmaplIhapANDUdarApahaH||32||
tathA dantIdravantyoshca kaShAye sAjagandhayoH| gauDaH kAryo~a~ajashRu~ggyA vA sa vai sukhavirecanaH||33||
taccUrNakvAthamAShAmbukiNvatoyasamudbhavA| madirA kaphagulmAlpavahnipArshvakaTigrahe||34||
ajagandhAkaShAyeNa sauvIrakatuShodake| surAkampillake yogau lodhravacca tayoH smRutau||35||

dantyudumbaraparNI syAnnikumbho~atha mukUlakaH| dravantI nAmatashcitrA nyagrodhI mUShikAhvayA||3||

Commentary: tayoH paryAyAnAha- dantItyAdi||3||
(tathA mUShikaparNI cApyupacitrA ca shambarIpratyakshreNI sutashreNI dantI ra(ca)NDA ca kIrtitA )
tatra shlokAH- (dadhyAdiShu trayaH pa~jca priyAlAdyaistrayo rase| sneheShu vai trayo lehyAH ShaT cUrNe tveka eva ca||36||
ikShAvekastathA mudgamAMsAnAM ca rasAstrayaH| yavAgvAdau trayashcaiva ukta utkArikAvidhau||37||
ekashca modake madye caikastatkvAthatailake| cUrNamekaM punashcaiko modakaH pa~jca cAsave||38||
ekaH sauvIrake~athaiko yogaH syAttu tuShodake| ekA suraikaH kampille tathA pa~jca ghRute smRutAH )||39||
dantIdravantIkalpe~asmin proktAH ShoDashakAstrayaH| nAnAvidhAnAM yogAnAM bhaktidoShAmayAnprati||40||
trishataM pa~jcapa~jcAshadyogAnAM vamane smRutam| dve shate navakAH pa~jca yogAnAM tu virecane||41||
UrdhvAnulomabhAgAnAmityuktAni shatAni ShaT| prAdhAnyataH samAshritya dravyANi dasha pa~jca ca||42||
bhavanti cAtra- yaddhi yena pradhAnena dravyaM samupasRujyate| tatsa~jj~jakaH sa yogo vai bhavatIti vinishcayaH ||43||
phalAdInAM pradhAnAnAM guNabhUtAH surAdayaH| te hi tAnyanuvartante manujendramivetare||44||

viruddhavIryamapyeShAM pradhAnAnAmabAdhakam| adhikaM tulyavIrye hi kriyAsAmarthyamiShyate ||45||

Commentary: nanu ye tAvadanuguNA madanAdInAM te guNabhUtA bhavantu, viparItA ye dantyA ugratAyA mAMsarasAdayaH, tathA elAdayo hRudyatayA vamanapratikUlA madanAdInAM te kathaM guNabhUtA ityAha- viruddhavIryamapyeShAM pradhAnAnAmabAdhakamiti| viruddhavIryamapIti virecanarUpakAryAprabAdhakatayA guNabhUtamityarthaH| yadi hi viruddhavIryaM guNabhUtaM na syAt tadA madanAdInAM kAryaM pratihanyAt; viruddhasyApi ca kAryApratIghAto~avashyamabAdhakatvameveti bhAvaH| viparItasya kAryAbAdhanarUpaM sAhAyyamabhidhAya tulyavIryasya kAryamAha- adhikamityAdi| tulyavIrye saMyukte sati kriyAsAmarthyamadhikaM bhavatItyarthaH||45||

tayormUlAni sa~ggRuhya sthirANi bahalAni ca| hastidantaprakArANi shyAvatAmrANi buddhimAn||4||

Commentary: sthirANIti sArabhUtAni| bahalAnIti ghanatvakkAni| hastidantaprakArANIti antapUrvopacitAni| shyAvatAmrANIti yathAkrameNa dantyAH shyAvAni, dravantyAstAmrANi||4||

iShTavarNarasasparshagandhArthaM prati cAmayam| ato viruddhavIryANAM prayoga iti nishcitam||46||

Commentary: atha tulyavIryaM tAvat kriyAsAmarthyAdhikyakArakaM , tena tatsaMyogo~astu, viruddhavIryasaMyogAstu kimarthaM kriyanta ityAha- iShTetyAdi| iShTavarNatvAdisampattyartham; ato madanaphalAderviruddhavIryANAM prayogastathA viruddhAmayaM ca prati viruddhavIryANAM prayogo vamanavirecanahartavyAmayavisheShe yaugika ityarthaH||46||

bhUyashcaiShAM balAdhAnaM kAryaM svarasabhAvanaiH| subhAvitaM hyalpamapi dravyaM syAdbahukarmakRut||47||

Commentary: atha madanaphalAdInAM vIryotkarShAdike vidhimAha- bhUyashcaiShAmityAdi| tulyavIryairveti tulyavIryaiH svarasaiH kvAthairvA||47||-

alpasyApi mahArthatvaM prabhUtasyAlpakarmatAm||48||

Commentary: tulyAtulyavIryasaMyogAdikAryamAha- alpasyApItyAdi| tatrAlpamAtrasya samAnavIryasaMyogAnmahArthatvaM bhavati, tathA viruddhavIryasaMyogAt prabhUtamAtrasyApyalpakarmatA kartavyA| iyaM cAlpakarmakatA prabhUtabheShajasya dIptikAraNakoShThavyAptyAdiprayojanAt kriyate, tena na niShprayojanA| vishleShAdapyalpasya mahArthatvaM viruddhavIryavishleShAdboddhavyaM; samAdhikavishleShAttu prabhUtasyAlpakarmatA j~jeyA| evaM saMskArAdapi samAnAsamAnaguNAnmahArthatvamalpakarmatA vA yuktA| alpasyApi mahArthatvaM yathA snigdhe~alpamAtramapi shodhanaM bahudoShaharaNAya bhavati, tadviparyayeNa prabhUtasyAlpakarmatA udAharaNIyA||48||-
pradeshamAtrametAvaddraShTavyamiha ShaTshatam||49||
svabuddhyaivaM sahasrANi koTIrvA~api prakalpayet| bahudravyavikalpatvAdyogasa~gkhyA na vidyate||50||
tIkShNamadhyamRudUnAM tu teShAM shRuNuta lakShaNam| sukhaM kShipraM mahAvegamasaktaM yat pravartate||51||
nAtiglAnikaraM pAyau hRudaye na ca rukkaram| antarAshayamakShiNvan kRutsnaM doShaM nirasyati||52||
jalAgnikITairaspRuShTaM deshakAlaguNAnvitam||53||
IShanmAtrAdhikairyuktaM tulyavIryaiH subhAvitam| snehasvedopapannasya tIkShNatvaM yAti bheShajam||54||
ki~jcidebhirguNairhInaM pUrvoktairmAtrayA tathA| snigdhasvinnasya vA samya~gmadhyaM bhavati bheShajam||55||
mandavIryaM virUkShasya hInamAtraM tu bheShajam| atulyavIryaiH saMyuktaM mRudu syAnmandavegavat||56||

akRutsnadoShaharaNAdashuddhI te balIyasAm| madhyAvarabalAnAM tu prayojye siddhimicchatA||57||

Commentary: tIkShNAdishuddhiviShayAvacAraNArthamAha- akRutsnetyAdi| te madhyAlpashuddhI balIyasAM puruShANAM kRutsnadoShaM yasmAnna nirharataH, tasmAdashuddhI| akRutsnadoShaharaNAditi hetuvarNanena yadA balIyaso~alpadoShatayA kRutsnadoShaharaNakArike madhyAlpashuddhI bhavataH, tadA samyakshuddhI eva te iti sUcayati| madhyetyAdi madhyabale madhyA, avarabale tu mRudvI shuddhiH prayojyeti vAkyArthaH| tatra prayojyabhAShayA asamyakshuddhI api balApekShayA kartavye, madhyAvarau prati tayoH samyakshuddhikartRutvaM bhavatIti darshayati||57||

tIkShNo madhyo mRudurvyAdhiH sarvamadhyAlpalakShaNaH| tIkShNAdIni balAvekShI bheShajAnyeShu yojayet||58||

Commentary: vyAdhitIkShNatvAdivibhAgena vishuddhau tIkShNatvAdividhAnamAha- tIkShNo madhya ityAdi| sarvamadhyAlpalakShaNa iti yathAsa~gkhyaM tIkShNAdivyAdhilakShaNaM; sarvalakShaNaH tIkShNaH, madhyalakShaNaH madhyaH, alpalakShaNaH mRudurvyAdhiH| balAvekShItyanena vyAdhestIkShNatve yadi balaM mahadbhavati tadaiva tIkShNashodhanaM kartavyamiti darshayati||58||

deyaM tvanirhRute pUrvaM pIte pashcAt punaH punaH| bheShajaM vamanArthIyaM prAya ApittadarshanAt||59||

Commentary: vamane kriyamANe~avasthAvisheShakartavyamAha- deyamityAdi| evaM pIte vamane sati anirhRute doShe pashcAt punaH punarvamanArthIyaM bheShajaM deyam| ApittadarshanAditi yAvat pittaM na dRushyate tAvat punaH punarvamanaM deyam| vamanaM hi pittAntatayA samyagyuktaM bhavati| uktaM hi- “pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM” (si.a.1) iti||59||

balatraividhyamAlakShya doShANAmAturasya ca| punaH pradadyAdbhaiShajyaM sarvasho vA vivarjayet||60||

Commentary: punaH punarbhaiShajyaprayogasyApavAdaviShayamucitaviShayaM ca darshayannAha- baletyAdi| balavati doShe puruShe~api punaH prayojyaM bhaiShajyaM, hInabale doShe puruShe ca sarvasho vA bheShajaM shodhanArthaM vivarjayet, shodhanaM na kuryAdityarthaH| vAshabdena ca madhyamabale puruShe doShe ca na sarvathA vivarjanenaikavAraprayogaM shodhanasya darshayati||60||

nirhRute vA~api jIrNe vA doShanirharaNe budhaH| bheShaje~anyatprayu~jjIta prArthayansiddhimuttamAm||61||

Commentary: nirhRute ityAdau doShanirharaNe iti doShanirharaNakaprayojane bheShaje| nirhRute iti doShamanirhRutyaiva nirgate| jIrNe veti yena vamanamadhikRutyaitaducyate, tena vamanasya pAkakAlApratIkShaiveti ‘apakvaM vamanaM’ ityAdinA vaktavyam| jIrNasadRushatA ca vamanasya kShobhAkartRutayA pAkonmukhatayA ca j~jeyA| anyat prayu~jjIteti vamanArthabheShajapAnAnantaraM tadahareva dadyAt||61||

pippalImadhuliptAni svedayenmRutkushAntare| shoShayedAtape~agnyarkau hato hyeShAM vikAshitAm||5||

Commentary: svedayenmRutkushAntara iti pippalImadhukakalkAbhyAM parilipya kushaiH pariveShTya tato mRudAvaliptAni svedayet| agnisvedAtapashoShaNaphalamAha- agnyarkau hato hyeShAM vikAshitAmiti|- eShAM dantIdravantImUlAnAM vikAshitAlakShaNaM guNaM svedopashoShaNAbhyAmagnyarkau hataH; tena nAtidoShANi dantIdravantImUlAni syuriti bhAvaH||5||

apakvaM vamanaM doShaM pacyamAnaM virecanam| nirharedvamanasyAtaH pAkaM na pratipAlayet||62||

Commentary: vamanaprayogeShvayogapratIkArArthaM bheShajAntaraprayoge kartavye pAkakAlApratIkShaNaM sopapattikamAha-  apakvamityAdi||62||

pIte prasraMsane doShAnna nirhatya jarAM gate| vamite cauShadhe dhIraH pAyayedauShadhaM punaH||63||

Commentary: vamane AvashyakaM kartavyamabhidhAya virecane~apyAha- pIte prasraMsane ityAdi| vamite cauShadhe iti virecanauShadhamAtre vamite| punariti tadahareva||63||
dIptAgniM bahudoShaM tu dRuDhasnehaguNaM naram| duHshuddhaM tadaharbhuktaM shvobhUte pAyayet punaH||64||
durbalo bahudoShashca doShapAkena yo naraH| viricyate shanairbhojyairbhUyastamanusArayet ||65||

vamanaishca virekaishca vishuddhasyApramANataH | bhojanAntarapAnAbhyAM doShasheShaM shamaM nayet||66||

Commentary: vamanavirecanAbhyAM ki~jciccheShIkRutadoShapratIkArArthamAha- vamanaishcetyAdi| atra bahuvacanaM vegabahutvApekShayA| apramANata iti na niHsheSheNa| tatra bhojanaM pAcanaM yavAgvAdibhojanam| antarapAnaM kaShAyapAnam| ye tu ‘pramANataH’ iti paThanti, te samyakshuddhAvapi koShThopalepakadoShaprashamanArthaM bhojanAntarapAnaM vyAkhyAnayanti||66||

durbalaM shodhitaM pUrvamalpadoShaM ca mAnavam| aparij~jAtakoShThaM ca pAyayetauShadhaM mRudu||67||

Commentary: mRudushodhanopapAdanIyamAha- durbalamityAdi| shodhitaM pUrvamiti pUrvashodhitasya durbalatayA mRudu bheShajaM deyaM, tIkShNena hi balabhraMsho~atiyogashca syAt||67||

shreyo mRudvasakRutpItamalpabAdhaM niratyayam| na cAtitIkShNaM yat kShipraM janayetprANasaMshayam||68||

Commentary: mRudubheShajaprayogopapattimAha- shreya ityAdi| asakRutpItamiti asakRutpItamalpabAdhaM bhavatItyarthaH| shreya iti shreyastvaM cAsyAtivyApattikaratIkShNApekShayA j~jeyam| na cAtitIkShNamiti na cAtitIkShNaM durbalAdInAM deyaM; yasmAdatitIkShNaM durbalAdIn prApya kShipraM prANasaMshayaM janayet||68||

durbalo~api mahAdoSho virecyo bahusho~alpashaH| mRudubhirbheShajairdoShA hanyurhyenamanirhRutAH||69||

Commentary: durbale bahudoShe kartavyamAha- durbalo~apItyAdi| bahusho~alpasha iti punaH punaH stokamAtrayA| evambhUtAnAM mahAdoShanirharaNe hetumAha- doShA hanyurhyenamanirhRutA iti||69||
yasyordhvaM kaphasaMsRuShTaM pItaM yAtyAnulomikam| vamitaM kavalaiH shuddhaM la~gghitaM pAyayettu tam||70||
vibaddhe~alpe cirAddoShe sravatyuShNaM pibejjalam| tenAdhmAnaM tRuShA cchardirvibandhashcaiva shAmyati||71||
bheShajaM doSharuddhaM cennordhvaM nAdhaH pravartate| sodgAraM sA~ggashUlaM ca svedaM tatrAvacArayet||72||

suvirikte tu sodgAramAshvevauShadhamullikhet| atipravartanaM jIrNe sushItaiH stambhayedbhiShak||73||

Commentary: atiyogasha~gkAyAM kartavyamAha- suvirikte ityAdi| suvirikte iti samyakpramANena nirhRute ityarthaH| sodgAramiti udgAreNa pacyamAnAvasthA~abhihitA | etena samyagvirecane bhUte~api yadauShadhaM tiShThati tattaddine evollikhet| tasyApyauShadhaikadeshasyApacyamAnatAyAM virecanAtiyogaH syAditi darshayati||73||

kadAcicchleShmaNA ruddhaM tiShThatyurasi bheShajam| kShINe shleShmaNi sAyAhne rAtrau vA tatpravartate||74||

Commentary: kadAcidityAdinA virecanasyAvikramatve hetumAha| atra kartavyaM yadyapi noktaM, tathA~api shleShmaNA nirodhaM bheShajasya gauravAdibhirupalabhya rAtriparyantaM bheShajasyAyogapravRuttirupekShaNIyeti kartavyamUhanIyam| pravartate iti doShasahitaM bheShajaM pravartate||74||
rUkShAnAhArayorjIrNe viShTabhyordhvaM gate~api vA| vAyunA bheShaje tvanyat sasnehalavaNaM pibet||75||

tRuNmohabhramamUrcchAyAH syushcejjIryati bheShaje| pittaghnaM svAdu shItaM ca bheShajaM tatra shasyate||76||

Commentary: tRuNmohetyAdinA pittAvRutabheShajasya lakShaNaM cikitsitaM cAha| syurjIryatIti jIryati bheShaje tRuDAdayo bhavantItyarthaH||76||

tIkShNoShNAnyAshukArINi vikAshIni gurUNi ca| vilAyayanti doShau dvau mArutaM kopayanti ca||6||

Commentary: tIkShNoShNAnItyAdinA teShAM guNakathanam| doShau dvAviti pittashleShmANau||6||

lAlAhRullAsaviShTambhalomaharShAH kaphAvRute| bheShajaM tatra tIkShNoShNaM kaTvAdi kaphanuddhitam||77||

Commentary: lAletyAdinA kaphAvRutabheShajasya lakShaNaM cikitsitaM cAha||77||

susnigdhaM krUrakoShThaM ca la~gghayedavirecitam| tenAsya snehajaH shleShmA sa~ggashcaivopashAmyati||78||

Commentary: susnigdhamityAdau avirecitamiti IShadvirecitam| snehaja iti snehaprayogajanitaH shleShmA| sa~ggaH doShasa~ggaH| tena la~gghanena doShapAkAdeva prabalashleShmopashamo doShasa~ggopashamashca kriyata ityarthaH||78||
rUkSha-bahvanila-krUrakoShTha-vyAyAmashAlinAm | dIptAgnInAM ca bhaiShajyamaviricyaiva jIryati||79||
tebhyo bastiM purA dattvA pashcAddadyAdvirecanam| bastipravartitaM doShaM harecchIghraM virecanam||80||
rUkShAshanAH karmanityA ye narA dIptapAvakAH| teShAM doShAH kShayaM yAnti karmavAtAtapAgnibhiH ||81||
viruddhAdhyashanAjIrNadoShAnapi sahanti te| snehyAste mArutAdrakShyA nAvyAdhau tAn vishodhayet ||82||
nAtisnigdhasharIrAya dadyAt snehavirecanam| snehotkliShTasharIrAya rUkShaM dadyAdvirecanam||83||
evaM j~jAtvA vidhiM dhIro deshakAlapramANavit| virecanaM virecyebhyaH prayacchannAparAdhyati||84||
vibhraMsho viShavadyasya samyagyogo yathA~amRutam| kAleShvavashyaM peyaM ca tasmAdyatnAt prayojayet||85||

dravyapramANaM tu yaduktamasminmadhyeShu tat koShThavayobaleShu| tanmUlamAlambya bhavedvikalpyaM teShAM vikalpyo~abhyadhikonabhAvaH||86||

Commentary: samprati yadetacchodhanasya kvacit karShAdimAnamuktaM na tat sarvapuruShaviShayaM, kintu madhyeShu koShThavayobaleShu tanmAnaM j~jeyamiti darshayannAha- dravyetyAdi| tanmUlamAlambyeti uktapramANamanuktapramANAnumAnabIjaM kRutvA| vikalpArthamAha- teShAM vikalpyo~abhyadhikonabhAva iti; bheShajapramANasyAdhikabhAva UnabhAvashca vikalpya ityarthaH||86||
ShaD dhvaMshyastu marIciH syAt ShaNmarIcyastu sarShapaH| aShTau te sarShapA raktAstaNDulashcApi taddvayam||87||
dhAnyamASho bhavedeko dhAnyamAShadvayaM yavaH| aNDikA te tu catvArastAshcatasrastu mAShakaH||88||
hemashca dhAnyakashcokto bhavecchANastu te trayaH| shANau dvau dra~gkShaNaM vidyAt kolaM badarameva ca||89||
vidyAddvau dra~gkShaNau karShaM suvarNaM cAkShameva ca| biDAlapadakaM caiva picuM pANitalaM tathA||90||
tindukaM ca vijAnIyAt kavalagrahameva ca| dve suvarNe palArdhaM syAcchuktiraShTamikA tathA||91||
dve palArdhe palaM muShTiH praku~jco~atha caturthikA| bilvaM ShoDashikA cAmraM dve pale prasRutaM viduH||92||
aShTamAnaM tu vij~jeyaM kuDavau dvau tu mAnikA| palaM caturguNaM vidyAda~jjaliM kuDavaM tathA||93||
catvAraH kuDavAH prasthashcatuHprasthamathADhakam| pAtraM tadeva vij~jeyaM kaMsaH prasthAShTakaM tathA||94||
kaMsashcaturguNo droNashcArmaNaM nalvaNaM ca tat| sa eva kalashaH khyAto ghaTamunmAnameva ca||95||
droNastu dviguNaH shUrpo vij~jeyaH kumbha eva ca| goNIM shUrpadvayaM vidyAt khArIM bhAraM tathaiva ca||96||
dvAtriMshataM vijAnIyAdvAhaM shUrpANi buddhimAn| tulAM shatapalaM vidyAt parimANavishAradaH||97||
dviguNaM taddraveShviShTaM tathA sadyoddhRuteShu ca||98||
yaddhi mAnaM tulA proktA palaM vA tat prayojayet| anukte parimANe tu tulyaM mAnaM prakIrtitam||99||

dravakArye~api cAnukte sarvatra salilaM smRutam| yatashca pAdanirdeshashcaturbhAgastatashca saH||100||

Commentary: paribhAShAntaramAha-  dravakArye~apItyAdi| snehAdisAdhane dravasampAdye yatra dravaM noktaM tatra salilaM deyamityarthaH| yatashca pAdanirdeshashcaturbhAgastatashca sa iti asyArtho lokata eva siddhaH, tathA~api spaShTArthaM punarabhidhIyate||100||

jalasnehauShadhAnAM tu pramANaM yatra neritam | tatra syAdauShadhAt snehaH snehAttoyaM caturguNam||101||

Commentary: jalasnehauShadhAnAmityAdau auShadhAt snehashcaturguNa iti kalkAt snehashcaturguNaH| snehAttoyaM caturguNamiti toyashabdasya dravopalakShaNatvAddravaM caturguNamityarthaH| yatra tu vishiShTaM mAnaM jalAdInAmuktaM tatra tathaiva kartavyaM, “nirdiShTe tattadeva tu” (su.ci.a.31) itivacanAt||101||
dadhitakrasurAmaNDaiH piNDamakShasamaM tayoH| priyAlakolabadarapIlushIdhubhireva ca||7||
pibedgulmodarI doShairabhikhinnashca yo naraH| gomRugAjarasaiH pANDuH kRumikoShThI bhagandarI||8||
tayoH kalke kaShAye ca dashamUlarasAyute| kakShyAlajIvisarpeShu dAhe ca vipacedghRutam||9||
tailaM mehe ca gulme ca sodAvarte kaphAnile| catuHsnehaM shakRucchukravAtasa~ggAnilArtiShu||10||
rase dantyajashRu~ggayoshca guDakShaudraghRutAnvitaH| lehaH siddho virekArthe dAhasantApamehanut ||11||
vAtatarShe jvare paitte syAt sa evAjagandhayA| dantIdravantyormUlAni pacedAmalakIrase||12||
trIMstu tasya kaShAyasya bhAgau dvau phANitasya ca| tapte sarpiShi taile vA bharjayettatra cAvapet||13||
kalkaM dantIdravantyoshca shyAmAdInAM ca bhAgashaH| tatsiddhaM prAshayellehaM sukhaM tena viricyate||14||
snehapAkastridhA j~jeyo mRudurmadhyaH kharastathA| tulye kalkena niryAse bheShajAnAM mRuduH smRutaH||102||
saMyAva iva niryAse madhyo darvIM vimu~jcati| shIryamANe tu niryAse vartamAne kharastathA||103||

kharo~abhya~gge smRutaH pAko, mRudurnastaHkriyAsu ca| madhyapAkaM tu pAnArthe bastau ca viniyojayet||104||

Commentary: kharapAkAdiviShayamAha- khara ityAdi||104||

mAnaM ca dvividhaM prAhuH kAli~ggaM mAgadhaM tathA| kAli~ggAnmAgadhaM shreShThamevaM mAnavido viduH||105||

Commentary: kAli~ggamityAdikaM shlokaM kecit paThanti, taM cAnArShaM vadanti||105||
tatra shlokau- kalpArthaH shodhanaM sa~jj~jA pRuthagghetuH pravartane| deshAdInAM phalAdInAM guNA yogashatAni ShaT||106||
vikalpaheturnAmAni tIkShNamadhyAlpalakShaNam| vidhishcAvasthiko mAnaM snehapAkashca darshitaH||107||
pArisheShyAt dantIdravantIkalpo~abhidhIyate||1-2||

rase cetyAdai evamityanena pUrvoktalehatrayamatidishati| tayorityAdikashcaturthaH; tayoriti dantIdravantImUlayoH| asRuShTe iti vibaddhe| pATayitvetyAdinA pa~jcamaH| kalkenAlipya cAntareti dantIdravantIkalkena pATitekShukANDamadhye Alipya| mUlaM dantItyAdinA~aShTau kRutAkRutarasAnAha| atra lAvavartIrakAdayaH “lAvo vartIrakashcaiva vArtIkaH sakapi~jjalaH| cakorashcopacakrashca kakubho raktacarmakaH” (sU.a.27) iti granthenAShTAvuktAH; teShAM pratyekayogAdaShTau rasA bhavanti| tayorvA~apItyAdinA yavAgUjA~ggalarasayogaM mAShayUShayogaM cAha| evametairdravaiH pUrvayogaishca militvA dvitIyaH ShoDashako bhavet||15-19||

tatkaShAyAdityAdinA utkArikAyogaM modakayogaM cAha| tatkaShAyAditi dantIdravantIkaShAyAt| modakakaraNe~api tatkaShAyAttrayo bhAgA ityAdividhAnamanuvartate| tayoshcApi kaShAyeNa madyAnIti tRutIyaH| dantItyAdinA bhakShyayogashcaturthaH| dantIM dravantIM maricamityAdikaH pa~jcamaH| hemadugdhA svarNakShIrI| cUrNitamityantaM pibediti sambandhaH| palamityAdikaH ShaShThaH| harItakyAshca viMshatiriti AkRutimAnena| ayaM yogastantrAntare “agastyamodaka” iti khyAtaH| dantIdvipaletyAdikaH saptamaH| atra dantIdvipaladrAkShArdhaprasthayoH kvAthaH kartavyaH| dantIkalkamityAdiko~aShTamaH| shyAmetyAdiko navamaH| gauDa iti guDaprakRutikaH| lipte ityatra ‘ghaTe’ iti sheShaH| tathA dantIdravantyoshcetyAdiko dashamaH| tathetyanena pUrvayogoktapippalyAdighaTAvalepa atidishyate| ajashRu~ggyA vetyAdika ekAdashaH| tathA ajashRu~ggyA dantIdravantyoshca kaShAye gauDo~ariShTaH kArya iti sambandhaH| taccUrNetyAdiko dvAdashaH| atra tayordantIdravantyoshcUrNakvAthAbhyAM tathA mAShAmbunA kiNvakaraNapUrvakaM yA surA kRutA tatsurodbhavA madirA kartavyeti vAkyArthaH| ajagandhetyAdinA yogadvayamAha| tatrAjagandhAkaShAyeNa dantIdravantIbhyAM sauvIrakatuShodake kartavye| suretyAdinA~aparaM yogadvayamAha| lodhravacca tayoriti yathA lodhrakalpeShu “surA lodhrakaShAyeNa” ityAdinA surA proktA, tathA “kampillakakaShAyeNa” (ka.a.9) ityAdinA kampillakayoga uktaH, tathA tayorapi dantIdravantyorlodhrasthAne prakShepAt surAyogaH sauvIrakatuShodakavidhAnenaiva kartavyaH| iti tRutIyaH ShoDashakaH||20-35||
dantItyAdyadhyAyArthasa~ggraho vyakta eva| bhaktidoShAmayAn prati uktAnAM nAnAvidhAnAM yogAnAM trayaH ShoDashakAH proktA iti yojanA| bhaktiH icchA||36-40||

samprati kalpasthAnArthasa~ggrahamAha- trishatamityAdinA| trishataM pa~jcapa~jcAshaditi pa~jcapa~jcAshadyogAdhikaM trishatam| prAdhAnyataH samAshrityeti prAdhAnyena madanaphalAdIni dravantIparyantAni pa~jcadashadravyANi yogavyapadeshatayA~a~ashritya||41-42||

athAtra vamanAdiyogeShu dravyAntarANAM surAdInAmapi vidyamAnatvAt kathaM madanaphalAdyAshrayavattvenaivAmI yogA vyapadishyanta ityAha- yaddhItyAdi| yadyapi madanAdibhiH surAdibhishca militvaivAmI yogAH kriyante, tathA~api phalAdInAM prAdhAnyAt phalAdInAM yogA ete iti vyapadesho bhavati, na surAdiyogA iti| guNabhUtA iti apradhAnabhUtAH | surAdInAmaprAdhAnya eva hetumAha- te hi tAnyanuvartanta iti; surAdayo hi madanAdIni vamanavirecanaprakArakAryAnuguNatayA~apratIghAtena cAnuvartante||43-44||

samprati, uktaprayogaShaTshatabIjenAnuktaprayogakalpanaM darshayannAha- pradeshetyAdi| pradesha ekadeshaH| atha kasmAnniHsheSheNa naiva yogA abhidhIyanta ityAha- bahudravyetyAdi| asa~gkhyatvAnniHsheShAnabhidhAnamiti bhAvaH||49-50||

atha vamanavirecanAnAM tadupodghAtAcca nirUhANAM tIkShNamadhyamRudutAyA lakShaNaM kAraNaM cAha- tIkShNetyAdi| sukhamiti duHkhamakurvan| asaktamiti apratibaddham| nAtiglAnikaraM pAyAviti virecanasya nirUhasya ca, hRudaye na ca rukkaramiti tu vamanasya lakShaNaM j~jeyam| akShiNvanniti apIDayan| virecanamiti vamanaM virecanaM ca; uktaM hi- ubhayaM hi sharIradoShamalavirecanAdvirecanashabdaM labhate (ka.a.1) iti||51-52||-

jalAgnItyAdinA tIkShNatve kAraNamAha| deshakAlaguNAnvitamiti anuguNadeshakAlaprAptyotkRuShTaguNavat| snehasvedopapannasyeti susnigdhasvinnasya| ki~jcidityAdinA madhyasya vamanAdeH kAraNalakShaNe Aha| ebhirguNairityanena kShipratvAdi jalAgnikITAspRuShThatvAdi ca pratyavamRuShyate| mandavIryamityAdinA mRudUnAM lakShaNaM kAraNaM cAha| mandavegavaditi lakShaNaM, sheShaM tu kAraNam||53-56||

virecanena stokadoShaharaNe sati kartavyamAha- dIptAgnimityAdi| dRuDhasnehaguNamityanena snehalakShaNo guNo dehe yadA dRuDho nAsti tadA~asya bheShajaM na dAtavyaM, kintu sneha eva tAvat kartavyaH; asamyaksnigdhe hi punarapi kriyamANaM virecanamasamyagyogAyaiva bhavati| duHshuddhamiti ayogenAvishuddham | shvobhUte, dinAntare bhUte, kiMvA ‘shvo bhUyaH’ iti pAThaH| doShapAkeneti pakvadoShe~avibaddhatvAdbahutvAcca shanairviricyate| bhojyairiti anulomanaiH| atra ca pravRuttadoShe~atiyogabhayAnna punarvirecanaprayogamanujAnIte||64-65||
yasyetyAdAvAnulomikaM virecanamauShadhamUrdhvaM yAti yasya, taM pAyayet ‘virecanamauShadham’ iti sheShaH| kavalaiH shuddhamiti kavalaiH shodhitamukhakaNTham| teneti uShNajalena pItena||70-72||
rUkShetyAdAvayogAjjIrNe viShTabhya UrdhvaM gate vA bheShaje anyadvirecanaM sasnehalavaNaM dAtavyam|75||

rUkShAdInAM virecanaprayoge kramavisheShaM sopapattikamAha- rUkShetyAdi| bastiM purA dattvetyatra bastishabdena snehabastimicchanti, nirUhastu vAtakopakatayA tathA nirUhAnantaraM virecanasya niShiddhatvAdiha neShyate; uktaM hi “nirUhadAnAt pavanAdbhayaM syAt” (si.a.1) iti, tathA “naro viriktastu nirUhadAnaM vivarjayet saptadinAnyavashyam| shuddho nirUhena virecanaM tu” (si.a.1) iti; kintu bastishabdena nirUhaH snehabastishca gRuhyate; nirUhasya yadvAtakartRutvamuktaM tadekasyaiva snehabastirahitasyAbhyAsAt, utsargatastu vAtahantRutvaM “bastirvAtaharANAM” (sU.a.25) ityanenaivoktam| nirUhAnantaraM virecananiShedhastvautsargikaH, tena visheShavidhinA tasyApavAdo yujyata eva; ki~jca, iha bastyanantaraM yadvirecanaM vidhIyate tacca bastidAnAdUrdhvaM saptAhAnantarameva bhaviShyatIti na kashcidvirodhaH| pravartitamiti pravRuttyunmukhIkRutam||79-80||

rUkShAshanA ityAdinA snehyA api na vyAdhivyatirekeNa shodhanIyA ityAha| karmanityA iti nityaM vyAyAmAdikarmakarAH| viruddhAdhyashanAjIrNAn doShAn sahantIti viruddhAshanAdayo doSharUpA na teShAM vikAraM janayantItyarthaH; viruddhAdhyashanAdayashca doShajanakatayA doShashabdenocyante| nAvyAdhAviti avidyamAnasaMshodhanaikasAdhye vyAdhau na tAn vishodhayediti; anyatrApyukto~ayamarthaH “anIritAnAM doShANAmIraNaM na prashasyate| uparyupari saktAnAmashmanAmiva tADanam ” iti||81-82||

uktaM vidhimupasaMharannAha- evaM j~jAtvetyAdi| virecyebhya iti virecanArhebhyaH| vibhraMsha ityAdau yasyeti saMshodhanasya| nanu viShatulyavibhraMshametacchodhanaM tatkimanenAcaritenetyAha- kAleShvavashyaM peyaM ceti; saMshodhanasAdhyavyAdhAvavashyaM peyam| tena, avasthAvisheShe~avashyakartavyatayA na shodhanaM parihartuM pAryata iti bhAvaH||83-85||

pramANopodghAtAt sarvashAstravyavahriyamANaM pramANaM nirUpayannAha- ShaD dhvaMshya ityAdi| dhvaMshIM trasareNukaM vadanti; anye tu dhvaMshIM dhUlimAhuH| aShTau te sarShapA raktAstaNDulA ityatra raktA iti sarShapANAM visheShaNam| taddvayaM dhAnyamASha iti taNDuladvayaM dhAnyamASho bhavet| te tu catvAra iti yavacatvAraH; anye tu mAShAshcatvAraH aNDikA iti vadanti| trayo mAShakAH shANaH| atra mAne aShTacatvAriMshanmAShakamAnaM palaM bhavati, tadeva dasharaktimAnena catuHShaShTimAShakapalena tulyaM bhavati, yatashcaturviMshatidhAnyamAShairdasharaktikAstulyA bhavanti; tatashca dasharaktimAnAshcatuHShaShTimAShakAshcaturviMshatidhAnyamAShairguNitAH ShaTtriMshadadhikapa~jcadashashatadhAnyamAShA eva bhavanti; tena dasharaktikacatuHShaShTidhAnyamAShapalamAnena saha dvAtriMshaddhAnyamAShapramANAShTacatvAriMshanmAShakRutapalamAnasya tulyatA| sushrute~api “tatra dvAdasha dhAnyamAShAH svarNamAShakaH, te ca catuHShaShTiH palam” (su. ci. a. 31) iti vyavasthApitam| tena catuHShaShTimAShakA dvAdashadhAnyamAShairguNitAH santo~aShTaShaShTyadhikasaptashatadhAnyamAShA bhavanti; evaM dRuDhabaloktamAnAdardhena sushrutapalAdimAnaM bhavati; evaM sushrute~api pa~jcaraktikamASho bhavati| dRuDhabalamAnaM mAgadhaM, sushrutamAnaM kAli~ggamiti bruvate| jatUkarNe tu ShaDgu~jjako mAShaka uktaH||87-97||-

dviguNaM taddraveShviShTamityAdi| atra yadyapi sAmAnyenaiva dravasya dvaiguNyamuktaM, tathA~api tantrAntaradarshanAt kuDavAdAveva dravasya dvaiguNyam| uktaM hi “raktikAdiShu mAneShu yAvanna kuDavo bhavet| shuShke dravArdrayoshcaiva tulyaM mAnaM prakIrtitam” iti| jatUkarNe~apyuktaM “dviguNAH kuDavAdayo dravANAm” iti| ihApi suniShaNNakacA~ggerIghRute “triMshatpalAni prastho~atra vij~jeyo dvipalAdhikaH” (ci.a.14) iti vacanena dravadvaiguNyaM pAribhAShikaprasthe draDhayatA~a~acAryeNa raktikAdau dvaiguNyaparibhAShAvyabhicAraH sUcyata ityupapAditameva prAk| ArdradvaiguNyaM ca tasyaiva bhavati yasya dravyasya shuShkasya cArdrasya copayogaH sambhavati, yacca nityamArdramevopayujyate na tatra dvaiguNyam| uktaM hyanyatra-  “vAsAkuTajakUShmANDashatapatrIsahAmRutAH| prasAraNyashvagandhA ca shatapuShpAsahAcarAH|| nityamArdrAH prayoktavyA na teShAM dviguNaM bhavet” iti| anyeShAM ca dvaiguNyaM kRutvA mAnasya vAradvayagrahaNaM kartavyamityarthaH||98-99||

dadhItyAdinA saptabhirdravyaiH saptaprayogAnAha| shIdhushabdaH priyAlAdibhishcaturbhiH pRuthak sambadhyate| abhikhinna iti AkrAntaH| gomRugAjarasairityatrApi ‘piNDamakShasamaM tayoH’ ityanuvartate| atrApi gavAdirasaistribhistrayaH prayogA bhavanti| tayorityAdinA trIn snehayogAnAha| anayoH kalkakaShAyeNa dashamUlarasatulyabhAgena ghRutaM pacedvisarpAdiShu, tailaM tu pUrvavanmehAdiShu, catuH snehaM tu shakRucchukravAtasa~ggAdiShu| rase ityAdinA eko lehaH| vAtatarShe ityAdinA dvitIyaH| sa evAjagandhayetyanena pUrvoktalehe evAjashRu~ggIsthAne~ajagandhAdAnaM vishiShTaM khyApayati| dantItyAdinA tRutIyo lehaH| bhAgasha iti pratyekabhAgagrahaNena| evametadantaiH prayogairAdyaH ShoDashako bhavet||7-14||

snehapAkatraividhyalakShaNamAha- snehapAka ityAdi| tulye kalkena niryAsa iti prathamaprakShiptakalkatulyatAM gate pAkena niryAse sati| saMyAva iveti atra saMyAvashabdena samaghRutaguDagodhUmakaNikAkRutapiNDa ucyate| shIryamANe ityAdi kharapAkalakShaNam| shIryamANe iti avasIdati| vartamAne a~ggulipIDanAdvartitAM gacchati||102-103||

kalpArtha ityAdiH sthAnArthasa~ggrahaH| kalpArthaH “kalpArthaM bhedArthaM” (ka.a.1) ityAdinoktaH| shodhanasa~jj~jA- “ubhayaM vA sharIramalavirecanAt” (ka.a.1) ityAdinoktA| pRuthagghetuH pravartane iti “tatroShNatIkShNavikAshI” (ka.a.1) ityAdinoktaH| deshAdInAM guNAH “tatra deshastu” (ka.a.1) ityAdinoktAH| phalAdInAM guNAH madanaphalAdikalpa evoktAH| yogashatAni ShaDiti “trishataM pa~jcapa~jcAshat” ityAdinoktam| vikalpahetuH “upabhogasukhArthaM” (ka.a.1) ityAdinA prathamAdhyAye proktaH| nAmAni madanaphalAdInAmeva, tAni ca pratyadhyAyamuktAni| tIkShNamadhyAlpalakShaNamiti “sukhaM kShipraM mahAvegaM” (ka.a.12) ityAdinoktam| vidhishcAvasthikaH “deyaM hyanirgate pUrvaM” (ka.a.12) ityAdinoktaH| sheShaM sugamam||106-107||
athAto madanakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

gRuhItvA cAnurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnyAgAreShU prAgudagdvAreShu nivAtapravAtaikadesheShu nityapuShpopahArabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhUma-rajo-mUShaka-catuShpadAmanabhigamanIyAni svavacchannAni shikyeShvAsajya sthApayet||11||

Commentary: bhAjanasampadamAha- gRuhItvetyAdi| anurUpaguNavadbhAjanasthAnIti anurUpaguNavattA ca bhAjanasya bheShajasamAnaguNatayaiva| svavacchannAnIti samyakpihitAni||11||

tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjIta surA-sauvIraka-tuShodaka-maireya-medaka-dhAnyAmla -phalAmla-dadhyamlAdibhirvAte, mRudvIkAmalaka -madhu-madhuka-parUShaka-phANitakShIrAdibhiH pitte, shleShmaNi tu madhu-mUtra-kaShAyAdibhirbhAvitAnyAloDitAni ca; ityuddeshaH| taM vistareNa dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdIni pravibhajya vyAkhyAsyAmaH||12||

Commentary: sa~gkShepeNa madanaphalAdInAM vAtAdibhedena bhAvanAloDanadravyANyAha- tAni ca yathAdoShaM prayu~jjItetyAdi| dhAnyAmlaM kA~jjikaM, phalAmlaM dADimarasAdi| shleShmaNItyAdau kaShAyashabdena shleShmaharadravyakvAtho~abhipretaH| uddesha iti sa~gkShepAbhidhAnamityarthaH| dravya-deha-doSha-sAtmyAdInItyatra Adishabdena prakRutibalAdInAM grahaNam||12||

vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate, anapAyitvAt| tAni vasantagrIShmayorantare puShyAshvayugbhyAM mRugashirasA vA gRuhNIyAnmaitre muhUrte| yAni pakvAnyakANAnyaharitAni pANDUnyakrimINyapUtInyajantujagdhAnyahrasvAni; tAni pramRujya , kushapuTe baddhvA, gomayenAlipya, yavatu(bu)ShamAShashAlikulatthamudgapalAnAmanyatame nidadhyAdaShTarAtram| ata UrdhvaM mRudUbhUtAni madhviShTagandhAnyuddhRutya shoShayet| sushuShkANAM phalapippalIruddharet | tAsAM ghRutadadhimadhupalalavimRuditAnAM punaH shuShkANAM navaM kalashaM supramRuShTavAlukamarajaskamAkaNThaM pUrayitvA svavacchannaM svanuguptaM shikyeShvAsajya samyak sthApayet||13||

Commentary: vamanadravyANAmityAdinA madanaphalasya prAdhAnyopadarshanapUrvakaM prayogavidhimAha| anapAyitvAditi vamanadravyAntarApekShayA~alpavyApattikatvAt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grIShmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinAnyeva madhyo j~jeyaH| ashvayuk ashvinI| maitre muhUrta iti shivabhujagamitrAdInAM madhye mitradevatAke, evaM maitre muhUrte| palAnAmiti rAshInAm| madhuvadiShTagandho yeShAM tAni, yAni madhviShTagandhAni bhavanti tAni grAhyANIti darshayati| phalapippalIriti madanaphalamadhyagatAni pippalIsaMsthAnAni bIjAni| tAsAmityAdi pUraNavAcakashabdayogAt karaNe ShaShThI| svanuguptamiti kRutarakShAvidhAnam||13||

atha cchardanIyamAturaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannaM shvashchardayitavyamiti grAmyAnUpaudakamAMsarasa-kShIra-dadhi-mASha-tila-shAkAdibhiH samutkleshitashleShmANaM vyuShitaM jIrNAhAraM pUrvAhNe kRutabalihomama~ggalaprAyashcittaM nirannamanatisnigdhaM yavAgvA ghRutamAtrAM pItavantaM, tAsAM phalapippalInAmantarnakhamuShTiM yAvadvA sAdhu manyeta jarjarIkRutya yaShTimadhukaShAyeNa kovidAra-karbudAra-nIpa-vidula-bimbI-shaNapuShpI-sadApuShpI-pratyakpuShpI-kaShAyANAmanyatamena vA rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtaM madhusaindhavayuktaM sukhoShNaM kRutvA pUrNaM sharAvaM mantreNAnenAbhimantrayet- ‘OM brahmadakShAshvirudrendrabhUcandrArkAnilAnalAH| RuShayaH sauShadhigrAmA bhUtasa~gghAshca pAntu te| rasAyanamivarShINAM devAnAmamRutaM yathA| sudhevottamanAgAnAM bhaiShajyamidamastu te’| ityevamabhimantryoda~gmukhaM prA~gmukhaM vA~a~aturaM pAyayecchleShmajvaragulmapratishyAyArtaM visheSheNa punaH punarApittAgamanAt, tena sAdhu vamati; hInavegaM tu pippalyAmalaka-sarShapa-vacAkalkalavaNoShNodakaiH punaH punaH pravartayedApittadarshanAt| ityeSha sarvashchardanayogavidhiH||14||

Commentary: dvyahaM tryahaM vA snehasvedopapannamityanena abhya~gge kriyamANe snehasahacaritasvedopapAdanaM dvyahaM tryahaM vA vidhIyate, “tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya iShTaH” (si.a.1) ityanena pAnaprayujyamAnasnehasya saptarAtraM trirAtraM vA prakarSha ucyate iti na virodhaH| etaccAbhya~ggasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraNaM pAnasnehAntadivasamArabhya kriyate, tena snehapAnavishrAmadinena samaM dvyahatryahapUraNamabhya~ggasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapAnAcca yadvishrAmadinam, “ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet” (sU.a.13) ityanenoktaM, tathaivehApi| kaphotkleshakAribhojanamAha- shvashchardayitavyamityAdinA| shva iti parasminnahni| vyuShitamiti rAtrimatikrAntam| nirannamiti padacchedaH| anatisnigdhamityAdinA vamanadina eva ghRutamAtrAyuktayavAgUpAnapUrvakaM vamanamanatisnigdhapuruShaviShayaM brUte| anye tu pUrvadina evAnatisnigdhasya ghRutamAtrAM pItavata eva yavAgvAH pAnamAhuH, “peshalairvividhairannairdoShAnutkleshya dehinaH| snigdhasvinnAya vamanaM dattaM samyak pravartate|| athAparedyuH pUrvAhNe sAdhAraNe kAle vamanadravyakaShAyakalkacUrNasnehAnAmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityAdi sushrutokteH| antarnakhamuShTimiti antarIkRutanakhamuShTiparimANam| yAvadvA sAdhu manyetetyanena mAtrAyA baladoShAdibhedenAsthiratvamityAha| yaShTImadhukasya kovidArAdiShu vicchedapATha uttaraprayogeShu kovidArAderyaShTImadhuvirahitasya grahaNArthaH| kovidAraH svanAmakhyAtaH, sa sharadi puShpati; karbudArastu kA~jcanAraH, sa vasante puShpati; nIpaH kadambaH, vidulaH vetasaH, shaNapuShpI ghaNTAravA, sadApuShpI arkapuShpikA, pratyakpuShpI apAmArgaH| rAtrimuShitaM vimRudya pUtamiti shRutakaShAyAt kaShAyAntaropadarshakaM pakShAntaraM; kiMvA, kaShAyapAna eva shItakaShAyavidhAnamihocyate| pUrNaM sharAvamiti ma~ggalArthaM pUrNakumbhavat| punaH punariti yAvat pittAgamanaM na bhavati tAvat punaH punaH kaShAyaM pibedityarthaH| anyatrApyuktaM- “pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM” (si.a.1) ityAdi| vamanAyogakArakahInavegapravRuttipratikArArthamAha- hInavegamityAdi||14||

sarveShu tu madhusaindhavaM kaphavilayanacchedArthaM vamaneShu vidadhyAt| na coShNavirodho madhunashchardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyAgamanAddoShanirharaNAcca||15||

Commentary: yadyapi ca ghreyAdivamanayogeShu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathA~api ‘sarveShu’ iti padaM bAhulyArtham| vamanArthakaShAye uShNe madhuprakShepo virodhitvAnna yujyate, uktaM hi- “madhUShNamuShNArtamathavA” (sU.a.27) ityAdi, evamAsha~gkya samAdhAnamAha na coShNavirodho madhuna ityAdi| avipakvapratyAgamanAdityanena pacyamAnaM madhUShNayuktaM virudhyeteti darshayati| doShanirharaNAcceti madhUShNaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uShNe iShyate, tasya doShanirharaNAdeva na virodho bhavatIti darshayati| evaM bastiprayoge~api madhuna uShNAvirodho varNanIyaH| etena yaShTImadhvAdinavadravyakRutairnavabhiH kaShAyairnavayogAH||15||

phalapippalInAM dvau dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH srAvayet, tena rasena tRutIyaM bhAgaM piShTvA mAtrAM harItakIbhirbibhItakairAmalairvA tulyAM vartayet, tAsAmekAM dve vA pUrvoktAnAM kaShAyANAmanyatamasyA~jjalimAtreNa vimRudya balavacchleShmaprasekagranthijvarodarAruciShu pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||16||

Commentary: phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgAvityAdau phalapippalInAM bhAgatrayaM kartavyaM; tatra bhAgadvayaM ShaDguNena kovidArAdikaShAyeNa kShAraparisrAvaNavidhivadekaviMshativArAn parisrAvaNIyam| kovidArAdInAM cAShTAnAmaShTau kaShAyAH pRuthak parisrAvaNe prayoktavyAH| yena ca kaShAyeNa phalapippalIbhAgadvayaM parisrAvya haritakyAdiparimANA mAtrA tRutIyabhAgaphalapippalIkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaShAyeNa mAtrAyogAH ; evamaShTau harItakyAdimAtrayA nirdiShTAH phalapippalIyogA bhavanti| mAtrAvikalpashca doShabalAdivikalpakRuto j~jeyaH| samAnaM pUrveNeti pUrvayogavadiha snehasvedAbhimantraNAdividhAnaM kartavyamityarthaH| evamanyatrApi pUrvavacchabdArtho j~jeyaH||16||

phalapippalIkShIraM, tena vA kShIrayavAgUmadhobhAge raktapitte hRuddAhe ca; tajjasya vA dadhna uttarakaM kaphaccharditamakaprasekeShu ; tasya vA payasaH shItasya santAnikA~jjaliM pitte prakupite uraHkaNThahRudaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samAnaM pUrveNa||17||

Commentary: phalapippalyA kShIrapAkavidhinA sAdhitaM kShIraM phalapippalIkShIram; ayameko yogaH| teneti phalapippalIsAdhitakShIreNa| tajjasyeti phalapippalIkShIrajAtasya dadhnaH| uttarakamiti saram| santAnikA kShIroparisthaH styAno bhAgaH||17||

phalapippalIshRutakShIrAnnavanItamutpannaM phalAdikalkakaShAyasiddhaM kaphAbhibhUtAgniM vishuShyaddehaM ca mAtrayA pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||18||

Commentary: phalAdIni phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAni ShaT| ete kShIrayogacatuShTayena ghRutayogena ca samaM pa~jca yogA adhyAyasa~ggrahe vaktavyA||18||

phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNa triHsaptakRutvaH suparibhAvitena puShparajaHprakAshena cUrNena sarasi sa~jjAtaM bRuhatsaroruhaM sAyAhne~avacUrNayet, tadrAtrivyuShitaM prabhAte punaravacUrNitamuddhRutya haridrAkRusarakShIrayavAgUnAmanyatamaM saindhavaguDaphANitayuktamAkaNThaM pItavantamAghrApayet sukumAramutkliShTapittakaphamauShadhadveShiNamiti samAnaM pUrveNa||19||

Commentary: phalapippalInAM phalAdikaShAyeNetyAdinA ekaM ghreyayogamAha| puShparajaHprakAsheneti puShpadhUlisadRushena| haridrAbhidhAnaH kRusharo haridrAkRusharaH||19||

phalapippalInAM bhallAtakavidhiparisrutaM svarasaM paktvA phANitIbhUtamAtantulIbhAvAllehayet; AtapashuShkaM vA cUrNIkRutaM jImUtakAdikaShAyeNa pitte kaphasthAnagate pAyayediti samAnaM pUrveNa||20||

Commentary: bhallAtakavidhiparisrutamiti rasAyanoktabhallAtakasnehagrahaNavidhAnena parisrutaH svaraso grAhyaH| phANitayogo~ayamekaH| AtapashuShkaM vetyAdinA cUrNayogo~apyekaH||20||

phalapippalIcUrNAni pUrvavat phalAdInAM ShaNNAmanyatamakaShAyasrutAni vartikriyAH phalAdikaShAyopasarjanAH peyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||21||

Commentary: phalapippalIcUrNAnItyAdau phalAdiShaTkaShAyabhedena kRutatvAt ShaD vartiprayogA j~jeyAH| vartikriyAyAM caturguNena kvAthena pAkAdvartyAkAratA kartavyA| atrApi ca tathA lehAdau ca sAmAnyoktena madhuprakShepo yuktaH; taM caike madhunaH pAkavirodhAnnAnumanyante||21||

atha khalu vamanavirecanArthaM vamanavirecanadravyANAM sukhopabhogatamaiH sahAnyairdravyairvividhaiH kalpanArthaM bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyarthaH , tadyogAnAM ca kriyAvidheH sukhopAyasya samyagupakalpanArthaM kalpasthAnamupadekShyAmo~agnivesha!||3||

Commentary: kalpArthaM darshayannAha- atha khalvityAdi| athashabdaH prAkprastute| khalushabdaH prakAshane| vamanavirecanArthamiti vamananimittaM virecananimittaM ca| vamanavirecanadravyANAmiti madanaphalAditrivRudAdInAm| anyairiti surAsauvIrakAdyaiH kovidArAdiprakAraishca| anyairityasya visheShaNaM- sukhopabhogatamairiti| atra sukhAyopabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, na tadAtvasukha upabhogo yeShAM te sukhopabhogAH, tathAhi tadAtve~asukhopabhogAnAM kovidArAdInAmagrahaNaM syAt| kalpanArthamiti padasya kriyayA sambandhamadarshayitvaiva tadvyAkhyAnapratyayanArthaM vyAkaroti bhedArthaM vibhAgArthaM cetyartha iti; tatra bhedArthamiti vamanavirecanadravyaprayogabhedArthaM, te ca prayogabhedAH “trayastriMshadyogashataM praNItaM phaleShu” (sU.a.4) ityAdikAH; vibhAgArthamiti atra ‘phalapippalInAM dvau bhAgau kovidArAdikaShAyeNa’, ityAdivakShyamANadravyavibhAgArtham| upodghAtaM samApya prakRutamAha- tadyogAnAmiti; vamanavirecanadravyaprayogANam| kriyAyA itikartavyatAyA vidhiH kriyAvidhiH, svarasAdirUpatayA karaNAnIti yAvat; tasya kriyAvidhervisheShaNaM- sukhopAyasyeti; sukhArthaH sukho vA upAyo yasya sa sukhopAyaH, tasya samyagupakalpanArthamiti samyagupadeshArtham||3||

phalapippalInAmAragvadha -vRukShaka-svAdukaNTaka-pAThA-pATalA-shAr~ggeShTA-mUrvA-saptaparNa-naktamAla-picumarda-paTola-suShavI-guDUcI-somavalka-dvIpikAnAM pippalI-pippalImUla-hastipippalI-citraka-shRu~ggaverANAM cAnyatamakaShAyeNa siddho leha iti samAnaM pUrveNa||22||

Commentary: phalapippalInAmAragvadhetyAdinA AragvadhAdiviMshatidravyakvAthabhedena kRutatvAdviMshatirlehA j~jeyAH| vRukShakaH kuTajaH, svAdukaNTakaH vika~gkataH, shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA, suShavI kAravellakaM, dvIpikA hiMsrA, ‘kaNTakArI’ ityanye||22||

phalapippalIShvelA-hareNukA-shatapuShpA-kustumburu-tagara-kuShTha-tvak-coraka-marubakAguru-guggulvelavAluka-shrIveShTaka-paripelava-mAMsI-shaileyaka-sthauNeyaka-sarala-pArAvatapadyashokarohiNInAM viMshateranyatamasya kaShAyeNa sAdhitotkArikA utkArikAkalpena, modakA vA modakakalpena, yathAdoSharogabhakti prayojyA iti samAnaM pUrveNa||23||

Commentary: phalapippalIShvityAdinotkArikA modakAshca pratyekaM viMshatiH| corakaH gandhadravyaM svanAmakhyAtaM, paripelavaM kaivartamustakaM, sthauNeyakaH granthiparNakaM, pArAvatapadI jyotiShmatI, ashokarohiNI ashokasadRushapatrA latA, ‘kaTurohiNI’ ityanye| kecidatra sthauNeyakaM parityajyApAkIpAdyA viMshatiM pUrayanti, apAkIpAdI svanAmakhyAtA| utkArikAkalpeneti sUdashAstroktotkArikAvidhAnena||23||
phalapippalIsvarasakaShAyaparibhAvitAni tilashAlitaNDulapiShTAni tatkaShAyopasarjanAni shaShkulIkalpena vA shaShkulyaH, pUpakalpena vA pUpAH iti samAnaM pUrveNa||24||

etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuTheraka-kANDIra-kAlamAlaka-parNAsaka-kShavaka-phaNijjhaka-gRu~jjana-kAsamarda-bhRu~ggarAjAnAM poTekShuvAlikA-kAla~gkataka-daNDairakANAM cAnyatamasya kaShAyeNa kArayet||25||

tathA badaraShADava-rAga-leha-modakotkArikA-tarpaNa-pAnaka-mAMsarasa-yUSha-madyAnAM madanaphalAnyanyatamenopasRujya yathAdoSharogabhakti dadyAt; taiH sAdhu vamatIti||26||

Commentary: tathA badaraShADavetyAdinA dasha yogAH| badarakRutaH ShADavo badaraShADavaH||26||

madanaH karahATashca rAThaH piNDItakaH phalam| shvasanashceti paryAyairucyate tasya kalpanA||27||

Commentary: madanasya vyavahArArthaM paryAyAnAha- madanaH karahATashcetyAdi| tasya kalpaneti ya evambhUtaiH paryAyairvyAkhyAtastasyeyaM kalpanA| asya ca paryAyAbhidhAnaM bhUriprayogeShu vihitatvenAbhyarhitatvAjj~jeyam| evamanyatrApi paryAyAbhidhAne prayojanaM varNanIyam||27||
tatra shlokAH- nava yogAH kaShAyeShu, mAtrAsvaShTau , payoghRute| pa~jca, phANitacUrNe dvau ghreye, vartikriyAsu ShaT||28||
viMshatirviMshatirlehamodakotkArikAsu ca| shaShkulIpUpayoshcoktA yogAH ShoDasha ShoDasha||29||
dashAnye ShADavAdyeShu trayastriMshadidaM shatam| yogAnAM vidhivaddiShTaM phalakalpe maharShiNA||30||

tatra doShaharaNamUrdhvabhAgaM vamanasa~jj~jakam, adhobhAgaM virecanasa~jj~jakam; ubhayaM vA sharIramalavirecanAdvirecanasa~jj~jAM labhate||4||

Commentary: vamanavirecanashabdArthaM vibhajate- tatretyAdi| UrdhvaM mukhena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti UrdhvabhAgam| adho gudena doShanirharaNaM bhajata iti adhobhAgam| vamanavirecanayorapi kadAcidvirecanasa~jj~jAM ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAM darshayannAha- ubhayamapItyAdi| na caivaM sati vamanavirecanavannirUhe~api virecanasa~jj~jAprasaktirudbhAvanIyA , yataH pa~gkajashabdavadiyaM virecanasa~jj~jA vamanavirecanayoreva yogarUDhyA vartate||4||

tatroShNa-tIkShNa-sUkShma-vyavAyi-vikAshInyauShadhAni svavIryeNa hRudayamupetya dhamanIranusRutya sthUlANusrotobhyaH kevalaM sharIragataM doShasa~gghAtamAgneyatvAd viShyandayanti, taikShNyAd vicchindanti, sa vicchinnaH pariplavan snehabhAvite kAye snehAktabhAjanasthamiva kShaudramasajjannaNupravaNabhAvAdAmAshayamAgamyodAnapraNunno~agnivAyvAtmakatvAdUrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAdauShadhasyordhvamutkShipyate, salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdadhobhAgaprabhAvAccauShadhasyAdhaH pravartate, ubhayatashcobhayaguNatvAt| iti lakShaNoddeshaH||5||

Commentary: samprati dvayorapi vamanavirecanadravyayoH sAdhAraNoShNatIkShNatvAdiguNayogakRutadoShaviShyandanAdisAdhAraNakAryadarshanapUrvakamagnivAyvAtmakatvAdivishiShTadharmayogakRutaM vishiShTaM ca kAryaM vamanavirecanarUpaM darshayannAha- tatroShNetyAdi| uShNamiti uShNavIryam| svavIryeNeti svaprabhAveNa| dhamanIranusRutyeti sakaladehagatA dhamanIranusRutya; sakaladehagatadhamanyanusaraNaM ca vIryeNa j~jeyaM, na sAkShAt| AgneyatvAdviShyandayantIti vilInaM kurvanti| vicchindanti chinnaM kurvanti| pariplavan itastato gacchan| asajjanniti na kvacidapi sa~ggaM gacchan| aNupravaNabhAvAditi aNutvAt pravaNabhAvAcca; pravaNatvamiha koShThagamanonmukhatvam, aNutvaM ca aNumArgasa~jcAritvam| udAnapraNunna iti udAnavAyupreritaH| agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi agnivAyUtkarShavattvAt| UrdhvabhAgaprabhAvAditi UrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvarUpaprabhAvAt| evaM salilapRuthivyAtmakatvamapi vyAkhyeyam| ubhayatashceti Urdhvamadhashca kShipyata ityarthaH| ubhayaguNatvAditi agnivAyvAtmakatvAt salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAdUrdhvAdhobhAgaprabhAvAccetyarthaH| iti lakShaNoddesha iti anantaragranthena vamanavirecanadravyasvarUpAbhidhAnaM kRutamityarthaH| atra ca prakaraNe sAmAnyenaiva vamanavirecanadravyANAm ‘AgneyatvAdviShyandayanti’ ityanenAgneyatvaM pratipAditaM; punashca visheSheNa ‘agnivAyvAtmakatvAt’ iti padena vamanadravyasyAgnyAtmakatvaM pratipAdyate; tena, sAmAnye visheShe ca vamanadravyANAmAgneyatvapratipAdanAt prakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati; virecanadravyANAM tu sAmAnyoktAgneyatvasambandhAd visheShaguNakathanaprastAve ca salilapRuthivyAtmakatvAbhidhAnAdvamanadravyApekShayA~apakRuShTamAgneyatvaM bhavati| tathAhi sushrute~api vamanavirecanayorapyAgneyatvamuktaM- “saratva-saukShmya-taikShNyauShNya-vikAshitvairvirecanam| vamanaM ca hareddoShAn prakRutyA gatamanyathA” (su.ci.a.33) ityanena| yaccAtrocyate-vamanaM yadyUrdhvabhAgaharatvaprabhAvAdUrdhvayati, tadA~agnivAyvAtmakatvAditi hetuvarNanaM na yujyate; yataH, yat sopapattikaM kAryaM na bhavati tat prabhAvakRutamiti vyapadishyate; uktaM hi- “prabhAvo~acintya ucyate” (sU.a.26) iti| tanna, yataH prabhAvasyaiveha vamanakArye vAyvagnyAtmakaguNatayA vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM heturupadRu(di)shyate, na tu vAyvagnyAtmakatvaM svatantro vamanahetuH; tathAhi sati yadanyadapi vAyvagnyAtmakamUrdhvabhAgadoShaharatvaprabhAvarahitaM, tadapi vamanakaraM syAt; yathA- kaTukarase dravye tat syAt; tasmAt prabhAvaguNatayaiva hetuvarNanam| evaM virecanadravye~api pUrvapakShasiddhAntAvanusartavyau||5||

tatra phala-jImUtakekShvAku-dhAmArgava-kuTaja-kRutavedhanAnAM, shyAmA-trivRuccatura~ggula-tilvaka-mahAvRukSha-saptalA-sha~gkhinI-dantI-dravantInAM ca, nAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAsvAda-rasa-vIrya-vipAka-prabhAvagrahaNAd deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcca , vicitragandha-varNa-rasa-sparshAnAmupayogasukhArthamasa~gkhyeyasaMyogAnAmapi ca satAM dravyANAM vikalpamArgopadarshanArthaM ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAmaH||6||

Commentary: samprati kalpasthAnavaktavyatayA ShaDvirecanaprayogashatAnyanatisa~gkShepavistaraprayogopadarshanapUrvakaM pratijAnIte- tatra phaletyAdinA ShaDvirecanayogashatAni vyAkhyAsyAma ityantena| tatra kRutavedhanAntAnAM vicchedapAThena vamanaprayogaprayojyatvaM, shyAmAdInAM virecanaprayogaprayojyatvaM ca darshayati| atraiva vamane virecane caikaikeShAM punarvastUnAM madanaphalAdInAM shyAmAdInAM ca bahavaH prayogA abhidhIyante, na punarekaikameva dravyaM vamanakArakaM virecanakArakaM vA; svalpasa~gkhyAprayogeNa grahaNasukhatA vamanavirecanayogasya bhavati, kAryaM ca sidhyatItyAsha~gkyAha- nAnAvidhetyAdi yAvadrogAvasthAdInAM nAnAprabhAvavattvAcceti| asyArthaH- yasmAnnAnAvidhadeshakAlasambhavAH, nAnAvidhAsvAdAH, nAnAvidhavIryAH, nAnAvidhavipAkAH, nAnAvidhaprabhAvAshca madanaphalAdikA oShadhyaH, tathA tatsaMskArakAH kovidArAdikA oShadhya upalabhyante; puruShAshca deha-doSha-prakRuti-vayo-balAgni-bhakti-sAtmya-rogAvasthAbhinnA nAnAvidhA dRushyante; tena naikaM dravyaM sarvasmin dehadoShAdau yaugikaM, sarvatra kAle vA prApyate sarvatra deshe vA; tasmAddehadoShAdinA bhedavati puruShe bahUnyeva dravyANi bahubhishca prayogairupakalpitAni yathAyogyatayA yathAprApti ca prayoktuM shakyante; ato bahunAmeva madanAdidravyANAM bahuprakAraprayogANAmupanyAso yukta iti bhAvaH| grahaNAt upalambhAt| deho nAnA sthUlakRushAdibhedena, bhaktiH icchA, avasthAshabdeneha rogAvasthaiva grAhyA, Adishabdeneha sattvAhArayorgrahaNam| bhUrivirecanaprayogopadarshanaprayojanAntaramapyAha- vicitretyAdi| nAnAvidhagandha-varNa-rasatayA prayoge tatkAlamuttarakAlaM ca sukhArthamityarthaH| atha kiM prabhedAnmadanaphalAdInAM ShaTprayogashatAni bhavanti, yenAdhikAH prayogA nAbhidhIyanta ityAsha~gkyAha- asa~gkhyeyetyAdi| vikalpamArgopadarshanArthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanAsamarthAn bhiShajaH prati etat ShaTprayogashatopadarshanaM kartavyAdhikaprayogakalpanAmArgopadarshakaM, tenApare~apyatra prayogAH kalpanIyAH; granthe niHsheShaprayogAnabhidhAnaM prayogANAmasa~gkhyeyatvenAshakyatvAdeva| anativistareNa ShaTprayogashatAbhidhAnaM mandabuddhisaMvyavahArArthamiti bhAvaH| uktaM hyanyatra-  “etAvanto hyalamalpabuddhInAM vyavahArAya, buddhimatAM ca svAlakShaNyAnumAnayuktikushalAnAmanuktArthaj~jAnAya” (sU.a.4) iti||6||

tAni tu dravyANi desha-kAla-guNa-bhAjana-sampadvIryabalAdhAnAt kriyAsamarthatamAni bhavanti||7||

Commentary: samprati vamanavirecanadravyANAM deshAdisampattyA guNotkarShaM darshayannAha- tAnItyAdi| deshAdibhishcaturbhiH sampacchabdaH pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bhAjanaM bheShajasthApanasthAnam| vIryasya balaM vIryAdhikatvameva||7||

trividhaH khalu deshaH- jA~ggalaH, AnUpaH, sAdhAraNashceti| tatra jA~ggalaH paryAkAshabhUyiShThaH, tarubhirapi ca kadara-khadirAsanAshvakarNa-dhava-tinisha-shallakI-sAla-somavalka-badarI-tindukAshvattha-vaTAmalakIvanagahanaH, anekashamI-kakubha-shiMshapAprAyaH, sthirashuShkapavanabalavidhUyamAnapranRutyattaruNaviTapaH, pratatamRugatRuShNikopagUDhatanukharaparuShasikatAsharkarAbahulaH, lAvatittiricakorAnucaritabhUmibhAgaH, vAtapittabahulaH, sthirakaThinamanuShyaprAyo j~jeyaH, athAnUpo hintAlatamAlanArikelakadalIvanagahanaH, saritsamudraparyantaprAyaH, shishirapavanabahulaH, va~jjulavAnIropashobhitatIrAbhiH saridbhirupagatabhUmibhAgaH, kShitidharaniku~jjopashobhitaH, mandapavanAnuvIjitakShitiruhagahanaH, anekavanarAjIpuShpitavanagahanabhUmibhAgaH, snigdhatarupratAnopagUDhaH, haMsa-cakravAka-balAkA-nandImukha-puNDarIka-kAdamba-madgu -bhRu~ggarAja-shatapatra-mattakokilAnunAditataruviTapaH, sukumArapuruShaH, pavanakaphaprAyo j~jeyaH; anayoreva dvayordeshayorvIrudvanaspativAnaspatyashakunimRugagaNayutaH sthirasukumArabalavarNasaMhananopapannasAdhAraNaguNayuktapuruShaH sAdhAraNo j~jeyaH||8||

Commentary: deshAdi samyag vyAkurvannAha- tatra trividha ityAdi| atra kecijjA~ggalAdideshalakShaNagranthaM na paThanti, tattu janapadoddhvaMsanIye paThitamiti kRutvehAnArShaM vadanti| yaistu janapadoddhvaMsanIye jA~ggalAdilakShaNaM na paThyate, tairatra paThanIya evAyaM granthaH||8||

tatra deshe sAdhAraNe jA~ggale vA yathAkAlaM shishirAtapapavanasalilasevite same shucau pradakShiNodake shmashAna-caitya-devayajanAgAra-sabhA-shvabhrArAma-valmIkoSharavirahite kusharohiShAstIrNe snigdhakRuShNamadhuramRuttike suvarNavarNamadhuramRuttike vA mRudAvaphAlakRuShTe~anupahate~anyairbalavattarairdrumairauShadhAni jAtAni prashasyante||9||

Commentary: yathAkAlamiti yathAkAlaM shishirAdibhiH sevite deshe| shmashAnAdibhiH pratyekaM virahitashabdaH sambadhyate| devayajanenAgArashabdaH sambadhyate| sabhA janamelakasthAnam| na phAlena kRuShTa iti aphAlakRuShTe||9||

tatra yAni kAlajAtAnyupAgatasampUrNapramANa-rasavIrya-gandhAni kAlAtapAgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varNa-rasa-sparsha-prabhAvANi pratyagrANyudIcyAM dishi sthitAni; teShAM shAkhApalAshamaciraprarUDhaM varShAvasantayorgrAhyaM, grIShme mUlAni shishire vA shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAM, sharadi tvakkandakShIrANi, hemante sArANi, yathartu puShpaphalamiti; ma~ggalAcAraH kalyANavRuttaH shuciH shuklavAsAH sampUjya devatA ashvinau gobrAhmaNAMshca kRutopavAsaH prA~gmukha uda~gmukho vA gRuhNIyAt||10||

Commentary: tatra yAni kAlajAtAnItyanenaiva kAlasampaducyate; kAlajAtAnIti svakAlabhUtAni| upAgatasampUrNetyAdinA pratyagrANItyantena guNasampaducyate| pratyagrANIti sampUrNaguNatayA niShpannAni| teShAM shAkhApalAshamityAdinA kAlasampadamuktAM prapa~jcayati| shAkhAgrahaNenaiva tvagAdInAmapi grahaNam| shIrNaprarUDhaparNAnAmiti cchedaH| grIShme mUlAni shishire veti kathanena yAnyAgneyAni teShAM mUlAni grIShme, yAni saumyAni teShAM mUlAni shishire, grAhyANIti vyavasthAM sUcayati; uktaM hyanyatra- “saumyAnyauShadhAni saumyeShvRutuShvAdadIta, AgneyAnyAgneyeShu” (su.sU.a.36) iti| bheShajagrahaNavidhAnamAha- ma~ggaletyAdi||10||

cikitsitasthAne tu tatra tatra vihitavamanavirecanayoH prayogAn vistareNAbhidhAtuM cikitsAdhikRutayogasthAnarUpakalpasthAnamucyate| yadyapi cikitsAyAM basterapi pratipAditatvAdbastyabhidhAyakaM siddhisthAnamapi cikitsA~ggatayA~abhidhAtavyaM, tathA~api pa~jcakarmaNAmautsargikapravRuttau vamanavirecanapUrvikaiva bastikarmapravRuttirbhavatIti kRutvA vamanavirecanAbhidhAyakaM kalpasthAnameva bastyabhidhAyakasiddhisthAnAdagre~abhidhIyate| vamanavirecanAnAM kalpAstiShThantyasminniti kalpasthAnam| kalpAbhidhAne~api virecanasyautsargikapravRuttau vamanapUrvikaiva pravRuttirbhavatIti vamanapUrvakatvAdvirecanasya vamanakalpA evAgre~abhidhAtavyAH| vamanakalpeShvapi vamanadravyashreShThatvAnmadanaphalasyaivAdau kalpo~abhidhIyate; shreShThatvaM ca madanaphalasya ‘vamanadravyANAM madanaphalAni shreShThatamAnyAcakShate~anapAyitvAt’ ityanenAtraiva vakShyati||1-2||

phalapippalIsvarasenetyAdinA shaShkulyapUpayoH pRuthageko yogaH| etenaiva ca kalpenetyAdinA sumukhAdipa~jcadashadravyakaShAyeNa pRuthak shaShkulyapUpayoH karaNAt pa~jcadasha yogA bhavanti| evaM militvA shaShkulIpUpayoH pRuthak ShoDashayogA bhavanti| poTA ikShugandhA; daNDairakA gundrAkhyagulmaH, nalo vA||24-25||
madanaphalayogAnAM navAdisa~gkhyotkarShanirAsArthaM sukhasmaraNArthaM ca tAn sa~ggraheNAha- nava yogA ityAdi| asya cArtho yathAsthAnaM vyAhRutaH||28-30||
athAto jImUtakakalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

kalpaM jImUtakasyemaM phalapuShpAshrayaM shuNu| garAgarI ca veNI ca tathA syAddevatADakaH||3||

Commentary: phalapuShpAshrayamiti vacanena jImUtasya patranAlAdiShu vamanaprayogaM niShedhayati| garAgarI cetyAdi paryAyakathanam| jImUtaH pItaghoShakaH||3||

jImUtakaM tridoShaghnaM yathAsvauShadhakalpitam| prayoktavyaM jvarashvAsahikkAdyeShvAmayeShu ca||4||

Commentary: tridoShaghnamiti yathAsvaM vAtaharAdidravyayuktaM, tathA vAtAdiharadravyakalpitaM ca sat tridoShaghnaM bhavati| hikkAdyeShviti Adyashabdena kAsAdInAmurogatadoShajanyAnAM grahaNam||4||
yathoktaguNayuktAnAM deshajAnAM yathAvidhi| payaH puShpe~asya, nirvRutte phale peyA payaskRutA||5||
lomashe kShIrasantAnaM, dadhyuttaramalomashe| shRute payasi dadhyamlaM jAtaM haritapANDuke||6||
jIrNAnAM ca sushuShkANAM nyastAnAM bhAjane shucau| cUrNasya payasA shuktiM vAtapittArditaH pibet||7||
Asutya ca surAmaNDe mRuditvA prasrutaM pibet| kaphaje~arocake kAse pANDuroge sayakShmaNi||8||
dve cApothyAthavA trINi guDUcyA madhukasya vA| kovidArAdikAnAM vA nimbasya kuTajasya vA||9||
kaShAyeShvAsutaM pUtvA tenaiva vidhinA pibet| athavA~a~aragvadhAdInAM saptAnAM pUrvavat pibet||10||

mAtrAH syuH phalavaccAShTau kolamAtrAstu tA matAH||11||

Commentary: mAtrAH syurityAdinA~aShTau mAtrAyogAnAha| phalavaditi madanaphale yathA aShTau mAtrAyogA uktAstathehApi kartavyAH, visheShatastu etAH kolamAtrAH kartavyAH, na tu phalavaddharItakyAdipramANAH kartavyA ityarthaH||11||

jIvakarShabhakekShUNAM shatAvaryA rasena vA| pittashleShmajvare dadyAdvAtapittajvare~athavA||12||

Commentary: jIvaketyAdinA caturo yogAH pAnasAdhanakaShAyabhedAt||12||

tathA jImUtakakShIrAt samutpannaM pacedghRutam| phalAdInAM kaShAyeNa shreShThaM tadvamanaM matam||13||

Commentary: tathetyAdinA ghRutayogamekamAha||13||
tatra shlokau- ShaT kShIre madirAmaNDe eko dvAdasha cApare| sapta cAragvadhAdInAM kaShAye~aShTau ca vartiShu||14||
jIvakAdiShu catvAro ghRutaM caikaM prakIrtitam| kalpe jImUtakAnAM ca yogAstriMshannavAdhikAH||15||

madanakalpAnantaramanapAyitvenekShvAkvAdidravyebhyaH prAdhAnyAjjImUtakasya jImUtakalpo~abhidhIyate| evaM yathAyathaiShAmanapAyitvaprakarShaH, tathA tathA pUrvaniveshanaM j~jeyam| tenAparavamanakalpAnAmapyadhyAyasambandho~atraivokto j~jeyaH| madanaphalasya snehasvedAdipUrvakatvavadihApi kramo~atideshAdunnetavyaH||1-2||

yathoktayuktaguNayuktAnAmiti kAlajatva-sampUrNarasatvAdiguNayuktAni madanaphaloktaguNadvArA~anusartavyAni| deshajAnAmiti madanakalpoktaprashastabhUmijAtAnAm| yathAvidhIti madanakalpoktavidhAnagRuhItAnAm| payaH puShpe ityeko yogaH| nirvRutte ityAdiko dvitIyo yogaH| nirvRutte iti utpannamAtre phale, tatra phalaiH kShIraM sAdhayitvA tena kShIreNa peyA sAdhanIyA| romashe ityAdi tRutIyaH| romashe iti upagataromNi phale, atrApi romashaphalasAdhitakShIrAt santAnikA j~jeyA| dadhyuttaramityAdikashcaturtho yogaH, atrApyupagataromAvasthaphalasAdhitakShIrasambhUtadadhisaro j~jeyaH| shRute payasItyAdikaH pa~jcamaH| dadhyamlamiti amlAvasthaM dadhi jAtam| haritapANDuke iti haritapANDvavasthAprApte jImUtakaphale| jIrNAnAmityAdikaH ShaShThaH kShIrayogaH| ete ca yogAH kShIrasambandhena avidhIyamAnakShIrAkArA api kShIraprayogatvenaiva sa~ggrahe ‘ShaT kShIre’ ityanena sa~ggrahItavyAH||5-7||

AsutyetyAdinA madirAyoga eka ucyate| Asutyeti nishAparyuShitaM kRutvA| atra yoge pakvajImUtakaphalamevAdhikRutaM; tathA, uttarayogeShvapi pakvameva phalamadhikRutaM j~jeyaM, “phalaM paryAgataM grAhyaM” ityautsargikavacanAt| dve cetyAdinA dvAdashakaShAyabhedAd dvAdashayogA ucyante| tenaiva vidhineti madanakalpoktena sAdhanavidhinA| athavetyAdau AragvadhAdisaptadravyakaShAyabhedAt saptayogA bhavanti| AragvadhAdayaH Aragvadha-vRukShaka-svAdukaNTaka-pAThA-pATali-shAr~ggeShTA-mUrvAH (ka.a.1) pUrvAdhyAyoktAH||8-10||-
ShaT kShIre ityAdinA sa~ggrahArtho vyAkRuta eva yathAsthAnam||14-15||
athAta ikShvAkukalpaM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

lambA~atha kaTukAlAbUstumbI piNDaphalA tathA||3||

Commentary: lambetyAdi paryAyakathanam||3||-

kaShAyaiH kovidArAdyairmAtrAshca phalavat smRutAH|15|

Commentary: kaShAyairityAdinA madanaphalasadRushavidhA aShTau mAtrAlakShitAH prayogA ucyante|15|-
pUtasyAsya trayo bhAgAshcaturthaH phANitasya tu| saghRuto bIjabhAgashca piShTAnardhAMshikAMstathA ||16||
mahAjAlinijImUtakRutavedhanavatsakAn| taM lehaM sAdhayeddarvyA ghaTTayanmRudunA~agninA||17||
yAvat syAttantumattoye patitaM tu na shIryate| taM lihanmAtrayA lehaM pramathyAM ca pibedanu||18||

shaktubhirvA pibenmanthaM tumbIsvarasabhAvitaiH||19||

Commentary: shaktubhirityAdinaiko manthayogaH||19||-

gulme mehe praseke ca kalkaM mAMsarasaiH pibet| naraH sAdhu vamatyevaM na ca daurbalyamashnute||20||

Commentary: gulme jvara ityAdinA rasaikayogamAha| kalkam ikShvAkubIjakalkam||20||
tatra shlokAH- payasyaShTau surAmaNDa-mastu-takreShu ca trayaH| ghreyaM sapalalaM tailaM vardhamAnAH phaleShu ShaT||21||
ghRutamekaM kaShAyeShu navAnye madhukAdiShu| aShTau vartikriyA lehAH pa~jca mantho rasastathA||22||
yogA ikShvAkukalpe te catvAriMshacca pa~jca ca| uktA maharShiNA samyak prajAnAM hitakAmyayA||23||

kAsashvAsaviShacchardijvarArte kaphakarShite||4||

Commentary: tadiShyate iti ikShvAkukalpanamiShyate||4||-
apuShpasya pravAlAnAM muShTiM prAdeshasammitam||5||
kShIraprasthe shRutaM dadyAt pittodrikte kaphajvare| puShpAdiShu ca catvAraH kShIre jImUtake yathA||6||
yogA haritapANDUnAM surAmaNDena pa~jcamaH| phalasvarasabhAgaM ca triguNakShIrasAdhitam||7||
uraHsthite kaphe dadyAt svarabhede ca pInase| jIrNe madhyoddhRute kShIraM prakShipettadyadA dadhi||8||
jAtaM syAt sakaphe kAse shvAse vamyAM ca tat pibet| ajAkShIreNa bIjAni bhAvayet pAyayet ca||9||
viShagulmodaragranthigaNDeShu shlIpadeShu ca| mastunA vA phalAnmadhyaM pANDukuShThaviShArditaH||10||

tumbyA phalarasaiH shuShkaiH sapuShpairavacUrNitam||11||

Commentary: tumbyA ityAdinA ghreyayogamAha| gandhasampatsukhocita iti gandhasampat sugandhavattvaM, tayA gandhasampadA sukhamucitamabhyastaM yena saH; avacUrNitekShvAkuphalarasapuShpaM mAlyamAghrAyaiva vamatyanabhyastadurgandha iti bhAvaH||11||-

bhakShayet phalamadhyaM vA guDena palalena ca||12||

Commentary: bhakShayedityAdinA vamanayogamekamAha| phalamadhyam ikShvAkuphalamadhyam| ikShvAkuphalakalkasAdhitaM tailamikShvAkuphalatailam; ayameka eva tailayogaH| pUrvavaditi jImUtakavat, tena “tathA jImUtakakShIrAt” (ka.a.2) ityAdinoktavidhAnena jImUtakasthAne ikShvAkuphalaM dattveha ghRutaM sAdhanIyam||12||-

pa~jcAshaddashavRuddhAni phalAdInAM yathottaram||13||

Commentary: pa~jcAshadityAdinA ShaD vardhamAnakayogAnAha| pa~jcAshadArabhya dashakena vRuddhairikShvAkubIjaiH shataM pUraNIyam| tena ShaDyogA bhavanti| tAni ca yathAsa~gkhyaM madanaphalAdInAM ShaNNAmanyatamakaShAyeShvAsutya vimRuditAni pAtavyAni | anye tu dashabIjAdArabhya pa~jcAshadbIjaparyantaM doShAdyapekShayA pAtavyaM; tatra madanAdikaShAyabhedAdeva yogabheda ityAhuH||13||-

yaShTyAhvakovidArAdyairmuShTimantarnakhaM pibet||14||

Commentary: yaShTyAhvetyAdinA navakaShAyayogAnAha| tatra yaShTyAhvamekaM, kovidArAdayo madanakalpoktA aShTau||14||
