uktAdhyAyasambandhAdikShvAkukalpo~abhidhIyate| yeShAM prashasyate ikShvAkukalpastAn vakShyAmIti yojyam||1-2||-

bilvetyAdinA eko lehaH, tathA ‘kalpa’ ityAdinA catvAro lehA ante draShTavyAH, evaM pa~jca lehAH| a~jjaliH palacatuShTayam| atra ca “tatashca kuDavaM yAvattoyamaShTaguNaM bhavet” iti vacanAdbilvamUlakaShAyasyAShTAva~jjalayo deyAH, tatashcaturbhAgAvasheSheNa kuDavadvayam| phANitam ardhashRuta ikShurasaH| ‘caturthaH phANitasya ca’ ityasya sthAne ‘trayastrikaTukasya ca’ iti kecit paThanti| saghRuta iti ghRutasyaiko bhAgaH| ardhAMshikAniti ekabhAgArdhamAnAn pratyekaM mahAjAlinyAdIn| mahAjAlinI pItakoShAtakI, kRutavedhanaH ghoShakabhedaH ‘jyotsnikA” iti khyAtaH| yAvat syAttantumadityAdinA lehapAkalakShaNamAha; etacca lakShaNaM lehAntareShvapi pAcanIyeShu j~jeyam| na shIryate na vistIryate| pramathyAM ca pibedanviti atIsAracikitsite “pippalI nAgaraM dhAnyaM” (ci.a.19) ityAdinoktapramathyAnAM madhye~anyatamapramathyAkRutaM kaShAyaM pibedityarthaH| ‘pramathyAM ca’ ityasya sthAne kecit ‘manthaM cApi’ iti paThanti| agnimanthAdAviti pratyekamagnimantha-syonAka-pATalA-gambhArImUlacatuShkaM pa~jcamUlakathanaprastAve rasAyane kathitam||15-18||-
payasyaShTAvityAdisa~ggrahArtho vyAkRuta eva| atra phaleShviti madanaphalAdiShu| ghRutaM yadyapi vardhamAnapUrvapaThitaM, tathA~api chandonurodhAdiha pashcAt paThitam||21-23||

apuShpasyetyAdinA ekaH kShIrayogaH| apuShpasyeti anutpannapuShpasya| muShTiM prAdeshasammitamiti pradeshinyA mUlaparyantakRutamuShTiparimANam; evaM ca nAtra muShTishabdaH palavacanaH| kShIraprasthe shRutamiti vacanAt kShIraprasthe yathoktamAnamikShvAkumAvApya caturguNaM pAnIyaM dattvA kShIraM sAdhanIyam| puShpAdiShvityAdinA caturaH kShIrayogAnAha| jImUtake yathA “payaH puShpe~asya nirvRutte phale peyA payaskRutA| romashe kShIrasantAnaM dadhyuttaramaromashe” (ka.a.2) ityanenoktaM, tathehApi yogacatuShTayaM karaNIyam| haritetyAdinA surAyogamAha| haritapANDUnAmikShvAkuphalAnAM surAmaNDe jImUtakavadyogaH kartavyaH; jImUtakavidhAnAtideshena “Asutya ca surAmaNDe muditvA prasrutaM pibet” (ka.a.2) iti granthoktavidhAnamihApi bhavati| phalasvarasetyAdinA ShaShThaH kShIrayogo~abhidhIyate| triguNakShIrasAdhitamiti triguNena kShIreNa sAdhitaM; tacca caturguNena toyena sAdhanIyam| phalashabdenAtrekShvAkuphalamucyate| jIrNe ityAdinA saptamaH kShIrayogaH| madhyoddhRute iti uddhRutamadhye| ajAkShIreNetyAdinA~aShTamaH kShIrayogaH| tena takramityAdinA takrayogaH| teneti tumbIphalamadhyena||5-10||-
athAtaH kalpanAsiddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
mahAn sthiraH sarvapacastathaiva shuddhasya peyAdibhirantaragniH|13|
dashaiva te dvitriguNA vireke prasthastathA dvitricaturguNashca| pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhaM kaphAntaM ca virekamAhuH||14||

kramAt kaphaH pittamathAnilashca yasyaiti samyagvamitaH sa iShTaH||15||

Commentary: samprati ‘kiM ca kRutAkRuteShu’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM yathAkramamAha- kramAdityAdi| kramAdityanena vacanena yathoktakramala~gghanena kaphAdyAgamanaM na samyagyogalakShaNamiti darshayati; yataH kaphAdUrdhvaM gataM yadA pittaM bhavati tadA tu pittAgamane~api sati na shuddhiH, kintu yadaivAmAshayAdhobhAgagataM pittaM vamanamAnayati tadaiva shuddhiH, tat pittAnayanaM ca kaphAnayanAnantarameva bhavati; evaM samyakkRutavirecanalakShaNe~api kramAditipadasyArtho~atra vyAkhyeyaH||15||-

dushchardite sphoTakakoThakaNDUhRutkhAvishuddhirgurugAtratAM ca||16||

Commentary: dushchardite ityAdyayogakRutavamanalakShaNam||16||

srotovishuddhIndriyasamprasAdau laghutvamUrjo~agniranAmayatvam||17||

Commentary: srotovishuddhItyAdi samyagvirecanalakShaNam| Urjo~agniriti paTuragniH | anAmayatvamiti virecanajetavyadoShajanitavikAravyapagamaH| prAptishcetyAdigranthArthaH sthAnAntare vyAkhyAta eva||17||-

syAcchleShmapittAnilasamprakopaH sAdastathA~agnergurutA pratishyA||18||

Commentary: syAdityAdyayogakRutavirekalakShaNam| na ca vAtAnulomyamityarthaH ||18||-

kaphAsrapittakShayajAnilotthAH suptya~ggamardaklamavepanAdyAH||19||

Commentary: kaphAsretyAdi virekAtiyogalakShaNam| kShayashabdaH kaphAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate||19||-
saMsRuShTabhaktaM navame~ahni sarpistaM pAyayetApyanuvAsayedvA||20||
tailAktagAtrAya tato nirUhaM dadyAtryahAnnAtibubhukShitAya| prasyAgate dhanvarasena bhojyaH samIkShya vA doShabalaM yathArham||21||

shIte vasante ca divA~anuvAsyo rAtrau sharadgrIShmaghanAgameShu||22||

Commentary: nishItyanena yannishAsamIpe~anuvAsanaM vihitaM tadeva kAlabhedena bhinnakAlaM darshayannAha- shIte ityAdi| shItashabdena shishirahemantayorapi grahaNam| diveti nishAsamIpe divAbhAge, rAtrAvapi ca dinasamIpAyAM rAtrau| doShAn parirakShatA doShAn dRuShTvA, antaraM ca doShavarjanena parirakShatA; ye snehasya pAne parikIrtitAH snehAdhyAye- “shleShmAdhiko divA shIte” (sU.a.13) ityAdinA granthena, ya evAkAlapItasnehadoShA bhavanti ta eva yathoktakAlaviparyayakRutAnuvAsane~api doShA bhavantItyuktaM bhavati| snehAdhyAye yadvAtapittAdhikatvAdivisheSheNApi rAtrau divA ca snehapAnaM vihitaM tadihApi samAnanyAyatvAdekadeshAbhidhAnenAparaikadeshAnumAnAcca j~jeyam||22||-
pratyAgate cApyanuvAsanIye divA pradeyaM vyuShitAya bhojyam||23||
sAyaM ca bhojyaM parato dvyahe vA tryahe~anuvAsyo~ahani pa~jcame vA | tryahe tryahe vA~apyatha pa~jcame vA dadyAnnirUhAdanuvAsanaM ca||24||

ekaM tathA trIn kaphaje vikAre pittAtmake pa~jca tu sapta vA~api| vAte navaikAdasha vA punarvA bastInayugmAn kushalo vidadhyAt||25||

Commentary: samprati doShabhedenAnuvAsananiyamamAha- ekaM tathA trInityAdi| etacca ‘sa~gkhyAH kati’ iti prashnasyottaram; aparaM sa~gkhyAprashnasyotaraM ‘triMshanmatAH karmasu ’ ityAdinA bhaviShyati| kaphapittayoshca yadyapyanuvAsanaM na vihitaM, tathA~api vAtAnugatakaphapittaviShayatayaitadboddhavyam| punarvetyanena vAte nava ekAdasha vA kuryAt| ayugmAnityanena dvicatuHShaDAdisa~gkhyayA yugmadAnaM niShedhayati, ayugmadAnaM prabhAvAdevAtropakArIti maharShivacanAdbodhyaM, yathA- “yugmeShvahaHsu putrakAmau saMvasetAm” (shA.a.8) iti; upapattishcAtrAtiprasa~ggabhItyA na kathitA~a~acAryeNa| yattu- “trIn pa~jca vA~a~ahushcaturo~atha ShaD vA” ityAdinA yugmabastidAnaM vakShyati, tannirUhA~ggatayA snehanArthakriyamANAnuvAsanaviShayayugmabastidAnaM j~jeyam, iha tu pradhAnatayA kriyamANAnuvAsanaviShayamayugmadAnamiti na virodhaH| etena, yaduktamAShADhavarmaNA- “nirUhakAryakAraNamayugmadAnamasminnoktaM niShiddhapUrva ca, yogasyAnte kramAdekaM tathA trInityAdIn snehAn prAha” (?) iti, tannirastaM j~jeyam| ki~jca, ayugmAnityanena punarvetyanena ca yatrAnuvRuttyA~anuvAsanaM deyaM tatrAyugmakaM nirUhAntaritaM ca kartavyamityarthaH, tena yathoktasa~gkhyAkAnnirUhAn dattvA yathoktasa~gkhyayA sneho deyaH| viShamasa~gkhyopAdAnaM tu madhyavidhayA~api dvyahacaturahAdigrAhakaM bhavati , tenottaratra vakShyamANasa~gkhyAnuvAsanaM na virodhIti brUte| jatUkarNe~apyuktaM- “nirUhe vyuShite bhuktavato~anuvAsanaM paraM dvitIye~ahani pa~jcame vA tathaikAdashAhe~apakarShato dvitricaturAdi(?) vAtAdiShUcyate” iti||25||

naro viriktastu nirUhadAnaM vivarjayet saptadinAnyavashyam| shuddho nirUheNa virecanaM ca taddhyasya shUnyaM vikaseccharIram||26||

Commentary: samprati nirUhavirecanayorantare~avashyaparihartavyakAlamAha-  naro viriktastvityAdi| avashyamiti vacanAdekAhasAdhye~api vyAdhAvavashyaM saptadinacchedaH kartavya iti darshayati| yadyapivirecanAnantaraM niShiddha eva nirUhaH pa~jcakarmIyAyAM siddhau, tathA nirUDhasya virecanaM niShiddhaM, tathA~api tatkAlameva sa niShedhaH; tena tricaturAdidine~api prasaktinirAsArthamidaM vacanam| yattu virecanAnantaraM navame~ahnyanuvAsanakAlAduttarakAlameva nirUhavidhAnaM, tenArvAgbasteH prasaktirapi na syAdityucyate; tanna, yato~anuvAsanashuddhyapekShasaMsarjanakramasyeyaM vidhA, yadA~avarashuddhyA tryaheNaiva peyAdikramaH samApyate, tadA caturthadine~anuvAsanadAnAt pa~jcame ShaShThe vA dine nirUhaH prasajjyeta, atastannirAsArthametadvacanam| nirUhAnantaraM tu saMsarjanakramo nAstyeva, tena tryahaM snehaM dattvA virecanaprasaktirastyeva| saptAhAdarvAk saptAhaM yAvacca nirUhavirecanavarjane hetumAha- taddhyasyetyAdi| vikasediti hiMsyAt| shUnyamiti pUrvashodhanashUnyasharIraM punaH shodhanAddhiMsyAditi bhAvaH| yattu “AsaptAhAdvireko vA tatashcApi nirUhaNam” iti tantrAntare proktaM, tacca saMsargavidhayA kriyamANasaMshodhanakrame j~jeyam| tatrApi ca saptAhapUraNaM saMsarjanasnehAdInAmanumatavikalpaparihArAd vyAkhyeyam||26||
bastirvayaHsthApayitA sukhAyurbalAgnimedhAsvaravarNakRucca| sarvArthakArI shishuvRuddhayUnAM niratyayaH sarvagadApahashca||27||
viTshleShmapittAnilamUtrakarShI dArDhyAvahaH shukrabalapradashca| vishvaksthitaM doShacayaM nirasya sarvAn vikArAn shamayennirUhaH||28||
dehe nirUheNa vishuddhamArge saMsnehanaM varNabalapradaM ca| na tailadAnAt paramasti ki~jciddravyaM visheSheNa samIraNArte ||29||
snehena raukShyaM laghutAM gurutvAdauShNyAcca shaityaM pavanasya hatvA| tailaM dadAtyAshu manaHprasAdaM vIryaM balaM varNamathAgnipuShTim ||30||
mUle niShikto hi yathA drumaH syAnnIlacchadaH komalapallavAgryaH| kAle mahAn puShpaphalapradashca tathA naraH syAdanuvAsanena||31||
stabdhAshca ye sa~gkucitAshca ye~api ye pa~ggavo ye~api ca bhagnarugNAH| yeShAM ca shAkhAsu caranti vAtAH shasto visheSheNa hi teShu bastiH||32||
AdhmApane vigrathite purIShe shUle ca bhaktAnabhinandane ca| evamprakArAshca bhavanti kukShau ye cAmayAsteShu ca bastiriShTaH||33||
yAshca striyo vAtakRutopasargA garbhaM na gRuhNanti nRubhiH sametAH| kShINendriyA ye ca narAH kRushAshca bastiH prashastaH paramaM ca teShu||34||

uShNAbhibhUteShu vadanti shItA~jchItAbhibhUteShu tathA sukhoShNAn| tatpratyanIkauShadhasamprayuktAn sarvatra bastIn pravibhajya yu~jjyAt ||35||

Commentary: samprati keShu ca kashca bastiriti prashnasyotaram- uShNAbhibhUteShvityAdi| uShNAbhibhUte tathA shItAbhibhUte iti vaktavye, yena ‘sarvatra’ iti karoti, tena snigdharUkShaguruladhvabhibhUte~api tadviparItauShadhasampAdito vastirdeya iti darshayati||35||

na bRuMhaNIyAn vidadhIta bastIn vishodhanIyeShu gadeShu vaidyaH| kuShThapramehAdiShu medureShu nareShu ye cApi vishodhanIyAH||36||

Commentary: nityavishodhanIyagadAnAha- kuShThapramehAdiShvityAdi| atra, AdishabdenArocakatandrAshlIpadAdInAM grahaNam| medureShviti medasviShu||36||

kShINakShatAnAM na vishodhanIyAnna shoShiNAM no bhRushadurbalAnAm| na mUrcchitAnAM na vishodhitAnAM yeShAM ca doSheShu nibaddhamAyuH||37||

Commentary: kShINakShatAnAM neti kShINA rAjayakShmiprabhRutayo j~jeyAH| vishodhanIyAniti apakarShaNakArakAn| yeShAM ca doSheShu nibaddhamAyuriti ye saMshodhanaharaNamAtreNaiva prANA~jjahati||37||
shAkhAgatAH koShThagatAshca rogA  marmordhvasarvAvayavA~ggajAshca| ye santi teShAM na hi kashcidanyo vAyoH paraM janmani heturasti||38||
viNmUtrapittAdimalAshayAnAM vikShepasa~gghAtakaraH sa yasmAt| tasyAtivRuddhasya shamAya nAnyadbastiM vinA bheShajamasti ki~jcit||39||

nAbhipradeshaM kaTipArshvakukShiM gatvA shakRuddoShacayaM viloDya ||40||

Commentary: tatra basteH kRutAkRutalakShaNAni krameNAha- nAbhItyAdi| viloDyeti sa~gkShobhya| saMsnehya kAyamiti vIryarUpeNa sAreNa kAyaM vyApya, uktaM hi- “vIryeNa bastirAdatte doShAnApAdamastakAt” (su.ci.a.35) iti| snehashabdena ca sAro~abhidhIyate; yathA- “dehaH snehaparikShayAt” (ci.a.8) iti| samyagiti niravasheSheNa| sukheneti vikAramakRutvA||40||-

prasRuShTaviNmUtrasamIraNatvaM rucyagnivRuddhyAshayalAghavAni||41||

Commentary: tAdAtvikabastisamyagyogalakShaNamabhidhAyottarakAlabhavamAha- prasRuShTetyAdi| ‘AshayalAghavAni’ ityatra ‘AmayalAghavAni’ iti pAThe rogopashAntirityanantaraM vAshabdo j~jeyaH, tena rogopashAntiriha nirUhasAdhyavikArANAmupashAntiH||41||-

syAdrukchirohRudgudabastili~gge shophaH pratishyAyavikartike ca||42||

Commentary: syAdityAdi bastyayogalakShaNam| na samya~gnirUhite iti ayogena nirUhite||42||-

li~ggaM yadevAtivirecitasya bhavettadevAtinirUhitasya||43||

Commentary: bastyatiyogalakShaNamatideshenAha- li~ggamityAdi||43||

pratyetyasaktaM sashakRucca tailaM raktAdibuddhIndriyasamprasAdaH | svapnAnuvRuttirlaghutA balaM ca sRuShTAshca vegAH svanuvAsite syuH||44||

Commentary: anuvAsanasamyagyogalakShaNamAha- pratyetItyAdi| asaktamiti sa~ggaM vinA| raktAdayaH dhAtavaH| svapnAnuvRutiH nidrAnuvRuttiH| sRuShTA iti abaddhAH||44||

adhaHsharIrodarabAhupRuShThapArshveShu rugrUkShakharaM ca gAtram | grahashca viNmUtrasamIraNAnAmasamyagetAnyanuvAsitasya ||45||

Commentary: adha ityAdyanuvAsanAyogalakShaNam| rUkShakharatA cAtra sharIrasyAsnehanAdeva| hRullAsAdi atiyogalakShaNam||45||-

yasyeha yAmAnanuvartate trIn sneho naraH syAt sa vishuddhadehaH||46||

Commentary: ucitasnehapratyAgamanakAlamAha- yasyetyAdi| yAmAniti praharAn| sa vishuddhadeha iti sa anuvAsanaprayogasamyagyogAdanuvAsanavyApattirahita ityarthaH| AshvAgate iti shIghraM pratyAgate, anyastu vidheya iti tadaivAnyaH sneho deyaH| punaH snehadAnopapattimAha- sneho na saMsnehayati hyatiShThanniti||46||-
triMshanmatAH karma nu bastayo hi kAlastato~ardhena tatashca yogaH||47||
sAnvAsanA dvAdasha vai nirUhAH prAk sneha ekaH paratashca pa~jca| kAle trayo~ante puratastathaikaH snehA nirUhAntaritAshca ShaT syuH||48||

trIn pa~jca vA~a~ahushcaturo~atha ShaDvA vAtAdikAnAmanuvAsanIyAn ||49||

Commentary: trIn pa~jcetyAdinA snehanArthamanuvAsanamAha| atra ye ‘vAtAdikAnAM’ iti paThanti, teShAmAdishabdena pittakaphayorapi grahaNaM; bahuvacanaM tu tadguNasaMvij~jAnabahuvrIhiNA vAtasya grahaNAdbahutvasa~gkhyAyogAdupapannam| yathoktaM kuShThanidAne- ‘vAtAdiShu praduShTeShu” (ni.a.5) iti, tathA kiyantaHshirasIye~api “vAtAdInAM rasAdInAM” (sU.a.17) iti bahutvaM nirdiShTam| anye tu- ‘vAtAdhikAnAM’ iti paThanti| atra caturNAM ShaNNAM ca snehAnAM yugmarUpANAmapi dAnamaviruddhameva, etadanuvAsanasya nirUhA~ggatayA snehanArthaM kriyamANatvAt; ayugmadAnaM tu ‘bastInayugmAn’ ityanena svapradhAnatayA~anuvAsanasya vihitamiti bhinnaviShayatayA na virodhaH; yataH snehanaprayojanamanuvAsanaM snehe bhUta evAyugmadAnena nivartanIyaM; kiMvA, ayugmA tantrato vyAkhyAnena sa~gkhyaivocyate, tathAhi- trIn, pa~jca, trIn catura iti sapta, pa~jca catura iti nava, pa~jca ShaDityekAdasha, iti pa~jca vikalpA iha vidhIyante| tantrAntare snehasya yugmadAnamuktaM, yathA- “rUkShasya bahuvAtasya dvau trIn vA~apyanuvAsanAn| dadyAt snigdhatanuM j~jAtvA tataH pashcAnnirUhayet” (su.ci.a.37) iti| srotaHshabdena vibaddhasirA~abhihitA||49||-
vishuddhadehasya tataH krameNa snigdhaM talasveditamuttamA~ggam||50||
virecayettrirdvirathaikasho vA balaM samIkShya trividhaM malAnAm| uraHshirolAghavamindriyAcchyaM srotovishuddhishca bhavedvishuddhe||51||
galopalepaH shiraso gurutvaM niShThIvanaM cApyatha durvirikte| shirokShisha~gkhashravaNArtitodAvatyarthashuddhe timiraM ca pashyet||52||

ityAturasvasthasukhaH prayogo balAyuShorvRuddhikRudAmayaghnaH||53||

Commentary: uktaM pa~jcakarmaprayogamupasaMharati- ityAturetyAdi| Aturasvasthasukha iti vacanena Ature AmayasyApahantRutayA, svasthe ca balAyurvRuddhikartRutayA yathoktapa~jcakarmaprayogaH sukhaheturbhavatIti j~jeyam| svasthe ca pa~jcakarmapravRuttiH “mAdhavaprathame mAsi” (sU.a.7) ityAdinA sUtrasthAne proktaiva j~jeyA||53||

atyAsanasthAnavacAMsi yAnaM svapnaM divA maithunavegarodhAn||54||

Commentary: ‘kiM varjanIyaM’ iti prashnasyottaram- atyAsanetyAdi| Asanam upaviShTAvasthAnam| sthAnam UrdhvatayA sthAnam| yAnaM rathAshvAdinA yAnam| eta AviShkRutatamA ihoktAH; tena krodhAticintanAdayo ye~apyupakalpanIyAdau vamanAdiprayoge niShiddhAste~api na sevyA eva||54||-

baddhe praNIte viShamaM ca netre mArge tathA~arshaHkaphaviDvibaddhe ||55||

Commentary: ‘praNIyamAnaH’ ityAdi prashnasyottaraM baddhe ityAdi| netre baddhe viShamaM praNIte ca gudAvayavaruddhatvAnna yAti| tathA ‘na sukhaM nireti’ ityAdinA ‘sucirAcca kena’ iti prashnasyottaram| na sukhaM niretIti cireNa duHkhaM kRutvA cAgacchatItyarthaH| doShAvRuta iti doSheNa balIyasA~avaruddhaH| alpa iti alpamAnaH| alpavIrya iti uShNalavaNAdyabhAvAnmRuduvIryaH||55||-
kA kalpanA pa~jcasu karmasUktA, kramashca kaH, kiM ca kRutAkRuteShu| liDgaM tathaivAtikRuteShu, sa~gkhyA kA, ki~gguNaH, keShu ca kashca bastiH||3||
kiM varjanIyaM pratikarmakAle, kRute kiyAn vA parihArakAlaH| praNIyamAnashca na yAti kena, kenaiti shIghraM, sucirAcca bastiH||4||
sAdhyA gadAH svaiH shamanaishca kecit kasmAt prayuktairna shamaM vrajanti| pracoditaH shiShyavareNa samyagityagniveshena bhiShagvariShThaH||5||

tryahAvaraM saptadinaM paraM tu snigdho naraH svedayitavya uktaH ||6||

Commentary: kalpanAshabdeneha pa~jcakarmA~ggakalpanocyate, tena pa~jcakarmA~ggasnehasvedaprayogameva prAgAha| tryahAvaramityAdi prathamaprashnasyottaram| tryahAvaramiti tryaheNa tryahaM vA vyApya kriyamANasnehanena avaraM yathA bhavatIti tryahAvaraM snigdhaH| saptadinamiti saptadinaM vyApya snigdhH| paramiti snehaprakarShakAlAvadhinA saptadinaM vyApya snigdhaH| tatashca kAlotkarShAt kriyamANashodhanA~ggasnehanapakShe saptadinaM yAvat snigdhaH, kAlAprakarShapakShe tu tryahaM snigdhaH saMsvedayitavya ityarthaH| uktasaptadinasnehanakAlAnatikramaM sopapattikamAha- nAtaH paramityAdi| ataH paramiti saptadinAt param| kuto nAdishantItyAha- sAtmyIbhavedityAdi| saptadinAt pareNa kriyamANasnehaH saptarAtraprayogeNa sAtmyIbhUtatvAnna snehanamadhikaM sharIre karotItyarthaH; tena yAvanmAtrasnehaprayogeNa saptadinopayuktena snehanaM vRutaM, sA mAtrA sAtmyIbhUtaiva; adhikamAtrA yA sAtmyatAM na gatA sA saptarAtrAt pareNApi kartavyaiva; vedyAstu saptarAtrAdasnigdhe puruShe ki~jcidvishrAmaM kRutvA punaradhikamAtrayA snehaM prayu~jjate| etacca tryahasnehanaM saptarAtrasnehanaM ca mRudukrUrakoShThaviShayabhedena| yaduktaM- “mRudukoShThastrirAtreNa snihyatyacchopasevayA| snihyati krUrakoShThastu saptarAtreNa mAnavaH” (sU.a.13) iti| nanu yadi krUrakoShThastu saptarAtreNa snihyatIti vyavasthA, tat kathamiha ‘nAtaH paraM snehanamAdishanti’ ityanena saptarAtreNApyasnehanamucyate; brUmaH- satyaM, krUrakoShThaH saptarAtreNaiva snihyati, paraM krUrakoShThatAmapekShya kRutayA snehamAtrayA snihyati, yadA tu hInamAtrA prayujyate, tadA saptarAtreNApi na snihyati| yattu tantrAntare- “triShaTkanavarAtreNa snehapAnaM vidhIyate” ityanena saptarAtrAdUrdhvamapi snehanaM vihitaM, tadAcAryAnabhimatameva; kiMvA, saptarAtrAdUrdhvamasAtmyIbhUtAdhikamAtrAprayogAbhiprAyeNa tadvarNanIyam| atra ca saptarAtrAdUrdhvaM snehaprayogasya niShedhAt, tryahAdarvAk prayogasya vA niShedhAt, sadyaH snehaprayogeNaikadinenApi snehanamanujAnIta iti bruvate| madhyakoShThAntaraM prati snehanaprakarShakAlo yadyapi noktaH, tathA~api madhyavidhayA pa~jcadinena madhyakoShThasya snehanaM j~jeyam| yattu kaishcit ‘mRudukoShThaM prati tryahAdUrdhvaM na snehanaM kartavyaM sAtmyIbhAvAditi cArtho labhyate’ iti vyAkhyAyate, tanna naH prINAti; yataH sAtmyIbhAvaH saptadinanirvartyatayaivAcAryeNoktaH , tenAtyalpamAtrAprayuktena snehena tryahAdyadi na snihyati mRudukoShThastadA~adhikadinAnyapi tatra snehaH kartavyaH||6||-

sneho~anilaM hanti mRudUkaroti dehaM malAnAM vinihanti sa~ggam||7||

Commentary: saMshodhanA~ggasnehaphalamAha- sneho~anilaM hantItyAdi||7||

prApte tu varconilamUtravege vAte~ativRuddhe~alpabale gude vA||56||

Commentary: prApte cetyanena shIghrAgamanahetumAha| vAte~ativRuddhe sneho gude vAtena pratihatatvAnna yAtyAshayaM, tataH shIghramAgacchati; alpabale gude snehaM dhArayituM na shaknoti puruShaH, alpabalatvaM gudasya saMvaraNIvalIdArbalyAt||56||-
medaHkaphAbhyAmanilo niruddhaH shUlA~ggasuptishvayathUn karoti||57||
snehaM tu yu~jjannabudhastu tasmai saMvardhayatyeva hi tAn vikArAn| rogAstathA~anye~apyavitarkyamANAH paraspareNAvagRuhItamArgAH||58||

sarvaM ca rogaprashamAya karma hInAtimAtraM viparItakAlam||59||

Commentary: atha vij~jAte~api vyAdhau bhiShajA~asamyakprayogAdibhirvardhamAne~asiddhimAha- sarvaM cetyAdi| viparItakAlamiti anucitakAlakRutam| mithyopacArAcceti bheShajAnAM tathA~akaraNAt, yathA- bheShajasya samyakpariNAme sati bhoktavyam| yadyaugikaM bheShajaM tat samyak prayuktaM sidhyatIti siddhAntaH||59||-

tatra shlokaH- prashnAnimAn dvAdasha pa~jcakarmANyuddishya siddhAviha kalpanAyAm||60||

Commentary: prashnAnityAdinA~adhyAyArthaM sa~ggRuhNAti| sa~ggrahashca vyaktaH||60||-
prajAhitArthaM bhagavAn mahArthAn samyagjagAdarShivaro~atriputraH||61||

grAmyaudakAnUparasaiH samAMsairutkleshanIyaH payasA ca vamyaH||8||

Commentary: samprati snigdhasya vAmanIyasya vamanAnuguNaM virecanIyasya ca virecanAnuguNaM bhojanaM pRuthagAha- grAmyaudaketyAdi| rasaistathetyAdinA virecanIyasyAhAravidhAnam| atra ca utkleshanIya iti yadA sambandho bhavettadA utkleshanaM pittasyaiva j~jeyaM; kiMvA ‘utkleshanIyaH’ iti nAnuvartata eva, tena kaphAvRuddhikarai rasairyUShaishca ‘bhojanIya’ iti sheShaH| etadvirecanArthaM pratibhojanaM tryahaM j~jeyaM, vamanArthaM tu pratibhojanamekAhameva; uktaM hi ‘snehAt praskandanaM jantustrirAtroparataH pibet| snehavaddravamuShNaM ca tryahaM bhuktvA rasaudanam| ekAhoparatastadvadbhuktvA pracchardanaM pibet” (sU.a.13) iti||8||-

shleShmottarashchardayati hyaduHkhaM viricyate mandakaphastu samyak||9||

Commentary: vAmanIyasya shleShmottaratve kartavye virecanIyasya cAlpakaphatve sampAdye upapattimAha- shleShmottara ityAdi| uktaviparyaye hetumAha- adha ityAdi| kaphe~alpe sati vamanaM pItaM vamanamakRutvaivAdho yAti; vRuddhe kaphe tu virecanaM prayuktamUrdhvaM yAti, vamanAya sampadyata ityarthaH||9||-

snigdhAya deyaM vamanaM yathoktaM vAntasya peyAdiranukramashca||10||

Commentary: samprati kramashca ka iti prashnasyottaramAha- snigdhAya deyaM vamanamiti; vamanapAnadine~abhya~ggena snigdhAya vamanaM deyamityarthaH, pAnajanitasnehastu pUrvamevoktatvAnna punarabhidhAnamarhati, anye tu ‘upajAtasnehaguNAya ’ iti vadanti| yathoktamiti madanakalpoktavidhinA deyam| vamanAnantaraM kartavyamAha- vAntasyetyAdi| peyAdiH “peyAM vilepI” ityAdinA vakShyamANaH| vamanakramamabhidhAya virecanakramamAha- snigdhasyetyAdi| susvinnatanoriti samyaksvinnadehasya| ayaM ca virecanA~ggaH snehasvedakramo vamanAnantarabhAvivirecane~api peyAdikramottarakAlaM kartavyaH; yaduktaM- ‘vilepyAH kramAgataM cainaM punareva snehasvedAbhyAmupapAdya virecayet’ iti| snehAnantaraM ca yattryahaM virecanArthaM pratibhojanaM, tadupakramAbhidhAnAnuSha~ggapratipAditameveti na punariha pratipAdyate| yathAvaditi kalpasthanoktavidhinA| yogyatamamiti sharIradoShAdyapekShayA yadvirecanaM yaugikaM bhavati taddeyam||10||-

peyAM vilepImakRutaM kRutaM ca yUShaM rasaM trirdvirathaikashashca||11||

Commentary: vamanavirecanottarabhAvipeyAdikramamAha- peyAM vilepImityAdi| yavAgUH bahusikthA| vilepI viraladravA| uktaM hi- ‘sikthakai rahito maNDaH, peyA sikthasamanvitA| yavAgUrbahusikthA syAdvilepI viraladravA’ iti| atra akRutayUShaH snehalavaNAdyasaMskRutaH, kRutayUShaH snehalavaNAdisaMskRutaH; evaM rase~api kRutAkRutavyavasthA| yaduktaM sUdashAstre ‘asnehalavaNaM sarvamakRutaM kaTukairvinA| vij~jeyaM lavaNasnehakaTukaiH saMskRutaM kRutam” iti| tririti annakAlatrayaM vyApya, dviriti annakAladvayam, ekasha iti ekAnnakAlam; etacca trirityAdi pratyekaM peyAdibhiH sambadhyate| etacca trirityAdi pakShatrayaM pradhAnashuddhishuddhAdyapekShayA yathAkramaM j~jeyam| tena, pradhAnashuddhishuddhe pratyekaM triH peyAdi kartavyaM, tenAnnakAlatraye peyA, tataH pareNAnnakAlatraye vilepI, tataH pareNAnnakAlatraye kRutAkRutayUShasahitamannaM , tato~api ca pareNa kRutAkRutarasenAnnamannakAlatraye deyam; evaM dvAdashabhirannakAlairvamanadinasAyAhnAt prabhRuti saptarAtreNa peyAdikramaH | ayameva krama upakalpanIye~api- “tataH sAyAhne lohitashAlitaNDulAnAM” ityAdinA, yAvat “dvAdashe cAnnakAle” (sU.a.15) ityanenoktaH | atra yUSharasayostu yadyapi kAlavibhAgo na pratipAditastathA~api yUShakAlatraye rasakAlatraye ca prathamamakRutasya uttarakAle ca kRutasya yUShasya, evaM rasasyApi kAlavibhAgaH kathanIyaH| evaM dviHpeyAdikramastathA ekashashca peyAdikramo varNanIya iti| ekakAle tu peyAdikrame yadyapi kRutAkRutayUSharasayoH kAlavibhAgo na prApyate, tathA~apyekasminneva kAle stokasaMskAreNa yUSharasayostatra kRutAkRutatvaM j~jeyam| pradhAnashuddhe bhUridoShagamanakShobhAdagnimAndyaM sambhavati, tena tatra peyAdikramashciraM kriyata iti j~jeyam| pradhAnashuddhyAdilakShaNaM cAgre vakShyamANam||11||-

yathA~aNuragnistRuNagomayAdyaiH sandhukShyamANo bhavati krameNa||12||

Commentary: peyAdikramasya vishodhanamandIkRutAgnerdIpakatvaM dRuShTAntena darshayannAha- yathetyAdi||12||-

kalpasthAnAnantaraM pArisheShyAdeva siddhisthAnamabhidhIyate| siddherabhidhAyakaM sthAnaM siddhisthAnam| siddhishabdena ceha vamanAdInAM vamanAdyasamyagyogajanyAnAM vyApadAM bheShajasya sAdhyatArUpA siddhirucyate, evambhUtasiddhikAraNAbhidhAyakatayA caitat siddhisthAnamucyate; kiMvA kAryakAraNayorabhedopacArAt siddhishabdeneha siddhikAraNAnyeva vamanAdInyucyante, uktaM hi “samyakprayogaM caiva karmaNAM vyApannAnAM ca vyApatsAdhanAni siddhiShUpadekShyAmaH” (sU.a.4) iti| na caivaM siddhisthAnasa~jj~jAvyutpattyA cikitsAsthAnAdInAmapi siddhisthAnasa~jj~jAprasaktirudbhAvanIyA, yata iyaM sa~jj~jA~atraiva yogarUDhyA vartate nAnyatra||1-2||

pradhAnashuddhyAdilakShaNaM prAha- jaghanyetyAdi| caturbhirvegairyacchodhanaM vamanaM tajjaghanyaM, yattu ShaDbhistanmadhyamaM, yattvaShTabhistat pravaram| vireke jaghanye dasha, madhye tu virecane dviguNA dashaviMshatirityarthaH, pravare tu virecane triguNA dasha triMshadityarthaH| vegasa~gkhyAvibhedena jaghanyAdibhedamabhidhAya doShamAnabhedenApi virecanasya jaghanyamadhyapravaratAM yathAkramamAha- prasthastathetyAdi| dviguNaH prastho jaghanye virecane, triguNashca madhyame, caturguNastu pravare| atra ca prasthashabdena sArdhatrayodashapalAnyucyante; uktaM hi tantrAntare “vamane ca vireke ca tathA shoNitamokShaNe| sArdhatrayodashapalaM prasthamAhurmanIShiNaH” iti| pittAntamiShTaM vamanaM virekAdardhamiti vireke yanmAnaM jaghanyamadhyapravaravibhAge proktaM yathAkramaM tathA vamane~api jaghanyamadhyapravaravibhAge tadardhaM j~jeyaM, paraM tu yat pittAntatvaM vamanasya, kaphAntatvaM virekasya, tat trividhashuddhAvarthAgataM j~jeyam| yadA caturbhirvegaiH prasthamAne doShe gate pittAntatvaM samyagvamanashuddhijalakShaNamupalabhyate tadA jaghanyA shuddhiH, yadA ca vireke dashabhirvegerdviprasthamAnadoShagamane kaphAntatvaM virecanasamyagyogalakShaNamupalabhyate tadA virecanasya jaghanyA shuddhirbhavati; evaM madhyapravarashuddhAvapi vamane pittAntatvaM, virecane kaphAntatvaM, samyagyogalakShaNaM j~jeyam| vegasa~gkhyAdoShamAnAbhidhAnAnantaraM samyakshuddhilai~ggikashuddheH pittAntatvAdilakShaNapratipAdanArthamihAbhidhAnaM, tena yaducyate AntikI, vaigikI, mAnikI, lai~ggikI ceti caturvidhA shuddhirihocyate vamanavirecanayoH, tadasmAkamasammatameva; kintu lai~ggikI caikA shuddhiH| tatra ca pittAntatvaM tathA ‘kramAtkaphaH’ ityAdigranthavakShyamANaM ca li~ggaM vamane, virecane ca kaphAntatvaM tathA ‘srotovishuddhIndriya’ ityAdigranthavakShyamANaM ca li~ggaM j~jeyam| tena yadatra AShADhavarmaNA “samyagvishuddhili~ggaM lakShaNato~atha mAnAcca vegAcca doShAgamanAccoktaM, kimidaM vyastaM samastaM vA” ityAdinA~a~akShiptaM, tadanabhyupagamanirastameva| anyeShAM tvatra parihArA vistarabhayAnna likhitAH| jaghanyAdishuddhitraividhyaM cAtra jaghanyamadhyotkRuShTadoShaviShayatayA vyavasthApanIyam| jaghanyAdishuddhilakShaNe~api yadvegena jaghanyAdishuddhilakShaNAbhidhAnaM, tat prAyobhAvitayA j~jeyam| doShamAnabhedena jaghanyAdimAnabhedaH pAramArthikaH; tena yatra vamane~aShTAbhirvegairdviprasthadoShasrutirbhavati tatra pravaraiva shuddhiH, yatra vamane ShaDbhireva vegaiH sArdhaprasthadoShasrutirbhavati tatra madhyaiva shuddhi;, yatra ca caturbhirapi vegairekaprasthadoShasrutistatra jaghanyashuddhireva; evaM virecaneShvapyudAhAryam| pittapravRuttirante yasmin tat pittAntam, evaM kaphAntamapi vyAkhyeyam| tena ‘kramAt kaphaH pittamathAnilashca’ ityanena yat samyagvamanalakShaNaM vaktavyaM, tathA ‘prAptishca viTpittakaphAnilAnAM’ ityanena ca samyagvirecanalakShaNaM yadvaktavyaM, tadanena sahAviruddhaM bhavati| tatra ca yadanilAgamanamante vaktavyaM tat pittAntasya kaphAntasya ca sUcakatayA j~jeyaM, niHsheShakRute hyAshayagate pitte kaphe ca vAyuH kevalaH sarati; tena ca kevalavAyusaraNena pittAntatA kaphAntatA ca j~jAyate| nanu yadi ‘kramAt kaphaH” ityAdinaiva granthenAyamartho~abhihitastat kathamiha pittAntaM ca vamanaM, kaphAntaM ca virekamAhuriti kRutaM? bUmaH- vegasa~gkhyAdoShamAnabhedapratipAdyamAnajaghanyAdishuddhitraye pittAntatvAdyanugatipratipAdanArthamihAbhidhAnam; evaM tadvamanavirecanasamyagyogalakShaNAnabhidhAne hi shiShyasya prabaladoShe~api puruShe~ayogashuddhAveva jaghanyashuddhigatavegamAnodaye sati atha pittAntatvAdyanudaye jaghanyashuddhibhramaH syAt evamnyadapyudAhAryam| vamane ca vireke ca yathA doShamApanaM kartavyaM tadAha- dvitrAnityAdi| dvitrAnityavyavasthitabhAShaNena malabhAgasyAmeyatAM darshayati; vamane tu pItamiti vamane pItamauShadhaM varjayitvA sheSho meyaH||13-14||-

vamanavirecanakalpanAprastAvAgatasamyagyogAdilakShaNamabhidhAya bastikalpanAmAha- saMsRuShTabhaktamityAdi| saptabhirdinaiH kRutasaMsarjanakramasyAShTame bhuktamupayuktasya navame~ahni sarpiHpAnamanuvAsanaM vA deyam; atra vikalpadvaye yadi vamanAnantaraM virecanaM kartavyaM tadA navame~ahni sarpiHpAnam, atha virecanAnantaraM yadA bastirdeyastadA~anuvAsanaM navame~ahni deyamiti vyavasthA| vamamAnantaraM navamadivase sarpiH pAnaM pUrvaM noktaM tenedAnIM virecanAnantarakartavyanirUhA~ggAnuvAsanasamAnakAlatayA sarpiH pAnamapi darshitaM, tena na nirUhA~ggatA sarpiHpAnasya kalpanIyA| navamashca divaso~atra shodhanadinamArabhyaiva j~jeyaH; uktaM ca jatUkaNa- ‘shodhanAnantaraM navame~ahni snehapAnamanuvAsanaM vA” iti, tathA sushrute~apyuktaM- “virecanAt saptarAtre gate jAtabalAya ca| kRutAnnAyAnuvAsyAya samyagdeyo~anuvAsanaH” (su.ci.a.37) iti| uttarabasticikitsite ca yaH peyAdikramAnantaraM rasasaMsarjanakrama uktaH, sa sarvakarmAvasAne prakRutibhojanagamanArthaM kartavyaH, na vamanavirecanakarmaparisamAptAveva, tenehAkRutarasasaMsargasyaiva navame dine sarpiHpAnamanuvAsanaM copapannam| yattu bhadrashaunake- “saMsRuShTabhaktaH sumanAH snehapIto dRuDhAnalaH| saMshuddhaH parato mAsAdanuvAsyastato naraH” ityuktaM, tat prAganuvAsanaviShayaM rogavisheShaviShayaM veti naitadviruddhaM bhavati; bahUni cAtra vyAkhyAnAni TIkAkRutAma~ggiri-saindhava-jejjaTeshvarasenAdInAM santi; anyaistu tadvyAkhyAnAni doShoddhArAdeva nirastAni| tailAktagAtrAyeti vacanamabhya~ggenApi snehaprayogadarshanArtham| svedastvatra pa~jcakarmapUrvatayA vihito~anukto~apyAyAtyeva; yaduktaM ‘tAnyupasthitadoShaNAM snehasvedopapAdanaiH| pa~jcakarmANi kurvIta” (sU.a.2) iti| dadyAtryahAditi anuvAsanadinAdUrdhvaM tryahAt, tena yathAvakShyamANakrameNa ekAhAd dvyahAdadhikAdvA snehAttadaharvA nirUho deyaH| nAtibubhukShitAyetyanena atibubhukShitasya nirUho~atiyogAyordhvagamanAya ca bhavatIti sUcayati| tatra dhanvarasena pratibhojanaM virecanavadagnimAndyAbhAvAdbalAvahatvAcca yuktameva; yaduktaM bhoje- “AmastakAdvishuddhasya nirUheNa rasAdikam| kimarthaM vihitaM bhojyaM saMsargashca viriktavat|| virekaH pAvakaM hanti tadadhiShThAnasamplavAt| na tu bastistathA tasmAdyayonnayati pAvakam’ iti| nirUha eva doShAgnibalApekShayA rasAdinA peyAdinA vA bhojanaM darshayannAha- samIkShya vA doShabalaM yathArhamiti; balamiti agnibalam| narastata ityAdinA nirUDhasyAnuvAsanamAha| nishItyanena nirUhAnantaraM taddine kriyamANamanuvAsanaM nishyeva kartavyamiti darshayati, na shIte vasante ca sadyonirUDhasya rAtrAvevAnuvAsanaM na deyamiti anye tu nishItyanena tadahareva nirUDhAya sAyamanuvAsanaM deyamiti darshayati, tena yathAvakShyamANavibhAgena rAtrau divA vA deyamityAhuH| anuvAsanArha iti vacanena yadi sAmatA mando vA pAvako bhavati tadA tadaharanuvAsanaM na deyamiti sUcayati| ata eva jatUkarNe dvitIyadivasa evAnuvAsanamuktaM- “tatastryahAnnirUhe vyuShite bhuktavato~anuvAsanam” iti; hArIte~api- “vyuShTaM rajanyAM prasamIkShya tasmAdbalAbalaM vA~apyanuvAsanIyaH” ityuktam| “sadyo nirUDho~anuvAsyaH syAt” iti vacanaM nirUhajanitavAtakShobhayuktapuruShaviShayam||20-21||-

pratyAgate cetyAdau anuvAsanIye iti anuvAsanasnehe| vyuShitAyeti nirvikAraM rAtrivyuShitAya divA bhojyaM deyaM, tathA sAyaM ca bhojyaM deyam| anuvAsanAnantaraM punaranuvAsanakAlamAha-  tryahe vetyAdi| atrApi tryahapa~jcAhavyavasthA pUrvavat; aya~jcAnuvAsanakAlo nirUhadina eva dAtavyAnuvAsane parij~jeyaH| anye tu paThanti yat- ‘parato dvyahe vA tryahe~anuvAsyo~ahani pa~jcame vA’ iti; vyAkhyAnayanti ca- parato dvyahe vA tryahe~anuvAsyo~ahani pa~jcame veti; atra tu dvyahe~anuvAsanamatiprabalavAtasya, anativRuddhavAtasya tryahe, pa~jcame tu pravRuddhakaphapittasyeti vyavasthA| dvitIyadinAnuvAsanaM hArIte~apyuktaM; vacanaM hi- “dRuShTvA~ativRuddhaM pavanasya rUpaM dine dine bastimudAharanti” iti; sushrute~apyuktaM- “rUkShasya bahuvAtasya snehabastiM dine dine| dadyAdvaidyastato~anyeShAmagnyAbAdhabhayAtryahAt” (su.ci.a.37) iti| ihApi ‘rUkShanityastu” ityAdinA, ‘vAtArtAshca dine dine” (si.a.4) ityantena dvyahe dAnaM vidhAsyati, tena ‘dvyahe vA tryahe vA’ iti pAThaH sAdhuH; ‘dvyahashabdena cAtra dinadvayasambandhamAtramucyate, na dvyahapUraNaM; tena prathamadivasadattAnuvAsanAt prabhRuti pUrNe tRutIye divase~anuvAsanaM prApnoti’ iti yaducyate, tannirastam; evaM tryahe~api tRutIyAhasambandha eva vivakShito j~jeya iti||23-24||

‘ki~gguNo bastiH’ itiprashnasyottaraM bastirvayaHsthApayitetyAdi| ayaM cAsthApanaguNaH, anuvAsanasya tu dehe nirUheNa’ ityAdinA granthena guNAn vakShyati| vayaH sthApayatIti vayaHsthApayitA; vayaHsthApanatvaM cAsya srotaHshuddhikaratvAt| sarvArthakArIti sthiratvApakarShAdiviruddhArthasyApi bheShajavisheShayogAt| shishuvRuddhayUnAM niratyaya ityanena vamanavirecanAbhyAmutkarSha ucyate, te hi shishuvRuddhayorniShiddhe| sarvagadApahatvaM saMshamanena j~jeyaM, sarvAn vikArAn shamayedityanena doShasaMshodhanadvArA sarvagadApahatvamucyata iti na paunaruktyaM; kiMvA sarvAn vikArAniti sarvAvasthAn vikArAniti visheShaH||27-28||

dehe ityAdinA~anuvAsanaguNamAha| nirUheNa vishuddhamArge iti vacanAnnirUhashodhita eva mArge saMsarjadanuvAsanaM yathoktaguNakartRu bhavatIti darshayati| na tailadAnAdityatra tailashabdena snehopalakShaNena kecidghRutamapi grAhayanti, kintu tailamevAtra vAtaharapradhAnatayA brUte iti yuktaM pashyAmaH; tathA hyatra auShNyAcchaityamityuktam, auShNyaM ca na sarpiShIti; snehA majjavarjitA anuvAsanAdhikRutA apyapradhAnatvAnnAtra ghRutamanumanyate| paramastItyAdau dravyamiti kAraNaM, tacca kAraNamanilaprashamanena j~jeyam, ‘nAnvAsanAt ki~jcidihAsti karma’ iti kecit paThanti| tailakRutyameva sakAraNaM vyAkaroti- snehenetyAdi| tailaM cAnuvAsane pakvameva j~jeyam; apakvasya tu ‘na cAmaM praNayet snehaM sa hyabhiShyandayedgudam’ (si.a.4) ityanena niShiddhatvAt| atra tailAnilayorviparItaguNayormelake dravyaprabhAvAttailameva vAtaM hanti, na vAtastailam; aNutvaM guNo yadyapi taile vAte cAsti, tathA~apIha prabhAvAdvAtasUkShmAvayavasambaddhaM tailaM snehAdinA vAtaM jayati, tena samAnamapyaNutvamiha viruddhArthakAryeveti| tailasya yathoktakAryakartRutve dRuShTAntamAha- mUle ityAdi| mUladRuShTAntena cAnuvAsanena sAkShAttarpaNIyasya gudasya dehamUlatvaM darshayati, uktaM hi parAshare- “mUlaM gudaM sharIrasya sirAstatra pratiShThitAH| sarvaM sharIraM puShNanti mUrdhAnaM yAvadAshritAH” iti; tathA~anuvAsanAdapi naro balavIryAdyupeto~apatyavAMshca syAdityarthaH||29-31||

sAmAnyena nirUhAnuvAsanayorguNamAha- stabdhAshca ye ityAdi| bhagnA iti bhagnakAyAH ; rugNA iti sandhimuktAH| bhaktAnabhinandane arocake| vAtakRutopasargA iti vAtakRutopadravAH| kShINendriyA iti atikShINashukrAH| atra shuddhavAtAdiShvanuvAsanaM, bhaktAnabhinandanaprakAreShu ca nirUha ityAdyartho~anusaraNIyaH||32-34||

basterbahuviShayAM stutimAcakShANaH ‘ki~gguNo bastiH’ iti prashnasyaivottaraM punarAha- shAkhAgatA ityAdi| shAkhAkoShThamarmagatA ityanena trividhashAkhAdirogamargo gRuhItaH; marmajashabdena hi madhyamarogamArgAshrayiNAM sandhijAnAmapi sAhacaryAdgrahaNam; iha marmAsthisndhayo hi madhyamo rogamArga uktaH| Urdhvasarvashabdena ca UrdhvAdhastiryagbhedAdapyuktarogamArgatrayagrahaNam| sarvAvayavA~ggajashabdena ca prAdeshikasarvA~ggabhedAdapyuktagrahaNam; vAyoH paramiti vAyoH paro na kashcit shreShTha iti yAvat| etena yadyapi kaphapitte api rogakAraNe bhavataH, tathA~api vAyureva shreShTha ityucyate| vAyoH shreShThatva eva hetumAha- viNmUtretyAdi| pittAdItyatrAdishabdena kaphasya grahaNaM, (na ca malashabdena kaphasya grahaNaM ,) malashabdena cetaradhAtumalAnAM khamalAdInAM ca grahaNam| Ashayashabdena malavyatiriktaprasAdAkhyAnAmAshayAnAM dhAtUnAM ca grahaNam| vikShepasa~gghAtakara iti viyogamelakakaraH; etena, yasmAdvAyureva doShamaladhAtUnAM saMyogavibhAgau karoti, tena doShadUShyaviNmalamelakarUpanikhilavyAdhikaraNe vAyureva pradhAnaM bhavatIti bhAvaH| kiMvA AshayashabdaH pratyekaM viDAdibhiH sambadhyate, sthAnena ca sthAnino labhyante, viDAdisaMyogavibhAgenaiva ca sarvavyAdhikaraNaparigraho bhavati| bhavatvevaM vAtasya prAdhAnyamataH kimityAha- tasyetyAdi| bheShajamiti pradhAnaM bheShajaM, yaduktaM- ‘bastirvAtaharANAm’ (sU.a.25) iti| ato bastAvardhacikitsArUpatA tathA sarvacikitsArUpatA ca yuktaiva||38-39||-

samprati sa~gkhyAprashnasyottaravisheShamAha- triMshadityAdi| karmakAlayogasa~jj~jA yathAkramaM triMshatShoDashAShTabastisamudayeShu j~jeyA| kAlastato~ardhenetyatra ardhashabdo na samaprativacanaH ; tena triMshadadha ShoDasha bhavanti| sAnvasanA ityAdinA karmAdInAM nirUhAnuvAsanavibhAgamAha| ekamanuvAsanaM dattvA dIyanta iti sAnvasanAH, evamanuvAsanena pratyekaM yogAd dvAdasha nirUhAshcaturviMshatirbastayo bhavanti| prAgiti Aramme| parata iti dvAdashanirUhottarakAle| nirUhAntaritAshca ShaT syuriti nirUheNAntarI kRutAH, evaM ca dvAdasha bastayaH pUraNIyAH| pa~jcaiva parAdimadhyA iti pa~jca snehA ante madhye Adau ca yeShAM vibhaktAste tathA; atra cAdau snehadvayam, ante ca snehadvayaM, nirUhatrayamadhye caikamanuvAsanam, evaM pa~jca snehA bhavanti| ye tu nirUhadina evAnuvAsanaM vadanti tanmate AdAveka eva, ante~api dinAntare ekaH, evaM pa~jca bhavanti; evaM karmakAlayorapi nirUhadina eva dinAntare vA~anuvAsanaM vyAkhyeyam| atra caikasnehAntaritAnAM nirUhANAM dAne vAtakShobho nAsha~gkanIyaH, karmAdiShu nirUhA yApanAbastirUpA dIyante, te snigdhA eveti kRutvA na vAtakShobhakA bhavanti| ete ca karmAdayo yadyapi shAstrapradesheShu na vyavahriyante, tathA~api tadvidyavyavahArArthameveyaM karmAdisa~jj~jA, yathA yamakamahAcchapAnAdisa~jj~jA; tena karmAdisa~jj~jAyAH shAstre vyavahArAdarshanAt karmAdipratipAdako grantho~anArSha iti yaducyate, tannirastam| karmAdisa~jj~jA ca tantrAntare~apyasti| tathAhi jatUkarNaH- “bastayastriMshat ShoDashAShTau ca karmakalayogAH; nirUhAH snehAntaritA dvAdasha ShaT trayaH; ekasnehArambhAH pa~jcatryekAntAH” iti; hArIte~api- “triMshakaM karma budhA vadanti” ityAdyuktam| karmAdInAM prayogaM kecidvAtAdiShu vadanti||47-48||-

samprati kramAgatashirovirecanasya kalpanAmasamyagyogAyegAtiyogalakShaNaM cAha- vishuddhetyAdi| vishuddhadehasyeti etacca pa~jcakarmasampAdanIyanRuviShayatvaM shuddhipUrvakatvaM shirovirecanasyehocyate; tena vamanAdinA~ashuddhe~api shirovirecanaikasampadyi puruShe~ayaM kramoj~jeyaH| snigdhamiti abhya~ggashirobastipAnAdinA| talasveditamiti hastatalasveditam| trirdvirathaikasha iti taddina eva doShANAmutkRuShTatvAdibalatraividhyamapekShya yathAyogyatayA yojyam| indriyAcchyamiti cakShurAdInAM svaviShaye pATavam| timiraM ca pashyediti tamovyAptaM sarvaM pashyedityarthaH| tasyAtiyogAyogayoshcikitsitamanu vaktavyatayA~anuSha~ggatAmAha- syAttarpaNamityAdi| mRudu dravaM cetyanenAtiyogacikitsitam| tIkShNaM tu punarna yoge iti ayoge shirovirecanasya punastIkShNaM shirovirecanaM deyam||50-52||-

siddhisthAnAbhidhAne~api sakalasiddhisthAnApekShaNIyapa~jcakarmakalpanAdyabhidhAyakatayA prAdhAnyAdAdau kalpanAsiddhirevocyate| atra ‘kA kalpanA’ ityAdIn shiShyasya dvAdashaprashnAnabhiniveshya tAn yathAkramaM vyAcaShTe prashnAnuguNagurubuddhiprakAshArtham| yaduktaM bharadvAjena- “apraduShTena bhAvena prasannenAntarAtmanA| shiShyeNa samyak pRuShTasya gurorbuddhiH prakAshate” iti| atra ‘kA kalpanA pa~jcasu karmasUktA’ iti prathamaH prashnaH, ‘kramashca kaH’ iti dvitIyaH, ‘ki~jca kRutAkRuteShu li~ggaM tathaivAtikRuteShu’ iti tRutIyaH, ‘sa~gkhyA kA’ iti caturthaH, ‘ki~gguNo bastiH’ iti pa~jcamaH, ‘keShu ca kashca bastiH’ iti ShaShThaH, ‘kiM varjanIyaM pratikarmakAle’ iti saptamaH, ‘kRute kiyAn vA parihArakAlaH’ ityaShTamaH, ‘praNIyamAnashca na yAti kena bastiH’ iti navamaH, ‘kenaiti shIghraM’ iti dashamaH, ‘sucirAcca kenaiti’ ityekAdashaH, ‘sAdhyAH’ ityAdiko dvAdashaH| sAdhyA ityAdiprashnasya yadyapyavakAsho nAsti, yato hi nAsAdhyA gadAH proktena yathAsvaM kriyamANena bheShajena prashAmyanti, tathA~apyasamyagbheShaje eva yathAsvaM bheShajAbhidhAnAdayaM prashnoboddhavyaH||3-5||-

‘sAdhyAH’ ityAdi prashnasyottaraM- medaHkaphAbhyAmityAdi| medasA kaphena veti medaH kaphAbhyAm| atra shUlAdInnirIkShya shuddhavAtabhrAntyA snehaM prayu~gkte, nAvaraNaM jAnAti, ata eva ‘abudhaH’ iti kRutam| anyatrApyuktaM- “kupite mArgasaMrodhAnmedasA vA kaphena vA| ativRuddhe~anile nAdau shastaM snehena bRuMhaNam” iti| avitarkyamANA iti asamyagj~jAyamAnAH| asamyagj~jAyamAnatva eva hetumAha- paraspareNetyAdi| rogashabdenAtra doSho~abhipretaH| paraspareNa pratibaddhamArgA ato durgrahA bhavanti, tathA dhAtubhishca raktAdibhiH sandUShitAH sammUrcchitAH santo durj~jeyA bhavanti, avij~jAtAshca svairbheShajairna prashamaM vrajanti; svairbheShajairiti mArgAvarodhAdikAraNadoShadhAtvantaranirapekShakairekadoShabheShajaiH; taddhi tathAbhUtAnAM bheShajaM yaugikaM na bhavatyeva, ato~anupashamo yukta evaH evaM ca doShANAM parasparAvarodhAn tathA dhAtusammUrcchanavisheShAMshcAvagamyaiva vyAdhau prapa~jco~anusaraNIyaH||57-58||-
athAtaH pa~jcakarmIyAM siddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

yeShAM yasmAt pa~jcakarmANyagnivesha na kArayet| yeShAM ca kArayettAni tat sarvaM sampravakShyate||3||

Commentary: yeShAmityAdinA~adhyAyArthaM sa~gkalpya pratijAnIte| pa~jcakarmANi yeShAM na kAryANItyanena vyastAni samastAni ca yeShAM na kAryANi, tAni pRuthagvakShyante||3||

anAsthApyAstu ajIrNyatisnigdhapItasnehotkliShTadoShAlpAgniyAnaklAntAtidurbalakShuttRuShNAshramArtAtikRushabhuktabhaktapItodakavamitaviriktakRutanastaH karmakuddhabhItamattamUrcchitaprasaktacchardiniShThIvikAshvAsakAsahikkAbaddhacchidrodakodarAdhmAnAlasakavisUcikAmaprajAtAmAtisAra- madhumehakuShThArtAH||14||

tatrAjIrNyatisnigdhapItasnehAnAM dUShyodaraM mUrcchAshvayathurvA syAt, utkliShTadoShamandAgnyorarocakastIvraH, yAnaklAntasya kShobhavyApanno bastirAshu dehaM shoShayet, atidurbalakShuttRuShNAshramArtAnAM pUrvoktodoShaH syAt, atikRushasya kArshyaM punarjanayet, bhuktabhaktapItodakayorutklishyordhvamadho vA vAyurbastimutkShipya kShipraM ghorAn vikArA~jjanayet, vamitaviriktayostu rUkShaM sharIraM nirUhaH kShataM kShAra iva dahet, kRutanastaHkarmaNo vibhraMshaM bhRushasaMruddhasrotasaH kuryAt, kruddhabhItayorbastirUrdhvamupaplavet, mattamUrcchitayo rbhRushaM vicalitAyAM sa~jj~jAyAM cittopaghAtAd vyApat syAt, prasaktacchardirniShThIvikAshvAsakAsahikkArtAnAmUrdhvIbhUto vAyurUrdhvaM bastiM nayet, baddhacchidrodakodarAdhmAnArtAnAM bhRushataramAdhyApya bastiH prANAn hiMsyAt, alasakavisUcikAmaprajAtAmAtisAriNAmAmakRuto doShaH syAt, madhumehakuShThinorvyAdheH punarvRuddhiH; tasmAdete nAsthApyAH||15||

sheShAstvAsthApyAH; visheShatastu sarvA~ggaikA~ggakukShirogavAtavarcomUtrashukrasa~ggabalavarNamAMsaretaHkShayadoShAdhmAnA~ggasuptikrimikoShThodAvartashuddhAtisAra- parvabhedAbhitApaplIhagulmashUlahRudrogabhagandaronmAdajvarabradhnashiraHkarNashUlahRudayapArshvapRuShThakaTIgrahavepanAkShepakagauravAtilAghava- rajaHkShayArtaviShamAgnisphigjAnuja~gghorugulphapArShNiprapadayonibAhva~ggulistanAntadantanakhaparvAsthishUla- shoShastambhAntrakUjaparikartikAlpAlpasashabdogragandhotthAnAdayo vAtavyAdhayo visheSheNa mahArogAdhyAyoktAshca; eteShvAsthApanaM pradhAnatamamityuktaM vanaspatimUlacchedavat||16||

Commentary: visheSheNAsthApyAnAha- sarvA~ggetyAdi| sphigAdibhiH shUlashoShastambhAH sambadhyante||16||

ya evAnAsthApyAsta evAnanuvAsyAH syuH; visheShatastvabhuktabhaktanavajvarapANDurogakAmalApramehArshaHpratishyAyArocakamandAgnidurbalaplIhakaphodarorustambhavarcobheda- viShagarapItapittakaphAbhiShyandagurukoShThashlIpadagalagaNDApacikrimikoShThinaH ||17||

tatrAbhuktabhaktasyAnAvRutamArgatvAdUrdhvamativartate snehaH, navajvarapANDurogakAmalApramehiNAM doShAnutklishyodara~jjanayet, arshasasyArshAMsyabhiShyandyAdhmAnaM kuryAt, arocakArtasyAnnagRuddhiM punarhanyAt, mandAgnidurbalayormandataramagniM kuryAt, pratishyAyaplIhAdimatAM bhRushamutkliShTadoShANAM bhUya eva doShaM vardhayet; tasmAdete nAnuvAsyAH||18||
ya evAsthApyAsta evAnuvAsyAH; visheShatastu rUkShatIkShNAgnayaH kevalavAtarogArtAshca; eteShu hyanuvAsanaM pradhAnatamamityuktaM mUle drumaprasekavat||19||

ashirovirecanArhAstu ajIrNibhuktabhaktapItasnehamadyatoyapAtukAmAH snAtashirAH snAtukAmaH kShuttRuShNAshramArtamattamUrcchitashastradaNDahatavyavAyavyAyAmapAnaklAntanavajvarashokAbhitaptaviriktAnuvAsitagarbhiNInavapratishyAyArtAH, anRutau durdine ceti||20||

tatrAjIrNibhuktabhaktayordoSha UrdhvavahAni srotAMsyAvRutya kAsashvAsacchardipratishyAyA~jjanayet, pItasnehamadyatoyapAtukAmAnAM kRute ca pibatAM mukhanAsAsrAvAkShyupadehatimirashirorogA~jjanayet, snAtashirasaH kRute ca snAnAcchirasaH pratishyAyaM, kShudhArtasya vAtaprakopaM, tRuShNArtasya punastRuShNAbhivRuddhiM mukhashoShaM ca, shramArtamattamUrcchitAnAmAsthApanoktaM doShaM janayet, shastradaNDahatayostIvratarAM rujaM janayet, vyavAyavyAyAmapAnaklAntAnAM shiraHskandhanetroraHpIDanaM, navajvarashokAbhitaptayorUShmA netranADIranusRutya timiraM jvaravRuddhiM ca kuryAt, viriktasya vAyurindriyopaghAtaM kuryAt, anuvAsitasya kaphaH shirogurutvakaNDUkrimidoShA~jjanayet, garbhiNyA garbhaM stambhayet sa kANaH kuNiH pakShahataH pIThasarpI vA jAyate, navapratishyAyArtasya srotAMsi vyApAdayet, anRutau durdine ca shItadoShAn pUtinasyaM shirorogaM ca janayet; tasmAdete na shirovirecanArhAH||21||

sheShAstvarhAH, visheShatastu shirodantamanyAstambhagalahanugrahapInasagalashuNDikAshAlUkashukratimiravartmarogavya~ggo pajihvikArdhAvabhedakagrIvAskandhAMsAsyanAsikAkarNAkShimUrdhakapAlashirorogArditApatantrakApatAnakagalagaNDa- dantashUlaharShacAlAkShirAjyarbudasvarabhedavAggrahagadgadakrathanAdaya UrdhvajatrugatAshcavAtAdivikArAH paripakvAshca; eteShu shirovirecanaM pradhAnatamamityuktaM, taddhyuttamA~ggamanupravishya mu~jjAdIShikAmivAsaktAM kevalaM vikArakaraM doShamapakarShati||22||

Commentary: shirodantetyAdinA visheSheNa shirovirecanArhAnAha| shirodantamanyAbhiH stambhashabdaH sambadhyate| pInaso~atra pakvapratishyAyaH, taruNe ca pratishyAye shirovirekaniShedha iti na virodhaH| apatantrakaH apatAnakabheda eva niHsa~jj~jaH; uktaM hi- “niHsa~jj~jaH so~apatantrakaH” (si.a.9) iti| shUlaharShacAlA dantena sambadhyante| akShirAjI netrarAjI , netrarogavisheShaH| vAtavikAre~apyatravirecanaM sthAnasambandhAgatashleShmavAtahantRutvenaivopapannam| mu~jjAdIShikAmivAsaktAmiti mu~jjAccharAvayavAdyathA IShikA sharikA AsaktA AkRuShyate mu~jjAnupaghAtena, tathA shirasi pakvo doSho hriyata ityarthaH||22||

prAvRuTsharadvasantetareShvAtyayikeShu rogeShu nAvanaM kuryAt kRutrimaguNopadhAnAt; grIShme pUrvAhNe, shIte madhyAhne, varShAsvadurdine ceti||23||

Commentary: anRutau shirovirecanaM niShiddham, avasthAvashena tadvidhAnamAha- prAvRuDityAdi| itareShviti hemantagrIShmavarShAsu| AtyayikeShvitivacanAdanAtyayikeShu gadeShu niShedhayati| Atyayike~api shItAdipratIkArArthamAha- kRutrimaguNopadhAnAditi; kRutrimaguNopadhAnaM rogabhiShagjitIyoktaM kartavyam| grIShmAdiShveva kAlavisheSheNauShNyAdipratikriyAM darshayannAha- grIShme pUrvAhNe ityAdi||23||
caNDaH sAhasiko bhIruH kRutaghno vyagra eva ca| sadrAjabhiShajAM dveShTA taddviShTaH shokapIDitaH||4||
yAdRucchiko mumUrShushca vihInaH karaNaishca yaH| vairI vaidyavidagdhashca shraddhAhInaH susha~gkitaH||5||
bhiShajAmavidheyashca nopakramyA bhiShagvidA| etAnupacaran vaidyo bahUn doShAnavApnuyAt||6||
ebhyo~anye samupakramyA narAH sarvairupakramaiH| avasthAM pravibhajyaiShAM varjyaM kAryaM ca vakShyate||7||
tatra shlokAH- iti pa~jcavidhaM karma vistareNa nidarshitam| yebhyo yanna hitaM yasmAt karma yebhyashca yaddhitam||24||
na caikAntena nirdiShTe~apyarthe~abhinivishedbudhaH| svayamapyatra vaidyena tarkyaM buddhimatA bhavet||25||
utpadyeta hi sA~avasthA deshakAlabalaM prati| yasyAM kAryamakAryaM syAt karma kAryaM ca varjitam||26||
chardirhRudrogagulmAnAM vamanaM sve cikitsite| avasthAM prApya nirdiShTaM kuShThinAM bastikarma ca||27||
tasmAt satyapi nirdeshe kuryAdUhya svayaM dhiyA| vinA tarkeNa yA siddhiryadRucchAsiddhireva sA||28||

avamyAstAvat- kShatakShINAtisthUlAtikRushabAlavRuddhadurbalashrAntapipAsitakShudhitakarmabhArAdhvahatopavAsamaithunAdhyayanavyAyAmacintA- prasaktakShAmagarbhiNIsukumArasaMvRutakoShThadushchardanordhvaraktapittaprasaktacchardirUrdhvavAtAsthApitAnuvAsitahRudrogodAvartamUtrAghAta- plIhagulmodarAShThIlAsvaropaghAtatimirashirasha~gkhakarNAkShishUlArtAH||8||

tatra kShatasya bhUyaH kShaNanAdraktAtipravRuttiH syAt, kShINAtisthUlakRushabAlavRuddhadurbalAnAmauShadhabalAsahatvAt prANoparodhaH, shrAntapipAsitakShudhitAnAM ca tadvat, karmabhArAdhvahatopavAsamaithunAdhyayanavyAyAmacintAprasaktakShAmANAM raukShyAdvAtaraktacchedakShatabhayaM syAt, garbhiNyA garbhavyApadAmagarbhabhraMshAccadAruNA rogaprAptiH, sukumArasya hRudayApakarShaNAdUrdhvamadho vA rudhirAtipravRuttiH, saMvRutakoShThadushchachardanayoratimAtrapravAhaNAddoShAH samutkliShTA antaHkoShThe janayantyantarvisarpaM stambhaM jADyaM vaicittyaM maraNaM vA, Urdhvagaraktapittina udAnamutkShipya prANAn haredraktaM cAtipravartayet, prasaktacchardestadvat, UrdhvavAtAsthApitAnuvAsitAnAmUrdhvaM vAtAtipravRuttiH, hRudrogiNohRudayoparodhaH, udAvartino ghoratara udAvartaH syAcchIghratarahantA, mUtrAghAtAdibhirArtAnAM tIvratarashUlaprAdurbhAvaH, timirArtAnAM timirAtivRuddhiH, shiraHshUlAdiShu shUlAtivRuddhiH; tasmAdete na vamyAH| sarveShvapi tu khalveteShu viShagaraviruddhAjIrNAbhyavahArAmakRuteShvapratiShiddhaM shIghratarakAritvAdeShAmiti ||9||

sheShAstu vamyAH; visheShatastu pInasakuShThanavajvararAjayakShmakAsashvAsagalagrahagalagaNDashlIpadamehamandAgniviruddhAjIrNAnna visUcikAlasakaviShagarapItadaShTadigdhaviddhAdhaHshoNitapittapraseka (durnAma ) hRullAsArocakAvipAkApacyapasmAronmAdAtisArashophapANDurogamukhapAkaduShTastanyAdayaH shleShmavyAdhayo visheSheNa mahArogAdhyAyoktAshca; eteShu hi vamanaM pradhAnatamamityuktaM kedArasetubhede shAlyAdyashoShadoShavinAshavat||10||

Commentary: sheShAstu vamyA ityabhidhAyApi pInasAdIn punarvamanaviShayatayA darshayan teShu visheSheNa vamanasya yaugikatAM darshayati; evamuttaratrApi punarvirecanAdiviShayopadarshane vyAkhyeyam| pradhAnatamamityanena mahArogAdhyAye “kedArasetubhede” (sU.a.20) ityAdinaikadeshenoktaM prAdhAnyakhyApakaM granthaM grAhayati; tena yaduktaM tatra- “vamanaM khalu sarvopakramebhyaH shleShmaNi pradhAnatamaM manyante bhiShajaH, taddhyAdita evAmAshayamanupravishya kevalaM vaikArikaM shleShmamUlamapakarShati, tatrAvajite shleShmaNyapi sharIrAntargatAH shleShmavikArAH prashAntimApadyante, yathA- bhinne kedArasetau shAliShaShTikAdInyabhiShyandamAnAnyambhasA prashoShamApadyante, tadvat” (sU.a.20) iti granthakhaNDakaM, tadiha sambadhyate; evaM virecanaprAdhAnye tathA bastiprAdhAnye~api yadihaikadeshaM mahArogAdhyAyoktaprAdhAnyakhyApakagranthakhaNDakaM vakShyati, tatra tadgranthAdhyAhAreNa yojanIyam||10||

avirecyAstu subhagakShatagudamuktanAlAdhobhAgaraktapittivila~gghitadurbalendriyAlpAgninirUDhakAmAdivyagrAjIrNinavajvari- madAtyayitAdhmAtashalyArditAbhihatAtisnigdharUkShadAruNakoShThAH kShatAdayashca garbhiNyantAH||11||

tatra subhagasya sukumArokto doShaH syAt, kShatagudasya kShate gude prANoparodhakarIM rujAM janayet, muktanAlamatipravRuttyA hanyAt, adhobhAgaraktapittinaM tadvat, vila~gghitadurbalendriyAlpAgninirUDhA auShadhavegaM na saheran, kAmAdivyagramanaso na pravartate kRucchreNa vA pravartamAnamayogadoShAn kuryAt, ajIrNina AmadoShaH syAt, navajvariNo~avipakvAn doShAn na nirhared vAtameva ca kopayet, madAtyayitasya madyakShINe dehe vAyuH prANoparodhaM kuryAt, AdhmAtasyAdhamato vA purIShakoShThe nicito vAyurvisarpan sahasA~a~anAhaM tIvrataraM maraNaM vA janayet, shalyArditAbhihatayoH kShate vAyurAshrito jIvitaM hiMsyAt, atisnigdhasyAtiyogabhayaM bhavet, rUkShasya vAyura~ggapragrahaM kuryAt, dAruNakoShThasya virecanoddhatA doShA hRucchUlaparvabhedAnAhA~ggamardacchardimUrcchAklamA~jjanayitvA prANAn hanyuH, kShatAdInAM garbhiNyantAnAM chardanokto doShaH syAt; tasmAdete na virecyAH||12||

sheShAstu virecyAH; visheShatastu kuShThajvaramehordhvaraktapittabhagandarodarArshobradhaplIhagulmArbudagalagaNDagranthivisUcikAlasakamUtrAghAtakrimikoShThavisarpa- pANDurogashiraHpArshvashUlodAvartanetrAsyadAhahRudrogavya~gganIlikAnetranAsikAsyasravaNahalImakashvAsakAsakAmalA- pacyapasmAronmAdavAtaraktayoniretodoShataimiryArocakAvipAkacchardishvayathUdaravisphoTakAdayaH pittavyAdhayo visheSheNa mahArogAdhyAyoktAshca; eteShu hi virecanaM pradhAnatamamityuktamagnyupashame~agnigRuhavat||13||

Commentary: visheSheNa virecyAnAha- kuShThetyAdi| visUcikAyAM virecanamuttarakAlaM sheShadoShaharaNArthaM j~jeyam||13||

kalpanAsiddhau j~jAtapa~jcakarmopayogasya karmapravRuttinivRuttiviShayakajij~jAsA bhavatyatastadupadarshanArthaM pa~jcakarmIyasiddhirucyate| pa~jcakarmapravRuttinivRuttiviShayaj~jAnArthamadhikRutya kRutA siddhiH pa~jcakarmIyasiddhiH||1-2||

anAsthApyAnAha- anAsthApyAstvityAdi| madhumehashabdena sarvapramehagrahaNam| dUShyodaramiti sannipAtodaram| yAnaM rathAdiyAnam| dahed ‘bastiH’ iti sheShaH| vibhraMshamityatra ‘indriyANAm’ iti sheShaH| Urdhvamupalpavediti mukhAdibhirudgacchet| mattamUrcchitayorvyApat syAditi madamUrcchArUpA vyApat syAdityAhuH| baddhodarAdAvAdhmAtAnAM bastirniShidhyate; tena “snigdhAya baddhodariNe” ityAdinA yAvacca “nirUhaM sAnuvAsanam” (ci.a.13) iti granthena nirUhavidhAnamaviruddhaM bhavati; anye tu udarAdhyAya eva ‘baddhodariNe’ ityanena savibandhodariviShayaM nirUhaM varNayanti, tenAtra sAmAnyena baddhodare nirUhaniShedho na viruddhaH||14-15||

ananuvAsanaviShayopadarshane anAsthApyeShu bhuktabhaktaH paThitaH, tavdyudAsArthamabhuktabhaktopAdanam; anuvAsanamabhuktasyAnAvRutatvAdUrdhvaM yAti, na tu nirUha iti visheShaH; anuvAsanaM tu snehasya sUkShmatayA visaraNashIlaM sAyaM dIyate; tena tAMvatkAlamabhojanAcchUnyasharIrasyordhvaM yAti| anuvAsanaM ca “shUle ca bhaktAnabhinandane ca” (si.a.1) ityanena yadyapi vihitaM, tathA~apIha bhaktAnabhinandanahetvantarbhUtAyAmarucau tanniShedho na viruddhaH; anabhinandanaM hyashraddhAmAtraM vAtakRutam, arucistu sarvadA anicchA; kevalavAtarogashcAshraddhA, shuddhavAtarogayukto~anuvAsanArhaH| nirUhaprAdhAnyakhyApane vanaspatimUlocchedanavadityanena mahArogAdhyAyoktabastiprAdhAnyakhyApanagranthopadarshanaM; “yathA vanaspatermUle cchinne skandhashAkhAvarohakusumaphalapalAshAdInAM niyato vinAshastadvat” (sU.a.20) iti, mUle drumaprasekavaccetyanena kalpanAsiddhyuktaM- “mUle niShikto hi yathA drumaH syAt” (si.a.1) ityAdiyathoktAnuvAsanaprAdhAnyakhyApanagranthagrahaNaM karoti||17-19||

ashirovirecanArhAnAha- ashirovirecanArhA ityAdi| pAtukAma iti snehAdipAnakAmaH, pAnaklAnto dinAntare~api pAnajavyAdhipIDitaH| anRutau shItagrIShmavarShAsu| durdine iti meghAcchAdite~ahni| kRute pibatAmiti shirovirecane kRute snehAn pibatAmityarthaH| kuNiH kubjitakaraH ; pIThasarpI pa~gguH| anRutau durdine cetyAdau shItadoShAnityanena shItakAle dIyamAnasya durdine ca kRutasya pUtinAsAkartRutvaM, grIShmavarShAkRutasya tu shirorogakartRutvam; anye tu, anRutudurdinamityanena avArShikaM durdinamAhuH||20-21||

caNDa ityAdinA sakalapa~jcakarmAviShayAnAha| yadyapi ca vimAne janapadoddhvaMsanIye (vi.a.3) rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) ca anapavAdapratIkArAdayo~anupakramaNIyatvenoktA eva, tathA~apIha prakaraNAgatatvAt punarucyante| caNDAdiShu pravRuttirbheShajasyAshakyatvAnniShidhyate; kRutaghnAdiShu cAdharmavashAdeva bheShajaM na sidhyati, pratyutAdhArmikapratikriyayA~adharma eva bhavatIti nivRuttirvidhIyate| sato rAj~jaH bhiShajashca dveShTIti sadrAjabhiShajAM dveShTA, kiMvA saditi rAj~jo bhiShajashca visheShaNam| taddviShTa iti sadAdidveShyaH| yAdRucchikaH nAstikaH| vihInaH karaNairiti upakaraNaiH| vairI vaidyApakArakaH, vaidyadveShTA tu nApakAraka iti visheShaH| vaidyavidagdhaH vaidyamAnI| bhiShajAmavidheya iti bhiShajAmanAyattaH| sarvairiti vamanAdibhiranyaishca saMshamanAdibhiH| eShAmiti caNDAdivyatiriktAnAm||4-7||

adhyAyArthasa~ggrahamabhidhAya vamanAdyaviShayatvena tathA vamanAdiviShayatvena ca pratipAdite vamanAdinivRuttipravRuttinishcayaM niShedhayannAha- na caikAntenetyAdi| abhinivishediti nishcayaM kuryAt| tarkyamiti anuktamapyuhanIyam| buddhimatetivacanena abuddhimatAmanuktohaM niShedhayati; uktaM hi- “tasmAdbuddhimatAmUhApohavitarkAH, alpabuddhestu yathoktAnugamanameva shreyaH” (vi.a.8) iti| atha kimarthaM yathoktAnugamanameva shreya iti, tathA kimarthamekAntatAvadhAraNaM na kartavyamityAha- utpadyatehItyAdi| deshakAlabalaM pratIti deshAdibhedakRutetyarthaH| kAryamakAryaM syAditi kartavyatayoktamakaraNIyaM syAditi, tathA varjitaM ca yat karma tat kAryaM syAdavasthAvisheShAt| niShiddhasyaivAvasthAvashAt kriyamANasya vamanAderudAharaNamAha- chardihRudrogetyAdi| sve cikitsite iti chardicikitsAdhyAye| avasthAM prApya nirdiShTamityanena avasthAvisheSha eva niShiddhavidhAnamutsargApavAdata ityavirodhaM darshayati; evamanyatrApyapavAdaviShaye vamanAdividhAnamavasthAvisheShaparatayA samAdheyam| nyAyopapAditamuktaM cArthamupasaMharannAha- tasmAdityAdi| shAstropadeshe satyapi svabuvdyaivashAstrAnugatayA~anuktamapi kartavyaM; yaduktaM- “pracaraNamiva bhikShukasya bIjamiva karShakasya sUtraM buddhimatAmalpamapyanalpaj~jAnAya bhavati” (vi.a.8) iti||24-28||

sampratyupakramaNIyAnAmeva rogAdiyogakRutAvasthAbhedenAkartavyapa~jcakarmatAM darshayannAha- avamyAstAvadityAdi| avamyAdau tAvaditipadaM prAkprastutopadarshanArtham| prasaktashabdo maithunAdibhiH pratyekaM sambadhyate| saMvRutakoShThaH vAyunA~alpIkRutakoShThaH, ‘vAyuvyAptakoShThaH’ ityeke| tatra kShatasyetyadinA yathoktavamanAdAne hetumAha| prANoparodhaH maraNaM, ‘balakShayaH’ ityanye| shrAntAdInAM vicchedapAThena prANoparodhasya pUrvApekShayA hInamAtratvaM darshayati| vAtaraktacchedakShatabhayamityatra raktacchedo raktamokShaH| sukumArasyeti mRudusharIrasya| hRudayApakarShaNAditi hRudayahiMsanAt| tadvaditi UrdhvaraktapittinAmityatrokto doShaH| avamyAnAmavasthAyAM vamanamAha- sarveShvapItyAdi| yadyapi cAtrAdhyAyAnte sarveShveva nirdiShTeShvavasthAyAM niShiddhamapi vakShyati, tathA~apIha vidhAnenAtrAvashyaM kartavyaM vamanamiti bodhyam||8-9||

virecanAviShayamAha- avirecyAstvityAdi| subhagakShataguda iti subhagagudaH, kShatagudashca; anye tu subhagaM sukhasaMvardhitamAhuH| muktanAlaH asaMvRutagudaH| kShatAdayashca garbhiNyantA iti vamanAviShayamadhyapaThitAH| rujAM janayed ‘virecanaM’ iti sheShaH| adhobhAgaraktapittinaM tadvaditi atipravRutyA hanyAdityarthaH| kAmAdItyAdAvAdishabdena shokakrodhAdInAM grahaNam| atra cApravRuttiH stokapravRuttishcAyoga eva; uktaM hi- “ayogaH prAtilomyena na cAlpaM vA pravartanam” (si.a.6) iti| ayogadoShAshca vibhraMshahikkAstambhAdayo vakShyamANAH| AmadoSha iti AmadoShanimittavisUcikAdiH| purIShakoShTha iti purIShAdyAsaktakoShThaH| dushchardanokta iti prAgvamanoktadoShaH syAt||11-12||
athAto bastisUtrIyAM siddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
prapIDya caikagrahaNena dattaM netraM shanaireva tato~apakarShet|20|
dattaH shanairnAshayameti bastiH kaNThaM pradhAvatyatipIDitashca| shItastvatistambhakaro vidAhaM mUrcchAM ca kuryAdatimAtramuShNaH||21||
snigdho~atijADyaM pavanaM tu rUkShastanvalpamAtrAlavaNastvayogam| karoti mAtrAbhyadhiko~atiyogaM kShAmaM tu sAndraH sucireNa caiti||22||

pUrvaM hi dadyAnmadhu saindhavaM tu snehaM vinirmathyaM tato~anu kalkam||23||

Commentary: ‘pUrvaM hi dadyAd’ iti granthaM kecidanArShamAhuH; tantrAntareShu tvasyArthasya dRuShTatvAdyukta evAyaM pAThaH; ucyate hi sushrute “dattvA~a~adau saindhavasyAkShaM madhunashca paladvayam | pAtre talena mathnIyAt” (su.ci.a.38) ityAdi| punardravaistamityatra dravashabdena kvAthasya grahaNam||23||-

vAmAshraye hi grahaNIgude ca tat pArshvasaMsthasya sukhopalabdhiH||24||

Commentary: vAmapArshvashayanaM yaduktaM tasya prayojanamAha- vAmAshraye ityAdi| vAmAshraye yasmAd grahaNIgude, tena vAmapArshvasuptasya grahaNIgude prakRutisthe bhavataH, prakRutisthe ca gude gudasya bastinA samyagupashleShAd vyAptirbhavati, tathA valayashca lInA bhavanti, tena sukhaM bastiryAti, grahaNIgudayoH prakRutisthatayA ca bastirvyApya sukhaM grahaNIM bhAvayatIti boddhavyam||24||-

viDvAtavego yadi cArdhadatte niShkRuShya mukte praNayedasheSham ||25||

Commentary: viDvAtetyAdau niShkRuShya mukte iti nalikAmAkRuShya viDvAtavege mukte| datte tu bastau uttAnadehaH kRutopadhAnashca syAt| etatkaraNaprayojanamAha- vIryamApnotItyAdi||25||-

eko~apakarShatyanilaM svamArgAt pittaM dvitIyastu kaphaM tRutIyaH||26||

Commentary: eko~apakarShatItyAdi| etadvAtAdibhedena ekAdibastidAnavidhAnaM; na tu tridoShe prathamo vAtaM jayati, dvitIyaH pittaM jayati, tRutIyaH kaphamityAdi vyAkhyeyaM; yataH, “snigdhoShNa ekaH pavane samAMsaH” ityAdinA pavanAdibhedenaiva sa~gkhyAniyamaM kariShyati| evaM svamArgAccAnilameko bastirapakarShati, pittaM dvitIyastu svamArgAditi pittaM dvAveva jayataH , kaphaM traya eva jayantIti j~jeyaM; svamArgAditi svasthAnAt| yadyapi ca bastiH pakvAshayagatameva doShaM jayatItyuktaM, tathA~api pittAdisthAne~api visheShabastividhisAmarthyAddoShaharaNamucyate; tena, utsargatastadgatadoShaharaNaM vishiShTavidhAnena ca sthAnAntaragatadoShaharaNaM bhavati| ayamartho jatUkaNe~apyucyate- “bastiH kAryaH sakRudbastisthAnashaktyA~anilAdiShu” iti| atra dvitIyaH pittamapakarShati, tRutIyaH kaphamapakarShatItyucyate; tathA~api prathamadvitIyayorapi pittakaphApahatvamastyeva , paraM dvitIyena pittApaharaNaM, tRutIyena ca kaphApaharaNaM sthAnapratyAsattyA kriyata iti kRutvA dvitIyaH pittaM harati, tRutIyaH kaphaM haratIti coktam| pittakaphayoshca yadyapi sukhaM cikitsitaM bastirna bhavati, tathA~api vAtAvarake vAtAnubandhe vA pitte kaphe caitadbastidAnaM j~jeyam; uktaM hi sushrute- “bastirvAte ca pitte ca kaphe rakte ca shasyate” (su.ci.a.35) iti||26||
pratyAgate koShNajalAvasiktaH shAlyannamadyAttanunA rasena| jIrNe tu sAyaM laghu cAlpamAtraM bhukto~anuvAsyaH paribRuMhaNArtham||27||
nirUhapAdAMshasamena tailenAmlAnilaghnauShadhasAdhitena| dattvA sphicau pANitalena hanyAt snehasya shIghrAgamarakShaNArtham||28||
IShacca pAdA~gguliyugmamA~jcheduttAnadehasya talau pramRujyAt| snehena pArShNya~ggulipiNDikAshca ye cAsya gAtrAvayavA rugArtAH||29||

bhAgAH kaShAyasya tu pa~jca, pitte snehasya ShaShThaH prakRutau sthite ca||30||

Commentary: samprati trividho yo dvAdashaprasRuto nirUhastasya kaShAyasnehamAtrAM nirUpayannAha - bhAgA ityAdi| bhAgAH kaShAyasya pa~jcetyanena sarvatraiva doShe svasthe ca puruShe dvAdashaprasRutabhAgarUpe nirUhe pa~jcabhAgAH kaShAyasya bhavanti, tena pa~jca prasRutAH kaShAyasya| snehasya ca doShabhedena svasthe ca mAnabhedamAha- pitte ityAdi| pitte snehasya ShaShThaH, tathA prakRutau sthite ca puruShe svasthe ShaShTha ityarthaH; tatra ShaNNAM pUraNaH ShaShThaH, tena dvAdashaprasRutasya ShaShTho bhAgo dviprasRutaM bhavati| snehashabdena ghRutatailAdigrahaNam| vAte tu vRuddhe caturtho bhAgaH; snehacaturtho bhAgaH prasRutatrayam| aShTabhAga iti sArdhaH prasRutaH| asminnarthe hArItaH- “kvAthasya pa~jcaprasRutA vibhAgAH, snehasya ShaShTho hyadhike tu pitte| svasthe ca tAvat, pavane caturthaH, kaphe~aShTamo~atyantagate(?) vikalpaH” iti| eShA snehamAtrA hInamAtre~api nirUhe kvAthasnehayoruktamAtrAnusAreNa yojanIyA; sheShaNAM tu madhukalkasaindhavAnAmiha mAtrAniyamo noktaH, teShAmapi prakRutyAdibhadenAniyatatvAt; tena madhvAdInAM prakRutyAdyanusAreNa prasRutamAnena dvAdashaprasRutatvaM pUraNIyam| tatra jatUkaNapratyayAt sarvatra kalkasya paladvayaM bhavati| uktaM hi tatra “caturviMshatike puTake peShyANAM dvipalaM, ki~jcicca madhusaindhavAt, sneho vakShyamANaH, sheShaM kaShAyasya; vAte tailaShaTpalaM svasthe ca; catvAri pitte ghRutasya, kaphe trINi tailasya” iti; saindhavaM tu karShapramANamasti; yataH sushrute- “saindhavAkShaM samAdAya madhunaH prasRutadvayam” (su.ci.a.38) ityAdyuktam; hArIta tu- “kShaudraM tu deyaM prasRutapramANaM dvitIyamAhurlavaNasya cAkSham” ityuktaM; tenAnayA dishA saindhavamadhukalpanA| yathoktakaShAyasnehakalkamadhusaindhavApUritAMshapUraNaM cAvApenaiva kartavyam; AvApashcAtrAnukto~apyuttaratra vakShyamANo vAtAdibhedena mAMsarasakShIragomUtrAdiko j~jeyaH| vakShyati hi- “snigdhoShNa ekaH pavane nirUho, dvau svAdushItau payasA ca pitte| trayaH samUtrAH kaTukoShNatIkShNAH kaphe nirUhA na paraM vidheyAH” iti| hArIta~apyuktaM “snehaM guDaM mAMsarasaM payashca hyamlAni mUtrANi ca saindhavaM ca| etAni sarvANyapi yojayIta nirUhayoge madanAt phalaM ca” iti| yattu tantrAntare- dvAdashaprasRutapUraNaM prati pratidravyavibhAgenoktaM; yathA- “dattvA~a~adau saindhavasyAkShaM madhunaH prasRutadvayam| vinirmathya tato dadyAt snehasya prasRutatrayam| ekIbhUte tataH snehe kalkasya prasRutaM kShipet| sammUrcchite kaShAyaM tu catuHprasRutasammitam|| vitarecca tadAvApamante dviprasRutonmitam| evaM sukalpito bastirdvAdashaprasRuto bhavet” (su.ci.a.38) iti; tadvAtaviShayameva, snehasya vAtaghnatvAt; kintvatra yaccatuHprasRutaM kaShAyasya manyate, tadasmattantrAnumatameva | yattvanye paThanti- “madhusnehanakalkAkhyakaShAyAvApataH kramAt| trINi ShaT dve dasha trINi palAnyanilarogiNAm|| pitte catvAri catvAri dve dvipa~jca catuShTayam | ShaT trINi dve dasha trINi kaphe cApi nirUhaNam” iti; tadasmattantrAnugatatvAdanumatameva||30||-
nirUhamAtrA prasRutArdhamAdye varShe tato~ardhaprasRutAbhivRuddhiH||31||
AdvAdashAt syAt prasRutAbhivRuddhiraShTAdashAd dvAdashataH paraM syuH| AsaptatestadvihitaM pramANamataH paraM ShoDashavadvidheyam||32||

nAtyucchritaM nApyatinIcapAdaM sapAdapIThaM shayanaM prashastam||33||

Commentary: samprati ‘shayane vidhiH kaH’ iti prashnasyottaramAha- nAtyucchritamityAdi| pUrvaM yaH shayanavidhiruktaH sa tAtkAlikaH, ayaM tUttarakAlika iti visheShaH| pradhAnaM mahanmRudu cAstaraNaM pradhAnamRudvAstaraNaM, tenopapannaM yuktam| prAkshIrShakamiti “prAcyAM dishi sthitA devAstatpUjArthaM ca prAkshirAH” (su.sU.a.19) iti vacanAt||33||-

bhojyaM punarvyAdhimavekShya tadvat prakalpayedyUShapayorasAdyaiH||34||

Commentary: yUShAdi bhojyavidhAnaM yathAkramaM kaphe, pitte, vAte; kiMvA, agnyapekShaM yathAyogyatayA vyAkhyeyam| yathoktavidhAnaM vakShyamANavidhiShu kartavyatayA darshayannAha- sarveShvityAdi| etadAdyamiti pradhAnam, autsargikamiti yAvat; tena visheShavidhAnenApavAdo~apyasya bhaviShyatIti sUcayati||34||-
dvipa~jcamUlasya raso~amlayuktaH sacchAgamAMsasya sapUrvapeShyaH||35||
kRutakShaNaM shailavarasya ramye sthitaM dhaneshAyatanasya pArshve| maharShisa~gghairvRutamagniveshaH punarvasuM prA~jjaliranvapRucchat||3||
bastirnarebhyaH kimapekShya dattaH syAt siddhimAn kimmayamasya netram| kIdRukpramANAkRuti ki~gguNaM ca kebhyashca kiMyoniguNashca bastiH||4||
nirUhakalpaH praNidhAnamAtrA snehasya kA vA shayane vidhiH kaH| ke bastayaH keShu hitA itIdaM shrutvottaraM prAha vaco maharShiH||5||
trisnehayuktaH pravaro nirUhaH sarvAnilavyAdhiharaH pradiShTaH| sthirAdivargasya balApaTolatrAyantikairaNDayavairyutasya||36||
prastho rasAcchAgarasArdhayuktaH sAdhyaH punaH prasthasamastu yAvat| priya~ggukRuShNAghanakalkayuktaH satailasarpirmadhusaindhavashca||37||
syAddIpano mAMsabalapradashca cakShurbalaM cApi dadAti bastiH | eraNDamUlaM tripalaM palAshA hrasvAni mUlAni ca yAni pa~jca||38||
rAsnAshvagandhAtibalAguDUcI punarnavAragvadhadevadAru| bhAgAH palAMshA madanAShTayuktA jaladvikaMse kvathite~aShTasheShe||39||
peShyAH shatAhvA hapuShA priya~gguH sapippalIkaM madhukaM balA ca| rasA~jjanaM vatsakabIjamustaM bhAgAkShamAtraM lavaNAMshayuktam||40||
samAkShikastailayutaH samUtro bastirnRuNAM dIpanalekhanIyaH| ja~gghorupAdatrikapRuShThashUlaM kaphAvRutiM mArutanigrahaM ca||41||
viNmUtravAtagrahaNaM sashUlamAdhmAnatAmashmarisharkare ca| AnAhamarshograhaNIpradoShAneraNDabastiH shamayet prayuktaH||42||
catuShpale tailaghRutasya bhRuShTAcchAgAcchatArdho dadhidADimAmlaH| rasaH sapeShyo balamAMsavarNaretognidashcAndhyashirortishastaH ||43||
jaladvikaMse~aShTapalaM palAshAt paktvA raso~ardhADhakamAtrasheShaH| kalkairvacAmAgadhikApalAbhyAM yuktaH shatAhvAdvipalena cApi||44||
sasaindhavaH kShaudrayutaH satailo deyo nirUho balavarNakArI| AnAhapArshvAmayayonidoShAn gulmAnudAvartarujaM ca hanyAt||45||
yaShTyAhvayasyAShTapalena siddhaM payaH shatAhvAphalapippalIbhiH| yuktaM sasarpirmadhu vAtaraktavaisvaryavIsarpahito nirUhaH||46||
yaShTyAhvalodhrAbhayacandanaishca shRutaM payo~agryaM kamalotpalaishca| sasharkaraM kShaudrayutaM sushItaM pittAmayAn hanti sajIvanIyam||47||
dvikArShikAshcandanapadmakardhiyaShTyAhvarAsnAvRuShasArivAshca| salodhrama~jjiShThamathApyanantAbalAsthirAditRuNapa~jcamUlam ||48||
toye samutkvAthya rasena tena shRutaM payo~ardhADhakamambuhInam| jIvantimedardhishatAvarIbhirvIrAdvikAkolikasherukAbhiH||49||
sitopalAjIvakapadmareNu prapauNDarIkaiH kamalotpalaishca| lodhrAtmaguptAmadhukairvidArImu~jjAtakaiH kesharacandanaishca||50||
piShTairghRutakShaudrayutairnirUhaM sasaindhavaM shItalameva dadyAt| pratyAgate dhanvarasena shAlIn kShIreNa vA~adyAt pariShiktagAtraH||51||
dAhAtisArapradarAsrapittahRutpANDurogAn viShamajvaraM ca| sagulmamUtragrahakAmalAdIn sarvAmayAn pittakRutAnnihanti||52||
drAkShAdikAshmaryamadhUkasevyaiH sasArivAcandanashItapAkyaiH| payaH shRutaM shrAvaNimudgaparNItugAtmaguptAmadhuyaShTikalkaiH||53||
godhUmacUrNaishca tathA~akShamAtraiH sakShaudrasarpirmadhuyaShTitailaiH| pathyAvidArIkShurasairguDena bastiM yutaM pittaharaM vidadhyAt||54||
hRunnAbhipArshvottamadehadAhe dAhe~antarasthe ca sakRucchramUtre| kShINe kShate retasi cApi naShTe paitte~atisAre ca nRuNAM prashastaH||55||
koShAtakAragvadhadevadArushAr~ggeShTamUrvAkuTajArkapAThAH | paktvA kulatthAn bRuhatIM ca toye rasasya tasya prasRutA dasha syuH||56||
tAn sarShapailAmadanaiH sakuShThairakShapramANaiH prasRutaishca yuktAn| phalAhvatailasya samAkShikasya kShArasya tailasya ca sArShapasya||57||
dadyAnnirUhaM kapharogiNe j~jo mandAgnaye cApyashanadviShe ca| paTolapathyAmaradArubhirvA sapippalIkaiH kvathitairjale~agnau||58||
dvipa~jcamUle triphalAM sabilvAM phalAni gomUtrayutaH kaShAyaH| kali~ggapAThAphalamustakalkaH sasaindhavaH kShArayutaH satailaH||59||
nirUhamukhyaH kaphajAn vikArAn sapANDurogAlasakAmadoShAn| hanyAttathA mArutamUtrasa~ggaM bastestathA~a~aTopamathApi ghoram||60||
rAsnAmRutairaNDaviDa~ggadArvIsaptacchadoshIrasurAhvanimbaiH| shampAkabhUnimbapaTolapAThAtiktAkhuparNIdashamUlamustaiH||61||
trAyantikAshigruphalatrikaishca kvAthaH sapiNDItakatoyamUtraH| yaShTyAhvakRuShNAphalinIshatAhvArasA~jjanashvetavacAviDa~ggaiH||62||
kali~ggapAThAmbudasaindhavaishca kalkaiH sasarpirmadhutailamishraH| ayaM nirUhaH krimikuShThamehabradhnodarAjIrNakaphAturebhyaH||63||
rUkShauShadhairapyapatarpitebhya eteShu rogeShvapi satsu dattaH| nihatya vAtaM jvalanaM pradIpya vijitya rogAMshca balaM karoti||64||
punarnavairaNDavRuShAshmabhedavRushcIrabhUtIkabalApalAshAH | dvipa~jcamUlaM ca palAMshikAni kShuNNAni dhautAni phalAni cAShTau||65||
bilvaM yavAn kolakulatthadhAnyaphalAni caiva prasRutonmitAni| payojaladvyADhakavacchRutaM tat kShIrAvasheShaM sitavastrapUtam||66||
vacAshatAhvAmaradArukuShThayaShTyAhvasiddhArthakapippalInAm | kalkairyavAnyA madanaishca yuktaM nAtyuShNashItaM guDasaindhavAktam||67||
kShaudrasya tailasya ca sarpiShashca tathaiva yuktaM prasRutaistribhishca | dadyAnnirUhaM vidhinA vivij~jaH sa sarvasaMsargakRutAmayaghnaH||68||

snigdhoShNa ekaH pavane samAMso dvau svAdushItau payasA ca pitte| trayaH samUtrAH kaTukoShNatIkShNAH kaphe nirUhA na paraM vidheyAH||69||

Commentary: uktAnAM vAtAdiharabastInAM sa~gkhyAkalpanAM vishiShTAM darshayannAha- snigdhoShNa ityAdi| eka iti eka eva puTakaH| payasA ceti payoyuktau| kaTukoShNatIkShNatvaM kaphaharadravyayogAdeva j~jeyam| na paraM vidheyA ityanena tantrAntaravihitaM caturthabastidAnamatyarthasharIrahiMsakaM niShedhayati; yathA sushrute- “dvitIyaM vA tRutIyaM vA caturthaM vA yathArhataH| samya~gnirUDhali~gge tu prApte bastiM nivartayet” (su.ci.a.32) ityanenoktaM caturthadAnamiti||69||
rasena vAte pratibhojanaM syAt kShIreNa pitte tu kaphe ca yUShaiH| tathA~anuvAsyeShu ca bilvatailaM syAjjIvanIyaM phalasAdhitaM ca||70||
itIdamuktaM nikhilaM yathAvadbastipradAnasya vidhAnamagryam| yo~adhItya vidvAniha bastikarma karoti loke labhate sa siddhim||71||

samIkShya doShauShadhadeshakAlasAtmyAgnisattvAdivayobalAni| bastiH prayukto niyataM guNAya syAt sarvakarmANi ca siddhimanti||6||

Commentary: samIkShyetyAdi| atra doShAdayo ye dasha parIkShaNIyAH proktAsteShveva upakalpanIyoktadoShabheShajAdyekAdashakasya tathA rogabhiShagjitIyoktadashaparIkShyasyAvarodho vyAkhyeyaH; anuktAvarodhashcAyaM yonivyApattika evAsmAbhirukto~anusaraNIyaH| samIkShyeti j~jAnapUrvakamavekShya| sarvakarmANi ceti vamanAdIni ca doShAdInapekShya prayuktAni guNakarANi bhavanti||6||

suvarNarUpyatraputAmrarItikAMsyAsthishastradrumaveNudantaiH | nalairviShANairmaNibhishca taistairnetrANi kAryANi su(tri)karNikAni ||7||

Commentary: kimmayamasya netramityasya prashnasyottaraM- suvarNetyAdi| trapu va~ggaM, rItiH pittalam| viShANairiti mahiShAdishRu~ggaiH| sukarNikAnIti susamAhitakarNikAni; ‘trikarNikAni’ iti kecit paThanti, trikarNikatvaM cAgre vakShyamANam||7||
ShaDdvAdashAShTA~ggulasammitAni ShaDviMshatidvAdashavarShajAnAm| syurmudgakarkandhusatInavAhicchidrANi vartyA~apihitAni caiva||8||
yathAvayo~a~gguShThakaniShThikAbhyAM mUlAgrayoH syuH pariNAhavanti| RujUni gopucchasamAkRutIni shlakShNAni ca syurguDikAmukhAni||9||
jAradgavo mAhiShahAriNau vA syAcchaukaro bastirajasya vA~api||10||
dRuDhastanurnaShTasiro vigandhaH kaShAyaraktaH sumRuduH sushuddhaH | nRuNAM vayo vIkShya yathAnurUpaM netreShu yojyastu subaddhasUtraH||11||

AsthApanArhaM puruShaM vidhij~jaH samIkShya puNye~ahani shuklapakShe||12||

Commentary: ‘nirUhakalpaH’ ityAdiprashnasyottaram- AsthApanArhamityAdi| shuklapakShe iti shuklapakShasya sarvArambheShu prashastatvAt, hArItena tu kRuShNapakSha evAtra vihitaH; uktaM hi- “kRuShNapakShe kAryaM, janmani sarvarogA hatAH suhatA bhavantIti vadanti shAstraj~jAH; shukle devA jAtAH, kRuShNe~asurAshca sarvarogAshca; tasmAdrogacikitsA kRuShNe sadaiva kartavyA” iti| ekAgramiti bastiprayogaikamanasam||12||-
balAM guDUcIM triphalAM sarAsnAM dve pa~jcamUle ca palonmitAni||13||
aShTau phalAnyardhatulAM ca mAMsAcchAgAt pacedapsu caturthasheSham| pUtaM yavAnIphalabilvakuShThavacAshatAhvAghanapippalInAm||14||
kalkairguDakShaudraghRutaiH satailairyutaM sukhoShNaistu picupramANaiH| guDAt palaM dviprasRutAM tu mAtrAM snehasya yuktyA madhu saindhavaM ca||15||
prakShipya bastau mathitaM khajena subaddhamucchvAsya ca nirvalIkam| a~gguShThamadhyena mukhaM pidhAya netrAgrasaMsthAmapanIya vartim||16||
tailAktagAtraM kRutamUtraviTkaM nAtikShudhArtaM shayane manuShyam| same~athaveShannatashIrShake vA nAtyucchrite svAstaraNopapanne||17||
savyena pArshvena sukhaM shayAnaM kRutvarjudehaM svabhujopadhAnam| sa~gkocya savyetaradasya sakthi vAmaM prasArya praNayettatastam||18||
snigdhe gude netracaturthabhAgaM snigdhaM shanairRujvana pRuShThavaMsham| akampanAvepanalAghavAdIn pANyorguNAMshcApi vidarshayaMstam ||19||

pUrvAdhyAye vamanAdipravRuttiviShayAdikamabhidhAya kalpanAsiddhyuktabastikalpanAyAH prapa~jcenAbhidhAnArthaM bastisUtrIyA siddhirucyate| basteritikartavyatAbhidhAyakasUtramadhikRutya kRutA siddhirbastisUtrIyasiddhiH||1-2||

tiryakpraNidhAnAdidoShamAha- tiryagityAdi| na yAti dhAreti tiryakpraNidhAne sati gudavalIrodho bhavati, tena dhArA na yAti| atistambhakara iti bastirdehasya stambhaM karoti| jADyamiti sharIrajaDatA| tanvalpamAtrAlavaNastvayogamiti tanurvA, alpamAtralavaNo vA| sAndraH tanuviparItaH, kShAmaM puruShaM kuryAt| lavaNo~atIti atimAtralavaNaH| tasmAditi yathoktavidhAneShu doShanidarshanAt| suyuktamiti tiryakpraNidhAnAdirahitaM, shItatvAdirahitaM ca||20-22||-

shAlyannamityAdau jIrNe iti AsthApanopalepe koShThasthe jIrNe| tanumAMsarasAdibhojanaM ceha nirUheNa manAgupahatasya vahneH paripAlanArtham| peyAdikramastvatra na kriyate, virecanavadihAmasyAbhAvAt; ata eva sushrute peyAdikramaM tyaktvA rasAdikrama uktaH| paribRuMhaNArthamityanena lekhanArthaM kriyamANe nirUhe paribRuMhaNArthamanuvAsanaM tadahaH kartavyamiti darshayati| ata eva kalpanAsiddhAvapi- “narastato nishyanuvAsanArhaH” (si.a.1) ityanena tadaharanuvAsanasyAvashyakatvamuktaM ; jatUkarNe~apyuktaM- “jIrNe sAyaM kRutAnnaM ca puShTyarthamanuvAsayet” iti| nirUhapAdAMshasamena taileneti nirUhapAdapramANena, caturviMshatipale nirUhe ShaTpalena snehenetyarthaH; iyaM cottamA mAtrA~anuvAsanasya; uktaM hyanyatra- “uttamA ShaTpalI proktA madhyamA tripalI bhavet| kanIyasI sArdhapalA tridhA mAtrA~anuvAsane” iti; sushrute~apyetAvanmAnameva snehasyAnuvAsana mAtrAbastivibhAgenAnuvAsane uktam| snehashIghrAgamanarakShArthaM vidhAnamAha- IShadityAdi| tacca pAdA~ggulyottAnadehasya mAtrAshataM sthApanaM kartavyam| nirUhe tu triMshanmAtrAkAlaM yAvaduttAnasya sthApanaM manyante| pAdA~gguliyugmamiti parvasandhiH| A~jchediti AkarShet| nidrAmupAsIteti vacanaM kriyAntarasya niShedhArtham||27-29||-

idAnIM vayobhedena nirUhapramANaM darshayannAha- nirUhetyAdi| Adye varShe bAlasya palamAne nirUhe kvAthAdi yathoktamAnAnusAreNa vaktavyam; ardhaprasRutAbhivRuddhiH tataH prativarShaM bhavati; tena dvAdashavarShe ShaTprasRuto bastirbhavati; dvAdashAdUrdhvamaShTAdashavarShaparyantaM prativarShaM prasRutavRuddhyA dvAdashaprasRutapUraNaM bhavati; ‘dvAdashataH paraM syuH’ ityanenAdhikapramANabastimAnaM mahAtyayakaraM kaishcidanumataM niShedhayati; yathA hArIte ekIyamataM paThyate- “ardhADhakaM paramatamaM pramANam” iti ; tathA sushrute~api (?)- “dvAdashaprasRutaM kecit triMshatpalamathA~apare” ityAdi| bastimAnaM darshayitumAha- AsaptaterityAdi| Asaptatestaditi dvAdashaprasRutamAnaM saptatiM yAvadbhavati| ShoDashavaditi dashaprasRutapramANam| bAlavRuddhayoryathoktaprasRutamAnaviShayaM darshayan tatrAnyaM visheShamAha- nirUhamAtretyAdi| bAlavRuddhayoryathoktaiva nirUhamAtrA prasRutapramANA kAryA, visheSheNa tayorbastirmRuduH kAryaH| tIkShNatvamArdavakaraM ca vidhAnaM vakShyati; yathA- “tIkShNatvaM mUtrapIlvagnilavaNakShArasarShapaiH| prAptakAlaM vidhAtavyaM kShIrAdyairmArdavaM tathA” (si.a.7) iti||31-32||-

dhaneshAyatanasyeti himAlayasya| bastirnarebhya ityAdayo dasha prashnAH| netraM nalikA| kiMyoniguNashca bastirityatra bastiH bastipuTakaH, yoniH prabhavasthAnam| snehasya vA keti anuvAsanasya kA praNidhAnamAtrA| anuvAsanasya cAtra prapa~jco~abhidhAtavyaH; tenAnuvAsanasya kalpamAtraprashno~atra boddhavyaH; yadA tu ‘snehasya vA kaH’ iti pAThaH, tadA snehasya nirUhadinadIyamAnasya ko vidhirityarthaH, sa cottaragranthena sa~ggatArtha eva| ke bastayaH keShu hitA iti kebhyaH puruShebhyaH kiMyonayA hitA bastaya ityarthaH||3-5||

‘ke bastaya’ ityAdiprashnasyottaraM- dvipa~jcamUlasyetyAdi| atra mAMsaM dashamUlasamam| rasaH kvAthaH| amlaM kA~jjikAdi| sapUrvapeShya iti balAdyuktakalkayuktaH| trisnehayukta ityanena, majjaparityAgaM sarvabastisiddhaM smArayati; uktaM hyanyatra- “vij~jeyastrividhaH sneho bastyartha majjavarjitaH” iti| sthirAdivargasyetyAdau madhusaindhave yadyapi sAmAnyenoktabastividhAnalabdhe, tathA~api tailAdInAmatrAprakarShArthaM punastayorabhidhAnaM, kiMvA sAmAnyavidhismaraNArthamatrAbhidhAnam; evamanyatrApi sAmAnyavidhiprAptasya punarabhidhAne vyAkhyeyam| eraNDamUlamityAdau palAshA shaTI| hrasvAni mUlAnIti sthirAdipa~jcamUlam| kaMsa ADhakaH| bhAgAkShamAtramiti bhAgenAkShamAtram| chAgAcchatArdha iti pa~jcAshatpalo bhavati| sapeShya iti balAdikasya kalkayuktaH||35-45||

yaShTyAhvayasyetyAdikAshcatvAraH pitte, pUrvaM tUktAH pa~jca vAte| atra payaHsAdhanaM kShIrapAkaparibhAShayaiva| yaShTyAhvalodhretyAdinA jIvanIyamityantenaiko yogaH| jIvanIyAnAmatra kalkaH| sushItatvamihautsargikaM mRudukoShTheShvadhikaM pittahitatvAt; anayA ca dishA~aparapittaharabastAvapi shItatvaM j~jeyam| dvikArShikamityAdau anantA utpalasArivA| tRuNapa~jcamUlaM- “sharekShudarbhakAshAnAM shAlInAM mUlameva ca” (ca.ci.a.1pA.1) ityAdinoktam| ambuhInamiti kShIrAvasheShaparyantaM shRutam| rAjakasheruH kasherureva| sasaindhavamiti IShatsaindhavam| sasArivetyAdau shItapAkI shItalI| madhuyaShTitailaM madhuyaShTisAdhitaM tailam| uttamadehaH mastakam||46-55||

koShAtaketyAdikAshcatvAraH kaphe bastayaH| shAr~ggeShTA gu~jjA| atra kvAthadashaprasRutena tathA kalkena kShaudrAdinA ca yadyapi mAnamadhikaM bhavati, tathA~apyevameva dravyasaMyogaM kRutvA dvAdashaprasRuta eva bastirdeyaH, tadadhikamAnasya niShiddhatvAt| paToletyAdau paTolAdipippalyantaistoyaM sAdhayitvA pUrvavad dvitIyaH, kapharogiNe dvipa~jcamUlyAdibhistRutIyaH kartavyaH| kShAraH yavakShAraH| rAsnetyAdau shampAkaH catura~ggulaH| tiktA kaTurohiNI| atra piNDItakakvAtho~apyAvApakalpo yena pravishati; piNDItakaH madanaH| rUkShauShadhairatyapatarpitebhyo~apyeteShu kuShThAdirogeShvayaM datto balaM karotIti yojanA||56-64||
punarnavetyAdikaH sarvavAtAdisaMsargaviShayaH| vRushcIraH shvetapunarnavA| dhAnyAni phalAni ceti dhAnyaphalAni| payojaladvyADhakavaditi samajalakShIradviprasthayuktam||65-68||

samprati vAtAdibhedena pratibhojanaM vishiShTaM tathA~anuvAsanaM cAha- rasena vAte ityAdi| pratibhojanaM nirUhAnantarabhojanam| vAte bilvatailAnuvAsanaM, pitte jIvanIyasAdhitaM, kaphe ca madanaphalasAdhitam| atra bilvatailAdIni vakShyamANAni vyAkhyAnayanti; tena snehavyApatsiddhau yad vakShyati “dashamUlaM” (si.a.4) ityAdinA bilvatailaM, jIvanIyaM ca “jIvantI madanaM” (si.a.4) ityAdinA vakShyamANayamakaM, tathA “madanairvA~amlasaMyuktaiH” (si.a.4) ityAdinA vakShyamANaM madanatailaM j~jeyam||70-71||
