‘kIdRukpramANAkRuti’ ityasyottaraM- ShaDityAdi| tatra ShaDa~ggulamekavarShAt prabhRuti yAvat ShaDvarShaM, dvAdashavarShasyAShTA~ggulaM netraM bhavati, viMshativarShasya dvAdashA~ggulaM netraM bhavati| atra vyutkramAbhidhAnena ShaDvarShAdarvAgviMshativarShAdUrdhvaM ca netramAnavikalpo nAsti, ShaDvarShAdUrdhvaM netramAnavikalpo~astIti darshayati; tena ShaDvarShAdUrdhvaM pratyabdama~ggulatRutIyabhAgavRuddhirbhavati, dvAdashAdUrdhvaM pratyabdamardhA~ggulavRuddhiH, evamuktamAnapUraNaM bhavati| sushrute netramAnabheda uktaH, sa nAtivirodhakAritayA upekShaNIya eva| uktaM hi tatra- “sAMvatsarikAShTadviraShTavarShANAM ShaDaShTadashA~ggulaM netraM, pa~jcaviMshativarShAdUrdhvaM dvAdashA~ggulam” (su.ci.a.35) iti| mudgAdivAhicchidratvaM yathAsa~gkhyaM ShaDdvAdashAShTA~ggulanetreShu j~jeyam| karkandhushabdeneha shRugAlabadarI svalpA gRuhyate; uktaM hi sushrute- “kolAsthimAtracchidraM” (su.ci.a.35) iti| bRuhadbadarIgrahaNe tu kaniShThApramANAgraM tadvahanaM nArhati; kecidevaM virodhaM pashyanto badarAsthimajjAnamiha karkandhUshabdena grAhayanti| satInaH vartulakalAyaH| vartyA~apihitAnIti dravyAntarapraveshanirAsArthaM vartyA~apihitamukhAni kartavyAni| yathAvaya iti yasmin vayasi netraM vihitaM, tadvayaHsthasyaivA~gguShThakaniShThAbhyAM yathAsa~gkhyaM mUle~agre ca tulyapariNAhaM netraM kartavyam| RujUnItyAdinA netraguNAnAha| shlakShNAnIti akarkashAni| guTikAmukhAnItyanena vartulamukhatayA~atIkShNamukhatAM darshayati| ekA karNikA~agre kartavyA netrasyAntaHpraveshanirAsArthaM, bastinibandhane dve iti bastinibandhanaprayojanake dve||8-9||-

kebhyashca kiMyoniguNashca bastirityasyottaraM- jAradgava ityAdi|- jAradgavaH vRuddhagobhavaH| bastiriti mUtrAshayapuTakam| naShTasira iti samuddhRutasirAsantatiH | vigataH pUtigandho yasya sa vigandhaH| kaShAyarakta iti kaShAyabhAvanayA raktIkRutaH | vayo vIkShya yathAnurUpamiti vayobhedena yathoktena yo bastiryasyocitapramANo bhavati, sa tasya netre nibandhanIyaH| etena ‘kebhyaH ko bastiH’ ityasyottaraM bhavati||10-11||

balAmityAdinA bastividhAnamAha| palonmitatvamiha triphalApa~jcamUlyorapi pratidravyam| phalAnIti madanaphalAni, tAni cAkRutyaivAShTAviha| atra balAdInAmauShadhAnAmautsargikakvAthavidhinA~aShTamadanaphalAdhikaShaTShaShTipalatvaM “kvAthaH kvAthyasamaH” itivacanAd bahukvAtho bhavati; bastau ca puTatrayadAne~api pratipuTake dashapalakvAthadAnaniyamAt triMshatpalAni paramupayujyante, sheShastu yadyapi niShprayojanastathA~api maharShivacanAdyAvatpramANamuktaM tAvataiva kriyamANaH kvAtho~atra guNavAn bhavatIti, tena na mImAMsyametat; uktaM hi- “yathA kurvanti, sa upAyaH” (sU.a.26); iti kiMvA, upayuktakvAthyadravyamAnavibhAgodAharaNArthametaduktaM , tena tadanusAreNopayuktakvAthasAdhanayogyamAnameva kvAthyaM grahItavyam| yavAnyAdInAM pratyekaM pratinirUhaM picumAnatvaM; picuH karShaH| snehasyeti ghRutatailasya, uktatvAt | etacca snehamAnaM prakRutisthe puruShe vakShyamANavyavasthayA j~jeyam| ‘yuktyA madhusaindhave ca’ ityanena madhusaindhavayoH prakRutyAdyapekShayA~aniyataM mAnaM darshayati; cakAro mAMsarasakShIragomUtrAdInAM cAniyataM mAnaM darshayati; eShAM ca mAnavyavasthAmagre kaShAyamAnaprastAve darshayiShyAmaH| ucchvAsyeti ucchvAsanena dravyAbhighAtajanitavAtanirgamamicchati| nirvalIkamiti kriyAvisheShaNam| netrAgrasaMsthAmiti prathamaM dravanirgamAdipratiShedhArthaM nalikAgramukhadattAM vartim| tailAktagAtramiti abhya~ggasAhacaryAt svedo~api j~jeyaH, tenAbhyaktasvinnamityarthaH; uktaM hyanyatra “anuvAsitamAsthApayedabhyaktasvinnasharIram” (su.ci.a.38) iti| prastAvAgatashayanavidhimAha- shayane manuShyamityAdi| same~athaveShannatashIrShake veti vikalpadvayamAturecchayA kartavyaM; kiMvA, unnatakaTIdeshasya puruShasya samaM, tucchakaTIkasyonnatashIrShaM shayanaM vidheyam, evaM hi tayoH samyagbastirdehAnusArI bhavati| savyeneti vAmena; vAmapArshvashayanaprayojanaM ‘vAmAshraye hi’ ityAdinA vakShyamANam| manuShyaM yathoktasarvaguNaM kRutvA taM praNayediti sambandhaH| svabhujopadhAnaM yathA bhavati tathA shayAnam; upadhAnaM gaNDuH| savyetarad dakShiNam| sakthi ja~gghA| vAmaM sakthi prasArya, tadupari dakShiNaM sakthi sa~gkocya, visRutasavyasakthisa~gkucitadakShiNasakthItyarthaH| snigdhe gude netracaturthabhAgamiti karNikAvacchinnaM sarvaM caturthabhAgamiti| anu pRuShThavaMshamiti pRuShThavaMshamanugataM kRutvA| akampanetyAdau kampanaM calanaM, vepanaM vepathuH, lAghavaM shIghrakriyatA; Adishabdena bastigrahaNapIDanAdi gRuhyate| vidarshayanniha sampAdayan| prapIDya caikagrahaNena dattamityanena vishramya punaH pIDanaM vAyujanakaM niShedhayati||13-19||-
athAtaH snehavyApatsiddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

snehabastInnibodhemAn vAtapittakaphApahAn| mithyApraNihitAnAM ca vyApadaH sacikitsitAH||3||

Commentary: adhyAyavaktavyamAha- snehabastInityAdi| bastiprayojyAH snehA etacchlokAbhihitA ityarthaH; prapa~jcAnabhidheyA ye tvapare~atrArthAH “snehabastiM nirUhaM ca” ityAdinA vaktavyAH, te na prapa~jcavAcyA iti te na pratij~jAtAH||3||
abhukte shUnyapAyau vA vegAt sneho~atipIDitaH| dhAvatyUrdhvaM tataH kaNThAdUrdhvebhyaH khebhya etyapi||38||
mUtrashyAmAtrivRutsiddho yavakolakulatthavAn| tatsiddhataila iShTo~atra nirUhaH sAnuvAsanaH||39||
kaNThAdAgacchataH stambhakaNThagrahavirecanaiH| chardighnIbhiH kriyAbhishca tasya kAryaM nivartanam||40||

yasya nopadravaM kuryAt snehabastiraniHsRutaH| sarve~alpo vA~a~avRuto raukShyAdupekShyaH sa vijAnatA||41||

Commentary: vAtAdyAvRutasnehapravartanamabhidhAya apravartanIyasnehamAha- yasya nopadravamityAdi| nopadravaM kuryAditi aniHsRuto~api stambharugAdInUrdhvoktAnna kuryAt| alpo vA~a~avRuta iti stokaniHsRutaH, stokashca vRutaH| vRutasyApi stambhAdyupadravAkaraNe hetumAha- raukShyAditi| tadA~atyartharUkShatayA sharIrasya tiShThannapi sneho na vyApadamAvahatItyarthaH; upekShya iti na tatra yathoktavAtAvRutasnehacikitsA kartavyetyarthaH; anyatrApyuktam- “ahorAtrAdapi snehaH pratyAgacchanna dUShyati| kuryAdbastiguNAMshcApi jIrNastvalpaguNo bhavet” (su.ci.a.37) iti||41||
yuktasnehaM dravoShNaM ca laghupathyopasevanam| bhuktavAn mAtrayA bhojyamanuvAsyastryahAttryahAt||42||
dhAnyanAgarasiddhaM hi toyaM dadyAdvicakShaNaH| vyuShitAya nishAM kalyamuShNaM vA kevalaM jalam||43||
snehAjIrNaM jarayati shleShmANaM tadbhinatti ca| mArutasyAnulomyaM ca kuryAduShNodakaM nRuNAm||44||
vamane ca vireke ca nirUhe sAnuvAsane| tasmAduShNodakaM deyaM vAtashleShmopashAntaye||45||
rUkShanityastu dIptAgnirvyAyAmI mArutAmayI| va~gkShaNashroNyudAvRuttavAtAshcArhA dine dine||46||
eShAM cAshu jarAM sneho yAtyambu sikatAsviva| ato~anyeShAM tryahAtprAyaH snehaM pacati pAvakaH||47||
na tvAmaM praNayet snehaM sa hyabhiShyandayedgudam| sAvasheShaM ca kurvIta vAyuH sheShe hi tiShThati||48||
na caiva gudakaNThAbhyAM dadyAt snehamanantaram| ubhayasmAt samaM gacchan vAtamagniM ca dUShayet||49||
snehabastiM nirUhaM vA naikamevAtishIlayet| utkleshAgnivadhau snehAnnirUhAt pavanAdbhayam||50||
tasmAnnirUDhaH saMsnehyo nirUhyashcAnuvAsitaH| snehashodhanayuktyaivaM bastikarma tridoShanut||51||
karmavyAyAmabhArAdhvayA(pA)nastrIkarShiteShu ca| durbale vAtabhagne ca mAtrAbastiH sadA mataH||52||
yatheShTAhAraceShTasya sarvakAlaM niratyayaH| hrasvAyAH snehamAtrAyA mAtrAbastiH samo bhavet||53||
balyaM sukhopacaryaM ca sukhaM sRuShTapurIShakRut| snehamAtrAvidhAnaM hi bRuMhaNaM vAtaroganut||54||
dashamUlaM balAM rAsnAmashvagandhAM punarnavAm| guDUcyeraNDabhUtIkabhArgIvRuShakarohiSham||4||
shatAvarIM sahacaraM kAkanAsAM palAMshikam | yavamAShAtasIkolakulatthAn prasRutonmitAn||5||
caturdroNe~ambhasaH paktvA droNasheSheNa tena ca| tailADhakaM samakShIraM jIvanIyaiH palonmitaiH||6||
anuvAsanametaddhi sarvavAtavikAranut| AnUpAnAM vasA tadvajjIvanIyopasAdhitA||7||

shatAhvAyavabilvAmlaiH siddhaM tailaM samIraNe| saindhavenAgnitaptena taptaM cAnilanuddhRutam||8||

Commentary: AnUpAnAmityAdau tadvaditi pUrvakvAthena sAdhitA| shatAhvetyAdi yogAntaram| saindhavenetyapi yogAntaram||8||
jIvantIM madanaM medAM shrAvaNIM madhukaM balAm| shatAhvarShabhakau kRuShNAM kAkanAsAM shatAvarIm||9||
svaguptAM kShIrakAkolIM karkaTAkhyAM shaTIM vacAm| piShTvA tailaM ghRutaM kShIre sAdhayettaccaturguNe||10||
bRuMhaNaM vAtapittaghnaM balashukrAgnivardhanam| mUtraretorajodoShAn harettadanuvAsanam||11||
lAbhatashcandanAdyaishca piShTaiH kShIracaturguNam| tailapAdaM ghRutaM siddhaM pittaghnamanuvAsanam||12||
saindhavaM madanaM kuShThaM shatAhvAM niculaM vacAm | hrIveraM madhukaM bhArgIM devadAru sakaTphalam||13||
nAgaraM puShkaraM medAM cavikAM citrakaM shaTIm| viDa~ggAtiviShe shyAmAM hareNuM nIlinIM sthirAm||14||
bilvAjamode kRuShNAM ca dantIM rAsnAM ca peShayet| sAdhyameraNDajaM tailaM tailaM vA kapharoganut||15||
vradhnodAvartagulmArshaHplIhamehADhyamArutAn| AnAhamashmarIM caiva hanyAttadanuvAsanAt||16||
madanairvA~amlasaMyuktairbilvAdyena gaNena vA| tailaM kaphaharairvA~api kaphaghnaM kalpayedbhiShak||17||
viDa~ggairaNDarajanIpaTolatriphalAmRutAH| jAtIpravAlanirguNDIdashamUlAkhuparNikAH||18||
nimbapAThAsahacarashampAkakaravIrakAH| eShAM kvAthena vipacettailamebhishca kalkitaiH||19||
phalabilvatrivRutkRuShNArAsnAbhUnimbadArubhiH| saptaparNavacoshIradArvIkuShThakali~ggakaiH||20||
latAgaurIshatAhvAgnishaTIcorakapauShkaraiH | tat kuShThAni krimIn mehAnarshAMsi grahaNIgadam||21||
klIbatAM viShamAgnitvaM malaM doShatrayaM tathA| prayuktaM praNudatyAshu pAnAbhya~ggAnuvAsanaiH||22||
vyAdhivyAyAmakarmAdhvakShINAbalanirojasAm| kShINashukrasya cAtIva snehavastirbalapradaH||23||
pAdaja~gghorupRuShThAMsakaTInAM sthiratAM parAm| janayedaprajAnAM ca prajAM strINAM tathA nRuNAm||24||
tatra shlokau- vAtAdInAM shamAyoktAH pravarAH snehabastayaH| teShAM cAj~japrayuktAnAM vyApadaH sacikitsitAH||55||
prAgbhojyaM snehabasteryad dhruvaM ye~arhAstryahAcca ye snehabastividhishcokto mAtrAbastividhistathA||56||

vAtapittakaphAtyannapurIShairAvRutasya ca| abhukte ca praNItasya snehabasteH ShaDApadaH||25||

Commentary: vAtapittetyAdinA snehabastervyApadaH prAha| etAshca vyApado mithyAyogena snehasya kriyamANA ucyante; pratij~jAtaM hi ‘mithyApraNihitAnAM ca vyApada’ iti, tena snehAyogAtiyogajanyavyApadAmihAnavasara eva; anuvAsanAyogAtiyogajanyAshca vyApadaH kalpanAsiddhAvevoktAH; tadbheShajaM cAtisnehite shodhanabastiH, asnehite punaH snehabastidAnameva j~jeyam| etacca “tasmAnnirUDhaH saMsnehyo nirUhyashcAnuvAsitaH” ityAdinoktatvAt prasa~ggenehoktam ||25||
shIto~alpo vA~adhike vAte pitte~atyuShNaH kaphe mRuduH| atibhukte gururvarcaHsa~jcaye~alpabalastathA||26||
dattastairAvRutaH sneho na yAtyabhibhavAdapi | abhukte~anAvRutatvAcca yAtyUrdhvaM tasya lakShaNam||27||
a~ggamardajvarAdhmAnashItastambhorupIDanaiH | pArshvarugveShTanairvidyAt snehaM vAtAvRutaM bhiShak||28||
snigdhAmlalavaNoShNaistaM rAsnApItadrutailikaiH | sauvIrakasurAkolakulatthayavasAdhitaiH||29||
nirUhairnirharet samyak samUtraiH pA~jcamUlikaiH| tAbhyAmeva ca tailAbhyAM sAyaM bhukte~anuvAsayet||30||
dAharAgatRuShAmohatamakajvaradUShaNaiH| vidyAt pittAvRutaM svAdutiktaistaM bastibhirharet||31||
tandrAshItajvarAlasyaprasekArucigauravaiH| sammUrcchAglAnibhirvidyAcchleShmaNA snehamAvRutam||32||
kaShAyakaTutIkShNoShNaiH surAmUtropasAdhitaiH| phalatailayutaiH sAmlairbastibhistaM vinirharet||33||
chardimUrcchAruciglAnishUlanidrA~ggamardanaiH | Amali~ggaiH sadAhaistaM vidyAdatyashanAvRutam||34||
kaTUnAM lavaNAnAM ca kvAthaishcUrNaishca pAcanam| vireko mRuduratrAmavihitA ca kriyA hitA||35||
viNmUtrAnilasa~ggArtigurutvAdhmAnahRudgrahaiH| snehaM viDAvRutaM j~jAtvA snehasvedaiH savartibhiH||36||
shyAmAbilvAdisiddhaishca nirUhaiH sAnuvAsanaiH| nirharedvidhinA samyagudAvartahareNa ca||37||

pUrvasiddhau bilvatailAdInyabhya~ggasevAnuvAsanArthaM nirdiShTAni, tadabhidhAyikA ceyaM siddhirityanantaraM snehavyApatsiddhirucyate; snehAnAmAnuvAsanikAnAM tadvyApadAM ca bheShajAnAmabhidhAyikA siddhiH||1-2||

abhukte ityAdihetutrayaM snehabasterUrdhvagamanakAraNaM j~jeyaM; pUrvaM ca yadyapyabhojanadAnameva kAraNaM pratishrutaM, tathA~apyekakAryatayA cikitsitasAmAnyAcca shUnyapAyutvAtipIDane apyatra hetutvenokte; shUnyapAyutvaM cAdhonirodhAkartRutayA snehamUrdhvaM nayati| UrdhvebhyaH khebhya iti mukhanAsAdibhyaH| etIti nirgacchati| apishabdAnmukhAdinirgamanasya kAdAcitkatvaM darshayati| tatsiddhataila iti mUtrashyAmAdisAdhitatailena yuktaH| sAnuvAsana iti tatsiddhatailena cAnuvAsanaM deyam| Agacchata iti Agamanasamaya eva stambhAdi kartavyam| stambhaH vyajanashItajalasekAdinA; kaNThagrahaH UrdhvagamanapratiShedhArthaM kaNThapIDanam| chardighnIH kriyAH chardishcikitsite “mano~abhighAte tu mano~anukUlAH” ityAdinA “sukha eva jetum” (ci.a.20) ityantenoktA ihAbhipretA j~jeyAH||38-40||

utpannavyApatpratIkAramabhidhAyAvyApannAnuvAsanAnuguNaM bhojanamAha- yuktasnehamityAdi| yuktasnehamiti avyApannasnehamiti bhAvaH| upasevanaM bhojanam| tryahAditi vidhAnaM prAyikam| dhAnyetyAdau ShaDa~ggavidhinA toyaM sAdhanIyam| kalyamiti prabhAte| snehAjIrNamiti snehasyAjIrNaM koShThopalepakamaMsham||42-45||

pratyahAnuvAsanIyAnAha- rUkShanityastvityAdi| va~gkShaNashroNigatashca tathodAvRuttashca vAto yeShAM te va~gkShaNashroNyudAvRuttavAtAH| arhA iti anuvAsanArhAH| uktaM cAnyatra- “rUkShasya bahuvAtasya snehabastiM dine dine| dadyAdvaidyastato~anyeShAmagnyAbAdhabhayAttryahAt” (su.ci.a.37) iti| pratyahadAnatryahadAnopapattimAha- eShAmityAdi| tryahAt snehaM pacatIti pakvAshayopalepakaM snehaM bahirniHsRutenoShmaNA pacati; yadyapyatrAgninordhvasthitena tAdRushaH sambandhaH snehasya nAsti, tathA~api jATharasyaiva vimishritairavayavaistatpAko vaktavyaH| prAyaHshabdena pa~jcAhapAkamapi darshayati, tena pa~jcAhadAnamapyanuvAsane mandAgniM prati prAguktaM j~jeyam, uktaM hi- “paratastryahe vA dvyahe~anuvAsyo~ahani pa~jcame vA” (si.a.10) iti||46-47||

Amamiti apakvam| praNayediti anuvAsanaM dadyAt| sAvasheShaM kurvIteti na niHsheShaM dadyAt| gudakaNThAbhyAmiti anuvAsanapAnAbhyAm| anantaramiti ekakAlam| vAtamagniM ca dUShayediti atra vAtadUShaNamajIrNajanakatayA vAtAvaraNAcca j~jeyam||48-49||

nirUhAnuvAsanayoH parasparAvyavadhAnadAne doShamAha- snehavastiM nirUhaM vetyAdi| ekameviti parasparAnantaritam| utkleshaH kaphapittotkleshaH| nirUhAt pavanAdbhayamiti nirantaranirUheNa sharIrasya shodhanAtiyogAt pavanAdbhayaM bhavati| nirUDhaH saMsnehya iti nirUheNa srotaHsu shodhiteShu kaphapittajaye kRute snehavastirabhyasyaH; tathA~anuvAsitashca samyaganuvAsanena hi snigdhaH sannirUhya eva| evaM prayujyamAnasnehanirUhayostridoShahantRutvaM snehena vAtajayAnnirUheNa kaphapittajayAdbhavatItyAha- snehashodhanetyAdi| shodhanamiha nirUho~abhipretaH||50-51||

anuvAsanavisheShasya mAtrAbasterviShayaM pramANaM guNAMshca yathAkramamAha- karmetyAdi| karmAtra kandukacAlanAdi , vyAyAmaH dhanurAkarShaNAdiH| vAtabhagne vAtena pIDite| sadeti pratyaham| hrasvAyA iti ardhAhaHpariNamanIyAyAH; uktaM hi- “ahorAtramahaH kRutsnaM dinArdhaM ca pratIkShate| uttamA madhyamA hrasvA snehamAtrA jarAM prati” (sU.a.13) iti| tantrAntare snehamAtrAtrayaM pramANairevoktaM; yathA- “ShaTpalI tu bhavejjyeShThA, madhyamA tripalI bhavet| kanIyasI sArdhapalA tridhA mAtrA~anuvAsane” iti| sushrutenApi bastipramANamuktaM; yathA anuvAsane- “tasyApi vikalpo~ardhArdhamAtrAvakRuShTo~aparihAryo mAtrAbastiH” (su.ci.a.35) iti| anena ca sArdhapalamAno mAtrAbastirukto bhavati; tatra hi ShaTpalaH snehabastiruktaH, anuvAsanaM tu tripalam| sukhopacaryamiti ceShTAhAraniyamAbhAvAdeva||52-54||
dashamUlamityAdau bhUtIkaM kattRuNaM yavAnikA vA; kAkanAsA vAyasIphalam, anye tu vAsAphalaM ‘kAyuyATuTI’ iti khyAtaM dravyAntaramevAhuH| etad dashamUlasthitabilvena bilvatailamiti vadanti||4-7||
jIvantImityAdinA yamakamanuvAsanam| etadyamakaM pUrvAdhyAye jIvanIyasa~jj~jayA vyApadiShTam| lAbhata iti yathAlAbham| candanAdyaM jvaracikitsitoktam| tailaM pAdaM yasmin tat tailapAdam||9-12||

madanairvA~amlasaMyuktairityatra madanasya kalkatvam, kA~jjikAdInAmamlAnAM dravatvam| etacca madanatailamiti khyAtam| bilvAdyo gaNaH dashamUlaM; dashamUlaM cAtra kvAthakalkAbhyAmapi deyam| uktaM hi- “kvAthakalkAvanirdeshe gaNAttasmAt samAvapet” iti| kaphaharairiti pUrvodhyAyoktakaphaharabheShajaiH, kiMvA trikaTukapa~jcakolAdibhiH||13-17||
viDa~ggetyAdau ebhishca kalkitairiti vakShyamANaiH| latA ma~jjiShThA, gaurI haridrA| snehabastirbalaprada iti etaistailaiH kRutaH snehabastirityarthaH||18-24||
sa~ggrahe bhojyagrahaNena dhAnyanAgarajalAdyapi sa~ggrAhyam| dhruvaM ye~arhA iti pratyahamanuvAsanIyAH| vidhishcokta iti ‘na tvAmaM praNayet’ ityAdigranthokto~arthaH||55-56||

yathAkramaM ShaDvyApadAM hetumAha- shIta ityAdi| gururiti gurutvayuktaH | varcaHsa~jcaye~alpabala iti sa~jcite male sati alpabalo varcaHsa~jcayapravartanAkShama ityarthaH| tairAvRuta iti padaM pratyekaM vAtAdiShu pa~jcasu yojanIyam| abhibhavAdapIti vAtAdinA~a~avRutamArgatvAnna yAti; tathA tena vAtAdinolbaNenAbhibhUtaguNatvAcca na AyAti| anAvRutatvAditi annenordhvamArgasyApihitatvAt| tasya lakShaNamiti yathAkramaM vAtAdyAvRutasya lakShaNaM vakShyamANama~ggamardAdi| veShTanairiti pArshvaveShTanaireva| ete ca stambhAdayo vAtAvRutasnehamahimnaiva jAyante, tena snehaprayogAt pUrvaM na bhavantyeva||26-28||
rAsnAtailaM “rAsnAsahasraniryUhe” (ci.a.28) ityAdinA vihitaM vAtavyAdhAvuktam| pItadrutailaM ca pItadru-sauvIrakAdidraveNa sAdhyamiti bruvate| tAbhyAmiti rAsnApItadrutailAbhyAm||29-31||
phalatailaM pUrvavyAhRutameva j~jeyam||32-33||
Amali~ggairiti AmalakShaNairAlasyAdibhiH| AmavihitA kriyeti “AmaM praduShTamannAbhibhUtaM punarullikhet” (vi.a.2) ityAdinA vihitA~anusartavyA||34-35||

snehaM viDAvRutamityAdau vartibhiriti phalavartibhiH, kecittu ‘bastibhiH’ iti paThanti| shyAmAbilvAdIni ca shyAmA ca bilvAdIni dashamUlAni ca shyAmAbilvAdIni; kiMvA, shyAmAdInyapyatra kalpoktAni nava gRuhyante; tairnirUhasya tathA~anuvAsanasya ca sAdhanamiha j~jeyam| udAvartahareNeti trimarmIyoktodAvartacikitsitena||36-37||
athAto netrabastivyApatsiddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
atha netrANi bastIMshca shRuNu varjyAni karmasu| netrasyAj~japraNItasya vyApadaH sacikitsitAH||3||
pIDyamAne~antarA mukte gude pratihato~anilaH| uraHshirortimUrvoshca sadanaM janayedbalI||13||
bastiH syAttatra bilvAdiphalashyAmAdimUtravAn| syAddAho davathuH shophaH kampanAbhihate gude||14||
atimAtrapraNItena netreNa kShaNanAdvaleH||15||
syAt sArti dAhanistodagudavarcaHpravartanam| tatra sarpiH picuH kShIraM picchAbastishca shasyate||16||
na bhAvayati mandastu bAhyastvAshu nivartate| snehastatra punaH samyak praNeyaH siddhimicchatA||17||
atiprapIDitaH koShThe tiShThatyAyAti vA galam| tatra bastirvirekashca galapIDAdi karma ca||18||

tatra shlokaH- netrabastipraNetRUNAM doShAnetAn sabheShajAn| vetti yastena matimAn bastikarmANi kArayet||19||

Commentary: sa~ggrahe teneti yathoktabheShajAbhij~jabhiShajA||19||
hrasvaM dIrghaM tanu sthUlaM jIrNaM shithilabandhanam| pArshvacchidraM tathA vakramaShTau netrANi varjayet||4||
aprAptyatigatikShobhakarShaNakShaNanasravAH| gudapIDA gatirjihmA teShAM doShA yathAkramam||5||
viShamamAMsalacchinnasthUlajAlikavAtalAH| snigdhaH klinnashca tAnaShTau bastIn karmasu varjayet||6||
gativaiShamyavisratvasrAvadaurgrAhyanisravAH| phenilacyutyadhAryatvaM basteH syurbastidoShataH||7||

savAtAtidrutotkShiptatiryagulluptakampitAH| atibAhyagamandAtivegadoShAH praNetRutaH||8||

Commentary: savAtetyAdayaH praNetRudoShajanitAH praNetRudoShA ucyante| tatra savAtatA anucchvAsya baddhe bastau tathA niHsheShaM ca datte bhavati| atidrutatvamapi praNayane nirgamanena| utkShiptatvam UrdhvakShiptatvam| tiryagiti tiryakpraNidhAnam| ulluptatvamiha pIDanadoSho yaH pIDanavicchedaM kRutvA punaH pIDyate sa j~jeyaH| kampitatvaM netrasya| atIti atipraNayanaM netrasya| bAhyagaM gude na praviShTamauShadham| mandatvaM ca pakvAshayAprAptatvam, etaddhi mandapIDanAdbhavati| ativegaH dUrapraveshAdbhavati, sa cAtipIDanakRutaH||8||

anucchvAsya ca baddhe vA datte niHsheSha eva vA| pravishya kupito vAyuH shUlatodakaro bhavet||9||

Commentary: etadvyApadAM cikitsitAni pratyekamAha- anucchvAsyetyAdi| ete cAnucchvAsanAdayo yadyapi pUrvameva niShiddhAH “subaddhamucchvAsya ca nirvalIkaM” (si.a.3) ityAdinaiva, tathA~api pramAdAttathAprayoge sati jAtavyApadAM cikitsAbhidhAnArthamasmin prakaraNe punaruktAH||9||-
drutaM praNIte niShkRuShTe sahasotkShipta eva vA||10||
syAt kaTIgudaja~gghArtibastistambhoruvedanAH | bhojanaM tatra vAtaghnaM snehAH svedAH sabastayaH||11||

tiryagvalyAvRutadvAre baddhe vA~api na gacchati| netre tadRuju niShkRuShya saMshodhya ca praveshayet||12||

Commentary: tiryakpraNidhAnadoShe~abhidhAtavye nalikAmukharodhi dravyAntaraM tatsamAnavyApattikaratvAducyate| tiryagvalyAvRutadvAre baddhe vA~apIti tiryakpraNihite netre valyAvRutadvAre sati tathA bastidravyagatasUtradravyAdinA vibaddhe netre bastidravyaM na yAti; tannetraM tiryakpraNihitaM niShkRuShya Ruju praveshayet, baddhadvAraM ca saMshodhya praveshayediti yojyam||12||

snehavyApatsiddhyabhidhAnaprasa~ggAt snehadAnasAdhananalikAdivyApatpratIkArArthA netrabastivyApatsiddhirucyate| netragatA tathA bastipuTakagatA ca vyApat tathA netrAsamyakpraNidhAnajanyA ca yA vyApadastAsAM siddhiH; tena netrabastivyApatsiddhiH duShTanetrabastipuTakayoshca vyApatsiddhiH tayoH sadoShatvena j~jAtvA parivarjanam||1-3||
antarA mukte madhye vicchede kRute| gude pratihato~anila iti pIDanavicchedajanito vAyurgudAt pratyAhataH| bilvAdi dashamUlaM; shyAmAdi shyAmAtrivRudAdivirecanadravyam||13-14||-

atimAtrapraNIteneti punaH punaH praNItena; anye tu duShpraveshanamatimAtrapraNItamAhuH ; atipraNayanaM yadyapi grathitakarNikAyA upari na bhavati, tathA~api karNikApIDayA gudapIDanAdatipravesho j~jeyaH| picchAbastiH vakShyamANaH||15-16||

na bhAvayatIti pakvAshayaM na prApnoti| atipIDane koShThe vA tiShThatIti pakShaH mandAdatipIDanAdvAtAvaraNAcca j~jeyaH; galagamanaM tu tIvrAtipIDanAdanAvaraNAcca bhavati| iyaM ca vyApat pUrvAdhyAye AhAraM vinA dattAnuvAsanaviShayatayoktA, iha tu nirUhasyAnuvAsanasya cAtipIDanajanyatayA bodhyata iti visheShaH| iha bastirvireko vA koShThasthe~apravartamAne, kaNThapIDanAdi tu galagate j~jeyam||17-18||

tadevAha- hrasvamityAdi| netradoShakathane aShTAvitipadamanuktakarkashatvAdidoShANAmatraivAntarbhAvopadarshanArtham| karkashatvasya jIrNena kartRutvasAmyAdagrahaNam | evamanyatrApi sa~gkhyAvacane prayojanamiha varNanIyam| tanu kRusham| aprAptyAdi yathAkramaM hrasvanetrAdiShu j~jeyam| atigatiH dUrapraveshaH| kShobhaH gudapraviShTasyetastato gamanam| gudapIDeti pArshvacchidranirgatena bastidraveNa yogAdgudapIDA| jihmeti kuTilA||4-5||

viShamaH viShamasaMsthAnaH, sthulaH atipramANaH, jAlikaH sUkShmAnekacchidraH, vAtalaH vAtaduShTaH, sa cAtra vihitasnehAdeH phenilatvAdinA nishcIyate| snigdhaH atisnigdhaH| klinnaH shIrNAvayavaH| gativaiShamyAdayo yathAkramaM viShamAdiShvaShTau doShAH| visratvam AmagandhatA, daurgrAhyaM durgrahatA, cyutiH hastAdbhraMshaH, adhAryatvaM basteriti klinnatvAddhi dhAraNAyogyatvaM bastipuTakasya||6-7||

drutamityAdi| utkShiptamapi samAnavyApattikaratayaikagranthenaiva paThyate| niShkRuShTe sahaseti cchedaH, utkShepastvasahasA~api vyApattikara eva| bastermUtrAshayasya stambho bastistambhaH| sabastaya iti vAtaharabastiyuktAH||10-11||

naraH shvo vamanaM pAtA bhu~jjIta kaphavardhanam| sujaraM dravabhUyiShThaM, laghvashItaM virecanam||18||

Commentary: vamanavirecanayoH pUrvadine yathA bhoktavyaM tadAha- nara ityAdi| etat prAguktamapi prakaraNavashAdvisheShAbhidhitsayA~abhidhIyate| pAteti pAtukAmaH| dravabhUyiShThamiti cchedaH| virecanaM pAtA laghu ashItaM ca bhu~jjIteti sambandhaH| evambhUtabhojanopapattimAha- utkliShTetyAdi| utkliShTAlpakaphatveneti vamanaM prati utkliShTakaphatvena, virecanaM prati tvalpakaphatveneti vibhAgaH||18||-
pItauShadhasya tu bhiShak shuddhili~ggAni lakShayet||19||
UrdhvaM kaphAnuge pitte viTpitte~anukaphe tvadhaH| hRutadoShaM vadet kArshyadaurbalye cet salAghave||20||

vAmayettu tataH sheShamauShadhaM na tvalAghave| staimitye~anilasa~gge ca nirudgAre~api vAmayet||21||

Commentary: virecanayoge sAvasheSha evauShadhe shuddhilakShaNadarshane sati kartavyamAha- vAmayettu tataH sheShamauShadhamiti; shuddhilakShaNe jAte sheShamauShadhamupalabhya virecanAtiyogapratiShedhArthaM vAmayedityarthaH| na tvalAghave ityanena lAghavavyatiriktasheShashuddhilakShaNadarshane satyapi na virecanasheShauShadhavamiH kartavyA| vamanauShadhaprayoge kartavyamAha- staimitye ityAdi| vamanauShadhaprayoge yAvat staimityAnilasa~ggau vartete, tAvannirudgAre~api bheShaje sati vamanaM kArayitavyam| etadvamanAvadhimAha- AlAghavAttanutvAcca kaphasyeti| pramAdAllAghavatanutvayoH parataH kriyamANavamanasya doShamAha- Apat paraM bhavediti; Apaditi atiyogalakShaNA| anye tu, staimitye ityAdinA~api virecanauShadhasyaivAvasthikaM vamanamucyate ityAhuH||21||-
vamite vardhate vahniH shamaM doShA vrajanti hi||22||
vamitaM la~gghayet samyagjIrNali~ggAnyalakShayan| tAni dRuShTvA tu peyAdikramaM kuryAnna la~gghanam||23||

saMshodhanAbhyAM shuddhasya hRutadoShasya dehinaH| yAtyagnirmandatAM tasmAt kramaM peyAdimAcaret||24||

Commentary: shuddhasya peyAdikramopapattimAha- saMshodhanAbhyAmityAdi| yadyapi nirUDhasyApyagnimAndyaM bhavati, tathA~api nirUDhasya tAdRugagnimAndyaM na bhavati yena peyAdikramaH kriyate, ato nirUhavyudAsArthaM saMshodhanAbhyAmiti dvivacanaM kRutam| yA tu samyagviriktalakShaNe “Urjo~agniH” (si.a.1) ityanenAgnivRuddhiruktA, sA ca virecanauShadhakShobhAtisa~ggAt kRutA~agnimAndyApekShayA~agnivRuddhiH ; teneha yAtyagnirmandatAmiti vacanena samaM na virodhaH||24||

kaphapitte vishuddhe~alpaM madyape vAtapaittike| tarpaNAdikramaM kuryAt peyA~abhiShyandayeddhi tAn||25||

Commentary: tarpaNAdiviShayamAha- kaphapitte ityAdi| vishuddhe~alpamiti asamyagvishuddhe| tarpaNAdikrame ca peyAyAH sthAne svacchatarpaNaM, vilepyAH sthAne ca ghanatarpaNaM deyam||25||
anulomo~anilaH svAsthyaM kShuttRuShNorjo manasvitA| laghutvamindriyodgArashuddhirjIrNauShadhAkRutiH||26||
klamo dAho~a~ggasadanaM bhramo mUrcchA shirorujA| aratirbalahAnishca sAvasheShauShadhAkRutiH||27||

akAle~alpAtimAtraM ca purANaM na ca bhAvitam| asamyaksaMskRutaM caiva vyApadyetauShadhaM drutam||28||

Commentary: yAdRushamauShadhaM vyApadyate tadAha- akAle ityAdi| alpaM vA atimAtraM vA~alpAtimAtram| na ca bhAvitamiti svarasaistulyavIryairvA~abhAvitam||28||

atyuShNavarShashItA hi grIShmavarShAhimAgamAH| tadantare prAvRuDAdyAsteShAM sAdhAraNAstrayaH||4||

Commentary: autsargikaM saMshodhanayogyaM kAlaM darshayannAha- atyuShNetyAdi| atyuShNetyAdi grIShmAdiShu yathAsa~gkhyaM j~jeyam| tadantare iti grIShmAdInAM madhye| prAvRuDAdyA iti prAvRuTsharadvasantAH| teShAM sAdhAraNA iti uShNavarShashItAnAM sAdhAraNAH; anudbhUtoShNavarShashItA iti yAvat||4||
prAvRuT shucinabhau j~jeyau sharadUrjasahau punaH| tapasyashca madhushcaiva vasantaH shodhanaM prati||5||
etAnRutUn vikalpyaivaM dadyAt saMshodhanaM bhiShak| svasthavRuttamabhipretya vyAdhau vyAdhivashena tu||6||

karmaNAM vamanAdInAmantareShvantareShu ca| snehasvedau prayu~jjIta snehaM cAnte prayojayet||7||

Commentary: karmaNAmityAdau antareShviti vamanAnantaraM virecane kartavye virecanAnantaraM vA bastau kartavye snehasvedau yathoktavidhAnena punaH kartavyau, na sakRutprayuktenaiva snehasvedena pa~jcakarmANi kartavyAnItyarthaH| snehaM cAnte prayojayediti saMshodhanakarmaparisamAptau saMshodhanajanitaglAniparihArArthaM saMshamanIyasnehaM prayojayedityarthaH||7||

visarpapiDakAshophakAmalApANDurogiNaH | abhighAtaviShArtAMshca nAtisnigdhAn virecayet||8||

Commentary: nAtisnigdhAniti anatisnigdhakAyAn narAn||8||

nAtisnigdhasharIrAya dadyAt snehavirecanam| snehotkliShTasharIrAya rUkShaM dadyAdvirecanam||9||

Commentary: avashyakartavye virecane sati atisnigdhAsnigdhayoH samyagyogakArakaM virecanaM darshayannAha- nAtItyAdi| snehavirecanamiti snigdhaM virecanamityarthaH| anatisnigdhe snehavirecanamanatisnigdhatvena kriyamANavirecanAyogapratiShedhArtham; atisnigdhasya snehavirecanaM snehanaprakarShAdativegaM gacchan pracalitAnapi doShAn nihantuM na shaknoti, doShAstu tena virecanena svasthAnAt pracyAvitA bhUyaHsrotaHsu lIyante, tatpratiShedhArthaM rUkShaM virecanaM samyagyogakArakaM dadyAdityayamAshayaH||9||

snehasvedopapannena jIrNe mAtrAvadauShadham| ekAgramanasA pItaM samyagyogAya kalpate||10||

Commentary: samyagyogakArikAM saMshodhanasAmagrImAha- snehasvedopapannenetyAdi| mAtrAvaditi ‘alpamAtraM mahAvegaM’ ityAdinA vakShyamANamalpamAtrAvattvaM j~jeyam| ekAgramanaseti saMshodhanaikacittena, kAmAdivyagramanaso hi vegavighAtAdayogaH syAt||10||
snigdhAt pAtrAdyathA toyamayatnena praNudyate| kaphAdayaH praNudyante snigdhAddehAttathauShadhaiH||11||
ArdraM kAShThaM yathA vahnirviShyandayati sarvataH| tathA snigdhasya vai doShAn svedo viShyandayet sthirAn||12||
kliShTaM vAso yathotkleshya malaH saMshodhyate~ambhasA| snehasvedaistathotkleshya shodhyate shodhanairmalaH ||13||

ajIrNe vardhate glAnirvibandhashcApi jAyate| pItaM saMshodhanaM caiva viparItaM pravartate||14||

Commentary: shodhanasamyagyogasAmagryabhidhAne proktasnehasvedayoH phalamabhidhAya, kramAgatasya jIrNe pItamityasya viparyaye doShamAha- ajIrNe vardhate glAniriti; ajIrNAvasthAyAM pIte shodhane sati glAnirmahatI bhavati| viparItaM pravartate iti vamanamadho yAti, virecanaM cordhvaM yAti||14||
alpamAtraM mahAvegaM bahudoShaharaM sukham| laghupAkaM sukhAsvAdaM prINanaM vyAdhinAshanam||15||
avikAri ca vyApattau nAtiglAnikaraM ca yat| gandhavarNarasopetaM vidyAnmAtrAvadauShadham||16||

vidhUya mAnasAn doShAn kAmAdInashubhodayAn | ekAgramanasA pItaM samyagyogAya kalpate||17||

Commentary: ekAgramanaseti yaduktaM tadvivRuNoti- vidhUyetyAdi||17||
AdhmAnaM parikartishca srAvo hRudgAtrayorgrahaH| jIvAdAnaM savibhraMshaH stambhaH sopadravaH klamaH||29||
ayogAdatiyogAcca dashaitA vyApado matAH| preShyabhaiShajyavaidyAnAM vaiguNyAdAturasya ca||30||
yogaH samyakpravRuttiH syAdatiyogo~ativartanam| ayogaH prAtilomyena na cAlpaM vA pravartanam||31||
shleShmotkliShTena durgandhamahRudyamati vA bahu| virecanamajIrNe ca pItamUrdhvaM pravartate||32||
kShudhArtamRudukoShThAbhyAM svalpotkliShTakaphena vA| tIkShNaM pItaM sthitaM kShubdhaM vamanaM syAdvirecanam||33||
prAtilomyena doShANAM haraNAtte hyakRutsnashaH| ayogasa~jj~je, kRucchreNa yAti doSho navA~alpashaH||34||
pItauShadho na shuddhashcejjIrNe tasmin punaH pibet| auShadhaM na tvajIrNe~anyadbhayaM syAdatiyogataH||35||
koShThasya gurutAM j~jAtvA laghutvaM balameva ca| ayoge mRudu vA dadyAdauShadhaM tIkShNameva vA||36||

vamanaM na tu dushchardaM duShkoShThaM na virecanam| pAyayetauShadhaM bhUyo hanyAt pItaM punarhi tau||37||

Commentary: punarvamanavirecanAdAnaviShayau prAha- vamanaM na tvityAdi| punaH pItaM tu hanyAdityarthaH||37||
asnigdhAsvinnadehasya rUkShasyAnavamauShadham| doShAnutklishya nirhartumashaktaM janayedgadAn||38||
vibhraMshaM shvayathuM hikkAM tamaso darshanaM bhRusham | piNDikodveShTanaM kaNDUmUrvoH sAdaM vivarNatAm||39||
snigdhasvinnasya cAtyalpaM dIptAgnerjIrNamauShadham| shItairvA stabdhamAme vA doShAnutklishya nAharet||40||
tAneva janayedrogAnayogaH sarva eva saH| vij~jAya matimAMstatra yathoktAM kArayet kriyAm||41||
taM tailalavaNAbhyaktaM svinnaM prastarasa~gkaraiH| pAyayeta punarjIrNe samUtrairvA nirUhayet||42||
nirUDhaM ca rasairdhAnvairbhojayitvA~anuvAsayet| phalamAgadhikAdArusiddhatailena mAtrayA||43||
snigdhaM vAtaharaiH snehaiH punastIkShNena shodhayet| na cAtitIkShNena tato hyatiyogastu jAyate||44||
atitIkShNaM kShudhArtasya mRudukoShThasya bheShajam| hRutvA~a~ashu viTpittakaphAn dhAtUnvisrAvayeddravAn||45||
balasvarakShayaM dAhaM kaNThashoShaM bhramaM tRuShAm| kuryAcca madhuraistatra sheShamauShadhamullikhet||46||
vamane tu virekaH syAdvireke vamanaM punaH | pariShekAvagAhAdyaiH sushItaiH stambhayecca tat||47||
kaShAyamadhuraiH shItairannapAnauShadhaistathA| raktapittAtisAraghnairdAhajvaraharairapi||48||
a~jjanaM candanoshIramajjAsRuksharkarodakam| lAjacUrNaiH pibenmanthamatiyogaharaM param||49||
shu~ggAbhirvA vaTAdInAM siddhAM peyAM samAkShikAm| varcaHsA~ggrAhikaiH siddhaM kShIraM bhojyaM ca dApayet||50||
jA~ggalairvA rasairbhojyaM picchAbastishca shasyate| madhurairanuvAsyashca siddhena kShIrasarpiShA||51||
vamanasyAtiyoge tu shItAmbupariShecitaH| pibet kaphaharairmanthaM saghRutakShaudrasharkaram||52||
sodgArAyAM bhRushaM vamyAM mUrcchAyAM dhAnyamustayoH| samadhUkA~jjanaM cUrNaM lehayenmadhusaMyutam||53||
vamato~antaHpraviShTAyAM jihvAyAM kavalagrahAH| snigdhAmlalavaNairhRudyairyUShakShIrarasairhitAH||54||
phalAnyamlAni khAdeyustasya cAnye~agrato narAH| niHsRutAM tu tiladrAkShAkalkaliptAM praveshayet||55||
vAggrahAnilarogeShu ghRutamAMsopasAdhitAm| yavAgUM tanukAM dadyAt snehasvedau ca buddhimAn||56||

vamitashca viriktashca mandAgnishca vila~gghitaH| agniprANavivRuddhyarthaM kramaM peyAdikaM bhajet ||57||

Commentary: atiyoge~api yathA peyAdikramo bhavati tadAha- vamitashcetyAdi| atiharaNAdativamito~ativiriktashceti boddhavyam||57||
bahudoShasya rUkShasya hInAgneralpamauShadham| sodAvartasya cotklishya doShAnmArgAnnirudhya ca||58||
bhRushamAdhmApayennAbhiM pRuShThapArshvashirorujam| shvAsaviNmUtravAtAnAM sa~ggaM kuryAcca dAruNam||59||
abhya~ggasvedavartyAdi sanirUhAnuvAsanam| udAvartaharaM sarvaM karmAdhmAtasya shasyate||60||
snigdhena gurukoShThena sAme balavadauShadham| kShAmeNa mRudukoShThena shrAntenAlpabalena vA||61||
pItaM gatvA gudaM sAmamAshu doShaM nirasya ca| tIvrashUlAM sapicchAsrAM karoti parikartikAm||62||
la~gghanaM pAcanaM sAme rUkShoShNaM laghubhojanam| bRuMhaNIyo vidhiH sarvaH kShAmasya madhurastathA||63||
Ame jIrNe~anubandhashcet kShArAmlaM laghu shasyate| puShpakAsIsamishraM vA kShAreNa lavaNena vA||64||
sadADimarasaM sarpiH pibedvAte~adhike sati| dadhyamlaM bhojane pAne saMyuktaM dADimatvacA||65||
devadArutilAnAM vA kalkamuShNAmbunA pibet| ashvatthodumbaraplakShakadambairvA shRutaM payaH||66||
kaShAyamadhuraM shItaM picchAbastimathApi vA| yaShTImadhukasiddhaM vA snehabastiM pradApayet||67||
alpaM tu bahudoShasya doShamutklishya bheShajam| alpAlpaM srAvayet kaNDUM shophaM kuShThAni gauravam||68||
kuryAccAgnibalotkleshastaimityArucipANDutAH| parisrAvaH sa, taM doShaM shamayedvAmayedapi||69||
snehitaM vA punastIkShNaM pAyayet virecanam| shuddhe cUrNAsavAriShTAn saMskRutAMshca pradApayet||70||
pItauShadhasya vegAnAM nigrahAnmArutAdayaH| kupitA hRudayaM gatvA ghoraM kurvanti hRudgraham||71||
sa hikkAkAsapArshvArtidainyalAlAkShivibhramaiH| jihvAM khAdati niHsa~jj~jo dantAn kiTikiTApayan||72||
na gacchedvibhramaM tatra vAmayedAshu taM bhiShak| madhuraiH pittamUrcchArtaM kaTubhiH kaphamUrcchitam||73||
pAcanIyaistatashcAsya doShasheShaM vipAcayet| kAyAgniM ca balaM cAsya krameNotthApayettataH ||74||
pavanenAtivamato hRudayaM yasya pIDyate| tasmai snigdhAmlalavaNaM dadyAt pittakaphe~anyathA||75||
pItauShadhasya vegAnAM nigraheNa kaphena vA| ruddho~ati vA vishuddhasya gRuhNAtya~ggAni mArutaH||76||
stambhavepathunistodasAdodveShTanamanthanaiH| tatra vAtaharaM sarvaM snehasvedAdi kArayet ||77||
atitIkShNaM mRudau koShThe laghudoShasya bheShajam| doShAn hRutvA vinirmathya jIvaM harati shoNitam||78||
tenAnnaM mishritaM dadyAdvAyasAya shune~api vA| bhu~gkte taccedvadejjIvaM na bhu~gkte pittamAdishet||79||
shuklaM vA bhAvitaM vastramAvAnaM koShNavAriNA| prakShAlitaM vivarNaM syAt pitte shuddhaM tu shoNite||80||
tRuShNAmUrcchAmadArtasya kuryAdAmaraNAt kriyAm| tasya pittaharIM sarvAmatiyoge ca yA hitA ||81||
mRugagomahiShAjAnAM sadyaskaM jIvatAmasRuk| pibejjIvAbhisandhAnaM jIvaM taddhyAshu gacchati ||82||
tadeva darbhamRuditaM raktaM bastiM pradApayet| shyAmAkAshmaryabadarIdUrvoshIraiH shRutaM payaH||83||
ghRutamaNDA~jjanayutaM shItaM bastiM pradApayet| picchAbastiM sushItaM vA ghRutamaNDAnuvAsanam||84||
gudaM bhraShTaM kaShAyaishca stambhayitvA praveshayet| sAma gAndharvashabdAMshca sa~jj~jAnAshe~asya kArayet||85||
yadA virecanaM pItaM viDantamavatiShThate| vamanaM bheShajAntaM vA doShAnutklishya nAvahet||86||
tadA kurvanti kaNDvAdIn doShAH prakupitA gadAn| sa vibhraMsho matastatra syAdyathAvyAdhi bheShajam||87||
pItaM snigdhena sasnehaM taddoShairmArdavAdvRutam| na vAhayati doShAMstu svasthAnAt stambhayeccyutAn||88||
vAtasa~ggagudastambhashUlaiH kSharati cAlpashaH| tIkShNaM bastiM virekaM vA so~arho la~gghitapAcitaH||89||
rUkShaM virecanaM pItaM rUkSheNAlpabalena vA| mArutaM kopayitvA~a~ashu kuryAddhorAnupadravAn||90||
stambhashUlAni ghorANi sarvagAtreShu muhyataH| snehasvedAdikastatra kAryo vAtaharo vidhiH||91||
snigdhasya mRudukoShThasya mRudUtklishyauShadhaM kapham| pittaM vAtaM ca saMrudhya satandrAgauravaM klamam||92||
daurbalyaM cA~ggasAdaM ca kuryAdAshu tadullikhet| la~gghanaM pAcanaM cAtra snigdhaM tIkShNaM ca shodhanam||93||
tatra shlokau- ityetA vyApadaH proktAH sarUpAH sacikitsitAH| vamanasya virekasya kRutasyAkushalairnRuNAm ||94||
etA vij~jAya matimAnavasthAshcaiva tattvataH| dadyAt saMshodhanaM samyagArogyArthI nRuNAM sadA||95||

vamanavirecanayoH shuddhili~ggAni yadyapi prAguktAni, tathA~apIha sheShauShadhamalAdivisheShAbhidhAnArthaM punaH pItauShadhasyetyAdinA tAnyabhidhatte| kaphAnuge pitte UrdhvahRutadoShaM vadet, viTpitte cAnukaphe dRushyamAne~adhohRutadoShaM vadediti yojanA; etat kaphAntatvaM virecanasya, vamanasya ca pittAntatvaM pUrvameva vyAhRutam| etat pittAntatvaM kaphAntatvaM vA~asamyakshuddhe~api doShasyAnupUrvyA~avasthAnAdbhavatIti kRutvA lakShaNAntarANyapi etayoH sAhacaryeNAha- kArshyadaurbalye cet salAghave iti||19-20||
yathoktavamanaphalamAha- vamite vardhate ityAdinA| samyagjIrNali~ggAnyalakShayanniti saMshodhanabheShajasya vakShyamANasamyagjIrNali~ggAnyalakShayan| tAnIti jIrNauShadhali~ggAni||22-23||
jIrNauShadhali~ggAnyAha- anuloma ityAdi| UrjaH balam| indriyashuddhiH indriyapATavam| udgArasya cauShadhagandhAdivirahitvameva shuddhiH||26-27||

prAvRuDAdIn mAsavibhAgena darshayannAha- prAvRuT shucinabhAvityAdi| shucinabhau AShADhashrAvaNau| Urjasahau kArtikamArgashIrShau| tapasyaH phAlgunaH| madhu caitraH| shodhanaM pratIti shodhane kartavye~ayaM yathoktaH prAvRuDAdiRutuvibhAgo bhavati; svasthavRuttau rasotpattau vA tasyAshitIyokta eva varShAsharaddhemantashishiravasantagrIShmarUpaH Rutukramo bhavati| etAnRutUniti prAvRuDAdInRutUn| vikalpyaivamiti yathoktamAsavibhAgena vyavasthApya saMshodhanaM dadyAt| etaduktasaMshodhanA~ggartukramavibhAgenaiva carakasaMskAra~api navegAndhAraNIye “mAdhavaprathame mAsi” (sU.a.7) ityAdinA granthena caitrashrAvaNAgrahAyaNeShu vamanAdisaMshodhanamuktaM, tathA rogabhiShagjitIye (vi.a.8) ca shishiraM parityajya prAvRuDAdinaiva RutukramaH saMshodhanA~ggatayoktaH; tena, rasabalotpAdacintAyAM svasthavRuttAnuShThAneShu ca shishirAdikramo bhavati, saMshodhanavyavasthAyAM tu prAvRuDAdiriti prAvRuDAdikramo~ayaM saMshodhanAnukUlatayA~a~acAryeNa kalpito na pAramArthikaH| ye tu, prAvRuDAdikramaM ga~ggAyA dakShiNe kUle, uttare~api shishirAdikramaM vadanti, tanmate ‘shodhanaM prati’ iti grantho~anupapannaH; tena, “bhUyo varShati parjanyo ga~ggAyA dakShiNe jalam| tena varShAprAvRuDAkhyau RutU teShAM prakalpitau ” ityAdinA granthena yadi nAma deshabhedenApi RutukramaH pAramArthiko~abhidhIyate, tathA~api nAsAvAcAryasyehAbhimataH, prapa~jcitashcAyamarthaH sUtrasthAna eva| ayaM ca shodhanakAlopadesho~anAtyayike vyAdhau j~jeyaH, Atyayike tu UShmAdipratikAraM kRutvA atyuShNe~api kAle saMshodhanapravRuttirbhavatyeva, ukto hyayamartho rogabhiShagjitIye- “Atyayike tu punaH karmaNi kAmamRutuM vikalpya kRutrimaguNopadhAnena” (vi.a.8) ityAdinA granthena||5-6||

snehasvedayoH phalaM ‘snigdhAt pAtrAt’ ityAdinA bhUridRuShTAntena darshayan snehasvedayoravashyakartavyatAM sUcayati| ayatneneti alpAyAsena| praNudyante iti AkRuShyante| viShyandayati sarvata iti sarvataH sthitaM dravamAkarShati| agnidRuShTAntena snigdhagAtrasya samyagdoShaharaNamucyate, tRutIyadRuShTAntena tu snehasvedayormilitayoH phalamucyate| kliShTamiti mlAnam| utkleshyeti kShArAgnisambandhAt samutkleshya||11-13||

mAtrAvaditi yaduktaM tadvivRuNoti- alpamAtramityAdi| alpamAtraM mahAvegamiti alpamAtratve satyapi prashastamahAvegam| avikArIti vyApattAvapi IShadvikArakAri| mAtrAvaditi prashastamAtrAvat| yadyapi ca sukhAsvAdAdayo mAtrAyAH phalaM na bhavanti, tathA~apIha mAtrAyAH prashastatvena dravyasaMskArAdivisheShAdhInA api te gRuhyante; sukhAdyAshrayadravyagatatvamapi hi mAtrAyAH prAshastyamiha; kiMvA, evambhUte eva saMshodhane etanmAtrAvattvaM paribhAShitaM j~jeyam||15-16||

saMshodhanAyogAtiyogajanyA AviShkRutA vyApadaH prAha- AdhmAnamityAdi| (AdhmAnAdayashcAmI nAvashyamayogAtiyogAnte bhavanti, tenopadravabhUtatvAt pRuthaguktAH|) etA vyApadaH preShyAdivaiguNyAdutpannA ayogAdatiyogAcca bhavantIti vAkyArthaH| tatrAdhmAnamayogAdbhavati, parikartikA tvatiyogAt, srAvo~ayogAt, hRudgraho~apyayogAdeva, tathA~a~ggagraho~ayogAcca bhavati, jIvAdAnamatiyogAt; vibhraMshastu gudabhraMsha-sa~jj~jAbhraMsha-kaNDvAdilakShaNabhraMshabhedAttrividho vaktavyaH; gudabhraMsha-sa~jj~jAbhraMshAvatiyogajanyau, sheShastu vibhraMsho~ayogajanyaH; upadravo~apyayogajanya eva, klamo~apyayogajaH| eteShAM cAyogAtiyogajanyatvavibhAga uttaragranthe sphuTo bhaviShyati| yadyapi cAyogAtiyogamithyAyogAstatra tatra kAraNatvenoktAH, tathA~apIha vamanavirecanayormithyAyogaM necchati; yato doShANAM caturvidhaiva pravRuttirbhavati, yat- atipravRutiH, asamyakpravRuttirvA, apravRuttiH, alpapravRuttirvA; tatrApyapravRuttyalpavRuttI ayogagRuhIte eva; yA~api cAtra prAtilomyena pravRuttiH, sA~api doShasyApekShitasyApravartakatvAdayogagRuhItataiva; vakShyati hi “ayogaH prAtilomyena na cAlpaM vA pravartanam” iti||29-30||

yogAtiyogAyogasvarUpamAha- yoga ityAdi| ativartanamiti saMshodhyAtiriktapravartanam| prAtilomyeneti vamanasya virecanena, virecanasya vamanena pravartanam; etacca prAtilomyapravartanaM prAyo vivakShitadoShApravartakatayaivAyoganikShiptam| na cAlpaM vA pravartanamiti sarvathA~apravartanamalpaM vA pravartanamiti| sthitamiti jhaTiti UrdhvaM gacchat | etatprAtilomyapravRuttyA yathA~ayogatvaM tadAha- prAtilomyenetyAdi| prAtilomyenAkRutsnaharaNAt ayogasa~jj~je te iti yojyam| prAtilomyaharaNe~akRusnadoShaharaNameva darshayannAha- kRucchreNetyAdi| pratilomaharaNe kRutsno doSho na yAti, alpasho vA yAtIti bhAvaH; tenAkRutsnadoShaharaNaM pratilomaharaNe upapannamiti bhAvaH| ‘kRucchreNa yadAgacchati cAlpasha’ iti pAThe, yacchabdo hetau; pUrvatra pAThe vA shabdo hetau||31-34||

AdhmAnAdInAmayogAtiyogau kAraNatvenoktau, tena kAraNayorayogAtiyogayoH prathamaM hetuli~ggacikitsitAni prAha- pItauShadha ityAdi| jIrNe iti auShadhe jIrNe| punaH pibediti tadahareva| bhayaM syAdatiyogata iti pUrvAjIrNauShadhanavInauShadhAbhyAmatiyogaH syAt| mRudu vA dadyAdityAdau gurukoShThe balavati tIkShNaM, laghukoShThe durbale ca mRudu dadyAditi vyavasthA||35-36||

stokapravRuttirUpamayogaM kAraNabhedenAha- asnigdhetyAdi| asnigdhasyeti asamyaksnigdhasya| rUkShasyeti na manAgapi snigdhasya| anavamiti jIrNatayA mandavIryam| nirhartumiti niHsheSheNa hartum| vibhraMshamiti viparItapravRuttisAmarthyam||38-39||

aparamayogamAha- snigdhasvinnasya cetyAdi| jIrNamiti alpatvAddIptAgnitvAcca jIrNam| Ame iti apakve doShe, ‘pItaM’ iti sheShaH| ete~atrAyogalakShaNatrayeNa ye pratipAditA gadA na te bhinnasAmagrIjanyA bhinnacikitsA vA, tena na pUrvamayogajanyavyApattiprastAve paThitAH; evamatiyogalakShaNatayA vakShyamANagadeShvapi vAcyam| yathoktamiti ‘pItauShadho na shuddhashcet’ ityAdinoktaM; kiMvA~agre ‘taM taila’ ityAdigranthenoktam| pAyayeteti saMshodhanaM pAyayeta| dhAnvairiti dhanvamRugapakShimAMsarasaiH||40-44||

atiyogasya hetvAdikamAha- atitIkShNamityAdi| iyaM ca sAmagrI virecanAtiyogasyaiva ghaTate; yato mRudukoShThe bubhukShite ca viTpittakaphaharaNakrameNa ca saivAtiyujyate ; vamanAtiyogasAmagrI cAnenodAharaNenonneyA; kiMvA, atitIkShNamiti padenaiva vamanasyApyatitIkShNatvamatiyogakAraNamuktaM, viTpittakaphaharaNaM yathAyogyatayA krameNa virecane vamane ca boddhavyam| sheShamauShadhamullikhediti tAdAtvikI cikitsA| mRudvitipadaM vamanena virecanena ca sambadhyate| vaTAdInAmiti nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthakapItanAnAm| varcaHsa~ggrAhikAH ShaDvirecanashatAshritIyoktAH priya~ggvanantAdayaH||45-51||
purato~amlaphalakhAdanaM mukhasrAvaNena jihvAstabdhatvaM hantum | atiyoge niHsRutAmiti jihvAvisheShaNam||52-56||

ayogAtiyogayorAdhmAnAdivyApadAM yathAkramaM hetuli~ggacikitsAdi nirdishannAha- bahudoShasyetyAdi| etAshca vyApado nAvashyamatiyogAyogayorbhavanti, upadravabhUtatvAt ; ata evopakalpanIye- “atiyogAyoganimittAnimAnupadravAn vidyAt”- “AdhmAnaM parikartikA”(sU.a.15) ityAdinA granthena etA dasha vyApadaH pratipAditAH||58-60||

parikartikAmAha- snigdhenetyAdi| pItaM gatvA gudamityAdi virecanAtiyogajanyaparikartikAyAM sa~ggataM, na vamanAtiyogajanyaparikartikAyAm; upakalpanIye ca sAkShAdvamanAyogAtiyogajanyatayaivAdhmAnAdaya uktAH, tenAnukto~api vamanavyApattau parikarto~anenodAharaNena kalpanIyaH; tantrAntare~apyuktaM- ‘yA tu parikartikA virecane, tadvamane kaNThakarShaNaM; yo~adhaHparisrAvo virecane, sa vamane kaphaprasekaH” (su.ci.a.34) iti; tadanayA dishA AdhmAnAdIni vamanavirecanayorayogAtiyogajanyatayA vyAkhyAtAnItyeke| Ashu doShaM nirasyeti vamanAtiyogajanyeyaM vyApat| atra la~gghanAdikriyA atiyoge satyapyAmapAcanAya j~jeyA| kShAmeNa mRudukoShThenetyAdisamprAptijanitasya kShAmapuruShaprabhavasya la~gghanapAcanAdyamupakrAntameva||61-63||

AmAvasthAkartavyamAha- Ame jIrNa ityAdi| kShArAmlaM laghu shasyata iti atIsAre yaduktaM- “cA~ggerIkoladadhyamlanAgarakShArasaMyutam| ghRutaM” (ci.a.19) iti; laghumAtraM ca shasyata iti j~jeyam| puShpakAsIsamityatra puShpashabdena kecit sA~ggrAhikAni dhAtakIkusumAdIni grAhayanti||64-67||

alpamityAdinA parisrAvamAha| shamayedvAmayedapItyAdau alpadoShe shamanaM, bahudoShe UrdhvagatadoShe tu vamanamiti vyavasthA| vAmayedapItyatrApi snehitaM punariti sambadhyate| cUrNAsavAriShTA grahaNyarshashcikitsAdiShu j~jeyAH||68-70||

pItauShadhasyetyAdinA hRudgrahamAha| na gacchedvibhramaM tatreti hRudgrahapIDito~ayaM mriyamANo vA~ayamiti bhrAntiM na gacchedityarthaH| vamanaM cAtra mUrcchite duHshakaprayogaM, tena mUrcchArambha eva vamanaM kArayitavyaM; kiMvA mUrcchAyAmapya~ggulIpraveshAdinA vamanaM kArayitavyam| pittamUrcchArtamiti pittaprabaladoShajanitamUrcchArtam| ativamata iti vamanAyAtipravAhaNaM kurvataH| pittakaphe~anyatheti pitte kaphe vA hRudayapIDAkare snigdhAmlalavaNaviparItaM rUkShatiktakaTukAdikramaM kuryAt||71-75||
pItauShadhasyetyAdinA a~ggagrahaNamayogajamatiyogajaM cAha| kaphena vA ruddho doShaH punara~ggAni nigRuhNAti; shuddhasya vA mArutaH kupito~a~ggAni pratigRuhNAti stambhAdibhiH||76-77||

atitIkShNamityAdinA jIvAdAnamAha| laghudoShasyeti svalpadoShasya| vinirmathyeti shoNitameva kShobhayitvA | jIvamiti jIvanahetudhAturUpaM shoNitam| shoNitaM ki~jcidraktapittakShobhAdbhavati, ki~jcicca jIvashoNitaM bhavati; tadvisheShaparIkShArthamAha- tenAnnamityAdi| pittamAdishediti shoNitagataM pittamAdished raktapittamiti yAvat| AvAnamiti shuShkam| pitte iti raktapitte sati kShAlitaM vastraM vivarNaM bhavati, jIvashoNite tu sati shuddhaM vastraM bhavati| parIkShA ca cikitsAbhedArthameva; raktapitte raktapittaharI kriyA, jIvashoNitaM tu dRuShTvA ‘tRuShNAmUrcchAmadArtasya’ ityAdinoktA kartavyA| atiyoge ca yA hiteti atraiva ‘pariShekAvagAhAdyaiH sushItaiH stambhayecca tam’ ityAdinoktA j~jeyA| jIvaM taddhyAshu gacchatIti asRukprabhAvAdAshveva shoNitarUpatAM yAti sadyaskamasRuk| shyAmetyAdau shyAmA priya~gguH||78-84||

gudaM bhraShTamityAdinA gudabhraMsharUpaM vibhraMshamAha| kaShAyairiti kaShAyarasaiH| sAmetyAdinA sa~jj~jAvibhraMsharUpavibhraMshacikitsAmAha| sAma sAntvanam| gAndharvashabdo gItam| etau ca vibhraMshAvatiyogajanyau| yadetyAdinA tRutIyamayogajanyavibhraMshamAha| viDantamavatiShThata iti malamAtramapahRutyAvatiShThate| bheShajAntamiti bheShajamAtraM vamanenAvatiShThate| nAvahediti nApaharati| etadvyApadashca vibhraMshasa~jj~jA pAribhAShikI| yathAvyAdhibheShajamiti kaNDvAdiviparItaM bheShajam||85-87||

pItaM snigdhenetyAdinA stambhamAha| mArdavAdvRutamiti bheShajasya mRudutayA doShairvRutam| svasthAnAccyutAn stambhayediti yojanIyam| so~arha iti la~gghanapAcanAnantaraM tIkShNaM bastiM virekaM vA tIkShNamarhatItyarthaH||88-89||

rUkShamityAdinA upadravAnAha| yadyapyAdhmAnAdayo~apyamI upadravA eva, tathA~api teShAM sa~jj~jAntareNaiva gRuhItatvAcchUlAdaya eva upadravashabdAbhihitAH| shUlAdayashcAmI pradhAnAnyuttarakAlabhAvitvAdanupadravarUpA apyupadravashabdenocyante; yathA- “dhUmaH kuryAdupadravAn” (sU.a.5) iti; kiMvA, ayogAkhyasya vyAdheramI upadravA iti j~jeyam||90-91||
snigdhasyetyAdinA klamamAha| kaphaM pittaM cotklishya vAtaM ca tAbhyAmeva saMrudhya bheShajaM tandrAdiyuktaM klamaM kuryAt| tadullikhediti tad bheShajaM kaphapittaM collikhedityarthaH||92-93||
ityetA ityAdinA adhyAyArthasa~ggrahaM darshayitvA vyApadutpAdahetumAha| dadyAt saMshodhanaM samyagiti tathA saMshodhanaM dadyAd yathA vyApado notpadyanta evetyarthaH||94-95||
athAto bastivyApatsiddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
dhIdhairyaudAryagAmbhIryakShamAdamataponidhim| punarvasuM shiShyagaNaH papraccha vinayAnvitaH||3||
kAH kati vyApado basteH kiMsamutthAnalakShaNAH| kA cikitsA iti prashnA~jchrutvA tAnabravIdguruH||4||
nAtiyogau klamAdhmAne hikkA hRutprAptirUrdhvatA| pravAhikA shiro~ggArtiH parikartaH parisravaH||5||
dvAdasha vyApado basterasamyagyogasambhavAH| AsAmekaikasho rUpaM cikitsAM ca nibodhata||6||
snigdhasvinne mahAdoShe bastirmRudvalpabheShajaH| utklishyAlpaM hareddoShaM janayecca pravAhikAm||40||
sa bastipAyushophena ja~gghorusadanena vA| niruddhamAruto janturabhIkShNaM sampravAhate||41||
svedAbhya~ggAnnirUhAMshca shodhanIyAnulomikAn| vidadhyAlla~gghayitvA tu vRuttiM kuryAdviriktavat||42||
durbale krUrakoShThe ca tIvradoShe tanurmRuduH| shIto~alpashcAvRuto doShairbastistadvihato~anilaH||43||
mArgairgAtrANi sandhAvannUrdhvaM mUrdhni vihanyate| grIvAM manye ca gRuhNAti shiraH kaNThaM bhinatti ca||44||
bAdhiryaM karNanAdaM ca pInasaM netravibhramam| kuryAdabhya~jjanaM tailalavaNena yathAvidhi||45||
yu~jjyAt pradhamanairnasyairdhUmairasya virecayet| tIkShNAnulomikenAtha snigdhaM bhukte~anuvAsayet ||46||
snehasvedairanApAdya gurustIkShNo~atimAtrayA| yasya bastiH prayujyeta so~atimAtraM pravartayet||47||
sruteShu tasya doSheShu nirUDhasyAtimAtrashaH| stabdhodAvRutakoShThasya vAyuH sampratihanyate||48||
vilomanasamudbhUto rujatya~ggAni dehinaH| gAtraveShTananistodabhedasphuraNajRumbhaNaiH ||49||
taM tailalavaNAbhyaktaM secayeduShNavAriNA| eraNDapatraniShkvAthaiH prastaraishcopapAdayet||50||
yavAn kulatthAn kolAni pa~jcamUle tathobhaye| jalADhakadvaye paktvA pAdasheSheNa tena ca||51||
kuryAt sabilvatailoShNalavaNena nirUhaNam| taM nirUDhaM samAshvastaM droNyAM samavagAhayet||52||
tato bhuktavatastasya kArayedanuvAsanam| yaShTImadhukatailena bilvatailena vA bhiShak ||53||
mRudukoShThAlpadoShasya rUkShastIkShNo~atimAtravAn| bastirdoShAnnirasyAshu janayet parikartikAm||54||
trikava~gkShaNabastInAM todaM nAbheradho rujam| vibandho~alpAlpamutthAnaM bastinirlekhanAdbhavet||55||
svAdushItauShadhaistatra paya ikShvAdibhiH shRutam| yaShTyAhvatilakalkAbhyAM bastiH syAt kShIrabhojinaH||56||
sasarjarasayaShTyAhvaji~gginIkardamA~jjanam| vinIya dugdhe bastiH syAt vyaktAmlamRudubhojinaH||57||
pittaroge~amla uShNo vA tIkShNo vA lavaNo~athavA| bastirlikhati pAyuM tu kShiNoti vidahatyapi||58||
sa vidagdhaH sravatyasraM pittaM cAnekavarNavat| sAryate bahuvegena mohaM gacchati cAsakRut||59||
ArdrashAlmalivRuntaistu kShuNNairAjaM payaH shRutam| sarpiShA yojitaM shItaM bastimasmai pradApayet||60||
vaTAdipallaveShveSha kalpo yavatileShu ca| suvarcalopodikayoH karbudAre ca shasyate||61||
gude sekAH pradehAshca shItAH syurmadhurAshca ye| raktapittAtisAraghnI kriyA cAtra prashasyate||62||

tIkShNatvaM mUtrapIlvagnilavaNakShArasarShapaiH| prAptakAlaM vidhAtavyaM kShIrAdyairmArdavaM tathA||63||

Commentary: samprati tatra tatra bastInAM mRudutvaM tIkShNatvaM ca vihitaM; tena tadvij~jAnArthaM mArdavatIkShNatvakArakadravyagaNamAha- tIkShNatvamityAdi| pIluH auttarapathikaM phalaM; pIlusthAne kecid bilvaM paThanti| prAptakAlamiti uktAvastham||63||

ApAdatalamUrdhasthAn doShAn pakvAshaye sthitaH| vIryeNa bastirAdatte khastho~arko bhUrasAniva||64||

Commentary: bastiprabhAvamAha- ApAdetyAdi| pakvAshaye sthita iti pakvAshayagata eva| Adatte vIryeNeti shaktyA svabhAvasambaddhayA| evambhUtavIryaM bastAveva; tena pAcanAdiprayogANAM na bastivattadahareva sakaladehagatadoShavijetRutvaM bhavati| khastha iti AkAshagataH| sushrute tUktaM- “vIryeNa bastirAdatte doShAnApAdamastakAt| pakvAshayastho~ambarago bhUmerarko rasAniva” (su.ci.a.35) iti||64||

yadvat kusumbhasammishrAttoyAdrAgaM haret paTaH| tadvaddravIkRutAddehAnnirUho nirharenmalAn||65||

Commentary: samprati basteH sharIre malaprasAdasahite~api yathA malAMshamAtrahArakatvaM bhavati, taddRuShTAntena darshayannAha- yadvadityAdi| dravIkRutAditi snehasvedAbhyAM vilAyitAt| malAniti doShAn purIShaM ca||65||

tatra shlokaH- ityetA vyApadaH proktA basteH sAkRutibheShajAH| buddhvA kArtsnyena tAn bastInniyu~jjannAparAdhyati||66||

Commentary: ityetA ityAdisa~ggrahaH| yasmAdetA vyApado bastiduShprayogajanyA bhavanti, tasmAt kArtsnyena bastIn buddhvA niyu~jjannAparAdhyati, bastivyApadaM nAsAdayatItyarthaH||66||
gurukoShThe~anilaprAye rUkShe vAtolbaNe~api vA| shIto~alpalavaNasnehadravamAtro ghano~api vA||7||
bastiH sa~gkShobhya taM doShaM durbalatvAdanirharan| karoti gurukoShThatvaM vAtamUtrashakRudgraham||8||
nAbhibastirujaM dAhaM hRullepaM shvayathuM gude| kaNDUgaNDAni vaivarNyamaruciM vahnimArdavam||9||
tatroShNAyAH pramathyAyAH pAnaM svedAH pRuthagvidhAH| phalavartyo~athavA kAlaM j~jAtvA shastaM virecanam||10||
bilvamUlatrivRuddAruyavakolakulatthavAn| surAdimUtravAn bastiH saprAkpeShyastamAnayet||11||
snigdhasvinne~atitIkShNoShNo mRudukoShThe~atiyujyate| tasya li~ggaM cikitsA ca shodhanAbhyAM samA bhavet||12||
pRushniparNIM sthirAM padmaM kAshmaryaM madhukaM balAm| piShTvA drAkShAM madhUkaM ca kShIre taNDuladhAvane||13||
drAkShAyAH pakvaloShTasya prasAde madhukasya ca| vinIya saghRutaM bastiM dadyAddAhe~atiyogaje ||14||
AmasheShe nirUheNa mRudunA doSha IritaH| mArgaM ruNaddhi vAtasya hantyagniM mUrcchayatyapi||15||
klamaM vidAhaM hRucchUlaM mohaveShTanagauravam| kuryAt svedairvirUkShaistaM pAcanaishcApyupAcaret||16||
pippalIkattRuNoshIradArumUrvAshRutaM jalam| pibet sauvarcalonmishraM dIpanaM hRudvishodhanam||17||
vacAnAgarashaTyelA dadhimaNDena mUrcchitAH| peyAH prasannayA vA syurariShTenAsavena vA||18||
dAru trikaTukaM pathyAM palAshaM citrakaM shaTIm| piShTvA kuShThaM ca mUtreNa pibet kShArAMshca dIpanAn||19||
bastimasya vidadhyAcca samUtraM dAshamUlikam| samUtramathavA vyaktalavaNaM mAdhutailikam||20||
alpavIryo mahAdoShe rUkShe krUrAshaye kRutaH| bastirdoShAvRuto ruddhamArgo rundhyAt samIraNam||21||
sa vimArgo~anilaH kuryAdAdhmAnaM marmapIDanam| vidAhaM gurukoShThasya muShkava~gkShaNavedanAm||22||
ruNaddhi hRudayaM shUlairitashcetashca dhAvati| shyAmAphalAdibhiH kuShThakRuShNAlavaNasarShapaiH||23||
dhUmamAShavacAkiNvakShAracUrNaguDaiH kRutAm| karA~gguShThanibhAM vartiM yavamadhyAM nidhApayet ||24||
abhyaktasvinnagAtrasya tailAktAM snehite gude| athavA lavaNAgAradhUmasiddhArthakaiH kRutAm||25||
bilvAdinA nirUhaH syAt pIlusarShapamUtravAn| saralAmaradArubhyAM siddhaM caivAnuvAsanam||26||
mRudukoShThe~abale bastiratitIkShNo~atinirharan| kuryAddhikkAM, hitaM tasmai hikkAghnaM bRuMhaNaM ca yat||27||
balAsthirAdikAshmaryatriphalAguDasaindhavaiH| saprasannAranAlAmlaistailaM paktvA~anuvAsayet||28||
kRuShNAlavaNayorakShaM pibeduShNAmbunA yutam | dhUmaleharasakShIrasvedAshcAnnaM ca vAtanut||29||
atitIkShNaH savAto vA na vA samyak prapIDitaH| ghaTTayeddhRudayaM bastistatra kAshakushetkaTaiH||30||
syAt sAmlalavaNaskandhakarIrabadarIphalaiH| shRutairbastirhitaH siddhaM vAtaghnaishcAnuvAsanam||31||
vAtamUtrapurIShANAM datte vegAnnigRuhNataH| ati vA pIDito bastirmukhenAyAti vegavAn||32||
mUrcchAvikAraM tasyAdau dRuShTvA shItAmbunA mukham| si~jcet pArshvodaraM cAdhaH pramRujyAdvIjayecca tam||33||
kesheShvAlambya cAkAshe dhunuyAttrAsayecca tam| gokharAshvagajaiH siMhai rAjapreShyaistathoragaiH||34||
ulkAbhirevamanyaishca bhItasyAdhaH pravartate| vastrapANigrahaiH kaNThaM rundhyAnna mriyate yathA||35||
prANodAnanirodhAddhi prasiddhataramArgavAn | apAnaH pavano bastiM tamAshvevApakarShati||36||
tataH kramukakalkAkShaM pAyayetAmlasaMyutam| auShNyAttaikShyAt saratvAcca bastiM so~asyAnulomayet||37||
pakvAshayasthite svinne nirUho dAshamUlikaH| yavakolakulatthaishca vidheyo mUtrasAdhitaH||38||
bilvAdipa~jcamUlena siddho bastiruraHsthite| shiraHsthe nAvanaM dhUmaH pracchAdyaM sarShapaiH shiraH||39||
vamanavirecanAnantarabhAvitvAdbasteH saMshodhanavyApatsiddheranantaraM bastivyApatsiddhirucyate; atra bastishabdo nirUha eva vartate, tadvyApadAmevAtra vaktavyatvAt||1-2||

kAH katItyAdi pa~jca prashnAH| nAtiyogAvityAdinA Adyaprashnasyottaram| nAtiyogAviti ayogAtiyogau| etaddvAdashavyApadAM ca vivaraNa eva sphuTArtho bhaviShyati| asamyagyogasambhavA iti nirUhasyAyogAtiyogamithyAyogarUpAsamyagyogasambhavAH| anena ca samutthAnaprashnasya sAmAnyakAraNAbhidhAnenottaraM dattaM bhavati| atra bastiprayogasyAsamyagyogena nirUhakAryadoShaharaNasyAtiyogAyogau vyApattirUpau janyete klamAdayo~api cAtiyogAyogajAtA eva vishiShTahetulakShaNacikitsitatayA ihApi pRuthagucyante, yathA saMshodhane AdhmAnAdayo~ayogAtiyogajAtA api pRuthaguktAH| kecit ‘nAtiyogAt klamAdhmAne’ ityAdi, tathA ‘dashaitA vyApado basteH’ ityAdi paThanti; tatra pUrvAdhyAyoktavyAkhyAnAdartho neyaH ; kintu pUrva eva pATho nirvyUhaH| AsAmityAdau rUpashabdenaiva prati prati vakShyamANahetuvisheSho~avaruddho j~jeyaH, yena heturapi hi vyAsagamakatayA rUpameva||3-6||

snigdhasvinnetyAdinA pravAhikAmAha| pravAhikAmatIsAroktalakShaNAmuktAM janayati| shodhanIyAnulomikAnityatra shodhanIyAniti trivRudAdishodhanadravyayuktAn; AnulomikAniti anulomanakShIrekShurasayuktAn| vRuttimiti peyAdikramam||40-42||

durbale ityAdinA shirortimAha| tanuH aghanaH| tadvihata iti nirUhabastiprakopitaH| UrdhvaM mUrdhni vihanyate iti Urdhvamanusaran mUrdhni vihanyate; ye tu ‘UrdhvaM vidhAvati’ iti paThanti, tanmate uparyupari dhAvatItyarthaH| asya virecayediti atra ‘shira’ iti sheShaH, ‘anu virecayet’ iti vA pAThaH| tIkShNAnulomike~anne bhukte sati anuvAsayediti yojyam; kiMvA tIkShNAnulomikenaivAnuvAsanaM sAdhyamityarthaH||43-46||

snehasvedairityAdinA a~ggArtimAha| anApAdyeti snehasvedaiH sharIraM nopapAdya| so~atimAtraM pravartayet ‘doShAn’ iti sheShaH| tataH stabdhodAvRutakoShThasya rujAM karoti| bhuktavato yadyapyanuvAsanaM sarvatra bhavati, tathA~api bhuktavata iti vacanena bhojanAnantaramevAnuvAsanaM darshayati||47-53||
mRudvityAdinA parikartikAmAha| bastinirlekhanAditi vAyunA ca tIkShNena bastikarShaNAt| vyaktAmla iti bastivisheShaNam||54-57||
pittaroge ityAdinA parisrAvamAha| kShiNotIti hinasti| eSha kalpa iti ArdrashAlmalIvRuntoktakShIrasaMskArakalpaH| suvarcalamiti suniShaNNakamAhuH| karbudAraH kA~jcanAraH||58-62||

gurukoShThe iti krUrakoShThe malapUrNakoShThe vA| alpashabdo mAtrAntaiH pratyekaM sambadhyate| uShNAyAH pramathyAyA iti atIsAroktapramathyAnAM yA pramathyA uShNA tasyAH prayogaH; pramathyeti pAcanakaShAyasyAyurvedasamayasiddhasa~jj~jeti pratipAditamevAtIsAre| kAlaM j~jAtveti virecanayogyAvasthAM j~jAtvA| surAdimUtravAnityatra Adishabdena sauvIrakatuShodakAdInAM grahaNam| saprAkpeShya iti bastisUtrIyoktabalAdibastyuktakalkayuktaH| tamAnayediti ayogakArakaM vibaddhaM bastiM harati||7-11||

ayogamabhidhAyAtiyogamAha- snigdhasvinne ityAdi| atiyujyate iti atiyogakArako bhavati| shodhanAbhyAM samA bhavediti vamanavirecanAtiyogoktali~ggacikitsitAbhyAM samA bhavet| bastyatiyogaje dAhe vishiShTacikitsAmAha- pRushniparNImityAdi| atra kShIrAdiShu pa~jcadraveShu kalkasya vilayanam| drAkShAdiprasAdAH shItakaShAyavidhikRutA j~jeyAH||12-14||

AmasheShe ityAdinA klamamAha| AmasheShe sati dattena nirUheNa doSha Irita iti yojyam| doShashabdena cAtra pittakaphAvAmasahitau mArgAvarakAvucyete| mUrcchayatIti mArgAvarodhAt kopayati| mArgaM ruNaddhIti dehe srotAMsi ruNaddhi| ye tu, doShashabdeneha kaphamAtraM grAhayanti, tanmate sadAhatvaM klamasyApyanupapannam| vacetyAdau mUrcchitA iti AloDitAH| kShArAMshca dIpanAniti grahaNIcikitsAdyuktAn| dAshamUlikamiti “dvipa~jcamUlasya raso~amlayuktaH” (si.a.3) ityAdinoktaM; kiMvA dashamUlakvAthakRutam| mAdhutailikaH vakShyamANaH||15-20||

alpavIrya ityAdinA AdhmAnamAha| ruddhamArga iti nivAritAdhomArgaH; sa cAnilaM ruNaddhi, anilashca ruddhamArgatayA AdhmAnaM karotIti| marmapIDanamityAdhmAnavisheShaNam| ruNaddhi hRudayaM shUlairiti shUlairhRudayaM vyApnoti| shyAmAphalAdibhiriti shyAmAdibhirnavabhiH, phalAdibhishca ShaDbhiH kalpasthAnoktaiH| dhUmashabdeneha gRuhadhUmagrahaNam| guDashcAtra tAvanmAtro bhavati yAvatA vartiH kartuM yujyate| karA~gguShThetyatra karagrahaNaM pAdA~gguShThaniShedhArtham| athavetyAdinoktadvitIyavartAvapi vartitvasampattyarthaM guDo deyaH| bilvAdibhishca nirUha iti “bilvamUlatrivRuddAruyavakolakulatthavAn” ityAdinoktaH| saraletyAdau siddhamityatra ‘tailaM’ iti sheShaH||21-26||

mRudvityAdinA hikkAmAha| atinirharanniti atiyogena doShAnnirharan| hikkAghnamiti hikkAcikitsoktaM bheShajam| hikkAyAM ca yadyapi “prasaktacchardiniShThIvikAkAsashvAsahikkArtAnAmUrdhvIbhUto vAyurUrdhvaM bastiM nayet” (si.a.2) ityanena bastirniShiddhaH, tathA~apIha vishiShTahikkAyAmanuvAsanasya hitatvAt, “balAsthirAdi” ityAdinoktamanuvAsanamanavadyam| vAtanuditi padaM li~ggavipariNAmena dhUmAdibhishca sambadhyate; tena vAtahitAnAmevAtra dhUmAdInAM prayogaH||27-29||

atitIkShNa ityAdinA hRutprAptimAha| savAtatvaM basterniHsheShadAnAdinA j~jeyam| asamyakpIDitatvameva hRutprAptijanakatayA j~jeyam| lavaNaskandhaH rogabhiShagjitIyoktaH| vAtaghnairiti dashamUlAdibhiH||30-31||

vAtamUtretyAdinordhvatAmAha| datte iti bastau datte| tasyordhvaM gacchato bastermUrcchArUpaM vikAraM dRuShTvA mukhasecanAdi kartavyam| AkAshe dhunuyAditi niravalambaM dhunuyAt| trAsayecca gokharAdibhiriti j~jeyam| evamanyairiti anuktairapi trAsanaprakAraiH| kaNThAvarodho yathA kartavyastadAha- na mriyate yatheti| kaNThoparodhaprayojanamAha- prANodAnanirodhAddhi prasiddhataramArgavAnityAdi| kaNThapragraheNa prANodAnanirodhAt prasiddhataramArgavAnapAno bhavati, gudapravartanasvarUpo bhavatItyarthaH; tatashca bastimUrdhvakShiptamadho nayati; prANodAnanirodhena tu prANodAnAbhyAM pIDito~apAnaH svamArgagAmI bhavatIti j~jeyam| kecittu ‘yAvat prANoparodhAddhi’ iti paThanti, tatra prANoparodhaM yAvat kaNThapIDanaM kartavyamityarthaH| kramukaM pUgaphalam| shiraHstha iti bastyekadeshe shirasi sthite sati| pracchAdyamiti AlepanIyam||32-39||
athAtaH prAsRutayogIyAM siddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

athemAn sukumArANAM nirUhAn snehanAn mRudUn| karmaNA viplutAnAM ca vakShyAmi prasRutaiH pRuthak||3||

Commentary: imAniti agre vakShyamANAn| tenAdhyAyasheShavaktavyAnAM nAvashyaM prasRutopalakShitavidhAnam| sukumArANAmiti tanvAdiguNasambaddhaM bhavati||3||
shvadaMShTrAshmabhideraNDarasAttailAt surAsavAt| prasRutAH pa~jca yaShTyAhvakauntImAgadhikAsitAH||13||
kalkaH syAnmUtrakRucchre tu sAnAhe bastiruttamaH| ete salavaNAH koShNA nirUhAH prasRutairnava||14||

mRudubastijaDIbhUte tIkShNo~anyo bastiriShyate| tIkShNairvikarShite svAdu pratyAsthApanamiShyate ||15||

Commentary: etaduktamRudubastiprayogAnAmante kartavyamAha- mRudvityAdi| svAdu pratyAsthApanamiShyata ityatra svAdu drAkShAdidravyakRutam| kecittadahareva pratyAsthApanamicchanti| AsthApanaM lakShyIkRutya dIyata iti pratyAsthApanam||15||
vAtopasRuShTasyoShNaiH syurgudadAhAdayo yadi| drAkShAmbunA trivRutkalkaM dadyAddoShAnulomanam||16||
taddhi pittashakRudvAtAn hRutvA dAhAdikA~jjayet| shuddhashcApi pibecchItAM yavAgUM sharkarAyutAm||17||

athavA~ativiriktaH syAt kShINaviTkaH sa bhakShayet| mAShayUSheNa kulmAShAn pibenmadhvathavA surAm||18||

Commentary: kulmAShA iti ardhasvinnayavAdimayA bhakShyAH||18||

sAmaM cet kuNapaM shUlairupavishedarocakI| sa ghanAtiviShAkuShThanatadAruvacAH pibet||19||

Commentary: bastimithyAprayogodIritAnAmatIsArabhedAnAM cikitsitamAha- sAmaM cedityAdi| sAmaM yathA syAt tathopavishediti; tena malAdivyatiriktAmamAtropavesharUpo~ayamatIsAraH kevalAmashakRudvAtaraktapittakaphajanyAnAmiha ShaNNAmatIsArANAM vaktavyAnAM prathama ukto bhavati| kuNapamiti shavagandham| shUlaiH ‘yukta’ iti sheShaH| ghanaM mustakam||19||

shakRudvAtamasRuk pittaM kaphaM vA yo~atisAryate| pakvaM , tatra svavargIyairbastiH shreShThaM bhiShagjitam||20||

Commentary: kevalashakRudAdijanyAMshcAtisArAnAha- shakRudvAtamityAdi| pakvamiti nirAmam| AmashabdenehAgnidaurbalyAdavipakvAhArarasa eva koShThopalepaka Amo gRuhyate; yaduktamanyatra- “AmAshayasthaH kAyAgnerdaurbalyAdavipAcitaH| Adya AhAradhAturyaH sa Ama iti sa~jj~jitaH” iti| svavargIyairiti purIShasa~ggrahaNavAtaghnashoNitAsthApanapittakaphaharabheShajavargaiH; kiMvA uttaratra pratyekaM shakRudAdivakShyamANabheShajaiH||20||

ShaNNAmeShAM dvisaMsargAt triMshadbhedA bhavanti tu| kevalaiH saha ShaTtriMshadvidyAt sopadravAnapi||21||

Commentary: atIsArabhedAnAha- ShaNNAmityAdi| eShAmiti etadabhihitAnAm| anye tu bastivibhraMshajAH ShaTsa~gkhyA bhavantIti vadanti; pUrvavyAkhyAnameva sAdhu||21||

shUlapravAhikAdhmAnaparikartyarucijvarAn| tRuShNoShNadAhamUrcchAdIMshcaiShAM vidyAdupadravAn||22||

Commentary: upadravAneShAmAha- shUletyAdi||22||

tatrAme~antarapAnaM syAt vyoShAmlalavaNairyutam| pAcanaM shasyate bastirAme hi pratiShidhyate||23||

Commentary: yathoktAtIsAreShu cikitsAmAha- tatrAme ityAdi| antarapAnaM pAcanamAhuH| pAcanamityanena ceha pUrvaM ‘sa ghanAtiviShA’ ityAdyuktaM pAcanaM gRuhyate| vyoShAmlalavaNairyutamiti vyoShAmlalavaNayogena kRutam||23||

svAdvamlalavaNaiH shastaH snehabastiH samIraNe||24||

Commentary: svAdvamlalavaNaiH shastaH snehabastiriti svAdvamlalavaNadravyasAdhitasnehakRutamanuvAsanamityarthaH| samIraNe iti kevalavAtAtIsAre||24||

rakte raktena, pitte tu kaShAyasvAdutiktakaiH| sAryamANe kaphe bastiH kaShAyakaTutiktakaiH||25||

Commentary: rakte rakteneti sarakte~atIsAryamANe raktena bastirdeyaH| pitte tviti pitte~atIsAryamANe kaShAyAdikRuto bastireva||25||
shakRutA vAyunA vA~a~ame tena varcasyathAnile| saMsRuShTe~antarapAnaM syAd vyoShAmlalavaNairyutam||26||
pittenAme~asRujA vA~api tayorAmena vA punaH| saMsRuShTayorbhavet pAnaM savyoShasvAdutiktakam||27||
tathA~a~ame kaphasaMsRuShTe kaShAyavyoShatiktakam| Amena tu kaphe vyoShakaShAyalavaNairyutam||28||
vAtena vishi pitte vA viTpittAbhyAM tathA~anile| madhurAmlakaShAyaH syAt saMsRuShTe bastiruttamaH||29||
shakRucchoNitayoH pittashakRuto raktapittayoH| bastiranyonyasaMsarge kaShAyasvAdutiktakaH||30||
kaphena vishi pitte vA kaphe viTpittashoNitaiH| vyoShatiktakaShAyaH syAt saMsRuShTe bastiruttamaH||31||
syAdbastirvyoShatiktAmlaH saMsRuShTe vAyunA kaphe| madhuravyoShatiktastu rakte kaphavimUrcchite||32||
mArute kaphasaMsRuShTe vyoShAmlalavaNo bhavet| bastirvAtena pitte tu kAryaH svAdvamlatiktakaH||33||

tricatuHpa~jcasaMsargAnevameva vikalpayet| yuktishcaiShAtisAroktA sarvarogeShvapi smRutA||34||

Commentary: anuktasaMsargacikitsAM sUtrayannAha- tricaturityAdi| tricatuHpa~jcasaMsargAniti AmAdInAM trika-catuShka-pa~jcakarUpAn saMsargAn| evameva vikalpayediti pradhAnAdimelakena vikalpayet, tathA bheShajamapi teShAM yathoktabheShajAnusAreNa kalpayedityarthaH| ete ca bhedA likhyamAnA atibahuprabhedatayA granthagauravamApAdayanti, svayaM ca buddhimatA sukaravibhAgA eveti na likhyante| evamAdisaMsargakRutaM rogabhedamanyatrApi buddhyA kartavyatayA~atidishannAha- sarvarogeShvapi smRuteti| iyaM vyavasthA sarvarogeShvevayathAsambhavamAcAryAnumatetyarthaH| tatra grahaNIgade yatra tu ShaDapyAmAdayaH sambhavanti, tatraivaM saMsargAH prakalpyante; yatra ca trayodoShAH sambhavanti, shoNitena vA samaM catvAraH, tatra teShAmeva parasparasaMsargo bheShajavibhAgArthaM kalpanIyaH||34||
kShIrAddvau prasRutau kAryau madhutailaghRutAttrayaH| khajena mathito bastirvAtaghno balavarNakRut||4||
ekaikaH prasRutastailaprasannAkShaudrasarpiShAm| bilvAdimUlakvAthAddvau kaulatthAddvau sa vAtanut||5||
pa~jcamUlarasAt pa~jca dvau tailAt kShaudrasarpiShoH| ekaikaH prasRuto bastiH snehanIyo~anilApahaH||6||

yugapat ShaDrasaM ShaNNAM saMsarge pAcanaM bhavet | nirAmANAM tu pa~jcAnAM bastiH ShADrasiko mataH||35||

Commentary: AmAdiShaTkasamudayarUpasaMsarge kAryamAha- yugapadityAdi| yugapaditi ekadaiva militAnAM ShaNNAmiti yAvat| ShaDrasamiti militaShaDrasakRutam| nirAmANAmiti AmavarjitAnAM shakRudAdInAM pa~jcAnAm| ShADrasika iti ShaDrasamelakena kRutaH||35||
udumbarashalATUni jambvAmrodumbaratvacaH| sha~gkhaM sarjarasaM lAkShAM kardamaM ca palAMshikam||36||
piShTvA taiH sarpiShaH prasthaM kShIradviguNitaM pacet| atIsAreShu sarveShu peyametadyathAbalam||37||
kacchurAdhAtakIbilvasama~ggAraktashAlibhiH| masUrAshvatthashu~ggaishca yavAgUH syAjjale shRutaiH||38||
bAlodumbarakaTva~ggasama~ggAplakShapallavaiH | masUradhAtakIpuShpabalAbhishca tathA bhavet||39||
sthirAdInAM balAdInAmikShvAdInAmathApi vA| kvAtheShu samasUrANAM yavAgvaH syuH pRuthak pRuthak||40||
kacchurAmUlashAlyAditaNDulairupasAdhitAH| dadhitakrAranAlAmlakShIreShvikShurase~api vA||41||
shItAH sasharkarAkShaudrAH sarvAtisAranAshanAH| sasarpirmaricAjAjyo madhurA lavaNAH shivAH||42||
bhavanti cAtra shlokAH- snigdhAmlalavaNamadhuraM pAnaM bastishca mArute koShNaH| shItaM tiktakaShAyaM madhuraM pitte ca rakte ca||43||
tiktoShNakaShAyakaTushleShmaNi sa~ggrAhi vAtanucchakRuti| pAcanamAme pAnaM picchAsRugbastayo rakte||44||
atisAraM pratyuktaM mishraM dvandvAdiyogajeShvapi ca| tatrodrekavisheShAddoSheShUpakramaH kAryaH||45||

tatra shlokaH- prAsRutikAH savyApatkriyA nirUhAstathA~atisArahitAH| rasakalpaghRutayavAgvashcoktA guruNA prasRutasiddhau||46||

Commentary: prAsRutikA ityAdyadhyAyArthasa~ggrahaH| savyApatkriyA iti vyApadashca mRudubastikRutajADyAdikA uktAH, tathA kriyAshca tAsAmeva vyApadAmuktAH| nirUhAshcAtisAracikitsite proktAH| rasakalpashcAtIsAreShu rasoddeshacikitsayA kRutaH| ghRutaM codumbaretyAdinoktam||46||

saindhavArdhAkSha ekaikaH kShaudratailapayoghRutAt| prasRuto hapuShAkarSho nirUhaH shukrakRut param||7||

Commentary: hapuShAkarShaH||7||

paTolanimbabhUnimbarAsnAsaptacchadAmbhasaH| catvAraH prasRutA eko ghRutAt sarShapakalkitaH||8||

Commentary: paToletyAdau ambhasaH iti kvAthAt| sarShapakalkita iti atra yadyapi kalkamAnaM noktaM, tathA~api dvAdashaprasRute nirUhe dvipalakalkasya vihitatvAdiha pa~jcaprasRute tadanusArAt ShaDbhAgonaM palaM bhavati; evamanyatrApyanuktamAnakalkavyavasthA||8||-
viDa~ggatriphalAshigruphalamustAkhuparNijAt||9||

kaShAyAt prasRutAH pa~jca tailAdeko vimathya tAn| viDa~ggapippalIkalko nirUhaH kriminAshanaH||10||

Commentary: viDa~ggetyAdau phalaM madanaphalam| AkhuparNI dantI||10||
payasyekShusthirArAsnAvidArIkShaudrasarpiShAm| ekaikaH prasRuto bastiH kRuShNAkalko vRuShatvakRut||11||
catvArastailagomUtradadhimaNDAmlakA~jjikAt| prasRutAH sarShapaiH kalkairviTsa~ggAnAhabhedanaH ||12||
samprati bastivyApatprashamakabastyabhidhAyakatayaiva prAsRutayogIyA siddhirucyate| prasRutopalakShitA ye yogAH tAnadhikRutya kRutA siddhiH; tena prasRutAlakShitA apyatra yogA vaktavyA eva||1-2||
shvadaMShTretyAdau shvadaMShTrAdidravyatrayakvAthasya pratyekaM prasRutamAnatvam, evaM tailasurAsavaprasRutAbhyAM saha pa~jcaprasRutAH pUraNIyAH; surAkRuta AsavaH surAsavaH||13-14||
vAtopasRuShTasyetyAdau uShNairiti bastivisheShaNam| dAhAdayo dAhamohatRuDAdayo vAtapittajanyAH| drAkShAmbunA trivRutpAnasya dAhAdikArake pitte vAte ca hitatvaM darshayannAha- taddhItyAdi||16-17||

saMsarge cikitsAmAha- shakRutetyAdi| shakRutA~a~ame pradhAne saMsRuShTe, tathA vAyunA vA~a~ame saMsRuShTe; tenetyAmenApradhAnena varcasi anile ca pRuthak saMsRuShTe, atra teneti pUrvavadvyAkhyeyam| atra saMsRuShTeShu tRutIyAnirdiShTamalpamAnatayA~apradhAnaM, saptamInirdiShTaM bahumAnatvAt pradhAnaM j~jeyam| tayoriti pittAsRujoH| saMsRuShTayoriti ekamAnena yuktayoH| kaphe vyoShakaShAyalavaNairyutamityantaM yAvat ‘antarapAnaM’ ityanuvartate| vAtena vishItyAdau madhurAmlakaShAyo bastiriti madhurAdidravyakvAthAdikRuto bastirdeya ityarthaH| shakRucchoNitayorityAdau anyonyasaMsarge sati shakRutA shoNite shoNitena vA shakRuti saMsRuShTe; evaM pittashakRutoH raktapittayoshca dvividhaH saMsargo vyAkhyeyaH| viTpittashoNitairiti pratyekaM viDAdibhiH kaphe saMsRuShTe| kaphavimUrcchite iti kaphenApradhAnena saMsRuShTe ityarthaH||26-33||

prasRutaM paladvayam| madhutailaghRutAttraya iti militAt| atra ca yathoktaireva dravyairbastirdeyaH; tena netarabastinyAyenAnuktakalkAdikalpanA; yatra niyatamAnadravyavibhAgena bastyabhidhAnaM, tatra sAmAnyabastidravyamAnAnavakAshaH; yatra tvekadeshakathanaM, tatra nirUhayogitayoktadravyamAnAdhikAraH; saindhavapraveshastvatyAjya eva| bilvAdimUlaM dashamUlam| sa vAtanuditi sa bastirvAtaM hantIti||4-6||

sarvAtIsArasAdhAraNaM bheShajamAha- udumbaretyAdi| ‘raktashAlibhiH’ ityatra ‘raktamUlibhiH’ iti pAThe ‘raktamUlI raktairaNDam’ ityapare| jale shRutairiti ShaDa~ggavidhAnena jale shRutaiH| bAlodumbaram udumbarashalATu| bhavediti yavAgUrbhavet| ikShvAdInAmiti tRuNapa~jcamUlapaThitAnAM sharavarjitAnAmikShukushakAshashAlimUlAnAm| shAlyAditaNDulairiti raktashAlikalamAditaNDulaiH| dadhyAdibhiratra jalasthAnIyairyavAgUH sAdhanIyA||36-42||

prapa~jcoktaM bheShajaM sa~ggraheNAbhidadhAti- bhavanti cAtretyAdi| pAnamiti pAcanapAnam| bastishceti snigdhAmlalavaNamadhura eva bastiH| mArute iti mArutAtisAre; evamanyatrApi pitte ityAdau pittAdijAtisAre iti j~jeyam| sa~ggrAhi vAtanudityatra ‘bheShajaM’ iti sheShaH; tacca bheShajaM yathoktabastyAdirUpameva| pAcanamAme pAnamiti pAcanaghanAtiviShAdidravyakRutaM pAnamityarthaH| picchAbastayo~asRugbastayashceti picchAsRugbastayaH| uktamiti sAkShAdatideshena ca trikAdisaMsarge proktam| mishramiti etadeva pratyekaM mishrIkRutam| dvandvAdiyogajeShviti tricatuShkAdisaMsargaje~atisAre| tatrodrekAdivisheShAditi saMsarga eva balAbalavisheShAdupakramasyApi visheSho bhavati| etadeva balApekShaM bahudurbalA~apratyanIkaM bastyekabheShajamiti sheShaH(?)||43-45||
payasyetyAdau yadyapi payasyAdInAM kvAtho na shrUyate, tathA~api dravAntaraiH samamekaikaprasRutavidhAnAt pratyekaM payasyAdikvAthasya prasRutamAnatvam| vRuShatvakRuditi shukravRuddhikRut||11-12||
athAtastrimarmIyAM siddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

ata urdhvaM vikArA ye trimarmIye cikitsite| na proktA marmajAsteShAM kAMshcidvakShyAmi sauShadhAn||11||

Commentary: marmaparipAlakabastikathanaprasa~ggAdanuktamarmagatarogAn sacikitsitAn darshayannAha- ata UrdhvamityAdi||11||
kruddhaH svaiH kopanairvAyuH sthAnAdUrdhvaM prapadyate| pIDayan hRudayaM gatvA shiraH sha~gkhau ca pIDayan||12||
dhanurvannamayedgAtrANyAkShipenmohayettathA| (namayeccAkShipeccA~ggAnyucchvAsaM niruNaddhi ca)| kRucchreNa cApyucchvasiti stabdhAkSho~atha nimIlakaH ||13||
kapota iva kUjecca niHsa~jj~jaH so~apatantrakaH| dRuShTiM saMstambhya sa~jj~jAM ca hatvA kaNThena kUjati||14||
hRudi mukte naraH svAsthyaM yAti mohaM vRute punaH| vAyunA dAruNaM prAhureke tamapatAnakam||15||
shvasanaM kaphavAtAbhyAM ruddhaM tasya vimokShayet| tIkShNaiH pradhamanaiH sa~jj~jAM tAsu muktAsu vindati||16||
maricaM shigrubIjAni viDa~ggaM ca phaNijjhakam| etAni sUkShmacUrNAni dadyAcchIrShavirecanam||17||
tumburUNyabhayA hi~ggu pauShkaraM lavaNatrayam| yavakvAthAmbunA peyaM hRudgrahe cApatantrake ||18||
hi~ggvamlavetasaM shuNThIM sasauvarcaladADimam| pibedvAtakaphaghnaM ca karma hRudroganuddhitam||19||
shodhanA bastayastIkShNA na hitAstasya kRutsnashaH| sauvarcalAbhayAvyoShaiH siddhaM tasmai ghRutaM hitam||20||
madhurasnigdhagurvannasevanAccintanAcchramAt | shokAdvyAdhyanuSha~ggAcca vAyunodIritaH kaphaH||21||
yadA~asau samavaskandya hRudayaM hRudayAshrayAn| samAvRuNoti j~jAnAdIMstadA tandropajAyate||22||
hRudaye vyAkulIbhAvo vAkceShTendriyagauravam| manobuddhyaprasAdashca tandrAyA lakShaNaM matam||23||
kaphaghnaM tatra kartavyaM shodhanaM shamanAni ca| vyAyAmo raktamokShashca bhojyaM ca kaTutiktakam||24||
mUtraukasAdo jaTharaM kRucchramutsa~ggasa~gkShayau| mUtrAtIto~anilAShThIlA vAtabastyuShNamArutau||25||
vAtakuNDalikA granthirviDghAto bastikuNDalam| trayodashaite mUtrasya doShAstA@mlli~ggataH shRuNu||26||
pittaM kapho dvAvapi vA bastau saMhanyate yadA| mArutena tadA mUtraM raktaM pItaM ghanaM sRujet||27||
sadAhaM shvetasAndraM vA sarvairvA lakShaNairyutam| mUtraukasAdaM taM vidyAt pittashleShmaharairjayet||28||
vidhAraNAt pratihataM vAtodAvartitaM yadA| pUrayatyudaraM mUtraM tadA tadanimittaruk||29||
apaktimUtraviTsa~ggaistanmUtrajaTharaM vadet| mUtravairecanIM tatra cikitsAM samprayojayet||30||
hi~ggudviruttaraM cUrNaM trimarmIye prakIrtitam| hanyAnmUtrodarAnAhamAdhmAnaM gudameDhrayoH||31||
mUtritasya vyavAyAttu reto vAtoddhataM cyutam| pUrvaM mUtrasya pashcAdvA sravet kRucchraM taducyate||32||
khavaiguNyAnilAkShepaiH ki~jcinmUtraM ca tiShThati| maNisandhau sravet pashcAttadarugvA~atha cAtiruk||33||
mUtrotsa~ggaH sa vicchinnamuccheShagurushephasaH | vAtAkRutirbhavedvAtAnmUtre shuShyati sa~gkShayaH||34||
ciraM dhArayato mUtraM tvarayA na pravartate| mehamAnasya mandaM vA mUtrAtItaH sa ucyate||35||
AdhmApayan bastigudaM ruddhvA vAyushcalonnatAm| kuryAttIvrArtimaShThIlAM mUtraviNmArgarodhinIm||36||
mUtraM dhArayato bastau vAyuH kruddho vidhAraNAt| mUtrarodhArtikaNDUbhirvAtabastiH sa ucyate||37||
uShmaNA soShmakaM mUtraM shoShayan raktapItakam| uShNavAtaH sRujet kRucchrAdbastyupasthArtidAhavAn||38||
gatisa~ggAdudAvRuttaH sa mUtrasthAnamArgayoH| mUtrasya viguNo vAyurbhagnavyAviddhakuNDalI||39||
mUtraM vihanti saMstambhabha~ggagauravaveShTanaiH| tIvraru~gmUtraviTsa~ggairvAtakuNDaliketi sA||40||
raktaM vAtakaphAdduShTaM bastidvAre sudAruNam| granthiM kuryAt sa kRucchreNa sRujenmUtraM tadAvRutam||41||
ashmarIsamashUlaM taM raktagranthiM pracakShate| rUkShadurbalayorvAtenodAvRuttaM shakRudyadA||42||
mUtrasrotaH prapadyeta viTsaMsRuShTaM tadA naraH| viDgandhaM mUtrayet kRucchrAdviDvighAtaM vinirdishet||43||
drutAdhvala~gghanAyAsAdabhighAtAt prapIDanAt| svasthAnAdvastirudvRuttaH sthUlastiShThati garbhavat||44||
shUlaspandanadAhArto binduM binduM sravatyapi| pIDitastu sRujeddhArAM saMstambhodveShTanArtimAn||45||
bastikuNDalamAhustaM ghoraM shastraviShopamam| pavanaprabalaM prAyo durnivAramabuddhibhiH||46||
tasmin pittAnvite dAhaH shUlaM mUtravivarNatA| shleShmaNA gauravaM shophaH snigdhaM mUtraM ghanaM sitam||47||
shleShmaruddhabilo bastiH pittodIrNo na sidhyati| avibhrAntabilaH sAdhyo na tu yaH kuNDalIkRutaH||48||

doShAdhikyamavekShyaitAn mUtrakRucchraharairjayet||49||

Commentary: cikitsAmAha- doShAdhikyamityAdi| mUtrakRucchraharaiH prayogairdoShAdhikyamavekShya prayuktairjayedityarthaH||49||-

saptottaraM marmashatamasmi~jcharIre skandhashAkhAsamAshritamagnivesha!| teShAmanyatamapIDAyAM samadhikA pIDA bhavati, cetanAnibandhavaisheShyAt| tatra shAkhAshritebhyo marmabhyaH skandhAshritAni garIyAMsi, shAkhAnAM tadAshritatvAt; skandhAshritebhyo~api hRudvastishirAMsi, tanmUlatvAccharIrasya||3||

Commentary: saptottaraM marmashatamiti sharIrasa~gkhyAbhihitaM; tacca mAMsasirAsnAyvasthisandhiShu niviShTam| skandhashabdenAnantarAdhirucyate; shAkhAshabdena ceha shAkheva shAkheti kRutvA bAhudvayaM ja~gghAdvayaM cocyate; neha shAkhAshabdena raktAdidhAtUnAM grahaNaM, raktAdidhAtUnAM skandhe~api, vidyamAnatvAt| tatra shAkhAshritAni catushcatvAriMshanmarmANi, sheShaM skandhAshritam| yaduktaM sushrute- “teShAmekAdashaikasmin sakthi bhavanti, etenetarasakthi bAhU ca vyAkhyAtau; udarorasordvAdasha, caturdasha pRuShThe, grIvAM pratyUrdhvaM saptatriMshat” (su.shA.a.6) iti; eteShAM ca marmaNAM pratyekaM vibhAga uktaH sushrute eva “talahRudaya” (su.shA.a.6) ityAdinA prapa~jcato~anusaraNIyaH| saptottarashatamarmaNAmamarmasharIradeshavilakShaNaM dharmamAha- teShAmityAdi| cetanAnibandhavaisheShyAditi yasmAnmarmasu cetanAdhAturvisheSheNa nibaddha ityarthaH; cetanAnibandhashca marmasvadRuShTakRuta eva marmapIDayA visheShapIDAdarshanAdunnIyate| shAkhAnAM tadAshritatvAditi yasmAcchAkhA api skandhAshritAH, tena skandhAshritashAkhAshritebhyaH sAkShAt skandhAshritaM marma garIyo bhavatItyarthaH; skandhAshritatvaM ca shAkhAnAM skandhopaghAtena tadupaghAtAt, tathA skandhaniShpannenaiva rasAdinA tatpoShaNAt; ki~jca skandhAshritAnyeva marmANi sadyaHprANaharANi, na shAkhAshrayANi; tena ca skandhasya prAdhAnyam| yaduktaM sushrute- “shRu~ggATakAnyadhipatiH sha~gkhau kaNThashirogudam| hRudayaM bastinAbhI ca ghnanti sadyo hatAni vai” (su.shA.a.6) iti| hRudbastishirAMsi garIyAMsIti sambandhaH| etadgarIyastve hetumAha- tanmUlatvAccharIrasyeti| tanmUlatvAditi tadAshritatvAt, tathA ca hRudayAshritatvaM sharIrasya ‘tatra hRudaye dasha dhamanyaH’ ityAdinA ‘nAbhyAmarA iva’ ityantena darshayiShyati| yadyapi ca marmAntarANyapi visheSheNa prANAshrayANyuktAni; yathA ‘dashaivAyatanAnyAhuH prANA yeShu pratiShThitAH| sha~gkhau marmatrayaM kaNTho raktaM shukraujasI gudam’ (sU.a.29) ityanena, tathA~api sha~gkhAdIni na sharIrAshrayabhUtAni yathA hRudayAdIni; tena prANAyatanatve samAne~apyuktasharIrAshrayatvavisheShAdiha hRudayAdInAmeva prAdhAnyamucyate; ki~jca, prANAshrayatvamapi yathA hRudayAdInAM na tathA sha~gkhAdInAm; uktaM hi “saptottaraM marmashataM yaduktaM sharIrasa~gkhyAmadhikRutya teShu| marmANi bastiM hRudayaM shirashca pradhAnabhUtAnyRuShayo vadanti|| prANAshrayAn tAnapi pIDayanto vAtAdayo~asUnapi pIDayanti” (su.shA.a.6) iti| anye tu sha~gkhAdiprANAshrayANAM hRudayAdiShveva sAmIpyAdantarbhAvaM darshayanti, taccAmUlatvAdupekShitam||3||
puShpanetraM tu haimaM syAcchlakShNamauttarabastikam||50||
jAtyashvahanavRuntena samaM gopucchasaMsthitam| raupyaM vA sarShapacchidraM dvikarNaM dvAdashA~ggulam||51||
tenAjabastiyuktena snehasyArdhapalaM nayet| yathAvayovisheSheNa snehamAtrAM vikalpya vA||52||
snAtasya bhuktabhaktasya rasena payasA~api vA| sRuShTaviNmUtravegasya pIThe jAnusame mRudau||53||
RujoH sukhopaviShTasya hRuShTe meDhre ghRutAktayA| shalAkayA~anviShya gatiM yadyapratihatA vrajet||54||
tataH shephaHpramANena puShpanetraM praveshayet| gudavanmUtramArgeNa praNayedanu sevanIm||55||
