hiMsyAdatigataM bastimUne sneho na gacchati| sukhaM prapIDya niShkampaM niShkarShennetrameva ca||56||
pratyAgate dvitIyaM ca tRutIyaM ca pradApayet| anAgacchannupekShyastu rajanIvyuShitasya ca||57||
pippalIlavaNAgAradhUmApAmArgasarShapaiH| vArtAkurasanirguNDIshampAkaiH sasahAcaraiH||58||
mUtrAmlapiShTaiH saguDairvartiM kRutvA praveshayet| agre tu sarShapAkArAM pashcArdhe mAShasammitAm||59||
netradIrghAM ghRutAbhyaktAM sukumArAmabha~ggurAm| netravanmUtranADyAM tu pAyau cA~gguShThasammitAm||60||
snehe pratyAgate tAbhyAmAnuvAsaniko vidhiH| parihArashca savyApat sasamyagdattalakShaNaH||61||
strINAmArtavakAle tu pratikarma tadAcaret| garbhAsanA sukhaM snehaM tadA~a~adatte hyapAvRutA||62||
garbhaM yonistadA shIghraM jite gRuhNAti mArute| bastijeShu vikAreShu yonivibhraMshajeShu ca||63||
yonishUleShu tIvreShu yonivyApatsvasRugdare| aprasravati mUtre ca binduM binduM sravatyapi||64||
puShpanetrapramANaM tu pramadAnAM dashA~ggulam||65||
mUtrasrotaHparINAhaM mudgasroto~anuvAhi ca| apatyamArge nArINAM vidheyaM catura~ggulam||66||
dvya~ggulaM mUtramArge tu bAlAyAstvekama~ggulam| uttAnAyAH shayAnAyAH samyak sa~gkocya sakthinI||67||
athAsyAH praNayennetramanuvaMshagataM sukham| dvistrishcaturiti snehAnahorAtreNa yojayet||68||
bastau , bastau praNIte ca vartiH pInatarA bhavet| trirAtraM karma kurvIta snehamAtrAM vivardhayet||69||
ataH shirovikArANAM kashcidbhedaH pravakShyate||70||
raktapittAnilA duShTAH sha~gkhadeshe vimUrcchitAH| tIvrarugdAharAgaM hi shophaM kurvanti dAruNam||71||
sa shiro viShavadvegI nirudhyAshu galaM tathA| trirAtrAjjIvitaM hanti sha~gkhako nAma nAmataH||72||
paraM tryahAjjIvati cet pratyAkhyAyAcaret kriyAm| shirovirekasekAdi sarvaM vIsarpanucca yat||73||
rUkShAtyadhyashanAt pUrvavAtAvashyAyamaithunaiH| vegasandhAraNAyAsavyAyAmaiH kupito~anilaH||74||
kevalaH sakapho vA~ardhaM gRuhItvA shirasastataH| manyAbhrUsha~gkhakarNAkShilalATArdhe~ativedanAm||75||
shastrAraNinibhAM kuryAttIvrAM so~ardhAvabhedakaH| nayanaM vA~athavA shrotramativRuddho vinAshayet||76||
catuHsnehottamA mAtrA shiraHkAyavirecanam| nADIsvedo ghRutaM jIrNaM bastikarmAnuvAsanam||77||
upanAhaH shirobastirdahanaM cAtra shasyate| pratishyAye shiroroge yaccoddiShTaM cikitsitam||78||
sandhAraNAdajIrNAdyairmastiShkaM raktamArutau| duShTau dUShayatastacca duShTaM tAbhyAM vimUrcchitam||79||
sUryodayeM~ashusantApAddravaM viShyandate shanaiH| tato dine shiraHshUlaM dinavRuddhyA vivardhate||80||
dinakShaye tataH styAne mastiShke samprashAmyati| sUryAvartaH sa tatra syAt sarpirauttarabhaktikam||81||
shiraHkAyavirekau ca mUrdhnA trisnehadhAraNam | jA~ggalairupanAhashca ghRutakShIraishca secanam ||82||
barhitittirilAvAdishRutakShIrotthitaM ghRutam| syAnnAvanaM jIvanIyakShIrAShTaguNasAdhitam||83||
(upavAsAtishokAtirUkShashItAlpabhojanaiH )| duShTA doShAstrayo manyApashcAdghATAsu vedanAm||84||
tIvrAM kurvanti sA cAkShibhrUsha~gkheShvavatiShThate| spandanaM gaNDapArshvasya netrarogaM hanugraham||85||
so~anantavAtastaM hanyAt sirArkAvartanAshanaiH| vAto rUkShAdibhiH kruddhaH shiraHkampamudIrayet||86||
tatrAmRutAbalArAsnAmahAshvetAshvagandhakaiH| snehasvedAdi vAtaghnaM shastaM nasyaM ca tarpaNam||87||

nastaHkarma ca kurvIta shirorogeShu shAstravid| dvAraM hi shiraso nAsA tena tad vyApya hanti tAn||88||

Commentary: nastaHkarma ceti sarvashirorogasAdhAraNaM cikitsitam| shirorogeShu nastaHkarmakaraNe hetumAha- dvAraM hItyAdi| tena nAsArUpeNa mArgeNa| taditi nasto dattamauShadham| vyApyeti shiro vyApya| tAniti shirogadAn||88||
nAvanaM cAvapIDashca dhmApanaM dhUma eva ca| pratimarshashca vij~jeyaM nastaHkarma tu pa~jcadhA||89||
snehanaM shodhanaM caiva dvividhaM nAvanaM smRutam| shodhanaH stambhanashca syAdavapIDo dvidhA mataH ||90||
cUrNasyAdhmApanaM taddhi dehasrotovishodhanam | vij~jeyastrividho dhUmaH prAguktaH shamanAdikaH||91||
pratimarsho bhavet sneho nirdoSha ubhayArthakRut| evaM tadrecanaM karma tarpaNaM shamanaM tridhA||92||
stambhasuptigurutvAdyAH shlaiShmikA ye shirogadAH| shirovirecanaM teShu nastaHkarma prashasyate||93||
ye ca vAtAtmakA rogAH shiraHkampArditAdayaH| shirasastarpaNaM teShu nastaHkarma prashasyate ||94||
raktapittAdirogeShu shamanaM nasyamiShyate| dhmApanaM dhUmapAnaM ca tathA yogyeShu shasyate ||95||
phalAdibheShajaM proktaM shiraso yadvirecanam||96||
taccUrNaM kalpayettena pacet snehaM virecanam| yaduktaM madhuraskandhe bheShajaM tena tarpaNam||97||
prAksUrye madhyasUrye vA prAkkRutAvashyakasya ca||98||
uttAnasya shayAnasya shayane svAstRute sukham| pralambashirasaH ki~jcit ki~jcit pAdonnatasya ca||99||
dadyAnnAsApuTe snehaM tarpaNaM buddhimAn bhiShak| anavAkshiraso nasyaM na shiraH pratipadyate||100||
atyavAkshiraso nasyaM mastulu~gge~avatiShThati| ata evaMshayAnasya shuddhyarthaM svedayecchiraH||101||
saMsvedya nAsAmunnamya vAmenA~gguShThaparvaNA| hastena dakShiNenAtha kuryAdubhayataH samam||102||
praNADyA picunA vA~api nastaHsnehaM yathAvidhi| kRute ca svedayedbhUya AkarShecca punaH punaH||103||
taM snehaM shleShmaNA sAkaM tathA sneho na tiShThati| svedenotkleshitaH shleShmA nastaHkarmaNyupasthitaH ||104||
bhUyaH snehasya shaityena shirasi styAyate tataH| shrotramanyAgalAdyeShu vikArAya sa kalpate||105||
tato nastaHkRute dhUmaM pibet kaphavinAshanam | hitAnnabhu~gnivAtoShNasevI syAnniyatendriyaH||106||
vidhireSho~avapIDasya kAryaH pradhmApanasya tu| tat ShaDa~ggulayA nADyA dhameccUrNaM mukhena tu||107||
viriktashirasaM tUShNaM pAyayitvA~ambu bhojayet| laghu triShvaviruddhaM ca nivAtasthamatandritaH||108||
virekashuddho doShasya kopanaM yasya sevate| sa doSho vicaraMstatra karoti svAn gadAn bahUn||109||
yathAsvaM vihitAM teShu kriyAM kuryAdvicakShaNaH| akAlakRutajAtAnAM rogANAmanurUpataH||110||

tatra hRudaye dasha dhamanyaH prANApAnau mano buddhishcetanA mahAbhUtAni ca nAbhyAmarA iva pratiShThitAni, shirasi indriyANi indriyaprANavahAni ca srotAMsi sUryamiva gabhastayaH saMshritAni, bastistu sthUlagudamuShkasevanIshukramUtravAhinInAM nADI(lI)nAM madhye mUtradhAro~ambuvahAnAM sarvasrotasAmudadhirivApagAnAM pratiShThA , bahubhishca tanmUlairmarmasa~jj~jakaiH srotobhirgaganamiva dinakarakarairvyAptamidaM sharIram||4||

teShAM trayANAmanyatamasyApi bhedAdAshveva sharIrabhedaH syAt, AshrayanAshAdAshritasyApi vinAshaH; tadupaghAtAttu ghorataravyAdhiprAdurbhAvaH; tasmAdetAni visheSheNa rakShyANi bAhyAbhighAdvAtAdibhyashca||5||
ajIrNe bhojane bhukte toye pIte~atha durdine| pratishyAye nave snAte snehapAne~anuvAsane||111||
nAvanaM snehanaM rogAn karoti shlaiShmikAn bahUn| tatra shleShmaharaH sarvastIkShNoShNAdirvidhirhitaH||112||
kShAme virecite garbhe vyAyAmAbhihate tRuShi| vAto rUkSheNa nasyena kruddhaH svA~jjanayedgadAn||113||
tatra vAtaharaH sarvo vidhiH snehanabRuMhaNaH| svedAdiH, syAdghRutaM kShIraM garbhiNyAstu visheShataH||114||
jvarashokAtitaptAnAM timiraM madyapasya tu| rUkShaiH shItA~jjanairlepaiH puTapAkaishca sAdhayet ||115||
snehanaM shodhanaM caiva dvividhaM nAvanaM matam| pratimarshastu nasyArthaM karoti na ca doShAvAn||116||
nastaH snehA~gguliM dadyAt prAtarnishi ca sarvadA| na cocchi~gghedarogANAM pratimarshaH sa dArDhyakRut||117||
tatra shlokau- trINi yasmAt pradhAnAni marmANyabhihateShu ca| teShu li~ggaM cikitsAM ca rogabhedAshca sauShadhAH||118||
vidhiruttarabasteshca nastaHkarmavidhistathA| savyApadbheShajaM siddhau marmAkhyAyAM prakIrtitam||119||

tatra hRudyabhihate kAsashvAsabalakShayakaNThashoShaklomAkarShaNajihvAnirgamamukhatAlushoShApasmAronmAdapralApacittanAshAdayaH syuH; shirasyabhihate manyAstambhArditacakShurvibhramamohodveShTanaceShTAnAshakAsashvAsahanugrahamUkagadgadatvAkShinimIlana- gaNDaspandanajRumbhaNalAlAsrAvasvarahAnivadanajihmatvAdIni, bastau tu vAtamUtravarconigrahava~gkShaNamehanabastishUlakuNDalodAvartagulmAnilAShThIlopastambhanAbhikukShigudashroNigrahAdayaH ; vAtAdyupasRuShTAnAM tveShAM li~ggAni cikitsite sakriyAvidhInyuktAni||6||

Commentary: hRudayAdyabhighAtabhavAn vyAdhIn krameNAha- tatretyAdi| klomApakarShaNaM klomApakarShaNAkArA vedanA| veShTanaM shirasi veShTanAkArA vedanA| kuNDalaM bastau kuNDalarUpA vedanA| upastambhaH bastereva| cikitsite iti trimarmIyacikitsite| sakriyAvidhinIti sacikitsitavidhAnAni||6||

kintvetAni visheShato~anilAdrakShyANi, anilo hi pittakaphasamudIraNe hetuH prANamUlaM ca, sa bastikarmasAdhyatamaH, tasmAnna bastisamaM ki~jcit karma marmaparipAlanamasti| tatra ShaDAsthApanaskandhAn vimAne dvau cAnuvAsanaskandhAviha ca vihitAn bastIn buddhyA vicArya mahAmarmaparipAlanArthaM prayojayedvAtavyAdhicikitsAM ca||7||

Commentary: marmaparipAlane basteH prAdhAnyaM sopapattikamAha- kintvetAnItyAdi| yasmAt pittakaphayordvayorakriyayorIraNe~anila eva hetuH, tena kaphapittaje~api vikAre vAyurnimittaM, vAtajavikAre~api vAyuH svatantra eva kAraNam, ataH sarvavikAreShu marmANi rakShayatA tatkAraNAdanilAdeva marmANi rakShaNIyAni| tathA prANamUlaM ceti jIvitahetushcAvikRuto vAyuH, vikRutashca prANopaghAtakaH; tena marmANyapi prANarakShArthaM vAtAdrakShyANi| bastisAdhyatama iti itaracikitsApekShayA bastinA sAdhyatamaH; uktaM hi- “bastirvAtaharANAm” (sU.a.25) iti| dvau cAnuvAsanaskandhAviti rogabhiShagjitIye “anuvAsanaM tu sneha eva, sa dvividhaH- sthAvaro ja~ggamashca” (vi.a.8) ityanenoktau dvAvanuvAsanaskandhau j~jeyau| iheti siddhisthAne| buddhyA vicAryeti doShauShadhAdIni dasha buddhyA vicArya, vAtavyAdhicikitsAM ca buddhyA vicArya prayojayedityarthaH||7||

bhUyashca hRudyupasRuShTe hi~ggucUrNaM lavaNAnAmanyatamacUrNasaMyuktaM mAtulu~ggasya rasenAnyena vA~amlena hRudyena vA pAyayet, sthirAdipa~jcamUlIrasaH sasharkaraH pAnArthaM, bilvAdipa~jcamUlarasasiddhA ca yavAgUH, hRudrogavihitaM ca karma; mUrdhni tu vAtopasRuShTe~abhya~ggasvedanopanAhasnehapAnanastaHkarmAvapIDanadhUmAdIni; bastau tu kumbhIsvedaH, vartayaH, shyAmAdibhirgomUtrasiddho nirUhaH, bilvAdibhishca surAsiddhaH, sharakAshekShudarbhagokShurakamUlashRutakShIraishca trapusairvArukharAshvAbIjayavarShabhakavRuddhikalkito nirUhaH, pItadArusiddhatailenAnuvAsanaM, tailvakaM ca sarpirvirekArthaM, shatAvarIgokShurakabRuhatIkaNTakArikAguDUcIpunarnavoshIramadhukadvisArivAlodhrashreyasIkushakAshamUlakaShAyakShIracaturguNaM balAvRuSharShabhakakharAshvopaku~jcikAvatsakatrapusairvArubIjashitivArakamadhukavacAshatapuShpAshmabhedakavarShAbhUmadanaphalakalkasiddhaM tailamuttarabastirnirUho vA shuddhasnigdhasvinnasya bastishUlamUtravikArahara iti||8||

Commentary: visheSheNa marmabhedacikitsitamAha - bhUyashcetyAdi| hRudyupasRuShTe ‘vAtena” iti sheShaH| lavaNAnAmiti nirdhAraNe ShaShThI| anya eva anyatamaH, yathA- shreShThatama iti| hRudyeneti mano~anukUlena; yad dveShyarasasya hRudahitatayA~ahRudyatvaM, tanmano~ananukUlatvameva| hRudrogavihitaM ca karmeti trimarmIyacikitsite| dhUmAdInIti Adishabdena pariShekopanAhAdigrahaNam| bastau tviti ‘praduShTe vAtena’ iti prakaraNAjj~jeyaM; pittakaphaduShTau ca vAyureva pradhAnamiti prAgeva pratipAditaM; tena kaphapittaduShTirapi labhyate| vartaya iti phalavartayaH| shyAmAdibhiriti “shyAmAtrivRuccatura~ggulatilvakamahAvRukShasaptalAsha~gkhinIdantIdravantInAm” (vi.a.8) ityAdinA prAguktaH shyAmAdiH| bilvAdiriti bRuhatpa~jcamUlaM; kiMvA “bilvamUlatrivRuddAruyavakolakulatthavAn” (si.a.7) ityanenokto bilvAdirj~jeyaH| sharAdimUlashRutakShIrahapuShAdikalko~aparaH| kharAshvA ajamodA| pItadArusiddhatailena sAdhitamanuvAsanaM yasminnirUhe sa tathA| kecittu saralasArAkRuShTatailaM pItadArusiddhatailamAhuH| tailvakasarpiH tilvakakalpoktam| shatAvarItyAdau dvisAriveti anantamUlashyAme| shreyasI rAsnA| upaku~jcikA kRuShNajIrakam| shitivArakaH shAli~jcaH| ashmabhedakaH pAShANabhedakaH| uttarabastiriti vakShyamANottarabastividhAnAddeya ityarthaH| nirUhaH nirUhasthAne deya ityarthaH||8||
bhavanti cAtra shlokAH- hRudaye mUrdhni bastau ca nRuNAM prANAH pratiShThitAH| tasmAtteShAM sadA yatnaM kurvIta paripAlane||9||
AbAdhavarjanaM nityaM svasthavRuttAnuvartanam| utpannArtivighAtashca marmaNAM paripAlanam||10||

prAsRutayogIyAnantaraM trimarmIyA siddhirucyate, trimarmajarogAshrayivyApadAM bastirUpacikitsopadarshanArthaM; vyApatpratIkArAnantaraM bastiprayogAdhikArashca pUrvAdhyAyAdanuvartate ; kiMvA, bastivyApaccikitsA pUrvAdhyAyAdikRutA, bastivyApAdAcca trimarmajA api rogA bhavanti, tena teShAM j~jAnapUrvakacikitsopadarshanArthaM trimarmIyasiddhirucyate| etadadhyAyavaktavyAshca gadAstrimarmIyacikitsite~adhyAyavistarabhayAnnoktAH, ta iha pratipAdyante| atrApi marmashabdena marmagatA gadA ucyante, tAnadhikRutA siddhistrimarmIyasiddhiH||1-2||

hRudrogamapatantrakamAha- kruddha ityAdi| sthAnAdUrdhvamiti vAtasthAnApekShayA yadUrdhvam| stabdhAkSho~atha nimIlana iti stabdhAkSho vA bhavati nimIlitAkSho vA bhavati| niHsa~jj~ja iti vyAdhivegakAle dRuShTiM saMstabhya sa~jj~jAM ca hatvA kaNThena kUjati, niHsa~jj~jashca bhavati| mohaM vRute punariti hRudaye vRute punarvAyunA mohaM yAti; vAyuneti kaphayuktena; eke tamapatAnakamevApatantrakamAhuH| atra jatUkarNaH- “vAtakaphAbhyAM hRucchiraHsha~gkhapIDanAnamanA~ggAkShepapramohAkShistambhAnimIlanakRucchrocchvAsakUjanAnyapatantrake”iti| kiMvA apatantrakaM dvividhaM varNayanti- vAtAt, kaphAcca ; tatra ‘niHsa~jj~jaH so~apatantrakaH’ ityanena kaphaja ucyate; ‘vAyunA dAruNaM prAhuH’ ityanena vAyunA janitamapatantrakamevApatAnakamAhuH| tasya dAruNatvaM dAruNavAtArabdhatvAditi vyAkhyeyam| tathaiva sushrute vAtavyAdhAvatantrakaH paThitaH||12-15||

tAsviti cetanAvahAsu dhamanIShu| yavakvAthAmbuneti yavaiH ShaDa~ggavidhinA shRutapAnIyena| hRudroganud vAtakaphaghnaM yat karma taddhitamapatantrake| shodhanA ityAdau “kRutsnashaH shodhanA na hitAH’ iti vacanena shodhanArthastokanirUhadAnaM, bhUrishodhananirUhadAne tu vAtakShobhaH syAditi bhAvaH||16-20||
madhurasnigdhetyAdinA tandrAlakShaNaM cikitsitaM ca kecit paThanti||21-24||
hRudrogamabhidhAya bastirogAnAha- mUtraukasAda ityAdi| ete ca mUtradoShA mUtrakRucchrAdbhinnA eveti trimarmIya eva pratipAditam||25-26||

pittaM kapha ityAdinA mUtraukasAdamAha| ayaM ca vAtakapha-pittavAta-tridoShairjanyata ityuktaM bhavati| saMhanyate iti saMhate raktapItavarNatA pittena, shvetavarNatA kaphena, kaphapittalakShaNatA kaphapittAbhyAM, vAyustu sarvAnugata eva| atra vAyorAvaraNakRuta eva kopaH; tena pittakaphayoreva cikitsoktA ‘pittashleShmaharairjayet’ ityanena, vAyostvAvaraNajayAdeva jayo bhavatIti bhAvaH||27-28||

animittarugiti alakShyamANanimittaruk| mUtravairecanImiti mUtravirecanIyadashakaprayogarUpAm| hi~ggudviruttaraM tu ‘dviruttaraM hi~gguvacA’ (ci.a.26) ityAdinoktaM, hi~ggu dviruttaraM yasmin taddhi~ggudviruttaram||29-31||

mUtritasyeti mUtravegagatasya, mUtravegayuktasyeti yAvat| cyutamiti svasthAnAccyutam| vAtoddhatamiti vAtavikShiptam| etallakShaNAntarayuktameva kRucchraM; mUtrakRucchramito~anyadeva, bhinnakShaNatvAt| ki~jciditi stokam| uccheShagurushephasa iti pravRuddhamUtrAvasheSheNa sthitena gurushephasa iti| vAtAkRutirityAdi sa~gkShayalakShaNam | vAtAkRutiriti vAtalakShaNayuktaH| vidhAraNAditi mUtravegarodhAt| UShmaNeti pittoShmaNA| shoShayanniti UShmaNA sahito vAta eva mUtraM shoShayan| gatisa~ggAdityAdinA vAtakuNDalikAmAha| mUtrasya gatisa~ggAdudAvRutto vAyurmUtrasthAnamArgayorbhagnavyAviddhakuNDalI mUtrayati; bhagnaH pratihataH, vyAviddhaH vakrI, kuNDalIti AvartamAnatayA sthitaH; IdRushaM vAyorupasthAnaM mUtramArga eva bhavati| vAtakuNDalikAlakShaNamAha- saMstambhetyAdi| bha~ggaH bha~ggAkAravedanA| raktaM granthiM kuryAt vAtakaphAbhyAM duShTamiti yojyam| viDyukto vighAto viDvighAtaH| drutAdhvetyAdinA bastikuNDalamAha| udvRutta iti parAvRuttamukhaH| pIDita iti hastAdibhiH| shleShmaruddhabilo bastirna sidhyati, tathA pittodIrNashca na sidhyati| avibhrAntabila iti aruddhadvAraH| kuNDalIkRuta iti vartulIkRutaH| vartulIkRutasyaiva lakShaNAnyAha- syAdbastAvityAdi||32-48||-

uttarabastiM dApayedityuktaM, tata uttarabastividhimAha- puShpanetramityAdi| puShpanetramityuttarabastinetrasya sa~jj~jA; uttarabastisa~jj~jA uttaramArgadIyamAnatayA, kiMvA shreShThaguNatayA uttarabastiH| jAtyashvahanavRuntena samamiti jAterashvahanasya ca puShpayorvRuntenAgrasamam; uktaM hi hArIte “kundasya vRuntapratimaM tathA~agre” iti; ashvahanaH karavIraH| sarShapacchidramiti sarShapavAhicchidram| dvikarNikamiti netre bastibandhanArthamekataH karNikA, aparA~agre shephaHpramANaShaDa~ggulAdau karNikA kartavyA| trikarNikam’ iti vA pAThaH| yathAvayovisheSheNa snehamAtrAM vikalpya ceti yathoktasnehaH pa~jcaviMshativarShasya, tatastvarvAgvayobhedavikalpenApakarShaH kartavyaH; uktaM hi sushrute “snehapramANaM paramaM praku~jcashcAtra kIrtitaH| pa~jcaviMshativarShANAmarvAgbuddhivikalpitam” (su.ci.a.37) iti| hRuShTe iti stabdhe, yadyapratihatA vrajecchalAkA, tatra puShpanetraM shephaHpramANasamaM praveshanIyam| shalAkayA prathamamanveShaNaM mArgavij~jAnArtham| gudavaditi gude yathA netrAkampanAdiguNayuktaM praveshyate tathA meDhre~api| atigataM li~ggapramANAtirekapraviShTaM netraM bastiM hiMsyAt| Une iti li~ggamAnastokapraviShTe||50-57||

pippalItyAdinA vyuShite~apyanAgacchataH snehasya pravartikAM vartimAha| iyaM ca vartirguDapAkena kaThinA kartavyA yathA shlakShNA bhavati| pashcArdhe iti mUle; a~gguShThasannibhAmiti pAyau snehapravRuttyarthaM dIyamAnA~a~gguShThasamAnA kartavyA| tAbhyAmiti meDhragudAbhyAM dattavartibhyAm| uttarabasteranuvAsanavat sevyaparihAravyApatsamyagdattalakShaNAnyatidishannAha- AnuvAsaniko vidhirityAdi||58-61||

ArtavakAle tvautsargikatayoktaM strINAmuttarabastidAnamArtavakAle vidhatte| ArtavakAladAne hetumAha- garbhAsanetyAdi| garbhAsanA garbhashayyA, garbhAshaya ityarthaH; anye tu yonimAhuH| Adatta iti samyag gRuhNAti| apAvRuteti apagatasa~jcitarajorUpAvaraNA||62-64||-

puShpanetrapramANaM tvityAdi| mudgasroto~anuvAhIti mUdgavAhicchidram| apatyamArge vidheyaM catura~ggulamiti apatyamArge snehayitavye catura~ggulapraveshanaM prAptayauvanAnAmeva nArINAM kartavyaM, mUtramArge tu snehayitavye dvya~ggulapraveshanaM prAptayauvanAnAmeva nArINAM kartavyam| bAlAyAH svalpapramANatayA ekA~ggulapraveshanameva mUtramArgaprayogArthaM kartavyaM; bAlAnAM tvapatyamArge na dIyata eva, tAsAmapatyamArgasyAvRutatvAt| vartiH pInatarA bhavediti snehapratyAgamanArthA vartiH pInatarA kartavyA| snehamAtrA cAtra “snehasya prasRutaM cAtra svA~ggulImUlasammitam” (su.ci.a.37) ityanena sushrutoktA j~jeyA||65-69||-

kramAgatashirovikAraj~jAnArthaM trimarmIyAvistRutAn vaktumAha- ata ityAdi| dAruNa iti AshukArI| paraM tryahAjjIvatItyAdikaH prabhAvo~ayaM sha~gkhakasya| pratyAkhyAyAcaret kriyAmityanena utpannamAtra eva pratyAkhyAnapUrvikA cikitsA kartavyA~asya||70-73||

rUkShetyAdinA~ardhAvabhedakamAha| avashyAyaH himaH| shastrAraNinibhAmiti shastracchedAraNimanthananibhAm; araNiH agnyutthApanakAShThaM; kiMvA araNinA kAraNenAgnirevAtra lakShyate| catuHsnehasyottamA mAtrA; uttamA ca mAtrA ahorAtrapariNamanIyA| jIrNaM dashavarShasthitaM ghRutam| upanAhaM kecicchirobastibhedamAhuH, yo mAstiShka ucyate; tantrAntare hi mAstiShka upanAhaH shirobastiprakAra uktaH-  “mAstiShke~aShTA~ggulaM paTTaM bastau tu dvAdashA~ggulam” ityAdinA; shirobastividhAnaM shAlAkye j~jeyaM; yathA- “dvAdashA~ggulavistIrNaM carmapaTTaM shiraHsamam| AkarNabandhanasthAne lalATe vastraveShTite|| celaveNikayA baddhvA mAShakalkena lepayet| tato yathAvyAdhishRutaM snehaM koShNaM niveshayet|| UrdhvaM keshabhuvo yAvada~ggulaM dhArayecca tam| AvakranAsikAkledAddashAShTau ShaDvAtAdiShu|| mAtrA sahasrANyaruje hyekaM skandhAdi mardayet| yuktasnehasya paramaM saptAhaM tasya sevanam” iti; tathA “AshirovyAyataM carma kRutvA~aShTA~ggulamucchritam| tenAveShTya shiro~adhastAnmAShakalkena lepayet|| nishcalasyopaviShTasya tailaiH koShNaiH prapUrayet| dhArayedArujaH shAntyai yAmaM yAmArdhameva vA|| shirobastirjayatyeSha shirorogaM marudbhavam” ityAdi| dahanaM vA~asyeti tantrAntarapratyayAd dvya~ggulalalATasha~gkhapradesheShu sharakANDAdinA dahanaM j~jeyam| yaccoddiShTaM cikitsitamiti taccAtra shasyate iti yojyam||74-78||

mastiShkaM shiraHstho majjA| dravamiti dravaM sat| viShyandate iti cyavate| etacca sUryAvartasya rUpaM doShadUShyayorvikRutiviShamasamavAyAdbhavati; tena nAnyavikAra evambhUto bhavati| tathA vedanA sUryatApe evAsya vardhate nAgnitApe, ityetadapi prabhAvakRutameva j~jeyam| trisnehadhAraNamiti pAThAt tailaghRutavasAdhAraNaM vadanti| lAvAdayo viShkirA annapAnoktAH||79-83||

manyA grIvAsirAdvayaM, ghATA grIvAyAH pashcAdbhAgaH, pashcAt pRuShTham| sA cAkShibhrUsha~gkheShvavatiShThata iti sha~gkhAdIn vyApya sthirA bhavati| anantavAtamenaM tantrAntare anyatovAtamAhuH| sirArkAvartanAshanairiti sirAvyadhaiH, sUryAvartanAshanaishca bheShajaiH||84-87||

shirorogaprastAvAgatAnavashyavaktavyanastaHkarmabhedAnAha- nAvanamityAdi| nAvanAdayashcikitsAsthAnoktAH| atra sushrute dhUmaM varjayitvA pa~jcavidhaM nastaHkarmoktaM-  “taddvividhamapi pa~jcavidhavikalpaM; tadyathA- nasyaM, shirovirecanaM, pratimarshaH, avapIDaH, pradhamanaM ca” (ci.a.40)| iti; iha tu nAvanashabdenaiva shirovirecanamapi gRuhItaM; yaduktaM- “snehanaM shodhanaM caiva nAvanaM dvividhaM smRutam” iti; tena sushrutokto~apyartho gRuhIta eva| shodhanaH stambhanashca syAdavapIDa ityatra saMshamanamapyavapIDasya karmecchanti, tacca stambhane evAntarbhAvanIyam| avapIDya yatra kalkAdIni dIyante ityavapIDaH; anena shirovirecanArthaM dIyamAnasaindhavapippalyAdikalkasyApyavarodhaH| dhmApanaM taddhi dehasrotovishodhanamiti vacanAd dhmApanaM shirovirecanaprayojanakameveti darshayati| shamanAdika ityatra shamanashabdena prAyogikaM gRuhNAti, tena prAyogikasnaihikavairecanikadhUmAnAM nAsAdIyamAnAnAmiha grahaNaM, mukhapeyastu dhumo na nasyam| ubhayArthakRuditi snehanavirecanArthakRut| pratimarshalakShaNamagre “nastaHsnehA~gguliM dadyAt” ityAdinA vakShyamANam| uktapa~jcavidhanastaHkarmaNastraividhyamAha- evamityAdi| karmeti nastaHkarma| shamanena stambhanasyApi grahaNaM; tarpaNe snehanasyAvarodhaH; anye ye kecit prabhedAstantrAntare pratipAditAste~apyatraivAntarbhavanti||89-92||

virecanAdikarmatrayasya viShayamAha- stambhetyAdi| tarpaNamiti snehena tarpaNam| tathA yogyeShu shasyata iti dhmApanadhUmayogyeShu shasyate; tatra dhUmayogyAH sUtrasthAne pratipAditAH, dhmApanayogyAstu dhmApanaguNakathane ‘dehasrotovishodhanam’ itipadena ye~abhinyAsApasmArAdayaH shodhanIyasrotasa uktAste j~jeyAH||93-95||-

shirovirecanacUrNaM vidhiM cAha- phalAdItyAdi| phalAdibheShajamiti rogabhiShagjitIyoktaM phalapatramUlakandapuShpaniryAsatvagbhedAt saptavidhamuktaM shirovirecanadravyam| cUrNaM kalpayediti pradhamanArthamavapIDanArthaM ca cUrNaM kalpayet| madhuraskandho~api rogabhiShagjitIya evoktaH||96-97||-

nastaHkarmavidhimAha- prAksUrye ityAdi| grIShme prAksUrye, shIte tu madhyasUrye iti vyavasthA| prAkkRutAvashyakasya ceti prAkkRutAvashyakaraNIyamalavisargAdikasya| evaM shayAnasyeti ki~jcidavanatashiraskatayA shayAnasya| kuryAdubhayataH samamiti ubhayanAsApuTenApi tulyaM dadyAt| praNADI nasyadAnanalikA| yathAvidhIti pramANAdidoSharahitam| kRutanasyasya dhumapAnopapattivarNanapUrvakaM dhUmapAnamAha- svedanetyAdi| pradhmApanasya cokto vidhistathA vakShyamANashca ‘ShaDa~ggulayA’ ityAdinA| viriktashirasamityAdi sarvavirecanasAdhAraNam| triShviti vAtAdiShu| virekashuddha iti shirovirekashuddhaH| yasya doShasya kopanaM sevate iti yojyam| akAlakRutajAtAnAM rogANAmanurUpata iti akAlakRutashirovirecanajAtAnAM rogANAmanurUpatashcikitsAM kuryAdityarthaH||98-110||

dasha dhamanya iti ojovahA dasha dhamanyaH, “arthe dasha mahAmUlAH samAsaktAH” (sU.a.30) ityAdinA arthedashamahAmUlIye pratipAditAH| prANApAnAviti ucchvAsanishvAsau, kecittu prANApAnau yathoktAveva vAtau prAhuH; tatrApAno yadyapi meDhrashroNyAdyAshraya evetyAhuH, tathA~api hRudayAvyatiriktAnuvidhAyitvAddhRudayAshrita ityucyate| manaH antaHkaraNam| buddhiH mahacchabdAbhilapyA| cetanA buddhivRuttibhedaH| mahAbhUtAnIti AtmasambaddhAni sUkShmamahAbhUtAni| etat sarvaM sA~gkhyadarshane vyavasthApitaM shArIre ca vyutpAditamanusaraNIyam| pradeshAntare coktaM- “ShaDa~ggama~ggaM vij~jAnamindriyANyarthapa~jcakam| AtmA ca saguNashcetashcintyaM ca hRudi saMsthitam” (sU.a.30) iti; te~arthA etacchlokoktAH, adhikArthAnAM ca prokteShvevAvarodho vyAkhyeyaH; kiMvA iha shAstroddhAreNAbhidhAnam| yathA hRudaye dasha dhamanyAdInyAshritAni, taddRuShTAntena darshayati- nAbhyAmarA iva pratiShThitAnIti; nAbhiH cakranAbhiH, arAH cakranemimadhyasthakAShThAni, yathA- cakranAbhyAM sambaddhA, arAstadupaghAtAdupahanyante, tanmUlatvena tatsambandhA bhavanti, evaM dhamanyAdayo~apItyarthaH| ‘nAbhyAmaparA’ iti vA pAThaH, tena garbhanAbhyAmaparA ivetyarthaH (arA iva apareti vyAkhyAnayanti)| etena pradeshAntaravartinAmapi dhamanyAdInAM hRudayAshritatvaM siddhamiti bhAvaH| shirasa AshrayatvamAha- shirasItyAdi| indriyaprANavahAni srotAMsi yadyapi pradeshAntare~api bhavanti , tathA~api shirasi visheSheNaivaitAni prabaddhAnIti sUryamiva gabhastaya iti dRuShTAntena darshayati| shiraAshrayatvaM ca yathoktasrotasAM tadupaghAtena vishiShTopaghAtadarshanAdunnIyate| basteH sharIrAshrayatvamAhu- bastistvityAdi| sthUlagudAdimadhyasthitatvapratipAdanenAsya sthUlagudAdInAM bastyAshrayatvaM darshayati| ambuvahAnAM srotasAM pratiShTheti sthAnamityarthaH, udadhiryathA~a~apagAnAM pUraNIyasthAnaM, tathA bastirapyambuvahasrotasAM vishrAmasthAnam| tanmUlairiti tatsambaddhairmarmasa~jj~jakaiH; nahi srotasAM marmatvamasti; kiMvA srotomarmashabdena sirAmarmaNAM grahaNaM; kiMvA marmasambaddhAni marmapoShakANi vA srotAMsi marmasa~jj~jakAni srotAMsi| AshrayanAshAdAshritasya nAsha iti AshrayanAshAdAshritasya nAsho yasmAdbhavati, tasmAddhRudayAdInAmanyatamasya nAshAccharIranAsho bhavatIti yuktam| sharIrasya hRudayAshritatvaM sharIrArambhakapradhAnadashadhamanyAdyAshrayatvenaiva j~jeyam| upaghAtAditi ki~jcidvaikRutAt||4-5||

nAvanaM snehanamiti snehanArthaM nasyam| svedAdiriti cchedaH| ghRutaM kShIramiti garbhiNyA vAtajayArthaM garbhapuShTaye ca| jvaretyAdi| jvarAditaptAnAM snehanaM nAvanaM timiraM kuryAt, tathA madyapasya timiraM kuryAt| atra cikitsAmAha- rUkShairityAdi| shItA~jjanaM sroto~jjanaM vadanti; kiMvA tiktadravyakRutama~jjanaM shItA~jjanaM; yaduktaM shAlAkye- “lekhanaM ropaNaM caiva prasAdanamathApi ca| tiktena ropaNaM kAryaM, madhureNa prasAdanam|| kaTvamlalavaNAdyaishca lekhanaM kArayedbudhaH| shaityAnnirvApayettikto raukShyAdropayati drutam” iti| rUkShairitya~jjanAdibhiH sambadhyate| lepaH nayanAlepaH ; puTapAkaH akShitarpaNajavikAraharalekhanaH shamano vA j~jeyaH; puTapAko hi shAlAkye snehana-lekhana-prasAdanabhedAt trividha uktaH; tadvidhishcehAnyAdhikArAnna prapa~jcitaH||111-115||

pratimarshasya nAvanasampAdyobhayakarmadarshanArthaM nAvanakarma prAguktamanUdyate- snehanamityAdi| anye, sarvanastaHkarmaNAmevaitat karmadvayamanUdyate, tatra ca snehanashamanasya prAguktasyAvarodha iti vadanti| tasyArthamiti snehanaM shodhanaM ca| na ca doShavAniti na vyApattimAn| pratimarshavidhimAha- nasta ityAdi| snehA~ggulimiti snehapUritAma~ggulim| sarvadeti sarvartuShu| dArDhyakRuditi shiraHkapAlAdidArDhyakRut| ayaM pratimarshaH svalpasnehapramANo~anucchi~gghanashca sArvakAliko j~jeyaH; yastu bhUrisnehamAtro nAsau sArvakAlikaH| yaduktam “IShaducchi~gghanAt sneho yAvAn vakraM prapadyate| nasto niShiktaM taM vidyAt pratimarshaM pramANataH” iti; tathA “pratimarshaM tu na pibet kaNThAsrAvabhayAnnaraH| yAvat sneho vrajedAsyaM tatpramANaM ca tasya tu” iti||116-117||
trINItyAdisa~ggraho vyaktArthaH||118-119||

gadyoktamarthaM shlokena darshayannadhikamapyAha- ki~jcit hRudaye ityAdinA| AbAdhavarjanamiti marmopaghAtakahetuvarjanam| svasthavRuttAnuvartanaM ca hRudayAdipoShakatayaiva pAlakaM bhavati| utpannArtivighAta iti utpannamarmarogapratIkAraH||9-10||
athAto bastisiddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||

siddhAnAM bastInAM shastAnAM teShu teShu rogeShu| shRuNvagnivesha ! gadataH siddhiM siddhipradAM bhiShajAm||3||

Commentary: siddhAnAmiti prasiddhaphalAnAm| teShu teShviti vakShyamANavAtagadAdiShu| siddhimiti bastiniShpAdikAM, kiMvA bastyabhidhAyakagrantham||3||
ardhashlokairataH siddhAn nAnAvyAdhiShu sarvashaH | bastIn vIryasamairbhAgairyathArhAloDanA~jchRuNu||18||
bilvo~agnimanthaH shyonAkaH kAshmaryaH pATalistathA| shAlaparNI pRushniparNI bRuhatyau vardhamAnakaH||19||
yavAH kulatthAH kolAni sthirA ceti trayo~anile| shasyante sacatuHsnehAH pishitasya rasAnvitAH||20||
nalava~jjulavAnIrashatapatrANi shaivalam| ma~jjiShThA sArivA~anantA payasyA madhuyaShTikA||21||
candanaM padmakoshIraM tu~ggaM te paittike trayaH| sasharkarAkShaudraghRutAH sakShIrA bastayo hitAH||22||
arkastathaiva cAlarka ekAShThIlA punarnavA| haridrA triphalA mustaM pItadAru kuTannaTam||23||
pippalyashcitrakashceti trayaste shleShmarogiShu | sakShArakShaudragomUtrA nAtisnehAnvitA hitAH||24||
phalajImUtakekShvAkudhAmArgavakavatsakAH | shyAmA ca triphalA caiva sthirA dantI dravantyapi||25||
prakIryA codakIryA ca nIlinI kShIriNI tathA| saptalA sha~gkhinI lodhraM phalaM kampillakasya ca||26||
catvAro mUtrasiddhAste pakvAshayavishodhanAH| (vyastairapi samastaishca caturyogA udAhRutAH )||27||
kAkolI kShIrakAkolI mudgaparNI shatAvarI| vidArI madhuyaShTyAhvA shRu~ggATakakasheruke||28||
AtmaguptAphalaM mAShAH sagodhUmA yavAstathA| jalajAnUpajaM mAMsamityete shukramAMsalAH ||29||
jIvantI cAgnimanthashca dhAtakIpuShpavatsakau| pragrahaH khadiraH kuShThaM shamI piNDItako yavAH||30||
priya~ggU raktamUlI ca taruNI svarNayUthikA| vaTAdyAH kiMshukaM lodhramiti sA~ggrAhikA matAH||31||

parisrAve shRutaM kShIraM savRushcIrapunarnavam| AkhuparNikayA vA~api taNDulIyakayuktayA||32||

Commentary: taNDulIyakayuktayetyantena parisrAve dvAvuktau||32||

kAla~gkatakakANDekShudarbhapoTagalekShubhiH | dAhaghnaH saghRutakShIro dvitIyashcotpalAdibhiH||33||

Commentary: kANDekShuH bRuhadikShuH; poTagalaH hoggalaH| utpalAdibhiriti utpalAdayo nalinasaugandhikAdayo jalajAH puShpavisheShAH||33||
karbudArADhakInIpavidulaiH kShIrasAdhitaiH| bastiH pradeyo bhiShajA shItaH samadhusharkaraH||34||
parikarte tathA vRuntaiH shrIparNIkovidArajaiH| (deyo bastiH suvaidyaistu yathAvadviditakriyaiH )||35||

bastiH shAlmalivRuntAnAM kShIrasiddho ghRutAnvitaH| hitaH pravAhaNe tadvadveShTaiH shAlmalikasya ca||36||

Commentary: veShTaiH shAlmalikasya cetyantena dvitIyaH pravAhaNe||36||
baladoShakAlarogaprakRutIH pravibhajya yojitAH samyak svaiH svairauShadhavargaiH svAn svAn rogAnniyacchanti||4||
karmAnyadbastisamaM na vidyate shIghrasukhavishodhitvAt| AshvapatarpaNatarpaNayogAcca niratyayatvAcca||5||

ashvAvarohikAkAkanAsArAjakasherukaiH| siddhAH kShIre~atiyoge syuH kShaudrA~jjanaghRutairyutAH||37||

Commentary: ashvAvarohikA ashvagandhA, ashvakarNaH, ikShurako vA; jatUkarNadarshanAttu ashvAvarohakaH ashvakarNaH| nyagrodhAdyAshcatvAraH nyagrodhodumbarAshvatthaplakShAH| tenaiva vidhineti pUrvayogavidhinA| etau dvAvatiyoge||37||-
bRuhatI kShIrakAkolI pRushniparNI shatAvarI||38||
kAshmaryabadarIdUrvAstathoshIrapriya~ggavaH| jIvAdAne shRutau kShIre dvau ghRutA~jjanasaMyutau||39||
bastI pradeyau bhiShajA shItau samadhusharkarau| go~avyajAmahiShIkShIrairjIvanIyayutaistathA||40||
shashaiNadakShamArjAramahiShAvyajashoNitaiH| sadyaskairmRuditairbastirjIvAdAne prashasyate||41||
madhUkamadhukadrAkShAdUrvAkAshmaryacandanaiH| tenaiva vidhinA bastirdeyaH sakShaudrasharkaraH||42||

ma~jjiShThAsArivAnantApayasyAmadhukaistathA| sharkarAcandanadrAkShAmadhudhAtrIphalotpalaiH| raktapitte, pramehe tu kaShAyaH somavalkajaH||43||

Commentary: raktapitte iti cchedaH| etau dvau militvA sa~ggrahe paThitau ‘dvau raktapitte’ ityanena| somavalkaH viTkhadiraH||43||
gulmAtisArodAvartastambhasa~gkucitAdiShu| sarvA~ggaikA~ggarogeShu rogeShvevaMvidheShu ca||44||
yathAsvairauShadhaiH siddhAn bastIn dadyAdvicakShaNaH| pUrvoktena vidhAnena kurvan yogAn pRuthagvidhAn||45||
tatra shlokAH- trikAstrayo~anilAdInAM catuShkAshcApare trayaH| pakvAshayavishuddhyarthaM vRuShyAH sA~ggrAhikAstathA||46||
parisrAve tathA dAhe parikarte pravAhaNe| sAtiyoge matau dvau dvau jIvAdAne tathA trayaH||47||
dvau raktapitte mehe ca ekatriMshacca sapta te| sulabhAlpauShadhakleshA bastayo guNavattamAH||48||
satyapi doShaharatve kaTutIkShNoShNAdi bheShajAdAnAt| duHkhodgArotkleshAhRudyatvakoShTharujA vireke syuH||6||
avirecyau shishuvRuddhau tAvaprAptaprahInadhAtubalau| AsthApanameva tayoH sarvArthakRuduttamaM karma||7||
anuvAsanaM nirUhashcottarabastishca sa trividhaH||8||
shAkhAvAtArtAnAM saku~jcitastabdhabhagnarugNAnAm | viTsa~ggAdhmAnAruciparikartirugAdiShu ca shastaH||9||
uShNArtAnAM shItA~jchItArtAnAM tathA sukhoShNAMshca| tadyogyauShadhayuktAn bastIn santarkya viniyujyAt||10||
bastInna bRuMhaNIyAn dadyAd vyAdhiShu vishodhanIyeShu| medasvino vishodhyA ye~api narAH kuShThamehArtAH||11||
na kShINakShatadurbalamUrcchitakRushashuShkadehAnAm| yu~jjAdvishodhanIyAn doShanibaddhAyuSho ye ca||12||
vAjIkaraNe~asRukpittayoshca madhughRutapayoyuktAH| shastAH satailamUtrAranAlalavaNAshca kaphavAte||13||
yu~jjAddravyANi bastiShvamlaM mUtraM payaH surAM kvAthAn| avirodhAddhAtUnAM rasayonitvAcca jalamuShNam||14||
suradArushatAhvailAkuShThamadhukapippalImadhusnehAH| UrdhvAnulomabhAgAH sasarShapAH sharkarA lavaNam||15||
AvApA bastInAmatH prayojyAni yeShu yAni syuH| yuktAni saha kaShAyaistAnyuttarataH pravakShyAmi||16||
cirajAtakaThinabaleShu vyAdhiShu tIkShNA viparyaye mRudavaH| saprativApakaShAyA yojyAstvanuvAsananirUhAH||17||
trimarmIyAyAM bahurogapratipAdanAdbahurogahitabastipratipAdanArthaM bastisiddhirucyate| atraiva bastishabdena siddhibastayovakShyamANA abhipretAH||1-2||

pUrvaM siddhAnAM bastInAmityAdinA pratij~jAtArthAn bastInAha- ardhashlokairityAdi| vyAdhiShvityatra vyAdhishabdo doShe~api vartanIyaH| bahusha iti ekaikasmin vyAdhau doShe ca bahusha ityarthaH| vIryasamairbhAgairiti anyonyAnupahatasAmarthyairdravyabhAgaiH| vardhamAnaka eraNDaH| pishitasya rasAnvitA iti prakShiptamAMsarasAH| va~jjulaH vetasaH, vAnIraH tadbhedaH| tu~ggaH punnAgaH| alarkaH mandAraH| ekAShThIlA pAThA| kuTannaTaM kaivartamustakam, anye tagaramAhuH||18-24||
kShveDaH kRutavedhanaH| dravantI dantIbhedaH| prakIryA kara~jjaH| nIlinI nIlavuhnA, ‘nIlA~jjanikA’ ityanye||25-27||
ete shukramAMsalA ityatra ete iti catvAraH pUrvoktAH||28-29||
piNDItakaH madanaH| raktamUlI sama~ggA| taruNI ArAmataruNI, navamAlikA vA||30-31||
karbudAraH kA~jcanAraH, vidulo vetasaH| kovidArajairityantena dvitIyaH parikarte||34-35||

basteritikartavyatAM guNAMshca pratipAdanIyabastya~ggabhUtAnAha- baladoShetyAdi| atra ca balAdau yathApradhAnamiha gRuhIte sarvaparIkShAvarodho vyAkhyeyaH; “parIkShya doShauShadha ... ” (si.a.3) ityAdinokto~apyayamarthaH punaH prakaraNavashAducyate| svaiH svairauShadhavargairiti yathAvyAdhipratipAditairauShadhaiH| svAn svAniti tattadbastividheyauShadhaprashamanIyAn| AshvapataparNatarpaNayogAditi apatarpaNArthaprayukto bastiranyApatarpaNabheShajebhyaH shIghramapatarpaNaM karoti; evaM tarpaNadravyayukto~api bastiH shIghramitaratarpaNApekShayA tarpaNaM karoti||4-5||

jIvAdAne iti jIvashoNitapravRuttau| go~avyajetyAdinA jIvAdAne prashasyate ityantena jIvAdAne tRutIyo bastirucyate| ayaM ca yadyapi shlokArdhAvihito bastiH, tathA~api shlokArdhairiti pratij~jA bhUriprayogANAM shlokArdhavihitatvena j~jeyA; kiMvA atrApi go~avyajetyAdinA~ardhashlokavihita eva vyavasthitaH; pUrvArdhena tu tasyetikartavyatocyate; itikartavyatAbhidhAnaM ca shlokArdhAdatirekeNApi bhavatIti yogAntareShvapi dRuShTam||38-42||

anuktabastikalpanArthamAha- gulmAtisAretyAdi| yathAsvairauShadhairiti yathAsvavyAdhipratyanIkairbhaiShajaiH| kuryAdyogAn pRuthagvidhAniti yathoktavidhinA dravyAvApAdinA yogAn yathocitAn gulmAdikalpanIyAn bastiShu kuryAt||44-45||
trikAstraya ityAdiH sa~ggraho vyakta eva| alpauShadhakleshA iti alpauShadhA alpakleshAshca||46-48||

bastyapekShyA shodhanAntareNa doShaharaNe doShamAha- satyapItyAdi| kaTukAdibheShajairvirekadAnAdduHkhaM codgArashcotkleshashcAhRudyatvaM ca koShTharujAshcaitai sarve bhavanti; tatra duHkhaM kaTukAdinA rasenodvegAdeva bhavati; ete doShA bastau na sambhavantIti bhAvaH| virekashabdena vamanavirekAvapi grAhyau; kiMvA vamanaM bastinA samamatyantabhinnaviShayatvAdeva nodAhRutaM, virekastu pakvAshayasthe~api doShe bastiviShaye bhavatIti kRutvA virekameva prati basteH prAdhAnyamihocyate| avirekAdiviShaye basteryaugikatayA prAdhAnyamAha- avirecyAvityAdi| tAvityAdau yathAsa~gkhyaM vyAkhyeyam- aprAptadhAturaprAptabalashca bAlaH, prahINadhAtuH prahINabalashca vRuddhaH, evambhUtatvAccAvirecyAvetau| sarvArthakRuditi niratyayadoShaharaNabRuMhaNAdikRut||6-7||-
basterbhedAnAha- anuvAsanamityAdi| tadyogyauShadhayuktAniti uShNArtihareNa shItArtihareNa vA auShadhena kalpitAn||8-10||

vishodhanIyAn vyAdhInudAharati- medasvina ityAdi| vishodhyA ye~apIti bhUridoShatvena ye shodhanArhA ityarthaH| doShanibaddhAyuSha iti doShe malAdirUpe dehasthe nibaddhamAyuryeShAM shoShyatidurbalaprabhRutInAM te tathA; uktaM hi ‘shoShI mu~jcati gAtrANi purIShasraMsanAdapi| abalApekShiNIM mAtrAM kiM punaryo viricyate’ (ci.a.8) iti||11-12||

kAryavisheShApekShayA bastInAM saMskAravisheShAnAha- vAjIkaraNe ityAdi| madhuprakShepo bastau pUrvoktasAmAnyavidhAnalabdho~apyadhikamAtrayA prakShepArthamavashyaprakShepArthaM cehocyate| avirodhAddhAtUnAmiti pUrveNa sambadhyate, tena yasmin saMskAre amlAdiShu madhye yaddhAtuvirodhi na bhavati taddeyaM, yattu dhAtuvirodhi bhavati na taddeyaM; vyAdhitaprakRutyaviruddhaM yad yasya bhavati tat tasya deyamityarthaH| rasayonitvAcca jalamuShNamiti jalaM yasmAdrasayoniH, tena taduShNaM sat sarvabastigatarasasya poShaNArthaM sarvabastiShu deyam; etacca jalaM bastiShu sAkShAt prakShepAdarshanAt kalkAdipeShaNe viniyojyaM; kiMvA atra tadvacanaprAmANyAdeva j~jeyaM; kiMvA jalashabdo~ayaM dravopalakShaNaH, tenAmlAdidravadAnasyaiveyamupapattiH| rasayonitvaM dravasambandhAdevAmlAdInAmupapannam| anye tu jalamuShNaM pratiniyatameva, cUrNabastAvevecchanti, cUrNabastishca yaH kevaladravena dIyate; tantrAntare~apyuktaM yathA “rAsnAvacAbilvashatAhvayailApUtIkakRuShNAphaladArukuShThaiH| sasaindhavAmloShNajalaH satailaH shUlaghna iShTaH khalu cUrNabastiH” iti||13-14||

suradArvityAdinA bastiShu doShAdyapekShayA vyastasamastavidhayA prakShepyAnAha| AvApA bastInAmiti bastiShvAvApyA ityarthaH| yAnIti kaShAyayuktAni| cirajAtakaThinabaleShu tIkShNA iti atroktatIkShNadravyayogena tIkShNAH| viparyaye ceti acirajAte akaThinabale ca| anuvAsananirUhA iti anuvAsane kaShAyayogaH snehasAdhanArthameva, AvApastvanuvAsane~api shatAhvAdInAM kartavya eva; yaduktamanyatra- “pippalIM madanaM kuShThaM shatAhvAM madhukaM vacAm| yojayenmAtrayA piShTvA AvApamanuvAsane” iti||15-17||
athAtaH phalamAtrAsiddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
bhagavantamudArasattvadhIshrutivij~jAnasamRuddhamatrijam| phalabastivaratvanishcaye savivAdA munayo~abhyupAgaman||3||
bhRugukaushikakApyashaunakAH sapulastyAsitagautamAdayaH| katamat pravaraM phalAdiShu smRutamAsthApanayojanAsviti||4||
kaphapittaharaM varaM phaleShvatha jImUtakamAha shaunakaH| mRuduvIryatayA~abhinatti tacchakRudityAha nRupo~atha vAmakaH||5||
kaTutumbamamanyatottamaM vamane doShasamIraNaM ca tat| tadavRuShyamashaityatIkShNatAkaTuraukShyAditi gautamo~abravIt ||6||
kaphapittanibarhaNaM paraM sa ca dhAmArgavamityamanyata | tadamanyata vAtalaM punarbaDisho glAnikaraM balApaham||7||
kuTajaM prashashaMsa cottamaM na balaghnaM kaphapittahAri ca| ativijjalamaurdhvabhAgikaM pavanakShobhi ca kApya Aha tat||8||
kRutavedhanamAha vAtalaM kaphapittaM prabalaM harediti| tadasAdhviti bhadrashaunakaH kaTukaM cAtibalaghnamityapi||9||
iti tadvacanAni hetubhiH suvicitrANi nishamya buddhimAn | prashashaMsa phaleShu nishcayaM paramaM cAtrisuto~abravIdidam||10||
phaladoShaguNAn sarasvatI prati sarvairapi samyagIritA| na tu ki~jcidadoShanirguNaM guNabhUyastvamato vicintyate ||11||
iha kuShThahitA garAgarI hitamikShvAku tu mehine matam| kuTajasya phalaM hRudAmaye pravaraM koThaphalaM ca pANDuShu||12||
udare kRutavedhanaM hitaM, madanaM sarvagadAvirodhi tu| madhuraM sakaShAyatiktakaM tadarUkShaM sakaTUShNavijjalam||13||
kaphapittahRudAshukAri cApyanapAyaM pavanAnulomi ca| phalanAma visheShatastvato labhate~anyeShu phaleShu satsvapi||14||
guruNeti vacasyudAhRute munisa~gghena ca pUjite tataH | praNipatya mudA samanvitaH sahitaH shiShyagaNo~anupRuShTavAn||15||
sarvakarmaguNakRudguruNokto bastirUrdhvamatha naiti nAbhitaH| nAbhyadho gudamataH sa sharIrAt sarvataH kathamapohati doShAn ||16||
tadgururabravIdidaM sharIraM tantrayate~anilaH sa~ggavighAtAt | kevala eva doShasahito vA svAshayagaH prakopamupayAti||17||
taM pavanaM sapittakaphaviTkaM shuddhikaro~anulomayati bastiH| sarvasharIragashca gadasa~gghastatprashamAt prashAntimupayAti||18||
athAdhigamyArthamakhaNDitaM dhiyA gajoShTragoshvAvyajakarma roganut| apRucchadenaM sa ca bastimabravIdvidhiM ca tasyAha punaH pracoditaH||19||
AjoraNau saumya gajoShTrayoH kRute gavAshvayorbastimushanti mAhiSham| ajAvikAnAM tu jaradgavodbhavaM vadanti bastiM tadupAyacintakAH||20||
aratnimaShTAdashaShoDashA~ggulaM tathaiva netraM hi dashA~ggulaM kramAt| gajoShTragoshvAvyajabastisandhau caturthabhAgopanayaM hitaM vadet ||21||
prasthastvajAvyorhi nirUhamAtrA gavAdiShu dvitriguNaM yathAbalam| nirUhamuShTrasya tathA~a~aDhakadvayaM gajasya vRuddhistvanuvAsane~aShTamaH||22||
kali~ggakuShThe madhukaM ca pippalI vacA shatAhvA madanaM rasA~jjanam| hitAni sarveShu guDaH sasaindhavo dvipa~jcamUlaM ca vikalpanA tviyam||23||
gaje~adhikA~ashvatthavaTAshvakarNakAH sakhAdirapragrahashAlatAlajAH| tathA ca parNyau dhavashigrupATalI madhUkasArAH sanikumbhacitrakAH||24||
palAshabhUtIkasurAhvarohiNIkaShAya uktastvadhiko gavAM hitaH| palAshadantIsuradArukattRuNadravantya uktAsturagasya cAdhikAH||25||
kharoShTrayoH pIlukarIrakhAdirAH shamyAkabilvAdigaNasya ca cchadAH| ajAvikAnAM triphalAparUShakaM kapitthakarkandhu sabilvakolajam||26||

athAgniveshaH satatAturAn narAn hitaM ca papraccha gurustadAha ca| sadA~a~aturAH shrotriyarAjasevakAstathaiva veshyA saha paNyajIvibhiH||27||

Commentary: atha bastiviShayAn sadAturAn darshayannAha- athAgnivesha ityAdi| hitaM ceti sadAturANAM hitam| paNyajIvinaH vaNijaH||27||
dvijo hi vedAdhyayanavratAhnikakriyAdibhirdehahitaM na ceShTate | nRupopasevI nRupacittarakShaNAt parAnurodhAdbahucintanAdbhayAt ||28||
nRucittavartinyupacAratatparA mRujAbhi(vi)bhUShAniratA paNA~gganA| sadAsanAdatyanubandhavikrayakrayAdilobhAdapi paNyajIvinaH||29||
sadaiva te hyAgataveganigrahaM samAcarante na ca kAlabhojanam| akAlanirhAravihArasevino bhavanti ye~anye~api sadA~a~aturAshca te||30||
samIraNaM vegavidhAraNoddhataM vibandhasarvA~ggarujAkaraM bhiShak| samIkShya teShAM phalavartimAditaH sukalpitAM snehavatIM prayojayet||31||
punarnavairaNDanikumbhacitrakAn sadevadArutrivRutAnidigdhikAn| mahAnti mUlAni ca pa~jca yAni vipAcya mUtre dadhimastusaMyute||32||
satailasarpirlavaNaishca pa~jcabhirvimUrcchitaM bastimatha prayojayet| nirUhitaM dhanvarasena bhojitaM nikumbhatailena tato~anuvAsayet||33||
balAM sarAsnAM phalabilvacitrakAn dvipa~jcamUlaM kRutamAlakAt phalam| yavAn kulatthAMshca pacejjalADhake rasaH sa peShyaistu kali~ggakAdibhiH||34||
satailasarpirguDasaindhavo hitaH sadAturANAM balavarNavardhanaH| tathA~anuvAsye madhukena sAdhitaM phalena bilvena shatAhvayA~api vA||35||
sajIvanIyastu raso~anuvAsane nirUhaNe cAlavaNaH shishorhitaH| na cAnyadAshva~ggabalAbhivardhanaM nirUhabasteH shishuvRuddhayoH param||36||

tatra shlokaH- phalakarma bastivaratA netraM yadbastayo gavAdInAm| satatAturAshca diShTAH phalamAtrAyAM hitaM caiShAm||37||

Commentary: phalakarmetyAdisa~ggraho vyaktaH||37||

pUrvasiddhiShu phalAnyAcAryeNa prayogeShu vihitAni, tena teShAM phalAnAM guNAvadhAraNArthaM tathA~anuktagajAdibastimAnopadarshanArthaM ca phalamAtrAsiddhirucyate| gajAdibastividhAnakathanaM yadyapyaprastutaM, tathA~api gajAdiShvapi yaugikatayA bastereva pratipAdyate mAtrA~atra ; tena phalAdInAM tathA gajAdibastimAtrAyAshca pratipAdikA siddhiH phalamAtrAsiddhiH||1-2||

phalAdInAM bastiyogeShu guNAn pratipAdayituM pUrvavRuttamitihAsamAha- bhagavantamityAdi| itihAsashca saMhitAdharmatayA granthe pUjyatopadarshanArthaM ca kriyata eva| phalAdInAM bastau varatvaM phalabastivaratvaM, tasya nishcaye avadhAraNe| phalAdiShviti madanajImUtakAdiShu| kalpe jImUtake yadyapi pittadoShaharatvamuktaM, tathA~apIha vacanAt kaphapittaharatvamasya prAdhAnyAdunnIyate| mRuduvIryatayA~abhinattIti nAtyarthaM bhinatti| doShasamIraNamiti bastinA doShahArakam| kRutavedhanamityAdau Ashu kaphapittaM harediti yojyam| iharShivivAdakathanena jImUtakAdInAM guNadoShAshca kathitA bhavantIti tAtparyaM j~jeyam| prashashaMsetyAdi| phaleShu jImUtakAdiShu| phaladoShaguNAn pratIti lakShyIkRutya| sarasvatIti vAk| adoShanirguNamiti doShavadeva guNavadeva vA na ki~jcidityarthaH| tena satyapi stokadoShasambandhe yadguNabhUyiShThaM tadiha rogaprashamaprayogeShu sArvayaugikam| sarvagadAvirodhIti padena madanasya sArvayaugikatvaM brUte| AshukArIti AshudoShanirharaNakAri| ato labhata iti phaleShu prakarShatvAdeva madanaphalaM phalamityucyate, na jImUtakAdiphalam||3-14||

sarvakarmaguNakRuditi sarvakarmaNAM vamanAdInAM guNaM doShaharaNAdikaM karotIti sarvakarmaguNakRut; kiMvA sarvakarmANi la~gghanabRuMhaNAdIni, guNAMshca balAgnyAdIn karoti| nAbhyadho gudamiti vrajati| tantrayate dhArayate| vighAtAditi prakopakahetunA~asambandhAt(?)| svAshayagaH svAshaya eva prAyaH prakopaM vrajati; yastu pradeshAntare vAtaprakopaH sa tanmUla eveti bhAvaH| tatprashamAt prashAntimupayAti pakvAshayasthavAtamUlaprashamAdbastinA| kRutAttanmUlAnubandhAH sheShasthAnagatavikArAH prashAmyanti| etacca ‘vanaspatimUlacchedavat’ ityAdidRuShTAntena prAk pratipAditameva| etena bastinA mUlavijayAddeshAntargatatanmUlavikArajayo yaH kriyate sa uktaH| yattu bastervIryamApAdamastakaM prasarati tacca vIryaM sarvavikArAn hantIti prAguktameva j~jeyam| iha tu, vIryamapihitaM kRutvaiva shiShyaprashnAnuguNamevottaraM dattamiti j~jeyam||15-18||

athAbhigamyetyAdau gajAdInAM karmApRucchaditi yojyam| roganuditi karmavisheShaNaM, tena karma roganuditi rogaharaNe shreShThaM cikitsitamityarthaH| bastimabravIditi gajAdInAM rogaharaNe shreShThaM bastimevAbravIt; tadanantaraM tasya bastervidhiH punaH shiShyeNa pRuShTa AjoraNetyAdinA prAheti yojanA| uraNaH meShaH| bastimiti puTakam| jaradgavaH vRuddhavRuShaH| tadupAyacintakA iti gajAdibastisAdhane dattacittakAH| aratniH hastaH| kramAditi yathAkramaM gajAdiShu aratnyAdi netrapramANam| caturthabhAgopanayamiti netracaturthabhAgapraveshakam| gavAdiShviti goprakAreShu; gomahiShAshvAnAM grahaNAdbahuvacanaM sAdhu| gajasya tu vRuddhiriti dvyADhakadvyaiguNyena droNa ityarthaH| anuvAsane~aShTamamiti yathoktAjAdinirUhamAnAdajAdInAmanuvAsane~aShTamaH snehabhAgo deyaH||19-22||
vikalpanA tviyamiti visheShakalpanA gaje~adhikA vakShyamANA| tAlajaM tAlaphalam| tathaivetyAdinA gavAM hitamucyate||23-26||

yathoktAnAM sadAturatve hetumAha- dvijo hItyAdi| dehahitaM na ceShTate iti paNyajIvina ityantaM yAvadanuvartanIyam| parAnurodhAditi nRupAnujIvipuruShAntarAnurodhAt| upacAratatpareti puruShopacAratatparA| mRujA sharIramArjanam| paNA~gganA veshyetyarthaH| atyanubandhavikrayakrayAdilobhAditi nirantarAnubaddhakrayavikrayAderlobhAt| anyAnapi sadAturAnAha- akAletyAdi| nirhAraH malAdinirgamaH||28-30||

punarnavetyAdirnirUhaH nikumbhA dantI| mahAnti mUlAni pa~jceti bilvAdipa~jcamUlAni| nikumbhataileneti nikumbhakvAthakalkasiddhena tailena| balAmityAdau kali~ggakAdibhiriti “kali~ggakuShThamadhukabilva.” ityAdinehoktaiH| phalena bilvena shatAhvayA~api veti tailatrayamAnuvAsanikam| sajIvanIyastu raso~anuvAsana iti jIvanIyakaShAyasAdhitaH sneho~anuvAsane kartavyaH| tathA nirUhaNe jIvanIyaraso~alavaNaH shishoH kartavyaH| anuvAsanamapi jIvanIyasAdhitaM shishoreva| na cAnyadityAdinA bAlavRuddhayaugikatvaM basterAha| paramiti shreShTham||31-36||
athAta uttarabastisiddhiM vyAkhyAsyAmaH||1||
atha svalvAturaM vaidyaH saMshuddhaM vamanAdibhiH| durbalaM kRushamalpAgniM muktasandhAnabandhanam||3||
nirhRutAnilaviNmUtrakaphapittaM kRushAshayam| shUnyadehaM pratIkArAsahiShNuM paripAlayet||4||
yathA~aNDaM taruNaM pUrNaM tailapAtraM yathaiva ca| gopAla iva daNDI gAH sarvasmAdapacAratH||5||

yApanAshca bastayaH sarvakAlaM deyAH; tAnupadekShyAmaH- mustoshIrabalAragvadharAsnAma~jjiShThAkaTurohiNItrAyamANApunarnavAbibhItakaguDUcIsthirAdipa~jcamUlAni palikAni khaNDashaH klRuptAnyaShTau ca madanaphalAni prakShAlya jalADhake parikvAthya pAdasheSho rasaH kShIradviprasthasaMyuktaH punaH shRutaH kShIrAvasheShaH pAdajA~ggalarasastulyamadhughRutaH shatakusumAmadhukakuTajaphalarasA~jjanapriya~ggukalkIkRutaH sasaindhavaH sukhoShNo bastiH shukramAMsabalajananaH kShatakShINakAsagulmashUlaviShamajvarabradhna(vardhma)- kuNDalodAvartakukShishUlamUtrakRucchrAsRugrajovisarpapravAhikAshirorujA- jAnUruja~gghAbastigrahAshmaryunmAdArshaHpramehAdhmAnavAtaraktapittashleShmavyAdhiharaH sadyo balajanano rasAyanashceti (1)| eraNDamUlapalAshAt ShaTpalaM shAliparNIpRushniparNI bRuhatI kaNTakArikA gokShurako rAsnA~ashvagandhA guDUcI varShAbhUrAragvadho devadArviti palikAni khaNDashaH klRuptAni phalAni cAShTau prakShAlya jalADhake kShIrapAde pacet| pAdasheShaM kaShAyaM pUtaM shatakusumAkuShThamustapippalIhapuShAbilvavacAvatsakaphalarasA~jjanapriya~gguyavAniprakShepakalkitaM madhughRutatailasaindhavayuktaM sukhoShNaM nirUhamekaM dvau trIn vA dadyAt| sarveShAM prashasto visheShato lalitasukumArastrIvihArakShINakShatasthaviracirArshasAmapatyakAmAnAM ca (2)| tadvat sahacarabalAdarbhamUlasArivAsiddhena payasA (3)| tathA bRuhatIkaNTakArIshatAvarIcchinnaruhAshRutena payasA madhukamadanapippalIkalkitena pUrvavadvastiH (4)| tathA balAtibalAvidArIshAliparNIpRushniparNIbRuhatIkaNTakArikAdarbhamUlaparUShakakAshmaryabilvaphalayavasiddhena payasA madhukamadanakalkitena madhughRutasauvarcalayuktena kAsajvaragulmaplIhArditastrImadyakliShTAnAM sadyobalajanano rasAyanashca (5)| balAtibalArAsnAragvadhamadanabilvaguDUcIpunarnavairaNDAshvagandhAsahacarapalAshadevadArudvipa~jcamUlAni palikAni yavakolakulatthadviprasRutaM shuShkamUlakAnAM ca jaladroNasiddhaM nirUhapramANAvasheShaM kaShAyaM pUtaM madhukamadanashatapuShpAkuShThapippalIvacAvatsakaphalarasA~jjanapriya~gguyavAnIkalkikRutaM guDaghRutatailakShaudrakShIramAMsarasAmlakA~jjikasaindhavayuktaM sukhoShNaM bastiM dadyAcchukramUtravarcaHsa~gge~anilaje gulmahRudrogAdhmAnabradhnapArshvapRuShThakaTIgrahasa~jj~jAnAshabalakShayeShu ca (6)| hapuShArdhakuDavo dviguNArdhakShuNNayavaH kShIrodakasiddhaH kShIrasheSho madhughRutatailalavaNayuktaH sarvA~ggavisRutavAtaraktasaktaviNmUtrastrIkheditahito vAtaharo buddhimedhAgnibalajananashca (7)| hrasvapa~jcamUlIkaShAyaH kShIrodakasiddhaH pippalImadhukamadanakalkIkRutaH saguDaghRutatailalavaNaH kShINaviShamajvarakarshitasya bastiH (8)| balAtibalApAmArgAtmaguptAShTapalArdhakShuNNayavA~jjalikaShAyaH saguDaghRutatailalavaNayuktaH pUrvavadbastiHsthaviradurbalakShINashukrarudhirANAM pathyatamaH (9)| balAmadhukavidArIdarbhamUlamRudvIkAyavaiH kaShAyamAjena payasA paktvA madhukamadanakalkitaM samadhughRutasaindhavaM jvarArtebhyo bastiM dadyAt (10)| shAliparNIpRushniparNIgokShurakamUlakAshmaryaparUShakakharjUraphalamadhUkapuShpairajAkShIrajalaprasthAbhyAM siddhaH kaShAyaH pippalImadhukotpalakalkitaH saghRutasaindhavaH kShINendriyaviShamajvarakarshitasya bastiH shastaH (11)| sthirAdipa~jcamUlIpa~jcapalena shAliShaShTikayavagodhUmamAShapa~jcaprasRutena chAgaM payaH shRutaM pAdasheShaM kukkuTANDarasasamamadhughRutasharkarAsaindhavasauvarcalayukto vastirvRuShyatamo balavarNajananashca | iti yApanA bastayo dvAdasha||16||
kalpashcaiSha shikhigonardahaMsasArasANDaraseShu syAt||17||
agnisandhukShaNArthaM tu pUrvaM peyAdinA bhiShak| rasottareNopacaret krameNa kramakovidaH||6||
snigdhAmlasvAduhRudyAni tato~amlalavaNau rasau| svAdutiktau tato bhUyaH kaShAyakaTukau tataH||7||
anyo~anyapratyanIkAnAM rasAnAM snigdharUkShayoH| vyatyAsAdupayogena prakRutiM gamayedbhiShak||8||

satittiriH samayUraH sarAjahaMsaH pa~jcamUlIpayaH siddhaH shatapuShpAmadhukarAsnAkuTajamadanaphalapippalI kalko ghRutatailaguDasaindhavayukto bastirbalavarNashukrajanano rasAyanashca (1)| dvipa~jcamUlIkukkuTarasasiddhaM payaH pAdasheShaM pippalImadhukarAsnAmadanakalkaM sharkarAmadhughRutayuktaM strIShvatikAmAnAM balajanano bastiH (2)| mayUramapittapakShapAdAsyAntraM sthirAdibhiH palikaiH sajale payasi paktvA kShIrasheShaM madanapippalIvidArIshatakusumAmadhukakalkIkRutaM madhughRutasaindhavayuktaM bastiM dadyAt strIShvatiprasaktakShINendriyebhyo balavarNakaram (3)| kalpashcaiSha viShkirapratudaprasahAmbucareShu syAt, akShIro rohitAdiShu ca matsyeShu (4)| godhAnakulamArjAramUShikashallakamAMsAnAM dashapalAn bhAgAn sapa~jcamUlAn payasi paktvA tatpayaHpippalIphalakalkasaindhavasauvarcalasharkarAmadhughRutatailayukto bastirbalyo rasAyanaH kShINakShatasya sandhAnakaro mathitoraskarathagajahayabhagnavAtabalAsakaprabhRutyudAvartavAtasaktamUtravarcashshukANAM hitatamashca (5)| kUrmAdInAmanyatamapishitasiddhaM payo govRuShanAgahayanakrahaMsakukkuTANDarasamadhughRutasharkarAsaindhavekShurakAtmaguptAphalakalkasaMsRuShTo bastirvRuddhAnAmapi balajananaH (6)| karkaTakarasashcaTakANDarasayuktaH samadhughRutasharkaro bastiH; ityete bastayaH paramavRuShyAH uccaTakekShurakAtmaguptAshRutakShIrapratibhojanAnupAnAt strIshatagAminaM naraM kuryuH (7)| govRuShabastavarAhavRuShaNakarkaTacaTakasiddhaM kShIramuccaTakekShurakAtmaguptAmadhughRutasaindhavayuktaH ki~jcillavaNito bastiH (8)| dashamUlamayUrahaMsakukkuTakvAthAt pa~jcaprasRutaM tailaghRutavasAmajjacatuShprasRutayuktaM shatapuShpAmustahapuShAkalkIkRutaH salavaNo bastiH pAdagulphorujAnuja~gghAtrikava~gkShaNabastivRuShaNAnilarogaharaH (9)| mRugaviShkirAnUpabileshayAnAmetenaiva kalpena bastayo deyAH (10)| madhughRutadviprasRutastulyoShNodakaH shatapuShpArdhapalaH saindhavArdhAkShayukto bastirvRuShyatamo mUtrakRucchrapittavAtaharaH (11)| sadyoghRutatailavasAmajjacatuShprasthaM hapuShArdhapalaM saindhavArdhAkShayukto bastirvRuShyatamo mUtrakRucchrapittavyAdhiharo rasAyanaH (12)| madhutailaM catuHprasRutaM shatapuShpArdhapalaM saindhavArdhAkShayukto bastirdIpano bRuMhaNo balavarNakaro nirupadravo vRuShyatamo rasAyanaH krimikuShThodAvartagulmArshobradhnaplIhamehaharaH (13)| tadvanmadhughRutAbhyAM payastulyo bastiH pUrvakalkena balavarNakaro vRuShyatamo nirupadravo bastimeDhrapAkaparikartikAmUtrakRucchrapittavyAdhiharo rasAyanashca (14)| tadvanmadhughRutAbhyAM mAMsarasatulyo mustAkShayuktaH pUrvavadbastirvAtabalAsapAdaharShagulmatrikorujAnUruniku~jcanabastivRuShaNameDhratrikapRuShThashUlaharaH (15)| surAsauvIrakakulatthamAMsarasamadhughRutatailasaptaprasRuto mustashatAhvAkalkitaH salavaNo bastiH sarvavAtarogaharaH (16)| dvipa~jcamUlatriphalAbilvamadanaphalakaShAyo gomUtrasiddhaH kuTajamadanaphalamustapAThAkalkitaH saindhavayAvashUkakShaudratailayukto bastiH shleShmavyAdhibastyATopavAtashukrasa~ggapANDurogAjIrNavisUcikAlasakeShu deya iti||18||

Commentary: satittirirityAdika ekaikayogena vakShyamANAnAmekonatriMshatAM bastInAM madhye trayodashaH| dvipa~jcamUlItyAdikashcaturdashaH| mayUramapittapakShetyAdikaH pa~jcadashaH| kalpashcaiSha ityAdinA~a~atideshikaM pa~jcadashAdhikaM shatamAha| tatra viShkiraiH “lAvo vartIrakashcaiva” ityAdinoktaistathA “vartako vartikA” (sU.a.27) ityAdinoktairviMshatiryogA bhavanti; mayurashcAtra viShkirapaThito~api pUrvoktatvAnneha gaNyate; pratudaishca ‘shatapatra...’ (sU.a.27) ityAdinoktaistriMshadbhavanti; tathA prasahaishca ‘gokharAshvatara...’ (sU.a.27) ityAdinoktairekonatriMshat; ambucarAshca haMsAdayaH saptaviMshatiruktAH, etaiH saptaviMshatirbhavanti; rohitAdibhirmatsyairnava; evaM pa~jcadashottaraM shataM bhavati| akShIra iti rohitAdiShu sambadhyate| godhAnakuletyAdibhiH pratyekaM gaNanIyeShu ShoDashaH| kUrmAdInAmanyatametyAdikaH saptadashaH| atra kUrmakarkaTAdaya ekAdasha paThitAH| tatra yaH prAyaH kUrmeNa kriyate sa pratyekaM gaNanAyAM pravishati| karkaTAdibhistvAdigrahaNagRuhItairye dasha bastayo bhavanti te atideshikA j~jeyAH| govRuShabastAdiraShTAdashaH| govRuShaH puMvRuShaH| karkaTAdirekonaviMshatitamaH| ityete bastaya ityanena kUrmAdInAmanyatamamityAdigranthoktA bastayaH pratyavamRushyante| uccaTaketyAdi uccaTA svanAmakhyAtA, ikShurakaH kokilAkShaH| dashamUlItyAdiko viMshatitamaH| mRugaviShkiretyAdinA AtideshikA UnaShaShTiryogAH| tatra mRugaiH ‘pRuShataH sharabho rAmaH’ (sU.a.27) ityAdinoktaiH saptadasha, saptadashabhirviShkiraishca saptadasha, lAvAdibhishca mayUrakukkuTavarjitairunaviMshatyA UnaviMshatiH, AnUpaishca sRumarAdibhirnava, bileshayaiH shvetashyAmacaturdaMShTrAdibhishcaturdasha| madhughRutetyAdika ekaviMshatitamaH| sadyoghRutatailetyAdiko dvAviMshatitamaH| madhutailamityAdikastrayoviMshatitamaH| tadvanmadhughRutAbhyAmityAdikashcaturviMshatitamaH| etadantAH ShaT prayogA uktA madhutailapradhAnatvAnmAdhutailikA j~jeyAH| dvipa~jcamUlItyAdikaM kecinna paThanti, sa ca sa~gkhyAtirekAdbastisUtrIyasiddhipaThitatvAcceha na paThanIya iti ca vadanti||18||

sahacarapalashatamudakadroNacatuShTye paktvA droNasheShe rase supUte vidArIkShurasaprasthAbhyAmaShTaguNakShIraM ghRutatailaprasthaM balAmadhukamadhUkacandanamadhUlikAsArivAmedAmahAmedAkAkolikShIrakAkolIpayasyAguruma~jjiShThAvyAghranakha- shaTIsahacarasahasravIryAvarA~ggalodhrANAmakShamAtrairdviguNasharkaraiH kalkaiH sAdhayet| bahmaghoShAdinA vidhinA siddhaM bastiM dadyAt| eSha sarvarogaharo rasAyano lalitAnAM shreShTho~antaHpuracAriNInAM kShatakShayavAtapittavedanAshvAsakAsaharastribhAgamAkShiko valIpalitanudvarNarUpabalamAMsashukravardhanaH (3)| ityete rasAyanAH snehabastayaH sati vibhave shatapAkAH sahasrapAkA vA kAryA vIryabalAdhAnArthamiti||19||

Commentary: snehabastitrayArthaM snehatrayaM darshayannAha- ata UrdhvamityAdi| mattAkShaH kokilaH| jIva~jjIvaH viShadarshanamRutyuH| puShkarAkShaH haMsavisheShaH| brahmaghoShaH vedadhvaniH| ete ca brahmaghoShAdayo~adRuShTadvArA upakArakA rakShaHprabhRutivIryApaharaNArthaM kriyante||19(1)|| baletyAdikaM dvitIyaM tailam||19(2)|| sahacarapalashatamityAdikaH snehastRutIyaH| sahasravIryA dUrvA| varA~ggaM guDatvak| shatapAkAH sahasrapAkAshcetyatra snehApekShayA shataguNena sahasraguNena vA draveNa ekadaiva pAkaM manyante kecit||19||
bhavanti cAtra- ityete bastayaH snehAshcoktA yApanasa~jj~jitAH| svasthAnAmAturANAM ca vRuddhAnAM cAvirodhinAH||20||
ativyavAyashIlAnAM shukramAMsabalapradAH| sarvarogaprashamanAH sarveShvRutuShu yaugikAH||21||
nArINAmaprajAtAnAM narANAM cApyapatyadAH| ubhayArthakarA dRuShTAH snehabastinirUhayoH||22||

vyAyAmo maithunaM madyaM madhUni shishirAmbu ca| sambhojanaM rathakShobho bastiShveteShu garhitam||23||

Commentary: yApanabastiShu varjanIyamAha- vyAyAma ityAdi||23||

sarvakShamo hyasaMsargo ratiyuktaH sthirendriyaH| balavAn sattvasampanno vij~jeyaH prakRutiM gataH||9||

Commentary: peyAdikramarasAbhyAsAbhyAmupapAditasvAsthyasya puMso lakShaNamAha- sarvakShama ityAdi| sarvakShama iti sarvarasAbhyAsakShamaH| asaMsarga iti asaktavegaH; kiMvA ‘nirAsa~gga’ iti pAThaH, nirAsa~ggaH pratiniyataviShayAparAhataH sarvaceShTAkShamaH||9||
tatra shlokAH - shikhigonardahaMsANDairdakShavadbastayastrayaH| viMshatirviShkiraistriMshatpratudaiH prasahairnava||24||
viMshatishca tathA saptaviMshatishcAmbucAribhiH| nava matsyAdibhishcaiva shikhikalpena bastayaH||25||
dasha karkaTakAdyaishca kUrmakalkena bastayaH| mRugaiH saptadashaikonaviMshatirviShkirairdasha ||26||
AnUpairdakShashikhivadbhUshayaishca caturdasha| ekonatriMshadityete saha snehaiH samAsataH||27||
proktA vistarasho bhinnA dve shate ShoDashottare| ete mAkShikasaMyuktAH kurvantyativRuShaM naram||28||

mRudutvAnna nivartante yasya tvete prayojitAH||29||

Commentary: yApanAbastyapravRuttau kartavyamAha- mRudutvAdityAdi||29||-

shophAgninAshapANDutvashUlArshaHparikartikAH||30||

Commentary: yApanAbastyatiprayoge doShamAha- shophetyAdi||30||-
ariShTakShIrasIdhvAdyA tatreShTA dIpanI kriyA||31||
yuktyA tasmAnniSheveta yApanAnna prasa~ggataH| ityuccairbhAShyapUrvANAM vyApadaH sacikitsitAH||32||

karmaNAM vamanAdinAmasamyakkaraNApadAm||33||

Commentary: samprati siddhisthAnashabdasya niruktiM darshayan siddhisthAnAbhidheyaM vAkyArthaM sa~ggRuhNannAha- karmaNAmityAdi| asamyakkaraNApadAmiti vamanAdInAmasamyakprayoge janitAnAmApadAM; vamanAdivyApatpratikArashca siddhisthAnArthaH pradhAnatayopadarshitaH; tena vamanAdikalpanAdyabhidhAnamapi anAgatavamanAdivyApanniShedhaprayojanakaM siddhisthAne yuktameva||33||-

ityadhyAyashataM viMshamAtreyamunivA~gmayam||34||

Commentary: siddhisthAnaM samApya kRutsnaM tantramupasaMharati- ityadhyAyetyAdi| AtreyamunivA~gmayamiti anukRutAtreyavacanabhayam||34||-

dIrghamAyuryashaH svAsthyaM trivargaM cApi puShkalam||35||

Commentary: etattantrAdhyayane phalamAha- dIrghamAyurityAdi| trivargamiti dharmArthakAmAn| puShkalamiti mokShaM; kiMvA puShkalamiti trivargavisheShaNam| siddhimiti cikitsAprayogasAdhyaniShpAdakatvam| vidhinA paThanniti rogabhiShagjitIyoktena pAThavidhinA| etatsaviMshamadhyAyashataM paThataH dIrghAyurlAbhAdayashca evambhUtapAThajanitadharmavashAdeva tathA pAThajanitashAstrAvabodhapUrvakashAstrAnuShThAnAcca bhavanti||35||-
vistArayati leshoktaM sa~gkShipatyativistaram||36||
saMskartA kurute tantraM purANaM ca punarnavam| atastantrottamamidaM carakeNAtibuddhinA||37||
saMskRutaM tattvasampUrNaM tribhAgenopalakShyate| taccha~gkaraM bhUtapatiM samprasAdya samApayat||38||
akhaNDArthaM dRuDhabalo jAtaH pa~jcanade pure| kRutvA bahubhyastantrebhyo visheSho~jchashiloccayam||39||
saptadashauShadhAdhyAyasiddhikalpairapUrayat| idamanyUnashabdArthaM tantradoShavivarjitam||40||
tatrAdhikaraNaM yogo hetvartho~arthaH padasya ca||41||
pradeshoddeshanirdeshavAkyasheShAH prayojanam| upadeshApadeshAtideshArthApattinirNayAH||42||
prasa~ggaikAntanaikAntAH sApavargo viparyayaH| pUrvapakShavidhAnAnumatavyAkhyAnasaMshayAH||43||
atItAnAgatAvekShAsvasa~jj~johyasamuccayAH| nidarshanaM nirvacanaM sanniyogo vikalpanam||44||

tantre samAsavyAsokte bhavantyetA hi kRutsnashaH||45||

Commentary: samprati tantrayuktIruddishya tAsAM tantre evAnusaraNamAha- tantre samAsavyAsokte ityAdi| samAsAbhihite ityanena atisa~gkShipte tantre nAvashyaM sarvAstantrayuktayo bhavantIti darshayati, kiMvA samAsAbhihite ekadeshena dRushyante iti sambandhaH||45||-

yathA~ambujavanasyArkaH pradIpo veshmano yathA||46||

Commentary: tantrayuktInAM kAryaM dRuShTAntena darshayannAha- yathetyAdi| yathA~ambujavanasya sa~gkucitasya vistArako~arkastathA tantre sa~gkucitasyArthapradeshasya vistArakAstantrayuktayaH; pravodhanAdvistArakA bhavantItyarkadRuShTAntena darshayati; dIpadRuShTAntena tu yathA dIpaH santameva tamasA pihitaM prakAshayati tathA hetvAdikAstantrayuktayaH santamarthaM gUDhaM prakAshayantIti darshayati| etadevArthadvayaM tantrayuktInAM sampAdyamabhipretyoktaM prabodhanaprakAshArthA iti||46||-
ekasminnapi yasyeha shAstre labdhAspadA matiH||47||
sa shAstramanyadapyAshu yuktij~jatvAt prabudhyate| adhIyAno~api shAstrANi tantrayuktyA vinA bhiShak| nAdhigacchati shAstrArthAnarthAn bhAgyakShaye yathA||48||
durgRuhItaM kShiNotyeva shAstraM shastramivAbudham| sugRuhItaM tadeva j~jaM shAstraM shastraM ca rakShati||49||
(tasmAdetAH pravakShyante vistareNottare punaH| tattvaj~jAnArthamasyaiva tantrasya guNadoShataH)||50||
etAM prakRutimaprAptaH sarvavarjyAni varjayet| mahAdoShakarANyaShTAvimAni tu visheShataH||10||
uccairbhAShyaM rathakShobhamavica~gkramaNAsane| ajIrNAhitabhojye ca divAsvapnaM samaithunam||11||
tajjA dehordhvasarvAdhomadhyapIDAmadoShajAH| shleShmajAH kShayajAshcaiva vyAdhyaH syuryathAkramam||12||
teShAM vistarato li~ggamekaikasya ca bheShajam| yathAvatsampravakShyAmi siddhAn bastIMshca yApanAn||13||

tatroccairbhAShyAtibhAShyAbhyAM shirastApasha~gkhakarNanistodashrotroparodhamukhatAlukaNThashoShataimiryapipAsAjvaratamaka- hanugrahamanyAstambhaniShThIvanoraHpArshvashUlasvarabhedahikkAshvAsAdayaH syuH (1)| rathakShobhAt sandhiparvashaithilyahanunAsAkarNashiraHshUlatodakukShikShobhATopAntrakUjanAdhmAnahRudayendriyoparodha- sphikpArshvava~gkShaNavRuShaNakaTIpRuShThavedanAsandhiskandhagrIvAdaurbalyA~ggAbhitApapAdashophaprasvApaharShaNAdayaH (2)| atica~gkamaNAt pAdaja~gghorujAnuva~gkShaNashroNIpRuShThashUlasakthisAdanistoda- piNDikodveShTanA~ggamardAMsAbhitApasirAdhamanIharShashvAsakAsAdayaH (3)| atyAsanAdrathakShobhajAH sphikpArshvava~gkShaNavRuShaNakaTIpRuShThavedanAdayaH (4)| ajIrNAdhyashanAbhyAM tu mukhashoShAdhmAnashUlanistodapipAsAgAtrasAdacchardyatIsAramUrcchAjvarapravAhaNAmaviShAdayaH(5)| viShamAhitAshanAbhyAmanannAbhilAShadaurbalyavaivarNyakaNDUpAmAgAtrasAdavAtAdiprakopajAshca grahaNyarshovikArAdayaH (6)| divAsvapnAdarocakAvipAkAgninAshastaimityapANDutvakaNDUpAmAdAhacchardya~ggamardahRutstambhajADyatandrAnidrA- prasa~ggagranthijanmadaurbalyaraktamUtrAkShitAtAlulepAH (7)| vyavAyAdAshubalanAshorusAdashirobastigudameDhrava~gkShaNorujAnuja~gghApAdashUlahRudayaspandananetrapIDA~ggashaithilya- shukramArgashoNitAgamanakAsashvAsashoNitaShThIvanasvarAvasAdakaTIdaurbalyaikA~ggasarvA~ggarogamuShkashvayathu- vAtavarcomUtrasa~ggashukravisargajADyavepathubAdhiryaviShAdAdayaH syuH; avalupyata iva gudaH, tADyata iva meDhram, avasIdatIva mano, vepate hRudayaM, pIDyante sandhayaH, tamaH praveshyata iva ca (8)| ityevamebhiraShTabhirapacArairete prAdurbhavantyupadravAH||14||

teShAM siddhiH- tatroccairbhAShyAtibhAShyajAnAmabhya~ggasvedopanAhadhUmanasyoparibhaktasnehapAnarasakShIrAdirvAtaharaH sarvo vidhirmaunaM ca (1)| rathakShobhAtica~gkramaNAtyAsanajAnAM snehasvedAdivAtaharaM karma sarvaM nidAnavarjanaM ca (2)| ajIrNAdhyashanajAnAM niravasheShatashchardanaM rUkShaH svedo la~gghanIyapAcanIyadIpanIyauShadhAvacAraNaM ca (3)| viShamAhitAshanajAnAM yathAsvaM doShaharAH kriyAH (4)| divAsvapnajAnAM dhUmapAnala~gghanavamanashirovirecanavyAyAmarUkShAshanAriShTadIpanIyauShadhopayogaH pragharShaNonmardanapariShecanAdishca shleShmaharaH sarvo vidhiH (5)| maithunajAnAM jIvanIyasiddhayoH kShIrasarpiShorupayogaH, tathA vAtaharAH svedAbhya~ggopanAhA vRuShyAshcAhArAH snehAH snehavidhayo yApanAbastayo~anuvAsanaM ca; mUtravaikRutabastishUleShu cottarabastirvidArIgandhAdigaNajIvanIyakShIrasaMsiddhaM tailaM syAt||15||

Commentary: teShAM siddhiriti teShAmuktavikArANAM sAdhanaM bheShajamityarthaH| niravasheShatashchardanamiti ajIrNAnnasya niravasheShatashchardanam| mUtravaikRutetyAdi yadA maithunAnmUtravaikRutAdi bhavati tadA vidArigandhAdijIvanIyagaNAbhyAM kvAthakalkIkRutAbhyAM sakShIraM tailaM sAdhayitvottarabastirdeyaH||15||

idamakhilamadhItya samyagarthAn vimRushati yo~avimanAH prayoganityaH| sa manujasukhajIvitapradAtA bhavati dhRutismRutibuddhidharmavRuddhaH||51||

Commentary: tantrAdhyayanaphalamAha- idamakhilamityAdi| avimanA iti tantrArthAvicalitamanAH| prayoganitya iti nityaM cikitsA kartavyatayA yasya saH| sukhasya jIvitasya ca pradAtA; kiMvA sukArUpasya jIvitasya pradAtA sukhajIvitapradAtA| dhRutyAdIti upacitA dhRutismRutibuddhidharmA yasya sa dhRutismRutibuddhidharmavRuddhaH||51||
(yasya dvAdashasAhasrI hRudi tiShThati saMhitA| so~arthaj~jaH sa vicAraj~jashcikitsAkushalashca saH||52||
rogAMsteShAM cikitsAM ca sa kimarthaM na budhyate| cikitsA vahniveshasya susthAturahitaM prati||53||
yadihAsti tadanyatra yannehAsti na tatkvacit| agniveshakRute tantre carakapratisaMskRute||54||
siddhisthAne~aShTame prApte tasmin dRuDhabalena tu| siddhisthAnaM svasiddhyarthaM samAsena samApitam)||55||
iti carakasaMhitAyAM aShTamaM siddhisthAnaM sampUrNamsamApteyaM carakasaMhitA
pArisheShyAdevottarabastisiddhirabhidhIyate| uttarANAM shreShThAnAM bastInAM siddhiruttarabastisiddhiH||1-2||

vakShyamANabastInAM viShayaM mithyopacArajanitavyAdhisamUhaM darshayituM samyagupacArameva tAvadAha- atha svalvityAdi| vamanAdibhiriti vamanavirecananirUhashirovirecanaiH; kintu nirUhashirovirecanayorna sarvaM vakShyamANaM peyAdi sambadhyate, tenAyaM krama etayorna bhavati| muktasandhAnabandhanamiti muktasandhibandhanam| kRushAshayamiti doShashUnyAmAshayam| pratIkArAsahiShNumiti uccairbhAShyAdikriyAkShamaM; kiMvA vamanAdiprayogAsahiShNum| paripAlayet sarvasmAdapacArata iti sambandhaH| taruNANDAdidRuShTAntatrayAbhidhAnaM kasyacit ki~jcit prasiddhaM bhaviShyatItyabhiprAyeNa||3-5||

pratij~jAtAn yApanabastInAha- yApanAshcetyAdi| sarvakAlaM deyA ityanena pUrvanirUhANAmasArvakAlikatvaM darshayati; eteShAM ca sarvasmin kAle dAnamaviruddham| AyuSho yApanaM dIrdhakAlAnuvartanaM kurvantIti yApanA bastayaH| mustetyAdau khaNDashaH klRuptAnIti khaNDaM khaNDaM kRutAni| pAdajA~ggalarasa iti yathoktakShIrakRutakvAthapAdikajA~ggalarasa ityarthaH| tulyaM madhunA ghRutaM yasmin sa tulyamadhughRutaH; etena pUrvaM bastau yathAniyamitasnehamAnena yAvad ghRutaM deyaM bhavati tAvanmAnaM madhvapyatra deyam| asmiMshca bastau pUrvoktabastimAnavibhAgenaiva bastiH kalpayitavyaH| atra kShIraM kaShAyasthAne bhavati| shatakusumA shatapuShpA| sasaindhavamiti IShatsaindhavam| eraNDamUletyAdirdvitIyaH| tadvat sahacaretyAdikastRutIyaH| tadvaditi pUrvavadbastividhAnena| tathA bRuhatItyAdikashcaturthaH| atra ca bastau phalashrutirnAsti, sAmAnyena ‘ityete bastayaH snehAshcoktA’ ityAdinA vakShyamANA phalashrutirj~jeyA| balAtibalAvidArItyAdikaH pa~jcamaH| balAtibalArAsnetyAdikaH ShaShThaH| shuShkamUlakANAM cetyatra ‘dviprasRutaM’ ityanuvartate| nirUhapramANsheShaM kaShAyamiti nirUhapuTakatrayayogyapramANaM kaShAyam; evaM puTakatrayadeyAH pa~jcakaShAyaprasRutAH sthApyA bhaviShyanti| kvAthaparibhAShayaiva kartavyo~atra ca kvAthaH| nirUhapramANasheShaM kaShAyaM madhukamadanAdinA yuktaM siddhaM bastiM dadyAditi yojanIyam| hapuShetyAdikaH saptamaH| stimitAH shuShkAH punaH kaNDitAH kShuNNA ucyante| pUrvapaThitaM mustAdikamatra pradeshe kAshmIrAH paThanti| hrasvapa~jcamUlItyAdiko~aShTamaH| balAtibalApAmArgetyAdiko navamaH| balAmadhuketyAdiko dashamaH| atra balAdikaShAyasya punarAjena payasA pAkAt kShIrasheShaH pAkaH kartavyaH| shAliparNItyAdika ekAdashaH| sthiretyAdiko dvAdashaH| erakA hoggalaH| kalpashcetyAdinA AtideshikAstrayo~abhidhIyante||16-17||

rasottareNopacaredityatra rasaH mAMsarasarUpa uttare yasmin tena peyAdinA rasottareNa krameNa; kiMvA vamanavirecanayorantare peyAdinA krameNopacaret, nirUhe tu rasottareNeti vyavasthA| tatra ca nirUhe stokAgnimAndyApekShyA rasAdireva kramo bhavatIti pratipAditameva prAk; kiMvA rasAbhyAsakrama uttarakAlaM yasmin tena peyAdinA rasottareNa| rasAbhyAsakramamevAha- snigdhAmlasvAduhRudyAnItyAdi| peyAkramottarakAlaM yadA virecanAdikarmAntaraM na kartavyaM tadA saMshodhanamUlasharIrasya prakRutibhojanArthaM balApyAyanArthaM cAyaM rasAbhyAsakramo j~jeyaH; anye tu peyAdikrame eva rasasaMskArArthaM snigdhAmlasiddhAdikramaM varNayanti| atra cAmlasvAdU prathamaM pakvAshayasthitavAtaprashamanAyopayujyete, tathA~amlalavaNai tadUrdhvasthitAgnisandhukShaNArthaM, tataH pittaprashamanArthaM svAdutiktau, tataH pittordhvasthitakaphaprashamanArthaM kaShAyakaTukau, ityeSha kramaH| atrApi ca yau rasau pratyanIkabhUtau tAveva mishritAvupayujyete| eShAM caturNAM rasayugmAnAmupayogaH peyAdikrame eva| evaM dvAdashAnnakAlaiH sarvarasabhojanaprAptiruttamavidhayA j~jeyA| anyonyetyAdi| anyonyapratyanIkAnAmiti parasparamabhibhAvakAnAm| vyatyAsAdupayojayediti ekaM yugmamupayujyAparasya yugmasyopayogaH| prakRutiM gamayediti prakRutibhojanaM gamayet| prakArAntaraM rasAbhyAse prAha- snigdharUkShayoriti| snigdharasamupayujya rUkSho yojyaH, rUkShaM vopayujya snigdha ityanena krameNa prakRutibhojanaM gamayedityarthaH| snigdharUkShau cAtrodAharaNArthamupAtau, tena gurulaghvAdiyugmarasavyatyAsAbhyAso~apyatra boddhavyaH| kiMvA kaShAyakaTukau tata ityanena yugmarasAbhyAsa upadarshitaH, anyonyapratyanIkAnAmityAdinA tu pratyekaM pratyanIkAnAmanyonyavyatyAsenAbhyAsa ucyate||6-8||
ubhayArthakarA dRuShTA iti snehabastinirUhayoripi sAdhyamarthaM snehanaM shodhanaM ca kurvata iti bhAvaH||20-22||

shikhigonardetyAdinA uktabastisa~ggrahaM karoti| sa~ggrahArthashca pUrvameva vyAhRutaH| ekonatriMshadityete iti pratyekaM nirdiShTA bastayaH snehaiH samamekonatriMshadbhavantItyarthaH| samAhArasa~gkhyAmAha- dve shate ShoDashottare iti| tacca yathA~asmAbhirvyAkhyAtaM tathA vyaktameva pUryate| ativRuShamiti shukropacayavantam| stambhitAshceti madhunA stambhitAH||24-28||-

etacchophAdiShu cikitsAmAha- ariShTetyAdi| tasmAditi yApanAtyarthaprayoge shothAdidarshanAt| na prasa~ggata iti na abhyAsataH seveta| tebhyo rakShediti uccairbhAShyAdijanyavyApabhdyo rakShet||31-32||-

etacchAstrasaMskAropapatyupadarshanapUrvakaM shAstrasya saMskArakau carakadRuDhabalau darshayannAha dRuDhabalaH- vistArayatItyAdi| yasmAcchAstre prathamamativistAratayA kvacilleshoktyA ca pratipAditeShu na samyagarthAvagamaH, tena tadativistaraleshoktadoShanirAsArthaM saMskartA yujyate, ataH tantrottamamidaM carakeNa saMskRutam| pUrvagranthasya cAtIva vistaratvAdinA tantrAbhidhAnaM pUrvashrotRujanAbhiprAyAdeva boddhavyam; idAnIntanashrotRupuruShAbhiprAyeNa tu saMskartuH saMskAro j~jeyaH| uktaM ca- “sa~gkShepoktamatihanti vistaroktaM na gRuhyate| sa~gkShepavistarau hitvA saMskuryAcchAstramAditaH” iti| purANaM ca punarnavamiti vistArasa~gkShepAdinA punarnavaM kurute| carakasaMskArApUrNatAM darshayan dRuDhabala Aha- tatvityAdi| tRutIyo bhAgastribhAgaH| tribhAgAsampUrNatA ceyamadUrAntaratayoktA, tena dRuDhabalapratipAditaikacatvAriMshadadhyAyAnAM na saviMshAdhyAyashatatribhAgatA yujyate iti nodbhAvanIyam| AtmanaH pa~jcanadapurabhavatvena shreShThapradeshabhavatvaM darshayati| AtmanaH saMskAre tantrAntarAnItArthena saMskAraM darshayannAha- kRutvA bahubhya ityAdi| tantrebhyaH sushrutavidehAditantrebhyaH| visheShasya carakoktArthAdatiriktarUpasya u~jchashilarUpa uccayo visheSho~jchashiloccayaH; tamanyatantrebhyaH kRutvA saptadashauShadhAdhyAyasiddhikalpairidamanyUnashabdArthaM tantradoShavivarjitaM ShaDviMshattantrayuktibhirbhUShitamapUrayadRuDhabala iti yojanA| tatra bhUmipatitAnAmaNUnAM dhAnyAdibIjAnAM shodhanyA saMharaNamu~jchaH; praviralasya tu kaNishAdirUpatayA patitasya cayanaM shilaH| etena tantreShu yatsArabhUtaM taccarakAcAryaiH sa~ggRuhItaM; mayA tu urvaritaM parishiShTaM kRutvA pUritamiti darshayati| anyUnashabdamanyUnArthaM ceti anyUnashabdArtham| tantradoShAshcaturdasha “punaruktaM duShpraNItasUtrasa~ggrahamakramaM” (vi.a.8) ityAdinA rogabhiShagjitIyoktAstairvarjitam | tantrayuktibhiriti vakShyamANatantrayuktibhiH| vicitrAbhiriti vicitrArthanyAyayuktAbhistantrayuktibhiH||36-40||-

tantrayuktIrevAha - tatretyAdi| adhikaraNaM nAma yamarthamadhikRutya pravartate kartA; yathA “vighnabhUtA yadA rogA” (sU.a.1) ityAdi| atra rogAdikamadhikRutyAyurvedo maharShibhiH kRuta iti ‘rogAH’ ityadhikaraNam| yogo nAma yojanA vyastAnAM padAnAmekIkaraNam| udAharaNaM tAvadyathA- pratij~jAhetUdAharaNopanayanigamanAni; tatra pratij~jA- mAtRujashcAyaM garbhaH, hetuH- mAtaramantareNa garbhAnupapatteH, dRuShTAntaH- kUTAgAraH, upanayaH- yathA nAnAdravyasamudAyAt kUTAgArastathA garbhanirvartanaM, tasmAnmAtRujashcAyamityeShAM pratij~jAyogaH; evamanye~api yogArthA vyAkhyeyAH| hetvartho nAmayadanyatrAbhihitamanyatropapadyate; yathA- “samAnaguNAbhyAso hi dhAtUnAM vRuddhikAraNam” (sU.a.12) iti vAtamadhikRutyoktaM, tatra vAtasyeti vaktavye yadayaM samAnashabdaM dhAtUnAmiti karoti, tena yathA vAyostathA rasAdInAmapi samAnaguNAbhyAso vRuddhikAraNamiti gamyate| padArtho nAma padasya padayoH padAnAM vA~arthaH padArthaH| tatra dravyamitipadena khAdayashcetanAShaShThA ucyante; padayorartho nAma yathA- ‘AyuSho veda’ iti padayorAyurbodhakaM tantramityarthaH; evaM padAnAmapyartha udAhAryaH| pradesho nAma yadbahutvAdarthasya kArtsnyenAbhidhAtumashakyamekadeshenAbhidhIyate; yathA- “anupAnaikadesho~ayamuktaH prAyopayogikaH’ (sU.a.27) ityAdi| uddesho nAma sa~gkShepAbhidhAnaM; yathA- “hetuli~ggauShadhaj~jAnaM” (sU.a.1), anena sarvAyurvedAbhidheyoddeshaH| nirdesho nAma sa~gkhyeyoktasya vivaraNaM; yathA- hetuli~ggauShadhasya punaH prapa~jcanaM “sarvadA sarvabhAvAnAM” ityAdinA “ityuktaM kAraNaM”(sU.a.1) ityantena kAraNaprapa~jcanamityAdi| vAkyasheSho nAma yallAghavArthamAcAryeNa vAkyeShu padamakRutaM gamyamAnatayA pUryate; yathA “pravRuttirhetubhAvAnAM” (sU.a.16) ityatra ‘asti’ iti padaM pUryate, tathA “jA~ggalajai rasaiH” ityatra mAMsashabdaH pUryate| vAkyeShu caita eva padAH sheShAH kriyante, ye~aniveshitA api pratIyante| prayojanaM nAma yadarthaM kAmayamAnaH pravartate; yathA- “dhAtusAmyakriyA coktA tantrasyAsya prayojanam” (sU.a.1)| upadesho nAmAptAnushAsanaM; yathA- “snehamagre prayu~jjIta tataH svedamanantaram” (sU.a.13) ityAdi| apadesho nAma yatpratij~jAtArthasAdhanAya hetuvacanaM; yathA- “vAtAjjalaM jalAddeshaM deshAt kAlaM svabhAvataH| vidyAdduShparihAryatvAt” (vi.a.3) ityAdi, tatra pratij~jAtArthasya hetuvacanaM- duShparihAryatvAditi| atidesho nAma yatki~jcideva prakAshyArthamanuktArthasAdhanAyaiva evamanyadapi pratyetavyamiti paribhAShyate; yathA- “yaccAnyadapi ki~jcit syAdanuktamiha pUjitam| vRutaM tadapi cAtreyaH sadaivAbhyanumanyate” (sU.a.8) iti| arthApattirnAma yadakirtitamarthAdApadyate sA~arthApattiH; yathA- naktaM dadhibhojananiShedhaH, arthAddivA bhu~jjItetyApadyate| nirNayo nAma vicAritasyArthasya vyavasthApanaM; yathA- catuShpadabheShajatvAdi vicAraM kRutvA~abhidhIyate- “yaduktaM ShoDashakalaM pUrvAdhyAye bheShajaM tadyuktiyuktamalamArogyAya” (sU.a.10) iti| prasa~ggo nAma pUrvAbhihitasyArthasya prakaraNAgatatvAdinA punarabhidhAnaM; yathA- “tatrAtiprabhAvatAM dRushyAnAtimAtradarshanamatiyogaH” (sU.a.11) evamAdyabhidhAya, punaH “atyugrashabdashravaNAcchravaNAt sarvasho na ca” (shA.a.1) ityAdinA pUrvokta evArtho~abhidhIyate| ekAnto nAma yadavadhAraNenocyate; yathA- nijaH sharIradoShotthaH, trivRudvirecayatItyAdi| anaikAnto nAma anyatarapakShAnavadhAraNaM, yathA- “ye hyAturAH kevalAdbheShajAdRute mriyante, na ca te sarva eva bheShajopapannAH samuttiShTheran” (sU.a.10) ityAdi| apavargo nAma sAkalyenoddiShTasyaikadeshApakarShaNaM; yathA- “na paryuShitAnnamAdadItAnyatra mAMsaharitakashuShkashAkaphalabhakShyebhyaH” (sU.a.8) iti| atra hi sAmAnyena paryuShitabhakShaNaniShedhaM kRutvA mAMsAdeH paryuShitasyApi bhakShaNamapakRuShya vidhIyate| viparyayo nAma apakRuShTAt pratIpodAharaNaM; yathA- “nidAnoktAnyasya nopasherate viparItAni copasherate” (ni.a.3) iti| pUrvapakSho nAma pratij~jAtArthasandUShakaM vAkyaM; yathA- “matsyAnna payasA~abhyavaharet” iti pratij~jAtasyArthasya “sarvAneva matsyAnna payasA~abhyavaharedanyatra cilicimAt” (sU.a.26) iti| vidhAnaM nAma sUtrakArashca vidhAya varNayati; yathA- “malAyanAni bAdhyante duShTairmAtrAdhikairmalaiH” ityatra duShTishabdena malAnAM hInatvamadhikatvamAcAryagRuhItamAcAryo varNayati- “malavRuddhiM gurutayA lAghavAnmalasa~gkShayam| malAyanAnAM budhyeta sa~ggotsargAdatIva ca” (sU.a.7) iti; kecittu prakaraNAnupUrvyA~arthAbhidhAnaM vidhAnamAhuH, yathA- rasarudhiramAMsamedosthimajjashukrANAmutpAdakramAnurodhenAbhidhAnam| anumataM nAma ekIyamatasyAnivAraNenAnumananaM; yathA- “garbhashalyasya jarAyuHprapAtanaM karma saMshamanamityeke” (shA.a.8) ityAdyekIyamataM pratipAdyApratiShedhAdanumanyate| vyAkhyAnaM nAma yat sarvabuddhyaviShayaM vyAkriyate, yathA- “prathame mAsi sammUrchitaH sarvadhAtukaluShIkRutaH kheTabhUto bhavatyavyaktavigrahaH” (shA.a.4) ityAdinA~asmadAdyaviditArthavyAkaraNam| saMshayo nAma visheShAkA~gkShAnirdhAritobhayaviShayaj~jAnaM, yathA- “mAtaraM pitaraM caike manyante janmakAraNam| svabhAvaM paranirmANaM yadRucchAM cApare janAH||” (sU.a.11) ityAdinoktaH saMshayaH| atItAvekShaNaM nAma yadatItamevocyate; yathA- “sA kuTI tacca shayanaM jvaraM saMshamayatyapi” (ci.a.3) ityatra svedAdhyAyavihitakuTyAdikamatItamavekShate anAgatAvekShaNaM nAma yadanAgataM vidhiM pramANikRutyArthasAdhanaM; yathA- “athavA tiktasarpiShaH” ityAdyanAgatAvekShaNenocyate| svasa~jj~jA nAma yA tantrakArairvyavahArArthaM sa~jj~jA kriyate; yathA- jentAkaholAkAdikA sa~jj~jA| UhyaM nAma yadanibaddhaM granthe praj~jayA tarkyatvenopadishyate; yathA- “parisa~gkhyAtamapi yadyad dravyamayaugikaM manyeta tattadapakarShayet” (vi.a.8) iti| samuccayo nAma yadidaM cedaM ceti kRutvA vidhIyate; yathA- ‘varNashca svarashca’ (i.a.1) ityAdi| nidarshanaM nAma- mUrkhaviduShAM buddhisAmyaviShayo dRuShTAntaH; yathA- “vij~jAtamamRutaM yathA” (sU.a.1) ityAdi| nirvacanaM nAma paNDitabuddhigamyo dRuShTAntaH; yathA- “j~jAyate nityagasyeva kAlasyAtyayakAraNam” (sU.a.16) iti| nidarshananirvacanayorayaM visheShaH- yannidarshanaM mUrkhaviduShAM buddhisAmAnyaviShayaM, nirvacanaM tu paNDitabuddhivedyameva; kiMvA nirvacanaM niruktiH- yathA- “vividhaM sarpati yato visarpastena sa~jj~jitaH” (ci.a.21) ityAdi| niyogo nAma avashyAnuShTheyatayA vidhAnaM; yathA- “na tvayA svedamUrcchAparItenApi piNDikaiShA vimoktavyA” (sU.a.14) ityAdi| vikalpaH pAkShikAbhidhAnaM; yathA- “sArodakaM vA~atha kushodakaM vA” (ci.a.6) ityAdi| pratyutsAro nAma upapattyA paramatanivAraNaM; yathA vAryovidaH prAha- “rasajAni tu bhUtAni rajasA vyAdhayaH smRutAH” (sU.a.25) ityAdi, hiraNyAkSho niShedhayati- “na hyAtmA rajasaH smRutaH” ityAdi| uddhAro nAma parapakShadUShaNaM kRutvA svapakShoddharaNaM; yathA- “yeShAmeva hi bhAvAnAM sampat sa~jjanayennaram| teShAmeva hi bhAvAnAM vipadvyAdhInudIrayet” (sU.a.25) ityAdinA svapakShoddharaNam| sambhavo nAma yadyasminnupapadyate sa tasya sambhavaH; yathA- mukhe pipluvya~gganIlikAdayaH sambhavantItyAdi| ityetAH ShaTtriMshattantrayuktayo vyAhRutAH| bhaTTAraharicandreNa tvanyAshcatasrastantrayuktayaH pariprashna-vyAkaraNa-vyutkrAntAbhidhAna-hetvAkhyA vyAhRutAH; tAshca tantre~apaThitatvAdetA svevAntarbhAvanIyAH| tatra pariprashna uddeshe~antarbhavati, vyAkaraNaM tu vyAkhyAne, vyutkrAntAbhidhAnaM nirdeshaprabhedaH, hetushabdena yAni pratyakShAdIni pramANAnyuktAni tAni hetAvantarbhavanti| vyAkhyA pa~jcadashaprakArA, saptavidhA kalpanA, ekaviMshatirarthAshrayAH, saptadasha tAcchIlyAni, caturdasha ca tantradoShA bhavanti, taduttaratantre pratipAditatvAnneha vilikhitA AcAryeNa (?)||41-44||-
samyakshAstrAbhyAsaphalamAha- ekasminnapItyAdi||47-48||

shAstre durj~jAnasamyakj~jAnayordoShaguNAnAha- durgRuhItamityAdi| durgRuhItaM shastraM yathA~a~atmana eva karacchedAdikamApAdayati, tathA durgRuhItaM shAstraM mithyAbheShajaprayogAdAtmano~api vyApadamAvahati, yathA vA shastraM sugRuhItaM taskarAdibhyo rakShAM karoti, tathA sugRuhItaM shAstramAtmana Aturasya ca rakShAmApAdayatIti| tasmAdetA ityAdikaM shlokamuttare tantre tantreyuktivyAkaraNe pratipAdakaM paThanti, taM cAnArShaM vRuddhA vadanti, agniveshatantre uttaratantrAsyaivAnArShatvAt||49-50||

tajjA ityAdi yathAkramaM uccairbhAShyAdijA dehordhvapIDAdayo j~jeyAH| uccairbhAShyAdUrdhvadehe pIDA, rathakShobhAt sarvadehapIDA, atica~gkramaNAdadhaH pIDA, atyAsanAddehamadhyapIDA, ajIrNabhojanenAmajAH, ahitabhojanena doShajAH, divAsvapnena shleShmajAH, maithunena kShayajA iti||10-12||

atroccairbhAShyAdiko granthaH prAyo vyakta eva| atibhAShitasyAsUtritasyoccairbhAShyeNa samAnatvAdudAharaNam| piNDikodveShTanaM ja~gghApiNDikayorudveShTanAkArA vedanA| sirAdhamanIharShaH sirAdhamanyorucchUla(na)tvam| rathakShobhajA ityukte sandhishaithilyAdInAmapi prasaktiH syAdatastannirAsArthamAha- sphikpArshvava~gkShaNavRuShaNakaTIpRuShThavedanAdayaH syuriti| ajIrNAdhyashanAbhyAmityatra ajIrNAshanasyAmajavikArakartRutvAdadhyashanasyAsUtritasyopAdAnam| evamahitAshanajavikArasamAnavikArakAritvAdviShamAshanasyApyasUtritasyopAdAnam| avalupyata iva chidyata iva||13-14||
yasya dvAdashasAhasrItyAdishlokatrayaM kecit paThanti; taccAprastutamiti||52-55||
